instructions: Boil hen; debone and cut into small pieces. Put fat in pan. Add

title: Blueberry Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs oil sugar and vanilla on low speed for 1 minute. Add flour baking soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. Beat 15 seconds on low then 45 more seconds on medium speed. Stir in nuts and blueberries. Spread batter in greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme; mix until well blended. Serve with fresh fruit and cookies as dippers. Yields 2 cups.

title: Caramel Topping
instructions: Boil in pan for about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Keep water over can. Makes an excellent topping for sliced apples or use on ice cream.

title: Spiced Orange Juice
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes then chill. Just before serving strain this mixture into punch bowl or pitcher. Add orange juice concentrate and ginger ale.

title: Microwave Cheese Pastry Snacks
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mix together cheese flour cereal walnuts garlic salt butter bacon and water with a fork until a dough forms. Drop 7 level tablespoons in a circle onto each of 3 lightly buttered plates suitable for microwave. (Butter plates only around edges where dough will be placed.) Sprinkle with paprika. Microwave one plate at a time at High for 2 3/4 to 3 1/4 minutes rotating dish 1/4 turn after 1 1/2 minutes. Dough will be slightly puffed when done and will be crisp on drying. Remove immediately from plate. Serve hot or cold. Repeat with remaining mixture. Makes 21 snacks.

title: Southern Tea
instructions: Steep tea bags in 2 cups boiling water for 1 minute. Combine in gallon pitcher and add enough water and ice to fill completely.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Brown meat and garlic in skillet and drain fat. Blend next 3 ingredients in a bowl; stir in meat/garlic. Boil stuffing shells according to directions on package; drain. Fill each shell with cheese/meat mixture. Place in a baking pan; cover with spaghetti sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover pan with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Brown meat well in round frying pan or wok. When done add Worcestershire and soy sauces and all the vegetables. Cook for about 10 to 15 minutes and add teriyaki sauce. (You may add more teriyaki than recipe calls for.) When done serve over rice or pasta. M-mmm good!

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix eggs flour baking powder and sugar; mix well. Add corn. Gradually add milk. Pour into well-buttered dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Flour roast on both sides then brown in frying pan. Put roast and all the other ingredients into crock-pot (6-quart size if possible). Start the night before or cook the standard 8 to 9 hours. Cook on medium or low.

title: Alice'S New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Drain and reserve clam liquid. Add enough water to clam liquid to make 2 cups. Fry bacon of pork until crisp. Remove bacon or pork and crumble and set aside. Saute onions in bacon grease for about 5 minutes drain and add to potatoes and simmer in clam liquid until thick. (I use a masher and slightly mash potatoes to make them thicken) It should be fairly thick. Add approx. 2 Tbsp. of the bacon grease to the chowder. Add clams cream salt & pepper & butter. Reheat but do not boil. Top with crumbled bacon or salt pork and serve. Makes about 2 1/2 to 3 quarts.

title: Turkey Divan With Peaches
instructions: Simmer turkey in an inch of water for 15 to 20 minutes until the pieces are no longer pink. Cook broccoli to package directions without salt. In small bowl stir together the sour cream mayonnaise onion powder and garlic powder. Spray shallow baking pan with nonstick spray. Add turkey; arrange broccoli and peach halves around tenderloins. Spoon sour cream mixture on top and sprinkle with cheese. Broil 6 to 7-inches from heat for 5 to 6 minutes or until the sour cream mixture is puffy and light brown.

title: Biscuits And Gravy
instructions: Brown turkey sausage. Add water and chopped onion. Blend in flour. Add milk. Cook until thickened. Add mushrooms salt and pepper. Serve on refrigerator biscuits.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Sauce Melt cheese in Ro-Tel. Add chicken and mushroom soup and onion.

title: Homemade Pancake Batter
instructions: Beat egg with hand beater or whip until fluffy. Mix in remaining just until smooth. For thinner pancakes add 1/4 cup milk.

title: Chili And Cheese Dip
instructions: Cut Velveeta into small pieces. Microwave approximately 45 to 60 seconds. Stir. Add 1/2 to 1 whole can of chili depending on taste. Microwave until cheese is melted. Serve hot with nacho chips.

title: Spanakopita(Greek Spinach Pie)
instructions: Brown onion in olive oil. Put browned onion in bowl with spinach (well drained) eggs and cheeses. Mix well. Add salt and pepper (if you like) dill and parsley. Melt butter. Brush 9 x 13-inch pan with butter. Layer filo dough one sheet at a time buttering each one. Put 10 sheets down. Spread spinach mixture. Cover with 10 more sheets of filo brushing each one with butter. With razor blade or sharp knife cut through top 10 sheets to cut into pieces. Bake in 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger and chopped onion; drain. Add all other ingredients; bring to a boil and simmer 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Almond-Spinach Casserole(My Own Concoction)
instructions: Thaw spinach; drain. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet. Saute almonds; set almonds aside. In same skillet saute celery and onion until golden brown (you might need to add another tablespoon of butter). Dilute 1 can soup with 1/3 cup water in which bouillon cube has been dissolved. Add to sauteed vegetables. Simmer 5 minutes. Mix 1/2 of the soup mixture with spinach. Mix remaining soup mixture with rice. Pour spinach mixture into buttered baking dish. Pour over this the rice mixture. Sprinkle toasted almonds on top of rice mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 8. Casserole can be prepared in advance. Freezes well.

title: Peanut Kiss Cookies
instructions: Add egg and vanilla to the first 4 ingredients. Blend in the flour. Shape into balls and roll in white sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Take out and add chocolate kisses. Press into cookies. Bake for 3 minutes longer.

title: Creamy Chip Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Mix other ingredients together until fluffy. Add a large bottle or bag of Armour dried beef that is finely chopped.

title: Chocolate Mint Bars
instructions: Melt margarine and chocolate in saucepan. Beat eggs and sugar well and add chocolate mixture to this. Add flour vanilla salt and chopped walnuts to mixture. Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pan. When cool frost with Peppermint Frosting.

title: Buttery Pound Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large mixing bowl; butter and eggs should be room temperature. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Beat on high speed for 20 minutes; scrape sides with a rubber spatula. Grease well bottom only of tube pan (angel cake pan). Line bottom with wax paper; put into cold oven. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use cake tester; ovens vary. If tester comes out clean its done.

title: Baked Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients including sugar. Add milk melted shortening and well beaten eggs. Mix well; pour in a greased mold cover and bake near center of oven until dinner is done. Serve hot with Chocolate Sauce. This pudding may be steamed if desired.

title: Chicken Pan Pie
instructions: Place chicken in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Add peas and mixed vegetables. Combine soup and broth in a saucepan and bring to a boil; pour over chicken. Next combine butter salt pepper and flour in a saucepan; heat on medium and then add buttermilk. Stir together well. Spoon over top of pie and bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Creamy Fettucini Alfredo
instructions: In a large saucepan combine cream cheese Parmesan cheese butter and milk. Stir over low heat until smooth. Add fettucini and toss lightly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Vegetables On Baked Potatoes
instructions: Spray pan with Pam. Saute bell pepper onion and broccoli until onion is clear. Divide in half and put on each potato.

title: Martha Washington Candy
instructions: Mix all together. Roll into small balls. Dip in waxed chocolate.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Marinate chicken in French dressing for several hours; drain well. Combine with other ingredients. Serves 4.

title: Classic Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Cool some (5 minutes). Put cream cheese cucumbers and onion in blender; blend until bottom of blender is clean. Add other ingredients and beat until mixed. Add dissolved Jell-O. Mix. Pour into ring mold or any Jello mold. Chill until firm. Garnish to suit the meal.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cream all ingredients together with electric mixer except shrimp. Fold shrimp in by hand. Refrigerate until serving time. Serve with favorite crackers.

title: Green Bean Casserole(Low-Fat Recipe)
instructions: In an 8 or 9-inch glass pie plate microwave liquid Butter Buds or chicken broth wheat germ oatmeal Italian seasoning and garlic powder on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir after each minute. Remove mixture from pie plate; set aside. In the same plate combine beans mushrooms and onion. Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes stirring after 2 minutes. Stir in combined sour cream and cornstarch coating vegetables thoroughly. Microwave on High 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened; stir. Sprinkle reserved wheat germ mixture over the top before serving. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Cake Icing
instructions: Boil until thicken 3-4 minutes. Punch holes in cake and ice while still warm.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix fruit and flour together. Add other ingredients adding milk last. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes or until light brown.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken and debone. Cut up meat in skillet with tablespoon of butter or oil. Cook onion pepper both cans of soup tomatoes and chili powder. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add chicken meat. In\t9 x 13-inch pan pour crushed chips in bottom. Pour chicken soup mixture on top of chips. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Dump Pie
instructions: Dump pie filling in a 9 x 12-inch glass pan. Spread pineapple over it. Top with dry cake mix. Chop up margarine and place evenly on top. Sprinkle nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until golden on top.

title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients into a gallon jug. Use only enough oil to fill gallon. Mix well.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine; add brown sugar. Let cool; add eggs flour and vanilla. Mix well. Mix in chips and pecans. Pour in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Be sure not to overbake!

title: Spinach Dip(Microwave)
instructions: To defrost spinach place packages in oven. Microwave at High for 5 minutes turning packages over after half the cooking time. Let stand for 5 minutes. Drain thoroughly; set aside. Place soup mix and water in a small bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at High for 1 minute. Let stand covered until vegetables are rehydrated. Place cream cheese in large bowl. Microwave at 50% (Medium) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until cream cheese is softened. Mix in rehydrated soup mix drained spinach sour cream and red pepper sauce. If desired serve with sour dough or French bread cubes carrot sticks or crackers. Makes 4 cups.

title: Italian Crescent Meat Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In frypan brown ground chuck and onion; drain. Stir in sauce mix and tomato sauce; heat until hot and bubbly. Combine cheese and sour cream. Pour hot meat mixture into greased 12 x 8-inch or 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spoon cheese mixture over meat.

title: Chinese Style Rice
instructions: Scramble egg in oil in saucepan stirring to break into pieces. Add water soy sauce garlic and onions. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice and mushrooms. Cover remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork before serving.

title: Apple Bars
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients like pie crust. Beat egg yolk in measuring cup; add enough milk to make 2/3 cup. Add to crust mixture. Roll out 1/2 of crust to fit large cookie sheet. Put crushed cornflakes over it. Fill with sliced apples. Sprinkle the sugar and cinnamon over the apples. Roll out the other 1/2 of the crust. Put over the top and pinch edges together. Beat egg whites until stiff. Spread over top of crust. Do not add sugar to egg whites. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven and pour following glaze while hot.

title: Broccoli Cheese Dip
instructions: Saute onion in margarine until soft. Cook broccoli according to directions. Add soup to onions. Heat. Slice cheese into soup and onion mixture. Heat until cheese is melted. Add broccoli. Heat though. Serve warm with doritos or nacho chips.

title: Creole Green Beans
instructions: Cook onion and green pepper in fat until onion is yellow. Blend in flour add tomato juice gradually and cook for 5 minutes. Add beans and heat thoroughly.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients; pour in casserole and top with bacon slices. Bake 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini-Potato Pancakes
instructions: Whisk together milk and egg in medium size bowl. Add the flour baking powder salt pepper and garlic. Whisk until smooth. Stir in the potatoes zucchini onion and cheese. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Using 1/4 cup for each pancake cook until browned on underside about 3 minutes. Turn pancake over. Reduce heat to medium-low; cook 5 minutes until cooked through. Keep warm on plate. Repeat. Makes 4 servings or 12 pancakes.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
instructions: Butter casserole. Put bread on bottom; add sausage. Beat eggs; add milk. Sprinkle cheese on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Portobello-Alfredo Sauce
instructions: Remove brown gills from undersides of mushroom caps using a spoon and discard gills. Chop mushrooms. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat; add mushrooms and garlic and saute 5 to 6 minutes or until tender. Stir in cream and milk. Bring to a boil over medium high heat; reduce heat and simmer whisking constantly 10 minutes. Stir in cheese pepper and salt; stir constantly until cheese melts and mixture thickens. Stir in 2 Tbsp. parsley. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Cheesy-Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package omitting salt; drain well. Saute onion in butter in a medium saucepan. Add broccoli and remaining ingredients to saucepan; cook over medium heat until cheese melts stirring often. Serve immediately. Yields 5 1/2 cups.

title: Beef Chop Suey
instructions: Cook in pressure cooker on high until it steams well. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Turn off heat and let pressure go down. This could be cooked in a regular pan. Should be cooked slow so rice wont stick. This is good served with a fruit salad and rye bread.

title: Scones
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a large cookie sheet. In a medium bowl with a fork mix flour baking powder sugar and salt. With a pastry blender cut in the margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. In a cup beat eggs with a fork. Reserve 1 tablespoon. Put milk into remaining eggs and add this mixture to the flour mixture. Blend until well mixed. Turn dough onto a lightly floured board and roll with a floured rolling pin until dough is 1/2 inch thick. With a knife cut dough into 3-inch squares then cut each square into 2 triangles. Place triangles 1 inch apart onto cookie sheet. Brush with reserved egg and sprinkle with granulated sugar. Bake 10 to 15 minutes until golden. Makes 10 to 12 scones.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place chicken in ungreased large oblong glass baking dish. Cover bottom of pan thoroughly with chicken. Pour soup over chicken. Pour broth over soup. Add drained vegetables over top. Mix together Bisquick and milk. Pour over top of vegetables. Melt butter and pour over mixture. Dont stir any of this together. Just layer as instructed. It mixes by itself. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Bake and debone chicken breasts and lay into a 15 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Prepare Stove Top according to directions. Spread on top of cubed chicken. Mix 1 can water with chicken soup and celery soup and spread on top of Stove Top. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Ripe Olive Tuscan Pot Roast
instructions: Brown beef in oil; add wine or bouillon and water to meat. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until tender.

title: Mountaineer Slaw
instructions: Boil water sugar and vinegar for 3 minutes; set aside to cool. Toss shredded cabbage with salt; let set for 1 hour. Then add remaining ingredients. After liquid has cooled pour over slaw mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Makes 25 or more servings.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Mix all together except mushroom soup. Roll in 1-inch balls. Line in roaster using all mixture. Pour mushroom soup over meatballs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Mexican Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix all above except cheese and chilies. Put half the batter in ungreased loaf pan; layer with chopped chilies layer with cheese and add remaining batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown. Serve with a spoon as a side dish with tacos.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Cook rice in chicken broth after removing fat. Mix together with other ingredients and place in a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place beans and soup into casserole dish and stir until well mixed. Place mixture in oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle top of casserole with fried onions and bake until golden brown about 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken. Mix well until sugar is melted. Marinate meat in sauce for at least for 4 hours. Broil in oven until chicken is cooked thoroughly or grill on an outdoor grill.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix and make into patties and fry in oil.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Grease a large Bundt pan. Cut biscuits in quarters. Mix cinnamon and brown sugar. Roll biscuit quarters in mixture. Drop into pan. Add sugar to melted butter and bring to a boil. Pour over biscuit pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Chili(Microwave)
instructions: Cook ground beef onion and garlic in a covered dish on full power for 8 to 10 minutes or until all pink is gone. Stir 1 to 2 times while cooking. Drain well.

title: Taleroni
instructions: Boil noodles until tender. Drain. Brown ground beef and onion drain. Add to noodles then add all other ingredients. Place slices of cheese on top and heat until cheese is melted.

title: Polish Cabbage And Ground Beef
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain the grease. Add cabbage and simmer until cabbage is tender. Add celery soup and milk. Heat and serve.

title: German Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cook milk sugar egg yolks margarine and vanilla 12 minutes or until thick. Add coconut and nuts.

title: Cocoa Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt cocoa and butter together; add sugar eggs flour vanilla and nuts. Bake in greased pie plate at 325\u00b0 until firm.

title: Orange Breakfast Ring
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine orange peel sugar and cream cheese. Unroll both cans of rolls. Press seams together to form a flat surface. Spread with cream cheese. Roll up as jelly roll form a ring with roll and place on jelly roll pan. From outside cut halfway to center of ring all around ring about 2 inches apart. Give each piece a half turn. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Mix powdered sugar and orange juice. Drizzle on top of ring. Serve warm.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9-inch dish. Put bread buttered side up in dish. Sprinkle cooked sausage and cheese over buttered bread. Mix eggs milk salt and mustard. Pour over bread sausage and cheese. Let stand 6 hours or overnight in refrigerator covered. Take out of refrigerator 15 minutes before baking at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until set. Great for breakfast brunch or anytime!

title: Cinnamon Baked Apples
instructions: Place apples in an ungreased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Drizzle with lemon juice. Toss to coat. Set aside.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients in greased casserole dish. Top with reserved crumbs; dot with 1 tablespoon margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Salad-Pretzel Crust
instructions: Combine pretzels margarine and sugar. Spread mixture in 11 x 7 baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Shrimp Casserole Harpin
instructions: Early in the day cook shrimp as directed. Place in 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with lemon juice and oil. Cook rice as label directs; drain. Refrigerate all. About 1 hour and 10 minutes before serving start heating oven to 350\u00b0. In butter saute green pepper and onion for 5 minutes. Add to shrimp in casserole along with rice and other ingredients except 1/4 cup almonds and paprika. Top with reserved almonds and sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered for 55 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss gently. Makes 8 (3/4 cup) servings.

title: Dessert Kolachy
instructions: Thoroughly blend margarine softened cream cheese and sugar. Add flour baking powder and salt; mix well. Knead to form stiff dough; roll to 1/4-inch thickness on well-floured board. Cut into 2-inch squares. Place 1/2 teaspoon preserves in center; press opposite corners together. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from racks and cool. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Slice onions sprinkle with salt; mix with green tomatoes. Hang up in cloth bag overnight to drain.

title: Onion Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Fruit Bowl
instructions: Drain cans of fruit saving one cup of juice. Mix juice and instant pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. May add grapes or cantaloupe.

title: Creamy Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Prepare the pastry by sifting the flour with the salt. Cut in the shortening. Put in the egg yolk. Blend the egg white with the water and reserve. Mix well and divide the dough into two portions; one twice as large as the other. Roll out large portion for pie shell and roll out small portion and cut into strips for lattice top. Brush the pie shell with part of beaten egg white reserve remainder. Prepare the rhubarb filling by beating the eggs and adding the flour salt and sugar. Blend until very thick and lemon colored prior to adding rhubarb. Pour into pie crust and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for an additional 30-35 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in a 9-inch glass baking pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine cake mix margarine and pecans. (Mixture will be crumbly.) Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Serve with whipped topping if desired.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Drain peas; add mushroom soup. Add egg slices and pimento peppers. Top with crushed crackers and dot with butter pats. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Sprinkle cheese on top and melt. Serve piping hot.

title: Chocolate Custard
instructions: In a large pot heat milk with sugar to boiling. Once it boils turn down the heat to low and cook stirring often with a wooden spatula for about 12 minutes. Add dairy milk chocolate chocolate syrup and cocoa. Using a wire whisk mix well making sure that no lumps of cocoa remain. Cook another 15-20 minutes stirring frequently.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Brown onions and peppers in butter. Set aside. Parboil zucchini with dash of salt and pepper. Cook until tender and drain. Mix corn with eggs; mix all ingredients together and turn into oblong pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hamburg Soup
instructions: Place all ingredients in kettle and simmer until potatoes are tender.

title: Birds In A Nest
instructions: Cut 1 to 1 1/2-inch diameter hole in center of English muffin (it will resemble a doughnut). Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet. Place English muffins in skillet on medium heat until toasted on both sides. Crack 1 egg into hole of each muffin; cook until eggs are set flipping once. In another skillet melt 1 tablespoon butter and add ham. Cook just enough to warm ham. Top English muffin with ham and then shredded cheese to taste. Top with parsley sprig if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Thinly slice squash. Boil in salted water until tender. Drain. Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased casserole dish. Top with reserved cheese if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. This makes an even better tasting dish when rewarmed the next day.

title: Festive Lasagna
instructions: Prepare lasagna according to package directions drain. Combine sausage onion and garlic. Cook until sausage is no longer pink stirring occasionally; drain. Stir in next 7 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat simmer for 20 minutes. In a medium size bowl blend Ricotta egg parsley and salt. Spread a thin layer of sauce in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Layer 1/3 each lasagna remaining sauce Ricotta mixture Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Repeat layers. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until bubbly about an hour. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together; put in freezer can. Fill can with milk allowing 2 inches from top of freezer.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Arrange cooked broccoli in greased baking dish. Place skinned cut-up cooked chicken on top. Combine soups mayo and lemon juice. Pour over all. Sprinkle with cheese. Melt butter and stir in bread crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Braised Pork Chops
instructions: Coat chops with mixture of flour salt mustard and garlic salt. Brown on both sides in hot oil in skillet. Put chops in crock-pot.\tAdd chicken soup. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or high 3 to 4 hours.

title: Hot Sausage And Beans Casserole
instructions: Brown the sausage onions and celery. Mix the tomato soup tomato paste brown sugar and mustard and simmer 15 minutes. In a separate pan mix the green beans yellow beans butter beans kidney beans and hot chili beans and bring to a boil. Simmer 15 minutes. Mix all together in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish; add bacon strips to top. Bake approximately 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven or until bacon is browned and beans are heated through.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Heat vegetable oil. Use a deep fat fryer or use approximately 2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan. Mix dry ingredients. Add egg and buttermilk until you reach a consistency that the mixture will hold its shape when rolled into a ball. Fold in chopped onion. Roll into 1 to 2 inch balls and drop into hot vegetable oil. Fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Rock Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour baking powder and sugar together. Cut in the butter until it resembles coarse bread crumbs. Stir in raisins eggs and milk to form a stiff batter. Drop rounded tablespoons of batter onto well-greased baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake to golden color about 15 minutes.

title: Company Carrots
instructions: Combine carrots mayonnaise onion carrot water and horseradish. Add salt and pepper to taste. Top with crumbs and cheese. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: In a mixing bowl blend the Cheddar cheese cream cheese butter and nuts. Pack the spread into a 1 cup crock custard cup or small bowl. Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled as a spread for crackers.

title: Crabmeat-Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms and remove stems. Dice the stems. Cook mushroom stems onion seasonings and garlic in butter or margarine until translucent. Remove from heat. Stir in bread crumbs. Add water or more melted butter if needed to moisten stuffing. Add crabmeat. Fill the mushroom caps with stuffing and place on baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat Crisco eggs sugar baking soda and baking powder. Add cocoa. Alternate flour and water. Beat well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Or bake 30 cupcakes for 18 minutes.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Take ends off green beans wash and then cook beans (whole) until almost done. While still hot pack in pint jars; add garlic and dill. Boil vinegar water and salt keeping it hot when packing beans. Then pour over beans and seal. Makes about 4 pints. Tastes like dill pickles.

title: Chicken-Dressing Casserole
instructions: Mix liquids and margarine together. Layer chicken stuffing and liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Add other ingredients; mix well. Pour into a 9-inch graham cracker crust. Freeze.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese mayonnaise and ketchup. Blend well and add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together like a regular cake. Add zucchini last. Stir in zucchini (do not beat). Pour into 2 pans and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Citrus Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the fruit sour cream marshmallows and coconut. Cover and refrigerate for several hours. If desired serve on lettuce lined plates. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hamburger Special
instructions: Brown ground beef onions and uncooked rice in 4 tablespoons shortening. Add garlic powder red kidney beans tomatoes and chili powder. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve with tossed salad.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Brown bacon in heavy saucepan. Add onion and cook until translucent. Add potatoes water salt and pepper. Cook until potatoes are tender. Stir in corn milk parsley and butter. Cook for 10 minutes.

title: Diabetic Chocolate(Hot Or Cold)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Can be stored in a jar or Tupperware container. Use 3 tablespoons of mix for each cup hot water or cold water. Stir well. Use to suit your taste.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ground beef 2 tablespoons chopped onion evaporated milk oats salt and pepper in bowl; mix well. Shape into loaf. Place in a 7 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix Worcestershire sauce with vinegar 3 tablespoons onion water catsup and sugar in bowl. Pour over loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 6 servings.

title: Cheese Tuna Muffins
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons tuna on each muffin. Sprinkle each with about 2 teaspoons reserved cheese and paprika. Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Sweet And Sour Slaw
instructions: Combine shredded cabbage green pepper and onion in a large bowl. Sprinkle with sugar. Combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Pour over cabbage mixture. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Toss just before serving. Serves about 8.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix sugar flour soda salt eggs and fruit cocktail. Pour into ungreased loaf pan. Mix brown sugar and nuts together and sprinkle on top of cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Bilodi Biscuits(Makes 8 To 10 According To Size)
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together; mix with shortening. Add the milk and knead lightly on floured pastry board until smooth. Roll out thin. Cut into desired shape or size. Place in baking pan and bake 15 minutes in moderate oven.

title: Yugoslavian Easter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix margarine sugar egg yolks and flavorings together thoroughly. Blend flour baking powder and cloves; stir into butter mixture. Mix well. Shape into 3/4-inch balls or shape into cylindrical 2-inch half moons. Bake 10 minutes on lightly greased cookie sheet. Do not let brown. Let cool for 2 minutes then remove from cookie sheet and dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Pinto Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown meat of your choice. Saute onions and peppers in 2 tablespoons oil. Mix well the pintos and tomatoes; put in skillet or casserole dish. Mix a box of cornbread mix according to directions on the package. Pour cornbread mixture on top of casserole. Put in a 400\u00b0 oven and bake until cornbread is golden brown on top.

title: Scallops And Broccoli
instructions: Add cornstarch to soup. Saute mushrooms in garlic in 2 tablespoons margarine. Add scallops. Cook 3 minutes. Add broccoli and cook 3 more minutes. Add soup and soy sauce. Bring to boil. Lower heat and cook two minutes covered or until broccoli is crisp cooked. Serve over rice.

title: Prune Spice Cake
instructions: Cover prunes with water. Cover and simmer until tender; do not sweeten. Drain saving 2/3 cup liquid. Add water if necessary. Pit and chop prunes. Sift together dry ingredients. Add prune liquid and oil. Mix to blend and then beat vigorously 2 minutes. Add eggs; beat 1 minute longer. Stir in prunes and pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with crumb top then nuts and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage with onion and drain; set aside. In separate pan bring water to a boil. Add soup celery and rice. Cook these three 10 to 12 minutes. Crumble into soup mixture the sausage and onion mixture. Bake in 2-quart dish at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Caramel Layer Squares
instructions: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in top of double boiler; cook stirring constantly until caramels are completely melted. Remove double boiler from heat.\tCombine dry cake mix remaining 1/3 cup milk butter and nuts; stir until dough holds together. Press 1/2 of cake mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake\tat 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate morsels over crust. Pour caramel mixture over chocolate morsels spreading evenly. Crumble remaining cake mixture over caramel mixture. Return to oven and bake 15 to 18 minutes; cool. Chill 30 minutes; cut into small bars. Yields about 5 dozen.

title: Butter Chunk Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Cut cold butter into 1/4-inch cubes. Toss baking mix and cubes until coated. Beat milk and egg. Stir into butter mixture. Turn dough onto cloth-covered board generously dusted with baking mix. Roll to coat. Fold and knead 10 times. Roll into rectangle (15 x 8-inch). Spread with soft butter. Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over dough. Roll up tightly beginning at 15-inch side. Pinch edge into roll. Cut into 12 slices with sharp knife. Place cut sides down in pan. Bake until golden 15 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Drizzle with glaze. Makes 1 dozen rolls.

title: Green Beans With Mushrooms
instructions: Saut mushrooms in margarine until lightly browned. In another pan cook tomatoes and beans until done. Add this to mushrooms; toss lightly and serve. Serves 6.

title: Easy Microwave Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Blend powdered sugar and cocoa in microwavable mixing bowl. Add milk and butter. Do Not Stir. Cook 2 minutes on High and stir ingredients to blend. Add vanilla and nuts; mix well. Pour into buttered dish. Freeze 20 minutes or chill in the refrigerator 1 hour. Cut into squares.

title: Bisquick Lasagna Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Spread cottage cheese on bottom and sprinkle on Parmesan cheese. Mix cooked meat oregano basil tomato paste and 1/2 cup of the Mozzarella cheese. Spoon into pan. Beat eggs milk Bisquick salt and pepper until smooth. Pour over meat. Bake at 400\u00b0 until knife comes out clean about 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with rest of cheese and bake 5 minutes.

title: Banana Sour Cream Walnut Loaf
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and bananas. Beat until well blended. Sift flour with baking powder soda and salt. Add alternately with sour cream to banana mixture stirring just to blend. Stir in walnuts. Spoon batter into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan greased and floured on the bottom only. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until loaf tests done. Let stand in pan and cool. Wrap in plastic wrap to store.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate Cheddar cheese and blend with cream cheese. Add seasonings and pecans to taste. Form into a single ball. Sprinkle with paprika and roll in pecans.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Slice squash - chop onion. Add sugar salt and pepper and water. Simmer until tender (about 20 minutes). Drain put in buttered casserole. Alternate squash and cheeses. Dot with butter. Pour half and half over all. Cook 25 minutes or until set at 300\u00b0.

title: Parmigiano(Italian Eggplant)
instructions: Skin eggplant and slice it. Dip in egg and fry drain well. Place in a baking dish one layer of eggplant sprinkle of cheese then sauce. Then another layer of eggplant etc. Be certain there is sauce on top. Bake in oven 1 hour. Serve hot and cut like a cake.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Place crushed Doritos chips in bottom of casserole dish. Fry ground beef and onions until done. Drain and then add Worcestershire sauce. Pour hamburger over Doritos. Mix soup and milk and pour over beef. Put the enchilada sauce over soup mixture. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Bake until cheese melts and casserole is heated through.

title: Burnt Sugar Cake
instructions: Burn 1/2 cup of sugar in skillet to deep brown. Add water and stir until dissolved. Set aside to cool. Cream sugar and butter. Add egg yolks that have been beaten. Add milk. Add flour sifted with baking powder and soda then add burnt sugar liquid. Lastly add beaten egg whites and flavoring. Bake in quick oven (about 350\u00b0) for 30 to 35 minutes in layers. Frost with caramel icing.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Combine lemonade milk and food coloring. Stir well. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into crust and freeze until firm 4 hours or overnight. Garnish with lemon slices and whipped topping. Serves 8.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Melt and stir caramels and 1/3 cup milk. Mix cake mix butter and 1/3 cup milk. Put 1/2 mixture in pan and press (will be stiff). Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Steak Rolls
instructions: Cut round steak in 3-inch or 4-inch strips. Wrap steak around carrot and secure with toothpicks. Brown in fat in Dutch oven. Cut onions in rings and place on top of rolls. Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer until almost tender; remove from pan. Place quartered potatoes on bottom of Dutch oven. (If dry add water.) Salt potatoes; place rolls back on top; continue cooking until potatoes are soft.

title: Chicken Tempura Delight
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and chill for 1 hour. Dip chicken in batter then roll in flour. Brown in oil and drain. Serve with sweet and sour sauce.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix potatoes and onions; put in greased pan. Make sauce by mixing milk butter cornstarch salt and pepper. Cook until smooth. Pour over potatoes. Bake 90 minutes at 360\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Sprinkle salt on squash and onion place in colander. Let drain until moisture is gone. Add cornmeal flour egg and cheese (and bacon). Make into patties.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Mix together Oreo cookies and butter and press into 9 x 13-inch pan (save 2/3 cup for a topping). Place butter pecan ice cream (softened) on top of cookie crust. Pour syrup on top of ice cream and spread Cool Whip on top of syrup. Sprinkle crumbs on top of Cool Whip. Place in freezer and freeze.

title: Caramel Cherries
instructions: Drain the cherries well. Melt caramels for 2 to 3 minutes in microwave. Make sure it is all melted. Cover cookie sheet with foil or wax paper. Dip cherries into melted caramel set on cookie sheet and cool.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: Roll dough into balls. Roll in sugar. Place ball 1 inch apart on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10-12 minutes. When done push hersheys kiss into center of each cookie.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix together; pour half into well-greased baking dish. Cover with grated cheese. Pour the rest of the batter over the cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown.

title: Zucchini Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Pack into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Core cabbage heads and place in boiling water until leaves loosen. Pull apart leaves and cut out the vein. Mix all ingredients together except the puree water and sugar. Place one heaping tablespoon of mixture on each cabbage leaf. Roll up and place open edge down in large roaster with lid. Layer cabbage rolls on top of each other. Pour equal parts of puree and water to cover cabbage rolls. Sprinkle with sugar. Cover roaster and bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Makes approximately 2 dozen.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake(Microwave)
instructions: Melt butter in an 8-inch round glass cake dish in microwave 30 seconds on High. Mix brown sugar into melted butter. Cook uncovered in microwave until sugar melts (about 2 minutes on High). Arrange pineapple slices and maraschino cherries in dish.

title: Antipasto
instructions: In a 2-quart bowl or container combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to blend. Serve with sesame crackers. Makes about 7 cups.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Pour over bottom of 9 x 13-inch buttered pan cake mixed according to instructions and spread over coconut and nuts. Mix margarine powdered sugar and cream cheese. Spread over top of cake leaving 1-inch space around cake edge. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Easy Clam Chowder
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large saucepan; simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Austin-Lee'S Favorite Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Buy cookie dough and roll out thin. Cut with a Power Ranger cookie cutter. Bake as directed on package.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Thoroughly mix Bisquick and cheese. Add sausage and mix until smooth (will take quite a while). Shape into 1-inch balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Can freeze after baking and heat to serve.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add strawberries and stir until dissolved. Add bananas and nuts. Drain juice from pineapple and add pineapple. Mix together and pour into mold. Top with sour cream.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole combine chicken broccoli soup onion mayonnaise Worcestershire sauce curry and salt. Mix well. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly. If desired sprinkle with cheese. Half each biscuit and arrange cut side down around edge of casserole. Combine egg celery seed and salt and blend well. Spread over biscuits. Return to oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Venison Jerky
instructions: Mix ingredients. Soak 1 1/2 to 2 pounds boneless meat in marinade overnight. Cut into strips (1/8 to 1/4 x 1-inch). Lay strips on oven racks with the drip pan below and the door slightly open; roast for 5 to 6 hours at 150\u00b0. The meat will shrivel and blacken as it dries. Pat off any beads of fat. Cook the meat until it is chewy and flexible enough to bend without breaking. Do not overdry.

title: Overnight Layered Salad
instructions: Place lettuce in a large 4-quart bowl. Top with green onions celery and water chestnuts. Sprinkle peas over salad. Spread mayonnaise evenly over top. Sprinkle sugar Parmesan cheese seasoned salt and garlic powder over top of salad. Cover and chill in refrigerator overnight or 24 hours. Before serving garnish with hard-boiled eggs crisp bacon or tomato wedges. (Salad Supreme seasoning is nice sprinkled over top too.)

title: Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Place ribs in 4 quarts boiling water; boil 20 minutes. Drain.

title: Easy Sausage Balls
instructions: Crumble the sausage and mix with cheese. Add biscuit mix 1 cup at a time. Form into small balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven until light brown (13 to 15 minutes). Cooking may take a few extra minutes if balls are frozen. Serve warm. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Bacon Wrapped Crackers
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Wrap raw bacon slices around Club crackers. Bake in broiler pan for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Turkey Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in margarine for 3 minutes. Stir in flour. Add chicken broth gradually. Stir and cook over medium heat until thickened. Add pimentos almonds pepper turkey and rice. Stir to combine. Turn into a 2-quart casserole and sprinkle cheese and paprika over top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Mix cream cheese Cool Whip sugar vanilla and milk (may not need all the milk). Layer cake pie filling and mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Combine with sour cream and soup mix. Cover with onion rings and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Spicy Mixed Nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. In bowl mix egg white and the water until blended. Stir in nuts. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread nut mixture in a single layer in jelly roll pan. Bake 40 minutes; stir. Reduce heat to 200\u00b0; bake 30 minutes longer. With fork loosen nuts from pan. Cool. Store up to 1 month in covered container. Makes 4 cups.

title: Berry Patch Coffee Cake(Servings:  8)
instructions: Cream together sugar cream cheese and margarine. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together. Add alternately with milk. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Dot with jam. Cut through with a knife several times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Prepare rice. Heat sauce. Add salt pepper and Italian seasoning (to taste) to sauce. Brown meat in a large skillet; drain off fat. In a large bowl mix meat sauce and rice together.

title: Mystery Cake
instructions: Sift the first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl. Make 3 holes in this dry mixture. In one add vinegar in another add vanilla and the last add oil. Over all pour cold water and beat well. Bake in 2 (8 or 9-inch) cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Four Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and rinse in cold water; drain well. Add onion and green pepper vinegar oil sugar salt and pepper. Shake container. Refrigerate overnight for best flavor.

title: Susan'S Favorite Enchiladas
instructions: Garnishes Additional cheese and sour cream and chopped cilantro.

title: Firehouse Favorite Hot Bologna
instructions: Cut ring bologna into 5 equal pieces each and then cut each piece in half lengthwise. Pour some crushed peppers in bottom of large jar. Then add bologna slices more crushed peppers vinegar/water solution and dry peppers layering them until all bologna slices are covered with hot pepper mix. Fill jar with liquid mixture being sure to use all peppers. Cover tightly and then shake/roll jar to distribute wet ingredients evenly among bologna. Let bologna season for 1 week before serving. Makes 20 pieces hot bologna.

title: Favorite Old-Fashioned Fudge
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar salt milk and butter. Cook and stir over low heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils. Reduce heat until mixture simmers. Cover and cook three minutes. Uncover. Boil without stirring until candy reaches soft ball stage (234\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Cool to lukewarm beating until mixture begins to thicken and lose gloss. Stir in nuts and pour into 8 x 8-inch buttered pan.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Beat all ingredients together until smooth.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Whip the cream cheese Cool Whip and confectioners sugar together until creamy. Spread over crust. Top with pie filling. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Fettucini
instructions: Boil chicken until tender (can be cooked in crock-pot). Cut up into pieces after deboning. Save broth. Lightly cook green pepper onion and margarine. Add flour until moist. Add broth and milk. Stir until thickened. Season with salt and pepper (lightly). Add cheeses; cook slowly. Add chicken pieces. Pour over cooked spaghetti. Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Chess Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together; spread in 13 x 9 pan. Soften butter and cream cheese mix; slowly add sugar. Spread on top of chocolate mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool then cut in square.

title: Espresso Torte
instructions: Dissolve coffee powder in hot water; set aside. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar beating until egg whites hold distinct short glossy peaks. Fold in coffee liquid; set aside. Beat yolks until thick and light in color. Whip the cream until stiff; blend in liqueur all at once. Fold whites yolks and cream together. Pour into pan on top of crust. Cover and freeze until firm (8 hours or longer). Serves 12 to 14.

title: Brown Velvet Frosting(Chocolate)
instructions: Melt chips. Transfer to a large bowl. Cool 5 minutes. Blend in sour cream vanilla and salt. Gradually beat in confectioners sugar until smooth and creamy. Makes 2 2/3 cups frosting.

title: Party Coffeecake(May Be Prepared Ahead Of Time.)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly in large bowl with electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Beat in sour cream then dry ingredients which have been sifted together 3 times. Blend in lemon juice vanilla and almond flavorings.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain well. Add dry spaghetti sauce mix and mix well with beef. Add tomato sauce and stir to blend. Remove from heat. Put beef mixture evenly in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Combine sour cream and Mozzarella cheese and spread over beef mixture making certain to spread to sides of pan. Put crescent rolls on top to make a crust piecing if necessary. Combine melted butter and Parmesan cheese and using a pastry brush brush top of rolls with cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until rolls turn golden brown and cheese melts.

title: Apple Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Honey Bubble Ring
instructions: In a bowl combine the first 5 ingredients. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces; dip each piece halfway into honey mixture. Layer in a greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Cool for 10 minutes. Invert pan onto a serving platter.

title: Scotch Crispies
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels and peanut butter. Stir until creamy. Put in large bowl and add Rice Krispies. Press into an aluminum foil-lined 9-inch square pan. Chill until firm.

title: Hot Crabmeat Spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Rinse drain and flake crabmeat; remove all shell fragments. Stir softened cream cheese. Add milk and Worcestershire; mix thoroughly. Mix in green onions. Add crabmeat to mixture. Spray an 8-inch Pyrex or ceramic baking dish with Pam. Put mixture in a dish. Spread evenly and top with slivered almonds. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with crackers.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Layer cabbage and onion rings in a large container with a tight-fitting lid. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup sugar. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil using high heat. Pour hot mixture over cabbage and onions. Cool. Cover and refrigerate. Will keep up to 3 weeks. Best after 3 days marinating.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine raw meat 4 ounces of tomato sauce and all the remaining ingredient except the Mozzarella cheese together. Form a large ball and then roll out the meat mixture flat and long like a jelly roll. Sprinkle 3/4 of the Mozzarella cheese over the top of the flatten meat mixture. Then roll it up like a jelly roll folding the sides to seal the cheese in until you have a loaf. Place in 1 1/2-quart loaf baking dish (uncovered) in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Pour remaining tomato sauce over and sprinkle remaining cheese on top during the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Buttery Pound Cake
instructions: Oil pan; sprinkle flour in pan and heat pan and oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar and butter with mixer; pour vanilla flavoring in milk. Alternate flour and milk mixing as you alternate. Put egg yolks in the batter and beat egg whites in a bowl. Fold in the egg whites; mix batter for about 30 seconds adding baking powder. Remove heated pan from oven and pour in batter. Let cake cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Gingersnap Pie
instructions: Pour half and half into large bowl. Add pie filling mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended 1 minute. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping pecans gingersnaps pumpkin and pumpkin pie spice. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm about 6 hours or overnight. Remove from freezer and let stand about 10 minutes to soften before serving. Store any leftover pie in freezer.

title: Orange Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar beating at medium speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine next 4 ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and orange juice beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in flavoring and orange rind. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 to 30 minutes. Cool cake in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack.

title: Cheddary Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In a large saucepan combine soup 1/2 cup of milk onion cream cheese celery carrots Parmesan cheese and salt. Cook and stir until mixture is hot and cream cheese is melted. Stir in the chicken and broccoli; heat through. Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish. In a medium bowl combine the egg oil and remaining milk. Add the pancake mix and Cheddar cheese; blend well. Spoon over hot chicken mixture. Sprinkle with almonds if desired. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 6 servings.

title: Apricot Glazed Chicken
instructions: Set oven to 375\u00b0. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all ingredients. Add chicken turning to coat. Bake 15 minutes. Turn. Bake 30 minutes more. Turn 2 times more. Serve remaining sauce with chicken.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Drop noodles into boiling salted water and cook 10 minutes. Rinse noodles carefully to keep from tearing. Drain.

title: Cucumber With Yogurt Sauce
instructions: In small skillet cook cumin seed until they start to crackle and are \toasted.\ Remove from heat and shake skillet. Combine cucumber yogurt cumin seed chilies oil salt and garlic. Chill. Makes 2 cups.

title: Filled Chocolate Cookie Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Mix crushed cookies with melted butter. Press into the bottom of a 12-inch pie taker. Spread ice cream over top of cookies. Pour fudge topping in an even layer over ice cream. Spread whipped topping over fudge topping. Garnish with chocolate curls or cookies if desired. Put in freezer for two hours. Serve with server/sliver utensil.

title: Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Spread the mixture on inside and top of bun. Fill sandwich with ham and Swiss cheese. Bake on a cookie sheet at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cobbler
instructions: Melt the butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan in a 350 degree oven.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Fry onions and bacon together. Boil potatoes until tender. Place in crock-pot. Add onions and bacon. Add sour cream and milk and salt for seasoning. Cook for about 1 hour.

title: Hamburger-Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Add all ingredients except soup mix. Simmer one hour. Add soup mix and cook 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Stir until dissolved. Add pineapple and pie filling. Mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate until set. Mix sour cream cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Spread over Jell-O mixture. Top with nuts.

title: Grannie'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Melt butter and beat together with sugars vanilla peanut butter and eggs.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Spread chicken in one layer in baking dish. Pur crushed tomatoes over chicken. Next put chopped onion green pepper and seasoning on chicken. Bake uncovered for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Aztec Quiche
instructions: For the freezer Spread the Monterey Jack cheese and half the Cheddar over the bottom of the pie shell. Sprinkle diced chilies over cheeses. Stir together in a bowl the half and half eggs and seasonings. Pour carefully into the pie shell. Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar. Cover the pie with foil and freeze (optional).

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel cook and mash all potatoes. Beat in with electric mixer sour cream and cream cheese. Add garlic powder and taste for salt and pepper.

title: Apricot Meatballs
instructions: In a bowl combine the first 4 ingredients. Crumble beef over mixture and mix well. Shape into 1 inch balls. In a skillet brown meatballs in several batches drain. Transfer to a greased 2 qt. baking dish. Combine preserves and barbecue sauce pour over meatballs.

title: Pasta With Asparagus
instructions: In a skillet cook garlic red pepper flakes and hot pepper sauce in oil and butter for 2 to 3 minutes. Add asparagus salt and pepper. Saute until asparagus is crisp-tender about 8 to 10 minutes. Add Parmesan cheese; mix well. Pour over hot pasta and toss to coat. Serve immediately. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain off grease. Mix instant potatoes according to directions on box. Spray casserole dish with Pam. Put layer of half the mashed potatoes. Next layer browned ground beef then layer the remaining half of mashed potatoes. Sprinkle grated cheese all over top. Cook in 400\u00b0 oven until bubbly and cheese is melted.

title: Chocolate Chess Squares
instructions: Combine flour and powdered sugar; cut in 1/2 cup butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press mixture evenly into bottom of 9-inch square pan lined with heavy-duty foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Combine sugar cocoa and salt. Add 2 tablespoons butter and eggs; beat 2 minutes. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in pecans. Pour mixture over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: In large kettle combine first 4 ingredients. Saute then add next 4 ingredients. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Place in blender until smooth. Return to kettle and add sausage rounds and serve when heated through.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Saute onion pepper and mushrooms. Season with pepper oregano and garlic powder. Add noodles cheese pepperoni sauce and onion mixture to 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan. Put in 350 degree preheated oven for 15 minutes stir and cook for 15 additional minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Wash squash; cut stems from the ends. Cut squash pepper and onion. Place in cooking utensil with enough water to cover squash. Cook until squash is tender then add 3 strips of bacon or pan sausage and cheese. Add egg and seasonings. Place in greased casserole dish; cook for about 30 minutes. During last 5 minutes of cooking sprinkle top with bread crumbs.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour together. Beat eggs and add to mixture. Add margarine milk vanilla and coconut. Pour into 9-inch deep dish unbaked pie crust. Bake 10 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Reduce oven to 350\u00b0 and bake additional 30 minutes or until done.

title: * Indian Stew *
instructions: Saute pepper and onion in oil. Add meat and brown. Pour in balance of ingredients. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mr. Mike Thomas' Oyster Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding milk or water to make the mixture soupy. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lime Chicken Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine the first 4 ingredients. Add chicken and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours or overnight. Arrange chicken on a foil lined baking pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until browned and glazed. Baste occasionally. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix cornbread crumbs with sage poultry seasoning salt and pepper. Cook onions and celery in butter. Heat cream of chicken soup and broth. Mix all together. Add cooked chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned.

title: Diabetic Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream butter until light. Add egg; mix well. Add flour; blend thoroughly. Dissolve saccharin in 1/2 teaspoon water. Add vanilla and saccharin to flour mixture; mix well. Form into two 8-inch long rolls. Wrap in waxed paper; refrigerate overnight. Slice 1/4-inch thick; place on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until browned.

title: Pretzel Dip
instructions: Mix together cream cheese Ranch dressing and beer. Stir in Cheddar cheese until well mixed. Use with vegetables pretzels etc.

title: Veggie Bars
instructions: Mix together cream cheese mayonnaise and Ranch mix and put on crust; press the following toppings into the cheese onions cauliflower broccoli and tomatoes. These should be chopped fine and refrigerate.

title: Hostess Twinkie Surprise
instructions: Slice Twinkies in halves. Place in oblong pan or dish. Pour strawberries over Twinkies. Mix next 4 ingredients. Pour over strawberries. Chill.

title: Grape Juice
instructions: Cook grapes and water for 10 minutes. strain through a cloth bag. Add sugar to the strained juice and cook for 5 minutes. Pour into hot jars and have your lids hot. Seal.

title: Asparagus And Potato Salad(6 Servings)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Combine potatoes and asparagus with dressing.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Cream flour confectioners sugar and butter; press in ungreased square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs Appetizer
instructions: Slice hard-boiled eggs in half and remove yolks. Mix yolks with remaining ingredients. Pipe yolk mixture into egg white halves with cake decorating tools. Sprinkle bacon pieces on top.

title: Squash Boats
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Cook squash 6 to 8 minutes until tender but not too soft. Cut in half lengthwise and scoop out and discard seeds. Mix pepper tomato onion bacon and Cheddar. Fill squash halves (boats); dot with butter and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Wild West Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle Fritos in bottom of casserole dish. Pour beans soup chili powder and hot dogs over Fritos. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with cheese the last 5 minutes.

title: Cheesy Chicken
instructions: Brown deboned chicken breasts in pan on top of range in 2 tablespoons of oil. Place chicken in a baking dish. Top with cream of chicken soup and Cheddar cheese. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Royal Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Place slices of buttered toast in shallow baking pan. Place chicken on toast and tomato on chicken. Sprinkle with salt. Spread thickly with grated cheese mixed with Worcestershire sauce. Melt cheese under broiler. Serve at once. Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in large bowl. In 2-quart saucepan combine water cocoa margarine and shortening; bring to boil stirring occasionally. Pour hot mixture over dry ingredients; blend at low speed. Add buttermilk eggs and vanilla; continue mixing until well blended. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes in greased and floured 17 x 11 x 3/4-inch pan. Frost while hot.

title: Beef Dip
instructions: Put meat in colander; rinse with warm water and pat dry. Put meat in food processor to mince finely. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix. (Make the night before.) Serve in hollowed out pumpernickel bread with cubes of pumpernickel bread to dip.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add molasses and egg; Beat well. Sift dry ingredients; Add to creamed mixture; Mix well.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Fry first 3 ingredients. In a bowl mix the remaining ingredients. After frying add hamburg mixture to sauce mix. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes stirring 2 to 3 times.

title: Classic Green Bean Bake
instructions: Combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in beans and 1/2 can onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes; stir. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Mix the following ingredients and pour over cake while still warm

title: White Chocolate Crunchies
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave (6 minutes at 50%). Mix other ingredients in hot chocolate. Spoon onto wax paper and let cool.

title: Twinkles Cake
instructions: Split Twinkles and place cut side up in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Make instant pudding according to directions. Pour pudding over Twinkles. Slice bananas over this and pour strawberries over bananas. Top with Cool Whip and chill.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts Supreme
instructions: Wipe chicken with damp paper towels. In large bowl combine sour cream lemon juice Worcestershire sauce celery salt paprika salt and pepper. Add chicken and coat well. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Remove and roll in crumbs. Arrange in single layers in large baking dish. Melt butter and shortening. Spoon half over chicken and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Spoon remainder over chicken and bake 10 to 15 minutes until tender and nicely browned.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pork chops. Cover pork chops with mixture. Cook in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Pie(Yields 6 Servings)
instructions: Peel apples. Take out the core. Cut into small pieces. Put into the mixing bowl. Add cinnamon flour and sugar to apples and mix together. Fill one shell with apple mixture. Put the other pie shell on top. Poke a few holes in the top so hot air can get out as it bakes. Bake for 1 hour until light brown.

title: Mushroom Chicken
instructions: Wash and debone chicken breasts. Salt and pepper breast. Dip in milk and roll in crushed corn flakes. Arrange in foil-lined large baking dish. Melt butter and pour over chicken. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Mix mushroom soup and 1 can of milk. (Pour milk into soup can to measure.) Place back in oven for an additional 15 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Cook oysters in their liquor in large pot over high heat until edges begin to curl (2 to 3 minutes). Add milk butter salt and pepper. Reduce heat to medium-low; heat until hot. Pour into tureen or individual bowl. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley. Makes 8 servings.

title: Seasoned Eggplant
instructions: Spray large skillet with cooking spray heat over medium heat until hot. Saute vegetables until crisp-tender. Add herbs and red pepper and cook for 2 minutes. Add broth to skillet and heat to boiling reduce heat and simmer covered until vegetables are soft and most of the liquid is absorbed for about 20 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together. Add Crisco eggs and vanilla. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Applesauce Bread
instructions: Beat all ingredients together except nuts and raisins until well combined. Add nuts and raisins. Divide the mixture into 2 loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Put juice from pineapple and oranges in saucepan. Add pudding mix and cook until mixture becomes clear. Cool. Add pineapple chunks and oranges to sauce when cool as well as apple chunks and banana slices. Fold together and chill.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Combine strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar. Combine remaining dry ingredients. Add margarine eggs and strawberry mixture. Fold in 1 1/2 cups whipped topping. Pour in a greased 9 x 15-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Combine the cream cheese and milk. Mix at medium speed until well blended. Fold in remaining topping and spread on cooled bread.

title: Rainbow Fizz
instructions: Pour orange juice and club soda into tall glass over ice. Add grenadine and allow to settle on bottom. Add cherry on top.

title: Nut Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Beat in sugar vanilla and Crisco until creamy. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Mix at low speed until blended. Stir in nuts. Mixture will be stiff. Spread evenly in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Cut into bars. Makes 2 dozen cookies.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mash potatoes then add 1/3 stick margarine sugar and salt. Beat eggs vanilla and flour in separate bowl then mix with potatoes. Grease a 9 x 12-inch baking dish with margarine and pour in mixture.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Put in a casserole bowl and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts In Lemon Sauce
instructions: Cut chicken breasts horizontally to make 2 thin slices. Coat with flour. Heat butter in 12-inch skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken and garlic in butter 4 to 6 minutes turning once until chicken is brown. Add apple juice and lemon juice. Sprinkle with pepper. Heat until hot. Sprinkle with capers. Garnish with strawberries and parsley.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Mix sugar flour and cinnamon. Add Crisco oil eggs plum baby food and chopped nuts. Blend by hand. Pour into Bundt pan and bake 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Toss lightly to coat. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix together. Shape into 4 patties. Fry over medium heat turning once until golden brown. Serve with tartar sauce. Can substitute cooked chicken if desired. Use same amount of chicken as salmon.

title: Happiness Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Add tears of joy sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kind service. Blend well and fold into daily life. Bake in the warmth of human kindness and serve with a smile.

title: Delicious Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in moderate oven 3/4 hour uncovered. Irish potatoes may be baked around loaf.

title: Crab Buns
instructions: Mix well and put on hamburger buns. Wrap in foil. Heat at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fingalings(No Bake Cookies)
instructions: Mix together cocoa butter and milk and boil (1 1/2 to 2 minutes). Take off heat and add oatmeal and vanilla. If desired add nuts or raisins. Drop onto a sheet and cool.

title: Hot Buttered Tomato Juice
instructions: Put tomato juice and Worcestershire sauce in coffeepot. Put remaining ingredients in basket. Allow to go through perk cycle and serve hot. Makes 12 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Wash beans. Soak overnight. Add salt; stir and drain reserving liquid. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cut off the third of the salt pork and place the piece on the bottom of bean pot. Add beans to pot.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain. Toss with butter eggs and Parmesan cheese. Put in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread softened cream cheese on top. Pour spaghetti sauce over the top. Then spread browned ground beef on top of sauce. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Cook for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Great to take to potluck dinners.)

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Cut 1 can biscuits in quarters and place in bottom of pan. Pour melted butter over biscuits. Mix cinnamon and sugar; sprinkle over. Repeat. Bake until done using biscuit directions. (May have to cook a little longer.)

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Freeze in gallon bags. Add 3 bottles (1 liter) ginger ale to frozen gallons at least one hour before serving.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Combine rice marshmallows pineapple and nuts. Whip cream gradually adding sugar and vanilla. Fold in rice mixture. Chill. Garnish with cherries.

title: Homemade Salsa
instructions: Cook slowly until mixture comes to a soft boil. Add peppers to taste when cooking. Put in pint cans and serve with chips.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well with sugar. Add salt and then add corn syrup and melted butter. Arrange pecans in bottom of pie shell and pour corn syrup mixture over pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix peas soup and milk together; pour into casserole dish. Repeat layers of eggs pimento and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Marinated Sweet And Sour Carrot Salad
instructions: Cook carrots in covered pan until crisp and tender. Drain and cool. Combine remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours to blend flavors.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a large hot iron skillet greased with 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Quick Pickled Beans
instructions: Drain beans. Place in glass jar. Pour kraut juice over beans and cover loosely. Let stand at room temperature for 3 days.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Bake
instructions: Beat eggs slightly with a fork. Beat in cheese flour salt and onion powder. Stir in broccoli and water chestnuts. Pour into a greased 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until mixture is firm. Serves 8.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill then serve on a leaf of lettuce. Serves 10.

title: Jiffy Chocolate Chews
instructions: Boil for 1 minute the margarine milk and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Remove from stove; stirring continually drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. (If sugar milk and margarine cooks too long candy is crumbly.)

title: Italian Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar egg yolks oil and margarine. Sift in\tflour and baking soda.\tAdd buttermilk and vanilla to batter and mix well. Add coconut nuts and raisins. Fold in beaten egg whites. Grease and flour 3 (8-inch) layer pans or 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pick-Ups
instructions: Let Karo and sugar come to a boil. Add peanut butter and cornflakes. Drop on wax paper.

title: Sugared Pecans
instructions: Combine sugar water and honey in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook until it reaches soft ball stage of 325\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Dip pecans in sugar mixture. Place on wax paper to cool.

title: Oriental Chicken Wings(Makes 40 Wings)
instructions: Mix together marinade. Put wings in pan. Cover with mixture and marinate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Turn often. To make them extra crispy put them under broiler for about 10 minutes.

title: Cheese Cookie Snacks
instructions: Stir together cheese and butter until blended. Stir in flour and salt. Blend well. Stir in cereal (dough will be stiff). Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on an ungreased baking sheet 2-inches apart. Flatten cookies to 1/4-inch thickness with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool. Store in airtight container. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: * Rhubarb Meringue Pie *
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Blend in melted butter and dry ingredients. Add rhubarb and mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 355\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer. Cool and cover with meringue. Beat 2 egg whites and 4 tablespoons sugar for meringue. Bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes until brown.

title: Cheese Spread For Crackers
instructions: Soften cheese. Mix together ingredients and form into a ball. Serve with crackers.

title: Red Chicken
instructions: Broil chicken in electric skillet 20 minutes each side at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0. Remove chicken. Add cherries and barbecue sauce to skillet. Heat and put chicken back into skillet. Cook 30 minutes or longer. Serve over noodles.

title: Easy Glazed Carrots
instructions: Steam the carrots until crisp-tender. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve hot. Serves 6.

title: Microwave Cheese Sauce
instructions: Heat milk and set aside. Melt butter on High. Stir in flour. Heat 1 minute on High. Stir in warm milk. Blend well. Cook on High for 2 1/2 minutes or until boiling. Stir in Cheddar cheese and blend well.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar vanilla and oil. Beat well. Add flour salt soda and cinnamon. Beat well. Batter will be very thick. Add pecans and pears. Beat to combine.

title: Swedish Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine beef milk 1/3 can soup dry onion soup mix parsley flakes thyme and nutmeg. Place in a 12 x 9 x 2 1/2-inch baking dish. Shape into a loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Heat remaining soup and sour cream stirring constantly. Serve over meat loaf. Serves 8.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Bake 4 hours in oven. Bake 2 hours at 400\u00b0 and 2 hours at 300\u00b0. Check often.

title: 14 Carrot Gold Loaf
instructions: Cook carrots onions and celery. Combine rest of ingredients in a bowl. Mix. Fold in cooked carrots onions and celery. Put into quiche pan lightly greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve with rolls and fruit salad.

title: Ham And Cheese Buns
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into finger rolls or 1/2 hot bun. Wrap in foil and heat at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Blond Brownies
