instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan and cool slightly. Add brown sugar egg and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients; add walnuts and stir. Mix together wet and dry ingredients and stir well. Spread in an 8 x 8-inch well-greased pan. Sprinkle top with chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned and set.

title: Chocolate Teddy Bears
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs; blend well. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture. Blend; chill. Shape into bears. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Texas Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine flour soda baking powder salt corn flakes coconut oatmeal and nuts. Add to egg mixture. Blend well. Drop by teaspoon on greased sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef. Mix all ingredients except ketchup. Cover mixture with ketchup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until not runny.

title: Broccoli Cashew Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Mix mayonnaise and sugar well. Add dressing just before serving.

title: Golden Punch
instructions: Combine the sugar and 4 cups water in large pot. Heat until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and stir in the gelatin. Add pineapple juice Twister apple juice and remaining water. Mix well. Freeze. Remove from freezer about 2 hours before serving and use a knife to slush. Add Sprite or 7-Up as needed.

title: Rice Dish
instructions: Mix well and put in 2 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 (covered).

title: Creamy Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In large saucepan combine Marshmallow Creme sugar evaporated milk margarine and salt. Bring to full boil over moderate heat stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes stirring constantly over moderate heat. Remove from heat. Add milk chocolate chips and semi-sweet chocolate chips; stir until chips melt and mixture is well blended. Stir in nuts and vanilla. Pour into an 8-inch square pan. Chill in refrigerator until firm about 2 hours.

title: Crescent Rolls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Dissolve yeast. Beat in eggs and flour. Cover and let stand all night. Divide into 2 parts. Roll each part into a circle and cut each circle in 8-inch pie-shaped pieces with pizza cutter. Roll up beginning with wide end. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Boil sugar and syrup together 2 to 3 minutes. Beat eggs with whisk until mixed well. Pour hot sugar syrup mixture over beaten eggs slowly. Add butter vanilla and salt. Put pecans in unbaked 9-inch pie shell on rack in oven; pour sugar syrup mixture over pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes or until set.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed on box. Cut Spam meat and bell peppers into small pieces. Mix together with macaroni and cheese. Place in oven-safe casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Thaw and drain broccoli; mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-35 min.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan placed in oven. Mix milk flour and 1/2 cup of the sugar in a small bowl. Pour milk mixture over melted margarine. Top with peach slices.

title: Peanut Butter Ice Cream *
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and beat. Add condensed milk and beat. Add milk and beat. Add vanilla and peanut butter; beat by hand. Freeze.

title: Paw Paw Pie
instructions: Peel and remove seeds. Cook in open kettle with other ingredients until thick. Put in unbaked crust and bake until crust is baked. Cover with meringue and brown.

title: Texas Torte(Cheese Appetizers)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. To eggs add flour salt and milk. Beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a flat well-greased 8 x 12-inch Pyrex baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cut into squares and serve hot. Freezes well. It doesnt double well.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into a ball and roll in chopped nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pineapple in a small ungreased cake pan. Spread pie filling over pineapple. Sprinkle cake mix (dry) over pie filling. Sprinkle oats pecans and coconut on top of cake mix. Pour melted butter evenly over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into balls. Press with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Baked In White Wine
instructions: Melt margarine in baking pan and saute garlic. Coat chicken with flour. Place in pan. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Dip *
instructions: Peel pit and mash avocados in bowl with lemon juice salt and pepper. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning. Spread bean dip on large platter (shaped like round cake); top with avocado mix. Layer with sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with chopped onions tomatoes and olives. Cover with cheese. Chill for 1 hour. Serve with chips. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Southern Gingerbread
instructions: Add beaten eggs to sugar molasses and melted shortening then add the dry ingredients which have been mixed and sifted and lastly the hot water. Bake in shallow pan or muffin tin in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Taco Biscuit Appetizers
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain off excess fat. Add taco seasoning and 3/4 cup water. Cook 15 minutes. Spread each can of rolls into 2 oblongs on cookie sheet. Spread a thin line of meat mixture down each oblong. Top with cheese. Fold over and pinch closed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cut into bite-size pieces. Serve warm.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in cake pan. Add peaches. In a bowl mix flour sugar and milk. Pour on top of peaches and bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: In a large skillet saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender. Add tomatoes mushrooms and oregano. Add ground beef. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in pan; sprinkle crumbs on top of butter. Then add layer of coconut chocolate chips nuts and butterscotch chips. Pour milk over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let cool and cut in squares.

title: Uncle Terry'S Too-Good Tomato Gravy
instructions: Fry & drain bacon and sausage. Add sugar tomatoes and 1 cup water (you may cut water back to 3/4 c. and add 1 can rotel tomatoes if you want a little kick to your gravy). Make up your rue and add to this mixture. Add enough kitchen bouquet to give it a rich gravy color then add lawrys seasoned salt & pepper to taste.

title: Sticks
instructions: Mix together. Pour on top of first layer. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. When cool cut in squares. These freeze well.

title: Breakfast Eye Opener
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble and set aside. Saute onion in bacon drippings (drain off some). Add the next three ingredients to onion and stir constantly until heated. Add cheese; stir until cheese melts. Spoon 2/3 of sauce into an 8-inch square dish. Make four indentions in sauce; break an egg into each. Spoon the remaining sauce around eggs. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until eggs are set. Top muffins with sauce and eggs.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Put flour seasoned salt onion powder and pepper in a bag. Toss meat in flour mixture. In a large pot brown meat in oil. Add water and all ingredients listed down to carrots. Stir and simmer 10 minutes. Add carrots onions potatoes and celery. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Mix last 4 ingredients and stir into stew. Simmer 15 minutes. Add peas and cook 5 minutes more.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Mix the sugar and soda together well and add light cream. Boil stirring constantly until a soft ball forms when dropped into a cup of cold water.\tAdd butter and pecan halves. Beat by hand about 5 minutes or until thick. Drop on waxed paper. Cool.

title: Butter Bean Soup
instructions: Cook beans until done (can soak for 1 hour to speed up cooking). Fry bacon remove from skillet saving grease. Cook onion and celery in grease until tender. Pour Heinz 57 sauce and tomato sauce into hot beans. Add onion celery and seasonings. Cook about 20 minutes longer adding bacon pieces before serving.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Mix vegetables and seasonings and saute in margarine until pepper is tender. Add tomatoes. Boil 5 minutes. Add shrimp. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with hot rice.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown meat onion and pepper. Add chopped olives eggs and hot sauce. Add 3/4 can of enchilada sauce. Heat remaining sauce. Dip tortillas into hot sauce and fill with meat mixture; fold and lay in pan. Put grated cheese and extra sauce over enchiladas. Warm in oven until cheese melts.

title: Alabama Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a large preheated iron skillet or a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Wash slice and boil squash until tender. Drain thoroughly. Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Add squash and onion. Mix beaten egg salt and pepper (I use a dash of hot sauce); mix with squash. Cover with cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons melted butter. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until done or brown.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Cook cornstarch sugar and water until thick. Remove from heat. Add syrup Jell-O and peaches. Pour into baked pie crust. Refrigerate until cool. Top with whipped cream.

title: Belle'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a saucepan bring oleo shortening water and cocoa to boil. Blend in eggs and buttermilk with soda dissolved in it. Add cinnamon. Mix with dry ingredients (sugar and flour). Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Use microwave dish and add sugar nuts salt and syrup. Cook for 4 minutes. Take out and stir. Put back in microwave for 3 1/2 more minutes. Take out and stir. Put in vanilla and margarine and stir. Put back into microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and add 1 teaspoon of soda. Stir and pour on baking sheet. Let cool.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten egg. Sift together flour salt and cinnamon. Add soda and water. Add nuts raisins and vanilla. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes. Remove while hot. Makes 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Raisin Sauce
instructions: Combine water sugar and raisins. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Dissolve with 1 tablespoon cold water and cornstarch. Stir into raisin mixture then add lemon juice. Cook until liquid is clear. Makes 3 cups raisin sauce.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Drain oysters. Pour into casserole with crumbs. Pour milk etc. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Marlene'S Italian Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken into egg and milk. Roll in Italian bread crumbs. Repeat. Fry in hot oil for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients and chill overnight.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Bake cake according to package directions. Cool. Prepare pudding according to package directions. Set aside.

title: Harvest Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion; drain. Cook celery in a small amount of margarine over low heat. Cook noodles as directed on package. Add all ingredients together and put in large casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Sour Cream Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine potatoes and next 7 ingredients in large bowl; mix well. Spoon into buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover with cornflake crumbs. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Brown hamburg and drain. Put that in crock-pot. Melt cheese and add sauce. Add those to the meat. Put on low. Keep warm. Use Fritos and chips to dip.

title: Cubed Steaks With Smothered Onions(Weight Watchers)
instructions: Cut steak into 2-inch wide strips. Cut the onions into very thin slices. Cut the scallions into 2-inch sections. In a shallow bowl blend the flour 1/4 teaspoon of the pepper and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Toss the steak strips in the flour mixture.

title: Sugar Free Lemon Squares
instructions: Combine flour 8 packets of Equal and salt in bowl. Cut in butter until it resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle 1 tsp. lemon peel and vanilla; mix to form dough. Press dough into 8-inch square pan bottom and sides. Bake at 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Beat eggs and 18 packets of Equal. Mix in lemon juice butter and lemon peel. Pour into baked crust. Bake until lemon filling is set about 15 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into small bite-sized pieces. Add potatoes carrots and enough gravy to cover. Cook over outdoor fire at 465\u00b0. This will serve 3800 people. If more people are expected two rabbits may be added but do this only in an emergency. Most people dont like hare in their stew.

title: Quik Coffee Cake
instructions: In a small bowl mix Bisquick brown sugar cinnamon and butter or margarine. Mix together until crumbly; sprinkle over batter in cake pan. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Makes 6 to 8 slices.

title: Rolled Stuffed Cabbage Leaves
instructions: Separate cabbage leaves and blanch in boiling water for 5 minutes to make the leaves pliable for rolling. Cut each leaf into 2 or 3 sections eliminating the tough section of the stem. Set aside.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Preheat oven. Sift the flour. Add the baking powder salt and sugar. Break in the egg; add the milk. Blend and drop onto very lightly greased cookie sheet by tablespoon. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 425\u00b0 or for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Carrot-Pecan Casserole
instructions: Drain carrots and mash. Stir in sugar and next 8 ingredients. Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Garnish with carrot curls or fresh parsley sprigs. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Penuche Nut Icing
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in saucepan. Bring slowly to rolling boil while stirring. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Beat until lukewarm. Add vanilla. Beat until thick enough to spread. Add nuts. This is a very good frosting for a spice cake or banana cake.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except chocolate chips. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes; take out of the oven. Cut through batter. Put back in oven for 20 minutes.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Blend well all ingredients. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Cut 1 cup cranberries in half. Mix liquid ingredients then add dry sifted ingredients until smooth by hand. Add cranberries and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Wild Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook rice per package directions. Combine chicken olives onions pecans celery and mayo. Add mixture to rice. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate overnight. Take out 30 minutes before serving. Stir and serve.

title: Mock Chicken-Fried Steak
instructions: Mix egg 1/2 cup cracker crumbs milk onion chili powder salt and Worcestershire; add ground beef and mix well. Shape into patties 1/2-inch thick; coat with remaining cracker crumbs. Cook in hot oil over medium-high heat about 3 minutes on each side.

title: Praline Pecan Crunch
instructions: Heat oven to 250. Combine cereal and pecans in 13x9-inch pan and set aside. Combine corn syrup brown sugar and margarine in 2 cup microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high 1 1/2 minutes and stir. Microwave at high 1/2 to 1 1/2 minutes more or until boiling. Stir in vanilla and baking soda and pour over cereal mixture. Stir to coat evenly. Bake 1 hour stirring every 20 minutes. Spread on baking sheet to cool. Break into pieces. Makes 10 cups. Prep time 10 minutes. Bake time 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Spray large skillet lightly with Pam or Bakers Joy. Saute vegetables until soft and water has evaporated. Set aside to cool in large mixing bowl! Measure herb and seasonings. Blend together and add to vegetables. Next add ketchup egg substitute and milk followed by meat and finally the oat bran. Mix well and form into 1 or 2 loaves. Place in a baking pan and bake 50 to 55 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Curried Carrots
instructions: Cut carrots into 1/4-inch slanting slices. Drain the oranges reserving 3 tablespoons juice. In a wide frying pan over medium-high heat melt butter. Add carrots and orange juice. Cook covered until carrots are tender and most of the juice has evaporated. In a cup stir together curry powder salt and lemon juice. Add and let cook for 1 minute then add the remaining ingredients and cook three minutes more.

title: Graham Gems
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine the first 6 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Make a well and then add egg buttermilk and shortening. Stir only until blended. Fill greased muffin tins half full and bake 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In medium skillet melt butter; add stuffing. Mix and cook stirring often 5 minutes or until golden brown. Place 1 cup in bottom of 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Put broccoli over stuffing; cover with chicken pieces.

title: Squash And Potato Casserole
instructions: Layer potatoes onions and squash alternately seasoning each layer. Place small amount of soup each third layer. Repeat ending with soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are done.

title: Rosy Rhubarb Preserves
instructions: Combine rhubarb pineapple and sugar in kettle. Place over low heat and stir gently until sugar dissolves. Cook over medium heat until thick and clear usually 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in jello. Makes 3 1/2 pints.

title: Scrambled Eggs In Pita Pockets
instructions: Wrap pita bread in aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until warm.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread in a baking dish. Cover with miniature marshmallows and chopped nuts. Nuts are optional. Cook until marshmallows are brown.

title: Anthony'S Shrimp Scampi Pier Iv
instructions: Peel devein and butterfly shrimp. (To butterfly split them almost in two and flatten out.) Melt butter in skillet. Add chopped garlic parsley and shrimp. Saute over low heat until shrimp are pink in color. Season with additional salt pepper lemon juice sherry and oregano. Serve with rice and vegetable. (Sauce goes extremely well over rice.)

title: Miniature Cinnamon Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium bowl mix flour baking powder salt nutmeg and dried currants.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; chill. Garnish just before serving with crisp-cooked crumbled bacon.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Cut lard into flour; add vinegar and water. Makes 3 pie crusts.

title: Deviled Clams
instructions: Chop celery and onions fine and cook in butter until soft. Mince clams in blender then crumb bread in blender. In dish mix celery onions clams and crumbed bread well. (Use no clam juice only what clings to clams.) Beat egg and add pepper and Worcestershire sauce to it; mix well. Add parsley last. If too juicy add more fresh bread crumbs. Put dry crumbs in another dish and drop a tablespoon of mixture in crumbs. Coat well using hands. Repeat. Fry in small amount of oil until golden brown.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain in a colander and put back into skillet. Add celery green pepper and onion. Cook until vegetables are soft. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for about 10-15 minutes. Serve on a bun. For a smaller family this recipe can be cut in half.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Slice cookie dough 3/8 inch thick and place 1/2 inch apart on a 12-inch pizza pan. Bake 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Mexican Bread Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Place bread crumbs in pan. Dot with 1/4 cup of the butter. Bake uncovered stirring occasionally until golden brown about 20 minutes. Cool crumbs. Heat brown sugar water brandy cinnamon and cloves over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved. Place 1 cup of the bread crumbs in ungreased round pan (9 x 1 1/2-inch). Pour 1/3 cup of the syrup over crumbs; sprinkle with cheese. Top with 1 cup crumbs; sprinkle with apples raisins and walnuts. Top with 1/3 cup syrup and remaining crumbs. Pour remaining syrup over crumbs; dot with remaining butter. Bake uncovered in a 300\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbly about 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with sweetened whipped cream if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Stir lemonade mix and milk together. Add Cool Whip and stir until smooth. Pour into graham cracker crusts and refrigerate for at least one hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix well the first 5 ingredients. Cook squash until tender; drain well. Add to top mixture. Stir well and put in casserole. Mix cracker crumbs and melted margarine; sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill in refrigerator.

title: Sesame Ginger String Beans
instructions: Garnish with sesame seed.

title: Cheese And Meatball Soup
instructions: Mix and shape meat mixture into small balls. Place all other ingredients except cheese whiz in soup pot along with uncooked meat balls. Stir gently and bring to boil. Cover and simmer for about two hours or until vegetables are tender. Add cheese whiz stirring gently until blended.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Place drained beans in 1-quart dish. Mix in chestnuts. Pour cream of mushroom soup over this. Top everything with onion rings and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant in boiling salted water approximately 7 minutes. Drain. Gradually stir milk into soup blend in egg. Add drained eggplant onion and stuffing mix. Toss lightly to mix. Pour into greased baking dish.

title: No Cake Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix the first 2 ingredients then add remaining ingredients. Grease and line bread pan with wax paper. Pack mixture real hard into pan with hands. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. When cool wrap in aluminum foil and keep refrigerated at least a week.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine seasonings with cheese and bread crumbs or wheat germ. Wet chicken pieces. Roll in crumb mixture. Place on baking sheet skin side up. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour (if desired turn pieces after 30 minutes).

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a heavy saucepan add margarine sugar and evaporated milk. Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add chocolate chips stirring until melted. With electric mixer add vanilla marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Beat on medium speed until creamy. Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Cool completely and cut into small squares.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels margarine and 1/2 cup sugar. Press into a 13x9 inch glass dish. Mix Cool Whip cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar together and spread on first layer. Drain juice from pineapple and mix with 1/4 cup of sugar and cornstarch. Cook until thick add pineapple and pour on top. Refrigerate until cool.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine cheese flour and seasonings. Dip chicken in combined egg and milk batter. Coat with cheese mixture. Place in baking dish and pour margarine over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread chocolate on top and let set in refrigerator until chocolate is partially set then cut into pieces. Store in refrigerator.

title: Arroz Con Pollo
instructions: Brown floured and salted chicken in olive oil. Set aside in warm place. Add ham onion scallions and saute for few minutes. Add rice and spices. Blend for few minutes and add chicken broth; salt to taste. Cook on stove for about 10 minutes. Place rice mixture and chicken in casserole and cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Dorothy'S Pie Crust
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Beat egg with water slightly. Add vinegar. Chill for 1 hour. Roll out on floured board. Makes 2 pies.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on in salted water. Remove skins when cooked. Boil eggs; peel and chop. Mix cubed potatoes eggs celery radishes green onion and salt. Add Miracle Whip and vinegar. Stir mixtures together. Serve warm (then chill).

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa and sugar. Add melted margarine. Next add 2 eggs beaten. Add vanilla and milk. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until it puffs up and begins to crack around the edge of filling.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; fold in whipping cream (now Cool Whip could be used).

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes and sugar with electric mixer until smooth. Dip mixture into coconut and roll into balls. Place on cookie sheet and add 1 marshmallow to center of each ball. Bake until marshmallow is browned.

title: Deer Summer Sausage
instructions: Dissolve salt in water and mix in other ingredients. Roll into long rolls and wrap in aluminum foil. Let set in refrigerator for 24 hours. Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Unwrap and replace with new aluminum foil. Cool.

title: Tamale Casserole(Easy)
instructions: Line 8 x 8-inch pan with tamales (corn wrapper removed). Heat chili through (pour 1/2 can water into chili). Pour chili over tamales. Sprinkle onion over chili then sprinkle with cheese. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Rice Krispie Squares
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until melted and blended. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal and stir until well coated. Press mixture evenly into greased 13 x 9-inch pan and cool. Makes 24 squares.

title: Theresa'S Oreo Delight
instructions: Mix ice cream and Cool Whip together. Crunch Oreo cookies and add to mixture. Pour into pie shells. Refreeze.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together. (Best not to use fat-free or low-fat pork. May make Sausage Balls too dry.) Knead to form soft dough. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. These may be fast-frozen then stored in plastic container until ready to use. Bake frozen at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Baked Peaches
instructions: In a greased baking dish place a layer of peaches and fruit cocktail. Cover with brown sugar then a layer of crumbled crackers and dot with butter. Repeat this to the top of the dish and bake slowly at 300\u00b0 approximately 1 hour. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potatoes On Pineapple Rings
instructions: Beat the sweet potatoes salt butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Place pineapple slices on a baking sheet. Pile sweet potato mixture on pineapple slices. Top each serving with a marshmallow. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes or until heated through.

title: Classic Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa well. Add egg yolks and mix well. Add milk and flavoring. Mix well and pour into pie shell. Dot surface with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Best In The West B.B.Q. Baked Beans
instructions: Brown beef bacon and onion. Drain well. All all ingredients except beans. Stir well. Add beans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. This is a main dish. As a side dish reduce beef to 1/2 pound.

title: Easy Yankee Pot Roast(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Combine roast potatoes and carrots in crock-pot. Pour in cream of mushroom and French onion soups. Cook on high for 2 to 3 hours then turn to low and cook for 10 to 11 hours.

title: Geri'S Peanut Butter Hot Fudge Pie
instructions: Cream cheese and sugar together thoroughly. Add peanut butter and milk. Whip with mixer until light and fluffy. Fold in Cool Whip (use mixer). Pour hot fudge into bottom of baked pie shell. Layer peanut mixture on top of hot fudge. Cool 5 to 6 hours in refrigerator.

title: Ranch Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a Dutch oven or other large pot. Cook 1 hour on top of stove. Dont boil just allow to simmer. This serves many and is a man sized meal. Delicious served with cole slaw and corn bread.

title: Deli Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook and rinse pasta. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients. Add pasta and toss well. Refrigerate. If salad seems dry add more dressing. Makes a lot.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil and eggs; beat well by hand for 1 minute. Sift flour salt and spices together; fold into egg mixture. Add vanilla. Fold in pears pecans and coconut.

title: Duncan Hines Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs oil and milk together. Place into 2 greased and floured round cake pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Potato Salad(For 6)
instructions: Cream or chunk potatoes. Stir in rest of ingredients.

title: Warabi (Fern Shoot) Pupu
instructions: Cut warabi into 1-inch lengths. I pile the stem ends middle part and\ttips separately. Bring water to boil; add salt. Add warabi stem end first then middle part. Bring to boil; cook for about 1 minute then add the tips. As soon as tips turn color drain in sieve and dunk in a large bowl of water. Drain and dunk in water several times until the warabi is cooled. (The trick here is to cool it immediately or else the warabi will turn brown or black although it is still edible.) Drain well. Toss together warabi and remaining ingredients. Can be eaten right away. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Fried Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Slice raw peeled sweet potatoes 1/2-inch thick. Place in heavy skillet that has margarine melted. Sprinkle sugar on potatoes. Cook on low heat turning often. When tender remove to serving dish.

title: Cherry-Pineapple Crumble
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time About 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Carrots
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes or until carrots are tender. Add butter. Stir until melted. Serve immediately.

title: K'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat cheeses on high speed with mixer until blended. Fold in dip. On waxed paper place almonds. Place mixture on almonds. Mold into round ball. Place in bowl. Chill.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
instructions: Mix shortening egg flour baking powder salt nutmeg and milk together. Fill muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Then roll in melted butter. Mix sugar and cinnamon together and roll puffs in them.

title: Blueberry Cake With Vinegar Sauce(Old New England Recipe)
instructions: Grease and flour and 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Sift first 3 ingredients together. With back of spoon work shortening against sides of mixing bowl until smooth and creamy. Add sugar slowly continuing to work until light. Add egg; beat with a spoon. Add flour mixture alternately with combined milk and vanilla in thirds beating with a spoon. Fold in blueberries. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Rocky Road Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in a frypan. Stir in peanut butter. Cool 5 minutes. Add 3/4 cup small marshmallows. Pour mixture in greased pan and refrigerate. Cut in bite-sized pieces when hard.

title: Macaroni And Tuna Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredinets in a large bowl. Add enough mayonnaise so that macaroni is covered then add 2 tablespoons more. Refrigerate. Best after 12 hours.

title: Barbecued Beef
instructions: Keep heat gentle and stir occasionally for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve on buns (rye is especially good). Makes 10 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Beat together cream cheese and milk until smooth. Add onion Worcestershire sauce lemon juice and Tabasco sauce. Smash the shrimp with a fork; stir into cheese mixture. Chill.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli and drain. Spread in ungreased baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Layer ham and cheese over broccoli. Beat remaining ingredients with hand beater until smooth. Slowly pour over ham and cheese. Bake uncovered for 1 hour.

title: Green Bean Dish
instructions: Mix all; cover and let marinate in refrigrator for 24 hours.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Beat well with mixer. Gradually add sugar; beat about 5 minutes until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each. Add flour to creamed mixture; beat well. Stir in vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes in greased 10-inch tube pan. Cool in pan 10 minutes.

title: Caesar Salad(Serves 4 People)
instructions: Using a large bowl take a large spoon and mash anchovies and garlic into a paste. Add Dijon mustard; mix good. Add egg yolk and Worcestershire sauce. Stir the olive oil in slowly until it thickens. Toss enough romaine lettuce to serve 4 people. Add fresh cracked pepper then top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Chicken Marengo
instructions: Wash chicken under cold water; remove skin if desired. Dry well on paper towels. On sheet of waxed paper combine flour salt and pepper; mix well. Roll chicken pieces in flour mixture coating evenly. In 5-quart Dutch oven slowly heat the olive oil and 2 tablespoons butter. Saute all chicken pieces on both sides in hot fat until browned. Remove and set aside. Add the garlic thyme basil and parsley to Dutch oven. Saute over medium heat 5 minutes. If using fresh tomatoes scald in boiling water; peel skins. Cut tomatoes in quarters; add to Dutch oven. (If using canned tomatoes add with liquid.) Add tomato paste sugar Tabasco and 3/4 cup of the wine. Stir to mix well. Place chicken in sauce. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer covered 40 minutes.

title: Choco Crinkles
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture. Add Rice Krispies and chocolate chips; mix. Place on greased cookie sheet using 2 teaspoons. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and shortening. Add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla. Add coconut and nuts. Fold in egg whites. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt butter and cheese slowly after chopping up. At low speed mix in powdered sugar (after sifting) and cocoa in large bowl. Add vanilla to liquid. Mix all together. Use 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans or Pyrex dishes. Let harden in refrigerator. Cut in pieces.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Melt 1/4 stick butter. Mix vegetables soups mayonnaise cheese broccoli florets and onion. Mix thoroughly then add bread crumbs rolled in melted butter to top. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 325\u00b0 until bubbly and creamy.

title: Freezer Cream Corn
instructions: Put in roaster. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Stir several times. Take out of oven and add 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon salt. Stir and cool. Put in boilable bags and freeze.

title: Date Loaf
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and boil together to a soft ball stage. Add the dates and boil 2 or 3 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Add the coconut nuts and vanilla. Beat until it starts to get hard then mold in wet cloth.

title: Temptation Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt in oven. Spread over bottom of pan. Layer crumbs coconut chocolate chips and peanut butter chips. Pour milk over chips. Sprinkle with peanuts. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool in pan to room temperature. Chill until set. Cut into bars. Store in airtight container in a cool dry place.

title: French Silk Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Blend in chocolate and vanilla. Add eggs 1 at a time beating 5 minutes after each egg at medium speed. Pour into graham cracker crust or baked pie shell. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Boil water with cloves and cinnamon for 4 to 5 minutes. Put tea bags into water for 4 minutes. Pour in sugar. Add the remaining ingredients and enough water to make one gallon.

title: Barbecue Wieners
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Add wieners and cook 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Texas Meatballs And Rice
instructions: Mix ground beef egg chili powder salt and pepper. Shape into balls. Cook and drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover. Cook until mixture is bubbling and onions are tender. Stir after half of the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender 2 to 3 minutes and serve.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil. Pour over the flour and sugar. Mix together then add the soda to the buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Bake in a 12 x 9-inch oblong pan.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: In large salad bowl combine broccoli cauliflower bacon onion eggs and tomatoes. In another bowl combine mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Mix until smooth. Just before serving pour dressing over salad and toss.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix meal and buttermilk together. Add water until you get mixture just a little soupy. Pour into a small greased iron skillet. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Glazed Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: In a large pot cover sweet potatoes with water. Bring to a boil and boil 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Drain. Let cool enough to touch. Peel and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Arrange slices in a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch Pyrex; set aside.

title: Peanut Delight
instructions: Mix sugar and cracker crumbs together add peanut butter and melted oleo and mix well. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate morsels and pour over peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate about 2 hours and cut into squares. Easy to make and is delicious.

title: Crab Meat Dip
instructions: Cream all ingredients together in a bowl. Spoon into casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve hot with assorted raw vegetables or crackers.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Combine ground meat salt and pepper. Shape into 4 patties. Brown in margarine. Cook onion along with burgers. After they are browned top with soup water basil and mushrooms. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve with mashed potatoes or noodles and a vegetable.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Make a dark brown roux of flour and bacon grease in a large heavy pot. Add onions green onions celery bell pepper and garlic and saute until soft. Add tomato paste and mix this well with vegetables. Add all other ingredients except last 3. Simmer slowly for 1 hour covered stirring occasionally. Add shrimp and cook until done 5 to 15 minutes. This should set awhile and is much better made the day before and reheated but not boiled. Freezes well. Add parsley just before serving. Serve over rice. Serves 10.

title: Maple Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream together the butter and sugar then add the flour and beat in the eggs one at a time. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Pour in unbaked pie crust and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Makes a large 9-inch pie.

title: Seven-Up-Apricot And Orange Punch
instructions: Combine orange juice concentrate and apricot nectar in punch bowl. Mix well. Add 7-Up gently. Spoon in sherbet.

title: Maple Walnut Granola(Diabetic Approved)
instructions: Soak dates in hot water while preparing other ingredients. Combine next four ingredients and process in a blender until smooth. Place remaining ingredients in a large bowl and add blended ingredients. Mix well. Spread on cookie sheets and bake at 200\u00b0F for 2-4 hours stirring occasionally until crisp and dry. This recipe yields no cholesterol.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill 1 hour. Serve with shrimp or fresh vegetables.

title: Oatmeal Patties
instructions: Simmer last 3 ingredients until transparent. Mix other ingredients and let stand 5 minutes. Add vegetables. Shape into patties and fry. Serve with gravy or alone.

title: Polish Hot Dish
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain. Slice sausage and brown. Mix with rest of ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Boneless Beef Birds(Benlose Fugler)
instructions: Pound steak well on both sides with flour salt and pepper. Cut into 4-inch squares. Place about 1 tablespoon filling on each square. Roll and bind with clean boiled string or fasten with toothpicks. Brown in butter in electric skillet. Add 1/2 cup water and simmer on 280\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Or after browned place in buttered baking utensil with water; cover with foil and bake in a 275\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 6 to 8 rolls.

title: Lemon Pecan Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place pecans in bottom of 10-inch greased baking pan. Sift flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In a bowl stir milk lemon juice lemon zest vanilla and food coloring; set aside. In a large mixing bowl cream butter for about 45 seconds. Gradually add sugar and gelatin; beat until mixture is very light and fluffy 4 to 5 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating about 1 minute after each addition. Scrape bowl frequently while adding eggs.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Brown bacon that is cut into small pieces with diced onion. Put tomatoes in pan. Add bacon and onions. Cook 15 minutes. Add to spaghetti and mix. Pour 1/2 mixture into large baking dish then 1/3 of cheese that has been grated. Add remaining spaghetti; top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Use as dip for fresh vegetables.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple saving the juice. Mix the pineapple and marshmallows and put in covered container. Refrigerate overnight. In a small saucepan mix pineapple juice sugar flour vinegar and the egg. Heat over medium heat until mixture becomes thick. Put this in another container cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in large baking dish. Add half the stuffing mix; mix well. Layer chicken over stuffing. Combine soups milk and mixed vegetables in bowl; mix well. Spread over chicken. Top with remaining stuffing mix. Pour broth over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Yield 6 servings.

title: Pink Stuff!(Salad)
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in casserole dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Vietnamese Rice
instructions: Cook rice and set aside. Cook celery and onions in oil until tender. Add eggs and scramble. Add Spam rice and cabbage; toss. Sprinkle with soy sauce and toss. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Serves 4 to 6 adults.

title: Fruit Punch(Good!)
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid as directed then add pineapple juice and Hawaiian Punch. Serve cold.

title: Chewy Chocolate Macaroons
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Drop by teaspoon 1-inch apart on well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from sheet at once.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and let set until lightly jelled (take out one cup). Mix Jell-O oranges and pineapple together. Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and 1 cup Jell-O together. Spread on top of Jell-O mixture. Let stand until firm in 7 x 11-inch glass pan.

title: Two Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes until fork-tender; let cool! Cut cucumbers lengthwise in half; remove seeds then cut crosswise into 1-inch chunks. Mix mayonnaise vinegar salt sugar and 1/2 cup water. Add potatoes and cucumbers! Cover and chill in refrigerator 1 hour.

title: Quick Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add cake mix; blend. Work in the flour until soft dough. Let rise until double. Roll out into a circle with rolling pin dusted with flour on a surface dusted with flour. Sprinkle with cinnamon melted oleo sugar or chopped nuts as desired. Roll up the circle of dough pinching together at ends. Cut into 1-inch pieces with knife and place in greased pan. Brush with melted oleo. Let rise until double. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Ice with powdered sugar icing made with powdered sugar thinned with milk and vanilla.

title: Froice
instructions: Make and let stand for an hour. Temper frypan. Put 1/2 cup of batter in well-greased pan. Sprinkle on currants. Brown on both sides; spread with butter and sugar. Makes a large amount. Cut recipe in half for small family.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Spoon into hot oil. Cook until golden brown.

title: Sweet Potato Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 16 to 18 muffin tins. Combine dry ingredients. Add egg oil milk and sweet potato mixing gently. Fill tins and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Tostada Platter
instructions: Mix refried beans and salsa. Spread on a platter. Mix sour cream green onions avocado and olives. Spread over beans. Sprinkle lettuce tomatoes and cheeses over sour cream. Place chips around edges and in separate bowl.

title: Holiday Fruit Cake
instructions: Put raisins dates fruits sugar water and shortening in a large pot; bring to a boil then simmer for 20 minutes. Cool. Sift flour once before measuring. Combine flour soda cinnamon cloves and salt and sift together. Stir into cool mixture adding eggs and nuts last. Pour into very well-greased and floured pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Frozen Strawberry Daiquiris
instructions: Pour limeade lemonade rum and strawberries into blender and blend.

title: Taglarini
instructions: In a large heavy pot combine tomatoes tomato sauce corn and olives; slowly heat. In a large skillet heat olive oil and saute onions and garlic. Add to pot. Saute beef in skillet until red is gone then add to pot. Carefully add seasonings to taste. Cook about 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in cooked macaroni and remove from heat.

title: Bill'S Stew
instructions: Place beef in oil and brown. Combine all other ingredients and bring to a boil. Cook on medium heat until done.

title: Turkish Vermicelli Soup
instructions: Break vermicelli into 1/2-inch pieces. Heat oil in large saucepan. Add onion and vermicelli and cook stirring constantly until vermicelli is brown and onion is clear. Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil. Simmer until vermicelli is cooked and carrots and celery are done stirring often.

title: Japanese Pie
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar together. Melt margarine and blend into egg mix. Blend well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Lightning Salad
instructions: Refrigerate grapefruit (undrained). Dissolve gelatin in boiling 7-Up. Stir in cold undrained grapefruit. Pour into a serving bowl. Refrigerate.

title: Minestrone
instructions: Place soup bone and beef in large pot (8 quart). Add water; bring to boil; skim. Add tomatoes sauce onions parsley garlic salt pepper and basil; bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add carrots and celery; cover and simmer 1/2 hour. Remove meat and bones; trim fat off meat and discard. Cut meat into pieces and return to soup. Heat to boiling; add uncooked pasta green beans and peas. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir in kidney beans; heat to boiling. Makes about 6 quarts.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring 1 1/2 cups cold water to boil in a medium heavy-bottomed saucepan over high heat. Stir in rice reduce heat to low cover and cook until water has been absorbed and rice is tender 20-25 minutes.

title: Warm Green Bean And Pancetta Salad
instructions: *Pancetta Italian bacon cured in salt is available at Italian markets and some specialty food stores.

title: Delicious Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and pineapple juice. Add ginger ale and spoon in sherbet.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Beat milk eggs and flour until smooth. Rinse chilies and drain on paper towels. Mix cheeses and reserve 1/2 cup for top. Make alternate layers of cheese chilies and egg mixture in deep casserole dish. Pour tomato sauce and remaining cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to directions. Melt butter in skillet over medium heat; add bell pepper and onion saute 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in cooked rice cream style corn and next 6 ingredients. Spoon into a lightly greased 3 1/2 quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Top with cheddar cheese and bake 5 more minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Black Walnut Gold Filling Cake
instructions: Mix cake and bake as directed on box for 3 round cake pans. Mix remaining ingredients listed to use as icing for each layer and on sides of cake. Make sure to cool cake before frosting.

title: Banana Peach Jam
instructions: Mix all but sugar in a large pot; bring to a rolling boil. Stir in sugar; bring to rolling boil for 1 minute. Put in baby food jars.

title: Fancy Franks
instructions: Arrange bun halves on broiler pan. Place wieners spread open on buns. Sprinkle with onion. Cover with cheese. Pour catsup over cheese. Broil until cheese melts. Serve hot. Yield 6 servings.

title: Pecan Molasses Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs flour salt almond extract and syrup. Stir well. Add pecans and pour in pie crust. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0 and 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 loaf pans or 1 tube pan. In a large bowl cream the shortening and sugar until fluffy. Stir in remaining ingredients. Blend well. Bake about 70 minutes.

title: Waldorf Slaw Salad
instructions: Toss gently to coat everything. Chill to let flavor blend. Before serving garnish with more apple slices. Dip the apple in lemon juice to prevent browning. Add 1/4 cup chopped walnuts.

title: Prize Winning 4-H Corn Bread
instructions: Put Wesson oil in muffin tins and put in oven to get hot. Mix all the ingredients well and fill muffin tins. Put in oven at 450\u00b0 to cook for about 10 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Mix margarine and stuffing in a large casserole dish. Mix soup and broth and pour on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes And Waffles
instructions: Beat eggs on high with a mixer. Beat in butter milk on lowest speed. Sift all dry ingredients together. Beat into eggs and milk on low. Add melted butter and beat just until smooth on medium. Spray a cast iron skillet with cooking oil or rub lightly with butter. Have the skillet very hot and place about a half cup of batter in it. Cook until it is set around the edges; turn and cook the other side until brown. Cook on a waffle iron on medium heat using 7/8 of a cup of batter. Cook until the light goes out. To bake in the oven cover bottom of a skillet with batter bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until pancakes are fluffy and brown.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water. Add remaining ingredients. Spread in glass baking dish and chill.

title: Baked Cauliflower
instructions: Cook flowerets in small amount of water (boiling) for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp and tender. Place flowerets in buttered baking dish. Set aside. Combine soup sour cream 1 tablespoon melted butter and pepper. Stir well and pour over cauliflower. Combine bread crumbs and remaining melted butter and put over soup mix. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbly.

title: Blackberry Jam Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add all dry ingredients together. Alternate with buttermilk. Add beaten eggs vanilla and blackberry jam. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cornmeal Pancakes(Modern)
instructions: Sift together flour salt and soda. Stir in cornmeal. Add eggs and buttermilk and heat until lumps are gone. Pour 1/4 cup of batter for each cake onto lightly greased hot griddle. Bake until golden brown on both sides.

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Pour enough water into rhubarb to keep from sticking. Add sugar and cook until tender. Remove from heat stir in dry jello. Makes 1 1/2 pints.

title: Toast Cups
instructions: Trim crust from bread slices. Press center of slice into muffin tin leaving corners to form 4 tips. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Brush with melted butter (optional). Cool. Fill with favorite meat filling. Garnish with olives and paprika.

title: Easy Mayonnaise Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in muffin tins filled one-half full for 10 to 12 minutes in a 425\u00b0 oven.

title: Mushroom Burger
instructions: In small skillet saute mushrooms in butter. Mix all ingredients; shape into patties. May need more crumbs. Fry in butter or on Teflon skillet.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in greased tube pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Jezebel Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. It is wonderful drizzled over a block of cream cheese and served with crackers or biscuits. It is also wonderful served with ham or just about anything. Refrigerate unused portion. It can be packed into jars and given as a gift along with a package of cream cheese and Wheat Thin crackers.

title: Old-Fashioned Popcorn Balls
instructions: Place popcorn in a large buttered bowl. In heavy 2-quart saucepan stir together syrup water brown sugar and vinegar. Stir constantly over medium heat until mixture boils. Continue cooking stirring occasionally until temperature on candy thermometer reaches 260\u00b0 or until a small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a ball. Remove from heat; stir in butter. Slowly pour over popcorn. Make balls.

title: Sweet-Sour Lettuce
instructions: Mix half and half vinegar and salt in salad bowl. Add lettuce; toss. Makes 5 or 6 servings.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake white sheet cake; let cool. Mix pineapple and sugar and boil for 10 minutes. Punch holes in cake so pineapple mixture wont run to sides. Pour over cake and let cool. Mix pudding with milk; pour over cake and let set. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle coconut over Cool Whip. Top with nuts (optional).

title: Preacher Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Fold in the Cool Whip. Refrigerate. Ready in 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Simple Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove all bones and skin. Cut chicken into desired size pieces. Spread evenly on bottom of a 10 x 10 x 20-inch casserole dish. Mix 3/4 of the dressing mix with chicken broth celery soup milk celery celery salt and curry powder if used. Pour this mixture over the chicken in the dish then sprinkle the remaining 1/4 of the stuffing mix over the top. Take some of the chicken broth and pour around the edges of the casserole. This helps keep the casserole from sticking. If desired sprinkle melted butter over the top of the casserole. Bake uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 or brown on top to your liking.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix bananas sugar butter and eggs. Sift flour and soda. Add to first ingredients. Add chopped nuts. Bake in a greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Season meat with garlic powder black pepper generously on all sides. In 8-quart Dutch oven on top of stove brown meat on all sides in hot cooking oil for about 5 minutes keeping cover on. Lower heat to medium. Add sliced onions until brown. Add broth and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer pot roast for 3 to 4 hours. The last 45 minutes of cooking time add diced celery carrots and chopped parsley. When vegetables are tender remove meat and keep warm.

title: Mexican Masterpiece Dip
instructions: Combine beans and jalapeno dip; spread mix on large platter. Top with avocado dip.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In a 5-quart Dutch oven cook chicken in boiling water with salt saffron and pepper until done about 45 minutes. Remove chicken; set aside. Skim off excess fat if desired. Add vegetables; bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients; boil for 11 to 13 minutes or until bow ties are tender.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: Cook pasta. Combine all ingredients and let sit overnight in a large covered Tupperware container.

title: Coke Salad
instructions: Drain fruit (about 2 cups) and boil juice. Dissolve jello in juice. Add cream cheese and mash. Let stand until it begins to thicken. Add nuts and fruit and last Coke. Place in oblong Pyrex glass dish (9 x 12-inch). Chill until set.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook ground beef pork onion and garlic until meat is browned and onion is tender. Drain off fat. Add tomatoes and break up with fork. Stir in tomato sauce 1/4 cup parsley flakes sugar 2 teaspoons salt and basil. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for about 1 hour or until mixture is consistency of spaghetti sauce.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes cool. Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Add baking powder soda cinnamon nutmeg allspice and salt. Mix well and add chopped nuts. Chill dough; drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 400 degrees for 12-15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Lemonade Chicken
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Stir well. Place chicken on grill (medium to hot). Grill 15 to 20 minutes turning frequently. Brush with sauce and grill an additional 30 to 35 minutes or until done basting and turning frequently. Serves 8.

title: Sour Cream Gravy
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan mix flour and salt. Gradually add drippings stirring until smooth. Add wine. Stir over medium heat until thickened. Reduce heat to low. Stir in sour cream; heat to serving temperature.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Starting with spinach put each ingredient in large salad bowl. Spinach on bottom salt and pepper then put on bacon then eggs then torn lettuce salt and pepper then cheese onion and top with frozen peas (put on frozen).

title: Calico Cabbage
instructions: Butter large casserole dish. Mix ingredients together. Put remaining butter on top and bake at least 1 hour at 350\u00b0 stirring occasionally.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour and salt in mixing bowl. Cut in shortening. Add milk and vinegar. Shape dough into a ball. Chill for 30 minutes. Divide dough in half. Roll each half on a floured surface to fit 2 (9-inch) pie pans.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle the seasonings on the steaks and then broil them for 15 minutes in the oven. Remove meat then cut each piece into 2-inch wide strips. Place the Italian salad dressing in a large bowl. Add vinegar and beat together with a wire whisk. Place the steak all bell pepper strips and cherry tomatoes in the bowl. Mix well with the dressing. Chill for 2 hours then serve.

title: Veggie Chili
instructions: Chop coarsely all vegetables and steam until just tender. Saute garlic and onions in sprayed skillet until clear. Remove and brown all meat. Place all ingredients into a covered roaster and stir. (Crock-pots may also be used.) Roaster Bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours. Crock-pot Low 8 to 10 hours.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
instructions: Bring water and sugar to a boil; add cherry pie filling. Bring to boil again. Add jello and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat; add pineapple lemon juice Coke and nuts. Stir together and refrigerate.

title: Crusty Chicken(Quick, Easy And Delicious)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray baking dish with Pam on bottom only. Clean chicken well. Mix soup and water well. Coat chicken with soup and dredge in the stuffing crumbs. Once all chicken breasts have been coated with soup and crumbs and placed in pan sprinkle evenly with seasoning pack mix. Drizzle with the melted butter. Bake approximately 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked thoroughly. Serves 4.

title: Potato-Ham Soup
instructions: Cook the potatoes onion and salt in water to cover and boil for 15 minutes. Add margarine. Cook 5 more minutes. Add ham. Cook 5 more minutes. Add milk. Heat and eat. Do not boil.

title: Spinach Salad With Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Cut vegetables in bite size pieces. Stir all together.

title: Black Beans
instructions: Wash beans and put them in water for several hours. Cook them in same water. In a separate pan heat the 2/3 cup olive oil. Saute the onion green pepper and garlic; add to beans. Also add salt pepper oregano lauren leaf and sugar. Bring to boil; cook for another hour. Add vinegar and dry wine and cook at low heat for another hour. When ready to serve add the 2 teaspoons olive oil.

title: Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Remove crescent rolls from package and pat 1 package crescent dough carefully on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese sugar egg yolk vanilla and lemon juice together. Carefully spread cream cheese mixture on top of dough in pan. Cover with remaining crescent dough. Beat egg white until foamy and spread on top of dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes milk eggs white sugar 1 stick oleo 1 cup chopped nuts vanilla salt and cooking sherry. Put in buttered casserole dish.

title: Hot Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa together. Mix sugar eggs evaporated milk and vanilla. Add to butter and cocoa. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Wonderful Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove and frost while warm.

title: Delicious Oriental Chicken Barbecue
instructions: Combine soy sauce pineapple juice lemon juice sugar minced garlic and ground pepper. Pour over chicken and marinate for about 1/2 hour or more. Preferred cooking method is barbecue grill. Baste chicken with remaining soy sauce mixture while cooking. Serve with your favorite white rice.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Can be served immediately or will keep a week to ten days in refrigerator. Delicious with vegetables.

title: Tomato Pudding To Eat With Beans
instructions: Cook in small pan in microwave on High for 8 minutes stirring in between until bubbly through.

title: Mama'S Pineapple Layer Cake
instructions: Bake cake layers according to directions. Cake mix usually makes 3 layers. Mix Cool Whip and sour cream.

title: A La Green Beans
instructions: Using a medium saucepan saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat through and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Melt the margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle in layers the cracker crumbs chocolate chips nuts and coconut. Pour the Eagle Brand milk over this. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool 15 minutes; cut into squares.

title: Toffee Bars
instructions: Line jelly roll pan with foil; layer with soda crackers. Cook butter and brown sugar together for 3 short minutes. Pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 3 minutes until crackers float. Remove from oven; sprinkle with chocolate chips. Spread when melted. Cool; break into pieces.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix instant pudding and 2 cups milk; stir in Cool Whip.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Place carrots and water in a 1-quart casserole; cover with a tight fitting lid or plastic wrap. Microwave on High 100% power for 6 to 8 minutes or until tender. Allow to stand 5 minutes then drain. Combine brown sugar orange juice orange peel and butter in a 1-cup measure. Microwave on High 100% power for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Pour over carrots; cover. Microwave on High 100% for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: In a 7 1/2 x 12-inch dish layer the following

title: Cowboy Casserole(Former Dallas Cowboy, Don Meredith)
instructions: Cook spaghetti until just tender. Brown onion in butter; add ground beef and cook until browned. Add salt pepper and seasonings. Add soups and Worcestershire; mix spaghetti and meat sauce. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Put into casserole dish. Top with cheese and heat in oven until cheese melts.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Cream together sugar and margarine. Add eggs. Beat. Add flour. Stir in vanilla chips and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Candied Pineapple
instructions: Combine in 3-quart dish sugar 1/3 cup pineapple juice reserved from drained pineapple slices and light corn syrup. Arrange 5 pineapple slices in single layer over sugar mixture and microwave on High (100%) 8 to 12 minutes or until sugar dissolves and slices are glossy and transparent at edges turning over and rearranging every 4 minutes. Cool on a wire rack where they will become more transparent while standing.

title: Iced Tea
instructions: Combine tea bags and mint with boiling water in saucepan. Steep for 15 minutes. Strain into 1-gallon container. Stir in sugar until dissolved. Add lemon juice concentrate and cold water; mix well. Serve over ice with sprigs of mint.

title: Aunt Helen'S Egg Nog(Easy And Yummy!)
instructions: Beat together first five ingredients. Gently fold in whipped cream. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Easy and yummy! Serves 8.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Naked Apple Pie
instructions: Beat egg in a middle-size bowl. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add sugars vanilla and salt to beaten egg. Pare and chop or slice apples. Chop nuts. Add to mixture. Spread it all in a greased 9-inch pie plate and bake it 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Tastes delicious.

title: Belly Buttons
instructions: Toss all together in large bowl; cover and let set overnight. (Helps to sprinkle crackers with the dill weed and the Ranch dressing then add the oil.)

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Arrange pineapple chunks over this. Sprinkle cake mix over pineapple. Cover with melted butter. Bake for 45 minutes then top with the coconut and nuts and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Prepare and cook carrots in microwave (slice carrots on the diagonal or use baby carrots). In large skillet cook and stir brown sugar salt orange peel and butter until bubbly. Add carrots and cook over low heat stirring occasionally about 5 minutes or until carrots are heated and glazed through. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples and white sugar and add oil and walnuts. Beat eggs and add with vanilla. Mix soda baking powder flour cinnamon and salt; add to other mixture. Grease a 9 x 12-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Cheddar Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Recrimp pie shell in its aluminum pan making high fluted edge or transfer pastry to 4-cup square baking pan and crimp edges.

title: Corn Cakes
instructions: Add corn meal to boiling water; boil for 5 minutes. Turn into bowl. Add milk. Add remaining dry ingredients that have been mixed and sifted. Add egg well beaten; add fat. Cook same as other griddle cakes.

title: Chicken Noodles
instructions: Mix eggs milk and salt together. Add flour and mix well. Roll out on well floured board. Cut and put in hot boiling chicken and broth. Cook until done approximately 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs with a wire whisk or fork. Add salt butter syrup sugar and vanilla; mix well. Pour into pastry shell; sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Yield One 9-inch pie.

title: Meat Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onions then drain and set aside. In saucepan mix soup milk cheese and taco seasoning. Simmer until cheese melts. Add brown hamburger; heat and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Saucepan Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a heavy saucepan combine sugar cocoa milk and margarine. Bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes. Stir in peanut butter and rolled oats. Return to a boil and remove from heat. Immediately drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Cool. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Honey-Dijon Zucchini
instructions: Combine zucchini and red pepper strips in a microproof 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with lid or vented plastic wrap and microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until crisp-tender.

title: Rice Nibblers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Use as a dip or as a spread with crackers.

title: Frozen Oreo Cake
instructions: Crush cookies and mix with melted butter. Pour mix into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut ice cream into 8 sections 3/4-inch thick. Spread fudge topping over the ice cream and freeze then put Cool Whip on top and garnish with cookie crumbs; freeze again.

title: Chocolate Mint Souffle
instructions: Combine 2 teaspoons sugar and flour in saucepan. Gradually stir in milk mixing well. Stir in egg and egg yolk and cook over low heat until thickened stirring constantly. Cool. Melt chocolate in creme de menthe. Stir into egg mixture. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Spoon into 4 (8 ounce) souffle cups which have been lightly buttered and sprinkled with granulated sugar. Bake in a pan of hot water at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until souffle tests done (a silver knife inserted in center comes out clean when done). Serve at once. Yields 4 servings.

title: Southern Spoon Bread
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients with 1 cup of the milk. Bring to boil and stir until thick. Beat eggs and add to the other 1 cup of milk. Stir into thickened mixture. Pour into greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Delicious!

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Put chicken in shallow pan. Mix undiluted soups together and pour over chicken. Spread sour cream and sprinkle almonds over all top. Bake 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours serve with rice.

title: Cheese Nippies
instructions: Melt shortening in shallow large pan. Add seasonings; stir in cereal and grated cheese and mix. Place in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 stirring occasionally for 15 minutes. Eat as popcorn. Yield 5 1/2 cups.

title: Recipe For A Happy Marriage
instructions: Toss well with lots of hugs and kisses and a generous dash of cooperation.

title: French Chocolates
instructions: Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch or 9-inch square pan. Mix spread sugar and milk in heavy 2 1/2 to 3-quart saucepan; bring to full rolling boil on medium heat stirring constantly. Continue boiling 5 minutes on medium heat or until candy thermometer reaches 234\u00b0 stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in chips until melted. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into prepared pan. Cool at room temperature; cut into squares. Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk and lemon juice. Stir in cranberry sauce pineapple and nuts. Fold in whipped topping. Spread in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Freeze until firm. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before cutting. Serve on lettuce leaves. Return leftovers to freezer. Makes 15 servings.

title: Andi'S Spicy Enchilada Casserole(Easyee)
instructions: You will need one large bowl one large spoon and one medium sized glass dish.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Slice cookie dough and spread close together on pizza pan. Bake as directed on cookie package. Cool. Beat together cream cheese milk and sugar. Spread over cooled cookies. Then add layers of pineapple oranges bananas and nuts. Spread strawberry pie filling over the top. Ready to eat but better if chilled.

title: No Cook Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine instant pudding with condensed milk. Stir in Cool Whip until mixture is smooth. Slowly add milk (about 1/4 cup at a time). Slice bananas and add to mixture. Layer large baking dish with vanilla wafers and pour pudding mixture over wafers. Garnish with vanilla wafers and sliced bananas if desired. Chill for an hour before serving.

title: Creamed Tacos
instructions: Brown meat and drain off grease. Add chili until melted. Add other ingredients; when cheese melts and thickens serve over Doritos and top with onions lettuce and tomato.

title: Amish Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine oil and sugar and mix well. Add egg; beat 1 minute until well blended. Add vanilla in separate bowl. Combine flour baking soda and cream of tartar. Add to creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yields about 5 dozen.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Heat oil. Fry steak and soy sauce until browned. Stir in peppers and onions; heat until tender. Stir cornstarch in broth; add to meat and vegetables. Cook until thick. Serve over rice.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: Chop onion garlic and fresh chilies. Melt cheese; add tomatoes onion garlic chilies and cumin; mix well. Keep warm; serve with chips.

title: Jackie'S Tomato Cheese Twist(Jackie Clotfelter)
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Cut in butter until mixture is mealy. Add cheese. Stir in enough tomato juice to make a soft dough. Knead for about 30 seconds. Roll out about 1/2 inch thick and cut into 3 x 1/2-inch strips. Twist the strips together and place on baking sheet. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with celery seed. Bake for 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stir-Fried Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Skin bone and cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Season chicken with ginger and pepper. In a large frying pan or wok heat oil to high temperature. Add chicken and stir-fry until browned. Push chicken to one side and add vegetables. Stir-fry vegetables for 3 minutes. Combine 3/4 cup broth salt and sugar. Add to chicken. Reduce to medium-high heat; cover and cook for 2 minutes. Stir remaining 2 tablespoons broth into cornstarch to smooth paste. Add to chicken and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately. Serves 8.

title: Parmesan Roll-Ups
instructions: You will need 4 large toothpicks.

title: Best Hand And Body Lotion Ever
instructions: Mix ingredients until smooth and put in pretty lotion bottles.

title: Sourdough Starter
instructions: Put milk in a shallow pan covered with screen or cheesecloth and let stand at room temperature for 24 hours. Place in quart jar and stir in flour. Let stand at room temperature (warm) for 2 to 5 days until very bubbly. When it has a good sour aroma and bubbles subside it is ready for use. You may wish to catch another wild yeast if your first one is not active enough or to get a slightly different flavor. It may be kept ready for use in the refrigerator for several weeks before it is necessary to use it and refresh it.

title: Frog'S Legs
instructions: Skin frog legs. Wash; cut off feet. Soak for 1 hour in salt water. Bean an egg. Season legs with salt and pepper. Roll in fine bread crumbs then in egg and then in bread crumbs again. Fry in hot fat. Drain well.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine beans milk soup pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions. Top with remaining onions. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Blueberry-Pineapple Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix drink gelatin and sweetener in a saucepan. Heat to boiling point to dissolve gelatin. Add all other ingredients. Pour into an oiled mold or oblong container. Refrigerate to gel. Yields 8 servings.

title: Spinach And Cheese Pie(Breakfast)
instructions: Combine cottage cheese cheddar cheese eggs and flour in a large bowl. Thaw spinach and drain thoroughly. Fold into cheese mixture. Spoon into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400 - 425 for 40 - 60 minutes until top is puffy and lightly browned.

title: Happy Times Punch
instructions: Boil sugar and water for 1 minute stirring constantly. Add all three juices. Just before serving add ginger ale. Sprinkle ginger inside of punch bowl. Makes nearly 3 quarts.

title: Canned Grape Juice
instructions: Wash grapes and remove stems. Put 1 cup of grapes and 1/2 cup sugar in a quart jar. Fill jar with hot water. Seal the jars and process in pressure canner at 5 pounds pressure for 8 minutes.

title: Chocolate And Pecan Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening sugars vanilla water and eggs until fluffy. Mix flour with soda and salt; blend into shortening mixture. Stir in nuts and chips. Drop 2-inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Green Beans And Corn Casserole
instructions: Layer vegetables then top with cheese. Mix soup and sour cream and spread over cheese. Combine melted margarine and Ritz crackers and sprinkle over top of soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash and clean chicken. Use a clean mixing bowl to season chicken. Baste chicken with butter; completely rub the butter on the chicken. Season the chicken with seasoned salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Open and stir the mushroom soup and add a little water to make it creamy. Pour soup over chicken and mix it with your hands thoroughly. Pour chicken into baking dish. Cover with onions and bell peppers (sliced). Bake 2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Meat And Vegetable Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low for 6 hours.

title: Venison Stir-Fry
instructions: Cut beef into 2-inch strips. Toss beef 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 teaspoon cornstarch 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon soy sauce and dash of white pepper in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes. Cut broccoli into 1-inch pieces. If using fresh broccoli it needs to be blanched. No need to blanch frozen broccoli. Slice onion and mushrooms. Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch and the water

title: Pineapple Stuffing
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in pineapple. Fold in bread cubes. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered 1 hour or until brown on top at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Tijuana Dip
