instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Season to taste. Drain. Melt cheese in meat. Add picante sauce. Let cook on low heat for about 5 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Sombrero Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese in bottom of baking dish. Spread chili over cream cheese. Spread onion over chili. Spread Cheddar over onion. Sprinkle ripe chopped olives over Cheddar if desired. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 5 minutes or until Cheddar melts and runs together.

title: Day-Old Buns, Rolls, Etc.
instructions: Jazz up leftover hamburger and hot dog buns or dinner rolls etc.

title: Mom'S Best Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 8-inch square baking pan with vegetable spray. Set aside. In medium bowl combine flour cocoa and salt. Mix well. In large bowl whisk egg whites egg sugar applesauce oil and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture until just blended. Do not overmix. Pour batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle with walnuts. Bake until just set; toothpick inserted in center comes out clean about 25 minutes. Place pan on wire rack. Cool for 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pack in foil pans about 1-inch deep and place in freezer. Keeps a long time.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Let cool. Crumble half of cake in the bottom of a punch bowl. Mix pineapple pie filling and pecans. Pour half mixture over cake in punch bowl. Prepare pudding mix as directed on package. Pour half of pudding over pineapple mixture in punch bowl. Repeat layering. Top with Cool Whip nuts and coconut.

title: Chicken Rice Salad
instructions: Combine rice green pepper onion chicken French dressing and Tabasco. Toss lightly. Chill thoroughly (overnight if possible). Cut eggs in half. Combine yolks in small bowl with balance of ingredients. Refill egg whites. Arrange lettuce in salad bowl. Mound rice in center. Arrange stuffed eggs on top.

title: Down East Blueberry Pie
instructions: Cook 1 cup of blueberries with sugar and 1/2 cup of water until soft. Make paste of flour salt and 1/2 cup of water; add to cooked berries. Cook slowly until thickened. Add to uncooked berries; turn into shell. Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let stand for 1 hour. Roll out thin cut in desired pieces. Fry in deep fat. To eat dip in honey. This dough can be used for fried pies.

title: Fat-Free Pumpkin Raisin Cake
instructions: Spray 9-inch square baking pan with cooking spray. In large bowl combine dry ingredients and raisins. In medium bowl combine remaining ingredients. Add to dry ingredients; stir until smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack. If desired serve with Fat-Free Yogurt Cream Sauce. Makes 16 servings.

title: Garden Vegetable Bake
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan mix all ingredients; toss thoroughly. Cover with foil in which holes have been punched. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until all vegetables are tender. Remove foil in the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Spinach Casserole *
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Saute onion in oleo. Add onions to spinach and other ingredients except artichokes which have been cut in half and lined in a 3-quart casserole. Pour spinach mixture over artichokes and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Serves 16.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Cook peas until tender but still bright green in color. Drain and cool. Mix the remaining ingredients with peas adding enough Miracle Whip to hold the mixture together. Salt to taste. Chill for 2 to 3 hours before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix together cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning and spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with lettuce black olives and cheese. Top with onions mushrooms and peppers if desired. Buy a bag of tortilla chips and dip in.

title: Diet Raisin Pie
instructions: Combine raisins boiling water salt cornstarch orange juice and lemon juice; cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add Equal and lemon rind. Pour into uncooked crust. Top with lattice crust. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until crust is done.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. To serve use 1/3 cup of mix with hot water in regular cup size.

title: Duck And Sauerkraut
instructions: Parboil breasts. Place sauerkraut in casserole. Arrange breasts over kraut. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Spread drained chillies thinly in 10 x 6 baking dish. Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on top of chillies. Beat eggs. Add milk and heat together with eggs. Pour eggs and milk over chillies and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter. Use garlic salt to season. Place in 2-quart casserole. Add rice and beef consomme. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cover casserole dish while baking.

title: Coconut Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter shortening and cream cheese gradually adding sugar. Beating well at medium speed add eggs. Beat well after each egg. Combine flour soda and salt; add to creamed mixture stirring until well blended.

title: Hot Buttered Rum Mix
instructions: In a small mixer bowl beat together softened butter or margarine brown sugar powdered sugar nutmeg and cinnamon until well combined. Beat in the softened ice cream. Turn mixture into a 4-cup freezer container. Seal and freeze. (Mixture will not freeze solid.) Makes about 4 cups of mix.

title: Veggie Pita Pizzas
instructions: Split each pita bread round horizontally so you have four rounds. Place rounds on baking sheet. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 2 to 3 minutes or until dry and crisp. Spread each round with tomato sauce. Arrange vegetables on top. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven about 5 minutes or until cheese melts and pizzas are heated through.

title: Spring Temptation
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sherbet stirring until melted. Chill for 30 minutes. Then add Cool Whip pineapple and marshmallows. Freeze until firm. Serve with graham crackers on the side as you would with a dip. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix meats bread crumbs milk seasonings and egg together. Put in a well-greased loaf pan. Lay strips of bacon across the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Iron Skillet Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa. Melt butter in iron skillet. Add sugar mixture and mix lightly. Combine beaten egg yolks and milk; add to mixture stirring constantly. Cook slowly until thick. Add vanilla and blend well. Pour into baked pie shell. Cover with stiffly beaten egg whites. Brown in oven.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Cook sausage until brown and drain. Add other ingredients and mix. Chill until cool. Make into 3/4-inch balls. Dip in flour and beaten egg and roll in bread crumbs. Deep fry until brown. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Meatballs And Spaghetti
instructions: Mix well into meat. Add eggs and milk; mix thoroughly. Lightly roll mix into balls. Brown in oil before adding to sauce.

title: Miracle Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter milk and salt in a 4-quart mixing bowl. Microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir until well blended. Microwave on High 6 to 7 minutes until mixture boils and forms a soft ball in cold water. Add chocolate chips and stir until melted. Fold in marshmallow cream and vanilla until well blended. Pour into a buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Chill until firm and cut into squares. Top each square with a walnut half.

title: Dirt Cake(Served At Awards Party For Swimming)
instructions: Mix pudding and milk; fold in Cool Whip. Mix cream cheese butter and sugar. Mix pudding and cream cheese mixtures together. Use 8-inch flowerpot. Line bottom with wax paper. Layer Oreos and pudding. End with Oreos. Add plastic flowers and serve with a hand shovel.

title: Aunt Bernice'S Stolen Delight
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add and mix milk and peanut butter. Fold in the Cool Whip. Put in a chocolate cookie pie shell and freeze 2 hours to overnight. Before serving cut into pieces and top each piece with a spoonful of Sanders fudge sauce that has been heated.

title: Spaghetti Chop
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. In skillet brown ground beef; drain. Add onion salt and seasoning salt. Cook until onion is tender about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. When spaghetti is cooked drain and return to skillet. Add beef mixture soup and ketchup. Mix well. Simmer for 10 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Exotic Cooler
instructions: Cut the fruits into thin slices. Add wine and sugar. Pour in carbonated water. Stir well.

title: Chuck Wagon Beans
instructions: In a 2-quart bean pot combine onion and all other ingredients. Stir well. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 1 hour (the last 15 minutes of baking time remove lid).

title: Cabbage, Carrot And Raisin Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; toss well. Cover; chill for at least 1 hour. Yields 8 servings (about 73 calories per 1/2-cup serving).

title: Betty'S Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in tap water added in buttermilk. Work shortening into flour soda and sugar. Add milk and yeast. Turn onto floured surface roll out dough and cut out biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Bake pie shells according to package. Chop pecans and bake on cookie sheet at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. In large mixing bowl mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar until completely creamed. Add vanilla. Fold in 12 ounce Cool Whip. In baked pie shells layer with pecans then cream cheese mixture. Top with favorite pie filling and 8 ounces Cool Whip. Chill for 30 minutes slice and serve.

title: Tropical Delight
instructions: Mix dry Jell-O with cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Add all fruits that have been well drained. Mix and refrigerate.

title: Grandma Stillman'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix butter sugar egg sour milk and baking soda. To this mixture add sifted flour baking powder cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir only until well blended. Pour batter into greased or buttered small loaf pans (2 x 2 1/2 x 6-inch). Sprinkle top of each loaf with a cinnamon/sugar mixture. Press pecan halves onto surface of loaves. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 4 small loaves.

title: Frig (Sweet) Pickles
instructions: Bring to a boil. Put in gallon jugs and put in refrigerator. Ready to eat in 2 to 3 days.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries and sugar in small amount of water until all of berries are open. Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Dissolve cherry jello in 1 cup boiling water then add 1 cup cold water. Mix all together and stir once or twice while congealing.

title: Sunshine Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl stir together all the cake ingredients until moist. Beat by hand for 2 minutes. Coat a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray. Pour batter into pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool completely.

title: Hot Seafood Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs and mix well. Put in a buttered casserole dish and sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: In large saucepan cook apples in cider until tender stirring occasionally. When tender process apples through a sieve or food mill. Measure 6 cups of pulp into same pot. Stir in sugar and spices. Cook over low heat stirring frequently to prevent scorching. Cook about 1 hour or until very thick. Pour hot into hot sterilized jars and seal. For longer storage process pint jars in boiling water bath for 10 minutes.

title: Rice Krispie Caramel Bars
instructions: Melt 1/4 cup butter caramels and sweetened condensed milk in microwave. On stove melt 1/2 cup butter and marshmallows. Add cereal.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix and pour into greased pan.

title: Dutch Fritters
instructions: Dissolve sugar and salt in scalded milk. Use a large 1 1/2 gallon bowl. Add margarine. In a separate bowl mix yeast and warm water. Add yeast mixture and eggs to milk. Mix with a wire mixer. Add flour until dough is still soft enough to spoon into hot oil but not too runny. Let raise until doubled in size. Spoon into hot oil about 370\u00b0. Ladle out of hot oil when evenly browned onto old paper bags or paper towels. Roll in granulated or powdered sugar.

title: Busy Lady Pie
instructions: In 9 x 14-inch pan add peaches with juice. Add dry cake mix. Top with butter; cut into pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix together. Store unused in fridge.

title: Company Fish Casserole Or Let'S Make The Family Feel Special
instructions: Thaw fish if frozen. Separate fillets; cut and piece together to make eight 6 x 2 1/2-inch strips. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid. Add enough milk to reserved mushroom liquid to make 1 1/2 cups total liquid; set aside.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown hamburger in a large skillet. Add 2 cans of tomato sauce and season with oregano to taste. Cook noodles according to directions; then drain.

title: Praline Squares
instructions: Arrange crackers 1 layer deep on ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Place butter and brown sugar in saucepan. Bring to a boil and stir constantly for 2 minutes. Stir in nuts and mix well. Spoon mixture over crackers. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Remove and let stand 2 minutes. Cut into squares while still warm.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Chill jello until firm around edges then beat until fluffy with salad dressing horseradish and mustard. Fold rest of ingredients in order given. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Mexican Chip Dip
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Sprinkle taco mix on meat. Add 2 cans of beans. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes on low heat. While hot alternate with layers of meat cheese and sour cream; repeat with cheese on the top layer last. Bake at 300\u00b0 until hot throughout.

title: Clipper Chowder
instructions: Drain tuna and break into large pieces. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Cook onion and celery in butter until tender. Blend in flour add milk and bouillon gradually to onion and celery mixture and cook until thick stirring constantly. Add cheese and tuna; heat until cheese melts stirring constantly.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine egg and ketchup; stir in cheese bread crumbs onion green pepper salt thyme and pepper. Add ground beef or pork; mix well. Pour into baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour or until done.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Combine sugar flour and 3 tablespoons pineapple juice. Heat on low heat until sugar melts. Stir in pineapple chunks and Cheddar cheese. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs. Drizzle margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except coconut and refrigerate overnight. Add coconut before serving. (Quick and easy.)

title: Under The Sea Salad(Old Recipe)
instructions: Dissolve 1 package orange jello in 1 cup hot water; mix in 1/2 pound marshmallows cut up or use small ones. Use 1 cup whipped cream 3/4 cup mayonnaise 1 small package Philadelphia cream cheese (be sure and have cream cheese soft) and 1 can drained crushed pineapple. Let this jell until firm. Place in refrigerator. Dissolve 1 package lime jello as directed then just before it jells pour over other mixture. Refrigerate and jell.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Slice cucumbers and sprinkle with salt. Let stand 30 minutes and drain. Combine sour cream vinegar tabasco sauce chives dill seed and pepper. Pour over cucumbers and chill.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together (except sugar). Let yeast mixture stand in warm place until yeast is lively and bubbles up. Add Crisco to dry ingredients then butter and yeast mixture. Roll out and cut rolls into desired shape and size. Place on greased baking sheet; cover with damp towel or waxed paper for 30 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: You will need pint jars and seals.

title: Hershey'S Chocolate Syrup
instructions: Mix cocoa and sugar in microwave-safe dish; add hot water and mix well. Cook in microwave for 4 to 5 minutes on High stirring after 2 1/2 minutes. Add vanilla and stir. Let cool and pour into container and store in refrigerator. You may also cook on stove top. Bring mixture to boil stirring constantly. Boil 3 minutes remove from heat. Add vanilla and let cool. Pour into container. Makes 2 cups. You may double this recipe.

title: Sweet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix flour with sugar salt cream of tartar soda and cinnamon. Cream butter to soften. Add flour mixture milk and vanilla. Mix until all flour is moistened then beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer. Add eggs and chocolate. Beat 1 minute longer. Pour batter into a 10-inch tube pan already greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 1 hour and 20 minutes or until tester comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan and finish cooling on rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and top with glaze and coconut.

title: Ripe Olive Resotti
instructions: Melt oleo; add onion and celery and saute gently several minutes. Add rice and stir until well coated with oleo and deep golden color (but not brown). Add consomme water salt and pepper. Turn into 2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Fold in sliced ripe olives and cheese and return to oven for 5 minutes. Serves 8. Delicious served with steak.

title: Rainbow Jello Mold
instructions: Mix each jello separately using 3/4 cup hot water and 3/4 cup cold water for each. Set aside.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Put 1 cup pecans in each unbaked pie shell. Mix the other ingredients and pour over pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done. Makes two pies.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until very crispy. Remove bacon from pan. Saute onion in bacon grease until done. Drain pork and beans then add them to bacon grease and onion. Add mustard and crumbled bacon to beans and heat.

title: Moist-Ever Carrot Bars
instructions: Combine in order given.

title: Double Chocolate Brownies
instructions: In a large bowl combine cocoa and baking soda; blend in 1/3 cup melted margarine. Add boiling water and stir until well blended. Stir in sugar eggs and remaining margarine. Add flour vanilla and salt. Stir by hand until well blended. Fold in pecans and chocolate chunks. Pour into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from side. Do not overbake. Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Six Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in order listed; do not toss. Marinate in bowl overnight.

title: Chuck Wagon Beans
instructions: Brown chopped onions celery and garlic in a skillet. Then mix all ingredients together adding the bacon last. Place in a baking dish and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Makes large servings.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Grease a Bundt baking pan. Mix sugars and cinnamon in a bowl. Quarter biscuits and roll in sugar mixture. Layer into greased pan. After all pieces are coated and in pan bring butter and remaining mixture to a boil until sugar is dissolved. Pour over biscuits and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until done. Turn out on plate and store covered. To serve pull off in pieces to eat.

title: Rigatoni Casserole
instructions: Brown first 6 ingredients all in skillet; drain well. Cook rigatoni pasta; drain. Mix ground beef rigatoni and large jar of Ragu spaghetti sauce.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Sift together sugar and flour. Add marshmallows. Set aside. Bring to a boil cocoa oleo shortening and cola. Pour over dry ingredients. Add the buttermilk soda and eggs. Mix by hand. Do not beat with a mixer. Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. If chocolate cakes are baked too long they may become too dry so bake just until done. Frost with Coca-Cola Icing.

title: Strawberry-Orange Marmalade
instructions: Prepare fruit. Stem and mash one layer at a time. Measure 1 1/4 cups into large bowl. Finely grind about 1/2 pound unpeeled rhubarb. Add to it 1/2 cup strawberries. Mix sugar into fruit. Stir well. Let stand 10 minutes. Add lemon juice to fruit pectin in a small bowl. Mix well. Add to fruit. Stir 3 minutes. Ladle quickly into scalded containers. Cover at once with tight lids. Let stand at room temperature 24 hours. Store in freezer. Small amount may be covered and stored in refrigerator up to 3 weeks. Makes about 5 to 8 containers.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix sugar pumpkin spices salt and milk. Add egg last. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 15 minutes at 425 degrees. Reduce heat and bake another 50 minutes.

title: Microwave Brownies
instructions: Mix and cook all ingredients in microwave in safe dish for 16 to 18 minutes turning dish every 4 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender. Blend 30 seconds to mix. Scrape down sides and blend for 1 minute more. Let cool until thickened. Is equivalent to a can of Eagle Brand. Will keep a long time refrigerated. Substitutes just fine in any recipe I have made.

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Add 1 cup water to zucchini in saucepan; bring to boil. Cook 6 minutes. Add sugar lemon juice and pineapple. Cook 6 more minutes. Add apricot gelatin and cook 6 more minutes. Pour into freezer containers with tight lids. Let set up at room temperature for 24 hours. Store for several weeks in refrigerator or freeze several months.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Quarter biscuits. Put sugar and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon in paper bag. Add biscuits and shake until covered. Put biscuits over nuts in the pan. Bring to a boil the oleo brown sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon. Pour over biscuits. Bake until done approximately 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Turn out immediately on plate.

title: Hamburger Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: *Can use 2 cans cream soup of your choice.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Crush crackers and melted butter together. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Prepare Dream Whip as directed on package. Add to cream cheese mix. Pour on top of graham crackers. Put blueberry pie filling on top of cream cheese mixture.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef (drain fat). Add onion and green pepper; cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Stir and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Combine crumbs cheese salt and pepper. Dip chicken in melted oleo then in the crumb mixture being careful to coat the chicken evenly. Treat any bare spots with a gentle patting of crumbs. Place chicken skin side up in a buttered baking dish. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in casserole; mix well. Top with chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Pinch biscuits into bite size pieces. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon; roll biscuit pieces in mixture. Grease Bundt pan. Put pecan chips in bottom. Roll biscuit pieces in sugar mixture and put in pan. Melt oleo and mix with remaining sugar and cinnamon mixture. Spoon over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes and invert on cake plate.

title: Berry-Rice Pudding
instructions: In medium saucepan combine water evaporated skim milk and rice. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat; cook covered over low heat for 20 minutes stirring often. Uncover; cook 5 minutes more. In a small bowl combine egg yolk 2 tablespoons sugar lemon juice and salt. Stir about 1 cup of the hot mixture into yolk mixture; return all to saucepan. Bring to a gentle boil. Cook and stir over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until slightly thickened. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and lemon peel. Cool mixture thoroughly.

title: Honey Chicken
instructions: Combine bread crumbs orange rind salt and pepper. Dip chicken in orange juice. Roll in crumb mixture. Place in greased shallow pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Sift flour along with dry ingredients. Add shortening and cut in with a knife or pastry cutter. Add yeast to buttermilk and mix thoroughly.

title: Cathedral Windows
instructions: Melt oleo over very low heat. Add chocolate chips to melt them. Add beaten egg. Cool and add the marshmallows. Shape into a log. Cover with the pecans. Wrap in waxed paper. When cold slice.

title: Dried Beef Spread(This Is An Appetizer)
instructions: Blend cream cheese and milk. Add dried beef green pepper onion flakes garlic powder and black pepper. Stir to mix well. Fold in the sour cream. Add nuts. Spoon into small baking dish and pour 2 tablespoons melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with Triscuits (or other crackers). Each person spreads cheese mixture on cracker as desired.

title: Skillet Cobbler
instructions: Layer oleo then batter then fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni Dessert
instructions: Drain juices. Combine juice with flour sugar and beaten eggs. Cook until smooth and thick. Cool. Combine everything folding in Cool Whip last. Chill. Very good.

title: Delicious Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour nutmeg cinnamon and salt.\tStir in apples. Put in pastry. Dot with butter. Cover with pastry. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Holiday Joy
instructions: Use large wishing bowl and mix above ingredients together until lumps disappear. Bake in ample pan of joy until nicely brown. Cool with comforting words. To seal the generation gap use warm understanding! Serve a \peace\ everyday to give your life contentment. No refrigeration needed. Serve to everyone.

title: Cottage Cheese Dessert
instructions: Mix cottage cheese Cool Whip and Jell-O with mixer. Stir in pineapple. Chill and serve.

title: Veggie Bars
instructions: Spread crescent rolls in ungreased cookie sheet with 1-inch sides. Bake 5 to 6 minutes until lightly browned. Cool 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Fill rest with milk. Freeze as usual.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips and cheese. Mix well. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli in water with bouillon cubes until tender. Blend cream milk flour and cheese in blender. Mix slowly with broccoli mixture in pan. Return to blender and whip for 1 minute. Return to pan and cook for 20 minutes (simmer low).

title: Lemon Fruit Freeze
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs melted margarine and sugar into 9 x 13-inch pan or Tupperware. Reserve a little of the crumbs to sprinkle on top. Mix pie filling Eagle Brand fruit cocktail and lemon juice and pour over graham cracker crust. Spread Cool Whip over pudding mixture. Sprinkle remaining graham crackers over Cool Whip. Freeze. Remove 30 to 40 minutes before eating.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine above and chill for a quick tasty punch.

title: Diet Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Make into balls (1 teaspoon size). Place on greased cookie sheet and press flat with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crumbs and pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Top with crumbs and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: In a small mixing bowl combine cream cheese butter and vanilla. Beat at low speed on electric mixer until light. Gradually add sugar beating until fluffy. If necessary add milk to make of spreading consistency. Stir in chopped pecans. Frost one 8 or 9-inch square cake.

title: Three Pepper Chicken
instructions: In shallow bowl combine crackers and Italian seasoning. Dip each chicken breast in egg then coat with cracker mixture. Set aside.

title: Cinnamon Breakfast Rolls
instructions: Cut bread dough into 32 pieces; make balls. Mix pudding (powder form) brown sugar and cinnamon. Dip bread dough balls into butter then into powder mixture. Place into tube pan arranging into layers around pan; let rise 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn out onto serving plate.

title: Oven-Fried Apple Rings
instructions: Slice apples into rings. Place half the amount in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dot with 1/4 cup of the butter. Combine the sugars and spices. Sprinkle half the amount over the apples. Repeat the process for the second layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows over low heat. Mix other ingredients then add melted mixture. Stir well to make sure everything is coated. Pack in 8-inch buttered pan. Cool in refrigerator. Cut in squares.

title: Cola Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in juice from pineapple and cherries. Bring to a boil. Stir in other ingredients. Let congeal.

title: Extra Crispy Fried Chicken
instructions: Salt and lemon pepper chicken. Pour the buttermilk over chicken. Refrigerate 1 hour. Pour off excess buttermilk and dip into flour until chicken is covered. Deep fry until golden brown. Fry on medium heat so it wont burn before getting well done.

title: Whole Wheat Biscuits
instructions: Sift white flour into mixing bowl. Add whole wheat flour and other dry ingredients. Mix and form a well in the center. Pour the milk and oil into well. Stir until dough is formed.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff adding 1/4 cup sugar to keep them stiff. Cream the shortening and add salt vanilla and remaining sugar gradually. Combine with unbeaten yolks beating until light and creamy. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Fold in beaten egg whites. Add the lightly floured blueberries. Bake in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add salt soda and eggs. Mix together. Stir in flour potato chips vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoonful onto baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix squash sour cream and 1/2 of cheese and crackers. Top with other cheese and crackers and butter. Pour into greased casserole dish and bake for 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Blueberry Muffins(From A Maine Bed And Breakfast)
instructions: Mix dry and wet ingredients separately. Combine and add 1 cup well-drained blueberries. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Combine chocolate wafer crumbs nutmeg and butter mixing well. Press mixture into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan; allow to chill. Beat cream cheese with electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar and mix well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in sour cream melted chocolate cocoa and vanilla. Mix well. Gently fold in whipped cream; spoon into prepared pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Saute ground beef onions celery until done drain off excess fat and pour into 2 quart casserole dish. Pour chicken soup over this do not stir. Then mushroom soup over this and sprinkle with the noodles on top. Bake 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Tenderloin Stuffed With Lobster(Assemble The Roast Tenderloin Up To A Day Ahead.)
instructions: Trim off tips of tenderloin to make 11-inch long cylinders. Sear the tenderloins on all sides in a large skillet one at a time. Butterfly each tenderloin lengthwise by cutting the lower third of the meat of within 1 inch of the opposite side. Lay the tenderloin open; butterfly remaining thick portion starting from the last cut in the center. Pat meat firmly to make a 9 x 11-inch rectangle about 1/2 inch thick. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange half the lobster pieces in rows lengthwise across the tenderloin. Roll the tenderloin firmly keeping the lobster pieces centered inside the roll. Tie the meat roll with string at 2 inch intervals. Repeat with second tenderloin and remaining lobster. Refrigerate until 1 hour before serving time. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 135\u00b0 to 140\u00b0. Remove strings. Slice and serve with Bearnaise Sauce. Serves 20.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and water and boil until clear. Remove. Add jello and stir. Place strawberries in pie shell and pour hot mixture over pie. Refrigerate.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Combine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Return to oven to brown.

title: New Mexico Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Add sugar to beaten eggs. Add oil. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with hot water. Add pumpkin and nuts last. Add 1 cup raisins if desired. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Minnie'S Apple Crumb Cake
instructions: Combine flour 1 cup sugar and baking soda. Add to melted margarine. Use slightly more than half the mixture to line an ungreased 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Combine apples 4 tablespoons sugar lemon juice and cinnamon. Pour into baking dish. Arrange remaining crumb mixture on top and pat down gently. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Roast With Cola
instructions: Place roast in heavy-duty aluminum foil lined baking dish. Sprinkle with soup mix. Pour cola over this and seal tightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 until tender. Allow 30 to 45 minutes per pound roasting time.

title: Payday Bars
instructions: Mix 1/3 cup melted margarine and egg well press in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. While hot cover with miniature marshmallows. Add Rice Krispies and peanuts to 1/4 cup melted margarine vanilla peanut butter chips syrup and peanut butter. Pour over marshmallows.

title: Orange Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice sweet potatoes in 1/4-inch slices and arrange in a buttered baking dish. Make syrup by combining sugar orange juice salt orange rind and water. Pour over the potatoes. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until tender. Baste occasionally. Uncover the last 10 minutes and allow to brown. Layer with miniature marshmallows and brown just before removing from oven. Serves 6.

title: Rice And Vegetable Bake
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Peel and chop onion. Rinse the red pepper. Remove seeds to dice. Coarsely chop celery and parsley. Chop nuts. Combine cooked rice with vegetables and nuts. In saucepan melt butter. In a bowl beat eggs and milk. Season with salt and pepper. Add melted butter. Stir to combine. Pour egg mixture over rice mixture. Blend well. Place mixture in a lightly greased baking pan or a tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Blend dry ingredients with shortening. Add egg and liquid mixture. Form into roll; wrap in waxed paper or covered container. Store in refrigerator. Take off as much as needed. Warm to room temperature; roll on heavily floured board. Makes 4 or 5 pie crusts.

title: Miracle Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: In blender container combine milk eggs sugar flour margarine vanilla and salt. Cover and blend about 10 seconds or until mixed. Do not overblend. Stir in coconut.

title: Poor Man'S Cakes(Fattigmann)
instructions: Beat egg and egg yolks slightly. Add other ingredients. Use enough flour to make a soft dough. Mix handling as little and lightly as possible. Roll out on floured cloth. Cut in 2 x 2-inch diamond shapes. Make a slit in center and pull one end through. Fry in hot lard until lightly browned. Drain on brown paper. Dust with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Blend zucchini until you have 1 cup. Add everything else into blender. Blend well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then sprinkle nutmeg or cinnamon on top. Decrease heat to 350\u00b0. Bake until nice and brown and a toothpick comes out clean (about 25 minutes).

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: In large roaster spread cereal in layers. Spread all nuts on top.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brush bottom and sides of crust evenly with egg yolk; bake on baking sheet until light brown about 5 minutes. Remove crust from oven. Combine sliced apples lemon juice 1/2 cup sugar 1/4 cup brown sugar 3 tablespoons flour salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Mix well and spoon into crust. Mix remaining flour sugar brown sugar and butter with fork until crumbly. Sprinkle topping mixture evenly over apples. Bake on baking sheet until topping is golden and filling is bubbling about 50 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Serve at room temperature. Serves 8.

title: Hen And Dressing
instructions: In a large pot place hen; cover with water. Add salt pepper and whole onion. Cook until tender. When done reserve liquid for broth to be used in dressing. Break toast into small pieces; crumble cornbread. Put celery and onions in saucepan. Cover with water and cook until tender. In large roasting pan add toast and cornbread; pour in celery and onion mixture. Stir in eggs sage salt pepper and reserved hen broth. Add more broth if needed for desired consistency. Mix thoroughly. Leave in roasting pan. Place hen on top of dressing. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour or until brown. Serve with gravy of your choice.

title: Luau Meatballs
instructions: *Substitute Worcestershire sauce and serve with spaghetti.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. For a gallon multiply by 4.

title: Peach Custard Cake
instructions: Place flour salt and butter in a 1 1/2-quart bowl. Mix well with fingers until evenly blended. With back of spoon press mixture on bottom and halfway up sides of buttered 8-inch square pan. Arrange the sliced peaches (well drained) on crust in pan. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over the peaches. Bake for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Mix reserved syrup from peaches with 1 egg (slightly beaten) and evaporated milk. Pour over peaches. Bake for 30 minutes or until custard is firm except in center. Center becomes firm on standing. May be served warm with ice cream. Serves 9.

title: Sara'S Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in blueberries. Add milk egg and butter. Mix until dry ingredients are moistened. (The batter will be lumpy.) Spoon batter into twelve (2 1/2-inch) greased muffin cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Creamed Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon drain crumble and set aside. Melt butter in large skillet; add celery and onion and saute until tender. Combine flour sugar salt pepper paprika mustard and milk; stir into celery mixture. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in vinegar. Add potatoes and green pepper; stir carefully to coat with dressing. Heat thoroughly. Just before serving stir in sour cream and sprinkle with bacon. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Beat eggs well and add sugar. Melt margarine and chocolate; add to eggs and sugar then beat well. Add flour nuts and vanilla. Bake on shallow pan for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ginger Creams
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add beaten eggs and molasses. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with warm water. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes in slightly greased jelly roll pan. Frost with powdered sugar frosting. Cut while warm. For thicker bars use 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients. Put in dish. Sprinkle chips over top and pour melted margarine or butter over chips. Bake at about 375\u00b0 until it is hot about 25 to 30 minutes. For a richer taste cook rice in chicken broth.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Mix together on low heat until all cheese is melted. Add potatoes and cover. Stir frequently to separate potatoes (will burn easily). Cook until potatoes are tender. Put into buttered casserole. Dot with butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Put into 400\u00b0 oven until golden and bubbling. Cover until ready to serve.

title: Party Spread
instructions: Mix ingredients with fork. Spread on crackers. Garnish with green or black olives (optional).

title: Hot Mushroom Turnovers
instructions: In large bowl with mixer at medium speed beat cream cheese 1 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 cup butter until smooth. Shape into ball; wrap and refrigerate 1 hour. Meanwhile in 10-inch skillet over medium heat in 3 tablespoons hot butter cook mushrooms and onion until tender stirring occasionally. Stir in sour cream salt thyme and 2 tablespoons flour; set aside. On floured surface with floured rolling pin roll half of dough 1/8 inch thick. With floured 2 3/4 inch round cookie cutter cut out as many circles as possible. Repeat. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Onto one half of each dough circle place a teaspoon of mushroom mixture. Brush edges of circles with some egg; fold dough over filling. With fork firmly press edges together to seal; prick tops. Place turnovers on ungreased cookie sheet; brush with remaining egg. Bake 12 to 14 minutes until golden. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening and sugar until creamy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Mix flour baking powder soda and salt and blend into egg/sugar mixture. Mix in oats and chill. Shape stiff dough into balls or drop from a teaspoon about 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 in conventional oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Store covered.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let stand to improve flavor.

title: Coconut Bonbons
instructions: Mix coconut corn syrup and vanilla; let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Roll into small balls. Dip into melted chocolate and let harden on wax paper.

title: Toll House Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. Blend butter brown sugar vanilla water and egg. Add flour mixture. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Beat together margarine sugar eggs buttermilk and soda. Slowly add flour until smooth. Then fold in dates coconuts chopped pecans and chopped orange slices. Bake 250 degrees in tube pan for 1 hour or until done. Pour over when done.

title: Baked Brie 2
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Slice horizontally and carefully lift lid. Insert the fresh herbs and 1/2 of almonds. Replace the lid and place in the center of ovenproof dish. Smooth butter around the outside of the brie and sprinkle top with remaining almonds. Bake 12-15 minutes or until cheese just begins to melt. Serve with crackers and fresh fruit. Serves 4-6.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash until tender; drain slice and set aside. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs; add squash and remaining ingredients reserving some cheese for the top. Place in a casserole dish and cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Busy Day Vegetable Stew And Rice
instructions: Bring water ham onion and garlic to boil in large saucepot. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 2 hours or until ham is tender. Remove ham; cool slightly. Cut ham from bones and return to pot; discard bones. Add corn tomatoes okra basil sugar salt and pepper. Return to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes or until okra is tender stirring occasionally. Serve with corn bread or French bread. Makes 4 servings.

title: Lime Avocado Salad
instructions: Boil water pineapple and sugar. Pour over jello. Set. Crush avocado. Mix with whipped cream. Add to jello. Mix well. Mold.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: In large skillet brown ground beef; drain. Add onions pepper pepperoni and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes. Add cooked macaroni and sauce; heat thoroughly. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Grease pie tin. In bottom layer bacon. Then layer cheese and onion. Beat remaining ingredients together well. Pour over first two layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Quiche(Individual)
instructions: You also need a 24 cup pan. With pastry cutter cut in butter. Add water. Mix until dough forms. Use 2 1/2-inch cutter to form small cup crusts.

title: Ham Barbecues
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chipped ham. Simmer the sauce for 1/2 hour. Add the chipped ham and heat the ham thoroughly.

title: The Best Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and beat well. Add shortening butter and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed butter-sugar mixture. Chill several hours. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Press with bottom of glass to flatten. Dip bottom of glass in flour-sugar mixture to avoid sticking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Let first 3 ingredients set 15 minutes. Knead flour into other ingredients. Let stand in warm place for 2 hours. Knead down and make into rolls. Let stand in warm place for 2 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Peanut Butter-Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and baking powder. Add milk applesauce and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in peanut butter. Pour batter into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Mix sugar cocoa and water. Pour over batter. Do not mix! Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Break noodles and mix with cabbage and onions. Mix flavor package with oil vinegar sugar and salt. Pour over cabbage and add sesame seed and almonds. Set at least 1 hour.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Cover cucumbers in salt water overnight (1/3 cup salt to each quart water). Drain and dry.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook all ingredients except cheese for 1 hour until carrots are tender. Remove from heat. Add cheese; stir until dissolved.

title: Wanda Andrews' Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Bake in 9-inch greased pan for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Brisket Marinade
instructions: The night before you cook your brisket place brisket in pan large enough for the marinade to cover half the brisket. Mix all ingredients together and pour enough to cover 1/4 of brisket.

title: Hot Clam Dip
instructions: Melt butter. Add clams and seasonings. Mix well. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika. Microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Spinach-Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute green onions in the heated butter until soft but not browned. Add the flour salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Add the vegetables and chicken broth. Cover and simmer 5 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are cooked and mixture is heated through. Add half and half. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes longer. Serve piping hot with favorite bread. Serves 4. Garnish soup with grated Cheddar cheese.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix zucchini sugar water lemon juice and cinnamon. Cook for 20 minutes or until tender then add to mixture. Mix flour and water for thickening; pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Divan Pie
instructions: Dip meat in flour. Brown quickly and remove to warm platter. Stir bouillon water and wine into skillet. Add juice of 1 lemon and grated lemon peel. Return turkey to pan and simmer 20 to 30 minutes until tender. Garnish platter with lemon slices and parsley.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Mix everything together except 1/2 cup cheese.\tPut remaining cheese on top and cook in crock-pot on low 4 hours. Do Not Stir!

title: Happy Dessert Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix crushed crackers with butter and sugar or sweetener.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Combine ice cream and Cool Whip. Spread over Oreo cookies in 9 x 13-inch pan. Freeze.

title: Rye Snacks
instructions: Mix and spread on party rye. Put under broiler until brown. Serve warm.

title: Crabmeat Bacon Rolls
instructions: Mix tomato paste with egg. Add salt crumbs parsley celery salt and crabmeat. Mix thoroughly and chill. Roll into finger lengths wrap each roll and 1/2 strip of bacon and fasten with toothpicks. Chill well.

title: Chicken Breast Casserole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in bottom of casserole dish; cover with soup mixture and then Swiss cheese. Cover cheese with remaining soup mixture. Top with stuffing and pour butter over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour (until bubbly).

title: Pacific Lime Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add juice from pineapple. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until frothy. Fold into remaining ingredients. Chill until set.

title: Million Dollar Cake
instructions: Mix yellow Jiffy cake mix as directed on box. In a 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan bake 12 minutes. Cool.

title: Maple Easter Egg Filling
instructions: Cream together; knead real good. You can also substitute 1 tsp vanilla for the maple and add coconut. Dip in melted chocolate and place on wax paper to set. Makes a large batch.

title: Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine cocoa and sugar. Stir in milk and bring to a boil. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Yields 2 cups.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on until cooked through. Cool then peel and cut in chunks. Hard-boil egg cool and cut up. Mix mayonnaise mustard salt pepper celery and a little milk; add to potatoes and egg. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Vegetable Chowder
instructions: Wash all vegetables and cut into large chunks. Put in pan and add just enough water to cover. If using canned peas do not add until after butter is added. Boil until vegetables are tender. Add butter a chunk at a time so it melts easier. Stir. Add the can of evaporated milk. For a richer chowder add one large and one small can evaporated milk. Reheat. Add cheddar cheese and pepper when served. A mix of cheddar and mozzarella cheese is also good.

title: Recipe For A Happy Day
instructions: Measure words carefully. Add cups of understanding. Use generous amounts of time and patience. Keep temperatures low. Do not boil. Add a dash of humor and warm personality. Season to taste with spice of life.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Mix in large bowl the all-bran sifted flour and salt. Mix in blender the sour milk (add baking soda to milk) sugar Karo syrup and egg. Bake in 2 greased and dusted bread pans at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cover with foil last 10 minutes to prevent overbrowning. Test for doneness with toothpick (with glass pan reduce oven heat by 25\u00b0). To sour milk add 1 tablespoon vinegar or lemon juice to regular milk.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Heat water salt and vinegar to rolling boil. Remove from heat and let cool. Place dill in jars. Pack jars with cucumbers. When liquid is cool pour over cucumbers. Be sure to cover cucumbers completely. Let set 90 days.

title: Sweet Fried Cantaloupe
instructions: Cut melon into thin slices; remove seeds and skin. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and liqueur. Let stand for at least 1 hour. Mix together flour wine 1/2 teaspoon oil and a little salt. Blend in stiff egg white. Dip melon slices into batter and fry in hot olive oil only until light gold in color. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Serve.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Buffalo Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dredge chicken in salad dressing mix. Dip in mixture of margarine pepper sauce and vinegar. Arrange on baking pan (sprayed with Pam) and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Turn sprinkle with paprika and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown. Try dipping in Blue cheese dressing.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Melt Velveeta in cooked sausage. Add chili and heat thoroughly. Serve with chips or crackers while hot.

title: Cajun Style London Broil(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Sprinkle meat tenderizer on both sides of meat. Let stand for 45 minutes. Sprinkle both sides of meat with spices. Cook on red hot grill 5 minutes on both sides. Put honey on top after cooked. Serve after honey melts. Slice thin. Bearnaise sauce acceptable.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sunday Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken and oil. Place about 1 cup flour mixture in a paper or plastic bag. Shake a few chicken pieces in the bag at a time coating well. On medium-high heat 1/4 inch of oil in a large skillet. Brown chicken on all sides; remove to a large shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until done. Recipe makes enough coating for three chickens. Store unused mixture in airtight container. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix flour chopped pecans and margarine together in a small bowl (save a few pecans for top). Press in a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake 20 minutes in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Mix the cream cheese (beat before adding powdered sugar) and powdered sugar. Add 8 ounces Cool Whip (save remaining for top). Beat the mixture and put on top of cooled crust. Mix milk with chocolate pudding. Make a layer of this on top of cream cheese mixture. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Top with remaining Cool Whip and pecans.

title: Dip For Raw Vegetables
instructions: Use on broccoli cauliflower mushrooms celery radishes carrots and green onions.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Blend together and add a small can finely chopped shrimp.

title: Five Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans mix in all ingredients. Stir well and chill for 2 to 4 hours before serving. Serves 12.

title: No-Bake Strawberry Bottom Cheese Cake
instructions: Place berries on paper towels to drain. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping blending well. Spread thin layer of glaze over bottom of crust. Place berries on glaze and cover with another thin layer of glaze. Gently spoon mixture over glazed berries over crust. Cover with inverted dome and chill to set at least 4 hours.

title: Betsy'S Potato Soup
instructions: Bring water to boil; put potatoes in and chicken seasoning pepper and salt. Cook until 1/2 tender. Add soup simmer for 10 minutes. While simmering melt margarine; add flour to butter to make paste. Add to potatoes. Add milk; heat to serving temperature. Do not boil.

title: Oreo Icebox Dessert
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan crumble cookies. In mixing bowl blend the cream cheese powdered sugar and half of milk. Add peanut butter and other half milk; beat until smooth. Add container of Cool Whip. Pour over cookies and freeze. Serves 15. Can be made ahead of time.

title: Peanut Crisps
instructions: Blend peanut butter Crisco sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix together with flour and baking soda. Roll into small balls and roll into granulated sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Remove. Top with Hersheys Kiss in center. Bake for 5 minutes more. Yield 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Saut onion in butter until tender. Remove from heat and stir in butter celery salt red pepper and worcestershire sauce. Combine cracker crumbs and parsley flakes. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drain oysters reserving 1/3 c. liquor. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cracker crumbs in bottom of a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish; layer half of oysters and half of remaining cracker crumb mixture. Drizzle with half of butter mixture. Repeat layers. Combine eggs half and half and reserved oyster liquor; mix well. Pour over oyster layers. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until set.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in warm water. Combine flour soda baking powder salt and sugar. Cut in shortening until size of peas. Add buttermilk and then yeast mixture. Stir until all flour is dampened. Knead on floured board. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. (This dough can be stored in a tightly covered container in refrigerator for 2 weeks.)

title: Chuck Roast
instructions: Place roast in a glass baking dish. Mix ingredients and pour over chuck roast. Cook for 5 hours covered at 325\u00b0. When done break meat apart with fork. Serve on fresh hard rolls.

title: Eggplant-Zucchini Parmigiana
instructions: In medium saucepan combine broth celery onion and garlic. Bring to boil and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir in tomatoes paste herbs and pepper. Return to boil and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Meanwhile cut eggplant into 1/2-inch slices and halve slices. Bring 1/2-inch water to boil in Dutch oven. Add eggplant and zucchini slices; simmer covered for 4 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add remaining ingredients except sour cream. Divide mixture in half. Let 1/2 remain at room temperature. Chill other half in pan or other container until set. Spread sour cream over congealed mixture. Spoon the remaining mixture over sour cream. Congeal.

title: Noah'S Ark Clam Chowder
instructions: Combine in 3 quart saucepan. Heat over low heat. Serve with oyster crackers.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Boil all ingredients except corn and soda for 5 minutes mixing well and stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and add soda. Stir quickly. Pour over popped corn.

title: Sassy Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach as directed on package. Drain well (very important). Add remaining ingredients. Put in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cook vinegar egg and sugar until custard-like. Keep stirring. Let cool. Add cream cheese to egg mixture and blend well. Add shrimp. Mix well. Garnish with whole shrimp and parsley. Refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Lehto'S Upper Peninsula Pasties
instructions: Cut lard and suet into flour to a coarse crumb. Add water mixing with a fork. Refrigerate until ready to roll.

title: Pineapple-Lemonade Punch
instructions: In a large pitcher combine pineapple juice lemonade and water. Chill for 2 hours or more. Add club soda and if desired strawberries. For an alcohol drink Increase water to 6 cups and add 1 1/2 cups of Rum or Tequila and omit the club soda.

title: Vinegar Cake
instructions: Follow directions for cake mix and bake. In a pot mix vinegar and sugar. Cook on medium heat until it begins to thicken. Polk holes in finished cake and pour vinegar mixture over top of cake. Let cool and serve.

title: Marinade Sauce(For Pork Chops)
instructions: In a sauce pan combine ingredients (not soda). Bring to boil. Remove from heat. Let cool. Add soda. Pour over pork chops. Marinate for 2 - 3 days.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine eggs sugar oil and milk. Stir in flour and cinnamon until just combined. Fold in apples pecans and coconut. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in water and boil for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from water and arrange in 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Cook chicken debone and cut in little pieces. Place chicken over broccoli. Spoon chicken soup over chicken and pour on broth. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Jinny'S Easy Apple Cake
instructions: In medium large bowl add apples beaten egg and oil and mix. Add sugar salt cinnamon and soda. Mix well and add flour. Mix well. Add nuts and raisins. Bake in prepared 8 x 8-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Delicious with whipped topping or vanilla ice cream. Best of all easy! Men love it.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese together and set aside. Mix pretzels and margarine. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Spread cheese mixture over pretzels. Spread whipped topping over cheese and chill. Dissolve gelatin in boiling hot pineapple juice. Add strawberries being sure the liquid on berries does amount to more than 2 cups. Allow mixture to start to gel before pouring over the whipped topping.

title: Western Walnut Ice Cream Topping
instructions: Mix together and store in the refrigerator for a few days. You may want to set the jar in a pan of hot water before serving. It is not necessary to add any calories to this recipe.

title: Apple Cobbler Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease muffin tin. Combine the quick bread mix (both bags) apple juice eggs and yogurt in a large bowl. Beat just until mixed. Stir in walnuts and raisins. Spoon into muffin cups filling each 2/3 full. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of a muffin. Remove from pan immediately and place on rack to cool slightly.

title: Potluck Potato Casserole
instructions: Use a 3-quart dish. Defrost hash browns. Combine 1/2 cup of butter with hash browns. Mix rest of ingredients together and mix into hash browns. Butter a 3-quart casserole and put hash brown mixture in dish. Mix corn flakes with 1/4 cup melted butter. Pour over top of mixture. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Peanut Butter Tandy Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with electric mixer until thick and lemony. Gradually add sugar. While beating add milk and vanilla. Blend dry ingredients into egg mixture. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 15-inch jelly roll pan or a large cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Spread 1 cup of peanut butter over hot cake. Cool thoroughly before covering with melted chocolate chips. Refrigerate until hard.

title: Aloha Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Do not stir. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cajun Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients into large mixing bowl. Stir in eggs and pineapple and blend well. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 10 x 2 inch pan and bake for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Sour-Cream Raisin Bars
instructions: In medium saucepan cook raisins in 1 1/2 cups water for 10 minutes. Drain; set aside. In medium bowl with electric mixer at\thigh speed beat butter with brown sugar until light and fluffy. At low speed add oats flour soda; mix until blended. Press half of mixture into 13 x 9-inch baking pan; set aside.\tPreheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tIn another medium saucepan combine egg yolks sour cream granulated sugar and cornstarch. Over medium heat\tcook stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Stir in\traisins and vanilla; pour over oat mixture in pan. Sprinkle with remaining oat mixture; bake 30 minutes. When cool cut into small bars.\tYield about 2 dozen bars.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix potatoes sugar and oleo until well mixed. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Makes 2 pies.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple and sugar. Heat to a boil. Add jello stir well and let cool. Add buttermilk. Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Pour in pan and congeal.

title: Pickled Cucumbers
instructions: Mix cucumbers onions and salt. Let stand 2 hours. Drain and rinse well. Mix vinegar and sugar with cucumbers. Put into containers and freeze. Makes about 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with a spoon. Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 or 60 minutes. May take a little longer watch carefully.

title: Easy Barbecue
instructions: Brown hamburg and onion. Drain grease. Add other ingredients and simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Stir together sugar salt and cornstarch in saucepan. Add water. Stir until smooth. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil until it thickens. Add vanilla butter and food coloring. Cool by stirring. Drain strawberries and add to sauce. Pour into pie shell and top with whipped topping.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cheesecake(This Is Really Good!)
instructions: This is a very good cake. The coconut topping can be doubled for a more flavorful cake. Then some of this topping can be put between layers with the frosting as well as on the top and sides.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put pecans on top. Bake in Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat and bake 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Apple Crumble
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square 8 x 8-inch baking dish or rectangle 10 x 6-inch. Arrange apples in dish. Mix Bisquick sugar and egg until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Drizzle margarine over the top. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake until topping is golden brown and apples are tender about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries and sugar. Refrigerate overnight. Drain thoroughly and discard juice. Whip the cream with the sugar and vanilla. Add whipped cream and remaining ingredients to sweetened cranberries. Mix well. Refrigerate 24 hours before serving. Serves 20.

title: Pasta With Daylily Buds And Mushrooms
instructions: Cook pasta while preparing vegetables. Clean first six ounces of mushrooms with a brush or damp towel; do not rinse. Tear or cut into bite-size pieces. (If using shiitake remove hard stems.)

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in 1 tablespoon oil. Add 1 cup chicken broth chicken soup and green chiles. Heat thoroughly. Add chicken. In glass dish or pan layer with tortillas (torn into bite-size pieces). Layer with meat mixture layer of cheese layer tortillas and end with layer of cheese. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until heated thoroughly. Top with sour cream and salsa.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients and parsley flakes until soft dough forms. Beat 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown in a 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Savory Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In a Dutch oven cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender; drain. Add the next 8 ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Remove the bay leaf. Serve over spaghetti. Garnish with fresh oregano if desired. Makes about 1 quart and serves 4 to 6.

title: Easy Citrus Broccoli
instructions: Wash and cut up broccoli. Place broccoli in steamer over boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Transfer to a serving plate and keep warm.

title: Toasted Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Toast coconut lightly. Bring sour cream to room temperature. In a saucepan combine milk egg yolks water and pudding mix. Cook over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Cool for 15 minutes. Beat in sour cream. Stir in 1/2 cup of coconut. Pour into prepared pie crust. Chill thoroughly. Top with whipped topping. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of coconut on top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Dried Beef And Lima Casserole
instructions: Melt butter or margarine and brown chopped onion in it. Add flour and milk and stir until smooth and thick. Pour over dried beef and cooked lima beans. Add chopped egg white and lemon juice. Stir mixture. Sprinkle with egg yolks. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Country Fried Turkey Nuggets
instructions: Slice turkey (chicken) breast into nuggets whatever size is desirable. Wash meat thoroughly in cold water. Mix eggs milk and A.1. steak sauce. Egg whites may be separated if desired. Marinate nuggets in batter for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Oatmeal-Raisin Muffins
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 12 in cupcake pans or 24 in muffin pans.

title: Breakfast Lasagna
instructions: Butter bottom of 9-inch pan. Place bread on bottom. Brown sausage and bacon; spread over bread. Beat eggs and add milk and seasonings. Pour over bread and meat. Repeat as needed. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes. Add cheese on top and bake 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Cook 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 until top is nicely browned.

title: Garden Casserole
instructions: Fry meat and drain. Layer potatoes carrots English peas and corn in large baking dish. Add meat and put oleo on top of meat. Pour tomatoes and tomato sauce on top. Do not stir. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: German Pancake
instructions: Melt butter in baking pan (9 x 13-inch). Beat eggs and add milk; mix well. Add flour a little at a time and mix smooth. Pour in pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in crusts. Sprinkle with coconut on top.

title: Rice Pilaf(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Melt 1/4 pound butter in a skillet; saute the onions parsley and 1 clove minced garlic. Add the rice and sprinkle with fine herbs (eg. oregano thyme) and a pinch of salt; stir and add boiling chicken broth. Mix thoroughly; cover and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Crab Meat Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Spread on any platter that has a deep center. Defrost snow crab. Squeeze thoroughly to remove all moisture. Flake on top of cream cheese. Top with shrimp sauce and garnish with parsley. If made early in the day remove from refrigerator 1/2 hour before serving for spreading consistency. Serve with crackers.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In large bowl beat 1 1/2 cups sugar and softened margarine until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs. Add flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Make into 1-inch balls and roll in cinnamon and sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Raisin-Pecan Pie
instructions: Roll pastry to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Place in a 9-inch pie plate; trim off excess pastry along edges. Fold edges under and flute. Prick bottom and sides of pastry with a fork. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 3 to 5 minutes; remove from oven. Cool.

title: Turkey Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously butter 9-inch pie pan (1 1/2-inches deep). Break spaghetti in half. Cook in boiling water until tender. Drain.

title: Chicken Hawaiian
instructions: Cook onion pepper and garlic in oil. Pour rest of ingredients in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Salsa
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise remove and discard stems seeds and membranes. Peel and quarter onion. In blender or food processor process peppers and cilantro until finely chopped. Add salt and lime juice. Add tomatoes and onions and pulse until they are coarsely chopped. Transfer to serving dish and serve within 1 or 2 hours. Makes 2 cups.

title: Sesame Fried Rice
instructions: Boil and cut chicken while cooking rice. Heat large skillet with oil. Add rice slowly stirring constantly. Add onion then peas stirring constantly. When heated through serve.

title: Caramel Rolls
instructions: Let bread thaw but do not let rise (about 30 to 45 minutes). Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Tear one loaf of bread and put in pan. Melt butter; add rest of ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour over dough. Tear second loaf and throw in empty spots. Let rise 2 to 4 hours or overnight. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove onto plate or wax paper.

title: Barbecued Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except steak); bring to a boil. Tenderize steak with tenderizing salt. Put steaks in sauce; cook over low heat for 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Serve immediately!

title: Hot Nectar Tea
instructions: Pour boiling water over tea bags in a kettle and cover. Steep 5 minutes. Remove tea bags. Combine pineapple juice apricot nectar orange concentrate lemon juice sugar and water in a kettle; heat slowly stirring several times to simmering. Stir in hot tea. Very carefully pour into a large punch bowl. Garnish with lime and lemon slices and maraschino cherries threaded onto a long skewer. Ladle into punch cups. Serve warm.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Note You might want to prepare in the late evening.

title: Galumpkies(Stuffed Cabbage)
instructions: Core cabbage and steam by setting cabbage in large bowl with water. Microwave on High for 10 minutes. Cabbage is done when leaves are \workable\.

title: Deviled Eggs Supreme
instructions: Boil eggs 10 minutes. Drain peel and cut in half lengthwise and cool about 10 minutes. Remove yolks and add to pickles Miracle Whip sugar dill weed salt and pepper onion and celery. Stir well and fill egg halves with 1 tablespoon of mixture. Sprinkle with paprika and chill until cool. Garnish with celery leaves. If there is any remaining egg mixture make a sandwich!

title: Raspberry Muffins
instructions: Combine flour baking powder baking soda and Sugar Twin in a mixing bowl. Add milk yogurt and raspberry flavoring; stir just to blend. Spray a muffin tin with nonstick spray. Divide batter evenly into 18 muffins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 18 muffins.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients. Chill. Serve with fruit slices.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese and grated Cheddar. Add all other ingredients except pecans; mix well. Shape into ball or roll. Roll in pecans. Wrap in foil and chill 24 hours before serving.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Grind green peppers red peppers green tomatoes and onions. Let drain 1 hour. Add sugar vinegar salt flour and celery seed to mustard. Stir and boil for 10 to 12 minutes. Add mayonnaise. Put leftovers in freezer bowls or canning jars and seal.

title: Potato Bake
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Luscious Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Let cool completely. Fold in whipped cream. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Fettuccine With Basil, Turkey And Walnuts
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water cook noodles until almost tender 2 to 3 minutes. Drain well. Add cream turkey ham basil cheese and hot pepper flakes to pot. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes stirring occasionally until very hot and well blended. Add pasta and walnuts and cook tossing 1 to 2 minutes until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Fruity Yogurt Drink
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender. Blend until well mixed. Serve cold.

title: Taco Wheels
instructions: Mix all ingredients except tortillas. Roll up as for jelly roll. Slice as desired. Arrange on platter. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar butter salt yolks and whole eggs. Dissolve soda in hot water. Add with sour cream to butter mixture. Sift flour baking powder nutmeg and vanilla and add to egg mixture. Dough will be sticky. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Roll on well-floured surface. Cut and bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until cookies are set but not browned.

title: Mexican Round Up
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain off fat. Add tomato sauce chili powder water beans and Spanish rice. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Put Fritos on a pizza pan. Pour meat mixture over Fritos. Top with grated cheese. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Whip Dream Whip; mix with sugar and cream cheese. Spread in crust. Add cherry pie filling. Enjoy!

title: Shrimp Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill for 1 hour. May be made ahead if sealed and refrigerated.

title: Mexican Beef Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet brown meat and pour off fat. Add green pepper onion and garlic. Cook and stir until tender. Stir in cooked macaroni water tomatoes tomato paste corn and olives. Pour into a 3-quart shallow baking dish (13 x 9-inch). Stir together tomato sauce and seasonings. Pour over macaroni mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until hot. Top with corn chips and cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts. Makes 8 servings.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni; rinse and drain. Stir in all other ingredients. Pour mix into 9 x 13-inch buttered baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Leftovers of this freeze well.

title: Coconut Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and cream cheese together; gradually add the sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour soda and salt; add to the creamed mixture stirring until just blended. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Cool in the pan 10 to 15 minutes then remove from pan.

title: Golden Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in skillet in about 1 tablespoon oil. Add green pepper onions and carrots. Pour in water and spread soup over top. Bring to a boil then simmer for 30 minutes covered. Serve with rice.

title: Taffle Apple Salad
instructions: Drain juices from pineapple and combine pineapple with egg sugar flour and vinegar in a small saucepan. Stir over medium heat until thickened. Cool completely. Fold in whipped topping and 1/2 cup peanuts. Peel core and slice apples. Then fold apples into pineapple mixture. Serve with 1/2 cup peanuts on top. Tastes just like a taffy apple without the mess.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ice cubes in a mixing bowl. Mix well. Put all ingredients in blender; blend well.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the shortening sugar and eggs. Sift together remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients together. Chill dough. Roll into balls (size of small walnut) then roll balls into a mixture of 2 teaspoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned but still soft. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Chill slightly. Add all other ingredients. Mix together well. Can be put into jello mold. Chill overnight.

title: Potato Rolls
instructions: Put warm water (105\u00b0 to 115\u00b0) in a bowl. Sprinkle yeast over the warm water. Add sugar and salt stirring until dissolved. Let stand until mixture starts bubbling.

title: Vanilla Glaze
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl until well blended.

title: Passover Vegetable Loaf *
