instructions: Saute onion in oil until transparent. Add celery carrots and green pepper. Saute until tender-crisp. Remove from heat and combine with remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar corn syrup and water to soft ball stage. Test with small amount in cold water or until it spins thin thread when dropped from spoon. Pour syrup into beaten egg whites and beat with mixer until consistency to drop from spoon onto waxed paper. Chopped nuts or candied cherries may be added just before spooning up. Garnish with half nuts or pieces of cherry on top.

title: Jelled Spinach Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello in hot water and then add next three ingredients. Place in freezer until set. Transfer to mixing bowl and whip with beater. Add celery cottage cheese spinach cayenne onion and salt. Mix thoroughly and chill. Serve cold. Serves 9 to 12.

title: Deluxe Coleslaw And Dressing
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving in a large bowl gently toss first 6 ingredients. In a separate small bowl mix remaining ingredients. This will make about 1/2 cup coleslaw dressing. Pour over ingredients in large bowl and toss gently. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken In Mustard Sauce
instructions: In blender or food processor combine onion celery garlic and vinegar. Add the rest of the ingredients. Process just until thoroughly mixed but not liquefied.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Add all ingredients to cooked macaroni. Add a little milk if needed. Bake in a large baking dish for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil the eggs for 20 minutes; let cool. Split the eggs taking out the yolk and putting them in a bowl. Mix the salt pepper and mayonnaise with the yolks until creamy. When well mixed spoon into the egg white halves. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar; add eggs (one at a time) beating well after each addition. Save 1/2 cup flour to flour fruits; add remaining flour sifted with salt and baking powder alternately with pineapple juice. Add floured fruits coconut and nuts. Stir only until well blended. Pour into waxed paper-lined 3 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. (If Pyrex pans bake at 250\u00b0.) Decorate with candied pineapple and cherries. Continue to bake 1 hour longer.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: In Pyrex pan melt 3 tablespoons margarine. Mix above ingredients together. Pour on butter in baking dish. Add any pie filling or lightly sweetened fruit. Bake 30 or 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Freezer Corn
instructions: Mix together. Stir constantly to prevent scorching. Bring to boil and cook for 15 minutes. Cool and put in freezer containers.

title: Easy Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Mix chicken and broth in pan; heat. Add biscuits. Cook 10 minutes uncovered then 10 minutes covered. Add small amount of butter milk and pepper.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken And Rice
instructions: Layer in crock-pot rice chicken soup and water. Let cook on low for about 4 hours.

title: Apricot Mousse
instructions: Mix Jell-O pineapple and sugar and cook for about 5 minutes. Add cream cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Add baby food and cool. Then whip the milk and combine. Pour into a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex dish greased with oleo. Refrigerate. When ready to serve cut into squares and place on a lettuce leaf.

title: Grits Casserole 1
instructions: Cook grits according to directions on the package. While hot dissolve stick of garlic cheese and stick of oleo in it. Beat eggs in a cup; finish filling cup with milk. Add to grits mixture and mix well. Pour into greased pan or casserole. Place in 350\u00b0 preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples and sugar together; let stand while mixing the cake. (Not necessary to use mixer.) Mix all of the other ingredients together. Add apple and sugar mixture. Bake in a 9-inch Pyrex pan which is greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes until it tests done.

title: Applesauce Fresh(Serves 6)
instructions: Combine all ingredients into stainless steel or glassware. Cover and cook for about 20 minutes stirring often for there is little liquid only the juice from the apples.

title: Western Spaghetti
instructions: Heat the oil or bacon if used. Cut into pieces and fry until light brown. Mince the garlic with the salt and add with the chopped onion and green pepper to the hot fat; cook slowly until the onion is limp and golden. Add the meat and continue cooking stirring occasionally until the meat is well browned. Add the tomatoes and simmer one hour or longer. (It is this long cooking of the sauce before combining it with the spaghetti that improves the quality of the finished dish). Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until barely tender; drain. Combine with the sauce and half of the cheese. (Taste the mixture; extra salt may be needed). Pour into a greased casserole. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake in a slow oven (275 to 300 degrees) until time to serve at least one hour and preferably 1 1/2 hours.

title: Paella(From Spain)
instructions: Boil the clams and mussels until they open. Clean the shrimp and boil to make the broth. Add more water if necessary to make 8 cups.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender and cool. Combine sugar and tomato soup and add prepared mustard salad oil vinegar and salt. Pour over carrots onion and pepper. Marinate 12 hours. Drain and serve.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese Cool Whip powdered sugar vanilla and pecans. Empty mixture into graham cracker pie crusts. Mix strawberries and glaze and pour into crusts.

title: Molasses Blueberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased 8 x 8-inch pan for 30 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Place oil in a 10-quart pot. Add onions garlic carrots celery and 1/2 teaspoon salt; cook over low heat until onions are wilted but not brown. Add cabbage kale thyme bay leaves and rest of salt. Increase heat stirring constantly for one minute. Add water tomatoes and chickpeas; bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 45 minutes. Add pasta and cook 15 minutes more until pasta is tender. Correct seasonings.

title: Chicken Paprikash
instructions: Peel and slice onions slightly smaller than 1/4-inch thick. Line bottom of Dutch oven with layer of whole onion slices. Cover completely with paprika. Layer chicken pieces over onions followed by more paprika (you cant use too much!) then the onions paprika chicken paprika. Repeat until you run out of chicken. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons water; cover pot tightly and start on medium-high heat until it begins to boil then lower heat to simmer. Allow to cook for one hour or until chicken is tender. Periodically check paprika level adding more if needed. After chicken is tender mix 2 cups Jiffy baking mix with 2/3 cup milk. Combine ingredients until well blended. Spoon dough onto boiling chicken and onion mixture. Cover tightly; let simmer 12 to 15 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Blend everything except save one egg white until later. Fold the beaten egg white in last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Coconut And Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 2 (8-inch) unbaked pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes.

title: Decoration Icing
instructions: Mix together; beat well with electric mixer. Make sure it is stiff. This is nongreasy icing.

title: Rice-A-Roni And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chicken. Cook Rice-A-Roni according to the directions on the box. Add chicken to the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes enough to serve 12 to 15 people.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook the potatoes onion and celery until tender. Add milk water salt and pepper. Continue to cook until hot.

title: Egg And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given except butter. Melt butter in large baking dish and pour egg and cheese mixture spreading evenly. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

title: Confetti Dip
instructions: Combine deviled ham sour cream and relish. Chill well. Garnish with pepper and pimento.

title: Grammy Billies Best Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients first. Break eggs into buttermilk. Add eggs and buttermilk to dry mixture. Melt Crisco on hot griddle. Pour half into batter and mix. Pour onto griddle silver dollar size.

title: Coconut Pies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Prebake pie crust for 8-10 minutes. Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie crusts. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Dish
instructions: Brown ground beef drain. Add all other ingredients to the hamburger and simmer until well heated. Pour over Doritos. Sprinkle with cheese on top. Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Measure cornbread bread broth milk and bouillon into casserole. Allow to soak about 30 minutes. Squeeze to break up lumps. Add remaining ingredients mixing well. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until done to your preference. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pumpkin Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Grease a Bundt pan and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until done. Top cake with brown sugar.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Dredge fruit and nuts in small amount of flour. Cream the sugar and margarine. Alternately add flour and eggs. Add flavoring and dredged fruit and nuts. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: In saucepan on medium heat mix flour sugar pineapple juice vinegar and egg. Cook until thick like pudding; cool. Mix with remaining ingredients. Chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Rose Wine Punch
instructions: In a large punch bowl combine wine grenadine syrup lemon juice and ginger ale. Spoon sherbet into punch. Serve immediately. Serves 22 (4 oz.) drinks.

title: Peppermint Stick Christmas Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except wafers.

title: Butter Fingers
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add remaining ingredients in order. Mold into crescent shape. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 16 minutes until light brown. Roll in powdered sugar. Yields about 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Pour boiling water over broccoli and set aside. Cover. Saute onion and celery in margarine. Mix all ingredients and pour in baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Peggy'S Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger onion garlic and cloves. Remove fat. Dump in all cans of ingredients. Drain mushrooms and black beans. Add spices. Simmer for 1 hour and serve.

title: Penuche
instructions: Use a butter loaf pan. 9 x 9 x 3 inches. Heat sugar milk brown sugar corn syrup and salt in a 3 quart pan on medium heat stirring constantly until sugars are dissolved. Cook stirring occasionally to 234\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat and add margarine. Cool without stirring to 120\u00b0 (bottom of pan will be lukewarm). Add vanilla beat continually with wooden spoon until candy is thick and no longer glossy 5-10 minutes. Mixture will hold its shape when dropped from spoon. Quickly stir into loaf pan. Cut into about 1 inch squares.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut vegetables in small pieces. Mix rest of ingredients together.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Thoroughly spread garlic around bottom and sides of large bowl. Add eggs and beat well. Add juice of lemon and stir with a whisk. Add anchovies and oil; stir. Clean rinse and gently pull apart romaine leaves. Toss well until all leaves are generously coated. Add cheese pepper and olives and stir.

title: Crock-Pot Stuffing
instructions: Melt butter and saute onion celery and mushrooms. Pour over bread crumbs. Add seasonings. Pour broth over bread crumbs and add beaten eggs. Mix well and put in crock-pot. Cook on High for 45 minutes then 4 to 8 hours on low.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients. Grease a large iron skillet or casserole dish. Sprinkle on thin layer of meal and let brown slightly. Pour half of the batter and sprinkle cheese meat onion and peppers evenly over batter. Pour remaining batter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Suitable for freezing (prepare freeze and then bake).

title: Yummy Sauce For Grilled Chicken Or Pork
instructions: Put chicken on grill. In small saucepan combine dressing butter and sugar until butter is melted and sugar is melted. When chicken is almost done on grill baste with sauce several times rotating sides of chicken. (Tastes great on pork also.) Use leftover sauce for dipping.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Combine all ingredients. Mixture will be thin. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Cajun Soup
instructions: Pure the tomatoes in a food processor. Heat the tomatoes and chicken stock in a large stockpot. Coat the chicken with flour. Brown in the oil in a skillet. Add to the tomato mixture. Cook until the chicken is cooked through. Add the okra. Cook until the okra is hot. Add the shrimp. Cook for 15 minutes or until the shrimp turn pink. Stir in the Creole seasoning. Yield 12 to 15 servings.

title: Tangy Red Fish
instructions: Prepare fish; dry it. Add seasoning to taste; set it aside. In bowl add mustard and vinegar; mix well. Place fish into mixture for 5 minutes; drain it. The fish is ready for baking or frying.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and chop. Add onion and cracker crumbs. Melt butter and add to mixture. Stuff back into mushrooms. Brown with butter in oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Olive-Cheese Tidbits
instructions: Cut butter and cheese into flour. Add salt. Form into small balls. Form around olives and seal well. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until brown. Yields 48 balls.

title: Cheeseburger Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese slices in a large mixing bowl and mix lightly. Place mixture in an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 5/8-inch loaf pan. Shape into a loaf. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove loaf from oven. Cut each cheese slice into 2 triangles and arrange overlapping on top of loaf. Return meat loaf to oven 2 minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Appetizer Meatballs
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine meat salt onion bread crumbs and milk. Toss lightly until well blended. Shape into bite-sized meatballs. Roll in flour. Preheat multi-cooker frypan. Brown meatballs on all sides in hot butter. Remove meatballs as they brown. Combine remaining ingredients and stir into frypan. Stir well to bring up bits of browned meat from bottom of frypan. Bring to boil. Add meatballs to sauce. Cover and simmer very gently 8 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve as hot appetizers with toothpicks. Serve hot or cold. Makes 50 balls.

title: Chicken Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Arrange chicken skin side up in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Mix soups (do not add water to onion). Pour on chicken; cover. Bake for 30 minutes. Uncover; bake 45 minutes or until done. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Whipped Honey Orange Butter
instructions: Beat butter honey and orange peel until fluffy. Delicious on breads etc.

title: Chuck Roast Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place roast in thick foil. Cover with mushroom soup; sprinkle onion soup mix over soup. Seal the roast in full and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 3 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Combine biscuit mix and sugar; cut in shortening until particles resemble coarse cornmeal. Combine beaten egg and heavy cream; add to biscuit mixture and stir with a fork until mixture forms a ball. Roll about 1/2-inch thick on a floured board. Cut with a 3-inch cutter and place rounds on a greased baking sheet. Brush top of each round with melted butter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Split and butter while still hot. Spoon the strawberries over rounds and top with whipped cream. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Rhubarb Salad
instructions: Combine rhubarb sugar and 1/4 cup water. Bring to rolling boil; reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand covered until partially cooled. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Stir and blend in rhubarb mixture. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in the pineapple apple and nuts. Chill until set. Can be frozen.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Melt Velveeta and Cheez Whiz in a covered microwave-safe dish stirring every 2 minutes until fully melted. Add chili and salsa. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Lemon Nut Cake
instructions: Mix flour raisins pecans salt and baking powder in a bag and shake. Cream egg yolks butter and sugar. Add this to the flour mixture and beat. Fold in beaten egg whites and lemon extract mixture. Use loaf pans. This makes 2 medium size or 1 angel food pan. Bake at 300` for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lemon Cheese Bars
instructions: Mix dry cake mix with 1 egg and oil until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup. Pat remaining mixture in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well; melt butter and add all ingredients together. Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until done. (Use shallow pie shell.)

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix flour and baking soda. Combine butter sugars and pudding mix in bowl. Beat in eggs. Add flour and stir in oats. Spoon onto cookie sheets and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients. In large baking pan shape into loaf. Bake 1 hour or until done. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil the potatoes until done. Mix the potatoes butter and sugar; stir. Add the egg and milk. Stir the vanilla into the mixture and pour\tinto an undone pastry shell. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then turn to 350\u00b0 and let cook 50 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Pasta
instructions: Note Any vegetable oil can be used instead of olive oil.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables for 6 minutes in just salt and water (no grease). Pour off liquid; pour into casserole dish (1 1/2 to 2 quart). Add grated cheese celery onion and mayonnaise. Stir to mix together. Crush crackers and top casserole. Pour 1/2 stick melted butter on top of crackers. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbles.

title: Almond-Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ham stirring until blended. Spread 1 tablespoon on each ham slice. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Wrap in plastic and freeze up to 1 month. Thaw at room temperature 1 hour before serving. Cut each roll into 3/4-inch slices. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Place on top of casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes less if potatoes are thawed.

title: Coffee Tortoni
instructions: Toast coconut and almonds. Whip egg white and coffee; add remaining ingredients. Freeze in fluted baking cups.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup flour with blueberries to coat berries. Mix remaining ingredients together. Fill muffin tins (lined). Bake 15 minutes or until light brown at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Add flour and sugar to melted butter; beat well. Then add eggs (1 at a time). Add vanilla and buttermilk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Mix well and form into a ball or log. Roll in chopped parsley and chopped pecans.

title: Artichoke Casserole(Side Dish)
instructions: Cut artichokes in halves sprinkle with herbs garlic and cheese. Mix well and stir in undiluted soup. Stir until evenly coated. Combine oil and bread crumbs in a bowl then sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Ham And Rice
instructions: Place all ingredients into a thick-bottomed pot and cover tightly. Bring to a boil then turn burner to low setting. Cook for about 20 to 25 minutes or until rice is tender and dry.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Add liquor margarine 1 1/2 cups water potatoes and onion. Cook covered 15 minutes. Add clams 1 3/4 cups milk and cream. Blend 1/4 cup milk and flour. Stir into chowder. Heat to boil stirring occasionally. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and dash of pepper.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt the margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add the remaining ingredients in layers in order given over the melted margarine. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce and dice other vegetables into large salad bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve with your favorite salad dressing. Serves 10 or more.

title: Paradise Rice Salad
instructions: Chill rice. Combine orange juice Italian dressing honey and orange peel. Stir into rice. Cover and chill several hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli by package directions and drain. Saute onion in butter. Add broccoli and remaining ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Cook slowly until a soft ball can be formed in the water. Add the remaining ingredients. Beat until thick. Put in buttered pans. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Jane'S Apple Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add other ingredients and mix. Spread on apple slices.

title: Deluxe Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Prepare scalloped potatoes as directed on package except omit butter. Stir in diced cream cheese and mushrooms. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Hot Sausage Snacks
instructions: Mix together and drop (small walnut size) on a greased cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Freezes well raw or baked. May be baked and heated as needed.

title: Mexican Chicken & Rice
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet on medium high heat. Add chicken onion and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn broth and salsa. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice and cover. Remove from heat and sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Pickle Rolls
instructions: Spread cream cheese on one side of a tortilla. Place a slice or two or ham over this. Spread another layer of cream cheese over the ham. Roll a pickle up in the tortilla and slice the roll into finger food-sized pieces. Refrigerate the rolls if you arent serving them immediately.

title: Mystery Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy; add cream of tartar then beat until stiff. Gradually add sugar. Stir in crushed crackers vanilla and pecans. Put in pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with whipped cream.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift first 5 dry ingredients together. Beat egg and add shortening orange juice and hot water. Combine with dry ingredients. Add nuts and cranberries. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 325\u00b0. Brush bread with butter; wrap in waxed paper while hot and place in refrigerator for 3 hours. Remove paper; wrap in towel and put back in refrigerator.

title: Just For Kids Play Dough(Clay)
instructions: In heavy saucepan mix dry ingredients. Add oil water and food coloring. Cook 3 minutes on low to medium low heat or until mixture pulls away from side of pan. Stir constantly. Knead slightly and store in an airtight container. Can be used over and over again. Keeps up to 3 months unrefrigerated. Not edible!! Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Stuffed Spud
instructions: Place baking potatoes on paper towel in microwave oven. Microwave on 100% power for 16 to 18 minutes or until knife-tender turning once. Remove potatoes; wrap each in foil. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Sensibly Delicious Double Chocolate Chip Brownies
instructions: Melt 1 cup chocolate chips sugar applesauce and margarine in large heavy saucepan over low heat stirring until smooth. Remove from heat. Add egg whites stir well. Stir in flour baking soda salt and vanilla. Stir in 1/2 to 1 cup chocolate chips and nuts. Spread into greased 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until set at 350\u00b0. Cool completely. (Use 9 x 13-inch pan for double recipe and bake 35 to 40 minutes.)

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit well; chop into bite size pieces. Combine with cottage cheese and marshmallows. Add whipped topping; blend well. Sprinkle dry gelatin over top of salad. Keep refrigerated (may be frozen).

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours (crock-pot works well).

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix with 1 egg and 1 stick butter; press into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Beat 2 eggs 1 stick butter cream cheese and powdered sugar. Pour over crust. Sprinkle with pecans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Holiday Roast
instructions: Marinate the roast overnight in Italian dressing. Rub over the lemon pepper and 2 sauces. Put under the broiler until lightly browned on all sides about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and pour over the broth. Put roast in pan on a rack and bake in 300\u00b0 oven uncovered for 10 minutes per pound. Remove roast from liquid; thicken gravy with cornstarch. Just before serving add a couple of dabs of sour cream to the gravy.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Mix both kinds of peppers. Add vinegar and sugar. Bring to a rolling boil and boil 7 minutes. Remove from heat and cool 5 minutes. Add Certo and coloring; mix thoroughly. Pour in jars and seal. Skim off foam with a spoon just before pouring in jars. (You can use vinegar.)

title: Roll-Ups
instructions: Clean spring onions; dont cut off green part. Spread cream cheese on ham slices. Place 1 onion per each ham slice and roll up. Cut into bite size pieces.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cream together cream cheese sour cream and mayonnaise. Add soup mix and stir. Add spinach that has been thawed and squeezed to remove as much water as possible. Combine all together.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar well. Add milk raisins and cooked rice. Add remaining ingredients and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours until firm.

title: Crunchy Jumble Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt and set aside. In large bowl combine softened butter and sugar and beat until creamy. Add the egg and vanilla and mix well. Blend in flour mixture. Stir in the Rice Krispies semi-sweet chocolate morsels and raisins.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Pour into a large black skillet and cook at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Baked Bass
instructions: Season inside of fish with lemon juice and salt. Flour both sides and brown in shortening in heavy roaster. Prepare your favorite stuffing recipe and stuff fish. Any extra stuffing place around fish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour or until fish and stuffing are done removing lid the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: M&M'S Party Mix
instructions: Mix all together. Delicious as well as colorful. Great for birthday parties showers etc.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Boil sugar Karo and water until spins thread. Add peanuts. Cook until starts to turn amber color. Take off heat; add butter vanilla and soda. Stir. Pour into greased pan and cool.

title: Cheesy Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Cook noodles. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes. Combine hamburger and noodles. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Place in casserole dish and cover. Bake at 375 for 25 minutes. Serve with salad and garlic bread for a quick and easy meal.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Dip chicken in margarine. Coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mexican Fruitcake
instructions: Mix by hand. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter-Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine peanut butter and melted butter; stir until blended. Mix in sugar eggs and vanilla. Combine flour with baking powder and soda in separate bowl. Add to the peanut butter mixture along with milk and chocolate chips. Stir just until well blended. Spoon batter into 12 paper lined 2 1/2 to 3-inch muffin tins. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Serve a creamy fruit soup for a light lunch a brunch refresher or even a luscious dessert. Serve on ice to keep it really cool.

title: Spice Bread-In-A-Jar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spray 7 wide-mouth 1-pint jars with nonstick cooking spray. Cream shortening and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Stir in applesauce water and eggs. Add mixture of flour soda baking powder salt and spices; mix well. Stir in walnuts and raisins.

title: Cherry Bars
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine and add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time; beating well after each one. Add flour and salt. Grease a 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Spread in pan and drizzle pie filling on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Dribble powdered sugar glaze on top. Makes a nice coffee cake also!

title: Barbara Hannaford'S Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix in large bowl the eggs sugar and Wesson oil; beat at medium speed about 1 minute. Sift flour; add salt and cinnamon. Sift again and add all at once to eggs sugar and oil. Mix thoroughly and beat at high speed about 2 minutes or until mixture is smooth. Add carrots and beat 1 minute. Roll pecans in 1/4 cup flour. Add to cake mixture and mix gently until pecans are well mixed.

title: Oven Bag Sticky Buns
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Shake flour in Reynolds Cooking Bag. Place in 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. Add brown sugar pecans margarine orange juice and cinnamon. Squeeze bag to blend ingredients. Smooth mixture in bag to an even layer. Using wooden spoon or spatula place biscuits on top of sugar mixture in bag. Close with tie; cut six 1/2 inch slits in neck of bag below tie. Bake 20 minutes. Carefully slit bag down center. Place serving platter upside down on top of baking pan. Carefully invert pan over serving platter. Remove pan and bag.

title: Kay'S Zucchini Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large mixing bowl. Beat 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Frost with a Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Peach Glazed Carrots
instructions: Arrange carrots in large skillet. Combine preserves and butter. Spoon over carrots. Heat 15 minutes or until hot. Carrots can be prepared in oven same time at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Spray 9-inch square pan with nonstick spray. Mix cornstarch and sugar. Combine with the rest of the ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.

title: Apple Walnut Cobbler
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar cinnamon and walnuts. Place apples in bottom of 8 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with half of cinnamon mix. Combine egg milk and margarine. Add dry ingredients all at once; mix until smooth. Pour over apples. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon mix. Bake in a slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with whipped cream. Serves 8.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a huge mixing bowl. Use 1/3 cup of mix for each cup of hot chocolate.

title: English Apple Pie
instructions: In medium size bowl beat butter and brown sugar with wooden spoon or electric mixer until light and fluffy. Stir in flour 1 teaspoon cinnamon and the water until smooth and thick. Stir in pecans. Mound apples in 9-inch pie pan. Mix white granulated sugar with remaining 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Spoon the pecan mixture dropping in dollops onto the sliced apples. Sprinkle the cinnamon and sugar over top of all. Bake on lowest rack in preheated oven set at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until apples are tender when pierced with skewer. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lazy Day Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Put butter or\toleo in an 8-inch square pan in oven. Melt. Mix sugar flour baking powder salt and milk. Then pour over melted butter. Spread undrained cherries over batter and sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or longer. Blueberries could be used instead of cherries.

title: Chicken Barbecue
instructions: Prepare Sauce\tBlend all ingredients except chicken in blender at\tmedium\tspeed.\tAfter chicken\tis cooled pour sauce over and let sit for about 1 hour before serving.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: In large bowl beat egg until light colored. Add sour cream honey and vanilla. Beat again. Mash bananas with potato masher or a fork; add to egg mixture. Add nuts. Sift together remaining dry ingredients. Combine with banana mixture and blend lightly. Pour batter into a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour until browned. Cool before slicing.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: In large bowl mix butter Parmesan cheese salt pepper and egg. Cook spaghetti and drain and put spaghetti with preceding mix and toss to coat well. Spread evenly in 13 x 9-inch pan. Brown meat in large pan adding onion pepper and garlic. Drain off fat. Stir in sauce sugar and oregano. Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti layer. Top with meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese and bake another ten minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Danish Apple Pie(Serves 6)
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar. Combine with all other ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased 8-inch pie pan. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm with Cool Whip or ice cream.

title: Oat Bread
instructions: Grind the rolled oats in blender or food processor until fine. Add all ingredients to bread maker in order listed. Select white bread and start. Makes the larger 1 1/2 pound loaf.

title: Cheesy Broccoli-Potato Soup
instructions: Heat broth onion and frozen broccoli to boiling in 3-quart saucepan. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in potatoes until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat over low heat about 5 minutes stirring occasionally until hot and cheese is melted. Makes 6 servings about 1 1/3 cup each.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Beat eggs well and add vanilla and sugar. Blend in ice cream and thawed Cool Whip as you add milk.

title: Orange Cooler Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 10-inch tube pan. Combine in large mixing bowl the cake mix 1 1/4 cups water eggs 1/4 cup oil lemon peel and orange peel. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes. Immediately turn cake out on rack and set over shallow pan.

title: Mrs. Allen'S Four Cheese Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Add milk; cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Add grated sharp cheese cream cheese Velveeta cheese and Parmesan cheese. Stir until melted and thoroughly blended. Mix cheese sauce and cooked macaroni. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle grated sharp cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 until bubbly approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in large bowl. Make a hole in the center and add liquids. Mix. Grease and flour coffee cans or loaf pans. Fill 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine and simmer 30 minutes. Pour over meat and cook until done.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Saute onions green pepper and celery. Add beef and brown. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 3 to 4 hours. Serve on buns. Can be frozen.

title: Rice-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli. Combine all ingredients in casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until broccoli is tender.

title: Pan Cookies
instructions: Mix all well; pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in tight container. To serve Mix 1 cup boiling water with 2 teaspoons of mixture.

title: The Perfect Wrap With The Perfect Salsa
instructions: Fill each tortilla with rice black beans sweet potatoes and grated cheese. Heat them in the microwave for 1 minute or until cheese melts. Serve with The Perfect Salsa.

title: Beer Chicken
instructions: Combine butter beer lemon juice garlic salt and lemon pepper. Pour over chicken and refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours. Grill chicken brushing sauce over pieces as you turn them. Grill about 15 to 20 minutes per side.

title: Shipwreck Casserole Dish
instructions: Put ground meat in bottom of greased casserole. Top with layers of sliced onion then layer of potatoes sliced thin. Layer rice. Cover with layer of beans then top with soup. Salt and pepper to taste each layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. This dish gets better the longer it bakes.

title: Neill'S Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour into unbaked pie shells.

title: Pace-Setting Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion garlic & peppers; Pour off fat and add picante sauce tomato sauce tomatoes salt & pepper cumin and chili powder. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 can onion rings. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with reserved onion rings; bake 5 minutes longer or until brown.

title: Denny'S Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix thoroughly by hand in bowl. Roll into walnut size balls. Bake in an ungreased pan at 375\u00b0 until brown (about 20 minutes).

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions. Fry hamburger and onions. Add 2 tablespoons flour and brown lightly. Add 2 cups milk and stir and heat until it boils. Pour noodles and gravy in a 4-quart casserole. Stir in the soups and asparagus. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Top with cheese slices 10 minutes before serving and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Hobo Casserole
instructions: Cook about 3/4 of a bag of egg noodles. Brown hamburg until well done cooking in a large casserole dish or 13 x 19-inch pan. Add tomato soup corn and sour cream. Mix well. Then warm in oven at about 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Pop 5-quarts of popcorn. Place one layer on baking sheets and set aside. In a large saucepan combine brown sugar butter and corn syrup. Boil 5 minutes; remove from heat. Add baking soda vanilla and salt; stir thoroughly. Mixture will foam up. Pour over popped corn; mix well. Place baking sheets in 250\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Stuff
instructions: Spray crock-pot with Pam. Put a layer of carrots a layer of potatoes onions and cabbage until vegetables used up. Put uncooked ground round on top of vegetables. Pour cream of mushroom soup over ground round. Cook on low for several hours.

title: Cheesy Beef Burros(Lo-Cal)
instructions: In a skillet cook ground beef until browned; drain well. Combine beef cream cheese onion and the 1/4 teaspoon salt. Spoon beef mixture onto tortillas; roll up. Place seam side down in a 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Teriyaki
instructions: Cut steak in 1/4 inch strips before baking. If cooking on grill or broiling cut after cooked.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cornmeal together with a fork. Beat eggs butter lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn off the oven and leave the pie in the oven for 10 minutes. Let cool for 30 minutes on a rack before cutting. Yield 6 servings.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake mix as directed. While warm poke holes into cake using a wooden spoon. While cake bakes mix and heat eagle brand and cream of coconut. Pour this over warm cake and allow to soak in. When cool top with Dream Whip and coconut.

title: Taquitos
instructions: In pan heat roast beef until hot. Add seasonings to taste. Place corn tortillas in hot oil skillet for approximately 20 to 30 seconds. Remove tortilla and place onto napkin or paper towel. After last tortilla is done take roast beef and place a spoonful across corner of tortilla and roll up.

title: Tuna Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers lengthwise into halves. Remove seeds and ribs from peppers. Place peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes. Rinse; drain cut side down. Set aside.

title: Chilled Vegetables(Serves 1)
instructions: Steam vegetables; add onions. Mix soup with 1/4 cup water. Pour over vegetables and chill for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Marquis
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Beat together egg yolks milk vanilla and cognac. Add to chocolate; mix. Simmer stirring occasionally until thickened about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 30 minutes until mixture is warm. Stir in melted butter; mix thoroughly. Pour mixture into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan lined with clear plastic. Freeze 2 to 3 hours.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Divide cake mix into 2 equal parts. Put 1/2 cake mix in a 13 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch cake pan. Arrange peaches and juice on top of cake mix. Put butter nutmeg and cinnamon on top. Cover peaches with remaining of cake mix. Use fork to mash cake mix until juice comes on top. Bake until browned.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all together and cook until butter and onion are partially done. Pour over chicken and bake.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Separate biscuits; cut into quarters. Arrange on baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Combine soups milk pepper and salt in a large bowl. Mix well. Add chicken broccoli and potatoes; stir in gently. Pour into a large baking pan such as a lasagna pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven; arrange biscuit pieces on top. Put back in oven another 10 minutes. Remove again and let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Meat And Vegetable Stew
instructions: Brown meat (using no more than 2 tablespoons oil if needed). Drain fat or oil completely. Add 2 to 3 cups water and sliced onion. Set aside vegetables. Add all other ingredients to meat and water in pan. Stir together bring to boil reduce heat then cover and simmer for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Add potatoes and carrots if used. Add water to almost cover meat and vegetables. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes. Add other vegetables. Add water if needed. Cover; simmer 15 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are of desired tenderness.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oatmeal. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes. Add brown sugar white sugar oleo and eggs; mix well. Sift flour soda salt and cocoa. Add to above mixture and mix well. Add 1/2 chocolate chips and nuts. Pour batter into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle rest of chocolate chips and nuts on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done. Serve plain or with Cool Whip.

title: Fat Lady Delight
instructions: Mix Jell-O and pineapple until dissolved. Add cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Georgia Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill overnight. Top with hot fudge. Chill again for 30 minutes. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine soups with broth in saucepan. Add margarine. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add rice and chicken. Pour into casserole and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Summer Veggie Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Add salsa; mix well but gently. Chill. Serve on bed of lettuce.

title: Kiwi Kooler
instructions: Peel and quarter 2 kiwi fruit. Place kiwi fruit and cherries in container of electric blender; blend on high speed until smooth. Pour into a punch bowl. Add club soda ginger ale and orange juice. Mix well. Peel and slice remaining 1 kiwi fruit; garnish punch with kiwi fruit slices. Spoon ice cream into punch. Serve immediately. Makes about 25 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. In large bowl stir together flour baking powder baking soda salt cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Stir in sugar. Add oil water pumpkin and unbeaten eggs; beat at medium speed until thoroughly blended. Stir in dates and walnuts. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Stuffed Jumbo Shells
instructions: Cook shells as directed on box and drain well. Mix Ricotta eggs parsley Parmesan Romano and Mozzarella cheeses together. Add salt and pepper to taste. Fill each shell with the Ricotta mixture. Pour the Ragu sauce just enough to cover bottom of baking dish. Lay shells side by side and drizzle more of the Ragu sauce over them. Cover with foil. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Heat remaining sauce and set on table so each person can add more if they desire. This recipe fills 40 shells.

title: Potato Dumplings For Soup
instructions: Mash cooked potatoes add eggs baking powder and salt. Add enough flour so they can be easily dropped from spoon. Drop by spoonful into boiling broth or stew. Cook uncovered over low heat for 10 minutes; then covered for 10 minutes. If dumplings are not fluffy your broth was not hot enough.

title: Meat And Green Pea Tajine
instructions: Cut the meat into pieces weighing about 150 g (5 ounces); rinse and put them in a thick-bottomed saucepan with salt saffron ginger and oil. Cover with water and cook with the lid on stirring from time to time. Add water if necessary. When the meat is cooked and breaks off easily in the fingers take it out of the saucepan and put on one side. Pull the shelled green peas in the sauce adding sufficient water to cover and cook with the lid on over a moderate heat. When the green peas are almost cooked add the pickled lemon zest cut in pieces and the olives. Leave the sauce to boil down until it becomes thick. Be careful not to overcook the green peas as it would make the sauce too thick.

title: Black Forest Dessert
instructions: Mix flour pecans and margarine to make a crust. Bake in a large Pyrex baking dish at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Almond Lace Wafer
instructions: Start your oven at 350\u00b0 or moderate. Grease 2 cookie sheets generously and coat with flour. Work almonds through a nut grater or blender until mealy. (Dont grind them through food grinder nuts get too oily.) Measure nuts and all remaining ingredients in a saucepan.

title: Apple And Oat Breakfast Mix
instructions: To dry apples Select any tart firm-textured apple (Granny Smith Jonathan or McIntosh). Wash peel core and cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch slices or rings. Pretreat by dipping in ascorbic acid mixture. Dry at 130\u00b0 to 135\u00b0 until pliable preferably in a food dehydrator. I use the oven; it works well. I place fruit on a cookie sheet.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix potatoes eggs onions and relish. In a different container mix Miracle Whip milk mustard sugar salt pepper vinegar and celery seed. Mix well and pour over potatoes. Mix well and chill.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients except crackers. Start with crackers in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Make three layers of crackers with filling in between.

title: Vermicelli With Vegetables
instructions: Cook vermicelli and set aside. Cook vegetables until al dente. Combine cream butter chives basil and nutmeg. Cook until hot. Combine sauce with vegetables. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Deluxe Fajita Nachos
instructions: In medium skillet combine meat spices and seasonings for fajitas and water; blend well. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes. In large shallow ovenproof platter arrange chips. Top with meat and cheese. Place under broiler to melt cheeses. Top with tomato olives green onions and desired amount of salsa. Makes 4 appetizers or 2 main dishes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix corn syrup sugar butter and eggs. Add salt vanilla and pecans. Mix well. Pour into 9 inch pie shell. Cover rim with foil and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove foil and continue baking for 10 minutes.

title: Pam'S Chocolate Chips Cookies
instructions: I mix these by hand. Beat butter sugars vanilla water and eggs until fluffy. Sift together flour baking soda and salt. Add this to the butter mixture. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet sprayed with vegetable spray. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until edges are just starting to brown. If you overbake them they will be hard and crispy rather than soft and chewy. Makes about 6 dozen (2 1/2-inch) cookies.

title: Cake Mix Variety Cookies
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Dot'S Hors D'Oeuvres(My Mother-In-Law'S Favorite Snack)
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spread on sliced bread. Place under broiler until cheese bubbles and is just slightly browned.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Dressing
instructions: Crumble bread in roasting pan. Mix well all ingredients. Bake in large roasting pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

title: Winter Garden Scrambled Eggs
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs; add ham peppers mushrooms and onions. Melt butter in a large skillet; add the egg mixture. Cook and stir gently over medium heat until eggs are completely set. Add garlic salt pepper and celery seed. Yields 4 servings.

title: Motor Home White Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix flour milk sugar and salt. Melt shortening in small saucepan then add warm water. Add yeast and mix. Add yeast mixture to flour mixture mix a little at a time constantly stirring until yeast mixture is gone. Knead for 5 minutes. Let dough double its size then place in 3 bread pans to double again. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Nichole'S Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add shortening and cooked and mashed sweet potatoes. Mix thoroughly. Knead dough. (More flour is needed.) Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Place on greased baking sheets and bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Salad
instructions: Drain liquid off salmon. Remove bones from salmon. Mix salmon onion black pepper and Miracle Whip together.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch flour and sugar. Add boiling water stirring constantly until smooth and creamy. Cook in double boiler for 5 minutes. Mix egg yolks lemon rind butter and lemon juice and stir into the hot mixture. Cook over hot water for 10 minutes stirring constantly until egg is cooked.

title: Honey Hall Tortilla Rolls
instructions: With electric mixer beat ham and cream cheese together until smooth. Stir in pineapple green onions and honey. Spread 1/4 cup ham mixture on each tortilla. Roll up each tortilla. Wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate 2 to 8 hours before serving. To serve cut each roll into 1/2-inch slices and arrange on platter. Serves 8.

title: Sausage Bake(Good For Breakfast)
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Mix eggs milk mustard and salt. Stir in bread cubes cheese and sausage. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight covered. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered; 325\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients; cool but do not set. Mix next 2 ingredients together then stir or fold into first 3 ingredients. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Refrigerate until molded. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Cherry Coke Jello Salad
instructions: Heat cherries until almost boiling. Add the sugar and stir until dissolved. Pour over jello and stir until dissolved. Add the can of pineapple juice and all. Then add a cup of Coke. Refrigerate for several hours before serving.

title: Rave Review Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in a large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed by electric mixer for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and pecans. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pans for 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack. Fill and frost with Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Slice And Bake Lemon Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter shortening sugar and brown sugar in large mixing bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in egg. Mix flour and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture with lemon juice. Mix well. Chill for 2 hours. Shape into 2 (10-inch) rolls. Wrap well. Freeze until firm. Cut rolls into 1/4-inch slices. Place 1-inch apart. Brush with egg white and top with almonds. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until light brown. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Kalechy
instructions: Cream the butter and cheese. Add yeast (which has been soaked in a small amount of milk in which a bit of sugar has been added. Add flour and mix until worked in thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight. Next day roll out the dough to approximately 1/8-inch thickness and cut into small squares.

title: Swiss Fondue
instructions: Mix together grated cheese flour salt nutmeg and minced garlic. Heat buttermilk until it bubbles and gradually add by handfuls the grated cheese mixture allowing each handful to melt before adding another and stirring constantly with a strong wire whisk. Serve with warmed squares of French or sourdough bread. Also great with bite sized pieces of broccoli cauliflower carrots etc. Serves 8 easily.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Roll in balls and pat down with a fork. Bake lightly. Measure flour before sifting.

title: Carob Chip Cookies
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients. Pour into bowl. Add flour 1 cup at a time and other ingredients. Mix well. Drop by tablespoon on sprayed cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all together flour last. Pour into 3 coffee cans greased and floured 3/4 full. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In a large bowl blend together all ingredients except pastry shell. Pour into pie shell. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool and serve.

title: Sweet Pepper Relish
instructions: Coarse grind or finely chop all vegetables. Add salt; mix well with hands. Drain well. Mix vinegar sugar and celery seed. Put all ingredients into large pot or canner. Bring to boil simmer 30 minutes. Put into jars; seal. Great on greens cabbage or beans.

title: Classic Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef & onion add other ingredients; simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Cook and drain lasagna noodles. In 9 x 13 baking dish spread 1 c. sauce; layer lasagna sauce cheese until all are used ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40-50 minutes.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Mix all together until smooth. Place 1 stick of butter in a bread pan. Put in oven to melt. Leave 1/2 of butter in pan and use other 1/2 over top of biscuits. Spoon dough into pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown. Makes approximately 9 big biscuits.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0 and grease and flour Bundt pan. Blend all ingredients together. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Bake for 50 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Tomato Casserole
instructions: Heat tomatoes with sugar. Saute oleo celery onion and bell pepper. Add to tomatoes with flour and vinegar. Let thicken; put in casserole dish. Add 2 slices bread (cut up). Stir well. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Rolled Mexican Omelet
instructions: Fry sausage dry and pour off grease. Crumble it. Crumble the crackers and add them to sausage. Stir in eggs. Mix well and cook in a lightly oiled pan. Turn once. Cover top with cheese. Put the chopped green chilli in the center and fold in thirds. Leave in skillet until the cheese melts. Cut in 2-inch pieces and serve.

title: Potato Doughnuts
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add half of flour and rest of ingredients. Beat until smooth. Add rest of flour 1 cup at a time until firm enough to handle. Knead for 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl. Turn once. Cover with damp cloth. Let rise until double. Divide dough. Cut and place on floured surface. Let rise until double. Fry in 365\u00b0 oil top side down first. Turn when medium brown. Makes good cinnamon rolls too.

title: Making Hard Soap Or Cakes Of Soap
instructions: Put in iron or galvanized pan and let stand for two weeks. Then boil for a few minutes. If the lard and grease has been used it doesnt need to stand. It will cook in a few minutes. After soap cools cut it in pieces and may be used.

title: Steak With Peppers And Tomatoes(Skillet Dinner)
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat. Brown meat; remove and keep warm. Add peppers tomatoes oregano Worcestershire salt and pepper.

title: Polish Easter Cake
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt and butter. Cool to lukewarm. Pour lukewarm water into a large bowl. Sprinkle yeast over top and stir until dissolved. Add milk eggs and flour. Beat vigorously for 5 minutes. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 1/2 hours or until doubled. Stir down batter. Beat in almonds raisins and lemon peel. Pour batter into greased and floured Charlotte mold or deep cake pan. Let rise for 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Let cool in pan for 20 minutes then remove.

title: Jeanne'S Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and refrigerate coconut mixture. Mix cake according to directions. Bake and cool thoroughly. Split cake layers and stack cut side up. Spread coconut mixture between layers. Frost sides with Cool Whip. Cover and refrigerate. Do not cut for three days.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder baking soda mace salt and walnuts in large bowl and mix well. Beat eggs in mixer bowl. Add undrained pineapple milk and margarine; mix well. Add pineapple mixture to dry ingredients; mix until moistened. Spoon into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Eggplant Supreme
instructions: Boil the eggplant until tender. Drain well. Saute celery onion and green pepper in oleo. Put eggplant and celery mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole and add other ingredients; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned. May be made a day ahead or frozen for future use.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: *Omit coconut and sprinkle with ground nutmeg for a custard flavor.

title: Beet Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add beet juice vinegar salt and onion. Chill until partially thickened. Add beets and cucumbers. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce spinach fresh mustard or other greens.

title: Creamy Broccoli Or Cauliflower Bake
instructions: Heat 1 inch salted water to boiling. Add broccoli or cauliflower. Cover and heat to boiling. Cook until tender. Drain. Place broccoli or cauliflower in ungreased 1 1/2-quart round casserole. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat soup and milk with hand beater until smooth; pour over broccoli or cauliflower. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix baking mix and oleo until crumbly. Sprinkle over cheese. Bake until crumbs are light brown; about 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: To serve place 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls of mix in a cup. Add boiling water and stir. Curl up in your favorite chair and enjoy.

title: Golden Cheese Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In saucepan stir soup with spoon until smooth. Slowly stir in milk. Heat and stir just until it boils. Combine with remaining ingredients. Turn into greased 2-quart casserole. If desired top with buttered crumbs. Bake covered 30 to 35 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

title: Upside-Down Cake
instructions: In a cast-iron skillet melt butter. Add sugar and mix. Spread evenly over bottom of cake pan. Arrange pineapple nuts and cherries over butter mixture. Pour cake batter evenly into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Granny'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients (reserve enough tomato sauce for top). Mold and bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Chip And Nut Bars
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine margarine sugar eggs baking powder salt vanilla flour and instant coffee. On low speed mix until well blended. Stir in 1/2 cup nuts and 3 ounces of chocolate chips. Spread mixture evenly on greased 10 x 15 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle with remaining nuts and chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool. Cut into bars (48).

title: Fritole
instructions: Cook corn meal and milk over low heat until it starts to thicken mixing constantly. Add sugar oleo and flour then add eggs applesauce and salt. Stir in raisins.

title: George Strait'S King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight or by the short soak method Cover beans with water ring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes turn off heat cover and let stand 1 hour.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together. Spread over top of cake batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mandarin Spinach Salad
instructions: In a blender combine the mandarin oranges and the Italian dressing. Blend until smooth. Stir in poppy seeds if using. In a large salad bowl toss together the spinach fresh orange sections and half of the dressing mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown first three ingredients over medium heat until well browned 20 minutes. Drain off fat. Add spices. Stir well. Add tomato paste crushed tomatoes and water mashing tomatoes with a wooden spoon. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer covered and stir occasionally until thick about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Blt Brunch Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine the mayonnaise Cheddar cheese mushrooms bacon green pepper and onion. Layer half of the tomatoes in crust; top with half of the mayonnaise mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Snow Ice Cream
instructions: Whip milk eggs salt sugar and vanilla together. Add snow to make desired stiffness.

title: Russian Salmon Salad
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Add celery onions and pickles to rice. Mix mayonnaise pickle juice salt and pepper. Stir into rice. Break salmon into chunks. Gently stir salmon and peas into rice mixture. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Serve on endive garnished with eggs. Makes 6 servings (about 1 cup each).

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Place first 5 ingredients in food processor; pulse until \crumbly.\ Pour in ice water while pulsing just until dough holds together when pressed between fingers (not until it forms a ball in the processor).

title: Lasagna - Easy And Quick
instructions: Cook lasagna according to directions on the box. While lasagna is cooking mix sausage and ground beef together and brown in skillet. Drain excess fat. Line a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with sauce. Layer with meat mixture cheese and then lasagna. Continue layers of sauce meat Parmesan Mozzarella and lasagna until dish is full. Cover with sauce and top with Parmesan and 2 cups Mozzarella. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese has browned and sauce bubbles approximately 20 to 25 minutes.

title: No Watch Stew
instructions: Put all together in Dutch oven and cover. Cook at 250\u00b0 for 5 1/2 hours.\tDoesnt need to be looked at!

title: Olive Dip
instructions: Chop olives so they are fairly fine. Combine with sour cream and add garlic salt. Chill. Serve with any kind of chip or cracker.

title: Ham And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Add 2 tablespoons salt to 3 cups water. Add macaroni; bring to boil. Boil for 2 minutes then cover. Remove from heat; let stand 10 minutes. Melt margarine in saucepan. Add chopped pepper and onion; simmer for 5 minutes. Add the chopped ham; brown lightly. Rinse macaroni and drain. Mix with all other ingredients except 1/4 cup grated cheese reserved for topping. Pour mixture into casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Wine Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix with electric beater about 5 minutes. Pour batter into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes. Cool about 5 minutes. Turn out.

title: Turkey Stroganoff(Serves 2 To 3)
instructions: Lightly flour turkey. Heat oil in saute pan. Saute meat until lightly browned. Add onion; cook just until soft. Add broth. Stir to loosen brown bits on bottom of pan. Add cracked pepper. Add sour cream. Do not boil. Serve over cooked noodles or rice.

title: Hearty Cheese Omelet
instructions: Cook bacon in a 10-inch skillet until crisp. Remove bacon reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon set aside. Saute onion and diced peppers in drippings until tender; add potato and cook until browned. Remove vegetables with a slotted spoon set aside and keep warm. Combine eggs water salt and pepper in a bowl; whisk just until blended. Pour egg mixture into hot skillet over medium heat. As mixture starts to cook gently life edges of omelet with a spatula and tilt pan so that uncooked portion flows underneath. Sprinkle half of omelet with reserved vegetable mixture all but 1 tablespoon crumbled bacon and 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons of shredded cheese. Fold in half transfer to plate. Sprinkle with remaining bacon and cheese.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes. In a large bowl melt butter. Add sour cream salt soup and cheese. Blen well then add potatoes. Place in a 9 x13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle corn flakes on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Cut cheese into squares; place in top of double boiler. Cook over hot water stirring frequently until melted. Place sausage Bisquick and cheese in large mixing bowl. Mix well. Shape into balls and cook on cookie sheet for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese And Bacon Frittata
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.\tGrease 10 1/2-inch round or 9 x 9-inch pan. Beat\teggs milk onion margarine salt\tand pepper until well blended using hand beater or wire whisk. Pour into pan. Sprinkle cheese and bacon evenly over top. Bake 20 minutes or until set and golden brown. Serves 4.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients in double boiler and cook until thick. Add coconut. Pour mixture in a baked pie shell. Let cool.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli. Add onion and cheese. Put dressing on when ready to serve.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken in water with salt to taste. Bone. Reserve broth. Tear tortillas in pieces and dip in reserved broth. Mix Velveeta cheese onion soup and tortillas in broth together with Ro-Tel tomatoes. Add boned chicken and mix thoroughly. Put in casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Southern Beef And Greens Soup
instructions: Place beef water salt and pepper into Dutch oven; cover tightly and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add greens basil and marjoram and continue cooking covered 30 minutes. Cut potatoes into cubes. Add potatoes onion and tomatoes to meat and cook for 40 minutes longer. Remove shanks; cut meat from each and return meat to soup. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit; add bananas and apples. Mix in walnuts and marshmallows. Add Cool Whip (any amount). Keep in refrigerator covered.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Save all juice except cherry juice. Dissolve Jell-O with saved juice and add fruit; chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Grate cheese. Add cream cheese chopped Ortega chilies and remainder of ingredients. Shape into rolls or balls. Roll in finely chopped nuts or chili powder. Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Chip-Toffee Scones
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly butter 2 heavy large baking sheets. Combine flour 1/2 cup sugar baking powder and salt in large bowl. Stir in chocolate chips nuts and toffee bits. Beat cream in another large bowl until stiff peaks form. Fold whipped cream into dry ingredients. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface. Knead gently until soft dough forms about 2 minutes. Form dough into ball; pat out to form a 1 1/4-inch thick round. Cut dough into 12 wedges. Transfer wedges to prepared baking sheets spacing apart. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with additional sugar. Bake until golden brown about 20 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 12.

title: Sauteed Scallops With Watercress Salad(Serves 2)
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together well the mustard vinegar 2 tablespoons of oil salt and pepper to taste.

title: Corn Dodger
instructions: Mix all ingredients except water. Pour water over this mixture and beat until well blended. Dip hands in cold water. Take a handful of batter and drop onto a greased cookie sheet or griddle. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 8 minutes or you can cook on top of stove.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease a tube cake pan. Stir together cake mix and dry gelatin. Blend well with 3/4 cup oil. Add eggs one at a time stirring after each egg. Stir flour into nuts and add to cake mixture. Add strawberries to batter. Gently mix. Pour batter into cake pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes or until toothpick tests clean. Serve with Cool Whip and fresh strawberries on top. For a more decorative cake cover completely with Cool Whip and decorate with berries.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Sift together cake flour baking powder and salt. Add brown sugar shortening 2/3 cup milk and vanilla. Beat vigorously for 2 minutes on medium speed mixer. Add 1/3 cup milk and eggs. Beat 2 more minutes. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven. Frost with Penuche Icing.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer in order. Dot the top with 1 stick butter. Bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Add flour mixture to creamed mixture all at once. Mix well. Put in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour (325\u00b0 in glass).

title: Easy Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook broth and broccoli until tender. Melt cheese in microwave. Pour into broth and broccoli. Continue to heat until hot. One Weight Watchers point per cup.

title: Plain Cake
instructions: Cream sugar Crisco and eggs. Add flour soda and cream of tartar. Add milk slowly with vanilla and lemon extract. Put into greased and floured tube pan. Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Brown chicken in oleo. Cook for 15 minutes (low heat). Add a slice of cheese and a slice of ham to each chicken breast. Secure with toothpicks. Add a cup of green onions. Add soup and milk or water. Cook about 20 to 25 minutes. This can be done on top of stove or in oven.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water with the 2 tablespoons sugar. Add butter to milk; warm until butter is melted. Cool; add to eggs. Add yeast mixture and salt. Add flour with 1 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons baking powder. Mix well; then knead like bread. Let rise until double in size. Roll out braid and let rise 2 hours. Brush top with egg and sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Mmm Good Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat together margarine and sugars until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. In a separate bowl combine flour baking soda salt and spices. Add to margarine mixture. Mix well. Stir in oats. Press dough onto bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for about 25 minutes or until golden. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Grapefruit Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and water; cook until clear. Then add strawberry flavored Jell-O powder and almond extract then cool. Scoop out enough grapefruit (no membrane) to fill pie shell. Drain well! Add to mixture and put in baked pie shell. Top with Cool Whip and keep refrigerated.

title: Mother'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Turn out on lightly floured board and roll out to about 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes and bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) until lightly browned.

title: Ma'S Quick Snack Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and beat on high for two minutes with electric mixer. Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Top generously with 1 3/4 cups sliced almonds and 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate morsels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Test for doneness by inserting a toothpick in the center of cake. It should come out clean. Allow to cool in pan for approximately 15 minutes before serving.

title: Macadamia Nut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt. Blend eggs sour cream and vanilla. Stir in sugar mixture. Add nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cherry Squares
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar and add eggs beaten in one at a time and extracts. Add flour; mix well. Grease and flour a jelly roll pan (16 x 11 x 1-inch). Put 2/3 batter in pan. Spread cherry pie filling on batter. Spread remaining batter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes until brown on top. Glaze while still warm with

title: Cookies And Creme Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Combine cookie mix and milk in mixing bowl and beat at a low speed with electric mixer until blended plus 2 more minutes. Fold in 1/2 cup Cool Whip and crumbled cookies. Spoon into dessert dishes and cover to chill. Serve with dollop of Cool Whip and cookies.

title: Three Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook bacon in skillet until crisp. Remove bacon reserve 2 tablespoons drippings. Cook onion until tender in drippings. In a 2-quart casserole combine crumbled bacon beans onions undrained tomatoes brown sugar Worcestershire sauce and dry mustard. Bake covered in 375\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Uncover bake 20 to 25 minutes longer.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Put crackers in heavy paper bag. (Use 2 grocery bags put together.) Put all ingredients but crackers in blender. Mix well. Dribble over crackers in bag. Shake well. Keep in closed bag for 12 hours then store in container.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with hands. Divide into 3 parts. Form into log rolls. Wrap logs separately in aluminum foil. Cure in refrigerator for 24 hours. Unwrap and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Turn over about halfway through the baking time. The sausage should turn bright red in color.

title: Sweet-Sauer Cabbage Soup(Kopustu Sriuba)
instructions: Boil ribs in water with onion salt peppercorns and bay leaves for 1 hour. Add rinsed sauerkraut; boil 1/2 hour. Add shredded cabbage; boil 15 minutes longer. Ribs may be removed and served separately or meat cut into pieces and served in the soup.

title: Mediterranean Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Pour oil in pan (13 x 9-inch or larger). Layer vegetables in following order until all used eggplant zucchini onions peppers tomatoes and ending with eggplant; seasoning each layer with salt pepper and oregano. Top with sliced cooked sausages. Pour sauce over all. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Drain off some of the juices. Top with cheeses and return to oven until melted. Delicious simple and serves the whole family plus a couple of friends.

title: Crock-Pot Chili
instructions: Brown beef lightly in skillet and drain. Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Mix well and cover. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Serves 4.

title: Non-Cook Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In small pot over medium heat mix sugar milk margarine and cocoa. Stir until it comes to a boil. Let boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Continue to stir then take off heat and add oatmeal vanilla and peanut butter. Stir mixture well. Drop by teaspoons on wax paper and let cool.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar and baking soda. Add pineapple and 1 teaspoon vanilla and dash of salt. Mix well. Add eggs. Mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 (glass pan) or at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Buddy Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl beat peanut butter and butter until smooth. Add sugar eggs and vanilla; beat until creamy. Blend in flour and salt. Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips. Spread mixture into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Then remove from oven and sprinkle remaining chocolate chips across bars. Let stand 5 minutes or until morsels become shiny and soft. Spread across top of bars. Cool completely before cutting bars.

title: Aunt Helen'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill dough and then roll thin. Cut with cookie cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Coconut Cookies
instructions: Mix to form a soft ball. Drop or make small balls and place about 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all in a large bowl. Chill.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Cut about 3 large sheets aluminum foil. Can make a crease in the middle of the foil to allow sauce to filter down. Slice onions and garlic. Mix all ingredients together except the meat. Place meat on foil then pour the sauce on top of the meat that is in the middle of the foil. Enclose the meat tightly in foil. Put in baking pan. Bake all day at 350\u00b0 (about 10 hours). Break apart with fingers should be moist and sandwiches can be easily made. Additional sauce can be added if not moist enough. Great for picnics. Serves many.

title: Mint Orangeade
instructions: Combine 2 1/2 cups water and sugar in saucepan; bring to boil. Pour over mint. Add juice. Cover; let steep at least one hour. Strain; cover and chill. For each drink pour 1/3 cup fruit mix into tall glass over ice if desired. Fill with chilled ginger ale or club soda. Makes 6 cups drink base.

title: Campers Special
instructions: Make hamburger patties; put in foil. Put slice of onion tomato potatoes and carrots on top of patty. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 until vegetables are tender.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Mix the mustard and jelly in a saucepan over low heat. Slice the frankfurters diagonally in bite-size pieces. Add to sauce and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Pumpkin Cake
