instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 12-cup Bundt pan. Sift first eight ingredients into medium bowl. Beat shortening and 2 cups sugar in a large bowl. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add pumpkin and vanilla and beat. Stir in dry ingredients.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook hamburger. Add tomato paste and tomato sauce. Stir. Add remaining ingredients and cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours on low.

title: Luscious Lemon Cream Fruit Dip
instructions: In bowl beat together eggs 1/2 cup sugar and ReaLemon juice. In saucepan combine remaining sugar and cornstarch. Stir in water. Cook and stir until thickened. Remove from heat. Gradually beat in egg mixture. Over low heat cook and stir until slightly thickened; remove from heat. Add vanilla. Cool. Fold in whipped cream. Serve with fresh fruit. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into small balls and drop onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. If too dry add a little water. Pour into a well-greased pan and bake 25 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until browned.

title: Easy Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine cake mix 2 eggs margarine and vanilla. Mix well and pour into a 9 x 13 inch pan. In a separate bowl combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Mix together. Knead on floured surface. Roll to fit 9-inch pie plate.

title: Low Calorie Dip
instructions: Place in blender and puree until smooth.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Slice eggs lengthwise. Remove yolks and mash until lumps are gone. Add other ingredients and mix well. Spoon into egg whites. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Zucchini With Garlic And Onion
instructions: Wash and dry zucchini; shred each into a bowl then put into an absorbent towel to remove as much moisture as possible. Heat butter until bubbly. Chop garlic finely; add to butter along with onion. Cook garlic and onion until soft. Add zucchini and cook stirring for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Pizza Appetizers
instructions: Brown sausage; drain fat and cool. Add enough mayonnaise to make it pasty (about 1/4 cup). Add rest of ingredients and seasonings to taste. Spread on cocktail rye bread. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Stuffed Buns
instructions: Melt cheese. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Spread on hot dog buns (can be frozen if wrapped in foil). Stuff buns and wrap in foil.

title: Marinated Pasta Salad(Low-Calorie)
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions omitting salt. Rinse drain and cool. Place in a large bowl. Add vegetables and toss to mix. Add remaining ingredients. Toss cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve on leaf lettuce with French bread as an accompaniment. Serves 8.

title: Devil'S Food Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir in melted chocolate. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream. Mix well. Stir in walnuts. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost cool cookies with the following 3 cups confectioners sugar 1 teaspoon butter and few drops lemon juice. Sprinkle with crushed nuts.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Drain salmon; set aside 2 tablespoons salmon juice. Mix salmon egg and onion until sticky. Stir in flour and add salmon juice. Mix. Roll out patties.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Grease a 3-quart casserole with butter. Mix all ingredients except bacon and olives. Chop bacon; sprinkle with olives over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Blend together sugar and flour. Beat egg yolks. Add a little milk to them. Add this to sugar and flour. Add remainder of milk and stir well. Add margarine. Place in large microwave bowl and cook in microwave on High for 2 minute intervals until thick. Stir well between cooking intervals. When thick add vanilla and coconut. Pour into baked 8-inch pie shell.

title: Christmas Potato Bake
instructions: Peel and grate potatoes. Heat soup with butter. Add sour cream and grated cheese to hot mixture and mix together. Add this to potatoes and onions. Place in buttered casserole. Top with corn flake crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook and dice chicken. Add soup Veg-All salt and pepper. Pour all ingredients into 1 pie crust. Place 2nd pie crust on top and press edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and bubbly.

title: Coney Island Sauce
instructions: Brown meat slowly but thoroughly breaking with fork until very fine. Add other ingredients and simmer over low heat until well blended (10 minutes). Serve in a bowl to be ladled over hot frankfurters in heated buns. Serves 12.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Mix together sugar flour and cocoa. Add shortening eggs and vanilla stirring until well mixed. Add chopped nuts. Pour into a 12 x 10 x 2-inch greased pan and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 25 minutes. Makes 2 dozen brownies.

title: Greek Soup(A.K.A. Egg And Lemon Soup)
instructions: Boil broth add rice; cover lower heat and let simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool for 15 minutes. Separate egg whites from yolks. In a large bowl blend yolks and lemon juice together. Using a ladle slowly add the broth to the egg-lemon mixture stirring continuously otherwise egg will curdle. When bowl is full pour back into kettle with remaining broth and stir. Whip egg whites until fluffy and add to soup in kettle. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pumpkin Puff
instructions: Sift the first 6 ingredients together. Add the dates and nuts. Cream the margarine sugar egg and flour mixture. Add the pumpkin. Mix lightly. Pour into well-greased 2-quart mold. Cover and steam 2 hours. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Quick Grilled Chicken
instructions: In glass dish or plastic bag combine oil water taco seasoning lemon juice and vinegar. Add chicken breasts turning to coat all sides. Marinate 30 minutes. Broil or grill.

title: 10 Minute Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together and roll into balls the size of a walnut. Flatten with bottom of a buttered glass dipped in sugar. Bake for 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Smoked Sausage Lasagna
instructions: Place 1/2 cup sauce in bottom of 2-quart oblong casserole dish. Alternate layers of noodles Ricotta cheese spaghetti sauce sausage Parmesan cheese and salt. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pork 'N Kraut
instructions: Slice pork loin into 2-inch slices. Slice potatoes thickly. Slice yellow onions. Peel and slice carrots lengthwise. Brown pork in oil with salt and pepper to taste over medium/low heat.

title: Eggplant Caviar
instructions: Cook eggplant in simmering water until tender (about 20 minutes). Drain peel and finely chop. If too moist and watery heat and stir in skillet until moisture is absorbed. Blend pulp with minced onion garlic tomato salsa sugar dry mustard olive or corn oil lemon juice dash of lemon pepper paprika and marjoram and sesame seed. Combine in blender until well mixed and fairly smooth. Chill mixture well. Serve with French or rye bread or crackers.

title: Herb Garden And Lemon Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to box directions and drain. Meanwhile in 10-inch skillet heat oil. Add zucchini and onions. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until zucchini is crisply tender. Add remaining ingredients and pasta. Cover; let stand for 2 minutes or until tomatoes are heated through. Serves 6.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Cheese Frosting
instructions: Combine cream cheese and butter beating until light and fluffy. Add sugar and beat well. Stir in lemon rind and lemon extract.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar and eggs. Blend in flour chunked bananas and salt. Add soda dissolved in 2 teaspoons water. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased floured loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Use for dip or spread with vegetables meat or cheeses.

title: Martha Washington Candy
instructions: Mix sugar milk nuts salt extracts and coconut until well blended. Form into small balls. Chill. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate mixture; cool on wax paper.

title: White Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl beat shortening sugar and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla; blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup level off.

title: Glazed Onions
instructions: Parboil the onions for 3 minutes. Slip off skins. (Frozen onions may be used.) In a skillet combine onions olive oil 1/2 tablespoon of sugar and chicken broth. Bring mixture to a boil and simmer covered for 12 to 15 minutes or until onions are tender. Remove cover and simmer until liquid is reduced to a syrup. Add 1 tablespoon of sugar and 3 tablespoons of water and cook mixture over moderately high heat swirling the skillet until the sugar is melted and the onions are golden and glazed evenly. This takes a while but is worth the effort.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown together ground beef onion and pepper; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 2-quart baking dish for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Apricot Jello Salad
instructions: Drain fruit together. Mix jello with water and juices. Jell slightly; add remaining ingredients and chill until firm. Top with Custard.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Bring all ingredients to room temperature and combine. Mix well and shape into a ball. Roll ball in walnuts. Chill before serving.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix; add corn syrup and rum. Mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in additional powdered sugar.

title: Tangy Pot Roast
instructions: Dredge meat in the flour mixed with the salt and pepper. Rub the mixture into all surfaces. Heat the oil in a heavy Dutch oven or casserole and brown the meat well on all sides over high heat. Pour off drippings in a pan and reserve. Mix together the broth cranberry sauce horseradish cinnamon and cloves and add to the meat. Bring the mixture to a boil. Cover tightly and simmer gently about 2 hours or until the meat is barely tender. Meanwhile brown the onions in the reserved drippings in the skillet. Add the carrots and cook 2 minutes longer. Add drained vegetables to the meat broth. Cover and cook about 25 minutes longer or until the vegetables and meat are tender. Serves 7.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender then drain. Chop broccoli. Add all other ingredients. Top with Pepperidge Farm herb dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Turnovers
instructions: In a small saucepan cook peas and carrots in a small amount of boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain. Meanwhile stir together cream cheese milk and cooked vegetables. Unroll crescent dough; seal perforations to form 4 rectangles. Place 1/4 of the turkey mixture in the center of each rectangle. Lift the four points of each rectangle to the center; pinch edges to seal. Place turnovers on an ungreased baking sheet. Brush with melted butter or margarine; sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm. Serves 4.

title: Pat'S Microwave All-In-One Lasagna
instructions: Pour 1 cup spaghetti sauce and 1 cup warm water into an 11 x 7 1/2-inch glass pan. Layer half the pasta in pan. Add beef evenly over the pasta. Sprinkle with pepper; layer remaining pasta over meat. Add remaining spaghetti sauce and water. Cover with vented plastic wrap and microwave on High for 22 minutes.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 18 muffin cups with paper liners or grease them well.

title: Easy Chicken
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together and spoon sauce over about 10 chicken breasts. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer. Makes 10 servings.

title: Incredible Peach Pie(A Peach Custard Pie That Makes Its Own Crust)
instructions: In a large bowl beat 2 eggs and add milk corn syrup butter sugar vanilla and flour. Mix until smooth. Stir in coconut and peaches. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch pie plate. Top peach mixture with chopped pecans and sprinkle generously with nutmeg or cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until the custard is set. Allow to stand 15 to 30 minutes for easy serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Ding Bats
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar. Add well beaten egg and package of chopped dates. Cook together over low heat until dissolved. Add 1 cup chopped pecans and cook 8 minutes longer stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add 1 teaspoon vanilla; stir. Add Rice Krispies and mix well. Form in small balls and roll in flaked coconut. These may be made in advance and frozen or refrigerated for days.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Melt the butter. Add flour and gradually pour in the milk. Bring to the boiling point. Add corn seasonings egg yolks (beaten until thick and lemon colored) and egg whites (beaten stiff and dry). Turn into a buttered dish and bake in a moderate oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Yellow Scratch Cake
instructions: Put butter in a bowl until soft. Add sugar and cream well. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add milk alternating with flour which has been sifted with baking powder. Mix with electric beater or by hand.

title: Special Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Heat chocolate and cream cheese on Medium power in microwave 2 to 3 minutes. Stir. Stir in milk sugar vanilla. Reheat 30 seconds to 1 minute more on Medium power. Store in microwave jar in refrigerator. Take out and heat on Medium power 1 minute to serve warm over ice cream.

title: 20 Minute Rolls
instructions: Let raise 20 minutes or until double in size. Knead a little in pan and shape in rolls or cinnamon rolls. Let raise again 20 minutes or until double size. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes very good cinnamon rolls.

title: Black-Eyed Peas And Grits
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square pan 8 x 8 x 2 inches. Empty grits into pan; stir in boiling water. Stir in cheese spread and egg; continue stirring until cheese is melted. Gentle stir in black-eyed peas and tomatoes. Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. May be baked in muffins or a pan.

title: Fresh Cooked Shrimp
instructions: Combine water salt vinegar bay leaves spices and celery. Bring to boil. Add shrimp (in shell or peeled and deveined). Cover heat to boiling again. Lower and simmer gently for 5 minutes more until shrimp turns pink; drain. If cooked in shell peel shrimp and remove veins that run down back. Serve as an appetizer. Chill and pass cocktail sauce. Makes 4 or 5 servings.

title: Hershey Bar Pie
instructions: Melt the first 3 ingredients together. When cool use 1/2 pint of whipped cream and fold into the melted mixture. Put in graham cracker crust and chill.

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs pumpkin and soda. Mix in remaining ingredients; stir well. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yields 9 dozen.

title: Salmon Noodles Romanoff
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain. Mix noodles cottage cheese sour cream onions garlic Worcestershire sauce red pepper sauce salt and salmon. Place about 1 cup of salmon mixture in each of 5 or 6 greased baking shells or individual casseroles. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 5 or 6 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Quesadillas
instructions: Place 4 tortillas on ungreased cookie sheets. Top each with 1/4 Cheddar cheese Monterey Jack cheese bacon peppers and onion to within 1/2-inch of edges. Top with remaining tortillas.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into pie crusts and chill.

title: Super Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Put raw meat into a 2-quart casserole dish. Mix soup with water; pour over meat then sprinkle dry onion soup mix on top of soup. Cover and bake for 2 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Do not peek or stir! Saute fresh mushrooms and stir into meat along with sour cream. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Broccoli Souffle
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli; cool. Combine all ingredients in 2-quart casserole. Cover with buttered crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Orange Wassail
instructions: Combine sugar water and spices in a large Dutch oven; simmer over low heat 10 minutes. Discard spices. Add juices to syrup; heat well. Makes 4 quarts. (For a clear look use frozen orange juice.) Keep warm in crock-pot.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken Monterey
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine the 1/2 cup flour and taco seasoning in plastic bag. Add 2 or 3 chicken pieces at a time and shake to coat. Melt butter in a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Place chicken in pan turning once to butter all surfaces. Roll each breast in crushed chips and return to baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until tender. Stir in the 2 tablespoons flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Add evaporated milk and pepper sauce all at once; cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more then add cheese olives and lemon juice stirring until cheese melts. Put chicken on leaf lettuce and top with cheese sauce; pass remaining sauce.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. In large pot cover chicken with water and boil on medium fire until done. Add noodles. Cook until tender.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place half of potatoes in buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of onion half of cheese and half of butter then repeat. Mix milk and flour; pour over potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together bake in a 2 x 9 x 13-inch greased pan at 400\u00b0 until good and brown.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add eggs; beat well. Sift together flour baking soda and salt. Alternately add dry ingredients and orange concentrate to creamed mixture; mix well after each addition. Stir in pineapple and nuts. Turn into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on rack. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Savory Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain salmon; reserving 1/3 cup liquid; set aside. Remove skin and bones from salmon if desired; flake salmon with a fork. Brown 1 1/2 cups cracker crumbs in 1/4 cup butter in a large skillet; set mixture aside. Combine salmon reserved liquid remaining 1/2 cup unbrowned cracker crumbs eggs and the next 10 ingredients. Sprinkle 1/4 cup browned cracker crumbs in center of a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Shape salmon mixture into a 9-inch loaf and place on top of crumbs. Press remaining browned cracker crumbs on top and sides of loaf. Arrange bacon slices diagonally across loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes covering loosely with foil the last 15 minutes if crumbs brown too quickly. Serve with Cucumber Cream Sauce.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Core and peel apples; slice in thin rounds. Separate the eggs. Blend the yolks milk and slowly the condensed milk until well blended. In a greased pan arrange one layer of sliced apples; pour over custard. Put in oven for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until custard is solid. Take from oven and beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar. Pile on top of pudding. Put in oven until browned. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Hot Bean Dish
instructions: Brown burger and bacon. In large pan add everything else. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Drain beets; save liquid and add vinegar. Make a thin paste with cornstarch. Add rest of liquid. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Soak raisins in very hot water until plump. Drain well; add butter sugar raisins and beets. Heat thoroughly stirring often. Yield 4 servings.

title: Cathy'S East Texas Cobbler Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick of margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer the rest of the ingredients in order given. Top with the other stick of melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Spiced Tea(Dry)
instructions: Mix well. Store in airtight jar. Use 2 to 2 1/2 teaspoons per cup of boiling water.

title: Mom'S Old Fashion Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt soda and sugar together. Cut in shortening. Blend in eggs milk and vanilla. Roll out on floured table to 1/16 inch thickness cut into shapes using your favorite cookie cutters. Sprinkle with sugar or leave plain to frost after baking. Bake 6 - 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. DO NOT OVERBAKE! We like to make these cookies at Christmas time frosting them with different colored frosting and then adding different kinds of sprinkles. Great fun for the whole family.

title: Fuzz-Buzz
instructions: Put first three ingredients in electric blender with enough crushed ice to blend to a medium consistency. Serve in cocktail glasses. Peaches with red centers and red on the skin make a very pretty drink. (The name \Fuzz Buzz\ is derived from the fuzz in the peach skin and the buzz in the gin or vodka.)

title: Ribbon Salad
instructions: In small bowl soften unflavored gelatin in 1/2 cup of the cold water; set aside. In small saucepan bring milk to a boil. Remove from heat. Add sugar immediately and stir to dissolve. Add sour cream vanilla and softened gelatin mixture to the hot milk and beat until smooth and creamy. Set mixture aside but do not refrigerate.

title: Chopped Ham Rolls
instructions: Melt butter and add all ingredients except ham and cheese. Simmer on low heat for 5 minutes. Add ham and heat. Take off heat and add cheese; stir well.

title: Scandinavian Fruit Pudding
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; stir in the granulated sugar. Fold in fruit cocktail and drained pineapple. Stir until dry ingredients are moist. Turn into a buttered 9-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar then almonds. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut into squares and serve warm with whipped cream. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine and cheese. Put sugar and cocoa in a large bowl. Blend cheese and margarine with sugar and cocoa. Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Add nuts if desired. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Fresh Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Cut the unpeeled cucumbers into slices 1/16-inch thick. Combine vegetables in a large jar or bowl and sprinkle with salt and celery seed. Stir gently and let stand for about 1 hour.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: In a shaker mix Ranch Style mixture. Sit in refrigerator. In a large bowl mix remaining ingredients together. Add salad dressing and mix.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat in skillet with butter. Season. When meat is brown; add flour and stir. Mix in onion. Add canned mushrooms with liquid and water. Stir. Bring to boil cover lower heat and simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Check every so often to see when meat is ready. Keep stirring lightly so it will not burn. If liquid evaporates add a little hot water. Sour cream may be added lastly if desired.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus save liquid. Grate cheese and mix it with cracker crumbs. Mix liquid from asparagus tips with cream of mushroom soup. Put a thin layer of cracker and cheese mixture in bottom of greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole. Add a layer of asparagus tips sprinkle with nuts. Continue 2 layers; top with remaining cheese and cracker mixture. Pour soup over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Banana Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel bananas and cut them lengthwise. In a small bowl combine orange juice and sugar. Pour over bananas. In second bowl mix bread crumbs nutmeg and cinnamon. Sprinkle over bananas. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Banana Pecan Cloud Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together butter and sugar until very light and creamy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Sift together dry ingredients. Combine mashed bananas and milk. Add sifted ingredients in thirds alternating with thirds of banana mixture. Beat well after each addition until smooth. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch round pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake according to directions on box.

title: Zesty Grilled Ham
instructions: In a small saucepan bring brown sugar horseradish and lemon juice to a boil. Brush over both sides of the ham. Grill over medium-hot coals turning once until heated through.

title: Janet'S Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together thoroughly. Make early in the day. Refrigerate for a couple of hours to enhance the flavor.

title: Frosted Date Balls(Serves 30)
instructions: Cream butter sugar salt milk and vanilla. Stir in flour; add dates and nuts. Roll in small balls. Bake about 20 minutes or until brown at 375\u00b0. While still warm roll in powdered sugar and then roll in powdered sugar again.

title: Haskell'S Cranberry Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Pour into two baked pie crusts. Freeze. Remove from freezer a few minutes before serving.

title: Rhubarb Torte
instructions: Combine flour brown sugar oatmeal and melted butter. Mix then put 1/2 of mixture in 8 x 8-inch pan. Put cut up rhubarb on top then boil sugar and water and cornstarch. Pour over rhubarb; sprinkle the last half mixture of crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Quick Method Croissants
instructions: In a bowl soften yeast in warm water. Add evaporated milk salt sugar egg and 1 cup of flour. Beat to make a smooth batter. Blend in the 1/4 cup melted butter and set aside. In another bowl cut the 3 sticks firm cold butter into remaining 4 cups of flour until butter particles are the size of almonds. Pour yeast batter over flour-butter mixture and carefully turn the mixture over with a rubber spatula to blend just until all flour is moistened. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to 4 days.

title: Cinnamon-Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup sugar brown sugar cinnamon and walnuts for topping. Sift flour soda and baking powder together. Combine butter remaining sugar and eggs in mixing bowl; beat until light and fluffy. Stir in sour cream. Add flour mixture and vanilla; mix well. Spoon half the batter into greased and floured pan; sprinkle with remaining topping. Press topping lightly into batter with back of spoon. Place pan in cold oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 55 minutes. Large recipe is for a cake pan small recipe is for Bundt pan.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon or salt pork in a deep kettle until golden brown. Add onions celery and potatoes and cook stirring frequently until potatoes are soft. Add minced clams evaporated milk and clam nectar. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Garnish with parsley and a pat of butter. If a thicker chowder is desired add 2 tablespoons cornstarch to 1/4 cup cold water and add to chowder before heating thoroughly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter sugars vanilla and pudding mix in large mixing bowl; beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by rounded measuring teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine soups milk salt and pepper. In 2-quart baking dish arrange alternate layers of potatoes onion and soup mixture. Put margarine on top. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with cheese. Combine wine and soup thoroughly. Spoon sauce over chicken. Mix stuffing crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar butter salt and evaporated milk for 6 minutes. Put remaining ingredients in bowl. Pour boiling syrup over ingredients in bowl. Beat until chocolate is all melted. Pour in pan. Let stand a few hours before cutting. Store in tin box. Very good!

title: Cream Of Crab Soup
instructions: Remove cartilage from crabmeat. Melt butter in a 3-quart pan. Blend in flour and stir until smooth. Slowly stir in chicken broth and pepper. Simmer for 2 minutes. Add milk and cook slowly stirring constantly until thickened. Do not boil. Add crabmeat to milk mixture and salt to taste. Yields approximately 10 cups.

title: Sausage-Cheese Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Remove sausage skin and fry meat. Drain off fat. Add Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces. Cut Velveeta cheese into small cubes and melt in with sausage mixture. Spread on slices of party rye bread and place on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until browned. These can be made the day before and stored in the refrigerator until ready to be baked.

title: Italian Spaghetti
instructions: Simmer meat tomatoes and seasonings 2 hours. Add spaghetti which has been cooked. Let simmer for 1/2 hour and serve with grated cheese.

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: In a large glass measuring cup combine semi-sweet chocolate morsels and sweetened condensed milk. Microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir until morsels melt and mixture is smooth. Stir in walnuts and vanilla. Spread evenly into foil-lined 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm (about 2 hours).

title: Tamale Casserole
instructions: In a 9 x 12-inch pan start with tamales green chilies chicken a la king onion and Pet milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Can be topped with grated cheese last 15 minutes. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In skillet (large) cook and stir meat onion and green pepper until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain off fat. Stir in tomatoes rice salt chili powder and pepper. Heat through. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake 1 hour.

title: Joyce'S Favorite Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine flour baking soda and salt in small bowl. Beat brown sugar butter and sugar in large bowl until creamy. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats chocolate chip and nuts. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 9-10 minutes.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt bars and 1/2 cup butter over low heat. Beat remaining butter and the sugar in medium size bowl until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add flour and soda alternately with buttermilk. Stir until smooth. Add melted candy mixing well. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Bake in 9-inch Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and dry pudding mix; stir well. Add undrained pineapple marshmallows and nuts. Mix thoroughly. Pour into a serving dish and place in refrigerator for 2 hours.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Combine cucumbers onions peppers and garlic. Add salt. Cover with cracked ice and let stand for 3 hours. Drain well. Combine sugar vinegar and spices. Bring to a boil. Add cucumbers peppers and onions. Bring back to a boil. Put in jars and seal. Makes 8 pints.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Chicken And Rice Soup
instructions: Heat butter. When hot add celery. Cover and cook 5 minutes over medium heat. Pour chicken stock and add savory. Season well. Mix and bring to a boil. Add rice and stir; cook partly covered 10 minutes over medium heat.

title: Beef Barley Soup
instructions: Trim fat from meat. In a Dutch oven combine meat water celery mushrooms carrots onion salt rosemary pepper and garlic. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. (If necessary skim fat.) Stir in tomato paste and barley. Return to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until barley is done. Contains 6 g fat and 51 mg cholesterol.

title: Fruit Salad Supreme
instructions: Place all ingredients in 2-quart bowl; toss together very lightly. Cover. Refrigerate until serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Swedish Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix thoroughly shortening butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Blend in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Yields 7 dozen.

title: Cinnamon Potato Rolls
instructions: Combine in large bowl sugar and potatoes; add water and yeast to mixture. Cover and let set for 1 hour in warm place. Combine filling ingredients and set aside. Stir dough down. Mix in butter eggs and salt. Gradually add flour. Turn out on floured surface; knead until smooth. Divide dough in half; roll out in squares. Divide filling and spread on each half of dough. Roll; cut in slices. Place in 9-inch pan. Cover and raise until double in volume. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Yield 18.

title: Hamburger Dipft. Morgan, Colorado
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and sprinkle flour into it. Add rest of ingredients. Simmer the longer the better. Serve with tortilla chips. This is Dick Norris favorite.

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Whip Dream Whip and milk (put in freezer in bowl for approximately 15 minutes). Fold in powdered sugar drained pineapple and chopped pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain sausage and spread into a square glass baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over sausage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Pineapple Slush
instructions: Freeze the first 5 ingredients. Mix occasionally to maintain the slush condition the whiskey prevents the hard freeze state. Use spoon as scrape to transfer the \slush\ to glasses; ratio of 2/3 slush to 1/3 7-Up.

title: Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Whisk together dressing mix with dill pepper and oil. Pour over crackers; stir to coat. Spread in one layer on baking sheet and bake at 250\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir gently halfway through baking.

title: Ugly Cake
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients; dough will be very stiff. Spread in 9 x 13 greased and floured pan; spread the pecans over the dough. Beat together last 3 ingredients and spread over uncooked cake. Bake in 275\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Peanut Butter Sheet Cake
instructions: Boil oil oleo water and peanut butter for 1 minute. Add flour sugar soda and salt. Stir in buttermilk vanilla and eggs. Pour in greased sheet cake pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Make icing while cake bakes.

title: Steak And Gravy
instructions: Flour and brown steak; drain on paper towel. Put in crock-pot. Pour gravy plus 2 cans of hot water over steak. Cook on low all day or overnight.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel core and slice apples into a baking dish. Sift together flour and sugar and sprinkle over apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Drizzle butter over top. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. May add raisins or nuts.

title: Hot Chocolate (Or Cocoa)
instructions: Blend cocoa sugar and salt. Make a syrup by using 2 tablespoons water. Add syrup to milk and heat to just below boiling point. Serve hot with marshmallow or whipped cream.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain and chop artichokes. Combine artichokes with mayonnaise cheese and Tabasco sauce. Spread in 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour to brown. Broil a few minutes if desired after the 1/2 hour.

title: Cheese Sprouts And Apples
instructions: Boil Brussels sprouts 10 minutes. Drain. Reduce whipping cream in 8-inch skillet. Stir in Cheddar cheese nutmeg and cinnamon. Mix Brussels sprouts peeled cored and sliced apples and cream sauce. Pour into casserole or baking dish and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Toss lettuce tomato onion beans and cheese. Add dressing and top with chips just prior to serving.

title: Dip
instructions: Place peas in colander; rinse with water and drain. Combine tomatoes and next 5 ingredients in bowl. Stir in peas. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Serve with chips.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Beat margarine confectioners sugar and cream cheese together. In another bowl mix Cool Whip vanilla pudding and milk. Combine all together. Crush a small package of Oreo cookies. Put some in mixture and sprinkle the rest on the top. Gummy worms can be added to the mixture!

title: Crumb Apple Pie
instructions: Slice some apples into a rather deep pie tin as for an ordinary pie but have no bottom crust. Lets say a 9-inch pan. Sprinkle over them sugar to which you have added nutmeg cinnamon and a little salt to taste. Add about 4 tablespoons of water and dot with small pieces of butter.

title: Tangy Orange Vinaigrette Dressing
instructions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl. Add first 5 ingredients and pulse 2 or 3 times or until well blended. With processor running pour oil through chute in a slow steady stream; process until blended.

title: Broccoli Wild Rice Soup
instructions: In a saucepan mix rice contents of seasoning packet and water. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes stirring once. Stir in broccoli carrot and onion flakes. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in soup and cream cheese. Cook stirring occasionally until thickened. Makes 10 cups.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in pan starting with the lettuce.

title: Easy Zucchini Omelet(Frittata Di Zucchine)
instructions: Beat eggs parsley and Parmesan cheese together in small bowl; set aside. In 8-inch skillet heat oil on medium heat and saute garlic zucchini and onion until very tender but not browned about 5 to 7 minutes. When tender pour egg mixture over zucchini. Cook until eggs are set throughout the omelet. Lift edge with egg turner so that uncooked portion can flow to the bottom. Slide omelet onto large flat platter and turn omelet over in skillet to complete cooking. Cook until lightly golden on bottom and slip onto serving dish.

title: Moque Choux
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in oil until tender. Cut kernels from corn cobs and scrape with knife to get the corn \milk.\ Add all remaining ingredients; cook slowly for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Tea Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl mix flour baking soda powder and salt; set aside.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Cook whole zucchini in boiling salted water about 10 minutes or until tender; drain. Cut in half lengthwise. For zucchini curl cut a thin horizontal slice from top of each zucchini half cutting to but not through each end; roll up. Scoop out centers leaving a 1/4-inch shell. Chop center portion and set aside. Melt butter in a large skillet; saute mushrooms about 3 minutes or until tender. Stir in flour and oregano; remove from heat. Stir in Monterey Jack cheese and pimento; stir in the reserved chopped zucchini approximately 1/4 filling for each. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Broil several inches from heat 3 to 5 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Chip Melt In Your Mouth Cookies
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients together until light. Add next 7 ingredients. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening peanut butter and sugars. Add egg. Sift all dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Chill dough. Roll in little balls and press with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach; squeeze out all liquid and drain water chestnuts. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate until next day. Serve with crackers.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Mix pumpkin and water; add alternately to mixture with sifted dry ingredients. Mix gently. Stir in raisins and nuts. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes about 30 muffins.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix all together; roll into small balls and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Low-Cholesterol Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine in a large bowl; gradually add 2 cups sugar beating at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and fluffy (about 5 minutes). Add egg substitute 1/4 cup at a time beating well after each addition.

title: 5 Hour Oven Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; mix gently but well. Turn into a 3-quart casserole. Cover. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Beefy Macaroni Skillet
instructions: In skillet over medium-high heat cook beef and onion until beef is browned and onion is tender stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup water Worcestershire sauce and cheese; add macaroni. Reduce heat to low. Heat through stirring occasionally. Top with additional cheese if desired. Fast and easy.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Melt margarine. Blend in cracker crumbs and sugar. Line bottom of 1 (9 x 13 x 2-inch) pan. Let cool for about 1 hour. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar. Spread on top of crust. Top with chopped pecans. Top with Cool Whip. Spread the cherry pie filling. Chill about 4 to 5 hours before serving.

title: Party Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars shortening eggs and vanilla. Add flour; mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup M&Ms. Keep remaining to decorate. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Decorate as desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

title: German Pork And Bean Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except wieners in a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 25 minutes. Place wieners on top of bean mixture and bake an additional 20 minutes.

title: Lemon Supreme Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix sugar oil and nectar together. Then add 1 egg at a time. Bake in tube pan at 325 for 1 hour. Glaze with 1 cup of powdered sugar and juice of 1 lemon while still warm.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and celery in margarine. Add cooked rice soup chicken milk cheese McKays seasoning and broccoli. Put in a 9 x 13-inch glass casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes uncovered. Serves 12 or more.

title: Crab English Muffins
instructions: Mix together and spread on English muffins. Broil until lightly brown. Freezes good!

title: Tulsa Eggs
instructions: Cut pork steak into 1/2-inch cubes. Heat oil in a large skillet; saute pork over medium heat about 1 minute. Add potatoes onion garlic and green pepper. Cook 3 to 4 minutes. Add tomatoes bouillon cumin red pepper black pepper and salt; stir well. Cover and cook over low heat 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender stirring occasionally. Make four indentations in cooked mixture with a knife; break an egg into each indentation. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle Cheddar cheese over mixture. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Heat tortillas according to package directions. Spoon egg mixture over hot tortillas. Garnish each serving with parsley. Serve with sliced tomatoes if desired. Yield 4 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and sprinkle pudding mix over this. Add coconut cherries Cool Whip and nuts if desired. Mix altogether cover and chill. Will keep several days.

title: Popeye Dip
instructions: In large bowl of food processor combine all ingredients until well blended. Makes 3 1/2 cups.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Heat 7-Up; pour over Jell-O. Mix cream cheese with hot water until smooth. Add cheese and remaining ingredients together. Chill.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Add boiling water to jello. Let cool. Add mayonnaise and stir well. Fold in last 5 ingredients. Chill.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Cook bacon. Brown rice in bacon fat. Add the rest and cook slow until rice is done. Crumble bacon and add.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Heat crushed pineapple to boiling. Stir in jello; add cottage cheese and cool-whip mandarin and marshmallows and chill.

title: Strawberry Sherbet(Homemade Ice Cream)
instructions: Mix strawberries Eagle Brand and soda pop. Freeze.

title: Homemade Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut shortening into flour until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in just enough milk so dough leaves side of bowl and round up into ball. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 10 times. Roll 1/2 inch thick. Cut with floured 2 inch biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 1 inch apart for crusty side touching for soft sides. Bake until golden brown; about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: In a bowl combine egg and 1/4 cup soup. Stir in uncooked rice onion 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Add beef and mix well. Shape meat mixture into small balls. Place in a 10-inch skillet or Dutch oven.

title: Zucchini Latkes
instructions: Mix together zucchini onion and carrot. Mix in eggs 1/2 cup flour hot pepper paste salt and pepper. Add milk if too stiff or flour if too soupy. Fry in oil. Press spoonfuls down to flatten. Fry until golden brown turning once. Serve immediately with your choice of applesauce sour cream jam etc.

title: Oven-Fried Vegetables
instructions: Spray cold baking sheet with Pam. In a 9-inch pie plate stir together the bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and paprika until mixed. Place vegetables in medium bowl and drizzle with salad dressing. Toss until coated. Roll vegetables in crumb mixture. Place in single layer on baking sheet and bake at 450\u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Cheese Fondue
instructions: Mix ingredients together; warm in fondue pot. Great served with chunks of Italian bread.

title: Yellow Squash Pickles
instructions: Cover squash\tonions and peppers with water;\tadd 1/2 cup of salt. Soak for 1 hour and drain. Mix sugar vinegar mustard seed celery seed and turmeric. Bring to a boil. Add squash onions and peppers. Boil for 5 minutes. Seal in jars.

title: Strawberry Pizza(8 Servings)
instructions: Grease a large pizza pan. Spread cookie dough over pan. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Blend together the softened cream cheese confectioners sugar and vanilla. Add Cool Whip; mix until smooth. Do not beat. Spread mixture over cooled cookie crust.

title: Sauerkraut And Noodles
instructions: Fry bacon and drain; set aside. Rinse sauerkraut then brown in bacon grease. Cook noodles in chicken broth. Layer in buttered casserole starting with noodles the sauerkraut and top with bacon. Can be made ahead. Heat thoroughly before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a baking dish.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Combine last 7 ingredients. Boil mixture and pour over cabbage. Set to cool. Freeze. Makes about 5 quarts.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes and onion in baking dish. Add butter milk salt and pepper. Top with pork chops salt and pepper. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chops are tender. Mushroom soup may be added.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Cut strips of meat approximately 1/4 inch wide from round or loin. Place strips of meat strip by strip into glass baking dish to form a layer of meat. Brush on a mixture of liquid smoke and hot sauce. Sprinkle layer of meat with seasoning mixture. Add another layer of meat and repeat steps 2 and 3. Cover dish and refrigerate overnight. Using crumbled aluminum foil line oven racks and place meat strip by strip on the foil. Turn the oven no higher than 150\u00b0 and leave meat in for about 8 to 10 hours. This will look very dried out when it is ready.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: In a large size pot melt the Velveeta cheese and evaporated milk on low heat. Pour into a crock-pot. Add all of the celery soup drained mixed veggies and beans. Take a whisk and mix the soup into it good. Turn on and cook several hours. So easy and so good on a cold day.

title: Strawberry Sparkle Punch
instructions: Put berries in blender container at low speed until pureed. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Stir in lemonade concentrate until melted. Add cold water cranberry juice and strawberry puree. Pour over ice in large punch bowl. Immediately before serving pour in chilled ginger ale and stir.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Heat together soup cheese and milk. Layer noodles corned beef and green peppers. Pour hot mixture over top. Cracker crumbs may be used on top of casserole if desired. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Spray skillet with cooking spray. Saute zucchini and onion until tender; stir in parsley salt garlic powder basil and oregano. Mix well; combine eggs and cheese with sauteed mixture stirring well. Pour mixture into unbaked crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until set.

title: The World'S Best Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream 1 cup butter and sugars until light and fluffy. Add egg and oil mixing well. Add oats corn flakes coconut and nuts stirring well then add flour soda and salt. Mix well and form into balls the size of walnuts.

title: Curry Puffs
instructions: Saute beef onion and garlic in butter. Add curry powder water and salt. Simmer for about 30 minutes. Roll out and cut pastry to desired size (2 to 3-inches in diameter).

title: Monterey Jack Bread
instructions: Slice French bread. Melt 1 stick of margarine and pour over bread. Sprinkle lightly with seasoned salt. Mix mayonnaise and Jack cheese. Spread mixture over bread. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Melt cheese in double boiler. Mix all ingredients together; spread on rye bread slices.

title: Baked Pineapple For Baked Ham
instructions: Put in greased dish and cook 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Prepare yeast roll mix as directed on package. While dough is rising combine 3/4 cup brown sugar 1/2 cup butter and water. Mix until blended. Pour mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle pecans over syrup.

title: Couscous Salad
instructions: Bring water to boil. Stir in salt and add couscous. Remove pan from heat and cover. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer couscous to a large bowl and break up any clumps. Toss couscous with remaining ingredients. Add couscous dressing and mix well.

title: Chipped Ham Barbecue
instructions: Heat chipped ham thoroughly in skillet with 1 tablespoon margarine. Mix sugar vinegar water mustard and catsup in a saucepan and heat. Pour sauce over chipped ham and mix thoroughly. Allow to simmer for 5 minutes. Serve on plain or toasted buns.

title: Simple Salisbury Steak
instructions: In a bowl mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup beef bread crumbs egg onion and salt. Shape firmly into 6 patties. In skillet over medium heat cook patties until brown on both sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 20 minutes or until done. Put soup and mushrooms on top of patties occasionally.

title: Shrimp Angel Hair
instructions: Saute minced bell pepper onion and garlic in butter. Add flour and\tcook about 2 minutes.\tStir in shrimp mushrooms milk and sherry.\tCook over low heat until shrimp is cooked and sauce is thick. Season with cayenne pepper salt and pepper to taste. Serve over angel hair pasta. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Croissants
instructions: Pull apart fully cooked chicken breasts. Melt butter and set aside. Combine chicken and cream cheese. Add desired amount of melted butter to get desired consistency (should be creamy). Put one large spoonful of the chicken and cream cheese in center of croissant roll. Fold in all edges of croissant roll and bake as directed on croissant roll package.

title: Uncle Jackie'S Brownies
instructions: In large mixing bowl soften butter. Add sugar vanilla and eggs. Mix. Add cocoa mix then add flour and salt. Grease and flour 15 x 10 x 1 pan. Pour batter into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Frost with frosting of your choice.

title: Apple Pecan Crumb-Top Pie
instructions: In a bowl mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell.

title: Peas And Rice
instructions: In frying pan render bacon until soft. Add onion and garlic until soft. Add uncooked rice and pigeon peas. Stir until completely blended. Put in pot and cover with 3 cups of water. Bring water to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Roasted Potato Wedges
instructions: Scrub potatoes cut each lengthwise into 6 wedges. Place in a bowl and cover with cold water. Let stand 30 minutes and drain. Pat wedges dry with paper towel. Toss wedges with olive oil. Place skin side down on a baking sheet coated with vegetable cooking spray. Combine salt dried rosemary and pepper. Sprinkle mixture evenly over wedges. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until tender and brown. Yields 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Crunch
instructions: Drain pineapple; save juice. Place pineapple in baking dish. Mix juice flour sugar and margarine. Cook until thick. Pour over pineapple. Mix crackers and margarine and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: California Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle soup mix on bottom of a 17 x 13 x 2-inch buttered pan. Spread rice evenly on bottom of pan. Lay chicken on top of rice. Dilute soup with water and pour over chicken. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ebony And Ivory Bean Soup
instructions: Combine beans tomatoes potatoes and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and stir in cumin butter salt and black pepper. Cook stirring occasionally for about 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add more water if needed. Serve with a sprinkling of grated cheese over top if desired.

title: Low Fat Chili
instructions: Brown beef and onion in nonstick pan. Drain off fat. Combine all ingredients and simmer until thickened about 1/2 hour. Makes 6 servings at 150 per serving.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown rice green pepper and onions in bacon drippings. Remove from heat. Set aside to cool a bit. Add all remaining ingredients. Pour in water or broth stirring slowly. Bring to a boil. Lower heat immediately; cover leaving lid open a tiny bit. Cook 15-20 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs and molasses. Sift dry ingredients and blend.\tBatter is stiff. Chill dough 1 hour. Roll into walnut size balls and then roll in bowl of sugar. Bake 8 minutes at 375\u00b0.\tMakes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add cream then flour sifted with baking powder and salt. Mix well. Add vanilla. Chill 20 minutes. Roll very thin. Cut and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Add dry jello to cottage cheese. Add drained fruit and mix well. Add Cool Whip and nuts. Chill then serve. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cherry Cha Cha Pie
instructions: Mix crushed crackers and melted butter together and pat in pie dish. Whip the cream; add sugar. Or use Dream Whip according to directions. To the whipped cream or Dream Whip add miniature marshmallows. Pour into pie shell. Over the cream and marshmallow filling pour cherry pie filling. Chill at least 1 1/2 hours.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Prepare pudding mix with milk as directed on package for pudding. Cover with waxed paper and cool to room temperature. Fold in 1 cup of the whipped topping. Cut cake into cubes. Place in a serving bowl and sprinkle with orange juice. Spoon strawberries over cake cubes. Spoon on pudding covering cake completely. Chill for 2 hours. Top with remaining whipped topping and strawberry halves.

title: Burger Bake
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Add all but last two ingredients and warm completely. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with shredded cheese. Pinch up into 1/4 pieces canned biscuits and place on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bread is done.

title: Norwegian Apple Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Add apples and nuts; mix well again. Divide into 2 greased 9-inch pie plates. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Open Face Lemon Pie
instructions: Melt margarine and stir in sugar and flour. Add juice grated rind and eggs. Pour into 9 inch pie crust. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: Mix dressing cranberry sauce and onion soup together. Place chicken breasts in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour dressing mixture over chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Drain green beans peas and pimentos and place in medium mixing bowl. Chop bell pepper celery and onions and combine with vegetables. Combine sugar vinegar oil and salt in small saucepan; heat and pour over vegetables. Cover and let stand 24 hours to marinate. Drain and serve.

title: Easy Lasagna(Yields 6 Servings)
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water while preparing remainder.

title: Heart-To-Heart Egg Dish
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Layer broccoli chicken onion and cheese in ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with sliced eggs. Melt butter in saucepan on low heat. Blend in flour and seasonings. Stir until smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat and stir in milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Pour over eggs. Sprinkle croutons over sauce. Bake uncovered 20 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Prepare salad. Mix in taco chips and toss salad with salad dressing. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Turtle Brownies
instructions: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in top of double boiler on low heat and stir until mixture is melted.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour together with baking powder and salt. Cream shortening and add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add unbeaten eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each egg is added. Add vanilla. Add flour mixture. Beat vigorously until flour is completely blended. Put bowl of dough into refrigerator until quite cold usually about 2 hours. Divide dough in half. Roll out until dough is about 3/8-inch thick and cut with cookie cutter. Sprinkle top with sugar and bake in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Marinated Carrots(Copper Pennies)
instructions: Cook carrots until tender; drain. Mix remaining ingredients; let set 12 hours. Will keep 3 to 4 weeks. Keep refrigerated.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except crumbs and margarine) in bowl; pour in greased casserole dish and cover with crumbs. Drizzle butter on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: White Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar milk butter and syrup until it forms a soft ball. Cool slightly. Beat in vanilla and add nuts. Pour in greased pan.

title: Oreo Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Line bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan with crushed Oreo cookies; cover with 1/2 stick of melted margarine. Spread 1/2 gallon of softened ice cream over cookies; freeze. Melt syrup Eagle Brand milk and one stick of margarine. Bring to hard boil and boil for one minute. Let cool completely and spread over ice cream. Top with Cool Whip and nuts. Freeze.

title: Molded Beet Salad
instructions: Soften gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water. Add sweetener to boiling water to dissolve. Add softened gelatine to dissolve in boiling liquid. Add other ingredients. Let liquid get partly set before adding beets and cabbage. Use beet juice as part of the liquid.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Beat all this together. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Red, White And Blue Pie
instructions: Place 1/2 can of blueberry pie filling in bottom of each pie shell. In medium bowl combine cream cheese and sugar. Mix until smooth. Stir in Cool Whip; mix well. Place 1/4 of mixture on blueberry pie filling in each pie. Top with remaining blueberry pie filing then remaining cheese mixture. Top each pie with 1/2 can cherry pie filling. Place in freezer for 6 hours. Thaw for 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Brown Rice With Mushrooms
instructions: Follow directions on box to cook rice. Saute butter and mushrooms until golden in small frypan. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a buttered casserole dish. Cook in oven for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Put in 2 loaf bread pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Heavenly Fudgies
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan slowly melt 2/3 of the chocolate chips. Add the unsweetened chocolate and butter stirring until melted. Add eggs sugar flour vanilla and baking powder. Remove from heat and mix thoroughly. Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Surface of cookies should be dull and cracked with soft but firm edges.

title: Coney Island Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Put hamburger onions garlic and green pepper in a large pan. Cover with water. Simmer until vegetables are soft. Drain. (Save broth as a base for soup.) Add catsup and chili powder. Simmer slowly uncovered about 2 1/2 hours. Serve over hot dogs. Sprinkle with grated cheese. This sauce can be frozen.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine and bake until golden on top at 350\u00b0 approximately 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Mix spinach rice and butter together under low heat then add the cheese. Mix well. Put in casserole bowl. Heat in microwave when ready to eat.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and fold in the 3 cups zucchini. Put into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients and fill remaining portion of ice cream can with milk.

title: Spicy Shrimp Curry
instructions: *Available at Apsara-Oriental Gourmet Market in Herndon.

title: New Orleans Bars
instructions: Cream butter egg yolk and sugar. Add cinnamon to flour; add to creamed mixture beating well. Press half of dough on 15 x 11-inch cookie sheet as thin as possible. Brush with unbeaten egg white; sprinkle with pecans. Repeat with remaining dough. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cut in squares while hot.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Candies
instructions: Microwave chocolate and peanut butter on Medium (#5) until melted. Add the Rice Krispies and peanuts. When cool add 2 cups marshmallows. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake brownies according to package directions. Cool. Punch holes in brownies with fork. Pour Kahlua over brownies and set aside. Make Jell-O chocolate mousse according to direction on package. Break candy bars into small pieces. Crumble half of brownies and place in bottom of a deep glass bowl. Cover with half of the mousse. Layer with half the candy and then add half of the whipped topping. Repeat layers. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Baked Stuffed Quahogs
instructions: Saute onions. Add clams and a little of the reserved liquor. Cook about 5 minutes. Add bread crumbs. If too dry add a little more of the liquor. Add spices and fill greased clam shells. Blend melted butter and 1/2 cup bread crumbs and sprinkle on top. Garnish with paprika and bake 15 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven or until browned. Makes 10 single shells.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: First Beat on high speed for 2 minutes the pudding and milk. Then add Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Mix well. Layer with bananas and vanilla wafers. Keep refrigerated.

title: Cherry Pineapple Crunch
instructions: Use 9 x 13-inch pan. Drain pineapple and spread over bottom of the pan. Sprinkle brown sugar over pineapple. Spread cherry pie filling on top of pineapple and brown sugar as the next layer. Spread coconut over pie filling. Pour the dry box of cake mix over the coconut (do not mix the cake mix; use dry). Melt the butter and pour over the cake mix.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Jello Cheesecake(Lo-Cal)
instructions: Prepare crust. Mix Jell-O and water; let cool. Blend cottage cheese and cream cheese well in blender. Add cool Jell-O; blend well. Add canned milk. Blend at high speed. Add vanilla and lemon juice. Beat on high for several minutes. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch glass dish and refrigerate. A graham cracker crust may be used for all flavors and garnish with fresh fruit.

title: Beef Broccoli Oriental
instructions: Slice beef thinly across grain. Add baking soda and water; let stand for several hours or overnight. Combine soy sauce and next 5 ingredients; mix well and set aside. Heat a heavy pan or wok. Add oil and stir-fry meat until pink color leaves. Remove from wok. Add broccoli and green onions to the wok. Toss for a few minutes then return the meat to the wok. Add sauce to the meat and stir until thickened. Serve at once. Serve with hot steamed rice or Toasted Noodle Cakes.

title: Zesty Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook rotini according to package directions. Drain water and rinse with cold water. Put rotini in a medium bowl and mix all ingredients together. Add salt and pepper to taste. Chill 30 minutes and serve.

title: Pumpkin Dip
instructions: Cream the sugar and cream cheese. Add in the pumpkin and spices. Fold in the Cool Whip. Great for dipping ginger cookies!

title: Nana Falcone'S Carrot Muffins
instructions: In a food processor fitted with metal blade combine prunes hot water eggs egg whites canola oil and vanilla. Puree until smooth. Strain. Stir in brown sugar; set aside in large bowl. In another large bowl combine flour cinnamon nutmeg baking powder and salt. Add dry mixture to batter mixing just until smooth. Stir in carrots pineapple and raisins. Pour batter into muffin pan using paper liner cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown about 30 minutes. Makes 16 muffins.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Drain crabmeat and combine with all the other ingredients. Place in covered casserole and bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Serve with your favorite cracker for dipping. Have a very decadent sandwich.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
instructions: Line muffin tins with foil liners. Place one vanilla wafer in each liner. Mix the cream cheese vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs; mix well. Pour over wafers filling 3/4 full. Bake for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from pan when cool. Chill. Top with fruit preserves nuts or chocolate.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Brown onion in oil; add all other ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes. Prepare chicken or chops by salting and lightly flouring and place in greased pan. Pour sauce over meat and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a large boiler mix together sugar margarine Carnation milk and salt on medium-high heat. Bring to a rolling boil stirring constantly (scorches easily). Cook to soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Then stir in Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter. Stir well until blended and pour into buttered pan or pans. Makes about 5 pounds.

title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook onion until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Place cut up chicken in large bowl add 1 tablespoon curry powder garlic salt pepper and turmeric.\tMix well and let sit overnight in refrigerator or for 2 hours minimum.\tIn heavy pot add oil making sure that the sides of the pot is coated. When oil is hot add\tthe remaining 2 tablespoons curry powder and the ground cumin.\tCook over high heat for 1 minute stirring constantly. Add chicken stirring to prevent sticking to the pot. When\tchicken is slightly brown add onion and optional vegetables. Add 1 to 3\ttablespoons of water if necessary. Cook gently until chicken is tender. Serve over rice.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Defrost the hash browns completely. Add all ingredients together and mix well. Put in a 9 x 13 casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Trailside Treats
instructions: Stir together flour soda and salt. Set aside. In a large bowl beat margarine peanut butter and sugars until creamy. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture then oats chocolate pieces and raisins. Drop by tablespoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Bisquick Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in an 8 or 9-inch square pan. Mix sugar Bisquick and milk. Pour into pan. Cut up fruit. Use all but 3 or 4 tablespoons of the juice. Pour fruit and juice into the center of the batter. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Fondue
instructions: Put all ingredients in a 1-quart microwave-safe bowl. Cover and cook on High for 2 1/2 minutes. Stir until blended. Serve with fresh fruit or angel food cake.

title: Ham And Vegetable Pasta Soup
instructions: Saute onion in 2 tablespoons oil. Add ham bone and water. Bring to a boil. Add other ingredients except pasta. Simmer for 2 hours then add pasta. Simmer 1/2 hour more.

title: Cranberry Relish Mold
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in square pan. Cool until set and top with cream cheese (add a bit of milk and whip).

title: Jello-Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix all together and press into a 9x13 pan. Bake 10 minutes on 325\u00b0. Cool.

title: Lima Bean Delicious
instructions: Soak beans overnight. The following morning cook beans until most of the water is gone. Pour into baking casserole dish and add all the ingredients except bacon. Put that on top. Bake for 2 hours or until beans are soft.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: To prepared zucchini add dry ingredients. Stir. Add lemon juice; stir. Add eggs; stir. Place in prepared pie shell. Crimp top crust. Brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar. Bake 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown in 400\u00b0 oven. Tastes just like apple pie.

title: Golden Meatball Casserole
instructions: Mix together egg bread crumbs salt and hamburg. Make into little balls. Fry in 2 tablespoons oil. Add carrots (cut in strips) rice and onion together with water. Steam. Keep enough water on so it stays moist. When carrots are soft add Velveeta cheese over it to melt.

title: Turkey Stir-Fry
instructions: In large skillet or wok stir-fry turkey in oil over medium-high heat until no longer pink approximately 5 to 6 minutes. Remove turkey and keep warm. Stir-fry onion carrot green pepper and mushrooms until crispy and tender. In small bowl combine chicken broth cornstarch soy sauce and ginger. Add to the skillet; cook and stir until heated through. If desired serve over rice.

title: Chicken Luncheon Casserole
instructions: Combine soup and mayonnaise in saucepan and warm slightly. Add sour cream (do not boil). Grease 9 x 13-inch casserole with pan spray or margarine and arrange layers evenly in casserole

title: Hershey'S Lickety Split Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa and salt. Add milk and vanilla. Blend until smooth by mixer or hand. Add butter and beat until spreading consistency. Makes about 2 cups frosting enough for an 8 or 9-inch layer cake.

title: Guatemalan Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 F. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Mix muffin mix flour and chili powder. Beat in egg and milk. Pat into pan with hands. Spread refried beans then chili aver the crust. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 15-20 minutes the cheese should be melted and the crust firm. Remove from heat and allow to cool 10 minutes. Cover with optional toppings if desired. Cut into squares. Makes 12 pieces.

title: Cheesy Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Steam eggplant slices just until tender. Saute onion garlic and mushrooms in oil until brown. Add tomato sauce and herbs scraping up drippings. Simmer for a few minutes. Mix cottage cheese and milk. In a greased baking dish layer cooked rice eggplant cottage cheese and sauce. Repeat ending with sauce. Top with Mozzarella. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes stirring often. Makes 1/2 cup sauce.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
instructions: Layer first 3 ingredients.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour in unbaked pie crusts. Sprinkle with nuts on top. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Makes 2 pies.

title: Aunt Mellie'S Cream Pie
instructions: Mix all together and put in pie shell. Put cinnamon on top of pie and bake 50 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Robert'S Easy Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil to soft ball stage sugar and milk. Remove quickly from heat. Add peanut butter vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased pan. Let cool and cut.

title: Opera Caramel Frosting
instructions: Cook sugar cream and butter until a little dropped in cold water forms a very soft ball. Cool. Add vanilla and beat until spreading consistency.

title: Plum Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients (sugar flour spices and salt) in a large mixing bowl. In a separate bowl mix eggs and oil with wire whisk until well blended. Add to dry ingredients and beat with electric mixer. Add plums and vanilla. Continue beating until well mixed. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or longer (test for doneness). Cool on wire rack.

title: Hanky Pankies
instructions: Brown sausage and ground beef and drain. Add spices and cheese until melted. Spread on rye bread and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Scald milk. Combine sugar and flour and add to beaten eggs. Beat well. Pour nuts into scalded milk; stir. Cook until thick. (Do not overcook.) Add vanilla and nutmeg when cool.

title: Brownies
instructions: Heat together the margarine and cocoa. Add sugar salt and eggs mixing well. Add flour sifted with baking powder and add vanilla and nuts. Pour into a well-greased square pan and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Its good to double this recipe using a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Easy Roast
instructions: Rub roast well with garlic salt and pepper. Sear roast on all sides in hot oil. Remove from pan. Drain off excess fat. Place roast in foil-lined pan. Pour Coke and catsup over roast. Cover roast loosely with foil. Bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Favorite Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine broccoli cauliflower bacon onions tomatoes and eggs. Set aside. In another bowl combine mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Mix until smooth. Thirty minutes before serving pour dressing over salad and toss.

title: Salsa
instructions: Place all ingredients except onions in blender. Blend for 2 seconds then add chopped onions and blend for an additional 1 second. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Tuna Chowder
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter for 5 minutes. Add diced potatoes water and salt. Heat to boiling; cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes. Blend flour with 1/4 cup milk then add 1 3/4 cups milk. Stir into potato mixture. Cook until thick. Add tuna; heat and serve.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add oil and mix. Add sugar and mix. Add grated zucchini and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour salt soda and baking powder; mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Baked Cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 2-quart casserole. Cook cabbage in boiling salted water 10 minutes. Drain let cool; chop fine. In mixing bowl blend eggs 3 tablespoons butter cream salt and pepper; stir in cabbage. Turn into casserole. Blend remaining butter with bread crumbs and sprinkle over cabbage. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together shortening sugars egg water and vanilla until creamy. Add combined remaining ingredients; mix well. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. For variety add chopped nuts raisins chocolate chips or coconut. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix the self-rising flour and sugar together in a medium bowl. Add the beer to this mixture; it will become very sticky. Pour this mixture into a greased 9 x 5 loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Serve with butter or melted cheese.

title: Tropical Sunset Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit well. Mix all together and chill.

title: Earth Bread
instructions: Mix the eggs oil vanilla and sugar; set aside. Sift all dry ingredients together. Add sifted ingredients to egg mixture. Mix well. Add zucchini carrots banana and nuts. Mix well. Bake in 2 greased and floured loaf pans at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rob'S Praline Cheesecake
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs sugar and butter. Press in bottom of a pie pan. Combine remaining ingredients and put in crust. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Peanut Balls
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients; chill mixture. Roll into small balls.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix pie filling and cinnamon. Reserve. Beat flour sugar milk soft margarine baking powder salt and eggs. Pour half of batter in pan. Spoon half of apple mixture over batter. Repeat with rest of batter and apples. Sprinkle on brown sugar and nuts. Drizzle with melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Drizzle with glaze topping after cool.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Combine margarine and brown sugar in heavy saucepan. Cook until bubbles appear on sides of pan. Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Cool 10 minutes then stir in cream vanilla and salt. Add powdered sugar a little at a time unti frosting is spreadable.

title: Debbie'S Fried Dill Pickles
instructions: Beat eggs with milk Lea & Perrins sauce Tabasco 1 tablespoon flour salt and pepper to taste. Mix 2 cups flour with salt and pepper in separate bowl. Dip pickles in the egg mixture and then into flour. Deep-fry until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Red And Green Tortellini Salad
