instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water cook tortellini until just tender 7 to 8 minutes. Drain well. Return pasta to pot. Stir in vinegar oil and all remaining ingredients. Mix well. Adjust seasoning to taste. Serve immediately on assorted lettuce leaves or refrigerate and serve chilled.

title: Fresh Peach Crisp
instructions: Place peach slices in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish. Set aside. Combine flour sugar brown sugar salt and cinnamon in a medium bowl stirring well. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle flour mixture evenly over peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients then add apples and pecans. Pour into baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions in salted water until tender; drain. Arrange stalks in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer chicken. Combine the next 3 ingredients; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter; sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until heated. Trim with pimento strips. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hamburger Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown hamburger and pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cut back heat for 30 minutes. Mix hamburger mixture with macaroni and cheese (mix as directed on box). Stir. Top off with 1 cup Cheddar cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Microwave 6 minutes on High or bake 30 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: Cream the oleo and sugar. Add vanilla eggs and melted chocolate; mix well. Pour into a cooled baked pie shell; chill. Top with whipped cream and nuts.

title: Cranberry Nut Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine 1 cup sugar the water and cranberries in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook for about 3 minutes until berries are popping. They will be soft but not mushy. Remove from heat and stir in the remaining 1/2 cup sugar and nuts. Melt butter in a 3-quart baking dish. Pour the cranberry filling into dish. Pour the batter for the crust over the cranberry filling. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Matrimonial Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first ten ingredients together well making sure everything is incorporated evenly. Put into a 9 inch x 13 inch baking dish and cover with the other can of tomato sauce and a little water. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat loaf is done. Let it rest and then cut into 3/4 inch slices.

title: Baked Oatmeal Snack
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with milk jam or honey.

title: Tasty Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ham and simmer. Add chipped ham. Place on bun and serve.

title: Rhubarb Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Put rhubarb in iron skillet. Add quartered marshmallows and 3/4 cup sugar. Sprinkle red hots. Cream butter and 1 cup sugar. Add eggs dry ingredients and milk. Pour over rhubarb. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Cream butter; slowly add sugar and beat until light and lemon colored. Beat in 2 eggs. Sift the flour salt baking soda and baking powder together. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk beginning and ending with the dry ingredients. Stir in the apples walnuts and the vanilla extract or lemon rind. Butter a 9 or 10 x 5 x 3-inch loaf tin. Spoon the batter into the tin and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven 50 to 60 minutes until the loaf pulls away slightly from the sides of the tin or until a cake tester comes out clean. Cool in the pan 5 minutes then cool completely on a rack before serving.

title: Party Punch(Club Member: Nicholas)
instructions: Mix pineapple juice ginger ale and apple cider well. Refrigerate several hours before serving. Serve over ice cubes. Serves about 30.

title: Nut Roll
instructions: Melt marshmallows and milk in double boiler. Mix remaining ingredients and add marshmallow mixture. Mix throughly. Shape into rolls. Place in wax paper and then wrap in foil. Store in refrigerator. Slice to serve.

title: Mother Turner'S Pickles
instructions: Mix and set in juice for 2 hours. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan cook onion in margarine until tender. Stir in flour and pepper until well blended. Add milk all at once. Cook until thickened stirring constantly about 1 minute. Add cheese and stir until melted. Remove from heat.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Boil shrimp in water about 10 minutes. Peel and clean. Heat oil in skillet. Add onion bell pepper celery and garlic. Simmer 5 minutes. Add tomatoes tomato paste thyme bay leaf parsley sugar salt and pepper. Stir to mix well and add shrimp. Simmer 1/2 hour and serve with cooked rice and French bread.

title: Turmeric Slaw
instructions: Bring vinegar sugar turmeric and mustard seed to a boil. Pour over chopped vegetables. Keeps indefinitely in refrigerator. To freeze double recipe if you want larger amount. Freeze in amount to use at one meal.

title: Cheesy Potato Patties
instructions: Beat together eggs flour salt and baking powder. Stir in potatoes and cheese. For each patty pour 1/2 cup batter onto hot well-greased skillet or griddle. Cook until golden brown on both sides. Garnish with spiced apples sour cream or applesauce if desired.

title: Pork Chops And Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice enough potatoes to cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan after it has been greased with margarine. Layer onion rings over top of potatoes salt and pepper to taste. Spoon and spread cream of mushroom from can over onions. In a skillet with a small amount of oil lightly brown pork chops and place over cream of mushroom soup. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes and pork chops are done.

title: Old-Fashioned Molasses Cake
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the shortening sugar and egg. Blend in molasses and sour milk. Sift together flour soda salt ginger and cinnamon and stir into mixture. Beat well. Oil bread pan. Pour in pan and bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and moisten with cold milk. Add egg yolks and vanilla. Stir mixture into hot milk; continue stirring until thick. Add crushed pineapple and pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue whipped topping or whipped cream.

title: Crusty Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco in a mixer bowl until light. Add sugar gradually until fluffy. Beat in cream cheese. Add flour alternately with eggs beginning and ending with flour mixing well after each addition. Stir in vanilla and lemon thyme. Spoon into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan onto a wire rack. Makes 16 servings.

title: Individual Cheesecakes
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and flour; beat well. Add eggs one at a\ttime. Then add vanilla and lemon juice. Place 36 cupcake liners in\tcupcake pan. Put 1 vanilla wafer in each liner. Spoon cheese mixture over wafers.\tBake at 300\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Bake until firm to touch in oven. Cool and refrigerate. Spoon topping on top and refrigerate again.\tPeel off paper before serving.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Butter cookie sheet. Layer graham crackers (split) in bottom of cookie sheet. Bring butter oleo and sugar to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Pour over graham crackers. Sprinkle with pecans over syrup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Spring Delight Cake
instructions: Mix and pour in a greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Spiced Pork And Beans
instructions: Cook under medium heat. Place margarine onion bell pepper celery catsup garlic honey oregano and Season-All all in saucepan. Saute until green season is cooked. Then pour in pork and beans stirring constantly so that ingredients will not stick. Continue until dish is ready to eat.

title: Dirt
instructions: You also need new 8-inch flowerpot silk flowers new garden shovel and gummi worms.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening in 3 or 4-quart saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and let cool. Add sugar molasses and egg. Beat well. Sift together flour soda and spices. Add to first mixture. Mix well; chill. Form in 1-inch balls; roll in granulated sugar and place on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown the meat onion and celery. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add this to the beans tomato juice chili powder sugar and more salt and pepper to taste. Cook about 1 hour over low heat. Mix flour with water as a thickening and add to soup stirring constantly until thick.

title: Zucchini With Bacon
instructions: Cook zucchini in salted water boiling about 8 minutes. Mix together next 3 ingredients and fold in egg white. Layer in greased casserole 1/2 of the zucchini egg mixture cheese and bacon. Repeat. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Serve with wheat crackers etc. or make well in unsliced bread. Makes great party dish. Use bread from well around bread as chips.

title: Broccoli Casserole #6
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix other ingredients together (except crumbs) and add to broccoli. Spray baking dish with Pam and pour into mixture.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and top with cracker crumbs (Ritz). Return to oven for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour well a 10-cup tube pan. Cream butter margarine and Crisco for about 4 minutes. Add sugar 1 cup at a time and cream about 4 minutes each. Add eggs 1 at a time just until yellow disappears. Add flour 1 cup at a time alternately with milk. Add vanilla and nutmeg. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 or until cake is done.

title: Meat Loaf Topped With Ketchup-And-Bacon
instructions: Stir together the ground beef breadcrumbs onion eggs salt pepper and Italian seasoning. Shape into 2 (8-inch) loaves or 1 (10-inch) loaf and place in a lightly greased casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put in greased dish 8 x 10-inch or 9 x 13-inch. Crush Ritz crackers and put on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until crackers are brown and bubbly.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar and Karo together. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Add peanuts. Mix and microwave on High 3 to 5 minutes. Add butter and vanilla; microwave on High 1 minute. Add soda. Stir and pour on greased cookie sheet. Cool 1/2 to 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Country Style Ribs
instructions: Put ribs bay leaf and beer into pressure cooker/canner and process at 10 pounds for 10 minutes. Remove ribs and cover with barbecue sauce and grill until browned.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
instructions: Saute bell pepper and onion with margarine in 12-inch electric skillet until tender but not brown. Cut chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and add to skillet along with rice water cayenne pepper poultry seasoning bay leaf bouillon cubes minced garlic and black pepper. Bring to a boil; stir making sure all rice grains are pressed into the liquid. Reduce heat cover and simmer stirring occasionally. Cook until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed about 20 more minutes. On low heat let jambalaya sit uncovered to dry a little before serving.

title: Overnight Goodies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add sugar continuing to beat until egg whites are very stiff. Fold in vanilla chocolate chips and walnuts. Make 24 to 36 mounds on wax paper lined cookie sheet. Place in oven and turn off heat. Dont peek until morning.

title: Pot Stickers(Gyozas)
instructions: Rinse chicken and chop finely or use ground pork. Place meat in a bowl and stir in sesame oil celery onion sherry cornstarch sugar and salt. Set out 6 to 8 wrappers at a time. Place 2 teaspoons of filling on each wrapper. To shape each pot sticker moisten edges with a little water. Fold dough in half over filling. Pinch together edges to seal. Set pot stickers down firmly seam side up so it will sit flat.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 2 inch slices. Combine butter sugar and water in an electric skillet. Add sweet potatoes. Cover and simmer at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done turning frequently. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl. Set aside. Cream shortening and brown sugar. Add molasses and water. Mix well. Add the dry ingredients one cup at a time. Cover and chill one hour. Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle flour on countertop. Divide the dough into four sections. Roll out each section to 1/2-inch thick. Cut out circles with the cookie cutter. Lift the cookies onto a cookie sheet with a spatula. Put cookies 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Remove cookies from cookie sheet to cool. Do not stack cookies or they will stick together.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chips. Pour into baking dish. Top with crushed chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Stuffed Bread
instructions: Cut off ends of bread. Hollow out. Set aside crumbs. In skillet cook beef sausage and onion for 15 minutes. Stir in grated cheese. Mix together egg mustard salt pepper and bread crumbs. Add enough water to moisten thoroughly. Combine crumb mixture and meat mixture thoroughly. Stuff loaves with mixture. Replace ends. Secure with toothpicks. Brush tops with garlic butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Sift together the flour and salt. Mix in the lard using your hands. Keep in an airtight container. Add water when ready to use. Recipe makes 4 crusts and can be doubled.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Place squash in bottom of 2 1/2 qt. baking dish. Layer beef cottage cheese (sprinkle oregano in cheese) and rice. Spread top with mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35-40 min. I add shredded cheese on top of casserole the last 5 min. or so just until it browns.

title: Chicken Almond Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crumbs. Spoon into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Bread
instructions: Mix water sugar salt and Crisco together. Add flour and beat until smooth. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water and add to dough mixture. Beat. Add more flour until mixture is thick. Pour out on floured surface and knead. Place in greased bowl. Let rise in warm place until double. Punch down and let rise again. Punch down and divide into half. Shape into 2 loaves. Let rise. Bake 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: A Whole Mess Of Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugars shortening eggs vanilla baking soda baking powder salt and milk. Beat until smooth and creamy. Mix in flour then oats. Optional ingredients are chocolate chips 3 teaspoons cinnamon raisins nuts or coconut. Drop teaspoons of dough onto cookie sheet and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Do not let cookies get too brown or they will be too dry. Makes 12 to 16 dozen.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust as directed. Put 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese or Mozzarella on hot crust. Peel and slice tomatoes and put overlapping in bottom of crust. Layer Mozzarella. Add pepper and basil. Repeat first layer. Mix together mayo 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella. Cover the tomatoes with mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 24 minutes. Let cool to almost room temperature before slicing. Will serve 6 ladies or 4 men (they like it too).

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: In a shallow bowl mix together the cornmeal flour and sugar. Dredge both sides of the tomatoes (sliced in 1/2-inch slices) in mixture. Press slices firmly into cornmeal mixture to make a good coating.

title: Irish Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients; add soft butter and mix until blended. Add raisins. Pour in buttermilk mixture and mix until blended. Bake in 8-inch Pyrex dish at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve as a warm dip. Can be used as filling for tortillas. Vary by adding olives onions and chilies.

title: Chocolate Sundae Cake
instructions: Mix these ingredients in separate bowl and pour on top of dough or unbaked cake. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. As the cake bakes the watery mixture will settle to the bottom. When serving dip cake onto plate and add sauce to top.

title: Schaum Torte
instructions: Beat 6 egg whites until frothy 1/8 tsp salt sprinkled over egg whites add 1/8 tsp cream of tartar. Beat until stiff. Add 2 c. sugar very slowly beating after each addition then 1/8 tsp vanilla and 1 tsp vinegar with last addition of sugar.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes (30 minutes). Peel and cut in small chunks. Set aside. Combine 1/4 cup melted butter onion pepper sour cream and soup. Gently stir in potatoes and cheese. Spoon into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Combine 3 tablespoons melted butter and corn flakes. Sprinkle over potato mixture and bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cheese and sour cream; spread. Layer rest of ingredients and sprinkle top with taco mix. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Party  Punch
instructions: Have all juices chilled. Combine pineapple and orange juices; melt powdered sugar in lemon juice and add. Add ginger all just before serving. Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Chicken And Cheese Enchiladas(Prep Time: 10 Minutes; Cooking Time: 10 Minutes)
instructions: The pan needed for this recipe is a large steamer with spout on bottom. Put 1/2-inch of water in bottom of steamer. Add carrots celery and leaves onion chicken potatoes and spices. Use 1/4 chicken per person. Serves 6.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In a large pot place potatoes celery onion and broth. Simmer for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Add margarine salt pepper and parsley. Add milk and soup. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting(A Must On Carrot Cake.)
instructions: Combine flour and 1/4 cup of milk in small saucepan. Blend together into smooth paste. Slowly add remaining milk and beat until smooth. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture becomes thick paste. Cover and cool in refrigerator. When cool scoop mixture into large bowl. Blend fruit sweetener Neufchatel and margarine into thickened mixture. Beat with electric mixer. Stir in vanilla. Spread on cake or cookies.

title: Easy Pizza
instructions: Brown hamburger (drain). Brown bread in oven until light brown. Take hamburger and mix sauce. Spread evenly on bread; top with layer of Cheddar cheese and Mozzarella cheese mixed. Bake at 250\u00b0 until melted.

title: Chicken Breast With Toasted Mustard Seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. In medium saucepan bring cream to boil. Reduce and cook over low stirring constantly until thickened and reduced to 1 1/4 cups (about 10 minutes). Remove from heat and whisk in mustard 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. (Cream mixture can be made 4 hours ahead. Whisk occasionally to prevent skin.)

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: In large bowl lay in bread bacon bits peppers onions and tomatoes. Combine mayonnaise pickle relish juice and sugar. Blend well and drizzle over salad. Toss lightly.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Cover oats with water. Let stand 20 minutes. Cream butter sugar and brown sugar together then add eggs and remaining ingredients. Bake until done at 350\u00b0. Ice while still warm.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar margarine and evaporated milk to a boil. Stir about 5 minutes over medium heat to softball stage (238\u00b0); remove from heat. Stir in chocolate pieces. Add the vanilla chopped nuts and marshmallow cream. Beat until well blended. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Flowerpot Desserts
instructions: Cream oleo cream cheese and powdered sugar together. In separate bowl mix pudding milk and Cool Whip. Combine both mixtures and mix well. Alternate layer of mix with crushed Oreo cookies in a flowerpot ending up with cookies on top. Chill 3 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Molasses Bar
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Garlic Chicken, Sun Dried Tomato Pasta
instructions: *Note\teach package of sauce requires 1 1/2 cups milk plus 1 Tbsp. butter or margarine.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon. Place in casserole dish. Place bacon over mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese Crisps
instructions: Soften butter. Hand mix with cheese. Add flour and cereal. Roll in marble-sized balls and press with fork. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cookie Jar Gingersnaps
instructions: Measure sifted flour ginger soda cinnamon and salt into sifter. Sift 2 or 3 times. Cream shortening in medium size bowl. Add sugar gradually creaming well. Beat in eggs and molasses. Add dry ingredients mixing well. Form teaspoons of dough into balls. Roll balls in sugar covering entire surface. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until tops are lightly browned. Remove from pans. Cool completely. Store in airtight container.

title: Homemade Ice Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sweet milk. Pour into gallon ice cream freezer container adding enough milk to fill line. Place into freezer and start cranking.

title: Donna'S Fabulous Guacamole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Squeeze the juice of 1/2 of fresh lemon into the mixture. Chill about 2 hours before serving.

title: Homemade Kahlua
instructions: Mix sugar and water in a large saucepan and heat until sugar is dissolved. Let cool. Add coffee vanilla and vodka to sugar mixture. Pour into bottles. Makes great gifts!

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Brown ground meat in skillet and season with salt and pepper. Drain off excess liquid. Mix all together. Makes a delicious salad.

title: Cheese Fritters
instructions: Heat milk just enough to dissolve Blue cheese. Mix dry ingredients then stir in milk mixture to blend. Add 4 eggs and blend. Stir in Cheddar cheese. Chill well (preferably overnight). Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden. Serve with a sauce of sour cream mixed with a little honey and prepared mustard.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix hamburger bread crumbs onion egg salt and pepper to taste.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt in double boiler the almond bark and chocolate chips. Add the peanuts. Mix. Drop by spoonfuls.

title: Grape-Nut Pudding
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with cream or hard sauce.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Mix cottage cheese mayonnaise and olive juice together; add finely chopped olives. Cut celery stalks into 4-inch pieces. Using a spoon \stuff\ mixture into celery; if you choose to be more complicated you can use a pastry bag for stuffing. Remember to serve with napkins! Serves 12 to 18 people depending on length of your celery stalks.

title: Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening and eggs adding 1 egg at a time. Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Blend together creamed and sifted ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla. Bake in steam pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and egg. Sift together flour baking soda and salt. Add peanut butter last. Let stand in refrigerator 2 hours or until dough can be made into balls. Place balls on cookie sheet. Lightly make crisscross on each one to flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 depending on your oven. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Golden Potato Bake
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Add carrots. Mash at low speed with electric mixer. Slowly beat in enough milk to make light. Stir in margarine and a little salt and pepper. Turn into a 2-quart casserole. Dot with additional margarine if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Rice Pot-Shrimp Or Crawfish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric rice cooker. Turn on cooker to cook. Cook shrimp and rice mixture until the chime sounds. Leave cooker on warm and do not lift the lid for 15 minutes. This gives rice and shrimp a chance to steam. Remove lid and taste for doneness. If necessary cook an additional 5 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Easy Smoked Brisket
instructions: Place brisket on heavy foil. Sprinkle garlic salt and pepper on both sides. Sprinkle generously with liquid smoke. Wrap and seal securely and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 5 or 6 hours. An hour before brisket is done turn it over. If brisket feels dry add 1/2 cup water. Be sure to reseal foil tightly.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix cream cheese and green chilies. Spread on flour tortillas. Roll up. Dip in picante sauce.

title: Decorating Buttercream Icing(From Decorating Classes)
instructions: Blend butter and shortening. Add sugar vanilla and 2 tablespoons milk. Cream to proper consistency. Use rest of milk if necessary.

title: Blueberry Pie Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In an unbaked pie shell spread half of the blueberry pie filling in the bottom. Set remaining pie filling aside. Bake 15 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0.

title: Polly'S Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cut butter and flour with pastry cutter. Add cheese and knead for 1 minute. Put in refrigerator for 2 hours to cool dough. Roll 1/4-inch thick. Cut with small cutters. Add half pecans to the center of cookies. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 425\u00b0. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Date Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix all together; drop on baking sheet from teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Delicious!

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: In greased good size casserole place chicken and pasta mixed all in pieces in water with chicken bouillon cubes just to soften a bit. Pour over chicken and pasta. Grate the cheese and cover the top of casserole with this cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour or until liquid has been absorbed. Cover the first 1/2 hour then uncover to brown.

title: Eddie'S Divinity
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in heavy boiler until dissolved. Boil then lower heat until a soft ball is formed when you drop some in cold water. Beat egg whites until stiff. Pour 1/2 cup boiled mixture (cooled some) over egg whites beating constantly. Keep beating slowly adding syrup. Add nuts and flavoring. Beat until mixture holds it shape. Drop with spoon onto buttered waxed paper.

title: Dr. Byrd'S Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Don'T Bake Oat Cookies
instructions: Add sugar butter milk and cocoa. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and oats. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Cream Of Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken parts for 20 minutes. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Place prepared chicken parts in casserole dish that has been greased with margarine. Add cream of chicken soup seasoning salt black pepper onion and bell pepper. Do not stir or mix!!! Place these ingredients on top of chicken parts. Cook for 45 minutes then add cream of mushroom or cream of celery whichever is desired. Cover dish. Turn temperature to 275\u00b0. Cook for another 20 minutes. Serve piping hot over noodles rice or as a meat dish.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine 1st five ingredients. Put in refrigerator and chill. Take out and roll in pecans. Makes 2 balls.

title: Mulled Cider
instructions: Bring cider to boil; add the spices which have been tied in a cheesecloth bag. Boil for 3 minutes. Cool and remove spice bag. When ready to serve bring to a boil and serve at once. Garnish with a ring of unpeeled red apple stuck with whole cloves. Good for a wassail bowl on Christmas or New Years Day.

title: 24 Hour Layered Salad
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish shred lettuce and cover bottom of pan. Top with layers of onion celery and water chestnuts. Sprinkle frozen peas on top. Spread layer of mayonnaise. Sprinkle with seasonings. Top with cheeses. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Put tomatoes on top before serving.

title: Creamy Frozen Lime Pie
instructions: In a small mixer bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually add sweetened condensed milk and evaporated milk. Beat until smooth with mixer at medium speed add lime juice and beat for 1 minute. Pour into pie crust. Freeze for at least 2 hours. Let stand at room temperature 10 to 15 minutes. Garnish with lime slices sliced thin and in half. Slightly twist and garnish or also include cherries or mint sprigs before serving.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together raw sausage and grated cheese. Allow mix to come to room temperature before slowly working in Bisquick. Roll into balls and place on cookie sheet. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes approximately 3 dozen sausage balls.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Mix flour soda and salt; set it aside. Cream remaining ingredients. Blend in dry ingredients. Get a plate and put sugar on it. Form dough into balls and roll them in the sugar. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Hazelnut Torte
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar until thick and glossy. With same beater beat yolks until thick and lemon colored. Gradually add remaining 1/2 cup sugar beating until mixture is light and fluffy. Combine yolk mixture with nuts lemon juice rind and grated carrot. Stir into yolk mixture a few tablespoons of egg whites and blend in the rest.

title: Grandma'S Great Breakfast Pizza
instructions: *May use sharp Cheddar Swiss or Monterey Jack or a combination.

title: Low Cholesterol Low Salt Crispy Baked Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Dip chicken in milk. In plastic bag or bowl mix corn flakes rosemary and pepper. Toss chicken in crumbs. Put chicken on lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake 45 minutes. Garnish with lemon and parsley.

title: Brownie Dessert
instructions: Cut prepared brownies into bite-sized pieces.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix with hands until well blended. Form into small balls. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes on ungreased sheet.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Bake for 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Do not overbake.)

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt the peanut butter butter and chocolate chips in a pan. Mix in a large bowl with cereal. Put the powdered sugar in a paper bag. Add coated cereal and shake. Put in container and serve.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Cake And Topping
instructions: Bake yellow cake mix as directed on box. Cool. Pierce all over with fork. Mix sugar plain flour and pineapple. Cook in double boiler until thick and candy-like. Cool. Spoon icing over pierced cake. Sprinkle approximately 1 cup coconut on top of cake and icing. This makes a large 1 layer cake.

title: Marilyn'S Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Prepare jello with boiling water only. Cool to slightly thickened and add 1 1/2 cups rhubarb. Chill until thickened.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 Tbsp. half-n-half and sugar with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Spread on bottom of graham cracker crust.

title: Mincemeat Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream sugar with shortening then beat in egg yolks. Beat well then stir in mincemeat. Stir flour with the baking soda and salt. Combine with dates and nuts then add to batter. Mix well and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Turn into a large bread tin which has been greased and lined with waxed paper. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours. Cool on wire rack thoroughly before slicing. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: In a very large bowl combine cereal raisins and nuts. Melt together chocolate chips margarine and peanut butter. Stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal mixture. Stir to coat. Pour powdered sugar into a large unscented kitchen trash bag. add the cereal mixture and shake to coat evenly. Makes 5 1/2 quarts.

title: Potato Chip Cookies(Pecan Sandies)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla. Stir in 1 cup crushed potato chips and pecans. Add 2 cups flour gradually. Form into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet. Press flat with floured glass bottom to about 1/8-inch thick. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Hint They wont color much when done.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add taco seasoning and water (according to package directions). Stir and let simmer 5 to 7 minutes. Crush chips on plate. Layer taco meat and toppings. Serve with your favorite salad dressing. We use Ranch or Catalina.

title: Garlic Pot Roast
instructions: Stuff pea sized pieces of garlic into one inch cuts in roast by using a sharp knife. Do this all over roast then brown roast in a large skillet with just enough grease to lightly cover bottom of pan. After roast is browned on both sides put into a crock pot add salt and pepper and the sauces. Finish filling crock pot 3/4 full with water. Cook for 8 to 10 hours on high or until tender. (You may add onions carrots and potatoes if desired then fill with water.)

title: Choc-Oat-Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in oats chocolate chips and nuts; mix well. Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet; remove to wire rack and cool completely. Makes about 5 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Peppered Steak
instructions: Wipe the steak dry. Press the peppercorns into both sides of the steak. Cover and refrigerate for about 6 to 8 hours. Warm a large skillet until hot then add the 2 tsp butter to melt. Please steak in skillet and cook until thermometer registers 160\u00b0F for well done. Remove steak to a platter add wine to the skillet bring to a boil stirring constantly scrape the brown bits from the bottom. Slice steak very thinly. Spoon wine mixture into each serving. Serve with mashed potatoes. Sprinkle with freshly cut parsley.

title: Mincemeat
instructions: Put all together in large container. (I use my 7-quart pressure cooker bottom.) Boil hard 10 minutes. Cook until apples are soft and mixture has thickened. Stir often to keep from burning. Can while still boiling; no need to pressure can.

title: Cabbage Surprise
instructions: Boil chopped cabbage until tender. Cook hamburger or sausage and season with salt pepper garlic powder and onion powder. Drain. Drain cabbage and pour into large baking dish. Pour meat over cabbage. Spread soup undiluted over meat. Combine crushed Ritz crackers over soup and put pats of butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix crushed wafers powdered sugar and pecans. Add melted butter and thawed orange juice. Mix well. Roll into small balls. Roll them in finely grated coconut. Store in refrigerator overnight. They freeze well if you can keep them long enough. Makes about 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Drain noodles and pour into a baking dish. Add corned beef by separating with a fork. Add cream of mushroom soup. Then fill soup can with milk and pour over mixture. Mix in some cheese while stirring everything together. Then add cheese to cover the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Greek Burger
instructions: In a medium bowl mix beef onion lemon juice oregano garlic powder salt and black pepper (overmixing can cause toughness). Shape into patties.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine apples five tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; set aside.

title: Mayhaw Jelly
instructions: Measure sugar and set aside. Stir Sure-Jell in juice and bring to a rolling boil stirring constantly. Add sugar and bring to a full rolling boil that cannot be stirred down. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and let set a minute. Skim and pour into jars and seal. Be sure to use a deep pot.

title: Eggnog
instructions: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored. Beat in sugar and salt. Slowly add whiskey cream nutmeg and milk. Fold in well beaten egg whites. Makes 2 gallons.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix baking soda with water and add molasses. Pour mixture into uncooked pie shell. Add topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Cook onion with meat. Warm cream of mushroom soup with water and pour over meat. Put Tater Tots on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; drain. Put ground beef and onion over cabbage; add rice tomato soup and water in skillet where you browned meat. Pour over cabbage and meat mixture. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Classic Cheese Dip
instructions: Put milk and cottage cheese in blender. Cover and blend on high for 20 seconds. (The mixture makes a good low calorie substitute for sour cream with a little lemon juice and salt added.)

title: Chicken Dressing Made In Crock-Pot
instructions: Boil chicken breasts. Take meat off the bones. Mix with broth. Add chicken soup. Cook cornbread recipe for cornbread. Add 1 egg cornmeal and buttermilk; mix together. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done. Mix with 2 pieces of toasted bread 4 eggs poultry seasoning sage onion salt and pepper to taste. Cook on high for 30 minutes then cook in crock-pot on low for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Cherry Pie Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pie shell. Spread half of cherry pie filling in bottom; set rest of filling aside. Bake shell 15 minutes or just until crust is golden. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Meanwhile in small bowl with portable electric mixer beat cheese with sugar eggs and vanilla until smooth. Pour over hot cherry pie filling. Bake 25 minutes (filling will be slightly soft in center). Cool completely on wire rack. To serve spoon sour cream around edge of pie. Fill center with remaining cherry pie filling. Makes 8 servings.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Divide into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Green Beans With Sour Cream
instructions: Remove strings from beans; wash and cut into 1-inch pieces. Cook beans covered in a small amount of salt water 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside. Saute garlic in butter in a small skillet until tender; add bread crumbs and cook stirring occasionally until browned. Add bread crumb mixture parsley pepper and sour cream to green beans. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields approximately 6 servings.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Beat butter and sugar. Beat in egg yolks. Add flour salt milk lemon juice and grated rind; beat well. Beat egg whites until stiff not dry. Fold into other ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until top is golden and pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Black Walnut Cake Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spread on cooled cake.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Saute onions celery and green pepper in oleo. Gradually add flour and then milk and cheese. Cook slowly until it thickens. Add drained pimentos and mushrooms. Pour over 4 cans well drained French-style green beans that are in baking dish. Cover with cracker crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugars. Add and beat well the egg. Add salt. Mix together the pineapple and baking soda; add to first mixture. Fold in flour chopped nuts and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Sift flour twice if regular flour. Sift flour once if cake flour. Cream butter. Add sugar and cream together until smooth. Add eggs. Mix until smooth batter. Add flour slowly until mixed well. Add 7-Up and lemon extract; mix well. Beat cake 3 1/2 minutes. Pour batter in Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour or until brown and when cake leaves sides of pan.

title: Montana Cattleman'S Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain fat. Add soups water and barbecue sauce. Simmer until soup gets mixed together. Add raw vegetables (may use other kinds of vegetables too). Cook over medium heat until done or cook in crock-pot all day. Real good soup for cold and rainy days. (From my Mom.)

title: 9 Day Slaw
instructions: Cut cabbage fine. Chop green peppers and onions. Blend with 1 1/2 cups sugar. Mix remaining ingredients. Bring to a full boil stirring over high flame. Pour immediately over cabbage mixture. Let cool and store in refrigerator. Will keep for 9 days in refrigerator.

title: Olde English Trifle
instructions: Line the bottom of a deep glass bowl (wider at bottom) with ladyfingers; stand ladyfingers all around side of bowl. Spread bottom ladyfingers with strawberry preserves then layer of strawberries.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Put Tater Tots in a large casserole dish and brown in oven. Meanwhile brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Add soups to ground beef. Pour over browned Tater Tots. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese. Add one at a time. Beat well. Pour in a graham cracker crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large kettle saute onion in oleo until transparent but not browned. Add the sweet potatoes zucchini and broccoli. Saute lightly for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in broth; simmer for a few minutes. Add Irish potatoes and seasonings. Cook another 10 minutes. Stir in cream and heat through.

title: Orange Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in 12 x 8 x 2-inch casserole. Combine remaining ingredients except rice in large bowl; pour mixture over chicken. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Transfer chicken and vegetables to a warm serving platter and cover. Reduce cooking liquid over high heat stirring for 1 or 2 minutes or until slightly thickened. Serve chicken on a bed of cooked rice or pasta. Arrange vegetables over chicken; spoon sauce over chicken and vegetables. Serves 6.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Pulverize peppers in blender with water. Put in large cooking pot and add other ingredients except Certo and food coloring. Boil hard for 5 minutes. Add Certo and coloring and pour into sterilized glasses and seal. Makes approximately 12 jelly glasses.

title: Grandma'S Noodles
instructions: Mix all ingredients to form a ball. Let set for 15 minutes. Roll out thin on a floured surface. Roll up like a jelly roll and cut either fine medium or broad.

title: Cold Lemon Souffle
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften. Mix egg yolks with lemon juice rind and 3/4 cup of the sugar. Place in double boiler over boiling water and cook stirring constantly until lemon mixture is slightly thickened (about 8 minutes). Remove from heat and stir in gelatin until dissolved. Chill 30 to 40 minutes. Beat egg whites until they begin to hold their shape then gradually hold their shape then add 3/4 cup sugar until all has been added and whites are stiff. Beat cream until stiff; fold whites and cream into yolk mixture. Pour into a 2-quart souffle dish and chill 4 hours or more. Whipped cream may be put on top.

title: Geneva'S Famous Catfish Court Bouillon
instructions: In large cooker cover catfish with water. Boil until done (flaky). Remove bones. Strain water and set aside.

title: New Orleans Pralines
instructions: Boil sugar milk and syrup to soft ball stage (when small amount dropped into cold water forms a soft ball). Add pecans butter and vanilla and beat until creamy. Spoon onto wax paper. They will form a small disk; allow room between them. Top with half pecan on top just for appearance or just leave plain.

title: Molded Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter. Reserve 1/3 cup for topping. Press crumb mixture into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Dissolve gelatin and sugar in hot water. Stir in reserved pineapple syrup. Chill until partially set. Add sour cream and vanilla; whip until fluffy. Fold in pineapple oranges coconut and nuts. Pour over crumbs and sprinkle top with crumbs. Chill until firm.

title: Peanut Butter Blossom Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars butter and peanut butter together. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients. Add to above mixture. Shape into balls and roll into additional sugar. Bake at 370\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes. Press Kisses into cookies as soon as they come out of oven.

title: Festive Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine and mix well. Spoon into greased baking dish.

title: Princess Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Mix 1/4 cup soy sauce 1/4 cup sherry 3/4 cup water and 8 teaspoons cornstarch together. Toss over chicken and let marinate 20 minutes. Mix remaining soy sauce sherry sugar sesame oil rice vinegar 1 tablespoon water and cornstarch. Heat peanut oil in a wok or skillet. Stir-fry red pepper flakes for 1 or 2 minutes (depending on desired hotness). Add chicken and marinade and stir-fry until chicken changes color. Add remaining mixture water chestnuts and vegetables and stir-fry until sauce thickens and vegetables are desired tenderness and chicken is cooked. Serve over rice.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package. In another pan saute onion and broccoli in butter. Add cream of mushroom soup and Cheez Whiz. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In a large baking dish add broccoli cooked and well drained. Add soup and margarine. Mix all other ingredients well and pour into dish. Top with Ritz crackers and bake 15 minutes in microwave oven.

title: Potatoes With Cucumbers
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Combine these in skillet with olive oil salt pepper basil bay leaf and peeled seeded tomatoes. Add water to just cover. Put a lid on the pot and cook for 20 minutes over brisk heat.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Chill.

title: Simple Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Saute onion in butter until transparent. Add soup and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Add crawfish and simmer an additional 15 minutes. Add parsley and onion tops. Season. Serve over rice.

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts; remove meat from bones and cut up. Place 1/2 the noodles in a casserole dish. Mix all ingredients and pour over noodles. Place rest of noodles on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and oil with sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes. Frost with One Minute Chocolate Frosting.

title: Chocolate Milk
instructions: Directions per one cup of chocolate milk Mix cocoa powder sugar and 1 teaspoon milk in large coffee cup or hot chocolate mug and stir well to make a chocolaty paste. Gradually add 3/4 to 1 cup milk to the cup with paste in it stirring into paste as you pour. Serve cold or hot (with miniature marshmallows if desired).

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Peach-Plum Jam
instructions: Peel and pit peaches; chop very fine. Pit plums; chop very fine. Mix fruits; measure 4 1/2 cups into large saucepan. Place saucepan of fruit over high heat. Add pectin. Stir until mixture comes to a hard boil. At once stir in sugar. Bring to a full rolling boil and boil hard 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Skim and stir for 5 minutes. Ladle quickly into hot scalded glasses. Seal at once. Makes ten 6-ounce glasses.

title: Marinated Brisket
instructions: Mix and pour over brisket and marinate overnight. Add a cup of wine and cover with foil. Bake 8 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Hershey'S Disappearing Cake
instructions: Generously grease and flour 2 (9-inch) round cake pans. Cream butter shortening sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Blend in eggs. Combine cocoa flour baking powder baking soda and salt in bowl; add alternately with milk to batter. Blend well. Pour into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans; frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Mocha Chocolate Cake
instructions: Let the first 3 ingredients soak together for 20 minutes. Then add the next 5 ingredients to the oatmeal mixture. Sift together the last 4 ingredients and add to the mixture. Bake in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli for 10 minutes or until tender; drain. Combine all ingredients except broccoli crumbs and margarine; mix well. Stir in cooked broccoli; spoon into lightly buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with crumbs; dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Beef And Veggies
instructions: Brown the ground beef. Transfer to crock-pot. Add remaining ingredients. Mix to combine. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours (or high for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours). Serve with brown rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: English Christmas Pudding & Brandy Sauce
instructions: In a large bowl sift together the flour allspice and nutmeg. Add the breadcrumbs suet sugar raisins peel walnuts and grated orange rind. Toss well together.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend cream cheese then add sugar and fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with your favorite pie filling. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and spread 7 ounces marshmallow cream on hot cake. Let cool; spread frosting over marshmallow cream.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: In a large kettle cook potatoes carrots and celery in water until tender about 20 minutes. Drain reserving liquid and setting vegetables aside.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with Pam. Dip chicken in melted butter then coat chicken with remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered until tender (about 45 minutes).

title: Meal-In-A-Mug
instructions: In a large saucepan brown ground beef; drain. Add water beans tomatoes and Sloppy Joe mix. Bring to a boil. Add macaroni and reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until macaroni is almost cooked. Pour into thermos for a hot lunch. Makes about 8 cups.

title: Deviled Diamond Sandwiches
instructions: In medium bowl blend all ingredients. Seal. Refrigerate until ready to use. Spread on bread diamonds; arrange on serving tray. Garnish with sliced stuffed green olives pimento hard-cooked eggs and parsley. Makes 5 dozen tea sandwiches.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Slightly beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape into balls the size of walnuts. Refrigerate 30 minutes before baking. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Can be frozen after baking. Yield 4 dozen.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in 1 egg at a time then a cup of flour and then a little milk. Add flour mixture and milk alternately until all is used. Add baking soda vanilla and a pinch of salt.

title: Broccoli Corn Casserole
instructions: Completely thaw and drain broccoli. Mix broccoli with corn onion 2 tablespoons margarine egg salt pepper and 1/4 cup cracker crumbs. Pour into casserole. Mix 1/4 cup crumbs and 1 tablespoon margarine. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Slice squash and onion and let soak in salt water for 2 hours. Boil rest of ingredients and pour over squash and let set for another 2 hours. Boil for 5 minutes and put in jars.

title: Hot Bacon-Swiss Dip
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and mayonnaise. Stir in shredded Swiss cheese and green onion. Place in 2 1/2-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit 'N Juice Squares
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin until dissolved. Mix orange juice and ice to make 1 1/2 cups. Stir into gelatin. Remove 1 1/2 cups of gelatin. Stir in fruit.

title: Eggs With Chorizo
instructions: Put oil in frying pan. Add chorizo; let it cook then add the eggs and onion until theyre cooked.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and baking cocoa in bowl. Cream margarine shortening and sugar in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour mixture alternately with sour cream and milk beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan for several minutes. Invert onto serving plate. Yield 16 servings.

title: Pignoli Cookies
instructions: Grease cookie sheet (use Pam to grease cookie sheet). Put almond paste in bowl and soften. Add egg whites one at a time. Add cup of sugar and almond extract to mixture. Blend together using an electric blender. Drop 1/2 teaspoon at a time on greased cookie sheet. Add pignoli nuts on top of cookies. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes and cool.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water. Drain and add other ingredients. Toss with mayonnaise. Chill thoroughly. Better next day.

title: Millionaire Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate chips peanut butter chips butterscotch chips and paraffin in top of double boiler. Add nuts. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Chill. When firm may be packaged or served.

title: Chocolate Layer Dessert
instructions: Mix butter flour and nuts together and press in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Chile Con Queso Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in crock-pot along with the other ingredients. Stir frequently until all cheese is melted. Low setting is recommended if you have an hour or so before serving. Check periodically to prevent burning. Serve hot with corn chips or tortilla chips. Ole!

title: Dunbar Cake
instructions: Add together first 5 ingredients then stir in remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Great with cream cheese or peanut butter frosting.

title: Rice Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and bake in covered casserole 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. If grease is settled in middle cook a little longer.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
instructions: Cook hen in water and salt. Cool cut meat off bones and dice. Cook spaghett in broth. Cook celery onion and pepper in broth and add to drained spaghetti with tomato juice and diced chicken. Simmer for a few minutes. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and sprinkle with cheese. Bake about 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Drain the cherries. Cream the powdered sugar margarine and corn syrup. Roll mixture into balls (each takes about 1/2 teaspoon). Punch hole in center and roll cherry in. Refrigerate for about 3 hours or freeze 30 minutes. Insert toothpick into each ball.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Wash tomatoes and cut in slices. Turn into flour and meal mixture. Saute quickly in hot fat. Turn to brown on both sides. Turn heat low and cook partially covered until very tender. A little cream added to the pan just before serving provides a good sauce. Makes 6 servings.

title: Steak And Ale Rice
instructions: Wash rice in hot water. Saute onion in butter 5 minutes. Add rice to saute pan and stir until all grains are covered with butter. Mix bouillon and peppers with hot water until dissolved. Stir with rice. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix well. Drop and mash with a glass dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown chopped meat. Add salt onion and pepper. Cook for a few minutes then add wine for 3 or 4 minutes. Then add tomato sauce water and rest of seasoning. Cook for 45 minutes on low to medium heat. Boil rice; drain excess water. Serve over rice.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. In a bowl combine pineapple juice ketchup honey vinegar mustard and salt. Pour over pork chops.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: I first scrub the cukes and get all picks off. Bring the first 4 ingredients to a boil. Pack in jars tight. Put a piece of dill and a clove of garlic in jar. Pour hot liquid over pickles. Wipe jar rim and put on lid and seal. Set whole jar in quite hot water until water cools. Wait to eat at least 2 weeks. They are better if you wait longer.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix jello and boiling water. Stir until dissolved. Add sugar; stir. Add sour cream oranges pineapple and nuts. Refrigerate until set.

title: *Angel Biscuits*
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Sift dry ingredients and cut in shortening. Add yeast and milk. Knead enough to hold together. Roll dough into 1/2-inch thickness and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown.

title: Nancy'S Clam Chowder
instructions: Place all ingredients except milk and cornstarch in Dutch oven. Bring to boil then reduce to simmer until potatoes are tender. Mix cornstarch with cold water until dissolved. Pour into clam mixture. Add milk. Simmer until thickened stirring often. (Do not boil.) Serve immediately.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Allow peanut butter and cream cheese to soften to room temperature. In a mixing bowl cream peanut butter cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip vanilla and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly. Pour into pie shell. Refrigerate until firm. When ready to serve drizzle with hot fudge sauce. Sprinkle with peanuts or chocolate chips. Makes 8 servings.

title: Old-Time Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs nutmeg and flour. Mix dough real well. Dough will resemble biscuit dough. Sprinkle flour. Roll dough out and cut. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients above together. Get out your cast iron skillet and spray real well with Pam spray. Turn the oven on or preheat at 400\u00b0. Pour your ingredients into the cast iron skillet and cook for about 1 hour. Let set for 30 minutes. Flip onto a regular plate. Enjoy. Enjoy.

title: Hopscotch Crunchies
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels and peanut butter over hot water. Remove from heat. Stir. Stir in one can chow mein noodles and marshmallows. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Chill until set. Makes about 30.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in the refrigerator. These will keep for months and are delicious.

title: Barbecue Sausage
instructions: Slice sausage in 1-inch slices. Put in large skillet and cover with water. Cook covered over medium heat until water boils out and sausage browns slightly. Add barbecue sauce. Cook until sauce cooks through about 10 minutes.

title: Spicy Confetti Cornbread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients and pimento. Mix yogurt egg oil and scallions. Mix with dry ingredients just until combined. Put into 8-inch iron skillet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until done. Can be done over campfire if done carefully.

title: Date Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar with shortening; add eggs. Dissolve soda in boiling water; add to the sugar mixture. Sift together flour salt nutmeg and cinnamon; add to the sugar mixture. Cover dates with boiling water; pour off immediately and add the dates and nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Rinse and boil chicken. Mix soup sour cream and poppy seed in bowl. Mash crackers and mix with butter in separate bowl. Break chicken up and put in bowl with sour cream mixture. Stir. Prepare rice as directed.

title: Cabbage And Pineapple Salad
instructions: Shred cabbage. Stir in pineapple and marshmallows. Blend in mayonnaise.

title: Apple Walnut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine flour 1 cup sugar baking soda and salt. Sprinkle mixture over pie filling. In a bowl combine eggs vanilla oil and nuts; mix well. Pour over ingredients in pan; stir only until blended. Smooth batter evenly in pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until cake springs back from light touch. Cool on rack for about 20 minutes. Prick warm cake with fork.

title: Wilted Lettuce (French Lick Style)
instructions: Fry bacon crisp drain. Add vinegar and sugar to bacon drippings. Heat thoroughly. When hot pour mixture over lettuce. Add salt and pepper to taste and crumpled bacon. Mix well serve immediately.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Whip first 3 ingredients at medium speed for 15 minutes. Put this mixture into baked pie crusts. Dip sliced bananas into pineapple juice and place on top of mixture in pie crusts. Spread Cool Whip on top of pies and garnish with cherries and nuts.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Blend pulp and beaten eggs; alternately add milk and dry ingredients. Stir in butter. Pour into greased pan about 2 inches deep. Bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Serves 10.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together; spread on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Layer the remaining ingredients in the following order onions olives tomatoes and cheeses. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with chips.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter or margarine until soft. Gradually add sugar creaming until fluffy after each addition. Add eggs in thirds blending well. Thoroughly blend in corn syrup and salt. Add chopped nuts and turn into pastry shell. Arrange pecan halves on top.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Cover bottom of 8-inch square pan with fruit (drain well if using canned fruit). I usually fill it between 1/3 to 1/2 full (8 large or 14 small peaches). Mix 3/4 cup sugar butter baking powder salt milk and flour together; spread batter over fruit. Mix remaining 1 cup sugar and cornstarch; sprinkle over batter. Pour boiling water over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Taco Pizza
instructions: Mix refried beans and hot peppers. Spread on baked pizza crust. Put on cooked and drained hamburger. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Add lettuce tomatoes onion and cheese. Serves 4.

title: Mom'S Apple Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt the butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish or sheet cake pan. In a saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour until particles are like fine crumbs. Add milk and stir with fork until dough leaves the sides of the bowl. Turn out on pastry board and knead until smooth. Roll out until about 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle apples and cinnamon evenly over the dough. Roll up like a jelly roll. Dampen the edges and seal. Slice dough about 1/2-inch thick. Place in pan with melted butter. Pour sugar syrup carefully around the rolls. The liquid will absorb into the rolls. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Mix roll mix according to package directions; let rest 5 minutes. Mix together 1 egg with cheese and oregano. Grease jelly roll pan and spread roll mix out (use flour on fingers so dough wont stick). Spread egg mixture over dough; top with cheese and pepperoni slices overlapping each slice. Roll up jelly roll style. Pinch seams. Let rest 20 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until almost golden brown. Brush with margarine and return to oven for 5 minutes. Serve with salad.

title: Icing For Sponge Cake Or Angel Food Cake
instructions: Blend and bring to a boil. Simmer 10 minutes. Chill 2 hours. Whip the cream and fold into jello mixture. Cut cake in half and use some for filling. Place other half of cake on top and use remaining icing to cover whole cake.

title: Golden Glow Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add cold water lemon juice mayonnaise salt and pepper. Blend with mixer and chill.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in 2-quart casserole dish. In a large bowl mix chicken vegetables soup and 1/2 can milk. Place in the melted butter. Mix Bisquick and 2/3 cup milk. Pour onto chicken mixture. Do not stir. Bake for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Allow mixture to melt in a pan over hot water for 30 minutes. Do not stir. Remove from heat and beat with a mixer. Store in the refrigerator. Thin with cream as needed.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Beat eggs oil and water. Add cake mix and pudding mix. Blend well. Add poppy seed last stirring by hand. Spray 2 bread pans with nonstick spray. Divide mixture into 2 loaf pans. Bake 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Apple French Toast
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar and Karo. Cook over medium heat until bubbly. Pour into 13 x 9 greased pan. Add all of apple slices. Beat eggs. Add milk and vanilla to eggs. Dip slices of French bread into milk mixture and layer over top of apples in pan. Refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. To serve use spatula and invert each slice of bread on serving plates. Spoon apples over top.

title: Apple Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put all ingredients in large bowl. Mix with your hands as you would a meat loaf gently but thoroughly. Do not use a spoon or mixer. Bake in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan for 1 hour. Cool before cutting. For extra crispy edges bake a tad longer.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter together; add eggs and cream well. Add remaining ingredients and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour brown on top. Yields two pies.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti; mix next 4 ingredients. Mix Zesty dressing as on package and mix all together. Marinate overnight.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Clean and drain shrimp. Cook rice according to package. Brown onion in butter. Mix all ingredients. Put in casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Butter-Choc Chippers
instructions: Cream the shortening sugars eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Stir together dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture; blend well. Add chocolate butterscotch and nuts. Drop from teaspoon 2-inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes. Remove from sheet after cooled 5 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Peach Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in butter. Sprinkle mixture on bottom and sides of greased round pan. Place peaches cut side up over dough. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over peaches. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Mix egg yolk with milk. Pour it over peaches and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Warm Okra Salad
instructions: Cook okra until tender then add all ingredients and simmer. Let stand. Cook rest of meat then warm in microwave.

title: Goodies
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Line pan with graham crackers. Sprinkle with a layer of pecans. In a saucepan cook together for 2 to 3 minutes the mixture of butter or margarine and sugar. Pour over graham crackers and pecans. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool. Break into pieces like peanut brittle.

title: Chess Squares
instructions: Mix together cake mix. Soften stick of butter and 1 beaten egg and press into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. In mixer mix confectioners sugar eggs and cream cheese and pour over crust. Bake 55 to 60 minutes in a 325\u00b0 preheated oven in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Tortellini Soup
instructions: Break sausage up while browning. Pour off grease brown onion and garlic in saucepan. Add rest of ingredients. Heat to boil. Simmer 45 minutes covered.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In small pot mix ingredients; bring to a boil and simmer about 5 to 10 minutes. Add 2 Tbsp. margarine if cooking on grill. Refrigerate any leftovers for later.

title: Ranch Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute onion; and bell pepper in hot oil in a large skillet over medium high heat 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in chicken and next 7 ingredients; remove from heat. Tear tortilla pieces into 1 inch pieces; layer one third of tortilla pieces in bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Top with one third of chicken mixture and 2/3 c. cheese.\tRepeat layers twice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes. Yields 6-8 servings.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix all of the juices water and ginger ale together. Garnish with orange slices.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
instructions: For this ultra-simple recipe use jumbo Spanish onions sliced to 1/8 inch thick (#2 or #3 on a slicing machine). Separate the circles into rings and toss with all-purpose flour. While tossing sprinkle the onions with light cream to moisten them. Keep tossing them all together until they are well-coated. Deep fry in vegetable shortening and drain well.

title: Perfect Pie Crust(10-Inch)
instructions: Combine mixture by cutting shortening (one knife in each hand going horizontally) until very thin lumps form. Add water then roll out with a rolling pin on floured surface. Add whatever filling you wish and bake as you would.

title: Chocolate Popcorn
instructions: Over medium heat using a 4-quart pot combine the sugar butter corn syrup cocoa and salt and bring to a boil. Once the mixture is well mixed add the popped corn. Cook and stir until popcorn is coated approximately 2 minutes. Cool mixture and shape into 3-inch balls.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli in microwave for 5 minutes. Prepare noodles according to package directions. Cook chicken in microwave until just cooked; dice. Prepare Stove Top dressing according to package directions. Melt bouillon cube in small amount of water.

title: Cream Of Chicken Over Cornbread
instructions: Cut up chicken into small chunks. Put chicken in a skillet with 1/4 cup of water. Cook chicken until done (approximately 10 minutes). Chop up onion; add to chicken. Cook for 5 more minutes. Add cream of chicken soup and milk. Simmer for 15 more minutes.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt margarine; stir in brown sugar sugar and corn syrup. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popcorn mixing well. Turn into 2 cookie sheets. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove and cool completely. Break apart and store in covered containers.

title: Speedy Ham And Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine water noodles seasoning packet and vegetables. Bring to a boil. Combine flour and milk and blend well. Gradually add to soup stirring constantly. Cook until thickened. Stir in ham and cook until thoroughly heated.

title: Good Frozen Cucumber Pickle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let set overnight. Place in freezer containers and freeze. Goes well with any snack or dinner meal.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Drain. Place half of macaroni in a well buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with half the salt pepper and cheese. Dot with butter. Arrange another layer in the same manner. Pour milk over the top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all together and place in pan. Bake about 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 until hot. Broil until light brown on top. Serve with Wheat Thins. Blot off pools of oil on top and side.

title: Mini Cheesecake
instructions: Line muffin tin with foil liners. Place 1 wafer in each liner. Mix cream cheese vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well blended add eggs. Mix well. Pour over wafers filling 3/4 full. Bake for 25 minutes ant 325 degrees. Remove from pan when cool. Chill. Top with fruit preserves or cherry pie filling.

title: Green Beans With Shallot-Thyme Butter
instructions: In a small bowl combine butter shallots and thyme; set aside. Bring water to rapid boil in large saucepan; add green beans. Cook for 7 min. or until tender drain. Add shallot butter to hot beans; gently toss until butter melts. Serve immediately. Makes 6-8 servings.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Put sugar and cinnamon in bag and shake to mix. Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Put quarters of biscuits in bag with sugar and cinnamon and shake until all pieces are covered. Put half of nuts in bottom of Bundt pan and add quarters of biscuits alternating with remaining nuts. Put oleo and brown sugar in a pan and bring to boil for 1 minute. Pour over biscuits and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Seafoam Candy
instructions: Mix sugar water and syrup. Cook until it forms hard ball in cold water. Pour over beaten egg whites. Beat until stiff and add pecans and vanilla. Drop by spoonful on waxed paper.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Ground ham pork and veal together. Mix in all ingredients and form loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Grease and flour two loaf pans. Fill pans half full. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 then 30 minutes at 300\u00b0 until done.

title: Giblet Gravy
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add soup and broth. Mix flour or cornstarch with water until smooth. Add to soup mixture and cook until it thickens. Add eggs and giblets. If it gets too thick add some more broth.

title: Apple Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Cut each pork tenderloin lengthwise about 2/3 of the way through. Flatten out with a meat mallet to about 1/4-inch thick. Combine apples carrot onion pecans salt and pepper together and mix well. Place equal amounts in each tenderloin and spread out. Roll up tenderloins and secure with toothpicks. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Spread apricot preserves on top of each tenderloin and bake an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until pork is fully cooked. Slice and serve.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the cream cheese sugar and butter together well. Add one egg at a time beating after each addition. Add flour a little at a time blending gradually. Add vanilla. Pour into well-greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 or 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. May be iced if desired.

title: Salsa Ranchero
instructions: Mix all ingredients. For hotter sauce add one minced Jalapeno pepper.

title: Venus De Milo Soup
instructions: Cook hamburg; drain fat off. Cook macaroni in a separate pan; set aside. Put bouillon onion soup and tomatoes in a pot. Add hamburg and vegetables. Can substitute string beans corn carrots. Let simmer. Last add Ozzo.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: In saucepan cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine cream of chicken soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrot. Fold in drained squash and onion.

title: Cranberry Meatballs
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients.* For appetizers shape into 1-inch meatballs (about 5 dozen). Place on rack in a 15 x 10 x 1 baking pan at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Great Baked Beans
instructions: Brown the ground beef and onion. Mix remaining ingredients and add to browned ground beef and onion. Spray casserole dish with Pam. Pour mixture in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 35 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter or margarine in medium casserole or glass baking dish. In small saucepan on low heat heat fruit and sugar until sugar is dissolved. Mix remaining ingredients in separate bowl. Pour mixture into melted butter. Spoon fruit on top of batter. Spoon remaining juice over fruit and batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Toss cooked macaroni in oil. Add all remaining ingredients. Pour into lightly greased crock-pot. Stir well. Cover and cook on low 3 hours. Stir occasionally.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Peach Spice Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in airtight container. Use 4 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

title: Ray'S Simple Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and green onions. (This can be done a day in advance and placed in an airtight container in refrigerator for better flavor.)

title: Bridal Punch
instructions: Place sherbet in punch bowl. Pour ginger ale and apple juice over sherbet. Stir gently to mix.\tServes 40.

title: Fried Dill Pickles
instructions: Drain juice off pickles. Soak pickles in milk. Drain milk off and roll pickles in flour covering well. Deep-fry until golden brown.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine first six ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with pecan halves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 - 50 minutes or until set.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Stir butter eggs and Parmesan into hot spaghetti. Use this mixture to shape a \crust\ in 10-inch pie plate. Spread cottage cheese over crust and cover with sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese melts. Slice and serve.

title: Party Cheese Spread
instructions: Cream cheeses and butter together until well blended. Add other ingredients and mix well. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to the package directions. Pour half of the batter in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
instructions: Melt chocolate pieces in top of double boiler over hot (not boiling) water. Add peanuts to melted chocolate and stir to coat. Turn out on waxed paper spreading so that peanuts are separated as much as possible. Allow to cool.

title: Hamburger Hot Dish
