instructions: Brown hamburger. Combine meat with other ingredients and mix well. Place in casserole. Top with crushed potato chips; bake uncovered 1 hour in preheated 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet And Sour Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Heat mustard and jelly in saucepan. Add dogs and heat until cooked. Serve in a chafing dish fondue pot or crock-pot with toothpicks.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Mix at low speed until crumbly. Press 1 1/2 cups crumbs into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Reserve 1/2 cup crumb mixture for topping. To remaining crumb mixture add remaining ingredients. Beat 1 minute until well blended. Spread over crumb crust. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool and cut into bars. Makes 3 to 4 dozen bars.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Combine strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar. Stir well. Set aside. Beat eggs with mixer until frothy. Gradually add 1 cup sugar beating until thick. Add cream milk almond extract and salt. Mix well. Stir in strawberry mixture. Pour mixture into freezer can of a 1 gallon ice cream freezer. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions. Let ripen at least 1 hour.

title: Easy Penuche Frosting
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Stir in brown sugar. Heat to boiling stirring constantly 2 minutes. Stir in milk and bring to a boil again. Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm. Gradually stir in confectioners sugar. Place pan of frosting in a bowl of ice water. Beat until frosting becomes of spreading consistency. If icing becomes too stiff heat slightly stirring constantly. Great over chocolate or yellow cake.

title: To Cure Hams
instructions: Mix thoroughly the saltpeter 1 pint of fine salt and brown sugar and rub over the hams and let stand for 24 hours. Then rub meat with 2 pints fine salt and black pepper. Let stand for 5 days and then rub meat again with fine salt. Set aside for 30 days then hang and wash off salt. Have smoked at a good smokehouse for 10 days. Rub ham with red pepper when finished then wrap in brown paper.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Cook bacon and add onions for the last 2 minutes; drain. Blend eggs milk and salt. Add spinach onion and cooked bacon. Turn into 9-inch pie shell and bake at 375\u00b0 until set about 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Heat sugar and vinegar to boiling in microwave. Cool slightly and add dressing. Pour\tover vegetable mixture and let stand overnight. Toss several times. Keeps well for 3 or 4 days!

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients in greased casserole except 1 tablespoon oleo and 1/4 cup crumbs which are sprinkled on top of corn mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. In another bowl mix all other ingredients. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0. Frost when cool with Luxury Chocolate Frosting.

title: Zellwood Corn Pudding
instructions: Scrape corn from the cob and combine with remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for an hour or until set. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4-inch slices and thin strips. Mix flour Accent salt and pepper. Coat meat. In large skillet brown meat in 1/3 cup butter. Add onion and bouillon. Simmer 25 minutes until tender. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a small skillet; brown mushrooms. Combine sour cream tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce. Add 1/2 cup stock from the meat and stir until blended. Gradually pour into meat stock and mix well. Add browned mushrooms and heat. May be made ahead of time and frozen.

title: Chocolate Almond Pie
instructions: In bowl with electric mixer at low speed beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually blend in milk and almond extract; add pudding mix. Beat at low speed for 1 minute scraping bowl often. Spread mixture in crust. Chill until firm about 2 hours. Garnish with almonds. Makes 8 servings.

title: Beef Or Venison Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat. Add onions bouillon cubes and water to cover meat. Add tomato paste. Simmer until meat is done. Thicken gravy. Just before serving add sour cream. May also add mushrooms and vegetables.

title: Cantaloupe Pie
instructions: Peel seed and chop cantaloupe. Puree in blender container on low speed. Measure 1 1/2 cups pulp. Combine with milk 1 cup sugar nutmeg and salt in bowl; mix well. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour. Add cantaloupe mixture. Cook over medium heat until thickened stirring constantly. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into egg yolks; stir egg yolks into hot mixture. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Spoon into pastry shell. Beat egg whites in mixer bowl until foamy. Add 6 tablespoons sugar gradually beating until stiff peaks form. Spread over pastry. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour in shallow pan and chill. Set and cut in cubes.

title: Hello Piggie Cookies
instructions: Use a 9 x 9-inch pan. Melt oleo in the pan and spread the crumbs over the bottom of the pan. Add the other items in order given and spread the milk over the top. Do not stir as it should be in layers.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Chill. Serve with crackers or in middle of Hawaiian bread.

title: Cabbage Salad(Salata Z Kapusty)
instructions: Shred cabbage fine; mix in salt and lemon juice and let stand for 4 hours. Mix remaining ingredients to make dressing. Add dressing to cabbage and toss lightly. Refrigerate before serving. Garnish and season to taste. Serves 75.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Mix gelatin sugar salt and water. Warm just to melt gelatin. Put in mold and partially gel. Drain. Mix pineapple carrots and juice. Fold this into the partially jelled mixture in mold. Put back in refrigerator until jelled again. Serve on lettuce.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Peel shrimp; slice shrimp lengthwise. Dice or slice sausage and saute in oil and butter over low fire about 5 minutes. Add onions green peppers celery and garlic; slowly saute until tender. Stir in tomatoes seasonings rice and water. Reduce heat and cover. Cook at low temperature 25 to 30 minutes. About 5 minutes before jambalaya is ready add green onions and parsley. Cook until rice is fluffy. Serves 6.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook onions in butter over low heat. Blend in flour wine and sour cream. Add drained beans mushrooms and nuts. Mix well; place in 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole dish and top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Gold Sparkle Punch
instructions: Combine juices and water. Just before serving add soda. Serves 40 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Grandmother'S Pound Cake
instructions: Work butter until creamy; beat in sugar and eggs one at a time. When creamy fold in flour with spoon. Stir in flavoring. Spread in buttered and floured loaf pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti and cool. Add rest of ingredients. Refrigerate 12 hours.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add well beaten eggs then flour soda and salt which have been sifted together. Add chopped dates (or raisins) and nuts. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Birds' Nest
instructions: Mix grated carrot with chow mein noodles. Moisten with reduced calorie mayonnaise. Make well in center of mixture; fill in nest with grapes for eggs (or peas raisins melon balls).

title: Melon Cooler Salad
instructions: Blend concentrate and cream cheese. Divide melon balls in 8 salad bowls and pour mixture over.

title: Every Morning Bran Muffins
instructions: Place separated slices of bacon on rack in shallow baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. No need to turn or drain.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef and drain. Add taco seasoning mix drained salsa mushrooms Parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning. In small bowl stir together the cottage cheese and parsley flakes. Layer noodles cottage cheese ground beef mixture and Mozzarella cheese in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish coated with vegetable cooking spray. Repeat to make 3 layers. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6 to 9.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Pour salad dressing over chicken in baking pan. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Put rice vegetables and 1/2 onion around chicken. Pour bouillon and seasoning over all. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. Cover with remainder of onions. Bake for another 25 minutes.

title: 7-Up Biscuits
instructions: Combine Bisquik mix and 7-Up in mixing bowl. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 3 to 4 times. Roll 1/2 inch thick. cut with 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Icebox Gingerbread Muffins
instructions: Mix accordingly. Bake in a muffin tin at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until done. (I use paper liners). Batter will keep 3 to 4 weeks in the refrigerator. Make only as many as you need at one time.

title: German Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill several hours.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Salad Brown hamburger. Add kidney beans and simmer. Add lettuce onion cheese Doritos tomatoes and avocados placing some of the avocados and tomatoes on top. Serve with dressing. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix well and let stand for a few hours. This dip is extra good with crackers or bread.

title: Scotch Bars
instructions: Mix brown sugar with eggs and melted butter. Add flour and vanilla flavoring. Mix thoroughly. Add chocolate chips and pecans. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares after cool.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Will need 5-quart casserole. Place a layer of potatoes and onions in casserole dish; sprinkle with flour salt and pepper. Dot with butter. Repeat; top with a layer of potatoes. Dot with butter. Add enough hot milk to cover almost the last layer of potatoes. Bake covered in preheated moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer. Add cheese the last 5 minutes.

title: Almond Bark Treat
instructions: Melt almond bark in microwave on Low or Medium for 5 to 7 minutes. In a large bowl combine marshmallows Rice Krispies Captn Crunch and peanuts. Add melted almond bark and drop by spoon. May add different cereals but if Captn Crunch is\tnot used add\ta couple large spoonfuls of peanut butter for flavor.

title: Frikadeller (German Meat Patties)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Shape into golf size balls. Pad the balls flat. Fry in frying pan for about 5 minutes on each side or until crispy. Enjoy.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and set aside. Mix all soups and Cheez Whiz together. Then mix in veggies and rice. Sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pineapple in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch ungreased cake pan. Spread cherry pie filling over top of pineapple evenly but do not mix. Spread the dry cake mix over top and then sprinkle nuts over this. Slice the margarine real thin and place on top of nuts. (Be sure you have margarine in corners of pan good.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until cake begins to brown. Do not let the nut meats burn.

title: Camp Meat Venison
instructions: Heat skillet with 1/2 inch of water in bottom. When hot add venison. Cook until a little water and juice remains. Add 1 package of mushroom gravy (if available; otherwise serve as is.) Let thicken and get you a plate full before the other hunters empty the skillet.

title: English Muffin Bread
instructions: Combine 3 cups flour yeast sugar salt and soda. Heat liquids until very warm 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0 but not boiling. Add dry mixture; beat very well. Add remaining flour one cup at a time. Mixture will be \sticky.\ Spoon into two loaf pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal. Sprinkle tops with cornmeal. Cover and let rise in warm place for 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from pans immediately and cool. Slice and toast.

title: Cracker Pie
instructions: Beat eggs stiff; add sugar baking powder vanilla cracker crumbs and pecans. Put in greased pie pan. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. After pie cools spread with whipped cream and chill 1 1/2 hours or longer.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 1/2 hour. Use for spaghetti. May leave out water or cook longer to make thicker to use with lasagna noodles.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter sugar and vanilla. Mix flour and salt together and blend into butter mixture; mix in nuts. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for about 15 minutes until set but not too brown. While still warm roll in powdered sugar. Roll in powdered sugar again until cool.

title: Chocolate Mint Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa and cornstarch in a medium saucepan. Gradually add milk stirring with a wire whisk until smooth. Cook over medium-low heat stirring constantly 25 to 30 minutes or until mixture is thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in creme de menthe and vanilla. Spoon mixture into individual dessert dishes. Cover and chill thoroughly. Yield 7 servings. Low-fat and very tasty!!!

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and salt. Add milk and bring to boil over medium heat in thick boiler. Boil for 2 minutes until soft ball stage. Test in cold water. Add margarine and vanilla. Beat well 2 to 3 minutes or until it starts getting firm. Add nuts. Pour into buttered dish.

title: All In One Breakfast Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put into baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 300\u00b0 uncovered 45 minutes. Good reheated. Great when having overnight guests.

title: Chocolate Covered Marshmallows
instructions: You will also need 50 sturdy wooden picks.

title: Carrot-Pineapple Cake
instructions: Sift together into large mixing bowl flour sugar baking powder soda cinnamon and salt. Add salad oil eggs carrots crushed pineapple with syrup and vanilla. Mix until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed on electric mixer. Bake in greased and slightly floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until done. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan. Cool completely and frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Chocolate Fudge Frosting(Makes 2 Cups)
instructions: Beat until proper consistency to spread. Will cover 2 (9-inch) layers or 30 cupcakes.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding oil water and eggs together. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. While cake is still hot punch holes in top of cake with fork. Mix water lemon juice powdered sugar and butter together and pour over hot cake. Do not remove cake from pan.

title: Snow Bread
instructions: Place Swiss cheese between the sliced bread. Pour margarine over the foil wrapped bread. Sprinkle with a little Parmesan cheese and garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Jo'S Candy
instructions: Melt chips with oil and add peanuts. Mix well. Drop by teaspoons into candy cups.

title: Steamed Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place mushrooms in center of a 24 x 18-inch heavy-duty foil. Sprinkle with seasonings. Dot with butter. Sprinkle the 2 tablespoons of water over all. Bring long sides of foil together. Fold edge over three times to seal securely leaving enough room for steam expansion. Fold ends over to seal. Place foil wrapped mushrooms in a shallow baking pan. Bake 40 minutes.

title: Mustard Chicken
instructions: Dust chicken with flour. In medium skillet saute in butter until browned. Transfer to shallow baking dish. Spread each piece liberally with mustard. Saute onion and mushrooms until tender. Add parsley salt and pepper to taste. Blend in cream and stir just until heated. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Stir in lemon juice just before serving.

title: Stuffed Peppers(From Leftovers)
instructions: Boil bell peppers 3 minutes; drain. In saucepan combine all ingredients except cheese. Cook until heated thoroughly. Stuff peppers with mixture. Bake about 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. Top with cheese. Turn off oven and return peppers until cheese is melted.

title: Ranch Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly over low heat for several hours. Works well in a crock-pot.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Bring broccoli and onions to boil. Drain. Put in saucepan with butter. Add rest of ingredients. Heat and stir occasionally. Slow cook on simmer for 2 hours.

title: Chocolate Cream Taffy
instructions: Combine sugar water and vinegar in a saucepan. Stir over low heat until dissolved then boil without stirring until a small amount hardens when dropped into a glass of cold water. Flavor with vanilla. Pour into buttered plates and put a square of chocolate into the middle of each plate. Let cool until it can be handled. Pull the taffy until chocolate is pulled into taffy and is uniform color. Cut into one-inch squares. Children love to help make this taffy!

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: First Layer Crush Oreos in blender or food processor until fine add melted butter mix and press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Save 1 tablespoon Oreos for topping.

title: Aunt Lillie'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour. Knead lightly on floured board. Roll and cut cookies with favorite cookie cutter. Brush lightly with beaten egg white on cookie and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Combine squash and onion. Add meal cheese eggs and salt to taste. Form into small patties. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Impossible Chili Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate (large 10 x 1 1/2-inch). Cook and stir ground chuck in 10-inch skillet until brown; drain and stir in onion tomatoes and seasoning mix (dry). Sprinkle with olives and cheese. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth in blender or with mixer. Pour into plates. Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Serve with sour cream (optional) shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Granny Nichol'S Holiday Sweet Potatoes
instructions: In a 5-quart saucepan over high heat heat sweet potatoes and enough water to cover to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes until fork-tender. Drain potatoes; cool until easy to handle. Peel and cut into 1/2-inch slices.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix margarine chopped nuts and flour together until crumbly; press into sheet cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Beat together the Cool Whip cream cheese and powdered sugar; spread over cooled crust. Mix lemon pudding and milk; spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with Cool Whip; sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate overnight. Serves 12.

title: Southern Pecan Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix with frosting then add eggs oil water and 1/2 c. pecans. Grease tube pan well. Sprinkle remaining pecans in bottom of tube pan. Pour batter into pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes on 350\u00b0. Cool cake before taking out of pan.

title: Low-Fat Berry Bavarian
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in a large bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved. Mix cold water and ice cubes to make 2 cups. Add to gelatin stirring until slightly thickened. Remove any remaining ice. Stir in whipped topping with whisk until smooth. Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm. Garnish with additional whipped topping. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fish Pudding From Calvary Church
instructions: Bake fish with a little seasoning; bone and flake. Place in a bowl and add eggs mixing well. Add milk and half of butter half of crumbs parsley onion lemon juice salt pepper and sherry. Mix then place in buttered baking dish. Top with remaining crumbs and butter. If dry add milk. Place baking dish in pan of hot water and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Serve with tartar sauce or other favorite. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Rotkohl (Red Cabbage)
instructions: Brown onion in drippings or oil. Add cabbage apple salt pepper and caraway seed. Mix bouillon vinegar lemon juice and sugars. Add to cabbage and cook for about 15 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in a little water then stir into cabbage last. Simmer only enough for the cornstarch to thicken.

title: Biscuit Barbecups
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10 muffin cups. Brown ground beef in large skillet; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce onion and brown sugar. Cook 1 minute to blend flavors stirring constantly. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Place 1 biscuit in each greased muffin cup; firmly press in bottom and up sides forming 1/4-inch rim. Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mixture into each biscuit-lined cup. Sprinkle each with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes or until edges of biscuits are golden brown. Cool 1 minute; remove from pan. Makes 10 servings.

title: Open Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Add water and berries and boil until thickened. Add butter to sauce. Add 4 cups uncooked berries to sauce and pour into pie shell. Top pie with whipped cream.

title: Cucumber Tarragon Dip
instructions: Whirl cucumber in an electric blender until mushy. Add cottage cheese gradually then add remaining ingredients. Add more tarragon if you like. Chill thoroughly.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Warm cheese and butter to room temperature. Cream together until fluffy. Add flour and nuts; mix well. Make into rolls (3 rolls about 1 1/2-inches round). Roll each in wax paper. Chill several hours. Cut into 1/3-inch slices and place on ungreased cookie sheet one inch apart. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes only. Do not brown. Sprinkle with pepper. Store in airtight container.

title: Gloria'S Shaker Salad
instructions: Cook string beans in boiling water to cover by 1 inch. Boil briskly uncovered for 4 to 5 minutes. Drain string beans and run under cold water. Spread string beans on towel to drain. Refrigerate. In bowl combine vinegar onions thyme savory dry mustard salt and pepper. Mix ingredients well with whisk. Pour oil in mixture until smooth and thick. Add string beans lettuce scallions and toss together gently but thoroughly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: New England Clam Chowder(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Separate canned clams from liquid. Reserve broth. Fry pork until crisp; remove bits of pork. Add 2 cups clam broth (if not enough clam broth from canned clams make up difference with clam juice). Add potatoes and onion to fat also. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Add clams. Add 1 3/4 cup milk and light cream. Blend 1/4 cup milk and flour. Stir slowly into chowder. Heat to boil. Stir occasionally. Add 1/2 teaspoon dash of pepper and dash of thyme.

title: Pumpkin-Spice Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat eggs sugar oil and pumpkin. Stir in flour baking powder cinnamon baking soda salt ginger and cloves. Mix in raisins and nuts. Pour batter into pan. Bake until light brown 25 to 30 minutes. Cool; cut into bars (2 x 1 1/2-inches).

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Peel core and cut apples into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Mix together milk and oil; then beat into slightly beaten egg. Stir in lemon juice and coconut; then set mixture aside.

title: Tostato Casserole
instructions: Crumble shells or chips in bottom of cake pan. Brown ground beef. Pour in package of taco sauce mix and tomato sauce. While this simmers heat refried beans and layer over shells. Put meat mixture layer on beans and top with cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion celery and green pepper in margarine. Add soups and cheese. Cook over low heat until cheese melts. Fold in broccoli and rice. Add salt and pepper to taste. Put in casserole. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In saucepan bring to boil for 3 minutes the sugar cocoa butter and milk. Add oats peanut butter coconut and vanilla. Beat until stiff. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let stand at least 45 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of loaf pan 9 x 5 x 3-inch. Mix sugar and margarine. Stir in bananas and eggs until blended. Stir in remaining items except cereal. Stir in cereal. Spread in pan. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean 60 to 70 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients; add scalded milk and oleo (gradually put in 1 1/2-quart casserole). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Foil Dinners
instructions: Patty hamburger and season with seasoning salt. Prepare vegetables and slice thinly. Place a serving of each on top of patty and season lightly. Place in foil and wrap it. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and cook 1 hour and 15 minutes or until tender. Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Apple Walnut Cinnamon Bread(Makes Three 9-Inch Loaves)
instructions: Mix the yeast plus sugar in warm water. Let set until bubbly.

title: Carolyn'S Biscuits
instructions: Mix biscuit mix sour cream and soda together. Pat out on dry biscuit mix until dough is about 1-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter glass or whatever. Roll in melted margarine in baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Gator And Jenny'S Cinnamon Toast
instructions: Take bread and lay on flat pan. Squirt butter on bread and then shake\tsugar over butter. Take cinnamon and shake on top. Put pan in\toven on broil.\tWatch through window of oven for bread to turn brown and butter to melt. Have mom take out of oven and let cool for 1 minute.

title: Tomato Pudding
instructions: Saute celery and onions in butter to just tender. Blend in flour; mix well. Add tomatoes salt pepper sugar and mustard. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of bread crumbs. Pour into a well-greased 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake for 30 minutes. Put remaining 1 cup bread cubes on top. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake for additional 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Mix and simmer until warm. Pour over meat balls. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Place apples in shell. (Apples need to be stacked high as after cooking they will settle to the crust.) Mix flour sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle over apples. Make a crumb mixture of brown sugar butter and flour. Pat this over top of apples. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0. Turn oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Jerky
instructions: Marinate meat overnight. Lay strips across oven rack. Leave door open about 1 1/2 hours. Dry at 140\u00b0 to 150\u00b0 for 8 to 10 hours. When you complete this process you will have Jerky!

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cut chops into small bite size pieces and chop onion. Brown in skillet until done. Add drained bean sprouts. Simmer until warm. Add rice and soy sauce. Heat until warm through and through. Serves about 4.

title: Butter Pecan Dessert
instructions: Mix graham crackers soda crackers and melted butter. Spread in pan. Mix pudding and milk. Add quart pecan ice cream. Pour on top of graham cracker crust. Put in freezer until hard. Top with Cool Whip and chopped Heath bar. Set out just before serving.

title: White Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt white chocolate and mix with peanut butter. Melt Hershey bars and swirl into mixture. Let cool and cut into small squares.

title: Banana Butter
instructions: Place bananas and lemon juice in a blender or food processor fitted with a steel blade; process until smooth. Transfer bananas to large saucepan and stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 15 minutes stirring frequently. Pour into sterilized jars and seal. Store in refrigerator. Yields 3 cups.

title: Pancake Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine flour sugar soda and salt. Stir to blend well. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients. Use electric beater until blended well. Grease preheated 375\u00b0 griddle and pour 1/2 cup of batter for each pancake. Brown sausages and drain on paper towel. Roll pancake around each sausage. Place seam side down on ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. (Save a few for garnish on top.) Melt margarine and pour over cookies. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar; fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Spread over cookie layer. Mix pudding and milk. Spread over Cool Whip and cream cheese layer. Spread top of cake with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle a few cookie crumbs on top for garnish.

title: Creamy Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes and mash with pot masher or whip with electric beaters. Add chopped eggs pickles salt sugar and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Parmesan Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dip chicken in egg whites then in breadcrumbs turning to evenly coat both sides of chicken. Place in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Top with 2 cups of the spaghetti sauce and cheeses. Sprinkle with oregano. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until Mozzarella cheese is melted. Serve over hot pasta tossed with remaining 1 cup spaghetti sauce heated.

title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Beat egg with 1 teaspoon lemon juice; set aside. Combine flour garlic power and paprika. Dip chicken in egg then roll in flour. In skillet melt margarine. Brown chicken on medium heat. Dissolve bouillon in water. Add 2 teaspoons lemon juice. Pour over chicken. Simmer 20 minutes turning chicken as it browns.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Line bottom of pie plate with crescent roll dough like pie crust. Brown hamburger and onion. Add taco seasoning and tomato sauce. Put 1/2 of the chips over the dough and top with meat mixture. Spread sour cream over the meat. Add cheese over top and finish with the rest of the corn chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with lettuce and tomato salad.

title: Main-Dish Soup
instructions: Mix thoroughly beef egg bread crumbs onion salt and pepper; shape into 24 meatballs. In large heavy pan brown meat balls in shortening; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes or until noodles are done. Stir occasionally. Remove bay leaf. Makes about 7 cups.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in 1/4 stick margarine. Add soup sour cream and cheese until cheese is melted. Break potatoes into pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour mixture over potatoes. Melt 1/2 stick margarine and crushed corn flakes. Toss to coat crumbs. Sprinkle over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Mix well. Spread on ham slices. Roll up. Roll in wax paper. Freeze. To serve slice while frozen. Put on cracker.

title: Orange Punch
instructions: Put sherbet in chilled punch bowl. Pour ginger ale over this. Garnish with maraschino cherries. Serve immediately.

title: Ham Strata
instructions: In a buttered glass casserole or glass cake pan layer bread ham and cheese. Pour on a mixture of milk eggs mustard and onion salt. Make enough to cover all bread. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Sprinkle top with corn meal or crushed potato chips before baking. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8 people. Nice for Sunday morning brunch!

title: Peanut Butter Crunchies
instructions: Heat sugar and corn syrup until sugar is dissolved. Add peanut butter and cereal. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 pan. Melt chocolate chips and pour on top.

title: Sparkling Raspberry Tea
instructions: Mix tea juice and sparkling water. Serve over ice. Garnish with raspberries and mint.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Grated vegetables in a large bowl. Stir in all other ingredients except cheese.

title: Hot Mushroom Turnovers
instructions: In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed beat cream cheese flour and butter until smooth; shape into ball. Wrap. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Baked Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a deep 1-quart glass casserole. In a bowl combine ingredients. Beat until frothy. Stir in cheese. Bake 30 minutes until brown and fluffy. Serves 6.

title: Chili Pie
instructions: Lay chopped chilies in bottom of pan (approximately 7 x 11-inch glass or Corning Ware). Spread cheese on top. Beat eggs with a whisk and pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut in small pieces. Serve warm or cold.

title: Hawaiian Kabobs
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes; let cool. Pour mixture into a shallow dish; add chicken tossing gently to coat. Cover and marinate at least 1 hour in the refrigerator stirring mixture occasionally.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Butter pan being used for the cooking. Put in rice and then the chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle onion soup mix over the chicken and rice. Pour over evenly one can mushroom soup one can of milk and 1/2 can of water. Mix well. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Corned Beef And Noodles
instructions: Mix all ingredients into 2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Mix Knox gelatine and 1/2 cup water first and set aside. Heat tomato soup and blend with cream cheese. Add all ingredients. Pour into mold. Chill until firm. Serve with favorite crackers etc. or may be served as a salad.

title: Tropicana Twister Holiday Recipe
instructions: In an 8-quart punch bowl combine Tropicana Twister and ginger ale. Add small scoops of frozen yogurt (sherbet or ice cream). Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired. Makes 24 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Quiche
instructions: Mix eggs milk Bisquick mixture and cheese. Set aside. Chop vegetables and Spam and saute in butter. Mix with Bisquick. Spray glass baking dish with Pam. Pour mixture in pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours. Dont peek during cooking. Makes 4 large servings at approximately 270 calories each.

title: Skillet Pork Chops
instructions: Coat chops with flour and brown slowly on both sides in hot oil. Sprinkle with Creole seasoning. Add onion slices potatoes and carrots. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water and pour all over. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until meat and vegetables are done. May also be cooked in oven.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Wash the beets and cook in boiling water until tender. Remove the skins. Cut the beets into thin slices or cubes. Set aside. Mix the sugar cornstarch and salt. Add the vinegar. Boil the sauce for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add butter. Pour sauce over beets and let stand for a few minutes to absorb the sweet-sour flavor.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook broth and onion until onion is tender. Toast the French bread and place in the bottom of the soup bowl. Pour mixture over the bread and add as much cheese as desired. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Serve while hot!

title: A-1 Derful Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Lightly pack in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes. Drain and top with cheese.

title: Coconut Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Beat oil sugar and eggs thoroughly. Add flour mixture. Beat until smooth. Add pineapple carrots coconut and nuts. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on rack.

title: Delicious Jam
instructions: Put ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate overnight. Then put in pan and bring to boil. Simmer 15 minutes or until tender. Turn off heat. Add 1 large box cherry or peach Jell-O. Put in jars and seal. Makes 2 large plus 4 small jars.

title: Heavenly Dessert
instructions: Mix graham crackers saltines and melted butter together and press 2 cups into 9 x 13-inch pan reserving rest for topping.

title: Foil Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Peel baking potatoes and cut into slices about 1/8 inch thick. Place each half potato on double foil with 1 tbsp butter salt and pepper. Seal foil well and grill 25 minutes or until done. Serve potatoes in foil slitting open with scissors.

title: Hot Dish
instructions: Line baking dish sides and bottom with seasoned hamburger. Add sliced potatoes and onion. Add vegetable soup then cream of chicken soup. Bake for 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Plaster on your choice of meat.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Cook first 7 ingredients until thickens on low heat stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Serves 4.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Mix all together in bowl by hand (very important as mix tends to get tough). Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Do not flour. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Camaron Rebosado
instructions: Select nice fresh shrimp about 4-inches long in size. Remove the shell of the body but leave head and tail. Trim the pointed part of the head. Remove black veins by cutting partly the back. Salt to taste and soak in lemon juice then roll in flour. Drop each shrimp in beaten eggs and fry in deep hot fat until brown. Serve hot.

title: Hawaiian Pie
instructions: Bring pineapple sugar and flour to a boil. Add pie filling and dry jello. Cool 10 minutes. Add bananas and pecans. Pat into crushed pie shells. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Diabetic Delight
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use an ungreased 8-inch cake pan. In the pan sift and mix together the flour sugar soda and cocoa. Make 3 wells in the flour mixture. Put vanilla in first vinegar in the second and melted margarine in the third. Pour water over all and mix with a fork until ingredients are entirely moist. Bake 30 minutes or until done.

title: Zucchini Parmesan
instructions: After frying zucchini get a baking dish and line it with a little tomato sauce. Lay your zucchini rounds down then add a little more sauce on each round. Add some grated Mozzarella cheese and also sprinkle some Parmesan cheese. You just keep making the layers until zucchini is gone. Bake in low-heated oven until the cheese is melted. Its better if you use a flavored tomato sauce. Always top the zucchini with the Mozzarella cheese.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix together sugar and eggs. Beat well; add flour and oil. Add rest of ingredients. Bake in three 8-inch pans at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugar in saucepan until dissolved. Add vanilla cocoa and peanut butter; mix well. Add oatmeal and drop onto wax paper to harden.

title: Coleslaw Dressing
instructions: Heat first 4 ingredients in microwave until hot. Stir until sugar dissolves. Add garlic powder. Cool and toss in coleslaw.

title: Layered Mixed Vegetable Salad
instructions: In a large clear bowl layer lettuce and onions. Spoon 1/2 cup Ranch dressing evenly over top. Layer celery green pepper and peas. Spread remaining salad dressing over top. Sprinkle sugar cheese and bacon on top. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours. Add water chestnuts. Toss before serving. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Corn Bread(From The Files Of Viola Clark Williams)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in 9 x 12-inch pan greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rice Dressing
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage; drain well. Add onions bell pepper and green onions. Saute until well cooked. Mix your cooked rice with your meat and vegetable mixture; salt and pepper to taste. This is even better heated the next day.

title: Oatmeal Caramelitas
instructions: In a large bowl combine 1 cup flour oatmeal brown sugar soda salt and melted butter. Blend well to form crumbs. Press 1/2 of crumbs into bottom of 11 x 7-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and pecans. Blend caramel topping and 3 tablespoons flour. Pour over chocolate and pecans to cover. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Cut into bars.

title: Medley Salad
instructions: Cut up vegetables. Mix rest of ingredients and pour over vegetables. Mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Mama'S Beef Stew
instructions: Cook meat until done; add other ingredients and cook until vegetables are done adding catsup last. Serve with crackers or bread.

title: Drop Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add shortening and work into pastry blender. Add milk all at once. Stir until flour is moistened.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook stew meat on low in crock-pot with onion Italian seasoning and salt. Two hours before serving add soup and sour cream. Cook noodles; mix with sauce.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: To beaten eggs add buttermilk and beat again. Add oil and water. Beat thoroughly. Add each dry ingredient and gently mix after each addition. Do not overbeat.

title: Grandma'S Casserole
instructions: Saute onions celery green pepper and zucchini. Add ground turkey or ground chuck or combination of each to make one pound salt oregano garlic stewed tomatoes tomato sauce water and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Spread 8 ounce uncooked noodles in bottom of pan. Cover with sauce then cover with 8 ounces low-fat skim Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting. Cut into 8 servings. Contains 3 proteins and 1 bread plus 1 vegetable.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans; season with Accent. Combine with celery soup and 1/2 of onion rings. Put in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with rest of onion rings. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes until bubbly hot.

title: Jackie'S Low-Cal Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Cut meat into serving size pieces. Sprinkle with salt. Heat oil in large skillet. Add meat and cook; drain fat. Add tomatoes onions garlic and water or wine. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until meat is just tender. Add green peppers and cook 15 minutes longer. Skim fat; simmer sauce to thicken. Makes 6 to 8 servings at about 202 calories or less. To reduce calories add more tomatoes and peppers.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice and brown sugar. Combine flour sugar baking powder salt and egg in bowl; mix until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Kool-Aid Playdough
instructions: Mix together flour salt alum and Kool-Aid. Add boiling water and oil. Knead together. If it is too sticky add more flour. Store in airtight container and this will last a long time.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Cook pineapple juice sugar and Perma-Flo until thick. When cool add cream cheese and Cool Whip. Beat until smooth.

title: Lump Crab Meat Dish
instructions: Saute and brown onion garlic and bell pepper in 2 tablespoons of margarine. Make crumbs of the crackers. Add 1/2 of crumbs to the sauteed mixture. Add crab meat and mix well. Place in a covered casserole. Thirty minutes before serving pour the milk over crab mixture. Top with remaining crumbs. Drizzle melted margarine over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and cocoa together. Cream the Crisco and margarine until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add flour and milk alternately and beat well. Pour into tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Work together margarine and crumbs into deep square dish and pack down. In small mixing bowl cream cheese and sugar until fluffy. Put on top of wafer layer; spread can of blueberry pie filling on. Top with Cool Whip; chill.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick vegetable spray. Combine crab meat mustard margarine egg lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and seasonings. Add 2 to 4 teaspoons bread crumbs to bind. Shape into 4 cakes (use about 1/2 cup mixture each). Roll in remaining crumbs; place on prepared cookie sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned turning cakes over halfway through cooking time. Serve with lemon wedges if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Make cake in large flat pan (17 x 11 1/2-inch). Bake about 20 minutes. Make pudding with 1 cup milk. Cool. Blend cream cheese and Cool Whip. Add cool pudding to cream cheese/Cool Whip mixture. Drain pineapple. Spread Cool Whip mixture on cooled cake. Sprinkle nuts and pineapple on top. Keep refrigerated. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Shake And Bake
instructions: Mix then use on chicken or pork chops like Shake n Bake mix from the store.

title: Steak Supper In Foil
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Place 24 x 18-inch piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil in baking pan. Place meat on foil. Stir together mushroom soup and onion soup mix (dry); spread on meat. Top meat with vegetables. Sprinkle water on vegetables. Fold foil over and seal securely. Cook 1 1/2 hours until tender.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add boiling water and pineapple. Chill until firm and add 1 quart whipped topping. Fold in the angel food cake which has been broken into bite size pieces. Press mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Top with whipped topping and coconut.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix everything together except nuts and raisins in large bowl. Add nuts and raisins; mix until blended. Take a teaspoon and drop rounded spoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Leave about 3 inches between spoonfuls. Bake for about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Chili With A Zip
instructions: Brown meat then drain fat. Add onion garlic and bell pepper. Let wilt. Add tomatoes pinto and red beans chili peppers seasoning mix salt pepper and sugar. Let simmer on low heat for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar syrup salt vanilla and butter or fat. Line pie pan with plain pastry or use a premade pie pastry. Put in pecans in a layer. Add egg mixture. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 50 to 60 minutes. The nuts will rise to the top of the pie to form a crusted layer.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Combine eggs pumpkin sugar salt ground ginger ground cloves and evaporated milk. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Add cake mix sprinkled over filling. Cube margarine over cake mix. Add pecans on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Very Easy Yeast Rolls
instructions: Cream sugar salt and butter.

title: Creamy Tuna Mold
instructions: In a small pan soften gelatin in cold water; stir over low heat until gelatin is dissolved. In a small bowl combine tuna mayonnaise lemon juice and finely chopped onion; beat until smooth. Blend in dissolved gelatin sour cream and capers. Spoon into 3 1/2-cup mold; chill until firm. Unmold on a platter lined with lettuce; add garnish of cucumber slices and cherry tomatoes.

title: Tropical Chicken
instructions: Combine orange juice vinegar nutmeg and basil; set aside. Lightly coat chicken with flour. In hot shortening saute chicken until golden on all sides. Sprinkle with salt. Add orange juice mixture. Place potatoes between and around chicken pieces. Cook covered over medium heat approximately 25 minutes or until chicken and potatoes are tender. Then add pineapple with juice. Heat covered for 5 minutes. Serve at once. Garnish with parsley. Use pan drippings as a sauce if desired.

title: Tarragon Wine Mustard
instructions: Blend dry mustard and water in a small bowl. Let stand for 10 minutes. Combine wine vinegar flour tarragon salt and allspice in saucepan. Stir in mustard mixture. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Cook for 2 minutes or until thickened stirring constantly. Pour into bowl. Chill covered overnight. Beat with wire whisk until smooth. Spoon into 8 ounce jars. Store in refrigerator. Yields 2 (8 ounce) jars. Makes great holiday present!

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; chill or freeze. Thaw before serving.

title: Vinegar Pie Pastry
instructions: The indestructible pie crust. Roll re-roll and save scraps. Refrigerate or freeze.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: To make soup heat the oil in a large pot. Add the pieced tortillas reduce heat and cook until they are golden brown and slightly crisp. Add the onion and cook 3 minutes longer; add garlic and jalapeno and cook another 2 minutes. Add the chilies tomatoes and tomato paste; cook for 10 minutes. Stir in the cumin and cayenne. Slowly whisk in the chicken broth and picante sauce. Simmer the soup for about 20 minutes or until slightly reduced. Add the shredded chicken and avocado and heat until warmed through. To make garnish Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut tortillas into strips. Place the strips on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp. To serve ladle soup into 6 bowls and garnish with the grated cheese cilantro and baked tortilla strips. Serves 6.

title: Golden Age Breakfast
instructions: Mix well. Pour into greased 8-inch square baking dish. Let stand covered for at least 30 minutes or store in refrigerator overnight. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender and blend well. Bake in an unbaked pie shell for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. May be topped with Cool Whip ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Pineapple Dressing Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple into pan. Combine sugar flour and eggs. Add to juice and cook stirring constantly until thick. Remove from heat and blend in butter. Cool. Add pineapple chunks bananas and marshmallows.

title: Chocolate Pistachio Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix orange juice water eggs and oil in a large bowl. Blend to moisten then beat 2 minutes at medium speed scraping bowl occasionally. Pour about 3/4 of batter into a well-greased and floured Bundt pan or a 10-inch tube pan. Add 3/4 cup chocolate syrup to remaining batter. Mix well. Pour over batter in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or until done. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix together and bake for 40 minutes covered and 25 minutes uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven. Put cheese on top towards the end.

title: Chocolate Chip Pan Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 15-inch baking pan. In a small bowl mix flour and baking soda. In a large bowl mix butter sugars and vanilla extract. Add eggs and mix well. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate morsels and nuts. Spread mixture in pan then spread M&Ms on top. Bake 25 minutes. Cool in the pan and cut into squares. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Noodle Bake
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Mix noodles cottage cheese sour cream and onion together. Spoon into greased baking dish; top with meat sauce then top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove foil and brown.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt. add water vinegar and beaten egg. Blend well. Makes one double crust for pie.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 8 x 11-inch baking dish; add peaches. Mix flour sugar and milk; pour over top of peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Chicken Spread
instructions: Mix above ingredients well and serve with crackers.

title: Cherry And Nut Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour oleo sugar and baking powder together like pie crust then add eggs vanilla and milk mixture. Roll between wax paper and put on cookie sheet. If sticky add more flour. Put layer of dough then nuts mixture another layer of dough then add 1 can cherries (Thank You). Put lattice work on top.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Combine and cook in double boiler until thick enough. Pour into baked pie shell and chill.

title: Steak And Sweet Pepper Saute
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add half the steaks. Cook until brown on both sides about 4 minutes for medium-rare or until desired doneness. Remove steak to platter; keep warm. Repeat with remaining steaks.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given in casserole.

title: Tropical Bar Cookies
instructions: For crust Mix flour 1/4 cup sugar butter and 1/4 cup chopped almonds until crumbly. Press into 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Golden Or Banana Punch
instructions: In a large saucepan mix the sugar and water; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add the frozen orange juice. Cool. Mash or process the bananas with the juice of the lemons. Add to the first mixture. Add the pineapple juice. Stir well. Divide into two equal portions and freeze. When ready to serve place one frozen portion into a punch bowl and pour over 2 bottles or 1 (2 liter) bottle of ginger ale. Stir.

title: California Dip
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and Fluff with wooden spoon. Serve over fresh fruit (strawberries pineapple etc.).

title: Al'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add other ingredients; mix well. Bake in crust which has been baked until set. Bake for about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Frozen Ground Beef Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in heavy container with top. Cook until ground beef is done about 30 minutes. Then chop meat into large pieces. Put top back on and cook about 20 minutes longer.

title: Lemonade
instructions: Squeeze lemons in pitcher. Add lemon juice and sugar. Fill with water about 2 inches from top. Stir and chill. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Aunt Margaret'S Asparagus Supreme
instructions: Layer in casserole and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted and casserole is heated through.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Put vegetables in blender; chop. Add remaining ingredients. Cook 30 to 40 minutes after it starts to boil. Fill jars and seal. Makes 11 to 12 pints.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken on bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Place cheese on top of chicken. Cover with soup thinned with milk. Mix melted margarine with stuffing and place over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours covered with foil.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Blend together Cool Whip margarine cream cheese and confectioners sugar. In a second bowl blend together vanilla pudding milk and vanilla. Combine and mix both mixtures together. Crush Oreo cookies in a food processor until finely chopped. Layer in 9 x 13-inch dish Bottom Oreo cookies. Middle Pudding mixture. Top Oreo cookies.

title: Spinach Dip(For Vegetables)
instructions: In a covered blender blend all at high speed until finely chopped. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. You can make this 1-2 days before serving.

title: Pecan Delight
instructions: Whip egg white until foamy. Add cream of tartar; whip until stiff but not dry. Whip in sugar in small quantities at a time. Fold in crackers nuts vanilla and salt. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch dish at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and add whip topping. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Dutch Meat Loaf
instructions: In mixing bowl combine ground beef sausage bread crumbs onion and 1/2 cup tomato sauce. Beat egg and salt. Add to meat mixture. Shape into loaf in baking pan. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Drain off fat.

title: Anita'S Seacoast Salad
instructions: Prepare the macaroni as directed. Add the other ingredients. Chill. The peas may be cooked slightly or just thawed.

title: Butter Crumb Cod
instructions: Combine all ingredients except fish. Mix well. Place fish in baking dish and spread mixture over top. Bake 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes. Done when fish flakes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all together good. Bake in 2 (9-inch) cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Homemade Reese'S Cups
instructions: Melt margarine and pour over cracker crumbs. Mix well and add peanut butter.\tFold in powdered sugar then press into 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan.\tMelt Hershey bar and spread evenly over mixture. Let\tcool until chocolate\tbegins\tto harden and cut into desired sizes.

title: Can'T Leave Alone Bars
instructions: In a bowl combine the dry cake mix eggs and oil. With floured hands press 2/3 of the mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Set remaining cake mixture aside.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Save pineapple juice to dip into mixture. Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Crumb Coffee Cake
instructions: Crumb flour sugar and Crisco together. Save out 1 cup of crumb mixture for topping. Put soda into buttermilk mix into crumb mixture. Add egg salt and vanilla. Beat vigorously. Pour into large oblong baking dish. Sprinkle 1 cup crumb mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Special K Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar and syrup to a rolling boil. Set off burner. Add peanut butter and stir until well mixed. Add vanilla and cereal. Mix and drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Have peanut butter out of jar and ready to mix in.

title: Potato Dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray oblong pan with cooking spray. Add all ingredients except butter and cornflakes to potatoes. Mix; spread in pan. Mix cornflakes and melted butter; spread over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Candy Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Stir in sugar salt cocoa and milk. Bring to a boil. Boil exactly 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter then oats. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. (Cool then chill. Store airtight.)

title: Spicy Picadillo
instructions: Brown onions in drippings or butter in a large pan. Add beef and brown; drain excess fat. Add garlic cloves cinnamon tomatoes and sugar; simmer for approximately 1 hour covered. Add raisins and cumin; simmer covered for 20 minutes. Add almonds. Simmer covered for 10 minutes. Salt to taste. Serve hot in a chafing dish with chips.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Blend soup with barbecue sauce and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients together. Mixture should be very moist to ensure moistness of meatballs. Shape meatballs and quick fry until browned on all sides. Place in baking dish and bake for thirty-five minutes. Drain excess fat and then pour soup and barbecue sauce mixture over meatballs. Bake for an additional fifteen minutes or until bubbly.

title: Stuffed Potatoes With Ham
instructions: Clean and dry potatoes. Rub skins lightly with oil and Worcestershire sauce. Bake until tender (about 1 hour at 400\u00b0). Remove potatoes let cool slightly then slit open and scoop out potato. Mash potatoes then mix in sour cream ham onions salt and pepper. Stuff potato skins with potato mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes covered. Remove cover and sprinkle with cheese; return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar well beaten egg salt and chocolate. Beat well. Sift flour with baking powder and add alternately with milk. Beat again. Chill several hours.

title: Pretzel Dessert Or Salad
instructions: In mixing bowl cream together margarine and 3 tablespoons of sugar. Add pretzels. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 10 minutes in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Cool.

title: Beef Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Cook veggies until clear. Add meat and cook until pink is gone. Add water chili powder and oleo and simmer about 30 minutes or until thickened.

title: Crock Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Pour into a 6 qt. slow cooker uncovered on low 8 to 12 hours. Stir occasionally. After 8 hours check thickness. If it is too thin continue cooking until it reaches desired thickness. Fill clean pint jars and put on rims and rings. Secure tightly. Process in boiling water bath for 20 minutes. Remove jars from water. Lids should pull down as jars cool. Makes 7 to 9 pints.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Spread Oreos in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Soften ice cream and spread on top of cookies. Warm chocolate and pour on top of ice cream. Freeze. Spread Cool Whip on top. Refreeze.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Add berries last. Mix all together stirring for 2 to 3 minutes. Bake in 2 (8 or 9-inch) layer pans at 350\u00b0 until done for 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add remaining ingredients except cheese and tortillas. Simmer 10 minutes. Place rounded tablespoonfuls of meat mixture and cheese in each tortilla; roll up tightly. Place seam side down in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Top with remaining meat mixture. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. After removing from oven sprinkle with remaining cheese and serve.

title: Fudge Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar; add flour gradually. Then add soda salt and nuts. Place on a greased pan and cook in a low 250\u00b0 to 275\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Sauteed-De-Deer Backstrap
instructions: Cut backstrap into 1/4-inch thick fillets. Season with Cajun seasoning and fresh black pepper. Put flour in 1 gallon bag. Add seasoned meat and shake. Heat peanut oil in nonstick frying pan. Saute meat on both sides (2 minutes per slice). Put meat aside in ovensafe stoneware 2-quart pot. Pour off excess oil and make gravy using drippings water flour mixture and onions. Pour this over meat in stoneware pot. Add mushrooms (sliced) mushroom soup and wine. Cover roast and bake at 350\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Serve with steamed rice or mashed potatoes. Makes 4 to 6 servings. Beef round steak may be substituted.

title: Almond Tea
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil; add tea bags. Boil other 4 cups of water. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Add tea to the sugar and water mixture. Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Break broccoli into small flowerets and blanch for 3 minutes. Mix and toss all ingredients. Serves 4.

title: Holiday Potatoes
instructions: In a large bowl mash hot potatoes. Add cream cheese and butter; beat well until cream and butter are melted and mixed. Add sour cream. Blend eggs onion and milk; add to mixture. Add salt and pepper to mixture. Mix well until light and fluffy. Place in greased 9-inch round casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Cream Corn
instructions: Mix together and bake in a casserole for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: The Best Fruitcake
instructions: Lightly grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Line with waxed paper and grease the paper. Mix fruits and nuts in a large mixing bowl. Sift flour baking soda baking powder salt and sugar over mixture; toss to coat all nuts and fruits with flour. Set aside. Beat eggs until foamy then add vanilla. Pour over fruit mixture and stir just until blended. Pour into prepared loaf pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.

title: Old Fashioned Dried Apple Cake
instructions: Cook apples until soft adding enough water to have juice in apples. Melt butter; add syrup and sugar. Stir until all is melted. Remove from heat. Add slightly beaten eggs. Add flour. Mix well. Use more flour as needed to make dough stiff. Pinch off enough dough to roll out thin (about 8 to 9-inch round). Make six or eight layers. Stack layers; spread apples between each layer. Top layer will be cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Slime Cake
instructions: Make cake according to directions on box. Make and bake two 8 or 9-inch layers. Separately follow box instructions to make the vanilla pudding adding the 8 to 12 drops of green food coloring as you blend ingredients. Cover this mixture and place in refrigerator at least an hour or until you are ready to use it. (This is the slime.)

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg margarine and 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice until crumbly. Press into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually blend in sweetened condensed milk 2 eggs pumpkin and 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice. Mix well. Pour over crust and sprinkle with nuts and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Bacon Stuffed Burgers
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and discard all but 2 tablespoons drippings. Saute onions in drippings until tender. Crumble bacon; add with mushrooms to skillet and set aside. Meanwhile combine beef pork cheese pepper garlic powder and steak sauce in a large bowl. Shape into 16 patties. Divide bacon mixture and place over 8 of the patties. Place remaining patties on top and press edge lightly to seal. Grill over medium coals until well done. (Pork sausage in burgers requires thoroughly cooking). Serve on buns with lettuce if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Put flour in a deep narrow bowl (small mixing bowl). Make a well in the flour. Put the 3 eggs and salt in the well. Begin whipping with a fork. Gradually the eggs will pick up more and more of the flour. Keep whipping until you have a soft ball of dough. Dump onto well floured board. Knead more flour in until you have a stiff dough that is no longer sticky. Divide into 3 balls. Roll out about 1/8 inch thick making sure your dough is well floured on top and bottom. Pick up and turn over (should be larger than a pie shell) then cut in 3 to 4 inch wide strips. Stack; flouring well between each strip. After they are all rolled and stacked cut across stack to desired width of noodles (1/4 inch). Cook in large kettle of meat stock or just plain water that you add a teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of oil to. Takes 20 to 30 minutes to cook.

title: Portuguese Fish Chowder
instructions: In a deep kettle fry out pork cubes slowly turning occasionally until crisp bits remain. Remove these to use later. In the hot fat fry onions slowly until soft and golden. Add 6 cups cold water potatoes seasonings and vinegar. Boil until potatoes are half done. Add fish chunks. Continue cooking gently until fish is tender. Add the browned bits of pork.

title: Sweetheart Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add pineapple to sugar and boil. Add juices and cool.

title: Cherokee Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in olive oil. Add onions; cook until tender. Stir in ingredients in order given except cheese. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon into a baking dish and top with cheese. Broil until cheese is melted.

title: Rich Wild Rice
instructions: Precook wild rice. Saute onion celery and pepper in a little butter. Break up pork sausage and brown slightly. Mix with rest of ingredients and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Applesauce Raisin Cookies
instructions: While stirring ingredients in bowl simmer the raisins in tiny pan with enough water to cover them and a little to spare. Be sure to drain water from raisins before adding to dough. Cream the shortening. Add brown sugar and egg; mix well. Add applesauce. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add raisins and nuts if desired. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Turkey And Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium saucepan prepare stuffing mix according to package directions. Stir in 1/2 can onions. Spread stuffing over bottom of greased 9-inch round baking dish. Arrange broccoli spears over stuffing mix with florets around edge of dish.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into large greased casserole dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Insert butter knife in middle.

title: Yogurt Pie
instructions: Mix together yogurt Cool Whip and Sweet N Low and pour into pie crust. Chill for at least 1 hour. My favorite yogurt flavors include caramel banana cream black cherry and lemon. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix potatoes sugar beaten eggs and melted margarine. Add vanilla. Mix well and pour into two unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Soak gelatin in clam juice. Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add celery onion and rest of seasonings. Add gelatin mixture; blend well. Fold in shrimp and clams. Pour into a 6-cup oiled mold. I use a fish mold. Chill overnight. Unmold on large serving dish. May be decorated to resemble a fish or sprinkled with paprika. Serve with crackers. Will serve a large party.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Roll into 3/4-inch balls and coat with chocolate. Makes about 40.

title: Seasoned Potato Wedges
instructions: Place potatoes on cookie sheet. Combine melted margarine water and seasoning; brush over potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sausage, Potatoes And Tomatoes
instructions: Fry sausage in pan while loosening it with 2 forks to make clumps (or use your hands). Fry until browned. Add diced potatoes and stewed tomatoes. Stir periodically on low flame until potatoes are cooked.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: In mixing bowl mix together the margarine oil eggs sugar and vanilla; mix these ingredients well. Add flour cocoa salt baking powder soda cinnamon buttermilk zucchini chocolate chips and nuts. Mix for 2 minutes.

title: Glazed Kolbassi
instructions: Put into crock-pot and stir. Cut about 1-inch pieces of kolbassi into the sauce and cook about 3 hours. Enjoy.

title: Dill Mustard
instructions: In top of a double boiler combine mustard vinegar sugar water salt and dill. Cover and let set at room temperature for 4 hours. Bring water in bottom of a double boiler to a boil; add eggs to mustard mixture. Cook and stir until thickened about 10 minutes. Cool. Store in refrigerator. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Chicken Breast In Sour Cream
instructions: Arrange chicken breasts in shallow baking dish; cover with mushrooms. In a small bowl combine mushroom soup orange juice and sour cream; mix well. Pour over chicken until completely covered. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Red French Dressing
instructions: Shake all ingredients in tightly covered jar. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Or mix in a blender. Will not separate this way. Makes 2 2/3 cups.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix apples with sugar flour and cinnamon. Pour in unbaked pie crust. Beat eggs. Melt butter or margarine and mix together. Pour over apples. Bake at 325\u00b0. Easy and good.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook and drain sausage. Set aside. Cook spaghetti in water with 1/4 cup cooking oil. Set aside. Cook pepperoni in microwave just enough to get grease out of it. Layer ingredients in bowl as follows spaghetti Mozzarella cheese sausage pepperoni green peppers onion and top with Parmesan cheese. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Mix salad ingredients in the morning with the bottle of salad dressing.

title: Mom'S Raisin Cookies
instructions: Combine raisins and water in a small saucepan; bring to a boil. Cook for 3 minutes; remove from the heat and let cool (do not drain).

title: Heather'S Scottish Shortbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter. Sift together flour sugar and salt. Combine dry ingredients and butter; mix well. Pat dough into an ungreased 9 x 9-inch pan. Press down evenly. Pierce with a fork through dough every half-inch. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares while still warm.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Soak cucumbers and onions in salt water for 5 minutes. Let remaining ingredients come to boil then drain and add pickles. Boil for 5 minutes can hot.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions; drain and add salt pepper mushrooms and tomato sauce. Pour in 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Combine sour cream and herbs. Unroll crescent triangle and arrange on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until rolls are brown.

title: Cinnamon Apples
instructions: Core apples with corer. Be sure to leave apple whole and unsliced. Gently peel.

title: Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together and shape into a ball or serve in a bowl with crackers etc.

title: Quick Apple Butter Cake
instructions: Place a layer of graham crackers and a layer of apple butter until you have the desired number of layers usually 4 to 6 layers. Cover and refrigerate until you are ready to serve it.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
instructions: 1 + 1 + 2 = 1 (9-inch) pie crust.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Lightly brown onions and celery in hot oil; add flour and blend. Add broth and cook until thick stirring constantly. Add tomato juice seasoning and chicken. Heat thoroughly and serve over rice.

title: Party Chicken Breasts
instructions: Wrap each piece of chicken diagonally with a strip of bacon. Cover bottom of casserole pan with a generous layer of chipped beef. Place chicken in single layer on this. Cover with combined mushroom soup and sour cream. No salt or pepper is necessary as chipped beef seasons. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In medium saucepan put oil rice and chicken cubes. Fry until rice is browned a little breaking up the chicken cubes while frying. Add water tomato sauce garlic and onion. Turn on low and cook until all water is absorbed. Stir and serve.

title: Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cut up tomatoes. Bring to a boil long enough to soften the flesh then run tomatoes through a food mill to remove skin and seed.\tReturn tomatoes to pot boiling again.\tStir often to prevent scorching. When the puree is thick enough that the bubbles splatter can in sterilized jars and add 1/2 teaspoon canning salt to quart jar of tomatoes.

title: Debbie'S Polish Mistakes
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Spread on party rye (can be frozen now to use later or baked now). Bake on a cookie sheet for 15 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven. Will make an open-faced sandwich. Great for a party.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook sausage over low heat 5 to 8 minutes. Add onion green pepper and garlic; saute until tender. Add beans tomatoes and seasonings; simmer uncovered for about 20 minutes. Serve over the rice.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut cooked chicken into bite-size pieces. Stir mayonnaise milk vinegar pepper and salt together then add the chicken grapes celery and green pepper. Toss gently to mix. Spoon chicken salad onto lettuce leaves. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Begin 2 hours ahead. In 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat in very hot salad oil gradually cook flour until dark brown but not burned about 8 minutes stirring constantly. Stir in onion green pepper garlic salt and thyme leaves; cook until onion and green pepper are tender stirring occasionally. Open oysters and drain liquid into flour mixture; refrigerate oysters. Add tomatoes with their liquid okra and water; heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer about 30 minutes or just until mixture thickens slightly. Add oysters shrimp crab and hot pepper sauce; cook 10 minutes stirring occasionally until shrimp turn pink and opaque. Serve in soup bowl with a scoop of rice. Yields 8 servings or 14 cups.

title: Saturday Chicken(4 To 6 Servings; Closely Related To Sunday Chicken.)
instructions: Take your chicken and salt and garlic salt it a bit then paprika it thoroughly. Next spread it out in one layer in a shallow baking pan. Dilute the soup with the cream. Pour it over the chicken and sprinkle the chopped parsley prettily on top. Bake it uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. When blended add blueberries. Bake in greased muffin tins at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Will keep in refrigerator 2 to 3 weeks. (I also use chopped canned peaches.)

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs egg milk onion salt pepper and nutmeg. Shape into balls and let stand 30 minutes. Brown in hot oil. Add water and simmer 20 minutes. Add soup and cook 10 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Red Hot Dessert
instructions: Dissolve red hots in 2 cups boiling water. Add jello and applesauce. Refrigerate until set. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Pecan Pralines(Classic Creole New Orleans Recipe)
instructions: Combine heavy cream and sugar in medium size saucepan. Heat over medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture becomes golden brown and reaches the soft ball stage*. Immediately add pecans and lemon juice. Continue to cook until mixture again reaches soft ball stage. Drop praline mixture from large kitchen spoon onto oiled cookie sheet into mounds spreading each into a cake 1/4-inch thick and 4 inches in diameter. Let harden. Gently lift each praline with a spatula. Store in airtight container with wax paper in between. Pralines are extremely fragile handle with care.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix together until smooth. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Make frosting about 5 minutes before taking cake out.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar water and cornstarch for 3 minutes or until clear; add jello. Stir then cool. Slice strawberries into baked pie crust; pour cooked mixture over strawberries. Top with whipped cream when set.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix milk and vanilla pudding. Add sour cream and 1/2 carton Cool Whip. Spread 1/2 of this mixture in bottom of pan. Put a layer of vanilla wafers on top and then a layer of bananas on top of the vanilla wafers. Pour remaining mixture on top of this. Spread with other 1/2 cup Cool Whip as topping.

title: Strawberry Jam Cupcakes
