instructions: Cream sugar with shortening until fluffy add eggs and blend well. Sift together flour salt cinnamon soda and nutmeg. Add alternately with milk to creamed mixture. Fold in jam and bake in greased muffin pans in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from pan and frost with any favorite frosting. Makes 20 cupcakes.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chow mein noodles in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Top with chow mein noodles and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix butter shortening 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs. Blend in flour cream of tartar soda and salt. Shape dough by rounded teaspoonful into balls. Mix remaining sugar and cinnamon and roll balls in mixture before placing on an ungreased cookie sheet. Place 2-inches apart. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: One Bowl Chocolate Fudge
instructions: You can add marshmallows to make it sweeter.

title: Chicken Or Shrimp Saganati
instructions: In 2 teaspoons of the oil cook onions until golden; add garlic and cook 2 minutes. Add oregano cook 2 minutes more. Add ouso then tomatoes; partially cover and simmer 10 minutes.

title: All Bran Rolls
instructions: Mix stir and cool shortening water sugar All Bran and salt. Add eggs (beaten) yeast and flour; beat thoroughly. Cover and put in refrigerator overnight. Take out portions for rolls as needed. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Batter-Fried Mushrooms
instructions: Wipe mushrooms with damp cloth. In a medium bowl combine beer flour and egg. Dip mushrooms in batter. Fry in very hot oil turning with tongs until evenly browned. Drain on paper towels.

title: Triple Layer Pie
instructions: Prepare chocolate pudding with 1 3/4 cups milk. Pour into pie shell. Prepare vanilla pudding with 1 3/4 cups milk. Pour carefully over the chocolate layer. Fold chocolate syrup into whipped topping and spread over vanilla layer. Chill for 3 hours.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Put all in a crock-pot for 3 to 4 hours to really mix the flavors (or mix everything and leave it overnight in a closed container in the refrigerator and then heat as needed).

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: *Or boil potatoes with peel on them and cut in cubes if desired. Do not thaw potatoes if frozen are used.

title: Hopping John
instructions: Rinse black-eyed peas thoroughly. Place smoked ham hocks in pot covered with 3 inches of water. When water boils add the black-eyed peas. Season with a bay leaf cayenne pepper black pepper garlic powder and Cajun spice. Cover stir periodically add water if needed. Cook until peas are tender and ham hocks are done. Put rice in pot and cover with water up to first knuckle of pointer finger. Bring to boil. Once boiling stir cover and turn flame off. Allow rice to steam until cooked. Serve with chopped onion hot sauce and corn bread. Traditional Southern New Years Day dish.

title: Hot Smokies
instructions: Cook slow in crock-pot 4 hours or fast 2 hours.

title: Beef And Peppers Stir-Fry
instructions: Slice steak crosswise into 1/8-inch strips. Combine water sherry and soy sauce. Pour over beef and marinate while cutting peppers into thin strips. Quickly cook peppers in hot oil in large frying pan or wok 3 to 4 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from pan. Pour off and reserve marinade.

title: Drunken Dogs(Crock-Pot Cooking)
instructions: Cut hot dogs into bite size pieces. Bring everything to a boil. Simmer 2 hours. Eat with toothpicks.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together until consistent (batter will be stiff). Butter Dutch oven (bread pans or skillet) and pour stiff batter into Dutch oven. With knife mark an \X\ in top of batter. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until test toothpick comes out clean. Remove from oven and let cool for about 10 minutes. Remove from baking pan and serve warm or cooled. (If made as one large loaf it may take more than an hour to bake. If divided into smaller loaves decrease baking time and test for doneness.)

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix well and place in large pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
instructions: Mix the sugar and cinnamon with the apple slices. Put into unbaked pie shell.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oatmeal; let stand 20 minutes. Mix sugars and butter. Then add eggs. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Combine meat salt and pepper. Mix soup with milk or sour cream and chiles in saucepan. Heat a small skillet with oil to hot. Heat each tortilla just to soften. Dip each tortilla in sauce and place a small spoonful in tortilla. Add some chicken onion and cheese; roll up.

title: Creme De Menthe Cake
instructions: Blend well cake mix water 2 tablespoons creme de menthe oil and egg whites. Beat at medium-high for 2 minutes. Pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until top springs up when depressed. Cool thoroughly. Chill.

title: Hobo Dinner
instructions: Lay 1 (12 x 15-inch) piece of aluminum foil on table. Place hamburger and onion slice; salt and pepper. Next add carrots and potatoes; salt and pepper again. Close up foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually. Mix well. Add milk and vanilla; mix well. Chill about 2 hours. Drain cherries. Pat dry with paper towel. Shape small amount of sugar mixture around cherries. (Make sure to keep sugar mixture on ice while shaping the mixture around the cherries.) Allow cherries to chill about 2 to 3 hours.

title: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and boil potatoes. Drain water and add butter cream cheese and sour cream. Mash or mix with mixer. Put in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Quick Skillet Meal
instructions: Brown ground beef with chopped onion; drain. Add beans rice water and tomatoes. Bring to a boil and simmer until rice is done. Top with any kind of cheese and serve over crunched chips of any kind.

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Cook spaghetti drain. Combine with remaining ingredients. Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart loaf or casserole pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. May be turned out of pan for serving.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: For each serving spread dressing or mayonnaise and salsa on tortilla. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with lettuce and meat. Roll up wrap each tortilla in a plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate-Oatmeal Crispies(Makes 30 Cookies)
instructions: Partially melt chocolate in double boiler over medium heat. Remove from heat and stir until all is melted. Cool. Sift flour soda and salt. Set aside.

title: Applesauce Salad
instructions: Boil water; add candies. Dissolve and add Jell-O and dissolve. Remove from stove. Add applesauce.

title: Creamy Lemon Meringue Pie(Makes One 8 Or 9-Inch Pie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl beat egg yolks; stir in Eagle Brand and ReaLemon. Pour into crust. In small bowl beat egg whites with cream of tartar until soft peaks form; gradually add sugar beating until stiff but not dry. Spread meringue on top of pie sealing carefully to edge of shell. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until meringue is golden brown. Cool. Chill before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pork Chop Surprise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use large roasting pan; slice onions on bottom. Place chops on sliced onions be sure not to overlap. Slice potatoes in quarters; place on chops. Combine soup with 1 can of water. Pour over ingredients; top with salt pepper and chopped garlic. Bake 2 hours in covered roaster. Serves 6.

title: Nanna'S Red Hot Salad
instructions: Cook applesauce until thick. Dissolve red hots in hot water. Add gelatin and stir to dissolve. Add applesauce. Pour half into mold or 2-quart casserole. Chill until firm. Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise; stir in celery and nuts. Spread over gelatin and chill. Pour remaining applesauce mixture over cream cheese mixture. Chill until firm. Cut into squares and serve on lettuce leaf with mayonnaise if desired.

title: Salad Cheese Balls
instructions: Beat egg white. Mix with it the cheese and seasoning. Mold in small balls and roll in cracker crumbs. Place in the refrigerator for 1 hour or until the egg dries on the outside. Drop in deep fat or oil and fry to a golden brown.

title: Easy Chocolate Freeze
instructions: Line 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with waxed paper. Extend over sides. Mix crumbs with 6 tablespoons margarine; set aside. Melt 7 squares chocolate and margarine over very low heat stirring constantly. Cool. Beat eggs in large bowl. Beat in sugar at high speed of mixer until thick about 10 minutes. Fold in chocolate mixture and vanilla then 4 cups of Cool Whip. Spoon about 1 1/2 cups into pan. Sprinkle 2/3 cup cookie crumbs; press lightly. Repeat layers. Freeze overnight. Garnish with remaining Cool Whip and drizzle with chocolate.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Fry onion in bacon drippings. Drain. Brown sausage meat and drain. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Put in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and butter. Add powdered sugar and evaporated milk. Cook until thick and smooth stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Store in quart jar.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes and eggs; cool and peel and cut into pieces. Add other ingredients pickle cubes onion pimientos and mustard. Add salt; mix in mayonnaise. Put in bowl and sprinkle top with paprika.

title: Lumberjack Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large pot and bring to a boil then let simmer for 2 to 3 hours. Tastes great over rice.

title: Vitella Con Peperoni(Veal With Peppers)
instructions: Cut veal in 1-inch cubes. Cut peppers in 1/2-inch slices. Fry onions and peppers with olive oil for 15 minutes or until tender. Cook veal in separate pan with olive oil for 10 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook for 20 minutes. Add peppers and onions to veal and simmer for 15 minutes over low heat. Serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Mix the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Combine first bowl of ingredients into last bowl. Chill.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dice or chop cucumbers tomatoes and onions into very small pieces. Add all ingredients together in a salad bowl. Toss with a spoon. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Turkey Roll-Ups
instructions: Cook the turkey in a pan until done. Combine the cooked turkey with the chilies spinach soup and cheese; mix well. Spread the mixture evenly over the tortillas and roll each one up. Use toothpick to secure. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pecan Cheese Ring
instructions: Place cheeses onion mayonnaise and cayenne pepper in a large bowl. Stir until well combined. Place a 3-inch custard cup upside down in the middle of a 10-inch spring-form pan. Sprinkle half of the pecans in the bottom of the pan. Spread cheese mixture on top of pecans. Cover with plastic wrap and chill the mixture until firm at least 1 hour.

title: Cheese Egg
instructions: Scramble eggs in bowl. Cut up cheese and put in bowl. Pour in skillet and cook (scramble) until done. Amanda loves this for breakfast.

title: Oreo Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Pour margarine over cookies. Spread ice cream on top of cookies. Mix chips milk and sugar and drizzle over top of ice cream.

title: Jewel Box Jello
instructions: Take the red orange and lime Jell-Os and dissolve each in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Pour into 8-inch square pans and chill until firm.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Keep popcorn hot and crisp in 300\u00b0 oven. Butter sides of saucepan. Mix together remaining ingredients except vanilla. Cook to hard ball stage (250\u00b0). Add vanilla. Pour slowly over hot popped popcorn stirring just to mix thoroughly. Butter hands lightly; shape into balls. Makes 15 to 20 balls.

title: Lord Baltimore Cake
instructions: Cream shortening; gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Combine flour baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix just until blended after each addition. Stir in flavorings. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans; cool completely. Frost.

title: Aunt Blondie'S Chili
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except macaroni) together and cook for about an hour (simmer). Add cooked macaroni for about the last 10 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk beating until well blended. Fold into topping mixture. Ladle into pie shell. Freeze until firm. Serve frozen. Store any leftovers in freezer. Recipe makes 1 large pie. Double recipe makes 3 (9-inch) pies. (March 1986.)

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Place wings on cookie sheet; drizzle butter over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn; bake 15 minutes more. Pour sugar and soy sauce over top. Bake 15 minutes; turn. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Herbed Cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl; stir well. Use the cheese as a filling for snow peas celery sticks cherry tomatoes or cucumber slices. Can use as a spread for party bread. Yields about 2 cups.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine Jell-O sugar and water in a pan and dissolve. Add pineapple juice and cranberry juice. Pour into containers and freeze.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs oil vanilla and buttermilk. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Jerry'S Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Measure flour and put in a medium bowl. Cut in shortening until flour becomes coarse crumbs. Blend in just enough milk with a fork until dough leaves sides of bowl. (Too much milk makes dough too sticky to handle; not enough milk makes biscuits dry.) Knead gently on lightly floured surface 10 to 12 times.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix oleo 1 1/2 cups sugar eggs vanilla flour baking soda cream of tartar and salt together. Form small balls and roll in mixture of 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 6 to 8 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion salt and pepper. Place into casserole dish. Pour corn on top. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 until it begins to bubble around edges. Remove and cover with Tater Tots. Return to oven until Tater Tots are golden brown.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Press each biscuit flat. Place into ungreased muffin pan bringing dough up to edge of pan. Spoon meat mixture into cups. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo in casserole dish and arrange chops on top. Sprinkle over soup mix and rice. Cover with water. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 adding more water if necessary. You can also add a package of frozen peas if desired about 15 minutes before removing from oven.

title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
instructions: Heat oven at 325\u00b0. Beat eggs until frothy. Stir in sugar and oil; beat. Add zucchini pineapple and vanilla. Beat. Sift together all dry ingredients. Add to zucchini mix. Beat until well mixed. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan; remove to wire rack. Cool and serve. Will freeze until ready to serve.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix milk flour sugar and egg in a bowl. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan then pour can of cherry filling on top of ingredients. Stir around. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Date Nut Loaf
instructions: Mix together into loaf. Wrap in wax paper and chill.

title: Cranberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Combine the gelatin and the boiling water. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in cold water. Set aside. Combine the cranberries orange pineapple pecans and sugar. Mix well. Stir into gelatin mixture. Mix well. Chill until firm. Serve with creamy fruit sauce. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Mix margarine Crisco and sugar together. Mix well. Add eggs one at a time. Add milk alternately with flour. Add flavorings and then the walnuts; mix well. Pour into a greased and floured tube cake pan and bake starting in a cold oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Pour into a greased cake pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fern'S No Trouble Pickles
instructions: Slice medium size cucumbers lengthwise; pack cold in quart jars. Add 1 tsp. salt and pinch of alum in each jar. Dissolve sugar in vinegar and water; boil rapidly. Pour over cucumbers in jars and seal. Process in boiling water bath for about 10 minutes or until they begin to change color.

title: My Grandmother'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Measure flour soda ginger salt and cinnamon. Cream Crisco until soft. Gradually add sugar creaming after each addition until light and fluffy. Blend in egg and molasses. Add flour mixture. Form teaspoons of soft dough into small balls by rolling them lightly between palms then roll dough balls in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Deviled Celery Sticks
instructions: In a small bowl mix together meat spread pickles capers onion pepper Worcestershire sour cream and walnuts. Fill celery sticks with this mixture. Arrange on serving plate. Cover with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes about 1 cup filling.

title: Party Tortillas
instructions: Mix cream cheese and Hidden Valley Ranch powder together. Blend in chopped green onion and Cheddar cheese. Spread mixture over tortilla. Sprinkle equal amounts of pimentos black olives and green chiles over tortilla.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook chicken breasts; debone and cut into chunks. Cook broccoli. Mix soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder over low heat. Place broccoli in a greased casserole dish. Put chicken on top of broccoli and pour sauce over chicken. Top with grated cheese then buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Patrice'S Mayonnaise Muffins
instructions: Mix mayonnaise with flour and sugar; add milk and mix. Spoon into greased muffin pans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Place all ingredients except coconut in electric blender. Cover and blend at low speed for 2 minutes. Pour into a lightly greased and floured 9 or 10-inch glass pie plate. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. This pie makes its own crust.

title: Egg Sausage Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Sprinkle cheese on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Marinated Shrimp Salad
instructions: In a blender or food processor process vinegar oil onions parsley garlic salt basil and pepper until well blended. In a medium bowl combine shrimp and red onion. Pour vinegar mixture over shrimp mixture; stir until well coated and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend. Serve chilled. Yield 4 cups.

title: Party Sandwich For A Crowd
instructions: Cut bread in half length-wise. Hollow out top and bottom of loaves leaving 1/2 inch shell. Discard removed bread or save for another use. Combine cheeses onion mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce; spread over cut sides of bread. Layer ham and roast beef on bottom and top halves; place pickles on top of bottom half. Gently press halves together and wrap in plastic wrap; refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Cut into 1 1/2 inch slices. 12-14 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Brown ground meat; drain. Drain squash. Place all ingredients in casserole reserving 1/4 cup cheese for top. Mix well. Top with cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown onion in hot fat. Add meat and seasonings; brown. Add drained beans and soup. Pour into greased casserole. Mash potatoes; add milk egg and seasonings. Spoon in mounds over meat. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix water and sugar; bring to a boil. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well. Chill before serving. Makes two gallons or 40 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Chop onions garlic and celery. Beat egg. Mix beef sausage and crumbs. Add onion garlic celery and egg. Mix well. Add milk ketchup and seasonings. Mix well. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in a loaf pan. Pour tomato sauce over top. Bake for another 15 minutes. Take out of pan and pour rich sauce over the top.

title: Kookoo Sabzi(Fried Herb Patties)
instructions: Break eggs in a large bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of oil salt and pepper. Beat well. Add chopped herbs and greens. Mix well.

title: Banana Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and beat at low speed for 2 minutes. Pour into a 9 x 5-inch pan greased on the bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 65 minutes or until springs back when lightly touched.

title: Chex Party Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Heat butter or margarine in shallow baking pan in oven until melted. Remove. Stir in salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add Chex nuts and pretzels; mix until well coated. Heat for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Spread on paper towels to cool.

title: Goulash
instructions: Mix together and put into a baking dish. Cover with cheese and bake until hot through and the cheese is melted.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Combine egg whites corn syrup water sugar and cream of tartar in top of double boiler. Beat for 1 minute at high speed to blend. Place over boiling water and beat until mixture forms peaks when beater is raised about 7 minutes. Remove from boiling water. Add vanilla and continue beating until thick enough to spread. Frost top of cake and sides. Top with fresh coconut if desired.

title: Stromboli
instructions: If you like peppers or anything else you can add it along in your filling.

title: Kielbasa With Sauerkraut And Potatoes
instructions: Put sauerkraut into a saucepan and mix with kielbasa cut into 1/2-inch chunks. Heat to boiling then simmer an hour or more. Peel and cut potatoes into bite-size pieces then cook separately until nearly done. Add potatoes to sauerkraut kielbasa mixture at end of hour discarding potato water. Cook until done and flavors have mixed. Sauerkraut will make potatoes feel firm even when done. Serve with cornbread.

title: Helen'S Seasoning Mix
instructions: Mix in large bowl to get evenly mixed. Store in empty spice containers or canning jars. If the spice containers are not 3 ounce size cut back on salt. Use to personal taste.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together; beat until light. Add eggs cream and vanilla;\tmix well. With flour baking powder and salt (sifted together) add to shortening sugar eggs cream and vanilla mixture.\tBlend well. Shape into 3 to 4 balls. Chill 1 hour. Roll out and cut in doughnut shapes. Bake 8 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until delicately brown.

title: Delicate Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Pour the lemon pie filling into the baked pie shell. Beat egg whites until fluffy. Add cream of tartar and sugar gradually beating until stiff. Pour meringue on pie. Place pie in oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Norwegian Apple Cake
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar; blend well. Add eggs; blend well. Sift dry ingredients. Add butter and sugar mixture (batter will be stiff). Add apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Drizzle with 10x sugar to make it special.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix all but last ingredient and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown about 25 minutes.

title: Valley Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a small bowl combine 1/2 cup sugar 2 tablespoons flour nutmeg and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples tossing to coat well. Spoon apples into pie crust. Drizzle with lemon juice. In a bowl combine 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup flour; cut in butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Slide pie into a brown paper bag and fold end over twice. Fasten with paper clips and place on a cookie sheet. Bake 1 hour. Serves 6-8.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump pineapple and pie filling in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix over. Cut butter and dab over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Boil mushrooms in mixture for 2 minutes. Cover and let cool. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt butter; mix with cornbread dressing. Line an 8 x 12-inch pan with half the cornbread dressing mixture. Set aside. Cook squash until barely done; drain and mash. Saute onion; add to squash along with the rest of ingredients. Put in pan; cover with rest of cornbread mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until bubbly and slightly browned. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Banana Freeze Pop
instructions: Cut banana in half insert sticks in cut end.\tRoll in peanut butter then in\tcrushed peanuts. Wrap loosely and freeze.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Fix beef roast until done and cut up in small pieces. Cook all ingredients together for a good 1/2 hour.

title: Potato And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine soup cottage cheese sour cream and milk mixing until well blended. Add all remaining ingredients except cheese; mix lightly. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with cheese; continue baking until melted.

title: Zucchini Cookies(A Favorite With The Cookie Monster.)
instructions: Mix together egg oil sugar and molasses until well blended. Combine flour salt nutmeg cinnamon and baking soda. Add oats and zucchini and mix. Drop by 1/4 cup portions onto greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a spoon. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 12 minutes. Makes 12 large cookies.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage. Combine sugar milk and vinegar. Mix well until thick. Toss lightly with cabbage. Makes about 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim fat from beef.\tCut beef with grain into 2-inch strips. Cut strips across grain into 1/8-inch slices. Toss beef 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 teaspoon cornstarch the salt 1 teaspoon soy sauce and white pepper in glass bowl. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Cut each tomato into 8 wedges. Cut green peppers into 1-inch pieces. Cut onion into 3/4-inch pieces. Mix 1/4 cup chicken broth 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons soy sauce and the sugar. Heat wok until 2 drops of water bubble and skitter. Add 3 tablespoons vegetable oil. Rotate to coat. Add onion ginger root and garlic. Stir-fry until garlic is light brown. Add beef.\tStir-fry until beef is\tbrown about 3 minutes. Remove beef from wok. Add 2 tablespoons vegetable oil; rotate to coat side. Add tomatoes. Stir-fry 30 seconds. Stir in 1/2 cup chicken broth. Heat to boiling.\tStir in\tcornstarch mixture. Cook and stir until thickened. Add green peppers and beef. Stir-fry 30 seconds. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sour Cream Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in ungreased muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Dough will keep in refrigerator for about a week. Makes 12 rolls.

title: Potato Wedges
instructions: Melt butter in shallow pan. Wash potatoes leaving the peel on. Cut into wedges. Mix dry mixture in mixing bag. Add 4 to 5 potato wedges; shake until potatoes are coated. Lay potatoes in pan with melted butter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn potatoes every 15 minutes.

title: Crazy Cookies
instructions: Melt chips in double boiler. Remove from heat and add noodles and nuts. Mix well. Spoon on cookie trays and refrigerate. Keep stored in refrigerator.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Make into small balls. Bake on cookie sheet for about 15 minutes or until light brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Porcupine Balls
instructions: Blend the soup and water set aside. Mix the ground beef onion baking powder milk and rice together. Make into walnut size balls and place into a 2 1/2-quart casserole and gently pour soup mixture over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes. Uncover for 15 minutes. Very good with mashed potatoes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter (3 tablespoons) in a 9-inch layer pan in oven. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Arrange fruit in sugar mixture in pan. Mix 1/3 cup butter with sugar until creamy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Mix flour baking powder and salt thoroughly. Mix pineapple juice into creamy batter. Spread batter over fruit in the pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool a few minutes in pan (so topping doesnt run). Loosen cake from sides of pan. Place service plate over pan and turn over.

title: Boston Fish Chowder
instructions: Cover fish with cold water and bring to boiling. Use water for fish stock. Fry bacon until crisp; remove from pan. Brown onion in hot bacon fat. Cut potatoes into cubes and add to fried onions. Strain fish stock into onions and potatoes and cook until potatoes are soft (10 minutes). Flake cooked fish and add to potatoes. Add milk butter and seasonings and reheat. Sprinkle parsley and dill and bacon bits on top before serving.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa milk and margarine in saucepan. Bring to boil. Cook for 2 minutes after mixture reaches a full boil. Stir frequently. Remove from heat; add vanilla salt peanut butter and oatmeal. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Remove when cool. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Punch chops with meat tenderizer and lemon pepper. Fry in oil and a little garlic salt. Just brown this in a casserole dish.

title: Fish Almondine
instructions: Separate whites and yolks of eggs. Beat yolks and whites separately. Dip fish into yolks then into cracker crumbs then into egg whites and roll in crushed almonds. Fry in butter. Excellent for salmon or steelhead steaks.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain off grease. Mix ground beef with soup spaghetti and rice. Put in casserole dish and top with sliced cheese grated cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 until cheese melts and casserole is bubbly.

title: Sweet-Sour Cucumbers
instructions: About 1 hour before serving or up to 2 days before in large bowl combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 45 minutes to blend flavors stirring occasionally. Makes 4 cups.

title: Fettush
instructions: Break bread into bite size pieces; cut all vegetables into small pieces. Mix bread and vegetables in salad bowl. Add remaining ingredients mix well and garnish with black olives. Serves 6.

title: Party Dessert
instructions: Mix Dream Whip according to package. Add softened cream to Dream Whip. Fold in pineapple and marshmallows. Better if refrigerated overnight.

title: Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Spread clean pumpkin seeds on a cookie sheet. Let them dry overnight. Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine butter and salt; toss with seeds. Bake for 50 minutes stirring every 10 minutes or until seeds are lightly browned.

title: Oreo Crust Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Boil for 15 minutes the chocolate evaporated milk sugar and butter. Cool mixture and spread over ice cream and top with Cool Whip and nuts. Return to freezer until ready to eat.

title: Luann'S Microwave Spice Chicken
instructions: Mix V-8 vinegar hot sauce oregano and garlic powder. Marinate chicken breasts in this mixture for 1/2 hour; reserve marinade. Place chicken breasts on microwave-safe plate and cover with plastic wrap; microwave on Medium-high for 10 minutes. Place cooked chicken back into marinade and add celery green pepper and onion. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Mix cornstarch into marinade and chicken until blended and place in microwave on High for 2 minutes. Serve over rice with remaining marinade.

title: Chili-Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown and crumble sausage. Drain. Set aside. Melt Velveeta in top of double boiler or in microwave. Add chili chili powder and sausage. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix soup mayonnaise and cheese together. Stir in broccoli; pour into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Crush crackers and cover top; dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice together. Add pecans and drained fruits. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in 2 (9-inch) prepared pie shells and refrigerate.

title: Knox Blox
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill. Once set cut into bite-sized cubes.

title: Sherbet Punch
instructions: Empty sherbet into a punch bowl. Pour in ginger ale. Baste the sherbet with the ginger ale until it begins to melt. Slice lime and float in the punch. Garnish with mint leaves.

title: Beef And Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Slice beef into small pieces. Mix sugar soy sauce baking soda cornstarch water and oil. Add beef and marinate 1/2 hour. Lightly coat wok with oil. Cook garlic and ginger root on medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes then add beef marinade; stir often. Cut broccoli into small pieces. Place in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes; drain and rinse with cold water. Add cooked broccoli to beef. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over beef and broccoli. Cook and stir until beef and broccoli are well coated. Serve over white rice.

title: Easy Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and sugar. Dissolve yeast in water and mix into flour. Stir. Place in greased bowl for 1 hour. Knead well on lightly floured surface. Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Roll up and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch rolls. Cover; let set overnight at room temperature. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Frost.

title: Hominy Pie Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in hot oil add flour tomato and seasonings. Brown hominy and onion in\toil add to meat mixture. Place in casserole sprinkle with cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli-Chicken Cups
instructions: Be careful in your selection. Do not choose too young or too old. When selected give your entire thoughts to prepare for domestic use. Some wives insist upon keeping them in a pickle others are constantly getting them into hot water and some just dont care. This may make them sour hard and sometimes bitter. Even poor varieties may be made sweet tender and good by garnishing them with patience understanding and some real consideration. Sweeten them with love and season with kisses. Wrap them in a mantle of charity. Keep warm with a steady fire of domestic devotion and serve with peaches and cream. Thus prepared they will keep forever.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. In another bowl mix the last 3 and then combine all 6. Crush a package of Oreo cookies. Mix some in and pour the rest over the top.

title: My Best Fudge Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa in boiler. Add margarine milk syrup and salt. Heat to boiling stirring frequently. Boil vigorously 3 minutes. Stir occasionally. Cool. Beat in 4x sugar and vanilla.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Grease shallow baking dish. Cook and drain broccoli. Blend mayonnaise lemon juice and soup. Arrange broccoli in dish; top with chicken. Pour sauce over. Top with crumbs butter and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Macaroni
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese according to package directions. Add chicken and soup. Heat thoroughly.

title: Corn Vegetable Medley
instructions: In saucepan heat soup and milk to boiling stirring often. Stir in vegetables. Return to boiling. Cover; cook over low heat 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring often. Stir in cheese. Heat through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheese Souffle
instructions: Make a white sauce of flour butter and milk; add the beaten egg yolks seasoning and grated cheese. Stir until cheese is melted. Let stand a few minutes to cool. Add stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in a casserole in moderate oven about 25 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Truffles(From A 1930 Chocolate Lovers Hershey Cookbook)
instructions: Cream butter. Combine 2 cups of the sugar and cocoa. Stir into butter. Add flavoring to milk and beat into the creamed mixture. Add enough sugar to make a manageable dough. If dough is too soft may be placed in refrigerator to chill.

title: The World'S Best Cookies
instructions: Combine sugars and butter. Cream until fluffy. Add egg; mix well. Add oil and vanilla; mix. Add oats cornflakes coconut and nuts; stir well. Sift together flour soda and salt; add to mixture and combine well. Form into balls the size of walnuts. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork dipped in water. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Easy Tomato Aspic
instructions: Heat tomatoes to boiling; lower heat and simmer 2 minutes. Add rest of ingredients and stir until Jell-O is dissolved. Chill until set.

title: Chocolate Cherry Bars
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased and floured 15 x 10-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. (If using 9 x 13-inch pan bake for 25 to 35 minutes.)

title: Chicken Under Glass
instructions: Place chicken breasts in long baking dish in a single layer. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In large saucepan combine sugar cocoa and milk. Bring to a rapid boil. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat add butter and oats. Mix well. Drop on wax paper by spoon about 2-inches apart. Let cool.

title: Green Bean And Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Drain 1/2 juice from beans. Mix soup and beans. Season to taste. Cook for 15 minutes on medium heat. Sprinkle chow mein noodles on top; bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cream Cheese Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together cream cheese sugar and 1 egg; blend and set aside. Combine dry ingredients. Add oil and 3 eggs; mix all together. Fold in apples and nuts. Reserve 2 cups of batter. Pour remaining batter into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Carefully spoon cream cheese mixture over batter. Spoon over the 2 cups of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine milk cream and vanilla pudding mix in a mixing bowl. Whip until thick and then whip in the peanut butter. Place filling in a baked pie crust. Top with whipped cream and chill overnight.\tGarnish with sliced almonds before serving.

title: Grandma Evan'S Hot Dutch Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage (do not overcook). Combine everything but milk. Cook in double boiler. Stir constantly until thickened. Remove from fire and add milk. Beat with wire whip. Pour over cabbage.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Brown meat. Add water. Cover and cook slowly for 1 hour. Combine brown sugar cornstarch vinegar pineapple juice and soy sauce stirring constantly until thickened. Pour over pork; let stand 10 minutes. Add green pepper pineapple and onion. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Vegetables should remain crisp. Serve over rice.

title: Easy Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Boil chicken and cool. Debone and chop. Boil spaghetti in chicken broth until tender. Drain and reserve broth. Saute celery and onion in butter until tender. Mix all ingredients in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish and add enough broth to moisten well. Garnish with additional cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Smoothie
instructions: Melt white chocolate and butterscotch in top of double boiler. Stir in peanut butter. Put in little papers and cool.

title: Easy Turkey Asparagus(4 Servings)
instructions: Combine soup mayonnaise and lemon juice. Place asparagus in 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Top with turkey. Pour soup mixture over turkey. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Top with cheese and onion rings. Bake for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Granny'S Peach Preserves
instructions: Boil ingredients until the mixture sheets from a spoon about 20 to 30 minutes. Remove it from the heat and add a few chopped maraschino cherries. Pour into jars and seal.

title: Justin Wilson'S Garlic Bread
instructions: Slice bread lengthwise. Mix margarine or butter (softened) garlic and pepper. Spread mixture over bread. Sprinkle cheese over. Wrap in foil and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Cook over low heat until mix forms a ball. Stir constantly. Drop on wax paper and knead to remove lumps. Store in plastic bag.

title: Quick Mac And Meat
instructions: Brown meat and drain fat. Cook and drain macaroni. Mix tomato soup macaroni and meat. Eat and enjoy.

title: Special K Treats
instructions: Heat on low until sugar dissolves. In separate bowl pour mixture over 6 cups Special K cereals. Roll into balls and place on wax paper.

title: K.F.C. Chicken(Original)
instructions: Mix and shake in plastic bag. Put 1/4 pound of butter in pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cherry Coke Salad
instructions: Heat juice from cherries and pineapple. Pour over jello to dissolve. Add softened cream cheese. Stir until almost smooth. Cool. Add cherries pineapple Coke and nuts. Chill in desired container to congeal.

title: Teriyaki Marinade For Flank Steak
instructions: Place all ingredients for marinade in blender then marinate meat in a covered dish or Ziploc bag up to 24 hours. Barbecue and enjoy!

title: Three Cheese Chicken Bake
instructions: In a skillet saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender. Remove from the heat. Stir in the soup mushrooms pimentos and basil; set aside.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Cut up chicken and bake for 1/2 hour. Put pieces of cooked chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour cream of chicken soup and milk over the chicken. Mix stuffing butter and broth together. Sprinkle this mixture on top of chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan put 1/2 the stuffing mix. Cut meat into bite-size pieces and spread over dressing. Mix soup milk and water. Pour over casserole. Top with cheese if desired. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Middle East Tabouleh Salad
instructions: Wash burghul with cold water and drain at once squeezing all the water out. Add lemon juice oil salt and pepper. Stir well. Let stand a few minutes or until burghul has absorbed the lemon and oil. Sliced and chopped vegetables must be pretty dry so that when you add the burghul which has been mixed with oil and lemon juice it will not be soggy but hold together better. Add mint last if you want.

title: Lunchbox Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In large bowl combine margarine and shortening. Add sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Stir in flour and baking soda; stir in cereal and nuts. Mix well and drop by level tablespoonful on ungreased cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Bake 9 to 11 minutes until golden. Cool 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet.

title: Surprise Meringues
instructions: Beat egg whites salt vanilla and cream of tartar until peaks are stiff. Add sugar gradually; beat until stiff. Fold in chocolate bits. Cover cookie sheet with paper bag and drop on by rounded teaspoonful. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool before removing.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix rice and broccoli. Saute in butter; onions and celery. Add cream of mushroom soup Cheez Whiz and salt and pepper. Mix this with rice and broccoli. Pour in casserole dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach and drain. Squeeze liquid out when draining spinach. Mix all ingredients thoroughly; chill 2 hours or more. Roll into balls one inch in diameter. Freeze or refrigerate until ready to use. Bake about 30 minutes until golden. Makes 4 to 5 dozen balls.

title: Potato-Cheddar Soup
instructions: Cook bacon in heavy soup pot until crisp. Drain all but 1 tablespoon bacon grease. Add onion chicken broth carrot potatoes and seasonings. Add water to cover. Simmer until vegetables are tender. Add flour to hot water in covered jar and shake to make a smooth thin paste. Slowly add to simmering soup stirring constantly. Cook 5 minutes to thicken. Add sherry and cheese. Stir until cheese melts. Correct seasonings. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix the oleo eggs and 1 1/2 cups sugar together real good then add dry ingredients. Roll into balls size of walnuts. Mix the 2 teaspoons sugar and the cinnamon. Roll the cookies into the sugar-cinnamon mixture; bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Garlic Beans
instructions: Put beans in bowl. Place garlic buttons around in beans. Mix vinegar cooking oil sugar and pepper. Pour over beans. Cover and place in refrigerator. Leave overnight. Drain off all liquid and serve.

title: Frosted Coffee Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and brown sugar. Add egg and hot coffee. Sift next 4 dry ingredients and add to the first mixture. Add raisins and nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Frost while still hot with confectioners sugar.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Coat large saute pan with oil. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Brown chicken over medium heat allow 7 minutes each side or until no longer pink. Sprinkle chicken with cumin garlic powder and Mexican spices before turning. Remove chicken to a platter allow to cool. Saute onion and garlic in chicken drippings until tender. Add corn and chiles. Stir well to combine. Add canned tomatoes saute 1 minute. Pull chicken breasts apart by hand into shredded strips. Add shredded chicken to saute pan combine with vegetables. Dust the mixture with flour to help set. Microwave tortillas on high for 30 seconds. This softens them and makes them more pliable. Coat the bottom of 2 (9 x 13) pans with a ladle of enchilada sauce. Using a large shallow bowl dip each tortilla in enchilada sauce to lightly coat. Spoon 1/4 cup chicken mixture in each tortilla. Fold over filling place 8 enchiladas in each pan with seam side down. Top with remaining enchilada sauce and cheese. Bake for 15 minutes in preheated 350 degree oven until cheese melts. Garnish with chopped cilantro chopped scallions sour cream and chopped tomatoes before serving. Serve with Spanish rice and beans.

title: Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar and eggs. Mix in milk powder salt and flavoring. Add flour in small portions. Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until very light brown. If cooked too long they will get hard. Otherwise cookies are light and fluffy.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake by directions on box. When you take it out of the oven make holes in cake with wooden spoon handle. Pour condensed milk and caramel into holes after the two have been mixed together. Cool cake in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Top cake with Cool Whip and crumbled Heath bars.

title: Frozen Chocolate Mousse(10 To 12 Servings)
instructions: *Optional Substitute 2 cups graham crackers or butter cookies or animal cookies or Nilla wafers or...and 1/4 cup melted butter for crust.

title: Black'S Brown Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together pour in covered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pop-Up Pizza Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese with hamburger and simmer 10\tminutes. Pour\thot meat mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and cover with cheese. Pour Pop-Over Batter over cheese covering completely.

title: Chocolate Pudding Delight
instructions: You will need an 8 1/2 by 11-inch ungreased pan.

title: Daddy'S Hamburger Supreme
instructions: Mix together ground beef potato carrot onion spices and egg. Shape into patties; brown on both sides in Crisco in a heavy skillet. Remove patties onto a plate with paper towel to absorb grease. Add soup water and pimentos to skillet mix well and bring soup mixture to a slow boil. Return patties to skillet top with green pepper slices and spoon soup mix over top. Cook 45 minutes over a simmering heat on top of stove. If desired serve with mashed potatoes using gravy over the potatoes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer about 10 minutes. Then its ready to use.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips and cheese; blend well. Spoon into a lightly greased casserole; sprinkle with potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven until cheese melts. This recipe makes six servings.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter margarine and cream cheese well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour beating until batter is smooth. Add vanilla. Pour into a greased and lightly floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Salmon Confetti
instructions: Drain salmon. Reserve liquid. Cook macaroni. Saute onion green pepper and celery in butter for 10 minutes. Stir in flour. Cook stirring for 2 minutes. Add milk; stir until thickened. Stir in reserved salmon liquid salt and pepper and 2 cups cheese. Cook stirring until cheese is melted. Stir in pimento salt and pepper. Combine macaroni and salmon mixture in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until very hot.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into bite sized pieces (this should take about 2 months). Add brown gravy to cover. Salt and pepper. Cook over a kerosene fire about 4 weeks at 465\u00b0. Makes about 3800 servings. If more guests are expected add 2 rabbits. Do so only if necessary however as most people do not like hare in their stew.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes. Mix all ingredients and chill. Serves 12.

title: Apple Bundt Cake(Very Healthy)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix juice oil egg whites sugar and vanilla together; add apples and stir well. Add rest of ingredients; mix thoroughly. Spray Bundt pan with nonstick spray; add batter and bake for 1 hour. Let cool before removing from pan. Serves 24.

title: Salisbury Steak Patties
instructions: Combine these first ingredients cover and refrigerate for a short time. Then make into 6 large patties and brown in 3 tablespoons bacon drippings. When browned add 2 cans of beef gravy 2 tablespoons sherry and 1/4 pound fresh mushrooms.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown the ground beef. Drain off grease. Stir in pizza sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes on medium-low heat. While this is cooking split English muffins in half and toast in oven. Put ground beef and pizza sauce mix on muffin halves and top with half slice of cheese. Broil in oven until melted. Quick supper. Kids love these.

title: A.1. Chili(Serves 6)
instructions: In a large heavy pot over high heat cook beef green pepper onion and garlic stirring frequently until beef is browned about 15 minutes. Stir in chili powder. Cook stirring for 1 minute. Drain tomatoes reserving liquid. Chop tomatoes and add tomatoes and liquid steak sauce and water to beef mixture. Heat to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer 45 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Pecan Chewy Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening. Add sugar. Cream together. Add well beaten eggs. Add vanilla and the sifted dry ingredients. Fold in nuts. Bake in a shallow pan (8 x 12-inch) greased and floured at 350\u00b0.

title: One Step Pound Cake
instructions: Combine cake ingredients in a bowl and beat at low speed for 3 minutes. Bake in greased and floured 12 cup tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes. Cool.

title: Coconut Balls
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and cook about 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat add nuts and Rice Krispies blend well and shape into balls while it is hot and roll balls in coconut.

title: Cottage Cheese-Tomato Appetizers(Low Calorie)
instructions: Cut small slice off bottom of tomatoes and set flat. Cut thin slice from tops and spoon out centers with melon baller or spoon and discard. Invert and chill.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish one layer deep. Mix sauce and bring to a boil. Pour over chicken and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 1 to 1 1/4 hours until tender.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Mix with milk and sugar and slowly beat in Cool Whip and vanilla until mixed. Cube cake or tear into small pieces and put in deep glass bowl in layers 1) cream cheese mixture 2) pieces of cake and 3) cherries (spoon in juice along edges so that it runs down sides). Continue layers ending with cream cheese and cherries on top. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms
instructions: Saute first 6 ingredients together for 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and white wine. Simmer for 10 minutes. A great side dish for chicken.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon reserving about 3 tablespoons drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Cook onion in reserved drippings until tender. Stir in pork and beans brown sugar catsup Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours or in microwave on High for 15 minutes. Stir; top with bacon. Let stand a few minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Oreo Supreme
instructions: Mix 3/4 Oreos with margarine reserving 1/4 of the Oreos. Pat in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix pudding and milk; pour over Oreo mixture. Spread 12 or 16 ounces of Cool Whip over pudding mixture. Sprinkle with reserved Oreos. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise. Remove yolks and mash. Combine yolks crab meat celery bell peppers and salad dressing. Mix in sour cream. Blend well. Refill egg halves. Chill.

title: Cheese Cake Chilled
instructions: Combine ingredients into large bowl with electric mixer and mix on medium speed 2 to 3 minutes. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill about 2 hours and add whipped cream on top.

title: Famous Meat Loaf(Serving 100)
instructions: Mix thoroughly and make into firm loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 in convection oven until done about 1 hour. To test stick a fork in the middle. If no red juice comes out on fork it is done.

title: Okra With Corn And Tomatoes
instructions: Prepare okra as directed. Fry bacon until crispy. Remove bacon and reserve grease. In a medium size pot stir okra corn onion salt and red pepper sauce into reserved bacon grease. Cover and cook over medium heat until corn is tender. Stir in tomatoes; simmer for a while longer. Stir in bacon. Simmer an additional 4 minutes. Sprinkle fresh pepper over vegetables.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken in seasoned water. Remove chicken when done to cool. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth left after cooking chicken. Drain all but 3/4 cup of broth off spaghetti. While spaghetti is cooking saute onion and pepper in butter until soft. Add sauteed vegetables and remaining ingredients to cooked spaghetti. Add boned chicken meat. Heat until cheese is melted. Salt and pepper to taste. Add Tabasco to your families taste.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple (reserve juice add enough water to equal 1 cup). Heat this cup liquid dissolve black cherry jello in the hot liquid. Add pie filling and pineapple to jello let set up in refrigerator. Beat cream cheese add sour cream sugar vanilla and add pecans. Spread over set jello.

title: Peanut Butter Icing
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Ice peanut butter cookies when mixed thoroughly.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Rinse bean sprouts under running cold water; drain. Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in 10-inch skillet until hot. Rotate skillet until oil covers bottom. Cook and stir mushrooms in oil over medium heat until coated about 1 minute. Add bean sprouts rice chicken and onions; cook and stir over medium heat breaking up rice until hot about 5 minutes. Push rice mixture to side of skillet. Add 1 tablespoon vegetable oil to skillet. Add eggs; cook and stir over medium heat until eggs are thickened throughout but still moist. Stir eggs into rice mixture. Stir in soy sauce and white pepper. Makes 4 servings.

title: White Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender. Pour into container and refrigerate. When marinating meat especially poultry use glass or plastic dish. Marinates best overnight. Also acts like a tenderizer.

title: Lemon Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: In a bowl combine the egg sugar lemon peel and milk; mix well. Stir in the biscuit mix just until moistened. Fold in blueberries. Pour into greased 9 inch round baking pan.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles(Servings:  4)
instructions: Cover cucumbers onions and salt with water and let set overnight. In morning drain. Cook adding rest of ingredients until transparent. Pack hot in pint jars. Makes 10 to 12 pints.

title: Sweet Dills
instructions: Drain liquid from dill slices. Layer pickles. Then cover with sugar layer of pickles then sugar alternately until all pickles are used. Alternately turn jar over each day until all sugar is dissolved.

title: Holderkuchlein(Elderberry Fritters)
instructions: *50-50 oil and butter works best.

title: Relish Tray Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Chill. Serve with raw vegetables or chips. Makes 1 quart dip.

title: Grandfather Lee Christmas Fruit Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening salt and extract and blend. Add sugar gradually and cream well. Add eggs and mix well. Sift flour and soda and add to creamed mixture alternating with milk mixing thoroughly. Add fruit and nuts and blend. Drop small rounds on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0. Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Huckleberry Salad
instructions: First Layer Mix 2 packages jello 2 cups hot water and 1 cup cold water. Let jell.

title: Pauline'S No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil together the sugar butter milk peanut butter and cocoa for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add oats coconut and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper. Allow to cool.

title: Pineapple Cherry Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Mix well the first 4 ingredients. Add 7-Up. Do not overbeat. Grease and flour lightly 2 (10-inch) cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese and seasoning mix. Layer on tray. Put taco sauce over cheese. Put tomatoes lettuce cheeses and olives next. Serve with taco chips to scoop.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Slice all vegetables together. Cook noodles and drain. Add noodles to vegetables; add Italian dressing and chill. Serve with bacon bits.

title: Better Than Ever Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed. Poke holes with wooden spoon when cake comes out of oven. Pour Eagle Brand milk carefully in holes. Cover with caramel topping. Let cool and refrigerate. Cover with Cool Whip then sprinkle with Heath bars.

title: Betty Crocker Wedding Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease bottoms of pans with shortening; dust with flour. Beat all ingredients in large bowl on low speed scraping bowl until moistened. (Batter will be thick.) Beat on medium speed 2 minutes. (Batter will be lumpy.) Pour into pans evenly. After baking cakes measure about 2 inches in center. Run knife through remaining batter. Refrigerate remaining batter. Bake as directed or until toothpick comes out clean. Bake 30 to 40 minutes depending on size of pans.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in shallow baking pan. Place 1/2 slice of Swiss or Mozzarella cheese on top of each breast. Mix soup with wine and pour over chicken. Sprinkle top with dressing mix. Drizzle butter over mix. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Baked Seafood Bisque(Servings:  4)
instructions: Make white sauce from butter flour milk and seasonings. When thickened add cheese and sherry. Combine with thawed seafood. At this point it may be refrigerated or frozen. Put in individual ovenproof dishes. Top with remaining cheese and crumbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes until brown and bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Oreo Fudge Pie
instructions: Spread ice cream in crust; top with fudge sauce. Freeze until firm about 6 hours. To serve garnish pie with whipped topping and cookies. Makes 8 servings.

title: Low-Fat Chili
instructions: In a large pot brown ground round; stir in chopped onions and pepper and brown until onions are transparent. Add chili powder; stir and add tomatoes and beans. Cook on low heat approximately 1 1/2 hours. Top with shredded cheese if desired.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and butter. Line a 9 x 13-inch dish with 1/2 mixture. Blend cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Spread 1/2 of this mixture over cracker crumbs. Top with cherry filling. Add remaining cream cheese mixture; top with remaining crumbs. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Beat together shortening egg yolks sugar and sorghum. Sift together all dry ingredients. All alternately with the cup of hot water. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over pork-n-beans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Gingerbread
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Start oven 10 minutes before baking. Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with salt soda and spices with beater. Cream butter until smooth; add sugar and egg and beat until smooth and fluffy. Add molasses and beat hard 2 minutes longer. Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately. Turn batter into pan and bake 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or sauce.

title: Ham And Chicken Supreme
instructions: Cut ham and chicken into bite-size pieces.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain spinach in the box. Beat egg yolks. Mash cream cheese and add both to the hot mushroom soup. Add spinach beaten egg whites and Parmesan cheese. Put in buttered casserole. Bake 15 minutes. Last 2 minutes top with onion rings and add a little cheese to top.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a 10-inch skillet cook zucchini and onion in margarine or butter until tender about 10 minutes. Stir in seasoning.

title: Baked Cheese Ball
instructions: Open crescent roll dough and press seams together. (Dough should be a rectangular shape.) Place cream cheese in center of dough; coat with dill or chives. Fold dough together to cover cream cheese block. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Take out and brush with beaten egg. Return to oven for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 until golden brown. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Add all other ingredients. Place in buttered casserole. Top with crumbled Ritz crackers and dots of butter. Bake for 25 or 30 minutes in 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Poor Man Fruitcake
instructions: Heat applesauce and margarine. Add spices. In large bowl beat eggs and sugar. Add flour one cup at a time. Mix well. Add other ingredients. Bake 3 hours at 300\u00b0 in tube pan.

title: Albondigas Soup
instructions: In medium bowl combine ground beef rice egg cilantro seasoned salt and ice water. From into small meatballs. In a large saucepan combine broth with vegetables and garlic powder with parsley. Bring to a boil. Add meatballs. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Preserved Cucumbers
instructions: Wash small cucumbers and pack in fruit jars. Make liquid of water salt and vinegar. Pour over pickles until jar is full then seal. These are good eating as salt pickles.

title: Chicken Chop Suey
instructions: Cook chicken and shred in long thin strips (1 to 1 1/2 cups). In a skillet heat cooking oil and saute onions until lightly brown. Add celery cabbage and salt; cook for 5 minutes. Add chicken soy sauce and broth. Cook over low heat. Cover until vegetables are done. To thicken broth use cornstarch or flour (blend with 1 tablespoon cold water). Serve hot. May add additional vegetables.

title: Cara Jeanne'S Cranberry Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Mix flour sugar baking powder salt and baking soda. Stir in butter or margarine until mixture is crumbly. Stir in orange peel orange juice and egg just until all flour is moistened. Stir in cranberries and nuts.

title: Pots De Creme Au Chocolat(Mousse)
instructions: In a 1-quart saucepan over medium heat heat half and half until tiny bubbles form around edge of saucepan (do not allow half and half to boil). Stir occasionally with rubber spatula. Remove double boiler top to work surface and with rubber spatula beat egg yolks into the melted chocolate until smooth then stir in sugar. Gradually stir half and half into the chocolate mixture until thoroughly blended. Replace double boiler top over simmering (not boiling) water. Cook stirring constantly until mixture coats back of spoon about 15 minutes. Stir in 2 teaspoons vanilla extract. Pour mixture into 6 (6 ounce) cups or stemmed glasses. Refrigerate for about 4 hours or until mixture has set.

title: No Bean Chili Dip
instructions: In pie plate spread cream cheese evenly on bottom. Pour no bean chili over cream cheese. Spread taco cheese over chili place in microwave until cheese on top is melted. Do not overcook. Serve with taco chips.

title: Chess Bars
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl until crumbly. Press mixture into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cover with topping.

title: Creamy Strawberry Jello Dessert
instructions: You will need a decorative jello mold pan or any deep glass pan like a casserole pan. Prepare 4 hours ahead of time.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Mix all 6 ingredients with electric mixer. Stir in crumbled cheese. Makes about 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Hamburger And Corn Pone Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onions in shortening. Add seasonings and tomatoes. Cover; simmer over low heat for 15 minutes. Add beans. Pour meat mixture into greased casserole. Top with corn bread batter spreading with wet knife. Bake for 20 minutes in a 425\u00b0 oven.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir until smooth. Cook for 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add the milk. Cook over medium heat stirring until thick and bubbly. Stir in the potatoes salt and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes or until all ingredients are thoroughly heated.

title: Iron Skillet Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Put shortening in 9 inch iron skillet. Heat in oven because skillet must be very hot when batter is put into it. Mix corn meal salt soda and sugar in bowl. Add boiling water to coat the meal (improves texture). Add buttermilk eggs and baking powder. Mix well. Remove hot skillet from oven pour excess melted fat into batter mix again quickly and pour batter into hot pan. Bake 20-25 minutes. Brown top quickly under broiler.

title: Italian Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a greased quart dish arrange half the potatoes and half the onion. Sprinkle with half the cheese (both); repeat layers. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In small bowl combine soup milk Italian seasoning and garlic powder; spoon over potatoes. Cover and bake one hour. Uncover; bake 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Short Cut Blind Pigeons
instructions: Mix meat egg rice garlic powder and salt. Steam coarsely chopped cabbage (drain). Layer cabbage and meat mixture in casserole. Mix tomato soup and tomatoes together. Pour over mixture. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. One-third cup rice makes 1 cup cooked rice.

title: Nutmeg Log Cookies
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients. Beat in sugar and eggs. Mix in flour nutmeg soda and salt. Shape in long rolls on sugared board about the size of your finger. Cut in 2-inch diagonal lengths. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Traditional English Muffins In A Loaf
instructions: Grease and sprinkle with cornmeal two 8 x 4-inch loaf pans. Combine 3 cups flour with yeast sugar salt and soda. Heat milk and water until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to dry ingredients and beat well. Stir in remaining 3 cups flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into prepared pans. Sprinkle tops with cornmeal. Cover and let rise in a warm place free from drafts for 45 minutes.

title: Turkey Salad Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all but cheese and chips and put in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle top with cheese and then chips. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Divinity Candy
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and water in saucepan. Bring to a boil over low heat stirring to dissolve sugar. Cook to hard ball stage (250\u00b0). Beat egg whites stiff but not dry. Add gelatin 1 tablespoon at a time. Beat until peaks form. Pour syrup in fine stream over beaten egg whites until mixture will stand in peaks and loses its gloss. Add nuts. If too stiff add a few drops of hot water. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Cut eggplant lengthwise. Scoop out insides leaving 1/3-inch in shell. Cook in saucepan with little water until tender. Drain. Add butter and rest of ingredients (egg last). Mix well put in eggplant shells and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve as main dish or side dish.

title: Yogurt Pie
instructions: Congratulations to all of the parishioners staff and priests of St. Marys Church of the Immaculate Conception. The past 150 years have been filled with great events as your community of faith has continued to steadfastly grow in the gospel. May the next 150 years be so filled with Gods abundant blessings. Good luck in all of your endeavors and may peace and happiness fill your hearts.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix together and spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Cookie Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Set aside. Put 1 stick oleo cocoa oil and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil; pour over flour etc. mixture. Then add eggs buttermilk and soda. Mix well and bake in an ungreased cookie sheet pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Cookies
instructions: Melt chips in a double boiler and pour over noodles and peanuts. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Cool 1 hour.

title: Turkey-Noodle Parmesan
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan prepare noodles according to package directions; drain. In same saucepan combine soup milk 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese and black pepper. Add noodles and turkey. Over low heat heat thoroughly stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with parsley and Parmesan cheese. Garnish with onion strips if desired. Prep time 20 minutes. Cook time 10 minutes.

title: Rose'S Pimiento Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Serve on bread or with crackers.

title: Chicken Cutlets
instructions: Marinate cutlets in eggs water paprika and garlic for 2 hours. Bread marinated chicken in seasoned bread crumbs and saute in margarine. Place browned chicken in oblong casserole dish lined with foil. Add chicken broth wine cheese mushrooms etc. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove foil cover and bake 15 minutes more. Serve over rice.

title: Tomato Potato Soup
instructions: Saute onion in oil until soft. Add tomato paste garlic powder and water and bring to a boil. Add potatoes and simmer until soft. Add oregano and salt. Just before serving stir in cheese. Serve in mugs for a special treat. Serves 7.

title: La Donna'S Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes. Add sugar then stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Sift together flour baking powder salt and spices. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Pour into a 15 x 10-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Have a hand or dish towel sprinkled with powdered sugar ready. Remove cake from pan at once and place on towel. Roll up in towel and cool.

title: Golden Crumb Broccoli
instructions: Cut up broccoli to make about 6 cups. In saucepan cook broccoli covered in small amount of boiling salted water for 15 minutes; drain well. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix soup mayonnaise cheese pimiento and lemon juice. Pour over broccoli. Top with crushed crackers. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Graduation Sandwiches
instructions: Chop chicken and celery fine. Add salad dressing and seasonings. Blend well. Trim crusts from bread. Spread with spicy chicken mix. Roll to form diplomas then tie with narrow ribbon or use pimento slices.

title: Apple Chip Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs. Add salt baking soda cinnamon flour and vanilla. Add apples and walnuts. Bake in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Do not cover tightly to store.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients and cook 1 hour; stir often. Put in jars. Put in hot water bath for 15 minutes.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt butter over low heat and add cocoa. Mix flour and sugar together and add eggs and vanilla. Combine both mixtures and pour into greased pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corn-Potato Chowder
instructions: Heat margarine in saucepan until melted. Stir in onion and cook until tender. Stir in package potatoes with sauce mix water and milk. Heat to boiling stir frequently. Reduce heat cover and simmer stirring frequently until potatoes are tender (20 to 25 minutes). Stir in corn with liquid salt pepper and red pepper sauce. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes more. Recipe can be doubled just as good the next day reheated.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs 1/4 c. sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in half of Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Prepare pudding as directed on package using 3 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill several hours or overnight. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding. Garnish with grated chocolate or chopped nuts if desired. Makes 15 servings.

title: Baked Beans And Ground Beef
instructions: Rub chicken with butter and salt. Pour drippings over chicken as it bakes. Bake at 375\u00b0. Bake a 2 to 2 1/2 pound chicken for 1 1/4 hours a 2 1/2 to 3 pound chicken for 1 1/2 hours and for a 3 to 4 pound chicken 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Wilted Cabbage
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and set aside. To fat in pan add onion sugar vinegar salt and pepper. Stir. Add shredded cabbage. Cook on medium heat uncovered for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Drain and place in dish. Sprinkle with bacon and serve.

title: Ranch Vegetables
instructions: In casserole dish mix dressing mix and oil. Add frozen vegetables and toss. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes.

title: 5 Day Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers. Put in gallon jar with garlic and dill. Mix vinegars and salt and pour over cucumbers. Put in refrigerator for 3 to 5 days or longer. Serve cold.

title: Plum Cake
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar cocoa and shortening. Add plums and raisins. Gradually stir in flour and salt. Mix well.

title: Spicy Franks
instructions: Cut franks in 1-inch pieces. Brown in butter. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Stir now and then.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Prepare salad in a large bowl. Add ingredients one at a time as given each in a separate layer. Do not toss. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

title: Emerald Cabbage
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add cabbage celery green pepper onion salt and pepper. Cover and cook vegetables over low heat 10 to 12 minutes stirring mixture often. Serve at once.

title: Crabmeat Bites
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spread on split muffins and freeze. Broil 5 to 8 minutes until brown. Cut in quarters.

title: Jiffy Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt honey and butter together in a saucepan; pour over popped corn in a large mixing bowl. Toss until corn is well coated. Add nuts and mix. Spread corn mixture on greased cookie sheets and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until browned. Stir corn mixture in oven if it begins to brown unevenly or burn.

title: Cold Pack Mustard Pickles
instructions: Mix cold and pour over packed cucumbers. Makes 12 quarts.

title: Chess Squares
instructions: Mix together. Press into 9 x 13 lightly greased pan.

title: Pizza Duds
instructions: Mix ingredients and spread on slices of cocktail bread. Broil until it bubbles.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients; add water. Beat egg in measuring cup and add mayonnaise to fill to 1 cup. Add all together and mix. Lightly grease 8 x 8-inch pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix and jello; add oil then water. Stir until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Add 1 package frozen strawberries. Makes 3 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs with 1/4 cup sugar and butter. Press firmly in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in half the whipped topping. Spread over crust. Prepare pudding as directed on package using 3 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill several hours or overnight. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding layer. Garnish with grated chocolate and/or chopped nuts.

title: Okra And Tomato Gumbo(Microwave)
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients. Cover tightly and microwave for 10 to 15 minutes on High. Taste to see if seasonings need adjusting. Good served over rice. A Southern dish that is very tasty!

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour into baked pie shell. Top with cherries if desired. Cool and serve.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cream in Dutch oven. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer 13 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
