Pour hot mixture into blender a little at a time and puree until smooth. Return soup to Dutch oven. Stir in light cream and heat 2 more minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Creamy Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut steak into small pieces; add salt and pepper. Place in crock with sliced onion and bell pepper. Pour mushroom soup over all. Cover and set at low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Lay chicken in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soups and sour cream together; pour over chicken. Crumble Ritz crackers over top. Sprinkle with poppy seed and almonds. Pour melted butter over the top; cook for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pecan Dream Cookies
instructions: Sift flour cornstarch and powdered sugar. Cut in butter with pastry blender until soft dough forms. Add nuts using hands if necessary to work until it is smooth and holds together. Chill until dough is firm enough to handle.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream margarine and brown sugar substitute. Add egg and vanilla; cream until light. Combine dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients to margarine mixture alternately with milk; stir in chocolate chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until brown. Makes 36 cookies. Exchange One cookie equals 1 bread and 1/2 fat and contains 100 calories.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Stir in cream cheese soup and water; let cream cheese melt. Simmer but do not boil. Cook noodles according to package directions. Pour meat mixture over noodles.

title: Lemon-Buttered Broccoli(Microwave)
instructions: Place broccoli in 2-quart casserole. Cook covered on full power for 7 1/2 to 10 1/2 minutes or until tender. Stir to break apart halfway through cooking time. Drain and set aside.

title: Tostada Grande
instructions: In a large skillet brown ground beef; drain well. Stir in seasoning tomato sauce chilies and Tabasco sauce; heat until hot and bubbly. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes or until mixture thickens. Lightly grease a 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Separate rolls or biscuits; arrange in pan. Press over bottom and up sides to form crust. Spread beans over dough. Top with meat mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 22 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Sprinkle immediately with cheese. Garnish with lettuce tomato and onion. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Crawfish Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream with cream cheese. Add celery onion salt pepper and lemon juice to taste. Mince crawfish tails and add to the cheese mixture. Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

title: Cucumber And Tomato Salad
instructions: Slice and peel cucumbers into thin circles. Slice tomatoes (peel if you wish). Mix all ingredients together. Serve chilled.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix the first three ingredients above and spread 1/2 of mixture in a buttered and floured 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Bake 350\u00b0 for seven minutes.

title: First Birthday Cupcakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line muffin cups with paper baking cups. In large mixer bowl stir together flour sugar cocoa baking soda salt and baking powder. Add eggs shortening buttermilk and vanilla. Beat on low speed of electric mixer 1 minute scraping bowl occasionally. Then beat on high speed for 3 minutes. Fill muffin cups 1/2 full with batter. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from pan to wire rack. Cool. Frost with One-Bowl Buttercream Frosting. Garnish as desired. Yields about 2 1/2 dozen cupcakes.

title: Peanut Butter Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill. Serve with raw vegetables chips or crackers.

title: Salsa Verde
instructions: Prepare onions and peppers; remove stem end and seeds from peppers. Dice onions and saute in heavy small pot. When golden add garlic. After a minute add diced hot peppers. Simmer for 10 minutes adding water to keep to stew consistency. Add tomatoes and simmer another 5 minutes. Add a little flour for thickening and adjust with water to maintain stew to soup viscosity. Add salt and a little vinegar for bite. Good on most things.

title: Italian Burgers
instructions: Mix beef onions sweet peppers basil oregano garlic and black pepper. Shape into 4 burgers. Coat a nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and warm over medium-high heat. Add the burgers and brown on both sides. Add tomatoes and cook for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve burgers on toasted bread and top with 1 tablespoon cheese and 1 tablespoon of tomatoes and another toast slice.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Boil chickens with salt and pepper. Take off bone. Save 2 quarts stock.

title: Amish Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs together; stir well. Sift together the flour baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon. Stir in with the first ingredients. Add vanilla grated zucchini and nuts. Put in 2 greased loaf pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Hot Vegetable Dish
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Crush Ritz crackers and mix with butter. Place on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot or bubbly.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Pour over the hash brown potatoes in casserole dish. Mix the margarine and crushed corn flakes. Spread over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix soy sauce sugar Accent ginger and oil in bowl. Pour over chicken wings. Marinate overnight or put in Ziplock bag with chicken and freeze.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream by hand the sugar vanilla and eggs. Add oil. Mix together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Add nuts then fold in 4 cups of diced raw apples (6 medium sized Winesaps are best). Put in a well-greased and floured sheet cake pan. Sprinkle a 6 ounce package of butterscotch chips over top of batter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 50 minutes. Do not use mixer.

title: Herbed Biscuits
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl. Cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture is crumbly. Add buttermilk stirring with a fork just enough until ingredients are moistened.

title: Mom'S Peach Marmalade
instructions: Wash peel and pit peaches. Put through food chopper using a fine blade. Place in saucepan with lemon juice sugar and butter. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in pectin and marmalade. Let cool stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Pour into hot jars and seal. Makes 5 pints.

title: Chicken Florentine With Fresh Mushrooms
instructions: In medium size saucepan combine chicken breast and onion with water to cover. Cover and poach over medium-low heat until just white throughout about 20 minutes. Meanwhile melt margarine in a large frying pan. Add mushrooms and cook until tender about 5 minutes. Preheat broiler. Place spinach in an 8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg salt and pepper to taste. Arrange chicken in single layer over spinach. Top with mushrooms. Sprinkle with cheese. Broil 1 to 2 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Butter Frickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients and with a teaspoon drop mixture on greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cookies are puffed but still soft. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Stir together the flour baking powder and salt. Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in egg until blended. Add flour mixture and pineapple. Stir only until moistened. Turn into paper lined muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 12 large or 24 to 36 tiny muffins.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix all with a spoon. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Ice while hot with

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cook raisins in cup of water 5 minutes and cool. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and mix well. Add raisins and vanilla then add dry ingredients which have been mixed together. Add nuts last. Drop by teaspoon on a greased tin pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0 (until light brown). Batter may be stored in refrigerator and baked as desired.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease bread pan. Sift together first three ingredients set aside. In a large bowl gradually cream margarine and sugar together until fluffy. Add eggs and milk. Alternately add bananas and dry ingredients to margarine and sugar mixture. Mix thoroughly after each addition. Add nuts if desired. Bake for one hour or until a toothpick when inserted into middle of loaf comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Fake Pineapple
instructions: Remove peeling and seeds from squash. Grate squash. Mix all ingredients well and simmer for 20 minutes. Pour into sterilized jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Process 30 minutes in hot water bath.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine. Stir in other ingredients. Spread on top of potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit And Nut Fudge
instructions: Put the sugar milk and molasses in a saucepan. Stir until dissolved. Boil to 238\u00b0 or until a little of the mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Stir in the butter and chocolate. Allow to cool. Beat until creamy. Add nuts fruits and vanilla. Pour into greased tins. When cool cut into squares.

title: Bing Cherry-Coke Salad
instructions: Drain juice from cherries and pineapple. Set aside. Heat juice enough to dissolve jello. When cooled add cokes. When slightly thickened stir in fruit. Pour into mold or bowl and refrigerate until congealed. If desired add chopped nuts at this time.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Add a small amount of dressing to beef; set aside to cool. Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl. Add beef and mix together. Crunch up Doritos; add right before serving.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Mix thoroughly; place in jars and seal.

title: Quick Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk together thoroughly. Fold in Cool Whip; stir with spoon until smooth. Pour into the crust; chill for 2 hours. Its light and fresh!

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Mix first five ingredients and set aside. Place carrots in 9 X 13 pan. Sprinkle with 1/3 of onions. Place broccoli over carrots sprinkle 1/3 of onions. Place cauliflower on top and sprinkle with remaining onions. Pour oil mixture over all and refrigerate overnight. Before you serve drain off oil mixture and toss.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix all ingredients together. Marinate overnight stirring several times. You can garnish with cherry tomatoes cut in half before serving.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cut up bacon; fry with onion until bacon is crisp and onion is transparent. Add vinegar and water to pan; when heated add sugar to taste (sweet and sour). Slice boiled potatoes into large ovenproof dish. Pour hot dressing over potatoes; toss and place in warm oven until served. Cover to avoid dryness.

title: Gingered Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle pork chops evenly with salt pepper and sage. Saute chops in margarine in a large skillet about 10 minutes on each side until browned. Remove meat; set aside. Add mushrooms and spices to skillet; saute until mushrooms are tender. Stir in orange juice; cook 2 minutes longer. Return meat to skillet; heat until piping hot.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Season pork chops with salt pepper and garlic salt. Then mix honey and mustard. Pour over pork chops and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Brenda'S Spicy Chili
instructions: In skillet cook onions and ground beef together until beef is brown and onions are translucent. Salt and pepper to taste. Drain and empty into a large pot. Add remaining ingredients. Add 4 to 5 cups of water and bring to a rapid boil. Simmer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add to melted butter and egg and beat well then add orange juice and beat again. Fold in cranberries and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
instructions: You also need parchment paper.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook on top of stove until thoroughly mixed. Ready instantly to use in case you forget to buy ready-to-use at store.

title: Parmesan Onion Canapes
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Spread on bread. Place on a baking sheet and broil about 2-3 minutes. The canapes should be golden and bubbly. Makes 36.

title: Cereal Cookies
instructions: Cream fat until soft. Add sugar gradually; cream until fluffy. Add the well beaten eggs. Sift the soda with the flour. Add the remaining ingredients. Drop on greased cookie sheets; bake in 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Copper Pennies Salad
instructions: Slice carrots and boil in salted water until fork-tender. When cool alternate layer of carrots pepper rings and thinly sliced onion rings.

title: Pinto Bean Nachos
instructions: Put chips on a baking sheet. In a saucepan heat beans and salsa until hot. Spoon over chips then sprinkle with cheese bake at 350 degrees until cheese melts. Add jal. and enjoy.

title: Creamed Spinach
instructions: Wash spinach well to remove sand. Separate leaves and cut off roots. Bring water to boil in pot and add spinach. Boil uncovered for about 2 minutes. Drain and chop fine. Melt butter and blend in the flour. Add milk slowly and then the cream; stir constantly until smooth. Bring to boil for about 1 minute. Add chopped spinach. Mix and heat through. Add salt and grated onion; mix well. Heat for another minute. Serves 6.

title: World Famous Roast Beef
instructions: Line roaster with aluminum foil with enough excess to wrap roast. Mix soy sauce wine sugar and water. Stir in onion soup mix. Pour over roast and wrap in foil. Cook 4 to 5 hours at 300\u00b0. (Makes delicious gravy.)

title: Chicken-In-Soups
instructions: Combine soups and wine. Add chicken. Bake 1 hour covered at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix butter shortening sugars egg and vanilla thoroughly. Stir in remaining sifted dry ingredients. Spread in ungreased oblong pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Bake 20 to 25 minutes until done. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix butter eggs and sugar. Add pineapple with juice; mix well. Add bread; mix in well. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 50 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: French Cherry Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese with sugar and vanilla. Whip pint of cream well; fold in cheese mixture. Pour in crust. Chill 6 to 8 hours. Spread can of pie filling on top. Decorate with cream if desired.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat well. Add oil then vanilla. Mix flour and apples with this. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 in loaf pan or large flat pan. While still hot pour Buttermilk Icing on it punching holes to allow icing to seep in.

title: Chicken & Beer
instructions: Place cut-up chicken in a 4 quart cooking pot. Add all the ingredients to pot. Add all the ingredients to pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender approximately 1 hour. Add liquid if ingredients are getting thick. Should be a medium gravy consistency.

title: Whip Cream Icing
instructions: Beat Crisco and butter together. Add sugar gradually. Beat 5 to 10 minutes. Add hot milk slowly; beat well. Add vanilla and beat until creamy.

title: Stir-Fry Beef Or Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in nonstick pan. Stir-fry meat until done. Cut vegetables up and combine with meat. Pour soy sauce over mixture and stir until coated.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Bring first five ingredients to a boil and let boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and quick oats. Stir well and drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Let harden for a few hours then serve.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Blend oil and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift all the dry ingredients together and mix well. Add carrots pecans and vanilla. Bake in three 10-inch greased and floured cake pans for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and frost with the following.

title: Honey Dressing
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients then add the rest of ingredients. Use mixer and blend well. Keep in refrigerator. This can be used with any fruit salad. Serves 12.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cover with salad dressing. Let marinate overnight.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
instructions: Layer sliced potatoes with pork chops in crock-pot. Pour over top the mushroom soup celery soup and milk. Grate Cheddar cheese on top and cook on low for several hours until potatoes are tender about 5 to 6 hours. Velveeta cheese slices on top could also be used.

title: Fancy Holiday Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar extract and milk. Stir in flour and fruits. Refrigerate for a few hours. Drop from spoon on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Chopstick Tuna
instructions: Combine soup and water. Add noodles celery tuna cashews and salt and pepper. Toss lightly. Place in ungreased dish (10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch). Sprinkle few noodles over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until heated. Garnish with drained oranges.

title: Kidney Bean Relish
instructions: Chop onion celery and eggs together. Add beans mayonnaise relish and other seasonings. Refrigerate. Serves 6.

title: Barbecue Beef Burgers
instructions: Mix together well and simmer 10 minutes. Serve on hot hamburger buns.

title: Venison Roast
instructions: Trim fat from roast. Season meat. Place in roasting pan cover with apple slices. Cut onion over all. Sprinkle with Worcestershire and add water. Cover and cook at 250\u00b0 for 6 to 7 hours. Add additional water if needed. When done discard liquid. Carrots and potatoes may be added halfway through cooking also celery. Serves 14 to 18 people.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix altogether. Put in middle of big round loaf of Hawaiian bread. Make a nest in bread by scooping out the middle of the loaf.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In saucepan melt morsels and margarine. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Mix well. Press half of mixture in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In large bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Beat in milk vanilla and egg. Mix well and pour over crumb mixture and top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Cut in squares. Store in refrigerator.

title: Sour Cream Coffeecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare a 7 x 3 inch loaf pan. Sift flour with salt and soda set aside. Beat butter with sugar with electric mixer till light and airy add vanilla and egg beat till fluffy. Stir in 1/2 flour mixture beat until smooth. Add sour cream beat until smooth follow with other 1/2 flour beat 30 seconds until smooth. Spread 1/2 batter in pan sprinkle with 1/2 topping repeat. Bake 30-35 minutes till pulls away from pan and springs back lightly when touched.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until it looks done. Let cool.

title: Church Windows
instructions: Melt stick of margarine and chocolate chips together. Let cool. Mix with marshmallows. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate. When cold cut into squares.

title: Creme De Menthe Cake
instructions: Put fudge topping in hot water (sealed) so it will be easier to spread. When cake is cool spread fudge topping over cake. Chill for a few minutes. Add creme de menthe to large whipped topping and whip. Spread on top of fudge.

title: Hot Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except red hots. Take some of the mix and put in a small pan along with the red hots and melt over low heat. After red hots have melted pour this in other mixture and mix well. Heat to serve.

title: Mushroom Mousse
instructions: In a skillet saute mushrooms in butter until liquid has evaporated. Soften gelatin in chicken broth; add marjoram and heat to dissolve. Remove from fire and add sherry. Place mushrooms and broth mixture in blender or processor. Add egg yolks and remaining ingredients except for the cream and egg white. Blend until smooth. Add cream and blend again.

title: Fettucine Alfredo
instructions: In microwave bowl melt butter and cream cheese stirring at 30 second intervals until melted. Gradually add milk and Parmesan cheese until hot. Best if stirred with wire whip. Serve over cooked noodles. May also be cooked on stove top over medium high heat in heavy saucepan. Stir constantly. Serves 4.

title: Cherry Pie
instructions: Pour juice off cherries and save. Add sugar flour and cornstarch to juice. Heat stirring constantly until thickened. Add cherries almond flavoring food coloring and butter. Pour in 9-inch pie crust. Add top crust. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven 10 minutes then in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Fruit Juice Punch
instructions: Make syrup with water and sugar. Boil 5 minutes. Cool. Dilute frozen juices according to directions on can. Add orange juice lemonade and grape juice to syrup. When ready to serve add ginger ale. Serves 24.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Bring to boil the sugar oil vinegar and water. Cool to lukewarm and pour over sauerkraut pepper onion and carrot. Chill; keep in covered bowl. Will keep 2 or more weeks.

title: Chicken Adobo
instructions: Clean the chicken. Cut into pieces. Add the salt minced garlic and pepper to the chicken. Put in a kettle and add bay leaf vinegar and water. Cover and let simmer until the chicken is tender and the liquid has practically evaporated. Add fat and fry meat until brown. Serve hot or cold.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Melt and bring to a boil oleo and water. Add cocoa. Cool a little then add flour sugar salt eggs vanilla vinegar sour cream or buttermilk. Butter and flour cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Brown the ground beef. Drain off the oil. Cut up onion and peppers very small. Mix together cornbread mix. Use a Pyrex pan if possible. Pour 1/2 of cornbread mix into pan. Spread evenly. Pour 1/2 of sweet creamed corn on top of mix. Sprinkle cheese on evenly. Spread all of the meat over the cheese. Sprinkle onion and peppers on meat. Add remaining ingredients. Spread evenly. Bake until done. Serves 4.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Blend together butter dash of pepper flour sugar and salt. To this mixture add chopped onion and sour cream. Put 2 well drained cans French-style green beans in a buttered baking dish. Cover with sour cream mixture. Sprinkle generously with grated cheese. Cover with crushed cornflakes and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel and chop apples. Mix with peanut butter and stir in Cheerios.

title: Fruit Pizza(Beautiful Dessert)
instructions: Make cookie dough as directed. Press into disposable pizza pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool completely. Mix softened cream cheese sugar and vanilla together. Spread over baked cookie dough. Decorate with sliced fruit. Some ideas red and green grapes strawberries raspberries blueberries kiwi etc. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Scalloped Parsley Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut into wedges or slices. Cook potatoes in a little water for about 10 minutes. They should not get mushy. In a saucepan combine butter milk and flour. Whisk together. Bring to a boil stirring. Cook for about 5 minutes. Add salt pepper parsley and potatoes. Heat slowly. Season to taste. Sprinkle with extra parsley when serving. For a more pungent flavor add a little grated nutmeg. For a low-fat alternative substitute 1/2 cup vegetable broth for 1/2 cup milk. Preparation time 40 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a well-greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rich Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and add sugar then eggs flour and vanilla. Take a very small amount of dough spread thin and top with nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Raspberry Cake
instructions: Beat margarine with electric mixer until creamy. Gradually add sugar and beat until well blended. Beat egg whites until stiff set aside. Beat egg yolks until thick. Add to first mixture alternately with milk beating after each addition until smooth. Add vanilla then fold in egg whites. Divide evenly among 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer cake pans. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes. Turn out on racks to cool. Spread filling and frosting between layers and on top.

title: Spiced Cocoa
instructions: Mix all together. Store in container.

title: Kay'S Strawberry Jello
instructions: Combine Jell-O with boiling water. Add all other ingredients. Pour half the mixture into a 9 x 9-inch or 7 x 11-inch dish. Chill until firm. Spread sour cream on top then add rest of mixture. Chill.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place soup water onion and rice in baking dish. Stir together. Lay chicken in skin side up. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar beating well. Add eggs and molasses; mix well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk; begin and end with flour mixture. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 1 1/2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar after you remove from oven.

title: Dessert Gingerbread
instructions: Cream butter add sugar and beat until light. Add molasses milk and egg. Mix and sift dry ingredients and add them to the first mixture. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0). Top with whipped cream.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry cake mix nuts and melted butter. Mixture will be crumbly. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Broccoli Squares
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions and drain.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Cut Velveeta cheese into small pieces. Put in a large skillet over low heat brown ground beef while cheese melts. Drain. Add ground beef cheese soup and picante sauce. Leave over low heat until all cheese has melted and all ingredients are blended well stirring often. Pour over chips or place in a small bowl and dip chips one at a time. Great for small parties and holidays. Delicious.

title: Easy Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Butter bottom and sides of 1 1/2 or 2-quart casserole. In skillet brown pork chops on both sides. Remove and set aside. To saucepan add butter and lightly saute onions. Do not overcook. In strata fashion layer chops in bottom of casserole layer of sliced potatoes then onions. Pour 1/3 of soup mix over top. Repeat with second layer of chops etc. ending with top layer of potato slices. Pour remaining soup mix over top and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chops are tender. Serves 4.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Combine oil eggs and sugar. Combine flour salt soda and spices. Add to oil mixture. Add buttermilk coconut nuts and prunes. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 12 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 300\u00b0 or until done.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Brown onion and celery slightly in oleo. Beat eggs milk pepper and baking powder. Add about 1/2 cup broth to moisten. Stir all together. Pour into baking dish and bake about 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Bacardi Rum Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch tube or 12-inch Bundt pan. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan. Mix all other ingredients and pour batter over nuts. Bake 1 hour. Cool. Invert. Prick top. Add glaze.

title: Ooey Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix 2 beaten eggs and melted butter; place in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
instructions: Place softened cream cheese into 1/2 stick melted butter. Mix well. In separate bowl mix together drained Mexicorn and drained green chilies. Pour butter mixture over corn; stir together. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until hot and bubbly. Yummy!

title: 7-Layer Lettuce Salad
instructions: In an 8-inch square dish layer the first 6 ingredients in order listed. Blend salad dressing with sugar and cream. Add to top of salad then sprinkle cheese and bacon on top. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Hot Spinach Balls
instructions: Put uncooked spinach into sieve and press out liquid. Add other ingredients. Form into balls and place on cookie sheet and freeze. Put into plastic bag until needed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 dozen balls.

title: Spring Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello with water. Add orange concentrate. Mix well. When slightly thickened add pineapple and bananas. Place in mold.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Blend in egg and vanilla. Mix in flour salt soda and cream of tartar. Roll in walnut size balls and press with a sugared glass. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Lemon Butter
instructions: Put first four ingredients in double boiler. Stir add egg put on medium heat stir constantly and cook until smooth. Take off heat and add butter. Stir. Chill. Pour in small jelly glass.

title: Irish Potato Soup
instructions: Boil the water in a saucepan. Add potatoes carrot onions thyme bay leaf and clove. Cover over low heat for 45 minutes. Force the mixture through a sieve. Add milk cream salt and pepper. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Correct seasoning. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice by box directions and set aside. Place broccoli in boiling salt water and boil for about 4 minutes. Drain broccoli well and place in large container and add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients well including rice and salt to taste. Pour into buttered casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Clemson Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in Pyrex dish. Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken pieces. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Skoby'S Creamed Corn
instructions: Cook corn as directed on package. Mix all other ingredients except bread crumbs. Pour over corn and stir well. Pour into casserole dish and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix together 1st six\tingredients. Stir in Jiffy mix and bake in 8-inch square greased pan for 25 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Top Of The Stove Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients and shape into a loaf. Brown loaf on all sides in a large frypan in oil. Add onion and saute until lightly browned. Add water cover and let simmer 1 hour or until tender. Remove loaf and make gravy from drippings.

title: Baked Mashed Sweet Potatoes With Marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In small saucepan heat half and half sugar butter and salt over low heat; stir until butter has melted. Beat egg yolks in a medium size bowl. Gradually beat in half and half mixture. Beat yolk mixture into potatoes. Beat egg whites and fold in. Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole and top with marshmallows.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients. Press biscuits in muffin tin. Fill with meat mixture; top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix all together adding cornbread mix last. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or longer in 9 x 9-inch square pan.

title: Tomato And Mozzarella Summer Salad
instructions: Place tomato (stem side down) on plate. Cut thick slashes into tomato keeping base intact. Cut Mozzarella in thick slices and insert into cut tomato. If desired drop slices of garlic between cuts. Sprinkle fresh chopped basil salt and pepper. Drizzle with good olive oil.

title: Apple Sausages With Cornmeal Mush
instructions: In large saucepan heat 1 cup water the candies and food color until candies melt. Place apple rings in syrup; simmer until tender about 20 minutes. Place links in skillet. Add 3 tablespoons water. Cover; simmer for 8 minutes. Remove cover; cook until well done turning sausage to brown evenly. Serve hot sausage links and apple rings with Cornmeal Mush. Makes 5 servings.

title: Fudge Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and cookie sheet to 350\u00b0. In medium saucepan melt butter. Add cocoa and stir until dissolved. Add hot water and stir again. With wire whisk stir in sugar flour salt vanilla and milk. Stir until batter is smooth. Mix in pecans and pour into pie crust. Bake on preheated cookie sheet for 50 minutes or until custard sets.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine sugars and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Zippy Tuna Dip
instructions: Drain tuna break up into flakes. Gently stir in mayonnaise yogurt olives peppers green onions and cilantro. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until done. Pull cooked chicken apart and off the bone. Place in bottom of casserole dish. Crush bag of Doritos and put on top of chicken. In large saucepan blend the two soups broth Velveeta and Ro-Tel. Heat until cheese is melted. Pour over Doritos. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well each time. Sift together the flour salt and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Add the flavorings. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 until cake tests done. Cool 15 minutes. Remove from pan and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Sweet Potato Custard (Pie)
instructions: Measure cooked mashed potatoes and put in large mixer bowl to process on low speed to mash well. Add margarine while potatoes are hot. Add sugar eggs milk and vanilla. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour until well set and lightly browned. Yield 1 nine-inch pie.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Sprinkle flour over fruit and mix. Set aside. Cream butter and sugar. Add 1 at a time the eggs. Add flour soda salt and cinnamon. Combine batter with fruit and pecans. Mix well.

title: Up-To-Date Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook pasta. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large pot; add flour and stir. Stir in broth and milk. Cover and cook over medium heat until it thickens and boils. Reduce to low. Stir in cheeses and seasonings. Stir until melted. In large skillet melt 1 tablespoon butter. Stir-fry vegies until desired doneness. Mix pasta vegies and cheese sauce. Top with Parmesan.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cover roast with flour mixture. In large skillet add 3 tablespoons butter. Brown roast on all sides. Remove roast and place in large roasting pan. Arrange onions potatoes and carrots around roast. Sprinkle on soup mix over roast and vegetables. Add water. Cook for 2 hours covered. Add water if needed. Cook for 25 minutes or longer uncovered until veggies and roast are brown and tender.

title: Football-Shaped Cake
instructions: Bake cake in a 9-inch square pan at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool. Cut 4 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch edge off opposite 2 ends of cake (football shaped). Frost football with frosting rounding out edges. Cover generously with coconut. Decorate with candy corn and chocolate chips in center for lace. Place curved licorice lace on each side of center decorations.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Let roll mixture rise 1 time. Roll out on floured surface in a rectangular shape. Combine sugar butter and cinnamon. Spread generously over all dough surface. Roll dough as for jelly roll. Cut in 1-inch slices and place in cake pan. Do not use cookie sheet. Let rise again. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Mix enough coffee with powdered sugar to make a thin icing. Brush over rolls with pastry brush.

title: Praline Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine 2 1/2 cups flour baking powder and soda. Add to cream mixture alternately with milk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Dredge pecans in remaining 1/2 cup flour. Stir pecans and vanilla into batter Pour into 2 greased and floured 10-inch tube pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Shrimp Bake
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Meanwhile in a large skillet saute the shrimp green pepper onion and mushrooms in butter until shrimp turn pink. Add the soup to the rice; stir into the shrimp mixture. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with croutons. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Yield 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Haystacks
instructions: In saucepan bring sugar cocoa milk and butter to full boil. Remove from heat; stir in remaining ingredients. Drop quickly from teaspoon on waxed paper; cool. Yields 48.

title: Cheesy Baked Egg
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff. Spread on bread making slight hollow in center. Fill with unbroken yolk. Sprinkle with grated cheese and fresh ground pepper. Bake 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Lunch only.

title: Egg Salad Mold
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over water in saucepan. Place over low heat; stir constantly until gelatin dissolves about 3 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in salt lemon juice and Tabasco. Gradually blend into mayonnaise. Chill stirring occasionally until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon. Stir in remaining ingredients. Turn into a 3-cup mold. Chill until firm. Unmold and garnish with salad greens. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tortellini Pesto Soup
instructions: Bring broth and onions to boil. Stir in tortellini. Reduce to medium heat. Cook 3 minutes uncovered. Stir in pea pods. Cook additional 3 minutes. Stir in pesto sauce. Heat and serve.

title: Cheddar Snack Crackers
instructions: Beat margarine and Cheddar cheese. Add flour gradually. Stir in Rice Krispies and Tabasco to taste; may be omitted but adds zip. Place by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet; flatten with palm of hand. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven or until lightly browned. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix eggs oil and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients. Add to mixture. Add apples and pecans last. Pour into greased tube pan. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Burritos
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; drain grease. Add chili beans burrito seasoning and 1/2 cup of water. Simmer about 15 to 20 minutes. Fill tortillas with bean mixture. Layer with lettuce cheese tomato and onion. Fold and place more cheese on top. Place in the microwave for 15 to 20 seconds. Add hot sauce and sour cream if desired.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Tear cleaned romaine into bite size pieces. Combine remaining ingredients in container and shake well. Toss with lettuce. Add croutons fresh sliced mushrooms and freshly grated Parmesan or Mozzarella cheese if desired.

title: Baked Turkey Stew
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients in hot margarine or butter until tender. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Add undrained tomato and juice cocktail. Cook and stir until bubbly. Add turkey. Transfer to 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover; bake in 375\u00b0 oven 20 minutes or until heated through. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Boil giblets in lightly salted water. Remove meat from necks. Chop all fine or put through meat grinder. Reserve liquid for broth. Use bouillon to make up remainder of broth needed for 9 or 10 cups.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let set overnight. Serve as a vegetable or salad. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Summer Fruit Dip
instructions: Whip ingredients together; store in refrigerator until ready to use. Makes an excellent dip for fresh fruit. (Strawberries cantaloupe honeydew apples.)

title: Jay'S Chili(Yields 8 Servings)
instructions: In Dutch oven saute first four ingredients in hot oil until tender. Add meat 1 pound at a time stirring until meat loses redness. Drain; add water. Add remaining ingredients stirring after each addition. Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours stirring frequently. Season to taste with garlic salt and pepper if desired. Serve with Pillsbury Cornbread Twists.

title: Hot Cheesy Seafood Dip
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in top of a double boiler; bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cook stirring frequently until cheese melts. Stir in next 3 ingredients. Transfer mixture to a chafing dish; sprinkle with onions if desired. Serve warm with tortilla chips or Fritos. Makes 4 cups. Can freeze. Can do ahead.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Add combined flour baking soda salt and spices. Mix well. Stir in oats. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Throw in a cup of crushed pecans. Bake 8 to 9 minutes for a chewy cookie or 10 to 11 minutes for a crisp cookie. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix strawberry cola and Jell-O in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Let cool. Slice strawberries in pie crust. Refrigerate until jelled and then top with Cool Whip and strawberries.

title: Pasta Dish
instructions: Boil pasta. Set aside. Spray nonstick pan with oil. Saute peppers and onion until tender. Add pasta and stir; add soy sauce and water. Let simmer about 10 minutes.

title: Sugar Cream Pie
instructions: Prebake the pie shell until almost done. While this is baking cook the filling.

title: Miss Smith'S Homemade Pretzels
instructions: Mix dry yeast and water. Add sugar and salt. Add flour. Knead dough until smooth. Cut off pieces. Roll pieces of dough with your hands and shape. Place on cookie sheet and brush shapes with egg. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Break eggs over apples and sugar. Add rest of ingredients. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven in 8 x 8-inch pan 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Cut chicken into strips brown lightly with onions and garlic in oil. Add tomatoes tomato sauce seasoning and green peppers. Bring to a full boil. Stir in rice and remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Peel the potatoes and peel and slice the onion. Boil both together until the potatoes are tender. Add butter salt pepper and milk; mash until fluffy. Cook the spinach covered without water until tender (frozen spinach need only be thawed). Drain thoroughly and chop fine. Heat the undiluted soup over a low flame; stir in nutmeg then the spinach. Save out about 3/4 cup of the potato mixture for a border. Spread the remainder in the bottom of a buttered casserole. Top with the spinach mixture. Cut up the cheese into 1-inch wide strips and arrange on top of the spinach like spokes. Border the edge of the casserole with the rest of the potatoes fluffing them up with a fork. Place under broiler to melt and brown the cheese. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Boil cut-up chicken. Add celery. Bring to boil. Cook until done. When chicken is done debone chicken. Bring broth to boil. Add tomato sauce and noodles. Bring to boil. Simmer 30 minutes. Add deboned chicken. Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 30 more minutes.

title: Yummy Sandwich
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and use as a spread for the bread slices. Put any kind of sliced sandwich meat and sliced cheese over the filling adding a little mayonnaise between the meat and cheese and other slice of bread. (A variety of meats breads and cheeses in the same batch makes for a real surprise package!) Fresh and moist and yummy!!

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together. Chill. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Tiptop Angels(Yield: 8 Servings)
instructions: Dip pieces of cake quickly into melted butter. Coat with brown sugar. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Serve with coffee and ice cream.

title: Finger Paint
instructions: In cold water dissolve gelatin (let set). In 1 cup water dissolve laundry starch. Put starch into 2 cups hot water and cook until boiling (over medium heat). Remove from heat and add gelatin mixture. Add soap flakes or detergent. Stir until dissolved. Cool. Put into separate jars and add food coloring. Use on glazed shelf paper. Let dry. it can be ironed on with medium-heated iron and used to decorate items such as wastebaskets etc.

title: Buckeye Balls Delight
instructions: Line cookie sheet with waxed paper. Mix peanut butter vanilla and sugar with your hands until smooth. Shape into small balls place on waxed paper and refrigerate.

title: Savory Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine salad dressing lemon juice and seasonings; mix well. Pour over chicken; chill several hours or overnight. Reserve salad dressing mixture. Place chicken skin side up on a rack in a baking pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes brushing occasionally with salad dressing mixture.

title: Cool Whip Frosting
instructions: Mix milk sugar and pudding mix together with wire whisk. Let mixture thicken for several minutes. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: In a large bowl mix together corn meal flour sugar salt and baking powder. Then add eggs milk and oil to the corn meal mixture. Stir in chopped jalapeno peppers onion and cheese. Pour into a well-oiled pan and bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Christmas Rainbow Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Bake in 2 well-greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pans for 15 minutes. Poke with fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Do not remove from pans. Dissolve each package of jello separately in 1 cup of boiling water. Pour raspberry jello over one layer of cake and pour the lime jello over the other. Chill for 4 hours. Unmold one layer onto serving plate and top with 1 cup Cool Whip. Unmold second layer onto first. Frost top and sides with remaining Cool Whip. Chill. Garnish with gumdrops flattened and cut to resemble holly.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Remove bones and skin from salmon. Flake well. Add green pepper onion and egg; mix well. Add bread crumbs. Form into loaf. Bake in greased loaf pan in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Scripture Cake(Look Up The References In The Old Testament.)
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar; beat until light. Add egg yolks one at a time beating after each addition. Beat in honey. Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with milk to the egg mixture. Beat until smooth. Stir in nuts and fruits. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch) lined with wax paper. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done. Cool in pan for 5 minutes. Turn cake out on rack and peel off paper. Turn right side up to cool. Enjoy!

title: Zucchini Parmesan
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet and add zucchini onion parsley and the spices. Saute mixture over medium heat stirring often until zucchini is done but still crisp and tender. Toss in chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Turn mixture into a serving dish and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese.

title: Lasagna Roll-Ups
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain rinse and set aside. Put broccoli in a microwave-safe dish; cover with plastic and cook for 3 minutes. Add the minced onion and continue cooking for 1 to 2 minutes. Drain well and squeeze the extra moisture out with the back of a spoon.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into a ball and roll in chopped nuts.

title: Pineapple Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar flour syrup melted butter and crushed pineapple. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until filling is set.

title: Caramel Sauce(Microwave)
instructions: Place sugar and water in 4-cup microwave-safe glass measure. Cover tightly and microwave on High for 7 to 8 minutes until syrup turns light gold. Mixture will be extremely hot. Let stand for 2 minutes then remove from microwave and gradually stir in cream and vanilla. Microwave uncovered for 1 to 2 minutes more until golden brown. Cool slightly then pour into clean jar or container. Cover tightly and refrigerate. Makes 1 1/2 cups. Good over ice cream or fresh pears.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Drain the can of salmon well. Add eggs (beaten lightly) onion milk and enough flour to give the right consistency to shape into balls. Roll in corn flakes and fry in Mazola oil. Drain on paper towels and serve while hot.

title: Lions Club Ranch Beans
instructions: Soak beans 4 hours or overnight. Add tomato sauce canned tomatoes onion powder chili powder and bacon ends. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer covered until done. Add water as necessary to keep beans covered. About an hour before serving season to taste with salt pepper and liquid smoke. Serves 50 to 70. Cooking Time 8 hours.

title: Burger Bean Bake
instructions: Cook bacon crumble into small pieces. Cook ground beef and onion drain. Add bacon to meat and the remaining ingredients. Mix well put into baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Beef With Peppers
instructions: Heat skillet; add oil and crushed garlic (optional). When garlic turns brown remove. Add beef; cut in small thin pieces and fry a few minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add soup stock and continue to cook a few minutes. Add mixture of cornstarch soy sauce and water. Cook until sauce thickens stirring slowly. Add green pepper and onion. Add ginger chopped fine. Heat thoroughly and serve hot. Serves 4 to 6. May be served over rice or chow mein noodles.

title: Reese'S Cups
instructions: Mix; roll into small balls. Dip in dipping chocolate.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil noodles and strain. Heat milk and add cheese; cut into small pieces. Simmer until dissolved. Add mushroom soup. Slice eggs; pour all ingredients over noodles and mix. Season to taste. Bake about 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven covered.

title: Summer Casserole
instructions: Cut wieners into thin slices. Saute green pepper and onion in butter. Stir in bread crumbs beans wieners and cheese. Place in a 4-quart casserole dish. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg. Mix well. Add milk and mix. Add salt soda and baking powder to flour; mix with sugar mixture. Add nuts cherries and dates. Chill mixture. Use a teaspoon and drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Lime And Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and let set until slightly congealed. Chill large bowl and beaters. Pour in evaporated milk and beat until it stands in peaks. Combine with chilled and whipped Jell-O mixture. In another bowl combine chocolate wafer crumbs with melted butter and spread 1/2 of the mixture on the bottom of a 13 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Pour in the Jell-O mixture and spread remaining crumbs on top. Chill overnight if possible.

title: Farfalle Carbonara
instructions: In a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray saut garlic onions ham and peas 2 minutes or until soft. Add white wine and simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Whisk together next 5 ingredients and add to pea mixture. Cook mixture over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes or until thickened. Add 1/4 cup water and cooked pasta to skillet; cook 2 minutes or more to heat through. Season with freshly ground black pepper and Parmesan cheese to taste. Makes 6 servings.

title: Dreamsicle Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar butter and condensed milk. Boil to soft-ball stage (approximately 5 minutes). Add Marshmallow Creme and vanilla chips. Mix well. Remove 1 cup of mix. Add orange flavor and color to whats left in the pan. Stir well. Pour in 9 x 13 dish. Pour 1 cup of removed mix on top and swirl with knife. Put in fridge until set.

title: Muffin Pizzas
instructions: Split English muffins in half. Toast if desired. Top each half with 1 1/2 tablespoons of chili sauce 1 tablespoon of shredded cheese a sprinkle of Italian seasoning and 2 of the pizza garnishes. Arrange pizzas on a paper towel in the oven. Microwave for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until cheese is melted. The more pizzas you cook the longer the cooking time.

title: Eggplant And Okra
instructions: Put in saucepan. Cover. Cook slowly 30 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon finely chopped parsley. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lime Cheese Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; set aside. Cream the cream cheese sugar and vanilla; set aside. Whip condensed milk then add cheese mix and beat. Then add jello and mix. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill. Reserve a few cracker crumbs to garnish top.

title: Strawberry Salad(Dressing)
instructions: Leaf lettuce red lettuce romaine or iceberg mixed greens. Red onion cut into rings and separated. Add a pint of strawberries sliced with 6 - 8 almonds. Mix dressing ingredients and set aside. Mix greens strawberries onion and almonds. Pour dressing over and serve immediately.

title: Fresh Coconut Icing
instructions: Bring all ingredients except 1/2 cup of half and half with cornstarch dissolved in it to a bubbly boil. Stir in cornstarch mixture and continue cooking and stirring for 8 to 10 minutes. Put frosting on your favorite yellow or white cake layers while frosting is hot. This will frost three 9 x 13-inch layers or four 8-inch square layers. Its very juicy.

title: Grandma Latty'S Apple Rolls
instructions: Roll dough thin in circle. Put 1/2 cup apples in center. Top with 1 tablespoon of sugar. Wrap dough up around apples and sugar. Place rolls in 6 x 10-inch pan. Put a pat of butter or margarine on each roll. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Take from oven and allow to cool slightly.

title: French Fry Casserole
instructions: Cover bottom of casserole dish with ground beef. Cut onion over this layer. Place crinkle cut French fries over onion. Pour cream of mushroom soup (diluted with 1/2 can of water) over fries. Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Esoteric Salad
instructions: Drain and save liquids from oranges pineapple and peaches. Combine liquids. Add concentrated orange juice and enough water to equal 3 cups of liquid. Pour in saucepan and add the pudding mixes. Heat to top of stove stirring constantly until the mixture comes to a rapid boil. The mixture should now be thick with fish-like eyes. Let this mixture cool. Add fruit and enjoy.

title: Chicken-Vegetable Gumbo
instructions: Remove tip and stem from okra. Slice 1/4-inch slices and set aside. Coat a large Dutch oven with cooking spray. Place over medium heat until hot. Add onions and next 4 ingredients. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add okra tomatoes and next 6 ingredients. Stir well. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Add chicken; stir well. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 5 minutes. Yield 2 quarts. Good served over rice!

title: Toffee
instructions: Oil an 11 x 15-inch baking sheet with edges. In heavy 3-quart saucepan combine butter sugar and salt. Stir well with wooden spoon and place over moderate heat. Bring to boil stirring occasionally to dissolve sugar. When mixture boils wash down sides of pot with pastry brush dipped in water or use wet paper towel. Continue cooking over moderate heat stirring occasionally but not touching sides of pan until syrup reaches 290\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Pour mixture into oiled pan and allow to cool partially then score toffee into squares with a knife.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Pour pineapple with juice in boiler along with jello. Mix well. Bring mixture to a bubbling boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat; pour into serving container and refrigerate until it starts to thicken. Then stir in buttermilk and Cool Whip. Return to refrigerator until set.

title: Texas Millionaires
instructions: Combine brown sugar white sugar syrup butter milk and vanilla. Allow this mixture to come to a rolling boil stirring constantly. Add very slowly making sure not to stop the boiling 1 cup evaporated milk. Cook over a moderate flame until the mixture reaches a soft ball stage. Add pecans and pour into a large buttered pan. Refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares.

title: Cherry Jubilee
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add extract. Add eggs one at a time. Continue to cream until light. Add lemon juice. Place 1/2 of crumbs in the bottom of an 9-inch square pan. Spread mixture on top. Add cherry pie filling. Cover with whipped topping. Sprinkle rest of crumbs on top. Refrigerate; cut into squares.

title: Caramel Pie *
instructions: Mix sugar eggs flour and salt. Add milk and vanilla. Bake in unbaked pie shell for 1 hour with temperature at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandpa Louie Mollnar'S Gravy
instructions: Take juice from roast with half the onions and bell peppers. Bring to a boil. In another container take 1 cup of water and 1 cup of flour and mix until thick. Add to boiling water and youre good to go.

title: Smoky Crescents
instructions: Cut sausage links in half so you have 24 short links. Unroll crescent roll dough and spread it out flat. Cut the 8 triangles lengthwise into 3 triangles each. This will give you 24 long thin triangles of dough. Starting at the wide end of each dough triangle place a short sausage link on dough; roll up. Repeat. Place rolls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with barbecue sauce or mustard for dipping if desired.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix well and pour into buttered baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cover top with buttered crumbs before baking.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Add pepperoni and onion and cook on low for 5 minutes with lid on. Add beef mixture to the remainder of ingredients. Mix well in a large bowl. Spread evenly into an 8 x 11-inch baking dish and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Caramel Crunch Popcorn
instructions: Cover 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Spread the popped popcorn on the baking sheet in a single layer. In a medium nonstick skillet combine the sugar margarine and syrup; bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly (about 3 minutes). Continue cooking and stirring until the mixture turns a light caramel color about 5 minutes. Dont overcook or the caramel will brown and burn. Remove from the heat and slowly stir in the vanilla. Pour the caramel mixture over the popcorn. When the caramel has cooled break it into bite-sized pieces. Makes 24 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Add Marshmallow Creme. When well blended add Cool Whip. Serve with chunks of melon cantaloupe honeydew pineapple apple banana etc.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: In a colander toss cucumbers and salt. Place colander in sink or bowl and let drain for 2 hours. Mix sugar vinegar and celery seed in large bowl until sugar dissolves. Add cucumbers bell pepper and onion; toss to mix. Spoon into clean jars. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Can be refrigerated for 4 months.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Combine grape juice and ginger ale. Pour into punch bowl or glasses. Garnish with berries.

title: Thrifty Tennis Casserole(Simple, Hearty, But Good)
instructions: In 2-quart greased casserole layer potatoes onions and wieners. Salt and pepper each layer and pour on enough sauce to lightly cover. Repeat until all ingredients are used up topping with remaining sauce. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for a couple of hours or bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Freeze for 12 hours. Will keep for 3 months.

title: Brandied Pear
instructions: Slice pear in thin slices; sprinkle with lemon juice and add sweetener then the rest of ingredients. Toss lightly and let stand 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Stir the sugar flour and cocoa together. Combine the eggs and vanilla; beat while adding can of milk. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased and floured Pyrex pie dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Salmon Log Or Sandwich Spread
instructions: Scrape skin bones etc. from salmon and mash finely. Beat in rest of ingredients. Roll in chopped pecans and chill 6 to 8 hours. Makes 2 logs.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Cream margarine. Add cheese flour and salt. Mix well. Add rice krispies. Shape into small balls. Place on cookie sheet and flatten. Bake at 350 degrees until done.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix Crisco sugar and brown sugar. Mix egg and vanilla extract. Mix flour salt and baking soda. Combine all 3 mixtures and add chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Zucchini Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini in a little boiling salt water until tender. Drain. In saucepan cook carrot and onion in 4 tablespoons butter until tender. Remove from heat. Brown ground beef; add to carrot and onion mixture. Add 1 1/2 cups stuffing cubes soup and sour cream. Gently stir in zucchini. Put into casserole dish. Melt remaining butter; add rest of stuffing cubes. Toss and put on top of casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Busy Day Dinner
instructions: Place all ingredients in large roasting pan. Preheat oven at 300\u00b0 and bake covered 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Serve over noodles.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Core and seed green pepper. Put through coarse blade of food processor. Put green pepper cucumbers onion and garlic in large bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Add cold water and ice cubes. Let stand 2 hours. Remove garlic and drain vegetables. Mix sugar vinegar mustard seed celery seed and turmeric in large boiler. Add vegetables. Bring to boil on high heat. Remove from heat and pack in sterilized jars.

title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine in large mixing bowl the strawberries sugar egg white and lemon juice. Beat with electric mixer at highest speed until soft mounds form about 5 to 8 minutes. In another bowl beat the whipping cream until thick. Fold into strawberry mixture by hand. Spoon into baked shell. Sprinkle with crumbs. Freeze until firm 4 to 6 hours. Cover.

title: Favorite Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients by hand and pour into pie shell. Bake 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Combine undrained pineapple and eggs. Mix sugar flour and salt; stir into pineapple mixture. Pour into greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Toss bread cubes into melted butter. Spoon over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Add cheese to dry jello and mix. Add water and juice. Cool to soft consistency. Add pineapple marshmallows and nuts. Add Dream Whip; fold in gently. Pour into container or mold and refrigerate.

title: Jefferson Davis Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add butter and beat until well blended. Add cream eggs and vanilla and blend until smooth. Pour into 2 unbaked 9-inch pie crusts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes then lower temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Pepsi-Cola Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except rice in Dutch oven. Bake about 1 hour or until chicken is tender and thoroughly cooked. Serve with rice or noodles. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pickled Cabbage Syrup
instructions: Bring sugar and vinegar to slow boil for 5 minutes. Cool and pour over grated cabbage carrots celery and green peppers.

title: Microwave Baked Trout
instructions: Rinse trout under cool water and pat dry. Season with salt and pepper. Combine garlic powder bread crumbs and cheese in a bowl and mix well. Dip trout in egg white then in crumb mixture coating well. Loosely wrap each trout in plastic wrap or wax paper and place in large microwave dish. Cook on High for 8 to 10 minutes or until trout flakes easily. Garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Oriental Flank Steak
instructions: Place steak in large shallow dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over steak. Let stand several hours stirring occasionally. Broil or grill steak to desired doneness. Cut into thin slices on the diagonal.

title: Red Punch For 50
instructions: Mix and freeze for 3 hours or more.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and boil 5 minutes. This is very good on any meat.

title: Corned Beef And Cheese Pie
instructions: Arrange corned beef slices in pie shell. Beat together remaining ingredients and pour over beef. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until firm.

title: Cherry Tarte
instructions: Drain cherries. Combine 2/3 cup cherry juice with pineapple tapioca and sugar. Bring to a boil and cook until tapioca is clear. Add cherries. Remove from heat.

title: Fruit Swirl
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender; blend until thoroughly mixed. Serve immediately. Makes four 1-cup servings.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: Cut ice cream into blocks. Line pan with blocks of ice cream. Pour syrup over ice cream. Crush Oreo cookies and sprinkle over entire pan. Top with Cool Whip and small amount of crushed Oreos. Keep in freezer until ready to serve.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Drain two cans of broiled mushroom crowns. Hollow out and chop enough of the pieces to make 3 tablespoons. Cook pieces with the chopped onion in 1 teaspoon salad oil.

title: Tingler
instructions: In a blender mix juices and bananas on medium speed for about 1 minute. Add tofu cottage cheese berries and yogurt; mix for 1 minute (longer if a lighter drink is desired). Add sparkling mineral water; stir. Serve over chipped ice. Makes 5 cups.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Season ground beef with salt and pepper and form into meatballs about 1 inch in diameter. Brown in skillet. Drain pineapple slices reserving juice. Mix the pineapple syrup pickles with juice and cornstarch. Add to skillet. Cook and stir until gravy thickens and is clear. Add the pineapple slices cover and cook 5 minutes or until heated through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Melt butter in water. Mix everything else and chill 1 hour. Roll into balls and wrap about 1/3 piece of bacon around each. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream the butter and sugar. Add egg milk vanilla and almond extract. Beat well! Add flour and baking powder gradually to mixture. Put into cookie press. Press onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Butchertown Brown Bread
instructions: You also need 6 gold lined No. 3 tin cans.

title: Easy Spaghetti Bake(6 Servings)
instructions: Fry bacon. Add onions and garlic; cook until soft. Add meat; brown lightly. Stir in seasonings tomato sauce and water. Cover; simmer for 25 minutes. Break 1/2 spaghetti into greased 1-quart casserole. Cover with 1/2 sauce and 1/2 cheese. Repeat layers. Cover and bake in medium oven (350\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer until browned and bubbly.

title: Toasted Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix per box instructions and bake in a sheet cake pan. Prepare topping (while cake bakes) by mixing remaining ingredients together. Spread over warm cake and return to the oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Sesame Chicken Cutlets
instructions: Beat egg in bowl. Add salt pepper lemon juice and lemon peel. Set aside. Mix sesame seed and bread crumbs together. Place each breast half between 2 pieces of waxed paper and flatten to thickness of 1/4-inch with mallet. Dip breasts in flour then egg mixture then crumbs. Place in single layer on waxed paper. Refrigerate at least 1/2 hour before cooking. Melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add breasts and cook until golden brown on both sides 3 to 4 minutes. Serve on warm platter. Garnish with lemon slices and parsley. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Orzo With Lemon And Herb
instructions: Bring vegetable stock to a boil in a large saucepan. Add orzo and cook for about 8 minutes until just tender. Drain and toss with herbs and lemon juice. Season with pepper and salt. Serve hot room temperature or chilled. Can be made up to 6 hours in advance. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken Breasts And Hearts Of Palm
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Wrap each chicken breast around a heart of palm. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper. Fasten with toothpicks. Place seam side down in buttered Pyrex dish. Dot with butter. Bake for 25 minutes. Serve with Hollandaise Sauce in packets.

title: Strawberry Cream Roll
instructions: Beat eggs until thick and lemon-colored. Beat at high speed. Add vanilla and sugar; beat until fluffy and thick. Add dry ingredients all at once. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Low Country Boil
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup Tabasco sauce 1 tablespoon salt and 2 teaspoons seafood seasoning in a large bowl or pan. Marinate fresh shrimp in the mixture for 30 to 45 minutes.\tCut onions in rings and let boil in water or\tbeer for 5 minutes cut sausage in chunks and bring to a boil let simmer until juices permeates from sausage and remaining seasoning celery and green pepper simmer for 5 minutes add corn then shrimp let simmer for 10 to 15 minutes occasionally stirring to be sure all shrimp and pieces of corn have been immersed in boil for at least 5 minutes. Place on platter and\tserve with your favorite seafood sauce. Serves 6 to 10 people.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add all other ingredients. Pour into greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until center comes out clean on toothpick.

title: Lemon Cream Puffs
instructions: In a saucepan bring water and butter to a boil. Add flour all at once stirring until a smooth ball forms. Remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Continue beating until mixture is smooth. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart onto greased baking sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown. Remove to wire racks. Immediately split puffs and remove tops discard soft dough from inside. Set puffs and tops aside to cool.

title: Texas Brownies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour and sugar. In a 9 x 11-inch microwave-safe dish combine butter shortening coffee or water and cocoa. Microwave at High power for 2 minutes or until just boiling. Pour boiling mixture over flour mixture. Stir to blend. Add buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix well. Pour mixture into a micro-safe 9 x 11-inch baking dish. Microwave at Medium-high power for 18 minutes turning dish every 4 to 5 minutes until brownies test done. They may still appear soft of the surface.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter sugar and eggs. Stir in dry ingredients. Roll into small balls. Roll balls in a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pink Delight Dessert
instructions: Combine pie filling pineapple and milk together; mix well. Then add Cool Whip; mix again and chill.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Place pasta in a pot of boiling saltwater and cook for about 15 minutes or until pasta is done. Drain and wash pasta then place in large mixing bowl. Add onions celery and bell peppers and mix thoroughly. Next add shrimp crabmeat mayonnaise Creole mustard and Tony Chachere. Mix very well. If more mayonnaise is desired add more. When salad is well mixed add ketchup. Stir in ketchup and mix well. When pasta is well mixed pour into dish and cover. Place in the refrigerator for about 2 hours. Serve chilled.

title: Pork Chops - Southern Baked
instructions: Trim fat from chops. Mix salt pepper and garlic into a paste. Rub into pork chops. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Arrange chops in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 20 minutes longer.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Harvest Potatoes
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients except topping. Mix well. Place in 9 x 13-inch well-greased baking dish.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Better Than Potato Salad
instructions: Cook rice and let cool. Add all ingredients and keep refrigerated.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Add a mixture of the sugar cornstarch seasoned salt dry mustard and onion. Stir in the milk and melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir once.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak in small serving pieces. Do not flour meat. Brown steak in oil. Add onions salt and pepper. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water. Add to meat and simmer 1/2 hour or until meat is almost tender. Add tomatoes and green pepper; simmer 10 minutes longer. Combine cornstarch cold water and soy sauce. Stir into meat mixture. Bring to a boil stirring constantly; cook for 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 10-inch pizza pan with Pam; set aside. In a large bowl combine all ingredients except reserved cheese and sesame seed. Spread cereal mixture in prepared pan to form a crust; sprinkle top with reserved cheese and seed. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until the cheese melts. Cool on rack at least 10 minutes before cutting into 8 wedges.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Bake cornbread mix. In an oblong dish layer bite size pieces of bread tomatoes pepper onions bacon and pickles. Pour 1/2 of mayonnaise and pickle mixture over 1st layer and remaining over top. Store in refrigerator overnight or at least 2 to 3 hours.

title: Petite Cheesecakes
instructions: You will need 2 dozen paper baking cups.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli per package directions. Drain and reserve 1 cup liquid.

title: Artichoke Dip And Fried Tomatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a small casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown and bubbly approximately 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer the ingredients in a clear salad bowl.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Melt butter in skillet and add onion celery and green peppers. Cook slowly until tender; add flour and seasoning and stir. Stir in tomatoes; cook 10 minutes over low heat. Add shrimp. Remove bay leaf and lemon slice.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning; spread on platter. Sprinkle hamburger (optional) cheese lettuce and tomato over top evenly in layers. Pour picante sauce over top of everything or serve in bowl on side. Serve dip with tortilla chips.

title: Sauce For Hot Dogs(Ice Cream Social Recipe)
instructions: Cut onions fine; barely cover with water and simmer a few minutes. Add meat; cook. Add rest of ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours.

title: Champagne Salad
instructions: Blend cream cheese and sugar set aside. Drain strawberries (dont use juice). Mix bananas pineapple strawberries and pecans. Add cheese mixture. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour into a 9 x 13 inch pan (ungreased) and freeze. Can be made a day or two ahead of time. Take out 15 minutes before serving.

title: Snicker Bars
instructions: In large bowl put ice milk. Start mixer and add next 3 ingredients in order given; blend after each. Add Grape Nuts. Put in 8 x 8-inch pan. Freeze (it helps to spray pan with nonstick spray). Cut into 8 bars. Each one is 1/2 fruit 1/4 milk 1/2 protein 1/2 fat 1/2 bread 40 optional calories.

title: Tamale Corn
instructions: Remove\tshucks\tfrom the tamales and reserve the liquid (3/4 cup). Mix\tcream-style corn and mashed tamales. Grate the cheese and add to corn and tamales. Add milk and egg. Add tomato liquid and chili powder. Sprinkle crushed crackers on top and dot with butter. May serve as a meat. Can be prepared a day ahead. Let stand a little when removed from oven before serving.

title: Onion Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and roll into a ball. Serve.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and store in fridge.

title: Baked Sliced Potatoes
instructions: Cut unpared into 1/4 -inch-thick slices. Place overlapping slices in a buttered oven-to-table 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Mix Margarine and Oil. Brush slices with mixture. Pour remaining over Potatoes. Sprinkle with Garlic Salt and Thyme. Bake at 400 for 25 to 30 minutes or until Potatoes are done and browned at the edges. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Turkey Casserole(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Cook peas onion and celery in microwave about 6 minutes to steam tender. Add all ingredients (except cheese) to macaroni and stir. If mixture appears too dry add 1/2 cup water. Place ingredients in baking dish sprayed with Pam. Cover with cheese broken into pieces and spread evenly over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. (Tuna and chicken can be used also.) Can be made ahead of time and baked later.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spread chicken on bottom of sprayed pan. Mix soups sour cream salt and pepper together. Pour over chicken. Crumble crackers; add butter and poppy seed. Spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned. Will thicken as it sets.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Take the skin off chicken breasts debone or use boneless chicken cut into stirps or chunks and place in large casserole dish. Stir in cream of chicken soup and 1/2 can of water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Make up stuffing per instructions (I use only 1/2 of the envelope of spices). Take chicken out of oven when done.
