Spoon in cooked Stove Top stuffing mix thoroughly put back in oven for about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Bring sugar and water to a boil in a large sauce pan. Boil for 3 minutes. Set aside to cool. Blend in a blender (I do one-half at a time) pineapple juice orange juice and bananas. Mix with sugar water that has been cooled. Fill 1-quart containers and freeze until ready to use.

title: Jalapeno Dip
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; saute onion with bacon. Drain grease. Add Velveeta cheese and let melt. Add tomatoes and peppers and simmer on low heat.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Soak onions and cucumbers in salt water overnight. In the morning pour off salt water. Heat vinegar sugar and spices to boiling. Add pickles and heat to boiling point. Fill jars and seal tight. Makes 6 pints.

title: Trisha'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add pudding fruit and juice. Form into ball. Place almonds on top or try to roll on.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Boil dried beans for 2 minutes. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Cook until tender (about 1 1/2 hours). Pour liquid and beans into baking dish. Add catsup to taste. Add brown sugar to taste. Add vinegar. Sprinkle powdered mustard on top. Add chopped onion and put several slices of bacon on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Taco Cheese Dip
instructions: Layer each item on serving dish. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Freckle Face Taters
instructions: Quarter hot potatoes lengthwise and place in a bake and serve dish. Sprinkle grated cheese over potatoes. Melt butter in a skillet and add remaining ingredients; stir until mixture is moist. Crumble mixture over potatoes and broil until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: 7 Layer Bean Dip
instructions: Layer in a casserole (shallow dish) in order given. Serve with chips and salsa.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into fourths. In a shallow bowl combine sugar and cinnamon. Dip each biscuit piece in butter and then roll in sugar and cinnamon and place in a grease bundt pan. repeat this process until all biscuits are dipped and placed in the pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. When done immediately go around the edges with a knife to make sure it comes out with ease. Invert pan onto dish and gently raise the pan off. If some sticks to the top you can melt a little butter with cinnamon and sugar to paste on top.

title: Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot; cook on low for about 6 hours. Chicken noodle soup recipe serves 4.

title: Ratitos
instructions: Slit each pepper on the side and remove seeds leaving stem in place.

title: Macaroni And Cheese With Dogs
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Add noodles and oil. Let simmer for 10 minutes. In another pan boil hot dog pieces. In a large microwavable dish combine butter milk and Velveeta. Microwave on high for 10 to 12 minutes or until cheese is melted. Drain noodles and rinse thoroughly with hot water. Combine noodles cheese mixture and hot dog pieces. Mix well and serve warm. Grated Parmesan salt and pepper can be added for flavor when serving. This dish can be reheated and served as a leftover. Serves 6.

title: Cheddar Cheese Chowder
instructions: Add boiling water to vegetables salt and pepper. Cover. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes until just tender. Do not drain. In large pan or Dutch oven make a white sauce with margarine flour and milk. Add cheese. Stir to melt cheese. Add vegetables and liquid they were cooked in. Heat well; do not boil.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes; peel and dice. Add sour cream and shredded Cheddar cheese. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Pour 1/2 cup melted butter on the top. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 25 minutes or until lightly browned on top.

title: Pie'S Fruitcake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar and eggs. Add flour spices and salt; mix well. Add fruit and nuts. Stir. Put mix in pan.

title: 8 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in order Lettuce celery carrots onion and peas. Spread mayonnaise on top. Sprinkle with sugar. Top with bacon bits then cheese. Cover and chill 4 to 6 hours. Do not stir before serving. Keeps several days. Serves 8 to 9.

title: Deviled Egg Casserole
instructions: Halve eggs lengthwise. Remove yolks and mash. Mix with mustard 3 tablespoons sour cream and salt. Fill whites. Melt margarine in skillet; saute onion pepper and mushrooms until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in pimento soup and remainder of sour cream. Place 1/2 of soup mixture in a 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Arrange eggs in single layer in dish. Pour remaining soup mix over top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Mix Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Place in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Chocolate Peanut Goodies
instructions: Combine Duncan Hines milk chocolate frosting and Jif creamy peanut butter in large bowl. Stir with wooden spoon until blended. Add oats and chopped peanuts. Stir until thoroughly blended. Press candy mixture into ungreased 8-inch square pan. Cut in 36 pieces. Decorate tops with peanut halves. Store in covered container in refrigerator. Makes 1 3/4 pounds of candy.

title: English Toffee
instructions: Cook butter and sugar over medium-high heat until color of brown paper bag 7 minutes or more. Never remove when yellow and never leave unattended. Stir in almonds. Pour into 9 x 9-inch pan. Pour melted Hershey bars over top and sprinkle nuts over Hershey bars. Cool and break into chunks. Put into refrigerator to cool.

title: Jim'S Cheese Sauce(Microwave)
instructions: Microwave for one minute stir and pour over hot baked potato. Yields 2 servings.

title: French Toast With Orange Butter
instructions: Place bread in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Combine eggs milk salt nutmeg and vanilla; beat well. Pour mixture over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in electric skillet at 300\u00b0. Remove six slices of bread from dish and cook in butter 10 to 12 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Repeat procedure with remaining butter and bread. Serve hot with Orange Butter. Makes 6 servings.

title: Carrot Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl. Stir well. Cover and chill 2 hours. Gently stir sour cream into carrot mixture. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Creamy Swiss And Broccoli Soup
instructions: Boil ham in water 10 minutes; add broccoli. Cook until tender. Gradually add milk to flour stirring until well blended. Gradually add milk mixture to ham mixture stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add cheese and seasonings. Cook until cheese begins to melt.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix then roll in nuts if desired.

title: Sugar Cream Squares
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well. Pat down in oblong cake pan that is buttered.

title: Zucchini Muffins Or Pie
instructions: One slice of pineapple topped with a scoop of jellied cranberry sauce.

title: Strawberry Flip
instructions: Clean and cut up strawberries. Crush ice with an ice crusher (or wrap ice in a dish towel place on a cutting board and hit it with a hammer). Mix all ingredients for 1 minute in a blender or shake well in a covered plastic container. Makes 2 servings.

title: Tuna Crab Salad Mold
instructions: Mix gelatin in cold water. Heat over hot water and mix with mayonnaise. Mix with other ingredients and put in mold. Chill.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix together broccoli cauliflower peas celery and green onions. In a small bowl blend sour cream mayonnaise and Ranch dressing together. Pour over vegetable mixture. Mix. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Potato Goulash
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp crumble add onion cook until tender and golden. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Lemon Cookies
instructions: Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Scottish Shortbread
instructions: Place sugar on a baking board and put butter on top. Kneading gently with the fingers and heel of hand mix together. When all sugar is absorbed into the butter add flour to the board (maybe a 1/4 of the total amount at a time) and knead until all the flour is absorbed and dough is smooth not breaking apart. Cut the dough in half and roll each piece to approximately 7-inch in diameter (it will be about 1/2-inch thick). Crimp the edges and prick all over with a fork.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed on box. Pour into 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Mix peaches and cornstarch together to thicken peaches. Pour on top of cake mix. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until done (cake tester comes out of cake dry). Serve with whipped cream.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger. Put all ingredients except cheese and sour cream into a 2-quart saucepan. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. When serving sprinkle cheese on top and add 1 tablespoon sour cream. The amount of hot peppers you use would depend on how hot you want the soup to be. Use tortilla chips instead of crackers to complement this soup.

title: Pecan Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Blend cornstarch brown sugar and salt; mix with butter. Gradually add orange juice stirring until thickened and clear. Put sweet potatoes into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Pour sauce over sweet potatoes. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until heated through.

title: Sherbet Punch
instructions: Pour Sprite over sherbet. Add cherries. Mix together lightly leaving a good portion of sherbet in center. Pour into glasses. More Sprite can be added until sherbet is gone.

title: Pepper Snaps
instructions: In a small bowl combine dry ingredients and set aside. In a medium bowl cream the butter and \\sugar. Add eggs; mix well. Gradually add dry mixture; stir just until blended. Wrap in wax paper or clear plastic. Put in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Form 1/2 teaspoon of dough into balls. Place on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake for about 10 minutes until lightly browned. Cool on wire rack. Makes about 8 dozen.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Oil the crock-pot well. Add all ingredients and mix well. Cook 4 hours on low.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Put first 8 ingredients in pot and boil until broccoli is tender. Add half and half soups and cheese. Heat until all is melted (do not boil). Stir as it heats. Serves 8.

title: Shrimp Scampi And Pasta
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp. Saute onions parsley and garlic in butter until tender. Reduce heat to low. Add shrimp. Cook stirring frequently 3 to 5 minutes. Add water lemon juice salt and pepper. Simmer 3 minutes. Pour over cooked pasta.

title: Buffalo Chili
instructions: Brown meat in large pot. Rinse and drain. Saute onion in nonstick pan. Put meat and onion in large pot and add all other ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spoon tablespoon size dollop into hot oil and gently flatten to about 1/4-inch thick. Cook about 3 minutes or until golden brown on both sides.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Squeeze lemon juice on shrimp before adding noodles. Add all ingredients together mixing lightly.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix first three ingredients with pastry blender. Spread in greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cover with filling.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Drain tuna; chop onion and mix with the rest of ingredients in a large bowl. Dip is fluffier if you use mixer. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Candy
instructions: Boil milk sugar margarine and cocoa for 1 1/2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour into greased pan. No further cooking necessary. Makes 2 dozen squares.

title: Hamburger Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onions drain. Add all remaining ingredients except coleslaw. Stir and blend together. Place coleslaw in bottom of a 2 qt casserole dish. Spoon mixture over slaw. Cover and bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash potatoes; mix with other ingredients and beat well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and add topping.

title: Brandy Alexander Pie
instructions: Put water in a medium saucepan. Stir in gelatin until softened. Add 1/3 cup sugar salt and egg yolks. Blend. Heat slowly until gelatin is dissolved and mixture thickens. Do not boil. Remove from heat and stir in liqueurs. Chill until mixture mounds.

title: Beef And Bean Enchiladas
instructions: Brown the ground chuck with onions. Drain and stir in refried beans. Remove from heat. In saucepan heat soup milk water and tomato sauce. Wrap 6 tortillas in paper towel and heat 1 minute on High in microwave. Wrap tortillas with meat filling. Place wrapped tortillas in baking dish. Add sauce over top of tortillas. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Five minutes before ready to remove add cheese on top. Serve with sour cream and black olives.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Saute squash and onion in margarine for 10 minutes. Remove from heat; add seasonings let cool. In large bowl beat eggs; add cheese and stir in squash mixture. Place roll dough in bottom and sides of baking dish to make shell. Spread mustard over dough. Pour in squash mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cabbage Tomato Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in a small amount of water until crisp-tender. In a saucepan combine 1 tablespoon butter tomatoes salt sugar and minced onion. Cook for 5 minutes. Arrange cabbage tomato mixture and rice in layers in a casserole dish. Combine bread crumbs cheese and remaining butter and sprinkle over the top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Best Brownies
instructions: Mix and pour into 11 x 7-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Put in refrigerator immediately from oven to cool.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Pour into large casserole dish and cover with foil. Bake 1 hour with oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken A La King With Pepper Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0f. 190\u00b0c. gas mark 5. Prepare biscuits as label directs but brush biscuit tops with egg white and sprinkle with the black pepper. Bake as directed and keep warm. Cut the chicken into 2 cubes and in a non stick 12-inch skillet over a medium heat in 1 tablespoon of hot oil cook the chicken until browned and the juices run clear. Remove chicken to a bowl. In the same skillet add 1 more tablespoon of hot oil and 2 tablespoons of water cook the red pepper and onion until browned and tender. Return the chicken to the skillet with any accumulated juices from the bowl. Stir in the gravy milk and frozen peas; heat through. Serve with the warm biscuits. Serves 5.

title: Sponge Candy
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and vinegar in large heavy 6 quart saucepan. Stir and cook over medium heat until sugar dissolves.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in a 16 x 11 x 2-inch pan. Add sugar to pineapple and bring to a boil. Pour over cake while hot then cool. Add 3 cups cold milk to pudding mix and beat until thick. Pour over pineapple mixture. Mix Cool Whip and sour cream; spread over pudding. Sprinkle nuts over pudding then coconut. You may add cherries on top if desired. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Salmon Supper
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Saute onion and green pepper in hot fat until onion is golden. Blend in salt and flour. Gradually stir in milk and soup. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Add flaked salmon peas and lemon juice. Pour into baking dish 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch. Top with biscuits. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Blend ingredients together until smooth; refrigerate. This dip is best made the day before serving to give the herbs time to flavor the cheese. Excellent as a dip for fresh vegetables or on hunks of sourdough bread!

title: Beef-Filled Macaroni Shells
instructions: Cook macaroni shells as directed on package using maximum cooking time. Drain rinse with cool water. Arrange on paper towels to dry. While shells are cooking cook ground beef and onion in a large skillet until done. Drain off fat. Stir in catsup mustard chili powder and garlic salt. Heat. Heat shortening to 365\u00b0 and fry several shells at a time for about 2 minutes or until golden brown; turn once during frying. Drain on paper towels. As shells are fried spoon about 1 tablespoon warm filling into each fried shell. Garnish with a sweet pickle slice. Serve warm. Makes 3 to 5 dozen appetizers.

title: Cool Rise Sweet Dough Rolls
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour undissolved yeast sugar and salt in large bowl. Using electric mixer mix well. Add butter; blend thoroughly. Add hot tap water. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes. Scrape bowl occasionally. Add eggs and 1 cup more flour. Beat with electric mixer at high speed for 1 minute or until thick and elastic. Gradually stir in just enough of remaining flour with wooden spoon to make a soft dough which leaves sides of bowl. Turn out onto floured board. Knead 5 to 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic. Cover with plastic wrap then a towel.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Prepare Basic Biscuits except after cutting in shortening stir in cheese dry mustard and red pepper. Bake as normal. Makes 12 to 14 biscuits.

title: Breakfast In A Cup
instructions: Combine rice 1/2 cup cheese chiles pimentos milk eggs salt pepper and spices. Spray muffin pan and fill 12 cups with mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until set.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients and put in bottom of 9 x 9-inch microwave dish. Spread on cheese sauce. Brown ground beef and drain. Add to ground beef the salsa and place on top of cheese.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil stirring all the time; then boil for 2 minutes. Then add 1 teaspoon vanilla and beat with mixer for about 5 minutes.

title: Spam Balls
instructions: Mix and refrigerate for 2 hours. Then roll in chopped pecans.

title: Okra Creole
instructions: Microwave okra in 1/4 cup water 9 to 11 minutes. Stir occasionally. Drain. Mix cornstarch with small amount of tomato juice until smooth. Add to okra and stir in other ingredients. Cover and microwave 10 minutes longer. Stir occasionally.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in hot fat; remove. Add onion soup and milk to fat in pan; blend and set aside. Starting with potatoes put alternate layers of potatoes and cabbage into 2-quart casserole or 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan; sprinkle each layer with flour pour soup sauce over each layer. Place chops on top; cover casserole or use foil to cover pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 servings.

title: Squash And Apple Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut squash in half. Remove seeds and fibers; pare squash. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Stir remaining ingredients except apple slices. Arrange squash in ungreased baking dish 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inches; top with apple slices. Sprinkle sugar mixture over top. Cover with foil. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until squash is tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Vinegar Beets
instructions: Mix vinegar and cornstarch. Pour into pan with sugar. Cook until thickens. Add beet juice. Cook slowly until thick. Add beets. Add butter. Cook slowly 15 minutes.

title: Stuffing*
instructions: Mix together and top breasts (use 1/4 cup on each). Fold sides in and roll up. Place seam side down in 12 x 7 x 2-inch pan. Pour sauce over. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Uncover. Sprinkle with 1 cup shredded Swiss cheese and paprika. Bake 2 minutes until the cheese melts.

title: Graham Cracker Roll
instructions: Mix all together. Press this mixture into a mold. Chill overnight. Unmold. Slice and serve. Top with whipped cream.

title: Spicy Chicken(Low-Fat)
instructions: Prepare in Teflon skillet or on Teflon grill over low heat. Roll each piece of meat in seasoning and cook until done turning frequently. When done top with shredded cheese and cover until melted. Serve immediately.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients except cream cheese in double boiler. Cook and stir constantly until thick. Let cool to room temperature. Beat cream cheese until fluffy and fold into other ingredients. Serve with various fresh and canned fruits. Cut into chunks.

title: American Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat garlic and Parmesan cheese. Add tomato sauce seasonings and onion. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cook noodles. In large casserole alternate layers of meat sauce noodles cheese and cottage cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Middle Street Crumb Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix first 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Add oil milk and eggs. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Put batter into ungreased 8-inch square pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar then cinnamon. Dot top with butter. Bake until tester comes out clean in center about 50 minutes. Cool slightly. Cut into squares.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients and keep in covered jar. Use about 2 teaspoons (more or less according to taste) per cup of hot water.

title: Swedish Sweet Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in milk sugar salt eggs shortening and 2 1/2 cups flour to make dough easy to handle. Turn dough onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes. Cover and let rise in warm place until double about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water and milk. Add remaining ingredients. Can be mixed with a mixer until about the last 2 cups of flour. Let rise to double then punch down and put in refrigerator. Pinch off and let rise as needed. Will keep a week or more in the refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Noodles And Franks
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. In small saucepan heat tomato soup undiluted and frankfurters until hot; add noodles and serve. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Supper Pie
instructions: Prepare mashed potatoes and gravy mix according to package directions. Spread potatoes in well-greased 9-inch pie plate covering bottom and sides to make a shell. Mix ground beef egg bread crumbs vegetables and 1/4 cup gravy. Mix well. Spoon carefully into potato shell patting with back of spoon to level off evenly. Brush edges of potato crust lightly with oil or melted butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with remaining gravy.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat together eggs milk sugar cinnamon vanilla and salt. Place bread crumbs\tin 8 1/2-inch round baking dish. Sprinkle raisins over bread. Pour egg mixture over all. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Mother'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll dough in small balls with hands dip each in granulated sugar. Bake on greased cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut off tips of squash. Then cut each into 3 to 4 pieces. Drop into a large saucepan with enough boiling water to cover. Return to a boil. Reduce heat and cook until tender. Drain and mash.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Boil and slice potatoes. Heat in pan the last four ingredients until melted. Pour over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Oven Baked Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Cook onion until soft in hot oil. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 15 minutes (2 chickens or equivalent pieces). Place chicken skin side up in large pan; do not overlap. Cover with sauce. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 90 minutes basting occasionally.

title: Hanky-Panky
instructions: Brown beef and sausage with salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Melt cheese in meat. Spread 1 full teaspoon of mixture on rye bread and bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Gently mix fruit celery and pecans. Mix apple juice yogurt and margarine until smooth. Pour over apple mixture. Serve on lettuce-lined plates.

title: Orange Rice Cream
instructions: Make early in day or one hour before serving. Cook rice as label directs; refrigerate. Peel orange cut into sections; reserve 10 sections for decoration; cut rest in half and sprinkle with sugar; refrigerate. Just before serving whip cream stiff and add vanilla. Fold in rice and halved orange sections (if very juicy drain off some juice). Arrange in serving dish; decorate with 10 orange sections and chocolate pieces. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Beef Stroganoff - Mom'S
instructions: Cut sliced round steak into thin strips; dust with flour and dash of pepper. In a large skillet brown the meat in butter; add mushrooms onions and garlic and brown lightly. Stir in beef broth and cover; cook until meat is tender stirring now and then. Gradually stir in sour cream cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift flour cinnamon and salt together. Beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar oil vanilla and sifted dry ingredients a little at a time. The mixture will be thick. Add the zucchini; mixture will be gummy. Pour into two well-greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Check at 50 minutes with toothpick.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into a buttered 8 x 12-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden.

title: Paradise Jam
instructions: Boil prepared fruit 1 minute; add Certo and remove from heat. Stir for 5 minutes to prevent floating fruit. Skim foam if necessary. Ladle into jars. Cover at once with wax. If using jelly jars with 2-piece lids fill jar to 1/8-inch of top. Screw tops on tight. Invert jars for 5 minutes then turn upright. After jars have cooled check seal.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Beat all ingredients in blender on high speed 1 minute or until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 8 servings.

title: Green Punch
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and chill. Add ginger ale at serving time. Serves about 24 (4 ounce) servings. Ten times amount will serve 250 people.

title: Festive Pork Roast
instructions: In large plastic bag combine first five ingredients; mix well. Add roast turning to coat on all sides. Cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 days (turning several times a day). Remove meat discard marinade. Place with fat side down on a rack in shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Cover and let stand 15 minutes before carving. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put in blender and whip until frothy

title: Brownstone Front Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and sour cream. Mix. Combine flour soda salt and cocoa. Add to creamed mixture. You can add a tablespoon of oil. It helps when cream is thick. Bake at 350\u00b0 (approximately 1 hour but check it with toothpick). This is a large cake. It will make 3 layers.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Add onions to 1/4 cup of cooking oil and cook until dark golden brown. Add shrimp to onions and saut. Add well washed rice with water; salt rice to taste. Bring to a boil until almost all the water has evaporated. Stir mixture well. Cover on real low fire until cooked about 20 minutes.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Coat beef with seasoned flour. Heat oil in Dutch oven then add beef and brown on all sides. Drain off fat. Add onion seasonings lemon juice sugar Worcestershire water tomato sauce. Cover and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours adding more water if necessary.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Melt cheese and soup together. Add other ingredients plus sausage and stir. Serve warm. Very tasty with tortilla chips.

title: Italian Meat Balls And Sauce
instructions: Simmer together for some time.

title: Fish And Vegetables
instructions: Layer 1/2 of vegetables in an 8 x 8-inch dish. Season fish; place on vegetables. Cover with remaining vegetables. Add water; dot with butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Place all ingredients in dish. Stir. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours before serving. Yields 12 servings.

title: Macaroni Delight
instructions: Boil macaroni for 10 to 12 minutes. Place broccoli in pot. When it comes to a boil put in seasoning. Drain. Let cool 5 minutes.

title: Amish Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugars oil and butter. Add the remaining ingredients mix well. Roll in small ball and flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Defrost and drain broccoli well. Mix broccoli cream of mushroom soup beaten eggs grated Cheddar cheese grated onion mayo and half of melted butter. Pour in casserole dish. Top with small amount of bread crumbs and remaining butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Boil sugar water and butter for one minute. Add rum. After removing cake from pan pour the liquid mixture slowly over cake.

title: Lemonade Or Limeade
instructions: Dissolve sugar in 1 cup water. Add lemon or lime juice. Add remaining cold water. Serve over ice. Makes 6 1/2 cups.

title: Mimi'S Texas Slaw
instructions: Grind vegetables with coarse blade; mix well. Add salt and let stand 2 hours. Drain well. Add sugar seeds and vinegar. Do not cook. Put in jars in the refrigerator. Keeps for weeks.

title: Picadillo(Cuban Ground Beef)
instructions: Brown ground beef drain and set aside. Saute garlic onion and olives in olive oil. Add the browned ground beef tomato sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes. Serve with white rice.

title: Rhubarb Punch
instructions: Cut into pieces fresh rhubarb and cook in 2-quarts of water until soft. Strain through cloth bag. Dissolve sugar in 2 cups of water. Boil 10 minutes. Cool and add lemon juice and pineapple juice. Mix rhubarb mixture. Chill. Add ginger ale when ready to serve. Makes 1 gallon. Will serve 24 people.

title: Overnight Fresh Pickles
instructions: Cut cucumbers lengthwise in spears or crosswise in slices. Slice onion into rings. Alternate layers of cucumbers and onions into a large glass or ceramic bowl.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Beans
instructions: Heat to bubbling at 325\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Chow Mein Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Mix with all remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 1/2 hours. Serve with chow mein noodles.

title: Easy Cherry Cheese Danish
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine and cream together the cream cheese sugar egg and vanilla. Butter 1 jelly roll pan. Pat 1 package of crescent rolls into the bottom and a little up the sides of pan. Bake 4 minutes to set. Spread cheese mixture evenly on top. Spread on pie filling. Stretch remaining roll and lay on top. It will not completely cover. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown. When cool sift on powdered sugar.

title: Grandma'S Stuffing
instructions: Mix together 1/2 the broth with all the other ingredients. Make stuffing real moist before refrigerating (cover with wet towel)...stuff bird when stuffing is cool. Use other 1/2 of broth in gravy.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Fry hamburger; drain. Mix with taco seasoning and simmer for 5 minutes. Cool. Add rest of ingredients and pour French dressing over all; mix. (Add Doritos and dressing just before serving to insure freshness.)

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Process vanilla wafers into crumbs in the blender. Add pecan pieces to crumbs and process. Combine crumbs ground pecan pieces powdered sugar orange juice concentrate and butter in a large bowl. Stir until blended. Divide mixture in half. Cover one portion with plastic wrap and set aside. Shape remaining portion into 1-inch balls and roll in coconut. Repeat with other portion. Store balls in airtight container in refrigerator for up to one week.

title: Pearl Street'S Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Cut broccoli in 1-inch pieces. Heat butter garlic and parsley. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Add wine and chicken. Continue cooking over medium heat. When chicken is almost done add broccoli. Cook a few minutes more stirring often then add peppers. Serve over hot cooked rotini. Serves 2.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk. Bring to full rolling boil. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Crush crackers fine and add to candy mixture. Beat until mixture begins to hold shape. Spread into greased 8-inch square pan. Cool and cut. Yummy you will not know this is made from soda crackers!

title: Baked Cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 2-quart casserole. Cook cabbage in boiling salted water for 10 minutes. Drain and let cool; chop finely. In mixing bowl blend eggs 3 tablespoons oleo cream salt and pepper; stir in cabbage. Turn into casserole dish. Blend remaining oleo and crumbs and sprinkle over cabbage. Bake 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Peanut Soup
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a heavy 2 to 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Remove from heat and puree until smooth. Return soup to saucepan and add rice chili and salt. Bring to a boil. Simmer covered 15 to 20 minutes until rice is tender. In a small bowl mix 1/2 cup of the soup and peanut butter until blended. Stir in Tabasco sauce. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove dried chili. Thin with water if too thick. Add additional salt if needed.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into one-inch meatballs. Brown on all sides over medium heat. Put meatballs in Pyrex and cover with sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Pour hot water over dates and soda cover let sit for 15 minutes. Cream sugar and shortening add well beaten egg. Add flour salt and date mixture alternately to sugar. Cream well and add pecans and vanilla. Bake in greased loaf pan for 1 hour at 375 degrees.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt in top of double boiler; stir in milk. Cook over boiling water stirring constantly until thickened. Cook uncovered 15 minutes more stirring occasionally. Beat egg yolks; gradually stir in hot mixture. Return to double boiler. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Line bottom of casserole with vanilla wafers; top with layer of sliced bananas. Continue to layer wafers bananas and custard ending with custard on top. Beat egg whites stiff but not dry. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar and beat until mixture forms stiff peaks. Pile on top of pudding and bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until delicately browned. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: In a large saucepan mix soda buttermilk and sugar and boil slowly to soft ball stage. Mixture turns brown as it cooks but need stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add flavoring margarine and pecans. Stir until it begins to look like it is ready to sugar.

title: Orange Fluff
instructions: Follow directions on Jell-O box for orange Jell-O. Add drained mandarin oranges. Refrigerate until set.

title: Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Wash potatoes real good. Cut into bite-size pieces (about 1-inch square). Place clean and cut potatoes into pan with enough water to cover potatoes. Boil until potatoes are tender but not falling apart. When potatoes are done drain water off and let cool. Then in a 9 x 13-inch dish put cooled potatoes seasoned with salt and pepper. Then add a layer of shredded cheese then a layer of sour cream then a layer of green onions then a layer of bacon bits.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Mixture will be slightly runny. Blend in some self-rising flour for texture. Roll out and cut about 3/4 inch thick so biscuits will rise. Put either oil or melted butter in bottom of cookie sheet or loaf pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown at 400\u00b0. Pour melted butter over them after baked.

title: Hawaiian Salad
instructions: Mix together and store in refrigerator.

title: Aunt Hattie'S Pork Roast
instructions: Saute pork roast with salt pepper and flour in butter in pan. Put sauerkraut with 1/2 of the juice in a crock-pot. Cut up the apples (leave skin on) into wedges. Cut the new potatoes in half. Add the soup mix. Put sauerkraut in bottom of crock-pot. Put pork roast in next then add apples and potatoes. Cook on low all day (7 A.M. to 4 P.M. approximately).

title: Banana Pudding Dessert
instructions: Mix pudding and milk until thickened. Add Cool Whip and stir until mixed. Line bottom of oblong pan with graham crackers. Top with sliced bananas. Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture on top. Line with more graham crackers and spread other 1/2 of pudding mixture on. Line with more graham crackers and finally top with favorite pie filling (I like strawberry best). Cover. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Herbed Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients; work with hands to make certain it is well mixed. Pack into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Candied Popcorn
instructions: Keep popped popcorn in oven at 200 - 250 degrees to keep warm. Boil brown sugar butter corn syrup vanilla and salt for 5 minutes. Take off stove and add baking soda. Stir well and add to popcorn in a large oven proof bowl. Stir well and return to oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Stir well and return to oven for another 10 minutes. Take out of pan and place on waxed paper until cool. Store in an air tight container.

title: Parmesan Dill Fish Fillets
instructions: Thaw fish if frozen. In mixing bowl stir together egg white and water. In another bowl stir together crushed crackers dill weed Parmesan cheese and parsley. Dip fish into egg white mixture then into cracker mixture to coat. Cook fish in hot skillet until fish flakes easily with a fork turning once. Or bake in the oven at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes turning once.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together first 3 ingredients. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour 45 minutes.

title: Traditional Christmas Fudge
instructions: Combine butter evaporated milk sugar and salt in medium heavy saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil for 4 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows morsels nuts and vanilla. Stir vigorously for 1 minutes or until marshmallows are melted. Pour into foil-lined 8-inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with additional pecans if desired. Chill until firm. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Granny'S Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix applesauce and soda; add shortening and sugar. Blend in eggs. Mix in flour baking powder and vanilla. Bake in oven (350\u00b0) for 45 minutes or until well done.

title: Divinity
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup water and salt in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils then cook without stirring to hard boil stage.

title: Cherry Raisin Walnut Shortbread Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease an 8-inch square pan. Combine flour and sugar cut in margarine until mixture resembles fine meal. Press into greased pan and bake 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Meanwhile mix eggs brown sugar and vanilla beating well. Stir in soda walnuts raisins and coconut. Spoon over hot crust spread evenly. Return to oven; bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes or until top is set. Cool cut into bars and serve.

title: Sweet Potato Snowballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly butter a cookie sheet. In a bowl blend sweet potatoes brown sugar butter and allspice. Roll marshmallows separately in mixture forming balls. Roll each into coconut. Place on a baking sheet and cook 5 to 8 minutes or until marshmallows heat but dont melt.

title: Jalapeno Bread
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. When cooled mix with remaining ingredients (except biscuits). Cut biscuits into fourths and place in large bowl. Pour mixture over biscuit pieces and toss with hands until well distributed. Put into a lightly greased bundt pan.

title: Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Drain. Add soups pepper and milk until hot. Line baking dish with tortillas overlapping them and letting them come up the sides. Pour in meat mixture and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted and tortillas begin to brown.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar margarine and other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Makes 2 pies.

title: Coffee Ring
instructions: Place milk sugar and shortening in saucepan. Scald milk. Remove from heat. Add salt and cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in two tablespoons warm water and add to mixture. Beat in flour and knead. Let rise to double bulk and knead again.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Reserve 1/4 to 1/2 cup vanilla wafer crumbs and margarine in a bowl. Press into bottom and side of 9-inch pie plate. Mix lemonade and condensed milk in bowl. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon into pie shell. Sprinkle reserved crumbs in circle around edge of pie. Chill in refrigerator for 8 hours.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients except pie crust in pot. Simmer for 15 minutes. Put in pie crust. Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes in 425\u00b0 oven.

title: Marble Cheese Steak
instructions: Bake or fry steaks to medium done. When done layer sliced tomatoes and sweet onion on top of steaks. Cover and bake or fry until tomatoes and onion are soft. Layer steaks tomatoes and onions with cheese. Cook until cheese has melted. Serve with favorite veggies.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Ground bell pepper onion garlic carrot and mushrooms. (May chop fine in food processor for best results). Cook 1 cup of couscous as directed on box of pasta. Add to ground ingredients then add 1 scrambled egg. Mix well. Roll out to patties. Bake or fry as desired. Serve on hamburger buns (cheese optional). May use rice instead of couscous.

title: Flour Tortillas
instructions: Mix all together and roll out into desired size tortillas.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Put aluminum foil around crust after 25 minutes cooking time.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs salt soda and lemon juice. Beat well. Mix vanilla flour apples and nuts. Bake in 11 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pistachio Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix oil and eggs together. Then add sour cream and pudding mix for 5 minutes. Grease pan with Crisco (Bundt pan). Sprinkle bottom of pan with chocolate chips. Pour little over half of mixture into pan. Swirl syrup in with knife. Pour rest of mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan while still warm.

title: Cheese Hash Browns
instructions: Saute onion and butter together. Combine sour cream and soup with butter and onion. Crumble hash browns if patties; combine with soup mixture and add 8 ounces cheese. Put into 9 x 13-inch pan and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add rest of ingredients in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Nuts
instructions: Heat pecans in moderate oven for 5 minutes stirring once.

title: Shrimp-Rice Parmesan
instructions: About 1 hour and 15 minutes before serving in hot oil in skillet over medium heat cook rice stirring constantly until golden. Add water tomatoes salt pepper Worcestershire sauce onion and carrots. Cook covered until carrots are tender. Add shrimp. Cook 5 minutes or until shrimp are tender. Serve passing cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Candy Bar Cake
instructions: Combine candy bars and 1/2 cup butter in a heavy saucepan; place over medium heat and stir constantly until candy bars melt. Set aside. Beat remaining 1/2 cup butter at medium speed with an electric mixer about 2 minutes or until soft and creamy. Gradually add sugar beating at medium speed for 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating just until yellow disappears. Stir in vanilla. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix at low speed just until blended after each addition. Stir in pecans and candy bar mixture. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan for 15 minutes on wire rack. Remove from pan let cool completely on wire rack.

title: Hamburger Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef green pepper and onion in skillet. Drain grease. Add Philadelphia cream cheese and salsa. Heat until cheese is melted and place in crock-pot. Serve with \dip size\ Fritos corn chips.

title: Porridge Pie(Handy For Picnic Lunches, Or For Entertaining Friends.)
instructions: Lightly beat milk and eggs together in a large bowl. Add first measure of cheese rolled oats salt pepper herbs and cottage cheese. Drain and flake tuna. Add to bowl. Wash and chop the spinach. Wash and slice the mushrooms. Peel and grate the carrot. Peel and chop the onion. Blanch the tomatoes and chop. Add spinach mushrooms carrot onion and tomatoes. Mix thoroughly. Put in ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with second measure of cheese. Bake at 180\u00b0 C (350\u00b0) for 40 to 60 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
instructions: Turn crock-pot on high setting while chopping and cutting ingredients. Combine all ingredients except peas in crock-pot. Cover and reduce heat to low setting. Cook 7 to 8 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender. Stir in peas during last 30 minutes of cooking time. (If using high setting cook for 5 hours or until tender.) Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Brunch Eggs(Serves 24)
instructions: Scramble very very very lightly in butter the eggs and milk until just barely set. Put layer of eggs in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle half of soup on eggs sprinkle can of mushrooms and sprinkle cheese on top. Add second layer. Sprinkle top with paprika and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Cheddar Cheese Squares
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and milk in small saucepan. Cook on low heat about 5 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly stirring constantly. Add Cheddar cheese; stir and heat until cheese is melted. Serve over cooked chicken vegetables or pasta. Makes 1 cup sauce.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger with chopped onion and drain. Mix with soup and water. Put in bottom of pan. Pour soup over. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Arrange Tater Tots on top evenly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until onions really start to smell.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish. Spread 1 1/4 cups rice in bottom of pan or baking dish. Spread 1 package dry onion soup over 1 cup of cut-up chicken. Mix celery soup with 1 can of water and add to casserole. Mix cream of chicken or cream of mushroom with 1 can of water and add to casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Press rolls in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Spread sausage over rolls. Next put cheese then pour beaten eggs and milk over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Sugar Cookies
instructions: Using mixing bowl stir together butter and sugar. Stir in egg and milk. Stir in baking powder and enough flour to make thick dough. Stir until dough clings together. On floured surface using floured rolling pin roll dough very thin. Using floured cookie cutter press out cookies. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown. Sprinkle sugar lightly over tops of cookies while still hot. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Cream butter and sugar and then add well beaten egg yolks and mix well. Sift flour and then measure and sift again with baking powder. Mix vanilla and lemon and almond extracts in the milk and add alternately with dry ingredients. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake 50 to 55 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Pop popcorn in air popper. Yields 5 to 6 quarts popped corn. Place in large bowl. Combine butter sugar syrup and salt in heavy saucepan. Heat and stir over medium heat until boiling. Then boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and soda. Pour over popcorn and toss well until all pieces are coated. Spread on 2 large ungreased shallow pans. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Cool completely. Break apart and store in airtight containers.

title: Sun Glazed Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a baking dish. Combine all ingredients. Brush both sides of chicken with glaze. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Brush with more glaze. Bake 10 minutes and brush with glaze. Bake until chicken is done maybe another 30 minutes. Serve on a bed of rice.

title: Poppy Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a casserole dish. Combine sour cream and cream of chicken soup and pour over chicken. Melt butter and combine with crackers and poppy seed then pour over the top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cabbage Souffle Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in small amount of water with salt until tender; drain. Spread bread slices with margarine. Combine eggs and milk; soak bread in egg mixture until soft. Add cabbage cheese salt and pepper; mix well. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 8.

title: Summer Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix cooked shells with olive oil 2 teaspoons lemon juice salt pepper green onion and mayonnaise. Mix 2 teaspoons lemon juice and dried dill with tuna. Add to shells mix. Add peas. Gently mix. Chill and serve.

title: Eagle Brand Double Delicious Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine. Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs. Top with chips and press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature. Makes 24 to 36 bars.

title: Hot Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cook spinach as directed. Drain; set aside. Saute mushrooms in butter. Combine mayo sour cream cheese and blend. Stir mixture into spinach add mushrooms and artichoke hearts. Season with salt and pepper. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Slice tomatoes 1/2-inch thick and put on top of spinach. Saute crumbs in butter until golden. Sprinkle over top of tomatoes. Bake uncovered 20 to 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Pink Raspberry Punch
instructions: Combine sherbet and Hawaiian Punch. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Brown Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together then roll by hand into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Frost with confectioners sugar frosting when cool.

title: Ham Pot Pie
instructions: Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Beat egg and add 1/2 cup milk. Add to dry ingredients. Add shortening. Add enough milk to make a soft dough. Roll out and cut into 1/2-inch squares. Drop into boiling broth and add chunks of ham and potatoes. Cook 20 minutes.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown hamburger. Make rice to box directions but do not evaporate water. Add hamburger to rice. Add bean sprouts and chow mein in large pan. Simmer for 20 minutes. Preparation time 30 minutes.

title: Baked Almond Chicken
instructions: In shallow baking dish place chicken then salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with paprika about 1/2 teaspoon. Cut up margarine and add then water. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered. Remove from oven and spread soup over chicken and sprinkle with sliced almonds. Cover and bake 15 minutes more. Bake 5 more minutes uncovered. Serve with Green Rice.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: *Or you may use a graham cracker crust.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and lightly flour 2 (9 x 1 1/2-inch) round baking pans. Stir together flour cocoa powder baking soda and salt. In a large mixer bowl beat the 1/2 cup shortening on medium speed of electric mixer about 30 seconds. Add the 1 cup sugar and vanilla and beat until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating on medium speed for 1 minute after each. Add dry ingredients and water alternately to beaten mixture beating on low speed after each addition until just combined. Thoroughly wash the beaters. In a small mixer bowl beat egg whites until soft peaks form; gradually add the 3/4 cup sugar beating until stiff peak forms. Fold egg whites mixture into batter; combine well. Turn batter into prepared pans. Spread batter evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake test done. Cool 10 minutes on wire racks. Remove from pans. Cool thoroughly on wire racks.

title: 1000 Calorie Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crusts. Chill 3 to 4 hours.

title: Angel Flake Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Set aside. Sift together next 5 ingredients. To this add buttermilk shortening and the yeast mixture. Roll on floured dough board until thin. Fold in half making edges even and roll thin. Fold in half again and roll until thickness of biscuit desired. Cut out biscuits and place in an airtight plastic container. Keep stored in refrigerator until needed. They will keep for at least two weeks. Do not let them rise before placing in oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. This will make about thirty 2 1/2-inch biscuits.

title: Southern Chocolate Pie
instructions: In saucepan beat egg yolks slightly; add 1 cup sugar slowly until mixed and creamy. Sift dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture. Mix until all blends; add milk and vanilla gradually and cook on low heat until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cream of tartar. Top pie with meringue and brown at 400\u00b0.

title: Glazed Meatballs And Apples
instructions: Combine egg with milk; stir in bread crumbs and salt. Add ground beef and mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls; place in shallow pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Mix water ketchup and brown sugar in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add apples. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 5 minutes. Stir together soy sauce cornstarch and mustard. Stir into apple mixture and cook 2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon transfer meatballs to saucepan. Heat through and serve warm.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except walnuts. Roll into a ball or a log. Roll cheese balls in walnuts until completely covered. Wrap in aluminum foil and refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight. Serve with Town House crackers.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Mix well. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mocha Coffee
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in a container with a tight fitting lid. Add 2 to 3 teaspoons to cup of hot water.

title: Squash Mix
instructions: Saute squash zucchini and onion until tender. Add corn and cheese. Melt. Serve.

title: Garlic Roasted Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice garlic powder seasoning salt and pepper. Wrap chicken loosely in foil. Refrigerate overnight. Place chicken in ovenproof dish and bake. Top with garlic cloves. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Perky Cauliflower Slaw
instructions: Chop or shred cauliflower. Toss together in large bowl cauliflower onion and radishes. Blend together the lemon juice horseradish salt pepper and mayonnaise. Toss with vegetables until well blended. Chill covered in refrigerator. Serve in lettuce cups. Sprinkle each with snipped parsley.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese; add sugar and mix well. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and baking powder then vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Let stand 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice; add all other ingredients to rice and cook 5 minutes on top of stove. Pour into a covered dish; sprinkle with cheese. Cook at 400\u00b0 until cheese is melted or a little brown.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Melt soup in double boiler over hot water. Add gelatin mixture and stir until mixed well. Add cream cheese to soup mixture followed by all other ingredients. Blend together with mixing spoon and pour in 2-quart casserole mold. Refrigerate about 8 hours or overnight.

title: Fish Fillet With Spinach
instructions: Put fillets in dish. Cover with thawed spinach. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cover with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Cheese Rotel Dip
instructions: Put Ro-Tel in pan or double boiler first then cubed cheese and melt slowly. Stir often. Add chili and green onions. Stir until heated through. Serve with favorite chips. Keeps well in refrigerator for 2 to 3 weeks.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jellos and cool. Add crushed pineapple and cheese (cut fine); also add nuts. Let set up some. Lay pineapple rings on top with a cherry in middle of each slice. Chill until set.

title: Bacon Tomato Dip
instructions: In medium bowl stir together all ingredients except crackers or vegetables until well mixed. Cover; refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Spicy Mandarin Orange Muffins
instructions: Drain mandarin orange segments well and spread on paper towels while making batter. Sift flour measure and sift with baking powder salt nutmeg allspice cinnamon and sugar into a bowl. Cut in shortening until very fine. Combine egg and milk. Add all at once. Mix just until moistened. Add orange segments. Mix lightly until evenly distributed. Spoon into greased muffin tins filling about 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden. Remove. Dip top in melted butter then in cinnamon-sugar mixture. Serve hot. Makes 12.

title: Camper'S Cocoa
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. To make cocoa put 1/3 cup of mix in cup. Add hot water. Will keep forever.

title: Woodcock
instructions: Cut up cheese and add to tomato sauce. Cook slowly. Beat the egg and stir all remaining ingredients into sauce until well heated and cheese is melted.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Break bread into small chunks and put in a large bowl. Add milk and let soak for about 10 minutes. Crush with hands until blended. Add eggs sugar raisins and vanilla. Pour margarine into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spoon pudding mixture into pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 or more minutes until pudding is firm. Let cool then cut into squares. Spoon Whiskey Sauce over individual servings. Yields 12 to 15 servings.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar salt milk bread and vanilla; bake at 350\u00b0 in buttered dish until golden brown approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Place milk sugar and butter in saucepan; stir together over medium heat to mix together well. Continue stirring until it boils. Once it boils do not stir and let continue to boil exactly 5 minutes. Take off heat and add vanilla marshmallows and peanut butter. Stir until marshmallows are melted and mixture takes on a dull appearance rather than shiny. Pour into buttered dish.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Cut up egg and add to asparagus then add mushroom soup with 1/2 can water; mix well. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Bean-Onion Salad
instructions: Drain beans; add celery and onion. Combine remaining ingredients; mix with beans. Let set in refrigerator several hours before serving.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Shell eggs. Place in hot sterilized jars and cover with boiling liquid. Seal immediately.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix well and put in graham cracker crust. Simple and easy.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
instructions: Melt oleo in 13 x 10-inch cake pan; cool slightly then add crumbs and the rest of the ingredients on top of each other as listed in recipe. Do not stir!!! Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. When cool cut into bars.

title: **Christmas Fruit Salad
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Gradually add sugar light cream and lemon juice. Mix; cook in double boiler until smooth and thick stirring constantly. Cool. Fold in whipped cream. Pour this over fruit mixture marshmallows and nuts and mix lightly. Chill at least 24 hours before serving. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Perfect Pot Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat oil in heavy Dutch oven. Add meat and brown on all sides. Remove meat and add onion celery and garlic. Cook until tender. Add rest of ingredients. Drain off fat. Add meat. Cover and cook 2 1/2 or 3 hours. Transfer meat to warm platter. Strain and return sauce to stove; work in cornstarch. Bring to a simmer stirring often until thickens. Season with salt and pepper. Slice meat and pour some of the gravy over the meat. Pass the rest. Serves 8.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until crisp in a small amount of water. Drain well. Put back in pan and add cheese and 1/2 of butter. Melt and mix well. Add water chestnuts. Put into casserole dish. Top with crumbled crackers and remaining half stick of butter melted. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Mix all together; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beans 'N Rice Burritos
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Bring broth salsa cumin and salt to boil in saucepan. Cook rice. Add rice beans and tomato to saucepan; return to boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until water is absorbed. Stir in cheese onions and hamburger. Spoon mixture down center of warmed tortilla. Fold one end over filling; roll up. Serve immediately.

title: Kiss Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix peanut butter sugar and eggs well. Dough will be sticky. You can dip your fingers in flour then roll dough into balls. Place on greased cookie sheet about 2-inches apart. Bake 10 to 14 minutes. Remove and place Kiss in center.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: 1. Pour cherry liquid into heavy suacepan. Add margarine powdered sugar and raisins. Stir to dissolve sugar. Bring mixture to a boil for 5 minutes. 2. Remove from heat and pour into large mixing bowl. Let mix cool completely. 3. Sift flour and spices. Mix 1/2 c. flour and gumdrops. Add dry ingredients to raisin mix. Fold in gumdrops drained cherries and nuts. Blend well. 4. Spray (2) 9 x 5 x 3 loave pans. Pour into pans. Bake at at 350\u00b0 for 40-50 minutes. Let cool in pans for 5 minutes before removing to wire rack to cool. Let sit overnight before slicing.

title: Tequila (Sunset) Beef Steaks
instructions: Place meat in large plastic bag. Add all of the ingredients; seal bag. Chill from 1 to 24 hours; turn bag occasionally. Drain steaks. Cook on low to medium flame on grill to desired perfection.

title: Jalapeno Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour half of bread into pan. Sprinkle 1 cup grated cheese on top. Add the rest of the bread mix. Cook at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Mayonnaise Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients; cook in muffin pans. Fill each only 1/2 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown. Makes approximately 12 rolls.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and cinnamon onto wax paper. Melt butter or margarine in a medium size saucepan over moderate heat. Remove from heat.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Skin chicken and take off bone. Put into greased casserole dish. Mix soup and stock. Pour mixture over chicken.

title: Making A Happy Home
instructions: These ingredients thoroughly kneaded with the salt of good common sense flavored with the graces of nature and art music and flowers will make a paradise of a desert a palace of a hovel.

title: Lemon Cheese Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare lemon jello as directed on box. Add vinegar and sugar; partially set and whip. Add pineapple and cheese. Fold in cool whip. Refrigerate.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs. cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove egg yolks and mash together in small mixing bowl. Mix in paprika mayonnaise and mustard powder. Spoon into egg shells and sprinkle with paprika. Cool and serve.

title: Kola Baked Beans
instructions: Scrape rind of salt pork. Score deeply with sharp knife. Place onion in deep casserole; add beans. Bury pork in beans so only rind shows. Combine molasses mustard vinegar Worcestershire sauce and chile sauce. Add enough cola beverage to make 1 1/2 cups. Pour over beans. Bake in slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Yields 8 servings.

title: Fruit Cake Bars
instructions: Grease and flour 8 x 14 x 2-inch pan. Pour nuts into pan and press down. Melt margarine and sugar over low heat; remove from heat.\tAdd flour well beaten eggs and vanilla; pour over nuts. Sprinkle fruit over batter.\tBake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Chop all vegetables; mix with kraut that has been drained. Mix sugar and vinegar. Pour over salad. Let set in refrigerator for 24 hours. Drain. May keep for week.

title: Cucumber Cheese Ball
instructions: *I prefer pickling (small) cucumbers because they taste better and dont have as many seeds; you can get them at Easyway. If you do use pickling cucumbers it will take more than two because they are smaller.

title: Carrot-Orange-Yogurt Bars
instructions: In a bowl beat butter or margarine with an electric mixer on\tmedium\tto high speed about 30 seconds or until softened. Add about\thalf of the flour the sugar yogurt egg baking powder orange peel and baking soda to the margarine. Beat until thoroughly combined scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Then beat or stir in remaining flour. Stir in carrot. Spread batter into a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.\tBake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack. Frost with Orange Yogurt Frosting. Cut into bars. Store covered in the refrigerator. Makes 24.

title: Barbecued Spareribs For Fifty
instructions: Separate ribs into 8 ounces portions. Place in roasting pans. Brown uncovered in oven at 350\u00b0 until browned lightly about 30 minutes. Pour off fat. Pour sauce over ribs. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 until meat is tender about 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and bake an additional 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Seven Minute Icing
instructions: Cook slowly the flour and milk until thick. Let cool. Cream together the sugar butter and vanilla. Be sure to use an electric mixer. Add the cooled flour and milk mixture; beat well.

title: Tuna Cracker Dip
instructions: Mix all together and chill overnight. Serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook beans with all seasonings and peppers. Add smoked sausage and simmer until done. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Boil and bone chicken. Cut into bite sized pieces. Combine chicken with the soups. Add celery water chestnuts green onions and almonds (reserve a few to put on top). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes then spread Chinese noodles over top then sprinkle on reserved almonds and return to oven for another 10 minutes.

title: Fat-Free Pioneer Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Spray baking sheet with spray (no fat). Add Pioneer biscuit mix and milk. Mix well and turn on floured paper. Add flour to dust dough and roll to thickness desired. Cut into biscuits and place on sprayed baking sheet or pan. Bake 6 to 7 biscuits for 13 to 15 minutes.

title: Bourbon Slushies
instructions: Blend frozen bananas and frozen strawberries and serve.

title: Beef Tips With Rice
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy skillet. Set aside. Combine flour salt and pepper; dredge steak strips in mixture. Brown in margarine. Add bouillon; cover and simmer 1 hour or until beef is very tender. Add milk; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Lipton Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips 2 inches long. In large skillet heat oil and brown meat turning frequently. Stir in Lipton onion soup mix and 2 cups water. Cover; simmer 30 minutes. Stir in peppers. Simmer covered 10 minutes or until meat is tender. Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup water. Stir into skillet. Cook while stirring until thickened.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Warm the cream cheese to ease the mixing process. Mix all ingredients. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Brown green pepper onions garlic and celery in butter. Combine flour sugar salt and cayenne pepper. Add canned tomatoes bay leaf and Tabasco. Simmer all 45 minutes. The last ten minutes add small frozen shrimp. Serve over rice.

title: Buffalo Style Wings
instructions: Cut wings at joints and discard tips. Mix flour and 2 tablespoons of cayenne pepper together. Rinse chicken with water and then coat pieces with flour-pepper mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes until crispy. Melt margarine and add 2 tablespoons Tabasco sauce. For spicier wings add optional cayenne pepper. Dip each piece of chicken into butter mixture. Shake off excess. Serve with blue cheese dressing and celery sticks.

title: Banana Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each. Stir in bananas.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Pie Filling Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients for cake and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove cake from oven. Make icing and pour over cake.

title: Impossible Ham And Swiss Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Sprinkle ham cheese and onions on plate. Beat other ingredients until smooth. Pour into plate. Bake until golden brown 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Bran Waffles
instructions: Pour boiling water over 100% Bran and let stand. Cream sugar shortening and eggs. Add buttermilk and blend. Add bran and water mixture then flour baking soda salt and Bran Buds. Mix thoroughly. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 16 to 19 minutes or until tops are firm to touch.

title: Creamy Cheesecake
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients. Place in spring-form pan; refrigerate. Beat cream cheese until smooth beat in egg yolks and 3/4 cup sugar. In small bowl beat egg whites and cream of tartar. Fold into cheese mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 1/2 hour. Remove raise oven temperature to 425\u00b0. Beat last 3 ingredients. Spread slowly on top of cake. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix flour grated cheese and salt. Cream butter then add mixture. Blend well. Shape into rolls. Wrap in wax paper and freeze. Leave several hours. Remove from freezer and let thaw a little. Cut in slices and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Chili Verde Tacos
instructions: Combine cabbage cilantro and salsa in a serving dish and set aside. Cut chicken crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips. In a 10 to 12 inch nonstick pan over medium-high heat stir oil onion and garlic for 2 minutes. Increase heat to high add chicken and stir often until meat is no longer pink in center 4 to 6 minutes. Add cumin and oregano. Stir for 15 seconds. Spoon into serving dish.

title: Butterscotch Squares
instructions: Blend sugar shortening salt and vanilla; stir in beaten egg and flour sifted with baking powder. Mix smooth. Stir in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels
instructions: Soften cream cheese then add chilies olives hot sauce and garlic. Mix well. Spread mixture on flour tortillas. Cover tortillas with approximately 3 slices chicken. Roll up tightly and wrap in plastic wrap. Chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours preferably overnight.

title: Child'S Love Cake For Mother
instructions: Mix well. Bake in a hearty warm oven and serve to Mother every day! She ought to have it in big slices!

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Just add in one large bowl the tomatoes (diced up) and the sliced onions. Add the diced green peppers. Break up or slice the lettuce and add it in. Add in the 2 different packages of cheese. Add the kidney beans (cold). Brown hamburger drain and cool. Add hamburger; then add the bag of Doritos (but hold the top in one hand and smash them into small pieces).

title: Nut Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Pack into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Keep refrigerated until cold. Cut into blocks.

title: Blueberry Torte
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with mixture. Cream the cream cheese 1/2 cup sugar eggs and vanilla and pour over the crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Allow to cool. Spread the blueberry pie filling over cool cream cheese. Cover with whipped cream.

title: Kristen'S Strawberry Jam
instructions: Mix strawberries sugar and lemon juice in Dutch oven. Heat to boiling stirring frequently until translucent and jam is thick about 25 minutes. Quickly skim off foam. Pour jam into sterilized jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Makes 5 half pint jars.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Beat the first 5 ingredients and pour into a well-greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix together the brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over the cake. Swirl into the cake with a small teaspoon handle. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix in bowl the brown sugar flour salt and pie spice. Add the pumpkin milk and slightly beaten eggs. Stir until smooth. Pour into a 9 inch unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. This was one of Janice Odoms recipes.

title: Meringues
instructions: Line 3 cookie sheets with a few sheets of baking parchment. In a large clean bowl whisk egg whites and salt until they are stiff using an electric mixer. You should be able to turn the bowl upside down without any movement of the egg whites. Carefully beat the sugar into the egg white mixture a little at a time. The meringue should start to look glossy at this stage. Sprinkle superfine sugar a little at a time and continue beating until all the sugar has been incorporated and the meringue is thick white and stands in tall peaks. Transfer it to a pastry bag fitted with a 3/4-inch star tip. Pipe about 26 small whirls onto prepared cookie sheets. Bake in a preheated oven at 250\u00b0 F. for about 1 1/2 hours or until pale golden in color and can be easily lifted off the paper. Let the meringues cool in the turned-off oven overnight. Just before serving sandwich 2 together with the whipped heavy cream and arrange on plate. Makes 13.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Place turkey and chopped onion in a large pot and brown. You may drain if you like but there will be very little grease from the turkey. Mix in remaining ingredients and cook slowly until cabbage is tender. The amounts of cabbage onion and celery are not critical. Also you may increase the amount of chili powder if you like. The amount of water may be varied to your taste. A few chopped jalapenos will add a nice touch if you like hot peppers.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions. In cake pan pour melted margarine and sprinkle brown sugar on top of margarine. Arrange pineapple slices on top of brown sugar. Spoon cake batter over mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix dressing cheese and Italian dressing. Place chicken on greased grill over medium coals or rack of broiler pan 5 to 7-inches from heat. Brush with 1/2 of dressing mixture and grill or broil for another 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Creole Shrimp
instructions: Cook onions in butter until yellow. Blend in other ingredients. Cook slowly stirring occasionally until thickened (30 minutes). Stir in shrimp. May use cooked or uncooked if uncooked just cook longer until they are done.

title: Wilma'S Tuna Supreme
instructions: Heat soup add cheese and tuna. Add other ingredients. Serve over chow mein noodles.

title: Hamburger Garden Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain well. Add chopped celery green pepper onions carrots tomato sauce and water. Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Stir in cooked spaghetti mushroom soup oregano salt and pepper; mix well. Pour into casserole and top with cheese. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Fabulous Fudge
instructions: Just 5 minutes cooking - no beating! Mix in heavy 2-quart saucepan sugar milk marshmallow cream butter and salt. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until boils. Boil and stir five minutes more.\tRemove from heat. Stir in chocolate morsels until completely melted. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan. Cool.\tCut into 30 pieces.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies(School Recipe)
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugars. Add peanut butter and mix well. Add beaten eggs then dry ingredients; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Press ball both ways with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done. Cookies should not be hard when pulled from the oven.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Place apples in an 8-inch square greased casserole pan. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Combine flour brown sugar and butter. Spread mixture over sugared apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until fruit is tender and top is browned. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop raw broccoli and add bacon nuts and raisins. Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Pour on salad and mix well. Chill. You may add pimento for color.

title: Ginger Dip
instructions: Drain and chop chestnuts. Finely chop parsley and chop crystallized ginger. Combine all ingredients; cover and chill for at least 8 hours. To reduce fat and cholesterol fat-free mayonnaise and nonfat sour cream alternatives may be substituted. Serve as a dip with fresh vegetables. Yields 3 cups.

title: Pepperoni Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream with cream cheese to soften. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Slice top of bread off to make a \lid\. Hollow out bread and discard. Fill with mixture.
