Put lid on and wrap with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve on toasted garlic bread slices. (They are usually in big clear bags in store bakeries.)

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples nuts flour soda cinnamon sugar and salt in mixer. Beat in egg butter and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Shrimp Potato Boat
instructions: Scrub potatoes thoroughly. Bake or microwave potato until done. When cool to touch slice top of potato open lengthwise. Scoop out pulp leaving a firm shell about 1/4 inch thick. Mix pulp with other ingredients. Whip until smooth. Stir in shrimp. Stuff shells with shrimp mixture and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

title: Baked Crab
instructions: Saute minced seasoning in butter until it becomes glazy but not brown. Mix crab meat and crumbs and add cooked seasoning. Add mustard mayonnaise eggs garlic salt and pepper; mix well. Pack into well-greased shells. Top lightly with crumbs. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until lightly browned. Serves 10.

title: Holiday Snack Mix
instructions: Melt butter; add to melted butter the salts sauces and onion powder. Mix dry ingredients in large containers and place in cake pans or roasters. Pour some of the liquid mixture over it just enough to slightly dampen. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Stir every 5 minutes adding more liquid if desired.

title: Cocoa Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix shortening sugar eggs and vanilla until well blended. Blend dry ingredients then mix in. Stir in nuts. Spread in well-greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake about 30 minutes. Cool; cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Seafood Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Combine undrained tomatoes tomato paste onion oregano basil red pepper garlic powder and thyme. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat. Cook uncovered over medium-low heat 10 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly stirring occasionally. Add shrimp and green pepper. Cook uncovered 10 minutes or until shrimp are no longer pink stirring occasionally. Serve over spaghetti. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Thaw frozen bread dough. Put oil on cookie sheet. Press dough flat to fit pan. Turn dough over. Line dough with sliced pepperoni and Mozzarella cheese. Roll up like jelly roll; let rise 15 to 20 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Goodie Ice Cakes
instructions: You will need plastic cups.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of water. Combine sugar egg milk and 1 cup water. Add salt and flour. Knead several times. Put in bowl; brush with Crisco. Cover tightly and put in refrigerator until it doubles in bulk. Punch down and let rise 10 minutes. Make in rolls and let rise 2 1/2 hours or until double in bulk. Preheat oven. Bake at 425\u00b0 until done.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well with hand. Shape into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. May be made in advance and frozen.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine peanut butter with cream cheese. Blend with mixer until light and fluffy. Add confectioners sugar; blend well. Gradually add 1/2 cup milk; mix well on high until mixture thickens. Fold in 1 (8 ounce) container of Cool Whip. Spread mixture into graham cracker pie crust. Cover and freeze. EAT AND ENJOY!

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Whip egg whites until stiff. Add sugar cinnamon salt and nuts. Melt the butter on large cookie sheet. Spread nut mixture on melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir often.

title: Mandarin Chicken Salad
instructions: Poach chicken in simmered water 10 to 15 minutes or until no longer pink. Drain set to cool. When cool enough to handle remove skin and bones and shred (be sure to blanch the broccoli!). Stir water into peanut butter until smooth. Add soy sauce vinegar sesame oil wine and sugar. Stir in 1 tablespoon of onions and ginger mix. Pour over chicken and broccoli-noodles in a large bowl and toss. Garnish with peanuts.

title: Sausage And Peppers
instructions: In covered skillet over medium heat cook sausage chunks in 2 tablespoons of water for 5 minutes. Uncover and cook until sausage is brown on all sides. Add green peppers cut into strips sliced onion separated into rings and minced garlic to sausage in skillet; cook until peppers are tender but crisp. Stir frequently. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup 1 can of water and vinegar. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Cook rice according to package directions. Serve over rice.

title: Butterscotch Root Beer Pudding Pop(Kids Section)
instructions: Stir the root beer into the pudding and pour this mixture into the molds. Place the molds in the freezer until frozen.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add beans. Put layer of crushed chips in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole. Put meat on top of that then a layer of lettuce. On top of that sprinkle your onions celery and tomatoes. Put sour cream on that as you wish then your shredded cheese. Put in oven for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Popsicles
instructions: Put gelatin in bowl. Add boiling water and stir until dissolved. Add drink mix and sugar and stir. Add cold water. Pour mixture into popsicle containers. Freeze. It is best to use the same flavor gelatin and punch mix.

title: Cranberry Orange Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Measure flour and blend dry ingredients. Mix in all ingredients except cranberries. Fold in cranberries. Pour in pan and bake 1 hour. Cool thoroughly before slicing. Makes 1 large loaf or 3 small ones.

title: Sausage Nibblers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into bite size balls. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Great for parties and get-togethers. Good for dipping too.

title: Granny'S Dressing
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Mix breads together first then add sage salt pepper and onion. Mix broth eggs butter and cream of chicken soup together. Heat all together on stove until hot. Pour bread mixture if mixture is to loose add extra cornbread. Cook in oblong pan or iron skillet for 45 minutes to 1 hour until golden brown. You may cut into squares or spoon out and serve.

title: Yum Cookie Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square pan (9 x 9 x 2). Cream butter and brown sugar in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add egg milk and vanilla. Beat well.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour in skillet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in one big bowl then pour into a greased skillet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pasta Fazoul Soup
instructions: Sear meat first then drain the fat off. Saute vegetables with spices garlic and onion. Add stock and beans. Simmer until beans are tender. Add cooked pasta last.

title: Cocoa Fudge Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Beat all ingredients on low speed scraping bowl constantly for 30 seconds. Beat on high speed scraping bowl occasionally for 3 minutes. Pour into pan. Bake until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine ingredients in a greased 1-quart baking dish. Melt butter and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Rinse rice. Cook rice in 1 1/2 quarts milk. Allow to boil and then simmer 20 minutes. Add sugar and simmer until it thickens. Blend in eggs beaten in 1/2 cup milk and vanilla. Bring to a boil. Add cream; boil again and then cool and refrigerate.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry Over Rice
instructions: Saute vegetables and onion 6 to 8 minutes. Combine sauce and meat. Heat well. Serve over hot rice.

title: Grandma'S Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt. Sift; cut in Crisco. Add milk gradually until a drop batter is formed. Put in buttered tins and bake in 400\u00b0 oven (10 to 15 minutes).

title: Granny'S Home-Style Fried Okra
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix; toss with fingers until okra is well coated. Pour into the skillet with the melted shortening and cook covered over medium heat until okra is tender and begins to brown. Remove skillet from heat; let cover remain and allow to steam for 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Bring raisins and water to boil. Cook 10 to 15 minutes. Mix and add sugar and cornstarch to cooked raisins. Then add remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell; cover with top crust. Dot with margarine. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Turn oven to 375\u00b0 and bake until brown.

title: Peanut Dip For Apples
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Serve with sliced apples.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir together ingredients and press onto bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate. Bake for 10 minutes and cool.

title: `Big Mac' Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Great on burgers!

title: Polish Mistakes
instructions: Brown beef and sausage until brown; drain grease. Add cubed cheese; stir until melted with ground beef. Add sausage and seasonings. Spread onto bread slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Orange Raisin Quick Bread(Ultra Low-Fat, Moist And Delicious)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl sift together the flour soda baking powder sugar and Molly McButter. Combine egg product applesauce orange juice and zest and mix with electric mixer. Syir in raisins and cereal. Gradually add flour mixture to egg mixture and mix thoroughly. Pour into loaf pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray and bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Recipe makes 10 servings.

title: 3-Day Slaw
instructions: Shred or grate cabbage. Peel onions and slice. Combine sugar vinegar corn oil mustard and celery seed; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and cool. Alternate layers of cabbage and onions. Pour mixture over cabbage and store in a covered container in refrigerator for 3 days before serving.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Chop cranberries apples and walnuts in blender. Mix jello and gelatin together in 2-quart casserole dish or loaf pan. Add hot water. Add remaining ingredients. Cut apples and oranges as putting them in. Stir gently; put in fridge for 1/2 hour and stir again. Allow to set and serve. This is very good for the holidays.

title: Low Calorie Stuffed Baked Potatoes
instructions: Fresh chives may be used in place of dried chives.

title: No Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Dump all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Using hands mix well. Press in angel food pan. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 days before serving.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Spread filling in 13 x 9 pan. Cream butter; add dry cake mix and eggs and mix well. Spoon over filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Cut into squares.

title: Break'Fast Pizza
instructions: In greased 10 x 13-inch pan crumble bread. Pour beaten eggs mixed with a little milk over bread. Layer meat and onions. Top with cheese. Put mushroom soup in dollops over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. This can be topped with cream gravy.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix the bacon and vegetables. Pour off juices and save. Put cornbread into vegetables (crumble). Mix mayonnaise and juice together. Pour over salad.

title: Barbecue Pork
instructions: In crock-pot cook roast with onion and garlic on low overnight. Pour liquid off pork take pork off bone and discard fat. Add barbecue sauce to meat; cook on low for 4 hours stirring 2 or 3 times.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spread sugar cookie dough on pizza pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until edges turn brown. Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar. Spread on cooled crust. Mix in small saucepan the juice cornstarch lemon juice and water; cook until thickened. Arrange fruit in attractive pattern on cheese mixture then spoon glaze over fruit.

title: Miniature Shrimp Quiche
instructions: Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed until well blended. Stir in flour and salt. Cover dough and refrigerate for one hour. Shape chilled dough into 36 one-inch balls. Place in ungreased muffin pans shaping each ball into a shell. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Mashed Potatoes With Cheese
instructions: Add sour cream and Philadelphia cream cheese to mashed potatoes and whip together until desired taste is obtained. Thin with half and half cream until desired texture is obtained. Place in buttered casserole dish. Put some yellow shredded cheese on top. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab And Cheese Bites(Appetizer)
instructions: Mix oleo cream cheese crabmeat and Cheez Whiz. Spread on English muffin halves. Put in freezer until firm enough to cut into wedges approximately 1 hour. Remove from freezer and cut into wedges about 4 per half. Refreeze in plastic bag. When ready to use remove amount to be used and broil until golden brown. Cheese Bites can be kept in freezer for a few months. Add horseradish or use jalapeno Cheez Whiz for a spicier taste or serve with shrimp cocktail sauce on top of each wedge. Serves 8.

title: Spiced Tea(Microwave)
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well blended. Store mix in an airtight container.

title: Fluffy Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Let rise 30 minutes. Mix again. Spoon into greased muffin tins and let rise 30 minutes again. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Peanut Bar Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour & brown sugar; cut in cold butter until mixture is crumbly. Stir in 1/2 cup peanut butter chips. Press mixture on bottom of greased 12 x 9 baking pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Meanwhile combine condensed milk egg and vanilla; stir in remaining chips and nuts. Spread evenly over baked crust. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool completely in pan. Cut in squares.

title: Frozen Cucumbers
instructions: Combine cukes onions and salt. Soak 3 hours. In pan warm vinegar and sugar. Stir to dissolve sugar. Drain cukes and add to vinegar mixture. Ladle into freezer plastic containers and freeze. Defrost and serve chilled. Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Place Milnot and Blue cheese in blender; process on medium. Gradually add Cheddar cheese and flavorings. Process on high. Add cream cheese; continue processing until mixture is smooth. Shape into ball and refrigerate overnight. Wrap in foil or wax paper. About 30 minutes before serving roll ball in pecan-parsley mixture if desired.

title: Diabetic Blackberry Jam
instructions: Place crushed berries into large kettle; add sweetener and stir well. Boil rapidly stirring constantly. After mixture has thickened pour into hot jars leaving head space of 1/4-inch. Adjust caps processing in boiling water for 15 minutes. One tablespoon has 10 calories.

title: Fast Paced Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a glass 9-inch baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Refrigerate 8 to 24 hours. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake 1 hour. Good served with rice and a steamed squash medley. Serves 4.

title: No Peek Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in 2 round cake pans. Split each layer in half horizontally. Mix sour cream sugar and coconut. Reserve 1 cup for icing. Spread the rest in equal amounts between the layers. Mix reserved amount with Cool Whip. Ice cake. Store in airtight container in refrigerator for 3 days. Serve.

title: Grandma'S Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Set aside 2 tablespoons flour. Add rest of flour to creamed mixture. Add sour cream and mix well. Combine 2 tablespoons flour with baking soda then add to mixture. Add vanilla and almond extract and blend thoroughly. Turn into 10-inch greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Milk Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease bottom of 9 x 13 pan. In large bowl mix the thawed whipped topping eggs and vanilla until smooth. Stir in nuts. Spread mixture into pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until tooth pick comes out clean. Do not overbake. Cool and slice.

title: Apricot-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Place sweet potatoes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and set aside. In a saucepan combine sugar cornstarch salt and cinnamon; stir in apricot nectar water and orange peel. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat stir in butter and pecans. Pour over sweet potatoes. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Break oranges into pieces. Let set overnight.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 8 x 8-inch pan melt butter or margarine. Remove melted butter from heat add cocoa and stir until well blended. Add eggs one at a time beat well. Stir in vanilla flour and salt. Do not overbeat. Fold in nuts and spread on prepared pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpicks inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Pepparkakor Cookies From Kirsten'S Cookbook
instructions: Sift together into bowl the measured flour baking soda cinnamon ginger and cloves. In larger bowl stir sugar and softened butter. Add the egg maple syrup and water to the butter and sugar; beat until fluffy. Stir the dry ingredients into the mixture 1 cup at a time mixing well after each addition. Chill the dough in refrigerator 1 hour.

title: Peas And Pasta
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add cut garlic or garlic powder to oil (not garlic salt!). Add peas to oil and garlic. Salt and pepper. Serve over cooked pasta. Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Barley Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms in oleo. Combine with barley and liquid in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Hamburger Barbecue
instructions: Chop celery onions and pepper. Brown ground meat. Add celery onions and green pepper until soft. Season with salt pepper and garlic powder to taste. Drain fat. Mix ketchup water brown sugar and mustard. Pour over meat. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve on hamburger rolls with potato chips. Great crowd pleaser!

title: Ho Ho Cake
instructions: Cook the flour and milk and stir continuously until thick then cool. Blend together the sugar margarine and shortening. Combine with above milk mixture and beat 3 to 4 minutes until fluffy. Spread on cooled cake. Refrigerate until set.

title: Willy'S Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Blend together very well with wire whip. Refrigerate overnight before using. Makes 1 quart.

title: Pineapple Torte
instructions: Make sauce of cream sugar flour pineapple and vanilla. Cook until thick. Put layer of crushed wafers in bottom of 8 x 12-inch pan or dish. Add sauce then remaining wafers on top. Refrigerate. This can be made a day ahead. Serves 10. Top with whipped cream.

title: Aunt Jan'S Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening. Add milk; just enough to hold dough together. Pat 1/2-inch thick on floured board. Cut and brush with milk. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 to 16 small biscuits.

title: Butterfinger Bars
instructions: Cream together the butter brown sugar and white sugar. Add quick oats. Place in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan; pack down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple, Nut, Cheese Salad
instructions: Beat cream cheese at room temperature. Add Equal and beat well. Blend in Cool Whip pineapple and pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Put in crock-pot Ro-Tel cheese soup tomatoes tomato sauce and cabbage. Cook beef until done. Saute onion and bell pepper until brown. Add all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook 1 hour at high temperature.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix in 2-quart casserole dish. Combine soup and milk. Stir in noodles peas tuna and pimento. Cover; microwave on High for 9 minutes or until hot stirring twice during heating.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream 1 cup butter and sugar together in bowl. Beat in 4 eggs and pumpkin. Sift next 5 ingredients into batter mixing well. Add 3/4 cups water vanilla and nuts mixing well. Pour into 2 large loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate 'N' Oat Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour oats sugar and margarine mix well. Reserving 1/2 cup oats mixture press remainder on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes. Pour milk over crust; sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips. Top with oat mixture; press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until light brown; cool. Cut into bars store covered at room temperature.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix ground beef meat tenderizer garlic powder salt and pepper. Roll into walnut-size balls. Brown in skillet on medium heat covered. Drain fat and add water ketchup and about 3 tablespoons brown sugar. Simmer about 30 minutes. (If sauce is too watery add more ketchup.)

title: Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Put together yeast and 1 1/2 cups warm water. Let rise then add to other mixture as soon as the other mixture is lukewarm. Then use bread flour (I use Action) to thicken. Let rise like other bread.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Blend together pudding and Cool Whip. Add pineapple (with juice). Add nuts and mix thoroughly.

title: Yogurt Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a blender on medium speed for 5 seconds.

title: Chicken Breast
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and pour over chicken. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until nice and brown about an hour and a half to two hours.

title: Barbecue Round Steak For Microwave
instructions: Cut round steak into serving pieces. Place in a 3-quart glass casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over steak. Refrigerate for several hours. Microwave covered on power level 4 for 50 minutes.

title: Cheese Frosted Cauliflower
instructions: Cook cauliflower leaving whole. Drain well. Place it in a shallow pan and frost with mayonnaise mixed with mustard. Sprinkle on cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts about 10 minutes. Simple and fantastic.

title: Busy Day Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bring to a boil and spread on hot cake. Brown under low broiler heat and watch closely.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add ice water vanilla nuts and flour. Shape into finger length rolls. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes on cookie sheet. Cool roll in powdered sugar.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Heat frying pan or wok add oil and cook onions until golden brown. Add mushrooms and water chestnuts and cook one minute. Stir in cold rice mix well and cook an additional 2 minutes. Add sugar eggs soy sauce and shrimp. Cook until heated through and golden brown in color. Garnish with chopped green onions.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: In a bowl combine the beef egg onion milk crumbs salt and pepper. Shape into 4 oval patties. Fry in a skillet over medium heat until done. Remove patties and keep warm. Add gravy and water to the skillet. Heat 3 to 5 minutes. Serve over patties.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine eggs and milk well and add cracker crumbs. Set aside until liquid is absorbed. Add remaining ingredients except cheese to cracker crumbs mixture stirring well. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese while hot.

title: Divinity Fudge
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Boil sugar water and Karo until it spins like threads. Keep folding in egg whites while you pour in sugar mixture. Add vanilla and nuts.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix all. Float sherbet in punch bowl if desired.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water. Sift dry ingredients into large bowl add shortening yeast mixture and water. Mix and knead for 10 minutes. Put to rise in a warm place. In 1 hour punch down. Let rise another hour and make loaves rolls etc. and place in greased pans. Let rise till double in size and bake at 375 -425\u00b0 depending on size of bread.

title: Lasagne
instructions: In large pot heat tomato sauce and seasoning. Simmer about 1 hour. Add ground beef. In separate pot heat noodles to boiling for 7 minutes. Drain. Place 3 noodles lengthwise in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Add sauce to cover. Sprinkle on both cheeses. Repeat until ingredients are all used. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is bubbly and golden.

title: Hamburger And Potato Surprise
instructions: Divide hamburger into 4 parts; shape into thin patties. Place each patty in center of 10-inch square of foil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with slices of potato and onion. Add carrot slices. Wrap foil securely around hamburger. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Low-Fat Apricot Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Shake chicken in a plastic bag filled with flour and salt until chicken is coated. Place chicken in a single layer in a shallow baking pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Combine apricot preserves mustard and yogurt. Spread apricot mixture on chicken and bake for 30 minutes more or until done.

title: Jewish Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo sugar and eggs. Add flour cocoa salt and nuts. Spread on greased 11 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. While still hot add Eagle Brand condensed milk over top and smooth out. Put coconut on top and bake additional 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool completely and ice with Pillsbury chocolate fudge icing.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: In a heavy 3-quart saucepan heat oil and saute onions for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Lower heat cover pan and steam for 10 minutes. Then add bouillon bay leaf thyme salt pepper and wine. Simmer for an additional 10 minutes. Place soup in 4 deep ovenproof bowls and top each with a slice of toasted bread. Sprinkle with grated cheese and place under broiler until cheese is bubbly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Separate 3 egg whites. Beat the 3 egg yolks and 2 whole eggs with sugar and vanilla. Add the milk then add melted margarine. Fold in egg whites. Beat until smooth. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Makes 2 pies.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and drain then add garlic basil salt tomatoes and tomato paste. Simmer for 30 minutes in covered skillet. Cook noodles by directions on box. Combine cottage cheese Parmesan parsley eggs salt and pepper. Mix in mixer. Place half of noodles in dish and spread with half cottage cheese filling. Place sliced Mozzarella and then half the meat mixture repeat this again. Bake at 375\u00b0 for half an hour and let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Green Or Red Peppers(How To Freeze)
instructions: Wash peppers; remove tops stems and seeds. Blanch in boiling water for 2 minutes. (Blanching is not necessary but makes peppers easier to pack.) Cool and drain.

title: Scalloped Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients except light cream. Spoon rice mixture into 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole dish. Pour light cream on rice mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes or until set.

title: Baozi (Chinese Dumplings)
instructions: Cook and crumble meat. Squeeze thawed spinach to remove water. Mix spinach meat soy sauce and sesame oil to taste. Stack 2 biscuits and flatten to 1/4-inch round. Put spoonful of filling in center and pinch edges together. Place on rack over (not in) boiling water and steam 15 minutes. Makes 15; good hot or cold.

title: Quick Party Spread
instructions: In medium bowl beat the cream cheese and milk until smooth. Beat in soup mix until blended. Cover; chill until ready to serve at least 2 hours. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Lemon Icebox Fluff
instructions: Pour milk in bowl and partly freeze. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with cracker crumbs. Separate eggs. In one bowl beat egg yolks with sugar and 3 tablespoons lemon juice. In a separate bowl beat evaporated milk until thick and add remaining lemon juice. In third bowl beat egg whites until stiff. To assemble fold yolk mixture into egg whites then fold in milk mixture. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
instructions: Whip together sweet potatoes butter milk and pepper. Beat in egg yolks whip egg whites with salt until stiff. Fold into sweet potatoes. Pile into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until puffed and top surface is lightly browned. Serves 6.

title: Leprechaun Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to box directions. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for only 15 minutes; let cool. Soften cream cheese; beat in milk and pudding; pour over cake. Spread pineapple over pudding mixture. Spread with whipped cream; sprinkle with nuts. Enjoy.

title: Avocado Mayonnaise
instructions: Combine avocado chili pepper parsley garlic and scallions in a food processor. Process to a puree. Gradually add the oil and beat well. Add the lime juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve sauce with either fish or on cocktail toast. Makes abut 1 1/2 cups.

title: Rice Cereal Crust
instructions: Mix ingredients well and press into bottom and sides of greased 8-inch pie plate. Chill well and fill.

title: Diabetic Jelly
instructions: All ingredients should be mixed well. Boil the mixture gently for 5 minutes. Let cool and then pour into sterilized containers and store in the refrigerator. This recipe does contain natural sugar so you will need to figure the calorie and sugar count for it.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
instructions: Combine vegetables soup 1/2 cup cheese sour cream 1/2 can onion rings salt and pepper. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes.

title: Club Chicken Casserole
instructions: In saucepan melt butter blend in flour. Add milk broth and 1/2 cup of water. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Add rice chicken mushrooms green pepper pimento and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until hot. If desired top with 1/4 cup toasted slivered almonds. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish layer as listed berries sugar pineapple cake mix sugar butter or margarine and nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes.

title: Flank Steak
instructions: Slice steak as thin as bacon strips. Put bacon on top of steak strips and roll. Secure with a toothpick. Saute steak rolls in olive oil until all sides are browned. In a roasting pan combine broth and 1 1/2 cans water and mushrooms; add flank steak. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Shape and put in baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat loaf. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. May double recipe for 2 large and 1 small loaf pan. Use less batter for smaller pans.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a food processor or blender and chill until thick. Serve with desired fresh vegetables.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Take 1/2 of mixture place dish in refrigerator. When formed cover with sour cream. Place other half of mixture when jellied on top of bottom layer.

title: Mandarin Orange Pineapple Cake
instructions: Beat well. Bake in 3 layers cool.

title: Nanny'S Krispie Pork Chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash pork chops. Dip in butter then roll in Rice Krispies. Place on a baking sheet lined with foil. Drip leftover butter over chops. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Rice Krispies will get golden brown.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef onion and garlic powder. Add ketchup mustard and A.1. sauce to meat until warm. Pour into a casserole dish. Top with cheese. Cut biscuits into quarters arrange on top of cheese. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven until biscuits are golden brown. Kids love it.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Pour 1/2 the mixture in bowl and let it congeal. Spread 1 cup sour cream over it and sprinkle with pecans. Pour the other half of the Jell-O mixture over it.

title: Blushing Orange Coolers
instructions: Combine 1st three ingredients stir to dissolve sugar. May refrigerate covered up to 1 week. To serve add club soda to juice mixture. Serve over crushed ice. Garnish with orange rind curls and fresh cranberries. Yields 4 cups.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Fireside Coffee
instructions: Put in jar and give as gift.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes (mashed as usual) with cream cheese and mix well. Add remaining ingredients and place in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Sift together dry ingredients. Mix all ingredients except apples and chips. Fold in apples; pour into pan. Sprinkle chips on top. Bake 1 hour.

title: Arizona Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Set out pie shell to thaw. Beat eggs with milk and salt. Add cheese and chilies; mix well and pour in pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn oven down to 300\u00b0. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until set.

title: Beef Noodle Bake
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. In skillet cook beef onions and green peppers until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain off fat. Stir in tomato sauce salt and pepper. Blend together cottage cheese and cream cheese until fluffy. Spoon the noodles into a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread cheese mixture over noodles. Pour meat sauce over all. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 until heated through (30 or 40 minutes).

title: Easy Rolls
instructions: Mix together well. Looks like pancake batter. Butter muffin pans and bake at 325\u00b0 until brown.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: In microwave in 1 1/2-quart casserole stir powdered sugar cocoa salt milk and vanilla together. Mixture will be thick so you may only partially blend together. Put sliced butter on top centering it on mixture. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Dish will feel warm on the bottom. Stir vigorously until smooth. Blend in the nuts. Pour into wax paper lined 8 x 8-inch square pan. Chill well and cut into squares.

title: Barbecued Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in a large baking dish. Add all other ingredients except shrimp and mix well. Add shrimp and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp In Wine Sauce
instructions: Combine water clam juice and bay leaf in large saucepan; bring to boiling. Add shrimp. After mixture comes to boil again lower heat; simmer 3 minutes or until shrimp are firm tender. Drain reserving cooking liquid.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Boil and debone chicken and pour into mixing bowl. Add all ingredients except cheese. Mix together and pour into 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle grated cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serves 6. You may want to prepare your chicken ahead of time and freeze to make this a quick meal.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese with mayonnaise. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix oats and boiling water and set aside. Cream together next four ingredients and beat well then add dry ingredients. Bake in greased and floured pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. When done pour cake topping on and put under broiler until coconut browns.

title: Peanut Butter Tandy Takes
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Add milk and flour alternately. Pour into 17 x 11-inch pan (cookie sheet). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately spread 3/4 to 1 cup creamy peanut butter on top. Place in refrigerator until cooled. When cooled melt one (8 ounce) Hershey bar and 1 tablespoon of oil. Spread on top of cake.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese and sour cream. Beat until smooth. Stir in bean dip chili seasoning mix hot sauce parsley taco sauce 3/4 cup Cheddar cheese and 3/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with remaining 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot with tortilla chips. Yields about 3 1/2 cups.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in a large bowl.

title: Collard Greens With Tomatoes, Onion And Garlic
instructions: Start the bacon frying in a large pot. Fry for about 5 minutes add water and turn up the flame. Bring to a boil then lower the flame. Simmer for about 1 1/2 hours until the liquid has been reduced to about 3 cups. Add the greens to the pot. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove the cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Heat oil in a cast-iron skillet. Add onions and garlic; saute for 10 minutes or until onions wilt. Add the tomatoes red pepper flakes salt and pepper. Mix and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place rice in dish. Stir in soup and Cheez Whiz. Cut up frozen broccoli (uncooked) and mix with rice mixture. Cover loosely. Microwave 15 minutes on High (regular oven for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0).

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into hot greased skillet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Pour milk over crushed bread or cracker crumbs and set aside. Mix all other ingredients together well then add milk and crumb mixture. Place in greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Bunuelos(Fried Bread)
instructions: Combine flour salt and baking powder; mix well. Add fat and mix. Add water and mix. Knead with hands real well. Roll into small round shapes or cut into small squares. Fry in hot cooking oil or vegetable shortening. Delicious. Serve hot. Delicious with honey.

title: Marshmallow Pavlova Slice
instructions: Lightly grease 15 x 10 x 2-inch ovenproof baking dish and dust with cornstarch (coat well). Beat egg whites in large deep bowl until greatly increased in bulk and soft peaks form. Add 2 1/2 cups sugar gradually and beat well after each addition until thoroughly dissolved. Add vanilla essence and vinegar and beat for extra minute. (Mixture should be glossy with firm peaks.)

title: Almond Biscotti
instructions: Mix the first 8 ingredients in large mixing bowl then add flour and almonds until well blended. Separate dough into 3 parts; roll each into a \rope.\ Place on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly. Brush with egg and water mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes until center is slightly firm. Cool slightly. Slice diagonally with sharp knife. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Spicy Beef Strips
instructions: Cut round steak into 2 x 1/2-inch strips. Set aside. Heat cooking oil in a large wok. Add garlic and stir-fry until browned. Remove garlic. Add the round steak strips half at a time and stir-fry until browned. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Add to wok with all the ingredients. Stir to mix. Cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until meat is tender. Serve over hot fluffy rice. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs in a large bowl. Add vegetable oil sugar grated zucchini and vanilla. Add flour baking powder cinnamon baking soda and salt and mix. Add raisins and chopped nuts and mix. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes (test).

title: Pineapple Dip
instructions: Place cottage cheese and lemon juice in electric blender and blend until smooth. Add ginger and honey and place in a serving bowl. Spear pineapple chunks with toothpicks and set in the dip or arrange around bowl.

title: Southern Biscuits
instructions: Sift together all the dry ingredients and work in the shortening. Add the liquid to make a soft dough then roll it out on a lightly floured board to a thickness of 1/2-inch. With a biscuit cutter cut the dough before putting it into a greased pan and baking it in a hot oven at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Split Smoothie
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and mix until thick.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs. Add flour soda salt and spices. Combine applesauce and syrup; add to butter mixture. Fold in nuts. Pour batter into 2 greased 8 x 8-inch pans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots approximately 7 minutes. Drain. Mix all ingredients and pour over carrots. Keeps for weeks! Very tasty.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Note One 12.5 ounce can chicken can be used.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Mix 1 cup flour with dry ingredients. Mix 1 cup flour and liquid ingredients. Mix well. Make 2 balls and chill. Make small balls and roll in granulated sugar. Place on ungreased baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pecans last. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix butter sugar and eggs. Add vanilla and vinegar. Fold in coconut raisins and nuts. Bake in unbaked pie shell at 300\u00b0 for 40-45 minutes.

title: Chilli
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion. Drain. Add flour. Add tomato juice tomato sauce and chilli beans. Put into a slow cooker and heat 3 to 4 hours.

title: Springtime-Simple Strawberry Pie(Diet Pie)
instructions: Combine gelatin pudding and water in a kettle. Cook on high until thickened; stir several times. Cool some. Add strawberries and gently blend. Turn into prepared graham cracker crust or into a purchased graham cracker crust. Chill 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Garnish with whipped cream for serving. Serves 6.

title: Beef Tips On Rice
instructions: Cut meat into 1/2 to 1-inch cubes. Season with seasoned salt. Place in a large gumbo pot. Just cover meat with water; cook until tender. Mix cornstarch with a little water. Pour slowly into hot broth stirring constantly until desired thickness. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Add Kitchen Bouquet until desired color. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Pat cookie dough into an ungreased 14-inch pizza pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown. Cool.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Cook onion and green pepper in boiling water until tender; drain. Stir in tomato sauce eggs cheese bread crumbs salt pepper and thyme. Add ground meats mixing well. Shape into loaf in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Bavarian Apple Cheesecake
instructions: In a medium mixer bowl beat the first 1/3 cup sugar margarine shortening and 1/4 teaspoon vanilla on medium speed of an electric mixer until combined. Blend in flour and salt until crumbly. Pat into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Set aside.

title: Crab Pizza
instructions: Blend cream cheese and lemon juice then add onion worcestershire and mayonnaise. Shape into round 9 inch shallow dish or flat plate. Top with chili sauce. Just before serving top with crab and one layer of parsley. Serve with crackers.

title: Parsley-Cheese Toasts
instructions: Cut bread in 3/4-inch slices to within 1/4-inch of bottom of loaf. Blend butter parsley and garlic powder. Spread in between slices and on top. Put slices of cheese between bread slices. Place on buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese has melted and bread is brown and crusty.

title: Mock Southern Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Blend with Cool Whip; pour into crust. Refrigerate for about 1 hour. Top with fresh fruit or canned pie filling.

title: Tommy'S Pizza Burritos
instructions: Place 1 tortilla on microwavable plate; spoon sauce over tortilla to your liking. Sprinkle with cheese and top with favorite toppings. Microwave on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted; watch carefully and remove from microwave. Let cool for few minutes; roll up like burrito and eat. Makes 10 if using small tortillas. A fast and easy snack that is tasty and fun for kids to make.

title: Ham Souffle
instructions: Cut crusts from bread. Place 8 slices in ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Glass is good. Cover with 8 slices cheese and cut up ham. Place remaining bread on top. Mix well the eggs milk mustard (can by dry) and seasoned salt. Pour mixture over bread. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Biscotti Red Wine
instructions: In a large bowl make a well\twith flour. Place all ingredients in middle and mix flour into center until well mixed. Knead dough on a lightly floured surface with palms. Cut dough into small pieces and roll\tinto a 8-inch rope and pinch ends together to form small circles. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Preserves
instructions: Cut rhubarb into small pieces. Add the white sugar. Cover tightly in a large kettle (deep pan with a lid). Let stand 4 hours or until some liquid has formed. Remove cover and place kettle on low heat. As juice completely covers rhubarb heat may be turned up. Bring to a boil (hard boil) for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Skim off foam. Stir in the strawberry gelatin (6 ounces). Pour into glasses. Cover with paraffin. May be kept in the refrigerator or freezer.

title: Rich Potato Soup
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon margarine in a large pot. Saute onion and celery in margarine. Add 3 1/2 cups water and then add potatoes carrots and cabbage (if desired). Add chicken bouillon. Cook until veggies are tender (may need to add water).

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix butter and 1/2 cup Carnation milk. Mix well and spread 1/2 on bottom of greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 5 to 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt caramels with 1/2 cup Carnation milk and pour over baked cake. Add all pecans and chocolate chips on caramels. Spread rest of cake batter on top. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients well. Top with bread crumbs and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven until cheese is melted. (Leave cheese out if not desired.)

title: Rave Revue Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding water eggs and oil. Beat at medium speed 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour into 2 or 3 (9-inch) greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pans 15 minutes. Remove from pans and cool on rack. Frost with Coconut Cream Frosting.

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Cook grits margarine and water together until grits are done. Add Velveeta cheese and Tabasco; let cool. Add eggs and garlic salt. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves many. Good to freeze.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Can be prepared ahead of time and frozen.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook vermicelli as directed on package. Set aside.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix together the first 7 ingredients in a very large bowl. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix until smooth. Divide into 3 loaf pans well-greased on bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until done. Freezes well.

title: Mary'S Sweet Pickled Peppers
instructions: Wash stem and seed peppers. Cut in long wedge pieces. Pack into jars. Cover with boiling water. Let stand 5 minutes pour off. Add garlic salt and oil to each jar. Boil vinegar sugar and water for 5 minutes. Pour over peppers and seal. Be sure no oil is on jar rims or jars will not seal properly.

title: Buster Bar
instructions: Mix cookie ingredients together and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer ice cream peanuts and then hot fudge. Keep in freezer until ready to serve.

title: Aztec Soup
instructions: Heat bouillon and chilies to a simmer. Place sliced avocado and about 1/3 cup tortilla chips in each bowl. Add broth and pepper. Makes 6 cups. Serves 4.

title: Baked Stuffed Clams
instructions: Melt butter with herbs on low heat for 20 minutes. Meanwhile chop celery green pepper onion and clams. Add that to the bread crumbs and herbed butter. Mix thoroughly. Fill the clam shells and top with bacon. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Fills 15 to 20 large clam shells.

title: Hot Milk Sponge Cake
instructions: Heat milk and butter (keep hot). Beat eggs until lemon colored (2 minutes). Gradually add sugar. Beat in medium 4 to 5 minutes. Add flour and stir with a spoon. Add hot mixture and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix margarine eggs and sugar; add milk. Stir in dry ingredients. Last add apples and raisins. Bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven. Good with caramel icing or without any.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in lightly salted water according to package directions. Drain well. Put broccoli butter and cheese back in pan in which youve cooked the broccoli. Cook over very low heat until butter and cheese melt mixing well. Put in casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until casserole is bubbly.

title: Stew Beef
instructions: Mix soups together in large Dutch oven. Add sherry. Bake covered at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Number 1 German Slaw
instructions: Cover the first 3 ingredients and let stand for 15 minutes. Combine the remaining ingredients and boil. Pour over the cabbage and let stand.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Knead ingredients together; roll into biscuits. Bake for 20 minutes at 425\u00b0. Yields 12 to 14 biscuits.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except flavoring and poppy seed with mixer. Add almond flavoring and poppy seed. Pour batter into a buttered tube pan which has been dusted with a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Dot'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time. Add dry ingredients and syrup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon-Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening oleo and cream cheese. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add lemon flavoring. Fold in flour reserving 1/4 cup. Mix 1/4 cup flour with grated cheese and add to cake mixture. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan. Place in a cold oven. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Do not open oven door while cake is baking. Remove and cool for 10 minutes.

title: Sweet-Sour Meat Balls
instructions: Mix meat crumbs egg and salt and roll into small balls. Broil in oven or pan. Fry on top of stove until meat balls are brown. Drain meat balls. Saute pepper and onion in butter until tender and add remaining ingreds. to make sauce. Add meat balls cover and simmer 30 min. Yield 6 servings. Recipe doubles nicely and may be frozen.

title: Hawaiian Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients and chill. Garnish with lettuce leaves.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine vanilla wafer crumbs and melted margarine. Press into 8 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Leave cream cheese on counter until soft. Place softened cream cheese in a bowl. Add Kraft Jet-Puffed Marshmallow Creme.

title: Shower Punch
instructions: Mix water sugar and Kool-Aid. Add both grapefruit juices. Chill. This is better if you will mix the ingredients all except the ice cream the day before. This will cause the flavors to blend together. When ready to serve add ice cream. Add just enough ice to float in punch bowl to chill. Yield approximately 50 to 75 servings.

title: Cinnamon Buns
instructions: Pick one loaf bread into pieces; arrange in cake size pan. Mix all other ingredients. Spread mixture over bread. Pick other loaf into pieces; put on top of mixture in pan. Let raise 2 or 3 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Spiced Coffee
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients in blender for 15 seconds. Stir. Then blend for 15 seconds more. Store the mixture in a tightly covered container.

title: Lazy Pierogi
instructions: Cook noodles; drain and set aside. Core and cook cabbage (quartered). Add lemon juice to water while cooking 25 minutes until done. Drain and dice cabbage. Brown hamburger; drain and set aside in bowl. In same pan place salt pork. On low heat cook until most of drippings are out. Discard pork rind. To drippings add 1 stick butter. Saute onions and cabbage. Salt and pepper to taste. Blend in hamburger (if using) to pan mixture.

title: Halfway House Beans
instructions: Cook green beans and drain. Fry bacon and drain. Chop onion and saute in fat. Add tomatoes sugar salt and pepper. Cover and simmer until soft about 20 minutes. Add beans and crumbled bacon; stir together. Serves 8.

title: Mock Cordon Bleu
instructions: Lay beef slices on bottom of baking dish. Wrap each piece of chicken with a slice of bacon. Lay on top of beef slices. Mix and blend well cream cheese cream of chicken soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Cover with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Excellent served with rice.

title: Last Minute Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger then add mix water and tomato sauce. Bring to a boil; let simmer for 15 minutes. Spoon into bowls. Top with sour cream cheese and peppers.

title: Caramel Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 400\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine apples sugar and flour; set aside. In a double boiler melt caramels with milk stirring frequently. Add apple mixture. Spoon mixture into pie crust and top with nuts. Bake for 25 minutes; allow to cool 1 hour. Garnish with whipped topping.

title: Snowball Snacks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir butter sugar nuts flour and vanilla together. Mix well. Roll batter into 1-inch balls with your hands. Place balls on the cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes. After the cookies cool roll them in additional confectioners sugar to make the snowballs.

title: Monster Cookies(Yields 13 Dozen)
instructions: Mix in large bowl in order given. Put out on cookie sheet with a teaspoon. Flatten then bake. Do not overbake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 12 minutes.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Mix by hand to blend. Drop into balls on a cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar oil flour salt and baking powder. Spread half of the batter in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spread a can of pie filling any kind apple is good on batter then add the rest of the batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes. Over the hot cake drizzle 1/2 cup powdered sugar mixed with a little water. Good warm or cold.

title: Easy Salad(6 Servings)
instructions: Peel and slice oranges. Discard seed. Peel and slice cucumber. Chop onion and green bell pepper. Arrange lettuce on flat dish and put oranges and cucumber in alternating slices. Sprinkle with onion and green bell pepper. Serve cold with olive oil vinegar (wine) and salt.

title: Pecan Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs flour salt and bourbon or vanilla. Add chocolate chips and pecans. Stir well. Pour into partially baked pie shell and bake for 30 minutes or until center is set (up to 60 minutes). Serve with vanilla ice cream or frozen yogurt. (Its better to cool pie well before serving and reheat in the microwave.)

title: Raisin-Carrot Salad(Serves 8)
instructions: Rinse raisins in hot water; drain. Cool and combine with remaining ingredients. Chill and serve on crisp lettuce.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and bring to boil. Boil 1 minute. Add last 3 ingredients and stir. Continue cooking on low until thickens. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let cool.

title: Blueberry Salad Gelatin Mold
instructions: You will need a 4-quart kettle or pot.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour 1/2 mixture in well-greased hot skillet. Iron skillet is best. Sprinkle 1/2 cheese on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and evaporated milk in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over low heat stirring constantly. Cook for 4 minutes or to 234\u00b0 to 240\u00b0 on candy thermometer (soft ball stage). Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla; beat with spoon until thickened. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch buttered dish. Let stand until set. Cut into squares. Yields 24 squares.

title: Cinnamon Apple Muffins
instructions: Stir together flour sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon. Combine egg milk and oil. Add all at once along with apples to dry ingredients. Stir until dry ingredients are moist. Do not overmix. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. While warm dip the top in margarine and then into sugar. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Empty both cans of corn in casserole dish. Sprinkle crackers over corn. Melt margarine or butter. Drizzle over crackers. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Lemonade Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and soda. Mix in lemonade that has been thawed. Drop from teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Brush top with lemonade and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 oven (325\u00b0 for glass dish). Melt morsel and margarine together; stir in graham cracker crumbs and nuts. Press half the mixture firmly onto the bottom of a greased 13 x 9 inch pan. In large mixing bowl beat the cream cheese until fluffy; then add the Eagle Brand Milk vanilla and the egg; mix well. Pour over crust in pan and top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool to room temperature; then chill before cutting into bars. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Microwave Puffy Cheese Omelet
instructions: In largest mixer bowl beat egg whites at highest speed until soft peaks form. In smaller bowl using same beaters beat yolks mayonnaise and water. Gently pour yolk mixture over beaten whites. Fold together carefully. In 9-inch pie plate microwave butter at High 1 minute swirl to coat dish. Carefully pour egg mixture into pie plate. Microwave at Medium 6 to 8 minutes rotating dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes until set but still glossy on top. Sprinkle cheese over omelet. Microwave 1/2 to 1 minute on Medium until cheese is slightly melted. Quickly run spatula or turner around sides and bottom of dish. Fold half of omelet over the other half. Gently slide onto serving plate. Sprinkle with chives if desired.

title: Indian Tapioca Pudding
instructions: In the top of a double boiler heat 3 cups milk. While the milk is heating mix cornmeal quick tapioca sugar salt cinnamon and ginger. Pour the hot milk over this mixture in a saucepan and add molasses. Bake in a greased casserole or in a pan set in another pan of water in a 350\u00b0 oven stirring every 15 minutes until done about 2 hours.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: In a saucepan dissolve bouillon cubes in water. Add broccoli and cook until tender. Do not drain. In another large saucepan melt the butter and cook the onion until tender. Stir in flour and blend well. Add milk. Stir until thickened. Add cheese. Stir until melted. Add the broccoli and liquid. Combine. Heat but do not boil. Serves 3 or 4.

title: Chicken Chimichangas
instructions: Combine chicken green onions cumin oregano and salt in a large sauce pan. Stir in 2/3 cup salsa or picante. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring often. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of chicken mixture just below the center of each tortilla; sprinkle evenly with half of the cheese. Fold left and right sides of tortilla to partially enclose filling. Fold up top and bottom edges of tortilla (making a square). Place folded side down in a lightly greased baking dish coated with Pam. Repeat procedure with the remaining tortillas. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 13 minutes. Heat remaining salsa in a small sauce pan; pour over tortillas and sprinkle evenly with the remaining cheese. Top with sour cream if desired.

title: Hot Brats
instructions: Brown brats in oil; drain. Add beer to sausages. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add other items to pan and cook until thick. Serve warm with picks.

title: Molded Waldorf Salad
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in small saucepan. Cook and stir over low heat until gelatin dissolves about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in sugar salt and juices until sugar dissolves. Chill until thickened and very syrupy. Fold in apples celery and walnuts. Turn into 1 quart mold and chill until firm. Unmold on greens and serve with mayonnaise.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli and cauliflower. Stir together the mayonnaise yogurt vinegar and sugar. Pour over vegetables and toss. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Salad will keep several days in refrigerator.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: In a bowl mix together the butter sugars banana and egg. Sift together the flour baking powder soda and salt; add to the first mixture alternately with the milk. Place in greased or paper lined muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15-20 minutes. Makes 8 or 9 muffins.

title: Under-The-Sea Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water and add pear juice salt and vinegar. Put 1/2-inch in mold or reserve to use on top. Let remainder of jello slightly jell then whip. Cream cheese and ginger. Add to whipped jello. Fold in fruit. Fill mold or put in 9 x 13-inch shallow dish. When set cover with reserved jello.

title: Mushroom Macaroni Medley
instructions: Melt butter in a pan; stir in flour salt pepper Tabasco sauce cheese and mushroom soup. (Add a little water to soup; cook until slightly thickened.) Mix together macaroni dried beef and parsley. Add the sauce and put in a buttered casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well. Shape into loaf or meat balls rolled in dry rice. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Fry seasoned pork chops in iron skillet using the 1 tablespoon of olive oil until golden brown. Cook rice separately. Slice onion bell pepper and tomato. Place pork chops in iron skillet. Place onion bell pepper and tomato on top of pork chops. Cover with rice. Add gravy and cover. Let simmer on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve with salad.

title: Muffin Pan Rolls
instructions: Mix together. Put in refrigerator until ready to use. When ready to use stir and spoon dough into muffin pans. Let set for 15 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Easy Microwaved Pickled Broccoli
instructions: Eat and enjoy all the pickles saving the jar and the remaining juice. Wash and cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces. Stuff the broccoli into the jar until full or the liquid covers the broccoli near the top.

title: Steak Fajitas
instructions: Prepare beef according to taste. Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in frying pan. Add green pepper and onion. Fry until onion is cooked. Add prepared steak chopped into bite-sized pieces with remaining butter. Cook until steak is done. Add taco seasoning to meat. Stir until blended. Heat tortillas separately in microwave about 30 seconds. Put ingredients on tortillas about 3 tablespoons each roll and serve.

title: Dream Whip Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Blend until moistened. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool cakes for 10 minutes in the pans. Remove and finish cooling on racks. Frost or top with fruit syrup or ice cream.

title: Pork Chops Italian
instructions: Remove bone from each pork chop. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet; dredge in flour. Combine egg and water. Dip each pork chop in egg mixture and dredge in bread crumbs.

title: Tomato And Onion Salad
instructions: In medium bowl mix olive oil and red wine vinegar. Adjust amounts to taste. Add all seasonings again to desired taste. Wash dry and halve tomatoes removing the seeds and soft insides. Cut thin slices of the halved tomatoes. Add these slices and thinly sliced onion to mixture in bowl. Mix thoroughly and frequently to marinate. Serve at room temperature.

title: Mocha Almond Torte
instructions: Spread almonds on a baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for several minutes until lightly browned. Remove from oven and cool. Melt marshmallows in coffee over low heat. Use a fairly large pot and stir often while marshmallows are melting. When coffee mixture is smooth remove from heat and cool.

title: Fudge Ribbon Cake
instructions: Cream 2 tablespoons butter with the cream cheese 1/4 cup sugar and cornstarch. Add 1 egg 2 tablespoons milk and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla; beat until smooth. Grease and flour bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Place in bowl the flour 2 cups sugar salt baking powder soda 1/2 cup butter and 1 cup milk. Blend then beat for 1 1/2 minutes at a low speed. Add 1/3 cup milk 2 eggs Choco-bake and 1 teaspoon vanilla; beat 1 1/2 minutes. Spread half of batter in pan. Spoon cheese mixture over batter; spread to cover. Top with remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or chocolate frosting.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar then mix in eggs and pumpkin.

title: Normandy Cake
instructions: Cream butter and add egg yolks. Cream again. Add 1/2 of sugar. Add alternately flour and milk. Add melted chocolate and vanilla. Beat egg whites and add remaining sugar to these. Fold into cake mixture. Last and most important add baking powder by sifting it on the top of mixture cutting and folding it in. Bake in 3 layers in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels and oleo together. Press in dish. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Applesauce Sugar-Free Cake
instructions: Cook raisins and water until water is gone. Beat applesauce eggs and oil. Add flour cinnamon nutmeg soda vanilla and sweetener. Mix with raisins. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fri Chik Roast
instructions: Save liquid from Fri Chik. Mix with other liquids. Pour over grated Fri Chiks and bread crumbs. Saute onions and celery in margarine. Mix all together. Bake in bread loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stir-Fry Rice
instructions: Prepare rice. Prepare vegetables. Heat oil in wok or frypan. Saute on medium-high heat the onions and green peppers 1 to 2 minutes. Add celery and broccoli and cook 2 minutes. Add rice; stir. Add chicken or other meat and carrots. Season with garlic salt Morton Natures Season and soy sauce and stir. Turn heat off to serve. Add soy sauce to taste.

title: Filling Balls
instructions: Saut celery and onion in margarine until soft and then add all other ingredients. Mix well and form into balls. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Homemade Bread(For Bread Machine)
instructions: Combine altogether. This is made in a pound and half bread machine. You can use on dough and make into rolls and bake in the oven at 350 degrees until golden brown.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Slice bananas reserving two and empty cookies; set aside. Combine 1/2 cup of sugar flour and dash of salt in double boiler over boiling water. Pour in egg yolks and both milks stirring constantly until it thickens. Reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and add vanilla extract blending well.

title: Coconut Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and dip prepared raw vegetables. Note! Good on chips too.

title: Homemade Stuffing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spread in 9 x 13 pan. Squeeze butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Frankfurter Pie
instructions: Reserve 4 frankfurters. Cut remaining into 1-inch pieces. Heat oil in medium saucepan. Add onion and green pepper and cook until soft. Add cut frankfurters; saute until frankfurters begin to brown. Remove from heat. Stir in sauerkraut mustard pimento and Worcestershire sauce. Cut each slice of bread in half from corner to corner; flatten with rolling pin. Line pie plate with bread. Top with sauerkraut mix. Cut remaining franks and top the sauerkraut mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: All Purpose Bread Recipe
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water with the sugar. Add eggs oil salt and enough flour to make dough. Knead until smooth. Cover and let rise once. Shape into rolls buns or 4 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch) loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Good also for Caramel Rolls.

title: O Honey Bars
instructions: Mix together Special K and peanut butter. In saucepan mix Karo and sugar; bring to boil and pour over other mixture. Pour in buttered 9 x 13-inch or little longer pan. Run cold water over hands and pat down. Melt chocolate chips and spread on top. Cool cut and enjoy.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Preferably chill about 4 hours before serving to allow time for flavors to meld. Serve with crackers.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Combine the sugar ginger nutmeg cinnamon salt and baking soda. Mix well. Add the melted margarine evaporated milk and molasses. Add the extracts. The dough should be still enough to handle without sticking to the fingers. Knead the dough for a smoother texture. Add up to 1/2 cup additional flour if necessary to prevent sticking. When dough is smooth roll about 1/4 inch thick on floured board and cut into cookies. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Cookies are done if they spring back when touched.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet. Drain off the grease and add remaining ingredients. Cook about 45 minutes until done.

title: Yulekage(Norwegian Christmas Bread)
instructions: Put sugar salt butter and milk powder into a large bowl. Bring potato water to a boil and pour over first 4 ingredients. Let cool to lukewarm. (Potato water is water potatoes have been boiled in. If you dont have potato water you can use plain water and add 2 tablespoons instant potato flakes to the first 4 ingredients. Potato water helps make a moist loaf that doesnt become stale quickly.) Add eggs and yeast mixture (yeast water and 2 teaspoons sugar) to bowl. Beat in about 4 cups of flour plus the cardamon. Gradually beat in more flour until the dough is stiff enough to handle on the bread board.

title: Nacho Chips - Hot
instructions: Cook and drain hamburger; add taco mix according to directions. Add soups.

title: Oven-Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients; stir well. Dredge chicken in flour mixture. Pour butter into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Arrange chicken in pan skin side down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Patties Ole
instructions: Combine salmon potatoes chilies onion and egg. Form into patties. Pan-fry in butter over medium heat until golden brown turning when needed.

title: Frozen Cucumbers
instructions: Mix and soak first 3 ingredients for 2 hours. Drain and add other ingredients. Pack in jars or containers and freeze. When ready to serve thaw about 1 hour.

title: Persimmon Pudding(Uncooked)
instructions: Mix all together. Pack in pan and chill overnight. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan or tube pan. In a small bowl combine flour and baking powder; set aside. In a large bowl with electric mixer at high speed cream butter and brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. At low speed alternately add flour mixture and 1 cup milk until well-blended. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Remove pan to wire rack; cool 15 minutes. Remove cake from pan; cool completely.

title: Sweet Potatoes And Apples
instructions: Place sweet potatoes in baking dish. Scatter apples over. In bowl mix brown sugar cornstarch and nutmeg; stir in 1 cup apple juice (cold). Melt oleo in saucepan with 1 cup apple juice and heat. Stir in sugar mixture; boil stirring until thickened. Pour over sweet potatoes and apples baking at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10. Can freeze. Can do ahead.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and bake in a greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours. Start in a 200\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Increase oven to 300\u00b0 the rest of time.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients into tray of sifted flour. Work together until dough will handle. Roll out on board and cut with cookie cutter at 375\u00b0.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place chicken breasts in casserole. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before baking. Bake 1 1/2 hours covered. Remove foil and bake 15 more minutes letting chicken brown.

title: Miniature Cheesecakes
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter; stir well. Line 1 3/4-inch muffin pans with miniature paper liners. Spoon 1 teaspoon mixture into each liner; gently press into bottom. Place cream cheese in a small bowl; beat at low speed of electric mixer until fluffy. Gradually add sugar beating until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla mixing well. Spoon evenly into liners. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Guaranteed Dinner Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water with 1 teaspoon sugar. Stir in salt and 1/3 cup sugar; mix well. Stir in yeast mixture; add well beaten egg to mixture. Mix; add 3 cups of flour stirring mixture until it is smooth elastic. Add corn oil; mix. Add remaining 3 cups flour; mix well. Cover with wax paper; let rise until dough has doubled. Knead dough in remaining flour; roll dough to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Cut to desired shapes; place in greased pan. Cover; let rise until double in size. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in preheated oven at 400\u00b0. Rub butter on top when rolls are light brown. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff and set aside. Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar egg yolk vanilla and milk together and beat well. Place 1 can of crescent rolls in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Press to cover the bottom. Spread cream cheese mixture over rolls. Press the other can of rolls together on wax paper and place on top. Take egg whites and spread over the rolls. Sprinkle another 1/4 cup sugar over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Put all ingredients in bowl and stir to mix.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Place drained pineapple in blender with half of juice. Add gelatin and hot water. Blend 2 minutes. Add dry milk and remainder of juice sweetener vanilla butter flavoring and lemon juice. Blend 3 minutes. Pour in 10-inch pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon and allow to set 1 hour at least. Cut into 8 pieces.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate chips. Add sweetened milk. Add marshmallows then vanilla. Put in buttered pan.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Place in boiling water and cook for 5 minutes to soften. Drain. Put 2 tablespoons oleo in bottom of 6 quart kettle along with fish 4 tablespoons water and salt pork. Simmer on low until fish is light and flaky and fully cooked. Add potatoes evaporated milk and whole milk and remaining oleo. Simmer uncovered stirring occasionally to avoid sticking until oleo is melted and milk is warm. Do not boil.

title: Nan Pie
instructions: Mix together lemonade and milk well; fold Cool Whip into lemonade and milk. Place in graham cracker crust.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Fry sausage. Drain. Fry potatoes in oil. Drain. Add bell pepper to potatoes. Grate cheese. Press rolls on pizza pan to form crust. Add potatoes sausage cheese and pour beaten eggs over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Finger Sandwiches
instructions: Cream butter onion mustard and poppy seed. With electric knife slice package of ready to serve dinner rolls in half (separating top from bottom). Spread mixture on both top and bottom of bread. Lay slices of ham covering bread. Sprinkle sandwiches with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serve hot.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and sour cream with chicken. Layer bottom of buttered casserole dish with crackers. Spoon mixture over crackers. Sprinkle cheese on top. Sprinkle more crackers over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dip For Fruit
instructions: Combine egg and sugar and mix well. Add juices and heat until thickened then add the orange and lemon peel. Cool mixture and then add the mayonnaise.

title: Banana Blueberry Bran Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Line with paper baking cups or grease (not oil) 12 muffin cups. In large bowl combine rolled oats and orange juice; stir well. Add slightly beaten egg and oil. (Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.)

title: Fried Potatoes And Onions
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except oil. Pour oil into large skillet and heat on medium heat till hot. Place all mixture into pan and fry stirring occasionally to keep from sticking until potatoes and onions are golden brown and tender. Drain onto paper towels and enjoy.

title: Bridal Punch (Lime Green)
instructions: Mix lemon juice lime juice Sprite and pineapple juice. When ready to serve add sherbet and Fresca. Serves 30.

title: Linda'S Favorite Hot Little Wiener Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Cut hot dogs in half. Cut bacon strips in half. Wrap bacon around hot dog. Carefully place in crock-pot so that the bacon stays on the hot dog. Sprinkle brown sugar over and cook on high for 1 hour. Serve hot. Easy to make and fun to eat.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown beef. Add Ragu. Cook spaghetti 4 minutes. In a large dish put a layer of beef layer of spaghetti layer of cheese layer of beef layer of spaghetti soup and rest of cheese. Bake 35 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Mrs. Wilson Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put fat from chicken flour and mushroom pieces together. Add enough milk to make about 3 cups. Mix altogether and put in a pan (9 x 13-inches); cover with cheese (cut up). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Succotash
instructions: In a small saucepan combine all ingredients and heat thoroughly.
