title: Shrimp Pate
instructions: Mash shrimp; add remaining ingredients. Serve on garlic Melba rounds.

title: Chicago Deep-Dish Pizza
instructions: On lightly floured surface allow dough to stand covered at room temperature for 1 hour or until doubled in volume. Remove sausage from casing. Brown meat; drain. Add onions and cook until tender. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste and oregano; simmer 15 minutes. Roll out dough to 15 x 11-inch rectangle; press onto bottom and 1-inch up sides of greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with half of Mozzarella cheese and meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Dijon Casserole
instructions: Bake chicken breasts or other chicken pieces basted with 1 stick butter until done. Saute mushrooms and onion in butter until tender. Add drippings from chicken cream of chicken soup sour cream Dijon mustard salt and pepper to taste. Cook one package wide egg noodles and add 1 package frozen peas which have been cooked according to package directions. Place in serving dish. Top with chicken and cover with sauce. Reheat if necessary.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine mayonnaise relish sugar salt and pepper. Add celery and onion; mix well. Add broccoli and toss gently. Chill until serving. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix well. Use for spinach salad or red lettuce.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Microwave chocolate peanut butter and butter 1 to 1 1/2 minutes stirring after 1 minute. Add vanilla and pour over Chex and mix gently. Place sugar in a large Ziploc bag. Add coated Chex and shake to coat. Spread on wax paper to cool. Return to Ziploc bag. (I add more powdered sugar at this time.)

title: Green Bean, Corn And Tomato Salad
instructions: Cook beans in salted water for 2 minutes. Add corn kernels; cook 2 minutes and drain well. Whisk vinegar oil and sugar in bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Add beans corn tomatoes onion and parsley; toss to coat. Season again with salt and pepper. Chill.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and flour in bowl; add eggs margarine buttermilk and flavorings. Mix well. Turn into pastry shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes longer. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Reserve juice\tfrom pineapple to put between layers or on sheet cake pan.

title: Chocolate Vanilla Fluff
instructions: Pat all in bottom of 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Place 1/2 cup sugar in iron skillet; cook until it turns a dark brown syrup. Remove from heat and add boiling water. Cream eggs sugar flour milk butter and syrup. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with Meringue.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to ???. Combine all ingredients. Stir until moistened. Drop by teaspoons into greased muffin tins. Cook for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 20 rolls.

title: Basic White Or Cream Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and blend in flour in the top of a double boiler and let simmer for a few minutes to remove the raw flour taste. Stir milk in gradually using a spoon or whisk. Continue stirring until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Add salt and allow sauce to cook over hot water about 5 minutes. For cream sauce add cream instead of milk.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in the center. In a separate small bowl mix remaining 5 ingredients together. Pour fruit mixture into well and gently stir by hand. Coat 2 nonstick 9 x 5-inch bread pans with cooking spray and pour mixture into pans. Bake for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool before slicing.

title: Deviled Crab
instructions: Crumble saltines in cream. Add butter and cook until thick. Cool. Add beaten egg and fold in crabmeat. Season with red pepper salt and pepper. Place in crab shells and brush with melted butter. Broil until brown about 15 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Jay'S Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking powder salt and milk. Stir well. Chill at least 1 hour. Roll in balls (1 1/2 to 2-inches); flatten and round out with hands on ungreased cookie sheet. Dont make them too thin. Bake in preheated oven 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Corn Meal Pancakes
instructions: Mix well in a medium bowl with a wire whisk. Fry in a small amount of oil in a hot frying pan. Makes 6 pancakes.

title: Posie Cream Frosting
instructions: Operate mixer at low speed mix shortening salt 1 c. sugar butter and vanilla until smooth. Gradually beat in the rest of the sugar and beat until smooth spreading consistency.

title: Cupcake Cones
instructions: Prepare mix as package directs. Fill cones with 2 tablespoons mixture baking 6 cones at a time. Microwave 1 to 1 1/4 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Frost with whipped cream or frosting. Makes 24 to 30 cones.

title: Black Bottom Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell. Stir together 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Blend milk and egg yolk. Stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly just until mixture boils. Reserve 1 cup of custard mixture. Set aside.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix the soup water onion salt and pepper in a bowl. Pour over potatoes which are placed in a buttered casserole. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Let sit for a few minutes prior to serving.

title: Easy Low-Fat Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Toss bread cubes and pineapple in bowl. Spoon in greased 2-quart baking dish. Beat eggs with sugar; pour over pineapple mixture. Dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 8 servings.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dressing cumin and pepper; stir in chicken. Spoon 1/3 cup of chicken mixture onto tortilla; roll up. Place seam side down in 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Pour salsa over filled tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 30 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice with chopped red peppers. Makes 4 servings.

title: Greek Oven Fries
instructions: Soak garlic in olive oil for at least 1 hour. Scrub potatoes; cut lengthwise into 8 wedges each. Place wedges in a bowl and cover with very cold water. Allow to stand for 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Remove garlic from oil. Toss wedges in oil until coated. Coat baking sheet with cooking spray. Place potatoes skin side down on baking sheet. Sprinkle potatoes with oregano salt and pepper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with malt vinegar.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix the corns and 1/2 box muffin mix. Pour in a greased casserole dish. Spread sour cream over the corn and muffin mixture then sprinkle cheese on then the rest of muffin mix. Dot with oleo. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 (uncovered).

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix thoroughly in the order listed and chill. Put into graham cracker crust. Makes 2 pies.

title: Chocolate Cherry Bars
instructions: Combine sugar oleo and milk and boil 1 minute. Stir constantly. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips. When melted pour over partially cooled bars.

title: Baked Garlic Sausages With Mushrooms
instructions: Split sausages. Arrange in a greased shallow baking dish just large enough to hold them in a single layer. Saute mushrooms and onions in butter over medium heat until lightly browned. Smoothly mix in mustard and cream. Bring to boiling. Cook stirring occasionally until liquid is reduced and slightly thickened.

title: Cassoulet
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef celery onion pepper and garlic until veggies are tender. Pour off excess fat. Stir in salt and beans with liquid. Stir in tomato paste. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Lillian'S Grandmother'S Meatballs
instructions: Mix all of above together. Keep hands wet and shape meat into dome-like shape (not too large and not too round). If meat feels too dense add a little more milk. If too soft add a little more bread crumbs. Place in a very hot frying pan (with whatever oil you like preferably olive oil) and fry at low flame until golden brown on the outside. Do not cook completely. Add meatballs to gravy the last hour of cooking; continue to simmer. Skim any fat from frying pan. Add a little water or red wine 2 tablespoons tomato paste and mix with meat particles left in pan. Add dash of sugar; simmer covered for a few minutes to take the tartness out. Add this to the gravy.

title: Banana Cake(Large)
instructions: Mix thoroughly the eggs sugar and butter. Add bananas; mix well. Add vanilla and cake flour. Mixture must be quite thick so add more flour if not thick enough. Add baking powder with flour.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 can of onions. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Stir. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Crab Imperial
instructions: Combine and mix. Heap in shells or small bowls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place cookies on baking sheet and bake at 300\u00b0 until done.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Arrange in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine soup butter lemon juice and cheese. Spoon over broccoli. Top with crackers almonds and pimento. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Roast Moose
instructions: Place roast in roaster with a small amount of fat. Add seasonings; cover. Roast at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes per pound basting often. Pour wine over roast during last 30 minutes. Use meat thermometer for desired results.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain off fat. Add 1/2 cup taco sauce; stir and heat. Crush bag of Doritos; set aside. Shred lettuce. Toss with diced tomatoes chopped olives and minced onions. Add Doritos; toss. Add 1 to 2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese. Stir in ground beef mixture. Stir in Thousand Island dressing.

title: Weight Watcher'S Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients. Beat eggs. Add raisins pumpkin and carrots to eggs. Spray muffin pan with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. (Counts as 1 bread 1 fruit 1 protein 1 milk and 1 vegetable.)

title: Apple Cheesecake
instructions: Cream ingredients together and spread \dough\ into bottom of spring-form pan. Bring dough 1/2-inch up the sides. Place in freezer while making filling.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Pour this over batter and bake 45 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain well. Put into greased baking dish. Add cheese and butter. Sprinkle generously with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Frito Salad
instructions: Prepare lettuce for salad. Chill beans and add to lettuce tomatoes onions and cheese. Pour 3/4 bottle of dressing over all and toss lightly. Just before serving add crushed Fritos and toss.

title: Spanish Noodles
instructions: Brown beef in hot oil. Add onion mushrooms green pepper (optional) seasonings and tomato juice. Cover. When steaming reduce heat and simmer without lid for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Or Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Layer pie filling then pineapple in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Melt margarine and drizzle on top. Bake approximately 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Remove crust from bread and dip slices in wine vinegar. Combine all ingredients in a blender. Add enough water to fill blender and liquefy. (If there is not enough room in the blender add 1 to 2 cups of water and blend in 2 batches.) Soup should not be watery. Chill well before serving.

title: Hot Dogs In Sauce
instructions: Place hot dogs in a baking dish. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour over hot dogs. Bake in covered dish for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Layer rice in a shallow pan. Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over rice. Put a layer of raw chicken over dry soup. Pour 1 can of creamed soup mixed with water over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Philadelphia Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together first 3 ingredients. Add the eggs beating well after each. Add the flour. Then add the salt and vanilla. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. This cake may be baked in small loaf pans to be given as gifts.

title: Onion Soup Bistro
instructions: *Granulated beef and chicken bouillon may be substituted.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange sweet potatoes in 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Spoon preserves over sweet potatoes. Top with nuts marshmallows and margarine. Bake 25 minutes or microwave on High 6 to 7 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Orange Freeze
instructions: Put the sherbet juice and milk in a blender and blend for 15 seconds or just until the sherbet is smooth. You may have to stop the blender and stir the sherbet up a bit to help it combine. Pour the orange freeze into a tall chilled glass. Place a sprig of fresh spearmint in the top and serve immediately.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and add to unbaked pie crust. Cook in 450\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and cook 20 minutes.

title: Busy Day Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Place fruit in greased 8 x 8-inch pan. (If fruit is very juicy mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch with each cup of juice.) Cream shortening and sugar. Mix in egg. Add flour and milk alternately; mix until smooth after each addition. Pour over fruit in pan (9 x 13-inch). Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Chicken-Sour Cream Casserole
instructions: Combine butter and cracker crumbs; blend well. Spoon half the crumbs into a shallow 2-quart casserole; cover with chicken. Combine sour cream soup broth salt and pepper; blend well. Pour over chicken and top with the remaining cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. (Ritz crackers give an even more buttery flavor.) Yields 6 servings.

title: Rainbow Salad
instructions: First Layer Add juice of pineapple to lime Jell-O; cool. Add pineapple. When almost congealed add second layer with spoon.

title: Cheese Souffle
instructions: Mix butter (or margarine) with the mustard. Spread on each slice of bread. Cut bread into cubes. Put a layer of bread in bottom of dish then some of the cheese cubes. Then add rest of the bread and rest of the cheese. Mix eggs milk salt and paprika together. Pour over bread and cheese. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 until brown on top and sides.

title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Brown meat fast in hot fat in heavy skillet. Pour sherry over and transfer to medium casserole. Salt lightly. In remaining fat saute onions and mushrooms lightly; stir in tomato paste meat glaze and flour. Add slowly consomme and 1/4 cup wine. Stir until boils. Season to taste and pour over beef in casserole. Add bouquet garni. Cover and cook in slow oven (250\u00b0) about 3 hours until meat is tender and cuts with a fork. Add remaining wine at intervals. Serves 6.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain grease. Combine remaining ingredients in pan with meat and simmer (no water).

title: Scalloped Potatoes With Ham
instructions: Combine soup milk onion salt and pepper. Arrange alternate layers of potatoes ham and soup mixture in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake covered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour then uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Dissolve soda into water that you rinsed the tomato soup can with and mix with other ingredients. Pour batter into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch square cake pan and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes. Frost with a cream cheese icing or white icing of your choice. Sprinkle with additional chopped nuts if desired. This cake is very good without icing.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Saute ground beef onion bell pepper and garlic until meat is brown. Add tomato paste soup and hot sauce. Simmer 30 minutes. Cook noodles as directed. In greased baking dish layer noodles meat and cheese; repeat until mixture is gone finishing with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Molasses Drop Cookies
instructions: Grease baking sheets. Start oven 10 minutes before baking set to moderately hot at 400\u00b0. Wash raisins and plump then cool. Chop nuts. Sift flour measure and resift 4 times with the next 5 ingredients. Press brown sugar through a coarse sieve to remove lumps. In a 3-quart mixing bowl cream butter and shortening with wooden spoon until smooth. Add sugar and cream well. Scrape spoon. Remove. Beat in egg with rotary beater until fluffy. Then beat molasses until satiny. Remove beater and use spoon. Stir in flour mixture and milk alternately in 2 or 3 portions beginning and ending with flour and mixing until smooth after each portion. Stir in raisins and nuts until well distributed. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto prepared sheet. Bake about 10 minutes or until delicately browned. Remove at once from sheet to cake rack. When cool store in box or jar with tight fitting lid with sheet of wax paper between each layer. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Sweet-Sour Pork
instructions: Brown pork; add 1/3 cup water. Cover and simmer until tender about 1 hour. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Combine sugars and cornstarch. Add pineapple syrup soy sauce and salt. Add to pork; stir until thick. Add pineapple green pepper and onion. Cook 2 minutes. Serve over hot rice or fried noodles and extra soy sauce.

title: Frozen Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze overnight.

title: Lentil Skillet Supper
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add carrot lentil and onion; cook stirring constantly for 3 to 4 minutes. Add broth and rice; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Fluff with fork. Remove from heat and sprinkle with cheese. Cover; let stand 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes four 1-cup servings.

title: Sweet-Sour Cabbage(Surkal)
instructions: Shred cabbage very fine. Add other ingredients. Cover with water and simmer for 1 to 2 hours. Good served with roast pork.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Heat butter in large skillet. Add onions; saute stirring until golden about 8 minutes. Combine onions bouillon bay leaf garlic and thyme. Bring to boil; simmer covered for 30 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Mix asparagus peas mushroom soup and mayonnaise and pour into a casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs and bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until bubbling (approximately 30 minutes).

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in frying pan with enough cooking oil to cover. Simmer over low fire until clear. Combine rest of ingredients; start to simmer on low heat with lid on. After first mixture is completed add to mixture but drain part of oil. Simmer for approximately 1 1/2 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Fluffy Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in milk and peanut butter until smooth. Stir in lemon and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Turn into crust. Drizzle chocolate syrup over top of pie and gently swirl with spoon. Chill 4 hours or until set.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Add cooked onion to soup; add carrots and cheese. Place in greased casserole dish. Top with herb stuffing mix combined with 1/2 cup melted butter. Spread on top. Serves 6.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except nuts in a saucepan and bring to a boil for 3 to 5 minutes or until the mixture forms a soft ball in cold water. Take off of stove and stir in the pecan halves. Keep stirring until all the syrup sticks to the nuts. Pour the nuts out onto a brown paper bag separate and let them cool.

title: California Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients. Serve with fresh fruit. Cover and refrigerate leftovers. This is a nice dip for diabetics who want to jazz up their fresh fruit.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Mix ingredients together except apples for a crumb mixture. Pour over a 9 x 13-inch pan of sliced apples. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until apples are done.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Cut orange slice candy into small pieces. Roll candy dates and pecans in flour before mixing into cake. Add this mixture to sugar margarine and egg mixture. Add flour. Bake in tube pan for 2 hours and 45 minutes at 250\u00b0.

title: Jello Popcorn Balls
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Add jello and pour over popped corn. Butter hands and form popcorn into balls. Be sure to let popcorn mixture cool slightly or you will burn your hands!

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion together until tender. Drain. Add sour cream margarine salt nutmeg black pepper red pepper and slightly beaten egg. Pour half of the squash into casserole dish. Cover with half of the potato chips and cheese. Add remaining squash potato chips and cheese. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Cook in medium oven for 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Sally'S Eggs And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook onions in oleo until soft in a heavy iron skillet. Pour tomatoes in skillet with onions; season to taste with salt and sugar. Cook until not so watery. Break eggs one at a time around in tomatoes. Cover and cook until done. Sprinkle with black pepper if desired.

title: Zucchini Relish(Given To Me By A Camper Friend.)
instructions: Mix zucchini and onions; add salt. Mix well. Wash and drain. In a large pan add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Can in sterile jars. Process 5 minutes in boiling water. This insures sealing.

title: Homemade Vegetable Soup
instructions: Lightly brown ground beef in a small amount of oil; drain off excess fat. Combine all ingredients in large kettle. Simmer covered for 1 hour.

title: Baked, Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes drain and whip with margarine salt sour cream and cream cheese (a small amount of milk may be added if desired). Pour mashed potatoes in casserole dish. Top with cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Bake at 350 degrees until cheese is melted and potatoes begin to bubble around the edges.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes. Grate potatoes. Add beaten egg salt and pepper. Mix well. Add flour and onion and mix again. Drop heaping tablespoonfuls of mixture onto hot griddle or frying pan greased with oil or shortening. Makes approximately 12 pancakes. Serve with sour cream or applesauce.

title: Simple Chicken Italiano
instructions: In a large skillet combine chicken and about 1/3 of the Italian dressing. Saute until chicken starts to brown. Add veggies and remaining dressing. Cover and simmer 7 to 9 minutes until veggies are crisp-tender stirring frequently. Serve over pasta; sprinkle with cheese. Makes 5 servings.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Break bread into pieces in bottom of greased pan. Brown sausage and drain. Mix eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over bread.

title: Green Pepper Corn Bread
instructions: Combine eggs buttermilk and oil; mix well. Stir into corn meal until moist. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Pour into greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Dice these ingredients up together.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Roll in a big round ball let set in refrigerator and then roll in chopped walnuts.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Rinse rice in warm water. Cook rice in milk until thick. Add salt sugar and extracts. Stir in small amount of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks then add to rest of hot mixture. Cook for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well cream cheese butter and oleo. Add eggs; beat. Add sugar cake flour and vanilla.\tBake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Start in cold oven.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix corn meal and flour with just enough hot water to make a thick batter. Put the oil in an iron pan and heat hot. Then pour off oil into batter. Mix and pour in pan. Squirt margarine on top. Bake at 450\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes until nice and brown.

title: Electric Lemonade
instructions: You will need a 1 gallon jar (glass).

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spray dish with Pam 9 x 12-inch. Place bread as a liner in bottom of pan. Sprinkle with cheese and cooked sausage. Mix together eggs milk salt and pepper; pour over sausage and cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until eggs are set.

title: Catherine Darsey'S Bean Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given. Sauce can be served on green beans broccoli asparagus or other cooked vegetables. Leftover sauce should be refrigerated.

title: Lemon-Jello Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix milk oil and eggs. (Beat in one egg at a time.) Pour mix into angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let cake cool 10 minutes. Loosen edges of cake with knife. Turn cake out of pan and onto plate.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Using an 8-quart pressure kettle cook hen in salt pepper and water on 10 pounds pressure for 50 minutes. Cook chicken breasts salt pepper and water on 10 pounds pressure for 15 minutes. Remove chicken. Add margarine to broth; set aside.

title: Creamy Tomato Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat. Add onion and garlic and cook stirring until translucent about 6 minutes. Add tomatoes stock and oregano and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently until thickened about 45 minutes. Remove oregano sprigs. Slowly add half and half stirring constantly. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with oregano if desired. Serve hot.

title: Lime Nut Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello and chill until slightly thickened. Beat Dream Whip and cream cheese. Add all ingredients to jello. Refrigerate until jelled. You can put in 9 x 13-inch pan and cut in squares. You can put it in a mold and you will still have some leftover. It makes a good portion.

title: Eight Layer Salad
instructions: Mix the first seven ingredients in layers. Spread salad dressing on top 3/4 inch thick. Sprinkle with sugar salt and white pepper to taste. Cover with grated Cheddar cheese 3/4 inch thick and top with crisp fried bacon (chopped). Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Russian Rock Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and butter then add eggs and mix well. Add nuts dates and raisins that were floured well. Add cinnamon soda flour and vanilla. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Stir together sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in water until smooth. Stir in egg yolks. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Remove and stir in lemon juice and margarine; let cool and turn into pie shell. Beat egg whites at high speed until foamy; gradually add 1/3 cup sugar and beat until stiff. Lightly brown meringue at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Sort and wash beans; cover with water 2-inches over beans and soak overnight. Add salt pork to beans; cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Stir in next 10 ingredients and cook for 1 hour. Brown sausage; drain and add to beans. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients; beat well. Put in a greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Delicious!

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: In large bowl combine dry ingredients. Stir in carrots raisins and apples. In separate bowl beat eggs oil and vanilla and stir into flour mixture. Spoon into well-greased muffin cups (or paper-lined) filling 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes approximately 18 large muffins.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except potato chips) together and pour into large casserole. Top with chips and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Marinated Broccoli
instructions: Mix the oil with the vinegar water lemon juice garlic and seasonings. In a large salad bowl with a tight-fitting lid toss the mixture with the broccoli. Let marinate all day or overnight tossing the mixture several times before eating.

title: Aunt Wilma'S Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Drain fruit retaining juice. Heat juice and add Jell-O to dissolve. Add cola and congeal. Mix cream cheese with a small amount of mayonnaise or cream to thin slightly. After Jell-O has partially congealed add nuts cream cheese and fruit. Return to refrigerator to finish congealing.

title: Granny'S Potato Soup
instructions: Dice potatoes small rinse put in saucepan cover with water and cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender. Add salt and pepper to taste and margarine. Let simmer 3 to 4 minutes. Add canned milk. Bring to boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Parmesan Onion Canapes
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Spread on lightly toasted bread. Place on baking sheets and broil 4 inches from heat source for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Very good!

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Bring to boil the water and sugar. Cool and pour over the mixed fruits. Chill. You can also freeze this.

title: Chicken Lasagna Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0F. Spray a medium baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Cook noodles according to package directions but do not add salt. Drain and lay out flat on waxed paper. Meanwhile prepare sauce. In a small saucepan over medium-low heat combine cream cheese milk and Parmesan cheese stirring until smooth. Set aside. Spray a large nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray. Heat skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and green onions. Cook stirring until tender about 5 minutes. In a blender or food processor fitted with the metal blade combine mushroom mixture ricotta chicken and parsley. Process until smooth. Spoon mushroom mixture down center of each noodle and roll up tightly. If you want you can drizzle a small amount of the sauce down center of each noodle. Place rolls filling sides up in prepared dish. Spoon sauce on top. Cover with foil. Bake rolls until heated through about 25 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Sift cake mix and jello into bowl. Add oil eggs and warm water and beat well. Add strawberries and mix well. Pour into 3 layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Biscuits
instructions: Combine ingredients mixing as for a cake. Fill muffin pans about half full leveling with a knife. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes then increase to 450\u00b0 to brown. Makes 8 biscuits.

title: Ruby Plylers Apple Jack Pastry
instructions: Roll out dough cut biscuit size seal edges with water. Place cooked apples in center and fold over and seal with fork. Fry in oil about 1 inch in skillet turn over and fry until brown.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Saute beef onion and green pepper in a large frying pan until beef is lightly browned and vegetables are tender. Drain off fat; add flour to frying pan and stir well. Add tomatoes and seasonings. Combine noodles with meat sauce and put in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish; top with the shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through and bubbly. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Almond Bars
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and pat into bottom of greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix the next 4 ingredients and pour over base. Sprinkle with slivered almonds. Bake for 40 minutes at 325\u00b0. Chill and then cut into bars.

title: Blueberry-Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Into a mixing bowl sift first 5 ingredients. In another bowl beat the eggs milk melted butter orange zest and orange juice. Stir into flour mixture just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in blueberries and nuts. Pour batter into a greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool. Wrap in foil and store overnight before cutting and serving.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Beat sugar cream cheese and sour cream together. Add Jell-O and beat. Add Cool Whip vanilla and peaches. (Stir Cool Whip vanilla and peaches by hand.) Pour into crust and chill.

title: Lisa'S Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cut your sausage up thin. Saute in skillet and set aside. Cut up your onions pepper and celery (coarsely) and saute in olive oil. Add tomatoes seasonings tomato paste and sausage. Add mushrooms and beans last. Cook long and slow on medium to low heat not high heat. Serve over rice with garlic bread.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook the garlic onion and green pepper in the oil until soft. Add the beef and cook until lightly browned. Add the tomato sauce and chili powder. Cover and cook slowly for 20 minutes. Add the beans and simmer uncovered 20 to 25 minutes. Serve at once or make ahead and reheat. Add water to thin. Can be frozen.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix well. Store in airtight container. Use 2 heaping teaspoons of mix (or to taste) in cup of boiling water. Drink whenever you feel chilly.

title: Apple-Smothered Pork Chops
instructions: You will need 2 sheets (18 x 24-inch each) Reynolds Wrap| heavy-duty aluminum foil.

title: Cracker Pudding
instructions: Beat egg yolks and add to the milk. Combine crackers with the egg and milk mixture. Add 1/2 cup sugar vanilla and coconut in a saucepan. Cook until thickened. Allow egg whites to reach room temperature then beat gradually adding the remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Beat until stiff peaks form. Spread egg whites on top of cracker pudding and place in 350\u00b0 oven until delicately brown.

title: My Favorite Pickles(Best Of All, Soooo Easy)
instructions: Mix white sugar vinegar and celery seed. Combine until sugar dissolves. Take Vlasic dill pickles drain rinse and slice thin. Slice onions. Stir into sugar mixture and return to jar. Roll jar until all sugar is dissolved. Put in refrigerator and enjoy.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Fry hamburger and season with garlic powder and seasoned salt until crumbled. Drain and discard grease. With hamburger add onions and peppers. Saute for 5 minutes; mix in next ingredients (soup beer Worcestershire sauce oregano Tabasco sauce and tomatoes). Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes (partially covered). Stir occasionally. Serve open-faced over heated buns. Sprinkle on cheese.

title: Scottish Shortbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix ingredients together; knead until consistency becomes doughy. Press into greased mold. Bake 45 minutes until lightly browned and springy to touch. Cool and turn out.

title: Easy Dumplings
instructions: Mix ingredients together pouring milk slowly into flour. May not need a full cup. Roll out on floured board. Cut in pieces. Drop into boiling chicken broth.

title: Christmas Tea
instructions: Note All ingredients are dry.

title: Monkey Mix
instructions: Note Make this up in a gallon size Ziploc bag and this will be a piece of cake!

title: Chocolate Pretzels
instructions: Melt chocolate. Roll or dip 2/3 of pretzel log in melted chocolate. Roll in nonpareils.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook and bone chicken or use 4 or 5 chicken breasts. Saute in butter the mushrooms green pepper and onion.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Cook rice per directions on the box. Cook the bacon and crumble it. Combine the raisins and water. Saute celery and onion for 10 minutes. Combine all items and lay pork chops on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Put pineapple and jello in saucepan; heat to dissolve jello. Let mixture cool a little then add buttermilk and Cool Whip. Mix with mixer and place in refrigerator.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix together. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then reduce to 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done. Makes two 9-inch deep dish or 3 small crusts.

title: T.V. Snacks
instructions: Melt margarine. Add Worcestershire sauce and salts. Pour over all ingredients which have been mixed then mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 stirring every 10 minutes for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat well. Pour into tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Cut meat into chunks. Precook potatoes onion celery peas and carrots until tender. Drain. Add chicken broth and cream. Cook over medium heat until mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Place one pie crust into the bottom of a deep dish pie pan. Layer chicken and vegetables in the crust and top with sauce mixture. Cover with second crust and make several slits in top of the crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Line dish with Fritos. Layer cooked rice chili cheese onions lettuce and tomatoes. Serve immediately.

title: Bloody Mary
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in water. Add other ingredients. Chill. This can be served frozen.

title: Chicken Manicotti(Entree)
instructions: Shells Combine chicken/ mushroom soup and sour cream; mix well. Add chicken to half of mixture. Mix well. Stuff this mixture into partially cooked manicotti shells. Place stuffed shells in baking pan.

title: Polish Pickled Eggs
instructions: In a large bowl combine the pickled beets and their juice with the vinegar 4 cups water garlic bay leaf pickling spices and salt. Add boiled eggs and onion rings. Cover and refrigerate for several days.

title: Buttermilk Layer Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add shortening 2/3 cup buttermilk and flavoring. Beat about 1/2 minute at low speed then 2 minutes at medium. Add rest of buttermilk and eggs. Beat 2 more minutes. Makes 2 layers or 24 cupcakes. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 25 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Tart
instructions: Roll pie crust into a 13-inch circle; place onto a 12-inch pizza pan. Fold edges under and crimp; prick with a fork. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes; cool. Arrange 6 slices cheese overlapping on baked crust. Sprinkle with cooked ham. Cook onion in butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat stirring constantly until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in eggs and next 3 ingredients. Spoon over ham. Cut each of the remaining 2 cheese slices into 9 squares. Arrange on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 on lower rack of oven 15 minutes or until set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Yields one 12-inch tart.

title: Asparagus Casserole 2
instructions: Beat eggs. Add salt and pepper cracker crumbs pimento cheese and milk. Pour over asparagus in a casserole dish. Melt butter and pour over top of mixture. Top with remaining cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix together; pour into 1 crust and top with second crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Breaded Veal Cutlets
instructions: Dip veal into egg mixture; then crumbs. Brown in hot fat. Pour over milk mixed with soup in baking dish. Cover; bake in slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Beat pudding and milk until thick. Add sour cream and Cool Whip. Alternate layers of bananas and wafers. Spread pudding on each layer. Put Cool Whip and sour cream on top. Sprinkle with graham crackers or vanilla wafers.

title: Beef Barley Stew(Crock-Pot)
instructions: In a skillet brown beef and onion in oil. Drain. Transfer to a 5-quart slow cooker. Add water tomato sauce carrots celery salt oregano paprika and pepper. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours. Add beans corn and barley; cover and cook on low 2 hours longer or until barley beef and vegetables are tender. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain artichoke hearts. Chop up. Put in bowl. Mix all ingredients together. Put into ungreased pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes. Bake until brown or bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Hot Chocolate
instructions: Makes a big batch. Excellent for Christmas. Place lunch baggie full of homemade hot chocolate in green or red lunch bags for gifts.

title: Leeann Chin'S Stir-Fried Beef With Broccoli
instructions: Soak mushrooms in warm water until soft about 30 minutes; drain. Rinse in warm water; drain. Remove and discard stems; cut caps into 1/2-inch pieces. Trim fat from beef; cut beef with grain into 2-inch strips. Cut strips across grain into 1/8-inch slices. Toss beef 1 tablespoon oil 1 teaspoon cornstarch 1 teaspoon salt sugar soy sauce and white pepper in glass or plastic bowl. Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes. Cut broccoli into 1-inch pieces. Cut lengthwise gashes in stems thicker than 1-inch. Place broccoli in boiling water. Cover and cook 1 minute. Drain. Immediately rinse under running cold water; drain. Cut green onions into 2-inch pieces. Mix 1/4 cup chicken broth the oyster sauce and 2 tablespoons cornstarch.

title: Chicken-Apple Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce. Chill thoroughly. Serve on lettuce with potato chips and carrot sticks. Two cups of cooked turkey or 2 (6 1/2 ounce) cans of tuna may be used instead of chicken. Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Texas Fudge
instructions: Bring the sugar and milk to a boil slowly and cook about 15 minutes until a soft ball can be formed when dropping a little into cold water. Have the other 5 ingredients all ready to add quickly and stir until it begins to thicken. Pour onto 11 x 17 x 1-inch buttered cookie sheet. Cool and keep refrigerated until ready to cut and eat.

title: Plum Pudding
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients in a bowl. In a separate bowl blend dry ingredients; add all together. Grease a steam pan and cover thoroughly. Place mixture in steam pan for 3 1/2 hours. Serve with brandied hard sauce.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Prepare the hamburger by boiling rapidly in enough water to cover meat. Break the meat up so as not to have lumps in the meat. Pour off water and repeat cleaning process. Add all ingredients. Simmer for 1 hour. Cook spaghetti until tender enough to pinch in two. Add spaghetti to cold water to terminate cooking; drain. Layer mix in large casserole the sauce spaghetti and sharp Cheddar cheese ending with sauce. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until sides are bubbling and top is browned.

title: Minnesota Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients serve over ice.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together potatoes soup and sour cream. Place in a 9 inch x 13 inch dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Place cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Glorified Chicken
instructions: In a buttered casserole dish place rice and chicken. Mix in bowl together the orange juice sherry and cream of mushroom soup. Pour this over the chicken and rice. On top sprinkle the French onion soup mix. Cook covered for 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Stir occasionally.

title: 150 Year Old Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Dissolve soda in water. Mix ingredients; add the egg whites last. This is a very stiff mixture but do not moisten. Drop with teaspoon 2 inches apart. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0 or so).

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Put the chopped dates margarine brown sugar and beaten eggs in a saucepan; cook stirring constantly over medium heat until mixture is very smooth and thick. Then set aside to cool.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup lukewarm water. Dissolve sugar and lard in 1 cup boiling water. Cool to lukewarm; add yeast mixture egg and then flour (a little at a time). Let rise overnight in refrigerator. Make into cloverleaf rolls or roll out and cut. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Jam Or Jelly
instructions: Cook berries or make juice. Use 4 cups sugar to 5 cups juice or berries. Cook in 5-cup amounts (about 25 to 30 minutes). Jelly is done when it flakes off in a metal spoon. Stir often and watch closely.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Pare and core apples. Slice thin and add cinnamon and sugar. Put in prepared crust and dot with margarine. Put on top crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for an additional 25 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Top the ingredients with 1 cup crushed saltine crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Easy Nut Bread
instructions: Combine sugar egg milk and nuts in mixing bowl; mix well. Stir in biscuit mix; beat vigorously for 1/2 minute. Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes (more or less). Keep checking after 30 minutes. Check for sides pulling away like cake then its done.

title: Cry-Baby Cookies
instructions: Mix as for butter cake adding molasses after sugar then beaten eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and stir in chopped raisins and nuts. Add some of flour mixture to sugar mixture beat well then add coffee and flour mixture alternately. Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake in 375\u00b0 oven until done about 15 minutes. The children love these cookies and they are good for them too.

title: Marinated Artichoke Hearts With Pasta In A Creamy Sauce
instructions: Pour liquid from hearts into skillet. Add oil butter onion and garlic; saute until soft. Add hearts and basil and cook for five minutes (you may wish to cut hearts in half). Take off heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour onto 1/2 to 3/4 pound cooked pasta and mix completely. Enjoy!

title: Kentucky Wonder Green Beans Vinaigrette
instructions: Wash green beans and trim ends. Arrange beans in a steamer basket and place over boiling water. Cover and steam 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Plunge beans in cold water; drain. Combine beans peppers and salad dressing. Sprinkle with pepper. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients except soda and popped corn. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir constantly. Boil rapidly for 5 minutes (soft boil stage). Remove from heat and stir in soda quickly. Pour over popcorn in a large pan and stir. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Turn out on wax paper and break into clusters. Store in tightly covered containers.

title: Lite Tangy-Cheese Cauliflower(Microwave Oven)
instructions: Prepare cauliflower by removing stem and greens. Rinse under water but do not shake to dry. Place in a microwave-safe dish. Cover loosely with waxed paper. Microwave for 8 to 9 minutes on High (100%) or until tender. Meanwhile combine mayonnaise and mustard to make the tangy sauce. Immediately spoon mustard sauce on top of cauliflower. Sprinkle with cheese. Let stand 5 minutes until cheese melts. Makes 8 servings.

title: Holiday Gingerbread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and molasses. Sift dry ingredients and add to mix. Add hot water and beat until smooth. Pour in a greased and floured 9-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Apple Crisp
instructions: Dissolve cinnamon drops in water over low heat. Pour over apples and mix. Turn into buttered 9-inch pan. Mix flour sugar and butter to coarse crumbs. Spread over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until apples are done.

title: Potatoes
instructions: Mix together. Put in cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onion; drain. Add tomatoes and tomato paste pepper garlic salt and Parmesan cheese. Cook on low for 30 to 45 minutes. Cook noodles while waiting for sauce. Add cottage cheese after cooking. Cover casserole dish with noodles and Mozzarella cheese. Keep layering sauce and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fried Stuffed Jalapeno Peppers
instructions: Cut stems from peppers. Remove seeds with small knife (do not split peppers). Stuff with pimento cheese. Chill at least 2 hours. Combine 1/4 cup flour 2 tablespoons cornmeal salt pepper and buttermilk; set aside. Combine remaining flour and cornmeal. Dip stuffed peppers in milk mixture then dredge in flour mixture. Pour oil to a depth of 2 to 3 inches. Heat to 375\u00b0. Fry peppers a few at a time for 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Makes about 12 peppers.

title: Dr. Bird Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in by hand the coconut pineapple raisins and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Holiday Pound Cake
instructions: Beat eggs one at a time. Add sugar butter and flavoring. Put salt and soda in sifted flour. Remove 1 cup flour to roll pecans and fruits in before combining in cake. Add floured fruits and nuts and mix well. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt or round cake pan. Bake 3 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Easy Chocolate Cupcakes
instructions: Beat all ingredients together. Bake in cupcake tins at 325\u00b0.

title: Great Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Add other ingredients in order listed. Drop by tablespoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 10 minutes. Dont overbake. These are great for freezing. Layer between wax paper or parchment seal in airtight container. Will keep a couple of weeks.

title: Dynamite Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in jacket with bay leaf. Cool completely. Peel and grate. Melt butter and add to can of cream of chicken soup. Mix until smooth. Add sour cream 1 cup grated cheese (reserve 1/2 cup) onion and salt and pepper to taste. Place in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. The last 15 minutes top with 1/2 cup crushed cornflakes and 1/2 cup grated cheese.

title: Sausage
instructions: Mix all together and shape like a sausage. Wrap tightly in foil and refrigerate 24 hours. Before baking poke holes in foil. Bake on broiler pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Red Cabbage
instructions: Heat bacon drippings; add cabbage apples brown sugar vinegar water salt and pepper. Simmer covered for 15 to 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Yields 5 servings.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent roll dough on jelly roll pan. Bake according to package directions. Cool.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill overnight.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes for 20 to 30 minutes until tender. Drain cool and slice. Fry bacon until crisp and drain. In same skillet saute onion. Add flour sugar seasonings vinegar and water stirring until mixture begins to thicken slightly. Add bacon potatoes and crumble in eggs.

title: Peach Pudding
instructions: Spray a 4-quart pan. Cream 1 cup sugar and butter. Add milk flour and baking powder. Stir together and pour in pan. Add peeled sliced peaches on top. Dot with additional butter. Sprinkle 1 cup sugar over. Pour boiling water over mixture. Do not stir! Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes. Set pan on cookie sheet or foil in oven.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs. Sift flour cocoa and salt together 3 times. Add dry ingredients alternately to cream mixture with buttermilk and food coloring. Beat well. Fold in soda and vinegar mixture. Bake in 2 layers at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Pound out chicken breasts until 1/4-inch thick. Melt butter. Add to melted butter onion powder oregano parsley salt and pepper to taste. (You may also use diced onions.)

title: Turkey Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place 1/2 broccoli (cooked and well drained) on bottom of well buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix mayonnaise cream of chicken soup cheese and curry (be sure to mix curry with melted oleo). Place 1/2 the turkey over broccoli and cover with 1/2 the mayonnaise soup and cheese mixture. Continue with remaining layers. Top with buttered crumbs just before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Layered Dessert
instructions: Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour in layers graham cracker crumbs coconut chocolate chips and chopped pecans. Pour can of condensed milk over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar butter and syrup together and cook to a rolling boil. Then add peanuts. Cook until peanuts start to pop. Then cook 5 minutes. Turn off heat add baking soda and vanilla. Pour in well-greased cookie sheet. Cool then break and eat.

title: Pork Chops Baked In Sour Cream
instructions: Dredge pork chops in bread crumbs. Insert 1 clove slice into each chop. Brown lightly in oil. Place in baking dish. Combine and heat all other ingredients. Pour over chops. Bake covered for 1 hour. Serve with rice.

title: Cornbread Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Add tomato soup water salt pepper chili powder corn and green pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and peanut butter until smoothly blended. Cream in sugar gradually. Stir in vanilla and slightly beaten eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture in 3 portions. Form dough in 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Press balls down with floured fork so ridges remain in dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 6 dozen.

title: Yummy Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Mix Jell-O using only 2 cups of hot water. Add pie filling and crushed pineapple. Set aside to gel.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Mix all ingredients to make a crust. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Ranch Style Beans
instructions: Brown meat in butter. Stir in soup mix. Add all other ingredients. Put in 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until bubbly. Serve with green salad rolls and coffee.

title: Turkey Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Toss turkey with flour and cook onion celery thyme and pepper in margarine. Add carrots water soup beans and turkey. Pour into 2-quart casserole and put biscuits on top. Bake 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Aunt Bea'S Festive Chicken Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Combine reserved juice and cream cheese; mixing until well blended. Add pineapple and remaining ingredients except tomatoes and mix lightly. Chill.

title: Winter Fruit Salad
instructions: In a saucepan mix pineapple juice and pudding; cook until thickened and cool. Toss and chill. Cover with whipped topping.

title: Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Remove seeds from pumpkin. Clean off all strings; rinse and drain. Let seeds dry overnight in baking pan. For every cup of seeds melt 1 tablespoon butter with 1 teaspoon salt. Mix all together and bake in very low oven about 250\u00b0; cool.

title: Turkey Roulades
instructions: Lay cutlets flat with narrow end towards you. Spread cheese on each within 1/4-inch of edges. Fold up long sides about 1/4-inch. Press into cheese. Roll up from narrow end. Coat each with flour; dip in egg then roll in bread crumbs. Arrange seam side down in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Chill 30 minutes. Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Drizzle melted butter over cutlets. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until juices run clear when meat is pierced.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Grease 2 loaf pans. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients with mixer. Pour into greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Spicy Spaghetti
instructions: Mix all ingredients (not spaghetti) in a large pot and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Prepare spaghetti according to package. Serve with meatballs.

title: Sugared Peanuts
instructions: Over medium heat in heavy saucepan cook sugar and and water until sugar is dissolved. Add peanuts and cook stirring frequently until liquid has turned to sugar coating. Pour onto cookie sheet and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each addition. Stir in vanilla crushed pineapple and grated lemon rind. Combine raisins citron peel cherries and candied pineapple in large bowl. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Cover fruit with flour mixture. Be sure fruit is well covered. Combine with first mixture and blend well. Spoon into 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) pans which have been lined with greased brown paper. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours or until toothpick comes out clean and dry. Turn out on racks to cool. Ice when you wish. Cakes may be used in a week.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Roll out dough to 12 x 16-inch rectangle. Crumble cooked sausage evenly over dough. Spread cheese over sausage. Starting at end roll dough. Pierce through with fork to allow steam to escape. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Cool. Slice into 1-inch sections.

title: 4-Alarm Chili
instructions: Cook crumbled sausage onion and garlic in hot oil until sausage is no longer pink. Drain. Add remaining ingredients except Cheddar cheese sour cream and green onions. Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes. To serve top each bowl of chili with Cheddar cheese a dollop of sour cream and green onions. Makes 6 servings.

title: Snackin' Cake
instructions: Combine the cake mix eggs milk oil and frosting in a mixing bowl. Beat until blended. Pour into Bundt pan that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Southern Hash
instructions: Brown onion and bell pepper in butter; remove from pan. Brown ground beef until redness is gone. Add onion bell pepper rice tomatoes salt pepper and chili powder. Pour into greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Let set for 20 minutes after mixing. Press in pie pan and bake 7 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pizza Turnovers
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Stir in sugar oil and 1 cup flour. Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Knead until smooth and elastic (5 minutes).

title: Homemade Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate squares in a pan (low heat). Once melted add sugar and then can of Carnation milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until it thickens (sauce). Add vanilla. Tastes great on almost any flavor of ice cream!

title: Pikes Peak Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes into greased 9 x 9-inch casserole. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix cream with chicken broth and pour over potatoes. Cover and bake 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Uncover and bake another 30 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven. Leave until cheese melts.

title: Pizza Loaf
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Brown beef and onion; drain. Add 1 1/2 cups of tomato sauce oregano macaroni and egg. Place in a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Top with strips of cheese and remaining sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese for serving. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Bars
instructions: In large bowl combine peanut butter butter brown sugar and white sugar. Beat until creamy. Gradually beat in eggs and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and salt. Blend well. Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips over top. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes; remove and run knife through to swirl; bake another 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix with stuffing. Mix together remaining ingredients. Spread half of stuffing mixture on bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan or casserole dish. Cover with chicken mixture and top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Check the crumb mixture as it browns easily.)

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: In a glass bowl set the white bark and the chocolate chips. Cover and bake at 225\u00b0 until melted (about 20 to 25 minutes). Remove from oven. Mix in redskin peanuts until all peanuts are covered with chocolate. Drop spoonfuls on wax paper. May harden in refrigerator.

title: Dreamy Apricot Salad
instructions: Combine jello sugar and water in a saucepan; bring to a boil stirring until jello and sugar are dissolved. Remove from heat. Stir in baby apricots and pineapple. Let stand until cool. Beat condensed milk and cream cheese with mixer until smooth. Stir in jello mixture and nuts. Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Chill overnight. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter or spray 4 large loaf pans (9 x 5-inch) or 8 mini loaf pans (7 1/4 x 3 3/4-inches). Stir together in a large bowl the first 5 ingredients. Sift together the next 5 dry ingredients. Add by the cupful to the other mixture; stir until well blended. Add nuts and walnut oil; stir. Spoon into pans and bake for approximately 1 hour. Cool on racks.

title: Best Ever Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Boil 3 minutes. Let cool and then add 2 pints clean fresh strawberries. Pour into pie shell. Chill several hours. Then cover with 1 small Cool Whip.

title: Salmon Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. May add more or less of each ingredient depending on taste and texture desired. May substitute salmon and use instead of tuna in a tuna salad recipe.

title: Meat Pie
instructions: Press out crescent rolls in glass pie pan to form pie crust and bake until done. Brown hamburger onions green pepper and drain. To hamburger mixture add tomato sauce pepperoni chili hot beans and season with garlic powder and Italian seasoning. Simmer all together about 20 minutes on low-medium heat. Layer in pie crust the meat sauce mixture then Mozzarella cheese. Top with a layer of Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top cheese layer is very lightly browned. Let cool and cut into pie slices.

title: Butterscotch Crisp Balls
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows. Stir until butter is melted. Remove from heat. Add sugar-coated flakes. Add butterscotch chips and coconut. Mix well. Roll into balls about 1 1/2-inches around with greased hands. Allow to stand at room temperature until set about 1 hour. Makes about 3 dozen. Very good.

title: Swiss Cheese Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place the chicken breasts in a shallow Pyrex dish. Mix the white wine and the chicken soup in separate bowl and set aside. Place a slice of Swiss cheese on top of each chicken breast. Pour the wine mixture over chicken and cheese. Spread an even layer of bread crumbs over the chicken. Slice the butter into small sections and place on top of bread crumbs. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover and continue to bake for 15 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar shortening eggs pumpkin and water together. Add dry ingredients to pumpkin mixture and stir well. Divide into 2 well-greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: No Work Chicken
instructions: Place chicken snugly skin side down in flat baking dish in one layer. Make marinade by mixing together remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. When ready turn chicken cover dish with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Remove foil; baste well and continue baking uncovered for 15 more minutes.

title: Possum Pie
instructions: Combine butter pecans and flour. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Combine cream cheese powdered sugar and 1 cup of Cool Whip. Beat well. Spread on cooled crust. Make puddings as directed except reduce milk to 1 1/2 cups each. Spread vanilla pudding on cream cheese layer. Spread chocolate pudding on top of vanilla layer. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle with Heath or Crunch bar. Refrigerate.

title: Mimi'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In large heavy saucepan over medium heat stir together sugars and evaporated milk. Stir until it starts to boil then dont stir while it cooks to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Add marshmallow cream and beat well. Add peanut butter and beat quickly it will start to set up quickly after peanut butter is added. Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. (Do not make this on a real rainy or humid day!) When cool cut in squares. Store airtight.

title: Eggless White Cake
instructions: Cream shortening with 1 cup sugar. Sift together the flour soda baking powder and salt. Add alternately 1 cup buttermilk with dry ingredients to the shortening-sugar mixture. Add the vanilla. Pour in a greased floured 8 1/2-inch square pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fake Pralines(Very Easy And Delicious)
instructions: Heat and stir butter and sugar over low flame. Pour over graham crackers that are placed on a cookie sheet. Put a nut on each square. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Take out and let cool until topping hardens.

title: Calico Beans Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Saute onion and celery. Add bell pepper. Add tomato soup tomato paste and catsup. Stir and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Add drained green wax and lima beans and remaining ingredients. Mix altogether; bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 25.

title: Cajun Seasoning
instructions: Mix all and store in shaker. This is very good to sprinkle on soups and stews. Careful! Its pretty powerful. (I have made large amounts and given in decorated shakers for Christmas.)

title: Easy Cheese Cake
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Mix cheese with sugar vanilla egg (yolk only) and lemon juice.

title: Grilled Honey-Glazed Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Combine honey oil vinegar garlic herbs salt and pepper in shallow pan. Add pork and turn to coat well. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours. Turn pork occasionally. Remove pan from the refrigerator 30 minutes before grilling.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Remove from pot and debone.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done and debone. In a large pan cook macaroni and cheese then drain. Add butter and milk; mix well. Add cream of mushroom soup. Add chicken and mix well. Top with smashed crackers. Put in a glass pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mustard Dressing(For Slaw)
instructions: Mix together and cook over a slow fire until thick. Mix with slaw.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix and press into 13x9x2 1/2 inch greased cake pan.

title: Amish Cabbage
instructions: Chop and boil cabbage; drain and set aside. Fry bacon; crumble and mix with cabbage. Slice potatoes; cook in enough milk to cover. Cook until soft. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix together sour cream potatoes cabbage and bacon.

title: Taco Bake
instructions: Brown ground meat in frying pan along with taco seasoning. Drain grease from pan. Prepare corn bread mixes per instructions on box. Pour corn bread batter into a greased 9x13 pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10-15 minutes until lightly browned. Spread meat over corn bread and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Place pan back in oven until cheese melts. Spread shredded lettuce over melted cheese. Sprinkle with diced tomatoes and garnish with sliced black olives. Serve with sour cream and salsa.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let come to a boil. Cook only until it begins to change color. Put in jars and seal. Do not overcook or they will not be crisp.

title: Daddy'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: In a large casserole dish spread layer of stuffing. Drain peas and spread 1/2 can over stuffing. Spread layer of chicken over peas. Spread cream of chicken soup over this. Add remaining peas and top with celery soup. Add small amount of chicken broth. Add remaining chicken and top with remaining stuffing. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Bavarian Cream
instructions: Make gelatin and when slightly thickened whip. (I use quick set method on package.) Fold in fruit nuts and whipped cream until well combined. Then put aside until set!

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger bacon and onions. Combine all in a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 14.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cranberry sauce into hot\tjello mixture and dissolve. When this cools and starts to jell add pineapple and nuts. Mold.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix margarine sugars and egg. Stir in flour (dough will be stiff). Stir in nuts and chocolate chips. Press dough in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Bake until golden brown about 25 minutes; cool. Cut into bars. Yields about 24 bars.

title: My Best Fruit Cake(All Fruits And Nuts)
instructions: Mix coconut with nuts and fruit. Add milk and mix thoroughly. Cook in paper lined cake tin at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar 5 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla; beat 2 minutes. Sift in flour salt and soda. Mix in oatmeal chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by level tablespoons on greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 14 minutes. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Western Cookies
instructions: Mix butter with sugars. Add egg and vanilla. Add flour cocoa baking powder and soda. Stir in oats chips raisins and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls on greased sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients on low heat until thick stirring constantly. Set aside to cool. When cool stir in apples and pour into serving dish. Cover with Cool Whip.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Grease and lightly flour a 10 x 15 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl combine flour and sugar. Measure into heavy saucepan 2 sticks margarine 7 tablespoons cocoa and water. Heat to boiling stirring well. Add to flour-sugar mix and blend well. In medium bowl combine beaten eggs. Stir soda into buttermilk. Add to egg and vanilla. Pour into flour mixture. Add cocoa and pour into prepared pan. Bake 25 minutes or until done.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into small bite size pieces. This should take a month. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Cook over a kerosene fire for about 4 weeks at 465\u00b0. This should serve 3800 people. If more are expected 2 rabbits may be added but do this only if necessary as most people do not like hare in their stew!

title: Beef Tenderloin Over Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish. Cover with lid and bake in oven for 4 hours at 250\u00b0. Serve over rice.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Crust Combine 1 stick soft butter 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 cup flour and 1 cup chopped nuts; cook until golden brown at 350\u00b0 15 to 20 minutes. Stir often. Cool. Spread half on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Elegant Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening with sugar. Add flavorings. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk or sour cream. Blend well after each addition. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or test until done.

title: Chicken Rice-Thumbolina'S
instructions: Mix rice chicken 2 beaten eggs 1/2 can crushed tomato bits and 1/2 can cream of mushroom soup. Mix ingredients well. Place in greased molds (ovenproof). Cover top with aluminum foil. Place molds into larger pan and put 1 can water into larger pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Butter Coffee Cake
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl; let stand 5 minutes. Add 1/4 cup sugar stirring until dissolved. Add salt eggs sour cream and 1/4 cup butter to yeast mixture; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until blended. Gradually stir in enough flour to make a soft dough. Place in a well-greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) free from drafts 2 hours or until doubled in bulk.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel and slice the apples to fill the pan a little over half full. Sprinkle some sugar over the apples. Top with the remaining mixture which is crumbly. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. If cheese is used mix it in the topping.

title: Carter Cookies
instructions: Melt crunchy peanut butter in microwave. Add the chocolate bark. Melt in microwave on Simmer setting 2 minutes at a time stirring after each 2 minutes until melted. Add nuts cereal and marshmallows; stir until well coated with chocolate mixture. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Put apples into buttered pan. Mix flour soda salt butter brown sugar and oats. Sprinkle over apples and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Upside-Down Caramel Apple Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Line pie plate 9 x 1 1/4-inch with a 14-inch circle of foil. Spread 2 tablespoons margarine over foil. Press pecan halves rounded sides down on foil; sprinkle with brown sugar.

title: Mexican Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix together everything but chili and cheese. Put half of mixture in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Put chili and 1/2 of the cheese on the mixture in the pan. Add the rest of the corn mixture. Sprinkle remaining cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Banana Caramel Bars
instructions: Combine flour sugar and baking powder in a bowl. Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Slowly stir in egg mixing with a fork until crumbly. Pat half of mixture in 13 x 9-inch baking pan to form crust.

title: Easy Canned Grape Juice
instructions: Wash Concord grapes; pick from stems. Into a clean quart jar put 1 to 2 cups grapes. (I usually use 1 1/2 cups grapes.) Do not skin or seed. Add 3/4 to 1 cup sugar. Fill jar to overflowing with boiling hot water; partially seal. Process in 275\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes; complete the seal. The juice is ready to drink after 6 weeks standing. Strain the grapes from the liquid. You can eat the grapes or make a pie out of them. The juice has a particularly fresh sparkling flavor. (This is a 50s recipe from high school economics book.)

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Parboil chicken with celery and onion. Lay chicken in casserole and cover with noodles then soup. Add milk creamed corn peas salt and pepper. Sprinkle with parsley. Cover with bread crumbs and put butter on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and bake another 10 minutes.

title: Mississippi Pecan Pie
instructions: Boil syrup and sugar together for 2 minutes; cool. Pour slowly over eggs beating constantly. Add butter vanilla and nuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Hot Taco Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese and spread in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Mix chilies and taco sauce then spread over cream cheese. Sprinkle Mozzarella over top then heat until bubbly. Dip with plain Tostitos.

title: Rice Balls
instructions: Boil rice. When almost dry add eggs pepper and parsley. Let cool. Shape balls and roll in crumbs. Fry in olive oil until brown.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients well and shape into balls the size of a quarter and brown lightly.

title: One Dish Meal
instructions: Saute meat and onion until meat is barely cooked. Spray a 17 x 13-inch pan with \Pam\. Put meat and onion mixture in bottom and spread to sides. Pour tomatoes over meat mixture. (I dont use all of the juice.) Then spread the drained corn and the previously made mashed potatoes. (Make according to directions on bag using the softer recipe.)

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut bread dough into small pieces. Place in a tube or Bundt pan. Add in layers the remaining ingredients. To bake for breakfast cover with foil and place in oven overnight to let dough rise. Set time to bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Tomatoes Provencale
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half and press gently to remove seeds and water season with salt and pepper. Mix together remaining ingredients and spread cut sides of tomatoes with this mixture. Sprinkle tops with melted butter or salad oil. Arrange on a heatproof serving dish and cook in a hot oven of 450\u00b0 or under a broiler 10 to 15 minutes or until tomatoes are soft and tops are browned.

title: Pepper Slaw
instructions: Combine vinegar water sugar and salt. Add to shredded cabbage the diced peppers and celery seed. Toss to mix thoroughly then add vinegar mixture and let stand in a cold place several hours.

title: Tangy Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan; cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until heated through. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: German Icebox Slaw
instructions: In a large bowl alternate layers of shredded cabbage and onion rings. In a saucepan boil together remaining ingredients and pour over cabbage and onion mixture. Let stand 4 to 8 hours in refrigerator before serving. The slaw may be kept in the refrigerator as long as 3 weeks.

title: Italian Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine ingredients except margarine in 4-quart dish. Cover and microwave on High about 50 to 60 minutes. Stir every 15 to 20 minutes until spaghetti is tender. Add margarine.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Garnish with bacon bits just before serving.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and eggs together. Add fruit cocktail. Sift together flour and baking soda; add to mixture. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar and walnuts over batter. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Use 2 (13 x 9 x 2-inch) pans.

title: Pumpkin Date Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar gradually. Add eggs; beat well. Blend in water pumpkin and sifted dry ingredients. Fold in pecans and dates. Pour into 2 greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Gold Coast Special Tidbits
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Bring 2 cups water to boil. Add scallops and bring to second boil. Drain scallops. In shallow casserole dish cube and layer 1 package of cream cheese. Add layer of all the scallops. Top with other package of cream cheese. Dot with butter. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Remove foil and bake additional 5 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Raw Potato Hot Dish
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Drain fat. Add raw potatoes celery and soup. Place in 3-quart casserole and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: No Bake Butterscotch Bars
