instructions: Grease 9 x 12-inch pan and press crumbs marshmallows coconut and nuts in pan. In another pan beat eggs. Add sugar and margarine. Cook. Pour cooked mixture over crumb mixture. Melt peanut butter and butterscotch bits over low heat. Place on top of other mixtures.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: I remember a molasses cake Grandma Rogers made when I was a little girl. I would set on the bench by the kitchen table and say \Grandma how do you cook a cake?\ As I remember she would put enough flour to fill a skillet half full enough salt and soda to make it rise and enough molasses to make it real sweet a big hunk of butter and maybe a little milk if the batter was too thick. Then she would pour this in an iron skillet and fire up the wood stove until it was pretty warm and cook it until it was done. Then she would say \Run tell Grandpa the cake is done.\

title: Cherry Mountain Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix sugar flour baking powder and milk. Pour batter over margarine in pan and add to center of batter the pie mix. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Place romaine in plastic bag. Fasten bag and refrigerate no longer than 24 hours. Add remaining ingredients to bag. Fasten bag securely and shake until well coated.

title: Quick Sticky Buns
instructions: In 8 or 9 inch layer pan melt margarine in preheated oven. Remove from oven and stir in brown sugar cinnamon syrup and nuts. Place biscuits on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until biscuits are well browned. Let stand for 5 minutes. Invert on serving plate and remove pan.

title: Onion Souffle
instructions: Mix together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with chips crackers or bread.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown the sausage meat. Add the onions and green peppers; fry a little longer to brown onions and peppers. Add the Ranch Style beans pork and beans brown sugar ketchup mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Mix all together and put in crock-pot for several hours until bubbly. Or put in baking dish and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles.

title: Mama'S Easy Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil sliced squash until tender. Drain. Place in baking dish. Combine other ingredients except cracker crumbs and pour over squash then put cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Tortilla Rolls
instructions: With electric mixer beat ham and cream cheese together until smooth. Stir in pineapple green onion and honey. Spread 1/4 cup ham mixture on each flour tortilla to within 1/2-inch of edge. Roll up each tortilla starting from one edge; wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 8 hours before serving.

title: Savory Turkey Loaf
instructions: Beat together egg applesauce salt poultry seasoning and pepper in large bowl. Add turkey wheat germ and onion. Mix lightly. Shape into loaf in shallow pan. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Jeanette'S Hot Clam Dip
instructions: Melt butter in frypan. Saute onion and garlic. Add clams and lemon juice and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add everything except cheese. Mix well and put in a pie plate. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Spread on Ritz crackers.

title: Egg Salad
instructions: Remove the shells from the hard-boiled eggs and chop fine. Add the celery sugar and salt; begin to add the salad dressing gradually until there is a smooth mixture (a little more or a little less may be desired.) Let cool and serve as a sandwich or as a salad on a bed of lettuce. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Easy Sausage Balls
instructions: Crumble the sausage and mix with cheese. Add biscuit mix one cup at a time. Form into small balls (about 1 inch in diameter); place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven until light brown (13 to 15 minutes). Can be prepared in advance and frozen uncooked. Cooking may take a few extra minutes if balls are frozen. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and cut up in chunky pieces. Cook and drain broccoli as directed on box. Grease casserole with butter. Put broccoli in bottom of casserole and chicken on top of broccoli. Mix soup and mayonnaise; pour over chicken and broccoli. Cut up slices of bread into cubes and cover top of dish. Dot with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. If bread browns too fast lightly cover with foil.

title: Sourdough Scones
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the flours 3 tablespoons sugar baking powder soda orange peel lemon peel and currants. With a pastry blender work in the butter until fine crumbs are formed. Add the sourdough starter; stir with a fork until dough holds together. Form the dough into a ball and knead briefly only until ingredients are combined. Cut the dough into two equal parts; shape each half into a ball. Flatten into a 5-inch circle leaving dough slightly higher in the center. Cut each circle into 6 wedges. Sprinkle scones with remaining tablespoon of sugar. Place them on ungreased baking sheet; bake in the middle of a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Garlic Cheese Grits
instructions: Add grits and salt to water and cook until thick. Cool 15 minutes. Melt margarine and cheese roll and add to grits. Beat eggs with milk and slowly stir into grits. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole and top with crumbs or cheese. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: New England Fish Chowder
instructions: Simmer haddock covered in boiling water 15 minutes. Drain reserving broth. Remove bones from fish. Saute diced pork until crisp. Remove and set aside. Saute onion slices in pork drippings until golden brown. Add fish potato celery bay leaf salt onion and pepper. Pour in fish broth plus enough additional boiling water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid. Simmer covered 30 minutes. Add milk and butter; simmer 5 minutes more. Serve chowder sprinkled with diced pork. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Reuben Dip
instructions: In mixing bowl beat cream cheese sour cream and ketchup until smooth. Stir in the corned beef sauerkraut Swiss cheese and onion until blended. Transfer to a greased 1-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover; bake 5 minutes longer or until bubbly. Serve warm with bread or crackers.

title: Roquefort Dressing
instructions: Have cheese warm. Combine cheese with 1 cup buttermilk and beat in electric mixer until smooth. Then add remaining ingredients and blend well. Chill before serving.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2-quart casserole. Mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean about 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Brown hamburger; drain. In mixing bowl add meat and cheese. Stuff shells with meat mixture. Pour sauce over shells. Pour into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Pancakes
instructions: Mix eggs milk and oil. Mix remaining ingredients. Mix together and bake on griddle.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix together 2 cans of mushroom soup 2 cans of chicken soup 1 can Ro-Tel 1 cup chicken broth and 1 small chopped onion. Layer Dorito chips soup mixture and cheese. Start over. Top with shredded cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350 or until brown.

title: Apple Dessert
instructions: Put yellow cake mix margarine and coconut in bowl and mix. Pat into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix sugar cinnamon and apples and put over baked crust. Blend the sour cream and egg; drizzle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Caramel Frosting
instructions: In a large skillet combine margarine and sugar. Place over medium heat and cook stirring constantly until sugar melts and syrup is light golden brown. Add milk stirring constantly. (The mixture will tend to lump but becomes smooth with further cooking.) Cook over medium heat stirring until a small amount dropped into a small bowl of cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Beat to almost spreading consistency. Spread on your favorite chocolate or yellow cake which has been cooled.

title: Peanut Salad
instructions: Add mayonnaise to other ingredients according to how creamy you want it.

title: Taffy Apple Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together and serve on sliced Granny Smith apples.

title: Grandma Svensson'S Swedish Pancakes
instructions: Stir ingredients until smooth. Add one more cup of milk. Melt dab of oleo in hot large frypan.* Put about 1/4 cup of batter into pan. Swirl batter to cover bottom of pan (pancake will be thin). Fry until lightly brown then brown other side. (This doesnt take very long.) Roll pancake over knife blade. Keep warm on plate over pan of boiling water. Serve with butter syrup or preserves.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: In large glass bowl mix corn syrup sugar and water. Microwave on High for 4 1/2 minutes. Remove from oven. Add peanuts; microwave on High for 5 more minutes. Remove and add margarine salt soda and vanilla. Turn out quickly and spread on greased cookie sheet.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Combine chicken the three cans of soup and one can of rotelli. Crush Doritos in to small bits. Add Doritos to first mixture. Put it in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Peach Slump
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a heavy skillet. Bring to a simmer and top with biscuits. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes. Serve with cream. Serves 6.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Trim excess fat from pork chops and brown quickly in butter in a skillet. Remove chops from pan. Saute onion in pan drippings. Combine remaining ingredients and the onion in a lightly greased shallow casserole; mix well. Arrange chops on rice mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until chops are tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Christmas Slaw
instructions: Mix together well and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Serve or put in small containers for freezing.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Crack and peel fresh coconut and grate. Cream sugar and Crisco. Add coconut water and flour. Mix until smooth. Fold in egg whites. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
instructions: Slice cabbage width-wise into strips approximately 1/4-inch thick. Toss with peppers and Bragg as a dressing. Makes a large salad. May vary in color with orange or purple peppers.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and press into oblong pan or two pie pans. Cook 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Mix Dream Whip according to package directions. Cream the cream cheese. Add sugar vanilla and Dream Whip. Mix well. Spread over cooled crust. Chill. Cover with blueberry pie filling.

title: Delicious Sweet Rolls
instructions: Mix the ingredients in mixer. Gradually add flour until its all mixed good. Butter pan. Let rise in a warm place for a couple of hours. Roll out. Spread with margarine sugar and cinnamon. Cut and place in greased pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Donna'S Pork Chops
instructions: Put pork chops in casserole. Pour soup and water over pork chops. Cover and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix and blend for 5 minutes. Grease and sugar Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool slightly and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Rocky Road Caramel Corn Bars
instructions: Microwave oleo on High 45 seconds or until melted. Reserve 1 cup marshmallows. Add remaining marshmallows and chocolate chips. Toss to coat with oleo.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Mix the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour over chicken and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar and shake until thoroughly mixed.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve as a dip for fresh fruit.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix cinnamon cornstarch sugar and slightly beaten eggs. Add to pineapple. Mix everything together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Peanut Blossom Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In mixing bowl beat sweetened condensed milk peanut butter egg and vanilla until smooth. Add biscuit mix; mix well. Chill at least 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned (do not overbake). Press candy kiss in center of cookie immediately after baking. Cool. Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Spicy Pickles
instructions: Drain juice off of pickles. Add sugar to pickles along with garlic bulb and Tabasco sauce. Cover with the pickle juice. Shake pickles every day for a week.

title: Pineapple-Orange Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to box directions. Cool. Split layers to make 4.

title: Chocolate-Orange Sodas
instructions: In medium bowl stir orange juice with chocolate milk. Mix until smooth; stir in water. Pour 1/4 cup chocolate orange mixture into each of eight ounce glasses. Add 1 large scoop ice cream to each. Add soda to fill almost to the top.

title: Butterscotch Cheese Cake Bars
instructions: Melt morsels and margarine. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press half into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. In bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Add condensed milk egg and vanilla; mix well. Pour onto crumbs. Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Peel cucumbers wash and slice very thin. In a small container with lid combine salad oil lemon juice salt and pepper. Shake well. Add tomatoes sugar and onions. Pour dressing over vegetables. Toss well.

title: California Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine soy sauce water brown sugar butter pineapple juice and mustard. Heat until sugar has dissolved. Cool and pour over wings. Put wings in shallow baking dish and marinate for 2 hours in fridge. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Drain marinade and put wings on paper towels. Serve hot or cold.

title: Nonfat Pasta Primavera
instructions: Simmer onion celery green pepper zucchini and garlic in broth until onions are clear. Meanwhile cook carrots in a microwave-proof dish covered with plastic wrap for about 4 minutes on High. Set aside. Cook broccoli the same way. Add tomatoes carrots broccoli and spaghetti to onion mixture. Heat thoroughly. If more liquid is needed add broth.

title: Brownies
instructions: Combine flour soda and salt. In a saucepan combine butter sugar and water; bring just to a boil. Remove from heat. Add chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir until morsels melt and mixture is smooth. Transfer to a large bowl. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually blend in flour mixture. Stir in nuts. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 50 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Drop small spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Karin'S Kasserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare noodles and drain. Place in casserole dish. Stir in sausage and sour cream; add garlic salt to taste. Before baking pour in about 1 to 2 cups of milk. Bake until heated through (about half hour). Serves 5 to 8 hungry people.

title: Jan Hagels
instructions: Cream brown sugar and margarine until fluffy. Blend in salt and flour after blending in egg yolk and vanilla. Pat dough into ungreased 15 x 10 x 1 pan. Brush top with egg white. Sprinkle combined sugar and cinnamon on top of egg white. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake for 15 min. at 350 degrees. Cut into 1 1/2 in. squares.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Mix refried beans with taco seasoning mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix softened cream cheese and sour cream; spread over bean mixture. Sprinkle on onions then cheese. Pour taco sauce over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Let stand a few minutes before serving.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix 1 softened stick of butter and 2 eggs. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Then mix well the powdered sugar 1 softened stick of butter 2 eggs and cream cheese. Pour over first layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 40 minutes.

title: Hungarian Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Core the cabbage and cook it in boiling water until barely tender. Drain and separate 12 large leaves and trim ribs. Combine onion shallot egg whites garlic carrot and parsley until thoroughly blended. Combine onion mixture with rice ground beef bread crumbs vegetable seasoning and tomato juice using a fork to mix. Add frozen peas. Place 1/3 cup of the mixture in each cabbage leaf and roll up tucking in sides. Makes 12 rolls. Shred remaining cabbage; sprinkle in bottom of 2-quart casserole. Place cabbage rolls in casserole seam-side down packing tightly.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Add oatmeal if too soft. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake 7 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 9 dozen.

title: Party Cocktail Wieners(Microwave)
instructions: Combine barbecue sauce sugar and seasonings in a 1 1/2-quart bowl. Cover. Microwave on High for 2 1/2 minutes until hot. Stir in wieners; cover. Microwave 4 to 6 minutes stirring once. When hot serve with cocktail picks. Makes about 1 quart.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed and add 1/2 of the package of coconut. Bake as directed on box. Use 9 x 13-inch pan. Punch holes in the cake just out of the oven and pour from the can in the holes the can of cream of coconut and the can of Eagle Brand milk. Let cool and frost the top with the Cool Whip. Sprinkle the remaining coconut on top. This freezes well. Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Surprise Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter or margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in flour rum extract and nuts. Mix until well blended. Wrap a tablespoon of dough around each cherry. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes. Cool slightly. Roll in additional confectioners sugar and nuts finely chopped.

title: Crawfish Pie
instructions: Saute vegetables in butter. Add soup crawfish and crab meat. Add rice. Put in pie shell. Cover and vent pie crust top. Cook until pie crust is golden brown in 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven. Shrimp may be substituted.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0. Lay out to get cold. Drop into plastic bag with powdered sugar and shake until coated with sugar.

title: Dursey Cream Puff Ring
instructions: Grease and flour large baking sheet. Trace an 8-inch circle on sheet. In a medium saucepan heat water butter sugar and salt to a full boil. Stir in flour. Cook stirring until paste forms a ball and leaves the side of the pan. Remove from heat. In a food processor or by hand beat in eggs one at a time until paste is smooth and shiny. Spoon on baking sheet to form a circle. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until browned and firm. Place on rack to cool. Split with knife so you have a top and bottom. Fill with cream filling. Dust with confectioners sugar. Serves 8.

title: Lemon Cheese Cake
instructions: In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed beat cream cheese and mayonnaise; gradually beat in sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time then add lemon rind lemon juice and vanilla. Put in crust. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until set. Chill 4 hours.

title: Creamy Cheese Enchiladas
instructions: Fill each tortilla with 1/2 cup cheese and 1 tablespoon onion. Roll and place in 8-inch square baking dish. Melt butter and add flour stirring and add broth to make a thick sauce. Add sour cream and chilies and stir until smooth. Pour over tortillas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Hot Dog Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Cut hot dogs into bite sized pieces. Cook with onion and green pepper in oil in skillet until brown. Prepare gravy mix using package directions. Add gravy and rice to hot dog mixture; mix well. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Crawfish Jambalaya
instructions: Saute bell pepper garlic onion (not green onion) and celery in margarine in a Dutch oven. Add crawfish fat and season highly. Cook uncovered for 40 minutes over a low fire. Add the peeled crawfish tails and cook another 10 minutes. Add green onion and rice. Mix well and steam for 5 minutes before serving. (If it seems too dry add more margarine.)

title: Catalan Spinach
instructions: Blanch spinach; squeeze out water and chop. Heat olive oil. Add garlic pine nuts and raisins. Season with salt and pepper. Cook on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: In a large bowl combine cabbage pepper carrot onion and 1 teaspoon salt. Let stand 1 hour. Drain. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil; simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Cool pour over cabbage mixture. Pack in freezer containers; freeze. Yields about 4 pints.

title: Frito Pie
instructions: Line bottom of greased casserole dish with broken up Fritos. Add layer of chopped onion. Heat chili and pour over Fritos and onion. Top with more Fritos and grated cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter sugars and pudding mix in large mixer bowl; beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture; then stir in oats and raisins. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt and add to blueberries. Fill unbaked pie shell and add lemon juice. Dot with butter. Cover with top crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes; depends on oven. Watch close; dont get too brown.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Stir first four ingredients together and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan the cheese tomatoes olives sour cream and salsa. Top with green onions and serve with chips.

title: Comet'S Skillet Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; add enough milk to make batter. Heat oil in skillet and pour batter into skillet. Cook over medium heat until brown on both sides.

title: Sausage Spinach Loaf
instructions: Cook sausage until not pink. Drain. On floured surface roll dough to 15 x 8-inch rectangle. Sprinkle cheese on dough leaving 1-inch border. Top with spinach and sausage. Bring long sides of dough together. Pinch to seal edges and ends. Place loaf seam down on greased baking sheet. Combine egg white and water. Brush over loaf. Sprinkle with caraway. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden. Let stand 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
instructions: In bowl combine flour baking soda cinnamon cloves ginger and salt. In large saucepan melt butter over low heat. Remove from heat cool. Stir in 1 c. sugar molasses and egg beating with wooden spoon. Beat in the dry ingredients until well combined. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix 6-8 cups apple slices with sugars 2 tbsp. flour and spices. Set aside.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix together and drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 18 to 20 minutes. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour sugar and milk (this will be thin). Melt butter in 8 x 8-inch pan. Pour in batter. Arrange peaches on top. I also use the peach syrup over the peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 until nice and brown about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Top with cheese. Combine soup and wine and spoon over chicken. Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except blackberries. Fold blackberries in with wooden spoon. Do not use a mixer. Fold berries in by hand. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Roll out or pound meat thin with rolling pin. Mix remaining ingredients well. Soak meat approximately 1/2 hour depending on how strong you want it. Lay strips on broiler pan. Set oven to 150\u00b0. Bake 8 to 10 hours. The longer the drier and the tougher.

title: Cap'N Crunch And Cocoa Puffs Treat
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and honey in saucepan and bring to a rolling boil boiling for at least 30 seconds. Add peanut butter nuts and cereals into mixture and mix well. Spoon onto foil sprayed with Pam.

title: Potato Wedges
instructions: Toss together ingredients in bowl with lid and shake. Spread on baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Rice St. John
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage. Drain fat. In casserole pan add rice soup water onions celery peppers and meat. Mix well. Smooth it even and cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 until rice is done.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion in butter and then add the next 6 ingredients and cook for 5 minutes. Add the soup and simmer for 10 minutes more. Add sour cream mix well and serve on rice.

title: Yummy Casserole
instructions: Brown and crumble meat. Add chopped onion and cook until onion is soft. Tomatoes need to be cut up. Add salt pepper and 1/3 cup grated cheese. Pour into casserole dish and sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blackberry Bread
instructions: Stir dry ingredients together. Mix berries with eggs and oil. Stir into dry ingredients just until flour is moistened. Add walnuts. Pour into loaf pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cherry Pie Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix cherry pie filling eggs and flavoring with a spoon (no mixer). Do not overbeat. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake on 300\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
instructions: Serve with wheat crackers. Serves 10 to 12.

title: 6-Hour Stew
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Cover and bake at 275\u00b0 for 6 hours. Do not stir during cooking time.

title: Yam Stuffed Oranges
instructions: Bake potatoes on baking sheet at 350\u00b0 about 1 1/2 hours. Peel sweet potatoes and mash well. Blend together butter sugar eggs cream cloves cinnamon salt orange juice and pecans. Spoon into orange cups and bake for 15 minutes or until tops are brown. Top with marshmallows and brown for another 5 minutes.

title: Pizza Rolls
instructions: Mix together pizza sauce cheeses and ground beef. Put one tablespoon of mixture in the center of egg roll wrapper and wrap according to directions on wrapper package. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: E-Z Meatballs(Microwave)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well shaping into balls. Place in a 4 x 8 x 4-inch microwavesafe container. Cook on High in microwave for 15 minutes. Turn dish 1/4 turn every 5 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Aunt Agnes' Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add balance of ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Date-Nut Bars
instructions: Melt margarine and dates over low heat. Add vanilla and sugar. Beat eggs well. Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Mix together and add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Rice Pudding
instructions: Measure milk in 1-quart measure. Microwave 3 minutes on High; stir. Microwave 3 minutes on High or until almost boiling. Combine eggs sugar and salt in 2-quart casserole. Stir in scalded milk. Mix with raisins cinnamon and vanilla thoroughly. Microwave 4 minutes on High; stir again. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes until set.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat and onion in a skillet. Drain and then add beans barbecue sauce and brown sugar. Put in a baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Multi-Grain Bread
instructions: Snip apricots; put in a bowl with honey. Stir; let set. In a large bowl dissolve yeast in warm water; stir until dissolved. Add salt sugar and baking powder; stir to dissolve. Add buttermilk rolled oats and wheat germ; mix well. Let set 10 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta as directed. Drain and rinse in cold water. Toss with vegetables. Pour dressing over top and toss well with cheese. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Cook the spaghetti or angel hair pasta for about 10 minutes. Drain and set pasta aside.

title: Canned Sweet Relish
instructions: Grind ingredients together and let stand overnight in salt then rinse good with cold water and drain. Turn into large pan and add sugar vinegar turmeric and water. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 3 minutes then put in canning jars and seal. Makes approximately 6 quarts.

title: Quick Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Fold 1/8 cup sugar into the sliced berries; set aside. Beat the remaining 1/8 cup of sugar into the cream cheese. Fold the cream cheese into the Cool Whip. Cut the cake into slices about 1/3-inch thick. Arrange a layer of slices in the bottom of a glass bowl; sprinkle with a teaspoon of sherry and spread with melted jelly. Then put in a layer of strawberries and a layer of Cool Whip. Continue layering ending with a layer of Cool Whip. Garnish with a whole berry.

title: Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Brown meat; drain fat. Set meat aside. Blend mayonnaise milk eggs and cornstarch together until smooth. Stir in meat cheese and onions. Turn into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan heat to boiling point; set aside. Spread half the corn chips in greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Layer half the chicken and soup mixture over chips. Repeat layers of corn chips chicken and soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake for 5 minutes longer.

title: Parmesan Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix cheese margarine (or butter) and Italian seasoning. Spread on bread. Place on cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cooking time 10 minutes. Preperation time 5 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chicken Mozzarella
instructions: Cut off any fat or skin on chicken. Pound chicken to make tender cut into 2 inch square pieces. Saute onion and pepper rings with butter or margarine in shallow baking dish (10x10 Corning Ware). When sauted remove most of the onions and peppers then brown chicken. After chicken is browned on both sides remove dish from stove top add onions and peppers along with mushrooms. Cover with sauce. Cover dish and Bake 350\u00b0 for 30 min. When sauce is bubbling uncover and add mozzarella cheese to top and bake for 5 min. May be served with spaghetti or any pasta of your choice.

title: Gingerbread Men
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar in mixer bowl. Beat in egg. Add orange rind and corn syrup; mix well. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Chill for 1 hour or longer.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a quart jar with lid. Keep in refrigerator until needed. Shake well before pouring over salad.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream and cream cheese. Mix with mixer until smooth. Add dry taco seasoning. Mix well. Spread into casserole dish. Top with chopped lettuce. Spoon on taco sauce. Cover with onion and cheese. Add tomatoes and black olives. Serve with taco chips.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Butter a 10 x 10 or 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle bottom with the herbed bread crumbs (1/2-inch thick). Chop the onion green pepper and celery. On top of crumbs layer the green beans corn and the chopped vegetables. Mix together the soup and sour cream. Spread on top of vegetables. Sprinkle the cheese on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and bring to boil. Boil for 1 minute and 10 to 20 seconds only. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. No baking required. Drop by spoonful on wax paper and cool.

title: Russian Cornbread
instructions: Sift cornmeal and sugar in bowl. Beat in eggs oil and buttermilk. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased pan and bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Katie'S Strawberry Bread
instructions: Blend together well first 5 ingredients; then add eggs one at a time; beat well after each. Mix sour cream and baking soda together and add to mixture. Gently blend and fold in the flour and chopped walnuts. Fold in jam. Divide and place in two greased loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or 3 small pans for 50 to 60 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Party Cake
instructions: Bake cake on greased and floured 10 x 15-inch sheet pan. Prepare vanilla pudding with milk. Cool. Cook crushed pineapple with 3/4 cup sugar and flour. Mix butter margarine and 1 cup sugar with pudding and beat until smooth. Spread pudding on cake then spread with pineapple and sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Pumpkin Stew
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil; add tomato sauce water corn peas and salt. Simmer 10 minutes. Add potatoes pumpkin and milk. Simmer at lowest possible temperature for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve with grated cheese. Also good served over white rice.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Melt butter or margarine. Combine salt sugar and cinnamon. Add to melted butter. Mix well. Add egg and apples. Blend well. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Cover with lattice pastry top. Bake 10 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Continue baking until crust is golden brown and apples are tender approximately 30 minutes.

title: Self Iced Apple Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients; add shortening egg milk and vanilla. Mix well; add apples. Pour into 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

title: Lemon Broiled Fish
instructions: Marinate fish in lemon juice for 30 minutes. Lay fish on foil covered broiler pan. Spoon margarine over fish. Sprinkle with garlic salt white pepper and paprika. Broil about 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Serves 4.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix well with hands and shape into 3 or 4 long rolls. Wrap in Saran Wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours. Then bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into pie crusts. Refrigerate.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Cream together first three ingredients. Add eggs that are well beaten melt chocolate and add to egg mixture. Make sure chocolate is well cooled before adding. Blend flour into mixture. Add nuts (chopped) last. Bake in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake until done which is when a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar and cream well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift flour together with soda. Add to creamed mixture. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into a greased pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix well sugar cocoa and flour. Add egg yolks and milk. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 or 35 minutes or until firm.

title: Easy Lemon Cake Dessert
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box. Cool. Mix the pudding and pour on cake. Let set. Mix the lemon pie filling and cream cheese. Spoon this on the pudding layer. Top with the Cool Whip.

title: Grilled Mahi Mahi(Yield: 4 Servings)
instructions: Season fillets with oil spray mixed herbs sea salt and pepper. Grill fillets 3 to 4 minutes per side or to desired doneness (medium and moist). Set aside on a warm plate until needed. Grill pineapple rings with charred crisscross markings from the grill. Arrange fillets and pineapple rings on plate and add garnish to suit.

title: Coconut Dessert
instructions: Mix crackers and margarine. Line bottom of a 13 x 9-inch dish. Mix milk pudding and ice cream. Pour over cracker crust. Top with Cool Whip and toasted coconut.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix nuts and coconut. Spread on bottom of pan. Prepare cake mix according to directions. Pour cake mix evenly on nuts and coconut.

title: Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in a greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and Wesson oil; add eggs one at a time. Sift flour and other dry ingredients together. Add to sugar Wesson oil and egg mixture. Add milk and vanilla. Beat until smooth and add nuts and prunes mixing well. Pour in greased pan and bake at 375\u00b0 until done. Leave in pan and pour icing over while still hot.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil first 5 ingredients for 5 minutes. Stir in oats and peanut butter. Drop by spoonful on wax paper.

title: Berry Yum-Yum
instructions: Combine flour brown sugar nuts and margarine. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely. Blend cream cheese and sugar fold in Cool Whip. Spread over cooled crust. Top with pie filling.

title: Punch For A Bunch
instructions: Add hot water to jello and sugar to dissolve jello. Add lemon orange and pineapple juices. Add cold ginger ale when ready to serve. This recipe increased 6 times will easily serve 100.

title: Ambrosia Spread
instructions: Cream together butter and powdered sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time. Add bourbon and walnuts. Spread between each layer. Frost with whipped cream.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook until thickened. Cool. Put strawberries in deep dish baked pie shell. Pour liquid over strawberries. Chill. Serve topped with whipped cream.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Combine all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve while warm.

title: Sugar-Free Pineapple Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding as directed. Add pineapple (can use any fruit) and Cool Whip. Stir well and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Minute Pie
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water. Add unthawed frozen berries. Break up berries with fork. As berries thaw gelatin thickens. When partially set pour into baked pie shell. Chill until set. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Party Dessert
instructions: Blend milk and water. Stir in remaining ingredients (except garnishes). Shape into a roll 3 x 6 inches. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate 12 hours or more. Cut roll into 10 slices. Garnish and serve.

title: Butter-Crumb Cake
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese until light and fluffy; add remaining ingredients and beat until moistened then beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Pour into one 13 x 9-inch or two 8-inch square pans greased.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients until fluffy then add Cool Whip and mix. Put in graham cracker crusts and let cool. Makes 2 to 3 pies.

title: Baked Potato
instructions: Cook your potato for about 5 to 10 minutes in the microwave until soft. Take the potato out and take the peeling off. Pour cheese on the potato; it will melt. Also add butter. You can add more to your potato if you would like to. Now you have a baked potato.

title: Never Fail Pie Pastry
instructions: Measure flour and salt in a bowl. Cut lard into flour until particles are the size of peas. In a separate bowl beat egg add water and vinegar. Add to your flour mixture and toss lightly until mixture is dampened. Divide into 4 parts and make into balls. Roll out and put in pie pan. Fill with your favorite fruit. makes 2 - 9 inch pies.

title: Salmon Fritters
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Stir in corn meal. Combine egg and milk; stir into dry ingredients until just combined. Break salmon into bite size pieces and fold into batter. Drop by rounded tablespoons into deep hot fat (375\u00b0). Fry until golden brown about 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve with creamed English peas. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Italian Meatball-Vegetable Stew
instructions: Combine beef bread crumbs tomato juice eggs oregano garlic salt and pepper in a large bowl. Form into 2-inch balls. Put onions carrots and tomatoes in the bottom of slow-cooking electric cooker. Brown meatballs and arrange them over the vegetables. Cook on low covered for 4 to 6 hours. Turn to high. Add green beans and parsley and cook 40 minutes longer. Serves 8.

title: Royal Crown Mousse
instructions: Split ladyfingers lengthwise and arrange cut sides down on oven rack. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and brush cut sides with sherry or orange juice. Line the sides of an 8 or 9-inch pan with ladyfingers. Snip off ends of ladyfingers with shears to make level with sides of pan if necessary.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter or margarine. Add soups and water and other seasonings. Warm ingredients to boiling. Pour into ovenproof soup bowls. Place one slice French bread on top and grated Swiss cheese over bread. Bake in hot oven until cheese melts and bread toasts.

title: No-Bake Turtle Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place caramels and milk in a heavy saucepan. Heat over medium-low heat stirring continually until smooth about 5 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Pour into pie crust.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate until serving.

title: Cheddar Rice Patties
instructions: Slice center cuts of eggplant into 1-inch thick slices. Fry in oil until partially clear. Drain on paper towels. Place cuts into a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole dish. Top each slice with Mozzarella cheese and 1/4 cup highly seasoned spaghetti sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes on lower rack. Serves 6.

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Put ingredients in saucepan and bring to a slow boil. May add any other spices which you may desire. Pour over steak pork chops or chicken in a long cake pan or dish. Refrigerate at least 2 hours then grill.

title: Festive Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients mixing well. Spoon into a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over top of sweet potatoes. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sausage Bean Chowder
instructions: In a skillet cook pork sausage until brown. Pour off fat. In a large kettle combine kidney beans tomatoes water onion bay leaf salt garlic salt thyme and pepper. Add sausage. Simmer covered for 1 hour. Add potatoes and green pepper. Cook covered 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Remove bay leaf. Makes 8 generous portions.

title: Hot Bites
instructions: Bake 2 hours at 200\u00b0. Stir mix every 20 minutes. Stir 6 times.

title: Taffy(Swedish Style)
instructions: Place ingredients except flavoring and coloring into a 3-quart saucepan. Stir until sugar is partly dissolved then wipe sides down with a damp cloth to remove any crystals. Heat to rapidly boiling and cook briskly without stirring to 270\u00b0 (soft crack).

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together the sugar shortening eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Then blend in all the other ingredients reserving the bananas and chopped nuts for the last. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 to 40 minutes. It will make 2 loaves.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Beat milk and juice until well blended. Fold in well drained pineapple and other ingredients. Garnish and chill. May be frozen.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0 or until bubbly throughout.

title: Hash Brown Quiche
instructions: Press hash browns between paper towel to remove excess moisture. Press into the bottom and up the sides of an ungreased 9-inch pie plate. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix meat egg onion pepper bread crumbs and meat tenderizer; mix well. Add 1 cup 4 cheeses and 1/2 pasta saute. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven; drain. Add rest of pasta sauce. Bake 20 minutes longer; take out of oven and add 1/2 cup shredded cheese. Cover until melted. Serve.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Allow loaf of bread to thaw. Roll into a rectangular shape about 1/4-inch thick. Layer cheese and meat in center of dough. Spread drained pepper salad and mushrooms on top. Roll bread up like a jelly roll. Brush with beaten egg white and sprinkle sesame seed on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with commercial pasta sauce if desired. Serves 2.

title: Katherine Hepburn'S Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in heavy saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and beat like mad. Stir in flour salt and nuts. Mix well. Pour into a buttered 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. (If using molds spray with something like Pam; I use the spray instead of buttering the pan.) Remove; let cool. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares and dive right in.

title: Skillet Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Wash dry and season chicken.\tFlour chicken.\tDeep fry in skillet. While chicken is cooking make sauce 1 cup of ketchup 2 tablespoons of mustard two dashes of hot sauce sprinkle sugar and blend ingredients.\tAdd seasonings to taste. When chicken is done remove oil. Pour over chicken homemade barbecue sauce and 1 1/2 cups of water simmer for 30 minutes with lid over skillet.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs in baking dish. Add milk and chicken soup. Mix well. Add cheese and cracker crumbs then stir in cooked squash (drained). Add butter. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Swiss Steak Supreme
instructions: Pound 6 Tbsp. flour into sides of steak. Brown in hot fat. Add all ingredients. Cover cook over simmer heat or in oven until tender. 2 - 2 1/2 hours. Uncover the last 15 minutes and let sauce thicken.

title: Caramel Crispix Mix
instructions: Melt together first 5 ingredients and cook until glossy. Mix together the remaining ingredients with caramel mixture. Mix thoroughly. Spread into 2 (9 x 13-inch) baking dishes. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes to prevent popcorn from sticking together and to the pan.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix together. Put in a loaf pan. Can be frozen. Take out about 2 hours before serving. May also be placed in graham cracker crumb pie shell or baked pie crust.

title: Yummy Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Cook sugar Karo butter in glass bowl in microwave on high 3 minutes. Stir and cook 1 minute on high. Add vanilla and baking soda and stir. Pour over popcorn in paper bag. Shake well. Microwave on high for 1 1/2 minutes. Shake well. Microwave on high for 30 seconds. Spread on aluminum foil and let dry. All done.

title: Okra And Corn Casserole
instructions: Wash the okra and drain well. Place in skillet with 2 tablespoons of margarine and let it cook slowly stirring frequently until the sticky substance has disappeared. Cut corn from cob. Put okra and corn in alternate layers in a greased casserole sprinkling with salt and pepper as you go along.

title: Cheesy Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Magic Marshmallow Crescent Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Dip marshmallows in melted oleo and roll in sugar mixture. Wrap a crescent roll around each covering completely and pinching edges to seal. Dip in margarine and place in muffin tins. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until brown. Remove and drizzle with glaze. This is a great recipe for kids!

title: Pork Chops With Wild Rice
instructions: Combine rice and water in a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Salt and pepper pork chops to taste. Arrange on top of rice mixture. Bake covered 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0. Combine soup and milk. When casserole is done pour soup mixture over casserole. Return to oven uncovered and bake until soup is bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pineapple Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese with other ingredients until well blended. Chill. Great spread on crackers.

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Combine cream cheese egg sugar and salt then add chocolate bits and set aside. Sift together in bowl the flour sugar cocoa soda and salt. Add water vinegar oil and vanilla. Mix well. Fill muffin cups 1/3 full with chocolate batter. Top each one with a heaping teaspoonful of cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. If you dont want to make cupcakes you can put it in a cake pan and make a cake.

title: Louise'S Spoon Corn Bread
instructions: Mix water and corn meal and bring slowly to the boiling point. Cook five minutes. Add milk butter salt and well beaten eggs. Beat thoroughly and bake in a well-greased pan for 25 minutes in a moderately hot oven. Serve from same dish with a spoon.

title: Easy Salad
instructions: Mix jello and pineapple together. Fold in Cool Whip nuts and marshmallows. Chill. Will set up quickly.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In medium saucepan heat butter onion salt celery salt pepper and milk just to boiling. Stir in dry potato puffs and continue cooking until smooth stirring constantly. Garnish with paprika and parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: 24 Hour Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Combine vegetables. Heat vinegar sugar oil and spices. Pour over vegetables and toss and refrigerate for 24 hours. Toss before serving. Keeps in the refrigerator 9 days.

title: Spanish Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken; skin and debone. Cut cross grain into small pieces. Cut green onions onion bell pepper and garlic into small pieces. In large pot mix chicken soup mushroom soup Ro-Tel tomatoes tomato sauce French and Ranch dressing and dried celery. Heat to slow boil. Add slices of Velveeta and stir until thick. Saute green onions onion bell pepper and garlic. Cover bottom of dish with crushed Fritos and add layer of chicken; cover with sauce. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Cover top with Velveeta. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve while hot.

title: Karen'S Turkey Pasta Stuff
instructions: Cook the spaghetti as normal. Melt the margarine in a skillet; cook the turkey cutlets on each side. This only takes a few minutes. Take the turkey out and keep warm. If needed melt more margarine in skillet. Saute the peppers and mushrooms for a minute. Add the turkey. Cover and remove from heat. Make the Toscana sauce as directed on package.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix ingredients and knead like dough. Chill until very cold. Shape dough into walnut size balls. Melt 12 ounces chocolate chips with paraffin in top of double boiler. Insert a toothpick into dough ball and dip in the chocolate just enough to resemble a \buckeye\. These will keep well in metal containers in a freezer or refrigerator indefinitely.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
instructions: Place broccoli in water about 1 cup. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and cook until tender about 15 minutes. Remove and drain.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put in 9 x 13 baking dish.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes and mix all ingredients well. Top with 2 cups of Rice Krispies crumbs mixed with 4 tablespoons melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Mix 2 quarts boiling water sugar and lemon juice and cool. Mix all together with the pineapple juice pink lemonade strawberry daiquiri mix and 4 quarts of water. Put in gallon bags and freeze. Pour ginger ale on frozen mixture.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients including sugar. Make a well in the center. Add oil eggs water and pumpkin. Mix well with spoon (no mixer) and add nuts and/or raisins if desired. Pour into two greased bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Carrot Loaf
instructions: Place in a buttered casserole pan or a buttered mold. Set in a pan of hot water and bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) until firm about 45 minutes. Turn out of pan and surround with hot buttered peas.

title: Cara'S Taco Salad
instructions: Brown the hamburger; drain grease. Add the next 7 ingredients to hamburger. Mix with lettuce tomatoes green onions and nacho cheese chips. Put Cheddar cheese on top.

title: Waldorf Souffle Salad
instructions: Pour boiling water over gelatin dissolve. Add cold water mayonnaise lemon juice and salt. Beat at low speed until blended. Freeze about 25 minutes. Beat at moderate speed until fluffy. Fold in apples walnuts and celery. Turn into mold and refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine eggs sugar zucchini oil and vanilla together. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Lasagna
instructions: Mix together and cook 30 minutes the beef onion garlic basil salt tomatoes and tomato paste. Cook noodles and set aside. Mix cottage cheese eggs salt pepper parsley flakes and Parmesan cheese together. In 9 x 13 pan put 1/2 of the noodles in the bottom. Next put in 1/2 beef mixture then 1/2 cheese mixture then 1/2 Mozzarella cheese. Repeat process for second layer. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Serves 12.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix cranapple and pineapple juice. Just before serving add ginger ale and ice to this mixture. Serve in chilled punch bowl.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and melt butter. Add cooked onions and dressing and mix well. Put a layer of broccoli and a layer of dressing in baking dish. Pour soup over the top. Bake until it bubbles.

title: Dip For Fruit
instructions: Blend together cream cheese and powdered sugar. Spread on dish; top with caramel ice cream topping. Sprinkle with chopped walnuts. Delicious with sliced apples.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Drain juice from crushed pineapple. Melt 4 tablespoons margarine in a 9-inch round deep pan. Add light brown sugar and the drained pineapple. Leave on a low fire until mixture bubbles. Pour cake mixture over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Grandma Dye'S Mini Meat Loaves With Vegetables
instructions: Combine meat salt egg 1/2 can tomato sauce seasoning and 1/2 can onions in 9 x 13-inch dish. Form 3 loaves. Place potatoes around mini loaves. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Place vegetables around loaves and mix with potatoes. Lightly season with salt and pepper. Top with remaining tomato sauce. Bake uncovered 15 minutes. Top with 1/2 onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Artichoke Spinach Casserole
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup butter (softened) cream cheese and Parmesan cheese. Mix with artichokes and spinach. Fold in egg whites. Put in 2-quart casserole. Melt remaining 1/4 cup butter. Mix with herbed stuffing mix. Put on top of casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook onions in butter for 20 minutes; add broth and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Wassail Bowl
instructions: Heat the apple cider with 1 cinnamon stick in large pan. Bring to boil; simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Add the nutmeg honey lemon juice and pineapple juice. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Float baked oranges in punch bowl. Serve hot. Good in cold weather and for holidays.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together and let stand in jar in refrigerator several hours or overnight before using.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cut shortening and sugar together. Add baking powder salt extract milk and flour. Add eggs one at a time. Grease pan. Pour in batter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Joanie'S Pizzelles
instructions: Beat eggs well gradually add sugar and beat. Add oleo and beat until smooth. Add anise oil a few drops at a time mixing well. Add flour slowly mixing well. Add salt and whiskey blending well. Refrigerate batter several hours. (If desired batter can be refrigerated overnight or several days to enrich flavor.) Bake in a pizzelle baker.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl pour boiling water over bran. Add melted butter. Add rest of ingredients and mix thoroughly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Batter will keep 6 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Lima Bean Pot
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Brown sausage and remove. Drain pot and saute onion green pepper and celery. Put all ingredients into pressure cooker and cook for 25 minutes. Let pressure drop on its own.

title: Holiday Poke Cake
instructions: Prepare bake and cool cake mix as directed on package. When cake is cool pierce cake with large fork at 1/2 inch intervals. Stir 1 cup of boiling water into each flavor of gelatin in separate bowls for 2 minutes or until dissolved. Carefully pour red gelatin over cake then pour green gelatin over cake allowing it to go in the fork holes. Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve and then put on the frosting.

title: Sauerbraten (Or Beef Stroganoff)
instructions: Score meat by pushing a knife through it at an approximate right angle to the meat fibers in rows about 1-inch apart. Turn and score the other side making slits between those already made. Place slices of garlic deeply into the meat. Place meat on wax paper and dredge well with 5 or 6 tablespoons whole wheat flour. The floured surface will brown as readily without fat as with it. Place meat in a large skillet or Dutch oven. Brown meat well on both sides; keep heat moderate taking approximately 20 minutes. Place onions celery tops vinegar water salt and pepper around it and simmer slowly for 3 1/2 to 5 hours adding water if needed until very tender. Place in deep serving platter. Remove any fat and cut or slice into serving size pieces. Remove fat from broth. Increase broth with water to approximately 2 cups. Add the chopped parsley. Mix the oil and flour together and spoon in some of the broth until it is thin enough to add to the broth in the pan. Stir over low heat until the broth is thickened. Sprinkle the instant powdered milk over the gravy and stir in. Taste for salt. Spoon the gravy over and around the meat or serve in a separate bowl. Serve with small steamed red potatoes sprinkled with chopped parsley and mixed vegetables or a mixed vegetable salad.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Blend together sugar and butter. Add egg yolks and vanilla. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes scraping sides of bowl. Stir in flour one cup at a time blending until stiff dough forms.

title: Peanut Butter Temptations
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter and both sugars together. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour soda and salt. Blend into creamed mixture to make a dough. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and place into ungreased miniature muffin pans. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove pan from oven and press a peanut butter cup into center of each cookie until only the top of the cup shows. Let cool for 10 minutes then remove from muffin tin. Store in airtight container. Makes 80 cookies.

title: Bran Banana Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Spray Pam in muffin tin. In medium-sized bowl sift together flour Sweet N Low baking powder and salt. Stir in the bran cereal.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: Sift the first 5 ingredients. Combine egg milk and oil; mix well and add to flour mixture. Mix just until moistened. Add grated apple. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Dip muffin tops in the melted margarine then in 1/2 cup sugar with the cinnamon.

title: Bohemian Nut Slices
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on warm water. Let stand 10 minutes. Sift flour and salt. Cut in butter; blend in yolks and yeast. Mix until a smooth ball is formed. Beat egg whites until stiff gradually add 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla.

title: Cool As A Cucumber Pickle(No Heat)
instructions: In a large mouth gallon jar or crock pack as may cucumbers as you can get. Make a brine of the salt alum and pickling spices. Cover the cucumbers with apple cider vinegar. Put lid on tightly and let set for 6 weeks.

title: Cream Cheese Crescent Bake
instructions: In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan or dish spread 1 package crescent rolls butter side down. Stretch rolls to fit. Then mix cream cheese sugar and egg. Beat well. Spread over rolls. Then spread the other tube of crescent rolls butter side up on top of mixture. Stretch to fit. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top. You can add a can of cherry pie filling on top if desired.

title: Homemade Fudge Brownies
instructions: Grease a 10 x 7-inch pan with butter. Melt 1 stick of butter. Combine sugar flour and cocoa. Add eggs and vanilla. Add melted butter next. Add 1 cup of nuts if desired. Pour into pan and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Do not preheat oven.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Chop coarse scallion parsley tarragon capers and sun-dried tomatoes. Put salmon fillets through meat grinder or food processor on slow speed not too fine. Blend eggs and heavy cream slowly into coarse salmon meat one egg at a time with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon. Add chopped ingredients. Mix well. Add juice of lemon salt and pepper to your own taste.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Wash and sort beans soak in water overnight. The following morning simmer the beans 1 hour. Mix together salt onions dry mustard molasses ketchup and add to beans. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 6 to 7 hours. Put bacon on top. Water may have to be added during baking. Serves 6 - 8 people.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Bake brownies in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool slightly and sprinkle with Kahlua.

title: Baked Brie Appetizer
instructions: Put the Brie in a baking dish. Melt butter and pour over Brie. Sprinkle almonds over the top. Sprinkle brown sugar over the nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove to a serving dish surrounded by crackers. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Oriental Entree
instructions: *Soak chicken breast overnight in 3 tablespoons soy sauce 1/2 clove minced garlic and 1/2 cup oil. Drain before using.

title: Easy Turkey Lasagna
instructions: Combine Make a Better Burger with water. In skillet brown turkey; stir in sauce. Alternately layer noodles cheese and sauce until 3 layers are made. Cover; bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut bacon into smaller pieces and fry. Mix all ingredients and put in a 1-quart casserole. Bake 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Healthy Soup
instructions: Simmer first 7 ingredients in a large stock pot with 3 quarts of water until chicken is fork-tender. Cool. Refrigerate. Remove all fat from surface of chicken stock. Remove bones from chicken. Set meat to side. Remove and throw away any vegetables you dont want. Use this stock and meat in combination with noodles rice or vegetables for the healthiest soup possible.

title: Cookie Orson'S Corn
instructions: Saute the first 4 ingredients in a small amount of butter. Add corn cheese and salt. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Karo Pie
instructions: Mix well. Bake in unbaked pie shells. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 45 minutes or until filling is set. Will make 2 (8-inch) pies.

title: Easy Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the cheese. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle on cheese. Bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Saute celery green pepper and onion in oil in saucepan until tender. Sprinkle with flour curry powder Worcestershire sauce Tabasco sauce and salt. Cook for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Stir in cream cheese until melted. Add milk gradually. Cook until thickened stirring constantly; remove from heat. Stir in shrimp. Spoon into shallow 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with mixture of crumbs butter and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until bubbly and light brown. Yield 6 servings.

title: Caramel Oatmeal Chewies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine oats flour brown sugar soda and salt; mix well. Stir in margarine mixing until well blended. Reserve 1 cup; press remaining onto bottom of prepared pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown; cool 10 minutes. Top with nuts and chocolate pieces. Mix caramel topping and 1/4 cup flour until smooth; drizzle over chocolate pieces to within 1/4-inch of pan edges. Sprinkle with reserved oat mixture. Bake an additional 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown. Cool; chill until set. Makes about 32 bars.

title: Rice Trovato
instructions: Mix all together in a covered casserole for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mash Potato Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes for mash. Mix together butter milk and potatoes until smooth; let cool. When mixture is cool add hard-boiled eggs celery relish onion and Miracle Whip; mix until creamy.

title: Chow-Chow Relish
instructions: Chop tomatoes onions and sweet green peppers and sprinkle with salt. Let stand 4 to 6 hours in cool place. Drain well; add hot peppers vinegar sugar salt and spices tied in thin cloth bag. Simmer 15 minutes. Remove spice bag. Pack into hot jars. Close. Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes. Begin counting time as soon as water returns to boiling.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix the ingredients. Stores in refrigerator for months.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). Melt chips and butter. Stir in graham crumbs and nuts. Press 1/2 of crumbs on bottom of greased pan (13 x 9-inch). In mixing bowl beat the cream cheese until fluffy. Add milk vanilla and egg; mix well. Pour on top of crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Drain and rinse peppers; remove seeds and chop finely. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Blend in milk. Stir in corn bread mix cheese corn oil sugar and baking powder. Stir in peppers and pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Strawberries Romanoff
instructions: Toss strawberries with sugar and set aside. Slightly whip the ice cream. Fold in the heavy cream and Cointreau. Fold in the strawberries and serve in dessert dishes. Garnish each dish with a whole fresh strawberry and sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar. Serve immediately.

title: Carbinera
instructions: Brown sausage until almost done; drain. Add ham and keep warm. Cook spaghetti and drain.

title: Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Put shortening or margarine into a bowl with the white sugar and mix then add 2 eggs and mix. Add your milk and salt; mix. Sift your two cups of flour and your baking powder into bowl. Add your raisins and your cut up gumdrops. Add lemon flavoring to add taste. When you are all done put it in a 9 x 13-inch pan and cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes then at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Place beans tomato onion tops onion cheese and olives in a large salad bowl; add lettuce to fill bowl. Right before serving add dressing and avocados and top with Fritos.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugars. Add eggs. Sift together the flour soda salt and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture. Mix in chocolate chips and add vanilla. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Microwave Lasagne
instructions: Crumble meat into 1 1/2-quart casserole (or microwavable colander). Cook on High 5 to 6 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Drain; stir in tomatoes tomato paste salt basil oregano garlic and water. Cover; cook on High 4 to 5 minutes until mixture begins to boil. Combine cottage cheese egg Parmesan cheese and parsley; pour 1 1/2 cups tomato mixture into 12 x 8-inch dish. Spread evenly. Place 4 uncooked noodles over sauce. Top with 1/2 cottage cheese mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 Mozzarella cheese. Spoon 1 cup sauce over cheese then repeat layers. Top with remaining sauce. Cover tightly with 2 layers of plastic wrap. Cook on High 15 minutes then 30% power for 15 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Summer Ice Cream Punch
instructions: For each serving pour 1/2 cup pineapple-orange juice into a 10 ounce glass. Add about 1/4 cup ginger ale. Top with a scoop of sherbet or ice cream. Makes 12 (10 ounce) servings.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Mix in Karo syrup sugar margarine vanilla and salt. Add pecans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fun Punch
instructions: Mix all together in punch bowl. Tastes great!

title: Tiger Butter
instructions: Mix white chocolate and peanut butter together and pour onto wax paper. Spoon melted chocolate over white chocolate mixture and marbleize with knife. Let cool; break into pieces or cut into squares. Melt chocolates in microwave oven. Very easy and delicious.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix soup with 1/2 cup water per can. Pour over chicken. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 until chicken is done.

title: Meal In A Pot
instructions: Brown ground beef chopped bacon and small onion and drain. Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot. Cook on low. Can be prepared in the morning and cooked all day.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Beat pudding and milk until thick. Add sour cream and Cool Whip. Put 1/2 of Cool Whip in pudding and 1/2 on top. Add vanilla wafers and bananas as much as you like.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain water excess. Add Cheez Whiz and mix well over medium heat. Add rice and other ingredients until thoroughly blended. Bake in 2-quart casserole dish for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Beat eggs in bowl. Mix in sugar and milk. Blend all ingredients together and pour into glass pan (13 x 9-inch). Top with nutmeg. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Layered Club Salad
instructions: In a large salad bowl layer lettuce tomatoes peas chicken bacon and green onions. Spread mayonnaise on top. Makes 8 servings.

title: Baked Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Melt in shallow pan the margarine plus cooking oil. Beat the egg with a little milk. Add salt and pepper. Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs. Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture then in crumb mixture. Arrange in buttered pan. Allow to stand 10 to 15 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour turning once. For a special dish bone chicken breasts and proceed with recipe. Shorten baking time to 30 minutes.

title: Rolls
instructions: Dissolve 1 package yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in 1/4 cup of luke warm water. Let stand a few minutes.

title: Ambrosia Mold Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; save juices. Add cold water to juice to measure 1 cup. Stir 2 cups boiling water into Jell-O. (Stir until all dissolved.) Stir in other liquid (juice and water). Refrigerate until mixture slightly jells.

title: Macaroni Pie
instructions: Boil macaroni until almost tender in salted water. Rinse in cold water. Drain. Beat eggs; add milk. Pour over macaroni in baking dish. Add chipped cheese; stir. Garnish with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 9-inch glass pie plate. Spread sauerkraut in 9-inch glass pie plate. Top with tomato slices and dot with dressing. Cover with corned beef. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with mixture of crackers caraway seed and melted margarine. Return to oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Cut in wedges to serve.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash together sweet potatoes sugar and butter. Add cinnamon and nutmeg. (Taste and add more seasoning if you like.) Add coconut and pecans. Put into baking dish; top with coconut. Bake in moderate oven until warmed through and coconut is light brown.

title: Cheesy Hash Browns
instructions: Combine and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (9 x 13-inch dish). Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Mary'S Meatless Lasagna
instructions: Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water. Set aside. Saute the onions and garlic in skillet sprayed with Pam. Stir in the tomato spices parsley and salt. Cook sauce about 1/2 hour simmering and stirring often until thickened. Stir in sauteed mushrooms and cooked beans. To assemble lasagna place a layer of noodles on the bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Spread 1/2 of tomato mix over noodles then layer cheeses. Repeat 2 times and end with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 15 servings.

title: Margie'S Caesar Salad
instructions: In small bowl squeeze lemon; press garlic. Add Worcestershire sauce dressing plus sugar salt and pepper. Mix together with fork or whisk. If desired substitute less oil for Ranch dressing plus a tablespoon of water. Pour over lettuce and cut into pieces. Sprinkle Parmesan; add croutons and toss. Serve 6 to 8.

title: Kid-Pleasin' Cupcakes
instructions: Grease muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. In a large mixing bowl stir together flour pudding mix chocolate pieces sugar baking powder and salt.

title: Microwave Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Combine sugar margarine syrup and salt in a 2-quart baking dish. Bring to a boil. Cook on High for 2 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir in soda. Put popped corn in brown grocery bag and pour mixture over corn. Close bag and shake. Cook in bag on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Shake and cook another 1 1/2 minutes. Shake and cook for 1 minute. Spread out to cool. Store tightly covered.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Chill and serve.

title: Chocolate Float
instructions: Boil 1 cup sugar and 2 cups water for 10 minutes. Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Add vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture alternating with milk. Mix well. Pour hot syrup into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Drop batter by spoonfuls into syrup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream and top with nuts.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Crumble cornbread and light bread in a bowl. May use old biscuits in place of light bread. Add salt pepper sage boiled eggs onions and celery. Mix well and add chicken broth and milk. May need more broth. Place in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Apple Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 18 muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. In large bowl combine all ingredients; stir only until all ingredients are blended. Spoon equal portions into prepared muffin cups. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool 1 minute. Remove from muffin cups. Top with Apple Cinnamon Glaze. Serve warm.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg together. Add milk flour baking powder and salt. Mix well and stir in washed drained blueberries. Pour into 8-inch or 9-inch baking dish which has been greased and floured.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
instructions: Soften gelatin with cold water; dissolve over hot water and cool. Whip the whipping cream and add sugar cream cheese and salad dressing. Add gelatin and fold in pineapple and cherries. Put in oiled salad ring or individual oiled molds.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Boil spaghetti and drain. Add salad dressing Salad Supreme red onion and green pepper. Mix altogether and marinate overnight.

title: Golden Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients into bowl. Add egg milk and shortening. Beat until smooth about 1 minute. Do not overbeat. Bake in greased 8-inch square pan or muffin pans at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef. Drain. Stir in seasoning mix water and olives. Simmer 5 minutes. Separate biscuits. Place in ungreased 9 or 10-inch pie pan. Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust. Sprinkle 1 cup corn chips over bottom of crust. Spoon meat mixture over crust and corn chips. Spread sour cream over meat. Cover with cheese. Sprinkle remaining chips over top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until brown. May serve topped with lettuce and/or avocado slices.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook pork and chicken well done. Remove all fat. Save broth. Peel meat off in small strips. Cook potatoes; drain and set aside. (Dont overcook potatoes.) Put meat peas catsup salt pepper hot sauce and sugar in pork broth and cook as long as desired. When almost done add cooked potatoes and corn. Simmer until flavor is cooked in. If too thin add cornstarch. If too thick add chicken broth water or tomato juice.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour shortening and salt until it crumbles. Add water. Makes 2 small or 1 large crust.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix cream cheese and dry dressing mix together and spread 1 tablespoon of mixture over flat tortillas. Place chopped veggies across center and roll up. Eat whole or cut up into pieces. Top with salsa or taco sauce. This makes a great appetizer.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Beat eggs; add oil and mix in dry ingredients. Cook in muffin tin sprayed with Pam at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Carrot Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients into mixing bowl stir well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 15 minutes at 400 degrees bake additional 45 minutes at 350 degrees until firm filling. Cool.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions and garlic. Add thyme and add hot brown stock.

title: Beef-Stuffed Green Peppers(From 1975 Edition)
instructions: Cut green peppers in halves lengthwise; remove seeds. Cook in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; invert and drain. Combine salt pepper Worcestershire sauce oats egg 1/3 cup catsup onion and ground beef mixing thoroughly. Pack about 1/2 cup of beef mixture into each pepper half. Place peppers in 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Top each pepper with 2 teaspoons of catsup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables in the water until tender. Stir in all remaining ingredients except cheese. Cook until thoroughly heated. Servings of soup may be sprinkled with cheese. Serves 6.

title: Madeira Chicken
instructions: Filet the breasts. Pound thin between plastic. Dredge with seasoned flour. Set aside.

title: Mexi-Chips
instructions: You will need 1 pair tongs or spatula.

title: Blender Salad
instructions: Put jello into blender; add near boiling water. Turn on blender to mix and dissolve. Add cheese marshmallows and pineapple (in this order) blending as you add. Pour this into 1-quart bowl and refrigerate until mixture is partly thickened. Stir in the topping and return to refrigerator until needed.

title: Fried Rice Oriental
