instructions: Saute onions lightly; add rice and meat. Add chestnuts and almonds. Add eggs and soy sauce.

title: Rice Griddle Cakes
instructions: Mix rice milk butter well-beaten egg and salt. Gradually add and stir in the well-sifted flour and baking powder. Mix well. Spoon out and bake on hot slightly greased griddle.

title: Coconut Pecan Frosting
instructions: Combine milk sugar egg yolks butter and vanilla. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened about 12 minutes. Add coconut and pecans. Cook until thick enough to spread beating occasionally.

title: Creamy Pecan Pralines
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients over medium heat until mixture reaches firm ball stage. Remove from heat. Add next three ingredients and stir until mixture loses its gloss and is partially cooled. Pour out with spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Peach Delight
instructions: In a 9 x 12-inch pan arrange the peach slices which have been cut in half. Pour all but 2 tablespoons of peach juice over the slices. Mix the remaining 2 tablespoons of juice thoroughly with cake mix. Sprinkle all but 1/2 cup of cake mix very evenly over peaches. Sprinkle the pecans evenly on top of the mix. Then sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of mix over pecans. Drizzle the melted butter over the ingredients. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour or until golden brown. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant drain combine with onions milk 3/4 cup cheese salt pepper and crackers. Put in greased casserole and top with 1/4 cup cheese. Beat eggs with fork and pour over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until light brown.

title: Crescent Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: Roll out one package of crescent rolls and put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat cream cheese sugar egg yolk and vanilla. Spread over crescents. Roll out the other package of crescents and place over this. Beat the egg white and spread over the top layer of crescents. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Coconut Apple Crunch
instructions: Combine milk 1 package coconut cream pudding and sliced apples. Put in an 8-inch greased pan. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 until apples are tender and it is brown.

title: Lime Pear Salad
instructions: Set cream cheese out to soften. Drain pears and mash. Add enough water to pear juice to make 2 cups. Bring liquid to a boil.

title: Irish Potato Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter and add potatoes water and salt. Cook until potatoes are tender. Either mash or put in blender with the hot milk. Slowly blend into mixture the cold milk and beaten yolk. Add pepper and parsley. Do not boil. Serve with sharp Cheddar cheese grated.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake as instructed on box in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan; set aside and cool completely. Spread cherry pie filling on top of cake. Mix together thoroughly cream cheese Cool Whip sugar and milk. Pour over the cherry pie filling. Chill in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Rice Krispies Snacks
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and butterscotch chips in a large saucepan over low heat stirring until smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows Rice Krispies and peanuts. Pour/press into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with coconut. Refrigerate until firm. Store at room temperature.

title: Old Fashioned Gingerbread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until light and fluffy. Add molasses and oil. Mix well. Sift together flour soda baking powder and spices. Add to molasses mixture and stir well. Stir in boiling water. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip or Lemon Sauce (recipe follows).

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: This should be prepared in advance and refrigerated tightly covered overnight. Bake just before serving. Flavor is improved by advance preparation.

title: Quick Cheese Cake Pie
instructions: Set cream cheese out to soften. Mix milk with instant pudding. Mix either with wire whisk or electric mixer. Add softened cream cheese and pour into crumb crust.

title: California Casserole
instructions: Take frozen vegetables and mix together vegetables sour cream onion and cheese also the soup. Pour into casserole dish and cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or microwave for 15 minutes.

title: Salsa - Medium Hot
instructions: Chop the first 4 ingredients finely. Add the remaining ingredients. Heat 10 minutes and chill.

title: Cloud Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix shortening with sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Sift together the flour cream of tartar and baking soda; add to batter. Blend well.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Preheat oven and bake cake mix using package directions. Make holes in hot cake with wooden spoon handle. Mix condensed milk and cream of coconut in a bowl. Pour over hot cake. Cool. Combine Cool Whip and coconut in a bowl. Mix well. Spread over cake. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Pink Lassie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender and process on \stir\ until well blended. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix milk and Cool Whip. Add lemon juice and lemon flavor if desired. Cool in fridge 2 hours.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Prepare broccoli as directed on package. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Chop and boil the potatoes. Cook bacon; do not drain grease. Beat eggs sugar and vinegar together until light and fluffy. Pour over bacon and cook until boiling and thick. Pour over potatoes and serve while warm.

title: Chocolate Mint Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine and chocolate in saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat. Blend in sugar. Let cool slightly.

title: Oyster Casserole
instructions: Combine saltines with all seasonings and line a shallow casserole with 1/2 of mixture. Mix oysters egg and mushroom soup pour over saltines. Cover with\tremaining saltine crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peppy Pizza Pies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets with shortening using paper towel. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Place 5 biscuits 3 inches apart on each cookie sheet. Press biscuits out to form 4 to 5-inch circles. Spread 1 tablespoon pizza sauce on each circle. Top each with pepperoni and Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over each. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until crust is brown and cheese is melted. Serve right away.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Spread the crescent rolls on the bottom of a small cookie sheet. Cook as directed on package or until lightly browned. Cool. Mix Miracle Whip Ranch and cream cheese together and spread over the crust on cookie sheet. Sprinkle the rest of the veggies over the cream cheese mixture leaving the sharp Cheddar cheese as the last ingredient.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix all ingredients together. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Cook about 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Romaine Spinach Orange Salad
instructions: Cook and stir almonds and sugar in skillet over low heat until sugar is melted and nuts are coated and brown. Cool. Combine greens; add oranges. Top with nuts. Serve with Romaine Spinach Orange Salad Dressing.

title: Chicken Biscuit Stew
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt margarine in 10-inch ovenproof skillet. Stir in flour and pepper. Cook 1 minute until smooth and bubbly stirring constantly. Gradually stir in chicken broth and milk. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add chicken onion peas and carrots. Cook until hot and bubbly. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Arrange biscuits over hot chicken mixture. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shell and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Cajun Pickles
instructions: Discard the liquid from pickles. Add remaining ingredients. You may have to wait for some sugar to dissolve before adding rest of the sugar. Refrigerate for 3 days before serving.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Add all ingredients except spinach to a saucepan. Boil 1 or 2 minutes. Cool but do not refrigerate. Wash and tear spinach into pieces. Drizzle dressing over spinach when ready to serve.

title: Banana Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix by hand all ingredients together. Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool completely before removing from pan.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar Milnot and vanilla; cook for 8 minutes. Add butter. When butter is melted remove from heat and add chocolate chips and marshmallow cream. Mix well until well blended and creamy. Pour into buttered pan to cool.

title: Velveeta Goulash
instructions: Saute hamburger meat and onion until brown then cook seashells as directed on package. Add Velveeta Ro-Tel tomatoes and milk; cook until cheese is melted.

title: Tuna Rocks
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Heat and serve on toast.

title: Apricot Mousse
instructions: Advance preparation Combine apricots sugar vanilla extract and dash of salt. Whip cream until custardlike; fold into apricot mixture. Turn into a 3-cup refrigerator tray; freeze until firm about 4 hours. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Easy Argo Gravy
instructions: Pour off all but 2 tablespoons fat drippings from roasting pan. Add broth or water. Cook over medium heat stirring to loosen browned bits. Remove from heat.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Add ginger ale when ready to serve. Serves 25.

title: To Freeze Corn
instructions: Cut corn off the cob. Mix corn sugar and water in saucepan. Cook 5 minutes. Cool and freeze.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into two 9-inch greased and floured pie pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes its own crust.

title: Please-The-Cook Cookies
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff. Add brown sugar gradually beating constantly. Add nuts and stir. Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from sheet and cool. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Spinach Dip For Hollowed Out Bread
instructions: Cut top of bread off; cut out inside of bread to form bowl. Use top and inside to make wedges to spread dip on. You will probably need to double recipe for most loaves.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour; add sugar and salt. Mix together egg and evaporated milk; add to flour mixture and mix well. Chill in refrigerator overnight if possible before rolling out. If you dont want to make this many pies at one time you may shape into balls and roll each in a circle onto a square of waxed paper. Stack them with a section of wax paper between each circle and then freeze in tight container. As you want to serve up a few fresh hot fried pies remove as many circles as you like and allow to thaw on its own wax paper. Put your fruit on 1/2 of the circle and fold over. Be sure the crust is thawed before attempting to fold or you will break it. Seal the edges and deep fry in hot oil. This is important. Turn only once and drain on paper towels.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Cook onion in pan with Pam. Add beef. Cook until browned. Add drained beans and soup. Pour into greased casserole. Spoon mashed potatoes over top. (Add a bit of grated onion to potatoes if desired.) Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk in saucepan and cook to soft ball stage. Remove from heat.

title: Breaded Tofu Cutlets
instructions: Drain water and cut each piece of tofu lengthwise then crosswise. Place between absorbent paper towels and allow to dry for several minutes. Gently dust tofu one piece at a time with flour then dip in egg and roll in bread crumbs. Allow to dry for 10 to 15 minutes; top off an excess crumbs.

title: Best Ever Meat Loaf
instructions: Break eggs into large mixing bowl; beat slightly with fork. Add milk salt pepper and crumbled bread. Beat until bread has disintegrated. Add onion carrot cheese and beef; mix well. Pack into a loaf pan. Combine brown sugar catsup and mustard. Spread over surface of loaf. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Let stand for 10 minutes. Lift the loaf out. Slice and serve.

title: Apple Pizza
instructions: Measure the flour sugar and cinnamon into small bowl. Mix well. Press or roll biscuits into flat circles and place on lightly greased (or Pam spray) cookie sheet. Use tablespoon to depress center of biscuits to form pizza-like crust. Lightly sprinkle brown sugar mixture on biscuits. Spoon grated apples on biscuits then sprinkle with grated cheese if desired. Top with more of the brown sugar mixture and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage and onions in small amount of water (do not overcook). Put in vegetable oil cream of celery soup sugar and salt and pepper to taste. Put in casserole dish and cover with Pepperidge Farm herbal stuffing with 1 stick margarine. Bake until bubbly and golden brown at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Cream first 2 ingredients together well. Sift next 4 ingredients together and add alternately with next ingredient. Follow Solomons advice for making a good boy Proverbs 2314. Add next 3 ingredients. Fold in beaten yolks and stiffly beaten whites carefully.

title: Cinnamon Hard Candy
instructions: Boil sugar water and Karo syrup in a heavy pan to 300\u00b0 (hard crack stage); add oil and color. Remove from heat. Line cookie pan with aluminum foil. Pour in candy and place in freezer. When set break in pieces and toss in powdered sugar.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Mix pie filling and pineapple in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts over top of filling. Dump dry cake mix on top and spread evenly. Slice butter and place evenly on top of cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour or until golden brown.

title: Christmas Ribbon Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add ginger ale and lemon juice. Pour into 4-quart glass baking dish or mold. Chill until slightly thickened. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill until almost firm.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. May freeze if desired (may leave bananas out).

title: Onion Salad Dressing
instructions: In blender mix first 7 ingredients. Slowly add oil. Most of the time I also add some catsup. Blend.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Drain peas. Toss together the desired amounts of all ingredients and serve.

title: Pie Pastry
instructions: Cut lard and flour into small balls. Add water and salt and mix. Roll out dough 1/8-inch thick. Spread over and pat into desired size pie pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
instructions: Beat the cream cheese and sugar. Spray or butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Unroll crescent rolls but dont separate. Press onto bottom of pan. Spread cream cheese mixture over crust. Place second can of rolls on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream until fluffy oleo oil sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Add alternately with 7-Up to mixture. Grease pan or use Pam spray to coat pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes using tube or Bundt pan.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch Icing
instructions: In top of double boiler combine eggs sugar water and tartar. Cook over boiling water for 7 minutes or until holds in peaks while beating constantly with rotary egg beater. Remove; beat until cool. Sprinkle with crushed peanut brittle over top of frosted cake.

title: Wilma'S Christmas Candy
instructions: Mix buttermilk sugar and soda together in saucepan. Cook until brown and forms a soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add vanilla and butter. Beat until glossy. Add pecan meats; stir until thick. Spoon out onto wax paper and cool.

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl with electric mixer beat butter well; blend in brown sugar egg yolk and vanilla. By hand mix in flour 2/3 cup Heath bars and nuts. Press into ungreased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jellyroll pan. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until browned. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle remaining Heath bars over top. Cool slightly; cut into bars while warm.

title: Fabulous Fruit Cup
instructions: Combine pudding mix with fruit and juice in bowl. Blend in sour cream. Spoon into individual dessert dishes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 6 hours. Check after 4 hours. Mash with potato masher.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together corn bread mix eggs sour cream and margarine. Fold in the corns. Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch or casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until lightly brown. Remove from oven and sprinkle with shredded cheese.

title: Sweet Potato Surprise
instructions: Add potatoes and cream. Be careful not to use too much cream. Add sugar salt beaten egg and coconut. Let stand until cool. Press a marshmallow into the center of a portion of potato mixture and form into a ball. Roll in bread crumbs and fry in deep oil. Drain on paper towels and serve while still hot.

title: Jello-Cottage Salad
instructions: Mix dry jello with cottage cheese. Add pineapple and oranges. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill overnight before serving.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Let pie shell chill while making the filling. Blend eggs sugar salt vanilla and almond extract. Gradually stir in scalded milk. Pour into chilled unbaked pie shell. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: In a saucepan mix the sugar cocoa margarine and milk. Heat to boiling. Boil gently for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Beat in peanut butter vanilla and oatmeal. When blended drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper to cool.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Drain tuna. Make cream of mushroom soup as directed on can. Break up tuna and mix well in soup. Cook noodles as directed on package. Put in peas. Drain noodles. Pour mixture over noodles. Place in slightly greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package. Rinse in cold water. Add mayonnaise ranch dressing diced tomatoes black olives salt pepper and crumbled bacon. Mix well. Chill for 1 hour or longer.

title: Peach Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 10-inch tube pan with 2 tablespoons butter. Sprinkle pan with 1/4 cup sugar. Cream remaining butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add vanilla. Combine 2 3/4 cups flour baking powder and salt. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Beat well. Dredge peaches with remaining flour. Fold peaches into batter and pour into tube pan. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Salted Pecans
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet; add pecans and salt. Stir well to coat pecans; remove from heat. Place pecans in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Yields 4 cups.

title: Corn Beef Log
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with hand mixer. Roll into a log and pat on chopped nuts.

title: Aunt Debbie'S Cloverleaf Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl. Add sugar shortening egg salt and half the flour; beat at low speed of electric mixer until smooth. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough. Place dough in a greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place free from drafts 1 hour or until doubled in bulk.

title: Cherry Squares
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar creaming at medium speed until light and fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each. At low speed add flour and vanilla. Pour into well-greased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with sides. Spread batter evenly. Mark off into 48 squares. Place one/two cherries with a little filling into middle of each square. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cut while warm. When cool sift confectioners sugar over top.

title: Robbie'S Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix with hands all ingredients except chocolate chips. Press into a cookie sheet. Melt chocolate chips and spread over top of base. Cut into squares when hard.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel and cook potatoes until soft. Mash with onion salt and sour cream. Add butter to mixture. Place in 2-quart casserole dish and top with cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop all ingredients in blender. Add cream cheese and Accent to mixture. Shape into large ball. Wrap and refrigerate. Let set for several hours before serving.

title: Apple And Sweet Potato Dish
instructions: Slice sweet potato and apples very thin. Layer sprinkle cinnamon and dot with butter over each layer. Cook in microwave or conventional oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Amish Swiss Steak
instructions: Pound flour into steak. Season with salt and pepper. Brown in oil on both sides. Place in roasting pan. Slice 3 to 4 onions over meat. Pour bottle of ketchup over top and fill water in roaster to cover meat. Bake for 3 to 3 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Ingredients make a delicious gravy. I serve with mashed potatoes and tossed salad.

title: White Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar cream milk butter corn syrup and salt in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture reaches a boil. Boil 9 or 10 minutes (soft ball). Remove from heat and let stand until lukewarm. Add vanilla and beat until mixture begins to lose its gloss. (Requires little beating.) Quickly stir in walnuts and cherries. Turn into oiled pans. Let stand until firm. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Whip up instant pudding using 3 cups milk. When it is thick fold in Cool Whip. Line oblong pan with a layer of graham crackers. Pour half the pudding mixture over crackers. Put another layer of graham crackers over poured pudding and pour remaining pudding mixture over these crackers. Cover with another layer of graham crackers and chill overnight. Before serving frost cake with chocolate frosting (ready made).

title: Broccoli Omelet
instructions: Beat eggs in a bowl until light and fluffy. Stir in broccoli onion 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese milk salt basil and garlic powder. Pour into ungreased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese on top and place tomato wedges on top. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 until set 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Tomato Starter
instructions: Combine soups water and herbs in a large saucepan. Simmer 2 minutes. Dot with butter. Top each cupful with toasted saltine and a bit of parsley.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Butter casserole pan; mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until lightly brown.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake 2 hours at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0.

title: Sweet N' Sour Meatballs
instructions: Soak bread in bouillon. Mash bread into meat. Pour barbecue sauce and sweet n sour into frying pan and mix thoroughly. Form meat into 1-inch balls and dip into cold sauce. Heat sauce on low heat and cook meatballs turning until all sides are cooked. Simmer in sauce for about 2 hours or until sauce has become thick dark and glazed. Stir occasionally. Drain off fat. May be frozen and reheated.

title: Turkey Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain if necessary. Place in bottom of casserole dish. Mix together onion soup and drained vegetables. Place in casserole. Top with hash browns. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hash browns are done and casserole is heated through.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix sugar butter salt egg and vinegar. Add coconut pecans and raisins. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Where'S The Beef?
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add 3 dashes of Tabasco. Place in buttered 11 x 7 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Devil Dogs
instructions: Sift together flour salt soda cocoa sugar and baking powder. Add milk shortening and egg (nutmeats if desired). Batter will be cake like. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes. Can be frosted sandwiched or plain. Kids love them.

title: Cranberry Dessert
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar until light. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Fold in chopped nuts. Spread over crumb layer.

title: Salmon Log Roll
instructions: Drain and flake salmon; remove all bones. Combine salmon with next 6 ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Chill for one day. Then mold by hand in a log shape and roll in pecans salt and parsley mixture. Make design on top of log roll with sliced green olives with pimento centers and surround log roll on tray with fresh parsley to accent same.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Melt caramels and 1/4 cup evaporated milk. Keep warm. Mix cake mix butter and 3/4 cup evaporated milk. Place a little less than half the cake mixture in a greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Pour melted caramels over cake and sprinkle nuts and chips on top. Spread other half of cake mixture over the top and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook beans until tender. Fry\tbacon.\tPour off excess grease. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Add to beans and bake until heated through.

title: Vegetable Dip(Makes 4 Cups)
instructions: Serve with fresh vegetables. Recipe can be cut in half and makes 2 cups. Good for 2 weeks.

title: Cheesecake Cookies
instructions: Mix brown sugar nuts and flour together in a bowl. Stir in melted butter and mix with your hands until light and crumbly. Remove 1 cup of mixture to be used later as a topping. Place remainder in an 8-inch square pan and press firmly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 16 cookie squares.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions and drain well. Combine with other ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Chill several hours. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. (May be frozen before baking.) Makes approximately 36 balls.

title: Cherry-Cheese Delight
instructions: Combine cream cheese and sour cream. Place layers of cream cheese mixture and cherry pie filling in sherbet glasses. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix together; put in a greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes; remove from oven. Rub with butter or margarine; put back in oven to brown for 15 minutes more.

title: Almost Sugarless Banana Pudding
instructions: Make pudding as directed on box. Add crackers pineapple and bananas. Top with whipped topping; put in refrigerator.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Soak squash onion and bell pepper in salt covered with 3 quarts cold water for at least 1 hour. Drain well.

title: Fruit And Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except fruits in blender until smooth about 1 minute. Cover; chill 3 to 4 hours. To serve mound cheese dip in small bowl and place on tray and surround with fruits.

title: Men'S Favorite Meat Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper; add remaining ingredients except cheese. Place in large flat pan; sprinkle with cheese. Let stand overnight to allow flavors to blend. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 15 servings.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables in a large bowl. Pour salad dressing over and toss to coat evenly. Refrigerate until serving time. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Dorito Salad
instructions: Mix onion lettuce and Cheddar cheese. Add dressing and hot sauce to taste. Crush and add Doritos chips. Slice avocado and add to ingredients. Brown ground meat and add kidney beans and 1/4 teaspoon salt; simmer 10 minutes then add to cold salad.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed on box. Saute onions in margarine until done. Cook broccoli as directed on package and drain. Mix together broccoli soup rice onion butter or margarine and cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Place in a 9 x 13-inch ovenproof dish. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sullivan'S Island Shrimp
instructions: Cook bacon in frying pan until crisp; remove. Add butter onion and celery to grease in pan; saute until tender. Transfer bacon and this mixture to large pot. Add remaining ingredients (except shrimp cracker crumbs and sherry); cook slowly for 2 hours until mixture thickens. Add raw shrimp; cook until shrimp are done. Add cracker crumbs and sherry; serve with fluffy rice. Serves 16.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Place squash in colander. Sprinkle with salt. Let set until all moisture is drained. Then add other ingredients and form in patties; fry in deep fat.

title: Flank Steak Marinade
instructions: Combine oil vinegar and seasonings in shallow glass pan. Brush both sides of flank steak with marinade. Let stand in mixture 2 hours. Broil 3 to 5 inches from heat for 5 minutes. Turn. Brush with remaining marinade and broil another 4 minutes. Slice steak diagonally across grain as thin as possible. Spoon pan juices over meat. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well and pour into Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw drain and chop spinach. Mix with other ingredients. Scoop out middle of a round pumpernickel loaf of bread. Put dip inside. You can use a container the size of hole in bread to put your dip in. Dip assorted kinds of bread or crackers.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients into bowl. Add salt and pepper. Grease a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crab Quiche Bake
instructions: In a bowl combine all ingredients. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Molded Cranberry Waldorf
instructions: Pour 1 cup cranberry juice in a saucepan and bring to a boil; add gelatin stirring until dissolved. Stir in remaining cranberry juice and salt. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold apple celery and nuts into gelatin mixture. Pour into a 4 cup mold or 6 individual molds. Chill until firm. Unmold and top with mayonnaise if desired.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together and let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain cooked squash and add margarine salt and pepper jalapeno and milk. Mix and add beaten eggs onions cheese and cracker crumbs. Pour into greased casserole. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and softened cream cheese until fluffy. Blend in lemon juice; add condensed milk. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts; top with cherry pie filling. Chill.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Combine tomatoes bread cubes and onion. Heat butter flour and seasonings in microwave until butter has melted. Add to tomatoes and pour into a greased casserole.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: In a bowl cream butter. Add sugar gradually beating until light and lemon colored. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually stir in flour and salt. Add brandy. In another bowl mix together (all) raisins currants candied orange peel walnuts pecans citron and candied cherries; add to cake mixture mixing well. Pour into a greased tube pan (or two small loaf pans). Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cake tester inserted to the center comes away clean. Insert on cake rack. When cold sprinkle with brandy; wrap in foil. Store in refrigerator or cool dry place. Occasionally loosen foil and spoon brandy over the cake. Slice thinly.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake mix 2 eggs and butter. Batter will be stiff. Pour in cake pan then mix powdered sugar remaining 2 eggs and cream cheese. Pour over first layer. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Cake will sink in middle as it cools.

title: Bull Frogs
instructions: Mix all this in large pitcher; sit back and enjoy.

title: Mom Day'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: In a kettle add cream of chicken soup two cans of water and Good Seasons salad dressing. Bring to boil. Remove from heat. Put 1 cup rice on bottom of casserole dish. Put chicken on top. Cover the chicken and rice with soup mixture. Cover and put in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Cream the first 4 ingredients well; roll into small balls. Chill for 1 hour. Melt the remaining ingredients in top of double boiler. Stick toothpick into ball then dip into chocolate and place on wax paper. When all are completed place in fridge.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs; mix well. Add dry ingredients and mix. Batter will be stiff. Stir in apples and nuts. Pour into well buttered tube pan or 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cake cool 30 minutes before removing from pan. May use 13 x 9-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cumberland Chicken
instructions: Dunk chicken breasts in egg and water mixture. Roll in breading made of crumbs cheese sesame seed and parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fresh Blueberry Sauce
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a small saucepan. Stir in water and lemon juice. Add blueberries; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 to 2 minutes stirring constantly until clear and thickened. Serve sauce warm over pancakes ice cream etc. Yield 2 cups. Contains approximately 10 calories per tablespoon.

title: Cajun Cabbage
instructions: Combine bacon onion and bell pepper in a large pot in enough water to cook; cook until done. Add cabbage and tomatoes salt pepper vinegar and cayenne. Cook for 45 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil or simmer brown sugar oleo and white syrup for 4 to 5 minutes. Take off stove and add soda. Pour over corn and stir good. Put in 225\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Stir 3 or 4 times. Bake uncovered.

title: Best Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt the butter; pour into a large mixing bowl and beat in cocoa and sugar. When mixture is smooth beat in eggs one at a time then vanilla. Stir in flour salt and coconut. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 25 minutes. Let cool in pan on racks and cut into squares. Yield about 30.

title: Summer Squash
instructions: Cook squash until barely tender cool slightly. Scoop out centers leaving a shell. Mix scooped out squash and mix with remaining ingredients. Stuff the shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar. Then mix in rest of ingredients. Pour in pie shell and bake 30 minutes.

title: Quick Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Prepare macaroni according to box directions. Drain Veg-All and partially drain tomatoes. Mix all ingredients together in large casserole dish. Top with cheeses. (Or cheese can be mixed in with other ingredients.) Bake for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted completely at 360\u00b0.

title: Banana Lemon Tea Bread
instructions: In a large bowl with mixer at low speed beat oleo into creamy consistency and add sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in mashed bananas and lemon juice. Add to banana mixture. Stir in lemon rind. Place in greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potatoes And Coconut
instructions: Blend and bake in moderate oven until firm. Use as a vegetable or dessert.

title: Marie'S Carrot Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. If mixture is too stiff add a little mayonnaise. Use as a dip or spread on bread for ribbon sandwiches.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Grease 9 x 9-inch pan. Slice apples. Put 1/2 of apples in pan. Combine all ingredients except apples and juice. Sprinkle 1/2 of mixture on apples. Put remaining sliced apples over the dry mixture. Place remaining apples on top. Sprinkle remaining sugar mixture on top of apples. Drizzle apple juice over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken onion celery and salt in water until chicken is tender. Remove chicken to cool and debone. Strain broth. Reserve 1 cup broth for dough. Add cream of chicken soup and nutmeg to broth. Mix well. Return to heat. Dough Cut shortening into flour and salt. Beat egg. Add cooled broth and add to flour to make a firm dough. Add more flour if necessary. Roll dough as thin as possible. Return chicken to broth. Add pepper. Cut dough into desired square or oblong pieces. Add one at a time to broth and chicken (which has been brought to boiling point). Add more water and broth if necessary so they will be a bit soupy. If too soupy add a Tbsp. of flour mixed with a little water. After adding dumplings simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Place butter and vanilla in bowl. Beat until mixture is smooth about 2 minutes. Add gradually the sugar about 30 seconds and continue beating for 1 minute. Add eggs and beat for 30 seconds. Stop and scrape bowl. Sift dry ingredients. Turn mixer to speed and gradually add dry ingredients. Beat about 1 minute. Drop by teaspoons on greased baking sheet about 3-inches apart. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Sprinkle with sugar while hot. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Sunday Chicken
instructions: Cut up fryer. Salt and paprika it. Saute onion and apple in margarine. Add half and half curry powder and mushroom soup. Mix well together. Put pieces of chicken in baking dish and pour mixture over it. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 14.

title: Chocolate Caramel Layered Bars
instructions: While the kids unwrap the caramels Mom or Dad prepares a 9 x 13-inch pan (grease and flour). In a large bowl combine cake mix melted butter 1/3 cup evaporated milk and nuts. Stir by hand until mixture holds together. Press half of dough into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Pennsylvania Pot Roast
instructions: Rub roast with salt pepper paprika and flour. Cook bacon until crisp; drain on absorbent paper crumble. Brown roast in baking pan in 3 tablespoons bacon fat. Add gherkins onion garlic water and tomato sauce. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours until tender. Blend sour cream and pan gravy; heat. Stir in bacon bits and serve with roast. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Bean Salad(Tasty Sandwich High In Fiber And Low In Fat)
instructions: Mix vinegar chili powder and onion powder with mayonnaise in small bowl. Add beans and celery; mix well. Soften tortillas in heated frypan for about 1 to 2 minutes. Turn if necessary. Place half of the bean filling onto each tortilla. Top with tomato and lettuce and roll up. Makes 2 servings.

title: New England Salsa
instructions: Chop all ingredients that need to be chopped. In a large plastic or glass bowl combine all ingredients except salt pepper garlic and Tabasco. Stir well. Add salt pepper garlic and Tabasco to taste. Taste with a tortilla chip otherwise it does not taste right. Serve with lots of tortilla chips and company. Keeps well for one month in a tightly sealed jar.

title: Egg And Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain sausage crumble. Layer muffins sausage eggs mustard and cheese. You can add other ingredients like onions peppers etc. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Walnut Cookies
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients like a pie crust. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of warm water with 1/2 teaspoon of sugar; then add 1/2 cup evaporated milk and 4 egg yolks to flour mixture. Add 1/2 cup sugar and beaten egg whites to walnuts.

title: Pineapple Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Mix pudding and pineapple with juice sour cream vanilla and sugar in a deep bowl; beat for one minute on lowest speed. Pour into a pie shell and chill. Top with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix in blender or stir real good.

title: Apple Goodie
instructions: Place apples in baking dish. Mix sugar cinnamon flour and oatmeal; sprinkle over apples. Dot very generously with margarine. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 40 minutes.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Beat pudding mix and milk; set aside. Beat cream cheese and Cool Whip; add pudding mixture. Drain pineapple then add to pudding mixture; mix in marshmallows. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Mix the 2 sugars and oil. Add eggs vanilla soda and salt; mix well. Add flour oats and the rest of ingredients.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Cook meat until brown; drain. Add onions and Cheddar cheese. Let melt. Dip corn tortillas in hot grease for 10 seconds. Drain on paper towel. Place meat in tortillas and wrap. Place in baking dish and cover with cheese sauce. Sprinkle rest of grated cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Truckers' Beans
instructions: In large skillet saute onions and green pepper until slightly softened. Push sausage out of casing; brown in same pan. Drain excess fat. Combine all ingredients; heat through. (Or put in large casserole and bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes). Makes 12 generous servings.

title: Lazy Day Cookies
instructions: Place 18 graham cookies in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Now combine remaining ingredients. Blend well and cook stirring constantly for 5 minutes or until mixture is thick. Spread mixture over layer of graham crackers. Now put 18 crackers over the mixture. Cover the top layer by combining 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar with vanilla flavoring. Add just enough milk and melted oleo to give good spreading quality. Put in refrigerator until cold. Cut in bars. Tastes like date cookies.

title: Pumpkin Cake Pie
instructions: Beat together\tfirst seven ingredients and pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.\tEmpty the yellow cake mix over it breaking any lumps in the mixture. Pour in melted margarine and sprinkle the top\twith chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour no\tlonger. It should be a nice golden brown. May serve topped with whipped cream if you wish.

title: Creamed Corn
instructions: Put corn butter salt and pepper in saucepan. Heat until warm. Serve with love.

title: Broken Glass Cake
instructions: Dissolve each jello (lemon cherry and lime) in 1 1/2 cups water and chill. Crush crackers and mix with 1/2 cup sugar and butter. Put 1/2 of mix in bottom of oblong dish. Dissolve plain gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Heat 1 cup pineapple juice to boiling and add to gelatin; let cool. Whip the cream and add 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla. Fold into the pineapple juice. Cut up jello into cubes and fold into whipped cream mixture. Pour all into cracker lined pan and top with remaining cracker crumbs.

title: Orange Tapioca Salad
instructions: Mix jello pudding and water in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Boil 2 minutes. Let cool. Add Cool Whip; stir well. Add pineapple (drained well) and oranges (drained well). Stir well. Ready to eat.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Boil chicken for 1 hour. Cut into bite-sized pieces. Mix in all ingredients in the same water that you boiled the chicken in. For dumplings add more water. Heat until hot and dumplings have cooked about 20 to 25 minutes over medium heat (covered).

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Blend sugar flour and baking powder together. Mix with eggs then add butter milk vanilla and coconut. Pour into baked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Bacon Baked Beans
instructions: Brown chopped bacon. Add onions and fry until tender. Add sugar vinegar garlic powder dry mustard and sausage. Stir and simmer a few minutes. Add to beans. Do not drain grease. Bake uncovered 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Freezes very well. Makes lots!!!

title: Nenek'S Curry
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in oil until soft. Add enough water to make a paste. Add curry powders and let simmer 10 minutes. Add potatoes tofu and chicken seasoning covering with water. Cook until potatoes are soft. Just before serving add last 2 ingredients.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Place margarine in large glass bowl. Microwave about 1 minute on High. Stir in seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add Chex and nuts. Mix well until all pieces are coated. Microwave 5 1/2 to 6 1/2 minutes on High or until Chex look toasted. Stir every 2 minutes. Spread on absorbent paper to cool. Yield 3 1/2 cups.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in Pyrex dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. After its about done sprinkle cheese on top and melt.

title: Bubble Recipe(For Large Outside Bubbles)
instructions: *These brands work the best.

title: Lazy Cook'S Salad
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients then add last 3 ingredients and mix together. Let stand a day or so.

title: Caramel Nut Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Separate eggs. Beat yolks well. Combine sugar and baking powder and add to yolks. Add vanilla and almond extract. Beat the egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold into egg yolk mixture. Fold in graham cracker crumbs and walnuts and blend well. Line 2 (9-inch) greased layer pans with wax paper and then pour in mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. When cool spread 1 pint of whipped cream between layers and over top of cake. Pour Butterscotch Sauce over top and let run down sides. Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving. Serves 20.

title: Saltless Seasoning Salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and store in a dry place.

title: Homemade Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: In a large mixer bowl combine 1 1/2 cups of the flour and yeast. Heat the milk sugar the 1/4 cup butter and salt just until mixture is warm (120\u00b0) and the butter is almost melted stirring constantly. Add milk mixture to flour mixture; add eggs. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds; scrape sides of bowl constantly. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes. Using a spoon stir in as much of the remaining flour as you can (dough will be soft). Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately soft dough (3 to 5 minutes). On lightly floured surface roll half the dough to 12 x 8-inches. Spread with 3 tablespoons softened butter. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle half over rectangle. Roll up from a short side. Seal edges. Make a second roll with remaining dough butter and sugar mixture. Slice each dough roll into 8 pieces. Arrange slices cut side down in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cover; let rise until nearly double (about 1 hour). Bake rolls in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until light brown. Invert at once onto a wire rack. Cool slightly. Drizzle rolls with Maple Nut glaze or powder sugar glaze. Serve warm. Makes 16 rolls.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Peel tomatoes and onions; remove seeds from peppers and chop them fine. Stir all together and add salt sugar cinnamon cloves and vinegar. Cook slowly for 45 to 60 minutes or until thick stirring occasionally. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal. Makes 4 pints. If desired add 2 hot red peppers seeded and chopped.

title: Cauliflower In Cheese Sauce
instructions: Cook cauliflower in cup of water. Sprinkle salt on it and cook until tender uncovered for 10 minutes. Use slotted spoon to remove cauliflower. Reserve cooking water.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Layer 3 pieces of heavy foil crisscross. Melt butter. Place potatoes on foil. Pour butter and cream on top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Lay onion slices on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Sausage Cheese Grits Casserole
instructions: Bring salted water to boil. Slowly add quick cooking grits (not instant). Return to boil cover reduce heat and cook 3 to 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and add cheese; stir until melted. Add milk butter Worcestershire sauce and garlic salt. Mix well. Beat egg in small bowl. Add 1 tablespoon grits mixture until blended and add back to grits. Spoon half of grits into an 8-inch square baking dish top with one pound of cooked and drained sausage and cover with remaining grits. Cover and chill 8 hours.

title: Yesteryears' Cornbread
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt; stir in corn meal. Add eggs milk and shortening; beat until just smooth. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. I used the cornbread recipe in 1936-1943. At that time there was a grist mill across Highway 30. The man delivered the meal.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add salt and pepper. Pour half hamburger in casserole dish. Add cubed potatoes chopped onion and bell pepper. Add remainder of hamburger. Spread 1 can cream of celery soup evenly over hamburger. Cook about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. May add cheese to top and brown.

title: Peach Cream Pie
instructions: Peel and slice peaches. Put in crust. Bring sugar water cornstarch and salt to a boil. Add Jell-O to boiled mixture. Pour over peaches and refrigerate.

title: Peach Pie-Fresh
instructions: Boil sugar water and cornstarch until thickened. Add lemon gelatin (mix with a little water first) butter and coloring. Pour some into baked pie shell. Slice fresh peaches into it. Add more mix. Top with whipped whipping cream.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown chops on both sides in oil. Remove. In large casserole dish place 2 chops on bottom next onion and potatoes alternating until all is used keeping 1 or 2 chops for top.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Put beans water chestnuts diced potatoes and diced ham in a casserole dish. Pour mushroom soup over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. About 15 minutes before the end of baking time add French fried onions and continue baking.

title: Breakfast Strata
instructions: Arrange croutons in baking dish or pie plate. Sprinkle cheese over croutons. Cover and chill overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until firm in center.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Beat the eggs and add milk and crumbs. Add the corn seasoning and butter. Mix together well and pour in a greased casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chop Suey Casserole
instructions: Put Minute rice and boiling water into casserole (2 to 3 quart) dish and let stand 15 minutes. Brown meat onion and celery. Place in casserole over rice. Mix together soy sauce brown sugar and soup; pour over meat. Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Lu'S Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg lemon juice and lemon rind. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk. Gently fold in berries.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten eggs and peanut butter. Mix well. Sift flour soda and salt. Add them and vanilla to the mixture. Mix well. Place by small balls (about the size of large walnuts) on cookie sheet. Flatten 2 ways with fork tines. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Taboli Salad
instructions: Empty wheat into bowl and cover with cold water. Wheat will expand. Drain excess water.

title: Hot Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix all juices together with sugar and water. Pour over spices in percolator basket and brew at medium temperature.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in half the whipped topping. Spread over crust. Prepare pudding as directed on package using 3 1/2 cups cold milk. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill several hours or overnight. Spread remaining whipped topping over pudding. Garnish with grated chocolate or chopped nuts if desired. Makes 15 servings.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Sift sugar. Beat egg whites with salt until stiff. Very slowly add sugar beating constantly. Fold in vanilla and coconut. Drop from teaspoon onto greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Remove quickly from pan. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Combine flour salt sugar and butter in this order. Add scalded milk slowly stirring constantly to large saucepan. Cook slowly on medium-low heat until thick and smooth stirring constantly. Add 12 ounces coconut. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion for a short time; drain and set aside. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and milk to make sauce. Break up cream cheese; drop into sauce. Add grated Cheddar cheese stirring until smooth. Mix broccoli onion and sauce in casserole. Melt 4 tablespoons butter; mix with bread crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Put vegetables in layers and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Barbecue Brisket
instructions: Sprinkle meat with garlic powder. Place onions on top of meat. Mix last 4 ingredients together and pour over meat. Cover with foil and bake 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. To serve slice thinly against the grain.

title: Valentine Sodas
instructions: Fill a tall glass with strawberry ice cream about 3/4 full. Pour ginger ale over the ice cream. Top with whipped cream and strawberry preserves. Serve with a spoon.

title: Microwave Marshmallow Crisp
instructions: In a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish melt butter on High for 1 minute. Add marshmallows and cover. Microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir; add cereal. Blend and press firmly into pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Easy Funnel Cake(Just Like At The Fair!)
instructions: Beat together egg and milk. Combine dry ingredients together. Then gradually add milk and egg to dry ingredients (mix well; there shouldnt be any lumps/bumps)! Pour into funnel and in a circular motion into saucepan with hot oil. Load up with powdered sugar and sprinkle when cool!

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except rum) and bring to a boil stirring. Remove from heat; cool stirring once in awhile. In a cup add 1 teaspoon mix and shot of rum to boiling water. Add dash of nutmeg; top with whipped cream.

title: Punch
instructions: Heat 4 cups water and sugar until sugar is completely dissolved in water. Add remaining ingredients to sugar/water mixture. Freeze for at least 24 hours. Mix with ginger ale when ready to serve. Makes approximately 4 quarts.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Pour pork and beans in large mixing bowl. Add brown sugar barbecue sauce and catsup. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Put raw bacon strips on top of beans and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Geoff'S Jiffy Cake
instructions: Empty can of pie filling into 6 x 10-inch buttered Pyrex dish. Sprinkle dry cake mix over this just as it comes out of package. Do not pat down. Melt butter and drizzle it over all. Sprinkle nuts over the top and bake for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cut into squares and serve warm with ice cream. Tasty last minute dessert.

title: Pear Honey
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Boil 30 minutes or longer for a thick syrup. Pour into jars and seal.

title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
instructions: Beat Ricotta cheese with eggs and parsley flakes. Mix spinach and sausage into cheese. Stuff shells and place open side down in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Cover with Prego or Ragu spaghetti sauce. Sprinkle with powdered Parmesan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. This freezes well for later use.

title: My Best Brittle
instructions: Combine nuts sugar and syrup and microwave on High for 7 to 9 minutes (depends on your oven). Add butter and vanilla; cook for additional 1 1/2 minutes. Add baking soda and mix well. Immediately pour and spread onto well-greased cookie sheet. Let cool and break into pieces.

title: Homemade Applesauce
instructions: Will need a pan and a grown-up assistant with knife.

title: 1-2-3 Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Mix all ingredients well. Stir with spoon. Drop into greased muffin tins and bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Souper Corn Bread
instructions: Combine soup eggs and milk. Stir in muffin mix until blended. Fold in sausage. Pour into 9-inch greased pan. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until done.

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 10 x 14-inch pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bert'S Beignets(Ben'Yas)
instructions: In large deep iron skillet heat oil. While oil is heating cut biscuits in 1/4 pieces. Put confectioners sugar in large bowl and set aside. When oil is heated drop in biscuit pieces and cook until golden brown. Immediately take out of oil and roll in the confectioners sugar. Makes 40 beignets.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine Marshmallow Creme sugar milk butter and salt. Bring to a full boil. Stir constantly for 5 minutes with it boiling. Remove from heat; add chips and stir until melted then add vanilla and nuts. Chill 2 hours in 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Dream Biscuits
instructions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients; add milk. Roll out and cut. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Beat eggs till very foamy. Fold in cheese oil zucchini soup mix garlic powder and parsley. Add Bisquick. Pour into 9 or 10 inch pie plate greased with margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 - 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Mix well; add 1 pound pecans. Mix well. Pour into buttered pan (I use Pam). Makes approximately 7 pounds.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm water; add the oil sugar and salt to the starter. Add yeast work in flour. Add until the dough is of kneading consistency. Knead well shape and put in oiled loaf pans. Oil and put into shape. Let rise until double. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. You may need to place aluminum foil loosely over the top while baking to keep from burning the top while cooking the inside.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mash avocados with a fork. Add onion lemon juice salt and hot pepper. Beat until creamy. Fold in tomato cover and refrigerate no longer than 3 hours. Serve on lettuce.

title: Mott'S Deliciously Quick And Easy Cake(Low-Fat And Calorie Recipe)
instructions: Spray desired size pans with cooking spray. Prepare cake mix according to package directions with the following modifications Add 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour to the dry mix and stir well. Substitute an equal amount of Motts natural applesauce for the vegetable oil. Bake and cool as directed. Frost cake with your choice of Betty Crocker Creamy Deluxe light frosting and garnish with fresh berries if desired.

title: Turkey Dressing(Mom'S)
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in frying pan and add onion. Saute until onion softens (do not brown). Add butter onion salt pepper and thyme to bread crumbs. Mix and stuff turkey lightly. Do not press stuffing together.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Put sugar in a no-stick skillet and warm. Pour in the syrup (maple syrup or honey may be used). Stir and add oil and cocoa. Heat over low heat until mixture is thoroughly mixed. Serve over angel food cake.

title: Barbecue Beef Cups
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add barbecue sauce sugar and onions to meat mixture. Separate biscuits and press into muffin pan. Spoon mixture into biscuit cups and top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Crunchy Cranberry Mold
instructions: Heat cranberry juice to boiling; remove from heat. Add gelatin and stir until dissolved. Stir in lemon and orange juices. Refrigerate until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Fold in relish and nuts. Spoon into lightly oiled 1-quart mold. Chill at least 4 hours. Serves 6.

title: Oreo Delight
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies; put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt butter; pour over cookies. Let ice cream thaw somewhat and spread over cookies and butter. Pour chocolate fudge on top of ice cream. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle Oreos on top for looks.

title: Fudgy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar milk butter and cocoa. Bring to a full boil for 1 minute; time accurately. Add salt and vanilla. Blend in peanut butter and oats. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Firm in 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Breakfast Casserole Cheese Dish
instructions: Butter 8 slices of bread. Sprinkle with cheese (cubed or grated) and the ham. (Be liberal with the cheese!) Grease pan. Spread sprinkled buttered bread over bottom of pan. Beat eggs into milk. Pour over cheese and bread. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook yellow rice according to directions. Mix rice Mexicorn and soup and place in a casserole dish. Top with cheese slices. Microwave or bake until bubbly.

title: Barbecups
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add barbecue sauce and minced onion. Take biscuits and press each biscuit into an ungreased muffin pan making sure dough goes up to edge of cup. Spoon meat mixture into cups and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Challah Bread
instructions: Put 4 eggs in mixing bowl; add 6 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon salt 1 1/2 cups salad oil and 2 1/2 cups warm water. Mix lightly. Add 2 cups flour and 2 packages of dry yeast. Stir and knead in about 6 cups flour. Let rise until double. Divide into thirds. Divide each third in thirds. Roll each third into rope on floured surface. Braid. Let rise until double in size. Brush with one egg yolk beaten with 1 teaspoon water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Waffles
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat egg; add milk and lard. Mix all this well. Add vinegar last.

title: Sweet Pepper Dressing
instructions: Brown meat; add chopped seasonings and cook about 30 minutes. Add tomatoes and continue to cook at least 30 minutes more. Season to taste and mix in hot cooked rice. Dressing will be moist.

title: Lane Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar until light. Mix milk flour beaten egg whites and vanilla. Fold into butter mix. Bake in 4 layers at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Place croutons in baking dish. Top with 1/2 cheese. Top with cooked sausage and remaining portion of cheese. Beat eggs. Add 2 1/4 cups milk and mustard. Pour this mixture over layered ingredients. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Swiss Chicken Cutlets
instructions: Cut each cheese slice in half; place 1 half on top of each cutlet. Starting with a short end tightly roll up cutlets tie with a string.

title: Russian Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. This dressing will add an extra taste to just about anything.

title: Sheet Cake
instructions: Use a 9 x 15 jelly roll pan. Prepare cake mix following directions on box.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Boil chicken then shred. Mix first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Add grated cheese. Mix all together. Use only 1 cup of grated cheese. Cut up tortillas. Use a layer of tortillas then layer of sauce with chicken and layer of cheese. Repeat steps. Bake for 45 minutes; 15 minutes with foil covering and 30 minutes without foil.

title: Red Velvet Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add 1 egg at a time beating after each addition. Add food coloring. Add salt and flour. Alternately with vanilla add milk. Mix well after each addition. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 10-inch tube pan.

title: Green Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve 2 boxes Jell-O with water. Add drained can of pineapple. Add cottage cheese and salad dressing. Put all in blender until cheese is almost smooth. Chill can of Pet milk for 1 hour in freezer. Fold in Jell-O and chill.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Combine lime juice concentrate strawberries and 1 pint sherbet. Blend until smooth. Pour into chilled punch bowl. Add chilled lemon-lime pop. Spoon remaining sherbet over the top. Serve.

title: Glazed Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine pie filling pineapple strawberries and mandarin oranges in a large bowl; chill well. Coat bananas with lemon juice and add to mixture. Serve immediately. Makes 10 servings.

title: Easy Potato Casserole
instructions: Spread in a casserole dish. Cover with crumbled potato chips. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Serves a small army.

title: Tuna Cheese Spread
instructions: Add onions to softened cream cheese. Drain tuna; mash with fork. Combine with cheese onions lemon juice curry powder mayonnaise and salt. Blend to mix well. Chill before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Low-Fat Apricot Bars
instructions: Stir flour brown sugar baking powder baking soda and cardamon; set aside. Stir apricot nectar applesauce and egg until combined. Add to dry ingredients. Stir in dried apricots. Spread in 11 x 7-inch baking pan ungreased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Beat well. Add bananas and flour salt and soda which have been sifted together. Add vanilla and nuts. Put into 2 small greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Hot Kippered Salmon
instructions: Place fillets skin side down side by side in greased shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with salt pepper and brown sugar. Drizzle with the liquid smoke. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 8 hours. Drain any liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork. Yield 8 servings.

title: Dill Weed Dip
instructions: Mix together let stand overnight.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Or you can add 1 egg and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Kevin'S Favorite Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet. Drain all grease. Add sauce and garlic salt. Let simmer for 15 minutes. Pour mixture over cooked spaghetti.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Wash broccoli and cut flowerets. Chop green onions and add raisins. Crumble the cooked bacon. Add all ingredients together in a bowl.

title: Strawberry Pineapple Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar in a gallon container and add pineapple juice and water to fill the container.

title: Aunt Betty'S Peanut Butter Stick Cookies
instructions: Cut crust off bread. Cut each slice into 6 sticks. Toast sticks on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes. Melt in a double boiler 3 heaping tablespoonfuls peanut butter and 2 tablespoons margarine. Crush 1 package graham crackers and 3 heaping tablespoonfuls powdered sugar. Dip toasted sticks into melted peanut butter to coat. Roll in cracker-sugar mixture and cool on wax paper.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Soak brownies in Kahlua. In a large glass bowl layer 1/2 brownies 1/2 mousse 1/2 Heath bars and 1/2 Cool Whip. Repeat.

title: Italian Dressing
instructions: Shake all ingredients in tightly covered container. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Shake before serving.

title: Depression Chili
instructions: Saute ground raw rabbit meat in small amount shortening. Add spices tomatoes and water. Simmer 15 to 30 minutes on medium heat. Add flour mixture. Cook until slightly thickened. Can be served with homemade cornbread biscuits or crackers.

title: Nutty - Noodle Clusters
instructions: Mix both types of chips in heavy saucepan. Melt over low heat while stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in noodles and nuts. Mix quickly to coat evenly. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and cool. Makes 24 clusters.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Beat egg white and water until frothy. Add nuts; coat well. Blend spices with sugar; add to nuts. Spread in oiled shallow pan. Bake for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. This makes a great Christmas present.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve sugar and jello in boiling water. Let cool to lukewarm and combine with remaining ingredients. Can be molded if desired.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pan. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift all-purpose flour baking soda and salt together; stir in whole wheat flour and add to creamed mixture mixing well. Fold in bananas vanilla and walnuts. Pour mixture into pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Turn bread out onto rack.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased baking dish. Combine dry ingredients; add melted butter to mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle crumb mixture on top of apples. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Serve warm or cold. Top with milk or ice cream.

title: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix with spoon and beat 1/2 minute. Pour into 8x8x2 pan.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add remainder and mix well. Bake 15 minutes at 375 or 400\u00b0.

title: Frozen Lemon Pie
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar and lemon. Cook in double boiler until custard thickens let cool. Add sugar to egg white and beat. Add to the cooled mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Layer 3/4 of the crumb mixture in 1 - 1/2 quart rectangular baking dish. Spread lemon mixture over crumb layer. Sprinkle the remaining crumbs over the lemon mixture. Put in freezer and chill thoroughly. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash carrot and onion in small amount of salted water until tender. Drain and mash. Add sour cream and soup and mix well. Melt margarine; combine with dressing mix. Place a layer of dressing mix in bottom of baking dish. Add squash mixture; top with remaining dressing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Put in bowl broccoli florets add 1 diced red onion. Add shredded Cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Mix 1 cup Miracle Whip 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon wine vinegar. Mix and toss over broccoli mixture.

title: Venus Soup
instructions: Saute meat with onion for 10 minutes or until meat is browned. Add remaining ingredients all together mixing well. In a deep saucepan on medium heat stir occasionally for 10 to 15 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Serves about 6 to 8. Season to taste.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Layer potatoes and onion rings in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Season each layer with salt and pepper. Add bread crumbs to middle layer. Mix soup with milk and pour over potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until potatoes are tender. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: In a medium bowl blend corn meal baking powder and flour. Stir in water egg and 1 cup cheese. Spread 1/2 of the corn meal mixture in a 9-inch greased pie plate. Set aside.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in refrigerator overnight. Add tomatoes just before serving. Serves 4.

title: Ice Cream (Maw-Maw'S)
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until creamy. Add vanilla and evaporated milk. Pour into ice cream maker and fill to the fill line with regular whole milk.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoonfuls on well-greased pan and bake.

title: Potato Chip Chicken
instructions: Grind up the potato chips into powder or small pieces. Take the chicken after it has been washed and dip into butter and eggs. Roll the chicken in the potato chips. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Cream shortening until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar and eggs one at a time. Sift together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture alternately with coffee. Fold in diced apples and chopped walnuts. Pour into greased and floured cake pan. Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 45 to 50 minutes. Test for doneness.

title: Yummy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Put flour and sugar in bowl and set aside. Combine margarine cocoa and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over flour and sugar. Mix well. Add buttermilk beaten eggs soda and vanilla. Pour into a greased and floured sheet cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. See Chocolate Icing.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Add soups and mushrooms. Stir until well blended. Remove from heat. Add pimento chicken spaghetti and sour cream. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: 1-2-3 Alarm Chili
instructions: Brown hamburg; drain fat. Add all other ingredients. Let simmer for 45 minutes. May add can of pinto beans fresh tomato green pepper and chopped onion the last 5 minutes of cooking. Garnish with shredded lettuce and shredded cheese (Monterey Jack or Cheddar).

title: Hot Bean And Cheese Dip
instructions: Heat all ingredients plus 1/4 cup water in saucepan. Stir constantly until heated through. Keep warm in crock-pot. Serve with Fritos or tortilla chips.

title: Ham Chowder
instructions: Combine water potatoes carrots celery onion salt and pepper. Microwave on Full power 10 to 15 minutes. Do not drain! Melt margarine in microwave dish. Add flour and mix well. Add milk. Microwave on Full power 6 to 8 minutes stirring every 2 minutes until thick. Add cheese to milk/flour to make cheese sauce. Add cheese sauce corn and ham to vegetables. Heat on Full power 3 to 5 minutes or until hot. Do not boil. Serve hot with bread and crackers.

title: Caramel Nut Brownies
instructions: Mix cake mix melted oleo 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 2 tablespoons water. Pour or pat 1/2 of batter in a greased and floured pan (9 x 13-inch). Bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and blend in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and blend in butter and vanilla.

title: Chocolate Chip Bran Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; roll in small balls (kids can help with this job). Then roll in powdered sugar twice. Thats it! Store in tight covered container.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Place confectioners sugar in a bowl. Cut in the peanut butter with a pastry blender until crumbly. Set aside 2 teaspoons for garnish. Sprinkle remaining crumbs into a pie shell. Combine 2/3 cup sugar 1/3 cup cornstarch egg yolks and milk. Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens. Remove from the heat; add butter and vanilla stirring until butter melts. Pour into pie shell.

title: Strawberry Banana Salad
instructions: Mix the jello as directed on box less 1/2 cup water. Add strawberries. Let cool. Add the bananas. Pour into greased mold or dish. Top with the sour cream with the sugar mixed in.

title: German Chocolate Cake Frosting
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar evaporated milk egg yolks and shortening. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture come to a boil. Remove from heat. Add vanilla coconut and pecans. Beat until thick. Cool 15 minutes and then spread on your cake.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Add shortening to dry ingredients. Add wet ingredients. Roll between two sheets of wax paper.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture is as fine as cornmeal. Add liquid and mix very lightly until a soft dough is formed. Drop from teaspoon on boiling meat stew. Cover very tightly and cook without removing cover 12 minutes. Serves 6. Keep covered while cooking to prevent sogginess. Richer dumplings may be made by using 1 beaten egg and 1/4 cup milk instead of 1/2 cup milk.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter until soft. Sift together brown sugar and white sugar. Add sugar gradually to butter and blend until creamy. Beat in egg peanut butter salt and soda. Add sifted flour to batter. Blend in vanilla. Roll dough into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheet and press flat with fork. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chorice Appetizers
instructions: Slice sausage thin diagonally. Slice bacon in half. On one slice of bacon place sausage and date. Roll up and secure with toothpick. Bake for 20 minutes. May be turned after 10 minutes. Broil for 1 or 2 minutes on each side.

title: Cinnamon Rolls(Bread Machine)
instructions: Put ingredients (yeast 1/2 cup melted butter 1/2 cup warm water 2/3 cup warm milk bread flour wheat flour eggs and 3 tablespoons of sugar) in order required by your machine. Put on dough cycle.

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Cook the 1 cup raisins and 1 cup water together until about 5 tablespoons of water remains. Drain and reserve the liquid. Mix together the shortening sugar and eggs. Stir in the cooled raisin liquid and the vanilla. Sift the dry ingredients together and stir into the dough. Stir in the cooked raisins and the rolled oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Ranch Style Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers. Pour crackers into paper bag. Add oil mixture and shake shake shake until crackers are coated. Store in airtight plastic container at room temperature.

title: Chili Rice
instructions: Stir chili tomatoes onion garlic powder and pepper in a large skillet. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

title: Ham Pasta Salad
instructions: In a large bowl toss macaroni with ham green pepper tomato and onion. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise Parmesan cheese milk and salt. Pour over pasta mixture and stir to coat. Cover and chill. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese before serving. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice
instructions: Cook chicken; skin and debone. Pull apart in chunks. Melt butter and saute onion. Add soup milk flour and salt and pepper. Cook until thick. Cook wild rice as directed on box. In baking dish put 1 layer of rice and 1 layer of chicken then add sauce. (May make 2 layers.) Bake uncovered in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Add grated cheese.

title: Hashed Brown Rice
instructions: Combine the rice flour and milk. Heat butter in a 10-inch skillet. Add onions and cook until tender. Spread the rice mixture evenly in the skillet. Press it down firmly with a spatula. Cook over medium heat until bottom is golden brown. Turn out onto serving dish brown side up. Serves 4.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
