instructions: Mix together flour salt baking powder sugar and baking soda. Cut in shortening. Stir in gently the buttermilk. Knead for 2 minutes. Pat the dough to thickness of 1/4 inch. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Polynesian Chicken
instructions: Lightly season chicken and dredge in flour. Brown in frying pan. When brown put in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. In saucepan combine remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat until mixture thickens. Pour over chicken and bake an additional 10 minutes. For 10 pieces or more double the recipe.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
instructions: In greased baking pan place chicken. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place sauerkraut over chicken; top with Swiss cheese. Pour dressing evenly over cheese. Cover with foil and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease. Sprinkle with chopped parsley to serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Rice And Chicken Risotto(Risotto, My Dear, Is A Way With Rice; A Delectable Way.)
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter or margarine. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Place in a large baking dish. Cover and cook in the oven at 400\u00b0 until liquid is absorbed. (More liquid may be added for tender rice.) Remove cover the last 15 minutes to lightly brown.

title: Swedish Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar slowly. Add eggs flour and salt. Blend well. Add vanilla; mix then chill. Roll out on dough board and cut out with cookie cutters. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Hot Rotel Dip
instructions: Saute pepper and onion in two tablespoons oleo or cooking oil. Add sausage and continue to stir until sausage is browned. Drain on paper towels. In crock pot place cubed cheese and drained Rotel tomatoes. Add sausage mixture olives pimentos and Italian seasoning. Continue to stir until cheese is melted and mixture is thoroughly combined. Serve from crockpot with tortilla chips.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Shred or chop beef into small pieces. Mix all ingredients together 2 hours prior to serving. Serve with crackers or rye rounds.

title: Kitchen Sink Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Stir well. Add flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Mix well and add vanilla oats cornflakes chocolate chips and nuts. Make balls and flatten with a fork dipped in ice water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 13 minutes.

title: Liberty Bell Steak Sandwiches
instructions: Saute onions in margarine. Remove onions from skillet. Add meat to skillet. Heat thoroughly. Heat process cheese spread in saucepan over low heat. Fill roll with meat and onions. Top with process cheese spread.

title: Glazed Fresh Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots (covered with water) on stove over low heat until tender. Drain carrots and cover with butter and brown sugar.

title: Southwestern Muffins
instructions: Saute peppers and onion in 2 tablespoons oil until tender; stir in ham. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl; make well in center. Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry mixture with the peppers and ham. Mix until just moistened. Spoon into greased muffin tins filling 2/3 full. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Shaker Lemon Pie
instructions: Slice the lemons into paper-thin rounds rind and all. Place slices in a bowl. Pour sugar over and mix gently. Let stand for 2 hours. Prepare pie crust and chill until ready for use. Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Beat the eggs pour over lemons and mix gently. Pour lemon mixture into pie shell. Cover pie with top crust which may be gashed decoratively to let steam escape. Bake 15 minutes. Lower oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes more. Pie is done if a knife inserted into it comes out clean.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Saute onions and green peppers in butter. Add ground beef and lightly brown. Do not overcook. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour. Serve on a bed of rice. Makes a meal with green salad and French bread.

title: Divinity
instructions: Make divinity by combining sugar syrup and hot water. Cook until the mixture spins a thread (when thread spins from almost empty spoon). Pour cooked syrup into 3 beaten egg whites. Mix until peaks for candy stand up when dropped from a spoon.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar creaming until light. Add eggs beating well after each. Sift together dry ingredients; add alternately to creamed mixture with applesauce. Stir in raisins. Pour in greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Toffee Bar Crunch Pie
instructions: Spread dessert topping on bottom of crust. Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in Cool Whip and chopped toffee bars. Spoon into crust. Freeze 4 hours or until set. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until pie can be easily cut. Garnish as desired. Store leftover pie in freezer.

title: Cinnamon Blossoms
instructions: Separate biscuits with scissors. Make 5 cuts at regular intervals almost to center of each biscuit. Drop biscuits into hot oil in fryer. Fry 1 minute on each side or until golden brown. Drain. Coat warm blossoms with mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pennies From Heaven
instructions: Margarine and cheese should be room temperature. Cream. Add flour salt and pepper. Use several dashes of Tabasco. Add Rice Krispies mix. Make into marble size balls. Press with fork until flat. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 250.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt in a mixing bowl. Cut in shortening with 2 knives. Combine water and vinegar with egg; add to flour mixture and stir until moistened and dough is formed. Divide dough into 4 or 5 equal parts; shape each into a round flat patty ready for rolling. Wrap in waxed paper; chill at least 30 minutes. Place on lightly floured board; roll 1/8-inch thick and 2 inches larger than inverted pie pan.

title: Crispy Pork Chops
instructions: Cut off excess fat from edges of chops. Bread chops in the egg and crumbs coating well. Broil on a lightly greased rack about 8 inches away from heat for 10 minutes.

title: Coconut Bonbons
instructions: Do not cook! Melt butter. Let cool then add powdered sugar coconut Eagle Brand milk and nuts. Roll into balls. Dip in chocolate mixture. Let set on wax paper.

title: Homemade Pizza
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix the remaining ingredients together mixing the third cup by hand. Set in a bowl in warm water with damp towel over top for 15 minutes. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Brenda'S Spice Tea
instructions: Mix and store. Add 3 tablespoons to cup of hot water. Absolutely delicious!

title: Meat And Macaroni Dish
instructions: Fry meat in fat until lightly browned with onions salt and pepper. Have macaroni cooked and drained. In a well oiled baking dish put layer of meat on bottom then layer of macaroni then top with layer of meat mixture. Cover with can of tomato soup. Dot with butter and bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and add enough all-purpose flour until cutting consistency. This usually takes about 3 cups. Roll out on floured board and cut. The thinner you roll them the crispier. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Place in large saucepan. Cover with water. Add salt. Bring to boil and simmer for 1 hour. Remove chicken; cool and take meat from bones. Cut into chunks. Save broth. Melt butter in 3-quart pan. Add flour and mix. Add broth; cook until thick. Add soup and stir until smooth. Season with salt and pepper if needed. Serve over cooked rice or chow mein noodles.

title: Beanie Weenie Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. In large bowl cut sausage into bite size pieces. Add beans chopped pickles onions and eggs. Toss with your favorite salad dressing.

title: Beef Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Allow the two packages of cream cheese to soften. Slice the beef into small pieces and place about 1/4 to the side. Food processor is ideal for slicing.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Cream 1/2 cup margarine. Add sugar egg yolks vanilla and flour. Press evenly into tiny tart shells or muffin cups. Use paper liners. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Southern Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in baking dish. (Adjust ingredients quantities to individual taste.) Bake 30 minutes uncovered at 350\u00b0. Cover and bake for an additional 15 minutes baking time.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Combine green tomatoes red peppers onion and hot pepper in large saucepan. Add vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Cook 20 to 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Ladle into hot sterilized pint jars. Seal with two-piece lids. Hot water bath 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Texas Casserole
instructions: Brown meat in large casserole dish; drain grease. Add potato rounds then Ranch Style beans then tomatoes and about 1/2 can of water. Spread chunks of cheese around on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Add boiling water to jello. Mix sugar and cream cheese then add to jello. Let set then add pineapple nuts and Cool Whip.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Melt Velveeta cheese and 3/4 stick margarine together and mix into vegetables in a 9 x 13-inch oven dish. Roll crackers crumbs and mix with 1/4 stick margarine. Sprinkle over vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk. Add Eagle Brand milk. Add vanilla wafers and bananas. Chill for 2 hours.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl; cover and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple and add juice to cake mix for the liquid; mix according to directions. In large casserole dish or large pan melt butter. Add brown sugar. Stir until sugar is well wet. Layer pineapple. Add nuts and cherries then pour on cake mix. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 until cake springs back. Turn upside-down on cake plate and lift slowly.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread rolls into lightly greased 12 inch pizza pan. Firmly press lines to seal. Combine eggs bacon cheese and mushrooms. Pour over prepared crust and bake at 375\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Stir in rest of ingredients. Chill.

title: Our Favorite Pizza
instructions: Thaw pastry sheet and fold open. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Place tomato slices on waxed paper and sprinkle evenly with salt. Let stand 20 minutes. Sprinkle baked pastry shell with Mozzarella cheese and Feta cheese. Arrange tomato slices in a single layer to cover top. Sprinkle with Italian seasoning and olive oil. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage uncooked into casserole dish. Top with rice and cooked ground beef. Pour soup and water mixture next. Cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Top with cheese. Return to oven (turn oven off) until cheese is melted. Cover tightly with foil while cooking.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place half the potatoes in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with half the onions. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine soup and milk and pour over potatoes. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking 30 minutes more. Makes 4 or 5 servings.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Mix hot water and Kool-Aid and let cool. Mix bananas with sugar. Add pineapple mixture. Let set overnight in freezer. Punch is best when served while slushy.

title: Sugar-Free Fruity Thumbprints
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine the flour egg butter artificial sweetener coconut flavoring and apple juice. Beat until smooth. Drop from a teaspoon onto a foil-lined baking sheet spacing the cookies about 2 inches apart.

title: Granny'S Sunday Dinner Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix buttermilk and eggs together. Wash chicken and drain. Sprinkle with flour. Dip chicken in buttermilk mix. Fork chicken 1 piece at a time and drop in flour mixture. Take out and drop in hot oil just until chicken is brown. Take out and put single layer on cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Its good enough for the preacher!

title: Low Calorie Dip
instructions: Blend to sour cream consistency. Use as a dip with cauliflowerets cucumber slices celery and carrot sticks and other vegetables. Contains 210 calories per cup.

title: Foundation Or Plain Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Cream the shortening; add sugar and cream until fluffy. Add eggs then dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla a small amount at a time. Beat after each addition. Pour into greased pans. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 25 minutes. Makes two 8-inch layers. Frost as desired. Good with Chocolate Frosting.

title: Molded Spinach Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water in large bowl and let cool. Stir in lemon juice and salt. Cover and chill in refrigerator until partially set.

title: Best Slaw
instructions: Heat the sugar vinegar oil mustard celery seed and salt to a boil. Pour over the cabbage and onions. Refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours in an airtight container. Drain to serve. Will keep for 2 weeks refrigerated.

title: Oven Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Combine oatmeal and Parmesan cheese in blender and blend until oatmeal is fine. Skin chicken if desired and brush with barbecue sauce. Coat chicken with oatmeal mixture shaking off excess. Place skin side down in lightly greased baking pan.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Spread cream cheese on heat resistant dish. Spread chili over cream cheese. Spread salsa over chili. Sprinkle cheese on top. Microwave until Cheddar is melted or put in 350\u00b0 oven until Cheddar melts. Serve with nachos or corn chips.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Add food color to water. Mix all together. Stir over low heat until mixture foams forms into ball and clings to spoon.

title: Tom'S Famous Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together; can add more minute oats if needed for a soft but not firm consistency. Put in loaf pan or 9 x 13 pan and shape into a loaf.

title: Two Cheesy Biscuits
instructions: In a large bowl cut Crisco into flour until Crisco is the texture of peas. Add milk and mix. The dough should be wet. Add grated cheese. Mix. Dump onto floured surface. Knead four times. Roll or pat out to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Using a biscuit cutter or a glass cut biscuits. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix sour cream Ranch dressing and dill. Then add vegetables.

title: 5 Minute Fudge
instructions: Combine milk sugar and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat to boiling. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Stir 1 to 2 minutes or until marshmallows and chips melt. Pour into buttered 9-inch square pan. Allow to cool. Cut into squares.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Separate egg whites and beat until stiff. Set aside. Cream together first 3 ingredients. Add egg yolks one at a time then flour and baking powder alternately with milk. Add flavoring. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool ten minutes take out of pan and add glaze.

title: Dirt
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Oreos together. Crumble Oreos. Layer in a deep dish the cookies and cream mixture ending with cookies on top.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Peel and chop oranges. Add coconut and sugar to taste. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Tomato Sauce
instructions: Wash remove stem ends and cores and quarter tomatoes. Let tomatoes stand in colander to drain off excess liquid. In 8 to 10 quart kettle combine first 5 ingredients. Bring to a boil; cook 30 to 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Put tomato mixture through strainer. Add vinegar sugar and salt to tomato puree. Return to kettle. Bring to a boil and simmer until desired consistency about 30 minutes stirring often. Pour hot tomato sauce into hot jars leaving 1/2-inch space and seal (boiling water bath - 10 minutes). Makes 2 pints.

title: Doritos Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Add onion and cook until tender. Add soup sauce water and olives. Heat but do not boil. Pour Doritos into large casserole dish. Pour hamburger mixture over Doritos. Mix slightly. Top with cheese. Bake in oven 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Wyoming Squares
instructions: Beat the whites of 7 eggs until foamy. Add cream of tartar and continue beating until mixture is very stiff. Gradually add 1 cup sugar still beating. Beat the egg yolks until thick and add lemon flavoring. Then fold them into the egg whites very gently. Add 1 cup of cake flour; sift before measuring. Flavor with orange extract almond extract and vanilla. Bake in square or oblong pan from 30 to 40 minutes. When cake has risen the heat may be reduced slightly. When cool cake may be cut into squares; cover each square with a butter icing. Coconut could be sprinkled over this.

title: Gingerbread Dancers A La Cynthia Gregory
instructions: Cream the softened butter with brown sugar and add molasses. Mix dry ingredients and add to the butter/sugar mixture with water to form a soft ball.

title: Christmas Lizzies
instructions: Chop fruit and pecans. Mix all ingredients together and bake in small cupcake pans for 15 or 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Delish
instructions: Drain pineapple saving juice. Prepare cake mix according to directions substituting pineapple juice for liquid. Bake in greased 9 x 13 pan for about 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool Cake. Whip together cream cheese pudding and milk until smooth. Spread over cooled cake top. With drained pineapple cover with Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries and nuts.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Cream together butter and peanut butter; add confectioners sugar and mix well. Shape into small balls. Place on cookie sheets lined with waxed paper. Chill well. Melt together chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip the balls into the melted chocolate and place on waxed paper. Cool completely. Store in a cool place. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: Beat sugar and oil together. Add eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Stir in apples. May also use zucchini walnuts and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 in paper cupcake holders 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed and line bottom of a 13 x 9-inch dish. Sprinkle over noodles 2 tablespoons caraway seed. Crumble corned beef over noodles. Spread sauerkraut over meat. Mix cheese soup with milk and pour over. Spread Swiss cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Meatball Soup
instructions: In saucepan combine frozen vegetables and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain the ground beef and onion. Add the spaghetti sauce mix tomato sauce and water. Cook this slowly. Spread in the bottom of a Pyrex dish. Layer on top the Mozzarella cheese cottage cheese and dinner rolls. Dot with butter. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly.

title: Angel Cake Custard
instructions: Mix milk egg yolks sugar flour and salt. Cook in top of double boiler until coats spoon. Add vanilla. Add gelatin which has been dissolved in 1/4 cup water. Cool.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Melt margarine in 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Stir in pretzels and 3 tablespoons sugar. Place in a 325\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes stirring once or twice. Remove and cool.

title: Creamy Orange Cheesecake
instructions: Combine crumbs 3 tablespoons sugar and 3 tablespoons butter; press onto bottom of a spring-form pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine softened cream cheese 1/4 cup butter 1/2 cup sugar and 1/4 cup flour mixing at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each one. Blend in milk vanilla and rind. Pour over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Furniture Polish
instructions: Mix all together. Recipe from 1904 Gold Medal Cookbook.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into unbaked pie crust. Top with crumble pie topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour; may cover to keep the top from browning too fast.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Soften margarine. Mash bananas with fork. Sift flour with baking soda. Combine all ingredients; add chopped nuts if desired. Mix well and pour into greased and floured loaf pan.

title: Mushroom Patties
instructions: Mix ingredients into a batter. Pour about 1/4 inch or more oil in a skillet. When oil is hot take a tablespoon of batter at a time and place in hot oil. Flip once and fry until golden brown.

title: Salmon Souffle
instructions: Soak soft bread crumbs in scalded milk. Add salt dry mustard and cheese. Mix until cheese is melted. Let cool as you clean salmon; remove skin and bones. Add egg yolks. Fold in 2 cups flaked salmon (1 pound). Fold in 3 egg whites beaten stiff.

title: Wacky Kake
instructions: Into one 8-inch cake pan (ungreased) sift the flour sugar baking soda salt and cocoa. With the back end of a spoon make a hole in the dry ingredients and add the oil. Make another hole and add the vinegar. Make another hole and add vanilla. Pour the water over all the ingredients and now mix well with a fork. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni mix as directed simmering 15 minutes. Remove from skillet; set aside. Keep warm. In same skillet heat oil over high heat. Add green onions garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute. Add shrimp; cook 2 minutes. Add water chestnuts and prepared Rice-A-Roni. Cook 2 minutes. Add pea pods. Cook 1 to 2 minutes until crisp-tender.

title: Forty Cloves Of Garlic Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large Dutch oven melt butter in olive oil. Add chicken and cook turning until golden 5 to 10 minutes. Tilt pan and spoon off all but 2 tablespoons fat. Add garlic and stir to coat. Sprinkle with lemon juice thyme salt pepper and 1/4 cup water. Cover tightly and bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Crock-Pot Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Using 1 stick of margarine coat the sides and bottom of the crock-pot. Place half of the potatoes into the crock-pot. Add 1/4 cup onions 1/2 stick of margarine and 1 can of Cheddar cheese soup. Add remaining potatoes onion margarine butter and Cheddar cheese soup. Add cream of potato soup last. Place lid on crock-pot and cook for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Susan'S Wine Stew
instructions: Brown meat in oil; add onions garlic juice wine and seasonings. Cover. Cook over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add carrots and potatoes. Simmer until tender. Stir in mushrooms and bouillon. Heat through. Serves 6.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss the ingredients together; cover with grated cheese and a few crushed potato chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Italian Marinade For Steak Or Venison
instructions: Score meat in crisscross pattern 1 inch apart and 1/4 inch deep. Marinate in glass container 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Stir corn meal into (salted) boiling water. Stir for 1 minute and remove from the fire. Add butter; beat well. Add eggs and beat in the cold milk. Beat again and pour into buttered baking dish. Bake 25 minutes in hot oven (450\u00b0). Serve from baking dish.

title: Lemon Pudding
instructions: Add milk to beaten egg yolks. In a large bowl cream sugar flour and butter. Add rest of ingredients except the egg whites. Beat egg whites stiff and fold into mixture. Pour into a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Set casserole in pan of hot water in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes uncovered. It will be slightly brown on top. Cake will be on top and pudding on the bottom. Include a little of each in each serving. Make it morning it is to be served. Serve at room temperature or cold with a whipped cream if you like.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat in skillet and drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce and onion (optional) and simmer while noodles cook. Cook noodles with salt and vegetable oil according to package directions and drain. Layer 1/2 noodles cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese and meat sauce in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves six to eight.

title: Buster Bar Dessert
instructions: Layer crushed Oreos in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Reserve 1/2 cup for topping. Layer each ingredient in order as given on top of Oreos. Top with remaining Oreos. Keep in freezer.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle top with more cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Triple Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients in mixer and beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour half of batter into a 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and lightly floured. Sprinkle 1 cup morsels over batter. Spoon remaining batter over morsels. Sprinkle with 1 cup morsels and swirl. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan for 35 minutes; invert on a serving platter and cool completely. Combine remaining morsels and cream in a saucepan over medium heat stirring until morsels are melted. Cool 15 minutes. Pour glaze over cake using a frosting spatula to coat sides. Top with pecan halves.

title: Ice Cream Delight
instructions: Mix together crackers and melted margarine. Save 3/4 cup for topping. Put remainder on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat with mixer until smooth ice cream pudding and 1 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cracker crumbs that you pressed down. Chill 2 hours or make day before. Add 8 ounces Cool Whip and sprinkle with remainder crumbs on top.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 1 1/2 quart casserole tear bread. In mixing bowl combine remaining ingredients and stir thoroughly. Pour over bread and add more bread as needed to absorb mixture. Bake 65 to 70 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Pineapple-Lemon Chicken
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Combine reserved juice with garlic cornstarch Worcestershire sauce mustard and rosemary. Arrange chicken in shallow casserole dish skin side up. Sprinkle with salt. Broil until browned. Stir sauce. Pour over chicken. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Arrange pineapple and lemon around chicken. Spoon sauce over all. Bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings with only 229 calories per serving.

title: Tropical Fruit 'N Nut Bars
instructions: Drain pineapple well pressing out juice (1 1/2 cups) in saucepan. Sprinkle gelatin over reserved juice. Let stand 1 minute. Stir over low heat until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in honey pineapple and other ingredients. Turn into 8 or 9-inch baking pan. Chill until firm. Cut into bars.

title: Super Easy Braided Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar oil and salt. Add three cups flour; mix well. Add enough flour to make a nice soft dough. Knead 8 minutes. Place in greased bowl. Let rise until double in size. Punch down. Divide in 3 parts. Roll out in strands 10 x 14-inches long. Braid and place on sheet either straight or crescent shaped. Let rise to double. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Cranberry Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine the cranberries apples sugar cinnamon and 1 tablespoon flour. Transfer the mixture to a greased 6-cup shallow baking dish. In same bowl (no need to wash it) combine the remaining flour brown sugar oats and nuts if desired. Stir in the melted butter. Mix the ingredients well (should be crumbly). Sprinkle the oat mixture over the fruit mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until the crisp is lightly brown. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Serves 12.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables in just enough water to cover until tender. Do not rinse. Add milk pepper and potato flakes. Simmer until thickened. (May use more instant potato flakes if you prefer a thicker soup.) You may also add diced ham canned salmon or bacon to this soup. Garnish with shredded cheese prior to serving.

title: Chicken Ala King
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan. Add flour salt and pepper making a paste. Add chicken broth and light cream slowly so it doesnt get lumpy. Add rest of ingredients and heat slowly stirring well. Serve in prepared patty shells.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together in large bowl.

title: Kathryn'S Almost Fried Fish
instructions: Dip fish in vinegar or soak if time permits. Mix together corn meal paprika garlic salt and pepper. Coat fish after vinegar with corn meal mixture. Place in baking dish. Sprinkle leftover mixture on top. Pour melted margarine over top and bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Do not turn. Yields 2 servings

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 5 dozen. Excellent frozen.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in baking dish and cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: French Salad Dressing
instructions: In blender grate onion garlic and vinegar. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Store in fridge.

title: Nacho Supreme
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in crock-pot. Cook until all melted. May add milk as needed for desired thickness. Pour cheese mixture over chips and add desired topping to your taste.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Melt in large saucepan margarine and brown sugar. Beat eggs and add to butter mixture. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate morsels on top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Livers And Potatoes
instructions: Clean and butter outside of potatoes. Wrap in aluminum and put in oven at 400\u00b0. Pour 1/4 cup of oil in frying pan. Clean and drain livers on paper towel. Add 1 cup flour salt and pepper into a large bowl. Put livers into flour mixture. Place in hot frying pan. Turn until done. When chicken livers are done take rest of flour mix and put in frying pan. Constantly stir until medium brown. Pour in water and onion and simmer. After potatoes are done slice open and pour livers and gravy mixture onto the split baked potato.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Combine sherry soy sauce oil ketchup pepper pepper sauce ginger and garlic and mix thoroughly for marinade. Pour marinade over chicken halves and let marinate overnight. Cook on open grill or in the oven until fork-tender.

title: Green Tomato Pickle *
instructions: Cut tomatoes and onions in small pieces. Combine peppers vinegar sugar tomatoes and onions in open kettle. Add sugar and salt. Boil at low temperature about 4 hours.

title: Chipped Beef Chicken
instructions: Mix soup and sour cream and pour into a greased casserole dish. Wrap each chicken breast in chipped beef and \bury\ it in soup mixture. Refrigerate until ready to bake. Bake uncovered for 3 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat the butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In a saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour until particles are like fine crumbs. Add milk and stir with a fork only until dough leaves the sides of the bowl. Turn out onto slightly floured board and knead until smooth. Roll out dough into a large rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle cinnamon over and spread fruit evenly over the dough. Roll up like a jelly roll. Dampen the edge of dough with a little water to seal. Slice lengthwise into about 16 slices 1/2-inch thick. Place in a pan with melted butter. Pour the sugar syrup carefully around the rolls. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Rouladen(Beef Rolls)
instructions: Pound meat until thin and nearly double in size. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Brown bacon and onions in small skillet then crumble. Place small amount of mustard on one side of meat; top with spoonful of bacon and onions. Roll up meat slices and tie with string or secure with toothpicks. Lightly coat with flour each roll of meat. Brown each roll in skillet turning until brown. Drain excess oil from skillet; add water bouillon and tomato sauce. Add water to cover meat rolls. Cook 1 hour until meat is tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in a baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place a slice of lemon on each chop. Sprinkle brown sugar on chops. Mix catsup and water; pour around chops until they are just covered. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until well done.

title: Hard Sauce
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well. Add remaining ingredients and beat with a spoon until smooth and fluffy.

title: Spanish Tomato Rice
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet cook bacon until crisp; remove. Pour off half the fat. In remaining fat cook onion and green pepper until tender but not brown. Add tomatoes water long grain rice chili sauce salt brown sugar Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Cover and simmer 35 to 40 minutes. Crumble bacon on top. Trim with parsley. Makes about 5 to 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
instructions: The catfish should be in the 8 to 10-inch range but chunks cut from bigger fish are commonly used. The best fat for deep frying is a mixture of two parts bacon drippings to one part lard. Heat the fat in a big deep kettle until it will brown a 1-inch cube of bread in 40 seconds. Mix salt and pepper with corn meal; roll the fish in it. Toss them into the kettle a few at a time so temperature of the fat will not be lowered abruptly. Three to four minutes cooks the fish thoroughly and browns the outside crisply. Drain on a stack of papers before serving. Have a crock of dill or sour pickles handy.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites gradually adding cream of tartar vanilla and pinch of salt. Fold in other ingredients and drop on very lightly greased cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Put in oven and let bake for 5 minutes and turn off the oven. Let them sit in oven for about 3 hours or until you are ready to take them out. Hence the name Forgotten.

title: Chicken Nugget Batter
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl or bag and shake to mix. Add chicken and shake until battered. Remove excess batter and deep-fry at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Grilled Portabella Bruschetta
instructions: 1. Clean off mushrooms and remove the gills. Place on a plate and drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and vinegar. Let stand for 30-60 minutes. Meanwhile start the grill to med-high.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs Karo salt and nuts. Place in an unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 420\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Test with a knife until clean.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine sesame oil and five-spice powder in a skillet and heat to medium-high heat; add beef and brown. Remove from pan.

title: Hot Chocolate Drink Mix
instructions: Stir until blended. Store in tight container. For hot chocolate use water just below boiling point. Amount used may be varied to suit individual tastes. About 3 tablespoons.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Cream shortening peanut butter sugar and brown sugar. Add milk and vanilla. Add flour soda and salt. Make into balls and roll into sugar. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes.

title: Pita Sandwich
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and stuff into pita halves.

title: Mama Alicia'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Place equal amounts of vegetable oil and lime juice in a small shallow bowl. Add sliced onions and very thin slices of radishes. Sprinkle with salt to taste. As this dressing sits it will take on the radishes pink color. Serve with a spoon over salad greens.

title: Duff'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Blend together water and powdered milk. Add eggs. Blend salt vanilla and sugar together. Mix well with first mixture. Add raisins and melted margarine to mixture. Mix torn bread into liquid mixture until lightly moistened. (Dont overmix.) Bake at 350\u00b0 in a well-greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan until light brown. Test by sticking a toothpick in center. If it comes out clean pudding is done. Top with Bread Pudding Sauce.

title: Choplet Parmesan
instructions: Grate Mozzarella cheese. Dip choplets in bread crumbs and fry. Put a small amount of sauce in bottom of baking dish. Layer choplets cheese and sauce alternately in that order reserving a small amount of cheese for top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 4. Goes well with creamed potatoes.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Mix last 3 ingredients and pour over chicken in pan. Bake covered in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. May want to remove cover for a while to reduce sauce.

title: Cherry Dream Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 pan. In large bowl combine cake mix 6 tablespoons butter and 1 cup oats. Mix until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs add egg and mix until well blended. Press into pan. Pour pie filling over crust. Spread to cover. To reserved crumbs add remaining 1/4 cup oats 2 tablespoons butter nuts and brown sugar. Beat until mixed. Sprinkle over cherry mixture. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook sugar and molasses until hard ball forms in cold water. Remove from heat; beat in 1 teaspoon soda and pour over popcorn. Shape into balls; dampen hands a little as needed.

title: Dried Apple Cake
instructions: Mix and stir well together. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken
instructions: Combine bread crumbs garlic and salt in a large zip-top plastic bag shaking well to combine. Combine lemon juice and oil. Brush over both sides of chicken. Place chicken one piece at a time in the bag shaking to coat. Remove chicken from bag and place in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish coated with vegetable cooking spray. Sprinkle remaining crumbs over chicken. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Serve with lemon wedges if desired.

title: Low-Fat Blueberry Cake
instructions: In large mixer bowl combine flour sugar baking powder salt applesauce milk and egg whites. Blend at low speed until dry ingredients are moistened; beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange blueberries on top. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Strawberries
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let stand in refrigerator for 1/2 hour. Shape into strawberries and roll in red sugar candy. Dip top in green sugar for leaves.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake Milk Brownies
instructions: Brownie Crust Stir together the brownie mix butter and chopped pecans to form a crumb mixture. Set aside 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture. Put remaining mixture in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan to form crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ground beef bread crumbs chopped onion salt pepper and egg in a bowl and form into small balls. Brown in 2 tablespoons shortening. Put in greased 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Slice 4 or 5 potatoes over the meat. Heat 1 can cream of mushroom soup and 1 can of milk until smooth. Pour over potatoes and meat. Bake covered 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 until potatoes are done.

title: Fried Corn Bread
instructions: Mix baking soda baking powder salt and sugar. Then add buttermilk and egg. Stir in cornmeal until batter is like thick pancake batter. Add one tablespoon of melted grease or cooking oil. Fry in hot skillet.

title: Beer Batter For Shrimp
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper. Beat eggs; add beer and half and half. Add flour and mix well. Let stand 1 hour at room temperature before using. Dip shrimp in batter; fry in Crisco until a golden color.

title: Cranberry Jello Salad
instructions: Combine lemon jello boiling water pineapple juice and vinegar. Let thicken a bit and add celery pineapple and cranberry. Mix all together and let stand in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Arrange tortilla chips in and up sides of large casserole dish. Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour into casserole dish and cover with grated cheese. Bake 1 hour in 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Italian Soup
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a rapid boil. Beat the eggs with the cheese and parsley. Pour slowly into the boiling soup stirring with a fork until egg mixture separates into little shreds. Remove from heat immediately to avoid toughening the eggs. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately with additional grated cheese. Serves 6.

title: Sweet Apple Butter
instructions: Cook apples in water in large saucepan until very tender. Press through food mill and measure 4 quarts applesauce. Bring to boil in large saucepan. Add sugar cinnamon candies and cinnamon. Cook until bubbly stirring constantly to dissolve sugar and candies. Stir in Sure-Jell. Cook for 10 minutes or until of desired consistency stirring constantly. Spoon into 16 hot sterilized half pint jars. leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Seal with 2-piece lids. Yield 16 half-pint jars.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together soup sour cream salt pepper 1/4 cup melted margarine onion flakes and grated cheese. Pour over the hash browns that have been thawed in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with crushed corn flakes. Drizzle with 1/2 stick melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruited Cheese Salad
instructions: Beat cottage cheese well. Add dry jello and beat well. Fold in Cool Whip and drained crushed pineapple. Chill about 1 hour. Serve topped with a cherry.

title: Italian Delight
instructions: In a skillet brown the ground round steak chopped onions and clove of garlic in olive oil. After browning meat add the corn tomatoes tomato soup and mushrooms. Stir to blend well. Mix cooked ingredients and noodles in a greased (I use Pam) casserole dish. Top mixture with cheese and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 8. Dont forget the green salad and garlic bread.

title: Marinated Zucchini Salad
instructions: Combine zucchini green pepper celery onion and pimiento in a medium bowl and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in a jar; cover tightly and shake vigorously. Pour marinade over vegetables; toss gently. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight. Serve with a slotted spoon. Makes 8 servings.

title: Marinated Italian Chicken
instructions: Prepare 1 cruet of Good Seasons dressing; mix in 1 clove of garlic. Pour over chicken. Store in airtight container in refrigerator for 4 to 6 hours or overnight. May be grilled or baked until done usually 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat with onion; drain off excess fat. Add tomato sauce tomato paste water salt pepper garlic powder sugar oregano and Parmesan cheese. Stir sauce. Simmer about 1 hour stirring occasionally. Cook noodles as directed on package.

title: Poor Boy'S Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Grease lightly and flour 2 (8 x 1 1/2-inch) round baking pans. Set aside. In large mixing bowl cut shortening into pancake mix until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Combine eggs 1 carton of yogurt brown sugar and milk. Add to dry ingredients stirring until moistened. Turn mixture into prepared pans. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until done. Cool 10 minutes on wire racks.

title: Carolyn'S Marinade(For Beef, Chicken Or Ribs)
instructions: Mix ingredients and marinate your favorite meats!

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken in mixture. Pour remaining mixture over chicken in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt-free lemon pepper. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine cake mix nuts and melted butter (mixture will be crumbly). Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Persimmon Pudding With Lemon Sauce
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar thoroughly. Add the sifted dry ingredients raisins and nuts. Fold in the persimmon milk and vanilla. Pour into a greased mold. Place in a pan of water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Glazed Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in skillet. Spoon off fat. Meanwhile in cup stir together cornstarch and 1/4 cup water until smooth. In same skillet combine 3/4 cup water onion soup mix and sugar. Add apples stirring to coat. Heat to boiling. Return chops to skillet. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook for 10 minutes or until chops are no longer pink. Remove chops and apples to serving platter. Keep warm. Over medium heat heat sauce to boiling. Gradually stir in cornstarch mixture. Cook until thickens stirring constantly. Spoon over pork chops and apples.

title: Southern Squash Casserole
instructions: Layer in large casserole dish 1/2 squash 1/2 stuffing 1/2 soup 1/2 sour cream and 1/2 spices and onion; repeat. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup bread crumbs and bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Tuna Croquettes With Hash Brown Patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Divide evenly into 4 well-greased custard cups. Place cups on rack and add the frozen hash brown potato patties. Spread with margarine. Bake at 375\u00b0 until well browned.

title: Make Day Before Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Cover and put in refrigerator overnight. Bake 1 hour or until set at 350\u00b0. Cover part of the time baked. Serves 8.

title: Bowzer Bones(A Treat For Your Dog)
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour oatmeal bacon crumbles and seasonings. Add eggs and gradually add broth until mixture is just moist enough to shape into a ball. (If too moist add a little more flour. If too dry add more broth). Generously flour work surface. Roll out mixture to a thickness of 1/4-inch. Dip edges of cookie cutter into vegetable oil and cut out shapes. Use a doggie bone cutter if available. They can sometimes be found in cookware shops. Place Bowzer Bones on microwave cookie sheet in a single layer do not crowd. Cook on High power for 8 to 10 minutes or until firm. Cool completely and store in airtight container. Makes 1 dozen bones.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash sweet potatoes. Mix sugar milk 1 stick butter eggs and vanilla with the potatoes. Pour the mixture into a baking dish. Melt together brown sugar 3/4 stick butter pecans and marshmallows. Pour over sweet potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45-60min. until bubbly and caramel looking on top.

title: Toffee
instructions: Cook in heavy sauce pan or skillet to cracking stage the brown sugar and butter stirring often to keep from scorching.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add 7-Up. Bake at 350\u00b0 until springs back to touch about 30 minutes.

title: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: Add 1/2 cup sugar lemon juice and salt to beaten egg yolks and cook in top of double boiler until custard consistency. Pour cold water in bowl and sprinkle gelatin on top of water. Add to hot custard and stir until dissolved. Add grated lemon rind cool. When mixture begins to thicken fold in stiffly beaten egg whites to which the other 1/2 cup sugar has been added. Fill baked pie shell; serve with whipped cream.

title: Honey Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in small amount of boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain. Reserve 1/4 cup of the carrot liquid.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix dry jello and thawed berries until dissolved. Add Cool Whip and blend together. Put in a large bowl; chill before serving.

title: 15 Bean Soup
instructions: *Fifteen varieties in one bag.

title: Scotcheroos
instructions: Measure corn syrup and sugar into large 3-quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring frequently until sugar dissolves and mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and mix well. Add rice cereal. Stir until well coated. Press mixture into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Set aside.

title: Impossible Custard Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Pour ingredients into blender and blend. Pour into 9-inch greased pie plate. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake for 35 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Crab Mold
instructions: Mix together soup and cream cheese in saucepan on low. Dissolve gelatine in water and add to soup mixture and reheat. Dont boil. Add celery green pepper onion shrimp crabmeat and mayonnaise. Pour in a large ring mold and chill 6 hours. Unmold and serve with crackers.

title: Nachos
instructions: Spread tortilla chips on a large baking sheet. Top each with beans and a few green chilies. Sprinkle each with a tablespoon of cheese. Place under broiler until cheese melts about 2 to 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Sunshine Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Blend the first 4 ingredients in food processor until fine. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour into baking cups in muffin tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen muffins.

title: Basic Pudding Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and store in covered container. Prepare as directed in individual recipe. Makes 24 servings.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and chop spinach; drain and chop water chestnuts. Combine all ingredients. Tear out center of bread into mouth-size pieces to make bowl for dip. Put dip in center of bread and use pieces of bread you tore out to dip in the dip.

title: Cream Puff Dessert
instructions: Beat cream cheese well. Add milk and pudding. Cover with Dream Whip and nuts.

title: Easy Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate (dough will keep a few days). Spoon batter into greased muffin tins until half full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and debone. Grease 11 x 17 dish. Place chicken on bottom broccoli on top. Combine soup lemon juice curry powder and mayonnaise. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with mixture of cheese bread crumbs and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Jello Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and water and cook until transparent. Remove from heat. Add 1/2 package of jello and 3 to 4 drops of red food coloring. Add the pint of strawberries. Pour into freshly baked crust. Chill in refrigerator. Serve with whip cream.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Stir ingredients together well and bake in 2-quart dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Date And Nut Bread
instructions: Combine nuts dates soda and salt in a mixing bowl. Add shortening and boiling water. Allow this mixture to stand for 15 minutes. Stir to blend. In a separate bowl beat the eggs slightly and add vanilla. Stir in sugar and flour. Add to date mixture. Do not overmix. Place in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour in 350\u00b0 (moderate) oven. When done toothpick inserted in the center will come out clean. Cool before removing. Loosen sides with a spatula. For perfect slicing allow the loaf to cool several hours.

title: 7 Layer Fiesta Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and seasoning mix. Spread on bottom of 9-inch pie plate or quiche dish. Layer guacamole salsa lettuce cheese onions and olives over cream cheese mixture. Serve immediately. Refrigerate any remaining dip. Serve with tortilla chips. Serves 6.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Peanut Butter Meltaway Cake
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients over low heat until bubbling and not lumpy. Pour hot mixture over the sugar and flour. Add the beaten eggs milk soda and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch pan or jelly roll pan. Pour batter into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Toll House Cookie Brittle
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.\tCombine in bowl the vanilla margarine and salt. Blend\twell. Gradually beat\tin sugar. Add flour and chocolate bits.\tPress evenly onto ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Press into the dough. Bake for 25 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.\tWatch until golden brown. Cool. Drain on paper towels and break into brittle.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Combine sausage and ground beef. Mix well. Add about 1/5 of the spices and flavoring 1/2 cup red wine and 1 tablespoon olive oil. Cook until brown. Add to sauce.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Brownies
instructions: Melt the butter. Add the remaining ingredients; beat well. Bake in large cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven; cover with miniature marshmallows. Bake until they are nicely puffed up. Frost while still warm.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add rest of the ingredients and beat well. Pour into a pastry-lined pie pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until a silver knife inserted 1-inch from side comes out clean.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients except walnuts; top with walnuts. Put in casserole or baking dish. Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Golden Raisin Salad Dressing
instructions: In pan mix vinegar and sugar. Stir and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and add dried onion. With mixer or whisk add oils. Add salt mustard and celery seed; mix well. Pour over salad.

title: Raisin No Knead Batter Bread
instructions: Insert dough hooks into mixer. Scald milk; add butter and cool to room temperature. Pour warm water into large mixing bowl; add yeast and dissolve thoroughly. Place milk mixture sugar salt raisins and 3 cups flour into mixer bowl. Turn mixer to speed #3 to moisten ingredients about 1/2 minute Turn mixer to speed #7 and mix thoroughly about 3 minutes. Gradually add 2 cups flour (reserve 1/4 cup flour for board and hands). Total mixing time should not exceed 8 minutes. Let dough rise in bowl for 30 minutes. Turn dough out onto heavily floured board; flour hands and divide dough in half. Form loaves. Place in two well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pans. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Baked loaf will sound hollow when tapped with knuckles.

title: Coconut Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl beat eggs. Add sugar; stir until sugar dissolves. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into prepared pastry shell. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until center is puffed. Cool. Chill. Garnish with whipped cream if desired. Refrigerate leftovers. One-half cup of flaked coconut may also be added if desired.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour soup and milk into a 2-quart casserole. Stir in chicken vegetables and thyme. Place biscuits over chicken mixture. Bake for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain; add butter and mash. Mix sugar egg mayonnaise nuts pepper onion salt and cheese. Add to squash. Pour into buttered dish. Top with bread crumbs and cheese. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add alternately small portions of flour and one egg at a time. Mix well after each addition. Add flavoring last. Bake in stemmed pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cheese Danish Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease muffin cups. Combine cream cheese and sugar in mixing bowl. Stir in egg until well blended. In separate bowl combine muffin mix and milk; stir just until blended. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Top each with about one tablespoon of cream cheese mixture. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until set.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix together eggs oil pumpkin and water in a bowl. In another bowl mix and sift all the dry ingredients together. Blend the dry mixture slowly into the wet mixture. Add nuts and stir until smooth. Use approximately three 8 x 4-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Separate broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces and wash. Drain. Combine all vegetables. Mix mayo sugar vinegar and salt and pour over vegetables. Let marinate at least 4 hours in refrigerator stirring several times.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Grate cheese. Cream butter flour and cheese. Add salt and pepper. Separate into 4 parts. Roll in small (1 1/2-inch) rolls. Wrap in wax paper and place in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Hershey'S Black Magic Cake
instructions: Beat on high for 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured pan. Batter will be thin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Cake will be moist.

title: Miracle Soup
instructions: Cut vegetables into bite size pieces and cover with water. Let it come to a boil. Add dry onion soup mix and other seasonings if desired. After the vegetables have boiled for at least 15 minutes lower heat and simmer until vegetables are soft.

title: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Season chicken and cook. Lightly butter pan. Put tortilla in pan. Place chicken onion and cheese on 1/2 of tortilla and fold in half. Cook until fairly toasted on one side and flip over. Cook until toasted and cheese is melted.

title: Sasha'S Favorite Lentil Soup
instructions: Bring the first five ingredients to boil in large covered kettle and simmer slowly for 15 minutes. Slowly saute onion carrots and parsley in oil in skillet 15 minutes. Combine mixtures. Add tomatoes. Simmer together for 30 minutes.

title: No-Peek Casserole
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 in a covered casserole for 3 hours. Dont peek! Serve over noodles.

title: Cottage Cheese Whip
instructions: Sprinkle Jell-O into cottage cheese and pineapple. Add oranges (no juice). Mix in large bowl.

title: Aunt Bea'S Perfect Cream Puffs
instructions: Combine boiling water butter or margarine and salt. Heat until boiling and stir vigorously then add flour all at once. Stir constantly until mixture forms a smooth ball and leaves sides of pan clean. Remove from heat and add eggs one at a time. Beat after addition until egg is blended and mixture is smooth. Continue beating until mixture is stiff and breaks when spoon is raised. Shape on a greased baking sheet with 2 tablespoons allowing 2 inches between each one. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.\tPlace on wire rack to cool; fill with cream filling ice cream or flavored whipped cream. Makes 12 Cream Puffs. They are wonderful.

title: Cream Cheese Blintzes
instructions: Roll bread flat with a rolling pin. Mix cream cheese 1/2 c. sugar and egg yolks together. Spread evenly over the bread and rollup lengthwise. Dip in melted butter and roll in cinnamon sugar. Cool in fridge for 20 minutes and then cut into thirds. This can be frozen at this point and stored up to 4 months. Bake 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or bubbly.

title: Lemon Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order given and refrigerate several hours before serving. Just before serving slice 3 bananas into salad. Coconut may also be used.

title: Traditional Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix thoroughly (softened) shortening sugar eggs and flavoring. Blend in flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. Cover and chill 1 hour. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured cloth covered board. Cut into shapes. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with sugar or decorate. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until very light brown. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour; set aside. Beat egg yolks and mix into sugar and flour mixture. Heat milk when it comes to a boil add the sugar and flour mixture to hot milk; stir constantly. When thick remove from heat. Add vanilla and coconut. Stir well and pour into baked pie shell. Beat egg whites and put on top of pie filling.

title: No Crust Apple Pie
instructions: Lightly grease 9-inch pie pan. Mix all ingredients and pour into pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Pack washed okra in sterilized jars. Boil all ingredients together. Pour over okra and seal. Cook in hot water bath no longer than 10 minutes. Do not boil hot pepper; place in jars along with okra being sure one pod is in each jar.

title: Baby Wipes
instructions: Mix all together and pour over folded paper towels (Bounty works best) in a Rubbermaid container.

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: *Colored marshmallows may also be used.

title: Cinnamon Graham Muffins
instructions: Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves(Makes 40)
instructions: Drain grape leaves. Place in a medium bowl. Cover with boiling water; let stand 20 minutes. Drain and discard water. In large skillet over medium heat heat vegetable oil. Add onion stirring occasionally about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Add rice and cook 1 minute. Add 2 cups of the water. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Stir scallions currants pine nuts parsley salt mint dill weed and pepper into rice until well combined. Remove from heat. Select the best grape leaves to stuff; reserve remaining leaves. On work surface place a grape leaf vein side up and stem towards you. Place about 1 tablespoon of rice mixture close to stem of leaf. Fold up bottom of leaf then fold in sides. Roll to form a rectangular package. Repeat until all stuffing is used. Use remaining leaves to line the bottom of a 3-quart saucepan. Place stuffed leaves in a single layer very close together in pan.

title: Fresh Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Bake crescent rolls on pizza pan for 7 minutes at 350\u00b0. Soften the cream cheese; mix with Ranch dressing then spread on cooled crescent roll crust. Put on the fresh vegetables ending with tomatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese. Chill at least 2 hours then cut into slices and serve.

title: Angels On Horseback
instructions: Place 4 graham crackers on a cookie sheet. Place chocolate bars on top of graham crackers. Turn oven setting to broil. Broil until chocolate bars are slightly melted. Remove from oven and place 3 marshmallows on each cracker. Return to oven and broil until marshmallows are slightly brown. Remove from oven and top with remaining graham crackers.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Simmer all ingredients until well done. Brown flour in shortening to thicken gumbo. Serve with rice.

title: Goody Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add 1/2 of the nuts; blend in flour and remainder of the nuts. Shape into small balls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) for 10 to 15 minutes. When cool roll in powdered sugar.

title: Green Beans Tuscany Style
instructions: Trim the beans and cut into 2-inch pieces. Steam the beans in boiling salt water over low heat until just tender. Drain thoroughly and cover with a cloth to keep warm. Heat butter and oil over moderate heat. Stir in 1/2 the sage or parsley and garlic. Saute 1 minute then add the beans. Season to taste with salt and freshly grounded pepper. Stir over low heat for 5 minutes. Mix in cheese. Serve with the remaining herbs sprinkled on top.

title: Apricot Cream Salad
instructions: Combine apricots and 2 cups water in saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 12 minutes or until apricots are soft. Drain reserving liquid. Prepare jello according to package directions using reserved liquid for part of the water. Refrigerate until partly thickened. Mash or puree apricots in food processor or blender. Add to partly thickened jello. Pour into lightly oiled 1 1/2-quart mold. Chill until firm.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of loaf pan.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Cook onion and pepper in boiling water until tender; drain. Stir in tomato soup eggs cheese bread crumbs salt pepper and thyme. Add meats mixing well. Shape into loaf in dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Portuguese Sweet Bread
instructions: Beat 6 eggs; reserve about 1 tablespoon to brush on top of the bread. Add 1 cup sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Pour this mixture into a \well\ youve made in 7 to 8 cups bread flour such as King Arthurs. Melt 1/4 pound butter in 3/4 cup warm milk and dissolve 2 yeast cakes or packages in 1/4 cup water. Mix it all together; add anise if desired then knead your dough for 15 minutes until it is quite dry and elastic. Add more warm milk or flour as needed. After two risings form the dough into 2 loaves in greased cake pans. When double slit top with a sharp knife and brush with reserved beaten eggs. Bake in a slow oven at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes until the bread sounds hollow when you rap it.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Place margarine in baking dish and melt; then add other ingredients and mix together. Place in 350\u00b0 oven and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Refrigerator Yeast Rolls
instructions: Place shortening sugar and salt in a bowl. Pour boiling water over them. Blend and cool. Add beaten eggs. Sprinkle yeast into lukewarm water and stir until dissolved. Combine with egg mixture. Add flour. Blend well cover and place in refrigerator for at least 4 hours. This dough should be in a large mixing bowl as it rises slightly in the refrigerator. Will keep a week to 10 days and may be used as needed. About 3 hours before using rolls roll into desired shape using only enough flour to handle easily. Place on greased pan and allow to rise at room temperature for about 3 hours or until double in size. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Jello Salad
instructions: Mix lemon jello lemon pudding tapioca pudding and boiling water. When it starts to thicken add oranges and crushed pineapple and mix then add container of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins with salt. Peel. Add 2 tablespoons butter and next 4 ingredients. Mix with a mixer just like mashed potatoes. Spoon mixture into 2-quart greased pan. Brush with 1 tablespoon melted butter and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be made ahead and refrigerated then cooked.

title: Herring Pate
instructions: Puree in processor. Put in crock cover and chill. Serve on party rye. Garnish with chopped ripe olives and chopped hard-cooked egg.

title: Ham, Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. In saucepan brown ham in margarine. Stir in soup milk and 3/4 cup cheese. Heat until cheese melts. Blend macaroni with sauce. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter well then add eggs one at a time. Alternately add flour and sour cream. Add flavoring. Use a Bundt pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. For best results have butter eggs and sour cream at room temperature.

title: Greek Lemon Cake
instructions: In large mixer bowl combine cake mix and farina. Add milk eggs and oil. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for length of time given on cake mix package. Stir in 3/4 cup nuts. Divide batter evenly between two greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done. Place on wire racks not removing cakes from pans.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Soak sliced cucumbers for 24 hours in lime and 2 gallons of water. Stir once in a while. Wash 3 times in fresh water. Soak in clean water 4 hours. Wash 3 times.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and pour in pie shells. Bake in moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Put sugar Karo syrup water and salt together. Boil until it begins to spin threads. Add peanuts and cook until they are brown. Take up and add soda. Beat and pour quickly into a greased pan.

title: Buttery Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan heat sugar syrup and water until sugar dissolves. While syrup boils stir in butter and stir often. Heat to 230\u00b0. Add nuts. Heat to 280\u00b0 then stir constantly to 305\u00b0. Remove from heat. Quickly stir in soda; mix well. Pour onto 2 cookie sheets then stretch by lifting and pulling from edges. With a fork loosen from pan as soon as possible and break into pieces.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Blend flour margarine and confectioners sugar. Press evenly in 8 x 8-inch square pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Beat together 2 eggs sugar salt lemon juice and flour. Pour over baked crust and bake 20 to 25 minutes more until golden brown (lightly golden). Do not overbake. Cool and cut into small bars and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Brenda'S Mini Rye Appetizers
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Spread onto bread slices. Broil a short time until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Ice Cream Surprise
instructions: Arrange ice cream sandwiches in a 9 x 13 serving dish. Cut if needed. Prick with fork. Pour syrup over ice cream using as much as desired. Sprinkle with half pecan and candy pieces. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle remaining pecans and candy on top. Freeze until ready to serve.

title: Creamy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Rinse wild rice in cold water. Add with 1/2 teaspoon salt to 2 cups boiling water. Cook 20 minutes. Add long-grain rice remaining 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook 20 minutes.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Mix well pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool completely. Cream the cheese and blend in 3/4 cup sugar. Add the Cool Whip and marshmallows. Spread over the cooled pretzels. Dissolve the jello in boiling water; add frozen strawberries breaking up with a fork as you stir. Chill until slightly thickened. Pour over Cool Whip layer; chill until set.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Place beans in casserole dish. Add soup cheese and water chestnuts. Mix together. Top with additional cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Almond Brown Rice Stuffing
instructions: Cook almonds in margarine in large skillet over medium-high heat until golden brown. Add apples onion celery poultry seasoning thyme and pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in rice; cook until thoroughly heated. Serve or use as stuffing for poultry or pork roast. Stuffing may be baked in covered baking dish at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain cooked squash. Combine soup mayonnaise eggs butter stuffing mix and onion. Add to squash and stir. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 mins.

title: Mom'S Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef onion garlic oregano and basil in skillet. Add soup water and vinegar. Simmer for 30 minutes. Arrange layers of sauce noodles cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. End with sauce and Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; pick off bone. Boil noodles in chicken broth; drain. Mix both soups and Ro-Tel together. Mix noodles chicken and soup together. Put in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake until cheese melts.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a 9-inch tube pan or loaf pans. Bake at 250\u00b0 about 1 1/2 hours or when cake leaves sides of pan.

title: Heavenly Chocolate Truffles(Microwave)
instructions: In glass bowl mix milk and cocoa. Stir in chips. Microwave on High 2 minutes until chips are melted stirring after each minute. Stir in flour and vanilla. Stir in marshmallows until melted. Chill 2 hours until firm. Shape balls of about 1 teaspoon of chocolate mixture. Roll balls in powdered sugar graham cracker crumbs or cocoa mixed into powdered sugar. Keep mixture cold while rolling into balls. Chill 1 hour. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Eat More
instructions: Cook noodles 10 minutes. Drain; cook celery and tomatoes together. Brown meat and onion. Place all in casserole adding salt pepper and red pepper. Add chili powder. Let simmer in oven at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours covered. Serves 6. Sprinkle cheese on top if desired.

title: Frozen Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. Next day stir and add more mayonnaise if necessary.

title: Egg Nog Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco vanilla and sugar together. Add baking powder and salt. Add 1 cup flour then 1/3 cup egg nog alternately until all are in. Roll into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar-nutmeg mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Ham And Cheese Rolls
instructions: Beat cream cheese with scallions until smooth. Spread approximately 1/4 of cheese mixture onto each ham slice. Starting at long edge roll up jelly roll fashion. Place rolls on plate and refrigerate covered for 2 hours or until firm. Before serving cut into 1/2-inch slices. Serves 24.

title: Parsley Bake Rice With Vegetables
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Wash rice. Add chicken broth butter and rice. Cook for 10 minutes. Add other ingredients. Cook for 25 minutes. Stir twice. Keep rice covered while cooking.

title: Lasagna Supreme
instructions: Cook pasta. Cook ground beef and onions together; drain. Add all seasonings tomatoes (cut up) tomato sauce and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Cook for 20 minutes.

title: Rich Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Heat margarine salt and pepper over medium heat until margarine melts stirring constantly. Stir in flour. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in cheese until melted.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: In saucepan heat tomatoes croutons yellow corn and 1/2 parmesan until croutons are soggy.\tCut zucchini lengthwise scoop out middle and stuff with tomato crouton stuffing.\tCover with rest of parmesan.

title: Veg Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well. Crumble the crackers; spread on top. Melt the oleo; pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Vanilla Wafers
instructions: Thoroughly cream butter shortening and sugar. Add vanilla and salt. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each. Stir in sifted all-purpose flour. Mix well.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Brown ribs in skillet. Transfer ribs to baking dish. Place sliced onions over the top. Mix ketchup chili powder liquid smoke sugar lemon juice and water and pour over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 2 hours. Baste occasionally. May add more water if too dry.

title: A Happy Home
instructions: Take love and loyalty and mix faith. Blend it with tenderness and understanding; add friendship and hope. Sprinkle with laughter. Bake it with sunshine. Serve daily with generous helpings.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Cut zucchini and pepper into strips. Remove skin from chicken and cut into strips. Heat the oil in a skillet and fry the chicken strips over medium heat until chicken turns white. Add the remaining ingredients except tortillas and stir-fry until vegetables are crisp-tender about 5 minutes. Divide the mixture evenly into 6 servings. Place a serving of chicken mixture in center of each tortilla. Fold over in half to form the fajita. Serve with fresh salsa.

title: Chili Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Prepare corn bread batter according to package directions. Stir in the chilies cumin oregano and sage. Spread in a greased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate chips sweetened milk and butter on low heat. Add sifted flour to pan. Add nuts and vanilla. Drop by tablespoon or larger on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool on rack after 2 minutes and hide in tin or they will magically vanish.

title: Apple Glazed Spareribs
instructions: Cut spareribs into serving size pieces meaty side down. Combine jelly with vinegar stirring until jelly dissolves. Mix in teriyaki sauce and green onions; brush ribs with mixture. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Discard foil and turn ribs over; brush with remaining sauce. Bake 30 minutes longer or until tender turning ribs over and basting every 10 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Press hamburger meat in bottom of casserole dish. Spread soup over meat. Cover with cheese slices. Top with Tater Tots. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until Tater Tots brown.

title: Crab Pizza
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in mixer. Spread mixture on serving plate. Mix cocktail sauce and chili sauce. Spread on top of cheese mixture. Top with crab meat. Garnish with parsley (optional).

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and water in saucepan. Cook until mixture reaches 270\u00b0 (if small nuts) or 260\u00b0 (if large nuts). Add peanuts and cook until mixture reaches 300\u00b0 then add baking soda and vanilla. Stir and let it rise; stir again and let it rise the second time. Pour onto 2 buttered cookie sheets. Pull from edges into center until thin. Let cool.

title: Mixed Vegetables
instructions: Adjust quantities of ingredients to taste and number to be served.

title: Berry Cobbler
instructions: Layer the red raspberries on the bottom of a sprayed 9x13-inch cake pan. Then layer the blueberries on top of the raspberries. Sprinkle cake mix on top of berries. Pour Diet 7-Up all over the top of the cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40-50 minutes.

title: Cake Mix
instructions: Stir flour baking powder salt and sugar in a large pan. (A dishpan is good.) Sift 3 times. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender fingertips or a detachable mixer at low speed. (Shortening must be blended uniformly.) Store in covered container at room temperature.

title: Quick And Easy Candy
instructions: Melt chips over hot water in double boiler. Stir in nuts. Drop by teaspoon on buttered waxed paper and let set.
