title: Easy Roast Turkey Breast(Moist And Delicious)
instructions: You will need 1 large oven cooking bag (20 x 14-inch) with tie.

title: Raisin Honey Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream the honey sugar butter and egg. Sift together the flour salt cinnamon and soda. Stir into creamed mixture. Add rolled oats and raisins. Drop by heaping teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake on upper shelf of moderately hot oven (375\u00b0) for 12 to 14 minutes until lightly browned. Cool on racks.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crackers and margarine. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Add crackers to melted margarine and sprinkle over casserole. Bake another 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Orange Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift flour; measure and sift with other dry ingredients. Combine shortening eggs and orange juice. Stir liquid mixture into dry ingredients. Mix only until moistened; do not stir out lumps. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Pour hot milk over butter. Add sugar and salt; stir well. Crumble yeast in warm water. Let set. When milk is cool add yeast and beaten eggs. Slowly add flour (not necessary to use all the flour). Knead until smooth. Let rise double in size. Knead down and roll out. Spread with butter (oleo). Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll and slice; let rise. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown about 15 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in oil. Add green peppers carrots and onion. Sprinkle with garlic and onion powder. Saute briefly. Add broth soy sauce sugar vinegar and pineapple with juice. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice. If you prefer rice can be served separately.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix well; pour into large pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick Barbecue
instructions: Fry ground beef until well done. Pour chili sauce and tomato soup into frying pan. Add salt and pepper. Let simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sheath Cake
instructions: Place sugar and flour in bowl. Place in boiler the oleo Crisco water and cocoa. Bring this to a boil stirring constantly. Pour over ingredients in bowl. Add buttermilk eggs cinnamon soda and vanilla; mix. Grease and flour 10 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Heat tomato soup gelatine and cream cheese until creamy. Add chopped onion pepper celery and mayonnaise. Add shrimp. Pour into mold and refrigerate until set. Serve with crackers. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water. Drop frozen berries in hot mixture. When berries are thawed add pineapple. Pour 1/2 of the mixture into a pan. Refrigerate until congealed. Spread sour cream over top. Add the other 1/2 of the mixture over top and refrigerate until congealed.

title: Mayonnaise Cake(When You Are Out Of Eggs)
instructions: Sift sugar flour cocoa baking powder soda and salt into mixing bowl. Add water mayonnaise and vanilla. Mix well and bake in loaf pan 50 to 60 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Italian Chicken(Method:  Foil Dinner)
instructions: Place 3 tablespoons rice in center of each 8 (12-inch) squares of heavy-duty aluminum foil. Sprinkle chicken on both sides with 1/2 teaspoon salt and place on rice. Drain mushrooms; reserve 1/2 cup liquid. Divide mushrooms zucchini green peppers and onions into 8 equal portions. Place one portion over each chicken quarter. In large bowl mix together the tomato sauce 1/2 cup mushroom liquid oregano and basil; spoon over vegetables and chicken. Fold foil using drugstore wrap method. Be sure seals are tight. Bake in coals for approximately 1 hour. When chicken is cooked through open foil packets sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve.

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Dip chicken in melted butter; coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Creamy Fruit Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine fruit cocktail bananas apple grapes cherries and marshmallows. Fold in whipped cream; refrigerate. Serve cold. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Sift flour baking powder salt and cinnamon together; fold into pumpkin mixture. Grease and flour a 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Spread batter evenly in pan. Sprinkle nuts on top; bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Sprinkle powdered sugar on a clean dish towel; turn cake out on towel. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top of cake. Roll long side of cake and towel together; let cool. While cake is cooling beat together the last 4 ingredients. Unroll cake; spread this mixture over top. Roll back up and chill. Slice and eat.

title: Simple Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix milk and Cool Whip together adding just enough lemon juice to thicken mixture. Pour into pie shells; garnish with strawberries.

title: Heavenly Delight
instructions: With mixer blend together cream cheese lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk. Then add Cool Whip pineapple and pecans. Put in a pie shell and chill at least 2 hours.

title: Spiced Warm Cider
instructions: Combine cider and frozen orange juice in small soup pot. Place cinnamon sticks cloves and allspice in double layer of cheesecloth tied with kitchen string. Lower bag into juice. Simmer mixture covered for 1 hour over low heat. Strain if not using cheesecloth bag. Serve cider warm (it can be reheated). Recipe makes 33 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Pesto Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender starting at slow speed. Can be frozen and heated as needed. Serve over pasta or on pizza.

title: Tang Salad
instructions: Mix juices with Tang and instant pudding. Mix and pour over fruit.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Boil spaghetti as directed on package. Mix onion tomatoes green pepper mustard and sugar in a large bowl. After draining spaghetti place on bowl with the other ingredients. Mix. Stir in the Creamy Italian dressing. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Irish Potato Rolls
instructions: Mix together potato water salt and sugar. Sprinkle yeast on top and stir to dissolve. Add eggs and shortening. Mix mashed potatoes in gradually and enough flour for a stiff batter; beat until smooth. Add remaining flour and knead until smooth and elastic. Place in refrigerator in a greased covered container. Take out about 2 hours before needed. Shape and let them rise about 1 or 1 1/2 hours. Butter if you wish before baking at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. This will keep in the refrigerator for several days.

title: Chess Pie(My Original)
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar gradually then remainder of ingredients and beat well with mixer. Pour into unbaked pie shell and cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until pie is set. Meringue can be used and does improve looks and taste.

title: Peachy Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients pour over chicken. Use 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven uncovered basting occasionally until done (depends upon what part of chicken you use) 40 minutes. Serve with broiled can peaches if desired.

title: Make Ahead Cookie Mix
instructions: In a very large bowl combine butter salt and baking powder. Using electric mixer combine well. Add flour to butter mixture; blend until fine crumbs form scraping bowl often. Store in tightly covered bowl in refrigerator up to 4 weeks. Makes 8 cups mix.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Congealed Cherry Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit together. Save 1 1/2 cups juice and set aside. Bring the juice to boil and dissolve gelatin in it. Add cold water and chill. Fold in fruit and pecans. Pour into 6-cup mold or 11 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water and let cool until begins to thicken. Wash and chop cranberries add sugar oranges pineapple and nuts. Add this to jello mixture and let set. Real good with dressing.

title: Favorite Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Sift flour and measure. Add liquid and flour alternately beginning and ending with flour. Add flavoring. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured tube pan for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Combine 1/3 cup soup and 1/4 cup milk. Set aside. On waxed paper lightly coat chicken with flour; dip into soup mixture. On another piece of waxed paper coat chicken with stuffing. Arrange chicken on baking sheet. Drizzle with margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. In 1 quart saucepan combine remaining soup 1/4 cup milk parsley and lemon juice. Over low heat heat through stirring occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Lo-Cal Carrot Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill well before serving.

title: Ugly Duckling Cake
instructions: Blend ingredients and beat by hand for 2 minutes. Spread in 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan. Sprinkle on top 1/2 cup brown sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Baby Plum Cake
instructions: Mix sugar flour and spices. Sift twice. Add oil and eggs. Beat with mixer after each. Fold in plums vanilla and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Top with confectioners sugar (sift on top).

title: Shrimp Spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook the first 6 ingredients about 10 minutes and add shrimp. Add alternately in layers spaghetti and the sauce in a 2-quart casserole. Add the grated cheese on top and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts. Add salt pepper and seasoned salt to taste. Save broth. Cut chicken into small pieces. Place in baking dish (approximately 9 x 13).

title: Fruit Glace
instructions: Drain all fruits and save 1 1/2 cups fruit juice. Mix juices flavoring and pudding mix. Pour over fruit and chill.

title: Jalapeo Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornmeal flour sugar salt and baking powder. Set aside. Lightly beat eggs milk and oil. Add flour mixture cream corn chilies cheese and onion; mix well. Pour into greased 13 x 9 pan. Bake 25 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Grandburgers
instructions: Combine all ingredients drop on oiled pan and brown on both sides gravy or sauce on bun. Place bouillon cubes in cup of hot water and pour over grandburgers. Serves 5 to 6. Cooking time Browning turn.

title: German Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients together until thick stirring constantly. Add last 3 ingredients. Let cool and spread over chocolate cake.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie(Yields One 10-Inch Pie)
instructions: Cook raisins in 1 cup water until hot and plump. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. In a small bowl combine cornstarch and cold water. Add to raisin mixture. Boil 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Gradually whisk half of raisin mixture into yolks stirring constantly. Return to the rest of the hot raisin mixture; whisk to blend. Return to stove; boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Add sour cream and vanilla. Pour into shell.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies and add to vanilla ice cream. Add Cool Whip; mix well. Store in freezer.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unwrap dinner rolls and lay flat in jelly roll pan to form \crust\ for chopped vegetables. Bake 10 minutes until done in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool.

title: Hot Chicken Sandwich Filling
instructions: Cook chicken until done. Remove bones from chicken. Grind chicken. Bring 2 cups milk to a boil. Add flour cold milk salt and pepper to boiling milk. Cook until it forms a sauce. Pour over ground chicken. If filling is a little thin add crushed cracker crumbs to thicken.

title: Barbecue Green Beans
instructions: Brown bacon and onions in skillet. Add catsup brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer 2 minutes. Place beans in a casserole. Pour bacon mixture over top but do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pasta With Vodka And Tomato Cream Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and oil in pan. Add onion and saute until translucent about 8 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook until reduce to almost no liquid remains in pan about 25 minutes. Add cream vodka and red pepper. Boil until thickened about 4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream together the first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Place rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Linda'S Lasagne
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain excess fat. Add spaghetti mix then tomato sauce and tomato paste. Let simmer. Cook lasagne according to package directions. Drain noodles.

title: Pineapple And Apricot Salad
instructions: Drain the juice from the pineapple and apricots. Save juices. Dissolve the jello in the hot water. Add 1/2 of each juice. When jello thickens add 3/4 cup mashed apricots and marshmallows. Refrigerate until firm. When set spread the top with the following.

title: Fake Apple Dumplings
instructions: Tear bread into stuffing like pieces. Place in deep dish bowl. Place applesauce on top of bread. Place brown sugar on top and sprinkle with cinnamon. Heat in microwave for 1 minute. Pour milk over and serve or place back into microwave to heat milk also.

title: Seafood Scampi
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet on medium-high. Saute onion (cut in wedges) green pepper (cut in strips) and garlic (diced) for 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; stir 3 minutes. Add fettucini; toss and heat through. Serves 4.

title: Pineapple Shake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: The School'S Peanut Butter Fingers
instructions: Mix ingredients in order. Bake in a greased jelly roll pan and large Pyrex cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overcook!

title: Oven Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes and slice into 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick slices leaving skins on. Place in ovenproof pan. Melt margarine and pour over potatoes. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. May be microwaved for 10 minutes or until potatoes are cooked thoroughly (omit foil and use plastic wrap to top dish).

title: Dolores Fredette'S Foolproof Pie Crust
instructions: In large bowl mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until crumbly. In small bowl beat water vinegar and egg. Add to flour mixture and stir well until all ingredients are moistened. Wrap in wax paper and chill for at least 1/2 hour. Then proceed as usual. This dough will always be flaky tender and delicious no matter how much it is handled. Dough can be kept 3 to 4 days in the refrigerator.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Crust Mix flour butter and nuts together. Pat into flat crust in a 13 x 9-inch glass dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Set aside to cool.

title: Kentucky Prune Cake
instructions: Blend together sugar oil and eggs. Sift together flour soda cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Add to sugar eggs and oil. Beat well. Add buttermilk vanilla prunes and nuts. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Test until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Country Potato Chowder
instructions: In a Dutch oven cook bacon over medium heat until crisp; remove with a slotted spoon to paper towels. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. In the drippings saute onion and celery until tender. Sprinkle with flour and stir until blended. Gradually add cream. Stir in the potatoes soup parsley Worcestershire sauce seasoned salt and pepper. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 minute. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Add the carrots and beans. Cover and simmer 15 minutes longer or until the vegetables are tender. Stir in corn and reserved bacon; heat through. Yields 12 servings.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook and stir hamburger and onion in butter in 10-inch skillet until hamburger is light brown. Stir in flour salt garlic pepper and mushrooms. Cook stirring constantly 5 minutes. Stir in soup. Heat to boiling stirring constantly; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream and heat thoroughly. Serve over hot noodles.

title: Oven-Fried Vegetables
instructions: Spray a cold baking sheet with nonstick coating spray. Set aside.

title: Chunky Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: In a large pot saut onion and chicken in margarine for 5 minutes. Add soups carrots and mushrooms. Thin mixture with milk giving a smooth soup base. Heat through. Add Velveeta and allow to melt before serving.

title: Mayonnaise
instructions: Mix vinegar and butter in double boiler and boil. Blend sugar flour and eggs. Add slowly to vinegar mixture. Cook and stir until thick. Take off heat and add 1 heaping tablespoon mustard and 1/2 pint of mayonnaise. Makes 1 pint.

title: Forty-Clove Chicken Filice
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a shallow baking pan skin side up. Sprinkle all ingredients evenly over chicken. Squeeze juice from lemon and pour over top. Cut remaining lemon rind into pieces and arrange throughout chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Barbecue Roast
instructions: Rub sugar into meat and cook covered over low heat with a little water. When done pull apart or shred meat into a heavy saucepan. Mix remaining ingredients. Simmer. Makes excellent sandwiches.

title: Lime Punch
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a 1 1/2 gallon container stirring until sugar dissolves. Add lemon juice and next 3 ingredients stirring until blended. Cover and chill. Pour mixture into a large punch bowl gently stirring in chilled ginger-ale. Yield - 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Nannie'S Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Cook apples and run through colander to make 6 cups of applesauce. Place in crock-pot with remaining ingredients on high for 1/2 hour. Turn down on low and cook all night with lid on. Next morning remove lid and cook down to desired thickness. While hot pour in jars and cover with hot lids.

title: Orange Sliced Candy Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together well and set aside. Cream margarine; gradually add sugar then eggs one at a time. Mix baking soda with buttermilk and add alternately with flour. Mix well. Add the candy mixture. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes (sometimes a little longer).

title: Giant Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. In large bowl cream butter until fluffy then add sugar gradually. Beat until light. Beat in egg and vanilla until fluffy. Stir in flour mixture chips and nuts until well mixed. Shape in 2-inch balls. Do not flatten. Place 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets (six per sheet). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 23 minutes until golden and edges are light brown.

title: Open Faced Pizza Burgers
instructions: Cook patties. Arrange on bun halves. Add 2 tablespoons pizza sauce and top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mashed Potato Doughnuts
instructions: Mix enough flour to roll well. Roll out and cut. Fry in deep oil; Crisco would be a very good oil.

title: Stuffed Angel Food Cake(Enough For Two Cakes!)
instructions: Fold in the ingredients and pack into cakes. Place tops on cakes and frost. Frosting may be tinted.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour shortening and salt. Add water slowly until mix is not too sticky. Roll out dough and cut. Fit around your baking dish. Pour can of peaches. Add 2 teaspoons nutmeg. Roll out crust to top your dish. Prick crust with fork and sprinkle sugar and nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and done.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar or frost (cake is moist).

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potatoes into a large bowl; toss with lemon juice coating thoroughly. Let stand 5 minutes; drain well. Add melted butter flour onions egg salt pepper and baking powder. Stir to mix well.

title: Strawberry Pecan Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and jello; beat in the oil and milk. Add 1 egg at a time. Add berries coconut and pecans. Make 3 layers and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Dark Fruitcake
instructions: Grease 3 (8 x 4 x 2-inch) loaf pans or 2 (10 x 3 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf dessert pans. Line bottom and sides of pans with brown paper to prevent overbrowning. Grease paper. In a saucepan melt butter; cool. Stir together flour baking powder cinnamon nutmeg allspice cloves and 1 teaspoon salt. Add mixed fruits and peels dates cherries raisins almonds pecans and pineapple. Mix until well coated. Beat eggs until foamy. Add brown sugar orange juice molasses and butter; beat until blended. Stir into fruit mixture.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken bouillon and water. Add all other ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes.

title: My Own Thing Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Arrange rhubarb in greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Sprinkle with sugar and gelatin. Top with marshmallows. Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Spread evenly over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes until cake tests done. Cool 5 minutes then turn out of pan upside down on serving tray. Serve warm with whipped cream if desired. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Slice squash and onion. Boil until tender. Drain water. Add egg bread crumbs and 1 1/2 cups cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: In a large bowl combine crumbs morsels and nuts; mix well. Stir in condensed milk. Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Line with waxed paper and grease again. Spread mixture in pan and bake 40 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. When inserted toothpick comes out clean remove from pan and peel off paper. Cool and cut into bars. Tightly cover leftovers.

title: Super Sandwich
instructions: Put cheese Spam onion and olives in food grinder. Add tomato paste. Put in hot dog buns. Wrap in foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Cook in crock-pot for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Chicken Broccoli Orientale
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat in hot oil cook chicken 1/2 at a time until brown. Add onion and pepper. Cook 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Toast pecans in margarine in a skillet over low heat; stir constantly (will burn easily). Heat until brown but not burned; set aside to cool. Mix sugar eggs vanilla butter flavoring and part of the milk in a blender. Add to 1 1/2 gallon ice cream freezer. Add pecans. Add remainder of milk enough to fill the container.

title: Fiesta Bean Dip
instructions: Stir together and heat in microwave for 4 minutes. Stir and serve with corn tortilla chips.

title: Salmon And Mushrooms
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter until tender (about 3 to 5 minutes). In remaining butter stir in flour until well blended. Add milk and stir slowly until sauce thickens. Add sauteed onions and mushrooms wine and salt and pepper to taste. Stir in salmon and cook until heated. Serve over pasta egg noodles or rice.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: *Cook rice as directed but only for 5 minutes. Add liquid that is left in rice to meat and tomato mixture.

title: Cabbage And Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Cut up cabbage and boil until tender. Mash cabbage and measure 5 cups. Cook ground meat until brown. Add onions bell peppers and seasonings. Stir. Add cabbage Ro-Tel and mushroom soup and stir. Crumble Ritz crackers (all but about 5). Grate cheese and save 1/4 cup. Add cheese and crackers to ground meat mixture. Place in 2-quart casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven and sprinkle remaining cheese and crackers on top. Return to oven and bake about 10 minutes.

title: Bacon Poles
instructions: On a plate place 2 layers of paper towels. Wrap a strip of bacon around each breadstick in a spiral fashion. Place on paper towel not touching each other. Do 8 at a time and arrange in a circle. Cover with a single layer paper towel and microwave for 4 to 5 minutes on High until bacon is crisp.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Add rest of ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground hamburg both onion soup mix all of sour cream and bread crumbs then make into meatballs. Put in a pan. Pour in mushroom soup over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes covered with foil. Bake for 10 minutes uncovered. Enjoy!

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Mix together vanilla wafers powdered sugar cocoa white syrup chopped nuts and bourbon. Roll into balls then roll in powdered sugar. Make a few days ahead of time and store in airtight container.

title: Okra-Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat 10 to 15 minutes or until sausage browns; drain. Add water and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Blend together and press in pan. Bake in slow oven (350\u00b0) until light brown. Cool.

title: Fat Corn Muffins
instructions: Sift together flour cornmeal sugar baking powder and salt into a small bowl. Combine eggs butter and milk. Add to dry ingredients. Stir just enough to moisten. Spoon batter into greased 3-inch muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or more.

title: Horseradish Dip For Broccoli
instructions: Mix all together and serve with steamed broccoli.

title: Crab Meat Spread
instructions: Wash crab meat briefly with cold water; remove any pieces of shell and drain. Mix horseradish and chili sauce. Starting with chili sauce mixture alternate layers of sauce mixture and crab meat over cream cheese bar. Finish with layer of chili sauce. Serve with crackers.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Beat cream cheese and Miracle Whip good. Add the rest of ingredients. Chill. Form into a ball and roll in chopped nuts (finely chopped). Serve with a variety of crackers.

title: Applesauce Wheat Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and let set. Melt lard and honey. Add salt and applesauce. Add this to yeast mixture. Mix flours and add one cup at a time. Bake at 300\u00b0. Makes 4 to 5 loaves. Stays moist and chewy!

title: Best Old Fashioned Kolaches
instructions: Warm milk to lukewarm pour into bowl. Add yeast and stir until dissolved. Add sugar 2 cups flour and mix well until smooth. Place bowl in a warm place and let rise about 30 minutes. Stir in beaten eggs melted margarine and salt. Gradually mix in three remaining cups of flour. Work dough until smooth and elastic. Let rise until bowl is full or dough doubles in size about 1 hour.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: In 2-quart oblong casserole dish (microwavable) place potatoes and onions. Cover with Saran Wrap. Microwave on High for 7 minutes. Stir and microwave 7 more minutes. Remove and add rest of ingredients. Stir in. Bake uncovered 1/2 hour to 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet Applets Muffins
instructions: Sift together first 3 ingredients. Set aside. Add sugar gradually to shortening creaming well. Blend in egg; mix well. Add milk alternately with dry ingredients. Stir in apples. Fill well-greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool for 10 minutes. Dip in melted oleo then roll in mixture of 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon.

title: Birthday Icing
instructions: Put sugar shortening and salt in a bowl; mix. Add water. Beat 30 seconds. Makes icing for three 8 inch layers.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Thaw lemonade. Mix in Cool Whip and condensed milk. Spread in pie shells. Chill for approximately 1 hour.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Combine in large bowl. Do not mash or pack down. (Should be coarse and loose.) Use food processor if you like but dont make it mushy. Keeps refrigerated for 3 weeks. Can be used for stuffing celery for sandwiches or on crackers.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients put in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until thick. Stir every 30 minutes. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; shape into small balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes (375\u00b0 may be best if they brown too soon). May be refrigerated overnight before baking.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
instructions: Mix together pears sugar and pecans. Set aside 1 hour stirring often. Sift all dry ingredients. Add to pear mixture. Mix eggs and oil and stir in well with wooden spoon. Pour in 10-inch tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Nut Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts in top of double boiler. Place over simmering water and stir until smooth. Add nuts and mix. Spread candy quickly in buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Cool cut in squares. Makes 2 dozen pieces.

title: Turkey And Tortilla Casserole
instructions: In a bowl combine turkey soup chilies salsa olives onions and cumin. Set aside. Arrange half the tortilla strips in a well-greased shallow 3-quart casserole or a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover evenly with half the turkey mixture and all the Jack cheese. Top with remaining tortilla strips and remaining turkey. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese evenly over all. (At this point you may cover and refrigerate until next day.) Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and mixture is heated through. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into squares. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Whoopie Pies
instructions: Mix thoroughly together shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in sour milk hot water baking powder flour cocoa and soda. Mix together and drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350 for about 10 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon. Pour into casserole. Top with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add other ingredients and stir until smooth.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Combine relish onion horseradish mustard and seasonings. Fold in sour cream. Cover and chill.

title: Microwave Cheesy Chalupas
instructions: In a 2-quart glass mixing bowl combine the first 6 ingredients. Mix well. Cook on maximum power uncovered for 5 to 6 minutes or until heated through stirring twice.

title: Avice'S Beans(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Cook until skins burst. Leave this water on and mix all ingredients together. Cook 6 to 8 hours at 250\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 (No. 2 on Hi on crock-pot).

title: Pink Salad
instructions: Combine cottage cheese and jello. Then add Cool Whip. Refrigerate then serve as dessert.

title: Crush Punch
instructions: Mix pineapple and lemon juice together and set aside. Mix strawberry Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Cook sugar with 3 cups boiling water until syrup turns clear. Add Jell-O mixture to syrup then add pineapple-lemon juice. Add almond extract last and mix well.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Boil corn 8 minutes in unsalted water. Drain. Cool in cold water. Cut kernels from ears without scraping. Measure 1 1/2 quarts kernels. Use stainless or enamel saucepan. Combine celery peppers onion salt vinegar sugar and celery seed. Bring to boil. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir mustard and turmeric with water to make a paste. Add to pan. Stir until it comes to boil and thickens slightly. Now add corn. Bring to boil for 5 minutes. Place in sterile jars. Process 10 minutes in boiling water. Seal. Makes approximately 8 pints.

title: Peanut Butter Frosts
instructions: Combine flour oats sugar and soda in large bowl. Add butter peanut butter and egg; stir until thoroughly blended. (Mixture will be crumbly.) Press\tin the bottom of greased 9-inch square pan.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until edges begin to pull away from sides of pan. Center will be soft. Cool completely. Top with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add well beaten eggs. Add sour cream and mix well. Add flour and remaining ingredients. Bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven in a Bundt pan which has been greased well and floured. Makes a large cake.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Chop fruit and mix all ingredients in large container. Mix well. Roll in small pieces. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Makes about 12 dozen.

title: Excellent Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs for 2 minutes until light and foamy (speed 4 or medium). Add sugar vegetable oil zucchini and vanilla. Turn mixer on Stir speed (low) and mix until well blended 1 minute. Stir all ingredients together. Add dry ingredients to bowl use Stir speed for 1 minute. Add nuts and raisins (optional). Grease two loaf pans (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inches). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Curry Turkey Divan
instructions: Place frozen chopped\tbroccoli in 1 1/2-quart glass casserole.\tCover with glass lid.\tMicrowave for 8 minutes on High or until partially cooked; set aside.

title: Orange-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Put pineapple in pan with one can of water and sugar. Bring to a boil. Add Jell-O and stir until dissolved. Stir in rest of the ingredients. Chill.

title: Southern Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Cook onions and celery in small amount of water. Crumble cornbread and bread together with fingers. Add cooked rice. Add celery onions apples salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Add enough turkey stock or chicken broth to make a drop (sloppy) batter. Add well beaten eggs. Pour into a well greased 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour till brown.

title: Vegetable-Cheese Soup
instructions: In a medium saucepan melt butter and saute chopped onion and green pepper until tender. Stir in flour. Cook 1 minute. Add milk and bring just to boiling. Add frozen vegetables; reduce heat. Simmer covered for 20 minutes. Gradually stir in grated cheese until melted. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: *Can used baked dolphin bass or any other salt water fish desired.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together all ingredients with an electric mixer. Grease three 9-inch round pans; flour bottoms. Pour batter in equal amounts into pans. Bake until toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes before frosting.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown beef and onion in butter. Add other ingredients except sour cream and cook slowly uncovered for 1 1/2 hours. Just before serving stir in sour cream. Serve over rice topped with chopped dill pickles if desired. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Bake meatballs and fry sausage. Keep grease from sausage. In a large saucepot mix tomato puree. Strain 1 can of tomatoes and use the juice from them. Add onion sugar garlic salt pepper and parsley flakes. Add meatballs sausage and sausage grease. Cook on medium heat for 1 hour stirring occasionally then simmer for another hour.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Set cream cheese out to room temperature. Then beat. Prepare Dream Whip per directions. Then add powdered sugar. Beat in cream cheese until creamy. Add juice. Put in prepared crust and top with pie filling. Chill. For family gatherings I triple this and put in an 11 x 15-inch pan.

title: Roast Rabbit With Sour Cream
instructions: Cut rabbit into serving size pieces. Combine wine vinegar onion and spices; bring to a boil and remove from heat. Salt the rabbit meat liberally and allow to stand for 15 minutes. Rinse salt lightly and pour the cooled liquid over the meat. Store in the refrigerator for 3 days. Mix the marinade with an equal volume of beef broth and pour into a roaster. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 until tender. When half done pour some of the sour cream over the rabbit and continue doing this at intervals until it is gone.

title: Fruit Dream
instructions: Mix all together and pour in a serving dish. Sprinkle with chopped pecans.

title: Eggs In A Cloud
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cut salami in half; arrange cut side down around edge of prepared dish. Arrange bread over bottom of dish. Arrange cheese slices on top of bread.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients beating until smooth. Stir in squash and onion. Add pepper. Drop mixture by tablespoon into a hot greased skillet cooking until golden brown (as for pancakes). Drain on paper towel. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Orange Roughy Casserole
instructions: Place thawed spinach on bottom of dish. Top with fish pieces. Season. Sprinkle cheese over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon nutmeg and ginger. Beat together sugar and oil and add eggs one at a time. Stir in pumpkin and orange juice or whatever liquid you want. Blend in dry ingredients. Stir in raisins and nuts. Turn into well-greased floured loaf pans. Let stand at least 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until done. Let stand in pans for 5 minutes then turn on racks to cool.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Kabob
instructions: In a large frying pan put 2 tablespoons of oil. Heat up first then put sliced chicken breasts in until brown and slightly cooked. Then put chopped onion and bell peppers and cook for about 5 minutes.

title: Cheese Crescents
instructions: Prepare mix according to package directions (2 cups of Bisquick and 1/2 cup milk). Knead 8 or 10 times. Roll out on floured surface to 14-inch circle. Brush dough with melted butter. Sprinkle dough with cheese. Cut in 10 wedges (like a pie). Starting at wide end roll each to form a crescent shape. Put crescent point down on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown. Serve hot. Makes 10.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple and add gelatin. Stir until dissolved.\tLet cool and add buttermilk Cool whip and nuts. Mix well and pour into salad mold and chill.\tMay use 13 x 8 x 2 inch pan. Serves 6-8.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cover cabbage in small amount of water and cook 5 to 8 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Arrange alternate layers of cabbage and corned beef in shallow 2-quart casserole dish. Combine soup milk onion mustard and salt. Pour over cabbage and corned beef. Toss cubes cut from bread slices with butter. Arrange around edges of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Arrange cheese slices over center of casserole and return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Best Potato Soup Yo' Ever Put In Yo' Mouth
instructions: In large saucepan cook potatoes and onion in enough water to cover and cook on medium heat until tender. Add cubes of cream cheese. Remove from heat and stir until cheese is melted. Add soups butter and spices. Serve hot. Top with onion bits and/or green onion tops.

title: Cocoa Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 6 mini and three 6 x 3 x 2-inch loaf pans. In a large bowl at medium speed beat sugar oil and eggs until blended. In a medium bowl stir together flour cocoa powder baking soda and salt. At low speed beat flour mixture into egg mixture just until blended. Stir in chocolate chips. Fill mini pans 2/3 full and smaller pans 1/2 full. Place on baking sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans on wire rack 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool completely. Wrap in plastic wrap and then foil.

title: Wassail Bowl
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Insert cloves about 1/2-inch apart into orange. Place in shallow baking pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Pierce orange in several places with fork. In large saucepan combine apple juice lemon juice cinnamon sticks and baked orange. Cover and simmer over low heat 30 minutes. Remove cinnamon sticks and orange. Pour into heatproof punch bowl. Makes 16 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Combine rice soups milk and mushrooms. Place in a greased casserole or pan (13 x 9-inch). Layer chicken pieces on top of mixture. Sprinkle with onion soup mix. Bake covered 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes longer until chicken is brown and tender. Serves 6.

title: Taste Treats
instructions: Melt almond bark in double boiler or microwave then pour over cereal nuts and pretzels in a square keeper or large container. Mix until evenly coated turn onto wax paper to cool and dry. Break in small pieces when dry.

title: Rock Candy
instructions: Mix water Karo syrup and sugar in a saucepan. Boil to 310 degrees stirring occasionally. While its boiling cover two cookie sheets with powdered sugar. After it reaches 310 turn off heat. Add food coloring and flavor. Stir until blended. Pour evenly into two cookie sheets and let it sit until it hardens. Crack with the end of a butter knife. Store in an airtight container.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Bake in unbaked pie shell at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Sprinkle diced ham sausage or crumbled bacon and cubed Velveeta in pie shell. Beat eggs in bowl; beat in remaining ingredients. Pour egg mixture into pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300\u00b0. Bake about 30 minutes longer or until quiche tests done. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Beau Monde Dip(Low Calorie)
instructions: In blender cream cottage cheese until smooth. Add onion soup mix dill weed lemon juice and Beau Monde spice. Blend until mixed well.

title: Flautas
instructions: For each flauta top tortillas with 1 slice of meat and 1 tablespoon of each cheese. Roll tortilla tightly pierce with toothpick and drop into hot oil until lightly brown. Remove to paper towel to drain.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place breasts on foil. Put other ingredients on top. Wrap and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cut open top and brown additional 10 minutes. These are excellent made ahead in bulk and frozen.

title: Chip Dip
instructions: Beat until smooth and then add onions to taste.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef or turkey and set aside. Mix refried beans and Bisquick to form a paste. Use mixture to layer (form a crust) in baking pan. Layer meat over mixture followed by salsa then cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream and chopped green onions.

title: Quick Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Then mix in rest of ingredients (using dry jello). Fresh strawberries may be used for garnish. For variety use orange or lemon jello and mandarin oranges instead of strawberries.

title: Make Believe Champagne
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 5 minutes. Add fruit juice. Chill. At serving time stir in ginger ale. (Put ice cubes in punch bowl.) Serve with assorted hors doeuvres.

title: Mock Lasagne Casserole
instructions: Brown the meat; drain off fat. Add tomato sauce garlic salt pepper basil and 1/2 cup water. Cover; simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. In a 2-quart casserole layer half each macaroni cottage cheese shredded cheese and meat sauce. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Dump-It Cake
instructions: Mix fruit together in a baking dish. Cover with one yellow cake mix (unprepared). Pour over the top one stick of melted oleo. Bake at 375\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Empty cake mix in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients; beat 3 minutes until smooth and creamy. Line bottom of tube pan with wax paper. Pour into pan and bake 50 -55 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan and finish cooling on wire racks.

title: Ham And Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop onion and ham. Combine cream cheese and grated Cheddar. Work into a large ball.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and salt in boiling water. Drain pineapple measuring syrup (add water to make 1/2 cup). Stir in gelatin with lemon juice. Blend in mayonnaise and chill until thick. Whip cream and fold fruits nuts and whipped cream into gelatin. Pour into 2 freezing trays. Freeze until firm at least 3 to 4 hours. To serve slice. Makes 8 servings.

title: Scandinavian Salad
instructions: Make the dressing in a jar and shake well.

title: Southwest Shoe Peg Corn
instructions: Mix margarine and cream cheese; stir over heat until melted. Add Shoe Peg corn green chilies sugar and salt. Pour into buttered casserole. Heat at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Can be done on stove in saucepan if you are in a hurry.

title: Pineapple Casserole(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into buttered baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.

title: Flan(Egg Custard - Spain)
instructions: Boil milk with vanilla or cinnamon. When the milk is coddled add egg yolks 2 egg whites 9 1/2 tablespoons sugar and pinch of salt. Beat well. Boil 4 tablespoons of sugar with 4 tablespoons of water stirring constantly in a flan mold until the syrup turns into caramel. Let cool.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop spoonfuls in frying pan and fry.

title: Honey Mustard Dressing
instructions: Heat vinegar and honey in a heavy small saucepan over low heat stirring until honey dissolves. Pour into a bowl and cool. Whisk in mayonnaise mustard onion parsley and salt. Gradually whisk in oil. (Can be prepared 3 days ahead covered and refrigerated; bring to room temperature before using.) Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and beaten eggs. Sift together flour soda cinnamon and salt. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture then add apples. Mix well. Pour into 10 x 14-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Test by putting toothpick in it. If comes out clean its done. Drizzle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Saucy Turkey Manicotti
instructions: Cook manicotti and drain. Stir together sour cream and cream cheese until smooth. Add turkey onion parsley salt and pepper. Blend well. Spoon turkey mixture into shells. Layer in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine process cheese and milk over medium heat stir constantly until cheese is melted and mixture is smooth. Pour cheese sauce over manicotti. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pikes Peak Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes and place in greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix cream with broth and pour over potatoes. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 30 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted. Serves 6.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Remove yolks from egg whites; arrange whites on plate or container. Sieve egg yolks and combine with remaining ingredients except avocado; mix well. Refill egg whites with egg yolk mixture. Sprinkle with additional paprika. Garnish with avocado. Half of recipe may be stored in a container.

title: Antipasto Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except dressing in large bowl. Mix dressing according to package directions. Pour over salad and refrigerate.

title: Baked Custard(For Diabetics)
instructions: Lightly beat eggs then add remaining ingredients and beat well. Pour mixture into five 6-ounce custard cups and place cups in pan containing 1 inch of hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cover and chill thoroughly.

title: Fresh Okra Muffins
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl. Make a well in the center of mixture. Combine milk and next 4 ingredients. Add to dry mixture stirring just until moistened. Fold in okra and onion.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken in the water until tender (20 to 25 minutes). Remove meat in strips; sprinkle with lemon juice salt and pepper and toss then set aside.

title: Pecan Butter Fingers
instructions: Mix butter and sugar until creamy and fluffy. Gradually mix in flour. Stir in salt vanilla and pecans. Using a level tablespoon of dough shape into 2-inch long fingers. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes or until light brown. Remove from oven and cool completely.

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In large mixer combine sugar and margarine. Beat at medium speed scraping bowl often until mixture is creamy (1 to 2 minutes). Add rhubarb yogurt and eggs. Continue beating until well mixed. By hand stir in flour baking soda and cinnamon just until moistened. Spoon into paper-lined muffin pan. Bake 20 to 22 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan. While still warm brush top of muffins with strawberry preserves.

title: Payday Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix egg and 1/3 cup margarine. Bake in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes. While still hot put marshmallows on top. Stir together Karo 1/4 cup margarine peanut butter chips and vanilla. Heat stirring constantly until smooth. Stir in peanuts and cereal. Pour over marshmallow covered cake.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and salt and pepper. Drain off grease. Spread in greased 10-inch pie plate. Beat together until smooth (1 minute with mixer or 15 seconds in blender) milk Bisquick and eggs. Pour over meat mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top with tomato slices and cheese. Bake 8 minutes longer. Cool 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Happy Hour Special
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cut biscuits into quarters and place in 11 x 7-inch baking pan. Melt butter and stir in garlic. Pour over biscuit pieces making certain that all are well covered. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until biscuits spring back when lightly touched.

title: Taco Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and garlic powder together and drain. Mix the rest of ingredients together except chips and cheese in slow cooker and add hamburger. Simmer for 30 minutes. Serve in bowl with chips and cheese on top.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Into bowl sift flour soda and salt. Add caraway seed sugar and raisins. Mix melted butter beaten eggs and buttermilk; stir into flour mixture. Form into a round loaf; place in round 2-quart pan. With a knife cut a cross on top of loaf. After removal from oven rub top with butter while still warm. Cool; wrap in foil. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add peanut butter. Mix thoroughly. Add 1 container of Cool Whip until well blended. Fill pie shell. Frost with the remaining Cool Whip.

title: Chrusciki(Angel Wings)
instructions: Beat egg yolks until light. Add cream and sugar; beat well. Add flour salt and cinnamon. Roll small amount of dough at a time to a little less than 1/8-inch thick. Cut in 1 x 3-inch strips cutting ends diagonally. Make a lengthwise slit and pull one end through. Fry in hot deep fat at 350\u00b0 for about 2 minutes or until slightly brown. Drain on paper towels. When cold sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Crab Louis Dip
instructions: Mix and spread on plate.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until smooth. Add cream cheese and continue beating. Add eggs one at a time. Combine flour with baking powder and add with soft cream cheese. Add flavorings. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Microwave Divinity
instructions: Mix sugar water syrup and salt in 2-quart bowl. Cover bowl loosely with Saran Wrap so steam can escape. Microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes until boiling. Uncover and microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes until hard-ball stage is reached. Drop small bit into cold ice water to see if it will form a hard ball. Beat egg whites until stiff. Slowly pour hot syrup over egg whites. Have electric mixer on high speed. Add vanilla flavoring. Continue to beat at last 6 to 7 minutes until candy holds shape. Drop by small teaspoons on wax paper. Cool.

title: Hot And Sour Soup
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a Dutch oven. Bring to boil; cover and simmer for 10 minutes or low heat. Add surimi bamboo shoots and mushrooms. Simmer until heated through. Sprinkle with scallions.

title: Munster Pie
instructions: Beat egg add flour. Add 1\\2 of the milk blend. Add remaining milk cheese salami onion salt and pepper. Grease 9-inch glass pie plate. Pour mixture. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 min. Turn oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 25 min.

title: Chuck Roast
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and pour over the roast. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Light Batter For Vegetables Or Meat
instructions: Beat egg and water and blend with rest of ingredients. Dip meat or vegetables and fry until golden brown. Great for boneless chicken breast.

title: Heavenly Hash Christmas Candy
instructions: Cut up dates and marshmallows. Cut up nuts (not too fine). Melt chocolate and butter and pour over rest. Press in large pan. Let cool. Cut in squares. (Mixing up with your hands is much easier.)

title: Cherry Nut Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar salt and baking soda. Add vanilla eggs and oil. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Add cherries and nuts. Bake in ungreased pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tomato-Green Pepper Salad
instructions: Dip tomato in boiling water; peel remove seeds and chop. Remove seeds and chop green pepper 1/2 inch. Peel remove seeds and chop cucumber. Chop green onion.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: In a glass 13 x 9-inch pan spread cream cheese. Top with chili and add green chilies evenly. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake until hot and cheese is melted or may be heated in microwave.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Grease and flour 9-inch pie pan generously. Combine all ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Pour into pie pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into pie crust. Invert 2nd crust and seal the two crusts together. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until crust is brown.

title: Hot Curried Fruit
instructions: Drain all fruit and place in a 2-quart buttered baking dish. In a small mixing bowl combine cornstarch curry powder cinnamon and sugar. Sprinkle sugar mixture over fruit.

title: Lazy Day Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and sour cream mix well. Combine flour baking powder soda salt and nutmeg. Add to batter and mix well. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine brown sugar pecans and cinnamon. Sprinkle half of mixture over cake and swirl through batter. Sprinkle the rest on top. Cover and chill overnight. Uncover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Shortcut Stroganoff
instructions: Slice beef into very thin strips. In medium skillet over medium high heat heat oil. Add beef and cook until beef is browned and juices evaporate stirring often. Add soup broth water and worcestershire. Heat to a boil. Stir in pasta. Reduce heat to medium. Cook 15 minutes or until pasta is done stirring often. Stir in sour cream. Heat through.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix oleo peanut butter white and brown sugar. Then add water flour soda baking powder and salt. Mix well then add chocolate chips; mix again. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. You can sprinkle additional chocolate chips on top while hot to frost. Cut in bars.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix well first 4 ingredients. Melt in double boiler milk and caramels. Pour 1/2 of cake mixture in 9 x 13-inch glass dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Put caramel mixture over cake. Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans over this and pour the rest of cake mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Country Store Baked Beans
instructions: Cover beans with water in a 4-quart stockpot. Bring to a boil; boil 10 minutes. Drain reserve liquid. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Place half of bacon and half of onions in bottom of 4-quart bean pot or small casserole with cover. Add half of beans remaining onions then remaining beans; top with remaining bacon. Mix molasses brown sugar salt pepper and ginger with reserved bean liquid; pour over beans. Add enough water to cover beans by 2 inches. Cover and bake 4 to 4 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Add up to 3 1/2 cups hot water as needed to keep beans moist. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bacon-Sizzler Appetizers
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Peanut Paddies
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients to soft ball (235\u00b0) stirring often. Take off heat and add remaining ingredients. Beat until candy thickens. Drop on waxed paper or buttered oven liners.

title: Cold Asparagus Soup(Easy, Elegant And Flavorful)
instructions: Pour asparagus with liquid into blender; add all ingredients. Blend on high until smooth. Chill. Variations can include can of string beans and garlic powder or spice of your choice. A dollop of sour cream or yogurt can be added when serving.

title: Chocolate Pecan Cake
instructions: Place in square pan the butter and vegetable oil; add cocoa to butter and oil then water. Bring 1 cup of water to boil. Remove from heat; add flour and sugar. Add buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Stir with fork. Pour in oblong pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch) greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Five minutes before cake is done make icing (recipe follows).

title: Barbecue Shrimp
instructions: Cook all the ingredients together until garlic and parsley are done. Drop in shrimp until done. It makes a wonderful gravy. Throw the shrimp away and eat the gravy with French bread. (Only kidding! Keep the shrimp.) The gravy is wonderful. Easy easy!

title: Garden Ratatouille
instructions: Fry bacon until lightly browned. (Drain off excess fat.) Add olive oil and heat. Add chopped peppers onion and garlic; saute for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Turkey Lasagna
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; place over medium-high heat until hot. Add ground turkey and next 3 ingredients; cook until meat is browned and vegetables are tender stirring to crumble meat. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Wipe drippings from skillet. Return turkey mixture to skillet; add Italian seasoning and next 4 ingredients. Cover and cook over medium heat 30 minutes stirring often. Combine egg whites cottage cheese and parsley; set aside. Coat a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place 5 noodles in bottom of dish. Top with half each of turkey mixture and cheese mixture. Repeat layers. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with Parmesan and Mozzarella cheeses. Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand 10 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken and remove meat from bones. Add to chicken both cans of soup and mix well. Fill tortillas with chicken mixture. Pour enchilada sauce over filled tortillas. Top with both kinds of cheese and olives. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is bubbly.

title: Toasted Coconut Dessert
instructions: Mix together and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix well all ingredients together. Use paper liners in tiny muffin pans. Bake 18 minutes. May be frozen in sealed containers.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place bacon on top. Bake in a slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Riced Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine in a large cake pan. Add the rice. Mix the soups and milk. Place chicken on rice. Cover with liquid. Bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: John'S Curry
instructions: Saute onions bell pepper and garlic in 2 tablespoons of margarine or butter. Set aside. Brown meat in frying pan. Transfer to a large pot. Make a gravy in frying pan with drippings. You may want to thicken it with small amount of flour. Add all ingredients to meat and simmer until meat is done. Cook rice as directed on package. Cut up boiled egg 1 tomato pineapple banana raisins and coconut and place in small dishes. Serve on top of curry and rice.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Soften gelatine in cold water; add boiling water. Stir until dissolved. Add sugar lemon juice and crushed pineapple (including juice). Chill until partially firm. Whip 2 envelopes Dream Whip according to directions on package. Fold into gelatine mixture. Spread into a 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Break bits of angel food cake and spread gelatine mixture. Repeat until all cake and gelatine mixture are used. Chill. Prepare third envelope of Dream Whip; spread on top of cake and cover with coconut. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Diabetic-Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Crust Melt margarine and mix with cracker or cereal crumbs. Pat into bottom of 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let crust cool at room temperature.

title: Sweet Dream Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) and cream of tartar at high speed of an electric mixer 1 minute. Gradually add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves (about 2 to 4 minutes). Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil. Place in oven and immediately turn off heat. Do not open oven door for at least 8 hours. Carefully peel cookies from foil. Yields 4 dozen.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Put all together in a large jar. Let soak in it a clove of garlic cut into and a slice of onion. Let stand for a day or more and shake once in a while. Then remove onion and garlic. Put into bottle.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick of margarine and mix with graham cracker crumbs to form a thin layer of crust in an oblong baking dish; set aside. In saucepan cook to a custard 1 stick margarine eggs and sugar. Cool completely and spoon over crust. Place sliced bananas over custard mixture. Spread crushed pineapple over bananas. Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts. Top with cherries. Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Butterscotch Fudge
instructions: In large saucepan combine marshmallow cream sugar evaporated milk butter and salt. Bring to full boil over moderate heat stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add butterscotch chips. Stir until melted and well blended. Add orange extract and rind (can omit this). Add nuts. Pour in greased 8-inch square pan. Chill in refrigerator. Makes 2 1/3 pounds candy.

title: Cut-It-Short Torte
instructions: Mix and bake cake as directed on package in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 350\u00b0. Cool. Split cake into 3 layers. Spread 1/3 of whipped topping and 1/3 of pie filling between each layer and on top. Chill until set.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine boiling water and oatmeal; cover and let stand 20 minutes. Beat until fluffy the butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla. Add oatmeal mixture and mix well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Pour into well-greased and floured 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Do not remove from pan. Top immediately with frosting.

title: Double Chocolate Cake
instructions: Spray Bundt pan. Mix first 5 ingredients; set aside. Mix vinegar syrup water and vanilla; set aside. Cream margarine oil and 1/3 tablespoon sugar. Alternate dry ingredients and wet ingredients into creamed mixture. Pour into Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Purple Cow
instructions: Put 2 scoops of ice cream in a tall glass. Fill the glass with grape soda. Stir. You can also make an Orange Cow by using orange soda or a Brown Cow using root beer or cola.

title: Cheese And Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter. Cook broccoli until done. Add onion and pepper. Add all 3 soups. Add 3 cans of water. Add 1 jar Cheez Whiz and 1/2 jar of salsa or jalapeno Cheez Whiz. Heat and serve.

title: Butter Balls
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and continue to beat until light. Add vanilla and flour; fold in nuts. Shape into balls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar while hot. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Layer Or 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Place ingredients in layers in a low bowl and sprinkle a little salt and pepper as you go. Layer lettuce green pepper celery onion water chestnuts and frozen peas. Press peas down tightly. Spread a layer of mayonnaise over all. Place slices of tomatoes on top of mayonnaise. Sprinkle with grated cheeses then crumble cooked bacon and chopped hard-boiled eggs over top. Refrigerate for 24 hours.

title: Spice Bars
instructions: Mix eggs and pie filling. Add dry cake mix. Spread in greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Spread with icing.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300\u00b0. Heavily grease and flour a 10-inch tube or Bundt pan or two (9 x 5 x 3-inch) pans. In a large bowl at medium speed beat butter until smooth. At low speed add sugar gradually beating well. Clean beaters. Blend in honey at low speed. Add eggs one at a time beating at medium high speed after each addition. On a large sheet of waxed paper combine cinnamon cloves allspice nutmeg baking powder baking soda salt and 3 1/4 cups flour. Add blended dry ingredients to batter alternately with buttermilk. Toss reserved 1/2 cup with raisins figs and almonds; add to mixture. Pour batter into pan. Cut through batter with knife to distribute evenly. Bake 1 1/2 hours or until cake tester poked in center comes out clean. Let cool in pan 30 minutes. Turn out on a rack to cool. Top with your own favorite frosting.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil peel and slice potatoes.\tSlice onion and separate into rings. Mix together mayonnaise vegetable oil and vinegar.

title: Honeymoon Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Separate egg yolks and whites. Mash yolks and finely chop whites. Mix yolks with garlic oil and bread until smooth. Add pepper vinegar and salt. This is the dressing.

title: Lazy Chicken
instructions: In greased (spray generously with Pam) baking dish evenly spread uncooked rice. Place chicken on rice skin side up. Mix dry onion soup water and soup. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Frosting
instructions: Boil milk and flour together until thick and smooth. Cool. Beat together next 3 ingredients. Add boiled flour and milk to Crisco mixture. Beat at high speed until very fluffy.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with Wesson oil and sugar. Add flour sifted with other dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly; add dates nuts and apples; mix thoroughly. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 in greased pan.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Can put a custard sauce over top.

title: Debbie'S Oriental Dip With Snow Peas
instructions: Trim ends of snow peas. Place snow peas in vegetable steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam about 1 minute. Do not overcook. Should still be crisp. Remove snow peas; rinse with cold water and chill for about 2 hours.

title: American Country Fare
instructions: Prepare macaroni dinner as directed on package. Cook sausage in large skillet in water over medium heat for six minutes. Add vegetables and oregano. Continue cooking until vegetables are tender. Add macaroni dinner and mix lightly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown the meat with oil and garlic. Add tomatoes tomato sauce salt oregano and pepper. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fudge Walnut Ripple Layer Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixer bowl combine flour sugar cocoa baking soda salt buttermilk shortening\t2 eggs and 2 teaspoons vanilla extract. Beat on low speed until blended scraping bowl constantly.\tBeat 3 minutes on high speed scraping bowl occasionally. Pour into 2 paper lined greased and floured 9-inch cake pans.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix coconut and pecans. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix cake mix according to package directions and pour on top of coconut pecan mixture. In a saucepan put 1 stick margarine and cream cheese. Heat until mixture is warm enough to stir in the box of confectioners sugar. Spoon over top of mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Do not cut cake until cool.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cream softened cream cheese and mix with chopped shrimp and remaining ingredients. Serve with crackers.

title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and garlic powder. Dip chicken into flour and coat. Heat butter and oil in large skillet. Brown chicken slowly on both sides until cooked. Remove to warmed platter. Stir lemon juice and wine in pan with drippings to deglaze. Stir thoroughly to loosen all pieces. Spoon over chicken. Sprinkle with parsley and garnish platter with pimento and lemon wedges.

title: Pasta With Tomatoes
instructions: Combine cooked and drained macaroni with the Parmesan cheese. Add the tomatoes salt and pepper. Toss and serve.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken in salt water in a covered pan until tender (a frying chicken will take about 45 minutes). Remove chicken from broth; cool enough to handle. Remove skin and bones; chop meat. Add water to broth (if needed) to make 5 cups. Bring to a boil. Add chicken vegetables and spices. Simmer covered for 20 minutes. Add noodles; simmer uncovered for 10 minutes or until noodles are tender. Yields 6 servings.

title: Peach Layered Gelatin Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water. Add pie filling; mix well and pour into pans. Refrigerate until set.

title: Marinated Tomatoes
instructions: Pour Italian dressing over fresh sliced tomatoes. Marinate 15 to 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and fresh basil.

title: Slaw
instructions: Let cabbage and salt stand 45 minutes to 2 hours. Squeeze out all the water. Boil sugar white vinegar and water. Add celery green pepper celery seed and dry mustard or mustard seed to cabbage. Pour hot vinegar over slaw while hot. Keeps about a month or may be frozen.

title: Stir-N-Roll Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 475\u00b0 (very hot). Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Pour Wesson oil and milk into a measuring cup but dont stir then pour all at once into flour. Stir with a fork until the mixture clears sides of bowl and rounds up into a ball. Smooth by kneading dough about 10 times without additional flour. With the dough on waxed paper press out 1/4-inch thick with hands. For higher biscuits roll 1/2-inch thick. Cut and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Broccoli A La Greque
instructions: Cut broccoli into serving pieces. Cook until tender. Arrange in 9 x 13-inch dish. Combine next 8 ingredients. Pour over broccoli. Cover with plastic wrap and chill overnight. Turn broccoli once. To serve arrange on platter; sprinkle with crumbled Feta cheese. Garnish with tomato wedges and hard-boiled eggs (quartered).

title: Reese'S Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour cocoa baking soda and salt. In a large mixer bowl beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Gradually add flour mixture beating well. Stir in chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: Crush crackers and combine with beef 2/3 of the can of tomato sauce egg onion salt pepper and Italian seasoning. Mix well and press out into a large rectangle on waxed paper. Dump shredded cheese in a pile near one end of the rectangle and sprinkle a little along middle of rectangle. Start at the end where the pile of cheese is and roll up like a jelly roll. Be sure to \seal\ ends and smooth end seam into loaf. Be careful not to poke a hole in loaf. Place seam side down in loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Remove from oven drain off grease. Pour remaining tomato sauce over loaf and return to oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon and pour in a casserole dish. Top with bacon and bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Kiss Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in large bowl except Kisses. Mix on low speed until well blended. Make into balls about 3/4 inch. Place on cookie sheet. Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Take out of oven and place a Kiss in each cookie. Place back in oven long enough to soften Kiss.

title: Crabby English Wedges
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread on English muffin halves. Cut muffins in quarters or eighths and arrange on cookie sheet. Broil 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Can be prepared the night before and refrigerated. Broil just before serving. Excellent appetizer. Can freeze for up to 30 days and use as needed.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Cut in shortening. Using fork add water 1 tablespoonful at a time. Roll out on floured surface. If recipe calls for a baked pie shell prick and bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 2 pie shells or 1 double crust.

title: French Bread
instructions: Combine 2 cups of flour sugar salt and yeast in a large mixing bowl. Stir well. Combine milk water and margarine in a saucepan. Cook over low heat until margarine melts. Cool slightly. Gradually add liquid to flour mixture beating well at high speed of mixer. Beat an additional 2 minutes at high speed. Add 2 cups of flour beating well.

title: Baked Potatoes And Onions
instructions: Saute cut up onion in butter. Scrub potatoes and slice thin (dont peel). Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; sprinkle with salt. Pour butter and onion over potatoes; bake for 30 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Baste occasionally while baking.

title: Bubbly Iced Tea
instructions: In a large pitcher pour in the water. Add iced tea mix and stir until well dissolved. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Add carbonated drink stir and pour over crushed ice in tall glasses. Tasty!

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together. Add egg and mix well. Sift flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add to shortening mixture and mix to form crumbs.

title: Hamburgers With Stuffing
instructions: Mix milk and ground beef and divide into 4 or 5 patties 6 inches in diameter. In the center of each patty put 1/4 cup stuffing. Mold the meat around the stuffing to form a ball. Place in 8 x 8-inch dish and add the soup. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Cook on 375\u00b0 griddle. Serves 2.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes cool and dice in large bowl. Add parsley; toss. Cook bacon (cut into small pieces) until crisp add onion (chopped) and cook until onions are done. Drain off some of the bacon fat. Add flour and cook until bubbly. Stir in vinegar water sugar salt and pepper. Bring to boil simmer 2 minutes pour over potatoes and toss. Enjoy!

title: Hungarian Potato Soup
instructions: In a large soup pot or Dutch oven heat the margarine over medium heat. Add the onions and garlic; saute until very soft about 10 minutes. Stir in the potatoes water salt paprika thyme caraway and cayenne. Bring just to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer 35 minutes stirring occasionally. Mash the potatoes slightly with a long-handled fork and season with black pepper to taste. Makes 8 servings. This soup is delicious on a cold day.

title: Frozen Black Velvet
instructions: Combine cranberries and sugar; let stand 10 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Ball
instructions: Set out cream cheese until room temperature. Mix all ingredients together. Form into a ball. Garnish with parsley.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix flour cinnamon nutmeg and sugar together well. Add to this eggs milk butter and flavoring after they have been mixed in a separate bowl. Next add persimmon pulp to all of the ingredients; mix well and pour into a 9 x 12 pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until a knife inserted comes out slightly moist. Eat after cooled to room temperature or after refrigerated. Keep in refrigerator to store.

title: Great Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Combine flour oats soda cinnamon and salt. Cream butter; add sugars and beat well. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Alternately add dry ingredients and pumpkin mixing well. Stir in chips. For each cookie drop 1/4 cup dough onto greased cookie sheet; spread into pumpkin shape. Add a bit more to form stem. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until cookies are lightly browned. Remove from sheet and cool. Can be decorated using icing candies nuts or more chips. Makes about 20 cookies.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Cook the first 7 ingredients over double boiler until thick. Chill. Mix together the cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Put this mixture in bottom of the pie shell. Place raisin mixture on top. Top with Cool Whip and chopped pecans.

title: Carolyn'S Heavenly, Heavenly Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate 3 hours before serving.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli and place in buttered casserole dish. Mix all other ingredients except Cheddar cheese and pour over broccoli. Top with Cheddar cheese. May add paprika on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Steam all vegetables together until tender. Mix in all other ingredients. Heat through.

title: Cocoa Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Mix in shortening then water and eggs. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Slice your favorite pound cake; butter each side and grill in skillet (electric skillet works great). Remove from skillet and top each piece with vanilla ice cream and drizzle the top with hot fudge topping and honey. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with chopped pecans. This is certainly not dietetic but it is gggrrreat.

title: Brown Sugar Pie
instructions: Cream sugar butter and eggs. Stir in flour and milk. Add vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 until brown and settled.

title: Club Chicken Casserole
