instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Blend in flour. Add evaporated milk chicken broth and water. Cook quickly stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Add rice chicken and remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour into greased 2-quart casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until heated through completely. If desired top with 1/4 cup slivered almonds. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Mallow Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat ingredients at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Serve with fruit or pound cake cubes if desired. Makes 3 cups.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil the first 5 ingredients together for 5 minutes at full boil. Remove from heat quickly and thoroughly stir in 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda (this will change the consistency). Pour mixture over popped corn; mix well. (But be very careful candy mixture is very hot and will burn fingers if touched.) When well combined bake in slow oven at 225\u00b0 to 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring at 15 minute intervals. Pour out to cool completely then store in tight containers. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Coating For Chicken
instructions: Beat and let stand. Coat chicken. Turn chicken over every 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Apple Pie
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Put into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with strips of bread. Melt margarine and add sugar and egg. Mix and pour over bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Sausage And Rice
instructions: Crumble sausage and fry until brown; then mix with other ingredients. Pour into large casserole cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Stir in all of the ingredients except pecans. Bring to a rolling boil; add pecans. Let cool until bubbles form on top. Take off fire. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Dip out by teaspoon on greased surface until cool.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet. Drain off grease. Add soup and milk. Pour into a baking dish. Spread cheese on top of hamburger mixture. Then place Tater Tots on top of cheese uniformly. Bake at 350\u00b0 until Tater Tots are golden brown about 30 minutes.

title: Dessert Crepes
instructions: Place the ingredients in the blender in the order listed. Cover and blend at top speed for 1 minute. Let stand at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Manhattan Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon crisp; pour off all but 2 tablespoons of grease and saute onion. Drain liquid from clams; set clams aside. Add water to clam juice to make 1 quart and combine with all other ingredients except bacon bits and clams in a 4-quart saucepan; simmer together for 30 to 40 minutes then add bacon bits and clams and simmer about 10 minutes longer.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Spray a large skillet with Pam or brush with oil. Heat skillet and brown chicken quickly. Place in baking dish. Mix Parmesan cheese and spaghetti sauce. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until chicken is done. Cover with Mozzarella cheese and bake until melted. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with rotini.

title: Swamp Rice
instructions: Fry out the sausage. Cook rice per directions on box. Drain excess fat from sausage and set aside. In small amount of fat remaining saute the onions until tender. Add flour to onions and stir to moisten not brown. Add chicken broth and juice from the mushrooms to the mixture in the frying pan stirring constantly until gravy consistency. Mix rice mushrooms sausage and gravy thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour in casserole dish. May be topped with slivered almonds.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine butter or margarine and sugar; cream well. Add flour and potato chips. Mix in walnuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 8 dozen cookies.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except grated cheese and onions. Place in a buttered casserole dish. Top with cheese and French fried onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Blend peppers until liquid in blender. Combine peppers sugar and vinegar; bring to a boil. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Take off heat and add Certo and food color.

title: Galley Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion. Put meat and remaining ingredients in crock-pot and cook on low for 3 or 4 hours.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers and salt. Let stand 2 hours. Rinse in cold water and drain. Dissolve sugar in vinegar. Pour over vegetables. Put in small containers and store in freezer.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill at least 1/2 hour. Roll into balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. May be frozen before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Jello Salad
instructions: Make jello as directions. Add bananas marshmallows and drained pineapple. Allow to set.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Cook sausage and pour off fat. Thaw and drain spinach. Grate cheese. Reserve 1 egg yolk and beat with water. Combine remaining ingredients and spoon into pie shell. Top with pie crust. Brush top crust with egg yolk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: With a very sharp knife cut beef across grain into thin strips 1/8-inch thick. Combine soy sauce garlic and ginger. Add beef and toss. Set aside while preparing vegetables.

title: One-Dish Chicken Broccoli Rice
instructions: In skillet in hot margarine cook chicken 1/2 at a time until browned. Add broccoli and carrots. Cook until tender-crisp.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Bake 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cut into squares.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together; put into casserole dish. Crumble Ritz crackers over mixture; top with pats of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly hot about 30 minutes.

title: Ugly Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Beat first three ingredients with mixer until smooth. This will be thick. Spread in pan. Set to the side.

title: Bride'S Favorite Ice Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cream cheese and ice cream. Stir until smooth. Add the rest of the ingredients and pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Chill. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Franklin Hunley'S Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Scald one can of milk and one can of water. Beat 4 eggs; add salt sugar and flour. Pour into scalding milk and cook until thick. Then add other milk and water as desired. He used a can of water to each can of milk. Add flavoring after mixture is poured into freezer. (He also sometimes mixed a little lemon flavoring with the vanilla seemed to downplay the sweet taste he said.)

title: Brown Sugar Chess Pie
instructions: Blend mixture and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 45 minutes at 320\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring to boil sugar and milk over high heat and boil 2 1/2 minutes. Beat in peanut butter and marshmallow. Pour into buttered platter to cool.

title: Hot Sausage Appetizers - Sausage Balls
instructions: Thoroughly combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Shape into one-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes approximately 50 servings.

title: Grandma'S Salve
instructions: Melt and pour into 2\tquarts\tof cold water 9 times changing the water. Each time squeeze most of the water out with hands. At last heating add\ta piece of camphor gum the size of a small hickory nut. Break into small pieces to melt more readily. Roll into balls. While doing so work out the particles of water keeping a dry rag to wipe hands on as they become moist. To apply reheat before application. Store in waxed paper.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Pour pineapple over dry pudding mix. Mix well; add other ingredients. Mix well. Chill.

title: Toasted Coconut Frosting
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of oleo in skillet; add coconut. Stir constantly over low heat until golden brown and spread on absorbent paper to drain and cool. Cream 2 tablespoons oleo and cream cheese. Add milk and beat in sugar gradually. Add vanilla. Stir in 1 3/4 cups coconut. Ice cake and sprinkle top of cake with remaining coconut.

title: Chocolate Poor Man'S Cake
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Mix by hand adding one ingredient at a time. Add coffee last. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with Cream Frosting.

title: Initial Starter For Sourdough Bread
instructions: Mix first three ingredients well. Mix last two ingredients well. Then mix all together. Store in refrigerator and feed every 3 to 5 days.

title: Zesty Black Bean Soup
instructions: Cook bacon in 3-quart saucepan until crisp. Remove to paper towels. Add onion and garlic to drippings; cook and stir 3 minutes. Add beans broth water picante sauce salt and oregano. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Spoon into bowls. Dollop with sour cream if desired. Sprinkle with reserved crumbled bacon. Serve with extra picante sauce. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cherry Pretzel Delight
instructions: Mix pretzel crumbs sugar and margarine well. Press into 9-inch dish. Prepare topping mix according to directions. Add cream cheese and powdered sugar. Whip until well blended. Spread over pretzel mixture. Spread cherry pie filling on top. Refrigerate. Makes 9 servings.

title: Fresh Berry Pie
instructions: Bring the first 5 ingredients to a boil and boil until clear. Remove from heat. Add gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Cool. Place 4 cups fresh berries in baked shell. Pour mixture slowly over the berries. Chill until firm.

title: Polish Sausage
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well but lightly. Shape into patties. Can be made into links with sausage stuffer.

title: Mary Caggiano'S Eggplant Appetizer
instructions: Peel and cube eggplant; put in colander. Sprinkle salt on and let drain to remove bitter taste. Heat oil in large skillet; add onion and saute until tender but not brown. Add eggplant and tomato; cook slowly stirring often until thick about 15 minutes. Add vinegar and spices. Chill. Makes about 3 cups. Serve as an appetizer with crackers or as a side dish with meat.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all at once for about 5 minutes. Pour into two 9-inch greased pans or regular cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Party Turnovers (Crescent Roll-Ups)
instructions: In medium skillet brown meat and soup. Blend in cheese. Separate rolls in package and cut in half. Place spoonful of meat mixture into crescent triangle fold over and seal. Bake at 375\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 minutes until golden brown. Dip into hot mustard. Can be frozen. Makes 48 servings.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Boil the first 4 ingredients together until hard ball forms when syrup is dropped into cold water and it doesnt stick to teeth. Good luck!

title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Drain strawberries reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Beat cream cheese reserved liquid thawed strawberries sugar and vanilla until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Garnish with strawberry halves and kiwi slices. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Sift together 2 cups flour and salt; cut in Crisco. Add the milk gradually just until dry mixture is moistened. Form into a ball. Divide in half and roll out to fit a 9-inch pie pan. Peel the apples. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon together. Cut in butter with remaining flour and sugar making fine crumbs. Fill pastry-lined pie pan alternately with sliced apples and cinnamon/sugar mixture. Cover with crumbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until apples are soft.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add cold water. Using a glass bowl (clear if you have one) place marshmallows on bottom and pour gelatin over. Add pineapple and sliced bananas. Let gel.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and slice mushrooms. Put all ingredients in a frying pan and simmer covered for about 10 minutes on medium heat. If dry mushrooms desired remove lid after first 10 minutes. Cook 10 more minutes or until done.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. (This mixture boils over. Bake in large dish or put pan under dish to save your oven.) Serve warm only.

title: Mom'S Cake Filling(Pineapple)
instructions: Mix all together and cook in saucepan until thick. Pour over cake while hot. Cook cake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Be sure to take the batter out before you put the cake in to bake.

title: Honey-Avocado Butter
instructions: Blend or whip avocado and honey. Cover mixture with plastic wrap placed directly on surface of the spread. Refrigerate until well chilled. Delicious on hot cornmeal muffins or English muffins.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: Stir-fry the chopped celery and onions in the oil. Add 3 cups water and barley and boil 15 minutes. Add carrots with their water and chicken. Add more water (3 cups?) if needed. Heat then add chicken base 1 tablespoon at a time until broth has a good flavor.

title: Coca-Cola Icing
instructions: Heat oleo cocoa and Coke to boil; remove from heat and add powdered sugar. Mix then add pecans. Pour over cake.

title: 4-Layer Delight
instructions: Mix and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan the margarine flour and pecans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Microwave Apple Crisp
instructions: Arrange apples in an ungreased 2-quart glass casserole or square glass baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Mix remaining ingredients; sprinkle over apples. Microwave apples (uncovered) until they are tender about 12 minutes.

title: Hot Water Cornbread
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in bowl. Boil water in pan on stove or in microwave (must be boiling). Add bacon grease to water. Pour into cornmeal flour and sugar mixture. Stir until well mixed (about 15 seconds). Shape in patties and fry about 2 to 3 minutes in very hot oil until golden. Makes 6. Watch them disappear!

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cover beans with water and bring to a boil. Simmer slowly for 1/2 hour or more until tender. Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Drain the beans reserve the cooking water and add onions molasses catsup dry mustard salt bean water or beer vinegar curry powder and Worcestershire sauce. Place in a greased casserole. Decorate with sliced salt pork. Bake covered for 6 to 9 hours. If they become dry add well seasoned stock or reserved bean water. Uncover for the last hour of cooking. Good Luck!

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in about 3 tablespoons of oil in skillet. Do not season. Mix all ingredients except tortillas and cheese. Alternate mixture with tortillas in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Uncover the last 10 minutes.

title: Frito Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Drain. Mix in chili and heat thoroughly. Pour ingredients into casserole baking dish. Top mixture with crumbled Fritos then sprinkle with cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is slightly brown. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix thoroughly until the butter and milk are gone. Then roll into little balls. Put in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Add butter to crackers. Cook squash until tender; drain and mash. Beat eggs; add to squash. Add milk sugar salt butter and onion; mix well in 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Add crackers and cheese the last 10 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix Veg-All water chestnuts onion Cheddar cheese and mayonnaise and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Crush crackers and sprinkle over mixture. Melt butter and pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Chill and serve.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Pumpernickel Dill Dip
instructions: Mix together the sour cream mayo dill onion flakes and salt. Let sit and chill for about an hour.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Use equal parts of catsup and Coca-Cola. Mix and add to your taste the remaining ingredients.

title: Elsie'S Crispy Sweet Pickles
instructions: Note There is no cooking of the pickles. Takes approximately 12 days.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine milk eggs onion salt and pepper in large bowl. Stir in stuffing mix. Let stand 5 minutes. Add ground beef; mix well. Cook mushrooms and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Combine golden mushroom soup and sour cream; warm and serve over the meat loaf.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix meat mixed vegetables and soup in casserole dish. Mix flour butter and milk together; pour over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Bernie'S Banana Bread
instructions: Combine bananas sugar egg and melted butter. Mix in dry ingredients until flour is moistened. Using greased loaf pan bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Vanilla French Toast
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs; add milk sugar vanilla and salt. Soak bread for 30 seconds on each side. Cook on a greased griddle (or my antique cast-iron skillet) until golden brown on both sides and cooked through. Serve with syrup or cinnamon-sugar. Yield 2 servings.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Mix flour oatmeal brown sugar cinnamon and margarine. Take half of that and put in a 9-inch baking dish. Reserve the other half for later. Take rhubarb and put over mixture in baking dish. Cook the white sugar cornstarch vanilla and water until thick. Pour immediately over rhubarb and put rest of crumbs on. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Puerto Rican Pudding
instructions: Break bread into small pieces. In large bowl add the milk to the bread. Let set for 2 hours. Add eggs butter vanilla salt and sugar; beat with electric mixer until creamy. Add the raisins. Pour into a 12 x 10-inch buttered loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Dutch Apple Cream Cake(Serves 8)
instructions: For crust combine cake mix and margarine until crumbly. Stir in coconut and press 2/3 of mixture into bottom and up sides of well-greased (sprayed) 9 x 11-inch casserole dish. Spread apples evenly; sprinkle evenly with blended sugar and cinnamon. Blend sour cream and egg then pour over apples. Sprinkle remaining crust over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cool gelatin and water. Add nuts cranberry sauce pineapple and juice wine and celery. Let set.

title: Chicken Breasts With Sour Cream
instructions: Mix spices and herbs together. Dust chicken breasts in spice mixture and dredge with flour. Heat butter in saute pan over medium heat. Add chicken and cook 3 minutes. Season with salt. Turn pieces over and cook 3 minutes. Add green onions to pan and cook 1 minute. Pour in chicken stock and cook 6 minutes over low heat. Do not cover.

title: Sugar
instructions: Mix these 2 ingredients store in tightly closed container. This is so nice when served with tea or used in place of plain sugar in dessert recipes. Sprinkle pancakes or waffles with this sugar and quickly caramelize under broiler before serving. Stores for months!

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Line a 9 inch x 13 inch pan with whole graham crackers to form a crust. In bowl mix pudding mix and milk together. Add Cool Whip and mix until blended. Spread filling over graham crackers. Top with a layer of graham crackers. Chill overnight.\tFrost with chocolate icing. Store in refrigerator.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in salted water for 2 to 3 minutes; drain. Brown ground beef; drain off fat. Add sauce salt and pepper to ground beef. Put half of noodles in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with half of the sauce and cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and flour in mixing bowl. Heat oleo cocoa and Coca-Cola to boiling and pour over flour/sugar mixture mixing thoroughly. Add milk eggs soda vanilla and marshmallows and mix well. This will be a thin batter with marshmallows floating on top. Bake in flat pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Ice while hot. (May use oblong or round layer cake pans.)

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until fully cooked. Let cool and cut into bite size pieces. Mix in cream of chicken soup sour cream and poppy seed. Put in casserole dish that has been greased with butter.

title: Creamy Chocolate Cheese Cake
instructions: Crust Mix together first 3 ingredients and press into greased round or square pan.

title: Potato Cakes
instructions: Using leftover mashed potatoes add egg and green onion tops. Mix well. Shape into biscuit-sized cakes roll in flour and fry to golden brown in bacon drippings.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans or 3 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf pans. Cream eggs shortening and sugar. Mix in pumpkin and water. Blend in spices and dry ingredients. Stir in nuts and raisins and put in pans. Bake 65 to 70 minutes until clean.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Balls Or Logs
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. When it is mixed shape it into small balls or roll into logs.

title: Spinach With Sesame Seed
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add sesame seed. Brown lightly and set aside. Wash and drain spinach. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes and drain. Reduce heat and reheat soy sauce and sesame seed. Add salt and black pepper to taste. Serve.

title: Pico De Gallo
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a non-metal bowl. Place in refrigerator for about 2 hours to allow flavors to mix. Serve chilled.

title: Bread Dip
instructions: Mix first five ingredients together to form a dip. Cut a well in the middle of the loaf of bread. Pour the dip into the well. Arrange bread pieces around the loaf.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter sugar vanilla and lemon extract until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Combine strawberry jam and sour cream and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Add walnuts. Bake in a greased loaf pan for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: French Toast Bundt
instructions: Cut Rolls into fourths. Mix other ingredients in a bowl. Dip rolls in mixture and place in bundt pan sprayed with non-stick spray. Pour remaining mixture over rolls. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature until rolls reach the top of the pan. Remove wrap and bake at 350 for 35 minutes. Invert onto serving platter. Drizzle with Syrup and sprinkle with Powdered Sugar. Slice and serve with additonal Syrup.

title: Chicken And English Pea Bake
instructions: Combine first\t4 ingredients\tin a shallow\t2 quart casserole dish. Place chicken breasts in casserole turning to coat. Add mushrooms; pour broth around chicken. Cover and bake at\t350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.\tAdd peas. Cover and bake an additional 10 minutes or until peas are tender.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken salt and celery. When chicken is done cool and remove from bone. Make pie crust for top and bottom of pan.

title: Baked Acorn Squash With Crisp Onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. With large chefs knife quarter squash lengthwise. With spoon scoop out and discard seeds. Halve squash into pieces lengthwise. Place skin side down in jelly roll pan. In small bowl combine butter curry powder salt and pepper. Mix well. With pastry brush spread mixture evenly over inside of squash. Sprinkle with almond slices and bake 45 minutes until tender when tested with tip of paring knife. In large skillet saute onions. Spread onions on squash.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Season with salt and pepper; dredge in cornmeal. Heat bacon drippings in a heavy skillet; add tomatoes and fry slowly until browned turning once. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Meat Loaf Supreme
instructions: Combine first 11 ingredients; mix well. Shape into 18 x 12-inch rectangle on sheet of wax paper. Layer red pepper onion and cheese on meat mixture leaving 1-inch around edges. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Use wax paper to lift and roll. Pinch edges and ends to seal. Place loaf seam side down on rack of lightly greased broiler pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Cherry Bars
instructions: Mix by hand to avoid breaking up cherries. Bake in greased 10 x 15 jelly-roll pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Microwave onion and pepper for 1 to 2 minutes until tender. Mix all ingredients. Spray 1-quart casserole with Pam. Pour mixture into dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Vanilla Wafer Crumb Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs beating well. Add crumbs and milk alternately. Add coconut and nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Butterscotch-Chocolate Ice Cream Squares
instructions: Combine flour oats and brown sugar. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in nuts. Pat mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Stir while still warm to crumble. Cool.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries. Add sugar and let stand 1/2 hour. Dissolve jello in hot liquid. When jello begins to thicken add cranberries oranges pineapple and nuts. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce and top with whipped cream.

title: Coconut Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place apple slices in shallow 1-quart dish. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar cinnamon and walnuts. Cream butter and 1/3 cup sugar; add egg vanilla and coconut. Mix thoroughly. Stir in flour gently. Spread batter evenly over apple mixture. Bake 35 minutes or until crust top is crisp and golden. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Tim'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix everything and pour mixture into greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Decorative Icing
instructions: Beat sugar meringue powder and 6 tbsp water in a mixer at medium speed until smooth. Increase speed to highest and beat 5 minutes until thick and smooth adding up to 1 tbsp. more water for piping consistency if necessary.

title: Amish Stewing Noodles
instructions: Make a soft dough by combining all ingredients (add more milk if necessary). Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead until well worked. Roll dough out as thin as possible and cut into strips about 1/2-inch wide and 2 inches long. Let dry about 1 hour. These noodles are great in soups and stews or great as dumplings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken. Do not salt! Remove from bone and cut up; save broth. Melt margarine and stir into dressing. In a greased baking dish (13 x 9-inch) put a layer of dressing crumbs a layer of chicken and the mushroom soup which has been diluted with one can of broth. Again a layer of crumbs a layer of chicken and the can of celery soup which has been diluted with a can of broth. Top with crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Granny'S Date Nut Roll
instructions: In saucepan stir sugar milk syrup margarine and dates. Cook to soft ball stage (240\u00b0). Add pecans and vanilla. Beat until mixture becomes firm. Pour onto damp clean towel and shape into 1 1/2-inches thick roll. Refrigerate until firm. Slice. This roll keeps for a long time in a tightly covered container.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Beat together all ingredients except apples and nuts. Then add apples and nuts. Bake in greased and floured pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Apple Cider
instructions: Combine apple juice orange slices cloves and 4 cinnamon sticks in medium saucepan. Heat to boiling. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Strain and discard oranges cloves and cinnamon sticks. Stir in Equal. Pour into mugs. Garnish with cinnamon sticks if desired. Makes 8 servings (4 ounces each).

title: Hungry Jack Biscuit Barbecups
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10 muffin cups. Brown beef in large skillet; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce onion and brown sugar. Cook 1 minute to blend flavor stirring constantly. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Place 1 biscuit in each muffin cup. Firmly press in bottom and up sides. Spoon 1/4 cup of meat mixture into each biscuit lined cup. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mile High Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder cream of tartar and salt mixing well. Cut in shortening with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Combine egg and milk. Add to flour mixture stirring\tuntil dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface.\tKnead 8 to 10 times. Roll dough to 1 inch thickness. Cut with a 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes until brown.

title: Filled Coffee Cake
instructions: Fill biscuits with the cream cheese and sugar to taste. Seal edges with fingers. Dip in melted butter or oleo. Roll in a mixture of 1 cup sugar orange rind and chopped nuts. Stand up in Bundt pan (fills pan exactly). Pour remainder of sugar-orange-nut mixture over biscuits (and butter). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done. Cool in pan 1 minute. Turn out on plate. Serve hot. Delicious!

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together flour chopped nuts and margarine; spread onto bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan (about 3 to 4 inches deep). Bake for 20 minutes. Let crust cool.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa milk and margarine in saucepan. Bring to\ta boil for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper lined tray. Let stand until cool. Yields 32 servings.

title: Devilish Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise and remove yolks. Mash yolks then stir in mayonnaise yogurt and Parmesan cheese. Add Worcestershire sauce if desired. Fill the egg halves with the yolk mixture.

title: Mushroom Wine Sauce
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter; set aside.

title: Fudge Candy
instructions: Pour milk sugar and margarine in saucepan and bring to rolling boil. Boil for 9 minutes. Place marshmallow chocolate nuts and vanilla in large bowl. Add first set of mixture and blend well. Pour in greased baking dish (glass) and let cool. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: I use 1/2 this recipe for my family of 4.

title: Creamy Chicken And Bows
instructions: In a large skillet melt butter and stir in chicken with red pepper; cook for 3 minutes. Add peas cheese garlic powder and Cup-a-Soup blended with milk. Simmer stirring occasionally 5 minutes; toss with hot bows! Makes 2 servings.

title: Carrot And Cabbage Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add vinegar and salt. Chill. When slightly thickened fold in carrots and cabbage. Turn into individual molds. Chill until firm. Unmold on crisp lettuce. Serve with mayonnaise.

title: Oyster Puffs
instructions: Combine ingredients to make a stiff batter. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot fat. Fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Chow-Chow
instructions: Mix all together; boil 20 minutes. Seal while hot.

title: Chicken Liver Pate
instructions: In heavy saucepan melt a small amount of butter. Add livers. Cover and cook stirring occasionally until livers are no longer pink. Put livers through meat grinder. Blend with mayonnaise lemon juice 2 tablespoons butter onion hot pepper sauce and seasonings. Place mixture in 2-cup mold. Chill several hours; carefully unmold. Garnish with chopped hard-cooked egg chopped chives or snipped parsley.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add onions and simmer for a few minutes. Next add barbecue sauce brown sugar and water. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into small pieces. Mix sugar and cinnamon together drop pieces in and shake to coat. Mix remaining mixture with butter. Place coated pieces into greased tube or Bundt pan pour remaining mixture over pieces. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes and serve warm.

title: Super Bean Salad Bowl
instructions: Soak beans overnight in 6 cups water to which 2 teaspoons salt has been added.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Break egg into large mixing bowl. Add shortening sugar cinnamon milk and lemon juice; beat until creamy. Sift flour and baking powder into another bowl; add to mixture. Mix well with spoon. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto 2 cookie sheets. Do not grease them. Leave one inch of space between cookies. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from sheets; place on wire racks to cool. Makes 36.

title: Pimento Sandwiches
instructions: Mash pimentos and add cheese salad dressing vinegar salt pepper and then pickles if pickles are desired. This makes about 15 sandwiches.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Put marshmallow cream and peanut butter in bowl. Boil milk and sugar to 238\u00b0. Add 1/2 cup nuts. Put in buttered pan. After it starts setting cut into squares.

title: Banana Ice Cream
instructions: Mix ingredients together and\tpour into freezer. Add enough homogenized milk to make a gallon.

title: Glazed Parsnips And Carrots
instructions: Cut carrots and parsnips into chunky diagonal slices. In large skillet cook carrots in boiling water until tender. Drain. Cook parsnips the same way and drain. In skillet melt butter stir in sugar. Combine cornstarch and grapefruit juice. Stir into butter mixture. Return vegetables to pan keeping them separated. Cook until glazed and heated through. Kitchen tested and makes 8 servings.

title: Easy Does It Breakfast
instructions: Crumble sausage in skillet. When brown leave grease and sausage in skillet. Add flour salt and pepper. Stir until flour is blended with sausage. Then add milk. Cook until the gravy is the consistency that you like. Serve over biscuits or bread.

title: Shrimp Skewers
instructions: Alternate shrimp vegetables and pineapple on 3 skewers. Broil or grill approximately 5 minutes on each side or until done. Baste with Italian dressing while cooking. Serve over rice.

title: Hamburger Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Add tomatoes salt and pepper and potatoes. Cook until potatoes are done (you may need to add more liquid tomato juice or water). Add whatever vegetables you like. Quick and easy ready within an hour.

title: Potato Pinwheels
instructions: Boil potato until done (no salt). Let cool enough to handle then peel. While still hot mash thoroughly. Begin adding powdered sugar in small amounts at a time until the potato and powdered sugar mixture is at a rolled dough stage. Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness. Spread with peanut butter and roll up like a jelly roll. Chill for 5 to 6 hours. Slice into 1/4 to 1/2-inch pieces. Serve cold.

title: Snicker Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Snicker bars. Wrap dough around candy bars and bake at 325\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Delicious Deep-Fried Catfish
instructions: Mix flour cornmeal salt and pepper. Dip fillets into milk then dredge in flour mixture. Pour corn oil in a heavy 3-quart saucepan filling no more than 1/3 full. Heat to 375\u00b0. Fry fillets 1 1/2 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towels and serve with hush puppies and cole slaw.

title: Strawberry Banana Cooler
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender container. Cover tightly; blend until smooth and serve immediately. Yield 3 to 4 servings.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Place brown sugar oleo and granulated sugar in saucepan. Mix well and boil for 1 minute. Pour over popcorn. Toss and mix well. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Pour in peanuts if wanted.

title: Blinchiki
instructions: Place butter in pan to heat; take off stove. Add beaten eggs; add flour and salt. Slowly add milk. Fry each in hot buttered pan on both sides; fill and roll.

title: Cherry Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream until fluffy one cup of sugar and 1/2 cup oleo. Sift 2 cups of flour with baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with egg and milk. Beat well. Spread in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread pie filling over batter.

title: Easy Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a bowl for 3 minutes. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan. Let stand for 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Cheese Cake
instructions: Chill milk. Put one cup boiling water in jello; let cool. Cream sugar and cheese together. Whip milk until thick. Combine cream cheese and sugar. Add jello and lemon juice. Fold into milk. Mix cracker crumbs and margarine; press into 11 x 13-inch pan to form crust. Pour mixture over crumbs. Add some cracker crumbs over the top. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Cold Asparagus With Lemon-Mustard Dressing
instructions: Steam asparagus until crisp-tender and bright green; immediately drain and rinse under cold water. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Combine mayonnaise mustard and lemon juice in small bowl; blend well. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel; set aside. Divide asparagus between plates. Spoon 2 tablespoons dressing over top of each serving. Sprinkle each with 1/4 teaspoon lemon peel. Garnish with carrot strips if desired. Makes two appetizer servings.

title: Brownies(Triple Recipe)
instructions: Melt chocolate. Add butter and cream together. Add sugar and eggs. Beat. Add flour baking powder vanilla almond extract and chopped nuts. Put in cookie sheet size pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole For Four Persons
instructions: Mix flour and seasonings and dip chicken joints in this coating well. Remove rind and dice bacon. Peel and slice onion. Wash and slice mushrooms. Heat butter (or margarine) and oil in a frying pan and fry chicken until golden brown. Put into a casserole. Lightly fry the bacon and onion; add to the chicken. Add the mushrooms and herbs. Sprinkle in the rest of the flour. Pour off any fat left in the frying pan. Add the hot water and stir to dissolve the sediment. Add the chicken stock cubes and stir until dissolved. Pour into the casserole. Cover and cook until the chicken is tender (approximately 1 1/4 hours) at gas mark 4 (350\u00b0).

title: Matzo Meal Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs add water salt and matzo meal; stir. Melt a little butter in a pan and pour batter to form circles. Turn when golden brown and cook until done. Eat with jam or sugar.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; mix well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 375\u00b0.

title: David'S Chili
instructions: Dice and fry the bacon. Save the grease. Saute the onions or fresh garlic in the bacon grease. Brown the meat in small portions in the bacon grease. Mix all ingredients except the cheese and Maza flour. The water and beer should be added in equal amounts until a sufficient liquid level is obtained. Bring the chili to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Add the chicken mixture and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pretzel Torte
instructions: Crush pretzels then add sugar and oleo; mix well. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Save 1/2 cup of pretzel for topping.

title: Lasagna No. 2
instructions: Cook noodles and drain; set aside to cool. Brown meat and onion. Add all ingredients except noodles cheeses and meat. Simmer sauce on low for 15 minutes. Slice cheeses. Spread a little sauce on bottom of pan to prevent sticking. Layer noodles cheeses and sauce ending with sauce and cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 until cheese is melted about 30 minutes.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix with fork the flour sugar salt and Crisco. Add water egg and vinegar. Mix well then with hands mix into balls. Makes 3 (9-inch) pie crusts. Chill dough before rolling out.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix peanut butter powdered sugar margarine and vanilla; blend well and shape into 1-inch balls.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: *Thighs and breasts work great.

title: French Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift together flour cocoa soda and salt. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg whites; beat 1 minute. Combine water sour cream and vanilla. Add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Blend thoroughly after each addition. (With electric mixer use low speed.) Pour into well greased and lightly floured (2) 8 in round pans at least 1 1/2 in deep. Bake in 350 degree oven 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Mexican Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: In a bowl stir together the 1 cup of cornmeal baking soda and salt; stir in milk eggs and corn. Stir in cheese chili peppers and onion;\tmix until well blended. Meanwhile in\ta large skillet cook ground beef until brown. Drain. Stir in beans tomato sauce chili powder and garlic powder. Cook until heated through. Grease and sprinkle a thin layer of cornmeal over the bottom of a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Turn 1/2 of the cornmeal batter into the dish. Cover with\tthe meat-bean mixture and top with remaining cornmeal mixture.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until top is golden brown.

title: Creamy Coleslaw
instructions: In a large bowl mix well mayonnaise vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Add cabbage carrots and onion; toss to mix well. Cover and chill at least 1 hour to blend flavors. Makes 6 servings.

title: Daisy'S Blueberry Cake(Makes 16 Servings)
instructions: In a bowl mix together the butter and sugar until creamy. Stir in vanilla and orange rind. Beat in the egg. Stir in orange juice. Mixture will be slightly curdled.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: In a large measuring cup put oil and 2 eggs; fill up cup with milk to make 2 cups total liquid. Sift together flour sugar salt and baking powder. Mix all ingredients (flour pint of blueberries); fold into batter. Pour into a large greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Umm good!

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix well and pour into a well-greased baking dish. To double recipe use a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 if using a glass dish or 350\u00b0 for other kind of dish. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown on top. I prefer to use fresh corn. Add a little milk salt and pepper. Cook for a few minutes and cool. Serves 6.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients; add salt and pepper to your taste. Cover meat with sauce and soak in refrigerator overnight. Turn meat occasionally while soaking.

title: Onion And Bacon Quiche
instructions: Cook onions in butter (15 to 20 minutes) until soft. While onions cook saute bacon until lightly browned. Drain well.

title: Homemade Pie Crust
instructions: Mix egg water and vinegar together. Combine salt and flour. Pour egg mixture into the center of the dry ingredients. Stir with a fork from the middle to the outer edge until mixed. Chill. Roll out and place in pie pans. Makes enough dough for 5 pies.

title: Cherry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 F. Prepare cake mix as directed. Pour cherry pie filling in baking pan spread evenly pour 1/2 cake mix over filling do not stir. Add pecans and coconut. Add the other half of the cake mix over pecans and coconut pour melted butter over cake mix. Bake at 350 F for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Sweet `N' Sour Slaw
instructions: Bring vinegar sugar mustard and celery seeds to boil. Allow to cool and pour over cabbage pepper and celery. Better if allowed to set overnight. Will keep several days.

title: Veal Scallopini Piccata
instructions: Dredge veal medallions in flour; shake well. Heat butter and oil in skillet. Cook veal on both sides until browned. Cut 2 lemons and squeeze over veal. Season to taste. Simmer for 2 minutes. Serve on platter; garnish with the third lemon sliced thin.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients except raisins. In an 11 x 13-inch pan sprinkle bottom evenly with the 3/4 cup raisins. Pour the ingredients over raisins. Place pan inside larger pan filled with 1 inch water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Pudding will \set\ after removal from oven. Dont overbake.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: In electric skillet heat 1/2-inch oil to 400\u00b0. In medium bowl with fork stir one tablespoon oil and rest of the ingredients until blended. Drop batter by heaping tablespoons into hot oil. Fry 3 to 5 minutes until browned turning once. With slotted spoon remove fritters to paper towels. Drain. Serve with syrup or sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place chicken pieces in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix soups broth and Veg-All. Pour over chicken. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tasty Vegetable Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet cook onions in butter until soft and golden brown. Add beef and toss with a fork until red color disappears. Add salt pepper and rice. Mix well. Stir in peas tomatoes and cheese. Pour into greased baking dish and bake 15 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Creamsicle Punch
instructions: Soften ice cream and sherbet with wire whisk. Blend in milk. Add juice and ginger ale. Makes about 50 (5 ounce) servings.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Our sixth generation of cooks has already started thinking of cooking. Carole Underwoods four year old granddaughter asked her to make some Blueberry Muffins. Carole asked her granddaughter Morgan if she knew how and she replied \Yes me and mommie make them all the time; you take 4 pounds of water and mix it with 3 eggs and a box of sugar and cook it. Thats all you do.\ Now how about that for a 4 year old?

title: Jan'S Baked Beans
instructions: Brown bacon and onion together. Mix with the rest of ingredients. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until it bubbles then bake at 325\u00b0 until thick and liquid has cooked down. This will take at least 1 hour. Taste to see if mixture is sweet before baking. Also it should have a dark red color.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Squeeze grated potatoes with your hands to remove as much liquid as possible. Stir remaining ingredients into drained potatoes. Heat oil (enough for 1/2-inch depth) in a frying pan. Spoon potato mixture by large tablespoons into oil and flatten each pancake with back of spatula. Fry until golden then turn and fry on other side. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with applesauce or sour cream.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour salt and soda in a small bowl. In a large bowl cream the butter and sugars. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually add mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Swiss Onion Tart
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Over medium heat saute onions in butter slowly until they are translucent and soft. Sprinkle flour over them mix well and let cook a couple of minutes. Remove from heat and add egg yolks. Gradually stir in cream. Add salt pepper and nutmeg. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until filling is firm.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Mix potatoes mayonnaise cheese and onions. Put in buttered baked dish 9 x 8-inches or 12 x 8-inches. Top with bacon and olives. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Dont peel the potatoes; cook them whole and let cool. Substituting for Velveeta cheese is not recommended.

title: Drunk Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix all together; cook. Add water or whiskey as needed. Keep warm in crock-pot or skillet while serving.

title: Sour Cream Dressing(For Cole Slaw Or Cucumber And Onions)
instructions: Beat ingredients; pour over cabbage shredded thin or cucumber and onions.

title: Whole Wheat Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Cut in shortening until like coarse crumbs. Make a well; add milk all at once. Stir quickly with a fork just until dough follows fork around bowl. Turn onto lightly floured surface. Knead gently 10 to 12 strokes. Roll out dough 1/2 inch thick. Dip cutter into flour; cut dough straight down. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Mike'S Favorite Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Add spaghetti sauce and crushed tomatoes to a 5-quart saucepan and heat. Brown chopped meat in a skillet and drain. Saute chopped onions and chopped green peppers in heated corn oil. Add chopped meat onions green peppers basil Italian seasoning crushed red peppers bay leaves garlic powder salt and sugar to sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Fig Preserves
instructions: Cook in a large pot over very low heat until syrup is thickened. To check syrup dip spoon in syrup and let cool. Syrup should be thick enough not to pour off.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Line bottom of pie pan with crescent pie crust. Mix chicken soup and peas and carrots.\tPour into pie crust. Top with another crescent pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Rice Soup
instructions: Mix and brown ground beef salt pepper garlic powder cayenne pepper and onion in a large saucepan. Add tomato juice and potatoes. Cook until potatoes are tender. Add rice turn off heat cover and let stand 15 minutes. If soup becomes too thick you can add water or more tomato liquid. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar and vanilla. Add 2 beaten egg yolks sour cream and raisins. Stir well and cook over medium heat until thickened. Pour into 9-inch pie crust. Top with 2 egg whites (beaten until stiff). Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut butter into cake mix (dry) until crumbly. Pat mixture lightly into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; build up slight edge. Bake for 10 minutes. Have apples ready mixed with sugar and cinnamon (blend to create juice). Arrange apple slices on warm crust. Blend sour cream and egg; drizzle over apples to cover. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 until edges are light brown. Do not overbake. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Big Bucket In The Sky Chicken
instructions: Combine all the dry ingredients in double plastic food bag. Shake well. Prepare a 10 x 15 x 3/4-inch pan with Pam or wipe it well with oil. Run a cut-up fryer chicken under cold water and let excess water drip or put the wet chicken pieces into a colander and drain a few minutes. Dredge pieces in the flour mixture by placing each piece one at a time into the bag of seasoned flour and shaking it. Arrange the coated pieces skin side up on the prepared pan. Melt 1/4 pound butter or margarine and using a soft bristled brush dab the melted margarine over the floured surface skin side only of each piece. When all of the melted margarine has been divided among all the chicken pieces bake them uncovered without turning at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender.

title: Dorothy'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Form the meat then mix 1 can stewed tomatoes and 1 can tomato paste. Pour on top of meat. Bake at 350 degrees until brown on top.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Measure Bisquick in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix together until well blended. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until center tests done.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Mix sugar cinnamon and salt with apples and set aside. Combine shortening flour and salt in a bowl. Add enough to egg yolks to make 2/3 cup of liquid and add to pie crust mixture. Divide dough in half. Use a 17 x 11-inch cookie sheet and place 1/2 of dough on cookie sheet. Press with hand or roll with rolling pin until bottom and sides are covered. Sprinkle crushed cornflakes on dough. Add apple mixture. Roll other half of dough to fit the top. Press around edge with thumb. Beat egg whites stiff spread over top of dough. (Do not add sugar to egg whites.) Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cover with thin powdered sugar frosting while warm. Makes 18 servings.

title: Dough For Christmas Ornaments
instructions: Mix flour and salt together. Gradually add water a little at a time. Knead until dough is smooth and putty like. Roll dough about 1/4-inch thick. Cut out shapes. Bake on cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 until light brown or let dry on screen for 48 hours.

title: Coconut-Chocolate Treats
instructions: Melt margarine; stir in sugar and coconut. Chill. Shape rounded teaspoons of mixture into balls. Flatten slightly. Indent center of each. Fill with melted chocolate. Chill until firm. Store in refrigerator. Makes approximately 3 dozen cookies.

title: Recipe Of Mother'S Love
instructions: Throw in a little hope dreams hugs and kisses. Mix well. Use daily. Dont let temperature get over 300\u00b0.

title: Egg Dumplings
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Drop into hot broth dipping spoon in hot broth each time.

title: Pineapple Surprise Sheet Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Remove from oven. Spread crushed pineapple (juice and all) over cake. Mix pudding mix with milk and cream cheese. Spread over the pineapple and spread with Cool Whip. Top off cake with coconut.

title: Orange Cheese Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple sugar and water to boil. Dissolve jello into the hot mixture. Cool in refrigerator until it is the consistency of egg whites. Add cheese and nuts. Fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into bowl or mold; refrigerate until set.

title: Tomato-Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large Dutch oven; drain and add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally.\tYield\tabout 5 quarts. Great served with corn bread.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Blend butter and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Add flour alternately with milk beginning and ending with flour. Add vanilla and almond flavorings. Pour mixture in tube pan that has been thoroughly greased. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers thin. Add onions garlic and salt. Cover with ice. Let stand 3 hours. Drain. Combine with remaining ingredients and heat to a boil.

title: Denver Omelet Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat the eggs onion powder thyme salt and pepper. Stir in the potatoes cheese ham and green pepper. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Garnish with tomato slices. Serves 6.

title: Rich Scones
instructions: Mix flour and salt in a bowl. Rub in Crisco or margarine. Mix in fruit and sugar. Stir in beaten egg and milk. Make into soft dough. Roll out to thickness of 1/2-inch and cut in rounds with a 2 1/2-inch scone cutter. Place on greased baking sheet. Brush over tops with tablespoon of beaten egg. Bake in a 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes gas oven 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut stem end off pepper. Remove seed. Cook peppers in enough boiling water to cover 5 minutes. Cook hamburger and onion in skillet until light brown. Stir in salt rice and 1 can tomato sauce; heat thoroughly. (Save 1 can to go on top of peppers.) Stuff pepper with hamburger mixture. Stand upright in an ungreased baking dish. Pour tomato sauce over peppers. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover; cook 15 minutes longer. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Melt butter in broth. Add soup then seasoned mix. Add chicken and sour cream. Add broth to chicken; mix if too thick. Butter baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix everything except butter together. Pour in large casserole dish. Cut butter into small chunks on top of mixture. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 400\u00b0. Do not cover.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Kisses and extra sugar. Shape dough into balls approximately 1 tsp. Roll in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 - 12 minutes. When done quickly top each with a Kiss pressing firmly into cookie.

title: Lo-Cal Dessert Lime Fluff
instructions: Sprinkle dry jello over cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Drain oranges and pineapple. Add to cottage cheese mixture then add marshmallows and nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Defrost Cool Whip. Put in a large bowl. Add crushed pineapple with juice and stir. Add the pudding and stir. Add the marshmallows. Stir and let sit in refrigerator until chilled (1 to 2 hours). Great all year long especially good in summer.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil together butter sugar cocoa and milk. Boil 1 1/2 minutes. Take off stove. Add peanut butter vanilla and oats. Spoon out on cookie sheet and let cool.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all together. Shape into balls to freeze. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden.

title: Fantastic Mint Chocolate Pie
instructions: Place margarine corn syrup and chocolate in 2-quart saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Add Cocoa Krispies cereal to chocolate mixture. Stir until cereal is coated. With back of spoon shape mixture evenly in bottom and on side of 9-inch pan coated with cooking spray. (If mixture is too soft refrigerate about five minutes.) Chill crust.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes until golden brown. Cut into 2 x 1-inch pieces. Serve warm. Makes 4 dozen appetizers.

title: Angel Pineapple Pie
instructions: Heat pineapple sugar and water to boiling point. Add cornstarch that has been dissolved in a little water. Cook until thickened. Add salt. Cool. Beat egg whites until firm. Fold into pineapple mixture. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with Dream Whip and nuts.

title: Carrot Cake Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend all ingredients in large bowl. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Spread batter in greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done with a toothpick. Frost when fully cooled with cream cheese frosting.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well with mixer or blender. Refrigerate. Set out 30 minutes before serving to soften.

title: Ginger, Mint And Lemon Grass Sun Tea
instructions: Fill a 1-gallon glass container with water. Put all ingredients in water and leave in the sun for 1 to 2 days depending on sunshine.

title: Overnight Black-Eyed Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in refrigerator overnight. Can be served on salad greens or in a bowl with Fritos or other dippers for hors doeuvres.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except potato chips. Put in a greased casserole and top with crushed potato chips. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven until hot and brown on top.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine Karo peanuts water sugar and salt. Microwave on High 5 minutes. Stir. Microwave 13 more minutes on High. Test with candy thermometer. If not to 300\u00b0 microwave on High for 60 seconds then test again. Keep testing after every minute until it reaches 300\u00b0. Quickly stir in soda and vanilla until light and foamy. Turn out onto a buttered cookie sheet. Let cool and break into pieces. Store in a tightly covered container.

title: Youvarlakia - Meatball Soup
instructions: For broth I often use bouillon cubes to make the broth.

title: Oatmeal Caramelitos
instructions: Combine flour oatmeal brown sugar soda salt and margarine. Press 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Take from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips (can add nuts also) over baked crust. Combine caramel syrup and 6 tablespoons flour mixing well and drizzle over chocolate chips. Sprinkle remaining crumbs over topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Chill bars.

title: Brownies
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Melt oleo in brownie pan. Mix remainder in bowl; add oleo then nuts. Spread in pan. Bake about 20 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix crushed wafers and melted butter; press into bottom of rectangle dish. Slice bananas lengthwise and cover bottom. Avoid overly ripe bananas. Use yellow skinned or green tipped. Mix together condensed milk and lemon juice; spread on top of bananas. Spread crushed pineapple on top of Eagle Brand layer. Cover with whipped topping (8 to 9 ounce is plenty). Sprinkle coconut chopped nuts and arrange red cherries on top to designate serving size. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Easy no cooking pretty and good!

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Mix sugar crumbs and melted oleo. Line pan and sides.

title: Dressing For Fruit Salad
instructions: Beat together onion and sugar until sugar is dissolved. Add other ingredients. This is a thick dressing.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour large sheet cake baking pan. Beat\tsugar oil pumpkin and eggs in large mixer bowl on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally for 1 minute. Stir in dry ingredients. Stir in cinnamon nuts and raisins. Pour into pan and bake approximately 35 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting or is delicious served with whipped cream.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Mix the first seven ingredients and stir in remaining ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 on a greased cookie sheet for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Canned Corn
instructions: Take 1 cup friendly words 2 cups heaping of understanding and 4 heaping teaspoonful of time and patience. Add a pinch of warm personality and a dash of humor. Measure the words carefully and the heaping amounts of time and patience. Keep temperature low; do not boil. Add a dash of humor and a pinch of warm spice of life. Serve in individual molds and garnish with smiles. This recipe never fails.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Drain mushrooms reserving liquid. Brown mushrooms beef and onion in shortening. Stir in flour and salt. Add mushroom liquid water 57 sauce and parsley; combine well. Simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in sour cream. Serve immediately over noodles.

title: Apple Dumplins
instructions: Place the apples on squares of pastry rolled to about 6-inches. Mix the water sugar cinnamon nutmeg and margarine. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes. Pour over dumplins in pan and bake in oven at 375\u00b0 until apples are done and dumplins are nicely brown. Dip sauce over them while baking.

title: Sauerkraut Soup
instructions: Spray Dutch oven with nonstick coating. Brown meat. Stir in water apple juice undrained tomatoes sauerkraut onion bouillon pepper and garlic. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 25 minutes or until meat is tender. Stir in apple and simmer 5 minutes more. Yields 5 servings.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Put the egg in a cup. Add fruit juice to measure a cup. Combine oats baking powder and salt. Combine honey oil juice egg and dried fruit. Mix together until blended. Fill and slightly mound in greased muffin tins. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Makes about 12 muffins.

title: Head Cheese
instructions: Cook pork veal pork bones and onions in kettle with only 1 to 2-inches of water in bottom. Cook at least 3 hours or until meat begins to fall off. Cut meat from bones; save cooking water at least 1 cup. Mix all ingredients along with dissolved gelatin in a large bowl. Pour into glass loaf pans and refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Cajun Cabbage
instructions: In a large Dutch oven brown ground beef. Add onions and green pepper; cook until the onions are transparent. Add the rice tomatoes tomato sauce water seasonings and cabbage. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Yields 10 to 12 servings. Great casserole to take to a potluck supper!

title: Dream Bars
instructions: Thoroughly blend butter sugar and cake flour; spread in lightly greased 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Beat eggs and brown sugar until thick; add sifted dry ingredients. Add nuts and coconut; spread over first mixture. Continue baking 30 minutes. Cut in squares and cool in pan. Makes 2 dozen squares.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Quiche
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese dinner as directed on package except use 2 tablespoons milk instead of amount required. Add 2 eggs; mix well. Spread over bottom and sides of greased 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Toss Swiss cheese with flour; add remaining ingredients. Pour over dinner mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cover loosely with foil; continue baking 20 minutes or until set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Green Beans Excellent
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook for 30 minutes. Good with ham.

title: Farm Style Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Let dough thaw and rise almost double in size. Brush 8 x 10-inch pan or 9 x 9-inch with 1 tablespoon of butter. Roll out dough on floured surface. Brush with 2 tablespoons of butter. Sprinkle with sugar cinnamon and raisins. Roll up. Cut with a knife into 12 pieces. Place side up in buttered pan. Brush with remaining butter. Let rise 45 to 60 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Coconut Soup
instructions: Peel and grate the fresh coconuts. In a saucepan scald the milk and stir in grated coconut. Let stand until cold and squeeze the juice through a napkin. In a saucepan add juice to the broth and bring to the boiling point. Beat egg yolks in a tureen and pour the soup over. Serve hot decorated with toasted almonds. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Cream butter and grated cheese. Add red pepper and flour. Put in cookie press and make sticks 2 1/3 to 3-inches long. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Makes 100 sticks 6-inches long.

title: Entomatadas(Mexican Dish)
instructions: In skillet brown ground meat; drain. Add taco seasoning and salt. Remove from range. Pour meat in flour tortillas; roll like burritos. Place in a baking pan. Set aside. In a large saucepan pour tomato sauce white onion and salt; cook on medium heat for 20 minutes. Pour over burritos.

title: Pink Arctic Freeze
instructions: Soften cream cheese by adding sugar and mayo. Add cranberries and pineapple; mix. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in loaf pan lined with plastic. Put in freezer for 24 hours. Take out and put on dish. Apply extra Cool Whip as icing and re-freeze. Serve frozen.

title: Oven Fried Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Stir well. Rinse chicken with cold water and pat dry. Dip chicken in butter and dredge in cracker crumb mixture. Place chicken in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pork Chop Surprise
instructions: Slice potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with a layer of cheese. Place pork chops on top of cheese and season. (Optional Add another layer of cheese.) Spread cream of mushroom soup over top. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour until potatoes and pork chops are done.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Add sugar flour salt peaches and brandy to margarine in saucepan. Cook for about 4 minutes after it comes to a boil. Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish.

title: Angel Food Pie
instructions: Cook pineapple juice 1/2 cup sugar and cornstarch in double boiler until very thick; stir constantly to prevent lumping. Remove from heat and cool. Beat egg whites to a soft peak adding 4 tablespoons sugar gradually. Fold into cooled filling gently. Pour into graham cracker pie shell. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Beat cream cheese margarine\tmilk and vanilla until creamy. Stir in powdered sugar until smooth.

title: Heath Bar Crunch Ice Cream
instructions: Freeze the candy bars. Beat the eggs by hand until fluffy. Slowly add sugar. Mix in remaining ingredients. Pour mixture into an ice cream maker and freeze. (Follow makers directions.) While ice cream is freezing break candy bars into small pieces with a knife handle. When ice cream is done add candy pieces and mix well. Store in freezer. Makes 1 quart.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream(For 1 Gallon)
instructions: Scald milk and 1 cup sugar then mix 1 cup sugar flour salt and eggs with 2 cups cold milk. Stir into boiling milk; stir until it boils again over low heat to prevent from sticking. Add vanilla and cream; add enough milk to fill freezer can. Very good and smooth ice cream.

title: Vegetable Casserole(Very Good!)
instructions: Drain vegetables well. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into baking dish. Melt 1/3 cup oleo then mix with crushed Ritz crackers and cover vegetables in casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crock-Pot Wieners
instructions: Slice wieners. Set aside. Mix cranberry sauce and barbecue sauce in crock-pot. Let get hot. Add wieners. Let simmer 30 minutes.

title: Pizza Dip
instructions: On an 8-inch round tray spread cream cheese then spread seafood cocktail sauce. Add cheese shrimp olives and tomato.

title: Old Fashion Hermits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on 11 x 7-inch greased and floured cookie sheet. Sprinkle sugar on top. Bake 9 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Butter And Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each one. Alternately add the flour and whipping cream. Grease cake pan with Crisco. Place in cold oven and cook 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Feather Light Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Beat in eggs 1 at a time until light and fluffy. Add oil vanilla and lemon peel. Beat until well mixed. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Wrap and chill for several hours. Divide dough into thirds. Refrigerate portions until ready to use. Form cookie by rolling teaspoon of dough into balls. Flatten with a glass that has been set in sugar. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let set for 2 minutes before removing to cool. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Chandler'S Favorite Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Stir together peanut butter 1/2 c. margarine and powdered sugar. Mixture will be stiff. Press into 9 inch square pan. Spread topping over top of peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate to set chocolate topping. Cut into small squares.

title: Delta Dawn Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Add garlic and sausage to a large saucepan and heat over a moderate flame. Saute until the garlic is tender. Drain any excess oil. Add the butter. When melted add the parsley and green onions. Stir well and let the vegetables cook down about 10 to 15 minutes. Add the shrimp sprinkle with lemon juice and blend well with the other ingredients in the saucepan. Stir in the heavy cream and let the ingredients simmer for 5 minutes or until the shrimp are fully cooked and bright pink.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Saute rice onion and pepper in vegetable oil. When rice is golden brown add water and tomato sauce. Add salt sugar lemon juice and black pepper. Bring to a boil. Turn heat to low and cook slowly for 5 minutes while covered with lid.

title: Hearty Beef And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper. Drain fat. Stir in tomato sauce beans and seasonings. Simmer while preparing crust. Spread crescent roll dough in ungreased 9-inch pie pan and up the sides.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Chop 1 onion olives and grate cheese. Set aside. Fry beef 3 onions and peppers together. When onions are coked drain and put into boiling pot with tomato juice olive juice tomato sauce and chili powder. Boil until blended. While this cooks warm tortillas over low open fire.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease cake pin. Combine all ingredients except nuts until creamy. Sprinkle all the nuts on bottom of cake pan and add the mixture. Bake for approximately 55 minutes.

title: White Clam Sauce
instructions: Drain clams reserving liquid. In saucepan cook clams garlic and parsley in margarine a few minutes. Stir in soup milk clam liquid and cheese. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Coconut Cream Pie Filling
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Mix egg yolks with milk. Combine and cook over low heat stirring until thick enough. Add coconut and vanilla.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Sift flour baking powder sugar and salt into mixing bowl. Cut in the shortening. Add enough milk to look like thick cake batter. Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole. Pour undrained peaches or cherries on top of batter. Do not stir. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over peaches or 1 cup sugar over cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tasty Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine eggs flour sugar milk vanilla baking powder and butter. Pour into an ungreased 9 inch x 14 inch jelly roll pan. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes. Remove from oven and spread peanut butter evenly over cake. Let set in refrigerator until cool. Melt chocolate bars and spread evenly over peanut butter. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Cut into desired squares before hard.

title: Peach Cream Cheese Pie(Makes 2 Pies.)
instructions: Mix sugar jello and cornstarch then add cold water. Cook until thick. Add 5 or 6 fresh sliced peaches. Refrigerate.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and\twater until it spins a thread. Beat egg whites until they are stiff. Pour syrup mixture over egg whites then beat\tuntil foamy. Add flavoring nuts and coloring if desired. Pour in buttered plates.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix ingredients well and pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 350 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Chinese Egg Roll Pancakes
instructions: Beat the eggs and water in bowl. Sift in the flour and salt; beat until smooth with a rotary beater.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Combine cucumber and onion slices in a large bowl. Layer with salt and cover with ice cubes. Let stand 1 1/2 hours; drain and rinse. Place remaining ingredients in large sauce pot and bring to a boil. Add drained cucumbers and onions and return to a boil. Pack hot in hot jars. Remove air bubbles. Adjust caps. Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes about 7 pints.

title: Lola Faye'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar oil shortening and eggs together. Mix baking soda with flour. Gradually blend in flour mixture and milk. Mix in vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Spice Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans.\tMix flour cinnamon cloves allspice and nutmeg. Combine sugar oil and eggs; beat until well blended. Add pumpkin; blend well. Pour batter into prepared pans. Bake for 55 minutes or until done. Cool in pans for 15 minutes. Remove from pans and cool on wire rack. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Budget Beef Burgundy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine soup mix wine soup and beef in 2-quart baking dish. Bake covered 1 hour. Serve with buttered noodles.

title: Banana-Fudge Brownies A La Mode
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare brownie mix according to package directions reducing water to 2 tablespoons and using only one egg white; stir mashed banana into batter. Bake in an 8-inch square baking pan for 25 minutes; cool as directed. Cut cooled brownies into 9 squares. Serve each brownie topped with 1/4 cup scoop of frozen yogurt and 1 teaspoon of chocolate syrup.

title: You'Re Lucky If You Get Some
instructions: Combine ingredients. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Barbecue Chicken Wings And Curried Rice
instructions: Cut wings at both joints. Make stock from wing tips. Beat egg oil and water together. Dip wing pieces in and place on rack. Sprinkle with cornstarch on both sides; salt lightly and brown in hot oil. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Make sauce of catsup soy sauce sugar vinegar and stock. Pour over wings and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Saute onions pepper and celery until crisp (in oil left from browning wings). Stir in curry powder and rice. Serve barbecue wings over curried rice.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain fat. Combine with soup water onion and mixed vegetables. Mix well. Bake in covered dish 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. After baking remove cover and add Tater Tots to top and bake 15 minutes longer at 400\u00b0.

title: Potato Salad Recipe
instructions: Mix all of these together except potatoes. Cook potatoes with jackets on; cool and dice. Add after everything has been mixed together. For top save 2 eggs. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons paprika and 2 tablespoons salad seasoning.

title: Brownie Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine brownie mix eggs and oil; beat about 50 strokes with a spoon. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool about 2 minutes on cookie sheets. Remove to wire racks and let cool completely. Yield 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Diet Dreamsicle
instructions: Dissolve Jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add ice cubes to make 2 cups. Let stand 5 minutes. With mixer add vanilla pudding then add drained oranges. Fold in Cool Whip. Freeze in containers.

title: Red And Green Holiday Salad
instructions: Line salad bowl with lettuce. Arrange broccoli and tomatoes on top. Combine oil lemon juice mustard salt and pepper in a small bowl. Mix well; pour over salad. Sprinkle with croutons.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Line bottom of crust with sliced bananas. Soften cream cheese. Mix milk with pudding; add cream cheese. Beat until thick. Put in crust; chill for 2 hours.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add molasses and egg and beat well. Sift together flour soda salt and spices. Add to sugar mixture and mix well. Chill about an hour. Form into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar and place on greased cookie sheets about 2 inches apart. Bake in a 375\u00b0 hot oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Watch closely. Remove from sheets to cool.

title: Rhubarb Cake
