instructions: Mix dry ingredients well. Add eggs shortening milk and rhubarb. Pour into 9 X 13 pan. Mix the brown sugar and chopped walnuts; sprinkle over top and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes or until done.

title: Ramen Noodle Salad
instructions: Mix sugar oil and vinegar. Add flavor packets from noodles; mix well. Add vegetables and stir. Add crushed noodles and stir. Let stand in refrigerator for 24 hours. Stir 3 or 4 times in between the 24 hours. For a big bowl double this recipe.

title: Broccoli-Sausage Quiche
instructions: Line unbaked pie shell with double thickness of foil. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes. Remove foil. Bake for 4 to 6 minutes more or until golden. Remove from oven. Set aside. Reduce oven temperature to 375\u00b0.

title: Mushroom Parmesan
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add mushrooms. Cook over low heat covered until wilted. In saucepan blend 3 tablespoons of butter with flour and add milk sour cream salt pepper and nutmeg and stir until thickened. Pour mushrooms into casserole. Pour on sauce. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot; serve.

title: Best Ever Green Beans
instructions: In large skillet melt bacon grease on high. Pan must be hot. Add green beans and allow to sizzle for a minute or two. Add sugar garlic powder salt and pepper. Allow them to sizzle on medium-high for about 20 minutes. Stir frequently. Beans will cook down quite a bit. Weve tried this recipe with other green beans but none work like Double Luck.

title: Cinnamon Apple Rings
instructions: In a skillet combine candies and sugar; add water. Cook and stir over medium heat until liquid boils. Add apple rings to candy mixture. Simmer gently uncovered 15 to 20 minutes. Stir and spoon candy mixture over apples. Cool apple rings in candy mixture. Drain. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients into an ungreased 8-inch square pan. Make three little \wells\ in dry ingredients. Pour salad oil in one vinegar in the second and vanilla in the third. Add milk and stir with a fork until mixture is well blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl and blend at medium speed for 3 minutes. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Fill pans half full. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with stuffing mix. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Taco Spread
instructions: Mix sour cream and cream cheese. Spread on platter. Spread taco sauce over this. Layer pepper tomato and onion. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Chill. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Butter Pecan Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in egg yolk. Add flour. Roll dough into balls; place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Press with back of floured fork in one direction to flatten. Top each with pecan pieces. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes until lightly browned around edges. Remove from pan while still warm.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Heat margarine until melted. Blend in flour onion salt and pepper. Cook until bubbly stirring constantly. Stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling. Stir in chicken carrots celery and peas; reserve. Prepare Celery Seed Pastry.

title: Cold Oven Butternut Flavoring Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening margarine sugar and salt well. Add eggs one at a time. Add flavoring. Beat well. Add flour and milk alternately ending with flour. Fold in nuts and cherries by hand. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 3/4 hours at 325\u00b0. Start in cold oven. Do not open oven door while baking. Remove from pan immediately. Invert on wire rack to cool.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Cream together oleo eggs and sugar. Dissolve baking soda in sour milk (sour milk 2 tablespoons milk and 1 teaspoon vinegar). Add to creamed mixture. Add flour salt and apples. Top with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Lobster In Chafing Dish
instructions: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in pan; saute lobster and mushrooms for 5 minutes. Sprinkle in flour and stir. Add cream and shrimp. Season with salt pepper nutmeg sherry and cheese. Add egg yolks slowly. Place in chafing dish and allow to thicken. If necessary can be thinned with cream. Serve on Melba toast rounds.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Place 2 teaspoons in cup or mug or to taste; add boiling water.

title: Cucumber Rounds
instructions: Blend softened cream cheese dry Italian dressing mix and mayonnaise until smooth. Cover bread rounds with mixture. Place a cucumber slice on top of each bread round. Sprinkle dill seed over the cucumber slices. Makes 5 to 7 dozen.

title: Microwave Caramel Apples
instructions: You will need wooden sticks.

title: Green Grape Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and chill. Serves 8.

title: Love-Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix all together. Drop on baking sheet. Sprinkle with red sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes.

title: Rocks (Grandma Helen'S Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar. Add well beaten eggs. Sift flour soda and cream of tartar. Add to mixture. Slightly flour fruit and add. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done (about 8 minutes).

title: Tomato-Feta Salad
instructions: Rub inside of salad bowl with garlic; discard garlic. Combine tomatoes olives and cheese in salad bowl. Combine oil and remaining ingredients in a jar. Cover tightly and shake vigorously. Pour over tomato mixture tossing gently. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Yields 8 servings.

title: Cream Cheese With Shrimp And Guacamole Dip
instructions: Cream together cheese mayo Worcestershire sauce and garlic. Spread mixture on a rimmed plate. Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving cover chilled cheese with avocado dip then with a layer of picante sauce. Then top with the shrimp. Sprinkle with the green onions and serve with tortilla chips. Scoop through all layers to eat.

title: Pumpkin Bread(Fall Bread)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease two loaf pans. Combine dry ingredients. Combine eggs oil orange juice and pumpkin. Add to dry ingredients. Blend well. Fold in nuts. Pour into greased pans. Bake 1 hour.

title: Hot Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mash cheese and Crisco; cream well. Add flour and salt; mix well. Roll into small balls; chill 1 hour. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Balls will flatten as they cook. Serve at your next brunch.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter on High (10) for 1/2 minute or until melted. Blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually stir in milk. Microwave on High (10) for 5 to 7 minutes stirring after 3 minutes and each minute until thick and bubbly. Layer half of potatoes onion and sauce in greased 2-quart casserole. Repeat layers. Cover. Microwave on High (10) for 22 to 26 minutes. Chunks or slices of ham may be added. Remove and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Buttermilk Yeast Buns
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir to dissolve. Add buttermilk and sugar. Let mixture stand 15 minutes. Add butter and eggs; mix. Sift soda and salt with 4 cups flour and add to liquid mixture. Beat until smooth batter forms. Add remaining sifted flour stirring with spoon until thick enough to handle with hands. Knead on floured board. Place in large greased mixing bowl. Turn. Cover; let rise until double about 1 hour. Punch dough down; form into buns. (Squeeze dough into balls the size of an egg.) Place on greased baking sheet; flatten slightly with hand. Let rise until double about 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 48 buns.

title: Macaroni Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Place in large mixing bowl and stir other ingredients. Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with crushed potato chips or cracker crumbs drizzled with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients together into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Make 3 wells in mixture. Pour vinegar in first well vanilla in second and oil in the third. Cover with 2 cups cold water mixing with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Cream together Crisco sugar flour and egg. Spoon mixture over prepared pears. The mixture is a little stiff. Place it as biscuits over the pears. When baked it runs together and makes a good crust.

title: Fish Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese and cracker crumbs butter or oleo and paprika. Cook rice and celery together. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Quick Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoons of dough on greased cookie sheet. Dip bottom of glass in sugar and press onto dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes. Cookies do not brown. Sprinkle with colored sugar.

title: Vitality Bread
instructions: Mix the first 9 ingredients. Put on low heat until almost boiling; it will get real thick. Add 1 cup warm water and 1/2 cup flour; let cool to lukewarm. Add this mixture that has been sitting the yeast and 1/2 cup warm water. Add the remaining flour. Knead on oiled board until glossy. Place in oiled bowl; cover. Set in warm place until double in size. Punch and knead; put into 3 greased pans. Let double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple-Carrot Salad(May Be Served To Toddlers Or Nineties)
instructions: Shred apples and carrot on finest shredder. Add raisins and just enough mayonnaise to hold together. Serve on a Boston leaf lettuce. Makes 3 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Calico Bean Bake
instructions: Brown hamburger and bacon. Add chopped onion and cook. Add remainder of ingredients mix together and bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix corn and flour. Add everything else but eggs. Stir with spoon until well mixed. Pour into a greased pan or dish. Add eggs and mix lightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Bean Fondue Dip
instructions: Keep in reserve 1 cup cheese. Mix rest of cheese and all other ingredients. Spread in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with reserved cheese. Wrap and refrigerate at this point if making ahead. If not bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted. Serve hot with tortilla chips for dipping. Serves 18.

title: Homestyle Meat Loaf
instructions: In large bowl combine the first seven ingredients. Crumble meat over top; mix well. Shape into loaf; place in greased 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Mix catsup and BBQ sauce. Pour over top. Bake 10 minutes longer. Serves 12.

title: Deep-Fried Okra
instructions: Wash okra; drain. Cut off tips and stem ends. Cut okra crosswise into 1/2-inch slices. Combine flour cracker meal 1 teaspoon salt and pepper in a shallow dish. Combine egg buttermilk and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt in a dish mixing well. Add about 1/3 of okra to egg mixture then remove okra with a slotted spoon and place in flour mixture stirring gently to coat okra. Pour oil to depth of 2-inches into a Dutch oven and heat to 375\u00b0. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Continue process with remaining okra.

title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
instructions: Cook pasta shells as directed. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter. Add flour salt pepper and nutmeg (will be a paste). Add milk; cook on low until thick. Add spinach to sauce. Put in baking dish. Mix tuna and Ricotta cheese. Fill shells with mixture. Arrange shells on top of spinach mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Garnish with paprika.

title: Yams Souffle
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease a 1-quart souffle dish. Place the yams in a large pot cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook until tender 20 to 30 minutes drain and set aside to cool. Peel the yams. In a bowl mash the yams. Add 1 teaspoon sugar the egg yolks 2 tablespoons butter cinnamon nutmeg salt and milk; beat well. Whisk egg whites until peaks form. Fold into mixture. Pour the yam mixture into the prepared souffle dish. Dot the top with the remaining butter and sprinkle with sugar. Bake until golden brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix at low speed. Grease and flour 3 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour. This will also make 8 mini loaf pans. Bake mini loaf pans about 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. When cool ice with sour cream icing.

title: Speedy Rolls(Makes 36)
instructions: Place water sugar and yeast in bowl to dissolve. Add salt and 2 cups of flour. Beat with mixer for 2 minutes. Add egg and melted shortening. Beat for 1 minute. Gradually add 4 1/2 cups flour stirring until dough is formed. Allow dough to rest for 20 minutes for each of handling.

title: Helen'S Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: In large bowl slice bananas; sprinkle with lemon juice to keep them from turning dark. Open all fruit; drain and save juice for a fruit punch. Mix all fruits; pour pie filling in and mix well. Can decorate with some strawberries and kiwi.

title: Leftover Turkey Loaf
instructions: Place butter in small dish and cook 1/2 minute or until melted. Combine eggs milk salt bread crumbs pimento green peppers parsley and turkey. Add butter and mix well. Spoon mixture into greased 2-quart ovenware dish. Cover. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Layer croutons cheese and sausage. Combine eggs milk and dry mustard. Top with soup diluted with milk. Cook 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and saute onion. Add sauce. Combine beef mixture and cooked noodles. In a large casserole dish layer beef noodle mixture cheese and pepperoni until all is used. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Polish Sausage, Cabbage And Potato Meal
instructions: In hot oil in large heavy skillet over medium heat lightly brown sliced kielbasa. Remove from pan set aside. To remaining fat in skillet add cabbage potatoes and onion. Stir-fry 2 minutes. Sprinkle vegetables with flour mix well. Add water to chicken broth to make 1 1/2 cups. Return sausage to skillet. Add broth vinegar caraway salt and pepper. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer covered 20 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Yields 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Delight
instructions: Brown beef onion and green pepper (drain the grease); add tomatoes and corn. Simmer until thick; add chili powder and season to\ttaste.\tAdd noodles; put in greased casserole and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion green pepper and garlic in skillet stirring frequently; drain. Layer ground beef mixture rice and cabbage 1/2 at a time in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour juice over all. Bake covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Gone!!!
instructions: Line jelly roll pan with aluminum foil. Line pan with saltine crackers salt side up. Melt margarine with sugar and bring to a boil. Pour over saltines; spread evenly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Take out of oven and sprinkle with chocolate chips. Spread with a knife as chips melt. Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate for several hours. Break into pieces for serving. Enjoy!

title: Crock-Pot Oyster Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients except oysters in crock-pot. Cover and cook on high 1 1/2 hours. Stir well. Add oysters and cook on low for 1 to 3 hours. Sprinkle with cayenne and serve hot.

title: Millionaires
instructions: Mix caramels and evaporated milk in top of double boiler. Melt. Take off stove. Add pecans. Stir well. Drop onto cookie sheet greased with butter. Cool. Refrigerate 1 hour or until cold.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water; add remaining ingredients. Store in glass containers in refrigerator 2 or 3 days. Add a 2 liter bottle of 7-Up when serving.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix lime juice condensed milk and Cool Whip. Blend in food coloring. Fold into pie shell. Let sit until firm.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and allow to sit for flavors to meld. Use as a dip for any fresh fruit.

title: Cream Of Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large kettle or Dutch oven saute the onion in butter until tender. Add flour. Cook and stir until bubbly. Gradually add chicken broth and cook and stir until thickened about 5 minutes. Stir in milk cream basil salt pepper and garlic powder. Add the vegetables and cook gently until heated thoroughly. Makes 8 to 10 servings. Excellent.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix in Accent salt onion and lemon juice to the chicken celery almonds and mayonnaise. Toss and place in baking dish. Top with Velveeta cheese and crushed potato chips. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. May be prepared ahead and refrigerated.

title: Chicken Picante
instructions: Coat chicken with bread crumbs brown lightly in oil over medium heat in heavy skillet and mix liquids and seasonings. Add vegetables to skillet and pour liquid-seasonings mixture over top. Cover tightly and cook over medium-low heat until chicken is done about 25 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Condensed Milk
instructions: Pour ingredients into blender and beat 1 minute. Refrigerate until thickened. Makes about 1 1/4 cups.

title: Noodle Kugel
instructions: Add oleo to hot noodles and mix. Add other ingredients. Put in greased large 9 x 12-inch pan. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 45 minutes more.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts in mixing bowl. Pour in an unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle pecans on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 until firm in the center.

title: Green Enchiladas
instructions: Cook and drain meat and sprinkle with garlic salt. Add milk soups 1/3 of cheese and mashed chilies; bring to a boil. Be careful; it will stick.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together egg milk and shortening. Mix dry ingredients add mixed liquids and beat until smooth. Bake in 9-inch pan at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Low Cholesterol Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all together. Pour in freezer can. Finish filling with 2% milk. Freeze as usual.

title: Cabbage Bake
instructions: Brown meat and seasonings. Wash rice chop cabbage and mix everything together. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan or dish. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Open and stir after cooking 45 minutes. Recover and continue cooking.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Heat chicken and well drained pineapple in double boiler 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in mayonnaise. Heat 5 minutes longer. Stir in celery and 1/3 cup almonds. Spoon into serving dish. Sprinkle with remaining almonds and green pepper. Garnish with watercress and spiced apple rings. Serve at once. Yields 6 servings.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place 1/4 c. cooking oil in pan and heat while mixing ingredients.

title: My Favorite Dip
instructions: Layer in 9 x 12 pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Mix tomatoes and salt. Let stand about 12 hours. Drain. Heat vinegar sugars and spices to a boil; add sliced onions and boil gently 5 minutes. Add the drained tomatoes and peppers; bring slowly to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon. Pack into hot jars. Be sure syrup covers vegetables. Adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath (212\u00b0) for 5 minutes. Remove jars and complete seals unless closures are self sealing type. Makes 9 half pints.

title: Hamburger On A Half Bun
instructions: Mix all ingredients into raw meat. Spread to edges of open-faced buns. Broil until meat is done.

title: Pickled Bologna
instructions: Pound round steak (not with flour). Trim and cut in strips. On strip sprinkle flour salt and pepper. Add diced onion diced green pepper and a strip of bacon. Roll up; secure with a toothpick. Bake covered with a small amount of water at 350\u00b0. Baste occasionally.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let set overnight.

title: Zucchini Milano
instructions: Remove casing from sausage; crumble meat. Saute in medium size frying pan 10 minutes or until brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Pour off drippings then measure 1 tablespoon and return to pan. Stir in zucchini and onion; saute 5 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce sugar garlic salt oregano and pepper. Place sausage on top; cover. Cook slowly 15 minutes or until zucchini is slightly tender. Serves 6.

title: Mexi-Corn Lasagna
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large skillet. Simmer 5 minutes stirring frequently. Combine cottage cheese eggs Parmesan cheese oregano and garlic salt. Mix well. Arrange 6 tortillas on bottom and sides of lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish overlapping as necessary. Top with half the meat mixture. Spoon cheese mixture over meat. Arrange remaining tortillas over cheese. Top with remaining meat mixture. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Remove from oven; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Let stand 10 minutes before serving with additional picante sauce. Serves 8.

title: Hearty Green Pea Soup
instructions: Wash peas. Drain. Add 2 qts. water to peas season to taste. Cook 2 hours add potatoes carrots onions herbs and butter. Simmer until vegetables are tender and soup is to desired thickness. Can add ham bits or smoked sausage etc. if desired.

title: Chicken-Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Leave in refrigerator overnight in mixing bowl. Next day\tput in containers to be baked.\tThis may be baked at once or kept frozen up to six weeks. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Dump Truck Cake
instructions: Pour pineapple chunks and juice into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spoon cherry pie filling on next. Shake entire box of cake mix on and spread evenly. Cut butter into slices and spread over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: Grandma'S Raisin Crunchies
instructions: Mix baking powder soda vanilla and Raisin Bran. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Stir in coconut and raisins then add flour and salt to butter mixture; mix well. Stir in Raisin Bran mixture. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes; watch carefully bottoms burn quickly. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Skillet German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in jackets until tender; peel and dice. Keep warm. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Pour off all but 4 tablespoons of bacon drippings. Blend in soup milk relish vinegar and salt. Cook and stir until mixture comes to a boil. Gently stir in potatoes and all but 1 tablespoon of bacon. Heat thoroughly. Sprinkle bacon on top and garlic with wedges of hard-boiled egg. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Line bottom of tube pan with waxed paper. Grease and flour pan. Sprinkle pecans over bottom of pan. In a small bowl combine granulated sugar and cinnamon. Cut each biscuit into 6 pieces. Roll biscuits in sugar/cinnamon mixture and stack evenly in pan. Pour melted butter evenly over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan while hot. Combine powdered sugar and enough milk to make thin enough to drizzle over cake.

title: Cinnamon Butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients well with an electric mixer. Store in an airtight container and keep refrigerated. Yields about 16 oz.

title: Chinese Pork Chops
instructions: Mix first four ingredients in deep baking dish. Place pork chops on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Fruit Waldorf
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail well and mix lightly with celery and walnuts. Serve on salad greens and top with Cream Dressing or mayonnaise.

title: Asparagus Salad
instructions: Combine sugar and vinegar in 1 cup of water and salt to taste. Bring to a boil to dissolve sugar. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Remove boiling mixture. Add gelatin and onion and cool. Combine remaining ingredients and add to liquid. Put in molds and chill. Serve on lettuce with a teaspoon of mayonnaise on top.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix as listed. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Add sugar to pie filling. Stir in marshmallows and allow to stand 2 to 3 hours or overnight. Before serving cut up and add drained pineapple bananas and nuts.

title: Apple Bagel Snack
instructions: Place bagel on broiler tray. Top with American cheese then place a slice of apple on top. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar. Toast in oven for a few minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Crab Meat Mold
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine soup cheese and onions. Heat until cheese is melted.\tBlend in mayonnaise. Remove from heat. In another pan sprinkle gelatin over water over low heat; stir until gelatin dissolves. Stir in soup mixture. Add crab meat and celery. Pour into a 6 cup mold. Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.\tUnmold on serving plate. Serve as spread with crackers.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook bacon well. Drain most of the fat. Add tomato sauce and parsley. Simmer 10 minutes. Beat eggs in a cup. Boil spaghetti in salted water (al dente). Drain spaghetti and pour back in hot pan. Pour eggs on spaghetti and toss. Add sauce Parmesan cheese and pine nuts. Toss and serve.

title: Toffee Bars
instructions: Mix and pack into glass pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carolyn'S Fluffy Blueberry Muffin
instructions: Mix all ingredients until moistened. Fold berries into mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

title: Tupperware Bread
instructions: Mix together and use part of flour to knead but use all 10 cups. Put in Tupperware bowl (the large one!) burp and let rise until it pops off. Make into loaves let rise and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with cheese slices. Combine soup with milk or wine; stir well. Spoon evenly over chicken; sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: Brown meat with onion and mushrooms. Drain. Cook noodles. Drain. Put in large pan with tablespoon butter or vegetable oil. Add meat mixture and Ragu. Mix. Put cheese on top. Put in oven for 1 hour at 300\u00b0 or until done.

title: Chicken Stroganoff
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet. Add onion and mushrooms and saute until tender. Add 1 cup water chicken base pepper and sherry then simmer. Blend cornstarch and water until smooth. Add to sauce while stirring and cook until thickened. Turn off heat. Stir in yogurt and chicken strips. Serve over rice or noodles. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Crumble hamburger meat over the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle onion flakes next. Pour cans of soup over that; then pour peas. Cover with Tater Tots. Bake 1 hour or until done at 350\u00b0.

title: Jumbles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl beat butter and sugars until light and fluffy. Add egg. Blend flour into creamed mixture. Stir in baking bits raisins and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough about 2-inches apart onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 13 to 15 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Pie
instructions: Mix together well and pour into raw dough shell. Cook in a medium oven until brown. Cool.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix first four ingredients and stir until sugar dissolves. Pour over cucumbers pepper and onions. Store in refrigerator overnight.

title: Western Bean Casserole
instructions: Cut bacon in pieces; saute with onion and hamburg until meat is lightly browned. Add all the rest and stir. Bake at 350\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Gone-All-Day-Stew
instructions: Mix together soup water wine and flour until smooth. Combine remaining ingredients in covered roasting pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours. When ready to serve adjust seasoning if desired. Serve over noodles or with crunchy French bread. Yields 8 servings. Has 10 gm fat and 103 mg. cholesterol.

title: Filled Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops on both sides and place in shallow baking dish. Lightly mix bread cubes onion butter 1/4 cup water and seasonings; place a mound of filling in each chop. Blend soup and 1/3 cup water and pour over chops and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Very Strawberry Pie
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add ice cubes and stir until melted. Prepare instant pudding with 3/4 cup milk as directed on package for pie. Let stand about 2 minutes. Blend in gelatin. Chill if necessary until thickened. Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip and strawberries. Pour into crust. Freeze 1 hour or chill in refrigerator 3 hours before serving.

title: Angel-Lemon Delight
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 3/4 cup of the sugar a little at\ta time beating after each addition. Put egg yolks in top of double boiler. Beat until thick. Add remaining 3/4 cup of sugar lemon juice and peel to the egg yolks. Cook\tover boiling water until thick stirring occasionally. Soften gelatin in the 1/4 cup of water and then add to the egg yolk-lemon mixture. Cool. Fold in egg white mixture using a rubber spatula. Put half of the angel cake crumbs in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour\thalf of the sauce over cake. Repeat layers. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Cut into squares. Top each with a dollop of whipped topping.

title: Miss Lonnie Mae'S Peach Foam Salad
instructions: Mix jello and pineapple and boil for 3 minutes. Cool. Mix Cool Whip and buttermilk together then mix with cooled jello-pineapple mixture. Pour into long Pyrex dish and chill for several hours until set.

title: Joanne'S Pineapple Banana Bread
instructions: Stir well with spoon. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients then add liquid. Put frying chicken in baking pan or casserole dish. Pour sauce over chicken and cover with lid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove lid and turn heat to 500\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool before serving.

title: Peanut Butterscotch Squares
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar; stir in flour. It is crumbly. Press into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Sift together flour salt baking powder and cocoa. Cream sugar butter and Crisco. Add vanilla and beat 1 minute. Add eggs one at a time and beat 1 minute after each. Fold in dry ingredients alternately with milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: 3 Cheese Chicken
instructions: Cook 1/2 cup chopped onions and green pepper. Stir in cream of chicken soup milk drained mushrooms chopped pimento and basil. Pour 1/2 noodles in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with 1/2 sauce cottage cheese chicken American cheese and Parmesan cheese. Repeat twice. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese on platter. Spoon salsa onto cream cheese until cream cheese is covered. Cover salsa with a generous layer of shredded Cheddar cheese. Sprinkle onion green pepper tomato black olives and jalapeno peppers over the cheese layer. Serve with corn chips.

title: Cheesecake Tarts
instructions: Put a wafer in bottom of cupcake paper. Beat rest of ingredients together until well blended. Pour into each paper until thickness desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Makes 2 dozen. Top with melted chocolate chips drizzled on top or favorite topping.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Wash and sort beans. Only add cold water to cover beans. Add approximately 1 tablespoon baking soda. Cover and bring to boil. It will be very foamy. Remove from heat and rinse under cold water. (This supposedly removes some gas from the beans.) Cover again with cold water (only cover no more). Add cut up onion cut up bacon salt and pepper. Cover and bring to boil then simmer until beans are soft but not mushy (water should be almost absorbed). Add molasses dry mustard and brown sugar to taste. Pour into baking dish. Lay bacon strips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Arrange whole eggs and sliced onion rings in alternate layers in a large glass jar with tight fitting lid. Combine in saucepan the vinegar sugar salt and spices. Simmer for 10 minutes after it comes to a boil. Pour over eggs and seal jar. (Make sure eggs are covered.) Store jar in refrigerator for 2 or 3 days before serving. Serve with buttered popcorn crackers or pretzels.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix together well then drop by spoon in hot grease.

title: Nutty Peach Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Layer all ingredients in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in order listed. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes or until top is golden brown. Let stand at least 15 minutes before serving. Serve warm or cool and if desired with sweetened whipped cream or ice cream. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Clam Chowder(Makes 5 Cups)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Combine milks and remaining ingredients and stir together for 10 minutes or until thick and bubbly.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in Dutch oven at 300\u00b0 for 3 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until done. Do not overcook. Drain well. Let cool. Chop or dice tomatoes cucumbers onions and peppers. Add salt and mayonnaise. Stir just until mixed well and refrigerate. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Wilma'S Skillet Hash
instructions: Heat Crisco oil in large skillet on medium heat. Add potatoes onions green pepper and garlic. Cook on medium heat turning occasionally until potatoes are tender. Add broth meat salt hot pepper sauce and pepper to taste. Cook until meat is hot. Makes 8 servings. Contains 230 calories fat 9 g (81 cal or 35% of total calories) sat fat 2 g (9% of total calories) carb 15 g protein 22 g chol 60 mg and sodium 100 mg.

title: Tex-Mex Stew
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven. Brown meat with garlic in oil; drain off fat.

title: Archie'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix 1 cup sugar flour and cocoa thoroughly. Blend in 1/2 cup milk. Add egg yolks. Stir well. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 cup milk to cocoa mixture. Stir over medium heat about 5 minutes until mixture thickens. Pour into pie shell. Beat egg whites 1 teaspoon vanilla and 3 tablespoons of sugar. Beat well. Spread on pie. Bake at 425\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Spareribs
instructions: Brown pork slightly in hot oil. Add water cover and cook slowly for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Combine brown sugar cornstarch salt pineapple juice and soy sauce. Mix well. Cook until slightly thick stirring constantly. Pour over cooked pork and let stand for 10 minutes. Add pineapple chunks and let cook only 2 or 3 minutes. Can double recipe.

title: Cookies And Cream
instructions: Blend ingredients in order listed; add enough milk to finish filling freezer.

title: Date Candy
instructions: Mix together margarine sugar egg yolks and dates. Cook in skillet for 10 minutes stirring as you cook. Remove from heat and add the nuts and Rice Krispies. Stir well. Pour coconut on wax paper. Drop by spoonful and roll in coconut.

title: Drop Biscuits
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients; sift twice. Work in lard with tips of fingers. Add milk gradually. Mix in with knife to a soft dough. It will drop without spreading. Drop by spoonfuls on buttered pan 1-inch apart. Brush over with milk and brown in hot oven 8 minutes.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Melt oleo; mix into eggs. Add corn bread mix; blend well. Add all other ingredients; pour into iron skillet and bake 35 minutes or until brown at 375\u00b0.

title: Pasta With Basil, Plum Tomatoes And Garlic(For One Person)
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook pasta. Heat olive oil on medium heat in a pan. Add garlic basil and tomatoes. Cook until tomatoes soften slightly. Add lemon juice and pasta. Toss lightly. Top with cheese. Make yourself a tossed salad. Yummy!

title: Wild Rice Salad
instructions: Rinse rice under cold running water. Bring 3 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add salt to taste. Add rice. Return to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 40 minutes. (After 20 minutes taste every 5 minutes. Rice grains should pop open to reveal the white insides but should not turn mushy.)

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and let set 1 hour. Drain off and add sugar vinegar celery seed and turmeric. Boil 20 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix sausage and Bisquick thoroughly. Add grated cheese and mix thoroughly. Roll into small balls (about the size of a jack ball). Place on cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Do not overbake. Makes approximately 4 dozen.

title: Creamed Diced Carrots With Green Pepper
instructions: Melt butter in a 2-quart saucepan over moderate heat. Add onion and carrots; stir. Cover lower heat and cook for 10 minutes. Add green pepper cover and cook for 2 minutes. Sprinkle in flour stir then add half and half broth and seasonings. Stir well. Bring the mixture to simmer stirring constantly then cover and cook over low heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the carrots are done. They should be slightly crunchy.

title: Vegetable Sandwich
instructions: Chop onion carrot bell pepper and cucumber very fine. Mix with cream cheese and mayonnaise. Salt to taste. Use as a sandwich spread.

title: Ranch Potato Salad
instructions: Combine 8 medium Russet potatoes (boiled peeled and cubed) with 1 cup of sliced celery and chopped red onion. Combine the salad dressing mix with mayonnaise and water. Add to potatoes and toss to coat. Chill. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Beef Potato Boats
instructions: Brown beef onion pepper and celery (all chopped) in 1 ounce vegetable oil. Drain fat. Add seasonings and tomato sauce. Cut potatoes lengthwise in half. Scoop out and reserve potato shells.

title: Lemonade Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in 3/4 cup hot water. Add to cake mix and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Angel Pie
instructions: Combine sugar water pineapple and cornstarch. Cook in double boiler until thick. Remove from heat and fold in egg whites. Cool slightly and put into baked pie shell. Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let yeast sit while preparing other ingredients. Heat buttermilk until warm. Remove milk from heat and combine with oil sugar and salt. Sift flour and soda in a large bowl. Mix yeast with buttermilk mixture then add in flour mixture. Mix well and let stand for 10 minutes. Roll out dough on floured surface and cut out biscuits. Place rolls in a pan with melted butter. Coat each side with butter. Let rolls stand 30 minutes in a warm place to rise. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Crab Meat Salad
instructions: Dice crab meat and mix in a bowl with chopped celery 2 diced hard-boiled eggs seasoning and salad dressing. Mix well. Serve as an appetizer or as a salad on lettuce. Garnish with parsley or paprika.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Combine eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Add grated zucchini and stir. Mix together flour and other ingredients. Add raisins and nuts to dry ingredients. Stir into zucchini mixture. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until cake tests done. Frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf With Ground Turkey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine 3 tablespoons barbecue sauce and water. Add oats egg chili powder Worcestershire sauce and salt; mix well. Add turkey bell pepper onion corn and chilies if desired; mix well. Pat into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes; spread top of loaf with remaining barbecue sauce during last 10 minutes of cooking. Meat loaf is cooked through when it springs back to touch. Serve warm or cold with additional barbecue sauce if desired.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough otherwise just scrub and rinse them. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Use enough water from potatoes to make mixture soft. Mix and pour in casserole dish.

title: Peach Nut Bread
instructions: Grease and flour two loaf pans. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Beat on medium speed 1/2 minute. Pour mixture into pans and bake 55 to 65 minutes. Cool in pans 5 minutes before turning out to finish cooling.

title: Cream Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix butter cake mix butter and egg by hand and press in baking dish. Beat cream cheese eggs and confectioners sugar until creamy. Pour over first mixture in dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in an 8 x 12-inch dish. Sprinkle confectioners sugar over hot cake when baked. Cool. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Pour over casserole and bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Add water to spices in a saucepan stirring 2 minutes. Add butter and melt. Add brown sugar and vanilla. Stir 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Use 2 tablespoons butter batter (more or less to taste). Add 1 jigger rum and stir. Fill mug with boiling water and stir. Store remainder of butter batter in refrigerator.

title: Granny'S Better Than Snuff Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box using milk instead of water. Bake in an oblong pan (9 x 13-inch). Bring to boil the pineapple and sugar. When cake is done remove from oven. Punch holes in it and pour pineapple mixture over it. Let set awhile. Mix pudding according to directions on package. Add the pudding into mixer bowl and combine with cream cheese. Spread over cooled cake. Cover cake with a layer of sliced bananas and then cover with Cool Whip. Decorate top with strawberry halves and chopped pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Heavenly Dip
instructions: For the mountain this should be doubled.

title: Pink Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie crust.

title: Friendly Recipe
instructions: One Tongue that doesnt slander.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: In a saucepan blend mustard with a little vinegar. Add remaining vinegar and next 6 ingredients. Cover heat to boiling simmering 10 minutes. Cool. Pour over onions and eggs. Cover. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Impossible Quiche Tarts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 18 big muffin cups. Beat first 5 ingredients until smooth. Spoon 2 tablespoons in each cup. Mix next 3 ingredients. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon over batter in each cup. Bake until knife comes out clean 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pineapple Fritters
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt and sugar. Stir well. Set aside. Combine eggs and next 3 ingredients. Add to dry mixture. Mix until just moist. Fry a few at a time in 2 to 3-inches oil.

title: Hash Brown Potatoesfort Morgan, Colorado
instructions: Thaw hash browns squeeze out excess moisture. Melt butter. Mix with soup sour cream. Add onions and cheese. Add hash browns. Pour mixture into large baking pan. Cover with crushed corn flakes.

title: Sweet French Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and beat thoroughly. Pour into bottles or jars for storing.

title: Creamed Eggs
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat thoroughly. Serve over toast. Serves four.

title: Fig Muffins
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour baking powder and spices. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk stirring just until moistened. Stir in fig preserves. Spoon batter into greased and floured muffin pans filling 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Gina'S Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Mix with next 3 ingredients in large casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Egg Casserole
instructions: Make scrambled eggs using the eggs and milk. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Fry bacon. Drain and crumble over eggs. Spread sour cream over all. Sprinkle with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mother'S Favorite Peach Custard Pie
instructions: Slice peaches into unbaked pie shell. Melt butter; set aside to cool. Mix sugar and flour. Add all other ingredients including melted butter and pour over peaches. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done about 50 to 60 minutes. This pie is best served warm. Makes 5 to 6 generous portions.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Shape into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In saucepan cook onion until tender; add flour and broth until thickened. Take off the burner.\tStir in sour cream and set aside. In mixing bowl mix 2 cups of sauce chopped chicken one cup of cheese chilies and cumin. Soften tortillas according to package directions then place equal portions of the filling mixture (chicken) in each tortilla and arrange in 13 x 9-inch greased baking dish. Pour remaining sauce on top of the tortillas and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible French Apple Pie
instructions: Grease pie plate (20 x 1 1/2-inch). Mix apples and spices; turn into plate. Beat remaining ingredients except streusel until smooth (15 seconds in blender or 1 minute with mixer). Pour into plate over apples. Sprinkle with streusel. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife comes out clean (55 to 60 minutes).

title: Cup Of Gravy
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch and bouillon cubes in cold water. Cook stirring constantly until boiling and smooth.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Beat eggs with milk and salt. Saute onions in butter. Add rice broccoli egg mixture and cheese. Place in shallow casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Goulash
instructions: In frying pan add ground chuck salt and pepper. Cook until well done. Rinse with hot water and drain. Boil egg noodles rinse with hot water and drain. In large saucepan slowly cook tomatoes tomato sauce green peppers and onion. Combine ground chuck and noodles for a very appetizing dish. Serve piping hot with cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and continue to beat until light and fluffy. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Roll balls in a mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly browned.

title: Marinated Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Drain Bushs Best black-eyed peas. Rinse with cold water; drain well. Add chopped celery and onion. Combine oil vinegar mayonnaise salt and cayenne; mix well. Pour over peas. Stir gently. Allow to chill in refrigerator several hours or overnight. At serving time add the diced tomato. Mix carefully. Serve as a relish with meats or garnish with lettuce and a spoonful of mayonnaise and serve as a salad.

title: 1000 Island Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Dip bread into eggs and milk. Put on a hot pan on stove until brown. Put syrup and cinnamon and powdered sugar on top. Eat!

title: Parmesan Chicken Breast
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In a 15 x 10-inch baking dish sprayed with nonstick spray dip chicken in melted Parkay spread and coat each piece with remaining ingredients. Put in dish. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until tender. Serves 6.

title: Hot Cocoa
instructions: Stir together sugar cocoa and salt in 4 to 6-quart saucepan. Heat milk in microwave until hot but not boiling. Gradually add to cocoa mixture stirring until well blended. Stir in vanilla.

title: Big Batch Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream the oleo brown sugar and white sugar. Add eggs vanilla flour soda and salt. Mix well. Add chips and nuts. Chill. Make into balls or spoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Double Chocolate Cupcakes(Quick And Light)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl. Make a well in the center of the mixture. Add water and next 4 ingredients to dry ingredients. Stir just until batter is moistened. Fold in chocolate chips. Spoon into foil or paper-lined muffin pans filling 2/3 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Remove from pan immediately and cool. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Yield 1 dozen.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes then sprinkle 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese on top. Bake 25 minutes longer.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Put in crock-pot frozen cold or whatever cook on high stirring occasionally until melted. Then turn on low. Cook for 3 to 4 hours. Can be doubled or up to four times recipe. Real good for potlucks!

title: Bul-Ko-Kee(Korean Barbecue Beef)
instructions: Trim fat from beef and cut diagonally across the grain into 1/8-inch slices. Mix remaining ingredients. Stir in beef until coated. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes; drain beef. Stir-fry until light brown over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Vegetable Bars
instructions: Mix together and simmer 20 minutes. Stir often for it sticks easily; do not let it scorch. Pack hot into sterilized pint jars. Process in hot water bath for 30 minutes. Use as you would crushed pineapple.

title: Cheese Date Balls
instructions: Have cheese and margarine at room temperature; blend well. Mix in seasonings well and cut in flour (best by hand). Chill dough. Stuff a date with a pecan half and form cheese dough around each date. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Carrot Souffle
instructions: Mix in a blender and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Then top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes and 2 tablespoons melted butter. Bake for 15 minutes more. Serve with salad and rolls.

title: French Silk Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar creaming well. Blend in chocolate (melted and cooled); add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating for 5 minutes after each addition. Turn into cooled baked pie shell. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Graham cracker crust can also be used.

title: Cheese Apple Bake
instructions: Butter a 2-quart baking dish. Put drained apples in dish. Cream butter and Velveeta. Add sugar and flour. Put mixture on top of apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: In mixing bowl toss together the graham cracker crumbs and the melted butter. Press crumb mixture into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In a small mixing bowl beat the remaining 1/2 cup of butter about 30 seconds until softened. Add powdered sugar beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs. Spread mixture over crumb mixture. Slice bananas lengthwise into halves and arrange over egg mixture. Spoon pineapple over bananas.

title: Angel Cornbread (Yeast)
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Combine eggs milk and oil. Mix with dry ingredients. Pour into well greased pan or skillet and bake at 450\u00b0 until done. You can use one 11-inch skillet or two 8-inch skillets.

title: Navy Bean Soup
instructions: Sort and wash beans. Cover with water and soak overnight. Drain beans. Add pork or melted bouillon cube and 2 quarts water. Boil for 2 minutes. Cover; lower heat and simmer for 1 hour until beans are barely tender. Add remaining ingredients until veggies are tender. Serves 6.

title: Sirloin Steaks With Blue Cheese Butter
instructions: Trim excess fat. Place on grill 4 inches from hot coals. Sear 3-5 minutes. Turn steaks after cooking to your liking. Lightly score surface of steak. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread steaks with blue cheese butter.

title: Canned Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Pour olive oil over day old bread. Cut in cubes and spread on cookie sheet. Sprinkle oregano and parsley over top. Bake at 300\u00b0 until light golden brown.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Cook rice in a 5 or 6 quart Dutch oven. Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain. Add green pepper onion garlic curry powder salt and pepper. Simmer until tender. Add salsa. Simmer 5 minutes more. Pour meat mixture over rice in Dutch oven. Stir and heat through.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix butter milk sugar and cocoa in a saucepan. Bring to a boil for about 1 minute. Add peanut butter. Mix well. Add oatmeal. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Cranberry Star Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries and sugar. Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add pineapple syrup and chill until partially set. Add cranberry mixture pineapple walnuts and celery. Pour into star mold or 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill until firm. Serve plain or with a dab of mayo.

title: Fried Squash Patties
instructions: Slice squash; place in pan with onion salt pepper and small amount of grease. Smother and cook until almost all the water is cooked out. Take off stove and drain as well as possible. Add egg and enough flour to make a thick mixture. With hands make small patties and fry in small amount of grease until done. If needed roll patty in small amount of flour then fry.

title: Hamburger Cheese Bake
instructions: In large skillet cook meat and onion until the meat is browned and onion is tender. Stir in tomato sauce sugar salt garlic salt and pepper. Remove from heat.\tCook noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine cottage cheese cream cheese sour cream green onion and green pepper. Spread half of noodles in 11 x 7 x 1 1/2 pan; top with a little of meat sauce. Cover with cheese mixture. Add remaining noodles and meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt. Add margarine (softened) eggs vanilla and bananas. Add nuts. Bake in a loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Turn out on rack to cool.

title: Old-Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup milk. Beat slightly. Add remaining 1/2 cup milk last 2 cups flour baking powder and extracts. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Put into cold oven and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine in a small bowl the sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Cut each biscuit in 1/4ths and roll each piece in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Put in Bundt cake pan or angel food cake pan.

title: Beef Loaf
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in milk. Add ground beef eggs onion salt pepper and sage. Mix well. Form into loaf and place in greased loaf pan. With fork rough top of loaf. Combine brown sugar catsup or chili sauce nutmeg and ground mustard. Pour over loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Golden Graham'S S'Mores
instructions: Grease rectangular pan 13 x 9-inch. Heat corn syrup margarine and chocolate chips to boiling point in 3-quart saucepan stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal in large bowl; toss until completely coated with chocolate. Fold in marshmallows one cup at a time. Press mixture evenly in pan with buttered back of spoon. Let stand until firm at least 1 hour. Cut into 2-inch squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature no longer than 2 days. Makes 24 squares.

title: Winter Day Bean Soup
instructions: Combine the last 7 ingredients in a soup pot; boil 10 minutes. In the meantime saute the first 5 ingredients until onion is clear. Add to soup pot. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Serve over toasted French bread.

title: Ozelma'S Cheese Diablo(Appetizers)
instructions: Cut margarine into flour. Add cayenne pepper and grated cheese. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes. These are very hot.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Combine cream cheese and milk; mix thoroughly. Blend in remaining ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Let set overnight in refrigerator. Serves 18 to 20.

title: Hot Christmas Wassail
instructions: Combine fruit juices and cider. Combine spices and tie in cloth bag. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 1/2 hour. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Coffee
instructions: Whip whipping cream with 1/2 teaspoon each of nutmeg and cinnamon. Spice coffee with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and sweeten to taste. Serve demi-tasse with generous spoonful of the whipped cream. Serves 4.

title: Hamburger-Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine beef potato and cabbage in large microwave casserole. Cover and microwave on High for 7 minutes or until beef is no longer pink; stir once. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and microwave 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring once during cooking time.

title: Whoopie Pie Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spread on whoopie pies.

title: Oven Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Place approximately 10 pieces of chicken in pan. Put on salt and pepper. Pour sauce over top. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Caramelicious Fudge Brownies
instructions: In a small saucepan over low heat melt the caramels with the milk; stir until smooth. Immediately after removing brownies from oven sprinkle with chocolate chips and pecans. Drizzle with caramel. Cool completely before cutting.

title: Strawberry Summer Cake
instructions: Stir together the jam and Cool Whip. Cut angel food cake into 3 layers. Spread the Cool Whip/jam mixture on the cake. Put in refrigerator. Serve cold.

title: Fresh Summer Tart
instructions: Press cookie dough onto greased 14-inch pizza pan and bake according to package directions. Cool. Beat cream cheese sugar and 4 tablespoons of the frozen orange juice until fluffy. Spread over cooled crust. Arrange fruit decoratively on crust. Cut in wedges. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Peach Strawberry Soup
instructions: In food processor or blender combine all ingredients except lemon slices and mint. Cover and chill about 2 hours. To serve put 1/2 cup into 5 bowls and garnish with lemon slices and mint sprigs.

title: World'S Best Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugars until fluffy. Add egg and mix well. Add salad oil and vanilla mixing well. Add oats cornflakes coconut and nuts stirring well. Add flour soda and salt; mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets. Flatten with fork dipped in water. Bake 12 minutes. Cool on cookie sheet for a few minutes before removing. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in Bundt pan at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Grandma Mag'S Banana Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients mix well. Grease loaf pan. Pour batter into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth scraping down sides of blender as necessary. Place in a serving bowl. Cover and chill before serving. Serve as a dip with fresh vegetables or chips. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken and cut up in small pieces when cool. Cut up celery in small pieces. Mix all ingredients. Keep refrigerated. Serve on bed of lettuce.

title: Icebox Fruitcake
instructions: Crush graham crackers and vanilla wafers. Chop cherries and nuts. Add all ingredients together and mix well. Pack in covered container and store in refrigerator. Slice and serve.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and pudding in large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil. Mix well. Blend in 7-Up; pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Frost as desired.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Creamy Swiss Salad
instructions: Combine salad greens cheese olives and eggs in a large salad bowl. Blend mayonnaise cream mustard salt and pepper. Pour over greens and toss. If desired garnish with tomato wedges. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add soda to sour cream then blend with creamed mixture. Beat eggs well and add then add mashed bananas. Sift dry ingredients together then mix into first mixture. Add chopped nuts. Blend well and turn into greased and floured loaf tins. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until done. Makes 4 large loaves.

title: Apple Brown Crisp
instructions: Put on stove and heat. Pour in baking dish.

title: Meat And Oyster Dressing
instructions: Put meat to fry. Meanwhile grind next 5 ingredients and add to meat as it is ground. Let fry until it comes to grease on top. Skim grease. Add oysters and cook until oysters are done. Add bread crumbs and season to taste. May need more bread crumbs to make right consistency. Use own judgement.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix well and roll into 3 small rolls. Wrap well in waxed paper and freeze. Remove from freezer and slice into 1/8-inch slices.

title: Velveeta Fudge
instructions: Heat cheese and butter on low heat until melted or microwave for 3 to 4 minutes. Add cocoa vanilla powdered sugar and nuts. Mix well. Mixture will be very thick. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill. No cooking and very delicious.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Arrange vanilla wafers in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with about 1/4-inch Cool Whip. Top with more vanilla wafers then more Cool Whip ending with wafers. Chill overnight.

title: Double Chocolate Bars
instructions: Melt chocolate bits and allow to cool. Cream butter sugar and vanilla until fluffy; add syrup and continue creaming. Beat in eggs and chocolate. Sift flour; sift together dry ingredients. Stir into batter. Fold in chocolate pieces and walnuts. Spread in a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven about 25 minutes. Cut in bars when cool.

title: Banana Macadamia Nut (Or Walnut) Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixer bowl combine flour sugar butter eggs baking soda salt orange peel and vanilla. Beat at low speed scraping bowl often until well mixed 2 to 3 minutes. Add bananas and orange juice. Continue beating scraping bowl often until well mixed 1 minute. By hand stir in coconut and nuts. (Batter will be thick.) Spread into 1 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or 3 greased 5 1/2 x 3-inch mini loaf pans. Bake 9 x 5-inch loaf for 60 to 65 minutes or mini loaves for 35 to 45 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan.

title: Pink Lady Punch
instructions: Slowly add cranberry juice to sugar.\tStir well. Add pineapple juice and chill.\tPour into bowl and add ginger ale. Makes 32 punch cup servings.

title: Chicken And Dumplins
instructions: Place all ingredients except dumplings in dutch oven; cover double with water. Cover with lid. Cook over medium high until boiling and chicken is done no pink remains; and vegetables are tender. While chicken is cooking make dumplings. Drop dumpling batter by tbsp onto bubbling stew. Cover tightly reduce heat. Cook 12-15 min. without lifting cover. 8 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt all candy in crock-pot on high (about 1/2 hour). After melted unplug and add peanuts. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Sets up in a short time. Freeze well.

title: Apple Pancake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt butter in a 10-inch skillet or shallow pan. Remove 2 tablespoons butter and set aside. Put the apple slices in a large bowl with lemon juice. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Toss to coat slices. Cook the apples over medium heat in skillet with melted butter stirring often until apples are tender but still hold their shape.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Thoroughly brown venison in fat hot turning often. Add water beef broth lemon juice Worcestershire sauce onion and seasonings. Cover; simmer (dont boil) for 1 1/2 to 2 hours stirring occasionally. Add carrots and potatoes. Cover partially and cook until tender. Thicken liquid for gravy if desired.

title: German Pancakes
instructions: Heat butter in 9 x 13-inch pan in 350\u00b0 oven. Blend other ingredients in blender. Pour in hot pan and cook 25 minutes.

title: Nell Hughes' Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease tube pan. Add a little batter then sprinkle some pecan mixture over this. Add a little more batter and some more pecan mixture until it is all used up. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Bacon And Egg Casserole
instructions: Arrange bread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer Cheddar cheese Swiss cheese and bacon over bread. Beat eggs with milk and salt in bowl. Pour over layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until set. May chill overnight before baking. Yield 8 servings.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in order listed in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover and refrigerate for 12 hours.

title: Chile-Sausage Squares
instructions: Combine biscuit mix milk and 2 tablespoons mayonnaise; stir well. Spread mixture in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside. Cook sausage and onion in a skillet until meat is browned stirring to crumble meat. Drain well between paper towels. Layer sausage mixture over biscuit mixture. Combine egg cheese remaining mayonnaise and chiles; spread over sausage mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 8 servings or about 40 appetizers.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix squash onion eggs cheese and crackers (save some for top) all together. Add 1 cup hot milk over mixture. Top with butter. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chips and pour into casserole. Sprinkle garlic chips over casserole. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until hot. Dont overcook as mayonnaise will separate. Serves 8.

title: Don'S Shrimp, Cashew And Rice Fry
instructions: Prepare the rice according to the box directions set aside. Heat the oil and soy sauce in a large skillet. Saute the cashews mushrooms and water chestnuts until hot. Add shrimp and heat well. Mix in the rice and heat until the liquid is absorbed. Serve with egg rolls and Hardees garden salad.

title: Manwich Pockets(Great For Kids And Parties)
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease muffin cup pan for 10. Prepare Manwich Sloppy Joe sauce as directed. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Place 1 biscuit in each greased muffin cup; firmly press in bottom and up sides forming 1/4-inch rim. Spoon Manwich sauce (about 1/4 cup) into each biscuit-lined cup. Cut cheese slices in half. Crisscross cheese slices on top each cup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges of biscuits are golden brown. Cool 1 minute; remove from pan.

title: Hamburger Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add raw potatoes and onion; cook until potatoes are partly done. Add tomato juice. Simmer 1 hour.

title: Aunt Judy'S Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 cups very warm water. Stir in sugar and oil until sugar is dissolved. Mix in flour. Spoon into greased muffin cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Family Meat Loaf
instructions: Put sugar tomato sauce and mustard in bowl; set aside. Mix beef onion crumbs eggs salt and pepper. Add 1/2 cup of the tomato sauce mixture and stir until well mixed. Put in pan. Pour remaining sauce over meat. Cook on High for 18 to 20 minutes or until done in microwave. Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: In a saucepan brown the ground beef; drain. Add soup beans and chili powder. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add water if a thinner soup is desired.

title: Party Wienies
instructions: Mix and simmer over low heat for about 2 hours.

title: Chicken
instructions: Marinate boneless chicken breast in above mixture. Then cook until chicken is tender.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer all ingredients except Doritos corn chips etc. mixing sour cream taco seasoning and mayonnaise for second layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Serve with Doritos corn chips etc.

title: Pepper And Cabbage Relish
instructions: Put tomatoes cabbage and salt through food chopper. Place in a cloth bag and drain overnight. Next morning put peppers and onions through chopper. Mix vinegar brown sugar cinnamon black pepper and celery seed in large pot then add all chopped vegetables and bring to a boil. Cook slowly for 30 minutes. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Mix all together and put in casserole dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Elizabeth'S Fudge
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy 2-quart saucepan. Stir in milk and sugar. Bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly until mixture reaches the medium soft ball stage. Once this temperature is reached maintain boiling for a minimum of 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add chocolate and stir until chocolate melts. Add marshmallow cream and stir until blended. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares. Yields 3 pounds.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and set overnight. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Beat egg with water slightly. Add vinegar. Mix into flour-shortening mixture. Chill for 1 hour. Roll out on floured board. Makes 5 (9-inch) single crusts. May be frozen in pie dishes. Place waxed paper between covers in plastic bags for freezing.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned.

title: Fig Preserves
instructions: Wash fruit carefully in colander. Let sugar and water come to a boil. Add lemons figs and spices tied in a bag. Boil slowly until figs are tender and clear about 1 hour. Lift fruit carefully into sterilized jars; cover with juice. Seal while hot. Yields 4 pints.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix (minus the reserved cake mix) and press into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking pan (use metal not glass).

title: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
instructions: *Scotch bonnet peppers range from red and orange to yellow green. Shaped like a Scotchmans bonnet they are the preferred island pepper and very hot. They usually can be found only in Hispanic markets in the Milwaukee area. Jalapeno or Serrano peppers may be substituted.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: In Dutch oven or large covered skillet saute beef and pork until well browned. Add onions celery and bean sprouts; water can be added for plenty of moisture. Place in slow oven (300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0) for about an hour. Add soy sauce. If necessary thicken with cornstarch. Pour over rice and top with Chinese noodles.

title: Vermicelli Salad
instructions: Cook vermicelli and drain. Do not rinse. Put in airtight container. Add Accent lemon juice and oil. Toss lightly and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Add the rest of the ingredients.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Roll into walnut-sized balls. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes about 30 balls. (Definitely a double batcher!)

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven at 350 degrees. Combine green beans asparagus soup and melted butter in baking dish. Stir into mixture all of the Durkee fried onions except for 1/3 cup. Top with remaining fried onions and bake until browned.

title: Creamed Beef
instructions: Braise ground beef; season to taste with salt and pepper. Drain grease and discard. Melt butter in pan; add flour and milk to make a thick gravy. Use more/less milk as needed. Stir in braised beef. Simmer about 10 minutes. Serve on toast or biscuits. Serve with hashed brown potatoes.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add pumpkin. Add other ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheets. Frost with Orange Icing.

title: Lunchbox Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together flour soda sugar eggs butter (softened) and fruit cocktail (undrained). Beat for 3 minutes. Pour batter into pan. Sprinkle with butterscotch chips pecans (chopped) and white sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order listed above into a blender for 20 seconds on blend setting. Pour into greased 9 inch pie pan.

title: Tangy Peach-Yogurt Shake
instructions: In blender or food processor whirl peaches the yogurt and allspice until smooth. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

title: Miss Opal'S Peach Salad
instructions: Combine water sugar crushed pineapple and heat to boiling. Add peach jello and stir until dissolved. Add cream cheese to hot mixture and stir until melted. Mix well. Chill until thickened but not jelled! Add chopped canned peaches and Cool Whip and mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill!

title: Santa Fe Stew
instructions: Brown beef and 1/2 onion. Mix other ingredients in pot. Simmer 2 hours. Serve with grated cheese sour cream and/or onions.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except nuts and put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the chopped nuts on top.

title: Nut Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together then divide into 12 small balls. Refrigerate overnight. Roll out chilled dough and cut into wedges. Fill with your favorite filling (nut apricot or poppy seed). Roll up beginning with wider side as for crescent. Roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Lasagna(Makes Two Casseroles!!)
instructions: Meat Sauce Brown ground beef; drain. Add Prego spaghetti sauce salt pepper onions and oregano. Simmer for 1/2 hour. Cheese Filling Mix together beaten eggs cottage cheese (or Ricotta) Cheddar cheese and Mozzarella cheese.

title: Good French Dressing
instructions: Put in stew pan; bring to a boil. Cool. Will fill a quart jar. Will keep in refrigerator for 6 months or longer.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat with onion. Pour off grease. In small bowl mix flour salt garlic pepper and undrained mushrooms. Stir into meat. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Stir in soup heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in sour cream heat through 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oil. Form into patties. Heat oil in skillet. Fry patties until browned well on both sides covered. Place patties on paper towels on plate to soak up any excess oil. Good cold too!

title: Jamaican Coffee
instructions: Fill 6 warmed cups 3/4 full of hot coffee. Then top with Tia Maria. Sweeten lightly with sugar to taste and serve. Yield 6 servings.

title: Tofu Croquette
instructions: Cook onion in cooking oil until tender; blend in flour. Add milk and stir while it thickens. Add remaining ingredients and mix well and cool. Shape into patties. Roll in bread crumbs and fry in deep hot fat until done. Makes 25 croquettes.

title: Middle Eastern Pasta Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in olive oil and lemon juice until translucent. Add sauce and cinnamon. Heat and cook briefly to blend flavors. Serve over favorite pasta.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops
instructions: Trim all but a thin layer of fat from chops. Heat frying pan then add chops. Brown chops on both sides quickly. Remove chops. Saute onions and bell pepper in drippings for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain off any fat. Add brown sugar lemon juice Worcestershire sauce chili powder salt mustard and water; mix well. Place chops in single layer in pan. Add tomato sauce around chops and cover pan. Simmer 45 to 60 minutes until tender. Place chops on heated platter. Skim fat from sauce and spoon sauce over chops. Serves 6.

title: Bob Jones' Egg Nog
instructions: Whip cream until stiff adding 1/2 cup sugar. Separate eggs. Whip whites very stiff adding 1/2 cup sugar. Whip yolks until creamy adding 1/2 cup sugar. Continue beating until all sugar is dissolved. Add liquors to yolks mixing well. Stir in milk. Fold in whites thoroughly and then whipped cream.

title: Pizza Crackers
instructions: Spread one side of each cracker with pizza sauce. Top each with a piece of cheese and a slice of pepperoni. Arrange crackers on a paper towel lined plate. Microwave at 50% (Medium) for 30 seconds to 1 1/2 minutes or until cheese melts rotating dish 2 or 3 times during cooking.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Combine oil eggs sugar and vanilla.

title: Crab Toast
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients at room temperature. Add crabmeat. Split muffins and spread with mix. Freeze for a few hours (not frozen). Take out and cut into 6ths while partially frozen. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Broil until bubbly.

title: Fried Rice Almond
instructions: Cook onion green pepper garlic salt and pepper in oil for 5 minutes. Add rice soy sauce and almonds. Mix well and cook for 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serves 4.

title: Fudge Cake
instructions: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gnocchi
instructions: Boil potatoes and mash. Spread on board to cool. Add eggs; mix well. Add flour slowly to make soft pliable dough. Cut and roll into 1-inch size pieces. Drop gnocchi into boiling salted water. Cover and simmer until gnocchi come to surface and are tender. Drain well. In serving dish add spaghetti sauce and mix gently. Top with grated cheese.

title: 1-2-3 Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add Bisquick. Drop from point of spoon onto baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chestnut Leaves For Whooping Cough
instructions: Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. One or two cups a day for adults.

title: Fried Won Ton
instructions: Chop all ingredients fine. Place in bowl and mix soy sauce sesame oil cornstarch and water. Cook to thicken. Wrap meat mixture in won ton skins. Cook in hot oil. Drain and serve with sweet and sour sauce.

title: Barbecued Butter Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into casserole and cover. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours. Uncover the last hour.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Whip together cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time. Beat in. Spread crescent rolls in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour cream cheese mixture in. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Potato Soup
