instructions: Peel and cube potatoes into small pieces. Boil potatoes along with salt pepper and chopped onion in just enough water to cover potatoes. When tender add milk and simmer until thick. (More or less milk may be needed.)

title: Kix Bars
instructions: Place cereal in large mixing bowl. In medium saucepan combine sugar corn syrup and margarine. Cook over medium heat until sugar dissolves stirring frequently. Stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal; stir to coat. Spread in 11 x 7-inch dish sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Press evenly in pan. Cool. Makes 24 bars.

title: Simple Strawberry Dessert Cake
instructions: Slice pound cake. Place slices on plates (one or two slices per plate). Pour some strawberries and juice over each slice. If you choose to add whipped cream on top.

title: Pork Roast With Tangy Sauce
instructions: In a small bowl combine salt garlic salt and 1/2 teaspoon chili powder. Rub on roast. Place roast fat side up on rack in shallow roasting pan. Roast in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 2 hours (170\u00b0 for 40 minutes per pound).

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: In large bowl combine 1/4 cup soup and remaining ingredients except water. Shape into patties. Brown in large skillet. Drain grease. Combine rest of soup and water. Spoon over patties and simmer over low heat 20 minutes.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Danish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Lightly grease one large or two medium baking sheets. Prepare Cream Cheese Filling as directed; set aside. Stir together biscuit mix and sugar in mixing bowl. Stir in milk and butter until blended. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto prepared baking sheet to form 16 mounds. Make a shallow well in center of each mound using the back of a spoon. Place one heaping tablespoonful of Cream Cheese Filling into each well. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 5 minutes. Drizzle with Confectioners Glaze. Best served warm. Makes 16 pastries.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cup up cooked meat (any kind). May use roast left over or if using raw meat pork chops or steak brown on each side and cook a few minutes before adding to casserole. Hamburger or sausage may be used; cook and drain grease before adding to casserole. Saute carrot and onion in a little margarine or oil; mix all in mixing bowl. Pour into a buttered baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (covered). The last 10 minutes uncover to brown top. Delicious!!

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: A Nellie Snowdeal recipe.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add eggs sour cream and vanilla. Mix all together well; set aside. Mix walnuts cinnamon and sugar. Put 1/2 of batter in 9-inch tube pan (greased and floured) then 1/2 of topping (walnuts sugar and cinnamon) then rest of batter and other half of topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Bake cake the day before serving. Break half of cake into little pieces in a very large container (trifle bowl). Pour 1/4 cup kahlua over cake. Spread 1/2 of Cool Whip over pudding. Sprinkle candy over Cool Whip. Repeat layers ending with candy.

title: Pluckett Cake
instructions: Make mixture of first 3 ingredients. Cut each biscuit into quarters; roll in sugar mixture and drop into Bundt pan. Pour remaining sugar mixture over top; sprinkle with nuts. Melt 1 1/2 sticks oleo; pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Pour glaze over top of cake after you remove from pan while cake is still hot.

title: Basic Tomato Sauce
instructions: Combine everything together. Then simmer uncovered for 2 hours. Just before done add tomato paste to thicken. Put in jars while hot and seal.

title: Cappuccino
instructions: Mix well. Add 2 heaping teaspoonfuls to one cup boiling water.

title: Hawaiian Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Divide among 4 greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans. Cover tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and bake for 20 to 30 minutes more. Yields 80 to 100 servings.

title: Pound Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream butter (dont use margarine) and sugar. Divide cream cheese into 1/3s. Alternately add 2 eggs and 1/3 package cream cheese times 3 until 6 eggs and 1 package cream cheese are used. Beat 3 to 4 minutes each time between additions. Add cake flour and vanilla. Pour into greased large tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 3/4 to 2 hours at most.

title: Fig Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add oil and beat well. Add eggs one at a time alternately with the milk. Add figs pecans and vanilla. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Good; nice and moist.

title: Plantation Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken save broth. Chop onion pepper and celery; saute in margarine. Add chicken. Add soup milk and 1 1/2 cups chicken broth; stir until smooth. Take off heat add well beaten eggs and bread crumbs. Pour in large pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with grated cheese when done. Serve when cheese melts.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Mix well and chill. Roll to 1/4-inch thick on floured board and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and frost or decorate as desired.

title: Peppermint Candy
instructions: Place candy coating in a microwave safe bowl; microwave at medium (50% power) for four minutes stirring after two minutes. Stir in candy and spoon mixture into a greased wax paper lined cookie sheet. Spread thin and chill until firm. Break into small pieces. Store in an airtight container. Yield three dozen. May substitute lemon candy for peppermint.

title: Oreo Pie
instructions: Crush cookies and mix with melted butter. Save 1/2 cup of this for topping and press the rest into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Cream together 6 ounces Cool Whip and cream cheese then spread over cookie crumbs. Mix milk with instant pudding and spread over creamed mixture. Take remaining Cool Whip and spread over pudding. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cookie crumbs. Chill.

title: Divinity
instructions: Combine sugar and water; stir until sugar is dissolved. Add syrup. Cover saucepan and cook until syrup begins to boil. Remove top and cook without stirring to 255\u00b0. Remove from heat and pour in a fine stream over egg whites beating constantly. Continue beating until mixture holds shape and loses its gloss. Add vanilla and nuts. Drop quickly from tip of spoon onto waxed paper in individual peaks. Makes 30 pieces.

title: Peaches For Fried Pies
instructions: Mix and cook until thick. Put in hot pint jars and seal or it can be put in freezer.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix with electric mixer all ingredients.

title: French Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix well and bake 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes in an unbaked pie crust.

title: Easy Apple Dumpling
instructions: Roll biscuits thin and fill with apple filling. (Grand biscuits use 2 tablespoons; regular size use 1 tablespoon.) Put each dumpling in a glass dish sprayed with Pam. In saucepan bring to boil the sugar cinnamon margarine and 7-Up. Pour over dumplings and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown in color.

title: Teddi'S Potluck Chili
instructions: Brown and drain the ground meat. If using fresh kidney beans cook about an hour and drain off all water before putting the ingredients together. If using canned kidney beans combine all the ingredients in a large pot together.

title: Hamburg Soup
instructions: Brown beef drain fat. Stir in all other ingredients. Simmer partially covered. Stir several times. Cook about 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Boil chicken broth and butter. Add onion and celery. Cool 20 minutes. Add mushrooms. Gradually add all soups milk and chopped Velveeta cheese. Add grated cheese. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Roast walnut pieces on baking sheet for 5 to 8 minutes or until fragrant. Place spinach in salad bowl and toss with apple wedges and lemon juice. Add walnuts; mix well. Whisk oils and raspberry vinegar in a bowl; pour over spinach mixture. Add sesame seed. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Toss well and serve.

title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
instructions: Saute onions and celery in margarine just until tender. Add tomatoes and sauce and all seasonings. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Add macaroni. Simmer another 10 to 15 minutes. Mixture should be fairly thick. Serves 4 to 6.

title: My Own Chile
instructions: In heavy large pan add some cooking or olive oil. Brown meat onion garlic and celery until meat is done. Add salt pepper cumin seed and chili powder. Stir well. Add beans and tomatoes. Rinse cans and jars and add to soup. Cook only until chile comes to a boil. Stir well while heating.

title: Yogurt Orange Popsicles
instructions: Mix together and freeze in molds or ice cube trays.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain and add all other ingredients. Simmer and serve.

title: Herb Bread
instructions: Mix together and spread on French bread. Heat in foil in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Easy but very tasty.

title: Zucchini Fritters
instructions: Combine milk and egg in mixing bowl. Sift dry ingredients together and add (fold in) zucchini. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls into 375\u00b0 deep fat fryer. Turn only once. Drain on paper towel. Makes 1 1/2 to 2 dozen fritters.

title: Very Strawberry Pie
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add ice cubes and stir until melted. Prepare pie filling mix with 3/4 cup milk as directed on package for pie; let stand about 2 minutes. Blend in gelatin. Chill if necessary until thickened. Fold in 2 cups of the whipped topping and strawberries. Pour into crust. Freeze 1 hour or chill in refrigerator 3 hours before serving. Garnish with remaining whipped topping and additional strawberries if desired.

title: Peach Salsa
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients; stir gently. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour to blend flavors. May be refrigerated up to 2 days. Makes about 3 cups. Good with grilled beef chicken pork or fish.

title: Strawberry Banana Milkshakes
instructions: Ingredients are per shake.

title: Ukranian Bread
instructions: In a small bowl dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside. In a large bowl beat eggs and yolks until lemon colored gradually adding sugar. Add margarine salt lemon juice and peel. Beat well. Blend into yeast mixture. Add 6 cups flour and beat until smooth. By hand stir in enough flour to make dough soft. Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic. Sprinkle with raisins and knead for 5 more minutes. Place in a greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour. Punch down. Turn onto a lightly floured board and divide into thirds. Let rise for 10 minutes. Shape into loaves and place in greased loaf pans. Let rise in a warm place to double. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Core cabbage and parboil. Cool. Remove each leaf. Line roasting pan with some of the cabbage leaves. Take half of the sauerkraut and spread on top of cabbage. Mix hamburg pork and rice together. Add salt and pepper as wanted. Take each cabbage leaf and stuff with the meat mixture (amount according to size of leaf). When all meat mix is used up add the rest of the sauerkraut on. Roll up leaves. Pour 1/2 cup warm water over all. Cover. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add water as needed. Serve with carrots.

title: Escalloped Carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook carrots in salted water until tender. Cook onions in butter 2-3 minutes. Stir in flour salt mustard and milk. Cook until smooth. Add pepper and celery salt. In 2 quart casserole arrange layers of carrots and cheese slices. Pour in mustard mixture. Top with bread crumbs and bake 30-40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Bring broccoli to boil; simmer 20 minutes. Leave whole; drain water. Wrap slices of ham around broccoli and put in buttered casserole. Pour soup over all. Add onion flakes. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Crumbly Apple Pie
instructions: Mix apples sugar and cinnamon; pour into prepared pie crust. Mix and sprinkle on top the brown sugar flour butter and salt. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Layered Taco Dip
instructions: Layer all the ingredients exactly in the order in which they are given. This is a very attractive dish when prepared on a large serving platter and served with fresh tortilla chips.

title: Peanut Sesame Noodles
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente. Drain. Rinse in cold water and toss with 2 tablespoons sesame oil. Set aside. Place remaining sesame oil in large heated frying pan. Add green onions garlic and pepper flakes. Stir over medium heat until onions have softened 2 minutes. Add spaghetti vinegar sugar and soy sauce. Heat mixture tossing to combine for 3 or 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts and cilantro. Add salt to taste. Transfer to serving bowl. Makes 4 servings.

title: Choco-Cherry Nut Drops
instructions: Mix together flour soda and salt. Set aside. Then cream butter and gradually add brown sugar and white sugar; cream well. Blend in egg and vanilla; beat well. Add the dry ingredients gradually and mix well. Stir in morsels nuts and cherries. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Yield 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Fry meat in butter; drain. Add all ingredients except noodles (shells). Simmer 1 to 2 hours. Cook noodles and add to pot.

title: Chicken-Rice Skillet
instructions: In skillet or electric frypan stir together oil soy sauce onion and garlic. Add chicken and brown over medium heat. Season with ginger and pepper. Push chicken to center with pieces overlapping. Pour 2 1/4 cups water around chicken and add bouillon and rice. Cover and simmer about 35 minutes. Add 1/4 cup water if needed.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. May frost with a cream cheese frosting.

title: Gilbert'S Garden Pasta Sauce
instructions: In large saucepan saute onions and garlic in hot oil 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Butter 2 cookie sheets 15 1/2 x 12-inches and keep warm. Mix baking soda 1 teaspoon water and vanilla. Mix sugar 1 cup water and the corn syrup in a 3-quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally to 240\u00b0 on candy thermometer or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a soft ball that flattens when removed from water. Stir in margarine and peanuts. Cook stirring constantly to 300\u00b0 or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water separates into hard brittle threads. Watch carefully so mixture does not burn. Immediately remove from heat. Quickly stir in baking soda mixture until light and foamy. Pour half of the candy mixture onto each cookie sheet and quickly spread about 1/4-inch thick. Cool. Break into pieces.

title: Peanut Butter Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars butter and peanut butter. Beat in eggs and oil. Add remaining ingredients. Form into small balls. Press with fork and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: O' Henry Candy
instructions: Mix sugar and white syrup to rolling boil (do not overcook). Add peanut butter; blend until smooth. Add Special K; blend until smooth. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Top with melted chocolate.

title: Nacho Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Spread bottom of pie plate with cream cheese. Add beans spreading evenly over cream cheese. Sprinkle with olives. Spread salsa over mixture and top with Cheddar cheese. Heat at 375\u00b0 until Cheddar cheese has melted. Serve warm with taco chips.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Slice rolls in halves. Melt oleo; add mustard poppy seed onion and Worcestershire; stir well. Add ham and cheese; mix well. Spread over bottom half of roll until covered. Place top half of rolls over mixture. Replace in tin and wrap with foil. Place overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. May be frozen before baking.

title: Better Than Anything Cake
instructions: Bake yellow pudding cake mix in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. While cake is cooking bring to a boil pineapple and sugar; boil 5 minutes. When cake is done pour pineapple over cake; let cool. When ready to serve mix pudding. Spread over cake. Spread coconut over pudding. Cut bananas over coconut. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and add cherries.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; beat in oil and sugar then add zucchini and vanilla. In another bowl add dry ingredients (flour baking powder baking soda and salt). Add dry ingredients to other bowl. Mix all together. Put in greased loaf pan. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let it sit in pan for 10 minutes to cool.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream powdered sugar and cream cheese. Add peanut butter. Mix until blended. Fold in Cool Whip and mix until smooth. Put into crusts. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: Take 1 cup warm water dry yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar; mix well. Let rise. Now take 2 cups water 1 cup sugar shortening and salt; heat together until shortening melts. Let cool. Add about 7 cups or more flour 2 eggs and the first yeast mixture together. Beat with beater like making a cake. Set aside to rise at room temperature. Let rise until double. Punch down and roll out rolls in shape you want. These rolls can be precooked and frozen.

title: Banana Marlow
instructions: Melt marshmallows in boiling water. Add the banana pulp and lemon juice. Cool. When quite cool and slightly thickened combine with the cream which has been whipped. Pour into trays and freeze without stirring. Serves 6.

title: Confetti Salad
instructions: Cook shells according to package; drain. Rinse until cool and drain well. Combine Italian dressing mayonnaise salt and pepper. In a large bowl blend well. Add all ingredients to dressing mixture. Toss lightly until evenly coated. Chill.

title: Shontel'S Easy Dump Cake
instructions: Pour fruit into bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan (drain 1/2 of liquid).

title: Easy Oyster Stew
instructions: Drain oysters and artichokes; save juice. Saute onions in butter. Chop oysters and artichokes. Add soup and juice to desired consistency.

title: Chile Verde
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add jalapenos onions and tomatoes; boil for 20 minutes. Drain and cool. Put all ingredients in blender and blend to desired consistency. Over medium-high heat return to a boil. It is then youre ready to put on top of your food.

title: Veal Parmigiana
instructions: Dip cutlets in mixture of beaten eggs salt and pepper. Pat coating of crumbs over meat surface. Heat oil in large skillet; brown veal on both sides. Place meat in large baking dish. Combine and heat remaining ingredients except cheeses for 10 minutes. Pour over veal sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and cover tightly. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove cover place slice of Mozzarella cheese over each cutlet and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Graham Cracker Crust(No Bake)
instructions: Blend together and press in pie plate. Chill before filling.

title: Louisiana Chicken And Rice
instructions: Place all ingredients except chicken in casserole. Mix well. Place chicken onto and push into liquid so it is covered. Cover dish and microwave on High 24 to 27 minutes. Rotate dish several times. Let stand 10 minutes. Serves 4 or 5.

title: Pineapple-Lime Velvet Salad
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve lemon and lime gelatins in boiling water. Add cheese and beat with an electric mixer until smooth. Chill mixture to consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Fold in celery pecans and pineapple. Fold whipped topping thoroughly into jello mixture. Turn into 2 shallow 2-quart baking dishes. Cover and chill at least 4 hours or overnight. You can use a 13 ounce can chilled whipped evaporated milk instead of topping. Makes 24 servings.

title: Butter Sponge Cake
instructions: Beat egg yolks and sugar until fluffy; add scalded milk and vanilla beating constantly. Add flour and baking powder. Fold in melted butter or margarine. Batter will be very thin. Pour into 3 (9-inch) well-greased layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Ice cake with your favorite frosting.

title: Toasted Meringue Cake
instructions: Cream shortening add 2 cups brown sugar and mix well. Add 2 egg whites and 4 yolks. Sift flour with salt baking powder soda cloves and cinnamon. Add flour alternately with buttermilk

title: Peppy Cheese Dip
instructions: Blend ingredients (I use my food processor). Chill and serve with raw vegetables.

title: Quick Flavor With Instant Coffee
instructions: Dissolve coffee granules or powder in equal amount of water. Shake with coconut. Sprinkle on cupcakes or ice cream.

title: Amish Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and oil together. Add pumpkin. Mix dry ingredients then add water stirring just until mixed. Add dry ingredients to the pumpkin mixture. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9x5 loaf pans.

title: Ham-Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese in a large bowl. Add next 9 ingredients; mix well. Chill until nearly firm. Shape into ball. Roll in pecans and parsley flakes. Wrap in foil. Refrigerate overnight. Slice to serve.

title: White Chili
instructions: Sprinkle Southwest seasoning on chicken breasts and cook in microwave until done. Dont overcook the chicken but make sure it is done (no pink in the middle). While chicken breasts are cooking combine above ingredients in pan and cook on medium. Add cooked chicken breasts and simmer 30 minutes. Stir to ensure it doesnt stick to bottom of pan. Garnish with sour cream and shredded Monterey Jack cheese.

title: French Vanilla Icing
instructions: Cook milk and flour until thick (similar to starting gravy). Cool completely in fridge. Beat butter shortening sugar and vanilla until creamy. Add cooked milk and flour. Beat 10 minutes. Should resemble the inside of a Twinkie.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar and milk to boil. Stir constantly until sugar is fully dissolved. Remove from heat beat in peanut butter and vanilla. Pour in buttered pan to cool and set. Serves 6.

title: Cinnamon Coated Pecans
instructions: Boil until mixture spins a thread. Pour in 3 cups of pecans. Stir quickly until pecans are coated and just about to get hard. Pour out on tin foil. Separate with a fork.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
instructions: Cut bacon in pieces; fry until medium done. Put beans in oven dish; add bacon ketchup barbecue sauce mustard and sugar. Stir well; slice onion and separate. Layer on top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 4.

title: Crispy Chicken Rolls
instructions: Bone chicken breasts if not previously boned. Pound each half breast to about 1/4 inch thickness. Combine chopped shrimp margarine and green onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Spoon shrimp mixture onto center of each breast. Roll breast and skewer or secure with toothpick. Heat 1 inch oil in skillet. Make batter from flour baking powder salt and water. Roll or dip each breast in batter. Fry in hot oil until golden brown (about 15 minutes) turning frequently. Drain on paper towels. Serve quickly to retain crispiness.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine 2 cups flour and yeast. Heat water brown sugar shortening and salt to 115\u00b0 to 120\u00b0 stirring constantly. Add flour mixture; beat at low speed for 30 seconds then on high for 3 minutes. Knead in whole wheat flour to make a moderately stiff dough. Place in greased bowl turning once to coat. Cover; let rise in warm place until double in size. Punch down; divide in half and let rest 10 minutes. Shape into loaves and place in greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Cover; let rise until nearly double. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes.

title: Marie Moncrief'S Coconut-Black Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil and eggs. Beat well. Combine dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture alternately with buttermilk beating well after each addition. Stir in nuts coconut and extract. Pour batter into a well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 65 minutes or until cake tests done. Pour the following hot syrup over hot cake in pan.

title: Orange Blossom Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In medium mixing bowl combine orange juice 1/4 cup sugar oil and egg. Add biscuit mix and beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Stir in marmalade and pecans. Grease muffin pan or line with paper cups. Fill each cup 2/3 full with batter.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar salt and cocoa in bowl. Bring to boil water butter and cooking oil in saucepan. Then pour in bowl with dry ingredients. Beat well. Then add eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla. Beat well and pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Corn
instructions: Cut corn from cob. Fill jars 3/4 full of corn. Add salt sugar and vinegar. Pour enough boiling water to completely cover contents in the jar and seal.

title: Mustard Pickles
instructions: Combine tomatoes and onions;\tadd 3 tablespoons salt. Add enough cold water to cover. In separate container add 1 1/2 tablespoons salt and enough cold\twater to cover the peppers. Let each pan set 10 to 12 hours.\tDrain vegetables and rinse well. Combine green tomatoes onions and peppers in large pot and add enough\twater to cover. Bring to a boil for 10 minutes (onions should be\tclear\tbut not mushy). Drain; set aside to cool.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Bring soup to boil. Add cream cheese. Cook until melted. Add gelatin and cool in refrigerator. Add other ingredients and pour into lightly oiled pan. Refrigerate until firm. Can double recipe for 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake
instructions: To make crust mix first three ingredients; press in 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan.

title: Peanut Butter Balls(No Bake)
instructions: Cream together peanut butter powdered sugar and vanilla. Add Rice Krispies and nuts. Shape into small balls and roll in coconut.

title: Pastel De Elote
instructions: Sift flour measure and sift with corn meal and baking powder and salt into mixing bowl. Cream butter and sugar in another bowl and add eggs one at a time mixing in well. Add chilies corn and cheese;\tmix well. Blend creamed mixture into flour mixture. Pour into greased and floured baking dish (8 x 12 x 2-inch) and put into preheated oven (350\u00b0). Bake for 5 minutes at\t350\u00b0 and reduce to 300\u00b0 and bake for 55 minutes. Time of preparation 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Pineapple Steak
instructions: Mix ingredients and marinate steak 2 hours or more. Place steak and pineapple on skewers. Barbecue or broil shish kabobs until preferred doneness.

title: Best Ever Cookies
instructions: Cream brown sugar and butter. Add eggs cinnamon cloves nutmeg soda raisins nuts and flour. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Michael'S Lentil Stoup
instructions: Pressure cook lentils 10 to 15 minutes (1 hour regular cooking). Saute vegies in a bit of oil. Mix lentils vegies garlic and spices. Add water to desired thickness. Serve warm. Makes 14 to 16 servings.

title: Funny Bunny Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line large cookie sheet (17 x 14-inch) with foil. Divide cookie dough in half; refrigerate remaining dough. Divide remaining dough in half; shape one-half into large ball. To form bunnys body press ball into 6-inch circle 1-inch from bottom of foil-lined cookie sheet. Divide remaining dough in half; shape into ball and press into 4-inch circle so it just touches other circle. To form ears divide remaining dough in half. Shape into ears 5-inches long and 2-inches apart just touching head. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 12 minutes or until set. Cool completely. Remove from foil. Spread bunny with frosting. Decorate as desired. Makes 2 cookies. (M&Ms make cute bunny.)

title: Christmas Coconut Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl measure butter cream cheese and sugar and beat together. Add egg almond extract and orange juice; beat well. Mix together flour baking powder and salt. Gradually add to butter mixture until well blended. Stir in 4 cups of coconut; cover and chill 1 hour.

title: Homemade Soup
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water. Put in the onion and bring to a boil. Add the cut up potatoes. Boil until they are soft. Add all vegetables tomato sauce and hamburger meat. Let simmer for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Diabetic Orange Julius
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and run slightly.

title: Impossible Chicken And Broccoli Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie pan. Rinse broccoli under cold water to thaw. Drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli 2 cups cheese chicken and onions in pie plate. Beat eggs and Bisquick mix in blender until smooth 15 seconds or 1 minute by hand. Pour into plate over other ingredients. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 25 to 35 minutes. Put remaining cheese on top. Cook only until cheese is melted. Cool 5 minutes to set.

title: Chicken Baked
instructions: Mix and pour over chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Hamburg Tomato Rice Soup
instructions: In lg stew pot combine veggies bouillon salt pepper and water. Bring to boil then let simmer.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add fruit and egg then milk and flour sifted with baking powder and salt.\tBake in muffin tins at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until done.

title: Rhubarb Cobbler
instructions: Mix 1 cup sugar 1/3 cup pancake mix lemon peel and rhubarb. Toss together. Place in 9-inch greased pan. Mix remaining dry ingredients; stir in eggs until coarse. Sprinkle over rhubarb. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a greased dish until brown in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Shrimp And Sausage Dinner
instructions: Place in a large pot of water on stove. Add crab and shrimp boil. Bring to a boil; add sausage and let boil 5 minutes. Add corn and boil 7 to 10 minutes longer. Add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Arrange all ingredients on a large platter and serve with melted butter and cocktail sauce. Serves 6 to 8. (Great with a green salad and garlic bread.)

title: Stewed Okra And Tomatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle top with additional cracker crumbs and dot with margarine. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: End Of The Garden Relish
instructions: Cook beans and carrots separately until tender. Soak the rest of the vegetables overnight in salt and water. Drain and add the cooked carrots and green beans. Mix vinegar sugar and celery seed. Add all vegetables to this mixture and boil together for 10 minutes then spoon into jars. Makes about 7 half-pint jars.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: Mix cake mix margarine and 1/3 cup milk. Pat half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: No Rise Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Melt stick of butter and add to yeast and water. Add sugar and beaten egg. Stir well. Add flour. Mix all together and pour into greased muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pizza Snacks
instructions: Flatten biscuits individually on cookie sheet. spoon pizza sauce on biscuit. Top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 to 9 minutes. You may add other toppings such as sausage pepperoni mushrooms etc.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix the ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add all other ingredients and blend. Fold into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake in a slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until set.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: This recipe may be made as large or as small as you want. Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: In-Law Chicken Pie
instructions: Cut up chicken; cover with water. Add the salt and poultry seasoning to the water. Cover the pan and cook until chicken is done. Cool. Remove chicken from the bone and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Remove about 3 cups broth from cooking pot and place in another cooker. Make a thickening using about 3 tablespoons of flour and 1/2 cup water. Stir together until smooth. Pour this thickening into hot broth and stir together until gravy is thick and bubbly. Pour this gravy over chicken in pan. Sift flour salt and baking powder. Beat egg; add melted butter and about 1 1/2 cups milk together. Add this to dry ingredients. Make a batter that is stiffer than pancakes but not as stiff as drop dumplings. Drop by big mixing spoonfuls on gravy. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown and cooked through. Spoon biscuit on plate and top with chicken and gravy.

title: Old Fashioned New York Style Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Let cheese reach room temperature. Melt butter; mix butter 2 tablespoons sugar and graham crackers together. Put in bottom of 9-inch spring pan place in freezer until mixture is completed. In a separate bowl mix together cream cheese and 1 cup sugar until reaches a smooth texture. Mix in eggs vanilla cornstarch and sour cream. When smooth pour mixture into spring pan. You may bake now either in water or just in spring pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes turn oven down to 250\u00b0 bake additional 45 minutes. Shut oven off let cake sit 3 hours inside. Place in fridge at least 8 hours prior to serving.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and set aside. Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs mixing well. Sift flour salt and soda together. Add buttermilk and flour alternately to Crisco and sugar mixture in\tthirds. Mix well. Add red food coloring mixture; mix well.\tAdd vinegar last. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans. Bake 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Snowy White Fudge
instructions: Let butter begin to melt in heavy 3-quart saucepan. Brush sides of pan with melted butter. Add evaporated milk and sugar. Cook over medium-high heat to boiling about 8 minutes whisking constantly to dissolve sugar. Cook over medium-high heat whisking frequently to soft ball stage 236\u00b0 about 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Add candy wafers marshmallow cream walnuts and vanilla; stir until well blended. Pour into well buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan; cool and cut into squares.

title: Penuche Frosting
instructions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan and stir in brown sugar. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir over low heat 2 minutes. Stir in milk and heat to boiling. Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm. Gradually stir in confectioners sugar. Place the pan in a bowl of ice water. Beat the frosting until smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Fried Cauliflower
instructions: Boil the cauliflower and then batter it in eggs and flour. Deep fry in vegetable oil. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Remove 12 large leaves from cabbage. Trim off thick part of each leaf. Let boiling water stand on leaves a few minutes so they become easy to roll. Combine meat rice grated onion eggs salt pepper. Place mounds of meat mixture in cup part of each leaf. Loosely fold over sides of each leaf; roll up. Start heating oven to 375\u00b0. In bottom of Dutch oven place a few of remaining cabbage leaves. Arrange layers of stuffed cabbage with seam sides down and sliced onion in Dutch oven. Pour on tomato sauce tomatoes lemon juice. Add 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper. Bring to boil on top of range. Sprinkle with sugar to taste. Bake covered 1 hour; uncover; bake 2 hours. (Serves 8.)

title: Hot Spice Sauce For Plum Pudding Or Fruitcake(For 4 To 6 Servings)
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Blend in flour. Add remaining ingredients. Serve hot on warmed pudding or cake.

title: Fake Raspberry Jam
instructions: Cook ground tomatoes and sugar together for 15 minutes. Add the package of gelatin. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Put in jars and seal. Invert jars after 1 hour to distribute the fruit.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple (save juice). Mix crushed pineapple and marshmallows together and put into a bowl with a cover. Let set overnight (approximately 8 hours) in refrigerator.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce(For Corn Salad)
instructions: Mix together; cook until thick. (If desired you can add more vinegar.) Let cool.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Arrange apples water cinnamon and nutmeg and salt in bottom of sugar baking dish. Bake topping of sugar flour and oleo. Mix together and press over apples. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Vanilla Almond Coffee
instructions: Add the two extracts together and shake thoroughly. Brew your coffee and add extract mixture to taste. Adds a wonderful flavor especially for decaffeinated brews.

title: Pea And Tomato Soup
instructions: A novel and excellent combination is a mixture of a can of cream of pea soup and a can of cream of tomato soup.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Melt and cool butter. Sift together flour baking soda salt butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat and whip 1 1/2 minutes. Add bananas sour cream and nuts to flour mixture. Blend 1/2 minute. Bake in a loaf pan for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Melt shortening in large skillet. Add onions and mushrooms; cook and stir until onions are tender. Remove vegetables and drain. Brown meat in same skillet adding shortening if necessary. Remove pan from heat. Sprinkle salt marjoram thyme and pepper over meat. Mix flour and broth; stir into skillet. Heat to boiling stirring constantly; boil and stir one minute. Stir in wine. Cover. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Liquid should always just cover meat. If necessary add more wine and broth one part broth to two parts wine. Gently stir in onions and mushrooms. Cook uncovered 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Creamy Mandarin Salad
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Set aside to cool. Blend all ingredients and chill at least two hours. Serve on spinach or romaine lettuce. Top with chow mein noodles.

title: Dee'S Bowtie Pasta
instructions: In bowl combine pasta and vegetables. Mix all other ingredients and pour over pasta. Let stand 24 hours. Keep refrigerated.

title: Seafood Vera Cruz
instructions: Place fish fillets in Pyrex dish; salt and pepper to taste. Add lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce; allow to marinate while preparing vegetables. Saute onion in olive oil until golden. Add tomatoes pepper garlic capers black olives tomato paste and chopped parsley. Cover; cook for 10 minutes. Top fish with this mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes per inch of thickness of fish.

title: Artichoke Heart Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl with mixer beat shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and molasses until blended. Beat in 1 cup of flour salt baking soda and spices until well mixed. With spoon stir in enough of remaining flour to make stiff dough. Shape dough into 1 1/2-inch balls. Place 3 inches apart on cookie sheet. Lightly grease bottom of flat bottomed 3-inch glass. Dip into small bowl of sugar. Use glass to flatten balls to 3-inch diameter dipping each time in sugar. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package in two 9-inch round pans. Let cakes partially cool and poke holes in the top. Pour over each cake 1/2 cup of Kahlua. Let the cakes cool completely. Cut cakes into small pieces. Make chocolate mousse as per package directions. Using a large punch bowl pat cake pieces on the bottom of bowl. Place part of the chocolate mousse on top of the cake pieces then layer with Cool Whip and crushed Skor bars. Keep layering until punch bowl is filled. Top with Cool Whip and crushed Skor bars. Dig in!

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix together first five ingredients on low speed. Sift together dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Alternately add chopped nuts and fold in stiff beaten egg whites. Bake until done in a tube pan at 300\u00b0 about 2 hours.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together until creamy.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 9 x 13 pan. Cool. Punch holes in cake where juice can get in layer. Pour strawberries over cake. Put Cool Whip on top. Cool before serving.

title: Hearty Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Combine pancake mix oats brown sugar and cinnamon. Add remaining ingredients; mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Beat butter and shortening at medium speed about 2 minutes or until soft and creamy. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans; pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool 10 to 15 minutes before frosting.

title: Dr. Bird Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Gram'S Fresh Peach Pie
instructions: Combine 1 cup sugar cornstarch and salt. Add water and peaches. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Add lemon juice and cool. Meanwhile make crumbs with flour 1 cup sugar and margarine. Combine and mix until crumbs are fine. Put peach mixture in pastry shell. Cover with crumbs. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0 then 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cream Cheese Bacon Bars
instructions: Blend all ingredients well; spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes and cut into small squares.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown bacon and crumble. Add onion and saute. Drain bacon grease. Add vinegar garlic powder catsup and brown sugar to bacon mixture. Simmer 5 minutes. Drain and add beans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or heat in crock pot.

title: Tuna Pot Pie
instructions: Line 9-inch pie pan with 1 crust; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour filling in pie pan. Top with second crust. Seal and crimp edges. Slit top of crust to vent and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45-50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix above ingredients together and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Top with crushed potato chips.

title: Golden Baked Fish
instructions: Place fish in pan. Season with salt and pepper. In a small bowl beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in remaining ingredients. Spread on fish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork and is lightly browned. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix flour salt and soda; set aside. Mix butter and peanut butter; add both kinds of sugar. Mix well. Add eggs and beat well. Stir flour into peanut butter mixture. Drop dough from teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a loaf pan and line with a strip of wax paper. Grease the paper. Place the flour sugar and salt in a large bowl. While beating add the beer slowly. Mix until smooth. Pour batter into loaf pan and top with the melted butter. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in water with salt pepper and bay leaf. Remove chicken; reserve 1/2 cup of chicken stock. Cut chicken into large bite-sized pieces. Set aside. Combine soups tomatoes chicken stock salt and pepper to taste. Mix well. In a 3-quart casserole make 3 layers in the following order torn tortillas chicken tomato mixture chopped onions and grated cheese. Use all ingredients being sure cheese is on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Aunt Eleanore Dish
instructions: In a large frying pan crumble and fry sausage and ground meat together until good and brown. Drain meat in a colander and return to large frying pan. Add sauerkraut and 1 can water; bring to a boil. Add noodles. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 12 minutes or less. Test noodles for doneness after 8 minutes. Stir and serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix onion pepper and 1 package dried beef; mix with cream cheese. Form a ball and roll into rest of the dried beef. Enjoy. Serve with an assortment of crackers.

title: Easy Layered Salad
instructions: In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Layer lettuce green pepper onions and peas. Do not toss. Spread salad dressing over all. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chicken Chili
instructions: Heat half the olive oil in a Dutch oven over high heat. Add the onion and garlic; saute for 5 minutes. Add the red and jalapeno peppers and saute over medium heat for 10 minutes. Stir in the chili powder cumin coriander and cinnamon; cook for 5 minutes more. Remove from heat and set aside. Brown the chicken in batches in the remaining 3 tablespoons oil in a large skillet just until cooked through. Add the chicken tomatoes with the puree olives and beer to the Dutch oven and stir to combine. Simmer over medium heat for 15 minutes. Stir in the chocolate and season to taste with salt. Serve immediately. Pass the sour cream Cheddar cheese scallions and avocado in separate small bowls. Makes 6 portions.

title: Cream Cheese Crab Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Spread on toast or bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Angel Food Candy
instructions: Cut chocolate into small pieces. Set aside. Cut wax into small pieces. Set aside. In heavy 4-quart Dutch oven combine corn syrup and brown sugar. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture reaches 300\u00b0 on candy thermometer stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Carefully stir in baking soda (mixture will foam up). Pour at once into a greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan. When cool turn out of pan. Break into pieces using wooden spoon. In a double boiler combine chocolate chips chocolate pieces butter and wax. Stir mixture until melted and smooth. Remove from heat leaving in double boiler. Dip candy into chocolate using large cooking fork. Place on waxed paper lined baking sheets. Let stand until chocolate is set. Store in cool place.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup butter and graham cracker crumbs; press into 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Parmesan Potatoes(Microwave Recipe)
instructions: Place butter in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf dish. Microwave on High 1/2 to 1 minute to melt. Stir potatoes into melted butter to coat. Add cheese to taste and salt. Stir well. Cover with plastic wrap turning back one corner to vent. Cook on High for 15 minutes rotating after 8 minutes.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Combine beef beans oregano cumin and garlic. Place four of the uncooked noodles in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread half of the beef over noodles. Top with 4 more noodles and the remaining noodles.

title: Lobster Cakes With Corn Chowder
instructions: Mix together first 10 ingredients. Fold in lobster meat and season to taste. Add enough cracker crumbs until all blends together. Form 8 small cakes. Preheat oven to 357 degrees. Place cakes on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. To serve place lobster cake in soup plate. Pour chowder around. Enjoy!

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; add Milnot and water. Cook over low heat stirring frequently until desired thickness. Add 1 tablespoon butter or oleo and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Delicious served hot over hot biscuits.

title: Oven Potatoes
instructions: Scrub and peel off potatoes. Dice into bite-size pieces with skin on. Mix oil and onion mix together. In lined baking pan place potatoes; pour oil and onion mix mixture over potatoes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Yummy Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour and blend. Add vanilla and chocolate syrup. Stir until well blended. Pour into 9 x 14-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Spicy Stir-Fry Shrimp(Friday'S Dinner Menu)
instructions: Serve with green salad/low-fat Ranch dressing and crispy bread sticks

title: Maple Baked Beans
instructions: Place beans in an ovenproof crock with a lid. Stir in all other ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly about 30 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Blend mayonnaise lemon juice and salt. Add apples celery walnuts and raisins. Toss well. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Genesis Pie
instructions: Fold Cool Whip into yogurt and pour into crust. Freeze for 3 to 4 hours. Take out of freezer 30 minutes before serving.

title: Broccoli Puff
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain well. Beat egg yolks; add flour mixing well. Stir in nutmeg mayonnaise margarine salt and pepper and cheese. Add broccoli mixing lightly. Beat egg whites (room temperature) until stiff but not dry. Gently fold into broccoli mixture. Pour into lightly buttered 9-inch square baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 or 40 minutes or until browned and set.

title: Nanaimo Bars(Pronounced Na-Nigh-Mo)
instructions: In a double boiler melt together butter or margarine sugar and cocoa. Add egg and vanilla. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Stir in graham crumbs coconut and walnuts. Press mixture firmly into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill.

title: Mors Kake
instructions: Beat eggs and powdered sugar well. Add almonds walnuts lemon extract warm milk and flour which baking powder has been added to. Bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0) for 45 minutes. Decorate cake with whipped cream and fruit.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. This is the base of the punch. Freeze base in 4 equal parts in containers.

title: Vegetable Bake
instructions: Butter the bottom and sides of a 2-quart souffle dish. Wash each vegetable and slice very thin. Place a layer of sliced potatoes on the bottom of the dish and dot with butter. Repeat the process with the other vegetables in order; dot with butter in between each layer. Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon strips. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Soften cracker crumbs with milk and let set 10 minutes. Add egg to all of this which has not been mixed together. Add a can of tomato paste or catsup on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Triple-Treat Brownie Crunch
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Chop unsweetened chocolate. Combine 6 tablespoons of the butter and half of the chopped chocolate in a saucepan over the lowest heat. Let melt and stir until smooth. Remove from heat and let cool completely.

title: Applesauce Bars
instructions: Mix applesauce brown sugar and melted shortening. Sift in flour mixture. Add raisins and nuts. Put in a greased pan (7 x 11-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Basic Butter Cookie Dough
instructions: In a large bowl with electric mixer beat butter sugar egg vanilla and salt until light and fluffy. Gradually add flour; beat until well mixed. Cover dough. Chill 1 hour or place in freezer 30 minutes. Work with 1/4 dough at a time (keep remaining dough chilled). Roll out 1/4-inch thick between sheets of wax paper. Cut or mold dough into desired shapes. Repeat with remaining dough. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place cookies on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until cookies are lightly browned. Remove to rack. Cool completely. Makes 4 to 6 dozen cookies.

title: Bible Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) cake pans. Follow Solomons advice (2 Samuel 2243 first choice beat). Mix well then pour into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pie Crust(For 9-Inch Double Crust Pie)
instructions: Mix together. Roll half of dough out and place over bottom and sides of pie plate. Fill as desired. Top with remaining dough. Flute edges and slit top. Bake until lightly golden or as directed according to desired pie.

title: Electric Mixer Rolls
instructions: Heat milk to lukewarm. Add sugar. Dissolve yeast in milk and let stand 5 minutes. Add 3 cups of flour and beat vigorously. Add salt and eggs and beat well again. Add melted shortening or oil. When well blended gradually add remaining flour. When stiff turn onto floured board and knead. Return to oiled bowl to rise until double in bulk. Punch down and let rise again. When light knead before shaping into desired types of rolls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix altogether. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Bake for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Old Time Popcorn Balls
instructions: Butter sides of pan. Combine sugar water salt syrup and vinegar. Cook to hard ball stage. Stir in vanilla slowly; pour over popped corn and mix well. Butter hands; shape into balls. Makes 20 balls.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix juices well with syrup before adding ginger ale.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Run through food chopper and add 2 cups sugar. Chill. Mix 1 cup boiling water to 1 small package raspberry jello. Chill until partly set. Add cranberry mixture and nuts if desired. Chill overnight.

title: Peach And Pineapple Conserve
instructions: Mix first four ingredients and cook ten minutes. Add cherries and bring to a boil. Bottle.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Line large baking dish with layer of tortillas. Sprinkle with chicken broth. Saute onion and green pepper. Add soups and chili powder. Pour layer of soup mixture over tortillas then layer of chicken then a layer of cheese. Repeat layers. Pour can of Ro-Tel on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Add sugar to cranberries and apples. Mix well and let set overnight in refrigerator. Add Dream Whip and marshmallows; keep in refrigerator.

title: Hoss' Fat-Free Muffins(Not The Restaurant)
instructions: Mix all together and pour into greased muffin pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with crushed oreo cookies. Add cream cheese and powdered sugar with above mix. Mix pudding with milk and cool whip. Layer in a flowerpot; add flowers or gummi worms if desired.

title: Oven-Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter; stir in corn syrup water brown sugar and salt. Cut potatoes in halves lengthwise. Dip in corn syrup mixture coating all sides. Place in 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour remaining syrup over top. Bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) until tender and glazed about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Baste occasionally.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix then drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Macaroni Hamburg Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter until golden. Add hamburger; cook slowly until done. Drain excess fat. Grease a casserole dish. Combine macaroni with all ingredients including half of the cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Turn into casserole dish; sprinkle remaining cheese over the top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Hold a few orange sections aside. Dissolve jello in water. Stir in sherbet until dissolved. Pour into mold or serving dish. Refrigerate until almost jelled. Stir in oranges and whipped cream gently. Top with a dot of cream and an orange section. Very light and refreshing.

title: String Pie
instructions: Cook beef onion and pepper until brown. Drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce in separate bowl. Combine spaghetti Parmesan cheese eggs and butter. Place in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread cottage cheese over the top. Pour sauce mixture over the cottage cheese. Sprinkle with Mozzarella over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Frogmore Stew
instructions: You will also need a 6 to 8-quart stock pot and 1 large spoon with holes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and brown sugar together; add the egg and beat until fluffy. Stir in the dry ingredients buttermilk and vanilla. Add diced rhubarb and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle over the batter. Drizzle the melted margarine over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Combine spinach stuffing and sour cream. Spread cream mixture on squares of ham and roll placing seam-side down in oblong baking dish. Combine milk cornstarch and butter. Cook until thick. Stir in the Swiss cheese. Pour sauce over ham rolls and sprinkle a little additional Swiss cheese and paprika on top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender; process until smooth. Makes 1 1/4 cups or 1 can.

title: Frozen Angel Food Delight
instructions: Cut cake into 3 layers. Spread lime sherbet on bottom layer. Spread second layer with lemon sherbet. Add third cake layer. Frost with whipping cream. Freeze. Remove 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Any sherbet flavors may be used. Yields 12 servings.

title: Walnut And Port Cheese
instructions: Blend together cream cheese and powdered sugar. Using a table knife swirl Port through cheese making streaks but not blending in completely. Form into a ball. Wrap and chill at least 4 hours. Before serving press walnuts firmly into top and sides of cheese. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch Bars
instructions: Melt chips together. Bring to a boil the Karo syrup and sugar but do not boil. Stir in peanut butter. Add Special K. Put in greased 11 x 15-inch pan. Pat down evenly. Pour melted chips over and cool. Cut into bars.

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir together crumbs and 2 tablespoons sugar; mix in butter thoroughly. Press mixture evenly in bottom of ungreased 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake 10 minutes. Cool!

title: Barbecue Lover'S Chicken
instructions: In bowl combine all ingredients. In skillet slowly brown chicken in butter (about 25 minutes). Add sauce mixture. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes. Stir often. Serve with rice.

title: Cake Icing
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add all other ingredients.

title: California-Style Bloody Mary Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer 15 minutes. Add vinegar and let cool.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except nuts. Add nuts. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Cream the cheese. Add to dry jello mix. Blend in water. Add pineapple. Mix well and set in refrigerator until jello sets a little. Fold in Dream Whip and apricots; add nuts. Serves 12.

title: Shrimp Wraps
instructions: You also need toothpicks.

title: Swedish Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix hamburg bread crumbs eggs and water together. Shape into meatballs. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Saute onion in oil until lightly brown. Add meatballs chili sauce and jelly. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Strombolis
instructions: In frying pan brown ground beef; drain. Add onion and oregano also ketchup and tomato soup. Mix well. Heat and simmer for 10 minutes. In a small bowl add 1 stick softened butter or margarine paprika and garlic powder; mix well. Cut the rolls. Put this mixture on rolls like a spread. Add ground beef and top with 1 slice Mozzarella per roll. Wrap each one in Reynolds Wrap and put in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 1 dozen Strombolis.

title: Eggplant
instructions: Cook onion in oil until tender. Stir in tomatoes and Italian dressing; simmer. Slice eggplant 1/4-inch thick. Combine water and egg. Dip in bread crumbs. Put tomato sauce over eggplant and cover with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Mom'S Icing
instructions: Mix together and spread over cooled cake.

title: Fifteen Minute Cake
instructions: Grease a microwavable tube pan and coat with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar; pour in batter. Put in microwave oven and cook for 10 minutes on Low power and 5 minutes on High power. Test with broom straw. May take longer in ovens less than 600 watts. Cool and sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Creamy Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: In a large skillet melt margarine over medium heat. Add chicken. Cook stirring 3 minutes or until chicken is white. Remove chicken. Add broccoli red pepper and chicken broth. Cover and cook until broccoli is tender 5 to 7 minutes. Add bow ties and cheese; toss until cheese is melted. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken, Broccoli And Ziti
instructions: Saute chicken in garlic and oil. In large pot boil broccoli and ziti together until done. Add wine or broth and butter to chicken and simmer keep stirring until ready to add to ziti and broccoli. Simmer briefly. Add cheese to suit your taste.

title: Tofu Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use 9 x 13-inch pan. Defrost spinach and drain. Place tofu sugar garlic powder lemon juice and 1 teaspoon salt. Blend until smooth. Taste add more salt if necessary. Cover bottom of pan with sauce. Layer noodles 1/2 tofu filling and 1/2 spinach. Repeat layering ending with noodles. Cover with sauce. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch flour and sugar. Add milk and egg yolks that have been beaten. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Cool slightly; pour into baked pie crust. Cover with meringue made from egg whites and bake in slow oven at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 until brown.

title: Tomato Corn Relish
instructions: Put all ingredients in pot. Bring corn mixture to boil; boil for 15 minutes. Fill jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Wipe jar tops and threads clean. Place hot lids on jars; screw bands on firmly. Process in boiling water canner for 15 minutes. Makes several pints.

title: Candied Yams
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a heavy pot. Start cooking on medium heat. After boiling point turn to low and cook until done.

title: Cheese And Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes; skin cool and dice. Add Velveeta mayonnaise onion and salt to taste. Put in 9 x 11-inch pan. Top with bacon. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: 7-Minute Icing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler. Place over boiling water. Beat with electric mixer until thick and smooth. Spread on cake.

title: Sauteed Bananas
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in large pan or skillet. Add bananas and cook 2 minutes turning once. Sprinkle with orange juice; heat and serve immediately.

title: Cherry Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and salt. Add flavorings and egg yolks. Blend well. Stir in flour until well mixed. Quickly roll dough into long cylinder 1-inch in diameter and cut into 1/2-inch lengths. Form balls from cut pieces; place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press a quarter cherry into center of each. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes to a golden brown.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Prepare Jiffy mix according to directions. Add creamed corn. Place half of mix in greased 9 x 13-inch pan; set aside. Brown ground chuck and drain well. Add salsa to ground chuck; simmer 10 minutes. Spread ground chuck over top of cornbread mix. Sprinkle cheese over chuck mixture. Spread remaining cornbread mix. (Will look thin but rises.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for exactly 50 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juice off apricots and pineapple. Take 3/4 cup juice; add the sugar to it. Boil until syrupy. Cool. Combine all fruit in a bowl. Pour cooled syrup over it and stir. Put in cupcake papers and freeze. Take out 1/2 hour before eating. These keep well in freezer for quite some time.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning in bowl. Mix until well blended and smooth. Pour into shallow dish. Cover top with lettuce sprinkle with cheese then chopped tomato. Chill. Serve with doritos.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Boil until thick. Put cooked noodles in a 4-cup Pyrex dish. Crumble drained tuna (two 5 ounce cans) over noodles. Pour the gravy over the tuna. Cover with potato chips. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes; peel and slice medium-thick. Combine with onions dill and parsley. Season with salt and pepper. Add cut up eggs.

title: Sweet Onion Quiche
instructions: Saute onions in margarine. Place crackers in casserole. Layer onions on crackers. Mix eggs salt pepper milk and Accent. Pour over onions and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with towel for 15 minutes before serving. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Noodle Tortilla Soup
instructions: Cook chicken in oil with onions and chili powder. In saucepan add and bring to a boil the water and tomatoes. To this stir in and boil 10 minutes or until noodles are done the Lipton noodles chiles and garlic powder. Then add corn and cooked chicken mixture. Put in individual bowls and add tortilla chips crumbled and shredded cheese.

title: Turkey Au Gratin
instructions: Cook turkey for 3 1/2 to 4 hours at 350\u00b0. Cool for 15 minutes. Slice thin. Steam broccoli 4 minutes. Melt butter in a large pot over very low heat. Add flour to melted butter; blend. Cook mixture for 10 minutes stirring often to prevent burning. Add half and half milk cheese and garlic to flour mixture; stir until well blended. Allow to cook until mixture thickens (10 to 15 minutes) stirring often. Add water if necessary (a thick cheese sauce is desired). Arrange broccoli spears in a large roasting pan. Drape turkey slices over broccoli. Pour cheese sauce over turkey and broccoli until all is covered. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix dressing macaroni tuna celery green pepper onions and pimento. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Refrigerate. Serve on lettuce-lined plates.

title: Poached Apple Halves
instructions: In a shallow stainless steel pan make a thin syrup with sugar water and a few pieces cinnamon stick. (Thin syrup is 1 cup sugar and 3 cups water.)

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil\tsugar and zucchini; mix well. Stir in flour salt and soda. Fold in vanilla and nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove from pans and cool on rack. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Mama'S Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: In Georgia I add pecans.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix and stir until blended. Form into balls. Yields about 2 lbs.

title: Norwegian Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add remaining ingredients and beat thoroughly. Batter will be thin. Make large thin pancakes keeping pan well buttered. Pancakes may be filled with preserves ice cream ground walnuts and powdered sugar or cooked apples.

title: Surprise Cake
instructions: Cut angel food cake in half to make two layers. Spread strawberry jelly on top of first half and cover with other half. Top with Cool Whip and garnish with fresh strawberries.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Beat eggs until creamy. Slowly add sugar then flour baking powder and flavoring. Line jelly roll pan with wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Turn out on dish towel that has been floured with powdered sugar. Fill with jelly lemon pie filling or caramel condensed milk or your favorite filling and roll up.

title: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients on warm heat to thicken then whip applesauce and vanilla. Add flour and white sugar. Beat egg whites until foamy in another bowl. Mix the 2 bowls together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Scallops In Tomato And Paprika Sauce
instructions: If scallops are large cut in 3 or 4 pieces. If they are tiny bay scallops leave them whole. Heat the butter in a sautepan and add the scallops. Cook shaking the skillet or stirring for about 2 minutes. Remove from pan with a slotted spoon and set aside. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add the cognac or brandy to the pan and flambe. Let flame until it dies out without shaking the pan. Add the paprika; stir it through then add the tomato sauce garlic parsley salt and pepper to taste. Cook about 3 or 4 minutes. Return scallops to the pan and toss in the sauce. Spoon into 4 to 6 scallop shells and top with cheese. Place on a cookie sheet in a 400\u00b0 oven and let heat just long enough to melt the cheese and heat the scallops through about 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Pears Antoine With Sherbet
instructions: Peel and core pears; slice into chunks. Pour sherry into small bowl; add pears and marinate in refrigerator until serving time. Place 1 scoop sherbet in each of 4 dessert dishes. Spoon pear mixture on top and garnish with grated lemon peel.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder salt and baking soda into large bowl. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Add egg orange juice and orange peel all at once; stir just until mixture is evenly moist. Fold in raisins and cranberries. Spoon into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Remove and cool on rack. May use just cranberries instead of raisins.

title: Sourdough Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into oiled 9-inch square pan. Prepare topping.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix well. Bake in Pyrex flat dish for 3/4 of an hour in moderate oven. Use this like date and nut bread. Spread with butter.

title: Black Russian Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat at low speed for 4 minutes. Pour into well greased tube or bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45-50 minutes.

title: Healthy Cookies
instructions: Mix together and cook cookies 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 on a cookie sheet. Eat with milk for all four food groups.

title: Cola Salad
instructions: Empty the jello into a bowl. Add the boiling water; stir until the jello is completely dissolved. Stir in the cola beverage. Chill in the refrigerator or over ice and water until jello mixture is slightly thicker than consistency of thick unbeaten egg white. If chilled in the refrigerator stir occasionally. If chilled over ice and water stir frequently.

title: Chicken And Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Boil hen in water with salt. Debone and reserve stock. Melt butter in pot. Blend in flour gradually with milk. Then add broth and cook on low heat until thick and smooth. Remove from heat and add salad dressing lemon juice and curry powder. Mix well.

title: Lemon Poppy-Seed Muffins
instructions: Combine flour sugar salt baking powder and poppy seed. Add milk lemonade oil and egg whites. Stir until moistened; do not overmix. Coat a 12-muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray or line with muffin cups. Fill each 2/3 full with muffin mixture. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until golden brown.

title: Pain Perdne(Similar To French Toast)
instructions: Beat eggs; add evaporated milk and sugar and beat well. Grease iron skillet with butter/oleo. Dip bread slices in egg mixture and fry in skillet until each side is golden brown. Sprinkle with a little powdered sugar or serve with syrup. Makes 6 large portions.

title: Chile Burgers
instructions: Mix in bowl. Makes 4 patties. Fry to desired doneness. Serve immediately. Serves 4 persons.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Mix 1 can of asparagus grated cheese cream of mushroom soup and diced onion. Spread bread crumbs on top. Pour melted butter over bread crumbs. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Mix until well blended and set aside.

title: Deer Meat(Steak Or Loin)
instructions: You will also need a cast-iron skillet.

title: Spiders
instructions: Melt caramel chips and chocolate chips in top of double boiler. Add Chinese noodles and salted peanuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Cornflake Candy
instructions: Bring sugar and syrup to rolling boil. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter; mix well. Pour over cornflakes; mix well. Drop onto wax paper.

title: Judy'S Shoo-Fly Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and oleo until crumbly. Save 1 1/2 cups for toping. Mix together molasses soda and water. Add crumbs; mix well. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Do not open oven during first 40 minutes.

title: Homemade Biscuits
instructions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and mix. Knead on floured surface. Roll out to desired thickness and cut with biscuit cutter. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Makes 8 big biscuits.

title: Cocoa Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar margarine vanilla and eggs. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Frost with Fudge Frosting if desired. Cut into about 2-inch squares. Makes 16 brownies 160 calories per brownie.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease muffin tins. Sift flour with sugar baking powder and salt. Measure milk in a 2 cup measure. Add oil and egg. Blend well. Make a well in center of flour mixture and pour in milk mixture all at once; stir quickly with a fork just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in blueberries. Dip batter with a 1/4 cup measure not quite full and put into muffin cups. The cups should be slightly more than half full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins are golden brown.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in water until tender. Drain off water. Drain juice from pineapple into small bowl. Put pineapple in with carrots. Put butter in carrots and let melt. Take pineapple juice and add flour heat until lumps are gone. Put in carrots and heat on medium. Cook until slightly thick. Ready to serve.

title: Italian Braised Beef
instructions: Line a large Dutch oven with the strips of bacon. Add the roast and brown on all sides over high heat. Add the remaining ingredients; cover tightly and cook over low heat for 3 1/2 hours or until tender turning occasionally. Serve roast with the pot liquor and buttered pasta. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lavender Punch
instructions: Combine juice of lemon and orange sugar tartaric acid and boiling water. Allow to stand for 24 hours. Add cold water and grape juice. Pour into punch bowl. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Bailey'S Irish Cream
instructions: Mix by wire whisk in order listed; refrigerate.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix flour cornmeal sugar baking powder and salt together. Add eggs milk and oil. Beat just until smooth.(DO NOT OVERBEAT). Pour batter into greased loaf pans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 min.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix sugars and flour together in pan. Beat egg yolks and add half & half. Add this to sugar mixture. Add half stick butter. Cook and stir until thick. Add vanilla and let cool. Pour into 8 inch pie shell and top with meringue.

title: 8-Minute Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar sour cream vanilla and Cool Whip in bowl. Pour into crust and garnish with strawberries.

title: Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill before serving.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pack into an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Irene'S Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Buster Bar Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Mix 1/3 cup butter evaporated milk chocolate chips and powdered sugar in a saucepan. Boil for 8 minutes stirring constantly. Add vanilla and cool. Soften ice cream. Crush oreo cookies and mix with 1/2 Cup melted butter.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cover with cheese. Bake until slightly brown 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Christmas Nut Roll
instructions: Melt marshmallows (add a little water). Cut gum candy raisins cherries and nuts. Add to marshmallows. Add graham cracker crumbs (1 1/2 bags). Form into 2 rolls and roll in remaining graham cracker crumbs. Wrap in wax paper and keep in refrigerator.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a jelly roll pan. Mix together. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Red And Green Spread
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together until smooth. Stir in radishes and onions. Chill several hours to blend flavors. Serve with crackers or party rye bread.

title: Lime Marlowe
instructions: Prepare Jell-O according to package. Add marshmallows while hot. When ready to set blend in cheese (it will look sort of lumpy). Add remaining ingredients; let set. This makes a pretty salad for Christmas.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple and pudding. Add marshmallows nuts and Cool Whip. Mix and store for 3 hours.

title: Surprise Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until stiff. Add sugar gradually. Fold in vanilla crackers and nuts. Pour into two greased pie pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with Cool Whip and topping.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Put fruit in 8-inch square baking dish. Cream the sugar and butter. Combine flavoring and milk and add alternately to creamed mixture with sifted dry ingredients. Pour over fruit. Add Topping.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim fat from meat; cut into strips (2 x 1/4-inch). Heat oil in large skillet. Cook meat in oil turning frequently until brown about 5 minutes. Stir in water onion garlic salt and ginger. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes for round steak 5 to 8 minutes for steak. Add green pepper strips during last 5 minutes of simmering.

title: Scalloped Pineapple(Microwave)
instructions: Drain the pineapple reserving 1/3 cup of juice. Trim crusts from bread and cut into 1-inch cubes. Combine pineapple juice bread and margarine (cut in 1/2-inch pieces).
