Add beaten eggs sugar and cinnamon. Pour mixture into a lightly greased casserole. Cover and microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes or until set. Stir at 3 minute intervals. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies(Makes About 5 Dozen)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixer bowl beat condensed milk peanut butter egg and vanilla until smooth. Add biscuit mix; mix well. Chill at least 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until very lightly browned (do not overbake). Cool. Store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Line baked cooled pie shell with 2 cups of large uncooked berries. Make a sauce of the other 2 cups of berries. Cut up and cook until thick with the sugar water cornstarch and salt. Remove from heat. Add butter and stir well. Cool. Pour over berries in shell. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Spread with whipped cream.

title: Cherry Crisp
instructions: Blend 1 tablespoon biscuit mix with 2 cans of cherry pie filling. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Do not grease.

title: Coffee Can Bread
instructions: You will need two 1 pound coffee cans. Mix 2 cups flour with yeast. Stir water milk butter sugar and salt over low heat until butter melts. Cool 5 minutes. Add to flour and yeast. Add remaining flour and eggs. Dough will be stiff. Knead on floured surface until dough is smooth and elastic. Coat inside of each coffee can with small amount of oil. Divide dough in half; place half in each can. Cover with plastic tops. Let rise in warm place until dough reaches about 1 inch from top. Remove plastic and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 35 minutes. Can substitute molasses for sugar. Can brush outside with honey and sprinkle with slivered almonds after cooking.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except butter. Add buttermilk to have ingredients not too thick. Melt butter in Pyrex dish (oblong). Pour half of melted butter in mixture. Pour in baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 500\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Company Cheesecake
instructions: Add all ingredients together and press into a spring form pan. Set aside.

title: Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Place chicken in a greased 8-inch square baking dish. In a saucepan combine tomato paste water garlic and seasonings; bring to a boil. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until chicken juices run clear. Sprinkle with cheeses; bake 10 minutes longer or until the cheese is melted.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Mix all together and put in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Summer Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Round Steak
instructions: Line the bottom of Dutch oven with bacon strips. Peel and slice 1/2 of onion over bacon. Peel and slice 2 potatoes over onion. Cut steak in cubes and put a layer over potatoes then sprinkle half pack of soup mix on steak. Place remaining onion potatoes and steak then sprinkle with remainder of soup mix. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Vanilla Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening butter sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add milk mix well add flour. Add flavorings mix well and pour into well-greased and floured tube pan. Place in cold oven. Bake 325 \u00b0 for 1 hour 20 mins.

title: Chili Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Cook and stir ground beef in 10-inch skillet until brown. Drain. Stir in onion tomatoes and seasoning mix (dry). Spread in plate. Sprinkle with olives and cheese. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Serve with sour cream shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Rice Chantilly
instructions: Combine rice sour cream salt and cheese. Spread into buttered 1-quart dish. Bake about 5 minutes. Take out and stir. Smooth out mixture. Sprinkle 1/2 cup grated cheese on top. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: In large skillet heat oil; saute green onions until tender. Stir in rice and soy sauce. Cook over low heat 5 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally with a fork. Push rice mixture to side of skillet; stir in eggs and pepper. Cook over low heat 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in peas. Heat thoroughly. Serve with additional soy sauce if desired.

title: Herb Marinated Chicken Breast
instructions: Pour off fat leaving the brown flecks. Save the fat. Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil. Measure into skillet 2 tablespoons of reserved fat for each cup of gravy desired. Blend in equal amounts of flour or use half the amount cornstarch as you would use flour. Stir over low heat until browned.

title: Speedy Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef in frying pan. Add chili and tomato soups. Bring to a simmer. Add salt. Line casserole with half the Fritos. Pour in beef mixture; place remaining Fritos on top. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese is melted about 20 minutes.

title: Favorite Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend and beat at medium speed for 10 minutes. Pour into graham cracker crust. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Hot Tamales
instructions: Combine ground beef onion and taco flavor. Fry well. Add refried beans and mix well.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam chopped broccoli 5 to 10 minutes; set aside. Saute onions in 1/4 cup butter; saute cracker crumbs in 1/4 cup butter. Make sauce of soup mushrooms and cheese. When cheese is melted add garlic onions and almonds. Place cooked broccoli in 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Pour cheese sauce over. Combine sauteed cracker crumbs and almonds and sprinkle over broccoli. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Quick Caramel Cake
instructions: Bake one cake mix according to package directions (your choice which flavor) in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While cake is baking melt 14 ounce package of caramels. Combine with 1 stick margarine and evaporated milk. When cake is done pour caramel mixture on top. You may sprinkle with chocolate chips and pecans if desired.

title: Pineapple Beef Teriyaki
instructions: Heat wok or large skillet. Add 1/4 cup vegetable and beef; cook until just done. Remove meat from wok. Add vegetables and cook until done but still crisp. Return meat to wok and season with soy sauce. Serve over Polynesian fried rice.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix yellow cake mix butter and 1 egg with mixer on medium speed. Press into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Beat sugar sour cream and 2 eggs until smooth and creamy. Pour over mixture in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and stir well. Shape into a 12 x 7-inch loaf; place on a lightly greased rack of broiler pan.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Layer 1/2 cake in bite size pieces in punch bowl then 1/2 prepared pudding 1/2 cherry pie filling 1/2 crushed pineapple 1/2 coconut and 1/2 Cool Whip. Repeat and refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Martha Washington Chocolates
instructions: Mix all ingredients into very stiff dough. Roll into small balls. Let dry on wax paper. Dip in glaze.

title: Fudge
instructions: Spray 9 x 9 x 2 baking dish with nonstick coating. Melt chips milk and honey in saucepan over medium heat until smooth. Remove from stove and stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread in baking dish. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Pizza Hamburgers
instructions: Mix hamburg with salt and pepper; pat out into a 9-inch pie pan. Spread tomatoes over hamburg and sprinkle with the cheese parsley and onion. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Drain. Cut into wedges and serve. (Bake at 375\u00b0 in gas oven 400\u00b0 electric oven.)

title: Beef And Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: *I usually buy the meat by the number of slices I need rather than by the pound.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp. Melt butter over high heat in skillet. Add chopped garlic and juice of lemon to melted butter. Peel 1/2 of lemon and add peeling to butter mixture.

title: Quick Baked Pike Fillets
instructions: For 4 servings you will need

title: Broiled Crab Cakes
instructions: Pick over crabmeat gently and carefully to remove shells and cartilage; do not break up lump meat. Add seasoning lemon juice parsley and eggs; combine gently. Form into medium-size cakes; place in lightly buttered flat pan. Place under broiler; cook until golden brown turning once. Serve with salted crackers. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Melt oleo and mix with sugar and eggs. Add 2 cups self-rising flour. Combine with dissolved yeast mixture and add remaining flour. Drop by spoonfuls into greased muffin pan about 3 tablespoons or No. 16 size scoop into pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remaining batter may be kept several days in refrigerator. Makes 48 rolls.

title: Lentil Tomato Salad
instructions: Rinse lentils and place in a saucepan. Add water salt and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered about 30 to 40 minutes until lentils are just tender. Drain.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Makes 1 gallon powdered mix. Use 1/2 cup of mix per mug or glass of hot water.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix flour sugar milk and flavoring. Pour in butter. Add peaches to mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Eclair Dessert
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers. Make pudding using 3 cups of milk. Mix in Cool Whip. Pour half of mixture over crackers. Then layer more graham crackers and then more pudding. Top with layer of graham crackers. Frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle cheddar cheese on top. Bake 325 until done (25 min.).

title: Speed Snack
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into glass and enjoy.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Bring to a boil the water salt and food coloring. Remove from heat and add flour alum and cooking oil. Mix; let cool. Knead after dough has cooled.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder together 3 times. Beat eggs until light. Beat in sugar 1 cup at a time. Mix in flour. Heat milk to boiling point but do not boil. Put butter in milk to melt. Add flour mixture. Add extracts. Beat a few times. Bake in two 9-inch pans for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spring Breeze Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping; blend well. Spoon into crust. Chill. Garnish.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix and form into small bite size balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed and let cool. Poke holes. Heat pineapple and sugar. Let cool. Top with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger and seasoning mix together. Drain. Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Fiesta Potatoes
instructions: Set oven controls to broil. Spread hot potatoes in ungreased square 8 x 8 x 2 baking dish. Spread with salsa. Sprinkle with olives and cheese. Broil with top 3 to 4 inches from heat until the cheese is melted. Sprinkle with tortilla chips. Serve with the remaining ingredients.

title: Microwave Meat Loaf
instructions: Tear bread into small pieces. Mix with remaining ingredients except beef. Crumble beef into mixture; mix thoroughly. Press into 9 x 5-inch loaf dish. Microwave on High until internal temperature reaches 150\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes. Rotate once or twice if you dont have turn table. Spread on ketchup. Microwave at Medium (50%) until ketchup is heated 2 to 3 minutes. Let stand 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Classic Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine all vegetables and elbows then mayonnaise mixture. If needed add more mayonnaise to keep moist.

title: Grandma'S Grape-Nuts Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs and vanilla. Scald the milk and add to the egg mixture. Add in first 3 ingredients.

title: Freezer Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Peel slice and core apples. Combine sugar flour and spices. Add sliced apples and toss gently. Let stand 30 minutes until the juice begins to flow. Stir in lemon juice; cook over low heat until it begins to thicken. The apples should not be fully cooked. Spoon into 6 to 8-pint freezer containers. Plan on a quart to make a 9-inch pie and follow the oven time and temperature as for fresh apple pie. I bake mine at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. I also top with a crumb topping.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour and 1/2 cup sugar three times. Beat egg whites until frothy. Add salt and cream of tartar. Beat until stiff enough to hold shape. Add vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Then fold in flour and sugar mixture. Fold for 2 minutes. Pour into ungreased tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes. When done invert pan to cool.

title: Quick Jam Cake
instructions: Put the ingredients listed in a large mixing bowl. Blend on low speed of mixer until moistened. Mix at medium speed for about 4 minutes. Pour batter in prepared loaf pan (9 x 13-inch) or medium angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan on rack for 15 minutes. Use Caramel Icing.

title: Dell'S One Relish
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil then simmer for 50 minutes stirring often. Remove spice bag and put in jars and seal.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Mix in remaining ingredients. Put in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel and chop eggplant. Boil in salted water until tender; drain well.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat oil and sugar together. Add beaten eggs and bananas; beat well. Add flour soda baking powder and salt to the first mixture then add milk and vanilla. Beat well and stir in nuts. Bake in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan lined on the bottom with waxed paper in moderate oven (350\u00b0) about 1 hour. Cool well and store airtight.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours before serving. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and bell pepper in oleo. Stir in shrimp and cook until they turn pink. Add seasonings and soup plus 1 can water. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir all of mixture into 2 cups cooked rice and serve.

title: Dove Paprika
instructions: Brown pheasant pieces well in bacon drippings in deep pan. Add water salt pepper bay leaves and garlic (minced). Sprinkle in paprika. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until pheasant is tender; remove pheasant pieces from stock and set out 2 cups of gravy to cool. Mix sour cream slowly with the cooled gravy (to prevent curdling) until smooth then stir into the gravy in pan with cornstarch. Return pheasant pieces to pan and reheat. Serve with egg drop dumplings mashed potatoes or brown rice. Serves 4.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potato flakes with chicken broth. Melt oleo in saucepan; add flour and cook stirring until flour is lightly browned. Slowly stir in milk; keep stirring to make medium white sauce. Add potato broth mixture and diced potatoes. Add garlic powder peppers chives parsley and salt. Lop each serving with grated American cheese and bacon bits.

title: Low-Fat Carrot-Raisin Salad
instructions: In serving bowl combine first 4 ingredients to make a smooth dressing. Add remaining ingredients and mix.

title: Spiced Wieners
instructions: Cut wieners to bite size and put into crock pot. Pour salad dressing over wieners Cook 4 to 5 hours until done.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with 1 to 2 cups Cool Whip or enough for desired consistency. Chill for about 30 minutes in covered dish before serving.

title: 9 Day Cole Slaw
instructions: Pour over cabbage onion and pepper. Mix well. Will keep well when covered in refrigerator.

title: Waverly Cookies
instructions: Line jellyroll pan with crackers (about 42 separated). Melt margarine and butter. Add 1/2 cup sugar and cook 2 minutes. Spread over crackers. Sprinkle 1 cup pecans on top. Cook 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Place on waxed paper at once (they are sticky and cool quickly).

title: Paulette'S Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Soften butter. Add all ingredients and beat until creamy.

title: Jay'S Nacho Dip
instructions: Add taco mix to hamburger and sausage. Add remaining ingredients to saucepan. Heat stirring constantly until cheese melts and is hot. Keep warm in a crock-pot. Eat with taco chips!

title: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients (1/2 of cool whip) well. Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with remaining cool whip. Sprinkle with grated nuts.

title: Amy'S Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in 12 x 9-inch covered casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sold At Auction Ambrosia
instructions: Mix all together. Chill. Serve!

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together rice soup and water. Pour in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle onion soup mix over rice mixture. Place chicken pieces on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Creole Pork Chops(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Brown pork chops on both sides. Sprinkle with rice salt and pepper. Top each with a green pepper ring. Pour tomatoes over chops. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer one hour. Makes 4 servings.

title: Date Pinwheels
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add remaining ingredients and chill. Roll dough out (1/4-inch thick) and top with filling. Roll filling and dough up like jelly roll; chill. Slice and bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Creamed Corn
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and place in a shallow baking dish. Dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until it tests done when a knife is inserted.

title: Chicken And Mushrooms Dijon
instructions: In skillet in 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned. Remove. In additional 1 tablespoon of margarine cook broccoli and mushrooms until tender and liquid is evaporated; stir often. Add soup milk and mustard. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Cover; cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Stir often. Serve with noodles. Serves 4.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in water until soft and drain off remaining water. Add applesauce eggs sweetener and cooking oil and mix well. Bake in 9 x 13 inch pan at 350\u00b0 until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Pour half of cake batter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt margarine caramels and milk over low heat. Pour over cooled cake. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and chopped pecans. Add the rest of the batter and bake 20 minutes longer at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli, Rice And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: African Stew
instructions: Brown beef in skillet then place in stew pot. Add vegetables tomatoes and spices. Cook until tender. Add warm stew juice to the peanut butter. Add mixture to stew pot. Before serving add condensed milk. 1/2 hour prep time. 1 1/4 hours cooking time.

title: Canadian Treat
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13 inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Combine sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip. Add to cooled base. Beat the milk and pudding mixes. Let stand until thick then spread over top of the base. Add the other 1/2 of the Cool Whip and chill until ready to serve.

title: Purple Passion
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Chill overnight.

title: All In One Dinner In Foil
instructions: Get a piece of foil out big enough to seal all ingredients in.

title: Sour Cream Cut-Out Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir soda with whipping cream. Add to sugar mixture. Sift together flour baking powder and nutmeg. Add to sugar mixture. Chill. Roll and cut out. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Baked Beans On Stove
instructions: Mix together in saucepan. Cook for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Stir all together and bake about 30 minutes in oven.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat and pour off grease. Mix meat with onion soup peas salt and pepper. Pour into a casserole dish and top with the mashed potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Candy Bar Cookie Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cut cookie dough in half lengthwise. Cut each half into 12 slices. Set aside.

title: Baked Crabmeat
instructions: Mix and heat thoroughly. Put in ramekins and sprinkle with grated cheese and buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. May be served on toast instead of baked.

title: Vegetable Bars
instructions: Cover bottom of large jelly roll pan (10 x 15-inch) with rolls pressing together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool. Mix together cream cheese salad dressing and dressing mix. Spread on cooled baked roll dough and sprinkle with vegetables and cheese. Press down so they stick. Chill. Cut in very small squares. Enjoy!

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Cook grits until done. Beat eggs slightly. Add cheese eggs and milk; stir until melted and smooth. Place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish; bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Carrot-Banana Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy then add bread and mix well. Add remaining ingredients except carrots and banana. Mix together on low speed for 1 minute. Fold in carrots and banana. Pour mixture into a 7 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan that has been sprayed with a nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook butternut squash and mash (as in mashed potatoes). Add butter skim milk egg whites and cinnamon. Mash everything together. Put in baking dish or Pyrex dish and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix sour cream and soup then pour over hash browns (loose not frozen together) chopped onions and cheese. Toss together then put in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan or oven dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. During last 7 to 10 minutes of baking garnish with onion rings.

title: Burgundy Stew
instructions: Do not brown meat. Mix all ingredients well in Dutch oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 covered for 4 hours. Serve in bowls over rice. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken, Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In a large pot cook chicken. Debone; set aside. In a large skillet over medium heat saut onion celery and broccoli in butter for 5 minutes. Stir in cheese soup and milk until smooth. Place rice in a 11 x 9-inch baking dish. Add chicken on top of rice. Pour mixture in skillet over chicken. DO NOT STIR. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10. Prep time 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Party Punch
instructions: Combine water and sugar. Stir until sugar dissolves. Add orange juice pineapple juice grapefruit juice and bananas. Pour into a container and freeze. Upon serving put frozen mixture in punch bowl and ginger ale and stir to slushy consistency.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and put in pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken thoroughly. Cook rice according to pkg. directions. Chop chicken into fine pieces. Combine chicken rice soups and cheese in large baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. You can also use cream of onion soup instead of one of the other creamy soups if you want.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cut up tomatoes. Chop fine onions peppers and celery. Add other ingredients. Simmer all 2 hours. Process.

title: Rich Quick Cookies
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar in a heavy pan. Add nuts; bring to a boil. Cook for 2 minutes then cover graham crackers with the mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Diabetic Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix pudding gelatin and water in saucepan; stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Remove from heat. Cool in refrigerator until slightly thickened. Arrange strawberries in pie shell. Pour mixture over berries. Chill until set. Serve with whipped topping. Garnish with strawberries. This recipe is scrumptious.

title: Crawfish Casserole
instructions: Saute together butter chopped onion bell pepper onion tops parsley and garlic. Add pimentos mushroom soup and Cheddar soup heating thoroughly. Add crawfish or shrimp and rice. Pour into 12 x 12-inch casserole dish and top with crushed Escort crackers. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: Stir together brown sugar oil and egg. Set aside. Stir together milk baking soda salt vanilla and add to brown sugar mixture alternating with 2 1/2 cup flour. Fold in 1 1/2 cup diced apple (dont peel) and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Pour into tin and sprinkle with melted butter. Bake at 325 for 30 minutes.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant in bite-size pieces. This will take about 2 months. Add water to make brown gravy. Cook over log fire for 4 weeks. This will serve\t3800 people.\tIf more are expected add the 2 rabbits but do this only if absolutely necessary as most people dont like hare in their stew.

title: Hot Tamale Soup
instructions: Heat heavy pan and add first 4 ingredients; cook until beef is browned. Add chili powder cumin cayenne and cinnamon and cook 1 minute. Add broth and tomatoes with juice. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Cocoa Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine until light and fluffy. Sift flour baking powder salt and cocoa together. Mix in margarine until smooth and creamy. Mix in water sweetener cinnamon nutmeg and vanilla extract. Add to flour margarine mixture. Shape into balls. Place on cookie sheet; flatten with fork dipped in water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Yield 24 cookies. Carbohydrate 3.6 g protein .5 g fat 1.1 g calories 30. One cookie = 1/8 bread exchange 1/2 fat exchange.

title: Snowdrops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Whip the egg whites until foamy. Gradually add sugar; continue whipping. Add nuts and chocolate chips. Drop in mounds on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Put in oven and turn off oven. Leave in oven 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Do not open door.

title: Pink Lady Punch
instructions: Two pieces of bread. Add peanut butter and jelly.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Put in unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with remaining coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Slice hard-cooked eggs in half lengthwise. Place yolks in mixing bowl and mix well. Combine powdered mustard salt salad dressing pickle relish and white pepper; mix until smooth. Fill each cavity of egg white with yolk mixture. Mound up slightly. Sprinkle with paprika and garnish with fine chopped parsley.

title: Highland Cookies
instructions: Combine vinegar and milk and set aside. Combine sugar and butter. Add eggs. Sift together flour baking powder salt and soda. Add alternately with milk and flavoring to the sugar and butter mixture. Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Puddle Cake
instructions: Stir with a spoon. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until toothpick inserted into the cake comes out cleanly. A good eggless cake eaten plain or dust with powdered sugar or top with frosting as desired.

title: Date Loaf
instructions: Soak together the dates bicarbonate of soda and the boiling water. Cream margarine and sugar; beat in egg. Mix in flour and baking powder. Add drained date mixture and stir well. (Use liquid from date mixture until desired consistency.)

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix together squash onions sour cream and soup. In separate bowl mix melted margarine and herb stuffing. Place 1/2 in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spread squash mixture over stuffing. Sprinkle remaining stuffing over squash. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: No Knead Rolls
instructions: Blend together milk Crisco sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm by adding water. Add yeast and mix well. Add egg. Add flour gradually mixing until dough is well blended. Place in greased bowl. Brush top with melted shortening and allow to rise until light. Knead dough a few times to make smooth ball. Form into desired shapes and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 25 minutes or until brown. Easy and very tasty.

title: Oreo Cookie And Cream Surprise
instructions: Crumb Mixture Crush cookies in a food processor or very fine by hand. Set aside.

title: Ginger Tea Punch
instructions: Place tea bags and ginger in a tea pot. Add 4 1/2 cups boiling water. Cover; let steep 3 to 5 minutes or until desired strength. Remove tea bags. Stir in sugar. Cool at room temperature 2 hours. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
instructions: Mix lime juice and onion. Let stand for 30 minutes. Mix ketchup cilantro and shrimp. Combine all and add as much salt and hot sauce as you like. Chill and serve.

title: Catfish House Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil or boil until tomatoes are light green. Do not continue to boil. Gently stir a couple of times and seal in hot jars.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Take out of oven and poke holes in the cake with a wooden spoon. Pour milk in holes then ice cream topping. Frost with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with crushed candy bars. Refrigerate.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

title: Beth'S Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add warm milk and mix. Microwave until thick or cook conventionally until boiling and thick.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Dice squash and onion; cook in a little water with salt pepper and butter on low for 15 minutes. Drain water; add sour cream and undiluted soup. Add 1/2 cup butter to stuffing. Add one-half of stuffing mixture to squash mixture reserving one-half for top. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch casserole and sprinkle with remaining stuffing. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp-Spinach Crepe Stack
instructions: Prepare Creamed Spinach; set aside. Heat oil in medium skillet over medium heat; add onion and garlic. Cook stirring occasionally until onion is tender. Add mushrooms; cook until mushrooms are tender. Continue cooking until moisture has evaporated. Stir in Creamed Spinach shrimp lemon juice tarragon salt and pepper. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Frozen Walnut Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese salt mayonnaise and lemon juice. Add pineapple bananas walnuts and cherries. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in pan or mold. Freeze until firm. We always have this at Christmas.

title: Salmon Mousse
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add boiling water and mix. Add celery cucumber carrot pepper parsley and dill. Mix in mayo heavy cream salt and salmon. Mix well and chill overnight. I use a fish mold.

title: Wilted Lettuce Dressing
instructions: Remove bacon from pan and break into small pieces. Add to hot fat the vinegar mustard (prepared) and mashed egg yolk. Blend well. Add bacon.

title: No Beef Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix the pork sausage venison hamburger and egg. Season with the chopped celery onion crushed sage and salt and pepper. Put in 9-inch bread pan. Cover with catsup. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal-Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs milk and vanilla. Add applesauce; add sifted ingredients oats and raisins. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandma'S Homemade Ice Cream Mixture
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a large pan. Bring to a full boil. After it cools down a bit you may add fresh fruit of your choice or frozen fruit. Just dont get too much syrup in the mix.

title: No Guilt Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Over very low heat melt chocolate. Cool slightly. In food processor puree all ingredients except powdered sugar and chocolate. Blend well. Add melted chocolate and mix well. Pour into lightly greased 8-inch square pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until just set. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into squares. Makes 16 squares.

title: Homemade Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Boil carrots cook and drain ground beef. Use large kettle; add tomato sauce soup chopped onions and green beans. After rolling out half of crescent rolls place in bottom of casserole dish. Pour mixture from kettle into casserole dish; lay cheese on top and the rest of rolled out crescent rolls. Place in oven and bake approximately 30 minutes.

title: Hot Hamburger And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain rice. Add rice drained tomatoes and sour cream. Season to taste. Mix well. Pour into greased casserole. Spread cheese evenly over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Mix in milk and vanilla; add flour and nuts and mix well. Chill dough thoroughly; form into balls about 1-inch in diameter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet; cool. Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Chic'S Speciality Almond Butter Crunch
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan. Add sugar corn syrup and water. Cook stirring occasionally to hard-crack stage (300\u00b0). Immediately spread on ungreased cookie sheet or 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan. Cool thoroughly. Turn out on waxed paper. Spread with chocolate and sprinkle with half of finely chopped nuts. Set aside until chocolate is well set. If necessary chill to set chocolate. Turn and coat other side with chocolate and nuts. Break into pieces when cooled and dry.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Place pecans in unbaked pie shell. Mix eggs sugar salt vanilla margarine and corn syrup. Pour over pecans. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Fresh Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind and mix cranberries orange and sugar then let set. Mix strawberry Jell-O orange Jell-O hot water cold water and sugar. Put in refrigerator until it starts to jell then mix everything together and let set overnight.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Sweet and Sour Sauce and parsley; shape into 20 meatballs and place in baking pan. Bake meatballs in preheated 350 degree oven until browned and no longer pink in center about 20 minutes. Arrange meatballs in serving dish; pour hot Sweet and Sour Sauce over meatballs and sprinkle with parsley. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan combine the sugar cocoa salt and water. Add evaporated milk and bring to boil. Boil 4 to 5 minutes until thickened. Remove from heat and add margarine and vanilla.

title: Glazed Fruit Dessert(Serves 6)
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine pudding and pineapple juice. Stir until thickened. Fold in oranges pineapple and bananas. Refrigerate until serving. Garnish with a dollop of whipped topping.

title: Surprise Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients; press into 8 x 10-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool.

title: Layer Dinner Casserole
instructions: Place in a buttered casserole the chopped onions celery potatoes and ground beef. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour tomato juice over top and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Cream Filled Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and brown sugar. Add eggs. Combine flour soda and cinnamon; add to mixture. Stir in oats. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on waxed paper.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Cook in double boiler or crock-pot for 1 hour all ingredients except broccoli. Add the broccoli. Use as dip for crackers or nachos.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in sugar corn syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil without stirring 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popped corn. Mix well. Turn into 2 large cookie sheets. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool completely. Break apart.

title: Stained Glass Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and oleo in double boiler then cool. Pour chocolate mixture over marshmallows. Mix until all coated. Stir in nuts. Sprinkle with coconut and roll with mix. Prepare four (12-inch) strips of foil; roll mix in foil and refrigerate overnight. Makes 4 logs of candy.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
instructions: In a large saucepan on the conventional range top surface unit bring 6 cups of water and 1 teaspoon of salt to boiling point. Add 8 cabbage leaves; simmer about 2 or 3 minutes just long enough to make leaves pliable. Drain leaves on paper towels. Cook beef in a glass utility dish using microwave for 4 minutes. Mix together lightly in a medium-size mixing bowl ground beef cooked rice minced onion egg and poultry seasoning. Form meat mixture into 16 even balls. Cut the core out of the cabbage leaf. Fill the center of each cabbage leaf with 2 meat balls. Fold 2 sides of leaf over meat balls and roll up leaves from the end. Arrange cabbage rolls seam side down in a 2-quart glass utility dish. Combine tomato sauce brown sugar water and lemon juice or vinegar together in 2-cup glass measuring cup or small mixing bowl. Pour over cabbage rolls. Place wax paper over dish. Cook with microwave 10 minutes. Allow cabbage rolls to stand 10 minutes with covering before serving. Recipe yields 8 servings.

title: Ranch Potatoes
instructions: Microwave or cook the 2 cans of potatoes in a saucepan until completely warm. Add Ranch dressing. Cook again until warm. Add the bacon bits and shredded cheese. Cook for 2 minutes until the cheese is melted.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa milk butter salt and vanilla in medium saucepan. Bring to boil. Boil 5 minutes. Stir in oatmeal peanut butter and nuts. Drop stacks on wax paper. Let stand until cool.

title: Orange Sugar Pecans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook until soft ball stage. Add 1 pound shelled pecans; stir until it begins to sugar. Pour out on wax paper and break apart.

title: Fritter Batter For Deep Frying
instructions: Combine eggs milk and butter in bowl. Mix well. Add flour salt and sugar. Stir just until moistened. Use for coating vegetables onion rings fish and chicken for deep frying.

title: Easy Yeast Rolls
instructions: Melt shortening; add sugar. Add enough flour to thicken like gravy. Mix in dissolved yeast; add flour until dough is quite firm. Use more flour if needed or less. Cover and let stand about 15 minutes. Roll out and cut with rim of small glass. Fold circle over and dip in melted butter. Put on greased baking sheet. Place in cold oven and turn on to 400\u00b0 and bake about 15 minutes until light brown.

title: No Bake Cherry Confetti Pie
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients; stir in pie filling. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon ingredients into baked pie shells. Chill 1 hour before serving. Yields 2 pies. (Another good easy company dessert!)

title: Eclair Delights
instructions: Mix pudding with 3 cups milk until thick then add Cool Whip and vanilla. Put a layer of graham crackers on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan then half of pudding mixture another layer of graham crackers and rest of pudding mixture.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan or casserole dish. Line pan with chicken breasts. Top this with layer of ham then Swiss cheese. Combine soup and water; spread over cheese layer. Sprinkle stuffing over soup mixture. (May also sprinkle packet of herbs and seasonings if with stuffing.) Melt margarine and pour on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cover with foil for about the first 45 minutes then uncover to brown.

title: Bierocks
instructions: Brown ground beef or pork and onion in oven. Add cabbage. Cover and cook in oven 7 to 8 minutes. Add cheese and seasonings and mix well.

title: Pockets Of Pizza
instructions: Unroll refrigerated pizza crust. Press out to a 15 x 10-inch rectangle. Cut into four pieces. Top one side of dough with shredded Mozzarella cheese along with your favorite pizza toppings. Fold dough over filling. Pinch and seal edges. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spritzgeback(Butter Nut Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter cookie sheet. Whip butter and sugar together until well blended. Add vanilla egg yolks and rum. Add flour and ground almonds blending gently with spatula. Fill pastry bag with dough and form small circular shapes approximately 2-inches apart on the cookie sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Check after 10 minutes. Makes 40 cookies.

title: Skillet Bacon-Onion Biscuits
instructions: Combine eggs and tomato juice or milk in mixing bowl. Sift dry ingredients into bowl and beat until well blended. Drop by spoonfuls into hot well-greased skillet. Sprinkle top of each biscuit with chopped onion and bacon. Cook over moderate heat about 5 minutes until lightly browned on one side. Turn and brown other side. Makes 8 to 12.

title: Cold Water Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream butter and eggs together. Sift all dry ingredients together; slowly add dry ingredients to creamed butter and eggs. Add 1 cup cold water and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Picnic Wheel Meat Patties
instructions: Boil onions until tender; drain thoroughly. Force through sieve. Combine onions with meat parsley crumbs egg cheese and seasonings. Shape into 48 small patties. Pan-fry in shallow hot oil; drain on absorbent paper. Do not pack for the picnic until thoroughly cold. Serves 8.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli omitting salt. Drain well. Place broccoli in baking dish. Stir together soup and cheese. Add milk and egg. Pour over broccoli. Combine herb dressing and butter. Sprinkle over soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crumbs are brown.

title: Amandel Brood(Almond Bread)
instructions: Soak cereal in milk for 1 hour. Mix together with rest of ingredients.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Bring sugar vinegar water and mustard to a boil and cool.

title: Chocolate Crunch Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add beaten eggs. Gradually add the flour; dissolve soda in hot water and add with vanilla to dough. Fold in the nuts and chocolate bits. Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken Supreme Dijon
instructions: In large skillet cook chicken in butter. Remove to heated platter. Keep warm. To drippings in pan add garlic onion and mushrooms. Cook stirring until onion is tender. Stir in mustard and heavy cream. Simmer stirring until sauce is slightly thickened. Add chicken turning to coat in sauce. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls(Makes 75 Appetizers.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients until dough sticks together. Roll in 1 1/2-inch balls. Bake about 25 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm on toothpicks.

title: Tamale Loaf
instructions: Brown onions in butter and oil. Add corn tomatoes and olives; cook 15 minutes. Do not drain. Add eggs milk and meal and cook 15 minutes stirring constantly. Add all remaining ingredients and pour into a greased casserole. Bake and garnish with whole ripe olives. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Corn Spoon Bread Casserole
instructions: Combine eggs muffin mix cream-style corn whole kernel corn sour cream and butter. Blend well. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Put grated cheese on top and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Strawberry Soup
instructions: In food processor puree the strawberries. Add cider or apple juice cinnamon honey sugar and nutmeg. Just prior to serving whisk in cream and wine. Serve in chilled glass bowls. Garnish with strawberry slices and sour cream.

title: Missouri Venison Stew
instructions: Remove sinews and bones from venison; cut meat into bite-size pieces and roll in flour. Brown in hot bacon fat in deep kettle. Add hot water wine herbs onions and salt and pepper. Cover pot and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 2 hours. Add carrots and potatoes. Cover and simmer 1 hour adding more hot water if needed. When meat is tender and vegetables done serve hot. Serves 6.

title: No Bake Strawberry Or Blackberry Icebox Pie
instructions: Clean berries. Set aside. In bowl mix condensed milk and lemon juice. After well blended add berries (strawberries sliced and blackberries whole). Put in baked pie shell. Pour whipped whip cream on top of pie. Refrigerate.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Combine pineapple juice sherbet and 1/2 of ice cream. Beat until smooth. Add 7-Up. Spoon remaining ice cream into punch. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar syrup butter and salt. Put over medium heat and cook until dissolved. While this is cooking beat eggs until they foam. Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast with warm water; let sit. Mix egg sugar shortening flour and hot water. Add yeast mixture. Add flour; work dough. Brush top with oil; cover with cloth. Let rise until double in size. After dough rises may refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Drop by teaspoon and flatten in desired. Notice no flour in this recipe. Great taste.

title: Marshmallow Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes until tender remove skins and mash. Add butter milk salt cinnamon or nutmeg and paprika. Beat until free from\tlumps and light and fluffy.\tFold in walnuts. Turn into a greased casserole cover with marshmallows and bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) until mixture is heated through and marshmallows are brown. Serves 8.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook green beans as directed on package. Drain well. Make a paste of the flour and butter adding the salt sugar and onion. Add the sour cream and cheese. Gently fold in green beans and spoon into casserole. Cover with corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Health Bread
instructions: Boil and cool the raisins and water. Mix well and bake in a small loaf pan 3/4 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar oleo and milk rapidly for 8 minutes. Remove from heat. Add chocolate chips Marshmallow Creme and nuts. Fold until melted. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Tomato, Onion And Zucchini Salad
instructions: Place alternating slices of tomatoes zucchini and onion on serving platter. Sprinkle with herbs. Whisk together oil and vinegar and pour over salad. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours but not more than 4 hours.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill 3 hours; serve. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix and drop by 1/2 teaspoon in deep fryer.

title: Work Person'S Roast
instructions: Place roast in center of large sheet of foil. Cut slits in roast and insert garlic. Pour mushroom soup over top then pour Worcestershire sauce over soup. Sprinkle dry soup mix over top and season with salt and pepper to taste. Add meat tenderizer according to cut of meat. Pull foil up and seal lightly leaving space around roast. Put roast in cake pan and put in oven at 250\u00b0 from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Crock-pot can be used and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Layered Peppermint Pie
instructions: Layer 13 cookies in bottom of an 8-inch spring-form pan. Combine milk and water with electric mixer; beat in pudding mix until blended. Chill 5 minutes. Stir in the 3/4 cup crushed candy. Beat cream until stiff. Reserve 1/2 cup for garnish. Fold remaining whipped cream into pudding mixture. Pour half of mixture over cookies; repeat layers. Garnish with whipped cream and candies. Cover and chill at least 4 hours. Serves 12.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut up fruit. Keep in the refrigerator at all times for the family to eat. It is wonderful. Just keep on adding cut-up fruit.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a large saucepan add margarine oil cocoa and water. Bring to a boil stirring as not to scorch. Take from heat and pour in sugar sifted with plain flour and stir. Add buttermilk with 1 teaspoon soda stirred in. Add beaten eggs cinnamon vanilla and salt. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased oblong pan. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Mexican Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine vegetables. Combine salt pepper vinegar oil and pickles. Mix well. Pour over vegetables. Toss lightly. Can be served on lettuce. Serves 8 to 10.

title: German Molasses Cakesor Sho-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients and take out 1 cup of batter (set aside for topping).

title: Cara And Megan'S Flat Bread
instructions: Thaw bread dough according to package directions on a lightly greased baking sheet. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Press thawed dough into a rectangle about 8 x 16-inch. Prick top of bread with a fork. Brush with oil. Sprinkle to taste with salt and thyme. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until golden. Serve warm.

title: Green Pepper Jelly
instructions: Put red pepper and green pepper and a little vinegar in blender and blend. Pour into a saucepan and add the rest of the vinegar and the sugar. Bring to a fast boil. Add Certo and stir one minute. Bring to boil again and skim foam. Boil for 1 more minute and add food coloring. Remove from heat and cool. Put in jars and seal. Serve over cream cheese with crackers.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish and cover each piece with a slice of cheese. Spread soup over cheese and stuffing mix over soup. Pour melted butter over stuffing. Bake at 325\u00b0 approximately 45 minutes or until done.

title: Church Baked Beans
instructions: Drain cup of liquid off pork and beans. Chop onions and mix along with all other ingredients to beans. Mix well. Add strips of bacon to top of beans.

title: Chocolate Fudge Squares
instructions: Mix as usual (no liquid). Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take out of oven. *Pour marshmallows over hot cake layer and top with Fudge made as follows

title: Spiral Mix
instructions: Mix all together and chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Pudding
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Crumble sausage into a large saucepan. Cook over medium-low heat. Add onion. Cook and stir until transparent. Drain discarding all but 2 tablespoons of drippings. Stir in flour. Cook over medium-low heat about 6 minutes or until mixture bubbles and turns golden. Stir in milk. Add seasonings. Cook and stir until thickened.

title: The Best Of The Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruitcake Cookies(Very Good)
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs together. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Mix chopped fruits and nuts in (after they have been dredged in flour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Turkey And Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and mushrooms. Cook 2 minutes until onion is translucent. Add water and broth. Stir in rice mix and seasoning packet; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until rice is tender. Add sherry and boil for 1 minute then add turkey. Reduce heat to low. Mix cream and egg yolk. Stir in a few spoonfuls of soup. Add mixture to soup in saucepan in a slow steady stream stirring constantly. Cook only until slightly thickened and hot; do not boil! Makes 4 servings.

title: Hummus Bi Tahini
instructions: Put all ingredients into a food processor with a metal blade. Process to make a smooth paste. Add additional liquid if needed. Serve in bowl with pita wedges.

title: Chocolate Mountains
instructions: Cream shortening and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour salt and baking powder; add alternately with milk to the creamed mixture. Add melted chocolate and melted additional fat. Add nuts. Drop from a teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Top with candied cherries. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 10 dozen.

title: Easy Sweet Bread
instructions: Combine these ingredients and add to yeast mixture. Divide into 4 well-greased loaf pans. Dough will be sticky. After bread rises brush with egg wash (1 egg beaten 1 tablespoon milk) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn out of pan and cool.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Combine fruit with sugar juice and all. Cook 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Add Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Pour into jars. Either refrigerate or freeze.

title: Coffee Liqueur
instructions: Boil water and mix in sugar and coffee. Cool liquid and add brandy. Pour liquid into a jar. Drop in the vanilla bean. Seal and let it stand for at least 30 days.

title: Lemon Cake-Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour and butter. Add lemon juice lemon rind egg yolks and milk. Mix. Fold in egg whites. Pour into greased casserole (Pyrex). Bake in pan of hot water at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. When done dessert will have custard on bottom and sponge cake on top. (Use whipped cream or Cool Whip on top when served if you like.) Serves 8.

title: Crazy Peach Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar buttermilk salt and baking soda. Pour over melted margarine in a large baking pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Pour fruit over top juice and all (do not mix.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown and solid.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread the bean dip on a large platter. Spread the guacamole dip over beans. Mix the sour cream and mayonnaise. Add the taco seasoning mix. Spread this mixture as the next layer. Refrigerate for a few hours and it will become firm. Right before serving top with a layer of chopped black olives chopped tomatoes and cover with sharp Cheddar cheese. Serve with Fritos and taco chips.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Put asparagus into 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Add 1/2 cup bread crumbs and half of cheese on top. Pour diluted warmed mushroom soup over this. Do not stir. Pour peas and then add remainder of cheese in next layer. Then add remaining bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 20 minutes.

title: Wendy'S Easy Pot Pie
instructions: Cook chicken. Cool and chop. Mix chicken with cream of celery and cream of chicken soups and the Veg-All. Put mixture into pie crust. (I use Pillsbury pie crust that comes 2 to a box in the dairy section.) Put other pie crust on top. Pinch crust together. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain all vegetables and pimento for 1 hour. Bring sugar vinegar and oil to a boil. Pour sauce over vegetables and store in refrigerator overnight with a tight lid. Take out next day and drain sauce.

title: Surprise Cake
instructions: Mix Jell-O and pie filling together; set aside. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place miniature marshmallows in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix as per directions. Spread the mixed cake dough over marshmallows. Spoon Jell-O and fruit mixture over cake dough in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Homemade Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Pumpkin Wash and clean inside. Slice it up and peel it. Drop into boiling salty water. Cook until tender. Drain it and mash it.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in order listed. Cook and stir until sauce comes to a full boil. Pour into a bowl to use with appetizers.

title: Amish Pineapple
instructions: Pour half and half over bread crumbs and let stand. Cream butter and sugar together; beat in eggs. Fold in a large can pineapple. Add bread cubes soaked in half and half. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients together into bowl. Add shortening milk and peanut butter. Beat 2 minutes. Add milk and eggs. Beat 2 minutes more. Pour cake mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or two 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan or 30 to 35 minutes in layer pans.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Add flour baking soda salt cinnamon baking powder oil and zucchini; mix well. Add 1 cup of chopped nuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 50 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chocolate Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine Crisco and sugar until fluffy. Add egg yolks and beat well. Sift flour and cocoa together and add alternately with buttermilk (to which you have added soda and vanilla). After mixing well fold in coconut and beaten egg whites. Pour into 3 greased floured and wax paper lined 9-inch cake pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Cake will fall slightly when cool.

title: Garlic-N-Herb Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Pour oil in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Add garlic stirring to coat. Heat pan in oven for 5 minutes. Add rosemary and potatoes to pan stirring to coat.

title: Coconut Icebox Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake cake mix according to package directions using a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix the sugar and milk and bring to a boil. Stir in 1 package coconut and then pour over the cake while its still hot. Cover cake tightly until cool. When cool spread whipped topping over cake and sprinkle with other package of coconut. Cover tightly and refrigerate.

title: Apricot Melon Cooler
instructions: Remove seeds and rind from melon. Cut into pieces enough to make one cup. Set aside. Pour the nectar lemon juice and dash of salt into electric blender container. Cover and turn on motor gradually adding melon pieces. Add in order the ice cubes and the lemon sherbet. Blend until thoroughly mixed. Serve immediately.

title: Garlic Butter(3 Pound Recipe)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl. Mix thoroughly until whipped smooth. Put into container and refrigerate. Use as needed.

title: Chili Bean Casserole
instructions: Butter large casserole and line with crushed corn chips. Heat chili and beans. Alternate layers of beans chili onion corn chips and cheese. Top with cheese. Bake in a moderate oven for about 15 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Grandmommie'S Italian Meat Balls
instructions: Mix everything together and shape into balls. Use your \special\ sauce.

title: Pork Sauce
instructions: Boil all ingredients for 45 minutes and then strain. Makes one gallon.

title: Upside Down Cherry Pie
instructions: Melt butter in loaf pan. Blend flour sugar and baking powder in bowl. Blend eggs in milk and make batter of flour and sugar mixture. Pour batter in loaf pan with butter then add the can of cherry pie filling and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in crust comes out dry. Serve in the loaf pan to be dipped into bowls.

title: Sausage Pitas
instructions: Saute onions and peppers in 2 tablespoons butter; add kielbasa cut in 1/4-inch slices and the drained sauerkraut. Heat. Mix in sour cream and mustard. Heat through but do not boil. Serve in pita pockets.

title: Oriental Salad
instructions: Mix vinegar sugar dressing and flavor packets from noodles together microwave for 30 seconds and refrigerate. Crush noodles and mix with slaw mix sunflower seeds and broccoli in a large bowl. Pour liquid over salad mix and refrigerate. Serve cold.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat eggs at high speed until thick about 5 minutes. Gradually add sugar beating until mixture is light and fluffy. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to batter with vanilla and beat at low speed until smooth. In a saucepan heat milk and butter just until butter melts stirring occasionally. Add to batter beating until combined. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Cornbread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except black-eyed peas and grated cheese. Add the black-eyed peas and grated cheese and pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Snap Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix beans and corn in casserole dish. Mix soup cream cheese salt and pepper and pour on top of bean mixture spreading evenly. Mix melted butter and crushed crackers and spread on the top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake brownie mix according to package directions. While hot prick top with fork or toothpick. Pour Kahlua over top and cool. Break brownies into pieces. Make mousse according to package directions. Crush Heath bars. Layer brownie pieces mousse and Heath bars. Save some mousse for topping. You may be able to get 2 to 3 layers. Top with whipped cream and crushed Heath bars. Serve in crystal or fancy bowl. Refrigerate overnight. Keeps 4 to 5 days (if it lasts that long).

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with mixer. Pour into the freezer can. Finish filling the freezer can with milk and then freeze.

title: Shredded Wheat Bread
instructions: Pour hot water over Shredded Wheat; add molasses salt and shortening. Let cool. Add yeast mixture; let rise. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Knead and let rise twice in size. Put in pans; let rise. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mari Lynn'S Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Combine meat egg 1/2 of onion green pepper and crackers. Mix well. Line 1 1/2-quart casserole with mixture pressing evenly over bottom and\tup sides. Combine 2/3 cup water and margarine. Heat until margarine melts.\tAdd stuffing mix and other half of onion and celery. Mix well. Spoon into center of\tcasserole. Spoon soup over top. Bake uncovered in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour. Makes 4 to 5 servings. Good!

title: French Toast Casserole
instructions: Layer 1/2 of bread cubes in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Cube cream cheese and place over bread. Layer remaining 1/2 of bread cubes. Beat eggs milk and syrup. Pour over cheese and bread. Refrigerate overnight covered. Cook next morning at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Excellent for Christmas morning breakfast. Warm syrup and serve over casserole.

title: Quick Pizza Sauce
instructions: Cook all the ingredients together about 1/2 hour over slow heat. Add 1/4 cup grated Italian Parmesan cheese and use on any pizza dough.

title: Spicy Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute onion green pepper celery and garlic in butter in a Dutch oven until tender. Stir in tomatoes tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce oregano thyme and red pepper. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally about 15 minutes or until desired consistency. Stir in shrimp and simmer over medium heat 5 to 10 minutes or until shrimp is done. Serve over rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Square Bars
instructions: Combine flour sugar salt cinnamon and soda. Add pumpkin oil and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating after each one. Mix together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in a greased and floured jelly roll pan.

title: Michelle'S Cookie Recipe
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Place dough on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 7 to 10 minutes. Take cookies out while they are still gooey. If overbaked cookies will be hard in the morning.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Beat in sugar and vanilla. Sift together flour and baking powder. Stir into egg mixture. Mix in walnuts and dates. Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 until top has dull crust.

title: Hungry Jack Best Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients and heat until bubbly. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Cut biscuits in half and form half circles. Place cut side down around edge of dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Plum Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Start mixture; add oil sugar plum baby food vanilla and eggs one at a time. Combine flour and spices and add to first mixture. Add nuts. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken
instructions: In skillet in hot oil cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat. Combine soup and milk; stir in lemon juice and pepper. Pour over chicken. Top each chicken piece with lemon slice. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender stirring occasionally. Yields 4 servings.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Mix candy butter and pecans together; heat until melted. Combine rest of mix together. Fold in candy mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Butterscotch Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts in top of double boiler. Place over simmering water and stir until smooth. Add nuts and mix. Spread candy quickly in 9 x 5-inch dish. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Bacon Cheese Dogs
instructions: Cut halfway through the hot dog slices. Place cheese slice in each; wrap with 1/2 slice bacon. Secure with toothpick. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese melts and browns.

title: Salmon Patty Cakes
instructions: Save salmon juice; remove most of the bones. Scramble eggs well. Put the salmon in bowl with onion bread crumbs and parsley flakes. Mix well. If dry pour a little juice from the salmon into mix. Make small patties (about 8). Fry 10 pieces of fat back meat; save grease. Fry 4 cakes at a time until golden brown. Eat it by itself or serve over rice or make sandwich. Makes about 8 cakes.

title: Ed'S Delicious Quick-Beans
instructions: Note These beans will come out best if boiled in a ceramic or stoneware beanpot but if you dont have one just use a deep casserole dish with lid.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Add soups. Brown the Tater Tots in the oven. Pour sausage soup and cheese in casserole dish. Layer Tater Tots on top; cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Grease dish with spray Pam. Pour the first 4 ingredients into dish. Top with bacon cut up. Cook for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Great with ham.

title: English Muffin Bread
instructions: Pour scalded milk and oils over dry ingredients; stir together. Knead and let rise. Knead and let rise again. Knead and put in pans. Pam the loaf; dust with corn meal. Put Pam in bread pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sweet Corn For Freezer
instructions: Bring all to a boil. Cool well and put into freezer bags. This is very good and tastes like fresh corn.

title: Mom'S Meatloaf
instructions: Mix together the first three ingredients. Add desired amount of milk for proper consistency (approximately 1/4 cup milk). Top with ketchup and brown sugar if desired. Bake for one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cream butter and sugar. Blend in egg milk and flavoring. Blend in dry ingredients. Chill in refrigerator 2 hours. Roll 1/8 inch thick on a lightly floured board. Cut into shapes with floured cookie cutter. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in a moderate 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put in a casserole. Add slivered almonds. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise vinegar salt and pepper. Mix this with other ingredients. Chill and serve.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix together and microwave. Serve with crackers.

title: Boeuf Bourguignon
instructions: Brown meat. Put into casserole. Make gravy. Can add bouillon cubes for flavor. Pour over meat and add Burgundy wine. Put in oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. One hour before serving add mushrooms and some more Burgundy wine. Serve over rice or wide noodles.

title: Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Sift flour and then measure. Cream butter and sugar (a long time for finer texture). Add eggs one at a time. Add milk and flour alternately beginning and ending with flour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Test for doneness. Bake in Bundt or tube pan.

title: America'S Favorite Pot Roast
instructions: Trim all excess fat from roast brown if using chuck or another highly marbled cut. Combine flour salt and pepper. Coal meat with the flour mixture. Place all vegetables except mushrooms in crock-pot and top with roast (cut roast in half if necessary to fit easily). Spread mushrooms evenly over top of roast. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 to 10 hours. If desired turn to high setting during last hour to soften vegetables and make a gravy. To thicken gravy make a smooth paste of the 3 tablespoons flour and the water and stir into crock-pot. Season to taste before serving.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as instructed on back of box. Grease 14 x 18-inch cookie sheet. Pour in cake mixture. Bake as directed until fork comes out clean.

title: Indian Chicken
instructions: Note Small amounts of chopped parsley onion celery and green pepper are good.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
instructions: Cook flour and milk until thick; let cool. Cream 10x sugar Crisco margarine and vanilla together then mix with cooled ingredients and beat 10 minutes. Refrigerate. Good on top of yellow cake with strawberries.

title: Ziti With Sausage And Cream Sauce
instructions: Heat butter and oil in large frying pan. Add onion and saute for 2 minutes. Add sausage and cook crumbling with fork for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Reduce heat to low and add cream salt and pepper. Continue to cook stirring constantly until sauce thickens; do not boil.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
instructions: Place peaches in crust. Combine 1 cup sugar. 1/3 cup flour and salt. Add eggs and sour cream stirring until well blended. Spoon over peaches. Combine sugar and 1/2 cup flour; cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle over pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or golden brown. Us sliced peach to garnish.

title: Veggie Squares
instructions: Press crescent rolls into jelly roll pan. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix the Miracle Whip cream cheese and Ranch dressing. Spread on top of cooled rolls. Top with any combination of chopped veggies. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice enough cucumbers to make 1 gallon. Soak cucumbers and onions in salt water and ice cubes for 1 hour. Mix remaining ingredients. Drain cucumbers and onions; add to the mixture. After boiling for 1 minute put in jars and seal. Makes 5 to 6 pints.

title: Salmon Pate
instructions: Make sure salmon is free of bones and skin. Put cooked salmon and the rest of the ingredients into a food processor. Process until well mixed. Refrigerate. Serve as a cracker spread or as a sandwich.

title: Honey Mustard Dip For Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Mix together and use.

title: No Cook Fudge
instructions: In saucepan melt butter and peanut butter. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Mix well and spread into a 9-inch square pan. Let set until firm; cut and serve.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cook raisins and dates in water. Cook until water is gone. Mix raisins dates eggs applesauce and oil. Add nuts and mix rest of ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan or stem pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Banana Brunch Punch
instructions: In a blender or food processor blend bananas orange juice and lemonade until smooth. Remove half of the mixture and set aside. Add 1 1/4 cups of warm water and 1 cup sugar to mixture in blender; blend until smooth. Place in a large freezer container. Repeat with remaining banana mixture water and sugar; add to container. Cover and freeze until solid. One hour before serving take punch base out of freezer. Just before serving place in a large punch bowl. Add pineapple juice and soda; stir until well blended. Garnish with orange slices if desired. Yields 16 to 20 servings (3 quarts).

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken 20 to 25 minutes. Peel skin off. Pick chicken off bone and chop up. Dip tortillas in water from boiled chicken. Line in bowl or a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix onions cheese tomatoes chili powder and garlic salt. Layer chicken on tortillas. Pour mixture over chicken. Mix 2 cans of soups together and spread over top of chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Williamsburg Inn Honey Sauce
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and boil 3 minutes; cool then add next 4 ingredients. Pour over fresh fruit.

title: Kiwi And Grape Rice Pudding
instructions: Put milk and sugar in a saucepan and heat until small bubbles form around pans edge. Stir in rice and cook covered over lowheat about 45 minutes or until rice is tender and most of the milk is absorbed. Stir in vanilla kiwi and grapes. Put into dessert glasses garnish with kiwi and serve warm.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry for pie. In medium pan cook and stir meat until brown. Drain off fat. Stir in oregano salt pepper crumbs 1/2 cup tomato sauce onion and green pepper. Turn into pie crust. Spread cheese topping over filling. Bake about 30 minutes. Stir together remaining tomato sauce and the chili sauce. Serve with pie.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Shred Cheddar cheese; combine with cream cheese and Hidden Valley Ranch dressing. Mix thoroughly. Shape mixture as a ball; roll over pecans.

title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add garlic and saute on low heat until soft. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Stuff each shrimp. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Freida'S Fried Chicken Fingers
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Cut chicken into bite size strips. Combine egg salt pepper mustard and ketchup in bowl. Stir. Dip cut up chicken in mixture and coat with flour. Place in hot oil; fry until done approximately 5 minutes. Serve with ketchup or barbecue sauce for dipping.

title: Vegetable Lasagna(Eating Light)
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles; drain and set aside. In medium bowl combine eggs cottage cheese Ricotta and Italian seasoning; set aside.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: First day pack cucumbers in jar longways. Mix 1 cup plain salt and 1/2 gallon boiling water; pour over cucumbers. On second day pour off water and rinse good. Add 1 jar alum. Cover with boiling water. On\tthird day pour off water and rinse good. Add plain boiling water. On the fourth day pour off water then mix spices in bag with 1/2 gallon vinegar. Boil together. Add to cucumbers and let stand for 7 days. On eighth day take out of vinegar and slice.\tPut cucumbers back in jar. Add sugar until enough syrup covers cucumbers.

title: Easy Sherbet Punch
instructions: Put sherbet into punch bowl and place in refrigerator to thaw. Just before serving remove bowl from refrigerator and add ginger ale slowly stirring well.

title: Seasoned Crackers
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers together. Pour over crackers. Stir occasionally for 2 hours.

title: Very Special Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in fat in heavy skillet; pour off drippings. Add remaining ingredients and cover. Cook over low heat about 1 hour or until chops are tender and sauce has thickened.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: French Fried Mushrooms (Or Dill Pickles)
instructions: Dip mushrooms into milk; dip into pancake mix. Fry in oil at 375\u00b0 for 2 minutes or until golden brown; drain on paper towels.

title: Rosy Strawberry Ring
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add berries stirring occasionally until thawed. Stir in pineapple bananas and lemon juice. Pour into dish or mold. Chill until firm. Unmold onto serving platter. Decorate with sprigs of mint. Serve with Dressing.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook beef in the water until almost done. Add all other ingredients except potatoes. Cook 1 1/2 hours until vegetables are tender. Add potatoes and cook until they are done. More water may be added but a good rich broth is very important to taste well.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Combine all ingredients and add beaten egg. Drop by tablespoon in greased frying pan. Fry until golden brown on both sides.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Butter the sides of a saucepan. Combine butter sugar and syrup. Stir well and bring to hard ball stage. Take off heat and stir in vanilla and soda. Pour over popcorn to coat.

title: Basic Tomato Meat Sauce
instructions: Heat olive oil in saucepot. Add onion and cook until lightly browned. Add and brown ground chuck. Add slowly a mixture of tomatoes salt bay leaf and sweet basil or oregano. Cover saucepot and simmer over very low heat about 2 1/2 hours. Add tomato sauce.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Drain cherry juice and add sugar; boil 3 minutes. Add 1/2 cup boiling water to both packages of Jell-O in a bowl. Add cherry and sugar juice to Jell-O. Add Coca-Cola mix well and add cherries and pecans. Put in icebox to jell.

title: Can'T Leave Alone Bars
instructions: Mix with fork the cake mix oil and eggs. This will form a ball like pizza dough. Pat half of the mixture into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan ungreased. Melt in saucepan the butter condensed milk and chocolate chips. Put over cake mixture and then put rest of cake mixture on top. Swirl with knife. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Rich chewy and utterly delicious!

title: Marshmallow Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve. Good with fruit!

title: Pork Chop Skillet
instructions: Brown pork chops in skillet; remove. Add onion and brown. Add Minute rice and water. Salt and pepper to taste. I also use Cavenders Greek seasoning. Place pork chops on top of this mixture. Cover and steam for 30 minutes.

title: Icebox Dessert
instructions: Mix oleo crackers and sugar and put into 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Dream Whip and spread over cracker crumbs. Cover with your favorite pie filling and put in refrigerator.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar then add remaining ingredients in order given. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake 1 hour or until done at 375\u00b0.

title: Polenta In Microwave
instructions: Mix together cornmeal and cold water and add hot water and margarine. Mix well. Microwave 4 minutes. Stir and microwave 2 to 3 minutes more.

title: Veal Cutlets
