instructions: Brown veal and onion; add tomatoes water and soup and heat. Put in baking pan cover and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Uncover and put cheese on meat; warm until melted.

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add sugar; cool until syrupy then beat until fluffy. Whip the chilled evaporated milk. Add the lemon juice. Fold into first mixture. Combine crushed vanilla wafers with the melted butter. Line pan with crumb mixture. Add jello mixture. Refrigerate until set.

title: Pineapple Tea
instructions: Mix in punch bowl. Great to serve at showers. Makes 3 gallons.

title: German Apfel Kuchen(Apple Cake)
instructions: Cut butter into flour. Add 1/3 cup of sugar 1 egg and the lemon peel. Press into a ball. Roll out on floured surface. Line bottom and partially up sides of a greased 12-inch spring-form pan with the dough. Decoratively lay apples on pastry and bake for 35 minutes. In a medium bowl beat 3 eggs cream 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla. Pour over apples and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until custard is set.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Make balls about 1-inch. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 until brown 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Perigod Style
instructions: Brown cutlets on all sides in 6 tablespoons margarine until brown. Take out of pan add 2 tablespoons margarine add mushrooms. Brown about 5 minutes. Take out of pan. Into pan over medium heat stir in flour and salt until blended. Gradually stir in chicken broth and half and half milk. Stir constantly until thick. Put chicken broth in pan with mushrooms and simmer for 25 minutes until cooked. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Corn Crisped Chicken
instructions: Mix the crumbs and seasonings together. Dip chicken in the milk and roll in the crumb mixture until well coated. Place in a shallow foil-lined baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. This is an easy way to cook chicken for a large group.

title: Low-Cal Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Pour off excess fat.

title: Teresa'S Cake
instructions: Bake white cake as directed. Beat cream cheese vanilla pudding and milk. Spread on cake. Drain pineapple and spread over cake. Cover with Cool Whip.

title: Blueberry Swirl Pie
instructions: Mix and press in 9-inch pie pan; bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together. Form ball and put back in refrigerator to set.

title: Goody-Good Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine next 7 ingredients. Add to creamed mixture alternately with pumpkin beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in vanilla pecans and raisins. Spoon into 2 (9-inch) loaf pans that have been greased and floured. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks.

title: Baked Salmon Patties
instructions: Remove skin and partially drain salmon. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Spoon into greased muffin pans using 1/4 c. mixture in each muffin cup. Bake at 350 degrees until golden brown.

title: Turkey Milanese
instructions: Sprinkle turkey cutlets with salt and pepper. In bowl beat egg whites. On plate mix bread crumbs and cheese. Coat cutlets with egg whites and then crumb mixture. Fry in skillet over medium-high heat with olive oil for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes on each side. Serve with lemon.

title: Quick Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine vegetables soup and chicken. Pour into pie shell. Chop boiled egg over chicken mixture. Mix egg milk and Bisquick mix then pour over top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Ice Box Banana Chocolate Pie - No Bake
instructions: Method Slice banana on bottom of pie crust. Add prepared pie filling. Add chunks of chocolate bar if desired. Let filling set.

title: Blow-Out Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. Beat peanut butter and butter until fluffy. Add both sugars and beat until light and smooth. Add egg and beat 3 minutes. Add vanilla and mix well. Stir in flour and beat thoroughly. Sprinkle milk over mixture and beat to soften the dough. Fold in chocolate chips and peanuts then carefully add the candy. Drop by 2 tablespoons clumps on ungreased baking sheet about 1-inch apart. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until just browned. Makes about 30.

title: Good And Easy - Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Melt all the above in sauce pan on stove - DO NOT BURN. Pour hot over 2 bags of popped natural microwave popcorn. Enjoy this watching TV.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Brown and salt hamburger. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle Chinese noodles over top and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Rosemary-Garlic Butter
instructions: Whisk together until well combined. Use with halibut dish or use to make garlic bread.

title: Pinwheel Tortillas
instructions: Mix all of the filling ingredients together well. Divide the filling and spread evenly over tortillas. Roll up tortillas. Cover tightly with plastic wrap twisting ends. Chill for approximately 3 hours. Unwrap. Cut into slices 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick. Discard ends. Dip into salsa. Eat.

title: Turnip Greens
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly. Drain. Tear into bite size pieces. Combine greens bacon and water in a Dutch oven and bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Add vinegar pepper flakes salt and pepper. Cover and cook an additional hour. Remove bacon slices before serving. Yields 6 servings.

title: Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sugar frozen lemonade juice and extract. Mix well. Freeze in gallon plastic jug. Dont fill to top. Defrost 3 hours before serving. Cut off top of jug; pour in punch bowl. Add 7-Up.

title: Creamy Waldorf Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except whipped cream; mix well. Gently fold in whipped cream. Cover; refrigerate. Yields ten 1/2-cup servings.

title: Individual Pizza Rounds
instructions: To make a thin crust for pizza separate each pita into two round pizza crusts. For a thicker crust use 1 whole pita bread. Place bread hollow side up on baking sheet. Spread equal amounts of green pepper pepperoni and mushrooms or any of your favorite pizza ingredients. Top with Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Ham And Cheese Skillet Supper
instructions: Cut ham slices into strips 3/4-inch wide. Cook cabbage in boiling salted water 10 minutes or until tender crisp; drain thoroughly. Cook onion in oleo in large fry pan 2 minutes. Stir in flour mustard salt and pepper. Gradually add milk and cook stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in ham strips and cabbage; cook slowly 10 minutes or until heated through. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Melt-A-Ways
instructions: Cream butter or margarine with sugar in medium size bowl. Gradually add flour mixing in thoroughly; stir in nuts. Chill. Form teaspoonfuls of dough into marble size balls by rolling lightly between palms of hands. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until pale golden. Remove from cookie sheet with spatula. While still hot roll in additional confectioners sugar. Cool on wire cake rack.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Combine sauce and water in bowl. Mix well. In separate bowl combine Ricotta cottage Parmesan and Mozzarella cheeses egg and nutmeg.

title: Cinnamon Logs
instructions: Cut bread into 4 x 2 x 2-inch rectangular logs. Let stand to dry slightly. Blend milk eggs sugar cinnamon vanilla and nutmeg in medium bowl. Pour into shallow pan large enough to hold bread in 1 layer. Arrange bread in milk mixture turning to coat all sides. Chill until liquid is absorbed several hours or overnight.

title: Skirt Steak
instructions: Cut steak into pieces about 3-inches square. Season with salt pepper garlic powder and paprika. Heat oil/butter in heavy skillet (several tablespoons). Quickly brown steak on both sides (do not overcook). Into 1/2 cup water add soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Add this to the steak. Shake and simmer for about 5 minutes. (This last 5 minutes can be done just before serving to allow you to prepare it earlier.) Serve with buttered noodles.

title: Cherry Dream Squares
instructions: Mix the cake mix 6 tablespoons of the margarine and 1 cup of oats; mix until crumbly. Save 1 cup of the crumbs for the top. To the remaining crumbs add the egg and mix well. Press this mixture in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan then pour a can of cherry pie filling on top. To the 1 cup of crumbs add 1/4 cup of oats and 2 tablespoons margarine 1/2 cup nuts and 1/4 cup brown sugar; mix then put over the cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 (moderate). Mix flour baking powder allspice and salt. Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add egg whites; beat well. Add dry ingredients. Stir in oats applesauce and raisins. Mix well. Drop by level tablespoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake 11 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool on rack. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Biscuit And Chicken(Serves 5)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Rinse peas to separate. Heat peas chicken soup sour cream milk salt and pepper to boiling stirring frequently. Prepare rolled biscuits as directed on package. Pour hot chicken mixture into an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish and sprinkle with cheese. Place biscuits on cheese. Bake until peas are tender about 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Form into loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Cocktail Jello Cream
instructions: Heat fruit and mix the jello in it. Put in the refrigerator and let set a little. Beat softened cream cheese and whipping cream together. Fold the cream into the fruited jello and place back in refrigerator until it sets firmly. Serves 6.

title: Beulah Mclellan'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cream the potatoes until smooth. Combine with next 8 ingredients and place in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Rumaki
instructions: Cook bacon until partially cooked (browned but still limp). Cut each slice in half and wrap around water chestnut and liver. Secure with toothpick. In shallow dish combine soy sauce brown sugar ginger garlic powder and 1/4 cup water. Add bacon/chicken livers and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Turn occasionally. Remove from marinade and place on rack in shallow pan. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Place under broiler for 2 to 3 minutes until browned and crispy.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter. Add flour and cook until smooth. Add cream slowly. Then cheese and seasonings. Simmer until cheese melts. Cook green beans in salted water. Drain and mix with sauce. Add water chestnuts and top with slivered blanched toasted almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. (Can be made ahead refrigerated and then baked for 35 to 40 minutes.)

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Roll beef cubes in flour or cornstarch and brown in large skillet in a small amount of oil. Add beef broth and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Chicken Salad
instructions: Dressing Shred the peel from the orange; peel and section orange over bowl to catch and reserve 1 teaspoon juice. (Set aside sections.) Combine peel juice yogurt honey and poppy seed. Cover and chill.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a saucepan combine the chicken 1/2 cup of milk sour cream and soup and bring to a boil. Spoon mixture into 6 ungreased 10-ounce casserole dishes or custard cups or pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Sweet Potato Raisin Patties
instructions: Boil and mash sweet potatoes; add egg salt and flour (if mixture is real moist). Blend in raisins. Drop tablespoons of mixture on heated greased frypan. Brown slowly on both sides. Makes about 12 patties.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside. Stir together flour sugar and baking soda and cut in shortening. Mix buttermilk and yeast water. Stir in flour mixture.\tKnead 4 to 5 times. Pat out to 1/4-inch thick.\tPlace closely together on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Brush melted butter on top.

title: Jamaican Jerk Pork Chops
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Pour the flour and jerk seasoning into a large plastic bag seal and shake to mix. Add the chops two at a time reseal and shake to coat. Brown chops in oil and place them on a plate.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Use 1/4 cup mix per cup of hot water. May use more if desired.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Cook ground beef and\tdrain.\tAdd rest of ingredients and let cook until desired texture. Serve on buns.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Blend sour cream and cream cheese until smooth. Fold in celery and onion. Add salt pepper and lemon juice. Add chopped shrimp. Mix thoroughly and refrigerate several hours before serving. May be served with Fritos Doritos or crackers. May be prepared 2 days in advance. Makes 1 quart.

title: Yani'S Chocolate Pots De Creme
instructions: In a heavy small saucepan combine light cream chocolate and sugar. Cook and stir over medium heat about 10 minutes or until mixture comes to a full boil and thickens. Gradually stir about half of the hot mixture into beaten egg yolks; return yolk mixture to saucepan. Cook and stir over low heat for 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour into 4 or 6 pot de creme cups or small dessert dishes. Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours. Serve with whipped cream if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mrs. Florence Hooks' Spoon Bread
instructions: Scald meal with boiling water add salt. Cool. Add eggs milk and melted butter or margarine. Bake in buttered pan (square about 9 x 9-inch) at 450\u00b0 until browned (about 30 minutes). Good warmed over. Can be frozen.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Heat 2 to 3 minutes on High in microwave. Mix. Place by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Blueberry Boy Bait
instructions: Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine flour 1 1/2 cups sugar baking powder salt butter milk and eggs. Blend at low speed until dry ingredients are moistened then beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Pour batter into pan. Arrange blueberries on top. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Orange Sunbeam Cookies
instructions: Sift first 3 ingredients together in mixing bowl. Cut in butter or margarine until fine. Stir in raisins chopped. Blend egg orange rind orange juice and sweetener. Sprinkle over mixture stirring with a fork until it holds together. Shape dough into balls using a teaspoonful for each. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Toasted Pecans
instructions: Pour butter over nuts coating well. Single layer on cookie sheet. Sprinkle salt. Bake for 1 hour at 275\u00b0. Stir often.

title: Sin
instructions: Mix flour oleo and nuts until crumbly and spread on bottom of 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until slightly brown. Cool. Blend cream cheese 1 cup Cool Whip and the sugar. Spread on top of crust. Mix pudding and milk and pour onto cream cheese layer. Chill 2 hours. Frost with remaining Cool Whip. Store in refrigerator.

title: Eggplant Au Gratin
instructions: Peel and boil eggplant in salted water until soft; strain off water and mash. Fry onions in butter. Beat eggs. Grate cheese. Combine all ingredients; salt and pepper to taste. Place in buttered pan. Bake 30 minutes. Dot with butter; cover with crackers. Return to oven; cook 10 minutes. (May use potato chips crushed for topping.)

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Divide recipe mixture into 3 greased and floured bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted into middle comes out dry and clean.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; set aside. Pour hot water over sugar salt and shortening in large mixer bowl; let cool. Beat eggs; add 3 cups flour and mix all together with mixer. Add 3 more cups flour; mix by hand. Refrigerate overnight covered with towel. Punch down and knead; make into rolls. (Divide dough into halves and roll out and cut.) Let rise 3 to 4 hours then bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pasta Carbonara(Serves 4 To 6.)
instructions: Saute bacon in skillet until crisp. Remove and drain on paper towels. Boil 4 quarts water in a large pot. Add 2 teaspoons salt and then drop in spaghetti. Stir with wooden spoon and return to boil. Cook until tender about 8 minutes. Meanwhile beat eggs thoroughly in large bowl suitable for serving. Have cooked bacon and chopped parsley ready at hand. When pasta is done drain immediately in colander. Pour hot spaghetti into bowl of eggs and immediately begin tossing. As the strands of pasta become coated with beaten eggs their heat will cook the eggs. Sprinkle on bacon and chopped parsley. Toss again and serve immediately. Top with Parmesan cheese and black pepper.

title: Cheese And Sour Cream Enchilada
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Add taco seasoning and green chilies to meat. Fill tortillas with meat and 1/2 of the cheese. Place in a greased pan. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top. Mix soup and sour cream. Spread it on top of the enchiladas. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix soup and milk together. Place a layer of potatoes in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Add about half of each onion cheese soup. Repeat ending with soup on top. Cover. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring water butter and salt to boil. Add 1 cup flour. Mix well into dough. Set aside to cool approximately 15 minutes. Add 4 eggs 1 at a time. Beat well after adding each egg. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Put into preheated oven and bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Do not open oven door while baking. Let cool before removing from pan. Cut top off and take any dough out that is left inside. Fill with whipped cream or your favorite pudding.

title: Cheese-Crisp Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine crumbs cheese parsley and seasonings. Dip chicken into margarine then crumb mix. Arrange in single layer in shallow baking pan. Pour remaining crumbs over top. Drizzle any remaining margarine over all of the chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Crab Meat Hors D'Oeuvre
instructions: Split the muffins in half. Drain the crab meat. Mix cheese mayonnaise and margarine and add the crab meat. Spread on the muffins. Put in freezer on a cookie sheet. When the spread freezes cut each muffin slice into 4 pieces. Put in plastic bags and return to freezer. When ready to use broil for 5 to 7 minutes. Makes 48 pieces.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
instructions: Will also need 24 muffin papers in muffin pan.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Combine all ingredients; salt to taste. Cook slowly and boil down some. Cut round steak into pieces and brown in skillet. Place browned steak in the sauce and simmer until steak is tender about 1 hour.

title: Best Ever Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients together. Mix sugars shortening vanilla and eggs. Mix with dry ingredients. Roll out in powdered sugar. Cut into desired shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost when cooled but not necessary as these are very sweet and tender without the frosting.

title: Decadent Chocolate-Cherry Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to package directions adding cocoa powder to dry ingredients. While cake cools prepare pudding mix according to package directions using skim milk; cool. Set aside 12 cherries for decoration. Coarsely chop remaining cherries. Stir chopped cherries into cooled pudding; set aside. Cut 1-inch slice off top of cooled cake; set slice aside. Cut through 1 1/2 inches wide and 1 inch deep around top of cake; pull out and discard cake in trough. Spoon pudding into trough; replace top of cake. Sprinkle top of cake with confectioners sugar.

title: Super Corn
instructions: Soften oleo; add egg and sour cream and beat. Put Jiffy corn mix onion creamed corn and whole corn (drained) in a 9 x 12-inch buttered baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Pimento may be added for color.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook and stir hamburger and onion in butter in 10-inch skillet. Stir in flour salt garlic pepper and mushrooms. Cook stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Stir in soup. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream; heat through. Serve over hot noodles or rice.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 13 x 9-inch pan melt butter in pan in oven and remove. In large bowl mix eggs (beaten) flour milk baking powder salt and pepper. Mix well. Add cheese spinach and onion. Pour into buttered pan. Bake for 35 minutes. Cool for 45 minutes before serving. If made ahead of time they may be reheated at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Watergate Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Mix in a bowl pudding marshmallows and pineapple. Fold in Cool Whip until completely mixed. Chill and serve.

title: Energy Bars
instructions: Toast oats for 15 minutes at 250\u00b0. Add peanuts raisins and sunflower seeds. Cool. Mix in Rice Krispies. Melt butter peanut butter and marshmallows. Add dry mixture and mix together. Press into buttered pan. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. To serve cut into desired size or cut and wrap to store.

title: Maui Maui Meat Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together and form into balls. Brown then cover with sauce and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat in olive oil. Add onion and garlic. Cook until onion is transparent. Add tomatoes tomato paste salt basil oregano pepper and bay leaf. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Stir in olives. Spread 1/4 of sauce in baking dish. Cover with layer of cooked lasagna arranging strips lengthwise in baking dish. Add layer of Mozzarella cheese then a layer of Parmesan cheese and sprinkle with sliced ripe olives. Continue layering. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Baptist Skillet Cookies
instructions: Cook in skillet for 10 minutes. Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla and 2 cups Rice Krispies cereal. Cool enough to handle. Roll into small balls the size of walnuts. Roll in coconut to coat.

title: Grilled Eggplant Lasagna With Tomatoes And Three Cheeses
instructions: Layer eggplant with salt in a colander; let sit 20 minutes. Rinse and pat dry. Drizzle eggplant with oil and grill turning often until cooked. Rub an 8 x 11-inch baking dish with oil and set oven to 350\u00b0. Layer as follows Place several slices of eggplant in the dish. Add black pepper 1/2 the basil 1/2 the tomatoes 1/3 of the Fontina cheese Mozzarella cheese and Romano cheese. Continue layering in this way until you have made three layers of eggplant and 2 of tomatoes. Sprinkle the top with the remaining cheeses. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until cheese browns and juices are bubbling at the edges. Serve with slices of crusty bread.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Combine onions with cheese and mayonnaise. Spread on toast rounds.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Peel and cut apples into bite size pieces. Drain pineapple chunks and mix with apples. Combine juice from pineapple chunks with flour and vinegar. Cook juice vinegar and flour until thickened. Pour over apples and pineapple. Add cheese and nuts and mix until coated.

title: Hot Madras Beef Curry
instructions: Heat the butter in large saucepan and fry the onions until golden brown. Next add green chilies turmeric chili powder cumin garlic coriander curry and tomato paste. Fry for 10 minutes stirring constantly making sure the masala does not stick to the bottom of the pan. Add lemon salt and pepper. In large pan brown the round steak in butter. Add water and bouillon cubes. Let simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Mix in the masala sauce. Simmer for 2 or more hours adding water as needed. Serve over rice or noodles. This is a very spicy dish. You can use more or less chilies to suit your personal taste.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Add all ingredients except eggs. Beat eggs separate then add and mix. Spray pan with vegetable spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Bake inside a shallow pan.

title: Aunt Maude'S Almost Instant Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Pour buttermilk and yeast solution into dry ingredients. Mix and dump dough onto floured board and knead knead and knead until blisters show. Roll out 1/4 inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter spread melted butter over top. Fold over place on ungreased baking sheet and cover. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Diana'S Disaster
instructions: Layer in baking dish in order listed. For larger serving increase cans of pie filling and pineapple to 3. Bake at 300\u00b0 until top is brown.

title: Cranberry Poppy Seed Loaf(Makes 12 Servings)
instructions: Bring to a boil the sweetener and water; add red food coloring. Mix 1/3 cup cornstarch and 1/8 teaspoon salt together with 3/4 cup water; bring again to a boil. Cook until it thickens  pour in 1 pint fresh or frozen strawberries. Mix well. Cool. Pour in 9-inch baked pie shell and top with 1 pint fresh strawberries sliced. Cover with Reddi-Wip or Dream Whip.

title: Chocolate Coated Popcorn
instructions: Boil sugar water corn syrup and chocolate together until it reaches hard ball stage (about 254\u00b0). Pour slowly over popped corn in a large bowl. Mix quickly. Butter hands and quickly shape into balls. Makes about 12 balls.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet. Add onion and bell pepper. Add 2 1/2 cans of tomato sauce. Save the other half can. Add enchilada seasoning. Add all of the cheese except for 1 1/2 cups. Simmer ingredients for 8 to 10 minutes. Start filling tortillas. Wrap and place into greased pan(s). Pour remaining 1/2 can of tomato sauce over enchiladas. Sprinkle cheese and green onions over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 in oven until cheese melts.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Dump cherries in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with dry cake mix. Pour butter over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spoon out to serve.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain canned fruit reserving pineapple juice and adding enough peach juice to make 1 cup.

title: Hot Cocoa
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan. Blend in water. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil and stir for 2 minutes. Add milk; stir and heat. Do not boil. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Beat with rotary beater until foamy. Yields 1 quart.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli as directed and drain well. Add soup egg mayonnaise cheese salt and pepper to broccoli and pour into a 2-quart casserole which has been buttered. Toss butter and croutons together and sprinkle over broccoli. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix the sugar cornstarch and salt together set aside. In a medium sauce pan heat the pineapple then add the sugar mixture all at once while stirring briskly. Cook until thick and clear. Beat egg yolks in a bowl stir a little of the hot mixture into them; return to the pan and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in oleo and lemon juice.

title: Coronado Casserole
instructions: Cook beef rice and onion until lightly browned. Add spices olives tomato juice and boiling water. Place in greased casserole. Cover and bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Uncover sprinkle with cheese and continue baking about 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix raspberry jello and 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Add raspberries and lemon juice. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan; refrigerate until firm. Cover with sour cream. Dissolve cherry jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add pineapple and cranberry sauce. Mix thoroughly and chill. Spread on top of sour cream.

title: Holiday Fruit Cake
instructions: Combine eggs and water; add remaining ingredients. Place in well-greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 80 to 90 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Invert on rack.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs. Place soda in buttermilk and add to mixture the flour and flavorings. Mix until blended and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stir together first 5 ingredients. Add onions and sage to stuffing. Layer with stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Beat banana margarine sugars and flavoring until blended. Beat in egg. Stir in flour until blended. Spread in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done. Cool on rack.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme thoroughly. Arrange fruit around bowl of dip and serve.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Mix altogether and put into a casserole dish. Be sure the macaroni is uncooked. Let stand several hours or overnight in refrigerator. Take out 1 hour before putting in oven. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Homemade Toffee Heath Bars
instructions: You will need tinfoil and a cookie sheet.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a 10-inch unbaked pie shell. Top with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until set in center.

title: Cavettelli And Broccoli
instructions: In medium saucepan saute garlic and pepperoni until garlic is lightly browned. Add rest of ingredients and simmer for about 30 minutes. Cook cavettelli until al dente drain and add sauce. Eat hot or cold.

title: Tangy Party Meatballs
instructions: Mix together lightly. Gently roll in firm small balls (1 1/2-inch). Set aside. Prepare sauce.

title: Fiesta
instructions: Cook meat and onions in a little fat or oil until meat loses its redness. Add the rest of the ingredients except the beans plus a little water and cook slowly for 30 minutes. Add the cooked beans (and enough water to make a good \chili\ consistency) and cook 15 minutes more. Serves 16 to 20.

title: Swedish Rice Pudding
instructions: Use a 6 cup casserole. Cook rice and cool. Beat eggs. Add sugar salt vanilla evaporated milk and milk. Mix well. Sprinkle cinnamon or nutmeg on top. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 325\u00b0. (Will set when cool.)

title: Spinach Cheese Pie
instructions: Thaw patty shells roll out to fit a 10-inch pie plate. Cook spinach; drain well. Combine eggs and Cheddar cheese; beat well. Stir in spinach and onion parsley salt and pepper. Turn in shell and top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and Jell-O together. Blend in Cool Whip and pineapple. You can make any flavor you wish.

title: Wild Rice Mix
instructions: Place wild rice in a strainer and rinse thoroughly with water. Spread wild rice in a shallow baking pan; pat dry with paper towels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until dry. Cool.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients; bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Brown top.

title: Chinese Influence
instructions: Brown sausage; add celery onion and green pepper. Cook until tender in skillet. Put into 3 cups of boiling water after skimming off grease. Add noodle soup and rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until rice is cooked.

title: Soap Crayons
instructions: Pour water into a 1-cup measuring cup. Fill the rest of the cup to the top with Ivory Flakes. With a spoon mix the water and soap flakes together until mixture becomes a thick soapy paste without any big lumps. Add about 30 or 40 drops of food coloring to the soap mixture and stir well until the soap has color. Scoop out some of the mixture and put it in one of the cube spaces of an ice cube tray. Press the soap paste down into the cube until it is filled to the top. Fill 1 or 2 more cubes with the remaining soap mixture. Dry cubes in a warm dry place for 1 or 2 days until the soap paste gets hard (test by pressing with your finger). Pop the soap crayons out of the tray. Some colors will work better than others. Soap crayons are made from pure soap and food coloring so whatever is drawn with them can be wiped off bathtubs sinks floors windows hands and faces. They are great for making disguises like a big moustache or a clown face.

title: Mary'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat the eggs and sugar together. Add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour mixture into pie shells. Cover with pecan halves. Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecued Trout
instructions: Fill inside of trout with Ranch dressing. Marinate for 10 to 15 minutes. Place on barbecue about 5 minutes on each side.

title: Coushaw Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in a greased cake pan 9 1/2 x 13-inch at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown hamburger with onions and garlic. Drain fat. In a saucepan combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Add hamburger mixture. Cook until hamburger is heated through. This recipe can be doubled or tripled and the sauce frozen or canned for future use.

title: Harvey Chili
instructions: Put meat in pot cover slightly with water and boil for 20 minutes. Add other ingredients and cook slowly for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Cucumber Salad
instructions: Wash cucumbers pat dry and score with tines of fork. Cut cucumbers into transparent paper-thin slices to measure 4 cups. Place cucumber slices in deep bowl. Sprinkle every few layers with salt cover cucumbers with a plate and weight them down with a heavy object (a can of fruit or let stand at room temperature 2 hours. Drain cucumbers thoroughly and press out remaining liquid. Stir together vinegar sugar and pepper pour over slices and cover. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Drain cucumbers before serving. 4-6 servings.

title: Homemade Butter
instructions: Mix the 2 butters together with mixer until fluffy. Add buttermilk; mix until blended. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Bologna Dip
instructions: Mix bologna and eggs with mayonnaise (enough for dip consistency). Serve with crackers or potato chips.

title: Sausage Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease large cookie sheet. Remove sausage from casings; cook in a large skillet until browned. Stir to break into small pieces; drain off fat. Stir in cheese parsley and oregano; remove from heat.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Pour lemon juice over apples. Place apples into pie crust. Combine sugar cinnamon and salt. Sprinkle over apples. Cut margarine into slices and place over apples. Take second pie crust and place on top of pie. Cut slits into pie crust and sprinkle with sugar. Place on a preheated cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt in medium saucepan. Slowly stir in water and 2 cups strawberries. Cook over low heat stirring constantly and mashing berries until mixture thickens and boils 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly.

title: Busy Day Casserole(You Couldn'T Find An Easier Supper)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Lightly butter a 2-quart casserole. In casserole combine Ready Hamburger Mix spaghetti pork and beans ketchup and chili powder. Stir to blend. Heat about 20 minutes until bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: In double boiler add cheese half and half milk and white pepper. Melt altogether. Add steamed broccoli. Stir frequently.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat bell pepper and onion. Place meat mixture in baking dish. Place Tater Tots over meat mixture. Next pour mushroom soup over Tater Tots.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Pour everything into blender and turn on high speed. When completely blended pour into 9-inch ungreased pie plate. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Add coconut on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes; bake at 450\u00b0 for last 10 minutes.

title: Black Turtle Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight; drain. Add all ingredients. Simmer for 2 hours or until tender. Puree in blender (optional). Serve hot.

title: Skillet Spinach
instructions: Rinse spinach thoroughly and trim stems. If leaves are very large tear in half. Shake to dry. In a very large skillet heat bacon grease on medium-high heat then add pork or ham and brown slightly. Turn heat to low and add vinegar. Mix egg with half and half and stir into skillet. Add spinach a skilletful at a time letting it cook down while stirring until more can be added. Continue until all the spinach is used. Sprinkle scallion over top and stir until last batch of spinach is wilted. Salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oyster Or Mushroom Soup
instructions: In soup pot cook onions in butter very slowly over low heat until soft but not browned. Add flour; stir to blend. Add chicken broth and liquid from oysters or mushrooms; simmer 5 minutes until thickened. Add light cream and oysters or mushrooms; heat to simmer; do not boil. Season with salt pepper and mace (a favorite colonial seasoning the yellow outer coating of nutmeg). Makes about 10 servings.

title: Rich Fudge Brownies
instructions: In a large bowl combine sugars flour Egg Beaters applesauce corn syrup Hersheys chocolate syrup and cocoa. Mix until well blended. Stir in vanilla and Grape-Nuts if desired. Spread into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish that has been sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until done. Cool in pan on a wire rack. Frost with lite fudge topping. Yields 36 brownies.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain off grease. Add Ragu; mix well and simmer. Combine cottage cheese eggs and Mozzarella in bowl. Mix well.

title: Chow-Chow Relish
instructions: Mix vegetables together. Dissolve salt in 8 cups of water and pour over vegetables. Let stand in cool place overnight then drain. If too salty rinse and drain again. Tie spices in cheesecloth. Add to vinegar and 1 cup water. Let simmer 5 minutes. Add sugar; stir until dissolved. Add vegetables and simmer for 15 minutes. Bring to a boil and pack boiling ingredients in hot jars and seal.

title: Homemade Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Fry ground beef in skillet; after it is done add your chili. Rinse chili cans with a little water (just enough to rinse your cans out). You will need a square or oblong baking pan or dish. Chop onions. Grate the cheese and separate your corn tortillas. Place a tablespoon or a little more of beef and chili on each tortilla. Also sprinkle some chopped onions and grated cheese on each one. Roll each one as you go and place in baking dish. Pour the remaining beef and chili over them. Place the rest of the chopped onions on top. To top it all off sprinkle the remaining cheese over it all. Place in oven and let bake for approximately 10 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad And Rice
instructions: Combine cooked chicken celery chestnuts rice and peas. Add salt garlic salt mayonnaise lemon juice onion Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with bacon and cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. May prepare the night before. Serves 8.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass). In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan (dish) melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients; press down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until evenly browned. Cool and cut into bars. Store covered at room temperature.

title: Zucchini And Tomato With Herbs
instructions: In a skillet cook the onion in butter over moderately low heat stirring until softened; add zucchini. Saute the mixture 3 to 5 minutes or until tender. Stir tomatoes and herbs; cover for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Coconut Apple Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix together the first 11 ingredients thoroughly. This batter will be very thick. Place in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. While still hot spread top with the melted butter. Sprinkle with the white sugar and cinnamon mixture.

title: Coconut Sheet Cake
instructions: Cook yellow cake mix as per box instructions. Mix cream of coconut and milk together. Pour over hot cake. Punch holes in cake to let mixture seep down in cake. Let cool. Spoon Cool Whip on top of cake; then add flaked coconut on top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Turkey-Rice Bake
instructions: Combine soup 1/2 cup water mayonnaise and lemon juice. Blend 1 cup soup mixture remaining water rice 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese and salt in buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with turkey. Combine remaining soup mixture with broccoli. Pour over turkey and sprinkle remaining Parmesan cheese over top. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.

title: Papa'S Jelly Cake
instructions: Slice cake layers around through the middle to make 4 thin layers. Bring jelly to a boil; add sugar and bring back to a boil. Remove from heat. Spoon jelly mixture between layers. For top layer and sides add coconut to remaining jelly mixture. Stir well and spread over top and sides.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Wash and slice tomatoes. Beat egg salt and pepper together. Mix cornmeal and flour together and place in a baggie. Place tomato slices a few at a time in bag. Shake until well coated. Get oil in skillet hot. Place tomatoes in hot oil and fry until golden brown. Remove from oil and place on plate lined with paper towels.

title: Banana Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and baking soda. Beat in butter until mixture is crumbly. Beat in shortening eggs and sour cream. Continue beating 5 minutes. Add flavorings and bananas and beat 20 minutes longer. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan or two 9 x 5-inch bread loaf pans. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake 90 minutes or until a sharp knife inserted deep into the cake comes out clear. Let cool for 5 minutes then remove from pan.

title: Tropical Cheese Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese honey and ginger in a small mixing bowl. Stir in crushed pineapple. Serve with graham crackers.

title: Tarragon Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Brown onion and garlic in saucepan. Remove from heat. Mix flour in. Gradually add milk to mixture until smooth. Add salt tarragon chicken broth vegetables and chicken. Heat slowly until thickened.

title: Crabmeat Imperial
instructions: Saute butter and onions. Cool. Add all ingredients together trying not to break up crabmeat lumps. Place in casserole and bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Cheese Dainties
instructions: With all ingredients at room temperature mix well. If too sticky refrigerate to cool. Roll into fingerlike roll about 1 1/2-inch diameter. Slice into bits about the size of a quarter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Watch carefully and dont overbake.

title: Cabbage And Noodles
instructions: Cook until done drain. Cook 1 package noodles until done. Add to cabbage and serve hot. If you want to you can lightly fry the cabbage in a frypan (I do it adds a little different flavor).

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Take round steak; sprinkle garlic salt and celery seed over and pound it into the steak lightly. Do it to both sides. Put foil in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Lay the steak on top of it. Then cut up a large onion over the top and add the bell pepper. Put the can of stewed tomatoes over the top of that. Then put the drained tomatoes over the top of that. Then put the drained mushrooms on top of that. Then cover the top of all with the beefy mushroom soup. Do not stir any of it. Then cover with foil and put it into the oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Check to be sure the steak is done.

title: Dee-Dees Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease and flour pans well. Mix dry ingredients together. Make a well in center and add eggs water and oil. Mix well. Add nuts raisins cherries and pumpkin. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Pepper Sirloin Steak
instructions: Score edges of steak (one-inch intervals). Heat grill. Combine butter parsley Worcestershire sauce pepper and mustard in small saucepan. Stir constantly over low heat until butter melts. Reserve 1/4 mixture. Place steak on grill; brush with butter mixture. Grill over medium heat for 6 minutes each side (medium or medium-rare; cook longer for a more done steak). Use remaining butter mixture to drizzle over finished steak just before serving.

title: Strawberry Icebox Dessert
instructions: Roll vanilla wafers very fine and mix with 1/2 stick melted butter. Spread about 2/3 of crumb crust in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.

title: Quick And Easy Lite Baked Ziti
instructions: Mix spaghetti sauce and ziti in a baking dish. Add 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese and cottage cheese. Gently mix in. Sprinkle remainder of Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese melts on top.

title: Goat Cheese Torta
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Line a small bowl with plastic wrap leaving long ends (which will cover top when done). Place 1/3 of cheese mixture in bowl. Spoon Pesto on cheese. Place 1/3 cheese on top of Pesto. Spoon tomatoes on top. Finish with rest of cheese. Cover with plastic and refrigerate for 2 hours or up to 4 days. Unmold onto plate and serve with crackers.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs; blend in pumpkin. Gradually add dry ingredients and mix well. Place in 2 greased loaf pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or longer (ovens vary).

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Heat oil in electric fry pan at 300\u00b0. Pound round or sirloin steak until tender. Coat with flour salt pepper and Cajun seasoning mixed together. Brown; add onion green pepper and tomatoes. Add water to cover. Cover and cook until tender 4 to 6 hours.

title: Quick Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in sugar and let set for a minute then beat in remaining ingredients. Grease muffin pan. Fill half full with batter. Bake for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 24. Batter will keep in refrigerator.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and beat well. Mix cocoa and food coloring together; add to sugar mixture. Beating well add flour alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla and beat until blended. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Pour into three 9-inch cake pans lined with greased wax paper sprinkled with flour (can make 4 layers).

title: Diane Holley'S Microwave Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Fry tortillas and tear apart. Mix soup diced chicken and green chiles and heat in casserole dish; layer tortillas and chicken mixture. Add layer of cheese. Continue layering. Microwave on High for 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add Ro-Tel Velveeta and chili. When all is melted add whipping cream. Simmer on low in crock-pot. Eat with taco chips.

title: Hasty Pudding
instructions: Make a paste of the cold water and cornmeal; and stir until there are no lumps. Then pour gradually into the boiling salted water. Stir until very thick. Pour in a double boiler; cover and cook for 2 or 3 hours stirring frequently. Serve hot with milk sugar butter and salt or as desired.

title: Junior'S Bacon Beans
instructions: In medium-large frying pan add oil and bacon; cook over medium-high until bacon is half cooked then add fresh green beans and stir-fry for 5 to 8 minutes. Add garlic salt and soy sauce; stir-fry for 3 to 4 more minutes. After 8 to 12 minutes beans are ready to be served. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Christmas Pork Roast
instructions: Place roast in shallow baking dish. Rub with mixture of mustard/thyme. Combine 1/2 cup sherry 1/2 cup soy sauce and garlic (minced). Let stand 3 to 4 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator; turn occasionally. Remove meat from marinade; place on rack in shallow roasting pan. Roast uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat thermometer registers 185\u00b0. Melt currant jelly; add 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 2 tablespoons sherry. Stir and simmer 2 minutes; pass with roast. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Hot Russian Tea(Low Calorie)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in airtight container. Keeps a very long time. To make add 1 level teaspoon dry mix to 1 cup hot water. Each cup has 4 calories.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli unsalted and drain. Mix ingredients place in greased casserole dish. Crush cracker crumbs place on top with butter and paprika. Bake 45 min. at 350\u00b0.

title: Chili Pie
instructions: Crush the chips while still in the bag. Pour the crushed chips into a 2-quart casserole dish. Put the chili on top of the crushed chips. Put the cheese soup on top of the chili and spread it out. Pour a little water on the top of the soup and poke with a fork. Top with shredded cheese. Put in the oven at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes until hot and bubbly.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Microwave Cake
instructions: Using pan from microwave cake mix spray with Pam. Place butter and sugar in pan. Add pineapple. Top cake mix per box instructions. Microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Pear Cake
instructions: Cream oil and sugar add eggs and beat well. Add all dry ingredients nuts and pears; then add flavors. Bake in a greased and floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Fruit Pies
instructions: Mix pineapple flour sugar and cherries. Bring to a boil. Cook over a medium heat until thick. Stir in jello. Let cool. Add bananas. Stir. Pour into 2 baked pie shells or graham cracker shells. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle pecans on top. Refrigerate immediately.

title: Sweet Potato Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and other ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10-15 minutes. Cool and frost with

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut lettuce and cauliflower into small pieces. Slice onion and separate into rings. Place lettuce in bowl add cauliflower. Spread mayonnaise over top. Add onion bacon and cheese. Sprinkle sugar over top. Refrigerate overnight. Toss before serving.

title: Crunchy Oatmeal Cookies*
instructions: Cream butter add sugars then add egg and vanilla. Sift together flour soda cinnamon salt and baking powder and add to creamed mixture. Last add cornflakes oats coconut and nuts. Shape dough with hands into small balls and place about 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Yields approximately 3 dozen cookies.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta; cool. Cut up vegetables and crab; add to pasta. Toss with salad dressing and lemon juice. Refrigerate 2-6 hours.

title: Tropical Sangria
instructions: Combine wine brandy and sugar in a pitcher. Add lemon orange and pineapple chunks. Let stand 30 minutes in the refrigerator before serving. Serve with or without ice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes until done and drain well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all these ingredients and pour into baking dish.

title: Cake From Scratch
instructions: Cream the butter until smooth. Add sugar again creaming until smooth. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each egg. Add vanilla. Add flour one cup at a time. Add 1/2 milk after adding 1 cup flour mixing well after each addition. Add last 1/2 cup milk after adding second cup of flour. Add third cup of flour and mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. This will also make three 9-inch layers. I use Bakers Joy spray to grease pans.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: To keep ice cream from leaking through the pointed end of a rolled sugar cone stuff a tiny marshmallow in the bottom of the cone before adding the ice cream.

title: Sour Cream Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla and nuts. Bring to a boil slowly stirring until sugar dissolves. Boil without stirring over medium heat until soft ball and let stand 15 minutes. Do not stir. Add vanilla; beat until candy starts to loose its gloss. Stir in nuts and pour into buttered 9x9 inch pan.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend together; roll in nuts.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together and set aside to cool the first 5 ingredients. Mix together the remaining ingredients. Combine with first mixture and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into two 9 x 9 x 2-inch pans or one 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. If freezing is desired do so at this point then add topping before baking.

title: Party Dip
instructions: Mix and serve. Store in refrigerator. Makes 16 tablespoons. Per tablespoon 18 calories 0.5 mg cholesterol 0.03 g fat 247 mg Na.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring. Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs. Combine sifted flour with salt. Add with buttermilk and vanilla to mixture alternately. Fold in vinegar and soda. Pour into three 8-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Pat'S Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions and pull apart in rings. Have 4 bowls 1 with milk 1 with flour 1 with egg and milk and 1 with cracker meal. Dip onion rings in each bowl and lay out on cookie sheet. Let set for a couple of hours before frying. Deep fry. Can be frozen after frying.

title: Crunchy Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar butter molasses egg yolk and vanilla. Stir in flour and half of the chocolate chips. Mix and press dough into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake until golden brown (about 20 to 25 minutes).

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in water to cover until tender about 20 minutes. Set potatoes aside until cool enough to handle then peel and slice. Put potatoes in a large bowl. Saute bacon in a large skillet until browned and crisp. Remove bacon from skillet and reserve. Remove all but 8 tablespoons bacon grease from skillet. Set skillet over medium-high heat; add onion and saute stirring often for about 3 minutes. Stir in flour sugar salt and pepper. Stir well. Slowly stir in vinegar and 1/2 cup water. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Roast Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Combine herbs and garlic; set aside. Brush tenderloins with butter and roll in herb mixture coating evenly. Place tenderloins fat side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part of tenderloin making sure thermometer does not touch fat. Drizzle any remaining butter over meat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Double Crust Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Fit 1 pie crust into 1 9-inch pie plate (according to package directions). Do not bake. Combine chicken and remaining ingredients. Spoon into pie shell. Moisten edges of pastry with water. Place remaining crust on top. Fold edges under and flute. Cut slits in top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Yam Delight
instructions: Mix together the crushed pretzels and 2 sticks melted margarine. Put in 2 pie pans or one oblong dish. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Let cool.

title: Fruit Squares
instructions: Melt butter in 15 1/2 X 10 1/2 X 1-inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle on crumbs (tap sides of pan to distribute crumbs evenly). Sprinkle on coconut. Distribute candied fruit as evenly as possible over the coconut. Cut dates into a small amount of flour so they wont stick together. Distribute dates over candied fruit. Sprinkle on nuts. Press mixture lightly with hands to level pan. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over the top. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool completely before cutting. Remove from pan. Makes about 54 (1 1/2-inch) squares.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Prepare pudding mix and stir together with Cool Whip. Cover bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers. Put 1/2 of pudding mix over graham crackers. Top with 2nd layer of graham crackers. Cover with remaining pudding mix. Top with 3rd layer of graham crackers. Frost with Fudge Frosting.

title: Everyday Easy Broccoli Bake
instructions: Combine soup milk and soy sauce. In 10 x 6-inch pan layer 1/2 broccoli 1/2 soup mixture and 1/2 onions. Top with remaining broccoli and soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Blend Crisco and sugar. Combine soup with water and baking soda. Add this to Crisco/sugar mix alternately with dry ingredients. Stir in raisins. Bake in a greased pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Reception Punch
instructions: Mix and add to syrup. Serves 20.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Start with all ingredients except vegetables. Cook on high heat until it boils; stir often. Turn down heat to simmer. Cook 20 to 30 minutes or longer. Add frozen vegetables; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Pork Dumplings
instructions: Soak mushrooms in warm water until soft about 30 minutes; drain. Rinse in warm water; drain. Remove and discard stems; chop caps finely. Mix mushrooms pork bamboo shoots green onions egg white cornstarch salt 2 teaspoons soy sauce 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil and the white pepper.

title: Easy Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine in an 8 x 8-inch pan. In a bowl mix sugar flour cocoa eggs and vanilla. Pour in melted margarine and mix well. Pour back into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Real rich! Also doubles well to go in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Sweet Chunk Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and place whole cucumbers in crock. Cover with boiling water and let stand overnight. Drain and repeat this procedure on the next 3 mornings. On the fifth day drain and slice into 1/2-inch chunks.

title: Microwave 2 Minute Fudge
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole stir together sugar cocoa salt milk and vanilla until partially blended. Put butter over top in center of dish. Microwave on High power 2 minutes. Stir well until smooth. Pour into greased 8-inch square dish. Chill 1 hour. Makes 36 squares.

title: Grumpy'S Gazpacho(Serves 4)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream and chives. Chill thoroughly and serve in chilled cups or bowls. Top with sour cream and sprinkle with chives.

title: Creamy Chicken Vegetable Chowder
instructions: Combine milk chicken broth and both the canned soups in a 4-quart saucepan. Blend well. Add chicken onions corn chiles and mushrooms. Mix well. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Remove from heat. Add cheese. Stir until melted.

title: Fruit Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Boil dates prunes and raisins (that have been cut up) in a saucepan until thick. Add the oleo and leave until cool. Beat in the eggs then dry ingredients. Then add vanilla chopped nuts cereal and coconut. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Raw Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend items in blender. Use as a dip for raw carrot sticks celery cauliflower radishes pepper strips scallions etc.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix butter sugar eggs and bananas together and beat 2 minutes. Then add rest of ingredients. Mix all together and beat 2 or 3 minutes longer. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini in water for 5 minutes or until tender; drain. Beat eggs in large bowl until foamy. Add mayonnaise onion and green pepper to eggs. Add salt and pepper. Mix cheese with zucchini. Add to egg mixture; mix well. Pour into 6 cup shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fried Cabbage And Shells
instructions: Fry bacon in frying pan. Remove fried bacon but not the grease. Slice cabbage into 6 quarters then separate cabbage leaves and put in frypan with bacon grease. Cover frypan and cook over medium heat until tender (about 10 to 15 minutes). Add cooked drained macaroni and fried bacon to cabbage. Cook covered in frypan for 10 minutes over medium heat stirring periodically to avoid mixture burning. This can be used as a side dish or as a meal.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Remove 1/2 cup of mixture to sprinkle on top of cake before baking. Add the baking powder soda 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and nutmeg to remaining mixture. Add eggs and sour milk; beat until smooth. Pour into 2 (8-inch) greased cake pans.

title: Poppy Seed Dessert Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine first 5 ingredients. Add eggs milk oil and extracts. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 60 minutes. Cool on wire rack for 15 minutes before removing from pans.

title: Doubly Bubbly
instructions: Combine all ingredients; add 1 tray of ice cubes. Serves 20.

title: Nicki'S Raisin Bites
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar; add eggs and vanilla. Sift in dry ingredients. Fold in raisins drop by teaspoonful on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Yields approximately 5 dozen.

title: Jim'S Minestrone Soup
instructions: You will need a water-filled cauldron.

title: Avocados And Shrimp
instructions: Toss the shrimp with all ingredients except the last three listed. Chill shrimp mixture for 24 hours. Remove bay leaves and strain shrimp mixture. Sprinkle diced avocados with lime juice. Add avocados to the strained shrimp mixture. Serve on lettuce lined plates. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine bread cubes and 1 cup crumbs. Stir in broth eggs salt celery onion chicken and mushrooms. Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole. Melt butter or margarine and combine with 1/2 cup crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Whipping Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each. Add whipping cream. Beat just enough to mix. Add flour. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: The Veggie Dish
instructions: Line a glass dish with potatoes; place green beans on top. Then add corn and meat. Mix soup and milk together; pour over vegetables. Top with grated cheese. Cook on High in microwave for 8 minutes; let stand 2 minutes and then cook on Medium-high for an additional 2 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Chocolate Drops
instructions: Beat eggs; add soda and melted margarine. Stir in cake mix until well moistened. Stir in chocolate chips (and nuts if desired). Pinch off dough to form balls a little smaller than a walnut. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 13 minutes. Cool. Sift powdered sugar over tops. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Swiss Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix together. Bake in two layers at 325\u00b0.

title: Aunt Jenny'S Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and chill before serving.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes the night before. Next day grated potatoes and mix with onions. Set aside. Melt margarine and cheese in a pan. In a small bowl mix sour cream and milk. Add this to cheese mixture then add to potatoes in a casserole. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mommy'S Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. In a frying pan brown meat and onion. Drain excess oil. Combine meat onion macaroni corn and tomato soup in a casserole dish. Top with cheese slices. Bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: I chill my broccoli in ice water and drain well.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and chill.

title: Lisa'S Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Stir dry ingredients into bowl. Cut in shortening. Add milk; stir quickly. Knead. Roll dough to 1/2-inch. Cut out 12 biscuits. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Pour boiling water over jello stirring until jello is dissolved. Add orange sherbet stir until melted. Stir in 1 can of mandarin orange segments (1 cup). Pour into 6-cup ring mold chill until firm.

title: Basic Surprise
instructions: Combine oleo and sugar; beat in egg. Add flour using mixer. Make small balls and flatten. Put in cherries nuts dates or wafers. Roll into balls. Roll in coconut and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Check often.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Cream butter sugar and peanut butter together. Add Rice Krispies. Make into balls. Dip into melted semi-sweet chocolate.

title: Ham And Cheese Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease and flour 12 medium muffin cups. Beat milk oil and egg slightly in a large bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients with fork until moistened. Divide batter among cups. Bake until golden brown 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into 1-inch balls; flatten with fork. Bake 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes. Should be slightly brown on the edges. Makes 6 to 8 dozen.

title: German Bundt Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add egg yolks separately. Mix in extracts. Mix together flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. After greasing and flouring Bundt pan embed almond in each crease. Pour in batter. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Super-Easy Crab Dip
instructions: Put the cream cheese in a dish. (You can even leave it as it is.) Top with crab or shrimp drained. Pour cocktail sauce over it. Stick a knife in it and serve with crackers.

title: Oysters Mosca
instructions: Saute onion celery and garlic in butter; add seasoning and oysters. When edges curl add liquid then fold in bread crumbs. Put in casserole; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese or buttered bread crumbs or both. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Chile Roll
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Roll Velveeta between 2 pieces wax paper until about 1/2-inch thick. Spread cream cheese mixture on top of Velveeta. Roll like a jelly roll. Keep cold until about 20 minutes before serving. Serve with crackers. Makes large roll.

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: Combine browned sausage eggs pepperoni cheeses and parsley. Roll pizza dough in rectangle shape. Place mixture lengthwise down center of dough. Fold back over then tuck in ends. Fold front over. Roll onto cookie sheet or jelly roll pan. Using reserved egg yolk brush over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Slice and serve warm or cold as appetizer.

title: Hillbilly Salad
instructions: Sprinkle Jell-O straight from box on the cottage cheese and let stand for 1/2 hour. Then add can of Mandarin oranges and pineapple. Fold in 9 ounces of Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts or coconut.

title: Lemon Cheese Bars(Cheesecake Cookies)
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and oil until crumbly. Reserve one cup of cake mixture and pat the rest into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Beat cream cheese sugar lemon juice and 1 egg and spread over crust. Sprinkle top with reserved crumbs. Bake 15 minutes more. Cool completely and cut into bars.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients except candy Kisses. In large bowl mix on lowest speed with electric mixer or by spoon until dough forms. Shape dough into balls using a rounded teaspoonful for each. Roll balls in granulated sugar then place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes; dont overbake. Top each immediately with candy Kiss; press firmly so cookie cracks around edges. Let cool.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine the brown sugar and flour mixing well. In a large bowl combine eggs corn syrups vanilla and melted butter. Beat with a fork. Add the sugar mixture and mix well. Sprinkle the pecans over the bottom of the pie crust. Pour the filling on top of the pecans. As the pie bakes the pecans will rise to the top. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes until filling is set and pecans are golden brown. Cool before slicing.

title: Frozen Pudding Bars
instructions: Prepare pudding mix with milk as directed on package. Pour into paper or plastic cups to mold. Insert wooden stick. Freeze about 5 hours.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Dice celery green pepper and onion. Drain macaroni; add all ingredients. Mix well. Chill.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Separate eggs and beat whites until stiff; set aside. Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk; add alternately with flour. Beat well. Add coconut nuts and extracts. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.

title: Pumpkin Swirl Cheesecake(Makes 10 To 12 Servings)
instructions: Combine crumbs and margarine; press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch pan. Combine cheese 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Reserve 1 cup of cheese mixture; add pumpkin remaining sugar and spices to remaining cheese mixture. Mix well. Layer half of pumpkin mixture and half of cheese mixture over crust; repeat layers. Cut through batter with knife several times for marble effect. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Loosen cake from rim of pan; cool before removing rim of pan. Chill.

title: Pineapple Squash Bake
instructions: Thaw squash; combine with drained pineapple 4 tablespoons brown sugar and salt. Put in 1-quart casserole; dot top with butter. Sprinkle with remaining brown sugar. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: 2 Egg Custards
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; mix flour and sugar together real good and add to eggs. Then add milk vanilla and salt. Add all these together. Bake crusts until set then pour in the egg mixture and bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Turn oven back to 350\u00b0. Bake about 20 more minutes or until done when knife is inserted in center and comes out clean.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dry ingredients. Beat eggs with buttermilk; mix well. Stir into dry ingredients. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Debone chicken breasts and pound to flatten. Mix the cream cheese garlic dill parsley salt Tabasco sauce and lemon juice. Divide into 6 equal portions and place in center of chicken breasts. Roll breasts and place close together in baking dish. Combine wine and chicken broth. Pour over breasts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Homemade Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks and milk in top of double broiler. Mix sugar and flour and add to eggs and milk. Stir over boiling water until thickened. Add grated lemons and margarine. Pour into pie shells. Add vanilla flavoring.

title: Heart Healthy Coffee Cake(Lo-Fat)
instructions: In a medium bowl combine all-purpose flour whole wheat flour soda 1 teaspoon cinnamon and salt. Set aside. In a big bowl toss together chopped apples and egg substitute. Stir in sugar 1/4 cup nuts and applesauce. Add flour mixture and stir just enough to mix it. Pour batter into a 9-inch round baking pan.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cover casserole for the first 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail. Soften gelatin in lemon juice then dissolve over hot water. Blend cream cheese with mayonnaise and salt. Stir in gelatin. Whip cream until stiff adding sugar gradually during last stages of beating. Fold in cheese mixture nuts and fruit cocktail. Place in mold of your choice and freeze until firm (overnight). Turn out onto platter and garnish with watercress.

title: Peperonata
instructions: Cook and stir onions in oil in 10-inch skillet until tender; add remaining ingredients except tomatoes. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Add tomatoes; cover and simmer until green pepper is tender about 5 minutes. Garnish with ripe olives.

title: James' Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Beat eggs; add corn cornmeal oil soda salt and milk. Fold in onion pepper celery black pepper and chili powder. Pour in a 9-inch greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Punch For 35
instructions: Tie spices in cloth bag and simmer in the water for 10 minutes. Remove bag add 1 lemon sliced thin and the brown sugar; simmer about 15 minutes to make a syrup. Add the rest of the ingredients to the syrup and bring to boiling. Serve hot or cold.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco; add beaten eggs. Blend rest of ingredients. Take tablespoon of dough for each cookie. Put flour on hands so dough wont stick. Sprinkle sugar on top. Put on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 36 cookies. A good cut-out cookie.

title: Solo Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together well with mixer. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and sour cream by hand. Add baking powder salt and flour. Mix well. This will make batter stiff.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: In skillet over medium heat brown meat and onion until done. Pour off drippings; stir in corn tomato sauce rice steak sauce and black pepper. Set aside. Cut tops off peppers. Remove seeds. Spoon in mixture; arrange in 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until peppers are done.

title: Polynesian Chicken
instructions: Bake chicken at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Drain fat. Mix remaining ingredients together; pour over chicken. Bake an additional 45 minutes basting several times.

title: Cheese Bells
instructions: Gluh Wein is sold from stalls at the famous Nuremburg Christmas Market. All the stalls are in the open air and it is cold! The hot wine warms you to your toes and you are able to watch the animated clock and the pageant without freezing. The stalls sell ornaments crafts and most anything to do with Christmas for decorating cooking or gifts.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine first 7 ingredients; simmer for 8 to 10 minutes. Add beef 3 ounces cheese and rice. Stir until cheese melts. Spray pan with Pam. Pour into pan and sprinkle with rest of cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Let sit for 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Dressing For Cabbage
instructions: Boil all ingredients the let cool. Pour over shredded cabbage. Left over dressing may be stored in the refrigerator.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix sugar with juices. Pour in water. Place tea and spices in cloth bag. Add to water. Let steep 20 minutes. Remove bag. Serve hot. Makes 20 to 24 servings.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion salt and pepper. Drain well. In a casserole dish add ground beef and soup. Top with Tater Tots. Bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until Tater Tots are golden brown. Add cheese and return to oven just long enough for cheese to melt.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Peel and pull onion rings apart. Cook in butter in skillet until transparent. In a 2-quart casserole dish add layer of onions Parmesan cheese crushed Ritz crackers and pats of butter on crackers. Continue another layer ending with butter on crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and line pan with 1/2 of crumb mixture. Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Chill until set. Put Carnation milk in freezer in shallow pan until it starts to freeze. Then beat until stiff and add jello. In another bowl beat cream cheese with 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Fold cheese mixture into jello mixture and beat until smooth. Add crushed pineapple. Pour into lined pan. Top with remaining half of crumb mixture. Chill overnight.

title: Blueberry Trifle
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers; set aside. Mix condensed milk softened cream cheese Cool Whip and lemon juice until smooth. In trifle bowl put half of wafers; layer cream cheese mixture and layer of blueberry pie filling. Repeat layers. Chill in refrigerator until ready to serve. Extra Cool Whip can be put on top when ready to serve (optional).

title: Chicken Donatich
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and bread. Fry chicken in hot oil and drain. Bake chicken pieces with a small amount of butter for 15 minutes on 350\u00b0. Add chopped garlic vinegar tarragon chicken broth white wine salt and pepper and artichoke hearts (cut into smaller pieces) with the juice. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve on a bed of rice.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Eclairs(Only Fat From Frosting And Graham Crackers)
instructions: Mix contents of both boxes pudding with skim milk until thick. Prepare Dream Whip according to directions (use skim milk). Fold Dream Whip into pudding. Layer bottom of baking dish (9 x 13 x 2-inch) with graham crackers.

title: Fancy Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Oil a 10-inch round pie pan and place in oven to heat.

title: Cherry Dream Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate before serving. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients in double boiler until smooth. Let cool. Add Cool Whip. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine butter and flour in a saucepan over low heat; gradually add chicken broth and cream of chicken soup. Stir in chicken salt pepper and mixed vegetables. Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with one of the pastries. Add the chicken mixture and cover with second pastry. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until pastry is golden brown.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Shred all cheese together; add pimentos. Mix well. Add all other ingredients mixing until smooth. Chill 1/2 hour before serving. Serve on toasted bread or crackers.

title: Ooie Gooie Butter Cake
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Blend next 3 ingredients and pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve when cooled.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nutmeg in a large bowl. Mix well. Place in greased casserole. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Set casserole in a pan of water. Bake 90 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Zucchini Brownies
instructions: Mix flour cocoa and cinnamon together. Add eggs sugar oil vanilla and soda. Then add flour 1 cup at a time with buttermilk and zucchini. Bake in 10 x 15-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle on chocolate chips and nuts. Frost within 15 minutes after baking.

title: Sausage Patties
