instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape to form about 3 1/2-inch rounds and 3/8-inch thick. Pan-fry over medium heat for about 5 minutes per side.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Bake sugar cookie mix in pizza pan. While cookie is baking mix glaze.

title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat and saute onion and garlic. Add relish and chicken broth and cook with pot covered for 15 minutes over low heat. Add cream salt and chicken. Simmer another 8 to 10 minutes over low heat. Stir in cheese and serve hot.

title: Asparagus With Mustard-Dill Sauce
instructions: Combine all but asparagus. Cook asparagus until barely tender; cool in ice water and place on oval platter. Spoon some sauce over asparagus and serve balance in gravy boat.

title: Grandma Robbie'S Fried Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan. Season pancake mix with salt and pepper. Dip chicken in egg and the pancake flour and fry until golden brown.

title: Date Balls
instructions: I mash the dates as I cook this mixture. Cook the first 4 ingredients over low heat for 10 minutes. Add Rice Krispies and chopped nuts. When cool enough to handle make into small balls and roll in Angel Flake coconut.

title: Taos Inn Corn Chowder
instructions: Cut potatoes in 1/2-inch dice. Cover them with water by about 1-inch in large saucepan. Simmer until tender.

title: Marbled Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking pan in oven. After margarine is melted remove from oven. Press crushed Oreo cookies firmly and evenly. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Pour half of the batter evenly over prepared crust. Stir melted chocolate into remaining batter; spoon over vanilla batter. With table knife or spatula gently swirl through batter to marble. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Cool. Chill. Cut into bars. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and beaten egg yolks. Dissolve soda in buttermilk; dredge berries and nuts in flour. Add spices. Beat in egg whites and mix all together. Makes 3 (9-inch) layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Velvety Custard Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Slowly stir in hot milk. At once pour into unbaked pie shell. Dash top with nutmeg. Bake in very hot oven (475\u00b0) for 5 minutes; reduce heat to 425 and bake for 10 minutes longer or until knife inserted halfway in center comes out clean. Cool on rack. Serve cool or at room temperature. Yields 1 pie.

title: Gooey Butter Cake(Chocolate Or Vanilla)
instructions: Melt butter (margarine) in a 10 x 13-inch pan. Mix box of cake mix with 3 eggs. The dough will be stiff but spread over melted butter to form crust. Mix cream cheese sugar and 2 eggs. Mix well with low speed mixer. Pour over crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done about 30 minutes. If using chocolate bake 20 minutes then spoon white mixture more evenly over chocolate. Bake 10 more minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Corned Beef Ball
instructions: Mix and roll in balls. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Saute onions in oil for 2 minutes. Add soy sauce sugar and 1 1/2 cups water; heat to boiling. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes or until onions are tender. Mix cornstarch with 1/4 cup water. Gradually stir into onion mixture. Cook stirring constantly until sauce is thickened. Keep warm. Mix ground beef and salt and pepper. Shape into four 1-inch thick patties. Place patties on rack in broiling pan; broil 4 minutes on each side or until done. Place patties in casserole dish and spoon onion mixture on top and keep warm in oven until ready to serve.

title: Vegetable Bar
instructions: Spread crescent rolls on pan. Bake until done (about 10 minutes); cool. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise and Ranch dressing. Spread on rolls. Top with all vegetables. Cut into squares.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over butter sugar and salt. Stir to mix well. Cool. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Beat in eggs and add to cooled mixture. Add flour. Mix well. Let rest in refrigerator over night. Roll dough out to thickness of 1/4 inch. Cut rolls with biscuit cutter 2 hours before baking. Preheated oven at 450 degrees. Bake rolls for 12 minutes or until golden brown. Rolls can be frozen before they are cooked.

title: Hot Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and cream of potato soup. Add shrimp onion horseradish salt and pepper. Blend until smooth. Spread 1/2 of shrimp mixture into bottom of buttered deep dish pie pan. Sprinkle with almonds and half of grated cheese. Add remaining shrimp mixture. Sprinkle remaining Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Great with crackers or potato chips. Best when served hot.

title: Wendy'S Chili
instructions: Brown beef; drain off fat. Using a fork crumble the cooked beef into pea-sized pieces. In a large pot combine beef and all the remaining ingredients and bring to a simmer over low heat. Cook 2 to 3 hours stirring every 15 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder together and set aside. Cut oleo sugar salt and vanilla together and mix until crumbly. Take 3/4 cup of this mixture for topping and set aside. Bread eggs and add milk to flour mixture. Beat until creamy. Bake in a greased pan. Sprinkle crumbly mixture over top and add a sprinkle of cinnamon. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gluhwein
instructions: Mix juice from lemons and oranges with wine and sugar. Simmer until nice and warm.

title: Pretzel
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together; set aside. In another bowl mix the yeast warm water warm milk and egg yolks. Mix everything together except egg whites raisins and brown sugar. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Roll out thin like pie crust. Spread on stiffly beaten egg whites brown sugar and raisins on half the dough. Fold over; pinch dough together at edges. Put small slits in top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Powdered sugar or glaze topping is optional.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Place egg whites in shallow bowl. Place 1/2 cup of cornstarch in a shallow dish. Dip chicken pieces in egg whites and coat with cornstarch.

title: Dreamsicle Cake Ii
instructions: Follow the recipe on the box substituting milk instead of water. Also use orange extract. Bake in 2 round cake pans. Cut layers in half after cooled.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Add zucchini chips and nuts. Gradually add dry ingredients. Mix well. Grease and flour pans. I use 2 loaf pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Wash and prepare peppers and onions. Grind in food mill. Combine with other ingredients. Boil 30 minutes. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes and mix with all ingredients except the 1/4 cup butter and corn flakes. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan; top with butter and corn flakes mixed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours. Will keep for several days.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Crumble angel food cake in bowl. Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip together and add to cake. Pat into 13 x 9 pan and add strawberries to glaze and then pour over cake mixture. Chill.

title: Roasted Spiced Turkey Breast
instructions: Combine all ingredients except turkey in large shallow pan or bowl. Add turkey; marinate for 1 hour in refrigerator turning once. Discard unused marinade. Cover the breasts with foil; roast for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Baste occasionally. Uncover; roast for an additional 30 to 40 minutes until brown.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in large saucepan. Drain. Pour soups and sauce over meat. Stir and heat thoroughly. Empty chips into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour heated mixture over the chips. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 450\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fried Zucchini Sticks
instructions: Stir together bread crumbs cheese onion salt and garlic powder in medium bowl. Stir together egg whites and water in small bowl. Pour corn oil into heavy 3-quart saucepan or deep frying filling no more than 1/3 full. Heat over medium heat at 375\u00b0. Dip zucchini sticks in egg mixture then coat with crumbs. Carefully add to oil in single layer. Fry about 1 minute turning once or until crisp and lightly browned. Drain on paper towel and serve.

title: Dry Spice Tea Mix
instructions: Mix in\tjar. Can be used by teaspoon or made in larger quantity. Orange juice cranberry etc. can be added. Can add peppermint or cinnamon stick orange and lemon slices.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Place all ingredients except ice cubes into blender container. Cover and process at liquefy. With motor running remove feeder cap and add ice cubes one at a time. Continue to process until smooth.

title: English Trifle
instructions: Thaw strawberries. Drain peaches. Cut pound cake in half lengthwise. Cut each half crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices.

title: Super Quick Danish Pastries
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Make a well and add egg and milk. Stir until smooth; it may be necessary to add more milk to get a batter that can hold its shape.

title: Lite Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: You will need a 9 x 13-inch lasagna dish or pan.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Uncover and brown about 15 minutes.

title: Crunchy Drop Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together the brown sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Blend egg milk and vanilla. Add combined flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in cereal. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire cooling rack. Store in loosely covered container.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Garlic Croutons
instructions: Spread butter or margarine over both sides of bread slices; sprinkle with garlic powder. Cut into 3/4-inch cubes. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until croutons are crisp and dry. Let croutons cool then store in an airtight container. Yields about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Lay rolls flat on a cookie sheet. Pinch edges together. Bake as directed. Cool completely.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Brown hamburger and onion drain. Mix all together but macaroni pepperoni and part of the cheese. Layer macaroni and sauce in dish like lasagna. Put pepperoni and rest of cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Hot Crab Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Split muffins and butter. Spread mixture on muffins. Cut each muffin into fourths. Cut each fourth in half. Broil until hot and bubbly. May be frozen. Partly thaw when ready to serve.

title: Nut Snacks
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add other ingredients (only mix so as to leave some flour not completely blended in). Spread dough in 9 x 13-inch pan (ungreased) and pat down.

title: Frozen Pecan Log Roll
instructions: Crumble real fine the wafers. Mix Eagle Brand milk then nuts cherries and coconut; on wax paper roll into long log in wax paper then freeze. Also very good without coconut and cherries. A rich snack.

title: Calypso Pie
instructions: Pour cookies into bowl and blend with softened butter with a pastry blender or a fork. Place into a 10-inch pie pan and press crumb mixture firmly and evenly to bottom and sides of pan with the back of a spoon. Chill for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak in small strips and brown in oil turning often. Stir in onion soup mix and 2 cups water. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in peppers; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup water. Stir into meat mixture. Cook until thickened. Serve with cooked rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Homemade French Dressing
instructions: Mix all in blender and keep in refrigerator. Makes 1 quart. This is very good and inexpensive.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Cook brownie mix according to package directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. When done punch holes in the brownies. Mix 3 tablespoons coffee that has been perked and 1 tablespoon sugar. Drizzle into the brownies. Mix 3 packages chocolate mousse according to directions. Crumble up brownies in bottom of trifle bowl. Over this put the mousse then 12 ounces Cool Whip. Fill to the top. Break up 6 Skor candy bars and sprinkle on top.

title: Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in ungreased casserole. Top with crushed potato chips; bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Loaf Cake
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs and water. Beat on medium speed until mixture is well-blended.

title: 5 Can Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a Corning Ware dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Spoon Bread
instructions: Combine eggs muffin mix both corns sour cream and butter. Spread in a 11 x 7 x 1-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 10 to 15 minutes more or until knife comes out clean.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix peanut butter and butter together with confectioners sugar until smooth texture develops. Form small balls the size of buckeyes. Refrigerate balls. Next melt slowly the chocolate chips and paraffin together in top of double boiler. Using a toothpick dip cold buckeyes into chocolate until 2/3 covered. Let dry on waxed paper. Makes about 166 candies.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak in long narrow strips. Salt pepper and flour steak. Brown in small amount of oil. Drain oil and add tomatoes onions and peppers. Cook until tender about 40 minutes. Serve over rice. Serves 6.

title: Company Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions adding mandarin oranges (drained). Bake for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool.

title: Blueberry Crisp
instructions: Place raw berries in baking dish. Mix flour sugar salt and butter together with pastry blender. Sprinkle over berries. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Delicious warm. Some people like whipped cream or ice cream served over the crisp.

title: Crispy Fried Chicken
instructions: Wash and dry chicken. Sprinkle in Accent and let stand 15 minutes. Pour milk into bowl. Combine flour salt paprika and pepper. Dip chicken pieces in milk; roll in flour mixture. Pour oil in skillet to a depth of 1/2-inch. Heat until a drop of water sizzles in oil. Fry chicken uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes on each side turning only once. Drain well on absorbent paper.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a rolling boil. Boil 3 minutes stirring. Then remove from heat. Stir in 1 cup peanut butter. Blend in vanilla and oats. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken soup mushroom soup sour cream and water chestnuts; mix well and add chicken. Put in a casserole dish and make a topping of 1 1/2 cup any butter cracker crumbs and 1 stick oleo. Spread on top of chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and shape into balls roll in chopped pecans and top with drained red cherries (freeze well).

title: Bar-Be-Que Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and pepper in skillet. Mix all ingredients together and simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Lenora'S Ice Cream
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Add enough carton milk to make 1 gallon.

title: Easy And Quick Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and slice into large pot. Cover sliced cucumbers with water add lime; stir cover and let stand 24 hours. Rinse cucumbers until water is completely clear. Mix together sugar vinegar and spices; heat until hot. Pour over drained cucumbers and let stand 24 hours.\tCook cucumbers and sugar mixture 1 hour. Pour into hot sterile jars.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together pretzels powdered sugar and melted butter. Spread in a 9 x 13 inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool completely. Mix together cream cheese 1 c. powdered sugar egg and Cool Whip. Spread on pretzel mixture and chill while you dissolve jell-o in boiling water. Add raspberries and pour on top of cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate until set.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Cream together salad oil sugar and eggs. Add zucchini flour cinnamon vanilla salt baking soda and baking powder. Pour into 2 standard loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in greased pans.

title: Country-Style Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops between 2 sheets of plastic wrap. Pound lightly with flat side of mallet until meaty portion covers about twice the surface as before pounding. Sprinkle on both sides with salt and pepper. Dip in flour to coat. Beat together egg and water. Dip chops into mixture. Spread dry crumbs over plastic wrap and coat chops on both sides. Lightly pound again to make crumbs adhere to chops. Heat oil and butter in heavy skillet. Add chops. Cook over medium-high heat for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden brown. Transfer to heated platter. Serve immediately.

title: Ada'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes. When done put through a sieve or mash thoroughly\twith masher. Then add rest of ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake\t20 minutes in 425\u00b0 oven. Reduce temperature to 300\u00b0. Continue baking 25 to 30 minutes longer or until knife comes out clean.

title: Mom'S Fudge Cake
instructions: Stir together first 3 ingredients and cool. Sift together soda salt sugar and flour three times. Add dry ingredients to chocolate mixture. Stir until smooth. Add eggs sour milk and vanilla to chocolate mixture. Stir well but dont overbeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or two 8-inch round pans. Frost with Peanut Butter Fudge Frosting.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain well. Add other ingredients. Add salt to taste and mix well. Fold in enough mayonnaise to hold ingredients together.

title: Banana Nut Loaf
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar in large bowl. Mix bananas vanilla and eggs into mixture of shortening and sugar. Sift flour salt and soda; add alternately with buttermilk. Stir in pecans and put into prepared pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Glaze is optional.

title: Lite Bran Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Yields approximately 15 muffins.

title: Margarita Jelly
instructions: Measure water lime juice tequila and liqueur into a 6 or 8-quart saucepan. Stir in food coloring. Measure sugar into a separate bowl. Mix sugar thoroughly into juice mixture. Add margarine. Bring to a full rolling boil over high heat stirring constantly. Quickly stir in pectin. Return to full rolling boil exactly 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat; skin off any foam with metal spoon. Ladle quickly into clean hot jars filling to within 1/8-inch of top. Wipe jar rims and threads. Cover with lids. Screw bands tightly. Invert jars 5 minutes then turn upright. Check seals after jars are cooled. Makes about 5 (1 cup) jars.

title: Brunch Pizza
instructions: Separate dough into triangles and put on 12-inch pizza pan or 13 x 9-inch pan. Make 1/2-inch rim all around edges. Beat eggs with seasoning and salt. Pour onto crust. Top with ham cheese broccoli mushrooms green pepper and tomato. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until eggs are set and crust is golden brown.

title: Icebox Pickles
instructions: Put cucumbers onion and green pepper in large airtight container. Mix salt vinegar sugar celery seed and mustard seed together and pour over cucumbers. Set in refrigerator and stir every day for three days or longer if needed. Will keep several weeks. Must be kept refrigerated.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix flour and margarine. Press mixture into bottom of an 11 x 7-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Baked Potato In Blanket
instructions: Tenderize steak. Peel potatoes. Rub salt on potatoes. Cut steak into pieces to fit around potatoes. Wrap and pin with toothpicks. Roll in flour and brown in fat. Place in greased casserole dish and bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) for 1 hour and 20 minutes. May baste with hot water during baking to prevent steak from drying. Good with brown gravy.

title: Oven Stew
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and cover. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours. Add potatoes green peppers salt and pepper one-half hour before serving. Cook 7 hours for a double recipe.

title: Cocktail Wieners Or Smoked Sausage
instructions: Mix mustard and jelly in chafing dish or saucepan over low heat. Slice the frankfurters or sausage diagonally in bite size pieces. Add to sauce and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Hard Pretzels
instructions: Spread butter over pretzels; sprinkle on soup mix and garlic powder. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 15 minutes on each side.

title: Fruit Salad Cake
instructions: Mix everything and bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Corn On The Grill
instructions: Pull back husks from corn. (Do not remove.) Remove silks. Rub corn with butter; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pull husks over corn and tie the top with heavy string. Cook covered with grill lid over medium-hot coals (350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0) for 15 to 20 minutes turning occasionally. Remove strings and serve.

title: Grandma Devrie'S Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add orange juice and cranberry sauce. Stir in ice cream. Cool. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and butter add eggs and pecans. Bake in shell 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fruit Tea Punch
instructions: Make a syrup of sugar and water in a large saucepan. Add tea fruit juice and water (enough to make 1 1/2 gallons). Add ginger ale just before serving. May freeze all ingredients except ginger ale. Serves 50.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Stir in sugar corn syrup and butter. Then stir in pecans and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake in center of oven for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Roasted Mustard Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a roasting pan 3 times to coat with the vegetable oil. Put the mustard paprika cumin chili powder and cayenne pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to blend. Prick the potatoes several times with the tines of a fork and add them to the bowl. Toss to coat the potatoes evenly. Pour the coated potatoes into the prepared roasting pan leaving a little space between them. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour until the potatoes are fork tender.

title: Quick Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion soup mix together. Add sauce to hamburger and simmer 15 minutes. Add to spaghetti or serve over spaghetti.

title: Pepper Steak(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: In a large skillet or wok stir-fry the garlic in 1 tablespoon of the butter or margarine for 1 minute. Add the onions and green sweet peppers; stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Transfer the vegetables with a slotted spoon to a bowl.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Gradually beat in egg yolks. Blend in vanilla and pineapple. Fold in sifted dry ingredients. Rinse beaters and beat egg whites. Beat until stiff; fold into batter. Pour into 2 (9-inch) cake pans greased. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 35 minutes. Cool in pans for 5 minutes. Frost with 7 Minute Icing.

title: Breaded Pork Chops
instructions: Add salt and pepper to bread crumbs. Beat eggs; add milk. Dip pork chops in liquid; roll in crumbs. Put 3 tablespoons margarine in skillet; brown pork chops. Place chops into a baking pan or dish; add boiling water. Cover; bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Take the cover off about the last 10 minutes.

title: Leche Frita(Fried Custard Squares)
instructions: Start preparation the night before or several hours in advance. In saucepan combine milk lemon peel and cinnamon. Bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer 10 minutes. Set aside. In another large saucepan beat egg yolks until lemon colored. Beat in 6 tablespoons sugar then cornstarch. Stir in few tablespoons of hot milk then gradually stir in the rest. Cook over moderate heat stirring constantly about 4 minutes or until thickened. Discard lemon peel and cinnamon stick. Pour into a large greased rectangular pan and cool. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Cut into small squares. Dust with flour and dip in beaten egg. Heat oil and fry until brown on all sides. Drain. Dust with a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Just before serving sprinkle with powdered sugar. If you wish serve with strawberry jam.

title: Double Chocolate Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crushed cookies and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add onion and saute 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Add broth salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Place bread in bottom of ovenproof casserole. Sprinkle with 1/2 of cheese. Pour soup over bread and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: In a large mixer bowl beat brown sugar peanut butter and margarine until light and fluffy; blend in water egg and vanilla. Add oats flour and soda; mix well. Chill dough until firm (about 30 minutes). Form dough into 1-inch balls; place on ungreased cookie sheets and flatten slightly with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Taco Dip And Chips
instructions: Mix together the cream cheese sour cream and taco mix. Sprinkle Mozzarella and Cheddar cheeses on top.\tServe with taco chips.

title: Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with both sugars. Combine eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour oatmeal salt soda and baking powder. Mix well. Add grated chocolate chocolate chips and nuts. Mix well. Roll dough into balls and place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 6 - 7 minutes until light brown. Cool for 2 - 3 minutes and remove to rack to cool completely. Yields approximately 10 dozen cookies.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Melt peanut butter in 2 sticks of butter or margarine. Stir in the box of confectioners sugar. Stir until well mixed. Form into balls. Put on waxed paper on a cookie sheet. Place the balls in the refrigerator until chilled and firm. Melt the chocolate chips and the paraffin. When the balls are chilled using toothpicks dip each in the chocolate mixture and place in the refrigerator to set chocolate. Can be frozen.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine until tender. Add remaining ingredients (except spaghetti). Cook over low heat until sauce is smooth and cheese is melted. Add spaghetti and a little more broth. Pour mixture into 2 medium casserole dishes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Bread Pudding
instructions: Place the bread cubes in a greased 2-quart casserole; pour butter over and toss to coat. In a medium bowl lightly beat eggs. Add milk sugar vanilla cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Stir in bananas. Pour over bread cubes and stir to coat. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar margarine and shortening. Beat in 6 eggs. Add flour milk vanilla and lemon juice; beat thoroughly. Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan. Start in cold oven and bake 1 3/4 hours at 350\u00b0 until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chicken Broccoli-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Combine both soups water and pepper in bowl. Add to cooked chicken in frying pan; bring to boil. Stir in rice. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Add broccoli and peppers; simmer for 5 minutes uncovered.

title: Steak And Rice
instructions: Cut steak in 1-inch cubes; brown in butter. Add tomatoes soy sauce parsley mushrooms black pepper water and bouillon cubes. Cook until steak is tender and broth is thickened. Then add green pepper and onion. Simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Quick, Healthy And Easy Chili Beans
instructions: Brown meat with 2 tablespoons low-fat cooking oil. Drain. Put meat in crock-pot. Add remaining ingredients and cook on slow all day for a delicious home cooked dinner.

title: Corn Bread Taco Bake
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients; pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Prepare corn muffin mix except add 1/2 can onion rings. Spoon around outer edge of casserole. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with cheese and remaining onions. Bake 2 or 3 minutes longer.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all except onion rings. Pour into baking dish. Cover and bake 35 minutes at 375\u00b0. Uncover and top with onion rings. Brown about five minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans chop onion and combine with soups bean sprouts and water chestnuts. Add a shake of soy sauce. Put in greased 9 x 13 casserole dish. Combine soups and spread on top. Grate cheese on top. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Top with fried onion rings and serve.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix sugar and chocolate over low heat add other ingredients. Bring mixture to a rapid boil. Boil one minute. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Cool. Spread on cake.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs oil bananas nuts and pineapple. Grease and flour 3 layer cake pans. Pour into the 3 pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Frost.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Lay asparagus in casserole dish with eggs sliced on top; set aside. Make cheese sauce in pan. Heat milk butter and flour then add cheese and mix until smooth. Pour over asparagus and eggs. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast water and sugar until dissolved. Mix in all other ingredients until well mixed. Let rise punch down and make into rolls. Place on lightly oiled pan and let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Fudge
instructions: Stir good; put on low heat until melted. Let boil 7 minutes add 3 six-ounce packages of chocolate chips 1 pint marshmallow creme and 1 1/2 cup nuts. Let cool short time and pour into large cookie sheets. Makes 4 lb.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all together in casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Diabetic Cookies(1 Serving Bread)
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Cream together butter and powdered sugar. Add in flour and blend thoroughly. Press into ungreased 9 x 13 baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Combine eggs sugar and lemon juice and blend until light lemony color. Add dry ingredients together and add to lemon mixture. Pour into baked crust for 30 minutes. Cool and sift a little powdered sugar over top. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in large saucepan. Add onions carrots and peppers. Cook until onions and carrots are tender. Add beef; cook until crumbly. Stir in juice potatoes and seasonings. Cover and cook over low heat for 25 minutes. Mix flour with 1 cup of milk; beat until free of lumps. Add to soup. Add rest of milk. Heat and serve. Serves 4.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cut up all vegetables into bite size pieces. Add the rest of ingredients and simmer over low heat for 1 hour.

title: Frosty Holiday Grapes
instructions: Combine sugar and gelatin; mix well. Dip grape clusters in water; shake off excess water. Sprinkle sugar mixture through a sieve over wet grapes. Place on waxed paper about 45 minutes or until completely dry. Makes 10 edible garnishes. (Very decorative from Thanksgiving through the New Year; makes your table and platters very attractive.)

title: Nutty Nuggets
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add all other ingredients except powdered sugar. Stir until mixed well. Form little balls and bake 15 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool and roll in powdered sugar. Makes about 48 balls.

title: No-Fuss Lasagna
instructions: To make a day ahead and bake just before serving In a large saucepan brown ground beef; drain. Add tomato paste water spaghetti sauce mix sugar parsley salt garlic powder and pepper. Simmer partially covered for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Cajun Dirty Rice
instructions: In a large skillet brown pork and gizzards in hot oil. Add flour onion green pepper celery garlic parsley salt and spices. Simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: To make sauce cook onion in butter or margarine until tender but not brown. Stir in flour 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Add milk. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more. Remove from heat.

title: Wassail
instructions: Boil together in pan.

title: Piggy Bank Pork Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain. Melt shortening in large skillet. Brown meat. Drain off fat. Stir in noodles soup corn (with liquid) pimiento (with liquid) cheese and green pepper. Pour into ungreased 1-quart casserole. Bake uncovered 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix all together. Drop by spoon into hot deep fat. Cook until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Serve hot.

title: Dream Salad
instructions: Combine jello sugar and pineapple juice in saucepan; bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add marshmallows that have been cut into small pieces. Cool. Drain pineapple. Add the remaining ingredients to jello mixture. Whip the whipping cream first. I use long square glass dish. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours.

title: Anytime Muffins
instructions: Mix together cereal flour salt baking soda and sugar. Add eggs oil and buttermilk; stir well. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 5 dozen muffins.

title: Oven Fish Chowder
instructions: Put ingredients in large casserole dish. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Scald cream and add when done.

title: Anna'S Favorite Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain fat. Put hamburger into casserole dish. Spread drained corn on top of meat. Make potatoes according to package directions. Spread on top of corn. Sprinkle cheese over the top of the potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes to heat and melt cheese.

title: Potato Biscuits
instructions: Boil potatoes with jackets on; take them out of skimmer; drain and squeeze with a towel to insure being dry. Remove the skin; mash perfectly free from lumps. Add butter egg and sweet milk. When cool beat in yeast. Put in just enough flour to make stiff dough. When this rises do the same as biscuits and bake. Dough can be dropped into meat soups for pot pie.

title: Divinity
instructions: Mix sugar corn syrup and water in saucepan. Stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved; cook without stirring to 260\u00b0 (a little dropped into cold water forms a hard ball). Remove from heat and pour beating constantly in a fine stream into the beaten egg whites. Add vanilla and continue beating until mixture holds its shape and becomes slightly dull; fold in nuts. Drop quickly from tip of buttered spoon onto waxed paper in individual peaks or spread in butter pan and cut into 1-inch squares when firm. Makes 48 squares.

title: Homemade Finger Paint
instructions: Mix flour with salt. Add 2 1/2 cups cold water. Stir until smooth. Gradually add this mixture to 2 cups boiling water. Boil until smooth. Add food coloring and stir until well blended.

title: Shrimp Creole(For 4)
instructions: Melt 2 teaspoons margarine in a heavy saucepan and add celery onion and green pepper. Saute until onions are clear. Add tomatoes and seasonings and simmer 20 minutes. Add shrimp and cook for 3 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve on rice.

title: Krispy Bars
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Stir in peanut butter blending well. Remove from heat and spread into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour Rice Krispies over peanut butter mixture in pan and press firmly. Melt remaining ingredients in saucepan and pour over Rice Krispies. Cut into bars. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Old-Fashioned Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Cook pumpkin and combine with eggs. Mix well. Stir in sugar and flour. Blend in spices and milk. Mix thoroughly. Pour into already baked pie shells. Makes 3 to 4 pies. Bake until golden brown.

title: Chicken A La Maria Elena
instructions: Hint For less fat mix 1/2 Total 1% with regular.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream first 4 ingredients; beat until fluffy. Beat in flour with flavoring. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Hearty Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain and cool thoroughly. In a large mixing bowl combine crabmeat eggs celery onion parsley salt and pepper. Combine with macaroni and chill before serving. Garnish with additional hard-cooked eggs.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Layer pineapple and bread crumbs. Top with butter and sugar. Bake about 20 to 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Delicious with ham.

title: Molasses Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients first then put the eggs and milk in mixing bowl and stir along with molasses. Pour this in the dry ingredients; mix like you would biscuits until it is all thoroughly mixed. Pinch off a piece of dough and put in about 7 or 8-inch pie pan; roll this on a floured board or your table. Cut with a biscuit cutter or even something larger for bigger cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 or 13 minutes. Stick toothpick in the cookies or cake to see if it comes out dry if so its done.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Place berries in bottom of 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Mix dry ingredients in bowl; add melted butter milk and beaten eggs. Spoon batter over berries. Mix an additional 1/3 c. sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch. Sprinkle over batter. Now pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Chicken In Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in butter in a large skillet until tender. Add remaining ingredients except chicken and simmer 5 minutes. Add the chicken and cover with lid. Cook over medium heat for 45 minutes turning once.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo and add flour spinach juice milk and onion. Cook until thick. Add seasonings and cheese. Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Add spinach. Set in the refrigerator 6 hours or overnight. Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine peanut butter Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl; beat until well blended. Add egg; beat until just blended. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed. Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork.\tBake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Saute onion in butter; add to broccoli. Stir in rice. Add Cheez Whiz and mushroom soup. Put in large shallow dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Baked Grapefruit With Raisins And Nuts
instructions: Cut grapefruit in half crosswise. Run knife around each segment to loosen. Snip out the center core with kitchen shears. Combine raisins and walnuts; place in center of each grapefruit half. Drizzle honey over grapefruit. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve at once. Yields 4 servings.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: You will need 1 large brown bag.

title: Mrs. H. S. Avant, Sr. Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers; cut in pieces. Place in dish; cover with boiling water. Sprinkle salt and alum over cucumbers. Let cucumbers stand in water until water is lukewarm. Remove from water and rinse. Drain on towel. Make syrup of sugar vinegar and spices. Boil syrup; pour over cucumbers which have been placed in sterilized jars. Seal and turn upside down.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Bake in a greased loaf pan in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven 80 minutes for metal loaf pan or 65 minutes for glass loaf pan.

title: Marjorie'S Chicken
instructions: Mix all together and pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered or until chicken is tender. Serve with white rice.

title: Christmas Tree Sandwiches
instructions: You will need a Christmas tree cookie cutter; be sure cutter is not larger than bread.

title: Crunchy Pound Cake
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar thoroughly; add eggs alternating with flour. Add flavorings. Bake in a tube pan for 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and let cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Toss in oil. Mix remaining ingredients and add to lightly greased crock-pot. Cover and cook on low 3 to 4 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo. Combine with flour to make a paste. Combine cottage cheese and eggs; add to flour mixture. Add cheese to broccoli. Put in a buttered casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: In a large skillet brown pork chops in oil; sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper. Meanwhile in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish combine rice water tomato sauce and taco seasoning; mix well. Arrange chops over rice; top with green pepper. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until chops are browned and juices run clear. Uncover and sprinkle with cheese; bake until cheese is melted.

title: Diabetic Fluffy Fruit Dessert
instructions: Mix and chill thoroughly.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Pour hot vinegar back over pickles and seal.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook meat onion and garlic until brown. Add tomatoes paste pepper salt oregano and basil. Cook 15 minutes.

title: Fluffy Coconut Frosting
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Blend in sugar milk and extract. Fold in whipped topping and coconut. Makes about 4 cups or enough to frost tops and sides of 2 (8 or 9-inch) cakes.

title: Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Saute pumpkin and sugar in butter over medium heat for 15 minutes. Add milk salt\tand pepper. Bring to a boil. Serve with toast on crackers. Yields 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix first four ingredients until fluffy. Add rest of ingredients. Roll about 1/4-inch thick. Cut with cookie cutter. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven about 12 minutes or light brown.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well; add beaten whole egg. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with the soup. Add chopped nuts and dates which have been floured lightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool and frost.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Heat to boil the apple juice cloves and lemon juice. In a mug place the cinnamon stick butter and rum. After removing the cloves pour the hot juice into the prepared mug.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
instructions: Cook sugar crushed pineapple and jello in pan until dissolved. Add 2 cups cool water. Set until about half set and add cream cheese and Velveeta cheese. Stir and then fold Cool Whip into it and let set several hours.

title: Caramel Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions substituting the buttermilk for the water and adding the pudding. Bake in layer pans.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Set aside. Saute onions in butter. Add noodles and cook uncovered 3 minutes. Stir in broccoli (including liquid) and pepper. Cook 3 more minutes. Add milk and cheese and stir until cheese melts.

title: Misti'S Ice Cream
instructions: *Use 4 bananas (crushed) 2 cups strawberries 2 cups peaches or 1 small container of Hersheys chocolate syrup.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in one bowl. Pour into greased loaf pans and bake one hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Texas Monkey Bread
instructions: Sprinkle chopped pecans in the bottom of well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan; set aside. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Cut biscuits into quarters and roll each piece in sugar mixture. Layer in pan. Combine brown sugar and butter. Pour over dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan and invert.

title: Italian Tomato Sauce
instructions: Saute garlic in olive oil. Add pepper and onion. Add meat; saute. Add crushed tomatoes and paste. Add spices; add water. Simmer on low for 2 to 3 hours. Serve over favorite pasta. May substitute boneless pork for pepperoni or hamburg.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add pineapple and pie filling. Mix well and congeal.

title: Cajun Stewed Okra
instructions: Soak okra in cold water about 30 minutes before cooking. Drain and cut into pieces. Sprinkle with salt pepper garlic powder and season all. Drop okra into a bag into which you have placed the flour. Shake bag coating the okra. In large skillet covered with oil and heated drop okra in and fry until slime is gone. Add all dry ingredients while stirring over low heat to keep from sticking. When okra is tender add all other ingredients cover and cook over low heat adding water as needed to keep from sticking. Stir often. You may add more salt pepper etc to reach flavor desired. Should cook at least 1 hour.

title: Aunt Marie'S Pickles
instructions: Dissolve salt mustard seed celery seed and sugar in vinegar over low heat. Do not boil! Cool and pour over cucumbers. Let stand in refrigerator for 24 hours. Will keep in refrigerator for months or can be frozen.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and water. Mix well. Bring to a boil until clear over moderate heat. Add jello (dry). Put strawberries in mixture and pour in baked pie shell. Cool. Add Cool Whip when ready to serve.

title: Oatmeal-Coconut Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir all filling ingredients in a large bowl until well blended. Pour into pie shell. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes until top and crust are golden and a pick inserted in center comes out clean but oily (filling may still jiggle in center). Serves 8.

title: Phat-Thai
instructions: Soak the rice stick (like noodles) in warm water until tender but not soft. In a large wok saute garlic in hot oil add shrimp and cook until just pink.\tRemove shrimp set it aside and\tadd chicken. Remove chicken after browned and cook the eggs scrambled chopping the eggs with spatula when firm. Remove the eggs and stir-fry the tofu. Remove tofu add noodles vinegar\tpaprika and cayenne pepper sauce; cook for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Mix in previously cooked ingredients and bean sprouts. Toss well and cook for an additional 3 to 4 minutes.\tServe with a topping of crushed peanuts and (optional) lemon wedges on the side.

title: Pecan Squares
instructions: Beat egg whites in bowl add sugar and melted butter. Add vanilla nuts and flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Soften bread crumbs in milk. Add beef onions eggs and seasoning. Brown in butter. Remove meat balls. Stir in flour. Blend well. Dissolve cubes in hot water. Add to flour. Add milk and cream. Cook. Stir constantly until smooth (3 minutes). Add meat balls. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes until sauce is desired consistency. Makes 96 (1-inch) meat balls.

title: Stuffed Okra Curry
instructions: Mix all the spices and salt together; set aside. Slit the okra lengthwise without separating all the way through. Stuff them individually with spice mixture. Heat up oil in a vessel. When hot add stuffed okra. Saute it for a few minutes then cover the vessel with a lid and let cook on medium heat. Stir the okra intermittently to prevent burning. May add more oil if needed. Cook the okra until done.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers. Add salt and soak 3 hours in ice water. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and seal in jars.

title: Pop Cake
instructions: Add can of pop ONLY to the cake mix and mix and bake according to the directions on the box. DO NOT ADD OIL WATER OR EGGS.

title: Rice Medley
instructions: Saute onion peppers and mushrooms in half stick of margarine. Boil rice add onion pepper and mushrooms to rice add corn and other half stick of margarine. Season with salt and pepper and place in microwave to heat. You can also make it a main dish by adding fried scallops or chunked chicken.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix according to directions and bake until done in layers. Cool and frost with Icing. Beat eggs. Add milk sugar and margarine. Cook over medium heat for about 12 minutes stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat and add coconut nuts and vanilla. Spread on cooled cake layers.

title: The Big Bad Wolf'S Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with margarine. Melt the margarine and chocolate in a large saucepan over very low heat. Remove the saucepan from the heat. Stir in the sugar flour baking powder vanilla and eggs and beat well with an eggbeater. Stir in nuts.

title: Sweet Potato Crisp
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes; peel and slice crosswise about 3/8-inch thick. Spread in a greased shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cut margarine into flour and brown sugar as you would in making a pie crust. Add pepper milk and ground nuts; mix well. Spread over potato slices. Broil about 6-inches from heat until bubbly and carmelized about 7 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and shape into 1-inch balls. Store in covered container in refrigerator or freezer. When ready to use sprinkle with confectioners sugar. These are not baked. Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
instructions: Soak cucumbers in salt water (enough salt in the water to float an egg). Let stand 30 minutes to 1 hour; drain. Pack in jars with dill weed hot peppers and garlic to your liking. Heat water salt vinegar and sugar. Pour one cup over cucumbers and seal. Let set for 6 weeks.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour salt and cocoa 3 times and add alternately to creamed mixture with buttermilk. Add vanilla and red coloring. Last fold in soda and vinegar; do not beat. Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Microwave on High for 2 minutes the chocolate and butter. Stir in milk and add sugar. Beat until smooth. Add vanilla.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Boil chicken until done. Cut up into bite-size pieces. Mix cream of chicken soup with milk. Cook noodles following directions on package. Drain. In a casserole dish layer noodles chicken and soup mixture then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 35 minutes.

title: Honey Roasted Apples
instructions: Pare top 1/3 of apples and remove core leaving 1/2-inch of core on bottom. Place apples in oiled baking dish.

title: Virginia Carrot Pineapple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients until moistened. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. May use a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan or a 10 x 2-inch round pan. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting when cooled.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad
instructions: Combine peas peppers cucumber and scallions in medium bowl. Combine remaining ingredients (except lettuce) in a 2 cup glass measure; whisk until thoroughly blended. Pour over peas; toss well. Arrange lettuce on platter; serve salad on top. Keeps well for several hours at room temperature. Refrigeration is not advised as it hardens the peas. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all together; mixer may be used. Grease pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Mamie'S Squash Supreme
instructions: Drain squash; stir in onion soup sour cream carrot cheese salt and pepper. Sprinkle layer of stuffing mix in buttered casserole. Add squash mixture; cover with layer of stuffing mix. Dot generously with butter. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 minutes or put in microwave for 15 minutes at Medium-high until heated through.

title: Lynn Wear'S Winter Apple Conserve
instructions: Wash core and chop apples. Chop raisins orange peel and ginger. Add rest of ingredients except walnuts. Start at low heat and when sugar is dissolved let mix boil gently about 30 minutes. Stir often. Add walnuts. Pour into 1/2-pint canning jars. Seal and process 15 minutes in water bath. Serve as condiment or use as mincemeat by adding butter and brandy for tarts pies or pudding. Makes about 5 half pints.

title: Peanut Buddy Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Tea Cakes(Grandma Baden'S Recipe)
instructions: Cream sugar oleo and eggs together. Add vanilla and buttermilk. Stir in flour with baking powder and salt. Mixture will be soft. Drop by spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Cheddar Casserole
instructions: In a small skillet melt 2 tablespoons margarine over moderate heat. When foam subsides add the onion and cook 4 or 5 minutes until translucent but not brown. Bring 2 cups water to boil in 1 quart pan. Add salt and slowly pour in grits without allowing water to stop boiling. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Reduce heat to medium and cook 2 minutes. Add the onions Worcestershire and Tabasco a little black pepper and 1 1/2 cups grated Cheddar combined with 3 tablespoons soft butter.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potatoes and onion; strain. Let water stand until starch settles. Pour off water keeping starch. Add starch to potatoes. Add all other ingredients except oil. Heat oil in frying pan. Brown pancakes well on each side. Drain on paper towels and serve. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Apple-Beef Casserole(Dietetic)
instructions: Brown beef and drain thoroughly. Combine beef apple onion and sauerkraut and place in 2-quart casserole dish. Cover with tomato juice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Rice-Sausage Dressing
instructions: Soak bread cubes in warm milk. Saute onion in butter until transparent. Mix all ingredients. Use to stuff turkey.

title: Praline Bars
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with Pam spray. Place cookies in single layer on cookie sheet. Melt margarine. Add brown sugar and nuts. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes stirring constantly. Spread mixture over crackers. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes. Cut or break into pieces.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Refrigerate 12 hours and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until set and brown (uncovered).

title: Watermelon Slices
instructions: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water in medium bowl. Stir in cold water. Pour into 8-inch round cake pan.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add 2 cups of flour and beat until smooth. Add corn syrup butter and salt. Mix well for 2 minutes. Add remaining flour and knead until all flour is worked into dough. Cover and put in warm place until dough doubles in size (1 to 1 1/2 hours)*.

title: Cream Cheese Salad
instructions: Add salt to Jell-O; drain pineapple and add enough water to make 3 1/2 cups. Heat. Mix in Jell-O and cool until slightly thickened. Fold in softened cream cheese and beat with mixer at high speed for a few minutes. Add pineapple and beat until cheese is smooth. Add nuts and celery. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate for a few hours until solid.

title: Oatmeal Dinner Rolls
instructions: Combine oatmeal and buttermilk; set aside for 5 minutes. Add eggs and sugar; mix well. Mix together flour salt soda and baking powder. Stir all together adding oil last. Fill muffin pans half full and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Excellent with honey butter.

title: Biscuits Supreme
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in margarine. Add milk. Mix in quickly. Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead gently 1/2 minute. Roll to 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick. Cut and bake at 450\u00b0 on ungreased sheet 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Mix and press in oblong pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Frozen Fruit Punch
instructions: Boil water and sugar. Add orange juice and water lemonade and water and pineapple juice. When cool add bananas. Freeze. Two hours prior to serving remove from freezer. Add 2 (28 ounce) bottles ginger ale at table.

title: Chicken Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Using a flameproof ovenproof casserole brown the salted chops in drippings. Cover with rice. Combine soup and milk; pour over rice making sure all rice is moistened. Cover tightly. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Yummies
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients mixing well. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Roll each in peanuts. Chill 4 or 5 hours. Store in refrigerator. Yields 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Gingered Fruit
instructions: If you are using dried figs place them in a bowl and pour boiling water over them. Let stand 10 minutes then drain and cut in half lengthwise. Cut fresh figs in half lengthwise unless they are very small.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: Arrange one-third of sliced cake on the bottom of a trifle dish or large decorative bowl. Prepare pudding according to package directions. Place one-third more cake pieces around inside of bowl using half of pudding to hold them in place. Gently stir together jam and strawberries. Spoon half over pudding. Cover with remaining cake pieces. Layer remaining pudding and strawberry mixture. Chill. Garnish with whipped cream and fresh strawberries.

title: Pudding Popsicles(Great For Kids!)
instructions: Prepare pudding according to package directions and pour into small paper cups. Insert wooden (popsicle) sticks or plastic spoons. Freeze for 3 hours or until firm. Peel off paper cups and enjoy!

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Using 1/2 of all the ingredients youre going to make two exact layers. In a 2-quart baking dish begin layering on the bottom with Tater Tots soup onion ham and ending with cheese. Repeat exactly in the same order with the other 1/2 of the ingredients ending with cheese on top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cheese is melted.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Put everything in a bowl; mix well with fork; ready to serve.

title: Macaroni Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook meat; drain. Add soup and onion. Simmer. Mix macaroni with meat mixture and place in casserole dish. Cover with cheese and place under broiler until melted. Serve hot.

title: Granny'S Easy Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape dough into biscuits and place in a greased pan. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix soup milk soy sauce pepper green beans and 2/3 c fried onions in a 1 1/2 qt casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot. Stir; sprinkle remaining onions on top. Bake 5 minutes longer or until bubbly.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion in hot oil until tender. Add water and bouillon cubes; dissolve. Add noodles and salt. Cover; boil for 3 minutes. Stir in broccoli and garlic powder; cook 4 minutes. Add cheese milk and dash of pepper. Cook until cheese is melted. Serves 8.

title: Yummy Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix well roll in ball and flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake in 400 degrees until golden brown.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Blend together sugar eggs and oil. Add dry ingredients. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes for layers or put in tube pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 or until done when tested with toothpick.

title: Perfect Barbecue Slaw
instructions: Mix and season to taste. Chill for a few hours.

title: Aunt Ola'S Seven In One
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes thin. Peel and slice carrots and onion. Slice celery (dice). Put all ingredients in a 2 1/2 to 3-quart cassserole dish with lid. Bake until done about 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Brown chop meat; drain and put on top of casserole. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes. Cool slightly and grate while still warm. Mix together the sour cream celery soup onions and melted butter.

title: Hot Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Place into small baking dish. Top with 1/2 cup chopped sauteed pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Pot Pie
instructions: Cook mushrooms and onion in 2 tablespoons dressing over medium-high heat.\tAdd flour and seasonings. Gradually add milk stirring until thick. Stir in 1 cup dressing turkey vegetables\tand 1 cup cheese. Cook 5 minutes. Spoon mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole.

title: Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Spread over cooled cake. If mixture is too stiff add 1 to 4 teaspoons milk until it is smoother and easier to spread. This icing is perfect for the Red Velvet Cake Italian Cream Cake and Carrot Cake.

title: Banana-Pineapple Spice Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs. Stir all dry ingredients together and add to egg mixture. Add bananas and nuts. Bake in three greased and floured 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Turkey With Wild Rice(For Leftover Turkey)
instructions: Wash wild rice thoroughly. Drop into boiling water; add 1 teaspoon salt. Cook 25 to 40 minutes. Drain and rinse. Heat 1/2 of the butter with onions and mushrooms until soft. Use remaining half for the white sauce.

title: Chocolate-Malt Cheesecake
instructions: Stir ingredients well; pat in bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Put ingredients in food processor. Pour into large pot and cook for 1 1/2 hours. Pour into hot jars and seal. Process in boiling water for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole (2)
instructions: Mix together soup mayo lemon juice and cheese. Mix bread crumbs and butter for top of casserole. Mix all ingredients together and add sliced mushrooms.\tPour into casserole dish & top with bread crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Can be frozen.

title: Crow'S Nest
instructions: Cook apples down some either on top of stove or in microwave. Add sugar and cinnamon like you would for an apple pie. Put in cake pan. Cover apples with biscuit mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Serve with a mix.

title: Tutti Frutti Ice Cream
instructions: Combine fruit and juice. Add sugar eggs vanilla and salt. Mix well. Add milk and pour into freezer can. Freeze.

title: Butterscotch-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Sift together flour baking soda salt and cinnamon; set aside. Cream together shortening brown sugar and sugar in bowl until light and fluffy. Add egg; beat well. Stir dry ingredients into creamed mixture blending well. Add oats. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls about 3 inches apart on greased baking sheets. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from baking sheets when slightly cooled. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugar. Blend in orange juice. Add crumbs. Form into 1-inch balls. Roll in coconut. Refrigerate until firm enough to serve.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. Beat sugar sour cream margarine and egg whites in large bowl on low speed for 1 minute scraping bowl occasionally. Beat in bananas and vanilla on low speed for 30 seconds. Beat in flour salt and baking soda on medium speed for 1 minute scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in nuts. Spread in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown; cool. Cut into 2 1/4 x 1 1/2-inch bars.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten whole eggs. Add vanilla and vinegar. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Start baking at 300\u00b0; bake 10 minutes. Raise temperature to 350\u00b0. Complete baking time is about 45 minutes. Real good!

title: Kahlua Mousse
instructions: Chill medium bowl and beaters. Combine cream and coffee powder in chilled bowl. Beat until soft peaks form. Add Kahlua and 2 tablespoons sugar. Beat until stiff peaks form. In small bowl beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add 2 teaspoons sugar; beat until stiff peaks form. Fold egg white into whipped cream mixture. Transfer to dessert bowl cover and chill several hours or overnight. Decorate with chocolate curls. Chill in a 1 1/2-quart souffle dish if desired. Serves 4.

title: Mexican Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and meat drain. Add meat mixture to soups beans and sauce. Bring mixture to boil. Tear tortillas into strips and layer in casserole dish; then add meat mixture and strips of tortillas. Top with grated cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 400 degrees.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken; take from bone and cut into bite size pieces. Drop tortillas into chicken broth until limp. Line bottom of casserole dish with tortillas. Add chicken in order chili powder the cream soup and tomatoes. Top with cheese. Bake in 2-quart dish at 325\u00b0 uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Crab Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Add soup milk eggs Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce. Mix well. Reserve enough cheese and cracker crumbs to cover top of casserole. Add remaining cheese and crumbs to soup mixture with salt and crabmeat. Put in buttered casserole; cover with reserved cheese and crumbs. Place in a 325\u00b0 oven until thoroughly heated and brown on top.

title: Baked Limas
instructions: Cook beans in fresh water to which 1 teaspoon salt is added. Drain and rinse in hot water. Pour into a flat baking dish. Add and stir in margarine.

title: Deep Dish Cheddar Chicken And Rice
instructions: Saute onion in 1/4 cup margarine. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Gradually add milk; cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add chicken cheese (2 cups) rice and broccoli. Mix well. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add remaining 1 cup of cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cookie Bars
instructions: Combine margarine cake mix and 2 eggs in mixer bowl. Mix well. Batter will be stiff. Spoon into greased cake pan. Beat cream cheese and confectioners sugar in mixer bowl until light. Beat in 2 eggs. Mix in coconut and pecans. Spread over cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pistachio Pudding Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding with fruit. Add marshmallows; fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate then serve.

title: Egg Salad
instructions: Chop the eggs; mix all ingredients.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Melt butter in microwave. Add corn syrup and brown sugar to melted butter. Stir and cook in microwave oven for 3 minutes on High power. Stir soda into butter mixture. Stir vanilla into foamy butter mixture. Mixture will become foamy. Pour on popped corn. Stir as you pour.

title: Oven Oxtail Stew
instructions: Place oxtails in roasting pan at about 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Drain off excessive fat. Have vegetables cut to your favorite size. Place in pan with oxtails. Pour in beef broth; season to taste. Add 1 tablespoon cooking wine. Cover pan tightly with foil. Return to oven and cook until oxtails are well done. May or may not need to add small amount of water. Serve as is or with rice.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in 9-inch pan. Mix 1 cup sugar flour and baking powder; add milk and mix well. Pour over oleo. Do not stir. Pour cherries over batter. Do not mix. Sprinkle other 1/2 cup of sugar over batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 in preheated oven for 1 hour.

title: Turkey Chutney Salad
instructions: Measure 1/3 cup of chutney and drain the syrup into a large bowl. Finely chop chutney pieces and combine with syrup. Cut turkey into 1/2-inch cubes. Add to bowl with mayonnaise mustard salt and pepper; mix until combined. Divide salad among 4 individual serving plates lined with lettuce leaves. Sprinkle each with chopped almonds and garnish with the artichoke hearts cucumber and radishes dividing evenly. Serves 4.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook ground beef and diced onion until meat is done. Drain liquid off. Add drained mushrooms salt pepper garlic powder and Kitchen Bouquet. Stir in soup and heat thoroughly. Add sour cream right before serving. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: Wash and completely dry grapes. In a big bowl mix sugar cream cheese sour cream vanilla and desired amount of pecans. Mix well. Add grapes and mix it up. Sprinkle on top the brown sugar and the rest of the pecans.

title: Quick And Easy Cheeseburger Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Add soup vegetables and milk. Set aside.\tMix Bisquick and water and spread on bottom of greased 9 X 13 baking dish. Pour hamburger mixture over bisquick mixture. Bake for 20 minutes at 400 degrees. Top with cheese and return to over for 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar. Beat in egg and almond extract (by hand). Gradually blend in flour. Chill dough for ease in handling. Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness. (We like them thin; however you can make them thicker if\tso desired.) Cut into desired shapes and bake at\t350\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet (about 10 minutes or\tuntil golden brown). Frost with confectioners sugar frosting when cool.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients well with electric beater. Refrigerate. Put on salad just before serving. Spinach mushrooms and hard-boiled eggs.

title: Old Fashioned Marble Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Measure flour and sift together with baking powder and salt. Set aside. In large mixing bowl mix sugar and Crisco. Beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add vanilla. Add flour mix alternately with milk. Take out 2 cups of batter and mix with cocoa. Layer batter into tube pan beginning and ending with white batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients to make a sauce (do not dilute soups). Cook chicken breasts in salted water until done then cut into pieces. Cook broccoli just until tender. Spray casserole dish with Pam. Place layer of broccoli layer of chicken pieces and layer of sauce. Repeat layers. Cook at 375\u00b0 until bubbly. Top with cheese and cook until melted. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Pork Roast
instructions: Place pork roast in slow cooker. In a medium bowl mash cranberry sauce; stir in sugar cranberry juice mustard and cloves. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or until tender. Remove roast and keep warm. Skim fat from juices. Measure 2 cups adding water if necessary and pour into saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Combine cornstarch and cold water to make a paste; stir into gravy. Cook and stir until thickened. Season with salt. Serve with sliced pork. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Baked Egg Strata
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour in croutons. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat 1 dozen eggs. Add Carnation milk and enough regular milk to make 4 cups. Add salt and pepper. Mix all liquid together; pour over croutons and cheese. Refrigerate overnight. In the morning cook bacon; crumble over pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Abeliene Beans And Rice
instructions: In saucepan cook onion and green pepper with cumin in butter until tender. Add broth water rice salt and pepper. Cover bring to boil. Reduce heat simmer for 25 minutes or until done. Stir occasionally. Add beans and pimento. Heat. Makes about 5 1/2 cups or 4 servings.

title: Fried Mozzarella
instructions: Cut Mozzarella into 1/4 to 1/3-inch thick slices. In a shallow bowl combine bread crumbs and parsley. In second bowl beat the eggs with small amount water and add some salt and pepper. Place flour in third shallow bowl. Dip the cheese slices into flour until completely covered. Dip floured cheese into egg mixture then in bread crumbs then repeat the egg and bread crumbs until sides and edges are covered. Heat olive oil in 2 large skillets on medium. Saute cheese slices until crispy and golden brown (a few minutes on each side; watch carefully). Remove from heat and drain on paper towel. Serve immediately.

title: Crab And Mushroom Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart microwavable casserole dish with lid. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir. Cook another minute. Stir.

title: Slow-Cooked Barbecued Beef
instructions: Prepare this in a slow cooker before game time. Just throw in all the ingredients and let cook. You can serve the meat by itself or on rolls.

title: Mustard Eggs
instructions: Mix vinegar and yellow mustard; add sugar salt mustard seed cloves celery seed and a few drops food coloring; simmer about 10 minutes. Slice onions and pour juice over the onions when hot. Add eggs and refrigerate.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in skins until nearly tender. Peel and halve. Arrange in greased shallow 1 quart baking pan. Combine sugar water salt and butter; pour over sweet potatoes. Bake in\tmoderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes basting occasionally. Sprinkle top with coconut; bake 10 minutes longer or until lightly browned.

title: Rhubarb Sauce
instructions: Place rhubarb pieces water sugar and food color in a pan. Cook slow until soft. Then add strawberry jello and frozen strawberries. Cook slow until strawberries thaw.

title: Caldo Con Queso
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Add 1/2 cheese. Heat. Serve with cheese on top.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar oleo and milk in a heavy 2 1/4-quart pan. Bring to a full rolling boil while stirring constantly. Continue boiling for 5 minutes over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate pieces until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme nuts and vanilla. Beat mixture until well blended. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool. Cut into squares or desired shape.

title: Cold Broccoli Salad
instructions: Wash and trim off broccoli flowers from a large head of broccoli. Add 1/2 pound of bacon crumbled and fully cooked. Also cut the red onion into little rings or dice and add to other ingredients. Add pecan chips (small) and raisins.

title: Champagne Or Any Booze Punch
instructions: Serve plain or add champagne or any booze.

title: Chicken Casserole Deluxe
instructions: Prepare noodle mix as directed on package using 1/2 cup milk instead of 1/3. Stir in other ingredients and pour into a 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbling hot. Regular noodles and sour cream may be used in place of Romanoff mix.

title: Sensational Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients until well blended. Refrigerate. Serve with chips crackers or vegetable dippers. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: Fry sausage and onion together until done. Drain well. Spread bread dough on well greased cookie sheet until the dough is flat and covers the cookie sheet. Mix eggs and cheese together. Add the sausage and onion; mix well. Spread evenly over the dough. Roll up like a jelly roll. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 40 minutes or until brown. Let cool then slice and eat.

title: 5 Cup Favorite Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and refrigerate for 24 hours. If desired top with cherries for color.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Roll into small balls. At this point the balls may be frozen to use at a later date. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with toothpicks. Makes 60 to 72 balls.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
instructions: Make amounts according to amount of meat desired.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a saucepan. When mixture begins to boil time for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add next 4 ingredients; add flour last. Mix and place on greased jelly roll pan. Makes 3 pounds. Delicious.

title: Strawberry No-Bake Pie
instructions: Add lemon juice to condensed milk a little at a time. Add container of Cool Whip. Add strawberries. Put into graham cracker pie shell and refrigerate until set.

title: Chocolate Torte
instructions: Mix and put in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan the flour pecans and melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown. Cool completely.

title: Peanut Butter Swirl Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine crunch peanut butter softened oleo brown sugar (packed) and granulated sugar. Beat until creamy. Gradually beat in eggs and vanilla. In a small bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Blend into peanut butter mixture. Spread into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips over top. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven; run knife blade through to marbleize. Return to oven; bake 25 minutes more. Cool and cut into 2 x 1-inch bars. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Sheppard'S Pie
instructions: Cook ground beef onions and celery in large skillet until meat is browned and drain excess grease. Add soup and stir. Add thyme. Spoon meat mixture into a lightly greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Spread potatoes evenly over meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Make into 1-inch balls. Put 3 at a time in a large bag of Shake n Bake (barbecue). Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Festive Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Pare cucumbers and cut lengthwise in very thick slices. Wipe them dry with a cloth. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and dredge with flour. Fry in pan greased with about 1 tablespoon each of lard and butter. Brown both sides and serve warm.

title: Chicken Breast And Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Put chicken in bottom of a casserole. Cover chicken with celery onion parsley water chestnuts salt and pepper. Mix soups together with Miracle Whip and spread on top of casserole. Top with stuffing and pour melted butter over top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
