instructions: Sift together flour sugar and soda. Boil shortening butter or oleo water and cocoa and pour over dry ingredients above. After mixing the mixture add buttermilk eggs and vanilla.

title: Spring Coconut Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread 3/4 c. of the coconut evenly in shallow pan. Toast 7 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned stirring frequently. Cool. Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 1 minute or until thickened. Gently stir in 1 c. of the whipped topping and remaining 1 c. untoasted coconut. Spread mixture in crust. Stir 1/2 c. of the toasted coconut into remaining whipped topping. Spread over pudding layer. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 c. toasted coconut. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Store leftover pie covered in refrigerator.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Beat whole eggs gradually adding sugar. Add milk salt vanilla coconut and nutmeg. Pour into pastry shell; bake in moderate oven for 30 minutes or until custard is firm.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and water. Add sugar and juices. Just before serving add sherbet and ginger ale.

title: Baked Chicken Maryland
instructions: Butter a large casserole dish. Wash chicken. Mix the flour salt and pepper; roll chicken in it. Dip each piece in the egg beaten slightly with the 2 tablespoons water. Roll each piece in the bread crumbs; place in dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for about 45 minutes or until tender. Baste occasionally with margarine lemon and 2 tablespoons water. Serve alone or with gravy.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chili-Mac Supreme
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Boil macaroni until tender. Add chopped onion to ground beef just before it is done browning. In a large kettle over low heat combine tomato juice chili powder and salt. Allow to start simmering. Once it is simmering add ground beef with onion and kidney beans. Cook over very low heat for 1 hour. Top with shredded cheese and serve.

title: Chicken Paprikas
instructions: Brown onions in Crisco or oil. Add paprika chicken salt and pepper and water to about cover chicken. Cook until tender.

title: Tallulah Caboose Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Add vanilla. Combine dry ingredients (flour soda salt and cinnamon); add to mixture. Fold in chopped pecans and apples. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake is done (check with a toothpick that pulls out clean from the cake).

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix and chill overnight before serving.

title: Winter Fruit Compote
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Layer the fruits in a casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over fruit. Cover and bake 1 hour until fruits are tender. Allow to stand covered 45 minutes before serving. Great side dish for holiday dinners!

title: Vegetable 7 Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In large skillet melt butter. Add celery and stir until crisp-tender. Stir in soup milk onion powder and pepper; mix well. Stir in vegetables and chicken; heat through. Spoon into a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Arrange biscuits over hot filling. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Grind all vegetables in a grinder. Add salt. Let set 8 hours. Wash and drain to remove salt.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soup soup mix sour cream and chicken. Place into a greased casserole. Mix stuffing with water and butter according to package directions. Spread over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6. May be frozen ahead.

title: Banana Cream Walnut Torte
instructions: Sift sugar and baking powder together. Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat in sugar mixture. Fold in crackers walnuts and 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Spread onto a buttered 9-inch pie dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. (Torte will not brown.) Cool in dish.

title: Chili Cheddar Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornmeal flour baking powder sugar and salt together. Add milk eggs and shortening. Mix together. Add onion and let stand 5 minutes. Fold in cheese corn green chili peppers and red peppers. Spoon about 1/3 cup batter into greased and floured 2 1/2-inch muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 15 muffins.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt 1 stick margarine in Pyrex bowl. Mix other ingredients and pour (dont stir) into margarine. Bake about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Kool-Aid Punch
instructions: Then pour over apples and cook in a hot water bath for 20 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Scotchies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda salt and cinnamon and set aside. In large bowl beat butter sugars eggs and vanilla until creamy. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats chips and nuts. Drop by measuring tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour cocoa and salt together. Pour into boiling water and cook until thick. Add butter and vanilla; stir until blended. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Pumpkin Butter
instructions: Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 4 to 8 hours; stir frequently. Makes 18 1/2 pints.

title: Oriental Salad
instructions: Drain all juices off vegetables. Marinate vegetables with remaining ingredients.

title: Cookie Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Pour fruit pie filling in a well greased 9 by 9-inch casserole dish. Spoon cookie dough by scant teaspoons over fruit filling. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar evenly. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Divinity
instructions: Boil sugar and water until forms a soft ball. Add Creme vanilla and nuts. Pour in buttered dish to cool then cut in squares.

title: Fruit Salad Pudding(Excellent)
instructions: Cook macaroni and set aside. Mix together egg sugar and flour. Add to juice and cook until thick. Pour over macaroni and refrigerate overnight. Next day add Cool Whip and drained fruit to macaroni. Ready to serve. Makes large salad.

title: Lemon-Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare lime and lemon jello as directed on box. Melt cream cheese in warm jello mixture and let gel a little. Add crushed pineapple and whipped Dream Whip to other ingredients and fold all together. Let jell in refrigerator.

title: Bundt Cake
instructions: Bake cake as box directions. Spray Bundt pan with Pam. When cake is done turn out of pan on serving plate. When cool frost cake with frosting.

title: Meal-In-One Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain. Add tomato soup and water. Add package of noodles and cover. Cook until noodles are tender. Add corn sugar hot sauce and ketchup to noodle mixture. Pour half into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Grate half of cheese on top then pour rest of mixture and grate remaining cheese on top. Bake in oven for 30 minutes. Serve with bread or crackers for complete meal.

title: Pu Pu'S
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a saucepan and boil until thick. Add sausages and keep mixture warm until sausages are heated thoroughly.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix and cook cake by the recipe on the box. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and make holes all over the top. Mix cream coconut and condensed milk; pour over cake that has the holes in it. Put a large container of Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle with coconut. Keep refrigerated. It also freezes well.

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken in cubes. Saute in small amount of oil. Add sauce. Let simmer while rice cooks in water. Serve rice topped with chicken mix.

title: Pineapple Appetizers
instructions: Wrap water chestnut and pineapple chunk in bacon and secure with a toothpick. Dip in lemon juice; set aside in dish in 1 layer. When dish is filled sprinkle with teriyaki marinade. Let stand a few hours or overnight.

title: Broiled Mustard-Dill Salmon
instructions: Preheat broiler. Set oven rack 4 to 5 inches from element. Rinse fish; pat dry and lay skin side down on a baking sheet. With a zester or grater remove zest (yellow part of peel only) from lemon; squeeze 1 tablespoon juice from lemon. Mix lemon zest lemon juice mustard and dill. Brush mixture over salmon. Broil salmon until opaque in center (about 5 to 6 minutes for 1/2-inch thick fillet) 10 to 12 minutes for 1-inch fillet. Serves 2 to 4. Great for grill too!

title: Flowerpot Cake
instructions: Crush cookies in a plastic bag with a rolling pin or food processor; set aside. Cream butter cream cheese and powdered sugar. In another bowl cream milk pudding and Cool Whip. Mix well. Line a clean flowerpot with plastic wrap. Fill pot with alternating layers of cookie crumbs and pudding mixture. Garnish with gummy worms or silk flowers. Serves 12.

title: Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix well and using a teaspoon drop spoonfuls of batter on an ungreased cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Bambini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine Ricotta Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese in small bowl. Halve each biscuit horizontally forming 20 thin biscuits. Gently shape each piece of dough into an oval (2 1/2 x 4-inch). Place a pepperoni on one end with a tablespoon of cheese mixture on top. Moisten edges; fold dough over to enclose filling pinching edges to seal. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Cook until golden brown (10 to 12 minutes). Serve warm.

title: Sante Fe Soup
instructions: In a dutch oven cook meat and onion till meat is brown and onion is tender drain off grease. Add remaining ingredients blending well. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer 2 hours. Top individual serving with grated cheese and sour cream.

title: Apple And Nut Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in bowl; add apples eggs oil vanilla and nuts. Blend together until moistened. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach pressing out water well. Mix all ingredients and shape into 3/4-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Dutch Family Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate; blend with melted shortening. Cool; stir in sugar eggs applesauce vanilla and pecans. Sift baking powder baking soda and salt with flour. Stir in chocolate mixture and bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of a loaf pan. Mix sugar and margarine in a 2 or 3 quart bowl. Stir in eggs until blended. Add bananas and water. Beat 30 seconds. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened. Pour into pan. Bake until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean (8-inch loaf 1 1/4 hours 9-inch loaf 55 to 60 minutes); cool 5 minutes. Loosen sides of loaf from pan; remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Add first 4 ingredients and boil 1 minute. Then add remaining ingredients.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crust Mix pretzels butter and 3 tablespoons sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fire House Special
instructions: Combine ingredients in proportions in keeping with number to be served. (One box and 1 can each for family of four; increase for more servings.) Bake in casserole dish or heat together on stove until heated through.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Break half the buns (1 1/2) in bottom of large flat pan; add chopped peaches. Combine sugar cornstarch liquid and oleo. Boil until oleo is melted and slightly thick. Pour over peaches. Break remaining buns over top. Push down into juice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until slightly browned. A good way to use stale buns or leftover buns.

title: No-Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix thoroughly flour salt sugar and shortening. Add water vinegar and egg. Roll out on floured waxed paper and cut to the desired size. The recipe makes four 9-inch pie crusts. The extra crusts may be frozen for later use by separating crusts with sheets of waxed paper. With the wax paper below and above a crust fold the crust in half twice. Place in a plastic bag squeeze out the excess air seal and freeze. Thaw before unfolding. Can be frozen in a lump and thawed and rolled out later.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line bottom of 3 (9-inch) cake pans with waxed paper. Melt chocolate squares with water. Can be on stove top or in microwave. Mix flour with baking soda and salt; set aside. Beat oleo and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well. Stir in melted chocolate and vanilla. Add flour mixture alternating with buttermilk beating well. Beat egg whites until they form stiff peaks. Gently stir into the batter. Pour into pans. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Run spatula between cake and sides of pan while hot. Let cool for 15 minutes still in pans. Remove and peel off paper.

title: Jello Delight
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water and cool. Cream the cheese with salad dressing add the pineapple and nuts through the cream mixture and the whipping cream. Add the bananas last. Chill and serve. Will keep for a couple days in refrigerator.

title: Crustless Apple Pie
instructions: Combine egg sugar apples and nuts. Sift remaining ingredients together; add to first mixture. Pour into greased pie plate. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Rich Brownies(With A Wonderful Cream Frosting)
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add cooled melted chocolate and blend. Add sifted dry ingredients. Stir in walnuts. Bake in greased 8-inch square pan in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Frost with Creamy Chocolate Frosting.

title: Old Fashioned Beef Stew
instructions: In large heavy pan brown meat in shortening. Pour off fat. Add soups water and seasoning. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; cook 1 hour more or until tender. Stir now and then. Uncover and cook until desired consistency. Makes 6 servings.

title: O' Henry Bars
instructions: Mix oatmeal sugars and oleo. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes; cool. Melt chocolate chips. Add peanut butter. Spread on crust. Chill; cut into squares.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Soften cheese and sausage to room temperature. Combine with other ingredients. Form in balls 1-inch in diameter pop in 300\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. These freeze well uncooked. Cook without defrosting in 300\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and shape into a loaf. Top with barbecue sauce.

title: Refrigerator Lemon Pickles
instructions: Put zucchini or cucumbers in a bowl with green pepper and onion. Mix with salt and celery seed. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour.

title: Carrot Marshmallow Salad
instructions: Peel carrots and shred into mixing bowl. Add marshmallows pineapple raisins and coconut. Toss lightly. Combine mayonnaise and whipped cream. Add to carrot mixture. Freezes nicely. Eat frozen or fresh.

title: Nutty Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put melted margarine evenly in bottom of long glass baking dish. Sprinkle brown sugar over margarine. Add walnuts over brown sugar. Add the peaches over the brown sugar and nuts. Mix batter of flour sugar and milk; pour evenly over peaches. Bake approximately 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with Ritz crackers and melted butter.

title: Buttery Corn Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Combine the eggs and milk. Combine flour cornmeal baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with egg mixture. Pour into a greased 13 X 9 X 2 inch baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 22-27 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cut into squares; serve warm. Yield 12-15 servings.

title: No Roll Pie Crust
instructions: Melt cream cheese and margarine together. Mix in flour with fork. Pat crust to fit pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 or as directed for pie.

title: Quick Pickled Peaches
instructions: Use liquid from 1 can of the peaches. Add sugar vinegar and pickling spices. Mix together and bring to a boil. Add drained peaches. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Store in refrigerator in tightly covered container.

title: Apple Pie (Mom'S)
instructions: Mix with cold water. Put this into a pie shell (top and bottom). Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Italian Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix until mixture clings together. Roll into small balls about an inch in diameter. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 8 doz. sausage balls.

title: Tomato Chicken Curry
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in olive oil. Add spices. Remove garlic. Fry chicken in spice mixture for about 30 minutes. Add tomatoes; simmer for another 30 minutes. Add yogurt just before serving.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix all together the hash brown potatoes cream of chicken soup and Cheddar cheese. Pour in buttered 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Put crushed cornflakes over top. Melt margarine and drizzle over cornflakes. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Cheesecake Crunch Bars
instructions: Combine butterscotch morsels and margarine. Heat until melted and smooth. Stir in graham cracker crumbs and nuts with a fork until mixture forms small crumbs. Reserve 2 cups crumb mixture for topping. Press remaining mixture into an ungreased oblong cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Fresh Broccoli Mandarin Salad(10 To 12 Servings)
instructions: Toss all ingredients together and chill.

title: Ziti Bake
instructions: About 1 hour before serving In 8-quart Dutch oven prepare ziti as label directs; drain and set aside.

title: Colossal Cookie
instructions: Beat sugar margarine and syrup. Beat in egg and vanilla. Slowly mix in dry ingredients. Stir in chocolate chips. Refrigerate for 1-1/2 hours or freeze 3/4 hour. Place in 12 inch round foil pan. Press to within 1-1/2 in. of edge. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes.

title: Walnut Balls
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar slowly and cream. Add flour in 2 parts chopped nuts vanilla and salt. Chill overnight. Roll into small balls to size and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Easy Chili
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cook until meat is done. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Fritos. Chill. Just prior to serving add Fritos.

title: Spaghetti, Eggplant And Pepper
instructions: Dice eggplant; salt and leave to stand an hour or more covered with a weighted plate. Fry garlic and parsley in oil. Add eggplant with a pinch of ground chili powder (or chili pepper). Cut peppers in strips and cook with the vegetables for 15 minutes over moderate heat then over low heat until tender. Stir in tomato sauce. Cook pasta; drain well and mix with sauce.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix flour baking powder soda cloves nutmeg cinnamon and salt together in a large bowl. Set aside. Then in a large bowl mix together oil sugars pumpkin and eggs. Then add flour mixture mixing well. Add nuts and raisins. Bake in 2 loaf pans at 350\u00b0 in metal pans or 325\u00b0 in glass pans for 1 hour covering with foil for the last 20 minutes so it wont get too brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes. After it comes to a boil drain real well. Make sauce in large pan. Mix sauce with broccoli lightly and put in a buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Dot with butter and sprinkle with finely rolled Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and brown.

title: Dawn'S Fudge
instructions: Lightly grease 8 or 9-inch square pan. Combine dry ingredients in heavy 4-quart saucepan. Stir in milk; bring to full (bubbly) boil over medium heat without stirring to 234\u00b0 (soft ball stage). Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla. Do not stir. Cool at room temperature to 110\u00b0. (Pan should be barely warm to touch.) Beat with wooden spoon until fudge thickens and loses its gloss. Quickly spread in pan. Cool then cut.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Melt oleo; add sugar Bisquick and part of milk to make a stiff dough mixture. Put a thin layer of dough mixture on bottom of well-greased pan. Add rest of milk to dough mixture and stir well. Place fruit on top of dough mixture already in pan. Pour rest of dough mixture over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Pies
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together; mix well. Save egg whites for topping. Pour mixed ingredients into pie crusts.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli celery and onion in 2 cups water until done. Heat butter in 3-quart saucepan. Add flour; heat until bubbly. Add 2 1/2 cups water; boil one minute. Stir in (blended) veggies. Add bouillon salt pepper and nutmeg. Heat to boiling and add whipping cream. Do not boil cream.

title: Spanish Whipped Cream Cake
instructions: Add cinnamon oil and sugar to cake mix. Also add what mix calls for. Stir and bake as directed on box. Can make 2 or 3 layers. Pam spray 9-inch round or square cake pans.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Dream Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions making two 8-inch layers. Split both layers horizontally after they have cooled. Blend together the sugar sour cream and fresh frozen coconut. Chill.

title: General Cleaning Solution
instructions: (It suds less if you put the water in the gallon first and then add other ingredients.) Mix ingredients together in a gallon jug. Transfer to a spray bottle. Label bottle. Excellent for many household chores!

title: Speedy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix by directions on box. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together sugar and cocoa. Sprinkle over top of cake. Pour boiling water over the cake. Bake according to package directions until firm on top. Serve hot. Spoon cake and sauce into a bowl and top with whipped topping cherries or orange slices.

title: Orange Pop Jello
instructions: Boil 1 cup pop. Mix with jello; stir until dissolved. Add the rest of the pop. Refrigerate until slightly thickened. With mixer fold in Cool Whip. Add mandarin oranges. Pour into serving dish or mold. Refrigerate until set.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Add all dry ingredients with shortening and mix good and fine. Add milk and mix until forms dough. Do not over mix as dough will get tough. Roll out about 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick. Cut squares big enough to cover whole apple. Sprinkle a little sugar and cinnamon in center of apple and wrap in dough. Place in baking pan about 1 to 2 inches apart. Pour syrup over apples and then bake at 375\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until knife inserts easily.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Scald milk; add butter and cool slightly. Add eggs and sugar. When warm add yeast to milk and mix with salt and flour. Let rise good. Roll out and cut round; brush with butter. Double over and place in buttered pan. Let raise and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Most Excellent Nacho Dish
instructions: In order listed layer all ingredients in an oblong cake pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve as a dip with taco chips.

title: Molasses Layer Cake
instructions: Put molasses on stove to warm then stir in soda and take off stove. The molasses will turn yellow. Beat eggs lightly. Now in molasses stir in all ingredients (except apple) and enough flour to make dough like biscuit dough. Grease cake pan. Roll out or pat in a thin layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Between layers place apples.

title: Rice Krispie Treats
instructions: Melt margarine on low heat. Add marshmallows and stir up until melted. Cook over low heat for 3 more minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies and stir well. Press evenly into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Potatoes Gourmet
instructions: Boil the potatoes in skins. Cool peel and shred on coarse grater. Combine cheese and 4 tablespoons butter in saucepan. Heat and stir until cheese is almost melted. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream onions salt and pepper. Fold in potatoes. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Peel and mash potatoes. Blend in egg 2 tablespoons margarine and pineapple juice or cream. Add salt and nutmeg. Divide into 6 portions. Mold each portion around 1 marshmallow to form a ball. Add remaining 2 tablespoons melted margarine to crushed corn flakes. Roll sweet potato balls in margarine and corn flake mixture. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Voodoo Stew(Geri Morris' Recipe)
instructions: Heat oil. Add onion celery and carrots. Saute over moderate heat stirring until onion is transparent. Add broth. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer covered for 10 minutes. Add zucchini salt pepper herbs and vinegar. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and olives. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered until vegetables are done. Dissolve cornstarch in a small amount of the cooking liquid. Stir into stew. Cook over moderate heat stirring until thickened.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix the night before you ice the cake. Keep in refrigerator. Bake 2 layer yellow cake mix; cool and split in layers. Ice cake and refrigerate.

title: Lazy Day Stew
instructions: Arrange meat in roaster or casserole in single layer (dont brown meat first). Place vegetables on top of meat. Mix tomato sauce with water and sugar. Pour over meat and vegetables. Add salt and pepper. Scatter tapioca on top. Seal roaster in heavy foil. Bake for 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Do not open oven during recommended cooking time. When foil is removed meat will be brown with gravy.

title: Spaghetti Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain and set aside. Cook pepper and onion in chicken broth until tender. Add cheese soups and seasonings; stir. Add chicken and spaghetti. Mix well and pour into large baking dish. Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly and gradually add milk sugar salt and vanilla. Combine flour and water and add to mixture. Transfer to unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Then check and add time if necessary.

title: Maple Syrup Muffins
instructions: Mix together the flour baking powder and salt. Make a well in the center. In a separate bowl mix egg milk syrup and butter. Pour liquid mixture into dry mixture; combine thoroughly. Spoon mixture into greased muffin pan for 12 muffins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lee'S Favorite Cole Slaw
instructions: Wash cut and shred cabbage in food processor (or by hand). Peel carrot cut off ends and shred with cabbage. Add pickles sugar and mayo. Mix well. Serve cold with seafood barbecue or on hot dogs.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Drain Veg-All then combine cream of chicken soup and mayo. Put in baking dish. Crumble Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Add crackers (crushed) nuts and vanilla; stir to mix. Pour in large buttered 9 x 13-inch dish and cook 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Boil chicken in enough water to cover until done approximately 15 to 20 minutes and save the broth. Remove chicken boil pasta in the same broth until half done. Mix soup Cheez Whiz and chilies into boiling noodles and stir until smooth. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Add shredded chicken and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered. Serve bubbling hot.

title: Pineapple Bran Muffins
instructions: In bowl pour milk over bran cereal buds. In another bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add pineapple oil and egg to cereal; mix well. Add to flour mixture; stir until moistened. Spoon into 12 paper-lined muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Blueberry Banana Muffins(Yields 1 Dozen Muffins)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In medium bowl cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs. Mix in bananas and milk. In another mixing bowl combine flour baking powder and cinnamon. Add margarine mixture to dry ingredients; mix only until moist. Stir in whole blueberries. If adding frozen ones add them to your mixture while still frozen. Spoon batter into greased muffin cups filling cup to top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until muffins are golden brown. Let cool for 5 minutes then transfer to cooling rack.

title: Apple Butter(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Peel and core apples; cut in chunks. Simmer in apple juice with spices for 15 minutes. Cool and puree. Simmer again until desired consistency. Stir in sweetener.

title: Cherry Loaf
instructions: Drain red cherries (save liquid add water if needed to equal 1/3 cup). Cut up cherries. In large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. In separate bowl beat eggs add milk oil applesauce and cherry liquid. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Fold in red and green cherries pecans and orange peel. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: Gammon And Spinach
instructions: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces and fry in large skillet. Drain off all but approximately 2 tablespoons of grease. In a large jar mix sugar vinegar water and flour. Shake vigorously until creamy. Add to pan; add spinach. Slice eggs and add to pan. Cook approximately 5 minutes. Serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix in a large bowl; cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Combine the flour and baking powder. Add to butter mixture alternately with milk. Add flavoring and mix well. Place dough on a floured board and knead. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thick and cut or roll out like biscuits. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Rigatoni With Sausage
instructions: Cut sausage in 1-inch pieces. Place in hot skillet with olive oil. Brown slightly about 10 minutes. Add onion mushrooms (well cleaned and sliced) garlic salt and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes. Add tomato puree and bay leaf cover and cook slowly for 1 hour. Remove bay leaf. Cook rigatoni about 20 minutes in 5 quarts rapidly boiling water (salted). Drain and place in baking dish. Add sausage and sauce; mix. Sprinkle with grated macaroni cheese and bake in moderate oven about 10 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni and mix other ingredients except cracker crumbs together. Crumble cracker crumbs on top. Dot with butter and bake until brown about 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chile Relleno Casserole
instructions: Oil a 9 x 13-inch pan. Drain chiles and place half of them in bottom of pan (open chiles if necessary to cover bottom). Sprinkle half the cheese. Beat eggs and thinned sour cream with flour and pour over chiles. Poke with fork to be sure batter seeps through. Sprinkle top with parsley and garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour until the top is golden.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare 1 box stuffing mix as directed; set aside. Boil chicken in water until done. Drain. Let chicken set in cold water until cool enough to strip from bones. After cooling place chicken in oblong cake pan ungreased. Pour mixture of soups over meat strips. Stir together. Spoon and spread dressing over mixture pushing 2/3 of stuffing down into mixture. Stuffing makes a light crunchy top. Sprinkle with pepper and bake in preheated oven (350\u00b0) for 1 hour.

title: Spicy Turkey Roast
instructions: Remove mesh from turkey. Lay turkey out as flat as possible on cutting board placing skin side down. Combine the garlic rosemary pepper and salt in the work bowl of a food processor with the steel blade in place or in blender. Add oil processing until coarsely chopped.

title: Granny Tiner'S Sour Orange Pie
instructions: Separate the yolks and whites. Mix yolks and sugar. Beat whites until stiff. Combine yolks with whites then add juice. Pour as much as possible into the pie shell. Bake for about 5 minutes at 350\u00b0 and remove from oven. Use a fork to pull skim open in center and then pour your remaining mix into the hole. Continue baking until brown. (I forgot how long this takes?) This is my favorite!

title: Bacon Horseradish Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill one hour.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Bake sausage in shallow pan for 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn sausage once. Place layers of noodles in casserole. Dribble 4 tablespoons sausage drippings over top. Add applesauce lemon juice and spices then another layer of noodles. Place sausage on top and sprinkle grated cheese over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced zucchini and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; then drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrot. Fold in drained zucchini and onion. Combine stuffing and margarine. Spread half of mixture in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Spoon vegetable mixture on top then cover with remaining stuffing. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Butterscotch Chews
instructions: Melt morsels. Add noodles and cashews. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.

title: Chocolate-Mocha Frozen Dessert
instructions: Beat together the cream cheese milk chocolate syrup and dissolved instant coffee. Pour mixture over prepared crust and top with chopped pecans. Freeze overnight.

title: Cool Cucumber Salad
instructions: Add cucumber and onion to sour cream milk salt and pepper. Allow to refrigerate overnight for better flavor.

title: Breakaway Vegetable Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into fourths. Dip each piece in margarine and layer 1/3 of the biscuits in a lightly greased 10-inch Bundt pan. Sprinkle with half the bacon cheese onion and green pepper. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used ending with biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole(With Topping)
instructions: Combine and put in 9 x 13 pan. Add topping.

title: Hawaiian Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in baking dish. Mix sugar with 1/2 of pineapple juice or syrup. Pour over pork chops. Bake 25 minutes until sauce is bubbling. Place pineapple slice on each pork chop and a cherry in the center of each pineapple. Spoon sauce over pork chops some more. Return to oven for about 5 minutes.

title: Sausage And Sauerkraut Dinner
instructions: Brown sausage in butter in a 1 1/2-quart Dutch oven or large casserole. Arrange onion sauerkraut apples and potatoes around sausage. Top with apple juice salt and pepper to taste. Cover tightly and simmer over low heat stirring once for 30 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Toss together and put into flat casserole dish. Top with 1/4 pound lightly cooked bacon strips. Bacon cooked 3/4 done. Also top with 1/2 cup sliced stuffed olives (optional). Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; place in greased 9 x 12-inch dish. Top with chicken. Mix soup lemon juice mayonnaise and curry powder. Pour on chicken. Add cheese. Top with cracker crumbs mixed with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Flossie'S Pepper Relish
instructions: Roast pimientos in slow oven. Cool and peel. Coarsely grind pimientos onions and hot peppers. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly stirring constantly cooking for about 20 minutes. After mixture is thoroughly hot pour in jars and seal.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice in separate saucepans until done (wild rice 30 to 45 minutes). Fry bacon and remove from pan to dry; save grease. Cool bacon and break in small pieces.

title: Strawberry Fluff
instructions: Thaw strawberries. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Stir in food coloring. Put lemon juice and water in a custard cup and sprinkle gelatin over top. Let sit about 5 minutes to soften. Place custard cup in a small saucepan surround with a small amount of water and then heat over low heat until gelatin is dissolved. Blend gelatin into strawberries. Chill until mixture begins to thicken then whip the chilled evaporated milk until it is stiff and will hold a peak. Fold in gelatin mixture lightly but thoroughly. If necessary chill until mixture mounds when dropped from spoon. Pile lightly into 4 cups. Chill until set.

title: Paella With Peas And Carrots
instructions: Brown chicken in hot oil in a Dutch oven; remove chicken. Add onion and garlic to pan; cook over medium-high heat stirring constantly until tender. Add chicken tomatoes and salt. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Oven Doughnuts
instructions: Mix oil milk and sugar. Add egg beat well. Add remaining ingredients. Mix until smooth. Pour into greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from tins and roll in melted butter and then in mixture of 1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates let stand for 10 minutes. Add sugar to beaten egg; sift together all dry ingredients stir in walnuts. Add date mixture alternately with the sifted dry ingredients to the sugar/egg mixture. Stir in shortening and vanilla. Pour into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Salmon Salad
instructions: In bowl combine red salmon minced clams diced celery hard-cooked eggs water chestnuts and mushrooms. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice salt and pepper. Add to salmon mixture and toss lightly. Cover chill and serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Provencale
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In bowl toss potatoes onions tomatoes and olives with oil until well blended. Remove skin from chicken except wings. Place chicken vegetable mixture and bay leaves in large roasting pan. Sprinkle with salt thyme and oregano. Bake until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with fork and vegetables are tender about 45 minutes. Remove bay leaves before serving. Makes 8 servings 201 calories per serving.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mix together and heat slowly. Serve hot. Use crackers for dip. Serves about 12 as an hors doeuvre.

title: White Mountain Fudge
instructions: In saucepan combine milk syrup and salt. Cook until forms a soft ball in water. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla. Cool slightly. Beat well. Add nuts and/or fruits. Pour into well buttered pan. Cut into squares.

title: Fish, Chicken Or Veal Parmesan
instructions: Bread meat or fish as desired. Either bake in oven or deep fry until tender. Top with favorite marinara sauce followed by Parmesan cheese Provolone cheese and a little more sauce. Return to oven until the cheese melts. Serve with a side order of angel hair pasta topped with marinara sauce.

title: Corn Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put on hot griddle like pancakes. Great with your favorite syrup!

title: Everyday Dinner Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Add the shortening salt and sugar; allow to cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; add to mixture. Add the flour to the liquid gradually mixing well after each addition until a soft dough is formed. Cover the bowl tightly set in warm place and allow to rise until double in bulk. Turn onto a floured board; knead until the dough can be easily handled and mold into rolls. Place in a well-greased pan; let rise again until double in bulk. Bake in a hot oven (375\u00b0) for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Orange Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water and add sherbet. Add oranges and bananas. Pour into mold and let set.

title: Lime Sling
instructions: Pour hot tea over lemon and lime slices. Let stand 30 minutes; strain.

title: Fried Lumpia
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large pan. Drain grease and return beef to the pan. Add vegetables and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add about 1 tablespoon soy sauce (more if desired). Let mixture cool. Separate the egg. Add the egg yolk to meat mixture and reserve the egg white for sealing the lumpia wrappers. Separate lumpia wrappers carefully and prevent them from drying out. Spoon about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the beef mixture 1/4 down one end and pull that 1/4 end over mixture. Roll up tightly and seal the wrapper with egg whites. Deep-fry in oil until golden brown or pan-fry in some oil (I prefer deep frying). Drain on paper towels and serve hot with some ketchup sweet and sour sauce or barbecue sauce. Leftovers can be reheated in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Papas En Escabeche
instructions: Use 2-quart covered bowl preferably with sealed lid. Boil and cool carrots eggs (hard) and potatoes. Peel potatoes. Make three alternating layers with the following ingredients 2 potatoes 2 eggs 1/3 of carrots 1/3 of onion 1 sliced jalapeno salt pepper and paprika. After third layer add salad oil and 1/2 cup of juice from can of peppers and vinegar. Seal tightly with cover and refrigerate overnight occasionally turning upside-down then over again. Serve cold the next day.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Bake cookies are directed. Cool. Frost with cream cheese and top with desired fruit.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Spread pineapple on bottom of lightly greased baking dish. Cover with blueberries. Add 1/2 cup sugar sprinkled over berries. Sprinkle dry cake mix over sugar. Melt butter and pour evenly over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Willy'S Buckeyes
instructions: Mix peanut butter with butter then add powdered sugar mix with hands and shape balls and roll in chocolate. Lay on wax paper to harden.

title: Quick Cheesy Beef Dinner
instructions: Brown beef onion and pepper. Set aside. Cook macaroni dinner as directed on box. Then mix the beef mixture with macaroni. Ready to serve.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Layer in large casserole (13 x 9 x 2) the chicken onion 1/2 cheese and corn chips. Mix together soups and chicken stock. Pour over chicken then pour over salsa. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about an hour.

title: Fourth Of July Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake cake in 13x9x2 inch pan according to package directions. Cool cake in pan on wire rack. Turn cake out onto serving platter. Frost cake with whipped topping. Decorate top of cake as flag Arrange blueberries in upper left-hand corner of cake. Make 13 stripes across cake starting with stripe of strawberries across top then leaving stripe of white topping showing through and repeating the alternate stripes until you have 13 (7 red and 6 white). Cut and serve.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Crumble. Cook carrot and onion in bacon drippings. Remove from pan. Scramble eggs and remove from pan. Fry ham or chicken. Remove from pan. Place rice in pan. Add soy sauce salt and green pepper. Stir until heated. Add all ingredients. Serve hot with additional soy sauce if desired.

title: Elegant Chicken
instructions: Roll chicken breasts in Contadina seasoned bread crumbs. Brown in Pam or butter. Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add a slice of Muenster cheese to each piece of chicken. Pour sliced mushrooms over the chicken. Pour a small amount of chicken broth (about 1/4 way up) on the chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Stew
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes. In large skillet saute chicken and garlic in oil until chicken is partially cooked. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Stir in 2 cups water reserved pineapple syrup rice vinegar brown sugar soy sauce salt ginger and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 12 minutes or until rice is almost tender. Cut green and red peppers into 1-inch pieces; add pineapple chunks. Combine 3 tablespoons cold water and cornstarch; quickly stir into stew mixture. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until rice and green pepper are tender.

title: Strawberry Delight Punch
instructions: In blender container combine strawberries lemonade concentrate sugar and Nestea. Process at high speed until smooth. Pour into serving pitcher. Stir in cold water. Makes 12 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Carrot Ring
instructions: Combine all ingredients adding the beaten egg whites last. Pour into a buttered mold. Set in water; cook for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Unmold and fill center with mushroom sauce.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Sundae Cake
instructions: Mix syrup and water together. Pour into pans. Add nuts and marshmallows. Carefully pour cake batter onto syrup mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done. May be served warm with ice cream topping using chocolate syrup in bottom of pan as topping.

title: Honey Nut Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pat dough over ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix together cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning; let stand a few hours.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown beef; add taco seasoning. Simmer 10 minutes. Cool. Mix in remaining ingredients except tomatoes. Add tomatoes just before serving.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix softened butter eggs sugar and vanilla. Mix flour and baking powder; add to butter mixture. Mix well. Grease a cookie sheet and dust lightly with flour. Drop dough mixture by teaspoons on the cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for about 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Rick'S Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except hamburger. Brown the hamburger and add to beans. Bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. (B&M beans are best as they dont get mushy.)

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and butter. Press in bottom of pan. Mix well the confectioners sugar cream cheese and 3 eggs. Pour over cake mix and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Scotch Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter until soft. Gradually add sugar until fluffy. Gradually mix in flour. Mixture will be crumbly. Press mixture into two 9-inch glass pie pans. Score into wedges and pierce with fork. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool slightly. Cut wedges. Cool on rack. Makes 16 wedges.

title: Chili For Forty
instructions: Brown meat in heavy big pot. When meat loses the pink color add flour and seasonings. Mix well then add tomato juice. Let simmer as long as possible. Cool. Remove fat from top then reheat to serve.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar and water. Cook until thick approximately 45 minutes. Add peanuts and stir continuously until syrup turns light brown and peanuts are done (1 hour). Remove from heat and add salt soda and butter. Stir until mixed well. Pour into a buttered cookie sheet. Spread as thin as possible.

title: Heavenly Hamburger
instructions: Brown meat garlic salt pepper and sugar in oleo; drain. Add tomato sauce; simmer for 20 minutes. Cook noodles as directed; drain. Soften cream cheese; add to sour cream and onions. Combine meat mixture and noodles (or lasagna). Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan or casserole. Spread sour cream mixture over meat and noodles. Spread Cheddar cheese over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 8 or more.

title: Pecan Supreme
instructions: Mix flour butter and pecans into crumb mixture and press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Beat powdered sugar Cool Whip and cream cheese and pour over first layer. Beat pudding and milk together and spread over second layer. Cover with remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Southwest Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Serve with vegetables or tortilla chips.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring shortening and water to a boil. Add flour and salt quickly and stir constantly until mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a ball about 1 minute. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Beat with mixer adding eggs 1 at a time and beating until smooth after each addition. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Fill either by cutting off top of each puff or with pastry bag with vanilla pudding. Frost with chocolate icing.

title: Jeff'S Salsa
instructions: Dice onions cilantro leaves only and chiles and mince garlic. Take cans of whole tomatoes and blend in blender slightly remove and place in bowl. Cut all jalapenos into slices and blend in blender to a paste. Add all ingredients in bowl and stir. Season and stir.

title: Sweet Nothings
instructions: Melt butter peanut butter and chocolate chips together. Pour over cereal. Stir gently. Put powdered sugar in a brown paper bag or plastic food storage bag. Add the chocolate chex and shake.

title: Instant Cocoa
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Use 4 teaspoons to 1 cup of hot water.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Spread apples evenly in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Place butter in a small glass mixing bowl. Microwave for 45 seconds to 1 minute or until softened. Add remaining ingredients. Mix until crumbly then sprinkle over apples. Microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until apples are tender. Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: What To Do With Carrots Or Renee'S Remainder
instructions: Cut carrots in disk shape. Cut zucchini yellow squash broccoli and cauliflower as you like. In a large saucepan saute carrots in margarine.

title: Pumpkin Custard Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour into pastry lined pie pan. Separate eggs and beat egg whites and fold in after it is in pie pan. Bake in a moderate oven until firm. Makes 2 large pies.

title: Stuffed Flounder
instructions: In skillet cook onions in 1/4 cup butter until tender but not brown. Stir drained mushrooms in skillet with flaked crab cracker crumbs parsley 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Spread mixture over flounder fillets. Roll fillets and place seam side down in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. In saucepan melt 3 tablespoons butter. Blend in flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Add enough milk to mushroom liquid to make 1 1/2 cups. Add with wine to saucepan. Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles. Pour over fillets. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Return to oven. Bake 10 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily with fork. Serves 8.

title: Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Cut margarine into flour; add remaining ingredients. Press in 9 x 13-inch dish or pan. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 and let cool.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Cut corn from cob. Force cabbage through a grinder. Separate celery stalks. Remove leaves and chop. Peel onions and cut in thin slices. Wipe peppers and chop. Put vegetables in preserving kettle and pour over 1 quart vinegar. Mix sugar flour mustard cayenne and turmeric. Add to the other.

title: Coon Balls
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Roll into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Potato Broccoli Bake
instructions: Place potatoes in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine margarine salt paprika and pepper. Brush the margarine mixture onto the potatoes. Bake uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Arrange broccoli over the potatoes and pour the pimento cheese sauce over the vegetables. Cover and bake 10 minutes or until broccoli is tender.

title: Green Chili Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; debone in bite-size pieces. Mix together and bake 20 minutes or until bubbly. Grate Cheddar cheese on top and put back in oven until cheese is melted in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into small balls. Cook about 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Can be frozen.

title: Cold Cut Bread
instructions: Roll out dough (after it has reached room temperature) into a large oblong shape. Cut meats into strips. Cut Swiss cheese into strips. Spread all meats evenly on dough then spread Swiss and Mozzarella cheeses evenly over dough. Roll dough up in jelly roll fashion. Place seam down into a large greased cookie sheet. Brush bread with beaten egg. Sprinkle with seeds if so desired. Crimp ends. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. (If bread is very large more baking time may be required.)

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given.

title: Swedish Cole Slaw
instructions: Bring sugar vinegar and oil to a boil and while hot pour over cabbage mixture. Do not stir until cold. Cover and put in refrigerator. Will keep for days. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Raised Donuts Or Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix milk sugar butter and salt until butter is melted. Add yeast mixture and flour to make soft dough. Place dough on well floured board and knead until soft and elastic. Roll dough about 1/2 inch thick; cut with round cutter then cut small hole in center. (I use a glass and a 2 liter bottle cap.) Let rise until double in size about 3 hours. Fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Shake in bag with mixture of sugar and cinnamon or frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Graham Cracker Eclair
instructions: Layer crackers in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add layer of pudding mix; repeat 3 times. Spread chocolate frosting on top. Refrigerate overnight and serve the next day.

title: Hawaiian Cheesecake
instructions: Beat softened cream cheese with 1 1/2 cups milk until smooth. Add pudding mix and remaining milk beating 1 minute. Fold dairy topping into the mixture. Melt butter in a 9 to 10-inch pie plate. Form a crust working in as much coconut as possible. Press onto sides and bottom of pie plate. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20+ minutes. Cool. Fill and freeze. Serve frozen.

title: Peach Preserves
instructions: You will also need 8 (1 cup) jelly jars sterilized.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix together and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and cook the onion a little before adding other ingredients. Beat eggs first; add and combine all ingredients except cheese and place in baking dish; top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until brown and puffy.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well. Combine flour salt and sugar. Add gradually to beaten eggs and continue beating until sugar is dissolved. Combine corn syrup Dr. Pepper and vanilla. Add to beaten egg mixture along with melted margarine. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Combine chocolate pieces and pecans sprinkle over top of the filling. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 until well set 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Raspberry Punch
instructions: Boil raspberry juice with sugar cornstarch and spices. When cool add orange juice and grape juice. Serve over cracked ice or freeze and serve as sherbet.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except egg whites. In separate bowl beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes in 3 greased and floured (8-inch) pans or 2 (9-inch) pans.

title: Muddy Buddies
instructions: Pour cereal in large bowl. In 1-quart microwave-safe bowl combine chocolate chips peanut butter and margarine. Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth stirring after 1 minute. Stir in vanilla. Pour chocolate mixture over cereal stirring until all pieces are evenly coated. Pour cereal mixture in large resealable plastic bag with powdered sugar. Seal securely and shake until all pieces are well coated. Spread on wax paper.

title: Dry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Add drained pineapples. Stir in dry jello. Refrigerate. This makes a delicious salad and will keep for several days.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend all together in blender. Pour into graham cracker shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes (until set). Cool for 10 minutes on rack.

title: Prissy Pecans
instructions: Cook 3 minutes stirring constantly. Pour on waxed paper and push apart with spoon.

title: Sweet Spaghetti
instructions: Cut bacon in chunks. Put in a skillet and brown. When bacon is almost brown put in chopped onions. Brown well. Take bacon grease out (except 4 tablespoons). Add tomato juice and sugar. Cook on medium for 15 minutes. Then turn down to simmer. Cook your noodles. Add to sauce.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain all beans and pimentos in colander. Finely chop onions green peppers and celery. Add vinegar oil sugar salt and pepper. Mix well. Add drained vegetables.

title: Crispy Chicken Bits
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Cut in 1-inch pieces. In plastic bag combine flour parsley poultry seasoning salt and pepper. Add chicken pieces a few at a time to seasoned flour mix. Close bag and shake to coat pieces well.

title: Basic Nut Bread
instructions: Add and mix well by hand the first 7 ingredients. Add last bananas and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 or so minutes. Test doneness with broomstraw or cake tester. For best moistness only a few small crumbs should stick to tester wire.

title: Pot Roast Meat Loaf(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: *Or mix 1 teaspoon salt a few grains of pepper and 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes and sprinkle on all.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Season pork chops to taste. Roll in flour then brown on back side. Cut up vegetables and set aside until you have browned the pork chops. Saute vegetables in same skillet with the oil you cooked the chops in. Place the chops in casserole pan. After the vegetables are done pour the tomato juice in with the vegetables. Take that and pour over the chops. Simmer about 15 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0. Serve with rice and tossed salad or mashed potatoes.

title: Blt Dip
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise and sour cream. Add cut up tomatoes. Fry bacon crisp; crumble and add to mixture. Dip bagel chips.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Pie
instructions: Line pie pan with pastry. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Add apples and mix well. Place apples in pan. Dot with butter. Cover pie with crust cutting slits for steam to escape. Seal edges and flute. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until crust is well browned and apples are cooked through. If edge seems to brown too quickly cover with a strip of foil.

title: Golden Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cut green peppers into thin strips and blanch in saucepan of boiling water for 5 to 7 minutes. To destroy bitter flavor place peppers and other vegetables in layers in a heavily buttered 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Spinach Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Combine with rest of ingredients except sliced cheese. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Break American cheese into pieces and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Spinach Salad With Walnuts
instructions: Remove and discard woody stems of spinach. Wash spinach well. Spin to dry or dry with towels. Tear spinach in pieces and place in salad bowl. Add drained water chestnuts. Remove and discard root and wilted ends of green onions chop and sprinkle on salad.

title: Chili Con Corny(A Spicy Corn Chowder)
instructions: Saute 1 large onion with the olive oil. Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Pour into 2 well-greased bread pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pans for 10 minutes.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Place peppers in a boiler pan. Cover with water and boil approximately 20 minutes. Remove and drain. Rinse in cold water until cool. Mix beef onion ketchup rice salt and pepper well. Stuff peppers with meat mixture. Place peppers in a baking dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until meat is done.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Stir yeast and 1 tablespoon of sugar in warm water and let stand. Mix margarine salt and milk in small sauce pan and heat until margarine is just melting. Stir in sugar and egg. Add yeast mixture. Stir in most of flour. Use rest to knead in making a ball of dough. Place in a greased bowl and let rise until about double in size.(about one hour). Punch down and turn out on board and pinch into rolls. Place in greased pan. Let rise for about thirty minutes. Bake at 375 degrees until golden brown.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: In bowl combine milk sugar eggs vanilla salt and nutmeg. Beat well to blend. Sprinkle coconut into pastry shell; pour egg mixture over coconut. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool and serve garnished with whipped cream.

title: Basic Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water; add egg margarine and sugar. Mix well; stir in flour until mixture makes a smooth dough. Keep in large airtight container in refrigerator. When ready to bake spoon dough into greased muffin pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes about 36 large rolls or 72 small rolls.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix cream cheese butter and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Mix well. Add all other ingredients. Bake 1 hour in greased and floured Bundt pan (may need to bake a little longer). Remove from oven and cool 10 minutes. Drizzle additional 1/2 stick melted butter. Turn out of cake pan after cooling for 30 minutes. Dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Yum-Yum Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients by hand and pat into greased cake pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 then cool completely.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown hamburg and drain off grease. Mix both jars of salsa hamburg and 2 cups of cheese. Put into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining 1 cup of cheese over the top. Bake 30 minutes uncovered until bubbly at 375\u00b0. Serve with nacho chips and plenty of napkins!

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Arrange lettuce in bottom of deep bowl. In layers add celery green pepper onions and peas. Do not toss. Spread mayonnaise evenly over layer of peas. Sprinkle with sugar and cheese. Cover; refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Sprinkle bacon over salad before serving. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Coconut Pie Crust
instructions: Melt butter; stir in other ingredients. Press into 9-inch pie pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Cool before filling.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Roll out 1/4 inch thick and cut out with doughnut cutter. Fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Drain well on paper towels.

title: Joan'S Spicy Hot Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp. Remove bacon; crumble and set aside or substitute oil. Stir next 11 ingredients into bacon drippings or oil in skillet. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Pour mixture into serving dish. Sprinkle bacon and parsley over top. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mile High Raspberry Pie
instructions: Beat whites until fluffy. Add berries sugar and juice and beat at high speed for 15 minutes. Fold in whipped cream and pour into baked pie shell or crumb crust. Freeze several hours. Cut and serve at once after removing from freezer.

title: Turnip Puff
instructions: Mix all together. Pour in greased casserole and bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Original Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 can onions. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until onions are golden. Makes 6 servings.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add flour and milk as for white sauce. Add sugar and cheese; let cheese melt. Blend in sour cream. Mix part of this mixture with drained beans. Put in casserole dish; pour remaining sauce on top. Cover with crushed corn flakes; dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Heat thoroughly.

title: Citrus Veal
instructions: Pound medallions of veal into 4 x 5-inch pieces. Add tarragon to veal slices. Blanch carrots in water until crunchy. Drain. Place vegetables on veal slices. Wrap veal around vegetables and secure with toothpicks. Lightly roll veal in flour. Saute veal rolls in clarified butter for 2 minutes. Remove veal to pie tin and hold in warming oven. Add ginger and cook for 15 seconds. Deglaze with white wine; reduce by half. Add Grand Marnier; reduce by half. Add orange juice. Dissolve arrowroot in chicken stock and add to sauce. Reduce and add honey. Cut segments from fruits and add. Cook for 10 seconds. Pour sauce over veal. Garnish with citrus zest. Makes 2 servings.

title: Hearty Tuna Casserole
instructions: Drain and flake the tuna; set aside. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse in hot water. Combine noodles with the tuna celery and green onions. Blend in the sour cream mustard mayonnaise thyme and salt. Spoon half the mixture into a buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with half the zucchini. Repeat layers. Top with the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with the chopped tomato.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs. Add flour cocoa and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in 8 x 8-inch square pan (greased and floured) for 20 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream and 1/2 envelope taco seasoning. Brown ground beef and drain. Mix meat with 1 cup water and rest of taco seasoning. Cook a few minutes cool and drain. Layer cream cheese mixture meat mixture shredded lettuce diced tomatoes diced peppers and cheeses. Refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with chips.

title: Easy Pickled Cucumber Rounds
instructions: Combine first six ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil stirring until sugar dissolves. Set aside to cool.

title: Nantucket Cranberry Shortbread
instructions: Grease a pie pan. Line with cranberries. Spread the 1/3 cup sugar and 1/3 cup walnuts on top. In a bowl mix together the next ingredients (sugar flour eggs almond extract and butter). Pour onto the cranberry/sugar walnut mixture in the pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until top is golden.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Make a well of the dry ingredients. Add the eggs and oil stir until everything is moistened. Stir in the strawberries. Pour into two 8-inch loaf pans well-greased. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand to cool.

title: Date And Nut Loaf
instructions: Sprinkle soda over cut dates and pour boiling water over both. Stir sugar butter salt and egg. Add nutmeats date mixture and sifted flour. Bake in greased loaf pan in slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: First Day Wash cucumbers put in large container. Mix salt in a gallon of boiling water and pour over cucumbers. Let stand 24 hours in brine.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Place potatoes in casserole dish. Drain bacon; leave in frying pan. Stir in flour sugar water and vinegar. Stir and simmer until it makes a thin sauce. Add chopped onion and stir. Pour over potatoes. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Precook the peppers in boiling salted water 5 minutes. Drain. Cook beef and onion until meat is slightly brown. Season with salt and a dash of pepper. Add tomatoes water rice and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer until rice is tender. Add cheese. Fill pepper cups and place in baking dish. Put grated cheese on top and bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Savory Scallops
instructions: Pat dry scallops with paper towel. Place in greased pie plate. Sprinkle with lemon juice salt and pepper. Top with mushrooms; drizzle with 1/4 cup butter. Mix remaining 1/4 cup butter with bread crumbs. Sprinkle over mushrooms. Broil in preheated broiler 6 inches from heat until scallops are opaque 10 to 12 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

title: Amazing Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Combine milk sugar Bisquick eggs butter and vanilla in a blender. Cover and blend at low speed for 3 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pour Doritos in a large bowl and pour chicken broth over them. Let stand 5 minutes; stir occasionally. Spray large casserole dish with Pam. Layer 1/3 Doritos 1/2 green pepper 1/2 onion 1/2 chicken and 1/2 cheese. Repeat. End with Doritos on top. Reserve 1/3 of cheese. Mix together soup tomatoes garlic salt and chili powder. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle remaining cheese and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Lemon Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and let chill. Just before serving add coconut and bananas.

title: Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Mix 1 cup of sour cream with cottage cheese. Add onion Worcestershire sauce and salt to taste. Mix into noodles and place into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spread with remaining sour cream. Sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Linguini With Clam Sauce
instructions: Drain broth from clams. Set aside. In a saucepan heat oil and margarine. Add garlic. Saute 1 minute. Sprinkle in flour and cook stirring constantly 1 minute. Add clam broth parsley salt pepper and lemon peel. Simmer 10 minutes. Add clams and heat. Toss with hot cooked linguini. Serve with cheese if desired. Serves 2 large portions or 4 small side dishes.

title: Bacon Cheeseburger Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook onion ground beef and pepper in 8-inch skillet over medium-high heat until meat is no longer pink (8 to 12 minutes). Drain. Add pizza sauce. Reduce heat to low. Cook 5 minutes. Place baked pizza crust on ungreased 12-inch pizza pan or baking sheet. Top crust with ground beef mixture Cheddar cheese Mozzarella cheese and bacon. Bake for 8 to 12 minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Savory Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat the broiler with the rack on the top shelf of the oven. Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Carefully clean the mushrooms by wiping with a damp paper towel. Break the stems off and then chop them extremely fine discarding the tough ends. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and the chopped stems to the oil. Fry until the liquid from the mushrooms has evaporated. Remove from heat and set aside until cool. Once the stems are cool stir the cheeses herbs and spices into the mixture. The mixture should be thick. Using a little spoon fill each mushroom top with a generous amount of the stuffing mixture. Arrange the mushrooms on the cookie sheet. Bake for about 3 minutes or until sizzling under the broiler.

title: Chocolate Revel Bars
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Mix in eggs vanilla flour soda salt and oatmeal. Press 2/3 of this dough on cookie sheet. Melt chips condensed milk butter and vanilla on low until smooth and creamy. Pour over dough. Arrange remaining dough in little circles on top of chocolate mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Form into balls. Roll in powdered sugar. Makes 4 dozen. May be frozen.

title: Tomato Aspic
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water. Add 1/2 cup boiling water to gelatine. Mix with other ingredients. Chill. Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars and oil together thoroughly. Add flour soda salt vanilla and chocolate chips to sugar oil and egg until well blended. May use white chocolate chips or peanut butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Do not overbake. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Apricot Mochi Dessert
instructions: Mix together mochi-ko Jell-O and sugar; stir in nectar and water. Mix well.\tPour into greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and cover\ttightly with foil. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Keep foil\ton for additional 15 minutes. Uncover but cool thoroughly\tbefore\tcutting. Cut into desired shapes or sizes using cornstarch to coat lightly in order to handle them without sticking to the dish you wish to set upon.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in the milk 2 or 3 minutes. Add all of the remaining ingredients; mix well. Shape into small 2 ounce round balls and roll in the flour. Brown in the cooking oil in a frypan. Remove from the frypan and place in a roasting pan. Cover with water. Cook in preheated oven at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Add a small amount of water if necessary. Makes 8 meat balls to the pound; this menu should make from 20 to 26 meat balls.

title: Broccoli Tip Salad
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Then in a small bowl mix the next 3 ingredients very well and pour over the first four ingredients. Double this recipe to serve 9 people.

title: Granny'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in casserole. Mix soup with 1 cup milk; pour over chicken. Mix stuffing with 1/2 cup melted butter and broth from chicken. Spread over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chicken 'N Rice Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine rice chicken peas celery and grated onion; set aside. In another bowl blend together mayonnaise salt and pepper. Thoroughly mix into chicken and rice mixture. Chill an hour or more before serving. Serve on lettuce. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Bake Potato Bake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread in pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Lightly fry chicken then remove from frying pan leaving sufficient cooking oil to lightly fry onions. Add fried onions and tomatoes to chicken.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Stir cocoa and\tbaking\tsoda in mixing bowl. Blend in 1/3 cup vegetable oil add boiling water; stir in sugar eggs and remaining 1/3 cup\tvegetable oil;\tstir until smooth. Add flour vanilla and salt blend completely. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan or\ttwo 8-inch square pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes for 13 x 9-inch pan or 30 to 32 minutes for 8-inch pans. Cool; frost if desired.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Do this first! Separate the whites of eggs; beat very stiff; beat in sugar and stir in pecans and chocolate bits. Cover cookie sheet with foil and spoon the mixture onto the cookie sheet. Put in the oven and turn the oven off. The next morning you will have your Forgotten Cookies.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute chopped onions and celery. Place in a casserole dish and then layer the chicken soup and stuffing. Season with salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Pour the chicken broth over top and bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Festive Punch
instructions: Chill ingredients. Combine in punch bowl. Float ice mold in punch when ready to serve.

title: Cherry Bing Bars
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler. Add peanut butter and mix well. Crush peanuts fine and add with Rice Krispies to chocolate. Mix well and put in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Lettuce
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Combine egg onion sugar salt vinegar and water. Add to bacon and stir. Heat to boiling. Pour hot dressing over lettuce and toss.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Beat slowly the milk egg yolks and lemon juice. Wash beaters. Now beat the egg whites slowly adding 2 tablespoons of sugar per egg white. Pour lemon mixture into baked pie shell. Top with egg white mixture. Brown in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Put the noodles in bottom of a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Brown the hamburger with the onion. Spread over the noodles.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Cook sausage in skillet until brown and crisp. Drain fat. Heat 2 tablespoons sausage drippings in skillet and saute onion until tender. Set aside.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion. Drain butter and lima beans; mix meat beans and other vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Swiss Carrot Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl beat sugar oil and butter. With beater at low speed add sifted dry ingredients alternating with eggs beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Add carrots nuts and pineapple. Grease 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crescent Dinner Rolls
instructions: Stir up and let set overnight (covered). Divide into thirds. Roll out as pie dough. Cut into 8 equal parts. (I use pizza cutter.) Let rise again 6 to 8 hours. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sesame Teriyaki Bites
instructions: Cut steak into 24 cubes. Drain pineapple reserving 1/4 cup juice. Combine juice teriyaki sauce honey and ground ginger. Marinate steak in mixture overnight.

title: Tutti-Frutti Milk Shake
instructions: Measure all ingredients into blender. Blend for approximately 1 minute. Drink immediately. Serves 2.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and peas. Mix all ingredients together. Stir well and let chill at least 1 hour. Better if chilled overnight.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain off fat. Add other ingredients. Cook thirty minutes. Serve on buns.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium cooking uncovered for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Stir in remaining ingredients. Its done!

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Crust Combine 1/2 cup margarine 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup powdered sugar. Cut fine with pastry blender. Pour into a 9-inch square pan. Press on bottom until spread flat all over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. This should not be brown.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Combine milk and sugar in saucepan. Bring to a boil; boil for 4 1/2 minutes stirring constantly. In bowl place chocolate chips milk chocolate bar marshmallow cream and nuts. Pour hot sugar mixture over top and stir until all is mixed. Put into buttered pan to cool. Let set before cutting.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Press cookie dough onto a sound pizza pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown about 10 minutes. Let cool. Spread cream cheese on cooled cookie dough and layer sliced fruit arranging like a pizza.

title: Mexican Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine olive oil vinegar garlic salt and pepper to taste in bowl; mix well. Add chopped vegetables; mix well. Chill overnight. Stir to mix. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 96 tablespoons.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
instructions: Beat together cream cheese sour cream oregano and garlic powder. Spread evenly in a 9 or 10 inch pie plate. Spread pizza sauce over the top. Sprinkle with pepperoni onion and green pepper. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Top with cheese and bake for 5 minutes more until heated through. Serve with crackers vegetables or chips.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
