instructions: Cream margarine. Add oil sugar eggs vanilla and milk. Mix in dry ingredients. Stir in zucchini and chocolate chips. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan (Pam sprayed if preferred). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: Mix well. Shape into 2 ounce balls. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serve with your favorite sauce.

title: Chinese Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Boil cabbage in small amount of salted water for 5 minutes and drain. Saute all vegetables except cabbage in butter. Butter a baking dish and layer cabbage and then vegetables until all are used.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Boil 3 minutes; put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix syrup and sugar well. Cook at High power in microwave oven for 4 minutes. Then add peanuts and cook 3 minutes. Then add butter and vanilla; cook for 1 minute. Add soda and mix well then pour in an ungreased cookie sheet. Let harden.

title: Steak And Ale Sauteed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and trim mushrooms; dice. Boil in water to cover 5 minutes. Drain. Melt oleo in pot and saute onions. Add mushrooms beef bouillon cubes cornstarch and seasonings. Mix until dissolved. Add wine and Worcestershire and simmer until mushrooms are tender (20 to 30 minutes).

title: Cheesy Broccoli 'N Mushroom Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange broccoli in 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Mix well. Grease cookie sheet with sides; line with waxed paper. Grease paper; pour in batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn cake upside-down on cloth tea towel dusted with 10x sugar. Pull off paper. Roll tight and cool. Unroll and fill with filling.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Mix ingredients all together. Cut meat into thin strips; soak in mixture overnight in refrigerator covered. Put toothpicks through the end of each slice and hang on oven rack. Cook at 150\u00b0 for 4 to 7 hours with oven door slightly ajar. Bake according to how chewy or crispy you want.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and set aside. In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in milk until smooth. Stir in gelatin; add pineapple and mix well. Chill. When mixture begins to thicken fold in whipped topping. Pour into a 2 1/2-quart serving bowl. Chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Heat the oven to 375\u00b0. Halve the bread lengthwise. In a small bowl stir the oil oregano garlic and pepper. Spread on bread. Wrap each half in foil leaving the tops uncovered. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 25 minutes until golden and crusted. With a serrated knife cut each half into 6 pieces. Serves 6.

title: Grandma Flo'S Lemon Pie
instructions: In small saucepan mix sugar cornstarch salt lemon juice and water. Cook until thick. Add a little of this mixture into beaten egg yolks. Then place into saucepan and cook 2 more minutes. Place into a baked pie shell and top with meringue. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lemon Pie Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O in 2 cups hot water. Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water. Mix together. Add pineapple and juice. Chill until thick. Beat with mixer. Beat in Cool Whip and lemon pie filling. Top with nuts or grated cheese.

title: Brunch Cheesecake(Makes 16 To 20 Servings)
instructions: In a small bowl dissolve yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar in warm milk; let stand until foamy (5 to 10 minutes). In a large bowl combine flour and salt. With pastry blender cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add 4 egg yolks to yeast mixture and stir until blended. Stir into flour mixture until well blended; set aside.

title: Orange Sherbet-Gelatin Salad
instructions: Add sherbet into dissolved gelatin in boiling water. Mix well. When partially set (about 5 minutes) add orange slices and Cool Whip. Fold in and refrigerate.

title: Crabbies Appetizer
instructions: Mix margarine mayo cheese and garlic salt. Mashing with a fork add crabmeat. Spread on 12 English muffin halves. Cut into quarters or smaller.

title: Tuna Burger
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Fill buns wrap each in foil. Put in 250\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Enjoy. Can use chicken in place of tuna.

title: Venison Jerky
instructions: Cut venison into strips about 1/2-inch thick 1-inch wide and 12-inches long. Dig a 3-foot square hole about 3-feet deep. Make a narrow ditch from the side down into the bottom of the hole to produce an oxygen supply when a fire is built in the hole. Build a slow fire in the hole. Put green lengths of small branches over the hole and lay the strips of meat over these. Cover this over with logs or anything available but leave enough of an opening so the fire will not go out. Keep the slow smoldering fire going for about 12 hours by dropping in small pieces of dry wood. Jerky will keep almost indefinitely. It may be soaked in water 4 or 5 hours and boiled into a stew.

title: Dumplings, Pork Hocks And Kraut
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients then add beaten egg milk and shortening. Mix well and form into balls.

title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole dish. Mix dry ingredients. Stir in\tmilk and mix\tthoroughly. Add to melted butter. Arrange 2 cups fruit in batter. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar over top. Bake 15\tminutes at 450\u00b0. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0.\tBake 20 minutes more or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Cheese Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix together Oreo cookies and melted butter. Spread mixture in the bottom of a cake pan. Place in freezer to stiffen. In the same bowl mix together Cool Whip cream cheese and vanilla. Spread over cookie mixture. Top with chocolate pudding. Chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Oatmeal Squares
instructions: Bring sugar butter cocoa and milk to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Add oats peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well and pour in a dish.

title: Blt Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Serve with ritz crackers.

title: Ina Lou Hurt'S Chess Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add eggs and milk and beat until sugar is almost dissolved. Add melted butter vinegar and vanilla. Pour in uncooked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until firm.

title: Lania'S Best Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cream margarine and cream cheese add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Beat only until mixed well. Add flour about 1/2 cup at a time scraping down sides as they need it. Add vanilla. Beat on low to medium speed about 1 to 2 minutes until smooth. Pour into greased tube or Bundt pan and bake for 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown and done.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Pour hot water over gelatin and stir well. Add pineapple cherries and nuts. Pour in Coca-Cola and stir well. Let set overnight.

title: Depression Era Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Pour into two 9-inch unbaked pie shells. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Tastes like pecan pie.

title: Cream Puff Dessert
instructions: Boil in microwave - butter with 1 cup water then add flour. Mix well to form a ball. Cool for 5 minutes then add eggs one at a time. Spread in a well greased 9x13 pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Autumn Soup
instructions: Stew and debone chicken. Add remaining ingredients to water reserved from stewing chicken. Cut chicken into bite-size chunks. Add to soup. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Nite Night Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites. Gradually fold in sugar. Add cream of tartar; beat then fold in chocolate chips. On 2 cookie sheets lay wax paper. Drop mixture onto wax paper by spoonfuls. Put pans into oven. Count to 10. Turn oven off. Leave cookies in oven 6 to 8 hours or overnight.

title: Holiday Yams
instructions: Combine sugar and starch. Blend well. Stir in liquid butter and salt. Simmer over low heat stirring constantly until begins to thicken. Place yams in lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Add sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Rhubarb Kuchen
instructions: Combine gelatin 1/3 cup of sugar 3 tablespoons of flour and rhubarb; mix well. Let stand 15 minutes.

title: Irresistible Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Soak raisins in rum for 60 minutes (optional). In a large bowl cream butter. Add sugars and cream again until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla until smooth. In a separate bowl mix dry ingredients (flour oatmeal salt and baking soda). Add dry mixture to other bowl and mix well. Now add chocolate chips nuts and raisins. Stir from the bottom of the bowl until all the ingredients are well combined. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drop by teaspoons onto well-buttered cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on racks. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9-inch or 10-inch tube pan. Mix together the 4 teaspoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon and set aside.

title: Potatoes Anna
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Using 3 tablespoons of butter or margarine grease a heavy 8-inch skillet. Peel potatoes. Cut potatoes crosswise into thin slices. Put potatoes in a large bowl and toss gently with salt and pepper. Arrange in layers covering with butter. Place skillet over medium-high heat and cook 3 minutes to brown the bottom of potatoes. Remove from heat and cover with foil. Press down firmly with 9-inch Pyrex dish. Place skillet and dish in center of rack in oven. Bake 30 minutes. Remove Pyrex dish and foil; bake 5 more minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Oven Stew
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. In large Dutch oven combine all ingredients; mix well. Cover. Bake for 6 to 7 hours stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaves. Makes 12 (1 cup) servings.

title: Scrumptious Shrimp Dip
instructions: Finely chop the top ends of the scallions. Let cream cheese soften at room temperature. Mix softened cream cheese mayonnaise and scallions. Add drained cans of shrimp. Squeeze juice from lemon. Add Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies and put half of crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese and margarine until smooth. Mix in confectioners sugar. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Debone salmon. Add eggs flour meal ketchup and onions. Slowly add enough milk to make batter that can be dropped into grease. Heat Teflon pan to medium. Drop patties by the spoonful into butter flavored Crisco. Cook until golden brown.

title: Scalloped Corn With Jiffy Mix
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add thawed strawberries nuts pineapple and mashed bananas. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and pour half of mixture into 8 x 12 pan. Place in refrigerator until set (about 15 minutes). Spread sour cream over set jello and then add remaining mixture to top of sour cream. Let it set in refrigerator about 30 minutes. Cut in squares to serve. Makes about 12 servings.

title: Barazushi
instructions: Cook 4 cups rice. Soak Kurome in water; drain when soft. Cook grated carrot Aburage kamaboko Takemoto Kurome and ajisukekogai together with Wesson oil shoyu sugar and sake. Set aside until rice is done. Add 1 package Tamanoi sushi rice mix to hot rice; mix all together with the cooked ingredients. Garnish with thinly sliced eggs and red and green shrimp flakes. Delicious hot or cold.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake covered in casserole dish for 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cake Cookies
instructions: *Lemon cake mix and strawberry work well for these cookies.

title: Banana Blueberry Pie
instructions: Bake 2 pie shells. Cool. Mix together Cool Whip softened cream cheese and sugar. Cut up 3 bananas and fold into mixture. Divide into 2 pie shells. Top with blueberry filling; refrigerate.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut lettuce and cauliflower into pieces. Layer ingredients in order listed. Store covered in refrigerator about 12 hours. Toss and serve.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown beef and onion in small amount of fat. Mix with remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve on heated hamburger buns. Serves 4 to 5 generously.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown beef then brown onions and pepper. Mix chili powder salt and pepper. Grease casserole dish; add rice. Pour mixture into dish. Cover with grated cheese (optional). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

title: Mom Piper'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Measure all dry ingredients except cocoa into mixing bowl. Add eggs oil and milk to dry ingredients. Mix well. In a saucepan mix cocoa and boiling water. Add vanilla and blend well. Blend cocoa mixture into ingredients in mixing bowl. Batter will be thin. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool and frost with fluffy icing.

title: Karo Classic Pecan Pie
instructions: Stir together first 5 ingredients until blended. Add nuts. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: If using frozen mixed vegetables cook then drain. Combine first 6 ingredients. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Meat And Vegetable Pie
instructions: In medium bowl mix flour and salt. Cut in lard or shortening until small particles are formed. Mixing with fork gradually stir in 5 tablespoons cold water or enough to hold particles together. Form into a ball and wrap in plastic. Chill while preparing filling.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients at one time except nuts and apples. Mix well. (Omit baking powder if using self-rising flour.) Fold in nuts and apples. Bake in 12-cup tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand awhile before turning out.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Drop by teaspoon into a mixture of cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Lightly brown chicken breasts in 2 tablespoons of the margarine seasoning to taste with salt and pepper. If serving in individual casseroles arrange 2 pieces of broccoli in each end to end with buds towards outside of dish. Arrange chicken over broccoli.

title: Cherry Pie Delight
instructions: Mix flour eggs and sugar together. Spread cherry pie filling in greased cake pan. Sprinkle cinnamon over cherries. Spread flour mixture over cherries. Pour butter over flour mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Place cabbage in greased baking dish. Brown meat and onion. Stir in rice. Cook until rice is brown. Pour mixture over cabbage. Season with salt and pepper. Mix soup and water in bowl. Pour over cabbage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. In separate saucepan boil 1 cup water and add bouillon cube. Break up noodles and slightly brown in the butter. Stir constantly. Add rice and saute a few minutes stirring. Add beef broth. Cover and cook on low fire 20 minutes. When water is absorbed and rice is soft remove from fire and let stand 15 minutes with napkin undercover. Stir and serve. Serves 2.

title: Raisin Orange Bread
instructions: Combine raisins and water; bring to boil. Cool to room temperature. Mix egg brown sugar salad oil and orange peel. Stir in raisin mixture. Sift together flour salt baking powder and soda; add beating well. Pour into greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 60 minutes.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet and add vegetables; saute until tender. Stir in herbs and spices. In large bowl blend eggs and cheese and add vegetable mixture.

title: Egg Salad
instructions: Combine the eggs scallions celery caraway seed and bacon. Toss lightly. Combine the mayonnaise and horseradish; fold the mixture into the salad. Sprinkle with parsley and serve. Serves 4.

title: Hot Tamale Casserole
instructions: Boil ground chuck 45 minutes salt water to taste. Crumble chuck up real fine as it cooks. Drain the water from the meat saving it for later.

title: Cookie Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and eggs. Add juice and mix well. Bring to a boil. Add jello to boiling mixture. Cool completely. Beat chilled milk until foamy. Pour in jello mixture while mixing. Line 2 pie plates with vanilla wafers. Chill until ready to serve. You may use different flavors of jello.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and dry mushrooms; remove stems. Lay caps upside down in greased baking dish. Chop stems. In skillet melt 2 tablespoons butter. Add mushroom stems and saute. Combine stems and remaining butter pecans onions parsley salt and pepper. Mix well. Fill each cap with a teaspoon of the butter mixture. Broil 3 to 5 minutes until bubbly.

title: Fried Tomatoes
instructions: Slice tomatoes into thick crosswise slices. Combine all dry ingredients. Coat tomatoes with dry mixture. Drop in hot oil until golden brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chinese Broccoli And Beef Salad
instructions: Cut florets off broccoli; reserve tender parts of stalks. Cut stalks into 3/8-inch thick slices. In wok or large skillet heat oil and stir-fry stalks for 1 minute. Add florets and stir-fry for 3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Transfer broccoli to large bowl. Stir-fry pepper strips for 1/2 minute; add to broccoli. Stir-fry mushrooms until crisp-tender; add to broccoli. Combine vinegar soy sauce salt and red pepper. Pour over broccoli mixture; toss well. Add beef water chestnuts and bamboo shoots. Toss. Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours. Makes 12 servings.

title: Honey Of A Ham Steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place ham steak in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Pour milk over ham. Combine mustard and honey spread on top of ham. Bake 20 minutes. Cut into 4 pieces. Serves 4.

title: Barbecued Shrimp
instructions: Wash shrimp; drain and dry. Place shrimp in roasting pan. Spread butter over shrimp completely. Cover buttered shrimp with lots of black pepper so all you can see is pepper about 1/8-inch thick. Cover. Bake about 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve with lots of French bread for dipping in butter sauce.

title: Quick Creamed Chicken
instructions: In hot butter in skillet saute green pepper until tender. Stir in soup and milk. Heat slowly stirring constantly. Then add chicken and pimento. Cook 10 minutes longer. Serve over toast.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion. Boil for 5 minutes and drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in carrots. Fold in squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix and butter.

title: Hobo Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger in large pot. Pour off excess fat. Then add rest of ingredients. Simmer 1 hour.

title: Baked Butter Beans
instructions: Drain beans and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix in tomato sauce brown sugar salt mustard and syrup. Mix flour in water to dissolve and stir into bean mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until it thickens.

title: Yuletide Dessert
instructions: Mix cookies and 1/3 cup butter to make crumbs. Press in bottom of pan; reserve 2 tablespoons for topping. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating well. Spread over crumbs. Whip 1 cup cream and add 4 cups sugar 2 tablespoons cocoa 1/2 cup chopped walnuts 1 ripe banana (mashed) and 1/4 cup maraschino cherries. Pile on top. Scatter reserved crumbs on top. Refrigerate. Ready to serve.

title: Vidalia Pie(Hot Appetizer)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix well; put in greased dish and bake 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Sausage-Potato-Dinner
instructions: Grease a 10-inch baking dish. Line the bottom with potatoes. In separate saucepan heat soup and water stirring until smooth. Stir in cheese until melted. Add Hillshire sausage pieces green pepper and pimento (if desired). Pour over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until potatoes are done. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Balls (No Bake)
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape into bite size balls. Reserve several spoons of powdered sugar. Place in a small bag and add balls and shake. If you like coconut roll balls in flaked coconut instead of using powdered sugar.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Take chicken off the bone. Mix flour butter and eggs together. Roll out and cut into strips. Put chicken and strips of noodles into pot together. Fill with water until all is covered. Cook until noodles are soft.

title: Broccoli-Cheddar Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix broccoli corn onion and walnuts; place in pan. Beat remaining ingredients except cheese until smooth. Pour evenly into pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until a knife in center comes out clean; then sprinkle and top with cheese. Bake another 5 minutes. Let cool; then cut into squares. Top each square with a sliced black olive.

title: Lulu'S Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add eggs milk and vinegar slowly. Stir constantly while cooking until mixture thickens.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Add mushrooms flour salt and paprika. Stir in soup. Cook slowly about 20 minutes stirring frequently. Add sour cream and cook for about 8 minutes. Serve over cooked noodles or rice.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients. Pour into well-greased 9 x 5-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Pour additional butter on top and bake for 15 more minutes to brown. Serve warm or cool. Yield 1 loaf.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients adding whipped cream last. Chill.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter and oil on medium-high. Add flour to thicken.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Place meat in deep roaster. Add water and cook until tender enough to shred meat into bite size pieces. Then add diced onion and celery. Put all three back into roaster. Add rest of ingredients and simmer about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheddar Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter over low heat in a saucepan. Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually add milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Add salt and cheeses. Stir until cheese melts. Add potatoes. Stir gently to mix. Place in a greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Add shortening and eggs and mix until well blended. Stir in vanilla. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8-10 minutes at 350 degrees. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes celery and onion with the water in a covered pan until tender. Do not drain. Add milk bouillon cubes and butter. Mix sour cream with flour until smooth. Add to soup and cook it until thick stirring constantly. Add salt and pepper. Add ham if desired.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Cream the butter; add sugar gradually and cream until light. Stir in beaten eggs. Add flour baking powder and salt to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk. Stir in vanilla. Chill the dough for several hours. Roll out 1/3-inch thick on a floured surface. Cut with a floured cutter. Fry in deep fat (375\u00b0) until golden brown. Turn. Drain on a paper towel. Cover with cinnamon or powdered sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine milk sugar syrup and butter. Let boil for 30 minutes. Stir often so it wont scorch. Let cool and add peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until it thickens about 10 minutes. Pour into greased pan and let sit.

title: Cheesy Bacon Bites
instructions: Combine cream cheese bacon onion and pepper. Separate crescent rolls into two rectangles; pinch seams together. Spread cheese mixture on each rectangle. Roll up starting at longest side and seal. Cut each roll into 16 slices. For easier cutting I roll in wax paper and chill for a few minutes prior to slicing. Place slices cut side down on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Make into balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Press in bottom of 9 x 12-inch dish; cook at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into large baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Put boneless skinless chicken breasts on top of rice mixture. Cover with foil. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Smoky Salmon Spread
instructions: Drain salmon reserving 2 teaspoons liquid and flake. Combine cream cheese liquid smoke and salmon liquid; blend thoroughly. Stir in green onion then fold in salmon. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight to blend flavors. Serve as a spread with crackers. Makes about 1 1/2 cups spread.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Press in a cookie sheet the margarine oatmeal brown sugar flour and nuts. Cook in a 400\u00b0 oven. Watch it until brown; crumble while hot. Put 1/2 in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Gently push it down. Drizzle a little caramel sauce on crumbs. Put softened ice cream over caramel sauce the rest of crumbs over that and drizzle a little more caramel sauce over top. Cover; put in freezer.

title: Easy Strawberry Tart(Very Easy & Quick)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Orange Coffee Punch
instructions: Mix in large bowl. Blend together milk coffee sugar and orange extract. Pour into chilled punch bowl and top with small scoops of sherbet. Yields 4 2/3 cups.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: 1st Layer Mix graham cracker crumbs with 1 stick melted oleo and 1/2 cup sugar. Press crumbs into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix softened butter and flour; press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans and press into dough. Bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: French Onion Beef Stew
instructions: Dust beef with flour; place in dish. Add potatoes onions celery and carrots. Combine tomato juice sugar sauce salt pepper and basil. Pour over beef and vegetables. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Peel Off Pounds Soup
instructions: Cut vegetables in medium size pieces. Cover with water and boil for 10 minutes. Lower heat. Add soup mix and simmer until vegetables are soft.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Thoroughly butter the bottom and sides of a 9-inch square metal cake pan. Pour the graham cracker crumbs in the baking pan; insure that all surfaces are coated with the crumbs. Turn pan over an tap lightly to release excess crumbs.

title: Cheese And Pasta In A Pot
instructions: Cook macaroni and set aside. Saute onion and garlic until soft then brown beef in same skillet. When browned drain all fat and juices. Meat mixture should be dry.

title: Cherry-Chocolate Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease jellyroll pan 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch. Mix sugar butter almond extract and eggs in a large bowl. Stir in cocoa baking soda and salt. Stir in oats. Reserve 1/3 of oats mixture. Press remaining mixture in pan.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Serve in a bowl or dish using paprika on top for garnish. Serve with vegetable slices crackers chips or bread.

title: Texas Brownies
instructions: Use a large mixing bowl. Combine the flour and the sugar in a heavy saucepan. Combine butter shortening and coffee or water. Pour boiling mixture over. Add the buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix well using a wooden spoon or high speed of electric mixer. Pour into a well buttered 17 1/2 x 11-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brownies are done in center. While brownies are baking prepare frosting.

title: Turkey Salad Burritos
instructions: In medium mixing bowl combine turkey celery onion black olives and cheese. In another bowl whisk together salad dressing picante sauce and salt. Pour sauce over turkey mixture; blend well. Spoon filling onto tortillas; wrap burrito-style.* Heat in 13 x 9 x 3-inch baking pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until thoroughly warmed or microwave each burrito 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High. Serve with additional picante sauce; garnish with black olives. Yield 4 servings.

title: French Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water 25 to 30 minutes. Drain and mash. Add milk butter seasonings and baking powder. Beat until fluffy. Add onion. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake for 12 minutes at 350\u00b0 or 375\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Carrot Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream together margarine brown sugar and white sugar; blend in egg. Add carrots and vanilla; mix well. In a separate bowl combine dry ingredients (flour baking powder soda cinnamon and cloves). Add flour mixture alternating with oatmeal to cream mixture. Mix until well blended. Stir in raisins. Drop dough by teaspoon on cookie sheet coated with vegetable spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Stuffed Eggplant Italiano
instructions: Cut eggplant in half lengthwise. Place halves cut side down in shallow baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool slightly. Scoop out pulp leaving 3/8-inch shell. Place shells cut side up in baking pan. Coarsely chop pulp. Combine with remaining ingredients except Mozzarella cheese. Fill eggplant shells pressing firmly. Cover with foil. Pierce foil in several places to allow steam to escape. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove foil and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered about 2 minutes longer or until cheese melts. Cut each half into 2 pieces to serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cinnamon Coffee Bars
instructions: Cream together thoroughly the shortening brown sugar and egg. Stir in the hot coffee. Sift together all the remaining dry ingredients. Blend in nuts. Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch oblong pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into bars. Frost while still warm with a thin coating of Quick Coffee Cream Icing. Makes 2 dozen.

title: White Cream Sauce For Scallops And Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter; stir in flour over low heat. Gradually add milk and water. Heat slowly until it boils and thickens. Stir in cheese and basil. Add pepper to taste. Serve over linguini with fresh scallops and shrimp.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop everything as small as possible; mix well. Roll in chopped pecans. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Makes 1 large or 2 smaller balls.

title: Quick Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Sprinkle Jell-O over cottage cheese; mix well. Add pineapple oranges and rice. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Wild Cherry Wine
instructions: Put all cherries through meat grinder then add water and sugar. Ferment in stoneware container for 20 days. Strain; add more sugar if needed. Ferment for another 3 weeks before serving.

title: Mock Eclair Cake
instructions: In bottom of pan place one layer of graham crackers. Make pudding according to directions. Mix Cool Whip in with pudding. Pour 1/2 on top of graham crackers. Place next layer of graham crackers. Pour rest of pudding on 2nd layer of graham crackers. Place graham crackers on top. Stir icing and spread on top of crackers. Best if chilled for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut wings at joint. Wash. Pat dry on paper towel. Combine remaining ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange wings in single layer in marinade. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake uncovered in 375\u00b0 oven until tender 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Taco Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients cheese on the bottom chili and cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: In a pan bring the water cocoa oil and margarine to a boil. Add the flour sugar salt eggs vanilla milk and baking soda. Pour onto cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. As soon as cake is done ice with the following icing.

title: Quick Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Mix catsup or chili sauce vinegar mustard sugar salt and pepper. Pour over hamburger and onion. Simmer a few minutes. Serve on buns.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together except pecans. Roll it into a ball; chilled for a couple of hours. Roll it in the pecans.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls. Roll each in additional sugar then bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Gently press an unwrapped Hersheys Kiss into each ball.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Chop half of the mushrooms. In a large bowl combine chopped mushrooms ground beef 1/4 cup of soup egg 2 tablespoons of milk bread crumbs onion and pepper. Cover with wax paper and microwave on High for 9 to 10 minutes. Drain and let stand covered for 5 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in graham cracker crust. Refrigerate.

title: All In One Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium saucepan bring water and butter to a boil. Add milk and instant potatoes. Stir and set aside. In large skillet brown beef and onions. Drain off fat. Add soup beans and seasonings except paprika; stir thoroughly. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with potatoes. Sprinkle paprika over top for garnish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: In a small bowl beat together the cream cheese 1/4 cup sugar 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla and the salt until thick creamy and smooth. Reserve. In another small bowl beat 3 eggs just until yolks and whites are combined. Add the corn syrup 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Beat gently until blended. Spread reserved cream cheese mixture in the bottom of unbaked pie shell; sprinkle with the pecans and gently pour the syrup mixture over the pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 until the center is firm to the touch about 35 to 40 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Sausage Jambalaya(Club Member: Nicholas)
instructions: Place 2 tablespoons oil in saucepan. Add sausage and brown. Add onions and garlic. Cook until tender. Add water red pepper salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Add rice and bell pepper. When rice starts to swell turn gently. Cover pot and cook on low heat until rice is tender 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Minced Clam Casserole
instructions: Bake in 375\u00b0 oven 1/2 hour or until golden brown. If too moist add more crackers.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and butter. Add sugar and mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Frost between layers top and sides.

title: Doritos And Fritos Dish
instructions: Reserve some of the chips and cheese for topping. Mix all other ingredients together. Top with the saved cheese and chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Tenn Trash
instructions: Mix popped corn cereals and nuts in roaster pan. Cook brown sugar margarine and Karo. Cook until comes to a boil. Stirring constantly let boil 5 minutes. Not stirring removing and add vanilla and soda. Pour over dry mixture. Cook for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Roast Chicken
instructions: Wash and dry chicken. Place the bay leaf thyme and garlic in the cavity of the chicken. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and then truss. Place chicken in roasting pan; scatter onion chunks around it. Rub with olive oil. Place the chicken on its side and bake for 20 minutes. Occasionally pour off fat. Place chicken on its back. Add margarine and chicken broth and roast 20 minutes longer continuing to baste. It is done when juice is clear.

title: Quinoam, Leek And Tofu Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Working with 1/2 cup tofu at a time squeeze out water with hands. Set aside. Heat a large skillet or wok; add oil. Add garlic then leek. Saute until lightly browned. Add quinoa then tofu sauteing for 2 minutes after each addition. Add seasonings. Oil casserole. Add 1/2 cup bread crumbs; rotate casserole to coat evenly. Gently add the quinoa mixture. Press a well in the center of the quinoa; pour in soymilk. Cover with remaining bread crumbs and cheese. Cover; bake for 20 minutes. Remove cover; continue to bake until cheese is nicely browned.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all together and chill. Serve with your choice of vegetables.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix (as it comes from box) with remaining ingredients with a spoon. Pour into a very lightly greased jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 12 1/2-inch). Bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven then cool. Ice with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: In 13 x 9-inch square cake pan or casserole dish lay in peaches (drain peaches). Put juice in large saucepan. Add vanilla flavor oleo and cinnamon. Cook over low heat. Stir. Add cornstarch. Dissolve about 10 minutes. Pour over peaches. Lay pie crust on wax paper. Cut in strips. Lay on top of peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar together for dressing. Toss salad ingredients with dressing. Chill for two hours before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Wash and scrape carrots; cut in diagonal slices. Cook covered in small amount of water until just tender (approximately 12 minutes). Drain. Heat margarine sugar and preserves in saucepan stirring to combine. Stir into carrots until coated. Cook over low heat stirring gently about 3 minutes.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken broth that is thickened. Combine the mayonnaise lemon juice and cheese. Pour mixture over chicken and rice. Add bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: My Moms Fruit Salad
instructions: Chop unpeeled apples into 1/2 inch chunks. Slice banana into 1/4 inch slices and split all grapes in half. Mix jello according to box directions in a 2 quart casserole dish. Add all remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Microwave Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa salt and flour. Add milk and water. Microwave for 3 minutes on High; stir. If it is not thick enough heat for 2 more minutes. Add egg yolks and heat 3 more minutes. Add margarine and vanilla. Stir and pour into cooked pie shell.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites and salt until stiff. Add sugar slowly. Fold in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet covered with aluminum foil. Place in 350\u00b0 preheated oven. Turn off and leave overnight.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Combine milk and water; heat in large saucepan. Add meal sugar and salt stirring constantly until thickened. Add and mix well egg and margarine. Pour into greased pan and bake for 1 hour at 400\u00b0 or until golden brown. May substitute artificial sweetener for diabetics.

title: Orange-Apricot Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple to boil. Add sugar and jello powder. Stir. Add cream cheese. Cook and stir until cream cheese melts. Add apricots. Pour into bowl. Partially chill. Add Cool Whip. Stir. Chill in mold until set.

title: Cassions Dressing
instructions: Dissolve sugar and oil. Add wine vinegar; heat then cool. Add dry mustard and salt; beat until creamy. Add onion and celery seed. Beat again and chill.

title: Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Pour 1/2 gallon boiling water over 1 quart capped and washed strawberries; drain well.

title: Tuna Ball(Roll)
instructions: Blend 2 tablespoons of parsley with remaining ingredients. Mix well. Place in refrigerator until very cold. Turn out onto waxed paper. Shape into ball or 2 rolls. Roll in remaining parsley. This freezes well so can be made ahead of time.

title: Pineapple Cream Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice. Then fold in Cool Whip and crushed pineapple (not drained). Pour into graham cracker crust and place in refrigerator and let chill from 30 to 45 minutes before serving. Makes 2 pies.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp leaving tail intact. Preheat oven. Melt butter and rest of ingredients except shrimp. Place shrimp in shallow baking dish tail up. Pour sauce over all. Bake 5 minutes. Place under broiler 5 minutes to brown. Serve over rice.

title: Ham And Cheese Strada
instructions: Butter a 3-quart baking dish (9 x 13-inch) Butter one side of 8 slices of bread. Place buttered side down in baking dish. Spread with mustard. Top bread with cheese slices. Sprinkle with white or green onions. Top with ham slices. Butter remaining 8 slices of bread. Place over ham buttered side up. Beat milk eggs salt and pepper to taste. Pour over bread. Pat down. Top with Parmesan cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour (longer if very cold when placed in oven). Serves 8.

title: Hill Billy Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Cook peas until tender. Place onion Worcestershire sauce and butter in with ham and peas. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Let cheese soften. Roll out Velveeta on wax paper to thin layer. Spread cream cheese on Velveeta. Chop pepper into small pieces. Sprinkle on cream cheese. Mince green onions and sprinkle over peppers. Last sprinkle garlic salt over entire mixture. Starting at one end roll up jelly roll style. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight. Slice to serve.

title: Cajun Seasoning Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl; mix thoroughly. Store in tightly covered glass jar for use as needed.

title: Leek And Sweet Pepper Toss
instructions: In a microwave melt margarine in a small dish for 20 seconds on High. Add pepper leek stock and thyme. Cover with vented plastic wrap; microwave on High until vegetables are tender about 3 minutes. Toss with cooked broccoli or other vegetables; sprinkle on cheese. Serve warm as a side dish or tossed with hot pasta as an entree. Serves 4.

title: Breakfast Slush
instructions: Chase wild bullfrogs for 3 miles to gather up hops. To them add 10 gallons of tan bark 1/2 pint of shellac and 1 bar of homemade soap. Boil 36 hours. Strain through one well worn sock to keep it from working. Add one grasshopper to each pint to give it a kick. Pour a little into the kitchen sink. If it takes the enamel off its ready to bottle.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart baking pan. Stir. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Top with corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Marinated Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix Italian sauce sugar water black pepper vinegar salad oil and salt. Pour over vegetables; cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight stirring occasionally. Drain. Serve in lettuce lined bowl. Makes 8 servings.

title: James Italian  Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Form into about 1 inch balls and place on lightly greased baking sheet.

title: Stewed Tomato Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in skillet over medium heat. Stir in bread cubes until slightly brown and toasted; set aside.

title: Old Fashioned Biscuits
instructions: Blend flour salt sugar and baking powder. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Combine milk and 1/4 cup ice water. Add all at once to flour mixture. Mix well. Knead dough. Roll out and cut into biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Nutty Dumplings
instructions: Arrange pineapple slices in 10-inch skillet with cover. Pour in syrup from fruit and heat. Combine biscuit mix milk nuts and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Mix well with a fork. Spoon on pineapple slices and cook on low heat about 10 minutes. Sprinkle brown sugar over the top and cook another 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Lay chicken in a well-greased glass dish (9 x 12) and put one piece of cheese on each piece of chicken. Warm milk and soup; pour over chicken. Melt margarine and add stuffing. Sprinkle over soup/chicken. Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Take off foil and let brown 15 minutes more. Can be prepared night before and then cooked day to be served.

title: Salsa
instructions: Put into large bowl and blend with hand blender (or food processor). Put into sealable container and chill. Will stay fresh for 2 to 3 weeks.

title: Rum Cake And Coffee
instructions: Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Place chopped pecans in bottom (if like chopped cherries). Mix all ingredients well (can be slightly lumpy). Pour into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove cake from oven leave in pan and add glaze.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat together shortening and sugar. Add egg yolk and vanilla. Stir in flour; fold in potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Potato Salad
instructions: To 2 cups medium white cream sauce add 1/2 cup sour cream 2 tablespoons prepared mustard and 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Add onion celery and pepper. Cover and cook until tender. Add mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes. Add tomatoes and salt sugar and garlic powder to taste. Simmer all together stirring and breaking up the tomatoes for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together chicken soup water chestnuts mushrooms mayonnaise onion celery and sour cream. Line bottom of 8 x 13-inch baking dish with rice. Pour chicken mixture over top. Top with Crescent rolls like crust. Drizzle with butter top with cheese and almonds. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Christmas Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix equal amounts of cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Roll into log or ball. Place line of chili powder on wax paper and roll. Sprinkle top with chives paprika and pepper.

title: Beef Broccoli Supper
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile in a large skillet cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink; drain. Add the rice broccoli soup milk seasoning blend salt and pepper; stir until combined. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. Toss bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over beef mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover; bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until heated through. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: In a large pan stir until it boils. Boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1/2 teaspoon soda. Pour over popped corn. Bake in two 9 x 13-inch pans for 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash and break cauliflower and broccoli into small pieces. Add other ingredients. Pour Italian dressing over mixture. Toss together. Let set. When ready to serve add fresh tomatoes.

title: Grace'S Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Line angel food cake pan with waxed paper. Pour batter into pan. Put 1/2 gallon water in pressure cooker and cook at 12 pounds pressure for 1 1/2 hours. Bake in a 225\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Store in a cool place for at least 2 weeks.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Add all dry ingredients and mix well; then add oil eggs vanilla zucchini and nuts. Pour into well greased loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Marinated 12 Chicken Boneless Breasts
instructions: Mix together sour cream lemon juice Worcestershire sauce celery seed paprika garlic powder salt and pepper. Dip chicken into mixture. Marinate overnight.

title: Perfect Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter oil sugar and confectioners sugar in large bowl until light. Add vanilla baking soda cream of tartar eggs and salt. Mix well. Add flour 1 cup at a time mixing well after each addition. Chill for 4 hours or longer. Shape into small balls. Place on cookie sheet. Flatten into bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes or until light brown. Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Baked Beans(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Brown ground meat in olive oil in skillet. Mix all remaining ingredients together and add to browned meat. Place in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish or bean pot and bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Marilyn'S Meat Dip
instructions: Brown and drain ground chuck. Combine with chili and Velveeta in small casserole dish. Cover and warm in microwave until cheese is melted. Stir.

title: Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In a large bowl microwave margarine until melted. Stir in sugar and vanilla. Stir in eggs one at a time. Add cocoa mix. Add flour and nuts. Mix well. Pour into pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until brownies pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely. Cut into squares.

title: Dieter Vegetable Soup
instructions: Chop all vegetables coarsely. Add water and bouillon cubes. Bring to a boil then simmer about 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Contains 145 calories per serving.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter until soft (about 3 minutes). Mix with next 6 ingredients. Put into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine potato chips cheese and almonds; sprinkle on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in a crock-pot. Let bubble on low for 4 to 6 hours. Serves 4.

title: Brine For Smoking Salmon Or Trout
instructions: Marinate overnight. Rinse fish thoroughly and let air dry approximately 1 hour. Smoke 4 to 6 hours depending on size of fish. Pierce skin before smoking.

title: Shrimp Fettuccine
instructions: Clean and devein shrimp. Season with salt pepper and Tonys seasoning. Set aside. Start cooking the noodles. Saute butter with garlic. Add shrimp and cook until pink. Add cream and simmer 5 minutes. Slowly add both cheeses stirring. Add noodles and simmer 2 minutes. Serve with French bread. (Cooking time 20 minutes.)

title: Ham And Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Spray a slow cooker with butter flavored cooking spray. Combine ham potatoes and onion. Sprinkle cheese evenly over top.

title: Quick And Easy Broccoli Soup
instructions: Combine all into a large pot and heat slowly for 1 to 2 hours until thickened. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking. Feeds 8 to 10. Good served with barbecue sandwiches.

title: Elegant Chicken
instructions: Grease a large baking dish and line bottom with dried beef. Mix sour cream and soup together. Place chicken on beef and pour mixture over the chicken. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cracker Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except egg whites. Fold in whites. Pour into a greased 8-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Banana Split Pie
instructions: Mix together and press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Saturday Noodle Bake
instructions: Brown meats in margarine; add onion and cook until tender. Add soup cream cheese sugar Worcestershire sauce and seasonings; simmer for 15 minutes. Cook noodles drain. Place noodles in 11 x 7-inch buttered baking dish. Pour sauce over noodles. Mix cornflakes with melted butter; sprinkle over top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Swiss And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch dish and cover each piece with a slice of cheese. Mix water and soup; pour over chicken and cheese. Sprinkle stuffing over soup and drizzle with melted margarine. Bake 1 hour uncovered at 350\u00b0.

title: Gooie Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix\toleo and 2 eggs together. Put cake batter into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Mix together powdered sugar cream cheese vanilla and 2 eggs.\tPour over top of cake mixture and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Reserve some of topping and nuts. Cream together cream cheese Cool Whip and peanut butter sugar and vanilla. Pour in 2 crusts. Top with Cool Whip. Put nuts on top; freeze. Will keep for weeks in freezer. Thaw in refrigerator for 1 hour before serving.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Cook brown sugar oleo white sugar and dates together for 6 minutes or until dates have mixed well. Add coconut nuts and Rice Krispies. While warm form into balls and roll in powdered sugar or coconut.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Cut Milky Way candy bars into small pieces. Combine candy bar pieces and Eagle Brand in saucepan. Cook over low heat until smooth; remove from heat then add chocolate syrup and 1 quart of milk. Heat until blended. Pour mixture into 1 gallon freezer can; add milk to fill line. Freeze in electric or hand freezer.

title: Potato Delight
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish melt margarine. Mix all other ingredients except 1/2 cup potato chips. Pour into melted margarine; top with remaining potato chips. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Baptist Champagne
instructions: Mix chill and serve.

title: Iced Tea
instructions: Stove Top Bring saucepan of water to boil. When water is boiling drop tea bags in and boil for 10 minutes. Put sugar and lemonade mix in 1 gallon pitcher. Pour tea in pitcher and fill with cold water; stir. Chill and serve.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Mix all items together except cheese and Worcestershire sauce. Place in pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Mix cheese and sauce together and place on top of pie. Return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Dang Good Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour in pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until set and slightly brown on top.

title: Pacific Lime Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add pineapple juice. Chill until slighlty thickened then beat until frothy. Fold in pineapple. Add cottage cheese horseradish whipped cream and nuts. Chill in mold for at least two hours or overnight. Unmold onto lettuce bed. Fill center with pineapple chunks.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix the 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg and 3 teaspoons sugar separately.

title: Our Best Fried Rice
instructions: In a medium skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain and crumble. Set aside. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons drippings. To drippings in skillet add green peppers and onion; saute 3 minutes. Add rice and stir-fry until golden brown about 5 minutes. Stir in Worcestershire sauce salt and reserved bacon. Heat until hot.

title: Good Ole Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco until fluffy add sugar then add eggs one at a time beating well. Add flavors; add milk and flour alternately beating well. Bake time One hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Brown bacon and take out of pan. Saute onion in fat. Add flour until bubbly and slowly stirring add water vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Add bacon and simmer a couple of minutes. Pour over potatoes and eggs. Serve warm.

title: Sausage Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Roll into small (1 to 1 1/2-inch) balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Steak Burritos
instructions: Cook steak in skillet just until color changes. Put all ingredients in stew pot and simmer at least an hour. Spoon onto heated flour tortillas (medium size) turn one end up then fold in the sides to roll into a tube. Add a salad and you have a meal!

title: Artichoke Souffle
instructions: In food processor pulse cheese. Add artichoke hearts and pulse until chopped well. Add mayonnaise parsley flakes pimento and garlic salt. Pulse until mixed. (One or two pulses.) Keep the ingredients thick and creamy. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put mixture into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake 25 minutes. Serve with Garlic Bagel Toast or Melba Rounds. This makes a nice chafing dish appetizer for parties.

title: Coconut Shrimp
instructions: In medium-sized bowl mix eggs 1 cup flour rum milk baking powder and spices. Place remaining flour in small bowl. Spread coconut on small plate. Dredge shrimp in flour then dunk it in the batter then dredge it in coconut. Place coated shrimp on waxed paper. Carefully drop shrimp in hot oil and fry 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Brown Chewy Bars
instructions: Mix sugars and eggs. Add vanilla. Add biscuit mix coconut and nuts. Bake in a 9 x 13 pan for 40 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool and cut into bars.

title: O. J. Delight
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate 24 hours stirring occasionally. After 24 hours refrigeration freeze overnight until firm. Set out of freezer 15 minutes before serving to soften slightly. Serve in individual small bowls or glasses. May be frozen in paper cups for a childrens party.

title: Grace'S Chicken Supreme
instructions: Make white sauce with first 3 ingredients; set aside. Mix remaining ingredients except cheese and crumbs. Add white sauce. Pour into buttered 8-inch casserole. Add cheese and top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix well with 1/2 cup chopped nuts 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and dash of salt. Mix well and roll in 1 cup chopped nuts.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni. Add cheese milk salt and pepper. Pour into greased dish and top with bread or cracker crumbs. Dot with butter and cheese. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1/2 hour.

title: Grandma Opal'S Baked Chicken
instructions: Prepare Bisquick dumpling mix. Mix cornstarch and water. Place chicken in large roasting pan. Cover with remaining ingredients except dumpling mix and cornstarch mix. Bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Brownie Drops
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine in a double boiler or microwave. Stir and let cool. Beat eggs until foamy. Then add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time; beat until thickened (about 5 minutes). Blend in chocolate mixture. Add flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. Blend. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cheesecake
instructions: Combine flour salt baking powder pudding mix margarine egg and milk. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Pour into lightly greased 9-inch pie plate. Top with sliced peaches. Drain and reserve syrup. Next combine cream cheese syrup and sugar. Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Spread on top of fruit leaving 1-inch margarine around edge. Sprinkle cinnamon-sugar mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool completely and refrigerate.

title: Best Meat Loaf
instructions: Reserving 1/2 cup of the tomato sauce for later mix the remaining ingredients well with your hands. Pat into a pan to about 2-inch thickness making sure that the loaf does not touch the sides of the pan. Pour the remaining tomato sauce evenly over the loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Molasses Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Mix well. Gradually add eggs milk and molasses. Mix and sift 2 cups flour with soda salt and spices. Add to first mixture. Add dried fruit such as raisins apricots peaches apples etc. dredged in remaining 1/8 cup of flour. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until done.

title: Hot Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients and bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with crackers.

title: Vegetable Cheese Chowder
instructions: In large pan combine boiling water with bouillon cubes. Then add vegetables and butter. Bring to boil; reduce and simmer until vegetables are tender. Combine milk and flour in blender until smooth. Add to cooked vegetables and cook 3 minutes. Add cheese stirring until melted. Add parsley and pepper. Serves 4.

title: Pan De Elate - Corn And Chili Pepper Bake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Cover chili peppers and slice cheese. Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan; pour 1/2 mixture in pan. Top with peppers and cheese; add remainder. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Pie Meringue
instructions: Using mixer beat egg whites and all ingredients until peaks. Put on top of pie. Place in oven at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Faber Potatoes
instructions: Toss together. Place in greased baking dish (I use bacon fat). Bake 1/2 hour to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spanish Chicken
instructions: Season washed and cut up chicken with salt pepper paprika and garlic salt. Place in crock-pot. Mix tomato paste and water together and pour over chicken. Add olives. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherry Cookies
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream butter sugar egg and vanilla until light and fluffy. (No need to sift flour; measure by lightly spooning into cup). Add remaining ingredients; blend at low speed until a dough forms. Shape chocolate dough into 1-inch balls using a heaping teaspoonful of dough for each. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Push one cherry halfway into each. When all cookies are molded and cherries are in then prepare frosting and use immediately. Frost each cherry by spreading 1/2 teaspoon frosting over each cookie. Bake frosted cookies at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until puffy. Store tightly covered.

title: Quick And Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour salt and shortening with a fork until crumbly. Add cold water and gently toss. Form dough. On lightly floured surface roll out.

title: Ice Cream Rolls
instructions: Let ice cream melt. Combine with flour. Spray small muffin tins with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Saute celery green onion onion and bell pepper in margarine. Put cream of mushroom soup and Ro-Tel in another pan. Simmer; add crawfish tails. Cook for 15 minutes then add sauteed vegetables. Heat for another 5 minutes then serve over rice or bread.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid with milk and Cool Whip in bowl. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Chill about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sweet And Sour Cucumbers
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Pour over cucumbers and mix.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine vegetables soup and cheese and put in a shallow casserole or cake pan. Sprinkle bread crumbs over the casserole and then sprinkle the melted butter or margarine over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Easy Nachos(Kids Snacks)
instructions: Brown ground beef; add taco sauce and simmer 10 minutes. Spread Doritos around edge of cookie sheet or large platter. Pour beef mixture in center of platter. Pour cheese sauce over the beef while still hot so the cheese sauce melts in. Dip Doritos in beef and cheese and enjoy!

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Place meat in bottom of casserole dish. Salt and pepper. Pour soup over meat (do not dilute soup). Add grated cheese over this. Add milk. Place potatoes over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 until Tater Tots are golden brown.

title: Roast Beef Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute mushrooms and onion in margarine until lightly browned. Spread roast beef slices with mushroom and onion filling. Roll each slice of beef and place seam side down in 8 x 12-inch baking dish sprayed with butter flavored cooking spray. Spoon dressing evenly over beef rolls. Bake 10 minutes or until rolls are heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix dough into balls; place 1 inch apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until cookies are set not brown. Remove; let stand to cool. Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm.

title: Grama Johnson'S Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch ungreased cake pan or until toothpick in center comes out clean.

title: Lemon Rice
instructions: Saute celery and onions in 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet. Stir in water lemon rind lemon juice thyme salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Add rice. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Saute mushrooms in remaining butter in a small skillet until tender; drain. Add mushrooms to rice mixture; stir well. Makes 10 servings.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: While cabbage is cooking about 7 to 8 minutes in boiling water to cover prepare the white sauce. Melt butter; add flour and seasonings. Blend thoroughly. Stir in milk gradually. Cook until thickened. When cabbage is tender drain well. In a 1-quart casserole alternate layers of cabbage grated cheese and warm white sauce in greased casserole. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 (preheated oven) for 20 minutes or until crumbs are delicately browned.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: To beef stock add catsup pepper mustard onion sugar allspice salt and peppercorns. Cook over low heat until mixture thickens approximately 1 hour.

title: Broccoli And Butter Bean Casserole(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Cook broccoli and lima beans according to package directions. Drain and place in 2-quart casserole. Mix together sour cream onion soup mix mushroom soup and water chestnuts. Add this to vegetables and mix thoroughly. Melt butter or margarine. Mix with Rice Krispies and spread on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and oil then add all the ingredients together adding the buttermilk last. Grease and flour pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 3 very small loaves or 2 medium loaves. You can sprinkle top of loaves with sugar and cinnamon before baking.

title: Out-Of-This-World Nut Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together; add eggs beat well. Add cracker crumbs nuts and coconut. Stir in baking powder then add milk; mix well. Butter and flour 4 (9-inch) cake pans; divide batter among them. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool. Ice.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix sugar oleo and syrup. Stir over heat until it boils. When it boils cook 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and soda. Pour over corn. Bake in oven for 1 hour at 250\u00b0 stirring every 15 minutes. Cool. Store in tight container.

title: Swiss Corn Bake
instructions: Combine corn evaporated milk beaten egg 2 tablespoons chopped onion salt pepper and 3/4 cup cheese. Turn into buttered baking dish. Toss 1/2 cup soft bread crumbs with 1 tablespoon melted butter and 1/4 cup shredded cheese. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until set. Serves 6.

title: Cutout Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and butter until fluffy. Beat in vanilla. Sift together baking powder and flour and beat into sugar mixture. Roll out on floured board. Cut into desired shapes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Yields 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Tuna Loaf
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except the egg white. Put into loaf pan. Beat egg white until fluffy. Cover the tuna loaf with egg white. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1/2 hour.

title: Easy Taco Dinner
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef and onion in skillet until done; drain. Stir in taco mix and water. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer uncovered stirring occasionally for 10 minutes. Spoon beef mixture onto chips. Top with remaining ingredients. Serves 6.

title: Popcorn Bars
instructions: *One 6 ounce package (1 cup) semi-sweet chocolate chips or 1 cup peanut butter chips can be substituted.

title: Orange Tapioca Pudding Salad
instructions: Boil water orange jello and tapioca pudding for 3 minutes on stove. Remove from heat and let cool some. Let set in refrigerator until it starts to gel. Use mixer and add softened Cool Whip. Then add drained oranges. Use fruit juice from oranges and add water to make 3 cups. Return to refrigerator and let set. Kids like this salad. Put into mold if desired.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into chunks. Place one layer of crushed doritos then one layer of chicken then cheese then onion in casserole dish. Mix tomatoes with soup. Pour on top of chicken mixture. Top with layer of doritos. Bake at 350 F for 30-40 minutes.

title: Light Fruit Cake
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder. Pour flour over chopped fruit and nuts. In a mixing bowl cream together butter sugar eggs and flavorings. Pour creamed mixture over floured fruit. Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Makes large cake.

title: Barbecued Baked Beans
instructions: Combine bacon and onion in a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole. Microwave on High for 3 to 5 minutes until onion is tender and bacon is partially cooked. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave on Medium (50%) for 8 to 10 minutes stirring after 4 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 between 35 to 55 minutes or until firm.

title: Squash Relish
instructions: Combine squash onion and pepper. Sprinkle with salt and let stand 1 hour. Bring to a boil sugar vinegar celery and mustard seed. Add squash onions and peppers; boil 1 minute. Put in sterilized jars.

title: Kraut Kuchens
instructions: Thaw bread dough. In electric frypan or large skillet brown hamburger and cabbage adding water as needed to cook. Stir often until all seems well done. Try to let all moisture cook off. Stir in seasonings. Cut dough into 4 or 6 pieces. Roll each piece out to flatten as big as possible. Divide cabbage mixture maybe 1/4 cup or so to each. Fold dough over and press shut around edges. Cut 3 slits in top to let steam out. May let raise 30 minutes but not too much. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Good with a sauce of 1 can tomato sauce heated with 1/3 cup brown sugar. Spoon sauce in as you eat. Rewarms well.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: White Fluffy Frosting
instructions: In a saucepan mix sugar corn syrup vanilla cream of tartar salt and boiling water. Boil 3 to 5 minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff. Slowly pour boiling syrup over stiffly beaten egg whites. Continue beating until very stiff.

title: Fried Rice(Serves  6)
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet just until pink. Add green pepper onion and salt and pepper to taste. Mix well cook covered until ground beef in cooked through; drain stir in rice and soy sauce. Cook for 5 minutes longer adding water if necessary.

title: Scallops Au Gratin
instructions: Rinse scallops in cold water. Cook scallops in water uncovered for 3 minutes. Drain. Saute onion green pepper and celery in butter until tender. Combine sauteed mix scallops bread crumbs and pepper. Place in an 8 x 8-inch pan or casserole dish. Pour cream over all. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove foil. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Molded Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in remaining ingredients. Blend well. Pour into 3 or 4-cup mold. Refrigerate until firm. Unmold by setting the bottom of mold in tap water for a few minutes. This is not only tasty but also adds color to the meal.

title: Sesame Pork Roast
instructions: Combine soy sauce garlic cloves and ginger root. Marinate pork 1 hour in soy sauce mixture in refrigerator. Dry pork with a paper towel. Coat with honey and roll in sesame seed. Bake on a lightly greased broiler pan rack at 375\u00b0 until thickest portion reaches 160\u00b0 (approximately 1 hour).

title: Chicken Stew
instructions: Cook chicken and debone. Return to juice. Dice potatoes. Cook peas and potatoes in chicken broth with diced onion and salt. Set aside 1 cup of chicken broth to cool. When cool enough add thickening about 2 tablespoons. On low heat stir until thickness desired.

title: 7-Layer Salad
instructions: Layer vegetables one at a time in large glass bowl. Spread mayonnaise over top and sprinkle each of remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Toss before serving.

title: Rabbit Cacciatori
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. For baking large casserole is fine.

title: Green Noodles
instructions: Cook chicken; cut in small pieces. Saute onion and pepper in oleo. Add cheese mushrooms and soup; cook until blended. Cook noodles in chicken broth. Mix together with cheese mixture and chicken. Bake in large casserole at 300\u00b0 until bubbly. Add more broth if it seems dry. Cheese and chicken mixture may be frozen.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw frozen chopped spinach and squeeze dry. Stir soup mix 1 1/2 cups sour cream and 1 cup mayonnaise until blended. Stir in spinach water chestnuts (chopped) and chopped green onions. Cover; chill 2 hours. Stir before serving. Makes 4 cups.

title: Double Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes dry and pierce. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 1 hour on rack without foil. Melt butter and saute onion until clear and tender. Halve potatoes lengthwise. Scoop out the pulp leaving shells intact. Mash potatoes. Add seasonings butter onion and cheese. Put in enough milk for fluffy consistency. Fill shells. Score the tops with a fork. Bake in hot oven until tops are lightly brown.

title: Mama'S Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour salt and soda into creamed mixture then add sour cream and flavoring. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed. Mix cream cheese pudding and milk until creamy. Spread over cooled cake. Spoon drained pineapple over pudding then spread Cool Whip over pudding. Top with coconut. Chill until ready to serve. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Graham Muffins
instructions: Mix bran and boiling water; let sit. Cream the shortening and sugar. Add beaten eggs. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk. Add bran mixture and last fold in Kelloggs All-Bran. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes in greased or sprayed muffin pan.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease pan arrange by layers in order given. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Baked Beans
instructions: Drain pork and beans. In crock-pot add beans catsup sugars onion and bell pepper on high for 10 to 15 minutes. Turn down to low for 1 hour. Fry bacon drain off fat and lay on top of beans.

title: Hamburgers
instructions: Get hamburgers out of the freezer. Put them in a pan and cook them on the stove for maybe 6 hours. Take the flipper and put them on the bread. Then you eat them. Put ketchup mustard and mayonnaise on too. Pickles too.

title: Barbecue Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast in oil. Remove and brown onions. Add all other ingredients. Stir well and put roast in sauce. Cook until tender. Cook slow.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Add remaining ingredients; pour into casserole dish. Put Tater Tots on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Danish Cheesecake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together until crumbly then press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the next 3 ingredients and beat with mixer until smooth. Pour over the first layer. Sprinkle the top with pecans and bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar as soon as removed from oven.

title: Sunshine Salad
instructions: Dissolve both packages of jello in boiling water. Add cold water and set to cool. Add fruit and marshmallows and pour in 9 x 15-inch pan. Chill until firm.

title: Easy Tropical Pie
instructions: Make pudding according to package and pour in cooled pie shell. Chill 30 minutes.

title: Orange Cream Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine fruits; set aside. In small bowl combine dry pudding mix milk and orange juice concentrate. Beat until blended. Beat in sour cream. Fold into fruit mixture. Good to allow sliced bananas to marinate in pineapple juice for 10 minutes to avoid their turning dark.

title: Pineapple Torte
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar; mix well. Add pineapple; continue mixing. Slowly add the flour and the baking soda (the mix will bubble). Pour mixture into a 10 x 15 x 1-inch jelly roll pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Bake until golden brown in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Make Ahead Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all the fruit and save 1 1/4 cups. Combine saved fruit juice orange juice and pudding in saucepan. Cook until thick. Set aside and let cool. Combine fruits and bananas. Stir in cooled pudding. Chill and serve.

title: Old-Fashioned Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine brown sugar cinnamon lemon rind and juice in large bowl. Add peaches; toss to mix. Transfer to prepared baking dish. Combine flours and baking powder on piece of waxed paper. Beat together margarine and sugar in medium-size bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in egg white. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla stirring just to combine. Drop batter by spoonfuls over peach mixture; spread gently. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until peaches are tender and top is golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Soda Cracker Lemon Torte
instructions: Whip the egg whites cream of tartar and sugar; beat until sugar dissolves. Add the crushed crackers and nuts. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Quick Meat Loaf(About 8 Servings)
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients. Place in large meat loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Health Drink In A Jug
instructions: Mix well and store in refrigerator as using.

title: Apricot Bread
instructions: Soak apricots in warm water for 1/2 hour. Beat egg. Add sugar and melted butter. Add dry ingredients alternately with orange juice. Stir in apricots and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 5 x 9-inch pan or two 4 x 8-inch pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour for large pan or 50 minutes for small pan.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine pecans and coconut. Sprinkle in bottom of pan. Pour prepared cake mix over pecan and coconut mixture. Melt margarine and cream cheese together in saucepan. Add powdered sugar. Mix well. Pour mixture over cake batter. Bake for 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Remove from oven. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in order as listed.

title: Orange Crispies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream shortening with salt until light and fluffy gradually adding sugar. Add egg; beat well. Blend in orange extract then flour. Drop by rounded tablespoon 2 inches apart on ungreased sheet. Bake 10 minutes or until edges light brown.

title: Morning Extravaganza
instructions: Puree strawberries. Add orange juice pineapple juice and frozen yogurt.

title: Zucchini Pie
