instructions: Cook and stir zucchini and onion in oleo for 10 minutes then add parsley salt pepper garlic powder and oregano. Combine 2 beaten eggs and Mozzarella cheese and stir into zucchini mixture. Separate crescent dinner rolls and make into a crust in a 10-inch pie pan. Spread crust with mustard. Pour zucchini mixture into crust and bake 18 to 20 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven or until center is set.

title: Hot Tamale Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix 1 cup cornmeal and the cold water in 2-quart saucepan. Stir in boiling water butter and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Spread evenly over bottom and side of greased 3-quart casserole. Bake uncovered 15 minutes.

title: Old Spice Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and milk beat well. Sift flour soda salt and spices. Add and stir into batter. Beat well. Add nuts and raisins; mix until blended. Drop tablespoon of dough for each cookie on greased cookie sheet. Keep 3 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Chewy Cake(No Cholesterol)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in one bowl. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. (I use Pam spray). Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 35 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar salt and butter thoroughly. Beat egg and vanilla into mixture until light and fluffy. Sift together flour and baking powder. Gradually stir into creamed mixture. Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on floured surface. Cut using cookie cutters. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes or until light brown around edges. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Creek Indian Fry Bread(Tuklegg Sahkmoohlthie)
instructions: Combine flour salt and baking powder. Add milk or water and stir all together to make a stiff dough. Turn out onto a well floured board and pat down to about 1/2-inch thickness with hands. Cut these into strips or squares with a slit in the middle. Fry in deep hot oil until brown on both sides like a doughnut. This bread can be served with the main dish or used as snacking. This type of bread is famous for all types of Indians.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of baking dish. Add fruit. Mix other ingredients and pour over fruit. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Vina'S Easy Dish
instructions: Slice potatoes thick; boil until tender. Drain water; add butter and milk. Open chili mix with potatoes and simmer until hot.

title: Wilma'S Corn Custard
instructions: Combine all ingredients except grated cheese; mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place this pan in one larger and put about 1 inch of water in outer pan. Sprinkle grated cheese on top of mixture. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven about 1 hour or until case knife comes out clean. This is a very good dish to serve at Christmas.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot. Heat 1 hour and serve. Good with corn bread chips or over rice.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix ingredients together; do not use mixer. Let stand in refrigerator 2 days. Stir again. Bake in muffin tins at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes. This batter is good for 6 weeks. Makes 6 dozen muffins.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour. Roll in 2 rolls and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Slice and bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Whole Wheat Bagels
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water. Stir in honey salt and 1 1/4 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in remaining flour. Knead for 10 minutes on floured surface. Cover. Let raise until double about 15 minutes. Punch down and divide into 8 equal portions. Shape each piece into a smooth ball; punch hole into center and pull gently to enlarge hole and make uniform shape. Let raise 20 minutes.

title: Schnitz Un Knepp(Apples And Buttons)
instructions: Cover dried apples with water and soak overnight. In the morning cover ham with cold water and boil 3 hours. Add the apples and water in which they have been soaked and continue to boil for another hour. Add brown sugar. Make dumplings by sifting dry ingredients together 3 times. Stir in beaten egg milk and shortening. Drop the batter by spoonfuls into hot liquid with ham and apples. Cover kettle tightly and cook dumplings 15 minutes. Serve piping hot on a large platter. This comes from a very old Moravian cookbook from my hometown in Indiana.

title: K F C Coleslaw
instructions: Combine the sugar salt pepper milk mayonnaise buttermilk vinegar and lemon juice; beat until smooth. Pour over cabbage carrots and onion. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Cook sausage until done. Crumble then drain. Prepare 9-inch pre-made or \from scratch\ pie shell. Mix cheese and sausage. Sprinkle in shell. Lightly beat eggs in a bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture. Pour in shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool on rack 10 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Layer all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Louisiana Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in heavy pan. Add salt and pepper. Mix wine water catsup and brown sugar. Pour over chops. Cover and bake in moderate 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until chops are well done and liquid is cooked down. Lemon slices may be added before baking if desired. This is real tasty!

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into 9-inch pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Million Dollar Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl mix butter sugars egg and vanilla at medium-high speed until fluffy. Add dry ingredients to mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheets. Press flat with glass cup that has been dipped in granulated sugar. Bake 8 to 9 minutes until cookies are lightly browned.

title: Chicken Mozzarella
instructions: Flatten chicken to 1/8-inch; salt and pepper. Spread with 1/4 cup of the margarine. Put one stick of cheese on each breast and roll up jelly roll style. Flour the breasts dip in egg and roll in crumbs. Place breasts in butter with herbs. Melt and pour over chicken. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add wine and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Easy Oven Stew
instructions: Combine flour salt pepper and paprika in a paper bag. Shake beef pieces (a few at a time) until coated. Mix with oil in 3-quart casserole. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Stir once. Add vegetables water and tomato sauce. Mix well. Cover; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 3/4 hours or until done.

title: Meat Loaf In Crock-Pot
instructions: Place ground beef in large bowl. In small bowl whip 1 egg for each pound of meat. After whipping add bread (broken up into small pieces). To the whipped mixture add 1/2 cup milk for each pound of meat. Mix all liquid ingredients with the meat and shape into loaf shape. Place in the middle of the crock-pot along with carrots potatoes or whatever vegetables desired.

title: Ice Cream Crunch Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter together in large pan; add cereal. Spread on cookie sheet and cool. Break up cereal mixture into small pieces. Soften ice cream. Fold in all but 1 cup of cereal mixture and spread in 10-inch spring-form pan. Use remaining 1 cup cereal mixture to make decorative topping then freeze. Garnish with whipped cream and strawberries if desired. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in buttered casserole dish. Place cut up chicken on top and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Beat in eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add along with carrots. Stir well. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Layered Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Put 1/3 batter into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 of cinnamon mix. Repeat layers ending with batter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Increase temperature to 325\u00b0. Bake an additional 55 to 60 minutes or until cake is done.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Bake pizza shell for 5 minutes. Microwave the cream cheese at half power for 1 1/2 minutes then add the 1/4 cup sugar and lemon rind. Mix thoroughly and spread on pizza crust. Arrange the fruit on top of the spread. Mix the apple juice and cornstarch together and microwave on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes stirring occasionally until transparent. Pour this glaze on fruit and serve.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix with 3/4 teaspoon dill weed and 1/4 cup oil. Pour over 12 ounces oyster crackers; stir to coat. Place in 250\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir gently halfway through baking.

title: Swedish Pancakes
instructions: Mix eggs milk flour salt and sugar together in a blender on high speed. Melt butter in a Teflon pan. Pour butter into mixture. Pour 1/4 cup of batter into frypan and spread to the edges. When it looks dry flip it carefully for another 2 to 3 seconds. Then take off heat roll and place on a tray. Serve with jam or jelly. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Add the melted shortening to the sugar then drop in the eggs and beat until smooth. Stir soda into buttermilk and beat until foamy then add to the sugar and eggs. Sift in the rest of the ingredients and stir to make a smooth fairly stiff batter. (Add a bit more flour if necessary to handle dough.) Roll out 1/3-inch thick on floured board and fry in hot fat at 350\u00b0 to 360\u00b0. Roll in sugar while warm.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Barely cook broccoli. Put in buttered casserole. Add layer of chicken. Cover with soup and curry powder (mix with water enough to make a medium sauce). Top with a mixture of crumbs mixed with 2 tablespoons of butter. Cover this with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Garden Vegetable Pasta Alla Mamma(Prep: 15 Minutes, Cook: 10 Minutes, Serves 2)
instructions: Heat the butter in a large heavy skillet. When the foam subsides stir in the prepared vegetables. Saute stirring over low heat until crisp-tender about 5 minutes. Add the garlic; saute 1 minute. Stir in the parsley basil and oregano.

title: Lemon Balm Punch]
instructions: Boil the water and add the herbs. Let simmer for 5 to 10 minutes or remove form heat and let steep for 20 minutes. Cool and strain. Use with equal parts ginger ale or juice. Serve with ice.

title: Grape Pecan Salad
instructions: Wash and stem grapes. Air dry. Blend together cream cheese at room temperature and sugar until smooth. Blend in enough orange juice to make consistency of heavy cream. Gently combine all ingredients. Chill until white coating forms on grapes.

title: Chicken Spread
instructions: Mix chicken celery and pineapple. Stir curry powder into salad dressing. Add to chicken mixture. Mix well. Serve on unsalted whole grain crackers or in mini pita pockets. Refrigerate and use within 3 to 4 days. Contains 15 calories in 1 cup with 6 mg cholesterol.

title: Sweet And Sour Beets
instructions: Melt the butter. Blend in the flour. Stir in the beet juice vinegar heavy cream salt pepper and sugar. When smooth and bubbly add the drained beets. Serves 3 to 4.

title: White Party Punch
instructions: Stir together 7-Up and frozen lemonade in a punch bowl. A few minutes before serving add sherbet ice cream and pineapple chunks.

title: Low-Fat Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni to the \al dente\ stage (slightly firm); drain in colander. While macaroni is still hot add cottage cheese; mix well. Add Mozzarella; mix well. Add 3/4 of Cheddar; mix lightly spreading the rest of the Cheddar over the top. Garnish with a tomato slice and green pepper if desired. This can be served immediately or reheated later in the oven at 350\u00b0. If you want the top brown use the preheat setting. Add the garnish just before serving.

title: Kona Inn Banana Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add bananas and eggs. Sift dry ingredients and blend into a creamy mixture; dont overmix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Makes two 1 1/2 pound loaves.

title: Butternut Squash Casserole
instructions: Pour boiling water over squash. Let stand for few minutes. Peel and slice. Cook until soft and mash. Mix all ingredients. Cook in casserole dish in oven 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandma'S Holiday Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add rest of ingredients. Put in jello mold or bowl. Let set in refrigerator several hours before planning to serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Have cream cheese at room temperature; mix with Heinz 57 sauce hot sauce and nuts. Mix well and shape into a ball. Decorate with sliced olives. Chill until cold.

title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Drain beans; reserve liquid. Mash or process beans and taco mix together. Add liquid if necessary for smooth but not runny consistency. Spread mixture on round platter or 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. If desired mash avocado and mix with sour cream. Spread mixture or plain sour cream on beans. Spread salsa next. Top with lettuce tomatoes olives and cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Mix by hand and bake in oven for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with Pam. Mix together all ingredients. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Store leftovers in refrigerator.

title: German Chocolate Upside Down Cake
instructions: Coat 9 X 13 pan with Pam. Spread nuts and coconut in bottom of pan. Prepare cake mix and pour over nuts and coconut. Melt margarine. Mix cream cheese sugar and margarine. Spread over cake and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool and cut.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Remove centers of baked potatoes. Brown the skins while mixing remaining ingredients with potato centers. Put mixture into potato skins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in shallow pan. Pour margarine over chicken; sprinkle with crumbs. Add salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until tender and golden brown. Yield 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Brownies
instructions: Cream shortening brown sugar egg and vanilla. Add sifted flour salt and baking soda. Mix well all ingredients. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. When cool cut into bars.

title: Date Squares
instructions: Mix all together and bake in an 8-inch square pan. Cut in squares while still warm. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into small balls and bake 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Mexican Lasagna Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet. Add garlic tomatoes salt and taco seasoning. Set aside. Combine egg cottage cheese and Cheddar cheese.

title: Blueberry Batter Pudding
instructions: Pick over and wash berries. Put in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Cream together butter 1/2 cup sugar egg and vanilla until well blended. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Stir into mixture. Spread over berries. Mix 1/3 cup sugar cornstarch cinnamon and lemon rind. Stir in boiling water. Pour over blueberry mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown and pick inserted near center comes out clean. Serve warm plain or with cream if used.

title: Butterflied Southern Citrus Barbecue
instructions: Place lamb in large glass or enamel bowl. In measuring cup combine remaining ingredients; pour over lamb. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Drain lamb reserving marinade. Grill lamb 4 to 6 inches above coals or source of heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted in thickest part registers 140\u00b0 for rare or 150\u00b0 to 155\u00b0 for medium. Baste with marinade.

title: Glazed Ham
instructions: Boil to soften skin. Cover with water; take off skin. Score fat then add cloves to each score. Add brown sugar to cover ham. Pour juice from pineapple can over ham. Decorate with pineapple. During baking baste often. Towards end pour 1/4 to 1/2 cup of Log Cabin or any maple syrup. Mix cornstarch and water into a paste then pour into pan drippings. Add Gravy Master or Kitchen Bouquet.

title: Nanny Schembre'S Favorite Ratatouille
instructions: Lightly saute garlic and onions in olive oil. Dust vegetables with flour except tomatoes. Add vegetables to skillet along with tomatoes salt pepper parsley oregano and basil. Cook over medium heat for 30 minutes. Stir turn heat down to low and simmer 1 hour. Serve as a side vegetable or cold as a salad for lunch.

title: Ann'S Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except olive oil; mix well (use hands). Roll into golf ball size balls. Saute in olive oil until lightly browned. Add to sauce.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: To lighten recipe you can substitute Egg Beaters for eggs and 1 cup applesauce for 1 cup oil. It turns out just as good.

title: Cinch Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Add vanilla and eggs; mix. Mix together flour salt soda and cream of tartar. Mix well together. Roll into balls and roll in sugar sugar and cinnamon sugar and cocoa or nuts to make a variety. Put on sheets; flatten with bottom of glass. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes until lightly browned. I check often after 7 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken or 1 package of chicken breasts. Debone and cut in small pieces and put in casserole. Mix together milk chicken broth and cream of chicken soup. (Do not dilute chicken soup.) Pour over chicken. Sprinkle corn stuffing on top and pour melted oleo on. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Apple And Nut Cake
instructions: Beat together vegetable oil eggs sugar and vanilla. Add flour salt cinnamon and soda. Mix well. Add nuts and raw apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 in tube pan for 1 hour.

title: Springerle(Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl; gradually add sugar and continue beating until mixture is thick and light in color (10 to 15 minutes). Add anise flavoring and dry ingredients gradually. When too stiff for mixer knead by hand using ample flour if sticky. Divide dough in half; roll out and make impressions with springerle rolling pin or board (dough should be about 1/2-inch thick). Cut cookies apart and place on cookie sheets lined with smooth kitchen towels. Let stand overnight to set designs. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Tops should be white bottom yellowish but not brown. When cool store in airtight container. (A slice of apple in container will help keep them soft.)

title: Cheese Crisps
instructions: Form small balls and press flat with fork onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix eggs and oranges. Beat 3 minutes. Add dry ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pork Barbecue
instructions: Trim fat off meat. Mix other ingredients in bottom of a large crockpot; add meat. Cook on high for 4 hr. then reduce to low and continue to cook for 4-5 hrs. more. Take meat out and shred. Return meat to crockpot (leave other ingredients in crockpot meat will absorb juices after being shredded) and keep warm until serving time. If there is too much liquid on the meat discard some. May be frozen. May also be made with venison instead of pork.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs egg onion soup mix and 1/2 can of tomato sauce. Press into loaf pan. To remaining tomato sauce add 1/2 can of water and 2 tablespoons of brown sugar. Pour over meat loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Mix together vinegar sugar and cornstarch. Grind zucchini or squash coarse and mix salt in lightly. Let stand in icebox overnight. Add zucchini to mixture and heat until boiling. Stir all the time. Simmer 30 minutes. Seal in hot jars. Good on hot dogs hamburgers and with beans.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Add sifted flour and soda. Add peanut butter and mix well. Make into little balls and place on a cookie sheet. Dip fork into sugar and press down \crisscross\. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cookies will be soft.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and toss together with green pepper and onion. Mix together sugar oil vinegar celery seed mustard seed and salt. Boil for 5 minutes and pour hot dressing over bean mixture. Mix well. Refrigerate several hours before serving. May reduce sugar if desired. Keeps in refrigerator for several days.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and milk together. Melt one stick of butter in pan. Pour over butter. Pour one can of sliced peaches in middle. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Mornay
instructions: Season the chicken and place in an ovenproof dish. Dot with 2 ounces of the butter and bake in the center of the oven at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Make the white sauce.

title: Mexican Bean Dip
instructions: Brown ground meat. Cook onion and pepper until soft. Add to meat the onion pepper taco seasoning tomato paste and refried beans. Cook 1/2 hour in skillet stirring often. Place in casserole dish and top with shredded cheese. Bake until melted. Top with layer of sour cream before serving.

title: Baked Lemon Pudding(Low-Fat, Low Sugar)
instructions: You will need vegetable cooking spray.

title: Butternut Cake
instructions: Cream crisco sugar and eggs together for approximately 10 minutes. Add 1 cup flour; beat well. Add flavoring and mix. Add remaining flour and milk. Continue to mix well. Grease and flour 2 round pans. Bake at 350 degrees approximately 20 minutes until done.

title: Mom'S Strawberry Pie(Makes 2)
instructions: Cook the water sugar and cornstarch together until thick and boils. Then add jello. Mix well and remove from stove. Let set until cool. After mixture is cool add to sliced strawberries. Pour into 2 baked pie shells and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar and brown sugar first then add vanilla eggs and water. Make sure beaten well then add dry ingredients. Last add chocolate chips and nuts if you want. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: You will also need a clean flower pot plastic flower and gummy worms.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and shape into balls. Freeze. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Hot Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all in a large bowl; add milk if needed to roll in 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Golden Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugar and margarine together. Beat in egg yolks. Add vanilla and baking soda in water and mix. Next add cream of tartar. Finally add flour and mix well. Take 1/2 teaspoon of mixture and roll into size of marble. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Fruitcake
instructions: Sift together both types of flour setting aside 1 cup to roll raisins in.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: In a bowl combine the salmon (I remove the bones) onion crackers and egg. Mix to bind well.

title: Cheese Log
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chili powder. Form into a log and chill until firm. Roll into chili powder to make a light coating. Slice thin and serve on crackers. This can be frozen.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Soften jello in water. Combine other ingredients. Bake in 3 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Flake Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons warm water; set aside. Mix dry ingredients; cut in shortening until the consistency of corn meal. Add buttermilk and yeast; mix well. Add little extra flour and knead. Place in tight container and refrigerate. Will\tkeep for several days.\tWhen ready to use roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Let rise in warm place 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Rice Casserole
instructions: Over low flame stir in all ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with wedges of green pepper which have been boiled with 3 garlic cloves and salt for 5 minutes. Sprinkle heavily with grated cheese (Cheddar). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 12 +.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients (except boiling water); beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Add boiling water. Ingredients of batter will be thin. Pour into greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 two 9-inch pans or 3 (8-inch) pans 30 to 35 minutes one 13 x 9-inch pan 35 to\t40 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat slowly. Drain fat. Add garlic basil salt tomatoes tomato paste and 1 cup water. Simmer covered 15 minutes. Stir often. Cook noodles in boiling salted water. Drain and rinse. Beat eggs. Add Ricotta Parmesan parsley and pepper. Spray 13 x 9 pan with cooking spray. Layer half noodles and spread with half Ricotta mixture. Add half Mozzarella cheese and half meat sauce. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.\tLet stand 10 minutes before serving or assemble early and refrigerate. Bake 50 to 60 minutes and let stand 10 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Graham Cracker Delights
instructions: Line cookie sheet with foil. Break crackers apart and place on cookie sheet. In a small saucepan combine butter and margarine. Melt; add sugar and bring to a boil for 2 minutes. Pour over graham crackers covering all of crackers. Sprinkle with pecans chopped fine. Bake 5 to 8 minutes. Watch closely; burns easily.

title: Spinach Crust
instructions: Drain spinach in a colander and squeeze in a towel or with hands to remove all moisture. In a small pan melt butter stir in spinach and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in milk and egg.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken breasts in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour the soup/wine mixture over the chicken. Sprinkle the grated cheese over all this and cover loosely with foil. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Rhubarb Upside Down Cake
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. On bottom of pan put layer of rhubarb. Sprinkle on sugar. Add marshmallows; then sprinkle on Jell-O. Top with cake mix that has been made into batter as directed on package. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Serve hot with whipping cream or ice cream.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Empty frozen concentrates pineapple and cranberry juices and water into a large container. Let stand until frozen juice is thawed; stir well. Pour mixture into punch bowl; add ice cubes. Just before serving gently pour in ginger ale and club soda. Garnish with Fruit Ice Ring fruit and mint leaves. Yield 25 to 30 servings.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: In a large skillet brown the smoked sausage. Drain grease. Add cooked sausage back to skillet. Add remaining ingredients to skillet. Boil then simmer. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and\tsugar;\tadd eggs and beat well. Add remaining ingredients. Drop from spoon on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Measure the flour sugar baking powder salt cinnamon oil eggs and vanilla in the order listed in a large mixing bowl. Blend 1 minute on low speed then 2 minutes on medium speed. Stir in the carrots nuts and raisins. Pour into an 8 or 9-inch greased bottom only square pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Fresh Blackberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt. Add sugar mixture to blackberries; toss to coat fruit. Fill a pastry-lined 9-inch pie plate with berry mixture. Adjust top crust. Seal and flute edge.

title: Christmas Cookies(These Could Be Called Fruitcake Cookies)
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and margarine. Add combined cinnamon salt soda and flour. Stir in fruits and nuts. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Frosting For 2-Layer Cake
instructions: Stir pudding and pineapple then add Cool Whip. Do not beat; just stir together. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Break spaghetti in half. Cook and drain. While still warm combine spaghetti with eggs and Parmesan cheese. Pour into well-greased deep dish pie pan. Spoon sour cream over spaghetti. Cook ground beef; drain. Add tomato paste salt and water; simmer 10 minutes. Spoon ground beef on top of sour cream. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Add Mozzarella cheese then return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello pudding and boiling water. Let cool. Add whipped Dream Whip. After mixture has cooled add frozen strawberries and bananas.

title: Neptune'S Cheese Canapes(Microwave Appetizer Recipe)
instructions: *Substitution Can use package of imitation crab or can of tuna instead of crabmeat.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender. Prepare sauce with the sauce and hamburger. In a sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan layer sauce noodles Swiss and Mozzarella cheese slices and cottage or Ricotta cheese until pan is full. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening together; add sugar and beat well. Add eggs beating after each one. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Add flour mixture alternately with milk to creamed mixture; mix well. Add coconut flavoring; beat well. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. After cake cools remove from pan; mix 1/2 glass of milk with 1 tablespoon sugar. Mix well and pour over cake (pierce holes in cake so milk mixture can soak into cake).

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix real well the sugar chocolate and flour together in a pan. Add milk slowly. Cook on medium heat. When thickening starts add butter and stir. Cook until desired thickness. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Skillet Chicken Risotto
instructions: In 10-inch skillet brown chicken on all sides in hot oil about 15 minutes. Remove chicken pieces. Drain all but 2 tablespoons fat. Add rice onion salt and poultry seasoning. Cook and stir until rice is lightly browned. Add mushrooms carrots and water. Place chicken on top of rice mixture. Season chicken with additional salt and pepper. Sprinkle with paprika cover and simmer 45 minutes or until chicken and rice are tender. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Teriyaki Salmon
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place salmon fillets on rack in broiling pan. In cup mix teriyaki sauce ginger root and sesame oil. Brush mixture over salmon fillets. Broil salmon 3 to 5 inches from source of heat without turning until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork about 10 minutes. Garnish with parsley sprigs. Makes 4 main dish servings.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Saute together ground beef chopped onion and bell pepper. Add tomatoes red beans and seasonings. Simmer about 1 hour and serve over rice.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa in double boiler until smooth. Combine dry ingredients and stir in eggs. Add to butter and cocoa. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and cook for 30 to 35 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place sliced apples in greased oblong pan (9 x 13-inch). Blend remaining ingredients until mixture is crumbly. Spread over apples. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown. Serve warm with Cool Whip milk or ice cream.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with crackers or on lettuce leaf.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients using half of the cheese in the batter. Pour into a large greased skillet. Sprinkle with other half of cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Perfect Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Light grill and allow coals to get white hot. Lightly spray ribs with olive oil spray on both sides. Season ribs on both sides with salt pepper garlic and onion. Grill ribs on both sides until evenly brown placing cover on grill after each turning to add smoked flavor to the ribs. Place browned ribs in a roasting pan lined with foil. You may also use a disposable foil pan. Add about 1 1/2 cups of water to ribs and lightly pour or brush on your favorite barbecue sauce over ribs. Cover ribs with foil and place in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 to 1/2 hours.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cream Crumbs
instructions: Mix together and bake for 30 minutes in preheated oven. Great with summer drinks.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar vanilla and oil together until fluffy. Add shredded zucchini. Sift dry ingredients together add to egg mixture. Stir in crushed pineapple. Add coconut and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add tortellini and cook until al dente. Do not overcook. Drain and rinse under cold water. Meanwhile cook the vegetables according to package directions in boiling water or microwave. When done rinse under cold water and drain well. In large serving bowl stir together the olive oil garlic salt and oregano. Add cooked tortellini and vegetables. Stir gently to coat with dressing. If salad seems dry add a little more olive oil. Chill at least 1 hour. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread in an 8-inch square pan. Top with your choice of 1/2 cup of nuts and/or 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. This recipe can easily be doubled.

title: Honey Pecan Butter
instructions: Beat butter until smooth and soft. Beat in honey then mix in pecans.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Sift together the flour sugar and salt in pie plate. Mix together a little the milk and oil. Add (pour) on flour mix in pie plate. Mix with a fork and press into shape around pie plate. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine flour 1/2 cup sugar brown sugar baking soda salt shortening peanut butter milk vanilla and egg at low speed until stiff dough forms. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately top each cookie with a candy kiss pressing down firmly so cookie cracks around edge; remove from cookie sheets. Yields 4 dozen cookies.

title: Pineapple Squares
instructions: Mix together oatmeal flour brown sugar and soda. Cut in butter. Put 2/3 (about 4 2/3 cups) of crumb mixture into a greased 12 x 8 x 2 inch pan. Press down firmly. Spread with filling. Sprinkle with rest of crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 - 35 minutes.

title: E. Z. Toasty Bread
instructions: Slice bread lengthwise. Mix together margarine and onions. Spread on each 1/2 of bread. Place on ungreased cookie sheet spread side up. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned. Slice into serving size pieces.

title: Tuna Noodle Bake
instructions: Cook noodles as label directs. Mix tuna soup milk pepper and noodles. Pour into buttered baking dish. Top with potato chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Mix water tomato paste and sauce. Put in a crock pot. Add all seasonings onion and garlic. Add 1/4 c. red wine and 1/4 c. romano cheese. Turn crock pot on high and start cooking. Fry hamburger and sausage till brown drain. Add to sauce. Cook on high for 4 hours. Let cool. Take out inside part of crock pot and refrigerate over night. Put back in crock pot next day and heat to serving temperature.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti using package directions. Drain. Place spaghetti in large bowl. Add onion tomato cucumbers green pepper and Salad Supreme seasoning. Mix well. Add desired amount of salad dressing.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Cream butter cream cheese and powdered sugar in a large bowl and set aside. In a separate bowl mix milk pudding and Cool Whip and add mixture to the cream cheese mixture. Crush Oreo cookies in food processor until fine.

title: Miss Inez'S Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients except for bread and butter. Melt butter and crumble bread in the melted butter and pat this mixture on top of the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cat-Head Biscuits
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a medium bowl; add milk mixture and oil. Stir until moistened. Add a little more flour and turn dough over in bowl. Pour some oil in an 8-inch round baking pan. Oil hands and spoon a large amount of dough in hands and form a ball. Place in pan and pat with oiled hands. Make 5 biscuits. Place in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Jello Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed on box. Make vanilla pudding using skim milk. Make Jell-O using 1/2 the water needed (dont chill). Once cake cools poke holes using a fork. Pour the Jell-O into the holes. Spread with vanilla pudding and then Cool Whip. Chill and serve. Makes 12 servings.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix the ingredients; spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. After done brush warm biscuits with

title: Cocktail Smokies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cook slow on low stirring often. Add ingredients to taste. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together; shape into 1-inch balls. Bake in a shallow greased pan for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve as appetizers.

title: Spanish Bean Soup
instructions: Cover beans by 1 inch and soak. Drain beans recover with water add meat bones and cook until tender.* Fry bacon and onion in olive oil add to beans. Thinly slice chorizo add to beans. Add diced potatoes ham salt and saffron. Cook to desired consistency.

title: Green (Spinach) Pasta
instructions: Cook the spinach following directions on the package. Drain it. Let it cool slightly. Squeeze it as dry as possible and chop it finely. Put flour and salt in mixing bowl. Make a well in the center and in it put the eggs salt and spinach. Mix together with your fingers and knead until smooth adding more flour or a few drops of water as necessary.

title: Nonie'S Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix corn meal eggs milk soda salt corn and oil; set aside. Brown ground meat; drain and set aside. Grease a skillet for baking; sprinkle a thin layer of corn meal and let brown. Pour 1/2 corn meal mixture into skillet; sprinkle in meat cheese onions and jalapeno peppers. Add remaining corn meal mixture over filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain and rinse. While the preceding cooks brown ground beef onion salt and pepper. When done mix macaroni and beef mixture together. Add together the pizza sauce tomato paste tomato sauce and 1/2 tablespoon sugar. Mix all together. Add several dashes of garlic salt onion salt and oregano. Place 1/2 mixture in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni. Add remainder of mixture; top with rest of Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Gameburger Rice Supper
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in the oil until soft. Add ground meat and saute until it loses its color. Stir in remainder of ingredients. Save cheese and heat to a boil. Turn down and simmer covered for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top when ready to serve.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Take slice of ham. Spread on cream cheese. Slice pickles lengthwise. Put enough pickle on end of slice of ham. Roll up and cut into small pieces. Insert toothpick for easy handling.

title: Cinnamon Pickles
instructions: Peel cucumbers. Cut into rings. Remove seeds. Soak 24 hours in 2 cups pickling lime and 8 1/2 quarts water. Drain cucumber rings and wash off lime water. Pour cold water over them and let stand 3 hours. Drain. Simmer 2 hours in 1 cup of vinegar food coloring and alum with enough water to cover them. Drain.

title: Mom'S Apple Or Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 17 x 11 x 2 1/2-inch baking pan. In a saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour until it resembles coarse meal. Add milk and stir with fork until dough leaves side of bowl. Turn on floured board. Knead until smooth. Roll out dough in large rectangle (1/4-inch thick). Sprinkle apples and cinnamon over dough evenly. Roll up like jelly roll. Dampen edges with water to seal. Slice dough about 1/2-inch thick. Place in pan of melted butter. Pour sugar syrup carefully around rolls. This looks like too much liquid but crust will absorb it. Bake approximately 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown. You may dot some butter and sprinkle some sugar on top after it bakes awhile.

title: Jello
instructions: Sprinkle graham crackers on top.

title: Slickers(Dumplings)
instructions: Mix flour and all dry ingredients together. Mix in shortening and then buttermilk and make stiff dough. Roll thin and cut into strips. Drop in boiling broth. Cook until done.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Remove tops and seeds from peppers. In a large kettle bring water to a boil. Cook peppers for 5 minutes. Remove and drain. Cook rice according to package directions. In a skillet brown beef and onion. Drain. Add tomato sauce herbs salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes. Stir in rice. Stuff peppers with rice mixture. Place upright in shallow pan (baking dish). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes. Yields 5 to 6 servings. Leftover peppers will freeze well.

title: Sauerkraut Relish
instructions: Drain sauerkraut (do not wash) cut in small pieces and add other ingredients. Mix well and allow to marinate for 24 hours.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook in salted water the fettuccine according to package; drain. Add butter. Mix heavy cream eggs and cheese. Pour over pasta. Add parsley and mix well. Serve.

title: Southern Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Place blackberries in a 9-inch square baking dish. Combine sugar cornstarch and salt mixing well. Sprinkle over blackberries. Dot with butter.

title: Great Grandmother'S Pound Cake
instructions: Beat the butter to a cream. Stir in the sugar. Add the yolks of the eggs then the rose water. Stir well. Add the flour and stir until light. Stir in the well beaten egg whites. Pour into the pan and bake slowly (300\u00b0) until a light brown (about 2 hours).

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Combine. Beat mixture until smooth. Put in buttered bread pans. Leave in icebox overnight. Turn from pan and cut loaf lengthwise then cut in thin slices. Bake on cookie sheet at 450\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil cocoa sugar butter and milk 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from stove. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Slowly stir in oatmeal. Drop by spoonful onto cookie sheet.

title: Artichokes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except artichokes in 5-quart pot and bring to a boil. Add artichokes partially cover with lid and return to boil. Cook until stem end easily pierced with a fork allowing 30 minutes for medium or 40 minutes for large artichokes. Remove from liquid and drain upside down. Serve hot or cold. May be served with melted butter or mayonnaise for dipping.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels margarine and 3 teaspoons of sugar. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine egg yolks condensed milk and lime juice in a heavy saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture reaches 160\u00b0 (about 10 minutes). Beat egg whites and cream of tartar at high speed until foamy. Gradually add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves (2 to 4 minutes). Pour hot filling into pie shell. Immediately spread meringue over filling sealing to edge. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool before serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in greased and floured loaf pan. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Freeze in 9 x 13-inch pans. Cut in squares and garnish to serve. Also serves well just being chilled well.

title: Marinated Cucumbers
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Beef Skillet Fiesta
instructions: *Or use 1 bouillon cube dissolved in 1 1/4 cups boiling water. If converted rice is used reduce water but bouillon cube can still be added.

title: Pasta Pizza
instructions: Add pepperoni mushrooms peppers and onions. Top with cheeses. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Buffalo Drumsticks
instructions: Combine garlic mustard Worcestershire sauce oil pepper sauce and paprika in a small bowl and mix well. Dip each drumstick in mixture coating well and arrange in a single layer in a shallow glass dish. Pour any extra sauce over the top. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate overnight. Let chicken return to room temperature before cooking.

title: Chicken Ziegenfuss
instructions: Boil chicken with celery and onions for 1 hour or until done. Strain celery and onions from broth. Save enough broth for sauce. Let chicken cool and cut into bite size pieces. Mix chicken cream cheese green onion and 1/4 cup margarine. Roll crescent rolls into 8 square pieces. Put 1/8 cream cheese mixture on each roll. Roll up and pinch ends closed. Dip each in 1/4 cup melted margarine and then nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Taco Delight
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion together in skillet. Chop tomatoes and lettuce in large pan. Crush Fritos. Grate cheese. When ready to eat add cheese to lettuce and tomatoes mix add hamburger mixture mix and then add Fritos. Mix everything completely and eat while warm. You can adjust the amounts of the ingredients to suit your taste. Serves a crowd.

title: Jalapeno Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in pot; stir in flour mixing well. Add milk; stir until combined with flour over medium heat. Add cream cheese and heat until melted. Pour into casserole dish and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly. (Adjust the amount of peppers to your own taste. We like it hotter.)

title: Pickled Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a crock. Let stand 4 days.

title: Light And Heavenly
instructions: Mix the flour margarine and nuts. Press into a 3-quart casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Cool. This makes the crust.

title: Chocolate Truffle
instructions: Make the cake and pudding. Make layers of pudding cake and Cool Whip. Top with chocolate sprinkles and cherries.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Cook on medium heat stirring constantly until the mixture forms a ball. Let cool knead it a bit to smooth it out. Store this play dough in plastic bags in the refrigerator. Can leave out food coloring and divide dough into portions and knead a few drops of different food coloring into each portion.

title: Korean Salad Dressing For Spinach Salad
instructions: Whisk together the ingredients and pour over your salad.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix cornbread as per package directions. Add other ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peach Fluff
instructions: Put peaches in blender and chop well. Add dry pudding mix and light Cool Whip; chill.

title: Cinnamon Date Rolls
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour 1/2 cup sugar yeast and salt. Heat water 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup butter until very warm (125\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Stir into dry ingredients. Mix in eggs and enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic about 4 to 6 minutes. Cover. Let rest 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Soraya(Persian)
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Let stand 20 minutes. Pound chicken breasts a little to flatten. Spread butter thickly along wide part of breast. Sprinkle apricot slivers over butter. Roll breasts tightly around filling. Dip rolled chicken in flour then egg. Pack bread crumbs around chicken so they adhere. Melt small amount of butter in heavy skillet and brown breaded chicken (about 5 minutes on each side).

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil and debone chicken. Grease 9 x 12-inch pan. Put chicken in pan; put rice over. Mix together both soups and chicken broth and pour over rice. Pour dressing over and bake until brown.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over chicken. Use a glass dish not metal or plastic. Cover and place in refrigerator 2 hours. Remove chicken from marinade and cook on grill. Yields 8 servings.

title: Brownies
instructions: In top of deep double boiler put butter and chocolate; melt and blend together. Turn off heat and add sugar (use only 1 1/2 cups if you want a little more chocolaty brownie). When slightly cooled add eggs and beat well. Add scant cup of unsifted flour and beat well. Add a bit of cinnamon real vanilla and salt; mix well. Add chopped nuts or some raisins if desired. Turn into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. For soft-type brownies bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. For chewy ones bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Microwave Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa cornstarch and salt in a medium size glass bowl. Gradually stir in milk. Microwave on High for 5 minutes stirring once half-way through cooking time. Microwave on High until mixture is cooked and thickened about 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir in butter or margarine and vanilla. Pour into individual serving dishes. Press plastic wrap directly onto surface of pudding. Chill. Serves 4.

title: Nutritious And Delicious Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: *Nuts may be chopped and mixed into dough or halves (or quarters) may be placed on top pushing down to flatten cookie.

title: Oatmeal Pudding Cookies
instructions: Combine in mixer the butter sugars eggs and pudding; beat well. Pour into large bowl. Add all dry ingredients; mix well. Roll out in small balls and press. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Baked Beans And Hamburger
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Use 1/2 of this mix to coat crust. Add 1 quart vanilla ice cream softened. Drizzle other half of fudge mix over top and freeze. Take out 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cake Doughnuts
instructions: Sift together 3 times the flour baking powder and salt. Mix brown sugar eggs mashed potatoes milk oil and nutmeg. Then mix together with flour. Dough will be sticky. Roll out on board with as little flour as possible. Cut and fry in deep fat until pops up turn and remove from fryer.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar flour and salt in heavy saucepan. Add milk slowly. Stir and cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boiling point. Add to well beaten egg yolks; continue cooking to desired thickness for pie. Add vanilla and butter. Pour into cooked pie shell. Spread the whipped cream on top. Sprinkle with toasted coconut.

title: Raspberry-Blueberry Sauce
instructions: Mix 1 cup of the raspberries the preserves water and sugar in a medium sized heavy saucepan (not uncoated aluminum). Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Strain mixture through fine strainer suspended over bowl. Press down on raspberries to release juice. Discard seeds. Stir blueberries and remaining 1 cup of raspberries into hot raspberry syrup. Cover and let stand until cool. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Mix dry ingredients cut in shortening and milk. Stir with fork to mix. Turn out on floured board and knead a few times. Roll out and cut. Place on greased baking sheet or shallow metal baking pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook (can be steamed) carrots until tender but still crunchy. Mix all other ingredients and add to carrots. Refrigerate the longer the better.

title: Crescent Cordon Bleu
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease large cookie sheet.\tIn medium bowl combine chicken ham mushrooms and cheese.\tSeparate dough into 8 rectangles.\tSpoon rounded 1/2 cup of meat mixture onto center of each rectangle of dough.\tPull 4 corners of dough to center; twist slightly and seal edges. Place on prepared cookie sheet. Brush with egg; sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for 18 to 24 minutes. To reheat leftovers wrap loosely in foil and place in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until warm. Serves 4.

title: Oyster Mosca
instructions: Saute first 5 ingredients until soft and clear. Blend in the rest of the ingredients. Place about 8 raw oysters (depending on size) in serving dish. Pour mixture over oysters and bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Dump all ingredients except cornflakes and 1/4 cup oleo into a big casserole dish. Mix and top with crushed cornflakes or crackers. Pour 1/4 cup melted oleo over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mamie'S Blueberry Molasses Cake
instructions: Beat. Add 1 cup boiling water. Beat then fold in blueberries. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Curried Fruit, Vegetable And Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Turn out into a 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Form into a loaf. Bake for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours until well browned on outside. Serve with parsley potatoes and a salad.

title: Potage Daquise
instructions: Drain beets; chop and put back in liquid. Add boiling water and chopped onion. Add and season with remaining ingredients. Chill. Whisk in some sour cream. Fold in garnish.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Cook zucchini with sliced/chopped onion and about 1 tablespoon margarine. Add seasoned salt to taste. In a 9 x 12-inch casserole dish layer a couple of spoons of Ragu sauce some noodles cooked ground beef Ragu sauce zucchini mixture and cheese. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Bake (350\u00b0) or microwave uncovered 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Onion Ring Chicken
instructions: Combine oleo Worcestershire sauce dry mustard and salt to your taste. Crush onion rings. Dip chicken breast in sauce then roll in onion rings. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes in uncovered pan.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. One pound of sausage can be added to this recipe. Another variation is to add 1 package of meat seasoning mix.

title: Fancy Fruit Compote
instructions: Butter sides and bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan. Crumble 1/2 macaroons onto bottom. Pour all fruits on top. Melt butter and wine together and pour on fruit. Sprinkle almonds; crumble remaining macaroons and sprinkle on then sprinkle brown sugar. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Boil shells until almost done; drain. Brown hamburger; drain. Mix mushrooms onions garlic shredded cheese eggs and Ricotta. Sprinkle Parmesan (to your taste). Pour spaghetti sauce in a 9 x 13 (or bigger) pan. Stuff mixture in shells then cover with Mozzarella and sprinkle Parmesan on top. Dish is ready when the cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling over cheese.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle on top of sweet potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Puffs
instructions: Combine butter and water. Bring to a boil. Add flour and stir. Will form into a ball. Remove from burner. Add one egg at a time and mix well. Drop 1/2 tsp. to 1 tsp. on cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar together. Add eggs and vanilla and beat until well mixed. Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Add apples and raisins and stir gently with a strong spoon. Spread batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Seafood Spread
instructions: Spread cream cheese on a platter. Spread cocktail sauce on cream cheese. Boil shrimp in water and crab boil. Add Tonys seasoning to water. Let cool. Chop in food processor and sprinkle on top of cocktail sauce. Add crabmeat then shallots. Serve with crackers.

title: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms and remove stems (chop stems). In a skillet heat 2 tablespoons oil sausages chopped stems and garlic. Cook until lightly browned. In a bowl mix cheese parsley and bread crumbs. Add mixture in skillet with meat and toss. Fill mushrooms and sprinkle with remaining oil. Put on cookie sheet and bake for 25 minutes in oven preheated to 350\u00b0.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix bread crumbs salt pepper Parmesan cheese parsley and garlic well. Dip chicken pieces in butter and then in bread crumb mixture. Place chicken pieces so they do not touch in shallow pan. Sprinkle with remaining butter and crumbs. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Zucchini And Rice Terrine
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Oil a loaf pan or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cook rice in plenty of boiling salted water 10 to 15 minutes and drain. Chop onion and zucchini. Mince garlic. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook onion over medium-low heat until soft. Add zucchini and garlic and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
instructions: Mix together and make a long roll; put in waxed paper. Chill overnight then cut and put on cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Dip in powdered sugar while hot. Let cool then dip in powdered sugar again.

title: Green Beans Italian
instructions: Place beans in a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle onion over beans. Arrange stewed tomatoes evenly over onion. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve immediately. Yield 4 servings.

title: Turtle Brownies
instructions: Take remaining cake mix add and dot over top. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake 1 hour for 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish. Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Place ground beef in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Salt and pepper ground beef. Place a layer of thinly sliced onions over ground beef. Place a layer of thinly sliced potatoes over onions. Salt potatoes. Alternate layers of onions and potatoes. Pour mushroom soup on top. Do not add water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until potatoes are tender.

title: Pecan Millionaires
instructions: Melt caramels and milk in microwave until creamy. (Check often.) Stir pecans in melted caramels. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper and chill. Melt chocolate bark; dip candy in chocolate mixture using toothpick. Place on wax paper until set.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Cookies
instructions: Divide ingredients in\torder to use\tfood processor; make twice. Have cheese and margarine at room temperature. Mix in food processor 1\tcup flour 1/2 stick margarine 8 ounces cheese 1/2 teaspoon paprika 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon red pepper. Process until it makes soft dough. Add whole pecans; process until chopped.

title: Raspberry Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour and 3/4 cup sugar. Cut in butter until mixture resembles crumbs. Reserve 1 cup of this mixture for topping. To remaining mixture add baking powder soda salt sour cream 1 egg and extract. Blend well. Spread batter over bottom and up sides (2 inches) of pan.

title: Spanish Noodles
instructions: For the noodles mix together eggs salt and enough flour to make very stiff dough. Roll out very thin and allow to stand in cool place for 3 or 4 hours. Roll up and slice very thin.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Slice the sweet potatoes thin and place in a large skillet (electric skillet works well). Add sugar margarine and water to cover sweet potatoes about halfway. Add orange juice if desired. Cover and simmer on low heat until done. Add water as needed.

title: Edna Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add 2 eggs one at a time alternately with flour until all ingredients have been mixed. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 then increase heat to 400\u00b0 for remaining ten minutes. Do not open oven during baking time. Let cool in pan 20 minutes. Turn top side up on plate. Extra good cake!

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese in a bowl then chop meat and green onions. Mix well. Chop olives and mushrooms. Mix together. Chill 1/2 hour. Serve with crackers or raw vegetables.

title: Zesty Tomato Mac And Beef
instructions: Brown meat and onion in large skillet. Drain season with salt and pepper if desired. Add undrained tomatoes and water; bring to a boil. Stir in macaroni. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until pasta is cooked. Stir in cheese. Garnish with sliced green onions and sour cream if desired.

title: Marinated Flank Steak(London Broil)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over flank steak; marinate overnight. Grill and slice on the bias for most tender meat.

title: Stir And Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat together the 2 eggs oil and vanilla. Stir in sugar flour baking powder and salt. Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass bottom oiled and dipped in sugar. (I bake without flattening.) Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Vidalia Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions 1/8 inch thick. Sprinkle with sugar and add ice water to cover. Soak for 1 hour. Make batter of flour salt water vegetable oil and beaten egg whites. Drain onion rings and dip into batter. Fry at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Blend all together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle cinnamon on top of filling. Bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Reduce to 350\u00b0 and bake until a knife inserted in middle comes out clean 30 to 45 minutes or until done. Delicious tastes like sugar cream pie.

title: Aunt Martha'S Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown beef with onion and celery until meat loses its red color. Remove excess fat. Put all ingredients in crock-pot on low for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Wash peel core and slice apples. Combine apples and cider in 6-quart pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover stirring occasionally. Simmer until apples are tender (approximately 30 to 40 minutes). Puree apples in blender until smooth. Return apple mixture to pot. Add sugar cinnamon allspice and cloves. Bring to boil over medium low heat. Cover and cook until thick (approximately 1 hour). Pour into canning jars leaving 1/4-inch space. Cover jar with lids and deep boil jars for 10 minutes. Cool jars 10 to 12 hours.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni for about 7 minutes and drain. Brown ground beef salt pepper and onions and drain. Mix all of the ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Low-Fat Trifle
instructions: Prepare sugar-free vanilla pudding using skim milk. In a glass bowl layer cake pudding and fruit. Top with low-fat whipping cream like Cool Whip or Reddi-Wip.

title: No Bake Lemony Cheesecake
instructions: In a small bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water and set aside. In a medium bowl beat cream cheese with electric mixer until smooth. Gradually beat in dissolved gelatin. Fold whipped topping into cheese mixture and spoon into crust. Chill 4 hours or until firm. Serve topped with cherry pie filling.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken until done and chop. Mix together 2 cans of mushroom soup Ro-Tel tomatoes and all other seasonings. Fill each tortilla with mixture placing a toothpick through each to hold together then place in a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole dish. Mix last can of mushroom soup and sour cream together until blended smooth. Spoon over enchiladas. Sprinkle cheese and optional jalapenos over top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly. Ole!

title: Bryan'S Beef Jerky
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cut roast into strips and marinate over night. Dehydrate for 6-9 hours depending on thickness of jerky.

title: Peanut Butter Chews
instructions: Mix syrup and sugar. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Add peanut butter and butter. Stir until well mixed. Add cornflakes and mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper or covered cookie sheet. Serves 36.

title: Reuben'S
instructions: Mix together and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve on miniature rye bread.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken pieces on bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish. Top with cheese slices. Combine soup and wine; mix well. Spoon this sauce over chicken. Sprinkle stuffing mix over the mixture. Drizzle with the melted butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Easy Swiss Steak
instructions: Pound steak. Cut into bite size pieces. In skillet brown steak in shortening. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake(A Taste Treat From Linda)
instructions: Mix and put into a pie plate. Bake for 5 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Coconut Pie(Makes 2)
instructions: Mix ingredients then bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. This pie needs no crust; it makes its own.

title: Tuna Mold
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together. Pour 1 cup cold water over 2 envelopes unflavored gelatin in a medium saucepan. Heat until gelatin is dissolved.

title: Tuna Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mayonnaise until desired moistness. Good on crackers as sandwich filling to fill small cream puffs pocket or pita bread.

title: Punch For A Crowd
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Serve over ice.

title: Chutney Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; mix well. Cover and chill at least 1 hour. Shape cheese mixture into a ball; roll in chopped nuts. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Yields one 5-inch ball.

title: Chocolate Oat Cookies
instructions: Mix together sugar milk cocoa and butter. Bring to boil (full boil) for 1 minute. Take off and add vanilla flavoring and oats. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper and let harden.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients in order. Make hole in bread. Tear pieces of the pulled out center into finger size pieces and lay around bread bowl. Fill bread bowl with dip.

title: Quick Potato Salad
instructions: Cut slightly cooled potatoes into 1-inch cubes. In a large bowl combine potatoes onions and salad dressing then toss gently. Dust with paprika or black pepper. Garnish with chives and bacon. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm. Makes a good luncheon dish.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together all ingredients pour in freezer and finish filling with regular milk.

title: Sausage And Peppers With Rice
instructions: In large skillet cook sausage onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain off all grease.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Sprinkle chicken pieces with garlic powder. Marinate shaking to coat with oil for 2 hours or overnight. Drain. Mix together crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Coat chicken with crumb mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Cook onion in melted butter about 10 minutes. Add celery salt and pepper. Add chicken stock; cover and cook 10 minutes. Add drained vegetables water chestnuts and diced chicken; mix well and heat to boiling. Add sauce.

title: Italian Bread Sticks
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2/3 cup warm water; add salt sugar and shortening. Beat in 1 cup flour until smooth. Knead in remaining flour for 5 minutes. Shape into 20 (6-inch) pencil lengths. Place on greased baking sheet. Beat egg and remaining water together. Brush on sticks. Let rise for 1 hour. Bake for 20 minutes at 370\u00b0. Yields 20.

title: Lemon Cheese Filling
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Add beaten egg water lemon juice and rind. Cook stirring constantly until thick and clear. Add oleo and the food coloring. Will ice 2 layers of plain cake.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Whip egg whites. Add sugar one tablespoon at a time and continue to whip until egg whites form peaks. Scald milk and add to egg whites while beating. Add butter or oleo 1 teaspoon at a time. Then add shortening and vanilla. Beat for a long time until desired consistency.

title: Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients; press into a 9-inch pie plate. Do not bake.

title: Clam Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise. Place cut side down in shallow baking dish. Add 1/4 cup water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Scoop out eggplant; leave 1/2-inch shell. Chop eggplant; saute with celery onion and garlic in 1/4 cup oil about 10 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Spoon into shells. Brush outside rims and top with oil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Grampy'S Fudge
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large saucepan. Stir over low heat until blended. Bring to boil over mod heat being careful not to mistake air bubbles for boiling. Then boil slowly stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Remove from heat stir in chocolate chips and vanilla until chocolate is melted. Pour into 2 buttered 9 x 9 inch pans and cool. Makes 5 lb. Store at room temp.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Coat casserole dish with Pam. Place broccoli in dish. Mix last 5 ingredients. Pour over broccoli. Top with fine bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 10 inch greased skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Orange Delight
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Blend in frozen orange juice. Fold in Cool Whip. Fold in crushed pineapple and Mandarin oranges. Fold in miniature marshmallows and coconut. Chill until firm.

title: Candied Pecans
instructions: Cook until dry. Then place on buttered cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes on 350 degrees. Dont let burn. Take off cookie sheet. Store in dry container.

title: Lo-Cal Banana Split Cake
instructions: Place graham crackers in an 8-inch square pan. Mix pudding and milk and pur over graham crackers. Slice banana and layer over pudding. Spread Cool Whip over the bananas. Top with strawberries and pineapple. Chill for at least 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cover and chill macaroni. Combine remaining ingredients and chill. Combine all ingredients just before serving.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Bake pie shells for 5 minutes; let cool. Mix all ingredients together well. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 16 to 18.

title: Cauliflower And Lettuce Salad
instructions: Break up lettuce and place in medium size bowl. Place broken cauliflower over lettuce. Fry bacon. Let cool and crumble mix with chopped green pepper. Place on top of cauliflower.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown rice green pepper and onion in oil in large skillet. Add remaining ingredients. Cook 30 minutes until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Do not stir or uncover for best results.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or pan and stir-fry celery and onion over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes separating the onion \layers.\ Add soy sauce sugar and broth; bring to a boil. Add bean sprouts and chicken and stir to combine. Dissolve cornstarch in water and add gradually to sauce. Simmer gently until it thickens. Serve over chow mein noodles. Serves 4.

title: Butterfinger Dessert
instructions: Mix and pour over the crust. Top with Cool Whip and 1 more crumbled Butterfinger. Chill.

title: Picadillo
instructions: Brown hamburger with onions. Add tomato sauce basil and oregano. Cook until boiling; add raisins. Simmer on medium-low heat for about 30 minutes. Prepare yellow rice as directed on package. Serve with fried plantains or sliced bananas.

title: Brandy Alexander
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients in blender. Pour into champagne glasses and sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Midnight Mix
instructions: Place the cereal and pecans in a pan and place aside; pour butter and cheese over cereal. Bake at 200\u00b0 and stir often.

title: Mints
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth and creamy. Roll into 1/2-inch balls. Place on waxed paper. Flatten with palm of your hands. Let dry 10 to 15 minutes then use tines of fork to flatten (making a crisscross pattern). When tops feel dry turn mints over to dry. Store in airtight container between layers of waxed paper in refrigerator.

title: Crunchy Cheese Potatoes
instructions: In a large bowl combine sour cream milk chives salt and pepper. Add potatoes and mix thoroughly. Spread in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking dish. Combine cheese and cornflakes; sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with additional chives if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Banana Cherry Salad
instructions: In large flat pan smush bananas into small pieces. Add lemon juice and sugar. Stir in remaining ingredients. Freeze. Serve frozen or may thaw for 30 minutes prior to eating.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix well; pour into greased and floured 9 or 10-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Pour chicken broth into 4-quart pot. Put in chicken tenders. Cook about 10 minutes. Remove. Cut into pieces. Return to chicken broth. Add diced tomatoes and mixed vegetables.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift and mix thoroughly the first 5 ingredients in 10 x 6-inch (8 x 8-inch would also work) cake pan. Make 3 holes in above mixture. Put vinegar in one hole vanilla in another hole and oil in third hole. Pour cold water over all and mix with fork until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Can add chopped nuts.

title: Kentucky Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients in a doubled plastic food bag. Shake well. Spray Pam or use oil to prepare an 10 x 15 x 3-inch pan. Use cold water to wash chicken and then paper towel dry. Add chicken to bag a few pieces at a time and shake. Continue until all chicken is used up. Melt butter and using a soft pastry brush dab each piece of chicken until all are covered. Bake them uncovered without turning. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Coreene'S Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Mix ingredients and keep in tightly covered jar. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water. Great on cold wet days!

title: Grandma O'Dell'S French Crullers
instructions: Heat the water to a boil. Add the butter and when melted stir the flour in quickly. Remove from fire and cool slightly. Add eggs not beaten one at a time and mix thoroughly. Shape the crullers on an oiled brown bag using bag. Fry in deep fat at 395\u00b0 until golden brown. Drain and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Never Fail Pastry
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until it resembles coarse meal. Stir in remaining ingredients. (Work like kneading bread dough.) Divide dough into 5 balls. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and store in freezer bags. May be stored up to 5 weeks in freezer. Yields 5 (9-inch) pies.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill for several hours or overnight.

title: Oyster Cracker Appetizers
instructions: Mix crackers and oil together. Add dry ingredients and mix again. Refrigerate overnight. Stir. May be stored at room temperature in covered container.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Grease and flour 7 1/2 x 12-inch pan. Mix all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Gene'S Meat Loaf Gravy
instructions: Heat oil and flour in large skillet until light brown. Add all other items. Only takes about 5 minutes. If gravy gets too thick add more water. Serve over meat loaf.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet on medium high heat. Add chicken onions and peppers. Cook and stir until cheese is cooked through. Add corn and salsa bring to a boil. You may add a little water if needed. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Sprinkle with cheese; cover. Let stand 2 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender for 2 minutes. Grease and flour a 9 or 10-inch pie pan. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ground beef eggs tomato juice oats onion salt and pepper. Mix all together in a bowl.

title: Doughnut Drops
instructions: Mix together. Drop by spoon into hot oil (370\u00b0 for electric frypan). Drain on paper towel. Coat with cinnamon and sugar or powdered sugar.

title: Fried Rice(A Great Main Dish)
instructions: Fry bacon pieces. Remove bacon and saute onion green onion and carrot. Leave crisp. Add meat peas salt and pepper. In a separate pan cook 2 scrambled eggs. Chop eggs and add to meat mixture. Add cooked rice to meat mixture and stir. Add 1/4 c. soy sauce and stir until ready to serve.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth. Cook one minute. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly. Add cheese. Stir in salt and pepper.

title: Pull Away Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in small bowl. Stir boiling water and shortening and dissolve in large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all together. Cover bowl and refrigerate overnight. Knead. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Dip in melted butter. Line around the bottom and up the sides of a Bundt cake pan.
