Fill pan up around the stem of pan too. Let rise 1 hour (covered). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Banana Salad
instructions: Combine lemon juice salt and mayonnaise. Stir into cream cheese. Add pineapple cherries and nuts. Fold in whipped cream. Add bananas. Freeze until ready to serve. Yields 10 servings.

title: Smothered Steak Casserole
instructions: Season and flour steak. Brown in fat. Arrange in bottom of casserole. Cover with raw potatoes and carrots. Pour soup and milk over vegetables and meat. Cover and bake 35 minutes at 400\u00b0. Remove cover. Place biscuits over top. Return to oven and bake about 10 to 15 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Beans And Rice
instructions: In a nonstick skillet saute onion and garlic in oil until tender. Stir in the tomatoes zucchini and oregano. Cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until zucchini is tender stirring occasionally. Add the beans salt and pepper; cook and stir until heated through. Serve over cooked rice sprinkle with shredded cheese.

title: Fruit Bowl
instructions: Place fruit in clear glass bowl. Coat with lemon and orange juice. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell 8 minutes. Beat egg whites. Add 1/4 cup sugar. Beat until soft peaks. Beat remaining ingredients and yolks. Fold in egg whites. Bake 40 minutes.

title: Squash Muffins
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt sugar squash in large bowl. Make a well in center. Combine egg milk and oil; add to dry mixture stirring until moistened. Spoon batter into lightly greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Freeze well.

title: Deluxe Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle a little sugar over fruit and mix with one cup or one carton of sour cream.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: In a large soup kettle or Dutch oven melt the butter. Stir in flour; heat and stir until smooth. Gradually add milk stirring constantly until thickened. Add potatoes and onions. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat; simmer for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and stir until cheese is melted. Serve immediately. Yield 8 to 10 servings (2 1/2 quarts).

title: Chicken Lasagne
instructions: Remove chicken from bone. In a casserole layer noodles chicken onion bell pepper and cheese. Mix cream of chicken soup with chicken broth. Heat and pour over each layer. Make 3 layers. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes. Serves 4-6.

title: Chestnut Cookies
instructions: Mix cake mix egg and nuts together. Pour into a buttered Pyrex dish. Mix cream cheese vanilla sugar eggs and melted butter completely. Mix together. Pour over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in casserole dish and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Backpack Cookies
instructions: Cream butter in a large bowl; gradually add sugars beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture mixing well. Fold in oats and remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned. Transfer cookies to wire racks and let cool completely. Yield 7 1/2 dozen.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Knead together all ingredients. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Roll mixture into small balls. Set balls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Eat warm. These can be warmed for leftovers or eaten when you need a quick breakfast.

title: Best Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Combine yeast 1/4 cup lukewarm water and 1 tablespoon sugar in a large bowl. Stir until yeast is dissolved. Set aside.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Combine chicken pieces and lemon pieces in a bowl just large enough to hold them comfortably. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight turning occasionally.

title: Orange Roughy
instructions: Cover fish in Italian dressing and let marinate for 3 to 4 hours. Take out of marinade and wrap in heavy aluminum foil. Place on the grill and cook five minutes. Turn over and cook another five. Pierce the foil some for the last five minutes to give them the grilled taste. Additional marinade may be used to baste during cooking if you choose.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Roll 1 teaspoon dough in balls dip in slightly beaten egg white then in nuts. Place on pan. Press thumb gently into centers. Bake 10 to 20 minutes. Fill holes with jelly. Strawberry jam is best.

title: Cabbage And Dumplings
instructions: Mix together and either roll or drop. Cook 10 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Prepare brownie mix according to package. Bake in 9X13 pan and allow to completely cool. Using a fork prick holes all over pan of brownies. Drizzle with coffee liqueur. Break up brownies into small pieces; place half in bottom of large glass bowl or truffle dish. Cover with half pudding 1/3 of crushed candy and half the Cool Whip. Repeat with another layer. Top with remaining third of crushed candy. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Drain off liquid. Add soup milk broccoli and chicken. Add seasoning from Ramen noodles to taste. Serves 2.

title: Mexicali Pork Chops
instructions: Rub taco seasoning over pork chops. In a skillet cook chops in oil over medium-high heat until meat is no longer pink and juices run clear about 9 minutes.\tServe with salsa. Yield 4 servings.

title: Grandma'S Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar eggs and applesauce. Rub raisins with flour. Add with all remaining ingredients to creamed mixture. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan or two loaf pans about 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Toni'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat sugars and butter in a large bowl until fluffy. Beat in Bristol Cream and eggs. Stir in flour baking soda and salt. Add nuts and chocolate chips. Drop dough about 2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake 11 to 14 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.

title: Sour Cream Coconut Icing
instructions: Mix well. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours before using.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil chickens; remove meat; cut into chunks. In a greased casserole combine the chicken mayonnaise celery almonds cream of chicken soup onion lemon juice Tabasco salt and pepper. Toss to mix and cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Put potato chips on top to serve.

title: Pork Chops With Apples
instructions: Brown pork chops and onion in a large skillet coated with cooking spray. Combine water bouillon granules and pepper stirring to dissolve; add to skillet. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Skim off fat. Add apple slices and cinnamon mixture in skillet. Cove and simmer an additional 15 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and serve hot. Yield 4 servings.

title: Whipped Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition just until yellow disappears. Add flour alternately with cream beginning and ending with flour. Stir in vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Cool in pan on rack about 10 minutes. Cool completely on rack.

title: Carolyn Sue'S Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Chop crab meat fine. Mix all with crab. Heat in oven for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot with crackers or chips.

title: Texas Melt
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add enchilada sauce stewed tomatoes onions salt and pepper; bring to a boil and simmer. Spread sour cream on tortillas and fold in half. In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish spread enough sauce to cover bottom of pan. Place tortillas on top of meat mixture (sauce) and pour remaining sauce over tortillas. Top with cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Civil War Or Date Loaf Bread
instructions: Combine dates water soda salt and butter and let cool and then add beaten egg sugar flour vanilla and nuts. Beat well and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done in center.

title: Caramel Cake
instructions: Unwrap caramels and put in saucepan with 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Heat until melted stirring constantly; set aside.

title: Microwave Fried Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken breasts in egg whites then roll chicken breasts in crushed corn flakes. Arrange in microwave dish. Cover with Saran Wrap except for one corner. Cook in microwave for 20 minutes. Microwaves vary so check to see if chicken is done. You may have to add some time. Turn dish every 5 minutes during cooking.

title: Rosie'S Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in order listed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or microwave until cheese is melted.

title: Blueberry Cream Pie
instructions: Mix above ingredients together. Pour into 9-inch lined pie plate. Pour 1 cup heavy cream over berries. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Dilute frozen juices with 2 cans water for each can. Dissolve sugar in 1 cup boiling water; let cool. Add sweetened water and jello to juices. Add ginger ale and mashed bananas 2 hours before serving.

title: Fireside Coffee Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Store in airtight container. Makes 6 1/2 cups. To make 1 cup spoon 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon coffee mix in cup. Add 1 cup boiling water.

title: Eclaire
instructions: Prepare pudding fold in cook whip. Layer graham crackers and pudding mix in 9 x 13 pan starting with graham crackers. To with chocolate sauce. Cool for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Fish And Chips
instructions: Mix first three ingredients until the consistency of buttermilk. Then dip fish in flour and let dry a few minutes. Then dip in batter.

title: Broccoli-Cheddar Soup(Low-Cal)
instructions: Cut and discard the hardest part of the stalk. Separate broccoli into flowerets and stalks. Dice stalks and chop flowerets. Put broccoli in boiling water and cook about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside.

title: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan heat the oil over moderately high heat until very hot but not smoking. Add onions red peppers garlic and celery. Saute for 7 minutes until onions are golden. Stir in the chili powder cumin jalapeno pepper salt carrots mushrooms water and tomatoes. Bring the liquid to a boil over high heat; then lower the heat. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until carrots are barely tender. Add the beans and cover. Cook for 5 minutes or until they are heated through. Uncover saucepan; continue to cook for 10 minutes or until the liquid has thickened slightly. Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 4.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
instructions: Combine vegetable soup 1/2 cup cheese sour cream pepper and 1/2 can onions. Pour into a 1-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions; bake uncovered 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts.

title: Bacon Wrapped Shrimp
instructions: Marinate shrimp in French dressing in fridge for 1-2 hours. Dressing need not cover shrimp but turn once and then drain shrimp. Wrap each shrimp in 1/4 piece of bacon. Secure bacon with tooth pick. Place on oven rack in a shallow pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until bacon is dry or crisp. Do not over cook shrimp. Drain on a paper towel and enjoy!

title: French Toast
instructions: Combine eggs milk salt and sugar. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in 10-inch frypan. Dip bread one slice at a time in egg mixture. Then fry in oil over low heat. When brown on one side turn and brown other side. When done sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Serve with syrup or jelly. Makes 8 servings.

title: Barbecued Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except barbecue sauce. Spread mixture evenly in loaf dish (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Spread barbecue sauce over meat mixture. Cover with waxed paper and microwave on Medium-high (70%) for 12 minutes. Rotate loaf dish 1/2 turn. Microwave until center is no longer pink 13 to 16 minutes longer. Remove to serving platter; cover and let stand 5 minutes. Top with additional sauce if desired.

title: Angel Hair Primavera
instructions: Saute garlic in olive oil; set aside. Steam broccoli; set aside. Cook peas; set aside. Toss pasta with garlic oil peas broccoli and tomatoes. Serve immediately.

title: Sausage-Cheese Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all together; form into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook until hot and bubbly; 2 to 3 hours on high in crock-pot or 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Baklava
instructions: Grind almonds and walnuts and add sugar and cinnamon. Butter pan and add five phyllo buttering each layer.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Boil the sugar and water and cool. Blend all together. Put in container and freeze. Let thaw some before serving and stir well.

title: Sausage Alfresco
instructions: Prepare fettucine drain. Melt butter in skillet. Add onion then vegetables; cook until tender. Set aside; brown sausage and drain. Combine sausage vegetables and cream. Simmer; add cheese and parsley. Serve over fettucine.

title: Sharon'S Favorite Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mixture should be very moist but not soupy. Pour into buttered 9 x 12-inch or larger baking dish. Place into non-preheated oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes until top is golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Elephant Ears
instructions: Cut tortillas in half and deep fry until crisp (about 1 minute on each side). Drain well and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

title: Bonbon Candy
instructions: Cream milk margarine vanilla pecans and coconut. Add sugar; mix well. Roll in small balls and chill about 1 hour. Put a toothpick in each ball. In top of double boiler melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip chilled balls in hot chocolate and put on wax paper. Remove toothpick. Keep chocolate hot while coating. Do not try to double recipe.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Dissolve vinegar sugar and salt. Mix first 5 ingredients. Mix the 2 mixtures together and let stand overnight in refrigerator. This keeps for 2 weeks.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix in regular order. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Easy Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Sprinkle with Morton Natures Seasons. Place chicken in a baking dish or pan. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb And Jello Preserves
instructions: Cover rhubarb with sugar and let stand 1 1/2 hours. Cook sauce. Take off from fire and add Jell-O. Blend well and pour into sterilized jars or jelly glasses.

title: Sausage Strata
instructions: Fit bread into bottom of a greased 12 x 7-inch baking dish. Brown then drain the sausage well. Stir in the mustard. Spoon sausage evenly over the bread then sprinkle with cheese.

title: Aunt Mim'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients first. Batter will be tacky. Roll out dough thin and cut out your designs. Try not to use extra flour. Bake 7 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and melted butter. Add beaten eggs. Combine cocoa salt and flour. Add to sugar butter and eggs. Add vanilla. Grease and flour 8-inch pie pan and pour in batter. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

title: Honey Thyme Vegetables
instructions: Cook vegetables as directed on package; drain well. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir into hot vegetables. Makes 5 servings.

title: Patio Cooler
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan and place over low heat until sugar is dissolved. Cool. Combine with tea and fruit juices. Chill several hours. Just before serving stir in ginger ale and pour over ice. Can be used in punch bowl with ice ring. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Cover peaches with water and bring to a boil. Add sugar to canned peaches.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce. Cut up tomato; drain and rinse kidney beans. Drain garbanzo beans. Slice onion crumble chips. Mix preceding ingredients (reserving half of crumbled chips to sprinkle on top). Add dressing and toss. Sprinkle chips on top.

title: Cheese Popovers
instructions: Sift flour and salt into a bowl. Beat eggs and milk together then add to the flour beating until quite smooth. Add a few drops of Tabasco.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Beat together sugar eggs margarine and milk until well blended. Stir in bread and pineapple. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Black Walnut Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and add sugar. Add eggs and milk. Add flour sifted with soda. Add vanilla. Add nuts last. Drop from spoon on greased cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 14 minutes.

title: Pumpkin-Raisin Loaves
instructions: In mixing bowl combine the pumpkin water egg and spice. Add the muffin mix and raisins. Stir until moistened.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Hot Dish
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Set the pan in a larger pan of water and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coffee Can Batter Bread
instructions: This recipe may be baked in one 2 pound coffee can or two 1 pound coffee cans. Grease both can and lid.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
instructions: Mix everything except chocolate by hand until smooth and pliable. Chill. Roll into balls and chill until firm. Dip balls into melted chocolate; place on waxed paper until firm and set.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and rice separately according to instructions on package. Combine all ingredients into a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Yum-Yum
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Roll in flour. Melt butter in 9 x 12-inch Pyrex dish in a 350\u00b0 oven. Place floured chicken in Pyrex dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes turning chicken after 15 minutes. Mix soup with 1 can of water and pour over chicken. Cover and cook 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 1 or 2 loaf pans (greased) at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and oil until light and fluffy; add eggs and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients and add to other creamed ingredients. Blend well. Chill dough about 1 hour. Roll into small balls and flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done. Loosen cookies before they cool and stick to cookie sheet.

title: Macaroni And Vegetable Medley
instructions: Drain macaroni; add soup milk and cream cheese. Cook broccoli and cauliflower until tender; drain.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix peaches with 1 cup sugar. Put margarine in a deep pan. Set in 350\u00b0 oven to melt. Stir batter of remaining sugar flour baking powder salt and milk. Pour over melted butter. Do not stir. Place peaches on top. Bake for 1 hour or until crust is golden brown. Batter rises to the top during baking.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Chip Fudge
instructions: Combine cream sweetened condensed milk and chocolate syrup. Beat with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Fold in chopped nuts. Transfer to a 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan; freeze until firm. Makes 1 quart; 8 servings.

title: Creamy Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend together cream cheese mayonnaise and anchovy paste. Stir in chopped egg parsley onion and garlic. Chill until serving time. Serve with vegetables. Makes 1 3/4 cups dip.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef. Boil noodles. Layer 13 x 9-inch pan starting with sauce noodles sauce cheeses (Mozzarella cheese use a little or a lot). Layer until pan is full. Top should just be sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted down.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Wash peel slice and cook potatoes until soft. Turn into an electric mixer bowl and add sour cream cream cheese and butter or margarine. Beat until smooth. Spoon into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can be made ahead and refrigerated until ready to bake.

title: Sherry Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Beat in sugar. Combine with pumpkin cream spices and salt. Cook over a very low heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens or cook in a double boiler. Soften gelatin in sherry; dissolve in hot pumpkin mixture. Blend in butter and vanilla. Chill until mixture thickens. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; fold into filling. Mound in baked pastry shell. Chill until firm.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all of the 7 ingredients then separately mix 1 cup mayonnaise and 1 teaspoon of lemon juice and add to chicken mixture. Then sprinkle crushed potato chips on top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Daisy'S Casserole
instructions: Saute beef and onion; add water chestnuts mushrooms tomatoes tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Cook noodles; rinse and drain. Add to beef mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cracklin' Cornbread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Add buttermilk stirring until well mixed. Add cracklins and pour into a very hot iron skillet which has been well-greased. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar butter vanilla extract milk and pumpkin (either fresh or canned). Use whisk or fork to stir well. Pour into pie crust. Bake in regular pie crust. Makes 2 pies. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0 and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: An angel food cake baked from scratch is so much better for this recipe.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Saute chops on both sides. Place chops in buttered casserole. Place 1 tablespoon raw rice on each chop 1 slice onion and 1 slice tomato. Dissolve bouillon cubes in 2 1/2 cups water; pour over all. Sprinkle with herbs salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes; cover and simmer.

title: Kringla
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually. Add egg and beat. Sift flour and dry ingredients together. Add alternately with the buttermilk. Chill for 2 hours or longer. Form figure eights and bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Quick Cheese Ball
instructions: Fold cream cheese onions and 1 package of ham together; mix in Accent. Form into a ball and cover with remaining package of ham (cut into squares or chopped fine). Refrigerate until set.

title: Green Enchiladas Casserole
instructions: In skillet brown hamburger and onion. Set aside. In a saucepan heat remaining ingredients except corn chips until cheese is melted. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish alternately layer meat corn chips and cheese sauce. Repeat. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Ham And Lima Bean Salad
instructions: Cook lima beans according to package. Drain. Rinse with cold water; drain again. In a mixing bowl combine beans mushrooms onion bacon olives parsley and pimiento.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Add pizza sauce and simmer. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook noodles until done. In 12-inch square casserole dish layer noodles ground beef and sauce mixture and Cheddar cheese. Top with pepperoni and mushrooms. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on this layer. Garnish with green onions. Bake in microwave until cheese melts and dish has heated through approximately 10 minutes or bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pineapple Mint Jelly
instructions: Cover the mint with 1/2 cup water and 2 tablespoons sugar in with mint. Let stand overnight. Strain into pot then add pineapple juice lemon juice and 4 cups sugar. Bring to boil; add 1/2 cup liquid pectin. Boil 1/2 minute. Add green coloring. Skim and pour into jelly glasses. Makes about 6 (6 ounce) jars.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Stir 1/2 lb caramels and 2 tbsp hot water over hot water until smooth. Pour over 5 c popped corn kix or cheerios. Mix gently until blended. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Patio Punch
instructions: Combine drink powders and sugar. Add water and stir to dissolve. Add frozen concentrate. Chill until serving time. Pour over ice. Pour gingerale slowly down side of bowl. Makes about 4 qts.

title: Bunny'S Fried Rice
instructions: Saute green onions in olive oil. Cook 1 cup rice in 2 1/2 cups of water. Add cooked rice soy sauce and sugar to green onions. Heat through. Add boiled ham. Then add softly scrambled eggs and heat quickly.

title: Baked Tomato And Spinach
instructions: Melt butter and saute onions and garlic add spinach. Remove from heat in breadcrumbs egg and salt. Put into halves of tomato and put into a baking dish. Refrigerate a couple of hours. Bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: French-Toasted Ham And Cheese
instructions: In cup stir marmalade and mustard until mixed. Set aside. Cut ham slices to fit on half of the bread slice; cut cheese slices to fit on top of ham then top with a dollop of marmalade mixture and another bread slice. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jellyroll pan melt butter; remove pan from oven. In pie plate with fork beat milk and egg until mixed. Dip sandwiches one at a time into egg mixture to coat all sides. Place sandwiches in one layer in jellyroll pan. Bake until sandwiches are golden brown on both sides or about 20 minutes turning once. Cut each sandwich in half. Serve hot.

title: Ruthie'S Drop Molasses Cookies
instructions: Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Salt and pepper meat. Add garlic and brown in oil. Cook until garlic is yellow. Add soy sauce and water. Cook slowly for 20 minutes (no more than 30). Add vegetables except tomatoes and cook covered about 15 minutes. Mix cornstarch and water. Stir into skillet mixture. Add tomatoes. Cook 5 minutes. Serve over hot rice.

title: Farmhouse Chowder
instructions: Simmer potatoes and onions in broth until tender about 10 minutes. In separate pan cook butter and flour until bubbly. Add milk and water to butter and flour mixture. Cook until thick and smooth. Add this mixture to the potatoes onions and broth. Add next 6 ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Add cheese and eggs just before serving. Be sure to add all liquids from can of vegetables.

title: Twenty Minute Tamale Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet with cover. Add onion and meat and cook until lightly browned. Add tomatoes corn with liquid sour cream corn meal olives and seasonings. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add beaten eggs. Add remaining ingredients and pour into 2 greased 9-inch pie pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes its own crust. Makes 2 pies.

title: Summer Fruit Pie
instructions: Cook all fruit (except blueberries) on top of stove with the sugar and juice. Cook until a light boil. Remove from heat; add cornstarch butter and blueberries. Pour into crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Cook rice. Mix together with remaining ingredients. Bake in oven until bubbly. You may need to heat cheese in microwave before mixing ingredients.

title: Wet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Batter will be thin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mixing well over low heat and bring to a boil for 1/2 to 1 minute (no more or less). Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter and vanilla. Add oats and stir quickly. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Black Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook onion garlic and peppers in hot oil for about 2 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook 3 or 4 minutes. (I often use a can of pasta-style chunky tomatoes undrained.) Season with salt and pepper. Stir in beans and cover and let simmer while rice is cooking. Serve over rice.

title: Hawaiian Kabobs
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 1/2 cup of juice. In large bowl place pineapple chunks and vegetables. Set aside. In a saucepan combine pineapple juice with soy sauce olive oil brown sugar and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Pour over vegetable mixture; cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Heat honey cider vinegar onion and mustard in saucepan. Add oil; heat for 5 minutes. Toss spinach with dressing just before serving and garnish with all remaining ingredients.

title: Creamy Tacos
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain. Add cheese to meat and melt. Add chili and sour cream. Serve in layers. Crumble chips; put hamburger mixture then tomatoes lettuce and salsa.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in bottom of 8 x 8 x 2-inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and arrange pineapple rings. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Snowball Cookies(Shortbread Nuggets)
instructions: Cream sugar and softened margarine. Add eggs and vanilla. Mixture will be lumpy. Stir in flour and salt. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Form teaspoonfuls of mixture into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until lightly browned on the bottom. While still warm roll in sifted confectioners sugar.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Drain peas and chill. Boil eggs and chill. Add onion pickles salt pepper and mayonnaise to peas; chill. Serve cold.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef until browned; drain excess fat. Stir in onions and peppers and cook until onions are clear (tender). Stir in remaining ingredients except Tabasco and corn meal. Heat to boiling then reduce heat and simmer (covered) for two hours stirring occasionally. Mix corn meal with small amount of water to dissolve and use it to thicken chili as desired. Taste chili and use Tabasco for smooth mellow hot flavor.

title: Beef Roast With Mushrooms
instructions: In large heavy saucepan melt butter. Add meat and brown on all sides. Peel onion and stick cloves into onion. Add onion mushrooms and salt and pepper. Cover tightly and simmer for 30 minutes per pound. Check occasionally for moisture. Add a little wine or water if needed. When roast is tender meat juice may be thickened with sour cream or thinned with wine.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips. Beat until well mixed. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Fudge Sundae Pie
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup corn syrup brown sugar and butter in medium saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring occasionally until mixture begins to boil. Remove from heat. Add cereal stirring until well coated. Press in 9-inch pie pan to form crust. Stir together peanut butter fudge sauce and the 3 tablespoons corn syrup. Spread half the peanut butter mixture over crust. Freeze until firm. Allow ice cream to soften. Spoon into frozen pie crust. Freeze until firm. Let pie stand at room temperature before cutting. Sprinkle over few chopped peanuts then warm remaining peanut butter mixture and drizzle over top.

title: Bates Meatballs
instructions: Mix together. Form in balls. Bake in jelly roll pan in oven for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done. Place in sauce (recipe follows) and return to oven to hold warm.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent roll out on pizza pan. Be sure to go up the sides. Brown the sausage. Drain well. Mix in hash browns. Spread on dough. Sprinkle cheese on top. Mix eggs with milk. Pour over everything. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Cook ground beef and onions over medium heat until browned. Add next 8 ingredients. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add vegetables noodles and thyme. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Treat
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour applesauce in pan. Pour crushed pineapple into pan. Sprinkle cake mix over applesauce/pineapple mixture. Pour melted margarine over cake mix. Put nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Eat with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Velveeta Salsa Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain grease. Add onion; set aside. Microwave Velveeta cheese and salsa in 1 1/2-quart bowl on High for 5 minutes stirring after 3 minutes then add ground beef. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Dirt Cups
instructions: You will need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) plastic cups.

title: Sloppy Joes Turnovers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large skillet sprayed with cooking spray brown meat onion and green pepper. Add tomato sauce salt brown sugar substitute and garlic powder. Simmer 5 minutes. Separate crescent roll dough into triangles. Lay triangles on large ungreased cookie sheet. Place about 1 tablespoon of meat mixture in center of each triangle. Bring 3 corners together in center of each triangle. Bake for 12 to 16 minutes or until golden brown. Each serving is 2 triangles.

title: Mama'S Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Cook and mash potatoes. Add margarine and chopped eggs to hot potatoes. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Serve hot.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread coconut on bottom of 11 x 15 x 2-inch pan (do not use any smaller size pan). Cover coconut with pecans. Prepare cake mix\tas directed on box and pour over pecans and\tcoconut. Mix cream cheese oleo sugar and vanilla. Drop by spoonful over cake mix. Do not stir. Bake 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Shrimp Appetizers
instructions: Wrap bacon strips around each shrimp and secure with toothpick. Dip in chili sauce seasoned with Tabasco sauce. Grill turning until brown and bacon is crisp and lightly browned. Serve hot; 3 to 4 per serving.

title: Pimento Dip
instructions: Put everything in medium bowl and beat well. 1-2 minutes. Best if made 24 hours ahead. Serve with Scoops.

title: Upside-Down Berry Cake
instructions: Place first sugar and butter in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 3 to 5 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and mix spreading evenly. Mix together berries 1/2 cup sugar and flour. Pour over butter mixture. Mix remaining ingredients until moist. Pour over berries spreading evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Run knife around edge to loosen cake. Turn upside down on serving tray. Serve warm or cold.

title: Golden Puffs
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well with fork. Heat oil or Crisco 2 inches deep in deep-fat fryer or a kettle. Drop batter by teaspoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until golden brown on both sides about 3 minutes. Remove to paper towels to drain. May be rolled in sugar. To make a fruit puff add 1/2 cup shredded apple to the batter.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Quick Veggie Soup
instructions: In large pot add tomato juice and chicken broth. Add all veggies. Cover and cook on medium heat for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Chocolate Caramel Pecan Cheesecake
instructions: Combine crumbs and margarine. Press on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: No-Cook Divinity
instructions: In small mixer bowl combine frosting mix (dry) corn syrup vanilla and boiling water. Beat on highest speed until stiff peaks form about 5 minutes. Transfer to large mixer bowl. On low speed gradually blend in sugar. Stir in nuts.

title: Traditional Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In mixer bowl combine all ingredients except pastry shell. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake 35 to 40 minutes longer or until center is set. Cool. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Corn Souffle Elegante
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cracker crumbs cheese mushrooms onion and corn and pour into a well-greased souffle dish. Beat eggs half and half and parsley together and pour over the top. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Venison With Sour Cream And Mushrooms
instructions: Season meat with marjoram salt and pepper. Dredge meat in 1/4 cup flour. Heat shortening in a large skillet. Brown meat quickly on both sides. Remove. Reduce heat. Saute onions and mushrooms until onions are tender. Add sherry bouillon cube and water and stir well. Return meat to gravy and continue cooking until meat is medium rate. Combine sour cream and flour. Stir into pan and heat stirring until gravy thickens (add more sherry if too thick). Do not let gravy boil. Serves 4.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Drain vegetables and mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Melt 1/2 stick butter add crushed Ritz crackers (approximately 20) and spread over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Stir soups sour cream and green chilies until it bubbles. Fill tortillas with cheese and onion. Cover rolled tortillas with sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Frijoles Rancheros Beans
instructions: Wash and soak beans for 45 minutes. Cook beans for about 1 hour and 35 minutes. Before beans are ready fry the strips of bacon until crisp then in the same bacon pan add salt and onions and the small jalapeno. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes. Add the tomato sauce; cook for another 5 minutes. When beans are soft and done pour the mixture of the pan into the beans. Cook for 5 minutes. It should be mixed thoroughly.

title: Gravy Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle pork chops with salt and pepper. In 10-inch skillet brown in hot shortening. Pour off drippings. Mix cream of chicken soup Pet milk and water. Pour around pork chops. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 45 minutes or until chops are tender. Stir gravy well.

title: Cinnamon Puffs
instructions: Combine flour baking powder 1 cup sugar and 3 teaspoons cinnamon. Add margarine shortening and egg yolk. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Roll into 1-inch balls. Roll in 2/3 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon combined. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Use an 8-inch glass pie plate. Mix all ingredients together; pour into greased pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. It makes its own crust!

title: Nutty Blue Cheese Rolls
instructions: For filling in a medium bowl stir together walnuts Blue cheese 1 tablespoon parsley and pepper.

title: Microwave Potato Au Gratin
instructions: Combine potatoes soup sour cream and 1/2 cup of the cheese in 1 3/4-quart shallow microproof casserole; blend well. Cook on High 10 to 11 minutes or until potatoes are tender stirring once during cooking time. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Cover and let stand 3 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Three Way Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Sift dry ingredients together. Add flour to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk beating until smooth after each addition. Stir in chocolate pieces. Drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake in a hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. When cool spread with chocolate frosting.

title: Party Potato Salad
instructions: Dice and boil potatoes until tender. Drain and cool. Combine remaining ingredients and mix with cooled potatoes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Jimmy'S Favorite Pretzels
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Make pretzel shapes with dough (can make numbers for birthdays or holidays). Place on greased cookie sheet. Brush with beaten whole egg. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake 5 minutes. Turn over and bake 5 more minutes or until your choice of brown/crispness.

title: Greek Lemon Soup
instructions: Into large saucepan dissolve bouillon in water; add rice. Cover and simmer 25 minutes. In small bowl beat eggs and lemon juice. Gradually stir about 1/2 cup hot bouillon mixture into eggs; stir into hot soup. Serve immediately.

title: P-Nut Krispies
instructions: Mix together sugar and Karo syrup and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Blend well and add Cocoa Krispies. Blend well and drop on wax paper by teaspoonfuls.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat oil and sugar well. Add eggs; beat well. Sift flour cinnamon soda and baking powder. Blend with egg mixture. Fold in carrots and nuts. Place in pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chuckwagon Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients but last 3. Use 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Dip biscuits in butter then in corn meal. Arrange on top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Yakitori
instructions: In saucepan over low heat stir brown sugar soy sauce cold water 3 tablespoons oil and the mustard until dissolved. Cool mixture. Pour over chicken in bowl and marinate at room temperature 2 hours (or overnight in refrigerator). Place vegetable at center of broiler pan. Top with rack; brush with oil. Add chicken; brush with oil. Cook for 20 minutes turning once and basting often. Combine rice and hot water in pan. Drizzle with some of the marinade. Place by the chicken and cook about 15 minutes turning chicken and stirring rice occasionally. Chicken will be quite dark. Serve on platter with almonds and parsley sprinkled on rice. Serves 4.

title: Fondue Neuchateloise(This Is A Traditional Fondue)
instructions: Rub cooking pot with cut garlic. Add wine and heat. When wine is hot but not boiling add lemon juice. Add cheese by handfuls stirring constantly with wooden spoon until cheese is smooth and melted. Bring fondue to bubble briefly. Add seasonings stirring until blended. Mix cornstarch with Kirsch liqueur. Add to fondue; allow to boil for another 30 seconds. Serve and keep hot over burner. Spear bread cubes through soft side into crust; dunk and swirl in fondue.

title: Corn Bread Salad(To Eat With Soup Beans.)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. It is better the second day after preparation.

title: Blueberry Orange Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Combine dry ingredients. Gently stir in blueberries. Add rest of ingredients mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: My Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients cook until thick stirring constantly. Pour into prepared pie crust. When cool top with Cool Whip.

title: Fruited Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: In tightly covered jar shake Blue cheese dressing orange juice and lemon juice together. Refrigerate at least 3 hours to blend flavors. Shake well.

title: Stroganoff Stew
instructions: Sprinkle flour salt and pepper over meat. In large stockpot heat oil. Add meat; cook until browned. Add beef broth and water. Add the rest of the ingredients except sour cream. Boil then reduce heat to medium low and simmer 50 to 55 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove from heat; stir in sour cream.

title: Pecan Snack
instructions: Put pecans and slightly beaten egg whites in a bowl and stir. Sprinkle in sugar and cinnamon; mix well. Spread and separate on cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together and cook until sugar dissolves.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (If using Pyrex baking dish bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.)

title: Apple-Cranberry Wild Rice
instructions: In a large saucepan bring water and salt to a boil. Stir in the rice; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until rice is tender. Drain. Stir in savory; set aside. In a nonstick skillet saute leek in oil for 1 minute. Stir in cranberries apples and 3 tablespoons chicken broth; cover and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes stirring occasionally. Add rice onion salt lemon pepper and remaining broth. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Yield 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. In bowl combine hamburger with sour cream soup drained pimentos and drained corn. Fold in cooked (drained) noodles. Top with 2 cups Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Ho Ho Cake
instructions: Prepare devils food cake mix as directed. Spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes; cool. Cream for 15 minutes the margarine shortening sugar and flour. To this add vanilla and milk. Spread on cooled cake; refrigerate until firm about 2 hours.

title: It'S-A-Snap Cheesecake
instructions: In a small saucepan sprinkle gelatine over 1/4 cup cold water. Let stand 1 minute. Stir over low heat until gelatine is completely dissolved. In a large bowl with electric mixer beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla until blended. Gradually beat in gelatine mixture and remaining 3/4 cup water until smooth. Pour into crust. Chill until firm. Garnish if desired with fresh or canned fruit.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients pour in Bundt pan. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Dust with powdered sugar or make drizzle icing with powdered sugar and water.

title: Old Virginia Spoon Bread
instructions: Stir cornmeal\tand salt into 2 cups boiling water in saucepan. Cook for 1 minute; remove from heat.\tAdd melted butter and baking powder; mix well. Add eggs; mix well. Stir in milk gradually. Spoon into 2 quart baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: York Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir together butter sugar and vanilla. Add eggs; stir in flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Blend well. Reserve 2 cups batter; set aside. Spread remaining batter in pan. Arrange patties in single layer over batter about 1/2 inch apart. Spread reserved batter over patties. Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Yield About 36 brownies.

title: Pineapple Meringue Pie
instructions: Cut shortening into flour with a pastry blender until its a crumb mixture. Stir in cold water 1 tablespoon at a time to form a dough ball. Roll out dough on a floured surface to fit an 8-inch pie pan. Place dough in pie pan trim and decorate edge and bake at 475\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Wassail
instructions: Put ingredients in crock-pot. Cover. Cook on high for 1 hour and then on low for 4 to 8 hours. Serve hot.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Bake in buttered dish slowly for at least 1 hour.

title: Marvelous Mocha Cheesecake
instructions: In small bowl combine crumbs sugar and margarine or butter. Pat crumbs firmly in 9 x 13-inch baking pan (on bottom and sides of dish). Chill. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Add Eagle Brand and chocolate syrup. In small bowl dissolve coffee in water. Add to Eagle Brand mixture. Mix well. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into prepared pan. Cover. Freeze until firm. Garnish with additional chocolate crumbs if desired.

title: Miracle Whip Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients one by one until everything is mixed. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch ungreased baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done about 30 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle powdered sugar over top lightly with flour sifter.

title: Spiced Orange Tea Drink
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Makes nice gifts in decorated canisters.

title: Chocolate Fried Pies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Combine egg and milk; add to dry mixture and mix well. Roll dough to pie crust thickness. Cut into saucer size circles. Fill with chocolate mixture.

title: Easy Cold Pizza(Good Hot Too!)
instructions: To thaw dough place in refrigerator the night before in a covered bowl. By morning it will be thawed out.

title: Tammy Wynette'S Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco thoroughly; add eggs. Blend rest of ingredients one at a time beating thoroughly. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Carrot Pudding
instructions: Combine carrots butter lemon juice salt and sugar in large saucepan. Add just enough water to cover. Bring to boil; simmer covered about 1/2 hour then cook over high heat until liquid evaporates stirring constantly with spoon. Let cool 10 minutes.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Cook rice until almost done. Cut up red onions very fine and brown in shortening. Cut up giblets and put in with onions; cook until brown. Add garlic cut very finely. Chop green onions with tops and parsley and add to the mixture along with salt red pepper and water. Pour over cooked rice. When the water is absorbed put in a large baking pan. Dot with butter and brown in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes if desired. Serves 30 to 40 people.

title: Fire And Ice Tomatoes
instructions: Mix vinegar celery salt mustard seed salt sugar red and black pepper and cold water. Bring to boil; boil hard for 1 minute. Pour hot mixture over tomatoes green pepper and onion. Cover and place in refrigerator to chill. Before serving add cucumber. Serve very cold as a salad on lettuce or as a relish. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in double boiler. Add remaining ingredients and heat thoroughly. This may be made ahead and later transferred to a chafing dish. Heat in pan first as candle will not be strong enough to melt cheese.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening in saucepan over low heat. Let cool. Add sugar molasses and egg. Beat well. Mix together flour baking soda salt and all of the spices. Add liquid mixture. Mix well and chill. Form 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar and place on greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook meat and onion until tender. Add browned bacon; drain any fat. Blend flour and seasonings into meat mixture. Stir in soup. Cook slowly uncovered stirring frequently for 20 to 25 minutes. Stir in sour cream and heat thoroughly. Serves 6. Serve over egg noodles.

title: Brunch Eggs
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Crumble bacon and finely chop beef. Sprinkle on flour and add milk. Heat and stir until thickened. Scramble eggs into 1/2 cup oleo. Use a large deep dish casserole or pan approximately 9 x 13-inch. Layer sauce and egg ending with sauce (usually 4 layers). Cover a must. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can prepare day ahead covered and refrigerated. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Mother'S Granola
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients. Mix water oil and vanilla in bowl and pour over the other ingredients. Mix well. Spread in shallow pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1/2 hour until brown. Stir occasionally. Cool and store.

title: Beignets
instructions: In a small bowl combine water yeast and 2 teaspoons sugar. Let stand about 10 minutes until yeast foams. Meanwhile combine milk vanilla butter egg 1/3 cup sugar salt and nutmeg. Stir in the yeast mixture. Add the flour one cup at a time mixing well after each addition. After three cups have been added knead in the remaining flour 1 to 2 tablespoons at a time. Knead until smooth about 10 minutes. Place dough in an oiled bowl turning to coat. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk about 1 1/2 hours. Punch down dough and roll to a 1/2-inch thickness. Cut the dough into 2-inch diamond shapes. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 hour. Pour oil to a depth of 3-inches in a heavy pot or fryer. Heat to 365\u00b0 and fry the beignets 4 or 5 at a time for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towel and place in a warm oven while frying the remaining beignets. Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving warm. Makes about 30.

title: Sour Cream Onion Soup Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and dehydrated onion soup thoroughly. Let stand at least 1 hour before serving for flavor to blend.

title: Apple Cider Molded Salad
instructions: Soak raisins in 1/2 cup apple cider. Chop apples. Prepare jello according to package directions except use apple cider instead of water chill until slightly jelled. Add chopped apples. Drain raisins and add to jello add chopped walnuts and put into jello mold. When ready to serve turn out onto a plate and garnish with white grapes.

title: Quick Rice Pudding
instructions: Make pudding as directed on package. Add pineapple Cool Whip and rice. Fluff and serve.

title: Potato Doughnuts
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar gradually then melted shortening potato and milk. Add remaining dry ingredients. Roll out 1/4 inch thick. Use donut cutter drop into hot Criso or corn oil.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Remove crust from bread; spread bread slices with butter. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and set aside. Cook sausage until browned stirring to crumble. Drain well. Spoon over bread slices; sprinkle with cheese. Combine eggs half and half and salt; mix well and pour over cheese. Cover casserole and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set. Yields 10 servings.

title: Hawaiian Dream Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to package directions. Pour on a 17 inch cookie sheet. Put drained pineapple on top of cake. Mix pudding cream cheese and milk. Pour on top of pineapple.

title: Chicken With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
instructions: Brown garlic cloves in olive oil. Add chicken; brown on both sides 10 to 12 minutes. Add broccoli florets tomatoes basil red pepper flakes white wine and chicken broth. (Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.) Cook pasta according to directions. Serve chicken and tomatoes over pasta.

title: Bachelor Buttons
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together brown sugar butter (softened) and egg. Add baking soda water and flour. Add raisins or nuts if you like. Roll cookie dough in hand (about a teaspoon per cookie) then roll in cinnamon nutmeg and sugar. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.

title: Impossible Seafood Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inches. Mix crabmeat cheeses onions and pimiento in plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 minutes in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Cream well oleo and sugar; add eggs. Beat well. Add alternately sour cream and cake flour. Add baking powder salt and vanilla; beat well. Place 1/2 mixture in tube pan. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon mixture. Add remainder of cake mixture. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Broccoli-Rice
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Mix all of the ingredients; top with grated cheese. Cook 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Drain corn reserving liquid. Add enough milk to corn liquid to make 1 cup. In a mixing bowl stir together flour corn meal baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add corn milk mixture and beaten egg. Stir just until moistened.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all together and form into one-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on paper towels.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Heat soup milk and chicken. Cook noodles according to directions on package. Add onions celery and green pepper with other ingredients and place in casserole. (Optional Add 1 small package frozen English peas before placing in oven.) Sprinkle with paprika and cheese or bread crumbs. Cook at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes. Will serve 8.

title: Hot Fudge Cake(Easy And Great!)
instructions: Bring to a boil margarine oil cocoa and water. Cool. Mix flour and sugar. Add cocoa mixture to flour mixture and stir until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan for 30 to 35 minutes or until done at 350\u00b0.

title: Deep-Dish Pizza
instructions: Cook and stir hamburger until brown. Drain. Prepare pizza dough. Mix tomatoes onion oregano 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper and garlic powder. Break up tomatoes with fork. Press dough into pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Spoon sauce onto hamburger. Top with mushrooms and cheese. Cook at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Frying Pan Beans Or Cowboy Beans
instructions: In frying pan cook bacon and onion until bacon is brown. Add pork and beans brown sugar and molasses. Bring to a boil. Reduce to simmer and cook until thickened. Tastes may vary so feel free to add catsup mustard or any ingredient you like in baked beans. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Heat 2-inch deep oil to 375\u00b0. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls into hot oil frying a few at a time until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Cheezy Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine and cheese. Add nuts sifted sugar cocoa and vanilla. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Makes a lot.

title: Cold-Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar margarine and oil together adding eggs one at a time beating with each addition. Add vanilla and lemon extracts; stir. Mix flour and baking powder together; add to mixture alternating with milk.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. While noodles are cooking saute green pepper and onion in margarine. Add soup milk sour cream olives salt pepper and chicken. Drain noodles and mix with mixture. Put mixture into a 1 1/2-quart greased baking dish. Sprinkle with parsley and almonds (may use Parmesan cheese and/or bread crumbs also). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until almonds are lightly browned.

title: White Christmas Fudge
instructions: Spread on buttered plate. Cut when cold.

title: Mary Virginia'S Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar gradually. Beat at high speed for 5 minutes. Fold in vanilla chips and pecans. Drop by teaspoon on foil-lined cookie sheet. Turn off oven and place in the oven; leave overnight or 8 hours. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Risotto (Rice With Vegetables)
instructions: Melt oleo in casserole dish. Saute onions and carrots. Add rice and saute until opaque. Add bouillon cubes bay leaf salt thyme and water. Bring to boil. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in parsley. Serves 12.

title: Salmon Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients removing bones from salmon. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered.

title: Silver White Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients and 2/3 cup of milk. Beat 2 minutes. Add remaining milk egg whites and vanilla. Beat 2 more minutes. Pour into two greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Frost with favorite frosting. Recipe makes good cupcakes.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Bake
instructions: Mix soup water celery onion and stuffing. Spoon into greased 10-inch pie plate. Place chicken on stuffing mixture. Mix margarine sugar and mustard. Spread over chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove chicken. Stir stuffing. If desired garnish with chopped fresh parsley. Serves 4. Preparation time 10 minutes; cook time 30 minutes.

title: Brandied Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In medium saucepan saute celery onion and garlic in the oil until onion is tender but not browned. Add tomatoes tomato sauce salt herbs and pepper. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Nantucket Cinnamon Toasts
instructions: In a wide shallow bowl stir together sugar and cinnamon. With one strip of bread at a time quickly coat in butter let excess drip off turn quickly in cinnamon sugar. Bake on lightly buttered baking sheet in upper third of 375\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Turn over and bake 10 minutes more. Serve warm.

title: Manicotti With Spinach
instructions: Cook manicotti as directed on package. Rinse with cold water and drain. Combine cottage cheese cream cheese egg onion salt and Parmesan cheese. Fill manicotti shells with cheese mixture. Place in lightly oiled dish. Cover with marinara sauce. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cook spinach as directed on box and spoon on top of manicotti.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Sift dry ingredients together. Reserve 1/2 cup to dredge fruit and nuts. Combine dry ingredients with creamed mixture alternately with the liquids. Add fruits and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes in a slow oven. Makes 200.

title: Butter Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Place pecans and butter in a shallow pan. When oven reaches 500\u00b0 turn it off and place pan in the oven. When oven is cool pecans are done.

title: Borsch(Beet Soup)
instructions: Make a beef bouillon with beef 1 onion 1 carrot and water. Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours making sure you have 1 quart of liquid at the end of cooking. Meanwhile chop beet 1 carrot and 1 onion into long thin pieces. Put tomato paste fresh tomato vinegar sugar and 1 cup water into a separate pan. Simmer 30 to 40 minutes. Chop potatoes and carrots and add to boiling bouillon. Cook for 10 minutes. Add done vegetables (beets etc.).

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Steam spinach until done. Place in blender with garlic parsley basil and oregano. Process until mixed not liquid. In a bowl combine wheat germ tomato sauce and tomato paste. Add spinach mixture; stir to blend. Cook noodles; add oil. Mix Ricotta cheese salt pepper and parsley. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Butter bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer first the noodles and spinach mixture then Ricotta mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan then Mozzarella. Repeat. Cover with remaining Mozzarella and tomato sauce. Bake for 30 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: In large skillet over medium heat cook onions in margarine and bacon fat 3 or 4 minutes. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Add potatoes; continue cooking stirring constantly about 2 minutes or until heated through. Do not boil. Add parsley and bacon. Cook about 1 minute longer.

title: Chocolate Mousse(Serves 15)
instructions: Warm eggs to room temperature (at least 1 hour). Separate eggs. Melt chocolate and butter in double boiler stirring constantly as it has a tendency to become grainy or lumpy. Remove from heat and add egg yolks one at a time. Mix until just smooth and let sit. Beat whites until very stiff. Fold into chocolate mixture using wire whisk until very foamy and fluffy. Put this into the bowl you wish to serve it in and chill. Make this at least one day ahead preferably 2 days.

title: Crunchy Apple Salad
instructions: Place apples bananas and lemon juice in bowl and toss. Add pineapple raisins and nuts. Toss slightly. Add mayonnaise. Toss just until mayonnaise is mixed thoroughly.

title: Potato Pancakes(Potetpannekaker)
instructions: As potatoes are grated add milk at once to keep them from discoloring. Add remaining ingredients. Drop spoonfuls on hot greased skillet and fry to golden brown on both sides. Reduce heat after they are browned and cook until potatoes are done. Good with pork sausages.

title: Chicken Almond
instructions: Mix all but potato chips. Put in large baking dish. Refrigerate overnight.

title: California Sweet Potato Bake
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender. Drain. Peel and halve lengthwise. Arrange in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Mix brown sugar cornstarch and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Blend in orange juice. Add raisins. Stir while bringing to a boil. Add remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over potatoes. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Ranch Snack
instructions: In a large bowl mix crackers and salad oil. Combine dry dressing mix dill weed and garlic powder in a large brown paper bag. Add crackers to mix in bag and shake. Place in airtight container for at least 4 hours.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Water Chestnuts
instructions: Combine sugar and catsup. Wrap each whole chestnut with 1/2 slice of bacon and secure with a toothpick. Pour catsup mixture over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Rice Pudding
instructions: Add sugar to cooked rice. In medium saucepan combine dessert mix and milk. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Stir in rice mixture and raisins. Let cool stirring occasionally. Pour into 6 dessert cups. Refrigerate until firm. Garnish with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Mix together sour cream and the remaining 7 ingredients. Marinate chicken breasts in the mixture refrigerated overnight. Roll chicken in bread crumbs. Place in a 2-inch deep baking dish. Melt 1/2 cup margarine and 1/2 cup Crisco. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven. Drain and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Cranberry-Cherry Relish(Chutney-Like Condiment)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cranberries in heavy large saucepan. Bring mixture to boil over medium heat stirring frequently. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Add cranberries and simmer until they begin to pop about 5 minutes more. Remove cinnamon stick. Cover and refrigerate until cold. Can be prepared 1 week ahead of time. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Pimiento Cheese
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl; stir in cheeses. Stir in chopped pepper. Store in the refrigerator. Yield About 4 cups.

title: Ham And Eggs Au Gratin
instructions: Cook onion in butter until tender but not browned. Blend in flour and salt; cook until bubbly. Add milk; cook stirring constantly until melted. Add eggs potatoes ham and parsley. Pour into 1 1/2 or 2-quart baking dish; top with remaining cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Garnish with additional egg slices. Yields 6 servings.

title: Brownies
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Melt chocolate and margarine over hot water. Combine sugar eggs and vanilla in mixing bowl. Cream 1 1/2 minutes. Add cooled chocolate mixture and flour mixture. Blend good. Add nuts; pour into 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Baked Haddock
instructions: Place Haddock blocks into a 9 x 13 pan. Spread mayonnaise on top of each block. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Add to bottom of pan 2 Tbsp of butter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients except apples cinnamon and the 5 tablespoons sugar in a large bowl. Mix well. In another bowl mix apples cinnamon and 5 tablespoons sugar. Put in tube pan (greased and floured) a layer of batter 1 layer of apples. Repeat ending with apples on top. (Nuts may be added to last layer of apples.) Bake approximately 1 3/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Cupcakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dry ingredients. Mix egg shortening buttermilk and vanilla; add to dry ingredients. Beat on low speed for 1 minute then on high speed for 3 minutes. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. (Muffin tins lined with cupcake papers work the best.) Bake approximately 15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Top with Chocolate Frosting.

title: Fruit Cake Saltine Muffins
instructions: Mix together thoroughly. Press into greased muffin tins. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 until brown about 30 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Cook cake as directed on package in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put ingredients in blender. Mix and serve. Serves 6. Excellent for a Sunday Brunch!

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Make coloring paste by mixing red food coloring with cocoa. Set aside. Cream Crisco with sugar. Add eggs and coloring paste and beat 10 minutes. Mix in buttermilk slowly. Add flour and salt. Add vanilla and mix well. Stir (with a spoon) in separately vinegar and soda. Mix well and bake in 3 well-greased and floured 8-inch pans 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Turkey Dressing(For 20 Pound Bird)
instructions: Put giblets in pressure cooker with 1 1/2 cups water. Cook 15 minutes at 15 pounds pressure (or simmer until tender). Remove bones. Grind giblets. Cool. Save liquid.

title: Barb'S Pumpkin Delite
instructions: Mix the pumpkin eggs milk sugar and spices in a large bowl. Pour into a greased 9x13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix over the pumpkin mixture. Melt the butter and drizzle this over the cake mix. Top with pecans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Mrs. Gardner'S Strawberry Cake
instructions: Break cake into bite size pieces. Layer cake in bottom of punch bowl. Spread strawberry glaze over cake. Mix Cool Whip sour cream and confectioners sugar together. Spread some over glaze. Alternate cake glaze and Cool Whip mixture. Top with fresh sliced strawberries if desired. Refrigerate.

title: Vegetable Stock *
instructions: Save in a large Ziploc bag. When large Ziploc bag is full of vegetable scraps in your freezer its time to make stock. Place scraps in large stock pot and fill with water. Add spices and simmer 30 to 60 minutes. Strain once through colander and once through finer strainer to remove all solids. Freeze in ice trays and transfer to Ziploc bag for convenient small amounts.

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring butter sugar cocoa and milk to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla peanut butter and oatmeal. Spoon out on wax paper and let harden. Ready to serve in minutes.

title: English Muffin Bread
instructions: Combine 3 cups flour yeast sugar salt and soda. Heat milk and water until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0) and add to dry ingredients beating well. Add 1 cup whole wheat flour and then add remaining 2 to 3 cups flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon or spatula into 2 loaf pans that have been greased with Crisco and lightly sprinkled with cornmeal. Then sprinkle cornmeal on top of the loaves. Let rise in a warm place about 30 minutes or until dough is near the top of the baking pans. Bake 22 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Polynesian Shrimp Curry
instructions: Combine milk and coconut in small saucepan; bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Strain mixture; set milk and coconut aside. Peel and devein shrimp. Saute shrimp and pineapple chunks in 1/4 cup butter in large skillet 3 to 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink stirring frequently. Drain shrimp mixture and discard liquid. Set shrimp mixture aside. Combine remaining 1/4 cup butter and curry powder in large skillet; cook over low heat stirring constantly 2 minutes. Add green onions and celery; cook stirring constantly until crisp-tender. Combine flour and garlic salt; add to onion mixture. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add reserved coconut milk and chicken broth; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Stir in shrimp mixture and reserved coconut. Serve over rice. Yield 4 servings.

title: Tuna Log
instructions: Beat tuna and cream cheese together. Add grated onion and salt. Shape into log. Wrap with\tplastic wrap and chill in refrigerator until firm. Roll in\tpecans. Store tightly covered in refrigerator. Serve with crackers.

title: Chicken Ala Diana
instructions: Cut chicken in strips. Combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Dip chicken in scrambled egg and then bread crumb mixture. Fry chicken; brown. Layer chicken and Muenster cheese and pour bouillon cube over. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0; turn often.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: In bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan place chicken pieces to line pan. Add grated Cheddar cheese and spread over chicken. Add cream of mushroom soup (chicken) mixed with white wine or milk. Next put Stove Top dressing mixed with melted butter as per instructions on box. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes until chicken is tender.

title: Pig Pickin' Cake
instructions: Beat thoroughly together (makes 4 layers). Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Cool completely.

title: Chicken Grape Salad
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch chunks. Toss chicken celery and grapes in large bowl. Season with thyme garlic powder salt and pepper. Mix in mayonnaise. Refrigerate covered at least 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cream mayonnaise and cream cheese together. Mix the envelope of soup mix (shake back and forth to get good mix for dip). Blend soup mix into cream cheese and mayonnaise. Fold in shrimp gently. Keep covered in fridge. Serve with Fritos or potato chips.

title: Magic Cookie Bars(Makes 24 To 36 Bars.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients; press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: In a large casserole dish layer cooked rice then sausage and onions then mushrooms. Cover with grated cheese. Mix soup and eggs in bowl and pour over layered ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 10 people (or 6 hungry people!).

title: The Best Brownies
instructions: Blend oil sugar and vanilla in bowl. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt; add to egg mixture and blend well. Add nuts. Spread in 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brownies pull from edge of pan. Cool in pan.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Stir in the hot jello and break apart with fork while stirring. Add nuts and pineapple. Pour into rectangular dish. Congeal. When set spread with sour cream if desired. Cut into squares and serve as dessert or on lettuce as a salad.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and milk in saucepan. Fold in tuna peas and macaroni. Sprinkle potato chips on top. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding and eggs and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine brown sugar pecans and butterscotch chips and sprinkle over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Smoked Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cheese and mix with 2 packages of fine-cut beef onion Accent and sauce. Roll on remaining package of cut beef. Can be divided to make 2 balls. Chill.

title: Lasagna Rolls(No Fat)
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles drain and cool. Mix low-fat Ricotta cheese or light spinach pepper and Parmesan cheese. Spray casserole with Pam. Spread spinach on noodles and roll up and cut in half. Put ruffled edges up and line in dish then pour sauce over the noodles and bake uncovered 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 18 rolls. Serve with vegetable and salad.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oil in the blender until well blended. Add oil. Blend. Chill and serve with favorite salad.

title: Candy Bar Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes then line with candy bars. Cream sugar and cream cheese. Add eggs sour cream and peanut butter; pour over candy. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Melt chocolate chips and whipping cream over low heat. Drizzle over warm pie.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add zucchini oil sugar vanilla and cinnamon. Sift dry ingredients and add to zucchini mixture. Stir in nuts. Mix well. Bake in two greased and floured loaf pans for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Peach Pickles
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil except peaches. Drop in a few peaches at a time until fork will prick peach easily. Pack and fill jars. Process 20 minutes in boiling water bath.

title: Divinity
instructions: Place in large pan sugar Karo water and salt; stir until dissolved and it reaches boiling point. Cover with lid and boil for 2 minutes. Uncover and cook to hard boil stage. Meanwhile beat 3 egg whites. Slowly pour hot syrup over beaten egg whites beating constantly until cool and holds shape. Add vanilla walnuts and coconut. Drop in greased buttered candy board or pour out on board and cut when cool.

title: Crunchy Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown meat and onion in oleo leaving meat in chunks. Spread in a shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine soup milk salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Fold in partially frozen peas celery and pimiento. Pour over meat mixture. Edge top of casserole with potato chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Soda Punch
instructions: Mix equal parts of all sodas. Make ice mold of ginger ale and fruit slices of your choice.

title: Microwave Brittle
instructions: Combine in heatproof measuring bowl (2-quart) first 4 ingredients. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir; microwave for 4 more minutes. Stir in next 2 ingredients. Microwave for 1 minute. Remove from oven; add baking soda. Stir quickly and pour onto a buttered surface cookie sheet or counter. Cool; then break into pieces.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Step One Combine soup mayonnaise celery lemon juice and hard-boiled eggs then combine chicken rice and almonds.

title: Quick Heavenly Hash
instructions: Combine fruit cocktail coconut sour cream and sugar in a bowl. Mix well. Chill for 15 to 30 minutes before serving.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 2 large loaf pans. Mix dry ingredients. Gradually add moist ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Linda'S Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Heat butterscotch chips and butter in a double boiler stirring until smooth. Add pecans and shoestring potatoes or chow mein noodles. Stir well. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Place in refrigerator to harden. Keep in covered container.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and cap mushrooms. Use stems for another sauce or gravy; you do not use them. Stuff the caps with the ground sausage. Sprinkle with bread crumbs then the cheese. Place in middle of oven and broil for 10 to 15 minutes until meat is brown. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Dijon
instructions: Remove skin from chicken and dry thoroughly. Mix mustard and butter. Brush on chicken. Place chicken pieces in a baking dish (meatier parts toward edge of dish).
