Season lightly with salt and pepper. Cover with wax paper. Cook in microwave for 18 to 20 minutes or until chicken is done. Turn chicken pieces and rotate dish 1/2 turn after nine or ten minutes of cooking. Let stand covered for five minutes. Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

title: Decorator Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients except food coloring in a mixing bowl; beat on low speed until blended; beat on high speed for 5 minutes or until light and fluffy. Color as desired with food coloring.

title: Shrimp Noodle Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients together except 1/4 cup chow mein noodles. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle 1/4 cup noodles on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Makes approximately 3 servings.

title: Witches Brew
instructions: Soften cream cheese Remove from foil wrapper and place on plate. Heat 8 ounces for 15 seconds on full power. Add 10 seconds at a time until softened as desired.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts together thoroughly shaping into ball. Chill several hours after. Roll into nuts until covered.

title: Brunch Bake
instructions: Stir together salt eggs dry mustard and milk. Tear bread into chunks and add to mixture. Add cheese and bacon. Stir together. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 in an 8 or 9-inch square pan. For a nice change you can add mushrooms and broccoli. May be prepared the night before.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Drain oysters and reserve liquid. In baking dish stir cracker crumbs salt and butter. Stir until moist. Take half of mixture out and put into bowl. Press remaining half in the pan. Cover with 1/2 of the oysters. Sprinkle pepper over oysters then cover with remaining half of crumb mixture and the rest of the oysters. Combine cream oyster liquid and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over dish. Sprinkle with a few whole oyster crackers and dot with butter. Garnish with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Make sauce. Melt butter in large saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in flour 3 teaspoons salt and the nutmeg until smooth. Gradually add milk and turkey stock; bring to boiling stirring constantly; boil 2 minutes or until slightly thickened.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon grease and 1 tablespoon cornmeal just until blended. Heat bacon grease and 1 tablespoon cornmeal in cast-iron (10-inch) skillet until very hot. Pour in batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Easy Chocolate Candy
instructions: Heat chocolate bits and milk; stir over low heat until chocolate melts. Remove from heat; stir in confectioners sugar and chopped nuts. Chill. Form into 1-inch balls and roll in finely chopped nuts coconut or dipping chocolate.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar eggs vanilla and butter. Sift together flour soda cinnamon salt and nutmeg. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture. Add apples nuts and raisins. Mix well. Spread mixture into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Chilled Mexican Appetizer
instructions: Combine bean dip tomato paste and\tgreen chilies; spread mixture in a 12-inch round platter with sides. Combine chopped avocados tomatoes and lemon juice; toss and arrange evenly over the bean mixture; set aside. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix; spoon over avocado mixture. Combine green pepper green onions and ripe olives; sprinkle over sour cream layer. Top with cheese. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips. Yields 12 cups.

title: Cheese Frosted Sandwiches
instructions: Combine chicken boiled eggs olives and mayonnaise. Make 8 sandwiches with 3 slices of bread to each sandwich. Beat cheese raw egg and butter until fluffy. Frost tops and sides of sandwiches with cheese mixture. Make at least 24 hours in advance. Can be made several days ahead and refrigerated. Before serving heat for 15 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven that has been preheated. Cut each sandwich into quarters.

title: Potato Bake
instructions: In large bowl combine eggs bread crumbs onions milk pepper and salt. Drain potatoes and stir into egg mixture. Add half of Cheddar cheese and half of bacon. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 8-inch square casserole. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven 20 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bacon; bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
instructions: *Place head of cabbage in boiling water; cover. Remove from heat and let stand until the leaves are limp (about 10 minutes). Remove from water. Cut around stem end of cabbage to remove leaves; drain. Pour 1/2 cup tomato sauce in bottom of ungreased 10 x 13-inch casserole dish.

title: Quick Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook onion until tender in oil. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes. Makes 3 cups.

title: Play Dough For Children
instructions: Mix the flour and alum in a large bowl. Cook water salt and oil to boiling. Stir liquid into dry ingredients. Knead until smooth. Divide and knead in desired colors. Store in airtight container. Not to be eaten.

title: Macadamia Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl cream butter shortening and sugars until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat until smooth. Add dry ingredients. Mix until a soft dough forms. Stir in white chocolate and macadamia nuts. Drop teaspoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown. Transfer to wire rack to cool.

title: Egg-Sausage Casserole
instructions: Select center cut slices from an 18 month old ham (a 2 year old ham is even better). Slice ham about 1/4 inch thick; trim off skin. Place slices in ungreased hot skillet and fry quickly on both sides. Remove ham to hot platter and make a red eye gravy out of drippings by adding 4 tablespoons black coffee to skillet. Let it sizzle up and pour over ham. Serve with grits!

title: Potato Cake With Peanut Butter Frosting
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening in mixing bowl. Stir in potatoes then egg yolks. Sift in flour cocoa baking powder cinnamon and nutmeg; add milk. Without prior beating beat in egg whites. Continue beating well for at least 5 minutes or until batter is smooth. Grease 3 (9-inch) layer pans. Turn mixture evenly into 3 pans and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until done. While cakes are cooling on wire rack make Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Crumble crackers in buttered 8 x 12-inch casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over crackers and top with bacon bits. Bake 20 minutes. Serves 6 or 7. Can easily be halved.

title: Rio Grande Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 37 5\u00b0. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. With moistened hands shape into loaf and place in a shallow baking dish. Bake for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops With Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit reserving juice. Moisten chops in 1/4 cup juice and coat with Shake n Bake as directed. Arrange chops in single layer in shallow baking dish; bake for 40 minutes at 425\u00b0. Combine 1/2 cup juice brown sugar catsup and vinegar. Heat through. Put fruit on chops and brush with syrup. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Add everything else plus 1/2 can of water (tomato paste can). Rinse each can to make the 1/2 can water. Simmer about 2 or 3 hours.

title: Original Banana Pudding(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: Reserve 1 banana and 10 to 12 Nilla wafers for garnish.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks thoroughly. Add milk; beat again. Sift flour with salt and 1 cup sugar; add to egg mixture. Cook until thick. Add butter; let cool. Add vanilla and coconut.

title: Korean Barbecued Beef Short Ribs
instructions: With bone side down make a lengthwise cut in each piece cutting beef halfway to bone. Cut crosswise at 1/2-inch intervals. Meat will look like a fan. Combine remaining ingredients in a blender. Pour sauce over meat before broiling. Place on hot grill and brown on all four sides. Cook until brown and crusty.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Bake your potatoes in the microwave or oven. Slice potatoes in half. Scoop out pulp keeping skins intact. Mash pulp in a medium bowl. Mix all other ingredients with pulp. Spoon potato mixture into shell of the potato. Sprinkle with cheese. Then bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Heat liquid then add meat. When hot serve.

title: Bonbons
instructions: Pour molasses into a mixing bowl. Stir in dry milk and graham cracker crumbs. Mix together with hands until candy holds together. Shape into little balls and roll in chocolate sprinkles coconut nuts or graham cracker crumbs.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add sour cream. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture. Add extracts. Pour into prepared tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan.

title: Polish Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef with chopped onion. Drain well. Layer 1/2 in casserole dish. Top with drained sauerkraut. Top with other half of meat and onion. Sprinkle egg noodles on top (uncooked). Combine soups and milk and spread over mixture. Cover and cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour. Uncover. Sprinkle with 1/2 to 3/4 cup shredded cheese and cook for another 1/2 hour.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar well. Add oil zucchini and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Put into a greased loaf pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Crescent-Veggie Bar
instructions: Pat crescent dough in flat layer in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Cool. Beat cream cheese dressing mix and mayonnaise until smooth and spread over cooled dough. Chop vegetables and spread evenly over dough. Cover with grated cheese cut into squares and serve.

title: Helen'S Good Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together flour powder and salt then set aside. Cream Crisco and sugar then add lightly beaten eggs. Start adding flour mixture then 1/2 cup milk nuts more flour then the rest of the milk. (You stir this until blended.) Pour into greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. (Makes 1 big heavy loaf.) Best when served with butter.

title: Potatoes In Beer(Low-Fat Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Use a 3-quart deep casserole to prevent boil over. Coat dish with spray shortening. Cover bottom with 1/3 potatoes. Top with 1/2 onion. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons flour and 1/3 cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Continue layering as before. Top with remaining potatoes and cheese. Pour beer down sides of dish so as not to disturb layers. Cover; bake 45 minutes. Remove cover; bake another 20 minutes or until cheese is light brown on top. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Spray foiled lined pan or baking dish with vegetable spray. Place floured small pieces skin down in center of dish. Larger (floured) pieces outside. Cover tightly with foil. Bake about 1 hour turning about halfway through baking time with tongs. Bake at 350\u00b0 longer cooking time for larger fryer.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Soften cheese spread in bottom of glass pie dish. Pour can of chili on cheese spread. Add Cheddar cheese. Microwave until cheese melts. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Melt 24 Kraft caramels in 1/3 cup of hot water. Cool. Mix with 8 ounces sour cream and 12 ounces Cool Whip.\tPut in crumb crust and freeze.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Drain cherries and set aside. Drain pineapple and save juice. In a medium size bowl place a layer of oranges then coconut. Sprinkle some sugar then a layer of pineapple. Sprinkle with cherry halves. Layer of coconut then oranges and so forth until bowl is full. Pour saved juice on top and chill. Serve.

title: Sandy Gustafson'S Ham And Cheese Chowder
instructions: Combine water vegetables and seasoning. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Do not drain. Make white sauce of flour butter and milk. Add Cheddar cheese and stir until melted. Add ham and undrained vegetables. Heat but do not boil.

title: Hot Or Cold Chicken 'N Pasta
instructions: In large bowl mix mayonnaise buttermilk cheese and basil. Mix in chicken pasta and vegetables. Chill at least one hour before serving.

title: Garden Medley Soup
instructions: Heat broth and add vegetables. Cook until veggies are soft. Add Ro-Tel and cheese and cook until cheese is melted.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar cornstarch and water. Cook on medium heat stirring constantly until thick and clear. Then add the lemon juice salt and jello and stir to mix. Chill until thick. Place strawberries in pie shell and pour partially set jello mixture over berries. Chill several hours or overnight. Top with Cool Whip when serving.

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add mixture to Quick Mix and form a stiff dough that can be removed from mixing bowl in a single lump. Place dough on lightly floured surface and knead briefly using extra flour to keep dough from sticking to fingers or board. Pat dough out onto a pizza pan. Add pizza sauce and desired toppings and bake at 425\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Crisp Apple Dessert
instructions: Put apple slices into pie pan. Pour cinnamon and water over apples. Prepare crumb topping by mixing together softened butter sugar and flour. Sprinkle crumbs over apples and bake at 350\u00b0 until crispy about 30 minutes.

title: Fried Cookies
instructions: Combine in heavy pan the butter sugar dates and eggs. Cook until well mixed and darker in color. Cool and add vanilla and Rice Krispies. Grease hands and form into balls about the size of a walnut. Roll in coconut or nuts.

title: Baby Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in 1 quart saucepan with the apple juice and honey. Bring to a boil and simmer for about 20-25 minutes or until carrots are soft. Serves 6.

title: Ginger-Lime Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken and pat dry. Place it and other ingredients in large bowl. Stir and make sure chicken is entirely covered by marinade. Let sit at room temperature for 2 hours or in refrigerator for 4. Grill over hot coals about 5 minutes per side.

title: Colene'S Chicken And Gravy
instructions: Roll chicken in flour. Heat shortening in a large skillet. Fry chicken until done. Mix soup milk and soy sauce together. Pour over chicken in skillet. Simmer for about 45 minutes to 1 hour or until chicken is tender.

title: Sweet Peanut Treats
instructions: In the top of a double boiler over simmering water melt chocolate chips butterscotch chips and peanut butter; stir until smooth. Spread half into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Chill until firm.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat over 350\u00b0. Quarter the biscuits. Mix sugar and cinnamon in a Ziploc bag. Put biscuit quarters in Ziploc bag with cinnamon and sugar mixture and roll till coated. Grease a bundt pan with shortening. Put coated biscuit quarters in pan. Melt oleo; add brown sugar and water. Boil 2 minutes pour over biscuits. Bake 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fudge
instructions: Add to the above mixture. Stir to blend. Pour mixture into a flat pan. Cool to set.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in bacon drippings. Add soup and milk. Combine rice and broccoli. Mix both mixtures together. Put in baking dish and cover with cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes in ungreased muffin pan.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken. Debone and cut in small pieces. Mix soup poppy seed and sour cream together. Mix with chicken. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle crumbled crackers on top. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0. (This dish may be made ahead and refrigerated; bake when needed.)

title: Corn Sausage Chowder(Soup)
instructions: In Dutch oven or kettle cook sausage and onion until sausage is brown and onion is tender; drain on paper towel. Return sausage and onion to Dutch oven with potato salt marjoram pepper and water. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer just until potato is tender about 15 minutes. Add cream-style corn whole kernel corn and evaporated milk. Heat through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Daffodil Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot pineapple juice. Put 2 cups cold orange juice with juices. When starts to congeal beat in Cool Whip. Place in bowl.

title: Crock-Pot Pork Chops
instructions: Wash pork chops. Place crock-pot temperature on high. Put pork chops in first. Add water and pineapple. Put a slice of pineapple on each pork chop. Cook until tender. Delicious.

title: Miniature Cheesecakes
instructions: Place foil cupcake liners in muffin pan. Place vanilla wafer or gingersnap in bottom of each liner.

title: Homemade Soft Pretzels
instructions: In a large bowl place 1/8 cup hot water from tap. Add yeast and stir until dissolved. Add warm water and brown sugar. Stir until dissolved. Add flour until dough does not stick to sides of bowl. Place dough on a floured surface and knead until smooth. Pinch off dough the size of a golf ball and roll into a rope approximately 10 inches long. Form into shape of pretzel and place on a floured surface. Prepare cookie sheets sprayed with Pam. Fill frying pan with water. For every cup of water add 1 tablespoon of baking soda. Bring water to a slow boil. Place pretzels into slowly boiling water for approximately 30 seconds. Place pretzels on cookie sheet and salt with Kosher salt. Bake at 475\u00b0 just until golden brown. Pretzels are best if eaten right away. They can be frozen after the frying pan step and baked from frozen at a later date.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Cut mushrooms into 1/8-inch slices. Mix mushrooms and lemon juice in 1 1/2-quart bowl. Stir in oil 1/4 cup parsley salt pepper onions and garlic; toss. Cover and refrigerate stirring occasionally at least 3 hours. Garnish with parsley before serving.

title: Chicken In White Wine Sauce
instructions: Heat large skillet. Add margarine. Brown chicken pieces then remove to large casserole dish. Rub flour into fat in pan. Slowly add chicken broth and white wine. Add onions and carrots. Cook about 10 minutes. Pour over chicken in casserole. Add a large bay leaf salt and pepper. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 1 hour. Serve with rice or buttered egg noodles. Remove bay leaf before serving. Beer may be substituted for wine.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda baking powder salt cinnamon and nuts; set aside. Beat eggs lightly in mixing bowl. Add sugar and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients stirring only until moistened. Spoon batter into baking pans greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Turn out on rack. Cool completely.

title: Tuna Burgers
instructions: Mix all together. Shape into patties. If needed add extra oats. Cook in hot skillet in small amount of butter. Brown on both sides. Makes 3 patties.

title: Crackling Cornbread
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Mix well with the cracklings. Add milk and beaten egg. Mix well. Put in greased pan. Bake in hot oven 25 minutes.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Prepare Italian dressing as directed on package. Slice onion in thin slices and separate slices. In a pint size jar alternate layers of mushrooms and onions and sprinkle with garlic powder. Pour Italian dressing over the mushroom/onion mixture and refrigerate at least 8 hours. Shake often to mix spices. Makes one pint jar.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cook broccoli individually with 2 tablespoons water for 8 minutes in microwave. Set aside and cool. Take stick of butter celery and onion and cook in microwave for 4 to 5 minutes. Take butter celery and onion mixture and add cut up cubes of cheese roll and mushroom soup. Mix up and add broccoli. Heat in microwave for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Cream shortening and cream cheese gradually adding sugar. Beat well until light and fluffy. Add egg and almond extract beating well. Combine flour soda and salt; add to cream cheese mixture and beat well. Chill about 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in pecans. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; press 1/2 cherry into center of each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top with powdered sugar glaze if desired.

title: Fruity Chicken Risotto
instructions: Heat oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat. Cook mushrooms onion and bacon in oil over medium heat 10 minutes stirring occasionally until vegetables are tender. Stir in rice; cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in water soy sauce and bouillon. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Souper Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Blend soup milk and pepper to make sauce. In a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole arrange in alternate layers the potatoes onion and sauce. Dot top with butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Delicious Salmon Loaf
instructions: Pour salmon and juice into a bowl. Add milk and bread crumbs. Mix well. Add egg onion salt and chili powder. Mix. Pour into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes until center is firm.

title: Triple Layer Bars
instructions: Line a 9-inch square pan with graham crackers (spray first). Mix sugar milk and margarine; bring to a boil. Add crushed vanilla wafers. Pour over graham crackers. Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips together; spread over this. Sprinkle pecans over top. Cool on counter.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese and oleo. Add sugar slowly. Add one egg and a small amount of flour until all 6 eggs and flour are mixed in. Add flavorings. Bake in tube pan greased and floured at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes. Baking time is very important.

title: Rainbow Salad
instructions: Boil noodles until done. Drain. Whisk oil vinegar salt black pepper and paprika until well blended in large bowl. Add noodles and remaining ingredients. Toss gently until well blended. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Toss gently before serving.

title: Variable Vegetable Strata
instructions: Cut bread into 1/2-inch cubes. Sprinkle half of the cubes into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle vegetables and cheese over cubes. Top with remaining cubes. Blend together eggs soup milk and seasonings. Pour egg mixture over bread-vegetable mixture. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown about 50 minutes.

title: Summer Strawberry Soup
instructions: In a 1-quart saucepan bring wine and ginger to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Add heavy cream. Return to boiling and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat.

title: Turkey Brunswick Stew
instructions: Combine in saucepan the broth tomatoes with liquid lima beans corn onion ginger bouillon cubes and pepper. Heat to boiling; cover and simmer for 30 minutes stirring as needed. Add turkey and cook another half hour.

title: Mom'S Homemade Brown Sugar Candy
instructions: Combine sugar flour and butter in a large saucepan. Gradually add milk and mix thoroughly. Bring this to a boil without stirring unless it is sticking. Reduce heat to medium and continue to boil until a small amount of mixture forms a soft ball when dropped into cold water. Remove from heat place in a pan of cold water to cool. When cool enough candy should have a grain to it. Add vanilla then beat until candy begins to thicken. Quickly add nuts and scoop candy into a buttered 9 x 13-inch cake pan and spread around. Cut when cooled.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix well serve over ice.

title: Charmaine'S Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix in dishpan or roaster in order given. Drop by ice cream scoop 6 cookies to a tray or less and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Do not overbake. (Recipe does not call for flour.)

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine cream cheese and Cheddar cheese mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Add all remaining ingredients except pecans. Mix well. Chill. Shape into ball; roll in pecans.

title: Granola
instructions: Heat and combine honey and vegetable oil. Pour slowly over remaining ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 3 minutes. Keep an eye on it!

title: Linda'S Banana Dessert
instructions: Combine in bowl the flour margarine and nuts. Press in bottom of 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes; cool.

title: Trifle
instructions: In a large trifle bowl cover bottom and sides with pound cake soak with sherry and add fruit. Make up jello according to directions. Pour over fruit until covered (use leftover for kids). Put in fridge to harden. Make up custard omitting 1 cup of milk. Pour in bowl cover with plastic wrap and put in fridge for 1 hour. Take out of bowl mix custard pour over jello and let settle. Top with whipped cream.

title: Pepernota Pizza
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in 1 tablespoon olive oil until lightly browned. Set aside. In another frypan saute peppers wine vinegar pepper and salt if desired until tender. Spread pizza sauce on pizza crust then onions then peppers. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 8 to 10 minutes for prebaked pizza crust 25 minutes for fresh pizza dough.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Cook hen; chop and set aside. Mix next 8 ingredients in saucepan and boil. Combine cornstarch with enough water to make paste and add to vegetables; boil 1 minute. Add chicken and cream of chicken soup to vegetable mixture. Add water if needed. Serve over rice and top with onion rings. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix in greased casserole dish all ingredients except the crumbs; sprinkle them on top and bake until brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Blend together in blender all the ingredients and pour into casserole. Microwave 6 minutes at full power. Serve immediately with corn sticks or crackers.

title: Old Fashioned Peach Cake
instructions: Combine until crumbly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Round Steak Marinade
instructions: Cut meat into bite-sized strips. Place in airtight plastic container. Pour remaining ingredients over top. Mix thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight. Cook over campfire or under broiler.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Mix together hamburger rice salt pepper and onion and form into meatballs. Mix together 1 can soup 1 can water and chili powder to taste. Pour over meatballs and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Food Process Put in bowl the cranberries (soak overnight or at least 2 hours in sugar) celery apple and nuts. Mix. Set aside. Make up jello (may use any red flavor) with juice of cranberries (about 1/2 cup) and orange juice instead of cold water. Make jello by package but using juices to substitute cold water. Mix all ingredients. Pour into jello mold sprayed with Pam oil spray. Set overnight.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown hamburger. When meat is cooled add other ingredients and mix lightly. If too dry to spread add small amount of tomato juice. Spread on butter buns. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Macaroni, Tomato And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Boil macaroni according to box directions. Grate cheese; divide into thirds. Drain canned tomatoes; save juice. Chop tomatoes into bite size pieces. In bottom of 2-quart casserole dish layer 1/2 of chopped tomatoes then 1/3 of cheese and 1/2 of cooked macaroni. Repeat tomatoes cheese and macaroni. Pour juice over top of last layer of macaroni. Top with remaining cheese. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Baked Raisin Cake
instructions: Boil raisins first and let cool. Use 1 cup of raisin water. Cream sugar and butter together. Add beaten eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with raisin water. Add cooled raisins. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Tara'S Favorite Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars together. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients. Add raisins last. Bake for 9 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and flour in large bowl. In saucepan mix cocoa margarine and water mixture to a boil. Add this mixture to the sugar and flour. Mix well. Add beaten eggs buttermilk and vanilla and continue to mix well. Add soda last. Pour all into 16-inch pan and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. This recipe will serve 10 people.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in greased 9-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until top is brown and crusty about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour cinnamon and allspice. Add wet ingredients and stir until well blended. Stir in oatmeal and raisins. Add nuts. Drop by teaspoons and bake slowly at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: For first layer cook noodles and drain. For second layer brown beef. Add spices onion water and tomato sauce. For third layer cover with pepperoni. For fourth layer cover with cheese. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine self-rising corn meal sugar and onion in bowl. Add milk and egg to dry ingredients stirring to combine. Drop by heaping teaspoonful into hot deep fat (375\u00b0) frying only a few at a time. Fry until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Hot Pizza Dip
instructions: In a bowl combine cream cheese Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Spread on bottom of greased 9-inch pie plate. Combine cheeses. Sprinkle half over the cream cheese layer. Top with the pizza sauce and peppers. Sprinkle with the remaining cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve warm with tortilla chips or bread sticks. Yield About 3 1/2 cups.

title: Teriyaki Beef Broil
instructions: Partially freeze steak slice diagonally across grain into 1/4-inch strips. Place steak in shallow container with soy sauce vegetable oil molasses ginger mustard and garlic. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Thread steak on 9-inch bamboo skewers. Place skewers on lightly greased rack in a broiler pan. Broil 4-inches from heat for 6 to 7 minutes turning once.

title: Herbed Pot Roast
instructions: Heat frying pan. Add meat and brown on all sides. Season with salt and pepper. Put onion slices on top of meat; add wine and rest of ingredients. If desired add peeled halved potatoes small peeled whole onions and carrots cut diagonally in 2-inch pieces during last hour of cooking. Make gravy using 1/2 cup dry wine to replace 1/2 cup of liquid. Serves 6.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix sugar margarine and milk in a saucepan and boil 10 minutes. Add marshmallow cream and peanut butter. Mix well. Pour into greased pan and chill.

title: Quick Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients until completely mixed. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Melt butter in bottom of pan. Pour batter over butter; pour pears and the juice (with water added) over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Sift flour sugar and salt together. Add to yeast; add shortening. Stir well and roll out on a floured board. Cut with a biscuit cutter. Let rise 1 hour. Bake in a hot 375\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Jim'S Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes or just scrub and rinse. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting through. Put potatoes in baking dish; fan slightly. Sprinkle with salt butter and herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake potatoes for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly brown cheese is melted and potatoes are soft inside. Serve with bacon bits.

title: My Mother-In-Law'S Favorite Dessert
instructions: Cook tapioca in hot water (you may soak overnight) with salt in top of double boiler until transparent. Add dates brown sugar flavoring and nuts. Cool in refrigerator. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Raisin Squares
instructions: Mix ingredients together; add cooked raisins. Spread on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Ice while still warm with powdered sugar icing.

title: Tomato Soup Florentine
instructions: Cut tomatoes in chunks; takes 5 to 6 large fresh tomatoes. Remove cores and stew them over medium heat without adding water for 15 to 20 minutes. In a saucepan cook the onion and garlic in the butter with salt and pepper until onion is translucent. Add herbs and saute a few more minutes. Add cooked tomatoes sherry and honey. Cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes. Add fresh chopped spinach for last 10 minutes of cooking time. Serve with warm French bread.

title: Western Pralines
instructions: In large (3 1/2 quart) heavy saucepan combine sugar soda buttermilk and salt. Cook over high heat for about 5 minutes or to 210\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Stir often and scrape bottom of pan. Mixture will foam up! Add butter and pecans. Over medium heat continue cooking stirring constantly and scraping bottom and sides of pan until candy reaches soft ball stage (234\u00b0). Remove from heat and cool slightly only 2 minutes. Beat with spoon until thick and creamy. Drop from tablespoon onto waxed paper or foil. Let cool. Makes about 20.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Blend sugar and margarine; add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla and mashed bananas. Add flour and soda. Bake for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes one dozen.

title: Brown Edge Wafers
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add other ingredients. Beat by hand. Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0. Watch carefully. Done when edge of cookie is slightly browned. Makes about 35.

title: Caramel Pudding
instructions: Combine ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Boil over low heat until mixture is thick stirring constantly. Place in a dish alternately with pecans and vanilla wafers. Yield 4 to 5 servings.

title: Grandmother'S Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and spices. Mix butter and applesauce. Add to sugar mixture. Mix soda and flour. Add chopped nuts and raisins. Mix well. Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Bake approximately 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Bakes nicely in an angel food pan or may be baked in a loop pan.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown and simmer hamburger and pepper. Add onion garlic salt and oregano. Add tomato paste and tomato sauce. Line strips of noodles on bottom of pan. Layer meat sauce Mozzarella cheese and cottage cheese. Top with another layer of noodles and repeat until everything is gone. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until cheese is brown.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Put chopped rhubarb in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar and jello together and sprinkle over rhubarb. Sprinkle dry cake mix over sugar-jello. Pour 1/2 cup over cake mix. Shave butter and dot over top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Applesauce Raisin Muffins(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Mix egg oil and applesauce. Add and beat well the flour baking soda baking powder and spices. Stir in raisins. Spoon batter into greased muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Place all in casserole dish cover cook at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until rice is done.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in a greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle sugar over these. Mix flour sugar baking powder salt and egg together with a fork until crumbly and sprinkle over apples. Over all pour shortening (oleo). Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: In a small bowl combine refried beans and chilies. Spread on large serving plate. Combine sour cream and taco seasoning. Spoon over bean mixture spreading evenly. Cover and chill several hours. Just before serving garnish with cheese tomatoes onions and olives. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: New Orleans Beans
instructions: Combine in casserole or small pot or pan; cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cooked Cabbage
instructions: Fry bacon. Drain on paper towel. In grease left from bacon add chopped cabbage sugar and enough water to cover cabbage. Add Tabasco or red pepper to your taste. Cook until water evaporates or cabbage is tender.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings(Portuguese)
instructions: Mix the soy sauce and sweet and sour sauce together. Pour over chicken wings arranged in a large cooking pan. Marinate about 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar eggs and flavoring thoroughly. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting. Stir flour baking powder and salt together; blend in. Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Mock Ham Spread
instructions: Grind first 4 ingredients together and stir in rest and serve with crackers.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: In a medium-size bowl mix flour baking powder soda spices and nuts. In another bowl blend oil sugar and eggs. Beat until smooth and creamy. Add vanilla and carrots. Add flour mixture and mix until thoroughly blended. Generously grease pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 (8 or 9-inch) rounds pans for 25 minutes or until tester comes out clean. Delicious with cream cheese icing!

title: Arthur'S Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Sprinkle 1/2 cup of pecans in greased and floured tube cake pan and set aside. Cream butter and cream cheese. Add sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one egg at a time. Beat well after each addition.

title: Mock Chicken Luau
instructions: Saute chicken pieces in a pot. Add enough water to just cover chicken. Simmer until chicken is tender. Add spinach and soup. Continue cooking until mixture is thoroughly heated.

title: Fresh Zucchini Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream together the sugar eggs and oil. Add zucchini and pecans. Sift together the flour cinnamon nutmeg baking soda and salt. Then blend them into the creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla and raisins. Grease a Bundt pan tube pan or heavy iron skillet. Spread in cake batter. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool and remove from pan.

title: Stuffed Flank Steak
instructions: Mix together hamburger and bread crumbs very well. Put mixture in the middle of steak and roll up. Tie. Place in foil. Pour soup in the pan and bake your flank steak at 375\u00b0.

title: Grandma Miller'S Cucumbers And Onions
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover with cold water and refrigerate overnight. Drain. Rinse with cold water and drain again. Mix together the vinegar sugar and sour cream. Pour over vegetables and stir. Add pepper to taste. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spam Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Mix all ingredients together pour into baking dish and bake for 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Black Cow
instructions: Fill a 14-ounce glass 1/3 full with root beer. Add 1 scoop ice cream. Pour in about 1/4 cup more root beer. Add 2 more scoops of ice cream. Pour in enough root beer to fill glass. Serve with club soda to add for extra carbonation if desired.

title: Artichoke Heart Dip
instructions: Mash artichokes. Mix with cheese and mayonnaise. Add garlic salt to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl blend cream cheese and 2 teaspoons margarine (reserve 1 teaspoon) until smooth. Add next 6 ingredients; mix well.

title: Cookie Salad
instructions: Mix in large bowl first four ingredients. Include juice from pineapple and mandarin oranges. Right before serving crush cookies. Fold in cookies and Cool Whip.

title: Sauerkraut With Wine
instructions: Drain sauerkraut; soak in cold water for 1 hour. Drain. Saute onion in margarine. Combine all ingredients peppering heavily and simmer 1 hour.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil 5 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon soda. Pour over popped corn. Bake in 200\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Can add peanuts.

title: Garlic Shrimp
instructions: Pour sauce over shrimp and refrigerate 12 to 24 hours.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt in a bowl. Add eggs. Beat until smooth. Bring 4 cups of milk to a simmer in saucepan. Stir a small amount of hot milk into egg mixture. Then stir egg mixture into hot milk. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Cool. Stir in cream and vanilla. Pour into ice cream freezer container. Add milk to fill line. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions.

title: Cucumber Dip
instructions: Mix cucumbers with vinegar and salt. Refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve thoroughly blend cream cheese mayonnaise and garlic powder. Press all liquid from the marinated cucumbers and discard. Stir the cucumber and cream cheese mixtures together. Serve with fresh vegetables or corn chips.

title: Parmesan Meat Balls
instructions: Mix together. Handle gently and form into balls. Brown in hot oil; remove.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except cheese. Pour half batter in hot greased skillet; sprinkle grated cheese over batter. Pour in remaining batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done approximately 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: *You may use 2 boxes of chocolate pudding.

title: Hummus Dip
instructions: In a large bowl crush garlic and salt together. Add drained chickpeas lemon (squeezed) and tahini sauce. Mix with blender/hand blender or mixer until smooth. Serve with Lebanese bread/pita chips.

title: Country Spareribs
instructions: Brown the ribs in some oil and mix all the ingredients together; simmer in pan for 15 minutes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cover pan when putting into oven.

title: One Bowl Brownie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass baking dish). Microwave chocolate and margarine in large microwaveable bowl on High 2 minutes or until margarine is melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted.

title: Hamburger Dinner
instructions: Shred cabbage and put half of it in a greased casserole. Add half of the sliced potatoes and half of the hamburger. Sprinkle salt and pepper over this and add the remaining half of the ingredients in the same manner. Pour over milk and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 2 hours.

title: Macaroni Cutlets
instructions: Cook macaroni in 1-quart of water. Let it overcook until it almost flattens out. Add butter and milk and continue to cook. Add cheese stirring continuously. After cheese is all melted turn off heat and let set for a few minutes to insure that it is thick enough. Spread in pan about 1/4-inch thick and chill.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix shortening eggs and sugar. Add dry ingredients. Roll into walnut sized balls and roll in sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Smothered Steak And Mushrooms
instructions: Cut steak into individual portion sizes. Dredge in flour and brown in oil. Salt and pepper to taste. In same skillet or in a roasting pan lay meat on bottom; top with onion and mushrooms. Add potato slices if you like. Top with soup. Cover and cook at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours or simmer on low in covered skillet. Serves 4.

title: Tex Mex Dip
instructions: Put these in layers. You can also use avocado dip in place of ripe avocados (it is already mixed up).

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In a bowl combine all ingredients and whisk well to dissolve sugar. Place in a squeeze bottle or jar. Refrigerate unused portions.

title: Souper Burgers
instructions: In skillet cook beef and onion until beef is browned and onion is tender; stir to prepare meat. Spoon off fat. Add soup ketchup and pepper. Over low heat heat through; stir often. Serve on buns.

title: Hard Candy
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and water. Stir over medium heat until dissolved. Boil (without stirring) until the hard crack stage is reached. Remove from heat after the boiling has stopped; add flavor. Pour over greased cookie sheet. Let cool. Break into bite-sized pieces. Cover with powdered sugar to avoid sticking.

title: Chile Quesadillas
instructions: Sprinkle 2/3 cup cheese onto each of 3 tortillas. Top each with 1/3 of chiles and 2 tablespoons salsa. Cover with remaining tortillas pressing gently.

title: Ham And Potatoes Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes and ham in buttered baking dish. Stir milk into mushroom soup. Add onion salt and pepper to mixture. Mix well; pour over potatoes. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are tender. Remove cover after 1 hour to brown top.

title: Lynn'S Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except use only 1/2 cup of the butter and corn flakes. Mix other 1/2 cup of butter with corn flakes to sprinkle on top. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add the milk blending thoroughly into mixture. Fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into the pie crust. Sprinkle with the peanuts. Freeze until firm. Let stand at room temperature for about 10 minutes before serving. Top with chocolate syrup peanuts and Cool Whip.

title: Bessie Stermer'S Wine Vinegar Garlic Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all together in a bottle large enough to shake well then shake.

title: Punch Recipe
instructions: Dissolve jello in 4 cups hot water. Add rest of ingredients and freeze. Thaw 3 1/2 hours. Add 1 (2 liter size) ginger ale.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate over low heat. Cool. Sift flour with salt. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Cream butter. Add sugar and continue beating until well blended and fluffy. Blend chocolate; add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add vanilla. Add flour alternately with buttermilk mixture mixing well. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Cranberry Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 12-cup Bundt-type pan; set aside.

title: Cockeyed Cake
instructions: Sift flour and cocoa with remaining dry ingredients. Sift this into a greased 9-inch square pan. Make 3 wells (or holes) in flour mixture. Into one pour the oil. Into another pour the vinegar and into the next pour the vanilla. Pour the cold water over all. Beat with a spoon until nearly smooth and you cannot see the flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Combine everything except chips. Crumble chips on top when serving.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water stir in orange juice and let congeal slightly. Add pineapple and oranges. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise for dressing.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add remaining ingredients and store in tightly covered container. Refrigerate. Spoon mixture into greased muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Can be baked immediately without refrigeration.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together. Cut in shortening until like coarse corn meal. Add egg and rest of ingredients. Beat until thoroughly blended. Drop by teaspoonful 1 1/2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until done at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mints
instructions: Knead. Mix well. This is the recipe I use for molded mints.

title: Best Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain salmon; remove bones and skin. Mix with beaten eggs butter hot milk and corn flakes. Season with garlic salt onion and pepper. Mix and put in greased pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Shake 'N Bake Mix
instructions: Mix all together. Store in a tightly covered container in refrigerator. This equals 20 bags of store bought bags of chicken coating. Use on pork too.

title: Sweet Potato Surprise
instructions: Mash potatoes. Stir in the nutmeg. Shape into balls around each marshmallow. Roll in melted butter then in corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Can be frozen. Wrap tightly and store in freezer.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Preheat the oven on broiler setting. In a large mixing bowl combine the roma tomatoes sun-dried tomatoes garlic olive oil vinegar basil salt and pepper. Allow the mixture to sit for 10 minutes. Cut the baguette into 3/4 inch slices. On a baking sheet arrange the baguette slices in a single layer. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes until slightly brown. Divide the tomato mixture evenly over the baguette slices. Top the slices with mozzarella cheese. Broil for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain. Cook macaroni and drain. Combine hamburger macaroni and pizza sauce. Layer in casserole half the hamburger macaroni mixture half the pepperoni pieces and half the cheese. Repeat layers topping with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Coconut Corn Flake Macaroons
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add salt and gradually add sugar beating until dissolved. Fold in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 1/2 hour (30 minutes) in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar corn syrup and water to 239\u00b0. Start the beater and slowly pour 1/3 of the syrup over the unbeaten egg whites beating constantly. Cook remaining syrup to 255\u00b0. Add 1/2 of the syrup to the egg white mixture beating constantly. Cook remaining syrup to 290\u00b0. Add vanilla. Add to egg white mixture. Beat until mixture holds shape when dropped from spoon. Add nuts or candied cherries if desired and drop candy from spoon to form puffs.

title: Orange Sherbet Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add 7-Up and juice from mandarin oranges. Chill until partially thickened. Add oranges and orange sherbet. Beat until frothy. Chill until thickened.

title: Pasties
instructions: Mix ground chuck potato and onion together in bowl then shape into 2 loaves. Place loaf on pastry tart style fold pastry over top of loaf and seal edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine first 7 ingredients in bowl; mix well. Let stand for 15 minutes. Stir in pecan halves. Spread on 2 (10 x 15-inch) baking sheets. Bake for 1 hour. Remove to waxed paper to cool. Yield 8 servings.

title: Summer Berry Pie
instructions: Mix all berries in a large bowl. Pour in pastry shell. Mix sugar and cornstarch in medium saucepan. Stir in water gradually until smooth. Cook stirring constantly on medium heat until mixture comes to boiling point. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in jello until dissolved. Cool to room temperature. Pour over berries in pastry shell. Refrigerate 3 hours until set. Serve with topping.

title: Cherry Topped Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat together cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour into unbaked graham cracker crust. Top with pie filling. Chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix the ingredients thoroughly except for the egg whites and 4 tablespoons sugar; cook at medium heat until it thickens. Cool and pour into baked pie shell.

title: Green Tomato Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease casserole dish with olive oil. Layer sliced tomatoes and onions in dish. Sprinkle cheese salt bread crumbs and pepper on top. Bake about 1 hour or until onions are done.

title: White Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Sift together the flour 2 teaspoons baking powder and salt. Add to Crisco mixture with water. Beat into batter. Beat 1 teaspoon baking powder with egg whites until stiff. Fold into batter. Bake in 3 greased layer pans at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or in a 9 3/4 x 13 x 2 1/4-inch oblong cake pan for 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Topping For German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine sugar milk egg yolks and shortening in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans. Cook for 15 minutes. Spread only between layers and on top of cake.

title: Easy Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit; mix with sour cream. Add coconut and marshmallows. Chill for 2 hours.

title: Sauce For Party Links
instructions: Combine flour brown sugar dry mustard soy sauce pineapple juice and vinegar. Heat to boil. Let boil 1 minute. Add sausage and heat a little more. Serve from chafing dish. One recipe will do a 2-pound party pack approximately 109-count.

title: Darla'S Special Chicken Enchilada Bake(This Is A Delicious Main Dish.)
instructions: *This should make 2 cups of cooked chicken for recipe.

title: Barbecue Lasagna
instructions: Use large size cooking pan approximately 10 x 14. Grease the bottom of pan with cooking oil. Put in the layer of chicken. Sprinkle a layer of flour on the chicken. Cover it with a layer of celery then a layer of chopped onions. Melt 1 stick or margarine and pour into the pan. Then pour in a 10 3/4 ounce can of cream of mushroom soup. Season with pepper and salt. Cook for approximately 90 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Blackberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water; add berries and pineapple. Congeal overnight. Add topping of softened cream cheese sugar and sour cream; blend. Spread on top. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Sift together remaining ingredients. Mix well with pumpkin mixture. Pour into 2 large greased and floured loaf pans. Bake for 1 1/2 hours in a 325\u00b0 oven. You can use the Pam spray or the cooking and baking spray.

title: Block Party Beans
instructions: In Dutch oven brown meat and spoon off fat. Add onions and celery; cook until tender. Stir in soup paste and catsup; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or use crock-pot for several hours. Do on stove top for 1 hour and then crock-pot.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Melt margarine and pour into large shallow Pyrex dish. Stir into margarine uncooked rice. Stir until even and all rice is moistened. Place uncooked chicken parts on top of rice (salt and pepper chicken). Cover with mixture of water and cream of mushroom soup. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover with foil and bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Beef
instructions: Wrap bacon around each piece of chicken. Line an 8 x 8-inch shallow baking dish with chipped beef. Place bacon-wrapped chicken on top of beef. Mix soup with sour cream and spread over chicken. Sprinkle top with paprika. Do not salt. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Fruit Cocktail Pie
instructions: Make pie crust by mixing cracker crumbs butter salt and flour. Press in pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Melt together in a double boiler the milk and marshmallows. Cool. Add whipped cream and fruit cocktail. Pour into pie shell and garnish with 2 tablespoons reserved graham cracker crumbs. Chill for several hours.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Stew chicken. Debone chicken and chop in small chunks. Add soups Ro-Tel and rice to broth. Bring to a boil.

title: Quick Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and cheese dinner as directed on package then add and mix all additional ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: In skillet brown chops in small amount of shortening. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Place chops in greased baking dish. Top each chop with a tablespoon of rice. Place tomato slices onion slices and green pepper on rice. Spoon tomatoes over all. Cover. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Add mushrooms. Cover and continue baking for 30 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.

title: Green Salad(Cookbook Winner, 1992)
instructions: Mix pudding and undrained pineapple together. Stir in whipped topping fold in marshmallows and chill.

title: Best In The West Barbecue Bean Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef bacon and onion; drain excess fat. Combine and add all other ingredients except the beans; stir well. Add beans; combine thoroughly. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 20 to 24 servings.

title: Round Steak Barbecue
instructions: Spread steak with prepared mustard flour and brown. Combine ingredients pour over steak and simmer 2 hours or until tender. Serve with mashed potatoes rice or spaghetti squash.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Cream margarine with sugar. Add peanut butter eggs buttermilk water and vanilla. Add this to flour and baking powder mix. Combine and beat very smooth. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until tester comes out clean. Frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Hot Buttered Rum Mix
instructions: Blend butter and sugars using an electric hand mixer. Stir in the soft ice cream and place the container in freezer. This recipe makes 6 cups of mix enough for 48 servings.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind berries and sugar. Let set overnight. Next day drain well. Mix with other ingredients. Whip cream and fold together. I usually make a double recipe and I also use chilled can cream instead of whipping cream.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scoop out insides of potatoes leaving 1/4-inch shell. Mash potatoes with milk in a bowl. Stir in broccoli or spinach cheeses garlic salt and pepper. Spoon filling back into potato skins. Sprinkle with more grated Parmesan cheese (about 2 tablespoons) and bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: So Different Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine egg yolks and next four ingredients into bowl; mix well. Beat egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Fold gently into the egg yolk mixture. Fold in rhubarb. Spoon into pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes longer.

title: No Boil Lasagna(Club Member: Jason Baldwin)
instructions: In a large skillet brown ground beef; drain. Add spaghetti sauce and 1 cup water; bring to a boil. In a medium bowl combine Ricotta and egg. Add Mozzarella 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese parsley flakes sugar nutmeg salt and pepper. Rinse uncooked lasagna in hot water and place 3 to 4 strips in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour 1 2/3 cups meat sauce over lasagna. Layer 1/2 cheese mixture 1 1/2 cups sauce 3 to 4 strips lasagna remaining cheese mixture 1 2/3 cups sauce remaining lasagna strips and remaining sauce. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until lasagna strips are tender about 45 minutes. Uncover; bake an additional 15 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until browned; drain. Set aside. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles place on a greased 12-inch pizza pan. Press bottom and sides to form crust; seal perforations. Bake at 375 degrees for 5 minutes. Crust will be puffy. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees. Spoon sausage over dough; sprinkle with cheeses. Combine eggs milk oregano and pepper; pour over sausage. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Pineapple Angel Food Trifle
instructions: Drain pineapple tidbits reserving 1 cup juice; set aside. Combine instant pudding mix 1/2 cup reserved juice and milk in a large bowl. Beat at low speed with an electric mixer 2 minutes or until thickened. Fold in sour cream and pineapple tidbits. Place 1/3 of cake cubes in bottom of a 16-cup glass bowl. Drizzle with 2 to 3 tablespoons remaining reserved pineapple juice. Spoon 1/3 of pudding mixture over cake. Repeat procedure twice ending with pudding mixture. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Just before serving spread top with whipped topping.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: In large bowl mix cheese mayo nuts onion pepper and Tabasco. Form into a ring on a platter. Cover and chill.

title: Date Nut Fruit Cake
instructions: Chop dates and pour the 1 1/4 cups of hot water over them and set aside to soak. In a large bowl cream shortening sugar and eggs. Add dates and warm water that they have been soaking in. Add vanilla cinnamon salt and soda. Then add flour and pecans. Add cherries (with juice) raisins and candied pineapple. Mix well. Put in a 12 cup tube pan with floured sides and a waxed paper ring in the bottom. Bake at 325 degrees for 2 hours. DO NOT PREHEAT OVEN. Upon removal wrap immediately in foil.

title: Mexican Party Chicken
instructions: In a sauce pan combine chicken chilies enchilada sauce and soup. Heat until boiling. Place 1/3 corn chips in bottom of a greased baking dish. Alternate with layers of chicken mixture onion and cheese. Top with remaining chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Wilma'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening in bowl until light and fluffy. Add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating continuously. Add eggs one at a time beating until light and fluffy. Add flour and milk alternately beating well after each addition and adding baking powder and salt with last flour addition. Beat in flavoring and continue beating for 3 minutes. Pour batter into greased waxed paper-lined tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cake tests done. Cool for 10 minutes and remove from pan to cooling rack.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan or glass dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Homemade Pickles
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Fit cucumbers into two quart jars. Pour in enough of vinegar mixture to cover cucumbers. Tighten lid and refrigerate for 1 week to develop flavor.

title: Lemon Pudding
instructions: Add flour to sugar. Pour in juice and rind of lemon. Beat egg yolks and add with milk to lemon mixture. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in lightly greased casserole with pan of water. Bake at 300 degrees for one hour. Watch carefully for when it is brown and the pudding is set. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt peanut butter butter and chocolate chips together over low heat. Let cool slightly. Pour over Crispix cereal. Mix well.

title: Aunt Estelle'S Homemade Syrup
instructions: Add 1/2 cup water or more to dissolve sugars; add maple flavoring. Boil to thin syrup. Remove from heat. Stir in white syrup. This will not crystallize and will keep a long time.

title: Self Crust Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except water together in a large bowl. Stir in water gradually until well mixed. Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted 1 inch from center comes out clean. Makes 8 servings. Contains 150 calories per serving.

title: Lasagna Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion; drain. Add Ragu Hunts and mushrooms and mix. Cook shells until tender. Spread layer of shells sour cream and cheese. Alternate until all is used ending with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. The more cheese the better!

title: Mammoe'S Old Fashion Molasses Taffy
instructions: Combine sugar molasses butter and vinegar in saucepan. Cook slowly stirring constantly until mixture boils. Boil slowly constantly toward end of cooking to 260\u00b0 (or when small quantity dropped into cold water forms very hard balls). Remove from heat. Pour into greased pan. Cool enough to handle. (Grease hands.) Form mixture into balls. Pull until light yellow in color. Stretch into long rope. Cut into small pieces. Wrap each piece in waxed paper.

title: Taco Taters
instructions: Bake potatoes until done (a fork will easily be pushed into the center or about 1 hour at 400\u00b0 or microwave 4 to 5 minutes). Split potato open and ruffle with fork. Add butter salt and pepper to taste. Top with ground beef salsa and cheese; melt cheese in oven or microwave for an easy quick meal. May use variation with Manwich or jalapeno Cheddar dip. Serve with corn chips.

title: Easy Mexican Dip
instructions: Pour salsa over cream cheese; use spreader or chips to dip.

title: Chocolate Rum Cake
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and half of the chips and nuts. Beat. Fold in rest of chips and nuts. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pan. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Crab Mousse
instructions: Heat soup; add cream cheese. Add gelatin. Cool mixture. Add vegetables mayonnaise and crab. Season with Tabasco sauce garlic salt and parsley to taste. Put into greased 4 cup mold. Refrigerate overnight. Unmold onto platter lined with lettuce leaves. Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. In a quart casserole dish combine sauteed onion and eggs; add bread crumbs. Bake 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Drain corn. Add egg yolks milk flour and butter. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in moderate oven until firm about 1 hour.

title: Bekah'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding mix with fruit. Chill and serve.

title: Zucchini Pizza Style
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch slices. Dip in beaten egg then coat with bread crumbs. Brown lightly on both sides in hot oil. Overlap slices in a lightly buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with salt pepper oregano and Parmesan cheese. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Pour tomato sauce over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Batter Fried Vegetables
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients; stir in water and egg until smooth. Dip vegetables a few at a time into batter. Fry in hot oil (375\u00b0) a few pieces at a time until golden brown and crisp. Drain on paper towels.

title: Granny'S Popovers
instructions: *Have at room temperature.

title: Pumpkin Cake Squares
instructions: Beat with fork until cake is absorbed. Press into bottom of greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Combine cream cheese and butter and cook until mixture melts. Stir in spinach and next 6 ingredients. Set aside. Place half of artichoke hearts in greased 2-quart casserole dish; top with half of the spinach mixture. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 8.

title: United Nations Casserole
instructions: Dissolve bouillon in water; add salt. Bring to boil stir in rice. Reduce heat and simmer tightly covered about 25 minutes. Add mushrooms curry powder parsley flakes and nutmeg. Arrange chicken breast on top of rice. Sprinkle liberally with paprika. Bake uncovered 350\u00b0 1 1/4 hours or until chicken is tender. 8 - 10 servings.

title: Meat Loaf In A Crock-Pot
instructions: Mix all ingredients together good. Spray crock-pot with Pam. Put meat loaf into crock-pot and cook on high for 4 to 6 hours until done.

title: Fried Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage and caraway seed in broth just until cooked down a little. Cook bacon until crisp; crumble. Saute garlic and onion in large frying pan. Add cabbage and bacon and fry just until it still has a little crunch (like stir-fry).

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Pie
instructions: Place rhubarb and strawberries in unbaked pie shell. Pour flour and sugar over fruit. Dab butter around top of pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and put into a loaf pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool a few minutes for easier serving. This will serve 6 to 8.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Arrange in dish in layers all ingredients except soup after layer is arranged add part of soup. Arrange layer again and finish off with remainder of soup.

title: Bacon 'N' Beans
instructions: Fry bacon after cutting in small pieces. Add bacon onions and drippings to beans; heat to boiling point. Serve hot. Also good using fresh beans.

title: Oriental Dressing
instructions: Combine in blender and process. May need to double triple etc. recipe to get desired amount. Great marinade for chicken or beef stir-fry. Also good dressing for vegetable pasta salad (top with toasted sesame seed).

title: Spice Squares(Low Cholesterol)
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Boil 3 minutes in pan large enough to mix everything. Cool then add oil. Mix together the soda and 1 tablespoon warm water. Add to first mixture. Sift together the dry ingredients; add walnuts. Mix all with wooden spoon right in pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar when cool.

title: Roast Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix oil garlic salt and pepper in 9-inch square baking dish. Add potatoes and turn to coat with oil. Bake until tender and browned 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bundt Pan Cornbread
instructions: Mix together sugar and oil. Add milk and eggs. Add corn meal flour baking powder and salt. Finally add shredded Cheddar cheese creamed corn and green chilies. Bake in greased Bundt pan at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Put the first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Mix the sugar and mayonnaise together. Stir this into the pea mixture. Mix well. Top with Parmesan cheese and refrigerate about 2 hours before serving.

title: Crock-Pot Beef Tips
instructions: Brown beef tips or sirloin tips. Place in bottom of crock-pot. Add all other ingredients cover and cook on low 8 to 12 hours. Serve with rice.

title: Helen'S Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar. Cut in butter. Beat together egg and milk and add stirring quickly until dry ingredients are thoroughly moistened. Spread in pan (13 1/2 x 8 3/4-inch). Peel and core apples. Slice from blossom to stem making 1/2-inch thick slices. Stick these end down into the dough very close together. Mix sugar and cinnamon; dust over apples. Sprinkle over the nuts. Cover the pan and bake in oven (350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0) for 15 minutes. Remove cover and continue to bake until apples are done. Serve warm.

title: International Sandwich
instructions: Spread\tthe bread with mustard. Put bologna on bread; top with spinach. Sprinkle cheese over top. Place sandwich on paper or china plate. Microwave 2 minutes giving sandwich 1/2 turn after 1 minute. Makes 1 sandwich.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Layer cheese over cooked macaroni. Mix milk and egg and pour over macaroni and cheese and bake.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients and form ball. Roll in chopped nuts or parsley. Serve with crackers.

title: Mexican Chicken Dish(Serves 8)
instructions: Mix chicken cream cheese salsa and any other veggies you desire (green peppers jalapeno etc.). Take flour tortilla shells and put about 2 tablespoons of mixture inside shells. Roll and line them up in a pan. Pour melted Velveeta cheese mixed with salsa. Heat in oven for 15 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Melt margarine and bacon grease in a large roaster. Mix well. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake at 250\u00b0 for at least 1 hour. Stir often.

title: Beer Batter
instructions: Mix flour and salt in bowl. Beat egg yolks lightly with beer; add flour and salt. Stir in melted butter and let set for 1 hour. Add egg whites gently into batter. Coat fish and deep fry until golden brown.

title: Brown Stew
instructions: Put shortening in Dutch oven or heavy bottomed pot with cover. When this is very hot add the beef a few pieces at a time so they will brown on all sides. Remove. When the last batch has been browned return all to the pot and add 4 cups boiling water. Stir and add all the ingredients with the exception of the carrots onions and potatoes. Lower the heat cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Add other ingredients and cook for another 20 to 25 minutes or until they can be pierced with a fork. Remove meat and vegetables to a casserole while putting finishing touches to the gravy.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Saute broccoli and onion in margarine. Combine muffin mix with other ingredients. Fold in sauteed mixture. Bake in greased baking dish or pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Muffin tins can be used.

title: Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain then add to sauce. Do not cover. Cook slowly.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
instructions: Spray casserole pan. Layer bread. Brown and drain sausage. Put on top of bread. Layer cheese. Beat eggs and mix with mustard soup salt and milk. Pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Tuna Cakes
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Press into round cakes. Place cakes into a hot oiled frying pan. Let cakes brown on both sides. Drain. Serve hot. Delicious with a dash of hot sauce.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: In an 8-quart kettle over medium heat cook bacon until lightly browned. Add onions and fry until tender about 10 minutes. Gradually stir in flour until mixed well. Add enough water to clam liquid to make 4 cups. Slowly stir it into flour mixture. Cook stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Dump in potatoes pepper and garlic. Cover and cook until potatoes are tender 10 to 15 minutes. Add clams milk cream and butter. Simmer until thoroughly heated about 5 minutes stirring often. Makes 14 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Crunches
instructions: Bring sugar and corn syrup to a rolling boil stirring constantly. Blend in peanut butter. Continue stirring. Put corn flakes in a well-greased bowl and pour mixture over cereal. Cool and then shape into balls.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs 2 sticks of melted butter and 7 tablespoons of sugar in long Pyrex dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Set it in refrigerator after done.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Boil macaroni until tender. Drain. Rinse with cold water until cool. Dice tomatoes onion and bell pepper. Combine with macaroni. Add mayonnaise 3 to 4 tablespoons or enough to blend. Add celery salt and pepper to season to taste. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Sour Cream Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over soda; let cool. Cream sugar cream and eggs together. Add flour salt cocoa sifted together soda mixture cake coloring and vanilla. Beat thoroughly with electric mixer for 5 minutes. Pour into well oiled and floured oblong baking pan. Bake in moderate oven about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cool ice with chocolate frosting.

title: Concombre Choses
instructions: Take one slice of pumpernickel bread. Spread with approximately 1 teaspoon of cream cheese. Place 1 slice of cucumber over cream cheese. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Cold Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix crushed pineapple juice and pudding. Add Cool Whip. Pour into baked shell. Top with more Cool Whip and refrigerate until served.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Form into small balls. Press down with glass over wet cloth. Bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Decorate with colored sugar or as desired. (Do not bake until brown.)

title: Galaxie Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except nuts. Put into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool roll into ball and then into pecans.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Cook hamburger in butter until brown. Drain grease. Return to pan and add salt pepper garlic and tomato paste. Simmer for 1 minute. Add sour cream and cottage cheese. Mix well and pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Irish Potato Candy
instructions: Cook potatoes with jackets on. Peel and mash until smooth. Add sifted powdered sugar to make a dough. Roll out on a biscuit board about 1/2 inch thick. Spread with peanut butter. Roll up and let set about 1 hour then slice.

title: Gumbo
instructions: Bring beef onion tomatoes water chicken broth and bouillon cubes to a boil; simmer for 1 hour. Add lima beans and cook for 30 minutes. Add okra ham and chicken. Cook for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cut potatoes in small chunks. Cook until done keeping them covered with water. Cook onion in with potatoes. Do not drain water. Add soups and milk. Stir well. Cut Velveeta in chunks and add to potatoes. Stir continuously until cheese melts. Serve with cornbread or crackers.

title: Fiesta Corn Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Use an 8 or 9-inch square pan. Melt shortening in pan in oven. Combine dry ingredients. Add to melted shortening and remaining ingredients. Mix until just blended. Pour into pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli as directed then add the mayonnaise onion grated cheese eggs soup and salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Mix the stuffing mix with the melted butter. Put over top of broccoli and bake another 2 to 3 minutes or until brown.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and stir all ingredients together. Pour into unbaked 9 inch pie crust. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 400\u00b0 until a knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Stir cottage cheese in dry Jell-O. Add oranges and pineapple. Add Cool Whip. Mix together. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Orange-Cashew Chicken Salad
instructions: Peel and separate orange into sections and cut each section in half. In a large bowl combine orange chicken pea pods red pepper and onion rings.

title: Easy Herb And Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Put in bowl. Sprinkle with pepper and refrigerate. Serve with crackers and fruit.

title: Creamed Chipped Beef Over Hot Baked Potatoes
instructions: Prepare potatoes as usual for baking in conventional oven. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then pierce 2 to 3 times with a fork. Continue baking an additional 30 to 40 minutes until done.

title: Unstuffed Cabbage
instructions: In a large skillet brown the ground beef and onion. Drain. Add cabbage and cook until wilted. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Hot Chili
