instructions: Combine meat onion and garlic in a large skillet. Cook until meat is light brown. Add remaining ingredients (except for beans) and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Add beans (as many as desired) and heat until hot. Recipe may be halved. Serve with grated cheese lettuce and sour cream. Good with Mexican corn bread.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and Crisco. Add sugar gradually creaming well. Add egg yolks beating well. Add soda to buttermilk mixing alternately with flour to sugar mixture and beat slowly. Add coconut and pecans then fold in beaten egg whites. Makes 3 layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done using layer cake pans.

title: Spicy Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in an airtight jar.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and season with salt and poultry seasoning. Tear chicken from bone. Place chips in casserole dish. Leave enough for top. Place chicken on chips. Mix soup tomatoes and onions together and pour over chicken. Pour grated cheese over soup mixture and add crushed chips over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chicken Marengo(Serves 8)
instructions: Brown chicken in shortening. Remove. Add next 3 ingredients and saute until golden. Stir in flour. Add chicken and wine. Simmer 40 to 45 minutes until tender or use crock-pot.

title: Crunchy Cinnamon Pecans(Low Carb)
instructions: Melt butter in microwave 25 seconds. Mix sugars and cinnamon and mix well. Add melted butter and mix well. Add pecans and mix until well coated. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 30 minutes in 250\u00b0 oven. Remove from oven; cool on wax paper. Place in Ziploc bag to stay fresh.

title: Croute Provencale(Serves 4)
instructions: Mince the onions and saute them in 3 tablespoons of olive oil until tender and lightly browned. Add the tomatoes to the pan and season with salt and pepper; mix well. Add the thyme and green pepper and cook the mixture stirring constantly until all of the liquid has evaporated and the mixture is thick.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients at once on high speed until well mixed. Cook in greased tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chow-Chow
instructions: Chop first 4 ingredients. Leave 1 hour. Drain. Put vegetables on stove and add other ingredients. Bring to a boil. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oil eggs and sour cream with mixer; pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cake is done punch holes in cake with fork and pour coconut cream and Eagle Brand milk over cake. When cool frost with Coconut Frosting.

title: Ricotta Creme
instructions: Place Ricotta in a fine strainer and drain the liquid. Place all ingredients in food processor or blender and blend just to combine. Spoon mixture into parfait glasses. Chill. Garnish with a fresh thinly sliced orange ring and a sprig of fresh mint.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Toss vegetables. Combine rest in saucepan. Bring to a boil over low heat stirring occasionally. Pour over vegetables. Chill for 24 hours.

title: Brown Sugar Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Great with coffee.

title: Meatballs And Gravy
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well and shape into meatballs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes depending on the size of the meatballs. Mix the next 3 ingredients well in a large frying pan for gravy. Cover. Heat until bubbly and add meatballs stirring occasionally so the gravy doesnt stick to the bottom of the pan. These freeze well and can be added to spaghetti sauce or sweet and sour sauce.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot. Add garlic onion celery and parsley. Cook until soft. Stir in tomato paste and next 7 ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Lower heat cover and simmer slowly 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients and cook 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: To make crust Scrape off sandwich cookie fillings. Crush the cookies and combine with melted butter. Press into a 9-inch pie plate.

title: Khajur Ki Chutney
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender and mix well. Sieve and throw out the residue. Serve the strained chutney with kababs tikkas.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: In large bowl mix all ingredients until blended. Place in ungreased loaf pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chutney Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise chutney curry powder lime peel lime juice and salt and let stand in refrigerator. Cut pineapple in small pieces and drain thoroughly.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef soup eggs and oatmeal. Roll into small balls. Put in roast pan. Mix Vernors and ketchup. Pour over meatballs. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Cover first 2 hours then uncover last hour to thicken. Stir occasionally.

title: Stroganoff
instructions: Cook beef in large skillet or kettle until half done. Add onion and pepper. Cook until all is done. Press and drain grease. Add all soups and mushrooms to mixture and heat to a slow boil. Remove from heat and add sour cream. Stir well and serve over noodles.

title: Italian Meatballs With Spaghetti
instructions: Cook onion in hot olive oil until golden brown add mushrooms and brown slightly. Add tomatoes tomato paste water sugar salt pepper Italian seasoning and bay leaves. Cook slowly 1 hour. Combine meats and the next 6 ingredients; form into small balls. Brown in a small amount of hot olive oil. Drain meatballs on paper towels. Add meatballs to sauce and cook over low heat 15 minutes. Serve over spaghetti. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Best Beets
instructions: Place hot beets in serving dish. Pour French dressing over beets; toss lightly. Top with sour cream; sprinkle with onions. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Bring water and salt to a boil; add rice. Cover remove from heat and let stand until water is gone. Cook and drain broccoli. Mix onion rice broccoli soup and Cheez Whiz in a casserole dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Quiche Lorraine(For Real Men)
instructions: Cook and crumble bacon. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium sized bowl beat eggs cream salt pepper and nutmeg. Layer crumbled bacon and cheese in pie shell. Pour egg and cream mixture over it. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until quiche is golden brown or puffy. Let cool for a few minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers and heat or eat cold the next day.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle chops with salt; dredge in flour. Brown chops in hot oil on both sides. Place chops in a shallow 10-inch square casserole dish. Top with pineapple and green pepper rings. Combine next 4 ingredients in a small saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium. Combine cornstarch and water; stir well. Add cornstarch mixture to chicken broth mixture. Stir constantly until thickened and bubbly. Pour over chops. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Serve over rice.

title: Silvara Walker'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix together the corn meal flour baking powder salt and sugar. Add the buttermilk soda egg and oil. Beat like a cake. Oil and heat iron skillet on stove top. Pour cornbread mix in skillet and bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Eggnog
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan mix the eggs milk and 1/3 cup of sugar. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture coats a metal spoon. Remove from heat. Cool quickly by placing pan in a sink or bowl of ice water and stirring 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in rum bourbon and vanilla. Chill 4 to 24 hours. When serving top with ground nutmeg a sprinkling of sugar and a dollop of whipping cream.

title: Glazed Bacon
instructions: Place bacon in large baking pan and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until crisp. Mix brown sugar mustard and wine thoroughly. Pour over bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles making sure the bacon glaze is covering both sides approximately 10 minutes. Remove from pan to wax paper or foil. Cut bacon in half if desired. Do not refrigerate but let stand at room temperature until ready to serve. Should be dry not sticky.

title: Beef Choufleur
instructions: Brown meat in oleo for 5 minutes. Add cauliflower green pepper soy sauce and garlic. Stir lightly to coat with soy sauce. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender about 10 minutes. Blend cornstarch sugar and broth. Add to meat mixture with green onions. Cook stirring constantly until heated and thickened. Serve over rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pizza Appetizers
instructions: Brown sausage and cool. Mix together cheeses and oregano with sausage salt pepper and garlic salt. Put in Miracle Whip last. Spread mixture on rye bread sliced in 1 1/2-inch slices. May sprinkle cheese on top. Broil 2 minutes.

title: Spanish Custard Or Flan
instructions: Use a tube pan or mold which can go on a burner to caramelize the sugar and then go in the oven. Pour 1/2 cup sugar into the pan; set directly on burner on medium-low heat until sugar starts to melt. Stir with wooden spoon to keep melting evenly. Use hot pad to tilt pan to have caramel coat evenly the bottom and sides. Set aside. Mix yolks egg sugar and milk in large bowl. Stir until smooth. Add vanilla. Pour through sieve into caramelized sugar mold. Discard the gook in the sieve. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes with pan in hot water or until toothpick comes clean 1/2-inch from center. Cool completely. Run knife around edge; turn onto serving plate. Keep mold upside-down on plate to allow all caramel to drip out. Nice with strawberries or cookies.

title: Super Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Heat the oil then brown ground beef. After beef is brown drain off fat on paper towel. Discard oil from pan. Return beef to pan. Add the whole tomatoes tomato sauce water spaghetti sauce mix and mushrooms. Bring to a boil then simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Mashed Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and cook potatoes until soft enough to mash; add milk as needed. Mix remaining ingredients with mashed potatoes. Good warm or cold.

title: Spicy Cocktail Hot Dogs
instructions: In medium saucepan heat mustard and currant jelly stirring until the jelly melts. Add the hot dogs and cook over low heat until ready to serve. Place in chafing dish or fondue pot to keep hot dogs warm. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Arrange potato wedges peel side down in shallow baking pans. Mix remaining ingredients and brush over potatoes. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until potatoes are golden brown and tender brushing occasionally with oil mixture. Makes 8 servings.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain salmon and save liquid. Add enough milk to make 1 cup. Melt butter; add flour and stir until smooth. Add liquid. Cook and stir until thickened. Flake salmon; add white sauce. Then add other ingredients. Shape into a loaf and put in a greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Nut Kifle
instructions: Take flour butter and salt and mix well together. Then add egg yolks and sour cream. Form into small ball and refrigerate overnight. Roll out thin and fill with nuts or prune jelly. Fold in half and seal edges with fork teeth. Brush egg white on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Country Rice Dressing
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in a pan that will be used to bake. Bake for approximately 20 minutes covered at 350\u00b0. Stir before done.

title: Kidney Beans(Monday'S Dinner)
instructions: *Be careful not to add salt until you taste the liquid to determine what salt the seasoning meat produces.

title: Macaroni And Vegetable Salad
instructions: Add all ingredients; toss lightly. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Toss before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer the ingredients in a 9 x 14-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 48 to 53 minutes.

title: Almond Delight
instructions: Combine coconut almonds sugar flour and oleo. Mix well. Put in large pan and bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown; stir every 5 minutes. Let cool. Line dish with crumbs. Add pudding to milk; beat until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in crumb lined bowl; top with remaining crumbs. Chill.

title: Holy Cow Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. While still warm punch holes in cake. Pour condensed milk over cake. Put cake in refrigerator overnight (if you have time). Spread caramel over cool cake then Cool Whip. Sprinkle cake with crushed up candy bars.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Velvet Cake
instructions: Combine chocolate pieces and 1/4 cup water in saucepan; stir over low heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Sift flour salt and baking soda together; set aside. Combine sugar butter and vanilla in bowl; beat until well blended. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in melted chocolate mixture. Stir in flour mixture alternately with 1 cup water. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool. Frost with Chocolate Velvet Frosting.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix the Tang and pudding into pineapple and juice. Add the drained peaches bananas and strawberries.

title: Shrimp Potato Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain squash. Combine squash with sour cream onion egg mushroom soup curry powder salt and pepper. Top with herb stuffing. Cook for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Bottom Prepare stuffing and 1/2 can onions. Then add broccoli. Add sour cream soup milk and chicken and pour over broccoli and stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add 1/2 onions and put on top the last 5 minutes.

title: Sausage Cake
instructions: Separate sausage into small pieces and combine with raisins. Pour boiling water over sausage and raisins and allow to boil about 4 minutes. Let cool and add soda. While mixture cools sift together flour sugar and spices. Sift into sausage mixture and combine well. You may add nuts and fruits from your favorite cake recipe. Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours in slow oven at 300\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Drain spinach well. Mix all ingredients together. Best if made 12 hours ahead of time.

title: Easy Taco Casserole
instructions: Boil pasta as directed on package. Brown hamburger meat and drain. Add tomato sauce and taco seasoning. After pasta is cooked drain and add sour cream and 1 cup cheddar cheese and mix together.

title: Vanilla And Carob Ice Cream
instructions: First place 2 cups of water into blender. Now add all other ingredients and blend together until smooth. Add 1 more cup of water and blend again until smooth. Place into shallow oblong pans and partially freeze. Blend again and refreeze. It is now ready to serve. It is not only delicious but also nutritious.

title: Peanut Candy
instructions: Put in skillet and boil until peanuts start to pop. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Remove from heat and add 1 teaspoon soda. Pour on cookie sheet.

title: Cream Cheese Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat well cream cheese 1 egg 1/3 cup sugar and vanilla. Spread in crust. Sprinkle with 1 1/4 cups pecans.

title: Caramel Sticks
instructions: Melt sugar with margarine in saucepan. Cool. Add flour baking powder egg and vanilla. Stir in nuts. Spread in an 8 to 9-inch square pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 30 minutes. Cool a few minutes then cut into fingers.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt margarine in 2-quart casserole dish in oven. Remove from oven. Add batter of flour sugar milk and cinnamon. Do not stir. Pour the can of peaches over the top. Do not stir. Put the dish back into the oven. Bake approximately 1 hour. Remember do not stir at any point!

title: Tunaburgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Fill buns. Wrap in foil. Heat in 300\u00b0 oven 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve hot. Can be made ahead and frozen individually in foil before cooking. Thaw before heating.

title: Toffee Fudge
instructions: Sprinkle pecans on bottom of greased square pan 9-inch. Combine sugar and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly; boil 7 min. remove from heat and spread over nuts. Sprinkle chocolate pieces over top. Cover pan so heat will melt chocolate. Spread evenly over top. Cut in squares while warm. Refrigerate to set. Makes 36 1 1/2-inch squares.

title: Moist Pound Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs. Add flour; beat well then add nuts pineapple coconut and flavoring. Grease tube pan. Bake 1 hour at about 350\u00b0.

title: Chinese Noodles
instructions: Saute vegetables in 2 tablespoons oil. Add remaining ingredients and put in greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated.

title: Chip Dip
instructions: Mix together and add about 8 ounces Green Goddess dressing (enough to hold mix together). Add Tabasco sauce to taste (just a shake or two). Chill. Serve with nacho style chips.

title: Chocolate Chipper Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine all ingredients except chocolate chips and pecan halves. Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour batter into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased on bottom only). Sprinkle chips and nuts over batter. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cake springs back in center. Serve plain or with Cool Whip or ice cream.

title: Lemonade Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Mix together Cool Whip condensed milk and frozen lemonade partly thawed. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts and chill.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool at room temperature.

title: Mock Sour Cream
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender; combine until smooth. For variety add a dash of dill weed or tarragon.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Steam onion and zucchini for 5 minutes. Melt butter; mix with stuffing. Add sour cream and undiluted soup to zucchini and onion. Put half of the stuffing in a baking dish. add the zucchini and layer the remaining dressing on top. Sprinkle with the grated cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Freezer Jelly
instructions: Mix berries sugar and lemon; let stand for 10 minutes. Dissolve 1 box Sure-Jell with 3/4 cup water; stir well bring to rolling boil for 1 minute. Combine berry mixture and Sure-Jell; bring to hard rolling boil (blend froth in). Let stand for 15 minutes stirring every 4 to 5 minutes. Put in jar or dish 1-inch from top. Cover. Let stand 24 hours. Store in freezer.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook until tender in stock.

title: Jubilee Jumbles
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Happy Pumpkin Bread(24 Slices; A Low Sugar Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place pumpkin frozen fruit juice concentrate water whole mashed banana and vanilla in a mixing bowl and blend well. Sift together flours baking soda baking powder pumpkin pie spice cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Ice Cream Roll
instructions: Beat the eggs flour cinnamon 2/3 cup sugar and baking powder. Then add 3 tablespoons sugar soda vegetable oil water and cocoa. Put in a jelly roll pan lined with waxed paper. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. When done take out on a tea towel and roll up until cool then unroll and spread ice cream on it. Roll up wrap in foil and put in freezer. We like chocolate mint ice cream! Slice to serve.

title: Round Steak And Potatoes
instructions: Cut round steak into cubes and coat with flour. Brown in skillet with onion until tender. Place into greased casserole. Sprinkle with flour salt pepper thyme and garlic. Pour 2 cups hot water over meat and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Then add sliced potatoes on top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook uncovered at 450\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed; pour half of mix in bottom of pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Melt caramels in a double boiler and mix with butter and Pet milk. Pour over baked cake and sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips. Pour rest of cake mix over this and bake for about 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mocha Dream
instructions: Put coffee and chocolate bar in blender. Cover and run on liquefy until chocolate is liquified. Add bourbon and ice cream. Cover and run on blend until smooth.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased oblong cake pan.

title: Pronto Chili
instructions: In a saucepan brown beef and onion. Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Top each serving with cheese if desired. Yields 4 servings.

title: Nut And Poppy Seed Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water and set aside. Sift flour sugar and salt into a bowl. Cut in shortening and gradually add well beaten eggs. Blend then gradually add the dissolved yeast and once again blend thoroughly. Place in the refrigerator overnight. Next day divide dough into 7 or 8 parts. Roll out each part on floured board and spread with nut or poppy seed mixture and roll. Place on greased baking sheet and let stand for 1/2 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugar and shortening. Beat in the eggs one at a time. Stir in the flour alternately with the milk. Add vanilla. Pour into 4 cake pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Date Pinwheel Cookies
instructions: Combine dates 1/2 cup sugar water and nuts. Cook and stir approximately 5 minutes. (You may want to add a little more water.) Let cool. In a large mixing bowl mix sugars shortening eggs soda salt and flour to make dough. Roll dough out on a floured board. Spread date mixture onto rolled dough. Then roll into 2 rolls and put in refrigerator to chill. Cut cookies off to bake. Place cookies on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Guiltless Banana Pudding
instructions: In a large mixing bowl whisk or beat milk and pudding mix until thickened. Fold in whipped topping condensed milk and lemon juice. Layer half of the vanilla wafers half the bananas and half the pudding mixture in an 8-inch square glass dish glass serving dish or individual bowls; repeat. Put plastic wrap directly on surface of pudding and refrigerate. Serves 8 (1 cup per serving).

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour cornstarch and salt. Stir in water. Cook until thick. Gradually stir mixture into beaten egg yolks. Return to low heat and cook 2 minutes. Stir in butter lime juice and rind and cook slightly. Pour into prepared pastry shell.

title: Coconut Joys
instructions: Melt butter; add powdered sugar and coconut then mix well. Press into buttered cake pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread over coconut mixture. Chill and cut into squares for serving.

title: Texas Quick Dip
instructions: In medium-sized bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sour cream. Fold in salsa. Store in refrigerator but serve at room temperature. Serve with chips or vegetables.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Put the butter in a deep pan and melt in oven. Mix sugar flour and milk. Pour over melted butter. Add fruit with juice and bake in 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: A Magic Garden
instructions: Crumple the aluminum foil into an uneven mountain-like shape. Place it in the dish so that it covers the bottom. Stir the mix well; pour it slowly over the crumpled foil. Be sure that some of the salt is on most of the foil. You can put food coloring in it but you have to put it in as soon as you pour it in.

title: Texas Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Line with sliced potatoes and fruit. Combine 1 cup of reserved syrup from drained fruit with sugar cornstarch salt cinnamon and orange peel. Boil 2 minutes. Add butter and nuts. Pour over potatoes and fruit. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Combine peaches with 1 cup sugar. Mix well. Set aside. Beat eggs with electric mixer at medium speed until frothy. Gradually add 2 cups sugar to eggs. Beat until thick. Add salt vanilla extract and 1/2 cup milk. Beat until sugar has dissolved. Stir in whipped cream half-and-half and peach mixture. Pour mixture into freezer cylinder of a 1-gallon ice cream maker. Add enough milk to fill can 2/3 full. Freeze according to manufacturer instructions. Let ripen 1 hour.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Cut just the very tops of broccoli and cabbage. Slice carrots bite size. Shake and pour dressing over all and let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Slice the raw sweet potatoes 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Put them in a Corning Ware or Pyrex dish 2 inches deep in layers staggering rows not more than 3 layers. On each layer alternate sprinkling a little salt and sugar (you add between 1 to 1 1/2 cups). After this is done pour the unbeaten whipping cream over the potatoes filling the pan 3/4 full. Put pats of butter or margarine over the top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven for 3/4 to 1 hour. They should be nice and brown and caramelized.

title: Perfect Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Mix first 4 items; add remaining ingredients. Pour batter into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 70 minutes. Cover with another pan the first 20 minutes so loaf wont crack on the top.

title: Plum Nutty Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in floured tube or Bundt pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Bars
instructions: Slightly beat first 5 ingredients. Cook in microwave until thick then add remaining ingredients. Cool. Pour into your baked pie crust. Add meringue. Bake.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender. Mix for 3 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breast With Crab
instructions: *If you choose to leave out the mayonnaise you can substitute it for melted cheese of your choice. I prefer Colby Jack cheese.

title: Glorified Shortbread
instructions: Cut butter into mixture of next 4 ingredients until crumbly. Press into 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine confectioners sugar orange juice and rind in bowl. Spread on shortbread. Cut into 12 wedges. Top each wedge with 1 walnut half. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Mammy'S Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs; stir in dry ingredients margarine and milk. Pour into a buttered casserole dish. Set dish in a pan of hot water and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce onion bell pepper celery 6 chopped boiled eggs 1/2 bacon bits and 1/2 cheese in large casserole dish add on top frozen peas. Mix mayonnaise and sugar. Pour over top of peas spread to make smooth. Slice remaining eggs lay on top spread remaining cheese and bacon bits. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving. The longer it sits the better. You can use low-fat shredded cheese and low-fat bacon bits and the flavor will not be effected.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes and onions (very thin). Boil in water until tender. Drain water and add margarine and milk. Heat until just hot do not boil.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs for 5 minutes; add remaining ingredients. Spread in well-greased cookie sheet and sprinkle 3/4 cup nuts on top. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Turn out on a towel well dusted with powdered sugar. Roll as for a jelly roll. Wait 5 minutes and unroll and spread with filling.

title: Honey Lemon Chicken
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in shallow baking dish. Stir until well blended. Place chicken in marinade. Turn to coat. Refrigerate 30 minutes; turn once. Heat broiler or prepare grill. Remove chicken from marinade. Broil or grill 3 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Tex-Mex Tamale Skillet(Prep Time: 30 Minutes)
instructions: Brown beef in skillet over medium-high heat. Drain. Add salsa corn and tortilla strips; mix well. Reduce heat to medium; cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese; cover and cook an additional 5 minutes until cheese is melted. Sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Lemon-Carrot Tea Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place loaf baking cups in pan. Cream butter and sugar in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs; mix. Combine flour salt baking soda and baking powder; toss with fork to combine. Combine milk and lemon juice. Add alternately with flour to creamed mixture. Start and end with milk. Mix only until ingredients are moistened. Mix in lemon rind pecans and carrots. Place 1/2 cup batter (fill cavities approximately half full) in each pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Cool 5 minutes remove from pans cool completely and wrap. May be frozen 2 months. Serve cool. Makes 18 small loaves or use 2 bigger pans.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet over moderate heat saute onion celery and broccoli in butter for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in cheese soup and milk until smooth. Place rice in a greased 8-inch square baking dish. Pour cheese mixture over rice do not stir. Bake uncovered in 325\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes a delicious complement to any meat or fish dish as well as being attractive on the table.

title: Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes and onions in a large size bag and add oil. Toss to coat. Add dressing mix and toss again until coated. Bake on an ungreased baking pan for 35 minutes at 450\u00b0 or until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Egg Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites and add to mixture last. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm. Makes 1 pie.

title: Dream Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat 2 minutes. Pour in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use same kind of pudding mix as cake mix.

title: Hot 'N' Heavenly Chicken Breasts
instructions: Dredge chicken in seasoned flour. In medium frying pan melt margarine with onion and garlic. Add chicken and saute until lightly brown. Add bouillon cube mixed with water and simmer 10 minutes. Combine sour cream lemon juice and picante sauce. Pour over chicken; simmer heating through. Serve over angel hair pasta. Serves 4.

title: Apple Relish(For Canning)
instructions: Put all ingredients through food grinder. Cook 25 minutes. Put in clean jars and seal lids. Turn upside down until cold. Store for later use.

title: Grits Au Gratin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bring salted water to boil; slowly stir in grits. Cover reduce heat and cook stirring occasionally until liquid is absorbed according to package instructions. Remove from heat. Whisk eggs slightly; then stir in small amount of grits to warm them. Beat egg mixture into grits. Stir in remaining ingredients mixing well. Pour grits mixture into greased 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Basic Biscuits
instructions: Cut shortening into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Blend in enough milk to make a soft dough. Turn out on lightly floured board or pastry cloth and knead gently 30 seconds. Roll out 1/2-inch thick. Cut out biscuits with floured 2-inch biscuit cutter or sharp knife. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Orange-Cranberry Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and grated orange rind in bowl. Add butter egg yolk and vanilla. Cut in with pastry blender and then knead with fingers until smooth. Pat 1/3 of dough over bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until golden brown. Cool. Pat enough remaining dough evenly around sides to 1/2-inch from top.

title: Chicken And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Catfish Stew
instructions: You also need a 3 to 5-gallon metal pot.

title: Easter Swirl Coffee Bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast into warm water and let stand until dissolved. With an electric mixer cream the butter until light and beat in sugar. Beat in egg yolks then add yeast mixture milk salt and cardamon. Gradually mix in the flour beating at low speed or by hand. Dough will be quite soft. Turn out on a floured board and knead until smooth. Return dough to bowl and butter the top lightly. Cover and let rise in a warm place about 1 1/2 hours.

title: French Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish in preheated oven. In a medium-sized bowl mix flour 1 cup granulated sugar baking powder and milk together. Pour over the melted margarine in the baking pan. Place the sliced fresh fruit on top of the batter. Sprinkle 3/4 cup granulated sugar and optional cinnamon over the fruit. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until the top is golden brown. This is excellent served with vanilla ice cream.

title: Zucchini Beef Skillet
instructions: Saute beef onion green pepper and garlic in 12-inch skillet until well browned. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Marinated Flank Steak
instructions: Mix marinade ingredients together. Pour over flank steak and let marinate for at least 2 hours.

title: Red Potato Casserole
instructions: Scrub potatoes leaving part of skin intact. Cut in wedges. Mix all ingredients and place in plastic sealed bag; let set at least an hour. Spray casserole dish (2-quart) with nonstick cooking spray. Place all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Combine pineapple and cheese. Add flour and sugar. Pour into greased casserole. Cover with cracker crumbs and pour margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all together and cook until the right thickness for you.

title: Baked Italian Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bring macaroni to boil in boiler pot (do not overcook); drain. Grate Mozzarella cheese and Cheddar (put in separate pans). Cut olives in half (place to side); drain off liquid. Open mushrooms and drain.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing(Origin:  Usa - Southern)
instructions: Place first five ingredients in a blender and mix. Add oil slowly and beat until thick. Stir in poppy seed by hand. Use for all fruit salads finely shredded cabbage or sliced avocados.

title: Honey Of A Cornbread
instructions: In a medium bowl thoroughly mix cornmeal flour baking powder and baking soda. In another bowl whisk the egg whites until frothy. Whisk in skim milk yogurt and honey. Pour over the dry ingredients. Stir until all the dry ingredients are moistened. Do not overmix. Coat an 8 x 8-inch baking pan with no-stick spray. Pour the batter into the pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm or cold.

title: Millie'S 8 Minute Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon into crust. Chill. Garnish if desired.

title: Cinnamon Squares
instructions: Mix all together except nuts. Spread out on cookie sheet. Spread pecans over dough. Take egg white (not whipped) and brush over the top. Mash nuts down in dough. Bake at 325\u00b0 until brown. Cut as soon as you take out of oven and take up on wax paper to cool.

title: Society Pickles
instructions: From the North Dakota Jaycees July 1976.

title: Party Mints
instructions: Soften butter and add milk peppermint and coloring. Sift sugar; mix then knead with hands. Mold as desired. Let dry on wax paper 12 hours. Can freeze in tightly sealed container.

title: Swiss Chicken(Very Easy And Quick)
instructions: Pound chicken and dip in bread crumbs (plain). Sprinkle lemon pepper seasoning over it. Melt butter or oil over medium heat and brown chicken then drain and line in dish. Pour sauce over chicken and cut tomato wedges for top of each piece. Lay Swiss cheese over each piece. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Potato Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients in the order given; chill and serve on lettuce leaf. Serves 6.

title: Baby Wipes
instructions: Great for gifts bazaars bake sales craft shows! Read all instructions before beginning.

title: Fruit Cocktail Pie
instructions: Mix Knox gelatine sugar and salt; gradually stir in eggnog. Warm over low heat until Knox gelatine is dissolved. Chill until mixture folds well. Fold in whipped cream flavoring and 1 1/2 cups fruit cocktail. Chill again 5 to 10 minutes until mixture mounds. Heap into pie shell. Decorate with remaining fruit cocktail. Chill 2 to 4 hours.

title: Enchilada Casserole(Serves 6 To 8 People)
instructions: Layer in casserole dish in order listed (ground beef beans soup tortillas cheese and Ro-Tel). Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Dinner
instructions: Place soup chicken thyme and sweet potatoes in crock-pot. Cook on medium 1 hour and on low 5 to 6 hours adding peas in last hour of cooking.

title: Banana Blueberry Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese soften. Mix well with sugar. Bake pie crust and let cool. Beat whipping cream with vanilla until stiff; fold whipped cream into cheese and sugar mixture. Line bottom of pie crust with sliced bananas. Put cheese and whipped cream filling on top of bananas. Spread pie filling on top of whipped cream. Chill.

title: Ground Deer Steaks
instructions: Put deer meat in a steel mixing bowl or glass and add remaining ingredients. Mix well and make into patties. Roll patties in ground cracker crumbs. Can place on wax paper and store in refrigerator until ready to cook. Fry in electric skillet at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown and done.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Mix together in a large sealable bag. Add meat and seal. Keep refrigerated. Turn to coat all meat every 15 minutes for 1 hour or less. Drain meat and cook on grill as desired.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Cook broccoli in a little water until thawed; drain. In another pan melt cheese soup and lemon juice stirring constantly. Add broccoli to cheese mixture. Serve with the big Fritos.

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crumbs sugar and margarine; press in the bottom of a 15 x 10-inch jellyroll pan.

title: Ricotta Mix For Giant Shells Or Manicotti
instructions: Mix the ingredients well. Cook 1 pound of the shells or manicotti in boiling water for 5 to 6 minutes. Pasta must be on the hard side. Drain and run cold water on it. Pour some of your favorite spaghetti sauce in bottom of baking dish. Use a spoon or pastry bag to fill each shell or manicotti with cheese mixture. Place side by side in baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over (as much as desired). Sprinkle with Romano cheese. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender; remove from skillet and set aside. Add beef to skillet; saute until brown. Stir in flour salt pepper marjoram thyme bouillon and cooking wine. Cover and cook over low heat 3 hours. Stir in mushrooms and sauteed onion. Serve over noodles. Can be served over rice.

title: The Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients together reserving club soda until ready to serve. This is a \not too sweet\ punch that gets rave notices.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and salad oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple 1 cup chopped nuts and bananas. Spoon batter into 3 well-greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until tests done. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool completely. Spread Cream Cheese Frosting between layers and on top and sides. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat sugars oleo peanut butter vanilla and eggs until creamy and well blended. Mix in flour oatmeal baking soda and salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Okra Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients except okra in large pot. Cover with water and cook until tender. Keep enough water on vegetables to look \soupy.\ Then add okra and simmer about 4 or 5 minutes longer.

title: Brisket Marinade
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour over both sides of brisket that has been placed in a large plastic bag. Close bag tightly and refrigerate for 24 hours. Cook as desired. Recommended cook for 4 hours in a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Combine in mixing bowl all ingredients except whipping cream. Spoon into greased 9 inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with whipping cream and a cold glass of milk.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Pour the boiling coffee over the cocoa and baking soda in a large bowl. Let cool to lukewarm. Cream sugar and oleo. Add eggs. Beat well. Add cooled cocoa mixture. Add flour and buttermilk alternately. Stir in vanilla. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Mash avocados; add garlic salt lemon juice Worcestershire and Tabasco. Mix well. Leave two avocado seeds in the bottom of your dip.

title: Blueberry Cake Or Muffins
instructions: Cream oil sugar and eggs until light. In seperate bowl sift flour baking powder and salt. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla to the egg mixture. Add blueberries. Pour into greased 9x13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35-40 min. until brown. Sugar may be sprinkled on top.

title: Miracle Cheesecake
instructions: Pour water over Jell-O. Chill until slightly thickened. Cream the sugar cheese and vanilla. Add Jell-O and lemon juice. Mix well. Fold in stiffly beaten milk. Mix graham crackers and butter. Press firmly in bottom and sides of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill overnight.

title: Delta Delight Fruit Cake
instructions: Beat eggs together. Add the sugar and cream well. Add flour baking powder salt vanilla and almond flavorings. Add dates cherries pineapple and nuts. Hand mix well. Pack into wax paper lined greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 250 degrees 4 to 5 hours over a pan of water. Let cake cool completely before removing from pan.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Put salt pepper flour and meat into paper bag and shake being sure to coat meat well. Brown meat in heavy skillet; drain off any grease. Add water broth bay leaf onions tomato sauce and sherry. Bring to a boil and simmer 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bert'S Fudge Caramel Brownies
instructions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup milk (in double boiler or microwave); set aside.

title: Kraut Cake
instructions: Cut or chop sauerkraut; set aside. Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time beat after each egg. Beat in vanilla. Sift dry ingredients and cocoa add to creamed mixture alternately begin and end with flour. Stir in kraut. Bake in well greased 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: The Colonel'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cabbage. Add dressing to cabbage and mix well. Serve ice cold.

title: Crock-Pot Chili
instructions: Break meat into small chunks; place in slow cooker. Add all other ingredients except beans; cover and cook on low heat for 5 hours or high heat for 3 hours. Stir mix in beans (including juices). Cover and cook 1 hour longer on low heat or 1/2 hour longer on high heat.

title: Hot Chicken (Or Turkey) Salad
instructions: Combine all but last 3 ingredients. Place in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese slices. Combine margarine and crumbs; sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Good Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and corn syrup. Beat well. Blend in 1 cup pecans salt vinegar and butter. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Southern Fried Okra Salad
instructions: Coat salted okra with corn meal and flour. Fry in pan of oil. Cook to golden brown; remove add chopped tomato and onion. Toss.

title: C.J.'S Tangy Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Do not pare cucumbers; slice thin. Add onions peppers and garlic. Add salt. Cover with cracked ice. Mix thoroughly. Cover and let sit 3 hours. (I use large roaster pan.) Drain well. Combine remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Add cucumber mixture and stir well. Heat to boiling. Seal in hot sterilized jars. Makes 5 quarts. Be sure to pack cucumbers in jars.

title: Easy Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a large pan. Do not drain grease. Add tomato juice beans chili seasoning and tomato. Let simmer 20 to 30 minutes. If you prefer a thicker chili add a small can of tomato paste.

title: Hershey Bar Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar; add eggs. Sift flour; add alternately with milk. Stir in syrup. Melt candy bars; add to mixture. Pour in greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients. Form into ball. Chill. Roll in crushed nuts.

title: Twenty-Four Hour Salad
instructions: Mix jello in 2 cups of hot water and cool in refrigerator until partially set. Beat cream cheese and sugar together. Add jello and lemon juice and beat well. Stir in Cool Whip until well blended. Add marshmallows oranges and crushed pineapple. You may add one cup of white grape halves also if you wish.

title: Zebra Linebacker Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine meat barbecue sauce and pepper; heat thoroughly stirring occasionally. Fill rolls with meat mixture and process cheese food; wrap in foil. Bake 10 minutes. Makes 6 sandwiches. Preparation time 15 minutes. Cooking time 10 minutes.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Combine and simmer the chili sauce 1/4 cup finely grated onion and the cranberry sauce. Combine hamburger and onion and make into 1-inch meatballs. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over meatballs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: English Toffee
instructions: In a 2 to 3-quart saucepan melt butter over low heat. Add the sugar and stir constantly over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Then add the corn syrup and continue to cook over a medium-high heat stirring constantly until temperature reaches 297\u00b0 (do not undercook). Remove from heat. Add salt and nuts and gently mix in.

title: Rhubarb Salad
instructions: Cook rhubarb with sugar. Cool. Dissolve jello in hot water let cool. Add pineapple celery nuts and rhubarb. Chill for several hours.

title: Seasoned Oyster Crackers
instructions: Place crackers in paper bag.\tMix rest in a bowl and add remaining ingredients. Shake well and serve.

title: Chicken Or Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Put remaining noodles on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Squirrel And Dumplings
instructions: Salt and pepper to taste. Put squirrels in 5-quart boiler. Cover with water and boil until tender. Remove meat; debone and set aside.

title: Apple Crisp(Microwave)
instructions: In microwaveable pan place apples in bottom and simply add all other ingredients on top. Blend prior if preferred. Microwave 5 to 7 minutes on High.

title: Chicken Crescent Rolls
instructions: Cut up cooked chicken. Separate crescent rolls. Place about 1 tablespoon chicken on the wide end of the crescent and roll up. Combine soup cheese butter milk and pepper and heat until smooth. Pour 1/3 of the sauce on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken rolls on sauce and pour rest of the sauce over. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until tops of rolls are golden brown. Serves 10 (2 rolls each).

title: Ashville Salad
instructions: Heat soup and cheese then add gelatine that has been dissolved in cold water. Add mayonnaise celery peppers pecans and onion juice. Put in oblong pan and top with sliced olives. Chill.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Mix all remaining ingredients except crumbs or crackers. Pour mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle crumbs over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Squash Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolk well. Add sugar butter squash milk salt and cornstarch. Mix together and add vanilla. Over medium heat bring mixture to a complete boil. Pour into baked pie crust. Spoon meringue on top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes until brown.

title: Punch For A Crowd(60 People)
instructions: Ginger ale is added the very last minute. Serve over ice cubes in a large punch bowl. If necessary add 1 ginger ale. Get ready 1/2 hour ahead.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Using a foil casserole pan put cooked vegetables in the bottom. Cover with mixture of eggs soup milk and cheeses. Top with crushed Ritz crackers; dab approximately 3 tablespoons margarine on top of crackers. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour until browned and bubbly.

title: Chicken Pie With Sweet Potato Crust
instructions: Put a layer of chicken in 2-quart baking dish a layer of green pepper and then a layer of onions. Sprinkle with parsley. Repeat until all vegetables are used.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake yellow cake mix as directed. Cut cake in half. Break one half in bowl. Add 1 box pudding mix (mixed as for pudding) 1 can crushed pineapple and 1/2 can cherry pie filling. Then add a little Cool Whip and one sliced banana. Then repeat with more layers of same. Slice a banana on top; cover with Cool Whip and top with nuts. Let set in refrigerator.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: In small bowl blend pie filling mix whipped topping mix milk and vanilla on low speed of electric mixer. Increase speed to high and beat until very thick about 3 minutes. Pour 1/3 of mixture into crust. Layer slices of banana on top reserving 1/2 banana for garnish. Pour remaining filling into crust. Chill until set about 1 hour. Garnish with banana slices and additional whipped topping if desired. To prevent darkening dip banana slices for garnishing in lemon juice.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except cheese potato chips and almonds. Place salad in a 2-quart Pyrex oblong casserole. Top with cheese potato chips and almonds. Refrigerate overnight. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 45 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Grilled Vegetable Kabobs With Rice
instructions: Combine dressing parsley and basil in small bowl; cover and chill. Alternate squash onion tomatoes and mushrooms on 8 skewers. Spray grill rack with vegetable spray; place on grill over medium heat. Place kabobs on rack and cook 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender turning and basting frequently with dressing mixture. Serve with 1/2 cup rice on each plate and top with 2 vegetable kabobs. Serves 4.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening. Add egg bananas and cream. Add flour baking powder salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Mix well. Add oatmeal and walnuts. Mix well. Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Heavenly Yogurt
instructions: Spray a saute pan with nonstick cooking spray lightly. Brown banana; add orange juice apples and optional fruit. Continue cooking on medium heat until apples are softened and orange juice is reduced. Spoon over yogurt and sprinkle with granola.

title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and brown sugar a little at a time. Beat well. Add white granulated sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Beat 3 minutes. Sift together dry ingredients; add alternately with milk to creamed mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in a tube pan which has been greased and floured. Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Orange Sauce For Pork
instructions: Heat ingredients stirring to thicken and mixture is clear. Coat pork with sauce. Also good to use as a sauce after pork is cooked.

title: Lickety Split Banana Split Pie
instructions: Slice bananas into bottom of crust. Spoon softened ice cream on top. Freeze for 2 hours. Top with unheated hot fudge pineapple preserves whipped topping chopped nuts and a maraschino cherry.

title: Yogi Popsicles
instructions: Mix well and freeze in molds. Three ounce paper cups work well as molds. Insert wooden sticks or spoons for handles.

title: Field Mouse Casserole
instructions: Boil macaroni 10 minutes. While it is being cooled fry mice long enough to get the fat out. Drain macaroni. Grease casserole with the fat from the field mice. Layer the mice macaroni onions and tomatoes. Repeat layers until all are used. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and grated cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until mice are well done.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Toss together and pour over the following combined ingredients

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook the sweet potatoes and then mash them. Combine all of the ingredients together in a mixing bowl and then pour into the unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef chopped onion and bell pepper. Drain oil; add all dry ingredients then add tomatoes water tomato sauce tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 1 hour or until well done.

title: Aunt Bea'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs; beat until fluffy. Add lemon juice vanilla and pecans. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until center is set.

title: Sausage Breakfast Pie
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Line pie shell with Mozzarella cheese. Crumble sausage over cheese. Cover sausage with Cheddar cheese. Beat eggs and milk. Pour over sausage and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add mashed bananas and eggs. Sift dry ingredients and combine; add vanilla. Bake in greased loaf pan in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Combine peaches sugar salt egg flour butter and cinnamon. Pour this mixture into a prepared 6 1/2 x 10-inch rectangular dish or a 10-inch pie pan lined with pastry. Roll out second recipe for pastry and cut in strips and put on top of the pie. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Tropical Fruit Salad(No Fat, Low Sugar)
instructions: Drain fruit salad. Combine cottage cheese and yogurt. Layer in glasses or bowl cottage cheese mixture fruit salad and granola.

title: Stuffed Eggplant And Tomatoes(Taua)
instructions: Prepare stuffing Finely chop onion and green pepper and parsley. Food processor with knife blade works great. Add salt pepper paprika allspice to ground meat. Also add tomato paste. Mix with onion pepper and parsley that has been chopped. Set aside. Lay tomato down seam side down and cut slits about 1/2-inch apart. Do not go completely through tomato. Trim eggplant and cut into rounds. Put in colander and sprinkle with salt. Let drain for 20 minutes.

title: Graham Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add milk and egg and beat well. Add melted Crisco. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Mountain Candy
instructions: Leave cheese out of refrigerator overnight at room temperature. Mix all ingredients together with hands. Form into roll or press flat into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Grease 1 (9-inch) pie pan or a 10-inch quiche pan. Scatter drained ham in pan. Evenly scatter cheese over ham. Beat remaining ingredients 15 seconds in blender. Pour into pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Italian Ice Cream
instructions: Melt butter in shallow baking pan. Add almonds stirring to coat with butter. Lightly sprinkle almonds with salt. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden. Cool. Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl; stir well. Spoon into 9-inch square pan. Cover; freeze until firm. Makes about 12 servings.

title: Cherrywinks Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; shape into balls. Crush 2 1/2 cups corn flakes. Roll each ball of dough in corn flakes. Top each cookie with a 1/4 piece of cherry. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cover bottom of large casserole dish with bread cubes. Layer sausage on top and sprinkle with cheese. Beat eggs milk and spices together and pour over cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes the next morning. Serves 6.

title: Okra Casserole
instructions: In 8 x 8-inch pan slice a layer of potatoes then a layer of onion. Repeat with potatoes. Slice butter on top to suit yourself. Cover. Place in microwave for 9 minutes. Remove from microwave. Salt and pepper; sprinkle celery seed on top.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. If using frozen shrimp let it thaw. Mix together the shrimp onion celery and macaroni. Add enough mayonnaise to please yourself. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and chil 3 to 4 hours. Serve. Even better the second day.

title: Heavenly Dirt(Looks And Tastes Great!)
instructions: Pour milk into large bowl adding pudding mix. Beat with whisk until well blended 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in whipped topping and 1/2 of cookies.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Cream cheese and margarine. Add flour salt and pepper. Mix well. Add rice cereal and mix with hands as dough is very stiff. Roll into walnut-size balls and flatten into cookie with fork. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes. Yield 7 to 9 dozen.

title: Meat Loaf Patties
instructions: Mix the ground chuck and eggs together. Wet the 2 slices of bread in warm water; rinse the bread over the ground chuck so that the bread can fall in the bowl. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix everything together. Form a patty in your hand. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook until both sides are brown.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain peaches and pineapple (save juice). Mix Tang and pudding into juice. Mix all together.

title: Ranch Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft (dont overcook). In bowl mix together ranch dressing sour cream bacon bits green onions and chives and 1/2 bag of cheese until well blended. Cut potatoes in quarters and place in large casserole dish. Pour ranch dressing mixture over potatoes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 35 minutes or until cheese has melted and mixture is bubbling up the side of the dish.

title: Old Fashioned Beef Stew
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper. Coat meat with mixture. Brown in shortening thoroughly. Add water potatoes carrots onions and celery. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours and add all the rest of ingredients. If desired thicken stew by shaking in covered jar 1/2 cup cold water and 2 tablespoons flour until blended. Stir into stew. Boil for 1 minute.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding mix oil water and eggs together. Fold in nuts and coconut. Put in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cut a loaf of Italian French or rye bread. Put mix in center and use leftover bread for dipping. Dip freezes well.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Soft)
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening well. Add eggs and milk. Mix well. Add flour soda and baking powder; stir. Ad chocolate chips nuts and vanilla. Stir (will be quite stiff). Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned approximately 20 minutes.

title: Easy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with cheese slices. Spoon soup over chicken. Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Garnish with parsley. Serves 8.

title: White Frosting For Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix flour and salt; slowly add milk. Cook until thick; cool. Beat Crisco and sugar together until fluffy. Add cooled flour mixture to Crisco mixture; beat well. Add vanilla; spread on cake. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix both soups and tomatoes cutting up tomatoes. Add onion and chili powder along with 1 cup cheese. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with 3/4 cup Doritos. Mix chicken with soup mixture and pour over Doritos. Put remaining Doritos and cheese on top. Cover and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube or Bundt pan. Mix ingredients (except chocolate chips) thoroughly with beater. Add chocolate chips (can use whole bag). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Can be baked in loaf pan or cupcake tins.

title: Green Tomato Bread
instructions: Place green tomatoes in blender; puree then strain to get out all the liquid. In a large bowl beat together sugar eggs green tomatoes salt oil vanilla and almond. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and cinnamon. Add to egg mixture. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes or until done. Cool on wire rack and remove from pans. Bread may be frozen for future use if desired.

title: Venison Stew
instructions: Salt and pepper venison cubes; brown lightly in 2 tablespoons butter or oil. Put celery and onion in crock-pot. Add browned meat cubes and remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low 7 to 12 hours (high 4 to 6 hours) stirring occasionally. Serve over rice or buttered noodles.

title: Lemon Ginger Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise sour cream sugar lemon peel lemon juice ginger and salt; stir well. Add chicken grapes and celery. Toss to coat well. Cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving. Can be served in melon halves with toasted almond slivers sprinkled on top.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: In saucepan bring to boil 1 cup berries and water; simmer 2 minutes. Sieve berry mixture. Add sugar and cornstarch. Cook over medium heat until thick. Spread 1/4 cup glaze on bottom and sides of baked pie shell. Mix 5 cups strawberries with remaining glaze. Pour into greased pie shell. Chill 3 hours. Top with whipped cream.

title: Pesto And Sundried Pasta
instructions: Process basil olive oil pine nuts and 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese in food processor. Toss with noodles remaining Parmesan cheese and sundried tomatoes. Ready to serve.

title: Deluxe Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni per package directions. Rinse and set aside. Combine the next 6 ingredients; add macaroni and stir well. Spoon into lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fri-Bake Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Fry onions green peppers and chicken on both sides for 5 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Pictsweet Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry meat in oil. Add soy sauce. Add Chinese stir-fry (follow directions on package). Prepare Rice-A-Roni (follow directions on box). Add rice mix to vegetable mix. Add water chestnuts. Add soy sauce as needed.

title: Chicken With Mushrooms And Sour Cream
instructions: Cut each chicken breast into 1/2-inch strips. Melt butter in large skillet over high heat. Add chicken and scallions sprinkled with salt. Cook chicken strips until lightly browned. Add undiluted mushroom soup sliced mushrooms with liquid and 1/4 cup water. Heat to boiling stirring until smooth. Reduce heat and add sour cream. Do not boil. Serve over hot cooked rice. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chicken Broccoli Soup
instructions: Boil water with can of broccoli soup. Stir in chicken pieces. Add butter. Let boil. Add cooked rice. To make it thicker lessen butter and water. Can pour over rice if desired. Makes a nice pot of soup.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Combine the sugar liqueur cognac and cherry juice and cherries if desired. Just before serving add remaining ingredients. This punch is beautiful served in a silver bowl with a fancy ice block floating in it. This recipe serves 10.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and blend in. Combine dry ingredients. Add 1/3 of dry ingredients to liquid mixture; mix thoroughly. Then add 1/3 milk and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Repeat adding dry ingredients and milk until completely used. Mash 1/2 cup of blueberries and stir into mixture by hand. Fold in remaining 2 cup of blueberries until thoroughly mixed. Grease muffin tin with shortening (even top of pan). Flour pan. Add mix to pan. Sprinkle tops with sugar. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Test middle of muffin with toothpick to make sure it is completely done.

title: Grilled Honey Burgers
instructions: In a bowl combine honey cinnamon paprika curry powder ginger and nutmeg. Add beef and mix well. Shape into 8 (3/4-inch) thick patties. Grill uncovered over medium heat for 3 minutes on each side; brush with soy sauce. Continue cooking for several minutes until juices run clear basting and turning several times. During last few minutes grill pineapple slices until lightly browned turning once.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix last 5 ingredients together. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with Pam. Dip chicken in melted butter and roll in dry mixture. Place on prepared pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until tender and brown.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into a ball and chill.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix everything but soup and Gravy Master. Pack on a cookie sheet; let stand overnight in fridge. Cut into squares. Coat in flour and fry in a little Crisco until brown. Drain on paper towels. Cover with the 4 cans of soup that have been diluted with 4 cans of water and enough Kitchen Bouquet to make brown. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve with mashed potatoes covered with the gravy mixture.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix 3 eggs and butter; spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Combine cream cheese with 2 eggs and box of powdered sugar. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Greektown Dressing
instructions: Combine in cruet and shake vigorously. Chill before using.

title: Shamrock Shakes
instructions: In a blender place 1 scoop vanilla ice cream 1 cup milk and 2 drops of green food coloring. If desired add 1/4 teaspoon peppermint flavoring. Blend until smooth then pour into cups. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Rouladen
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Shrimp Dip #2
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Thaw artichokes and drain thoroughly. Chop into small pieces. Add all ingredients and blend well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with crackers.

title: Two Cheese Salad Dressing
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine cheeses sour cream mustard and lemon juice. Beat at medium speed until light. Stir in vegetables and fold in whipped cream. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before stirring again and serving. May be stored in the freezer and thawed before serving.

title: Lemon Cheese Bars
instructions: Mix dry cake mix 1 egg and 1/3 cup oil until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup. Pat remaining mixture lightly in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Beat cheese sugar lemon juice and 1 egg until light and smooth. Spread over baked layer. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Bake for 15 minutes. Let cool and cut into bars.

title: Chili Cheese Soup
instructions: This is the quickest easiest soup to make and it is wonderful thick and hearty.

title: York Sensational Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In large bowl with spoon or wire whisk stir butter sugar and vanilla. Add eggs; stir until well blended. Stir in flour cocoa baking powder and salt; blend well. Reserve 2 cups batter; set aside.

title: French Meat Pie
instructions: In skillet heat oil over medium heat. Saute onion until tender. Remove and set aside. Brown meat. Drain. Combine all ingredients except pastry.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Mix all together until well moistened. Bake in 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Oil Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a quart jar and shake it until the sugar dissolves. Stir well before using.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix spinach sour cream mayonnaise and water chestnuts. Stir in soup mix. Stir until all ingredients are mixed well. Chill and serve with wheat crackers.

title: Belles Waffles
instructions: Beat eggs oil and milk together; add dry ingredients and vanilla. This batter is better if it sets overnight. Pour recommended amount in waffle iron and cook according to waffle iron instructions.

title: Freezer Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions on box. Making 2 round layers. Split layers in half making 4 layers after cooling. Blend sugar sour cream and coconut. Spread all but 1 cup between layers. Blend remaining cup of sour cream mixture with cool whip. Spread on top and sides of cake. Seal in air tight container and place in freezer. Leave in freezer for at least 2 days. Set out 2 hours before cutting. Refrigerate after cutting.

title: Curried Rice Salad
instructions: Mix onions vinegar oil curry and rice. Marinate about 2 hours ahead. Add rest when ready to serve.

title: Mock Cranberry Collins
instructions: In a tall glass pour cranberry juice cocktail and lime juice over ice cubes. Top with club soda. Stir. Makes 1 serving.

title: Overnight Veggies
instructions: Combine peas green beans corn onion celery and pimento in a large bowl. Combine in saucepan the sugar vegetable oil white wine vinegar salt and black pepper. Heat until sugar dissolves. Pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Vegetable Hot Dish
instructions: Cook vegetables until just about done and drain. In hot dish mix soup sour cream vegetables and water chestnuts. Bake for 1/2 hour. Add cheese and bake 5 minutes more. Add onions and bake about 2 minutes more at 350\u00b0. Serve hot.

title: Sweet And Sour Teriyaki
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on box; set aside. Brown ground beef in 12-inch skillet; drain. Mix all ingredients except rice in beef. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes. Pour over cooked rice; mix well.

title: Mississippi Sausage Cornbread
instructions: Brown sausage in medium skillet and heat. Drain well and set aside. Combine cornmeal and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir well and pour half of batter into a greased 10-inch cast-iron skillet. Arrange sausage on top of batter. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup cheese. Spread remaining half of batter over cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes; sprinkle with remaining 3/4 cup cheese. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Shrimp Elegante
instructions: Peel shrimp leaving tails on; devein and butterfly. Place shrimp in salted boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain and place in a shallow broiling pan.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add onion egg and buttermilk; beat well. Drop balls into deep fryer. Fry until they float on top of oil. Drain on a paper towel.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 12 cup fluted tube pan. In large bowl blend cake mix eggs oil water brown sugar and cinnamon until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at highest speed. Fold in shredded carrots raisins and nuts. Spoon into tube pan. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool upright 25 minutes. Cool completely before serving.

title: Easy Blueberry Pie
instructions: Cook thawed blueberries in 1 1/2 cups water for 5 minutes. Add sugar and orange juice; cook for 5 minutes longer. Combine cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water; mix well. Add cornstarch mixture to blueberry mixture stirring until thickened. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Pour into pie shell. Cover with fresh blueberries. Serve cold with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar butter and milk for 9 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add chips Marshmallow Whip vanilla and nuts. Beat until mixed well. Pour into pan. Makes 5 pounds.

title: Grandma'S Grape Juice
instructions: Clean and scald 4 1/2 gallon canning jars. Put 2 cups clean grapes in each jar. Add 1 cup sugar per jar. Fill with boiling water. Adjust lids. Process in water bath for 30 minutes. Best if not used for at least 3 to 4 months.

title: Periogies
instructions: Combine ingredients. Roll dough in a large circle. Cut into big squares. Fill the dough with the potato or cheese filling. Squeeze ends tight and place in boiling water until they float. Rinse in cold water. Drain well then pan fry in butter. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Apricot Squares
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add egg and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture. Press 2/3 of mixture into cookie sheet (will cover about 3/4 of pan). Spread apricot preserves over this. Put rest of mixture over the top in small pieces.

title: Chili Bean Dip
instructions: Prepare chili. Fry refried beans until pasty. Layer Chili on bottom sour cream refried beans and Cheddar cheese. Bake until cheese melts. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain apricots 1 hour (very dry). Sprinkle Jell-O over them and stir. Add Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Mix together. Chill.

title: Anna'S Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and bananas. Mix well. Mix flour and baking soda together; add to mixture. Add nuts and mix well. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Marbella
instructions: Combine these ingredients and marinate overnight. Place chicken and marinade in shallow baking pan. Sprinkle 1 cup white wine and 1 cup brown sugar. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 basting frequently. Transfer to serving dish. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Spicy Pecan Apple Salad
instructions: Melt butter. Mix salt cinnamon cayenne pepper and pecans with butter. Bake pecan mixture at 350 for 15 min. or until golden brown. Set aside. To prepare dressing mix together sherry wine vinegar dry mustard and olive oil. Set aside. Toss together greens chopped apple and feta cheese. Add pecans and dressing to greens mixture.

title: Snack Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and stir in crackers. Stir until well mixed. Will freeze well.

title: Strawberry Pecan Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix milk eggs and oil; mix until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Put into layer cake pans and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done. Let cool on rack and then frost.

title: Cream Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Let first 5 ingredients chill in refrigerator overnight. Spread on room temperature tortillas. Roll up and cut. Hold in place with toothpicks. Serve with picante sauce or salsa.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs then the banana. Mix in the Jiffy mix. Pour into greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350 until done.

title: Fresh Apple Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cinnamon and sugar; set aside. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Stir in apples milk and vanilla. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture and stir well. Add walnuts. Batter will be very thick. Spoon 1/3 of batter in greased loaf pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon mixture. Repeat 2 more times ending with cinnamon mixture on top. Bake 1 hour or until center is set. Yield 1 large loaf.

title: Cheese And Sausage Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll into walnut size balls. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Whip the Dream Whip and cream cheese. Whip again and add sugar. Mix well spread over pretzels. Top with pie filling.

title: Chicken Breast Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in pieces place in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Dilute chicken soup to gravy consistency. Heat pour over chicken. Spoon prepared stuffing over soup. Dot with butter if desired. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly and slightly brown.

title: Pineapple Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch square or oblong baking dish. (I use Pam.) Blend ingredients and pour into prepared pan. Bake 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Yellow Angel Food Cake
instructions: Separate eggs 1 hour before making cake. Beat egg yolks well. Beat 1/2 cup cold water into the egg yolks. Add the sugar gradually and beat after each addition. Add the flour baking powder and salt (sifted together) gradually folding in each addition. Add vanilla.

title: Chocolate Crunch Cookies
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Grease cookie sheets.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add marshmallow cream nuts and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Granny Clara'S Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 1-quart casserole. Crumble prefried bacon over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Corn Saladroswell, New Mexico
instructions: Combine toss cover and chill. Can be prepared a day in advance.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Tear up lettuce. Slice tomato. Put all in large bowl and toss! (Left overs are good but Doritos will get soft.)

title: Apple Stake Cake
instructions: Use a box of spice cake mix. Make according to the directions on box. Cook apples until tender and add sugar to taste. Stake with 2 cups dried apples. A good cake.

title: Oriental Coleslaw
instructions: Mix coleslaw and onions. Break up dry noodles from soup mix. Add noodles almonds and sunflower seeds to coleslaw mix. (Dont add noodles too far in advance as noodles will get soggy.) When ready to serve add dressing and toss together well.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Mix evaporated milk and sugar with margarine stirring until it comes to a rolling boil. Boil and stir for 8 minutes. Remove from heat. Add chocolate bits Marshmallow Fluff nuts and vanilla and mix until smooth with wooden spoon. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. When cool score. Makes 5 pounds.

title: Beulah'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well and set aside. Combine Karo sugar and margarine in deep saucepan. Cook over medium to medium-high until rolling boil. Take off heat. Add vanilla. Add this to beaten eggs. Add pecans. Divide into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm (approximately 1 hour).

title: Squash Pie
