instructions: Mix sugars and flour together. Add milk and eggs to it. Put on stove. Let it come to a boil stirring constantly. Wait until ready to put in pie shell to add 1 tablespoon butternut vanilla flavoring. Put in unbaked pie crust. Have oven preheated to 450\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Pop Cake #2(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Bake the cake mix in an oblong 9 x 13 pan. When done punch full of holes and pour the strawberry pop over this while cake is hot. Mix up the Jell-O with 1 cup of water and also pour over cake. Put in the refrigerator to cool. When cool ice.

title: Sangria (Spanish Wine Punch)
instructions: Combine juices wine rum and sugar. Stir to dissolve sugar. Slice orange thinly. Cut slices in half. Add orange slices maraschino cherries and cinnamon stick to wine mixture. Let stand one hour. Remove cinnamon stick. Pour into water goblets one-quarter filled with cracked ice or small ice cubes. Yields 12 to 24 servings.

title: Sausage Squares
instructions: Combine biscuit mix with milk and 2 tablespoons mayonnaise. Spread in oblong baking pan (do not grease). Mixture will be very thin but spread evenly into the corners. Meanwhile brown sausage in skillet stirring often to break up. Add onion and continue stirring and cooking until meat is brown and onion crisp-tender. Drain well. Spread sausage mixture evenly over biscuit dough. In medium mixing bowl stir together the egg grated cheese and remaining mayonnaise and green chilies. Spread on top of sausage and press down lightly. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. This can be baked ahead.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix Cool Whip pineapple milk lemon juice and nuts. Divide mixture between 2 pie shells. Chill.

title: German Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix by directions on box. Place 1/3 batter in a greased and floured tube pan. Place 1/2 of dry frosting mix on cake batter. Place 1/3 of chocolate chips and 1/3 of pecans over this. Repeat layers. Then place last 1/3 of batter on top. Sprinkle with remainder of chocolate chips and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. May glaze or sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Sweet Sour Meatballs
instructions: Melt Velveeta cheese. Mix all together and roll into 1-inch balls. Roll out and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chess Pie(Old Southern)
instructions: Beat all the above well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole Deluxe
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except crackers and melted margarine) and put in a casserole dish. Put finely crushed crackers on top and pour melted butter over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Apple Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine first 3 ingredients. Blend until crumbly. Press 2 3/4 cups of mixture into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Add remaining ingredients except apples to the rest of mixture. Blend well. Stir in apples. Spoon over base. Bake 25 to 35 minutes until toothpick tests clean.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Have oleo at room temperature. Pat graham cracker crumbs and one stick oleo into a long Pyrex dish. Mix confectioners sugar one stick oleo cream cheese and eggs until melted. (Note Use double boiler and beat eggs before adding to mix.)

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Saute onion and celery in oil. Combine sauteed onion and celery with bread crumbs egg and Mozzarella cheese. Roll mixture in chicken breasts and secure with toothpicks. Mix soup and milk until diluted to a pouring consistency and cover chicken breasts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Butter-Brickle Cake
instructions: Blend together for 3 minutes. Spread half the batter in 9 x 13 cake pan. Sprinkle half the sugar mixture then the rest of the batter and sugar mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Easy Cheesy Vegetable Delight
instructions: Put 1/2 of precooked drained vegetables in a layer on the bottom of a large casserole. Put 1/2 of cheese and 1/2 of crackers in next layer. Then layer the rest of vegetables. On top spread rest of cheese crackers and melted butter. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Creamy Horseradish
instructions: Whip cream and fold in rest of ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Peachy Rice
instructions: Boil rice in salt water until soft. Drain and rinse in cold water. Beat well eggs in a bowl. Add cream milk and sugar. Beat until well blended. Add rice and mix. Butter 9 x 13-inch pan and pour mixture into pan. Drain peaches well. Lay on top of rice mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Breast And White Bean Salad
instructions: Season chicken with thyme salt and pepper. In large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat add 1 tablespoon oil. Add chicken and brown for 2 minutes reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 2 minutes per side. Remove and reserve. Add zucchini onion and dried tomatoes. Saute briefly; add beans and toss until heated thoroughly.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Mix and add milk to fill one-gallon freezer. Freeze. This is very rich and creamy.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Prebake pie crusts at 400\u00b0 until just beginning to turn golden. Cool. In large bowl combine both sugars and flour. Set aside. In another bowl combine eggs milk and vanilla and set aside.

title: Taco Mac Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Drain; rinse with cold water and drain again. Brown meat and drain fat. Add taco seasoning and mix well. Cool. In a large bowl mix macaroni green pepper onion cheese tomatoes lettuce and seasonings. Chill. Just before serving stir in seasoned ground beef French dressing and corn chips. Toss lightly. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Veggie Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables into 1/2-inch pieces. Cook potatoes and zucchini in water until just tender. Combine with potatoes and add raw celery. While hot toss with cilantro parsley and cider vinegar. Combine oil garlic white vinegar salt and pepper. Toss with salad and chill.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Combine raisins and water in saucepan and bring to a boil for 3 minutes. Let cool (do not drain) cream sugar and shortening together. Add eggs and vanilla; combine dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture and blend thoroughly. Stir in nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonful 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Beverly'S Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon. Pour into baking dish. Top with sliced bacon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Drain 1 can of pork and beans. Add all ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for an hour or so.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Press can of crescent rolls onto pizza pan and bake 12 to 15 minutes. Spread with cream cheese. Top with salsa. Sprinkle on diced grated veggies. Top with shredded cheese. Chill 2 hours. Slice and serve.

title: Black-Eyed Peas And Ham Hock
instructions: Cook ham hock until done reserving 3 cups liquid. Add black-eyed peas to boiling liquid and ham hock. Cook slowly until peas are soft. Season to taste.

title: Blueberry Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange blueberries in an ungreased 8 x 8-inch square pan. Mix the sugar flour oats margarine and salt; sprinkle on top. Bake until topping is light brown or 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Easy Italian Chicken
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet. Wash chicken. While still wet coat with bread crumbs. Fry chicken in hot oil until nicely browned. Pour spaghetti sauce into 9 x 13-inch pan. Place browned chicken on sauce. Top each breast with a slice of Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese to taste. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven and bake approximately 30 minutes until cheese bubbles.

title: Wanda'S Little Debbie Bars
instructions: Make 36 or more Ritz peanut butter cracker sandwiches. Melt the almond bark in microwave. Dip each sandwich in the melted almond bark. Place each dipped sandwich on wax paper or aluminum foil to dry.

title: Rancho Baked Beans
instructions: Cook hamburger meat and onions in fat until brown. Add other ingredients. Put in uncovered dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Asparagus And Pea Casserole
instructions: Make cream sauce of first 3 ingredients. Add cayenne pepper and cheese; set aside. Mix cracker crumbs with 1 stick melted butter; set aside. In buttered casserole add in layers the asparagus peas half of cracker crumbs and mushrooms. Top with sauce followed by other half of cracker crumbs. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Smoked Sausage And Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook rice and keep warm. Saute vegetables in oil until crisp and tender. Add sausage and season to taste. Heat thoroughly. Mix in 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Stir over rice and sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Serves 6.

title: Raisin-Spice Drops
instructions: Sift flour or flour mixture with spices. In large bowl at medium speed beat shortening sugar eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. At low speed beat in flour mixture. Stir in raisins and walnuts. Refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Vanilla Cream Pie
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole mix together sugar cornstarch and salt. Gradually add milk mixing well. Cook with microwave on High 4 to 6 minutes or until thick stirring every minute. Beat egg yolks slightly. Gradually add some of the hot mixture to egg yolks stirring constantly. Add combine egg mixture to hot mixture and mix well. Cook with microwave on High 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes until thick stirring every 30 seconds. Add butter and vanilla. Mix well. Pour hot filling into baked pie shell. Cool. Top with whipped cream or meringue. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hilda'S Party Salad(This Is One Of My Special Fruit Salads.)
instructions: Step 1 Dissolve cherry gelatin in 4 cups boiling water. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan or mold. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Layer Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening together. Add sugar. Beat eggs in one at a time. Add flour and milk. Cream together. Add flavoring. Pour into 4 layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Place chicken breasts in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with garlic salt cover each breast with broccoli florets. Mix cream of mushroom soup and 1/2 cup water. Pour over chicken and broccoli. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 375\u00b0 or until broccoli is tender. Remove from oven cover broccoli with Mozzarella cheese. Return to oven uncovered until cheese is melted.

title: Moms Sloppy Joes
instructions: Boil one cup of water and 3/4 cup ketchup. Add one to two tablespoons chili powder. Boil for 7 minutes. Add the ground beef onion salt pepper and mustard. Cook for 20 minutes. Drain off grease.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and onion. Add buttermilk; stir just until corn meal mixture is moistened. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls into deep hot fat (375\u00b0).

title: Cornmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix fat and sugar in large bowl. Add egg and beat well. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Drop dough from teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Mix shortening sugar eggs and bananas together. Add salt soda buttermilk vanilla flour and nuts. Mix well. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Chicken
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Marinate chicken pieces 2 hours or overnight in Ziploc bag. Shake drained chicken in cornstarch (only need a small amount to just dust the chicken). Place in buttered baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine marinade pineapple and juice juice of lemon and orange juice. Pour over chicken and continue baking 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with rice. Will thicken as baking. Overcooking will result in less liquid. I add extra orange juice.

title: Coconut Cake Topping
instructions: Bake any white cake mix. When done have already mixed the remaining ingredients. Pour over warm cake and brown under broiler. Watch closely. Serve warm.

title: Creamy Parmesan Cheese Sauce
instructions: Microwave cream cheese milk and Parmesan cheese in 1 quart measure. Microwave on Medium (50%) for 6 to 8 minutes or until sauce is smooth stirring every 2 minutes. Stir in seasonings. Toss with hot cooked pasta. Can add diced turkey or crab.

title: Jello Punch
instructions: Heat enough water to dissolve sugar and jello (whichever flavor you like\tI use strawberry). Then add pineapple juice and lemon\tjuice;\tfinish\tfilling gallon with water. Shake well; chill.

title: Layered Delight
instructions: Crust Mix flour nuts and melted butter. Spread in oblong pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Cook squash and onions until tender. Drain. Add margarine. Add salt and sugar to taste. Mash up cornbread and add to squash mixture until right consistency. Bake.

title: Joe'S Fish
instructions: Place catfish fillets in casserole-type dish and pour lemon juice over fish. Leave for one hour. Place fillets on charcoal grill and baste with melted margarine. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes (depending on grill temperature). After turning fillets baste again and cook for another 15 to 20 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Peaches And Cream
instructions: Mix pudding flour baking powder and salt. Add melted butter milk and egg. Pour into an 8 x 12-inch pan. Cover with drained peaches. Mix cream cheese sugar and 1/2 cup peach juice together. Pour over peaches. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Avocado-Orange Salad
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in container of an electric blender; blend.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except the cinnamon and sugar. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Roll balls into mixture. Bake 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet until lightly brown but soft. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Two Coconut Pies
instructions: Cream together sugar butter and egg yolks. Add milk and vanilla. Set aside. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold egg whites into cream mixture. Add coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chili Con Carne (Beef, Lamb, Pork Or Veal)(No.  K-114)
instructions: Wash beans thoroughly. Cover with cold water; soak 8 hours. Cover and heat to boiling point. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until tender but not split or mushy. Drain.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Grease baking dish with margarine. Add water rice and mushrooms. Sprinkle onion soup on top; dot with margarine. Arrange chicken pieces on top cover. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain water off vegetables. Mix sugar water and vinegar in a large mixing bowl. Add all vegetables and mix thoroughly. Cover bowl and let set in refrigerator for at least 12 hours.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix pineapple and pistachio pudding well. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Then add marshmallows and pecans. Place mixture in salad bowl. Place in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: In skillet over medium heat brown meat and cook onions until done. Pour off drippings; stir in corn tomato sauce rice and steak sauce; set aside. Cut top off peppers; remove seed and spoon mixture into peppers. Arrange in baking dish; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Potato-Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Mix soup milk onion salt and pepper. In large casserole dish layer potatoes soup mixture and sausage. Repeat layers ending with sausage. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Sprinkle with cheese; heat until cheese melts.

title: Salad Mix Up
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Refrigerate in large dish and cut into squares.

title: M&M'S Cookie Bar
instructions: Mix oats flour brown sugar and melted butter; reserve 1 1/2 cups for later use. Put the remaining in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Mix thawed lemonade Cool Whip milk and food coloring. Pour into pie plate lined with crushed crackers and butter (melted). Chill.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Blend ingredients then turn into pie plate. Using tips of fingers press into plate. Prick with fork. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Heat a small amount of oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Drop by tablespoon into pan. Fry until edges look dry. Turn. Fry until done.

title: Potatoes, Pasta And Rice
instructions: *Such as parsley chives thyme sage or 2 to 3 teaspoons dried herbs (your choice).

title: English Trifle
instructions: Bake cake according to package directions. Thaw strawberries and prepare pudding according to package directions. Take a sewing thread and moving it back and forth cut one (9-inch) layer horizontally. Place bottom half of the layer in a casserole dish. Layer with strawberries and pudding. Place the top of the cake layer on top of this and top with another layer of strawberries and pudding. Top with a thick layer of Cool Whip to fill the bowl. Sprinkle with pecans. Chill until served.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put all ingredients through blender at highest speed. The finer you can crush the ice the better. Makes about 3 glasses. Drink slowly if not you can get an instant headache.

title: Fruit Salad Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart container. Add water and ice to fill container.

title: Fig Strawberry Jam
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bring to a boil for 3 minutes. Place in jars. Seal and let set one or two days before freezing.

title: Fresh Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix in large bowl and add dressing.

title: Bucaroon Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar brown sugar shortening and eggs. Sift and add dry ingredients. Add oats chips vanilla and pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all together in mixer until blended. The amount of horseradish can be adjusted according to taste. Serve with crackers or bagel chips.

title: Apple Turnovers
instructions: Roll bread as thin as possible. Cook remaining ingredients over low heat for 5 minutes or until tender. Place 1/2 of apple mixture on one slice of bread. Moisten edges with water and fold over in a triangle. Repeat with 2nd slice of bread. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 7 minutes or until browned.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: In small bowl beat butter with an electric mixer until creamy. Add sugar 1/2 cup at a time and beat well after each addition. Add vanilla and milk. Beat well. This frosting can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 2 weeks. Whip again before using.

title: Mama'S Apple Cobbler
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Melt butter in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish or pan. Heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour until crumbs are fine. Add milk and stir with fork only until dough leaves sides of bowl. Turn out onto lightly floured board and knead just until smooth. Roll dough into large rectangle about 1/4-inch. Sprinkle cinnamon over apples. Roll up dough like a jelly roll. Dampen the edge of dough with a little water and seal. Slice dough into about 16 slices 1/2-inch thick. Pour sugar syrup carefully over rolls. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Orange Mandarin Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Beat cream cheese and unprepared jello together. Fold in sour cream and Cool Whip. Fold in fruit. (Make sure fruit is well drained.) Chill and serve.

title: Bacon And Tomato Casserole
instructions: Cook bacon; drain off some grease. Saute onion and pepper in the rest for about 5 minutes. Add tomatoes (chopped up) brown sugar salt pepper and seasoned pepper. Pour into casserole; break bacon up into it and put toasted bread crumbs on top. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: In 2-quart oblong baking dish combine broccoli and cauliflower.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix and add 4 cups cold water. Put in containers and freeze. Before serving add 1 quart ginger ale in punch bowl with frozen punch.

title: Preacher Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar milk cocoa and butter. Bring to a boil exactly 1 minute. Remove from heat and add the peanut butter oatmeal and vanilla. Drop by spoonful on aluminum foil and let harden.

title: Munchy Crunch
instructions: Melt the chips together. Add chow mein noodles and mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool and serve.

title: Hungarian Coffee Cake
instructions: Soften yeast in water for 5 minutes then stir until blended. Measure sugar salt and shortening into mixing bowl. Add hot milk and stir until shortening is broken into small lumps. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in 2 cups of flour to make thick batter. Beat 100 stokes until smooth and elastic. Add yeast and eggs; stir until blended. Stir in 1 1/2 to 2 cups flour and work in enough flour so dough isnt sticky. Turn dough on floured board and knead for 2 minutes about 100 strokes. Shape in ball and put into greased bowl; let rise until double in bulk about 1 1/2 hours. Punch down and use half to form small ball. Dip in melted shortening and roll in a mixture of brown sugar cinnamon and chopped nuts. Arrange in tube pan rubbed with shortening and sprinkle with halves of pecans and seedless raisins. Add another layer until half full. Cover and let rise until double in size about 50 minutes. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until golden brown. Turn out of mold immediately and cool on cake rack. Very delicious and fattening.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Simmer meat in water just to cover for 1 1/2 hours. Cook onions in butter until golden. Add meat to onions; cook until brown. Add mushrooms. Season with spices; simmer for 3 hours. Stir in sour cream over low flame until well blended. Serve over wide noodles. Serves 4.

title: Shepherd'S Bread Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together; hollow out a loaf of Shepherds bread forming a bowl. Pour dip into bread bowl. Use balance of bread cut into small pieces to dip. Makes a great veggie dip too.

title: Orange Glazed Cranberry Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In large bowl mix together flour sugar baking soda pumpkin pie spices salt and baking powder. In second bowl stir together remaining ingredients until well blended. Add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture and stir until all ingredients are well moistened. Pour batter into two 9 1/4 x 5 1/4 x 2-inch greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 minutes or until done with wooden pick. Cool in pans 10 minutes then remove to cooling racks. Completely cool bread then drizzle with glaze. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Chop all vegetables. Measure the 1 cup chopped. Mix everything together and cook 1 1/2 hours. Makes about 5 quarts. Can be frozen.

title: Wyatt'S Pecan Delight Pie
instructions: Whip egg whites on medium speed until soft peaks form. Continue whipping on medium speed while gradually adding sugar and baking powder. Continue to whip until very stiff. Add vanilla and mix well. Add the pecans and crackers; blend well. Use a 9-inch Pyrex pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until lightly brown. When cool add on top of pie the whipped cream. Then sprinkle the 1/4 cup chopped pecans on the cream.

title: Corn-Stuffed Tomato Salad
instructions: Place tomatoes stem end down on a cutting board. Cut each into 4 to 6 wedges cutting to but not through the stem end. Spread wedges apart slightly. Sprinkle with salt. Cover and chill. In small mixing bowl combine dressing parsley pepper and red pepper. In another bowl combine corn cheese bell pepper cucumber and onions. Add dressing mixture; toss gently to coat. Cover; chill. Serve tomatoes filled with corn mixture over lettuce on individual plates. Makes 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook cornstarch sugar and water until thick. Cool slightly. Add jello and stir until jello is dissolved. Cover bottom of cooked cooled pie shell with strawberries. Add cornstarch jello mixture. Top with whipped cream and chill well before serving.

title: Baked Ham With Raisin Sauce
instructions: Wipe off ham with damp cloth or soak in water according to directions. Put ham in roaster skin side up. Add one cup of water for any size ham. Bake 15 minutes per pound at 350\u00b0. Do not open roaster during this time. At the end of baking time remove ham to flat baking pan. Peel off skin; score fat. Top with brown sugar pineapple rings and/or cherries. Blend 1/2 cup brown sugar and dry mustard. Slowly add lemon juice lemon rind flour raisins and water. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick.

title: Prize Winning Wheat 'N Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottoms of 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Crush cereal to 3/4 cup. Beat egg. Stir in milk sugar and shortening. Add remaining ingredients just until moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Divide batter evenly into muffin cups. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Immediately remove from pan. Serve warm.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced squash and onion together in saucepan in small amount of water until tender. Cool and drain. Add beaten egg 1 cup stuffing milk sugar salt and pepper. Melt butter in bottom of casserole dish. Add squash mixture to dish. Top with stuffing and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Put salmon in a 2-quart mixing bowl. Add crumbled crackers and egg. Mix well. Make patties; roll in corn meal mix. Fry in pan with 1/2 inch oil (hot). Fry until golden brown. Serve with French fries and salad. Makes 12 patties.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Sift flour cream of tartar soda and salt. Mix shortening sugar and eggs. Combine all. Chill thoroughly. Roll into balls about the size of small walnuts. Dip one side into sugar and cinnamon mixed. Place balls sugar side up two inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in hot oven (375\u00b0) until lightly browned. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Mix together in a double boiler the soup puree and seasonings. Cook for 1 hour. Saute onion and celery in butter; add to soup mixture. Before serving add soda and milk. Do not boil.

title: Salmon Fillet
instructions: Coat fish on both sides with olive oil. Add salt and pepper to taste. Squeeze on 1/2 to 1 lemon. Top with slices of garlic and lemon. Bake uncovered 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream the butter and sugars together. Add eggs and mix until blended. Add vanilla. Combine flour salt baking powder & cinnamon. Add to butter mixture on low speed.

title: Cranberry Peach Cobbler
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish put pie filling and cranberry sauce in dish and mix up. Put cake mix in bowl. Add spices. Put in margarine and mix until crumbly. Put this on top of fruit mix. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes until browned lightly. Very good served warm.

title: Baked Yellow Squash
instructions: Steam squash until tender. Mash squash. Add onion 1/2 cup bread crumbs pepper eggs 1/2 stick butter sugar and salt. Combine well. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Pour squash in greased 2-quart baking dish. Melt remaining butter and spread on top. Sprinkle with bread crumbs to suit taste. Bake 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and bananas and applesauce. Stir in flour and soda. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake for 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Irish Cream Liqueur
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender. Mix well and refrigerate. Makes 26 ounces.

title: Beef And Potato Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet cook beef on medium heat until brown. Add onion celery and celery leaves and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in mushroom soup milk Worcestershire sauce 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Pare potatoes and slice thinly. Place half of the potatoes in a greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Spoon half of the ground beef mixture over potatoes repeat with remaining potatoes salt and meat mixture. Cover and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Church Chicken
instructions: Pour box of quick cooking rice into a 10 x 10-inch or 9 x 13-inch baking dish which youve buttered first. Mix the milk and soups and pour over the rice. Place uncooked frying chicken parts over the rice and sprinkle 1/2 package dry onion soup mixture over the top. Cover the dish and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours. Soups can be varied.

title: Ginger Lime Punch
instructions: Pour concentrate into a punch bowl. Add candied ginger; chill 2 hours. Add cold water ice sherbet and ginger ale. Add rum if desired.

title: Sunday  Brunch Casserole
instructions: In a skillet cook bacon until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon; crumble and set aside. In the drippings saute onion and green pepper until tender; remove with a slotted spoon. Beat eggs and milk in a large bowl. Stir in hash browns cheese salt pepper dill onion green pepper and bacon. Transfer to a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 35-45 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Yield 6-8 servings.

title: Spinach And Artichoke Dip
instructions: Shred cheeses. Saute onions and butter. Mix with other ingredients except grated Parmesan cheese and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Top with Parmesan and brown using broiler. Serve with tortilla chips sour cream and salsa.

title: Cranberry Cheese Bars
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour oats 3/4 cup sugar and margarine; mix until crumbly. Reserving 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture press remainder on bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Meanwhile in a small bowl beat cheese until fluffy; gradually beat in milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice; spread evenly over prepared crust. Combine remaining 1 tablespoon sugar and cornstarch; stir in cranberry sauce. Spoon evenly over cheese layer; top with crumb mixture. Bake an additional 40 minutes. Cool and chill.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt 4 candy bars with 1/2 cup butter in saucepan stirring constantly. Set aside. Cream sugar and 1/2 cup butter in mixer bowl until fluffy. Beat in flour and eggs. Stir in buttermilk soda and 2 teaspoons vanilla. Fold in candy mixture. Spoon into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 75 to 90 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool. Melt 2 candy bars and 1/2 cup butter with milk in saucepan stirring constantly. Beat in 1 teaspoon vanilla and confectioners sugar. Frost cooled cake. Serves 16.

title: Cornell Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs. In separate large bowl sift together flours yeast baking powder salt cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Add to first mixture. Add raisins wheat germ and oatmeal. Mix well. Arrange by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheets. Bake until lightly browned at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift flour and\tsugar together. Heat oleo Crisco and cocoa in water. Bring to a boil. Pour boiling mixture over flour and sugar. Add beaten eggs\tmilk soda and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Bake in 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Orange Muffins
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Make well in center of mixture. Combine egg milk orange rind orange juice and oil. Mix well and add to dry ingredients. Stir just enough to moisten. Stir in raisins. Spoon batter into greased muffin pan; fill 2/3 full. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Heat tomato soup; add cream cheese. It wont melt smooth so mix with Mixmaster until smooth. Add celery peppers and onions; heat a few minutes. Remove from heat. Add gelatine. Add mayonnaise and shrimp. Chill. If it sits a while the flavor goes through better.

title: Barley And Bacon Casserole
instructions: In 12-inch saute pan melt butter and cook carrot and onion until softened but not brown about 3 minutes. Add barley and stir until grain turns golden about 5 minutes. Add warm chicken stock and season to taste with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour. The barley should be tender but not mushy. Stir in celery and taste for seasoning. Let stand uncovered for 5 minutes. Serve topped with hot bacon. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Italian Noodle Casserole
instructions: Simmer onion celery and garlic in 2 tablespoons oil. Add hamburger and brown very lightly. Add tomato paste and sauce water and seasonings. Simmer 30 minutes. Cook noodles; drain. Butter 1 1/2-quart casserole. Layer noodles meat and cheese; repeat layers. Bake 30 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Slice onion and pepper in thin round slices. Mix with carrots. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over carrots. Cover and marinate overnight.

title: Cheese Pie
instructions: Blend well. Pour into pie crust. Top with sprinkled nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Boil hamburger meat; add other ingredients. Boil on low for one hour stirring and mashing hamburger meat occasionally. When done spoon excess grease out. If not enough chili powder add to desired taste.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Remove crusts from bread; butter. Place in greased dish. Brown sausage. Crumble and drain. Sprinkle bread with cheese. Combine eggs salt and pepper. Mix. Pour over cheese. Cover and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator fifteen minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set. Serves 8.

title: Bourbon Beef Tenderloin
instructions: Combine all marinade ingredients. Fold the tail end of the beef back onto itself so that the fillet is of uniform thickness; secure with butchers string. Pour marinade over meat; cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours turning over several times during that period. Cook over high heat on oiled grill reserving marinade. Keep lid closed but turn fillet often and baste with marinade occasionally. Fillet is cooked rare in about 30 minutes or when meat thermometer registers 115\u00b0. Remove from fire and cover with foil to retain heat. Let rest for 10 minutes so juices stay in meat.

title: Portobello Mushroom, Tomato And Basil Sandwich(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and saut until brown and juicy about 10 minutes.

title: Carrots Supreme
instructions: Place carrots in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and cook until tender. Meanwhile in a small skillet saute onions in butter until tender. Drain carrots; add onion soup mushrooms and Parmesan cheese. Transfer to a greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through. Yield 8 servings.

title: Lemon Slush Cake
instructions: Crust Mix margarine 2 tablespoons sugar and flour and press in bottom of jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Bake pie shell. Combine beaten eggs sour cream Worcestershire sauce and salt. Grate cheese and fold into mixture. Add bacon and onion rings. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 until golden brown at least 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Add onion and rice. Sprinkle salt and pepper on chicken. Place chicken and pour soups over chicken. Add water and bake covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover the last 15 minutes to brown chicken.

title: Crunch Bars
instructions: Spread saltines on buttered cookie sheet spread with butter sugar and bits. Refrigerate. Cut in 2-inch squares.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Put in heavy saucepan with sugar cinnamon and water. Place 8 biscuits on top. Cover with lid and cook for about 30 minutes. Serve hot with custard sauce or ice cream.

title: Old Fashioned Slush
instructions: Pour boiling water over tea bags. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Remove tea bags squeezing gently. Add sugar and stir until it dissolves. Stir in 6 cups of water whiskey frozen orange juice and frozen lemonade. Cover and freeze at least 8 hours.

title: Honeyed Beets
instructions: Cook beets; cut julienne. Cook onion in oleo until tender. Stir in beets honey etc. Heat until beets are hot. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Fudge Icing
instructions: Bring these ingredients to a boil then beat in enough powdered sugar so it will spread easily. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and spread on cake.

title: Moist Brownies
instructions: Mix flour sugar and cocoa together. Add eggs oil vanilla and nuts. Mix together with spoon do not whip with mixer. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. May be a little soft in center when time is up. Let cool.

title: Orange Congealed Salad(Serves 8)
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water; then add cold water. Set aside. Cook pineapple and sugar in saucepan until sugar dissolves. Add to gelatin mixture and mix well. Refrigerate for one hour. After one hour add whipped topping and cheese. Pour into lightly greased gelatin mold. Refrigerate until set. Unmold cut and serve.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Add other ingredients in layers as listed in that order. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut when cool.

title: Aloha Punch
instructions: Thaw concentrated juices and combine in large jar. Add water and sugar. Stir until sugar dissolves. Chill well. Add ginger ale. Pour punch into punch bowl with blocks of ice. With toothpick fix maraschino cherries in centers of pineapple slices. Float pineapple banana and lime slices on punch. Makes about 20 servings.

title: Sausage Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water; drain. Stir in margarine. Brown sausage; drain. Add to macaroni. Add salt pepper and spaghetti sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Grated cheese may be added to top.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Bars
instructions: Combine honey sugar and salt in saucepan; bring to a full boil. Stir in peanut butter. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla cereals and chocolate chips. Press into 9 x 9-inch buttered pan. Chill 1 hour. Cut into bars.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Boil for 16 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Stir until chocolate is melted. Pour in cake pan.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Pour butter into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs over butter then add milk evenly. Add remaining ingredients in layers evenly. Press down gently. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until lightly browned. Cool cut and serve.

title: Toasted Rice
instructions: Toast rice in heavy uncovered pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Melt butter in heavy pan with tight fitting lid. Brown rice slightly in the butter; pour in liquids and bring to a boil. Turn heat very low; cover and let steam for 25 to 30 minutes. Stir in finely chopped onions including tops and soy sauce. Remove from heat but keep covered and let steam for a few more minutes.

title: Pork Chops With Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops. Season to taste. Place rice in baking dish. Pour orange juice over rice. Arrange browned pork chops on rice. Pour soup over chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook the squash and onion on top of stove until tender. Drain liquid and put in a casserole dish. Mix with the soup and sour cream. Fold in shredded carrots and cheese. Melt 1 stick margarine and mix in the chicken stuffing mix. Put half of the stuffing in the casserole and the rest on top of the casserole. Bake in oven until top of casserole is brown.

title: Creamed Cornbread
instructions: In a large bowl combine corn cornmeal melted butter buttermilk onion eggs and baking soda. Mix well. Place half of batter into a 9-inch greased baking dish. Cover evenly with 1 cup of cheese then all of the diced peppers. Cover with remaining batter and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool for 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Brown Fig Preserves
instructions: Clean figs in water remove stems and cut figs in half. (If desired they can be left whole.) Place in a large pan a dish pan works well. Put 5 pounds of sugar on top heat stove to medium and cook for one minute. Then place on low setting and stir often for about 4 hours until thickened and almost no juice. Allow to cool overnight. Sterilize canning lids rings funnel and dipping spoon in boiling water. Cook jars 10 to 20 minutes in a 200\u00b0 oven. Place figs in jars seal tightly and boil in a water canner 30 minutes. Cool overnight.

title: Sweet And Sour Stew
instructions: Combine flour m.s.g. and pepper. Coat beef with flour mixture. Brown in oil in kettle. Combine water catsup brown sugar vinegar Worcestershire sauce and salt. Pour over beef. Add onion and cook over low heat for about 45 minutes. Add remaining vegetables. Simmer for 1 hour and 30 minutes or 2 hours until beef is done and vegetables are tender. Yields 6 servings.

title: Alexis' Brown Sugar Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream the butter until smooth. Add the sugars. Beat in the eggs and vanilla. Sift the flour salt and soda. Beat into the butter mixture. Add the chocolate chips. Drop 2 to 3 tablespoon of batter onto greased baking sheet 2 inches apart. Bake 8 minutes. Remove from pans with spatula and cool on racks. Makes about 30 cookies.

title: Tomato Rice Soup
instructions: Cook rice and celery in chicken broth. Add remaining ingredients. Heat. Remove chili pod before serving.

title: Slim-Jim Baked Chicken
instructions: Season chicken pieces with garlic salt rubbing well into the flesh. Sprinkle with paprika. Place in a shallow baking pan skin side down. Place larger pieces in the corner and smaller ones in the center. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over chicken.

title: Pizza(Better Than Traditional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Lightly oil 12-inch pizza pan. Sprinkle with cornmeal. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook 2 minutes. Add tomatoes 4 1/2 teaspoons basil or 1/2 teaspoon dried basil 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano salt and pepper. Cook 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Press dough into pan. Cover with sauce. Top with cheese. Sprinkle with remaining basil and oregano. Bake until crust is golden brown about 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Garnish with fresh basil if desired.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Beat the eggs together with the sugar. Mix this with the rest of the ingredients. Pour into a pie pan and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes carrots celery and onions in water until tender. Add milk butter and potato flakes until soup is of desired thickness.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Hard-cook the eggs then immediately crack eggshells and plunge into cold water for a few minutes and slip off the shells. Cut into halves and remove yolks. Mash yolks with deviled ham and parsley. Pile mixture into egg white halves and arrange on serving dish. Garnish with crisp vegetable relishes and green olives.

title: Oat And Wheat Bran Muffin
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all dry ingredients together. In a separate bowl mash bananas whisk in egg milk oil and sugar. Stir liquids into dry mixture. Add apricots. Spoon batter into non-stick muffin pan 2/3 full. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine pudding mix with milk. Add Eagle Brand milk. Spread layer in bottom of dish and cover with a layer of vanilla wafers layer of sliced bananas and a layer of Cool Whip. Repeat until all is used. Reserve some Cool Whip for topping.

title: Broiled On Peanut Butter Frosting
instructions: Mix ingredients. Spread on warm or cooled cakes. Broil 2 to 4 minutes. Watch carefully to avoid burning.

title: Hobo Stew(Low-Fat)
instructions: Combine and simmer for 1 hour until vegetables are cooked. Serve with Parmesan cheese bread and butter.

title: Chocolate Chip Bread
instructions: Pour warm water into bowl. Add yeast and stir until dissolved. Add margarine egg milk brown sugar 2 tablespoons white sugar salt cinnamon and warmed chocolate chips. Stir until very evenly mixed. Add bread flour one cup at a time constantly stirring. Beat until dough is smooth and elastic. Mix at least 10 minutes. Dump mixture onto floured board. Flour hands; knead 10 to 15 minutes. Put dough into lightly greased bowl. Let rise until doubled in size (about 1 1/2 hours). \Rise place\ should be warm dark and draft free. Take dough out of bowl; knead it down a few seconds.

title: Oatmeal Jumbles
instructions: Sift flour and add soda. Measure shortening and next six ingredients into large bowl. Beat vigorously with spoon or electric mixer until well mixed. Stir in flour oats nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoon 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix everything but Cool Whip. Place in pan. Cover with Cool Whip. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Stir all together and put in greased dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Country Skillet Dinner
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in frying pan and cook until beef is brown. Drain excess grease. Add tomato paste water oregano cumin and noodles. Simmer 15 minutes. Put 1/2 of mixture in large casserole dish. Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Use remainder of mix and more Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake until cheese is melted at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Combine in measuring cup the juice and grated rind of an orange plus 2 tablespoons shortening. Fill cup to 3/4 full with boiling water. Pour into\tmixing\tbowl and beat. Add sugar berries and nuts. Add egg. Mix together.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind together and add sugar. Mix well.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and shortening. Add egg water and vanilla and beat together until creamy by hand. Mix together flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Stir in oats. Drop by heaping teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix walnuts and margarine in 9-inch pie plate until well blended. Press into bottom and up sides of pie plate. Refrigerate. Microwave chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the milk in large bowl on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until chocolate is almost melted stirring halfway through heating time. (Stir until chocolate is completely melted.) Beat in cream cheese sugar and remaining milk until well blended. Refrigerate until cooled. Gently stir in whipped topping until smooth. Spoon in crust. Freeze 4 hours. Garnish as desired. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes or until pie can be easily cut.

title: Pickled Beans
instructions: Mix together cold water vinegar and salt. Cook beans until almost done. Wash in cold water. Pack beans in quart jars and fill with water mixture leaving a small space at the top of the jar. Seal tightly.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
instructions: Combine flour salt soda cinnamon and sugar. Combine eggs oil and strawberries. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients. Pour in liquid ingredients and stir only until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in pecans; spoon into two greased loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until done.

title: One Step Lasagna In Microwave(Serving Size: 6)
instructions: Brown beef in skillet. Add spaghetti sauce and water. Combine cottage cheese egg and pepper. In large oblong baking dish spoon 1/2 cup sauce (cover bottom of dish) add a layer of uncooked noodles a layer of meat and sauce mixture a layer of egg and cottage cheese mixture and a layer of Mozzarella. Repeat layers. Cover with plastic wrap. Heat on High for 8 minutes then cook for 30 to 32 minutes on Medium-high (I use 50% power). Top with Parmesan cheese. Let stand covered for 15 minutes.

title: Country Style Chicken Dinner
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In 9 x 13-inch baking dish combine potatoes and 1/2 can fried onions. In small bowl blend soup and milk. Pour 1/2 over potato mixture. Arrange cheese slices over potato mixture. Top with chicken skin side down. Pour remaining soup mixture over chicken.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli raisins and bacon in large bowl; mix well. Mix sweetened condensed milk vinegar mustard egg salt and pepper in bowl. Add desired amount of dressing to broccoli mixture; toss well. Top salad with onion rings. Chill for several hours to several days. May store dressing in refrigerator for several days. Yield 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Caramel Orange
instructions: Place the sliced oranges in a flat dish; pour over the curacao or Grand Marnier and allow to soak. Place sugar and 1 tablespoon water in a small saucepan over high heat and keep shaking the pan to avoid burning. Do not stir. As soon as caramel is pale brown pour over the oranges. Allow to cool before serving. Serves 4.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Grind or put in food processor the first 3 ingredients then mix with pizza sauce. Spread over open buns. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese bubbles about 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar and beat again. Add egg molasses and beat. Add remaining ingredients which have been sifted together. (I put dough in refrigerator until its firm and use a glass to press down before baking.) Roll dough into balls size of small walnuts. Roll in sugar and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk until thick. Blend in sour cream and Cool Whip. Alternate layers of wafers bananas and pudding ending with pudding layer. Chill and serve.

title: Hollandaise Carrots
instructions: Place all ingredients in covered saucepan (or frying pan) and cook over very low heat. Shake once in a while to keep from burning.

title: Bleu Cheese Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts together. Form into a ball. Place on a flat plate. Pat chopped nuts over the cheese ball. Refrigerate to set the flavors. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Sunshine Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add other ingredients and mix well. Chill until set.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar salt and cornstarch together; then pour into egg yolks that have been well beaten. Pour scalded milk into this mixture. Put in top of a double boiler and stir while cooking until mixture is thick. Add butter coconut and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue. Brown.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix together all but the Cool Whip and pecans. Fold in the Cool Whip. Add the pecans. Freeze overnight in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut and serve when needed.

title: Hamburger Sauce
instructions: Mix all together; warm up in a kettle. Pour over 20 hamburger patties in a pan; put in the oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until hamburgers are done.

title: Italian Salsa
instructions: Place first 6 ingredients in to bowl of a food processor. Pulse for about 10 seconds to break the cheese into small pieces. Scrape sides and pulse again. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add lemon juice and basil and mix thoroughly. Add salt to taste. Add tomato and avocado before serving. Serve chilled.

title: Salmon Pasta Salad
instructions: In a large bowl toss the pasta salmon tomatoes cucumber and onion. For dressing combine the oil lemon or lime juice dill garlic salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour over pasta. Cover and chill. Serve over lettuce. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baptist Cookies
instructions: Mix together and cook on top of stove in an iron skillet until all is melted. Remove from fire and add Rice Krispies and nuts. Cool and roll into balls and roll in Angel Flake coconut.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Set butter out to soften. Then mix thoroughly all ingredients. Chill at least 1 hour or overnight. Roll out cut and place on ungreased cookie sheet. You can brush the dough with food coloring (mixed with water) to match the holiday. Then sprinkle with sugar. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake 4 to 5 minutes no longer.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a well-greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until done.

title: Squash Dressing Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and cook at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 40 minutes just until the onions are done.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Cut stick of oleo into pieces in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle rice over oleo. Place chicken over rice and salt and pepper to taste. Mix both soups and water together and pour over the chicken; cover. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Herbed Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach in small amount of water; drain well. Combine spinach with soup cheese and onions and pour into greased baking dish. Combine stuffing mix with butter; sprinkle over spinach and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cocktail Party Pate
instructions: Mix in\telectric mixer or food processor fitted with steel knife. Beat liverwurst until softened. Add butter and cream cheese and\tblend until light and fluffy.\tAdd parsley onion brandy and\tcurry powder.\tAdd salt and pepper. Spoon into serving container.\tCover and chill. Serve with crudites and assorted crackers.

title: Texas Soup
instructions: Put all in a large pot (do not drain any of the vegetables). For seasoning add 1 envelope taco seasoning and 1 envelope Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix. Stir all together and heat at least 30 minutes. Its ready!

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown meat onion salt pepper and garlic. Dice pepper. Mix all ingredients except meat and cheese. Grease 9-inch cast-iron skillet and heat in oven. Place 1/2 of cornbread mixture in hot skillet. Add meat then cheese. Top with remaining cornbread mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until brown.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Refrigerate at least one to two hours before using.

title: Poulet De France
instructions: In a medium bowl mix stuffing melted margarine and 1 1/2 cups broth. Mix chicken 3/4 cup broth onions chives celery mayonnaise and salt in another bowl. Spread half the stuffing in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish treated with nonstick spray. Spread chicken mixture over stuffing. Cover with remaining stuffing. Whisk eggs milk and soup in a large bowl. Pour sauce evenly over stuffing. Cover with foil and bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove foil; sprinkle with cheese and bake 10 more minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Heat broth to boiling. Add all vegetables seasonings rice and chicken. Cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes until rice and vegetables are tender.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs and mix well. Add apples. Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon. Add sugar mixture. Add vanilla and nuts; mix well. Mix all together; dough will be very stiff. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat. Saute seasonings with meat. Add soup beans and tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes. Cut tortillas in fourths. Put 1/2 of these in greased casserole dish. Pour half of meat mixture on this and cover with half of the cheese; repeat. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Set aside about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Surprise Kisses
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter sugar and vanilla in large bowl. Add flour and nuts; blend well. Shape about 1 tablespoon of dough around each candy covering it completely. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 7 to 10 minutes or until set but not brown.\tCool and roll in confectioners sugar. Store airtight. Makes 36 to 48.

title: Homemade Biscuits
instructions: In large bowl mix lard with flour. Work up real good. Add milk. Work well. Turn oven on 350\u00b0. Makes sure it is hot. Put flour on whatever you like and put your dough on it. Work it. Cut out. Put in greased pan. Put in hot oven. Cook about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Wilted Lettace Salad
instructions: Fry bakon til crisp. Drain fat leavin bakon in skillet. Krumble bakon. Add vinegah watah onion salt sugah n peppah to skillet. Heat til hit boils.

title: Chili
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat cook onions and garlic in 1 tablespoon of olive oil. In a large pot over medium heat cook beef and turkey until meat is evenly crumbled and has lost all pink color. Drain well. Add all other ingredients and stir for several minutes. Cover pot and cook on medium for about 1 1/2 hours stirring often.

title: Mystery Barbecue Sauce
instructions: These ingredients were in a \secret\ barbecue sauce. The person revealing the ingredients to me said that he would reveal the ingredients only but not the quantities of each. So you see you must experiment with the ingredients to your own particular taste. The barbecue sauce that I tasted originally was the best I had ever had. Good luck.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and melted butter together and then press lightly into a 9 x 13-inch greased dish.

title: Cherry Or Strawberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Mix everything together well and freeze. Keep frozen.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese; then add rest of ingredients and mix well. Chill until firm enough to handle. Shape with hands into large ball (or smaller individual ones). Roll in cracker crumbs or finely chopped nuts. Refrigerate. Serve at room temperature.

title: Corn Custard
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in baking dish set into a pan containing about one-inch of water. Bake 50 minutes at 325\u00b0. Test for doneness by inserting knife in center of casserole. Corn is done when knife comes out clean and uncoated. Serves 4.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onions pepper and Wesson oil together. Pour corn and tomatoes in oblong cake pan. Cook macaroni and pour into pan with corn and tomatoes adding hamburger mixture Worcestershire sauce chili powder and garlic. Cook for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 people.

title: Supreme Rice Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in baking dish. Cover tightly and microwave 5 minutes on High. Stir and microwave 5 additional minutes on 50% power. Let stand several minutes before serving. Simply scrumptious!

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large mixing bowl beat egg yolks and sweetened milk and add lime juice. Add food coloring if desired. Pour into prepared pastry shell. Bake for 30 minutes. Cool. Chill. Top with whipped cream. Garnish if desired.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Bake chicken breasts until done. Set aside to cool. Mix cream of chicken soup and the sour cream. Be sure to blend well. Tear chicken into bite-size pieces and place in an oblong pan. Pour soup mixture over it. Sprinkle several poppy seed over this and top with croutons. The ones with sage provide a flavor of dressing. Bake at 400\u00b0 until heated through.

title: Italian Salad
instructions: Place in large skillet and simmer with 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Cool and refrigerate 24 hours. Drain well before serving.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Combine vegetables soup 1/2 cup cheese sour cream pepper pimentos and 1/2 can onions. Pour mixture into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remainder of cheese and fried onions and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Chop corned beef. Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake in a greased dish covered for 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in 4-quart saucepan. Simmer 45 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with sugar and lemon juice. Mix remaining ingredients together until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle on top of apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cake Layers
instructions: Mix butter sugar eggs vanilla milk and flour starting and ending with flour. Make 4 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0. Frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Cook meats together until well done. Add jar spaghetti sauce to meat and simmer for 10 min. Mix cottage cheese with egg and oregano in a bowl. Line a 9x13 pan with raw lasagne. Put cottage cheese mixture on noodles. Spoon sauce on top sprinkle cheese. Repeat layers andend with cheese on top. Bake cover for 45-50 min in 350\u00b0 oven. Put knife through noodle to make sure it goes through. Let stand for about 10 min. before cutting.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Saute onions in butter. Add cooked broccoli soup and cheese. Mix and turn contents into a 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with slivered almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook the frozen vegetables as directed on the package. Drain. Add the diced raw vegetables.

title: Crabmeat Patties
instructions: Saute onion celery bell pepper and garlic in oleo. Mix with other ingredients. Shape into patties. Dip in cracker crumbs. May fry or bake.

title: Flautas
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients; stir and heat on low until cheese melts. Crumb sausage and ground beef together in skillet and cook but dont brown. Drain grease. Add 2 cans of chili salsa to the meat and cook until most of the liquid is evaporated. Spread tortillas with hot bean mixture. Spread meat over beans. Roll tortillas and place seam side down in a single layer in a large well-greased baking pan. Pour remaining can of salsa on top. Sprinkle with Colby cheese tomatoes and green onion tops. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve each Flauta on a bed of shredded lettuce and top with a dollop of sour cream. Serves 8.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Beat the eggs; add the sugar and beat. Mix the flour baking powder and salt together and add to the egg and sugar mixture. Fold in the fruit and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Blueberry Cheesecakes
instructions: Blend the cream cheese eggs sugar and vanilla until smooth. Line small foil cups with vanilla wafers (flat side up). Fill 1/2 full with cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool. Spoon on prepared blueberry filling.

title: Oven Baked Nachos
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spray cookie sheet with Pam; line pan with round nachos. (Try to use unbroken pieces.) Spoon a little meat on each chip. Drop a little sour cream on the meat followed by a slice of jalapeno pepper on each. Put shredded cheese on each one and place in oven until slightly melted. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Enjoy!

title: Flossie'S Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Mix cornbread and chicken broth. Add all other ingredients. Mixture will be thin. Place in large pan or baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Fill a cup 1/2 full of mix; add hot water to make 1 cup hot chocolate.

title: Leb Cake
instructions: Mix well. Spread in layers in oblong cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Cut in squares while hot and ice with white glaze.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix together and store in tightly covered container. Use 2 teaspoons of mix to a cup of hot water for tea.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix meal flour sugar and salt together; add water and milk to dry ingredients. Blend well. Melt Crisco in baking pan. Pour mixture in baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Mexican Corn
instructions: Mix together the flour meal milk egg salt corn and oil. Brown hamburger onion cumin and hot pepper. Place 2 cups of corn meal mixture in greased hot iron skillet. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of cheese. Place hamburger mixture over this. Add rest of cheese and top with rest of corn meal mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Bridge Dessert
instructions: Beat milk into pudding and blend in sour cream. Layer half of the angel food in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Spread pudding over cake then pie filling then Cool Whip. Best made the day before.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Melt margarine in pan on stove. Brown meat with onion salt and pepper added. Place potatoes green beans carrots and water over meat. Cover and bake in the oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until meat is tender. Return to stove. Make a paste of 2 tablespoons flour and 1/4 cup water. Stir into stew to thicken broth.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies With Chocolate Chunks
instructions: Mix flour oats baking soda and salt in medium bowl. Using electric mixer beat peanut butter brown sugar butter honey egg and vanilla in large bowl until well blended. Stir dry ingredients into peanut butter mixture in 2 additions. Stir in chopped chocolate. Cover and refrigerate until dough is firm and no longer sticky. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter 2 large baking sheets. With hands roll 1 heaping tablespoon of dough for each cookie into 1 3/4-inch balls. Place cookies on baking sheets 2 1/2-inches apart. Bake cookies until puffed and beginning to brown on top but still soft to touch about 12 minutes. Cool on baking sheets 5 minutes. Using metal spatula transfer cookies to rack to cool completely.

title: Bootlegger Beans
instructions: Put all ingredients in casserole dish. Stir well. Cover and simmer the longer the better.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Wash and rinse kraut. Wash again. Add celery and onion. Mix oil vinegar and sugar together and pour over vegetable mixture. Let stand overnight.

title: Best Carrot Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate or serve.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and add milk eggs and vanilla. Pour in a baked 9-inch pie crust. Beat egg whites and brown on top of pie.

title: Easy Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Use all of Stove Top. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add sage to taste. Add broth as needed to keep mixture moist. Add enough broth so mixture will not be dry. Pour in dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Grandma Gray'S Venison
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oleo in large cast-iron frypan. Mix flour salt pepper and sage. Dip venison pieces into mixture and place in hot pan turning once until done.

title: Kurabia Cookies
instructions: Cream butter thoroughly and add sugar. Mix well. Then gradually add flour until mixture becomes pliable. Roll into desired shape. May be topped with blanched almond halves. Bake in a slow oven at 300\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until almonds are browned.

title: Down South Potato Pie
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes and butter mixing until blended. Add sugar flour salt nutmeg ginger cinnamon and cloves. Blend in eggs and milk. Pour into crusts and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie(Syrupless)
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Beat eggs and sugar until mixed. Blend in the flour buttermilk butter vanilla and salt. Beat until smooth. Add pecans and pour into pie shell that has been baked for 10 minutes. Bake about 30 to 40 more minutes.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Power level on High 8 to 11 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and peanut butter. Add sugars eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Shape into balls and press with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Makes about 9 to 10 dozen.

title: Bibingca
instructions: Melt the butter. Combine all the ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour the mixture into a greased oblong pan and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Prepare gelatin in usual manner using 1 less cup of water. Pour 1/2 of mixture in large salad mold. Let congeal. Spread carton of sour cream on top and add remainder of gelatin mixture.

title: Cornbread Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Quick Spanish Rice
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add onion green pepper beef and rice. Stir over high heat until lightly browned. Add tomato sauce and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring quickly to a boil. Cover tightly and simmer 25 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Homemade Fudge
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Pour in milk. Stir over high heat until mixture boils stirring constantly. When mixture begins to thicken add butter and vanilla. Stir until forms hard ball when dropped into cold water. Remove from heat and stir until fudge loses its gloss. Stir in pecans. Pour into a buttered dish. Let cool. Cut into squares with a buttered knife.

title: Copper Penny
instructions: Cook carrots and drain. Make marinade with liquid. Beat well. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate. Store in refrigerator. Serve cold.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Put broccoli flowerets and stems onion raisins sunflower seeds and bacon pieces in salad bowl. Then make the dressing of vinegar sugar and mayonnaise. Put over the salad just before serving.

title: Turkey Sausage
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into patties and brown.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except beans. Stir well. Add beans and bake slowly at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Roasted Red Peppers And Chicken Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta as package directs. Cook chicken and garlic in a 12-inch nonstick skillet generously coated with cooking spray over medium heat until lightly brown. Add bouillon granules water roasted red peppers mushrooms parsley and olives. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes. Stir in pasta; heat through. Serve immediately. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Turkey-Apple Bake
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except chili sauce and mix lightly. Press into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Top with chili sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until meat is cooked through. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Refreshing Punch
instructions: Mix together in a large punch bowl. (If more is needed add 1 more can of Hawaiian Punch and 1 quart 50/50.) Serves 25 people.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: In bowl combine all ingredients. Marinate overnight. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder.

title: Tangy Sausage
instructions: Mix sauce and add to sausage. Bake covered in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serve hot in a crock-pot dish. Better if made ahead. Add chunks of pineapple for that \little something extra.\

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except carrots. Add cooled carrots and mix thoroughly. Marinate for 2 or 3 days. When carrots are used up add more. Keeps for 4 weeks.

title: Pull Apart Vegetable Bread
instructions: Saute green pepper onion and chives in butter. Quarter biscuits. Combine all ingredients (be sure biscuits are well-coated with butter). Pour into ungreased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Soak tomatoes 24 hours in lime solution. Rinse well at least 4 times. Combine vinegar spices sugar and salt; add tomatoes and cook for 30 minutes. Remove tomatoes from the mixture. Continue to cook the mixture until it becomes a thick syrup. Pack tomatoes into sterilized jar; pour hot syrup over and seal immediately.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and pour into an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sausage And Cabbage Pot Pie
instructions: Cook sausage and onion in Dutch oven stirring occasionally until sausage is done; drain. Stir in sugar salt cabbage and tomatoes; break up tomatoes. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Prepare pie crust mix as directed for one crust. Shape pastry to fit top of 2-quart casserole. Mix flour and cold water; stir into hot sausage mixture. Pour into ungreased casserole. Place pastry over sausage mixture. Seal around edges. Slit top for steam to escape. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until crust is brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs and pumpkin. Sift flour into this mixture. Add water and mix until smooth. Pour into loaf pans or muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: *Choose at least 4. Suggestions carrots squash cucumbers green onions cauliflower broccoli flowerets tomatoes green and red pepper olives etc.

title: Swedish Parsnip Souffle
instructions: Cook carrots covered in small amount of boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside.

title: Louise'S Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 teaspoons sugar in warm water. Let stand 2 minutes. Add milk sugar shortening salt and eggs. Blend in flour until you have a soft dough. Knead. Turn in greased bowl. Let rise until double. Punch down and make hot rolls. Let rise again. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles a few minutes. Cook celery and onions 4 or 5 minutes. Fold everything together in 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Homemade Pasta
instructions: Mix flour together make a circle of flour. Make a hole in the middle. Place eggs in middle of flour and softly beat eggs in center of flour. Slowly add flour to eggs from each side and mix with eggs until completely blended. Knead dough add a sprinkle of flour if sticky. Continue kneading (fold toward you and push away) turn dough and continue folding and pushing away from you and turning for about 5 minutes. Let dough rest about 15 minutes. Give a couple pushes and folds (make ball). Cut a piece the size of an egg flatten and put in stretcher take out fold add flour and repeat about 4 times. Change notch smaller and stretch again. Add spaghetti attachment and put dough through machine. Can be folded and stored for a few days or eat today.

title: Old Time Beef Stew
instructions: In a Dutch oven brown meat in 2 tablespoons hot shortening turning often. Add 2 cups hot water and next 9 ingredients. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking.

title: Easy Black Forest Torte
instructions: Sprinkle marshmallows in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Prepare cake batter according to package directions; pour over marshmallows. Spoon pie filling over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool. Frost with whipped topping. Store in the refrigerator.

title: My Old Kentucky Home Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine corn syrup brown sugar eggs salt vanilla and butter. Mix well then add pecans. Pour into the unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until filling is set.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and stir. Add tomatoes and Doritos just before serving and stir.

title: Rainbow Finger Jello
instructions: Mix 1 (3 ounce) jello and 1 package Knox gelatine (be sure to mix these 2 ingredients together dry before adding boiling water). Add 1 cup boiling water and stir until dissolved.

title: Banana Crush Punch
instructions: Mix 6 cups water with 4 cups sugar in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely. Blend bananas until smooth. Add bananas lemon juice orange juice and pineapple juice to sugar-water mixture. Freeze until firm. Thaw to mushy stage and add 2 bottles club soda. Serves 25 to 30.

title: Pear And Apple Conserve
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Bring slowly to a boil and cook until mixture is clear. Pack in hot jars and seal at once.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil butter sugar cocoa and milk for 1 minute. Add oats peanut butter and vanilla; mix. Drop teaspoonfuls onto wax paper. Let cool and harden. Enjoy!

title: Easy Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion in boiling water for 10 minutes. Add salt Accent garlic and cheese. Stir until cheese melts. Add butter milk and cream; heat to boiling. Mix flour and water in jar. Shake until smooth. Add to soup stirring until thickened.

title: Fresh Fruit Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook shells 14 minutes. Mix in small bowl the yogurt and orange juice. Mix rest of ingredients with shells. Add yogurt dressing and mix well.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Sift cake mix into large mixer bowl and add pudding mix eggs oil club soda and nuts. Beat batter at medium-high speed for 4 minutes (this is very important). Pour batter into a greased Bundt tube or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool completely; frost.

title: Cream Cheese Pudding
instructions: Prepare pudding or pie filling mix as directed. Cool until lukewarm. With high speed mixer whip softened cream cheese until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in pudding until smooth. Serve as pudding or pie filling. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Sift flour once then measure. Add baking powder and salt. Sift three times. Cream butter thoroughly and add sugar gradually. Continue creaming until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add flour mixture alternately with milk beating after each addition. Stir in vanilla and coconut. Fold in egg whites carefully. Bake in greased eight-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until done.

title: Trash Bag Mix
instructions: Combine chocolate chips peanut butter and butter; melt in microwave or on stove until smooth. In large bowl (must have room enough for mixing) combine Rice Chex pretzels raisins and nuts; pour chocolate mixture over cereal and mix until well coated. In large white trash bag place powdered sugar then pour in coated cereal mixture. Tie bag and toss until all items are coated. Spread on wax paper to dry 10 minutes. Store in containers.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; place in a baked or graham cracker pie shell. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Single Serving Pudding
