instructions: Combine cocoa sugar and cornstarch in a 1-quart glass bowl and stir well. Gradually add milk. Stir well. Microwave milk mixture on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir well. Microwave on Medium-high for 1 1/2 minutes or until mixture is thickened. Add vanilla extract and stir well. You may double mixture. Do not forget the whipped cream! Enjoy!

title: Oreo Mud Pie
instructions: Crush cookies and keep 1 cup of cookies for top.

title: Cinnamon Ornaments
instructions: Mix the cinnamon and applesauce. Add the glue; mix again. Roll 1/4-inch thick and cut. Use toothpick to make the hole for hanging the ornament with ribbon etc. Let dry.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix together and cook until soft ball forms in cold water. Remove from heat and add marshmallows peanut butter and vanilla. Watch closely because it takes a couple minutes to cook. Pour into pan and cool.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour and measure 2 cups; add salt and baking powder and sift again. Cut in margarine until fine mixture. Gradually add milk to make a soft dough. Flour wax paper or dough board. Pour soft dough onto floured paper or dough board and knead several times then firmly pat out to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with floured cutter. Makes 12 to 18 biscuits depending on thickness. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes.

title: Caesar Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill for 30 minutes and serve.

title: The Best Apple Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or sheet cake pan. In a saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut Crisco into flour like pie crust. Roll out on floured board into large rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle cinnamon over apples; toss well. Spread apples over dough and roll up jelly roll style. Dampen edges of dough with water and pinch to seal. Slice into about 16 (1/2-inch) slices.

title: Beef And Spinach Supreme
instructions: Brown the first 5 ingredients and cook 3 minutes. Meanwhile combine spinach soup sour cream and rice. Add meat mixture and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. Cut into squares. Can be made a day ahead. Freeze leftover portions for later use.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Chop and mix all ingredients together. Let sit in refrigerator at least 2 hours better if it sits all night. Serve with tortilla or corn chips also good on warm tortillas or as a taco topping.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Heat soup; blend in cream cheese and Knox gelatine. Let cool. Add balance of ingredients and place in a well-greased mold pan. Let set until ready.

title: Mary K'S
instructions: Melt carob chips in microwave or on stove. Add other ingredients. Spoon trail mix onto wax paper and cool. Eat.

title: Confetti Dip
instructions: Cook until thickened eggs vinegar and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Ernie'S Fudge Pie
instructions: Over very low heat or in microwave melt butter and chocolate squares. Place eggs in mixing bowl and beat until light. Add syrup sugar salt and vanilla to beaten eggs; beat again. Add slightly cooled chocolate mixture to egg and sugar mixture. Mix thoroughly and pour into a 9-inch pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until top is crusty and filling is set but still somewhat soft inside. Do not overbake. Pie should shake like custard so it will not be too stiff when cool. Can serve plain but is best served with a topping of a thin spade of vanilla ice cream.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Put cinnamon and 3/4 cup of sugar in plastic bag and shake biscuits that have been quartered in mixture. Place in Bundt or tube pan. In a saucepan bring to a boil the butter and 1 cup of sugar. Pour this mixture over biscuit pieces in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Strawberry Black Bottom Pie(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Heat half and half in saucepan over medium heat. Stir in chocolate morsels. Beat smooth with wire whisk. Remove from heat. Whisk in egg yolks one at a time mixing well. Blend. Return to heat. Cook stirring 1 to 2 minutes longer. Cool. Pour into pie shell. Chill until set 2 to 3 hours.

title: Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Mix 1 large box grape jello according to directions. Add 1 can blueberry pie filling. Drain crushed pineapple. Add to jello mixture mix well. Pour in casserole dish and refrigerate for 1 hour. Mix sour cream 1 pkg. cream cheese 1 c. sugar 1 tsp. vanilla and spread on top of jello mixture. Sprinkle with pecans.

title: Hamburger Quiche
instructions: Brown beef and onions; drain fat. Mix other ingredients in. Add beef and onions. Put in uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. You can freeze it or you can warm it and eat. Serves 6.

title: Rotel Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and sausage. Melt cheese and add Ro-Tel. Add meat to Ro-Tel and cheese. Thin with milk as desired.

title: Royal Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken with flour. Brown chicken in butter and set aside.

title: Best Ever Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour salt and shortening cutting until well blended. Beat egg until light; add to water and vinegar. Add this to flour mixture and mix well. Roll as needed.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour pan. Sift flour cocoa baking powder and salt in a large bowl.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Cook sausage until done. Crumble then drain. Mix cheese and sausage. Sprinkle in pie shell. Lightly beat eggs in a bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture. Pour in shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool for 7 to 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl or grocery sack. Store in airtight containers. Use approximately 1/4 cup mix to 3/4 cup boiling water. Great to take camping!

title: Strawberry Fluff
instructions: Strawberry Fluff is made in 3 layers and the layers must be prepared in sequence.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and flour well. Separate eggs and add yolks to mixture. Slowly add the water and mix until smooth. Cook in top of double boiler until thick. Pour into baking dish.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Add add ingredients to a crock pot and allow to melt. Serve warm with Frito Lay Scoops.

title: Homemade Chicken Soup
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and put into big soup pot. Add celery salt and pepper. Cover with water. Put on lid. Simmer until chicken falls off bones. Drain broth. Debone chicken. Discard bones and celery. Add chicken and corn into broth. Bring to a boil.

title: Cheese Custard
instructions: Put grated cheese in baking dish 1/3 full. Beat the whole eggs; add salt pepper grated onion and milk. Pour egg and milk mixture over cheese and top with a few pieces of butter. Place in baking dish in pan of water and bake in slow oven for 1 hour. May be left longer.

title: Cream Of Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. After done and while hot punch holes with fork all over and pour the can of cream of coconut over the cake. When it is completely cool frost with the Cool Whip and Eagle Brand milk which have been mixed together.

title: Chili Soup
instructions: Saute onion until golden brown. Add tomatoes meat beans and seasonings. Cover and cook slowly for about 1 hour. Add water if needed.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Add this to mixture.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix by hand. Bake cookies 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. Time may vary according to oven.

title: Sour Cherry Crumb Pie
instructions: Mix tapioca and 1/3 cup sugar together. Layer cherries in 1 unbaked 9-inch pie crust in thirds alternating them with a sprinkling of the tapioca and sugar mixture.

title: Port Wine Jello Mold(Double Batch)
instructions: Drain cherries and oranges; reserve juices. Pour juices into 1-quart measuring cup and add enough water to make 6 cups liquid. Heat juices to boiling over medium heat. Add jello and stir well. Cool slightly and stir in wine. Chill until the consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Fold in fruit and nuts. Pour into mold. Grease pans with oil.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake or brownies as directed on package; let cool. Crumble Heath bars in blender. Mix pudding as directed on box then mix Cool Whip in with pudding. Crumble cake. Layer cake then pudding then candy; repeat layers. Spread remaining Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle crumbled candy on top of this. Refrigerate!

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with nuts and raisins. Pull thawed bread dough into walnut size pieces (35 balls). Fill pan single layers in rows. Heat together butter and sugar; do not boil. Take off heat and add milk and dry vanilla pudding fast. Stir quickly and pour over dough. Cover and allow to rise in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or less. Let stand 5 minutes then invert on foil on cookie sheet.

title: Morning Lift-Off
instructions: In a blender mix orange juice oatmeal and honey with bananas for 1 minute on medium speed. Add cereal tofu and wheat germ; blend for 1 more minute. Makes 5 cups.

title: Pineapple Souffle
instructions: Melt margarine and add sugar. Beat eggs and add. Put in bread and pineapple. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Beat first seven ingredients together by hand. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour 2/3 of batter in pan. Sprinkle 1/2 of chips mixture over batter. Pour and spread rest of batter over this then sprinkle rest of chips mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Combine browned hamburger cabbage onion and garlic and put in casserole dish. Combine milk and soup and pour over other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Magic Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (375\u00b0 for glass). Melt margarine in a 13 x 9-inch pan in oven. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over melted margarine. Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients in order chocolate chips coconut and walnuts. Press down. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until light brown. Cool. Chill if desired. Cut into bars and store at room temperature.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef. Add spaghetti sauce and simmer. Mix together cream cheese cottage cheese and 2 raw eggs. Mix well with mixer. Boil noodles until tender (do not overcook). In a large pan layer sauce on bottom noodles sauce cream cheese mixture boiled eggs and Mozzarella cheese. Continue layering until gone or you run out of room. Bake at 425\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes before cutting. If too soupy cook longer; too dry decrease cooking time.

title: Stir Up Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together first 8 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and stir all together. Bake in greased 9-inch angel food pan or loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mozzarella Sticks
instructions: Coat cheese in flour then dip into buttermilk and then into bread crumbs. Fry in oil until golden. Drain on paper towels. Garnish with basil. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Fry beef green pepper and onions in shortening. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Paper Sack Apple Pie
instructions: Chop apples into small pieces. Place half of apples in unbaked pie shell. Mix spices with 1/2 cup sugar. Sprinkle half of this over apples. Repeat.

title: Willard Scott'S Favorite Christmas Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together all ingredients with an electric mixer. Spray three 9-inch round cake pans with nonstick coating. Pour batter equally into the 3 pans and bake for 20 minutes. Test for doneness with a toothpick. Cool layers in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes. Carefully remove layers from pans to rack to cool completely.

title: Cranberry Jello Mold
instructions: Combine and pour into mold or bowl and let set.

title: Blintzes
instructions: Reserve crepes. Combine cottage cheese granulated sugar replacement vanilla and lemon peel in mixing bowl. Whip with fork until thoroughly blended. Fill each crepe with heaping 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of cottage cheese filling; roll each on to form blintzes and place in shallow pan. Bake at 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C) for 15 minutes or until warm. Sift the powdered sugar replacement over the blintzes.

title: Spinach Sausage Pie
instructions: Brown sausage breaking up meat with a spoon; drain off fat and cool. Lightly beat eggs in a large bowl (save 1 tablespoon of egg to brush on top crust). Add cheeses spices spinach and sausage mixing until well combined.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt cake pan or spray with Pam or Bakers Joy. Crumble nuts in bottom of pan. In large bowl mix cake mix and instant pudding with eggs and liquids. Mix well (about 2 minutes). Pour into pan on top of pecans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Remove from oven; pour on hot rum glaze. Cake will settle. Let cool in pan 30 minutes. Loosen edges; turn upside-down on plate. Nuts will be on top.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate. Serve with crispy raw vegetables.

title: Taramosalata - Fish Roe Dip Or Spread
instructions: Put tamara in cheesecloth and rinse several times in cold water. Put the salad and olive oil in a bowl. Cut the bread crusts removed into small pieces. Beat the tarama with electric mixer adding a tablespoon lemon juice alternately with the oil and soaked in water bread beating well after each addition. Continue until all lemon juice and bread are used. Fold in onion and parsley. If mixture is too thick add a little cold water. Serve on squares of bread or crackers.

title: Irish Bread
instructions: Boil raisins for 3 minutes; strain. Sprinkle with a little flour and set aside. Blend flour sugar baking powder salt oil milk and eggs. Fold in raisins. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 in oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook until it spins a thread. Pour over popcorn. Put butter on hands and press together to form balls. Wrap individually.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix crumbs sugar and margarine melted together and put in bottom of large pan for crust. Save some crumbs to sprinkle on top. Pour in cherry pie filling. Mix Dream Whip as on package with chilled milk; add cream cheese and vanilla. Mix until well blended. Chill for about 1 hour.

title: Cinderella Quiche
instructions: In bowl toss cheese with flour. Add half and half and remaining ingredients. Pour into shell bake 55-60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let stand 15-20 minutes after you remove from oven to make cutting easier.

title: Short Bread Cookies
instructions: Blend softened cream cheese margarine and sugar. Add flour and mix well. Shape teaspoons of dough into balls and press half a cherry in the center of cookie. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool; sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Salsa
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boil and simmer at least 30 minutes (3 to 4 hours in slow cooker). Process in sterilized pint and 1/2 pint jars in hot water bath for 30 minutes. Yields 8 pints.

title: Salmon Stew
instructions: Stew potatoes and onion until done; add salmon butter and salt and pepper to taste then add as much milk as desired.

title: Rice Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grind or chop celery onions and pepper. Fry sausage and remove from pan. Fry chopped vegetables in fat. Add meat. Cook rice in 5 cups boiling water. Simmer 30 minutes. Add Lipton soup and cook 7 minutes. Add vegetables meat and canned soup and milk. Pour into 2 shallow baking pans and bake slowly for 1 1/2 hours at 375\u00b0.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Make 3 depressions in dry ingredients. Pour vinegar into one vanilla into one and oil into one. Pour water over all. Mix well until smooth. Pour into greased 8-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool. Serve with cream Cool Whip or frosting.

title: Fresh Apple Nut Bread
instructions: In large bowl cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs. Mix flour soda baking powder salt lemon rind nuts spices and grated apple. Blend into creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Turn into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Husbands Delight Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add seasonings sugar and tomato sauce. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Cook noodles as directed on package. Blend onions sour cream and cream cheese. Grease 2 1/2 qt. casserole. Alternate layers of noodles meat sauce sour cream and grated cheese. End with layer of cheddar cheese. Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes at 350 degrees. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hawaiian Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef with salt and ginger. Shape into balls. Beat egg slightly with water; dip balls into egg mixture then flour to coat well. Brown in salad oil in large skillet remove with slotted spoon and set aside.

title: Baked Rice Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter baking dish. Combine all ingredients in dish. Bake for 3 hours stirring once during baking. Add raisins if desired.

title: People Chow
instructions: In large bowl pour in cereal. In separate bowl melt peanut butter and chocolate chips. Stir until blended. Pour over cereal. Add 1 box powdered sugar; place lid on bowl and shake well.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix 1 cup sugar cornstarch and salt. Add water. Cook in double boiler or microwave until thick. Add egg yolks and cook until real thick. Add lemon juice and rind; stir. Remove from heat; add butter. Put in baked pie shell. Beat egg whites with 1/4 cup sugar and cream of tartar until stiff. Put on filling and brown in oven.

title: Baked Apricots
instructions: In greased 1 1/2-quart casserole layer apricots sugar and crumbs until all ingredients are used. Pour melted butter over all. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Kim'S Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and marinate wings for 24 hours. Spray baking pan with Pam; bake as 1 layer at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours turning once.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Chop onion bell pepper and carrots. Mix all ingredients and chill overnight.

title: Turkette
instructions: Break spaghetti into small pieces (2 to 3 inches long) and mix with other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Conch Fritters
instructions: Combine all ingredients with enough milk for the mixture to hold its shape. Form into fritters and fry in 350\u00b0 oil until golden. Drain on paper towels and serve with hot sauce or the sauce of your choice.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: In a large box mix instant pudding sour cream milk and orange peel. Beat at low speed scraping bowl often 1 to 2 minutes. By hand fold in Cool Whip.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan. Add first 5 ingredients. Saute until vegetables soften about 5 minutes. Add next 4 ingredients and saute until fragrant about 2 minutes. Add chicken broth. Bring to a boil and cook over medium-high heat until thickens about 30 minutes. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp are opaque about 4 minutes. Season with freshly ground black pepper. Spoon over 3/4 cup rice and garnish with parsley. Serves 6.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Separate eggs; beat yolks with shortening and butter until well blended. Gradually add sugar; beat until light and fluffy. Add extracts; beat on low speed until blended at low speed. Add flour about 1/4 at a time alternating with about 1/3 milk at a time. Add coconut. Mix well. Fold in beaten (stiffly beaten) egg whites. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 about 2 hours. Cool on rack 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar Crisco margarine and cocoa. Beat in 1 egg at a time; beat well. Add milk and flour (sifted with baking powder) alternately with milk. Beat until well mixed. Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Ice cake with chocolate icing.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl combine flour baking soda cinnamon and salt; mix well and set aside. In large bowl beat eggs. Stir in oil and vanilla. Add sugar. Add flour mixture until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in apples and chopped nuts. Spread into greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake 45 minutes. Transfer to a wire cooling rack cool completely. (Cake can be frozen up to 3 months.)

title: Sponge Cake
instructions: Beat 6 egg whites with 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar until soft mounds form. Add 1/4 cup sugar and beat until stiff. Combine egg yolks cold water vanilla and lemon. Blend egg yolk mixture with dry ingredients. Beat 1 minute. Fold egg yolk mixture into egg white mix (1/4 at a time). Do not stir. Pour into ungreased tube pan. Cut through batter to remove bubbles. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Invert pan and leave until cool.

title: Heavenly Orange Fluff
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 1/2 cups boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and concentrate. Chill until partially set. Fold in oranges. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and chill until firm.

title: Deep-Fried Turkey
instructions: Heat peanut oil in King Turkey Cooker to 350\u00b0. Season outside of turkey. Secure turkey to hangers and submerge into oil. Cook 8 minutes per pound. This is the best turkey you will ever have. Meat is moist and juicy; skin is crispy. Delicious.

title: Dudley'S Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill overnight.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar cornstarch and drink until creamy. Add red food coloring and cool. Combine with fresh whole strawberries. Pour into cooked crust with a little sugar in bottom. Add whipped cream.

title: Crock-Pot Special
instructions: Combine onion and ground chuck or hamburger in skillet. Brown and drain. In 5-quart crock-pot combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cook on slow about 4 hours. Serve with corn bread.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Preheat oil in an electric skillet. Mix all ingredients then pour batter in a small funnel a little at a time. If the batter is too thick add more milk. When pouring batter in the oil make a circle with the batter and crisscross it back and forth. When the cake is brown on one side turn and fry the second side until brown. Remove the cake and place it on a paper towel. Sprinkle with powdered or brown sugar and cinnamon.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into lightly greased loaf pan. Makes 2 loaves. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Good Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 3 cups of water instead of 4. Add the cottage cheese and other ingredients. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce leaf with mayonnaise on top.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Prepare noodles according to directions given on package. Brown beef separately. Place ground beef cooked noodles and cans of soup and corn in approximately 2-quart casserole dish. Crush crackers into crumbs. Place on top after all contents are thoroughly mixed. Place in oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. You can add garlic salt and/or Tabasco sauce to ground beef while browning for a spicier dish.

title: Excellent But Easy Casserole
instructions: Combine soups chilies and tortillas and let soak 30 minutes. Place half of soup mixture in shallow 5-quart casserole. Cover with chicken. Add layer of remaining soup mixture and top with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Icing For Coconut Cake
instructions: Heat milk and flour on medium heat until thick. Set aside to cool. Cream shortening and sugar until no granulars. When milk and flour mixture cools add to creamed mixture and beat until fluffy; add vanilla. Cover yellow cake mix with icing and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Fresh Fruit Tray Orange Creme Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients together. Serve chilled with fresh fruit. I like orange sections and apple slices plus other fresh fruit.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Place into a crock-pot and melt down or place in a microwave-safe bowl until melted. Stir as needed.

title: Shrimp And Feta Salad
instructions: Combine shrimp Feta cheese cottage cheese onions tomatoes oregano and pepper in a large bowl. Mix well. Add pasta and herbed dressing; toss. Serve cold. Serves 8.

title: Pineapple Bread Pudding
instructions: Melt margarine and add bread broken up. Then add remaining ingredients together and pour over bread. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use 8 x 12-inch pan.

title: Tuna-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. In large casserole mix together the tuna peas noodles soup salt and pepper. Add cheese package from macaroni and cheese box. Add milk; mix thoroughly. Top with crushed corn flakes. Microwave on High for 4 to 5 minutes or heat in oven for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with salad for a complete meal.

title: Jumbalaija
instructions: Brown chicken in butter. Cook sausage in drippings. Remove and drain on paper towel. Repeat with ham and vegetables. Mix together and add seasonings. Add broth and tomatoes. Bring to a boil and add rice. Bake covered one hour until liquid is absorbed.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Beat egg in a large bowl. Add chopped onion celery and green pepper. Mix in all other ingredients. Put into a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour uncooked rice into a deep baking dish. Place pork chops on top of rice. Sprinkle 1/2 of Lipton soup mix on this. Mix mushroom soup and water in a large bowl stirring and mixing well. Then pour soup over pork chops. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 of Lipton mix over this. Cover with foil. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Cinnamon Brown Sugar Oatmeal
instructions: Combine all ingredients for 1 serving in microwave-safe bowl. Cook on High power for 2 minutes until thickened stirring after every minute of cooking. Old fashioned oats may take longer. Cover and let stand 2 to 3 minutes before serving.

title: Mole Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well and chill in refrigerator. Serve on crisp greens; top with grated Romano cheese and toasted sesame seed.

title: Egg Souffle
instructions: Cut off the crust and cube the bread. Layer the bread cubes ham and cheese in an 8 x 8-inch glass greased baking dish. Whip with spoon the eggs milk and salt. Pour this over the bread mixtures and top with the melted oleo. Bake 45 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven. This can be doubled and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve the jello in the hot water. Add the marshmallows and stir until dissolved. Cool until almost jelled. Add the cabbage pineapple (with juice) and nuts. Mix the salad dressing in the Cool Whip or Dream Whip. Add this to the first mixture.

title: Sliced Hen With Ginger (Tyukvetrece)(Serves 6)
instructions: Rub the chicken breasts with marjoram and ginger. Then slice them thinly. Heat oil in a frying pan and saute the onions until glossy. Add the carrots and brown them slightly. Add the sliced chicken and saute until the pan juices are reduced by half.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on box and put in an 8 x 12 x 2-inch casserole dish. Combine other ingredients and pour over broccoli. Sprinkle a generous amount of dressing crumbs over casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt 1 cup margarine stir in 1/4 cup cocoa then water. Bring to boil remove from heat. In large mixing bowl combine flour brown sugar baking soda cinnamon and salt. Add cocoa mixture; beat well. Stir in 1/3 cup Eagle Brand milk eggs and vanilla. Pour into greased pan. Bake 15 minutes or until done. In small saucepan melt remaining 1/4 cup margarine. Stir in remaining 1/4 cup cocoa and Eagle Brand. Stir in confectioners sugar and nuts. Spread on warm cake.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook lima beans until tender. Brown onions and peppers in butter. Mix with lima beans (make sure beans have been drained). Place in greased dish cover with cheese and crumbled crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Perfect Brisket
instructions: Place brisket in large pan. Pour liquid smoke over it. Season well with salts and onion. Cover with foil and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Beans And Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Tuna Patties
instructions: Fry in a skillet until brown and stays together. Tastes like fried chicken.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix water yeast and sugar and let set for 5 minutes. Add salt eggs and melted margarine. Add flour until it is sticky. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next morning make into rolls. Let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Then bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Bologna Ii
instructions: Take chicken broth and make gravy to pour over top. Mix chicken and vegetables together. Put half of mixture in greased casserole. Cover with 1 1/2 pints toasted bread crumbs. Add the rest of mixture and top with another 1 1/2 pints bread crumbs. Pour gravy over top. Be sure to have plenty gravy. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Cheese Biscuits With Sausage
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Roll into small balls and place on cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Crock-Pot Braised Ribs With Vegetables
instructions: Preheat ribs in skillet. Brown on both sides. Put short ribs into pot. Add tomatoes or juice salt pepper potatoes carrots and onions. Cover; simmer at medium setting for 4 to 5 hours or low setting for 7 to 10 hours.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl; add sugar gradually and beat until thick. Add pudding and beat. Fold in whipped topping milk and vanilla. Pour into ice cream freezer can. Add milk to fill. Freeze ice cream according to your freezer.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes until soft enough to mash. Add brown sugar crushed pineapple and 2/3 of marshmallows. Mash together. Place in a buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining marshmallows on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until heated through and marshmallows on top are softened and nicely browned.

title: Brown Sugar Pecan Rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to to 350\u00b0. Mix butter brown sugar and egg. Stir in flour and pecans. Drop by teaspoons about 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Dough will flatten and spread. Bake 12 to 15 minutes until set. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine hash browns 3/4 cup butter onions soup sour cream and cheese in a casserole dish. Place crushed cornflakes on top of dish. Use 1/2 cup of butter to soften cornflakes. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes depending on stove.

title: Best Ever Pear Cobbler
instructions: Arrange pear slices evenly in a 10 x 6 x 2 inch baking dish; sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine flour sugar cinnamon nutmeg and salt; stir well and sprinkle over pears. Dot with butter. Roll pastry to 1/4-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface; cut into 10 x 1/2-inch strips. Arrange in lattice fashion over pears; trim edges. Bake 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 6-8 servings.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Add sugar to milk yeast and 1 teaspoon salt; mix well. Add eggs to milk mixture and mix well. Add this to flour mixture. Put in greased bowl in refrigerator overnight.

title: Pig Picking Cake
instructions: Mix preceding ingredients together and bake in 3 greased and floured layer pans at 325\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by tablespoons into pan with oil and fry until browned.

title: Bro. Rayl'S Apple Bread
instructions: Mix oil sugar cinnamon and eggs with apples. Mix flour soda and baking powder; then add it to your apple mixture. Grease muffin tins or loaf pans. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and stem mushrooms and set on paper towels to drain. Mix remaining ingredients well (except cheese or paprika) in small mixing bowl. Use to stuff mushroom caps. Place in buttered glass baking dish and sprinkle with either Parmesan cheese or paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. May microwave on High for 5 minutes turning after 2 1/2 minutes cooking time. Serve immediately. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Goforth'S Chicken And Rice
instructions: Combine rice and water in a heavy 2 to 3-quart cooking container. Bring to hard boil in uncovered container. Lower heat and cover with tight fitting lid. Simmer for 20 minutes. Do not remove lid or stir rice while cooking! While rice is cooking heat oil in large skillet. Cut chicken into short thin strips and stir-fry in oil until done. When rice is done add chicken margarine salt and pepper gently stirring to combine. Serve with tossed salad and cantaloupe. This is one of our familys favorite dishes. Serves 6.

title: Crock-Pot Steak Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot except flour and butter. Cover and cook on low 8 hours. One hour before serving turn on high. Make a paste of butter and flour. Pour into soup and stir until thick.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Mix all ingredients; heat until cheese is melted.

title: Mama'S Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cut up one head of cabbage. Season as desired and boil until tender. Drain cabbage and place in a casserole dish. Place several pats of butter (as much as desired) all around in the cabbage. Cut Velveeta cheese into slices and place over the cabbage in the casserole dish. Bake in oven until cheese melts and is bubbly. Remove casserole from the oven. Crush enough Town House crackers to cover the entire casserole and melt enough butter to moisten the crushed crackers. Mix together and cover the casserole. Return to the oven and bake until the crust is browned.

title: Applesauce Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Stir in applesauce. Cool slightly. Stir and pour into mold or dish. Chill.

title: Chafing Dish Beer Balls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Form small bite-size meatballs. Brown balls then remove from skillet. Stir tomato paste into drippings. Add beer to this mixture. Return meatballs to sauce. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes. A pinch of dill seed may be added to the sauce. Serves 20 to 30. Keep warm in chafing dish and serve with toothpicks. (This freezes well.)

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and cream cheese until light and fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time. Beat after each egg. Add vanilla and lemon flavorings gradually adding flour to mixture. Place in a tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Mix oatmeal flour brown sugar and cinnamon with oleo and pat 1/2 of mixture in bottom of pan. Spread rhubarb over it. Cook until thick the water sugar vanilla and cornstarch and pour over rhubarb. Spread remaining crumb mixture on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in saucepan. Stir well. Place over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves then cook to soft ball stage (approximately 232\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add nuts stirring until well coated. Spread nuts on waxed paper and separate with a fork. Cool. Yields 2 cups.

title: Rivels
instructions: Mix together into coarse crumbs. Drop into boiling soup or stew. Reduce heat and cook approximately 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Nut Cookies
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cake mix and sour cream with an electric mixer on medium to high speed about 2 minutes or until smooth and creamy scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Stir in peanut butter pieces or chocolate pieces and nuts. Drop dough from a rounded teaspoon 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until tops look dry. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute. Remove cookie and cool on wire rack. Makes about 36.

title: Melon Ball Salad
instructions: Combine water sugar and cinnamon sticks. Boil 5 minutes then let cool. Pour over melon balls; let marinate 1-2 hours before serving.

title: Clinton'S Recipe
instructions: Shred chicken (add to sauteed onions and green chilies). Add Cheddar cheese and sour cream. Mix well; cook over low heat until all is mixed together and melted. Warm tortillas in skillet and wrap mixture. Put in baking pan. Pour bottle of chili sauce over. Bake at 250\u00b0 until warm clear through and sauce looks dry 20 to 25 minutes.

title: French Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg and sour cream. Mix in dry ingredients except coconut. Grease 8-inch tube pan or square pan. Line bottom of pan with all the coconut and pour in batter. Sprinkle top with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Hot Dish
instructions: In medium saucepan combine carrots celery onions water and salt. Bring to boil covered for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain liquid into 2 cup measure. Place vegetables in serving dish. Cover to keep warm. Using saucepan melt margarine and blend in flour. Use salmon liquid and vegetable liquid and enough milk to make 2 cups. Stir into flour mixture. Cook over medium heat. Add cheese and Worcestershire sauce until thickened. Pour over vegetables and salmon. Serve over baking powder biscuits or mashed potatoes.

title: Martha Washington Cherries
instructions: Take a pinch of dough mixture and roll half of cherry in it. Chill well; overnight preferred.

title: Cold Nachos
instructions: Put salsa in a bowl in the middle of the tray. Cut; shred and chop all ingredients. Place tortilla on the tray (one layer). Put a teaspoon of refried beans on each chip followed by a teaspoon of sour cream. Sprinkle shredded cheese over chips. Sprinkle onion lettuce tomato and olives. Serve as is.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Combine celery and onion in a 1-quart microwave dish. Cover and cook on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients except noodles. Cover and microwave on High 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 minutes or until mixture boils and thickens stirring once. Sprinkle with noodles. Microwave on High uncovered 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until noodles are heated.

title: Blackberry Ice Cream Supreme
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add 1 cup cold water. Stir in 1 pint vanilla ice cream by spoonfuls until smooth. Chill if necessary until slightly thickened. Spoon into dessert dishes. Chill until set about 2 hours.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Boil sugar and water until sugar is dissolved. Cool. Add the fruit concentrates. Stir well. Add 7-Up. Yield 20 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Burst Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside.

title: Chicken And Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish with vegetable spray. Place chicken pieces in baking dish without overlapping pieces. Peel sweet potatoes and slice in half inch slices. Place on and around chicken pieces.

title: Favorite White Bread
instructions: My favorite bread recipe. Turns out the best homemade bread.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans. Mix in soup and season to taste with salt and pepper. Place in small casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Top with onion rings. Garnish with a little chopped pimento. Makes approximately 4 servings.

title: Jalapeno Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix and pour in 8-inch square baking dish. Bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.\tAllow to cool 15 minutes. Cut into 1-inch squares. Serve with crackers.

title: Swiss Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put chicken in Pyrex dish; salt and pepper to taste. Pour soup and water on top of chicken then add cheese. Melt oleo; mix with corn bread mix. Spread this on top of cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mystery Dip
instructions: Shred dried beef into small pieces and mix with other ingredients. Serve in a small bowl surrounded with chip and crackers to dip with.

title: Three Greens Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; toss well. Combine vinegar broth and oil; stir well with a whisk. Pour over pasta mixture; toss gently to coat. Sprinkle with parsley and cheese. Serves 6.

title: Cushaw Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in pie shell. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until mixture is set.

title: Delicious Fresh Orange Cake
instructions: A nut-sprinkled cream cheese icing is the perfect foil for this moist not-too-sweet carrot cake.

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Boil 2 minutes. Take off stove. Stir in 2 cups nuts. Pour out on oil paper and break apart.

title: Venison Casserole
instructions: Put roast in crock-pot. Pour sauce over meat. Do not add water. Cook on low overnight or all day.

title: Spiced Bran Drop Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine brown sugar butter shortening coffee and egg. Beat until light and fluffy. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Remove immediately.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Put beef in blender. Mix half the beef and remaining ingredients. Let stand in refrigerator until firm. Shape as desired and roll in 1/2 of dried beef. Decorate with celery onions and lettuce if desired.

title: Calamari Salad (Italian)(Octopus, English; Pulpo, Spanish)
instructions: Put 3 cans octopus with oil into bowl. Squeeze 3 lemons into bowl. Eliminate pits by squeezing through strainer. Thinly slice onion and pepper. Add onion pepper and crushed garlic. Add olive oil and 1/4 cup red wine vinegar. Mix together. Cover the bowl and refrigerate. Serve with Italian bread or just by itself.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Dice large eggplant. Chop a little onion. Cook in salt water until tender. Drain and mash. Add milk mushroom soup egg and 1 cup stuffing. Put in greased casserole. Put 1/2 cup herb stuffing on top along with melted butter. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol Chocolate Chip Cookies That Really Taste
instructions: Soften margarine and cream cheese then combine in mixing bowl. Add sugars and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla butter flavor and Egg Beaters. Mix well. In separate bowl combine flour and baking soda; stir these together with a fork. Add flour mixture to dough a little at a time. After all the flour is mixed in add the mini morsels. The little chips go a long way. Spray cookie pan with nonstick spray and drop dough onto pan in rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake 9 to 11 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool on rack.

title: Mushroom Crust Quiche
instructions: Melt 3 tablespoons margarine. Add mushrooms and cook until limp. Stir in crackers then turn mixture into a well-greased 9-inch pie plate. Press mixture evenly over pan bottom and up the sides. In the same frying pan melt remaining 2 tablespoons margarine. Add onion and cook until limp. Spread onion over mushroom crust; sprinkle evenly with cheese.

title: Chicken And Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix oleo with stuffing mix. Put half of this mixture into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix all other ingredients and place in pan on mixture. Add the rest of the stuffing mix to top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix together; pour into 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-40 minutes.

title: Margie'S Flaky Fried Pastry
instructions: The secret of sourdough is in the aging process that occurs between uses. Your starter will last for a long time and give you much enjoyment but do not let it just sit in the refrigerator too long without using.

title: Summer Slush
instructions: Boil sugar and water until sugar dissolves in large pan. Add remaining ingredients and stir well to mix. Pour into containers suitable for freezing but large enough to scoop from. Stir once or twice after placing in freezer until mixture is firm. To serve scoop into glasses and add Sprite 7-Up or ginger ale. Refreshing in summer winter spring and fall.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix cream and eggs and allow to stand in refrigerator overnight. When ready to prepare remove from refrigerator. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cook sausage until done; drain and crumble. Trim crust from bread slices. Place them in the bottom of the pan. Place the crumbled sausage over the bread. Add the grated cheese. Pour the egg mixture over the top of the other ingredients.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix well the rice milk and sugar. Dot top with butter and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Caramel Nut Bars
instructions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk over low heat stirring until smooth. Set aside. Combine remaining milk cake mix and margarine; mix well. Press 1/2 the cake mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Sprinkle nuts and chips over cake. Pour melted caramels over this. Top with teaspoonfuls of remaining cake mix pressing gently into caramel. Add remaining nuts pressing gently. Bake for 20 minutes. Cool slightly and cut into bars.

title: Orange Sherbet Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add sherbet and mix until sherbet is dissolved. Let partially set in refrigerator and then add whipped cream.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix pudding as box instructs then add pumpkin and Cool Whip and spices. Spread into 9-inch graham cracker crust or regular pie shell.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar vinegar and peppers. Cook for 5 minutes. Mix cornstarch with a little water and add to sauce mixture.

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Brown beef in butter. Remove from heat. Put tomato sauce in meat; stir. May use a dash of salt and sprinkle of sugar. Combine cottage cheese sour cream onions and green pepper. Spread half-cooked noodles onto greased dish. Cover with cheese mixture. Put in the remaining noodles. Pour melted butter over noodles. Put ground beef and tomato sauce on top. I sprinkle a little cheese on top.

title: Beef And Vegetable Kebabs
instructions: Cut the green pepper in half. Remove and discard the core and seeds. Cut the pepper flesh into 1-inch pieces with a sharp knife.

title: Applesauce And Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cup oats flour cinnamon baking powder and soda. Add applesauce skim milk 1/2 cup brown sugar oil and egg white. Mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fill greased muffin cups 3/4 full. Combine 1 tablespoon brown sugar the 1/4 cup oats 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle over unbaked muffins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 22 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Burgers
instructions: Thoroughly combine ground beef sour cream Worcestershire sauce onions and salt. Crush corn flakes slightly gently stir into meat mixture. Let stand 30 minutes. Shape into 6 patties about 1/2-inch thick. Broil 4-inches from heat for 6 minutes turn and broil 6 minutes longer or until done.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix mayonnaise with artichokes and garlic. Mix 1/2 the cheeses into artichoke mix. Put into a casserole dish. On top add remaining cheeses. Add little pats of butter on top.

title: Black Walnut Icing For 4 Cake Layers
instructions: Cook slowly 1 hour until thick. Add 1 tablespoon margarine and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Put icing on hot cake layers. Then sprinkle nuts over filling.

title: Broccoli - Ham Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Chill and serve.

title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Heat water to boiling. Add\toil and honey.\tStir in gluten yeast salt and\tenough fresh ground wheat flour to make sticky (about 7 cups). Knead well; let rise. Roll part into rectangle and spread with filling and raisins. Roll up cut into rolls and bake at 350\u00b0. Ice when cool (if desired).

title: Applesauce Cookies(This Cookie Recipe Calls For Applesauce.)
instructions: In a bowl cream shortening with sugar. In a separate bowl sift dry ingredients then add to creamed mixture alternately with the applesauce. Drop with a teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: 2 Plus 2 Plus 2
instructions: Layer meat onions and soup in crock-pot. Cook 8 to 10 hours on low. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Mix all ingredients except celery. Put mixture into celery and enjoy.

title: New Year'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Allow cheese to soften and mix all ingredients (except pecans). Roll into ball and roll in chopped pecans. Recipe makes 2 large balls or 1 extra large ball or log.

title: Feather Scones
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder and salt then rub in the shortening. Beat eggs and milk together then stir in. Use a bit more milk if necessary to make a rather soft yet easily handled dough. Turn out on a floured board and knead slightly. Roll out to 1/2-inch thick. Cut into a triangle with knife or cut with a round cutter. Place on an ungreased baking pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until light and brown. Serve at once with butter. Makes about 30.

title: Light Diet Burgers
instructions: Combine beef 1-1/2 teaspoon salt pepper and 2 tablespoons steak sauce. Form into several patties. In large skillet sear patties on both sides. Remove from pan; lower heat and add onions peppers mushrooms 2 tablespoons steak sauce and 1 teaspoon salt. Simmer until vegetables are tender. Replace patties. Simmer until meat is cooked. Add tomatoes at the end just to heat through.

title: Sweet And Sour Beans
instructions: Fry bacon reserve drippings. Add sugar and vinegar to drippings and simmer until clear. Drain beans reserve 1/2 cup liquid.

title: Pineapple And Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake at 325\u00b0 in 3 layers.

title: Nippy Pork Chop Platter
instructions: Spread mustard over pork chops. Combine flour salt and pepper in bag. Shake chops in bag to coat. Then brown in heavy skillet in melted fat. Place chops in baking dish; cover with soup and milk that has been mixed together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together the green beans Shoe Peg corn celery soup sour cream Cheddar cheese and chopped onion. Pour into a 3-quart baking dish. Crush Ritz crackers and mix with margarine. Pour on top of casserole. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pinto Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook beef onion and garlic until brown; drain drippings. Add tomato sauce and chili powder. Spoon into lightly greased 12 x 8-inch or 10 x 10-inch pan. Top with cheese; spoon beans over cheese. Prepare corn bread as directed on package; pour on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or until corn bread is brown.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise vinegar and sugar; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add mayonnaise mixture; mix well. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Knipfla Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes. Add bay leaves allspice and onion. Boil until potatoes are half done about 1/2 hour. Use enough water as it is used for the soup broth.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni 6 minutes and drain. In medium saucepan combine cornstarch salt dry mustard and pepper. Stir in milk until smooth. Add margarine stirring constantly. Bring to boil over medium-high heat and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in cheese until melted. Add elbows. Turn into greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Ding Dong Cake
instructions: Bake the cake in 2 (8-inch) cake pans. When cool make 4 layers then frost with 12 Minute Icing in between layers and on top and sides. Ice with chocolate icing.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Add 1/2 cup water or more to moisten. Drop teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until sausage is cooked.

title: Broccoli Orange Salad
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Add mayonnaise mixture to the broccoli mixture. Gently stir in oranges. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix cake per box instructions. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake per instructions. Let cool slightly. With a wooden spoon handle poke holes in cake at 2-inch intervals. Drizzle topping over cake. Spread Cool Whip over topping. Sprinkle Heath bars over Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Four-Bean Salad
instructions: Rinse and drain all beans. Combine with pepper and onions. Blend remaining ingredients together well to dissolve sugar. Pour over bean mixture. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
instructions: Throw all together in a bowl and stir until mixed. Pour in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers; pack in pint jars. Have a shallow pan of hot water ready. Turn jars upside down in pan. This allows steam to rise in jars and heat cucumbers. Do not leave too long. Heat but do not boil vinegar water sugar and salt; remove jars and pour vinegar mixture over cucumbers. Let set for several weeks before opening jars to eat. Good with fish!

title: German Slaw
instructions: Pour 1 cup sugar over shredded vegetables and peppers; mix and set aside. Combine all other ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over vegetables. Mix and refrigerate from 12 to 24 hours in a covered container. Will keep for 2 weeks.

title: Canned Green Peanuts
instructions: Wash peanuts. Put in large pan and bring to a boil.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken and debone. Mix soups and sour cream together with meat; pour in greased casserole dish. Put crackers in Zip Lock bag and pour melted margarine and shake well; pour over top of casserole and sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until good and hot.

title: Broccoli With Bacon And Chestnuts
instructions: Cut the broccoli into florets peel the stems and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices. In a heavy skillet cook the bacon until crisp. Remove from the pan and drain all but 1 Tbsp. fat. Add the olive oil and butter heat until bubbly. Add the chestnuts and saut for 1 minute. Add the bacon and hold on low heat. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the broccoli and time for 5 minutes or until done to the desired tenderness. Drain well and put back into hot pan. Add the bacon-chestnut mixture to the broccoli; salt and pepper toss and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Be sure its beginning to thicken. If doubled it takes longer to cook.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and thinly slice boiled potatoes. Fry bacon slowly drain on paper. Saute onion in bacon fat until golden brown. Blend in flour sugar salt pepper and celery seed. Cook over low heat stirring until smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in water and vinegar. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Carefully stir in potatoes and crumbled bacon bits. Remove from heat cover and let stand until ready to serve 4 to 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Bar
instructions: Press crescent rolls on a large flat cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until brown. Let cool.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and 3 tablespoons of sugar and put in a flat baking dish (13 x 9-inch). Bake 8 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Remove and pat down; cool.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Salt and pepper pork pieces and brown quickly. Place rice in bottom of large buttered baking dish and cover with orange juice. Put pork pieces on top of rice and pour can of soup over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Check if additional moisture is needed. Replace with orange juice or water. Bake 15 minutes longer or until done.

title: Big Art'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Turn off and let simmer. Now get ready for the best barbecue sauce you have ever tasted.

title: Scottish Minches
instructions: Brown beef in vegetable oil then pour off any fat. Add onion and garlic to meat; steam together 10 minutes. Add potato seasonings and water to cover potato. Simmer until potato is mushy. Pour into\tbaking\tdish; top with crumbs. Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Summer Berry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in medium saucepan. Gradually stir in water until smooth. Stirring constantly cook on medium heat until mixture comes to boil; boil 1 minute. Add Jell-O. Let cool. Put in pie crust.

title: My Own Pizza
instructions: Lay two biscuits side by side and press out into a circular form. Place flattened biscuits on greased cookie sheets. Top with sauce and desired toppings. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Combine the first seven ingredients and pour over spareribs. Put in crock-pot on low for 8 hours. You can also put in oven for 3 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Meat Loaf Festiva
instructions: Mix in\tall ingredients by hand except catsup in a large bowl. Work the mixture into a large ball. Divide the ball into 4\tportions. Press each portion into a Bundt cake pan. Place the cake pan on a cookie sheet. Bake at 315\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Drain any fat every 1/2 hour. Cool 15 minutes. Turn the meat loaf onto serving dish. Garnish with catsup.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Crumble 1 to 1 1/2 cups of cornbread into a big salad bowl. In another bowl combine tomatoes pepper onion pickle and bacon. Spoon half the vegetable mixture over the cornbread. Stir together the mayo and pickle juice in a small bowl. Repeat the layering with the remaining cornbread vegetable and dressing. Garnish as desired. Cover tightly and chill 2-3 hours before serving. Makes 6-8 servings.

title: Chicken Or Veal Marsala
instructions: In a large frying pan put olive oil and garlic; brown. Pound chicken breasts or veal until 1/4-inch thickness. Add breading which you have added salt pepper oregano thyme basil and marjoram. Add chicken to oil; saute until lightly browned about 2 minutes on each side then add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned 3 to 5 minutes. Add 1/4 cup Marsala wine and the Rhine wine; bring to a boil. Add tomatoes and a little sugar; season to your taste. Let simmer covered while you boil water and cook your fettucine noodles. When noodles are cooked toss with margarine and grated Parmesan cheese. Serve with chicken or veal sauce. Bon appetit to you.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Flatten and sprinkle with cheese. Roll up and form into a loaf. Top with catsup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in pan; blend in flour and seasonings. Stir until smooth. Add milk and cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add cheese and heat until melted. Place drained potatoes in a baking dish; cover with sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until browned.

title: Appleless Apple Pie
instructions: Bring sugar water and cream of tartar to a boil. Add crackers. Boil for 2 minutes; cool. Pour into a pie shell. Sprinkle with spice. Dot with butter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serve hot with ice cream.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage. Add onion green pepper and celery. Cook a few minutes to saute the vegetables. Add other ingredients and pour into a large casserole. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cream of celery soup milk and mayonnaise. Melt butter in baking dish. Layer other ingredients. Pour soup/milk mixture over top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Place butter in bowl. Stir in flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Add bananas and buttermilk. Mix until moistened and beat 2 minutes on medium speed. Add 1/3 cup buttermilk and eggs and beat 2 minutes longer. If desired fold in walnuts. Bake in 2 greased and floured 9 x 9 pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant-Tomato Casserole
instructions: Cover eggplant with salted water and boil for 10 minutes. In buttered baking dish layer the eggplant corn and tomatoes. Sprinkle with sugar bread crumbs salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Kappa Alpha Theta Casserole
instructions: Cut crusts off of bread and cut into cubes. Cook celery until tender. Put 1/2 of bread cubes in bottom of 3-quart casserole. Mix shrimp crabmeat green pepper diced celery salt and mayonnaise and spread over bread. Mix egg milk and mustard and pour over mixture in casserole. Cover with rest of bread. Spread over the top one can of undiluted cream of mushroom soup. Spread cheese over top and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Shred the Cheddar cheese and let stand until softened. Cream together with softened cream cheese. Add chopped red pepper chopped green pepper garlic and hot pepper. (Drain off excess juice before adding to cheese.) Add smidgen Italian seasoning parsley and oregano. Add couple drops Worcestershire sauce. Blend with mixer. Shape on plate and refrigerate. Seasonings are really to your own liking. There is no exact measurement. Dont worry youll get better with practice.

title: Caramel Raisin Pie
instructions: Line pan with uncooked crust. Sprinkle raisins in crust. Mix sugar flour and whipping cream. Pour over raisins and cover with top crust. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown. If edges brown too fast cover with foil and continue cooking.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Make in large punch bowl. Bake brownies as directed on box. After baking brownies pour Kahlua over the top and let soak (optional it is just as good without it). Cut brownies in chunks and place half in bottom of punch bowl. Sprinkle half of chopped Skor bars spread half of the mousse and next the Cool Whip. Repeat. Top with maraschino cherries. Refrigerate. Serves a lot.

title: Pecan Pie 2
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Add nuts. Pour in two shells (uncooked) and bake 45 minutes on 350\u00b0.

title: Tender Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to make a marinade. Add marinade to large Dutch oven with 5 to 6 pounds spareribs (I like country style ribs). Simmer on stove approximately 1 hour stirring occasionally to make sure all ribs are covered. Place the \cooked\ ribs on hot barbecue grill to sear. Serve and enjoy. Pass around the cooked marinade and use as barbecue sauce. Serves 8 to 10 persons.

title: Down Home Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In 1-quart saucepan over medium heat heat all ingredients to boiling. Reduce heat to a low temperature. Simmer for 10 minutes. Makes 1 3/4 cups of sauce. Pour over your cooked meat dish.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Cut margarine into flour. Stir in 1/2 cup nuts. Press into 13 x 9-inch dish. Bake 10 minutes. Combine cream cheese and sugar. Beat until fluffy. Fold in 1 cup topping. Spread over cooled crust. Chill.

title: Irish Potato Soup
instructions: Saute bacon. Add potatoes onion marjoram and beef stock. Cook 25 minutes. Add leeks carrots and celery. Simmer 10 minutes. Add cream. Cook 5 minutes. Season. Garnish with parsley.

title: Buttermilk Pie #2
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until it looks grainy then add flour and eggs until it looks creamy. Fold in buttermilk butter flavoring lemon extract and vanilla. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Check at 30 minutes if getting too brown cut down 25 degrees.) Done when middle is not wiggly.

title: Magic French Fudge
instructions: In top of double boiler melt chips over boiling water. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour in buttered 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts. Place slice of ham and swiss cheese on each chicken breast. Tuck in and roll up like a jelly roll. Combine crumbs parmesan and parsley. In baking dish melt butter on high for 30 - 40 seconds. Dip chicken in butter then roll in crumbs. Arrange chicken rolls seam side down. Cook covered at 70 percent power in microwave for 12 - 15 minutes until done. Serves 4.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake uncovered in 300\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. Serve over cooked noodles. Yields 8 servings.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Salt and pepper meat. Sprinkle meat with meat tenderizer. Pound meat to tenderize and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Heat oil in Dutch oven or large pot. Brown meat in oil. Add remaining ingredients and simmer on low for 2 hours. Stir frequently and add more water if necessary. Combine cornstarch with small amount of water and mix well. Add to stew and cook to thicken. Serve with cornbread.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: First Layer Mix graham cracker crumbs granulated sugar and oleo. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 8 minutes at 325\u00b0; cool.

title: Catherine'S Southwest Cheesecake
instructions: Combine cheeses until creamy. Add eggs taco seasoning and chilies. Pour into spring-form pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and spread sour cream on top. Return to oven for 5 more minutes. Cool. Then refrigerate overnight. When serving remove sides. Pour a jar of salsa on top. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except carrots together. After well mixed add carrots. Bake in 3 greased and floured layer pans for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Use Carrot Cake Icing.

title: Caramel Rum Fondue
instructions: Heat caramels rum extract butter and water in a double-boiler over moderate heat stirring until mixture is smooth. Pour into fondue pot and keep warm. Spear apple slices and dip in fondue.

title: Spinach-Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Saute mushrooms garlic and onions (until onions are limp) in artichoke marinade. Stir in drained and dry spinach soup and sour cream eggs oregano nutmeg pepper and lemon juice until well blended.

title: Cobbler Dessert
instructions: Mix flour Crisco sugar salt and baking soda. Work like pie dough. Mix together eggs and vanilla then add to dough. If dough is stiff add up to 2 tablespoons milk. Divide dough in half and press 1/2 into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put filling over bottom. Flatten pieces of remaining dough and place on top of filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Frizzle meat. Add onions and garlic. Add other ingredients except spaghetti and cheese. Simmer for 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti. Cut into small or 2-inch lengths. Add to meat mixture. Layer this with cheese two layers each. Place in refrigerator overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before baking. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Overnight Salad
instructions: Combine beaten eggs sugar flour and orange juice. Cook until thick and while hot add marshmallows and cream cheese. Stir until smooth. Add drained pineapple and mandarin oranges. When cold fold in whipped cream. Sprinkle ground nuts on top (optional). Let stand overnight.

title: Easy Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in buttered 1-quart casserole. Cook 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix together sour cream sugar and coconut. Refrigerate overnight. Next morning bake cake. Split each layer in half to make 4 layers. Beat Cool Whip into coconut mixture. Frost layers and refrigerate.

title: Steak Diane
instructions: Sprinkle steaks with pepper and salt. In a skillet melt 2 tablespoons of margarine stir in onions and mustard. Cook for 1 minute. Add steaks cook for 3 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness. Remove to serving plate and keep warm. Add lemon juice worcestershire sauce and remaining butter to skillet. Cook for 2 minutes. Add parsley and chives. Pour over steaks.

title: Layer Salad
instructions: Arrange lettuce in bottom of bowl. Cover with celery and onion. Spread mayonnaise over top. Cover with thick layer of cheese. Sprinkle bacon on the top. Let sit one hour before tossing.

title: Easy No Bake Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk (beat). Fold in Cool Whip and condensed milk. Layer bananas and wafers. Put pudding mixture on top. Refrigerate.

title: Holiday House Fragrance
instructions: Simmer all ingredients. Add more as needed. Smell and Enjoy!!!

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into an unbaked pastry shell. Cook in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Kansas Coffeecake
instructions: Crumble sugars oleo flour and rolled oats together. Set back 1 cup for topping. Mix in eggs buttermilk soda and salt. Beat until smooth. Pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle reserved cup of crumbs on top of batter. You may then put mini chocolate chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Number of servings 12 to 15.

title: Joy'S Chicken
instructions: Wrap 1 strips bacon around rolled half of each chicken breast. Place 8 pieces of chicken in casserole which has been covered with 1 layer of beef. Mix sour cream and soups. Pour over chicken. Do not salt. Cook uncovered 3 hours at 300\u00b0. If you like you may increase sour cream and soup.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheet. In large bowl stir together butter and cocoa until mixture is smooth. Stir in sweetened condensed milk eggs vanilla extract oats baking mix salt vanilla milk chips and peanut butter chips until well blended. Let batter rest 10 minutes; drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheet. Bake 7 to 9 minutes or until tops begin to dry (do not overbake). Cool 5 minutes; remove from cookie sheet to wire rack. Cool completely. Store in airtight container. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add onion then milk and beaten egg. Add water until right consistency.

title: Ranch Cornbread
instructions: Beat buttermilk and egg together slightly. Sift cornmeal baking powder soda and salt together; add to buttermilk and egg mixture. Pour into a hot 9-inch iron skillet into which 2 to 3 tablespoons bacon drippings have been melted. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown the meat. Add the beans tomatoes salt catsup and steak sauce. Pour mix in baking dish. Mix the cornbread and drop by tablespoons on top of the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cornbread is brown.

title: Beer Biscuits
instructions: Mix ingredients. Drop in well-greased muffin tin. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown. You let biscuits rise in muffin tin from about 20 minutes to around 1 hour before baking. They are light puffy and fluffy.

title: Basic Marinara Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet. Add onion and garlic. Cook until tender. Add tomatoes and liquid spices and sugar. Cover and simmer over medium heat 20 minutes to blend flavors. Cool and divide into 3 half-pint freezer containers. Freeze and use to make Mediterranean Stuffed Potatoes Southwest Turkey Pie or marinara makes an excellent base for spaghetti sauce.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts (set aside). Cook rice (set aside). Saute onion butter and broccoli together. Add cream of mushroom soup milk and chicken broth. Add pieces of Velveeta cheese and Worcestershire sauce. Add cooked chicken (cubed) and cooked rice. Butter casserole dish and pour all ingredients into it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 to 30 minutes until top is brown. Makes about 5 servings.

title: Mexican Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Chop onion in small pieces. Prepare rice according to box directions but add the chopped onion to the water before it boils. Steam the broccoli until tender. Add the steamed broccoli and mushroom soup to the rice; mix together well.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and blend well. Pour into a loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Streusel Ginger Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease well and dust with flour a square pan (9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch).

title: Spiced Apple Pancakes
instructions: Make pancakes and serve with sauce.

title: Soft Bread Sticks(For Bread Machine)
instructions: Place yeast flour sugar herbs oil water and salt in bread machine pan and process on dough setting. After cycle is complete remove dough to lightly floured board and form into a tight ball. Cover with bread machine pan and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Heat over to 350\u00b0. Spritz 2 large baking sheets with cooking spray. Cut dough into 16 equal size pieces. Roll each piece into 20-inch long ropes. Place sticks on prepared baking sheet sides not touching. Set aside to rise until puffy (about 15 minutes). Brush with frothy egg white. Sprinkle with desired topping. Bake until golden brown (about 20 to 25 minutes). Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes then remove to rack.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Stir in cocoa flour vanilla and salt. Spread in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until tests done. Cool. Spread marshmallow cream over cooled brownies.

title: Jello Dessert With Topping
instructions: Let jello jell. Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Infallible Rice
instructions: Saute onion in butter until transparent. Combine onion rice and hot broth. Bring to a boil on top of range. Cover and cook in a 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Yum Yum Casserole
instructions: Spray 13 x 9 x 2 pan with Pam. Lay 1 can of croissant rolls in bottom of dish. Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Spread on croissants. Top with another can of croissants. Pour melted margarine over top. Mix 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Sprinkle with mixture over top of margarine.

title: Whoopie Pies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs vanilla hot water mixed with chocolate then dry ingredients with sour milk. Drop by teaspoon on greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Mix the last 4 ingredients; heat until butter melts. Wrap each apple wedge in a section of crescent roll. Place in baking pan and pour syrup over them. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serve warm with a scoop of ice cream or top with whipped cream.

title: Oatmeal Bars(20)
instructions: Sift together first 6 ingredients. Beat other ingredients well add the dry ingredients and beat again. Place in large greased pan (jelly roll type). Spread over pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Cool. Ice with \thin\ powdered sugar icing.

title: Maple Cream Bonbons
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream the butter sugar and maple flavoring until smooth. Stir in walnuts. Shape into 1-inch balls; place on waxed paper-lined baking sheets. Freeze until firm.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix all five ingredients then add Cool Whip last. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Melt butter in iron skillet. Add sugar and syrup. Stir until dissolved. Then add peanuts. Cook over high heat for 5 to 7 minutes. Cook 1 minute after first peanut pops. Do not let brown. Remove from heat stir in soda then pour on greased cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken. Cook egg noodles in chicken broth. When noodles are done drain and add chicken along with other ingredients except Ritz crackers and butter. Pour in dish. Spread crackers over top of casserole. Then pour melted butter on top of cracker crumbs. Bake at 300\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Orange-Peach Refresher
instructions: Peel and pit peaches. In blender container combine orange juice milk powder ice cubes and fruit. Cover and blend until the mixture is smooth. Pour into 2 glasses. Garnish with additional peach slices and mint sprigs if desired. Makes 2 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in shallow baking pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour on chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with white rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Quick Monkey Bread
instructions: Sprinkle pecans evenly in bottom of a well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan. Set pan aside. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Cut biscuits into quarters; roll each piece in sugar mixture and layer in pan. Combine brown sugar and butter; pour over dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool bread 10 minutes. Turn onto plate.

title: Rich Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift flour cocoa and salt together three times. Cream sugar and butter; add eggs. Beat well; add milk with soda then beat in flour and vanilla. Last add boiling water. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine 3/4 cup sugar and 3 cups strawberries. To one cup of sweetened berries add 1 cup hot water; bring to boiling point and add 1 strawberry jello; stir until completely dissolved. Cool until beginning to set. Then stir in remainder of berries vanilla extract and whipped cream. (Whip 1/2 pint of whipping cream and use remainder for top of pie.) Pour into baked pie shell. Chill until filled pie is set and top with rest of whipped cream. Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole(Small Recipe)
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Combine all ingredients; place in casserole dish and cover with 1 (4 ounce) package shredded American cheese or Cheddar cheese. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Jelly
instructions: In an 8 to 10-quart kettle combine apples and 5 cups of water. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until very soft stirring occasionally. Strain through a jelly bag or clean pillowcase. Do not squeeze. Measure juice. Add enough water to make 4 cups liquid.

title: Poor Man'S Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well blended. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Benne Bites
instructions: Lightly grease cookie sheet (Pam) and preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill until ready to serve.

title: Heavenly Ambrosia
instructions: Arrange half of the oranges in bottom of bowl; sprinkle with half of the coconut. Add the pineapple; sprinkle with remaining coconut. Add remaining oranges. Chill. Garnish with additional coconut if desired.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
