instructions: Mix together until spreading consistency. Spread on tortillas. Roll up and cut into 1-inch pieces. Bake on cookie sheet in 400\u00b0 oven for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pot. When thoroughly mixed heat and stir until thick. Cool and knead. Store in an airtight container.

title: Sugar-Free Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine and Jell-O. Add egg and vanilla. Add flour and soda. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Czechoslovakian Cheese Cake
instructions: Margaret Schultz mother was born in a Pennsylvania Dutch community. Her ancestors moved from Holland to Germany so the Dutch Pepernoten became Pfeffernuesse in Germany. Same recipe different name.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Brown meat over medium heat. Add onion rings and green peppers. Simmer covered for 5 minutes. Combine brown sugar vinegar soy sauce pineapple juice and cornstarch. Heat until smooth. Add can of pineapple and pour over meat mixture. Simmer for 5 minutes. Season to taste. Serve over rice.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Prepare pudding mix with skim milk then mix with other ingredients. Put into a graham cracker pie crust. Top with Cool Whip; sprinkle with chopped pecans or wafer crumbs.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and butter; beat well. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour soda baking powder salt and ginger. Mix creamed ingredients and dry ingredients with sour cream. Add raisins last and mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in a well-greased loaf pan.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut cube steak in thin strips and season well with garlic salt pepper and sprinkle of ginger. Brown lightly in deep skillet with 1/2 cup oil. Remove from skillet. Saute celery slices and pepper strips. When \crisp-tender\ or color has changed add meat soy sauce and cornstarch dissolved in water (may add more water as mixture thickens). Cook about 3 minutes. Add diced tomatoes and salt. Heat well. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Dairy Potato Bake
instructions: Stir together first 8 ingredients. Pour over potatoes. Stir until well coated. Top with corn flake crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Mississippi Corn Salad
instructions: Cut green onions up including green tips. Add cut up tomato. Add drained corn. Mix mayonnaise yogurt and bay leaf (crushed). Salt and pepper and mix. Refrigerate 4 to 14 hours.

title: Champion Sponge Cake
instructions: Sift together 1 cup sugar baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites at high speed until frothy. Add cream of tartar. Gradually add 1/2 cup of sugar beating until stiff but not dry and peaks form. Combine egg yolks water vanilla and dry ingredients. Beat at medium-high speed until thick and lemon colored (about 4 minutes). Gradually fold egg yolk mixture into egg whites. Pour batter into ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Invert to cool. Serve plain or frost with Pineapple Frosting.

title: Shrimp Victoria
instructions: Saute shrimp and onion in butter. Add mushrooms flour salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes. Add sour cream. Cook until thick and hot.

title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in a bowl and mix well. In a saucepan mix butter shortening cocoa and water. Bring to a rapid bowl. Pour over flour and sugar mixing gradually. Add soda with buttermilk and add to other ingredients. Mix together and pour into greased and floured 11 x 16-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Make icing 5 minutes before cake is done and pour over hot cake.

title: Pork Chops With Apple
instructions: In shallow dish combine apple and lemon juice onion and savory. Add pork chops turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Remove chops and place on broiler pan. Strain marinade and set aside. Bake chops at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Eggnog
instructions: Beat egg sugar and salt. Add milk and vanilla extract beating thoroughly. Pour into glass and sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Sugared Walnuts
instructions: Combine the sugars and sour cream in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved stirring constantly. Continue cooking this mixture without stirring until it reaches 238\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir until nuts are thickly covered and the coating loses its gloss. (Dont give up this takes a while!) Spoon nuts onto wax paper and separate nuts with forks. Cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with cheese slices.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown onion & pepper in cooking oil. Add hamburger meat and cook until done. Drain grease and stir in soup and noodles. Pour into baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-45 minutes.

title: Double Chocolate-Mint Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In top of double boiler melt 3/4 cup morsels over hot (not boiling) water; stir until smooth. Cool to room temperature. Combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl beat butter brown sugar white sugar and vanilla extract until creamy. Add melted morsels and egg; beat well. Gradually blend in flour mixture. Stir in remaining morsels and nuts. Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes. Allow to stand for 2 to 3 minutes before removing from cookie sheet; cool completely before covering. Yield 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Granny'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Then blend in egg; add other ingredients to mixture. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Roll dough into 1/8 inch thickness. Place on cookie sheet and bake in preheated moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes approximately 2 dozen cookies about 2 inches in diameter.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar syrup butter and vanilla; put nuts in the bottom of pie crust and pour mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done or bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes with pie pan on top then take off pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cream Cheese Squares
instructions: Cream sugar vanilla and cream cheese. Unroll dont separate 1 package crescent rolls and place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread on the cheese mixture. Brush top with beaten egg yolk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Store in refrigerator. Yields 24 to 30.

title: Strawberry Pie - Baked Graham Cracker Crust
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Stir Jell-O about 3 minutes; add 2 cups ice cubes. Stir until ice melts and Jell-O thickens. Blend Cool Whip into Jell-O until smooth. Fold in strawberries. Chill until mixture will mound. Spoon into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Golden Glow
instructions: In large pitcher or punch bowl combine concentrates and water. Just before serving add ginger ale and ice; stir to blend. Makes 25 (4 oz.) servings.

title: Mini Chip Sour Cream Streusel Cake
instructions: In saucepan heat sugar and water to boiling. Remove and add chips; stir until melted and desired consistency. Spread over cooled cake.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Heat the first 4 ingredients to the stage you can test with finger without burning. Beat eggs and the first mixture and beat to mix. Add yeast. Add flour one cup at a time. Beat until dough is smooth. If dough seems too thin add additional flour until dough climbs up the beaters. Set bowl in warm water; let rise until double in bulk. Turn on greased baking sheet. Let rise for 20 to 30 minutes in a warm place. Bake for 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Makes 20 to 24 rolls.

title: Lemon Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon Jell-O with 1 cup hot water. Cream in cream cheese slightly. Let this set then fold in cottage cheese celery nuts and pineapple.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in order. Serve cold with chips.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: First shred potatoes in a food processor or on a cheese grater. Place the shredded potatoes in a medium sized bowl and cover with cold water. Chill in fridge for at least 30 minutes. Drain potatoes squeeze out the excess moisture with hands. In a medium bowl combine the potatoes eggs salt and flour. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp. bacon grease in a skillet. When hot drop potatoes by spoonfuls and fry until golden brown on both sides. Serve.

title: Sunset Salad
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Let cool some. Then add carrots and pineapple.

title: Purple Cow
instructions: Combine all ingredients in covered shaker and shake until well blended. Pour in tall glass and slurp!!!

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Combine flour salt and paprika in paper or plastic bag. Brush chicken with lemon juice. Add 2 or 3 pieces of chicken at a time to bag and shake well to coat chicken with flour mixture. In 12-inch skillet brown the chicken slowly in hot shortening. Dissolve bouillon granules in the boiling water. Stir in green onion brown sugar lemon peel and any remaining lemon juice. Pour over chicken. Cover; reduce heat and cook over low heat for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Sprinkle with snipped parsley if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Rinse and drain. Combine with butter grated Parmesan cheese and eggs. Spoon into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Grandma'S Cookie Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix butter oil cocoa and water. Bring to a boil. Add the sugar flour and salt; beat well. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add to mixture along with eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Pour into greased cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix corn flakes and melted margarine. Spread over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Salad (Dessert Or With Meal)
instructions: Heat Apple sauce until hot enough to dissolve jello. Add orange juice. Refrigerate until firm. Serve squares on lettuce leaf. Suggestion serve sour cream as dressing.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients and serve with your favorite vegetables.

title: Kibbee And Eggs
instructions: Beat eggs (number of eggs will depend upon the amount of Kibbee and number of people youre serving). Gently mix in Kibbee and pour into pan and cook like an omelette. Serve with a cucumber and Laban salad.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice and mix thoroughly. Pour over rice in a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until set. Sprinkle additional nutmeg on top.

title: Pecan Delight
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy; add cream of tartar. Gradually add sugar while beating. When stiff fold in pecans crackers and vanilla. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool. Spread whipped topping on pie and keep refrigerated.

title: Fudge Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and cocoa in medium bowl. Add eggs corn syrup margarine and vanilla. Stir until well blended. Add pecans. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Chicken Hot Dish
instructions: Butter 9 x 13 pan. Put half of this mixture in pan.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all together. Serve with crackers. If desired can add a couple of shakes of hot sauce.

title: Chocolate Surprise
instructions: Mix butter flour and nuts and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until browned. Cool completely.

title: Creamy Onion Dip
instructions: Blend sour cream dry onion soup mix crumbled Blue Cheese and chopped walnuts. Makes 2 cups.

title: Turkey Soup
instructions: Place turkey carcass in 5-quart pot. Fill to within 1 1/2-inches from top with water (about 22 cups). Add bouillon. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours. Remove from heat. Take out turkey carcass. Let cool. Remove all meat from carcass. Put into bowl; cover and refrigerate. Pour broth into large container and refrigerate. Next day heat broth then add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and cook until barley and vegetables are cooked.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground chuck; add onion salt and garlic salt and pepper and simmer until onion is tender. Drain. In large boiler mix Prego sauce Ro-Tel and meat. Simmer for a minimum of 30 minutes. While sauce is simmering cook noodles until tender. When noodles are done add to sauce. Delicious! Even better the next day!

title: Bran Loaf Bread
instructions: Soften cereal in milk. Sift flour with sugar baking powder and salt. Stir egg and shortening into softened cereal. Add flour mixture; stir just until all flour is moistened. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 360\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on rack. For easier cutting store in refrigerator overnight (wrapped).

title: Honey Rutabaga
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer mixture 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Winter Chili Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer slowly for about 1 hour or until thickened.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar butter cocoa nuts and peanut butter. Boil 1 minute or longer. Drop on wax paper.

title: Goodies
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan spread dry cake mix. Melt margarine and mix with 1 egg. Dribble this over dry cake mix. Press down on bottom of pan. In another bowl mix softened cream cheese 2 eggs and sugar. Pour over top of cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cut into small squares. Very rich!

title: Creates It'S Own Crust Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Add milk and flour blending well. Add coconut. Pour into a lightly greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Drop Cookies
instructions: Boil the white sugar and Karo syrup together for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add the peanut butter vanilla and cereal. Drop onto waxed paper; let cool.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak; slice across grain into 2 x 1/4-inch strips. Brown steak in oil. Add onion and cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Combine sour cream soup catsup and Worcestershire sauce and add to steak. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture is thoroughly heated. Serve over noodles sprinkled with poppy seed. Yields 4 servings.

title: Tuna Tetrazzini(Microwave)
instructions: Combine cooked spaghetti soup and milk in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add tuna mushrooms onion and 1/2 cup cheese. Cook on Full power for 8 minutes. Stir halfway through and sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Cook in Full power for 1 to 2 more minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Stir the dry ingredients. Add milk egg and butter. Beat well and bake in an 8-inch greased pan in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions in skillet. Pour off drippings. Add Ragu sauce and mix well while simmering. Combine cottage cheese eggs and Mozzarella cheese in bowl. Mix until smooth. Layer noodles sauce and cheese mixture alternately in 9 x 13-inch baking dish until ingredients are used. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Steak Fingers
instructions: For milk mustard and flour amounts are approximate.

title: Non-Fattening Potato Slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut potato into thin rounds. Soak in cold salted water. Spread a layer of potato rounds on a lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt and paprika. Bake without turning for about 1 hour. Potatoes will brown and puff and will taste almost like French fries.

title: Pig Lickin' Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box except dont add water. Use the juice from oranges. Add oranges and 3 tablespoons pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Almond Crescents
instructions: Cream butter and vanilla. Add 1 tablespoon water and flour. Mix thoroughly; stir in nuts and shape into crescents. Place on ungreased pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. While hot roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on package and set aside. Cook broccoli; drain. Add Cheez Whiz while broccoli is hot. Saute onions celery and pepper in margarine. Mix rice and vegetables and add soup. Bake in covered casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the reserved butter and corn flakes. Pour into well-greased casserole dish. Sprinkle top with corn flakes. Pour reserved butter over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheez Whiz Soup
instructions: Heat and cook all vegetables with juice from the can. Stir in Cheez Whiz and melt. Do not let it boil.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Mix together crushed wafers and 1/2 cup margarine and pat in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 2 eggs 1 cup margarine and 2 cups powdered sugar; beat until fluffy and spread over crust. Slice bananas (coated with lemon juice) layer over filling. Drain pineapple layer over bananas. Spread Cool Whip over pineapple sprinkle with chopped nuts. Put 1 cherry in center of each serving. Refrigerate.

title: Cream Of Corn Soup
instructions: Combine milk and corn in top of double boiler. Saute minced onion in butter for a few minutes (do not brown); add flour. Add to corn mixture and cook 15 to 20 minutes. Mash through a strainer. Just before serving add well-beaten egg cream chives parsley salt and pepper. Reheat. Serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Have meat ground twice. Combine the beef and pork. Season with the salt and pepper. Add other ingredients; mix well and shape into a loaf. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Makes 8 servings.

title: Orange Ambrosia
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple; mix all ingredients together well. Serve cold.

title: Golden Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello with hot water in a bowl and cool. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into 9 x 9-inch Pyrex dish congeal. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix oil sugar and vanilla; then beat in egg until light and fluffy. Stir in milk. Blend in flour. Refrigerate in a covered bowl overnight or at least 2 1/2 hours. When ready to cook spoon out dough on a lightly floured cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Gak
instructions: Fill 1 dixie cup 1/3 full of blue starch. Fill 1 dixie cup 1/3 full of Elmers glue. Dump together and mix with index finger until slimy. Add a drop or two of food coloring. Store in a Ziploc bag. This is a toy not to eat!

title: Croatian Povetica Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Sift dry ingredients together and add slowly to the creamed mixture. Put vanilla in the sour cream and stir it in the rest of the mixture. Then swirl in the nut mixture.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown and drain ground meat with onions. In a soup pot combine meat and onions with remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil then simmer 45 minutes. Serve with cheese and tortilla chips.

title: Cinnamon Butter
instructions: Cream butter and add sifted powdered sugar. Mix in cinnamon. Put on toast English muffins biscuits etc.

title: Valerie'S Caesar Dressing
instructions: Combine first three ingredients in a jar and let rest for at least 2 hours or overnight. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Toss with romaine lettuce croutons and grated parmesan cheese.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Mix soup sour cream and chicken. Mix well and put into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix crushed crackers and melted oleo. Cover the chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Ryan'S Cherry Chiffon Dessert
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. (Drain pineapple very good.) Mix well. Spoon into small dishes or large bowl. Chill.

title: Olive Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Form into a loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. It will have a red look after cooking due to the tomato sauce.

title: Serve On Hot Dogs
instructions: Saute peppers and onion until tender. Add sauerkraut and heat.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Fold in bananas and nuts. Bake in two loaf pans for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Arrange fruit in unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle 1/3 cup of the sugar over fruit. Mix the remaining 2/3 cup of sugar with the melted butter egg and flour and pour over the fruit. Bake at 325\u00b0 approximately 45 minutes.

title: Date And Nut Caramel Roll
instructions: Combine sugar and milk in heavy saucepan. Boil over medium heat to soft ball stage (soft ball is formed by dropping 1/2 teaspoon of mixture into a cup of cold water). Add dates and continue cooking to soft ball stage again. Cool slightly and add chopped nuts. Turn onto buttered pan or platter; knead until creamy and stiff. Form into 4 or more rolls. Wrap rolls and place in refrigerator.

title: Cranberry Salad Delight
instructions: Serve on lettuce topped with salad dressing thinned with a little cream.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine flour salt sugar baking powder soda and cinnamon in bowl. Add eggs oil and vanilla mixing well. Stir in zucchini and walnuts. Pour into two greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 30 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix shortening eggs and vanilla together until it is smooth. Add in the salt baking soda and sour milk. Stir that well. Add flour in one cup at a time mixing after each addition. Mix bananas in. Fill pans about 3/4 full of the dough. Bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with the skin on and cool. Peel potatoes and cut into small pieces. Dice the onion and green pepper and add to potatoes. Add the salad olives and chopped eggs and stir in salad dressing. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; grease and flour a tube pan or 13 x 9-inch pan. (Tube pan is best.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Cocoa Lace Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat baking sheets; set aside. In medium saucepan melt butter. Stir in brown sugar and corn syrup and bring to a boil. Stir constantly until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat; stir in remaining ingredients until blended. Drop mixture by spoonfuls 3 inches apart on baking sheets. Bake 9 minutes or until cookies are spread thin and are deep brown but still soft. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheets. Work quickly with spatula removing cookies to cool completely on wire rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Roast Beef In Cooking Bag
instructions: Combine ingredients. Trim fat from beef roast. Combine all in cooking bag and cook at 350\u00b0 until beef is done. Makes its own gravy.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate sharp and mild Cheddar cheeses; set at room temperature until soft. To cream cheese add the Tabasco garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce; mix. Combine mild and sharp cheeses with cream cheese mixture; mix well. Shape into 2 large balls. Crush pecans and parsley flakes; roll cheese balls in this mixture until coated.

title: French-Style Peas
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add onion lettuce and mushrooms. Saute until onion is transparent. Add peas and water. Cook over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Southern Style Hominy
instructions: You will also need 1 cloth sack and large wash pot. A wooden frame with 1/4-inch spacing wire (hardware cloth) bottom will be useful for washing husk from corn if you are making this size batch. Smaller batches can be cleaned by hand.

title: Winford'S Secret Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Grind up onions bell pepper and celery in food processor or grinder. Cook bacon to be crispy. Crumble bacon and add to onions bell pepper and celery along with bacon grease. Cook to a mush. Add vinegar brown sugar and Cattlemans barbecue sauce. Add cornstarch to thicken and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Stir sugar and vinegar through cut up pickles making sure all sugar is wet. Add pickling spice and let sit stirring every 15 minutes. Let soak good in the syrup. Add to jar.

title: Suzy'S Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar add oil beat until fluffy. Add vanilla spices and salt. Mix dry ingredients. Add alternating with nuts zucchini and drained pineapple. Bake 1 1/2 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate. Great on Wheat Thins!

title: Pistachio Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix with a spoon (no mixer). Grease 2 loaf pans and dust with a mixture of 1/2 cup of sugar and cinnamon to taste. Any leftover can be used to sprinkle on top of loaves.\tBake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cool wrap in foil and refrigerate overnight. This enhances the flavor. Freezes well.

title: Creamed Chicken A La King
instructions: Saute diced chicken breast and onion until chicken is cooked. Add canned soups and a little milk to thin slightly. Add peas and carrots to suit your taste. Prepare puff pastry shells. Serve. (Can also be served over egg noodles or rice.)

title: Baked Potato Fluff
instructions: Peel cook and mash potatoes. Mix in with mashed potatoes onion cheese eggs and flour. Put in greased casserole dish. Top with canned onion rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Seven Layered Salad
instructions: Put into bowl in layers the following lettuce pepper celery onion green peas (drained) mayonnaise and sugar. Cover top with cheese and sprinkle top with bacon bits. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit in refrigerator overnight.

title: Valerie'S Best Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). In medium mixing bowl combine cocoa and baking soda. Blend in 1/3 cup melted butter. Add boiling water; stir until mixture thickens. Stir in sugar eggs and remaining 1/3 cup melted butter; stir until smooth. Add flour vanilla and salt; blend completely. Stir in nuts if desired and chocolate chunks. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely in pan; cut into squares. Makes about 36 brownies.

title: Sweet Potato Cake
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually and cream well. Add eggs; beat well after each one. Add sweet potatoes; mix well. Sift together rest of dry ingredients. Mix well and bake in a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Top with Caramel Icing.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Cut avocados in half and remove pits. Spoon out and mash pulp. Blend in remaining ingredients mixing until smooth. Makes 2 cups dip.

title: Company Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except macaroni cheese and mushroom soup and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Wash chicken and pat dry. Mix cream of chicken soup butter and salad dressing together. After ingredients are well mixed spread a small amount of mixture in bottom of casserole dish. Add chicken and spread remaining mixture over chicken.\tSprinkle potato chips over chicken then sprinkle almond chips over potato chips. Cover with lid or foil and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until chicken is tender. You may also microwave this dish with lid or plastic wrap for 25 minutes or until chicken is done all the way through. Best served with potatoes with onions green beans and garlic bread.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt chocolate chips peanut butter and butter until smooth and creamy. In large bowl pour chocolate mixture over Chex and mix until well coated. Let cool 20 to 30 minutes. Transfer mixture to brown grocery bag and add powdered sugar. Fold bag over and shake until well coated with powdered sugar. Add more sugar if needed when mix is completely cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Sweet Pepper Relish
instructions: Put onions and peppers through food chopper. Mix then cover with boiling water. Let stand for 10 minutes. Drain and let stand for 10 minutes. Add salt sugar and vinegar to peppers and onions. Simmer 15 minutes. Put in jars and seal while hot.

title: Hot Water Pie Crust
instructions: Pour boiling water over lard. Add and mix the flour baking powder and salt. Store in refrigerator until you are ready to use it.

title: Creamy Oyster Broccoli Stew
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan; combine milk and soup. Stir in broccoli potatoes and onion. Cook stirring occasionally over medium heat until bubbly breaking up broccoli with fork until thawed. Simmer covered for 10 minutes. Remove from heat; cool. Cover and chill. At serving time in 3-quart saucepan reheat soup. In saucepan place the fresh undrained oysters; cook over medium heat until edges curl. Add to broccoli mixture; heat through. If using canned oysters just add undrained oysters directly to soup; heat through. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Ten Dollar Fruit Pie
instructions: Melt butter in bottom of a large pan or baking dish. Combine milk flour sugar and baking powder. Pour over melted butter. Pour cooked hot fruit in center of batter. Spread a little. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes maybe a little longer.

title: Cumin Rice
instructions: Bring consomme to boil; add cumin. In skillet saute vegetables in butter until soft. Add rice and saute until golden brown. Put in a large casserole. Pour boiling liquid over rice. Cover and bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Stir and check for doneness of rice.

title: Yakitori(Japanese Skewered Chicken)
instructions: Combine sake (sherry) soy sauce and sugar in medium saucepan. Pare the ginger and cut into paper thin slices; add to saucepan. Bring to boiling. Lower heat and simmer 15 minutes or until sauce is reduced to 1 1/4 cups. Preheat broiler or hibachi. Dip skewered chicken pieces into sauce. Broil 2 minutes. Brush again with sauce and serve garnished with watercress.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add other ingredients. Beat well. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Unbaked Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together; add to melted butter and milk mixture. Bring these ingredients to a boil; boil hard for 2 minutes. Add oats peanut butter vanilla and salt; blend well. Remove from stove and drop by teaspoon onto wax paper while mixture is still warm. It takes about 1/2 hour for cookies to harden.

title: Double Chocolate Mint Dessert
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In large mixer bowl beat flour sugar butter eggs and syrup until smooth (first 5 ingredients). Pour into prepared pan; bake 25 minutes. Cool completely in pan. Spread Mint Cream Layer over cake (see following); chill. Pour Chocolate Topping over dessert (see following). Cover; chill.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix corn meal mix flour and sugar thoroughly. Add onion mixing well. Stir in egg and milk. Let batter rest for 10 minutes. Drop by spoonfuls into 375\u00b0 deep fat. When done they will float. Drain on brown paper.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Pack squash and onions in 1/2 cup salt and ice for 3 hours. Wash and drain good. Boil remaining ingredients. Add squash and onions and bring to another boil. Put in pint jars and seal.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Beat eggs and sugar until creamy. Add vanilla lemon juice heavy cream and half and half. Beat well. Add milk. Cook rice; add to egg mixture.

title: Children'S Play Dough
instructions: Mix flour and salt together. Mix water oil and coloring. Mix all together; knead dough then play with it. This is not edible. Store in airtight bag or bowl. Makes enough for 2 children. Try with cookie cutters and rolling pin for fun.

title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients at once. Pour in an 8 or 9-inch uncooked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie pan 1 1/2-inches apart. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Bake 15 to 17 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Cheese
instructions: Pre cook vegetables 5 minutes (may use fresh or frozen). Put chicken breasts on bottom of 9x13 baking dish. Put cooked vegetables on top; salt & pepper. Add soup and spread over top. Sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Sweet Chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray nonstick spray in casserole dish. Place half of soup mix on bottom of dish with 2 tablespoons of water and mix. Place chops in dish. Sprinkle brown sugar on chops (enough sugar to cover each chop). Pour the rest of mushroom soup over chops. Slice onion over chops.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large container and sample taste for sweetness. Add choice of fruit to mixture to bring it up to fill line on freezer. This makes 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In large saucepan melt peanut butter 1 cup condensed milk and 2 tablespoons butter. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat; stir in peanuts. Spread mixture in wax paper lined 8-inch square pan. In small saucepan melt chocolate morsels remaining condensed milk and butter. Spread chocolate mixture on top of peanut butter mixture. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off wax paper and cut. Tightly cover leftovers.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Place into pastry-lined 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each individual biscuit into 4 pieces. Mix sugar and cinnamon in plastic bag or bowl. Piece by piece roll biscuit pieces into sugar mixture and place in a Bundt pan. Melt margarine in cup and stir in leftover sugar mixture. Pour over biscuit pieces in Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Marinated Tomatoes
instructions: Pour over sliced tomatoes. Marinate 30+ minutes. Serve on chilled plate.

title: Shanghai Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion and garlic powders in a lightly greased skillet. Add celery vegetables and soup. Stir in rice and seasonings. Turn into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Sour Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat well. This makes a sour cream that can be used in any recipe calling for sour cream.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: After you put everything in a bowl then you pour ranch dressing over the top and mix together then put in refrigerator until thickens.

title: Strawberry Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Chill until firm. Looks nice in a jello mold topped with fresh mint leaves.

title: Noodles In White Sauce
instructions: Cook noodles per package directions. Drain and set aside.

title: White Chocolate Macadamia Bark
instructions: Grease bottom of 8-inch square pan; line bottom with sheet of wax paper. Heat dry 10-inch skillet over medium heat add Macadamias. Toast 5 to 6 minutes stir occasionally until golden. Remove from skillet; cool. Return skillet to heat repeat toasting procedure with coconut. Stir white chocolate chips in medium-size heavy saucepan over very low heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in toasted Macadamias. Spread chocolate mixture evenly in prepared pan sprinkle with coconut pressing in gently. Refrigerate for 30 minutes until set. Remove bark from pan and peel off wax paper. Break bark into irregular pieces. Store in airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks. Makes 3/4 pound.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pizza
instructions: Stir together first 7 ingredients. Press dough in a 12-inch pizza pan forming a rim along the edge. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Take out of oven. Sprinkle with marshmallows and chocolate chips. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes or until marshmallows are puffy and lightly browned. Cool and cut.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
instructions: Cover potatoes with water and add salt. Simmer potatoes for about 25 minutes until cooked. Dice potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes. Mix potatoes with garlic onions salt sour cream and cottage cheese. Fold into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese and bake for about 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Taboli Wheat Salad(Lebanese)
instructions: Chop parsley and onions; add tomato. Wash cracked wheat and soak in water approximately 10 minutes. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Toss and serve.

title: Herbed Chicken
instructions: Mix dressing wine garlic onion and seasonings. Pour mixture over chicken. Cover. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Drain. Place chicken on grill (medium) or rack of broiler pan. Grill or broil 8 to 10 minutes on each side.

title: Broccoli With Orange Sauce
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. In a saucepan melt butter. Whisk in cornstarch until smooth. Gradually stir in orange juice and zest. Bring to the boil and simmer until thickened. Drain broccoli and drizzle with sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Old Fashion Brownies
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs chocolate and nuts. Bake in a moderate oven about 25 minutes until it pulls away from edges of pan.

title: Lemon Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix jello water mayonnaise and vinegar together and heat until dissolved. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Drain frozen spinach and squeeze out moisture. Add spinach cottage cheese celery and onion to jello mixture and refrigerate overnight.

title: Baska (Easter Bread)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water to which salt and 1 teaspoon sugar has been added. Melt butter. Add potato water 1 cup sugar and egg yolks. Mix and then add yeast mixture plus cream ground anise (or anise flavoring) raisins and unsifted flour to make a soft dough. Let rise. Work down 3 times.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: When having to make biscuits in a hurry add 1 teaspoon baking powder to 2 cups biscuit mix. Also if making waffles or pancakes add 1 teaspoon baking powder

title: Cranberry Apple Salad
instructions: Heat and strain cranberry sauce reserving liquid. Dissolve gelatin in water; add salt lemon juice and reserved cranberry liquid. Chill until partially firm; beat until fluffy. Mix together mayonnaise diced apples cranberries and pecans. Chill in 9 x 13-inch pan. Serves 18.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with melted sweet chocolate.

title: Ralph'S Fruitcake
instructions: Cream butter. Add brown sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Briefly beat in vanilla. Toss together flour salt and baking powder and beat into creamed mixture 1 cup at a time (and no more than that). Mix until smooth after each addition. Preheat oven to 275\u00b0. Combine batter with fruit and nut mixture. Turn into pans and bake at 275\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes for small cakes 2 1/2 to 3 hours for large. When cool start misting with bourbon.

title: Uncle Bob'S Chicken Stir-Fry(Low-Fat)
instructions: In a pan sprayed with Pam add all ingredients except sweet and sour sauce. You can add a little water to the pan to help steam the vegetables. When vegetables are almost done add sweet and sour sauce. Heat and serve over noodles or rice.

title: Fresh Orange Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add rind shortening and eggs; beat. Add liquid; beat thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in buttered casserole.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Alternate layers of potatoes pepper onion salt and green peppers in greased baking dish. Mix soup and milk; pour over ingredients. Can sprinkle top with grated cheese. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Whole Meal Casserole
instructions: Saute first 3 ingredients then add tomato paste mushroom soup water chili powder and salt. Cover and cook 30 minutes or until done. Add corn olives and cooked noodles. Put in greased casserole; cover with grated cheese and bake until cheese melts. It is better to let it set a while before baking.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Butter bottom of casserole dish. Layer ingredients in order listed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until bubbly. Delicious with ham or can be used as a dessert.

title: Hot Beef And Bean Dip
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Stir in refried beans onion 1 1/2 cups cheese and picante sauce. Spread mixture into casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until heated through. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Blend butter sugar flour and salt. Add eggs beating well. Stir in corn and milk. Pour ingredients in buttered casserole and bake 1 hour at 400\u00b0 or until golden brown and silver knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Chop fine cabbage onion pepper and celery. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Chill in refrigerator 3 to 4 hours.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Boil fryers with salt and pepper to taste until tender. Cool and remove from bone. Cut into bite size pieces.

title: Candy Apples
instructions: You will need 10 sticks.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Place cooked chicken in casserole dish. Mix sour cream and soup. Pour over chicken. Mix Ritz cracker crumbs butter and poppy seed together. Sprinkle over top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Raspberry Tapioca Salad
instructions: Cook 1 cup tapioca pinch of salt and 5 cups boiling water for 20 minutes stirring often. Take off heat and add one package of raspberry Jell-O 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water. Mix well. Put in bowl and set in refrigerator. Stir often until set. Next day add frozen raspberries and Cool Whip.

title: Spaghetti And Meatballs
instructions: Boil noodles as directed. While noodles are cooking mix the following ingredients to form the meatballs salt egg hamburger crackers and onion flakes. Drop by teaspoonful into warm electric skillet (250 degrees). When meatballs are done drain off grease if necessary. To make the sauce combine the following ingredients mustard catsup brown sugar water and chili powder. When noodles are done drain and put them in the skillet with the meatballs and then add the sauce mixture. Simmer until heated thoroughly.

title: Aunt Theresa'S Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar and milk. Cook this mixture until thick and brown. The darker it is the more butterscotch taste it has. Mix milk and flour together. Add egg yolk and mix. Stir this mixture into the first mixture stirring constantly. Cook until thick and pour into baked pie crust. Makes 1 pie.

title: Turkey Pot Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients (vegetables and turkey) together. Add gravy to moisten. Put into pie shell. Carefully take second pie shell out of tin and place over shell with mixture.

title: Salad
instructions: Mix mayo and sugar together. Add all ingredients except cheese and bacon bits. Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: In large bowl combine first 3 ingredients. Cover with water and let stand for 2 hours. Then drain and add sugar and vinegar. Refrigerate for 2 days. Transfer to freezer containers and place in freezer. Thaw as needed. Serve and enjoy!!

title: Party Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients with salad dressing to hold together. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dissolve the gelatin in hot cranberry juice. Cool until partially set. Pour over chicken. Refrigerate.

title: Swiss Turkey Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake pastry shell 8 minutes; remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl toss cheese with flour and bouillon; add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into prepared shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until set topping with French fried onions during last 5 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease deep 10-inch pie plate. Cook broccoli and/or cauliflower to tender crisp in salt water about 5 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Mix with onion green pepper and cheese in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour over contents in pie plate. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted comes out clean 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand about 5 minutes before cutting. Serves 6.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Mix dry ingredients. Fold into pumpkin. Spread into a greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Turn onto towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll up and cool in refrigerator.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Cut the tops off peppers. Dice the onion. Mix ground beef onion rice crushed tomatoes salt and pepper in bowl until thoroughly combined. Stuff into peppers. Place peppers in a large pot; fill pot with tomato puree and water just enough to cover peppers. Stir occasionally. Cook for 1 hour or until you can pierce a pepper with a fork. The peppers will be tender when done.

title: Batter-Dipped Hot Dogs
instructions: Combine corn meal mix and pepper. Add milk egg and oil; mix well. Insert wooden skewer in one end of each hot dog. Coat with additional flour; dip into corn meal batter. Fry a few at a time in deep hot oil (375\u00b0) until golden brown. Drain on absorbant paper. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Easy-Cheesy Lasagna
instructions: Combine sauce bay leaves oregano and garlic powder in Dutch oven; bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour stirring often.

title: Christmas Toffee
instructions: Butter a cookie sheet. Melt butter in 2 qt. sauce pan stir in sugar gradually. Add syrup and water. Cook over moderate heat stirring occasionally until a little bit in cold water becomes very brittle.

title: Cool And Easy Pie
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl at least 2 minutes until completely dissolved. Add enough ice to cold water to measure 1 cup. Add to gelatin; stir until ice is melted. Add whipped topping; stir with wire whisk until well blended. Refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes or until mixture is very thick and will mound. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Garnish as desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine egg yolks and condensed milk. Mix well. Add lime juice and blend well. Beat one of the egg whites until firm. Fold into mixture. Turn into pie shell.

title: Easy Apple Butter
instructions: Cook on medium heat stirring constantly with wooden spoon about 20 minutes or until desired thickness. Makes about 1 pint jar.

title: Italian Hot Dish
instructions: Brown together the first five ingredients. Add the soup and water to the noodles in a two-quart baking dish. Stir in the browned ingredients. Scatter the cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix together and make 14 cakes; dip in egg and bread crumbs. Fry in deep fat after the cakes have been in the refrigerator for several hours so they can set and not fall apart when fried.

title: Strawberry Pie (Fresh)
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch water and strawberry jello; bring to boil and let boil for no more than 2 minutes. Remove from heat and cool. Wash and slice strawberries and put in pie shell. Pour cooled jello mixture over berries. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Thin Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate Crisco and salt. Add sugar and blend. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add flour vanilla and 1/2 of the nuts. Spread on cookie sheet 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle remaining nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour over potatoes and mix. Pour into a 2 1/2-quart serving dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Spread on top 2 cups cornflakes crushed and mixed with 1/4 cup melted butter. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dayspringer(Drink)
instructions: Combine ingredients in blender. Run on high until smooth and well blended. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery and brown ground beef. Add rest of ingredients except Chinese noodles. Turn into 2 1/2-quart casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered. Remove and cover with Chinese noodles; bake uncovered for 30 minutes. This can be made a day ahead. Also freezes well.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved. Stir in cold water. Stir in ice cream until smooth. Pour into serving bowl. Refrigerate 3 hours or until firm. Garnish with Cool Whip fruit and nuts. Makes 8 servings.

title: Micro-Fudge
instructions: Blend sugar and cocoa in large bowl. Add milk and margarine; do not stir. Put in microwave for 3 minutes on 80% until butter is soft and melted. Mix together. Put in buttered pan. Cool and cut.

title: Marinated Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Combine all vegetables in large bowl. Combine vinegar and remaining ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil. Pour vinegar mixture over vegetables; mix well. Cover; chill overnight. Makes 10 to 12 one-cup servings.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except cheese and potato chips. Spoon into 6 ungreased 1-cup baking dishes. Sprinkle with cheese and potato chips. Bake uncovered 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pan. In small bowl mix flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Melt morsels and butter; stir until smooth. Transfer to large mixer bowl. Stir in brown sugar; cool 5 minutes. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Mix in flour mixture. Stir in nuts. Bake for 20 minutes. Cool completely. Makes 35 brownies.

title: Sweet Beet Pickles
instructions: Cover cooked peeled beets with mixture of other ingredients. Let all come to boiling point. Pack in jars and seal while hot.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix and pie filling. Spread in oblong pan and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cool. Cut into squares.

title: Carol'S Corn Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom and sides of a 2 1/2-quart baking dish with a portion of the butter. Mix in blender on high speed all ingredients if using whole corn. Pour into baking dish.

title: Cheese Spread(Instead Of A Grilled Cheese, Try This Spreadable Cheese Recipe.)
instructions: In a bowl mix cocoa and sugar to a paste with cold water. Add to saucepan of boiling water; stir. Add syrup and salt; cook at least 6 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.

title: Plum Dumplings
instructions: Boil potatoes and rice them. Add eggs salt and baking powder. Add flour until dough does not stick. Take some dough; roll in hands to form a snake. Lay plums on top of this; cut dough between plums and roll dough around plums. Drop into boiling salt water until plum is soft. Take out of water; roll in bread crumbs. Sprinkle sugar on top. Eat warm.

title: Lemon Supreme
instructions: Mix all together cook at 350 degrees for about 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Saut onion and green pepper in fat until onions are yellow. Add meat and fry until mixture falls apart. Stir in rest of ingredients. Pour into greased 2 quart baking dish. Cover and bake 1 hour removing cover last 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325\u00b0. Put the peppers in a pan with cold water to cover. Bring slowly to a boil then drain. Cut off the tops of the peppers and scoop out the seeds. Blend together the chopped onion mushrooms the cooked rice salt and pepper. Fill each pepper with this mixture and dot with butter. Pour the tomato juice over the stuffed peppers. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Sear meat onion and garlic until pink disappears in oleo. Add cornmeal and mix well. Add 1 quart hot water salt pepper comino seed and chili powder. Simmer 1 hour in a large pot. Add beans and cook 15 minutes longer.

title: Hot Chicken
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight. Remove 1 hour before baking. Grate cheese over top. Cover with potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: Blend all together. Pour into ice cream freezer and freeze. May substitute lemon-lime soda grape etc. for orange.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix well with fingers and roll into one-inch round balls. Store in airtight container in refrigerator. Makes 40 balls.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa milk and butter and boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add oats vanilla and peanut butter. Beat until it begins to thicken (3 minutes). Drop on waxed paper by teaspoon and let cool.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken celery stick bay leaves and onion. When chicken is done debone chicken and discard celery bay leaves and onion. Saute margarine chopped pepper celery and onions. Add flour 2 cups of the Velveeta cheese and chicken broth. Cook mixture until thick. Cook spaghetti in remaining chicken broth. Drain; add spaghetti to sauce. Add deboned chicken. Grate cheese over top and cook in oven until cheese melts.

title: Rum Chiffon Cake
instructions: Soften gelatin in water for 5 minutes. Beat egg yolks. Add milk sugar and salt and beat. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until the mixture almost boils. The mixture should coat the back of a spoon then add the gelatin. Stir to dissolve. Cool until mixture begins to thicken. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into custard with rum. Turn into a baked pie shell. Cover with whipped cream and shaved chocolate. Chill.

title: Soft Spray
instructions: Mix in spray bottle. Keeps ticks off animals and people.

title: Seafood Primavera
instructions: Combine ReaLemon brand cornstarch and salt; mix well. Add scallops and shrimp. Cover; marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes. In large skillet over high heat cook and stir mushrooms carrots garlic and thyme in margarine until tender-crisp about 8 minutes. Add seafood mixture; cook and stir 5 to 8 minutes until seafood is opaque. Add pea pods onions and sherry (if desired); heat through. Serve over hot cooked pasta. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 4 servings.

title: Banana Pineapple Shake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender container. Blend at low speed 15 to 20 seconds to mix. Blend at high speed 30 to 60 seconds turning on and off frequently until well blended. Serve immediately. Makes 4 (1 cup) servings.

title: Oatmeal Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine oats and milk and allow to stand for 5 minutes then stir in pumpkin eggs and margarine. In a separate bowl mix together flour sugar baking powder salt and spices. Gradually add dry ingredients to oatmeal mixture. Stir in raisins and nuts mixing well. Place in a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes or until done. Cool on a wire rack. Makes one loaf.

title: Shrimp Congealed Salad
instructions: Heat the undiluted soup and add and melt the cream cheese. When the cream cheese is blended add the gelatin and stir well. Cool. Add the onion pepper celery mayonnaise and shrimp. Pour into a mold if desired or into a square or oblong dish. Refrigerate.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken in stew pot until tender. Cool bone and skin. Cut into bite-size pieces. Arrange chips in bottom of greased cake pan. Put on chicken. Mix soups and Ro-Tel then spread on chicken. Shred cheese and sprinkle on top. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Stir peanut butter honey and butter together until well mixed. Mix in wheat germ and nonfat dry milk. Shape into 1-inch balls. Chill and eat. Makes 18 to 20.

title: Ground Turkey Sausage
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Refrigerate overnight. Shape into patties and fry in oil on medium heat. Do not overcook.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Have ingredients at room temperature. Sift flour with soda and salt. Cream butter and shortening with sugar and vanilla. Add egg. Cream until mixture is fluffy. Stir in dry ingredients until mixture is smooth. Blend in milk. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten batter with bottom of a water glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 5 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Copper Penny Salad
instructions: Peel slice and cook carrots for 20 minutes or until slightly tender.

title: Breaded Herbed Fish Fillets(Catfish Or Trout)
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients. Coat fillets with cooking spray. Dredge in bread crumb mixture. Place fillets on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Use for dipping vegetables in.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix everything. Be sure potatoes are separated. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with Durkee French fried onions and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.

title: Working Girl Spoon Rolls
instructions: *One and one-half sticks margarine may be substituted for oil.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Combine soups broth and Ro-Tel tomatoes; blend until smooth. Place in casserole dish layer of chicken layer of tortillas onion cheese and soup and tomato mixture. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for one hour. Serves 6.

title: Creamy Mostaccioli With Snap Peas
instructions: Cook pasta adding snap peas last 1 minute. Drain. Warm sauce and pork add water if too thick. Add to pasta and peas; add tomato and toss. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Bread Dip
instructions: Stir ingredients together. Cut the top off a round loaf of bread and hollow out loaf of bread. Cut the bread taken out of loaf into cubes. Brush cubes with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil and 1 tablespoon melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Pour cheese mixture in loaf of bread then wrap tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 minutes.

title: Gazebo Cheese Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan melt butter over low heat. Add onions celery and carrots; saute until soft. Add chicken broth. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Add potato soup cheese parsley hot sauce salt and pepper. Stir in sour cream and simmer for 15 minutes. Add sherry and stir. Serve hot. Makes 10 cups.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in a saucepan bring to rolling boil stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat. Stir in chocolate until melted add marshmallow cream nuts and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Pour into greased pan. Makes 3 lbs.

title: Easy Homemade Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: In ice cream freezer container combine all ingredients; mix well. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions. Freeze leftovers.

title: Cocktail Sausages
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over sausages in crock-pot. Cook on low heat for 6 hours. (You adjust the amount of each ingredient based on the amount of cocktail sausages used.)

title: Western Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shake to mix well. Store in covered jar in refrigerator. Makes one pint.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix together. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve drain and season well with salt and pepper. Pour Ranch style dressing over; mix and serve.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter oleo and cheese. Add sugar vanilla and eggs. Beat. Add flour and beat well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake 65 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven. No preheating.

title: Cheese (Like Velveeta)
instructions: Let milk sour until thick; when thickened scald until it is too hot to touch. Pour into cheesecloth and let hang to dry overnight or 12 hours. Crumble curds to make fine crumbs. Mix in soda and let stand 2 hours. Place into a large skillet (preferably stainless steel) and add butter. Melt butter with curds then add cream and salt. Cook and stir until smooth. Pour in buttered container and let stand until completely cooled. Slice.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar butter and cream cheese. Alternate flour and eggs (1 cup flour/2 eggs). Add vanilla and rum.

title: Coke  - Cherry Salad
instructions: Drain juice from fruits heat and pour over gelatin to dissolve. Cool. Add cokes. Cut cherries in half. Add cherries and pineapples to gelatin mixture.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix together; mixture will be soft. Make into balls. Freeze to make solid. Put in 13 x 9 pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. When done pour sauce over them.

title: Butter Rolls
instructions: Roll each biscuit until thin. Add 2 tablespoons sugar 2 pats margarine and a little cinnamon to each biscuit. Roll up and pinch ends. Put in single layer. Sprinkle sugar on top (about 1/2 cup for 5 biscuits) and a little cinnamon. Pour milk to just cover biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 until biscuits are done. Baste with juice while cooking. Juice will be just a little thick.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 1 loaf pan. Combine flour soda and sugar in medium mixing bowl. In another bowl lightly beat eggs. Add oil and almond extract to eggs. Add egg mixture to flour mixture and stir well. Fold berries into batter. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Coconut Sheet Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package directions. While cake is cooking mix milk sugar and 1 package of coconut. Punch holes in cake after cake has cooked. Pour mixture over cake while hot. Set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Dry Gelatin Salad
instructions: You will need 1 felt tip 1 (3-inch) sharp paring knife 1 cast metal ice cream scoop 1 (8-inch) butcher knife 2 to 3 large bowls and 1 (2 to 3 gallon) kettle bowl.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Cut green peppers into chunks combine with sliced onions & cucumbers add garlic and salt (this can be put in clean sink). Cover with ice then cover with a towel and let set at least 3 hours (overnight is best). Drain well place in large pan. Combine remaining ingredients in sauce pan. Heat until sugar is dissolved. Pour mixture over cucumber mix. Heat to a boil & seal in hot sterilized jars. Makes 8 pints.

title: Cornmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar. Add egg and beat well. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Drop dough from a teaspoon on greased cookie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 30 cookies.

title: Sausage And Cornbread Pie
instructions: Cook sausage onion and garlic until meat is brown. Stir in\tcrumbled meat that has been drained and add tomatoes chiles corn and chili powder. Simmer for 20 minutes. Spoon mixture into a greased baking dish and set aside.

title: Chicken - Sausage Casserole
instructions: Mix sausage rice soup and mushrooms. Put 1/2 of this mixture into buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Top with chicken pieces and then top with remaining rice mixture. Cover with buttered crumbs or croutons. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Bring to a rolling boil the milk sugar and butter. Boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. (Syrup should form a soft ball stage when tested in cold water 232\u00b0.) Remove from heat and stir in the chips and creme. Add nuts if desired. Spread into a greased 10 x 13-inch cake pan. Chill until firm. Store in an airtight container.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Combine ground beef onion and celery in a large skillet. Cook until meat is done and browned. Drain off pan drippings. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over hamburger buns.

title: Cookies On A Stick
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl combine flour baking powder and soda. Set aside. In large bowl mix on medium speed the sugar brown sugar and butter until creamy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat in flour mixture until blended. By hand stir in peanuts and corn flakes until coated.

title: Taco Pie I
instructions: Cook ground beef with onion; drain grease. Stir in seasoning mix. Spread in pie plate. Sprinkle with chilies. Beat milk eggs and Bisquick for 1 minute. Pour over chilies. Bake 25 minutes at 450\u00b0. Top with tomatoes and cheese. Bake 8 to 10 minutes longer.

title: Beef Stew Meat
instructions: Using the broth cook the celery carrots and onion for approximately 15 minutes then add the potatoes and beef and cook until done. Then add the Prego and let simmer.

title: Berry Or Apple Crisp Topping
instructions: Combine until crumbly. For fruit add and mix 3/4 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons flour. Sprinkle topping over fruit mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. This recipe is for an 8 x 8-inch pan. If you use a 9 x 13-inch pan use 1 1/2 times the topping recipe.

title: K-Bars
instructions: In a large bowl combine sugar butter white syrup and peanut butter. Put in microwave on High until mixture comes to a boil stirring occasionally until sugar is dissolved. Add Rice Krispies; mix well and put in 9 x 13 pan lightly sprayed with Pam. Frost with chocolate chips and butterscotch chips melted together.

title: Dressing
instructions: Saute celery and onion (you may use 1 cup each). Combine both kinds of bread crumbs onion celery seasonings and butter. Add egg and mix lightly. Heat enough chicken stock to moisten crumbs and pour over dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and salt in 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Add margarine and milk; bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil for 90 seconds stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix for one minute. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Chill until firm.

title: Taco Salad]
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onion until onion is clear. Drain and rinse well.

title: Fried Country Ham And Red-Eye Gravy
instructions: Slice ham 1/4-inch thick. Trim off skin and part of the fat. (Save trimmings for seasoning beans and vegetables and for making red-eye gravy.) Place a little of the saved fat in a medium-hot skillet. After fat has heated place sliced ham in the skillet and let cook for 2 minutes per side. If ham is overcooked it becomes tough and hard.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Slice squash into 1/2 -inch slices parboil for 3 minutes. To make filling combine remaining ingredients except crumbs and margarine.\tMix well. Place squash in baking dish alternating with filling. Top with bread crumbs and dabs of margarine. Bake in 375 degree oven for 35 minutes.\tServes 6-8.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Beat egg whites with baking powder until stiff at high speed then add the vanilla extract and sugar and beat. After beating this at high speed add walnuts and Ritz crackers broken into large pieces. Beat on medium until all is mixed thoroughly. Pour mixture into buttered pie pan and bake for 30 minutes. Let cool and serve with fresh unsweetened whipped cream. Also very good with ice cream.

title: Split Pea Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large kettle combine peas water allspice salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour. Stir in potatoes carrots onions ham and cabbage; return to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for about 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring occasionally. Makes about 5 quarts. Freezes well.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix all together adding Fritos last. Serve.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in greased casserole dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. This can be doubled and cooked in a 9 x 13-inch pan for a large crowd.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix flour soda salt and cinnamon together. Cream butter and sugars until smooth and creamy. Add eggs then milk alternating with flour. Add vanilla oatmeal raisins and peanut butter. Drop by the teaspoon onto a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix margarine flour and nuts together. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool.

title: Refrigerated Slaw
instructions: Alternate layers of cabbage onion and sugar. Combine remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Simmer until well blended. Pour boiling liquid over cabbage mixture. Cover and let set for about 3 hours. Stir. Let set 2 or 3 hours. Refrigerate. Will keep for 5 or 6 weeks if refrigerated. Yields 15 to 20 servings.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and slice; chop onions and peppers. Let stand for 3 hours with salt over them; drain. Combine vinegar water sugar and spices. Bring to boil; add cucumbers. Heat thoroughly but dont boil. Pack while hot.

title: Beef Taco Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie pan. Cook beef and onion until brown; drain. Stir in taco seasoning and pour into pie pan. Sprinkle with chiles. In another bowl beat with hand mixer the milk biscuit mix and eggs for 1 minute until smooth. Pour over beef mixture and bake 25 minutes. Remove and top with diced tomatoes. Sprinkle with cheese and continue baking for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill for several hours.

title: Mexican Sauce
instructions: Cook onion in butter until softened. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling then reduce heat and simmer five minutes. Spoon out cloves and discard. Brush sauce over ham steak as they grill (or any meat).

title: Christmas Bread
instructions: Cool scalded milk to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in warm water and 1 tablespoons sugar. To the milk add 1 cup sugar yeast mixture and half the flour. Beat well. Add butter fruit cardamom almonds salt eggs and remaining flour to make stiff dough. Knead. Cover and let rise to double. Punch down and form two loaves. Let rise. When double bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Meatball Appetizers
instructions: Mix together like a meat loaf the hamburger egg onion and salt. Shape into\tsmall meatballs. Combine jelly chili sauce and lemon juice; cook until jelly dissolves. Pour over meatballs (raw). Bake in oven 1 hour at 225\u00b0. These can also be done in a crock-pot.

title: Snappy Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in a small amount of salted water until tender. Drain and place carrots in a lightly greased 1-quart baking dish. Combine mayonnaise onion horseradish salt and pepper. Stir into carrots. Mix crushed crackers with butter. Sprinkle on carrots. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. This may be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated. Serves 8.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream shortening sugar salt and vanilla. Add eggs and beat with mixer until mixture is very light and creamy. Add flour and buttermilk and beat 2 more minutes. In small mixing bowl mix cocoa soda and hot water. Add to rest of batter. Put into 3 (8-inch) round pans or 1 (9 x 12 x 2-inch) loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Apricot
instructions: Place chicken in shallow baking dish skin side down. Combine rest of ingredients and spread half of sauce on chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Turn chicken over and add rest of sauce. Continue baking 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Can be frozen or prepared in advance. Serves 4.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan the cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple. Sprinkle (dry) yellow cake mix over top. Sprinkle chopped nuts over top. Melt margarine and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve warm or cold topped with whipped cream Cool Whip or ice cream.

title: Amaretto Creamer For Coffee
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in airtight container. To serve use 2 tablespoons creamer in 6 ounces of hot coffee. Great for holiday gifts!

title: Easy Chili
instructions: Combine ground beef and onion in a Dutch oven; cook until beef is browned stirring to crumble meat. Drain off pan drippings. Add remaining ingredients except kidney beans; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in beans; continue to cook covered for 45 minutes. Remove cover and cook an additional 15 minutes. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add shortening and blend until crumbly. Add water. If possible allow to chill or use ice water. Roll on floured board. Makes 2 pie crusts.

title: Chocolate Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Prepare chocolate cake as directed. After cake is baked poke holes in cake and pour Eagle Brand milk over top of cake. Let it seep into cake. Warm fudge topping slightly and pour over cake. Put in refrigerator to cool.

title: Rich Lemon Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine 1 1/2 cups of flour and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Press onto bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Frosted Date Balls
instructions: Combine flour and salt; sift twice. Cream the butter and gradually add sugar. Add milk and vanilla; stir in the sifted flour. Blend in dates and nuts. Roll in 1-inch balls. Place about 3-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes until light brown. While still warm roll in confectioners sugar. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Peaches And Cream Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Combine first 7 ingredients beat 2 minutes on medium speed; pour into greased pie plate or pan. Place drained peaches over batter. Combine cream cheese sugar and juice; beat 2 minutes on medium speed. Spoon over prepared pan within 1 inch of edge of pan. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over top and bake 30 to 35 minutes until crust is golden brown. Filling will appear soft. Store in refrigerator.

title: Butternut Squash Pie
instructions: Add sugar salt and spices to squash and mix well. Beat eggs with milk then mix with squash. Pour in pie shells. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 40 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place cooked broccoli into buttered casserole dish. Place chicken on top of broccoli. Mix soup water mayonnaise and lemon juice together and pour over chicken. Sprinkle almonds on top of soup mixture and top with cheese. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Fry bacon while potatoes are boiling. Set bacon aside to cool. Drain potatoes. Put 1/2 of the potatoes into a casserole dish. Put 1/2 cheese salt and pepper on top. Make another layer. Crumble bacon on top. Pour melted butter over everything. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Bring the syrup and sugar to a boil in a saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and cereal. Drop by spoonful on waxed paper and cool.

title: Chicken Breast A La Mary
instructions: Cook chicken breasts for 30 minutes. In water with celery onion salt carrots and chicken bouillon cube. Cool.

title: Potato Chip Cookies(Taste Like Pecan Sandies.)
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla. Add flour and mix well. Stir in chips and nuts.

title: Mary'S Creamy Baked Cheesecake
instructions: You will need a 10-inch spring-form cake pan three inches deep.

title: Winter Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple juice into 1 cup measuring cup. Drain mandarin orange juice into same cup so you have 1 cup of liquid. Throw away rest of liquid. Mix 1 cup juice with dry pudding and stir well. In bowl mix canned fruit and banana cut into bite size pieces. Add glaze to bowl and mix well. Serve chilled.

title: Egg Drops
instructions: Mix flour egg milk and salt; beat well. Pour slowly by small spoonfuls into boiling soup. Cook about 5 minutes. Use in any soup.

title: Pumpkin Trifle
instructions: Set aside 1/4 cup cake crumbs for top. Divide remaining crumbs into four portions; sprinkle one portion into the bottom of a trifle bowl or 3-quart serving bowl. In a large mixing bowl combine pumpkin spices milk and pudding mix; mix until smooth. Spoon half into the serving bowl. Sprinkle with a second portion of crumbs. Whip cream until stiff; spoon half into bowl. Sprinkle with a third portion of crumbs. Top with remaining pumpkin mixture then last portion of crumbs and remaining whipped cream. Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top around edge of bowl. Place cherries in center if desired. Cover and chill 2 hours before serving. Yield 12 to 15 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve with variety of fruits.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Cream together the cheeses and the seasoning mix. Spread on large cookie sheet or round pizza pan. Then pour taco sauce over top. Layer with toppings of your choice. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Blend in wet ingredients until slightly moistened. Place in greased muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans and stir in butter. Mix other ingredients into the beans and pour all into a casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with onion rings and bake 5 to 10 minutes longer.

title: Hot Mexican Dip
instructions: Chop olives; combine with remaining ingredients. Chill overnight for full flavor. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread dip in shallow baking dish and bake 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Cherry Squares
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and butter. Press into 9-inch square pan. Chill. Stir chocolate and water over low heat until smooth. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in chocolate. Fold in 2 cups of the Cool Whip. Spread over crumbs. Top with cherry filling. Chill and garnish with remaining topping. Makes 9 servings.

title: Baked Chicken In Wine Sauce
instructions: Cook chicken and drain. Brown chicken in butter and put in baking dish. To the drippings in skillet add onions and saute until tender. Add all other ingredients and cook 1 minute. Pour mixture over chicken and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Baste every 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sandwich Gobs
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and beaten eggs in a large bowl. Mix well. Sift together flour cocoa and salt. Add dry ingredients to sugar mixture alternately with milk until combined.
