Drop spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove to cooling rack. Form sandwiches by putting icing between 2 cookies.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Layer all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Bake covered with foil.

title: Lemon Pudding Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix crushed wafers 1 tablespoon of sugar and melted butter. Press firmly into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake for 10 minutes.

title: Molded Creamy Orange Salad
instructions: Mix gelatin orange juice concentrate and hot water; add sherbet ginger ale and oranges. Pour into Jell-O mold and chill until set.

title: Granny'S Fried Apples
instructions: Wash peel core and quarter apples. Place in large heavy skillet with a little water and cook apples until slightly tender. Add sugar and oleo and cook until right consistency being careful not to burn. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Sift flour. Measure. Add baking powder soda and salt and sift again. Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Add well beaten eggs and mix thoroughly. Add vanilla and dry ingredients alternately with milk and mashed bananas stirring only enough after each addition to blend thoroughly. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 25 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Cream together oil sugar and eggs. Add the dry ingredients and vanilla. Fold in the apples and nuts. Pour into greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle confectioners sugar on top or serve with ice cream.

title: Easy Mushroom Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine rice onion soup beef broth mushrooms and butter in an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Bake for 60 minutes.

title: Tofu Mushroom Loaf
instructions: Saute onion garlic and mushrooms in oil. In large bowl mix remaining ingredients. Add the onion-mushroom mixture to the tofu mixture. Fold gently and spoon into oiled loaf pan. Top with 1/2 cup grated Monterey Jack cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour and measure. Resift twice with soda and set aside. Cream butter and add sugar slowly beating constantly to cream well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in dairy sour cream. Add flour mixture 1/2 cup at a time beating well and constantly. Stir in lemon extract and turn batter into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Use salt free shortening or fat for greasing pan. Bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0) for about 1 1/2 hours or until cake is done. Place pan on rack to cool 5 minutes. Loosen cake around edge of pan and edge of tube with dull side of knife. Press toward pan rather than toward cake. This protects crust. Turn cake onto rack to cool completely. Serve plain. When freezing this cake either whole or cut wrap in several thickness of clear plastic or aluminum foil.

title: Swiss Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Thaw and drain the frozen vegetables. Combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and 1 cup onions. Pour into shallow 1-quart casserole. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until vegetables are done. Top with cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.

title: Quick Hot Rolls
instructions: Crumble yeast cake in a cup and fill with milk. Put shortening in saucepan and melt. Add water then the milk and yeast. (Dont have shortening and water too warm.) Mix with dry ingredients and let stand. When double in bulk work down and cut into rolls. Let rise.

title: Fried Zucchini(Serves 4)
instructions: In a colander toss zucchini with salt. Let drain for 15 minutes. Pat dry. In a bowl whisk together eggs and mustard. Dip zucchini slices in flour then egg mixture then bread crumbs. Fry in vegetable oil until golden brown. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Drain on paper towels.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Crumble sausage into a large skillet. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes breaking up clumps until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove from skillet and drain. Spoon into 10-inch pie pan. Top with hash browns and Cheddar cheese. Beat eggs with milk and pepper. Pour over hash browns and cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until slightly puffed and a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 6 servings.

title: Breakfast Change
instructions: Fill soup bowl 3/4 full with water. Place 2 ounces thin filet of salmon in the water; let it sink to the bottom. Break an egg into the water to rest over the salmon. Cover with Saran Wrap and place in microwave on High. Cook 1 1/2 minutes or until egg white coagulates. Remove with slotted spoon by inserting it under the salmon. Remove from water with egg on top of salmon. Place on rye toast. Add dash of paprika.

title: Homemade Ice Cream(For Four-Quart Freezer)
instructions: Scald milk until bubbles form around edge. Remove from heat. Add sugar and salt. Stir until dissolved. Stir in half and half vanilla and whipping cream. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or longer.

title: Chocolate Mint Squares
instructions: Mix sugar and eggs. Then add other ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Mushroom Stuffing
instructions: Saute onion and celery in the margarine or butter. Drain and and retain margarine for later. (Note - Cheries Gourmet Tip Microwave may be used to saute the onion and celery.)

title: Poor Man'S Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef pour off excess fat. Place a layer of ground beef layer of potatoes layer of onion carrot and peas in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Repeat layers until ingredients are used up. Pour can of chicken soup on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cheese Pennies
instructions: Mix well with hands. Divide into thirds. Make into rolls. Wrap and chill.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Combine soup sour cream mayonnaise and curry powder. Mix all gently until blended. Put into a 2-quart dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes until bubbly. Ive made this so often that I believe I did invent it!

title: Terrine Of Turkey
instructions: Place the turkey in a large bowl. Add the onion parsley garlic bread crumbs water tomato paste mustard tamari and thyme. Mix the ingredients together then add the eggs and mix again until well combined. Press the turkey mixture into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Cover the terrine with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Remove from oven and let cool for 1 hour. Place another 9 x 5-inch loaf pan on top of the terrine and fill with dried beans or other heavy material such as a can of food or cover with foil and top with something heavy. Refrigerate 2 to 3 days.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: After cooking broccoli (according to package) omitting salt place in a baking dish. Combine soup and cheese. Add milk mayonnaise and egg to soup mixture. Pour over broccoli and sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until crumbs are lightly brown.

title: Crescent Rolls
instructions: Early in day or day ahead In large bowl combine shortening salt 3/4 cup sugar and 1/2 cup butter or margarine (1 stick). Pour 1 cup boiling water over mixture; stir until blended. In a small bowl sprinkle yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar over 1/2 cup warm water (105\u00b0 to 115\u00b0). Stir to mix slightly. Let rest 5 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: In saucepan cook squash and onion in boiling water (salted) for 5 minutes; drained. Combine soup and sour cream. Fold in drained squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix and melted margarine. Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon squash mixture on top. Sprinkle remaining stuffing over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix butter peanut butter and powdered sugar. Form into balls and dip in a mixture of chocolate chips and paraffin. Set on wax paper; refrigerate.

title: Cherry Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Speedy Orange Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl and let stand 5 minutes. Add 1 cup flour and next 4 ingredients. Beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth. Stir in remaining flour to make a soft dough. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead until smooth (about 2 minutes). Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Roll dough into a 14 x 7-inch rectangle; spread with 1/2 of Orange Filling leaving a 1 inch margin on long sides. Roll jelly roll fashion starting at long side. Pinch seam. Cut into 12 equal slices. Place cut-side down in greased muffin pans. Cover and let rise in warm place free from drafts 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes. Spread remaining Orange Filling over tops of rolls. Yield 12 rolls.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer beans in baking dish. Spread salsa over beans. Layer sour cream over top. Top with grated cheese. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven until cheese bubbles. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Egg Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Beat egg and add milk shortening and add all ingredients together. Spoon dumplings on top of your broth. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes and covered for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix cocoa flour and sugar together. Add water; mix then add cold milk. Mix well. Cook to desired thickness and serve over biscuits and butter.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pastry shell lined with 1/3 cup chopped pecans or 1/3 cup coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Put rice on bottom of roaster. Put chicken in and sprinkle with onion soup mix. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over top. Bake about 2 hours at 350\u00b0. You may add green pepper and celery if desired.

title: Baked Halibut
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Thaw frozen halibut. Rinse and pat dry. Place fish in greased baking pan. Combine melted Crisco olive oil vinegar lemon juice salt mustard marjoram garlic powder and pepper. Drizzle over fish. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 18 minutes. You may add vegetables the last 5 minutes. Garnish with dill weed or lemon wedges.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine the lime juice water and sugar; stir until sugar is dissolved. Add nectarines and banana; toss to coat. In a 2 1/2-quart glass bowl combine remaining fruits. Add nectarine mixture; stir gently. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving with a slotted spoon.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Stretch dough 12 x 18-inches. Top with all ingredients and roll up lengthwise. Pinch and tuck ends. Place on greased cookie sheet and let rise 1 hour. Slit top to allow steam to escape. Brush with olive oil. Bake in preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Orange Delight Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and rind. Beat until smooth. Add sour milk and soda then flour. Drop from spoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. While hot spread with 1 1/2 tablespoons orange juice and sugar to thin paste over cookies.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Slice apples into pie shell. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sift 1/2 cup sugar with flour; cut in margarine and sprinkle mix on top of apples. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and cook until apples are done and top is brown.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Butter a 9 x 12-inch casserole. Put in layers zucchini onions green peppers tomato flour butter and cheeses. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour 10 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 more minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Using an electric mixer cream margarine sugar and egg. Add bananas one at a time and beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt. Mix thoroughly.

title: Chicken Wing Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Marinate overnight. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven one hour. Pour off the juice return to the oven to brown.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until done; drain good. Mix all ingredients together then add macaroni. Chill thoroughly.

title: Poor Man'S Spaghetti
instructions: Prepare spaghetti as stated on box. Strain. Slice hot dogs diagonally. Fry in drippings until slightly brown. Place spaghetti in dish. Top with boiled eggs sliced in half lengthwise hot dogs and onions. Add ketchup and soy sauce to taste. Toss.

title: Beef Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Saute macaroni and vegetables in hot oil until macaroni turns slightly yellow. Add beef and continue until meat browns. Drain off excess oil. Add tomato juice and seasonings; bring to boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Uncover and simmer for several more minutes or until sauce is reduced to desired consistency.

title: Cookie-N-Mint Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift first four ingredients into a mixing bowl. Add next three ingredients and mix. Stir in crushed cookies. Pour into greased and floured cake pan and bake for 40 minutes.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix at high speed of mixer (or use blender) for 2 minutes. Pour into a greased deep pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Maisie'S Gingerbread
instructions: Stir sugar molasses spices and salt together. Add melted shortening and eggs; beat well. Add soda to boiling water. Add alternately with flour to creamed mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 in a well-greased pan. Cook for 35 to 40 minutes or until browned and springy to touch.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Fill pie plate 3/4 full with sliced apples. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon sugar and cinnamon over the apples. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients and spread over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until brown.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Cream cheese with soft margarine add red pepper and mustard. Add flour and mix then add Rice Krispies last. Form dough into small balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Dip a fork into cold water and press a cross design on the top of each cookie. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Hollow sheepherders bread and cut up hollowed out section into cubes. Mix all ingredients together and place into hollowed bread shell. Serve with bread pieces and additional crackers.

title: Kentucky Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (180\u00b0C). Mix together ingredients to cake-batter consistency. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan (2-L) or greased muffin tins. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm with margarine.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Line salad bowl with leaf lettuce. Arrange lettuce cauliflower celery radishes and green pepper in bowl. Sprinkle cheese over. Serve with Italian dressing.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook meat and onion together drain grease. Mix remaining ingredients in a pot and cook on top of the stove for about 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Delight
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth then stir in salmon dill lemon juice and Tabasco. Mix well. Stir in mayonnaise then cover and chill. Serve on party bread or crackers or on endive leaves.

title: Honey Pecan Mix
instructions: In 13 x 9-inch pan coated with spray combine cereal pretzels and pecans. In large saucepan over medium heat combine margarine sugar and honey. Bring to boil and boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour syrup over cereal mixture. Stir until well coated. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Let cool in pan. Store in airtight container.

title: Crock-Pot Wieners
instructions: Put all ingredients together in crock-pot and cook 4 to 6 hours stirring several times.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and fruit. Sprinkle dry Jell-O over mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Christmas Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries marshmallows and sugar and let set covered overnight in refrigerator. Next day add apples grapes nuts and apples to cranberry mixture and fold in whipped cream. Chill until serving time.

title: Bacon And Tomato Dip
instructions: Combine mayonnaise sour cream and bacon. Mix well. Add tomatoes last. Serve with corn chips.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion in skillet. Add barbecue sauce. Place biscuits in an ungreased muffin pan; shape like a cup. Add beef mixture in biscuits. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 10 to 12 biscuit cups.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Heat butter and water to rolling boil in saucepan. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball about 1 minute; remove from heat. Beat in eggs until smooth. Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls about 3 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until puffed and golden 35 to 40 minutes. Cool away from draft. Cut off tops. Pull out soft dough. Fill puffs with Cream Filling. Replace tops; dust with powdered sugar. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Brown sesame seeds and almonds. Combine flavor packet sugar vinegar oil salt and pepper. Mix with all other ingredients.

title: Layered Cauliflower And Lettuce
instructions: Layer as listed. Dont toss until ready to serve. I add a layer of shredded Cheddar cheese on top.

title: Crazy Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients on low to blend then turn to medium and beat for 15 minutes. Scrape occasionally. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour to 1 hour and 10 minutes. If baked in 13 x 9-inch pan check after 45 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add sour cream. Sift dry ingredients together and add to batter. Add milk and flavoring. Beat together. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels nuts margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar in bowl; mix well. Press into baking pan (13 x 9-inch). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in bowl. Add strawberries. Chill until partially set. Cream 1 cup sugar and cream cheese in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Blend in whipped topping. Spread over pretzel layer. Spoon strawberry mixture over top. Chill until set.

title: Sugar Plum Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs. Combine sugar and oil and pour over eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Add nuts and raisins. Bake in greased muffin tins at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Bars
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in water. Mix the the first 5 ingredients and cook until thick. Mix the remaining 5 ingredients until crumbly. Put 3/4 mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Add filling. Then sprinkle rest of crust mixture on top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Combine sugar flour and egg yolks; stir in milk; heav over low heat stirring with whisk until mixture reaches consistency of mustard sauce. Add butter 1 tablespoon at a time stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add chocolate; stir until melted. Stir in vanilla or rum and orange rind. Cool slightly. Add stiffly beaten egg whites and 1 cup of the cream whipped stiff. Pour into sherbert dishes. Chill about 5 hours until firm. Whip remaining cream as topping.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and shortening. Add peanut butter and egg. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Make walnut-sized balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Mash flat with a fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Mix and bake in 10 x 14-inch pan at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Zesty Zucchini Spaghetti
instructions: Cook pasta to directions. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chile sauce and garlic. Saute 1 minute. Add zucchini. Cook stirring constantly 4 minutes. Toss pasta with zucchini mixture. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Quick Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juices. Dissolve jello in hot water. While still warm stir in cranberry sauce and mix until melted. Stir in 1/2 cup cold liquid lemon juice and pineapple and nuts. Pour in 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until set.

title: Microwave Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In a 1-quart measure melt butter at High for 1/2 to 1 minute. Blend in flour and salt. Stir in milk until smooth. Microwave at High 6 to 7 minutes stirring with fork every minute until thickened. Stir in cheese until completely melted. Put cooked macaroni in casserole. Stir sauce into macaroni mixing well. Microwave at Medium-high for 7 to 10 minutes stirring after 4 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and shrimp. Add cheese in chunks beating well with mixer as each chunk is added. Add shrimp and mix until well blended. Chill at least 2 hours before serving. Serve with corn chips.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Bars
instructions: Cut cookie dough in half. For crust press half of the dough into the bottom of a greased 8 inch square baking pan. In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese sugar and egg until smooth. Spread over crust. Crumble remaining dough over top and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

title: Almost French Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Separate onion slices into rings. Dip each ring in egg white then in bread crumbs. Place on nonstick cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar sour cream and shortening well and add eggs and salt. Mix well. Sift together the flour baking powder soda and nutmeg. Mix well and chill for 1/2 hour; roll cut and bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Baked Chicken With Pressed Beef
instructions: Wrap each chicken breast in bacon. Cover bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan with pressed beef. Arrange chicken breasts on beef. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Microwave Instructions Combine peanuts sugar syrup and salt in 1 1/2-quart container. Cook on High for 7 to 8 minutes. Stir well after 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla; stir up. Cook 1 to 2 more minutes. Add baking soda and stir until foamy. Pour on cookie sheet and let set 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry(Microwave)
instructions: Put oil ginger and garlic into a 2-quart glass casserole. Cook uncovered 2 minutes on High. Add onion broccoli cauliflower and pepper to casserole stir. Cover with glass lid or plastic wrap. Cook 3 to 4 minutes on High. Sprinkle mixture with salt. Add pea pods and mushrooms. Stir. Cook covered for 3 minutes on High. Makes 8 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cupcakes
instructions: Cream butter sugar and peanut butter. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add 1 cup milk. Blend in dry ingredients. Add remaining milk and raisins. Pour into cupcake tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream together well the eggs sugar and oleo. Add the flour soda baking powder sour cream and vanilla. Prepare topping by mixing the brown sugar cinnamon remaining flour oleo and nuts. Spoon into a 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured) and layer in the topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Heat the first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and then add the eggs. When the dressing coats the spoon remove from heat and chill. Add the whipped cream. The whipped cream should equal half the amount of dressing. Mix well and serve with some of the following ideas.

title: Best Ever Banana Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add all other ingredients and stir. Do not beat (stir with spoon) pour in tube pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool in pan.

title: Bourbon Hot Dogs
instructions: Cook hot dogs in a large skillet with the butter until puffed. Mix together the ketchup brown sugar and whiskey. Add to hot dogs and simmer until sauce thickens. I keep them warm in the crock-pot.

title: Pork Chops, Rice And Gravy
instructions: Brown desired number of pork chops sprinkled with salt and pepper in skillet using shortening and medium heat. Remove chops to platter. Mix flour into drippings in skillet. Add chicken with rice soup and 1 can of water. Stir well; turn heat to low. Return chops to gravy cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Turn chops once or twice while cooking. In separate pan of salted water cook rice until tender. Remove chops to platter. Serve gravy over rice and chops.

title: Teriyaki Microwave Chicken
instructions: Combine water soy sauce and teriyaki sauce in a deep microwavable bowl or casserole dish. Place chicken breast side up in bowl. Sprinkle onion green pepper and spices over chicken. Marinate 15 minutes to 1/2 hour. Turn chicken breast side down before placing in microwave. Microwave on High 7 minutes per pound (average 35 minutes). Turn breast side up halfway through cooking time. Liquid left in bowl can be simmered for fat removal and thickened for gravy. Serve over rice.

title: Gold Medal Banana Cake
instructions: Melt shortening add beaten eggs and sugar. Sift flour baking powder soda salt and add to mixture. Add vanilla and bananas; mix well. Pour mixture into a tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Test with toothpick.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Add the drained fruit cocktail. Mix all together. Pour into an 8-inch square pan floured. Sprinkle the brown sugar and chopped nuts on top. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scoop the meat from the potatoes leaving a thin shell of skin. Place scooped out potato meat in medium mixing bowl. Add eggs salt and pepper to taste milk margarine and chives. Mash with a potato masher. You may add more milk if necessary to\tmake this mixture the consistency of thick cake batter. Make sure all ingredients are well mixed. Place shelled out skins on nongreased pan.\tSpoon potato mixture in alternating layers with sliced or shredded Cheddar cheese ending up with\tcheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese on\ttop melts and potato mixture becomes crusty.

title: Caramel-Chocolate Bars
instructions: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in top of double boiler. Cover and place over boiling water until melted stirring occasionally. Keep warm. Combine cake mix 1/3 cup evaporated milk and butter in large bowl. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. (Mixture is thick.) Spread one-half mixture in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Sour Cream Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients; blend well and refrigerate or chill. Serve on green salad. Makes 1/2 cup dressing.

title: Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Place Brussels sprouts celery and small amount of water in a saucepan. Cook about 10 minutes.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit well. Cut pear and peach halves in two. Arrange in baking dish. Blend butter sugar and curry powder. Cover fruit with sauce and chill several hours or overnight. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Christmas Simmer(Do Not Drink!)
instructions: Simmer above ingredients to fill your home with the wonderful smells of Christmas. (It can be stored in fridge.) This makes a nice \teacher\ gift when put in decorative bag (dont cut fruit) with recipe attached.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: In a pan mix cornstarch with a little milk then add the rest of the milk along with the sugar. Bring to a boil. Cook the rice. Mix these together. Add the rose water. Serve when its cold.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Grate cheese. Crumble sausage. Work Bisquick into cheese and sausage. If mixture is too dry add a teaspoon of water to moisten. Roll into balls. Put on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 15 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Chicken A La King Express
instructions: Saut onions and mushrooms until tender. Add diced chicken. Mix soup and milk in a bowl. Add soup mixture to chicken and vegetables. Add salt and pepper to taste. Heat just to boiling. Toast muffin halves and top with chicken mixture. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cranberry Apple Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2 loaf pan. Combine apples sugar and oil in a medium mixing bowl. Add egg mixing well. Combine dry ingredients in a separate mixing bowl. Add apple mixture mixing just until the dry ingredients are moist. Stir in cranberries and walnuts. Spread batter evenly in loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the bread comes out clean. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Bake in loaf pan 45 minutes (well-greased) or shallow pan 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pork Chops And Apple And Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown chops in oil and margarine. Add garlic onion sage and apple. Saute few minutes. Stir in pepper and wine. Place sauerkraut on top of chops. Cover; heat to boiling. Reduce heat to simmer. Cook 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Preheat oven 350\u00b0. Spray 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish with butter. Put all ingredients in large bowl and mix until it is all together. Then put in baking dish and spread evenly. Place into oven for 25 to 30 minutes. When golden brown take out and cut into bars. Makes about 24 bars.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to directions in chicken broth for best results. Saute onions and bell pepper in butter. Add remaning ingredients (1 can Cr. of Musroom can be substituted with a can of Cr. of Chicken). Put into a 3 quart GLASS casserole.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise lemon juice pepper celery onion and chicken. Serve on salad greens.

title: Chocolate Coconut Crust(For Ice Cream Pie)
instructions: Over medium heat melt chocolate chips and margarine. Add milk and stir. Add coconut and stir; remove from heat. Form crust with coconut mixture in greased pie pan. Put in freezer to firm. Add slightly softened ice cream of your choice to fill pie crust. Freeze until firm and cut like regular pie. Garnish pieces with fresh strawberries nuts bananas whatever your heart desires.

title: Golden Potatoes And Franks
instructions: Combine potatoes process cheese spread onion and mustard; mix well. In lightly greased 10 x 6-inch baking dish layer half of potato mixture and frankfurters. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Garnish with green onion slices if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hanky Pankys
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage in same pan. Drain grease. Reduce heat. Add oregano basil and chunks of cheese. Stir until melted. Arrange bread topped completely with cheese mixture on a cookie sheet and place in freezer until firmly set. (They can be dropped in a plastic bag after this and kept in freezer for future use.) Place under broiler until cheese is bubbly and browned.

title: Chicken Pollack(Spinach)
instructions: Brown first seven ingredients in 3 tablespoons oil. Add spinach. Put in pressure cooker for 5 to 7 minutes; take off pressure. Dry out liquid over high heat. Serve over boiled rice.

title: Yuletide Ham Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese in large bowl. Add cheese onion Worcestershire sauce lemon juice mustard paprika salt ham parsley flakes and pimento. Mix well. Chill until merely firm. Shape into ball roll in pecans. Wrap in foil refrigerate overnight. Sprinkle with additional paprika. Slice to serve.

title: Lemon Or Lime Ice Box Pie
instructions: Mix all together well and pour into a graham crust top with lemon or lime peel or thin slices of lemon or lime. Chill until set. Serve with a dab of whipped topping if you like.

title: Pudding Ice Cream
instructions: Mix pudding and set aside. Beat eggs until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Fill freezer; add remainder of milk (3 quarts) and pudding. Freeze.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix margarine egg vanilla and sugar thoroughly. Add flour. Mix and drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0. (Drop by teaspoon.) Bake until golden brown approximately 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken with 2 cans of soup and one can (for measuring) of chicken broth. Pour into casserole dish. Mix dressing mix with egg and 1 cup chicken broth. Put mixture over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Delicious with southern spoonbread.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Little Loaves
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except bacon. Shape mixture into 6 loaves. Crisscross two half slices bacon on each loaf tucking ends under loaf. Place loaves on rack in shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered 50 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Squeeze spinach dry. Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate 24 hours. Can be served in bread bowl or with crackers. Will keep for 4 or 5 days.

title: Banana Nut Bread Or Muffins
instructions: Combine all. Mix until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until done.

title: Cucumber Salad With Satay Sauce(Gado Gado)
instructions: Mix the vegetables well. Serve with Satay Sauce.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. May be chilled 2 hours and rolled and cut with cookie cutter or use unchilled in cookie press or roll in small balls dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Gourmet Hashed Browns
instructions: Defrost hash browns; lay on paper towels to dry with salt and pepper. Mix with soup sour cream and cheese. Mix butter and corn flakes and spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pudding Ice Box Cake(Cookbook Winner, 1989)
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding with 2 cups milk until thickened; set aside. In separate bowl mix chocolate pudding with 2 cups milk until thickened; set aside. Cut bananas into slices. Chop nuts. Layer bottom of pan with lady fingers. Spoon vanilla pudding onto lady fingers. Arrange banana slices on vanilla pudding. Add another layer of lady fingers. Spoon chocolate pudding over lady fingers. Arrange banana slices on chocolate pudding. Make one more layer of lady fingers and garnish with remaining pudding and nuts.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Add ginger ale and serve.

title: Mincemeat
instructions: Grind all ingredients together.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat corn syrup sugar eggs vanilla and salt with a fork until well mixed. Stir in pecan pieces. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes more.

title: Squash And Apple Bake
instructions: Microwave 15 minutes. Cut squash remove seeds peel and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Melt margarine; mix brown sugar flour salt and mace with margarine. Arrange squash in dish top with apples. Spoon brown sugar mixture over top; cover tightly. Microwave on High 8 minutes and check. Microwave until squash is crisp tender about 6 to 9 minutes longer. Let stand covered 5 minutes.

title: Sausage Pizza
instructions: Scramble sausage and drain grease. Add all other ingredients and simmer about 25 minutes. Spoon on English muffin halves and put in 400\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Corn Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tCream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mix well.\tAdd chilies. Sift flour and measure. Mix together with cornmeal baking powder and salt. Add to corn mixture and blend\twell. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch glass pan.\tPut in oven and turn down to 300\u00b0. Bake 1 hour. (May be made ahead and heated.)

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Note Cook chicken until meat falls off about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Iced Tea
instructions: Bring 16 cups of water with 2 cups of sugar added to a boil. Turn off heat and add the tea bags for 6 minutes. Remove bags and add pineapple juice and lemon juice. Thats it!

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add egg corn and slowly add buttermilk just enough to make balls. Form balls and drop into hot grease; brown.

title: Bourbon Slush
instructions: Thaw frozen juices. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into large container cover and place in freezer. When frozen chop it up and scoop into glasses. You need a spoon to enjoy it. As it melts you can drink it. Great for the holidays and special occasions.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Combine flour sugar and milk in deep baking dish. Melt butter. Pour batter in pan over melted butter. Spoon 2 cups sweetened peaches. Do not stir at all. Bake in oven for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Add cinnamon if desired. Serve hot or cold.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and\tbake in a shallow pan (9 x 13 x 2-inch) at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Spray pan with cooking spray for easier cleaning. All ingredients may be mixed in a baking pan. Cover pan\twith aluminum foil before baking. Let set a few minutes before serving.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake
instructions: Drain juice off pineapple. Add lemon juice to condensed milk. When thick add pineapple and Cool Whip. Crush vanilla wafers and line bottom of Pyrex dish with wafers and layer with pineapple mixture a layer of waters and a layer of pineapple mixture until all used up.

title: Mom'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: Boil chicken until very tender; remove from bone and cut up or shred. Cook limas until tender with diced onion. Add chicken limas corn tomatoes garlic cayenne salt and pepper (do not drain limas corn or tomatoes) to reserved broth. Add more broth if needed (canned). Simmer on medium-low about 1/2 hour. Thicken if desired. Serve with corn bread.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll into walnut-size balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with warm cheese sauce Cheez Whiz or nacho Cheez Whiz.

title: Seasoned Flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in tightly closed jar. Delicious and convenient to keep on hand for dredging any kind of meat or fish. Good for stew meat Swiss steak cutlets and pork chops.

title: Good Quick Gingerbread
instructions: Beat eggs well; add sugar and syrup. Beat well. Sift all dry ingredients and add to mixture. Mix boiling water and cooking oil together; add to the mixture. Bake in a slow 350\u00b0 oven until well done.

title: Layered Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pour green beans undrained into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan. Sprinkle stuffing mix on top. Layer with cooked chicken. Top with cream soup. Bake at 350\u00b0F for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Real Swedish Rye Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over oatmeal brown sugar salt butter and molasses. Cool add yeast. stir. Add 2 cups flour. Beat hard 2 minutes. Add rest of flour just enough to make soft dough. Rest 10 minutes. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl. Cover and let rise until double. Punch down and let rise again. Divide dough in half shape into two loaves. Let rise about 45 minutes. Bake in oven (375\u00b0) for 35 to 40 minutes. When baked brush tops with butter.

title: Chinese Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken chunks with cornstarch. Heat wok to medium temperature. Put in oil. Add chicken and cook about 3 minutes or until brown. Add all the ingredients. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes. Serve over hot rice. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Barbara Mandrell'S Strawberry Pie(Celebrity Recipe)
instructions: Prepare baked pie shell. Add confectioners sugar to 3 cups whole fresh strawberries. Let stand 1 hour. Crush remaining cup of berries and cook in water about 2 minutes. Drain through strainer. Mix cornstarch and granulated sugar; stir into berries. Cook gently until clear stirring constantly. Fill pie shell with whole berries and pour the strawberry sauce over them. Chill. Top with whipped cream. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in the egg. Add the flour cream of tartar and baking soda. Spread in a 13-inch pizza pan (not quite to edge of pan). Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.\tBlend in broth butter and milk. Mixture should be very moist to allow for loss of moisture during baking. Spoon into greased baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Taco Casserole
instructions: Grease cake pan. Layer with tortilla chips; debone chicken. Mix enchilada sauce soup and spices. Pour over layer of tortilla chips. Top with more chips; then add grated cheese. Pour broth over cheese top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add brown sugar and cook over low heat. Stir constantly. Add milk; cook until it boils 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add powdered sugar. Will ice a 2 layer cake. Plain cake mix will do.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Mix cheeses egg spinach and seasoning; save some Mozzarella cheese to sprinkle on finished dish. In 9 x 13-inch pan layer until gone 1 cup sauce noodles and 1/2 cheese mixture. Then sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Pour 1/2 to 1 cup water around edges; cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes(Great For Barbecues)
instructions: Defrost hash browns. Mix together hash browns sour cream chopped onions cream of chicken soup salt and pepper. Spread mix into 8 x 12-inch dish.

title: Turkey And Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook broccoli until just tender-crisp. Cook turkey until tender. Remove bones and skin and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch pan or dish. Place turkey on top of broccoli. Mix the 2 soups together with the sour cream and pour over broccoli and turkey. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until bubbly hot. (Chicken may be used instead of turkey.)

title: Shira-Ae With Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces. Slice carrots bamboo shoots and Konnyaku in 1-inch pieces. Cook in water sake sugar and soy sauce mixture for 15 minutes and cool. When cool mix with tofu mixture from the Vegetable Shira-ae recipe.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Layer the lettuce onion cauliflower broccoli and bacon. Mix together mayonnaise sugar and Parmesan cheese. Put on top; let set for 24 hours. Toss and serve.

title: Meat-Less Tacos
instructions: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and heat. Saute the onion and garlic. Add chili powder to taste a pinch of cumin tomato sauce and water. Bring to a boil then add beans and rice. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand another 5 minutes. Spoon into taco shells or tortillas and top with cheese hot sauce and lettuce.

title: Pecan Dainties
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add the rest of the ingredients gradually. Roll quite small like dates and bake in slow oven 275\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Do not brown! Roll in powdered sugar while hot.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Heat soup and cream cheese; add remaining ingredients and heat. Serve hot as dip for corn chips.

title: Christmas Munch
instructions: Melt bark in double boiler. Pour in Fruit Loops and nuts. Pat down on buttered cookie sheet.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef with salt and onion in shortening in skillet. Stir in catsup. Cook for 10 minutes stirring frequently. Spoon into buns. Yields 5 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese ketchup horseradish and lemon until creamy. Fold in chopped shrimp. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Cut up artichokes. Mix with mayo and cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread on bread or crackers.

title: Cranberry Cherry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries. Add sugar and orange rind; mix well. Let stand 30 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup boiling water to dissolve sugar. Refrigerate while preparing gelatin. Stir gelatin into 1 cup boiling water until dissolved. Add 1/2 cup cold water; chill until slightly thickened. Stir in cranberry mixture celery apples and walnuts. Pour into 1 (3 cup) mold. Cover; chill until set. Unmold onto serving plate. Makes 12 servings.

title: Sausage And Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Combine soup milk onion green pepper salt and pepper; blend well. Place half the potatoes in a greased 2-quart casserole. Add half the sausage. Cover with half the soup mixture. Repeat layers. Dot with butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 (moderate oven) about 1 1/4 hours.

title: Orange Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid lemonade pineapple juice and ginger ale. Chill for 2 hours. Add sherbet just before serving.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Mix and mold first three ingredients in a circle. Put strawberry preserves in the center. Chill for three to four hours before serving.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine sugar tapioca salt and nutmeg. Add rhubarb and strawberries. Mix to coat fruit. Let stand about 20 minutes. Turn into pastry lined 9-inch pie plate. Dot with butter. Adjust lattice top and seal. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Add pudding mix to pineapple. Fold in marshmallows and Cool Whip. Let set overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar milk and oleo in electric frying pan. Cook at 280\u00b0 boiling for exactly 5 minutes (no longer). Turn off pan. Add peanut butter marshmallows and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in greased pan.

title: Plains Pemmican(Traditional)
instructions: Pound meat into coarse powder. Cut raw fat into walnut size pieces and melt over slow fire. Pour fat over meat and mix in berries. Mix well and pack in parfletches.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan for 1 hour and 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Banana Squares
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo; add eggs milk vanilla and bananas then flour salt and baking soda. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased jelly roll pan for approximately 20 minutes or until brown. While hot frost with sugar and water glaze.

title: Crispy Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut each chicken wing at joints to make 3 pieces. Discard tips. Mix egg 2 teaspoons vegetable oil the soy sauce salt sugar and 5 spice powder in medium glass or plastic bowl. Stir in chicken. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Add water to chicken. Stir flour cornstarch and baking soda into chicken.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Mix in bowl first 7 ingredients. Toss lightly until well mixed. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stuff chops. Slowly brown on low heat on both sides 15 minutes total. Then bake covered about 1 1/4 hours or until tender.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Roll into ball and sit in refrigerator overnight. Roll in cheese tidbits or nuts.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Blend with others. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Whipped cream can be added on top after cool. Takes less than 5 minutes to make.

title: French Pastry
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and divide into halves. Pat into 2 (13 x 2-inch) strips. Place on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Extra-Ordinare
instructions: Brown bacon. Place chicken in pan. Cover with 1 cup melted butter and then spread all seasoning over chicken. Place browned bacon on top and then smother with onion and pepper. Bake covered for 30 minutes; then uncovered for an additional 30 minutes or until chicken is browned.

title: Vermicelli Salad
instructions: While vermicelli is hot drain and add Accent seasoned salt lemon juice and oil. Mix and cover. Refrigerate overnight. Next day add remaining ingredients. Keeps in refrigerator a good while. This is wonderful in the summer with hamburgers and steaks.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in saucepan. Bring to full boil stirring constantly. Continue to boil for 5 full minutes over medium heat. Remove from heat and add Marshmallow Creme peanut butter and vanilla stirring until well blended. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions drain. Add taco seasoning mix and water. Add green chilies beans and cooked rice. Pour mixture into baking dish and top with crushed Fritos and cheese. Bake until cheese is melted and serve.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to box directions. Bake 4 thin layers. Stack while hot. While cake is cooling mix frozen coconut that has been thawed out with sugar and sour cream. Mix good and spread. Cook cake at 375\u00b0 or if oven is slow make it 400\u00b0 but watch it. Be sure to grease the pans flour them and line with wax paper. (Note Always use this particular cake mix for no other will work.)

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Medley
instructions: Add vinegar sugar mayonnaise salt and pepper in a bowl. Be sure to mix well. Cut broccoli and cauliflower in bite size pieces. Mix with sugar mixture and crumbled bacon or bacon bits. Chop onion in small pieces. Stir well. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Sweet Stewed Tomatoes
instructions: Put in saucepan on top of stove. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle cinnamon to taste.

title: Quick Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef until browned stirring to crumble. Drain off pan drippings. Spoon beef into an 8-inch square baking dish. Top with pizza sauce and cheese.

title: Wanda'S Easy Rolls
instructions: Heat milk water and butter until butter melts. Sift together sugar yeast and flour. Pour heated liquids into sifted mixture. Stir and sit aside to rise (about 3 hours). Roll out on floured paper. Cut rolls with jar lid. Dip in melted butter. Fold in half on cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees until golden brown.

title: Miracle Pie(Coconut Pie; Georgia Cooking)
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend thoroughly. Pour into a 10-inch pie plate that has been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. A crust will form on the bottom pie filling is in the center and coconut topping above. Make it a family project to look up the ingredients. All are found in the King James version of the Bible.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers onions peppers and salt. Cover with cold water (ice if possible). Let stand 3 hours. Drain. Bring vinegar and spices to boiling. Add vegetables and simmer for just a few minutes. Pack into hot jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Adjust lids. Process 5 minutes in boiling water bath.

title: Burrito Bake
instructions: Mix the Bisquick water and beans together; spread this mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer the beef then the salsa then the cheese over the Bisquick. Bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Garnish with sliced black olives and chopped tomatoes. Serve this with sour cream if desired.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
instructions: Freeze. Cut in squares just before serving. Do not thaw.

title: Joe Froggers-Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix and sift flour. soda salt and spices. Cream shortening and sugar. Add molasses and extract to shortening mixture. Add the flour mixture and the flour  alternately in small amounts beating until well blended. Wrap dough in foil; chill overnight.

title: Baked English Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs with a wire whisk in bowl until smooth. Beat in milk. Stir in seasoning Cheddar cheese onion and bacon. Melt butter in a 9-inch frying pan/omelette pan. Pour egg mixture in pan. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until set and golden. Garnish with additional bacon if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Roll very thin on well floured surface. Let dry for approximately 2 hours. Cut and drop in boiling broth.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Rinse and drain lentils. Place in large kettle with 8 cups water. Add remaining ingredients except tomatoes and vinegar. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add tomatoes and vinegar. Simmer covered 30 minutes longer. Salt and pepper to taste. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Crock-Pot Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on low for 6 hours.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix together sugar and syrup in 1 1/2-quart bowl. Microwave 5 minutes on High. Add 1 cup peanuts and microwave 3 to 3 1/2 minutes on High or until light caramel color. Quickly stir in butter baking soda and vanilla. Spread on greased cookie sheet to harden.

title: Pecan Turtles
instructions: On a cookie sheet arrange 5 pecan halves to resemble turtles 4 feet and head. Place 1 caramel in center of each turtle. Continue until there are no spare parts. Place cookie sheet in preheated 325\u00b0 oven until caramels have softened approximately 5 minutes. Remove from oven with a buttered spatula or prebuttered fingers. Place a chocolate kiss on each turtle. (Chocolate will soften from heat of caramels.) With a buttered spatula gently swirl chocolate to cover caramel. Transfer to waxed paper to cool.

title: Battered Fried Shrimp
instructions: Beat egg salt and pepper to taste; add beer. Mix gently. Gradually add flour until you have consistency of a thin pancake batter. Dip shrimp in batter and deep fry until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Sausage Stew
instructions: In large skillet slice sausage into bite size pieces. Cook sausage and onion over medium heat until meat is slightly browned. Drain. Add peas tomatoes tomato sauce broth and seasonings. Cook and stir for 10 to 12 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Stir in the corn and cook 5 minutes longer or until heated through. Serves 6.

title: Sausage Breakfast
instructions: Grease 14 x 9-inch Pyrex dish. Cube 3 slices of bread and layer in dish. Break up 1 pound of sausage; fry and drain. Layer over bread. Beat 8 eggs and mix with 2 cups milk 1 teaspoon salt and dash of Worcestershire sauce. Top with one cup of grated cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Mix flour margarine and sugar. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients and place on top of the crust. Bake for 25 to 30 more minutes.

title: Spicy Okra
instructions: Mix okra and potatoes in large bowl. Sprinkle the Potato Shakers over this and mix to coat. Add cornmeal and stir lightly. Heat oil in baking pan. Add mixture to pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crisp and brown; stir once.

title: Rosie'S Gumbo And Rice
instructions: Fry okra rolled in flour. Add bell peppers and onion. Push to the side and add flour. Dump in a can of whole kernel corn Ranch Style beans with jalapeno peppers and can of tomato sauce. Last of all add any kind of cooked meat. Serve over rice.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix oil with spices. Add crackers. Put in a sealable container. Shake up periodically until all dry ingredients are absorbed.

title: Swedish Spritz Cookies
instructions: Blend butter and sugar; add egg and beat well. Sift flour and baking powder at least 3 times. Add to blend and mix well. Add vanilla and mix again. Put into cookie tube and squeeze onto greased cookie sheet. Bake until edges are light brown in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Cucumber And Onion Salad
instructions: Mix first six ingredients in a small bowl; add cucumbers and onions. Mix well. Keep chilled in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix Velveeta and cream cheese together. Add pecans and seasonings. Roll into ball. Wrap with Saran Wrap and put on plate in fridge overnight. Just before ready to serve roll in nuts and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Instant Russian Tea(A Great Christmas Idea)
instructions: Keeping all ingredients in their original form mix thoroughly until well blended.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in baking dish. Bake 350\u00b0 for 1-1/2 hour or until casserole looks done.

title: Pineapple Filling
instructions: Layer bread nuts apples and pineapple into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and milk. Pour over bread and fruit. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Great with ham.

title: Baked Kraut
instructions: Mix together kraut sausage tomatoes onion and egg. Salt and pepper to taste. Put crackers on top. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Pour in ice cream freezer. Fill to full line with homogenized milk. Freeze as per freezer instructions.

title: Cedi'S Tea
instructions: Steep tea bags in boiling water for 15 minutes. Discard bags; add sugar stirring until it completely dissolves. Then add orange juice lemonade concentrate water and pineapple juice. Yields approximately 1 gallon.

title: Sausage Ring
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and press into Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. After 25 minutes pour off excess grease if necessary. Then bake the remaining time. Serve with Ritz crackers or party rye.

title: Creole Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Store in an airtight container. Sprinkle on seafood chicken beef or pork. Great for grilling meats outdoors.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Let cream cheese soften and then mix all of the ingredients well. Sometimes I add a little lemon juice. Serve with crackers.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Line 9-inch pie tin with pastry. Beat eggs slightly. Add syrup sugar and other ingredients and mix thoroughly. Stir in 1 cup pecan halves and pour into pastry lined tin. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until set and pastry is browned.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Drain peas or mixed vegetables. Mix well and pour into greased baking dish. Top with Hungry Jack biscuits chow mein noodles or herb seasoned stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Pour dry pudding over undrained pineapple then mix. Add nuts and marshmallows. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Good served with Hawaiian bread.

title: Heavenly Onion Casserole
instructions: Melt butter over medium high heat. Saute onions and mushrooms until tender. Place in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Combine soup milk and soy sauce. Pour over cheese. Top with bread and cheese slices. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Bake loosely covered for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until heated through. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lost Bread(Pain Perdu - French)
instructions: Cream eggs and sugar together well. Add milk and vanilla and stir until sugar is dissolved. Dip whole slices of bread into the mixture allowing bread to absorb the milk but not to become soggy. Spray skillet with Pam. When pan is hot put bread into skillet and fry until golden brown.

title: Paralee Sargent'S Strawberry Salad
instructions: Put pineapple in pan. Let come to a boil. Add Jell-O. Let it thicken. Fold in gently large cottage cheese. Add Cool Whip. Refrigerate to congeal.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according the package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Stir in the mayonnaise pickles onion garlic celery salt and pepper.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Place cream cheese in bottom of dish. Microwave until melted. Pour chili over cream cheese. Pour taco sauce on top of chili. Grate cheese and sprinkle on top. Microwave on High for 10 minutes or cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in water until water is gone. Let cool. Mix eggs liquid sweetener and oil. Combine dry ingredients; add to liquid mixture. Add raisins and vanilla. Pour into a greased and floured 8 x 8-inch pan or Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until tests done.

title: 3 Bean Salad
instructions: Toss together; cover and chill.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Combine flour margarine and pecans; press into oblong pan. Bake 12 minutes at 400\u00b0; cool. Mix softened cheese and sugar; fold in Cool Whip. Spread over cool crust. Slice bananas on top and spread blueberry pie filling over. Can make ahead 1 day.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Layer bread then layer browned sausage and cheese in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour mixture over bread. Cover and set for at least 8 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 45 minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix together hamburger cracker crumbs water and seasoning. Shape into hamburgers. Roll in flour and brown both sides in butter. Put in casserole and cover with mushroom soup that is diluted with 1 can water. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Lemon Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese with mixer until light and fluffy. Beat in condensed milk and lemon juice one tablespoon at a time (use more or less to taste). Pour into pie crust and chill several hours until firm.

title: Cathedral Windows
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and butter in top of double boiler. Add the beaten egg; let cool. Fold in marshmallows and nuts. Turn out onto waxed paper covered with coconut. Form into roll and chill. Slice to serve.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour batter into three 8 inch greased and floured cake pans. Bake for 35 minutes (or until cake turns loose from sides) at 350\u00b0. Let cool before icing.

title: Fudge Topped Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine oleo sugar flour cocoa baking powder eggs milk and 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla. Beat well. Stir in walnuts. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake for 40 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan. Just before brownies are done melt chips with condensed milk and remaining vanilla (use heavy saucepan). Immediately spread over hot brownies. Cool chill then cut into bars.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Melt margarine slowly in heavy saucepan. Combine cocoa salt and sugar and add to melted margarine. Add milk. Boil 3 minutes. Add vanilla and cool. Beat to spreading consistency.

title: Taco Fried Chicken
instructions: In a 3 quart bowl combine taco mix flour and salt. In 2 quart bowl blend eggs and milk; dip chicken pieces in egg mixture. Place chicken in seasoned flour. Thoroughly coat chicken. Fry in hot oil or shortening for 20 to 28 minutes. Drain on paper towel.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Pat uncooked beef into pan. Sprinkle with onion and smooth soup over all. Layer the Tater Tots on the soup and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until meat is cooked and potatoes are crispy.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into quarter or halves. Roll into balls. Mix sugar cinnamon and roll balls in mixture. Place in greased Bundt pan. Add remaining sugar mix on top. Bring butter or margarine and brown sugar to boil and pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Turn onto plate. Pull apart to eat. Serves 10.

title: Potato Doughnuts
instructions: Combine sugar shortening eggs and potatoes. Add buttermilk in which soda has been dissolved. Add dry ingredients and vanilla. Let set in refrigerator for 1 hour. Roll on floured board to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with donut cutter and fry in deep fat until brown.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Peel and mash avocados. Add salt and lemon juice. Stir in Worcestershire sauce garlic pepper and onion. Add hot pepper if desired. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: California Artichoke Spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except cheese; blend well. Spread into an ovenproof serving dish. Sprinkle top with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Serve with crackers or tortilla chips and salsa. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Crystallized Slice Tomatoes
instructions: Soak tomatoes overnight in water in which the lime has been added. Drain; rinse and soak in clear water for 3 hours.

title: Easy Cheese Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray an 11 x 7-inch baking dish with Pam. Spread 1/3 of the sauce on bottom of dish; arrange 3 noodles in a single layer over sauce. Top with 1/3 of the sauce all of the ricotta cheese and vegetables and 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese. Place remaining noodles in a single layer. Spread evenly with remaining sauce. Cover dish with foil. Bake until noodles are tender and mixture is hot about 1 hour. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle paprika and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Beat in flour cocoa cinnamon salt and ground pepper. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour. Divide dough into thirds. Roll out to 1/8-inch and shape with cookie cutters. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Pineapple Refrigerator Pie
instructions: Blend and fold together until mixed well. Pour into 2 (9-inch) graham cracker crusts. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Real Chocolate Pie
instructions: In a sauce combine sugar cocoa and flour. Add beaten egg yolks and milk. Stir over medium heat until thick. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue if desired.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat together milk eggs sugar and vanilla. Pour into small baking dish. Place bread slices on top; sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes until knife comes out clean when placed in center. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook 1 cup of berries with water until soft. Strain. Mix cornstarch and sugar with the puree. Cook until thickened and clear. Cool. Line pie shell with half the remaining berries. Combine the other half with the puree. Pour into pie shell. May be garnished with Cool Whip.

title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Add vanilla. Combine dry ingredients flour soda salt and cinnamon. Add to the first mixture. Fold in chopped pecans and apples. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake is done.

title: Old Fashioned Peanut Candy
instructions: Cook to softball stage in iron skillet. Add pinch of soda 1/2 stick margarine and ground peanuts. Pour into greased pan.

title: Apple Or Peach Strudel
instructions: Into bottom of buttered baking dish (9-inch square or 11 x 13-inch) put thick layer of fruit. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon (nutmeg if you like). Dot with lumps of butter. Mix together 1 cup sugar baking powder flour and salt. Into this break 1 egg; mix until crumbly. Put this over fruit and bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 until brown about 20 to 30 minutes. You can double the crumbs if you use a larger dish. This is good and easy.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses Cookies
instructions: Into large bowl measure all ingredients except milk chocolate kiss type candies. With mixer at low speed beat ingredients until well blended. Shape dough into a ball; wrap with plastic wrap. Refrigerate dough 1 hour or until easy to handle.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bring water margarine and salt to boil. Remove from heat. Add flour all at once. Beat with wooden spoon until forms ball clean away from pan. Beat in eggs one at a time until smooth (shiny and elastic looking). Drop by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake until puffed and light brown 25 to 40 minutes depending on the size of dough (sounds hollow); dont peek before 25 minutes. Let cool completely. Cut lengthwise in half and fill.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken and put in baking pan skin side down. Mix French dressing jam and onion soup together. Pour over chicken in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Baste often. Serve over rice.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Slice onions. Melt butter in a 4-quart Dutch oven. Slowly cook onions in butter until lightly browned about 20 minutes. Add bouillon cubes water and wine to onions. Cover and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Add Worcestershire sauce and salt. Add white and black peppers to soup. Stir. Shred cheese.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Blend last 3 ingredients. Fold dressing into vegetable mixture and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: In a saucepan mix well the first 5 ingredients. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes stirring constantly. (Make sure you cook for 5 minutes.) Add the next 3 ingredients; mix well. Drop by a spoon onto foil or wax paper.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook meat all to pieces. Add potatoes cubed. Cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients.

title: One Pan Pork Chops
instructions: Bring all vegetables except peas to boil. Cook until done. Heat oven to 400\u00b0; brown pork chops in oven. Drain vegetables; place in oven with pork chops. Add tomato sauce plus water oregano salt pepper and garlic; stir to cover all ingredients with sauce. Stir during cooking. Fifteen minutes before done add peas. Cook until done about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 2 to 4.

title: French Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix together cream cheese vanilla and sugar until very smooth. In a separate bowl beat heavy cream until thick. Fold into cream cheese mixture carefully. Pour into pie shell. Top with pie filling. Chill thoroughly before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Cut crust from 6 slices of bread. Butter both sides of each slice of bread. Stack bread and cut each slice into 4 cubes. Place buttered bread into a Pam sprayed casserole dish. Beat all 12 eggs at once and mix in half and half as you beat the eggs. Set aside.

title: Garbanzo Bean Dip
instructions: Drain most liquid from beans. Blend all ingredients in food processor until smooth. Sprinkle with paprika before serving. Serve with pita points.

title: Cherry And Pineapple Salad
instructions: Combine pie filling and evaporated milk in bowl; mix well. Add whipped topping marshmallows and pineapple; mix well. Spoon into serving bowl. Chill for several hours or overnight.

title: Easy Beef Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown\tground\tbeef and drain. Simmer beef tomato sauce onion and mushrooms until onion is cooked and liquid is reduced by about a third. Pat crescent roll dough into the bottom of a 10-inch pie plate to form crust.\tBeat egg; mix with 1 cup of cheese and place in crust as the first layer. Add the meat mixture and cover with 1 cup remaining cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Bake for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Main Dish Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix liquid from peas with tomato soup in one bowl. Set aside. Cut carrots celery onions and peas and place in layer in casserole dish. Brown hamburger and put over vegetables. Take soup mixture and pour over vegetables. Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: 7-Minute Frosting
instructions: Place sugar cream of tartar salt water and egg whites in the top of double boiler. Beat with a hand held electric mixer for 1 minute. Place pan over boiling water being sure that boiling water doesnt touch the bottom of top pan. Beat constantly on high speed with electric mixer for 7 minutes. Beat in vanilla. Frost your favorite cake.

title: Frog Eye Salad(Good Enough For Dessert)
instructions: Night before serving Boil pasta 8 minutes rinse and drain. In large bowl mix pasta pudding oranges pineapple and juice. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: *I also add 1/2 to 1 cup cooked garbanzo beans to vegie mixture if served as a meatless main dish.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries add sugar and leave overnight covered in refrigerator. Add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Fruit And Cheese Dessert
instructions: Mix and press onto sided cookie sheet the butter flour and sugar. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Nut Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each one. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add butter mixture. Add nuts and flavoring. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Green Chile Burrors
instructions: Cook stew meat and beef cubes in crock-pot overnight. In morning stir and add chopped onion salt pepper and green chiles and tomatoes; simmer all day. Add cumin; thicken slightly with cornstarch if needed. Heat tortilla shells and place meat mixture in them and sprinkle with cheese in shell. Roll and put taco sauce over rolled shell.

title: Italian Bread
instructions: Cut bread on diagonal at 1-inch intervals. Brush with softened butter. Sprinkle with oregano. Wrap in foil. Heat on grill 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Grind celery pears onions and peppers together. Mix with sugar salt vinegar and allspice and let stand overnight. Boil all together for 30 minutes. Seal in sterile jars.

title: Vegetable Casserole No. 1
instructions: Combine vegetables cheese mayonnaise onion celery and water chestnuts. Pour into shallow baking dish and bake 45 minutes in a 300\u00b0 oven. Crush 20 Ritz crackers and combine with 1/2 stick margarine. Sprinkle over casserole and return to oven for 15 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: In medium saucepan brown ground beef and drain. Put into casserole baking dish. Take shredded Cheddar cheese and sprinkle over ground beef. Take frozen Tater Tots and put on top of cheese and meat; layer evenly. Heat cream of chicken soup and pour immediately onto casserole. Place directly in oven. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Salt to taste.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Fold pudding mix into whipped topping. Add other ingredients and chill.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mash shrimp with fork. Add cream cheese. Mix well and add other ingredients. Can add horseradish.

title: Raisin Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spread half of mixture on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Press firmly.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: In frypan melt butter or shortening; add flour as for pan gravy. Add cocoa and then milk. Add sugar to your taste. You can add salt if you like. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix all but tomato; let set overnight for full flavor. Garnish with tomato.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix dry Jell-O and all other ingredients together thoroughly. Refrigerate.

title: Graham Cracker Dessert
instructions: Prepare jello. Cool. Put layer of whole graham crackers in 9 x 9-inch pan and use filling. Combine powdered sugar melted butter egg yolk nuts and pineapple. Fold in stiffly beaten egg white. Pour over crackers twice so you have 3 layers of crackers and 2 layers of filling. Pour half jello (thickened) on top and whip rest and put on top.

title: Unsweetened Applesauce Muffins
instructions: Mix Sweet N Low with eggs. Add Crisco and spices. Mix flour soda and salt together. Add to egg mixture alternating with applesauce. Do not overmix. Add vanilla nuts and raisins. Spoon into muffin pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chart House Mud Pie
instructions: Crush wafers and add butter; mix well. Press into 9-inch pie plate. Cover with soft coffee ice cream. Put into freezer until ice cream is firm. Top with cold fudge sauce (it helps to place in freezer for a while to make spreading easier). Store in freezer approximately 10 hours.

title: Mock Pierogi
instructions: Chop onion into small 1/4-inch size pieces. Chop cabbage into 1-inch wide by 4 to 5-inch long strips. Melt butter in a cast-iron skillet. Add chopped vegetables. Fry on medium heat until soft. While frying vegetables boil water in a large pot. Cook noodles until done (not overdone). Drain noodles. Add to frying pan. Fry all ingredients together over medium heat until noodles are well blended with cabbage. Season with salt and pepper to taste. (Some people substitute drained rinsed sauerkraut for cabbage.)

title: Peanut Butter Pie(Serves 8)
instructions: Whip cheese until fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Add milk blending well. Fold whipped topping into peanut butter mixture. Pour into pie crust. Sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large pan. While this is heating melt butter and add flour to make a paste. Add paste to tomato mixture and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in milk or water. Return to heat and simmer until ready to eat. This goes great with grilled cheese sandwiches.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook pudding together with 3 cups of liquid drained from fruit and orange juice. Cool and add fruits. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Perfect Chocolate Cake
instructions: In medium bowl combine cocoa with boiling water mixing with wire whisk until smooth. Cool completely.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Sift together and set aside flour soda salt and baking powder. Blend together shortening and sugars. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture and mix well. Add rolled oats vanilla and chocolate. Dough is crumbly. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie pan and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until brown. Makes 11 dozen.

title: Old-Fashioned Fudge
instructions: Stir first 3 ingredients and cook to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add Hershey bars. Add chocolate chips and marshmallow cream. Add chopped nuts if desired. Pour into buttered cookie sheet and allow to set.

title: California Chicken Salad
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together the oil vinegar mustard chopped onion chives and 1/2 cup of the raisins. Season with salt. Slice each chicken breast diagonally to 1-inch thick pieces.

title: Main Dish Potatoes Bake
instructions: Boil and peel potatoes; cool. Mix all other ingredients except cheese. Pour over potatoes then cover with grated cheese. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan; can be covered with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is bubbly about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Cream 1/4 cup margarine in a large bowl at medium speed of electric mixer. Add granulated sugar gradually. Add beaten egg and egg whites. Beat until well blended. Add milk gradually. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add slowly to creamed mixture. Melt remaining 1/2 cup margarine. Pour into 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle brown sugar over margarine. Place pineapple slices on top of brown sugar. Pour cake batter carefully over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in cake comes out clean. Cake may be garnished with maraschino cherries placed in center of pineapple slices.
