title: Microwave Rice Pudding
instructions: In a 1-quart glass casserole combine all ingredients. Heat uncovered in microwave on High for 6 minutes. Rotate. Heat for 3 minutes. Stir. Heat for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir. Heat for last 1 1/2 minutes and stir. Place in desired bowls; cool and serve.

title: Fiesta Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Dirt
instructions: Crush 1 1/2 packages Oreo cookies. Mix ingredients saving part of the Oreos to put on top.

title: Baked Broccoli
instructions: Layer cooked broccoli cheese broccoli and cheese. Mix crackers and margarine; pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Mock Burrito
instructions: Brown ground round and season with taco seasoning. Lay fajita shell on counter. Smooth on beans; top with little chilies. Smooth on beef; top with cheese. Roll up and place on baking sheet with ends down. Bake approximately 15 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until edges turn brown. Serve with Mexican rice (omit butter) and chopped lettuce and tomatoes. Garnish with fat-free sour cream.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Mix together and garnish as desired.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Drain. Stir in butter Parmesan cheese and already beaten eggs. Cut through mixture with knife and fork for bite size pieces. (Or you can break spaghetti before cooking.) Form into 1 bowl-type crust in 2 buttered 10-inch pie pans. Let cool.

title: New Potatoes And Garlic Baked In Foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Scrub potatoes skins and leave on. Leave potatoes whole if they are 1 inch across; otherwise cut them into 1 inch pieces. Toss the potatoes in olive oil. Place 4 or 5 potatoes on one foil for one serving. Tuck in a garlic clove rosemary or thyme and season with salt and pepper.

title: Oatmeal Muffins(Blue Ribbon Winner)
instructions: Combine oats and sour cream. Stir in melted butter eggs and 2 cups brown sugar until well mixed. Sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Stir dry ingredients into oat mixture and add drained raisins. Blend. Divide into 2 greased or paper lined muffin pans.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Place peanut butter in a bowl. Add corn syrup and vanilla. Stir until well coated. Add milk a little at a time and stir. Add sugar and mix. Knead with hands on a dry surface until well coated or until sugar is all gone. Pat out about 1/2-inch thick and cut in squares.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Nuts can be added before or after browning.

title: Ground Beef Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Brown beef and onion. Boil noodles for 10 minutes; drain. Mix beef onion noodles tomato juice salt pepper and chili powder. Cook for 20 minutes then sprinkle with cheese and continue cooking until it melts.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Wash beans; cover with water. Simmer until almost done. Drain. Place pork in dish and add beans. Add molasses salt mustard 1 cup boiling water and chili powder. Pour over beans. Add water to cover. Bake in covered dish at 325\u00b0 for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Wasp Nest Cake
instructions: Bring milk and vanilla pudding to boil. Take off heat and add cake mix. Stir until mixed well. Pour into ungreased pan. Top with butterscotch morsels. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hershey Fudge
instructions: Combine and cook cocoa sugar salt and milk over medium heat; stirring constantly until it reaches 232\u00b0 or soft-ball stage. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Leave alone until temperature drops to 110\u00b0. Stir and beat candy until it begins to loose its gloss. Pour into buttered dish. Let harden.

title: Lena Culp'S Cocoa Drop Cookie Sandwiches
instructions: Combine shortening and sugar; add eggs beat. Add milk and vanilla slowly. Stir in dry ingredients. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Finger test should leave dent in center.) When cool spread vanilla icing on one cookie; top with second cookie.

title: Vegetable Squares(Refrigerate Over Night)
instructions: Line 10 x 15 pan with rolls press together bake at 350\u00b0 10 to 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Spice Cake Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Combine cake mix margarine milk and egg. Mix well. Stir in nuts and chocolate mint chips. Drop by tablespoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes for soft cookie 15 minutes for crisp cookie. Cool cookies on wire rack. Crushed toffee bars can be used instead of chocolate mint chips.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix together and place in casserole dish. Bake 45 mins. at 300 degrees. The last 15 mins. sprinkle canned onion rings on top.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil water mix cornstarch and sugar well; add to water and stir well.\tBlend cook over moderate hot heat until clear and thickened.\tTake off stove and add strawberry jello mix well. Bake pie shell. Let mixture cool. Add food coloring (optional) fold in strawberries and pour in baked pie shell.

title: Cindy'S Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook elbow macaroni according to package directions; drain. Rinse shrimp in cold water; drain. Add salt pepper celery and onions (desired amount). Add mayonnaise and mix together.

title: Green Party Punch
instructions: Mix fruit juices; chill. Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add a few ice cubes to cool quickly. Add fruit juices and mix. Just before serving add ginger ale and ice cubes. Garnish as desired.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Mix and pour over 1 1/2 pounds boneless stew meat or noodle or rice at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: In a square baking dish layer first the broccoli and then the chicken breasts (cut either in halves or in bite sized pieces). Combine the remaining ingredients (except the bread crumbs) and pour over the top. Sprinkle with the bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Pat
instructions: Mix; refrigerate for 1 hour and serve with crackers. Easy and excellent. Can be made night before.

title: Chicken Salad(Low Calorie)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the almonds. Chill and serve over salad greens if desired. Garnish with almonds. Makes six 1/2-cup servings.

title: Pecan Praline Cookies
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Beat egg whites until stiff. Blend in dry ingredients a little at a time until all is mixed in (stir by hand). Add vanilla and pecans. Mix all together. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool on cookie sheet or they may crumble when removed.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pack into large Pyrex dish. Sprinkle 1 cup bread crumbs over the top. Refrigerate overnight. Remove 1 hour before cooking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Heavenly Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs melted butter brown sugar and nutmeg. Press into pie plate. Reserve a little for garnish.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese and Cheddar together. Add pineapple Worcestershire sauce and green onions. Mix thoroughly with cheeses. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Form into ball and roll in nuts.

title: California Casserole(Delicious Meat And Noodle Dish)
instructions: In a large skillet cook ground beef with green pepper and onion until the meat is browned and vegetables are tender; drain. Add next 11 ingredients; mix thoroughly. Add noodles; mix well. Pour into a Dutch oven or large baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven for 10 minutes or until the cheese melts. Yields 12 to 16 servings. Good for Tobacco Honds Silage Hands.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy add eggs one at time. Alternate flour and milk blending well after addition ending with vanilla. Cook in greased and floured tube pan at 300 for 1 1/2 hours. Great with strawberries and whipped cream.

title: Lo-Cal Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix sauce and water; set aside. Cut cabbage into wedges; drop in hot water and bring to a boil. Take off heat and set aside. Cook rice according to package directions. Brown ground beef with seasonings and onion. Drain cabbage. Layer 1/3 of cabbage 1/2 of meat 1/2 of rice 1/3 of sauce (enough to cover). Layer 1/3 of cabbage sauerkraut remaining meat and rice 1/3 of sauce to cover. Top with remaining cabbage and sauce. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: German Chocolate Cake(Easy)
instructions: Flour and grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread coconut and pecans on bottom. Mix cake batter according to directions and pour over nut mixture. Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread over cake mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine melted oleo and crumbs; spread in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat sugar eggs and 2 sticks oleo for 15 minutes. Spread over crumb mixture. Slice bananas over filling. Spread pineapple over bananas. Spread Cool Whip over top of this. Sprinkle nuts on top. Cover with Saran Wrap and chill overnight.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake as on package. Bake half the mix in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate cheese. The pimento slices can be pressed through the grater. Press garlic buttons in garlic press and combine all ingredients and mix well. Form into ball and may be rolled in paprika or finely chopped pecans.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in medium sauce pan and cook on medium heat until thick stirring constantly. Spoon over biscuits. Very good.

title: Mom'S Lemon Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown around edges.

title: Avocado Soup
instructions: Warm soup milk celery and onion mixture. Place in blender. Peel and cut up avocados; add to blender. Blend mixture until smooth. Serve cold or hot. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Stir in. Spread into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 30-35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Marshmallow Meringue
instructions: Place marshmallows and milk in saucepan; cook over low heat folding over and over until marshmallows are half their original size. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and continue folding until smooth but light. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add salt and sugar slowly beating constantly. Carefully fold in slightly warm marshmallow mixture. Pile on pie. Place under broiler 3 inches from heat for 30 seconds.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach as directed. Squeeze all water out. Mix all ingredients. Form into bite-size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let sit on cookie sheet for 5 minutes. Makes 3 dozen +.

title: Pecan Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Put out on board or cabinet and knead. Form into 2 large rolls. Wrap each roll in waxed paper and chill. Slice as desired.

title: Microwave Easy Gravy
instructions: Pour drippings into 4 cup glass measure. Stir in flour until smooth. Pour in liquid and stir briskly until well blended. Cook on High (maximum power) for 3 to 4 minutes or until boiling stirring several times during cooking. Season with salt and pepper. Beat until smooth.

title: Potluck Potato Casserole
instructions: Defrost hash browns and combine in a large mixing bowl with 1/2 cup of melted butter; season with salt and pepper. Add chopped onion cream of chicken soup sour cream and grated cheese; mix thoroughly. Pour into buttered 3-quart casserole. Mix 1/4 cup melted butter with cornflake crumbs and sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Monkey Cake
instructions: Cut biscuits into quarters. Mix 3/4 cup sugar & cinnamon in plastic bag. Shake biscuit pieces in bag. Place coated biscuit pieces in greased bundt cake pan. Melt 1 1/2 sticks of butter and 1 c. sugar. Pour butter mixture over biscuit pieces. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together beans brown sugar mustard chopped green pepper and onion. Place in baking dish. Cover with the strips of bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Funnel Cake
instructions: Sift flour soda salt sugar and baking powder in separate bowl. Mix egg with milk; add to dry ingredients. (May need more milk it batter is too thick.) Beat until smooth. Hold finger over bottom of a funnel and pour in some batter. Remove finger and let batter drop in a spiral motion into pan filled with 1-inch hot oil (375\u00b0). Fry until golden brown turning once. Remove from pan and drain on a paper towel. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve hot.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Brown ground beef and drain. Add soup and rotel tomatoes to ground beef and simmer for about 10 minutes. Layer ground beef mixture corn tortillas and cheese in baking dish. Top with more grated cheese. Bake for about 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Tex-Mex Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine corn chips water and eggs. Press into 9 inch pie plate or casserole. Bake for 10 minutes. Brown ground chuck drain.

title: Mo'S Dream Bars
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 12-inch pan then sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over melted butter. Press crust to smooth. Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crust. Sprinkle chocolate chips coconut and nuts. Press down firmly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Simple Potato Salad
instructions: Peel cube and boil potatoes until tender. Strain and place in a bowl. Add all other ingredients. Toss and serve.

title: Dutch Babies
instructions: Put margarine in 6 custard cups. Combine 3 eggs flour milk oil and almond extract and put into cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove to dessert dishes. Melt marmalade and add to fruit to coat. Put fruit into Dutch Babies and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat eggs oil sugar and vanilla. Stir in zucchini. Combine dry ingredients. Add to zucchini mixture and mix well.

title: Pork Chops And Lima Beans
instructions: Cook lima beans in salty water until tender. Brown pork chops. Make sauce of other ingredients. Put pork chops and lima beans in Dutch oven. Pour over the sauce. Cook slowly on top of stove for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Red Hot Jello
instructions: Mix jello water and red hots together and cool. Add apples and nuts. Pour into a 9 x 13 inch pan. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Pork Chops And Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix above ingredients together. Spray your casserole pan with Pam and pour in mixture just made. Brown pork chops and place on top of mixture; bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Chicken Breasts In Sour Cream
instructions: Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish so pieces dont overlap. Cover with mushrooms. Combine mushroom soup sherry and sour cream. Stir until blended. Pour over chicken completely covering it. Dust with paprika. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream shortening eggs and sugar. Then add flour cream of tartar and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 or 15 minutes. Roll thin in sugar and cinnamon before baking.

title: Good Potato Soup
instructions: Cook bacon and onion in 4 quart Dutch oven drain and place on paper towels. Place potatoes celery carrots water and salt in Dutch oven. Cover and cook over high heat until it comes to a boil about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes until vegetables are tender. Drain in colander. Place half the potatoes in blender puree until smooth. Return puree mixture remaining potato mixture bacon and onions back in Dutch oven. Stir in cream salt and pepper. Cover and cook over medium heat about 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Do not boil. Place in serving bowls and sprinkle with cheese and parsley. Makes about 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Brown chicken and remove from pan. Brown onions and garlic. Combine all the rest of the ingredients. Add chicken onions and garlic; simmer 45 minutes. Just before serving stir in wine.

title: Fried Chicken Breast
instructions: Cut chicken into small strips. Dip chicken into pancake and buttermilk mixture. Put oil and butter in pan and heat. Lay strips of chicken in pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook until golden brown on both sides.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Sift flour baking soda and cream of tartar; set aside. Cream together butter and sugars; add beaten eggs. Add flour mixture mixing well. Roll into small balls and flatten somewhat with a fork. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Meatball Fondue
instructions: Add water to pineapple juice can to make 1 1/2 cups liquid. Stir in other ingredients until bubbly. Put in fondue pot. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Noodles
instructions: Mix together; roll on floured surface. Cut to desired thickness. Boil beef chicken or any type broth. Add noodles let stand about 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening thoroughly. Add the sugars eggs vanilla and peanut butter. Gradually add flour soda and salt. Shape into balls. Place on ungreased sheet. Flatten to 1/4 inch. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes.

title: Cowboy Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions. Drain well. In large pan combine tomatoes rice corn mixed vegetables and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Bring to boil stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Add hamburger mixture; reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. May be frozen. Very good!

title: Spring Rolls
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in frying pan. Add chopped garlic and fry for 2 minutes. Put in ground pork shrimp crab meat bean sprouts eggs green onion celery black mushrooms and jelly noodles. Fry for 5 minutes. Add soy sauce nampla salt and pepper

title: Country House Brownies
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; cool. Add brown sugar egg salt flour baking powder and vanilla. Mix well; add chocolate\tchips (coconut and nuts optional). Spread in greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.\tYields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Beat eggs. Add other ingredients and bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes.

title: Edible Peanut Butter Play Dough
instructions: Mix and knead into a pliable dough adding more powdered sugar if necessary. Roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Use powdered sugar for \flour\ for rolling. Can be pressed into a shallow pan as \candy.\

title: Mini Cheesecakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix together crumbs sugar and margarine. Press equal portions into paper lined muffin cups. In large bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Spoon equal amounts of mixture (about 3 tablespoons) into prepared cups. Bake for 20 minutes or until set; cool. Chill. Top with filling.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Grease a 10 1/2 inch cast iron skillet with 1 Tbsp. vegetable oil. Sprinkle corn meal over oil and let it brown slightly. Combine next 5 ingredients in a bowl stirring well. Pour half of corn meal mixture into skillet. Sprinkle with 1 c. cheese ground beef and peppers. Top with remaining corn meal mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs and beat well. Add oil. Combine flour baking powder salt and soda. Add dry ingredients alternately to first mixture. Add lemon extract raisins and pecans. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours and 15 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat chocolate and water until chocolate is completely melted. Mix margarine and sugar until fluffy; add egg yolks. Stir in chocolate and water mixture and flour and buttermilk; mix until smooth. Fold egg whites into batter. Pour into wax paper-lined 1-inch round pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Apricot Ribbon Salad
instructions: Heat nectar to boiling. Remove from heat and add jello stirring to dissolve. Stir in drained pineapple. Reserve 1/2 cup of this mixture; set aside. Divide remaining gelatin in half. Pour half into 2-quart mold. Refrigerate until set. Keep other half at room temperature.

title: Champagne Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice and thyme and let marinate for 5 minutes. Then season with salt and pepper.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Make into balls and fry in skillet with 1 large jar Welchs grape jelly and 1 1/2 bottles of chili sauce. Put into casserole dish; bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: *Chop and cook onion with squash until done; drain and cool.

title: Strawberry Cream Dressing
instructions: Place ingredients in a food processor. Process until smooth and creamy. Serve over fresh fruit. Thin with milk slightly to serve as a soup. Refrigerate covered; dressing will keep up to 3 days. Makes 1 cup.

title: Oreo Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and eggs together. Add cake mixes. Roll into 1-inch balls and cook 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cookies have cooled add filling between.

title: Hot Fruit Dish
instructions: Drain juice from fruit. Melt butter; add sugar and curry powder. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Lime Punch
instructions: Spoon ice cream and sherbet into 6-quart punch bowl. Pour juice and Sprite over ice cream and sherbet. This is so easy to make and so good. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Granny'S Watergate Salad
instructions: Stir jello into Cool Whip until well dissolved. Drain can of pineapple and stir in. Next stir in rest of ingredients and chill.

title: Strawberry Pie(Sugar-Free)
instructions: In saucepan stir together pudding mix and jello with water; stir over medium heat until it comes to a boil. Cool in refrigerator until thick. Arrange strawberries in pie shell. Pour mixture over berries. Chill until set. Serve with \Sweet Pretenders\ sugar-free topping.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Place eggs dark corn syrup peanut butter and vanilla in a large bowl. Mix well. Stir in peanuts; mix well. Pour batter into pie crust. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and serve.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and microwave about 5 minutes until warm. Pour over chicken or ribs. Place in oven and cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 375\u00b0.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion green pepper garlic salt basil and oregano; drain. Add soup and 1 can of water.

title: Cheddar Cheese-Bacon Bread(Bread Macine Recipe, 1 Pound Loaf)
instructions: Put ingredients in order listed. Use basic bake cycle. After first kneading is finished add 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar cheese and 1/2 cup cooked crumbled bacon.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Candy
instructions: Melt chips in double boiler over hot water. Crush noodles by hand. Add alternately with peanuts stirring constantly. When blended well drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Let harden or chill 1/2 hour. Store in airtight container.

title: Squash Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Scald milk. Place grated squash into prepared pie crust. Combine milk sugar and egg mixture together. Add spices. Pour over squash and bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or until silver knife inserted in center comes out clean. Do not let boil.

title: Turkey Lasagne(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: In large saucepan saute ground turkey onion garlic and mushrooms in oil until turkey looses pink color. Add tomato juice tomato paste and spices 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour sugar and salt. In mixing bowl beat margarine for 30 seconds. Add peanut butter and sugars; beat until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Add dry ingredients; beat until well combined. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; roll in granulated sugar if desired. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Crisscross with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 to 12 minutes. Cool for 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet.

title: Fudge Sundae Pie
instructions: Put evaporated milk chocolate morsels marshmallows and salt into heavy 1-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until chocolate and marshmallows melt completely and mixture thickens. Take off heat and cool to room temperature. Use a 9-inch pie pan. Fill with a graham cracker crust or line bottom and sides of pan with vanilla wafers. Spoon 1/2 of 1 quart vanilla ice cream over crust or wafers with 1/2 the chocolate mixture. Repeat with rest of ice cream then chocolate. Top with chopped peanuts or pecans.

title: Special Evening Cocktail
instructions: Combine orange juice rum liqueur and ice cubes in a large jar with tight fitting lid and shake well. Pour into 2 cocktail glasses. Garnish with orange slices and serve immediately to your favorite man.

title: Super Nachos
instructions: Brown beef sausage and onion; drain fat. Add Tabasco sauce. In greased casserole dish spread refried beans on the bottom. Spread meat and onion mixture on top of beans. Spread green chillies next. Spread cheese on top. Drizzle taco sauce over cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Add sour cream by the spoonfuls on top of everything after its cooled for a minute. Serve with tostados.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese on bottom of a microwave safe dish then spread chili over cream cheese. Top with grated cheese. Microwave on high 2-4 minutes or until cheese melts and chili bubbles. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Salad
instructions: Cool all together good. You can use Sweet N Low in place of sugar.

title: Hamburger And Noodles
instructions: Brown hamburger in large skillet with onion and green pepper. Add salt pepper and garlic powder to taste. Cook macaroni noodles according to package directions. Drain. Rinse with hot water and drain again. Put noodles in large bowl and add margarine. Mix. Drain hamburger. Squeeze out excess grease with paper towels. Mix well in bowl with noodles. Serve.

title: Homemade Soup
instructions: Cook meat well. Remove bones. Chop up. Add stew beef. Set aside. Cook potatoes onion and sweet potatoes until tender. Add rest of ingredients except hot pepper. Add salt sugar and pepper to taste. Boil for 1 hour.

title: Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside. Mix the flour sugar and soda. Cut in shortening. Add yeast water to buttermilk and mix all at once. Place desired amount of dough on floured cloth. Pat out and cut with biscuit cutter. Place on greased sheet and let rise. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks sugar and margarine well. Add milk. Mix well. Put in a double boiler and bring to boiling point. Then add cornstarch and vanilla. (Mix a little milk with starch and vanilla before adding to hot mixture.) Cook until thick as desired. Pour into a baked pie shell. Top with icing of egg whites and bake until brown.

title: Crunchy Chicken
instructions: Crush the cereal and melt the oleo. Dip chicken in oleo and roll in the cereal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Applesauce - Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add frozen berries and stir until thawed. Stir in applesauce. Pour into 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Chill until set.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a buttered casserole dish (8 x 13-inch); top with bread crumbs. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Seven-Minute Frosting
instructions: Put egg whites sugar water and corn syrup in upper part of double boiler and beat with eggbeater until thoroughly mixed. Cook and beat until frosting stands in peaks. Remove from fire and add vanilla. Beat until thick enough to spread. Coconut may be added to frosting if desired.

title: Linguine Salad
instructions: Cook linguine using package directions and drain. Combine all ingredients in bowl mixing well. Chill in refrigerator several hours before serving.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine pumpkin slightly beaten egg yolks and a mixture of sugar cornstarch and cinnamon; beat 5 minutes. Mix cream butter and whiskey. Beat egg whites until rounded peaks are formed. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Pour into pastry-lined 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 357\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until a silver knife comes out clean when inserted halfway between center and edge of filling.

title: Jalapeno Pie
instructions: Mix eggs (do not whip) until blended. Slice peppers lengthwise and remove seeds and stems. Into a 16 inch pie pan place 1/2 inch layer of coarsely grated cheese. Place peppers in a circular design around dish pointed towards center. Cover with remaining cheese. Pour eggs over mixture evenly. Garnish with pimento.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies(Good)
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar vanilla and egg. Mix in remaining ingredients. Roll into small balls. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar or use slotted spoon to make an interesting imprint. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes. This makes 3 dozen small cookies.

title: Lemonade Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs beating until light and fluffy. Stir together flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with 1/2 cup of the lemonade concentrate. Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese; gradually blend in crushed pineapple followed by 1 cup pecans green peppers onion and salt. Chill well. Form into ball; roll in 1 cup pecans. Chill. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Chinese Stir-Fry
instructions: In a wok put butter. Let melt and start to sizzle. Add vegetables and Oriental noodles. Add teriyaki marinade and seasoning. Cover and cook until vegetables are at desired doneness.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Saute butter and onions. Pour water over bread. Squeeze bread dry. Add all to ground beef mix. Add nutmeg salt and pepper. Shape into balls. Roll in flour. Brown in skillet.

title: Chili-Cheese Squares
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Whisk in flour butter baking powder and onion salt until mixture is smooth. Stir in cheeses and chilies. Pour into greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish square or round. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until firm and well browned. Cut into squares or wedges.

title: Cold Dough Cookies
instructions: Combine flour butter and Crisco and crumb the mixture as you would for pie crust. Add egg yolks to top of flour mixture (do not mix yet; wait until ingredients are in the mix.) Add 1/2 cup sour cream to flour mixture. Add cake of yeast 1 tablespoon sugar and vanilla to remaining sour cream in its container. Mix until yeast is dissolved. Add yeast mixture to flour mixture and stir by hand until dough is soft. Place dough in airtight container overnight (covering dough with plastic bag works well.) Divide dough into 5 parts and add flour and plenty of sugar. Roll with rolling pin to 1/8-inch thick (very thin); cut into triangles and add filling to wide section of triangle and roll as you would crescent rolls. Roll in sugar and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lou'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute ground turkey; drain and add crushed tomatoes tomato sauce paste and beer. Season with bay leaf oregano basil sugar Worcestershire sauce thyme salt and pepper. Begin this when you begin sauteing ground turkey. Saute in olive oil onion celery mushrooms and garlic. Slowly cook all ingredients for 2 hours. Serve over freshly cooked pasta.

title: Key Lime Cake
instructions: Combine the oil orange juice eggs gelatin and the cake mix and blend well. Pour the batter into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overcook. Remove the cake from the oven and while it is still warm prick the top of it all over with a fork. Combine the lime juice and the confectioners sugar and drizzle the mixture over the cake. (This mixture should be thin so as to penetrate the cake.) Cut the cake into squares to serve.

title: English Muffin Bread
instructions: Put 3 1/2 cups flour in large bowl. Add 2 packages yeast sugar salt and soda and mix together.

title: Chicken 'N Beef
instructions: Roll out chicken breasts until thin. Cut lengthwise into 4 strips. Roll up strips starting with small end and wrap with bacon and secure with toothpick. Mix sour cream and mushroom soup. In a greased casserole lay at least 1 piece of dried beef for each chicken/bacon roll. Place roll on beef and pour cream/soup mixture over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Usually serves 6.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
instructions: Cream shortening sugars and peanut butter. Add egg vanilla and milk alternately with sifted dry ingredients. Chill dough several hours or overnight. Roll into 1-inch balls; roll balls in sugar and bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes on ungreased baking sheets. Remove from sheets immediately and press chocolate kiss into each cookie.

title: Pop Corn Balls
instructions: Boil for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift the first 4 ingredients together. Bring the oleo cocoa and water or coffee to a boil and pour over flour mixture mixing well. Add remaining ingredients. Beat together mixing well with rest of ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Choco Torte
instructions: Melt oleo. Mix with flour and nuts. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes; cool. Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and 1/2 carton Cool Whip. Spread on crust. Mix 2 packages instant pudding according to package directions. Spread over cream cheese layer. Top with other 1/2 carton Cool Whip and garnish with shaved chocolate bar. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix approximately 2 hours ahead of serving and chill.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice 1/4-inch thick. Cook slowly on top of stove in boiling water with 1 teaspoon salt. Cook until almost tender. Remove from water. Place in baking dish and add sugar Karo water butter and vanilla. Bake at 400\u00b0 until liquid begins to thicken and potatoes are tender. Baste occasionally while cooking.

title: Asparagus-Pea Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus and pour into bottom of prepared baking dish. Drain peas and pour on top of asparagus. Spoon soup over peas. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Layer vegetables in order listed in a glass baking dish. Top with cheese. Mix Bisquick with enough water to make it pourable. Pour over vegetable/cheese layers making sure to cover all areas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Texas Crab Grass
instructions: Saute onion in butter or oleo. Add spinach crabmeat and Parmesan cheese. Serve in chafing dish with Melba rounds.

title: Grasshopper Bars
instructions: Prepare cocoa brownies as directed. Cool. Mix remaining ingredients except chocolate. Spread over brownies. Refrigerate 15 minutes. Heat chocolate over low heat until melted. Spread evenly over powdered sugar mixture. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Cut into bars about 1 1/2 x 1-inch. Makes 36 bars 140 calories per bar.

title: Meat Pie
instructions: Cook carrots and potatoes together. Put pie shell in pie pan. Layer the ingredients into the pie shell Beef on bottom onion potatoes and carrots (drained). Season and top with gravy. Top pie with crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 until hot and crust is nicely browned.

title: Crisco Crispy Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat Crisco oil in large nonstick skillet on medium high heat. Pour milk into shallow bowl. Combine flour paprika salt garlic powder and pepper in large plastic food bag. Dip chicken into milk and shake one piece of chicken at a time in flour mixture to coat. Fry chicken 25 minutes or until meat near the bone is no longer pink.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix in bowl the egg applesauce corn peppers onion jalapeno peppers and sugar. Add corn mix. Stir just until blended (mixture will be thick). Pour into hot greased iron skillet. Bake at 375\u00b0 in preheated oven for 45 to 55 minutes. Insert toothpick in center. Bread is done when toothpick comes out clean.

title: Apricot Filling For Kolaches
instructions: Put apricots in pot and add just enough water to cover the apricots. Cook on low heat about 20 or 25 minutes or until tender. Add sugar and cook until sugar is dissolved; add lemon juice. Cool well.

title: Cherry Pudding Torte
instructions: Mix flour sugar and oleo. Press into a 10 x 10-inch or 7 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Watch closely. Cool.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Stir well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Let cool completely before removing from Bundt pan to avoid sticking. Let cool on rack and decorate with cream cheese frosting.

title: Mom Eldridge'S Apple Crisp(Kelley Jo'S Great Great Grandmother)
instructions: Spread apples evenly in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; pour water over top. Combine flour sugar salt and cinnamon; stir lightly to mix and then cut butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Top with vanilla ice cream if desired.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water; add both Jell-O and gelatin together and stir. Add syrup from oranges. Stir. Add sherbet and chill until partially thickened. Fold in oranges. Pour into mold. Add maraschino cherries if desired.

title: Big John'S Cowboy Beef
instructions: Begin by putting a little butter or oil in skillet. Add all vegetables and cook until al dente. Add beef and cook all together until meat is browned and veggies are tender to the bite.

title: Skillet Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter evaporated milk in a large electric skillet. Set control dial at 280\u00b0. Bring to a fast boil; boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. Turn off fry pan. Add marshmallows peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until marshmallows peanut butter are melted and blended. Turn into a buttered 8 x 8-inch square pan. Cool before cutting in squares.

title: Pink Punch
instructions: Add boiling water to jello. Stir until dissolved. Add cold water juices and ginger ale just before serving. Garnish punch bowl with slices of lemon or oranges. Place a little bunch of flowers in center of each slice and let float on top of punch.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix Jell-O and 2 cups sugar and dissolve in 6 cups hot water. Add the pineapple juice almond extract lemonade concentrate and 1 cup sugar. Blend well. Freeze in 2 milk cartons.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Mix bananas marshmallows and pineapple in with jello. Cook the following together until thick egg pineapple juice sugar and flour. Cool and add cream cheese into the cooked mixture. Put over jello and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Red Velvet Pound Cake
instructions: Combine margarine shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg one at a time beating well after each one. Beat in vanilla and food coloring very slowly. Combine flour and salt and add to creamy mixture along with milk mixing very slowly until mixed very well. Bake in a greased and floured large tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Let cool. Then frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Can-Can Fruit Punch
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large plastic container; cover and refrigerate. Stir in ginger ale and serve over ice. Yields 5 quarts.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in one cup of hot water. Mix eggs box cake mix oil and lemon flavor. Mix with dissolved Jell-O. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix vegetables soup and chicken together. Place into one pie shell then put the other shell on top so that it forms the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan. Bring to a boil and stir. Remove from heat and add jello until dissolved and cool. Set in refrigerator then add buttermilk and stir until combined. Fold in Cool Whip and chopped nuts. Spoon into dish and chill until firm.

title: Ten Minute Vegetable Soup
instructions: Follow directions on the package to prepare the Ramen noodle soup in a large saucepan. Add vegetables. You may want to add water since the soup will be thicker. Let the soup come to a boil then lower heat to a simmer. Serve hot. For added flavor include 1 chicken flavored bouillon cube chunks of cooked chicken hot pepper sauce or anything else to your liking.

title: Nut Puffs
instructions: Cream butter and sugar with vanilla. Add flour and mix well. Stir in nuts. Form into marble sized balls and place on a cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. As soon as removed from the oven roll in confectioners sugar. This will form a glaze.

title: Taco Salad(Great For Get-Togethers)
instructions: Layer everything from the top of the list down. If you do not want meat or beans skip these ingredients.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Pour pie filling into buttered 3 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with spice then sprinkle with cake mix followed by pecans and melted butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover; bake about 10 minutes longer or until lightly browned.

title: No Crust Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and egg. Add next 5 ingredients. Blend well. Stir in nuts and apples. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Butterscotch Chip Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Set aside. Combine shortening granulated sugar brown sugar vanilla and water; beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Add flour mixture; mix well. Stir in butterscotch morsels and coarsely chopped nuts. Drop by well rounded 1/2 teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Cook cake according to directions on box. Bake in 9 x 13 inch pan let cool. Mix pudding with drained pineapple add other ingredient and mix well. Ice cake after cool.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 3 minutes. Cool and add all other ingredients except ginger ale. Freeze until ready to serve then add ginger ale.

title: Pepsi Pork Roast
instructions: Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Cheesy Squares
instructions: Mix cheese sugar vanilla and egg yolk until really creamy. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan and spread 1 package of crescent rolls on it. Top with cream cheese mixture. (You can add nuts or fruit on top of this.) Top with other package crescent rolls. Brush with beaten egg white. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Allow to cool then cut into squares.

title: Marshmallow Crisp Brownies
instructions: Prepare brownie mix as directed in 13 x 9 inch greased baking dish. Sprinkle baked brownies with marshmallows and return to oven for 3 - 5 minutes or until melted and golden. Cool on wire rack. In a saucepan combine chocolate chips peanut butter and butter over medium heat stirring constantly until chips are melted. Remove from heat and stir in cereal. Spoon and spread evenly over marshmallows.

title: Peach Cobbler Pie
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar together. Add milk and flour. Stir well. Pour dough in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour peaches and juice over dough. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup sugar. Cook about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until light golden brown. Peaches will sink to the bottom and crust will form on top.

title: Soul Spareribs
instructions: Place ribs in large kettle. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes. Drain and refrigerate until ready to grill. Mix all other ingredients. Place ribs on grill setting 6 to 8-inches from heat. Cook for 15 minutes; turn and brush with sauce. Cook 15 to 30 minutes longer turning and basting frequently.

title: Chewy Cake
instructions: Mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Oven Baked Stew Beef
instructions: Place stew meat in pan or baking dish. Sprinkle onion soup on top. Pour cream of mushroom soup over this. Cover tightly and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Sift flour and corn meal. Measure and add soda cream of tartar salt and sugar. Sift again. Add beaten egg sour cream milk and melted shortening. Beat thoroughly. Pour into a greased pan (9-inch) square. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lettuce Cashew Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer the lettuce bacon (crumbled) onion cauliflower and cashews. Mix together the salad dressing and sugar. Put the dressing on top of the other ingredients. Reserve some of the cashews and bacon to sprinkle on top of the dressing. Do not make too far ahead as this salad tends to get juicy.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Saute garlic and onions in oil until soft. Add green peppers eggplant and zucchini. Cook 5 minutes over medium heat tossing well. Add tomatoes with liquid and seasonings. Simmer until just tender (about 30 minutes). Cover last 15 minutes. Add mushrooms during last 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Pineapple Cheesecake(Microwave)
instructions: Spray a 9-inch pie plate with cooking spray; sprinkle with crumbs. In blender or food processor blend yogurt egg sugar and cornstarch. Gradually add cream cheese; blend until smooth. Pour into a large microwavable bowl. Microwave on High (100%) whisking 3 times 8 to 10 minutes or until it looks like chilled pudding. Remove; stir until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Cover; chill 1 hour. Top with Pineapple Topping. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Add nuts and marshmallows to pineapple. Stir in pudding. Fold in Cool Whip and cherries. Chill and serve.

title: Steamed Oysters
instructions: Prepare oysters as if you were going to serve them on the half shell. Place oysters on baking sheet. Put salt and pepper to taste on each. Place a drop of margarine and a drop of hot sauce on each. Sprinkle Parmesan on top of each. Place in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 3 to 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Oriental Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle chops with Tony Chachere seasoning and dust lightly with flour. Brown in oil in skillet with tight fitting lid. Cover chops with peppers and onions and pour soy sauce over all. Cover tightly and reduce heat. Cook for about 25 minutes turning once.

title: Fettuccine A La Didi
instructions: Cook fettuccine in water and olive oil until it is tender. Set aside. Melt butter in a frying pan and saute garlic 1 to 2 minutes; then add spinach. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently until moisture has evaporated. Add cream and nutmeg; season with salt and pepper. Toss in the fettuccine and Parmesan cheese; stir and cook for a final minute. Serve with extra Parmesan cheese.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except potato chips. Put in casserole; sprinkle potato chips over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
instructions: In a long casserole dish pour in rice evenly. Salt to taste. Place pieces of chicken on top of rice; salt. Mix cream of chicken soup and water. Pour over the chicken and rice. Lay thin patties of butter on each piece of chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 until the water mixture has cooked out approximately 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Shrimp And Avocado Salad
instructions: Note To prepare 20 minutes (allow time for chilling).

title: Sugarless Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Baked Cornish Hens
instructions: Clean and dry hens. Season inside and out with salt and pepper. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sausage Stuffed Squash
instructions: Wash squash thoroughly; cook in boiling salted water to cover 8 to 10 minutes or until tender but still firm. Drain and cool slightly. Trim off stems. Cut squash in half lengthwise; remove and reserve pulp leaving a firm shell.

title: Nana Chocolate Squares
instructions: Mix by hand (batter will be extremely thick). Spread by hand into a greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Flounder Amandine(Microwave)
instructions: Place almonds and butter in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Microwave at High 6 minutes or until almonds are lightly toasted. (Stir at 2 minute intervals). Stir in lemon juice. Place fillets over almonds and cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap; fold back a small corner of wrap to allow steam to escape. Microwave on High 6 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork giving dish a half-turn after 4 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into two 8 x 11-inch pans.

title: Crabmeat Muffins
instructions: Mix ingredients. Spread on muffins. Quarter the muffins. Freeze on cookie sheet then place in freezer bag. Broil 3 to 5 minutes as needed.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix well and put in sprayed casserole. Top with seasoned croutons rolled (or bread crumbs) with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash onions and salt until tender. Drain and add chicken soup celery soup sour cream pimentos salt pepper and grated cheese (optional). Mix stuffing mix and margarine. Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam. Put 1/2 dressing mix in bottom of dish. Pour squash mixture in pan and top with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: Mix milk and flour well and set aside. Cut up peeled potatoes and boil until tender. Add milk and flour mixture and cook until thickens. Add Cheez Whiz. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve with cornbread muffins.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix and cook over medium heat until thickened. Cool. Pour into baked pie shell in which strawberries have been placed. Top with cool whip and garnish with strawberries.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Slowly brown 1/2 cup sugar in skillet. Do not stir while its browning. When sugar is browned pour about 1/2 cup warm water in and let sugar melt. Put 3/4 cup sugar flour pinch of salt and milk in bowl. Mix well and add eggs to melted sugar in skillet. Put egg yolks in cup and add some of the hot mixture before putting in skillet. Stir until thickened and add vanilla and oleo and pour in baked pie crust. Beat egg whites with 1/4 cup sugar for top of pie. Egg whites will beat better if you add a few grains of salt and pinch of baking powder.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet and cook onions garlic and pepper until tender. Add remaining ingredients in order listed stirring well after each addition.\tSimmer uncovered 45 to 60 minutes. Remove bay leaf.\tMeatballs can be added at this time and cooked for 30 minutes.\tSauce freezes well.

title: 14 Carat Cake
instructions: Mix flour baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon. Add sugar oil and eggs. Beat for 1 minute. Stir in carrots pineapple nuts and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream brown sugar shortening eggs and salt; alternately adding dry mixture and milk. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Jambolette
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and pepper. Add soup etc. Mix in casserole with noodles and cover with cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Miracle Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Eggplant
instructions: Peel and slice 2 large eggplants. Parboil in salted water. Drain and mash. Cut 4 strips of bacon into small pieces. Saute with onion. Add stewed tomatoes to bacon and onion. Crumble bread; mix all ingredients together. Add seasoning to taste. Pour into slightly greased casserole and bake 30 minutes in preheated 325\u00b0 oven. Serve hot.

title: German Rolls(Zwiebacks)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar. Mix . Let come to top then add to flour bacon grease and warm milk. Stir up good. Add flour and knead to stiffness. Let rise to top. Put on greased cookie sheet. Squeeze off lump of dough putting one on top of another. Space 1-inch apart. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes until brown.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: About 45 minutes before serving With sharp knife slice pork into thin and bite-size pieces. In small bowl combine cornstarch next 4 ingredients and 1/2 cup water; set aside.

title: Holiday Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale and sliced orange until juices are thawed. Add ginger ale and float orange slices. Add a few ice cubes if desired.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Take 1 package smoked beef; chop fine. Mix with other ingredients. Chop 2nd package of beef and roll cheese ball in this. Refrigerate.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Pumpkin Mixture Beat eggs well. Add sugar pumpkin lemon juice flour baking soda cinnamon and cloves; mix together. Pour into greased and floured 15 x 10 cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes (your oven may be less). Dust a dish towel and roll lengthwise like a jelly roll. Let rest then unroll. Cool approximately 2 minutes then re-roll in towel and let cool completely.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Mix together cooking oil sugar eggs and vanilla. In another bowl mix all dry ingredients including apples and pecans. Add first mixture to second mixture and stir. Pour into Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or toothpick test.

title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix first 5 ingredients together. Reserve 2 cups for topping. Add eggs buttermilk and baking soda; mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan or 2 round cake pans. Add cinnamon to reserved mix. Sprinkle on top. Bake 40 minutes in 9 x 13-inch or 25 minutes in round pans.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onions and pour off any excess grease. Add beans tomatoes and soup. Layer in a large casserole dish the soft tortillas then meat mixture then grated cheese. Do another 3 layers ending with a lot of cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly about 35 minutes. Feeds approximately 20 people.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: In pan put refried beans; spread. Add sour cream on top of this. Chop up tomatoes; put on top. Add salsa. Break up lettuce and put on top. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Susan Horton'S Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Boil water and pour over Jell-O. Stir and add berries and cranberry sauce. Add nuts. Pour into a 2-quart oiled ring mold and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Put broccoli in greased dish with chicken on top. Combine soup mayonnaise curry and lemon juice and pour over chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle cheese over top. Combine bread crumbs with butter and spread on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Carolina Peach Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. You will need pastry for 9-inch double crust.

title: One Hour Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water. Place the milk sugar butter and salt in a pan. Heat until lukewarm. Add yeast and flour; mix well. Place in a greased bowl and brush the top with melted butter. Let rise for 15 minutes. Turn out onto a floured board. Pat until 3/4-inch thick. Cut into rounds with a floured biscuit cutter. Fold the rolls over and press the edges together lightly. Place on a greased baking sheet. Let rise 15 minutes. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Brush with melted butter. Makes about 3 dozen rolls.

title: Braised Beef
instructions: Roll beef in flour. Brown in a skillet in a little shortening. Place in covered dish or roaster. Blend and add to meat the water bouillon cubes and flour. Dissolve bouillon cubes a little before adding to meat. Add no salt or pepper its in the cubes.

title: Homemade Salami
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate for 3 days mixing well each day. On the fourth day mix well and form into 5 rolls. Bake on rack over a pan for 11 hours at 140\u00b0 or 9 hours at 150\u00b0. Turn rolls every 2 hours; cool. Wrap and may be frozen.

title: Vegetable Pie
instructions: Grease baking dish. Mix vegetables and cheeses. Place in dish. Mix rest of ingredients and pour over top. Place a few pats of butter or oleo on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Baked Angel Food Delight
instructions: Mix pudding and Cool Whip. Pour between slices. Pour gel on top; let drip over sides. Add sliced strawberries to gel.

title: Diet Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into Pam-sprayed pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Pound Cake
instructions: Blend butter sugar and oil until fluffy. Blend 1 egg at a time thoroughly. Sift dry ingredients together. Blend a little dry ingredients with a little of milk until all gone. Beat thoroughly. Now mix vanilla and lemon. Pour into tube cake pan (lightly greased). Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain flake and remove bones and skin from salmon. Combine all except parsley and pecans. Chill several hours. Roll into roll. Mix parsley and nuts and roll salmon in mix. Chill well. Serve with favorite crackers.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Boil sugar butter syrup or molasses and salt for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add soda and flavoring. Stir well over corn. Place in 200\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Let cool and store in covered container. (I cook mine in large roasting pan.)

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9-inch pan; line with honey graham crackers. Mix pudding with the milk. Beat 2 minutes and fold in Cool Whip. Pour a layer of pudding over crackers. Add another layer of crackers then another layer of pudding. Top with a layer of crackers. Frost with Fudge Frosting. Refrigerate.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Combine flour sugar and nutmeg; add oleo and beat until creamy. Stir in eggs buttermilk and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes longer.

title: My Zoop
instructions: Mix soup with milk. Saute onion celery and pepper until tender and add to soup. Boil carrots until tender and add to soup. Saute pork chop and add to soup. Bring to simmer and serve. Top with Parmesan cheese and chives if desired. Serves 4 generously.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan stir together 1 cup sugar and cornstarch. Stir gradually. Stir in egg yolks; stir constantly. Put egg whites on top and brown.

title: Spinach And Artichoke Party Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and Ranch mix in medium bowl. Add artichokes spinach and pimentos. Cut slice off top of round loaf and hollow out leaving 1-inch shell. Reserve bread pieces for dipping. Spoon dip into bread. Serve warm or cold.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and flour. Stir in fruit cocktail juice and all. Bake in greased 13 x 9 x 2 in. pan for 30 to 40 minutes. Mix sugar margarine milk and flavoring and bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Pour over cake while still warm in baking dish.

title: Part Low Plantation Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with a fork. Place in a greased and floured pan. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down (crisscross design) with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli using package directions; drain. Stir in cheese until melted. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup cracker crumbs; mix well. Spoon into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining 1/2 cup cracker crumbs. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Bird Feeders
instructions: Mix ingredients together to make a putty consistency. Drill holes in logs. Pack mix in holes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk pepper and cheese in a saucepan over low heat until cheese is melted. Mix with green beans and 1/2 can French-fried onions. Put into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining onions; bake uncovered for 5 minutes more or until onions are golden.

title: Stove Top Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar milk cocoa and butter in medium pan. Cook on medium heat. Cook 3 minutes after boiling. Remove from heat. Add oats vanilla and peanut butter. Mix well. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of mixture onto wax paper. Remove when firm.

title: Quick And Easy Meal
instructions: Add onion to ground beef salt and pepper and brown meat. Add frozen mixed vegetables and enough water to cover mixture. Bring to boil then simmer with lid on until done 20 to 25 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Zucchini Patties
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Spoon into skillet with small amount of heated oil. Brown on both sides.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 325\u00b0 until firm and done.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs; add flour butter and cottage cheese. Pour in casserole dish. Layer veggies over mixture. Cover with the Velveeta cheese strips. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: 4 Layer Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt oleo and stir in flour and nuts. Pour into 10-inch pie plate and spread like a crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Stir together flour baking powder soda and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Set aside. In a mixer bowl beat sugar and shortening with electric mixer until light scraping sides of bowl often. Add eggs one at a time and the milk beating until smooth after each addition. Add flour mixture and banana alternately to creamed mixture beating until smooth after each addition. Fold in nuts. Turn batter into a lightly greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 60 to 65 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool.

title: Spring Garden Salad
instructions: You can add any other veggies you choose. The secret is to keep the pieces small.

title: Bacon Quiche
instructions: Bake pastry shells as directed on package and cool. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. In large bowl combine eggs sour cream Worcestershire and salt. Blend well. Stir in cheese bacon and onions. Divide mixture between 2 pie shells. Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut Blender Pie
instructions: Combine milk sugar biscuit mix eggs butter and vanilla in electric blender. Cover and blend on low speed for 3 minutes. Pour into greased 9 inch pie plate. Let stand about 5 minutes then sprinkle with coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve warm or cool.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Use a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Layer potatoes with other ingredients ending with Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Grandpa Carr'S Best Chili
instructions: In Dutch oven brown meat until red is all gone. Add onion and cook a couple of minutes. Scrape a place in the center and cook garlic (fresh) for about 1/2 minute then stir into meat mix. Add salt pepper chili powder cumin brown sugar hot sauce and tomatoes. Put cloves allspice and bay leaf into tea ball and place in mixture. Stir to mix well. Simmer stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. Add kidney beans and cook 30 minutes. Add oregano and cook 15 minutes. Add red wine if desired. Enjoy.

title: Shake And Bake
instructions: Mix together. Put in covered container in refrigerator. Makes 4 to 4 1/2 cups. Will cover about 5 pounds of chicken.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Combine chopped walnuts margarine and flour. Put in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Grease 13x9-inch baking dish. Brown meat and onions drain add next six ingredients. Simmer until liquid is evaporated. Pour 1/2 c. taco sauce into casserole dish. Put layer of tortillas add 1/2 c. taco sauce over tortillas. Spoon beef mixture over it then add a layer of refried beans. Top with sour cream sprinkle on half of the cheese add another layer of tortillas. Spread on remaining taco sauce and cheese. Cover with foil and bake in a 375\u00b0 preheated oven for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 5 minutes or until top is brown.

title: Corn Au Gratin
instructions: Mix corn and milk and bring to a boil. Separate corn from milk and return milk to fire. Make paste from margarine and flour adding the paste to milk to thicken. Simmer 5 minutes and add salt and sugar. Return corn to milk and bring back to a boil over low heat. Transfer creamed corn to casserole dish. Sprinkle evenly with Parmesan cheese. Dot top with melted margarine and brown under broiler. Makes 6 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except barbecue sauce. Shape into loaf. Put into crock-pot. Cook on low for 5 to 6 hours; 10 or 15 minutes before serving cover well with barbecue sauce.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender for a few minutes. (You can beat with a mixer instead.) Pour into a greased 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with coconut and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Caramel Sauce
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup 3 tablespoons butter and 1/2 cup cream in saucepan. Bring to boil; gradually add remaining cream and butter. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally just to soft ball stage. Remove from heat; add salt and vanilla extract. Serve warm. May be reheated.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Blend together with hand mixer liquid butter sugar Egg Beaters and vanilla. Alternate adding a little flour and then a little milk. Keep alternating until you have added all the flour and milk. Beat egg whites until stiff. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Stir in all but 1 teaspoon eggs then stir in jar of sauce. Pour into pan sprinkle with Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese. Top with crescent rolls. Brush the rolls with remaining eggs. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cottage Cheese Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in water. Heat cottage cheese 1/4 cup sugar and salt until warm not hot. Combine flour and soda in a large bowl. Add heated mixture and eggs. Knead until thoroughly mixed. Let rise until double. Punch down. Shape into 2-inch balls and place 1 inch apart in a greased pan. Let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Beef-Bean-Biscuit Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Mix beans barbecue sauce and brown sugar into beef. Place in casserole dish. Cut biscuits into half and place on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove and sprinkle cheese on top. Return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Quick Swiss Pie
instructions: Press rolls into 12-inch pizza pan or 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Brown meat and onion; drain. Mix in oregano and spread over crust. Beat cottage cheese eggs and seasonings. Spoon over meat. Top with green pepper tomato and cheese. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hamburger Meal In A Dish
instructions: Cook beef and onion in skillet until browned stirring to crumble beef. Stir in next 7 ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes. Pour into a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Combine cornmeal and flour; mix well. Add egg buttermilk and bacon drippings to cornmeal mixture. Mix well. Spoon cornmeal mixture evenly over meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: In large bowl combine all-purpose flour 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon; stir in peaches and toss to coat well. Set aside. Mix 1 cup sugar in self-rising flour. Add milk gradually until well blended. Add melted butter; stir. Pour 1/3 batter into baking dish. Place peaches on top. Spoon rest of batter on top of fruit. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can be topped with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Put green pepper slices onion slices steak cubes and garlic salt into large skillet with lid or electric skillet in a little oil. Cook 10 minutes slow with lid on. Add the rest of the ingredients except noodles. Cook covered until meat is done about 2 hours. When meat is almost done cook noodles according to directions on package. When noodles are done drain well. Serve meat and vegetable mixture over noodles.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground meat and onion. Melt cheese over low heat. Add sour cream soup and chilies. Soften 12 flour tortillas in oil. Place beef in each tortilla and roll up. Lay in baking dish. Pour sauce over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Honey-Almond Dip
instructions: Whisk ingredients together in a small bowl. Makes about 3/4 cup of dip.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Put both kinds of bread in large mixing bowl. Pour 1 cup water over bread and let soak for several minutes. Mash very fine with fork. Add the meat chopped onion parsley grated cheese slightly beaten egg salt and pepper. Mix and shape into loaf. Put lots of butter or margarine over top and bake 30 minutes. Pour tomato sauce over meat; sprinkle with oregano and continue baking 20 minutes longer.

title: Pork Chop Bake
instructions: Lightly grease baking dish large enough to hold pork chops (approximately 7 x 11-inch or 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch). Put apples in bottom of baking dish. Mix sugar flour and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples. Place chops on top. Bake uncovered about 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Do not overcook.

title: Marsha'S Beef Burgundy
instructions: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes; flour and brown in butter or margarine. Add wine consomme salt and pepper bay leaves parsley and sliced onions. Simmer 1 1/2 hours (can be held overnight). Add small onions and mushrooms. Simmer 1/2 to 1 1/2 hours longer. Serve with rice. Meat may be treated with meat tenderizer if desired. Serves 8.

title: Weight Watchers Orange Salad
instructions: Sprinkle Jell-O over Cool Whip. Fold in. Add oranges and pineapple to cottage cheese. Fold Jell-O mixture into cottage cheese. Let set overnight to congeal.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Remove seeds and membrane from peppers. Combine peppers and onion in food processor. Sprinkle with salt (draws out liquid and bitterness). Let stand 3 hours. Drain well. Discard liquid. Add vinegar and sugar to pulp. Also add a couple drops of food coloring (optional). Simmer until thick as for jam 30 to 40 minutes. Add pectin if needed. Sterilize jars; fill with warm jelly. Let cool. Seal with wax. Good served on crackers.

title: Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Cut each breast into 8 nuggets about 1 1/2 square inches. Combine bread crumbs cheese Accent salt and basil. Dip nuggets in melted butter then in crumb mixture. Place in single layer on foil lined\tbaking\tsheet.\tBake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Muddy Buddys
instructions: Pour Chex in a large bowl; set aside. Mix together (in a saucepan) the chocolate chips peanut butter margarine and vanilla; then heat until melts. Pour chocolate mixture over Chex cereal until well coated.

title: Vegetable Squares
instructions: Unroll and press on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake as directed (not too long). Cool completely. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise and Ranch dressing. Spread cream cheese mixture on cooled crescent rolls. Spread vegetables on top of mixture. Makes 1 cookie sheet full.

title: Creamy Peach Pie(Diabetic)
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water; stir in ice cream until melted. Add whipped topping and mix well. Fold in peaches. Pour in pastry shell. Chill until firm.

title: Eezey Lime Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and water. Let cool. Add ice cream cherries pineapple and walnuts and pour in mold or dish.

title: Peanut Butter And Butterscotch Bits
instructions: Melt together the peanut butter and butterscotch bits over low heat. Stir in the cereal and drop in spoonfuls on a cookie sheet. Let cool in refrigerator.

title: No Crust Pizza
instructions: Drain mushrooms; reserve liquid. Add water to equal 1/3 cup liquid. Combine the liquid egg crumbs oregano 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper; let stand 5 minutes. Add beef; mix well. Pat beef mixture into 9-inch pie plate to form crust. Cut cheese into 8 triangles; layer half atop beef mixture. Top with pizza sauce mushrooms onions and green pepper. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Top with remaining cheese; bake 5 minutes. Remove to serving platter using 2 spatulas. Makes 8 servings.

title: Baked Beans (Easy)
instructions: Combine ingredients and simmer for 8 hours. Fry bacon strips and add to baked beans 1/2 hour before cooking time is ended.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix blueberries and sugar and set aside. Mix condensed milk and lemon juice. Add Cool Whip and chopped pecans. Fold in berries. Pour into crust. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours and serve.

title: Gourmet Chicken Bake
instructions: Place chicken breasts in greased baking dish. Cover chicken pieces with Swiss cheese. Mix soup and milk and spread over cheese. Mix butter and Pepperidge Farm dressing and spread over soup. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: 3 Hour Beef
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in roaster pan and cook covered at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serve over noodles rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Strawberry Creamsicle
instructions: Mix in blender with ice or ice cream.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Make sure broccoli is well drained. A salad spinner works great. Mix broccoli with onion bacon sunflower seeds and raisins. Let stand in refrigerator for 2 hours. Mix Miracle Whip sugar and vinegar together; add to broccoli mixture and chill.

title: Strawberry Frozen
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and sugar together. Add strawberries pineapple Cool Whip bananas and walnuts. Mix all together. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze overnight. Leave set a few minutes before cutting. Tastes like ice cream.

title: Egg And Sausage Dish
instructions: Prepare overnight. Combine eggs 2 1/2 cups milk and mustard. Layer bread cheese and sausage in greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour egg mixture over all. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and powdered sugar until crumbly. Mix in bowl vanilla pudding milk and Cool Whip. Put layer of crumbs in crust; reserve small amount for topping. Layer pudding mix over crumbs. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with reserved crumb mix.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Lightly butter a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Line with wax paper; lightly butter wax paper. In a heavy 3-quart saucepan cook the brown sugar granulated sugar and cream over low heat stirring constantly with wooden spoon until the sugar dissolves and the mixture comes to boiling. Cook stirring occasionally until candy thermometer registers 234\u00b0 or until a little in cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat. Add butter; set aside without stirring to cool to lukewarm (110\u00b0). Add vanilla and peanut butter. With wooden spoon beat until thick and creamy. Stir in nuts. Quickly turn into prepared pan; cool completely. Refrigerate. Turn out of pan in one piece. Remove waxed paper. With sharp knife cut into pieces. Makes about 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Swiss Fondue
instructions: Rub inside of fondue pot or saucepan with cut edge of garlic then discard. In fondue pot simmer wine. Blend in soup. Combine cheese and cornstarch stir into soup mixture. Heat until cheese melts; stir now and then. Spear bread with fondue forks and dip into fondue. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Using a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole alternate layers of sliced potatoes and onion until desired amount. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add mushroom soup and milk. Top with cheese and cracker crumbs. Bake for approximately 1 hour. This is a quick and delicious dish to serve with any meat. Usually served with meat loaf or steak.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and set aside. In a large bowl at medium speed cream butter oil and both sugars until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla continue beating. Add dry ingredients and stir until mixed. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Shape dough in 1-inch balls roll in sugar and place on a greased cookie sheet. Press each cookie with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until very light brown.

title: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small bowl combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; set aside. In a large bowl combine sugar butter and vanilla. Beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually blend in flour mixture alternately with milk. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch round cake pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes. Remove from pans; cool completely.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Steam vegetables until just tender-crisp (approximately 5 minutes for carrots and broccoli and 3 minutes for zucchini). Place in large bowl. Add macaroni and onions and toss gently. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise yogurt Parmesan cheese olive oil pepper basil oregano and garlic powder. Add vegetable mixture. Toss gently until well mixed. Chill. Serves 8.

title: Marybeth'S Dirt
instructions: Cream together the margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Then stir in the pudding milk and Cool Whip. Put one layer of crushed cookies on bottom of dish. Spread layer of creamed mixture on top then alternately layer cookies and creamed mixture ending with cookies on top.

title: Schooner Chocolate Chips
instructions: Chop all the nuts and mix together. Cream butter sugar vanilla Tia Maria and Frangelico until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Gradually beat into creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 10 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly; remove and serve. Dont overbake. Makes 6 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Tomato Dill Pasta
instructions: Drain off some of the juice from the tomatoes. Mix all ingredients except the noodles in a large bowl. Marinate at room temperature at least 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti and drain. Add hot pasta to sauce and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Summer Squash Delight
