instructions: Saute vegetables in butter for 3 minutes. Add seasonings cover and simmer until tender. Remove lid from sauce pan sprinkle with cheese return lid and turn off heat. Allow cheese to melt. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cherry Crisscross Square
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo; add salt cinnamon and flour. Work together as for pie dough pastry. Add sour cream and baking soda mixture and add egg yolks. Make a soft dough. Spread in bottom of a cookie sheet pan leaving enough dough for crisscross topping. Brush top with egg beaten. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Debone and chop. Add chopped eggs pickles and celery. Add mayonnaise to desired spreading consistency. Spread on favorite bread and top with olive.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine margarine and sugar until creamy. Add egg. Mix these ingredients with flour baking powder soda vanilla and milk. Roll out 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick. Cut with cookie cutters. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Frost if desired.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Mix and put in large bowl coated with corn oil; turn dough to coat with oil. Cover with damp cloth. Let set for 12 hours. Punch down dough. Let stand 15 minutes. Divide dough into 3 parts. Knead each part for 30 seconds or so. Place into 3 sprayed with Pam loaf pans. Cover with damp cloth; let set for 12 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. After turning your bread from pans while warm spread butter over the top of your bread.

title: Tortilla Tucks
instructions: Spread each tortilla with a layer of cream cheese. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese salsa green onions olives and avocado layer. Roll up as tightly as possible and place seam side down in a flat dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 8 to 24 hours. To serve slice in 1 inch rounds.

title: Black Forest Trifle
instructions: Cook pudding according to package directions but add the egg yolks. Set aside to cool completely. Cut cake into 1-inch cubes (may not need the whole cake). Using a large deep bowl layer cake sprinkle pineapple juice chocolate pudding pie filling and Cool Whip using about 1/3 of the amounts for each layer. Continue layering until bowl is full but ending with Cool Whip. Garnish with chocolate curls or chips or cherries. Refrigerate until served. (Best chilled overnight.) Spoon into dessert dishes.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs powdered sugar and melted margarine until thoroughly mixed together. Press into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill 1 hour. Melt peanut butter and chocolate chips together in pan or microwave. Spread over crust and chill. Keep refrigerated.

title: Raisin Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Blend in milk spices vinegar nuts and vanilla. Boil raisins in enough water to cover them for approximately 5 minutes. Drain and add to pie mixture. Pour into pie shell. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until pie is firm. Top with whipped cream if desired.

title: Kanelkakor(Swedish Cinnamon Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg and almond extract. Add flour mixed with baking powder and cinnamon. Blend well. Shape dough into 4 logs. Place on Teflon cookie sheets (17 x 14-inch). Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with chopped almonds. Bake 15 to 18 minutes. Let cool for 15 minutes and cut into diagonal 1-inch pieces (sprinkle with chopped almonds) and return to oven. Turn oven off and leave to dry and cool.

title: Festive Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix and chill. May be shaped* and decorated with green pepper olives etc. for serving. Serve with crackers.

title: Form A Circle Chicken
instructions: Saute green onions mushrooms and garlic in the butter. Remove from pan or use a separate skillet. Debone chicken breasts and put a slice of Monterey Jack cheese on top. Roll up both halves. In a 5-quart Dutch oven spread 1 can of soup on the bottom. Put the breast halves in the middle and use the rest of the chicken parts to form a circle around the breasts. Top other pieces of chicken with a slice of cheese and top with the mushroom sauce. Carefully spread the last can of soup over the top. Put on lid and bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with a baked potato French bread and green salad.

title: Brandied Chocolate Fondue
instructions: Combine chocolate and water in small saucepan; cook over low heat stirring often until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth. Add whipping cream and remaining ingredients stirring until well blended. Serve warm with fresh strawberries. Yields 2/3 cup.

title: Filled Cookies
instructions: Mix thoroughly margarine brown sugar and eggs. Stir in water and vanilla. Then add remaining ingredients but pie filling. Drop by teaspoon on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Make a hole in the center of cookie and put in a little bit of pie filling. Can be made without pie filling.

title: Pink Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well together. Refrigerate overnight. Next morning let stand 30 minutes. Put crumbled potato chips over top and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 12 people.

title: Raisin Cream Pie
instructions: Soak the raisins overnight in hot water. Drain. Blend sugar flour milk and salt. Add 3 egg yolks and raisins and cook until creamy. Pour into baked pie crust and cover with meringue. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Season stew cool and shred chuck roast. Dice and brown onion. Add rest of ingredients. Cook 10 to 15 minutes. Add shredded beef. Mix well. Serve on toasted buns. Serves 12.

title: Cheesy Apple Pie
instructions: In one bowl combine first 5 ingredients. In another bowl combine next 5 ingredients; set aside. For cheesy pastry shell combine and mix with pastry blender the rest of ingredients except cold water. Sprinkle water (3 to 4 tablespoons) over dry ingredients. Roll into pie crust for a 9-inch shell. Put apple mixture in shell then sprinkle cheese mixture over that. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then lower to 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes longer.

title: Posey Chow-Chow
instructions: Use spices to taste cloves turmeric and allspice.

title: Cheese Grits
instructions: Prepare grits as on package. Add butter and cheese to hot grits. Crack 2 eggs into measuring cup. Fill with half and half to make 1 cup. Beat mixture. Combine with grits. Pour into greased casserole. Cover with crushed cereal or bread crumbs tossed with melted butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Foil Wrapped Dinner
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut meat into 1-inch pieces. Place frozen peas in colander or sieve. Run cold water over peas just until broken apart. Drain.

title: Pretty Pumpkin 4-Layer Torte
instructions: Mix cake mix pumpkin soda eggs and water together. Bake in 2 circular cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and split each half to make 4 layers.

title: Brownies
instructions: Grease an 8-inch pan and line with wax paper. Melt together unsweetened chocolate and shortening. Beat eggs well and add sugar gradually. Beat in chocolate mixture and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and salt. Add chopped nuts if desired. Spread in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. (Dont overbake if you like them \chewy\.) Invert pan on cake rack and cool. Peel off wax paper.

title: Quiche Florentine
instructions: In large bowl combine ingredients. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan greased and floured. Over top of cake mix sprinkle chopped rhubarb. Sprinkle sugar over rhubarb and pour 1 pint whipping cream over top of sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until done. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa margarine and milk in a saucepan. Stirring constantly bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Add peanut butter and rolled oats and stir well. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper.

title: Turkey Chili
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in hot oil until onion is soft; stir in turkey. Cook until no longer pink. Add tomatoes soy sauce garlic and chili powder. Stir to combine. Cover and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in beans; simmer uncovered 15 minutes more. Serve over rice if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: South Of The Border Dip
instructions: In large skillet saute onions in margarine. Reduce heat to low. Add remaining ingredients; stir slowly until process cheese spread is melted. Serve hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine and put in a buttered casserole dish (long pan).

title: Georgia Caviar
instructions: Peel outer skin off large Vidalia onion. Cut onion from top into 8 to 16 sections being sure not to cut all the way through root end.

title: Avocado Salad
instructions: Cut the avocado into halves or in slices. Alternate slices of orange or pineapple with avocado. Plain lemon juice may be squeezed on avocado. Serve with French dressing or with thin mayonnaise.

title: Loaf Cake(Eggless And Butterless)
instructions: Cook raisins in 2 cups water. When done add cold water to remaining ingredients. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Savory Chicken Or Turkey Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cream cheese and 5 teaspoons margarine. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Separate crescent dough into 4 squares or rectangles and seal perforations. Spoon 1/2 cup of meat mixture onto center of each rectangle. Pull 4 corners of dough to top and seal. Brush with the 3 teaspoons margarine and dip into the crouton crumbs. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 4 servings.

title: Beet Salad
instructions: Drain juice off beets. Stir beets into Cool Whip and chill.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) layer cake pans. Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside. In large bowl with mixer at high speed beat next 3 ingredients. At low speed beat in mayonnaise. Add flour mixture alternately with water. Pour into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together and set aside. Fry noodles in hot oil (only takes seconds) a little at a time (noodles will puff up). Cut up chicken in thin strips. Cut up lettuce in strips. Mix chicken and lettuce well. Pour mixture over all and mix.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Chop onions and brown until golden in butter. Cut zucchini in chunks and stir into onions. In another pot boil broth. Add broth to onions and zucchini. Add vinegar and dill to zucchini broth and bring to a boil. Sprinkle in farina and lower heat. Simmer 20 minutes covered. Add a little water if too thick. Put soup in blender and mix until creamy. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Cherry Fizz
instructions: Combine cherry preserves and water. Pour cherry mixture into 2 tall glasses. Add scoops of cherry nut/or vanilla ice cream. Slowly pour carbonated beverage down sides of glasses. Makes 2 servings.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Pour into 8-inch skillet or pan of your choice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix milk and cereal together and let stand for 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Combine and spoon into muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Bubba'S Beef Brisket
instructions: Place brisket in a baking dish. Combine all ingredients except barbecue sauce and pour over brisket. Cover pan tightly. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 5 hours. Top with desired amount of barbecue sauce and bake an additional 15 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli in one can of chicken broth and set aside. Melt oleo and stir in flour in a soup pot. Add other 3 cans of chicken broth to oleo/flour and simmer until thickens. Add broccoli-broth mixture and evaporated milk. Add Cheez Whiz and melt.

title: Chick'N Chiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook onion and pepper in oil until tender. Remove from heat. Add chicken 1 cup cheese and chilies. Set aside. In pan combine soup sour cream and cumin; heat until warm. Do not boil. Stir 1 cup sauce into chicken mixture. Divide chicken mixture among tortillas. Roll up tortillas and place seam side down in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour remaining sauce over tortillas; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly.

title: Fajita Shish Kabob Marinade
instructions: Mix ingredients. Place meat in pan with high sides or large bowl covering with marinade. Refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours turning meat frequently. For moist meat cover grill with aluminum foil with holes punched at regular intervals. Buy skinless and tenderized skirt steak if possible. Makes 1 3/4 cups of marinade enough for 2 to 3 pounds of meat. With beer 2 1/4 cups enough for 4 to 5 pounds of meat.

title: White Chocolate Dip
instructions: Combine cornstarch sugar and water in a small saucepan; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat; add butter and white chocolate stirring until chocolate melts. Let cool. Serve with fresh fruit. Yield 1 cup.

title: Baked Beans - Different!
instructions: Cook bacon. Saute onion and garlic in bacon fat. Add sugar vinegar and mustard and cook for 15 minutes. Combine all ingredients in bean pot or baking dish. Bake 1 hour in 375\u00b0 oven covered. A sweet and delicious \different\ kind of baked beans dish.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco until light and creamy. Add eggs one at a time beating constantly. Add flour and salt and mix well. Add vanilla. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Boil for 3 minutes pineapple sugar and lemon juice. Set aside to cool. Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Cool until it starts to set. Add first mixture then add cheese pepper and pimento. Whip whipping cream and fold into mixture just as it begins to congeal. Let set.

title: Chocolate Oil Cake
instructions: Mix all in one bowl. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Filipino Puto Steamed Cupcakes
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into muffin tin. Steam for 8 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Sift together first 4 ingredients. Cream together next 3 ingredients. Blend sour cream and vanilla. Mix together last 3 ingredients. To the sugar and egg mixture alternately add the flour mixture and sour cream; mix until well blended. In a greased tube pan alternate layers of batter with the sugar/cinnamon/nut mixture ending with the latter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oleo in a large pot until tender. Add tomato sauce and stewed tomatoes. Stir well. Add deboned chicken that has already been well seasoned with Tony Chachere. Also add sugar and blend into mixture in pot. Simmer on low heat for about 30 minutes. Boil spaghetti in separate pot according to directions. Mix cooked spaghetti in pot with the sauce and serve.

title: Creamy Fettuccine With Smoked Salmon
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. In medium skillet bring cream to a boil stirring frequently about 5 minutes. Cut salmon into 2-inch strips. Add to cream. Stir in dill. Drain pasta. Return to pan. Pour cream mixture over pasta. Toss well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serves 4.

title: Homemade Reese'S Cups
instructions: Mix peanut butter sugar and oleo. Shape into small balls. Melt paraffin with chocolate chips in top of double boiler. Dip each ball in chocolate using toothpick for dip sticks. Place on wax paper and chill.

title: Shrimp Muffins
instructions: Mix shrimp cheese butter mayonnaise and garlic salt until well blended. Spread on English muffin halves. Broil until brown; cut into halves or quarters to serve.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix crumbs and 1 stick margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat eggs and butter (room temperature). Cream powdered sugar and butter. Beat 5 minutes. Spread over graham cracker crust. Cut up bananas on top of butter mix. Sprinkle pineapple on top of bananas then top with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: Lou'S Crunchy Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and place in a greased casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs cheese margarine and bacon. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Burrito Pie
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot salad oil fry 1 tortilla at a time about 30 seconds on each side until lightly browned and blistered. With tongs remove tortillas to paper towels to drain. Discard any remaining oil.

title: Cajun Spicy Shrimp
instructions: In large skillet melt butter. Add wine and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Linda'S Refrigerator Hot Sauce
instructions: Drain all but 1 can of the tomatoes. Put in blender one can at a time. Be careful not to blend too long. Just process until tomatoes are fine cut/not mushy. Pour into large bowl. Add the onions to the tomato mixture. Add the Serrano peppers to the tomato mixture (will find these in produce section). Add the jalapenos to the mixture. Add the remaining ingredients. Stir all until well mixed. Spoon into containers 7 to 8 pint jars. Must refrigerate. This is not a \canned\ recipe.

title: Dorito Casserole
instructions: Stir crumble and cook hamburger meat until brown. Add cream of chicken soup cream of mushroom soup tomatoes green chilies and taco sauce. Mix over heat. Empty Doritos into casserole pan. Pour mixture over Doritos. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Reese'S Tassies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except peanut butter cups. Shape into 48 balls. Drop in greased tassie pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven and insert peanut butter cup in center. Cool 15 minutes. Remove from pans.

title: Dump Soup(Lo-Cal)
instructions: Heat oil. Brown onions and garlic. Add remaining vegetables. Fill pot halfway with water. Add seasonings. Top with crushed tomatoes. Cover and simmer on low 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Cook to desired tenderness.

title: * Chicken Soup *
instructions: Combine ingredients into saucepan and heat. This is a simple but hearty soup. You can also add other vegetables chopped onion or chopped green pepper. Season to taste. Serves 4.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cream the butter sugar eggs milk and vanilla. Mix in casserole dish with drained yams.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
instructions: Boil fryers; bone and cut up in small pieces. Save 1 quart broth. Strain broth. Cut up and mix in broth the pepper celery and onions. Cook until done in broth. Add pimento soup and spaghetti to mixture. Spread in pan one layer of chopped chicken layer of spaghetti mixture and layer of cheese; continue until mixture is used up. Bake for about 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Nuggets
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix peanut butter lemon juice and salt together. Gradually stir in milk. Add raisins. Drop from teaspoons onto greased baking sheets. Bake 10 minutes. Yields 36.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli slightly and drain. Mix with onion soup; add sour cream and cubed cheese. Turn into a casserole. Top with corn flakes. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spiceland Hen House Eggplant(In Honor Of Stallion, Nat'S Luck)
instructions: Peel and dice eggplant; cook in salted water until tender. Drain well and set aside. (It is really best to steam rather than to boil the eggplant.) Saute green onions red onions and celery in a skillet with small amount of cooking oil until transparent; set aside. Saute sausage in skillet until well done; remove to paper towels; set aside. Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions; set aside.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Pour juices off peaches and pineapple chunks bananas and peaches in large bowl and add pineapple chunks. Dissolve pudding mix in fruit juices and pour over fruit and nuts.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage together (chop fine). In a large bowl shred carrots and cabbage together. Add onions and mushrooms. Mix together and add 1/2 to 3/4 c. soy sauce. Add pepper to taste. Drain meat and add to cabbage mixture. Let set for at least 1 hour (no more than 24 hours).

title: Jack-O'-Lantern Cookies
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 packages cream cheese margarine granulated sugar and vanilla mixing until well blended. Add flour; mix well. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Japanese Mock Sukiyaki
instructions: Brown meat in 2 tablespoons oil. Add broth vegetables and sauce. Cover and\tsimmer\t10 minutes. Combine 1/4 cup water and cornstarch. Stir in sauce and serve over rice.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat slowly spoon off excess fat. Add next 5 ingredients. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook noodles in large amount boiling salted water until tender; drain. Combine remaining ingredients except Mozzarella cheese. Place half the noodles in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread with half the cottage cheese filling; add half the Mozzarella cheese then half the meat sauce. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting squares. Filling will set slightly.

title: Cobb Salad
instructions: Divide lettuce among 4 plates. Arrange chicken and remaining ingredients except Vinaigrette in rows over lettuce. Serve with Lemon Vinaigrette.

title: Lemon Pepper Veggies And Rice
instructions: Cook rice per package directions. When rice is almost done begin cooking the veggies. In large covered saucepan melt the butter; add the sliced bell pepper sliced squash and sliced onions. Sprinkle on the lemon pepper tossing to coat. Cover and cook over medium heat for five minutes. Uncover and check for tenderness. Stir; turn heat to low and continue to cook uncovered until veggies are done stirring occasionally. Pour rice in serving plate; add the veggies on top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Serve with garlic bread and any meat.

title: Eagle Brand Milk
instructions: Blend in blender until smooth and creamy. Makes 1 can of milk.

title: Refreshing Summer Jello
instructions: Mix boiling water and Jell-O. Add orange juice and stir. Mix in fruit. Top with miniature marshmallows.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle coconut and pecans in pan. Mix German chocolate cake according to box. Pour over pecans and coconut. Mix butter cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Pour over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Caramel Banana Pie
instructions: Place unopened can of milk in a pan with enough water to cover top of can. Bring water to boil and reduce to simmer. Simmer for 3 hours. Remove can from water. Cool and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mock Whipped Cream Icing
instructions: Beat all together about 10 to 12 minutes. Should be thick enough to spread. Do not cook.

title: Pineapple Lime Mold
instructions: Bring the water to a boil. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add remaining 1/2 cup water and juice. Gradually add gelatin to softened cream cheese mix until blended. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in pineapple marshmallows and nuts. Pour into 1-quart mold. Chill until firm. Unmold onto serving plate. Surround with lettuce.

title: Italian Cream Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk and beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in 1 cup coconut and 1/2 cup pecans. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into batter; pour mixture into 3 greased cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes; turn out onto wire racks and cool completely.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt bark. Stir in chocolate chips and blend in peanuts. Drop on waxed paper. Chill to harden.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: In skillet brown chicken in oil until all pieces are slightly browned. Remove from the oil and add 3/4 cup of flour. Stir until brown; add 1 cup of cold water. Transfer to a large pot; add the browned chicken and 3 quarts of hot water. Add the chopped onion salt and pepper. While this is cooking fry the okra in oil salted and peppered slightly. Add to the gumbo pot. Sprinkle in green onion tops. Simmer until chicken is tender. File may be added to taste. Serve in a bowl over a mound of rice.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken (boil or steam) and debone. Mix soup mayonnaise curry powder and lemon juice. While simmering cook broccoli. Put chicken in baking dish. Top with broccoli. Pour on the sauce. Top with cheese and bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Fluff
instructions: Combine all and spread over sweet potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Brown and drain sausage and put in pie crust. Add cheese. Mix well all other ingredients and pour over cheese and sausage. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes until pie is puffed in center.

title: Toffee Bars
instructions: Line cookie sheet with graham crackers. Melt butter. Add sugar. Boil 1 minute. Add pecans. Pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Add water and vinegar to egg. Mix flour sugar salt and shortening in a large bowl. Mix in egg mixture. Knead to a soft ball. Do not overmix. Cover and let chill 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Saute cloves of garlic (chopped) with red pepper in butter. Add garlic pepper and butter to drained pasta. Sprinkle thoroughly with Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately. Can be made in advance and warmed in microwave.

title: Fish Fillets Golden
instructions: Arrange fillets in a single layer ovenware dish. Sprinkle salt pepper onion tomatoes and mushrooms over fish. Dot with butter. Cover. Cook in microwave oven 4 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over fish mixture. Cook another 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Sprinkle lightly with paprika before serving. Total cooking time 6 to 7 minutes. Recipe yields 2 to 3 servings.

title: Clair'S French Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: In 5-quart Dutch oven brown meat in salad oil on medium-high heat turning frequently. Stir in undiluted onion soup garlic tomato paste water basil salt and pepper. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce to lowest heat and simmer 2 hours. Add vegetables and simmer for 2 hours. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Vary amount of ingredients for size of family.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Work together flour cheese and margarine. Add Rice Krispies to the pastry. Roll into small balls about large marble size. Press to flatten with tines of a fork. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen small biscuits.

title: Birthday Cake
instructions: Get some dough out. Make the dough. Put batter in the bowl. Make the cake. Put the bowl in the oven. When it is ready you take it out then you put frosting on the cake then you put candles on the cake and light them up. Then you sing Happy Birthday.

title: Country Spaghetti
instructions: Break sausage into small pieces and brown slowly in skillet. Add onion garlic and celery and saute until soft. Spoon off any excess drippings. Stir in tomato paste and tomato sauce; add water wine salt and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes or up to an hour to blend flavors well. Spoon over spaghetti. Sprinkle cheese on top. Makes four servings.

title: Spanish Dip
instructions: Brown meat and onion; add remaining ingredients and simmer. Put in pie plate and sprinkle 1/2 pound grated cheese. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove and top with sour cream and 1/2 pound cheese. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts. Serve with chips or soft tortillas.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and shape into balls. Brown in a skillet on all sides in hot oil (low to medium heat) until done. Use in spaghetti sauce stroganoff soup or meatball subs (any variety of uses). Can be cooled and frozen for later use.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Layer broccoli chicken and cheese in casserole. Mix together soup mayonnaise and seasoning. Pour over layered ingredients. Top with buttered crumbs. Heat in oven until bubbly and brown on top about 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Sift together cornmeal baking powder and salt. Blend in onion egg and milk. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towel.

title: Mother'S Oh And Ah Cake
instructions: Beat egg yolks and cream. Add sugar gradually and beat until thick. Dissolve chocolate in hot water; cool. Add to first mixture. Add flour sifted 3 times with salt and soda. Fold in egg whites. Bake in two greased 8-inch layer pans in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter sugar and add eggs. Add all other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 in loaf pan (greased) for 1 hour (3 small loaves about 40 minutes).

title: Frozen Pineapple Pie
instructions: Cook eggs sugar and juice until it thickens. Stir in Jell-O and dissolve and let cool. Whip one can Carnation milk and fold into mixture. Put in graham cracker crusts.

title: Grandma Lucinda'S Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed until creamy. Beat egg into creamed mixture. Combine flour salt and baking soda; mix into creamed mixture until just blended. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 3 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies. Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes. Remove to foil on countertop. Yields about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Bundt Pan Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside. In large bowl pour boiling water over shortening. Cool. Add eggs flour sugar salt and yeast. Refrigerate overnight. Next day roll out on floured surface. Cut in circles and dip each roll in melted oleo. Layer in Bundt or angel food cake pan. Let rise 2 1/2 hours. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Recipe will make 2 pans of bread. The dough will keep in refrigerator 3 to 4 days.

title: Veggie Cream Cheese
instructions: Use food processor for chopping vegies and squeeze well to get juice out. Mix together. Great with crackers and on a bagel.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Melt oleo in boiler. Stir in milk and vanilla flavoring. Add cocoa and powdered sugar stirring constantly. Cook until candy glazes or about 3 to 4 minutes. Add nuts. Pour into buttered dish. Cool and cut.

title: Winnie'S Pimento Cheese
instructions: Grate Velveeta cheese; add cream cheese and mix well. Mix in pimentos. Stir in Miracle Whip to desired consistency. Salt and pepper to taste (optional). Serve on crackers or sandwiches. Better when served at room temperature. Refrigerate.

title: Peachy Cinnamon Coffeecake
instructions: Drain peaches and reserve juice. Add water to juice to equal 3/4 cup. Chop peaches. Combine muffin mix egg and 3/4 cup juice. Fold in peaches. Pour batter into 9-inch square greased and floured pan. Knead swirl packet and squeeze contents on top of batter. Swirl with knife. Sprinkle topping over batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Orange Glazed Pork Chops
instructions: Cook together sugar cornstarch orange peel ginger juice and soy sauce until thick. Broil chops basting often with glaze.

title: Potato Croquettes
instructions: Mix potatoes cheese butter and salt. Shape into balls and dip into egg. Then add bread crumbs and deep fry until golden brown.

title: Mildred'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add boiling water. Cook in double boiler until mixture starts to thicken. Add eggs and chocolate. Cook until mixture becomes thick. Add vanilla; pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Apple Pancake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Add the apple slices to a 10-inch skillet with butter in it. Pour the batter over the center of apples (it wont cover all the apples or go to edges of skillet). Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. It should be golden brown and have reached the sides of the skillet. After its done place a plate over the skillet and turn the pancake out on the plate. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon and serve with maple syrup.

title: Freezer Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and fill freezer with mixture.

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Boil zucchini for 6 minutes. Drain. Add pineapple lemon juice and sugar. Stir and boil for 10 minutes. Add jello. Stir well. Place in jars and refrigerate. Makes 4 1/2 jars.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Mix wafers cocoa karo and rum well. Form into balls. Roll these in nuts and sugar. Keep in air tight container.

title: June Peas
instructions: Cook the peas lightly (about 15 minutes). Add onions lettuce and 1/3 cup of liquid in which the peas were cooked. Cream butter with flour; add to peas. Reheat to boiling stirring gently. Season to taste. A pinch of fresh or dried chervil may be added. Serves 4.

title: Cream Scones
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in mixing bowl; stir to blend. Cut in butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add egg and cream all at once and stir until all flour is dampened. Then mix until the dough forms a soft ball and pulls away from sides of bowl. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead 30 seconds. Roll 1/2-inch thick and cut into squares or triangles. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Brush tops lightly with egg white and sprinkle with a little sugar. Bake in hot oven (450\u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Elly'S Blueberry Crumb Cake
instructions: Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Sprinkle remaining 1 cup of crumbs on top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Finger Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients and shape in rolls about as long as your finger. Place on cookie sheet and place in refrigerator until they feel hard to the touch. Melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip fingers and chill. Store in airtight covered bowl or tin. Keep refrigerated.

title: Bub'S Lemon Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Gradually stir in water. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Stir in butter and lemon flavoring. Serve warm over bread pudding.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in a bowl. Form a well in the center. Add remaining ingredients\tand mix well.\tGrease and flour three 1 pound coffee cans. Fill 2/3 full or up to 3rd ring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot Cocoa
instructions: You can substitute brand names. Mix together thoroughly in a very large container. Put a 1/4 cup of mix to a cup or mug. Add boiling water.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except milk and butter. Scald milk and butter together and stir into mixture. Pour into greased 6 x 12-inch baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash. Save half of bread crumbs. Beat all other ingredients together with electric mixer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Sprinkle saved bread crumbs on top. Bake uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: Simmer chicken 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Steak Marinade Italiano
instructions: Combine all ingredients; use to marinate any steak for about an hour. Use marinade to baste beef while cooking. Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix rice with undiluted soups green pepper onion celery and pimento. Mix in bowl; then pour into pan. Place chicken on top and dab with butter salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Shrimp And Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients only until blended. Add finely grated carrot 1/2 red sweet pepper chopped cucumber chopped black olives chives or chopped onion. (Use vegetable ingredients to desired taste.) Add chopped fresh cooked and cooled shrimp.

title: Ice Cream Jello Mold
instructions: Melt ice cream completely before you are ready to use it. Add 1 cup boiling water to Jell-O; dissolve Jell-O. Then add pint of ice cream. After all ice cream is dissolved in Jell-O add the rest of the ingredients and mix them with a spoon. Then pour Jell-O into a mold and let it set overnight in refrigerator. Do not use metal mold.

title: Neiman'S Cookie
instructions: Blender Oatmeal Measure and blend in a blender to a fine powder.

title: Peppersteak
instructions: Cut beef into paper thin slices sprinkle with tenderizer according to package. Heat salad oil in a large skillet over high heat add the beef slices and cook until the red color dissappears. Add peppers scallions celery cook 3 to 5 minutes. Blend water with cornstarch; stir in remaining ingredients except the rice. Stir quickly into beef mixture. Stir constantly until slightly thickened and boiling. Serve with rice or canned Chinese fried noodles. Serves 6.

title: Special Apple Pie(Makes One 10-Inch Pie)
instructions: Combine flour sugar cinnamon and salt in medium bowl. Cut in butter using pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add water and toss mixture gently with fork until evenly moistened. Gather gently into ball. Transfer to lightly floured board and roll into circle slightly larger than a deep 10-inch pie plate. Ease pastry into pan and flute high edge. Set aside.

title: Duckie'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Mix in buttermilk vanilla and salt. Stir in coconut. Pour into 2 pie crusts not deep dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Quicker Pour wet ingredients into blender. Blend and add dry ingredients except coconut. Blend until thoroughly mixed. Stir in coconut by hand and bake as above.

title: Crock-Pot Swiss Steak
instructions: Dredge meat in flour. Brown in oil. Put meat and rest of ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low all day.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix and stir together in bowl until smooth. Pour into two greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes until toothpick comes out clean. Leave in pan and pour on glaze while warm.

title: Sesame Cheese Wafers
instructions: In small mixer bowl cream together cream cheese spread and butter. Sift together flour and paprika; stir in sesame seed. Blend flour mixture into cheese mixture. Form into 5-inch long roll 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Wrap and refrigerate (for up to one week).

title: Easy Dumplings
instructions: Mix soup and broth. Blend with a wire whip. Place over medium heat while preparing the dumplings. Mix baking mix and milk until soft dough forms. Drop by spoonfuls into boiling soup/broth mixture. Cook uncovered over low heat for 10 minutes. Cover and cook 10 minutes more. Makes 10 to 12 dumplings.

title: Grandma'S Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Set aside. Mix flour sugar and Crisco in large mixing bowl. Add yeast mixture and buttermilk. Make a soft dough. Store in refrigerator until needed. It is best to make out biscuits and let rise at room temperature for one hour before baking. If dough is too soft you may need to work in more flour. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 -15 minutes or until brown.

title: Tofu Italian Meatballs
instructions: Using hands squash mixture to blend thoroughly and shape into 1-inch balls. Set aside on plate. Fry balls in oil turning until browned on all sides. Remove and drain on paper towels. Can be baked instead of frying to cook.

title: Fresh Raspberry Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Add sugar mixture to berries; toss gently to coat fruit. Fill a pastry lined 9 inch pie plate with berry mixture; dot with butter or margarine. Adjust top crust. Seal and flute edge. Cover edge of pie with foil. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Remove foil; bake for 20 to 30 minutes more. Cool on a wire rack. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cheese Stuffed French Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut bread lengthwise. Mix butter thyme and Tabasco and spread on both insides of loaf. Lay onion on bottom slice and sprinkle with cheese. Top with other slice and wrap in foil. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook chicken (boil). Combine chicken green chilies green onion and salsa. Heat tortillas in oil until limp. Place 1/4 cup of chicken into corn tortillas. Place in pan seam side down.

title: Lima Bean And Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour. Remove from heat and add milk. Stir well. Return to heat and heat until thick. Mix remaining ingredients into the sauce mixture. Top with 2 cups bread crumbs and drizzle with 3 to 4 tablespoons melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Do not add seasoning. Follow directions on box; add corn and mushrooms. Bake in moderate oven for 1 hour.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Break romaine leaves in 2 or 3-inch widths. At last minute before serving place romaine in chilled salad bowl. Drizzle with Garlic Olive Oil then vinegar. Squeeze lemon over. Break in eggs. Season with salt and Worcestershire sauce. Sprinkle pepper over all. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Toss several times until every leaf is coated. Add croutons. Makes 6 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt in a mixing bowl. Make a hole in the center and put the eggs shortening buttermilk soda and vanilla in the hole. Mix together just as you would biscuits. Chill dough for about one hour.

title: Southern Corn Bread
instructions: Mix meal flour salt sugar and baking powder thoroughly. Add egg. Mix well with milk. Pour into greased hot pan. Cook at 450\u00b0 in preheated oven.

title: Broccoli Or Spinach Quiche
instructions: Saute in butter the onion and garlic until light brown. Preheat oven 6 minutes. Mix soup eggs and flour until well mixed and smooth. Put vegetable and cheese into pie crust. Pour mixture over vegetable and cheese. Bake 50 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Black Bean Parmesan Lasagna
instructions: Cook tomatoes and green onions in a saucepan (uncovered) for 10 minutes. Mash the tomatoes and add black beans and picante sauce. Cook 5 minutes; combine Cheddar Ricotta and Parmesan cheese. Spread a scoop of black bean sauce over bottom of a 10 x 6-inch pan. Put two noodles at the bottom of the pan; layer with 1/3 of cheese mix. Add two more noodles and continue layer ending with cheese mixture. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and green chilies cut in thin long strips.

title: Strawberries
instructions: Divide into 4 parts; let dry 10 minutes. Shape into strawberries; dip in milk and roll in red sugar crystals. Put stems in green cake color and place in strawberries.

title: Kielbasa And Potatoes
instructions: Slice kielbasa into bite size pieces. Add oil to frying pan heat. When hot add kielbasa. Drain potatoes and add to pan. Slice onion and pepper and add to pan. Add spices to taste fry until potatoes onion and pepper are softened. Serve hot.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large kettle. Cook for 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Put in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Winter Squash Supreme(Hubbard Or Butternut)
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and add salt and pepper to taste. Butter a 2-quart dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and add squash mixture. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot generously with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Amish Barbecue Pork Chops
instructions: Mix together. Pour over raw pork chops and bake in a covered dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Fresh Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all but coconut and cook in top double boiler until thick. Add coconut and pour into pie crust and cool until set and pie crust is done. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Bean Salad
instructions: Finely chop tomato and onion and add to well drained corn and drained and rinsed beans. Add oil vinegar salt pepper and garlic to taste.

title: Banana Freezer Pops
instructions: Peel bananas; break into chunks. Place in food processor or blender container. Add orange juice concentrate water honey and vanilla; process until smooth. Pour banana mixture evenly into cups. Cover top of each cup with small piece of aluminum foil. Insert wooden stick through center of foil into banana mixture. Place cups on tray; freeze until firm about 3 hours. To serve; remove foil; tear off paper cups (or slide out of plastic cups). Serves 8.

title: Rosamarina Noodle Dessert
instructions: Cook first 6 ingredients and stir constantly until thickens. Cool in refrigerator. Boil noodles and rinse in cold water. Drain. Mix with custard mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Jello Popcorn
instructions: Blend and stir oleo and marshmallows over medium heat until melted. Add dry jello. Pour over the warm popcorn until well coated.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix all ingredients; spread in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes until golden brown. Cut into pieces (about 2 x 1-inch). Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Apple Dapple
instructions: Blend eggs oil and sugar. Sift flour salt and soda. Mix apples nuts and vanilla. Bake in floured oblong pan 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven while hot. Pour on topping.

title: Easy Gooey Butter Bars
instructions: Mix egg pecans butter and cake mix together. Pour into the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Then mix powdered sugar cream cheese and eggs. Pour over cake mixture and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Kids Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook on medium-high heat. Stir often until mixture no longer sticks to spoon or pan. Cool slightly. Knead until smooth. Store in airtight container.

title: Summer Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain. Rinse with cold water to cool quickly and drain well. Mix remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add pasta and refrigerate several hours. Makes 8-10 servings.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Mix well together and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Light Fruitcake
instructions: Prepare 2 regular tube pans by lining with 1-3 thicknesses of well greased heavy brown paper. Add a layer of waxed paper. Chop candied fruits dates and nuts coarsely and mix together. Set aside. Cream butter and sugar add eggs almond vanilla and lemon extracts. Reserve 1-1/2 cups of flour. Sift remaining flour baking powder and salt together and add to creamed mixture alternately with whiskey and preserves. Mix well.\tDredge fruits and nuts with reserved flour and add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Pour into prepared pans packing well. Bake at 250 degrees until cake tests done approximately 3-4 hours of baking time. Cool and remove paper. Soak with apricot brandy or peach schnapps.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add liquids and mix until smooth. Add 1 can poppy seed and nuts; beat on medium for 2 minutes. Bake in loaf or sponge pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until tested done. Do not overbake.

title: Pecan Squares
instructions: Cream together the first 2 ingredients. Add the flour and salt and mix until crumbly. Press into a greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden about 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cereal Surprise
instructions: Mix all cereals and nuts together in a large bowl. Melt 2 pounds white chocolate in a double boiler and then pour over cereal mixture. Mix until all are coated with chocolate. Spread on waxed paper to cool. Break into pieces and store.

title: Chicken-Potato Soup
instructions: Place chicken in large pot. Salt and pepper; boil until chicken is done. Remove from broth; bone and place boned chicken back in broth. Add onion celery and potatoes. Cook until vegetables are done. Boil for 15 minutes at high temperature. This will give you a thick soup base.

title: Poor Man'S Fruitcake
instructions: Cook 1 cup raisins in 2 cups water until only 1 cup of water remains. Cream together 1 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons shortening. Add raisins and liquid. Sift together cinnamon nutmeg soda and flour. Add to raisin mixture. Bake in loaf pan until pick inserted comes out clean.

title: Candied Popcorn
instructions: Place popcorn in a large roasting pan. In a 3-quart saucepan combine remaining ingredients. Cook and stir over low heat just until mixture comes to a boil. Pour over popcorn and toss to coat. Cool. Store in an airtight container. Yields 6 quarts.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0.

title: Grandpa'S Candy
instructions: Do not stir while cooking. Cook to hard ball stage and pour in buttered pan. Cool and break apart.

title: Big Brownie Oatmeal Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets. Mix all ingredients until well blended. Cover and let stand 30 minutes for oats to absorb liquid. Drop in rounded tablespoons 1 1/2-inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until tops look crackled and satiny. Remove with spatula to a wire rack to cool. Makes 32 cookies (without nuts).

title: Country Ham Casserole
instructions: Heat Velveeta cheese milk and salad dressing over low heat. Stir until sauce is smooth. Add remaining ingredients mix well and pour into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until hot. Serves 6.

title: Carrot Pineapple Cake
instructions: Preheat conventional oven to 325\u00b0. In small bowl combine shredded carrots and pineapple; set aside. In a large bowl mix all the rest of the ingredients except walnuts. Mix well. Fold in carrots pineapple and 1 1/4 cups of the chopped nuts. Bake in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch cake pan for 40 to 45 minutes (test with toothpick). Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting (included in this cookbook) after it cools. Sprinkle top of cake with nuts.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix together lemonade milk and Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Chill at least 1 hour. (Can be made a day or two ahead and keeps well!)

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Brown pork well in oil. Add onion cover and simmer 20 minutes. (Always cook pork thoroughly.) Combine vinegar cornstarch salt ginger and pepper slices and add to pork. Bring to a boil cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add pineapple and heat a few more minutes. Serve with rice. Serves 4.

title: Ground Beef Loaf
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine beef onion salt pepper egg bread crumbs and paprika; mix well. Pack firmly into a greased baking dish. Top with sliced onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 30 to 40 minutes and uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes. Let stand for about 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli and drain. Arrange in an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with half the cheese. Top with ham. Season with pepper and spoon on rice. Prepare white sauce by melting margarine in saucepan over low heat. Stir in flour. Add milk and blend. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon juice. Gently fold in sour cream. Pour over ham. Sprinkle on remaining cheese. Bake in a preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli With Red Pepper And Shallots
instructions: Trim off leaves and tough ends of broccoli stalks. Cut broccoli into flowerets. Peel stalks then cut into 1 inch pieces. To cook broccoli heat 2 qt. lightly salted water in 3 qt. saucepan over high heat to a boil. Add broccoli and boil uncovered 3 to 5 minutes or until bright green and tender. Drain broccoli in colander. Rinse under cold water; drain thoroughly. Melt margarine in 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add bell pepper and shallots. Cook 3 minutes stirring occasionally. Add broccoli. Cook 4 to 6 minutes stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with salt and pepper; mix well. Garnish with almonds if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Put potatoes in a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix soup sour cream and cheese. Pour over potatoes. Cover top with cornflake crumbs. Pat with butter or margarine and bake immediately to avoid cornflakes getting soggy. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and brown.

title: Sunshine Chicken
instructions: In skillet brown chicken in shortening; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients except rice. Cover. Cook over low heat 45 minutes or until done. Stir occasionally. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: One-Dish Chicken Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix contents of stuffing mix pouch and 1 2/3 cups water. Set aside. Place chicken in 13 x 9-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole dish. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Spoon stuffing evenly over the chicken. Cook for 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Layered Green Salad
instructions: Put lettuce in bowl; add the next 5 ingredients one on top of another. Mix mayonnaise and sugar. Spread on top. Cover with grated cheese; cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Boiled eggs can be used instead of cheese.

title: Pepper Relish(Uncooked)
instructions: Chop the vegetables in the meat grinder using medium blade. Sprinkle with salt and allow to stand overnight. Drain. Add the sugar celery and mustard seed water and vinegar to cover to the chopped vegetables. Mix together then jar. Makes 4 pints.

title: Chicken-Pepper Pot
instructions: Cook chicken. Remove from bones. Dice onion and potatoes. Make pie dough enough for about 4 pies. Roll out and cut in squares. Make layers in pan of chicken broth. First potatoes onion chicken and dough. There should be 3 layers. Cook on medium heat until potatoes and dough are done about 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Serves 6 people. Add salt and pepper.

title: Ice Pickles
instructions: Put ice over sliced cucumbers and onions; let ice melt. Dip vegetables out of ice water and drain. Place in mixture of vinegar sugar and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute then can.

title: Fabulous Ham And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Grease 9 x 10-inch glass dish. Spread half of the bread cubes evenly in the dish. Add the ham and both cheeses then cover with remaining bread cubes. Mix eggs milk onion salt and mustard. Pour evenly over bread cubes and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mary'S Taco Casserole
instructions: Cook meat and onions; drain. Add salt garlic powder taco seasoning and water. Bring to boil and simmer 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in soup and sour cream. Bring to simmer. Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer chips. Top with mixture (one-half) then 1 cup cheese. Repeat! Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbling and cheese melted.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add celery and onion. Cook until tender. Add the rest of ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheesy Creamed Corn(Slow Cooker)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker; mix well. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Make a roux by browning flour in well heated oil. Lower heat and add water gradually. Add chopped onion garlic pepper and parsley. Cook 30 minutes. Add crab meat bay leaves Worcestershire salt pepper and Tabasco to taste. Cook 15 minutes. Add shrimp and oysters. Cook 5 minutes on high until oysters begin to curl. Cut heat and add file to thicken. If you cannot find file add thinly sliced young tender okra at the beginning for thickening.

title: Cranberry Ice
instructions: Wash cranberries thoroughly. Cut lemons in half; squeeze the juice from them into a bowl. Grate peel from an orange into bowl. Set aside. In a saucepan boil together the cranberries sugar and 2 cups of the cold water until the berries pop. Cool. Blend in blender until smooth. Add the lemon juice/orange peel and the remaining 2 cups of water. Blend again until thoroughly mixed. Pour mixture into a large container and freeze. Remove from freezer about 1 hour before serving. A great drink from Cranberry Country. Yield 10 cups.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put peaches in square pan. Mix flour sugar and milk. Spread over peaches. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tropical Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and peaches. Reserve juice. Drain mandarin oranges. Be sure fruit is well drained. Cook the vanilla pudding with 1 1/2 cups of juice. Chill. Add diced banana and apple to the fruit mixture. Add the fruit mixture to the pudding mixture. Chill.

title: Egg Brunch Casserole
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Break bread into small pieces. Cut cheese and put over bread then ham or other meat over cheese. Top with melted margarine. Beat eggs milk salt and mustard together. Pour over bread cheese and meat mixture. Chill overnight. Bake uncovered 1 hour or until firm at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain squash. Heat margarine and cream of chicken soup. Grate onion and carrot and combine with sour cream and stuffing. Add salt and pepper to taste. Mix both mixtures together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt pan or an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan or angel food pan. Mix cake mix and pudding together. Add eggs water and oil. Stir until moistened about 50 strokes. Fold in poppy seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl stir together graham cracker crumbs butter cocoa and 1/3 cup sugar. Press evenly onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. In large mixer bowl beat cream cheese and remaining 1 1/2 cups sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla beat just until combined. Stir in peanut butter chips; pour over prepared crust. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until slightly puffed and center is set except for 4-inch circle in center remove from pan. Cool 30 minutes. With knife loosen cheesecake from side of pan. Cool completely remove side of pan. Using tip of spoon drizzle Chocolate Drizzle across top of cheesecake. Refrigerate several hours before serving. Cover refrigerate leftover cheesecake.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash and cook cauliflower until just tender; drain. Place in a bowl and pour dressing over. Let marinate in refrigerator for 6 hours or overnight; drain well. Place cauliflower on serving plate; frost entire head with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with paprika. Use a spoon to serve. Pat cauliflower dry with paper towels before adding mayonnaise. It will frost better. Serves 4.

title: Judy'S Quick Orange Salad
instructions: Mix dry Jell-O with cottage cheese. Add drained oranges and pineapple. Add Cool Whip. Fold all together carefully until well mixed. Refrigerate a while before serving.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all together in punch bowl. Garnish as desired.

title: Apple Crisp Delight
instructions: Place apples in greased 2-quart baking dish. Blend together the remaining ingredients. Work until crumbly then pack closely over the apples. If the apples are very dry a little water may be placed in the bottom of baking dish. Bake approximately 50 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Serve warm with whipped topping.

title: Chunky Potato Soup
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes. Bring water to a boil in large saucepan. Add potatoes and cook until tender. Drain reserving 1 cup of the liquid. Set aside potatoes and the liquid.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix Cool Whip lemonade and Eagle Brand milk together. Pour into crust and chill.

title: Marinated Carrot Salad
instructions: Boil carrots to barely done. Blend tomato sauce salt pepper sugar vinegar salad oil Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Layer carrots onion and pepper and pour sauce over. Marinate at least 24 hours. Lasts forever!

title: Chicken In Crescent Rolls
instructions: Blend cream cheese and melted oleo until smooth. Add chicken salt pepper milk onion and pimento. Mix well.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Toss bread cubes into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat eggs milk salt and pepper together. Pour over bread cubes. Mix cheese and sausage into the entire mixture. Refrigerate covered overnight. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Beyond The Grave Chicken Salad
instructions: In a large pot bring water and seasonings to a boil; add chicken. Lower heat and simmer 40 minutes. Remove from heat; cool. Shred chicken and refrigerate.

title: Belle Miller'S Lemon Sauce
instructions: Boil all ingredients until slightly thickened.

title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat pumpkin milk and eggs in bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 and finish baking.

title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Combine flour garlic powder and paprika. Dip chicken into egg mixture then into flour mixture. In a skillet brown chicken in butter or margarine. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water. Add bouillon broth and the 2 remaining tablespoons of lemon juice to skillet. Cover skillet and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serves 4.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook sausage over low heat 5 to 8 minutes. Add onion green pepper and garlic; saute until tender. Drain if needed. Add beans tomatoes and seasonings; simmer uncovered 20 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Asparagus Mold
instructions: Heat soup to a boil; add jello and stir until dissolved. Add cream cheese; mix or beat until melted. Add mayonnaise and water; stir until blended. Stir in rest of ingredients. Pour in mold and chill.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix ingredients in large container. Use about 3 tablespoons mix to 1 cup boiling water per serving.

title: Cheese Delight-Broiled Sandwiches
instructions: Beat cheese sauce and salad oil in mixer at lowest speed. (It will splatter!) Use cheese at room temperature. Cut up onion eggs and olives. Blend with mixer into mixture. Pile on sourdough or French bread and broil until brown.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter or margarine. Press firmly into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger; add mushrooms soup and seasonings. Cook noodles as stated on package. Simmer hamburger mixture for about 15 to 30 minutes. Add sour cream 10 minutes before serving. Serve over noodles.

title: Chicken Breasts Florentine
instructions: Boil spinach until tender. Drain and squeeze until most of water is out.

title: Country Meatball Ragout
instructions: Mix thoroughly beef bread crumbs egg onion salt and dash of pepper. Shape firmly into 24 meatballs.

title: Crock-Pot Swiss Steak
instructions: Add steak green pepper onion tomatoes sauce and water to crock-pot. Add salt/pepper to taste. Cook on high 8 to 10 hours until steak is very tender. Excellent served over white rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Shrimp Noel
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute mushrooms green pepper onion and celery in butter or margarine until tender but not darkened. Add pimento and tomatoes and stir in chili powder cumin and black pepper. Mix in cooked rice and shrimp. Add salt to taste and adjust other seasonings as desired. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and drizzle with melted butter or margarine. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Almond Vanilla Pies
instructions: Beat together 1/2 cup sugar 1 tablespoon flour syrup vanilla egg and water. Then mix in a separate bowl rest of ingredients. These will be your crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.

title: French Fried Potato Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Dot with oleo sprinkle onion parsley salt and pepper on potatoes. Combine soup and milk; stir to mix and pour over all. Top with cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Brandied Steak Mushrooms
instructions: In a large skillet saute the mushrooms in the butter until brown. Sprinkle with the seasoning salt. Add Worcestershire sauce and simmer until almost all of the sauce is absorbed. Add the brandy and continue to simmer until the mushrooms are tender. Great with steak or roast.

title: Mexican Pizzas(Hors D'Oeuvres)
instructions: Split muffins and place on cookie sheet. Blend mayonnaise and mustard and spread over muffins. Distribute peppers pepperoni and cheese over that. Cut each muffin half into 4 sections. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until bubbly (10 to 15 minutes). Serve hot. Makes 48 pieces.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine milk sugar and salt. Heat to boiling 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add marshmallows chocolate chips vanilla and chopped nuts. Mix well. Pour into buttered pan and let cool.

title: Deviled Eggs(For 6 Eggs, 12 Halves)
instructions: Cut hard-boiled eggs in half. Mix all ingredients in bowl with egg yolks. Fill mixture into egg white. Put a dash of paprika on each half.

title: Artie'S Barbecue Sauce(Spoon This On Any Meat After It'S Cooked)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large saucepan over medium heat. Saute the onions bell peppers and parsley until onions are clear. Add the wine vinegar tomato sauce hot sauce or cayenne pepper garlic honey and lemon juice. Mix well. Cover pot. Turn heat down to low and simmer 1 hour. Add salt Worcestershire sauce and liquid smoke; stir well. Cover and simmer at least 2 more hours stirring occasionally.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix with spatula. We use as salad dressing for dip and baked potato.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Put sugar in bowl. Add oil and cream together. Beat eggs good. Add them and warm applesauce. Sift 3 cups flour salt soda and spices together. Beat in 1 cup flour over nuts and raisins and mix well. Pour in well-greased and floured pan. Bake at 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Test as some ovens are hotter than others.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles as package directs; drain. In skillet brown ground beef and drain; add salt pepper and spaghetti sauce and stir well. Combine cottage cheese with sour cream. Arrange half of noodles in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish; cover with half of meat-sauce mixture then a layer of cheese slices then all of the cottage cheese mixture. Top with remaining noodles. Cut remaining Mozzarella or pizza cheese slices in 1/2-inch strips; lay cheese strips \lattice fashion\ across top of noodles in casserole. Then spoon rest of meat-sauce mixture into lattice spaces. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: In another bowl mix butter and Ritz crackers. Layer butter and Ritz mixture on top of cheese mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bert'S Tex Mex Hot Dog Topping
instructions: Brown onions in a small amount of oil; set aside. Cook ground beef until in chunky crumbled pieces; pour off fat!! In a crock-pot add all remaining ingredients. Mix well; cook 2 hours. Add more \hot\ if desired. Serve over grilled hot dogs. Great for a casual gathering football tailgate or summer picnic.

title: Irish Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes and onion until tender. Drain. Add salt and pepper. Mix sour cream cottage cheese sharp cheese and butter. Mix all together; put in casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cover last 10 minutes with layer of Cheddar cheese.

title: Ambrosia Cake
instructions: Put in mixing bowl the cake mix eggs oil and oranges with juice. Mix according to directions on box. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool and frost with Cool Whip pineapple and juice pudding and coconut. Mix with rotary beater or wire whip.

title: Almond Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ham stirring until blended. Spread 1 tablespoon of mixture on each slice of ham; roll up jellyroll fashion. Wrap in plastic wrap. Freeze up to one month. Thaw at room temperature for 1 hour before serving. Cut rolls into 3/4-inch slices. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix cooked and cooled spaghetti with vegetables. Add Salad Supreme and salad dressing to taste.

title: Cookie Monster'S Fry Dough
instructions: Let frozen bread dough rise according to package directions. Pat out dough and cut with cookie cutters. Place in electric skillet with heated oil. Fry until brown on one side; turn over and brown. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

title: Lime Pickles
instructions: Stir lime in water then put cucumbers in to soak for 24 hours. Then remove and wash until all grit is gone. Tie spices in cloth and put in jar. Add cucumbers vinegar sugar and salt. Soak overnight. Next day boil for 15 minutes. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Mix flour salt and paprika. Shake each chicken piece in flour mixture to coat. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with aluminum foil for fuss-free clean up. Melt margarine in pan. Place chicken pieces in melted margarine turning to coat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn chicken and cover with barbecue sauce and continue baking for 30 minutes. Serve chicken and throw away the foil. Serves 4.

title: Poppy Cheese Spread
instructions: In medium mixing bowl thoroughly combine cream cheese and cheese spread. Add dry Italian dressing mix and stir to evenly blend. Put in covered container and chill.

title: Green Pasta With White Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute garlic and onion in oil for a minute or two. Stir in flour and juice drained from minced clams. Add milk sherry parsley and pepper. Stir until sauce thickens. Mix in clams. Cook pasta according to directions. Spoon sauce over pasta and serve.

title: Fresh Cranberry Apple Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and cool. Stir in orange juice and chill until mixture is syrupy. While gelatin is cooling run cranberries and orange through food chopper using fine blade. Cut one cored but unpeeled apple into small bite size pieces. Add nuts and sugar. Combine with cranberry mixture and fold into slightly thickened gelatin. Core and slice remaining apple; brush slices with lemon juice and edge mold with them. Spoon gelatin into a one-quart star-shaped mold or six individual molds. Chill until firm in the fridge. Unmold on platter lined with salad greens. Serve with cream cheese mayonnaise or cinnamon-spiced whipped cream. Serves 8.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Pie Filling
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch well. Add water and cook stirring constantly until clear and thick. Add small amount to beaten egg yolks then add to kettle and continue cooking until egg yolks are cooked. Remove from heat add lemon juice rind and margarine. Cool and top with meringue

title: Herb-Crusted Roast Beef
instructions: Place meat in oven roasting pan. In saucepan heat oil. Add garlic and saute a couple of minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Cream softened cream cheese. Add Cheddar cheese and mix. Add ham and mix. Add remaining ingredients in order mixing well. Store in covered container in refrigerator. Freezes well.

title: Broccoli Cz Soup
instructions: Saute onions carrots potatoes celery and broccoli. Put broth in large pot. Gradually add milk and flour. Combine veggies with broth.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix well and pack into 9 x 12-inch container or cake pan. Melt 1 large package chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons margarine. Spread over top. Refrigerate. Cut into bars.

title: Easy London Broil(Heart Healthy)
instructions: The day before serving Trim fat from steak and place in plastic storage bag. Add salad dressing. Close bag securely. Turn bag to distribute dressing over entire surface of meat. Place on plate and refrigerate.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Skillet Pasta
instructions: Brown chopped sausage in skillet. Add onions and garlic. Cook until soft. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook until pasta is tender.

title: Chili Bean Dip
instructions: Place drained beans vinegar chili powder and cumin in blender. Blend until smooth. Remove mixture from blender. Stir in onion and parsley. Serve with raw vegetables sticks.

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat butter in rectangular pan in a 425\u00b0 oven until melted. Mix flour and all spices together. Coat chicken with flour mixture. Place skin side down in pan. Bake uncovered about 30 minutes. Turn chicken over. Bake another 30 minutes or until done.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into a ball; roll in pecans. Refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak bread in the milk for 30 minutes. Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into an unbaked 9-inch pastry pie shell and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool and top it with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Cut peeled potatoes into 1/4 or 1/2-inch cubes. Puree 2 cups of potatoes and stock in processor until smooth. Melt butter in pan. Add flour. Cook until light brown. Add onion and cook until transparent. Reduce heat to low. Slowly add puree mixture stir constantly. Add remaining potatoes and spices. Cream and cook 30 minutes very slow stir often. Top servings with cheese or onions or bacon or all.

title: Corn Casserole(Servings:  10)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and pour into large casserole (9 x 13-inch). If it seems too dry add a little more milk. Bake 45 to 50 minutes (until cooked in center).

title: Mince Curry With Peas(Ground Beef)
instructions: Heat oil and cook onions until transparent. Add tomatoes; cook 10 minutes. Add all spices and simmer for 15 minutes. Crumble beef into sauce stirring. Cook covered for 20 minutes. Add potatoes and cook until almost tender about 15 minutes. Add frozen peas. Cook for 10 more minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Yogurt Pound Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in large bowl. Beat at high speed for 3 minutes. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in Wesson oil over medium heat until lightly browned. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over carrots. Cover and cook over low heat until tender about 15 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients well with mixer. Blend in kahlua chocolate chips sour cream and nuts. Bake in greased tube or Bundt pan.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Frost.

title: Chicken Nachos
instructions: Season chicken with taco seasoning to taste about 1/2 package. Arrange chips on baking pan. Top with chicken. Shred cheeses; mix together and sprinkle on chicken. (Top with jalapeno pepper slices if desired.)

title: Quick Sour Cream Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls into a small muffin pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 until light brown. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Mushroom Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and chop. Saute stems green pepper pimento and onions in 3 tablespoons butter or margarine; remove from heat and add bread crumbs cheese and spices. Mix well. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Stuff mushrooms and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix sausage cheese and biscuit mix in a bowl. Roll into walnut sized balls. Place on broiler rack. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks sugar cocoa flour can milk and water well and cook until thick. Remove from stove and add margarine and vanilla; mix well with beater. Pour into 2 baked pie shells.

title: Sweet Dill Pickles
instructions: Drain juice from hamburger pickles and discard. Place pickles in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar and vinegar. Mix until blended evenly with a wooden mixing spoon. Place mixing bowl in refrigerator overnight but stir frequently with the wooden spoon. Replace pickles in original jar and refrigerate.

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: Stir together the first six ingredients. Blend molasses and milk separately. Add raisins. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet.

title: Peppermint Crunchies(Sugar-Free Candy)
instructions: Melt chocolate in top of double boiler. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar substitute and cook over hot water until thick about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in extract and pour over puffed rice. Mix well. Drop by teaspoons onto wax lined paper. Chill about 1 hour in refrigerator. This makes 40 cookies with 23 calories per portion. Exchange 1/2 fat. If you crave candy try this.

title: Hot Broccoli And Mushroom Dip
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet. Add mushroom soup garlic cheese and broccoli. Heat until cheese melts and becomes bubbly. Pour hot mixture into fondue pot to keep warm while serving.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Stir all together and spread over peaches. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Loaf Brown Bread
instructions: Combine ingredients well. Mix soda in molasses; put shortening in last. Line loaf tins with waxed paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes then let it stand in oven until ready to serve.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and put in 9 x 16-inch dish or pan. Layer all or any of the remaining ingredients on top of the cream mixture. Dip with chips.

title: Catherine'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Press crackers and oleo in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare Jell-O with a cup of boiling water. Set aside. Mix cream cheese and cup of sugar. Blend with Jell-O and refrigerate until slightly thickened. Whip Milnot until it holds peaks and fold into Jell-O mixture. Pour over crust and refrigerate.
