title: Cherry Bars
instructions: Cream the butter and then add the sugar gradually. Blend in the egg and the vanilla. Sift the dry ingredients together and stir into the creamed mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Spread dough in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or until firm in center. Cool slightly and then cut into bars.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into greased casserole. Cover with cracker crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Boil for 10 minutes. Cool then add oranges and Cool Whip. Pour in bowl. Refrigerate.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender in salted water. Drain and cube. In large skillet fry bacon and onions until cooked (reserve onions and bacon). Add vinegar sugar white pepper and 1 cup water to the fat in skillet. Cook until the mixture reduces by 1/3 in volume. Add potatoes to the mixture in skillet; cook until all are warm. If there is too much vinegar flavor you may add water to dilute. Toss potatoes with all ingredients. Serve warm. Feel free to adjust flavors to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Gram'S Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach as package directs and drain. Add soup mix and sour cream. Put in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with stuffing mix and drizzle with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cornflakes until well combined. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in cornflake crumbs. Put in shallow baking pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about four dozen.

title: Different Meat Loaf
instructions: Saute onion pepper garlic and celery. Add rest of the ingredients saving half the tomato paste and stewed tomatoes. Spray 3-quart baking dish with Pam then add ingredients. Top with half the paste and tomatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour covered then 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered. Cool in pan. Turn out on platter to slice.

title: Pork Chop Spanish Rice
instructions: In large skillet brown pork chops. Sprinkle rice onion and green pepper over browned pork chops. Sprinkle seasonings over vegetable layer. Pour tomatoes on top. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until pork is tender and rice is cooked. Sprinkle with cheese. Heat 5 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Seafood Boulettes In Tomato Gravy
instructions: Saute onion bell pepper and garlic in butter until onions are transparent. Add tomatoes with chili and tomato sauce; simmer for 1 hour. Add celery salt black pepper and cayenne pepper; continue to cook for 1 hour more. Drop the Boulettes in sauce and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over hot rice.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Arrange sweet potatoes in a circle in 9-inch pie plate. Place pineapple in center. Dot sweet potatoes and pineapple with marmalade. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with marshmallows. Broil until lightly browned.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Alternate layers of dried apricots and rock candy in a decorative glass jar. Fill with vodka any brand; cover and brew for 3 months at room temperature. Turn occasionally. Drink the brandy eat the apricots or ladle over ice cream and watch out!

title: Pecan Fingers
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix shortening and confectioners sugar thoroughly. Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour into shortening mixture. With hand press and flatten mixture evenly in ungreased oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well. Spread over baked layer. Bake 15 minutes. Cool. Cut into bars. Makes 24 bars.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix sour cream and soup. Add chicken. Melt margarine. Add crushed cracker crumbs and poppy seed. Put about half of cracker mixture on bottom of casserole. Add chicken mixture. Put rest of cracker mixture on top. Bake about 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger and diced onion. Add cream of mushroom soup and simmer. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Microwave butter in a 2-quart casserole at High 30 seconds to soften. Add brown sugar peanut butter and egg; mix well. Combine flour baking powder and salt in a bowl. Add flour and peanuts to brown sugar mixture; stir until smooth. Pour into greased 8-inch square baking dish. Microwave at Medium 5 to 7 minutes; rotate dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes. Let stand directly on the counter to cool slightly before cutting into squares. Makes 25 bars.

title: 1917 War Cake
instructions: Put first 6 ingredients into sauce pan and cook 3 minutes. After it comes to a boil add Crisco. When cool add baking soda dissolved in a little hot water. Add flour and baking powder. Stir well.

title: Fantastic Bubble Solution
instructions: Mix all ingredients at least the night before use. Store in a plastic or glass container.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until crumbly. Press into ungreased 9 x 13 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Brown beef and season to taste with salt pepper and garlic powder. Add egg and mix well. Add Mozzarella cheese. Stir until melted. Add bread and milk and stir. Add parsley. Stuff cooked noodles with meat mixture and place into cake pan (first spread some sauce in the bottom of pan). Spoon sauce over each manicotti and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach and drain well. Mix all ingredients together. Chill. Shape into bite size balls. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Can be shaped and frozen ahead of time to be baked just before serving.) Makes 150 to 175 balls.

title: French Toast Daddy Style
instructions: 1) Lightly butter each slice of bread.

title: Broccoli Cheese Chicken
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender stirring occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

title: Peas, French-Style
instructions: Line bottom and sides of heavy saucepan with washed lettuce leaves. Add peas. Sprinkle with salt pepper nutmeg and sugar. Add butter. Cover with more lettuce leaves.

title: Mary Ruth Ferguson'S Jam Cake
instructions: Mix as you would any other cake. Bake in 3 layers at 325\u00b0 until tests done.

title: Barbecued Meat Balls
instructions: Soak bread crumbs in milk; mix with beef salt Accent and onions. Form into 12 balls. Roll in flour and brown in margarine. Combine ingredients and pour over meat. Simmer for 10 minutes stirring several times until meat balls are glazed. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Mix sugar nuts cinnamon and butter. Set aside. Put in bottom of a pie pan. Put biscuits over mixture and bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden. Invert from pan immediately.

title: Peruvian Lomo Saltado
instructions: Heat oil in a non-stick pan and saute onion garlic and bell pepper. Cook potato stirring occasionally until potato just begins to brown. Add chili and steak. Saute a few more minutes stir in tomato oregano salt and pepper. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 7 x 10 x 2 1/2-inch pan. Mix together all dry ingredients and stir milk in until blended. Pour mix into pan with melted butter. Pour fruit evenly over mixture. Do not stir! Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Place chicken in casserole dish. Pour 1 cup broth over chicken. Mix sour cream and can of soup together. Add onion if desired. Spoon over chicken. Crush Ritz crackers and add poppy seed. Sprinkle on top of soup mixture. Melt margarine and drizzle over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Serves 6.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until soft (golden brown). Add sugar salt and nutmeg and toss well. Cook down slowly (do not let onions get too dark). Add hot bouillon and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add sherry. Ladle into individual crocks (6); top with a piece of bread. Add cheese on top. Cook in preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Strawberry Jelly With Less Sugar
instructions: Mix instant clear jel with 1 cup sugar. Be sure clear jel is instant! Add berries to rest of sugar and let set 10 minutes. Mix Sure-Jell with 2 1/4 cups water and boil one minute. Pour over strawberries and stir well. Add the sugar with the instant clear jel and mix well for 3 minutes or use an eggbeater to mix. Pour into jars or containers and it is ready for freezer.

title: Cinnamon-Coffee Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour rectangular pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Mix all ingredients except glaze. Spread in pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean 20 to 25 minutes. Drizzle with glaze while warm. Cut into bars about 3 x 1-inch. Makes 3 dozen bars.

title: Green Beans With Mushrooms
instructions: Drain excess liquid from green beans. Fill the can with enough water to cover the green beans and drain again. Open can of mushrooms and drain. Heat margarine in small frying pan. Add beans and mushrooms and saut. Add bouillon and water. Cover pan and cook until dry.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream together first 3 ingredients. Add milk. Blend. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon into baked pie shell. Freeze 1 hour. Serve.

title: Syrup Cake
instructions: Mix eggs sugar oil and syrup. Mix flour cinnamon soda and salt. Alternate dry ingredients and buttermilk into syrup mixture. Flour and grease sheet cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Nut Salad
instructions: Make Jell-O; let stand until it begins to thicken. Mix cream cheese and pineapple together. Add Jell-O and stir in nuts.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
instructions: Stir strawberries and sugar together thoroughly (set aside). Stir Sure-Jell and water in pan. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy. Pour into containers. Store in freezer until opened. After opening store in refrigerator. Makes 4 (8 ounce) containers.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a 4 qt. pan. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add carrots potatoes and mixed vegetables simmer until crispy tender. Add soup. Continue to simmer until vegetables are done. Add cheese stirring occasionaly until cheese melts.

title: Baked Green Beans
instructions: Drain juice from green beans; place in baking dish. Salt beans well. Fry bacon and drain fat. To slightly cooled bacon fat add sugar and vinegar; stir until dissolved. Pour mixture over green beans. Crumble bacon over top of beans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Sponge Dessert
instructions: Mix lemon jello sugar and hot water and then let cool. Beat milk and lemon juice together and add to jello mixture. Crumble vanilla wafers on bottom of long casserole dish then pour in mixture. Crumble vanilla\twafers on top.\tFreeze and cut in squares to serve.

title: Cooked Rice
instructions: Saute carrot and peas in hot oil in a skillet for 3 minutes. Add rice soy sauce and pepper. Stir and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat; set aside and keep warm. Pour egg mixture in hot oil in a skillet to make thin egg pancake over medium heat. Remove to cutting board. Cut egg pancake into thin strips. Add to rice; mix well. Sprinkle with green onion over fried rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Quick Crescent Quiche
instructions: For The Crust Separate the crescent rolls into 8 triangles. In an ungreased 9-inch pie plate or quiche dish arrange the dough triangles with their points toward the center of the dish. Press the dough over the bottom and sides of the dish pinching the edges together to seal.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Cook broccoli drain and set aside. Melt margarine in flour salt pepper and mustard. Stir in chicken broth and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until sauce thickens and bubbles. Add cheese and stir until cheese is melted.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Blend all ingredients until well mixed. Form into loaf shape. Place in loaf pan or on broiler pan.\tCover with catsup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Boil 10 minutes the brown sugar white sugar and 1 cup milk. Mix together flour 1 cup milk egg yolks and vanilla. Mix all ingredients and boil until thick. Pour into prepared pie crust. Top with meringue. Rich and delicious.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine flour Accent salt paprika and pepper. Roll chicken pieces in seasoned flour. Heat oil 1/2 inch deep in skillet. Place chicken skin side down in skillet. Put larger meatier pieces in first. Cook uncovered 15 to 25 minutes each side turning once. Drain well on absorbent paper. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruity Sugarless Cookies
instructions: Boil together dates raisins apples and water for 8 minutes. Add Crisco while still hot. Set pan in cold water to cool. Add flour eggs and Sweet*10. Add vanilla and crushed nuts last. Place in refrigerator to chill before dropping on a greased cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Each cookie equals 50 calories and 1 fruit serving.

title: Irish Colcannon
instructions: Mash potatoes. Mix in other ingredients and serve.

title: Cranberry Gelatin Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups hot water. Put cranberries and orange through food chopper and mix with sugar. Combine Jell-O and ground mixture then add a little celery and nuts. Chill and serve on lettuce or plain.

title: Hot Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions and drain well. Combine with other ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Chill several hours. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes about 36.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Blend in sweet potatoes. Add enough milk to make soft dough. Knead lightly. Roll 3/4-inch thick on a lightly floured board. Cut with 2-inch cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 on ungreased sheet 20 minutes or until brown. Makes 15 biscuits.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Cupcakes
instructions: Blend cream cheese egg 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Combine and beat well. Stir in chocolate chips and set aside. Sift together flour 1 cup sugar cocoa soda and 1 teaspoon salt. Add water oil vinegar and vanilla. Fill cups 1/3 full with chocolate batter. Top each with a heaping teaspoon of cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with sugar and chopped or slivered almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Refrigerate.

title: Busy Day Chicken And Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of a 13 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Cover bottom evenly with rice. Arrange chicken pieces on rice. Dot with butter. Sprinkle dry onion soup over all. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour boiling water into pan. Bake for about 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Scones
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg and mix well. Stir in pumpkin. Sift together flour and salt. Add alternately with milk. Knead lightly. Roll out on lightly floured surface and cut with biscuit or cookie cutter. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Hermits
instructions: Mix brown sugar shortening oleo and coffee; add egg baking soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until almost no indentation remains when touched 8 to 10 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Mix together water sugar and yeast. Add flour oil and salt. Knead a little and put in \oiled\ bowl. Let rise. Spread on greased pizza pan (can fill 2 small pans). Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Black Bean And Rice Casserole
instructions: Layer in a deep casserole dish rice 1/2 salsa 1/2 cheese beans salsa cheese. Heat thoroughly at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Garnish with sour cream and scallions.

title: Corn, Rice And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Grease baking dish. Stir corn rice and cheese. In bowl beat eggs salt pepper and milk. Place corn mix in dish; pour eggs mix over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown scrambled sausage. Drain and wash. Add Velveeta and chili; mix together. Put bowl of mixture in microwave to melt cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Spicy Italian Roast(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Season the roast with the garlic salt and place it in the Crock-Pot. Add the mushrooms and onion. Combine the seasoning mix with the tomato sauce and pour it over everything in the Crock-Pot. Cover and cook on Low 10-12 hours (high for 4-6 hours). To thicken gravy make a paste of the melted butter flour and tomato paste and stir into the meat drippings in the Crock-Pot. Cover and cook on High approximately 30 minutes or until thickened. Serve over hot pasta or rice.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put the pumpkin into one large mixing bowl. In another smaller mixing bowl beat 6 eggs. Pour beaten eggs into large mixing bowl and blend with pumpkin. Blend in 2 cups sugar. Blend in 2 1/2 cups milk. Mix the 3 teaspoons of cornstarch into the remaining 1/2 cup of milk and blend this into the large bowl. Blend in 2 teaspoons of pumpkin pie spice and 1 1/2 teaspoons of nutmeg. Pour completed mix into 2 (9-inch) pie crusts. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 50 to 55 minutes. (Shake pies lightly; if the pumpkin mix is firm like Jell-O in the center and not watery the pie is done.) Make two 9-inch pies.

title: Coconut Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add egg and coconut extract; beat well. Stir in SpudFlakes and Bix-Mix. Shape dough into 3/4-inch balls; arrange 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wire racks. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Lima Beans In Mustard Sauce
instructions: Cook beans and drain. Heat salad dressing milk and mustard stirring constantly. Turn hot beans into serving dish. Pour hot sauce over beans. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Sugar-Free Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Let set in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Sunday Dinner Roast
instructions: Place roast on heavy-duty foil. Spread roast with undiluted mushroom soup. Sprinkle over it the dry onion soup mix. Wrap sealing well. Use a shallow roasting pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 2 hours. Makes delicious gravy for potatoes or rice.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour soda and baking powder; set aside. Cream Crisco and sugar; beat in eggs one at a time. Add flavorings. Add flour and sour cream alternately beginning and ending with flour.

title: Taco Surprise
instructions: Prepare the stuffing as directed on box. Set aside. Brown meat and add sauce. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Layer half of stuffing in casserole. Top with ground beef then spread cheese over meat. Cover with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Double recipe for a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. You can sprinkle cheese on top also.

title: Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Brown ground beef with onion and peppers; drain. Add both cans of soup to meat mixture. Add cooked noodles; stir well. Place in a casserole dish and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and is bubbly.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Add chunks of butter to corn and salt and pepper to taste. Add canned milk and cracker crumbs; mix well. Turn mixture into a buttered 1-quart casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Whole Wheat Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast buttermilk sugar salt and egg in mixer bowl. Beat until all are mixed well. Add Crisco and potatoes; beat well. Add flour and beat well. Cover and let rise. Push down; form rolls and let rise. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Candied Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with hands in a large bowl. Grease 2 loaf pans then line with brown paper (grocery bag). Bake 1 1/2 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven. When done brush top and sides with white Karo syrup.

title: Broccoli Salad]
instructions: Soak broccoli in salt water for several hours. Drain. Mix altogether. Serves 6.

title: Corn Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease bottoms of 12 medium muffin cups. Blend all ingredients about 20 seconds. Beat 1 minute. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 15 minutes; immediately remove from pan.

title: Pico De Gallo(Rooster'S Beak)
instructions: Cut tomatoes and cucumbers into small cubes. Chop the onion and cilantro leaves. Mince the jalapenos.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients together and pour into crust. Chill.

title: Baked Bologna
instructions: With sharp knife cut skin of bologna. Cut into 1/2-inch or more diamond shapes. Punch holes all the way through so the basting gets in all the meat. Baste generously with brown sugar and pineapple or use any kind of jelly to suit taste. Bake in oven until piping hot all the way through or if you prefer put on rotisserie and use barbecue sauce instead of brown sugar. Baste every 15 minutes for a barbecue flavor. Delicious either way.

title: Cream Peas And Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. Cook peas in separate pan add sugar. Melt butter in pan add flour salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk. Cook until thick. Drain potatoes and peas and place in bowl. Pour sauce over and stir to coat.

title: Yogurt Rice Sauce
instructions: Cook rice. In another saucepan add well beaten egg to yogurt. Stir well and cook on low fire. Stir until mixture boils. Add rice. Cook 5 more minutes.

title: Creamy Lemon Cheese Cake
instructions: Measure 1 cup dry cake mix; set aside. Combine remaining mix with 1 egg and oil. Press in the bottom of a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Hamburger Skouse
instructions: Brown meat in large pan or pot. Drain meat. Meat can be rinsed with cool water if less fat is desired. Put all ingredients in pot and simmer until potatoes are done stirring occasionally.

title: White Fudge
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a microwave-safe bowl. Cook in microwave for 10 minutes. Do not cover. Cool in water while mixing. Then pour into greased pan. Refrigerate 1 hour. Keep in fridge.

title: Chocoholic Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over top evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Watch for brownies to slightly pull away from sides of pan. Let cool for 15 minutes. Cut into squares. These brownies are very rich and dense. You might want a gallon of fresh milk to go along with them!

title: Chart House Dip
instructions: Blend ingredients well. It helps to soften cream cheese first. Serve with cut-up veggies or crackers. Can sprinkle with paprika for color! This recipe is served in the Chart House Restaurant in Vail Colorado.

title: Strawberry Nut Bread
instructions: Sift the first 3 ingredients together. Add cinnamon and sugar. Beat the eggs and remaining ingredients. Mix but do not beat. Makes 2 large loaves or several muffins. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 for loaves less time for muffins.

title: Mocha Walnut Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt 1/2 cup of morsels over hot water. Stir until smooth; cool to room temperature. In small cup dissolve coffee in 2 teaspoons boiling water. Set aside. In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. In large bowl combine butter sugars and coffee. Beat until creamy. Add egg and melted morsels. Mix well. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in walnuts and remaining morsels. Drop by tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Allow to cool 2 to 3 minutes before removing. Yields 24 (3-inch) cookies.

title: Waikiki Meatballs
instructions: Mix the meatball mixture together and form meatballs. Melt 1 1/2 tablespoons shortening in large skillet. Cook meatballs and remove from skillet. Pour shortening from skillet.

title: Snack In A Bag
instructions: Combine oat circles breakfast cereal dried apricot halves (chopped) raisins chopped pitted dates sunflower seeds and almonds. This snack has been scientifically proven to help PMS symptoms! Really! Divide into 3 plastic bags.

title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake
instructions: In large bowl combine flour salt cinnamon sugars and oil; mix well. Reserve 3/4 cup of this mixture. Add nuts and cinnamon to this mixture; set aside. Add baking powder soda egg and buttermilk to mixture in bowl; beat until smooth. Pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with reserved mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Au Gratin Potato Casserole(Texas-Style)
instructions: Mix 1 cup melted butter salt and pepper; add onion and saute. Add soup sour cream cheese and potatoes; mix well. Place in a large greased casserole dish (9 x 13-inches). Melt 1/2 stick butter and add cornflakes; mix well. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 15 to 20.

title: Cold Cuts Quiche
instructions: Spread crescent rolls on bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan. Place 2 layers of salami ham and American cheese. Drain 1 jar Progresso pepper salad and place over the layers. Repeat layers in reverse; cheese ham and salami. Top with more crescent rolls. Pour 2 beaten eggs over all. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Pineapple Salad
instructions: Blend together cream cheese yogurt and sugar. Stir in crushed pineapple. Spoon into 6 paper muffin cups in muffin pan. Cover and freeze until firm. Remove paper cups from salads and arrange on lettuce leaves and top with chopped nuts. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spaghetti With Mushrooms
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package. Cook and stir mushrooms in butter in 3-quart saucepan over medium heat until tender.

title: Marinade Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and use with beef chicken or fish. Marinate in refrigerator 3 to 4 hours occasionally turning the meat over several times.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar. Add flour beaten eggs vanilla nuts and morsels. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch greased (or Pam sprayed) pan at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mousse(Josh Thacker'S Favorite Dessert)
instructions: Bottom Layer Mix flour melted butter and 1 1/2 cups pecans together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Let cool.

title: English Toffee Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg yolk. Add sifted dry ingredients and mix. Add vanilla and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Mix well. Press dough in greased tin (10 x 15-inch). Spread egg white over dough in pan. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Cut cookies while warm. Makes three dozen.

title: Sinful Caramel Pie
instructions: Brown coconut and almonds in margarine. Set aside. Mix other ingredients. If needed add a little milk. Pour into 2 crusts and sprinkle top with nuts and coconut. You can warm caramel in microwave a few minutes and drizzle easier. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Pie(Tastes Like Apple)
instructions: Peel and remove seeds and chop or slice zucchini like apples. Put in kettle with 1/4 cup water. Simmer until tender. Drain; cool. Combine with dry ingredients. Fill 9-inch unbaked pie shell; top with crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Large oversized zucchini work best. Absolutely delicious.

title: Lemonade
instructions: Combine sugar and 1 cup water in a small saucepan. Over medium heat bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 5 to 6 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and cool completely.

title: Pineapple Delight Salad
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients and cook until mixture thickens stirring constantly. Let cool. Add remaining ingredients and refrigerate until time to serve.

title: Julie Moonan Dessert Pudding
instructions: Cover bottom of 13 x 9-inch cooking dish with graham crackers. Put chocolate pudding on top of graham crackers. Slice bananas then next layer of graham crackers the pudding (vanilla) then crushed graham crackers on top. Chill for 1 hour ready to serve.

title: Holiday Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries grapes apples and nuts. Add pineapple and sugar; stir. Refrigerate 3 hours. Add marshmallows and fold in whipped cream 30 minutes before serving.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken. Drain and save 1 cup of broth. Cook spaghetti and drain. Saute onion and cut cheese into cubes.

title: Green Tomato Pie
instructions: Divide pastry almost in half. Roll out larger half on floured surface to 13-inch circle. Line 9-inch plate with pastry. Trim pastry to 1/2 inch beyond rim of pie plate. Combine tomatoes sugar flour lemon juice cinnamon nutmeg and salt in bowl; mix well. Arrange tomato mixture in pastry-lined pie plate.

title: Chocolate Chip Date Cake
instructions: Pour water over dates; add soda and let cool. Cream eggs shortening and sugar. Add date mixture. Add flour salt and soda. Before baking top with chocolate chips sugar and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Quick Banana Pudding
instructions: Prepare pudding mix as directed on package and cool. Line the bottom of pan with 12 cookies. Top with 1 banana sliced. Spread half the pudding on top. Top with remaining cookies then with 1 banana sliced and remaining pudding. Chill. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pecan Bars
instructions: In a small bowl mix well flour and 2 tablespoons brown sugar. With pastry blender work in oleo until dough holds together. Press on bottom of greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until firm.

title: Orange Flip
instructions: Combine juices and chill. Add mineral water and ice (if desired) just before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion and drain. Add potatoes tomatoes tomato sauce and Veg-All. Cover and cook until potatoes are done about 30 minutes.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients and refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Deep Fried Ice Cream
instructions: Roll ice cream into balls and refreeze. Heat oil until hot. Crush corn flakes and roll ice cream balls in corn flakes until well covered. One at a time place balls on slotted spoon and dip into oil. (Do not drop off spoon.) Leave in oil until corn flakes are browned about 2 to 3 seconds. Roll in cinnamon sugar and place in serving dish. Drizzle with honey top with whipped cream and serve. One ball per serving.

title: Coconut Date Balls
instructions: Mix and boil first 4 ingredients for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add pecans Rice Krispies and vanilla. Cool and shape into balls then roll in coconut.

title: Old-Timey Potato Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until translucent. Add potatoes water and salt and cook until tender. Add milk and season to taste. Simmer a few minutes before serving. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix ingredients in order given and pour into a well greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake for about 1 hour. Cool well before removing cake from pan.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 475\u00b0 until done.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl combine flour sugar and cocoa; cut in margarine until crumbly. Press on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes. In saucepan melt \1 cup\ chips with sweetened condensed milk and vanilla. Pour over crust; top with nuts and remaining chips. Press down firmly. Bake for 20 minutes or until set. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger lightly with onion. In 13 x 9-inch pan layer meat first. Spread 2 cans of cream of chicken; dont add water. Add grated cheese on top then layer Tots on top. Bake 25 minutes or until Tots are brown at 325\u00b0.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix flour cocoa and sugar and make 3 \wells\ in bowl. In one put soda in one put vinegar and in one put oil. Pour water over all and mix. You can also add a pinch of salt and a beaten egg if you wish. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes or make 30 cupcakes.

title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
instructions: Heat milk in top of double boiler then add cheese and stir until melted. Cool and then add other ingredients. Mix well.

title: Mad Hatter Meatballs
instructions: Brown green pepper and onion in margarine. Stir in rice soup tomato soup and water. Form meatballs from remaining ingredients. Drop into sauce. Simmer covered on low for 1 hour. Simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes or until thick. Great served with mashed potatoes.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Combine everything except crabmeat. Stir well. Add crab meat. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: The Ultimate Eggnog
instructions: Separate eggs and stir yolks with whiskey or rum 2 cups of sugar and 1 teaspoon nutmeg. Let mixture \ripen\ in refrigerator 12 to 24 hours. Just before serving add half and half to mixture. Beat egg whites adding remaining 1 cup sugar while beating; beat until sugar is dissolved and whites are firm. In separate bowl whip cream. Fold egg whites and whipped cream into yolk mixture. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Serves 25.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Mix equal amounts of Coke and ketchup in a large pot. Add chicken (skin if preferred). Let come to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until done approximately 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in water (set aside). Pour soup in pot. Do not add water. Heat to boiling. Add cream cheese in soup. Stir until melted. Add celery and green onions. Cook 5 minutes. Add shrimp and mayonnaise. Cook 5 minutes. Add dash of salt (Tonys seasoning Worcestershire sauce garlic powder to taste). Pour gelatine into pot with soup and other ingredients. Mix. Pour into greased mold. Chill for 3 hours or overnight.

title: Pizza With Smoked Mozzarella And Dried Tomatoes
instructions: About 40 minutes before serving prepare Sicilian Pizza Dough.

title: Snicker Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed on package. Pour half of batter in large greased pan and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt caramels milk and margarine over low heat. Pour caramel mixture over cake. Mix chocolate chips and nuts sprinkle onto caramel mixture. Then smooth rest of the cake batter over this mixture. Lower oven to 200\u00b0; bake 10 minutes then increase to 350\u00b0 and bake until done.

title: Red Hot Wings
instructions: Split wings at each joint and discard tips. Pat dry. Deep fry until done (brown and crispy) or bake at 425\u00b0 for 1 hour turning halfway through cooking time. Combine red hot sauce oleo and Worcestershire sauce. Dip wings in sauce to completely coat. Serve with favorite dip.

title: Cucumber Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Makes 1 1/2 cups. Serve with raw vegetables chips or crackers.

title: Coal Garden
instructions: Mix water salt bluing liquid and ammonia. Pour over coal in a pie pan or glass container. Drop food coloring on the coal and mixture. Different colors make it look pretty. Grows best where it is warm and dry. To keep it growing carefully add more liquid from the sides of the coal.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
instructions: Open cans of green beans. Pour out liquid from 1 can and reserve the liquid from the other can. Fry bacon until crisp; reserve drippings. Crumble the bacon; saute the onion in bacon drippings. Stir in flour liquid from beans salt pepper sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil. Add the drained green beans and crumbled bacon. Heat until warmed through.

title: Cinnamon Almond Bars
instructions: Will need a jelly roll pan.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spread 1/2 of potatoes in a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Slice sausage link and spread evenly on potatoes. Combine remaining ingredients and spread on sausage. Cover and bake for 50 minutes. Uncover and bake for 10 additional minutes. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place bread in casserole dish. Mix chicken vegetables mayonnaise salt and pepper; spread over bread. Mix eggs milk and oleo. Pour over chicken mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Take out to bake. Spread the chicken soup over top then top with the cornflakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and top with shredded cheese. Bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Lemon Brownies
instructions: Mix and spread thinly in an oiled pan.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Layer crackers (not crumbs) in 13 x 9-inch pan. Prepare pudding with 3 cups milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour over crackers. Put another layer of crackers on top of pudding mixture. Melt chocolate frosting in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir and swirl over crackers. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Freezes well.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Cook vanilla pudding as directed on package. Mix jello and pudding refrigerate overnight. Whip cream. Beat pudding mixture add whipped cream fruit cherries and marshmallows. Mix thoroughly chill before serving. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fried Grits With Ham
instructions: In saucepan combine 4 cups water and salt. Bring to boiling. Slowly stir in grits. Cook covered over low heat for 2 1/2 to 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in ham and margarine. Pour into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cool. Chill until firm about 3 hours. Cut in 2-inch squares. Beat egg with 2 tablespoons cold water. Dip squares in egg mixture then in flour. In skillet cook grit squares on both sides in small amount of hot shortening until golden brown about 8 to 10 minutes. Serve with maple flavored syrup. Makes 4 servings.

title: Southern Pie Crust
instructions: Blend ingredients with electric mixer. Add ice water 3 tablespoons at a time. Blend in until all water is added. Blend to smooth. Take out on a floured pastry board or sheet. Roll out in 7-inch pie crust. Makes 2.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in greased 9 x 12-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Scalloped Potatoes With Cheese Soup
instructions: Stir soup until smooth. Add milk and pepper. In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole alternate layers of potatoes onions sauce and cheese. Dot with butter; sprinkle with paprika. Cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
instructions: Toss first 3 ingredients in salad bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and blend well. Pour over cabbage and mix in well. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Roll meat in this mixture. Brown meat in the shortening. Add tomatoes tomato soup and water; cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours stirring now and then. Add onions carrots and potatoes. Cook until vegetables are tender. Cook uncovered 10 minutes to thicken.

title: Inside-Out Chocolate Bundt Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into Bundt pan. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when completely cooled.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. While hot cut up cheeses and mix together. Mix egg milk salt and pepper. Put all together and mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Smoked Salmon Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese in large mixer bowl until creamy. Add 3 ounces smoked salmon coarsely chopped and beat at low speed until blended. Add minced onion mayonnaise yellow mustard and minced garlic. Beat at high speed until well blended. Serve with crackers or breadsticks. Makes 2 cups.

title: Care And Feeding Of Herman
instructions: In a large bowl feed Herman 1/2 cup sugar 1 cup flour and 1 cup milk. Stir thoroughly. From now on refrigerate.

title: Nathan'S Steak
instructions: Get some meat and cook it in a pan and put the fire on the pan and it cooks up. Then you have steak.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in frypan adding salt and pepper; drain. Add stewed tomatoes and mix well. Cut processed cheese into small chunks; add to meat mixture and melt. Add enchilada sauce to meat mixture mixing well. Set aside. Cut cream cheese into 8 equal blocks. Spread block of cheese over 1/2 of each tortilla. Spread light layer of green chiles over cheese. Fold in half. Set aside. Spray 13 x 9-inch bread pan lightly with cooking spray. Layer bottom of pan with tortilla chips. Pour 1/2 of meat mixture over chips. Place folded tortillas over layer of meat mixture. Pour remainder of meat mixture over folded tortillas. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes. Remove from oven and spread grated cheese on top. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Saute vegetables in skillet with small amount of oil. Boil chicken and remove. Dice and return diced chicken to broth. Pour vegetables into broth and continue boiling for a while. Add chopped cilantro (3/4 to 1 cup). Serve and top with fried tortillas grated Mozzarella and add chopped avocado.

title: Sugar Thins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add remaining ingredients. Chill overnight. Roll out very thin on floured board. Cut and decorate. Bake in greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Makes about 10 dozen.

title: Garden Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl stir all ingredients except mushrooms. Stuff each mushroom cap with 1 tablespoon of filling. Place in buttered 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Makes 16 appetizers.

title: Onion Pie
instructions: Mix crumbs with margarine; press into a 10-inch pie pan. Saute onions in margarine. Pour into crust. Scald milk and add slowly to eggs. Add grated cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Pour into crust and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 1 egg. Press into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine powdered sugar 3 eggs flavoring and softened cream cheese. Mix well and spread over cake mix layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: In a large skillet brown the ground beef over medium-high heat. Stir in the taco seasoning and tomatoes. Line a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with half of the tortillas. Spoon the beef mixture into the dish then top with the remaining tortillas. Spread salsa over the tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream the sugar and eggs. Add melted butter. Add milk vanilla and coconut. Mix well. Bake at 325\u00b0 until firm.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Before starting jelly in quart jar add 1 1/2 cups flour and fill jar with water. Shake to dissolve all lumps. In pan combine peppers mustard salt vinegar and sugar. Bring to rolling boil stirring constantly. Add flour mixture to thicken. Place in pint or quart jars.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Add chicken to bottom pie crust. Top with soup mixed with sour cream salt and pepper. Cover with top crust! Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until brown. (This freezes well bake when needed.)

title: Baked Alaska
instructions: Bake any type of cake in a long pan. Freeze. Remove from freezer and place your favorite ice cream on top of cake. Trim the cake down to 1 inch larger than the ice cream. Cover with meringue or fluffy white frosting.

title: Jelly Pecan Pie
instructions: On medium speed beat eggs in mixer. Add sugar jelly and margarine. Stir in pecans and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Chill water and pineapple juice. Add Seven-Up. Make ice ring with Kool-Aid. Makes 1 gallon. Serves 25 (1/2 cups).

title: Mexican Fiesta Biscuits Mix
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt margarine in oven in 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish or nonstick aluminum baking pan. Tilt to evenly coat dish.

title: Caramel Nut Fruit Fudge
instructions: In a saucepan measure light brown sugar margarine and evaporated milk. Bring to boiling point. Let boil 2 to 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add vanilla and 1 cup 10x confectioners sugar. Beat and add cherries coconut pecans and raisins. This should harden quickly; cut into squares.

title: Lawry'S Fiesta Dip
instructions: In medium bowl combine ingredients. Blend well. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 2 cups. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh cut vegetables such as carrots.

title: Whole Wheat Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients; knead. Make deep slits. Place on cookie sheet. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Six Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix well; form balls. Press with fork dipped in water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Bobby'S Chili
instructions: Combine tomatoes and water; bring to boil. Add onions pepper salt and garlic. Mix well and bring to boil. Add ground beef (uncooked) stirring constantly. After coming to good boil cover and simmer for 90 minutes. Add water if needed. Add 4 1/2 tablespoons chili seasoning (Bobby uses Mortons). Cover and simmer 60 minutes. Add 2 cups mashed cooked pinto beans to tighten the chili (an old trick Bobby learned from an army cookbook).

title: Rabbit With Herbs And Mushrooms
instructions: Cut up the rabbit into serving size pieces. Saute in butter until browned on all sides. Mix parsley and chives with 2 tablespoons butter with a fork. Sprinkle rabbit with flour cook 1 minute while stirring. Add wine butter and herb mixture 1 cup water garlic thyme 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Bring to a boil cover and simmer 1 hour over low heat. Add mushrooms and simmer about 10 more minutes.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Place fish in a large skillet. Add 1 1/2 cups milk bay leaf celery and thyme. Simmer 10 to 20 minutes. Remove skin and bone. Cut fish into 1/2-inch pieces. Strain liquid from fish and reserve for later. In saucepan melt butter. Saute onion. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Gradually add the liquid from the fish then 4 cups milk and potatoes. Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir in cheese until melted. Add fish. Heat and serve. Serves 9.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to boil butter cocoa and water. Pour in large bowl; while hot add flour sugar and salt. Mix well. Beat in eggs sour cream and baking soda. Pour in large cookie sheet that has been greased and floured. Spread evenly. Bake 20 to 25 minutes (no longer).

title: Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Dip onions after sliced in a small bowl of milk then dip in flour. French fry until golden brown.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes until just about done. Peel and cube. Add rest of ingredients and put crumbled bacon on the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except sugar. Roll in large marble size balls. Roll in powdered sugar. Keep cool. Will keep well.

title: Rolled Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain. Add onions seasoning mix water and refried beans; mix well. Simmer for 5 minutes. Spoon onto tortillas; roll to enclose filling. Place seam side down in greased 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Mix taco sauce and tomato sauce in bowl. Spoon over tortillas. Sprinkle with 2 cups cheese. Bake until cheese has melted. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Chop tomatoes coarsely. Combine all ingredients. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Famous Johnnycakes
instructions: Combine sugar and salt with meal in a large mixing bowl. Scald with boiling water and stir well. Thin immediately with milk so mixture will drop easily from spoon (additional milk may be necessary).

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Cream together eggs sugar oil and pumpkin then add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased and floured pan or Bundt pan. Cool cake.

title: Garden Spot Pizza
instructions: Crust Spread crescent rolls on baking sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes. Cool.

title: Chocolate-Cream Drop Cookies
instructions: Slice each candy drop into 3 or 4 pieces and place 1 between 2 Ritz crackers. Warm for a few minutes at a low temperature in oven until candy melts. Delicious!

title: Easy Pound Cake
instructions: Combine butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add almond extract. Stir in flour mixing well. Spoon batter into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Chocolate Caramel Bars
instructions: Melt caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk and set aside. Mix together the cake mix oleo nuts and 1/3 cup milk. Press half of cake mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and pour caramel sauce over cake. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Crumble the rest of the cake mixture on top and bake for 10 minutes. Let cool before cutting. Keeps best if refrigerated.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and 1/2 carton of Cool Whip. Blend with mixer. Pour mixture into graham cracker crusts. Makes two cheesecakes then divide strawberry pie filling between both cheesecakes. Let chill for 2 to 3 hours for better flavor.

title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time and beat after each addition. In a bowl sift together flour baking powder and salt and add alternately with milk to the creamed mixture. Stir in chopped cranberries. Spoon into 12 paper-lined 2 1/2-inch muffin cups. Fill 3/4 full. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Almond Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add egg salt and extract. Mix thoroughly. Add 1 cup flour then add all of the water. Mix. Add remaining flour; mix. Drop by level measuring teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a floured jelly glass. Press almond on top. Bake until brown and crisp at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 160 cookies (20 to a cookie sheet).

title: Ginger Cream Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar egg molasses and water together. Stir in all dry ingredients until well blended. Chill dough. Drop by teaspoonfuls about 2-inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake just until set about 6 to 8 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. While still warm frost with Coffee Cream Frosting.

title: Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in medium skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic. Cook until softened (2 minutes). Stir in mushrooms. Cook until browned (about 5 minutes). Remove mushroom mixture from skillet and set aside. Place the remaining oil and flour in skillet. Stir to mix. Turn heat to low and cook stirring constantly until flour turns deep brown. Still stirring gradually add milk. Cook until mixture thickens (about 4 minutes). Stir in the mushroom mixture. Add salt and pepper. Serve immediately! Serves 4.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand 24 hours. Makes 10 servings. This is really tasty!

title: Easy Caramel Sauce
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a small bowl. Microwave on High for 2 to 4 minutes or until the caramel is melted stirring after every minute of cooking time. Makes 1 cup.

title: Fix Ahead Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Parmesan cheese. Mix well. Pour into 9-inch baking dish. Cover with a lid or foil. Refrigerate all day. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Remove cover and bake an additional 15 minutes longer. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture forms a ball. Takes about 6 minutes. Knead to form a ball after cools. Put in airtight container. You can divide ball and mix different food color in each. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and green pepper then drain. Combine the rest of ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover and remove from fire for 5 minutes. Then serve.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Shape into individual balls. Roll in graham cracker crumbs. Chill and serve.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: In a small bowl stir together flour baking powder and cinnamon. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl at medium speed beat together oil sugar and eggs until well blended. At low speed gradually beat reserved flour mixture into egg mixture. Beat until well blended. Stir in carrots pineapple and pecans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Frog Eye Salad
instructions: Cook tiny grain pasta in boiling water according to package directions; drain rinse in cold water and drain again. Drain canned oranges and crushed unsweetened pineapple reserving juices. Mix fruit with pasta in 3-quart bowl. Pour cold juices in saucepan and add sugar beaten eggs and flour (cornstarch). Place over medium heat and cook stirring until thickened. Pour over pasta and fruit. Stir in marshmallows. Mix well and chill overnight. Fold in thawed whipped topping. Makes 10 to 15 servings. Really good and a make ahead salad/dessert. (I never use all the juices to make the dressing.)

title: Chicken Monterey
instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in a large skillet. Pat the chicken dry; season them with salt and pepper and cook gently in the oil for 5 minutes. Do not attempt to brown the chicken or it will be overcooked; it should be pale gold. Remove chicken from skillet and reserve. Add the onions carrots and garlic to the oil remaining in the skillet and cook covered over low heat until the vegetables are tender about 25 minutes. Uncover the skillet and add the stock orange juice tomatoes and rosemary. Season to taste with salt and black pepper and simmer the mixture uncovered for 15 minutes. Return the chicken to the pan and simmer further 20 to 25 minutes or until the chicken is nearly done. Baste the pieces with the sauce and turn them once at the 15 minute mark.

title: Light Orange-Honey Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray bottom and sides of an 8-inch spring-form pan with nonstick coating. Lightly flour the pan.

title: Potato Starter
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water. Mash in water they were cooked in. Add sugar salt and enough cold water to make 3 1/4 cups of liquid. Allow this mixture to become warm. Add the yeast dissolved in 1 cup warm water. Allow this mixture to stand overnight. This should be light and frothy. Pour off 1 cup to save as starter for the next baking. Store in refrigerator in jar loosely covered. When ready for use set jar in warm water until 82\u00b0. Starter should remain usable for about a week. Work flour in this mixture as in sourdough bread.

title: Peeking Bonbons
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat flour and salt into creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Divide butter in half. Add red color to half and green color to other half. Mix. Chill 30 minutes. Shape into balls using rounded teaspoon of dough. Refrigerate while making filling.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cut up chicken and mix with green chili salsa to taste (until saucy texture). Heat tortilla in dry skillet and then dip in cream mixture (sour cream and whipping cream). Spoon chicken filling into shell and fold. Lay in 9 x 11-inch glass pan. When finished pour remaining cream mixture over enchiladas. Top with shredded cheese and heat at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Grand Champion Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Add soda to milk. Mix spices with flour. Add flour alternately with milk then add jam dates nuts coconut and apple. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 3 layers.

title: Ginger-Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook all ingredients except lemon juice and brown sugar in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes stirring occasionally until all liquid has evaporated. Reduce heat to medium-low. Stir in lemon juice and brown sugar. Cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally until carrots are glazed. Low-fat and low-cholesterol.

title: Instant Hot Tea
instructions: Mix and add to water as needed.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients but chili powder. Roll in chili powder. Chill until firm.

title: Mincemeat Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add vanilla lemon rind and egg. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients together; fold into creamed mixture alternately with mincemeat. Add nuts; mix into stiff dough. Form into rolls wrap in wax paper and store in refrigerator. Slice 1/4 inch thick. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Makes about seven dozen cookies.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix together and even out in a 9 x 13-inch pan or plastic container. Freeze. Take out 15 to 20 minutes before eating but return it to the freezer as soon as possible.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 3 tablespoons juice. Combine reserved juice sugar and flour in bowl; mix well. Stir in cheese. Add pineapple; mix well. Spoon into greased 1-quart casserole dish. Mix margarine and cracker crumbs in small bowl. Spread over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Key-Lime Pie
instructions: Use microwave-safe bowl and put egg yolks in microwave for 10 seconds. Use mixer and beat egg yolks and then add sweetened condensed milk and lime juice. Pour into pie shell and chill.

title: Pecan Tassies
instructions: Combine margarine and softened cream cheese mixing until well blended. Add flour; mix well. Chill. Combine brown sugar egg and vanilla; mix well. Stir in nuts. Divide dough into 24 balls; press into miniature muffin tins. Fill each cup 3/4 full of brown sugar mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 5 minutes; remove from pan. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar if desired.

title: Oven-Fried Cinnamon Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour salt cinnamon turmeric and pepper. Beat egg and milk. Coat chicken pieces with flour mixture. Combine bread crumbs and remaining flour mixture. Dip chicken into egg; coat with crumbs. Arrange in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with oil. Bake until crisp and brown about 40 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and vanilla in a bowl. Beat with wire whisk. Add milk. Mix well. Grease baking dish. Arrange bread crumbs and raisins on the bottom. Pour liquid mix over bread and raisins. Usually I put cinnamon or nutmeg on top of mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Pennies Salad
instructions: Peel carrots and slice into discs. Cook in boiling water until tender (do not overcook). Put carrots in bowl slice onions into thin rings and add to carrots. Cut green pepper into strips and add to mixture; add tomato soup undiluted. Add vinegar and oil. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill and serve.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Spread rice in bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle all but 1 tablespoon of onion soup mix over rice. Drain mushrooms saving liquid. Distribute mushrooms and pimentos over rice. Add enough hot water to mushroom liquid to make 3 cups. Pour over rice. Place browned chops on top. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon soup mix. Put in 350\u00b0 oven and bake for 1 hour. Should be covered with foil while baking.

title: Cherry Delights Cookies
instructions: Combine in large bowl the flour 2 egg yolks (add some egg white) Karo syrup sugar and margarine. Mix then chill for 20 minutes.

title: Caesar Dressing
instructions: Combine first nine ingredients in processor and blend until smooth about one minute. With machine running add both oils through feed tube in slow steady stream and blend until thick. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Daffodilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Separate dough into 12 pieces. With scissors cut each piece (almost to the center) to fashion eight flower-like petals. Indent center with tip of finger.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift into mixing bowl the flour sugar soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Cut in shortening. Add egg bananas rolled oats and nuts; beat until thoroughly blended. Drop by teaspoons about 1 1/2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 15 minutes or until edges are browned. Remove from pan; cool on rack. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Macaroni And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients; spoon mixture into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover dish and place in refrigerator overnight. Remove casserole from refrigerator; allow to set at room temperature 1 hour. Cook at 350\u00b0 with cover for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Corn Tamale
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in 1/4 cup water in a nonstick frying pan then mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Moss Ball
instructions: Place cheeses in mixer bowl; let stand at room temperature until softened. Beat on medium speed until well mixed. Add onion and Worcestershire sauce; beat well. Stir in pecans. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Roll cheese mixture into 1 large ball. Chill; roll in parsley. Put on serving plate; chill 2 hours or until firm. Serve the cheese ball with a variety of crackers.

title: Golden Chicken Breast
instructions: Put breasts in baking dish. Combine mustard and vinegar in bowl until smooth; stir in preserves. Gradually add soy sauce and stir until blended. Pour over breasts. Coat both sides. Bake meaty side down 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Turn over and bake 40 minutes or until tender. Brush with pan juices occasionally.

title: Ceasario'S Homemade Pizza Bread
instructions: In saucepan add first 7 ingredients (except Hunts tomato sauce). Bring to boil. Add Hunts tomato sauce. Stir then bring to medium heat for 4 minutes.

title: Mixed Grill Platter
instructions: Cut tofu into 8 crosswise 1/2-inch thick slices. Place on a clean kitchen towel and wrap towel around it several times. Allow it to rest for 30 minutes. Place tofu in a single layer in a large shallow baking pan. Pour half the marinade over the tofu and turn slices to coat thoroughly. Place slices of onion on top of tofu then top with a little of the marinade remaining. Place vegetables on top of onions and top with the rest of the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours. Heat grill or broiler. Pour marinade off vegetables reserving 1/2 cup. Place vegetables and tofu on a rack 4-inches from the heat in batches. Immediately combine olive oil with the 1/2 cup marinade and brush tofu and vegetables. Turn immediately to prevent sticking then grill until lightly browned on remaining side. Transfer finished vegetables and tofu from grill to serving platter and cook remaining tofu and vegetables using the same process.

title: Mexican Pot Roast
instructions: Put tenderizer on meat. Sprinkle on cumin to your taste; it sometimes is strong. Sprinkle on garlic powder (2 teaspoons). Put onions on meat. Cover with salsa. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tender. Slice it and serve with flour tortillas (warm as directed on package). Serve with Mexican rice.

title: Turtles
instructions: Butter 2 large nonstick cooking sheets. Arrange pecan halves in clusters resembling turtles. Combine cream sugar corn syrup milk and butter in saucepan. Stir on low heat until sugar dissolves. Increase heat to high and boil without stirring until mixture turns golden bubbles thickly and candy thermometer registers 234\u00b0 swirling pan occasionally about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Drop 1 tablespoon caramel onto each pecan cluster. Melt chocolate in double boiler. Drizzle 1 tablespoon chocolate onto each candy. Chill about 30 minutes.

title: Apricot Nut Tea Bread
instructions: Measure all ingredients into large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed 1/2 minute. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl constantly. Pour into pan (9 x 5 x 3 loaf pan greased and floured). Bake 55 to 65 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan; cool thoroughly before slicing.

title: Homemade Crackers(Wheat Thins)
instructions: Mix all ingredients; roll out onto 2 cookie sheets. Sprinkle with salt. Lightly roll again to press salt in. Cut into squares or diamonds with pizza cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0. After 20 minutes begin to check. Outer ones are done first. Remove as they turn golden brown and hard.

title: Escalloped Pineapple By Jack Brantley
instructions: Combine ingredients in large bowl. Stir thoroughly and pour in\tbaking\tdish. Let set several hours or overnight. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Good hot or cold.

title: Sour Cream And Chive Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in pan. Cover with water. Add salt. Cook for 25 minutes. Drain. Mash the potatoes after draining. Add sour cream milk and margarine. Add chives and pepper. Mix well. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cracked Wheat-Carrot Bread
instructions: Put cracked wheat in small bowl. Cover with boiling water. Let stand 15 minutes. Drain. Set aside. In medium bowl mix yeast sugar salt and whole wheat flour. Heat water milk and butter until very warm. Add to dry ingredients. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add cracked wheat carrots and 1/2 cup of the unbleached flour. Beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Stir in enough more flour to make a firm dough.

title: Low-Fat Quick Chili
instructions: Brown meat onion and pepper until vegetables are tender. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Mexican Style Chicken
instructions: Mix soups broth and Ro-Tel in saucepan and heat to boiling. Place chicken onion and Doritos in layers in a 9 x 13 casserole dish. Pour soups over this. Crumble chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Moravian Ginger Cookies
instructions: Mix molasses shortening and sugar thoroughly. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting. Stir together remaining ingredients; blend in. Work with hands until well blended. Cover; chill about 4 hours. (Thorough chilling is needed to make dough hold together.) Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll dough out paper thin a little at a time. Cut in desired shapes. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Frost if desired. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Cocoa Cream Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry shell and cool. In a medium saucepan stir together the sugar cocoa cornstarch and salt. Gradually stir in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Boil 1 minute; remove from heat. Gradually stir about half of the hot filling into yolks. Return all to saucepan; bring to a gentle boil. Cook and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla. Pour into pastry shell.

title: Barbecue Spread
instructions: Mix dressing and barbecue sauce. Refrigerate. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: No-Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and milk. Heat on medium until boils then add butter. Let boil for 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Grilled Fish
instructions: Brush both sides of fish with dressing and lemon juice while grilling. Sprinkle lemon pepper on fish according to taste. Grill until done.

title: Chocolate-Toffee Angel Cake
instructions: Whip the cream and fold in the grated Heath bars and fudge topping. Split the angel food cake into three layers. Fill and frost the cake with the whipped topping mixture. Refrigerate until served.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie(Prep Time: 15 Minutes; Refrigerating Time: 4 Hours.)
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup cold milk into bowl. Add pumpkin pudding mixes and spices. Beat with wire whisk until well mixed. (Mixture will be thick.) Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish with additional Cool Whip. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Mix margarine sugar and milk in heavy 2 1/2 to 3-quart saucepan and bring to a full boil; stirring constantly. Continue boiling for 5 minutes over medium heat (or until candy thermometer reaches 234\u00b0) stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cool at room temperature cut.

title: Creamed Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Slice cabbage and cook until tender. Mix soup milk and 1/2 can French fried onions together. Pour in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining French fried onions over top of cabbage. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Roll graham crackers until fine. Add milk and melt marshmallows then mix graham crackers raisins and nuts together and pour over marshmallows and mix well. Place in pan lined with waxed paper. Store in refrigerator.

title: Shredded Wheat Bread
instructions: Pour the 2 cups of boiling water over first four ingredients and cool to lukewarm. Mix yeast sugar and warm water and add to first mixture. Next add the flour. Knead 10 minutes. Let rise until doubled. Punch down and shape into loaves. Let rise to double again. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box. While warm use butter knife to punch holes in cake. Pour eagle brand milk and cream of coconut on top of warm cake. When completely cool spread cool whip on top of cake. Sprinkle shredded coconut on top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Kevin'S Oreo Dessert
instructions: Crumble 1/2 package Oreo cookies and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix oleo powdered sugar and cream cheese. In another bowl mix pudding milk and Cool Whip. Combine and pour over crumbled Oreo cookies. Crumble remaining cookies and sprinkle on top of dessert. Freeze until firm.

title: Buttercream Icing(Decorating)
instructions: With an electric mixer cream butter and shortening. In separate bowl sift powdered sugar; measure. Add powdered sugar to creamed mixtures. Add vanilla salt and milk. Mix until smooth. You may need to thin a little if too thick (should be the consistency of mashed potatoes).

title: Light Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese Cool Whip vanilla and lemon juice. Pour in crust and let chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Pork Steak Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion. Cook noodles and drain. Drain sauerkraut. Mix in casserole meat noodles sauerkraut and soup. Bake 1/2 to 1 hour at 350\u00b0. (If too dry add a little milk.)

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt. Heat oleo shortening water and cocoa. Bring to boil. Pour over flour mixture and mix well. Beat eggs soda buttermilk and vanilla. Add to mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt shortening in water and add to flour sugar and cocoa. Put soda in buttermilk; stir. Then add with eggs and vanilla to first mixture. Mix well. Bake in loaf or angel food cake pan for 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Raw Potato Dumplings(Kartoflane Kluski)
instructions: Grate potatoes; drain off brown liquid. Add beaten eggs salt crumbs and flour to make a stiff dough. Drop into boiling water from a wet spoon. Dumpling should be 1 1/2-inches long when cooked. Theyre done when they float to the top. Saute onion in skillet (low flame). Add dumplings and simmer for a few minutes.

title: Chili Chicken
instructions: Mix chicken and tomato sauce in 4-quart Dutch oven. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in beans and corn. Heat to boiling; reduce heat to low. Prepare dumplings. Drop by 12 spoonfuls onto hot chili. Cook uncovered 10 minutes. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook about 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cherry Mix Up
instructions: In pan spread cherry filling; top with pineapple and pour in dry cake mix. Mix with fork. Mash out lumps. Add nuts; add cold butter in pats. Place evenly over mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 46 to 60 minutes or until brown.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Store in airtight container. Use at least 2 teaspoons in 1 cup boiling water.

title: Raisin Bread
instructions: Mix altogether. Put batter in well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Frozen Cranberry Banana Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple juice into a medium bowl; set pineapple aside. Add bananas to the juice. In a large bowl combine cranberry sauce and sugar. Remove bananas discarding juice and add to cranberry mixture. Stir in pineapple whipped topping and nuts. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Freeze until solid. Remove from the freezer 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients about 3 to 4 minutes. Place in greased and prepared pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done about 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool. Remove from pan. Top with Cool Whip and strawberries.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Grind up Oreo cookies and set aside. Combine cream cheese margarine and sugar and set aside. Combine pudding milk and Cool Whip. Add cream cheese mixture and layer with Oreo cookies in flower pot. Add artificial flowers and serve with a garden trowel.

title: Sugared Peanuts
instructions: Combine sugar and water in large heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add nuts and flavoring. Cook on medium heat; stir constantly until mixture is dry and peanuts are sugar-coated and crystallized. Place in flat pan and bake in 250\u00b0 oven about 1 to 1 1/2 hours checking every 30 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Gumbo
instructions: Boil the chicken until thoroughly done. Remove skin and meat off the bone (except for wings leave intact). Dice meat into bite size chunks. Note when boiling chicken season water well. Save approximately 2 to 3 cups stock depending on amount of gumbo you make. Drain remaining stock.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Add flour to onion mixture. Add 1/2 of the Velveeta to onion-flour mixture. Add the eggs to the broccoli; mix well. Combine rice soup broccoli and cheese mixture. Fold in last 1/2 of Velveeta. Put into buttered casserole dish. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Molasses Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking soda spices and salt. Combine molasses lard butter and water in large bowl. Add dry ingredients to liquid; blend well. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Turn onto well floured bread board. Using well floured rolling pin roll to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with cookie cutter. Sprinkle with sugar and place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven 12 minutes. Cool on racks. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Non-Cook Cookies
instructions: Boil oleo sugar and milk for 1 1/2 minutes. Add vanilla peanut butter and oats. Place on waxed paper. Let air dry until hard.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Cream the cheese and butter. Combine flour and red pepper. Add to creamed mixture mixing well. Shape dough into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness. Brush wafers with beaten egg. Top each wafer with pecan half. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from pan while hot. Sprinkle lightly with salt.

title: Barb'S Marbled Cheesecake Deluxe
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Prepare Chocolate Crumb Crust. Stir together margarine and cocoa until smooth. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Beat in eggs and vanilla then flour. Measure 1 1/2 cups batter into medium bowl. Beat in cocoa mixture.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour in buttered casserole dish.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook cabbage for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Cut out core. Put meat mixture in center of cabbage leaf. Roll up and toothpick rolls together if needed. Pour can of stewed tomatoes over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Curry Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the chicken pieces in a casserole or roaster. Mix thoroughly to blend spices. Add chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until chicken and rice are tender and liquid is absorbed.

title: Choco-Caramel Cake
instructions: Mix caramels milk and margarine. Cover low heat until melted. Mix cake as directed on label. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 in. pan and pour in one half of cake batter. Cook in 350 oven for 15 minutes. Spread caramel mixture over hot cake and sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips. Cover with the remaining cake batter. Bake for 20 minutes in oven at 250. Then raise oven temperature to 350 and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Birthday Cake Icing
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Add Crisco powdered sugar water and flavoring. Beat until desired spreading consistency.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Use two 9 x 5-inch pans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. For an angel cake pan bake 2 1/2 hours.

title: Diviinty
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and water to soft ball stage. Add half of hot mixture to egg whites and beat until cool. Let remaining syrup cool until it forms hard ball in cold water. Add to egg white mixture and beat until smooth. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into buttered pan; spread 1 inch thick. Cut into squares.

title: Trinity Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine lemon juice soy sauce ginger and pepper; pour over chicken in shallow baking dish. Bake in preheated oven (350\u00b0) for 15 minutes. Arrange fruit about chicken. Baste with liquid and bake 10 minutes.

title: Cube Steak And Gravy
instructions: Roll steak in flour and brown both sides. Place in crock-pot. Mix gravy mix and pour over steak. Cook all day on low or until steak is tender.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients together for 10 minutes over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Combine with remaining ingredients (all but coconut). Mix thoroughly. Drop by tablespoonfuls into shredded coconut and hand roll into balls. Yields 36 snowballs.

title: Fall Harvest Rice
