instructions: Cook sausage in skillet stirring to crumble. Drain well. Combine sausage rice apple onion celery raisins sugar salt allspice cinnamon and pepper. Spoon into a 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 8 servings.

title: Grandma'S Homemade Cider
instructions: Place spices in tea ball. Put with rest of ingredients in crock-pot. Turn on high for 30 minutes then on low until ready to serve. Remove spices after a couple of hours.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar butter milk and cocoa for 3 minutes; stir while boiling. Take pan off stove and add oats peanut butter and vanilla. Mix until blended. Drop on wax paper.

title: Quick, Tasty Pork Chops
instructions: Wash center cut pork chops. Rub thoroughly on both sides with salt and pepper to taste; place in foil covered shallow pan. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce on each side of the chops. Rubbing it in and turning every 5 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown first 3 ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Put in slow cooker or bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat 10 minutes and put into tube pan.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Cream well butter and cheese; add dry ingredients. Mix well. Bake on ungreased sheet at 300\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Start on bottom rack; move up last 5 minutes.

title: Elegant Chicken Crepes
instructions: In a saucepan combine onion and water. Cook; cover 5 minutes. Do not drain. Combine milk cornstarch salt and pepper; add to onion. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minute more. Add cheese; stir to melt. Reserve 1/2 cup cheese mixture. Add mushrooms to remaining cheese mixture; cover and set aside.

title: Barbecued Limas
instructions: Fry diced bacon. Add chopped onion chopped pepper sugar tomato paste Worcestershire sauce and chopped garlic. Simmer 10 minutes. Add drained beans. Bake in casserole for 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Anna'S Delight Twists
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour shortening or olive oil vanilla and sour cream. Mix yeast with flour mixture. Cover with plastic; cool in refrigerator for 1 hour. It rises. Take out half of dough. Roll it out flat sprinkle with sugar. Repeat 2 more times. Cut flattened dough in half and then into strips and twist. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Melt shortening. Add flour; stir until it is brown. Lower heat. Add shrimp and cook about 3 minutes or until pink. Add garlic onion parsley and bell pepper; cook 2 minutes longer. Raise heat. Gradually add water then remaining ingredients. Bring to boil then simmer covered for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve hot over rice. Serves 4. Very good!

title: Cherry Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco margarine sugar eggs and vanilla. Add flour alternately with milk. Fold in chopped cherries. Pour into tube pan and place in cold oven. Bake for 2 hours at 275\u00b0. Cool on rack about 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely. Mix together the following ingredients for Cherry Frosting and frost cold cake.

title: New Potato Salad
instructions: Boil unpeeled potatoes; reduce heat to medium. Slice into bite size pieces (unpeeled). Mix oil and next 7 ingredients. Add potatoes and celery. Toss to mix well. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Deer Steak And Gravy
instructions: Roll deer steaks in flour and brown. Pour favorite soup over steak. Add mushrooms. Bake all this in oven until tender. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sweet-Sour Green Beans
instructions: Place beans onion rings and almonds in layers in casserole. Fry bacon crisp. Mix sugar and vinegar with drippings. Bring to a boil. Pour over beans. Let marinate overnight. Crumble bacon on top. Heat at 350\u00b0 until piping hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheese Boxes
instructions: Melt oleo and cheese over low heat. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add cheese mixture beating until blended. Stack 3 slices of bread trim off crust. Spread each layer and top with cheese mixture. Cut stacks into 4 boxes. Spread cheese mixture thinly around edges and top like icing. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 28 to 30. Freeze and remove and bake as directed.

title: Fan'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time beating after each egg. Add flour and milk alternately. Add salt and flavorings. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Choco-Holic Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small saucepan melt butter. Remove from heat. Stir in Nestle Choco Bake. Cool to room temperature.

title: Warm And Spicy Autumn Punch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Stud the whole oranges with cloves and bake for 30 minutes. In a large saucepan combine the apple juice and cinnamon stick. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the nutmeg honey lemon juice and pineapple juice. Serve hot in a punch bowl with the 2 clove-studded baked oranges floating on top.

title: Custard Bread Pudding
instructions: Start by preheating oven to 350\u00b0. Fill a large pan halfway with water and stick in oven while waiting for bread pudding to be mixed. You will need a 10 x 10 x 2-inch pan to put bread pudding in.

title: Nickelodeon Cake
instructions: Cook in oven 20 minutes just a little bit hot.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix well. Freeze. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Chop up raw cabbage. Add oil vinegar salt pepper and celery seed. Make ahead good next day.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Whisk together first 5 ingredients. Pour over crackers stir to coat. Place on baking sheets and bake at 275\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 12 cups.

title: Fennel Chews
instructions: Beat butter sugar and egg thoroughly. Add vanilla fennel and nuts. Mix well. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Dough will be thick and a bit difficult to spread.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in salted water until just tender; drain well. Mix other ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour over carrots. Cool and put in refrigerator. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Mix both cans of sauce in a bowl. Pour a little of the mixture into the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan enough to just coat. Reserve remainder. In a heavy skillet brown the meat. Add taco seasoning and water per package directions. Simmer 10 minutes. Dice onion. Shred cheese.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients saving some cheese and crackers for topping. Place into a casserole dish. Top with the rest of the cheese and crackers. Bake for 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Raspberry Frost
instructions: Be sure pineapple juice and ginger ale are chilled. Combine 1/4 of juice sherbet and ginger ale in blender until light and frothy about one minute. Pour into large punch bowl. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Stir in undrained thawed raspberries.

title: Half-Cup Pie
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice well. Add other ingredients and mix. Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill.

title: Peanut Butter Pie(Children Love This Pie.  So Do Adults!)
instructions: Mix well peanut butter powdered sugar cream cheese and milk. Pour into graham cracker crust and sprinkle nuts on top. When sliced for serving dip large tablespoon of Cool Whip on top. Keep refrigerated.

title: Fried Bean Cakes
instructions: To beans add enough self-rising flour to make the mix thick. Add pepper to taste. Fry in enough oil on medium heat until brown on both sides.

title: Summertime Drink
instructions: Mix well and serve.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil and debone chicken. Layer 6 tortillas (having been dipped in hot chicken stock) half of chicken and sprinkle with garlic and chili powder according to taste. Add half of bell pepper and onion. Repeat layers.

title: Broccoli-Pecan Salad
instructions: Break or cut broccoli into bite size pieces. Add nuts raisins onion and bacon bits.

title: Honey-Glazed Chicken
instructions: In a bowl or bag combine flour salt and cayenne pepper; add chicken pieces and dredge or shake to coat. Pour 4 tablespoons butter into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; place chicken in pan turning pieces once to coat. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine brown sugar honey lemon juice soy sauce curry powder and remaining butter; pour over chicken. Bake 45 minutes more or until chicken is tender basting several times with pan drippings. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Saute grated onion in melted butter. Alternate layers of cooked carrots grated cheese and sauteed onion. Top with bread crumbs. Bake about 1/2 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Barbara'S Back Porch Rolls
instructions: Put Crisco sugar and salt in large bowl. Pour in boiling water and stir. Add beaten eggs and stir well. Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water. Add Crisco mixture. Gradually stir in 6 cups unsifted flour. Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. Roll out and cut with a 2-inch cutter. Put in greased muffin tins and let rise until double about 3 or 4 hours. Bake in preheated oven at 425\u00b0 for 7 or 9 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Pea Fritters
instructions: Prepare skillet with shortening or oil for frying. Mash peas with a fork and add egg flour pepper and salt. Stir then drop with tablespoon in patties in skillet. Fry on medium to low heat until brown on each side. Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Mix cake ingredients well. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 to 345\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Fried Cucumbers
instructions: Slice cucumbers. Dip into beaten eggs and coat with meal and flour mixture. Heat 1/2 cup oil in frying pan. Fry cucumbers turning occasionally until tender.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add sifted dry ingredients. Stir in vanilla and milk. Add walnuts then eggs. Pour into greased and floured 3 (9-inch) cake pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in casserole dish. Combine both corns and sour cream. Pour into butter. Sprinkle corn bread mix over corn mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Purple Monster
instructions: Put milk berries sugar and 1 pint of vanilla ice cream in blender. Cover and blend on high speed until smooth. Pour into glasses and top with a scoop of ice cream. Garnish with fresh blueberries. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Custard
instructions: In heavy saucepan scald 3 cups milk (do not boil). In a bowl beat\ttogether the eggs sugar and salt. Beat well then stir in the cup of cold milk. Add some of the hot milk to the mixture. Mix well then gradually add to the rest of the hot milk. Cook over just medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture coats the back of the spoon (do not overcook or let boil). Strain. Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Best if allowed to ripen in refrigerator or until next day.

title: The Best Carrot Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and oil. Add eggs; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Sift dry ingredients together. Combine with liquids. Beat at low speed for 1 minute. Add carrots nuts and raisins and mix to blend. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. (I use one 9 x 13-inch pan). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Do not open oven door during baking time. Frost with cream cheese icing when cold.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter sugar and egg. Sift all dry ingredients together. Combine banana and yogurt in bowl; stir to mix. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternating with banana mixture until all is blended together. Stir in pecans. Pour in greased pans 1/2 full and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Yields 3 small loaves.

title: Lemon Ice Box Pie
instructions: Mix lemonade and milk together. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust and refrigerate. Serve when chilled.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into balls. Roll in powdered sugar and let dry.

title: Toffee Bars
instructions: Mix flour butter sugar and egg yolk; real well. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. After baking place Hershey bars on baked crust. Spread when Hershey bars are melted and sprinkle top with nuts.

title: Chunky Vegetables Over Shells
instructions: In large pot combine all ingredients except shells. Simmer over low heat until carrots are tender (about 30 minutes). Serve over cooked shells.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa salad dressing and vanilla together. Add flour baking powder and salt. Stir in warm water. Bake in a greased baking pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Swiss Steak Smothered With Onions
instructions: Coat surface of steak with a mixture of flour salt marjoram and pepper. Brown steak well on both sides in hot shortening in a large frypan with close fitting cover. Sprinkle any remaining flour mixture over steak. Add 1 cup of onions and the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Add remaining onions. Cover; continue cooking until meat is fork-tender about 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat together eggs sugar and oil. Mix in flour baking powder soda salt cinnamon and vanilla. Add zucchini and nuts. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Very good with cream cheese that has been thinned a little with milk and powdered sugar.

title: Zucchini Cheese Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook zucchini until tender. Mix all ingredients and spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Add sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add milk blending thoroughly with mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. Freeze until firm.

title: Ham And Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add milk ham salt and pepper. Pour into 2 unbaked 9-inch pie shells. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Other ingredients may be added such as peppers mushrooms bacon etc. Makes 2 pies.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream cream cheese taco seasoning and spread in bottom of platter of pan (approximately 13 x 9-inch). Top with lettuce onions tomatoes and cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream eggs shortening and sugar. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Morning Glory Muffins(375~ Oven)
instructions: Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin tins or use paper liners. Mix cereal and milk in large bowl; let stand 5 minutes or until softened. Stir in remaining ingredients. Fill tins almost full. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from pans.

title: Creamy Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients stirring well. Serve with Australian Outback Salad or fresh fruit salad.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Cook chicken (skin and remove fat) in salted water with bay leaf until tender. Remove from broth throw away bay leaf. Remove bones and cut or tear meat into pieces; set aside. In very large bowl or pan crumble cornbread and white bread; add seasoning chicken broth and soup. Mix thoroughly. If too dry add the can of water. Mix in chicken. Generously grease 3-quart baking dish or roaster pan. Put dressing in pan. Dot with butter or margarine. Bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Orange Chocolate Balls
instructions: Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan. Add the chocolate and melt over low heat. Remove from heat. Cool slightly. In a bowl beat the sugar and continue beating until light and creamy. Add the chocolate mixture and the orange rind and pecans. Put the mixture in the refrigerator. Chill until set and easy to handle. With two spoons roll the mixture into balls. Place chocolate sprinkles on a piece of waxed paper. Roll the chocolate balls in sprinkles until covered. Let chocolate balls firm up in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Cranberry Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a large glass bowl combine cranberries broccoli cabbage walnuts raisins onion and bacon. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cranberry mixture. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Serve on leafy lettuce. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: You will need a graham cracker crust in a pie plate. Spoon softened rainbow sherbet into shell and freeze hard. Top with 1 small carton of Cool Whip. Add candy sprinkles or shaved chocolate for color. Freeze. Slice and serve.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Break chicken into pieces and line bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix both cans of soup with 1/2 cup milk and salt and pepper to taste. Pour over the chicken. Cover with Pepperidge Farm stuffing. Combine melted margarine with 1/2 cup of chicken broth and pour over top of stuffing. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Drain clams; place aside. Add reserved juice gradually to clams and cream cheese. Add Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco seasoned salt pepper and garlic salt to taste.

title: Pumpkin Bars With Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Butter and flour 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Add 1 cup chopped walnuts. Pour into pans. Bake 25 minutes. When cool frost with cream cheese frosting. May be frozen up to 6 months.

title: Hermit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs (one at a time). Sift flour and cinnamon twice leaving enough to flour fruit. Add nuts. Put in vanilla and bake 3 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine cream flour salt paprika garlic powder pepper and onion. Arrange one cup of potatoes in the bottom of a two qt casserole dish cover with 1/3 of the cream mixture and dot with 1/3 of the butter. Top with two more layers of potatoes and cream mixture. Then pour the boiling water over the top of the layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hr or until potatoes are tender.

title: Sirloin Kabobs
instructions: Cut bacon into 1 1/2-inch squares. Thread skewers with sirloin bacon and mushrooms caps. Repeat until skewers are full. Marinate in dressing for 2 or 3 hours at room temperature turning frequently. Cook over charcoal grilled to desired doneness.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Mix all together in a cake pan. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sugared Nuts
instructions: Combine sugars and sour cream in large saucepan. Cover over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved. Continue cooking without stirring to 234\u00b0 on candy thermometer or until mixture forms soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir gently until all nuts are cooked. Pour on wax paper. Separate nuts with fork. Let dry; store in airtight container.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into cubes. Place in boiling water and cook 5 minutes to soften slightly. Drain. In large kettle place potatoes cream-style corn and oleo. Add evaporated milk and whole milk. Cook on medium to low heat until oleo is melted and milk is warm. Dont boil. Stir occasionally to avoid sticking.

title: Wilda'S Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Brown pork in fat; add water cover and simmer 1 hour. Drain pineapple and save syrup. Combine brown sugar vinegar and soy sauce; add to pork. Mix cornstarch well with pineapple juice and add. Continue cooking stirring until gravy thickens. Add pineapple green pepper and onion. Cook 2 to 3 minutes and serve over rice with soy sauce.

title: Jelled Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in the boiling water. Add the cranberry sauce and pineapple and stir until well mixed. Pour the mixture into a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish. Place in the refrigerator until slightly thickened about 30 minutes. Remove from the refrigerator and stir in the pecans. Place back in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours or overnight before serving. Cut into 12 servings and use a spatula to remove. Enjoy!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli about 8 minutes in boiling water. Drain. Mix mushroom soup mayonnaise onion cheese and egg with broccoli.

title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Dip chicken in egg milk and bread crumbs. Brown lightly in olive oil. Remove chicken and set aside. Make gravy with flour and butter. When bubbly add wine and water. May need to add more water to get to right consistency. Squeeze in lemon juice. Add chicken to gravy. Slice lemons on top. Add salt and garlic. Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Serve over pasta. Soooo Good!

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix carrots sugar eggs vegetable oil and nuts by hand. Mix well and add the flour salt soda and cinnamon. Mix all by hand; do not beat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in a well-greased cake pan. Cool well and ice with cream cheese icing.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and celery in margarine. Combine remainder of ingredients except for topping and mix well. Spoon into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with bread and dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. If mixed ahead of time and refrigerated increase baking time to 10 to 15 minutes. Extra rice and grated cheese may be added.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Saute onion in oleo in microwave. Crumble bread crumbs. Add onion oleo eggs chicken soup and seasonings. Add enough broth to make it fairly soupy. Can use canned broth or instant bouillon and water. Cook in crock-pot on low 4 hours.

title: Chocolate Chip Mint Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl beat sugar brown sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add eggs; blend well. Stir in flour mixture; mix well. Stir in mint chips.

title: Portuguese Beans
instructions: Slice and saute linguica; add sirloin. Pour off fat. Saute onion mushrooms bell pepper and garlic. Add to meat and let simmer. Salt and pepper to taste. In a large slow cooker or stew pot add all ingredients and simmer for 2 to 3 hours. Add 5 to 6 slices of bacon in the last hour.

title: Spiced Ham Rolls
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and let marinate overnight. Freeze rolls so that they are hard and slice them lengthwise like a big sandwich bun. Spread mustard mixture on bottom of rolls. Layer Swiss cheese ham more cheese etc. Spread rest of mustard mixture on underside of rolls. Spread a little mixture on top of sandwich. Cover with foil; bake about 15 minutes at 300\u00b0. Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes more. Slice into individual sandwiches. They stay together better if you leave them in the foil pan the rolls came in.

title: Marinated Fruit
instructions: Combine fruit. Combine liquids and pour over fruit. Chill for two hours.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar in a large bowl till smooth and add applesauce eggs and milk and beat till smooth. Add bananas and beat at low speed. Then beat at high speed 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Googy Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix 1 egg and melted margarine and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together cream cheese 2 eggs and confectioners sugar and pour over top of mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheese In A Bread Bowl
instructions: Hollow out the loaf of bread reserving as much as possible to slice thin for the dip. Saw-tooth the crust as you would a watermelon.

title: Beef Stroganoff With Rice And Potatoes
instructions: Cut meat in small strips (cuts easier if frozen). Sprinkle meat with seasonings. Brown meat in heavy skillet with shortening or oil. Stir in mushroom soup and 1 cup of beef broth. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until meat is tender. Add onions and cook 10 minutes longer.

title: Cranberry-Apple Punch
instructions: Heat water and sugar to boiling stirring until sugar dissolves. Cool. Chill all ingredients. Stir together in large punch bowl. Makes 60 servings.

title: Chopstick Tuna
instructions: Set aside 1 cup of Chow Mein Noodles. Mix remaining ingredients mix well. Put in 10x6x1 1\\2 baking dish. Sprinkle with cup of chow mein noodles. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 min.

title: Apples And Cheese
instructions: Pour apples into 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish. Melt together margarine and Velveeta cheese then add sugar. Remove from heat and add flour. Add to apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and browning approximately 30 minutes.

title: Quick Cacciatore
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the pasta. Bring to a boil in a skillet. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serve over hot pasta.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Prepare instant potatoes for 6 servings. Add cream egg chopped onion and sour cream. Sprinkle with paprika. Combine ingredients and bake for 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Dole Golden Sauce For Ham
instructions: In saucepan combine juice and remaining ingredients. Heat until it boils and thickens. Add pineapple slices. Heat through. Spoon over cooked ham or chicken.

title: Date Balls(No Bake)
instructions: Melt oleo and sugar together. Add dates and bring to a boil. Add eggs and milk to date mixture and boil for 2 minutes. Cool slightly (15 minutes) then add Rice Krispies salt vanilla and nuts. Cool. Form into balls when you are able to roll them in your hand. Roll in flaked or shredded coconut.

title: French Mustard
instructions: Cook all ingredients until thickens. Mix with ground ham or any meat.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs and beat 1 minute. Add cocoa and vanilla. Put red cake coloring in buttermilk. Add slowly with flour. Put vinegar in soda and add last. Make 3 layers and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook chicken and onion in water to make broth. When done remove chicken from bones and add to broth.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan layer the pineapple and pie filling. Sprinkle cake mix over cherries. Over cake mix sprinkle pecans. Cut margarine into patties and place on top of nuts. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve with Cool Whip ice cream or just plain.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix as package directs. Pour 2 cups batter into pan and bake 15 minutes. Melt caramels and margarine in saucepan and remove from heat. Add milk and mix well. Spread caramel mixture evenly over cake. Spread remaining cake batter over caramel mixture. Top with nuts. Return cake to oven and bake 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back. Cool and serve.

title: Mushroom Roll-Ups
instructions: Peel mushrooms and dice then saute for five minutes in butter. Blend in flour salt and Accent. Stir in cream and simmer until thick. Add chives and lemon juice. Blend well. Remove crusts from bread and roll slices thin. Spread with mushroom mixture and roll up. Pack and freeze if desired. When ready to serve defrost; cut each roll in half and toast on all sides in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Saute onion celery and mushrooms in butter until tender. Combine broccoli soup and cheese. Cook over low heat until cheese melts stirring occasionally. Add sauteed vegetables to broccoli mixture stirring well. Serve hot.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil white potatoes cool and cut in small cubes. Chop celery onions and green pepper very fine. Combine all ingredients with salad dressing and mix with potatoes. Garnish with paprika.

title: White Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix well; put into casserole dish and sprinkle coconut lightly on top. Put small marshmallows on top and brown lightly. Use more or less pecans raisins and coconut as you like.

title: Peter Pan Cookies
instructions: Combine Crisco salt and peanut butter; mix well. Add granulated sugar and brown sugar gradually and cream thoroughly. Add beaten eggs and mix well. Stir in flour and soda blending well. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Press cookies lightly with a fork. Bake in a slow oven (325\u00b0) 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Spaghettini Bolognese
instructions: Saute mushrooms carrot garlic onion celery and green pepper in Wesson oil in Dutch oven. Add sausage; cook until sausage loses redness. Drain fat. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over hot cooked spaghettini. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: French Potato Salad
instructions: Put potatoes in serving bowl. Mix all other ingredients very well then drizzle over potatoes. Gently stir until all potatoes are covered with dressing. May be served warm or cold. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Meat Loaf With Vegetables
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into loaf. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 10 servings.

title: Beef Dish
instructions: Put first 7 ingredients in crock-pot. Cook 5 to 6 hours. After sour cream. Serve over rice.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger until done in skillet. Peel and slice potatoes about 1/3-inch thick. Mix enough water with soup to make 3 cups. Open and drain beans. Put a layer of potatoes green beans salt and half of hamburger. Repeat layer. Pour soup over top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meat
instructions: Roast sesame seed in frying pan until brown. Remove from heat and crush. Mix seed wine and onions in bowl with sliced meat and let stand for 1 hour or more. Put meat on grill until cooked.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in crock-pot. Add soup and water. Cook on high for about 8 hours.

title: Mixed Nut Candy
instructions: Cook sugar and butter to 300\u00b0 or until the mixture turns brown. Spread mixed nuts in jelly roll pan. Pour cooked mixture over nuts. Top with chocolate chips. Spread with wooden spoon. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Fail Proof Rolls
instructions: Mix sugar shortening and hot water; add cold water salt and eggs. In small bowl mix yeast warm water and salt. Add to first mix; add flour and mix well. Cover with cloth (wet). Refrigerate; let rise until double in height. Take out and make rolls. Brush with melted butter. Rise 1 hour or until doubles in size. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Put ingredients into saucepan and cook over medium heat until hot. Put crushed chips shredded Monterey Jack cheese and chopped avocado (optional) into serving bowl and ladle soup over it.

title: Pecan Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar molasses and egg. Sift together the dry ingredients. Add to cream mixture then add butterscotch morsels. Chill 2 hours. Shape into 1 inch balls and roll in granulated sugar. Place in sprayed cookie pan. Top with pecan and bake at 370\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coffee Bars
instructions: Mix and place on large cookie sheet. Sprinkle with nuts and butterscotch bits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Wash and trim broccoli; cut stalks into spears. Cook broccoli covered in a small amount of boiling unsalted water about 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain.

title: Easy Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Add evaporated milk sugar whole milk and vanilla. (If adding fruit process in blender and add to mixture.) Freeze in electric or crank freezer.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix together use 1/4 to 1/2 cup mix for each cup. Pour boiling water over mix.

title: French Fried Carrots
instructions: Peel and cut in half; drop in hot grease in \Fry Daddy\ or deep fryer. Cook as you would French fried potatoes.

title: Chicken Salad Pie
instructions: Mix together chicken cheese celery pineapple nuts paprika mayonnaise and 1/2 cup Cool Whip. Pile in a baked pie crust. Pillsburys ready to bake crust is good. Frost top with 1 cup Cool Whip and garnish with grated carrots. Chill until serving time. Serves 6.

title: Venison Chili
instructions: Brown ground venison; drain. Mix all ingredients in slow cooker. Add garlic salt pepper and chili powder to your own taste. Cook for several hours in slow cooker.

title: Diabetic Easter Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate in top of double boiler. Add evaporated milk and stir for 2 to 3 minutes then add vanilla and sweetener. Spread on small foil pan or plate. Chill. Cut into 8 small pieces. Form into egg shaped ball and roll lightly in pudding powder or nuts.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Season ribs with seasoned salt and pepper. Roast in shallow covered pan about 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Drain off fat. Make spaghetti sauce mix as directed on package using tomato sauce and omit oil. Add remaining ingredients; simmer 15 minutes. Pour over ribs; continue roasting uncovered about 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Baste several times.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill several hours before serving.

title: The Natural Tomato Sauce
instructions: Saute onions and pepper to juice of tomatoes in saucepan and bring to boil. Let simmer until reduced about half in volume. Cut tomatoes in small pieces or mash and add with seasoning to juice. Let simmer briefly. (Should be quite thick.) Serve over patties.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in bowl and mix with hands. Make into balls and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Nell Reynold'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: From Harriet Looks cookbook.

title: Chunky Artichoke Salsa
instructions: Drain marinade from artichokes. Chop artichokes with onion olives and tomatoes. Add garlic basil salt and pepper and stir. Chill and serve. Makes 2 cups.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Lay dough on cookie sheet joined together making a crust. Bake according to package directions. Let cool. Mix cream cheese dressing and mayonnaise with mixer. Spread on top of crust. Prepare vegetables and arrange on top of crust with dressing. Add cheese. Refrigerate 1 hour before cutting into pieces.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour cream of tartar soda and salt into mixing bowl. Cut in shortening until it is a very fine crumb. Beat eggs with sugar and vanilla. Add to flour mixture. Mix well. Shape into balls about the size of a walnut. Place on cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Flatten each with bottom of a small glass tumbler covered with a dampened cloth. (Or you may first dip the bottom of the tumbler in oil and then in sugar.) Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) about 8 to 10 minutes until light brown. Yield 3 dozen cookies.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. In separate bowl mix eggs sugar and vegetable oil. Add flour mixture and beat well. Add pumpkin and beat into mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cool Cookie-Wiches
instructions: Prepare a batter for a white cake. Bake as small drop cakes. Cool. Cover with white icing. Roll in coconut.

title: Mexican Chicken Kiev
instructions: Put chicken between 2 pieces of wax paper and pound to 1/4-inch thick. Put 2 tablespoons chiles and 1 strip cheese in center of each chicken piece. Roll up and tuck ends under. Combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese chili powder salt cumin and pepper. Roll each stuffed chicken piece in shallow bowl containing melted butter. Roll in crumb mixture. Place chicken rolls seam side down in baking dish and drizzle with little melted butter. Cover and chill 4 hours or overnight. Bake uncovered in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Cute Cheese Cake Cups
instructions: You will also need 2-inch round foil baking cups.

title: Holiday Double Onion Stuffing
instructions: In large skillet brown bacon lightly. Drain off all but 2 tablespoons drippings. Add apples and celery; cook until tender. Remove from heat. Add onions stuffing and almonds and mix well. Mix eggs water thyme and broth. Pour over stuffing and mix well. Spoon into 8 x 12-inch greased pan or baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes then add Durkee onions to top of stuffing. Bake 5 minutes and serve. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Bundt Pan Bread
instructions: Take the biscuits and stand them up around the sides of the Bundt pan. Pour the oleo over the top and sides of the biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Pulls apart for slices.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Pour 1 cup boiling water over dates soda and butter. Let stand until cool. Add egg flour sugar chopped nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a greased and floured 12 x 7-inch pan.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop about 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto a hot greased griddle. Cook about 5 minutes or until brown; turn once to brown other side.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed. Stir in soup and wine. Heat through. Stir in mushrooms and shrimp. Turn into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Cover with Parmesan. Broil until lightly browned.

title: Fun Milk
instructions: Or use 2 teaspoons sweetened Kool-Aid. Omit sugar and water. Increase milk to 1 cup.

title: Country Ham Steak With Glazed Apples
instructions: In skillet melt margarine until sizzling. Stir in brown sugar and mustard. Add apples. Cook over medium heat. Stir occasionally until apples are crisply tender. Place ham in skillet with apples on top. Cover. Cook until ham is heated through.

title: Banana Bread*
instructions: Cream shortening and eggs. Dissolve soda in mashed bananas and add together. Add nuts sugar flour and salt. Place in greased bread pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mini Pizzas
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. On a cookie sheet place slightly flattened biscuit. Top with about 2 teaspoons pizza sauce then add a couple shreds of cheese and your other toppings. Bake about 10 minutes.

title: Indian Corn
instructions: Brown beef and drain grease. Add all remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Fish
instructions: Mix sauce (the first 6 ingredients) in large kettle and cook slowly for 1 hour. Cool sauce. Rinse fish and dry. Sprinkle lime juice over fish slices and season with salt. Flour both sides lightly when ready to fry. Heat olive oil with crushed garlic in frypan. Remove garlic as soon as it browns. Fry fish slices on low heat 15 minutes. Remove and arrange in deep glass dish. Pour sauce over it. Cover; refrigerate at least 24 hours. Serve cold.

title: Sunshine Cake
instructions: Sift flour and sugar; make a well. Add oil yolks and liquid; beat well with a spoon. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until very stiff. Fold egg yolk mixture over egg whites. Gently fold until blended. Pour into 10-inch tube pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes. Invert; cool.

title: Fresh Pear Cake
instructions: Combine sugar eggs and oil. Beat well. Combine flour soda and salt. Add sugar mixture one cup at a time. Mix well. Stir in vanilla cinnamon and pears. Spoon into a well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or a little longer.

title: Shelley'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Pour cooked broccoli in a baking dish. Put velveeta cheese chunks and crushed crackers over broccoli. Drizzle melted butter over everything.

title: Pork Chops With Amber Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops in heavy skillet; season with salt and pepper. Place rice in a 12 x 10 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour orange juice over rice. Arrange browned pork chops on rice. Pour soup over all. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Pig In A Blanket
instructions: Flatten the biscuits 1 at a time. Put a hot dog on biscuit. Bring edges up to cover hot dog. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve with mustard ketchup or relish.

title: Go Go Salad
instructions: Mix all fruits together and serve cold.

title: Strawberry Glace Pie
instructions: Cut up 1 cup of strawberries. Mix with sugar and cornstarch in a 2-quart saucepan. Stir in water gradually until smooth. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and clear. Add red food coloring (if desired). Cool. Stir in remaining berries saving 1/4 cup for garnish. Pour into crust. Chill until firm (3 hours). Top with Cool Whip; garnish with berries.

title: Oriental Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon.

title: Frosty Pudding Milkshake
instructions: Pour milk into blender. Add pudding mix and ice cream; cover. Blend at high speed 30 seconds. Scrape sides of container; blend 30 seconds longer. Pour into glasses. Top with club soda. Serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Creamy Chocolate Squares
instructions: Arrange 15 graham squares on bottom of 13 x 9 pan. Beat cream cheese in bowl until smooth. Gradually beat in 1 cup milk until blended. Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Beat for 2 minutes. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread half the pudding mixture over graham squares. Top with remaining graham squares and pudding mix. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Potato Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in skin until tender. Cut into 1/2-inch slices. In buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish cover bottom with potato slices. Cover with layer of crumbled bacon. Sprinkle with onions and then cheese. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over layered pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
instructions: Mix together Cool Whip and condensed milk. Sprinkle Kool-Aid on top and stir until firm. Put in baked pie shell and refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until done; drain. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day grate potatoes. Mix with other ingredients. Place in shallow 2 quart baking dish and bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Dirt Pie
instructions: Pour milk into medium bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Let stand for 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping. Stir 1 cup of cookies and rocks* into the pudding mixture. Spoon onto pie crust. Sprinkle remaining cookies. Freeze until firm 4 hours. Garnish with gumdrop flowers or gummie worms.

title: Veal Cacciatore
instructions: Brown veal add seasonings cover and let simmer for about 1 hour. Add tomato sauce mushrooms and peas. Cook over low heat turning occasionally until tender.

title: Two-Step Batter Fried Chicken
instructions: Sift together the dry ingredients. Mix egg milk and 1 tablespoon corn oil. Add to flour mixture and beat. Dip chicken into batter coating completely. Drain. Pour corn oil into deep fryer or 3-quart saucepan. Heat oil to 375\u00b0. Carefully add chicken a few pieces at a time. Fry about 4 minutes; drain. Place in a shallow baking pan and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer 1 French onion dip Ranch mix and cream cheese mixed.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar salt soda and cinnamon in bowl. Stir in nuts. Mix vanilla eggs oil bananas and pineapple in bowl. Add to flour mixture; mix just until moistened. Spoon into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until bread tests done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool completely. Pan may be prepared with nonstick baking spray. May substitute 2 loaf pans for Bundt pan. Yield 16 servings.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Chop onions and tomato. Pit and remove pulp from avocados. Add onions tomato and lemon juice to avocado pulp. Mix well. Chill. Serve with corn chips.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add remaining ingredients. Fill container then finish filling with whole milk to make a gallon. Freeze in gallon freezer.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In bowl combine flour cinnamon baking soda baking powder salt and allspice; set aside. Cream eggs oil brown sugar and white sugar together. Add grated zucchini and vanilla; mix well. Add dry ingredients and chopped nuts. Mix. Pour into 2 loaf pans (greased and floured). Bake at 250\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Italian Sesame Seed Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar; set aside 5 minutes or until bubbly. Add salt oil and 3 tablespoons sesame seed. Stir in flour slowly until a stiff dough forms. Turn on lightly floured board. Knead 10 minutes until dough is smooth and satiny. Cut into 4 pieces. Shape or cut each piece into 3 parts about 30-inches long. Braid. Place braid in tight coil on greased baking sheet. Let rise until doubled.

title: Pinto Bean Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put by tablespoonfuls into skillet of hot grease. Turn with egg turner until brown.

title: Hearty Beef Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Spoon stew into a 2-quart round casserole bowl. Place pie crust on top of the stew. Fold edges under. Sprinkle with cheese; cut 2 or 3 slits in crust. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until crust is golden brown. (Use as much cheese as desired.)

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix ingredients together with enough cracker crumbs to form patties. Roll in cornmeal and fry in Crisco until golden brown.

title: Texas Brownies
instructions: Combine butter shortening and coffee in saucepan (1 cup water plus 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa may be substituted for coffee). Bring to a boil. Mix flour and sugar in a large bowl. Pour boiling mixture over. Add buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix well and spread on well buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix well all ingredients except shrimp. Add shrimp and combine. Add a little more ketchup if needed for slightly pink color. Allow time for flavors to mix. Serve with crackers.

title: Chile Rellenos
instructions: In a 9 x 14-inch pan put a layer of Monterey Jack then 1/2 can chilies next a layer of Cheddar cheese then the rest of the chilies. Mix eggs and milk together. Add Bisquick and pour over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine the eggs sugar salt dark corn syrup maple syrup and vanilla. Beat well with an electric mixer or wire whip.

title: Chocolate Rum Balls
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler over hot water. Combine Marshmallow Creme and rum flavoring in small bowl. Stir into chocolate; mix well. Add cereal coconut and pecans mixing well. Form into small balls. Roll in additional coconut or chopped pecans. Chill until firm. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Vanilla-Butter Sugar Cookies
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine sugar and butter; beat until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Stir together dry ingredients; gradually add to creamed mixture until completely blended. Chill for 30 minutes. On a lightly floured surface roll dough to a 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with holiday cutters dipped in flour. Using a floured spatula transfer cookies to ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on wire racks.

title: Frozen Pudding Treats
instructions: Combine pudding mix and milk in bowl. Beat slowly with rotary beater or at lowest speed of electric mixer until well blended about 2 minutes. Pour into 6 (5 ounce) paper cups. Insert wooden or plastic spoon into each for a handle. Press a square of aluminum foil or wax paper down onto pudding to cover piercing center of foil with handle. Freeze until firm at least 5 hours. Press firmly on bottom of cup to release pop. Serve with foil around handle. Makes 6 pops.

title: Chicken Breasts Parmesan
instructions: Lightly pound chicken breasts between sheets of wax paper to an even thickness. Combine bread crumbs cheese oregano pepper and salt. Coat each chicken piece with egg then with crumb mixture pressing crumbs firmly and thoroughly over chicken surface. Pour enough oil into a large skillet to make 1/4-inch depth. Heat over medium high heat. Saute chicken two pieces at a time until golden brown about 3 minutes on each side. Drain on paper toweling; keep warm. Repeat with remaining chicken pieces adding a little more oil if needed.

title: Plucking Cake
instructions: Melt and heat oleo brown sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Butter pan real well. Cut 1 1/2 cans biscuits into quarters. Layer in tube pan; pour melted ingredients over biscuits and nuts (optional). Quarter next 1 1/2 cans of biscuits and pour balance of mixture over this. Bake for 1 hour in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Ho-Bo-Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger meat. Cook noodles until tender; drain. Put meat back into skillet; add sweet pepper. Cook until peppers change color. Add all other ingredients except cheese. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Top with cheese. (Put in oven or microwave.) Cook only until cheese melts. Serve hot.

title: Pink Fluff Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese with cherry juice. Add pineapple and cherries; mix well. Fold in marshmallows and whipped cream. Refrigerate until served.

title: Hardee'S Rise And Shine Biscuits
instructions: Bake at 425\u00b0 until they rise but dont let them brown unless you are going to eat them as soon as cooked.

title: Chicken Paprika
instructions: Melt margarine in large fry pan. Saute chicken pieces until lightly browned. Remove from pan; add onion to pan drippings. Blend in flour paprika salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; cook stirring constantly until thick and smooth. Stir in sour cream and Worcestershire Sauce. Mix 1/2 of sauce with the cooked noodles. Pour into shallow 3 qt. casserole. Arrange chicken pieces on noodles. Pour remaining sauce over chicken. Bake in slow (325\u00b0) oven 1 hour until chicken is tender.

title: Dot Edge'S Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Crush graham crackers with rolling pin. Mix all other ingredients with cracker crumbs and fold together well. Place in pans and refrigerate 2 nights at least. When hardened let set out for 2 to 3 hours and it will release from mold.

title: Easy Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix in ice cream freezer. Finish filling with sweet milk. Freeze and set.

title: Mock Cheese Souffle
instructions: Using 9 x 13 inch baking pan lay bread out covering bottom and up onto sides of pan. Mix all other ingredients together in a bowl and pour over bread.

title: North Dakota Ranch Beans
instructions: Mix together and simmer for 2 hours at 250\u00b0. Feeds a crowd!

title: Rumaki
instructions: Drain water chestnuts and marinate in soy sauce several hours. Cut water chestnuts in half if very large. Roll in sugar. Cut bacon slices in half crosswise and again lengthwise. Wrap water chestnuts in bacon slices. Secure with a toothpick. Bake at 425\u00b0 until bacon is crisp. Turn once. Drain on paper towels. Makes 16 to 20. (May be made day before and refrigerated. Before serving reheat 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve in chafing dish.)

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop by teaspoon. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar or chocolate chips. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pita Bread Snack(A Favorite Vbs Bible Times Snack)
instructions: Cut pita bread halves into halves again to make triangles. Spread cream cheese inside pita triangles. Chop olives and sprinkle them on cream cheese.

title: Fiesta Tamale Pie
instructions: Mix muffin mix egg and milk; set aside.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Grease 8 x 8-inch pan. Put sliced apples in pan. Mix all remaining ingredients together until crumbly. If ingredients are too moist add a little flour. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Seafood And Rice
instructions: Cook vegetables in 1/4 cup water until tender-crisp. Add rice shrimp crab meat mayonnaise and seasonings. Mix well. Turn into buttered shallow casserole. Tip with rice cereal. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: *I use Peter Pan peanut butter.

title: Juicy Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan with aluminum foil. Mix cereal salt and pepper. Dip chicken into milk then roll in cereal mixture until well coated. Place chicken skin side up in pan. Drizzle with melted margarine. Bake until chicken is done about 1 hour. Do not turn chicken. Makes 4 servings.

title: Dressing For Chicken Or Turkey
instructions: Combine. Add enough water to make very moist. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown on top. Cooked chicken may be added and topped with your favorite chicken gravy or use canned cream of chicken soup and enough water to make as thin as gravy. Sprinkle with chopped dried parsley. Bake as directed.

title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix all together until well blended.

title: Chocolate Raspberry Cheesecake
instructions: Microwave chocolate with 1/4 cup water at High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes until melted. Remove and stir until completely melted.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mash salmon including bones skin and liquid. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until firm.

title: Martha Washington Creams
instructions: Melt paraffin over low heat and stir in chocolate chips. Cream sugar milk and butter; add vanilla nuts and coconut. Roll into balls and dip in chocolate. Place on waxed paper until cool.

title: Easy Chocolate Chip Fudge
instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk and chips in glass mixing bowl. Microwave on High (full power) about 1 to 1 1/2 minutes until mixture is smooth when stirred. Add chopped nuts if desired and vanilla. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Cover; chill until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Rice With Peas
instructions: Fry the ham for 3 to 5 minutes in the oil. Add onion green pepper garlic Sazon and the salt. Cook for 10 minutes. Add peas and 4 cups of water. Let it come to a boil. Add the rice; stir it. Leave the rice uncovered until all the water is almost absorbed then cover for 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Bake all ingredients at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in round Corning Ware. Serve with sourdough bread crackers or whatever.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixer bowl beat Eagle Brand milk and peanut butter until smooth. Add biscuit mix and vanilla. Mix well.

title: Sunny'S Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut up chicken and two chicken breasts. Skin chicken and remove as much fat as possible. Put in large pot and cover with water. Add celery onion salt and pepper. Cook over low heat until done about 30 minutes. Debone chicken cube and combine with chopped celery onion mayonnaise and garlic salt. Refrigerate. Serves 10.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs and blend. Add flour milk and vanilla. Mix on medium to high 4 minutes. Pour into 2 greased and floured round pans reserving 1 tablespoon batter for filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Toasted Onion Canapes
instructions: Toast one side of bread rounds under broiler on baking sheet. Spread onion mayonnaise and cheese mixture on untoasted side. Broil 3 inches from heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 20.

title: Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and set aside. In a large bowl mix/cream Crisco brown sugar and white sugar. Add vanilla water and eggs. Mix thoroughly. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Easy Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. In 350\u00b0 oven melt butter in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Remove and sprinkle with sugar nuts coconut and cherries. Top with pineapple. To reserved juice add water to measure liquid specified on cake package. Prepare as package directs. Spread over fruit. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until tests done. Cool 5 minutes; invert onto large serving dish.

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 round pans or a 9 x 11 x 1/2-inch pan. In large bowl combine dry ingredients. Add eggs milk oil and vanilla. Beat for 2 minutes; remove from mixer. Stir in boiling water; batter will be thin. Pour into pans. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes for rounds or 35 to 40 minutes for other pan or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool cake completely before frosting.

title: Tiger Paws
instructions: Melt white chocolate and pour over other ingredients. Stir until all coated. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Mushroom, Celery And Pimento Salad
instructions: Wipe mushrooms clean of any dirt and slice caps and stems thinly into a bowl. Add celery pimientos or red peppers and chives or onions.

title: Steak Skillet Supper
instructions: In skillet quickly brown meat in hot oil. Add gravy water and spaghetti sauce stir.\tCover and cook over low heat 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Add zucchini cover and cook 10 to 12 minutes or until zucchini is to desired tenderness. Serve over noodles or rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Top with marshmallows if desired. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: *One 12 ounce package butterscotch pieces may be used instead of the chocolate for a light butterscotch flavor.

title: Hungarian Goulash
instructions: Cut stew pieces in half. Fry adding sliced onion salt and pepper. Add water and remaining spices. Simmer on medium heat for 1 1/2 hours. When meat is tender add macaroni. Cook until done. Serve.

title: Beef Patties
instructions: Put bread and water in a bowl. Add rest of ingredients; mix well and shape into six (1/2-inch thick) patties. Cook in greased frypan over medium heat turning once to brown both sides. Makes 6 servings.

title: Oatmeal Butterscotch Dessert
instructions: Mix butterscotch pudding and 2 cups milk at high speed until well blended. Stir in whipped topping. Dipping cookies in milk line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan; put 1/2 pudding mixture over cookies. Make another layer of cookies then the rest of pudding mixture. Crumble some cookies and sprinkle on top. Refrigerate until cold.

title: Quick And Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients in large bowl. Chill. Serve with a spoon of Cool Whip topping over each serving (optional). Keeps well in refrigerator 4 to 6 days.

title: French Canadian Meat Pies(Makes 2)
instructions: Combine pork and beef in large pan. Add onion and garlic and cook stirring until meat is brown. Then drain. Stir in poultry seasoning salt celery salt pepper sage and water. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Uncover and simmer 10 minutes longer. Remove from heat and stir in mashed potatoes.

title: Sticks And Stones Snack
instructions: Heat the oven to 300\u00b0. Mix the cereal and pretzel sticks in an ungreased rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Stir the margarine and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. Pour over the cereal mixture. Stir until the cereal is evenly coated. Bake uncovered 25 minutes stirring several times. Stir in the raisins. Cool. Store in an airtight container. Makes about 8 cups of snack.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup nuts. Form into a ball. Cover with chopped nuts.

title: Powdered Sugar Glaze
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; spread on warm cake.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs then spices. Add soda to applesauce. Mix in flour then raisins and nuts etc. Beat after each addition.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored. Blend in condensed milk slowly. Add cream of tartar to egg whites and beat until foamy. Continue beating adding sugar 1 tablespoon at a time until egg whites peak. Fold 6 tablespoons of the meringue into the filling mixture. Pour into a 9-inch baked pie shell. Top with meringue and bake in a slow oven (330\u00b0) until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
instructions: Beat everything but milk at low speed until well mixed. Add milk slowly until desired consistency.

title: All In One Dinner In Foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Get a piece of foil out big enough to seal all ingredients in. Place steak on foil; season with salt pepper and garlic. Place sliced potatoes on top of steak. Add drained can of green beans on top. Sprinkle onion soup on top and then add 4 tablespoons butter on top. Seal all in foil. Place on a cookie sheet. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4.

title: Chinese Pork Chops
instructions: Mix stir-fry sauce water and sugar in small bowl and set aside. Put oil into wok and heat over medium-high. Place chops in wok and brown on both sides. Remove chops to plate reserving as much oil as possible. Stir-fry onion slices in same pan until light gold brown.

title: Holiday Ham And Chili Cheese Ball
instructions: In a small bowl combine Cheddar cheese cream cheese deviled ham scallions and chilies. Mix well. Shape mixture into a ball.

title: Chicken Scallopini
instructions: Put butter in medium bowl; beat in lemon juice and egg with fork. In another bowl mix bread crumbs cheese basil salt and pepper. Dip chicken slices into egg mixture; coat evenly with crumb mixture. In a large frying pan melt 2 teaspoons of butter. Cook chicken over low heat turning once until done. Serve with spaghetti in a red sauce.

title: Perfect Mashed Potatoes(Low-Fat)
instructions: Slice potatoes in half and scoop out flesh. Mash potatoes and garlic or onions with fork or potato masher. Whip in skim milk. Add black pepper and salt.

title: K Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil sugar brown sugar and Karo syrup. Add vanilla salt and peanut butter. When peanut butter is melted add cereal. Stir until coated. Put in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cut when cooled. Makes approximately 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Rinse beans. Add to 2 quarts cold water. Bring to boiling. Simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover. Let stand 1 hour. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Drain reserving liquid. Measure 2 cups liquid adding water if needed. Mix with molasses sugar and mustard. Score half of salt pork. Grind remainder. In 2-quart casserole combine beans ground pork and onion. Pour sugar mixture over. Top with scored pork. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes. Add liquid if needed. Serves 8.

title: Blackberry Puddin'
instructions: Cream 1 cup sugar and butter together. Add the flour baking powder salt and milk; mix well. Then pour blackberries on top. Pour 1 cup sugar over and the boiling water. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 until top is golden brown. Will take about 50 minutes.

title: Chestnuts And Sugar Plums
instructions: Combine chestnuts and prunes in 8 x 8-inch dish. Combine juice butter sugar and salt in bowl; mix well. Pour over prune mixture. Bake until just heated at 350\u00b0. Stir occasionally. Spoon in serving dishes. Serve with pork or poultry. Makes 8 servings.

title: Christmas Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together all ingredients with an electric mixer. Grease and flour three 9-inch cake pans. Pour batter into pans. Bake for 20 minutes. Test for doneness with toothpick. Cool completely.

title: Idiot'S Delight
instructions: Melt butterscotch bits in a double boiler. Mix noodles and peanuts in melted butterscotch. Drop on wax paper.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix together; serve on wheat crackers and top with cocktail sauce. Best if you let sit overnight.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Fry loose sausage; do not drain. Cook chicken. Cut up. Prepare shrimp. Set all aside. Prepare rice as per directions on box. Add in tomato sauce (do not make it soupy) sausage chicken and shrimp (also dump in grease from sausage). Add in red pepper to taste.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Bring soup to boil. Add cream cheese; stir until melted. Slowly add gelatine. Add shrimp celery and onion; stir. Remove from heat; cool for 5 minutes. Add mayonnaise; stir. Place in greased mold (3 1/2 cup mold) in refrigerator until firm.

title: Oven Baked Pork And Beans
instructions: You may add any meat ingredient also cut up ham crisp bacon cooked ground beef etc.

title: Baked Tomato Pie
instructions: Layer pepper tomatoes and onion in pie pan. Mix basil grated cheese and mustard. Add salt and pepper to taste. Spread over top of pie. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pie Crust For Unbaked Fillings
instructions: With pastry blender or fork blend crust mix with brown sugar. Mix in walnuts. Add egg yolk and vanilla. Combine well and press into a buttered and floured 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden. Cool before filling.

title: Mexican Salsa Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain off grease. Add salsa and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Pour cheese on top of mixture let melt. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place fruit on bottom of 13x9x2 pan. Spread evenly. Mix soft butter and cake mix. Place mixture on top of fruit. Bake for 30-45 mins. Layer should be golden brown. Can be served with ice cream. If using a glass dish temperature is 325\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Pour in a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: The Wizard'S Giant Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar and salt. Stir well. Add flour one cup at a time beating after each addition. Turn dough out onto a floured board and knead until smooth. Cut off small chunks of the dough. Roll into 1/2-inch ropes and twist into pretzel shapes. Dust cookie sheets with cornmeal. Arrange pretzels on the sheets. Brush tops of pretzels with beaten egg and sprinkle generously with salt. Bake in a hot oven at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Makes 6 or 8 large pretzels.

title: Baked Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Blend together beef onion salt and pepper. Shape into 8 patties. Arrange layer of potatoes in a greased glass 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Season. Then add layers of corn and of beans and arrange meat patties on top. Pour the tomatoes over all and bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is done. Yields 8 servings.

title: Toffee Bars
instructions: Cream together margarine brown sugar and egg yolk. Stir in flour salt and vanilla. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Frost with melted Hershey bar.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil milk sugar and oleo until it forms a soft ball (when tested in cold water). Take off stove and add marshmallows beat until dissolved. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Pour in lightly greased pan. When cool cut in squares.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Add milk to eggs. Spread rolls on pizza pan or jelly roll pan. Layer with sausage hash browns egg mixture and then cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Carratiera Sauce - No Cook
instructions: Blend. Let stand 1/2 hour or more. Pour over hot drained pasta. Great for summertime!

title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together. Pour into a buttered 8 x 8 inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes. Serve hot with cold milk tastes great with cinnamon or fried apples.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Brown meat and drain fat. Add all ingredients adding 5 cans of water. Stir occasionally so rice doesnt settle. Cook according to rice directions.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix together corn Jiffy corn bread mix eggs and sugar. Fold in 1 cup sour cream. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: May add shredded cheese to top.

title: Dan'S Homemade Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Add next 8 ingredients. Simmer 1/2 hour. Add kidney beans. Heat until beans are hot. You can add more tomato juice to make a thinner chili.

title: Easy Fried Pies
instructions: Cut butter into flour with pastry blender. Combine milk and egg yolk. Pour over flour mixture stirring to mix well. Roll out small portions on floured surface. Place pie filling in center. Fold over and seal edges. Fry in deep hot fat until golden brown.

title: Prize Winner Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar and salt thoroughly in saucepan. Add hot water and cook over high heat stirring constantly until thick and clear. Remove from stove; add beaten egg yolks. Return to stove and cook at low heat stirring constantly for 6 minutes. Take off stove and add lemon juice and butter. Cool. Pour into cooled baked pastry shell. Top with meringue.

title: Spanish Rice(Large-Quantity Recipe)
instructions: Combine tomatoes water onions pepper and salt; heat to the boiling point. Add butter\tand rice; cover to bring to boiling point again. Reduce heat\tand simmer until rice is tender. Remove from heat and add cheese.\tStir until cheese is melted. Will stay warm and fluffy if covered with heavy cloth and then with pot cover. Yields 50 servings of 1 cup each.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix ingredients together until well blended. Eat and enjoy!!

title: Fried Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all and roll out. Cut around a saucer.

title: No-Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa margarine and milk. Bring to a boil. Cook 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended. Drop by teaspoons onto wax paper and let set.

title: Lemon Chicken Cutlets
instructions: Bread and fry chicken. Place in long baking dish. In medium size bowl mix together broth butter flour lemon and seasonings. Pour over cutlets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 3/4 of an hour covered with foil. Remove foil and bake another 15 minutes.

title: White Turkey Chili
instructions: Simmer turkey carrots and celery in broth for 10 minutes or until turkey is no longer pink. Drain all but 1 cup of liquid. Add beans chilies and spices. Simmer 10 minutes. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Season and lightly brown pork chops. Mix other ingredients. Arrange pork chops in a shallow baking dish; pour sauce over them. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with rice or baked potatoes.

title: Easy Macaroons
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool slightly. Remove from pan. Enjoy!

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine flour mixture and pumpkin pie spice. Using electric mixer on medium speed mix together brown and granulated sugars. Beat in butter. Add egg pumpkin and vanilla. Beat until well mixed light and fluffy. Stir in flour mixture raisins and nuts. Drop by round spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets 2 inches apart. Bake until slightly browned along edges about 20 minutes. Cool cookies on flat surface.

title: Cauliflower Supreme(Low-Fat)
instructions: Break off flowerets of cauliflower. Slice lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick slices. Simmer cauliflower in boiling water in covered pan for 5 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat; drain. Fold in grapes and almonds. Return to burner until heated through.

title: Bread(Original From Alberta B. Seitz)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. In large bowl put sugar salt and shortening; add hot water. When dissolved add milk then yeast mixture. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. On floured board roll dough into a large rectangle; fold into thirds roll again; repeat 4 or 5 times. Place in greased pan and let rise until doubled. Bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Mix flour and oleo and pat into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread onto cooled crust. Mix pudding mixes and milk until thick. Spread on top of cream cheese mixture. Put rest of Cool Whip on top. May garnish with walnuts. Chill several hours.

title: Grilled And Chilled Japanese Eggplant
instructions: Prepare a charcoal fire. Grill the eggplants over hot coals until soft about 10 to 15 minutes turning frequently. Remove and set aside until cool enough to handle. Combine the chicken broth bonito flakes soy sauce and rice wine in a saucepan. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add the ginger and remove from the heat. Use a sharp knife to slice the eggplant lengthwise into 4 slices without cutting through the stem end. Fan each eggplant out on a platter and drizzle with the sauce. Refrigerate until completely cool or up to 24 hours before serving. Yield 8 servings.

title: Crabbies
instructions: Soften butter and cheese. Blend with crab meat mayonnaise and garlic salt; spread over halved English muffins. Place waxed paper between muffins and freeze.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Break spaghetti into fourths (about 1 1/2 cups). Saute onion and celery in margarine in Dutch oven (deep pan) until crisp and tender. Stir soup bouillon lemon juice pepper and nutmeg into sauteed mixture. Add chicken and spaghetti and stir. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer stirring occasionally 20 minutes or until spaghetti is tender.

title: Microwave Irish Stew
instructions: Place beef cubes in 3-quart microproof casserole or baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Stir together gravy mix and water. Pour over meat. Cook covered on 70 (Roast) for 50 minutes stirring once during cooking. Add vegetables and mix to cover with gravy. Cook covered on 50 (Simmer) for 40 to 50 minutes or until vegetables and meat are tender. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Stir Bisquick and sugar together. Add slightly beaten eggs and remaining ingredients until well mixed. (Do not use mixer.) Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Easy Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Boil chicken until well done; drain and set aside to cool (for cutting). In medium bowl mix soup sour cream green chilies and seasonings. Cut chicken into small pieces and stir into soup mixture. Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch pan or glass casserole dish. Lay tortilla flat on hard surface; place 2 to 3 tablespoons of chicken mixture across center of tortilla. Sprinkle with 1 to 2 tablespoons of cheese (reserve 1/2 cup cheese for topping).

title: Frankfurter Tuckaway
instructions: Cook 4 ounces of macaroni. Cut 4 frankfurters lengthwise and insert slice of cheese. Wrap with a slice of bacon. Fasten with a toothpick. Mix soup with milk. Bring to a boil and add macaroni. Put in greased baking dish and top with frankfurters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Separate eggs beating yolk until thick. Add yolks and vanilla. Sift flour and baking powder together. Alternate flour and milk. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into mixture. Bake at 365\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Buy thick pork chops butcher will slit a pocket for you. Mix stuffing (ingredients above). Fill pockets of chops and place remainder around chops in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes (until tender). You can use Stove Top dressing.

title: Natchez Sugar Pralines
instructions: Boil first six ingredients until mixture forms ball in ice water then add vanilla. Beat until creamy. Add pecans and spoon out onto waxed paper or buttered plate.

title: Shrimp Dip(Yield:  3 Cups)
instructions: Soften cream cheese in a bowl. In a mixer beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in lemon juice. Stir in remaining ingredients (except chips). Chill to blend flavors. Garnish as desired. Serve with chips.

title: Beef Gravy And Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour and milk; add to margarine and beef cut in little pieces. Cook in a pot until thickened. Add more milk if needed. Stir constantly. Pour over biscuits.

title: Billy'S Venison Soup
instructions: Bring to a boil and simmer for two hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake crust. Mix softened cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Add strawberries. Pour into pie crust. Chill overnight.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Put cookies in food processor or blender crush until mixture looks like dirt. It helps if cookies are frozen. Set aside.

title: Fresh Veggie Appetizer
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Unroll dough into 4 rectangles. Press onto bottom and up sides of 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan to form crust. Bake 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown; cool. Mix cream cheese dressing sour cream dill and onion salt until well blended. Spread on crust. Top with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate. Cut into squares. makes 24.

title: Quick Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: In a large Dutch oven or kettle cook beef and onion until beef and onion are tender. Drain fat. Stir in beef broth mixed vegetables undrained tomatoes potato celery marjoram oregano salt pepper and bay leaf. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Cover; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Discard bay leaf. Makes 4 main dish servings.

title: Tumbleweed'S Queso
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add jalapenos and chilies. Add all other ingredients cheese last.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Mix water white vinegar salt and sugar well and pour over pickles and other ingredients cold. Let set out several days before putting in refrigerator. Place cucumbers in bottom of a glass gallon jar then alternate with fresh dill onions garlic and jalapeno peppers. (I use hot crushed peppers if I dont have the jalapeno peppers; dont use too many peppers as it will make the pickles too hot.)

title: Mustard Pickles
instructions: Place cucumbers in quart jar. Do not overpack in jars. Put mustard salt and sugar on top. Pour vinegar over them. Shake 3 or 4 mornings before putting them away.

title: Yule Log
instructions: (Can use 1/2 pound cherries and pineapple as an option instead of the mixed fruit.)

title: Trifle
instructions: Prepare in a trifle bowl a large brandy sniffer or a large flat glass bowl. Prepare devils food cake in a 9 x 13-inch square pan. Place 1/2 of cake in bowl (after baking). Spread 1 can of chocolate pudding over cake. Sprinkle with 1/2 of candy mixture (brickle and chocolate). Cover with 1/2 (6 ounces) of Cool Whip. Repeat all steps. Save some candy to sprinkle on top for decoration. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Can be frozen!

title: Bolognese Veal Braised In Milk
instructions: Rub veal with oil and butter and place in roasting pan along with a few sprigs of rosemary and sage leaves. Put pan in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Turn frequently and baste from time to time with the meat juices. Remove veal from pan and place in covered casserole. Add enough milk to immerse 2/3 of veal. Cover casserole leaving top ajar. Cook slowly approximately 2 hours or until meat is done. Turn and baste meat occasionally adding any remaining milk. When meat is cooked remove to a platter and keep warm.
