Milk in casserole should have coagulated into small nut brown clusters. If not raise heat to high. Cook uncovered briskly until milk further reduces and darkens. Skim off fat and discard being careful not to remove any coagulated milk clusters. Add warm water turn heat to high boil away all water while scraping and loosening all cooking residue in casserole. Taste and correct seasonings. Carve into 3/8-inch thick slices. Spoon sauce over meat and serve immediately.

title: Hobo Bread
instructions: Combine the raisins water and soda and let stand for 2 hours. Add both sugars salt flour (one cup at a time) and nuts. Grease and flour two (1 pound) coffee cans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Crunchy Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Mix meat soups part of grated cheese and the cooked macaroni. Pour half of the mixture in a lasagna dish or other baking dish. Break 1/2 can of dried onions over. Cover with rest of mixture. Save a handful of grated cheese to sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Just before removing from oven add the rest of dried onions and bake 5 more minutes and serve. Enjoy!

title: White Wonder Cake
instructions: Cream shortening add sugar and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to mixture alternately with milk. Blend until smooth after each addition. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Stir well. Add pineapple ice cream and nuts. Mix together well. Chill before serving.

title: 9 Layer Guacamole Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in this order on dinner plate and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Missouri No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar milk cocoa and butter in saucepan. Cook at full rolling boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add oats peanut butter salt and vanilla. Mix well. Drop by spoon onto wax paper. Cool.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well. Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan; cover with 3 strips bacon if you like that flavor. Pour over meat loaf one 8 ounce can Hunts tomato sauce. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Drain; let stand 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: In saucepan melt butter over low heat; add soups and mushrooms. Stir; remove from heat. Add pimento chicken spaghetti and sour cream. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Friendship Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a greased tube or Bundt pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. These cakes freeze well or will keep several days at room temperature staying moist.

title: Strawberry Gelatin Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add cold liquid. Blend in sour cream until smooth. Pour into mold. Add drained fruit cocktail. Refrigerate.

title: Molasses Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix flour margarine and sugar with hands. Save 1 cup for topping. In remainder of crumbs add molasses cold water and baking soda. Mix well with spoon. Pour into greased floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. If glass dish is used bake at 325\u00b0.

title: No Fail Fudge
instructions: Place in double boiler and mix well until all ingredients form large ball. Add nuts. You may need a little more milk. Press into 6 x 6-inch pan. Cool and cut.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; season to taste. Layer Tater Tots in 2 1/2 quart casserole with hamburger. Combine mushroom soup milk and dry onion soup. Pour over ingredients. Stir slightly to allow liquids to drain\tdown. Top with onion rings. Bake 40 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix with hands in a big boll hamburger meat 1 egg 3 shakes of garlick powder 3 shake of pepper and 3 shakes of salt and 3 shakes of ongion powder. Crombell tost in to small pices; make in to small balls and cook in scilet till well done.

title: French Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Brown meat in oil. Reduce heat and stir in soup and 6 cans water. Add tomato paste salt pepper and basil. Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours. Add vegetables. Reheat to boiling. Simmer covered 30 minutes or until vegetables and meat are tender. Stir in cheese.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix well. Place in covered bowl. Put 1 cup sugar over top. Let stand at least 1 day. This will last a long time in refrigerator.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix together the flour sugar shortening nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Take out 1/2 cup for on top of cake. Add cooked raisins to this mixture then add 2 heaping teaspoonfuls soda to 2 cups buttermilk or sour milk; add to first mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the 1/2 cup crumbs over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreos; set aside. Cream butter sugar and cream cheese. Set aside. Mix pudding and milk until smooth. Combine both mixtures and fold in Cool Whip. Layer in 8-inch plastic flowerpot . Start with Oreos and end with Oreos. Garnish with gummie worms and silk flowers. Add a garden spade to serve.

title: Indiana Chili
instructions: Saute ground beef until done. Add kidney beans and tomato juice. Add chili powder and sugar. Meanwhile saute onion slices in butter or margarine. When onions are cooked (clear) add both onions and butter to meat mixture. Simmer 1/2 hour. Serve with oyster crackers.

title: Pig In A Blanket
instructions: Separate dinner rolls; spread with melted margarine. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Roll sausage link starting from wide end. Cut each roll into 3 or 4 pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Dannon Apple Spice Cake
instructions: In a large bowl thoroughly combine dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients except raisins; blend well using spoon. Stir in raisins. Pour into greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan or 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Loosen cake from sides with spatula. Invert on plate. Cool completely.

title: Fancy Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes. Slice potatoes and cut into strips. Spray jelly roll pan with vegetable spray cover with potatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Remove from oven sprinkle on cheeses and bake an additional 10 minutes.

title: Chicken And Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cut any visible fat from chicken; remove skin and cut into cubes. In large pan heat oil over medium heat. Cook chicken for about 3 minutes or until lightly browned. Add onions and garlic; cook for about 3 minutes until softened. Stir in peppers. Add tomatoes breaking up with back of spoon. Add stock thyme oregano and cayenne; bring to boil. Stir in rice. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Toss with all ingredients. Cover and chill. This is a good change from the usual green salad and complements most any meal. Serves 6.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put eggs sugar salt nutmeg and vanilla into blender container. Cover and process at mix until sugar is dissolved and eggs lemon colored. Remove feeder cap and add milk. Continue to process until blended. Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake for about 30 minutes until knife comes out clean.

title: Cocktail Wraps
instructions: Separate dough along perforations into 8 triangles; cut each lengthwise into thirds. Wrap dough around Hillshire Farm little smokies or wieners. Press ends together to seal. Bake as directed on dough package. Makes 48 appetizers.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
instructions: Beat egg and sugar together until light; add milk then melted butter and extract. Sift flour salt and baking powder twice and add the liquid mixture to them; beat well. Bake about 45 minutes in moderate 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in saucepan until done; drain then let cool. Mix together in separate bowl mayonnaise mustard milk salt pepper and celery seed. Add remaining ingredients to potatoes and toss mixing in mayonnaise mixture. Serve cold.

title: Baked Potato Skins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Put potatoes in microwave for 10 to 12 minutes on High. Cut in half lengthwise. Carefully do not rip potato skin. Scoop out potato pulp leaving 1/4 inch of potato around skin. Brush generously with soy sauce (optional but will enhance flavor). Place on cookie sheet. Top with cheese and bacon. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese has melted. Serve with sour cream if desired. Serves 2.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots for 15 minutes. Cook bacon until crisp in frying pan. Saute onions in bacon drippings. Add brown sugar pepper carrots and bacon. Cook until heated.

title: Miniature Reubens
instructions: Cover bread with dressing sauerkraut corned beef and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese melted about 10 minutes.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop peppers and onions. Cover with boiling water. Let stand for 5 minutes. Drain. Cover again with boiling water. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain. Add other ingredients (tie spice in bag). Cook 15 minutes. Pack in hot jars and seal.

title: Brownie Candy Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place 30 (2-inch) foil cupcake liners in small muffin pans or on cookie sheet. Combine brownie mix fudge packet from mix eggs water and oil in a large bowl. Stir with spoon until well blended about 50 strokes. Place 2 level tablespoons batter in each foil cupcake liner. Bake in each foil cupcake liner. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Push 1 peanut butter cup candy in center of each cupcake until even with surface of brownie. Bake 5 to 7 minutes longer. Cool completely.

title: Bread Deluxe
instructions: Combine yeast 1 cup of warm water and sugar; let stand 10 minutes. Add to beaten eggs salt oil 1 cup sugar and 5 cups of warm water. Add yeast mixture then gradually add 15 cups of flour to which you have added 1 cup of powdered milk. Mix until smooth. Let rise. Knead down. Put into loaf pans; let rise until doubled in bulk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Makes 6 loaves.

title: Breakfast Balls
instructions: Cook 1 pound of the sausage to a crumble and drain off the fat. Chop the ham. Mix all the sausage well with the ham and other ingredients with salt and pepper to taste. Form into large balls to make a muffin shape and place them in a large muffin pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes turn up the heat and bake 15 minutes more to brown. Serve with hot currant sauce or jelly. Good with scrambled or baked eggs. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar salt baking powder and baking soda; stir in caraway seed. Cut in oleo; add raisins. Combine buttermilk and egg; blend in flour mixture. Turn out on floured board. Knead until smooth about 25 times. Shape into a smooth ball; place into a well-greased 2-quart casserole. Cut a 4-inch cross about 1/4-inch across top. Lightly beat egg yolk and water; brush over loaf and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Mom'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter to soften add sugar gradually and cream until fluffy. Add syrup salt and eggs. Stir in pecans pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool and serve.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Peel apples and oranges and cut fine. Mix all ingredients together and add 3 or 4 tablespoons mayonnaise.

title: Orange Tofu(Great For Toddlers)
instructions: Saute tofu cubes in oil or butter for 2 minutes over medium heat. Add tamari and ginger and continue cooking over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes stirring often. Add orange juice and cook for 1 more minute. Serve over Texmati brown rice.

title: Red Velvet Cake With Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Cream sugar oil eggs vanilla soda and cocoa. Add alternately flour butter and buttermilk. Pour into 2 well greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Scald milk. Add a little milk to egg mixture at a time. Stir constantly over medium heat about 15 minutes until coats the spoon. Chill. Serve with whipped cream and dash of nutmeg.

title: Baked Fish
instructions: Take haddock pieces the size of your hand and place in glass dish with just enough melted butter to cover the bottom of dish. Take finely crushed bread crumbs (seasoned or plain) and sprinkle over top. Add melted Cheez Whiz and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry Mousse
instructions: Run berries and apples through food chopper. Also add orange (pulp and peel). Add sugar; mix. Let stand several hours to blend.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti drain and cool under cold water. Separate spaghetti and start mixing vegetables between layers of spaghetti. Use whole bottle of Salad Supreme and Italian dressing. Make day before. Keep stirring so flavors will mix.

title: Creamy Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water and salt about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Meanwhile saute the onion in butter until tender. When potatoes are cooked stir in onion corn pimiento milk half and half brown sugar paprika salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes longer until soup is slightly thickened.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Saute beef salt and onion in skillet. Drain and let cool. In a large bowl place lettuce beef grated cheese corn chips and dressing and mix thoroughly. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Chocolate Nog
instructions: In blender container beat egg until light in color. Add ice cream milk and Nestle Quik. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately. Sprinkle with nutmeg if desired. Makes three 6-ounce servings.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage coarsely; steam lightly until just wilted in water with a pinch of salt and sugar. Melt butter in a large (13 x 9-inch) Pyrex dish. Sprinkle 3/4 cup of Frosted Flakes over butter. In a saucepan mix celery soup milk mayonnaise and beaten egg. Spread cabbage over crumbs in Pyrex dish. Pour soup mixture over all. Top with grated cheese and other 1 cup of Frosted Flakes crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Impossible Turkey Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inch. Sprinkle turkey onions cheese mushrooms and salt in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand mixer. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Makes 7 servings; 145 calories per serving.

title: Pizza On A Bun
instructions: *You can use one of the three meats or all.

title: Candied Nuts(Club Member: Jason Baldwin)
instructions: Mix sugar cream water and vanilla. Cook to soft ball stage. Add nuts and stir until nuts are coated. Pour onto wax paper. Separate with 2 forks.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix chicken soup vegetables poultry seasoning and garlic salt in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Stir baking mix and milk until blended. Pour over chicken mixture. Sprinkle with parsley. Bake 30 to 32 minutes or until crust is light golden brown. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa margarine and milk in pan and boil 2 minutes. Let cool and add peanut butter vanilla nuts and rolled oats. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Shredded Hashed Brown Potatoes
instructions: Peel and shred the potatoes (should be 3 cups). Rinse the potatoes and drain well (pat with paper towels to make as dry as possible).

title: Oyster Dressing
instructions: Dice up potatoes celery and onions. Cover with water; add salt pepper and a chunk of butter. Cook until very done. Break bread into chunks and using 1 stick margarine and 1 loaf bread at a time toast them in a large pan on the stove until brown. Stir while toasting. Mash the potato mixture fine in the juice they were cooked in. Pour over bread. Pour juice from giblets over bread; add chopped giblets. Beat eggs; add half and half. Pour over bread. Chop oysters and add to dressing; add salt and pepper to taste. Stir all together.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and oleo. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Stir in sour cream. Sift flour 3 times with soda. Add 1/2 cup at a time to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla.

title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pat into burgers. Grill pan-fry or bake until done. Garnish as you wish.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Slice cucumbers very thin. Mix all ingredients together. Pour over cucumbers. Cover and put in refrigerator for 3 hours or overnight.

title: Fruit Crisp
instructions: Place pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut oleo into dry cake mix; add nuts and spread over filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Most prefer butter brickle on apple while many enjoy the white mix on cherry. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Cinnamon Apple Salad
instructions: Dissolve candy in water and jello. Cool. Add remaining ingredients. Chill until firm.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: In 1 quart scalded milk put oil and sugar. Let cool to lukewarm. In pint of warm milk put yeast; let dissolve without stirring. When first mixture is cool add yeast and milk to it. Add enough flour to make soft dough; cover and let rise at room temperature until it doubles in bulk (about 2 hours). Knead roll cut stretch dip in melted butter. Fold over and butter tops. Let rise for 2 hours again; bake at 450\u00b0 until brown. Makes about 100.

title: Vanilla Pudding
instructions: In saucepan blend sugar cornstarch and salt. Add milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Cook 2 more minutes. Remove from heat. Stir into eggs. Return to hot mixture. Cook 2 more minutes. Remove from heat. Blend in butter and vanilla. Chill. Yields 4 to 5 servings.

title: Carrot Pineapple Salad
instructions: Cook carrots; drain. Mash and sprinkle with sugar; set aside. Dissolve Jell-Os in boiling water then add cold water carrots and pineapple. Stir well. Congeal. Top with a dab of mayonnaise.

title: Granola
instructions: Mix and spread 1/2-inch deep on cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool crumble and add nuts seeds raisins or other dried fruit.

title: Cherry Squares
instructions: Put melted butter in a bowl; add sugar and mix well; add egg and blend well. Add dry ingredients and vanilla. Then add nuts and cherries. Bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Frost with Almond-Cherry Flavored Frosting.

title: Classic Coke Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Combine flour and sugar. Combine melted butter cocoa and Coke. Add to flour and sugar mixture stirring well. Add buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Fold in the miniature marshmallows. Pour into prepared pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and frost while still warm.

title: Strawberry Chiffon
instructions: In a small saucepan melt butter; stir in crumbs. Pat firmly on bottom of 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Chill. In large bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in sweetened condensed milk and strawberries. Fold in marshmallows and Cool Whip. Pour into prepared vanilla wafers pan. Chill for 2 hours or more. Garnish with Cool Whip or strawberries.

title: Kaiser Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together; cover and let stand overnight. Recipe may be doubled for larger groups.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Combine. Cook until clear and thick. Mix with 4 cups rhubarb cut up and top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Salsa In A Shell
instructions: Mix cream cheese sour cream and salsa until well blended. Stir in Cheddar cheese. Cut top off bread and save. Hollow out bread. Spoon cheese mixture into bread and cover with bread top. Wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 400\u00b0.

title: Humble Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium-size bowl combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into pie shell and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar butter and vanilla. Mix well. Then add flour baking powder and soda. Lastly add crushed bananas and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix together with garlic salt and Tabasco sauce. Let chill. On wax paper roll mixture into logs or ball. Roll in chili powder and pecans. Chill until served.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Heat oil in stockpot and saute onion and garlic for 2 minutes. Stir in vegetables and seasonings broth and drained beans. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat; simmer 30 minutes. Add tomato pasta and tomato sauce and simmer until pasta is done. Add cabbage (optional) salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes or until cabbage wilts. Serve in bowls with parmesan cheese sprinkled on top of soup.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Mix flour cinnamon pumpkin sugar baking soda and eggs with electric mixer until well blended. Line greased jelly roll pan with wax paper and pour batter in this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Flip cake on dish towel that has been covered in confectioners sugar. Let cool.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat oil and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Mix together dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients to oil and sugar mixture blending well. Fold in carrots and nuts. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan in 325\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Glazed Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut each wing in 3 parts. Discard tips. Place chicken wings in shallow glass dish. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken. Cover and put in refrigerator for 1 hour turning occasionally. Cook in oven for 1 hour turning after first half hour. Makes about 30 appetizers. Oven temperature is 375\u00b0.

title: Grate Zucchini Bread(Low-Fat)
instructions: In large bowl combine the whole wheat and white flours sugar baking powder baking soda salt cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. In a medium bowl mix together the egg white whole egg oil zucchini and vanilla. Add this mixture to the flour mixture stirring the ingredients to combine them well. Stir in the nuts and/or raisins if desired. Pour the batter into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake the bread in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a pick inserted in the center of the bread comes out clean.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Let set overnight in refrigerator. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Good and easy.

title: Pineapple Layer Cake Frosting
instructions: Mix pineapple and pudding until well blended. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Makes enough to frost three 9-inch layers. Preparation time 015.

title: Chocolate Scrump Pie(Named By Tim Fowler)
instructions: Mix pudding as directed on package. Take 3/4 of whipped cream and mix with all the pudding. Add coconut pecans and chocolate chips to the mixture. Fold mixture into pie crust. Take remaining Cool Whip and spread on top of pie. Now take remaining coconut pecans and chocolate chips and sprinkle them over the pie. Place in the refrigerator for about 2 hours and its ready to eat.

title: Pecan Pie Surprise Bars
instructions: Grease bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve 2/3 cup dry cake mix for filling. In large mixing bowl combine remaining dry cake mix margarine and egg. Mix until thoroughly combined. Press evenly into bottom and sides of prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown. Meanwhile combine reserved cake mix brown sugar syrup vanilla and 3 eggs in a large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed for 1 to 2 minutes. Pour filling over baked crust. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Return to oven and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until filling is set. Cool and cut into 36 bars.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage drain fat and set aside. Saute pepper onion and celery in butter or margarine. Stir in soups and rice; mix well. Fold in sausage. Pour into a buttered casserole dish sprinkle with crumbled cornflakes. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly butter 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish; set aside. Pare quarter core and thinly slice apples. You should have 6 cups. In large mixing bowl place apples 1/2 cup sugar cinnamon and lemon juice; toss lightly to mix. Place in prepared baking dish; set aside.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Add all ingredients in large kettle stir to mix taco seasoning. Bring to a boil boil 15 minutes. Serve with toppings grated cheese corn chips sour cream salsa chilies or black olives.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and eggs then flour milk vanilla margarine and coconut. Prebake pie shells 5 minutes. After prebaking 5 minutes pour mixture in shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Press softened cream cheese in bottom of small Pyrex dish. Spread chili on top of cream cheese; sprinkle onions on top of chili. Then sprinkle cheese on top of mixture. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serve hot with tortilla chips or Fritos.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Pour peaches and juice in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix over peaches then the chopped nuts and coconut. Dribble melted oleo over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Avocado Dip
instructions: Mix well and serve with chips.

title: Sweet Sue Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables in oil over low heat until tender. Grease a large casserole dish. Layer in the following order half of the chicken and dumplings cheese spaghetti vegetables half of the chicken and dumplings and soup. Cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until brown around the edges.

title: No Weep Meringue
instructions: In a small saucepan combine cornstarch sugar and water. Heat until clear over medium heat stirring constantly. Set aside to cool. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 6 tablespoons of sugar a small amount at a time. Add cornstarch mixture and beat until peaks form. Put on your favorite pie and bake until brown.

title: Peaches And Cream
instructions: Drain peaches in bowl and chill. Mix pudding with milk and refrigerate 5 minutes. Beat whipping cream until stiff. Fold in chilled pudding mixture. Refrigerate 10 minutes. Add sherry if you wish mixing well. Spread over peaches. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Plain Muffins
instructions: Combine milk egg and shortening. Sift together dry ingredients and mix with liquid mixture blending together with 25 to 30 strokes. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 15 minutes for small muffins or 30 minutes for large muffins. Yields 12 large or 20 small muffins.

title: Oriental Chicken Wings
instructions: Wash and dry chicken. Hook tips of wings over opposite end of bones to form triangle. Fry slightly in skillet. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well mixed. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove lid increase heat and cook until liquid is almost gone. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Boil prawns/shrimp until they turn pink approximately 5 to 8 minutes or saute prawns in olive oil. Cook vermicelli/pasta according to package directions. Wait until all other ingredients are ready. (Serve hot.)

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix well all ingredients except pecans. Pour mixture into pie shells and sprinkle with the pecans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 375\u00b0. Bake for 25 minutes longer. Do not overbake.

title: Chocolate Pudding Bake
instructions: Sift 3/4 cup sugar and flour with 2 tablespoons of cocoa baking powder and salt into a 9-inch square pan. Stir in milk oleo and vanilla; spread evenly in pan. Combine next 3 ingredients and sprinkle over batter. Pour water over top. Bake pudding at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream if desired. Serves 6.

title: Ham And Mushrooms
instructions: In a 2 1/2-quart cooking bowl cook onion and butter on High for 2 minutes or until slightly softened. Add mushrooms and cook on High uncovered 3 to 4 minutes stirring once only until mushrooms are tender but not shriveled. Stir in flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt mixing with fork until it is all absorbed. Add half and half stirring to mix well. Cook on High uncovered 8 to 10 minutes until boiling and thickened. Stir in beef granules mustard frozen peas ham and sherry. Season to taste with salt and pepper if needed. Heat on 30% power Defrost or Medium-low about 15 minutes stirring once.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Drain peaches; place in lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle with spices. Combine flour oats brown sugar and melted butter; crumble over peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Good served hot or cold.

title: Pineapple Souffle
instructions: Cut off crust from bread and cube. Melt butter. Add sugar milk and eggs. Whip together. Add pineapple and bread cubes. Stir together until well mixed. Bake in greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 about 1/2 hour or until set.

title: French Pancakes
instructions: Mix and fry. Butter and sprinkle with powdered sugar and roll pancake.

title: Seafood Newburg
instructions: Stir milk and flour together. Cook and stir over low heat until sauce simmers and thickens. Stir in sherry and seasonings. Stir in seafood until heated through. Top with buttered bread crumbs and bake until the crumbs are brown on top (400\u00b0).

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. Form into balls. Put on a baking sheet with sides. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Parisian
instructions: Place 4 chicken breasts in pan. Mix mushroom soup wine and mushrooms together. Spoon over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove chicken.

title: Crispy Coconut Shrimp
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp leaving tails intact. Combine flour salt and 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard in a small bowl. In another small bowl beat egg and cream. Combine coconut and bread crumbs on a sheet of wax paper. Dip shrimp in flour mixture then in egg/cream mixture and finally in flour/crumb mixture coating well. Refrigerate in a single layer until ready to cook. Pour oil into medium saucepan to 2-inch depth. Heat to 350 degrees on deep-fat thermometer. Fry shrimp a few at a time in hot oil for about 2 minutes turning once until golden brown. Use slotted spoon and remove to paper toweling to drain. Keep warm in slow oven (200 degrees) until all is done. Serve with Chinese Mustard Sauce and bottled duck sauce.

title: Snow Balls
instructions: Cream sugar salt and butter thoroughly; add vanilla. Gradually stir flour into creamed ingredients. Work nuts in dough. Chill well. Form into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar immediately. Cool on rack. Roll in sugar again. Store in airtight container. Yields 5 dozen snow balls.

title: Recipe For A Good Church Softball Game
instructions: Preheat the day at a refreshing 75\u00b0. Gently stir one team of softball players and umpires together and carefully pour onto playing field. Take second team and strategically place off to the side of the field. Take the strong voiced scorekeepers and place them at 2 different sides. This method is used to avoid confusion among the players.

title: Tabasco Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles add sugar and Tabasco sauce. Do not refrigerate for 7 days. Stir every day. On day 8 refrigerate and enjoy.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Mix graham crackers melted oleo and sugar. Press down in bottom of pan. Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together; put on top of cracker crumbs and top cream cheese mixture with pie filling.

title: Fried Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms; drain. Mix egg milk and Worcestershire sauce. Set to one side. Mix flour instant potatoes lemon pepper salt and pepper. Marinate mushrooms a few at a time about 3 to 5 minutes in egg and milk mixture. Press into flour and potato mixture making sure the mushrooms are coated. Fry about 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until done then take off the bone. Cut into small pieces. Cook noodles in chicken broth until done. Mix in chicken soup mushroom soup sour cream and chicken. Melt butter in casserole dish. Crumble Ritz crackers in butter to make a small crust. Pour in the mixed ingredients then make a small crust on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 or 400\u00b0 until brown on top about 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Heat broiler. Mix dressing juice and seasoning mix. Place chicken on rack of broiler pan. Brush with 1/2 of the dressing mixture. Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat for 8 to 10 minutes. Turn; brush with remaining dressing mixture. Continue broiling 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Serve with twisted breadsticks and black beans with chopped red pepper if desired.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Mix remaining ingredients. Cook on stove until warm then pour over meat. Cover\tmeat with foil. Does not need water.\tWill cook in its own juices. After baking drain fat off. Pour vinegar mixture over meat and put back into oven uncovered. Bake until looks glazy.

title: Leek And Potato Soup
instructions: Saute leeks in butter 5 minutes. Blend in flour and cook 2 minutes. Gradually blend in water. Add salt pepper and potatoes; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes partially covered. Add milk; bring to a simmer. Blend in cream. Turn off heat and add butter. Garnish with chives or parsley.

title: Corn Medley
instructions: Combine corn celery bouillon cube and water; simmer until cube is dissolved and vegetables are tender. Add mushrooms tomato salt and pepper. Simmer briefly. Serves 6. Fifty calories a serving.

title: Baked Green Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Flute the edges of the pastry; place pastry-lined pie pan in refrigerator to chill. Heat the milk over very low heat until tiny bubbles appear around the edges of the milk. Set aside to cool until almost lukewarm. Beat the eggs in a bowl until whites and yolks are well blended. (The reserved white is for later use.) Mix the sugar salt and cinnamon; stir into the beaten eggs and beat until some of the sugar dissolves. Add the vanilla and almond extracts to the cooled milk. Gradually pour this mixture into the egg-sugar mixture stirring constantly. Strain the mixture into a clean bowl. Stir in the coconut. Set aside.

title: Blueberry Pizza
instructions: Mix together place into greased pan press into bottom of pan. Bake 375 for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar soda salt and cocoa together. Add buttermilk Wesson oil vinegar vanilla eggs and food coloring in order and mix thoroughly. Bake in 3 layer pans which have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Add cocoa butter vanilla and salt. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie crust. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Cherry Salad
instructions: To cherry jello add 2 cups hot water 3/4 cup cold water crushed pineapple and juice. To strawberry jello add 2 cups hot water 3/4 cup cold water and strawberries. Allow cherry jello to set. Spread sour cream over cherry jello and pour on partially set strawberry jello layer. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Fudge Nut Bars
instructions: In double boiler melt chips milk oleo and salt. Remove from heat\tand add walnuts and vanilla. Sift and set aside flour salt and soda. In large bowl blend oleo and brown sugar. Mix well and add eggs and vanilla. Blend well; add flour mix and oatmeal.\tPress 2/3 of mix in greased 10 x 15-inch pan. Spread chocolate filling over. Crumble remaining 1/3 crumb mix over filling. Sprinkle nuts over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain. Mix in remaining ingredients. Add water and let cook slowly.

title: Five Layer Dinner
instructions: Layer potatoes hamburger onions peppers and tomatoes in 2-quart casserole dish. Salt and pepper each layer. Garnish with sliced peppers. Cover with foil and bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: California Summer Salad
instructions: Place all ingredients in an airtight glass jar that can be shaken before each serving. Allow several hours or overnight for the flavors to blend. This mixture does not have to be refrigerated. It can be left out at room temperature and more ingredients added as needed.

title: Wilted Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream and honey; set aside.

title: Best Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Bring water and salt to a boil. Add rice; cover and remove from heat. Let sit for 5 minutes. Melt butter in skillet; saute onion and celery until tender. In large mixing bowl combine rice celery and onion with remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed. Mix sour cream cottage cheese and onions. Set this mixture aside. Brown hamburger meat; drain. Add tomato sauce and seasonings then simmer for 10 minutes. Layer meat mixture and noodle mixture in a casserole dish. Top with Cheddar cheese. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Pound Cake (Almond)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Beat for about 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Dog Treats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour cornmeal liver and garlic together. Add eggs shell and all. Mix well so shells are crushed. If too thick add water as needed.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar flour and milk. Circle approximately 10 minutes. Add salt and butter and circle 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Vietnamese Fried Rice
instructions: Wash the rice. Cook rice in 3 cups water. Chop onion and cook in frypan containing 1 tablespoon oil. Place small pieces of\tpork in oil. After seasoning with salt pepper and sugar fry for 10 minutes.\tRemove\tpork and cook shrimp in same manner for only 5 minutes. Remove shrimp from pan. Cook peas. Use another skillet to fry the cooked rice in 1 tablespoon of oil. Add pork\tshrimp\tand peas to fried rice and cook on medium heat for 10 minutes. You may add a pinch of Accent if desired. Yellow food coloring may be added at the time rice is being cooked to add a more appetizing color.

title: Calico Beans(Serves 8)
instructions: Cut up bacon and fry until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Save fat. Cook beef in bacon fat until browned. Add onion and sauce until tender. Drain fat from skillet. Combine beef onion salt brown sugar mustard and vinegar in 3-quart baking dish. Partially drain all cans of beans; add to dish stirring gently until mixed. Top with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in an 8-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice and water. Combine sugar flour rolled oats butter and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place layer of broccoli in large flat casserole then layer of cheese and layer of Ritz crackers and drizzle with butter. Repeat with second layer. Heat until hot just before serving. May be made ahead.

title: Sticky Rolls
instructions: Halve biscuits; roll in margarine.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: To make pie shell beat egg whites with cream of tartar and eggs until foamy. Add 1/2 cup sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating after each addition until stiff. Add pecans. Place in a lightly greased 9-inch pie pan spreading like a pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Remove and cool.

title: Corn Cakes
instructions: Mix well and cook on hot griddle. Batter will be thin. Serve for breakfast with syrup or with lunch or dinner for bread substitute.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Place ingredients in large jar. Refrigerate. Marinate the mushrooms in the dressing for up to 2 days. Serves 20.

title: Grandma Vi'S Spanish Yellow Rice
instructions: In 1/4 cup vegetable oil simmer shrimp onion and green pepper for 3 minutes. Add tomato juice saffron sugar and bay leaf. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add water salt pepper and oregano. Bring to a boil. Add rice. Reduce heat cover and cook for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally until rice is cooked. Serves 6.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Stir with fork until blended. Fry in hot oil until browned.

title: Meat Balls With Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Mix all ingredients except soup. Form into balls about 1-inch in size. Bake in baking dish in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour. Drain and return to baking dish. Add mushroom soup. Bake about 15 minutes longer.

title: Cornbread
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour cornmeal sugar baking powder and salt. In small mixing bowl beat egg whites and oil. Stir into dry ingredients just until mixed. Spray a 9 x 9 x 2 baking pan with nonstick spray coating. Pour batter into pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Makes 12 servings.

title: Potato-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes (peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices) about 30 minutes in salt water. Combine soup and milk. Layer half of potatoes onion and cheese in a greased 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour half of soup mixture over cheese. Repeat layers. Sprinkle paprika over top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Date Rolls
instructions: Stir first 4 ingredients and boil 8 to 10 minutes in double boiler until thickened. Cool for 5 minutes. Add Rice Krispies and nut meats. Take little pieces and roll in hand about 2 inches long in confectioners sugar or coconut. Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Strawberry Pie Filling Salad
instructions: Mix all together and freeze overnight in a Jell-O mold.

title: Southern Raised Biscuits
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water; let stand 5 minutes or until bubbly. Add buttermilk and set aside. Combine dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add buttermilk and yeast mixture gradually gently combining with a fork. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead lightly 4 or 5 times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut and place on greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise for 1 hour. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large casserole dish make alternating layers of onions potatoes and chicken. Mix together soup and oleo and spread over evenly. Bake 1 hour.

title: Easy Ice Cream (No Eggs)
instructions: Mix sugar and pudding mix; add milk (both kinds) and then vanilla. Freeze in hand or electric freezer. Fresh fruits may be used by leaving out part of the milk and adding that amount of fruit. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Grant'S Fruitcake
instructions: Cut fruit into small pieces and mix with flour.

title: Sour Cream Torte
instructions: Add pudding to cake mix. Mix and put in 2 (9-inch) round cake pans. Bake as directed on the box. When cake is cold cut both layers in half so that you end up with 4 layers.

title: Peanut Butter-Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients separate. Beat butter until fluffy. Add egg peanut butter milk and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Add dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in 1/2 cup of the sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon. Put in greased and floured Bundt pan. Melt butter and add remaining sugar and cinnamon. Heat until sugar melts and pour over biscuits. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes then remove to cake plate.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender. Mix soups water and broth. Heat. Layer bread crumbs chicken in small pieces then soup. Keep layering and make bread crumbs last layer. Bake 15 minutes at 450\u00b0 then 30 minutes on 350\u00b0

title: Picnic Potato Salad
instructions: Cover potatoes in their skin with water in a large pot. Cook on medium heat until tender. Drain water and let potatoes cool. Peel potatoes and chop into bite-size pieces. In large mixing bowl combine potatoes onion sweet pickles pickle juice mustard and mayonnaise. Sprinkle salt onto mixture and stir. Spoon into serving dish and dust lightly with paprika.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple juice with pudding mix in medium saucepan. Cook until starts to boil then remove from heat. Allow to cool until clear. Place apples pineapple and grapes in large bowl. Add pudding mixture and stir gently. Add bananas shortly before serving; stir gently. Decorate top with cherries.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: In small bowl combine all dry ingredients except nuts. In large bowl cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and applesauce; mix well. Stir in flour mixture until smooth. Add nuts. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix butter 2 cups flour powdered sugar and pecans as pie dough. Pat in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil and eggs and blend. Add grated raw apples and sugar. Sift dry ingredients and add to apple mixture. Mix well. Add nuts raisins dates and coconut. Bake in a tube cake pan in slow oven for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Baked Sauerkraut And Sausage
instructions: Wash sauerkraut. Slice sausage and chop the onion. Layer sausage then onions sauerkraut and brown sugar. Repeat until all is used.

title: Oriental Peas
instructions: Put the first 3 ingredients in skillet and saute. Add the peas. Cook for 5 minutes in 1 cup of boiling water and drain. Add pimento soup water chestnuts and 1/4 cup liquid from chestnuts. Mix up. Put in covered dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Country Potato Salad
instructions: Wash potatoes; place in a pot of cold water. Cover and boil for approximately 20 minutes or until soft. (Or the potatoes can be microwaved in 1/4-inch water for 10 minutes until soft.) Halfway through the cooking add the carrot.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine eggs sugar shortening and applesauce; stir well. Sift dry ingredients; add a little at a time to the mixture. Stir until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Best Ever Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch water beaten egg yolks lemon juice and margarine together. Cook in a double boiler until thick (about 25 minutes). Remove from heat. Add lemon extract and vinegar. Stir thoroughly and then cool. Pour into crust. Cover with meringue and brown. Serves 6.

title: Pizza Dip
instructions: Mix all together in bowl. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Can also be microwaved or put in crock-pot. Serve with tortilla chips or Fritos.

title: Apricot-Raisin Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cover apricots with boiling water and soak about 1/2 hour. Squeeze juice from orange and add enough boiling water to make 1 cup. Set aside. Save orange peel.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Stir sugar cocoa and milk together. Boil 10 to 15 minutes. Take off stove. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Stir about 10 to 15 minutes. Pour on buttered plate.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients (be sure to drain fruit). Blend in a small carton of sour cream. Put in refrigerator. Serve cold.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain and lay in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together all other ingredients; pour over broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Dreams
instructions: Combine cream cheese butter or margarine salt walnuts sherry flavoring and dash of paprika. Make square sandwiches (cut crust from slices of bread; cut each slice into 4 squares). Spread with cream cheese mixture. Garnish with stuffed olive slices.

title: Janet'S Quiche
instructions: Divide ingredients in half. Cook spinach; drain well. Cut ham into chunks. Place Swiss cheese in bottoms of pie crusts then spinach mushrooms and ham. Beat eggs half and half salt pepper and flour together. Pour on top of pies. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese over pies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Yields 2 pies. Enjoy one now and freeze one for later.

title: Senate Bean Soup
instructions: Wash and sort beans and cover in a large pot with 6 to 8 cups of hot water. Boil 2 minutes. Let stand 1 hour off of heat. Add another 2 quarts of cold water and ham bone. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes until beans are tender. Remove ham bone and trim off meat. Return to soup. Makes 3 quarts. I serve over rice.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In 3-quart oblong baking dish combine soup milk thyme and pepper. Stir in vegetables and chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble.

title: Vegetarian Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix shortening sugars yogurt and vanilla thoroughly. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting. (For a softer more rounded cookie add 1/4 cup more flour.) Stir dry ingredients together; blend in. Mix in chocolate chips. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until delicately browned. (Cookies should still be soft.) Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet. Makes about 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add 3 cups flour and stir. Add remaining 1 1/2 cups flour and stir. Add bag of chocolate chips. Stir. Shape into teaspoon size balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Apple Roll
instructions: Roll out dough. Spread with\tbutter cinnamon and 4 tablespoons brown sugar. Add 2 cups finely chopped apples; make a roll then slice about 1/2 inch thick put in cake pan. Mix 1 cup water and 1 cup molasses; pour over the rolls. Bake in moderate oven. Serve with milk. Eat while hot.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Small measures for 1 cake large for 2 cake pans.

title: Chocolate Almond Pie
instructions: Melt marshmallows and chocolate in milk in double boiler. Remove from heat; cool. Whip the cream until stiff. Fold into chocolate mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into crust and chill. Can be topped with whipped cream if desired.

title: Kentucky Corn
instructions: Melt margarine in a casserole. Beat eggs into mixture one at a time. Add milk or cream. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stir-Fried Broccoli And Beef
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and 1/2 cup water. Set aside. Mix cornstarch with remaining 1/4 cup water; set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in uncovered wok at 300\u00b0. Add broccoli stalk slices cover; cook 2 minutes. Add flowerets; cover cook 2 minutes or until tender-crisp. Remove broccoli to hot platter. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to wok; heat at 375\u00b0. Add meat; stir-fry 1 minute. Add soy sauce mixture; stir-fry 2 minutes. Return broccoli to wok; mix. Add cornstarch mixture. Stir until slightly thickened. Serve immediately.

title: Never Fail Meringue
instructions: Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and cornstarch. Add water and cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick and clear. Cool. Beat egg whites with salt and vanilla. Add 6 tablespoons sugar gradually beating after each addition of ingredients. Add cooled cornstarch mixture and continue beating until peaks form. Use as desired.

title: Sheila'S Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan over medium heat. Scramble egg in bowl. Dip chicken in egg and then bread crumbs. Fry lightly. Take out and pat off excess oil and set aside. In the same pan melt butter slice mushrooms and stir-fry. Add parsley chicken broth and salt and pepper to taste. Add cooking wine. Lay chicken in greased baking pan. Pour mushroom mixture over chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Super Spuds
instructions: Cook potatoes covered in lightly salted boiling water about 20 minutes or just until tender. Cool to room temperature. Cut potatoes in half. Using a small spoon or melonballer remove a small scoop of potato from each potato half. Sprinkle each potato cavity with pepper. Combine sour cream chopped olives chopped tomatoes and hot pepper sauce in a small bowl. Fill potato cavities with a dollop of sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with chives. Serve at room temperature. Makes 24.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Take uncooked chicken off bones and cut into bite-size pieces. Salt and pepper. Melt margarine in skillet on low heat. Add all ingredients except chicken. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top and push down with spatula. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered. Cover with foil and bake 20 to 30 minutes longer. Add grated cheese if desired. Heat just until melted.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together in 2nd bowl flour oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. (Put 1/2 cup oats into blender and make a powder.) Mix together all ingredients. Add chocolate chips Hershey bar and nuts. Make golf ball size cookies; place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 8 minutes. Makes 112 cookies. This is the original recipe.

title: Blueberry Pound Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except blueberries. Mix well as you would any cake mix. Fold in blueberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix all but last two ingredients and refrigerate. Toss the items. Add the last two ingredients at the last minute.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Place meat in casserole. Mix all other ingredients together; pour over meat. Bake for 3 hours at 350\u00b0 covered. Mash while hot. Serve on buns. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Jalapeno Jelly
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar and peppers in heavy saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and cool 20 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut all vegetables into small pieces. Mix together salad dressing sour cream and dry salad mix. Add to vegetables and toss well.

title: 5 Layer Casserole
instructions: Put in layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Dog Biscuits(For Man'S Best Friend)
instructions: Combine flours yeast bulgur cornmeal parsley flakes and milk in a large bowl. In small bowl combine yeast and warm water and stir until dissolved. Add chicken broth. Stir liquid into dry ingredients and mix well with hands. Dough will be stiff so add more water if necessary. Roll dough 1/4-inch thickness on floured surface. Cut with knife or doggie bone cookie cutter. Transfer cut biscuits to cookie sheet and brush lightly with egg glaze. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn off heat and let biscuits dry out in oven overnight. Yield 6 to 7 dozen biscuits.

title: Butter Frosting For Cake Decorating
instructions: Beat at low speed. To thin add water. To thicken add powdered sugar.

title: Saucy Green Beans
instructions: Place beans in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender.

title: Long Island Tea
instructions: Mix and fill with Coke.

title: Lemon Berry Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in a medium bowl using wire whisk until smooth. Stir in lemon peel and juice. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of Cool Whip. Spread evenly in bottom of crust. Press strawberry halves into cream cheese layer. Reserve some for garnish. Pour 2 cups milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 1 minute. Let stand 1 minute or until thickened. Gently stir in 1 cup of Cool Whip. Spoon over berries in crust. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish with remaining Cool Whip and reserved berries. Keep covered in refrigerator.

title: Hoagie Spread
instructions: Chop all the meats and cheese into small pieces. Shred the Lettuce dice the tomatoes and onions. Mix all the ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Spread on an Amoroso or any long or round sandwich roll.

title: Sangria Wine Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Bake in greased and floured Bundt or tube pan for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix well then make into patties. Place in a hot skillet with oil and fry until brown on both sides.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Delicious with vegetables or chips.

title: Authentic French Dressing(For Bibb And Leaf Lettuce)
instructions: Shake all ingredients together. Serves about 4 salads.

title: Hot Tea
instructions: Mix well; put 2 teaspoons to 1 cup of hot water. Keep in tightly closed jar.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Mix together the oleo eggs and sugars. Blend in pineapple and bread pieces. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Superb with ham. (Use Pyrex casserole dish.)

title: Baked Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix together crumbs cheese and parsley. Melt butter. Add garlic mustard and Worcestershire sauce; stir well. Let butter mixture cool but not congeal. Dip chicken in butter then crumbs. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Add melted butter to sweet potatoes then milk and sugar. Add flour salt and baking powder. Pat or roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with floured cutter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chili Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger and diced bacon; add and saute onions. Add tomatoes and tomato sauce. Cook on medium to low heat in large Dutch oven or heavy pot. Add all seasonings. Cook 1 hour then add tomato paste and cook on low heat 30 minutes. Add cooked beans and simmer for 30 more minutes. Cook pinto beans in clear water until tender not mushy after washing and presoaking for 4 hours or overnight.

title: Asparagus Souffle Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8-inch square baking dish. In a large bowl beat eggs for 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tester inserted near center comes out clean. Let cool. Cut into 36 squares. Serve at room temperature.

title: Molded Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; save juice adding enough water to make 1 1/4 cups liquid. In a saucepan bring to boil. Remove from heat; stir in gelatin until dissolved. Break up cranberry sauce with a fork; stir into gelatin mixture. Cool until mixture begins to thicken. Stir in crushed pineapple celery and nuts. Pour into oiled mold. Chill until set. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crullers
instructions: Dissolve soda in milk. Strain it into 1/2 pint flour and melted butter. Beat eggs with sugar. Work them into rest of ingredients. Add flour to make it stiff enough to roll out; cut and fry in hot lard or oil. Flavor with nutmeg.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe casserole combine and mix sugar corn syrup and peanuts. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir in salt. Microwave on High 3 to 5 minutes or until light brown in color. Add butter and vanilla blending well. Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes. Add baking soda; gently stir until light and foamy. Pour immediately on buttered cookie sheet. Break when cool. Store in airtight container. Makes about 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Work butter into flour with fingers. Add the rest of the dry ingredients and raisins. Use fingers to do this. When mixture resembles coarse meal add egg beaten lightly with buttermilk. Stir with a spoon until well blended. Dust hands with flour and knead dough for 3 minutes on a floured surface (will be smooth). Cut in half and shape into two balls. Set on greased baking sheets and flatten slightly and cut a cross into the top with a sharp floured knife. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes until gold and crisp.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar vanilla and oil until fluffy. Add zucchini flour baking powder soda and salt into egg mixture. Add fruit and nuts and bake in two or three loaf pans or one angel food cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Swiss Steak For 2
instructions: Cut steak into 2 pieces. Salt pepper and flour steak. Brown in oil. Add tomatoes. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Add green pepper onion and salt. Cover and simmer until meat is tender about 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Slice peaches into buttered tin. Sprinkle with sugar and dots of butter. Place in warmed oven. Mix together remaining ingredients. Cover peach mixture with flour mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan. Cool. Add eggs 1 at a time. Beat well by hand. Cream in sugar. Add dry ingredients then chips and nuts. Add vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Bake in a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: California Sushi Sauce
instructions: Stir well. May be used as a vegetable dip also.

title: Itsy-Bitsy Pizzas
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Coat cookie sheets with nonstick cooking spray. Evenly sprinkle 1 tablespoon cornmeal on each sheet. Cut dough into 6 equal pieces. On lightly floured surface roll each piece of dough into a 6-inch circle using hands to stretch dough. Pinch edge of dough to form a low stand-up rim. Place 3 dough circles on each cookie sheet; brush each circle lightly with oil. Top pizzas as desired. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is melted.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Return to pan. Add cheese; stir. Pour into a 9 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch casserole dish. Cover with cracker crumbs. Pour melted margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pickled Onions
instructions: Put onions in crock (glass) bowl. Add salt; mix well. Let stand 12 to 18 hours to cure. Rinse with cold water and drain well. Combine sugar and vinegar; let boil. Pack onions in pint jars. Add sugar and vinegar mixture to cover onions and within 1/4-inch of top. Add 1 or 2 cloves per jar. Wipe rim; add lids and submerge in boiling water for 5 minutes.

title: Fudge Goodies
instructions: Mix brown sugar softened butter egg flour salt milk and soda together. Beat until smooth. Add 1/2 cup hot water to 1 square chocolate or 3 tablespoons cocoa and add vanilla. Add chocolate mixture to first mixture. Mix well then pour in pan. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Nana Georgia'S Prune Cake
instructions: Mix and stir all ingredients together with wooden spoon. Bake in a buttered glass baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pickled Squash
instructions: Sprinkle salt over onions and squash. Put ice on top. Let stand 3 hours; drain. Mix the vinegar sugar seeds and turmeric. Heat well. Add squash mix. Bring to a full boil. Fill jars and seal.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and bake in 2 greased and floured bread pans at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: After Dinner Mint Brownies
instructions: *Three tablespoons of cocoa and 1 tablespoon oil equals 1 square unsweetened chocolate.

title: Chicken Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients. Can be stored in refrigerator. Makes enough for 10 chicken halves.

title: Something Different Sweet Rolls
instructions: Mix cake mix yeast and flour. Stir in 2 1/2 cups of hot water. Let rise until double in size. Roll into a rectangular shape on floured surface. Spread with butter cinnamon and sugar mixture. Roll as a jelly roll and cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch slices. Let rise in pan. Before baking melt topping ingredients oleo syrup brown sugar and nuts. Pour over rolls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix with cocoa. Add vanilla buttermilk cake coloring margarine and eggs. Blend until moistened. Add soda and vinegar and mix into cake mixture. Beat for 4 minutes at medium speed. Bake at 375\u00b0 in layer pans for 25 to 30 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Blend 1/3 cup peanut butter with powdered sugar and vanilla. Using 1/2 teaspoon for each shape into balls. Combine melted Candiquick and 1/2 cup peanut butter. Spoon just enough mixture into each of 24 paper bonbon cups (1 1/2-inch) to cover the bottom. Top with remaining chocolate mixture. Chill for faster setting. Makes 24 cups.

title: Sock It To Me Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil together. Add cake mix and sour cream. In a separate bowl mix chopped pecans brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour half of the batter in a tube pan that is greased and floured well. Add pecan mix on top of the batter then add the remainder of the cake batter. Bake for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Ham And Green Bean Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Rinse beans under running cold water to separate; drain and spread in ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Layer with ham and cheese. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour over cheese. Bake uncovered until golden brown 45 minutes.

title: Macaroon Pie
instructions: Roll out saltines on wax paper until finely crushed. Add cut up dates and nuts. Set aside.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain artichokes and grate or put in food processor. Add mayonnaise and cheese. Mix all together. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm.

title: Special Chocolate Cake With Double Frosting
instructions: Combine cocoa boiling water and butter stirring until mixture is smooth; set aside to cool. Combine sugar and next 4 ingredients in a mixing bowl; add cocoa mixture and shortening beating at medium speed until blended. Add buttermilk eggs and vanilla; beat 2 minutes or until blended. Pour batter into 3 waxed paper lined and greased 8-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove layers from pans and let cool completely on wire racks. Spread never fail frosting between layers and on top of cake. Spread chocolate frosting over top and sides of cake. Garnish with chocolate curls if desired. Yield one 3-layer cake.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Cook onion and green pepper in reserved drippings until tender but not brown. Drain if needed. Crumble bacon and mix with other ingredients. Bake uncovered in 1 1/2-quart casserole at 325\u00b0 for about 2 hours.

title: Crock-Pot Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Start with a layer of potatoes in the crock-pot then add a few onions and a layer of cheese. Continue repeating the layers until all ingredients are used. Pour soup over and cook 7 1/2 to 8 hours on low.

title: Peanut Chocolate Balls
instructions: For candy combine crackers peanut butter and sugar. Stir together with melted butter. Roll into ball and place on wax paper. Stick toothpicks into each ball.

title: Rave Reviews Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour into greased floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on rack.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Cook shrimp crab onions and tomato soup until tender. Remove from heat. Add other ingredients. Place in mold that has been sprayed with Pam. Refrigerate until jelled. Serve with crackers.

title: Church Supper Potato Salad
instructions: In a large bowl begin with a layer of shredded cabbage. Add a layer of potatoes salt pepper and celery seed. Add layer of onion rings pepper rings and boiled egg slices. Spread with mayonnaise. Make other layers or until all ingredients are used. Top with thin layer of mayonnaise and sprinkle with paprika. Refrigerate at least 24 hours. Mix before serving. Serves 18 to 20.

title: Curry Pineapple Dip
instructions: Cut pineapple in half and drain. Blend first 4 ingredients and chill.

title: Ham And Cheese Rolls(Becky Creel'S)
instructions: Combine ham cheese onions and mustard. Separate rolls into 8 triangles. Place 2 heaping tablespoonfuls of ham mixture in center of each triangle. Bring tips of triangle together in center of ham and press edges together to seal. Place on greased baking sheet. Combine water and egg. Brush over rolls. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Crisp Potato Squares
instructions: Melt bacon fat in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Mix other ingredients; spread evenly in bottom of pan. Dot with bacon fat or chopped fried bacon on top. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cut into squares and serve. (Very good with pork chops.)

title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Spread seeds on cookie sheet. Pour remaining ingredients over seeds. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours stirring every 30 to 40 minutes. EAT!

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for about 10 to 12 minutes or until brown at 375\u00b0.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all together. Drop by tablespoon into hot oil. Cook until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Marshmallow Salad(Better Known As Pistachio Salad)
instructions: In a very large bowl mix pineapple marshmallows and Cool Whip all together; mix it well then add the box of pudding mixing well again. Spread salad in an oblong container. Sprinkle walnuts on top then add maraschino cherries in 2 long rows.

title: Layered Salad With Sweet Onions
instructions: Break lettuce in small pieces. Place in bottom of a large salad bowl. Cover with layer of green pepper onion rings peas celery and bacon. Mix mayonnaise sour cream sugar and spices together. Smooth mixture over top of layered vegetables. Sprinkle cheese over mixture. Refrigerate several hours. Sprinkle chopped peanuts on top before serving.

title: Granola
instructions: In a large bowl combine oats apple and wheat germ; mix well. In a small saucepan stir together honey water and cinnamon. Heat to boiling; remove from heat. Stir in vanilla or almond extract. Pour over oat mixture; mix well. Spray a 15 x 10 baking pan and spread oat mixture evenly in pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven about 45 minutes or until brown stirring occasionally. Spread onto foil to cool. To store place cooled granola in an airtight container in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and pour into a greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Drop Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs. Stir in molasses. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with water. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Test one cookie if it cracks open the dough is too stiff. If the cookie flattens the dough needs more flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Martha Washington Creames
instructions: Add sugar a little at a time. If it gets crumbly add a drop of milk. Flatten and roll into a ball. Dip in chocolate. Put a nut on top.

title: Canned Apples
instructions: Wash and peel apples. Slice. Place an aspirin in bottom of hot sterile jar. Pack sliced apples in jar. Cover apples with boiling water. Place another aspirin on top of packed apples. You may also add Fruit Fresh use as directed for brighter apples. Seal with hot lids.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Place chicken in large boiler. Add water; cook until done. Remove chicken from broth. Cool. Bone chicken and cut meat into bite size pieces.

title: Old Fashioned Cornmeal Mush
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and stir into boiling water very slowly. Turn down fire and cook slowly stirring for 10 to 15 minutes. Eat warm with milk and sugar or lump of butter. If desired you may fry by pouring into an oiled loaf pan and store overnight. The next day slice and fry crisp in hot fat over hot fire. Serve immediately with butter and syrup.

title: Orange And Avocado Salad
instructions: Peel avocados and cut into thin slices; dip slices into lemon juice to keep from turning dark. Peel oranges (navel) and cut into slices.

title: Brow Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream together oleo and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Spread batter evenly into a greased 9-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Mamere'S Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and lemon gelatin. Add apricot nectar and oil. Add the eggs one at a time and vanilla and lemon flavorings. Bake in ungreased tube pan at 325\u00b0 about 55 minutes.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put in casserole dish.

title: Strawberry Whipped Cream Cake
instructions: Beat yolks until thick; gradually add sugar vanilla and then water. Blend in sifted dry ingredients. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch waxed paper-lined pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. When cool cut in half.

title: Purple Passion Cake
instructions: Cook cake; let it cool completely. Beat the cream cheese and gradually add powdered sugar. Add the Cool Whip; beat well. Cover the cake completely. Spoon on the blueberry pie filling. Let it run down sides of cake (may fill hole in center).

title: Lazy Man'S Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in a Pyrex oblong glass pan. Mix sugar flour milk and baking powder together. Pour this mixture over melted oleo. Then pour fruit over the 1st mixture. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coriander Pork
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pork. Marinate pork in mixture for 30 minutes. Grill over medium-hot coals for 12 to 15 minutes turning once.

title: Kathy'S Brownies
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking powder; set aside. Melt chocolate and butter. Add vanilla and eggs; beat well. Add sugar; mix well. Add this to the flour mixture. Pour into a greased pan 8 x 8-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Jello Mold
instructions: Mix jello with\t1 cup boiling water. Let set slightly. Add pineapple and cranberries.\tCut in sour cream gently. Add nuts if preferred.\tChill well.

title: Green Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind the peppers and onions into small pieces using a food grinder. Add the salt and let mixture stand overnight. In the morning drain well and add the sugar and vinegar. Cook the mixture 20 minutes or longer until the vegetables are soft and tender. Spoon cooked relish into hot sterilized 1/2 pint jars. Cover with lids and process 5 minutes in hot water bath. Remove from the water and let cool 24 hours before storing.

title: Chili
instructions: Drain meat removing excess fat. Put meat in roaster pan. Add seasonings to taste. Cook onions in water; add to pan of meat. Add tomato paste. Drain beans and add to meat; mix well. Divide chili between two roaster pans. Add enough water to make a medium texture of chili. Not too thick not too thin. Heat oven to 350\u00b0 and let simmer until piping hot about 1 hour. Serves 40.

title: Pork Barbecue
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pork and simmer 1/2 hour or until thick. Pour over pork which has had fat removed. Stir and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Beef In Potato Shells
instructions: Prepare and bake potatoes. Cut potatoes lengthwise into halves. Scoop up potatoes leaving a 1/4-inch shell. Brush outsides and insides of shell with margarine. Place shells cut sides down upon ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until edges are brown 15 to 20 minutes. Cook and stir ground beef until brown. Stir in tomatoes and seasoning mix. (Break up tomatoes.) Simmer 20 minutes. Spoon mixture into shells. Sprinkle with cheese. Heat until cheese is melted in 475\u00b0 oven. Top with sour cream and sprinkle with green onions. Serves 6.

title: Artichoke-Aroni Salad
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to package. Remove from heat; add finely chopped other ingredients. Stir in mayonnaise and curry. Serve cold or still warm.

title: English Roast Beef
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Season the roast with salt and pepper to taste. Melt 2 Tbsp. butter in a dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the outside of the roast on all sides in the butter. After the roast is browned add 1/2 c. water to the pan and sprinkle 1/2 tsp. of sage and 1/2 tsp. of mint onto the roast. Place onion and garlic into the pan if desired and season with seasoning salt and red pepper flakes if using. Cover the pot and place the roast in the oven for 2 to 3 hours depending on how well done you prefer the meat to be; 2 hours for rare and 3 for well done. Removed finished roast to a pan to keep warm. Melt 1 Tbsp. of butter in a medium skillet. Whisk flour into melted butter until smooth. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 c. cold water. Mix until a smooth paste is formed. Return to medium heat and season with remaining sage and mint. Stir in the liquid from the roasting pan and boil stirring constantly until the gravy is thickened. Remove from heat. Slice the roast and serve with gravy poured over the meat.

title: Angel Lush
instructions: Mix pudding mix and pineapple in medium bowl. Gently stir in whipped topping. Cut cake horizontally into 3 layers.

title: Easy And Good Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Par boil brussels sprouts until medium hard about 7-10 minutes. Fry bacon onion and garlic until brown. Add brussels sprouts to pan and mix. Add salt and pepper to taste and saute 10 minutes.

title: Rice The Japanese Way
instructions: Cook rice. In a large circular dish (Japanese rice tray) layer 1/2 of rice. Next add all of kombu which has been soaked and drained. Layer remaining rice. Sprinkle generous amount of Furikake and red ginger strips. Great for parties!

title: One Dish Pork Chop Dinner
instructions: Place skillet on medium high heat. When hot place pork chops in skillet and brown on both sides. Do not flour. When brown add mushroom soup and sliced potatoes; cover and turn heat to low and cook about 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Trash
