instructions: Melt almond bark in double boiler then pour over mixture. Spread on wax paper; cover cookie sheet until hard then break up into pieces.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Melt 2 cups milk and margarine (dont boil). Mix brown sugar eggs vanilla and flour together. Add remaining 2 cups milk. Pour into 2 pie shells and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes until filling is firm.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: In heavy pan bring first three ingredients to a boil stir well. Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Pour over cake while frosting is hot.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Combine fruit 3/4 cup sugar and cinnamon in 1-quart baking dish. Combine egg sugar milk and vanilla and beat until thick. Stir in mix and drop by spoonfuls over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until top is brown. Serve warm with ice cream or Cool Whip.

title: Quick As A Wink
instructions: Slice raw potatoes. Place in bottom of baking dish. Crumble hamburger over potatoes. Add cream of celery and cream of chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove the foil the last 1/2 hour.

title: Mystery Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg yolks; alternate dry ingredients and soup. Add nuts and raisins. Bake in square cake tin.

title: Mother'S Day Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Beat 10x sugar cream cheese butter and vanilla until smooth. (Add red food coloring if wanted.) Slice layers in half and frost. Add strawberries on top.

title: Recipe For A Loving Family
instructions: Mix all together gently. The result will be a happy family full of love peace faith trust caring forgiveness and sharing.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients then add meat. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Honey Bunnies(Makes 15 Bunnies)
instructions: In large bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour undissolved yeast and salt. Heat evaporated milk honey and butter until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Butter does not need to melt. Gradually add to dry ingredients; beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs and 1/2 cup flour; beat 2 minutes at high speed scraping bowl occasionally. With spoon stir in enough additional flour to make stiff batter. Place in bowl coated with Bakers Joy; spray top of dough with Bakers Joy. Cover tightly with plastic; refrigerate 2 to 24 hours.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Pour into a casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Quiche
instructions: Put bacon (or ham or sausage) onion and cheese in pie shell. Combine eggs milk salt pepper (mushrooms) and pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Stir-fry pepper celery and onion in the oil in a large skillet about 8 minutes until tender. Add consomme and rice. Cook stirring for 5 minutes. Blend in mushroom soup. Pour into lightly buttered 2-quart baking dish. Cover. Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until rice is done and liquid has been absorbed. Decorate if you like with pimento strips.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix sugar and water; chill. Then mix juices and bananas. Take out sugar solution and mix together. Divide and pour into two containers (ice cream buckets) and freeze solid. Thaw for at least 2 hours until slushy. Pour in punch bowl. Add one 2 liter bottle ginger ale for each container. Serves 48.

title: Texhoma Beans
instructions: Cook beans in water and salt to taste. Saute onion in 2 tablespoons oil. Brown meat; drain off grease. Add beans meat and remaining ingredients and simmer.

title: Layered Fruit Salad
instructions: Layer apples apricots pears peaches and pineapple in a large bowl. Combine orange juice and lemon juice. Pour over fruit. Spread cherry pie filling on top. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Dutch Cake
instructions: Cream the first 3 ingredients well. Then add the rest of the ingredients. Mix all ingredients and pour into 2 (9-inch) cake tins. Batter will be thick. Sprinkle with cinnamon and brown sugar. Then dot with butter pushing butter down into the dough. You may add apples or blueberries to the batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. If you add fruit bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Three In One
instructions: Saute pepper and onions in butter. Add meat; cook until browned. Place alternate layers of meat mixture and corn in buttered baking dish seasoning with salt and pepper. Arrange sliced tomatoes over top. Cover with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crumbs are brown. Serves 6.

title: Jalapeno Pickled Peppers
instructions: Boil pint jars 15 minutes. Leave in hot water until ready to use. Wash peppers. Cut peppers into rings. Fill each jar with cut peppers. Boil water vinegar and salt. Pour over peppers and seal.

title: Fresh Apricot Pie
instructions: Sprinkle lemon juice over apricots in a large bowl. Add the sugar tapioca and salt. Mix gently to combine fruit and dry ingredients. Let stand 15 minutes. Roll out half the pastry and fit into a 9-inch pie pan.

title: Butternut Squash
instructions: Slice squash in half lengthwise. Place face down on a baking dish. Add 1/2 cup water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until flesh is tender and shell is firm enough to be stuffed.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and cottage cheese until blended. Add pineapple and Cool Whip. Then add pecans and orange slices. Regular Jell-O and Cool Whip can be used if preferred.

title: Icebox Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour into shells. Put in icebox.

title: Apple Cider Punch
instructions: Add all ingredients in a big pot and heat on simmer for about 20 minutes. Add 1 to 2 cups water if desired.

title: Boiled New Potatoes With Mustard And Parsley
instructions: Cook potatoes in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water until they are just tender 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile in a small bowl combine wine mustard oil salt and pepper.

title: Almost Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Make approximately 12 holes in the baked cake using a wooden spoon handle. Pour the condensed milk over the holes. Pour the 2 ice cream toppings over the holes. Chill cake. Just before serving top with Cool Whip and crumbled Heath bars.

title: Sausage Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Let 2 loaves frozen bread rise; pat in a cookie sheet until flat (like a pizza). Fry sausage and drain well. Mix chopped onion green pepper celery and grated cheese. Spread on top of flattened bread dough; roll up and butter the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corn Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in oleo. Add rest of ingredients. Place in casserole dish and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Mousse(The Bomb)
instructions: Mix both puddings together according to package directions. Bake devils food cake according to package directions. Use a square or rectangular pan to bake cake. When cake cools cut into squares. In a large bowl layer cake squares on bottom. Next add pudding layer then Cool Whip layer. Sprinkle top of Cool Whip with crushed Heath bars or Skor bars. Begin another series of layers starting with cake and ending with Cool Whip and Heath bars. If you use pecans sprinkle on top of candy bars.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine boiling water and oatmeal. Let stand for 20 minutes. Cream butter and sugars then add to oatmeal. Sift together flour cinnamon baking soda and salt. Add to oatmeal mixture and stir in vanilla. Bake in a greased and floured 11 x 13 pan at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients for icing and spread on cake. Brown under broiler until bubbly.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise sour cream and honey. Add apples; mix well to prevent apples from discoloring. Add celery walnuts and grapes; mix lightly. Chill well before serving. Yield 3 or 4 servings.

title: Tangy Green Beans
instructions: Wrap 6 or 7 beans in each bacon strip and boil until bacon is done. Mix butter vinegars salt pepper parsley and onions together. Boil and pour over beans.

title: E-Z Fudge
instructions: Boil pudding mix sugar and milk until a soft ball forms in cold water. Add butter. Beat until creamy. Add nuts if desired.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss chicken celery almonds pimento and mayonnaise. Blend in lemon juice onions and seasonings. Fill a shallow greased casserole. Mix grated cheese with chips. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until heated through and lightly browned. Yields about 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Cook chicken until done. Cut into bite size pieces. Cook chicken broth bouillon cubes and vegetables that have been chopped in food processor until soft. Put chicken in stock and add water until desired taste. Before serving cook noodles. Put noodles in bowl and pour broth over noodles. Serve. Sure to make anyone feel good when tasting! Serves 6 to 8. Can freeze. Can do ahead.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken in greased casserole dish. Combine soup and broth. Pour over chicken. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into 3 well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Basic Red Salsa
instructions: Put all in blender; blend until desired consistency. Stores well in refrigerator for several days.

title: Hot And Spicy Chili
instructions: Combine ground beef onions and garlic in a large saucepan and cook until meat is browned. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil then lower temperature and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Chocolate Pizza
instructions: In a microwave-safe bowl combine 2 1/2 cups vanilla chips and chocolate chips. Microwave chips for 2 minutes. Stir; microwave 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir until smooth. Add marshmallows cereals and peanuts. Mix spread evenly on 13-inch pizza pan that has been coated with Pam. Arrange cherries on top. Sprinkle with coconut. Melt remaining vanilla chips; add oil and stir until smooth. Drizzle over pizza. Chill until firm. Serve at room temperature.

title: Neiman Marcus Cookie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar add eggs and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and mix well. Add chocolate chips grated candy and nuts. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Chop cabbage. Mix other ingredients. Pour over cabbage. Sprinkle with rice wine.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: In a baking dish layer rice and chicken; top with mixture of soup and milk. Sprinkle with pepper and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Orange Butter Whitefish Fillets(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Mix salt pepper orange juice orange rind melted butter and nutmeg. Pour over fish. Bake at 450\u00b0 allowing 10 minutes per inch thickness for frozen fish or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Connie'S Red Beans
instructions: Cut up bacon and fry with cut up onions. Drain off grease. Cut up celery and green pepper. Drain the kidney beans. Combine these with the rest of the ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Slush
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 10 minutes. Cool. Add orange juice crushed pineapple lemon juice and banana. Makes 2 trays.

title: Hot Sausage Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and onion. Drain. Add chilies and tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes. Add sour cream and cream cheese. Keep hot in crock-pot.

title: Cranberry Raspberry Pie
instructions: Drain raspberries (press lightly) and reserve syrup. Add enough water to make one cup. In saucepan combine cranberries and syrup mixture. Bring to a boil; simmer 5 minutes. Meanwhile combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Add to cranberry mixture. Cook quickly stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Stir in raspberries.

title: Southern Cooked Beans
instructions: Put washed beans in crock pot or in large pot on stove. Add water salt and oil. Cook until partially done and add ham or ham hocks. Cook until beans are tender. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Thaw Cool Whip and mix all of the ingredients with fork. Refrigerate a couple of hours. Serve with fresh fruit (strawberries grapes apples pears cantaloupe cherries etc.).

title: Poulet A Deux
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to flatten. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with slices of ham. Place 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese in center of each. Roll and secure with toothpicks. Arrange in baking dish. Combine tomato sauce sugar salt Tabasco and garlic powder; pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove toothpicks. Place slice of Mozzarella cheese over each roll. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Favorite Fillets
instructions: Combine bay leaf tomato sauce mustard and mayonnaise in bowl. Microwave for 2 minutes on High. Arrange fish in baking dish. Pour sauce over fish and top with crumbs. Microwave for 5 minutes; turn dish and cook 5 minutes longer.

title: Ham Salad Filling
instructions: Rinse frozen peas under running cold water to separate; drain. Mix all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least two hours.

title: Easy Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli onion and bacon in large bowl. Mix well. Combine mayonnaise sugar and vinegar in small bowl; mix until sugar dissolves. Chill both mixtures until 30 minutes before serving time. Pour dressing over broccoli mixture; mix well.

title: Impossible Taco Pie
instructions: Brown ground chuck with onions; drain. Add taco seasoning mix. Spread mixture in a greased 10 1/2-inch pie plate. Spoon drained chilies over meat mixture. Mix eggs milk and Bisquick until creamy; pour over meat mixture. Bake 25 minutes. Take out put sliced tomatoes on top and sprinkle cheese over tomatoes. Return to oven for 8 to 10 minutes until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Top with sour cream. Serve with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Note Kiwi fruit and grapes are also good added

title: Quick Potato Cheese Bake
instructions: Prepare instant mashed potato as label directs. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Add Parmesan to potatoes and eggs. Beat until well blended. Spoon potatoes into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake slightly puffed and golden. Makes 6 or 7 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Microwave Fudge
instructions: Put all ingredients except nuts in a 2-quart microwave dish. Microwave on High 4 minutes. Add nuts and blend only once until smooth. Chill in refrigerator. Cut into squares.

title: Meat Loaf And Sauce
instructions: Mix above ingredients and form into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese on pie shells. Arrange 1/2 strawberries over cream cheese. Mix sugar cold water cornstarch syrup butter and salt in a pan and bring to a boil. Cook until thick 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in strawberry Jell-O and red food coloring immediately while hot. Chill until almost congealed before pouring over strawberries. Chill. Before serving top with whipped cream.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Measure and sift flour; add to first mixture. Stir in remaining vanilla apples and nuts. Mix well; mixture will be very stiff. Pour into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Three Vegetable Roast
instructions: Peel seed and chunk squash and potatoes. Brush with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook at 350\u00b0 on a greased cookie sheet until tender.

title: Whoopie Pies
instructions: Cream together sugar salt shortening vanilla and eggs. Sift together flour soda and cocoa. Also add baking powder. Add this to first mixture alternately with water and sour milk. Add slightly more flour if milk is not thick. Drop by teaspoon. Bake in a hot oven.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and oil. Add dry ingredients then pumpkin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Granola
instructions: Add vanilla to oil honey nutmeg cinnamon and salt; mix well. In a large roasting pan put the flakes wheat germ all-brand nuts and seeds. Pour honey mixture over all. Put in oven at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes; take out and stir. Repeat every 10 minutes for 45 minutes. When cool add 1 3/4 cups of raisins or any dry fruit and coconut.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: Combine carrots celery and carrot tops cilantro onion chicken breast garlic and stock in a large soup pot. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 25 minutes or until chicken is tender. Heat oil in fry pan over medium high heat. Cut tortillas into 1/2 inch strips and fry to desired crispness. Drain on paper towel lined plate. Strain simmered soup into large bowl and slice cooked carrots from the strained vegetables. Discard other vegetables if desired. Remove chicken breast and refrigerate covered until cooled. Once cooled shred meat and add to broth refrigerate. Once completely cooled skim off any fat. Ten minutes before serving bring soup to a simmer over medium high heat. Peel avocado and slice. Add avocado tortilla strips tomato sauce lime juice additional cilantro if desired and jalapeno chilies to soup and stir. Simmer 5 minutes and serve.

title: Chicken With Almonds
instructions: Place the chicken breast in the freezer for 30 minutes to 1 hour. When the chicken is firm remove the skin and cut into thin pieces about 1/4 x 1-inch or cubes and set aside.

title: Baked Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine cooked squash margarine onions crushed crackers beaten egg mixed with milk salt pepper and 1/4 cup of cheese. Pour into buttered casserole and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 fo 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl. Beat well at medium speed. Divide into 4 layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Peel and slice onions; separate into rings (about 5 cups). Saute in butter until golden not brown (about 20 minutes).

title: Meatball Muffins
instructions: Mix and spoon into greased muffin pan. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Almond Cake With Raspberries
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Thaw and drain raspberries. Butter a 9-inch spring-form pan. Line bottom with waxed paper. Butter paper. Grind almonds and 1 cup sugar to a powder; combine with flour. Melt butter. Add Amaretto. Beat white and salt until peaks. Fold 1/4 of almond mixture at a time into whites alternating with butter. Pour into pan. Gently push raspberries into top of cake. Cook for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool and mold. Dust with confectioners sugar.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Apple Cheese Bake
instructions: Mix cheese butter sugar and flour with hands until doughy consistency. Pour apples in 8-inch square pan then spread cheese mixture over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Slightly cook carrots drain and cool. Crush Ritz and add to melted oleo. Mix all ingredients and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes with brush. Slice potatoes with skins on into about 1/2-inch slices. Boil in water about 15 minutes. Lay boiled slices into a greased 10 x 14-inch baking dish or pan. Dot potatoes with remaining stick of oleo. Liberally sprinkle potatoes with garlic powder. Add pepper to taste. Mix 1 can of cream of mushroom soup with 1/2 can of milk (measured with same can). Pour over potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove potatoes from oven and spoon Cheez Whiz over top and return to oven for 5 to 10 minutes more.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Mix Cool Whip cream cheese vanilla pudding and milk. Line the bottom of a large pan with whole vanilla wafers. Alternate layers of pudding mixture and sliced strawberries. Top with crushed vanilla wafers.

title: Rave-Bringing Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cook bread crumbs in butter until browned. Set aside to cool.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Make pumpkin according to recipe on the can for 2 pies. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan (Pyrex if you have one). Sprinkle dry cake mix over pumpkin mixture. Drizzle with margarine to cover dry cake mix. Top with chopped pecans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0; cool. Top with Cool Whip to serve.

title: Graham Squares
instructions: Cool well before covering cooked bottom. Then cover with 1 cup whipped cream sprinkled with graham cracker crumbs. Keep in freezer.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix together; store in jar. To serve add 2 teaspoons to 1 cup hot water.

title: Beef, Cabbage And Tomato Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Add tomato sauce cinnamon cloves and salt; mix well. Layer cabbage and ground beef 1/2 at a time in 12 x 12-inch casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Derek'S Awesome Juice
instructions: Put them all into the blender blend around 4 minutes. Pour it in a tall glass. Try it! It is very tasety.

title: Brownies
instructions: Blend melted butter sugar and vanilla in medium bowl. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well with a spoon or whisk. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture until well blended. Spread into medium-sized pan. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lasagne Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inches. Cook and stir beef over medium heat until brown; drain. Stir in oregano basil tomato paste and 1/2 cup of Mozzarella cheese. Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in plate. Spoon beef mixture over top. Beat milk baking mix eggs salt and pepper until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes clean 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cool 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Crab Stew
instructions: Cream butter with flour mashed hard-cooked egg yolks mustard salt pepper and\tcayenne beating until mixture is smooth. Slowly add enough hot milk to\tmake a thin paste. Pour paste into remaining hot milk and bring to boiling point stirring constantly. Add crab meat and heat 1 minute longer. Remove from heat and add sherry.\tPlace a slice of lemon in each soup bowl. Pour in mixture and garnish with the chopped hard-cooked egg white and parsley.

title: Baked Corn Casserole
instructions: Stir first six ingredients and mix together. Pour into greased casserole. Spread 4 crumbled crackers on top with grated cheese and bake at 300\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Wheat And Cheese Snacks(Diabetic)
instructions: Crush cereal to 1/2 cup. In a small bowl beat margarine and cheese until light and fluffy. Stir in cereal and flour. Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pueblo Chicken And Rice
instructions: In large bowl combine rice tomatoes onion chillies and olives. Spoon 1/2 into 2 1/2-quart dish. Spread with chicken 1/2 of sour cream and 1/2 of cheese. Top with remaining rice mixture sour cream and Jack cheese. Chill 24 hours. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes (1 hour if chilled) or until hot throughout. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Yon Mazetta
instructions: Brown meat; add onions celery and pepper. Simmer soup and cheese until cheese is melted. Add drained cooked noodles to mixture. Turn into large casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. This makes enough for 2 to 3 meals. Freezes well; do so prior to baking.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring the sugar cocoa and milk to a boil. Take from heat and stir in the remaining ingredients. Drop on waxed paper. Let stand for 1 hour.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix together and drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets. Bake for 12 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Sift dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Add oats. Add anything else you want; mix well. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Make Jell-O and let cool. Grind cranberries and orange. Combine with remaining ingredients and let set until it becomes juicy. Add to cool Jell-O.

title: Chicken Breast Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half. Mix cheese and crumbs in bowl. Dip chicken in melted butter and roll in cheese and crumbs mixture. Place chicken in shallow dish sprayed with pam. After dipping all chicken if any crumbs are left over pour over chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered. Heat soup and stir in sour cream. Pour over chicken or use as side dip for chicken.

title: Cream Pie
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Mix flour 1 cup sugar and salt; gradually add milk. Cook over moderate heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Cook 2 minutes and remove from heat. Add small amount to egg yolks; stir into remaining hot mixture. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add butter and vanilla; cool slightly.

title: Holiday Stuffing
instructions: Cook sausage in large skillet until browned. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Cook onion and celery in drippings in skillet until tender. Combine sausage cooked vegetables sage marjoram bread cubes and parsley in large mixing bowl; blend well. Stir in chicken broth to moisten. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Add green beans and soup. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spoon mashed potatoes on top of meat mixture. Sprinkle cheese over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Boil dates butter molasses white raisins brown sugar and water for 3 minutes and cool.

title: Old Fashioned Fried Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Shake in bag of flour with seasoning in it. Fry in electric skillet containing Crisco. Cook until brown. Drain. Put lid on skillet and cook 2 hours at 200\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook berries until they pop open. Add strawberry jello. (Dont add water to jello.) Stir berries and jello until mixed well; add sugar pineapple and nuts. Mix all together and pour in container and chill.

title: Cabbage And Ham Hash
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet cook onion cabbage and carrot in hot margarine until vegetables are tender. Stir in ham potatoes Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Spread mixture evenly in skillet. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes turning occasionally with spatula.

title: Chicken Magnifico
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour 1/2 of sauce into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover sauce with 1/2 pound uncooked noodles. Lay 6 chicken breasts or 1 cut up chicken on top of noodles. Cover with the rest of the sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dog Food
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add tomato sauce chopped tomatoes and add seasoning to flavor. Simmer for 15 minutes. Add can of corn (do not drain) and corn meal. Let cook until corn meal absorbs liquid. Add olives if desired. Lay cheese slices on top; let melt.

title: Greek Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into strips. Marinate 5 to 10 minutes in mixture of oregano pepper lemon juice and salt. Heat olive oil in skillet and saute minced garlic briefly. Add chicken strips (and marinade if you want) and cook until just brown. Serve over cooked rice with some steamed broccoli.

title: Granny Pie
instructions: Butter a 9-inch pie plate. Fill with mixture of first 5 ingredients. Top with brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with whipped cream.

title: Rotisseri Kumbak Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a quart jar and shake. Keep in the refrigerator. Delicious salad dressing. Very good for boiled shrimp.

title: Sinful Salad
instructions: Mix jello in 1 cup boiling water; add fruit. Pour half of mixture in 13 x 9-inch greased dish. Let jell then top with sour cream and remaining jello mixture. Let set.

title: Cuban Chicken
instructions: Simmer chicken in oil 15 minutes. Remove. To pan add garlic onion and green pepper. Cook 4 minutes. Add tomato sauce potatoes spices wine raisins and olives. Add chicken. Simmer about 35 minutes (until done). Stir in frozen peas. Cook until peas are done (2 to 3 minutes).

title: *Church Cookout Chili
instructions: Brown meat; drain well. Put meat in crock-pot. Add other ingredients. Cook on high 1 hour; turn to low and cook 4 hours.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Chicken
instructions: In large roasting pan melt butter in 375\u00b0 oven. Mix buttermilk with egg in a flat dish. Combine flour pecans sesame seed and spices on wax paper. Dip chicken pieces in buttermilk mixture then coat with pecan mixture. Place chicken skin-side down in melted butter. Turn chicken to coat with butter and place skin-side up in one layer. Place pecan half on each piece. Bake for 1 hour without turning.

title: Southern Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix and heat sugar water and vinegar. Set aside. Then mix other ingredients. Next pour mixture (sugar water and vinegar) over veggie mixture and marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours. Drain and serve.

title: Soup Mixture
instructions: Cook and drain all ingredients. Add to tomatoes and bring to a good boil. Add salt and before removing from heat add sugar and lastly add soda. Cook in pressure cooker 30 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Place cabbage leaves in boiling water until tender. Mix rice salt meat pepper and egg. Form meat mixture into balls and wrap cabbage leaves around them. Spread half of sauerkraut on bottom of Dutch oven; place a layer of cabbage rolls on top and spread remaining kraut on top. Add tomato soup and water; cover. Cook 1 hour and 30 minutes on top of stove. Makes 6 servings.

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a small bowl mix paprika caraway seed onion flakes (crushed) dry mustard lemon peel thyme leaves salt and ground red pepper. Brush wings with melted butter and lightly pat paprika mixture on wings. Place wings in a large open roasting pan. Bake 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Land O Lakes Caramel Orange Rind
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease Bundt pan with 1 tablespoon butter. Place teaspoonfuls of orange marmalade in pan. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well. Shape into ball and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt cinnamon and lemon rind in mixing bowl. Prepare pears. Arrange in layers in 9-inch pastry shell. Sprinkle sugar mixture over each layer. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Put crust over top with slits to release steam. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until pears are tender.

title: Shortbread(A Taste Of Scotland)
instructions: Sieve the flour and add the sugar. Rub in the butter and then work the mixture into a ball with a knife. Butter a baking tray and then spread in the mixture or press into a floured mold. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until browned. Remove from oven. Cut into squares from the tray and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Curried Chicken Fruit Salad
instructions: Peel the orange over a bowl to catch the juices. Section and cut into pieces. Add the cooked macaroni chicken and grapes. In a small bowl combine yogurt and curry then pour over macaroni mixture. Toss to coat.

title: Sleigh Ride
instructions: Whip the cream with vanilla. Mix coffee with sugar and chocolate. Pour into mugs. Place a generous dollop of whipped cream in each mug. Garnish with candy cane.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Sift flour and salt into a bowl. Add milk oil and egg; beat until smooth. Separate onions into rings. Dip each ring into batter. Fry 2 to 3 minutes in 375\u00b0 heated oil. Turn drain and sprinkle with salt.

title: Christmas Fruit Balls
instructions: Cream margarine eggs and brown sugar. Add dry ingredients sifted and well mixed. Add raisins pineapple cherries and nuts. Form into balls about 1 teaspoon to each ball. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 10 dozen balls.

title: Fried Turkey
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together in plastic bag (this will coat more than one turkey). Dry turkey inside and out with paper towels. Coat turkey inside and out with mixture. Let stand overnight or longer. Heat oil to 325\u00b0. Put heavy string through turkey and lower it slowly into oil. Make sure turkey is covered with oil breast up. Do not exceed 350\u00b0. Cook 4 minutes per pound. Peanut oil may be strained and used over and over.

title: Dean'S Butterscotch Pie(For 2 Pies)
instructions: Mix brown sugar eggs and milk together then separately mix white sugar flour and cornstarch; then mix and add to mixture. Add vanilla and butter then add 1 quart boiling hot water. Stir and let thicken. Pour into baked pie shells.

title: Hot Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Stew chicken until well done. Remove bones and grind or cut very fine so it wont be stringy. Cover with rich broth. Put in enough cracker crumbs to dissolve broth. Add chicken and mix together. Bake in a flat pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until it thickens. Serve on hot buns.

title: Pumpkin Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix and pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Place in saucepan and cook five minutes. Stir in a can of whole kernel corn mixed with chopped red and green peppers. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Baked Beans And Bacon
instructions: Mix beans onion pepper Worcestershire ketchup and syrup. Stir in brown sugar. Take 3 slices bacon and cut into fourths. Lay aside. Take remaining 3 slices and cut into bite size pieces. Mix bacon pieces and stir evenly into beans. Take remaining bacon and cut into fourths. Place on top of dish. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Italian Spaghetti
instructions: Brown onion ground beef and fat. Add tomato paste tomatoes and water. Mixture should simmer for 1 hour. If needed more water can be added. Serve over cooked spaghetti with 1 teaspoon of grated cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Pretzel Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons of sugar and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 9 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Joyce'S Joyful Brownies
instructions: Mix together and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: Mix on medium speed butter and sugar for a full 4 minutes. Stir in melted chocolate and vanilla. Beat eggs one at a time on high speed until well blended. Pour in baked pie shell. Best if refrigerated overnight.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Broil chicken. Remove skin and bones. Layer broccoli and then chicken pieces. Mix mayonnaise and remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Mix ingredients well and pour in two pie shells (Mrs. Smiths is a good brand).

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain fat. In a large casserole dish mix ground beef refried beans salsa and 1/2 of the cheese. Top with remaining cheese. Microwave or bake until cheese on top is melted.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Stir together thawed strawberries eggs and vegetable oil. Mix together flour baking soda salt cinnamon sugar and nuts. Add to strawberry mixture and stir until blended. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick Bread Mix
instructions: Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Place in 14 cup container and seal. Store up to 6 weeks at room temperature (6 months for freezer). Use mix for biscuits muffins waffles quick breads and cookies.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Reserve 1/2 cup of chicken broth. Remove meat from bones and cut into bite sized pieces. Break tortilla chips into bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Arrange chicken on top of chips. Mix soups tomatoes and onion. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mountaineer'S Fruit Cake(Prune Cake)
instructions: Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Berry Delight
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs sugar and butter/oleo well and press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cream cheese sugar and milk until smooth. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Spread over crust then arrange strawberries in an even layer. Prepare pudding and pour over berries. Chill several hours then top with remaining Cool Whip. Garnish with a few choice berries.

title: Lamb Barley Soup
instructions: Melt butter. Add lamb onions and celery. Cook until lamb is light brown stirring occasionally while cooking. Pour off any fat. Add some carrots peas and potatoes and also bay leaves barley water lemon juice salt and pepper. Cover and cook over low heat (275\u00b0) for about 45 minutes or until vegetables are done. Add parsley and mix well. Serve while hot.

title: Mallow-Graham Bars(Makes 18 Bars)
instructions: In a large saucepan over low heat melt margarine. Add marshmallows; stir until melted. Remove from heat; stir in graham crackers raisins and peanuts. Spread mixture into a greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Cool 1 hour or until firm. Cut into 18 bars. Store in an airtight container.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix melted margarine and stuffing. Put 1/2 of stuffing mix in casserole dish. Mix cooked squash and other ingredients. Put 1/2 of squash mix on top of stuffing; then stuffing then squash then rest of stuffing. Bake about 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Soda Biscuits
instructions: In large bowl mix flour salt baking powder and soda with pastry blender or two knives cut into shortening; until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in buttermilk all at once just until dough clings together. Knead lightly floured surface a few times. Roll out 1/2 inch thick cut with 2 1/2 inch round cutter. Place about 1 inch apart on cookie sheet and braise with butter. Bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Bonnie'S Beef Wellington
instructions: Brown steaks on both sides. Saute onion and mushrooms in butter and wine. Defrost and roll out patty shells. Place piece of meat on patty shell; add mixture of onion mushrooms and wine to meat and wrap pastry around meat. Bake for 20 minutes at 425\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan; mix together remaining ingredients. Reserve 1 cup and spread remainder evenly on bottom of pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gladys' Sweet Stuff
instructions: Cook over low heat until tacky. Water test to see if it is hot enough (put a drop of the mixture into a bowl of cold tap water; if it forms a ball that you can pick up the mixture is ready!)

title: Zucchini And Whole Wheat Fettuccine
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions; drain. Steam zucchini in small amount of water over high heat for 3 minutes; drain and set aside. Combine oil butter (or margarine) garlic and basil in small saucepan. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes; do not brown garlic. Toss fettuccine with zucchini garlic-basil sauce grated cheese and salt. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Peach Melba Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Place peach slices in bottom of pie shell. Cream together sugar flour oleo and salt. Add beaten eggs and vanilla to creamed mixture and mix well. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for 50 minutes. When knife is inserted in middle it should come out clean.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Grease a 15 1/2 x 12-inch baking sheet; set aside. In a 3-quart saucepan combine sugar corn syrup salt and peanuts. Cook and stir over medium-low heat to 240\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Add butter flavor Crisco and vanilla. Continue to cook and stir until 300\u00b0. Stir in baking soda. Immediately pour onto prepared baking sheet; spread quickly into even layer about 1/4-inch thick. Cool completely. Break into pieces.

title: Easter Dinner Ham
instructions: Place the ham in a baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 min. Mix the jelly dijon mustard ginger and brown sugar in a saucepan. Cook over low heat until the jelly melts stirring occasionally. Remove the ham from the oven. Pour the mixture over the ham. Bake for 30 min. longer.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Fry bacon (not crisp). Brown hamburger and onions. Drain butter beans only. Combine all ingredients in large casserole (3-quart). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients except flour tortillas. Place equal portions on each of 5 tortillas and spread to cover. Roll up each tortilla; refrigerate for awhile. Remove from refrigerator and slice into 3/4-inch slices. Serve with salsa.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add lemon rind eggs and milk. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Place in well-greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Smaller pans 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gilda'S Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Top with Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in Mason jar until ready to use. To make add 1 to 2 teaspoons to 1 cup hot water.

title: Mom'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Beat together first 8 ingredients. Add soda to cold water; add to batter. Mix in baking powder and flour. Drop onto greased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork dipped in water. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Whisk together the flour and salt. Rub the butter into the flour with fingertips until resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle the water over the mixture while tossing with a fork. Knead the dough for several turns on a lightly floured surface to bring it together. Shape the dough into a thick disk. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate at least 1 hour. To roll out the dough place between 2 pieces of waxed paper and roll it out to a circle 2-inches bigger than the size of the pan. Fit the dough into a 9-inch lightly buttered pie plate. Fold the overlapping edge of the crust under the rim. Pinch a small piece of dough between your thumb and 1st knuckle of index finger angling your hand slightly. Repeat around crust putting your index finger into the depression your thumb just made. Keep the crust in refrigerator until ready to fill. If prebaking the crust refrigerate at least 30 minutes before baking.

title: Marsala Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and paprika; stir well. Dredge chicken in breadcrumb mixture. Arrange chicken in a shallow baking pan coated\twith cooking spray. Dot with margarine and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for\t30 minutes. Pour wine over chicken.\tCover and bake 15 minutes; uncover and bake 15 minutes. Serves 6. Low in calories and fat grams.

title: High-Note Tenor Hush Puppies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together into bowl; mix in onion. Add egg and milk; stir until just mixed. Drop from teaspoon several at a time into deep hot fat. Cook until golden brown; drain on absorbent paper. Serve hot. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Double Chocolate Treasures
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In heavy saucepan over low heat melt 1 cup chocolate chips (I use the microwave). Stir until smooth. Cool slightly. Beat together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in eggs vanilla and melted chocolate. Add combined dry ingredients except powdered sugar. Stir in remaining chocolate pieces.

title: Hog'S Head Cheese
instructions: Wash your cucumbers thoroughly and pack into jars. Make a solution of a proportion of 2 cups salt to a gallon of boiling water. Pour over cucumbers and place a saucer over the top of each jar (do not seal tightly). Let stand for 1 week. On the eighth day drain and wash cucumbers. Cut them into small chunks thin slices or spears. Make a solution of one gallon hot tap water and 1 tablespoon powdered alum and pour over the pickles which you should put back into the cleaned gallon jar (do not pack tightly because the alum will make them swell). Drain the water off the pickles for the next 3 mornings and make a fresh solution of alum and water to pour over the pickles. Alum makes the pickles crunchy. On the twelfth morning drain all the water off the pickles. Heat 6 cups white vinegar 6 cups sugar and a mixture of 1 tablespoon pickling spice and 1 tablespoon celery seed; (put the spices and celery seed on a clean cloth and tie it so that the spices do not get into the vinegar). Bring to a boiling point and pour over the pickles.

title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine bacon broccoli cauliflower and Cheddar cheese. Mix separately the mayo onion vinegar and sugar. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate overnight.

title: Orange Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix together the jello and cottage cheese. Add the pineapple and oranges. Chill. Add the Cool Whip before serving.

title: Killer Brownies
instructions: Bake brownies as directed on box in a 9x13-inch pan. When done remove from oven. Sprinkle marshmallows on top. Return to oven for 3 minutes. Remove from oven. Mix 1 bag (6 oz.) chocolate chips and peanut butter in pan on top of stove until melted. Remove from heat add rice krispies. Mix well - Spread on top of brownies. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Cut into squares.

title: Cherry Crumb Cake
instructions: Take 1 1/2 times the crumb recipe for best results. Sift first 4 ingredients in bowl. Cut in butter until crumbly. Add egg; mix with fork. Press half of crumb mixture into greased pan. Spoon cherry pie filling over first layer. Top with remaining crumbs. Serve warm topped with whipped cream cold milk or ice cream.

title: Maple Pecan Chiffon Cake
instructions: Do not grease pan. Into a small mixing bowl put flour sugar baking powder and salt. Mix in brown sugar. Make a well and add oil egg yolks cold water and maple flavoring.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine sugars and cinnamon. Wet hands and cut biscuits into quarters. Roll biscuits in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Drop into greased Bundt pan. Sprinkle remaining sugar over biscuits and pour melted butter over biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Rissotto With Porcini Mushrooms
instructions: Melt butter in a deep skillet. Grind in pepper to taste. Add the rice. Stir thoroughly. Add wine. Let some evaporate; add the broth. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes.

title: No Crust Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Add milk and flour. Blend well. Add coconut. Pour into lightly greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening sugar and vanilla. Add egg and milk. Beat until light and fluffy. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Fold in creamed mixture. Divide into 1/2 and chill for at least 1 hour. Roll out and use cookie cutters or just use spoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Enjoy plain or with Buttercream Icing. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugar; add beaten egg and vanilla. Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Beat the flour mixture into the creamed mixture. Shape dough into two rolls. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate about 3 hours. When ready to bake preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut rolls into slices and bake on slightly greased cookie sheet for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Sunshine Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt basil Accent and pepper. Mix together soy sauce catsup honey corn oil and garlic. Put chicken in baking dish and baste with sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered basting frequently for about one hour or until fork can be inserted with ease.

title: Morning Mix-Up
instructions: In a large skillet saute potatoes ham and onion in oil for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. In a small bowl beat eggs salt and pepper. Add to skillet; cook stirring occasionally until eggs are set. Remove from heat and gently stir in cheese. Spoon onto a serving platter; sprinkle with chives.

title: Caramel Fudge Balls
instructions: Chop 1/2 cup of the walnuts to medium size pieces. Chop remaining walnuts into fine pieces for coating fudge balls. Melt butter in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Add sugars salt and sour cream. Cook over low heat stirring until sugars dissolve. Cover; boil slowly 5 minutes. Uncover; cook rapidly without stirring to 236\u00b0 (soft ball stage). Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla; beat until mixture is creamy and begins to hold its shape. Stir in medium size walnut pieces. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Quickly shape into balls. Roll in finely chopped walnuts. Let stand until firm. Makes 24 balls.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine sausage and cheese in bowl add Bisquick small amount at a time and mix with hands. Shape into small balls and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Make dressing first--Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar; add raisins onion and bacon. Chop enough broccoli to fill 2-3 quart bowl. Mix together. Chill.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt chocolate and oil in double boiler. Stir in peanuts. Drop by spoonful on waxed paper. Chill.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Put lentils in pan with enough water to cover. Add vegetables and cook until lentils are tender. May be served as is or with cooked elbow macaroni.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt butter over medium heat. Add carrot leek and garlic; cook until tender but do not brown. Add stock; bring to simmer. Add broccoli; cook 8 to 10 minutes until broccoli is tender. Pour soup into food processor; process until vegetables are finely chopped but not pureed. Pour back into pot. Add cream pepper and celery seed.

title: Horseradish Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan over low heat add flour salt and both peppers stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Stir in horseradish and lemon juice. Cook until sauce is thoroughly heated. Serve hot with corned beef or roast beef.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl on low speed mix cake mix 1 egg butter and 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice until crumbly. Press into bottom of 15 x 10-inch pan. In another bowl mix cream cheese milk 2 eggs pumpkin spice and salt. Pour over crust. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Chill and cut.

title: Black-Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Combine cream cheese egg sugar salt and chocolate chips in a mixing bowl. Mix.

title: Mom'S Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add flour and sugar. Mix. Add salt and orange peel. Scald milk and add to egg mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into pie crust and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Creamy Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix sour cream and seasonings. Chill. Sprinkle lemon juice over apples. Lightly mix cabbage with apples. Pour sour cream mixture over cabbage mixture just before serving. Toss lightly. Serves approximately 100.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients as listed beating after each addition. Bake at 325\u00b0 in three layers (about 25 minutes).

title: Date Nut Bars
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Mix in other ingredients with a fork. Pour into a well-greased 8-inch pan. Put into a preheated 350\u00b0 oven and bake 25 minutes. Allow to cool and roll in confectioners sugar after cutting into squares.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes With Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Mix buttermilk and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and dry ingredients alternately; mix well. Roll out on floured cloth and cut. Bake at 375\u00b0 on foil-covered cookie sheet until lightly browned.

title: Mother'S Jello Salad
instructions: In bowl empty Jell-O and pour boiling water over it. Stir until dissolved. Set aside. Mix pineapple lemon juice and sugar in small saucepan and bring to boil. Stir pineapple mixture into Jell-O. Place in refrigerator until it begins to thicken around edges. Whip the cream and add to Jell-O. Stir in cheese and place back in refrigerator.

title: Beef-Tomato-Cabbage Scallop
instructions: Brown ground beef in 2 tablespoons of oil. Then add onion and celery and cook for 10 minutes. Add can of tomatoes salt and pepper and bring to a boil. In buttered 2-quart baking dish alternate layers of chopped cabbage and meat mixture putting in layer of cabbage first ending with a layer of meat mixture on top. Top with bread crumbs. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: Truly Different Cupcakes
instructions: Melt chips and oleo; add nuts. Combine in bowl flour sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix well but do not beat. Add chocolate mixture and stir carefully. Put into foil paper baking cups that are set into muffin pans. These must be baked in paper foil cups. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Yields 24 cupcakes. Cool before serving. They have a crunchy top and need to frosting.

title: Shrimp Crab Au Gratin
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Add half and half and milk. Cook and stir until thick and smooth. Stir in lemon juice crab meat shrimp water chestnuts rice pimento and 1/2 of the cheese. Spoon into large baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until mixture is hot.

title: Cranberry Sour Cream Crumble Coffee Cake
instructions: Sprinkle chopped almonds in bottom of greased 10-inch tube pan. Set aside. In bowl stir all topping ingredients until crumbly. Set aside.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Layer ingredients 2 or 3 times. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes in sprayed pan.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Mix mushroom soup with milk. Add onions to taste. Top with Cheddar cheese. Shred potatoes for 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all together then put into pan. Top with cheese. Bake 10 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Thin White Sauce(Soup Base)
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour and blend. Add milk and salt. Cook until slightly thick stirring constantly. Makes 3 cups.

title: Chicken Delights
instructions: Put rice in buttered 9 x 9-inch cake pan. Place chicken on rice. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken. Mix soup milk and water; pour over chicken. Cover with foil and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Cook uncovered in crock-pot for 8 hours on low.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir in salt and flour. Add food coloring. Mix until well blended. Using a cookie gun form the cookies into desired shapes about 1-inch apart on a lightly buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until cookies are just beginning to turn brown.

title: Herb Baked Chicken
instructions: Spray a 2-quart oblong baking dish with vegetable cooking spray; arrange chicken bone side down in dish. Sprinkle with thyme and pepper. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Chicken
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach then pack in 9 x 13 casserole dish. Dip chicken in butter and flour and place on top of spinach. Season with salt pepper and garlic. Pour whipped cream on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Goulash
instructions: Heat ground beef and onion in skillet; drain. Cook macaroni; drain and rinse with cold water. Combine all ingredients in a large ovenproof dish and stir using enough ketchup to mix but not soupy. Parmesan cheese may be sprinkled on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until mixture is hot and begins to bubble.

title: Meat Marinade For Shish-Kebabs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Marinate 2 to 3 hours. Stir occasionally. For 2 pounds of cubed meat 4 to 5 servings.

title: Salt Water Taffy
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in a pan. Stir in next four ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils and sugar is completely dissolved. Continue to cook without stirring until temperature reaches 260\u00b0 or until a hard ball is formed in cold water. After boiling has ceased cool down. Stir in flavoring and coloring. Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Let stand until cool enough to handle. Grease hands and pull until it has a satin-like finish and is light in color. Cut into 1-inch squares. Wrap in wax paper.

title: Crustless Apple Pie
instructions: Mix apples sugar cinnamon and water. Place in a greased 9-inch pie pan. Cream shortening. Add brown sugar and flour. Cream good. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Breaded Cauliflower
instructions: Break cauliflower into flowerets. (Soak in cold salted water to remove any bugs.) Parboil in salted water for 10 minutes; drain water immediately to stop cooking. In a small bowl break and slightly beat the egg milk and pinch of salt. In another bowl place the bread or cereal crumbs. Dip cauliflower into egg mixture; coat well then dip into crumbs. Cover well. Fry in oil or shortening until brown turning to brown all sides.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into cubes. Boil in water until tender (about 15 minutes). Drain and cool. Chop boiled eggs and add to potatoes; add pickles and bell pepper. Mix with mayonnaise gently. If desired add celery and onions. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt peanut butter chocolate chips and margarine. Put Rice Chex into large bag. Pour melted mixture over cereal. Shake in bag until coated. Pour 1 pound powdered sugar into bag and shake to coat.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar and corn syrup and cook 4 minutes at 100% power. Add peanuts and cook another 3 1/4 to 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla. Cook for one more minute. Add soda and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour and spread quickly on greased flexible baking sheet. Cool for 30 minutes and break into small pieces.

title: Cheese Chowder
instructions: Combine potatoes carrots onion and stock in soup kettle. Simmer partially covered for 15 minutes. Meanwhile melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and stir until blended. Slowly add milk stirring with a whisk until smooth. Stir in cheese and cook over low heat until melted. Season with salt and pepper. Slowly add to veggies and stock. Stir over low heat until blended. Best served in bread roll bowls.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Blend well and pile in casserole dish. Top with grated cheese and crumbled potato chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let stand a few minutes before serving.

title: Low-Cal Sundae
instructions: Fills 5 or 6 cup-type dessert dishes.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Arrange biscuits in a single layer in the bottom of a hotel pan. Drizzle reserved strawberry syrup over biscuits and let set 1 hour. Prepare mousse according to package directions and gently fold strawberries and Oreo pieces into prepared mousse. Pour into reserved hotel pan. Cover and chill until set.

title: Slush
instructions: Boil sugar and water. Add remaining ingredients. Freeze. Thaw until slushy to serve.

title: Hawaiian Beef And Rice - Luau
instructions: Combine all ingredients for the marinade and pour over the roast. Marinate in the refrigerator for 24 hours turning several times.

title: Easy Chicken-Rice Supper
instructions: Heat margarine in a 2-quart saucepan until melted. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in milk and broth. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole or rectangular 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 6 servings each containing 315 calories and 16 grams fat.

title: Ingrid'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Heat syrup sugar butter and cream to boiling. Cool. Add remaining ingredients and let stand overnight. Roll out very thin. Cut into diamond shape and brush with egg whites and a split almond on the top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes approximately. Watch closely as they burn easily.

title: Salmon Souffle
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except egg whites after removing bones from salmon. Fold in egg whites. Put in casserole and bake about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spicy Hot Chili
instructions: Cook meat until browned. Mix all ingredients together in a large pot. Simmer for 2 hours.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and meat together. Mix other ingredients. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 long enough to melt cheese. Layer of chips meat cheese chips meat cheese.

title: Graham Cracker Icebox Pudding
instructions: In top of double boiler cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs and milk. Cook over hot water until eggs are done not thick about 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add pineapple and vanilla. Alternate layers of crumbs and custard. Start and end with crumbs. Refrigerate overnight. Cut in squares. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples with 4 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; set aside. Beat eggs gradually adding 2 cups sugar then mix oil in well. Sift flour salt and baking powder then add egg mixture gradually alternating with orange juice. Add vanilla. Pour half the batter in then place some apples. Add remaining batter and end with apple slices on top. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Layer one crust in bottom of casserole. Add filling. Put other crust on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick margarine and mix with graham cracker crumbs. Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix 2 sticks margarine sugar and eggs; beat 15 minutes. Spread over crust. Slice bananas over mixture. Drain juice off pineapples and spread over bananas. Top with Cool Whip. Nuts and cherries may be used to garnish.

title: Garden Dip
instructions: In a small mixing bowl allow cream cheese to soften. Stir in tomato soup; add celery onions parsley and horseradish and mix well. Add dash of garlic salt pepper and sauce; blend well. Store in refrigerator in a covered container for several hours or overnight.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients together thoroughly. Chill for several hours. Shape into a ball. Roll in finely chopped pecans dried beef or toasted almonds.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-o in hot water. Melt marshmallows in pot over low heat. Cool. Add ice water pineapple and nuts. Add cool whip or dream whip to taste. Chill.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix to form crumbs and spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order and bake in a well-greased Bundt pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool and turn out onto a plate. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar.

title: Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix cocoa water syrup and salt. Cook stirring often until mixture becomes a heavy syrup. Stir in margarine and vanilla. Serve hot or cold. If desired sweeter add honey to taste after sauce has finished cooking.

title: Easy Chicken And Pasta
instructions: In medium skillet over medium-high heat cook chicken until browned. Set aside. Add soup water garlic powder pepper and vegetable combination. Heat to boil. Add noodles. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring often. Return chicken to pan. Cook 5 minutes or until noodles are done stirring often.

title: Ramen Noodle Salad
instructions: Break noodles in small pieces. Mix with cabbage and onion. Combine salt pepper oil sugar vinegar and flavor package. Pour mixture over noodles and cabbage. Stir and refrigerate overnight.

title: Lollipops
instructions: You also need 18 sticks.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Serve.

title: Eleanor Nabak'S German Potato Salad
instructions: Mix potatoes and veggies. Take bacon seasoning sugar vinegar bacon grease and a little cornstarch and mix over low heat. Serve warm.

title: Oven Chicken And Gravy
instructions: Cut chicken lengthwise into strips. Place chicken in melted butter in a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tender. Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake 15 more minutes. Serve with rice or potatoes.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Place the peeled tomatoes onions peppers sugar vinegar and salt in a dishpan. Cook until thick about 2 hours. Put this into jars and seal.

title: Caramelized Peanuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients in heavy skillet. Cook until all peanuts are completely coated and no syrup is left. Put on ungreased cookie sheet and spread so that peanuts are separated. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring several times.

title: Apple Cinnamon Cheesecake
instructions: Mix ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Blend completely. Press on bottom and an inch up the sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan; set aside. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients except soda and popcorn in a 2-quart microwave dish. Bring to a boil (3 minutes on High). Stir and then cook 2 minutes more on High. Remove from microwave and stir in soda. Stir until foamy. Put popped corn in brown paper bag. Pour syrup over corn close bag by folding top. Shake and place bag back in microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and shake; then cook another 1 1/2 minutes on High. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and let cool.

title: Kaylee'S Favorite Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine sugar and Crisco in large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs syrup and vanilla. Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add gradually to creamed mixture at low speed; mix until blended. Divide dough into 4 quarters.

title: Silly Putty
instructions: Will also need 5 ounce paper cups popsicle stick (for stirring rod) paper towels and plastic bag (zip-lock or twist tie).

title: Reuben Dip
instructions: Mix and bake in 9 x 9-inch Pyrex dish at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and cheese melts. Serve on rye bread or crackers.

title: Pecan Brittle
instructions: Into heavy kettle put first four ingredients; bring to a boil. Boil until syrup spins a thread; add peanuts. Stir and cook until mixture just begins to brown. Remove from heat; stir in soda. When soda is well mixed and mixture still foaming pour into shallow 8 x 12-inch pan or cookie sheet; do not spread. When cold break into pieces.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix raw peanuts sugar and white Karo and boil over medium heat in boiler until honey colored and peanuts begin to pop. (Hard crack stage on candy thermometer.) Remove from heat and stir in soda. Beat vigorously. Work fast and pour on buttered cookie sheet. Spread thin and allow to cool. Break into desired pieces.

title: Gingersnap Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine milk and pie filling in a large bowl. Beat with wire whisk until well blended. Let stand 5 minutes or until thickened. Stir in whipped topping pecans gingersnaps pumpkin and pumpkin pie spice. Spoon mixture into crust. Freeze overnight or until firm. Remove from freezer and let stand for about 20 minutes before serving. Garnish with dollop of whipped topping. Makes 8 servings. Store leftover pie in freezer.

title: Round Steak Casserole
instructions: Season round steak with salt and pepper. Cut into serving pieces and place in crock-pot with sliced onion. Add potatoes green beans and garlic. Top with soup and tomatoes. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours (high 4 to 5 hours). If too much liquid has collected remove cover and turn to high during the last 1/2 hour.

title: Italian Skillet Dinner(Serves 8 - 10)
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse and drain well. Brown sausage in large skillet; drain grease then add ground beef and brown it; drain grease. Saute onions until clear. Add spaghetti sauce seasoning and cooked pasta and heat until bubbly. Top with cheese and heat until cheese melts.

title: Strawberry-Banana Smoothie
instructions: Blend in blender until smooth.

title: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening oleo and sugars. Add eggs and beat well. Add milk and mix well. Add flour soda and cinnamon; mix well. Add oatmeal and chocolate chips; mix well. Drop onto an ungreased cookie sheet; dont mash down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until very lightly browned.

title: Cranberry Refrigerator Cake(Serves 12)
instructions: Mix together cranberries banana and granulated sugar. Set aside. Place 1/2 of wafers in bottom of pan.

title: Play Dough For Kids
instructions: Mix well. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture gets very thick. Cool and knead. Store in a plastic covered container.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a 4-quart pot boil meat with salt 2 whole ribs of celery whole onion and whole potato very slowly for 3 hours or longer. Take soup meat from pot and remove meat from bone chopping to bite size and discarding bone and fat.

title: Korean Barbecued Beef(4 Servings)
instructions: Cut beef diagonally across grain in 1/8-inch slices. Mix remaining ingredients. Stir in beef until well coated. Cover; refrigerate 30 minutes. Drain beef; stir-fry in 10-inch skillet or wok over medium heat 2 or 3 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice if desired.

title: Baked Potato Slices
instructions: Combine soup paprika and pepper. Spray 2-quart rectangle baking dish with Pam. Arrange sliced potatoes in baking dish overlapping rows. Spoon soup mixture over potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10 minutes.

title: Stuffed Potato
instructions: Slice potato in half longways. Cut out potato on one side of sliced potato. Mix butter salt pepper garlic green pepper and onion together. Place in open shell of potato skin for each potato. Close together with other 1/2 potato; wrap in aluminum foil. Bake 1 hour until potato is done. Eat alone or with steak.

title: Salmon Crunchy Salad Loaf
instructions: Mix chilled ingredients together except the chips and chill. (Its better to add lemon juice to mayonnaise before adding to salad.)

title: Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Dredge spareribs in flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Brown in fat. Add onion. Combine ketchup Tabasco sauce chili powder and hot water in a bowl. Pour over meat; cover. Place over low heat and cook until tender.

title: Epiphany Cake
instructions: This cake is served during Epiphany following Christmas.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and butter; cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour to creamed mixture alternating with milk beating well after each addition. Stir in flavorings. Pour batter into a well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Best Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip. Add as much coconut as you like. Pour into a pie crust that has been baked and cooled. Brown some coconut in oven and add to top of pie. Cool in refrigerator before serving.

title: Frozen Fruit Drink
instructions: Mix in blender and enjoy.

title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugars vinegar and salt. Add vanilla and eggs. Mix well. In a separate bowl combine flour baking soda and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in oats and optional ingredients if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Civitan Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Dice fruit cake into 1/4-inch pieces. Set aside. (Dices easier if cold.) Mix cake mix oil flavoring and eggs in a large bowl until smooth. Add the fruit cake pieces.

title: Butter Rum Rolls
instructions: Roll frozen dough in melted margarine. Let rise (2 1/2 hours). Bake 12 to 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove from oven and glaze with melted sugar water and rum. Drizzle mixture over top. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar.

title: Popeye'S Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook spinach as directed on box. Drain and press all water from spinach. Combine remaining ingredients. Split 1 loaf French bread lengthwise; top half (about 1/4) and hollow out the middle of the bottom half. In bite size pieces place bread in a separate bowl. Pour mixture into bottom half of bread. Use bread pieces to dip.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: In salad serving bowl mix sugar lemon juice and mayonnaise together until smooth. Add broccoli and toss to coat well. Add remaining ingredients and toss to mix. Refrigerate. Serve cold.

title: Adam'S Pear Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oleo and divide evenly between the pie shells. Dot oleo pieces over top of filling. Cover with top crust. Score top crust with knife to allow steam to escape. Bake at 450\u00b0 until crust is lightly browned about 10 to 15 minutes. Turn temperature down to 350\u00b0. Bake until juice bubbles out top and looks thick (about 45 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Key West Bollos(Black-Eyed Pea Fritters; Boy-O'S)
instructions: Cover peas with water and soak overnight. Remove skins by rubbing between hands. Cover beans with additional water in another bowl and skins should rise to the surface; drain. Combine peas garlic hot sauce and salt in work bowl of food processor or blender adding small amount of water to keep mixture moving. Process until mixture has a fine consistency. Beat mixture by hand until it is like cake batter. Heat oil to 365\u00b0. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil. Turn to brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels. Test for doneness and should look like hush puppies. Makes 4 to 5 dozen. Bollo mix is always best if made a day or two ahead to allow flavors to marry getting all the work out of the way.

title: Apple Pie No Sugar
instructions: Heat apple juice and then add cornstarch. Stir constantly over medium heat until thickened. Remove from heat and add cinnamon nutmeg salt walnuts and raisins. Stir in 4 cups of sliced apples. Pour in pie crust and place lattice on top. Place on hot cookie sheet. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Peel fruit reserve as much juice as possible in a shallow baking dish. Slice oranges and halve slices; cut grapefruit into segments and pineapple into chunks. As each fruit is completed place in a layer in a clear or cut glass bowl. Sprinkle each layer with sugar. Pour reserved juices over layers. Cover; chill 1 hour or more. Scatter cherries over fruit.

title: Frozen Egg Nog
instructions: Beat together eggs sugar and salt until it is thick like custard. Add 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and heavy cream. Whip it and freeze.

title: Pineapple Delight(12 Servings)
instructions: Mix together dry cake mix and whole can of pineapple - including juice. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. Bake 35-50 minutes until golden brown or cracks appear dry. Bake at 350.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In skillet brown onion lightly. Add green pepper beef and rice. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Serves 4 to 5 people.

title: Texas Fudge(Not Candy)
instructions: Shred all cheeses. In a greased casserole dish place cheeses and beaten eggs. Toss until cheese is covered with egg. Add jalapeno slices on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool slightly; cut into squares. Place on Triscuits; top with 1/4 teaspoon salsa. Serve warm.

title: Cucumber-Onion Pickles
instructions: Wash peel and slice cucumbers and onions. Cover them with salt and let stand overnight. Bring vinegar and salt to a boil. Sift together mustard turmeric and cornstarch. Mix with a little cold vinegar and add to vinegar and sugar. Drain cucumbers and onions from salt water. Put in vinegar solution and bring to a boil. Pack in sterilized Kerr jars and seal at once.

title: Old Testament Justice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add beaten egg yolks honey milk and 3 cups of the flour with the spices and baking powder sifted into flour. Use remaining 1/2 cup. Pour to add to fruit. Add beaten egg whites and flour mixture. Bake in greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Southern Almond Bars
instructions: Melt butter. Add 1 1/2 cups sugar. Beat in the eggs and almond flavoring. Add flour and salt. Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan. Sprinkle with sliced almonds and cinnamon-sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Take out cut into squares and put back into oven. Bake another 5 minutes or until light brown on top.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Mix dough and roll out thin; grease pan and cut strips to line bottom. Add cherries sugar salt 3/4 cup juice and butter. Cut strips and cover top. Cook at 400 degrees until brown.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Crisp bacon reserving the fat. Crumble the bacon. Saute onion in bacon grease; add salt sugar mustard water vinegar sliced potatoes bacon and parsley last. Heat to serve.

title: Ranch Chicken
instructions: Mix bread crumbs and Ranch dressing mix; coat chicken with melted butter. Roll in bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Upside Down Cornbread
instructions: Cook beef onion green pepper until brown and stir in flour. Mix in tomato paste salt and pepper. Remove from heat stir in cheese. Spread in 9 inch pan. Cover with prepared corn bread mix. Bake (as directed on Jiffy cornbread mix box) 30 - 35 minutes in preheated oven. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Best Ever Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ingredients and form into small loaves. Place in an 11 x 13-inch covered dish. Pour sauce over loaves and bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 1 hour. Remove cover the last 10 minutes of baking time. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Cool slightly and add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour in a 6-cup mold. Chill.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Add pre-mixed dry ingredients. Mix in chips and nuts. Roll into balls. Place 2-inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Peanut Brittle
