instructions: Mix sugar Karo and water. Bring to a boil. Add peanuts. When peanuts smell or turn light brown remove from heat. Stir in soda. Mix well. Pour on cookie sheet lined in foil.

title: Hot Crab Dish
instructions: Mix crab and eggs. Blend remaining ingredients into mayonnaise and stir into crab mixture. Pour into greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated and lightly browned.

title: Dried Fruit Compote
instructions: Place dried fruit cinnamon sticks and water in large saucepan. Bring to boil turn down heat to moderate simmer. Cook until water is absorbed. Stir in honey to taste. Combine cashew nuts and water to cover in blender. Blend and add water or nuts until cashews are a whipped cream consistency. Place fruit in compote and top with big dollop of cashew whipped cream. Fruit may be served warm or cold.

title: Incredible French Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch strips. In large bowl whisk together egg white chili powder salts garlic and onion powder until frothy. Add potatoes; toss to coat well.

title: Bourbon Burgers
instructions: In medium bowl soak croutons in bourbon until all liquid is gone making sure croutons are completely saturated and soggy. Add ketchup and beef and mix well. Form into patties. Place on medium-hot grill.

title: Angel Hair With Savory Tomato Sauce
instructions: In skillet over medium heat heat oil. Add garlic. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add tomatoes salt and pepper. Cook stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Meanwhile cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Toss hot pasta with sauce. Serve with cheese.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Brown ground chuck with celery onion salt pepper and garlic powder. Drain; add remaining ingredients to meat. Cook for 1 hour on low heat.

title: Cookie Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. In saucepan combine water oleo cocoa and Crisco oil; bring to a boil. Add to flour mixture. Add eggs buttermilk and baking soda. Pour on cookie sheet and bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
instructions: In a plastic bag combine the flour salt and pepper; shake to mix. Add the chicken; shake to coat lightly. Remove the chicken; reserve the excess seasoned flour. In a large skillet warm 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium heat. Add the chicken; brown on one side for about 5 minutes. Add remaining tablespoon oil. Turn the chicken; brown well on the second side about 5 minutes longer. Transfer the chicken to a plate; set aside. Coarsely chop onion. Add the margarine to the skillet. When the margarine melts add the onion and cook stirring until softened 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the reserved seasoned flour and cook stirring until the flour is completely incorporated about 1 minute. Add the broth 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice and the thyme; bring the mixture to boil stirring constantly.

title: Dump Cake(Yield: 16 Servings)
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook stirring often 5 minutes or until no calorie sweetener dissolves.

title: Carrot-Raisin Salad
instructions: Combine carrots and raisins. Mix together remaining 3 ingredients and mix with the carrot mixture.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
instructions: Beat together cream cheese sour cream oregano garlic powder. Spread evenly in a 9 or 10 inch pie dish. Spread sauce over top then sprinkle with onions pepper and pepperoni. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Then sprinkle Mozzarella cheese and bake for 5 more minutes until cheese melts.

title: Ditalini With Pesto, Beans And Broccoli Rabe(4 Servings)
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water 3 minutes. Add broccoli rabe and boil until broccoli rabe is just crisp-tender and pasta is just tender but still firm to bite stirring occasionally about 5 minutes longer. Drain pasta and broccoli rabe reserving 1/2 cup cooking liquid. Return pasta and broccoli rabe to pot.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix beans soup and part of crushed onion rings in a casserole dish. Sprinkle crushed onion rings or place whole onion rings on top of casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Diabetic Sugarless Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and flatten with fork. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in an 8-inch square pan. Stir well. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 stirring occasionally. Let cool. Combine strawberries sugar lemon juice and egg whites. Beat at high speed about 8 to 10 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Press 2/3 of brown sugar mixture in a 9-inch pan and pour in strawberry mixture. Put remaining crumbs on top and freeze until firm.

title: French Fried Eggplant
instructions: Cut eggplant in half lengthwise. Slice 1/2-inch thick. Soak in ice water 30 minutes. Prepare batter ingredients. Dip in batter. Fry 2 to 5 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice with water salt and stick of margarine according to package directions. Mix remaining ingredients all together and bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Hamburger-Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Make macaroni as directed on package. While this is cooking brown your hamburger meat with bacon enchilada seasoning and winter garden seasoning blend. After all of this is cooked drain rinse and add to cooked hamburger meat. Add tomato paste and can of water. Stir over low heat about 5 minutes. Put in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Put cheese over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is well melted.

title: Diabetic Apple Pie
instructions: Combine apple juice with cornstarch cinnamon nutmeg and butter. Place sliced apples in unbaked pie crust and pour apple juice mixture over apples. Add top crust. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Lower heat to 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove foil last 20 minutes.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Mix egg and milk. Sift together all other ingredients and gradually add to the milk mixture; beat until batter is smooth. Heat deep oil to 375\u00b0. Hold finger over the hole of a funnel which has a hole dimension of 3/8 to 1/2-inch. Fill funnel with batter. Hold funnel as near surface of oil as possible remove finger and drop batter into oil using a circular movement from center outward to form a spiral cake about 3-inches in diameter. It takes practice remember to place finger on bottom of funnel as you form each cake. Form as many in skillet as will float uncrowded. Fry until cakes are puffy and golden brown turning once. Remove cakes with slotted spoon to a paper towel to drain. Sift lightly with powdered sugar with a little cinnamon added. Serve at once.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Sift cornstarch and sugar together. Add syrup eggs butter and pecans. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tortillas
instructions: Mix well the first 4 ingredients. Add water. Knead until dough is soft and elastic like bread dough. If sticky add a little more flour. Pinch off approximately 8 to 10 balls then roll out with floured rolling pin. Cook on ungreased cast-iron skillet or griddle on medium-high heat.

title: Applesauce Cake *
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add egg. Mix dry ingredients and add to mixture. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 in tube pan lined with foil. If cooking too fast place pan of water above cake for last 1/2 hour.

title: Crab Mold
instructions: This recipe is best when made the day before you plan to serve it. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Melt cheese with soup; add remaining ingredients except crackers. Pour into mold and let sit overnight. Unmold; serve with crackers.

title: Sister'S Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. (Take them out of oven when they puff and go flat.)

title: Grandma Knight'S Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until creamy. Chill for about 1 hour. Great for dipping apples grapes bananas strawberries etc.

title: Fifteen Minute Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine the beef salt pepper onion green pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Press into greased 9 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake on the lowest shelf in hot oven (450\u00b0) for 10 minutes. Broil 5 minutes more. While meat is cooking combine remaining tomato sauce sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes. Add meat drippings if desired.

title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
instructions: Blend butter eggs brown sugar and molasses together. Sift together flour soda salt cloves cinnamon and ginger. Add to mixture. Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Hot Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and spread on bun. Put 1 slice cheese and 1 slice ham on each bun. Wrap in foil. Heat in oven 15 minutes. May be frozen.

title: Cake Waffle Cookies
instructions: Combine melted margarine and eggs. The add flour baking powder and lemon extract. Make sure the waffle iron is hot. Drop 1/2 tsp. of batter on each waffle iron grid. Bake about 30-45 seconds. Should be light golden not brown. Take off with large fork. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cookie should be soft. Makes 3-4 doz.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients until creamy and smooth and pour into pan that has been sprayed with Pam or Mazola cooking spray. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 60 minutes. Should be light in texture and golden brown.

title: Coconut-Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream sugar eggs and butter. Add buttermilk and coconut. Bake in 9-inch shell at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 35 minutes.

title: Sponge Candy
instructions: Combine sugar corn syrup and vinegar in heavy kettle. Use a candy thermometer and boil (medium heat) to 300\u00b0. Mixture will look as if it is going to burn. Remove from heat and add baking soda. (It is best to sift the soda; lumps will not break with stirring.) Immediately start stirring very very quickly and pour mixture into a thoroughly buttered 8 x 12-inch baking pan. Allow mixture to cool for at least 4 hours then break or cut into pieces and dip in melted chocolate.

title: Cheddar Dill Scones
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In medium bowl combine all ingredients except butter eggs and half and half. Cut in butter until crumbly. Stir eggs and half and half in just until moistened. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth (1 minute). Divide dough in half; roll each half into 8-inch circle. Cut each circle into 8 pie shaped wedges. Place 1 inch apart on cookie sheets. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 16 scones.

title: Banana-Nut Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 12-cup muffin pan.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Spray 13 x 9-inch pan with cooking spray. Layer half of onions; cover top with half of cheese. Repeat. Dot each layer with 3 tablespoons margarine. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour chicken broth over all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Skillet Beef Ole
instructions: Brown meat in a large heavy skillet over medium heat. Stir with a wooden spoon to break into small pieces. Add onion green pepper and red pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp. Gently stir in salt chili powder basil garlic beans and corn. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes to blend flavors. Stir in some of the reserved bean liquid if you want to increase moistness. Gently stir in the olives and parsley. Heat through and serve with a green salad and French bread. Serves 4.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wings With Blue Cheese Dipping Sauce
instructions: Melt the butter or margarine in a small saucepan. Add hot sauce and remove from heat. In a large pan or deep-fat fryer heat 1 inch of oil to 375\u00b0. Fry wings in batch without crowding until golden brown 10 to 15 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Brush wings with spicy butter and serve warm with Blue Cheese Dipping Sauce.

title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon half and half and sugar with a wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust.

title: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs sugar shortening and molasses together until smooth. Add flour cinnamon ginger soda and salt. Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Form mixture into balls the size of walnuts. Roll in sugar and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. You can mash the balls or leave them round. They will crack on top if left round. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Bring chicken stock to a boil and add celery onion and broccoli. Cook until vegetables are tender. Reduce heat; add milk and cheese. Make a thickening of the flour and some milk and add to soup until desired consistency. Do not boil.

title: Slaw Or Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Add the beaten egg vinegar and water and cook slowly. When mixture thickens add 2 heaping teaspoons of yellow mustard and 2 tablespoons of margarine. Mix until butter melts. Store in refrigerator. Keeps for several weeks.

title: Cracker Crust Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy and add cream of tartar. Beat until stiff. Add sugar gradually and then add vanilla. Mix crackers and nuts together. Fold all together and pour into 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool. Cover with 1 cup cream whipped to which 1 small can crushed pineapple had been added. Sprinkle generously with coconut.

title: E-Z Cornbread
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Add cornbread mix. Stir until just blended. Melt butter in a 9 x 13 pan. Pour cornbread in with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Kentucky Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients well and pour into pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Microwave Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into one inch balls. Arrange in microwave-safe pan. Cover with wax paper and microwave on High for 20 minutes. Good hot or cold.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Combine egg yolks salt and milk; mix well. Place over low heat stirring constantly until warm. Combine sugar and flour mixing well. Gradually add to milk mixture stirring constantly. Cook over low heat; stir until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and coconut. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar; spread on top of pie.

title: Oriental Pot Stickers
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Place 1 teaspoon in center of each wrapper. Moisten edges with water; press together. Flatten bottom and make each one stand upright.

title: Date Bread(Diabetic)
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder salt mace cloves and nutmeg. Add dates. Combine eggs milk sweetener and shortening; add to dry ingredients. Put in greased loaf pan (9 x 5-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Add cut up vegetables dressing and cheese. Chill and serve.

title: Easy Spinach Souffle
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 2-quart souffle dish. In a saucepan combine mayonnaise flour onion salt nutmeg and pepper; stir constantly over medium heat for 1 minute. Stir in milk until smooth. Stir\tconstantly cook until thick. Remove from heat.\tStir in spinach. Beat in egg yolks. In a small bowl beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Gently fold into spinach mixture. Spoon into prepared dish. Place on lowest rack of oven. Reduce oven temperature to\t375\u00b0. Bake for 40 minutes until puffed and golden brown. Serve immediately.\tServes 4 to 6.

title: Paradise Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine softened cream cheese sugar and vanilla mixing until well blended. Add egg; mix well. Spread onto bottom of pastry shell. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Carefully pour over cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until done. Cool. Brush with maple syrup and garnish with nuts if desired.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed. Mix well after each addition. Fold in rhubarb last. Pour in baking dish. Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1/2 cup chopped nuts well. Sprinkle over top of cake and cut into cake with knife. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine sugar oats flour and cinnamon. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Arrange half of the apple slices in buttered 8-inch square dish. Sprinkle half the sugar mixture over the apples. Top with remaining apples and the rest of the sugar mixture. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Raspberry Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Mix chocolate wafers and melted butter. Press in bottom of pan for crust. Layer (first) raspberry sherbet; (second) half brownie crumbs; (third) drizzle half chocolate syrup; (fourth) vanilla ice cream; (fifth) rest of brownie crumbs and (sixth) drizzle rest of chocolate syrup. Freeze overnight. Serve frozen.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl mix together all dry ingredients. In medium bowl beat eggs slightly. Add oil vanilla raisins carrots apples and coconut.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Layer in a large pie plate (start with the cream cheese). Microwave until cheese is melted about 5 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Low-Fat Jello Salad
instructions: Dump all ingredients into a large mixing bowl. Mix well. Chill and serve.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Cook 15 hours in a slow 250\u00b0 oven. Remove meat and shred it. Place in broth put in containers and freeze until ready to use. Serve on hoagie buns.

title: Lemon Chicken Pasta
instructions: In a large skillet melt margarine; stir-fry chicken in butter until cooked. Add onion and cook onion until tender but still crunchy. Add lemon juice salt and pepper to taste. Cook 1 more minute. Toss with cooked noodles.

title: Chocolate Ripple Pound Cake
instructions: In small saucepan melt shortening; add cocoa stirring until smooth. Set aside. Cream butter and gradually add sugar; beat well. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each egg. Add flour and vanilla mixing well. Remove 2 cups of batter. Add chocolate mixture; stir until blended.

title: Quick Barbecue Beef
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large baking dish. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve over noodles.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients saving 1/2 of onion rings to sprinkle on top after pouring into casserole. Top with pats of oleo or butter and season with salt pepper and paprika. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together in a large bowl the flour cornmeal salt sugar and baking powder. Add the milk and egg. Beat for 1 minute then add the cooking oil or soft shortening. Beat for 1 more minute. Place 2 teaspoons oil in an 8-inch cake pan. Pour in batter. Oil will rise greasing pan. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Split and toast any left.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all together and place in a glass baking dish or place in mold. Chill overnight.

title: Cherry Dessert Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with the exception of the whipped topping. Top the salad with the topping. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple Oat Muffins(Low-Fat And No Sugar)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl mix the flours oats spices salt and baking soda. Add the chopped apple along with the apple juice concentrate and raisins. Stir just enough to mix. Spoon batter into nonstick or lightly oil-sprayed muffin tins and bake for 25 minutes or until tops bounce back when pressed lightly.

title: Betty'S Peanut Brittle
instructions: (The prettiest brittle is made with half light Karo and half dark.) Put sugar syrup water and salt in pan and cook over low heat until sugar melts. Add raw peanuts. Dont stir; watch.

title: No Bake Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix together in pan sugar cocoa milk and butter. Cook on medium heat until mixture forms ball. Remove from heat and cool for 1 minute. Add vanilla salt peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool.

title: Scalloped Corn Supreme
instructions: Heat corn and milk. Gradually stir in egg. Add next 4 ingredients and dash of pepper. Mix well. Pour into greased 8-inch round baking dish. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Divinity
instructions: Boil sugar water and salt until the mixture reaches the hard ball stage. Place cream in bowl and pour in hot syrup. Add nuts and vanilla. Mix until the mixture becomes firm enough to drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: In large saucepan melt margarine and add rice onion green pepper and garlic. Cook stirring over low heat until rice is brown then add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat until liquid is absorbed about 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix in a bowl the flour baking soda salt cinnamon and sugar. Add eggs and oil. Beat well. Add carrots and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Combine all and refrigerate overnight. May add whipped topping if desired.

title: Grilled Honey Mustard Chicken
instructions: Mix salad dressing honey and mustard. Spread over chicken and grill approximately 10 minutes. Turn chicken breasts. Spread more mixture over chicken. Grill another 10 to 15 minutes or until tender. Serve with grilled green onions.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown onion in oil. Add ground beef and brown. Combine tomato sauce and spices together; add onion and beef. Simmer for 30 minutes or longer if desired. If too thick add another can of tomato sauce. If you want chili and beans add 1 can pinto beans.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Whisk together eggs soda buttermilk vanilla and cinnamon. Bring oleo water and cocoa to a boil over medium heat. Pour over egg and buttermilk mix. Add flour mix. Pour onto a greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Pistachio Nut Cake Deluxe
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt cake pan. (I also cut out a circle of wax paper to fit bottom of pan to prevent sticking). Melt shortening. Put all ingredients into food processor. Now add shortening and mix for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Batter will be thin. Spoon into prepared pan. Level with spoon. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake comes out clean. Remove cake when pan is cool to the touch.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Place hamburger and onion in bottom of casserole dish. Place cream of mushroom soup on next layer then vegetables and cream of celery soup. Evenly space Tater Tots on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: German Pancakes
instructions: Pour into hot skillet with touch of Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 until raised up the sides of pan.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage and carrots. Blend rest in a bowl then mix well.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine jello pineapple and water. Bring to a boil and cool. Add cottage cheese and prepare Dream Whip. Refrigerate. Can use any flavored jello for color and Cool Whip.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce For Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together in saucepan flour sugar and cocoa. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Serve over ice cream.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat onions and garlic; drain. Add sauce tomatoes and spices. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with tortillas (torn in small pieces). Pour in 1/2 meat mixture another layer of tortillas and rest of meat mixture. Add another layer of tortillas. Mix soup and milk and pour over top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10 .

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix first two ingredients in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Form into balls. Place on cookie sheets and freeze. When ready to cook place in a 350\u00b0 oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix spices flour salt and water well. Add pumpkin and mix. Add slightly beaten eggs. Stir in milk. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 15 minutes until crust is set. Then reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake about 45 minutes longer or until inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Pineapple Pizza
instructions: Spread cake mix onto thoroughly buttered pizza crust. Place sliced pineapple into mix evenly. Sprinkle sifted sugar over pizza. Cook at 300\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Strawberry Angel Delight
instructions: When cake is cooled trim any brown crust. Cut cake in 3 layers. Prepare whipped topping as package directs using low-fat milk. Stir in yogurt food coloring and half the strawberries.

title: Oven Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Divide ribs into serving pieces. Place in roasting pan. Lay onions on top and pour over them the sauce made from the remaining ingredients. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours in moderate oven or until tender. Remove cover for the last 20 minutes and allow to brown.

title: Zucchini Jelly
instructions: Grate squash. Boil without water for 15 minutes until clear. Add sugar and lemon juice. Boil 6 minutes. Remove from heat and add apricot Jell-O. Cool and freeze.

title: All American Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Melt butter. Saute onion and garlic until soft. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes. Cover and let stand for 1 hour for better flavors. Cool and refrigerate for up to a week. Makes 2 cups.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. I frost cookies with melted Andes Mints. Twenty-one mints for cookies in recipe.

title: Cheddar-Broccoli Noodles
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan over high heat heat water to boiling. Add noodles and broccoli. Return to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 5 minutes or until noodles and broccoli are tender stirring occasionally to separate noodles. Stir in one seasoning packet; drain off most of liquid. (Reserve remaining seasoning packet for another use.) Add cheese soup sour cream and pepper. Heat through stirring occasionally. Garnish with sweet red pepper if desired. Makes about 4 cups or 6 side dish servings. Prep time 10 minutes. Cook time 15 minutes.

title: Pepper Soup
instructions: Brown meat in vegetable oil. Add sliced onions cooking until they begin to soften. Sprinkle enough flour on meat to coat when mixed. Add all of remaining ingredients except mushrooms. Simmer 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender and pepper flakes have completely softened. Add mushrooms 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Grandma'S Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed adding mandarin oranges to the batter. Bake as directed. When cake has cooled mix Cool Whip vanilla pudding and crushed pineapple together. Frost cake. Refrigerate.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Stir pudding mix pineapple with juice nuts and 1 cup marshmallows in a large bowl until blended. Gently stir in 1 tub whipped topping. Mix remaining tub of whipped topping and 2 cups marshmallows in a separate bowl. Reserve 1/2 for garnish. Spoon 1/2 of the pudding mixture in a large bowl. Top with remaining marshmallow mixture and remaining pudding mixture. Garnish with reserved marshmallow mixture marshmallows and maraschino cherries Refrigerate. Makes about 16 servings.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
instructions: Grease bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate.\tCombine flour salt baking powder pudding mix margarine egg and milk. Beat for 2 minutes. Pour batter into pie plate. Drain peaches keeping the juice.\tArrange peaches on top of batter. Combine cream cheese 1/2 cup of sugar and 3 tablespoons of peach juice. Beat for 2 minutes. Spoon over peaches to within 1-inch of edge of plate. Combine 1 tablespoon of sugar with 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to\t35 minutes until golden brown.\tFilling will appear soft. Cool. Store in refrigerator.

title: Stew Casserole
instructions: Lay stew meat in casserole first. Layer celery carrots potatoes and onions (as many as you want). Add salt. Pour tomato juice over top and bake for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours when vegetables are done. Easy and tasty.

title: Home Pasta Dough
instructions: In 1 large bowl combine 1 cup flour 1/3 cup water and remaining ingredients. Beat on low speed for 2 minutes occasionally scraping bowl. With wooden spoon stir in enough additional flour to make a soft dough. Turn on lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and not sticky about 10 minutes. Divide dough into 5 sections and let set covered for 10 minutes. Roll dough out on floured surface or put through pasta machine. Cut into desired shapes. Let dry or cook immediately.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Separate the eggs. Mix together in no particular order the egg yolks milk flour and sugar. Melt butter and add to the mix. Blend egg whites until stiff. Fold into mix gently. Add baking powder. Now youre ready to make some good pancakes. Rich fattening and guaranteed to stick to your ribs.

title: Blueberry Vinegar
instructions: Place blueberries in 2-quart crock or jar. (Do not use plastic container.) Pour vinegar over blueberries; mash berries slightly with wooden spoon or potato masher. Let stand overnight. Strain vinegar into 1 1/2-quart saucepan discarding berries. Stir in sugar. Bring to boil; boil for 10 minutes. Pour hot vinegar into clean sterilized bottles or jars and cap with clean corks. If you use jars line lids with several layers of plastic wrap. Refrigerate. Yield 1 quart vinegar.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Brown hamburger onion salt and pepper together. Drain grease. Add brown sugar chili sauce and tomato soup. Heat and serve on a hamburger bun.

title: Herbed New Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in their jackets. Peel and slice while warm. Sprinkle immediately with sugar and vinegar. Add onion salt pepper and mayonnaise. Toss gently. Fold in herbs. Best made in advance and refrigerated. Garnish with a bouquet of dill or parsley and sliced hard-cooked eggs if desired. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Leigh'S Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Stir together the rest of ingredients and add to first three ingredients. Form dough into balls the size of walnuts. Roll them in a mixture of 2 teaspoons of sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons of cinnamon. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Blend all ingredients together with mixer until smooth and creamy. Spread on cooled cake.

title: Apple Pizza
instructions: Unwrap rolls and lay flat on a round or square pan. Lay out the apples. Drizzle the melted butter all over the apples and sprinkle cinnamon brown sugar and Mozzarella cheese. Preheat the oven to 325\u00b0 and bake for about 25 minutes.

title: Company Squash
instructions: Cut and cook squash until tender. Mash and add oil bouillon cube onion egg sour cream salt and pepper. Pour into prepared casserole dish. Combine bread crumbs shredded cheese and paprika; sprinkle over top of squash mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package. Heat oil and margarine until melted. Cook shrimp and garlic until shrimp is pink. Stir in rest of ingredients. Toss pasta and shrimp mixture until pasta is coated. Add salt and pepper and top with Parmesan cheese. Serves 4.

title: Spanish Slaw
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Quiche With Vegetables
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix together. Put in a greased quiche dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Chop onions and potatoes and stir-fry. Place layer of potatoes and onions and layer of cheese.\tMix milk and eggs; pour over onion mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Make syrup of sugar water cloves and cinnamon. Boil 10 minutes. Strain syrup after cooling. Mix fruit juices with syrup and chill. Just before serving add ginger ale and sherbet. Makes a nice adult nonalcoholic punch.

title: Raspberry Trifle
instructions: Cover base of dish with sponge cake. Drain fruit and save juice. Place fruit on top of sponge cake. Make Jell-O using fruit juice and water. Pour onto sponge cake and allow to set. Make up custard and allow to cool. Pour on top of fruit sponge cake and Jell-O. Whip the cream and spread over the custard when set. Decorate with raspberries.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Add celery and onion to browned sausage. Cook until tender not brown. Stir in soup milk rice salt and mushrooms.

title: Lonie Pickard'S B~B~Q Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and boil 30 minutes slowly.

title: Green Grape Sparkle
instructions: Put ice cream scoops in individual bowls. Top with grapes. Pour drink over top. May also be served from punch bowl. Easy for children to make and deliciously refreshing to eat or drink!

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and noodles. Sprinkle with cheese and cover with noodles. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Cool and debone. Cook vegetables until tender then add tomatoes and sausage Worcestershire sauce salt pepper and garlic salt. Simmer about 10 minutes. Add rice to chicken in a big pot and vegetables and sausage mixture. Cook all together with the broth for about 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Rolls
instructions: Bring the first 4 ingredients to a boil. Cool to lukewarm. Add the eggs and yeast. Wait 10 minutes. Add the flour. Let rise double then cut out with biscuit cutter and place in greased pan. Let rise and cook in medium oven at 400\u00b0 for 16 to 20 minutes. Can be refrigerated after dough rises one time.

title: Taco Tureen
instructions: Brown hamburg onion and green pepper until meat is done. Pour off fat; add remaining ingredients. Simmer until heated through.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and beat on medium speed for 5 minutes. Fold in chopped nuts. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Let set 15 minutes then turn out on cooling rack. Frost when cool.

title: Banana Split
instructions: Peel 1 side of banana. Take 1/2 strip lengthwise out of banana. Fill with marshmallows and chocolate chips. Put peel back in place and wrap in tin foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 5 minutes. Melt chocolate and marshmallows and let cool. Eat.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Shake all ingredients in a tightly covered jar. Refrigerate and shake before serving.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix all together lightly and refrigerate.

title: Bowtie Pasta With Tomato Bacon Sauce
instructions: Cook bacon drain on paper towels. Pour off all but 2 tbsp. of bacon grease. In grease cook onion until tender. Add tomatoes sugar salt and pepper stirring to break up tomatoes. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer for 15 mins.

title: German Shortcake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the pie filling and cinnamon. Work with your hands. Spread in a 9 X 13 inch pan. Cover with pie filling. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 45 minutes. Beat 2 egg whites stiff with 2 Tbsp. sugar. Add 2 Tbsp. butter and cinnamon.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar and evaporated milk for 12 minutes. In large bowl mix peanut butter marshmallow chocolate chips and margarine. Pour hot mixture over it and mix. Set in refrigerator to cool.

title: Pine Bark
instructions: Line cookie sheet with foil. Layer saltines on foil. Boil sugar and margarine for 3 minutes. Pour over crackers and bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Watch very carefully it burns easily. Take from oven. Sprinkle chocolate chips on crackers. Let set until they melt a little then smooth out. Put in refrigerator. Let harden. Break into pieces.

title: Bob'S Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix with electric mixer. Pour into 3 small bread pans or 2 large bread pans (grease pans). Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: No Fail Yeast Rolls
instructions: Combine margarine and 1 cup hot water. Mix and add to butter mixture the eggs sugar salt and 1 cup cold water. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup water. Add bread flour. Mix well and store in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pickled Beans Or Sauerkraut
instructions: Boil water vinegar and salt. Cool. Cook beans cool and drain. Add the drained corn. Mix and put in glass or stone container. Pour vinegar mixture over. Let stand for 4 days or until they are as sour as wanted. Put in jars. Cook in hot water bath for a few minutes to seal.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda salt cinnamon and sugar; mix well and set aside. Combine eggs oil and strawberries. Add to dry ingredients mixing well. Pour batter into two greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla in saucepan. Heat until little beads appear. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Mix well and pour into ice cream freezer.

title: Russian-Spiced Tea
instructions: Let water come to a boil and add tea bags. Let steep 4 to 5 minutes. Remove tea bags and add remaining ingredients. Keep hot without boiling. Run through a strainer before serving. Serves about 18 to 25.

title: Spinach Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Cook chicken cube and squeeze lemon juice over chicken. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Marinated Pork
instructions: Mix orange juice ginger and garlic powder. Pour over pork. Marinate overnight in refrigerator. (Cook in hot air cooker for best results.) Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 then for 20 minutes at 320\u00b0. Turn and marinate occasionally with sauce. Check and cook longer if desired.

title: Lizzies
instructions: The use of a candy thermometer to measure the temperature accurately and to prevent under or overcooking your candy is strongly recommended. The boiling temperature indicates the concentration of the solution of your candy. The higher the concentration the longer it is cooked and the higher the temperature becomes. Thats why it is so important to use a candy thermometer.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar Crisco eggs and flavorings. In another bowl combine flour salt and baking powder. Pour in creamed mixture and add all other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until done.

title: Liz'S Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all together and serve with favorite raw vegetables. Chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Marinated Roast Pork Loin
instructions: Place pork loin in large glass or plastic container. Whisk together rest of the ingredients to make the marinade. Pour on top of pork. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Starlight Mint Surprise Cookies
instructions: Sift flour soda and salt together. Cream the butter. Gradually add sugar and brown sugar; cream well. Add unbeaten eggs water and vanilla; beat well. Blend in dry ingredients. Gradually mix thoroughly. Cover and chill at least 2 hours.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut steak into serving sizes; salt pepper and roll in flour. Fry steak until brown; pour off excess grease. Add onion rings (that you have sliced and separated). Add tomatoes that have been blended. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Mock Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cut cookies in half lengthwise. Cover bottom of 12 x 9-inch pan with sliced cookies. Cook vanilla pudding according to package directions adding 1 tablespoon rum. While still hot pour over cookie layer. Add another cookie layer. Repeat with chocolate pudding. Add another cookie layer. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with nuts jimmies or cherries. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Burger'S Chocolate Pies
instructions: Shift flour cocoa sugar together mix well. Add egg yolks slowly. Add evaporated milk and mix well. Add milk and water. Cook on medium heat. Stirring constantly. Add butter and vanilla flavoring when getting thick. Pour into pie shells.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Beat egg yolks in a medium mixing bowl. Pour in condensed milk stirring constantly. Add lime juice and rind. Add food coloring; stir until blended. Pour mixture into graham cracker crust. Place pie in oven and bake 15 minutes. Transfer to rack; let cool. Spread Cool Whip on cooled pie.

title: Christmas Special Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and set aside. Mix dry ingredients; pour over fruit and nut mixture and stir until well coated. Beat 3 eggs until foamy and pour into mixture. Stir well. Spoon in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan that is greased and lined with wax paper. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes at 300\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Cabbage Lasagna(Low-Fat Recipe)
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and green pepper. Drain well. Add sauce. In a large casserole sprayed with nonstick cooking spray layer cabbage meat cheese and mushrooms. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 until cabbage is tender about 1 hour. Great dish if you love cabbage.

title: Cream Of Corn Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and celery. Cook 10 minutes. Stir often. Add creamed corn milk and pepper. Cook 30 minutes. Stir often. Serves 6.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Put sugar corn syrup 1/2 cup water salt and peanuts in 2-quart microwaveproof bowl or casserole. Cook on High (maximum power) for 5 minutes; stir. Cook on High for 13 to 15 minutes or until the syrup separates into threads. This is the hard crack stage or 300\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Check temperature with thermometer several times during the last few minutes. (Do not leave thermometer in oven while cooking.) Stir in butter soda and vanilla just until light and bubbly. Pour over buttered cookie sheet. Spread. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Creamy Cauliflower
instructions: Cook cut up cauliflower until done. Mix mayonnaise and mustard. Put cauliflower in casserole dish. Cover top with mayonnaise mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts.

title: Sweet-Sour Beets
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar beet juice bay leaves and cloves in a saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil then pour over onions and beets. Cover and chill. Onions take on the beet color and the mixture keeps well.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 12-cup muffin pan and set aside.

title: Party Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine 2 (8 ounce) jars or packages sharp cheese spread 2 cups of natural cheese Blue cheese and grated onion. Beat until smooth. Shape into 2 balls. Chill thoroughly. One plain and one garnished with nuts. Chill again then serve.

title: Zesty Zucchini Saute
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat melt butter and oil. When hot add zucchini garlic parsley and basil. Saute until tender-crisp (7 minutes). Season with salt and pepper. Serves 4.

title: Terry'S Mango Pie
instructions: Mix milk juice and pulp with 6 ounces Cool Whip. Blend well; pour into crust. Spread remaining 2 ounces of topping over top. Refrigerate until firm. May be frozen and served frozen.

title: Vegetable Soup With Rice
instructions: Soak beans overnight in cold water to cover; drain. Combine bacon onion and butter in a large saucepan and cook over medium heat until golden stirring frequently.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast with warm water and sugar; let set. Sift flour and let set. Pour boiling water over shortening. Mix salt and 1/2 cup sugar and eggs together. Mix boiling water and shortening with sugar and egg mixture. Add 1/2 of the flour mixed yeast water and sugar. Add remaining flour. The amount of flour may vary depending on the weather. Divide in half and let set out 3 hours in a warm place to rise. If placed in refrigerator roll out and let rise one hour before cooking. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine. Add stuffing; mix well. Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl. In small baking dish add 1/2 of stuffing mixture; press firmly. Add squash mixture then add remaining stuffing mix to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti And Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown and drain sausage; add spaghetti and sauerkraut. Salt and pepper. Cook until hot and blended.

title: Potato Gnocchi(No Fat)
instructions: Steam the potatoes in their skins until tender. When cool enough to handle peel and mash. Immediately add the flour and the salt. Knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth. If dough sticks add a little more flour. Form into rolls about as thick as your thumb. Cut into 3/4-inch sections and press down with a fork. Add the gnocchi and boil until they rise to the top (about 5 minutes). Add the gnocchi in several batches. Drain and place in a warm bowl. Mix the gnocchi with just enough sauce to completely coat them. Extra sauce can be added by each person according to their taste.

title: Cheese Toast
instructions: Get a piece of bread. Put cheese on top. Put it in the toaster oven until cheese is melted then eat it.

title: Masoods' Kheema Biryani(Saffron Rice With Ground Lamb)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl drop saffron threads in; add boiling water and soak for 10 minutes. Meanwhile in heavy saucepan bring 2 cups of water to boil. Pour in rice and add salt. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes. Strain and put rice aside. Separately heat oil. Add onions cumin seed and salt; stir for 3 or 4 minutes. Add turmeric and cumin for 1 minute then add lamb. When cooked add fresh coriander. Heat remaining 1/4 cup oil and in 4-quart casserole stir in fennel seed and rice until coated. Spread 1/3 of rice mixture on bottom of casserole. Layer 1/2 the saffron mixture and 1/2 lamb mixture. Spread the other half of the rice over the lamb and add the meat and then add the remaining rice mixture. Put rest of saffron over mixture. Add chicken stock and pour in casserole and bring to boil over high heat. Cover casserole with sheet of foil and fold down. Set lid on top of foil and bake in the middle of the oven for 25 minutes or until rice is tender and all the liquid is absorbed in casserole. Fluff the rice with fork and serve the biryani directly from the casserole or serve on platter.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Beat the eggs until fluffy. Add the sugar then the other dry ingredients. Add apples and nuts. Bake in well-greased 8-inch pan 50 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pinch Cake
instructions: Melt margarine. Add brown sugar and cinnamon; mix well. Take thawed bread and make into dough balls. Mix dough balls into margarine mixture. Put dipped dough balls in greased Bundt pan. When all done pour remaining margarine mix over dough balls in Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Preparation time 35 minutes.

title: Punch For Fifty
instructions: Chill ginger ale orange soda and pineapple juice. Put ice cream and sherbet in large punch bowl. Pour chilled ginger ale soda and pineapple juice over top and stir.

title: Shrimp Victoria
instructions: Saute shrimp and onion in margarine for 5 to 10 minutes until shrimp is pink and tender. Add mushrooms and cook 5 more minutes. Sprinkle in flour salt and cayenne pepper. Stir in sour cream and cook gently for 10 minutes (do not boil). Serve over white rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mayonnaise Biscuits
instructions: Mix and put in muffin tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Brown ground meat until it loses its pink color then drain. Add onion and peppers to meat mixture and saute for about 5 minutes; set aside. Mix cornbread mix into an iron skillet that has been heated with oil in oven. Pour meat mixture over cornbread mix. Top with grated cheese. Pour remaining mix over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Roll
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and sugar together. Save enough sugar to roll candy in. Roll out and spread with peanut butter. Roll up and chill before slicing.

title: Wet Cake
instructions: Dont use mixer and dont grease pan.

title: Judy Carlton'S Hobo Beans
instructions: Combine the first 8 ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes. Add the beans and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 covered then 1 hour uncovered.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add next 5 ingredients and mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Banana Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix well. Pour into muffin cups using 1/3 cup per cup. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yields 24 large muffins.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Note 1 can green chilies chopped may be substituted for jalapenos.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Bake until done at 350\u00b0 (about 1 hour).

title: Round Steak With Onions And Sour Cream
instructions: Saute steak with onions and butter. Simmer 20 minutes. Add sour cream mushrooms and flour. Simmer 5 more minutes.

title: Cheesy Nachos
instructions: Spread tortilla chips over large platter. In medium saucepan combine undiluted soup salsa and 3 tablespoons of water. Heat over low heat to simmering stirring occasionally. Allow to simmer 1 minute. Pour mixture over chips. Sprinkle with scallions and olives. Serves 8.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Use a 2 1/2-quart cooking pot. Turn beef into pot sprinkle with salt. Stir over medium heat with a blending fork until all meat changes color. Add onions and celery mix well. Cover and cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes. Add tomatoes and liquid and all seasonings mixing well. Bring to a boil; cover. Turn heat low and simmer gently for 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Add kidney beans and beef broth. Simmer over low heat 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet And Savory Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef crumbs onion egg and garlic. Shape into 16 meatballs. In skillet brown meatballs in shortening; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients except for rice. Cook over low heat 20 minutes or until done. Stir now and then. Serve with rice.

title: Glazed Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dressing soup mix and preserves in a large bowl. Dip chicken parts into mixture and coat well. Place on foil-lined pan pour remaining mixture over chicken. Bake for 1/2 hour on each side turn once more and raise temperature of oven to 375\u00b0. Bake for another 1/2 hour. During this time glaze should thicken.

title: Bachelor'S Quarters
instructions: You will need a can opener pot with cover spoon toaster knife and a clean plate.

title: Black Skillet Apple Cake
instructions: Into a black skillet sift the flour baking powder salt nutmeg cinnamon cloves and sugar. Combine the oil egg pecans and apples. Stir together and bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Crabmeat Melts
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except crackers. Top each cracker with 1 tablespoon of the crabmeat mixture. Place on cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes. Makes 36.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Drain 1 cup juice from pineapple. Heat with 1 cup of water to boiling point then pour over jello and mix. Add cream cheese mayonnaise and marshmallows. Mix well with egg beater. Add crushed pineapple and pecans. Mix well and chill.

title: French Toast Casserole
instructions: Generously butter a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Cut bread in 1-inch thick slices. Arrange in single layer in prepared dish.

title: Sicilian Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain. In a large skillet simmer oil garlic onion and parsley until tender. Combine tomato paste and water. Add the tomato puree wine and seasonings. Continue to simmer 5 to 7 minutes. Add peppers. Simmer an additional 2 minutes until tender. Pour over pasta and blend. Chill approximately 1 to 2 hours. Garnish with black olives. Serve cold.

title: Butterscotch Squares
instructions: Mix and sift flour baking powder and salt; stir in 1/2 cup nuts. Melt shortening. Add brown sugar and cook slowly until sugar melts. Stir constantly. Beat in thoroughly eggs then vanilla. Stir in flour mixture. Turn into greased shallow pan (7 x 11 x 1-inch). Spread 1/2-inch thick. Sprinkle with remaining nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut in squares while warm. Yields 28 squares.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Brown beef. Add taco mix water and olives. Then simmer for 5 minutes. Form crust by pressing unbaked rolls in pie plate. Sprinkle 1 cup of chips over crust. Spoon in meat mixture. Spread with sour cream; cover with rest of cheese and rest of chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown. Serve with lettuce and tomato.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Sprinkle onion soup over bottom of pan. Add rice. Lay chicken over top of rice. Dilute chicken soup with water and pour over chicken. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and bake 30 minutes to brown chicken. The recipe may be altered by adding more rice and soup if desired. In addition mushroom soup may be used. Pour some soup directly on the rice or it will not cook.

title: Moist 'N Crispy Chicken
instructions: Place crushed cereal paprika salt and pepper in large plastic food bag. Shake to blend well. Brush chicken on all sides with mayonnaise. Place one piece at a time in bag. Shake to coat well. Place on rack in broiler pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Twice Baked Potato
instructions: Wash potatoes; pat dry. Prick each potato with fork. Bake on a rack at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are done. Cut a thin slice from top of each potato; scoop out pulp into a bowl. Mash potato pulp with the hot milk until fluffy. Beat in butter and green onions. Add seasonings. Fry bacon until crisp. Add to potato mix. Spoon potato mixture into shells. Sprinkle with cheeses. Place potatoes on baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheeses are melted.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and Jell-O. Add eggs oil and wine mixing well. Grease 9 x 13 pan. Pour mixture into pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Soften cheese to room temperature. Drain and rinse crab and sprinkle with the lemon juice. Stir all ingredients together. Press into a bowl; chill. Loosen and invert onto large plate. Surround with crackers and serve.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Separate egg yolks and heat in double boiler. Make thick paste of flour and water. Thin if necessary so it will pour. Beat yolks and thickening together. Add sugar cocoa and salt. Add milk. Mix and cook in a double boiler until stiff stirring constantly. Pour into baked pie crust. Spread whipped egg whites on top and brown.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Heat griddle; grease generous (medium hot). When bubbles begin to form turn and brown other side. (Makes 6 medium size pancakes.)

title: Scotch Chocolate Cake And Icing
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in a mixing bowl mixing well. In a saucepan put margarine Crisco cocoa and water. Bring to a rapid boil and then pour over flour and sugar mixing gradually. Put soda in buttermilk. Add to the eggs and vanilla. Beat slightly. Add to other ingredients. Mix and turn into an 11 x 16 greased and floured pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Make icing 5 minutes before cake is done and pour hot icing over cake.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel slice and dice eggplant. Boil until tender then drain. Place eggplant in 2-quart baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Brown bacon and onions together. Drain off excess drippings. Add tomato soup stirring over medium heat. Add cheese. When melted pour over eggplant. Add croutons on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until brown.

title: Homemade Vegetable Soup
instructions: In large kettle cover shanks with water. Heat to boiling. Add bay leaves and peppercorns. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 1 3/4 hours or until meat on shanks is tender. Remove shanks from stock; cut meat from shanks into 1/2-inch cubes. Let stock cool slightly. Skim fat from surface. Strain stock into large kettle. Add meat and remaining ingredients; heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for about 20 minutes or until carrots are tender.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 for about 5 minutes. Gradually add sugar and salt to beaten egg whites. Add vanilla. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Drop cookies from a large teaspoon onto the cookie sheet. Place in oven and turn off heat. Remove when oven is completely cooled.

title: Low-Fat Lasagna
instructions: Mix spaghetti sauce and tomato sauce together. Layer spaghetti sauce mixture noodles and cottage cheese in that order. Repeat until four complete layers have been made. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Blackberry Apple Pie
instructions: Roll out crust. Mix together carefully the apples blackberries sugar and cornstarch. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Add to pie shell. Dot with butter. Add top shell; brush with egg and milk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes. While hot sprinkle with sugar.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in greased casserole at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken, Cabbage And Noodles
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove skin and debone chicken. Cut up cabbage and boil in broth from chicken along with noodles. Add cut up chicken when noodles are done. Good stew!!

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Brown sausage and ground beef; drain. In saucepan melt cheese and add the meat to it. Stir in remaining ingredients; cook for 5 minutes. Cool slightly. Cover; store in refrigerator until serving time. When ready to serve spread on cocktail rye and cook on ungreased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes. Makes approximately 72 slices.

title: Mini Chip Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in saucepan; stir in brown sugar. Remove from heat; pour into small mixer bowl. Cool. Beat egg and vanilla into cooled mixture. Add flour and salt mixing just until well blended. Stir in mini chips. Spoon into greased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan. Cool; frost if desired. Cut into squares. Yields 16 brownies.

title: Kathryn'S Apple Pudding
instructions: Mound apples in buttered 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with orange juice. Combine sugar flour spices and salt. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is crisp. Makes 6 servings. Best served warm topped with vanilla ice cream.

title: Spicy Chicken And Pasta
instructions: Cut the sausage into slices. Put the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Brown the sausage. Slice the onion add to the pan and cook until soft about 5 minutes. Chop the garlic add and cook 2 minutes. Drain the tomatoes chop and stir along with the basil thyme salt and pepper. Simmer stirring occasionally for about 20 minutes. Cut the chicken across the grain making 1/2-inch strips. Pit and quarter the olives. Add chicken olives parsley and red pepper and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Just before serving boil the pasta and drain it. Serve pasta topped with the sauce.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread rolls on cookie sheet. Cook. Mix 1 package Ranch dressing with cheese. Cover cooked rolls with softened cream cheese. Sprinkle Lawrys seasoned salt over all.

title: Tang Salad
instructions: Mix well and Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Beef Stroganoff Casserole With Biscuit Topping
instructions: Brown meat and onion with seasonings in a large skillet. Add soup and milk; simmer 10 minutes. Add sour cream and vegetables. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Put casserole dish in 350\u00b0 oven while preparing biscuits. Remove from oven. Arrange biscuits on top of mixture. Bake until biscuits are done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mediterranean Chicken
instructions: Heat margarine in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat until melted. Cook garlic onion and chicken in margarine until chicken is brown on both sides. Stir in remaining ingredients; reduce heat. Cook 10 to 15 minutes or until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut. Yields 6 servings.

title: Raisin Cake
instructions: Put washed raisins into a saucepan with the cold water; boil for 5 minutes. Cool and drain liquid into a measuring cup; add water to equal 1 c. if necessary. Cream together sugar and butter. Sift together flour cinnamon cloves and salt. Dissolve the baking powder and baking soda in the reserved raisin liquid. Mix all ingredients together and add nuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes.

title: Karo Krazy Krunch
instructions: Mix nuts and popped corn in a large bowl. Set aside. In saucepan combine sugar butter and Karo. Bring to a boil stirring constantly over medium heat. Boil until mixture reaches 300\u00b0 on candy thermometer (hard crack stage). Add vanilla and stir. Pour over popped corn stirring to coat. Quickly spread onto a cookie sheet to cool. Break apart when cooled.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and form into small meatballs. Brown. Combine cornstarch soy sauce vinegar water sugar and pineapple juice. Cook until thickened. Add meatballs green pepper and pineapple. Heat through and serve.

title: Fried Biscuits
instructions: Add yeast to warm water. Add other ingredients and let dough rise. Work into biscuits and drop into fat. This recipe will make about 7 dozen biscuits. They can be frozen individually and stored in bags. When you work them up dont let the biscuits rise too high. The fat should be slightly hotter than 350\u00b0. If fat should be too hot the biscuits will be soggy in the center.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir until well blended. Store in jar with screw lid in refrigerator until needed.

title: Basil Cheese Spread
instructions: In a food processor blend cream cheese goat cheese and butter. Line a 1 quart souffle dish with damp cheesecloth allowing it to hang over the sides. Spread about 1/4 of the cheese mixture in the souffle dish followed by 1/3 of the pesto. Repeat with remaining cheese and pesto ending with cheese. Fold ends of cheesecloth over top and smooth with fingers. Chill 3 hours or until\tfirm. Unfold cheesecloth. Press pine nuts around sides and\tgarnish with basil leaves. Refrigerate cheese keeps 7 to 10 days.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts; cool and cut in bite size pieces. Set aside. Crush 3/4 stack Ritz crackers and line bottom of a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Place the chicken pieces on top of crackers. Mix the soup and sour cream and pour mixture on top. Top with another 3/4 stack of Ritz crackers. Melt the butter and mix with poppy seed. Pour on top. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimpbalaya
instructions: In large skillet melt butter and saut green pepper and sausage until cooked halfway then add chicken. Cook until meats are done. With slotted spoon remove the meat from pan letting the drippings drain back into the pan; set aside. Add flour to make a thickening then stir in enough milk to make a thin gravy. Add the shrimp to the skillet along with the meat and any juice it may have. Cook until the shrimp turn pink about 10 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve on the noodles.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Pull off about 10 leaves of cabbage; wilt in very hot water. Take raw hamburger and chop up. Add onion salt and pepper. Add rice and mix. Take cabbage leaf; put ball of hamburger mixture in leaf and add Dash then roll. Place toothpick to hold roll together. Place in bottom of pan. Cook over medium heat 30 minutes with water just covering. Add potatoes whole and peeled. Sprinkle with Dash. Cover and cook until potatoes are done. Add juice or sauce and warm.

title: Broccoli And Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Saute onion in margarine. Mix with the rest of the ingredients. Mix together. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Split Levels
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl melt chocolate cream cheese and milk on high for approx. 3 minutes. Add seeds stir and set aside. In a separate bowl combine flour baking powder salt sugar butter egg and almond extract. Spread and press 1/2 of this mixture in the bottom of a 9 x 9 inch pan. Spread chocolate mixture on top. Sprinkle remaining dry mixture on top of chocolate. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 - 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Tuna Waldorf Salad
instructions: Sprinkle apples with lemon juice. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Chill. May be served on lettuce leaf.

title: Czechoslovakian Cake(Bar Cookie)
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients. Spread 2/3 of the paste in well-greased 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan then spread on preserves. Drop rest of paste over preserves so that preserves show through. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into squares.

title: Peach Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Drain peaches. Spread softened butter in bottom of deep square pan 9x9. Pack brown sugar evenly on top of butter. Arrange peaches cup side down on sugar mixture. Lay cherries in uniform pattern between peach halves. Cream shortening add sugar gradually creaming thoroughly. Blend in well-beaten eggs and flavoring. Stir in sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Pour batter carefully over fruit. Bake in 350 degree oven about 1 hour. Loosen sides of cake with spatula and turn out on pan immediately allowing pan to rest over cake a few seconds so the syrup will drain. Serve warm or cold with whipped cream.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Cut rhubarb into one-inch pieces. Beat eggs milk sugar flour cinnamon and vanilla just until well blended. Stir in rhubarb. Pour into pastry lined pie pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce peas onion eggs bacon and cheese in this order. Then top with mayonnaise. Toss when ready to serve.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Put cookies in food processor or blender and crush until mixture looks like dirt. Set aside. Combine margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix pudding and milk according to package directions. Add to cream cheese mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer cookies cream mixture cookies cream mixture etc. in deep glass bowl. End with cookie layer on top. May put gummy worms on top.

title: Boiled White Icing
instructions: In top of double boiler put all ingredients-bring water to boiling and beat egg whites 5 to 7 minutes until peaks form. Take off burner but leave over water and add 10 marshmallows or 1 c small marshmallows beating until melted. Can be used on layer cake.

title: Grandma Blaschke'S Krist Cookies
instructions: Mix well to make a good stiff cookie dough. Pinch off pieces the size of walnut or drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with a few drops of water and sugar on each or use milk instead of water. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: American Lasagna
instructions: Alternate cooked noodles Swiss cheese cottage cheese American cheese and meat sauce in a dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Best Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar vanilla butter and milk for 2 minutes and stir. Turn off heat! Add marshmallows cut in small pieces; stir until marshmallows are melted. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour out on cookie sheet. Nuts may be added.

title: Chicken Broth With Enoki Mushrooms
instructions: Bring stock chicken (if desired) and ginger to a boil in medium saucepan. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Strain through fine sieve and return to pan. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Using vegetable shortening lightly grease a small baking cookie sheet. In large bowl sift flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Add softened butter and cut into flour mixture using a pastry blender or fork until its in fine crumbs. Add raisins and toss. Pour buttermilk into flour and toss mixture with fork until mixed well. Using hands gently gather mixture and press into a ball. Put ball on a lightly floured board and knead with palms of your hands until dough is smooth (about 1 minute). Shape into a smooth round ball and place on prepared cookie sheet. Using hands flatten dough into a circle (about 1 1/2 inches thick). Press a large floured knife into center of loaf halfway through dough. Repeat at right angle to divide loaf into quarters. Sprinkle cinnamon very lightly on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Bake until golden brown. Cool on wire rack and brush top with melted butter while still warm.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with mixer and pour into an unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers. Pack in quart jars. Place 2 garlic bulbs (this is the little individual bulbs after the big bulb has been peeled) hot pepper and 1 head of dill in each quart jar. Bring water vinegar and salt to a rolling boil. Pour over cukes. Seal jars.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Saute margarine onion pepper and mushrooms together. Place in 2-quart casserole. Add 1 cup uncooked long grain rice seasoning and broth powder Gravy Master and water/mushroom liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in their jackets in boiling salted water until nearly tender. Drain peel and cut in slices about 1/2-inch thick. Place in a greased shallow baking dish and sprinkle with salt. Cook together brown sugar water and butter in a separate pan for several minutes. Then stir in lemon juice and pour over potatoes. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes basting occasionally with the syrup. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chilled Mustard Sauce For Stone Crab Claws
instructions: Blend mustard mayonnaise and A.1. sauce until smooth. Gradually add cream; chill and serve with stone crab claws. Makes 2 cups.

title: Pot Roast And Gravy
instructions: Season roast with seasoned salt onion powder seasoned pepper and garlic powder. Brown roast on both sides in hot olive oil in large Dutch oven. Add 3/4 cup of water chopped onion minced garlic parsley and thyme. Cover and cook slowly for about 3 hours. Remove roast to serving platter. Skim fat. Make gravy.

title: Aunt Betty'S Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash and sterilize jars. Put 1 sprig of dill in bottom of each jar. Pack cucumbers into jars. Bring water vinegar and salt to a boil and boil for about 5 minutes. Pour over cucumbers and seal.

title: Elephant Ears
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup water. Set aside. Combine salt sugar and 2 cups flour. Stir in yeast 1 cup water beaten egg and butter. Beat in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Put cabbage leaves into boiling water until soft; drain. Mix all ingredients. Melt 1/2 stick butter in casserole dish. Divide mixture into equal parts with cabbage leaves. Roll up; put into baking dish. Cut up 1/2 stick butter; put on top of rolls. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Sugared Pecans
instructions: In a large bowl toss pecans in beaten egg white coating evenly. Add dry ingredients and toss well. Spread nuts on greased baking sheet (I cover the sheet with foil and spray the foil with vegetable spray) and bake at 300 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice water and salt until done. Mix together well and top with a mixture of fresh bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until topping is brown.

title: Old South Cucumber Lime Pickles
instructions: Soak clean cucumbers in water and lime mixture in crockery or enamel ware for 12 hours or overnight. Do not use aluminum ware. Wash 3 times in clean water and soak in fresh ice water for 3 hours. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a low boil; stir until sugar is dissolved. Add cucumbers and soak 5 to 6 hours or overnight. Boil pickles in soaking liquid for 35 minutes. Fill sterilized quart jars with cucumber slices and pour syrup over cucumbers leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Cap each jar when filled. Process 5 minutes in boiling water bath. Boiling water should cover jars by 1-inch. Start processing time when filled jars are placed in rolling boiling water canner with tight fitting lid. Should be left on high heat during processing. Label. Store in dry dark cool place.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Sprinkle with cheese. In separate bowl mix eggs milk Bisquick onion salt and pepper. Beat and pour over sausage and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Brown Sugar Syrup
instructions: Mix sugars and water in saucepan. Cook until mixture will spin a fine thread. Serve hot with hot pancakes and homemade butter.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the potatoes salmon onion cracker crumbs parsley salt pepper and egg yolk; mix well. Beat egg white until stiff peaks form; fold into salmon mixture. Shape into six patties. Heat oil in skillet; fry patties over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side or until lightly browned.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Combine soy sauce ginger salt and garlic. Pour over pork and marinate 30 minutes. Dredge pork in cornstarch. Cook (in oil) drain. Cook vinegar ketchup brown sugar Worcestershire and pepper sauce to a boil. Add green pepper and onions. Add tomatoes and pineapple 2 tablespoons cornstarch and water. Thicken and pour over hot pork. Serve with rice.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and water; chill until thick. Stir in other ingredients. Put in muffin tins or paper muffin cups. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Carrot Pennies
instructions: Slice carrots into pennies. Cook until fork-tender. Chop pepper and onion and combine with remaining ingredients. Add to drained carrots. Let marinate several hours and serve cold.

title: Sweet Potato Supreme
instructions: Combine all ingredients; spoon into 1 to 1 1/2-quart baking dish.

title: Breakfast On-The-Go Drink
instructions: Place can of pineapple (with all the juice) strawberries and ice cubes in blender. Cover and set it on \chop\ for about 5 seconds. Add sliced up banana and yogurt; blend on \liquefy\ or \stir\ for about 10 seconds until smooth. Add sweetener to taste and blend 2 more seconds. Serves 2.

title: Aunt Lela Burton'S Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch tube cake pan. Cream margarine Crisco and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time and beat until creamy. Add flavoring salt and flour. Beat until creamy. Bake for about 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Cake will freeze well. Add an extra egg if more moisture needed.

title: Pumpkin Ring
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour angel food cake pan. Beat all ingredients (except glaze) on low speed for 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed for 3 minutes.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Shape meat balls. Place on baking sheet and bake until no longer pink. Simmer barbecue sauce and meatballs in crock-pot.

title: Spaghetti And Master Meat Sauce
instructions: Add Italian seasoning and package of spaghetti season mix to two cups Master Meat Sauce. Heat and mix with 4 cups of hot cooked drained spaghetti.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix oil sugar eggs zucchini and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour for 1 big loaf pan. Adjust time for smaller loaves. Done when toothpick inserted in center comes clean.

title: Marinated Grilled Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate overnight or several hours in refrigerator. Grill over slow coals about 1 hour or until done turning frequently and brushing with marinade.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Place in casserole (sprayed with Pam). Heat soup cheese and oleo until melted. Pour over broccoli and cover with croutons. Heat in oven until croutons brown a little. If you dont like croutons you may use Ritz crackers or Pepperidge stuffing mix instead.

title: Savory Cornish Hens
instructions: Remove giblet packs; wash hens and pat dry. Cut crusts from bread; cut into 1/2-inch cubes. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden stirring occasionally; remove from oven. Combine parsley salt pepper and poultry seasoning; set aside. In heavy skillet melt butter. Add onions and livers; cook until livers are lightly browned and onions are tender. Remove and chop livers. Add livers onions and butter from pan to bread cubes; toss to mix well. Salt and pepper hens lightly. Pack tightly with stuffing; truss. Place in oven baking dish breast side up. Brush with melted butter; roast at 375\u00b0. Turn every 15 minutes; baste with butter and pan juices. Cook a total of 50 to 60 minutes until juices run clear when knife tip is inserted in hen. Serve hot.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
instructions: Combine vegetables soup 1/2 cup cheese sour cream pepper pimientos and 1/2 can Durkee French fried onions. Pour into a 1-quart casserole. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs and pumpkin together then add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake in 2 (9 x 13-inch) greased pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Truffle Cake
instructions: Make cake mix as directed. Make pudding as directed. Layer crumbled cake strawberries pudding Cool Whip and Heath bars. Repeat layers.

title: Glazed Carrot, Vicky
instructions: Peel and slice carrots approximately 1/4-inch thick. Place carrots in saucepan or straight sided saute pan. Add enough water to barely cover carrots. Add butter sugar salt and nutmeg.
