Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer. Stir occasionally. Simmer carrots until almost all water has evaporated and carrots are tender. Toss carrots to coat with glaze. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Butter Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix with a spoon cake mix softened margarine 2 eggs and 1 cup chopped pecans. Batter will be thick. Pat mixture into a buttered floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix with mixer powdered sugar 2 eggs and cream cheese. Then pour over the mixture in pan and bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Do not expect to test the doneness with a toothpick.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Prepare Jello according to package directions. Let it set up then whip. Add all other ingredients. Chill.

title: Great-Grandmother'S Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Heat stirring constantly until thickened. Pour into baked pie shell. Cover with meringue and brown.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Peanut Butter Sandwiches Baked In Custard
instructions: This diet is designed to help you cope with stress buildup during the day.

title: Upside-Down Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk and egg; stir just enough to moisten the dry ingredients. Spread topping in bottom of greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Top with batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer as listed except mayonnaise and cheese. Mix mayonnaise and cheese then spread on top. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple Bars
instructions: Place half of Gilge pie crust in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle pie crust with crushed corn flakes. Combine apples sugar and cinnamon. Pour over pie crust. Cover with rest of pie crust; prick steam holes. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes. Drizzle with confectioners sugar icing. Delicious with cheese as well!

title: Southern Fried Apple Pies
instructions: Mix all together and set aside to cool.

title: Sweet And Sour Lentils
instructions: Combine water and lentils; bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 1/2 hour. Add chopped onion and cook 15 minutes more. Add remaining ingredients. Add more water if lentils look dry. Continue to simmer for 10 minutes. If the lentils are not tender add a little more water and soak a few more minutes. Serve over rice bulgur or millet.

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Brown beef salt and pepper. Mix together soups sour cream peas pimientos and cooked noodles. Add to meat mixture. Pour into baking dish and sprinkle with bread crumbs or grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: *Some suggestions broccoli carrots cauliflower tomatoes and green onion.

title: Believe It Or Not Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops; place in baking dish. Mix Coke and ketchup together; pour over pork chops. Cover with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Believe it or not This is delicious!

title: Inexpensive Fruitcake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Simmer gently for 20 minutes the raisins dates sugar water and shortening. Cool. Sift together and stir in dry ingredients. Mix in nuts. Pour into two well-greased and floured loaf pans (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch). Bake for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Stir all ingredients to a soft dough. Gently smooth dough on floured cloth-covered board into a ball. Knead five times.

title: Buttermilk Brownies
instructions: Sift first 3 ingredients together. Then mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased and floured 11 x 7 x 1-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Five minutes before it is finished cooking mix topping together.

title: Spinach And Cheese Baked Ziti
instructions: In large pot cook ziti as package directs; cook spinach and drain. Squeeze to remove excess moisture. In a large bowl combine spinach Ricotta eggs Parmesan pepper and nutmeg. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Drain ziti and return to pot. Add spaghetti sauce and oregano. Place half the ziti in a 12 1/2 x 8 1/2-inch clear shallow baking dish. Add all of the spinach mixture and half the Mozzarella. Top with remaining ziti and Mozzarella and cover with foil. Bake 25 minutes. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes or until bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes then serve. Serves 8.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute first five vegetables in 1/2 stick margarine. Combine undiluted soup and sour cream. Mix until smooth and add carrots and sauteed vegetables mixing lightly. Combine stuffing mix and melted margarine. Spread 1/2 of stuffing mixture over bottom of greased 12 x 7-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top and sprinkle with remainder of stuffing. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Texas Yum-Yum Cake
instructions: Mix and spread in 9 x 13-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Boil zucchini sugar and pineapple for 10 minutes. Add Jell-O; boil 2 minutes longer until it starts to thicken.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Set aside. Beat egg yolks. Add evaporated milk pumpkin 1/2 cup brown sugar salt and spices. Cook over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add gelatin mixture stirring until dissolved. Cool. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Add rest of sugar. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. Refrigerate. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine in large bowl the condensed milk and wafers. Add pudding mix. Beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of the wafers bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice. End with pudding. Chill. Garnish. Refrigerate.

title: Gulliver'S Creamed Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flour and butter. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Blend flour and butter in another pan then pour into the big mixture. Blend well and let thicken. If you wish just put 1 tablespoon of flour first and see if thickens. If not then add the second tablespoon. Bring to the desired consistency. If you like corn this will melt in your mouth.

title: Enchilada Stack-Ups
instructions: Combine tomato sauce chilies and seasoning in saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Combine cheese and onions. Mix lightly. Place tortilla in paper towel and heat slightly in microwave to soften. Place 1 tortilla in large casserole dish or large skillet with 2 tablespoons sauce and 1/2 cup cheese mixture. Repeat layers ending with a tortilla on top. Top with remaining sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 25 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese mixture. Continue baking until cheese is melted. Cut in wedges. Serve.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine sugar pumpkin and eggs together. Add flour baking powder and salt. Mix well and drop by spoonfuls onto slightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown (about 8 to 10 minutes). Remove from cookie sheet and cool.

title: Crazy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in ungreased square baking pan. Make 3 holes; pour oil in one vinegar in one and vanilla in the other. Pour water over all. Mix well with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Combine hamburger and remaining ingredients except noodles and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with noodles and bake for 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: 3 Step Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla with electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs and mix again. When well blended pour mixture into crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool in refrigerator 3 hours or overnight.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Cookies
instructions: Melt butterscotch chips. Add peanut butter. When soft add chopped peanuts and noodles. Mix thoroughly. Dip out with teaspoon and lay on wax paper until cold.

title: Lemon Cake Squares(Yield: 24 Large Squares)
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Frosty Eggnog
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar and salt; blend well. Add milk Cool Whip vanilla and nutmeg. Blend thoroughly and chill. May be served from a punch bowl or stored in a milk carton in the refrigerator until desired. Shake well before serving.

title: Convenient Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil drain and mash potatoes with all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Put in long casserole dish and top with bacon bits paprika parsley flakes and pepper. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Cocoa Cream Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa cornstarch yolks of 3 eggs sugar salt and milk in saucepan on medium to low heat. Cook until thick; remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Cheese Enchiladas
instructions: Sauce Combine tomato sauce and water in a skillet. Season with cumin and chili powder to taste. Heat to a low boil to mix flavors. Reduce to a simmer.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add all ingredients and mix with enough water to mix good. Cook to desired.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine pineapple juice lemonade and orange juice. Add ginger ale just before serving. Add maraschino cherries or sherbet if desired.

title: Angel Delight Cake
instructions: Break angel food cake into small pieces and place in a long baking dish. Pour cooked pudding over cake pieces and cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle flaked coconut over Cool Whip. Sprinkle red cinnamon drops on top of cake for festive occasion.

title: Sausage Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in a double boiler. Brown the sausage and drain. Saute onions and bell pepper in butter. Mix all ingredients and heat in crock-pot.

title: Walnut Dream Bars
instructions: With a pastry blender or two knives cut the butter or margarine into 1 cup of the flour and 1/4 cup of the brown sugar until mixture is the consistency of coarse cornmeal as in pie crust. Pat this mixture firmly into an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan and bake in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Add remainder of cheese just before serving. Important Cover with foil before baking.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown meat slowly in hot fat about 15 minutes. Add onion and garlic the last few minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water; add to meat. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Add tomatoes and green pepper. Cook 10 minutes longer. Combine cornstarch cold water and soy sauce and stir into meat mixture. Bring to boil cook and stir 5 minutes longer. Remove garlic. Serve with hot noodles. Can use round steak sprinkled with tenderizer and floured. Adjust cooking time.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cake mix oleo and nuts together. Pour into a large ungreased baking dish. Top with yellow cake mix; drizzle melted oleo over the top. Sprinkle on the nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and no longer.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Fry hamburger; drain. Add rest of ingredients. Heat through. Serve with taco chips sour cream and cheese.

title: Coconut Bread
instructions: Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt; set aside. In a large bowl combine sugar oil eggs and coconut extract. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk; stir just until moistened. Fold in coconut and nuts. Pour into two greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until breads test done. Cool 10 minutes in pans before removing to a wire rack to cool completely. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple with Jell-O until dissolved. Cool completely. Add buttermilk drained pineapple and Cool Whip. Mix thoroughly. Add nuts. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan and refrigerate until set. Can be used as a salad or a dessert. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add Seven-Up last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Steak Pockets
instructions: Combine steak potatoes mushroom soup and 2 cans of water (pepper and onion if desired) in large bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Place in heavy-duty foil and close securely. Place on hot grill 15 minutes on each side.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Sprinkle 2 or 3 teaspoons salt over this and let stand about an hour. Squeeze juice out of vegetables. Make a syrup and pour over. Put in a container to freeze.

title: Snow Cream
instructions: Mix condensed milk milk (I use low-fat) sugar and vanilla. Add alternately snow and milk mixture until you get the right consistency. If you have any leftover freeze it. It doesnt get as icy as regular Snow Cream does in the freezer.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine syrup sugar and butter. Add eggs and pecans. Mix thoroughly. Bake in an unbaked pie shell at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Sue Hill'S Bounyacouda
instructions: Mix together and bring to a boil. Serve with French bread. Dip bread in hot mixture and eat. Very good!

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Start rice or barley and water in soup pot. Brown the beef; drain and add to pot with all other ingredients. Bring to boil; cover and simmer about 1 1/2 hours. Great served with French bread.

title: Marble Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box of mix. Immediately after removing from oven spread with chocolate chips let melt a little and spread with marshmallow creme while cake is still hot. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Green Beans
instructions: Steam green beans (or cook as usual) for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Boiled White Frosting
instructions: Boil all ingredients except egg whites until at a soft ball stage. Cook slowly. Beat 2 egg whites until stiff. Add boiled mixture slowly to whites while continuing to beat. Beat until desired consistency.

title: Fresh Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Gradually add orange juice until smooth. Bring to a boil over medium heat; boil 1 minute. Remove from heat; add lemon juice and grated rind. Cool. Fold in assorted cut-up fruit drained. Pour into cookie crust. Chill 4 hours.

title: Calico Bean Soup
instructions: Cover beans with water. Add ham hock and bring to a boil for 2 minutes. Let soak overnight. Drain beans in the a.m. Add 2 quarts of water pepper onion and garlic. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Remove ham hock. Clean off bone and return meat to pan. Add extra ham tomatoes and simmer 1/2 to 1 hour or until beans are tender. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Sausage And Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in a large bowl. Fry both sausages and drain grease. Add sausage and salsa to cheese. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Oyster Chowder
instructions: Drain oysters reserving liquid. Saute onion and celery in butter in a large pot until tender. Add milk oyster liquid corn potatoes salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thoroughly heated (do not boil). Add oysters; simmer 5 to 8 minutes or until edges of oysters curl. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Yield 8 cups.

title: Mexicali Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onion in margarine. Add chili corn and tomatoes mixing well. Pour into a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Prepare corn mix according to package; stir cheese into dough. Spoon dough around edge of baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Candy
instructions: Soften chocolate drops. Stir in condensed milk then chopped pecans then vanilla flavoring. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon on waxed paper on cookie sheet and keep in refrigerator.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown beef onion and chilies on medium high heat. (Can do in microwave.) Drain some of the fat. Stir in rest and bring to boil. Simmer 30 minutes or on low in crock-pot forever! Serve with grated cheese (Monterey Jack or Cheddar) and Doritos.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix the eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Slowly stir in the hot milk. Pour into the pie shell. Dust the top with nutmeg.

title: Apricot Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve the jello in the boiling water. Add the cream cheese and stir to melt the cheese (little bits will not melt). Put in the fridge or freezer to chill while you cut up the vegetables and chop the nuts (just long enough to get cool). In a large bowl mix all together. Prepare a 9 x 13 dish by lightly spraying with Pam. Spread mixture in the dish and return to refrigerator to set preferably overnight. Cut into 12 to 15 servings and place on lettuce leaf to serve.

title: Chocolate Goody Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease (or use cooking spray) bottom of rectangular pan 13 x 9 x 2 inches. Stir brownie mix water oil and eggs in medium bowl until well blended. Spread in pan. Bake 28 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted 2 inches from side of pan comes out clean or almost clean. Cool completely; frost with frosting. Sprinkle with peanuts; refrigerate while making cereal mixture.

title: Holiday Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries marshmallows and nuts together. Add sugar. Whip cream until stiff. Fold all ingredients; chill.

title: Happy Day Cake Or Best Two Egg Cake
instructions: Stir shortening to soften. Gradually add sugar and cream thoroughly. Add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add to cream mixture alternately with milk beating after each addition. Bake in two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round pans in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for about 23 minutes.

title: Stir-Fry Vegetables
instructions: In small amount oil cook celery onions pepper and carrots until tender. Add remaining ingredients plus garlic salt to taste and 1/4 cup soy sauce. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Sausage And Kraut
instructions: Combine kraut potatoes apple and nutmeg in saucepan. Bring to boil; simmer for 10 minutes. Brown sausage; stir into kraut mixture. Simmer for 10 minutes covered.

title: Mexican Pie
instructions: Grease a 10-inch pie plate. In medium saucepan heat broth to boiling. Stir in rice butter and salt. Return to boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer according to package instructions. Remove from heat; let cool slightly. Stir in eggs and pimiento. Press against sides and bottom of pie plate.

title: Bacon Spinach Quiche
instructions: Cook spinach and drain well. Combine eggs salt and seasonings. Stir in milk bacon and spinach. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake on bottom rack at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spoon into greased muffin pan. Cook at 400\u00b0 until lightly browned. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Peel core and slice apples. Mix sugar spices salt and lemon juice; toss with apples. Fill pie with apples piling high in center. Cut butter in small cubes over apples. Cover with top crust. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 20 to 30 minutes more until crust is brown.

title: Morning Glorious Muffins
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine flour sugar soda cinnamon and salt. In another bowl combine carrot apple coconut dates and pecans. Stir in beaten eggs oil and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients stirring until moistened.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Stir together dry ingredients (not sugar). Add sugar and oil and mix well. Stir in carrots drained pineapple and nuts. Turn into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans or 1 (9 x 13) pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let cool.

title: Creamed Beef
instructions: Cook dried beef in butter until done. Push meat to one side. Blend flour into butter. Add milk all at once. Cook stirring until thick. Gradually add beef. Add Worcestershire and dash of pepper. Spoon over buttered toast. Serves 3.

title: Delicious Homemade Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with a mixer until thoroughly mixed. Pour into Bundt cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. After cake has cooled some mix 1 cup of powdered sugar and 2 tablespoons of milk (you may have to add just a little more milk than this to get the consistency that you want) and pour over cake.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Finely chop shrimp mushrooms onions pepper cabbage and water chestnuts. Transfer all chopped ingredients and ground pork to large mixing bowl. Add sherry soy sauce ginger sugar and salt. Mix well. Mix water and cornstarch in small bowl until blended. Place 1/4 cup of the pork mixture evenly across a corner of each wrapper. Brush cornstarch mixture evenly over all edges of wrappers. Carefully roll wrappers around filling folding in the corners. Heat oil over high heat until it reaches 375\u00b0. Fry 3 or 4 rolls at a time in the hot oil until golden 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Chicken Breasts Diane
instructions: Place chicken breast halves between sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Pound slightly with mallet. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon each of oil and butter in large skillet. Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side. Do not cook longer or they will be overcooked and dry. Transfer to warm serving platter. Add chives or green onion lime juice and brandy (if used) parsley and mustard to pan. Cook 15 seconds whisking constantly. Whisk in broth. Stir until sauce is smooth. Whisk in remaining butter and oil. Pour sauce over chicken. Serve immediately.

title: Stuffed Zucchini Boats(Yield:  6 Servings)
instructions: Boil zucchini until tender; cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out zucchini and reserve shells. Add 1/2 cup cheese and next 6 ingredients. Stuff shells with mixture. Dot with butter and 1/4 cup cheese. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Fudgy Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. When melted add sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir together flour baking powder and salt.

title: Breast-Of-Chicken Fiesta
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and seasoning mix; stir well. Dredge chicken in mixture and place in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Saute onions in oleo stir in whipping cream and remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Escalloped Cabbage
instructions: Place 1/2 of saltines in a buttered casserole; cover with cabbage. Sprinkle with salt pepper and celery seed. Scald milk. Add 4 tablespoons butter and let melt. Pour milk and butter over; top with remaining crumbs. Dot with remaining butter. Cover and bake at 350` for 35 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Hot Garlic Pickles
instructions: Scrub cucumbers with a brush (do not peel). Trim off ends and cut into quarters lengthwise. In the bottom of a quart jar place 1 dill head. Place cucumbers lengthwise in the jar. Add 1/2 of 1 jalapeno pepper and 1 garlic bud. Press down between cucumber pieces. Add another dill head and another row of cucumbers. Press another garlic bud and another 1/2 of a jalapeno pepper in between cucumbers (this makes 2 quarts). Fill jar covering with liquid.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook the spinach in 1/2 cup water until tender and drain thoroughly. Add soup egg and cheese and mix well. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cube the bread and toss with butter and garlic salt. Place on spinach mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Date Cake *
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar flour baking powder and salt. Then add dates and nuts. Put in shallow pan and bake 20 minutes in a moderate oven (350\u00b0). Let cool for 5 minutes. Cut in squares and roll in confectioners 10x powdered sugar.

title: Pickled Eggs And Red Beets
instructions: Boil together all ingredients except eggs. Put in jar or container with lid. Add eggs and refrigerate for 2 days.

title: Spaghetti Squash
instructions: cut squash in half lengthwise. After removing seeds place squash cut side down in 2-inches of water and boil about 20 minutes. Cool enough to handle then scrape squash with a fork from shell. Place in large bowl and add other ingredients and toss together.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Aunt Clara'S Heavenly Hamburger
instructions: Brown beef garlic and onion in nonstick pan with margarine. Drain off excess fat. Add tomato sauce salt sugar and pepper. Simmer 2 to 5 minutes. Cool and drain noodles. Combine noodles with cream cheese and sour cream. Butter an 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Put half of sauce in dish then noodle mixture and top with rest of sauce. Decorate with Cheddar cheese and parsley if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6. Freezes great!

title: Pork Chops Fried(Costolette Di Maiale Al Fritto)
instructions: Trim fat from pork chops. Beat eggs garlic salt pepper and salt together. Coat pork chops with bread crumbs and set aside on tin foil. Heat oil in frying pan and when hot dip chops in egg mixture then oil. Fry until nicely golden brown about 5 to 8 minutes on each side. Garnish with lemon wedges if desired. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Put pears onions and peppers through meat chopper. Drain part of pear juice off or it will be soupy. Add other ingredients and cook 30 minutes after it begins to boil. Put hot relish into hot jars and seal.

title: Ross' Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Warm bowl. Add water and dissolve yeast. Add warm butter sugar eggs 4 cups flour and salt. Mix until shiny and free of lumps. Gradually add remaining flour. Put in large bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Put in refrigerator for 8 to 10 hours (or up to 2 to 3 days).

title: Quick Lasagna Toss
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. In a soup pot cook sausage on medium to high heat about 8 to 10 minutes or until not pink stirring to crumble. Drain; add noodles and the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until heated and cheese is melted.

title: Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in shortening. Add other ingredients. Heat until boiling. Pour into baking dish. Cover with bread mixture starting at the edge then to the middle. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes or until bread is done.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix and bake in 3 pans for 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cream Pie Mix
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt together. Add heated milk slowly to mix. Cook over double boiler until thickened. Add egg yolks and\tbutter; reheat. Add flavoring and cool. Make meringue with egg whites. Fill crust with filling and cover with meringue. Brown in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Nancy'S Lentil-Vegetable Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Mix together well. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. Season to taste before serving.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and milk. Bring to full boil and cook for 6 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add butter chocolate chips vanilla and nuts. Beat until creamy. Pour into greased pan. When cool cut into bite-size pieces.

title: Eston'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken until done and debone. Put layer of chicken on bottom of casserole dish. Sprinkle with onion powder. Mix cream of chicken soup and sour cream. Spread evenly over deboned chicken. Mix oleo and crushed Ritz crackers. Spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot.

title: Jello Stuff
instructions: Drain juice off peaches; cut peaches into bite size chunks. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Use peach juice to mix in last; refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Serve chilled. Can use pineapple with strawberry or lime jello instead of peach.

title: Raw Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream oil sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Beat well; add carrots nuts and pineapple. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan about 45 minutes to 1 hour in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Beef And Gravy
instructions: Flour meat and sprinkle with onion and garlic salt. Brown in skillet with green pepper. Put meat and peppers in crock-pot. With grease in skillet make a little gravy. Add soups to gravy and bring to a boil. Pour over meat in crock-pot and cook until tender. Serve over rice or buttered noodles.

title: Cabbage Salad For 50
instructions: *Taste before adding may need more or less.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Whisk egg yolks condensed milk rind and juice together until smooth. Pour into pie crust. Bake 7 to 8 minutes. Cool on wire rack 15 minutes. Refrigerate until cold 2 hours. Spread top with whipped cream. Serves 8.

title: Raw Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil sugar water and cornstarch until clear and add strawberry jello; cool slightly. Pour over arranged berries pointed up in cooked pie crusts. Serve with whipped cream. Makes 3 pies.

title: Spectacular Squash
instructions: Combine stuffing with butter. Press half in 9 x 13-inch pan or 3-quart casserole. Steam squash and onion until barely cooked and drain well. Combine soup sour cream and grated carrots. Fold in squash and onions.

title: Bourbon Franks
instructions: In a large saucepan mix all ingredients except frankfurters. Cover and simmer at least 2 hours stirring occasionally. Sauce can be made ahead to this point. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours. Reheat sauce until hot. Add frankfurters and simmer until heated thoroughly about 5 minutes. Makes about 64 appetizer servings.

title: Rhubarb Yorkshire
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup butter in a 1-quart dish in 425\u00b0 oven until it bubbles. Meanwhile beat eggs with milk then gradually beat in flour and salt. Pour batter into bubbling butter. Drop rhubarb into center of batter. Do not mix. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Grease or spray with Pam a 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt butter and marshmallows in saucepan on low heat stirring until completely melted. Remove from heat and immediately stir in Rice Krispies until thoroughly coated. Spread evenly on greased pan with a greased spatula. Let cool 5 minutes and cut into squares.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Saute until soft in olive oil the onions garlic and zucchini. Process all in blender or food processor until shredded. Dont overprocess. Return to pot. Add broth 1 can water chicken broth cubes and water and curry powder. Cook on low/simmer until blended. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil. Stir until moist. Do not beat. Add vanilla pineapple 1 cup nuts and bananas. Stir but do not beat. Spoon into 3 well-greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Meat Pie(Serves 6)
instructions: Slowly brown onion pepper celery and meat stirring constantly until brown. Add remaining ingredients; simmer until thickened. Serve with hot biscuits.

title: Chuck Wagon Beans
instructions: Melt shortening. Add onions garlic and meat. Cook until lightly brown. Add all remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat about 40 minutes.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Heat together cheese and soup. Pour over combined vegetables. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Bonbons
instructions: Mix pecans butter Eagle Brand milk and powdered sugar in large bowl. Make into 1-inch balls. Put on waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: Mix together cream cheese Cool Whip sugar and pineapple juice until smooth. Blend in pineapple tidbits and grapes.

title: Cheese Crispies
instructions: Mix cheese and butter together. Add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Roll into small balls. Flatten them on a cookie sheet with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fettuccine Susan Anne
instructions: Cook and drain fettuccine. In another large pot simmer 2/3 cup of the milk and the margarine for 1 minute. Turn off heat and add drained pasta; toss until coated. Turn heat to very low and add remaining milk and all other ingredients. Toss briefly until sauce thickens and coats fettuccine. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings 220 calories each serving.

title: Filled Chocolate Cupcake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Chop 1/2 cup nuts and set aside. Sift all dry ingredients into a bowl. Add water vinegar oil and vanilla. Mix thoroughly into dry ingredients. Fill cupcake liners 1/2 full (divide batter between 24 paper liners).

title: Spanish Bread Pudding(Or Cuban)
instructions: *Spanish or Cuban supermarkets.

title: Crusty Corn Bread
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Mix well. Add egg and milk. Stir until smooth. Melt shortening in skillet. Pour hot shortening into batter and mix well. Pour batter into skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fudge Round Cookies(Unbaked)
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in pan and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute; remove and stir in oatmeal. Stir until oats are softened; add nuts and vanilla. Drop by small spoonfuls onto cookie sheet or waxed paper and let stand until firm.

title: Pineapple Nut Bread
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix well. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Yummy Ice Cream
instructions: Melt candy bars and marshmallows until thick and sticky. Add condensed milk gradually stirring until liquid. Finish filling with milk to make 1 gallon. Freeze.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls; flatten on a cookie sheet. Bake until brown. Cool. In bowl mix softened cream cheese sour cream and Ranch mix. Stir until mixed. Spread on cooled crescent rolls. Add cheese and top with chopped veggies.

title: Chewy Coconut Bars
instructions: Place margarine in a 1-cup glass measure; microwave on High (100%) for 1 minute or until melted. Beat eggs in medium bowl until light and fluffy. To the eggs add 18 packets Equal maple flavoring flour baking powder and vanilla. Add margarine; blend thoroughly. Stir in nuts raisins and coconut. Pour into an 8-inch square microwave-safe baking dish. Microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes (check after 6 minutes). Sprinkle with 1 packet of Equal. Bars will firm as they cool. Let cool completely before cutting into bars. Top with cherry slices. Yields 25 bars.

title: Potato-Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Divide vegetables in half. Layer half each of eggplant potatoes onion and green pepper in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Repeat layers with remaining vegetables.

title: Apricot Nut Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over apricots and dates. Add shortening sugar and salt; cool. Add egg flour baking powder and nuts; mix well. Turn into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours (75 minutes).

title: 4 Layer Cake
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Pour in bottom of pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool.

title: Acorn Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half and scrape out seeds. Rinse. Rub inside of squash with margarine stick. Salt and pepper to taste. Turn cut side down on cookie sheet and bake in a moderate (350\u00b0) oven until baked and easily pierced with a fork (approximately 1/2 hour). Remove from oven scrape out of skin and mash with butter.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Chop up vegetables fine; mix together. Pour dressing over them. Let it chill.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Put hash browns in a large bowl of very hot water for 10 minutes. Drain then brown them in 4 tablespoons butter or margarine. Place them in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Beat the eggs with 1/2 cup milk. Add diced meat chopped broccoli cheese and salt (very little if any is needed) and pepper to taste. Pour over hash browns. Refrigerate overnight. Or if you wish you can bake it right away in a 325\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours. Be sure to cover with tinfoil before baking. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Beef And Bean Barbecue
instructions: Cook ground beef and vegetables in hot fat until vegetables are soft. Add tomato sauce water garlic vinegar mustard thyme brown sugar and seasonings. Blend well and simmer 5 minutes. Pour beans into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Pour meat mixture over them. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Punch Bowl Dessert
instructions: Pour pudding on top of 1/2 box vanilla wafers. Next pour 1 can cherry pie filling then 1 can pineapple chunks drained. Next slice 3 bananas on top. Add the other 1/2 box of vanilla wafers. Top with a small carton of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans. Double to put in a punch bowl. This looks nice in a glass bowl with all the layers.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: In a bowl mix the flour baking powder soda and salt. Cut in shortening until it resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in buttermilk. Knead dough gently. Roll out to 1/2 inch thickness.

title: French Fried Fish
instructions: Cut partially thawed fish into 4 pieces. Cut pieces in half crosswise. Dip 8 pieces into egg then cracker crumbs. French fry for a few minutes in hot oil.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar milk and margarine until soft-ball stage about 10 minutes. After coming to a rolling boil add vanilla margarine and peanut butter. Beat until thick. Pour into buttered pan; cool completely and cut into squares.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Dissolve lime and lemon jello in water; let thicken 20 minutes. Add mayonnaise and milk; beat until smooth. Add pineapple cottage cheese and nuts. Stir with spoon. Mold.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple in casserole dish. Mix sugar and flour together and sprinkle over pineapple. Add grated cheese and top with crackers. Melt 1 stick margarine and pour on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Uncover and eat while hot.

title: Pineapple Slaw
instructions: At last minute combine cole slaw mixture toasted nuts and 1 pkg. crushed raw ramen noodles. Pour dressing over and toss. Add cooked chicken to make it a main dish.

title: Cheese Biscuits(Lo-Cal)
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 4 servings. Each counts as 1 bread 1 protein 1 fat and 5 calories.

title: Instant Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover in Tupperware bowl. Place in refrigerator and use as needed. Fill greased muffin tins 3/4 full and bake at 450\u00b0 until brown. I usually mix and bake immediately.

title: Braised Turnips
instructions: Peel turnips and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices. Melt butter in a skillet and add turnips. Cook over low heat until barely tender. Add beef broth; cover and simmer over low heat until turnips are tender about 15 minutes. Remove lid and allow some of the broth to cook down leaving a small amount of sauce. Sprinkle with lemon juice and chopped parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pina Colada Punch
instructions: Chill pineapple juice and crushed pineapple.

title: The Best Cookies In The World
instructions: Cream oleo and sugars. Add egg. Mix well. Add oil and vanilla. Mix well. Add oatmeal cornflakes coconut and nuts stirring well. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add to mixture and mix well. Form into balls the size of 3 small walnuts. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; flatten with fork. Bake for 12 minutes at 325\u00b0. Allow to cool for a few minutes before removing from pan. Makes about 100 cookies.

title: Raisin Pound Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine dry cake mix applesauce water oil eggs cinnamon nutmeg and allspice. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Stir in raisins. Pour into two greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool 5 to 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire rack.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Use 13 x 9 x 2 inch deep casserole dish. Spread cubed bread over bottom of dish. Add bacon sausage green peppers and onion over first layer. Mix salt dry mustard eggs milk and cheese together. Pour over all. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Saute celery bell pepper and onion in sausage drippings and drain. Place sausage and vegetables in a baking dish. Add rice and chicken broth on top of sausage and mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Breast Stir-Fry
instructions: Chop chicken breasts into small pieces. Toss with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and set aside to marinate for 2 to 3 minutes. Prepare vegetables and rice according to package directions. Heat wok or large skillet on medium to high setting. When hot add vegetable oil and chicken pieces. Cook 3 to 5 minutes or until browned. Add drained mushrooms drained vegetables and soy sauce. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat together eggs sugar squash oil and vanilla. Set aside. Sift together flour salt soda baking powder cinnamon nutmeg and ginger. Add to squash mixture and beat well. Add 1 cup nuts (raisins or dates can be added). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise vinegar and sugar; pour over vegetables and toss gently. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Yields 10 servings.

title: Court Bouillon With Vinegar
instructions: Peel and slice carrots. Peel and thinly slice onions. Cut celery into pieces about 3/4-inch. Peel and crush garlic. Pour vinegar into large saucepan. Add water carrots onions thyme bay leaves celery garlic and cloves. Bring to boil and add peppercorns and salt to taste. Leave to cool then strain.

title: Crunchy Nut Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar shortening eggs and vanilla. Sift flour soda and salt. Stir in cut-up nuts. Mix together. Flatten cookies with greased glass dipped in sugar.

title: Sunny South Harvest Cooler
instructions: Mix equal parts of apple juice and ginger ale and serve over ice in tall glasses. If desired a little lemon juice and sugar can be added. Club soda can be substituted for ginger ale.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
instructions: Add dry ingredients; then add oil and eggs and beat well. Add carrots. Pour into 3 pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Make cake and cool. Mix jello and water; let set up a little in refrigerator. Prick cake with fork in several places so jello can run down cake. Pour jello over cake. Spread the Cool Whip on top.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into balls about the size of a walnut. Brown meatballs in heavy iron skillet. Serve with favorite red sauce and pasta. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Janie'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Top with onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips; coat with flour salt Accent pepper and butter. Heat over low heat in 10-inch heavy skillet. Combine meat onion and garlic. Sear over medium heat on both sides. Add broth and sherry; bring to a rapid boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Crispy And Easy Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Wash and peel cucumbers; cut in strips. Soak overnight in lime water. Next a.m. wash good in cool water and soak in cool water 3 more hours. Combine and dissolve vinegar spice sugar and salt; soak overnight then boil for 40 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

title: Children'S Play Dough
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in saucepan. Add water and cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 4 minutes. Remove immediately when water disappears and is thick. Put hot dough on plate. Cover with damp cloth and cool. Knead when cool. Add food coloring if desired. May be rolled and cut out for decorations. Put cutouts on wire rack and in oven that is heated at 350\u00b0 and turn off when put in oven.

title: Watermelon Pickles
instructions: Cut rind into 1-inch cubes. Soak rind in lime water for 3 hours. Drain and rinse well. Cover with water and cook until tender. Mix vinegar sugar and spices. Bring to boil. Add rind and simmer for 1 hour. Put into jars and seal.

title: Spinach Salad With Sweet-Sour Dressing
instructions: Mix in a blender or with rotary beater. Refrigerate. Keeps well. Just before serving toss well with fresh spinach leaves bacon (fried crisp and crumbled) hard-boiled eggs (chopped) and sliced fresh mushrooms.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix milk and soup over low heat in small saucepan. Spray 4-quart casserole dish or pan. Cut bacon crosswise in half. Slice onion across. Set both aside. Peel potatoes and slice thin. Layer potatoes onion and bacon about 3 times. Cover with soup mixture. Cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours without lid stirring occasionally.

title: Vineyard Summer Salad
instructions: Place shrimp in bottom of large bowl and sprinkle with cayenne pepper and lemon juice. Cube red potatoes. Trim and dice scallions; add to bowl with green peas. Mix lightly with mayonnaise and refrigerate at least 1 hour. When ready to serve arrange on a bed of red or green leafy lettuce. Garnish with pepper strips and beets. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Party Smokies
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Stir once or twice during baking. Serve in chafing dish to keep warm.

title: Old Fashioned Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients then add fruit; mix well. Add liquid and shortening. Cook at 275\u00b0 for 3 to 3 1/2 hours.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat and simmer 30 minutes or longer.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Dip salted chicken in melted butter. Place rice in bottom of pan. Mix soups water and salt. Pour mixture over rice. Lay chicken on top. Bake uncovered for approximately 2 1/2 hours in 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix and cook on medium heat until it forms a ball. Roll with flour until it feels good.

title: Saucy Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: If desired partially cook broccoli; drain. Place in a greased 9-inch baking dish. In skillet brown chicken in oil on both sides. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange chicken over broccoli. In a bowl combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder; pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear. Sprinkle with cheese. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Vanilla Walnuts (Or Pecans)
instructions: *Or instead of a vanilla bean substitute 1 tablespoon vanilla extract blending it first with the corn oil before tossing with the nuts.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Cook in 10-inch skillet 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lickity Split Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar evaporated milk and margarine in a saucepan. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in marshmallows and chocolate chips. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple to boiling. Dissolve jello in hot pineapple; stirring constantly. Let cool. Add 2 cups buttermilk. Beat well. Add Cool Whip. (I beat with mixer.) Chill.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Parboil potatoes and onion. Put in a baking dish. Add stick of butter cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup potato juice. Bake in oven until browned. (Good for pork chops and chicken.)

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat margarine. Add mushrooms onion bell pepper and garlic. Cook about 5 minutes. Add pecans and cook for 1 minute. Wash rice well and drain. Mix rice with margarine mixture. Add broth and season to taste with salt and pepper. Turn into greased casserole and cover. Bake about 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Sheath Cake
instructions: Sift together flour and sugar. In pan mix oleo cocoa shortening and water. Bring to boil and pour over sugar mixture. Mix well. Add soda buttermilk salt eggs cinnamon and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured sheet cake pan and bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Onion Rice
instructions: Melt oleo. Mix with other ingredients; stir well. Bake in covered dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Surprise Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on. Cool in refrigerator (overnight is best). Then pare cooled potatoes. Grate 1/2 of the potatoes into a buttered casserole dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Sprinkle with salt pepper and onion powder. Dot with butter.

title: Oatmeal Pecan Raisin Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl using mixer at medium speed beat margarine brown sugar granulated sugar and vanilla until light. Add eggs; blend well. Reduce speed to low. Add oats and dry ingredients beat just until blended. Stir in pecans raisins and chocolate pieces. With damp hands shape dough into 1 1/2-inch balls; place on wax paper covered baking sheet. Using back of teaspoon dipped in water flatten balls to 3/4-inch thickness. Put in freezer 15 minutes or refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Remove from wax paper and place 3 inches apart on greased baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 14 to 16 minutes. Remove from baking sheets and cool on racks. Makes about 40 cookies.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Chicken
instructions: *Or use 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce.

title: Salad Dressing Cake(Chocolate Cake)
instructions: Mix flour sugar cocoa set aside. In a small bowl mix warm water and soda together then add to dry ingredients. In a cup mix Miracle Whip vanilla and egg together then add to other mixture. Bake 350\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes in 9 x 13 inch pan.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Heat in glass bowl in microwave. Stir frequently. Add vanilla. Stir well. Cook for 2 minutes.

title: Chocolate Praline Bars
instructions: Separate dough into 2 large rectangles. Place in ungreased 10 x 15-inch flat pan (this size only). Press dough to cover bottom. Mix sugar and butter in a pot. Boil for 1 minute. Pour evenly over dough and sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 14 to 18 minutes until golden. Remove immediately and sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Swirl as they melt. Cut when cool.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cut pineapple in quarters lengthwise with crown (leaves) intact. Remove fruit from shell by slicing 1/4 to 1/2-inch above shell leaving about an inch of fruit at each end. Fill shell with chicken tuna or fruit salad. With toothpicks fasten 1/2-inch slices of pineapple to side of \boat\ to make outrigger.

title: Slow Cooked Swiss Steak Supper
instructions: Spray 12-inch skillet with cooking spray; heat over medium-high heat. Sprinkle beef with seasoned salt. Cook in skillet 6 to 8 minutes turning once until browned. Layer potatoes carrots beef and onion in 4 to 5-quart slow cooker (Crock-Pot). Mix tomatoes and gravy; spoon over mixture in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 to 8 hours or until beef and vegetables are tender. Sprinkle with parsley if desired. Makes 6 servings

title: Veggie Bake
instructions: Cut squash and zucchini into small chunks about 1/2-inch. Dice peppers. Drain mushrooms. Mix all veggies together in olive oil. Place veggie mix in baker and bake for about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 until veggies are tender. Cool 5 minutes before serving. Sprinkle on some Parmesan cheese.

title: Truly Different Cupcakes
instructions: Melt chocolate squares and oleo in double boiler. Remove from heat and add walnuts. Cool. Mix flour sugar vanilla and eggs. Stir only enough to mix. Add chocolate mixture. Put into 24 cupcake papers and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Marguerite'S Spanish Cream Dessert
instructions: In medium saucepan stir in gelatine 1 tablespoon sugar and salt. Add milk blended with egg yolks. Set over low heat and stir constantly for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in light cream or half and half and vanilla. In separate bowl beat egg whites until stiff gradually beat in 4 tablespoons sugar. Fold egg white mixture into gelatine mixture blending well. Pour into individual dessert dishes and chill until firm. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Frog-Eye Salad
instructions: Combine sugar flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Gradually stir in pineapple juice and eggs. Cool to room temperature. Bring water salt and oil to a boil. Add acini de pepe. Cook until done. Drain and rinse. Cool to room temperature. Combine with egg mixture. Refrigerate overnight in covered airtight container. Add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly but thoroughly. Refrigerate until chilled in covered container. Makes 25 servings.

title: El-Egg-Ant Brunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove yolks and mash. Combine yolks 3 tablespoons sour cream mustard and salt and mix well. Refill egg whites. Saute green pepper and onion in butter 5 minutes. Stir in pimentos soup and remaining sour cream. Pour sour cream mixture into 9 x 9-inch dish. Place eggs on top. Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Triple Fudge Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a fairly large pot cook pudding with 2 cups milk as directed on package. Blend cake mix into hot mixture. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with nuts and chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Microwave Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs and sugar; stir in buttermilk. Add other ingredients and mix well. Let batter set in refrigerator for 24 hours before using. Will keep up to 6 weeks under refrigeration.

title: Nacho Chicken
instructions: Combine soup 1 cup cheese chilies and onions in medium bowl. Stir together flour and milk. Add to soup mixture stirring to blend. Place 1/3 cup tortilla chips in bottom of 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish. Top with half of soup mixture then half the chicken. Repeat layers sprinkling 1/2 cup cheese over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated thoroughly. Sprinkle remaining tortilla chips around edge of dish.

title: Marzetti
instructions: Brown ground meat; add seasonings. Place meat in casserole dish. Sprinkle noodles over meat. Mix soup sauce and water; pour over noodles. Cover and cook 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until noodles are cooked. Top with cheese; return to oven until cheese is melted. Serves 6.

title: Rice Salad
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar and mayonnaise until smooth. Add rice cherries pineapple and marshmallows and mix well. Fold in whipped cream and pecans.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer each ingredient in a bake-and-take pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown.

title: Lemon Cream Pie
instructions: Beat condensed milk and lemon juice. Beat in Cool Whip. Add crushed pineapple if desired. Pour into baked pie crust or graham cracker crust baked and cooled.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Drain beets. Measure 2/3 cup beet juice sugar vinegar and salt. Heat together to boiling point. Add drained beets. Bring back just to boiling.

title: Crock-Pot Beef Tips
instructions: Chop stew meat into small pieces. Add soups. Cover slow cooker and cook on high for 7 hours. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Broiled Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Cream butter brown sugar and cocoa. Add cream. Stir in nuts. Spread on cake that has cooled for 10 to 15 minutes. Place cake in broiler with top of frosting about 4 inches from source of\theat. Broil about one minute or until frosting bubbles. Watch closely to avoid scorching.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle breasts with salt and pepper and dredge with flour. Heat butter and oil in large skillet. Saute breasts 4 to 6 minutes on each side. Add tomatoes and cook until heated through. Transfer chicken and tomatoes to warm plate. Add tarragon parsley and lemon juice to skilled and deglaze. Pour over each breast. Serves 4. 20 minute preparation.

title: Whipped Cream Cake
instructions: Beat 1 cup whipping cream until soft peaks form. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually add sugar beating well. Combine the flour baking powder and salt; fold into whipping cream mixture. Fold in vanilla.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chips and cheese. Sprinkle chips and cheese on top; bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mash cooked squash (drain off water before mashing). Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased casserole. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Caribbean Black Beans And Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce to a low heat. Cook around 3 hours. When beans are tender add rice and serve. Serves 8.

title: Beefy Bean Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet brown ground beef. Drain excess fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer about 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Presbyterian Potatoes
instructions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add potatoes and mix. Layer potato mixture cheeses and onions as many times as desired. Pour milk and butter over top. Sprinkle additional cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: Mix all in a big pan. Melt 2 pounds of white chocolate candy. Quickly pour over mix; coat evenly. Spread on wax paper. Let cool.

title: Eggnog
instructions: Beat sugar into egg yolks. Add salt stir in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture coats spoon. Cool. Beat egg whites until foamy; gradually add 3 tablespoons sugar beating to soft peaks. Add to custard and mix thoroughly. Chill 3 to 4 hours.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Mix together; chill and roll in walnuts.

title: Crunchy Lemon Chicken
instructions: Mix cereal and peel dip chicken in egg white; coat chicken in crushed Bran Flakes. Arrange in 13 x 9-inch pan which has been sprayed with no fat spray. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. One breast contains 180 cal. and 2 grams fat.

title: Baked Ham And Milk Gravy
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Peel rest of skin from shank end of ham score fat generously and place in large open roasting pan. Pour milk in pan; leave 2 inches to rim empty. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 then lower temperature to 225\u00b0 and bake for 6 to 7 hours basting with milk each hour. When done remove ham to large platter. Place roaster pan on stove burner suck up fat with baster bulb and discard. Prepare flour and water thickening. Turn on heat for pan and with mixer or whisk add the bouillon cubes Kitchen Bouquet and thickening. Continue stirring while gravy comes to a good simmer. Continue to cook for 2 to 3 minutes stir frequently. Lush with biscuits.

title: Cherokee Casserole(Yields 6 Servings)
instructions: Brown meat in oil; add onion and cook until tender. Stir in other ingredients in order given except 3 olives and cheese. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon into serving dish; top with cheese and 3 olives. Broil until cheese is melted.

title: Jubilee Jumbo Cookies(Grancy Says She'S Made A Million And We'Ve Eaten Them All!)
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. Sift next 3 ingredients. Add sifted mixture to creamed mixture alternately with milk vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes until light brown in oven preheated to 375\u00b0. Remove from oven and frost while still hot. (See recipe below.)

title: Favorite Whipped Cream Recipes
instructions: In small mixer bowl combine cream confectioners sugar and vanilla. Beat until stiff. Serve cold. Yields 2 cups.

title: George'S Fried Chicken
instructions: Wash and drain chicken breasts. Crush chips finely. Dip chicken pieces in egg; roll or press potato chips into chicken pieces. Deep fry in oil for 10 to 15 minutes depending on size.

title: Broccoli Rice Bake
instructions: Parboil broccoli and cauliflower. Drain. Layer broccoli cauliflower and canned onion rings. Pour sauce over all.

title: Veal Cutlets Milanese
instructions: Pound cutlets thin and roll in flour. Beat egg yolks slightly and add salt and pepper. Dip floured cutlets in beaten eggs and then roll in bread crumbs. Fry cutlets in oil over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

title: Quick Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix in blender until smooth. Heat and pour over cooked beef or pork or marinate uncooked meat several hours or overnight before cooking.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Whip milk and cream cheese together. Mix Jell-O by package directions. Add pineapple and whipped mixture to Jell-O. Stir well and chill.

title: Breakfast Bake
instructions: Make crust of tater tots in 9 X 13 casserole dish. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 oven. Mash down tater tots to separate. Brown sausage - drain - sprinkle over tater. Beat eggs slightly. Add sour cream and chilies. Pour over sausage. Cover and let set in refrigerator over night. Cover with grated cheese. Bake 350\u00b0 oven (covered) for 30 minutes. Uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Peach Pie(Club Member: Christy Hosey)
instructions: Add ingredients together in a large bowl. Add 1 can drained sliced peaches on top of mixture. Do not mix in peaches. Bake at 300\u00b0.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Put garlic and pepper in bottom of hot pint jars. Remove part of steam from okra pods. A part of stem must be left on. Pack okra firmly in jars; add dill seed. Use small pods of okra. Bring vinegar water and salt to boil; simmer for five minutes. Pour over okra and seal jars. Solution makes about 6 pints.

title: All In One Dish
instructions: Brown your hamburger and onion. Drain. Slice up your potatoes and arrange thin layer in 4-quart pan. Spriknle small amount of hamburger mixture then add 1/3 of can of vegetables and tomatoes then start over using your salt and pepper on each layer. Make sure you use the liquids also from the cans. Top with thin layer of potatoes. If liquid does not come to top add little water to top it. Bake at 350\u00b0 until potatoes are soft.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Add 1 cup boiling water to jello and add rest of ingredients. Pour into individual molds or 1 large mold. Garnish with Cool Whip and mandarin orange sections.

title: Breakfast Casserole(Breakfast)
instructions: Butter bottom of 9x13 pan. Layer sausage mushrooms green onions tomatoes and cheese in baking dish. (I use a glass pan.) Beat remaining ingredients and pour over sausage mixture.

title: Norma'S Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Blend all together and pour into shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar flour and salt. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir the mixture until thickened and bubbly. Reduce heat. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove saucepan from heat. Separate egg yolks from whites. Set whites aside for meringue. Beat egg yolks slightly. Gradually stir 1 cup of the hot mixture into yolks. Return egg mixture to saucepan; bring to gentle boil. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Stir in butter or margarine and vanilla. Stir in 1 cup coconut. Pour hot mixture into baked pastry shell (9-inch). Cover with meringue. Sprinkle with remaining coconut. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until meringue is golden.

title: German Potato Soup
instructions: Mix potatoes bouillon cubes onions and celery in the boiling water. Cook for 1 hour. When vegetables are done add 2 cans cream of celery soup and the Velveeta cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Stir frequently to prevent sticking.

title: Quick Appetizers
instructions: Wrap a half piece bacon around a water chestnut secure with a wooden toothpick. Place under broiler until bacon is crisp. Enjoy.

title: Red Hot Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients well at room temperature then chill to serve.

title: Mushroom Potatoes(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: In a bowl combine soup milk and onions. Stir in the potatoes. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Quarterback Apple Cake
instructions: Combine cream cheese 1/4 cup sugar and eggs mixing until well blended. Set aside. Combine flour remaining 1 1/2 cups sugar baking soda cinnamon and salt. Add combined oil and eggs mixing just until moistened. Fold in apples and nuts.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large heavy saucepan and saute the onion and garlic. Stir in prepared spinach. Remove to a large mixing bowl. In the same pan melt 3 tablespoons butter; stir in flour and gradually add milk to make a smooth cream sauce. Stir in salt pepper nutmeg and reserved spinach mixture. Beat eggs well and add to the spinach. Stir in cheese. Lay out one sheet of phyllo dough; brush with melted butter and fold to fit bottom of a 9 x 9 x 3 1/2-inch baking pan. Repeat with one more sheet. Pour the spinach mixture over the dough. Prepare phyllo dough as before and cover the top of the spinach tucking in edges. Brush the top with more melted butter. Bake 40 to 45 minutes until browned and puffed. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting into squares. Serves 9.

title: White Chocolate Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate in top of double boiler. Pour over pretzels and peanuts in a large bowl. Put mixture on buttered cookie sheet. When cold break into pieces. Line cookie sheet with buttered wax paper.

title: Lunch Punch(Meal In A Glass)
instructions: Liquify in blender for 3 minutes. Add ice to chill this drink tastes a little like strawberries.

title: Crescent Garlic Toast
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 8 triangles and put them on an ungreased cookie sheet. Generously brush each triangle with salad dressing. In a small bowl combine Parmesan with basil. Sprinkle over each triangle. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Party Pork
instructions: Mix and shake the pork with flour salt and pepper and brown in oil. Add remaining ingredients; simmer covered for 30 minutes. Add 1 small can mushrooms. Serve over 4 cups of cooked rice. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Pomander Punch(Serves 12)
instructions: Press whole cloves into oranges covering entire skin. Place oranges in punch bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and chill several hours.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Put the fruits through a food chopper using coarse blade. Add sugar and nut meats mix well and chill.

title: Ricotta Marble Cake
instructions: Make cake mix according to directions. Put in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Caramel Cake
instructions: Combine sour cream and milk; set mixture aside. Cream 1 cup butter; gradually add 2 cups sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream mixture beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Stir in flavorings. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool on wire racks. Spread Caramel Frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake. If desired garnish with pecan halves and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Yields one 2-layer cake.

title: Slivered Almond Crust* * * * *
instructions: This entree takes a long time but can be frozen. It is another one men like. We must have been living in Arizona sometime around the seventies when it appeared in Bon Apetit or Gourmet magazines.

title: Rice Salad(Perfect For Picnics)
instructions: Chop or cut up small the first 6 ingredients. Cook rice (enough for 6 servings or 1 cup) in chicken broth. Mix artichoke juice with mayonnaise and curry powder. Mix well and chill.

title: Diabetic Spiced Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Arrange sweet potatoes in nonstick casserole dish. Combine sugar substitute salt and spices; sprinkle over sweet potatoes. Dot with margarine and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Whip
instructions: Cook rhubarb sugar and water until rhubarb is tender. Then sprinkle on dry strawberry Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Let chill until whipping stage. Prepare Dream Whip. Whip rhubarb mixture fold in Dream Whip. Let chill. I cheat and use thawed Cool Whip. Can be frozen.

title: Scrapple
instructions: In saucepan break sausage in small pieces. Add 4 cups water stirring to separate meat. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes. Drain meat reserving 3 cups of stock. Add salt and sage to stock; bring to boiling. Combine corn meal and 1 cup cold water; gradually stir into stock. Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Add sausage; pour into loaf pan. Cool; chill overnight. Slice fry and serve as for fried corn meal mush. Makes 9 servings.

title: Easy 7 Up Cake
instructions: Mix together the dry cake mix eggs oil and dry pudding mix. Add in 7 up and beat 4 minutes with and electric mixer. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 pan and bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Other beans such as pinto navy etc. could be substituted.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Place rice in oven-proof casserole. Add the 2 soups plus 1 soup can of water. Mix in the butter chopped onion and oregano. Mix well. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour. Stir several times during baking. Good with chicken.

title: Quick 'N Easy Snack Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. In a large mixer bowl blend cake mix eggs water and oil at low speed until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at high speed. Pour into pan. Sprinkle nuts and chocolate pieces over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar butter and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients and mix well. Make dough into balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Press with a fork dipped in sugar. Nuts can be added if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sunday Morning Brunch
instructions: Mix mushrooms eggs salt 1 cup milk mustard and mushroom soup (which has been mixed with 2/3 cup milk). Layer bread sausage cheese and egg mixture in 9 x 12-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Whipped Icing
instructions: Cook milk and flour until thick; cool. Beat margarine Crisco and sugar for 4 minutes (scraping bowl often). Add cooled thickened mixture. Beat 4 more minutes. Add vanilla and beat 1 more minute.

title: Tequila Sunrise Surprise
instructions: Combine grapefruit juice tequila and lemon juice. Chill. To serve pour half of the mixture over ice in a large punch bowl. Slowly pour in 1 can ginger ale and stir gently to mix. Repeat with the remaining punch ingredients when needed. Makes 24 to 30 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Ham Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Spry Pan Coat
instructions: Does anyone remember Spry? Well its the same as Crisco. Mix Crisco with flour to form a smooth mixture. Keep in covered dish on pantry shelf. It will stay sweet and fresh. Use for greasing cake pans muffin tins cookie sheets etc. This is great. I got this from Aunt Jenny Spry cookbook.

title: Crescent Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in sugar shortening eggs potatoes and 4 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle.

title: Megan'S Marvelous Fudge
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until blended (use wooden spoon). Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and continue boiling for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate pieces and vanilla until chocolate is melted. Pour into 2 buttered 9 x 9-inch pans and let cool. Cut into squares.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat together eggs oil vanilla salt flour cinnamon powder and soda. Mix well. Add 2 cans mashed carrots and walnuts. Stir thoroughly. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Note A few shakes of Mrs. Dash seasoning is very good.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken. Heat in saucepan until sugar is dissolved.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water. Add pineapple and blueberries including juice. Mix and let jell. Stir once or twice. Use the average size Pyrex dish.

title: Microwave Chicken Soup
instructions: Place mushrooms celery carrot and margarine in 1 quart casserole. Cover tightly and microwave on High (100%) until vegetables are tender 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Cut chicken breast half into 1/4-inch strips. Stir chicken and remaining ingredients into vegetable mixture. Cover tightly and microwave until boiling 5 to 6 minutes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: In a greased casserole dish layer potatoes layer onions and layer corned beef; repeat layers then pour can of undiluted soup over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Hot Cider
instructions: Put all spices in a cloth. Combine all ingredients (including cloth bag of spices). Let simmer. Serve with 1/2 peppermint stick in each cup. Will keep in refrigerator. Just reheat and serve when wanted. (Good for colds and flu.)

title: Chicken Breasts And Stuffing
instructions: Boil chicken. Throw away skin and bones. Break up meat. Mix stuffing mix with seasoning packet and 2 cups chicken broth from boiled chicken pot. Add 1/2 can of soup plus eggs. Mix well. Put in greased baking dish. Combine chicken meat and other 1/2 can of soup plus 1/2 cup milk and spread over stuffing mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Bacon Quiche
instructions: Make pie shell. Spread butter over inside of shell. Refrigerate until ready for use. Fry bacon; crumble. Shred cheese. Mix the remaining ingredients with rotary beater until blended. Sprinkle crumbled bacon and shredded cheese on bottom of unbaked pie shell. Slowly pour in cream mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes until inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Million Dollar Pies
instructions: Mix together and pour into crusts. Chill until well set and keep refrigerated.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs. Pour in buttered casserole dish. Top with crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Crunchy Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain fat. Cook macaroni. Mix all ingredients together (except French fried onions) and put in large pan. Top with onions. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is crunchy.

title: B.B.Q. Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer uncovered 10 minutes.

title: Polish Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Core and blanch cabbage. Separate leaves and drain. Cook rice as usual. Fry onion. Combine rice onion meat egg salt and pepper. Wrap portions of meat mixture in individual cabbage leaves. Layer sauerkraut on bottom of roaster and between rolls.

title: Italian Anise Cookies
instructions: Beat together margarine sugar and eggs. Add all remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until set.

title: Pasta With Scallops And Lemon Mustard Butter Sauce
instructions: Bring wine and lemon peel to simmer in heavy medium skillet. Add scallops and cook until almost opaque about 1 minute. Transfer scallops to bowl using slotted spoon. Increase heat and boil until wine is reduced to 1/4 cup about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Whisk in mustard then 1/4 cup butter 1 piece at a time. Add scallops and any juices and heat through. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper.

title: Surprise Spicy Refresher
instructions: Combine sugar 1 cup apple juice and spices in saucepan. Boil 3 minutes. Let cool. Combine all ingredients. To serve hot place in glass coffee maker pot. To serve cold pour over ice in punch bowl. Yields 4 quarts.

title: Lemon-Catfish Parmesan
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Dip catfish in oil. Roll in stuffing/spice mixture. Arrange on greased baking dish. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Garnish with lemon slices if desired. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and pour sugar over them. Mix Jell-O and water until Jell-O is dissolved. Refrigerate until slightly set. Add cranberries pecans and pineapple. Put into a mold and refrigerate until firmly set.

title: Heavenly Salad
instructions: Do not mix Jell-O with water.

title: Soft Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas and mix all ingredients with mixer until smooth. Grease a bread pan and pour in the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot Dog Casserole
instructions: Cut up hot dogs in small pieces. Add onions in oleo and simmer. Drain beans put in all ingredients. Cook and drain noodles and add to other ingredients. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in 1/4 cup butter in skillet until tender and golden. Cook broccoli using package directions; drain well. Combine sauteed onion broccoli soup rice Cheez Whiz and milk in bowl; mix well. Spoon into greased 2-quart casserole. Toss crumbs with melted butter in small bowl; sprinkle over broccoli mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown on top.

title: Apricot Cranberry Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender. Pour equally into 2 loaf pans and bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and chopped apples. Mix thoroughly. Sift together the flour and baking powder; add to mixture. Mix in vanilla. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool slightly. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Primavera
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients and simmer slowly 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile cook and drain pasta. Serve with salad and French bread.

title: Chicken Booyah
instructions: Place in kettle chicken salt and water and cook until chicken is tender. While chicken is cooking prepare potatoes carrots celery onion and cabbage. When chicken is tender remove from liquid to cool. Place prepared vegetables in broth and cook until tender. Add the following and cook until tender tomatoes Minute rice parsley noodles pepper and seasoned salt. Remove chicken from bones and cut into pieces. Add chicken to soup. Soup may be thinned with water if necessary. Season with salt and pepper to taste when eating.

title: Chili Stew
instructions: Brown meat with onion garlic and bell pepper. Add tomatoes to meat with juice. Add remaining ingredients and seasonings. Simmer covered for 5 hours.

title: Lemon Supreme Cake
