instructions: Combine all ingredients. Beat two minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes in greased and floured tube pan. While cooling cake mix the glaze. Pour over cake.

title: Smoked Sausage Rice Skillet
instructions: Saute carrots and zucchini in margarine in 10-inch skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes. Add tomatoes with juice mushrooms water basil thyme and sausage. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer 6 minutes. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat and let stand for 8 minutes stirring after 4 minutes. Makes 5 servings.

title: Sandwiches
instructions: Mix together. Put on bun; wrap in foil. Put in oven at 375\u00b0; if frozen for 1/2 hour.

title: Pineapple Coconut Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening with white and brown sugar. Add crushed pineapple. Add beaten eggs. Sift flour with soda and salt. Add flour and vanilla. Mix well. Add nuts and coconut. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Quickie
instructions: Tear cake into small bite size pieces. Mix pudding according to directions. Add sour cream to pudding and spread over angel\tfood cake. Add pie filling on top. Add Cool Whip last. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Quick Pork And Potato Bake
instructions: Place pork chops in oblong cake pan; salt and pepper lightly. Spoon soup over chops. Grate cheese over lightly. Sprinkle with chopped onion. Place Tater Tots over chops until chops are covered. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Turn down to 200\u00b0 and bake 15 more minutes.

title: Upside-Down Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain well. Add ketchup and chili powder mixing well. Place ground beef mixture in casserole dish making a well in center. Put drained corn in well. Mix corn bread according to package directions then pour over top of casserole. Bake according to corn bread mix directions.

title: Mex-Veg Pasta
instructions: Note Wear gloves or wash hands well after handling the chilies. They can burn your skin.

title: Apple-Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a greased deep dish (at least 3-inches deep). Mix other ingredients (except margarine) in a bowl. Spread over first layer in dish. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered then uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Cookie Press Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and almond extract. Blend dry ingredients together then gradually add to wet mixture. Mix thoroughly. Divide dough into thirds and color one part red one part green and leave other part white. Fill cookie press and press out cookies. Decorate with colored sugar colored balls etc. before baking. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Great at Christmas or any time.

title: Chopstick Chicken
instructions: Combine soups rice and water in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place chicken pieces on top. Brush with melted butter. Cover with foil. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake 30 minutes longer or until chicken is tender. Serves 4.

title: Bread & Butter Pickles
instructions: Take the sliced Cucumbers Onions and Salt and soak for 4 hours in water. Drain. Prepare the Vinegar Sugar Ground Cloves Turmeric Celery Seed and Mustard Seed. Heat the solution place Cucumbers and Onions in it bring to a boil. Turn heat to simmer for about 20-30 minutes; they will lose their green look. Pack hot in jars and seal. Boil flats a few minutes before serving. Makes 7-8 pints.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients together in saucepan. Cook 20 minutes. Add 1 box brown sugar and 1 cup bacon fat or salad oil. Cook 10 minutes.

title: Creamed Cabbage
instructions: Chop cabbage and cook in boiling salted water until tender. Drain well and place in buttered casserole dish. Melt butter in small pan and stir in flour and salt until smooth. Add milk gradually and allow mixture to thicken. Add cheese and cook until melted and mixed well. Pour cheese mixture over cabbage and top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until crumbs are lightly browned.

title: Impossible Beef Enchilada Pie
instructions: Grease a 2 x 13-inch casserole thoroughly. Cook beef in skillet until brown. Add onion and garlic and cook until limp. Add half of the taco sauce and seasonings. Cover bottom of casserole with crumbs. Spread 1/2 cup of shredded cheese over this. Pour meat mixture over cheese. Beat eggs adding milk and Bisquick and mix thoroughly. Pour carefully over meat mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and spread on the rest of taco sauce and remainder of cheese. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts. Let stand a few minutes then cut into squares. Serves 6 to 8 generously.

title: Mama'S Hermit Cake
instructions: Cream margarine with sugar until creamy. Add eggs one at a time; add lemon juice almond and vanilla flavoring. In a separate bowl use 3/4 cup plain flour to coat cherries dates and pecans. Set aside. In separate bowl combine flour baking powder soda and cinnamon. Add flour a little at a time to sugar-egg mixture using all of 4 1/4 cups. Add prepared fruit a little at a time until mixed well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours or until brown and tests done. Glaze while still hot and in pan.

title: Tiger Butter
instructions: Combine white chocolate and peanut butter in top of a double boiler or put in microwave 2 minutes. Stir if not melted put in 1 minute stirring constantly until melted. Spread onto a waxed paper lined 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly pan. Pour melted semi-sweet chocolate over peanut butter mixture and swirl through with a knife.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
instructions: Heat apple juice with cornstarch in a saucepan stirring constantly. Stir in next 3 ingredients. Pour over apples in bowl mixing carefully. Spoon into pastry-lined pie plate. Cover with remaining pastry. Brush with melted butter. Bake in a moderate oven until golden brown.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Mix well the dry cottage cheese; add peaches and Cool Whip. Mix well and chill.

title: Classis Pecan Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir eggs corn syrup sugar margarine and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Easter Bread Ring With Colored Eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease a baking sheet. In large bowl sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cut in butter. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add orange juice sugar and vanilla. Mix dough until soft and manageable. (Use hands dipped in flour if sticky.) Knead for 10 minutes. Place in bowl; cover and let stand for 1/2 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Pour into an uncooked pie crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes until done.

title: Spicy Mexican Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken debone and cut in small pieces. Place Doritos in a 9 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch baking dish. Mix ingredients together with part of cheese. Pour onto Doritos; cover with rest of cheese. Can use more cheese if you like. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes. Very good covered dish meal.

title: Jello Pie
instructions: Bring sugar eggs and juice to a boil. Stir in jello Cool Whip and chilled Pet milk. Mix with cooled jello mixture. Pour into pie pans lined with vanilla wafers. Makes 2 pies. Chill and then serve.

title: Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion in cooking oil with bell pepper in electric frypan or large skillet. Drain oil; add tomato sauce and water to the ground beef onion and bell pepper; season with salt pepper chili powder garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce. Stir constantly with wooden spoon to prevent sticking. Add elbow macaroni to mixture directly from package (uncooked) and continue stirring. Add more water as needed to prevent dryness. Macaroni will absorb the water and make the sauce as it cooks. (Spaghetti may be substituted for macaroni.) Cook slowly until macaroni is tender 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place chicken in bottom of casserole dish. Mix soup and broth together; spread over chicken. Pour peas and carrots over this. Mix remaining ingredients together. Pour over chicken mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Special Drink
instructions: Mash strawberries and sugar together. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill. Serve over ice. Makes 8 ounce glasses.

title: Chili Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Mix meat mixture with corn beans and chili powder in a skillet. Simmer 15 minutes. Pour into a casserole dish. Top with corn chips then cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until the cheese melts.

title: Dutch Oven Omelet For Branding Crew
instructions: Place 2 tablespoons oil in Dutch oven.\tDice onions and mushrooms; add to the oven. Chop bacon; add to Dutch oven and cook until bacon\tis crisp. Drain. Beat eggs water and seasonings. Add drained chilies; pour over mixture in Dutch oven. Place on prepared\tcoals until eggs are set. Stir 2 times then add grated cheese over eggs. Put on preheated lid; cook over coals just until cheese has melted. Cut into wedges; serve with salsa.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix everything except stuffing then when stuffing is done spread on top of mixture and bake at 375\u00b0 uncovered for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in 1-quart saucepan. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.

title: One Pan Pork Chops
instructions: In frypan brown pork chops on both sides. Slice all vegetables and put them in layers on top of pork chops. Make sauce of Worcestershire sauce ketchup and water; pour over chops and vegetables. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and roll into 1-inch balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes approximately 80 balls.

title: Zucchini Puffs
instructions: Grate cheese in a blender if available or chop finely. Remove stem ends from zucchini and shred finely. Press out as much moisture as possible from zucchini using paper towels. Combine with onion crumbs salt pepper parsley and eggs. Put 1 teaspoon oil in each of twelve muffin cups. Heat at 375\u00b0 for 3 or 4 minutes. Carefully spoon batter into sizzling oil. Bake 20 minutes. Makes 12 puffs.

title: Peach Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Cover the bottom of an oblong cake pan generously with butter or margarine. Then sprinkle with a thin layer of brown sugar. Next put 4 cups of peach slices on top of that. Fix up a box of white cake mix and pour over the top of the peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and sprinkle with cumin. Mix all ingredients together.

title: Bavarian Salad
instructions: Melt Jell-O and marshmallows in hot water. Chill until thickened. Add other ingredients. Mix well and chill.

title: Jalapeno Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut jalapenos lengthwise into halves; discard seeds. Chop finely. Combine baking mix milk and Cheddar cheese in a bowl; mix well. Add jalapenos and 1/4 cup butter. Beat with an electric mixer set at high speed for 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls 2-inches apart onto 2 ungreased baking sheets. Bake until golden brown about 10 minutes. Brush with remaining butter. Serve immediately. Makes 20 biscuits.

title: Congealed Cranberry Salad
instructions: Prepare Jell-O as usual with 2 cups of hot water. Mix well. Add 2 cups cold cola. Let stand until almost jelled. Add remaining ingredients. (Sugar is added to sweeten cranberries.)

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix eggs oil and sugar. Blend the rest of the ingredients except zucchini and nuts. After blended add the zucchini and nuts. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Pork Chow Mein
instructions: Cut pork into 4 x 1/2 x 1/4-inch strips. Place in a bowl. Add garlic and 2 tablespoons soy sauce. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours. Meanwhile combine broth cornstarch ginger and remaining soy sauce; mix well and set aside.

title: Aunt Flossie'S Unbelievable Jelly
instructions: Bring beet juice lemon juice and Sure-Jell to a boil. Add sugar and jello. Stir until dissolved and boil 15 minutes stirring constantly. Test to thickness wanted then skim and add Kool-Aid. Stir to dissolve. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal.

title: Turkey Chili
instructions: Over medium heat in a large skillet heat oil. Add turkey and onions cook and stir about 4 to 5 minutes or until turkey is no\tlonger\tpink. Stir in garlic chili powder paprika cumin salt pepper and tomatoes cover.\tOver high heat bring to\ta boil; reduce heat and simmer for one hour. Add beans cook until heated through. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hot Tortilla Casserole
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch dish spray Pam. Crunch chips and cover bottom of dish. Open tamales. Save some juice. Lay tamales in dish; sprinkle cheese and add Texas Pete. In separate bowl mix chilli and refried beans with one bottle of Tennessee Sunshine. After mixed add juice of tamales. Stir well. Spread chili mixture over tamales. Cover well. Add another layer of crushed chips. Spread remaining cheese. Add last bottle of Tennessee Sunshine. Preheat oven at 375\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes or until it bubbles at and around the sides.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: In mixer cream butter and sugar; add flour. Add eggs one at a time; beat until lemon colored. Add lemon juice. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Rich! Serve in small pieces.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain and mix in butter Parmesan cheese and eggs. Form in crust in 9 x 9-inch dish. Brown beef onions and pepper. Mix in tomatoes tomato paste sugar oregano and garlic salt. Spread cottage cheese in crust. Add meat mixture. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake 5 minutes.

title: Pierre Franey'S Chicken Breasts With Balsamic Vinegar
instructions: Sprinkle cutlets with salt and pepper. Rinse mushrooms drain and pat dry. Season flour with salt and pepper. Dredge cutlets in the mixture. Shake off excess. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat and cook cutlets until brown on one side. Add garlic cloves. Turn chicken pieces scatter mushrooms over them and continue cooking. Cook 3 minutes and add balsamic vinegar broth bay leaf and thyme. Cover and cook for 10 minutes over medium-low heat. Turn pieces occasionally. Discard bay leaf. Serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Cook all ingredients over medium heat 4 to 5 minutes stirring vigorously until mixture forms a ball. Remove dough from pan; let stand on counter 5 minutes. Knead dough about 30 seconds or until blended. Store in airtight container.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cups(Mock)
instructions: Put 1 cup chocolate chips in double boiler. Melt. Dab chocolate on sides and bottoms of teeny tiny paper cups (cupcake). Add peanut butter then melted chips on top.

title: Coquille St. Jacques
instructions: Note Power level High Medium and Medium-high 17 to 22 minutes total.

title: Sweet Noodle Pudding(Ethnic Dish)
instructions: Combine and beat in mixer all the ingredients other than the noodles. Then add the boiled noodles (drained) and mix well. Place in greased rectangle baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3/4 hour or until golden brown.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onions in butter add meat and cook about 10 minutes. Add soup sour cream and seasoning. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Garbage Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. While this is melting mix first 4 ingredients together in a large bowl. When chocolate is ready pour over cereal mixture and mix well. Put on cookie sheets. Press down and refrigerate for a few hours until hardened. Break into pieces.

title: Baked Fish Fillets
instructions: Dip fish in salted milk then in bread crumbs. Place fish in well-greased baking pan. Dot over with small pieces of butter.

title: Rice Frittata(Casserole)
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni mix as package directs. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Tuna Noodle Supreme
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook pasta and drain. Stir together sour cream mayonnaise Parmesan cheese milk and mustard. Salt and pepper to taste. Add hot pasta tuna broccoli red peppers and green onion. Stir until evenly blended. Place tuna mixture in 2-quart baking dish. Cover. Bake 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding With Raisins
instructions: Mix 1/2 milk and the 1/2 cup of water. Heat slowly until hot. Add rice sugar and salt. Mix thoroughly. Cook over a low fire for 2 hours stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Add remainder of milk raisins nutmeg and vanilla. Pour in a greased baking pan and bake for another hour in moderate oven at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 12.

title: Uncle George'S Clam Fritters
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder. Combine all ingredients. Drop by teaspoon into deep fat. Fry until golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Nougatines
instructions: Combine sugar syrup honey and water. Stir occasionally. Boil to hard ball stage (265\u00b0 to 270\u00b0). Add salt to eggs. Beat until stiff. Gradually pour on half of the syrup beating constantly with the eggbeater or a spoon. Boil remaining syrup to hard crack stage (285\u00b0 to 290\u00b0). Pour gradually onto egg mixture beating constantly. Place over heat on asbestos mat. Beat until thick. Add flavoring and nuts. Pour into well buttered shallow pans. When cool cut in squares. Coat these with melted chocolate.

title: Chunky Italian Soup
instructions: Cook beef and onion; drain. Stir in tomatoes and next 7 ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer stirring occasionally about 30 minutes. Add next 3 ingredients and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in pasta. Pour into soup bowls and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese for each serving.

title: Quaker Chocolate Oats Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add combined flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats chocolate morsels and nuts. Mix well.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans. Place in flat dish. Mix water and soup. Spread over beans. Sprinkle on cheese. Cook 30 minutes. Add onion on top. Cook 5 minutes. Do not burn.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Cream the butter sugar and honey. Beat eggs until frothy. Add milk to eggs. Add this to creamed mixture. Beat thoroughly. Sift together flour baking powder and spices. Add to creamed mixture. Add chopped figs and raisins. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven in tube pan for 30 minutes. Cool ice and serve.

title: Asparagus Rolls
instructions: Put mixture on bread and roll. Melt 1/2 pound butter. Brush on rolls and freeze. Cut off edges of bread with electric knife. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until brown.

title: Sausage And Cheese Dip
instructions: Fry sausage. Mash up as for chili. Drain all grease from sausage. Pat with paper towels. In a crock-pot add grated cheese soup 3/4 can of water and sausage. Cook approximately 2 hours or until cheese has melted. I put my cheese and soup mix in the microwave and melt the cheese (5 to 10 minutes) then add the sausage and it is ready. Serve warm with chips.

title: Nutty Yam Bake
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water until tender. Mash sweet potatoes while hot. Add sugar butter cinnamon and nutmeg; mix well. Beat in milk and eggs and whip with electric mixer. Put into greased 3-quart casserole dish.

title: Black Olive Dip
instructions: Mix all items in bowl and bake for 15 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serve hot with crackers. (May also be microwaved.)

title: Baked Beef With Gravy
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in open baking dish at 350\u00b0 for three hours. Stir occasionally. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix well at medium speed adding nuts last. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: (I use food processor for grating cranberries and oranges.)

title: Spaghetti Broccoli Feast(Microwave Recipe)
instructions: Combine onion mushrooms garlic oil and butter in 4-quart casserole. Cover tightly with Saran Wrap turning back edge to vent. Microcook at 100% for 7 minutes stirring once. Stir in wine mustard salt pepper basil and oregano until well mixed. Add broccoli zucchini and tomatoes. Stir to coat.

title: Lox Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a medium bowl. Serve with mini slices of pumpernickel or bagels.

title: Carrot Souffle
instructions: Steam or boil carrots until very soft. Drain well. Transfer to large mixing bowl. While carrots are warm add sugar baking powder and vanilla. Beat with mixer until smooth. Add flour and mix well. Add whipped eggs and beat well. Add margarine and blend well. Pour mixture into 2 qt. baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until top is a light golden brown. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar before serving. Serves 8 - 10.

title: Chicken Chili Verde
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan pour a little oil to prevent sticking. Spread out one layer of tortillas. Scoop out chicken meat; spread out. Sprinkle with a little bit of water over meat. Spread cheese and a spoon of chilies. Season. Keep making layers as deep as you wish with final layer ending with cheese. Spoon out soup mixed with a 1/2 can of water. Cover and heat at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Cheese Burger Bake
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese according to package directions set aside. In a skillet cook ground beef and onions until meat is browned and onion is tender drain. Combine meat prepared macaroni and cheese mushroom soup and milk. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top and bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Southwest Baked Apples
instructions: Cut off tops of apples and core. Chop the tops of the apples; add walnuts brown sugar and cinnamon. Put this mixture in the cored center of the apples. Place apples in a baking dish filled with 1/2-inch of water. Bake apples in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Serve with heavy cream slightly whipped with sugar and vanilla.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Put 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies in blender and press chop button for about 10 seconds. Combine the Ro-Tel tomatoes cream cheese and salt in mixing bowl; stir in chicken and onion. Heat cooking oil to medium heat in small skillet and fry tortillas one at a time until limp 5 seconds per side and drain. Spoon chicken mixture on each tortilla roll up and place seam down in a 2-quart casserole in one layer. Cover with foil and bake in 305\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Pour on Sour Cream Sauce and top with cheese. Return to oven couple minutes to melt cheese.

title: Graham Cracker Dessert
instructions: Combine crackers sugar and butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt marshmallows in milk and cool. Whip Dream Whip and add to marshmallow mixture. Pour into crust. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs sour cream or yogurt and bananas. Mix well. Stir in flour until moist. Fold in nuts and pour batter into pans. Grease and flour two 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Cut ribs in servings and place in single layer in pan. Bake uncovered 30 to 40 minutes at 300\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix together and store in a tight container. Put 1/4 to 1/3 cup mix in each cup and fill with hot water.

title: Tortilla Chip Dip
instructions: Melt all the ingredients together on medium heat. Serve warm.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Spray or oil 9 x 13 baking pan. Sprinkle with pecans and coconut. Pour prepared cake mix into pan. Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese. Spread over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Top will crack open as it bakes.)

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix cake ingredients together.

title: Broken Glass Salad
instructions: Dissolve each package of Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Pour into shallow pans to jell. Take 1 package Knox gelatine and dissolve in 1/4 cup cold water. Bring 1 cup of pineapple juice to a boil. Add 3 tablespoons of sugar and the plain gelatin. Mix and set aside to cool thoroughly. Crush 24 graham crackers and mix with 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup soft butter. Press 1/2 cracker mix in the bottom of an 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan. Whip 1 pint of whipping cream. Add 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Fold in gelatin pineapple mixture. Cut the strawberry orange and lime Jell-O into squares and add to whipped cream mixture. Sprinkle remaining cracker mixture on top. Chill overnight.

title: E Z Italian Chicken Breasts
instructions: Blend egg and milk with fork; dip meat in milk mixture and then deluge in bread crumbs to which you may want to add salt and/or pepper. After coating chicken refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.

title: Mashed Potatoes And Cream Cheese
instructions: Cook peeled potatoes until tender. Whip potatoes. Add remaining ingredients in order given. Blend well. Pour into baking dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Keeps two weeks in refrigerator.

title: Old-Fashioned Candied Yams
instructions: Peel and cut tomatoes in quarters. Sprinkle with sugar nutmeg and butter. Cover and simmer over medium heat until liquid forms a syrup. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Southwestern Chowder
instructions: Mix all together. Heat in 3-quart pot.

title: Whole Grain Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: In a medium bowl combine flour oat bran cornmeal sugar baking powder soda and salt. Combine buttermilk egg yolks and oil. In a clean large bowl beat egg whites with mixer on high speed until they form stiff peaks. Combine buttermilk mixture with the flour mixture. Fold in egg whites.

title: Tater Crisp Fried Fish
instructions: Rinse fillets under cold water; pat dry. In a shallow dish beat eggs. In another shallow dish combine potato flakes Parmesan and oregano. Dip fish fillets in egg. Coat fish with potato flakes mixture.

title: Marinated Sausage
instructions: Mix first seven ingredients together in a measuring cup; set aside. Slice red onion very thin. Slice sausage at a bias cut. Slice tomatoes thin also. Put ingredients in a marinade container or bowl with an airtight lid and marinate at least 8 hours. Overnight is best. Serve with Ritz or other crackers.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Combine all but cherries and pecans. Mix well. Stir in the last 2 ingredients lightly. Line muffin cups with muffin papers (I prefer foil). Spoon mixture into tins. Cover and freeze 15 minutes before serving. Will make about 16.

title: Very Good Soup
instructions: Boil first 5 ingredients for 20 minutes. Add California Blend vegetables. Boil 10 minutes. Add soup and cheese. Soup is done when cheese has melted.

title: White Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Beat cream cheese (medium speed) until smooth. Gradually add sugar and vanilla beating well. Stir in candy coating and pecans. Spread into a buttered 8-inch square pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into small squares. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add bouillon cubes and Knox gelatine that has been softened in 1/2 cup cold water. Stir until dissolved and cool. Add other ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13 pan and chill. Cut in squares to serve.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Bring margarine brown sugar salt and Karo to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Then add vanilla and soda. Stir well. Pour over popped popcorn; mix well. Peanuts or pecans are optional. Use a large oven pan and grease with butter. Pour popcorn mix in pan; bake at 275\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Place pie filling in pan. Mix remaining ingredients thoroughly. Sprinkle over cherries. Bake 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil vanilla eggs and lemon juice. Add salt flour soda nutmeg and cinnamon to mixture. Fold in apples and pecans. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. When cake is done mix 1 cup brown sugar and enough apple juice to make thin. Pour over cake and let set 1 hour before turning out of pan.

title: Egg And Cheese Bake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given except butter. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour in cheese/egg mixture spreading evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. (Chopped up ham or cooked bacon pieces can be added to this dish also.)

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Combine corn bread mix and sugar in a large bowl. Add eggs milk and oil mixing well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Yields 12 servings.

title: Superior Cornbread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl; stir to blend. Combine eggs melted margarine and milk. Pour over dry ingredients. Stir until all dry ingredients are moist. Pour and scrape into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 18 to 24 servings.

title: My Mother'S Molasses Gingerbread
instructions: Mix all together and beat well. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven in 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream together oleo egg and sugar. Add the rest of the ingredients. Pour in a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Hearty Onion Soup
instructions: Cook onion in oil and butter in pot over medium heat stirring frequently 30 minutes until softened and caramelized. Stir in flour to coat onions. Cook 1 minute. Slowly stir in broth. Cover; cook over low heat 20 minutes. Add sherry if you wish.

title: Chicken Saltimbocca
instructions: Place chicken between sheets of wax paper or plastic wrap. Gently pound until each breast half enlarges to approximately 6 x 5 inches. Discard wrap. Place ham slice and half a cheese slice on each breast. Spoon 1 tablespoon tomato sauce on top; sprinkle on a bit of thyme. Roll up the breasts like jelly rolls; fold in the sides. Melt butter in baking dish. Combine crumbs cheese and parsley on a plate. Dip chicken rolls first in butter then in the crumb mixture. Arrange rolls seam side down in dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave (power level 10) for 7 to 10 minutes turning and rearranging rolls after 5 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes then serve.

title: Yogurt Yumsicles
instructions: Yogurt and orange juice make dandy popsicles. A 2-year-old a bowl and a fork are all the equipment necessary (plus towels for mopping up!). If using whole fruit puree everything in a blender or food processor. Gelatin in the mixture retards melting on a hot day. Soften it in water. Heat slightly to dissolve; blend with yogurt mixture. Pour into molds or small paper cups. Plastic spoons make good handles; stick them in when yogurt is partially frozen.

title: Pineapple Peach Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool; add ginger ale and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly. Cool until partially set. Arrange fruit in a mold. Cover with gelatin mixture. Chill until firm. Serve with fruit salad dressing. If desired 1 cup chopped nuts may be added. See Miscellaneous for Fruit Salad Dressing.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well. Spread half of the mixture into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch Pyrex baking dish. Cover with chilies and cheese. Spread remaining batter over the top. Bake for 30 minutes or until lightly browned at 400\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Creamy Pralines
instructions: Butter a medium saucepan. (This will make clean-up easier.) Pour in cream and place over high heat. When it begins to boil add sugar and stir rapidly until it dissolves. Then stir in vanilla and pecans and continue to cook over medium heat stirring frequently until mixture reaches soft ball stage (236\u00b0 on a candy thermometer). Remove from heat and quickly beat in butter. This helps arrest the cooking process. The candy should lose its glossy color and become very cloudy. Lay out a long strip of waxed paper on a work surface. Moisten it with a damp towel. (Prepare paper while candy cooks to avoid delaying this process.) When candy is ready drop good-sized spoonfuls of it onto the paper stirring occasionally as you go along to keep the pecans well distributed. Remove pralines from the paper before they have cooled completely. Later on it will be hard to remove them without breaking them. Store between layers of waxed paper in tightly sealed container.

title: Beef With Pea Pods
instructions: Put meat in casserole. Sprinkle with salt and flour. Shake until thoroughly coated. Bake at 400\u00b0 uncovered for 20 minutes.

title: Autumn Apple Salad
instructions: In a saucepan combine pineapple and sugar. Bring to boil and boil 3 minutes. Add Jell-O and stir until dissolved. Add cream cheese and stir until mixture is thoroughly combined. Cool. Fold in apples nuts celery and Cool Whip.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Spoon on cookie sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dieter'S Delight
instructions: Mix pudding as per directions on box. Add Cool Whip and cover. Tear cake into small pieces. Cover bottom of bowl. Layer strawberries and pineapple. Spread pudding and Cool Whip. Repeat layers.

title: Dilled Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir in oyster crackers. Stir occasionally. Refrigerate overnight. Store in an airtight container.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Scoop pulp from zucchini halves leaving 1/4-inch thick shells. Cut pulp into 1/4-inch pieces. Mix with remaining ingredients until blended. Spoon about 3 tablespoons into each shell. Arrange spoke fashion on a 10 or 12-inch microwave-safe plate. Cover with vented plastic wrap. Microwave on High 4 to 6 minutes rotating dish 1/2 turn once until shells are almost tender. Let stand 3 minutes or until tender.

title: Chocolate Mint Dessert Spread
instructions: Mix melted chocolate cream cheese creme de menthe and cinnamon. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Divide into 3 balls and roll in nuts. Serve with chocolate cookies.

title: Ranch Beans
instructions: Cook bacon in skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon; drain and crumble. Pour excess fat from skillet reserving 3 tablespoons. Add onions garlic and green peppers; saute until tender. Combine with remaining ingredients. Pour in an 8 or 9-inch aluminum baking pan. Preheat gas grill. Cook with cover down on medium heat for 30 minutes or until sauce is of desired consistency. Stir occasionally. Makes 4 to 6 servings. Can be cooked in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Let cream cheese soften. In a bowl mix together the cream cheese and jar of salsa. Spread into bottom of 9 x 13 baking dish. Mix taco seasoning with drained hamburg. Cool; put on top of cream cheese. Chop up lettuce (fine); put layer on top of hamburg. Put layer of diced tomatoes. Next add shredded cheese. Sprinkle taco seasoning on top. Chill. Serve with Scoops.

title: Kathy'S Fruit Compote
instructions: Drain fruit; use 1 cup of juices and put in saucepan. Add pudding; cook until glaze like. Cool a little then pour over fruit. Put in refrigerator. Prepare in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: French Oven Stew
instructions: Combine beef onion celery and carrots in a 2 1/2-quart casserole. (I use my crock-pot.) Combine tomato juice tapioca sugar salt and pepper. Pour over meat and vegetables. Cover and bake in preheated oven (300\u00b0) about 2 1/2 hours. Add potatoes and cook 1 hour longer. Stir occasionally. (I put in crock-pot about noon and its ready around 5 or 6 p.m.)

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Stir together flour baking powder and salt. Set aside. In large mixing bowl beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs. Beat well. Stir in milk and vanilla. Add flour mixture. Mix well. Stir in nuts dates and chopped cherries. Shape level measuring tablespoonfuls of dough into balls. Roll in crushed corn flakes. Place on greased baking sheets. Top each with cherry quarter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Poulet Del Monico De Jean(Chicken Del Monico By Gene)
instructions: Butterfly thin and pound out meat. Layer ham cream cheese and spice mix. Add 1 thin pat of butter. Roll meat to enclose ingredients. Seal on all sides. Toothpick if necessary or tie with string. Place into walled casserole dish or pan. Drizzle wine 1/2 stick melted butter and lemon juice over chicken rolls. Cover with other cheese and 1 more thin slice of ham. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Broil to brown cheese on top. Garnish with lemon slices and sprinkle paprika on top.

title: Soft Buttermilk Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beat well. Mix soda in milk and add alternately with flour which has been sifted with baking powder and salt. Beat well and add vanilla. Drop 1 teaspoon of dough at a time in a bowl of flour. Shake off excess flour and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Crock-Pot Italian Chicken
instructions: Season chicken breasts to taste with salt and pepper. Place in crock-pot on low heat with soup dressing mix and basil. Cook approximately 6 hours. When fully cooked add mushrooms and sour cream. Serve over fettucine noodles which have been lightly sprinkled with Parmesan cheese. Julienned fresh carrots broccoli celery etc. may also be added to crock-pot with the chicken halfway through cooking process. Dinner cooks itself while you work!

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain liquid from beans. Rinse kidney beans. Mix all together.

title: Mrs. Fields' Blue Ribbon Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine the flour soda and salt. Mix well with a wire whisk. Set aside. In a large bowl with an electric mixer blend the sugars at medium speed. Add the butter and mix to form a grainy paste scraping down the sides of the bowl. Add the eggs and vanilla extract and mix at medium speed until light and fluffy. Add the flour mixture and the chocolate chips and blend at low speed until just mixed. Do not overmix. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake for 22 to 24 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer cookies immediately to a cool surface with a spatula. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Refrigerator Pie Crust
instructions: Sift flour and salt. Add shortening and mix well. Add beaten egg water and vinegar. Form in round dough and chill in wax paper a little before rolling out. (Keeps in refrigerator at least 1 week.) Makes crust for 2 pies.

title: Cheesy Ham Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and croutons. Spoon into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and croutons. Bake for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pink Punch
instructions: Add boiling water to Jell-O and sugar. Stir until dissolved. Add cold water and juices. Add ginger ale just before serving. Garnish punch bowl with slices of lemon and orange. Place a bunch of plastic flowers in center of each slice and let float on top of punch.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Drain liquid from oranges and pineapple. Place cottage cheese in a large bowl and sprinkle dry Jell-O on top. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for a few hours before serving.

title: Date Nut Bread(Original Recipe)
instructions: Grease 1 loaf pan and preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix nuts dates soda and salt. Add water then oil. Mix well and let stand 20 minutes. Mix egg and vanilla separately then add to nut mixture; mix well. Mix flour and sugar together. Add gradually to nut mixture mixing thoroughly. Pour mixture into loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches) and bake for 1 hour and 5 minutes in oven. Test with toothpick to test doneness. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Wrap in foil immediately. Can be frozen.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl cream the sugar shortening eggs and vanilla. Combine flour baking soda cloves and cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in bananas oats and chocolate chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonful on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Immediately remove cookies to wire racks to cool. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat butter sugar eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Stir together flour cocoa baking soda and salt. Add to butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or just until set. Cool completely. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Potato Soup Surprise
instructions: Boil potatoes. Drain almost all of water. Add wieners green beans milk and evaporated milk. Let simmer 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Crumble 3/4 box crackers; moisten with butter. Cover bottom of dish with cracker mix. Heat mixture of cream of chicken soup chicken broth cream of mushroom soup and sour cream to simmering point. Add chicken then pour chicken and sauce in dish with cracker mix. Sprinkle top with remainder of cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until sauce bubbles.

title: Easy Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix salad dressing eggs water and cinnamon. Mix at medium speed on electric mixer. Stir in carrots and nuts and pour into greased pan. Cool. Spread icing and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Chicken In An Hour Ten
instructions: Peel and cut carrots. Put in 1 1/4 cups water (in a Dutch oven start cooking on low). Peel potatoes and cut in chunks; add to carrots. Sprinkle all celery salt chicken bouillon salt and pepper over \veggies\. Add chicken breasts (skinless); cook on high for 15 minutes; stir every once in a while. Cook until done.

title: Fresh Georgia Peach Pie
instructions: Dilute orange juice with 2 cups water. Add sugar and cornstarch. Cook until thickened and bubbling. Add almond flavoring. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Slice fresh peeled peaches into prebaked pie shell. Cover with filling and let stand for about 1 hour. Cover with whipped cream and serve. Garnish top with sliced peaches if desired. Serves 5.

title: Fresh Pear Cake And Glaze
instructions: Combine sugar eggs and oil; beat well. Combine flour soda and salt. Add to sugar mixture one cup at a time mixing well after each addition. Stir in vanilla cinnamon and pears. Spoon batter into a well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from pan and allow to cool. Top with glaze.

title: Mint Sandwich
instructions: Melt chocolate wafers in separate double boiler over hot water. Add 1 tablespoon coconut oil to each pot of dark chocolate. Add a few drops of peppermint to green chocolates. Thinly spread 1/2 of dark chocolate on waxed paper on a cookie sheet. Wait until layer is firm then spread pot of green chocolate thinly over the dark chocolate. Wait until green is almost firm then spread remaining dark chocolate over the green. Let candy harden. Cut with sharp knife dipped into hot water and then dried or just break into pieces.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies; set aside. In a bowl beat the cream cheese butter and sugar until smooth. In another bowl mix pudding and milk until well blended. Fold in Cool Whip. Add cream cheese mixture. Alternate layers starting with crumbs pudding and ending with crumbs. Chill overnight.

title: Fish Fillets
instructions: Mix soup and sour cream in casserole dish. Roll fish fillets and put in sauce. Cover and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pecan (Or Peanut) Clusters
instructions: Combine syrup evaporated milk and corn syrup in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until mixture boils and is bubbly all over top. Boil and stir over medium heat 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate chips until completely melted. Stir in pecans (or peanuts). Drop with 2 teaspoons on waxed paper. Chill until set. Makes 24 clusters.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl; stir well. Divide mixture into 6 equal portions; shape each portion into a 1-inch thick patty.

title: Onion Shortcake
instructions: Slice onion into rings and cook slowly in butter until transparent. Combine corn mix egg milk and corn. Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan. Add sour cream salt and 1/2 the cheese to onion. Mix well and spread evenly over corn batter. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Matzo Balls For Soup
instructions: In medium bowl mix all ingredients. (For lighter fluffier matzo balls separate egg yolks from whites; whip whites and fold into mixture.) Place in refrigerator for 15 minutes. Bring water to boil in large pot. Remove mixture from refrigerator. Moisten hands with cold water and form balls using a heaping teaspoonful of mixture. Roll in hands and drop into boiling water. Cover pot tightly and simmer about 40 minutes. Remove matzo balls with slotted spoon. Allow to cool then add to hot chicken broth of your choice. Makes 12 large or 18 small matzo balls.

title: Uncle Ed'S Favorite Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook bacon in a Dutch oven until crisp; remove bacon reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in Dutch oven. Crumble bacon and set aside. Cook carrot and next 3 ingredients in drippings over low heat stirring constantly about 3 minutes or until tender but not browned. Add flour stirring to blend; cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add chicken broth stirring constantly. Bring to a boil over medium heat; reduce heat and simmer about 8 minutes or until thickened. Add cheese stirring until melted. Stir in milk sherry olives and pepper; cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with bacon. Garnish with parsley if desired. Yield 9 cups.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine peanut butter Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Add egg; beat just until blended. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed. Mix just until blended. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Grease 10 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Cream shortening and white sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or longer; use a toothpick to see if it is done.

title: Mulberry Shortcake
instructions: Pour mulberries into greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour honey or sugar over berries. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Combine egg milk oil and honey or brown sugar in mixing bowl; blend well. Fold in flour baking powder and salt adding a small amount of milk if necessary to form very soft dough. Spread dough over berries. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Apple Pie Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a greased 8-inch pie plate. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Boil eggs. Layer lettuce celery onion peas and mayonnaise. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Chop eggs and sprinkle on top. Top with bacon bits. Make this the night before serving. Allow to sit in refrigerator so flavors can mingle together.

title: Turkey Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except turkey. Add turkey mixing well.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain all vegetables. Mix everything together except Ritz crackers. Place mixture in baking dish and top with crushed crackers. Pour melted margarine on top of crackers. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Turkey Treats
instructions: At Thanksgiving students enjoy these edible turkey treats.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly brown onions butter dry mustard allspice and pepper. Pour over beans; add catsup and brown sugar. Mix well. Pour into casserole. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Tropical Fruit Punch
instructions: Dilute frozen fruit juices with ice water and aerate in blender or by pouring from one container to the other several times. Pour into punch bowl add chilled ginger ale and ice.

title: Pineapple Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise mustard cooked chicken celery onion mushrooms peppers and the olives together. Just before serving add the pineapple and mandarin oranges.

title: Caramel Sundae Topping
instructions: Place caramels and the 1/2 cup water or milk in the top of a double boiler. Heat stirring frequently until caramels are melted and the sauce is smooth. Makes 1 cup.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan. Add sugar and milk. Bring to boil; boil for 16 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add marshmallows chocolate chips and squares cut in small pieces. Stir until melted. Add pecans. Beat rapidly for 1 minute. Pour into large well buttered cake pan (17 1/2 x 12-inch). Cool; cut into squares.

title: Peanut Butter Shake
instructions: Blend on low all ingredients except ice. Add ice and blend until smooth. Add a little cocoa for a peanut butter cup shake.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Follow jello directions. In another pan on stove bring can of cherries to a boil. In a separate bowl mix together jello cherries and add 1/2 can of Coke. Chill for 2 hours and serve.

title: Chili Sauce(This Is A Good Cocktail Dip.)
instructions: Grind all ingredients together and serve. Keep in refrigerator. Will last four or five days.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Old Fashioned Baked Apples
instructions: Make shallow cut in skin completely around each apple one inch from the bottom (to keep skin from shrinking during cooking). Place apples in 12 x 7-inch glass baking dish. Place 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1/2 tablespoon butter in center of each apple. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover apples with wax paper. Microwave for 10 to 14 minutes on High or until tender. Let stand covered for 3 minutes before serving.

title: Tapenade
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor or blender. Process or blend briefly. Mixture should be blended but still coarse. Transfer to a bowl and serve with chunks of crusty French bread.

title: Curry Dip
instructions: Blend together and chill.

title: Pumpernickel(Bread Machine)
instructions: Add all ingredients according to your bread machine instructions.

title: Vegetable Pie(Low Fat Vegetarian Dish)
instructions: Spray 10 inch pie pan with Pam. Arrange frozen vegetables in pie pan. Sprinkle onions and peppers on top. Cover with grated cheese. In blender combine remaining ingredients and blend. Pour over frozen vegetables. Bake at 400\u00b0 approximately 35 - 40 minutes or until knife in center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Beat eggs slightly with hand beater or wire whisk in medium bowl. Beat in remaining ingredients. Place pie plate on cookie sheet to prevent spills. Pour filling into pie plate. Bake for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake for about 45 minutes longer or until done. Cool. Refrigerate for about 4 hours or until chilled. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Cream Of Celery Soup
instructions: Simmer for an hour after celery has been cooked until done.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks and sugar until light and fluffy. Melt margarine and chocolate together. Add to egg mixture. Add milk and vanilla. (Must be added in this order.) Pour into unbaked pie shell (deep dish). Bake for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn oven back to 350\u00b0 and bake for 20 minutes. Allow pie to be a little shaky because after it is baked with the meringue on it it will be firm enough.

title: French Bread Pizza
instructions: Spread spaghetti sauce over both halves of bread. Sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Add pepperoni slices and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is hot and bubbly.

title: Black Forest Torte
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spoon batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake as directed. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan and let cool completely on a wire rack. Slice cake horizontally to make 3 layers. Place bottom layer on cake plate. Spread with about 1 cup whipped topping. Top with 1/3 of cherry pie filling. Repeat on 2nd and 3rd layers. Chill.

title: 24 Hour Layered Salad
instructions: Sprinkle layer of onion pepper and celery over lettuce. Spread chestnuts over mixture then spread peas. Drop spoonfuls of mayonnaise over peas and spread best you can. Sprinkle sugar then cheese over salad. Then sprinkle bacon bits over cheese. Seal with saran wrap or cover with lid. Refrigerate over night.

title: Coconut Cream Pies
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt in saucepan. Add milk and egg yolks; mix well. Cook over medium heat until thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 cup coconut and vanilla. Spoon into pie shells. Beat egg whites in mixer bowl until soft peaks form. Add remaining 6 tablespoons sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating until stiff peaks form. Spread over fillings sealing to edges. Sprinkle pies with remaining 1/2 cup coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield 12 servings.

title: Italian Peanut Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Alton'S Specialstilwell, Kansas
instructions: Boil all ingredients except corn starch and water for 5 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes and slice. Put layers of potatoes sliced onion salt pepper half of the soup and half of the cheese in baking dish. Repeat. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. This is excellent with any charcoaled meat. Serves 6.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together pretzels margarine and sugar. Pour into Corning Ware long dish.

title: Sausage And Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Drain and chop sauerkraut. Pat excess moisture from sauerkraut. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place in ungreased shallow baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes about 40 to 50. Serve warm.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar oil and margarine. Then add milk eggs vanilla bananas flour and nuts. Beat with electric mixer for 3 minutes.

title: Crunchy Eggrolls
instructions: Combine everything in a big bowl and mix thoroughly. At end of wrapper spoon 2 tablespoons of mixture then fold 3 sides together to form a rectangle. Roll the wrapper tightly toward pointed end. Seal the end with water. Deep fry on medium heat until golden brown. Serve with sweet and sour sauce.

title: Cornucopias
instructions: Roll salami slices into cornucopias; fasten with a pick. Fill with white cream cheese seasoned with horseradish.

title: Yummy Baked Rice
instructions: Cook rice water and salt for 20 minutes. Saute onions in margarine. Combine all ingredients and place in greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Noodle Chili
instructions: Brown meat. Bring noodles to a boil. Cook until tender. Mix all ingredients together. Cook on stove for about 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix peanut butter softened butter vanilla and confectioners sugar until it is the right consistency to roll in a ball. Dip into melted chocolate discs and cool. Keep refrigerated.

title: Buttermilk Noodles Marzetti
instructions: Cook noodles; drain and set aside. In a skillet saute mushrooms and onion in butter or margarine. In a large bowl combine noodles mushrooms and onion. Toss well. Add salt and pepper. Stir in T. Marzettis fresh buttermilk Ranch dressing. Serve hot or cold. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Fresh Squeezed Lemonade
instructions: Combine sugar and boiling water stirring until sugar dissolves. Add lemon rind lemon juice and cold water. Mix and chill. Serve over ice. Makes 8 cups.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat sugar and margarine. Add eggs; mix well. Add flour cocoa and salt. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until almost set. Serve with whipped cream. Yield 6 servings.

title: Spinach And Cheese Filled Filo
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: Pineapple Nut Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening egg and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Then add pineapple and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Mexican Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Simmer 3 minutes. Ready to eat. Makes 1 jar.

title: Crab Dip #1
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with freshly sliced vegetables crackers and cheese platter.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add liquid and bake in oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Stir frequently.

title: Drumstick Cake
instructions: Crust Mix cookies 3/4 cup peanuts and butter all together and press in a 10 x 13 or 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle 1/2 cup grated sharp cheese over top. Add 1 cup toasted bread crumbs over cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Pizza
instructions: Mix together grated zucchini eggs and Cheddar cheese. With hands form into a pizza pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Add onion to beef and saute in pan until beef is browned. Pour off grease. Add salt and pepper. Stir into meat the sauce and oregano. Spread meat mixture over baked zucchini. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beer Muffins
instructions: Mix well. Pour into greased muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Drain tuna. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Serve with crackers or on bread.

title: Chicken Casserole Chop Chop
instructions: In a large bowl combine soup milk and salt stirring until blended. Fold in chicken beans chop suey vegetables cheese and onion. Turn into 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish (I used 9 x 13-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until beans are tender. Top with French fried onions. Return to oven for 10 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Linguine Salad
instructions: Prepare linguine as directed. Rinse in cool water and drain. Dice vegetables into desired size. Add vegetables dressing and salad seasoning to linguine. Mix well. Great for barbecues and picnics.

title: Twinkie Pie
instructions: Slice Twinkies lengthwise and layer half of them cut side up in a deep bowl. Spread vanilla pudding on top of Twinkies. Pour both boxes of strawberries with juice over pudding. Layer remaining half of Twinkies cut side down over strawberries. Spread Cool Whip over all. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Play Dough To Bake
instructions: Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Paint with poster or acrylic paint.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder salt baking soda cinnamon ginger and nutmeg in a large bowl. Combine carrots oil pineapple eggs and water; stir into dry ingredients mixing until smooth. Stir in walnuts and raisins. Pour into greased an floured 9-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Remove from pan and cool completely. Frost with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream together cream cheese butter and powdered sugar. Beat together French vanilla pudding and milk. Add cream cheese mixture to the pudding mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. In food processor or blender crush Oreo cookies.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding according to pkg. directions. Break cake into small pieces cut fruit into small pieces. In punch bowl make layers of cake fruit pudding and cool whip. Repeat layers until bowl is filled. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in butter; add the remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Let come to a boil and then simmer for several hours.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Place half of pineapple in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover with half of brown sugar and half of cracker crumbs. Dot with half of butter. Layer remaining ingredients and bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve warm. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and pat into bottom of a 10 x 12-inch oblong pan. Bake 8 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Beat the next 3 ingredients well and put on top of pretzel mixture. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Dissolve jello in boiling water and add strawberries. Stir until jello begins to thicken. Pour over cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate 2 hours. Delicious and pretty for company.

title: Chinese Style Green Beans
instructions: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. In a saucepan melt the butter. Stir in the flour until smooth. Add the milk gradually stirring constantly. Cook stirring until thickened. Add the salt and pepper. In the prepared dish layer half of the green beans half of the water chestnuts half of the bean sprouts half of the mushrooms half of the onions half of the cream sauce and half of the cheese. Repeat the layers. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Top with fried onions and bake for 10 more minutes. Serves 6.

title: Polly'S Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into a vanilla wafer or graham cracker crust. Freeze. Set out a few minutes before serving.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Melt a stick of margarine; stir into the crushed Ritz crackers. Place crackers on top of other ingredients. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chinese Chicken (Pork) And Rice
instructions: Cook and stir rice onion and celery in oil over medium heat until rice is golden brown. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling stirring. Reduce heat cover tightly and simmer 12 to 15 minutes. Stir in pepper the last 5 minutes.

title: Kentucky Nut Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Makes 3 small loaves.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
instructions: Blend sugar cinnamon and butter with mashed cooked sweet potatoes. To form balls roll each marshmallow and coat with sweet potatoes mix. Then roll each sweet potato ball in coconut. Put balls in buttered baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes until marshmallows become soft but not melted.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Cook rice and broccoli separately. Mix vegetables rice soups and Cheez Whiz. Pour in baking dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. (May be prepared 2 or 3 days in advance.)

title: Oyster Bisque
instructions: Melt butter; add flour. Then heat milk to just boil. Then add mushroom soup onion salt pepper and Old Bay. Bring oysters to boil in own liquid then add to milk.

title: Wonderful Punch
instructions: Mix Jell-O and sugar in boiling water. Add to 9 cups hot water and let cool. Mix with lemon extract and pineapple juice. Mix well. Freeze for about 1 hour or longer. Before you serve add some ginger ale. Makes 48 quarts of punch.

title: Lo-Cal Taco Pie
instructions: Press rolls into pie pan. Brown turkey; add bouillon onion and pepper. Add tomato paste water and taco seasoning. Mix well. Put 1/2 turkey mix on crust. Sprinkle with 1/2 cheese. Add remaining turkey mix. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 8 servings. Each serving provides 1 bread 2 1/2 meat and 5 optional calories.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Place Ritz crackers in bottom of casserole dish. Empty juice from asparagus. Put asparagus on top of crackers. Pour cheese soup on top of asparagus. Put crushed Ritz on top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until light brown.

title: Fettuccini Mushroom Carbonara
instructions: Saute bacon until crisp; drain reserving drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute mushrooms in reserved bacon drippings until tender; set aside.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil until potatoes are done. Mash with mixer.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Layer chicken dressing green beans chicken dressing and green beans. Pour soup and water over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until heated.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all fruit in large bowl. Mix dry instant pudding and fruit together. Chill and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour in greased casserole. Bake for 1 hour. During the last half hour sprinkle bread on top or Cheddar cheese (grated) on top.

title: Salmon Steaks With Dijon Sauce
instructions: Place salmon steaks on oiled broiler pan; brush both sides with oil. Broil 4 inches from heat 4 to 5 minutes on each side. Meanwhile combine mayonnaise lemon juice mustard chili sauce and dill weed in a small bowl. Spread over salmon for last minute of boiling time. Serve extra sauce with salmon. Makes 4 servings.

title: Potato Latkes
instructions: Grate potatoes and onion. Mix in flour and pinch of salt. Blend together. Beat eggs into mixture. Let stand about 5 minutes. Drop tablespoons of batter into 1/8-inch of hot fat or oil. In a large skillet. Brown on both sides.

title: Marbled Pudding
instructions: Pour milk in small mixing bowl. Add pudding mix. With blender on low speed mix well for 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold whipped topping into pudding for a marbled effect. Put Cool Whip on top for looks if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan lined with waxed paper and grease paper. Separate eggs. Beat egg yolks until thick and creamy. Use electric beater since yolks need long hard beating. Add sugar gradually. Stir in cocoa and extracts. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gently fold or mix into batter. Pour into pan and bake 25 minutes or until cake pulls away from side of pan. Place sheet of foil or clean dish towel on cooling rack and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Invert pan over foil and remove cake. Peel away waxed paper. Roll cake while warm starting with short side. Cover with waxed paper and cool. When cold unroll and spread filling (ice cream) and reroll. Cover with confectioners sugar or whipped cream. Cut into slices. Serves 8.

title: Old-Fashioned Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and butter and roll very fine into a greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Mix jello and hot water and let stand at room temperature. Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla with a fork until soft then mix with jello. Whip evaporated milk until stiff. Mix all together then pour over crust. Let chill for about 2 hours.

title: Cheesecake Tarts
instructions: Line muffin tins with cupcake liners and put a vanilla wafer on bottom. Beat cream cheese vanilla and sugar together. Add eggs beating after each one. Fill lined muffin tins to 1/2 full with mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and then put cherry/blueberry/strawberry pie filling on top. Serves 20 to 24.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Brown meat garlic and onions. Add all other ingredients. Bring to a boil. Place in crock-pot. Cook 12 to 16 hours on low.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple including juices. Sprinkle pudding mix over the pineapple. Let sit for a few minutes. Gently mix in the coconut and pecans. Blend in the Cool Whip and marshmallows. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to let flavors blend. Then serve.

title: Never Fail Roast Beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Put beef in pan uncovered. Roast beef for 1 hour at 400\u00b0. Turn oven off. Let roast remain in oven for 1 hour. Do not open oven. Always perfect!!!

title: Granny'S Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix butter sugar 4 egg yolks and 2 whole eggs and vanilla. Add flour and milk. Cook 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 in floured pans.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Unroll crescent dough and separate at rectangle markings. Spoon pie filling equally on the dough. Fold and press to seal. Place in 9 x 11 x 2-inch cake pan. Mix hot apple juice or water with sugar and lemon juice. Pour into pan around dumplings. Bake in moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. If not browned use broiler to brown. Serve warm with remaining syrup or maple syrup.

title: Chocolate Banana Cake
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan over medium heat melt the chocolate and butter together. Remove from heat and mix in sugar bananas vanilla and eggs. Measure the flour in a 2-cup measuring cup and thoroughly mix in the baking soda. With a whisk mix into the saucepan until thoroughly combined. Pour into a greased floured 8-inch layer pan and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes until a tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Butterscotch Bars
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Grease pans. Cook at 375\u00b0 in cake pan for 15 to 20 minutes. When sinks down it is done. Use 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan and 1 (8 x 8-inch) pan. Makes a large recipe. Cut while warm.

title: Striped Delight
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients. Press into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix together the next 3 ingredients until smooth. Prepare pudding using 3 1/2 cups milk. Mix with cream cheese mixture. Pour over crust. Chill several hours. Before serving top with Cool Whip.

title: Apple Tuna Sandwich
instructions: Combine tuna apple yogurt mustard and honey. Spread 1/2 cup mixture on 3 bread slices. Top each with lettuce leaf with remaining bread. Place on cutting board and cut sandwiches in half.

title: Quick Strawberry Cake
instructions: Cut the angel food cake in half (horizontally). Make a trench in the bottom half and scoop out cake. Fill the trench with strawberries that have been thawed. Take the scooped out cake pieces the remainder of thawed strawberries and a little Cool Whip and mix together in a bowl. Place the top half of the cake back on the cake. Fill hole of cake with strawberry cake pieces and Cool Whip mixture. Ice total cake with remainder of Cool Whip. Decorate with whole strawberries. Very easy very good.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Melt butter. Saute onions and minced garlic. Add wine. Peel and devein shrimp. Layer shrimp in shallow baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve over rice pilaf.

title: Terry'S Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all together and serve with crackers.

title: Apple Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Generously grease 2 loaf pans or 16 muffin pans. Sift dry ingredients together; add oil eggs apples vanilla raisins and pecans to dry ingredients and mix well. Pour into pans. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean about 1 hour for loaf pans and 30 to 45 minutes for muffins. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing. Refrigerate.

title: Marinated Broccoli
instructions: In jar with tight fitting lid combine vinegar sugar dill seed salt pepper and garlic powder. Shake until well blended. Add oil and shake again. Pour over broccoli in large plastic bowl. Toss cover tightly and marinate for 24 hours turning several times. Makes 8 servings.

title: Frosting For Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: While cake cools melt butter and chocolate together over very low heat. Add milk and continue to heat but do not bring to boil. Pour this hot mixture into mixer bowl. Add vanilla then beat in gradually enough powdered sugar to make a smooth spreadable frosting.

title: Homemade Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour milk and oil; roll into size of your desire. Place on greased cookie sheet; bake until golden brown.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix rice (that has been cooked by directions); add chicken and onion. Saute onion before mixing. Add the mayonnaise. Add the cheese to mixture. Put in baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti in chicken broth; drain. Add rest of ingredients; mix well. You may want to add part of the tomato juice to mixture to get the consistency you wish. Heat in oven or microwave until hot.

title: Cool Days Chili
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Brown hamburger and onion. Drain well. Combine all ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Pizza
instructions: Spread dough on large cookie sheet (oil sheet). Put pizza sauce on dough. Put cheese and favorite pizza topping. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until done.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus and save liquid. Sprinkle 1/3 of crumbs in bottom of greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Spread half of asparagus over crumbs. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons asparagus liquid over top. Spread 1/2 of soup over asparagus. Repeat layers ending with crumbs. Dot margarine over top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Tropical Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayo and curry powder. Add chicken and celery. Mix well. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes.

title: Bean Recipe
instructions: Brown ham in about 2 tablespoons oil. Add rest of ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Good with corn bread.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Sprinkle dry Jell-O over Cool Whip; mix. Add pineapple oranges and cottage cheese to Jell-O/Cool Whip mixture. Stir well.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Saute onion. Remove from heat. Stir in flour salt poultry seasoning and pepper. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid. Add water to make 1/2 cup liquid. Gradually stir into flour mixture. Blend in milk until smooth. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat until sauce begins to thicken. Arrange broccoli spears and chicken pieces in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over and top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly around edges.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl mixing well. Refrigerate.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Microwave chicken on Low power for 15 minutes. Remove skin from chicken. Place in baking dish. Season with salt pepper and Accent. Cover with sauce. Bake covered at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Sift together flour spices soda and salt. Mix sugar and oil then add eggs. Mix milk alternately with dry mixture to oil and sugar. Add prunes jam and nuts. Bake in a tube cake pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0. You may frost with Buttermilk Icing.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix apples sugar cinnamon and butter in a glass pie plate. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Slice 1/4 stick of butter on top of cake mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Dad'S Favorite Cookies
instructions: Combine butter and brown sugar and beat well. Add eggs and vanilla and beat again. Combine flour baking powder and soda and salt and add to mixture. After mixing add oats and coconut if desired. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven approximately 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except corn flakes and melted butter. Put in 9 X 12 baking dish. Top with corn flakes and melted butter. Bake at 350 for 45 to 55 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Quick Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Combine margarine cabbage salt and pepper in large skillet. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Add corned beef. Cover; cook for 5 minutes or until meat is thoroughly heated. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
instructions: One half hour before serving combine noodle mixture with cabbage and onions and add dressing.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add well beaten eggs. Cream well together. Sift baking powder and flour twice; add to creamed mixture then add cherries and remaining ingredients. Press into well-greased tube pan and put in cold oven and bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Ham And Cheese Chowder
instructions: Cook potatoes carrots celery onions and 1 teaspoon salt in 2 cups water for 15 minutes. Do not discard water. Make white sauce combining melted margarine flour 1/2 teaspoon salt pepper and milk. Cook on low heat until it thickens. Add to cooked vegetables. Add the diced ham and grated cheese. Do not cook. Keep heat low to prevent scorching.

title: Sheath Cake
instructions: Sift flour and sugar and set aside. Bring to boil in saucepan the margarine shortening cocoa and water. Combine the flour and sugar in the liquid ingredients and stir in buttermilk cinnamon vanilla soda and eggs. Pour into greased 12 x 18-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan with 1/2-inch sides. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Five minutes before done make up icing. Frost cake as soon as taken from oven.

title: Broccoli Souffle
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli; brown onion in margarine and stir in water and flour. Beat eggs in bowl; add broccoli then mix in Cheez Whiz. Add and mix in onion mixture; put in 9-inch pie plate top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Meat Rolled In Cabbage
instructions: Scald cabbage separate leaves. Combine chopped meat grated potato carrot onion garlic clove salt pepper Worcestershire sauce and 1/2 glass tomato juice. Mix well. (Add 1 tablespoon raw rice to mixture if desired.) Put 1 tablespoon meat on a cabbage leaf and fold over. Place rolls in a large pot. Add the rest of the tomato juice stewed tomatoes a little lemon juice and brown sugar or honey to taste and beef bouillon packets. Cook 3 hours. Put rolls in a flat baking dish in a single layer. Thicken juices with cornstarch. Pour over cabbage rolls. Brown in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together the Bisquick and sausage then add cheese. Roll into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet for 20 minutes.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Cut beef into 1 1/2-inch cubes. Brown in oil in skillet. Combine with carrots potatoes water garlic onions Worcestershire sauce paprika bay leaf salt and pepper in crock-pot; mix well. Cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours or until tender. Remove bay leaf. May precook carrots and potatoes partially to ensure tenderness.
