May add peas celery and tomatoes if desired. Yield 6 servings.

title: Dills Into Sweet Pickles
instructions: Drain juice from dill pickles. Into large bowl slice pickles 1/4 inch thick. Add sugar vinegar and spices. (Spices are to be tied in two thin cloth bags.) Stir gently. Let stand at room temperature until sugar dissolves and makes own syrup.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased muffin tins for about 15 to 18 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil. In separate bowl cream together the eggs and sour cream. Mix all together and bake on greased and floured cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Mom'S French Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add warm water and oil. Mix thoroughly. Turn out onto floured board and knead 30 times (or mix in bowl with electric mixer dough hooks until elastic and satiny).

title: Salmon Bake
instructions: Place salmon fillets in aluminum foil (skin side down). Baste with Wish Bone salad dressing. Place thin slices of tomatoes and lemons on top of fish. Roll in foil and broil slowly on grill 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cool Rise Pecan Ring
instructions: In a large bowl mix 2 cups of flour sugar salt and yeast. Add margarine. Gradually add very hot water. Beat 2 minutes. Add eggs and 1 cup flour. Beat at high speed for 2 minutes.

title: Sweet Nothings
instructions: Melt chocolate chips peanut butter and butter. Pour over Rice Chex. Put in paper bag with confectioners sugar and shake it! Pour onto cookie sheet spread out and cool.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix shrimp with a little water from the can. Mix softened cream cheese; add horseradish and Worcestershire sauce. Arrange in dish and spread cocktail sauce on top. Serve with crackers.

title: Holiday Eggnog
instructions: In large bowl combine yolks with sugar gradually beating constantly. Stir in bourbon and rum gradually. Fold in milk egg whites and cream. Pour into punch bowl and chill. Garnish with nutmeg when ready to serve. Yields 20 punch cups.

title: Jello Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients. Roll into balls; roll in powdered sugar.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Crumble together the thawed hash brown potatoes. Mix together the soup sour cream Cheddar cheese margarine and salt. Heat in microwave for 1 to 2 minutes. Add to hash brown potatoes. Top with corn flakes or bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Scallops Ubriaco
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan or skillet. Lightly saute the onions garlic and mushrooms. Add the wine and reduce to one quarter the original volume. Add artichoke hearts and heavy cream and cook until the sauce is the correct consistency. Add the red pimento. Then poach the scallops in this sauce for approximately 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste and stir in chopped parsley. Serve over fettucine.

title: Low-Fat Microwave Chicken A La King
instructions: In 1-quart microwave casserole dish microwave butter on High for 30 seconds until melted. Add celery and carrots; cover and microwave on High 2 minutes until celery is softened. Add chicken; re-cover and microwave on Medium for 2 minutes stirring once halfway through. Stir in onions and peas; re-cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes more.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Cream sugar and oleo or butter. Beat eggs with milk and add. Sift together flour soda nutmeg cinnamon and cloves; add sifted mixture. Add bourbon or orange juice. Add pineapple cherries raisins and pecan pieces. Drop teaspoon size on cookie sheet and bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Classic Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 350\u00b0. In large bowl stir eggs corn syrup sugar margarine and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell and place pie on baking sheet in oven. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Serves 8.

title: Barbecued Wild Turkey
instructions: Rub turkey cavity with salt; brush with 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke. Stuff with celery leaves and onion. Truss bird. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke to the oil brush on bird. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place on rack in roasting pan and roast in 325\u00b0 oven about 3 hours or until tender. Brush several times during cooking with oil mixture.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter until fluffy. Mix in eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk alternately. Add flavor and mix well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done. Slice and top with strawberries and Cool Whip.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and shortening well. Add milk. Roll out on floured board.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans on bottom and sides of an 8-inch pie plate. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco mix and spread on top of refried beans. Put Cheddar cheese tomatoes and black olives on top of sour cream mixture in this order. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve. Eat with nachos.

title: Vichyssoise-Potato Leek Soup
instructions: Saute leeks onion and celery in butter. Add chicken broth potatoes and parsley. Bring to a boil and simmer until potatoes are soft (about an hour). Add salt and pepper to taste and a few drops of Worcestershire. Put soup through processor. Before serving heat through. Add about 1/2 cup cream or milk. Sprinkle chives on top.

title: Cinnamon Bubbly Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar and cinnamon in a large plastic bag. Cut biscuits into quarters put them in the bag and shake well to coat. Spray a large tube pan with cooking spray. Put a couple of small pieces of butter around then sprinkle with nuts. Pile biscuits pieces into the pan. Meanwhile mix butter sugar and cinnamon in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over biscuits and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or so. Put a large serving platter over the pan and invert the biscuits to serve.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Combine pumpkin sugar milk and eggs in bowl. Add dry ingredients and butter. Mix only until flour is moistened. Stir in nuts. Bake in well greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan for 65 minutes (or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean) in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Yields 1 loaf.

title: June'S Brown Bread
instructions: In bowl mix raisins butter salt and baking soda. Pour the boiling water over the mixture. Let stand at least 3 hours. Then add flour sugar chopped nuts and eggs. Fill 9 greased and floured medium size cans about 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Turn loaves on side to cool. Wrap in foil and store overnight in refrigerator for easy slicing. Yields 9 loafs.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except crust) in a blender until smooth then pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Pork Chow Mein
instructions: Fry meat until browned. Add bouillon onions celery salt pepper and bean sprouts. Blend cornstarch soy sauce water and Gravy Master. Add to pork mixture. Cook for a few minutes until thickens.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix in order given and bake in al loaf pan for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Breakfast Strada
instructions: Fry and drain bacon and/or sausage (if desired). Butter a lasagna pan. Cube bread; place 1/2 on bottom of pan. Put 1/2 of cheese on top. Crumble bacon and sausage; put on top. Put rest of bread then cheese on top. Beat eggs milk spices and Worcestershire sauce together and pour on top. Put in refrigerator overnight (after covering with foil). The next morning bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Walnut Caramel Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. To prepare the crust combine flour 1/2 cup butter and 3 tablespoons sugar in a medium bowl. Mix with a fork until well blended. Press into a lightly greased 9-inch square pan. Prick with a fork and bake 10 to 15 minutes until brown. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chocolate chips. Let stand 2 minutes then spread chocolate over the crust.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Brown beef; drain fat. Add other ingredients.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Do not grease pan.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken breasts 30 to 40 minutes. Cool. Mix remaining ingredients with diced/shredded chicken in bowl (drain Veg-All). Put in pie shell. Cover with second pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix together. Cook in double boiler and pour in pie shell. Cool and top.

title: Cherry Shortcake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine powdered sugar cream cheese whipped topping and walnuts; mix well. Fold in cake cubes. In a serving dish/bowl pour half of the cake mixture. Pour half of the cherry filling on top of the cake mixture. Repeat layers until all ingredients have been used. Chill 3 hours before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Sprinkle 1/2 crumbs in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish. Cover with half the oysters; salt and pepper to taste. Dot with half the butter. Repeat layers. Combine half and half eggs and Worcestershire; beat well. Pour over oysters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients and carrots together. Add oil eggs and vanilla and blend well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in three 9-inch pans or one 9 x 13 pan.

title: Christmas Custard
instructions: To heated milk add egg yolks (well beaten) along with flour. Add the sugar. Cook in double boiler until thickened then cool. Beat the egg whites and stir in. Add vanilla and 1 carton Cool Whip. Chill. If it gets too thick add a little more milk.

title: Gobs
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening until it is very smooth; add eggs and beat. Add hot water sour cream and vanilla. Beat well.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Cream the oleo and flour. Add other ingredients. Roll into small balls and press lightly with fork. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 275\u00b0.

title: Country Style Baked Beans
instructions: Combine ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix all well and pour into unbaked pie crust and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix flour oleo and nuts. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Combine cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip; spread on top of cooled crust. Pour milk and pudding mixture on top. Put rest of Cool Whip on top and chill.

title: Italian Beef Pie
instructions: Brown meat and mushrooms in oil. Spoon into 2-quart casserole dish. Stir in all other ingredients except cheese. Put cheese on top and bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Biscuit Barbecups
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10 muffin cups.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy; add corn syrup and salt. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in pecans and vanilla. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Combine both flours sugar salt raisins and soda in bowl. Add liquid mix and put in 2 greased bread pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45+ minutes. It is done when toothpick comes out clean. Can be frozen for later. No fat is used in this recipe. Egg substitute may be used.

title: Pizza Pups
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Split open hot dog buns and spread each with 2 tablespoons pizza sauce. Cut frankfurters in half lengthwise and lay them on the buns. Top each with one or more teaspoons pizza sauce. Place the pizza pups on a baking sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes. Top with Mozzarella cheese; bake 2 minutes more or until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Souper Easy Steak
instructions: Sprinkle steak with meat tenderizer and cut into serving size pieces. Place in Pyrex baking dish. Mix soups and a little water into a thick sauce; pour over steak. Cover with foil and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 2 to 3 hours.

title: Hungry Jack Beef Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in salt beans sauce sugar and onion; heat until bubbly. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Cut biscuits in half to form 1/2 circles. Put cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Death-By-Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake according to directions; cool. Cut into squares. Line trifle bowl. Add layers of cooked chocolate pudding whipped topping and Krackel alternating with the cake. Whipped topping should form \ribbons\ visible from outside the bowl. Chill and serve.

title: Santa'S Whiskers Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter until fluffy. Blend in milk and flavoring. Stir in flour cherries and nuts. Form dough into three seven-inch rolls. Roll in coconut to coat outside or stir coconut into dough instead of using it as a coating. Chill thoroughly.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole No. 2
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a casserole dish. Cook in oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Rice Krispie Bars
instructions: Cook Karo and brown sugar until bubbles then add peanut butter and Rice Krispies. Beat together and press mixture in square pan.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Makes a lot. Recipe can easily be halved. Serve with fresh vegetable tray.

title: Dad'S Delicious Spaghetti
instructions: Slowly cook ribs in frying pan until well done. Cook sausage in same frying pan until fully cooked then make meat balls out of hamburger and fry until done. Mix meat in a large pot with sauce on low heat for 3 hours. Its even better the next day or as lasagna.

title: Dried Apple Stack Cake
instructions: Mix all together well. Pour 1 cup batter in pans. Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Put in between each layer old fashioned dried apples.

title: Quick And Easy Chili
instructions: In a skillet brown ground beef and onions. Drain. Transfer meat and onion mixture to a large pot. Add Chili-O mix stewed tomatoes and beans. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook at medium heat for approximately 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Tomato, Shrimp And Pasta Salad
instructions: Use tomatoes held at room temperature until fully ripe. Core tomatoes. Cut in wedges (makes about 2 cups); set aside. Cook pasta according to directions until tender but firm about 10 minutes; drain. Rinse with cold water; drain well.

title: Foolproof Vegetable Soup
instructions: With bouillon cubes cook frozen vegetables until done about 20 minutes. Turn down heat and stir in cans of beef vegetable soup. Stir well. Ready to serve.

title: Strawberry Pie (Shoney'S)
instructions: Cook water sugar and cornstarch in boiler until thickened. Add a few drops of red food coloring and 3 tablespoons of dry strawberry jello. Pour over large fresh strawberries that have been stacked in baked pie shell. Chill overnight. When ready to serve top with Cool Whip.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook cabbage leaves in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain. Mix next 9 ingredients in a bowl. Spread out cabbage leaves and then spoon mixture onto the leaves (this is enough to make 8 rolls). Roll the leaves up to enclose the filling. Put the rolls on the tomatoes in skillet. Simmer for 45 minutes covered.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Add 1 cup boiling water to package of jello. Let cool. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Thaw both packages of broccoli and drain off water. Mix all ingredients except cheese together. Spread in greased casserole dish. Top with grated cheese and bake at 325\u00b0 until it bubbles.

title: Homemade Ice Tea
instructions: Boil tea bags in 2 to 3 cups of water for about 20 minutes. Take bags out of tea and add sugar and mix. Add enough water to make 1 gallon; refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan and mix in cheese sour cream and onions. Add potatoes. Stir quickly together. Pour in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pudding Pie
instructions: Note Can use butterscotch pudding or other favorite flavor.

title: Buffalo Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Combine Crisco sugar brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at low speed until blended. Add eggs and beat at medium speed until blended. Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add gradually to creamed mixture at low speed. Stir in oats cornflakes chocolate chips nuts and coconut. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup which is filled and leveled off with a knife drop mixture onto cookie sheet 3-inches apart. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned around the edges but still slightly soft in the center. Cool 3 minutes on cookie sheet before removing to rack with a wide thin pancake turner. Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Bacon Appetizers(Makes 45 To 50)
instructions: Combine and refrigerate the brown sugar and ketchup. Wrap 1/3 piece of bacon around water chestnut and secure with toothpick. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Pour refrigerated sauce over appetizers. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour more.

title: Whole Baked Trout
instructions: Melt margarine over medium heat. Add lemon juice. Remove head. Place trout in 9 x 13-inch baking pan; pour margarine mixture over trout. Bake 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from oven; baste trout with margarine mixture. Bake another 10 to 15 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Best Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk in mixing bowl until smooth. Add Eagle Brand milk and softened cream cheese. Stir in Cool Whip and sliced bananas. Add 1 layer cookies and 1 layer of pudding until all cookies have been used.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Place walnuts in a pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly toasted. Cool. Beat margarine at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy; gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating well. Then add egg substitute beating well. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients; add to margarine mixture alternately with sour cream alternative beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Stir in vanilla and walnuts. Combine 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon; fold half of mixture into cake batter. Spoon batter into a 9-inch square pan coated with cooking spray and sprinkle with remaining sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool cake in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan; invert and cool on wire rack.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple. Blend pineapple lemon juice and Cool Whip together. Pour in graham cracker pie crusts. You may freeze and serve at later time if desired.

title: Raisin Bran Flake Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients well in a large bowl. Add oleo buttermilk and eggs; mix well. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yield approximately 6 dozen regular size muffins or 12 dozen mini muffins.

title: Chili
instructions: Cut onion into small pieces. Brown hamburger with onion and salt and pepper. Put into large pot. Add kidney beans and tomatoes; simmer for 1 hour. Serve over rice.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Follow directions on package of Pillsbury cranberry bread substituting orange juice for liquid and adding orange rind nuts and cranberries. Bake as directed.

title: Upside Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a 9 x 13 pan place the nuts and coconut. Prepare the cake mix according to the directions on the box. Pour on top of the nut and coconut mixture.

title: Louisiana Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Mix all fruit in a large bowl. Pour peach pie filling over the fruit. Stir until mixed. Chill before serving.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Put bread in 200\u00b0 oven until crisp. Then crumble in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Melt margarine; add other ingredients and pour over bread. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Boil cranberries in water until skins pop; add sugar and smash. Add lemon jello and all other ingredients. Put in jello mold and chill.

title: Haystacks (Candy Cookies)
instructions: Mix sugar syrup peanut butter in pot and bring to boil stirring all the time to keep it from sticking to pan. Then add flakes; stir well. Dip on buttered cookie sheet.

title: Baked Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes cheese mayonnaise onion salt and pepper. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with bacon and olives. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Spiced Eggplant
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut the eggplant in half and place it on an oiled baking sheet cut side down. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until soft. Let cool.

title: Pan Burritos
instructions: Call Pizza Hut at 548-2336.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if skins are tough otherwise wash and rinse them. Cut potatoes into thin slices but do not cut all the way through. Put potatoes in a baking dish. Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes at 425\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake potatoes for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned cheese is melted and potatoes are soft inside.

title: Spicy Hot Dogs
instructions: Precook hot dogs in boiling water. Cool and cut into bite size pieces. In electric frying pan sprinkle brown sugar over hot dogs. Add beer (a little at a time) to make a paste. Sprinkle with hot sauce. Cook on low heat until glazed. Continue adding beer brown sugar and hot sauce as needed. Serve warm.

title: Easy Cake
instructions: In glass pan put cherry pie filling then sprinkle white cake mix over it. Put can of pineapple (undrained) on cake mix. Put on brown sugar and bake until top is dark brown 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Molasses Stack Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add molasses and mix well. Beat in eggs. Mix dry ingredients with flour. Stir water and dry ingredients alternately into molasses-shortening mixture. Work in flour until you have a stiff dough. Roll rather thin. Use a dinner-sized plate to cut out layers or preferably cut them with an old-fashioned pie pan with scalloped edges. This gives a pretty edge. Bake the dough on a baking sheet or in layer cake pans at 375\u00b0 until fairly brown. If you want to make 2 cakes bake four or five layers for each cake. If you prefer to make one large cake bake 6 layers. When cutting the large cake only cut through 3 layers when serving it. Warm applesauce slightly and spread between layers of cake. (The warm sauce will help the cake moisten more quickly.) Do not put applesauce on top layer.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook over medium heat until thick. Pour into baked pie crust and add meringue.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry ingredients; add melted butter mixing until crumbly. Sprinkle crumb mixture over apples. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 30 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Onion Bread
instructions: In a skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain and discard drippings. In the same skillet cook onions in the oleo until tender. Cool. In a mixing bowl combine flour sour cream and salt; add eggs. Separate crescent roll dough into 4 rectangles. Pat dough into the bottom and up the sides of a greased 9-inch pan stretching as needed. Pinch edges together and seal. Pour onion mixture over dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Hawaiian
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Salt pepper and flour chicken pieces. Brown chicken in oil; remove to a baking dish. Flour and brown pineapple slices. Place over chicken. Flour and brown onion slices; place over chicken and pineapple. Pour pineapple juice and water over chicken. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: The Big One Pancake
instructions: In a blender whip eggs for 1 minute. Gradually add milk and then flour while blender is on. After adding milk and flour continue blending for 30 seconds. Melt butter. Pour melted butter into souffl dish (or round high dish) then add mixture to dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes (until fluffy and golden brown and firm). Serve with powdered sugar strawberries or syrup.

title: Sandra'S Very Rock Road Fudge
instructions: In a 2-quart glass mixing bowl cook sugar 1 cup marshmallows milk and butter in the microwave on High for 4 1/2 to 6 minutes until melted stirring once during cooking. Stir; cook another 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in chocolate and vanilla until smooth. Fold in nuts and remaining marshmallows. Spread in a foil-lined pan. Size depends on how thick you want the fudge. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into pieces.

title: Stuffing With Style
instructions: Cook sausage in skillet 10 minutes. Stir in onion celery and cook 15 minutes. Combine sausage mixture with cornbread stuffing mix corn chicken broth melted butter sage salt and pepper in bowl. Place in greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Bake in 350 oven for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings. Each serving 407 cal 17 g fat 10 g protein 53 g carb.

title: Dressing
instructions: Mix broth with bread crumbs and cornbread. Let set for 1 hour. Add sage salt pepper and marjoram. Let set for 2 hours. Food process the onion and celery. Add to the other ingredients. Add eggs. Mixture should be thin. Bake in a large container at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours and 45 minutes.

title: Southern Corn Bread
instructions: Melt shortening in baking pan. Sift dry ingredients; combine egg buttermilk and stir into dry ingredients along with melted shortening. Pour batter into hot pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 450\u00b0 or until browned.

title: Wassail
instructions: Break cinnamon into small pieces and tie in cheesecloth bag with allspice and half of cloves. Stud oranges with the rest of cloves. Simmer all together. Stir in 1 cup rum and heat thoroughly.

title: Fresh Plum Cobbler
instructions: Combine sugar and salt in a medium mixing bowl. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture is crumbly. Add flour 1/2 tsp. cinnamon and baking powder; mix with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Remove and reserve 1 c. mixture. Combine 1 beaten egg and 1 tsp. almond extract. Stir into remaining flour mixture to form a soft dough. Pat dough evenly into a greased 9 inch square baking dish. (Dough may be sticky; flour hands if needed.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise and cheese. Add hearts and garlic powder. Spread in a glass pie plate. Sprinkle with plenty of Parmesan cheese and dashes of paprika for color. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with crackers.

title: Sunshine Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl combine flours sugar baking powder and salt. Add remaining ingredients. Stir just until moistened (batter may be lumpy). Fill greased or paper lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until top of muffin springs back when lightly touched. Makes 15 to 20 muffins.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Keep wet and dry ingredients separate. Mix egg and buttermilk in a shallow dish. Mix flour cornmeal and salt in a shallow dish. Working in batches dip tomato slices into egg mixture allowing excess to drip back into dish. Coat with flour mixture. Fry in hot bacon drippings in a large skillet until browned turning once with tongs. Transfer to colander to drain. Stand upright to prevent sogginess.

title: New Orleans Chicken
instructions: Combine lemon juice Worcestershire sauce vinegar margarine water brown sugar catsup salt and mustard. Mix well and put in shallow dish. Roll chicken in flour to coat then dip into sauce. Place chicken in greased pan and cover. Bake for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and continue baking for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; beat 15 minutes after adding milk. Bake in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: In large bowl mix together flour brown sugar baking powder and salt. In small bowl beat together egg melted butter and milk. Add all at once to flour mixture and stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in blueberries.

title: Sugared Pecans
instructions: Melt margarine and add nuts. Stir to coat. Beat egg whites with salt. Slowly add sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Whip until stiff. Fold into cooled nuts. Spread on long cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes.

title: No Shortening Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a loaf pan. Mash bananas in large pan. Add eggs. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into pan; bake for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out fairly clean. May need to cover with foil during last half of baking. Remove from pan; let cool on a wire rack.

title: Almond Chicken
instructions: Quickly cook chicken in hot oil in wok. Add bamboo shoots celery bok choy water chestnuts chicken broth soy sauce and monosodium glutamate. Mix thoroughly. Bring to a boil cover and cook 5 minutes over low heat or until crisp-tender. Blend cornstarch in 1/2 cup cold water. Add to chicken mixture. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Avoid overcooking.

title: Vinegar Roll
instructions: Roll pastry into rectangle. Slice butter and scatter pats all over pastry. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Roll pastry as you would for a jelly roll starting on long side of rectangle. Curve roll around inside greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Mix sugar vinegar and water. Pour over roll. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until slightly browned and syrup is bubbly and beginning to thicken. Serve as is or with heavy cream.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix in order given. Form 2 rolls. Refrigerate overnight. Cut into slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Pour mixture into muffin tins lined with paper bake cups. When frozen remove from tins and store in large freezer bags.

title: Cranberry-Banana Drink
instructions: In a blender or food processor whirl the banana cut up and the cranberry-juice cocktail. Whirl to blend. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Eagle Brand Substitute(Easy And Cheap)
instructions: Stir to dissolve but do not boil it. Makes 1 cup or 8 ounces. Not as thick as Eagle Brand but taste is the same. No fat.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Mix vinegar and sugar; pour over green beans. Heat beans and top with bacon crumbs.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Cook beef and onions until meat is lightly browned. Drain; add salt and pepper stir in catsup and tomato sauce and heat thoroughly. Put into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cut cheese into thin slices or strips. Sprinkle over meat. Top with canned biscuits. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Seven Minute Frosting(Never Fails)
instructions: In top of double boiler combine egg whites sugar salt and water beating constantly with portable mixer and cook exactly seven minutes. Frosting should stand in stiff peaks. Remove from heat adding vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread. Covers pound cake all over generously.

title: Liz'S Clam Sauce
instructions: Heat oil. Lightly brown garlic. Add butter and parsley. Next add clams and juice. Salt and pepper now. Add to cooked drained spaghetti and toss. Better the next day!

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: These are unbaked cookies any child can make.

title: Overnight Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Mix together in a bowl the spinach cottage cheese spaghetti sauce and parsley. Lay noodles in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread mixture over noodles and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Continue to make layers of noodles mixture and cheese until pan is filled. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Fast Fixin' Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Start with God the Father and 1 Lord Jesus Christ (2 Cor. 86).

title: Double Cherry Dessert
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dry cake mix with eggs and butter until smooth. Spread into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread pie filling over dough. Sprinkle cherries with nuts. Bake until golden brown approximately 40 to 45 minutes. Cool at least 15 minutes. Drizzle with glaze. Serve warm or cool.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix water milk and eggs in a saucepan. Add dry ingredients slowly mixing thoroughly. Heat on medium stirring constantly until thick.

title: Squash Au Gratin
instructions: Saute onions in butter until tender. Arrange half the squash in buttered baking dish. Cover with half the onions. Repeat. Sprinkle with crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl beat together oil sugar and eggs until well mixed. Add remaining ingredients and stir until combined. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for up to 6 weeks.

title: Easy Salad
instructions: Mix lemon jello and hot water. Stir until jello is dissolved. Let cool. Add Miracle Whip and stir. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all together. Fold in 8 ounce carton whipped topping. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Skin chicken. Rinse chicken with water and dry with paper towels. Combine all ingredients (except chicken). Mix well. Add chicken and mix together until chicken is fully covered. Marinate at least 1 hour. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes on each side. Great on the grill!

title: Hot Boiled Peppered Shrimp
instructions: Chop green onions and peppers into small pieces. Place margarine salt onions and peppers in 2 quart pot with 1/2 cup of water. Bring to boil stirring occasionally. Wash shrimp thoroughly shake off excess water and place into pot with other ingredients. Boil until shrimp becomes pink or done. Stir often. Remove from heat. Cover with lid and let sit for 15 minutes for flavor to permeate. Remove shrimp from shell and serve.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cake
instructions: First soak oats for 20 minutes in 1 1/2 cups hot water. Set aside. Then in large bowl mix all ingredients remaining. Add oats last. Put in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spray or grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Frost when cooled with vanilla icing.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Blend sugar and margarine then add other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake slow about 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes then 350\u00b0 until pie filling is firm in middle and slightly brown about 30 to 40 minutes then add meringue and brown.

title: Gorilla Bread
instructions: Melt margarine and sugar together stirring occasionally. Take cream cheese and cut into 20 squares (this depends on how many biscuits you have). Mix other cup of sugar and cinnamon together in bowl. Take each biscuit and place cream cheese square in middle; wrap biscuit around it forming a ball. Take balls and roll in cinnamon/sugar mixture. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of nuts in bottom of greased Bundt pan. Place 8 to 10 balls in bottom of Bundt pan. Pour 1/2 melted sugar and butter mixture over top of this. Layer another layer of biscuits on top of this. Pour other 1/2 of butter mixture on top of this. Sprinkle with remaining nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bottom layer is done. Serve warm.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Place beef in 3 quart casserole. Sprinkle with salt pepper and basil. Cut all the vegetables into cubes and place on top of the beef except for the potatoes. Combine soup and water and pour over vegetables coating all the pieces. Cover tightly and bake at 300 degrees for 3 hours. Add potatoes and bake 45 minutes longer.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Mix all other ingredients. Add to beef and bring to a boil. Pour into 2-quart dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook the lima beans peas and snap beans 1 hour. Drain water and add to the other ingredients. Cook for 1 hour. This makes 7 quarts.

title: Make Ahead Shrimp Macaroni Salad
instructions: Peel shrimp. Cut cheese into small cubes 1/2-inch. Mix everything together and chill. Best if it sets awhile for flavors to mix. Very good to use as a main dish luncheon.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken cooked vegetables and soups mixing well. Add and mix in rice (optional) salt and pepper. Use the chicken broth from your boiled chicken or 1 can of chicken broth to casserole mixture. Stir in dressing leaving it moist.

title: Frog Eye Salad
instructions: Combine sugar flour and 1/2 teaspoon of salt; gradually stir in pineapple juice and eggs. Cook over moderate heat stirring until thickened. Add lemon juice. Cool mixture to room temperature. Bring water remaining 2 teaspoons of salt and oil to a boil. Add acini de pepe. Cook at a rolling boil until acini de pepe is done. Drain acini de pepe rinse with water drain again and cool to room temperature. Combine egg mixture and acini de pepe. Mix lightly but thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight in airtight container. Salad may be refrigerated for as long as a week in airtight container. Makes 25 servings.

title: Jo'S Favorite Pear Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt margarine in large pan or casserole dish. Next mix the pears and syrup with the pineapple and juice. Spoon this into the margarine; do not stir. Mix the flour sugar milk lemon and vanilla together. Pour this over the pear/pineapple. Do not stir. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Top servings with ice cream or whipped topping if desired. Good hot or cold.

title: Baked Corned Beef
instructions: Beat eggs; add mustard sugar salt and vinegar. Boil until thick then spread this mixture on the fat side of corned beef. Place on rack in pan. Cover with double fold foil wrap. Pinch foil around sides of pan. Bake for 7 hours at 260\u00b0; cut thin to serve.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 3 tablespoons water. Heat soup. Add cream cheese mixing until blended. Add rest of the ingredients. Pour into mold. Let set overnight.

title: Mama'S Best Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all in pot and let simmer for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray with Pam 3 round cake pans. Cream butter Crisco and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time. Add vanilla. Sift flour with baking soda and baking powder. Fold in buttermilk until blended evenly. Add coconut and nuts. Last fold in egg whites. Pour cake pans to 3/4 full. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Mix together the margarine flour and nuts; put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned (10 or 15 minutes). Cool.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Mold
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar. Add pretzel crumbs. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool. Blend Cool Whip and softened cream cheese and 1 cup sugar. Spread over pretzel mixture. Mix jello with boiling water. Add frozen sliced strawberries and pour over Cool Whip mixture. Refrigerate and cut into squares to serve.

title: Pecan Fudge Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat the first 8 ingredients until smooth. Stir in nuts; pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until set. Cool completely. Garnish with whipped cream. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Rinse and dry spinach. Tear into pieces and place in salad bowl. Add\tonion rings and sliced mushrooms. Heat oil vinegar sugar wine and Bac*Os. Pour over spinach while hot and serve.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Pour into freezer can and freeze until firm.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into bite-size pieces. This will take you about two months. Reserve the trunk youll need something to store the pieces in. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Cook over a kerosene fire for about two weeks at 465\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in casserole dish 9 x 13-inch except Cheez Whiz. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes then remove and add Cheez Whiz. Bake additional 15 to 20 minutes. Do not cover dish in oven.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jellos and water by jello box directions. Cool. Add bananas and pineapple. Pour in large container and cover with marshmallows. Chill.

title: Corn Flake Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Soak cabbage in ice water for 5 minutes. Drain. Mix soup mayonnaise and milk; bring to boil. Melt margarine in baking dish. Mix crushed corn flakes with margarine and use half of mixture in bottom of baking dish. Reserve the other half for top of casserole. Put cabbage over corn flakes mix. Pour heated soup mix over cabbage. Top with remaining corn flakes. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. The last 5 or 10 minutes add cheese and continue to bake.

title: Mom'S Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix and store in an airtight container.

title: Peach Surprise
instructions: Line deep Pyrex dish with whole vanilla wafers along the whole bottom. Cup up peaches into dish. When you have a heaping bowl spread them over vanilla wafers then spread Cool Whip over peaches. Take remaining wafers and crush until fine then sprinkle over the top. Chill before serving. (Its mouth watering.)

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and saute onions and celery. Add soup cheese and rice. Let cheese melt and mixture get bubbly hot. Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with broccoli and cover with cheese mixture. Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing moistened with melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Put chicken in bottom of a 9 x 13 greased casserole dish. Drain Veg-all and pour over chicken sprinkle with pepper. Mix soups flour milk and mayonnaise together and pour over top will be real thin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Stir in butter eggs and cheese. Press into pie plate. Put in Ricotta cheese meat and sauce and cover with foil. Put in fridge for 24 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Remove foil. Sprinkle with Mozzarella and bake 5 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Surprise
instructions: Combine pretzels sugar and oleo. Mix well. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Then cool. Blend together cream cheese 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over cooled crust. Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Stir in strawberries and pineapple. Chill until thick. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill thoroughly.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Combine flour margarine and chopped walnuts; press in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cream together powdered sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip. Spread over bottom crust when cooled. Make your pudding according to instructions and pour in pan. Chill until firm. Spread whipped cream on top and sprinkle with walnuts.

title: Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for liquid. Put in greased oblong cake pan then stir in liquid. Mix all together. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Forgotten Chicken
instructions: Pepper and paprika chicken to taste. Mix rice milk and soup together. Pour rice mixture in glass baking dish. Place chicken in dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken and bake 2 hours at 320\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Roll
instructions: Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon-colored. Add sifted dry ingredients and beat until well blended. Add vanilla extract and fold in egg whites. Spread in greased waxed paper-lined 10 1/2 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake in moderately hot oven (375\u00b0) for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Dry Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple chunks and mandarin oranges. Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Add dry jello and drained pineapple and oranges. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Sweet Potato Williamsburg
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted water. Peel and mash. Then stir in sugar cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Just before serving fold in cream and pecans.

title: Crab Louis
instructions: Combine crab and lettuce in large salad bowl. Sprinkle with eggs and chives. Garnish with tomato wedges.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars shortening and peanut butter; add 2 eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Beat well. Stir in flour and baking soda. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Frozen Delight Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding the bananas and cherries last. Pour into coldcut keeper or a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Freeze. Cut in squares before serving. May have to let set a few minutes before cutting.

title: French Toast
instructions: In shallow bowl beat eggs milk sugar cinnamon and salt. Dip bread in egg mixture coating both sides. In skillet cook bread on both sides in small amount of butter over medium-high heat until brown. Serve with maple-flavored syrup.

title: Lasagna
instructions: In large skillet cook meat diced onion and diced bell pepper. Cook noodles until done. Shred cheeses.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook slowly the first 3 ingredients stirring occasionally. When small amount dropped in cup of cold water forms a soft ball take off stove. Add remaining ingredients.\tBeat well until smooth. Pour into\tbuttered platter. Cut in squares when cooled.

title: Health Nut Brown Rice
instructions: Cook carrot zucchini sunflower seeds almonds and pepper flakes in margarine in large skillet over medium-high heat until almonds are browned. Add rice and parsley; stir until heated.

title: Creamy Fruit Dip
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese and concentrate until smooth. Fold in Marshmallow Creme. Serve with fruit. Store in the refrigerator. Yield 2 cups.

title: Daddy'S Secret Recipe Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. In a 13 x 9 inch baking dish combine all the above ingredients well except for the shredded cheese. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and bake at 350 degrees until cheese is bubbly.

title: Blueberry Bread
instructions: Mix brown sugar oil vanilla and buttermilk. Sift together flour salt and baking soda. Add to brown sugar mixture. Add blueberries and nuts. Grease and flour 2 bread pans. Pour in batter. Top batter with mixture of white sugar oleo and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 60 minutes. Cool before removing from pans. To freeze refrigerate overnight first.

title: Squash Casserole With Stuffing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare stuffing mix according to directions except reduce water to 1/4 cup. Spread half of stuffing in a 2-quart baking dish. In a large saucepan cook squash and carrot in a small amount of water 8 to 10 minutes until tender. Drain well. Stir in soup sour cream onion and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. Spoon mixture over stuffing; top with remaining stuffing. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until thoroughly heated.

title: Banana Nut Muffins
instructions: In large bowl combine oil sugar egg and vanilla. Beat. In separate bowl combine flours bran soda baking powder and salt. Add mashed bananas and milk to oil/sugar mixture. Stir in flour mixture. Stir in nuts. (Do not overmix.) Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Mix the ingredients starting at the top of the list. Mix the eggs in one at a time. Mix well after each addition. Pour into a greased and floured tube or Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake tests done approximately.

title: Homemade Cake Batter
instructions: Mix all the ingredients beating eggs after each addition. Pour into a greased cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.

title: Mother'S Beef And Potato Casserole
instructions: Spread layer of sliced potatoes and sliced onion and beef (separate beef in small chunks to layer) in 1 to 1 1/2-quart casserole. Repeat layers ending with potatoes on top and add water. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. (We like to cover the top layer of potatoes with black pepper.) Cover and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until potatoes test done (45 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Grate cheese and butter. Mix in flour salt and pepper to form a soft dough. Using the small star design of a crank-type cookie press press the individual cheese straws onto a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until straws are hard. If cheese straws spread out too much when cooked add a little more flour for a firmer dough.

title: Simple Manicotti
instructions: In a skillet cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink. Drain. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 cup spaghetti sauce onion powder salt and pepper. Cool for 5 minutes. Set 1/2 cup aside. Add cheese to the remaining meat mixture. Stuff into manicotti shells. Arrange in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine remaining spaghetti sauce and reserved meat mixture. Pour over shells. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yield 7 servings.

title: Basic Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil pasta until just tender. If overcooked the pasta may become mushy as you stir in other ingredients. Begin by adding half bottle of dressing and half bottle of salad seasoning. Mix well and taste. Add more dressing and/or seasoning if desired. You may also add one or more of the optional ingredients. Salad is best after it sets in the refrigerator about 12 hours.

title: Cheesy Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo in saucepan. Add flour and chicken noodle soup. Add enough milk to make medium white sauce. Cook over medium heat until bubbly. Add Velveeta; heat until melted. Pour over cooked noodles in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Stir. Put chicken on top. Heat in a 350\u00b0 oven until hot.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Store in a covered container. Mix 3 teaspoons in each cup of very hot water.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. After cool dust with powdered sugar.

title: Turkey Meatballs
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together until moist. Bake in 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes until brown.

title: Amaretto Cranberries
instructions: Bring sugar and water to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Add cranberries and cook until skins burst about 5 minutes. Stir in marmalade and lemon juice. Remove from heat and cool. Add almonds and Amaretto. Chill before serving. Keeps very well in refrigerator. If freezing add almonds and Amaretto after defrosting.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Spray angel food cake pan with cooking spray. Cook 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Limas
instructions: Dont soak beans. Put beans and bacon in pan with some water and cook on top of stove 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Add sugar ketchup and salt. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Mix 1/3 cup mushroom soup 1/4 cup milk onion and parsley. Dip chicken in soup mixture then roll in stuffing. Place in shallow baking dish. Pour butter on chicken. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Combine remaining soup and milk in dregs of first mixture. Heat stirring occasionally. Serve over chicken or in gravy boat. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Heat and dissolve gelatin in water. Add soup and cool. Add cream cheese; mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with wheat crackers.

title: Tea Biscuits
instructions: Soften margarine. Mix all ingredients. Drop into greased miniature muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 24.

title: Raspberry Pudding
instructions: Mix thoroughly sugar eggs and melted butter. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Combine mixtures alternately with milk. Put thin layer of dough in prepared pans 1 layer of berries (1 pint) and top with balance of batter. Then top with balance of berries. Bake in 1 large pan 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inches or 2 medium pans which are greased and floured.\tBake for 30 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Candy Roll
instructions: Cook water sugar and syrup until very hard ball. (Use candy thermometer.) Beat egg whites and pour into syrup. Beat rapidly while adding. Add vanilla then beat adding confectioners sugar a little at a time until 3/4 of box is used. Warm peanut butter for spreading; sprinkle confectioners sugar on wax paper and put about 1/3 of the dough on it. Roll thin and then spread with peanut butter. Roll up like a jelly roll and wrap in wax paper. Chill about 20 minutes then do the other dough in 2 parts the same. Slice in small pieces.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream flour and egg yolks together. Add sugar and milk then vanilla and coconut. Cook over medium heat until thick. Pour into cooked pie shell.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until frothy. Add cooking oil and sugar. Beat in zucchini. Sift together flour salt baking soda and baking powder. Beat dry ingredients into mixture. Fold in nuts. Turn into 4 (8 x 4-inch) greased pans. Bake at 320\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes (check after 60 minutes). Leave in pans 20 minutes to cool then turn out. Makes 4 loaves.

title: Bread Knots
instructions: In a small mixer bowl combine 3/4 cup of the all-purpose flour the yeast caraway seed or pepper and salt. Add water and oil. Beat with electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds scraping bowl constantly. Beat on high speed 3 minutes. Stir in the whole-wheat flour and as much of the remaining all-purpose flour as you can.

title: Arizona Style Burros
instructions: Brown ground meat with chopped bell pepper and onion until meat is cooked and seasonings are limp. Add can of green chile sauce and cook on low for about 20 minutes. While mixture is cooking add salt pepper and garlic to taste. Warm up the refried beans adding water as needed for a smooth texture.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Cook over medium heat until thick. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Mock Eggnog
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat milk and pudding mix on low speed for 2 minutes. Beat in the sugar nutmeg vanilla and a pinch of salt if desired. In another bowl beat cream until thickened about 3 minutes. Stir into pudding mixture. Refrigerate until serving. Sprinkle with additional nutmeg if desired. Yield about 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in jar until ready to use. Use 2 teaspoons per cup of hot boiling water.

title: Better Than Robert Redford
instructions: First Layer Combine flour margarine and chopped nuts. Mix well and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Saute onion green pepper ground beef and rice in oil in large skillet until beef is browned. Pour off excess fat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 35 minutes stirring once until rice is done. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Deerburgers
instructions: Combine ingredients with the deerburger. Fry in small amount of vegetable oil on medium heat until browned. Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Covered Worms
instructions: Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips in a saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat. Add noodles and nuts. Stir carefully and cover noodles completely. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool. Makes about 36 pieces.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine small pieces of cauliflower and broccoli chopped celery peas and bacon.

title: Pink Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in one cup boiling water. Dissolve Kool-Aid in 2 quarts cold water. Add sugar; pour in jello mixture. Add pineapple juice and Sprite. Add sherbet when ready to use.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix cookie mix egg and water. Spread on lightly greased pizza pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Baked Cheese
instructions: Beat cream cheese. Add sour cream onion bacon and cheese. Spoon in enough mayonnaise for good consistency (not more than 3/4 cup).

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add enough water to reserved fruit juices to make 1 1/2 cups and mix with gelatin. Stir in blueberries and pineapple. Pour into a 1-quart dish and chill until firm. Blend cream cheese sugar sour cream and vanilla. Spread over congealed salad and sprinkle with pecans.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Bring cornmeal shortening and 2 cans of milk to boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Combine egg remaining milk and salt and add to the mixture. Quickly stir in baking powder. Pour mixture into a greased 1-quart casserole dish. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serves 12.

title: Southfork Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and pour off fat. Add onion green pepper garlic red pepper chili powder cumin oregano and salt. Mix well. Cook until onion and green pepper become tender. Add beans tomatoes corn and tomato sauce. Stir to mix well breaking up tomatoes with a fork. Simmer slowly stirring occasionally until thickened and blended (about 45 minutes).

title: Christmas Wreaths
instructions: Melt butter food coloring marshmallows and vanilla in a double boiler. Pour over Rice Krispies. Mix well.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Cut brown off bread and line a greased 13 x 9-inch pan with bread. Put sausage on top of bread then cheese. Beat eggs milk and salt. Pour over other mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Baked Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Saute onion celery and garlic in butter; add rice undiluted soups and cheese. Mix together; turn into buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole. Add broccoli and stir. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Nutty Slaw
instructions: In a large bowl combine ingredients and mix well. Chill for 3 hours or more before serving. This colorful slaw is a perfect addition to any meal.

title: Ice Cream Salad
instructions: Stir cracker crumbs margarine and nuts together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan (all except 1/2 cup). Mix instant pudding and milk together and add to this the ice cream. Mix well. Pour over cracker crumb crust. Top with a large Cool Whip. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on this and refrigerate. Do not freeze.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in their skins. Cool peel and shred coarsely. Put cheese and 1/4 cup butter in pan over low heat and stir until cheese melts. Take from heat and add the sour cream onions salt and pepper. Stir. Fold the potatoes into the cheese mixture. Spoon the potato-cheese mixture into a 2-quart greased casserole dish. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine noodles tuna soup cheese milk and olives (if desired). Turn into buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and bake according to box directions. Cool and mix together last 3 ingredients and frost cake. Cover and freeze overnight. Remove and keep cake refrigerated.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions. Add taco seasoning. Spread beans in 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Spoon meat mixture over beans. Spread salsa on top. Top with shredded cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat sugars shortening eggs and vanilla on medium speed until light and fluffy. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoons on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease small or large pans. Fill pans 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0. Check after 45 minutes by inserting toothpick in center. They will be done when toothpick comes out dry with no moist batter.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls on bottom of a lightly-greased cookie sheet. Bake and cool as directed on package. Mix together cream cheese mayonnaise and dry Hidden Valley mix. Spread on cooled crescent rolls. Sprinkle broccoli then cauliflower then carrots on top of cheese mixture. Top with Cheddar cheese. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle pecans and coconut over bottom of pan. Make cake mix per directions on box. Pour batter over pecans and coconut.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill for salad or dessert.

title: Crisp Puff-Pastry Sticks
instructions: Remove puff-pastry from package and thaw at room temperature for 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. On lightly floured surface unfold 1 sheet of puff pastry. With floured rolling pin roll pastry into 18 x 10-inch rectangle. In cup with fork beat egg salt and 1 teaspoon water. Brush pastry with some egg mixture. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Cut pastry sheet crosswise into 1/4-inch wide strips. Place on ungreased large baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden. Remove. Repeat with second sheet only. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Store in tightly covered container. Makes about 12 dozen strips.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Toast 1/2 cup coconut. Set aside. Bake shell 8 minutes. Cool slightly. In medium bowl beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients except coconut. Mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup coconut. Pour into pie shell. Top with toasted coconut. Bake 10 minutes. Reduce oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 25 to 30 minutes longer or until done. Cool or chill. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Strawberry-Banana Shake
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a container. Chop or mince ingredients together. Mix and enjoy.

title: Bollos
instructions: Soak peas overnight. Remove the husks by rubbing between hands until they are loose. Place peas in water again and the husks will rise to the top. Pour them off. Grind peas garlic and peppers to a very fine paste. Save drippings from grinder and add along with the salt. Add a little water if necessary. Beat the mixture with electric beater until it becomes creamy. Drop by the spoonful into hot deep fat and fry until brown (just as you would hush puppies).

title: Pear Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with boiling water. Add cream cheese until melted. Mix with a mixer. Add Cool Whip. Add pears juice from pears and nuts. Chill.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Sift flour and measure; add salt and sift again. Combine shortening and boiling water in small saucepan. Keep over low heat until shortening is melted. Add flour all at one time and stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball and leaves side of pan. Remove from heat. Add unbeaten eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition either by hand or electric mixer. Continue beating until a thick dough is formed. Dough should be shiny. Drop by tablespoon or heaping teaspoonful onto a greased baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake in hot oven (425\u00b0) for about 50 minutes or until beads of moisture no longer appear on surface; do not open oven door during early part of baking. When cool slit sides and fill with Cream Filling. Sprinkle tops with powdered sugar.

title: Date Crisp
instructions: Combine sugar milk egg flour salt and baking powder; beat well. Add nuts and dates. Spread batter in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream. Serves 8.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Place wings in a single layer on a baking sheet. Combine remaining ingredients and brush generously over wings. Bake 15 to 20 minutes basting frequently. Serve with Chinese hot mustard if desired.

title: Brown Sugar Crisp
instructions: Cook condensed milk and brown sugar in top of double boiler over boiling water until thick. Remove from heat and add corn flakes mixing thoroughly. Drop from spoon onto buttered cookie sheet 1 inch apart. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Oyster Casserole
instructions: Mix first three ingredients in a separate bowl. Mix parsley and onion. In a 2 to 3-quart casserole put a layer of bread crumb mixture then layer of parsley and onions. Next put a layer of oysters with 1 drop of Tabasco sauce salt and butter on each oyster. Repeat procedure until all is in baking dish. End with crumb mixture. When you have completed layers gently pour wine and then cream over layers. Sprinkle grated cheese over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Marinated Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. When cool enough to handle peel and cut into chunks.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix milk and eggs with the mashed bananas. Sift the dry ingredients into the banana mixture. Pour into a greased and floured pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Italian Turkey Casserole
instructions: Starting with a cold nonstick frying pan brown turkey meat slowly or brown in a microwave oven. Drain off any fat. Add the onion and garlic. Saute in 1 teaspoon liquid Butter Buds. Add turkey meat back to skillet and cook about 1 or 2 more minutes. Stir in spices and tomato sauce and heat until thick and bubbling.

title: Frito Salad
instructions: Melt cheese in milk over very low heat or in a double boiler. Keep warm. Combine lettuce tomatoes onions avocado and Tabasco sauce. Season with pepper and garlic salt. Add Fritos. Toss well. Pour melted cheese mixture over salad. Toss and serve.

title: Chicken Or Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Spring Strawberry Salad(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and stir well with a whisk. Combine greens and strawberries in a large bowl. Add vinegar mixture. Toss to coat. Sprinkle with pine nuts (if desired).

title: Microwave Chicken With Herbs
instructions: Spray all sides of chicken with Kitchen Bouquet microwave browning spray (about 12 sprays). Brush with herb butter. Place skin side down in microwave usable baking dish. Cover loosely with wax paper and microwave (High) 10 minutes. Turn skin side up. Spray with Kitchen Bouquet microwave browning spray (about 6 sprays). Brush with herb butter. Microwave (High) 10 minutes or until leg moves freely and inner thigh meat is done. Garnish with fresh herbs if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; fold in nuts strawberries pineapple and bananas. Pour half of mixture in pan. Refrigerate until firm. Spread sour cream. Gently spoon in strawberry mixture. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Cut into squares; serve on lettuce.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and shortening. Beat into this mixture sugar and eggs adding each egg one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift together flour baking powder cocoa and salt. To this mixture add milk and vanilla. Combine the flour mixture milk and vanilla mixture alternately beginning with the flour mixture. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Peach Jam
instructions: Set timer for 1 minute cooking. Place peaches and Sure-Jell in a large 6 to 8-quart heavy cooker. Bring quickly to a hard boil stirring constantly. At once add sugar (cant be stirred down). Boil hard 1 more minute. Remove from heat. Skim off foam with metal spoon. May freeze or place in clean jars and seal.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: In a small bowl combine stuffing and oleo. Reserve 1/2 cup stuffing mixture. In a 2-quart baking dish spread remaining stuffing mixture. In bowl combine soup sour cream and cheese. Stir in squash and carrot. Spread soup mixture over stuffing mixture. Sprinkle with reserved stuffing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until hot and bubbling. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Prince Edward Island Bannock
instructions: Try 3/4 cup milk and add if needed to roll out mixture. Strike down with butcher knife to look like biscuits. Grease pan and bake at 400\u00b0 approximately 30 minutes until brown.

title: Shrimp Remoulade
instructions: Mix all ingredients; let marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours stirring often. Serve on toast squares or crackers.

title: Southern Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into serving pieces wash and pat dry with paper towels. Combine flour baking powder salt pepper and paprika. Dip pieces of chicken in cream then coat as thickly as possible with seasoned flour. Preheat skillet to 325\u00b0 with oil about 5 minutes. Arrange coated chicken in skillet. Brown on all sides about 10 minutes. Cover and cook about 30 minutes on 225\u00b0. Remove cover and fry an additional 10 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pizzelle
instructions: Mix well using 1 teaspoon on each iron. Dust with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Cinnamon Cucumber Rings
instructions: Put rings in 8 1/2 quarts water and 2 cups lime. Let stand in lime water for 24 hours. Drain rings. Wash in cool water 3 times. Pour clean water over and soak for 3 hours. Drain then add 1 cup vinegar alum and food coloring. Add enough cold water to cover cucumbers. Heat and simmer for 24 hours. Drain and rinse with cool water.

title: Kraut-Swiss-Rye Casserole
instructions: Mix together kraut onion and sour cream. Place mixture into 9x13 baking dish. Spread the swiss cheese over the mixture and top it with the crumbled rye bread. Pour the melted margarine over the casserole and bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Bayley'S West Indies Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover and marinate for 2 to 12 hours.

title: Strawberries Accent Dessert
instructions: Combine flour brown sugar nuts and melted butter or margarine. Spread evenly in shallow baking pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Sprinkle 2/3 of crumbs in 13 x 9-inch glass dish.

title: Korean Beef
instructions: Tenderize meat on both sides with wooden meat mallet. Partially freeze meat and slice paper thin.

title: Reuben Rolls
instructions: Blend corn beef cheese and sauerkraut together. Add Miracle Whip and mustard. Roll out pizza dough and spread mixture all over. Roll dough up and bake on cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes or 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Supreme Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion. Remove from heat and mix with all remaining ingredients except noodles. Alternate layers of noodles with layers of meat mixture in a greased casserole dish. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add sugar then add cocoa and cornstarch. Add milk. Stir well. Cook slowly until thickens. Add 1 tablespoon butter. Remove from heat. Cool. Add the flavoring. Pour into already baked pie crust. Make your meringue with leftover egg whites and 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 until meringue is golden (about 5 minutes).

title: Special Party Dip
instructions: Brown ground round; drain. Cook sausage (crumbled not patties); drain. In a crock-pot put chunks of Velveeta cheese can of chili cooked sausage and meat all together. Cover; cook on low. Eat with chips or on small deli breads toasting the little breads with this mixture on top of it.

title: Quick Fruit Dip
instructions: Soften cheese in microwave for 1 minute. Add marshmallow cream. Mix well. Serve with sliced fruit.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad Ii
instructions: Blend cream cheese and salad dressing together; add fruit marshmallows pecans and powdered sugar. Fold in whipped cream very gently. Pour into mold; freeze just until firm. Slice and serve on greens.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Separate eggs; beat yolks. Add grated rind and lemon juice; stir well. Add milk and mix thoroughly. Put in pie crust. Beat egg whites stiff. Fold in 2 tablespoons confectioners sugar. Spread on top of pie. Place in preheated oven (350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0) for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Remove and cool. Put in refrigerator for about 24 hours before serving.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Mix together yeast sugar salt and water. Sift a mound of flour about 4 cups and add to the yeast mixture. Stir until dough is completely moistened. Turn mixture on lightly floured board and knead to make soft smooth dough. Pinch off pieces; roll into ropes and shape into pretzels.

title: Old Time Vinegar Pie
instructions: Mix flour with half the sugar and add boiling water. Cook in double boiler for 15 minutes stirring often. Add rest of sugar and beaten egg yolks; cook a few minutes longer. Add butter and vinegar. Flavor with lemon extract (if desired) and cool. Pour into baked shell and meringue.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Combine soup mayonnaise egg and onion. Blend with broccoli. Pour into buttered dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Melt oleo and stuffing crumbs on top of broccoli. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-45 minutes.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Brown rice with oleo; put in a casserole dish and add soup and broth. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole. Put crushed cornflakes on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve immediately. Serves 8.

title: Cinnamon Ornaments
instructions: Mix all together. Roll out on wax paper. Use cookie cutters to cut out shapes. Use toothpick to put hole in top to insert string to hang up. Move to another sheet of wax paper. Dry on flat surface until completely dry (about 1 week). Turn over each day. When dry insert gold cord or string for hanging. Also can paint designs on ornaments when dry. Fun to make.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Muffins
instructions: Combine flour oats brown sugar and baking powder. Whisk together milk peanut butter banana egg oil and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients mixing until moistened. Fill cups 3/4 full.

title: Pam'S Salad
instructions: Bring to boil crushed pineapple just as it comes from can. Remove from heat; add sugar and salt. Add jello. Set aside until cools and begins to thicken. Work in cream cheese that has been standing at room temperature. Whip cream or canned milk that has been chilled. It will whip. Fold into pineapple mixture. Add nuts if desired. Pour into good size dish. Garnish with maraschino cherries (5 or 6). Refrigerate. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and cream cheese together. Add sugar and eggs beating after each one. Add flavoring. Slowly add flour gradually beating on medium speed. Bake in a tube pan at 325\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Drain artichoke hearts saving juice. Add onions pepper olives and artichoke hearts all chopped or sliced. Combine mayonnaise curry powder and juice from artichoke hearts. Stir into rice mixture. Serves 6.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease a Bundt pan. Pour cherries in bottom of pan. Drain pineapple. Pour on top of cherries. Sprinkle cake mix on top of the cherries and pineapple. Melt margarine pour on then add coconut and nuts. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Beverly Slimm'S Beef And Mozzarella Bake
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat cook beef basil black pepper and garlic until browned stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soups water and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese. Add macaroni.

title: Grandma'S Jack O' Lantern Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given pouring mixture into waiting pie crusts. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes until testing knife comes out clean. May cook the pumpkin pudding in a baking dish instead. May serve with whipped cream chunks of Cheddar cheese or vanilla ice cream.

title: Skillet Chicken
instructions: Shake chicken in paper bag with flour salt garlic salt and pepper. In skillet brown chicken in Wesson oil. Remove excess fat. Combine onion sauce sugar and vinegar. Pour over chicken. Cook until chicken done.

title: Hot Apple Cider
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a saucepan. Stir well. Heat slowly over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove cloves and cinnamon sticks before serving.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put into pan pressing evenly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Then fill and bake.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all and pour into 2-quart casserole dish greased with Pam. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Jello-Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Add together lime and lemon Jell-O to boiling water and stir constantly until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat and mix in dry taco seasoning in skillet. In bowl mix olives cheese lettuce tomatoes and onion. Drain meat and mix in with salad. Then break up chips and mix all together. Top with taco sauce and favorite salad dressing.

title: Pasta E Fagioli(Macaroni And Beans)
instructions: In hot oil in 5-quart Dutch oven or heavy kettle saute garlic and onion stirring until golden about 5 minutes. Add tomatoes 1 teaspoon salt pepper oregano and parsley. Simmer covered 30 minutes. Mash tomatoes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish place one layer cracker crumbs. Add 1/2 can soup and place sliced boiled eggs on soup. Arrange asparagus and the remaining soup. Top with cracker crumbs and butter. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Maple Balls
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients; form into balls. Melt wax and chocolate over top of a double boiler and keep over heat while dipping balls. Makes approximately six dozen.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Blend the strawberries sugar eggs vanilla salt and condensed milk together. Pour into ice cream freezer. Add the milk. Freeze as usual.

title: Crab Puffs
instructions: Rinse and drain crabmeat. Mix first 6 ingredients. Spread on muffins. Cut each muffin into 6 wedges and place on cookie sheet*. Broil until golden.

title: Picante Corn Bread
instructions: Heat an 8-inch cast-iron skillet at 425\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Combine flour cornmeal baking powder soda and salt in a large bowl. Make a \well\ in the center of the mixture; set aside. Combine buttermilk eggs and picante sauce. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Remove skillet from oven; add butter. Pour melted butter into batter. Blend well and pour mixture into hot skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Creamy Frozen Salad
