instructions: Blend sour cream lemon juice sugar and salt. Stir in pineapple cherries pecans and banana. Pour into 1-quart mold. Cover and freeze. Thaw at room temperature for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Large Pot Brunswick Stew
instructions: In an iron pot outside cook hens and middling meat until half done. Add hamburger and onions; continue cooking until hens are done. Add potatoes and cook to pieces then add tomatoes and butter beans. Cook stew until well done. Add corn and butter; cook until corn is done. Season in the beginning and throughout the cooking. Cook the stew to desired thickness (approximately 7 hours cooking time). Serves around 100 people.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour in pineapple and cherry pie filling. Sprinkle brown sugar over that. Pour cake mix on top of that then add nuts. Pour melted butter over all. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well; add sugar and beat well. Add flour and vanilla. Add milk; beat well. Pour into crust (will make two). Bake until golden brown in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spoon cherry pie filling evenly in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spoon pineapple with juice over pie filling. Sprinkle cake mix evenly over pineapple. Drizzle melted oleo evenly over all. Sprinkle with coconut and pecans. Bake 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven or until cake tests done.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Boil water; take from heat and mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in 9 x 13 dish.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Saute onion in butter for 5 minutes. Add to ground beef in large bowl. Sprinkle in salt and pepper; mix well. Stir in crumbs eggs and juice. Shape into a loaf. Place in a greased pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 60 to 90 minutes or until browned. Remove loaf and place on platter. Serve with brown gravy.

title: Cold Cookies
instructions: Stir together sugar cocoa and milk. Bring to a rolling boil. Remove from heat; immediately add margarine vanilla and peanut butter. Stir until combined. Add oatmeal. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Seven-Up Salad
instructions: Mix and spread in flat pan. Chill until firm.

title: Ten Minute Tomato Soup
instructions: Heat tomatoes until boiling. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Return to heat and cook on medium until butter is melted and heated thoroughly.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet and add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender. Add tomatoes and seasonings bring to a boil. Stir in rice cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Turn heat off. Top with slices of Velveeta cheese and cover until melted.

title: Bird'S Nest Pie
instructions: *Place 1 tablespoon of white vinegar in measuring cup. Add enough milk to equal 1 cup. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Wash and slice tomatoes. Salt both sides. Pat into flour coating well. Fry in shortening or oil on medium heat until just golden brown on each side. Lift out with fork and drain on paper towels.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cover potatoes and onions with water; cook one-half hour until tender. Add caraway seed dill weed milk salt and pepper. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and butter.

title: Green Pepper Tostadas(Health Conscious)
instructions: Saute green peppers onion and tomatoes in the oil. Add the whipped cheese; cook for 5 minutes. Broil tortillas until slightly crisp. Place 3 tablespoons of pepper-tomato mixture in the center of each tortilla. Sprinkle with the grated Mozzarella cheese; broil until the cheese is melted. Serve topped with shredded lettuce.

title: Brownie Pudding Cake
instructions: Sift together flour granulated sugar 2 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add milk oil and vanilla; mix until smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Combine brown sugar remaining cocoa and 1 3/4 cups hot water; pour over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lucky Charm Treats
instructions: Put butter and marshmallows in big pan on medium heat until melted then add Lucky Charms cereal and stir. Spread out in 9 x 13-inch pan that has had butter smeared in it. That makes it easier to remove from pan.

title: Tuna Rice Bake
instructions: Combine rice 1 slightly beaten egg butter and parsley. Firmly press mixture against bottom and sides of a lightly greased 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle 3/4 cup cheese over rice crust. Top with half of the tuna; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Beat together milk 3 eggs salt and pepper; pour over cheese-tuna mixture. Sprinkle remaining tuna on top. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Arrange tomato slices on top. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Cream butter. Add sugar egg and vanilla. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Stir in mashed bananas. Fold in dry ingredients and nuts. Bake in well-greased loaf pan or 8-inch square cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix together. Make into balls. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 13 minutes.

title: Bacon, Eggs And Toast Brunch Casserole
instructions: Mix together croutons and cheese. Pour into greased 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Mix together remaining ingredients except bacon and pour over crouton mixture. Top with with bacon. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until eggs set.

title: Best Rum Cake Ever!!
instructions: Before you start sample the rum to check for quality. Good isnt it? Now go ahead select a large mixing bow measuring cup etc. Check the rum again. It must be just right. To be sure rum is of the highest quality pour 1 level cup of rum into a glass and drink it as fast as you can. Repeat.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onion in margarine until tender. Add meat; cook and brown. Drain. Blend in flour and garlic salt. Gradually add beef broth; stir until thickened. Stir in sour cream and mushrooms; heat. Serve over noodles or rice. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Easy Way Pralines
instructions: Combine pudding brown and granulated sugar and milk in saucepan. Bring to a full boil and cook 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Beat 3 minutes. Candy will be shiny. Add pecans and stir. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let harden 1 hour. Makes 24 pralines.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti onion and celery in broth. Reserve 1 cup of broth. Mix all ingredients well. Place in a baking dish coated with cooking spray. Top with cheese; bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted and spaghetti is hot. This may be frozen without cheese and used later.

title: Butterscotch Crunchies
instructions: Combine morsels and peanut butter in top of double boiler. Place over hot not boiling water until melted. Stir. Add noodles. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Top with cherry; chill until set.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco butter and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each addition.

title: Hamburger-Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown the ground beef and onion in a small amount of cooking oil. When lightly browned drain off excess fat. Combine with the remaining ingredients in a large kettle. Simmer covered for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes whole in skin until done. Run cold water over the sweet potatoes and remove skin. Break apart sweet potatoes in a bowl. Add butter and mix well with mixer. Stir in sugar milk eggs nutmeg cinnamon and vanilla. Beat on medium speed until mixture is smooth. Pour filling into an unbake pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs 5 minutes at high speed of electric mixer. Gradually add sugar beating well. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Combine flour and next 5 ingredients. Add to pumpkin mixture and blend well. Spoon batter onto a greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan spreading evenly to corners. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn cake out onto a towel sprinkled with 1/4 cup powdered sugar. Beginning at narrow end roll up cake and towel together jelly roll fashion. Cool. Combine 1 cup powdered sugar cream cheese butter and vanilla. Beat until smooth and creamy. Unroll cake and spread with filling. Roll cake up again; chill seam side down. When ready to serve remove from refrigerator and slice.

title: Seasoned White Beans
instructions: Boil salt pork and set aside. Reserve some of water from pork to add to beans. Place beans in pot with water about 2 to 3-inches above beans. Boil until beans get to be a little tender; remove beans from fire. Drain and rinse beans. Into empty pot add cooking oil and saute onions celery bell pepper\tand garlic; add cubed salt pork and smother a little while. To this add\tbeans and some of water from pork. Continue cooking and adding water until desired creaminess. Add onion tops and parsley. Should cook for half hour or more.

title: Big Bucket In The Sky Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chicken. Heat oil in a large frying pan. Dip chicken into batter. Fry chicken in hot oil until cooked and golden brown.

title: Pea And Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole dish. Mix tuna soup peas and rice together with salt and pepper. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake 30 to 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until edges are browned.

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Line a jelly roll pan with soda crackers (about 35). Mix butter (oleo) and brown sugar. Boil 3 minutes. Pour over crackers and bake 8 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over top. Let chips melt. Spread with a big spoon. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and pat in. Cut before completely cool. Refrigerate.

title: Texas Brownies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour and sugar. In a saucepan combine butter shortening coffee or water and cocoa. Stir and heat to boiling. Pour boiling mixture over the flour and sugar in the bowl. Add the buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix well.

title: Shrimp And Lobster Bouillabaisse
instructions: In a 5-quart Dutch oven combine tomatoes broth clam juice leeks water Cajun seasoning and orange peel. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 10 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Grease and heat a medium iron skillet or 9-inch baking pan. Combine beaten egg and buttermilk. Add corn meal; mix sugar and oil. Stir until moistened. Pour into greased pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until brown.

title: Raisin, Carrot And Apple Cake
instructions: In a bowl beat the butter sugar spices and vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients tossing to blend. Mixture will be dry. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake in 8-inch square pan for 40 to 45 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Quick Pan Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of warm water in a large bowl. Add sugar salt egg shortening and 1 cup of flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in remaining flour and continue stirring until smooth. Scrape batter from side of bowl. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled (30 minutes). Stir batter and turn onto floured surface. Divide into 12 equal parts. Shape into smooth ball with lightly greased fingers. Place in greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Let rise until doubled (20 to 30 minutes). Beat egg white and 1 tablespoon of water slightly and brush over rolls. Sprinkle with seed. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 12 rolls.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into 3-inch lengths. Split 1/2 inch up from the stem ends. Cook in a covered saucepan in an inch of boiling water until tender 8 to 10 minutes after the water starts to boil. Do not overcook. Remove gently from the water; drain and chill.

title: Potato Refrigerator Dough
instructions: Mix 1 cup of lukewarm water with sugar and salt. Sprinkle yeast over 1/2 cup lukewarm water; stir yeast until dissolved. Add to first mixture. Add slightly beaten eggs and shortening. Mix in first with spoon then with hand the potatoes and flour. Knead until smooth. Place in refrigerator in large Tupperware bowl. About 2 hours before baking shape rolls into desired shape. Cover; let rise until light (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Peanut Butter And Jelly Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour shortening peanut butter sugar egg and salt until smooth. For each cookie roll one teaspoonful dough into ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; with finger make dent in center of ball. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until set. Carefully remove to rack (cookies will be tender). Cool and fill hollows with jelly. Makes about 36.

title: Spiced Maple Cider
instructions: In large saucepan combine all ingredients except liqueur bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Remove orange slices and spices. Add liqueur if desired. Serve warm.

title: Frozen Caramel Pie
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Pack into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Divide popped corn into 2 large baking pans. Mix brown sugar butter and corn syrup and salt in saucepan; cook and stir over medium heat until it bubbles around the edge. Cook 5 minutes more. Take pan off heat and stir in baking soda and vanilla. Pour equal amounts of the mixture over the popcorn. Stir until popcorn is coated. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Korn'S Pie Crust(Great)
instructions: Pour hot water over lard; stir until smooth and add salt and vinegar. Add flour until dough comes off hands easily. Yields 4 (2 crust) pies.

title: Creme Puff Cake
instructions: Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers. Mix pudding with milk then fold in Cool Whip. Pour half of mixture over crackers then cover with another layer of crackers. Use remaining pudding mixture and a third layer of crackers. Let set in refrigerator at least an hour then cover with a thin drizzle of powdered sugar using remaining ingredients. It is best if left in refrigerator 24 hours or at least overnight.

title: Old-Fashioned Baked Beans
instructions: Wash beans thoroughly; place in a 4-quart saucepan. Add enough water to cover 2 inches above beans. Let soak overnight. Drain off water. Cover with fresh cold water. Add soda; bring to a boil. Drain again and rinse well. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil. Place onion slices in bean pot or deep casserole dish. Add remaining ingredients except salt pork. Add hot beans and enough boiling water to barely cover beans. Place strips of salt pork over top. Cover and bake at 250\u00b0 for 9 to 10 hours or until beans are tender adding more boiling water as liquid evaporates. Remove cover. Bake for one hour longer to let salt pork become crisp and brown. Serve piping hot plain or with catsup or chili sauce. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Add all of the ingredients mix and form into a ball. Put in skillet add 1/2 cup water and bake with lid at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Check often. If should get dry add more water.

title: Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Add eggs to sugar one at a time. Add flour and salt then baking powder. Melt butter and sour cream; add to mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mary'S Chicken Stew
instructions: Dredge chicken in seasoned flour. Fry bacon in large skillet remove and reserve. Place chicken in skillet and brown. Transfer to large casserole Dutch oven. Add vegetables. Pour over all the chicken broth. Sprinkle with the sage and crumbled bacon. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until the chicken and vegetables are tender.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Cover bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish with chipped beef. Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon and arrange in dish. Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken. Bake at 275\u00b0 uncovered for approximately 3 hours. Twenty minutes before baking is finished sprinkle cheese over chicken and finish cooking. Serves 8.

title: White Trash Candy
instructions: Combine both Chex cereals pretzels and peanuts in large bowl. Melt the coating in microwave at 50% power stirring every 2 minutes. Pour melted coating over dry mix and stir until all is coated well. Line two cookie sheets with wax paper and spread mix all over. Chill at least 15 minutes. Remove from pans by breaking apart like peanut brittle. Store in Ziploc bags. Refrigerate in humid weather. Makes a very large amount of candy. May want to halve the recipe.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top with the following topping.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package leaving liquid in if desired. Blend soup butter and seasonings. Combine with broccoli; simmer on top of stove or crock-pot until hot. This can be doubled easily. Serves 4. Can do ahead.

title: Eggless Jam Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with an electric mixer. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes in a tube pan.

title: Jessie'S Pie Crust
instructions: Mix the flour salt and sugar into a bowl. Add and mix in the shortening. Beat in small bowl the egg vinegar and water. Add egg mixture to flour mixture; mix well. Refrigerate a couple of hours before using.

title: Pork Chops Southern Style
instructions: Flour chops. Brown on both sides in hot oil. Place in baking dish. Add corn green pepper and tomato sauce; pour over chops. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Mushroom Chicken(Serves 4)
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. In large bowl mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Picante
instructions: Butterfly chicken breasts or pound to even thickness about 1/2-inch thick. Season with salt pepper garlic powder chili powder and rosemary. Heat oil to medium-high in frypan and cook each side of chicken about 1 minute. Set chicken aside and keep warm. In same pan add picante and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until mixture is reduced in half. On sheet pan arrange chicken. Cover each piece with cooked picante mixture and top with cheese. Place under broiler until cheese bubbles and is brown. Serve with yellow or Spanish rice.

title: Easy Camp Stew
instructions: Saute onion in margarine; add all of the ingredients. Stir thoroughly. Cook on medium for 30 minutes.

title: Deep Fried Turkey
instructions: Use kitchen syringe to inject dressing or Cajun mixture into turkey meat. Heat oil in deep fryer or fish fryer to 325\u00b0. Fry turkey for 30 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 185\u00b0. Fried turkeys can be frozen whole; cool wrap in foil and freeze.

title: Barbecued Hamburger
instructions: Brown green pepper onion and hamburger in a tablespoon of fat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1/2 hour. Serve on hamburger buns. Can be kept in refrigerator several days. Heat before serving.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Mix the water yeast sugar margarine 1 egg and 3 cups of flour together. Then work in the remaining 3 cups as needed until the dough is stiff. Refrigerate the dough 2 to 24 hours.

title: Old-Fashioned Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Line two 8 inch pie plates with unbaked pastry. Combine pumpkin sugar and remaining ingredients in order given. Bake in a preheated very hot oven 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat quickly (leave oven door slightly ajar about three minutes) to slow oven 325\u00b0 and continue baking for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean when inserted in center of filling. Serve warm or cold. (We prefer the pie warm topped with ice cream.)

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Break the cheese into nuggets. Fold in the mayonnaise. Dissolve the dry ingredients in the vinegar. Add the oil to the mayonnaise while beating. Whip in the vinegar and cold water. Mix well.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar vinegar beaten egg flour and pineapple juice. Cook on medium heat until thickened approximately 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; let cool. Combine apples pineapple and Cool Whip. Add peanuts and marshmallows. Stir in cooked custard mixture after it is completely cooled; mix well. Chill well before serving.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar and corn syrup in an 8-ounce measure. Cook for 4 minutes at 100% power. Add the peanuts and cook for 3 or 4 more minutes. Add margarine and vanilla and cook for 1 more minute. Add soda and stir until mixture is light and foamy. Pour and spread onto a greased flexible baking sheet. Cool for 1/2 hour and then break into pieces. Store in an airtight container.

title: Baked Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in baking pan at 250\u00b0. Mix other ingredients. Remove melted butter from oven and coat chicken first in the butter then the crumb mixture. Lay chicken in remaining butter in pan top with any remaining crumb mixture sprinkle with paprika if desired and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 until tender about 1 hour. Baste chicken a time or two during baking. Cover with foil if coating starts to brown too much before chicken is tender.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Oatmeal Crisps
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugars until fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Combine margarine powdered sugar flour and salt. Mix at low speed. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Beat eggs; add sugar flour (1/2 cup) and lemon juice. Blend. Pour over crust. Bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut in squares.

title: Sopapillasroswell, New Mexico
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.

title: Cheap Chili
instructions: Simmer all together for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: My Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix oil oleo and sugar until creamy. Add whole egg then add egg yolks one at a time. Add vanilla and half cup buttermilk and beat. Add half flour and beat good. Add rest of milk and flour beating good. Pour into 3 greased cake pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Maple Heights Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Combine with all other ingredients except bacon. Place in lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Top with bacon and mix in. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: In large salad bowl place ingredients in order given; toss lightly to mix. Cover and chill. Serve on crisp letuce leaves.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: Mix meats eggs cheese parsley and 3 cloves of garlic in a large container. Take crust off of Italian bread. Wet then squeeze out water and put into mixture and form into balls the size of an egg. Put the meatballs into a baking pan and brown them in the oven. Put them into sauce and cook for 2 hours or fry meatballs in olive oil until brown and then add to tomato sauce.

title: Rock Cakes
instructions: Sift the flour into a medium sized bowl. Cut in the butter or margarine until it resembles breadcrumbs. Add the dry ingredients a little grated nutmeg and the egg well beaten. Add the milk being careful not to make the mixture too moist. Put in small heaps on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Heat oven to 200\u00b0. Divide popped corn between 2 greased baking pans 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 1 large roaster. In saucepan heat sugar butter syrup and salt. Stir occasionally until bubbles from around edges. Continue to cook over medium heat 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda until foamy. Pour over popped corn stirring until corn is well coated. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Pour out on greased foil or waxed paper.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler(A Cup Of Cobbler)
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Put margarine in baking dish and place in oven to melt. Meanwhile put sugar flour and milk in bowl and mix well. Put fruit on top of melted margarine. Add flour mixture on top and bake 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Cream butter sugar and blend in ginger cinnamon and salt. Add egg and beat. Blend in molasses and milk. Stir together baking soda and flour. Combine all ingredients. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0 in an 8 x 10-inch greased baking pan.

title: Sombrero Dip
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Add red chili beans. Pour in 8 x 8-inch dish; cover with remaining ingredients in order. Bake at 350\u00b0 to melt the cheese.

title: Cheerios Oat Cookies
instructions: *If children under 4 years old omit raisins.

title: Microwave Nine Bean Soup(Spicy)
instructions: Microwave Power High (10). Microwave Time 2 Hours and 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Mud Pie
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies. Mix cookies butter and nuts. Press mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool. Pour slightly melted ice cream in pan. Sprinkle a few crushed Oreo cookies on top and freeze.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water. Add the cranberry sauce. Stir well. Add crushed pineapple. Mix well. Add celery and nuts. Refrigerate for 8 hours. Will keep indefinitely.

title: Katie'S Breakfast Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes in oven until done. Cool. Slice potatoes lengthwise and scoop out. Scramble eggs. Cook eggs in butter leaving eggs still soft. Mix eggs with potato meat sour cream and 1 1/2 cups cheese. Heap mix into potato shells. Sprinkle remaining cheese over potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Brownies
instructions: First melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Combine cake mix butter pecans and 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Mix all together then put half of the batter in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Pour caramel over 1/2 batter sprinkle all chocolate chips and spoon rest of batter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Honey Dijon Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate. Will keep for approximately 2 weeks. Discard when it begins to separate.

title: Bread And Butter Pickle
instructions: Pour over pickles what you need and save remainder for another time. Enough for 4 to 5 quarts. Put to cold pack and when begins to boil remove at once.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into pie plate and chill.

title: Beer Muffins
instructions: Mix until moistened but no more. Do not beat. Pour into 8 or 12 greased muffin tins or cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Choc-Oat-Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats chocolate morsels and nuts. Mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese pineapple nuts and Cool Whip then add dry jello from box. Mix together and let set.

title: Fanny May Fudge
instructions: Heat butter sugar and milk until warm not hot. Add marshmallows. Heat until marshmallows melt. Bring to boil and remove from heat. Add Hershey bar chocolate chips and nuts. Stir (do not beat) until all is dissolved. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate to set. Cut in squares.

title: Glorious Tossed Salad
instructions: Chop and mix all vegetables. Add in cheese and dressing. Toss. Top with bacon bits and croutons. Preparation time 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Austin'S Awesome Avocado Dip
instructions: Peel remove seed and lightly puree avocados. Add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly with fork. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add cornstarch; mix until smooth. Stir sugar and vinegar making a smooth sauce. Add beets; let cook slowly until thoroughly heated.

title: Puddin'S Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Cut in shortening well. Combine all liquid ingredients including the egg and mix well. Add dry ingredients until well moistened. Chill thoroughly. Add a little more flour to roll out.

title: Blackberry Jelly
instructions: Sort and wash ripe berries; remove stems or caps. Crush berries and extract juice. Measure juice in kettle; stir in sugar. Place on high heat and stirring constantly bring quickly to rolling boil that cannot be stirred down.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and bake in 2 (15-inch) greased and floured pizza pans. Spread mixture in pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Check center for doneness. Cool. Spread with Cool Whip.

title: Butter Pecan Pound Cake
instructions: Allow butter to soften. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugar and butter. Add flour and blend well. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each. Add vanilla and beat until fluffy. Stir in pecans. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake 45 minutes or until a pick inserted near center comes out clean.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Combine egg salt and sugar. Add milk gradually then add coconut and mix. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Decrease heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes or so longer.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice carrots. Cook in water and bouillon cubes. When done drain the water. Add sour cream and cheese to carrots. Cook onions in margarine. Mix all together and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Flake Clusters
instructions: In a sauce pan put butterscotch and chocolate chips in. Stir over low heat until melted remove from heat and stir in peanuts and Corn Flakes. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and let set up.

title: Green Noodles With Mushroom And Olive Sauce
instructions: Saute garlic in oil over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Pour in wine and cook until mushrooms are cooked. Add olives and pine nuts and saute 8 minutes. Add chopped parsley. Cook and drain noodles. Toss with sauce and serve.

title: New England Crab Cakes
instructions: Spray unheated large skillet with nonstick spray. Add the celery onion and parsley. Cook and stir over medium heat until tender. Remove from heat.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown chops in skillet. Place chops in large baking dish and place sliced onions on top of chops. Mix soup with milk and pour over chops. Cover with foil and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven an hour or until tender.

title: Banana Walnut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar; beat. Add eggs; beat. Add flour and other ingredients; beat. Add nuts last. Pour in 2 loaf pans. Top with nut halves. Bake at 350\u00b0. Test when done with toothpick. This freezes well.

title: Pat-A-Pie Crust(For Those Who Think They Cannot Make Pie Crusts)
instructions: Sift flour sugar and salt. Whip oil and milk pour into flour mixture. Mix with fork until flour is completely dampened. Shape in pan with fingers. Press evenly over bottom and sides of pan. Prick with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Fill with favorite pie filling. Reserve 1/3 of dough to crumble on top if making fruit pie.

title: Company Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to boil. Add salt potato flakes sour cream and cream cheese to water. Mix with mixer until well blended. Butter 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Put potatoes into dish and top with dots of oleo. Sprinkle parsley flakes over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until slightly browned.

title: Creamy Rice And Vegetables
instructions: Bring vegetables milk garlic salt and basil to boil in large saucepan. Stir in rice and cheese; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes or until milk is absorbed.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Bring warm water sugar and coffee to rolling boil. Let simmer for 1 hour and add vanilla and vodka. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Arlene'S Apple Crumble Cake
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar and 1 ounce flour. Squeeze lemon juice over apples. Toss apples with sugar mixture. Put in baking dish. Mix butter rest of flour and cinnamon. Add rind and rest of sugar; sprinkle over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Easy Cheesy Turkey Loaf
instructions: Combine ingredients except catsup. Mix lightly and place in a nonstick loaf pan. Spread top with catsup. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings; 221 calories per serving.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix 1st three ingredients; roll into 3/4 inch balls and coat with crushed cereal.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook chicken. Remove skin and bones. Cut up. Cook broccoli according to directions. In bottom of greased pan place broccoli. Layer chicken on top. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and pour evenly over chicken. Top with grated cheese. Cover with crumbs and pats of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Mix the peaches tapioca cornstarch nutmeg white and brown sugars lemon juice and margarine. Pour in crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions adding snap peas after 18 minutes of cooking. While rice is cooking pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness. Place on rack of broiler pan. Combine honey soy sauce ginger garlic and red pepper. Spoon half of mixture over chicken; let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Broil 4-inches from heat for 6 minutes; turn and baste with remaining honey mixture. Continue broiling until chicken is cooked through about 4 minutes. Serve chicken along side rice; sprinkle rice with black pepper to taste. Makes 4 servings.

title: Waffle Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in hot waffle iron for 1 or 2 minutes until crisp. Remove and cool. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Enjoy!

title: Sweet-Sour Cucumbers
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 45 minutes to blend flavors stirring mixture occasionally. Makes 12 servings.

title: Veal Marsala
instructions: Pound meat and dredge in flour. Brown in oil. After meat has all browned place onion mushrooms garlic and parsley in skillet and cook until onion is transparent about 10 minutes. Place in pot over meat. Add tomato sauce and wine. Cook over low heat for about 2 hours. About 30 minutes before serving add peas and continue cooking.

title: Italian Cream Cake With Frosting
instructions: Combine soda and buttermilk and let stand for a few minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff. Cream the sugar oleo and shortening. Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat after each. Add buttermilk alternately with flour to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla and fold in egg whites. Add pecans and coconut. Put in 3 greased and floured pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
instructions: Slice apples and leave peelings on. Soak in lemon water to keep apples from turning brown. Drain. Combine cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla. Mix and place in small bowl. Arrange apples nicely around bowl mixing the colors of apples to make attractive.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream sugar flour and melted butter. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add vanilla and buttermilk. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 after 10 minutes. Bake about 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Red Beans And Brown Rice(Texas-Style)
instructions: In a large saucepan saute onions and garlic in oil until tender. Add the beans chilies broth ketchup molasses chili powder vinegar and soy sauce. Let come to a boil; reduce heat to a simmer. Let cook for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve over brown rice. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put pie filling and pineapple in a large pan; top with the cake mix. Mix the butter coconut and pecans. Pour over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Put sugar corn syrup and peanuts in pan and boil until peanuts begin to pop and mixture turns light brown. Then add soda. Pour out on greased surface and allow to cool. Break in pieces.

title: Golden Wassail
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a large pan. Heat to boiling point reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and strain. Pour hot wassail into mugs. Can garnish with floaters of thin orange slices studded with cloves. Makes 9 cups.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix and pour into buttered dish.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion; add all ingredients except 1/2 cup Ro-Tel and tortillas. Cook 10 minutes. Layer tortillas meat and cheese. Pour remaining 1/2 cup Ro-Tel on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes its own crust.

title: Hershey'S Chocolate Syrup Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs and beat. Sift flour and baking powder and add to creamed mixture. Add chocolate syrup. Spray 9 x 13 pan with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.

title: Lasagne(Very Good)
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef ground pork onion and garlic in large saucepan or Dutch oven until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain all fat. Add tomatoes and break up with fork. Stir in tomato sauce 2 tablespoons parsley flakes 2 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon salt and the basil. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered 1 hour or until mixture is the consistency of spaghetti sauce.

title: Strawberry Impossible Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender or mixer. Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mother'S Shipwreck Stew
instructions: Coat casserole dish with canola oil or spray with Pam. Arrange ingredients in order in casserole. Mix salt chili powder Worcestershire sauce tomato sauce and water together and pour over. Cover with foil or lid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Check middle for doneness.

title: Bible Cake
instructions: In large heart with love mixer soften and cream Genesis 18; slowly beat in Isaiah 7. In small corner of heart beat Job 39 well and add to this mixture. Sift together 1 Samuel 28 1 Kings 19 Matthew 21 Exodus 30 and Luke 14. Add to first mixture and mix well. Through your thoughts fold 2 Samuel 16 and Genesis 43. Grease a 9-inch tube pan with Judges 5. Line with waxed paper. Pour in batter. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Lower temperature to 325\u00b0. Bake 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and enjoy.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Combine all in a crock-pot and serve hot with nacho chips. Also great as a hot dog sauce and over a baked potato.

title: Chunky Guacamole
instructions: In a medium bowl combine tomato jalapeno green onion garlic lemon juice and salt; mix well. Peel and seed avocado; cut into 1/2-inch cubes. Stir avocado cubes into tomato mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
instructions: Pour equal amounts of milk and water in top of double boiler. Heat to \almost\ scald. Add broccoli and cheese. When cheese is melted and broccoli thawed and cooked some put this through food mill so mixture is creamy and broccoli no longer has to be chewed. You want a very smooth soup.

title: Surprise Pudding
instructions: Put all ingredients in a shaker and shake for a couple of minutes. Pour immediately into a small bowl and let set for 2 to 5 minutes and eat with a spoon.

title: Blueberry Goop
instructions: Put on top of jello mixture after it sets.

title: Orange Float
instructions: Reconstitute orange juice as directed; divide among 8 large glasses. Add ice cream and fill each with club soda or ginger ale.

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Place chicken on top. Sprinkle onion soup mix over top. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 320\u00b0 for 1 hour and dont peek.

title: Hobo Dinners
instructions: Place one patty of hamburger on piece of aluminum foil. Make the aluminum pieces large enough to hold several ingredients stacked on top of the patties. Layer potatoes onion bell pepper salt pepper and a pat of butter on top of each hamburger patty. Close and seal the aluminum packs. Place on grill and cook for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Clean shortening sugar and pumpkin. Add egg and mix well. Add dry ingredients and blend well. Stir in raisins and chocolate chips. Drop from spoon to ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Frost warm.

title: Baw Baw'S Chili Sauce
instructions: Put into large pot and cook on real low heat until it is real thick. Put in jars and seal.

title: Brisket
instructions: In a medium skillet saute onions until lightly browned. Add bell pepper and mushrooms; saute until soft and set aside. Place 1/3 of sauteed mixture on a large sheet of heavy foil in a shallow roasting pan. Place meat on top and add remaining sauteed mixture. Sprinkle with onion soup mix and pepper. Pour wine around meat. Arrange carrots and potatoes around meat. Wrap airtight in foil allowing space for gravy to form. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 3 to 4 hours. Slice meat across grain and serve with pan juices and vegetables. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Place in ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Punch 2 holes in flour mixture. Pour oil in one hole; pour vinegar in remaining hole. Pour cold water on top. Add vanilla and stir. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Gene'S Simple (Barbecue) Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients. (Add red pepper flakes for hot version.) Use to baste meat in final minutes of grilling time. Also great just drizzled over Ripple potato chips.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: Pour chilled evaporated milk into a medium-size bowl and whip with electric mixer until soft peaks form. Mix water lemon juice and jello in microwave bowl and heat for 1 minute. Stir to dissolve gelatin. Mix whipped milk and gelatin mixture with mixer until thoroughly blended. Pour into baked pie crust and chill until fully set. Garnish with kiwi fruit.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes. Cut thin slice from top. Scoop out insides. Add remaining ingredients reserving 1/4 cup cheese and paprika to the potatoes. Mash. Spoon into shells. Top with cheese and paprika. Heat until cheese melts.

title: Butter Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla and egg then sifted dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Chill dough. Place on cookie sheet in small balls and flatten with fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden about 10 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans. In large mixer bowl combine butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat on high speed 3 minutes. Combine dry ingredients; add alternately with water to butter mixture. Blend just until combined. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans to wire racks. Cool completely. Frost with chocolate buttercream frosting.

title: Chicken-Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and cheese; heat until cheese is melted. Do not boil. Add chicken and pimentos and mix well. In casserole dish arrange a layer of cheese sauce a layer of asparagus a layer of cracker crumbs and repeat layers. Dot top with butter and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until browned approximately 10 minutes.

title: Aw Maw'S Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in Dutch oven and cover with water. Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender; drain. Cover and chill. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients like pie crust. Take 1 cup of mixture and set aside. To rest of mixture add the egg milk soda salt and vanilla. Beat well and pour into greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle cup of mixture over cake then add 12 crushed Heath bars over mixture. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chutney Cheese Roll
instructions: Let cheese stand at room temperature 6 to 8 hours. Roll 1/2 of soft cheese between 2 pieces of wax paper to 1/8-inch thickness. Repeat with other half. Spread softened cream cheese over the rolled out cheese to cover it completely. Toast nuts 10 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven. In food processor or blender chop nuts; add remaining ingredients and spread over the cheese. Roll the cheese with the help of the wax paper sealing the ends of the roll. Refrigerate until firm. Serve with crackers. May be frozen.

title: Cold Pickled Vegetables
instructions: Drain beans peas and pimentos into colander. Rinse with cold water and drain thoroughly. Combine sugar vinegar water oil and salt in a bowl. Add celery onion and drained vegetables. Mix well. Cover and chill overnight. Will keep in refrigerator for several days at least. To serve drain well. Serves 12.

title: Heavenly Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the fruit cocktail. Add bananas marshmallows and coconut. Fold in whipped cream. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and chill.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Mix ingredients and 1/2 can noodles in baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 can noodles. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Mix all ingredients together and put in pan. Cover with crushed potato chips or sliced almonds. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Daddy Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into 6 to 8 burgers. Cook on outside grill or under the broiler. Serve on a bun; add cheese for cheeseburgers.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a bowl. Add egg milk and shortening (oil). Beat until smooth. Pour into greased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Saute onion and celery. Crumble cornbread and add white bread onion celery eggs salt pepper sage poultry seasoning and stock (may use canned stock and some water). Mix well; the mixture should be the consistency of thick cornbread batter. Pour into a large oblong pan greased or sprayed with Pam. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm and browned on top.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes until tender and skins are very crisp about 1 1/4 hours. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out centers into bowl. Add butter and mash until smooth. Fold in cheese sour cream chives salt pepper and bacon. Mound mixture in potato shells and bake another 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Diabetic Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Combine chicken and water to cover in large skillet. Cover and boil. Reduce heat simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well. Chop chicken; set aside. Cook spaghetti as directed on package; drain and set aside. Combine soup milk and seasoning in saucepan. Stir to blend. Layer spaghetti chicken soup mixture and mushrooms in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Grandma'S Garlic Grits
instructions: Cook grits in salt water per package directions. Put 3/4 of margarine and cheese in grits. Let cool slightly. Add eggs and milk. Pour into buttered casserole and add rest of cheese. Sprinkle cornflakes on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beet Salad
instructions: Grate beets real fine into a salad bowl. Add cabbage and carrots. Beat together the lemon juice honey oil and salt and pour over beet mixture. Toss and chill. Sprinkle seeds over top. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Fudge Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bring to boil (hard). Boil one minute. Set aside to cool. It takes a lot of beating. Creamy and excellent!

title: Potato Vegetable Chowder
instructions: In saucepan over low heat melt margarine. Stir in onion. Saute until tender. Stir in flour bouillon thyme and pepper. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly. Gradually stir in milk and water. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Stir in potatoes ham and vegetables. Reduce heat. Simmer stirring occasionally 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Makes 4 (1 1/2 cup) servings. Freezes well.

title: Chili Bean Bake
instructions: Cook oil meat and onion until lightly brown. Add all other ingredients except cheese. Stir gently to mix. Pour into greased casserole and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serve over buttered noodles with tossed salad.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Combine dressings and cheese; mix well. Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Chill before serving.

title: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Praline
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and milk to soft ball stage; cool 10 minutes. Add vanilla and beat 2 minutes. Add nuts and stir until loses gloss. Drop by tablespoon on buttered dish.

title: Chocolate Delight Bars
instructions: Beat the first 3 ingredients. Sift the next 3 ingredients and stir in. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips. Return to oven 1 minute. Spread on top. Beat eggs and sugar; stir in butter vanilla and nut meats. Place over melted chocolate chips and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0F for 1 hour.

title: Easy Overnight Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar 1/2 cup brown sugar salt baking powder soda and cinnamon in large mixing bowl. Add buttermilk oleo and eggs. Beat on low speed of mixer until moistened then beat on medium speed 3 minutes. Spoon batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Combine 1/2 cup brown sugar the nuts and 1 teaspoon cinnamon; sprinkle over batter. Cover and refrigerate overnight or 8 to 12 hours. Uncover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. To reheat cover with foil and put in 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Peel and slice apples (enough to fill your baking dish). Spray dish with Pam. Layer apples. Cut up stick of butter into patties and lay on top of apples. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over apples and butter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about an hour.

title: Hash Casserole
instructions: Mix cornmeal salt and cold water. Add to boiling water. Cook stirring until thickened. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally for 10 minutes. Pour into 9-inch pie pan and push up on sides of pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Fill with corned beef hash. Pour ketchup over top and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Mix dry pudding with pineapple. Stir in Cool Whip. Add apples and nuts; mix.

title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli in pieces using the tops and some of the smaller stems. Mix all ingredients together and let set 2 hours in refrigerator before serving.

title: Orange-Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes. Cook in water to cover in saucepan for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender; drain. Cool. Peel potatoes; cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices. Melt margarine in large skillet. Stir in marmalade orange juice lemon juice and salt. Bring to a boil. Add potatoes. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes turning potatoes occasionally. Spoon onto serving dish; sprinkle with coconut. Yield 8 servings.

title: Top Me Twice Cake
instructions: Grease 12 x 8-inch cake pan. Combine sugar vanilla and eggs in a large bowl. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. At low speed add flour soda and pineapple; mix 1 minute. Pour into pan. Sprinkle with mix of brown sugar and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Just before cake is done prepare sauce. Pour over warm cake.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread sauce over the bottom of a 9-inch pie plate or another shallow serving dish. Carefully spread sour cream over sauce. Sprinkle cheese and remaining ingredients over all. Cover and chill. Serve with crisp corn chips.

title: Plumcake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat the butter until creamy then add the eggs and continue beating. Add the sugar and beat until fluffy. Stir the flour and the baking powder into the dough. Spread the dough into an 8-inch spring-form pan (buttered) and bake it around 45 minutes or until golden brown on top. Remove the sides and bottom of pan and cool on a rack. Is good warm or cold.

title: Rice Krispie Rolls
instructions: Crush Rice Krispies and set aside. Melt margarine set aside. Mix flour shortening milk and pour out on floured dough board. Roll out in thickness of about 1/2 inch. Cut with 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter then take knife and cut in half. Put Rice Krispies in plastic bag dip biscuit halves in margarine drop in bag and shake it well. Put these on a cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 (preheat oven) for 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Salad
instructions: Combine jello and crushed pineapple with juice. Heat until jello dissolves. Remove from heat. Blend in buttermilk coconut and pecans. Fold in Cool Whip. Place in 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Chill until firm.

title: Better Than Sex Cake #3
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding oil and water. Beat until blended. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Pour into large greased tube pan (angel food size). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Yam Roll
instructions: Beat eggs 5 minutes with electric mixer. (This is an important step.) Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into a 1 x 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan that has been well-greased and floured. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done. When done turn out on a tea towel that has been sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll up like jelly roll. Cool. When cool unroll and fill.

title: One-Step Lasagne
instructions: Combine water with spaghetti sauce in bowl. Cover bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with 1 1/2 cups of sauce. Arrange a layer of uncooked noodles slightly overlapping on top of sauce. Spread half the Ricotta and half the Mozzarella over noodles. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Add another layer of sauce. Repeat with another layer of noodles the remaining Ricotta and Mozzarella and 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Top with layer of noodles. Pour remaining sauce over spreading evenly to cover edges of noodles. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan.

title: Cinnamon Toast Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Add salt flour and baking powder. Mix well. Blend in nuts. Divide and shape dough into 6 loaves. Lightly grease cookie sheet. Place 3 loaves on cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven; slice loaves. Dip sliced cookies in cinnamon sugar and return to oven. Toast for 10 minutes. Repeat with the remaining 3 loaves. Cool and serve. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Peel and core pears. Grind pears onions and peppers in food chopper. Place in saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cook 30 minutes. Stir frequently. Remove spice bag. Pour into hot sterilized jars. Leave 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust lids. Process 5 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 8 to 10 pints.

title: Reindeer Cookies
instructions: Place the cookie dough in the freezer for 15 minutes or until firm. Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Cut the dough into 24 slices and place the slices 2-inches apart on a large ungreased cookie sheet. Pinch each slice 1/3 of the way down until 1/2-inch wide. Position 2 pretzels at the top of each slice to form antlers then use brown M&Ms to create eyes and red ones to make noses. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Salt and pepper chops. Put in shallow pan. Combine brown sugar ketchup and water. Spoon over chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cover for first half of baking time. Uncover for last half. Turn chops at least once.

title: Corn Flake Candy
instructions: Combine the butter milk brown and white sugars in a pan. Let it come to a boil 1 or 2 minutes. Take off the heat and add the cornflakes pecans and peanut butter; beat until smooth. Drop onto waxed paper by the teaspoonful. Allow to stand for at least 20 minutes before serving.

title: Nut Bread Delight
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in loaf pan.

title: Pudding Pizza
instructions: Allow cookie dough to warm slightly. Place dough on an ungreased pizza pan or baking dish. Press evenly to bottom and sides to form crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool.

title: Tabouli Salad
instructions: Soak bulgar in the lemon juice. Set aside. Prepare chopped ingredients. Add to bulgar when lemon juice has been absorbed. Mix all together add salt and pepper and add olive oil last. Adjust seasoning. This is a nice vegetarian salad served with pita bread.

title: Tomato - Pear Relish
instructions: Cook 1 hour slow. Add pimentos the last 3 minutes. Makes 5 pints.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order given and mix lightly. Pack firmly into a greased small loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Pour off juice and turn loaf onto warm platter. Serve with mixture of mushroom soup and 1/4 cup milk stirred constantly. Pour some of the sauce over the loaf to serve and the rest in a side dish.

title: Liver In Herbed Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cut liver into strips 1 inch wide. Cover with boiling water. Then drain thoroughly. Mix flour seasoned salt and pepper in plastic bag. Add liver a few pieces at a time and shake until coated. Set aside.

title: Dreamy Apricot Salad
instructions: Combine gelatin sugar and water in a saucepan; bring to a boil stirring to dissolve sugar and gelatin. Remove from heat and stir in fruit; set aside to cool.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Put potatoes in a greased bake dish. Pour first mixture over potatoes. Mix cornflakes and the last margarine together; sprinkle on top of mixture. Bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add nuts and spices then flour and fruit last. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 (15 for electric stove). For softer cookie bake 8 to 9 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 items in bowl. Pour into pie crust. Top with second pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Hot Water Cornbread
instructions: Combine cornmeal salt and oil. Pour hot water and mix. Add flour and baking powder. Mix well. Blend in egg. Make 8 to 10 patties. Cook in hot oil in skillet or in the oven on greased cooking sheet until browned on both sides. Takes 10 to 15 minutes on top of stove and 20 to 25 minutes in the oven.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift flour; measure. Add baking powder and salt; sift again. Cream butter or margarine thoroughly; gradually add sugar creaming until fluffy. Add beaten eggs flavoring and liquid. Add and blend in flour one-third at a time. Dough should be soft but just firm enough to roll out on a lightly floured board to about 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with floured 2 to 3-inch cookie cutter. Lift with spatula to ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at shelf position B (below center of oven) for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Cookies may be brushed with milk or buttermilk and sprinkled with sugar before baking. Can also make these as drop cookies; edges will be brown on these.

title: Zucchini Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 in 8-inch square nonstick baking dish for 55 to 60 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Broiled Herbed Chicken(Serves Four)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lift the skin of the chicken carefully with your fingers being careful not to tear it or detach it except from the main part of the flesh. You are forming pockets in it. Soften butter. Chop parsley and blend it in until you have a slightly greenish paste. Add thyme.

title: For Goodness Sakes Salad
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve the gelatins in boiling water. Cool slightly. Stir in the milk pineapple nuts and horseradish sauce; mix well. Chill until partially set. Pour into an oiled 8-cup mold. Chill for 6 hours or overnight. Unmold and serve on a bed of lettuce leaves.

title: Mother'S Chicken Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Ham B.B.Q.'S
instructions: Melt butter worcestershire sauce and brown sugar in pot. Add ketchup water and relish to suit. Add chipped ham that has been pulled apart. Heat thoroughly.

title: Grilled Tuna Steaks
instructions: Cover steaks with dressing and let stand in refrigerator 2 hours. Twenty minutes before you are ready to cook preheat grill. Cook over medium coals for 5 to 10 minutes on each side until meat flakes easily with a fork.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Stir in corn cheese and corn bread mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Good for church suppers.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Separate rolls into triangles. Place points inward. In ungreased pizza pan press together to form a crust. Sprinkle with sausage potatoes and cheese. Beat eggs water and seasonings together. Pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Christmas Trees
instructions: Cream butter in large mixing bowl; gradually add sugar and gelatin beating at medium speed. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Use a cookie gun to shape dough as desired following the manufacturers instructions. Place cookies on ungreased cookie sheet. Garnish if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Baked Noodle Ring
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain well and keep hot. Melt butter in saucepan. Stir in flour to make a smooth paste. Add salt and pepper. Stir in milk and cream a little at a time. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thickened. Beat egg yolks until light and lemon colored. Stir small amount of hot mixture into egg yolks. Add yolks all at once to that mixture. Continue to cool 1 minute. Beat egg whites until they hold peak.

title: Banana Puddin
instructions: After mixing vanilla pudding as directed by the box (wire whisk works great) add Eagle Brand milk; whisk. Then add the Cool Whip; whisk. Lay vanilla wafers on the bottom of the pan you plan to use; top each wafer with a slice of banana. Next pour pudding mixture over bananas. Slide wafers down along the sides of the pan.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients. Put in refrigerator until chilled. Roll out. Sprinkle with sugar. Cut with cookie cutter. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Chicken Skroodle Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; let cool. Remove meat and cut in bite sized pieces. Use chicken broth to cook Skroodles. Follow directions on package for cooking these. Saute celery and green pepper in butter; add pimentos. Mix all together. Add Greek seasoning and salt to taste. Mixture will be soupy; bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 45 minutes or until brown and fairly firm.

title: Hollywood Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon and beef. Cook noodles; drain and cool. Dice cheese and add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. This casserole may be frozen and cooked later or refrigerated overnight.

title: Vinaigrette For Salad And Tomatoes
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl. This recipe has been used at LeBistro for 20 years. Spoon over any fresh salad mixture. Also excellent over tomatoes and asparagus with fresh red onion.

title: Spicy Fettucine
instructions: Brown sausage; add onion pepper and mushrooms and saute until tender. Add tomatoes and green chilies. Simmer 10 minutes or until meat is completely cooked. Serve over fettucine. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chinese Butterscotch Clusters
instructions: Melt chips over medium heat; remove from heat. Stir in peanuts and noodles. Use heaping teaspoonfuls of prepared mixture. Drop on waxed paper to form clusters. Let cool before serving.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together. Great with country style ribs.

title: Cranberry Relish(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Place all ingredients in food grinder (leave orange unpeeled). Mix thoroughly. Refrigerate 1 or 2 days. Add another orange if too tart.

title: Chocolate Sheath Cake
instructions: Mix the sugar and flour in a bowl; do not sift. Combine margarine cocoa Crisco and water in 2-quart saucepan. Bring to boil; pour over dry ingredients and stir. Add eggs and buttermilk soda and vanilla. Bake in an 11 x 18-inch pan for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage. Sprinkle 1 1/4 teaspoons salt over top of cabbage. While cabbage wilts mix in jar or shaker sugar mayonnaise vinegar and milk. Stir cabbage and add dressing.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix desired amount to taste into boiling water.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cut potatoes into bite-size pieces. Melt margarine soup cheese and onion together. Then stir in potatoes. Pour into casserole dish. Top with corn flake crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice. Cook broccoli until tender; add onion. Mix rice and broccoli with Cheez Whiz. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Chews
instructions: Bring to 240\u00b0. Pour into a buttered sheet cake pan. Cool cut and wrap.

title: Chocoholic'S Petite Custards
instructions: Place eggs chocolate chips sugar vanilla and salt in blender. Heat milk just to simmer and add to ingredients in blender. Whirl on low for 1 full minute. Pour into demitasse cups. Chill until firm for 3 hours or more. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream. Can be frozen. Can add walnuts. Can be made with Baileys Irish cream in lieu of milk.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Stir cherries (do not drain) water and sugar together in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Cut up butter on top. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Continental Chicken
instructions: Line bottom of pan with the dried beef. Wrap each breast with bacon slice and put on top of dried beef. Bake at 400\u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes. Pour off bacon fat. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and cover. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter in large bowl. Gradually add sugar mixing well at medium speed. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Mix just until blended after each addition. Stir in flavorings. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Oriental Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Precook wild rice in 3 cups water until tender. Dont drain. (Cover with water and bring to a boil; turn heat down and simmer 45 to 60 minutes.) Brown ground beef and saute onion celery and green pepper. Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sour Cream Pancakes
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add eggs buttermilk and sour cream. Beat until blended. Stir in melted butter. If thinner pancakes are desired add more buttermilk.

title: Salty Chicken
instructions: Skin chicken; place on grill. Baste with sauce made from ingredients for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is done.

title: Mummies
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Separate crescent roll squares from roll. Spread each square and roll up a hotdog in crescent roll. Bake on a cookie sheet for 12-15 minutes (until rolls are golden brown). Remove from oven and let cool. Once cooled dip toothpick in mustard and dot two eyes on one end of each hot dog.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix well and fry in deep fat. Wonderful to serve with fried fish.

title: 9 Day Slaw
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and set aside. Take Wesson oil vinegar and sugar; bring to a boil. Pour over cabbage mixture while hot. Cover and put in icebox.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat first 6 ingredients until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Combine dry ingredients and blend into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Frito Pie
instructions: Heat chili. Spread a layer of Fritos chili and then cheese. Repeat this order. Heat at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Clam Fritters
instructions: Drain clams reserving 1/3 cup juice. Combine Bisquick salt and thyme. Add egg clam juice and clams. Stir. Drop from tablespoons into hot oil. Fry until golden. Drain on paper towels. Makes 24 and may be frozen. For a couple recipe use 3 cans of clams.

title: Vegetarian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil. Add tomatoes and break up with spoon. Add tomato paste vegetables (raw ones first); anything goes peppers carrots zucchini mushrooms corn squash broccoli beans etc. Add spices. Simmer about 45 minutes until vegetables are tender. Stir in 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese if you like the sauce to be thicker. Very low in calories and fat.

title: Ranch Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Omit salt from mashed potatoes.

title: Potato-Corn Chowder
instructions: You will also need vegetable cooking spray.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Steam carrots broccoli and pea pods together until crisp-tender; cool. Cook fettuccine in chicken broth just until tender; drain and cool. Combine vegetables and pasta. Add basil to prepared salad dressing. Toss gently into pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and fresh parsley.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Melt shortening in heavy Dutch oven over high fire. Add flour and stir until it is light brown. Lower heat; add shrimp and cook 3 minutes or until pink. Add garlic onion parsley and bell pepper and cook 2 minutes longer. Raise heat; gradually add water then remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil then simmer covered for 1 hour. Serve very hot over fluffy rice. Serves 4. Doubles easily. Freezes well.

title: Norwegian Slaw
instructions: Mix together chopped or shredded cabbage with salt. Let stand for 2 hours. Boil the sugar and vinegar and add to the cabbage. Then add the mustard seed celery seed green pepper and celery; mix well. Keeps several days in Tupperware or plastic containers. Use as desired.

title: Ethel'S Gooseberry Cobbler
instructions: Line 9-inch square pan with pie crust. Mix together flour and sugar. Spread half of the mixture over the pie crust in the pan. Dot with butter. Add gooseberries and water. Sprinkle remaining flour and sugar mixture over the berries; dot with butter again. Cover with top crust. Sprinkle a little sugar on top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until nicely browned.

title: Diabetes Peach Pie
instructions: Mix tapioca into white grape juice and let soak 10 minutes. Add lemon juice and cook until thickened. Pour over peaches and turn into pastry-lined pie tin. Top with pastry topping. Bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0 then lower to 375\u00b0. Bake 35 to 40 minutes longer. Yields 8 servings.

title: Dove Buttered Biscuits
instructions: Mix altogether. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake until brown at 400\u00b0.

title: Moravian White Christmas Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients to butter. Add it to liquid. Chill several hours and roll out. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Quick Tomato Jam
instructions: Boil tomatoes with sugar for 10 minutes. Add sliced lemon and lemon gelatin; boil fo 10 minutes. Put in hot sterilized jars and seal.

title: Mudder'S Buttermilk Pies
instructions: Mix sugar and flour together in a bowl. Add eggs buttermilk butter and vanilla to bowl. Pour mixture into 2 pie crusts and bake in oven at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 pies.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix lettuce cheese onion and beans. This can be covered and stirred in refrigerator. Just before serving add chips and dressing. Toss.

title: Hot Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix and put first three ingredients in buttered casserole. Mix other ingredients together and put on top of casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and freeze.

title: Kugel Cake
instructions: Grease 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan. Cook medium egg noodles. When done drain. Put noodles back in pot. While still hot add margarine. Stir with a spoon sugar vanilla and Ricotta cheese plus sour cream. Add eggs. Blend together.

title: Glazed Yams
instructions: Combine the syrup sugar water butter and cinnamon and heat to boiling point. Pour over yams which have been peeled halved or sliced and arrange in a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat cracker crumbs milk salt pepper onion and flour. Lightly brown onion in butter; add to meat mixture. Shape into balls; lightly brown in same pan as onion. Put in 2-quart casserole dish. Cover with soup (plus 1/2 can of water). Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes then uncover for 10 more minutes.

title: Mmmpossible Cheesecake
instructions: Place milk vanilla eggs sugar and Bisquick in blender for 15 seconds on high. Add cream cheese and beat for 2 minutes on high. Pour into greased pie plate and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40-45 minutes until center is firm. Let cool.

title: Microwave Potatoes
instructions: Slice unpeeled potatoes by hand or in food processor and place into a casserole dish sprayed with Pam sprinkling seasoned salt as you go. Place pats of butter on top of potatoes and sprinkle with chives. Cover with Parmesan cheese if desired. Cover dish with paper towel or vented plastic wrap. Cook on High in microwave 10 to 12 minutes. Stir midway through cooking cycle. (Cooking time will vary.) Garnish with sour cream or serve as is.

title: Beans Vinaigrette
instructions: Mix all ingredients except green beans and bring to a boil. Drain 4 cans of beans leaving liquid in 1 can. Heat all green beans. Pour dressing mixture over beans and let marinate overnight. Serve hot or cold. Serves 125.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion in salted water 5 minutes drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Shred raw carrots and stir in. Fold in zucchini and onion. Combine stuffing and margarine. Spread 1/2 of stuffing in 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon mixture on top then rest of stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Select a plump chicken. Dress. Cut in pieces. Place in saucepan. Cover with boiling water. Add celery salt and pepper. Cover. Simmer slowly until chicken is tender. Prepare dumpling dough.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Brown Italian sausage; drain. In a large bowl combine first 6 ingredients. Boil manicotti shells for 8 minutes; drain. Spray 9 x 13-inch glass dish with Pam. Cover bottom with Prego (1/2 jar). Stuff shells with mixture and place in dish. Cover the stuffed shells with the remaining Prego. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Put remaining mixture over the top and bake for another 10 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes; serve.

title: Spiced Nuts
instructions: Beat egg white and water until frothy but not stiff. Add pecans and mix until all the nuts are coated. Mix sugar salt and cinnamon. Add to the nuts. Mix again. Place on jelly roll pan or shallow tray. Bake in oven at 225\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: In large skillet cook meat in oil over medium heat until browned and liquid is absorbed. Add 3 cups water and bouillon. Stir together cornstarch soy sauce and remaining water. Add to skillet and cook stirring constantly until thickened and clear. Add celery cook over medium 5 to 8 minutes. Add green peppers; cook 5 minutes longer. Serve over hot rice or noodles with additional soy sauce if desired.

title: St. Patrick'S Day Dinner
instructions: Combine beef garlic bay leaf and broth. Cover and cook in a 300\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove cover and add vegetables. Cover again and continue cooking approximately 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

title: Chocolate Sheath Cake
instructions: In saucepan put oleo shortening cocoa and cold water. Bring to boil. Pour hot mixture over flour and sugar. Mix well. Add buttermilk vanilla cinnamon salt soda and eggs. Mix well. Pour on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Canned Pickled Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half (small tomatoes leave whole). Cover tomatoes with vinegar and water mixture. Slice onions and peppers. Add sugar. Cook until the tomato skins turn loose from tomatoes. Pour up into jars and seal. Good with beans collards and vegetables.

title: Skillet Chicken And Rice
instructions: In a large skillet melt butter; add rice and mushrooms with liquid. Add dry onion soup and mix. Add chicken and water; mix well. Turn skillet to low and cook covered about 30 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Decadent Pineapple Lime Gelatin Salad(Sugar-Free, Low Sodium)
instructions: Bring pineapple with juice to boil in saucepan. Dissolve gelatin in pineapple well. Remove from heat. Add buttermilk and stir until well mixed. Add pecans and stir. Spray 8-inch square glass pan with Canola non-stick spray and pour gelatin mixture into pan.

title: Pecan Chess Pie
instructions: Melt oleo and add sugar and other ingredients. Bake at 275\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add steamed broccoli and all other ingredients. Mix well. Heat until boiling. Serve in a chafing dish with melba toast.

title: Not Edible Glue Dough
instructions: Mix flour cornstarch and glue. Add water as needed. Knead dough until workable.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables in large bowl. Mix together sour cream salad dressing vinegar sugar salt dill celery seed and garlic cloves. Pour over vegetables and toss well. Pour peas over top. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Moist N' Creamy Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool 15 minutes; then poke holes down through cake with a fork.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Slowly stir in hot milk. Pour at once into unbaked pie shell. Dash the top with nutmeg. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to 425\u00b0 and bake for 10 minutes longer or until knife inserted is clean.

title: Sherbet Punch
instructions: Simple and pretty for your party table. Serves 15.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
