instructions: Combine potatoes 1/2 cup margarine onions soup sour cream and cheese. Mix well and put into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.

title: Peanut Butter Delights
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa butter milk and salt in saucepan. Bring mixture to hard boil. Let boil 2 minutes. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Same Day Sauerbraten
instructions: Brown meat in heavy pot; drain off fat and add 3/4 cup water. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Remove meat and cut in 1/2-inch slices and return to pot. In another pan boil 3/4 cup water and remaining ingredients. Use seasonings to taste. Pour over meat; cover and simmer until fork-tender (about 1 1/2 hours). Add water if necessary. Thicken with flour and water mixture off heat. Simmer until flour is cooked stirring often. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: In a large pan add bouillon cubes to water; bring to boil and add chicken breasts. When chicken is done remove from broth. Return broth to boil and then add 16-ounces thin spaghetti and diced green onions. While spaghetti is cooking cube chicken breasts.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets until done then peel and grate with large grater. Add 1 tsp. salt and mix slightly. Melt 1/2 cube butter. Remove from heat and add diluted soup sour cream green onions and grated cheese. Fold this mixture with potatoes. Place in buttered casserole and cover top with cornflake crumbs. Bake in oven at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Let jello almost set then whip. Add 1 cup whipped cottage cheese. Add 1 cup drained pineapple and mix. Fold in 1 cup Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: Grandma'S Smothered Chicken
instructions: * I use fatback grease it is better.

title: Misty Chicken
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients and heat until thick. Then add the next four ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until golden brown. Spray a 9 x 9-inch pan or oblong dish.

title: Breakfast Brunch Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage in large skillet over medium heat until done. Drain in colander. Combine with remaining ingredients in large mixing bowl. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve hot. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine chicken enchilada sauce chicken soup onion and garlic salt. Line a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish with about 2/3 of the tortilla chips. Pour chicken mixture over chips. Sprinkle with cheese and cover with remaining tortilla chips. Pour chicken broth over chips and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Serve with Spanish rice and refried beans.

title: Moist Chocolate Cake
instructions: Dissolve cocoa in boiling water and mix hot coffee with soda. Cream shortening and sugar. Add all but baking powder and flour. Add baking powder to flour and add to creamed mixture. Beat until flour disappears. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. May use 13 x 9-inch pan or 2 round pans. Dust cooled cake with powdered sugar or frost with your favorite frosting. Moist enough to enjoy without frosting.

title: Gelatin Flavored Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Ad gelatin (any flavor) for color. Add dry ingredients to butter and sugar; mix well. Press dough through cookie press. Sprinkle with gelatin. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 80 cookies.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Mix egg sugar margarine and dates in saucepan. Cook until dates are soft and mixture is thick. Place saucepan in ice water until mix is cool enough to handle. Add Rice Krispies and nuts and mix quickly. Shape into small balls and roll in coconut.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Break lettuce into bowl until half full. Add in layers celery onion green peppers peas cheese and bacon. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise together. Pour over salad. Refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: Brown meat over medium-high heat about 5 minutes stirring to break up chunks. Drain off fat. Stir in salsa and beans. Bring to a simmer; cover and cook 25 to 30 minutes stirring often until flavors are blended. Makes 3 cups.

title: Oriental Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak into diagonal strips about 1/4 x 2-inches. Preheat large skillet; sprinkle salt into skillet. Brown meat. Mix garlic ginger sugar and soy sauce; stir into meat. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Add onion and bean sprouts. Cover and simmer for 5 more minutes. Make a smooth paste of cornstarch and reserved liquid; stir slowly into hot mixture and cook until liquid thickens. Place green peppers and tomatoes on top. Cover; steam 3 minutes or until peppers are cooked tender-crisp. Serve over rice (broccoli can be substituted for bean sprouts).

title: Hot Sausage And Cheese Pinwheels
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls leaving in rectangles. Spread sausage evenly and sprinkle generously with cheese. Roll into logs. Chill until firm. Bake for 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven on ungreased cookie sheet. Cool about 20 minutes. Slice into 4 to 5 slices per roll. Serve with mustard. Serves 6.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix together mushroom soup celery soup and milk. Put uncooked rice in bottom of 8 x 11-inch dish. Layer turkey next. Pour soup mixture over and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Dessert
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add syrup; cool slightly.

title: Mom'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Heat milk to scalding (bubbles around edge of pan). Pour milk over bread cubes. Cool and add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Soda
instructions: For each serving pour syrup and milk into a chilled 14-ounce or 16-ounce glass; mix well. Add chilled carbonated water to fill glass 3/4 full. Stir. Add 1 to 2 scoops vanilla ice cream. Fill to top with carbonated water.

title: Norwegian Toast Cookies(Tebrod)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order given. Dough should be sticky but not real glossy. You may have to add a tablespoon or so more flour. On a greased cookie sheet spoon and shape into 3 loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven; slice loaves. Arrange slices cut side down on cookie sheet and bake another 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until golden brown. Each loaf makes 18 slices. To make daintier slices make loaves larger or narrower. These are very good.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water until almost tender. Drain. Arrange on bottom of greased casserole. Lay boned chicken breasts on top. Mix mayo soup and lemon juice and pour over chicken. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 and then turn off oven. Lay sliced Cheddar cheese on top and leave in oven until melted.

title: Ground Beef Grandstyle
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions. Drain. Combine softened cream cheese soup and milk. Add salt ketchup and hamburger. Mix thoroughly. Put in a 2 qt. casserole dish and bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 10 minutes. Place biscuits on top and bake 15-20 minutes longer or until golden brown.

title: Anzac Cookies(Australian-New Zealand Army Corps)
instructions: Melt margarine and syrup. Add to dry ingredients. Dissolve soda in boiling water. Add to other ingredients. Place on greased cookie sheet by teaspoon size. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Mexican Spiced Bean Salad
instructions: Prepare dressing according to package directions; and set aside. Open and drain all beans and corn. Toss together in a large bowl with sliced onions. Toss again with dressing and let it set for at least one or more hours.

title: Hot Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in an ovenproof dish and heat at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Plump raisins by soaking in boiling water. Soak them covered for 30 minutes. Drain and allow to dry. In a large bowl combine raisins peanuts onion bacon and broccoli. In another bowl combine mayonnaise brown sugar and vinegar. Pour over broccoli. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
instructions: Blend oatmeal; measure and blend in a blender to a fine powder. Cream the butter and both sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together with the flour oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. Add chips candy and nuts. Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake for 6 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In large bowl combine milk and water. Add pudding mix. Mix well. Chill for 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture in a 2 1/2-quart serving dish. Top with a 1/3 each wafers bananas pudding. Repeat layers twice ending with pudding. Chill and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion\ttogether until tender. Season with salt pepper and sugar to\ttaste.\tMix with soup sour cream and beaten egg. Melt butter and\tmix with stuffing in separate container.\tSpread 1/3 of stuffing mixture on bottom of casserole dish. Layer half\tof squash mixture spread 1/3 crumbs on top of mixture then rest of squash then rest of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tailgate Chicken Wings
instructions: Disjoint chicken wings and discard tips. Stir all others together for marinade. Marinate overnight in plastic bag turning a few times. To cook place in flat pan so they can spread out and bake at 350\u00b0 for more than an hour basting with marinade until its gone and wings are glazed. Sue cooks them about an hour and a half.

title: Red Cabbage Simplified
instructions: Prepare the cabbage. Melt the butter and saute the onion. Add brown sugar vinegar and caraway seed. Add the cabbage and cook it for 25 minutes. Stir it frequently. Canned red cabbage may be substituted. Cook about 5 minutes.

title: Oven Meatballs
instructions: Mix Stove Top as directed. Chop pepper and onion and mix with stuffing. Add A.1. sauce; mix this with raw hamburger. Make into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and spoon soup over meatballs and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Touch O Spice Cider
instructions: In a saucepan simmer cider water and spices together for 10 minutes. Serve warm garnished with an orange slice.

title: Chicken Escallops
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper; set aside for later. Combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese set aside for later. Open each breast and lay on waxed paper pound flat with mallet. Dredge with flour mixture refrigerate 1/2 hour. Combine egg and water whip. Dip each floured breast in egg mixture drain thoroughly. Coat each with bread crumb-cheese mixture press coating on firmly with knife blade. Cover lightly and refrigerate 1/2 hour for coating to firm. Heat oil in heavy skillet until bread cube sizzles gently and browns on the edges. Fry each escallop in hot oil 4 minutes on each side or until thoroughly cooked. Place on serving platter and drizzle with hot chicken gravy if desired.

title: Butterscotch Whole Wheat Squares
instructions: Put into 2 (8-inch) greased and dusted cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump fruit cocktail sugar flour soda salt and eggs in bowl and stir together. Pour into prepared 9 x 13-inch or 2 round pans. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Glaze while hot.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a 3-quart casserole. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Sourdough
instructions: In a bowl sprinkle yeast over warm water. Stir until dissolved. Blend in sugar. Add enough flour to make a pancake batter type consistency. Make the dough the night before and let stand on counter. Each time a portion is used add 1 cup water and flour to make same consistency. Use recipe to make biscuits or cinnamon rolls.

title: Dill Dip For Veggies
instructions: Stir together; let sit overnight to let flavors soak through. Serve with all types of raw veggies.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Combine meat rice egg parsley onion salt pepper and 1/4 cup soup. Mix thoroughly. Shape in about 20 small balls and place in skillet. Mix remaining soup water and Worcestershire. Pour over meatballs. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 40 minutes stirring often. Makes 4 or 5 servings.

title: Lemon Lust
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 cup Cool Whip and confectioners sugar until soft and creamy. Spread over cooled crust. Mix milk and pudding mix. Spoon over top and spread out. Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Spoonbreaker Chocolate Chip Cookies(Ask Greg How These Got Their Name!)
instructions: Grind oatmeal and Hershey bar (broken into small pieces) in food processor or blender until oatmeal resembles coarse flour. In large bowl cream butter and sugars; add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients; mix well then add chips and nuts. Put spoonfuls 2 inches apart onto cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 9 to 10 dozen.

title: Chocolate Syrup Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Supreme
instructions: Mix flour nuts and margarine together like pie crust and pat firmly into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken And Ham Bake
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender. Place ham in casserole dish. Place chicken over ham. Mix sour cream soup and cheese. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: English Toffee
instructions: Cook butter sugar and water on high until color of brown grocery bag about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in pecans. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay Hershey bars on top. After they melt spread out. Cut or break into serving pieces.

title: Dump Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple juice into a bowl and slice bananas into it. Let set for 10 minutes then drain. Drain 1 can of oranges. Combine all fruits and mix. Chill.

title: Bacon Chestnuts
instructions: Make a day ahead to marinate. Wrap each chestnut in 1/2 slice bacon; lay in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Drain fat. Then mix and pour over the following brown sugar granulated sugar and catsup. Refrigerate overnight and then bake again for 30 minutes or until bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: M'S Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix pineapple cornstarch sugar and salt. Cook until clear and thick stirring constantly. Take off heat and add butter and lemon juice. Pour into 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Kate'S Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Knead until dough leaves your hands. Form into 9 balls. Roll each ball out on floured board and spread with poppy seed filling. Roll up. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Campers Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Line casserole dish with chips. Add meat beans taco seasoning and water mixed. Add Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes to melt cheese. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions. In saucepan simmer milk butter Cheez Whiz and sharp cheeses stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and creamy. Stir in Mozzarella cheese. Continue stirring until Mozzarella is partly melted. Pour mixture into casserole dish. Break up bread into pieces over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop with teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. This recipe is 100 years old!!!

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients let come to a boil. When cool dip pieces of chicken in sauce. Pour remaining sauce over chicken. It can be used on pork also. Recipe will cover one. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: In a large pot combine the dry beans and enough water to cover them. Soak overnight. Bring beans and water to a boil; boil for 2 minutes then remove pot from heat. Let stand for 1 hour. Combine beans and juice with remaining ingredients. Put this mixture into a casserole. Cover. Bake 5 hours at 300\u00b0. If liquid evaporates add more water.

title: Crisp Crusted Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry. Set aside. Beat egg and milk in a bowl. In another bowl mix potato flakes garlic powder and cheese. Roll chicken first in egg mix then in the potato flake mixture. Melt butter in a shallow baking pan. Roll coated chicken pieces in the butter and place skin side up in a pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until juices from thighs run clear when pierced with a fork.

title: Diabetic Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Cook cake according to directions adding 1 to 2 teaspoons strawberry flavoring. Put in a square baking dish (8 or 9-inch size). When cool cut in half then split layers. Mix whipped topping according to directions. Add 2 teaspoons strawberry flavoring.

title: Dave'S Midwest Chili
instructions: Chop onion into 1/4-inch pieces. Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Add ground beef-onion mixture to beans and tomatoes in a 2 1/2-quart crock-pot. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Stir sugar butter milk and salt together; bring to a boil. Stir constantly until soft ball forms in cold water. Remove from heat; immediately add chocolate chips and Marshmallow Fluff. Keep stirring until everything is dissolved. Add nuts if desired. Pour immediately into buttered pan; cut when lukewarm or when knife cuts cleanly.

title: Indonesian Pork Butt Roast
instructions: Brown pork butt in its own fat. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over meat and cover. Simmer turning meat 2 or 3 times for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until very tender. Remove meat to platter. Slice and serve with plain or curried rice and applesauce.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat oil and eggs together. Add sugar and vanilla; mix well. Blend in flour and cinnamon. Add apples and nuts and mix well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Franks
instructions: Cut franks in 1-inch pieces. Melt jelly mustard and bourbon over medium heat; stir in franks. Simmer until franks are cooked and sauce is thickened slightly. Serve in a chafing dish.

title: Aunt Adele'S Pickles
instructions: Mix brine ingredients together bring to boil and cool.

title: Crabbies
instructions: Melt butter; stir in ingredients. Spread mixture on top of English muffins. Broil until slightly crispy and bubbly. Cut into fourths.

title: 100% Parmesan Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix cheese margarine and Italian seasoning. Spread on each slice of bread. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. This is a great way to doctor up stale bread.

title: One Bowl Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees (325 glass pan). Microwave chocolate and butter in a large bowl on high until melted. Stir in sugar and cocoa until well blended. Mix in egg beaters and vanilla until well blended. Stir in flour until blended. Spread in greased foil line 13 x 9 baking pan. Bake 30-35 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out with fudgy crumbs.

title: Desert Rat Rabbit
instructions: Cut your rabbit up as you would chicken. Unless youve got a young one under 4 pounds throw the hind legs to your dog (bone the meat first rabbit bones are brittle and could hurt your old buddy). The reason for this is that the hind legs of an adult jackrabbit are so gamey and strong that no amount of kitchen trickery will render them edible. Wash the pieces and set them to soak overnight in a gallon of salt water with a 1/2 cup of vinegar. Pour off the salt water and rinse. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and let simmer as slowly as possible for at least an hour. Remove from water and let cool. Put some seasoned flour in a paper bag and drop in rabbit pieces and shake until flour covers them. Heat a little bacon grease or other oil in a big iron skillet. Brown both sides of rabbit at high heat; reduce heat to low simmer. Add a little water and cover skillet so rabbit will steam. Should be done in about 30 minutes to an hour. Poke with a fork to check tenderness. Serve like fried chicken.

title: Pork Chop And Rice Casserole
instructions: Put rice in casserole dish. Layer pork chops on top of rice. Pour soup over casserole. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Salad
instructions: Cook until boiling. Fold in handful of marshmallows in hot sauce. Set overnight. Prepare whipping cream as directed. Crush up peanuts. Then layer bananas sauce and nuts. Repeat and layer until bowl is full.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Spray a 9 X 13 pan. Put rice on bottom. Mix together soup mix soup and water. Cover with foil and bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Suggestion You can freeze leftovers for up to 30 days.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a saucepan boil margarine water and cocoa. Pour this while hot over dry ingredients (flour sugar and salt). In a bowl beat buttermilk vanilla soda and eggs. Add to first mixture. Bake in a large greased cake pan or jelly roll pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Frost with powdered sugar frosting while cake is warm.

title: Garbage Salsa For Chili
instructions: Steam green beans seven minutes only. Run cold water over them to stop the cooking. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender. Cook flour butter and milk until thickened. Add cheese and stir until melted. Prepare 1/2 package of the stuffing mix using water and butter as directed. Add onion and celery.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ham cheese broccoli and soup in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Stir remaining ingredients until dough forms. Drop by spoonfuls evenly over broccoli mixture. Bake uncovered for 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serves 4.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Marinate deer strips (1/8-inch thick) for 2 days. Use dehydrator or 170\u00b0 oven (place on racks with toothpicks until dry or right consistency).

title: Mary'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Chill milk in freezer until milk just starts to crystallize. Add water to gelatine and Jell-O and refrigerate until edge of Jell-O is thick. Whip cream cheese and sugar together and set aside. Melt butter; add to crumbs and pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Whip the chilled milk until thick like whipping cream. Fold in cream cheese mixture. Add gelatine. On low speed blend entire mixture until everything folds in. Pour over graham cracker crust. Top with cherry or blueberry pie filling or sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs.

title: Christmas Wassail
instructions: Pour cranberry juice pineapple juice water and brown sugar into a 20-cup percolator. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Place remaining ingredients in percolator basket. Perk through complete cycle. Serve hot. Makes 16 cups.

title: Easy Italian Casserole
instructions: Brown the ground beef and onion. Drain and mix with the other ingredients except cheese. Bake for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend cream cheese green onions Worcestershire sauce soy sauce Accent and 1/3 of the dried beef mixing well. Form into a ball. Lay rest of beef on wax paper or foil. Roll cheese ball in the beef to form outer coating. Chill in refrigerator and serve with party crackers.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Cook and stir ground beef and onion over medium heat until beef is brown; drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spread in pie plate. Beat eggs milk and baking mix until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes. Top with tomatoes sprinkle with cheese. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 5 to 8 minutes longer. Cool 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in saucepan; stir in flour until lightly brown. Gradually add broth. Blend in cheese and stir until melted. Saute vegetables in remaining butter until translucent; cool slightly and puree in processor or blender. Soup may be made ahead to this point. At serving time combine cheese mixture with puree and heat gently. Add cream and seasonings; continue to heat gently and adjust seasoning. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Dessert Pizza (Fruit)
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla and pour over baked cookie dough.

title: Noodles
instructions: Mix together and roll thin. Let dry a little and cut.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook hamburger with taco seasoning. Add beans; break chips. Add all ingredients and mix well with dressing and Tabasco sauce. Mix in large bowl.

title: Icebox Slaw
instructions: Boil the vinegar vegetable oil celery seed and salt and pour over cabbage onions bell pepper and sugar. Put in refrigerator. This will keep in refrigerator for 3 weeks.

title: Blitz Torte
instructions: Cream shortening; beat in sugar and salt. Add beaten egg yolks vanilla milk and flour sifted with baking powder. Spread mixture in two round layer cake pans greased (this will barely cover bottom of pans). Beat egg whites until very light; add 3/4 cup sugar gradually. Spread meringue over batter in both pans. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes. Let cool. Put together with Cream Filling. Makes 1 (9-inch) layer cake.

title: Orange Or Lime Salad
instructions: Stir Jell-O and pineapple together. Add sour cream Cool Whip and nuts. Stir well. Will be ready to eat.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine milk and egg. Add Bisquick parsley onion and half the cheese. Pour into greased 8 or 9-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining cheese on batter. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Broiled Tomatoes
instructions: Cut top off tomatoes and put on baking sheet. Sprinkle lightly with crumbs and dot with butter. Broil until heated and lightly browned on top (or bake tomatoes in hot oven 425\u00b0 for about 10 minutes). Sometimes I use fresh bread cubes. Melt the butter in a very small pan and add bread cubes stirring until butter is absorbed. Then place the bread cubes on top of the tomatoes.

title: Grilled Potatoes
instructions: Cut foil to wrap 1 potato per person. Wash potatoes. Slice the potatoes about 1/4-inch slices all the way through.

title: Chicken Ala Prego
instructions: Beat egg. Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese together. Dip chicken in egg then in the crumbs. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; put some sauce on bottom of pan. Place chicken on top of sauce. Put remaining sauce on top of chicken. Bake covered 1 hour at 400\u00b0. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and melt in oven.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cook 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and drop. Cook about 5 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Rainbow Pasta Dinner
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water cook pasta until just tender 8 to 10 minutes. Drain then rinse with cold water and drain again. Transfer to a large bowl. Add all remaining ingredients except lettuce to pasta. Toss to blend well. Serve at room temperature or chilled on a bed of shredded lettuce.

title: Barbecue Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix soy sauce mustard brown sugar and garlic powder into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add chicken wings; coat well. Marinate 2 hours or more. Bake in same pan for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Baste while baking.

title: Waffles Or Pancakes
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together in mixing bowl. Add egg yolks and milk slowly beating it until batter is smooth. Add melted butter and stiffly beaten egg whites.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef onion salt and pepper. Drain well. Add all other ingredients and spaghetti. Simmer about 1/2 hour.

title: Delicious Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail and crushed pineapple well. Mix Eagle Brand milk with cream cheese well. Add lemon juice or Real Lemon. Blend well. Add Cool Whip with electric mixer. Stir in nuts and coconut with large spoon. Refrigerate.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed. In another skillet cook hamburger with onion and mushrooms until done. Drain off. Add spaghetti sauce and simmer about 15 minutes. Add to spaghetti with Parmesan cheese. Mix well in a casserole dish. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Cook until cheese is turning light brown in a moderate oven.

title: Cheddar Carousel
instructions: Combine all ingredients except preserves. Put in ring mold. Chill thoroughly. (Mixture will form together when chilled.) Unmold and fill center with preserves.

title: Nutty Cracker Delights
instructions: Place crackers in a single layer in a foil lined 15 x 10-inch baking pan. Melt butter. Add sugar and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Cook for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Pour evenly over crackers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven. Sprinkle chocolate chips and spread when chips melt. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and gently pat into chocolate. Cool in refrigerator for a few hours. Break into pieces.

title: Chicken San Angelo
instructions: Dredge chicken in flour and set aside. Heat oil in pan and add garlic and chicken. Brown chicken on both sides and season. Pour off oil and deglaze pan with white wine and chicken stock. Add broccoli artichoke hearts sun-dried tomatoes and roasted red peppers. Reduce liquid in pan by cooking until sauce is of the consistency you want. Add in softened butter and serve over pasta or rice.

title: Pickled Pears
instructions: Bring almost to a boil. Drop pears into mixture for 5 to 10 minutes. Check with ice pick for tenderness. As soon as you can stick ice pick through pears put in jars and seal.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate the potatoes and onions (if you are using them) with the grating disk of food processor or using the large holes of a hand-held grater. Transfer the potatoes and onions to a colander. Squeeze mixture to press out as much liquid as possible. Transfer to bowl. Mix in the egg salt pepper flour and baking powder.

title: Honey Nut Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl mix cereal oats nuts cinnamon and salt. In small saucepan mix butter honey and brown sugar. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until butter is melted and ingredients are well blended. Pour honey and butter mixture over cereal; mix until thoroughly coated. Spread into 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until mixture is golden brown turning occasionally. Immediately spread mixture onto waxed paper. Stir in raisins. Cool completely. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Donna'S Chocolate Logs
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine. Let it cool well. Add marshmallows and nuts and mix well. Tear off 3 pieces of aluminum foil. Divide chocolate into 3 parts and spread on foil. Roll it up; sprinkle coconut on candy as you roll them up. Refrigerate overnight. Cut in slices.

title: Top Of The Stove Cookies
instructions: Add together margarine sugar cocoa and milk. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Have ready peanut butter vanilla and pinch of salt. Add to boiling syrup and mix. Add oats 1 cup at a time mixing thoroughly. Drop by teaspoons on wax paper until cold.

title: Lemon Fish Fillets
instructions: Dot each fillet with butter and lightly sprinkle with salt. Broil about 3 minutes on each side.

title: Strawberry Mousse
instructions: Make jello as directed. Let it sit awhile but not until firm. Mix strawberries jello and Cool Whip. Put cake pieces in pan. Pour jello mixture over the cake and mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Chinese Noodle-Link Sausage
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Fry sausage in small pieces. Leave about 3 tablespoons fat in pan. Fry onion slightly. Add rest of ingredients. Place in 2\tquart casserole. Top with cheese. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Praline Pie
instructions: Bake crust 5 minutes. Add margarine brown sugar and nuts. Put back in oven and bake 10 more minutes. Let cool. Cover with vanilla pudding mix.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Blend with butter. Add eggs and vanilla and mix well. Add buttermilk. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Delicious Pecan Oat Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour boiling water over oatmeal and let stand. Mix sifted flour and baking powder and set aside. Cream butter brown sugar and flavoring well. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add dry ingredients alternating with oatmeal. Add nuts. Spoon in paper baking cups in muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 22 minutes. Makes 20 to 24.

title: Canadian Cheese Soup
instructions: In large Dutch oven saute onion celery and carrots in butter over medium heat for 5 minutes. Stir in chicken broth. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Combine dry ingredients and seasonings; gradually stir in milk. Add milk mixture to vegetables and broth mixture. Cover and simmer gently until thickened. Cut cheese into chunks. Add to soup mixture. Heat over very low heat stirring constantly just until cheese is melted.

title: Old Time Ketchup
instructions: Put the spices in spice bag. Cook until thick. May add 2 or 3 tablespoons cornstarch last for more thickness.

title: Apple Ann Cake
instructions: Mix and pour into an oblong greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Sprinkle top with sugar.

title: Cream Cheese Tarts
instructions: Beat well. Line muffin tins with papers. Put a vanilla wafer in the bottom of each paper. Put 3 tablespoons of ingredients on each wafer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Top with cherry or blueberry pie filling. Makes 24 tarts.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving pieces. Dredge in seasoned flour. Melt shortening and brown meat on both sides. Add onion celery green pepper tomato soup and water. Reduce heat. Cover and cook 45 to 60 minutes or until done. If desired thicken gravy with cornstarch dissolved in water.

title: Southwest White Chili
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat. Add chicken; cook 4 to 6 minutes stirring often. Remove chicken with slotted spoon. Cover and keep warm. Add chopped onion to saucepan. Cook 2 minutes. Stir in chicken broth green chilies garlic powder ground cumin oregano leaves cilantro and ground red pepper. Simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in cooked chicken and kidney beans. Simmer for 10 minutes. Garnish with cheese. Serves 4.

title: Avocado Dip
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon juice and mix in rest of ingredients (may blend all ingredients but avocado and lemon juice). Chill but serve at room temperature.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Combine oats flour and sugar. Mix in Parkay butter until mixture is crumbly. Place half of mixture on the bottom of a buttered pan. Spoon in pie filling on top of bottom mixture. Spread the remaining over the top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until lightly brown. Serve warm.

title: Turkey Pasta Salad
instructions: Stir together macaroni turkey celery and red pepper in large bowl. Stir together cream cheese sour cream and milk. Add to macaroni. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed. Crumble half cake in bottom of large bowl. Prepare pudding mix adding 1/2 cup extra milk. Layer with 1/2 cup of pineapple and 1/2 can pie filling. Cover with layer of Cool Whip and nuts. Repeat with remaining cake pineapple and pie filling.

title: Chicken Kabobs
instructions: You will also need 12 (6-inch) long skewers. On each skewer alternate chicken green pepper and apple. Repeat once. Place kabobs in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine lemon juice with oil. Brush on kabobs. Sprinkle with lemon pepper and salt. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Makes 4 servings.

title: Stir-Fried Green Beans
instructions: Wash and string beans. Cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Pour oil around top of preheated wok allow to heat for 2 minutes. Add beans. Stir-fry 3 minutes. Add chicken broth and sugar. Cover. Reduce heat and cook 10 minutes. Combine cornstarch and water; add to wok. Cook beans until thickened. Yields 4 servings.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar flour eggs and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Add vanilla oleo and bananas. Line bowl with wafers or cook in microwave on High for 3 minutes then stir. Continue until it thickens.

title: Two Layer Fruit Cake
instructions: Boil sweet milk sugar flour and eggs. Cook until thick and then add chopped nuts raisins coconut and vanilla. Then add candied fruit.

title: Guacamole(Mexican Dip)
instructions: Cut avocados in half and remove seeds. With a fork mash avocado flesh with onion and garlic until smooth. Blend in lemon juice and oil. Season to taste with salt black pepper cayenne and the sauces. Chill for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Graham Cracker Squares
instructions: Melt margarine; add sugar. Blend eggs and milk. Add to sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Cool. Stir in 1 cup graham cracker crumbs nuts and chocolate chips. Line bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with whole graham crackers. Spread mixture over crackers. Top with another layer of whole graham crackers. Spread with frosting and refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients; fold in chocolate chips last. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: In a large deep skillet heat butter. Add onion green pepper and garlic; saute 6 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat; stir in flour. Gradually add 2 1/2 cups of water stirring until smooth. Return to heat. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil stirring. Reduce heat to simmer. Cook covered stirring occasionally for about 30 minutes until rice is tender.

title: Peppered Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice with salt according to the directions on package. Grease casserole dish with butter. Layer the ingredients 1/2 the rice 1/2 the sour cream 1/2 the chilies and 1/2 the cheese. Repeat the layers. Dot the top with the butter. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with tinfoil. Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Picnic Cookies
instructions: Place sugar milk cocoa and margarine in large saucepan. Cook over heat until bubbly; stir often. Stir in oats and peanut butter. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Refrigerate until firm. Makes 36 cookies.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add peanut butter and 2 beaten eggs. Sift flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture then roll in small balls and place on a greased cookie sheet. Then press down with a fork. Bake 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven or until golden brown.

title: Easy Cheesy Spaghetti Bake
instructions: Brown meat; drain fat. Add water tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce mix and boil gently uncovered for 30 minutes. Stir often. Cook 3/4 pound spaghetti. Melt butter in medium saucepan. Add flour gradually and instant dry milk that has been mixed with water to make 1 3/4 cups liquid. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Add American cheese and Parmesan cheese and cook until cheese melts. Layer in baking dish as follows 1/2 spaghetti 1/2 sauce cheese sauce remaining spaghetti and remaining sauce. Top with 1/4 cup American cheese. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until bubbly.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook and drain vegetables. Arrange in greased baking dish. Layer poultry on top. Combine soup mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over poultry. Sprinkle buttered crumbs over it; top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until it bubbles.

title: Spinach Artichoke Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Thaw spinach and drain. Chop artichoke hearts into tiny pieces. Melt butter or margarine. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate or serve warm not hot.

title: Floyd'S Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix as any cake. Bake in 9 or 10-inch tube pan. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 80 minutes or until done.

title: Rhubarb Bars
instructions: Mix first seven ingredients together. Put 3/4 of oatmeal mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook last five ingredients together. Pour cooked rhubarb over oatmeal mixture. Top with remaining oatmeal mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes cool and cut into bars.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Thoroughly grease a (9-inch) spring-form pan. Mix crumbs with cinnamon 1/2 cup sugar and butter. Press crumbs over bottom and sides of pan.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Potatoes should be defrosted. Drop in boiling water for 3 or 4 minutes. Pour into greased casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cover with 2 cups crushed corn flakes with 1/4 cup melted margarine before baking.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over water and let dissolve. Add shortening sugar and flour. Mix together. Knead and roll and cut out. Let rise 20 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Makes about 1 dozen.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Cook cake as directed. Cool and crumble 1/2 on bottom of bowl. Mix 1 box of pudding as directed and pour over cake. Put 1 can of cherry pie filling over pudding. Pour juice from pineapple in a bowl. Use 1/2 can of pineapple over cherries. Dip bananas in juice and place on top. Repeat steps and let set overnight in refrigerator. When ready to serve top with Cool Whip. Makes 1 punch bowl or 2 large bowls full.

title: White Chocolate Haystacks
instructions: Line baking sheet with waxed paper. Melt the chocolate in top of double boiler over simmering water stirring until smooth and creamy. Add the nuts and pretzels stirring until well coated with chocolate. Remove the pan from heat. Spoon the mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheet. Cool to room temperature or refrigerate. Makes 32. The cookies may be refrigerated indefinitely.

title: Blueberry Nut Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Stir in milk and oil or margarine which has been melted. Mix and sift flour baking powder and salt; add to egg mixture with vanilla. Fold in blueberries and nut meats. Bake in a greased bread pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until bread tests done. Remove to rack to cool for 20 minutes; remove from pan to finish cooling. Quick breads generally slice better if set overnight.

title: Southern Angel Biscuits(Regular Recipe)
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in warm water; set aside. In a medium mixing bowl mix 3 1/2 cups of flour with other dry ingredients; cut in shortening. Stir in buttermilk yeast mixture and egg; blend thoroughly. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface; knead slightly adding remaining flour if necessary. Roll out dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter dipping cutter into flour as needed. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet; let dough rise slightly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield about 24 biscuits.

title: Creamy Tomato Soup
instructions: Blend cream cheese with soup to make a smooth mixture. Stir in water Worcestershire sauce and celery and salt. Heat on simmer until hot stirring often.

title: Groundhog
instructions: Clean groundhog. Parboil in clear water until tender. Season with spices and roast over open flame. Or bake in oven until brown.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding(Makes 8 To 10 Servings)
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine Eagle Brand and water; add pudding mix. Beat until well blended. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart round glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of the vanilla wafers bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice ending with pudding mixture. Chill thoroughly. Garnish as desired with wafers etc. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Orange-Pineapple Molded Salad
instructions: Blend together the Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Fold in dry the orange Jell-O. Fold in oranges and pineapple. Set in mold overnight.

title: Cheesy Herb Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. In a small bowl combine cream cheese and Parmesan cheese. Mix well. Set aside. Unroll crescent dough into 2 long rectangles. Press together perforation to seal. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly over each rectangle. Starting at shortest side roll up jelly roll style. Pinch edges to seal; place sections together on a cookie sheet creating one long roll. With a knife dipped in water partially cut each roll into 6 slices within 1/8-inch of bottom (do not cut through). Fold down slices alternately from left to right and overlapping slightly to form a loaf.

title: Mother'S Cheese Wafers
instructions: Have margarine and cheese at room temperature. Blend margarine and cheese together. Add flour salt and cayenne pepper. Roll out to desired thickness and cut in shapes or put through a cookie press. Bake at 325\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Quick Reese'S Cup Candy
instructions: Use shallow pan about 8 x 11-inch size. Melt peanut butter and margarine together. Mix in powdered sugar; work until blended well. Spread in pan. Melt chocolate bar in double boiler. Spread on top of peanut mixture. Cool 1/2 hour. Cut and serve.

title: Five Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add extracts flavoring and eggs. Sift together flour salt and baking powder; add to mixture alternately with sour cream. Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 or until done. Glaze if desired.

title: Spiced Carrot Soup
instructions: Saute the onion in the butter until softened. Add the carrots and ginger and cook an additional 2 minutes. Add the soup stock and simmer for 15 minutes. Whirl in a blender or processor until fairly smooth. Add the juices and cinnamon then blend again. Chill. Garnish with orange peel and a mint sprig if desired. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Sauteed Veal Chops
instructions: Heat butter in skillet. Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper. Brown slowly on both sides about 20 minutes. Remove chops; place on serving plates. Add wine and some of prepared gravy (to thicken and taste). Bring to a boil scraping loose all the brown particles from skillet. Lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Spoon juices over meat. Enjoy.

title: Carrots And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots until tender. Saute onion and celery in a little butter. On low heat melt butter and Velveeta cheese. Pour cheese mixture over vegetable mixture and stir until well mixed. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Monkey Cake
instructions: You will need a tube pan with a solid bottom.

title: Russian Dressing(From Overrock Inn)
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

title: Cape Cod Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients into large mixing bowl. Mix in the rest of the ingredients. Do not overmix a little lumpy is fine. Pour into a paper lined or greased cupcake pan. Sprinkle the tops with sugar and bake 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 6 small muffins or 3 large muffins.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Grease a square baking dish. In baking dish mix Bisquick and water and spread in bottom. Brown ground beef drain and add seasoning. Spread on top of Bisquick mixture. Top with onion lettuce and tomato. Mix sour cream and mayo and spread on top. Top with cheddar cheese and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave. Add all at once the remaining ingredients. Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan. Let set cut into squares.

title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and peanut butter; gradually add 1/2 cup sugar and brown sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg milk and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour soda and salt; add to creamed mixture.

title: Hawaiian Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add all other ingredients except the ginger ale which is added to the punch bowl as needed.

title: Sausage And Mushrooms
instructions: Cook and cool sausage. Slice when cold. Slice onions green peppers and celery thin. Add the remaining ingredients. Put in a crock-pot and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours until celery and onions are done. Serve on hard rolls.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Peel and core the apples. Make a syrup of the water sugar and cinnamon drops. When syrup starts to boil drop apple halves in syrup and cook 10 to 15 minutes. When tender place apple halves in baking dish. Pour syrup over apples and bake at 350\u00b0 until done (until syrup is thick). If apples are sour use more sugar. Cook 30 or 40 minutes in oven.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops into roaster. Cover with onion rings carrot slices pineapple green pepper and garlic. Mix brown sugar vinegar ketchup and soy sauce; pour over pork chops. Cook at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours. Remove pork chops vegetables and pineapple from liquid. Mix cornstarch and pineapple juice into the pan. Cook until thick and pour over pork chops. Serve with rice.

title: Snicker Apple Salad
instructions: Blend together brown sugar and softened cream cheese. Stir in Cool Whip. Add cubed apples chopped peanuts and candy bars.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into baking dish. Top with pats of margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Shortcake Dessert
instructions: Make pudding according to package directions. Mix strawberries and glaze. Layer cake pudding cake strawberries etc. Put in glass dish where you can see layers. Top with whipped topping.

title: Shake And Bake
instructions: Just stir and store in refrigerator.

title: Uncle Terry'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Coarsely grate cabbage. Add chopped onions and enough mayo to moisten. Add salt & pepper to taste and hormel bacon bits. Mix and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and sprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ribbon Jello Mold
instructions: Let plain gelatin soften in cold water. Boil milk with sugar. Add gelatin; let cool a little and add vanilla and sour cream. Beat well and keep warm. Take each package of Jell-O and mix with 1 1/2 cups hot water. Put 1 cup sour cream mixture between Jell-O. Let set after each layer until jelled. Makes 1 glass dish (9 1/2 x 14-inch).

title: Peach Cake
instructions: *Use water if fresh peaches.

title: Lemon Dill Salmon
instructions: Place Salon filets on a greased broiler rack. Combine remaining ingredients and baste filets. Broil 4-inches from heat for 10 minutes per inch of thickness. Baste frequently. Do not turn. Salmon is cooked when it flakes with a fork. Garnish with dillweed leaf.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix milk sugar and salt in saucepan and boil. Set it aside until cool. Mix yeast water and sugar. It will rise so give it room to double. You are mixing milk mixture with yeast mixture to rise. Then gradually sift flour into the mixture and knead until all flour is mixed. Cover with warm towel for 1 1/2 hours. Place on lightly floured board. Pinch off and shape with hands dough about the size of a small egg. Place on greased pan. Leave space to rise and spread out. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Let this dough rise 1 1/2 hours before cooking.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Heat on stove. Mix well. Bring to boil and serve with or without marshmallows.

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Cream together shortening sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. Add to flour mixture. Add chopped nuts and milk or cherry juice. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Cut cherries in half. Place one on top of each cookie. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Julie'S Custard
instructions: Beat eggs add to milk slowly. Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This does not need to be put in a pan of water.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: To cooked cornbread add all other ingredients. Cover and set aside for several hours.

title: Coconut Thins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Mix cornstarch with flour and blend into butter and sugar mixture. Thoroughly chill for several hours. Shape into very small balls and roll in coconut. Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Flatten with fork and bake for 20 or 25 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven. Makes 3 to 4 dozen. Freezes very well.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef crumbs onions milk parsley salt pepper egg and Worcestershire sauce. Shape into meatballs. Brown meatballs in butter; remove from heat. Heat chili and jelly stirring constantly until jelly is melted. Add meatballs.

title: Black Bean Sauce
instructions: In large skillet heat oil over moderately high heat. Add peppers and garlic; saute 5 minutes stirring frequently with wooden spoon. Stir in beans and minced cilantro.

title: Brunch Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cream cheese and milk in saucepan; stir over low heat until smooth. Gradually add cream cheese mixture to eggs mixing until blended. Saute onion in margarine; add onion and remaining ingredients to cream cheese mixture. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until set. Yields 8 servings.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Note Omit baking powder and salt if using self-rising flour.

title: Hamburger Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Melt cheese in double boiler or crock-pot. Mix cheese hamburger Ro-Tel chili powder and hot sauce. Serve with chips.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and oil until foamy. Add sugar vanilla soda flour salt and cinnamon. Fold in apples and nuts. Batter will be thick. Pour into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or less.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Cook 10 minutes. Add beef or pork.

title: Turtle Sundae Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions on the box. Put 1/2 of the batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Preheat 10-inch skillet uncovered over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Melt butter in the skillet then add steak slices and onion. Brown about 5 minutes. Add bouillon cube and water; cover. Reduce heat to low and simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Add soup mushrooms salt and pepper stirring to blend. Cover and heat 10 minutes. Add sour cream stirring to blend. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer. Add 5 eggs and 2 egg yolks 1 at a time beating after each addition. Add flour followed by heavy cream. Add vanilla and grated rind. Mix until a smooth creamy consistency. Pour into a heavy aluminum spring-form pan. Bake in a 500\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes. Reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour. Yields 16 servings.

title: Pudding Salad
instructions: In a heavy saucepan mix jello and puddings with water together; bring to a full boil and cook until thick stirring constantly. Remove from heat and cool completely. When cooled add Cool Whip and fruit cocktail.

title: Orange Pecans
instructions: Put sugar and orange juice in large saucepan and cook to a soft ball stage on candy thermometer (236\u00b0 to 240\u00b0). Turn off heat and add orange rind and pecans. Use a wooden spoon; stir until mixture turns cream color (5 to 7 minutes). Pour onto cookie sheet; spread out. When cool enough to handle break apart.

title: Cinnamon Balls
instructions: Roll into small balls about 1/2 size of a walnut. Roll into cinnamon sugar. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 250\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Candy
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa milk and butter. Bring to rolling boil stirring constantly. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from fire. Add vanilla peanut butter and oats and drop by spoonful on waxed paper. Let sit in refrigerator for 30 minutes.

title: Hawaiian 24 Hour Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine egg yolks juice of lemons sugar cream and salt in double boiler and cook until custardy. Stir constantly. Chill then add whipped cream pineapple cherries almonds and green grapes. Chill for 24 hours and garnish with whipped cream and grated coconut.

title: Strawberries Devonshire
instructions: Wash and hull strawberries. Place in large serving bowl. Cover and chill. Just before serving combine sour cream and brown sugar in a small bowl. Beat until well blended. Serve over strawberries. Makes 6 servings.

title: Gravy Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle lean pork chops with salt and pepper. In 10-inch skillet brown in tablespoon of hot shortening. Pour off drippings. In baking dish pour around chops a mixture of mushroom soup milk and water. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until chops are tender. Stir gravy well.

title: Walnut Chews
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar nuts flour baking powder salt and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut in squares and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Sausage Rice Bake
instructions: In shallow 2-quart casserole place rice; set aside. In large skillet on medium heat saute sausage stirring to crumble. Drain; discard excess fat. In same skillet mix celery onions pepper and sausage. Cook until veggies are tender and onions are transparent. Stir in salt pepper and broth. Increase heat and boil mixture 2 to 3 minutes. Combine mix with rice. Cover dish with tight fitting lid or foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour and 15 minutes or until rice absorbs liquid and is tender. To serve fluff rice; sprinkle with pecan halves. Serves 6.

title: Bay-Lans Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: In large pot cook the potatoes celery and carrots in the chicken broth until tender. Mash the vegetables with a fork coarsely. Add the processed cheese and stir over medium heat until melted. Add the milk and stir again. Do not let the mixture boil. Add seasoning parsley and green onions; cook on low heat 20 minutes.

title: Cream Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Beat together eggs oil sugar and sour cream.\tCombine flour salt baking powder and baking soda and\tadd to egg mixture. Mix well. Dust blueberries with the 2 tablespoons flour and carefully fold into batter. Bake\tat 375\u00b0 for 24 minutes in greased or sprayed muffin tins. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
instructions: In a large pan bring pineapple to a boil; remove from heat. Stir in Jell-O. Cool to room temperature. Stir in buttermilk. Fold in Cool Whip and pecans. Pour into mold or Pyrex oblong dish. Chill at least 4 hours or overnight. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix milk with thawed lemonade. Stir in Cool Whip. Put in pie shell. Chill 1 hour.

title: Memphis Corn Fritters
instructions: Sift the flour; measure and resift with the baking powder salt and sugar. Beat egg then add milk and shortening then flour mixture and beat until smooth. Fold in corn and let stand 5 to 10 minutes while you heat shortening. Fry at 360\u00b0 and serve hot.

title: El Rancho Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add onion and cook until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Grandma'S Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring sugar Karo syrup water and butter to boil. Add peanuts and boil until peanuts get brown (20 minutes). Remove from heat and add vanilla; mix well. Fold in baking soda and pour on three buttered cookie sheets. Pull out as it cools.

title: Stuffed Burgers
instructions: Preheat broiler. Shape beef into 12 thin patties. In small bowl combine mustard and olives. Place 1 tablespoon of mixture in center of each of 6 patties. Top with remaining patties. Pinch edges together to seal. Place patties on greased rack in broiler pan. Broil 8 minutes or until done. Toast buns. Serve burgers in buns. Makes 6 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt together peanut butter and margarine. Stir in powdered sugar; add vanilla if desired and add a few drops of milk (enough to make it like fudge). Press in pan. Refrigerate. (Can add nuts if desired.)

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and baking soda; add oil eggs buttermilk and vanilla flavor. Blend until smooth. Add bananas and nuts and mix well. Grease pan; bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Cheesecake Cupcakes
instructions: You will also need 12 cupcake liners.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Soak fruit and raisins in the brandy at least 12 hours. Mix together the flour baking soda cloves (or allspice) and cinnamon; set aside.

title: Instant Lemon Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Using electric mixer combine butter and egg. Mix in cake mix and lemon juice. Batter will be very thick. Mix in Rice Krispies using beater or by hand. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake approximately 8 minutes. Do not brown. Let cool briefly then remove to surface covered with paper towel. Store in covered container.

title: Mom'S Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly the shortening butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Blend remaining ingredients. (For a softer rounder cookie add 1/2 cup flour.) Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown. Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet. Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

title: Bernaise Sauce
instructions: Stir egg yolks lemon and wine vigorously in 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Add 1/4 cup butter. Heat over very low heat stirring constantly until butter is melted and sauce is thickened. Stir in onion tarragon and chervil leaves. Serve with fish or steak. Yields 3/4 cup of sauce.

title: Pete'S Hamburger Pie(A Variation)
instructions: Grease 9-inch square pan. Put in pizza dough covering sides. Brown hamburger drain. Mix in sauce pour into pan. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and is brown about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Combine sour cream sugar raisins egg yolks salt and cinnamon in a large saucepan. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Cook stirring until thickened. Pour into pie crust.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix Jell-O oil and eggs. Beat with mixer until smooth. Add strawberries and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Frost with vanilla icing.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Mix melted butter and graham cracker crumbs. Press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In small bowl beat other 1/2 cup butter about 30 seconds until softened. Add powdered sugar. Beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs. Spread egg mixture over crumb mixture. Slice bananas; arrange over egg mixture. Spoon pineapple over bananas. Spread Cool Whip over top. Sprinkle with shaved chocolate and nuts. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Cut into squares. Top with cherries if desired.

title: Fruit Kabobs
instructions: Take your pretzel stick and put on a piece of cheese slice of banana and a pineapple chunk. Serve and eat. Kids can do this!

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Bring all ingredients to room temperature. Mix well; shape into a ball. Roll in chopped pecans. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed. Cut in serving pieces or punch holes in cake while hot. Mix milk and cream of coconut. Pour over cake while hot. Cool and cover. Spread Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: In skillet saute hamburger meat about 5 minutes. In the meantime put about 4 or 6 cups water and vegetables in a pan and bring to a boil. Drain meat and add to vegetable mix. Cook until done about 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all but coconut in blender low speed for 3 minutes. (Can use medium speed on mixer for 3 minutes.) Pour into greased pie pan. Let stand about 5 minutes. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together thoroughly. Make into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; drain grease. Add all together. Cook until potatoes are done.

title: Hot Corned Beef Party Sandwiches
instructions: Spread thin layer of mayonnaise and desired amount of mustard on each half.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Saute onions in oleo. Add clams catsup cheese and Worcestershire sauce. Heat stirring constantly until cheese melts.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Combine skim milk flour yogurt and tomatoes with green chilies in saucepan. Heat over medium heat stirring often until thickened. If too thick thin with chicken stock. In skillet heat oil. Saute onion bell pepper and garlic. Add diced chicken and heat through. In casserole dish make layers of sauce chicken mixture tortilla quarters and cheese ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add dry mixture. Add eggs and sour cream; beat well. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread(Makes 2 Loaves; Tasty)
instructions: Beat eggs gradually adding sugar until well mixed. Add vegetable oil and beat. Mix together flour salt baking soda cinnamon and baking powder. To egg mixture add the zucchini alternating with dry mixture. Add raisins apples carrots nuts and vanilla. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until bread is done. Cool about 10 minutes. Remove from pan. May freeze up to 6 months.

title: Sunshine Carrots
instructions: Slice carrots crosswise on the bias about 1-inch thick. Cook covered in boiling salted water until just tender about 20 minutes. Drain.

title: Potatoes Supreme
instructions: Combine sour cream cottage cheese and spices. Fold in potatoes pour into buttered casserole dish. Top with cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Crock-Pot Roast
instructions: Season roast and roll into flour coating roast. Brown in hot skillet with a little oil on both sides until just brown. Put roast into crock-pot. Pour can of soup over roast and sprinkle about 1 teaspoon of Worcestershire sauce on top. Put top on and cook on low all day about 6 to 8 hours. Makes a delicious gravy.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Simmer chicken breasts in water with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and pepper until done (approximately 20 minutes). Saute 1/2 cup onions and 1/2 cup green peppers in butter until soft. Add Velveeta cheese cream of mushroom soup and cream of chicken soup. When chicken is done remove from water and boil 2 cups of noodles in chicken broth until tender. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and combine with soup mixture. Add cooked noodles with 1/4 cup broth. Put in lightly greased baking dish and bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 or 12 to 15 minutes in microwave.

title: Soft Caramel Icing
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in a buttered heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring often (soft ball stage) at 240\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Let cool slightly. Add vanilla. Beat until spreading consistency. Enjoy! Enough for 2 layer cake.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and tortillas. Layer in rectangular baking dish 6 tortillas then half of chicken mixture and half of the grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot throughout.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight. Put in jars and process 20 minutes in water bath.

title: Seven Layer Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. in 13 x 9 inch baking pay melt butter in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter; pour Eagle Brand evenly on top of crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients in order listed; press down firmly with fork. Bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Chill if desired. Cut into bars. Store tightly covered at room temperature. Makes 24 to 36 bars.

title: Microwave Fresh Strawberry Jam
instructions: In a 3-quart casserole place berries and pectin. Stir well. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at High 8 to 10 minutes until mixture is at full rolling boil. Add sugar to boiling berries and stir well.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given except kisses. Shape into balls and roll in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Place chocolate kiss on top and press down. Bake 2 to 5 minutes longer.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes and rub skins with oil. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Allow potatoes to stand until cool to the touch. Slice skin away from top of each potato. Carefully scoop out the pulp leaving shell intact; mash pulp. Combine potato pulp and remaining ingredients except paprika stirring well. Stuff shells with potato mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Seal securely in aluminum foil. Freeze. To serve thaw in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions but add vegetables with seasoning package. Combine soup milk and parsley. Set aside.

title: Italian Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Mix well and set aside.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces. Add soups sour cream and noodles; pour into casserole dish. Salt and pepper to taste. Cut bread into inch squares and place on top. Pour melted butter over bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bread is brown.

title: Yogurt Chicken
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a shallow dish; set aside. Brush yogurt on all sides of chicken breast halves; coat with bread crumbs mixture. Place in a lightly greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Drizzle with butter and sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Yield 8 servings.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Combine cocoa and food coloring to make a paste. Stir into creamed mixture. Sift flour and salt together. Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Blend well; add vanilla. Combine vinegar and soda. While still foaming add to the batter. Do not beat instead stir gently. Bake in two greased and floured layer pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put rice in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole Pyrex dish. Next sprinkle on poultry seasoning. Lay chicken on rice. Pour 3 cups water on top of the chicken. Sprinkle on salt and pepper. Add mushroom soup last. Cover chicken and rice with mushroom soup. Cover with aluminum foil and cook until done 50 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: No Cook Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together then add milk cream and vanilla. Beat until well mixed. Put mixture into ice cream freezer canister and crank it until mixture gets solid. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Zucchini Souffle
instructions: Cook zucchini until tender and drain. Sprinkle with salt pepper and garlic salt. Combine egg yolks sour cream and flour. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into sour cream mixture. Place 1/2 of zucchini in a baking dish. Top with 1/2 sour cream mixture and 1/2 of the grated cheese. Layer remaining zucchini sour cream mixture and cheese. Melt butter and stir in bread crumbs. Sprinkle over top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Christmas Amber Rum Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a Bundt or tube pan. Combine ingredients in a bowl. Blend well; then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Turn into pan. Bake 55 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan 15 minutes. While cake is cooling prepare glaze.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges. Combine pineapple oranges grapes marshmallows and coconut. Mix sour cream (or yogurt) with sugar. Stir into fruit mixture.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat onion and garlic. Add tomato sauce paste basil and salt. Spread half on cooked noodles. Mix together cottage cheese Parmesan cheese parsley eggs salt and pepper. Spread on top of meat mixture.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese; add grated cheeses. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients (except pecans) and form into ball or log. Roll in pecans and refrigerate.

title: Sour Cream Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown meat in Dutch oven; drain. Add other ingredients and cook several hours to give flavors time to blend. Any other vegetables can be added. This is even better the second day.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Cream oleo. Add sugar and egg. Beat until creamy. Mix peeled and finely chopped apples together with nuts flour baking powder soda salt and cinnamon. Stir into creamed mixture. Turn into buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for forty minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: *Granny Smith apples are recommended for this.

title: Dump Dessert
instructions: Layer ingredients in order listed in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Poppy Cheese Bread
instructions: Slice bread at an angle (but not all the way through) from left to right then right to left. Stuff cuts with cheese. Mix together remaining ingredients in a saucepan and simmer. Cover bottom and sides of bread with foil. Pour mixture over bread. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Minted Zucchini
instructions: Combine butter and oil in large skillet and heat until butter melts. Add onion and saute over high heat about 1 minute. Stir in zucchini. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook stirring occasionally until zucchini is tender about 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in mint and cook an additional 30 seconds.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can leave out cocoa and make a chess pie.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs beating after each one. Add remaining ingredients. Beat and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes in a Bundt pan.

title: Mexican Salsa
instructions: *If you use fresh tomatoes clean as for canning.

title: Peanut Popcorn Balls
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan add sugar corn syrup vinegar and peanut butter. Cook until mixture reaches 260\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Add vanilla.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Beat eggs; add milk. Add all other ingredients (1/2 of Parmesan cheese 1/4 cup). Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle top with other half of Parmesan cheese (1/4 cup). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until it tests dry and top is slightly brown. Do not undercook.

title: Salmon Puff
instructions: Mix flaked fish and potatoes. Add onion and celery then add butter and egg yolks and fold in beaten egg whites last. Place in buttered casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry-Pineapple Mold
instructions: Mix together; freeze in square pan. Take out 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Place pieces on lettuce and allow to thaw a little.

title: Butter Nut Chewies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Melt Crisco. Beat eggs until light and foamy in a large bowl of electric mixer. Beat in sugar vanilla and Crisco until creamy. Combine flour with baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Mix at low speed until blended. Stir in nuts at low speed. (Mixture will be stiff.) Spread evenly in prepared pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until top is light brown. Cool 10 to 15 minutes. Cut into bars. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Beef Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: Chop the chipped beef and mix with all the ingredients. Chill and serve with assorted crackers.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
instructions: Mix nutmeg cinnamon and Equal. Mix with apples and add lemon juice mixing well to coat apples. Pour into prepared crust and bake in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until crust is golden and mixture bubbly.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Form into a ball and roll in finely chopped nuts.

title: Zucchini Sweet Relish
instructions: Put zucchini and onion slices through food grinder. Mix well with 5 tablespoons salt; let stand overnight. Rinse with cold water. Drain well in colander or sieve. In a large kettle mix vinegar sugar dry mustard nutmeg cornstarch turmeric celery seed and black pepper. Cook until it starts to thicken. Add ground vegetables and mix well. Cook slowly for 30 minutes. Can it hot sterilizing jars at once.

title: Country Sweet-Sour Cabbage
instructions: In a large pan add first 5 ingredients. Cook 10 to 15 minutes. When cabbage is tender add brown sugar and vinegar. If desired salt and pepper. Cook an additional 5 to 10 minutes to let the sugar/vinegar cook a bit.

title: Hot Creamed Crab
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth in small electric mixer. Add mayonnaise lemon juice Worcestershire sauce flour and pepper. Beat again until smooth. Fold in crabmeat almonds and salt to taste. Put in casserole dish and bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Place over heat (candle or other heating device).

title: Baked Custard
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and vanilla together in a bowl. Place milk in 4 cup glass measure. Microwave milk on High setting for 3 1/2 to 4 minutes or until hot but not boiling. Gradually add hot milk to egg mixture while continuing to beat.

title: Nibblin Fish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large plastic bag and shake to mix. Serve.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine 2 cups buttermilk baking mix 2/3 cup milk and 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar cheese with a wooden spoon until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 30 seconds.
