Drop dough by heaping tablespoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown. Combine 1/2 cup butter or margarine and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder. Brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet. Serve warm. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Sift together salt and flour. Pour water into oil then dump into dry ingredients. Work in. Form two balls; roll out.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients in a glass pie plate. Sprinkle with a little more Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbly and golden. Serve with cocktail breads or crackers.

title: Franke'S Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel and cut eggplant in small cubes. Cook in salted water about 15 minutes. Drain and mash; set aside.

title: Chocolate-Peppermint Topping
instructions: Combine whipped topping syrup and extract in a bowl. Blend well. A particularly good topping for angel food cake.

title: Corn Light Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together and put in a greased loaf pan. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove pan from oven and cover with cloth to cool.

title: Never Fail Tupperware Crust
instructions: Combine ingredients in mixing bowl. Put on lid and \burp\. Shake hard for 60 seconds. Divide dough in half and roll out thin on floured pastry sheet. Makes 2 9-inch flaky crusts. Easy and good.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Cut hot potatoes in half lengthwise. Scoop out potatoes leaving skins intact for re-stuffing. With wire whisk beat potatoes with cottage cheese milk and onion. Spoon mixture back into skins. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley flakes. You may also top with bacon bits shredded cheese or other favorites. Bake 10 minutes or until golden brown in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Christmas Eve Simple Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: In a large skillet brown diced onion in small amount of fat. Add ground chuck. Cook until done and crumbly. Prepare mashed potatoes. Cook frozen corn. Slightly grease or spray nonstick cooking spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Drain fat from meat. Spread crumbled meat in bottom of dish. Spread cooked corn on top of meat. Carefully spread mashed potatoes on top. Dot with butter or margarine. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until brown about 1/2 hour.

title: Mom'S Best Krumkaker
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar until thick. Melt butter. Cool. Add slowly to egg and sugar mix then add flour and cardamom. Bake in krumkake iron on top of stove. Remove with knife and roll in a cone shape on wooden cone. Store in airtight box. This makes about 60.

title: Virginia Spoon Bread(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Scald milk in saucepan (do not boil); remove from heat. Add cornmeal whisking constantly until lump free add butter; cool. When sufficiently cool add egg yolks.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cheese. Mix all ingredients well. Refrigerate mixture overnight before rolling into ball. Roll in additional cup of pecans. Decorate with cherries or stuffed olives.

title: Potatoes In Cream Sauce
instructions: Blanch 4 diced potatoes by boiling for 7 minutes ; drain and set aside. In a small saucepan combine remaining diced potato and water; bring to a boil then cover and simmer for 10 minutes. With a hand mixer blend potatoes until smooth; stir in butter buds onion powder bouillon granules and 1/2 c. milk until smooth. Add more milk to reach a cream consistency. Add pepper. Pour potato sauce over blanched potatoes.

title: Quick Easy Appetizer
instructions: Brown turkey in a skillet; drain any fat. Cut Velveeta cheese in cubes and melt in skillet with turkey. Serve in toast points (can be reheated). Can put under broiler to re-warm or reheat in microwave. Can serve with crackers to spread.

title: T.V. Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar then add flour baking powder and soda. Mix well then add remaining ingredients. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let set until cool. If you use ice cream dipper your cookie will be nice and round. Bake on large cookie sheet. These are also good with half whole and half wheat. Makes about 36 cookies.

title: Santa'S Whiskers
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Blend in milk and flavoring add cherries and nuts. Form into 2 inch rolls and roll in coconut to cover rolls. Chill. Cut in 1/4 inch slices. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown about 12 minutes. Makes 60.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix in two round cake pans. Break one cake into pieces and place in punch bowl. Layer 1/2 of pudding mix on cake pieces. Add layer of 1 can crushed pineapple (drained) 1 can pie filling and 1 container Cool Whip on top. Then place next cake on top (do not break) and repeat with layering of pudding crushed pineapple pie filling and Cool Whip. May add pecans.

title: Fruit Cookie Pie
instructions: In medium bowl beat together butter and sugar until light and creamy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour salt and baking powder. Gradually blend into butter mixture just until moist. Press dough evenly into 12-inch pizza pan. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or lightly brown. Remove and cool.

title: Soft Sugar Cookie Puffs
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs; add cream and beat well. Beat in the sugar butter and almond extract. Combine flour and baking powder; gradually add to sugar mixture. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or until easy to handle. On lightly floured surface roll out dough to 1/4 inch thickness. Make sure dough is thick enough so cookies will puff up. Cut with cookie cutters dipped in flour. Place on greased baking sheets. Sprinkle with colored sugars and bake or frost when cool.

title: Orange Pork Steaks
instructions: Look in the phone book under pizza. Call order your favorite kind and have it delivered (give name address and phone number.) Wait for door bell to ring. Open door pay delivery man. Grab some napkins and eat straight from box. Refrigerate leftovers for breakfast.

title: Garden Glory
instructions: Mix jello mayo and cottage cheese. Then add all other ingredients and mix well. Chill 2 to 4 hours.

title: Wassail Bowl
instructions: Mix juices and sugar in crock-pot. Stud orange with cloves and add to liquid. Add allspice and cinnamon sticks. Simmer for 6 to 8 hours. May add 1 cup rum if desired. Delicious at Christmas when your guests first arrive in from the cold.

title: Green Beans With Cheese Topping
instructions: Combine green beans onion soup mix and water; cover and cook over low heat 20 to 30 minutes or until beans are tender. Drain and spoon into a serving dish. Add butter almonds and cheese; toss lightly. Sprinkle with paprika. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish spray with Pam or foil. Put chicken breast in bottom of dish top with 1 slice Swiss cheese on each breast. Combine soup and wine; mix well. Pour over chicken add 1 cup of stuffing (or more if desired). Drizzle with melted oleo. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored; add baking powder salt and sugar and beat again. Fold in flour and vanilla. Line a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with waxed paper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 13 minutes. While cake is baking place a towel a little longer then the pan on the table and sprinkle generously with powdered sugar. When cake is done immediately turn upside-down on the powdered sugar. Remove waxed paper from bottom of pan. Fold side of towel over cake and roll together to form a roll. When cool unroll cake and spread with your favorite jelly or preserves. Roll cake again and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Slice to serve.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook together sugar water crushed berries cornstarch and lemon juice until thickened. Add butter and cool while you spread softened cream cheese on baked crust. Place whole berries on cheese. Pour cooked mixture over all. Chill and top with Cool Whip.

title: Spinach Cornbread
instructions: Combine cornbread mix with spinach. Saute onion and salt in 3/4 stick butter. Mix all together. Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple and save syrup. Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add cold water to syrup to make 1 1/2 cups. Add lemon juice and salt. Add cold water and syrup to gelatin. Chill until partly set. Meanwhile combine sugar and cranberries in bowl. When jello is nearly set add ground fruit celery and nuts. Place in mold if desired.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating 1 to 2 minutes after each. Sift flour salt and soda. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with sour cream beating after each addition. Add milk; beat in well. Add extracts and vanilla. Beat well. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Combine egg whites sugar water and corn syrup in top of double boiler beating with rotary or electric mixer until thoroughly mixed. Place over rapidly boiling water. Beat 7 minutes or until frosting stands in peaks. Remove from boiling water. Add vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread. Makes enough frosting for the top and sides of two 9-inch layers.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Bake cookie dough until done about 7 to 10 minutes. Let cool spread with mixture of cream cheese sugar and a little vanilla. Decorate with whatever fruit you like. You can also have Cool Whip on top if desired.

title: Sugarless Cookies
instructions: Mix together orange marmalade egg and shortening or oil. Add to this mixture the flour vanilla soda and salt. I also add some orange flavoring. Stir in raisins and nut meats.

title: Pace Six Layer Dip
instructions: Mash avocados in a bowl with lemon juice salt and pepper. Combine sour cream and mayonnaise in another bowl.

title: Coconut Candy
instructions: To the coconut juice add (if needed) enough sweet milk to fill a cup. Boil sugar and juice for 6 minutes. Add the coconut meat; boil 10 minutes stirring constantly. Beat until creamy. Drop on buttered dish. Let cool.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar milk and butter until it forms a soft ball in water then add peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Beat with spoon until slightly stiff. Pour into buttered pan. Allow to cool thoroughly before cutting.

title: Beefy Cheese Balls
instructions: Shred beef in blender save 1/2 cup. With large spoon stir in other ingredients. Shape into 2 large balls. Roll in remaining beef. Refrigerate. Serve at room temperature with your choice of crackers.

title: Apple Crumb Cake(Yield: 2 Servings)
instructions: Melt 1/3 cup butter in a large skillet. Pare core and slice apples to 1/2-inch pieces. Add apples to butter and cook stirring 8 minutes until tender. Stir in 3/4 cup sugar 1 teaspoon lemon peel 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon mace and currants. Cook 15 minutes stirring until thickened. Cool.

title: Easy Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Boil chicken in 4 quarts of water with seasoning in water. Remove chicken and debone. Cook noodles in chicken broth until done. Add chicken and soups to the noodles. Do not drain the noodles. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Spread rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add water. Sprinkle onion over mixture. Season chicken to taste; place skin side up on rice mixture. Slightly dilute soup with milk; spread over top of chicken. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Children'S Play Dough
instructions: On medium heat cook and stir until mixture dries and forms a mass not sticky (watch it goes fast). Cool. Keep in plastic bag. Add coloring if desired.

title: Elegant Peanut Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat eggs corn syrup sugar peanut butter and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Stir in peanuts and put in pie shell. Bake 15 minutes then reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and top with whipped cream.

title: Pineapple Pork Chops
instructions: In dish mix pepper salt and flour. Coat pork chops with flour mixture. With meat mallet pound chops on both sides.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Heat salad oil and sugar to boiling point; pour over the above and chill in refrigerator. Keeps well for days if kept cold.

title: Strawberry Loaf
instructions: Combine sugar and water. Bring to a boil. Cool. Add cherry brandy. Set aside. Heat jam until melted. (If preserves are used force through sieve.) Add strawberry extract and food coloring. Set aside. Cut pound cake horizontally into 3 even pieces. Wash dry and cap strawberries. Reserve 6. Slice remaining berries. Whip 1/2 of the cream and fold berries into it. Place bottom slice of cake on a serving plate. Brush with cherry brandy syrup. Spread half of berries-cream mixture on cake and top with a second slice of cake. Add remaining slice of cake and brush with remaining syrup. Beat the remaining cup of heavy cream with confectioners sugar until stiff.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water. Add 1 1/2 cups cold water. Chill. Grind cranberries. Add sugar and other ingredients. When Jell-O begins to thicken combine mixtures.

title: Milk Punch
instructions: Mix milk sugar and bourbon and stir. Add ice cubes and sprinkle with nutmeg. Serve as an alternate to Bloody Marys.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
instructions: Wash beef and in deep pot cover with water. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer for 2 hours. Strain reserving beef and vegetables. Stock may be used in place of oil to saute meat vegetables etc. If stock is to be used as soup blend vegetables and stock in blender for 30 seconds. May be frozen. Serving size 1 cup.

title: Kielbasa And Sauerkraut
instructions: Place a layer of kraut in bottom of small roaster. Slice some onions on top then cut kielbasa in pieces and lay them on top of onions. Keep making layers in this order with the minced garlic and bay leaf. Top with bacon strips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple-Lime Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Whisk in sour cream until blended. Stir in pineapple and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage until done. Drain well. Beat eggs. Add eggs milk cheese and bread (which has been broken into pieces) with sausage and mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. If you use glass dish bake at 325\u00b0. Also sprinkle more cheese on top of mixture.

title: Beef Nacho Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown meat; drain. Stir in salsa corn Miracle Whip and chili powder. Divide meat mixture chips and cheese into half layer in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Top with shredded lettuce and chopped tomato if desired.

title: No-Knead Parker House Rolls
instructions: Heat cup of water to boiling point and add sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Pour the cup of lukewarm water into a bowl and add yeast. Let stand until dissolved and add the lukewarm water mixture egg and flour. Beat until smooth. Place dough in greased bowl. Brush top with melted shortening. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Roll out in a circle about 1/2-inch thick. Cut into rounds with cookie cutter. Crease heavily a dull edge of knife through center. Brush lightly with butter. Fold over in pocket shape and place on greased baking sheet 1-inch apart. Let rise until double in bulk. Bake in hot oven at 425\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Press out rolls on pizza pan to form crust. Sprinkle with seasoned pork sausage and uncooked hash browns. Beat eggs and milk together; pour over pizza. Top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until eggs are done.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels and 1/2 cup sugar and butter. Mix well and press into a long oblong dish. Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and 1/4 cup sugar; spread on first layer. Combine juice from pineapple and 2 tablespoons flour. Cook until thickened. Cool and mix with pineapples and place on top of second layer of salad.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Lay whole graham crackers over entire bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix milk and pudding mix. When thick add all of Cool Whip. Put 1/2 pudding mixture on layer of graham crackers. Then put another layer of graham crackers then rest of pudding mixture. Top with another layer of whole graham crackers. Melt frosting in microwave. Stir and spread over cake. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Old Fashioned Caramels
instructions: Butter a 9 x 11-inch cake pan. Melt butter in heavy 3-quart saucepan. Add sugar and mix well. Stir in corn syrup. Cook until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat. Stir in sweetened condensed milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture reaches 240\u00b0 soft ball. It will take 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour into pan. Cool to room temperature. Slip spatula under corner and remove from pan. Cut into small pieces. I wrap each piece with plastic wrap.

title: Pilgrim Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine Crisco sugar and salt very well. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour milk and flavoring; beat well. Grease and flour TUBE pan. Pour mixture in pan; place in COLD oven and set temperature at 300\u00b0. Bake for 2 hours.

title: Asparagus Italiano
instructions: Coat Prosciutto lightly with mixture of olive oil and thyme. Blanch asparagus until just tender (2 to 4 minutes). Immerse blanched asparagus in ice water. Drain. Wrap each stalk with Prosciutto. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with lemon wedge.

title: Mustard Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix maple syrup mustard lemon juice and salt together. Spoon over skinned chicken pieces. Let stand at least 24 hours or overnight in sealed container. Melt margarine and place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. I use a glass pan. Pour over sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes then turn oven up to 400\u00b0 for another 20 to 30 minutes. Every 15 minutes baste chicken with sauce. I serve the sauce to dip chicken in while eating. Depending on chicken pieces I even stretch sauce to cover 4 pieces of chicken. Also when using plain maple syrup I add 1 to 2 tablespoons of honey. Serve with rice pilaf.

title: French Toast
instructions: Preheat griddle to 350\u00b0. Combine egg and milk. Whip to desired consistency. Add vanilla. Add generous amount of ground cinnamon. Dip bread in mix. Lay to dry in single stacks for 1/2 hour (will absorb moisture). Grease griddle with Pam or margarine.

title: Lemon Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix well sugar cornstarch and cold water. Cook and stir until smooth. Stir in egg yolks. Slowly bring to boil stirring constantly. Add lemon juice salt and margarine. Cool. Combine cream cheese and milk. Mix well. Stir in pie mix and lemon juice. Fold in with first mixture. Pour into pie crusts. Top with Cool Whip. This is enough for two pies.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix these ingredients and chill.

title: Crispy Cheese Rounds
instructions: Mix all ingredients on low speed in a mixer. When the mixture resembles wet sawdust with clean hands make cylinders about the diameter of a quarter. Wrap the cylinders in wax paper. Place in the freezer. Leave in the freezer at least 1 1/2 hours or in freezer bags in freezer until ready to use within 2 months. Slice cylinders into rounds 1/8-inch to 1/4-inch wide (thinner rounds are more crisp). Place 1-inch apart on a cookie sheet. Place a pecan half in the center of each. Place in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. After cooled store in airtight container.

title: Crunchy Date Rounds
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugars. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Sift together dry ingredients; gradually add to creamed mixture blending well. Stir in nuts and dates. Drop from teaspoon into crushed flakes rolling to coat well. Place two inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Top with walnut halves. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched. Cool before removing from pan. Makes three dozen.

title: Beverly'S Lasagna
instructions: Mix the ricotta cheese egg parmesan cheese and parsley. Layer in a 9 x 13 pan with the tomato sauce lasagna noodles and Ricotta cheese mixture. Top with mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 1 hour.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place in buttered casserole and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place over medium-high heat until hot. Add mushrooms onion and garlic; saute until tender. Combine egg substitute and next 4 ingredients. Stir in spinach. Add mushroom mix stirring well. Spoon in prebaked pastry shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Arrange cheese slices on top. Bake 5 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Roux
instructions: Combine ingredients in heavy saucepan over medium-high heat for about 3 minutes stirring constantly. Reduce heat and continue cooking and stirring until you get the color called for in the recipe. Dark roux will take about 15 minutes.

title: Potato Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and margarine; add sugar gradually and beat until fluffy. Add eggs and beat until light. Add hot mashed potatoes and blend together. Sift flour; measure and add salt baking powder chocolate and spices. Sift again. Add dry ingredients alternating with milk and vanilla. Beat after each addition. Fold in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes for layers 1 hour for loaf.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and beat for 2 minutes. Pour into 2 loaf pans and bake for 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top should crack open; test with toothpick. Glaze while hot.

title: Navy Bean Soup
instructions: If using dry beans wash and sort. In large kettle cover the beans with 6 to 8 cups of hot water. Bring to boil; boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover; let stand for 1 hour. Add another 8 cups cold water and ham pieces. Bring to boil; simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Stir in remaining ingredients; simmer for 20 to 30 minutes until beans are tender. Makes about 3 quarts soup.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Pour oil in pan with chopped pepper and onions. Add all other ingredients. Simmer 3 minutes. Add carrots and continue to simmer for about 10 minutes.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat in 2 tablespoons hot fat. Add and cook 5 to 10 minutes all ingredients except noodles or rice. Heat thoroughly then serve over rice or noodles. Serves 4. Preparation time 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry-Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels 1/4 cup sugar and margarine. Press firmly into lightly greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Shrimp And Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a large roasting pan toss potatoes peppers salad oil and 1 teaspoon salt. Roast vegetables in oven for 30 minutes stirring once halfway through cooking time. Meanwhile slice green onions; peel and devein shrimp. In bowl toss green onions shrimp and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Stir shrimp mixture into vegetable mixture; roast 10 minutes longer or until shrimp are opaque throughout and potatoes are fork-tender. Makes 4 main dish servings.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Fry beef and drain all fat. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Layer over tortillas and cheese a few times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch) loaf pans. Sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Cream butter; add sugar gradually beating until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. Beat nonfat dry milk water and bananas until mixed well. Add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture starting and ending with dry ingredients. Blend well after each addition. Fold in nuts. Turn into pans and bake 50 minutes. Remove from pan and cool on a wire rack.

title: Canadian Margarita
instructions: Pour into the blender (all in equal parts). Blend well. Enjoy!

title: Friendship Cake
instructions: Combine butter and sugar in large bowl. Beat well. Add eggs beat well. Coarsely chop brandied fruit and stir into batter. Add pecans and juice; mix well. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Cherry Divinity
instructions: Combine sugar water and corn syrup in a 2-quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring until sugar is completely dissolved. Stop stirring; continue cooking until 260\u00b0 on candy thermometer or until a small drop hardens when dropped in cold water. Meanwhile beat egg whites in small bowl until stiff peaks form. Continue beating egg whites while pouring the hot syrup in a fine stream into the whites blending well. Add vanilla. Beat until mixture holds its shape and becomes slightly dull (this may take several minutes). Fold in nuts and cherries. Quickly drop mixture from tip of a buttered teaspoon onto waxed paper. Allow to dry for 2 or 3 hours. Then store in airtight container.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Spray casserole (1 1/2-quart dish) with Pam. Layer with soup on bottom and end with asparagus on top. Spread shredded cheese over top. Dot with a little butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken and debone. Set aside. Cook rice using 1 cup chicken broth. Add cream of chicken and Cheddar cheese soup to rice. Mix well. Stir in chicken. Place in casserole dish and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Supreme
instructions: Crumble ground beef loosely into rectangular baking dish. Sprinkle with onion flakes and peas; spread evenly with mushroom soup. Top with Tater Tots. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until cooked through. Yield 8 servings.

title: Stew Beef Dinner
instructions: In a large pot cook beef until done. Add onion (diced). Cut potatoes in fourths. Cut carrots and turnip in pieces and dump all in pot with stew beef. Cook until all vegetables are about done. Next add cabbage cut up over the top of recipe. Cook until cabbage is tender. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Mexican Peanuts
instructions: Saute garlic in peanut oil. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Cook\tfor about 2 minutes in the open skillet at medium heat. As soon as they are cool enough to eat they may be served. They keep well so they may be served later when they are cool.

title: Easy Mexican Soup
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain fat. Add all remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour.

title: Eggs For A Crowd
instructions: Blend milk eggs and spices in blender. Butter a 13 1/2 x 9 3/4-inch baking dish. Layer with 8 slices of buttered bread. Cover with 3 cups grated cheese and 1/2 of egg mixture. Repeat with second layer using balance of ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Let rest before cutting. Serves 12.

title: Batter Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt and margarine. Cool to lukewarm. Measure warm water into large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast. Stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm mixture egg and 2 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Cover and let rise until double about 30 to 45 minutes. Punch down and shape into 2 dozen rolls. Place on greased sheet and cover to let rise until double. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Add ingredients to tomato mix. Bake mixture uncovered in oven at 350\u00b0 for 6 hours or until desired thickness. Pack in hot sterile jars. Hot water bath 15 minutes.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Boil chicken until fully cooked; drain and break in small pieces. Combine vegetables in skillet and fry until hot. Add chicken salt and pepper and fry for a few minutes. Put noodles in a large pan with enough oil to coat the pan bottom. Stir in chicken vegetables and green onions. Heat through. Add soy sauce if desired.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and oil together; add eggs and vanilla. Then add remaining ingredients a little at a time; mix well. Spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 or 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add all dry ingredients and mix well. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake approximately 1 hour or until done. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk. Add sour cream. Add 1/2 of Cool Whip. Layer mixture vanilla wafers and bananas. Top with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Polvorones De Canele(Cinnamon Cookies)
instructions: First cream 1/2 cup plus 1 teaspoon of confectioners sugar and the margarine together. Add the 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon salt and vanilla. Stir in flour and work into a stiff dough. Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Mix together 1 cup of confectioners sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon and roll the 1 inch balls into cinnamon mixture. Place on greased sheets into oven set at 350\u00b0 for about 15 - 20 minutes until lightly browned. Cool well.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Combine cream cheese and butter. Beat until smooth. Add powdered sugar and vanilla beating until light and fluffy. Spread frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake. Sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped pecans on top.

title: Coconut Or Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour and cocoa. Beat egg yolks and combine with 1 cup of milk. Mix together and cook over low heat or double boiler. Then add remaining milk and butter. Cook until very thick. Add vanilla and stir. If you are making coconut pies add the coconut at this time and stir well. Pour in 2 cooked pie shells and top with meringue.

title: Sauteed Chicken Medallions
instructions: Cut breasts into finger size pieces whack flat bread and saute in butter for about 4 minutes on each side.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Combine oleo and crumbs and pat into the bottom of a 13x9 -inch pan. Beat eggs 4 minutes. Add powdered sugar butter and vanilla and beat 5 minutes more. Spread over crumbs and chill. Spread pineapple and sliced bananas over former; then topping nuts and cherries. Refrigerate 6 hours then serve.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown green pepper and mushrooms in melted butter. Add almonds and brown slightly. Add broth to heat. Add rice. Bake in casserole for approximately 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Whip together the whipped oleo Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat into mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all together. Grease and flour a tube cake pan. Start in cold oven at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes then at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes more (one hour and 20 minutes in all).

title: Oatmeal No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix first three ingredients in saucepan and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Stir together then drop by tablespoon onto wax paper. Let cool in refrigerator.

title: Harvest Cake
instructions: Let apples and sugar stand mixed for 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients to same bowl. Mix all ingredients until well blended. Bake in tube pan (ungreased) for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until toothpick when inserted comes out clean. Serve plain or with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: El Vundegas(Meat Ball Soup)
instructions: Bring first 5 ingredients to boil before dropping in meatballs one at a time. Shape last 4 ingredients into meatballs. Simmer soup for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Scalloped Clams
instructions: Combine onion clams parsley salt and Tabasco. Mix crumbs with butter. Set aside 1/3 of crumb mix. Combine remaining crumbs with clam mix. Put in buttered baking dish. Top with crumbs. Pour on heavy cream. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Freezer Coleslaw
instructions: Combine vegetables with salt and let stand 1 hour. Place remaining ingredients in saucepan bring to boil for 1 minute cool and drain. Add vinegar mixture to vegetables and stir gently. Ladle into plastic freezer bags. When ready to use defrost and serve chilled. Yields 1 1/2 to 2 quarts.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni; shred cheese. Drain macaroni and add stick of butter. Mix in cheese. Add can of milk and pepper. Stir until blended. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Take out and stir and place in oven again for 10 minutes.

title: Cheesecake Cookies
instructions: Mix brown sugar and flour together in large bowl. Stir in butter and mix with hands until crumbly. Remove 1 cup of mixture and save. Place remaining crumbs in 8-inch pan; press firmly. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Creamsicle Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on the box except use milk instead of water. Bake.

title: Salsa-Cheese Dip
instructions: In microwave cook chilies with onions and tomatoes until tender. Slowly add cubes of Velveeta microwaving and stirring each time until melted. Dip should be thick. Only add cheese until it reaches your desired consistency.

title: Apple-Nut Cake
instructions: Blend oil sugar and eggs. Mix flour and dry ingredients. Add at intervals. Add vanilla apples and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Cook to soft boil and pour over corn.

title: Banana Puff Pie
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and pour into pie shells. Freeze. Take out of freezer a few minutes before serving.

title: Cobbler(Fruit)
instructions: Put the stick of oleo in a deep baking dish. Melt in oven at 350\u00b0. Make a batter with sugar flour baking powder salt and milk. Pour over melted oleo. Do not stir. Empty fruit on top of batter. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done or for 1 hour.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add vinegar. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Add butter and stir. Pour sauce over beets. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes to absorb sweet/sour flavor of the sauce.

title: Poached Chicken Breast
instructions: Rinse breasts thoroughly under running cold water. Place in a saucepan large enough to hold them in a single layer. Add cold water to a depth of 1-inch above the breasts and any optional items. Remove the breasts from the pan. Set the pan over high heat and bring to a full boil. Return breasts to pan skin side down. When water returns to boil turn heat down low and simmer 17 minutes checking to make sure bubbles continue to break the surface throughout the cooking. Remove pan from heat and let breasts stand in the liquid for 30 minutes. With a slotted spoon remove breasts; when cool enough to handle pull off skin and remove bones. Serve immediately or refrigerate immediately. Serves 4.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix ingredients together and store in airtight container. Use 2 teaspoons of tea to 1 cup of hot water or to taste.

title: Raisin Squares
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch nonstick or glass bakeware. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Breasts Supreme
instructions: Wrap dried beef and bacon around chicken breasts. Place in casserole dish. Combine sour cream and mushroom soup and pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot Mustard
instructions: Mix together vinegar and mustard. Let stand overnight. Blend well the eggs salt and sugar. Cook over low to medium heat until mixture thickens. Stir constantly. Cool and then add mayonnaise. Mix well. Makes 2 1/2 pints.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: For a brown crust when baking pecan or custard pies place pie pan on iron skillet which is turned upside down. Bake as usual.

title: Frozen Pea Salad
instructions: Wash and cut lettuce toss with onion. Scatter frozen peas over top of lettuce/onion - do not mix in. Seal with mayo and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese; cover tightly and refrigerated overnight or 4 hours. Add bacon crumbles just before serving and toss well.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Place 4 slices of bread in bottom of casserole dish. Sprinkle cooked sausage on top of bread then cheese. Place the last 4 slices of bread on top of cheese. Beat eggs milk salt and pepper together. Pour egg mixture over casserole. Cover and set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Grease dish. Drain pineapple and spread in dish. Mix sugar and flour and pour over pineapple. Sprinkle cheese over next then cracker crumbs. Melt butter and drizzle over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Swiss Cheese And Onion Soup
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons butter in saucepan. Add garlic onion mustard and salt. Saute until tender. Add water. Cover and simmer over low heat. In a separate saucepan melt remaining 3 tablespoons butter. Whisk in 3 tablespoons flour and cook whisking over low heat 1 minute. Slap a waffle (heat absorber) under the pan. Add milk; cook whisking until uniform and thick 5 to 8 minutes. Add pepper tamari Tabasco and Worchestershire horseradish sherry cheese and onions. Cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine broccoli mayo eggs soup and mushrooms and a portion of cheese. All ingredients should be evenly mixed. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top and then add Ritz crackers crumbled to very top. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes; uncover and cook for 10 more minutes.

title: Spanish Bean Soup
instructions: Soak 1/2 pound garbanzos (chickpeas) overnight in salt water. Drain. Add beans in soup pot with beef and ham bone and 2 quarts of water. Cook slowly for 45 minutes. Cut fat in liquid. Add paprika and diced onion fry slowly until the onion is light brown then add to the soup. Add potatoes saffron salt and pepper. Cook until beans and potatoes are tender then ladle into bowls with thin slices of Spanish sausage.

title: Rhode Island Clam Chowder(6 Servings)
instructions: Dice the cucumbers into 1/4-inch pieces and degorge (sprinkle with salt to draw out the excess water then blot on paper towels). Mix stock tomato juice yoghurt garlic salt and pepper. Beat with a fork until smooth. Drain cucumbers and add to the mixture. Add the shrimp and chill. Garnish with egg and mint or parsley just before serving. This soup is smooth cool and a delicate blushing pink with the surprise flavor of cucumbers and shrimp. Guests always want a copy of this recipe.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Put all in a blender and mix until smooth. Store in refrigerator. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Currant Muffins
instructions: Sift together the flour sugar baking powder salt and ginger. Combine egg milk and shortening; add to dry ingredients. Stir until all flour is moistened. Fold in currants. Spoon into greased muffin pans filling cups 2/3 full. Sprinkle with topping. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yields 18 muffins.

title: Peanutty Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In a heavy 3-quart saucepan combine sugar evaporated milk and caramels. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until mixture comes to an overall boil. Let boil for 5 minutes stirring continuously. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips and peanuts until chips are melted. Pour mixture into a buttered 8-inch square pan. Let cool completely. Cut into 64 (1-inch) squares.

title: Walnut Apple Crisp
instructions: Toss apples in lemon juice and water in 2 quart baking dish. In large bowl combine flour oats sugar nutmeg and salt. Mix thoroughly. Cut in butter in food processor to resemble coarse crumbs. Mix in walnuts. Crumble over apples to cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until top is light brown.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs longwise. Place yolks in a small bowl. Mash together the yolks butter cream and mustard until well blended. Add olives and cayenne. Fill whites with egg mixture. Chill before serving.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and paprika. Put in buttered 13 x 9. Top with cheese and sprinkle paprika. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and cheese is bubbly.

title: Rocky Road Ice Cream(Based On 4-Quart Freezer)
instructions: Combine milk and chocolate in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until chocolate is melted stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add sugar and salt. Stir until dissolved. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Pour into ice cream freezer and freeze as directed.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Toss together. Add 1 cup mayonnaise and 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Toss again.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: In small mixer bowl cream sugar and butter about 4 minutes or until fluffy. Stir in cooled chocolate and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating on medium speed of electric mixer after each addition and scraping sides of bowl constantly. Fill baked pastry shell and chill several hours or overnight. Whip cream with remaining 1/4 cup powdered sugar and Amaretto until firm. Spread on top of pie.

title: Brisket
instructions: Place brisket in roaster pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Cover pan with foil to make airtight for 24 hours or overnight. Bake 4 hours at 250\u00b0. Slice thinly and bake 1 hour more.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add onion until soft. Add rest of ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours stirring frequently.

title: Super-Easy Orange Chocolate Chip Ice Cream Mold
instructions: Place a 3-cup mold in refrigerator to chill. Stir cream sugar and orange juice in a medium-size bowl until sugar dissolves. Place in freezer 1 1/2 hours or until partially frozen (mixture must be thick so chips wont sink). Fold in chocolate chips. Pour into chilled mold cover and freeze until hard several hours or overnight.

title: Pat In Pan Pie Crust
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well with fork. Pat in pie plate. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 minutes or use for uncooked pie crust.

title: Soft Breadsticks
instructions: In a mixing bowl dissolve yeast in warm water. Add sugar salt and oil. Stir until dissolved. Add 2 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Turn onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic about 6 to 8 minutes. Place in a greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size about 1 hour. Punch down and divide into 12 portions. Roll each portion into a 10 x 1/2-inch rope. Place 1-inch apart on a greased baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal. Let rise uncovered until doubled about 40 to 60 minutes. Beat egg white and water. Brush over breadsticks. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Place baking sheet on middle rack of oven. Place a large shallow pan filled with boiling water on lowest rack. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Brush again with egg white. Bake 5 minutes longer or until golden brown. Yield 1 dozen.

title: Ramen Noodle Salad
instructions: Combine the ingredients. Crush Ramen noodles (do not cook). Mix all.

title: Apple Cider
instructions: This recipe may be halved. Place all ingredients in container and simmer for 2 to 3 hours before serving. Spices may be tied in a bag if desired.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Cut celery and put in large pan. Flour and brown meat that has been cut in bite size. Drain on paper towel then add to celery soy sauce and brown sauce. Cut onions and brown them. Add to rest. Cook until meat is tender about an hour or so.

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix all together. Shape into patties (golf ball size). Fry in vegetable oil until golden brown on both sides. If you wish shape into loaf and bake at 370\u00b0 for 45 minutes in greased loaf pan.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Put the cooked and drained vegetables in a greased casserole. Add the soups. Put Cheez Whiz on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until it bubbles. Bake with lid on.

title: Skillet Fried Peach Pies
instructions: Combine peaches and sugar. Add water to cover. Cook down until tender. Mash peaches with potato masher and let cool. Cut pastry dough about 5 x 8-inches. Place 1/4 cup peaches in each crust. Fold over and stick edges of crust together. You may have to dampen edges to get them to stick good. Fry until brown in a well-greased skillet.

title: Portuguese Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring milk and water in saucepan to a boil (watch carefully). Turn to low; add rice. Cover 20 minutes. Turn off heat. Pour sugar; mix quickly (will be soft). Mix eggs separately then mix together with rice. Again mix quickly. Let set in serving dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Makes 8 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Parmesan Party Rounds
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Mix well. Stir in green onion. Spread a thin layer of mixture on each slice of bread. Place on a baking sheet. Broil about 4 inches from heat until bread is lightly toasted. Serve immediately. Yield Approximately 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Low Calorie Salad
instructions: Combine Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Sprinkle dry jello over top. Fold in drained fruits. For variations use other jello.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Chill overnight.

title: Peach Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil. Add flour and baking powder. Make 1-inch balls (do not press) and bake on greased and floured cookie sheets for 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. While still warm hollow out cookies and when cool fill with apricot filling. Mix 1/2 pint white vermouth and 6 drops red food color. Roll cookies in vermouth then white sugar and add peach leaves. Yield 5 dozen cookies (2 1/2 dozen peaches).

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix together potatoes salt and pepper. Add egg and enough flour to thicken batter. Heat oil in skillet. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls into skillet. Cook until evenly browned on both sides.

title: Night Before Egg Casserole
instructions: Use cooking spray to coat 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Pour croutons in pan to cover bottom. Cover with 1/2 cheese and meat. Combine eggs milk dried mustard soup and salt and pepper. Pour liquid mixture over contents of pan. Spread rest of cheese over liquid. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Remove plastic wrap or foil and bake for 1 hour. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa. Add melted margarine. Add beaten eggs and salt stir well. Add flour stirring well again finishing with nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased 13 x 9 pan bake 350 for 40 minutes. Cool cut into squares.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: French Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar salt and shortening. Add 4 cups flour and mix very well. Add remaining flour 1 cup at a time and knead in. Place in greased bowl and punch down every 10 minutes for 1 hour. Divide into 2 balls and let set for 10 minutes. Roll into rectangle then roll up into 2 long loaves. Place on greased cookie sheet and clip top every 2-inches. Let rise 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Noodles Supreme
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan prepare noodles according to package directions. Add broccoli for last 5 minutes of cooking time. Drain. In saucepan add soup sour cream Parmesan cheese pepper noodles and broccoli. Over low heat heat through stirring occasionally. Makes 5 servings.

title: Chicken Rotel Spaghetti
instructions: Place chicken in water to cover and simmer until tender; debone and cut into bite-size pieces. In same broth cook spaghetti (do not drain). In skillet saut onion and green pepper in butter. Add flour and blend well. Add mushrooms and tomatoes. Simmer about 10 minutes stirring occasionally.\tAdd Ro-Tel mixture to cooked spaghetti. Stir in Velveeta cheese. Add chicken. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour into buttered casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients together and mix well. Add cornbread mix last and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Combine the lettuce celery onion peas water chestnuts and broccoli.\tCover with 1\tcup mayonnaise and 1 cup salad dressing and the\tsugar.\tMix with mayonnaise. Use 2 cups mayonnaise\tor salad dressing mix sugar in and salt and pepper to\ttaste.\tLayer lettuce on bottom of dish; spread to edge of dish. Add\tthe chopped tomato over mayonnaise then add the crumbled bacon. Add the\tshredded cheese over the bacon. Cover; let set for 24 hours. Do not mix to serve.

title: Frozen Strawberry Salad
instructions: Drain fruits. Blend sugar cream cheese and salt. Fold in whipped topping. Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass dish. Cover and freeze. Remove from freezer a few minutes before serving time. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce. Garnish with fresh strawberries if desired. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Chill peas celery onions rice and shrimp. Combine and blend well all remaining ingredients. Pour over chilled mixture. Toss lightly and let stand in the refrigerator for several hours (preferably overnight).

title: Toasted Coconut Pie
instructions: Thoroughly combine eggs sugar margarine lemon juice and vanilla; stir in coconut. Pour filling into unbaked pie shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edges comes out clean. Cool before serving.

title: Chocolate Lover'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two (9-inch) round cake pans. Line bottom of pans with wax paper.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa. Add beaten eggs butter and milk. Mix well. Heat until hot on top of stove. Pour into deep dish pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is golden brown. Top with meringue and brown.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and divide into 2 casseroles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Caramel Pecan Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together. Pour into graham cracker crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Turn oven off and open door. Cool pie in oven to room temperature. Remove from pan and refrigerate if desired.

title: Chicken Cashew Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown onion and celery in butter. Add next 4 ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes. Put into buttered casserole. Top with layer of nuts and noodles. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly.

title: Dog Biscuits
instructions: Beat milk water drippings and bouillon cubes until all are dissolved. Pour into dry ingredients and mix well. Press out on an ungreased cookie sheet. Cut into shapes (of dog bones). Bake at 300\u00b0 for one hour then turn off heat and leave in oven until they harden.

title: Ed'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: Boil meat together until tender. Cool and remove meat from bones. Save meat broth. Grind meat with onions using coarse blade on food chopper. Add corn tomatoes butter and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer mixture 3 to 4 hours. Gradually add meat stock after having skimmed off fat. Serves 30 people. This freezes well.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Prepare pudding according to directions on box. Now mix all the other ingredients together with pudding and chill in a mold or dish.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Red Wine
instructions: Boil 1/2 cup of water in a heavy pot; add bouillon cube. Sear pork in hot butter turning with tongs until brown. Lower heat; add bouillon liquid herbs vegetables and a little wine. Cook for 1 hour; turn. Add more wine. Cook another hour; remove meat and keep warm. Drain vegetables from cooking liquid and mash. Return all to the pot. Mix cornstarch with cold water. Add to pot to thicken sauce stirring all the while. Serve sauce with the meat.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Halve peppers lengthwise. Remove stems seeds and membranes. Add salt to enough boiling water to cover peppers. Boil 5 minutes; drain.

title: Chicken Veggie Alfredo
instructions: In a large skillet brown chicken in oil. Transfer to a slow cooker. In a bowl combine the Alfredo sauce corn peas mushrooms onion water garlic salt and pepper. Pour over chicken. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hrs. Serve over linguine. Yield 4 servings.

title: Microwave Chip Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in microwave. Add hamburger and seasoning. Mix together.

title: Orange Loaf Cake
instructions: Cut orange. Squeeze over 1/2 cup of the sugar. Grind the orange peel and raisins twice. Cream remaining 1 1/2 cups sugar and oleo. Add eggs then milk mixed with the soda orange/raisins and flour. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes. Spoon sugar/juice over hot cake.

title: Sweet And Sour Beef Stew
instructions: Brown meat cubes in hot oil. Add the next 6 ingredients plus 1/2 cup water and 1 teaspoon salt. Cover and cook over low heat until meat is tender (approximately 2 hours).

title: Mom'S Bean Soup
instructions: Place beans in a 4-quart Dutch oven with 6 to 8 cups water. Heat to boiling and let simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat cover and let stand for 1 hour. Drain. Add 2 quarts water ham onion garlic parsley salt basil pepper oregano and bay leaf. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until beans are tender.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Pack cucumbers in jars. Bring mixture to boil. Pour over cucumbers and seal.

title: Fried Vidalia Onion Rings
instructions: Follow directions for waffles on the Bisquick package. Coat onion rings with batter several at a time. Drop into hot oil (about 375\u00b0) and cook 2 to 3 minutes turning if necessary to brown evenly. Drain on paper towels and salt to taste while still hot. Serves 3 or 4.

title: Chicken Swiss
instructions: Top chicken with cheese. Mix vermouth with soup. Spread over chicken. Top chicken with stuffing mix. Pour melted butter over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Swiss Fondue
instructions: Cut the bread in bite size pieces taking care that each piece has a portion of crust. Heat the garlic with the wine in the chafing dish pan until air bubbles appear; remove the garlic. Mix the cheese with flour and salt. Add to wine in three installments stirring with a wooden spoon until cheese has melted. Stir until mixture bubbles. Have each guest spear his piece of bread on a fondue fork dip it into the fondue and stir until bread is coated. If the fondue becomes too thick stir in warm wine.

title: Meringue Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients and beat on high with mixer for 15 minutes until consistency of marshmallow cream. Grease cookie sheets and drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet.

title: Seven-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Add cream cheese to jello mixture. Add all other ingredients except Seven-Up. Mix well. Stir in Seven-Up. Chill in refrigerator. Stir.

title: One Meal Brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Place beef brisket in large baking dish or roaster. Mix next 7 ingredients and pour over brisket. Place in oven and bake for 2 hours. Add vegetable to pan and continue baking for 2 additional hours or until done.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Submerge tea bags in boiling water for 10 minutes. Dissolve jello in tea; cool in ice until it starts to gel. Add other ingredients and refrigerate until congealed.

title: Low Calorie Frosting
instructions: Place water lemon juice and vanilla in bowl. Sprinkle in dry milk. Turn beater to high speed and whip for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Vegetable Squares
instructions: Spread\tcrescent rolls out on cookie sheet. Bake until brown.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in water until tender about 45 minutes. When cool enough peel potatoes and mash. Add butter sugar spices eggs and milk in large bowl. Beat until smooth. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie crust. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until crust is brown.

title: Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Test for doneness.

title: Cool Mandarin Salad
instructions: Mix together jello tapioca pudding and water and bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Add Cool Whip oranges and pineapple. Mix well. Pour into an 8 x 12-inch pan. Refrigerate. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Smoothie Mango Shake
instructions: Combine mangos ice honey and milk in blender or food processor. Puree until thick consistency. Serve in glasses with a mint garnish. Serves 4.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix sugar shortening and eggs. Add sour cream and bananas. Stir in dry ingredients. Pour into greased loaf pan and let stand 20 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until it tests done. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy and sugar is dissolved. Add egg yolks beating well. Combine buttermilk and soda stirring until soda dissolves. Add flour alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture beginning and ending with flour. Stir in vanilla. Add 1 1/2 cups of chopped walnuts and coconut stirring well. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Fold egg whites into batter. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting; sprinkle top with chopped walnuts.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Put cheese half and half and oleo in a saucepan and melt into a smooth sauce stirring constantly. Grate the potatoes and stir in sauce mixing thoroughly. Put in a 13 x 9-inch casserole packing firmly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread sour cream on top and spread onions evenly over the top. Fry and crumble bacon on top of the green onions. Put back in the oven and bake 5 minutes longer or more.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Scald milk. Add margarine. Mix sugar salt and vanilla with beaten eggs. Add broken pieces of bread to egg mixture. Mix well. Add milk and raisins and mix well. Pour into large baking pan. Set in pan of water. Bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Makes 35 to 40 servings.

title: Bean And Bacon Sandwich
instructions: Mix beans and relish and put filling on bread slices. Top with bacon (and cheese if desired). Heat in a 400\u00b0 oven or microwave until hot and cheese melts.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cube round steak; add salt paprika pepper and onion. Brown in melted butter; add bay leaf Worcestershire sauce and soup. Simmer 3 to 4 hours. Add sour cream just before serving. Dont let boil after adding sour cream.

title: Out Of The World Pie
instructions: Cook pie filling sugar pineapple cornstarch and coloring until thick. Remove from heat and add dry jello. Allow to cool. Add bananas and pecans. Pour into pie shell and top with whipped topping.

title: Sweet Gherkin Pickles(Gherkins, Immature Cucumbers, Are Often Made Into Sweet Pickles.)
instructions: First Day In the morning wash cucumbers thoroughly. Scrub with vegetable brush. Drain cucumbers and place in large container. Cover with boiling water. That afternoon 6 to 8 hours later drain and cover with fresh boiling water.

title: Sausage Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Melt cheese; mix all ingredients together. Keep hot for dipping.

title: Fried Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and dry fresh firm mushrooms. Dip in beaten egg and dredge in flour. Preheat oil to 375\u00b0 on deep-fat thermometer or until a 1-inch cube of bread browns in 60 seconds. Fry mushroom until brown then drain on paper towels. Salt and pepper to taste. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Festive Punch
instructions: Make Kool-Aid and orange juice by directions on package. Chill thoroughly. Just before serving mix all ingredients together.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Grind together the first 3 ingredients and add the salt. Let stand 1 hour. Drain and add vinegar and sugar. Boil 15 minutes. Cool and add mayonnaise and mustard. Mix and seal.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix together and heat in a microwave. Stir as cream cheese melts. Serve with bread sticks.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Sprinkle nuts evenly in bottom of tube pan greased and floured. Combine cake mix eggs water oil and rum in large mixing bowl. Blend and mix for 4 minutes on medium speed. Pour over pecans. Bake for about 1 hour at 325\u00b0 or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes before removing. Glaze with Rum Glaze while cake is still warm.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onions. Put salt over top; drain and rinse. Heat vinegar sugar turmeric celery seed and mustard seed until sugar dissolves. Add pickles and onions. Heat. Put in canning jars. Process in a water bath for 5 minutes.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Roll on floured board 1/4-inch thick and bake on greased cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Acorn Squash Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Melt margarine in 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Parboil squash in a small amount of water. Scoop pulp out. Place in a bowl; add remaining ingredients except cinnamon. Mix well. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put all the ingredients into baking dish in the order listed and squeeze margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Baked Beans Deluxe
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain on absorbent paper. Saute onion in bacon drippings. Combine all ingredients except bacon in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole; mix well. Top with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir together cornstarch broth and soy sauce. Set aside. In skillet over medium heat in 2 tablespoons hot oil stir-fry chicken until no longer pink. Remove and set aside. In skillet in 1 tablespoon hot oil stir-fry veggies garlic and ginger until tender-crisp. Stir in broth mixture. Cook until mixture boils and thickens stirring constantly. Return chicken to skillet. Heat through. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Yo-Yo'S
instructions: Mix flour milk and salt. Stirring until smooth; then cook until smooth stirring constantly. Set aside and cool.

title: Crunchy Nut Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly sugar butter eggs and vanilla. Mix and sift together flour soda and salt. Stir into first mixture. Add chopped nuts. Shape 1 level tablespoon of dough into balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet and flatten with fork that has been dipped in cold water. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well; make into balls. Melt the paraffin and chocolate chips in pan then drop balls into chocolate mixture.

title: Potato Casserole(Hand Me Downs)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in casserole dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Blend flour butter and powdered sugar; press in pie pan with fingers. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until slightly brown.

title: Wild Rice Salad With Basil And Tomatoes
instructions: Mix all together. Let stand 20 minutes. Serve on lettuce leaves with tomato wedge garnish.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown hamburger; add onions and cook until onions are soft. Add the 2 cans of tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes medium heat. Add the frozen corn and peas and cook 10 minutes. Add the cooked rice. Season to taste and cook until heated through.

title: Chocolate Chip Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients together. Add vanilla and lemon flavoring to cheese and beat in eggs. Add flour and salt to creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Raspberry Pie Or Strawberry
instructions: Boil sugar cornstarch and water until thickened and clear; add jello and few drops food coloring. Let cool; add berries and pour into baked crust.

title: Mexican Chef Salad
instructions: Toss first 5 ingredients together add tortilla chips and toss. Slice and add avocado. Brown meat add beans and salt; simmer for 10 minutes. Mix with cold salad decorate with tortilla chips avocado and tomatoes slices.

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Break crackers in half then layer them out on aluminum foil-lined cookie sheet. Boil together for 3 minutes (medium-low heat) the margarine sugar and butter. Pour over crackers then cover with chopped pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool and cut then layer on aluminum foil and put in a tin to store.

title: 2-Coconut Pies
instructions: Pour melted margarine over sugar. Add beaten eggs milk coconut and vanilla. Pour into pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 on lowest shelf for 40 to 45 minutes or until set.

title: Fat-Free Sweetened Condensed Milk Substitute
instructions: Dissolve sugar in hot water. Let cool. Add nonfat dry milk and beat or put into blender until smooth. This equals a 14 ounce can of milk.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spray 9 x 13 pan with nonstick spray. Tear 4 slices of bread into small pieces.\tCover bottom of pan with bread pieces.\tBrown sausage and mix with eggs cheese salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press rolls in bottom and up sides of a greased pizza pan. Smooth seams. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Soften cream cheese; mix with mayonnaise and dry dressing mix. Spread on cooled crust. Top with cheese and vegetables. Cover; refrigerate until served. Cut into slices or squares.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Blend flour and shortening well. Add sugar baking soda eggs and mashed bananas. Mix well. Add nuts. Bake in a greased lightly floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and combine with macaroni. Add 1 boiled egg (chopped). Chill before serving.

title: Preservation Of Newspaper Clippings
instructions: Mix together. Let stand 24 hours. Put clippings in solution. Let it soak for 2 hours. This will neutralize acids in paper. This keeps clippings from turning yellow.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and brown sugar. Add eggs. Stir in dry ingredients. Fold in raisins and nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 200 cookies.

title: Sobol'S Bar-B-Q Sauce
instructions: Assemble and mix the ingredients.

title: Buttermilk Milk Pie
instructions: Beat the sugar flour butter and eggs real good. Add the buttermilk and vanilla; mix well. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Easy Supper Dish
instructions: Brown meat in heavy skillet. Add salt when done. Add Spanish rice and simmer about 15 minutes covered.

title: Baked Perch Fillets
instructions: Sprinkle fish with onion salt and pepper. Place in baking dish. Combine Tabasco sauce and buttermilk. Pour over fish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until fish flakes. Serves 2.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix according to directions on box and cool. Crumble into small pieces. Prepare pudding according to directions on package.

title: Mock Bisquick Mix
instructions: Sift flour baking powder milk and salt. Blend in Crisco thoroughly. Store and use like Bisquick.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy; gradually add sugar. Beat until stiff. Add salt and vanilla. Mix well; add pecans and chocolate bits and drop by teaspoonful on ungreased foiled cookie sheets (2). Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Put in and turn off immediately and take out in morning. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: * You may wish to use additional confectioners sugar and lemon juice for an even yummier taste!

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook ground beef until brown; drain. Stir in beans tomato sauce taco sauce chili powder and garlic powder. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Place tortilla chips in ungreased 2-quart casserole. Top with beef mixture. Spread with sour cream. Sprinkle with onions tomato and cheese. Bake uncovered 20 to 30 minutes until bubbly. Arrange additional chips around edge of casserole; serve with shredded lettuce chili peppers and taco sauce if desired.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute 1/2 cup onion and 1/2 cup chopped green pepper in butter. Add cream of chicken soup and onion soup. Mix together with cooked rice. Bake in a large dish; top with cheese of your choice. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Oven Baked Eggs
instructions: In a saucepan melt margarine then stir in flour and salt until blended. Slowly add Sprite and milk stirring until mixture is smooth. Add cheese and stir until it is melted into the mixture. Pour mixture into a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Break eggs into the sauce. Bake at 350 degrees until eggs become firm. Serves 6.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Cut apples after coring and paring if skins are tough into fairly large pieces. Some apples like Cortlands do not darken as quickly when cut for a salad. Add lemon juice chopped celery and walnuts; toss to mix. Chill. Mix with mayonnaise for serving on a bed of lettuce. Chopped candied ginger also may be added to the salad.

title: Quick And Easy Peach Pie
instructions: Combine everything except fruit. Sprinkle over fruit in deep pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fancy Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Serve in small pastry tart shells or crackers as sandwich spread or on lettuce leaf. This can be made with canned tuna in spring water rather than chicken.

title: Pecan Buttermilk Pralines
instructions: Mix sugar soda and milk in heavy saucepan and cook over medium heat to soft ball stage (234\u00b0). Remove from heat and add vanilla and pecans. Begin beating immediately. Beat until candy begins to thicken. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper or greased baking sheet. Cool. Yields 30 small patties.

title: Bite-Sized Chili Rellenos
instructions: In a bowl whisk together the flour and salt; add the beer and whisk until batter is smooth. Let the batter stand covered at room temperature for at least 1 hour and up to 3 hours. Cut chilies into 3/4-inch strips; cut cheese into 3/4 x 1/2 x 1/2-inch pieces. Wrap a strip of chili around each piece of cheese; secure the chili and cheese with a toothpick and chill the cheese morsels on a plate for 1 hour. In a deep saucepan or wok heat approximately 1 cup oil until it is hot but not smoking. Stir the batter and coat the cheese morsels in batter allowing any excess to drip off. Fry them in the oil turning frequently for 15 seconds or until they are golden and crisp. Transfer the chilies to paper towels to drain and discard the toothpicks. Makes about 20 hors doeuvres.

title: Happiness Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Add tears of joy sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with love and kindly service. Fold in 4 cups of prayer and faith. After pouring all this into your daily life bake well with the heat of human kindness. Serve with a smile anytime and it will satisfy the hunger of starved souls. You never test the resources of God until you attempt the impossible.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Follow directions on package for cooking macaroni then drain and wash with cold water.

title: Peanut Butter Mousse Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese at low speed until soft and fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter at medium speed. Slowly beat in milk; fold Cool Whip into mixture. Pour half of filling into each shell. Sprinkle each pie with peanuts. Freeze until firm and then cut into wedges. If stored for any length of time in freezer wrap pie before freezing to exclude air.

title: Chocolate Ooey-Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Mom'S Ranch Stew
instructions: Brown meat (drain fat) onion (chopped fine) and pepper. Add other ingredients and simmer in a large pot at least 20 minutes. Serve with cornbread rolls or crackers.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain well. Mix together mayonnaise soup and onion. Add broccoli. Beat eggs well and add to broccoli mixture. Pour into 9 or 10-inch casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs. Add a little extra grated cheese scattered on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mary'S Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese powdered sugar peanut butter and milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in graham cracker crust and freeze. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Saute onion chilies and garlic in oil until soft. Add tomatoes bouillon chicken broth water tomato juice cumin chili powder salt pepper Worcestershire sauce and steak sauce. Bring soup to boil; lower heat and simmer covered 1 hour. Put tortilla strips in bottom of bowl. Spoon on soup. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or more.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Beat margarine and shortening until light and creamy. Add sugar and beat until creamy. Add flour and mix well adding milk a little at a time. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add vanilla. Beat until creamy. Pour mixture into three 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Frost with

title: Date-Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time. Mix the flour and soda and add to creamed mixture. Add remaining ingredients mixing thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until done.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Mix well and marinate meat for 2 hours. Baste often. Very good for \Shish Kabobs\.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: In a heavy saucepan bring the milk just to the boil. Stir in the rice and the raisins or fruit. Cook covered for 30 or 40 minutes or until most of the milk is absorbed stirring occasionally. You may wish to leave the lid off during the last 8 to 10 minutes. Remove pan from heat; add sugar and vanilla. Spoon into dessert cups and sprinkle with nutmeg. Serve warm or chilled. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Watch closely so as not to brown too much. Cool.

title: Pineapple Chess Pie
instructions: Mix the flour with the sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until a knife inserted will come out clean about 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet. Drain off any grease. Place hamburger in soup kettle. Add water. Bring to a boil. Boil on low heat for 15 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and bring back to boil on medium heat. Cook for 30 minutes on low.

title: Dirty Rice Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in a baking dish. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 1/2 hours or more.

title: Green Split-Pea Soup
instructions: Fry bacon in 5-quart pan. Remove bacon drain and save 1 1/2 tablespoons grease. Add onion carrots and celery. Cook over medium heat 3 minutes. Add peas ham hock water bay leaves salt and pepper. Bring to boil lower heat and simmer covered 1 1/2 hours. Remove hock cut off meat and return to soup. Crumble bacon. Garnish with crumbled bacon and toasted croutons.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. Pour into greased long cookie sheet pan 11 x 17-inch. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Noodle Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain well and add mushroom soup evaporated milk and mushrooms. Spread half of noodle mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with layer of shredded cheese. Spread on remaining noodles. Sprinkle again with shredded cheese and top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and slightly browned.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix by directions on box. Pour half of mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes; remove from oven. While cake is baking in saucepan combine butter caramels and milk. When sauce is melted and smooth add pecans. Spread sauce filling over hot cake. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Add remaining cake batter and spread over top of filling. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool completely and cut in squares.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Pour half the batter in a greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Melt caramels with milk and butter over low heat stirring constantly. Pour over cake. Sprinkle with 1 cup nuts and chocolate chips. Pour remaining batter over filling. Sprinkle with remaining nuts. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and remove from heat. Stir in brown sugar and mix well. Add eggs one at a time stirring until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Stir well.

title: Quick And Easy Low-Fat Cobbler
instructions: Place pie filling in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Pour dry cake mix over pie filling. Melt margarine; pour over cake mix. Sprinkle on pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with low-fat ice cream.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Clouds
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla at medium speed on electric mixer. Gradually add heavy cream; mix well. Whip until thickened. Using the back of a spoon shape into 10 (3 1/2-inch) shells. Place on waxed paper-lined cookie sheet. Freeze 2 hours or\tovernight. When ready to serve fill with cherry pie filling. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top if desired.

title: Cereal Croutons
instructions: Mix seasoned salt celery salt and garlic powder. Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Put oil in shallow baking pan; tilt to coat pan. Add cereal and toss. Sprinkle with salt mixture and toss. Bake 15 minutes and stir well. Bake 15 minutes more. Cool on paper towels.

title: Party Meatballs
instructions: Combine meatball ingredients. Shape meat mixture into 1-inch balls. Bake in a shallow baking dish at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Drain excess grease from meatballs. Mix chili sauce and jelly in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave until jelly melts. Pour over meatballs. Serve in a crock-pot or chafing dish.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Tie all spices together in cheesecloth. Chop vegetables fine. In a large bowl combine vegetables cover with salt and let stand overnight covered with cheesecloth. In morning drain vegetables; press through cheesecloth squeezing out as much liquid as possible.

title: Honey-Mustard Chicken
