instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Mix the honey and mustard together. Grease the bottom of your pan or casserole dish. Put chicken in the pan. Brush sauce on both sides and put it in the oven at 350\u00b0. Bake for 2 hours until golden brown.

title: Pierogi(Stuffed Tiny Pies)
instructions: Do not add milk or seasoning when you mash the potatoes. Cook onion in butter or margarine until tender. Combine with potatoes dill salt and dash of pepper. Stir in cottage cheese. Makes 2 cups.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans and place in casserole dish. Spread soup over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until soup bubbles. Take from oven and stir. Place onion rings on top. Bake until brown.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt margarine in 8-inch baking dish. Beat eggs with a fork. Mix flour and sugar until well blended and add to eggs. Add remainder of ingredients and pour into dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Dessert Pizza
instructions: Cut frozen cookie dough into 1/4-inch slices. Arrange cookie slices slightly overlapping on 13-inch pizza pan. Press edges to seal. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly. Loosen cookie from pan then allow to finish cooling on pan. Blend cream cheese and sugar well. Spread over cooled crust. Arrange fruit on cream cheese mixture. Chill.

title: Burger Bundles
instructions: Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions. Mix evaporated milk and meat. Divide into 5 patties. On waxed paper pat each to 6-inch circle. Put 1/4 cup of stuffing into center of each. Fold meat over and seal. Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over meat. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ranch Biscuits
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and Mandarin oranges. Add dry jello to cottage cheese and stir. Add fruit and Cool Whip.

title: Pea Pods And Chicken Salad Oriental
instructions: *Pea pods should be trimmed and blanched (boil in water 1 minute drain and rinse with cold water).

title: Rice Noodle Casserole
instructions: Melt butter crumble noodles into it and brown for a few minutes. Add all other ingredients. Bake at 350 for about 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Krispy Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape into balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of a glass dipped in flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Spinach Bars
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan melt butter. Mix remaining ingredients and spoon into a pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool slightly before cutting. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oatmeal. Set aside. Mix together brown sugar Wesson oil flour salt white sugar whole eggs and soda. Mix all together and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Grandma Barre'S Icebox Cake
instructions: Beat whipping cream until thick and frothy. Add chocolate syrup for flavor and color. Spread chocolate cream mixture between graham crackers making a stack and alternating mixture between graham crackers. Leave enough chocolate cream mixture to spread over entire stack. Refrigerate overnight. Slice on an angle to serve the next day. Be creative; add a decorative topping such as chocolate sprinkles etc. Be sure to spread enough chocolate cream mixture so the graham crackers do not dry out.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla and water. Add flour and mix well. Add nuts and bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar while hot.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cut up beef. Mix soup and milk. Add cheese onion and beef. Stir in macaroni. Store covered in 1 1/2-quart casserole 4 hours or overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered. If necessary add more milk before baking.

title: School Bean Chowder
instructions: Cook beans in 3 quarts of water or more depending on dryness of beans. When beans are nearly done add 1/2 teaspoon chili powder and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. While beans are cooking combine meat onions and garlic. Brown in skillet on top of stove or 350\u00b0 in oven stirring frequently. Add puree chili powder salt and bread crumbs. Simmer 15 minutes. Combine meat mixture and beans. May have to add more water for desired seasoning and consistency. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Brown hamburger with onion and drain. Add other ingredients along with macaroni. Put in pan. Spread cheese on top then add pepperoni. Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken Breasts And Rice
instructions: Sprinkle rice evenly into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix remaining ingredients except chicken and Parmesan cheese. Pour 1/3 of the mixture over rice. Arrange chicken breasts over soup mixture; cover with remaining soup mixture. Cover with Parmesan cheese. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 2 hours.

title: Raisin Filled Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening. Add eggs buttermilk flour baking powder soda and vanilla. Mix well. Roll out and cut out.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
instructions: Mix and boil the above ingredients. Pack cucumbers in jars with dill garlic and hot pepper. Pour hot solution over and let stand 10 minutes then pour solution off in jug and save for the next batch. Pour fresh solution in each jar and seal use hot lids and rings.

title: Pickled Peaches
instructions: Combine sugar cinnamon and vinegar. Cook for 20 minutes. Dip each peach in boiling water. Remove skin by rubbing with a cloth. Stick 2 cloves into each peach. Cook in the syrup until tender. Do not cook too many at one time. Place cooked peaches in preheated glass jars. Boil remaining syrup for 10 minutes. Pour over peaches. Seal jars.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar shortening and butter together thoroughly. Add salt and egg; beat again. (Add soda to sour cream.) Add to above ingredients. Beat again and fold in flour. Chill before rolling out for cookies. The dough is rich and soft. I have better luck if I freeze the dough then work with small amounts at a time. You may need to add extra flour when rolling out to cut. These are very good.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into a ball. Serve with crackers.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat eggs; add to pumpkin then all liquids. Mix dry ingredients to pumpkin mixture. Pour into loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Easy Portuguese Soup
instructions: Fry Portuguese sausage in a large pot until brown. Add onion and garlic; fry a little. Add tomato sauce plus 1 can of water. Then add kidney beans plus 1 can water. Bring to a boil. Add 1/2 cup macaroni carrots and potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes. Cook for 1/2 hour until noodles carrots and potatoes are cooked. If gravy is too thick add more water. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serves 4.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together by hand. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in greased/floured tube or Bundt pan. Cake will crack slightly on top. Cool in pan 1 hour before removing. Use cream cheese frosting or serve plain.

title: Debbie'S Salad
instructions: Put spinach in bowl. Press down and season with salt and pepper. Add bacon and chopped eggs. Break lettuce and put on top. Season again and layer next with peas and onions then cheese. Cover completely with mayonnaise. Cover bowl tightly and put in refrigerator overnight. Toss just before serving.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots with salt until tender; cool and drain. Cook sugar soup vinegar and seasonings until thick and mustard dissolves. In a dish layer carrots green pepper and onion. Pour mixture over then another layer and more mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas with fork. Stir in other ingredients. Bake in greased loaf pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread graham cracker crumbs in pan. Sprinkle on coconut. Pour condensed milk over coconut. Sprinkle on both kinds of chips. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Earthcake Dessert
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cover bottom of cake pan with coconut. Cover coconut with chopped nuts.

title: Chocolate Streusel Bars
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar and cocoa. Cut in margarine until crumbly (mixture will be dry). Reserving 2 cups crumb mixture; press remainder on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Sour Cream Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Combine water and 2 tablespoons picante sauce in a large shallow pan or dish. Place tortillas in mixture and let stand 5 minutes; drain. Cook ground beef and onion in a heavy skillet until brown. Drain off excess grease. Stir in salt pepper cumin chili powder garlic olives and remaining picante sauce; simmer 5 minutes.

title: Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Pack in jars leaving 1-inch headspace. Combine sugar cornstarch nutmeg and salt together. Stir in the cold water. Put on stove and stir until thick and bubbly. Add lemon juice. Pour hot syrup into jars making sure there are no air holes. Keep syrup hot while putting into jars. Process at 15 pounds pressure for 15 minutes.

title: Red Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar. Add 1 quart of water and stir until blended. Add rest of water pineapple juice and 7-Up. Chill.

title: Indian Tacos
instructions: Cook pinto beans and add Pace picante sauce or use 4 cans pinto beans. Brown ground beef with garlic. Dont chop. Drain meat and remove garlic. Add taco seasoning and tomato juice. Simmer 1 hour. Chop lettuce tomatoes and onion. Grate 1 pound of Cheddar cheese.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Pound breasts between two sheets of Saran Wrap to 1/8-inch thickness. Saute onion green pepper carrot and garlic in butter until soft. Add bread crumbs and 1/2 cup broth to mixture. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Strawberry Surprise(Frozen Dessert)
instructions: Mix together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish flour brown sugar oleo and pecans. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven stirring often for 20 minutes. Let cool completely. Reserve 1 cup for topping. Spread the rest of the bottom of same dish evenly.

title: Lemon-Raspberry Parfait
instructions: In a saucepan combine cornstarch sugar and salt. Mix together the milk and egg yolks and slowly stir into cornstarch mixture. Cook over medium-low heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Boil stirring 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and pour through a sieve. Whip the cream until it holds soft peaks. Fold whipped cream into cooled pudding. Halve pudding and fold raspberry puree into one half. Spoon alternating layers of pudding into parfait glasses. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Blueberry Yum Yum
instructions: Combine berries 1 c. sugar and 1/4 c. water in sauce pot on low heat until berries are soft - approximately 15 minutes. Combine corn starch and 3 Tbsp. water to berry mixture. Cook until thickens. Cool.

title: Ribbon Layered Jello
instructions: Dissolve 2 packages of gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water. Add 1 cup boiling water and 1 can of milk. Mix together and set mixture in warm water so it doesnt set.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
instructions: Mix flour 1/2 cup confectioners sugar baking powder salt and nutmeg in small bowl. Set aside. Combine milk water Crisco oil and lemon peel in medium saucepan. Heat to rolling boil over medium-high heat. Add flour mixture all at once. Beat with wooden spoon until mixture pulls away from sides of pan into a ball. Remove from heat cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Heat 2 to 3 inches Crisco oil in deep fryer or large saucepan to 350\u00b0. Drop dough by tablespoon into hot Crisco oil. Fry 3 or 4 puffs at a time 4 to 6 minutes turning over several times. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle top with confectioners sugar.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix all together and chill overnight. Quick and easy dessert.

title: Fruit Juice Cocktail
instructions: Mix pineapple juice and almond flavoring. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Oven Shrimp Dish
instructions: Use 9 x 12-inch pan. Melt cube of butter and add about 1/4 cup white wine and lots of garlic. Add sliced mushrooms onions and pieces of green and red peppers pea pods and shrimp. Cook at 350\u00b0 uncovered turning shrimp once until done. Serve over rice.

title: No Oil Dressing
instructions: Shake all ingredients in tightly covered container. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Shake before serving. Makes about 3/4 cup dressing 15 calories per serving.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except marshmallows with electric mixer. Pour into buttered 1-quart casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle marshmallows on top shortly before removing dish from oven.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Mix melted margarine and brown sugar. Cool slightly and add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add sifted flour to liquid mixture and mix well. Add chopped nuts and chocolate chips. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cut when cool.

title: Prune, Apple And Chestnut Stuffing For Wild Goose
instructions: Soak prunes in wine overnight. Remove the prunes pit them and cut up in large pieces. Pour the soaking liquid over the chestnuts in a small saucepan and add just enough water to barely cover them. Simmer gently until the chestnuts are tender about 25 minutes and the liquid is nearly gone. Stir in the butter then mix together with the apple prunes and the bread crumbs. A touch of fresh rosemary is a good seasoner but dried is apt to be too overpowering. Makes 2 cups.

title: Elaine'S Never Fail Cobbler
instructions: Combine Bisquick 1/2 cup sugar milk and butter. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 12-inch pan. Scatter berries over batter. Combine water and 1 1/2 cups sugar in a saucepan and boil 2 to 3 minutes. Pour over berries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Goliath Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar eggs vanilla and syrup. Add soda. Mix well. Then add peanut butter. Stir in oats chips and M&Ms. Mix well and drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Mix together lightly stuffing margarine and broth. Spread half of mixture in buttered 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix together chicken celery onion mayonnaise and salt. Spread over stuffing. Top with remaining stuffing. Mix together milk and eggs; pour slowly over top.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash fresh picked small cucumbers and pack in sterilized quart jars. Add 1 clove garlic 1 sprig fresh dill and 1/4 teaspoon mustard seed.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Pour into casserole. Top with grated cheese or cheese cracker crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream all ingredients together except flour. Stir in 4 1/2 cups of flour or until a stiff mixture that you can pinch off and roll in a ball. place on a cookie sheet. Take a fork dipped in water and mash on the top of the cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown 9 minutes. Makes lots of cookies. Keep what dough you dont use in icebox and bake as needed.

title: Chicken Oriental
instructions: In large skillet brown onion in margarine. Add chicken and cook until done. Slice cabbage and add to chicken and onion. Add Rice-A-Roni. Cook until cabbage is done. Serve while hot.

title: Saucy Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread in evaporated milk in bowl. Add ground chuck onion egg tomato sauce salt and pepper; mix well. Shape into loaf. Place in cast-iron baking pan. Pour tomatoes over top. Bake covered at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 5 servings.

title: Lucky
instructions: Step 1 Mix flour margarine and chopped pecans. Spread on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let crust and pan cool.

title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cook until tender. Drain mix all other ingredients together and beat until \fluffy\. Put in greased 9 x 13 pan or similar large dish. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: All ingredients at room temperature. Mix until well blended. Make into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until brown.

title: Meringue Puffs
instructions: Heat oven to 200\u00b0. Line 2 cookie sheets with paper from paper grocery bags. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar in a medium size bowl at high speed until peaks form. Add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating 1 to 2 minutes after each addition until mixture stands in stiff glossy peaks. Beat in vanilla. Spoon half of meringue mixture into decorating bag or plastic tube fitted with a large star shape. Pipe into 1 1/4-inch star shapes on cookie sheets. Repeat with remaining meringue. Bake for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove from paper while meringues are still warm.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain off grease and cool. Chop into bite-size pieces the tomatoes and lettuce; chop onion and crush the taco chips. Toss all ingredients and chill.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together and press into 8-inch spring-form pan.

title: Pineapple, Pecan Cheese Ball
instructions: In a mixing bowl whip cream cheese until smooth. Gently stir in pineapple green peppers green onions and seasonings. Add American cheese (optional). Turn out onto a sheet of plastic wrap and shape into a ball. Roll cheese in nuts. Refrigerate overnight. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Crisp Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In shallow baking pan thoroughly blend all ingredients together except potatoes and turn to coat thoroughly. Bake stirring occasionally 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Garnish with parsley. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown ground meat; drain. Add pizza sauce to meat and heat through. Cut buns in half; top each with mixture sliced pepperoni and shredded Mozzarella cheese. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Let cool. Add 7-Up sugar and vanilla. Add nuts if desired. Soften cream cheese at room temperature. Cream and mix with crushed pineapple. Mix into jello and pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Chill until set.

title: Sweet Dough
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/2 cup of the warm water. Mix sugar salt shortening and yeast (which has been softened). Add remaining 1/2 cup of water and the egg. Add flours and mix well. Knead on lightly floured board for 5 minutes. Let rise until double in bulk (about 1 hour).

title: Philly Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Beat all ingredients in small mixing bowl at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Refrigerate. Serve with vegetable dippers or as a baked potato topper.

title: Chili
instructions: Fry out fat. Cook chopped onions and garlic tender. Add meat and cook until it loses its pinkish color. Add 2 tablespoons flour. Cook peppers with water and cook until tender. Strain through strainer into meat. Add tomatoes (well mashed) 1 quart of hot water and seasonings and cook for about 2 hours. More hot water may be added if needed. Beans may be added. Cook chili at slow boil.

title: English Stew
instructions: In large saucepan layer cabbage (chopped) potatoes (diced) onion (rings) and cut sausage. Add small amount of water. Place on stove top. Steam or boil until vegetables are tender. Serve with corn bread. Makes a nice meal for cold days.

title: Crab Mousse
instructions: Combine celery crabmeat onion mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce in bowl. Heat soup and cheese until warm add wine and gelatine. When gelatine is dissolved add to crab mixture mix and pour in lightly oiled mold. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Pizza Bread
instructions: Thaw bread dough. When thawed roll on floured board until rectangular in shape. Add pepperoni and shredded Mozzarella cheese leaving about 1 inch of dough on edges with no cheese. Roll up dough jelly roll fashion and place seam side down in a ring on greased cookie sheet. Bake according to bread recipe or until brown on top. Great!

title: Spinach Or Broccoli Souffle
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on box. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Mix well. Place into greased shallow 2-quart baking dish. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli Nut Salad
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Toss with rest of ingredients and refrigerate. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Louisiana Yam Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into pastry shell and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until knife comes out clean. May be served with Cool Whip on top.

title: Mom'S Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar gradually creaming until light. Add egg and vanilla and beat until fluffy.

title: Jalapeno Corn Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch square baking pan. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Pour half of this batter into pan. Cover evenly with half the cheese then peppers then remaining cheese. Top with remaining batter. Bake 1 hour. Let cool 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Brian'S Raspberry-Chocolate Pie
instructions: Roll puff pastry sheet (with flour) to fit inside 13 x 11-inch baking pan. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until light brown. Cook pudding and milk according to pie recipe on pudding box. Stir in cream cheese on low heat and add powdered sugar. Pour into prepared puff pastry. Cool and top with raspberries and whipped cream if desired.

title: Chicken And Noodles
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat melt 1/4 cup spread. Add chicken and garlic powder. Cook stirring occasionally for 4 minutes. Stir in remaining spread mushrooms and peas; cook 2 minutes or until chicken is coated through. Stir in hot cooked noodles and cheese. Toss and cook until cheese is melted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Three Cheese-Ham Puff
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 2-quart round casserole. Beat eggs with hand beater. Beat in baking mix and milk until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole. Bake until knife inserted near center comes out clean 50 to 55 minutes. Let stand about 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Parmesan Onion Bake
instructions: Saute onions and celery until tender in a large skillet in 3 T butter; drain and set aside. In a saucepan melt the remaining butter; stir in flour salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually stir in milk and bring to a boil. Cook for 2 minutes until thickened stirring constantly. Pour over vegetables and toss to coat.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop up artichoke hearts. Mix all together and bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly (gets a little brown on top too). Bake about 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with dippers. You need to have fairly firm crackers. Triscuits or Wheat Thins work well. (I usually use fresh Parmesan cheese not the canned. Its tastier!)

title: Confucious Almond Cookies
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine flour ground nuts 1/4 cup sugar and brown sugar then cut in butter until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Form the mixture into a ball and knead until smooth. On a lightly floured surface roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into 1 1/2-inch circles. Place 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Lightly sprinkle with the additional sugar then lightly press a whole nut in the center of each cookie. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove and cool on wire rack.

title: Banana Crunch Bread
instructions: In small bowl combine melted margarine and frosting mix until crumbly. Set aside. In large bowl blend sour cream with eggs and bananas then blend in cake mix for 2 minutes.

title: Turtle Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt caramels with 1/3 cup of condensed milk over low heat. Spread evenly over pastry shell. Melt chocolate and margarine over low heat. Beat eggs with remainder of condensed milk water vanilla and salt. Add chocolate mixture; mix well. Pour over caramels. Top with pecans. Bake 35 minutes or until center is set. Cool and chill before serving.

title: Baked Chow Mein Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place chow mein noodles in a plastic storage bag; crush noodles. Combine crushed noodles & nuts in shallow dish. Melt butter in microwave. Add soy sauce ginger & pepper to butter; stir to combine. Dip chicken breasts in butter mixture then roll in noodles. Gently press noodle mixture onto chicken. Lay in bottom of 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake 25-30 minutes or until juices run clear when pierced with a fork.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese; pour into a greased casserole. Cover with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Then add other ingredients except cheese. Pour 1/2 of the mixture into a greased pan (cast iron skillet works well). Then spread on the cheese. Pour the rest of the mixture. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Hot Dog Cooler
instructions: Mix juices and water; stir. Add grape juice and stir. After all ingredients are well blended chill. Store in large jugs until well chilled.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Bake and crumble corn bread combine with onions radishes peppers and tomatoes. Mix well mayonnaise cucumber salad dressing and mustard. Pour over corn bread mixture and toss.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise; remove seeds and wash. Combine beef cooked rice onion salt pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Pile mixture into peppers in large baking dish. Pour sauce over each pepper. Cover tightly and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 and 1/4 hours or until peppers are tender basting occasionally. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Easy Top Crust For Fruit Pie
instructions: Make pie filling using any fruit or berries following recipe for regular pie. Put into deep-dish bottom crust.

title: Chicken Sandwich Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Make into patties and fry in lightly greased pan until brown.

title: Christmas Boiled Custard
instructions: Put milk in double boiler and when thoroughly heated add eggs sugar and salt which have been previously mixed together. Cook approximately 10 minutes or longer stirring constantly. Do not overcook as milk will curdle. Custard is done when it coats a wooden spoon. Add vanilla to taste. My dad usually added something a little stronger. Chill as cold as possible. Also good over vanilla ice cream.

title: Congealed Tuna Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water for 5 minutes. Dissolve chicken bouillon cubes in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Add gelatin to bouillon cubes. Add tuna mayonnaise celery olives and boiled eggs. Chill in your favorite mold or in a small bowl.

title: Marinated Shrimp Kabobs
instructions: Toss shrimp and artichoke hearts with French dressing. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before grilling. Drain marinade off and reserve. Thread shrimp and artichoke hearts alternately on 6-inch wooden skewers. Grill over coals until done to taste. Makes 6 servings.

title: *Caramels
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil. Continue to cook until 250\u00b0 on candy thermometer is ready stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Pour into buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. When cool cut into individual squares and wrap individually in wax paper. Makes about 1 1/2 pounds. This recipe can be doubled. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Rhubaba
instructions: In oven melt butter in an 8 x 1 1/2-inch round baking dish; stir in brown sugar. Top evenly with rhubarb. If desired add a few drops of red food coloring to sherry; drizzle over rhubarb.

title: Sour Cream Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar sour cream Karo butter and salt in heavy saucepan. Bring to boil slowly stirring until sugar dissolves. Boil without stirring on medium heat to soft boil stage. Remove from heat and let stand 15 minutes. Do not stir. Add vanilla beat until mixture starts to lose its gloss about 8 minutes. Stir in cherries and nuts. Pour into greased pan. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart container suitable for microwave oven stir together peanuts sugar syrup and salt. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Remove from oven and stir. Return to oven and microwave on High for 4 more minutes. Remove from oven; stir in butter and vanilla. Return to oven and microwave on High 2 more minutes. Remove from oven and quickly stir in baking soda (mixture will be light and foamy) and pour onto a lightly greased baking sheet or marble slab spreading thin. When cool break into small pieces. Store in airtight container. Makes 1 pound.

title: Dreamsicle Cake
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and beat 3 minutes. Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Elegante
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes 1/4 inch thick. Cook in salted water until almost tender. Drain.

title: Hamburger Crunch
instructions: Saute onion and ground beef. Mix with the rest of the ingredients except noodles. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Take pan from oven and sprinkle with a 6-ounce can of chow mein noodles. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes more. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mrs. Mcmullan'S Fruit Cake(From The Files Of Dessie Bell Hayes)
instructions: Chop everything good. Using both hands mix and mix until all mixed good. Makes 2 loaves. Put wax paper in pans and press cake until well packed. Place in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Test to see if it sticks together. If it does remove from oven. Let cool. When cooled remove from pan and remove wax paper. Wrap in a cloth soaked with grape juice or wine. Store for future use.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour baking powder soda and salt; mix well. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a floured surface; knead three or four times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place biscuits on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until tops are golden. Yields 14 biscuits.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar and flour. Add eggs margarine buttermilk and vanilla. Pour into deep-dish pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 3/4 hours. Pie is done when small knife inserted in pie comes out clean.

title: Chinese Dinner
instructions: On large skillet crumble hamburger meat and cook until brown. In another saucepan cook Ramen noodles as directed on package. When hamburger and noodles are done pour noodles in hamburger and mix. Now mix 2 to 3 cans mixed vegetables into meat and noodles. No need to cook any longer. Delicious with soy sauce.

title: Parmesan Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside. Dip chicken in salad dressing; dredge in bread crumb mixture. Place chicken bone side down in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to an hour or until tender. Six servings at about 197 calories per serving.

title: Cream Of Vegetable Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter in kettle until tender. Add flour; cook and stir until bubbly. Gradually add chicken broth; cook and stir until thickened about 5 minutes. Stir in the milk cream basil salt pepper and garlic powder. Add vegetables; cook until heated through.

title: Spicy Roasted Southern Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Melt butter and place in a mixing bowl. Add Worcestershire hot sauce or pepper sauce pepper and salt. Whisk together. Add pecans and stir to coat thoroughly. Pour nuts out onto a jellyroll pan and spread into a single layer. Place in oven and bake for 20 to 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels if necessary. Store in an airtight container. Can be made in advance.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Take breasts and put 2 slices of ham and 2 slices of cheese in the middle. Fold and put toothpicks in to hold together. Bake in oven in foiled pan at 450\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Souped-Up Delmonicos
instructions: Brown steaks seasoned with desired amounts of salt pepper and seasoned salt. Add oregano soup and milk. Lower heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes.

title: Black Forest Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package directions in a 9 x 13 x 2 pan. Mix pie filling and almond flavoring. While cake is still warm poke top with fork and spread cherry filling over cake. While cake cools prepare pudding adding extra vanilla flavoring. Fold in whipped topping. Spread pudding mixture over cake carefully covering cherry pie filling. Decorate with chocolate sprinkles and cherries. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Mix other ingredients with yeast. Mix dough thoroughly. Flatten on a lightly floured surface and cut out into rounds with a biscuit cutter. Place into a greased pan and let stand 15 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Pour in spaghetti sauce and rice. Simmer until rice is done. Steam cabbage then layer meat sauce cabbage and cheese. Top with remaining cheese. Bake in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all 3 ingredients together.

title: Homemade Pizza For Kids
instructions: Mix dough by directions on package. Grease cake pans or any size pan you want to use. Separate dough and grease hands before patting out on pan. Top with whatever you like. Add cheeses and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. This is fun to do when friends are over. Everyone has their own pizza the way they like it. (One package dough makes 2 pizzas usually.)

title: Chocolate Streusel Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour sugar and cocoa. Cut in margarine until crumbly (mixture will be dry). Reserving 2 cups crumb mixture press remainder firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Pour over prepared crust. Combine nuts with reserved crumb mixture; sprinkle over cheese mixture. Bake 25 minutes or until bubbly. Cool and chill. Cut into bars. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix meal and sugar; add beaten eggs and butter. Stir in vinegar and vanilla. Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shells. Set aside for 10 minutes then bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Cheese Balls
instructions: In a large bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add next 6 ingredients; stir until well blended. Divide cheese mixture in half; form each half into a ball. Sprinkle each cheese ball with paprika. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend. Serve with crackers or cocktail bread. Makes 2 cheese balls.

title: Celery Casserole
instructions: Boil celery for 8 minutes. Pour in greased baking dish with water chestnuts. Mix milk with soup and pour over celery. Brown bread crumbs in butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Moist Apple Cake
instructions: Pour sugar over apples; let dissolve. Add flour egg soda and cinnamon. Mix well. Pour into a well greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. While cake is baking make sauce.

title: Vegetable Shrimp And Pasta
instructions: In a large skillet heat corn oil over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and garlic; saute 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Remove. Add water wine soup mix oregano and dried red pepper to skillet. Stirring constantly bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes. Return shrimp to skillet; simmer 2 minutes. Spoon over pasta; toss to coat. Serves 4.

title: Wrapped Veggies With Ranch Dressing
instructions: Cut veggies into strips 1/4 x 3-inch. Wrap each strip in won ton wrap. Seal end with water and cornstarch mixture. When all are wrapped heat oil for frying. Fry until golden brown. Serve with Ranch dressing.

title: Pina Colada Fruit Dip
instructions: In a food processor bowl with meat blade or blender container combine all ingredients. Cover; blend 30 seconds. Refrigerate several hours or overnight to blend flavors. Serve with fresh fruit. Yield 2 1/2 cups.

title: Grilled Eggplant
instructions: Preheat grill. Combine olive oil and garlic in a bowl. Cut onions and eggplant into 1/2-inch thick slices. Brush with garlic oil mixture. Grill for about 4 minutes on each side. Baste with remaining garlic oil. Season with sea salt.

title: El Gando
instructions: Brown meat; add salt pepper and garlic salt or powder to taste. Add canned tomatoes and chili mix. Cook yellow rice according to package directions. Mix meat mixture and rice. Put in large Pyrex dish. Heat cheese soup and milk; pour over meat and rice. Mix onions olives lettuce fresh tomatoes and grated cheese together. Sprinkle over casserole. Top with crushed Fritos.

title: Oma'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix onion and chicken soup well. Add eggs and mix. Add squash that has been cooked in salt water and mashed. Mix well and add sugar. Pour into well greased casserole dish. Top with cheese and crushed ritz crackers. Melt butter and pour over top. Bake covered for 45 minutes at 325 degrees.

title: Microwave Rocky Road Candy
instructions: Cook chocolate chips and butter on High for 2 to 3 minutes; stir. Add nuts and marshmallows. Pour into buttered pan. When cool cut into squares.

title: Frozen Christmas Salad
instructions: Prepare whipped topping according to package directions. Combine all ingredients. Place in square non-glass container. Freeze.

title: Yum! Yum! Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pineapple sugar and juice of 3 lemons. Bring to a boil. Mix 1/2 cup water and gelatin. Stir into mixture and boil 2 minutes; then set aside to cool. Whip the whipping cream and add cheese. Stir in cool mixture. Tint color desired.

title: Four Bean Salad
instructions: Mix beans sprouts green pepper and onion in large bowl. Mix sugar vinegar salad oil salt and pepper together and pour over veggies. Refrigerate until served.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together all ingredients except cheese. Pour half of the batter in large baking dish or pan then add Cheddar cheese. Pour remaining batter on top of cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until brown.

title: Tater Sticks
instructions: Dip potato wedges into melted margarine; shake with seasoning mix in plastic bag coating well. Place skin side down on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until tender.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Melt cheeses in double boiler (can be melted in a microwave). Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Serve while hot with crackers.

title: Christmas Holly
instructions: In saucepan melt butter or margarine and marshmallows over low heat; stir constantly. When melted remove from heat. Add food coloring; stir in corn flakes. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper to look like holly leaves. Decorate with cinnamon drops to look like holly berries.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Skin breasts and cut meat off bones. Cut in large bite size pieces. Mix orange juice and milk together. Dip chicken pieces then coat generously with flour. Cook in oil about 2-inches deep. Chop green onions. Put chicken in bowl. Cover with cashews and onions. Pour on gravy.

title: Italian Christmas Pie(Calsoune)
instructions: My moms special Christmas Eve pie.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Add vinegar and orange juice. Mix well. Cook over medium heat until thickened stirring constantly. Add beets to the sauce. Serve hot or cold.

title: M&M Super Cookies
instructions: Coarsely grind 1 1/2 cups of M&Ms. Reserve the rest for decoration. Beat oleo and sugar. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add flour soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in chopped candies and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Bake 9 to 11 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl combine Eagle Brand and water. Add pudding mix beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipping cream. In a large bowl spoon in 1/3 pudding mixture add 1/3 vanilla wafers and 1 banana. Continue layering ending with pudding mixture.

title: Whiskey Balls
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients; add whiskey. Form into small balls. Roll each ball in additional powdered sugar. Store in covered container.

title: Soup Mixture
instructions: Chop and measure all vegetables. Place in open kettle with sugar and salt. Cook until thick. Pour at once into hot jars and process 1 1/2 hours.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Put sauerkraut on bottom of dish or pan. Add noodles. Mix soup mustard and mayonnaise. Spread over noodles. Add onions corned beef and cheese.

title: Percolator Punch
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in the bottom of a 6-cup glass percolator. (Use glass or plastic; metal will ruin the punch. Yes it is worth it to borrow a pot!) Place spices in basket of percolator. Let the mixture come to a full perk. Let perk 3 minutes. Keep warm until served.

title: Herbed Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3-quart pan. Heat to boiling; stir well. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Serves 6.

title: White Bread
instructions: Combine 1 cup boiling water and milk in a bowl. Add 3 teaspoons sugar and margarine mixing well. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add to milk mixture and mix well. Set aside.

title: Mashed Potato Rolls
instructions: Place mixture in a greased bowl to rise (about 3 hours). Work down and shape into favorite shape. Brush with butter and let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned.

title: Quick Rice Pudding
instructions: Heat rice and 2 cups milk to boil; stir constantly. Reduce heat; cover. Cook over low heat 5 minutes. Add vanilla pudding and 3/4 cup milk. Mix well. Stir into rice mixture. Bring to boil. Stir constantly. Add raisins and nutmeg. Pour into serving dish and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Chill 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Beat first 2 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and whip for 10 minutes or so. Pour into baked crust. Sprinkle remaining crust on top. Chill and serve.

title: Margarita De Largo
instructions: Shake and pour in 8 ounce footed glass.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour one-piece tube pan. Mix dry ingredients together. Add shortening boiling coffee milk eggs and vanilla. Pour into pan. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes. Cool and ice with milk chocolate icing.

title: Peanut Butter Cake Squares
instructions: Mix together flour margarine and peanuts; press into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool completely. Mix cream cheese peanut butter sugar and 1 cup nondairy topping. Spread this over crust. Mix chocolate vanilla puddings and milk. Pour over cream cheese and chill until firm. Top with remaining topping. Grate milk chocolate over top and sprinkle with peanuts; chill and serve.

title: Pork Tenderloin
instructions: In large roasting pan place tenderloin. Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl mix thoroughly. Pour marinate sauce over meat; marinate for 4 to 6 hours. Then bake for one hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered.\tMake sure internal heat reaches 150\u00b0 temperature inside.

title: Myra'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain and mash. Add eggs oleo. Mix saltine cracker crumbs onions and milk. Let cook softer and add to squash. Mix chicken soup with water until smooth. Add to squash. Pour in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly brown about 30 minutes.

title: Carrie'S Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries; pour sugar salt and lemon juice over cranberries. Mix and let stand 2 hours. Mix jello with boiling water. When cool and syrupy add to cranberries nuts and pineapple. Place in refrigerator until firm. This salad may be frozen. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Swiss Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Combine seasoning mix water and chicken in large skillet. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Spoon filling into bottom of each taco shell. Top with lettuce cheese and tomatoes.

title: Baked Yellow Squash
instructions: Cut up squash and boil until tender. Drain. Saute onion in butter. Mash squash in medium bowl. Add onion cheese milk part of cracker crumbs and egg. Put in buttered casserole dish and sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add sugar oil zucchini and vanilla and mix lightly but well. Combine the flour salt soda baking powder and cinnamon and add to egg mixture. Stir until blended. Add nuts. Pour into 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: See'S Fudge
instructions: Mix milk and sugar. Bring to rolling boil and boil 10 minutes. Put chips nuts Marshmallow Creme margarine and vanilla in large bowl. Pour milk mixture over all and stir until smooth. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine vinegar garlic salt and salad dressing; blend thoroughly. Combine other ingredients then add salad dressing mixture and toss lightly. Chill thoroughly for best flavor. Serves 8.

title: Turkey Ranchero
instructions: Cut each thigh in half; remove bone and skin. Place in slow cooker. Combine dry enchilada sauce mix with tomato paste and water. Mixture will be thick. Spread over turkey thighs. Cover. Cook on low 7 to 8 hours or until tender. Turn pot on high. Add cheese; stir until cheese melts.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Melt butter; saut onion in butter. Mix all ingredients together; stir in potatoes. Pour into 8 1/2 x 13 Pyrex dish. Top with 2 cups crushed corn flakes and 1/2 cup butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are done.

title: Susie'S Salad
instructions: Cut up vegetables and marinate overnight all together in a closed container. When ready to serve mix together Miracle Whip sour cream and Italian seasoning mix. Mix vegetables and seasoning mixture. Serve.

title: Easy One Dish Spaghetti
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet with cover saute vegetables and ground beef in oil. Add spaghetti spreading over beef mixture. Mix tomatoes catsup and seasonings. Pour over spaghetti making sure spaghetti is covered with liquid. Cover and cook over medium heat (simmer) for 30 minutes. Sprinkle grated cheese over top before serving. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Leather Britches Or Shuck Beans
instructions: Wash and dry a batch of firm green beans. Remove ends and strings. Using a large darning needle with heavy white thread push the needle through the bean pod near the middle of each pushing them along the thread so that they are about 1/4 inch apart. Hang up the strings of beans in a warm well ventilated place to dry. They will shrivel and turn greenish gray.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Cook bone and chop chicken. Cook rice. In large bowl combine all ingredients. Turn into 3-quart casserole. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bring to boil. Take off heat and store in container.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook onion in 4 tablespoons margarine until tender do not brown. Mix soup with Cheez Whiz and milk. Combine all ingredients. Put in greased baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Catfish Stew
instructions: Cook in pressure cooker for 15 minutes the fish onions potatoes and celery. Then add tomatoes and margarine. Simmer until done.

title: Swifty Beans
instructions: Put beans in crock-pot on high. Mix vinegar brown sugar onions and fried bacon in large skillet. Bring to boil; simmer for 1 minute. Pour over beans in crock-pot; cook for about 1 or 2 hours on medium.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Makes 1 large loaf or 12 small individual ones. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Drain off fat. Add 1 cup brown sugar 1/2 cup vinegar and 1 teaspoon mustard. Stir. Pour over loaf and bake 20 more minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine Eagle Brand and egg yolks at low speed. Slowly add juice mixing until homogeneous. Pour into baked shell. Refrigerate overnight. Top with meringue or Cool Whip.

title: Easy Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Heat butter in a 3-quart saucepan until melted. Add okra onion and green pepper; cook and stir until onion is tender. Stir in broth tomatoes with liquid bay leaf salt and pepper. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Stir in chicken and parsley; heat through. Serve chicken mixture over hot rice.

title: Spinach And Treet Casserole
instructions: Break or cut all solid ingredients into small pieces. Mix ingredients except eggs milk flour black pepper and garlic salt. Put spinach mixture in greased casserole dish. Pour milk and egg mixture over spinach mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until firm and brown.

title: Juanita'S Quick Mexican Chicken
instructions: Follow directions on Rice-A-Roni box to prepare rice but substitute chili-style tomatoes for recipe on box. Meanwhile while rice is cooking slice chicken thinly into strips about 3 inches long. Saute strips in a 10-inch saute pan or wok with oil until golden brown. Dont crowd the pan. Saute the chicken in batches if necessary. Use a slotted spoon to remove to a platter and keep warm in a 200\u00b0 oven.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli mushrooms water chestnuts onion and dressing in a large bowl. Cover and marinate several hours stirring occasionally.

title: Asparagus Supreme
instructions: Cook fresh asparagus in boiling salted water for 5 to 6 minutes (or cook frozen according to package directions). Drain well. Combine soup sour cream carrots onion and pepper. Fold in asparagus. Turn mixture into a 1-quart baking dish.

title: Chicken Feed
instructions: In skillet saute onion mushrooms garlic and 1/4 teaspoon thyme in the margarine. Stir in the chicken gravy bouillon and pepper; spoon into a greased casserole and remaining thyme. Spoon over mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Russian Teacakes
instructions: Mix together butter 1/2 cup powered sugar and vanilla. Mix in flour salt and nuts. Best to chill this dough for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Once chilled shape into 1 inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 - 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm and then again once they are cool.

title: Pasta Trivera
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Add salt and spaghetti; boil 7 to 8 minutes. Heat 1/3 cup olive oil in saucepan. Add garlic and cook slowly for 3 minutes. Stir in parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste. Put off the heat and stir in walnuts.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Stir together in large bowl flour sugar soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir together pumpkin oil and water in another bowl. Add eggs beaten well. Make a well in center of flour mixture and stir in pumpkin mixture just until dough is moistened. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350 for 1 hour or until bread taste done. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan. Cool on rack.

title: Barbecued Baked Beans
instructions: Mix beans barbecue sauce raisins sugar onion and apple together in a 2-quart baking dish. Top with bacon. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for one hour.

title: Applesauce Raisin Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt soda and cinnamon. Stir in oats sugar and raisins. Add applesauce oil eggs and milk. Stir only until dry ingredients are blended. Fill a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan half full. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan immediately. Cool. Wrap cooled bread; store one day before slicing. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Sweet And Sour German Pork Chops
instructions: Drain juice from sauerkraut. Place in bottom of oblong baking dish. Place pork chops over kraut. Mix and pour over top the tomato soup water and brown sugar. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook green beans and drain. Melt cheese and soup over low heat and add to beans. Add 1/2 can of French fried onions and stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Add other half on top and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberry sauce and sour cream in mixing bowl. Stir in pineapple. Pour into ice trays without sections to freeze. Serve on lettuce. Yields 6 servings.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
instructions: Cook apples and other ingredients in apple juice until tender approximately 10 minutes. Pour into a 10-inch pie crust. Put slits in top crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch and cinnamon in 2-quart saucepan. Stir in peaches and lemon juice. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Keep peach mixture hot in oven. Put shortening into flour. Add 1 tablespoon sugar baking powder and salt. Mix until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in milk. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto hot peach mixture. Bake until topping is golden brown about 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm and if desired top with whipped cream.

title: Sour Salmon And Noodles
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Coat macaroni with butter. Pour in bowls and top with salmon mixture.

title: French Toast
instructions: Beat all ingredients together. Dip bread one at a time in egg mixture; turn to coat evenly. Fry until lightly brown. Turn and brown other side. Serve with syrup or jelly.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix and beat eggs sugar and salt together. Add Karo and pecans alternately. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at a low temperature (350\u00b0) until done.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix ground beef milk salt and pepper. Shape into balls. Fry until brown.

title: Mrs. Wealand'S Molasses Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in order. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Before putting in oven beat an egg and brush on top of each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Mix everything together in one container. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Martha'S Soup
instructions: Boil first 5 ingredients for 20 minutes. Add vegetables and cook for 5 minutes. Add cream of chicken soup and cheese. Simmer until cheese melts about 20 minutes.

title: Hearty Cauliflower Soup
instructions: In a saucepan cook cauliflower and carrots in water until tender; set aside (do not drain). In a skillet over medium heat brown the sausage and onion drain. Add flour salt and pepper. Gradually add the milk; bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Add cauliflower carrots and cooking liquid; heat through. Stir in the cheese until melted. Yield 6-8 servings.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mash bananas and set aside. Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs; beat well. Sift dry ingredients. Add vanilla bananas nuts and dry ingredients to sugar and oil mixture. Mix well. Bake in loaf pan about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: White Trash
instructions: Mix all ingredients except almond bark or candiquick in a large bowl. Melt almond bark or candiquick. Pour over all ingredients. Mix well. Pour out on 2 long pieces of wax paper (30 to 36-inches). Spread evenly and thin. Let cool for about an hour then break into pieces. Store in large covered containers. Makes 2 (one gallon) jars full.

title: Sweet And Sour Salad
instructions: Dice green pepper onion celery and pimentos into small pieces. Combine with wet ingredients. Add drained peas and beans. Chill. The longer it sets the better it tastes.

title: Grandma Welch'S Sweet Potato Pone
instructions: Separate egg yolks and whites. Mix all ingredients except egg whites. Beat whites until stiff and fold in potato mixture. Bake in a buttered dish for about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until firm.

title: Cot'S Recipe
instructions: Bring sugar and syrup to boil. Add peanut butter and blend thoroughly. Pour over the cornflakes. Stir until well coated. Drop from spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Baked Eggplant A La Wyatt'S Cafeteria
instructions: Cut peeled eggplant into 1 inch cubes and soak in salt water in refrigerator overnight (minimum of 6 hours). Drain eggplant and place in pan. Cover with water and simmer until tender. Soak bread crumbs in milk. Saute onions green peppers and celery in melted butter for about 15 minutes or until tender. Combine cooked eggplant bread crumbs and sauteed vegetables. Add eggs pimento and seasoning; blend thoroughly. Place in greased baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix together 5 cups flour and lard. Add 1 cup flour milk and salt. Roll out on floured surface.

title: Triple Chocolate Pie
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine chocolate fudge pudding mix with 1 1/4 cups milk. Mix with a wire whisk until well combined and thickened. Pour mixture into pie crust and refrigerate for 15 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apple slices in 9-inch square baking pan. Add water. Combine dry ingredients. Using a pastry blender cut in butter until butter particles are fine as in biscuits. Sprinkle crumb mixture over apples.

title: Tripe Soup
instructions: Wash tripe in water and vinegar. Season tripe with salt and pepper. Let stand for 30 minutes. Cook in 1/2 pot water for 1 1/2 hours or pressure cook for 1/2 hour. Add onion cabbage pumpkin and other vegetables; season to taste. Add spaghetti 30 minutes before the soup is finished cooking. If the soup is too thick add a little water and season to taste.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together. Mix with pineapple. Add butter or margarine and cook until thick. Stir while cooking as it sticks easily. Let cool before using. Line bottoms and sides of pie shells with sliced bananas. Sprinkle pecans over bananas. Add pineapple mixture and cover with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

title: Dietetic Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Must be refrigerated.

title: Doris' Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixing bowl combine flour and brown sugar cut in butter and oleo until it resembles crumbs. Press crumbs into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes or until golden brown. While it bakes combine eggs sugar and syrup salt and vanilla. Blend well; stir in pecan pieces and pour over golden hot crust. Reduce heat to 275\u00b0. Bake until center is set. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Cranberry Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In large bowl mix flour sugar soda spice salt and baking powder. In second bowl mix remaining ingredients well. Add both together until moistened. Pour batter into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans to cooling racks.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Flour and grease tube pan. Mix with spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Springs back when touched.

title: Onion Pie
instructions: Saute onion in 2 tablespoons of butter or margarine until golden brown. Melt 1/4 cup of butter or margarine in a container. The microwave is good for this. Add 30 crumbled crackers. Put the butter and cracker mixture in a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish covering the bottom of the dish. Next place the hot sauteed onions on top of the cracker mixture then place cheese over the onions. Next scald milk in a saucepan. Add to it 3 beaten eggs salt and pepper. Pour over cheese and onions. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean like custard.

title: Creamy Turkey Soup
instructions: Bring turkey broth to a boil in a large pot. Add potatoes carrots and celery and cook for about 20 minutes or until potatoes are almost tender. Add leftover turkey green onions salt pepper thyme and sage; stir well and return to a boil. Cook over medium heat for another 5 minutes. Meanwhile mix evaporated milk and flour in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer. Blend milk mixture into soup. Cook stirring constantly until thickened (approximately 8 to 10 minutes). Serve hot.

title: Beef And Onion Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and chopped corned beef. Add chopped onion and onion powder. Form into ball and chill. For larger ball double ingredients.

title: Sour Cream Salad
instructions: Drain cocktail and mix with other ingredients.

title: Cool Fruit Tart
instructions: Mix Bisquick and 1/3 cup sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Mix in egg until soft dough forms. Spray fruit tart pan with Pam. Work dough toward edges. Prick with fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Creamed Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients except butter and flour in a pot; bring to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes. Blend butter with flour; add to the corn. Mix well and remove from heat.

title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients until blended. Garnish with shredded carrots if desired.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Make a paste of red coloring and cocoa. Add to cream mixture. Add vanilla. Mix buttermilk in same cup as coloring. Use all clinging coloring. Sift flour salt and soda together. Add to mixture; beat well. Fold in vinegar. Pour into 2 cake pans lined with greased wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pear Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; make well in center of mixture. Combine remaining ingredients and add to dry mixture. Stir until just moistened Spoon into two well greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3 inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Date Nut Bars
instructions: Mix together and put in greased 8 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg and vanilla. Sift flour soda and salt. Add to mixture. Stir in nuts. Wrap and roll in wax paper and put in freezer until hardened. Slice and bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Add Flour shortening and salt. Mix together and then add next four ingredients. Mix can be frozen. Makes 3- 9 inch pies. Bake at 350 degrees.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Place dry rice in casserole dish. Pour in beef broth and water. Put in stick of butter. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Breasts In Mustard Sauce
instructions: Heat margarine or butter in 10-inch skillet over medium heat. Add chicken breasts. Cook for 12 to 14 minutes turning after 6 minutes or until juices run clear. Remove chicken and reserve. Add onion and brandy or apple juice to skillet. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Stir in whipping cream parsley and mustard. Cook and stir over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add chicken and walnuts. Heat until hot. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sarah'S Chili
instructions: Combine ingredients; simmer for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first 5 ingredients stirring well. Spoon mixture into a greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Combine cracker crumbs and butter stirring well. Sprinkle mixture evenly over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Brownie Pudding
instructions: Sift flour sugar cocoa baking powder and salt. Add milk oil and vanilla; mix until smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Combine sugar cocoa and water; pour over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken  Salad
instructions: Poach chicken in broth with next 5 ingredients 30 to 40 minutes or until tender. Salt to taste; cool in broth; debone and chop fine. Blend chicken with 1 cup mayonnaise. Add next 3 ingredients and season to taste. Fold in eggs and add additional mayonnaise until mixture reaches desired consistency. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Mom'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to directions; set aside to cool. Slice enough fresh berries to line bottom of pie shell. Save several berries with hulls on for garnish. Cut remaining berries into a saucepan; add sugar and cook on medium heat. Stir. Put cornstarch in small bowl; add some liquid from saucepan. Stir until well mixed and return to saucepan. Stir until mixture thickens and pour into pie shell. Cool. Cover with whipped cream. Garnish with whole berries. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Ugly Shonton Meat Balls
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients well and form into balls. Brown gently add wine. Simmer until wine is evaporated. Add soup mixed with milk. Simmer until sauce is down to about half.

title: Quick Country Pie
instructions: Melt butter and add chocolate chips. Heat until chips are melted. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour in an unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Crunch Delight
instructions: In a bowl combine the margarine flour coconut sugar and almonds. Press lightly into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown stirring every 10 minutes to form coarse crumbs. Cool. Divide crumbs mixture in half. Press half into same baking pan. In a mixing bowl combine pudding mixes and milk. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon over the crust and top with remaining crumbs. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Melt the 2 tablespoons of butter; add the chopped mushrooms and green pepper. Stir and cook 3 to 4 minutes. Add flour salt and paprika and cook until frothy. Add cream and cook until it thickens. Add chicken and set aside over hot water. Beat egg yolks and 1/4 cup butter onion and lemon juice. Stir into the other mixture and cook a few minutes. Serve on waffles or toast.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Bring to boil last 7 ingredients. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Virginia Pickles
instructions: Make a brine of a proportion of 2 cups salt to one gallon water; boil and pour over cucumbers boiling hot. Let stand one week. In hot weather skim daily. Drain and cut in chunks or slice. For the next 3 mornings make a boiling hot solution of one tablespoon powdered alum and one gallon water and pour over the pickles. Each morning drain the pickles and make the solution fresh.

title: Easy Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Dissolve cocoa and food coloring and set aside. Mix all other ingredients and beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Beat in cocoa and food coloring mixture. Divide mixture evenly between 3 (9-inch) round greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool before icing.

title: Vegetable Squares
instructions: Lay crescent rolls out on baking dish or cookie sheet. Bake until brown. Let cool completely. Mix together cream cheese mayo and Hidden Valley. Spread on cool crescent rolls. Top with chopped vegetables.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: When eggs are half beaten add flour and beat until smooth. Stir in sugar and salt. Add melted butter vanilla and milk (in that order). Pour into unbaked 8-inch pie shell. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling liquid. Pour in 8 or 9-inch square pan. Chill until firm at least 4 hours. Cut into shapes.

title: Spinach And Lettuce Salad
instructions: Mix oil vinegar and sugar and pour over the spinach and lettuce bacon and onion. Mix well.

title: Baked Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt half the butter in a heavy saucepan cook the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent. Add the rice and stir briefly until the rice is coated with butter. Stir in broth and spices. Cover with a loose fitting lid and place in oven. Bake exactly 17 minutes. Discard parsley and thyme sprigs and bay leaf and serve.

title: Mushrooms & Chicken Livers
instructions: Cook livers covered in butter until almost tender. (about 10 mins.) Add mushrooms and green onions cook until onions and livers are tender. combine remaining ingredients and add to livers. Heat and stir just until sauce is hot. Serve over rice or hot buttered toast.

title: Easy Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix the cottage cheese and mayonnaise together then add the dry dressing mix.

title: Coke Salad
instructions: Drain juice from cherries and pineapple. Heat and pour over gelatin. Let cool. Add Cokes and cherries. When gelatin is slightly thick add cheese fruit and nuts. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let chill until firm before serving.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Combine flour cocoa baking powder soda salt and cinnamon; set aside. Beat together margarine and sugar until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Stir in vanilla peel and zucchini. Alternately stir in dry ingredients and milk. Add nuts. Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Turn out. May drizzle with powdered sugar glaze.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Boil water and sugar; put in Jell-O. Stir well. Stir in pineapple cream cheese and Cool Whip. Add nuts and celery (if so desired). Refrigerate. Quick and good.

title: Tomato Casserole
instructions: In greased baking dish layer tomatoes (by overlapping) onion cheese and dressing mix. Continue layering ingredients ending with cheese and dressing crumbs on top. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Quickies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend milk and peanut butter until smooth. Mix in crumbs and chocolate pieces. Drop by teaspoonfuls 1-inch apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until set. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Paprikas Potatoes
instructions: Melt shortening. Add paprika and sliced potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook over medium flame. Gradually add water until done about 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together adding ground beef last. Pack firmly in loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fettuccine Casserole
instructions: Cook pasta accordingly. Meanwhile in saucepan over medium heat melt butter. Blend in cheese; stir in whipping cream. Heat almost to boiling stirring constantly with whisk. Place eggs in a small bowl and beat slightly. Stir small amount of hot cream mixture into saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly with whisk until thoroughly heated about 5 minutes. Stir in bacon and parsley. Toss sauce with hot pasta. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Pound Cake
instructions: Beat shortening until creamy; add sugar and beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and vanilla. Beat well. Fold in nuts and cherries. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 in ungreased tube pan.

title: Gingered Carrots
instructions: Cut carrots diagonally into 1/4 slices. Cook carrots in boiling water for 7 minutes or until tender. Drain. Keep warm in a serving dish. Combine next 4 ingredients in saucepan gradually add orange juice stirring well. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly pour over carrots; toss well. Garnish if desired.

title: 2 Layer Pineapple-Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello with boiling water. Pour thin layer (1/2-inch deep) into a 9 x 13-inch salad pan. Let congeal. When remainder of gelatin thickens add marshmallows pineapple and pecan pieces. Fold whipped topping in carefully; mix well. Pour over congealed clear gelatin layer. Let congeal overnight. When ready to serve cut jello squares and turn salad bottom side up on shredded lettuce so clear red jello is on the top and creamy layer is on the bottom.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and flour. Slowly add milk and vanilla. Then cook slowly until done.

title: Sauce Piquant With Italian Sausage
instructions: First you make a roux. When the roux is dark brown add chopped onions pepper and celery and continue cooking. When onions become clear add green onions and parsley and continue cooking a few minutes. Add a bit of cold water so that roux becomes a thick liquid. Add garlic and rest of seasonings including tomato sauce and wine. Add sausage and cover with water about 2 inches over the rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil stirring frequently being sure that you have enough water so that sauce piquant wont stick. Cook for several hours until meat is tender. Serve over spaghetti or rice or just about anything or by itself.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook the chicken in enough water to cover. Add the bay leaf garlic chopped onion celery tops and basil. When chicken is done (1 to 2 hours) drain and let cool. Remove from bones and dice. Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Layer all ingredients in order and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sesame Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0F. Melt margarine in shallow baking dish while oven is heating. Add chicken and sprinkle both sides with soy sauce and sesame seeds.

title: Florida Pie
instructions: Crush the bananas. Drain pineapple. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Brown onion in butter. Combine with soups broth and chilies. Add pieces of chicken and mix well. In large baking dish place a layer of tortillas chicken and cheese. Repeat layers until casserole is filled ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Better if sets a couple of hours before baking can also be frozen.) Serves 8.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Use no salt or pepper.

title: Cranberry Chutney
instructions: In large saucepan over medium heat bring cranberries sugar and juice to a boil stir frequently. Reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the rest of the ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight or up to a week before using.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Butter a 2 1/2-quart casserole or larger if available. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook and drain spaghetti. Saute onion and pepper in butter; drain. Heat soup and broth until hot. Combine all ingredients. Bake for 1 hour; after 30 minutes stir and continue cooking.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine butter and onion in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong baking dish. Microwave uncovered at power level High for 4 to 5 minutes or until onion is fairly soft stirring once. Add beef mushrooms and seasonings. Microwave uncovered at power level High for 9 to 10 minutes or until beef is cooked stirring twice.

title: Peanut Butter Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in peanut butter then flour. Pour into two lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until centers test done. After about 15 minutes of baking sprinkle peanuts onto batter to five a crunchy topping. Serve with whipped cream and a sprinkle of peanuts if desired. Makes 2 loaves 12 servings each.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Beat together the butter Crisco and sugar. Start with 1 cup sifted flour. Add milk. Add 1 more cup of flour. Add sour cream; add remaining flour. Stir in flavoring and margarine or butter. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first four ingredients. Pour sugar over and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight or longer.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix and simmer the first 3 ingredients for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; salt and pepper to taste. Pour into greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Top with grated cheese and let come to bubble again.

title: Cake
instructions: Line baking pans with aluminum foil. Use 2 loaf pans or 1 tube pan or 4 (1 pound) coffee cans. Have nuts and fruits ready and mixed. Save some to decorate cake.

title: Kid'S Special Fruit-Flavor Popcorn
instructions: Place popcorn in large bowl. Add melted butter; toss to coat. Sprinkle with gelatin; toss until evenly coated.

title: Pineapple Icing
instructions: Bring to a rolling boil sugar and milk. Cook 7 minutes. Add margarine pineapple and vanilla. Pour over yellow cake.

title: Cindy'S Meat And Potatoes
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Peel and slice potatoes. Add to hamburger. Sprinkle on chili powder; stir and add tomato sauce. Cover with water and heat to a boil. Then switch to medium heat and cover 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Noodles And Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown beef. Add onion soup juice bouillon cubes and water Simmer for 10 minutes. Add more water if necessary. Add noodles and cook until noodles are tender. Add salt pepper and sour cream. Heat gently. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley before serving.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil in a saucepan and let boil for 1 minute. Remove from stove; add last 3 ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Allow to cool then eat.

title: Colorful Six-Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all beans and scallions in a large bowl; stir to mix. Combine olive oil egg yolk vinegar sugar garlic and pepper in container of an electric blender. Process at low speed until well blended. Pour over vegetables. Cover and chill 4 hours. To serve spoon bean salad onto lettuce-lined salad plate; garnish with quarters of hard-cooked eggs. Yields 12 servings.

title: Johnny Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Candy
instructions: Mix sugar milk margarine pecans coconut and vanilla together. Roll into small balls and place on a wax paper lined cookie sheet. Chill in refrigerator.
