In a double boiler melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Take a toothpick and dip each chocolate ball in chocolate mixture. Twist toothpick to remove. One toothpick will do a whole recipe. Makes about 60 pieces.

title: Candy Cane Cafe White Bread
instructions: Put yeast in 2 cups warm water and set aside. Put 5 pounds flour in a large container. Mix in sugar and salt. Add shortening and mix well until it feels like corn meal no chunks of shortening. Throw a pinch of sugar and flour into yeast mixture. Add 4 cups water to flour mixture; add the yeast water too. Mix well cover and let rise overnight.

title: Chocolate Bubble Biscuits(Makes 16 Biscuits)
instructions: In large bowl combine flour 1/4 cup sugar baking powder and salt. Using pastry blender or 2 knives cut in 1/3 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in chocolate morsels. Add milk; stir until dough holds a shape. On floured board knead dough lightly. Roll dough into 16 balls. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small saucepan melt remaining 1/3 cup butter. Pour 1/2 cup of melted butter in 8-inch square baking pan. In cup combine remaining 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle 1/3 cinnamon sugar mixture over butter in baking pan. Place dough balls in single layer in pan. Brush with remaining melted butter. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon/sugar mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan. Serve warm.

title: Marge'S Whipped Potatoes
instructions: Cook drain and mash potatoes. Add butter sour cream cream cheese salt and pepper. Blend together and pour into large casserole. Sprinkle with Lawrys or paprika. Refrigerate until needed then bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Wonderful for holiday dinner.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour into a casserole dish.

title: Dutch Apple Dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a bowl combine apples milk and cinnamon; set aside. In a large bowl cut 1/2 cup oleo into 1 cup biscuit mix until crumbly. Stir in apple mixture.

title: Pan-Fish With Green Onions And Mushrooms
instructions: Dredge the fish in a mixture of cornmeal salt and pepper. Fry fish in 2 tablespoons butter until browned on each side. Transfer to a dish. Saute mushrooms and capers in another skillet in 2 tablespoons butter or margarine and remove them to a lightly buttered shallow baking dish. Saute the onions and garlic in butter for 1 to 2 minutes. Lay the fish on the bed of mushrooms sprinkle with bread crumbs mixed with tarragon and spread the onions garlic and chives over this. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: In mixing bowl mix first 4 ingredients by hand. Bring to a boil and add to above ingredients the margarine oil water and cocoa. Mix together buttermilk and baking soda. Add to flour mixture the eggs and vanilla. Mix by hand. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Little Pizzas
instructions: Mix together tomato paste sugar salt Worcestershire sauce and garlic. Spread thinly on muffins. Sprinkle cheese over tomato mixture. Top with sausage. Sprinkle with oregano. Bake at 450\u00b0 about 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients starting with sweet potatoes in mixing bowl. Add\tmilk. Fold in beaten sweetened egg whites. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake until center is firm approximately 40\tminutes. Nutmeg and sugar may be sprinkled on top of pie before baking if desired.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Let cheese and margarine soften. Mix well with hand mixer. Cut all crust off bread and cut into 2-inch squares. Spread all sides with cheese mixture and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Serve with cole slaw.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix and chill butter cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix and chill pudding mixes and milk.

title: Pasta And Sausage Bake
instructions: In a skillet brown sausage; drain. In a greased 2-quart baking dish combine sausage sauce pasta and Parmesan cheese. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Grease casserole. Place rice soup and water in casserole; mix well. Place chicken over that and sprinkle with dried onion soup. Seal tightly with aluminum foil or tight cover on casserole. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Corn Vegetable Medley
instructions: In saucepan heat soup and milk stir in hot vegetables and cover with cheese. Heat through. Makes a large vegetable dish. Preparation time 10 minutes.

title: Chicken 'N Gravy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Shake flour in 14 x 20-inch Reynolds oven bag (large size). Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Add gravy mix garlic powder and water to bag. Squeeze bag to blend ingredients. Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt and pepper. Place in bag. Place carrots and celery in bag around chicken. Close bag with nylon tie; cut six 1/2-inch slits in top. Bake until chicken is tender 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tina'S Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream together oleo or butter and Crisco. Add sugar. Mix well and add eggs one at a time beating well. Add sour cream cake flour baking soda coconut almond extract coconut extract and vanilla extract. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0 in tube pan.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter flavor Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Blend in egg. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls (about 2 measuring tablespoons) of dough 3-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies 11 to 13 minutes for crisp cookies. Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes. Remove to cooling rack. Makes 3 dozen 3-inch cookies.

title: Stir-Fried Cabbage
instructions: Measure oil into wok (or large skillet). Add cabbage turn heat to moderate and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add sugar salt pepper and vinegar. Cook stirring constantly until cabbage is tender but crisp about 3 to 4 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix baking powder in salmon juice. Mix salmon egg and onion together with fork. Add flour and baking powder mixture. Mix together and drop by spoonful into hot shortening and fry.

title: Cajun Cabbage
instructions: Brown drain and crumble the bacon. Saute the onions in bacon fat. Add vinegar salt and pepper. Coarsely chop the cabbage and add to skillet. Add drained chopped tomatoes. Cover and simmer 35 minutes. Add bacon. Simmer 10 more minutes.

title: Irish Soda Bread(Yield: 1 Loaf)
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Pain Perdu(Lost Bread)
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar rapidly; continue to beat. Add cornstarch and when mixed add milk cinnamon and vanilla. Dip bread slice in mixture coating each side thoroughly. Use just enough oil to cover bottom of skillet and fry over moderate heat. Fry each slice until golden brown. Serve hot sprinkled with powdered sugar.

title: Frozen Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix and put in freezer until ready to serve.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Simmer ingredients except eggs for 5 minutes. Pour over eggs in large jar. Refrigerate for 3 days.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Pam a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Layer whipped cream. Layer crushed Oreos. Layer sliced bananas. Repeat ending with Oreos sprinkled on top. Make in the morning to serve at night. Best refrigerated 10 hours.

title: Cake Frosting
instructions: Cook flour milk and salt to a paste; let cool. Beat shortening margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add together; beat. Add vanilla.

title: Broccoli Layered Salad
instructions: Layer in large bowl.

title: Pina Colada Punch
instructions: Mix well. Finish filling gallon jug with water.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs vanilla and zucchini. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Grease and flour 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Remove chicken from bones; dice in buttered dish. Saute onions in 1 tablespoon butter on medium-low heat. Add chicken broth cream of chicken soup and diced boiled eggs until ingredients are mixed well. Pour over chicken in dish.

title: Marshmallow Delight
instructions: Melt marshmallows in hot milk. Add eggs and lemon juice. Cook until thick; cool. Add whipped cream pineapple nuts and grapes. Chill. Makes 20 servings.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Drop by teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken; butter dish. Add onion cheese chips and chicken to dish. Heat can of mushroom soup chicken soup and 1/2 can Ro-Tel tomatoes. Pour over chicken. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Brownies
instructions: Mix well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch cake pan (well-greased) for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Microwave Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers in half; wash and remove seed and white membrane. Mix ground beef and onion in 1 1/2-quart casserole and cook at Max power for 5 minutes stirring once during cooking. Stir in salt pepper rice and half of the tomato sauce. Fill pepper halves with mixture. Place in glass dish. Top each pepper with remaining sauce. Cook covered at Max power for 8 to 10 minutes or until peppers are tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Bisquick Waffles
instructions: Mix all ingredients. One cup batter makes 4 square waffles. Recipe makes 12 individual waffles. Club soda makes waffles crisp.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Blend cheese milk vanilla and salt. Gradually add sugar beating until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency. If necessary stir in additional milk one tablespoon at a time. Before adding sugar stir in chocolate; cool.

title: Congealed Vegetable Salad
instructions: Prepare gelatin with boiling water and cold water. Add onion salt and vinegar. Blend and chill until slightly thickened (about 1 hour). Add other ingredients pour into mold and chill until firm. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Homemade Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. While waiting combine cottage cheese sour cream egg spices and cheese in large bowl. Mix well. Drain macaroni and add to cheese mixture. Spoon into sprayed 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Toss with Miracle Whip.

title: Old-Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Simmer raisins in water in saucepan over low heat until raisins are plump 20 to 30 minutes. Drain liquid and add water to measure 1/2 cup. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Have ungreased cookie sheets ready. Cream the shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in raisin liquid. Sift together dry ingredients and add to moist ingredients. Mix well. Add oats nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonful 2-inches apart on cookie sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 6 to 7 dozen.

title: Blintz Bubble Ring
instructions: Cut cream cheese into 20 pieces. Roll into balls. Roll each biscuit into a 3-inch circle. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Place 1 cheese ball and 1 teaspoon cinnamon mixture in the center of each biscuit; pinch dough to seal. Pour butter or margarine into the bottom of a 5-cup ring mold. Sprinkle half of the nuts and half of remaining cinnamon mixture into mold. Top with half of the rolls placing seam side up. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown. Cool in pan for 5 minutes. Invert onto serving plate.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump undrained pineapple in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread evenly. Dump in pie filling and spread evenly. Dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer and spread. Sprinkle nuts on top. Cut butter in thin pats and put over top. Serve warm or cold. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix fruit cocktail and eggs. Add flour sugar baking soda and salt. Fold in nuts and coconut. Sprinkle 1/2 cup brown sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients in microwave. Mix in cereal. Put in bag with almost a bag of powdered sugar and shake.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Cook onion and green pepper in 1 Tbsp. of the margarine till tender. Combine egg milk 1/3 cup of the crushed crackers and dash of pepper. Stir in onion mixture and corn. Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole. Melt remaining margarine; toss with remaining crumbs. Sprinkle crumb mixture atop corn mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or till a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Makes 4 servings.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butter brown sugar egg yolk orange peel and vanilla; beat until light and fluffy. Combine flour and salt; stir into butter mixture. Shape into 1-inch balls. Slightly beat egg white with fork. Dip balls in egg white; roll each in walnuts. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets; press thumb gently in center of each cookie. Bake in upper third of oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until set. Remove from cookie sheets; cool on wire racks.

title: Pork Chops Hong-Kong
instructions: Brown chops pour off fat. Place chops in baking pan; arrange onion mushrooms and water chestnuts on top. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Fancy Popcorn(Make Your Favorite Flavor)
instructions: Makes 3 quarts. Use a 4 quart bowl. In a large bowl microwave butter and marshmallows on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Marshmallows will puff up. Add gelatin and stir to blend. Pour over popped corn and stir to coat corn. Spread on buttered surface to dry.

title: Pork Chop Meal
instructions: Salt and pepper pork chops to taste. Cook quickly in lightly greased skillet without flour until brown. Layer as follows pork chops onion slices pepper strips or rings chopped celery cooked rice and tomatoes. Put lid on skillet and simmer 35 minutes.

title: Mexicali Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops; season with salt and pepper. Set aside. Reserve drippings in skillet.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes-Chicken(Low-Fat And Cholesterol)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Scrub potatoes and prick in several places with a fork. Bake in the center of the oven for 1 hour or until tender. While potatoes are baking place the chicken stock onion and garlic in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove potatoes from oven and cut in half. Scrape the pulp into a bowl reserving the shells. Add the chicken mix along with everything except the Parmesan cheese. Beat with a mixer until light and fluffy. Stuff the potato mix back into the shells. Sprinkle with Parmesan and place back into the oven for 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Lemon Caper Cream
instructions: In a large skillet melt butter over medium heat. Add shallots and saute until lightly browned 3 to 5 minutes. Add lemon juice and stir; scrape the bottom of the pan with wooden spoon to remove lumps and browned bits. When most of juice evaporates add cream. Gently boil until thick 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in capers and serve immediately over cooked pasta. Garnish with parsley.

title: Turkey Rolls
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Chicken Cilantro
instructions: Heat oil; add turmeric and garlic and saute onion. Add chicken salt and pepper; lightly brown. Add all water and chicken cubes; boil for 30 to 45 minutes until chicken is tender. Add cilantro green onions and potatoes. Simmer until potatoes are cooked. Serve with rice and green salad or shred cooked chicken and serve with flour tortillas and beans.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients; chill. Serve with vegetable sticks.

title: Chicken And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook the noodles in chicken broth until done. To this add the soups. Add chicken pieces and put in baking dish. Top with Velveeta. Sprinkle chili powder on top for color. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered with foil for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Onion Cheese Strata
instructions: Separate onion slices into rings. Trim crusts from bread. Place 4 slices of bread in bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 1/2 of cheese and onions. Repeat.

title: Cheesy Garden Mac Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Rinse with cold water; drain well. Mix macaroni with mayonnaise condensed milk vinegar and cheese. Then add carrots peppers and onion. Mix well. Let stand in refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Jerrie'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Debone and cut very fine (reserve broth). Add all ingredients (except English peas) to broth. Cook over low heat for 3 hours. Add English peas the last 30 minutes of cooking. This will stick so stir often.

title: Mrs. Royal'S Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. To the stock add onions. Cook until tender. Add enough water to make 2 quarts. Bring to a boil and drop in spaghetti. Cook over high heat until tender. Add tomato soup pimento celery mushrooms and cooked chopped chicken. Cover and cook 1 hour; simmer. Add cheese when ready to serve.

title: Hobo Bread
instructions: In the evening soak raisins in boiling water with baking soda; cover. In the morning add brown sugar white sugar oil and salt. Add flour. Grease and flour 4 (1 pound) coffee cans. Fill cans dividing batter equally. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let cool a few minutes before removing from cans then cool on wire rack. Enjoy right away or wrap and freeze.

title: Juicy Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pack in loaf pan or baking dish. Spread with sauce. Bake in 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Laurine'S Millionaire Candy
instructions: Microwave caramel and milk until melted 2 minutes. Stir and heat 2 more minutes. If all is melted add pecan halves; stir real good. Drop by small spoon onto buttered aluminum foil until hardened. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in a double boiler pan. Dip caramel into chocolate; put back on aluminum foil.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken and take out bone save broth. Mix melted margarine and dressing. Layer of dressing layer of chicken in a casserole dish. Pour over chicken cream of mushroom or celery soup mixed with 1 can of broth. Another layer of dressing and layer of chicken then chicken soup mixed with 1 can of broth. Sprinkle rest of dressing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Meal In One Mexican Salad
instructions: Cook ground beef until brown. Add chopped onion; cook until tender. Stir in beans French dressing water and chili powder. Simmer for 15 minutes. Combine lettuce and green onions. Add beef sauce and cheese. Sprinkle lightly with additional cheese.

title: Marie'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni as per directions; drain and return to cooking pan. Add the butter or margarine; stir thoroughly. In lightly buttered pan (either 9 x 13-inch or 9 x 9-inch) place 1/2 the macaroni. Cover with 1 1/2 to 2 cups shredded cheese. Add second layer of macaroni and cheese. Beat the eggs with a fork or beater; add the milk blending thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 if glass pan if used) for 40 to 45 minutes or until cheese on top is slightly browned and a bit crusty.

title: Pasta Ala Norcina
instructions: In a frying pan crumble sausage and brown in margarine. Add wine. When wine evaporates add tomatoes salt and pepper. Cook 15 to 20 minutes over medium heat. Cook pasta according to directions. Drain; add sauce and toss.

title: Quick Lunch Box Cake
instructions: Grease and flour bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine all ingredients except chocolate and nuts in a large mixer bowl; blend well at lowest speed of mixer. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour batter into pan. Sprinkle with chocolate pieces and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown together beef and onion. Add tomato juice sugar corn beans and taco seasoning. Cool all together. Serve over corn chips. Sprinkle grated cheese over top. Add spoonfuls of sour cream on top of cheese.

title: Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: In a shallow dish or pie plate combine all ingredients except pepperoni and olives. Top mixture with pepperoni and olives. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 25 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with rye chips crackers of choice or assorted fresh vegetables. Yield 36 appetizer servings.

title: Mexican Caviar
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and chill overnight. Stir well before serving with corn chips.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Crumble the cornbread and mix with the next 4 ingredients. Mix the mayonnaise and creamy cucumber dressing together; pour over the cornbread mixture.

title: Sloppy Joe Potato Topper
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat cook beef with peppers until beef is browned stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup mix water and ketchup. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon over potatoes. Garnish with cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Steam zucchini onion and carrots 4 to 5 minutes. Then mix box of stuffing with melted butter. Stir in veggies cream of chicken soup sour cream and 1 cup of cheese. Top with other cup of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Croquettes
instructions: Mash potatoes with milk and butter but leave stiff. Add pepper and onion. Cool to room temperature. Measure 1/3 cup portions; shape into cones. Roll in bread crumbs then in egg which has been beaten with water. Place on greased cookie sheet; store in refrigerator. Twenty minutes before serving bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until brown and crusty.

title: Indian Chicken Curry
instructions: In a small bowl combine sliced apples and lemon juice; toss. Set aside. Slice chicken; set aside. Combine flour and chicken broth; stir until mixed. Add all ingredients into skillet. Cook on low for 30 minutes or until everything is cooked down; add extra water if necessary. Serve over rice.

title: Easy Breaded Pork Chops
instructions: Spray cookie sheet. Coat the side with mayo and then cover with the bread crumbs. Coat top side only.

title: Pineapple Coconut Ice Cream
instructions: Get milk hot. Beat egg yolks add sugar flour and salt. Mix into hot milk slowly cook for a few minutes. Cool. Add pineapple whipped cream coconut vanilla beaten egg whites 1 can of milk and lemon juice. Put into freezer. Add milk to fill. Very good.

title: Ricotta Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Soften butter. Blend with Ricotta until creamy. Add vanilla and mix well. Add sugar gradually beating until well blended. Add egg and mix well. Slowly stir in dry ingredients and blend well. Drop from a teaspoon onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes. Yields 30 to 36 cookies.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Roll pie crust. Line pan; prick shell on bottom and sides with fork. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven and reduce heat to 375\u00b0.

title: Light Okra Or Squash
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with Pam cooking spray. Roll okra or squash in meal place on sheet. Spray top of vegetable with cooking oil. Salt. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 until tender and brown.

title: Tub Salad
instructions: Mix all together and put in a dish 9 x 12. Freeze. Let thaw about 15 minutes before eating.

title: Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/4 inch by 1/2 inch strips. In a bowl combine egg white and seasonings; beat well. Add potatoes; toss to coat. Place in a single layer on two baking sheets coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake uncovered at 450\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 8 servings. One 1/2 c. serving equals 40 calories 20 mg sodium 0 cholesterol 9 gm carbohydrate 1 gm protein trace fat. Diabetic Exchange 1/2 starch.

title: Sour Cream Candy
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients to a hard ball. Add vanilla and beat with spoon. Add pecans. Drop quickly on waxed paper.

title: Granny B'S Apple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 4 (7 3/4 x 3 3/4 x 2-inch) loaf pans or 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inch) loaf pans. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 for small pans or 375\u00b0 for large pans. Pare and slice apples. Cover with water and set aside.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Bake the pie shell in a 425\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and cool while preparing filling. Lower heat to 325\u00b0. Cream the margarine with the sugar. Beat in the egg yolks rind juices flour and milk. Beat the egg whites to soft peaks and fold into the lemon mixture. Pour into the partially baked shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until top is firm and golden. (Good served warm.)

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Add sugar cornstarch and salt to egg yolks. Pour scalded milk into this. Return to double boiler. Stir and cook until thickened. Add the butter coconut and vanilla. Pour into a pie pan lined with pastry. Bake. Top with meringue.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
instructions: Makes a 9 x 13 pan thin layer or double use the next size pan or have it thicker. Takes about 15 minutes to mix and bake for 1 hour.

title: Vermicelli Mushroom Sauce
instructions: In medium saucepan heat oil. Add onion green pepper and garlic. Saut until tender; add mushrooms. Saut 2 minutes; add tomato sauce and seasoning; heat to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Herbed Cheese And Onion Bread
instructions: In a small bowl proof yeast in 1/4 cup chicken broth for 10 minutes. Into a large bowl sift together the whole wheat flour and salt. Add cheese onion rosemary dill and marjoram and toss. In another bowl combine milk the yeast mixture chicken stock or broth 1 egg and honey; when well combined add to flour mixture stirring until the dough is well blended. Gradually add all-purpose flour and blend the dough until it forms a ball. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead it adding more flour if it is too sticky for 10 minutes or until it is smooth and elastic. Form the dough into a ball; put it in a buttered bowl and turn it to coat it with the butter.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine in blender or processor until smooth and slightly thickened. Makes 14 oz. (Same amount as can of Eagle Brand milk.)

title: Chili Mac
instructions: In a large skillet cook meat onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. (Electric skillet at 350\u00b0.) Drain off fat. Stir in tomatoes beans tomato sauce water chili powder salt and bay leaf. Bring to a boil then add macaroni. Cover and reduce heat to low (220\u00b0). Simmer stirring frequently until macaroni is cooked (about 10 to 15 minutes). Remove the bay leaf before serving. Serves 6.

title: Turkey-Green Grape Salad
instructions: Combine turkey celery grapes and mayonnaise. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Toss lightly. Serve on greens and trim with small bunch of grapes. Or serve in avocado halves brushed with lemon juice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash and cut cauliflower into bite-size pieces. Add green onions and radishes. Mix garlic and cheese dressing according to package directions then add mayonnaise sour cream and caraway to it. Blend well and pour over cauliflower and mix together.

title: Cranberry Banana Christmas Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spray a loaf pan with nonstick spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serves 16.

title: Cocoa-Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. In large bowl combine all ingredients except nuts. Pour into prepared pan. Sprinkle nuts on top. Bake 65 to 70 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan. Wrap tightly in foil. Cool completely.

title: Crabmeat Muffins Appetizer
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Spread mixture on muffin halves. Place under broiler until lightly toasted. Makes 12 large portions. Can be halved to make 24 portions or quartered for bite-sized portions.

title: Three Layer Jello Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels margarine and 1/2 cup sugar. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip until smooth. Spread on pretzel layer. Heat pineapple juice. Add gelatin and strawberries (still frozen). When thickened pour on top of second layer. Chill. When firm serve in pan.

title: Queen'S Favorite Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in an average size dish (approximately 9 x 12 inches). Add milk to flour and sugar. Mix these three ingredients thoroughly and add to melted margarine. Add peaches and do not stir. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes or until browning is noted. This is excellent served while warm. For extra flavor top with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Oven-Baked Stew
instructions: Preheat oven to 425. In 2 1/2 quart shallow casserole toss beef with flour then bake uncovered for 20 minutes stirring halfway. Reduce heat to 350. Add carrots tomatoes and bay leaf. Blend soup mix with red wine and combine with other ingredients. Bake uncovered 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender. Stir in mushrooms and bake covered an additional 10 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Serve over hot noodles.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter and sugar until creamy. Add 1 egg at a time. Sift dry ingredients and add alternating with sour cream. Grease pan with shortening then flour. Bake 1 hour and 20 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: White Bbq Sauce For Chicken
instructions: Melt oleo. Combine dry ingredients and add to oleo. Stir until well blended. Remove from heat. Combine remaining ingredients and gradually stir into butter mixture. Return to heat. Stir until thick and smooth. Enough for 2 chickens.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk together in bowl. Pour into crust.

title: Tina'S Easy Banana Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Put in greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water. Add 1 cup warm water (not boiling) and cream cheese until fluffy. Add sugar mayonnaise and gelatine to cream cheese. Add pineapple nuts and marshmallows; mix well. Put into 10 to 12 individual molds.

title: Pumpkin Mousse
instructions: Pour milk into bowl. Add pudding and beat with whisk and let stand 5 minutes. Add pumpkin spices and 2 cups Cool Whip. Spoon into crust and chill 4 hours.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
instructions: Cook meat in a little oil with onion and pepper until meat is brown and done. Stir in remaining ingredients and cook 5 minutes.

title: Pecan Chicken
instructions: Foil line 9 x 13-inch pan; this helps in cleanup. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour milk in bowl large enough for chicken to fit in; set aside. Mix all other ingredients except chicken in large Ziploc. Dip chicken in milk then shake in bag. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Combine first six ingredients. Stir in eggs and sour cream. Knead briefly and shape into a ball. Place on greased cookie sheet. Use a sharp knife to cut an \X\ onto top or spoon into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown and knife comes out clean.

title: Creamy Delicious Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0 in a medium-sized bowl combine crushed graham crackers and the butter. Using your fingers press the crumb mixture into the bottom of a 9- or 10-inch springform pan forming the crust. In a large bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed beat the cream cheese sugar vanilla and 1 egg until smooth and creamy. Add the remaining 3 eggs and the sour cream an beat until well combined. Add the heavy cream and beat for 2 to 3 minutes or until well blended. Pour over the crust and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until firm. Turn off the oven and open the door for 1 minute allowing the temperature to drop. Close the door and allow the cake to sit in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove the cake from the oven cover with aluminum foil and chill for at least 6 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Beef And Vegetables Chinese Style
instructions: Cut the steak into thin strips 2 x 1/4 x 1/4-inch. Cut the bamboo shoots into thin strips. Slice the water chestnuts. Cut the onion into 8ths. Slice the celery and carrot diagonally. Cut large mushrooms in half. Mix together the ginger sherry sugar soy sauce and cornstarch. Heat the oil in a frying pan with the garlic. Saute garlic until browned then remove. Cook the beef strips until they change color stirring constantly. Add the soy sauce mixture stock vegetables and seasonings. Bring to the boil stirring and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Orange Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in salted water 15 minutes. Mix sugar cornstarch salt ginger orange juice and butter and pour over carrots. Cook stirring occasionally for about 8 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Ginger-Cinnamon Fruit Dip
instructions: In a small bowl combine the yogurt cream cheese ginger and cinnamon until well blended. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve with fruit. Yield 3/4 cup.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Combine egg buttermilk and butter slowly stir into dry ingredients (pancake batter will be very thick). For each pancake spoon about 1/4 cup batter into a very hot skillet with moderate oil. Turn pancakes when tops are covered with bubbles and edges are brown. Serve with syrup.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind all together and mix well and chill. (It freezes well.)

title: Hot Fudge Pudding
instructions: Blend in bowl the flour salt 2 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and sugar. Stir in milk and chopped nuts. Spread in a 9-inch pan.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix altogether. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Zucchini Fritters(Martian Pancakes)
instructions: In blender add pieces of zucchini to the egg until all mixed. Add spices and pancake mix until mixture sufficiently thickened for pancake batter. Drop spoonfuls into hot oil 1-inch deep in frying pan. Turn once when brown. Good to eat with syrup.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into small balls. Mash balls down lightly with fork on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 until very lightly browned.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Make topping first. Mix the box of frozen strawberries 4 tablespoons sugar and cornstarch. Cook until bubbly. Cool in refrigerator for 2 hours.

title: Plain Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour salt cream of tartar and soda together. Set aside. Mix sugar and oleo together. Beat until smooth. Add eggs beating after each addition then add vanilla. Add small amount of flour mixture beating until smooth until all flour is used. Roll into small balls and drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yield About 8 dozen.

title: Alfredo Sauce
instructions: Melt butter. Bring cream and milk to a boil in a large pan. Mix rest of ingredients except cornstarch together and add to boiling mixture. Mix with whisk. Burns easy. Thicken with cornstarch. Serve over hot fettucine.

title: Creamy Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Heat water and butter; add vanilla and chocolate. Add confectioners sugar; beat until of spreading consistency.

title: Easy Ground Beef Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef in saucepan; stir until crumbly and drain. Add spaghetti sauce water and seasonings; mix well. Simmer for 10 minutes. Mix cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese eggs and half the Parmesan cheese in bowl. Layer 1 cup sauce 3 uncooked noodles 1 1/2 cups sauce and half the cheese mixture in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Repeat layers.

title: Salsa
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients well. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Keeps well refrigerated. Makes 3 cups.

title: Champagne Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed for about 15 minutes. Cool thoroughly. Mix cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk. Add remaining milk and pudding. Mix well. Pour over cake. Pour pineapple on top and then top with Cool Whip nuts and garnish with cherries. Refrigerate.

title: French Market Soup
instructions: Sort and wash 2 cups bean mix. Place in a Dutch oven. Cover with water 2 inches above beans. Soak overnight. Drain beans. Add 2 quarts water and next 3 ingredients. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until beans are tender. Add remaining ingredients; simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove ham hock from soup. Remove meat from bone. Chop meat and return to soup.

title: Parmesan Chicken Bake
instructions: *To make this recipe lower in fat grams I spray my pan with Pam and use fat-free bread crumbs using no margarine at all.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put butter in baking dish and put in 350\u00b0 oven to melt. Make batter of sugar flour baking powder salt and milk. When mixed pour over butter (do not stir). Empty can of peaches (drained) on top of batter. (Do not stir.) Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Good with ice cream.

title: Southern Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put into a casserole.

title: Cider Punch
instructions: Boil all ingredients for 15 minutes. Let stand for 12 hours and strain. Serve hot.

title: Tater Tots Appetizer(Club Member: Christy Hosey)
instructions: Wrap 1/3 slice of cheese and 1/3 slice bacon around Tater Tot. Serve with toothpicks. Bake until done.

title: The Ultimate Oatmeal Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Combine flour baking soda salt and spices. Add to margarine mixture and mix well. Stir in oats. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix flour and milk. Add to other mixture (except butter). Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until firm and browned.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Drain fruit. Mix rest of ingredients and stir in fruit. Chill for several hours or overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix together 1 cup sugar and peanut butter until crumbly. Put more than 1/3 in bottom of pie shell. Save rest to go on top.

title: Caviar Supreme
instructions: Soften cheese. Add mayo. Blend in lemon juice onion juice and Worcestershire on a tray. Form mixture into a flat circle 1-inch high. Press parsley into sides and spread caviar on top (in middle) around top edge. Spread onions then eggs. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. Serve with Melba rounds.

title: Honey Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder soda and salt together; set aside. Work shortening until soft and smooth. Gradually add sugar and mix again. Stir in honey unbeaten egg and nuts. Blend in sifted dry ingredients. Divide dough in half and shape each half into a roll. Wrap each roll in wax paper and place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Taco Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef and onion. Stir in tomato sauce beans and seasoning. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Break taco shells in half at fold. Place shells rounded side up along the sides of casserole and top with cheese. Bake 15 minutes. Sprinkle with reserved taco shells and bake 5 minutes longer. Top with lettuce and tomatoes just before serving. Pass sour cream and taco sauce.

title: Miss Elsie'S Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks; add other ingredients and cook in double boiler until partly thickened. Put in unbaked pie shell and bake until thick. Beat egg whites for meringue. Sprinkle coconut on top and brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch bread pan. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine white flour baking soda and salt. Stir in wheat flour. Fold in bananas vanilla and chocolate chips. Pour mixture into pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Boo Boo'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Randall House Dressing
instructions: Shake or stir all ingredients together. Chill.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on package. Saute onion in butter until transparent. Add this along with Cheez Whiz and broccoli. Beat eggs and add to mixture.

title: French Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ground beef onions crackers and\tegg. Place in meat loaf pan. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Prepare sauce with celery soup and milk mixture.\tPour mixture over meat loaf. Cook meat loaf and sauce for 30 minutes or until done. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cocktail Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine sausage biscuit mix and grated cheese. Shape into cocktail size meatballs. Place in baking pan and bake at 300\u00b0 until lightly brown about 25 minutes or less. These freeze well.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except beets. Heat to boiling the add the beets. Cover and simmer 5 minutes; chill.

title: No Cream Broccoli Soup(Low Calorie)
instructions: In large soup pot heat vegetable oil. Add onions garlic salt pepper and thyme. Stir until onions are softened. Add broth and water. Bring to a boil and stir in potatoes. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender. Meanwhile trim ends and tough stalks off broccoli. Cut flowerets and stalks of broccoli into 1-inch pieces. Add to pot and cook until broccoli is tender. Puree soup in a blender (for creamy soup). Return to pot and add lemon juice.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine the cream cheese powdered sugar milk peanut butter and Cool Whip with mixer. Drizzle syrup in bottom of crusts. Pour mixture into pie shells. Dribble syrup over top. Freeze.

title: Scotch Shortbread(Missionary)
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in a mixing bowl. Work in butter until the dough is the consistency of short crust. Sprinkle board with rice flour. Turn dough onto a board and knead until smooth. Cut into portions and shape into rounds. This amount will make 4 small rounds. Place on grease-proof paper in a baking tin. Prick with a fork. Put in oven at 350\u00b0. When the cakes begin to color (from 20 to 30 minutes) lower the heat. Allow to cool in the tin.

title: Blueberry-Banana Fridge Pie
instructions: Cream softened cream cheese and add sugar and mix well. Stir in Cool Whip. Cut up bananas and line bottom of pie crust. Add cheese/Whip mixture over banana. Spread gently the blueberry pie filling over the cheese/Whip mixture. Serve with a dollop of Cool Whip. This is delicious!!

title: Cavatappi With Spinach, Beans & Asiago Cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss well. Sprinkle with ground pepper.

title: Crab Delight
instructions: Heat soup. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add to soup. Add cream cheese and beat smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into 5-cup mold. Refrigerate until firm. Serve with crackers.

title: Mary Wilcox'S Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar Crisco and butter. Add eggs one at a time stirring after each. Add flour milk and lemon flavoring. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Place in cold oven. Now turn oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 1 1/2 hours. Depending on your oven you may need to bake less time. Watch for the top of the cake to get golden brown and a knife inserted into middle comes out clean. Invert onto a plate and cool out of pan. No icing needed.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cut bacon up into small pieces. Chop up onion. Brown 1 pound hamburger with bacon and onion. Add pork and beans molasses catsup and dry mustard. Mix and pour into casserole or baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Batter Bread
instructions: Let yeast dissolve in water. Add salt sugar and oil. Stir in 2 cups of flour. Knead in 1 more cup of flour (will be soft dough). Return to bowl; cover. Let rise about 1 hour. Knead and shape into loaf. Place in loaf pan and let rise until double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheddar Baked Orzo With Pepperoni
instructions: In saucepan saute pepperoni and onion over medium heat while stirring for 3 to 4 minutes. Reduce heat and add flour with whisk to form a roux. Whisk in broth. Simmer sauce 2 minutes while continually stirring. Whisk in Cheddar cheese stirring until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.

title: Crab Mold
instructions: Heat soup cool slightly and add gelatin. Add all ingredients together and mix well by hand. Chill in mold.

title: Peanut Butter N Banana Bread
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir together flour sugars baking powder salt and cinnamon. In another bowl combine mashed bananas milk peanut butter oil vanilla and egg. Add to flour mixture stirring just until combined. Stir in chocolate pieces. Pour batter into two greased 8 x 4 x 2 inch loaf pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50-55 minutes or until wooden toothpick in center comes out clean. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool thoroughly. Wrap and store overnight before serving. To serve frost with peanut butter frosting. If desired top with crushed peanuts and miniature semi-sweet chocolate pieces.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Cook beef until brown. Cook rice according to package directions. Mix rice tomatoes and soup. Add meat to bottom of dish. Add rice mixture to top of this. Stir in just a little meat. Add Cheddar cheese to top. Microwave until cheese melts. Serve on lettuce also with Doritos.

title: Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Grate ginger or cut into fine strips. Heat a large frying pan and add butter 2 1/2 tablespoons ginger the mustard seeds and cashews. Saut for 2 minutes. Add precooked pasta (use a kind with ridges) coconut and cilantro. Saut over medium heat until hot. Set aside; keep warm. Heat a large frying pan and add oil and 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger. Saut 30 seconds. Add shrimp (use large precooked ones) scallions and lime juice. Saut until hot. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve over hot pasta and garnish with lime wedges and cilantro.

title: Microwave Chili
instructions: *Can substitute 2 (8 ounce) cans of tomato sauce for the can of tomatoes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Heat beans (and meat if used) in saucepan. Pour into large salad bowl. Add chips cheese olives lettuce and tomato. Pour salad dressing over the top. Toss just before serving.

title: Peanut Pattie
instructions: Combine sugar syrup milk and peanuts and cook in saucepan until a few drops of mixture forms in a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Take off heat add butter vanilla and coloring. Beat until creamy. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper or foil. Let cool. Yield 25 to 30 patties.

title: Crab Rangoon
instructions: Mix cheese crab and garlic. Place fingertip amount on each wonton. Seal with water. Fry lightly in oil until lightly browned. Can reheat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 min. Makes about 50 wontons.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Mix with meat onion and celery. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Will be thick.

title: Apple Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix flour butter and 2 Tbsp. sugar; pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix apples sugar and cinnamon. Add onto crust.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: To prepare; Sprinkle bottom of casserole dish (8 x 8) with part of cracker crumbs. Layer asparagus grated cheese and roasted almonds alternating each. After dish is filled pour 1 cup of milk on one side of dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Favorite Pudding Dessert
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small bowl mix margarine flour and nuts together and spread in 9 X 13 pan. Bake about 15 minutes. Cool completely. In medium bowl mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together. Fold in whipped topping. Spread onto cooled crust. Prepare pudding with milk and spread onto creamed cheese mixture. Top all with whipped topping. Chill until serving.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into gallon container. Finish filling up with milk. Put in freezer and freeze.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Look rice do not wash. Put in bottom of casserole dish. Cover with soup making sure all rice is covered. Melt butter in pan and cut up onion. Add hamburger and simmer until it is crumbly. Pour over soup and rice. Cover and bake about 1 1/2 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse shrimp. Combine first 7 ingredients. Toss to mix. Serve with dressing. Yields 4 servings.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Mix eggs milk salt and pepper. Break up bread into small pieces; let bread dry out slightly. Add bread to milk mixture. Add raw meat and mix thoroughly. Form small balls. Cook vinegar brown sugar dry mustard water and salt and pepper until melted and blended together. Pour over balls which have been placed in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour or until lightly browned; turn occasionally. Save sauce; reheat in serving dish. Serve with long toothpicks.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Dip in your favorite fruit.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; chill a few minutes. Form into 2 balls; let set overnight then chop another cup of pecans and roll or pat the pecans on the ball.

title: Mini Fruit Cakes
instructions: Mix well all the ingredients and spoon into mini cupcake pans sprayed with Pam. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fruited Rice Pudding
instructions: Heat milk to boiling over moderate heat. Quickly stir in vanilla pudding mix and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in cinnamon dissolved in vanilla sugar currants and pineapple or favorite preserves. Stir in cooked rice and blend. Chill. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chicken And Rice Soup
instructions: Boil chicken. Remove from broth. Bone chicken. While boning chicken add rice to broth. Cook until rice is almost done. Add mixed vegetables and chicken. Simmer until vegetables and rice are done. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Catfish Stew
instructions: Saute onions in margarine or oil. Add fish water pepper seeds with salt and pepper to taste. Cover pan and simmer until fish is tender and flaky. Serve over rice.

title: Georgia Hash
instructions: Cut up potatoes to fry. Put in a hot skillet with 1/4-inch oil. Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Do not allow to become crispy. While potatoes cook cut up other vegetables (amounts to your desire). Add to potatoes along with salt and pepper to taste. Cook until tender stirring occasionally.

title: Tex-Mex Dip
instructions: Peel pit and mash the avocados in a medium-size glass or wooden bowl. Add the lemon juice salt and pepper. Set aside. Combine the sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasonings in a bowl. Set aside. To assemble the dish spread the bean dip on a shallow serving platter a glass pie plate or a casserole. Top with the avocado mixture then the sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with the chopped onions tomatoes and olives. Cover the whole top with shredded cheese. Serve chilled or at room temperature with tortilla chips.

title: Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Brown hamburger; add onions peppers tomatoes and tomato sauce from mix. Simmer 15 minutes. Roll crust in oblong dish. Layer 1 package cheese and 1 layer of meat. Add other package of cheese and sprinkle with can of cheese that is in mix. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hot Mustard Sauce
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients together then add the beaten eggs and wine vinegar. Blend well.

title: Snickers Bars
instructions: Melt together chips and shortening in a double boiler or microwave. Pour half into a buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Cool. Melt caramels with butter and water. Add nuts and pour over cooled chocolate mixture in pan. Cool again. Top with remaining melted chocolate mixture. Keep refrigerated until serving time.

title: Enchilada Verde Casserole
instructions: Remove bones and skin from chicken and shred this should yield about two to three cups of chicken meat. Line bottom of casserole dish baking dish or bread pan with tortillas cover but only one tortilla thick. Divide ingredients into three units. Then layer chicken cheese seasonings green chilies and sour cream. Spread the sour cream around so it covers the layer repeat until you have three layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour or until the top is lightly brown and it is bubbling. Serve with green salad salsa and bread of choice.

title: Crescent Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand for 5 minutes. Combine flour sugar and salt in a large mixing bowl. Cut in 3/4 cup butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Combine eggs milk and yeast mixture; add to the flour mixture stirring well (dough will be sticky). Cover and refrigerate overnight. Punch dough down and divide in half. Roll each half into a 12-inch circle on a floured surface; cut each circle into 12 wedges. Roll up each wedge tightly beginning at wide end. Seal points and place rolls point side down on greased baking sheets. Curve rolls into crescent shape. Brush with melted butter. Cover and let rise in a warm place for an hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and set aside. In saucepan add the last 5 ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour over cabbage and stir often. When cool refrigerate. Best if made a day ahead of time.

title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding mix water eggs and oil in large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pans for 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack. Fill and frost with Coconut-Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Place strawberries in baked pie shell. Cook water sugar cornstarch flavoring and as much red food coloring as you want until thick. Let cool. Pour over strawberries in shell then refrigerate and serve.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine first 6 ingredients and pour into greased 9x13 in. pan. Combine pecans sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter. Cut thru with knife to swirl. Bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Combine sugar and orange juice until smooth. Pour over hot cake.

title: Company Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ketchup. Place in a metal baking pan; form into loaf. Cover bottom of baking dish with ketchup (1/2-inch deep). Place in preheated 350\u00b0 oven depending on your oven and bake about 1 hour. The ketchup and juices from the meat make a wonderful sauce to serve over meat loaf.

title: Fig Nut Bar
instructions: Mix as mentioned. Take half the dough; pat into pan. Spread filling over it. Take small pieces of dough; pat over top. Bake. Cool. Cut in strips.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and 1 cup water in saucepan mixing well. Cook 45 minutes. Braise chops or ribs in sauce in usual manner.

title: Spaghetti Florentine(International Cuisine:  Italian)
instructions: Prepare spaghetti; brown ground beef and drain. Stir herb-spice mix tomato paste and water together. Bring to a boil; simmer 10 minutes. In 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish layer half of the spaghetti sauce cottage cheese spinach and Mozzarella cheese; repeat layers. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Make ahead; assemble casserole. Cover tightly and refrigerate.

title: Easy Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Mix and beat 4 minutes. Bake in 3 greased and floured cake pans at 350\u00b0 25-30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in saucepan. Stir 2 cups milk in gradually. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Boil 1 minute. Blend in vanilla and if desired 1 tablespoon butter.

title: Creamy Chicken Chowder
instructions: In a 4-quart pan combine milk broth and soups. Blend well. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Mix well and cook over medium heat approximately 10 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent scorching. Add cheese just before serving. Stir until melted. Served with crescent rolls and salad this makes a great easy to fix meal.

title: Rice With Green Chilies And Sour Cream
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on package (quick-cooking rice may be used). Combine cooked rice with sour cream and season to taste with salt. Arrange half the mixture in the bottom of a greased casserole. Cut the 1/2 pound of Jack cheese into domino-sized pieces and wrap them in strips of green chili peppers. Place these on top of the rice in the casserole add the remaining rice mixture and dot with butter. Cover with the grated Jack cheese. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cafe Au Lait Mix
instructions: In an airtight container combine all ingredients; mix well. Makes 2 cups of mix.

title: Quick Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. In a 1 1/2 quart casserole cook onion and butter in microwave on Medium-high for 1 to 2 minutes or until onions appear transparent. Cube Velveeta cheese and cut up tomatoes. Add all ingredients to casserole with onions. Stir to mix. Microwave on Medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minute intervals (stir in between) until cheese is melted. Serve with Italian bread. Makes 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; stir well. Add water and cook until clear. Remove from heat; add jello. Let cool. Pour half of jello mixture into crust. Add berries which have been cut into fourths; then add remaining jello mixture. Top with 1 small container whipped topping. Refrigerate until served.

title: Baked Steak
instructions: Place steak in baking dish; season with salt and pepper. Spread with butter and add a layer of lemon. Cover with chopped green pepper top all this with chili sauce.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions on box using two 8-inch layer pans. Split both layers horizontally after they have cooled. Blend together the sugar sour cream and coconut. Chill. Spread all but 1 cup of the sour cream mixture between the layers. Blend the remaining cup of the mixture with whipped cream. Spread on top and sides of the cake. Seal in airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days before serving. Keep refrigerated after cutting. (Ours never last the 3 day waiting period!)

title: Ham Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put into a casserole dish. Top with the biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until hot and bubbly.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 until set about 45 minutes.

title: Helen'S Holly Taters
instructions: Cut potatoes (with skin on) into wedges. Combine all other ingredients. Drop and roll potatoes thoroughly. Place on large flat pan. Dab with 1 stick margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3/4 to 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Marlow
instructions: Steam marshmallows over hot water and add pineapple. Combine with whipped cream. Pour into a greased tray to become firm. Does not require freezing.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in beans and 1/2 can onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbling; stir. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.

title: Two-Cheese Sausage Balls
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease jelly roll pan. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape into 1-inch balls and place in pan not touching each other. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients to blend. Put in casserole or six individual dishes. Sprinkle grated cheese over top. Cover with crushed potato chips. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Crazy Cheese Straws
instructions: Let the frozen puff pastry thaw (this takes about thirty minutes). Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. Dust your countertop with flour. Lay the puff pastry on the floured area.

title: Broccoli Tuna Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine soup and milk; set aside. Combine tuna fish broccoli 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French onions. Stir in 3/4 cup soup mixture. Divide tuna mixture evenly between the tortillas and roll up; place seam side down in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Stir tomato into remaining soup; pour over top of tortillas. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top center of tortillas with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs 1 at a time beating after each addition. Combine flour baking powder salt and cocoa; add to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla and pecans; spoon batter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until top is barely soft to the touch. Remove from oven and cover top with marshmallows. Return to oven for 2 minutes or until marshmallows are soft. Spread marshmallows over cake and immediately cover with frosting. Let frosting harden before cutting the cake.

title: Lemon Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Chill until thickened. Beat with blender and add defrosted lemonade Cool Whip and orange marmalade. Pour into greased mold pan and chill until set.

title: Florida Celery And Eggplant Croquettes
instructions: Dice eggplant and onion. Combine eggplant and onion with celery salt and pepper. Bring 1-inch water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add vegetables and cook uncovered 5 minutes. Drain off water.

title: Savory Minestrone Main Dish Soup
instructions: In large saucepan brown bacon and cook onion and celery with garlic and basil until tender. Stir in soups water tomatoes ditalini and salt. Bring to boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Add cabbage and zucchini; cook 10 minutes more or until done. Stir occasionally. Makes 8 cups.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain the artichoke hearts and marinated artichoke hearts. Cut them in small pieces and place in the bottom of a pie plate quiche dish or serving dish or your choice. Add the chopped jalapeno chili peppers and blend together. Scoop out 4 to 6 tablespoons of mayonnaise on the top of this mixture and spread over the top. Put the shredded cheese on top of the mayonnaise layer. Heat in the microwave oven until the cheese melts or in a conventional oven at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Serve with taco chips or raw vegetables. This is a very popular appetizer.

title: Evergreen Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar and water with Kool-Aid. Add ginger ale pineapple juice and ice just before serving. Freeze ice cubes with cherry. Makes a pretty punch.

title: Holiday Fruit Cookies
instructions: Mix well the shortening sugar and eggs. Add milk and remaining ingredients. Stir in fruit and nuts. Chill dough overnight. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Do not pare cucumbers; slice thin. Add onions green peppers and sliced garlic. Add salt. Cover with cracked ice; mix thoroughly. Let stand 3 hours. Drain well. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over cucumber mixture. Heat just to a boil. Seal in hot sterilized jars. Makes 6 to 8 pints.

title: Banana Nut Muffins
instructions: Use paper cups or grease a 12-cup muffin tin. Mix dry ingredients including nuts. Mix wet ingredients. Fold wet ingredients into dry. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until tester comes out clean.

title: Quick Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles as per package. Brown beef and salt pepper and garlic to taste; drain. In a baking dish spoon a little sauce on bottom then add noodles to cover bottom of dish. Add Provolone cheese Ricotta cheese and ground beef. Cover with spaghetti sauce. Bake 30 to 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Peach Dessert
instructions: Bake in tube pan at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Fluffy Cranberry Cheese Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine gelatin and sugar; set aside. In a saucepan bring cranberry juice to a boil. Remove from the heat and pour onto gelatin mixture stirring to dissolve. Stir in the cranberry sauce. Chill until slightly thickened.

title: Ham Rolls With Orange Rice
instructions: Bring orange juice to a boil. Lower heat and add rice. Cook covered for 20 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Combine chopped oranges with rice and mix with mayonnaise pecans parsley and onions. Spoon mixture onto ham slices and roll as tightly as possible. Place in greased baking dishes seam side down.

title: Drop Egg In Bowl Chocolate Cake
instructions: Drop egg in bowl. Cover with ingredients as listed. Beat until smooth. Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Candy Mints
instructions: Mash and cream the cream cheese; add the powdered sugar gradually stirring until the mixture becomes like a stiff dough. Add desired flavoring and food coloring mixing ingredients thoroughly. Roll in small balls and dip in the granulated sugar. Dip your mold in granulated sugar and press the ball down in the mold. Unmold at once on waxed paper.

title: Gina'S Orange Whole Wheat Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs and oil together. Sift flour and baking soda together. Add to egg mixture. Gradually add orange juice until you have a good consistency. Add nuts to batter if desired. Fry on a medium hot griddle. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add carrots and onion. Saute vegetables 8 minutes. Remove vegetables from skillet reserving pan drippings. Set vegetables aside.

title: Hot Artichoke Cheese Dip
instructions: Squeeze artichoke hearts dry. (I usually rinse them off with tap water after I drain the can.) Cut up into bite size pieces. Combine with cheese mayonnaise and garlic powder.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix thoroughly and shape into loaf. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 450\u00b0 about 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Allow about 1 1/2 hours to make and cook.

title: Fudgsicles
instructions: Mix all ingredients according to directions on back of pudding mix. Pour into molds ice trays or small paper cups. Insert popsicle sticks. Freeze. Makes 10 to 12 fudgsicles.

title: Spinach Salad With Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine first six ingredients in tight-fitting jar. Shake to blend. Refrigerate. Makes 1 1/2 cups dressing.

title: Tropic Sun Spareribs
instructions: Rub ribs with garlic. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange onion in large baking pan. Place ribs on top. Add 1/4 cup water to pan. Cover with foil. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour. Combine remaining ingredients. Spoon over ribs. Bake uncovered 1 hour longer. Serves 4.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix together first five ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip. Let set before serving.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: In mixing bowl put 1 mushroom soup celery soup eggs and medium handful of dried onions. Stir with large spoon until completely mixed. Open spice packet from stuffing mix and sprinkle 1/2 the packet evenly across mixture. Stir in then sprinkle remaining 1/2 packet and stir in completely. Open can of mushrooms. Using cover squeeze off juice and discard. Chop mushrooms into small pieces and add to mixture. Remove bag of croutons and flatten with rolling pin into Grape-Nuts size pieces. Be careful not to powder croutons too much. In a large bowl put ground meat and chop until broken up. Add mixture to meat. With a large Baggie on hands completely mix. Make 2 to 2 1/2-inch meat balls and put in pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Spoon remaining mushroom soup over meat balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Swirl Coffee Cake
instructions: In large bowl beat butter until creamy. Gradually add the 1 cup sugar beating until fluffy. Add the eggs vanilla and sour cream; beat until well blended. Sift together flour baking soda and baking powder. Gradually add this mixture to the creamed mixture beating at low speed just until blended. Pour 1/2 batter into ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Combine 1/2 cup sugar 1 tablespoon cinnamon and the chopped nuts. Pour 1/2 of this sugar mixture over the batter. Top with remaining batter and remaining sugar mixture. Swirl lightly with knife to marble. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in 375\u00b0 preheated oven. Cool 10 minutes. Turn out of pan to cool on rack. Makes 1 (10-inch) cake.

title: Cheese Log
instructions: Mix ingredients. Chill on wax paper. Shape mixture into log 8 x 1 1/2-inch. Roll in chopped nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Perfect Pumpkin Or Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour spice and salt in a large bowl. Stir in pumpkin (sweet potato) milk and eggs. Pour half of the mixture into each pastry shell. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until tests done. Serve with whipped cream.

title: One Bowl Applesauce Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Measure all ingredients into large bowl. Blend 30 seconds on low speed then beat 3 minutes on medium speed; scrape bowl often. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake 50 minutes for layer pans 60 minutes for 13 x 9-inch pan or 70 minutes for tube pan. Test for doneness.

title: Chocolate Biscuit Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine half and half and butter in a heavy saucepan; cook over medium heat until butter melts. Cool. Combine eggs sugar and cocoa; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer 1 minute. Gradually stir in half and half mixture; set aside. Crumble biscuits into a lightly greased 2-quart shallow baking dish. Add egg mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean covering with aluminum foil after 35 minutes to prevent overbrowning. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Sweet Potato Fluffy
instructions: Beat potatoes butter sugar eggs milk and orange juice until fluffy. Add marshmallows and nuts. Pour in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Candied Yam Boats - Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes with a brush. Bake at 325\u00b0 until tender about 1 hour. Remove the potatoes from oven. Cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out center of halves leaving about 1/2-inch shell. Set shells aside.

title: Olive Craver'S Kraut Drop Dumplings
instructions: Cook kraut. Be sure there is enough water to cover dumplings. Salt to taste. Drop by spoonful into hot kraut. Cook until done.

title: Pot Roast Norway
instructions: Roll meat in flour; brown slowly on all sides in little hot fat. Mix and add remaining ingredients. Cover; cook slowly 2 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Triple-Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Combine cranberry juice concentrate and sugar in a heavy saucepan. Bring to boil over high heat stirring until sugar dissolves. Add fresh and dried cranberries and cook until dried berries begin to soften and fresh berries begin to pop stirring often about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in orange marmalade orange juice orange peel and allspice. Cool completely. Cover; chill until cold about 2 hours. (Can be made 3 days ahead. Keep refrigerated.)

title: Salt Water Taffy
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add water and honey. Cook to 270\u00b0. Pull.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: Use a heavy pot. Saute garlic celery green onions and sweet onion in butter. Add chopped potatoes mushrooms and carrots; cook 3 minutes. Add chicken broth water salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer covered 20 minutes. Whisk in 1/2 pint of half and half. Serve hot with a little grated sharp Cheddar cheese and chopped green onion sprinkled on top.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix flour cocoa sugar and salt in pan. Mix egg yolks and milk and add to dry ingredients and mix well. Cook on medium heat until thicken stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add oleo and vanilla. Pour into 9-inch baked pie crust and top with meringue. Bake at 350 for 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown beef in oil. Add garlic and cook until yellow. Add soy sauce salt 1/4 cup water and cook for 45 minutes. Add vegetables. Cook 10 minutes. Stir in cornstarch blend with 1 cup water. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Grilled Corn With Garlic Butter
instructions: Stir together soft butter and minced garlic. Cover mixture and chill. Remove husks from corn grill corn uncovered on a lightly greased grill rack over medium heat about 10 minutes or until corn is tender. Turn several times as needed. Serve with garlic butter and salt while corn is still warm. 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Apple Butter
instructions: Cook Zucchini in small amount of water. When soft put through a blender. Add sugar vinegar spices and lemon juice to zucchini. Put in a heavy saucepan and bring to boil on low heat until thicken. Add Hot Candies until melted. continue cooking until thickened stirring constantly. Put into hot jar and seal.

title: Chinese Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into bite-sized balls. Brown in hot oil before baking 30 minutes on broiler rack in 325\u00b0 oven. Pour 16 ounces barbecue sauce over meatballs before serving. Reheat in 200\u00b0 oven and add more barbecue sauce. Serve from chafing dish.

title: Applesauce Spice Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix applesauce eggs and cocoa. Beat 2 minutes. Fold in raisins and nuts. Turn into a well-greased 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake in 9x12 cake pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Plain Cake
instructions: Soften shortening in a large bowl. Beat in sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Mix flour baking powder and salt in separate bowl. Add half of flour mixture and half of milk to egg mixture and beat 300 strokes. Add rest of flour mixture and milk; beat 300 strokes more. Fill greased baking pan half full or pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 (moderate oven) 25 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back when touched. This is an old recipe and is good with strawberries over it.

title: Sausage - Chuck Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain all but 2 tablespoons fat. Pat sausage in casserole. Brown meat. Put in casserole. Lightly brown peppers onions garlic and potatoes. Add to casserole. Put in spices; lightly toss. Add beef broth; cover. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Layer broccoli in dish. Mix soup beaten eggs cheese onion salt and pepper and pour over broccoli. Melt margarine. Crush cheese nips and sprinkle over broccoli casserole. Drizzle melted butter over all. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Jane'S Whipping Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter and sugar until creamy. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and whipping cream a small amount at a time on low speed of mixer. Add flavorings. Start in a cold oven set at 325\u00b0. Cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes then turn out of pan.

title: Heavenly Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pan and press down. Bake at 350\u00b0. Watch closely until golden brown about 5 minutes. Let cool.

title: Special K Cookies(Or Rice Krispie Cookies)
instructions: Bring Karo and sugar to rolling boil (one you cant stir down). Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Stir until smooth. Add cereal. Mix well and spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut into squares.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine sugar milk cocoa and vanilla. Bring to a boil. Add peanut butter and boil hard. Add oats. Mix well and drop onto wax paper by the spoonfuls. Let harden.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Combine milk sugar vinegar egg butter cornstarch salt celery seed and mustard. Cook and stir over low heat until thickened. Remove from heat and add onions and salad dressing. Peel and chop potatoes and hard-boiled eggs. Fold in dressing. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Frosty Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour in a 9 x 12-inch dish. Freeze firm. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook peas and onions together; set aside. Cook carrots and celery together; set aside. Cut up chicken; set aside. In large pot melt butter. Add heaping 1/2 cup flour and blend well. Add milk and cream and 2 cups chicken broth slowly. Cook until sauce is creamy. Add mixture to vegetables chicken and lemon juice. Mix well and season to taste. Pour into pastry lined 3-quart casserole. Top with crust. Slit top and bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 or until browned.

title: Smooth 'N Creamy Frosting
instructions: Combine pudding mix sugar and milk in a small bowl; beat slowly with a rotary beater or at lowest speed of an electric mixer until well blended about 1 minute. Fold in whipped topping and spread on cake at once. Makes about 4 cups enough for 2 (9-inch) layers. Store frosted cake in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Stir constantly until soft ball stage sugar milk and butter. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 2 cups peanut butter. Mix. Put in buttered pan. Cool until hard.

title: Aunt Pearl'S Blackberry Jam Cake
instructions: Sift together flour cloves allspice and cinnamon. Add apples dates and nuts. Stir coating fruit with flour mixture. Set aside. Blend butter and sugar until creamy. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Set aside. Dissolve baking powder in milk. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add flour mixture milk buttermilk and jam alternately to egg mixture. Beat two minutes. Pour batter into 4 greased and floured 8 or 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool and ice with date frosting.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve strawberry Jell-O in boiling water. Mix with electric mixer to the Jell-O mixture the cranberry sauce. Lightly grease an 8 x 12-inch dish or 10 x 10-inch glass dish or a large bowl. Pour 1/2 of mixture in dish; let set in refrigerator. Spread the sour cream over the set mixture. Sprinkle the chopped pecans over the sour cream. Carefully pour remaining Jell-O mixture over pecans; let set in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Casserole
