instructions: Mix chicken soup mayonnaise celery onions and almonds together. Fold in chicken cooked rice and boiled eggs. Refrigerate overnight. Cook covered at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove lid and add onion rings and cook for 15 minutes.

title: Quick-As-Wick Hot Dish
instructions: Place potatoes in bottom of greased baking dish. Crumble hamburger over the potatoes. Add vegetable beef soup. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Easy Chow Chow
instructions: Chop tomatoes and drain off juice. Chop rest of ingredients and mix all of them together along with vinegar sugar and salt. Add enough water to cover and cook slowly for 15 minutes. Seal in jars.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Cream together the butter and sugar. Add and mix the eggs and chocolate syrup. Combine in a bowl the flour salt and baking powder. Gradually add to the chocolate mixture. Add the vanilla and nuts. Pour brownies into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Spanish Steak
instructions: Melt butter in heavy frying pan. Add onions and cook several minutes. Add remaining ingredients and simmer on top of stove for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Scald but do not boil. Can hot.

title: Corn Chowder(Serves 4)
instructions: Preheat large saucepan over medium heat about 1 minute. Spray twice with cooking spray. Saute the onions until translucent. Add 4 cups of the corn (2 cans) and saute 4 to 5 minutes until softens a bit. Add 2 cups chicken stock and cook until corn can be mashed easily. Transfer contents of pan to a blender and puree until smooth. Return to saucepan. Add pepper rosemary thyme black pepper cayenne pepper 1 cup chicken stock and 2 cups corn (1 can). Stir and cook 10 minutes more until it thickens. Garnish with the fresh basil.

title: Individual Or Little Cheesecakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients with mixer for 5 minutes. Place a vanilla wafer on bottom of a foil baking cup (midget size 2-inch diameter). Spoon a tablespoon of cheese mixture on top of each wafer. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for approximately 15 minutes. Top with cherry pineapple strawberry or blueberry pie filling. Makes about 40 little cheesecakes.

title: Apple Dumpling
instructions: Wrap each 1/4 apple in roll. Place in casserole bowl. Boil sugar orange juice and butter together. Add vanilla and pour over apples. Bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes. When baked spoon some juice over bread to glaze.

title: Graham Cracker Yankee
instructions: Place whole graham crackers in bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Boil sugar egg cream butter and flour. Remove from heat. Stir in crushed graham crackers coconut and vanilla. Spread over whole graham crackers in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with another layer of whole graham crackers. Frost with powdered sugar egg and vanilla mixture.

title: Pauline'S Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Alternate layers of bananas oranges pineapple grapes and coconut in a bowl. Sprinkle with sugar. Chill. Add maraschino cherries just before serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Olive-Nut Spread
instructions: Stir all ingredients until well mixed. Use for open-faced sandwiches for teas and ladies functions.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine ingredients. Drop cookies on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Dorito Chicken
instructions: Crush Doritos and spread over the bottom of a 2 quart glass pan. Mix chicken sour cream chili powder salt garlic powder and white pepper and place on Doritos. Crush more Doritos on top and add cheese on top. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar butter and nutmeg until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in bananas and vanilla. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Beat into creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in nuts. Spread batter in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on rack. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Overnight Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges reserving juices. Place juices in a saucepan with lemon juice and water; stir in pudding mix. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Remove from heat. Cool. Add pineapple oranges and marshmallows. Fold in whipped topping. Chill overnight. Just before serving fold in banana.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Put small amount of oil in frying pan. Smash beans and cumin together and simmer until well blended. Put in 9-inch pie pan. Layer picante sauce then cheese. Top with lettuce tomato and onion. Dip with tortilla chips.

title: Picnic Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp saving drippings. Remove bacon from pan. Crumble and set aside. Cook onion in drippings until tender. Combine with beans brown sugar mustard catsup and Worcestershire sauce.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Blend sugar and flour together. Add eggs. Mix well adding vanilla last. Place rhubarb in pie shell. Pour egg mixture over rhubarb. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Drain fruit. Blend Cool Whip and pudding. Fold in drained fruit and marshmallows.

title: Chicken Yum Yum
instructions: Melt margarine in medium-size roaster. Season chicken with salt and pepper to taste (black or red pepper). Add to cut up fryer. Place in margarine. Add the soup mix. Stir around. Add 2 1/4 cups water. Wash rice and add to mixture. Cover with lid and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Alabama Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add other ingredients; mix well. Knead and roll out (about 1/2-inch thick) on floured board. Cut biscuits butter tops and place one on top of the other. Let rise 30 minutes and bake at 450\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: No Bake Soda Cracker Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl combine cracker crumbs and coconut; set aside. In a pan bring to a boil the white sugar and milk. Boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter; mix well. Pour over cracker mixture; mix well. Drop by teaspoons on wax paper. Let stand. Nuts may be added if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes in water until soft. Mix all ingredients except sugar and potatoes. Mash potatoes and sugar together. Add to flour mixture. Roll on floured board and cut into biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In large skillet cook onion in hot oil. Add meat and garlic; brown lightly. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove bay leaf and serve over hot spaghetti.

title: Soap Making - Soft Lye Soap
instructions: Soap Making To clarify fat melt and add a few slices raw potatoes letting them get a golden brown and the grease to bubble. When this is done strain through a cloth into a jar or lard pail.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Thinly slice steak across grain into bite size strips. Combine flour and sour cream. Stir in bouillon granules 1/2 cup water and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Set aside.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in crock-pot. Mix sour cream and flour. Add soup and mushrooms. Pour over chicken breasts. Cook for 6 hours on low heat. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain frozen chopped broccoli. In skillet melt oleo and saute onion. Add mushroom soup and garlic cheese and melt. Add cooked broccoli and mix. Place in casserole and spread with slivered almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender. Blend until smooth. Store in refrigerator. It will keep several weeks.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and bell pepper. Put in crock-pot. Add cheeses olives and chiles. Put on low until everything is melted.

title: Mocha Brownie Cake
instructions: Combine butter 1 cup sugar and coffee until light. Beat in eggs. Stir in syrup until well blended; combine flour baking powder and salt. Fold flour mixture into batter until blended. Stir in 1 cup nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured pan. Combine remaining sugar and nuts. Sprinkle evenly over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until sides pull away from pan. Garnish with whipped cream orange slices nuts and mint leaves.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Salad
instructions: Blend mayonnaise with milk. Combine remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly with dressing. Chill.

title: Neens Banana Nut Bread(Makes 2 Large Loaves)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mash bananas. Add remaining ingredients one at a time in order. Mix well. Spoon into 2 large greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Remove from pan and let cool slightly. Put in Ziploc bag until outer crust is moist.

title: German Sausage Scramble
instructions: Brown sausage lightly in heated skillet. Remove excess fat and reduce heat to medium. Add onion. Simmer 5 minutes. Add potatoes seasonings and sour cream. Stir until potatoes are brown. Add more sour cream if desired.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve over Chinese noodles.

title: Gingersnap Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream the shortening and sugar. Beat in egg and molasses. Combine flour baking soda ginger cinnamon and salt. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Roll teaspoonful of dough into balls. Place with sugar side up on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown and crinkly. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Heat milk in double boiler. In a large mixing bowl beat egg yolks and sugar. Beat egg whites and add gradually to yolk and sugar mix. Beat thoroughly. Add about 3 cups of milk to mixture. Beat. Add to hot milk. Cook and stir until foam disappears or mixture thickens (this will take quite a while). Add flavoring after removing from heat. Refrigerate. Recipe may be halved.

title: Michigan Blueberry Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan combine 2 cups of the blueberries with sugars flour butter lemon juice nutmeg and salt. Over low heat cook mixture stirring until it comes to boil and is thickened. Cool and stir in remaining berries. Turn filling into prepared pie crust and top with whipped cream flavored with 1 tablespoon sugar and vanilla. Chill until ready to serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Joyce'S Apple Cake
instructions: Melt butter and add sugar and eggs. Beat together. Add flour and spices; mix well. Add apples raisins and nuts. Bake in greased and floured large loaf pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or in 2 small loaf pans at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Bake ahead and freeze.

title: Baked Cabbage
instructions: Place shredded cabbage in casserole. Mix flour and sugar. Combine with cream and pepper. Pour over cabbage. Cover cabbage with bacon slices (uncooked). Bake 40 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 in covered dish. Remove cover for a few minutes to crisp.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Balls
instructions: In saucepan saute onion flakes and basil in olive oil. Add tomato sauce or paste; stir well. Add salt tomatoes and water; stir well. Cook for about 1 hour.

title: No Bake Pie
instructions: Mix well. Put in pie crust and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cream Cheese Noodles
instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven combine water bouillon and spices. Bring them to a boil. Add mushrooms and boil 5 minutes. Add noodles to boiling stock and cook according to package directions plus 2 or 3 minutes. Drain stock retaining 1 cup. Return noodles to pot and add cream cheese and margarine. Stir over low heat until cheese is melted adding enough stock to keep everything damp to wet. (Serve immediately.)

title: Peanut Patties
instructions: Mix sugar syrup cream and peanuts together. Cook for 1 hr over very low heat. Stir occasionally to keep from scorching. Add vanilla and red food color (as desired). Beat until creamy and spoon out on wax paper to form patties.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute butter celery green pepper and onion. Put in casserole dish. Pull meat from the bone. Dice and place in casserole dish. Then add rice and mushroom soup. Mix altogether. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Cream the butter cream cheese and powdered sugar; set aside. Mix milk and pudding. Add creamed mixture to pudding. Stir in a large tub of Cool Whip. Crush 1/2 package of Oreos and sprinkle on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour pudding over Oreos. Crush the other 1/2 package of Oreos and sprinkle on top. Refrigerate.

title: Smoked Beef Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in oven until heated through. Serve warm or cold with crackers.

title: Red Cinnamon Pickles
instructions: Peel and seed cucumbers (remove seeds with spoon). Cut into rings or strips. Soak in 1 cup lime and 1 gallon water for 24 hours. Drain and wash; soak in water for 3 hours. Drain and mix 1 cup vinegar 1 bottle red food coloring 2 tablespoons alum and enough water to cover cucumbers. Simmer for 2 hours; drain. Bring to a boil 2 cups vinegar 2 cups of water 10 cups sugar 8 cinnamon sticks and 1 pack red hots. Pour over cucumbers and let stand 24 hours. Drain again and save liquid. Bring liquid to boil and pour over cucumbers. Leave for 24 hours. Drain again and keep liquid. Place cucumbers in jars. Bring liquid to boil and pour over cucumbers and seal.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Chop green onions and mix with softened cream cheese and sour cream.

title: One Dish Meal
instructions: Layer hamburger in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Place sliced potatoes around on top of hamburger. Sprinkle vegetables over the potatoes. Add mushroom soup plus 1 can water. Add salt pepper and onion salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Twenty minutes before 1 hour is up add cheese to cover and let melt.

title: Cheddar Potato Casserole
instructions: In a separate bowl mix soup milk sour cream and onion. In greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish layer cooked potatoes first then 1/2 cheese then potatoes. Pour soup mixture over layers; top with the rest of the cheese crunched up corn flakes and melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until bubbling in the middle.

title: Cow Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients and drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Feeds many cowpokes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Cube angel food cake enough to not quite fill the whole 9 x 13 pan. Set aside. Beat cream cheese sour cream and Cool Whip until blended. Fold in cubed angel food cake. Spread evenly into the 9 x 13 pan. Add fruit filling on top. Top with nuts if desired. Refrigerate.

title: Cracker Cake
instructions: Add crumbs shortening 1 cup sugar and 3 egg yolks; beat together. Alternate this with 1 cup milk. Fold in 3 egg whites. Bake in layers. Mix in saucepan milk 1 cup sugar 3 egg yolks and butter. Cook until thick. Add vanilla and spread over baked cake.

title: Mock Chop Suey
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and celery. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Heat to bubbling. Serve over noodles. (If celery is omitted add another onion.) Excellent served with carrots and Chinese style rice.

title: Traditional Chex Party Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Heat butter in large shallow roasting pan in oven until melted. Remove; stir in seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add cereals nuts and pretzels. Mix until all pieces are coated. Heat in oven 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on absorbent paper to cool. Makes about 9 cups. Party mix may be frozen.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. (Use toothpick test.)

title: Flatbread
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients and shortening until fine like cornmeal. Then add cold water and mix. Take about a tablespoon of dough and roll out very thin on a well floured board. Bake flatbread on top of an electric grill until crisp. This is delicious.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Chop chilies. Mix with soup. Melt cheese in double boiler or microwave. Mix all together. Serve warm with chips.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: *If using self-rising flour omit the baking powder.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Use food grinder. Peel pears; hard pears are good for this. Combine all ingredients and cook until pears are tender. Seal in sterile jars.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix and pour into buttered baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add topping and bake 5 to 10 minutes longer.

title: Pineapple Whip
instructions: Bring pineapple and sugar to a boil. Dissolve gelatine in cold water; stir into pineapple mixture. Place in refrigerator until it begins to thicken then stir in whipped cream cherries and nuts.

title: Friend Of A Friend'S Chicken
instructions: Combine canned soups and milk; put rice in bottom of greased casserole. Spoon soup mixture over rice.

title: Broccoli-Cheddar Soup(This Will Serve 6 To 8 People)
instructions: Place stock pureed onion celery garlic and broccoli together and boil. Cook until the broccoli is tender. Prepare roux (butter and flour) and cook for 10 minutes. Add the roux gradually to the simmering stock. Stir with a whip until it thickens. Cook low for an additional 10 minutes. This can be stopped at this point if you want. Add the cream and Cheddar Cheese to the hot soup a little at a time until the cheese has melted in. Add salt and pepper last.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and slice onions. Cut peppers fine. Mix with salt and put cracked ice in it. Let stand in the refrigerator for 3 hours. Drain thoroughly.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Place all ingredients except soda in heavy pan; bring to boil. Cook approximately 7 minutes (hard crack in cold water). Remove from heat stir in soda pour immediately onto greased cookie sheet. When cool break into pieces.

title: Pistachio Pudding
instructions: Mix Cool Whip pineapple and juice together. Stir in dry pudding then stir in miniature marshmallows. Chill. Ready to serve.

title: Sweet And Sour Amish Dressing
instructions: Blend in blender. Put in jar with 1 clove garlic. Will keep indefinitely.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Add dry yeast to water; mix with buttermilk. Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening then add the milk mixture. Knead slightly and roll out. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 450\u00b0. Do not let stand to rise as other rolls. May be kept in refrigerator several days in covered container. Pinch off cut and bake as needed.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Cook sugar milk salt and butter until it forms a soft ball when a little is dropped into a cup of cold water. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and vanilla and beat. Pour into a well buttered platter.

title: Sensibly Delicious Chocolate Chip Brownies
instructions: Melt 1/2 of the chips with sugar butter and applesauce in saucepan. Take off heat. Add egg whites. Add dry ingredients and vanilla. Add rest of chips. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. (Only 6 grams of fat in each square.)

title: Layered Refried Beans
instructions: Put all ingredients in order into a large casserole. Put second 1/2 of picante sauce before corn chips. Put into refrigerator before serving.

title: Melting Dreams
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients. Blend in the margarine. Use hands if necessary and mix until smooth. Shape into small balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet; flatten with a fork. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until the edges are lightly browned.

title: Della Mae'S Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Bring broth and soup mix to a boil. Break biscuits into small pieces and drop into hot broth. Cook until biscuit pieces are tender (about 10 minutes). Add pepper.

title: Breakfast In A Biscuit
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spray muffin pan with vegetable spray. Open one tin of biscuits and press each biscuit into one cup of the muffin tin. In small skillet spray vegetable spray. Beat eggs and add salt and pepper; scramble. Place 1 Tbsp. scrambled eggs on each biscuit. Divide cheese ham and salsa evenly over eggs. Open second tin of biscuits and press over top of salsa mixture. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Corn And Shrimp Soup
instructions: Heat butter and add flour. Make a medium brown roux. Add onion and saute until done. Add remaining ingredients except green onions and parsley. Let simmer 1 hour. Add water for desired consistency. Add green onions and parsley. Simmer 15 minutes then serve.

title: Batter Fried Fish
instructions: Break egg into 1-quart bowl. Beat slightly. Add milk. Stir. In separate container combine cornmeal baking powder and salt then add to milk-egg mixture while stirring. Add 1 tablespoon oil. Stir. Add enough flour to form a thin batter (about 1 cup). Cut fish into approximate 2-inch squares. Salt to taste. Preheat oil in deep fryer. Test by dropping 1-inch cube of bread into oil. Cube should brown to golden in few seconds. Dip fish in flour then into batter. Fry in deep fat until golden brown. Dont overcook. Fry only 3 or 4 pieces at a time. Drain on paper towels. Be ready to serve at once.

title: Chicken  Breast Supreme
instructions: For each serving use a chicken breast. Remove skin. Dip chicken breast in the soup that has been diluted with milk. Press into the stuffing mix to which you have added the onions and parsley flakes. Place coated chicken in shallow baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in water and cool. Cream oleo and sugar. Beat in egg yolks. Stir in vanilla and chocolate. Mix flour soda salt. Beat in flour mixture alternating with buttermilk. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form and fold into batter. Pour batter into three 9-inch layer pans that is lined on bottom with waxed paper. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed in center. Cool 15 minutes. Remove and place on racks.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage in 1/8 wedges and cook in boiling salted water for 8 minutes. Put drained cabbage in greased baking dish. Melt oleo in saucepan and blend in cornstarch. Add milk salt and pepper. Cook until mixture thickens. Pour this white sauce over cabbage. Top with pepper rings and the cheese and cover top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until crumbs are brown.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Wash and break up broccoli. Toss in peanuts bacon (fried and crumbed) and onion. Mix sugar mayonnaise and curry. Right before serving toss in dressing.

title: Soup(Simple, But Great Chicken Soup)
instructions: Cover chicken with water boil and spoon off scum that will rise. Cook 1 more hour. Pull chicken from the bone. Put back in broth with carrots celery onion and allspice. Cook 1/2 hour. Remove allspice before eating. Serves 4.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Grate cheeses and mix well with pimentos. Add mayonnaise to desired consistency. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Potato Dumplings
instructions: Mash potatoes well in egg and 1 cup flour. Drop into broth by\ttablespoonfuls\t(chicken beef and pork broth). Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. These are very good and quick.

title: Fruit-Stuffed Pork Loin
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Open pork flat on work surface. Season with salt and pepper; rub in next 2 ingredients. Combine scallions bread crumbs fruit and 1/4 cup apple juice. Spread over pork. Roll and tie to secure. Place in rack set in roasting pan; add juice to pan. Roast 35 minutes. Bring preserves and pan juices to a boil. Pour over pork. Roast 15 minutes or until thermometer reads 160\u00b0. Yields 12 servings.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients together in mixing bowl and beat lightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. May be baked in 2 pans and stacked or in 1 long pan.

title: New West Chicken Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine mayonnaise ginger and salt. Stir in chicken grapes celery green onions and walnuts. Cover; chill before serving.

title: Steamed Dilled Carrots(Serves 3)
instructions: Bring 1 inch of water in a medium saucepan to a boil. Place carrots in a steaming basket and set the basket in the pan. Sprinkle the dill over carrots. Cover and steam until carrots are tender about 10 minutes. Place carrots in a bowl and toss with the vinegar and juice concentrate.

title: Sesame Chicken Wings
instructions: Remove tips of chicken wings; freeze for making soup. Bend each wing at the joint; cut into 2 sections. Combine sesame seed bread crumbs paprika and salt in a shallow dish. Dip chicken pieces in cream using a brush to coat completely; roll in crumb mixture. Refrigerate at least 1 hour to set the crumb coating. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in the oven while it preheats to moderate (375\u00b0). Remove pan from oven when butter is melted. Add chicken; turn to coat all over. Bake in preheated moderate oven for 40 minutes or until golden and tender. Serve with bottled duck sauce.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: In a square pan layer bottom with cream cheese. Next layer 1 jar of salsa. Next add Hormel chili. Spread evenly and top with shredded cheese. Place in oven until cheese is bubbly and toasty. Serve with nacho chips. Its quick and delicious!

title: Thrifty Punch
instructions: Mix cherry drink with sugar and juices in a 6-quart punch bowl. Add water and stir well. Just before serving add chilled ginger ale. Yields 25 servings.

title: Ham And Potatoes
instructions: Mix soup and milk. Layer ham potatoes and onions. Pour soup mixture over ham potatoes and onion mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until potatoes and ham are done.

title: Jezebel Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients and stir well. Store in refrigerator. Serve over cream cheese as an appetizer or with pork or beef. This sauce is great to make ahead of time because it keeps for weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Boil sliced carrots until tender. Cool and drain. Layer in a non-metal bowl with sliced onion. Heat together remaining ingredients. Pour over carrots and onions. Marinate overnight stirring several times.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all together and roll out real thin. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Cut tortillas into strips. Put chicken in large pot; cover with water. Cook until done. Save chicken broth. Cut chicken into small pieces. Mix soups cheese and tomatoes. Dip tortilla strips into chicken broth and layer chicken tortillas and sauce; repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with grated Cheddar cheese and corn flakes or potato chip crumbs. Bake for an additional 15 minutes or until cheese melts. Make this the day or night before. Serves 10.

title: Sonny'S Favorite Chicken Dressing
instructions: Boil hen in 3 quarts salted water until tender. Remove from broth set chicken aside and reserve broth. Take corn meal and salt add water until slightly soupy. Generously grease iron skillet. Add mixture and bake in 400\u00b0 oven until light brown and crusty. Add to broth and allow to sit awhile to absorb broth. Boil onions and celery in water with 2 tablespoons of margarine. Cook until onions and celery are clear and tender. Add all to chicken broth crumble crackers finely and add to broth mix. Beat eggs until frothy and add slowly to broth mix to prevent quick cooking of eggs. Salt and pepper to taste. Use potato masher to make mixture soft and slightly soupy (may add canned broth) and without lumps. Grease well one large baking pan or 2 large casserole dishes. Pour in mixture then add corn oil to top for browning. Cook in hot oven (approximately 400\u00b0) until brown but soft in center. Best served hot.

title: Caramel Pecan Pie
instructions: Place caramels water and butter in double boiler. Heat until melted stirring until smooth. Combine sugar salt eggs and vanilla. Mix well; add to caramel sauce and pecans. Stir well. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Spice Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 12 muffin cups or line them with paper baking cups. In a large bowl cream the butter with the sugars and cinnamon until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs. In a small bowl sift flour baking soda and salt together. In a separate bowl combine the coffee milk and vanilla. Blend the liquid ingredients into the flour and butter mixture. Fill muffin tins and bake for about 25 to 35 minutes. Cool briefly on wire rack. Serve warm with butter. Makes 12 servings.

title: White Flour Pancakes
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients - mix in all others. Heat griddle until hot. Drop pat of butter to grease pan. Add 2 -3 Tblsp. Mix onto pan making shapes or circles. Cook until golden brown and flip over once. Makes approx. 12.

title: Bavarian-Style Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl. Add Crisco chocolate and 2/3 cup milk. Blend for 30 seconds then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs rest of milk and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Spread batter in long cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Rum Pie
instructions: Scald milk in double boiler. Add beaten egg yolks and 1/3 cup sugar.\tCook over boiling water until spoons coated. Remove from heat and add Knox gelatine; stir until dissolved.

title: Chicken Spaghetti Dinner
instructions: Put chicken in Dutch oven; add salt and cover with water. Cook until tender; cool and remove from bone. Add ingredients through salt and pepper; simmer 20 minutes. Add boxes of cut spaghetti and cook until tender. Remove from heat and add 1/2 of grated Mozzarella cheese; mix very lightly. Add more water if needed. Top with remaining cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar oil and eggs well. Mix cocoa coloring and vinegar. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well. Cook for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool.

title: Low-Fat Mac And Cheese
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions; drain. In a large bowl combine pasta with cheese onion pimentos black and cayenne peppers sour cream and mayonnaise. Spoon into a lightly oiled 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven 40 to 45 minutes or until heated through.

title: White Chili
instructions: Rinse beans. Place in kettle and cover with water. Soak at least 24 hours. Drain. Cut chicken into pieces and put in a pot. Cover with at least 5 cups water. Bring to a simmer and cook until tender about 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Victoria
instructions: Saute shrimp and onion in margarine for 5 to 10 minutes or until shrimp are pink and tender. Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes more. Sprinkle in flour salt and pepper. Stir in sour cream and cook on low heat for 10 minutes or until thick. Be careful that mixture does not come to a boil. Serve over rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cherry Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually work in sugar until mixture is smooth and light. Beat in egg yolks; sift cake flour over cherries pineapple and nuts. Toss with hands until fruit and nuts are well coated with flour. Stir floured mixture into creamy mixture and add extract. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold them into batter thoroughly but gently pour batter into well oiled 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 3/4 hours or until done. Cool on wire rack about 10 minutes then remove from pan. Cool cake completely before slicing. Can be frozen.

title: Debbie Rogers Baked Beans
instructions: Brown bacon and onions together. Mix with all other ingredients then pour into crock-pot and cook all day on LOW heat.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Oil pizza pan lightly. Cut dough in 1/8-inch slices. Place in pizza pan to cover bottom of pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes; cool. Blend cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Spread over cookie crust. Add fruit in order in circular arrangement. Make glaze of preserves and water. Dob glaze over fruit with spoon. Chill until ready to serve; be sure to glaze the bananas!

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix together; shape into balls (walnut size). Chill 3 to 4 hours. Dip into melted chocolate.

title: Poached Fish
instructions: Place all ingredients except peppercorn and lapu-lapu into a saucepan. Bring to a boil and allow to simmer for 1 hour. Add peppercorns and allow to simmer for 10 minutes more. Pass through a food mill or a fine strainer. Place clean and dry lapu-lapu or other white meat fish in tepid court bouillon and bring to a boil. Lower flame and allow to simmer until fish is cooked. May be served with Hollandaise sauce or mock Hollandaise sauce.

title: Tennessee Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease a regular loaf pan or 4 small mini pans. Sift together flour baking powder soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. In a medium bowl cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Stir in pumpkin. Stir in dry ingredients in 4 additions alternately with water (3 additions) just until smooth. Do not overbeat. Fold in nuts. Turn batter into prepared pans. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven until cake tester comes out clean 45 to 55 minutes or 30 to 40 minutes. Turn out on a wire rack right side up. Store tightly covered.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Drain pork and beans saving the liquid in a skillet. Brown bacon beef and onion. Combine all three beans with browned meat. Combine all of the rest and pour beans and meat in a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix together pistachio pudding and crushed pineapple. Add marshmallows pecans and Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

title: Spiced Oatmeal
instructions: Bring 3 cups water to rapid boil; add oatmeal. While oatmeal is cooking add coconut. Remove from burner and add butter and brown sugar. Serve with hot buttered toast. Serves 6.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Mix broken pieces of Hershey bars chips vanilla marshmallow cream and margarine in a 6 to 8-quart pan. Set aside. Mix sugar and milk in a 4 to 6-quart pan. Boil and cook for 6 1/2 minutes. Pour the cooked sugar and milk over first mixture and blend. Add chopped pecans. Drop balls onto waxed paper. Let stand for 4 to 6 hours or until chilled. Remove from paper and store. Makes 6 pounds.

title: Collard Greens And Turkey Wings
instructions: Soak and wash collard greens. Remove all grit. Remove hard stems. Place greens together in small bunches. Roll together. Cut crosswise into wide strips. Place greens water onion and turkey wings in large pan. Season with sugar pepper garlic and salt substitute seasoning. Cook until greens are soft and tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach. Mix all of the ingredients together except the bread. Refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours before serving. Hollow out the center of the bread and pour dip into it. Break up hollowed-out bread for dipping. Add raw vegetables breadsticks and more bread for dipping.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Combine chili cheese and chilies in a saucepan or fondue pot. Heat over medium-low stirring frequently until the cheese melts. Serve warm with tortilla chips. Yields 12 servings.

title: Skillet Beef Noodles
instructions: Brown beef in electric skillet. Drain off any excess grease; add tomatoes onion soup mix salt pepper oregano sugar and mustard. Mix well and add uncooked noodles; simmer for 20 minutes. Add whole kernel corn. Stir and heat for 5 more minutes.

title: Coffee Swirl Cake
instructions: Grease tube pan. Mix brown sugar cinnamon and pecans together. Put 1/2 of nut mixture in pan. Mix cake mix instant pudding water and oil together. Add eggs 1 at a time. Beat well. Put 1/2 of cake mixture in pan. Add other 1/2 of nut mixture then add other 1/2 of cake mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Mix butter and brown sugar together with hands; add flour and mix some more. Shape into balls and prick with a fork about 1/4-inch thick. Bake 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream oleo gradually. Add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add bananas and mix until smooth. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture stirring just enough to moisten. Stir in chopped pecans and raisins. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan at 350 degrees for one hour. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove to wire rack to completely cool. Makes 1 large and 1 small loaf. This freezes well. (Good for muffins too.)

title: California Dip For Vegetables Or Chips
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Flavor is better if made the day before using. Keeps up to 3 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine. Add other ingredients in order given. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 7-Layer Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients and enjoy.

title: Dietetic Fruit Cake
instructions: Add oil to applesauce and egg. Add sweetener. Sift dry ingredients together. Add lemon and orange rinds. Add fruit and nuts to dry ingredients. Add applesauce mixture. Mix well. Cook in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Soup Burger Skillet Meal
instructions: In a large skillet brown chopped hamburger and drain. Add soup and beans and simmer until hot. Spoon onto buns as a sandwich or open face as a meal. Serves 4.

title: Charlie'S Peanut Brittle
instructions: Butter 2 baking sheets each 15 1/2 x 12 inches; keep warm. Combine soda 1 teaspoon water and the vanilla; set aside.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Put apples in pan with sugar cinnamon and water; cook 10 minutes. Pour into greased baking dish. Cream butter and brown sugar. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Pat on top of apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook on medium heat in saucepan until bubbly thick. Continue to cook and use mixer to smooth mixture. Pour in cooked pie shell. Top with meringue when cool.

title: Nut Cake
instructions: Flour pecans and soak in one bottle of black walnut flavoring. Cream butter Crisco and sugar. Add 1 egg at a time. Add all other ingredients. Grease and flour a tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: No Bake Date Crunch Bars
instructions: Grease a 9 x 9-inch pan with butter or margarine. Dust with powdered sugar. Boil butter sugar and dates together 5 minutes. Stir constantly. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour over Rice Krispies in a large buttered bowl. Mix. Spread in pan. Dust with more powdered sugar. Cut when cool.

title: Lou'S Sherried Chicken
instructions: Bone breasts of chicken leaving the skin on. Cut breasts in half making 6 pieces. Form each piece into a ball with skin stretched over ball. Arrange in baking dish. Place in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Combine cream of mushroom soup sherry and paprika. Use the can to measure out a half can of sherry. Blend well. Add paprika until mixture is red. Remove chicken from oven after 30 minutes. Remove skin from chicken and drain off liquid. Spoon mixture over chicken. Use all the mixture. Return to oven for an additional 30 minutes. Serve with rice and vegetables. Serves 3 to 6.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together by hand. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar over pie. Cover edges of crust with foil while baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Beans(Microwave)
instructions: Combine onion green pepper and bacon in a 1-quart casserole. Microwave until done. Drain off grease if you wish. Add remaining ingredients and microwave on High until bubbly.

title: Freezer Sweet Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumber slices onion and salt well and let stand 2 hours. Drain; do not rinse. Mix sugar with vinegar stir well and pour over cucumber slices. Put in containers and freeze.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in ice cream freezer. Fill 2 or 3 inches from the top of freezer.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into an unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool and top with whipped cream or ice cream if desired.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; debone. Prepare stuffing as directed on box. Layer chicken and stuffing mix in baking dish. Cover with cream of chicken soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for half hour or until heated through.

title: Homemade Pastrami
instructions: Trim excess outside covering of fat from brisket. Barely cover meat with cold water. Add garlic bay leaves and red peppers. Cover pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 30 minutes to the pound or until meat is tender but still firm. Lift meat from liquid to shallow baking pan. Brush both sides lightly with liquid smoke. Pound or crush whole spices together in mortar until medium fine. Pat onto both sides of meat.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in shortening. Add corn beaten eggs and corn muffin mix. Stir. Pour into baking dish. Mix sour cream and grated cheese and spoon over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35-40 minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
instructions: Place raisins in pan and cover with water. Bring to a boil; simmer 10 minutes. Take off heat and let cool. Should be only a little water left in pan. Keep it; do not drain.

title: Marsala Breast Of Chicken
instructions: Mix. flour with pepper and paprika and lightly dust chicken breasts. Melt butter in hot skillet. Saute chicken gently over low heat until golden on both sides and juices run clear. Remove to platter and keep warm in 200\u00b0 oven. Pour wine into skillet scraping brown bits into wine. Add mushrooms and cook until wine is reduced by 1/2. Pour sauce over chicken and sprinkle with parsley. Serves 2.

title: Won Ton
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients. Mix well. Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of the wrappers using a small amount of water to seal the edges. Fold into triangle and then deep fry until golden brown. Yield 80 to 90 pieces.

title: Chocolate Cream Cupcakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 18 muffin cups with paper liners. In a small bowl combine cream cheese 1/3 cup sugar and egg. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips. Set aside.

title: Creamy Pesto Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix pesto and salad dressing until well blended. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Scalloped Asparagus
instructions: Melt 4 tablespoons butter and stir in flour salt and pepper to make a smooth paste.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Mix all ingredients (do not cook meat) in a large mixing bowl. After mixing pour into prepared baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Caramel-Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet; add coconut and 1/2 cup pecans. Cook until golden stirring frequently. Set aside and let cool slightly. Combine cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk; beat at medium until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Layer 1/4 of cream cheese mixture in each pie shell. Drizzle 1/4 of caramel topping over each pie. Sprinkle 1/4 coconut mixture evenly on each pie. (Repeat layers cream cheese caramel and coconut.) Cover and freeze at least 8 hours. Let frozen pies stand at room temperature 5 minutes before serving. Makes 2 pies.

title: Shrimp Chowder
instructions: Cook onion in butter in a large saucepan over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes until tender. Add water and bring to a boil. Add shrimp and cook for 3 to 5 minutes until no longer translucent in center. Remove shrimp to a bowl with slotted spoon. Add potatoes salt and pepper to saucepan. Simmer for 4 to 6 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add milk and half and half. Bring just to a boil stirring occasionally. Turn off heat; stir in cheese and parsley. Let stand for 2 minutes until cheese melts. Stir in shrimp and serve.

title: Baked Beans(Great For A Barbecue!)
instructions: Brown beef in a large skillet. Drain grease and add seasonings. Saute until wilted. Add mustard ketchup and barbecue sauce; mix well. Add beans and pour into casserole dish. Lay bacon slices on top and bake at 325 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground meat with chopped onion. Stir to separate meat particles. Add soup mustard ketchup and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes. Spoon onto 8 split toasted buns.

title: Cooked Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage into quarters. Place in a large skillet with tight fitting lid. Add rest of ingredients. Place on stove and cook until tender with lid on to retain steam. Turn cabbage a couple of times.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together and bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Pound boneless chicken very thin. In one bowl mix eggs and a little milk. In another bowl mix breadcrumbs salt pepper and seasonings. Pour Wesson oil in frying pan and heat. Dip chicken into egg mix and then breadcrumbs mix. Cook in oil until chicken is done. Layer in baking dish. Top with spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar butter and egg yellows. Sift flour and soda together; beat together. Add sour cream; add vanilla. Add stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in greased baking dish. Let sit while preparing topping.

title: Hot Pepper Pecans
instructions: For each cup of large pecans melt 2 tablespoons of butter in shallow pan. Spread evenly in bottom of pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir several times. Mix 2 teaspoons soy sauce 1/2 teaspoon salt and 3 or 4 dashes of Tabasco sauce into the toasted nuts. Pack into jars with tight lids. Will keep 4 to 5 weeks if tightly covered.

title: Eggplant Dip
instructions: Place 3 whole unpeeled eggplants in the oven on a cookie sheet. Bake for 1 hour at 450\u00b0. Remove and peel; chop into cubes. Place chopped eggplant in a large bowl. Soak in a mixture of lemon juice water and salt for 20 to 30 minutes. Then place the eggplant cubes into a blender with onion and salt and pepper to taste; blend well. Place dip on a plate or low bowl and decorate with black olives and parsley. (This is a great dip for vegetables.)

title: White Bread
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour sugar salt and yeast. Blend well. Heat water and shortening (to 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add water mixture to flour mixture. Blend at low speed then medium speed for 3 minutes. Stir in remaining flour until soft and pliable. Knead 5 to 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl. Cover with clean cloth and let dough rise until doubled (1 to 1 1/2 hours). Punch down dough removing all air bubbles. Divide in half. Shape into 2 loaves. Place in greased bread loaf pans. Rise until dough is 1-inch above edge of pan.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: The cherries and pineapple are candied fruits.

title: Grandma'S Fudge Cake
instructions: Separate eggs. Cream together margarine egg yolks and sugar. Add chocolate milk and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and salt. Fold in 2 stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into two greased 9-inch layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Bake slightly longer if using 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan. Frost with white icing.

title: Brownies For A Crowd
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts. Stir by hand. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased and floured). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with nuts before baking.

title: English Muffins
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/2 cup warm water (110\u00b0). Combine milk sugar salt and shortening; cool to lukewarm. Stir in 2 cups flour; beat well. Add yeast and mix. Add enough remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough. Turn out on a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth (8 to 10 minutes). Place in greased bowl turning once.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Dissolve sugar and yeast in lukewarm water; add milk shortening and salt. Mix. Stir in flour (it may be necessary to add a little more flour to make the dough more easy to knead). Cover and let rise for 1 hour. Put by tablespoons into ungreased muffin tins (do not fill over 1/2) or you can put in baking pans and have them connected together. Let rise 30 minutes. Brush tops with butter and bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Orpha Snowden'S Quickie Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in a pan and add fruit. Mix thoroughly the flour milk and sugar. Pour over the fruit and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown. I always add a little sugar to the fruit.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs. Place in a greased casserole. Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 until bread crumbs are browned.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Stir melted margarine and brown sugar together. Add egg and vanilla to margarine mixture and stir. Add flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Stir together. Add chocolate chips. Bake in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool before slicing.

title: Chicken Balls
instructions: Cut up chicken in small chunks and fry. In small mix cream cheese butter Lawrys and garlic salt until the cream cheese is real soft. Add cooked chicken. Roll in crescent rolls. Bake about 20 minutes. Makes about 16 chicken balls.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Combine the first six ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender. Meanwhile in a saucepan melt butter and stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to a boil and stir for 2 minutes until thickened.

title: Egg-Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Halve zucchini lengthwise. Scoop out pulp leaving 1/4-inch shell. Chop pulp to make 1 cup; set aside. Place zucchini shells cut side down in large skillet. Add the water and simmer covered until just tender (5 to 6 minutes). Drain; turn cut side up in same skillet. Sprinkle with a little salt. Meanwhile in medium skillet cook zucchini pulp and tomato in butter until squash is tender (about 3 minutes). Add eggs salt and pepper. Cook over low heat until just set lifting with spatula so uncooked portion runs underneath. Spoon egg mixture into zucchini shells. Top with cheese. Cover; heat until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mexican Rice(Serves 4)
instructions: Bring chicken broth to boil. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil for 2 minutes. Add rice; saute for 2 minutes. Add boiling chicken broth cumin and pepper. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add tomato and chives; simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir and set aside (covered) for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pierogi
instructions: Mix together cheese eggs salt and onion. Add flour until batter holds together. Drop spoonfuls of batter into boiling water to which 1 tablespoon salt has been added. Boil 3 minutes. Fry in butter and serve with sour cream.

title: Stuffed Burgers
instructions: Prepare stuffing as directed on package. Combine milk and beef; divide into patties on waxed paper. Pat into 6-inch circles. Put 1/4 cup stuffing in center of each draw meat over stuffing and seal. Place in casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Mix well. Roll in waxed paper. Slice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until slightly brown. Dust with 10x sugar tops and bottoms.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Drain sauerkraut. Chop all ingredients very fine. Mix with wine vinegar and add sugar. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Bring the first 6 ingredients to a boil. Place 1 slice of onion in the bottom of each jar then fill with sliced pickles. Pour hot liquid over pickles and seal. Put jars in hot water and bring to a rolling boil. Remove jars from water. Fills 7 pints.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pielubbock, Texas
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 or 10-inch pie pan.

title: Easy Fudge Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt chocolate and margarine in saucepan over low direct heat. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients to saucepan mixing well. Pour into well-buttered round 9-inch Pyrex dish. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Cut into slices before pie cools. Delicious served hot with vanilla ice cream.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the ginger ale. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Refrigerate or freeze. Add ginger ale when ready to serve.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Prepare pie pan by lining with bottom crust. Break Ritz crackers coarsely into the unbaked crust. In a saucepan combine water sugar and cream of tartar. Boil gently for 15 minutes. Add lemon juice and rind. Cook for about 10 minutes. Pour syrup over crackers. Generously dot with butter or margarine and sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover with top crust. Cut slits in top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 425\u00b0. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped topping. No one will know theres not a lick of \apple\ in your apple pie!

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Heat to boiling then simmer. Stir occasionally. It may thicken.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Tear the romaine lettuce into bite-size pieces. Reserve. Rub salad bowl with clove of garlic. Into salad bowl add the olive oil. Crush the garlic into the olive oil. While whisking constantly break the egg into the salad bowl mixture. When this mixture achieves a smooth consistency very slowly add lemon juice until it has a creamy look. Add 1/2 of the cheese and mix again. At this point add the chopped anchovy filets and 2 tablespoons wine vinegar. Whisk this mixture until smooth. Add lettuce coating well. Add remainder of cheese and top with croutons and artichoke hearts (drained). Serve on chilled plates. Serve with London Broil.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: By hand mix\tall ingredients very thoroughly. The mixture is\tright and ready when the whole piece of meat is gathered in the center of your bowl. Mix and fold until this happens. Form into meatballs the size you prefer.\tCook until brown on both sides in hot oil.\tDrop gently into spaghetti sauce. Let meatballs cook in sauce for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Barbecued Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef in skillet; drain off fat. Drain 1/2 of the juice off kraut. Combine onion and beef mixture kraut tomato sauce and brown sugar. Turn into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Peel peaches and slice. In a large bowl toss peaches 1/2 cup sugar flour lemon juice salt and cinnamon. Pour into glass casserole dish. Dot with butter. Cover with tinfoil and bake in oven at 425\u00b0 until hot and bubbly about 35 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: *If using large package use deep dish pie shell.

title: Master Cake Mix
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and sugar to blend. Stir 3 times. Cut in shortening with pastry blender or electric mixer. Store in covered container at room temperature.

title: Reduced Calorie Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix contents of party dip with sour cream and milk. Mix gently with wire whip or spoon. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving. Perfect dip for chips vegetables or crackers.

title: Creamy Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine crumbs sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add eggs and lemon juice; mix well. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until center is set; top with sour cream. Bake 5 minutes longer. Cool. Chill. Serve with favorite topping. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Berry Crisp
instructions: Toss berries with sugar and flour (enogh to coat). Place the berries in a greased 8-inch square pan. Combine 1 cup flour 1 cup sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in egg. Mix until well blended and crumbly. Sprinkle on top of berries. Pour melted margarine over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream or milk.

title: Hearty Pancakes
instructions: In bowl combine flour oat bran sugar baking powder milk Egg Beaters and margarine. Using scant 1/4 cup for each pancake portion batter onto lightly greased nonstick griddle or skillet. Cook over medium heat turning once to brown both sides. Serve topped with sliced strawberries if desired.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: In casserole dish pour 2 cups rice. Sprinkle with salt. Heat soup in saucepan with 1 can water. Pour half on rice. Place chicken pieces on top. Pour remaining soup over chicken; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until fork-tender.

title: Curried Turkey Salad With Georgia Peach Chutney
instructions: Combine turkey onions chestnuts rice and raisins in a large bowl. Prepare a sauce using remaining ingredients except peanuts. Fold sauce into turkey mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 to 4 hours or overnight to blend flavors. Serve on curly leaf lettuce and garnish with peanuts.

title: Sausage
instructions: Mix together and grind. You can use less black pepper and more cayenne if desired hotter.

title: Window Cleaner
instructions: Put into a spray bottle. Make sure window is totally dry or it will streak.

title: Super Simple Potato Salad
instructions: In an ungreased 3-quart microwave-safe plastic bowl combine frozen hash brown potatoes and water; spread evenly in bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 20 minutes or until potatoes are hot and tender stirring once halfway through cooking time.

title: Cheeseless Cheese Cake
instructions: Place ingredients in blender. Blend well and pour into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Refrigerate until set. Fat free.

title: Low Calorie Onion Soup Dip
instructions: Blend yogurt and cottage cheese in medium bowl; stir in onion soup mix and chili powder. Refrigerate covered for 3 hours. Place on tray with an assortment of crisp vegetables. Yields 2 cups.

title: Surprise Salad
instructions: Boil together first 3 ingredients. Remove from fire and add cold water. Refrigerate. When almost congealed fold in remaining ingredients.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Heat oil. Dip chicken in flour mixture then in egg and brown in oil. Set chicken in baking pan and put a thin slice of lemon on each piece. Mix 1/4 pound stick of margarine 1 MBT packet juice of 1/2 lemon and parsley flakes. Pour mixture over chicken and freeze.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Spray with Pam. Arrange graham crackers with sides touching on cooking sheet.

title: Cracker Ice Box Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine and add sugar milk and egg. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add graham cracker crumbs nuts and coconut. Line a 9x13 inch pan with whole graham crackers. Spread the cooked mixture over the crackers. Add another layer of graham crackers. Make frosting; mix confectioners sugar milk and vanilla. Spread this over final layer of graham crackers. Chill in refrigerator about 3 hours before cutting. (A ready to spread frosting may be used.)

title: Peanut Butter Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and cream in heavy 2 1/2 to 3-quart saucepan; bring to a full rolling boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy thermometer reaches 234\u00b0 stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme nuts and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Cajun Eggs
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and cook to desired wellness.

title: Mam-Maw Mize'S Lemon Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add sugar flour salt lemon juice butter and water. Cook over low heat until thick. Pour into baked crust. Top with meringue. Brown in oven.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients except cracker crumbs and margarine. Pour into a casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Drizzle melted margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This is a good dish for covered dish dinners and can easily be doubled or tripled.

title: Strawberry Pie Filling
instructions: Cook until clear the sugar water and cornstarch. Remove from heat and add jello and some butter. Let this filling cool. Add berries to this. Put in pie shell. Put topping on top such as Cool Whip.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine ground cranberries and sugar and let stand overnight. Drain in mesh sieve and add grapes and chopped nuts. An hour before serving stir in whipped cream.

title: Little Drumsticks
instructions: Marinate little drumsticks from chicken wings overnight. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Do not cover.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients all together and put in greased baking dish (large dish). Top with a layer of crushed corn flakes. Melt oleo and pour over before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Caramel Rolls
instructions: Thaw dough and allow to reach room temperature. Mix brown sugar and cream or milk. Spread into bottoms of two greased (9-inch) round baking pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle half of nuts over the bottom of the pans. Roll dough into 10 x 18-inch rectangle. Spread with butter leaving about 1/2-inch without butter on one 18-inch side. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over dough then sprinkle remaining nuts over the sugar. Roll up like a jelly roll ending with the side that does not have butter on the edge. Pinch to seal the edge. Cut into 1-inch slices and put cut-side down into pans. Cover and let rise until double in size. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overbake or the caramel will harden. Put waxed paper on wire racks and cool rolls with caramel side down. Serve warm or cold. Makes 18 large rolls.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Mix all well. Put into 16 paper lined muffin cups. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Onion Stuffing
instructions: In a large skillet cook onions in butter until soft and slightly golden in color dividing into two batches if necessary.

title: Oreo Ice Cream
instructions: Let ice cream and Cool Whip get to room temperature; mix. Add Oreos. Pour in one or two 9 x 13-inch pans. Freeze and cut into squares later.

title: Canning Jar Bread
instructions: Wash and dry 8 pint size wide mouth canning jars or 5 to 6 wide mouth pint and a half jars. Grease well. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and water. Beat well and add pumpkin. With a spoon add dry ingredients and pecans. Fill jars half full. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes. When done remove one at a time from oven. Put scalded lid on and seal.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Put rice in bottom of 2 1/2-quart casserole. Add sausage celery peppers and onions. Pour can of chicken broth over the top. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add enough milk for spreading consistency. Spread cream cheese on ham slices and roll around dill pickles. Chill. Before serving cut in 1/2-inch slices.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine until tender. Mix all ingredients. Put in casserole dish. Top with crackers and melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown. (Do not overbake.)

title: Chili Conqueso
instructions: Saute chopped peppers onions tomatoes and chili pepper in oil until tender. Add seasonings and cheese; cook slowly until cheese is melted and seasonings are blended. Serve with corn chips.

title: Top Of Stove Pot Roast
instructions: Dredge roast with flour on all sides. Heat a heavy pan or Dutch oven over moderate heat. Brown roast slowly using no fat. When brown place a rack under meat. Add water and white vinegar. Cover and simmer over very low heat until tender. Half an hour before serving add salt pepper and mustard. Blend into juices adding more liquid if desired.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and put in casserole. Cook 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle other half can of noodles over top. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes more. Let stand a few minutes before serving.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed (cool completely). Mix strawberries and strawberry glaze in separate bowl. In separate bowl mix Philly cream cheese and confectioners sugar. After these are blended fold in Cool Whip. Pour Cool Whip mixture evenly over cake then spread strawberry glaze mixture over Cool Whip mixture.

title: Easy Microwave Cheater Lasagne
instructions: In a 2-quart pot brown ground beef separating meat with a fork as it cooks. Add spaghetti sauce water and salt. Heat through. Mix the egg in with the Ricotta cheese.

title: Easy Fettucine
instructions: Cook and stir garlic in oil in skillet on low heat until golden brown. Stir in process cheese spread milk and Parmesan cheese until melted. Add fettucine and mix lightly. Serve immediately.

title: Magic Rainbow Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In a 13 x 9-inch pan melt butter in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour condensed milk over crumbs evenly. Top with nuts and M&Ms. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until light brown. Cool. Chill and store at room temperature.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli 5 minutes and drain. Combine all other ingredients and add broccoli. Bake in a greased casserole at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Layer items in bowl as listed. Pour dressing over layered salad and refrigerate overnight. Toss just before serving. Serves approximately 10.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk cocoa and butter for 2 minutes. Add vanilla peanut butter and oats as soon as you turn the heat off. Stir and drop on waxed paper.

title: Banana-Apricot Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 or so for a glass pan).

title: Salmon Fried Cakes
instructions: Drain salmon liquid into measuring cup and add evaporated milk to measure 2/3 cup liquid. Combine Bisquick mix pepper egg liquid and lemon juice in mixing bowl. Flake and stir in salmon. Stir in onion green pepper parsley celery and dill weed and mix well. Heat about 1-inch of oil in skillet to 365\u00b0. Drop salmon mixture by teaspoon into hot oil and fry 2 to 3 minutes or until golden. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions; drain and reserve 1/2 cup liquid. In skillet simmer onions in margarine. Add flour and Pet milk to onions. Cook until thick. Add cheese chunks and all seasonings. Cook on top of stove until cheese is melted. Add drained spinach and mix well. Put in 8 x 8 casserole dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top (if desired). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Add vinegar soup and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over carrots onion and pepper and let set for 2 hours or more. This will keep for several days.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in the boiling water. Put in blender. Add cream cheese; process to blend thoroughly. Add apricot baby food; blend again. Add Cool Whip and blend. Place in 8 x 8-inch square baking dish. Refrigerate to set.

title: Sally'S Chili
instructions: Cover bottom of Dutch oven with olive oil and meat. Add everything but Masa Hirina. Mix well and simmer 3 1/2 to 4 hours or until meat is tender.

title: The Best Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients and bake for 10 to 15 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients well together. Pour over crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 55 minutes or until set.

title: Kathryn'S Famous Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook in casserole until golden brown about 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Slice apples in pan. Add a little sugar and cinnamon. Mix together to form crumbs the rest of the ingredients. Spread crumbs over top of apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Apricot Chewies
instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar butter and vanilla. Coat apricots that have been cut in small pieces and small pieces of pecans in the flour. Add to egg mixture. Pour in 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch pan that has been greased and floured. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until light brown. Cut in squares and coat in powdered sugar.

title: Lemon Tea Bread
instructions: Beat cream cheese and butter at high speed of electric mixer until creamy. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add to cream cheese mixture alternately with milk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Stir in almonds.

title: Mushroom Beef Stew
instructions: Cut meat into small pieces. Season and boil until tender. add beef stew corn peas potatoes and carrots. Let cook for about 10 to 15 minutes or until tender. Add onion soup mix mushroom pieces and macaroni. Let simmer until it has made a gravy. Season to your taste. Turn off. Let cool.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix milk and pudding. Add sour cream and 2/3 container of Cool Whip (save 1/3 of Cool Whip for topping). Layer wafers bananas and mixture until all used up. Top with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Stuffed Chicken Shells
instructions: Cook shells. Cook chicken breasts and cut into bite-size pieces. Make stuffing and mix chicken into it; stuff shells with mixture. Place in a 9 x 15-inch baking dish. Mix the soups together and pour over shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Place zucchini in strainer and press out as much moisture as possible. Mix with eggs and onion in small bowl. Combine dry ingredients and stir into zucchini-egg mixture. Heat oil on griddle or in skillet over medium heat. Drop dough by tablespoon and brown lightly on both sides. Serve immediately with butter and lemon wedges.

title: Mommie'S Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add egg and mix well. Sift flour before measuring. Sift all dry ingredients together and then add to sugar and egg mixture. Mix in vanilla. Fold in nuts. Turn dough out roughly two equal portions and roll up. Refrigerate dough overnight. Slice dough rolls into 1/4-inch slices and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Makes 2 to 3 dozen cookies.

title: Silver Dollar Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients together except grated cheese. Pour into 3 or 4 qt. casserole dish. Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes. Stir once after 10-15 minutes. When all ingredients are done remove from oven and sprinkle grated cheese on top. May be cooked in microwave oven.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix eggs mayonnaise onion margarine and cheese. Add broccoli. Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish covered. Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. The last 10 minutes put cracker crumbs on top and bake uncovered.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Place in buttered casserole dish. Top with crackers. Drizzle butter over all and bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until onion and celery are tender.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 8 ingredients in order given. Stir in flour until mixture is stiff enough to hold spoon upright. Drop from teaspoon onto greased floured cookie pan. Flatten. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Freeze 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Orange Icebox Cake
instructions: Mix flour salt and sugar well; add milk and heat. Add beaten egg yolks after mixture is hot. Cook until thick then add gelatin which has been softened in orange juice and rind. Let cool. Beat egg whites; add 3 tablespoons sugar. Fold into custard.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Heat sugar in skillet until sugar caramelizes. Add peanuts. Pour onto buttered surface. Stretch and pull candy into thin sheets. Break up into individual pieces.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until slightly tender in salty water. Drain. Cut broccoli into bite size pieces and place in a casserole dish. Mix eggs onion pepper mayonnaise soup and cheese together. Pour over broccoli. Top with dressing. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbling.

title: Chicken Dinner
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Season chicken to taste (I use garlic powder seasoned salt and lemon pepper). Place in a baking dish. Add potatoes carrots bell pepper and onion. Pour the Worcestershire sauce over the chicken. Pour a packet of beef stew seasoning mix over the chicken and vegetables. Pour the stewed tomatoes over the top. Add mushrooms and cover with foil. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender.

title: Twice-Cooked Green Beans
instructions: Heat 1/2-inch water in 12-inch skillet to boiling and add green beans. Heat to boiling then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes until beans are tender-crisp. Drain. Wipe skillet dry. In same skillet heat 2 tablespoons olive oil. Cook beans and 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper. Stir frequently until beans are tender. Remove from heat and stir in soy sauce.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes; peel and dice. Fry bacon until crisp; lay on paper towel to cool. Save bacon grease. Add potatoes to bacon grease; salt and pepper. Add vinegar to this. Crumble and add bacon; add enough flour to make dressing to thicken. Do this while in iron skillet and serve while hot.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
instructions: Combine potatoes with cottage cheese sour cream garlic salt and chives. Place in buttered casserole. Top with grated Cheddar cheese; sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Turkey Chili
instructions: Brown ground turkey onion and green pepper. After browned add garlic powder chili powder cumin oregano chiles whole tomato and juice tomato paste chicken broth and salt. Simmer in slow cooker 2 to 3 hours. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Cinnamon Buns
instructions: Let bread dough raise. Pinch dough in small pieces about the size of a walnut and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt oleo. Mix together with milk pudding light brown sugar and cinnamon and pour over bread pieces. Let rise until double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Layer Tater Tots on bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake as directed on package.

title: Cheese And Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Combine pineapple and marshmallows. Set aside. Combine sugar eggs flour and juice. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Cool and pour over pineapple mixture. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Ornaments
instructions: Mix all ingredients; mix will be dry. Roll out on cookie sheet or wax paper to desired thickness. Cut with cookie cutter or knife into desired shapes. Allow to dry 5 days.

title: Curried Rice And Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Saute onion and butter until yellow. Stir in rice salt pepper and curry powder. Roll 1/2 cup curried rice mixture in each slice of boneless or boiled ham; secure with toothpick. Place in shallow baking dish and cover with foil. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Texas Style Cabbage
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet; cover and cook on medium heat for 10 minutes.

title: Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: I had two excellent reasons to begin making gingerbread cookies my children Jamie and Jessica. They are now 22 and 17 years old but they still want gingerbread cookies at Christmastime!

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Cream cheese and margarine; add sugar and vanilla and blend well.

title: Wesson Oil Cake
instructions: Beat egg yolks with buttermilk vanilla and Wesson oil. Blend self-rising flour and soda. Mix and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mom'S Ham Glaze
instructions: Mix well and pour over ham every 15 minutes. Bake ham at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours to heat through.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square baking pan. Flatten and cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Combine sugar and cinnamon in plastic Ziploc bag. Place pieces of biscuits several at a time into bag and shake until coated. Put into baking pan. Mix remaining sugar and cinnamon butter and water. Pour over biscuits and toss lightly. Bake for 30 minutes. Place plate over pan and flip over. Remove pan carefully.

title: Mexi Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese together. Heat in microwave 3 minutes on High. Add cheese. Serve.

title: Duke'S Dilly Potato Salad
instructions: Wash potatoes and cook in salted water until tender. Place potatoes in a large bowl and add other ingredients. Mix well. Sprinkle with extra dill and serve warm.

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Mix the rhubarb sugar and pineapple together well. Boil for 20 minutes over a medium high heat. Stir in jello powder. Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Oyster Cracker Snack
instructions: Mix in large flat pan. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Store in a tightly closed container.

title: Polish Dump Cake
instructions: Pour cherry pie filling into 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour pineapple over this. Sprinkle dry cake mix over the fruit. Cut margarine into slices and place over mix. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter. Add ground meat and cook until done. Drain well. Combine beef mixture with tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce. Cook on low for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Prepare noodles according to directions on box. Use a large baking dish coated with Pam or margarine. Start with sauce mix and pour 1 to 1 1/2 cups into dish. Next a layer of noodles. Then a layer of cheeses. Continue to layer making sure to finish with sauce being on top. Bake 40 minutes.

title: Buttermilk  Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and half of the milk. Add beaten eggs. Add rest of the milk and stir in melted butter. Add vanilla. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat slightly and bake until knife comes out clean. Yields 2 pies.

title: Garbanzo Bean Soup
instructions: Fry onion garlic and green pepper in olive oil with chorizo sausage and ham until done but not brown. Put all ingredients in beans and cook until done. Very good!

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind all ingredients together; add sugar. The relish is better made a day or two before eaten.

title: Pepper Steak
