instructions: Cut steak into 1-inch (bite size) pieces. In a medium bowl mix the eggs seasoned salt Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Dip steak pieces into the egg mixture then coat with flour. Fry in a large skillet. Drain on paper towel. After all steak is fried pour oil out of skillet and stir-fry diced pepper a couple of minutes. Add French onion soup 1 can water tomato sauce and catsup. Mix then add steak and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add rinsed kidney beans and heat. In a large bowl cut up lettuce and tomatoes. Add chips and cheese. Add meat with beans. Pour dressing to taste over salad; mix well.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Prepare Stove Top stuffing as directed and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with chicken; slice margarine over chicken evenly. Cover with celery soup which has been mixed with bouillon. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Take out and scatter can of onions over evenly then put back in and bake 10 more minutes.

title: Sausage Dip
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Add cheese and green chilies. Keep hot in crock-pot.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Combine melted oleo with egg and raisins. Mix remaining ingredients add to liquid mixture a little at a time until blended. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Scones
instructions: Sift first 4 items. Cut in shortening until coarse. Beat eggs together with buttermilk; then pour into dry ingredients and mix to make soft pouch. Turn out dough on a lightly floured board and pat into 1/2 inch thickness. Cut in 8 inch diameter with large cutter and each into 4 parts. Total of 16. Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Bring ingredients to a boil except cornstarch. Add a little water to cornstarch so it dissolves. Add cornstarch little by little stirring well. Use non-aluminum pan with lid. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Dice cooked chicken. Cook noodles diced celery green pepper chopped onion minced garlic and chopped parsley in chicken broth. Combine chicken noodles vegetable mixture mushroom soup drained tomatoes salt and pepper. Add shredded cheese and bread crumbs. Put in large casserole dish and top with cheese and crumbs. Bake at 300\u00b0 until lightly browned about 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Prepare muffin mix by directions including 2 additional teaspoons liquid to add moisture to mix. Bake by directions. Fry bacon until crisp and crumble lightly. Toss all vegetables and bacon; set aside. Combine mayonnaise and pickle juice; mix well.

title: Pizza Salad
instructions: Combine last 5 ingredients and pour over first 5.

title: Corn Flake Candy
instructions: Boil together sugar and Karo syrup and remove from heat. Stir in the peanut butter until smooth. Next stir in corn flakes. Roll into balls and place on wax paper or serving dish.

title: Tangy Salad
instructions: Heat to boiling the oil sugar and vinegar; set aside to cool lightly. Drain all vegetables and toss lightly. Pour warm liquid over vegetables and refrigerate overnight. This salad keeps well for over a week.

title: Mrs. Pound'S Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Cook sugar syrup milk and cocoa until forms soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat. Add butter. Let cool some then beat until creamy enough to spread on cake.

title: Pistachio Surprise
instructions: Mix pudding mix and pineapple (do not drain). Add Cool Whip and marshmallows. Refrigerate.

title: Hot Curried Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit (liquid makes good jello with lemon oranges or lime). Put in Dutch oven. Cover with mixture of butter brown sugar and curry powder. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve in place of vegetable.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar cocoa baking soda and salt together. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake 3/4 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Lover'S Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In heavy saucepan combine caramels sweetened condensed milk and 1/2 cup shortening. Over medium heat cook and stir until melted and smooth. In medium bowl combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt. In large bowl beat sugar and remaining 3/4 cup shortening until fluffy. Beat in eggs. In small bowl combine water buttermilk and vanilla. Add alternately with flour mixture beating well. Spread half the batter into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake for 15 minutes or until center is set. Spoon caramel mixture evenly over cake. Spread remaining batter evenly over caramel. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake for 40 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Loosen from sides of pan while warm. Cool completely.

title: Itch(Serve Like Tabouleh)
instructions: Soak bulgar in 1 1/2 cups hot tap water for approximately 2 hours before mixing with sauce; set aside.

title: Hog Pudding
instructions: Cook sausage in pan until brown; drain. Pour 1 can of corn in deep baking dish. Spread sausage on top of corn. Add second can of corn. Place in hot oven and bake 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Blueberry Pie
instructions: Combine and mix well dry ingredients in large saucepan. Add water and stir to dissolve cornstarch. Add 1 cup of berries and cook stirring constantly over moderate heat until thickened. Add lemon juice and stir well to mix; cool slightly. Add 3 cups of berries. Transfer all filling to pie shell. Chill thoroughly. Serve with whipped cream ice cream etc.

title: Day After Christmas Casserole
instructions: Combine 1/2 bread cubes with eggs in large bowl. Combine remaining cubes with milk; stir into egg mixture. Add soup; mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients; stir until well mixed. Pour into casserole; brush with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Milk Chocolate Bundt Cake
instructions: In a saucepan heat the candy bar and chocolate syrup over low heat until melted; set aside to cool.

title: No-Bake Cheesecake Pie
instructions: In a heavy saucepan melt chips over medium-low heat; stir until smooth. Remove from heat; stir in cream cheese until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into crust. Cover and refrigerate overnight or until set. Just before serving sprinkle with toffee bits. Serves 6-8.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into fourths and coat with sugar and cinnamon mixture. In saucepan melt butter sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Place half of the biscuits in a greased Bundt pan; add pecans or raisins. Pour half of the liquid over this. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheesecake Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare brownies. Spread into well-greased pan. Beat cheese margarine and cornstarch until fluffy. Gradually beat in condensed milk eggs and vanilla until smooth. Pour evenly over brownie batter. Bake 45 minutes or until top is brown. Cool frost and cut. Store in refrigerator covered.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use glass or aluminum pan. Place pats of butter on bottom of pan. Place chicken on top of butter. Pour salsa on top of chicken cutlets. Sprinkle cheese on top of salsa. Bake for about 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Beat well with heavy-duty mixer. Add sugar. Beat until light and fluffy (5 minutes). Add eggs one at a time. Add flour to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Combine beef beans oregano cumin and garlic powder. Place 4 uncooked noodles in bottom of a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread 1/2 of the beef mixture over the noodles. Top with 4 more noodles and remaining beef mixture. Cover with remaining noodles. Combine water with picante sauce. Pour over all. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until noodles are tender. Combine sour cream onions and olives. Spoon over casserole. Top with cheese. Bake uncovered until cheese is melted (about 5 minutes).

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the fruit cocktail. Add the marshmallows to the drained fruit. Combine in top of a double boiler over boiling water the vinegar egg or egg yolks and sugar. Cook until mixture is thickened. Cool then fold into fruit mixture. Whip the cream and fold into mixture.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup in 3-quart saucepan and cook until mixture bubbles. Remove from heat and mix in peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chips together in saucepan and pour over pan of Krispies Treats.

title: Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Brown beef. Mix onion tomato sauce juice cloves and cinnamon. Put half of cabbage in 2-quart casserole; put half of meat mixture over cabbage. Repeat layers. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Caramelized Nuts
instructions: Beat until stiff egg white and cold water. Mix together white sugar brown sugar salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Toss pecans or peanuts in egg white. Then pour into sugar mixture. Spread out on cookie sheet. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Swiss Sandwich Puffs
instructions: Combine mayonnaise onion and parsley; spread on small squares of\ttoasted rye bread. Top each square with Swiss cheese. Broil 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Hot Beef Din
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend sour cream and cream cheese in small bowl. Add mayonnaise. Stir in 3/4 c. pecans and beef. Transfer to oven proof dish; and top with remaining pecans. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes serve with crackers.

title: Cranberry Shrub
instructions: When ready to serve combine juices well; pour in punch bowl. Top with scoops of sherbet. Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook until thick and clear. Remove from heat. Add 1 small box strawberry jello mix well and cool to room temperature. Slice strawberries in a baked and cooled pie crust. Spoon on glaze be sure to cover well so berries wont turn dark. Serve with Cool Whip. Can also use a graham cracker crust. Refrigerate.

title: Mexican Layered Dip
instructions: In medium bowl combine black beans and 2 tablespoons salsa; mash with fork and stir until smooth. On 12-inch serving plate spread bean mixture into 10-inch circle. Top with sour cream; spread to within 1/4-inch of edge of beans. Top with one cup salsa lettuce cheese olives green onions and tomato. Serve with Easy Tortilla Chips. Makes 5 cups; 12 to 16 servings.

title: California Coffee
instructions: For each serving pour 2 tablespoons brandy into mug. Fill 2/3 full with hot strong coffee. Top with 1 scoop (about 1/4 cup) chocolate ice cream.

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Butter cupcake pan. Sift together flours and baking powder; reserve. Combine banana with brown sugar until smooth. Beat in eggs milk and melted butter. Stir in dry ingredients only until blended. Quickly stir in chocolate chips. Do not overbeat. Spoon batter into cups. Bake 25 minutes or until browned slightly. Cool on rack.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Mix salt and flour. Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly. Add milk to mixture. Divide. Roll out half of mixture on floured surface to desired thickness to fit a 9-inch pan. Makes 2 (9-inch) pie crusts.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Cook sausage in medium saucepan over medium heat until browned stirring to crumble. Drain off all fat except about 2 tablespoons. Stir in flour cook stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Gradually whisk in milk salt and pepper. Cook stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly about 5 minutes.

title: Ginger Ale Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water; add ginger ale crushed pineapple and bananas. Mix well. Pour in Pyrex and refrigerate until jelled.

title: Easy And Quick Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into pie shell. Place in refrigerator overnight or until well set and serve.

title: Vanilla Cherry Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line a 9-inch square baking pan with foil. Grease and flour. Blot cherries between layers of paper towels. In a small mixer bowl beat butter sugar eggs corn syrup and Kirsch until blended. Add flour cocoa and baking powder. Blend until combined. Stir in chopped cherries almonds and vanilla chips. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely. Cut into squares. Garnish with Vanilla Chip Drizzle.

title: Deluxe Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix baking mix and 2 tablespoons sugar. Cut in margarine. Pat into round pan 9 x 1 1/2-inches. Bake 10 minutes. Mix 1/3 cup sugar nutmeg egg yolks and sour cream; spread over hot layer. Bake 20 minutes; cool completely. Prepare Strawberry Glace; cool slightly. Arrange strawberries over layer and spread Strawberry Glace over the strawberries. Makes 12 servings.

title: Water Chestnut Appetizer
instructions: Cut bacon strips into thirds. Cut water chestnuts in half. Wrap each half chestnut in bacon strip and secure with toothpick. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Mix brown sugar and catsup and pour over chestnuts. Bake 30 minutes longer. Serve hot.

title: Jello Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello with hot water; add whole cranberry sauce to jello and water mixture. Let gel until firm. Add Cool Whip then nuts. (This is good for a salad or dessert.)

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and flavoring well. Add flour and mix well. Chill overnight. Shape teaspoonfuls of dough in balls. Put on cookie sheet and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Uncooked Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa oleo and milk; boil one minute. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Heavenly Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend all together. Serve with cut up fruit.

title: Ham (Bologna) Salad
instructions: Cut the bologna into 1/8s. Put into pan; add water. Boil for 15 minutes. Cool. Put in fridge until cold. Put bologna through food grinder; also onion. Mix bologna onion and sweet pickle relish with mayo. If it tastes sour add package of sweetener.

title: Mama'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix flour 1/2 cup sugar and salt in top of double boiler. Add scalded milk and stir well. Cook over direct heat until thick and smooth stirring constantly. Beat egg yolks well. Stir in a little hot mixture and pour back into double boiler. Cook over boiling water 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Beat egg whites until light and fluffy and gradually beat in the 6 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Fold 1/2 cup moist shredded coconut into the cooled filling then fold about 1/2 of the meringue into the filling and pour into cooled pie shell. Spread remaining meringue so as to touch the edges of the crust all around. Place in a 425\u00b0 oven for 4 1/2 minutes.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: I usually double recipe for 4 people.

title: Peppermint Patties
instructions: In large bowl combine condensed milk extract and food coloring (if desired). Add conf. Sugar; beat on low speed until smooth and well blended. Turn mixture onto surface sprinkled with conf. Sugar. Knead lightly to form small ball. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on wax paper-lined baking sheets. Flatten each ball into a 1- 1/2 inch patty. Let dry 1 hour or longer; turn over and let dry at least 1 hour. With fork dip each patty into warm candy coating (drag fork lightly across rim of pan to remove excess coating) Invert onto wax paper-lined baking sheets; let stand until firm. Store covered at room temperature or in refrigerator.

title: Sandy'S Spicy Ears
instructions: Boil water and cook Orechiette and bouillon cubes. Meanwhile put olive oil in saut pan with the chopped squash peas and mint leaves. Cook on medium heat. While cooking sprinkle on spices at will.

title: Corned Beef Stew
instructions: Cook until well blended.

title: Broccoli Dish
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on box. Add next 4 ingredients. Stir well. Place in greased casserole and cook for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Amish Cookies
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs. Stir in flour baking soda baking powder buttermilk vanilla salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Drop 4 or 5 cookies on ungreased cookie sheet each cookie measuring 1/4 cup. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake 7-8 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Beef Tips
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cut meat into 1-inch cubes. Add other ingredients. Bake in covered dish for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Serve over buttered noodles or rice.

title: Spinach Florentine
instructions: Cook spinach;\tdrain and set aside reserving liquid. Brown beef and onion. Drain grease. Stir spinach liquid (1 cup) and sauces into meat. Simmer.\tCook noodles and drain. Combine cheese spinach bread crumbs eggs and 1/2 cup of oil.\tSpread spinach-macaroni mixture in lightly greased dish with the meat mixture on top. Cook until bubbles at 350\u00b0. This casserole freezes well.

title: Taco Salad Or Dip
instructions: Serve with taco chips Tostitos or Doritos.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Slice cookie dough and cut into fourths. Place in greased mini muffin pans. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. As soon as you take them out place a peanut butter cup in the center.

title: Hamburger Corn Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion; strain off any grease. Mix with remaining ingredients. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Top with 1 cup bread crumbs mixed with 3 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Honey Cake
instructions: Bring honey gently to boiling; then add the coffee. Beat the eggs until light and lemon-colored; then add the oil a little at a time. Beat until well blended; then add sugar. Sift all dry ingredients; then add them to egg mixture with honey and coffee. Mix well. Pour batter into a greased loaf pan; bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Pour peas into bottom of casserole dish. Sprinkle half of the cheese evenly over peas. Arrange asparagus over the peas and cheese. Add other half of the cheese then the chopped eggs. Spoon mushroom soup over all and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Heat soup Ro-Tel sour cream and picante sauce in pan. Stir-fry chicken (diced) with desired seasonings. Roll chicken cheese mushrooms onions green pepper and a little sauce in each tortilla.

title: Harvest Potatoes With Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a small bowl combine seasonings. Place 2 tablespoons melted butter in a 10-inch nonstick skillet. Arrange 1/3 of the potato slices in a circular pattern in skillet. Sprinkle with about 1/4 teaspoon seasoning 4 teaspoons melted butter and 2 tablespoons onion. Repeat layers twice. Cover tightly with foil. Press layers down. Bake 20 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove from oven. Let stand 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Shrimp Ring
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Heat soup to boiling add cream cheese stirring until well blended. Add gelatin mixture mix well and let cool. Add shrimp mayonnaise celery and onions. Pour into 6-cup ring mold. Refrigerate for 4 to 5 hours. Unmold on lettuce leaves. Serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Frosted Salad
instructions: Mix and chill until firm.

title: Lemon Cookies
instructions: Grease cookie sheets. Mix together ingredients. Drop in powdered sugar. Place on cookie sheet. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Put roast and all ingredients into crock-pot. Cook on high 6 to 8 hours. When meat is very tender shred into pieces while still in crock-pot with juices. Serve on Italian beef rolls. Make sure to put juice on meat when serving.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Make 1-inch balls. Flatten on cookie sheet (the thinner the better). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar when cool. Yields 7 to 8 dozen. This is a really stiff batter be patient.

title: Crema De Fruta(Fruited Jell-O)
instructions: Boil gelatine with 1 cup water. Cool. Mix all ingredients in a Jell-O mold pan. Pour the gelatine. Mix well. Place in refrigerator for an hour or two. Loosen on side. When ready to serve transfer into a platter. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Chinese Almond Cookies
instructions: Preheat electric oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour with sugar soda and salt into a large bowl. Mix in shortening; knead thoroughly (8 to 10 minutes). Combine egg and almond extract; stir into flour mixture. Mix well. Shape into balls using 1 tablespoon of dough. Place on ungreased baking sheets; make a depression in the top with the thumb. Press a blanched almond in the center.

title: Baked Corn Casserole
instructions: Use leftover mashed potatoes and cooked cabbage. Mix the potatoes and cabbage together. Add salt and pepper to taste and chopped onion to taste. Fry lightly in skillet until browned and hot. Serve as vegetable and good to use up leftovers.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and warm in the microwave for 5 minutes. Serve with chips.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes; drain peel and dice while hot. Cook bacon in frying pan until crisp. Remove bacon from pan. Cook onion in bacon grease until golden brown. Blend in flour salt and sugar. Stir in the water. Boil 2 minutes. Add vinegar and heat through. Pour the hot dressing over the hot potatoes. Mix in the chopped bacon. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Eggs And Sausage Casserole(Aka Egg And Sausage Scramble)
instructions: Grease or spray an 11 x 13-inch or 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Layer bread sausage and cheese. Beat eggs milk and seasonings. Pour over bread sausage and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Ice with cream cheese icing. Try not to eat the whole thing in 1 night. It is even better eating the next day.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Break cake into bite-size pieces. In a separate bowl mix the Cool Whip sour cream and evaporated milk together. In a large bowl put a layer of cake and 1/3 of Cool Whip mixture over cake. Make 2 layers (end with last of Cool Whip mixture). Add glaze as last layer; top with strawberries. Refrigerate overnight. Do not mix. Serve with long spoon. Bon appetit!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water for a few minutes until barely tender. Drain well. Saute chopped onion in small amount of oil or butter. Add broccoli soup milk and cheese. Turn into casserole dish and cover with stuffing crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Oatmeal Cookies(Oatsies)
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In medium bowl mix oats and brown sugar. Stir together butter syrup salt and vanilla. Mix thoroughly into oat mixture. Press dough evenly in bottom of pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Cool. Spread chocolate on top. Spread nuts on chocolate. Chill 1 hour. Cut into bars. Yield 32 cookies.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
instructions: Spread on bread. Can be done 2-3 hours before serving. Put cucumbers on right before serving.

title: Vegetable And Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In a large skillet melt margarine. Add celery and stir over medium-high heat until crisp-tender. Stir in soup milk onion powder thyme and pepper. Mix well. Stir in vegetables and chicken; heat through. Spoon into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Arrange biscuits over hot filling. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown and filling is bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Filets De Flet A La Moutarde(Broiled Flounder Fillets With Mustard)
instructions: *Other mild white fish is good too!

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Cook ground meat with onion; drain. Mix all ingredients except chips and grated cheese. In a 2-quart casserole dish layer crushed chips and meat mixture until gone. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Enchiritos
instructions: Mix hamburger onion and salt and pepper to taste. Brown and drain. Mix chili and enchilada sauce in pots and warm up. Put small spoonful of meat mixture in a straight line across tortilla then spoon chili mix on. Add cheese and roll up. Place some chili mix on bottom of oblong pan. Finish rolling enchiritos and place in dish. Use remaining chili mix to cover all. Top with cheese over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Swiss-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Halve potatoes lengthwise then slice crosswise into 1/8-inch slices. (Do not put potatoes in water after slicing.) Immediately line up in a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with slices overlapping arranging in serving portions. Pour butter over potatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with Swiss cheese and then with Parmesan cheese. Bake an additional 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese is melted and slightly browned.

title: Cheese Danish
instructions: Mix all together until creamy except for rolls. Put crescent rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread to cover bottom. Spread mixture over rolls. Put another package of rolls over cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Gooey Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour over chicken in baking dish. Bake at 250\u00b0-300\u00b0 for 2-3 hours. Continue to baste chicken until become sticky. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Delicious
instructions: Melt butter in medium saucepan. Add flour and salt. Add chicken broth slowly stirring constantly. Cook over low heat until thickened stirring constantly.

title: Normandy Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Line a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan with waxed paper. Arrange ladyfingers around sides and bottom of pan. Cream margarine; gradually add sugar creaming until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating until smooth after each addition. Blend in milk vanilla and rum extract. Blend in melted chocolate until well blended. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; fold in chocolate mixture. Fold in pecans. Pour into prepared pans. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Peanut Buddy Bars
instructions: Beat peanut butter and margarine until smooth. Add sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Mix in flour and salt. Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips. Spread in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Immediately sprinkle baked dough with remaining chocolate chips. Let stand about 5 minutes until chips become shiny and soft. Spread the chocolate morsels with a knife as you would frosting. Cool completely and cut into bars. Freezes well.

title: Beef And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute meat until brown; drain. Add bell peppers and onion. Cook until done. Add tomatoes water salt and chili powder. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add rice and kidney beans. Pour into baking dish. Cover and cook for 1 hour. Stir; bake a little longer or until rice is done. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Jacques
instructions: In a covered skillet saute chicken in a mixture of butter oil and garlic until tender but not brown. Remove to warm dish. Stir into skillet the peppers until they are limp. Add the mushrooms and olives and cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Remove mixture to warm bowl. Stir in 1 cup of sour cream salt and pepper; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add sherry chicken and reserved mushroom mixture and cook for 2 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Uncle Eddie'S Favorite Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and vanilla. Add sugar gradually creaming until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Sift dry ingredients together. Add gradually to creamed mixture. Chill thoroughly (at least 3 hours). Roll on a well floured surface to 1/8 to 1/4 inch. Cut in desired shapes. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 6 to 8 minutes. Cool slightly on cookie sheet; remove to rack to finish cooling. Decorate!

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: When refrigeration is poor put eggs in hot water (not boiling) for 15 seconds. The eggs will keep from spoiling for 4 to 6 weeks without refrigeration.

title: Coconut Cream Pie(No Bake)
instructions: Prepare whipped topping with 1 cup of milk as directed on package using a large mixer bowl. Add remaining milk and pie filling mix. Blend and then beat at high speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Fold in coconut. Spoon into crust. Chill at least 4 hours or overnight.

title: Strawberry Pizza Pie
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with flour and nuts. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan and cook 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dump in cherries; sprinkle cake mix over cherries. Cut butter into pats and place over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Talerina
instructions: Chop then mix the following brown bell pepper onion celery garlic ground chuck and sausage. Mix tomatoes tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce shoe peg corn salt and pepper. Combine both mixtures together. Cook as spaghetti. Add chopped black olives 3/4 pound grated sharp cheese. Mix one package cooked wide noodles. Bake 45 minutes in buttered casserole at 350\u00b0. Top with 1/4 lb. sharp cheese. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Skillet Corn And Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken in margarine in a skillet for 10 minutes or until brown. Remove set aside and drain off fat. In skillet combine remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Cover. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and broccoli is tender-crisp stirring often. Garnish with potato wedges.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef; add onion and garlic (minced) until limp. Cook Italian sausage. Warm pepperoni. Combine all ingredients in large kettle. Reduce heat and simmer at least 3 hours stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaves. Skim off fat before serving. Feeds 10.

title: Bud'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place rice on bottom of oven dish.\tArrange chicken pieces on\ttop. Sprinkle\tonion soup mix over chicken. Pour soup mix over all. Cover and bake for 90 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Layer in a rectangular dish the sauerkraut corned beef shredded Swiss cheese mixture of mayonnaise and Thousand Island dressing and rye bread. Pour melted margarine over bread. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cornflake Candy
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and butter in 3-quart saucepan. Cook over moderate heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved and mixture boils. Remove from heat and add cornflakes and peanuts. Press lightly in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: 7-Up Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello and water let cool. Add 7-Up marshmallows and pineapple. Let set. In a saucepan beat egg; add butter flour pineapple juice and sugar. Cook until thick; let cool and fold in Cool Whip. Spread on top of jello. Grate frozen cream cheese on top. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Butter Rum Sauce
instructions: In saucepan melt butter; add brown sugar and Borden whipping cream. Boil rapidly 8 to 10 minutes; add rum. Pour over bread pudding. Serve warm. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Tacos
instructions: Saute beef onion green pepper and garlic until beef is no longer red. Drain excess fat. Add tomato sauce and seasonings. Simmer for 20 minutes or until somewhat thickened stirring often. Warm taco shells in a 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Spoon beef mixture into shells. Top with lettuce tomatoes and cheese.

title: Lo-Cal Dip
instructions: Blend until creamy. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Mom'S Easy Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix eggs and milk in bowl. Combine flour salt pepper and herbs on plate. Dip chicken in milk and then roll in flour mixture. Place in pan with Crisco and fry until brown.

title: Stuffed Bread
instructions: Cut off top of bread and hollow out forming crust shell. Tear bread into small pieces to make 2 cups. Brown beef in oil; mix in remaining ingredients except cheese slices and bread pieces. Simmer 4 to 5 minutes and stir in bread pieces. Fill crust with mixture. Cut cheese slices in half diagonally and place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes or until cheese melts. Replace top and serve. Yield 4 to 8 servings.

title: Yum-A-Selta(Hearty Dish)
instructions: Brown meat with salt pepper sugar and onion. Add tomato soup. Cook noodles; drain. Add cream of chicken soup. Layer meat mixture (1/2) noodle mixture (1/2) cheese (1/2) and repeat process. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Batty Cakes
instructions: Sift dry ingredients add egg and buttermilk. Stir till smooth. Drop by tablespoons on greased griddle. This is a kind of corn meal pancake. Crispy around the edges and very tasty with butter and syrup.

title: Date And Nut Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add in sugar and vanilla extract and mix well. Add in flour baking powder and salt and mix well. Stir in dates and walnuts. Pour into greased square pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. When cool cut into squares and dip in 10x sugar.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease jelly roll pan. Cream shortening and vanilla. Add sugar; cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs and pumpkin; beat well. Sift flour baking powder baking soda and spices. Stir into pumpkin mixture mixing until smooth. Blend in coconut and nuts. Spread batter in pan; bake for about 35 minutes. Cool; cut into bars. Makes 32 bars.

title: Hungarian Paprikas
instructions: In large pan heat oil. Add meat cubes and cook over medium heat until well browned. Remove meat to bowl. Saute onions in drippings until tender and golden brown. Return meat to pan. Add paprika salt pepper garlic salt and caraway seed stirring until well blended with meat. Stir in 3/4 can of beef broth. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until the meat is fork-tender.

title: Strawberry Glaze Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Add syrup and water. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and is thick and clear. Remove from heat and stir in Jell-O; stir until completely dissolved. If a darker color is desired add red food coloring. Cool sauce and add berries. Pour in pie shell and refrigerate 2 hours or more. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream. Serves 6 or 8. I save a few big berries to put on top of whipped cream.

title: Coconut Topping
instructions: Melt butter in a small glass bowl in microwave (1 minute). Add remaining ingredients to butter and mix well. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Prick potatoes with a fork and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until tender. Cool slightly. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise. Gently scoop out each potato half leaving a thin shell. Set shells aside. Put pulp into a small mixing bowl; add cream cheese chives salt and pepper. Beat until smooth. Add milk a tablespoon at a time beating until fluffy. Put mixture back into the shells and sprinkle with paprika. Place in a baking dish and cover loosely with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes; uncover and bake 10 more minutes or until heated.

title: Chocolatetown Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry shell and set aside. In bowl cream butter; add eggs and vanilla. Combine sugar and flour; add to creamed mixture. Stir in chips and nuts. Pour into the pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool about one hour; serve warm.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix the first 3 items together. Blend well the rest of the ingredients together. Pour in 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: Stew chicken in large Dutch oven-sized pot. Use a large amount of water. Stew until tender. Remove chicken. Add sliced carrots diced potatoes celery green beans broccoli and onion. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix well the first 4 ingredients. Add rest of ingredients; mix well. Shape into balls; roll in sugar. Press down with glass or fork on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Combine flour cocoa and baking soda; gradually blend into creamed mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes. Cookies will be soft. Cool on sheets until set about 1 minute. Remove to wire rack to cool completely. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: French Toast
instructions: Break eggs in bowl; add milk cinnamon and nutmeg. Beat. Dip sliced loaf bread in mixture on both sides. Fry in pan with butter until golden brown.\tAdd butter on top with syrup.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Bring water to boil. Cook cabbage about 7 minutes or until just wilted. Drain cabbage. Add salt and pepper to taste. Grease a baking dish with margarine or butter. Put half of cabbage in bottom of dish. Cover with half of the soup. Layer half of cheese over soup. Repeat layers in same order using remaining cabbage soup and cheese. Sprinkle crushed cracker or bread crumbs on top. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Uncover. Cook 5 minutes longer for crackers to crisp. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Easiest-Ever Cocoa Fudge
instructions: Microwave sugar cocoa milk and butter on High (full power) until butter is melted about 2 to 3 minutes; stir until smooth. Blend in vanilla and nuts. Spread into buttered 8-inch square pan; cool. Cut into squares.

title: Chili For Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix all together and simmer about 1 hour or until it cooks down thick enough to use on hot dogs. Stir often when it first starts cooking.

title: Butter Fingers(Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Cream sugar and butter well. Add vanilla; grind the nuts and add to this. Add the cold water then the flour and salt. Knead thoroughly. Roll small amount at a time by hand in a roll the size of your finger cut in pieces about an inch long. Cook in preheated oven at 300\u00b0. Cook until light brown about half an hour depending on your oven. When cool dust cookies with powdered sugar. Make only one batch at a time. When cool store in a tight can lined with wax paper. These keep a long time and the flavor improves with age. Yields 24.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add milk sugar chocolate morsels and vanilla flavor. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Check with cool water; if forms into a ball add nuts. If ball does not form cook 5 minutes longer. Spread in a buttered pan.

title: Cranberry Sauce And Glaze(For Chicken, Duck, Cornish Hen)
instructions: Mix together cranberry sauce orange juice duck sauce and wine. Use half mixture to baste poultry and bake.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl sift dry ingredients 5 times. Add milk and shortening and beat 2 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flavoring and beat until thoroughly mixed. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done.

title: The Elvis Delite
instructions: Toast two (2) slices of whole wheat bread. Apply one thick coating of smooth peanut butter. Slice one large banana onto applied peanut butter and toast. Cover with plain slice of toast. Cut diagonally from upper right to lower left. Then enjoy a very tasty Elvis delite.

title: Scented Christmas Ornaments
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients; mix well. Stir in applesauce; mix well. Stir in glue; mix well.

title: Pecan Crunch Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place butter in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and put into oven to melt. Combine buttermilk and egg. Combine flour pecans paprika salt pepper and sesame seed. Dip chicken pieces in buttermilk mixture then place in plastic bag with flour mixture. Shake well to coat chicken lightly. Place skin-side down in baking dish; turn pieces to coat with butter. Bake 1 1/2 hours or until fork-tender and golden brown. Serves 8.

title: Double Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugars butter milk and vanilla in medium bowl. Stir in flour baking powder and salt. Stir in oats peanut butter chips and chocolate chips. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 11 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately take from cookie sheet. Makes 5 dozen. (Self-rising flour can be used.)

title: Carrots A La Orange
instructions: Wash carrots scrub with stiff brush and cut in half. Cook until just tender. Melt butter or margarine in heavy skillet. Add sugar and orange juice. Let bubble 2 to 3 minutes. Add carrots tossing now and then to glaze well over medium heat. Top with orange slices and sprinkle with nutmeg turning now and then so carrots and oranges are thoroughly glazed. Serve at once! Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; take off bones and put in casserole dish. Mix milk with chicken soup. Pour over chicken. Mix stuffing with chicken broth and pour on top of milk mixture and heat in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients then fold in remainder ending with Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Pineapple - Lime Ring
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water and juice. Gradually add gelatin to cream cheese mixing until blended. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in marshmallows pineapple and nuts. Pour into 6-cup ring mold. Chill until firm. Unmold onto serving plate. Garnish with flaked coconut and marshmallows.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat well. Add vanilla potato chips and beat together. Add nuts and mix well (do not beat now). Drop by teaspoon on an ungreased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla. Beat well. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Then put mixer away and stir in flour.

title: Toll House Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift together flour baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Cream together butter and sugars. Add vanilla and eggs; beat well. Gradually add sifted dry ingredients mixing well. Fold in chocolate pieces and nuts. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until done. Let cool on wire rack.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut wings in half. Discard tips. Place wings in pan large enough so wings do not overlap each other. Sprinkle pepper and salt. Mix next 6 ingredients. Add hot water and blend well. Pour this over wings. Cover pan with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 2 hours. Remove foil. Lower heat to 300\u00b0 and baste wings often for about 30 minutes. Drain wings on paper towels. Serve hot or cold.

title: Moist Creamy Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool 15 minutes. Then poke holes down through cake with utility fork. Meanwhile combine milk sugar and 1/2 cup of coconut in saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Spoon over warm cake allowing liquid to soak down through holes. Cool completely. Fold 1/2 cup of the coconut into whipped topping and spread over cake. Sprinkle with remaining coconut. Chill overnight. Store leftover cake in refrigerator.

title: Cowboy Potatoes
instructions: Fry bacon and remove from pan. In bacon grease fry potatoes onion and green pepper until tender. Dice bacon and add. Add salt and pepper.

title: Chicken With Dried Beef
instructions: Line the bottom of a baking dish with half of chipped beef. Wrap each piece of chicken with a strip of bacon and place on top of beef. Place remaining beef on top of chicken. Blend soup and sour cream until smooth and pour over chicken mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Cinnamon Rice And Lentils
instructions: Combine the raisins with the apple juice. Set aside to plump. Place the broth and cinnamon stick in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil. Stir in the lentils rice oil and raisins with the apple juice and return to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and cover tightly. Let the rice simmer undisturbed for about 45 minutes. Uncover the pan and toss the rice mix with the remaining ingredients. Adjust seasoning to taste. Garnish with a dollop of plain yogurt and pecans.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all reserving 3/4 cup of pecans. Chill. Roll into 1 large or 2 small balls. Garnish by rolling in the remaining pecans mixed with dried or fresh parsley if desired. May garnish with pieces of maraschino cherries for color.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Beat eggs. Combine with pumpkin. Add sugar oil and water. Add flour and mix well. Add raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Cook drain and cool the peas. Break lettuce into large bowl. Fry bacon crisp and break it up. Chop onion and green pepper.

title: Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine gelatin and boiling water. Add other ingredients to gelatin mixture. Pour in 9 x 2-inch pan (glass or metal). Chill until firm. Cut in squares. Serve with dressing of 1/2 cup Miracle Whip and 1/2 cup whipped cream. Delicious. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake uncovered. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Grammy'S Cinnamon Cucumber Rings Or Mock Apple Rings
instructions: Day One Combine 2 gallons water and pickling lime. Add cucumber rings peeled and sliced about 3/8-inch thick. Scoop out the seeds. Let stand 24 hours.

title: Apple Cheese Torte
instructions: In medium bowl using pastry blender or fork combine cookie crumbs and margarine. Press on bottom and up sides of 9-inch spring-form pan or use pie pan.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
instructions: For Sauce Stir together the soup milk and pepper in a medium mixing bowl. Set aside.

title: Pork Chops Vera Cruz With Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops in oil in 10-inch skillet turning to brown well on both sides. Drain off excess fat. Sprinkle with flour brown sugar mustard salt and garlic. Add onion and wine. Cover and cook over low heat until chops are tender about 1 hour. Add water as needed and spoon sauce over chops several times. Meanwhile cook rice according to package. Add green pepper to pork 15 minutes before end of cooking time. Top with pimiento. Serve with rice. Serves 6.

title: Scallops And Linguine In Alfredo Sauce
instructions: Fry scallops in butter and garlic in frying pan until scallops are cooked. Cook broccoli for 20 minutes and drain. Cook noodles for 20 minutes; drain and let cool. Heat white sauce. Mix noodles broccoli and sauce with scallops and serve.

title: Vincent'S Marinade
instructions: Very good for steaks etc.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels with butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; press into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake 7 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool. Mix softened cream cheese with Cool Whip and 1 cup sugar. Spread over pretzel crust. In a large bowl mix jello water strawberries and pineapple. Chill mixture until partially set. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Let chill a few hours before serving.

title: Almond Joy Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to box recipe. Bake in 16 x 10 x 2-inch pan. While cake is baking mix 1 cup evaporated milk and 1 cup sugar; bring to rapid boil and then remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows; stir until melted. Add coconut and almonds and mix well. Spread mixture over hot cake. In saucepan add 1/2 cup margarine 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Bring to a rapid boil; remove from heat. Stir in chocolate bits; stir until melted. Spread over coconut layer.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and oil; add eggs. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add vanilla nuts and prunes. Pour into buttered pan and bake at 300\u00b0 until brown. While still hot cover with icing.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add crumbled cornbread and mix well. Add a few pinches of crushed sage and 1/2 to 3/4 t. of poultry seasoning if desired. Bake at 300 degrees for 35 - 45 min. or until set.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl to make a stiff dough using a little more flour if needed. Roll very thin on floured surface; let stand 20 minutes. Slice 1/4-inch thick wide. Drop into boiling soup or broth. Cook uncovered approximately 10 minutes. Makes 3 cups cooked noodles.

title: Chinese Hot Dish
instructions: Brown the first 3 ingredients. Mix and place the remaining ingredients in a casserole dish. Add the hamburger. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Salt hamburger only slightly as soy sauce is salty. Put Chinese noodles on top of casserole for the last 15 minutes.

title: Wee Lemon Cakes
instructions: Mix cake according to directions except omit 3 tablespoons water. Drop by teaspoon into greased and floured miniature cupcake pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients. Remove cakes when cooked and immediately drop cakes into mixture. When coated remove from mixture with slotted spoon and place on wax paper. Makes 4 to 5 dozen. Serve warm or cold.

title: Cheese-Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover mixture and refrigerate. Serve with assorted crackers. Yields 2 1/2 cups of dip.

title: Grandma Warmann'S Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in 1/2 cup warm water. Stir until dissolved fully. Let stand. Pour 3 cups boiling water over 1 1/2 cups cracked wheat. Let stand 1 hour. Add to cracked wheat the bran 1 1/2 cups warm water salt brown sugar oil whole wheat flour and 2 cups white flour. Mix well and add dissolved yeast. Beat hard and add more white flour to make firm dough (5 to 6 cups). Knead on floured surface 5 to 6 minutes. Place in greased bowl. Let rise until doubled. Punch down and put into greased bread pans. Let rise again. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until done. Makes 4 full loaves.

title: Microwave Choco Oats Drops
instructions: Place sugar milk and butter in a quart glass casserole dish. Microwave 3 to 5 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil. Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Bake for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. In large bowl combine flour sugar and butter to form a dough. Press the dough evenly into the prepared pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Allow this to cool; prepare remaining ingredients in large bowl. Whisk together remaining ingredients until well blended. Pour the mixture over cooled shell and bake 25 minutes. Allow to cool then sprinkle with confectioners sugar and almonds. Cut into bars and serve.

title: Broccoli, Rice And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed on box. Place in a 2-quart casserole dish. Mix Cheez Whiz cream of chicken soup and chunk chicken together; set aside. Steam broccoli and margarine (with onion if you like) until done. Place on top of rice mixture then add cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Asparagus With Mustard Sauce(Microwave)
instructions: Trim off tough ends of asparagus. In microwave dish arrange asparagus alternately tips and ends. Add water. Cover with plastic. Vent 1 corner. Microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes or until tender-crisp. Rearrange halfway through. Let stand 3 minutes.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix together all dry ingredients. Add eggs oil buttermilk and mix well. Refrigerate overnight before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Keeps 6 weeks.

title: Chicken Breast Supreme
instructions: Wrap each breast with bacon and secure with toothpick. Cover bottom of flat greased baking dish with chipped beef. Arrange chicken on beef. Mix soup sour cream and cheese. Pour on top. Bake at 275\u00b0 uncovered for 3 hours. Serve with rice. Serves 8.

title: Play Dough(Stovetop Recipe)
instructions: Mix in a medium pot flour salt and cream of tartar. Combine and add water food coloring and oil. Cook over medium heat and stir (about 3 to 5 minutes). It will look like a globby mess and youll think its not turning out but it will. When it forms a ball in the center of the pan turn out and knead on a lightly floured surface. Store in an airtight container or plastic bag.

title: Swedish Rye Bread(Bread Machine Recipe)
instructions: Mix dry ingredients except yeast and set aside. Pour water and molasses into bread machine. Add dry ingredients yeast and butter. Set machine for dough cycle. During the knead cycle add any additional water or flour to bring dough to a soft (not gummy) consistency. At end of dough cycle turn onto floured surface. Let rest for 15 minutes. Form into a round loaf. Place onto a lightly greased baking sheet that has been sprinkled with corn meal. Cover with a clean dish towel and let rise until doubled. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Loaf should make a hollow sound when tapped on the bottom. Cool for 15 minutes before slicing. Serve buttered with paper-thin sliced ham for a special treat.

title: Chocolate Nut Zucchini Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water. Let cool. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan or Bundt cake pan. Sift flour with baking powder soda and salt. Set aside. In large bowl of electric mixer at high speed beat eggs until thick and light. Gradually add sugar 1/4 cup at a time beating well after each addition. Add salad oil and cooled chocolate; beat until well blended. At low speed add dry ingredients mixing until smooth. Add zucchini and nuts with wooden spoon. Turn batter into prepared pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours or until surface springs back when pressed lightly. Cool 15 minutes and remove from pan. Or may bake in 3 loaf pans for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Mint Pudding
instructions: Combine first 3 items in a medium saucepan. Gradually add milk stirring with a wire whisk until smooth. Cook over medium-low heat for 25 to 30 minutes or until thick. Remove from heat; stir in liqueur and vanilla. Spoon mixture into individual dessert dishes. Cover and chill thoroughly. Just before serving sprinkle evenly with crushed peppermint.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; put into refrigerator to cool. After cooling shape into ball and sprinkle with even amounts of paprika and chili powder.

title: Strawberry And Pineapple Dip
instructions: Let cheese soften at room temperature; mix in sugar and vanilla. Serve with strawberries or pineapple of piccolo cookies (Nabisco).

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine first 5 ingredients. In another bowl combine rest of ingredients. Add dry ingredients stirring until moistened.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix in order the first 8 ingredients. Mix cocoa and hot water. Add to batter; pour into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Brownie Pudding
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients until smooth. Add nuts. Pour into a greased 8-inch square pan. Mix brown sugar and cocoa; sprinkle over batter. Pour hot water over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Mix chicken soup peppers cheese and onion. Layer in casserole starting with cheese mixture meat and chips. Make edge with chips. Makes 3 layers of cheese 2 of meat and chips.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Mix corn meal mix eggs oil milk corn sugar garlic and onion and mix well. Mix in peppers and cheese. Pour into well-greased 8 1/2 x 11-inch baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until brown and firm. Wonderful with beans!

title: Vegetable Chili
instructions: Saute first 5 ingredients for 10 minutes. Add all ingredients into crock-pot; simmer until done. Feeds a large family. Great with grandmas cornbread.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak stale bread in milk. Crush with hands until well mixed. Add eggs sugar vanilla and fruit. Pour margarine in bottom of thick pan and bake until very firm. Let cool and serve in cubes with lemon sauce.

title: Jane Evans' Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Brown meat on medium in skillet. Mix all the rest of the ingredients in a bowl. Pour over browned meat and simmer 45 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch blended with enough cold water to make smooth. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Italian Easter Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. In separate large bowl add milk butter sugar salt egg yolks citron orange and lemon peel and raisins. Mix in 1 cup flour. Add softened yeast. Beat in remaining flour. Toss on floured board and knead until smooth. Shape into ball and place in oiled bowl. Brush top with oil and let rise in warm place for 2 hours. Take 2/3 of dough and divide into 4 pieces. Shape each into long roll (18 x 1-inch). Twist 2 rolls into circle or nest and place on greased sheet. Place colored eggs in dough. Do other roll. Also roll 6 thin pieces from remaining dough and crisscross over eggs. Brush top with butter and let rise again 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. When cooled drizzle top with 1 cup confectioners sugar and 1 tablespoon milk. Makes 2 rings.

title: Hamburg Noodle Bake
instructions: Fry hamburg salt pepper and onion until brown. Add tomato sauce; simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Cook noodles in salt water. Put 1/2 of the noodles in greased casserole. Spread on top 1/3 of the sour cream then 1/3 of the meat mixture. Repeat until all is used up. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: A Happy Home
instructions: Take 1 large field half a dozen children 2 or 3 small dogs a pinch of brook and some pebbles. Mix the children and dogs well together; put them on the field stirring constantly. Pour the brook over the pebbles; sprinkle the field with flowers. Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun. When brown set away to cool in the bathtub.

title: Port Wine Congealed Salad
instructions: *Can use Welches grape juice instead of wine.

title: Oven Easy Beef Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients in casserole. Cover tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Microwave Brownies
instructions: Beat together the butter sugar eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy 1 to 2 minutes. Beat in cocoa. Add flour; beat until well blended. Stir in pecans by hand. Spread evenly in a wax paper lined 8-inch square glass dish. Cook in microwave oven on High for 3 minutes. Turn dish a quarter turn; continue to cook on High 2 1/2 to 3 minutes longer. Let cool. Sift powdered sugar over top if desired. Cut into 16 to 24 squares.

title: Rice-Pot Jambalaya
instructions: Spray rice pot with Pam. Add melted oleo. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes onion raw rice bell pepper chicken broth and protein of choice. Stir. Cook until rice is done.

title: Chicken Divan(Great For Company)
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Mix together mayonnaise soup and curry powder. Layer broccoli chicken and the mayonnaise soup and curry powder mixture. Sprinkle on cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes.

title: Freezer Peach Preserves
instructions: Peel and pit peaches. Grind or finely chop fruit. Measure 2 1/4 cups into large bowl. Add lemon juice and sugar; let set 20 minutes. Mix 3/4 cup water and Sure-Jell in small saucepan. Bring to a full boil and boil 1 minute stirring constantly. At once stir into fruit. Continue stirring 3 minutes. Immediately ladle into containers. Cover with lids and let stand at room temperature 24 hours. Store in freezer or small amounts may be kept in refrigerator up to 3 weeks.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Cook longer than ordinary pancakes. Edges should be crisp.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: In a nonaluminum pan simmer ingredients for 15 to 20 minutes. Strain. This is good hot or cold.

title: Creton
instructions: Cook pork and onion over low heat stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Add salt and pepper; continue cooking for about 2 hours. Add ground cloves the last 15 minutes. For smooth texture mash with potato masher. To lessen grease ladle off after removing from heat. Also when it sets up after cooling scrape off fat with a knife or spoon.

title: Black Midnight Cakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch or two 9-inch or 8-inch pans. Measure all ingredients into large mixer bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed scraping bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes at high speed scraping bowl occasionally. Pour into pan(s). Bake in oblong pan about 45 minutes round pan 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 9-inch pie plate. Mix Bisquick salt pepper marjoram parsley oil and cheeses until well blended. Fold in chopped onion and sliced zucchini. Pour into pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Oven Barbecue Chicken
instructions: In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot salad oil cook chicken a few pieces at a time until browned on all sides; remove chicken to roasting pan as it browns.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Place broccoli on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Cover with stuffing. Pour prepared soup over stuffing and cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Nice dish for covered dish dinners.

title: Creamy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into thin slices to measure about 4 cups. Heat 3 T margarine in saucepan until melted. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly; remove from heat. Stir in milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute.

title: No Cal, No Fat, No Sodium Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and serve. Great for all diets.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Put meatballs in slow cooker/Crock Pot. Pour over remaining ingredients. Heat on low until thoroughly heated through about 4 hours. Stir a few times during the cooking process to incorporate sauces.

title: Reba'S Graham Candy
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa milk and oleo. Boil 1 1/2 minutes. Add peanut butter vanilla and crumbs. Stir well. Pour into 8 x 10-inch pan or 2 plates.

title: Mexican Quiche
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch ungreased cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Cook dates and water; cool. Add sugar and egg; mix well. Add Rice Krispies nuts and vanilla. Grease hands; shape into balls. Roll in coconut. Store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Pie Dough
instructions: Beat eggs very well. Add to mixture of flour baking powder sugar Crisco and vanilla. Chill overnight. Roll on floured board for desired size.

title: First Prize Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter 9-inch spring-form pan. Wrap outside of pan securely with foil. Heat chocolate with water and coffee powder in saucepan over very low heat stirring occasionally just until chocolate is melted. Cool to room temperature. Beat butter in mixer bowl until creamy. Beat in sugar until light and fluffy 5 minutes. Beat in egg yolks one at a time beating well after each. At low speed gradually beat in flour. Stir in cooled chocolate mixture. In clean bowl beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually increase speed and beat until stiff but not dry. Fold into chocolate mixture. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 60 to 65 minutes until toothpick inserted in cake about 1-inch from side comes out clean. (Top may crack.) Cool in pan on rack. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove side of pan. Sift confectioners sugar lightly over top of cake. Makes 14 to 16 servings.

title: Garden Pasta
instructions: Saute all ingredients together; stir often. When veggies are tender and tomatoes dissolve pour mixture over pasta in a Pyrex dish. Mix well. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and enjoy!

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all together then freeze. When ready to serve remove from freezer 10 minutes prior to serving time.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift flour and powdered sugar together. Set aside. In a large bowl beat egg whites (at room temperature) cream of tartar and salt until foamy. Add second amount of sugar 2 tablespoons at a time. Beat on high until meringue holds stiff peaks. Gently fold in flavorings. Sprinkle flour-sugar mixture 1/4 cup at a time over meringue folding in gently just until flour mixture disappears. Push batter into ungreased Bundt pan and gently cut through batter. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until top springs back when touched with finger. Turn on wire rack until completely cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on package; drain well. Combine all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Unbaked Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar margarine cocoa and milk. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from stove and stir. Add peanut butter vanilla and oatmeal. Mix well. Drop on wax paper by teaspoonfuls. Let cool.

title: Chinese Spring Rolls
instructions: Cut meat into small thin pieces. (Tofu may be substituted). In large frying pan or wok heat 2 tablespoons of oil until smoking. Stir-fry meat small portion at a time and set aside. Add more oil if necessary and stir-fry vegetables until crisp-tender.

title: Greek Crackers
instructions: Mix ingredients; pour over crackers. Stir until absorbed. Store in airtight container.

title: Hot Cinnamon Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit very well and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Dot with butter. Mix brown sugar and spices and sprinkle over fruit. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Decorate with cherries.

title: Creole Beans
instructions: Bring water to boil and add beans. Boil 2 minutes. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Return to heat and simmer covered until tender a fork pierces a single bean easily; drain. Saute onion and green pepper in a little oil. Stir in flour seasonings and sugar. Add tomatoes and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Stir in cooked beans; heat through. Makes 8 servings.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie
instructions: Microwave chocolate and 2 tablespoons milk in a large microwaveable bowl on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted stirring halfway through heating time. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Beat in cream cheese sugar and the remaining milk until well blended. Refrigerate to cool about 10 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Break up hash browns and squeeze water out. Melt butter. Mix everything together and put in a buttered dish. Mix corn flake crumbs and 1/8 cup of butter and sprinkle on top before you bake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Brown Beef Stew
instructions: Cut meat into 1 inch cubes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roll in flour and brown in the fat. Add water cover and simmer until almost tender 2 to 3 hours. Add vegetables season with salt and pepper and continue to simmer until vegetables are done stirring occasionally.

title: Crab Melt-A-Ways
instructions: Melt the oleo and cheese; add the other ingredients and mix. Split the muffins and cut into fourths. Spread mix on muffins and broil for 5 minutes.

title: Hummingbird Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients; add oil eggs and stir but dont beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple nuts and bananas. Spoon into 3 (9-inch) cake pans that are greased and floured or bake in muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Mix all other ingredients with ground beef. Bake in 9 x 13-inch baking dish for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Delicious!

title: O' Henry Bars
instructions: Bring to a boil syrup and white sugar and remove from heat. Mix in peanut butter. Add Special K cereal. Press into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt butterscotch chips and spread on top then melt chocolate chips and spread over. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook and debone hen. Put peppers celery and onions in broth and simmer. Partially cook spaghetti in water and pour in sieve. Rinse with cold water to remove excess starch. Add to broth and simmer until tender; add diced chicken mushrooms pimento and ripe olives. Mix in the grated cheese. Serve hot with green salad and crisp crackers.

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: Heat oven to 275\u00b0. In ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan mix cereal nuts croutons and pretzel sticks. Blend remaining ingredients. Pour over cereal mixture; mix well. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Layer pork chops potatoes and soup. Cover and bake at 420\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking until brown.

title: Fresh Lemonade
instructions: Thinly slice lemons crosswise. Discard end slices and seeds. Put lemon slices in a sturdy pitcher. Add sugar. Stir with wooden spoon until sugar is dissolved; let set 10 minutes. Add 1 tray of ice cubes and 6 cups of cold water. Stir well. Makes 8 tall glasses.

title: Beef In Wine Sauce
instructions: Brown beef in Kitchen Bouquet. Combine all ingredients. Pour into 2-quart crockery casserole. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Pour over celery peppers and onions. Mix together remaining ingredients. Now pour sugar mixture over beans. Marinate overnight.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: In a small pan simmer pineapple flour and sugar until thick. Allow to cool. Layer sliced bananas over pie crust. Pour pineapple mixture over bananas. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Cover with whipped topping. Chill well. (So easy to make and so good.)

title: Easy Citrus-Raisin Bars
instructions: Combine 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup sugar; cut in 1/2 cup butter with pastry blender until well blended. Press into bottom of lightly greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden (15 minutes).

title: Seafood Lasagna
instructions: Cook margarine and onion until onion is tender. Add cream cheese to onion until well blended. Add cottage cheese egg salt pepper and basil to onion and cheese and blend well. Put 4 noodles in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread half of mixture over the noodles. Blend soup milk and wine together and gently fold in crabmeat. Layer shrimp then 1/2 of soup and crab mixture. Repeat the noodles cheese and soup mixtures. Top with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with Cheddar cheese and bake 5 minutes more. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Use an 11 x 13-inch pan. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chocolate Layered Dessert
instructions: Pour milk into a large bowl add pudding mixes. Beat with a wire whisk 2 minutes let stand 5 minutes. Gently stir in 2 cups of whipped topping. In trifle bowl layer 1/2 marble cubes drizzle with 1/2 the chocolate syrup then 1/2 the toffee bars. Repeat layers again. Garnish with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Peel sweet potatoes and boil until done. Let cool. Place potatoes in large bowl and mix until smooth adding butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add nutmeg salt and milk. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie crusts. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake pies for 20 minutes. Lower heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 45 minutes longer or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool before serving.

title: Chickpeas And Macaroni
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in olive oil. Add ripe tomatoes. Cook macaroni until tender. Drain. Add chickpeas macaroni and sauce together; cook on low for 1/2 hour. Serve with a tossed salad.

title: Fritos Philly Dip
instructions: Mix cheese with cream until smooth. Add rest of ingredients and let stand 30 minutes. Insert garlic on toothpicks. Serve with chips.

title: Sauteed Chicken Breasts With Cheese(Serves 4)
instructions: Split chicken debone remove and discard skin. Add nutmeg salt and pepper to flour. Dip breasts into flour then eggs then bread crumbs mixed with cheese. In a large skillet brown chicken in melted butter about 5 minutes or until done. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Shirley Whipkey'S Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop cranberries. Mix with sugar and set overnight. Add pineapple Dream Whip or Cool Whip and pecans.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes 1/2 cup margarine onion soup sour cream and cheese; stir well. Spoon into a 2 1/2-quart casserole (greased). Crush cereal and stir in remaining butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cook 30 minutes before adding cereal on top then finish cooking.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Stew chicken until done. Remove chicken from broth; save broth. Debone chicken. Roll pieces of chicken in flour. Place floured chicken in casserole dish. Add chopped onion celery soup mushroom soup and 2 cans of broth from chicken stew. Place layer of flaky biscuits on top or use thinly rolled homemade biscuits to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Fudge Icing
instructions: Melt the shortening and chocolate over hot water or in microwave. Add the rest of the ingredients stirring constantly bring rapidly to a full boil. Boil to 220\u00b0 or exactly one minute. Cool in a pan of ice water until lukewarm. Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla and beat until icing begins to lose its gloss and is a consistency to spread.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (glass dish). In 13 x 9-inch pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine. Pour milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Chill if desired. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Waxy Pecan Loaf
instructions: Mix all together and bake in slow oven in greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fried Cushaw
instructions: Cut cushaw in half (put other half in refrigerator; use within a week). Remove all seeds from both halves. Peel cushaw and cut into 1-inch squares. Fry in butter and brown sugar until cushaw is tender and browned.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add the rest; mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Seafood Primavera
instructions: Melt butter; stir in flour seasonings and garlic until smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Add milk and stir with wire whisk until all lumps are gone. Add cheese; return to heat and stir constantly until thickened.

title: Dannette'S Dessert
instructions: Combine softened butter with cookies (or flour and nuts). Spread into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Cool.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter or margarine. Add and heat to boiling tomato sauce mushrooms olive salt pepper garlic button broth and chicken. Add cooked vermicelli and cheese. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Grapefruit Salad With Champagne Dressing
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl; stir with a wire whisk until blended. Cover and chill. Combine lettuce and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl; toss gently. Pour dressing over lettuce mixture; toss gently. Serve immediately. Yield 6 servings.

title: Cherry Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Spread cherries in an ungreased square pan 8 x 8 x 2 inches. Mix remaining ingredients with a fork. Sprinkle over cherries. Bake about 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown. Serve warm with cream or ice cream if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Carol'S Cheesecake
instructions: Mix ingredients and spread on top. Return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter gradually add sugar and eggs mixing well after each addition. Add buttermilk mix well. Combine flour and soda. Gradually stir into creamed mixture; add vanilla mix well. Roll dough 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut into rounds with cookie cutter and place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Sprinkle lightly with granulated sugar. Bake in 350\u00b0 or 400\u00b0 oven for 7 or 8 minutes or until cookies are light brown. Remove from cookie sheet and cool. Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Summer Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut cantaloupe honeydew melons and watermelon in a large bowl. Mix. Refrigerate until cold.

title: Cracklin' Pepper Bread
instructions: Scald milk; stir in sugar salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm. Pour warm water into large warm bowl. Add yeast stirring until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture egg and 3 cups flour; beat until smooth. Add enough additional flour to form a stiff dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes). Place in a greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk (about 1 hour).

title: M&M-Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and beat. Add salt soda and vanilla. Slowly add flour and mix in chips and M&Ms. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: Cut Velveeta cheese into cubes. Put into microwave bowl or cook on stove. Put in the can of Ro-Tel. Then stir until cheese is melted. Not more than 15 minutes. Serve hot. It will thicken as it cools.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13 pan. Over this sprinkle crumbs coconut and bits. Pour milk over and sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Spoon 1/2 cup of the fudge topping into bottom of crust. Place in freezer 10 minutes. Whisk peanut butter and milk in a large bowl until well blended. Add pudding mixes. Beat for 2 minutes or until smooth. (Mixture will be thick.) Stir in 1/2 of the whipped topping. Gently spoon over chocolate layer. Top with remaining whipped topping. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set. Drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup fudge topping just before serving. Makes 10 servings.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Cook cake as told on box. Let cool. Cut each cake in halves. Mix cream cheese with powdered sugar. Mix well then add Cool Whip. Spread on icing to cake then add berries and repeat.

title: Pacific Lime Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water. Add juice from pineapple. Chill until slightly set. Beat until frothy. Fold in remaining ingredients. Chill until set.

title: Peggy'S Chicken Liver Pate
