instructions: Place chicken livers broth wine bay leaf salt and bouillon in saucepan. Cover and simmer gently until livers are just cooked through approximately 10 minutes. Drain reserving liquid. Place in blender with remaining ingredients. Blend well adding reserved liquid as needed for a spreadable consistency. Pack in crock and chill well before serving.

title: Lazy Day Duff
instructions: Melt butter in 8-inch baking dish. Sift dry ingredients; add milk stirring until blended. Spoon over butter; do not stir. Pour fruit over batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve warm with cream. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Luau Chicken
instructions: In crock-pot mix all ingredients except chicken until well blended. Add chicken pieces and push them down until covered with sauce. Cook on low several hours or overnight until tender. Increase heat to high last 1/2 hour to allow sauce to thicken. Delicious with rice.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan. Stir in brown sugar. Remove from heat and cool approximately 10 minutes. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Set aside. One at a time beat 3 eggs into sugar mixture then add flour mixture and chocolate chips. Spread dough in 15 x 10 x 1-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Marina'S Pie Crust
instructions: Cut with pastry blender the flour shortening and salt. Add egg mixture. Mix with fork. Roll lightly; make enough for 2 full (double crust) pies and 1 one crust pie.

title: Cinnamon Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine brown sugar cold water and butter; bring to a boil and cool. Sift together flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Cream together butter and sugar. Add the dry ingredients alternately with milk. Spread into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour brown sugar mixture over batter. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Bride'S Punch
instructions: Thaw strawberries. Combine juices and water. Chill. Pour into punch bowl. Add ginger ale or sprite. Add strawberries and frozen fruit ring.

title: Macaroon Ice Cream
instructions: Crumble 1/2 the macaroons on bottom of 9-inch square pan. Spread ice cream over cookies. Whip the cream; add sugar nuts and the rest of macaroons. Spread over ice cream. Freeze.

title: Soncho'S(Soft Tacos)
instructions: Brown beef and onion and drain well. Add tomatoes. Mix. Add rest of ingredients. Fill soft shell flour tortillas. Garnish with cheese lettuce and chopped tomatoes. Makes 4 to 6.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs oil and sour cream; pour half in long cake pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon together; spread over batter. Add rest of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle croutons in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown and drain sausage; sprinkle over croutons. Add grated Cheddar cheese and put over sausage. Beat eggs with 2 cups milk. Pour over top and refrigerate overnight. Mix mushroom soup with 1/2 cup milk and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Port
instructions: Do this the night before Combine and cook stock and 1 cup Port in 3 quart saucepan until reduced to 3/4 cup (takes 1 hour). Preheat oven 15 to 20 minutes to 400\u00b0. Place roast on rack in roasting pan; cover roast with butter. Bake 35 to 45 minutes. Rest 15 to 20 minutes. Meat thermometer should register 125\u00b0 or rare. Keep warm in 120\u00b0 oven if needed. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat. Add shallots remaining Port and red wine vinegar; bring to boil over medium heat. Scrape any brown bits and mix in; let boil 1 minute. Transfer sauce to a 9 to 10-inch skillet; add reserved stock and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce and simmer 2 minutes. Whisk in butter 1 tablespoon at a time; add salt and pepper. Pour in sauce boat. Superb! (Recipe can be doubled.)

title: Old Timer'S 14 Day Pickles
instructions: Put 1 cup of salt to 1 gallon of pickles in water. Boil 1 gallon of water. Have pickles in jar; never take them out. Put salt in the water. Pour boiling hot water onto pickles and let set for 8 days. On the eighth day drain off water; rinse pickles in jar 2 or 3 times (just let water run over them). Pour clear boiling water over them and let set for 24 hours. Drain this off and put 2 tablespoons of alum in 1/2 gallon of water. Bring to a boil and pour over pickles. Cover the pickles. Let this set for 24 hours. Drain and rinse as before.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Peel and slice cucumbers and sprinkle with salt. Let set for 20 minutes. Rinse and add sour cream vinegar onion sugar and pepper. Let chill for 1 hour.

title: Perfect Apple Pie
instructions: Peel core and thinly slice apples (6 cups).

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook roast until well done. Cut meat into cubes. Dice onion and add to meat broth and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix in Kitchen Bouquet and 2 tablespoons cornstarch. Cook all together until onion is tender. Add sour cream; stir well. Pour over cooked rice potatoes or noodles.

title: Spaghetti Patties
instructions: About 45 minutes before serving In large bowl combine all ingredients except salad oil. In large skillet over medium heat in 3 tablespoons hot salad oil drop 3 heaping 1/2 cup mounds of spaghetti mixture. Using a pancake turner press each mound into a 4-inch patty. Fry patties until golden brown about 7 minutes turning once. Remove to platter; keep warm. Repeat with remaining spaghetti mixture adding more oil if necessary. Serve with any meat poultry or fish dish in place of potatoes or rice.

title: Green Wonder Salad
instructions: Drain all vegetables. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Parfait
instructions: Put sugar and water in a saucepan. Boil until the syrup spins a thread (about 5 minutes); beat stiff. Beating constantly pour the syrup slowly over egg whites. Keep beating until mixture is cool. Fold in heavy cream. Fold in strawberries. Freeze until firm. Serves 10.

title: Hobo Stew
instructions: Brown garlic and ground chuck together. Cook cabbage and carrots together 20 minutes. Drain. Add ground chuck that has been browned with garlic and other vegetables. Simmer for 30 minutes. Dont stir too often or cabbage will turn to mush. Freezes well.

title: Sunday-Supper Salad
instructions: In large salad bowl combine bologna eggs cheese onion and parsley. Stir the salt pepper vinegar and salad oil to mix well. Pour over mixture in salad bowl; lightly toss until salad is well coated with dressing. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Just before serving garnish edge of bowl with greens. Makes 6 servings.

title: Butter-Rum Sauce
instructions: In heavy saucepan combine brown sugar flour and salt. Stir in water. Stir in evaporated milk and corn syrup. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in nuts butter or margarine and rum flavoring. Serve warm over scoops of vanilla ice cream or slices of angel cake. Makes 2 cups sauce.

title: Copper Pennies (Carrots)
instructions: Cook carrots for 8 to 10 minutes in a small amount of water. Drain; add remaining ingredients. Mix well cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight. Serve hot or cold. Makes a big bowl full. Number of servings depends on size of servings.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 of butter and 2 cups corn flakes in mixing bowl. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Put crushed corn flakes on top and drizzle remaining butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Old Timey Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: One of the secrets of these cookies is the use of butter. Do not substitute. Combine butter salt and peanut butter; mix well. Gradually add granulated sugar and brown sugar. Cream thoroughly after each addition. Add eggs mixing well. Sift together the flour and soda; blend with the first mixture. Drop the dough by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheets. Or roll the dough into balls 3/4 to 1-inch in diameter. Place on baking sheets. Press lightly with fork to flatten. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 10 to 12 dozen cookies.

title: No-Peek Chicken
instructions: Put uncooked rice in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix melted margarine milk and soup. Pour over rice. Lay the chicken on top of this. Sprinkle soup mix over the chicken. Seal well with foil. Bake 2 1/2 hours in 325\u00b0 oven. Do not peek!

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Blend sugar and flour together. Gradually add the well beaten eggs. Mix in butter. Add buttermilk. Sprinkle in coconut. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm and brown.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Mix sugar oleo and white syrup and cook (boil but not real hard) until one degree before soft ball stage on candy thermometer. Remove from heat immediately. Then add soda vanilla butter extract and marshmallows. Pour over popcorn until evenly coated. Butter hands and form into balls. Do not pack very hard. Delicious.

title: Chicken Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on box and mix all ingredients except for cheese. Put into lightly oiled casserole dish or pan; 9 x 13-inch is good. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Cube cheese into Pyrex dish. Add chilies chili and green onions. Bake in low oven for 45 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Ultimate Margaritas
instructions: In a blender mix everything together using limeade can as a measuring cup. Pour over ice or add ice cube in blender for frozen margaritas.

title: Easy Bake Tuna Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook noodles and drain. Mix milk mushroom soup celery soup and tuna together. Cook over medium heat until it is creamy. Pour over noodles in a casserole dish. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes (ovens may vary). Remove from oven. Sprinkle cheese on top. Continue to bake till cheese is melted.

title: Linda'S Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Pour melted margarine over fruit and nuts. Beat eggs and sugar. Add flour and soda (which have been sifted together) alternating with buttermilk. Fold in fruit and nuts. Grease and flour tube pan and add cake mixture. Bake at 300 degrees for 2 hours. Cool on rack.

title: Macaroon Custard
instructions: Scald milk in a double boiler. Mix sugar cornstarch and egg yolks with 3 tablespoons of milk. Add to scalded milk. Cook until thickens; then fold in beaten egg whites and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Add whole or broken macaroons.

title: Beef Or Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Saute onions and garlic. Blend flour. Stir in broth milk chiles salt and cumin. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Reduce heat; simmer for 5 minutes. Stir occasionally; set aside. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon a little sauce in the center of each tortilla. Spread to edge. Add 2 tablespoons meat down the center of tortilla. Sprinkle cheese over meat. Roll up tortilla and place in baking dish seam side down. Pour remaining sauce. Sprinkle green onions. Add remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients and set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 9 x 13-inch pan add half of mix then add half of chocolate mixture. Add rest of batter then other half of chocolate mixture. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Ro-Tel Rice
instructions: Brown meat and drain. In a large casserole dish combine cooked ground beef with all the remaining ingredients (except grated cheese). Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated thoroughly about 30 minutes. Remove from oven top with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Bring shortening sugar molasses and vinegar to a boil. Cool; add egg. Mix dry ingredients; add to hot mixture mixing well. Chill. On a lightly floured surface roll thin cookies 1/8-inch. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake 8 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool 5 minutes. Frost and/or decorate. Place in plastic bags and tie with ribbon. Good to eat and/or to decorate Christmas tree.

title: Icebox Lemon Pies
instructions: Empty can of milk in large bowl. Add lemonade. Mix well. Add sour cream and mix well. Add Cool Whip with a wire whisk. Pour into pie shells. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Christmas Kahlua Balls
instructions: In a large bowl combine cookies nuts and 1 c. sugar. Add Kahlua and corn syrup and mix thoroughly. Shape into 1 inch balls and roll each in powdered sugar. Place in air tight container and chill overnight. Yield 3 dozen.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Crumble sausage in large saucepan. Cook over medium-low heat. Add onion; cook and stir until transparent. Drain discarding all but 2 tablespoons of drippings. Stir in flour; cook over medium-low heat for about 6 minutes. Stir in milk. Add seasonings. Cook stirring until thickened. To serve slice biscuits and spoon gravy over halves.

title: Smoked Sausage (Hawaiian Style)
instructions: In a large skillet place sliced sausages and 1 can pineapple chunks plus juice. Add more if necessary. Cook until sausage is done. Prepare Tater Tots at same time. Serve with cottage cheese.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in top of double boiler until marshmallows melt. Remove top pan and set on low heat for 6 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Cook onions in margarine until soft but do not brown (use tops and bottoms). Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish with cover. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until rice is tender and dry. Toss lightly with fork. Yield 6 servings.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; add flavoring. Add flour gradually with buttermilk. Beat well. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

title: Honey-Mustard Ham Glaze
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl; mix well. Brush or spoon mixture over ham last 30 minutes of baking time. Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Potluck Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together soup butter salt pepper onion sour cream and cheese. Add 2 pounds hash brown potatoes (thawed) and mix well. Pour into a 3-quart buttered casserole.

title: Veal Parmigiana
instructions: Dip veal in beaten eggs then in bread crumbs. Brown on both sides in small amount of olive oil. Place in baking dish. Pour cooking sauce over veal. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Swirl Cake(No Oil Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 12 cup Bundt pan. In small bowl combine sugar and cinnamon; set aside. In large bowl blend cake mix applesauce and eggs until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at high speed. Pour 1/2 batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle with sugar mixture. Cover with remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool upright in pan 25 minutes. Turn onto serving plate. Cool completely. Dust with powdered sugar or a brown sugar glaze (drizzle).

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine and cook 12 to 15 minutes (until spins a fine thread). Remove from stove. Add 1 teaspoon soda. Spread thin on a buttered cookie sheet or marble slab. Cool. Break into pieces.

title: Thumb Print Pecan Cookies
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar gradually and cream until light. Add egg yolk. Mix thoroughly and blend in flour. Form into small balls (about 1-inch in diameter). Dip into egg white then into nuts. Place on greased cookie sheet and press firmly flat with bottom of glass. Bake in slow oven (300\u00b0) for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and press centers down and bake about 15 minutes. Cool and fill with a tart jelly or jam. Makes 15 to 18 cookies.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Soak eggplant 15 minutes in salted water and drain. Cook eggplant with water to cover until tender. Add salt and pepper. Mash. In skillet simmer onion celery and tomatoes until tender. In buttered casserole dish combine eggs eggplant crumbs and cooked vegetables. Add milk to mixture. Top with grated cheese and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Very similar to Frankes Cafeterias eggplant casserole.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well in a large bowl. Store in jars and use 4 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions and set aside. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle brown sugar over entire bottom of pan. Put crushed pineapple on top of brown sugar (juice and all). Pour cake batter over pineapple and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Have a cookie sheet or long pan ready when you take cake out of oven and immediately turn cake onto sheet.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Dip chicken pieces in barbecue sauce. Place in pan skin side up. Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Pile chicken at one end of pan. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Place them in the pan in drippings next to chicken. Sprinkle cheese over biscuits. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Chip Beef Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese and sour cream. Add dried beef green pepper and onion to the cream cheese and sour cream. Heat at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes. Stir occasionally while heating or microwave for 3 minutes.

title: Italian Bread(Pizza Crust Or Fried Dough)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together by hand or in a food processor. Knead for 8 minutes. Cover and let rise until double. Shape bread and let rise again covered. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 40 minutes. For crisp crust brush with water. For soft crust brush with butter.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water slowly over the cocoa stirring until mixture is consistency of cake batter. Beat egg yolks well and add to chocolate. Cream butter and sugar well; stir into mixture. Stir soda into buttermilk. Add buttermilk and flour slowly. Add vanilla. Fold in well beaten egg whites. Bake in two pans for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Saucy Cheese Tortellini
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions drain. Meanwhile in 3 quart saucepan combine soup peas carrots and pepper. Over medium heat bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Cook 4 minutes or until peas are tender stirring constantly. Stir in cheese and parsley. Heat until cheese melts. Stir in cooked tortellini. Makes about 5 cups.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Sift spices and flour; add soda to buttermilk. Add flour mixture and milk alternately to the sugar-butter mixture. Fold in jam preserves and nuts last until well-distributed. Bake about 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Puffed Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small mixing bowl; mix well. Toast 1 side of bread lightly; butter untoasted side. Spread chicken mixture over butter. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold in cheese. Spread over chicken mixture. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

title: Lo-Fat Chili
instructions: *Can use ground beef if you rinse beef with hot water after frying and draining fat.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli 2 to 3 minutes. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Drain fruit reserving juices. Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Add reserved juices with enough water to measure 1 3/4 cups. Mix well. Add blueberries and pineapple; mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish. Refrigerate until firm. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl; blend until smooth. Spread over gelatin. Refrigerate until well chilled.

title: Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to boil. Simmer 20 minutes and pour in hot jars; seal.

title: Aunt Alma'S Taco Salad
instructions: In memory of Aunt Alma Bunch.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 2 loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inches) or 3 loaf pans (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inches). Mix sugar and shortening in large bowl. Mix in eggs pumpkin and water. Stir in flour baking soda salt baking powder cinnamon and cloves until blended. Stir in raisins and nuts (optional). P our into pans. Bake about 1 hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean; cool 5 minutes. Loosen sides of loaves from pans; remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing. Makes 2 or 3 loaves (24 slices each). Serving size 1/24 loaf. Calories 120. Fat 4 g (with nuts) 3 g (without nuts).

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except nuts) and form into a ball. Roll in chopped nuts.

title: Country Pea Soup
instructions: Combine peas water tomato juice ham bone or hock potato celery onion carrot bay leaf salt and pepper in large kettle; bring to boiling lower heat and simmer stirring occasionally 1 1/2 hours or until peas are mushy-tender.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Drain pineapple between paper towels. Serve with fruit wedges or mini muffins.

title: Summer Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package mixing with pineapple juice instead of water. Pour batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake. Cool. Mix cream cheese and cold milk beating until smooth. Add instant pudding. Beat 2 minutes or until thickened and spread over cake. Spread drained pineapple over this and then cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with crushed nuts. Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Mama Ethel'S Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and gradually add sugar. Cream together until light and fluffy. Add eggs. Sift flour before measuring. Add spices and salt. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add buttermilk mixture and flour mixture beating after each addition. Lightly dredge the raisins and pecans with extra flour and add to batter. Add jam and stir. Pour batter into 2 greased and wax paper lined 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean. Frost with caramel icing.

title: Cooked Candied Carrots
instructions: Boil carrots until tender. Then add brown sugar butter and lemon juice. Cook on low heat until done. May need to add a little more brown sugar to taste.

title: Nanaw'S Buttermilk Cake(Serves 10 To 12)
instructions: For a different flavor add 1 teaspoon almond extract to the batter.

title: Blackberry Brandy Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cook and strain.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over 1 cup oatmeal and set aside. Cream together butter brown sugar white sugar vanilla and eggs. Sift together flour soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Mix with the creamed mixture. Add the oatmeal. Mix well. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake until cake test is done. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Shortcut Stroganoff
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add beef and cook until browned and juices evaporate stirring often. Add soup broth water Worcestershire sauce and pasta. Heat to boil; cook over medium heat 15 minutes or until done stirring. Add sour cream; heat through and enjoy.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Melt butter and hot water together. Add flour baking powder and salt. Pat into pie pans or refrigerate 1/2 hour and roll out dough. Makes three 9-inch pie shells.

title: Baked Onions
instructions: Mix liquids. Peel onions cut off top and bottom. Place in plastic bag with marinade for 1 hour. Remove onions from bag and save marinade. Arrange onions in baking dish. Pour 1/4 cup marinade over onions. To microwave cover dish and cook 9 to 10 minutes for 4 onions; 5 to 7 minutes for two onions. In oven cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Savory Cheese Tarts
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a mixing bowl; cut in shortening and cream cheese thoroughly with a pastry blender. Sprinkle with water 1 tablespoon at a time mixing with a fork until flour is moistened.

title: Blue Ribbon Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour bottoms of 2 (8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch) pans. In a large bowl blend all ingredients (except nuts) until moistened. Beat 1 minute at medium speed. Stir in nuts then pour into pans. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until you can pull a toothpick clean out of the center. Let cool 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and ground beef with onion in frying pan crumbling into small pieces while cooking. Drain grease. Transfer beef/sausage mixture into crockpot. Add next four ingredients and mix well. Cook on low several hours stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Zucchini Crescent Pie
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet cook zucchini and onion in margarine until tender. Drain. Stir in parsley and spices. In a large bowl blend eggs and cheese. Stir in vegetable mixture. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Place in ungreased 10-inch pie pan pressing over bottom and up sides to form crust. Spread mustard onto crust. Pour egg-vegetable mixture evenly into crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting into wedges. Serves 6.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Mix. Then add flour baking soda and salt. Finally add mashed bananas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. (Top should feel solid).

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Have butter and eggs at room temperature. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy (in mixer). Add vanilla and mace. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Add flour and mix only until blended. Put into a buttered and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake in moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours. Let stand in pan 5 minutes. Turn out to cool.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine Crisco sugar and milk well. Add flour and eggs one at a time. Add salt and vanilla. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Banana Loaf
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Mix dry ingredients and add creamed mixture together with bananas. Stir in nuts.

title: Taco Spread
instructions: Mix together sour cream cream cheese taco seasoning and lemon juice and spread in a large plate or pizza pan. Layer in order lettuce tomatoes onion and top with shredded cheese. Dip with tortilla chips.

title: Chickpea Sesame Dip
instructions: In food processor puree chickpeas 1/4 cup reserved liquid the garlic salt and lemon juice. Add sesame paste; whirl or stir until smooth and creamy adding more liquid salt and lemon juice if needed. Refrigerate covered at least overnight to develop flavors. To serve mound in shallow bowl; sprinkle with parsley. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Beer Batter For Fish Or Shrimp
instructions: Coat fillets with 3 to 4 tablespoons dry Bisquick. Mix 1 cup Bisquick salt egg and beer. Dip fillets in batter and fry 2 minutes on each side (4 minutes) or in deep fryer.

title: Sugared Pecans
instructions: Mix sugar honey and water in a saucepan and cook to soft ball stage (242\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add nuts. Stir until thick and creamy. Turn out on wax paper. Separate with a fork.

title: Easy Evergreen Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water. Add Kool-Aid and juice. Just before serving add the ginger ale. Keep all ingredients cold before mixing. Makes 50 punch cup servings.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Rinse and drain kraut. Bring the sugar and vinegar to a boil. Let it cool. Add remaining ingredients to kraut. Pour sugar and vinegar over the kraut. Refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: In a pan mix sugar flour and 1 cup milk. In a mixing bowl divide eggs setting whites aside. Beat egg yellows and add 1 cup milk. Add yellow egg mixture to ingredients in pan and cook over medium heat until thick and boiling. Set off stove and add vanilla and butter. Stir in coconut. Put in cool pie crust.

title: Fruit Squares
instructions: Mix batter together; spread 3/4 of the batter into a well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Cover with pie filling then top with the remaining batter. Spread the batter gently using 2 forks. You do not have to cover all of the filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to package directions. Place pan on burner to melt butter (low setting). Stir in brown sugar (enough to completely cover bottom of pan). Distribute pineapple slices. Place one cherry in each slice. Spread cake batter evenly over mixture and bake until inserted toothpick comes out clean approximately one hour at 350\u00b0 or according to cake mix directions.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Fill a 9-inch buttered cake pan 2/3 full with peeled sliced apples. Mix cinnamon and sugar. Sprinkle on apples. Mix melted margarine 3/4 cup sugar flour egg walnuts and salt. Pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Topping
instructions: Melt chips milk and marshmallows (I do mine in microwave oven). Spoon over ice cream or cake while hot or store in refrigerator in closed jar.

title: Green Bean Roll-Ups
instructions: Place 4 to 6 beans on a half slice of bacon. Roll up and secure with toothpick. Place in shallow baking pan. In separate bowl melt margarine and add Worcestershire sauce and onion juice. Pour over beans. Marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours before cooking. Bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Then put on broil until the bacon is crisp turning roll-ups to cook evenly.

title: Orange Crush Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar Crisco and butter. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Cream until light and fluffy. Sift dry ingredients together. Add alternately with Orange Crush and flavorings. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix everything together except Cool Whip. Fold Cool Whip in last. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Set aside. Combine cream cheese eggs and 3/4 cup sugar. Beat until fluffy. Spread over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Set aside to cool. Combine pudding mix and milk. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Add pumpkin and cinnamon; mix well. Stir in 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread pudding mix over cream cheese layer. Spread remaining whipped topping over pudding layer. Sprinkle top with pecans. Store in refrigerator. Yields 15 servings.

title: Snow Flake Salad
instructions: Whip cream cheese until fluffy. Blend in whipped topping. Fold in remaining ingredients except green cherries. Pour into serving dish. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Garnish with green maraschino cherries.

title: French Green Bean-Pea Salad
instructions: Before serving crumble 5 or 6 slices of well drained bacon over top.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions together. Drain off excess fat. Mix all other ingredients except biscuits. Add beef and cream cheese mixture together. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Place biscuits on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Add sauces and simmer. Cook noodles and drain.

title: Janet'S Forgotten Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Whip egg whites with salt and cream of tartar to soft point. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff. Add vanilla. Pour in 8-inch square pan (greased). Put pan in oven and close door. Turn oven off. Leave overnight or 4 to 5 hours. Cover with Cool Whip and refrigerate at least 6 hours. Serve topped with thawed raspberries.

title: Doughnut Muffins
instructions: Using a fork beat egg in mixing bowl. Add oil and milk. Continue beating with fork. Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Place in 12 greased medium size muffin pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and put dot of butter or margarine on top of each muffin. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Beans And Broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients except beans. Simmer for 20 minutes. Toss and eat.

title: Buttermilk Chocolate Cake
instructions: Put chocolate in boiling water; stir until melted. Cool. Sift together flour sugar salt soda and baking powder. Add shortening buttermilk cooled chocolate and vanilla to dry ingredients. Beat vigorously for 2 minutes by hand or on medium speed with electric mixer. Add unbeaten eggs and continue beating for 2 minutes longer. Pour into greased and floured or paper-lined 9-inch round cake pans and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Cool slightly and remove from pans. Frost with favorite white frosting or white between layers and chocolate over top and sides.

title: Chili Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger in a large saucepan. Add onions chopped with chili powder tomato paste and Texas Pete. Cook until onions and hamburger are done. Add pintos (cooked). Simmer for 30 minutes. Salt to taste.

title: Taco Mix Dip
instructions: Peel pit and mash avocados with lemon juice salt and pepper. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasonings.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well in large bowl. Mix together flour salt baking soda and baking powder and add to sugar mixture. Mix in remaining ingredients. Dip out by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until almost brown. Makes 10 to 11 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Wash seeds well and stir with oil in bowl. Spread out on cookie sheet and sprinkle salt on top. Bake at 250\u00b0 until crisp and slightly brown.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour shortening and salt. Beat egg; add water and vinegar. Add to flour mixture. Work into ball.

title: Easy Baked Apple Squares
instructions: Beat sugar and eggs together. Add dry ingredients and mix. Add oil and vanilla and mix. Fold in walnuts and apples. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cut into squares. Serve hot or cold. Top with vanilla ice cream.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan and cook over medium heat (stirring continually) until it forms a ball. Turn out on cookie sheet or aluminum foil and cool until it can be easily handled. Then knead very well.

title: Ground Beef Dip
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until meat is browned stirring to crumble; drain. Wipe pan drippings from skillet before continuing. Return beef mixture to skillet; stir in tomatoes and remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until cheese melts. Serve with corn chips. Yields 4 cups.

title: Crispix Mix
instructions: Microwave Directions In large bowl combine cereal pretzels and nuts. Melt oleo. Add spices Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice to oleo. Pour over and mix into cereal mix. Microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes stirring after every 2 minutes. Cool on paper towels. (Can bake at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes; stir every 15 minutes.) Yields 9 cups.

title: Green Bean Bundles
instructions: Mix margarine brown sugar soy sauce and garlic powder. Drain beans in colander; cut bacon strips into 3 equal pieces (cut through whole package of bacon and stack short strips; this will be easier to work with). Gently stretch each piece of bacon and wrap around 10 (or more) green beans; fasten with toothpicks. Place each bundle making rows into a large glass baking dish. Marinate overnight with margarine brown sugar soy sauce and garlic powder. Cover. Refrigerate overnight covered with Handiwrap. Bake uncovered 30 minutes (or more) at 350\u00b0. When brown they are ready. If beans appear done and bacon isnt brown under broiler watch carefully.

title: Spanish Steak
instructions: Cut meat into small pieces. Brown in skillet with olive oil. Add chopped onions. Cook until slightly brown. Chop celery and green pepper fine. Add to other ingredients and bring to a simmer. Let simmer for 1 hour. Serve over rice noodles or macaroni that has been cooked separately.

title: Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Place mix in mug equal to 1/2 of total volume. Fill with hot water. Makes 50 cups.

title: Cold Beet Soup-Russia(Svekolnik)
instructions: Bring chicken stock and water to a boil with the vegetables garlic salt and pepper. Simmer 10-15 minutes. Stir in the sugar. Continue cooking for 30 more minutes. Let soup cool to room temperature then stir in lemon juice. Chill soup in refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Garnish with chopped parsley and sour cream.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Break spaghetti into quarters. Cook in water containing 1 tablespoon cooking oil; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Mix with the dressing. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Slice mushrooms in half through stems. Quarter artichoke hearts and combine with mushrooms. Combine remaining ingredients and heat but do not boil. Pour over mushrooms and artichoke hearts. Refrigerate overnight. Remove peppercorns and bay leaf before serving.

title: Quick Lemon Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together dry cake mix and pie filling. Pour onto a 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients thoroughly. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Creamy Chicken Piccata
instructions: Combine flour and paprika in bowl. Dredge chicken in flour and brown in margarine in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook through. Remove from pan. Stir in remaining 1 tablespoon of flour. Gradually add cream water and bouillon granules over low heat. Cook and stir 5 minutes until bouillon is completely dissolved. Stir in lemon juice and sherry. Add cooked chicken and mushrooms. Simmer covered 15 to 20 minutes longer. Top with cheese prior to serving. Serves 4.

title: Good Sloppy Joes
instructions: In a skillet brown ground chuck or hamburger then drain off fat. Add chicken gumbo ketchup and mustard. Simmer and heat for 15 minutes. Warm buns.

title: Plantation Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until done.

title: Minted Fruit Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients except fruit. Stir until sugar dissolves. Pour lemon mixture over; cover. Chill 3 hours or overnight stirring occasionally. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes about 8 cups.

title: Caramel Balls
instructions: Mix Marshmallow Creme sugar and vanilla. Knead until well blended and soft. Roll into balls and let sit in refrigerator overnight. Melt caramels in double boiler. Dip balls in caramel and roll in nuts.

title: Crispy Coleslaw
instructions: Combine first three ingredients in a large bowl. Set cabbage mixture aside. Combine mayonnaise sugar vinegar and seasoning stir well. Pour over cabbage mixture toss well cover and refrigerate coleslaw several hours. Serve cole slaw in lettuce lined bowl and garnish with pepper rings and pimento if desired.

title: Blender Pesto
instructions: Place basil olive oil pine nuts garlic and salt in a blender. Mix at high speed. Stop from time to time to scrape sides of blender with rubber spatula. When ingredients are evenly blended pour into a bowl. Beat by hand the 2 grated cheeses. Add softened butter and mix well. Before spooning pesto over pasta add 1 tablespoon water to the pesto from the water the pasta was cooked in.

title: Almond Chicken Casserole
instructions: You may also use fresh mushrooms as desired sliced fairly large or canned mushrooms. Mix ahead. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. You can add a vegetable of your choice if desired beans peas corn or mixed vegetables. Serves 6.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut circle on top of peppers. Pull top off and clean inside fully. Do not break peppers. Cook peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain peppers. Cook hamburger and onion together in skillet. Drain. Stir in garlic salt rice and 1 can tomato soup. Stuff peppers with hamburger mixture. Stand peppers upright in ungreased baking dish. Pour remaining can of soup over peppers. Cover and cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover cook 15 minutes longer. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Grease baking dish. Put in rice. Sprinkle onion on top. Dissolve bouillon cubes in the boiling water. Pour over rice. Place pork chops on top. Cover tightly. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chocolate Pixies
instructions: Sift Flour Baking Powder and Salt; set aside. Melt Butter and Chocolate; cool slightly. Blend in Sugar Eggs (1 at a time). Beat one minute. Add sifted ingredients and nuts. Mix and chill 15 minutes. Shape into balls. Roll in Powdered Sugar. Bake at 350 for 18 - 20 minutes.

title: Four-Fruit Party Punch
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in punch bowl. Add ginger ale and club soda just before serving. Float scoops of orange sherbet in punch.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork(Microwave)
instructions: Toss together pork and cornstarch in 2-quart glass casserole. Stir in remaining ingredients except green pepper. Cover with glass lid or plastic wrap. Microwave on roast for 25 minutes. Stir in green pepper. Re-cover and continue cooking on roast for 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Let stand covered 5 minutes before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Easy Cookies
instructions: Mix and spoon out onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Honey-Glazed Baked Ham
instructions: Wrap ham in heavy-duty foil and bake until tender. While ham is baking mix pineapple juice honey and mustard in saucepan and simmer until mixture is thick about the consistency of molasses. One half hour or so before ham is ready to be served remove from the oven. Score the top and decorate with cloves. Coat ham with sauce and return to oven for 30 minutes. Additional basting may be necessary to obtain heavy glaze. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix cool milk with pudding mix until thick and fold in Cool Whip. In a 13 x 11-inch dish place a layer of pudding mixture then a layer of graham crackers. Repeat layers finishing with crackers on top.

title: Ricky'S Favorite Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef onions salt and pepper; drain. Add Italian seasoning and bell pepper. Let simmer 15 minutes. Add tomato ingredients and let simmer 15 minutes more. Boil noodles until tender.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in frypan and brown. Then add next 4 ingredients and let mixture simmer about 15 minutes. While simmering mixture cook 2 different kinds of macaroni (1/2 pound of each) drain and add to mixture. Put 1/2 of mixture into large baking dish. Put 1/2 pound of cheese on top of mixture in baking dish. Add remaining mixture and top with remainder of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Darn The Calories!  Full Speed Ahead Salad Dressing
instructions: Whip all the ingredients together in a mixer or blender at moderate speed. If too thick thin with added coffee cream.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil and peel potatoes. While warm sprinkle salt pepper and vinegar. Add onion and celery. Combine mayonnaise mustard and cream; pour over salad. Toss well. Chill at least 2 hours. Sprinkle with parsley and crumbled bacon.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Bake pie shell at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Set aside. Saute onion and bacon in butter just until coated. Add spinach stirring well. Cook 2 minutes. Add flour salt pepper and nutmeg mixing well. Combine eggs half and half and cheese. Beat well. Stir into spinach mixture. Pour into pie shell and bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until top is golden and center is set.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and cut up chicken breasts. Saute onion in margarine in large saucepan. Add soups and tomatoes. Heat a few minutes to mix well. Tear tortillas into quarters and grate cheese. Grease large casserole. Alternate layers of tortillas sauce chicken and cheese. Repeat until ingredients are used up. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Puppy Chow Mix
instructions: Melt butter milk chocolate and peanut butter in microwave. Put Crispix in large container. Pour melted mix over Crispix. Stir until coated. Sift confectioners sugar in a bag pour Crispix into sugar and shake until coated.

title: Wild Duck
instructions: Season\tdressed ducks inside and out.\tStuff each duck with mixture of 1 section each apple orange celery and onion. Cover each duck breast with 2 slices of bacon. Place in a 12-inch Dutch oven with 13 coals on top and 15 coals on the bottom. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix together. Scoop into greased muffin tins. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Yields 16 to 24 depending on size of tins.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together right before serving and refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Bake
instructions: In Dutch oven cook beef onion and garlic until done. Drain in undrained tomatoes tomato sauce mushrooms and spices. Boil gently uncovered 20 to 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in drained spaghetti. Put half of the meat sauce in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with Mozzarella and top with Parmesan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This dish will freeze.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix coloring and cocoa together; let set. Beat together the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and continue beating. Add coloring cocoa and vanilla. Stir well. Alternately add cake flour and salt which have been sifted together and the buttermilk. Beat hard. Stir in the vinegar and soda. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35-40 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: After eggs have cooled peel and slice in half lengthwise. Hollow out eggs and put yolks in a separate dish. Add mayonnaise mustard salt pepper and parsley. Mix until creamy may be slightly lumpy. Use ingredients to taste. Stuff eggs with mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve chilled.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Melt butter in heavy frypan. Add meat and onion; cook until brown stirring frequently. Add remaining ingredients; stir and cover. Cook over low heat for 20 to 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Yields 4 servings.

title: Salmon-Macaroni Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir together beaten eggs macaroni salmon chunks bread crumbs cheese and salt. Turn mixture into a greased 10-inch oven-safe skillet or a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until set in center. Cut into wedges or squares and garnish each serving with a parsley sprig.

title: Chili Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; salt to taste. Add tomato paste chili mix chili powder and water. Simmer 10 minutes. Layer in glass casserole dish(s) meat mixture tortillas (approximately 3) pinto beans olives and cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves approximately 4 to 6.

title: Mock Cream Of Mushroom Soup(Lo-Fat)
instructions: Drain mushrooms into measure and add water to make 1/2 cup juice. In a small saucepan heat oil over medium heat. Add flour and bay leaf stirring constantly for 1 minute. Gradually add mushroom liquid milk oleo and pepper stirring constantly until it thickens (2 to 3 minutes). Remove from heat and discard bay leaf. Pour into a blender and blend until smooth. Add the mushrooms and garlic powder blending until pureed. Can be used in recipes calling for mushroom soup. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Quick Jambalaya
instructions: In large skillet combine oil onion & green pepper. Cook over low heat 5 minutes or until onion & peppers are tender stirring occasionally. Stir in chicken rice beans tomatoes salsa thyme and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 10-15 minutes or until flavors are blended.

title: Fudge Deluxe Pie
instructions: In heavy saucepan over medium heat melt chocolate with Eagle Brand milk and salt. Cook and stir until very thick and fudgy 5 to 8 minutes. Add water; cook and stir until mixture thickens and boils. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Cool 15 minutes. Chill thoroughly for 20 to 30 minutes; stir. In large mixer bowl beat whipping cream until stiff; fold in cooled chocolate mixture. Pour into prepared pastry shell. Chill 3 hours or until set. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Flank Steak Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients and marinate meat all day. Great on the grill.

title: Carrots
instructions: Slice carrots and cook; do not overcook. Drain then add thin sliced green pepper and onion. Mix soup sugar oil and vinegar; bring to a boil. Pour over vegetables. Let stand for 24 hours. Serve cold.

title: Ground Pork And Kraut
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pat out on waxed paper to 7 x 11-inch size. Drain kraut and mix with onion. Spread over pork; roll. Place bacon across top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie *
instructions: Mix together coconut and pecans and set aside. On low heat melt chocolate and margarine; stir until blended. Remove from heat gradually blend in evaporated milk. Set aside. Mix together sugar cornstarch and salt. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually blend in chocolate mixture. Pour into two unbaked pie shells. Sprinkle coconut and nut mixture over top of pies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Filling will be soft but will set while cooking. Cool at least 4 hours before cutting.

title: Maple Cream Fudge
instructions: Cream cheese until smooth slowly blending in sugar and flavoring and nuts. Mix until blended (use hands). Press into well greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Chill until firm.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Make a well in the flour and add the shortening buttermilk salt and soda. Stir until dough leaves sides of bowl. Turn out on floured board and work slightly. Pat out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut biscuits out and place in pan or on cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Smoked Doves
instructions: Baste doves in a mixture of lemon melted butter lemon pepper Italian dressing and Worcestershire sauce. Wrap each dove with a strip\tof bacon. Place in a pan and smoke in a smoker 15 minutes on each side.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: In a shallow glass bowl combine orange juice and cornstarch and mix well. Stir in chicken. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours. Drain chicken and discard juice mixture. In a small bowl combine broth and soy sauce. Set aside. In a wok or large nonstick skillet heat oil over medium heat. Add garlic and ginger. Stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add chicken and stir-fry 3 minutes. Add vegetables and stir-fry until crisp-tender about 5 minutes. Stir in broth and mix. Place 1/2 cup rice on each plate. Top with the chicken mix. Serves 4.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Put rice in water overnight or simmer until water is absorbed. Keep milk and eggs at room temperature. In large bowl Combine milk eggs sugar vanilla and salt. Mix well. Gradually add rice mixture to egg mixture. Pour into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 min. Stir well. Sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon.

title: Swiss Cheese Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except almonds. Mix well. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Orangeade
instructions: Mix together and pour over crushed ice.

title: Strawberry Sorbet
instructions: Combine strawberries orange juice and sugar to taste in food processor or blender. Whirl until pureed about 2 minutes. Add water lemon juice and orange rind. Whirl just until combined. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Freeze until firm 2 to 3 hours. Remove from freezer. Let stand 15 minutes. Break into chunks; transfer in 2 batches to food processor. Whirl until thick puree. Serve immediately or return to pan and cover. Freeze several hours or until firm. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Amber Crunch Sundae
instructions: Melt butter and combine with rest of ingredients except ice cream. Spread half of mixture in a 6x12 inch pan. Top with softened ice cream. Spread remaining mixture over top of ice cream. Freeze until firm. Cut into squares and serve with Amber Sauce.

title: Six Weeks Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix boiling water and All Bran; let cool. Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Then add buttermilk flour soda and salt. Mix then add bran mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Put remaining dough in refrigerator. Do not stir when taken out of refrigerator.

title: Microwave Mexican Casserole
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap; fold back a small edge of wrap to allow steam to escape. Microwave at High for 6 to 7 minutes or until meat is browned stirring once. Drain. Add mushroom soup enchilada sauce and evaporated milk; stir well.

title: Magic Eggs
instructions: With a round cookie cutter or a glass cut a circle in the bread. Lightly toast the bread. Place some butter in the skillet and heat. Add a slice of bread to the hot skillet. Break an egg into the hole. When the bottom of the egg has cooked turn over and cook the other side. Take care not to break the yolk. When done remove to the serving plate and begin the next egg. In a large skillet it is possible to cook two at the same time. Add more butter as necessary.

title: Scrambled Egg Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon. Mix all ingredients together (except cheese). Pour into a greased baking dish and cover with grated cheese. Set in a pan of water and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fantastic Microwave Fish(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: Place the 1/4 cup of olive oil in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch oval dish. Cook uncovered at 100% in a high-power oven for 2 minutes. Stir in tomatoes; cook for 8 minutes. Place the basil garlic and remaining oil in a food processor. Process until lightly chopped. Remove the dish from the oven. Stir in the basil mixture pepper flakes and 1 teaspoon of the salt. Cook uncovered for 1 minute.

title: K F C Cole Slaw
instructions: Be sure that the cabbage and carrots are chopped up into very fine pieces (about the size of rice kernels). Combine the sugar salt pepper milk mayonnaise buttermilk vinegar and lemon juice. Beat until smooth. Add the cabbage and carrots. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Basil Pasta Sauce
instructions: In saucepan saute the mushrooms onions and garlic in oil. Add tomatoes wine (or broth) basil and salt. Bring to boil; simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir in the sausage and tomato paste; heat through. Serve over pasta.

title: Hot Fruit
instructions: Cook in a large kettle for 25 minutes on top of stove stirring occasionally.

title: Spinach Squares Appetizer
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add milk salt pepper onion spinach and cheese; mix. Pour into casserole pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Cut into squares. Makes a bunch. If not enough double everything. Enjoy!

title: Microwave Spiced Apples
instructions: Peel and core apples. Cut in chunks. Place in small microwave-safe dish. Sprinkle with Equal and apple pie spice. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 1 minute. Remove plastic wrap. Stir in margarine. Cover and cook 1 minute longer. Remove cover. Stir and serve. Makes 2 servings.

title: Mommy'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine beef with 1/2 cup of the ketchup Worcestershire sauce bread milk and egg. Season with salt and pepper. Mix remaining ketchup (1 1/2 cups) with the brown sugar in a separate bowl. Smash meat mixture in a casserole dish. Pour ketchup mixture evenly over the top. Cut up the bell pepper (slice into rings for looks). Place on top. Bake at (preheated) 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until the top is almost burning.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and broccoli (drain) according to directions. Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl. Pour mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch chips in double boiler. Add noodles and nuts. Stir until coated. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.

title: Mary'S Dessert Cookies
instructions: Mix together and pat into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Mix ground beef cooked rice chopped onion salt and pepper and egg together. (Trim off thickest part of stem from cabbage leaves.) Divide meat into equal portions meat balls if you desire. Wrap each in a leaf fasten with wooden toothpicks. Brown cabbage rolls slightly in oil. Add tomato sauce and water to pan. Cook slowly for about 40 minutes.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar; blend in flour and salt. Roll tablespoons of dough into small balls about 1-inch in diameter. Place dough balls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Press a dent in each ball. Fill with preserves (apricot or raspberry are excellent). Sprinkle nuts on preserves. Bake 15 minutes. Cool and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Brown chicken in oil on both sides. Remove from skillet and add onion garlic tomato sauce tomatoes oregano celery seed salt and pepper. Place chicken back into skillet and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over spaghetti rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Marshmallow Kabobs
instructions: You will need 4 plastic straws.

title: Favorite Shortcake
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Cut in butter; add milk. Pat dough into greased 8-inch pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Turn on cake cooler to cool.

title: Strawberries 'N Cream
instructions: In a bowl combine milk and lemon juice. Stir just until mixture begins to thicken. Stir in berries. Beat cream just until it mounds. Fold whipped cream into berry mixture. Freeze until firm. Break up frozen mixture and place in a large chilled mixer bowl. Beat with electric mixer until smooth. Fold in nuts. Return to freezer. Makes 1 quart.

title: Buttermilk Pralines
instructions: In heavy 4 1/2 to 5-quart Dutch oven mix sugar soda corn syrup and buttermilk. Cook stirring occasionally over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes until candy thermometer reaches soft ball stage. Remove from heat and stir in margarine vanilla cinnamon and pecans. Stir until mixture starts to \set up.\ Quickly drop spoonfuls onto foil (shiny side up) which has been sprinkled heavily with salt. Makes about 3 dozen (really good).

title: Dip For Fresh Fruit
instructions: Whip cream cheese and then add marshmallow cream. These should be equal to 1 and 1. You may dip apple melons (especially when it is not too ripe) strawberries etc.

title: Luscious Lemon Cream
instructions: Beat eggs 1/2 cup sugar and lemon juice until foamy; set aside. Combine 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch and water; cook until thick and clear over medium heat. Add eggs; mix. Cook and stir until slightly thickened. Remove. Add vanilla and cool. Fold in whipped cream and chill. Serve dip with fresh fruit.

title: Aunt Helen'S Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix all together; cook until forms soft ball in cold water. Set aside and let cool then beat and spread on cake.

title: Avocado And Tomato Salad
instructions: Peel and pit avocado. Cut into bite-size pieces. Add sliced onion. Marinate mixture with oil vinegar salt and pepper about 10 minutes. Add sliced tomatoes. Mix and serve.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with tortilla chips. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chips. Cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers. Melt butter and mix with crumbs. Spread on bottom of 9x13 pan. Do not pack down.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Microwave cream cheese until soft. Combine in 9 x 9-inch baking dish with sour cream. The next layer is chili. The next layer is beans. Garnish with shredded cheese and peppers. Bake 20 minutes until bubbly in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: 5 Can Casserole
instructions: Mix the 5 cans together. Put bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Thinly slice apples. Combine apples flour cinnamon and nutmeg; simmer for 7 minutes.

title: Fresh Fruit Pie
instructions: Cook the first 6 ingredients together then add the jello. Add the fruit. A pie shell or a graham cracker crust may be used. Top with Dream Whip.

title: Apple Sauce Cake
instructions: Mix well. Pour into tube pan. Bake 325\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Chop 3 of the eggs and slice the other. Mix potatoes onion chopped eggs mayonnaise mustard bacon sour cream and oleo. Mix together well and top with pimentos and sliced egg. Serve this warm. Also good cold.

title: Basil Butter Beans
instructions: In saucepan combine beans onion celery and water. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until beans are tender to taste. Drain; add butter basil salt and pepper. Stir to coat. Serve immediately. Yields 2 servings. (Can be doubled to serve 4.)

title: Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: In large saucepan bring potatoes onion water and salt to boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer until potatoes are tender. Do not drain. Stir in milk.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown and drain meat; add rest of ingredients. Mix well and simmer for 10 minutes. Use Doritos chips for dip or spread over plate of chips.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Add flour sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Blend in melted butter. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Serve warm with whipped cream. Makes 1 (9-inch) pie. Pies freeze well for later use.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Combine and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Mrs. Mccarthy'S Irish Stew
instructions: Thoroughly brown meat in hot fat. Add water garlic sliced onions and seasonings. Simmer covered about 2 hours. Add carrots potatoes and small onions. Continue cooking 30 to 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add mushroom soup mushrooms and frozen peas. Cook 5 minutes more.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Saute ground beef and drain fat. Stir in barbecue sauce onions and sugar. Press each biscuit into a muffin pan. Spoon in meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Gonga'S Old-Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco together. Add sugar; beat for 10 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating 2 minutes after each egg. Sift flour and baking powder together and stir in gradually. Add flavoring. Bake for 120 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cake leaves sides of tube pan.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Season as desired. Make mashed potatoes. In casserole dish place hamburger on bottom then layer corn green beans and mashed potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Jeanie'S Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Cook first 2 ingredients until syrupy. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Pasta With Zucchini
instructions: Heat large frying pan and saute pancetta until clear. Remove meat and fat from pan. Drain and discard fat and set meat aside. Add oil to pan and saute garlic for just a minute. Add zucchini and saute over high heat until it is hot not mushy. Add cream and stir.

title: Great Aunt Edith'S Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cream shortening and sugar. Add one egg at a time; add nuts and bananas. Add flour; cream mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Amaretto Bread Pudding
instructions: Pudding Break up bread in small pieces and place in medium bowl. Cover with half and half. Cover bowl and let stand for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish with butter. In a small bowl beat eggs sugar and almond extract. Stir into bread mixture. Gently fold in raisins and almond into bread mixture. Spread bread mixture evenly in buttered baking dish. Set on middle rack of oven and bake 50 minutes until golden. Remove and let cool.

title: Honey Rum Balls
instructions: Combine crumbs cocoa sugar salt and nuts. Stir in honey and rum. Mixture should be stiff. Shape into bite-sized balls and roll in powdered sugar. Better if allowed to stand 24 hours.

title: Cream Cheese Candy Mints
instructions: Mash the cream cheese add the powdered sugar gradually until the candy mixture becomes like a stiff pie dough (approximately 3 1/4 cups). Add desired flavoring and paste color. Roll into small balls. Roll balls in granulated sugar. Press balls in candy mold unmold at once. Yield 60 candies.

title: Fruitcake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar; add eggs. Sift together 2 cups of flour and other dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients alternately with juice. Use 1 cup of flour with fruits and coconut before adding them to batter. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms and remove stems. Mix all other ingredients. Spoon mixture into mushroom caps. Bake on rack at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Wash and cut carrots into 1/2-inch slices. Place in 1-quart casserole with brown sugar and margarine. Cover and microwave on High for 9 to 11 minutes stirring in 5 minutes. Mix water and cornstarch until smooth. Stir into carrot mixture. Cover and microwave at High for 2 to 4 minutes until thickened. Stir before serving.

title: Aunt Edith'S Gallettes(Pizzelles)
instructions: Cream together butter light brown sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs one at a time. Gradually add flour. Chill dough for several hours. Roll into walnut sized balls; flatten slightly. Bake on preheated pizzelle iron for approximately 35 seconds on each side. If using electric iron follow manufacturers directions for time. Remove with spatula. Cool on wire rack.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Boil for 1 minute then cool. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl. Add vinegar mixture and toss. Pack into 4 (1 pint) freezer containers. Cover and label. Freezes up to 1 month. Thaw in refrigerator about 8 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Bring to boil oleo water peanut butter and oil. Stir with a whisk. Remove from heat and add flour sugar baking soda milk eggs and vanilla. Mix into cooked mixture with whisk stirring well. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until tested done.

title: My Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant in salted water until tender; drain. In mixing bowl pour stuffing melted margarine slightly beaten egg eggplant and sauteed onion (or chopped and boiled in eggplant salted water). Mix the cream of mushroom soup in milk of choice with 1/2 of the cheese. Pour into casserole dish; top with remaining cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix marshmallows cranberries crushed pineapple and sugar in a bowl and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Just before serving fold in the nuts and whipped cream. This is a great holiday dish.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs together. Add pumpkin. Then add dry ingredients then water stirring just until mixed. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quickie Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Soak yeast in warm water 5 minutes. Pour milk over sugar and salt in bowl; stir to dissolve. Beat in Crisco egg 1 cup flour and softened yeast. Cover and let rise in warm place 15 minutes. Stir in remaining flour to make soft dough. Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead lightly.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and cream cheese blending in sugar with electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time and continue to blend. Add flavorings and flour; beat until smooth. Do not overbeat. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours or until cake is golden. Test for doneness.

title: Peppered Salmon Steaks
instructions: Prepare charcoal fire or preheat broiler. Combine seasonings in small bowl. Rinse fish in cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Rub olive oil onto salmon steaks. Rub seasoning mixture onto both sides of salmon steaks. Grill over charcoal or broil in oven until no longer opaque in center (about 5 minutes per side). Makes 4 servings per recipe. (You can also use halibut tuna swordfish or grouper.)

title: Corn Soup
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Add onion and saute until soft. Put corn through food processor and add to bacon and onion. Cook until brown. Add oleo and flour. Combine well and cook slowly for 3 minutes. Add milk salt and pepper. Cook until thickened. Add 2 cups of light cream and stir until smooth. Serves 6.

title: Crunchy Fudge Sandwiches
instructions: In a large saucepan melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter over a very low heat stirring until smooth. Stir in cereal. Press half the mixture in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill. Set remaining mixture aside.

title: Sante Fe Chicken
instructions: Peel avocado and cut into 1-inch chunks. Place in medium bowl with tomatoes onion garlic and cilantro. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons lime juice 1 teaspoon salt and pepper to taste. Toss gently cover and refrigerate.

title: Sour Cream Fudge
instructions: Melt butter or oleo. Combine sugar cocoa Karo and sour cream in pan and add to melted oleo. Cook 3 or 4 minutes (soft ball in cold water). Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Place pan in cold water for 2 minutes. Add chopped nuts. Beat until it looks thick. Use an 8 x 8-inch greased pan.

title: Summer Squash And Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl; mix well. Pour into greased 9-inch square baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.

title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Press firmly into ungreased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake about 1 hour; let stand 5 minutes before slicing. (Can microwave for 18 to 20 minutes.)

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well. Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan; bake 1 hour. Drain; let stand 5 minutes.

title: Afternoon Delight(Broiled Crabmeat Sandwiches)
instructions: Combine crabmeat green pepper onion olives and salt. Mix together mayonnaise lemon juice and horseradish until well blended; add to crabmeat mixture. Place on toast slices. Top with cheese. Broil until cheese melts.

title: Stuffed Tomato Salad
instructions: Scald tomatoes and remove the skins. Cut a slice from the top of each and with a small spoon remove the seeds. Peel the cucumbers and cut them into dice. Season highly and mix with at least half the dressing. Fill the tomato cups with this and put a spoonful of the dressing on top. Sprinkle a very little finely chopped parsley over and serve on a bed of lettuce leaves.

title: Strawberry Chiffon Pie
instructions: Mix together the strawberries Jell-O sugar and eggs. Boil over hot heat for 5 minutes. Chill. Pour evaporated milk into a large bowl. Place in freezer until crystals form around the bowl. Beat with mixer until stiff. Fold in cold mixture. Mix well. Place in graham cracker crusts and chill.

title: Barbecued Roast
instructions: Place roast in Dutch oven. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over roast. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Blueberry Lemon Bread
instructions: Cream butter gradually add 1 cup sugar beat at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well. Combine flour salt and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternating with milk. Begin and end with flour mixture. Stir in lemon rind then fold in blueberries. Pour batter in 8 x 4 x 3-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until pick comes out clean. Combine 1/2 cup sugar and lemon juice in small saucepan. Heat until dissolves. Puncture top of bread with toothpick. Pour lemon juice over warm bread allowing to soak in. Cool for at least 30 minutes.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Blend lemon juice and condensed milk together. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Freeze.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Arrange stalks in a greased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top. Combine soup mayo lemon juice and curry. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter; sprinkle over all. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Trim with pimento strips. To make in microwave oven cook on High for 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Grandma Fends' Date Cookies
instructions: Combine dates 1/2 cup sugar and water. Bring to boil; add nuts and cool. Cream butter; add brown and white sugars. Add eggs. Sift flour soda cinnamon and salt. Add to butter. Chill. Roll out dough. Spread with date mixture. Roll back up. Let chill. Cut and bake at 350\u00b0 about 12 to 15 minutes. Makes approximately 5 dozen.

title: Chicken Oriental
instructions: Mix soup milk chicken onion celery and water chestnuts in 3-quart saucepan. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Reduce heat; keep warm. Mix Bisquick water and soy sauce until soft dough forms. Gently smooth dough into ball on well floured board. Knead 5 times; roll out. Cut into 1 to 1 1/2-inch squares. Pour chicken mix into a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Melt margarine and brush on top of dough squares. Bake for 15 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Blender Impossible Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend on high while counting to 10 slowly. Pour into a well-greased 10-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apple Drop Cookies
instructions: Sift flour with baking soda salt and spices into large bowl. Stir in walnuts apple and raisins. Set aside. Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg and cider; beat until combined. Stir in flour mixture. Mix well. Drop by tablespoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven about 8 minutes until golden brown. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Buttermilk Yeast Rolls
instructions: Crumble yeast into warm water in large mixing bowl. Stir to dissolve. Add buttermilk and sugar; let mixture stand 15 minutes. Add warm butter and eggs; mix. Sift soda and salt with 4 cups of flour; add to liquid mixture. Beat until smooth and batter forms. Add remaining sifted flour stirring with spoon until dough is no longer sticky. Knead on floured board. Place in large greased mixing bowl. Cover; let rise until double about 1 hour.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until done then drain. Cut boiled eggs up in small pieces. Crumble bacon up. Chop onion. Cut tomatoes up in small pieces. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Add salad dressing then refrigerate.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Sprinkle sugar over top of cranberries and let stand over night. Mix grapes pineapple nuts and marshmallows with cranberries. Fold in whipped cream.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Sift flour along with dry ingredients. Add shortening and cut in with a knife or pastry cutter. Add yeast to buttermilk and mix thoroughly. Roll dough as for biscuits. Cut to desired size. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Unused dough may be kept in refrigerator.

title: Pea Picking Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 in 3 or 4 layers. Let cool.

title: Barbecue Rice
instructions: Melt butter. Add celery and onions. Cook slowly until tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add the soup broth mushrooms and liquid smoke. Add the cooked rice. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggnog Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with eggnog. Fold in pecans raisins and chopped cherries. Bake in a loaf pan approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Combine and blend with mixer (low to medium speed) the sugar oil vanilla and pumpkin. Add eggs one at a time and blend. Add baking soda baking powder cinnamon and salt. Add flour and nuts. Blend on medium to high speed until batter is smooth. Pour batter into ungreased 11 x 16-inch (or similar size) jelly roll pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Salmon Stew
instructions: Slice potatoes onions and carrots; place them in a large pot and cover with water. Add butter salt and pepper; then cook vegetables until almost done. Stir in salmon and soup. Turn off heat. Stir in milk and serve.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix potatoes eggs flour onion salt pepper and garlic. In a skillet heat the oil and butter together until hot. Shape the mixture into patties and fry in hot oil until golden brown. Serves about 6.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together; cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve with fresh crisp vegetables.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with vegetable pan spray. Layer out potato slices. Lightly brush potato slices with oil. Sprinkle garlic powder and paprika over potato slices. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Holiday Crescent Braid
instructions: Roll each part of dough into rectangle 15 x 6-inches on a lightly floured board. Spread each with half the butter. Place on greased baking sheets. At 1-inch intervals on long sides of rectangles make 2-inch cuts with scissors.

title: Eggplant And Tomatoes
instructions: Peel and slice eggplant. Alternate layers of eggplant and tomatoes in 2-quart baking dish until full. Cover with wax paper. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Drain. Mix sauces together and pour over eggplant mixture. Put under broiler and brown (you can cook eggplant and tomatoes in microwave also).

title: Lemon Bar
instructions: Mix like cookie dough. Press in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
instructions: Salad Slice green onions. Mix cole slaw onions sunflower seeds almonds and noodles.

title: Potato Latkes *
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl. Add matzo meal salt and pepper. Grate onions and potatoes (after peeling) and place in colander. Run boiling water through to help retard color change. Mix onions and potatoes in bowl with egg mixture. Fry in oil until brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels. Makes about 14 medium size latkes.

title: Tender Beef Tips
