instructions: Trim fat off stew beef. Place meat in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over stew beef. Cover pan with foil. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 6 hours. (I often cook this in a crock-pot. It is just as good done that way.) This dish can be served with rice or noodles.

title: Hamwiches
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Press 1 package rolls in bottom of pan. Mix cheese milk eggs mustard and pepper together. Divide mixture in half. Add diced ham to 1/2 cheese mixture. Spread ham mixture on top of crescent layer. Spread second package of crescents on top of ham mixture. Spread remaining cheese mixture over crescents. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and poppy seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown. Cut in squares.

title: Baked Cod
instructions: Cut cod into serving pieces. Place fish in lightly greased baking dish. Pour melted margarine over fish. Top with Parmesan cheese pepper and paprika. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Sesame Carrot Sauce
instructions: Push garlic through press. Combine with ginger stock soy sauce honey and seed in a small dish. Microwave uncovered on High until bubbly about 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Toss with cooked broccoli or other vegetables; sprinkle on carrot. Serve warm as a side dish or slightly chilled on lettuce as a salad. Serves 4.

title: Fried Tomatoes
instructions: Dress up veggies by adding simple ingredients to canned or frozen English peas pearl onions sliced mushrooms sliced almonds or lemon pepper singly or in combination.

title: Hot Turkey Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and soup. Mix the rest of the ingredients and spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour mayonnaise and soup mixture evenly over the top. Bake 15 minutes in 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Rocky Road Candy Squares
instructions: Melt chocolate chips Eagle Brand and butter over low heat in medium saucepan. Stir together. Pour over the following ingredients which you have measured into a large bowl peanuts and marshmallows. Mix and fold until all covered. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan or dish which is buttered and lined generously with wax paper. Chill until firm. Lift out peel back the paper and slice uniformly into squares. To serve bring to room temperature. Stores well covered in refrigerator. This is the easiest best candy to make and eat. Great for Christmas treats.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Let strawberries sugar and eggs boil for 2 minutes (stirring the 2 minutes). Remove and add Jell-O. Set aside and let cool. Beat the Carnation milk until it stands in peaks (may add a little lemon juice until stands in peaks). Fold into Jell-O mixture. Pour into 2 graham cracker crust pie shells. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix thoroughly sugar shortening and eggs. Sift together and stir in flour cream of tartar and baking soda. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts. Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon. Place 2-inches apart. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Blueberry Or Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix and bake Jiffy cake according to instructions on box. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat cream cheese vanilla pudding and milk. Beat this well until smooth. Pour this over the cooled cake. Now put pie filling on top of this. Now spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle top with finely chopped nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Turkey Divine
instructions: Cook turkey legs until tender. Remove meat from bones. Cook broccoli 9 minutes on High in microwave stirring halfway through. Mix rest of ingredients together. Arrange broccoli in sprayed casserole dish. Top with meat. Pour soup mixture over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Molded Chicken Salad
instructions: Prepare the Jell-O with water including the vinegar and onion salt. Cool. Mix mayonnaise lemon juice and sour cream. Pour Jell-O mixture slowly into mayonnaise mix. Chill until it begins to set then add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate in 7 3/4 x 12-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan. Serves 12.

title: Good Bye Chicken(My Mother'S Recipe, Adapted For Microwave)
instructions: Pour milk into 6 to 8-cup glass measure. Heat at 70% power for 3 1/2 minutes. Remove from oven; set aside. Place butter and half of the salt and onion salt in 2 cup glass measure; place in oven. Heat on High for 45 seconds. At pause stir flour into butter until smooth. Return to oven and cook on High for 45 seconds. Remove from oven briskly stir in warm milk and pepper. Cook on High 3 to 5 minutes until of consistency of cream soup stirring every 2 minutes. Pour Minute rice into buttered 2-quart microwave dish. Combine chicken broth and remaining salt; pour over rice. Sprinkle half of the cheese over rice. Top with asparagus then chicken. Pour on sauce. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cook on 70% power uncovered for 10 to 12 minutes until cheese is melted and sauce bubbling. Top with slivered almonds and serve.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Cook peas 10 minutes and set aside. Dilute soup with chicken broth. Cover bottom of casserole dish with peas. Sprinkle eggs over peas. Crumble 4 or 5 crackers over this. Repeat layers. Pour chicken soup over top and sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Corn And Cheese Bake
instructions: Combine eggs and sour cream in a large bowl; stir in corn and next 5 ingredients. Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bake until cheese melts. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Overnight Salad
instructions: Spread mayonnaise over peas. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bacon bits. Cover with foil and leave in refrigerator overnight. Do not mix any of this until the next day then mix and eat.

title: Extra Creamy Fudge
instructions: Stir together margarine sugar and milk in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a full boil stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy thermometer reaches 234\u00b0 stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in chocolate until melted. Add remaining ingredients. Mix until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch or 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool to room temperature and cut into squares.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a 5-quart freezer. Fill to line on freezer with milk.

title: Cajun Creole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a Dutch oven. Cover with 3 quarts of water. Salt and pepper bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 3 hours. Shell devein and wash shrimp. Place in a pot of boiling water. Cook 6 minutes (until shrimp turns pink). Remove from water and drain. Place in bowl in refrigerator. Remove chicken from broth and cool. Add shrimp rice sausage (cut into bite-size pieces) chicken bouillon and chopped onion. Pour liquid from stewed tomatoes into chicken broth. Slice tomatoes and add to Creole. When chicken has cooled remove skin and debone; tear chicken into small pieces and add to mixture. Add okra cut into one-inch pieces crushed red pepper and gumbo file. Cover and cook until rice is tender. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Date Nut Pudding
instructions: Put dates and butter in mixing bowl. Pour boiling water over and soda and allow to cool a bit. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Pour into a greased or wax paper lined 9 x 13-inch baking dish and bake in slow oven for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Garnish with warm lemon sauce or whipped cream (Cool Whip).

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Combine pineapple strawberries milk and Cool Whip together until all ingredients are blended together. Add marshmallows and nuts; chill for 1 hour.

title: Homemade Ranch Style Dressing
instructions: Stir all of the dry ingredients listed; store in an airtight container.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix together all ingredients except cheese and potato chips. Put in casserole. Top with cheese and chips. Bake uncovered 10 to 15 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Mint-Wine Lamb Chops
instructions: Set oven on broil; trim fat from chops. Mix remaining ingredients. Brush chops with wine mixture. Place lamb on rack in broiler pan. Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat about 4 minutes or until brown. Brush again with wine mixture. Turn chops and brush the other side. Broil 5 to 7 minutes longer for medium doneness (160\u00b0). Makes 8 servings.

title: Buttermilk Pie 1
instructions: Beat eggs. Combine buttermilk flour sugar oleo and vanilla. Blend well. Bake 10 minutes at 275\u00b0; increase to 300\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Use unbaked pie shell.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together sour cream and baking soda and set aside.

title: Family Favorite Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onions in skillet; add tomato sauce salt and pepper. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Combine next 5 ingredients.

title: Strawberry Brownie Torte
instructions: Grease two 9-inch round layer cake pans. Line with wax paper extending up sides of pans. Grease wax paper. Prepare brownie mix as package directs for cake-like brownies. Put into prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until top springs back when touched. Cool then put this together just like a strawberry shortcake one layer of brownie next half of strawberries then half of the whipped topping then another layer of brownie then rest of whipped topping then rest of strawberries. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Carrot-Broccoli Medley
instructions: Place margarine salt nutmeg carrots and broccoli in 1-quart casserole.\tCover tightly and microwave on High (100%) for 4\tminutes; stir. Cover\tand microwave until vegetables are crisp-tender 2 to 4 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 4.

title: Jack'S Favorite Salsa Dip
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a large saucepan. Dice the onion or chop it in a blender. Sugar the mix to suit your taste. Bring to a boil then let it simmer for 18 to 20 minutes stirring frequently.

title: Broiled Or Grilled Turkey Steak
instructions: Blanch turkey in boiling water for 2 minutes. Remove from water; pat dry. Rub the steaks on all sides with mustard. Sprinkle on the tarragon and pepper. Grill or broil 5 to 6 inches from the heat source in middle of grill (high heat) until cooked through about 5 to 10 minutes on each side. Serve warm or slightly chilled.

title: Cake In A Cone
instructions: Follow directions on the box to prepare the cake batter. Place cones in ungreased muffin pans. Fill cones about 1/2 full (1/4 cup) - do NOT overfill the cone or batter will overflow and bake on the sides of the cones.

title: Chicken Cordon Blue
instructions: Flatten each breast to 1/4-inch thickness. Place one slice ham and cheese on top of chicken. (Do it in that order). Sprinkle with parsley and pepper. Roll and fasten with toothpick. Dip in egg and roll in crumbs. Brown in oleo. Place in casserole. Combine soup sour cream and mushrooms and pour over chicken. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Tommie'S Pie Crust
instructions: Mix the flour sugar and salt. Sift together. Add the Crisco. Mix with electric mixer until it resembles corn meal then add the cold water. Shape into 2 balls and roll out thin with a rolling pin. Simple enough for anyone to make! To cut down on fat use 3/4 cup Crisco.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread sour cream on bottom of a 10-inch quiche or pie plate. Can also use a large platter. Layer taco sauce on top of sour cream. Sprinkle with lettuce. Add tomatoes olives and onion. Top with cheese. Scoop up with Tostitos.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on the package. Drain. Melt 1/2 to 3/4 stick butter and cheese. Stir butter and cheese until creamy smooth. Mix with broccoli and pour into buttered casserole. Top with crushed Ritz crackers which have been added to melted stick of butter. Warm in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar egg yolks and small amount of milk until mixed well. Then add remaining milk with vanilla margarine and coconut. Cook on medium heat until thickened. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Noodle Pudding
instructions: Mix and bake in greased pan 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Add 2 cans cherries after 1 hour and bake again for 15 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes. Mix everything together and pour into 9 x 12-inch casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with buttered corn flake crumbs the last 15 minutes of baking time. This can be mixed a day ahead and refrigerated until ready to bake.

title: Wedding Soup
instructions: Make ground meat and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese into small meat balls. Drop meat balls into boiling chicken broth. Add spinach and noodles. Cook to boiling for 5 minutes.

title: Six Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 12-inch pan. Add ingredients by layer. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool in pan before serving.

title: Solo Poppy Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add Solo poppy filling. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in vanilla and sour cream. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add gradually to Solo poppy mixture beating well after each addition. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into greased 9 x 10-inch tube pan which has the bottom lined with wax paper. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour and 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from pan and peel off paper. Decorate by sifting confectioners sugar through a paper doily.

title: Fillets In Red Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in pan; add next 5 ingredients and saute until beginning to soften. Add next 4 ingredients and simmer until soft. Remove from pan and puree. Return half of sauce to pan; add fish in single layer if possible and top with remaining sauce and olives. Simmer until fish is cooked.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in refrigerator for a few hours. Actually is better prepared day before serving and keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Pizza Pecan Pie
instructions: Roll crust on pastry cloth or lightly floured bread wrapper. Spread crust on pizza pan; make sure that there are no holes in crust. Mix ingredients except for Karo syrup and pour into unbaked crust. Dribble syrup over top of mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until top is crusty. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into balls. Place on cookie sheet. Press with fork to make crisscross pattern. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream first 5 ingredients well. Add milk and vanilla. Pour into uncooked 9-inch pie crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Aunt Ella'S Cookies
instructions: Mix soda and warm coffee in molasses. Mix eggs and spices. Beat sugar and butter. Add molasses mixture last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Place beef in bottom of baking pan. Place chicken on top of beef. Bake for 30 minutes. Mix sour cream and mushroom soup together and pour over meat. Bake 40 to 50 minutes longer.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender. Pour in deep dish pie shell. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lila Smith'S Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage a little onion and celery. Add rest of ingredients; mix well. Add celery seed.

title: Old Fashioned Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in frozen pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Whipping Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. First mix together 2 sticks of butter and the sugar. Add the eggs then slowly add the plain flour whipping cream and vanilla flavoring. Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a greased tube pan; put into a cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 hours. Check with toothpick for doneness.

title: Icebox Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding according to recipe on box. Add the softened cream cheese to pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer mix with bananas and vanilla wafers in large bowl. Refrigerate 4 to 6 hours before serving. This makes a lot. Recipe can be cut in half.

title: Italian Soup
instructions: Cut sausage in chunks and brown. Pour off fat; saute onions and green pepper to soft. Add garlic parsley oregano basil tomatoes and pepper. Simmer for 1 hour. Before serving turn up heat and add bow tie macaroni. Cook until tender.

title: Gerald Warmouth'S Easy Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: In blender blend 2 cups water and 2 packages yeast. Let stand for about 4 to 5 minutes to dissolve.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder and cook. Pull chicken apart and layer bite size chicken with broccoli. Pour the cooked mixture over layers as you build. (can be frozen).

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Put into 2-quart greased casserole. Melt 1/2 cup butter. Blend in flour and gradually add milk and bouillon cubes. Pour over broccoli. Heat water and butter until melted. Pour over stuffing and toss with walnuts. Place on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Flake salmon and beaten eggs. Add remaining ingredients and place in a greased loaf pan. Bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Hot Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Lightly grease a 9x13 inch casserole; pour in pineapple and juice. Add flour and sugar. Blend 1/2 cup cheese crackers and melted margarine. Mix together. Add remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Hollandaise Sauce *
instructions: In small saucepan with wire whisk stir together all ingredients until smooth. Stir over medium-low heat until thick. Do not boil. Serve over vegetables seafood or poached eggs. Sprinkle with paprika. Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Tater-Dipped Veggies
instructions: In a small bowl combine potato flakes Parmesan cheese celery salt garlic powder and butter. In another bowl beat eggs.

title: Zucchini Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Blend shortening sugar and egg. Add all other ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Chile Con Queso
instructions: Cook onions and garlic in oil until softened. Drain oil. Add remaining ingredients and cook until cheese melts on low heat. Cut cheese in chunks for easier melting. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Savory Harvest Cabbage
instructions: Melt shortening in Dutch oven or frying pan. Add cabbage and stir over medium heat until tender. Add remaining ingredients and heat thoroughly. Serves six to eight.

title: Shrimp Rice
instructions: Make a white sauce with first 7 ingredients; add shrimp and sherry. Serve over rice.

title: Velvet Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill in mold (about 1 hour) before serving.

title: Cedric'S Casserole
instructions: Fry onion in margarine. Add hamburg salt and pepper. Heat through but do not brown. Spread 3 cups of cabbage in a greased casserole. Cover with meat mixture and place the remaining cabbage on top. Pour can of tomato soup over all. Bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Potato Puffs
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Combine potatoes and eggs and add to dry ingredients. Mix well. Drop from tablespoon into 1/2 cup shortening and fry until brown on both sides. Can be served with syrup.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix Cool Whip Fluff and cream cheese with mixer. Dip strawberries in brown sugar. Place strawberries in serving plate and serve with mixed Fluff Cool Whip and cream cheese as a dip.

title: Bowknot Hot Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast in warm water. Set aside. Combine milk sugar shortening and salt; mix well. Add 1 1/2 cups flour. Beat well. Add yeast and egg. Gradually add remaining flour forming soft dough. Place in greased bowl. Cover and let rise until double (about 1 1/2 to 2 hours). Knead and pinch off a small amount of dough. Roll a strip about 6-inches long. Tie in bowknot. Bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Cranberry-Apple Crumble
instructions: In a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish combine apples and cranberries. Mix sugar and 2 tablespoons flour; toss with fruit. In a bowl combine oatmeal pecans 1/2 cup flour and sugar. Stir in margarine. Spoon over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 in oven for 45 minutes. Garnish with cranberries and pecans. Serve at breakfast topped with cream or over vanilla ice cream. Makes 8 servings.

title: Zucchini-Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream together sugar brown sugar and margarine. Beat in egg vanilla flour and baking soda. Blend together zucchini nuts and chocolate morsels and stir into mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie pan about 2 inches apart. Bake about 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chili Con Queso Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes. Stir well and allow to stand a few minutes.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes; cut into quarters. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in a bag. Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in bag coating pieces well. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Place potatoes in a layer in pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about an hour turning once during baking. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

title: Stuffed Shells - Florentine
instructions: Heat marinara sauce. Spoon 1 cup of sauce into bottom of a large pan or maybe 2 pans. Reserve remaining sauce. Cook spinach as directed on pkg. Drain well and mix with ricotta cheese egg oregano nutmeg and parmesan cheese in a large bowl.

title: Fresh Green Beans With Lime And Ginger Vinaigrette
instructions: Steam fresh green beans until firm and crunchy. Add sliced almonds and cherry tomatoes. Pour dressing over beans and toss gently. Serve at room temperature.

title: Shrimp And Crab Salad
instructions: Place cream cheese and tomato soup in double boiler. Melt stirring until smooth. Soften gelatine in cold water. Dissolve in hot water then stir into soup mixture. Add seasonings and let partially set. Add 1 can white crabmeat and 1/2 cup fresh cooked shrimp cut in small pieces. Let partially set then add mayonnaise onions celery and olives. Stir until well blended and place in salad mold.

title: Poor Man Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar oil and vanilla. Sift together flour cocoa and salt and add to previous ingredients. Add cold water. Mix well. Add vinegar. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza
instructions: Simmer tomato juice and seasonings until almost thick. Add rest of ingredients except for the bread and cheese. Simmer until thick. Toast pita bread under the broiler on both sides so it is a little crisp. Put on pizza mixture. Add cheese; put under broiler to melt cheese.

title: Grandma Faraudo'S Creamed Tuna On Toast
instructions: Melt margarine in 2-quart saucepan. Add flour and mix quickly into a paste (remove from heat to avoid scorching). Slowly add milk and continue to mix to blend. Return to moderate heat stirring slowly. When it starts to thicken remove from heat and add tuna and pepper. Heat through. Spoon over slices of toast biscuits or English muffins.

title: Pearl'S Strawberry Jello Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello with boiling water. Then add strawberries and juice pineapple with juice and nuts. Mix. Pour half into 13 x 9-inch pan or mold. Refrigerate 1/2 hour to firm. Leave remaining jello mixture out on counter. Spread sour cream over chilled jello. Pour remaining mixture on top of sour cream. Chill. Makes 8 cups.

title: Diabetic - Yogurt Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese and yogurt. Blend until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill. Carve balls from your favorite melon and serve with toothpicks to accompany this tasty dip. Dip makes 2 cups or 8 servings (4 tablespoons per serving).

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). Melt morsels and butter; stir in crumbs and nuts. Pour 1/2 of mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch. Press firmly to line bottom of pan.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mash butter with hot potatoes. Beat in sugar eggs vanilla and milk. Add salt to taste; add nutmeg. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until it wont shake when moved. Do not overcook; it will firm as it cools.

title: Meringue
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup sugar cornstarch and salt in a saucepan; stirring constantly. Add water and cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Cool completely. Beat egg whites at high speed of an electric mixer until foamy. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup of sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until soft peaks form. Add vanilla and cornstarch mixture. Beat until stiff peaks form enough for one 9-inch pie.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Soften 1 stick oleo crumble 1/4 pound crackers into butter and mix. Pour over vegetables. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Pinwheels
instructions: Mix all ingredients except rolls. Place 1 tablespoon of the mixture on the middle of a crescent roll. Bring edges of the crescent roll ove top of mixture and pinch together. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with chicken gravy.

title: Coffee Nip
instructions: In a 2-quart bowl sprinkle gelatine over Amaretto or almond extract and water. Let stand 1 minute to soften; stir to dissolve. Add coffee and sugar. Stir until mixture is clear. Pour into 8 sherbet glasses. Cover and chill until firm. Garnish with Cool Whip and almonds.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Use enough water to make a soft dough. The softer you can handle the dough the better the crust. This makes enough dough for 5 or 6 pies. If the scraps get too dry and stiff to roll just work a little water into them. They will still be flaky if rolled thin.

title: Egg Noodles With Madcap Sauce
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat; add onion garlic and beef and cook until beef is browned. Drain excess fat. Add tomato sauce tomatoes salt pepper and oregano. Cook 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain. Serve sauce over noodles.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Butter bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch pan. Place layer of whole graham crackers in bottom of pan. Beat pudding and milk. Add the container of Cool Whip and mix well. Pour half the pudding mixture over the layer of crackers. Top with another layer of crackers. Pour remaining half of pudding over the crackers and top with another layer of crackers.

title: Milk Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve chilled.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix crackers sugar oleo and peanut butter; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread evenly over mixture. Let cool. Cut as desired.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Mix dry onion soup mushroom soup dry red wine and whole mushrooms together. Pour over raw stew meat. Mix well. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Cover tightly. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Broiled French Fries
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line broiler pan with aluminum foil. Drop potatoes into a large pot of boiling water. Partially cover. Return to boiling and cook 4 minutes. Drain. Toss in a large bowl with butter. Arrange potato wedges in single layer on prepared pan. Sprinkle with half the cheese. Broil 5 to 10 minutes or until deep golden brown. Turn potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan. Broil 5 to 8 minutes longer or until golden brown. Season with salt and pepper. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Orange Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; chill until firm. Stir once while chilling.

title: Memama'S Glazed Fruit
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Cinnamon Pickles
instructions: Soak cucumbers water and lime for 24 hours then drain and soak in ice cold water for 3 hours. Drain again. Add cucumbers and add water to cover top. Heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Soak for 2 hours. Drain. Throw away mixture.

title: Hurry Up English Trifle
instructions: Make gelatin according to package directions plus rum flavoring. Cut cake into 1-inch cubes and place them in the bottom of your serving bowl. Pour the slightly cooled gelatin mixture over the cake and refrigerate until set firm. Whip cream and 2 tablespoons of sugar until stiff and spoon over the top; swirl with a spatula. Sprinkle with grated chocolate. Delicious light and easy.

title: Curry Spiced Rice
instructions: In 3-quart casserole dish combine onion and butter. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap; microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and microwave on High for 5 minutes. Stir well. Cover and microwave for another 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed. Let stand 4 to 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Microwave Bread Pudding
instructions: Microwave milk and butter on High for 3 minutes in a 9-inch round microwave dish. Stir in eggs sugar cinnamon vanilla and raisins. Stir to blend. Add bread pieces and let soak for a minute or two. Microwave on High for 7 minutes. Let set 5 minutes before serving.

title: Marshmallow Pineapple Icebox Dessert
instructions: Dissolve marshmallows in warmed but not boiled milk. Cool slightly. Add whipped cream pineapple and nuts. Mix wafers and butter; pat in 9 x 13-inch pan. Save a few crumbs to sprinkle on top. Put pineapple mixture in pan. Let stand in refrigerator 12 hours.

title: Irish Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat butter and 4 ounces sugar until white and creamy. Add beaten eggs and mix together. Mix in flour. Pour into oblong baking pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Turn onto wire rack and cool. Make coffee. Add gelatin brown sugar and whiskey and pour evenly over cake. Chill about 1 hour. Spread the whipped cream over cake. Decorate with grated walnuts.

title: Steak Casserole
instructions: Salt steak; pound in flour. Cut steak in 1-inch cubes. Brown in skillet. Put in casserole dish and add potatoes carrots and onion soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Double Chocolate Bundt Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease and flour 12-cup Bundt cake pan. Blend cake mix sour cream water and eggs on low speed until moistened. Beat for 4 minutes on medium speed. Fold in chocolate pieces; pour into pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan. Cool completely. Spread cake with Caramel Glaze allowing some to drizzle down sides.

title: Grilled Fin Grouper With Butter Pecan Sauce
instructions: Combine chopped shallots white wine heavy cream salt and pepper in medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium. Simmer and stir until mixture is reduced to about one-third. Whisk in butter a tablespoon at a time until all is melted; strain then add salt and pepper to taste. Add roasted pecans.

title: Barbecued Baby Beef Ribs
instructions: Tips This basting sauce is good also for chicken turkey legs or ground meat patties.

title: Escalloped Potatoes And Ham
instructions: Cut ham into 1/2-inch cubes. Pare and slice potatoes. Heat milk to boiling; add ham and potatoes and again heat to boiling. Add salt if tenderized ham is used. Turn into a greased 6 or 8-cup baking dish; dot with the butter cubes. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Ham cubes are more flavorful if pan fried before adding to the potatoes.

title: Dessert Delight
instructions: Beat milk and Cool Whip together. Drain pineapple and put in whip mixture. Add nuts and marshmallows. Refrigerate for about an hour.

title: One-Step Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour fluted or tube pan. Combine the ingredients in a large bowl. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Pour into pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes or until cake springs back when touched. Cool upright in pan 15 minutes. Remove and eat! May glaze with lemon icing. Delicious served with fruit flavored sherbet.

title: Asparagus With Lime Hollandaise
instructions: Trim woody stems from asparagus. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add salt. Add asparagus and boil 6 to 8 minutes until firm-tender. Arrange ham on 4 plates. Drain and divide asparagus on plates. Put yolks in top of double boiler and beat with juice from lime and cook over medium heat until double in volume. Drizzle in butter. Add salt and pepper. Pour in \strips\ over asparagus. Garnish with grated egg.

title: Deluxe Apple Pie
instructions: Line 9-inch pie pan with pastry. Mix sugar flour salt and cinnamon. Add to apples and mix thoroughly. Set aside. Crush pears and spread in bottom of pastry lined pan. Sprinkle with rum. Heap apple mixture over pears. Dot with butter. Put on top crust and seal. Crimp edges. Cut slits for steam to escape. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Grits Casserole(8 To 10 Servings)
instructions: Cook grits according to directions on package. Cut up butter and cheese roll and add to grits while hot; mix well. Beat eggs and add enough milk to make 1 cup. Add salt and pepper. Pour into buttered casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Add Cheddar cheese last few minutes (optional).

title: Hot Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients and put into a greased casserole dish. Mix together the margarine (melted) 1/2 cup nuts the brown sugar and the oats. Place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken with onion until tender; remove to cool. Add to chicken broth the soup and butter. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a rolling boil and add dumpling squares one at a time.

title: Hungarian Potato Soup
instructions: Cook onion in butter until tender. Add potatoes salt and 1 cup water. Cover and cook 15 minutes or until tender. Blend flour paprika and sour cream until smooth. Stir into potato mixture. Add milk and heat until boiling stirring. Cook 1 minute and season to taste.

title: Brown Sugar Casserole Pudding
instructions: Sprinkle sugar over bottom of deep 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spread both sides of bread with margarine; cut in 1/2-inch cubes and arrange over sugar. Sprinkle with raisins. In a medium size bowl beat eggs slightly with wooden spoon or whisk. Beat in cinnamon milk rum or bourbon vanilla and salt. Pour over raisins. Place in shallow pan; add hot water to pan to come 1-inch up sides of casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 60 to 70 minutes until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Remove from water; let stand 10 minutes. Loosen pudding at edges with thin knife. Spoon into bowls. Makes 6 servings.

title: Baked Sea Bass In Filo With Julienne Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt 1/2 oz. butter in a frying pan and gently fry the mushrooms for 2-3 minutes until just softened. Remove from the heat and season. Set aside to cool. Melt half the remaining butter in a small saucepan. Lay the filo sheets out on the work surface and brush with melted butter. Fold each sheet over and brush again. Lay a fish fillet in the centre of each season and top each with some of the mushrooms and chopped parsley. Fold over two opposite corners of pastry and then bring up the other two to form a parcel scrunching and twisting them together as they meet in the middle. Press gently to seal and then transfer to a baking sheet. Brush with butter and bake for 20-25 minutes until crisp golden and cooked through. Meanwhile peel the carrot and cut into very thin sticks or coarsely grate. Trim the courgette (zucchini) and cut or grate in the same way. Trim the leek slice in half lengthwise and run under water to flush out any trapped earth. Shake well to remove excess water and then shred finely. Set aside. Five minutes before the sea bass is cooked melt the remaining butter and stir-fry the prepared vegetables for 2-3 minutes until just tender. To serve divide the shredded vegetables between two warmed serving plates and season. Top each pile of vegetables with a parcel of fish and serve with wedges of lemon to squeeze over.

title: Peanut Butter Breakfast Bar(Weight Watchers)
instructions: Mix thoroughly; form into bar on foil and freeze. Eat frozen (if you can wait!) Equals 1 bread 1 milk 1 fruit 1 fat and 1 protein.

title: Puffy Shrimp Tempura
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Dip shrimp or vegetables in batter and deep fry.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Reserve 1/2 cup cheese for top. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or so.

title: Seven-Layer Mexican Dip
instructions: Mash avocados in a bowl with lemon juice salt and pepper. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise sour cream and taco seasoning. On a large flat plate spread bean dip in a large circle. Top with avocado mixture then sour cream mixture. Follow this with onions then tomatoes followed by olives. Cover all with grated cheese. Chill until ready to serve with corn chips.

title: Quick And Chewy Crescent Bars
instructions: Unmold can of\trolls and place rectangles in ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Press dough to cover bottom of pan and seal perforations. Pour milk over dough. Sprinkle with frosting mix. Drizzle with the melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown. Cool. Cut into squares. Makes 3 to 4 dozen bars.

title: Cool Cream Of Corn Soup
instructions: Place all ingredients in medium-sized saucepan. Bring to boil cover and simmer on low for 20 minutes. Puree in blender or food processor until smooth. Stir and taste. If too thick add a dash of water to thin slightly. Ladle 8 ounces of soup into each bowl.

title: Cheesy Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti until tender. In saucepan warm soup and cheese until cheese melts. Add drained spaghetti noodles. Serve as side dish.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package. Drain well. Saute onion and celery until tender but not brown. Mix all ingredients. Reserve 1 cup cheese. Sprinkle with Accent celery salt and pepper then mix. Place in buttered pans. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: J. R.'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients thoroughly. Shape into jelly roll on aluminum foil. Wrap roll in foil and bake for 1 hour. Uncover and bake for 30 more minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Blend yeast and water together well. Then add beaten egg milk sugar oil salt and flour. Mix well and refrigerate. Use when needed. Let rise 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until brown.

title: Cheezy Hot Dog
instructions: Make a split in the hot dog and fill it with cheese. Place hot dog in bun. Wrap hot dog loosely in a paper towel. Microwave for 35 seconds on High.

title: Kurt'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix butter milk and sugar in pan; bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil for 5 minutes or to 234\u00b0 on thermometer. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter chips Fluff and vanilla. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: In large bowl mix half and half sugar and vanilla. Stir in whipping cream. Freeze in 4 quart ice cream freezer as directed. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Ham And Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill. Serve cold.

title: Asparagus Party Pin-Wheels
instructions: With rolling pin roll out bread slices until they are flat. Mix together cream cheese Cheddar cheese and egg until smooth and creamy. Spread this mixture on bread slices. Place one asparagus spear on each bread slice. Roll up. Melt butter in pan and dip each pin-wheel lightly in the butter. Place rolls in pan until they are almost frozen. Slice with very sharp knife into bite size pieces. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. (May be frozen and baked at a later date at same temperature but for approximately twice the time.)

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening peanut butter sugar and egg. Blend all dry ingredients. Stir into shortening. Chill dough. Roll dough in balls (1 1/4-inch). Place 3 inches apart on greased pan. Flatten with a fork dipped in sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Clam Stuffed Mushrooms(Makes 20 Appetizers)
instructions: Remove and finely chop mushroom stems. Brush caps with melted margarine; place in shallow pan. In skillet cook celery pepper onion mushroom stems pimiento and bouillon in margarine 5 minutes; add remaining ingredients. Spoon mixture into caps; bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until hot. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Zucchini Pickles
instructions: Put the sugar vinegar salt turmeric celery seed and mustard seed in a large pot. Boil for 5 minutes. Add the alum. Add the zucchini peppers and onions. Bring to rolling boil. Set off stove. Place in hot jars and seal.

title: Fruit Cooler
instructions: Add raspberry flavored drink mix and sugar to pineapple juice. Stir to dissolve. Add remaining fruit juices. Chill and serve over ice.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and pour off fat. Layer a greased casserole with bread sausage and cheese. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over mixture in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. This may be assembled and refrigerated to be baked the next day.

title: Portuguese Soup
instructions: Brown stew meat; add water with onions carrots stewed tomatoes potatoes beans string beans and corn. Add salt and pepper to taste; boil over medium flame for 1 hour then add rice cabbage and tomato sauce. Simmer on low flame about 20 minutes.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello in hot water and cool. Then add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients and pour into mold. Refrigerate until set. Serve with crackers.

title: English Cherubs
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup brown sugar butter flour and dash of salt in a medium mixing bowl. Mix until well combined (mixture will look dry). Press in bottom of a greased 9-inch square pan. Beat eggs until foamy. Add remaining brown sugar 1/2 cup sugar vanilla and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Mix well. Stir in coconut and pecans. Spread over layer in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until top is set and lightly browned. Cool; cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Vanilla Fudge
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients until soft ball forms in cold water (at least 20 minutes after it starts to boil). Remove from heat and add vanilla peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Mix well together and pour into buttered dish. Place in fridge to cool then cut into squares. Keep in fridge or a cool place.

title: Hot Beef Sandwiches(Makes 100 Sandwiches)
instructions: Place roasts in roaster (may be left whole or cut up as stew meat). Add spaghetti sauce dill pickles and juice. Add enough water to cover the meat. Cover and cook until meat is able to break apart easily at 350\u00b0 for approximately 6 hours. May be done in slow oven overnight.

title: Rotini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown hamburger then combine all ingredients except cheese and noodles. Prepare rotini noodles in pot of boiling water until tender. Drain. Mix sauce with cooked noodles. Pour 1/2 of mixture into a casserole dish. Layer with 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese then mixture and top with remaining cheese. Bake for 40 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden brown.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix slightly beaten eggs corn cooking oil and buttermilk. Sift together corn meal salt and baking powder. Add to egg mixture. Pour half the batter into greased baking dish. Put layer of cut up hot chilies then layer of cheese over batter. Add remaining batter. Cheese may be sprinkled over top. Bake 25 minutes in 450\u00b0 oven. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Okra And Tomatoes
instructions: Slice okra and salt to taste. Combine flour and meal; stir together. Coat okra with meal mixture and fry in vegetable oil until almost done. Chop tomatoes and stir remaining meal and flour on tomatoes. Add to okra and fry until brown. (Do not stir often.)

title: Buckeye Candy
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Add eggs singly beating well after each addition.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender and drain. Add next four ingredients. Pour in greased casserole dish. Mix margarine and corn flakes together. Put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Upside-Down Pudding
instructions: Pour washed blueberries into buttered casserole (1 1/2-quart size) and sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar. Cream shortening 1/2 cup sugar and 1 egg together. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add this to creamed mixture alternately with 1/2 cup milk. Pour batter over blueberries. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Spoon out while hot and serve with cream whipped cream ice cream or milk. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Miss Elsie'S Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Applesauce Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar together. Add applesauce and eggs. Sift all dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Mix well. Add last 4 ingredients. Mix all together. Bake in a tube pan with wax paper in it for 4 hours in a 200\u00b0 to 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Oyster Casserole
instructions: Drain oysters reserving liquid. Crumble crackers. Mix oyster liquid with about equal amounts of milk and the mushroom soup and heat on slow burner. Add drained oysters to the crackers cubed cheese and chopped broccoli. Lightly stir in the liquid mixture. Turn into sprayed ovenproof dish and bake uncovered in 400\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchilada
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Season chicken with garlic and onion season. Melt stick of butter in large skillet; add onion and bell pepper. Saute. Add green chillies and evaporated milk. Stir. Add both soups. Blend well in skillet. Place a layer of Doritos in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add 1/2 of cooked chicken to pan. Pour 1/2 of soup over chicken and top with grated cheese. Repeat procedure. Cover with foil and place in oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Sealeg Soup
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Thinly slice celery. Melt butter in heavy pan. Add potatoes and celery. Barely cover with water. Cook until tender. Add milk. When scalded add sealegs and heat until scalding.

title: Easy Method Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and drain. In a large bowl mix together tomato juice sauce paste onion oregano basil salt pepper garlic brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Stir in meat. Spread 1/3 cup meat sauce over bottom of dish. Place 1/2 the uncooked noodles over the sauce and top with 1/2 cottage cheese and then half of Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers and cover with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Microwave at Medium for 35 minutes uncovered. Place remaining Mozzarella cheese on top and continue microwaving at Medium for 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix jello and hot water until dissolved. Add cold water and frozen strawberries and refrigerate until lightly thickened. Mix crushed pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 then cool. Beat together 1 cup sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip. Spread on cooled pretzel layer. (This layer can be doubled.) Then put strawberries on top. Set in fridge for at least 12 hours.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix together. Store in refrigerator.

title: Poppy Seed Cake(Bundt)
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding oil water and eggs together until smooth then add poppy seed (stir in). Put cinnamon-sugar at bottom of greased (shortening) Bundt pan then put mix in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well.

title: Chocolate Cake Icing
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa thoroughly. Add milk and oleo. Place over heat and boil until it spins a thick thread. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Beat for about 2 minutes with mixer. Spread between layers on top and sides of cake.

title: Cheesy Beef Cornbread
instructions: Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cornmeal in bottom of well-greased 10-inch skillet (iron skillet works best). Cook beef first in another pan and drain. Combine Jiffy mix with milk corn and eggs and mix well. Pour 1/2 batter into skillet. Sprinkle other ingredients on batter. Top with remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Easy Mexican Casserole
instructions: Remove paper from tamales and cut in 1-inch pieces. Drain corn and combine all ingredients except cheese. Place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole and top with grated cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Anchovy And Artichoke Pasta
instructions: Saute garlic and anchovies in oil. Quarter artichoke hearts and add to pan. Add clam juice wine and basil. Bring to boil; simmer 3 to 4 minutes then toss with cooked pasta.

title: Pull Taffy
instructions: Cook in a pan over medium heat until the hard crack stage (a string will harden and crack when dropped into cold water). Pour into a buttered pan or use several dinner plates. Cool candy until you can handle it. Take a handful of the taffy from the pans (it will be honey colored). Keeping your hands well buttered start pulling taffy out into a string and roping it back together. Taffy will turn whiter as it is pulled and get stiffer and harder to pull. Once it is white enough and seems to be stiff enough to hold its shape pull out into a long rope and lay on waxed paper. Cut the ropes into bite-sized pieces and wrap in the paper. Twist the ends and store.

title: Hot Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook spinach. Drain well. In a baking dish add cream cheese mayonnaise Parmesan cheese and spinach. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1/2 hour. Serve with Pepperidge Farm sesame sticks or any other cracker.

title: Broccoli Surprise Salad
instructions: Combine the broccoli flowerets and rings of sliced onion. Just before serving add a dressing made of mayonnaise sugar and wine vinegar. Pour dressing over salad only when ready to serve. Toss and add peanuts and raisins. Toss again. Serve right away.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Scrub carrots well but leave skin on. Grate into a big bowl; add raisins. Sprinkle a little lemon juice over the mixture. Pour honey or corn syrup over salad until it tastes right.

title: Southwest Appetizer
instructions: Soften cream cheese and spread out evenly in glass pie plate. Add can of chili on top.\tDistribute green chilies on top of chili. Sprinkle cheese over all. Warm in microwave until cheese melts or put in oven until warm. Serve with tortilla chips potato chips or crackers. \MMM\ good!

title: Carol'S Mud Bugs
instructions: Pour Chex cereal into large bowl; set aside. In a 1-quart microwave-safe bowl combine next 3 ingredients. Microwave High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth stirring after 1 minute. Pour chocolate mixture over cereal. Stir until all pieces are evenly coated. Pour cereal into large Ziploc bag with powdered sugar. Seal and shake until all pieces are evenly coated. Spread on wax paper to cool.

title: Forgotten Roast
instructions: Place roast on a large piece of aluminum foil and arrange vegetables around roast. Sprinkle meat and vegetables with dry onion soup mix. Spoon undiluted mushroom soup on top. Wrap loosely with foil making sure it is sealed at top and sides. Place in a roaster pan and bake at 275\u00b0 for 4 hours or 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Gram'S Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients on high until well mixed. Pour into graham cracker pie crust. Bake fast for 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then slow for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown and custard is set.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Put oil in pan; heat. Take pieces of bread put in pan and sprinkle parsley and garlic salt. Cook until brown. Remove from oil. Put in paper towels. Remove grease. Place in brown bag to drain rest of grease off. Mix lettuce and dressing then croutons.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Shred cheese and mix all ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls. Bake 15 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown. For a firmer texture add an extra 3 c. of biscuit mix and an extra 2 c. of cheese to above listed ingredients. Makes about 6 doz. and can be frozen if uncooked.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together; chill and roll into ball. Roll in chopped nuts. Serve with crackers.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion. Drain. Mix other ingredients together and add the hamburger meat and onion. Simmer for at least 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake 60 minutes in a 350 degree oven.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Saute onions peppers and mushrooms in melted oleo. Then add other ingredients. Put in greased baking dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the crab and simmer over low heat until thoroughly heated. Stir in the crabmeat and serve. Yields 2 cups.

title: Yum-Yum Salad
instructions: Boil sugar in water. Add Jell-O and pineapple. Let stand to cool. Fold in cheese Cool Whip nuts and marshmallows. Let set to congeal. Stir occasionally as it begins to set. May be served as a salad on top of lettuce or as a dessert.

title: Ham And Corn Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium-high heat saute bacon until nearly crisp. Remove and drain on paper towels; set aside. Remove all but 1/4 cup drippings from saucepan. Add celery onion green pepper and garlic. Saute over medium-high heat for 5 minutes. Add potatoes and broth. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Place 2 cups of the corn and 1/2 cup of the milk in a blender. Cover and blend until pureed. Add pureed corn remaining corn ham and potatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in remaining 3 1/2 cups milk 1 tablespoon of the parsley salt pepper and hot pepper sauce. Bring to just under boiling. Serve and garnish with reserved bacon pieces and remaining 2 tablespoons parsley.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Mix margarine sugar potato water egg milk and yeast then add potato and stir together. Add flour. Knead and put in refrigerator and cover. Make off and let rise in warm room.

title: Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch cinnamon and water and bring to a boil. Add the lemon juice. Fill 7 quarts with apples sliced and pour syrup over apples. Seal. Cool pack for 20 minutes.

title: Lelia'S Gingerbread
instructions: Pour water over shortening. Add sugar molasses and egg; beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Spray 8-inch pan with Pam. Place in 350\u00b0 oven 35 minutes. Cool in pan.

title: Chicken Breasts With Wine And Mustard
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Saute the breasts in 4 tablespoons butter 3 to 5 minutes on each side until browned. Remove from pan. Saute the shallots briefly. Add wine cream and stock; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook until sauce is thickened. Whisk in mustard. Whisk in remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Return chicken to the sauce and heat through. Place chicken on platter and spoon sauce over it and top with a twist of pepper from the mill.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt margarine in 2-quart casserole. Mix flour and sugar well then add milk and mix well. Pour into casserole. Pour peaches on top. Bake for 1 hour or until golden brown.

title: Salmon Pate
instructions: Drain debone and flake the salmon. Mix together with all other ingredients except garnishes. On a pretty platter mold mixture into a fish shape. Arrange almonds to resemble scales. Use slice of olive for eye and thin strips of celery for the tail. Garnish with parsley. Chill until serving time. Serve with buttery crackers. Refrigerate leftovers. Yields 16 servings. Low in salt sugar and fat. Very good for diabetics.

title: Cheeseburger-Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add all other ingredients but hold back 1/2 cup cheese for topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Instant Mince Pie
instructions: Mix all in bowl and fill crust. Dot with butter. Cover with top crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Scallop And Vegetable Cheese Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet heat 2 teaspoons oil. Add onions and garlic; saute for 2 minutes. Add bread crumbs and cook until lightly browned. Remove from heat; add 3 tablespoons Parmesan cheese and parsley. Spread evenly over bottom of ovenproof baking dish. Layer half of Mozzarella cheese on top. Then add layer each of zucchini carrots spinach and scallops. Sprinkle with basil salt and pepper. Layer remaining Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese and parsley. Brush remaining oil over top. Cover with foil. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove foil and continue to bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese And Pineapple Salad
instructions: Dissolve jellos in boiling water. Add cold water and pineapple. Stir Miracle Whip into cottage cheese and add to jello-pineapple mixture. Stir in chopped nuts. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Summer Sauce
instructions: Clean and boil until thickens. Use on chicken or spaghetti.

title: Easy Klobasniky (Sausage Rolls)
instructions: Thaw bread dough completely but dont let rise. Cook sausage in boiling water for 15 minutes. Cut sausage into 8 pieces then slice each piece in half lengthwise. Drain out grease on paper towels. Cut bread dough into 16 pieces. Wrap sausage slices into bread pieces pinching together. Use flour on hands. Place rolls seam side down in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been sprayed with Pam. Let rise until double about 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 16.

title: Roquefort Or Blue Cheese Salad Dressing
instructions: Makes 1 quart.\tBeat all ingredients except cheese with mixer. Crumble cheese into dressing. Store in refrigerator covered until ready to use. Shake well before serving.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all except cheese and bring to a boil. Simmer for 20 minutes. Put cheese and liquid in blender for 1 to 2 minutes. Dip can be served hot or cold.

title: Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt almond bark and add chocolate chips. Add peanuts. Drop with teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Orange Stir-Fry Chicken
instructions: Trim fat from chicken breast halves. Cut into 1/4-inch strips. Mix soy sauce 1 teaspoon cornstarch the ginger root and garlic in medium glass or plastic bowl. Stir in chicken. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Beef Tips And Gravy
instructions: Take 2 pounds of beef tips cut into small cubes. In a frying pan put 2 tablespoons butter or oil and beef tips. Brown tips with salt and pepper to taste. After tips are brown add 1 1/2 cups water; lower temperature and put lid on pan. Cook meat until tender. When meat is tender remove from pan and leave liquid. Add 1 1/2 cups water and 4 to 5 tablespoons of Bisquick and mix making a gravy then add meat back in and cook 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix flour oats baking powder and salt. Beat egg with honey and milk. Pour egg into oats. Stir until just mixed. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Holiday Lizzies
instructions: Cream together sugar butter and eggs. Sift flour and soda together and add to egg mixture. Stir in milk. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Yields 80 or 90 cookies.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt into a bowl. Cut in peanut butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add oats egg and milk stirring only until blended. Pour batter into greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Cool. Cut and serve with jelly.

title: Best Ever Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and add next six ingredients. Cook uncovered for 1 hour. Meanwhile mix remaining ingredients and cook noodles. Slice Mozzarella.

title: Pasta Con Broccoli
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water for about 4 minutes. Drain and return to pan. Add cream butter garlic tomato sauce and broccoli. Bring to a boil for about 4 to 5 minutes. When noodles are done stir in mushrooms to heat. Remove from heat and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese salt and pepper. Toss and serve immediately. Makes 2 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: In a large saucepan add the celery soup chicken soup and milk. Heat at medium heat while stirring. In a large casserole dish add the chicken breasts. Spread the butter over the top and then sprinkle on the garlic powder. Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Southern Style Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes and boil until tender. Drain well. Put in a bowl and add butter mayonnaise salt and pepper to taste. Mash with electric mixer for just about a minute and then add about a 1/4 cup milk. Continue to mash until desired smoothness.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: In a small bowl beat eggs and sugar well. In a separate bowl mix flour cocoa and salt. Add to sugar mixture. Blend in chips and nuts. Pour in a well-greased pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set. Note I sometimes put mixture in an unbaked pie shell.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut up cabbage and onion in casserole dish. Put 1/2 butter over this. Stir up egg mayonnaise and soup; pour over cabbage. Crumble up crackers over this; pour rest of butter over mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Put sugar margarine and evaporated milk in microwaveproof dish (a casserole 1 1/2-quart with a lid). Cover and microwave on Roast for 10 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir until sugar is dissolved. Recover and put back in microwave and cook an additional 5 minutes on Roast. Remove from microwave and stir in marshmallows vanilla and chocolate chips or peanut butter. Stir until all melted.

title: Watermelon Rind Pickles
instructions: Slice rind in small thin pieces. Soak overnight in lily lime. Rinse in the morning and put in boiler; cover with water and cook 3 hours. Add green cake color spices vinegar and sugar; cook until tender. Put in jars and seal.

title: Chocolate And Cheese Dessert
instructions: Mix flour nuts and margarine together and crumble into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pat\tdown with a spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Cover with water and cook until tender.

title: Lily'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix the above ingredients together. Scoop up a handful of ground beef mixture and make a ball approximately the size of a baseball and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Continue to do this until you have used all the mixture. It makes 5 or 6 balls. Pour approximately 1 cup of water in the pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes or until the meat is brown. Take pan out of oven and pour off the grease and water. Pour or squirt ketchup over the top of each ball of meat and place back in the oven for about 5 minutes or until ketchup is set. Leftovers make great sandwiches.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drained crushed pineapple may be added.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice
instructions: Mix rice chicken soup mushroom soup and water thoroughly. Pour in pan. Push chicken pieces into rice mixture. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake about 15 minutes longer or until done.

title: Fiesta Sandwich
instructions: Cut off the top 1/3 of loaf of bread and set aside. Hollow out leaving 1/2-inch thick crust all around. Spread cut surfaces with bean dip. Layer as follows Colby Jack half the red pepper Monterey Jack with jalapenos olive slices tomato cubes Cheddar and avocado. Top with remainder of red pepper. Combine shredded taco cheese with salad dressing and spoon on top. Replace top of bread loaf. Wrap tightly in foil and keep cool until ready to serve. If desired heat in oven or over coals to warm and melt cheese. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Polynesian Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut up wings; discard tips. Marinate overnight in teriyaki sauce mixture. Next day put chicken and sauce in pan. Pour sweet and sour sauce over wings. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. During the last 15 minutes pour on the Hawaiian vegetables including the sauce and continue baking. Serve with rice.

title: Okra And Tomatoes
instructions: Saute onion in butter in large skillet until tender; add green pepper and remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Shrimp And Wild Rice
instructions: Saute onions and green peppers in butter until tender. Mix all together and pour into buttered casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Green Beans
instructions: Put corn meal flour garlic powder salt and pepper in large plastic container with lid. Add green beans. Shake well until beans are completely coated. Heat butter in skillet until bubbly. Add beans cook over high heat stirring occasionally. Cook 10 minutes or until coating is crunchy and brown. Serve hot with extra butter if desired.

title: Judy'S Italian Casserole
instructions: In a skillet brown the beef with onion garlic and seasonings; stir to separate meat. Combine in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish with soup water and noodles. Place the cheese around the edge of the casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix oil sugar cinnamon soda salt flour and eggs in a large bowl. Mix well. Fold in strawberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Makes 2 loaves.

title: 3 Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans place in bowl and add pepper and onion. Mix oil and vinegar; add sugar salt and pepper. Pour over mixture and toss. Refrigerate covered for 12 to 24 hours.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar flour salt and nutmeg. Mix egg mixture into rhubarb. Put into a deep pie pan with crust. Cover with crisscross crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Pistachio Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together except syrup. Mix for 10 minutes. Grease Bundt pan and sprinkle with crushed walnuts and toasted coconut. Take 1 cup batter and mix with syrup. Divide remaining batter in half and place half in pan then the layer of chocolate batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 60 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Potato Dumplings
instructions: Roll out and cut. Drop into boiling broth. Cook until done.

title: Haluski With Dumplings
instructions: Chop cabbage and saute in butter. While cooking mix flour eggs salt milk and 1/2 cup of water. Add more water if needed. Drop small amounts in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain and add to cabbage. Brown onion in butter and pour over cabbage and dumplings.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Beat the oil sugar and eggs until creamy. Add the jam and buttermilk. Sift the flour with the salt soda and spices. Add to other ingredients. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in a tube pan about 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: No-Peek Stew
instructions: Trim off all fat from meat. Combine all ingredients in slow-cooker. Cook covered at low heat setting for 9 to 10 hours. Makes 8 cups about 5 servings.

title: Pesto Tortellini
instructions: Chop parsley in blender; with motor running add nuts garlic basil and salt. Process until garlic is chopped. Slowly add olive oil. Stop machine and fold in cheese. Cook tortellini according to package directions. Drain and toss with sauce. Serve at room temperature with toothpicks. Garnish with chopped fresh tomatoes and basil. Serves 12 (1/4 cup servings).

title: Drop Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine. Add cocoa sugar and milk. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and oats. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Spicy Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Cut washed potatoes (with or without skins) into 1-inch cubes. Do not blot dry. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a plastic bag. Toss potatoes in bag to coat them. Evenly spread potatoes in one layer on lightly greased dish or pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Turn potatoes every 15 minutes.

title: You-Name-It Cake
instructions: Follow directions on box of cake mix. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let cool. Mix vanilla pudding cream cheese and milk. Spread on cake. Drain pineapple. Spread on pudding mix. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pecans if desired.

title: Spareribs
instructions: *For small portions use 2 tablespoons for every 8 ounces of tomato sauce.

title: Seafoam Frosting
instructions: Boil until spins a thread in cold water. Slowly add egg whites to syrup beating at same time.

title: Smoked Salmon Ball
instructions: Place cream cheese in a large bowl. Beat with an electric mixer set at med-high speed until smooth. Add onion lemon juice 1 TBSP. parsley horseradish liquid smoke garlic pwd. And salt to cream cheese and mix well. Flake the salmon. Stir salmon into cream cheese mixture. Shape the salmon mix into 1 large ball or 2 small balls. Combine pecans and remaining parsley in a small bowl. Coat salmon ball with pecan mixture. Chill tightly wrapped in plastic wrap for 1 hour. Serve with wheat crackers.

title: Banana Cooler
instructions: Combine banana buttermilk or yogurt honey and lemon juice in blender and mix well. Pour into chilled glass and garnish with lemon slice. Makes 3/4 cup.

title: French Puffs
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the shortening sugar and egg. Set aside. Sift together flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Add to shortening sugar and egg mixture alternately with the 1/2 cup milk. Fill muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 10 to 12 muffins. When thoroughly baked roll in the melted butter and then in the sugar/cinnamon mixture.

title: Wild Plum Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients add eggs oil and baby food. Stir just until mixed. Spray or oil muffin pans. Fill with batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or longer if needed. Makes 1 doz. large muffins.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar Crisco and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time. Beat well after each addition. Stir in extracts. Stir together flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk; beat well after each addition. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours or until done. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool on rack.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Place all vegetables in dish (such as Tupperware) with lid pour the bottle of dressing over and toss. Let stand overnight before eating. Toss 2 or 3 times before serving. Keep refrigerated green onions are good in there too!

title: Cool Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water; add other ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate until firm.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13 x 2-inch Pyrex dish at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Leona'S Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients. Make a well in center. Combine rest of ingredients. Pour into dry ingredients and mix. Pour batter in 9 x 13-inch pan greased and floured. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Creamy Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cabbage. Mix well. Just before serving spoon mixture over cabbage. Toss slightly. Yields 12 servings.

title: Autumn Soup
instructions: In soup kettle over medium heat brown beef slowly. Add onions and cook 5 minutes. Loosen meat from bottom of pan. Add water carrots potatoes salt pepper meat extract bay leaf and basil. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

title: Wheat Bread(Two Loaves)
instructions: Heat first 4 ingredients until 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into cup; level off. Combine warm liquid 2 cups unbleached flour and remaining ingredients in large bowl; beat 2 minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in remaining flour to make a stiff dough. Knead dough on well floured surface until smooth and elastic about 2 minutes. Place in greased bowl. Cover; let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size 45 to 60 minutes. Grease 2 (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans. Punch down dough; divide and shape into 2 loaves. Place in greased pans; cove rand let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size 45 to 60 minutes. Heat oven to 350\u00b0; bake 40 to 50 minutes until deep golden brown and loaves sound hollow when tapped. Remove immediately from pans.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter the sugars pudding mix and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts (batter will be stiff).

title: Party Mints
instructions: Mix half of the margarine and one half of the sugar with mixer. Then add rest of the margarine and the sugar plus water and oil. When mixed into ball add food color. Pinch into small balls place on waxed paper and mash crossways with fork to make design. Store in cool place.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix pumpkin with eggs. Add dry ingredients. Heat milk with butter and add to pumpkin mixture. Pour in shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes more or until knife comes out clean. This makes a very deep pie. I use a 10-inch round 2-inch deep pie pan.

title: Tangy Lemon Squares
instructions: Cream together butter and 1/2 cup of powdered sugar until fluffy. Add 2 cups of flour; beat until blended. Spread evenly over bottom of a well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients except cheese. Put in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Heat on low heat for 2 or 3 hours or on high for 1 or 2 hours.

title: Quick Sweet Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Mix the flour cinnamon salt and soda. Combine the egg molasses brown sugar oil and orange peel. Mix the egg mixture alternately with the yogurt to the dry ingredients. Pour into a buttered pan and bake for about 50 minutes in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven.

title: No-Snow Sculptures
instructions: Will also need beater and big bowl.

title: Crock-Pot Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use enough bread crumbs to make mixture hold together well (dryer than if you were cooking it in the oven). Cover with catsup and place bay leaf on top. Place crock-pot time on automatic and cook 8 to 10 hours.

title: English Trifle
instructions: Layer bottom of trifle bowl with sliced jelly roll. Pour over sherry and leave to soak overnight in the refrigerator. According to directions make one pint of custard and pour over soaked jelly roll. Return to refrigerator to cool and set.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Beat butter eggs salt and sugar. Sift dry ingredients; add to first mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla then mix in drained blueberries. Bake in paper lined muffin tins at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Southern Coleslaw(From Frances Wright)
instructions: Grate up your cabbage and carrots. Combine the two ingredients. Add sugar and vinegar then slowly add mayonnaise to the consistency you like. Great on a hot summer day.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix together peanut butter cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Blend well with mixer. Add Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle chopped peanuts on top if desired. Chill.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix by hand. Pinch bread in small pieces in a large mixing bowl. Pour scalded milk over bread. Let this soak at least an hour. While still warm add sugar melted margarine and beaten eggs; mix well. Add cinnamon nutmeg vanilla pineapple and raisins. Mix well and pour in well-greased 12 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar on top. Mixture will be soupy. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until light brown.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: This can be made with fresh or frozen corn. Have corn cut off cob and boiling. Make a dough just like for chicken dumplings and drop in small pieces around in the corn. Cook it until the dough is done. Its delicious!

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add bourbon and milk. Mix until smooth. In double boiler mix in semi-sweet chocolate pieces and paraffin until melted. Roll candy mixture into ball (put a pecan in the center); dip ball in chocolate mixture. Place another pecan atop the chocolate ball. Let dry on waxed paper. Refrigerate.

title: Quick And Jazzy Jambalaya
instructions: In large skillet saute rice vermicelli mix per package directions. Stir in 2 cups water ham onion tomatoes garlic hot pepper sauce and contents of seasoning packet. Bring to boil over high heat. Cover reduce heat to low. Simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in shrimp and green pepper. Cover; simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until most of liquid is absorbed and shrimp turns pink.

title: Hot Fruit Punch
instructions: Combine and heat slowly; do not boil! Makes 20 small or 12 large cups.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and bake for 45 minutes or 1 hour.

title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad 2
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for cucumbers in a large bowl; mix well. Peel and slice cucumbers and add to first 5 ingredients; mix well. Cover and marinate overnight.

title: Reuben Rolls
instructions: Roll dough onto rectangular baking stone. Mix all remaining ingredients and spread on dough. With pizza cutter cut dough down the middle lengthwise. Roll the dough up jelly roll fashion starting at the short end. (Be careful; your corned beef mixture will start to ooze out. Just stick it back in as you are rolling.) Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Persimmon Pudding Cake
instructions: Add some raisins (to taste) dates coconut and nuts (if desired). Put persimmons in colander and set in bowl. Pour hot milk over them and work pulp through colander. Add goodies to it.
