Pour into baking pan and cook until fork comes out clean and nice and brown. Good plain or with cream cheese frosting or Cool Whip on top.

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into graham crusts. Chill.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: If you prefer quart jars

title: Burrito Surprise
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add all other ingredients including juice from green chilies or a little jalapeno juice if you like it hot (I add this). Mix with fork. Place a little filling on a tortilla (burrito style) and roll up. Put enough on the tortilla so you can taste it. Chill well. Slice when ready to serve. Makes at least 5 burritos. Keeps refrigerated for a week.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: 1st Layer Mix together margarine with flour and nuts in a 9 x 13-inch pan and brown for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Roast Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken and pat dry. Cut along one side of breast or backbone to butterfly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. At the same time boil 2 cups water. Add garlic and boil for 5 minutes. Drain and slip off peels. Lift out chicken. Arrange sliced potatoes and garlic cloves in pan. Set chicken skin side up on top. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until chicken is tender.

title: Snackin Lemon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Blend first 5 ingredients and beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into pan and bake for 35 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes.

title: Marinade(Chicken, Beef Or Vegetables)
instructions: Bring to boil; simmer 20 minutes. Cool. Marinate beef or chicken before grilling. Excellent for kabobs. Can also be used to marinate vegetables.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Kabobs
instructions: In a saucepan cook carrots covered in a small amount of boiling water for 8 minutes. Drain well. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Cut pineapple slices into quarters. Set aside.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Into dishpan mix sugars oil and sour cream. When creamy add eggs and vanilla. Beat until frothy. Add flour corn flakes oatmeal salt and soda. Shape into balls (mixture will be very thick). Place on cookie sheet. Press with a fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Cucumber-Shrimp Spread
instructions: In small mixing bowl combine cucumber and salt; let stand for 10 minutes. Place cucumber in center of clean kitchen towel. Gather together each corner of towel to enclose cucumber in pouch. Squeeze pouch to release excess liquid from cucumber discarding liquid. Transfer cucumber to medium mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Serve on cocktail bread crisp breads or rice cakes.

title: Broccoli, Cauliflower, Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables in microwave for 6 minutes covered. Then mix sour cream and celery soup with 1/2 can onion rings. Mix well in dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ground Beef And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in oil until browned and crumbly. Mix in onion salt pepper and rice. Cook 2 or 3 minutes longer. Add soup and water; mix thoroughly. Remove from heat. Spoon cabbage into 1 1/2 or 2-quart casserole. Pour meat mixture over cabbage to completely cover. Do not stir. Cover and bake in a slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Butter a 9x13 inch dish. Spread margarine on bread slices place in baking dish. Crumble sausage over bread sprinkle cheese over sausage. Combine eggs milk salt and pepper mix well. Pour over cheese. Cover casserole and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake casserole uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set and cheese is bubbling. Yields 8 servings.

title: Deer Roast
instructions: Let simmer 2 hours.

title: Green Onion Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Cover and chill.

title: Sloppy Joe Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350. In large skillet cook ground beef and onion until beef is thoroughly cooked stirring frequently. Drain. Add mixed vegetables and sandwich sauce. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Spoon into an ungreased 8-inch square glass baking dish. Cook mashed potatoes as directed on the package using hot water milk and margarine. Let stand for 5 minutes. Spoon potatoes around the edges of the hot beef mixture. Sprinkle paprika over the potatoes. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and thoroughly heated.

title: Lula Paste
instructions: Cook slowly stirring until thick about 5 minutes sugar eggs and vinegar. Cool. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well serve as a vegetable dip or a spread for crackers. Nice for Christmastime because of color.

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Blend dry and wet ingredients. Add pecans dates and cherries. Drop by teaspoon into cornflake crumbs. Place on greased cookie sheet. Top with 1/4 cherry.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the chicken onion and half of the shredded cheese. Set the mixture aside.

title: Fresh Peach Bread Pudding
instructions: Spray 9-inch by 13-inch baking pan with Pam cooking spray. Break up bread into pan and tuck peach slices between bread pieces. Beat eggs sugar and vanilla together; pour egg mixture evenly over bread. Dot with butter pieces. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 55 minutes. Can be assembled the night before and refrigerated. Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before baking.

title: Grandma'S Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix oatmeal and boiling water together. Let cool. Stir rest of ingredients together with oatmeal mixture. Pour out into a 9 x 13 greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Pour icing over cake while still warm.

title: Veal Scaloppine(Scaloppine Di Vitello)
instructions: Pound veal between 2 pieces of wax paper until very thin. Mix flour salt and pepper; coat veal. Melt butter in frying pan and brown veal lightly on both sides. Remove veal and set aside. Add mushrooms and saute for a few minutes. Add wine and cook over high heat for 2 minutes scraping pan. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil. Return veal to pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Place veal in platter and pour sauce over top. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings. Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley sprigs if desired.

title: Dog Food
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat melt the butter chocolate chips and peanut butter. Stir in the Crispix until it is well coated. After the mixture is coated well pour it into a plastic bag or bowl with a lid that contains the powdered sugar. Gently toss mixture until well coated. Store in an airtight container.

title: Summer Ice Cream
instructions: Place Pet milk in freezer for 2.5 hours. Melt butter and mix with 1/5 packages of crushed graham crackers. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with crushed graham crackers (save 3/4 cup for later). Cream sugar with cream cheese. Whip Pet milk until very fluffy and will stand in peaks. Pour jello into cream cheese mixture. Combine with whipped cream and add vanilla. Pour into cracker crust. Sprinkle top with remaining crushed graham crackers. Freeze for 2 hours.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Add sugar and flour. Gradually stir in boiling water. Bring to boil for 1 minute stirring gradually. Add berries and sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This recipe will serve 10 people.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Sift flour with baking soda and salt. In small bowl chop apples 1/2 cup nuts and lemon peel. Combine sugar salad oil and eggs. Beat well with spoon. Add flour mixture mixing until smooth. Add apple mixture; stir until smooth. Spread in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Ice with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Baked Apple Cake
instructions: Slice apples in baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Mix flour sugar salt and baking powder in a bowl. Beat together the oil and egg. Add to flour mixture. Spread over apples. Sprinkle with coconut. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes one 9-inch square pan.

title: Exquisite Pie
instructions: Melt butter; mix with remaining ingredients and pour into unbaked 9-inch crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Food Cake Topping
instructions: Combine dry pudding to pineapple. Fold in Cool Whip. Serve over sliced angel food cake.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch corn syrup and water in pan. Bring to boil. Cook constantly until thick and clear. Add Jell-O stirring until dissolved. Cool. Place strawberries in baked shell. Pour gelatin mixture over strawberries. Chill until firm. Top with whipped cream and serve.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Pie
instructions: In small bowl combine sugar cinnamon flour and salt mixing well. Add to apples in large bowl tossing lightly to combine. Turn into pastry lined pie plate mounding high in center. Dot with butter. Place top crust over apples and trim. Crimp the crust to seal. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Yield One 9-inch pie.

title: Veg-All Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine soup Veg-All chicken milk thyme and pepper. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust. Crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust and brush with egg. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Place peaches into unbaked pie shell round side up. Mix 1 cup sugar 1/4 cup butter 1 egg 1 tbsp flour (more if peaches are very juicy) and 1 tsp vanilla. Blend and spread over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Place the onion in a large bowl. Add the spinach on top. Sprinkle with raisins and nuts. Serve with your favorite French dressing.

title: The World'S Best Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; add egg and mix well. Add oil and vanilla and mix well. Add oats cereal and coconut. Add nuts and stir well. Combine flour soda and salt; add to other ingredients and mix well. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in cold water. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Bake cookies for 12 minutes. Cool a few minutes before removing. They stay moist and keep beautifully!

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice in 2 cups of water; rinse in colander and drain. Add Cheez Whiz while rice is hot. Saute celery and onion in oleo until clear. Prepare broccoli as directed on package. Add oleo and chop very fine; drain broccoli. Combine all stuff with undiluted mushroom soup. Pour into an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch Pyrex dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Easy Cheesy Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage with onion; drain and set aside. Wipe out the same pan with paper towel and melt the 1 1/2 tablespoons butter. Add beaten eggs to the pan and scramble lightly. Fold in mushrooms and sausage mixture and set aside. In a medium saucepan melt 2 tablespoons butter with salt pepper and flour. Add milk stirring over low heat until smooth and thickened. Stir in cheese to melt. Add dry mustard and blend. Fold sauce into the reserved egg mixture. Pour into a buttered casserole dish and bake 30 minutes. Can be made ahead refrigerated and heated at serving time. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Blend flour sugar and shortening. Add egg yolk and water mixture. Stir until dough forms ball. Roll out. Recipe makes three two-crust pies plus single crust. Dough may be kept in freezer several weeks. Thaw at room temperature. Mix will not make dough tough.

title: Double-Crust Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Saute chicken and onion in butter for 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and next 9 ingredients. Bring to boil cover reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove bay leaf.

title: Ratatouille Rounds
instructions: Allow crusts to come to room temperature. Cut rounds from the crust using a 3 inch biscuit cutter. Combine the butter and olive oil in a heavy skillet and heat. Add onion eggplant zucchini tomato garlic and seasoning. Cook on medium heat for about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Put about 1 1/2 teaspoons of the filling in the center of each pastry round. Pull up about 1/2 inch of the pastry over the filling all around the circle and pleat it around the edge of the filling. There will be no pastry over the center of the filling. It will be an open face filling peeking through the pleated pastry edge. Brush the pastry with the egg wash and sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 450 degrees for about 12 minutes or until pastry is golden brown. Makes 20.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until creamy.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Combine squash and onions; sprinkle with salt. Let set for 1 hour. Drain off liquid. Mix vinegar sugar celery seed and mustard seed in a saucepan. Bring to a hard boil; then add squash and onions. Bring to a boil and then fill jars.

title: Hawaiian Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. If beans become too dry add reserved pineapple juice.

title: Mexican Munchie
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese on large plate. Top with refried beans. Spread over cream cheese. Pour salsa over beans and top with sliced black olives. Serve with taco chips.

title: Good Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine onions celery green pepper French dressing and caraway seed. Dip cauliflower tidbits into dressing. Yields 8 servings.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: In large container combine squash onions peppers and salt. Cover with crushed ice; mix well. Let stand for 3 hours. Drain; rinse and drain again. In a large kettle combine remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Add squash mixture; return to a boil. Ladle hot mixture into hot jars leaving 1/4 inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process for 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Yield 8 pints.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake on 350\u00b0 until firm. Makes 2 pies.

title: Kool-Aid Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water. Add Kool-Aid (lime for green or tropical punch for red). Mix pineapple juice with sugar and water mixture. Put in freezer overnight to make icy. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Sausage Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Crumble sausage into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Add onion and green peppers; stir well. Cover and microwave on High for 7 to 8 minutes or until sausage is browned stirring once. Drain well; set aside.

title: Carrot Bread
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Add oil vanilla eggs and carrots. Beat until smooth. Grease and flour loaf pans. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Scallop Bisque
instructions: Rinse scallops to remove any grit and if large cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Cook onion in butter until tender. Blend in flour and gradually add milk. Cook and stir over low heat until slightly thickened. Add salt pepper spice bag scallops and Worcestershire sauce. Cook gently for 10 minutes. Remove spice bag and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and cinnamon in a paper bag and shake biscuit pieces in mixture. Place coated biscuit pieces in a tube pan or Bundt pan. Cook margarine and sugar until thick and pour over biscuit pieces in pan. Nuts may be added if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes in pan before putting on plate.

title: The Not Exactly Neiman-Marcus Cookie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Process oatmeal in blender or food processor until oatmeal turns into fine powder. Set aside. Cream the butter with both sugars. Add eggs one at a time then vanilla. Add flour salt baking powder baking soda and oatmeal. Stir in chocolate chips grated Hershey bar and nuts. Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast Bake
instructions: Crumble the sausage in medium skillet. Cook over medium heat until browned stirring occasionally. Drain well.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in wok or large skillet. Add remaining ingredients; stir-fry over high heat for about 5 minutes or until zucchini is crisp-tender. Serve over Texmati rice.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream sugar oil and eggs together. Sift dry ingredients together. Add all at once with buttermilk and vanilla to creamed mixture. Mix well. Stir in apples and walnuts. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Put cookies in food processor or blender and crush until mixture looks like dirt. Set aside. Cream margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix pudding and milk according to package directions. Add to cream cheese mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer cookies cream cookies cream etc. in an 8-inch flowerpot lined with Reynolds Wrap. End with cookie \dirt\ layer on top. Decorate with an artificial flower and plastic spoon resembling a small shovel to serve.

title: Mushroom Lima Bake
instructions: Cook lima beans in 3/4 cup water for 5 minutes then drain. Slice onions and mushrooms then saute them in margarine and salt. Add mushroom soup when onions are cooked. Combine lima beans with soup mixture and put it in a buttered 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese and pour heavy cream over the top. Serves 8 to 10. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Place softened cream cheese in 8 x 8-inch dish. Pour chili over it. Sprinkle cheese over chili. Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 or microwave until bubbly. Stir and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Broccoli Spears Stuffed
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Stir remaining ingredients except butter and stuffing mix. In separate pan melt butter and mix stuffing in with it. Spread other ingredients in baking dish. Sprinkle butter and stuffing mix on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Cacciataco
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with Lawrys seasoned salt. Brown on all sides in hot oil; drain. Combine taco seasoning mix water and tomatoes (chopped up). Pour this mixture over chicken. Cover and simmer 40 minutes. Serve over cooked rice or spaghetti. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili Con Queso Dip
instructions: Saute onion in 2-3 Tbsp. butter. Add all other ingredients. Melt and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Golden Glow Salad
instructions: Add boiling water to jello; stir until dissolved. Add combined juice and cold water. Mix in rest of ingredients. Chill until firm.

title: Chicken Salad For 30
instructions: Gently toss together chicken pieces celery onion and crushed pineapple. Combine mayonnaise with next 4 ingredients. Adjust seasoning to taste. Pour over chicken mixture and gently toss to coat well. Refrigerate. Sprinkle with almonds just before serving.

title: Creamy Asparagus Soup
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in butter in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat stirring constantly until tender. Stir in asparagus and next 7 ingredients. Bring to a boil stirring often. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes stirring often. Cool slightly. Pour half of mixture into container of an electric blender; process until smooth stopping once to scrape down sides. Transfer mixture to another container. Repeat procedure. Return asparagus mixture to Dutch oven. Stir in milk; cook just until thoroughly heated (do not boil). Dollop each serving with sour cream and garnish if desired. Yield 2 quarts.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: In a large saucepan bring 4 cups water to a boil. Add shrimp and simmer 1 to 3 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Drain and set aside. In a large skillet combine onion green pepper and 1/4 cup water. Cover and simmer 3 to 4 minutes or until vegetables are slightly tender. Do not drain.

title: Egg Souffle
instructions: Mix everything together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan (or until knife inserted in center shows that the egg is well cooked). This can be prepared and refrigerated overnight for a special Sunday morning breakfast.

title: Chicken Rice Dish
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients and put in 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over the top then crunch potato chips and sprinkle over the cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly then turn down to 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Layered Spinach-Lettuce Salad
instructions: Layer first 8 ingredients in large plastic bowl/container. Combine mayonnaise sour cream and salad dressing mix. Spread over top of salad sealing to edge of bowl. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Pink Pina Colada Pie
instructions: Spread coconut evenly in bottom of a 9-inch pie plate. Microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes or golden brown. Toss with fork every minute. Set aside.

title: Beer Batter Fish
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Combine mix salt egg and beer until smooth. Dip fish and drip excess. Fry until brown on both sides.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large mixer bowl beat condensed milk and peanut butter until smooth. Add Bisquick and vanilla; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned. (Do not overbake.) Immediately press a chocolate candy kiss in the center of each ball. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Cajun Spice Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage with onion and garlic. Add package of taco mix. Stir and brown. Place in Dutch oven. Add the peeled tomatoes (juice and all). Add tomato paste pepper and Worcestershire. Bring to boil. Add chili powder; simmer. Add water if needed or flour to thicken. Simmer for about 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Sift together 2 cups flour and confectioners sugar. Cut in butter until mix clings together. Press in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Cheese Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix flour cheese spread and margarine thoroughly. Shape into 50 balls. Cut Smok-Y-Links into 16 pieces each. Shape cheese mixture around each piece. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Add everything to melted butter except eggs. Blend and add eggs and vinegar. Blend well with fork. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine apples celery walnuts and raisins. Blend salad dressing lemon juice sugar and salt. Fold dressing into apple mixture. Chill. Serve on lettuce leaf. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: 7 Layer Cookies
instructions: Layer ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan. Drizzle milk over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Slice green tomatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Let stand on paper towel for 15 minutes. Put 1 cup flour in plastic bag; add tomato slices. Fry until brown.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside. Combine soup milk sour cream pepper and 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt. Stir in potatoes 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup French fried onions.

title: Sweet Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind up peppers and onion in food chopper. Add vinegar sugar and pickle spices (wrapped in cloth). Pour about a pint of hot water in mixture for 15 minutes; let drain then cook slow for 35 to 40 minutes. Take off and cool. Put in jars and seal. Wonderful on dried beans.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash with 1/2 onion until tender. Drain then mash. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and put in casserole. Sprinkle with rest of crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Pie Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients as for pastry. Split dough in half and roll out to fit cookie sheet pressing dough into corners. Put one layer of apples (sliced thin and peeled) on dough. Mix sugar and flour; sprinkle this over apples. Sprinkle cinnamon over apples also. Roll out remaining dough and place over top of apples again pressing into corners. Cut slits over entire top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 51 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from oven and cover with thin glaze of powdered sugar and water. Do not cover tightly.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Combine together all ingredients and mix well. Press into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add 1/2 teaspoon soda and a pinch of cream of tartar. (This will be foamy.) Pour over 8 quarts popped corn. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 20 minutes. Place on two greased cookie sheets.

title: Lemon Rice
instructions: Combine rice margarine garlic lemon peel pepper and broth in a 2 or 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Stir in parsley. Add salt to taste.

title: Colossal Cheeseburger
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 12-inch pizza pan or cookie sheet. In large frying pan brown ground beef and onion. Drain well. Stir in salt pepper chili powder and tomato sauce. Simmer while preparing crust. Separate crescent dough into 16 triangles. Arrange 13 triangles around pan spoke fashion with narrow tips of triangle extending over pan about 5 inches. Press remaining triangles in center of pan. Seal perforations. Spread meat over dough and sprinkle with cheese. Bring dough tips over filling to the center. Pinch edges to seal. Brush with milk. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Combine flour salt and dash of pepper. Coat meat cubes in seasoned flour. Brown in hot shortening in Dutch oven; add soup 2 1/2 cup water onion and basil. Cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 1 hour. Add potatoes carrots and wine. Cover. Bake 1 hour longer or until tender. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Mix crackers with 1/2 cup sugar. Add nuts and vanilla. Fold in egg whites and 1/2 cup sugar with crackers. Grease pan good. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Cool. Cover with whipped cream.

title: Lemonade Salad
instructions: Heat 1 cup syrup (drained from fruit cocktail); add gelatin and stir until dissolved. Add undiluted lemonade. Chill until partially thickened. Add drained fruit cocktail and nuts. Pour into a mold. Serve on crisp greens.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Spread this over baked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden. Cool. Chill completely. Cut into small (these are very rich) diamond shaped bars. Store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Aunt Annie'S Shrimp Mold
instructions: Heat soup gelatin and water. Stir until smooth. Stir in cream cheese. Remove from heat. Stir in rest of ingredients in order. Pour in 1-quart mold and refrigerate. Serve with Ritz or Town House crackers. Make day ahead!

title: Barbecue Brisket
instructions: In a large broiler slice onion and lay flat in bottom of broiler. Place brisket on top of onion with fat side up. Season well with seasoned salt and pour in Pepsi. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Take out; drain Pepsi. Mix Pepsi and sauce; baste and bake for another 45 minutes.

title: Roux(Microwave-Style)
instructions: Mix oil and flour together in a 4-cup microwave-safe measure. Microwave on High for 6 to 7 minutes. Stir at 6 minutes. Roux will be a light brown at this time and will need to cook 30 seconds to 1 minute longer to reach the dark brown color so important in making Louisiana gumbos and stews. This roux will be very hot but usually the handle on your glass measuring cup will stay cool enough to touch. Add onion celery and bell pepper to roux in measuring cup. Stir and return to microwave. Saute on High 3 minutes. Add garlic parsley and green onions to roux. Stir and return to microwave. Saute on High 2 minutes. You should have about 3 3/4 cups roux now. If any oil has risen to top pour off. Slowly add enough hot tap water to bring roux to the 4 cups mark. Stir and you will have a smooth dark roux in only 12 minutes. Roux freezes very well and you are ready at any time to put together a delicious gumbo or stew.

title: Six Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for several hours. Can be served as salad on lettuce or as dessert in pretty bowls.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw hash browns. Mix first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered with foil.

title: Zucchini Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes.

title: Leann'S Brownie Delight
instructions: Make brownies according to package but substitute the applesauce for the oil and use egg substitute for the eggs. Cool. Cut brownie into a 2-inch square pour 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup over and top with one scoop frozen yogurt. Makes 24 servings. Calories 133 Protein 1.85 g Carbohydrate 23 g Total Fat 1 g Sodium 106 mg.

title: Sukiyaki
instructions: Cut meat into thin slices across the grain 1 inch wide and 2 inches long. Sprinkle meat with paprika. Brown in butter 2 to 3 minutes. Pour mixture of soy sauce water monosodium glutamate and liquid sweetener over meat. Push meat to one side of skillet or wok keep ingredients separate. Add green onions and fresh mushrooms. Cover and cook over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Add bean sprouts bamboo shoots and water chestnuts. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes so not overcooked. Serve over rice (1/2 cup cooked rice per serving do not add salt to rice when cooking). Yield 6 servings. Carbohydrate 28 g protein 18 g fat 20 g calories 364. One serving= 2 meat medium fat exchange 1 1/2 bread starch exchange 1 vegetable exchange 2 fat exchange.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Put a spoonful or two in a glass and add water (hot if preferred).

title: Cornish Hens
instructions: Combine ingredients stirring well. Brush hens with soy sauce mixture and place breast side up in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours to 1 1/2 hours depending on size of hen. Baste often with soy sauce mixture. Serve 1 hen for each person.

title: Delicious Brownies
instructions: Melt butter. Sift flour and mix all ingredients together by hand. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Tree
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients mixing well. Shape into a cone (flat). Press chopped parsley onto tree shape to cover all surfaces. Place cranberries on tree as ornaments. Serve with crackers. Yields 1 Cheese Tree.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix ingredients; add enough milk to make a batter that will drop in balls from a spoon. Fry in hot deep oil until done.

title: Harvard Beet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Beat eggs and vanilla together. Add to creamed mixture; add dry ingredients and water. Drain and fine chop beets; stir into batter. Pour into 2 (8-inch) lightly greased and floured pans. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Fill with cherry pie filling between 2 layers and frost with cream cheese frosting. Chill and serve.

title: Fresh Cranberry Relish
instructions: In a food processor or blender chop cranberries into big pieces. Add nuts and chop. Add orange and sugar and chop until desired consistency. Refrigerate.

title: Sugar-Free Snack Cake
instructions: Bring fruits and water to a boil. Add butter and boil for 5 minutes. Set aside to cool. Add remaining ingredients to mixture. Bake in 11 x 7 x 2-inch pan that has been greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Freezing Corn
instructions: Wash and silk corn. Cut off cob. Mix corn water salt and sugar well together. Put in plastic bags or containers and freeze. (No cooking required before you freeze.)

title: Irish Tea Scones
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In large bowl sift or stir together first 5 ingredients. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Make well in center; set aside.

title: Stir-Fried Shrimp And Snow Peas
instructions: In wok or large skillet heat 2 tablespoons corn oil over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms snow peas bean sprouts and green onions; stir-fry 2 minutes. Remove. Add 1 tablespoon corn oil and shrimp; stir-fry 2 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Return vegetables. Stir in the cup of stir-fry sauce mix. Stirring constantly bring to boil over medium heat and boil for 1 minute. Serves 4.

title: Ginny'S Navy Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans; cover with water and soak overnight. Drain. Place all ingredients in a pressure cooker. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Close cover securely. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe and cook 30 minutes at 15 pounds. Let pressure drop of its own accord. Serves 10 to 12. Alternate cooking method is in large soup pot on medium flame for 3 1/2 to 4 hours or until beans are soft.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Put hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan and put remaining ingredients over top putting cheese on last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Or mix all together and top with crushed potato chips and bake.

title: Cotton Family Pound Cake
instructions: Blend sugar butter and eggs together until creamy. Add flour and baking powder slowly adding cream until all flour has been added. Add lemon and vanilla flavor. Beat until creamy.

title: Bourbon Slush
instructions: Mix all ingredients and freeze for at least 36 hours. Stir every couple of hours for about 4 times until thoroughly blended.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix the sugar butter and eggs together. Then add the coconut and vinegar. Pour the mixture into the pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Bacon And Vegetable Bread
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain off fat and crumble. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butter and cheese in a small bowl. Cut biscuits into 1/4 pieces. Roll biscuits fourths in cheese mixture. Arrange half the biscuits in a Bundt pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Layer bacon green pepper onion and remaining biscuits half at a time in prepared pan. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Invert on to serving plate. Cut into 8 servings.

title: Mexican Beef Dip
instructions: Melt Velveeta cheese in double boiler until melted. Brown ground beef and diced onion in skillet and drain excess fat. Add ground beef onion and Ro-Tel to melted cheese; reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve with your favorite chips.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix all together except biscuits. Pour over biscuits which have been crumbled into small pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 until a little brown and pudding is set. Do not overcook.

title: Grilled Chicken Oriental
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces. Place chicken in marinade and refrigerate several hours. Thread chicken pieces onto skewers. Grill chicken brushing occasionally with marinade.

title: Potato Balls
instructions: Put cooked peeled and chopped potatoes in large mixing bowl. Add chilies (drained) and garlic; mix together well. Separate egg whites from yolks. Beat whites until stiff then add yolks. Beat again. Use frying skillet and 1/2 cup oil; heat to medium heat. Put flour on plate; take a tablespoon of potato mixture and put on flour. Roll into ball; dip ball into egg mixture and deep-fry each ball for about 1 minute until crust is done. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spread out dough in pizza pan and bake at recommended temperature until golden brown; let cool.

title: Peanut Butter Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine cake mix eggs and oil. Add other ingredients. Spray cookie sheets with a nonstick spray. Roll cookie dough into balls about the size of a large marble. Arrange on cookie sheet allowing space for dough to spread. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned. Yield 3 1/2 to 4 dozen crisp cookies.

title: Chicken Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the chicken to make a nice moist filling. Half this mixture into 2 separate bowls. In one bowl add the cooked chicken and mix again. Spoon a portion of this filling into the tortilla shells and roll up. Spoon the remaining bowl of filling atop the shells after they have been placed in a long baking dish. Be sure to grease the dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Bring to boil and pour over cucumbers that are washed and put in jars with dill and garlic. Seal hot.

title: Burritos
instructions: Brown meat; add seasonings and taco seasoning mix. Add soup and refried beans to the meat mixture (will be soupy but thick). Heat tortillas on both sides in a little butter until soft (easy to roll). Put meat mixture in shell and roll up. Place in foil to keep warm. Heat chili in separate pan; add water to make sauce. When serving burritos serve with chili sauce shredded lettuce tomatoes grated cheese sour cream etc. Any burritos not eaten may be frozen (I normally use plastic wrap then I can reheat in the microwave).

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown onion bell pepper and meat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place cabbage in long baking dish. Add rice to meat mixture and spread over cabbage. Heat tomato soup and water and pour over mixture. Wrap in foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until done (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Add grated cheese and brown.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add rest of ingredients and simmer 1/2 hour. Serve on hamburger buns. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Pumpkin Pie Crunch
instructions: Combine pumpkin and the next 5 ingredients. Pour into a greased (bottom only) 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over pumpkin mixture. Top with nuts. Drizzle melted margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Southern Party Potatoes
instructions: Defrost potatoes. Combine butter salt pepper onion soup sour cream and cheese. Mix thoroughly. Pour over potatoes into 3-quart casserole. Mix 1/4 cup butter and cornflakes; sprinkle over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 16.

title: Spinach Lasagna(Low-Fat)
instructions: In medium bowl mix cottage cheese spinach egg product and Italian seasoning. Set aside. Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce in bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer 1/3 each of noodles spinach filling and remaining sauce; repeat twice. Sprinkle top with Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Uncover. Bake 25 minutes longer. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chex Muddy Buddies Recipe
instructions: Pour cereals into large bowl. Set aside. In 1-quart microwave-safe bowl combine Hersheys chocolate chips Reeses peanut butter and margarine. Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth stirring after 1 minute. Stir in vanilla. Pour chocolate mixture over cereals stirring until all pieces are evenly coated. Pour cereal mixture into large Glad-Lock bag with powdered sugar. Seal securely and shake until all pieces are well coated. Spread on waxed paper to cool.

title: Double Delicious Cookie Bars
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan in oven. Spread graham cracker crumbs evenly over butter. Pour milk evenly over crumbs. Sprinkle chips in and press into crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Salmon Stew
instructions: Brown bacon and onion. Add salmon ketchup and a little water. Heat. Do not stir too much or it will become mushy. Serve over rice.

title: Fiesta Bean And Rice Bake
instructions: In a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole combine beans picante sauce rice beef and half the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Serve with tortilla chips if desired. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cover zucchini with water and boil until tender then drain or steam zucchini. Set aside. Brown hamburger with garlic powder onion green pepper and salt; drain. Add tomatoes and tomato paste. Cook for about 10 minutes. Add drained zucchini. Stir well.

title: Shoo-Fly Cakes
instructions: Mix flour sugar shortening and salt and take out 1 cup of crumbs for the top. Mix boiling water with baking soda and add King syrup. Mix well. Pour into dry ingredients and mix. Grease and flour (or use Bakers Joy) three 7 x 2-inch cake pans. Two large pans could be used. Pour into pans and top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 to 45 minutes. Test with toothpick for doneness. You can use this recipe to make cupcakes also.

title: Herman Cake Sourdough Starter
instructions: On the 10th day use the starter to make the cake. The cake uses 2 cups starter; give one cup to a friend and save 1 cup for your next cake (feed the starter you keep this day and five days later).

title: Apricot Loaf
instructions: Soak dried apricots in warm water for 15 minutes. Drain water and cut apricots into pieces. Set aside. Cream in shortening and sugar together. Add eggs; blend well. Add sifted flour baking powder baking soda and salt alternately with water and orange juice. Fold in apricots and nuts. Pour batter in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Push batter into corners of pan leaving center slightly hollow. Let stand for 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Wash raisins and drain. Cream shortening with sugar then add eggs and milk. Combine oatmeal raisins and mix well. Add flour sifted with soda salt and cinnamon. Beat thoroughly. Drop onto greased pans and bake about 12 minutes in oven 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Makes about 3 dozen medium cookies. (I omit oatmeal). The cookies are moister without oatmeal.

title: Crab Mold
instructions: Sprinkle gelatine over heated soup. Mix and cool slightly. Add other ingredients and stir. Put into greased mold and refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Tomato Rice Pilaf
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add onions; saute until transparent. Add rice; saute about 5 minutes stirring often. Add hot chicken stock tomatoes and salt. Cover tightly; bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is dry and fluffy. (May be served in scooped out tomatoes.)

title: Raisin Squares
instructions: Add water to raisins and boil for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add shortening and let cool while you sift the flour sugar soda and spices together. Add to cooled raisin mixture and beat well. Add egg and beat. Add nuts of desired. Pour into a large flat greased and floured pan. Bake about 35 minutes in moderate oven. Cut into squares.

title: Coco-Berry Calypso
instructions: In blender combine berries and cream of coconut. Cover; blend until smooth. With blender running add ice cubes one at a time through opening in lid. Blend until slushy. Serve in chilled glasses. Makes 3 (6 ounces) servings.

title: Brazilian Cocoa
instructions: In top of double boiler combine chocolate sugar and salt. Stir in water. Over simmering water heat until chocolate is melted. Stir in milk and coffee. Add nutmeg. Top with whipped cream. Sprinkle with instant coffee.

title: Salmon Log
instructions: Drain salmon. Combine next 6 ingredients with salmon. Shape into log and roll in nuts and parsley.

title: Sugared Walnuts
instructions: Cook sugars milk and butter to soft ball. Add vanilla. Cool then beat until it turns white. Stir in walnuts. Put on buttered pan.

title: Old-World Raspberry Bars
instructions: *Ten ounce jar of your favorite flavor preserves can be substituted for 10 ounces raspberry preserves.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook sausage until done. Crumble and drain. Mix cheese and sausage. Sprinkle in pie shell. Lightly beat eggs in bowl. Combine remaining ingredients with egg mixture. Pour into shell on top of sausage and cheese. Bake 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Easy Day Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour 1/2 batter then 1/2 brown sugar mixture then the rest of batter and the rest of brown sugar mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Zucchini Spoon Bread Casserole
instructions: Wash zucchini; chop into small cubes. Add onion and grated cheese to zucchini. Add Bisquick salt pepper and oregano. Add eggs and oil; mix well. Bake in greased casserole dish. Can be frozen uncooked. Make sure to defrost 3 hours before baking. For main dish just add 2 cans of lobster or crabmeat. Serve warm.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper. Coat stew meat then place into 4 quart pot. In a 2 cup microwave container bring water to a boil and add the bouillon cubes and Worcestershire sauce. Pour this over meat and add all other ingredients except the tomato paste. Add enough water to cover vegetables. Cook on medium heat for 4 hours stirring occasionally. Stir in tomato paste.

title: Brady'S Fish Fry Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add onion. Gradually stir in milk and eggs; set aside while you fry fish so mixture can rise. Do not stir. After rising drop from teaspoon into hot fat where fish was fried. Enjoy.

title: Stuffed Turkey Mushrooms
instructions: Remove the stems on the mushrooms and chop. Heat chicken broth and cook onions and ground turkey. Add chopped mushroom stems and other ingredients. Cook this mixture about 5 minutes. Stuff this mixture into the mushroom caps and sprinkle with the grated cheese. Preheat your broiler and place in oven for 2 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Easy Apple Pie
instructions: Place apples in oblong pan. Mix 1/4 tsp. cinnamon and 1 c. sugar then sprinkle over apples. Melt stick of margarine then add 1/2 c. sugar 1/4 tsp. cinnamon 1 c. flour and 3 Tbsp. water. Mix well and spread over apples. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Recipe For Love
instructions: Mix well and serve with smiles and laughter daily.

title: Chicken Kelly I
instructions: Marinate chicken chunks in eggs for 2 hours in refrigerator. Mix bread crumbs parsley and garlic salt in large storage bag. Place chicken in bag and shake to coat. Brown chicken lightly in olive oil. In 13 x 9-inch sprayed dish lay chicken then mushrooms and cheese and pour bouillon over. Cover dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Dad'S Barbecue
instructions: Bring mustard vinegar oil and water to boil; baste the meat with this each time you turn the meat about 2 or 3 times before adding the barbecue sauce.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Add jam. Mix all dry ingredients then add alternately with liquids. Add pecans last. Steam for 1 hour in a 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Carrot And Zucchini Muffins
instructions: Grease or spray 12 (3-inch) muffin pan cups. In a large bowl stir together dry ingredients. In medium bowl with fork beat egg slightly. Stir in buttermilk oil and vanilla. Stir egg mixture vegetables nuts and raisins into flour mixture just until flour is moistened. Spoon batter into muffin pan cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until golden and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool muffins in pan on rack 5 minutes. Carefully remove muffins from pan.

title: Sweet Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in baking dish and bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Beat margarine Crisco and sugar for 10 minutes. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk alternately with flour first and last. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375. In large bowl combine broth sour cream and gravy. Mix well with a wire whisk. Stir in uncooked noodles peas ham paprika and 1/8 tsp. of pepper. Spoon into ungreased shallow 2 qt. casserole. Place chicken over noodle mixture. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and remaining pepper. Cover with foil. Bake uncovered at 375 for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more or until chicken is tender and juice runs clear. Noodles should also be tender. Place 2 cheese slice halves over each chicken breast. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Fruitcake
instructions: Combine flour spices baking powder and salt. Sift 3 times. Cream butter with sugar. Add eggs beating thoroughly after each. Reserve some flour mixture. Add remaining flour to creamed mixture. Mix well. Sift reserved flour over fruit-nut mix. Turn batter into fruit-nut mix and stir together. Pour into 1-pound loaf pan that has been lined with greased brown paper. Fill to within 1/8 to 1/4-inch of top. Rap pans to pack batter down. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Hot water may be placed in oven with cake to keep it moist.

title: Lemon-Pecan Fruitcake
instructions: Cream together sugar and margarine until smooth; add beaten egg yolks and mix well. Combine 2 cups flour and baking powder and add to creamed mixture. Add lemon extract. Coat pecans pineapple and cherries (all chopped) with 2 cups flour and add to creamed mixture. Fold in beaten egg whites. Cover and let stand overnight. The next day put mixture into a greased tube pan and bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Skin chicken; remove all visible fat and cut into serving pieces. Place all ingredients except mushrooms and wine into pot over medium-high heat. Bring to boil. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Add mushrooms and wine and simmer for 5 more minutes. Garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Banana Milkshake
instructions: In blender put all ingredients except ice cubes. Turn blender on liquify for 10 to 15 seconds then add ice cube. Turn on ice breaker for about 15 seconds. Makes 2 shakes.

title: Daisy'S Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over the oats; while hot add Crisco salt molasses sugar and cold water. Stir in flour and stir as long as can be stirred easily; adding flour as needed to knead well. This can be assembled and mixed down overnight. In the morning it will be ready for tins. Let rise and bake about 40 minutes at 300\u00b0. Will make 2 double loaves.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth about 30 seconds. Serve immediately. Makes 3 cups.

title: Rice Casserole(Delicious With Chicken)
instructions: Mix all together in baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. I double this recipe.

title: Chicken Turnovers
instructions: Depending on the size of your chicken you may use 2 packages cream cheese. Mix all ingredients together. Using 2 crescent rolls to form a square put 2 triangles together. Put 2 tablespoons of chicken mixture into middle of square and fold over. Pinch edges together and bake according to roll directions.

title: Raisin Bread
instructions: Heat milk to boiling point. Put butter sugar raisins and nutmeg in a large bowl. Pour heated milk over this. Mix and set aside to cool. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water and 1 tablespoon sugar. Combine mixtures and eggs. Stir well. Start adding flour by cups mixing until kneading consistency; not too hard. Cover. Let rise. Punch down. Let rise again. Punch down. Form into loaves. Let rise. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Home Baked Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll very thin. Sprinkle with sugar. Cut and bake in oven at 400\u00b0.

title: Mamie Snyder'S Lemon Sponge
instructions: Beat egg whites and add last. Put into unbaked pie shell; bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Dont let top get too dark.

title: Russian Salad
instructions: Heat marshmallows milk and cream cheese together until solid ingredients are melted. Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add remaining ingredients to gelatin. Combine the two mixtures. Congeal. May add some chopped nuts on top after it has congealed.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar corn meal flour salt and margarine. Add milk lemon juice and grated lemon rind. Pour into a 10-inch unbaked (pricked in middle 3 times) pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Or Turkey Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place mixture in greased casserole dish. Top with 1/2 cup grated cheese and 1/2 c. crushed potato chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Strawberry Wine Punch
instructions: Wash berries and chop coarsely. Combine the berries with Rose wine sugar undiluted pineapple juice and salt. Grate lemon rind and squeeze juice. Add to wine and berry mixture. Add empty lemon shells to mixture. Cover and chill overnight. Strain liquid discarding pulp. Add the strained liquid to Cold Duck and serve over ice.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Melt butter in 2-quart saucepan. Add peanut butter and stir still creamy. Stir in powdered sugar until hot and coarse. Press into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour chocolate chips on top and melt. Refrigerate.

title: Fluffy Frosting
instructions: Scald milk; cool. Beat egg whites stiff. Fold into cooled milk with vanilla. Combine sugar oleo and shortening. Beat at high speed 5 minutes. Add milk mixture. Slowly beat 5 minutes more until fluffy.

title: Diet Soup
instructions: Simmer all ingredients until vegetables are tender.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix chicken soup broth and vegetables in dish. Spoon in flour and buttermilk mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Pour butter or margarine over crust. Bake 20 to 40 minutes until crust is brown.

title: Rosemary Chicken
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Bring to boil and set aside. Combine margarine orange juice concentrate vermouth salt and pepper; set aside. Wash and pat dry chicken. Dip into orange juice then into flour mixture (flour salt ginger and pepper). Brown chicken in margarine and oil. Add rosemary seasoning; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until liquid evaporates. Cook rice; blend with peas and half of margarine mixture. Spread rice on bottom of ovenproof dish. Arrange chicken; cover with remaining margarine mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes covered. Remove cover and cook for 10 minutes further.

title: French Silk Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat butter at low speed until very creamy. Gradually add sugar; beat at low speed until very creamy. Melt chocolate and cool; then add to batter a little at a time. Continue to beat until creamy. Add vanilla; then add 1 egg. Mix into batter 3 to 5 minutes at medium speed. Repeat with second egg. Pour into pie shell. Refrigerate. Top with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

title: Chicken Tettrazinni
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour in 9x13 casserole dish. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa flour cornmeal and dash of salt in a mixing bowl. Add eggs milk vanilla margarine and pecans. Beat well and pour into a 9-inch deep dish pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until center is firm. Cool and sprinkle or sift a little powdered sugar on top.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat and garlic and drain. Stir in beans corn taco sauce and chili powder. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Combine in bowl the lettuce tomatoes green pepper cheese and onions. Divide mixture in tortilla cups. Top with beef mixture. Serves 6.

title: Crunchy Chicken Bake
instructions: Melt margarine in flat baking dish. Combine egg and milk. Set aside. Mix potato flakes cheese salt and pepper together. Dip chicken first in egg and milk mixture then roll in potato flake mixture and coat well. Place chicken in baking dish. Reserve left over potato mixture. Bake chicken 30 minutes at 400\u00b0 uncovered. Turn chicken and sprinkle with reserved potato flakes mixture. Bake 30 minutes more or until tender.

title: Grape Juice Cocktail
instructions: Pour 1/2 of the grape juice and 1/2 of the ginger ale into an 8 ounce glass. Serves 2.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add buttermilk bananas and vanilla. Sift together remaining dry ingredients; add to banana mixture. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Fold in floured nuts. Spread batter evenly in two well oiled and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. When cool spread Banana Nut Frosting between layers and over top and sides.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Mix liquids. Alternate dry and liquid ingredients in pie shell (8-inch pie shell) ending with dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm (toothpick test).

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix first four ingredients until creamy. Add remaining ingredients to creamed mixture then add one (12 ounce) package Reeses peanut butter chips to mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Mix apples and brown sugar in baking pan and set aside. Mix flour sugar salt and cinnamon. Set aside. Beat egg and mix with flour mixture. Spread over apples and pour butter on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and sugar; pat into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Let cool. In a separate bowl mix cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Mix well. Spread on top of pretzel crust. Dissolve strawberry jello in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Stir in the frozen strawberries. Cool until begins to thicken; then spoon on top of other mixture and refrigerate.

title: Ann Valentine'S Blushing Tomatoes
instructions: Scoop out pulp leaving 1-inch shell. Drain the pulp. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix until well blended. Add tomato pulp. Chill. Before serving place tomatoes on lettuce and top with dressing. Sprinkle with additional parsley if desired.

title: Honey Mustard Scallop Kabobs
instructions: In small bowl combine wine honey mustard and red pepper. Add scallops; toss to coat well. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Drain scallops reserving marinade. Preheat broiler. On four 14-inch skewers alternately thread scallops cherry tomatoes green pepper cubes and mushrooms. Place kabobs on foil lined broiler pan. Broil 3-inches from source of heat about 8 minutes basting with reserved marinade and turning occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

title: Heath Bar Dessert
instructions: Bake chocolate cake according to directions on box in 8 or 9-inch layer pans. Cool. Make pudding following directions on box. Crush Heath bars with mallet until they are in small pieces. Using a large bowl layer as follows 1 layer cake (cut into chunks) 1/2 chocolate pudding 1/2 Cool Whip 1/2 Heath bar pieces. Repeat layers. Put in refrigerator until ready to serve. Enjoy!

title: Southern Souffle-Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and milk. Add sour cream and stir. Cut beef into small bits; add with remaining ingredients. Bake in small casserole 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top may be sprinkled with slivered almonds before baking. Serve with crackers.

title: Taco Bake
instructions: Brown meat. Drain all liquid off. Mix with tomatoes and soup mix. In long casserole dish place a layer of tacos then a layer of meat another layer of tacos and end with rest of meat mixture. Sprinkle and cover with grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream diced lettuce and tomato salsa sauce and refried beans.

title: Scotts College Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and garlic salt. Drain off excess grease and add the celery and mushroom soups and mix well. Pour this mixture into a 9 X 12 baking dish. Top with velveeta cheese slices. Top with a bag of tater tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tater tots are done. Then top with grated mozzarella cheese and return to oven until cheese melts about 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Copper Carrot Pennies
instructions: Boil carrots in salted water until tender. Cool. Alternate layers of carrots green pepper rings and onion slices in dish. Combine remaining ingredients adding more salt. Beat until well blended and pour over vegetables. Refrigerate. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Mary Hagaman'S Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Spoon into lightly greased shallow 2-quart casserole. Combine 1 cup herb stuffing with 1/4 cup margarine (melted) and 1/2 cup grated cheese. Sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Use a plastic plant pot (8 1/2 inch top and 6 1/2 inch bottom). Put cover of Cool Whip in bottom of pot. Cream or crush cookies in blender and set aside.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening. Add egg and molasses; beat well. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed ingredients. Mix well. Chill dough then shape into 1-inch balls and roll in granulated sugar. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Apple Orange Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour 1/3 cup sugar and salt. Cut butter into small pieces and mix into flour mixture until crumbly.

title: Chicken N' Dressing Casserole
instructions: In a square baking dish place cut up chicken. Pour one can of cream of chicken soup. Using the broth in which the chicken was cooked moisten one half package of the Pepperidge Farm dressing and put on top of soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown beef garlic and onion. Add tomatoes tomato sauce mushrooms sugar oregano salt and basil. Bring to a boil. Boil uncovered 20 to 25 minutes. Stir often. Remove from heat; add spaghetti. Put 1/2 mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with all of Mozzarella cheese. Put rest of spaghetti mix on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hearty Chicken-Rice Dish
instructions: The night before mix water soup broth and rice. Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place chicken breasts on top of mixture. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 2 hours.

title: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce
instructions: In a large skillet melt Crisco. Add onion and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in ground beef and garlic salt; brown. Add mushrooms parsley tomato sauce tomatoes salt oregano pepper basil and bay leaf. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Uncover and cook for about 1/2 hour longer until sauce is desired consistency. Cook spaghetti as directed on package; drain. Spoon meat sauce over spaghetti on platter.

title: Chocolate Cream Frosting
instructions: In small bowl cream together butter and vanilla gradually add cocoa 10x sugar and milk. Beat until smooth (may need to add extra milk). Makes about 2 cups frosting enough for two 8 or 9-inch cakes.

title: Oven Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. In oven melt shortening and butter in a large cast-iron skillet. Mix flour seasoned salt paprika and pepper in a plastic bag. Add pork chops in bag and shake well until all chops are coated. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Turn and continue to bake for 20 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Pasta Shells Florentine
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix spinach 1 cup Mozzarella cheese cottage cheese egg white and Parmesan cheese until well blended. Fill each shell with a heaping tablespoon of spinach mixture. Place in 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Spoon sauce over shells. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle with remaining 4 ounces of Mozzarella cheese and bake for 10 to 20 more minutes until thoroughly heated and cheese bubbles on top. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cool baked crust. Combine Seven-Up sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan. Cook and stir until thick and clear. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Add 6 to 8 drops of red food coloring and almond extract. Wash berries and pat dry. Put berries in pie crust. Pour glaze over berries. Chill. Serve with whipped cream if desired. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Dutch Apple Pie
instructions: Combine apples flour sugar cinnamon and salt in bowl. Mix. Pour in pie crust. Pour cream on top of apples. Add top pie crust. Cut several slits in top of crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Brown 'N Serve Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in milk sugar salt shortening and 2 1/2 cups of the flour. Beat until smooth. Add remaining flour to make soft dough. Knead until smooth.

title: Grape Sherbet
instructions: Mix sugar grape juice lemon juice and pineapple. Whip the cream and add to the mixture. Finish with the required amount of milk. Freeze in a gallon ice cream freezer.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix well and just heat to blend 1 box of Velveeta cheese. Put into a casserole and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Combine ingredients in cooker pot with cabbage on top. Cut meat in pieces if necessary to fit into cooker. Cook on low 12 to 14 hours or on high 6 to 7 hours or on automatic 6 to 8 hours. Yield 4 servings.

title: Chunky Pecan Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Banana Daiquiri
instructions: In blender put banana broken into chunks. Add lots of ice frozen limeade ice cream and rum. Blend adding cold water to thin while blending. Enjoy!

title: Virginia'S Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown beef in 3-quart saucepan; drain off excess fat. Add sauce and water; simmer about 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients except lasagne for filling. Pour about 1 cup sauce on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Layer 3 pieces of uncooked lasagne over sauce*; cover with about 1 1/2 cups sauce. Spread 1/2 cheese filling over sauce. Repeat layers of lasagne sauce and cheese filling. Top with layer of lasagne and remaining sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Remove foil; bake about 10 minutes longer. Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting for easier handling. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Or Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Mix together all ingredients at once. Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar eggs shortening and pumpkin. Stir in flour pumpkin pie spice salt and soda gradually. Add water vanilla and nuts. Pour into a greased and floured 1 pound coffee can about 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until done.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Stir together flour and first amount of sugar; set aside. In large mixer bowl beat egg whites cream of tartar and salt until foamy. Add second amount of sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating on high speed until meringue holds stiff peaks. Gently fold in vanilla. Sprinkle flour-sugar mixture (1/4 cup at a time) over meringue folding in gently just until flour-sugar mixture disappears.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Cook slowly (about 10 minutes) the butter sugar and dates. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Roll into small balls and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes; cut into quarters. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in a bag. Moisten potatoes with a little water; shake a few in the bag mixture at a time coating well. Melt the oleo in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Place potatoes in a layer in the dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn potatoes over once.

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Cream the cream cheese lemon juice Worcestershire sauce garlic salt lemon juice and grated onion together. Spread into bottom of 7 x 9-inch pan. Spread cocktail sauce over top; sprinkle crabmeat over. Garnish with parsley flakes. Good served with Captains wafers.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Cool. Mix remaining ingredients together and add to cool Jell-O in an 8 x 8-inch pan; chill. Serve on lettuce leaves if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Swiss Bliss
instructions: Mix tomato juice Worcestershire sauce and cornstarch. On heavy-duty foil which has been greased and placed on a cookie sheet arrange overlapping pieces of steak. Top with sliced onions green peppers and fresh mushrooms. Pour cornstarch mixture over all. Seal tightly. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 2 hours.

title: Hamburger-Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Press ground beef into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or casserole dish. Salt and pepper meat. Arrange frozen Tater Tots in a single layer covering meat. Spread canned soup evenly over Tater Tots. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours until meat is done.

title: Incredible Edible
instructions: In 13 x 9-inch pan mix brown sugar and cocoa. Stir in water and mix well. Add marshmallows. Prepare cake mix as directed. Spoon cake batter over cocoa mixture. Top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Top with whipped cream to serve.

title: Walnut Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Lightly grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Sift flour baking powder and salt. In small bowl of mixer medium speed beat butter eggs and sugar until fluffy. Beat in melted chocolate and vanilla. On low speed blend in flour mixture. Fold in chopped walnuts. Spread in pan; bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes. Makes 16 squares.

title: Almond Nut Balls
instructions: Cream the margarine and confectioners sugar until light and fluffy. Mix in almonds vanilla lemon and almond extracts until well blended. Stir in flour until well mixed. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 325\u00b0 until very lightly browned about 18 minutes. Remove from sheets and cool on wire racks. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 340\u00b0. Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole. Heat soup with milk. Stir in meat. Layer stuffing then meat twice ending with turkey or chicken. Sprinkle with cheese or croutons. Bake 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Pour each ingredient into cake pan and top with coconut or sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes (until brown).

title: Borscht(Russia)
instructions: Pour the cans of tomatoes and beets (including the juices) into a large soup pot. Add the potatoes and cabbage and cover with water with at least 1 inch over the vegetables. Add the garlic salt and pepper to taste and add the bay leaves. Add the cumin hot peeper and lemon if desired. Bring to a fast boil lower the heat to a low boil and cook until the vegetables are just tender. I usually put all the ingredients in the crockpot in the morning and we have hot soup ready for dinner that evening. Serve with sour cream.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar flour vinegar buttermilk and vanilla. Beat well. Pour into unbaked crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 until firm.

title: Comfort Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in large bowl. Then add oil eggs and vanilla and mix well. Add apples and raisins. Pour batter into greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until cake shrinks from sides of pan. This cake is moist and keeps well for a long time if nobody finds it. If they do its a flash in the pan.

title: Southwestern Chicken With Black Bean Salsa
instructions: Combine ingredients mixing well. Store in covered jar. Also good on shrimp. Rub chicken breasts with seasoning. Cook on grill until done. Top with Black Bean Salsa.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Grease and flour sheet cake pan. Pour 1/3 of cake mixture into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tester is clean about 11 to 15 minutes. Melt caramels and margarine in milk. Pour on top of cake. Sprinkle chips and pecans on caramel mixture. Pour rest of cake mix on top and bake 20 more minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Swedish Delights
instructions: For dough sift together flour sugar and salt. Stir in lemon peel. Cut in butter as in pie crust. Stir in sour cream with a fork until mixture holds together. Knead with hands to combine. Form into a ball and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Pringle'S Candy
instructions: Crush potato chips. Melt white bark. Stir in crushed chips and peanuts. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet lined with wax paper on it. Let set until hard.

title: Hamburger Sour Cream Casserole
instructions: In a casserole dish add 1/2 noodles 1/2 hamburger sauce sour cream cream cheese hamburger and sauce and remaining noodles. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Toast
instructions: In a bowl combine the coconut sugar butter egg and vanilla. Mix well spread over each slice of bread. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Mexican Chef Salad
instructions: Chop lettuce onion and tomatoes. Toss with cheese dressing and hot sauce. Crunch and add tortilla chips and avocado. Brown ground beef and stir in beans and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Simmer 10 minutes and mix into salad and serve.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Pull crescent rolls apart. Place one candy bite in the center of the roll. Wrap the roll around the candy. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven cool. Top with vanilla cake icing.

title: Peppery Beef And Vegetables(Low Cholesterol And Low-Fat)
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. For sauce in a small bowl stir together water soy sauce cornstarch pepper and red pepper. Set aside. Add 1 tablespoon oil to skillet or wok. Heat over medium-high heat. Add garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add pea pods and red pepper; stir-fry 1 minute. Add mushrooms. Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes. Remove vegetables from wok. Add 1 tablespoon oil to wok. Stir-fry beef in hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes or until done. Push beef to the side of pan. Stir sauce and pour into the center of the wok. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Return vegetables to wok; cook and stir all ingredients 1 minute. Toss with spaghetti. Makes 4 servings.

title: Celery Seed Salad Dressing
instructions: Beat sugar salt and mustard with small amount of vinegar. Add oil very slowly. Continue beating while adding oil. Last add remaining vinegar and beat very well. Add celery seed.

title: Chicken-N-Dumplings
instructions: Heat water and broth to boiling. Meanwhile open and separate biscuits in large bowl with flour in it. Coat all biscuits with flour. Put onions in pot with water and add butter and salt and pepper. Once water reaches boiling pinch off biscuits into 4 to 5 pieces each adding them to the water. When pot is full add chicken. Cook at a simmer until done. If needed a mixture of water and flour may be used as a thickener.

title: Poppy Seed Bread (Cake)
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and beat 10 minutes with mixer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes for Bundt or tube pan (greased and floured). For 2 bread pans try 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: If using for salad chop ham chicken pecans pickles boiled eggs and celery in larger pieces; if for sandwiches chop a little finer. Add cayenne to taste and enough mayonnaise to hold together.

title: Sharp Cheese Spread
instructions: Cut cheese into small pieces; also chop pepper. Grind together in food processor or blender. Blend in small amount of milk until creamy and smooth.

title: Linguine And Shrimp
instructions: Cook linguine and drain. Boil shrimp. Heat dressing in skillet. Add remaining ingredients. Stir-fry 8 to 10 minutes. Add shrimp. Toss with linguine. Serve.

title: Nutty Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut or dice bananas apples and oranges. Mix all together in a large bowl. Add fruit cocktail and pecans. Mix all together then add Cool Whip. Let set for 15 minutes in refrigerator. Ready to serve.

title: Homemade Bubbles(For Children)
instructions: Gently stir all ingredients together in a big plastic container.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Whip condensed milk limeade and food coloring until stiff. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared crust and chill until set. Garnish with lime slices if desired.

title: Easter Sweet Bread
instructions: In large bowl put milk. Slowly beat in sugar salt and butter. Then add eggs and 1 cup flour. Mix in slowly. Then add yeast mixture and mix well. Add vanilla and lemon and mix. Add rest of flour little at a time. Keep mixing until dough is soft. Grease large bowl. Place dough in flour 1 hour. Punch down. Let it rise for 30 minutes. Then roll and braid; form into a circle. Place on a cookie sheet for 30 minutes. Brush 1 egg and 1 teaspoon milk. Sprinkle colored candies all over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Corn Casserole
instructions: In a bowl combine beaten egg broccoli corn onion salt and pepper. In a small saucepan melt margarine; add stuffing mix. Toss to coat. Stir 3/4 cup of buttered stuffing in vegetable mixture. Put in greased casserole. Sprinkle with rest of stuffing mix. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Broccoli Ham Ring
instructions: Assemble crescent rolls on baking stone or pan overlapping wide ends. This should look like a star open round circle in center with points facing out.

title: Onion, Orange And Spinach Salad
instructions: Remove stems from spinach. Wash and dry thoroughly. Combine spinach onions oranges and celery in a large salad bowl. Toss gently. Combine remaining ingredients in a jar and shake vigorously. Serve dressing with salad.

title: Crawfish Dip
instructions: Saute peppers in butter then add seasonings parsley Rotel tomatoes and crawfish. Add a few chunks of cream cheese at a time constantly stirring. When the cheese is melted its ready! If this is too thick you can cut it with whipping cream or half and half.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into ball. Chill for two to three hours and then roll in pecan chips.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Honey Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Combine flour milk salt and yeast in large mixing bowl. Combine remaining ingredients then add to dry ingredients (pour warm liquid over flour mixture). Blend at low speed 1 minute. By hand stir in 1 cup whole-wheat flour. Add 4 to 4 1/2 cups all-purpose flour. Knead for 5 minutes. Place in a greased bowl; cover and let rise in a warm place 45 to 60 minutes or until light and double. Punch dough down and divide into thirds for 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2 pans or in 1/2 for larger pans. Shape into loaf by rolling dough into rectangle. Roll up jelly roll fashion and place in greased pans. Cover and let rise 30 to 45 minutes in a warm place until light and doubled. Bake at 375\u00b0 (350\u00b0 glass pans) for 40 to 45 minutes until loaf sounds hollow when tapped. Makes 3 loaves. Can freeze. Can do ahead.

title: Chocolate Delight
