instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with whole graham crackers. Mix pudding and mix together until real thick; add Cool Whip and mix well. Spread mixture over graham crackers. Top with another layer of crackers then spread on chocolate frosting and refrigerate. Serve cool.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs and 1 stick butter melted. Press in bottom of 13 x 9-inch sheet cake pan. Beat eggs sugar and 2 sticks butter for 15 to 20 minutes. Pour on top of crumbs. Slice bananas and layer on top of egg mixture. Add layer of pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries if desired.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix together and mold into ball. Roll in chopped nuts. Can be frozen.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugar. Sift together the flour and soda. Combine all ingredients. Bake in well-greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for almost 1 hour.

title: Miniature Pecan Tarts
instructions: Stir together cream cheese 1/2 cup butter and flour until smooth. Shape into 24 balls. Place in ungreased miniature muffin cups. Press dough into bottom and around sides of cups to form into small shells.

title: Udder (Healing) Baum
instructions: Warm jelly in warm pan of water over low heat and stir in other 2 ingredients. Fill into small jars.

title: Fluffy Potato Doughnuts
instructions: Beat until light eggs sugar and vanilla. Add potatoes and shortening; set aside. Sift dry ingredients together then add alternately with milk to potato mixture beating well. Chill dough 3 hours (if desired). Roll to 3/8-inch thickness.

title: Meat And Potato Pie
instructions: Combine meat milk soup mix salt and pepper. Mix gently and put into 1 pie crust. Top with potatoes. Place other pie crust on top of potatoes. Seal and flute edge. Cut design in top crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sloppy Joe Sandwiches(Cooking For A Crowd)
instructions: Brown beef and drain fat. Add the next 7 ingredients. Simmer or cook in an electric roaster for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Serve on buns. Makes 100 servings.

title: Brownies(Old German Recipe)
instructions: Mix all in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Date Loaf
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk. Add dates nuts and 1/2 of the crumbs. Pour out on the rest of the cracker crumbs. Knead and shape into loaf. Wrap in foil and place in refrigerator. Serve thinly sliced with Cool Whip or whipped cream topped with a cherry.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until crisp-tender. Mix broccoli with dry rice soups and cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir and serve. Could add chopped ham or turkey before baking. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions together until done and drain. Cook noodles and drain. Mix all ingredients; top with 1 package of crushed crackers and 1 stick of melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Pot Cheese Balls (Zeppole)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoonfuls into about 2 inches of hot vegetable oil. Drain on paper towel after browning. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Oven Baked Fish
instructions: Place fillets on baking dish and brush with Italian dressing. Bake until fish flakes.

title: Easy Supper Dish
instructions: Brown beef in skillet. Add onion salt and pepper. Add macaroni and stir thoroughly. Add tomato juice. Bring to a rapid boil. Reduce heat and cook 15 to 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and cover. Serve when cheese is melted.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat drain. Stir in sauce and seasoning mix. Simmer 5 minutes. Unroll dough and press into bottom and sides of ungreased 12-inch pizza pan. Prick bottom & sides with fork. Bake 10 - 12 min. until golden brown. Cover top with meat mixture top with cheese. Continue baking until cheese begins to melt. Top with remaining ingredients and serve with sour cream.

title: Chocolate Chunk Blondies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square pan (9 x 9 x 2-inch). In large mixer bowl cream butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg milk and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture. Stir in nuts if desired and chocolate chunks. Spread into prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool completely; cut into bars.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add onion and cook until tender. Stir in kidney beans salad dressing water and chili powder. Simmer 15 minutes. Shred 8 ounces Cheddar cheese. Combine lettuce and sliced green onions. Add meat sauce and 1 1/2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese. Toss lightly and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Mock Eclair
instructions: Mix pudding with milk. Beat 2 minutes. Blend in Cool Whip. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with butter. Line with graham crackers. Pour half of pudding mixture over crackers. Then add another layer of crackers. Pour remaining pudding over crackers. Add another layer of crackers. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Teriyaki(Serves 4)
instructions: Heat heavy frying pan. Grease it with vegetable oil. Add chicken and saute over high heat evenly until it gets golden brown on both sides. Combine seasonings for teriyaki sauce. Drain oil from frying pan. Pour teriyaki sauce over chicken and cook covered tightly over low heat for about 7 minutes. Turn chicken pieces twice while cooking. Increase heat and continue cooking uncovered glazing chicken on both sides with teriyaki sauce. Reserve some of the sauce to top the chicken when served.

title: Sour Cream Sugar Cookies
instructions: In one bowl beat together shortening sugar eggs vanilla and sour cream. In a very large bowl sift together flour baking powder soda salt and nutmeg or cinnamon. Pour the contents of the first bowl into the sifted ingredients. Stir until well mixed but do not beat. Cover and put in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Scoop out 1/4 of the dough at a time onto a well-floured surface. Sprinkle with flour and roll to approximately 1/8-inch thickness. Cut out with floured cookie cutters. Sprinkle with colored sugar if desired. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets for 6 to 8 minutes until slightly golden. Cool on a wire rack. Decorate with icing if desired. Makes 4 or 5 dozen.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with chopped tomatoes green onions and grated Cheddar cheese. Serve with plain Doritos.

title: Hawaiian Pork Luau
instructions: Drain sliced pineapple reserving juice; measure 1/4 cup juice. Add water to remaining juice to make 1 3/4 cups. Set aside. Moisten pork chops with the 1/4 cup juice. Empty Shake n Bake into plastic bag; mix ginger. Shake pork chops until evenly coated. Arrange pork chops in single layer in shallow baking dish; place 1 pineapple slice on each pork chop. Dice remaining pineapple and set aside. Bake pork chops at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cracker Jack
instructions: Cook to hard boil. Pour over popped corn.

title: Sweet Pickles(14 Days)
instructions: Step 1 Add 4 cups canning or pickling salt to 2 gallons of fresh water. Fill 4 gallon churn with whole cucumbers. Pour water and salt over cucumbers and let stand for 7 days.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Add sugar and vanilla to beaten egg whites. Beat again until firm. Stir in pecans and crackers. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Banana Caramel Pie
instructions: Put opened can of Eagle Brand milk in boiler. Add water until it is 1 1/2 inches on can. Continue to boil for 4 to 5 hours. Do not let water in boiler cook all the way down. When milk is caramelized remove from heat and let cool. Slice bananas and place in cooked pie shell. Pour caramel over bananas. Top with Cool Whip. Grate Heath bars and sprinkle on top.

title: Eagle Brand Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use 8-inch square baking pan. Place margarine in pan and melt in oven. Take out and add in this order graham cracker crumbs butterscotch morsels chocolate chips. Pour Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool completely before slicing into bars.

title: Sweet Potato Cake Squares
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add sweet potatoes and vanilla mixing well. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Combine flour cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to sweet potato mixture and mix well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cake tests done.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix together and season to taste.

title: Pork With Apricot Dressing
instructions: Brown chops in butter; remove from pan and add onion to brown. When brown add mixed mustard vinegar and apricot jam. Cook until hot; add chops and serve over cooked rice.

title: Scalloped Eggplant
instructions: Peel eggplant; cube and cook until tender in salt water. Drain thoroughly. Mash and season to taste. Mash tomatoes and mix with eggplant onion eggs and cornbread crumbs. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Add enough milk to cover well. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cheddar Baked Potatoes
instructions: In a small bowl combine soup paprika onion and pepper. In a greased 2-quart baking dish arrange potatoes in overlapping rows. Sprinkle with cheese; spoon soup mixture over cheese. Cover; bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover; bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Potatoes should be fork-tender.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and pour into buttered casserole dish the sweet potatoes milk 1/2 cup butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix brown sugar flour 1/3 cup melted butter and 1 cup nuts and pour on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Heavenly Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. You will need 3 (9-inch) round pans.

title: Sausage Cheddar Quiche
instructions: Cover quiche dish with crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cook sausage and drain. Combine next 7 ingredients mixing well. Spoon into shell and top with cheese. Combine milk and eggs beating until foamy. Pour over cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Dice chicken and spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix sour cream and soup together and pour over chicken. Mix 1 box Stove Top stuffing according to directions on box. Spread over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Bake pastry shell at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes; set aside. Combine eggs and next 6 ingredients in a medium bowl and stir well. Spoon egg mixture evenly into prepared pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Garnish with whipped cream. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease Bundt pan. Cut biscuits in 4 pieces. Roll biscuit pieces in sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Pack pieces into Bundt pan. Melt butter or margarine. Stir in brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour over biscuits. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Wait 5 minutes and turn out of pan. Pull hunks off and eat.

title: Baptist Pie
instructions: Drain oranges and pineapple. Add lemon juice. Mix well; stir in milk then fold in Cool Whip. Pour over crust and sprinkle on the nuts. Garnish with more oranges. Refrigerate at least 8 hours before serving.

title: Hummus
instructions: Drain the chickpeas then proceed to create a fluid and smooth form of chickpea mash in a food processor. Add the garlic lemon juice tahini and salt to your liking. Be sure that the amount of tahini is sparingly added. Too much will create a soupy and gritty oil spill. Serve with pita bread or on vegetables (i.e. tomatoes).

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil remove from heat and add 3 1/2 tablespoons strawberry jello. Cool add 1 quart strawberries.

title: Terry'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix together egg yolks sugar flour and cocoa. Add some warm milk to dry ingredients then mix well. Add mixture to remaining milk. Stir constantly on medium heat until thick. Pour into baked pie shell and chill.

title: Granola
instructions: Mix all ingredients by hand in large bowl. Spread evenly on cookie sheets. Bake at 275\u00b0 until coconut is lightly browned (approximately 1 hour). Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Three-Step Salad
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat cook and stir almonds and sugar until almonds are coated and lightly browned about 4 minutes. Spread the almonds on heavy-duty foil to cool; gently break apart. In a large salad bowl combine romaine oranges celery and onions. Top with almonds. In a jar with a tight-fitting lid combine the oil vinegar sugar salt dry mustard and garlic powder; shake well. Pour over the salad and toss gently.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Saute onion bell pepper and celery; brown ground beef. Add tomato soup ketchup Worcestershire mushroom soup and Tabasco. Simmer all together until well blended. Cook spaghetti noodles according to package directions. In casserole layer noodles and sauce and sprinkle with grated sharp cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbles.

title: Jello Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and boiling water until dissolved. Add ice cubes; let melt. Then add by spooning in the vanilla ice cream. Let set in refrigerator.

title: Cheesy Chili Dip
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients. Spoon into 1-quart casserole. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Stir before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Oreo Freakout
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan crumble Oreo cookies by hand; reserve 4 or 5 for later. Slice ice cream in 1/2-inch slices; layer on cookies. Pour Hersheys syrup over ice cream; sprinkle nuts over syrup. Spread Cool Whip over nuts. Crumble remaining cookies over Cool Whip. Put in freezer at least 1 hour. Serve and enjoy.

title: No Roll Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together into a dough. Put in the refrigerator over night and pinch off in small balls. Space on cookie sheet. Put about a cup of sugar in a bowl and dip the bottom of a glass in the sugar and press the cookie dough and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until as brown as desired. Remove immediately to cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender; cut into pieces. Place half and half and water in top of double boiler. Add cheese salt and pepper. Heat until cheese is melted; add broccoli. Mix cornstarch and water. Add to soup and heat until thickened.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening. Add sugar and one egg at a time. Add flour and extract. Fold in 7-Up. Cook at 325\u00b0 for one hour and fifteen minutes in a Bundt cake pan.

title: Date Filled Wontons
instructions: To prepare the date filling in small saucepan combine dates granulated sugar and water. Bring to a boil. Cook stirring constantly over low heat about 4 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in walnuts lemon or orange juice and vanilla. Cool date filling.

title: Chicken Breasts Lorraine
instructions: Crumble beef into bottom of unbuttered casserole. Lay chicken breasts on\ttop. Cover with soup sour cream onion and pepper. Mix a little with a fork.\tDo not cover. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours (turn\tto 250\u00b0 after 20 minutes). If starts to brown too much on top reduce temperature 25\u00b0.

title: Polenta
instructions: Place smoked sausage in a large saucepan. Cover with water and boil. Place cornmeal Parmesan cheese and garlic salt in a mixing bowl. Stir in cold water to make a thin paste. Take sausages out of pan leave water in pan and return to a boil. Stir in cornmeal mixture and cook until thickened.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream oleo Crisco and 2 cups sugar well. Reserve 1/2 cup sugar for egg whites. Add 1 egg yolk at a time beating well after each. Sift and measure flour; add salt and baking powder. Add soda to buttermilk and dissolve. Begin adding flour mixture and add alternately with buttermilk ending with flour. Add flavoring. Beat egg\twhites\tand 1/2 cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Fold into cake mixture. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Italian Pepper Sandwich
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and tomato in salad dressing until soft. Cut rolls and butter. Place meat on roll bottoms; cover with cooked vegetable mixture and top with cheese slices. Broil 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts and buttered side of roll top is lightly browned. Close sandwich and serve.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Frost with chocolate frosting or dust with powdered sugar.

title: Apple Pie(Crust And Filling)
instructions: Measure flour and salt into bowl. Cut in shortening thoroughly. Sprinkle with water 1 tablespoon at a time mixing until all flour is moistened and dough almost cleans side of bowl (1 or 2 more tablespoons of water can be added if needed.) Gather dough into ball; shape into flattened round on lightly floured cloth-covered board. With flour covered rolling pin roll dough 2-inches larger than inverted pie pan. Fold pastry into quarters; unfold and ease into pan. Trim overhang edge of pastry 1-inch from rim of the pan. Fold and roll pastry edges under even with pan; flute. Fill and bake as directed in recipe.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and chili powder together. Drain grease. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish with chips. Spread meat over chips. Add another layer of chips. Spread beans and chop onion over chips. Add another layer of chips. Spread soup over these. Slice cheese on top and pour Ro-Tel over it. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven covered with foil for 45 minutes.

title: Microwave Cheesy Chili Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a microwavable 1-quart casserole. Microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes stirring every 4 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix together the ingredients and put in baking dish. Put the remaining half of the stuffing on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sweet Pickles(14 Days)
instructions: Into a clean stone jar put 2 gallons of cucumbers washed and sliced lengthwise. Regardless of size cucumbers must be sliced or they will shrivel. Dissolve 2 cups of salt in one gallon of boiling water and pour while hot over pickles. Then cover and weight down pickles and let stand for 1 week. Remove scum daily.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut cup of chicken into small pieces and put in bottom of casserole dish (2 1/2-inches high). Mix chicken broth soup and chopped onion. Pour over chicken. Mix the rest together and pour over top crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats; cover. Let stand for 20 minutes. Beat butter until creamy; gradually add sugar and beat until fluffy. Blend in vanilla and eggs. Add oats mixture; mix well. Sift together flour soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture. Pour batter into well-greased and floured 9-inch pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. (Frosting mix and cake together.)

title: Kids Stuff
instructions: Melt in microwave. Pour over box of Crispix or Rice Chex until well coated. Dump 2 cups powdered sugar into brown paper sack. Add cereal mixture and shake.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Brown meat on top of the stove in a large frying pan. Place browned meat and remaining ingredients in a pressure cooker. Cover; lock and weight pressure cooker. Cook on high until pressure is up then reduce heat and cook for 45 minutes. Let stand until pressure is reduced.

title: Butterscotch Haystacks
instructions: Melt chips in double boiler. When melted add potatoes and peanuts. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Let cool.

title: Navy Bean Soup
instructions: Sort and wash beans. Cover with water; bring to a boil for 2 minutes and cover. Cool for 1 hour. Drain. Add water tomatoes onion garlic and celery; simmer 2 to 3 hours. Add remaining ingredients and heat to boiling. Serves 10.

title: Pecan Kisses
instructions: Beat egg white until it stands in soft peaks. Gradually mix in brown sugar and vanilla. Fold in pecan halves until well coated in egg-sugar mixture. Place pecan halves on well-greased cookie sheet about 1 inch apart. Bake in a 250\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Turn oven off and let set for 30 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Best Punch Ever
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into empty clean gallon milk jugs not all the way to top (3/4 full). Freeze. Best if done 1 week before needed or longer. Remove from freezer; let punch sit out for few hours before serving. Serve slushy.\tDo not add anything else to punch.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until done; drain and rinse with cold water. Mix in large bowl onion celery green pepper and eggs. Add macaroni shrimp and crabmeat or lobster meat. Stir in Miracle Whip; add mustard. Mix well all ingredients. Add salt pepper and seasoning salt to taste. Makes a great dish for cookouts. Serves 10.

title: Pink Potato Salad
instructions: Place in bowl cubed potatoes chopped onion diced celery and sliced radishes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix lightly with French Dressing. Chill in refrigerator. Remove bowl. Toss carefully with salad dressing and sweet pickle relish and mustard. Blend in hard cooked eggs and minced parsley. Serve in bowl. Garnish with paprika. Serves 6.

title: Tasty Chicken
instructions: Skin chicken and cut into bite sized pieces. Saute onions and sliced peppers until soft. Flour chicken. Add salt and pepper. Add to vegetables and stir for 5 minutes. Add ketchup water and sugar. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over cooked white rice.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole Elegante
instructions: Boil broccoli and onion in small amount of water over low heat only until crisp. Drain. Add Cheez Whiz and soup to broccoli and onion in warm pan. Add margarine. Stir until blended. Add cooked rice and chestnuts. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Top with sharp shredded cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Meringue Kisses
instructions: Line 2 cookie sheets with foil. In small bowl beat egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form beating at high speed. Gradually sprinkle in sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating well after each addition until sugar completely dissolves and whites stand in stiff glossy peaks. Preheat oven to 200\u00b0. Spoon meringue into large decorating tube. Pipe onto cookie sheet into mounds about 1 1/2 hours. Turn oven off; let cookies stand in oven 30 minutes. Cool completely on rack.

title: Homemade Pizza
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch dish. Press biscuits down as crust. Spread 1 jar Ragu pizza sauce over biscuits; top with browned ground meat and onion. Add pepperoni and black olives. Salt pepper and garlic powder to taste. Cover meat with cheeses. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 (uncovered) for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Cheesy Squash Bake
instructions: In large skillet saute squash and onions in butter for 15 minutes or until tender; remove from heat. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper if desired. Combine egg and sour cream; stir in half the bacon. Add to squash mixture and blend. Spoon half of the squash mixture into a buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle Swiss cheese over top; spoon squash mixture over cheese. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese and remaining bacon on top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 6 servings.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine sausage beef salt and pepper. Make into 1-inch balls. Brown in shortening; drain and let cool. Beat eggs and milk together. Coat sausage balls with mashed potatoes. Dip in egg mixture and roll in bread crumbs. Let set 30 minutes. Deep-fry until golden brown.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Grease large casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/2 of poultry seasoning in bottom of casserole. Combine all other ingredients and pour over stuffing. Top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Seasoned Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix all together and pour over 1 bag Keebler Zesta oyster crackers in plastic covered bowl. Stir or shake several times.

title: Pickle Relish
instructions: Combine cucumbers onions and cloves. Cover with 1/3 cup salt and ice cubes. Let stand for 3 hours. Mix vinegar sugar and turmeric. Let this come to a boil. Put in vegetable mixture; simmer 15 minutes. Put into jars and seal.

title: Hawaiian Delight
instructions: Break cake into small pieces. Arrange a layer of cake in bottom of deep bowl. Mix pineapple cherries and nuts together in a bowl. Toast coconut in a skillet on stovetop by stirring over low heat until brown; set aside to cool. On the layer of cake spread the fruit mixture then layer of coconut. Then a layer of thawed topping. Then repeat until everything is used up and finish topping by adding coconut as final item. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in pan. Saute onions. Add soup and juice from can of mushrooms. Blend together. Pour over cooked rice in casserole. Add layer of cheese drained mushrooms and almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated through. Serves 10.

title: Deep Fried Dutch Apple Cake
instructions: In a large skillet heat oil or shortening to a depth of 1/2-inch. Beat egg with 1/4-cup milk. Use rotary beater or whisk. Do not overbeat. Add flour alternately with the milk and mix thoroughly using a slotted spoon; ending with milk. Stir in apples. Pour into hot oil. Fry on both sides until golden brown; sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add beef soup and beans in casserole dish. Mix and add salt and pepper. Top with mashed potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Christmas Crunch
instructions: Microwave the white chocolate for 1 minute. Then stir each minute until melted. It takes about 3 minutes. Stir in crushed peppermint candy. Line a cookie sheet with waxed paper and spread the white chocolate mixture on the cookie sheet. Place it in the freezer for 12 minutes. Take out and break in pieces.

title: Caramel Dip And Apples
instructions: Core and slice apples. Place in a large container of cold water and lemon juice to prevent fruit from browning until ready to serve.

title: Key Lime Tart With Lime Ricky Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients in bowl and mix completely. Place one ounce of graham crackers in 8 flan rings or ramekins.

title: Butter Horns
instructions: Blend well. Divide dough into several round balls. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients thoroughly and spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine stuffing and margarine and spread on top of vegetable mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until hot all through.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Melt butter in square pan. Mix flour sugar milk baking powder salt and vanilla flavoring. Pour over melted butter. Pour peaches with juice over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Make sure the batter rises. When batter rises sprinkle a little sugar on pie.

title: Buttermilk Chess Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and melted margarine. Add flour salt and buttermilk. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until firm (about 45 minutes).

title: Granny'S Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Put in pie shell. Put pie crust on top. Make slits so steam can escape. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: First off heat up about 1/2 inch of cooking oil to about 360\u00b0. While its heating mix corn meal baking powder and salt. Then add the onions. Blend in milk and water maybe adding a little corn meal if necessary until the dough is stiff enough to be handled. Shape the dough into oblong thumb-size cakes and drop into the fat. Turn them occasionally until well browned.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash with salt pepper and onion. Drain well. Mix chicken soup and sour cream with squash. Add grated carrot to squash mixture. Melt oleo in a pan and mix dressing mix in oleo. Pat half in bottom of dish. Pour squash mixture on top of dressing crust. Sprinkle remainder of dressing mix on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 in Bundt pan or tube pan until done.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 loaf pans 9 x 5 x 3-inch. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs pumpkin and water. Blend in dry ingredients except for the nuts and fruit. Mix well then add nuts and fruit. Bake in greased and floured pans for 65 to 75 minutes.

title: Pasta Delite(Excellent Dish For Company Or The Family.)
instructions: In a large skillet or saucepan heat the oil with the garlic and shallots over moderate heat. When they sizzle add the tomatoes breaking them up with your hands. Crumble in the Ricotta cheese and stir in the sugar basil and oregano. Simmer until the sauce is thick but still slightly liquid 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Comforting Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: In large saucepan bring water and bouillon to boil. Add noodles and cook until tender. DO NOT DRAIN. Add soup and chicken. Heat through. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Crunchy Salmon Patties
instructions: Add egg to drained salmon. Salt and pepper and add enough flour to hold patties together. Form into patties. Roll in corn meal and fry until really crunchy.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Beat 2 eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Place these ingredients in a baking dish (or ring mold) which has been well-greased with 2 to 3 tablespoons of olive oil. Bake in moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. The ring center or top may be covered with creamed mushrooms creamed chicken or tuna or buttered vegetable.

title: Oatmeal Crispies (Cookies)
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Add dry ingredients oats and nuts. Mix well. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour and mix well. Spread on a 13 x 9-inch cookie sheet. Prick top all over with a fork. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours turn off oven. Remove shortbread cut into squares and sprinkle with sugar. Return to oven and leave until oven cools. Store in airtight container. Will keep for weeks. Freezes well.

title: Kentucky Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together to cake batter consistency. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan or greased muffin tins. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Tuna Ball
instructions: Drain and flake tuna in bowl. Add cream cheese; mix well. Add onion bacon bits and seasonings; mix well. Shape into ball; roll in parsley flakes. Serve with Club crackers. Yield 8 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and sweet pepper. Drain. Add beans brown sugar mustard Worcestershire sauce and ketchup. Cook in crock-pot for 3 hours on high.

title: Thirty Minute Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground chuck in heavy pot. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes. All ingredients should be altered to taste. The amounts given are only estimates as I never measure for my sauce.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix graham crackers\tbutter\tand 2 tablespoons sugar thoroughly. Press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch spring-form pan.

title: Chicken With 40 Cloves Of Garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large Dutch oven melt margarine in oil. Add cut-up chicken turning until golden (5 to 10 minutes). Tilt pan and spoon off all but 2 tablespoons fat. Add garlic and stir. Sprinkle with lemon thyme salt pepper and water. Cover tightly and bake 1 1/2 hours. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar and salt. Add 1/4 cup milk. Bring to boil and boil 1 minute. Turn off heat but leave pan on the stove for 5 minutes. Add margarine and vanilla. Mix pudding with 3 3/4 cups milk. Add Cool Whip.

title: Potted Shrimp Sandwich Spread
instructions: Mince the shrimp and mix with butter. Add the other ingredients. Makes approximately 1 1/4 cups.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed. Spread in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer ham and cheese over broccoli. Beat remaining ingredients with hand mixer until smooth. Slowly pour over cheese. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Church Windows
instructions: Melt chocolate chips butter or margarine and paraffin. Cool slightly. Stir in marshmallows and nuts. Shape into logs on aluminum foil; sprinkle with coconut and roll. Store in fridge. Slice when wanted.

title: Heavenly Delight
instructions: 1st Layer Mix flour margarine milk and pecans and put into bottom of greased pan 10 x 13 x 2-inch. Preheat oven. Cook about 25 to 35 minutes. Let cool.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: In a small bowl place chicken strips with 2 tablespoons soy sauce and 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Blend well. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Heat 2 tablespoons oil with 1/2 teaspoon salt in wok over high heat. Add chicken strips and stir-fry until white and firm. Add onion and mushroom. Cook until vegetables are soft. Remove from wok. Add remaining 2 tablespoons of oil cabbage and sugar. Stir-fry about 3 or 4 minutes until cabbage is crisp-tender. Return chicken-vegetable mixture to wok. Add cashews and toss add 1 teaspoon cornstarch to 1/4 cup soy sauce. Stir into the chicken mixture. Cover and steam 1 minute uncover and stir until sauce is thickened. Serve with Chinese noodles.

title: Gerrell'S Sour Cream Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until light and fluffy; gradually add sugar mixing well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition; stir in vanilla. Fold sour cream into cream cheese mixture and pour into prepared pan. Bake at 500\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Reduce heat to 225\u00b0 and bake 50 minutes. Turn off oven; open oven door slightly and let cheesecake stand in oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven; let cool to room temperature on a wire rack. Chill 8 hours or overnight. Garnish as desired. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Graham Cracker Goodies
instructions: Put a layer of graham crackers in a 17 1/2 x 11 1/2 pan. Cook remaining ingredients slowly until thickened about 15 minutes. Spread over graham crackers then put another layer of crackers.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Mix pineapple pie filling cake mix coconut and pecans. Then pour butter on top and bake 45 minutes at 300 to 350\u00b0.

title: Lasagna Supreme
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain; set aside. Cook ground beef garlic and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until meat is browned stirring until meat crumbles. Drain well. Wipe pan drippings from skillet with paper towel. Combine Paul Newmans socarooni sauce with meat. Let simmer 20 minutes. Combine eggs and next 4 ingredients; set aside.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Prepare Dream Whip according to directions on box. Mix this with cream cheese mixture. In a pan put a layer of graham cracker crumbs then a layer of 1 can of pie filling. Top this with Dream Whip mixture. Repeat.

title: Marinade For Turkey, Chicken, Pork Chops Or Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in blender. Marinate meat several hours or overnight.

title: Mole Poblano
instructions: Remove cooked chicken from broth and set aside keeping chicken warm. Reserve broth. Slice chilies open and remove seeds. Toast chilies in a preheated oven just enough not to burn. Toast bread on griddle of stove just enough to brown. In frying pan fry sesame seed in 1/4 cup oil. Remove seed and set aside. Add 1/4 cup oil to pan and fry onion until tender. Set aside. Toast tomato on griddle then peel off skin. Be sure to follow instructions carefully to have a good tasting mole.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Chill. Garnish with more orange sections if desired. Makes 3 1/2 cups or 6 servings.

title: Swedish Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix together.\tSpoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Boil sugar and corn syrup together about 2 minutes. Pour slowly over beaten eggs stirring constantly. Add butter and vanilla. Put pecans in bottom of uncooked crust. Pour mixture over pecans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Country Living Fudge(Easy Breezy To Make)
instructions: Line 8-inch square pan with wax paper or foil. Combine in pot chips milk salt on low heat until chips melt. Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Seafood Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Add potatoes and juice. Simmer for 20 minutes or until potatoes are cooked. Add clams crabmeat shrimp milk half and half creamed corn salt pepper and thyme to taste; add parsley. Cook until it starts to boil. One-half cup wine is optional.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Put meat and other ingredients in crock-pot in order given and cook on slow heat for 8 hours.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Roll pineapple in sour cream. Then roll in coconut. Put toothpick in each chunk and freeze. Great for parties.

title: Old Fashion Lace Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour baking powder and sugar. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop 1/4 teaspoonful of batter 4-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden. Let cool before removing. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix together butter sugar and eggs. Beat until slightly lumpy only. Stir in crushed pineapple with juice and cubed bread. Bake in a greased 1 1/2 quart casserole uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Fresh Apple Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add egg and cinnamon. Beat thoroughly. Fold in grated apples. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour (preheat oven).

title: Chum Casserole
instructions: Fry meat onion and peppers together until peppers and onions are almost done. Cook noodles in salt water until done; drain. Mix all together in casserole. Top with bread crumbs if desired. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until done. If it is too thick before serving add some hot milk.

title: Welsh Cookies(36)
instructions: Cream sugar oleo and shortening together. Add beaten eggs to the creamed mixture. Sift all dry ingredients together. Combine creamed mixture\tdry ingredients raisins and milk to form a soft dough.\tGently roll a portion of dough to 1/4-inch thickness;\tcut with round cookie cutter. Fry on skillet at 350\u00b0 for 3 minutes on each side. Sprinkle lightly with granulated sugar while cooking.

title: Cream Caramel Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare 3 (9-inch) cake pans. Cream margarine or butter until light. Add sugar gradually until mixture is light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each addition. Sift flour baking soda and salt together. Add about 1/4 of the flour mixture beating until thoroughly mixed. Add 1/3 sour cream and combine thoroughly. Repeat alternating flour and sour cream. Begin and end with flour. Stir in flavoring. Pour into prepared pans. Place in preheated oven and bake for 25 to 35 minutes. Test for doneness. Remove onto cake racks when done. Cool 10 minutes and carefully remove from pans. Frost with Caramel Frosting.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Beat all ingredients together and pour into oiled 9 X 13 pan.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a large spring-form tube pan. Have all ingredients at room temperature. Do not preheat oven. Put all the ingredients into a large bowl; blend all ingredients. Beat with electric mixer for 5 1/2 minutes at medium speed. After placing pan in oven set temperature at 350\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Butter baking dish. Boil chicken until done. Place chicken then broccoli in dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken and broccoli. Garnish with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbling brown.

title: Real Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together. Add cold water. Cook in microwave stirring often. When it is a medium consistency add egg yolks lemon juice and rind. Return to microwave and cook until thick. If too thick use hand blender to smooth out. Add margarine. Pour into pie crust. Beat egg whites and 1/3 cup sugar. Spread meringue to hot pie sealing to sides. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until brown.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs (well beaten). Add syrup and flour. Mix together thoroughly. Add nuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake one hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken and debone. Combine all ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Then mix 1 package Bisquick until it forms paste. Cover top of pie. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Dot with butter and let brown.

title: Puppy Chow Snack
instructions: Melt butter peanut butter and chocolate chips. Stir in Rice Chex. Put 2 cups powdered sugar in bag; add Chex mixture and shake until coated. Spread mixture on cookie sheet to dry.

title: Breakfast Scones
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Put parchment paper on baking sheet. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Using paddles at low speed add butter cubes and mix until nearly blended. Add fruit.

title: Turkey Casserole With Cheese
instructions: Melt fat in skillet. Add onion and brown. Add water or broth rice salt and pepper. Cook for 20 minutes or until rice is done. Add turkey and cheese. Heat until cheese melts. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Put greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 1/2 hours before baking. Let stand at room temperature. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cover mixture with croutons. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cheesecake Tarts
instructions: Mix all ingredients except wafers. Place vanilla wafer in bottom of baking cup liners. Fill 3/4 full with cheese mixture. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in refrigerator. Top with any fruit filling. Makes 18 tarts.

title: Layered Dessert
instructions: Mix well together and pat into 11 x 13 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Wine Rice
instructions: Mix ingredients and cook in double boiler 45 minutes. Add sugar and sprinkle cinnamon on top when served.

title: Oreo Shazam Bars
instructions: Finely roll 20 cookies. Mix cookie crumbs and butter; spread over the bottom of a 9 x 9 x 2 baking pan pressing lightly. Chop remaining cookies. Layer coconut white chips and chopped cookies in prepared pan. Drizzle evenly with condensed milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and set. Cool completely; cut into bars. Makes 24 bars.

title: Ice Cream Kahlua Cake
instructions: If you like chocolate and Heath bars you will love this dessert.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cover hamburger with cold water (4 cups) and simmer until meat loses pink color. Drain. Add celery onion and vegetables. Cook slowly until vegetables are done. Add tomatoes and chicken noodle soup mix. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Noodles
instructions: Mix milk salt and eggs. Add to flour. Place plenty of flour on counter and roll out. Leave out 20 minutes rolled out. Fold with plenty of flour between folds then cut.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Soften\tcream cheese.\tAdd onion Worcestershire sauce and shrimp. Mix together mashing shrimp until smooth. Form into mound. Top\twith cocktail sauce if desired. Serve with crackers.

title: Fusilli With Parsley-Mushroom Sauce
instructions: In a small bowl combine the yogurt cheese parsley sour cream and pepper; cover and refrigerate. In a large kettle cook the fusilli according to package directions omitting the salt. Meanwhile heat the olive oil in a heavy 7-inch skillet over moderately high heat for 1 minute. Add the mushrooms onion and garlic and cook stirring occasionally for 5 to 7 minutes or until the onion is soft. Add the wine to the mushroom mixture and cook for 1 to 2 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed. Add the yogurt-cheese mixture and heat through; do not boil or the sauce will curdle.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake(Well Worth The Time Involved)
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients. Set aside. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Alternately add milk and flour creaming after each addition. Add vanilla and beat with mixer until very creamy. Grease 3 cake pans with Crisco and dust with self-rising flour. Divide cake batter evenly among the prepared pans. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Cool completely before icing. If desired sprinkle 1 teaspoon of coconut milk over each layer before icing.

title: Mary'S Layered Tostada Dip
instructions: In an 8-inch pie plate layer bean dip then combine avocados and 4 tablespoons mayonnaise and 2 tablespoons sour cream. Layer that on top of bean dip. Then combine remaining sour cream and mayonnaise. Add the taco seasoning to top. Sprinkle cheese and vegetables on top.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Beat together in a medium bowl the milk mayonnaise sugar and self-rising flour. If necessary add a little more (no more than 1/2 cup) of the self-rising flour so that dough can be dropped from spoon and hold its shape. Mix in grated cheese. Drop by spoonfuls 1 inch apart on greased baking sheet in about 9 equal mounds. Brush tops a bit with butter and sprinkle with more cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Dust with garlic salt to taste as soon as they come out of the oven. Makes 9 biscuits.

title: Chicken Quiche
instructions: Mix the above ingredients together and pour into a 10-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375 degrees for 40 - 50 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Corn Dodgers
instructions: Place cornmeal in large bowl; make well in center. Add salt and boiling water. Stirring until mixed thoroughly. Shape hot mixture into 3-inch patties with help of a spoon. Fry in butter until golden brown on both sides. Serve with bean soup or with butter and maple syrup with bacon and eggs. Yield 12 patties. Recipe over 100 years.

title: Florida Champagne
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar and water; boil 3 minutes. Chill. In large punch bowl combine chilled juices and sugar water mixture. When ready to serve add ginger ale to juices. Place flavored ice ring or ice cubes in punch bowl.

title: Spinach Madeleine
instructions: Cook spinach. Drain reserving liquor. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour stirring only until smooth. Add onions. Cook until soft. Add liquor slowly stirring to avoid lumps. Add milk. Cook until thick and smooth. Add seasonings and cheese (cut into smallish pieces). Stir until melted. Combine with spinach. Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight. May be topped with breadcrumbs. May be frozen. It is really better the second day!

title: Kool-Aid Frozen Cups
instructions: Fill a 2-quart pitcher half full with water. Empty package of your favorite flavor of Kool-Aid into pitcher. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Finish filling with water. Chill or take 12 (7 ounce) plastic cups and place in freezer. Freeze until frozen.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. While still hot poke holes all over cake with long tined fork.

title: Winter Squash And Apple Compote
instructions: Bring the juice or cider to a boil in a medium-size saucepan. Add the winter squash and continue cooking for 10 to 15 minutes. Add the apples. When the pot continues to boil again sprinkle the sugar and (if desired) the cinnamon red hearts on the apples. Continue to cook until apples and squash are tender. It is possible you might need some additional apple juice (add as needed). You should be able to see the juice near the top of the apples when done. When taking out of the saucepan into a bowl mix the apples and squash. This is a good side dish with meat or chicken.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Marinate chicken in salad dressing 30 minutes to overnight. With chicken breast flat top with 1 slice ham and 1 slice cheese. Roll and use toothpick to secure. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with cheese and bake until cheese is slightly melted.

title: Italian Zucchini Crescent Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In 10-inch skillet cook zucchini and onion in margarine until tender. Stir in parsley and seasonings. In large bowl blend eggs and cheese. Stir in vegetable mixture. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Place in ungreased 10-inch pie pan or 11-inch quiche pan. Press over bottom and up sides to form crust. Spread crust with mustard. Pour vegetable mixture evenly into crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar and salt blending well. Pour in milk and vanilla. Stir well. Sprinkle unbaked pie shell with nutmeg and pour mixture in. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tuna Patties
instructions: Pour tuna in mixing bowl. Add the eggs and mix well. Crush the crackers real good and add to mixture. Add flour and mix well. Make into patties. Fry them in oil until golden brown.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Put in mixer bowl all at one time and beat until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Hot Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 475\u00b0. Add shortening to flour and blend. Add milk and mix until dough will form into a ball. Turn dough out on a floured board; knead lightly until you can work the dough out to a smooth surface.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Mix well until sugar is dissolved. Add pineapple juice and stir. Pour into 2 clean 1/2 gallon cardboard milk containers. Close with paper clips and freeze solid. One hour before serving remove frozen slush from freezer and place in punch bowl. Let sit until serving time. With fork chop and scrape until well broken up. Add ginger ale. Mix and serve.

title: Stuffed Pasta
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook and drain pasta shells as directed on package. Spread spaghetti sauce in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients except pesto. Fill each pasta shell with about 2 tablespoons of cheese mixture. Arrange filled shells on spaghetti sauce. Cover and bake approximately 45 minutes or until hot. Serve with pesto.

title: Old Time Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Stir in water. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly until thick (3 to 5 minutes). Remove from heat; stir a small amount of hot mixture into egg yolks; then pour into remaining hot mixture in pan. Bring to a boil and cook one minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add lemon peel and butter. Slowly stir in lemon juice. Cool to lukewarm; pour into pastry shell.

title: Kraut Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into balls. Make a thick paste with flour and milk. Coat each ball and then deep fry until brown. Can freeze and then heat in oven at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Coconut Oatmeal Macaroons
instructions: Sift flour once; measure. Add baking powder salt and soda. Sift again. Cream the butter; add sugars gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour oatmeal and coconut. Mix thoroughly. Shape dough into small balls and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Pink Peppermint Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust. Heat marshmallows and milk in a saucepan over low heat stirring constantly just until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla salt peppermint extract and food coloring. Refrigerate stirring occasionally until the mixture mounds when dropped from a spoon. Beat whipping cream in a chilled bowl until stiff. Stir marshmallow mixture until blended; fold into whipped cream. Pour into crust. Refrigerate at least 12 hours.

title: Vegetable Juice Cocktail
instructions: Place measured tomatoes and all ingredients except lemon juice in a 12 quart or larger pot and simmer for about 30 minutes or until all the vegetables are soft. Remove bay leaves. Press vegetables through a fine sieve or put through a food mill to remove seeds skins and pulp. Return juice to pot stir in lemon juice to taste and bring to boil. Quickly pour into clean hot quart jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace; seal. Process in boiling water about 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 7 quarts.

title: Indian Pilaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in skillet. Add onion and rice; cook and stir until rice is yellow and onion is tender. Stir in next 5 seasonings. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Heat chicken broth to boiling; stir into rice mixture. Cover tightly. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.

title: Marinade
instructions: Marinate meat and vegetables several hours or overnight. (Do marinate meat carrots celery and onions. Do not marinate peppers and mushrooms.)

title: Copper Carrot Pennies
instructions: Slice carrots and boil in salt water until fork-tender. Drain. When cool alternate layers of carrots pepper rings and onion slices (slice thin). Make a marinade of remaining ingredients. Blender is ideal. Pour mixture over vegetables and refrigerate either in jar or covered dish. Store in refrigerator.

title: Ham And Swiss Quiche
instructions: Blend mayonnaise milk eggs and cornstarch until smooth. Add ham cheese and onion. Stir to mix. Spoon into pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Stir well. Add next four ingredients. Spoon mixture into lightly greased casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes until bubbly.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: Heat in large kettle stirring constantly until sugar dissolves. Makes one gallon or 16 servings.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Line bottom and sides of spring-form pan with ladyfingers. Set aside. Whip cream until stiff. Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Fold whipped cream into cream cheese mixture. Spoon layer of whipped cream mixture and then layer of pineapple pie filling on ladyfingers. Repeat with 2 layers of ladyfingers cream mixture and pie filling. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Microwave Swiss Steak
instructions: Put steak in microwave casserole dish. Add tomato sauce and green chilies. Mix. Add water. Mix. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook for 20 minutes in large oven (15 in small oven) on High.

title: Mexican Chicken Soup
instructions: Saute chicken cubes; add broth and bring to a boil. Add salsa rice beans lime juice and cilantro. Return to a slow boil then turn down heat and cook on low for 10 minutes. Serve in a bowl with shredded cheese on top. This soup is best when made a day before serving.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl beat eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Grate zucchini and add to mixture. In second bowl sift together flour salt baking soda and cinnamon. Add raisins and nuts to flour mixture. Stir flour mixture into zucchini mixture. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut the tops and bottoms off of the tomatoes and slice in half crosswise. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and dip lightly in flour. Fry in hot butter until brown on both sides. Serves 6.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Cook bacon and then chop it. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Boil ingredients; add pickling spices or simmer until sugar melts. Pack cucumbers in jars. Pour liquid over cucumbers and seal jar. Process in hot water bath for 5 minutes. Makes 2 quarts or 4 pints.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Combine other ingredients (except crumbs) to the broccoli. Pour in casserole dish. Sprinkle top with crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. May be refrigerated or frozen before cooking.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix 1 can celery soup and 1 1/2 cups chicken broth. Bring to a boil and set aside.

title: * Mock Chicken Turnovers *
instructions: Melt fat; add flour. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot milk. Add and cook until thick. Add flaked tuna and egg. Make pie pastry and roll out into 4-inch squares. Place a spoonful and seal. Cut a gash in top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 12 or 14 squares. Serves 4 to 5.

title: My Mom'S Baked Beans
instructions: Prepare dried beans according to package directions or 8 cups boiling salted water (1 teaspoon salt). Add beans and take off heat to let soak 1 hour or longer.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Place in refrigerator for a short time. Take part of the dough and roll out. Cut in desired shapes. Place on cookie sheet that has been sprayed with Pam then take out more dough and roll out and cut adding leftover dough to part fresh each time. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 10 minutes. The best sugar cookies!

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and butter. Cream until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Stir in almond and vanilla extracts flour and milk.

title: Sweet Red Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix as package directs. Pour 2 cups batter into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Veal In Lemon Butter Sauce
instructions: Dredge veal cutlets in flour; salt and pepper. Heat butter in hot skillet. Add meat and brown. Reduce heat and cover pan. Cook for 20 minutes. Turn veal 2 or 3 times. Transfer meat to warm platter and keep warm. To juice add wine lemon juice and remaining butter. When butter has melted pour over meat and serve. Serve immediately.

title: Ricotta Puffs
instructions: Mix together eggs; add Ricotta sugar baking powder and flour. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. In saucepan pour oil. When it is hot drop dough by the tablespoonfuls into oil. Puffs will turn themselves when browned. Remove from oil and place on paper towel to drain. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Eat them hot.

title: Red Christmas Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Mix food color and cocoa together. Add to mixture. Blend well. Mix buttermilk and vanilla. Add flour and salt alternating with buttermilk and vanilla to mix. Combine white vinegar and soda. Add to the mixture while still foaming. Bake in two cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and place in a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Bean Casserole(Excellent!)
instructions: Brown ground beef; put on side. Fry bacon and onion. Combine all ingredients and simmer one hour or put in crock-pot for a few hours. The longer you cook the better. Can be main meal or side dish. Great for parties.

title: Escalloped Potatoes
instructions: Thaw potatoes. Combine them with the rest of the ingredients except corn flakes. Place in a 3-quart casserole or large flat baking dish. Sprinkle buttered corn flakes on top of potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Place pork chops in bottom of baking dish; salt and pepper. Place onions and potatoes over chops. Add soups; cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add oil and zucchini then add dry ingredients. Stir in pineapple nuts raisins and coconut. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 one hour or until done.

title: Beef Dip
instructions: Melt cheese in chafing dish. Tear beef in small bits and add to cheese. Keep warm.

title: Golden Harvest Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 18 muffin cups with paper baking cups or grease bottoms and sides. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup. Level off. In a large bowl combine all-purpose flour whole wheat flour sugar baking soda cinnamon salt and cloves. Add apples carrots coconut raisin and walnuts. Mix well. Add oil milk vanilla and eggs. Stir just until moistened. Fill lined muffin cups 3/4 full.

title: Maple Pecan Pralines
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a Dutch oven. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Stir in pecans. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture reaches soft stage (236\u00b0). Remove from heat and stir in the flavoring. Beat with a wooden spoon 5 to 8 minutes until it begins to thicken. Working quickly drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Mix and pat into cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes; cool.

title: Broccoli Puff
instructions: Place broccoli in a casserole dish. Combine the soup mayonnaise egg and 3/4 cup cheese; pour over broccoli. Top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Serves 6 to 8 people. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Creamy Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Put broccoli in casserole dish. Beat soup and milk together until smooth. Pour over broccoli in dish. Sprinkle cheese over broccoli. Mix Bisquick with butter until crumbly. Sprinkle mixture over cheese. Bake 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Country-Style Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Cook ribs covered in enough boiling salted water to cover for 45 - 60 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cook onion and garlic in hot oil till tender. Stir in tomato sauce and the next 8 ingredients. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Stir once or twice. Grill ribs over slow coals about 45 minutes or until done. Turn every 15 minutes. Brush with sauce till coated. Serves 6.

title: Liz Wood'S Chili Cheese Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine beaten eggs cheese and chilies. In a medium frying pan saute onion and beef together until beef is no longer pink and onion is limp. Drain off any fat and add meat and onion to the egg mixture. Pour into a greased 8-inch square pan and bake 45 minutes or until set. Cool and cut into squares for serving. (Can also be served as a main dish for 4.)

title: Festive Ham Glaze
instructions: Bake ham at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Melt butter. Stir in preserves mustard and brown sugar. Brush ham generously with apricot glaze. Bake 30 minutes longer basting occasionally with glaze. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Mexican Shepherd'S Pie(For A Crowd!)
instructions: Saute meat onions and peppers. When cooked add taco seasoning. Mix well. Add salsa water and Tabasco. Mix well. Layer meat mixture into four shallow hotel pans (or eight 9 x 13-inch pans). Add layer of corn then layer of potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake approximately 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 80.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine cream cheese eggs and powdered sugar in mixing bowl and beat at high speed for at least 15 minutes. Pour crushed graham crackers into a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Place cream cheese sugar and egg mixture on top of crumbs. Slice bananas and dip in pineapple juice. Place on top of mixture. Top with pineapple and spread prepared Dream Whip on top. Sprinkle nuts and crushed crackers on top. Refrigerate.

title: Grilled Barbecue Catfish
instructions: Clean fish and place on sheet of aluminum foil. Sprinkle on salt Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Slice onion and place on fish. Wrap aluminum foil around fish loosely. Cook approximately 45 minutes on low heat.

title: Rolls
instructions: Put oil sugar and salt in a large bowl and pour boiling water over it. Dissolve yeast in cup of warm water. Add 2 cups of flour to bowl when lukewarm to make a batter. Stir well. Add eggs and yeast. Stir again. Add rest of flour and stir until it leaves sides of bowl. Cover with cloth. Set in warm place to rise double. Punch down. Let rise again then make into rolls. Put in pan and let rise double. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cabbage And Apple Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbages apples carrots peppers and red onion in large bowl. Blend mayonnaise 1/4 of the walnuts sour cream dill mustard honey and vinegar in processor until smooth. Toss with cabbage mixture. Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving sprinkle with remaining walnuts and garnish with green onions.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package instructions; drain. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Cover for 45 minutes and uncover for 10 to 15 minutes.)

title: Spice Dip
instructions: Mix sugar with spices. Fold in whipped topping. Do not overmix. Serve with assorted fruits cookies or cake cubes. Makes 1 2/3 cups with approximately 6 calories per teaspoon.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Tear biscuits into quarters and roll into balls. Put in bowl; melt margarine and add sugar cinnamon raisins and nuts. Stir well. Pour over balls and mix well. Place in a Bundt pan that has been greased. Bake approximately 30 minutes.

title: Sweetened Southern Tea
instructions: Heat 2 quarts water to boiling. Remove from heat and stir in the sugar until dissolved. Add tea bags. Cover and allow to steep for about 5 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add remaining water. Serve over ice. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Egg-Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together with enough mayonnaise to hold together. Line a bowl with plastic wrap before pouring mixture in. Mold in refrigerator. Turn out on a plate. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve with crackers.

title: New Horizons Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken thoroughly with flour. Brown slowly in hot oil with garlic. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid. Add mushroom liquid soy sauce catsup wine and onion to chicken stirring to combine. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Stir in mushrooms and olives; bring to boil. Serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise vinegar and sugar and pour over salad; mix. Let stand 1 hour or more.

title: Apple And Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: In a medium bowl stir together flour oat bran brown sugar baking powder baking soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Set aside. In a small bowl combine buttermilk egg whites and oil. Add to dry ingredients. Stir just until moistened. Stir in shredded apples. Store batter tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

title: Church Potato Salad
instructions: This is the recipe we use for chicken suppers.

title: Eggplant Fritters
instructions: Peel and slice one eggplant. Steam until tender and drain. Mash and beat until smooth. Add egg flour salt and baking powder. Form into patties and fry in deep hot fat.

title: Grape Butter
instructions: Boil for 20 minutes then put through food press to remove seeds and skins. Put in jars and seal.

title: Seafood Chowder
instructions: Saute onion in butter for 3 minutes; add stock celery carrots salt pepper bay leaf and thyme. Simmer gently 10 to 15 minutes. Add fish; simmer 5 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Make smooth thin paste of 1 cup milk and flour. Add to hot mixture and cook\tstirring until thick.\tStir in remaining milk cream crab meat and clams. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put boned chicken in bottom of long casserole dish. Mix soup and sour cream together and spread over chicken. Cover with crushed Ritz crackers. Pour melted butter evenly over top of crackers. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat egg whites until frothy; add salt and cream of tartar and continue beating until egg whites are stiff. Add sugar a tablespoon at a time beating constantly until glossy. Mix in vanilla and fold in chips. Drop on greased cookie sheets with teaspoon. Place in oven. Turn off oven and let cookies stand overnight. Do not open oven for at least 5 hours. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix oil parsley flakes powder dill weed and dressing mix together. Pour mixture over crackers. Mix well and store in an airtight container. Better than popcorn!

title: Chicken Crisp
instructions: Mix dry Italian dressing with flour in large mixing bowl. Place melted butter in a smaller bowl. Coat chicken and pieces in butter first then flour mixture. Place in large baking pan and bake uncovered 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Spiced Cocoa
instructions: Combine water cinnamon cloves and allspice. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in cocoa sugar and milk. Heat do not boil. Add vanilla. Makes 4 cups.

title: Grandmama'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time alternately with flour. Add lemon and vanilla and mix well.

title: Hawaiian Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple sugar and salt; cook 10 minutes. Let cool. Mix gelatine and hot water together. Let cool until syrupy then combine with pineapple mixture. Mix whipped topping as directed on package. Cream the cheese and mix whipped topping. Mix everything together and chill.

title: Butter Cookies(Roll Type)
instructions: Cream butter; add powdered sugar until fluffy. Add beaten egg and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Blend into creamed mixture.

title: Special Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets the night before until done. Let cool. Chop or shred and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day melt other ingredients. Pour over potatoes. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: No-Cook Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix 1/2 Cool Whip with pudding sour cream milk and vanilla flavoring. Put layer of vanilla wafers layer of sliced bananas and layer of pudding mixture in 9 x 13-inch dish. Top with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle crushed vanilla wafers on top. Refrigerate.

title: Blueberry Melba(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: In small saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch. Stir in Port and lemon juice. Cook and stir over low heat until thickened and translucent. Stir in blueberries; simmer about 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature. To serve arrange peach halves cut side up in 6 sherbet glasses. Top each with 1 scoop ice cream. Spoon cooled blueberry sauce evenly over each. Colors are very pretty and cool looking for a summer dessert.

title: Buttermilk Griddle Cakes
instructions: In a large bowl stir together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Make a well in the center of the dry mixture; set aside. Separate eggs reserving the whites. In another bowl lightly beat egg yolks buttermilk and melted butter to blend. Add to dry ingredients. (Batter will be slightly lumpy.)

title: 1 Egg Yellow Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Kentucky Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in the order given. Pour in large greased casserole (9 x 9-inch) about 3 inches deep. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Smoothie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a blender until frothy. Yields 5 (1/2 cup each) servings; 280 total (56 per 1/2 cup) calories. Exchange 1 1/2 fruit.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Mixture will be very thick. Do not use mixer. Bake in oblong pan for 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spicy Pot Roast
instructions: Put all in crock-pot for 10 hours. Makes 6 to 7 servings.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water in a large bowl. Stir until dissolved. Blend in sugar shortening salt and egg; add 1/2 flour. Beat thoroughly with a wooden spoon. Add remaining half flour and beat about 2 minutes until smooth.

title: Old-Fashioned Baked Ham
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 2 tablespoons of juice; set aside. Place ham in a baking pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine brown sugar cloves mustard and vinegar in a small bowl; stir in reserved pineapple juice. Score ham; place pineapple slices and cherries on top of ham. Spoon glaze over fruit and ham. Bake for another 40 to 45 minutes basting occasionally. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Squares
instructions: Microwave 3/4 cup margarine with 2 squares chocolate 1 to 2 minutes or until melted when stirred. Stir in crumbs coconut and peanuts. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan; chill 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Cherry Bars
instructions: Spread dough in greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Cool slightly then cut into 40 bars.

title: Strawberry Jello Mold
instructions: Make Jell-O with only 1 cup boiling water. Add strawberries bananas walnuts and pineapple. Pour 3/4 of mixture into mold. Let jell until firm. Spread sour cream over Jell-O mixture. Pour remaining mixture over sour cream and jell until solid. Delicious!!

title: Mary'S Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar salt and spices. Gradually stir in milk and then pumpkin. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Cheese Pie
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in oleo until tender. Stir in flour and broth. Cook and stir until thickened. Add chicken carrots and egg. Turn into pie shell and top with slices of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese turns light brown.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Make the day before serving. Keeps 3 days.

title: Apple Bars
instructions: Combine in order given. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Glaze or frost if desired.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake for 45 minutes at 250\u00b0 stirring every 15 minutes. Spread out on paper towels to cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Cream Cheese Squares
instructions: Layer 1 package cookies in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine and blend cream cheese sugar and eggs. Top cookie layer with filling. Layer 2nd package of cookies on top of filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pizza Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles to desired doneness as directed on package; drain. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large skillet cook ground beef onions and green pepper for 7 to 9 minutes or until meat is browned and vegetables are crisp-tender; drain. Add noodles Italian seasoning pepperoni olives tomato sauce and tomato paste; mix well. Fold in 1 cup of the cheese. Pour mixture into ungreased 2 quart baking dish. Top with remaining 1 cup cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated and cheese begins to brown. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Tuna
instructions: Cut tuna into 6 steaks each about 1 inch thick. Remove any skin or bone.

title: Spinach-Broccoli Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Break broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Mix with spinach and onions. To make light white sauce melt low-fat oleo in pan; add flour and mix. Add low-fat or skim milk (powdered works well) and blend cooking until thickened and smooth. Add little dill and mustard to taste. Pour over veggies in casserole. Sprinkle with grated cheese or bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Packaged Cake(Microwave)
instructions: Grease and flour 2 (8-inch) round glass cake dishes. Prepare cake mix as to package directions. Heat one layer at a time uncovered on roast for 8 to 9 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes.

title: Pistachio Nut Salad-Dessert
instructions: Mix together pudding mix and milk and heat 2 minutes. Add pineapple marshmallows and nuts. Save some Cool Whip to frost top. Fold in remaining Cool Whip. Pour into an 8 x 11-inch loaf pan. Refrigerate overnight. Frost with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with finely chopped nuts. At holiday time can also top with red maraschino cherries.

title: It'S Better Than Potato Salad
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Transfer to bowl. Cover; chill. Add mayonnaise or salad dressing celery onion mustard and salt to chilled rice. Mix well; cover and chill. Stir in remaining ingredients before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple with juice to a boil. Add gelatin and mix well. Cool. Add buttermilk nondairy whipped topping and nuts. Mix well. Refrigerate. Let congeal.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream together sugar and cream cheese. Add peanut butter and mix well. Mix all of mixture with Cool Whip. Divide into two pie shells. Refrigerate for 6 or more hours.

title: Graham Gems
instructions: Mix ingredients well and put in greased or paper-lined muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until done.

title: White Chocolate Bark
instructions: Stir glace cherries and pecans into melted chocolate. Spread mixture into a thin layer on a greased cookie sheet. Let stand until firm. Cut into squares. Store covered at room temperature. Yields about 2 pounds of candy. This is great for Christmas.

title: Pumpkin Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients together in large bowl with mixer. Mix until smooth. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spoon into graham cracker crumb crust. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

title: Marinated Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut top off cantaloupe. Remove seeds etc. Fill with fruit and rum. Replace top and refrigerate overnight. Especially good to take on picnics.

title: Breakfast Pie
instructions: Pour into buttered baking dish and bake for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O water and sugar in pan. Bring to boil and put in bowl to cool. Combine cream cheese and Eagle Brand milk; mix until smooth. Add pineapple and baby food to Jell-O mixture. Mix this with cream cheese and milk; add nuts. Pour into mold or sheet cake pan. Chill until firm.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
