instructions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan the first 6 ingredients. Mix mayonnaise and sugar. Spread on top as frosting. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours before serving.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Pour batter into a well-greased 10 1/2-inch cast-iron skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Yields about 8 servings.

title: Barbecue For 10 Halves Of Chicken
instructions: Beat egg oil and vinegar. Add remaining ingredients. Just heat do not boil.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: In greased casserole dish place chicken pieces. Spread can of whole cranberry sauce over chicken. Sprinkle dried onion soup mix over top then pour over all the Catalina dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour and cover for only 1/2 the baking time. Serve with rice.

title: Valentine Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream 1 cup margarine and 2 cups sugar into bowl; add eggs beating well after each addition. Stir in cream. Sift flour with salt and baking powder; add to creamed mixture. Mix well; stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla. Chill for 20 minutes. Roll out very thin on floured surface; cut with cookie cutters. Place on greased cookie sheet; bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven until brown. Cool. Combine remaining sugar milk and remaining margarine in saucepan; bring to a boil. Cook until mixture forms soft ball when dropped in water. Remove from heat; add vanilla and food coloring glaze.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Cream the potatoes. Brown hamburger meat. Take 3 tablespoons flour and milk; mix well. After meat is done drain. Pour gravy over hamburger meat. Put into baking dish a layer of creamed potatoes and a layer of meat. Last layer should be creamed potatoes. Garnish top of creamed potatoes with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with cheese if desired.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil cut chicken and debone. Cut up (reserve broth). Melt butter. Add soup sour cream broth carrot and dry stuffing. Mix well. Pour in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve.

title: Strawberry Jello Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix jello cooking oil and water; beat well. Add eggs one at a time and beat after each egg. Add strawberries and beat well. Bake in layer cake pans 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix together. Bake in greased pans approximately 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 loaves (about 3 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 2 1/2 size pans). Cool 5 minutes in pan and then remove to cooling rack and cool completely.

title: Dukes Skillet(Quick Hot Dish)
instructions: Brown the meat in shortening. Add remaining ingredients and heat.

title: Breakfast Cookies
instructions: Mix together oleo peanut butter and brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat until fluffy then add honey flour wheat germ baking powder soda and other ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pineapple Au Gratin
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into a buttered 1-quart casserole. Top with crushed Ritz or Town House crackers. Drizzle with 1/4-cup melted butter. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Mexican Skillet Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter cinnamon salt and milk in an electric skillet. Set thermostat at 280\u00b0. Bring to boil. Boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. Turn off skillet. Add marshmallows chocolate chips pecans and vanilla. Stir until marshmallows and chocolate chips are melted and smoothly blended. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch square buttered dish. Cool before cutting into squares. Yields 2 pounds.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Makes two pies.

title: Salsa
instructions: *Italian tomatoes (Roma) are best in salsa.

title: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Heat oil in 3-quart saucepan. When hot add onions and saute until translucent. Add green peppers and saute until slightly softened. Add rest of ingredients and mix together well. Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Cookies
instructions: Mix topping cake mix and egg well. Shape into small round balls. Roll in powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix together with dressing.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix together 2 tablespoons warm water and 1 package dry yeast. Sift dry ingredients and cut in the shortening. Add yeast and buttermilk. This makes a sticky dough. Add flour (extra if necessary) and roll 1/4-inch thick. Cut as biscuits and roll in melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix and spread into 9-inch pie pan. Jab with fork a few times and bake 6 to 8 minutes at 450\u00b0. Cool. Fill with sliced strawberries.

title: Dump Peach Cobbler
instructions: Dump together flour sugar milk and baking powder; mix. Spray baking dish with nonstick spray. Pour mixture into baking dish. On top of this dump sliced peaches with syrup. Chop oleo on top and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for some 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Forget Um'S
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Mix 1 cup sugar and beat until sugar dissolves. Add and mix by hand the chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Key Lime Toasted Pecan Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine flour and sugar. Stir to mix. Combine eggs yogurt whipping cream and coconut flavoring. Mix well. Stir in toasted pecans. Spoon into well greased muffin tin filling each cup 2/3 full. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of one of the muffins. Makes 10 large muffins.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; place in covered container and chill preferably overnight. Roll out very thin cut into circles and put on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar and bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by spoon into hot oil and cook until done. Drain on brown paper.

title: Spring Breeze Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually add and beat sugar in. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Blend well. Pour into crust. Chill at last 4 hours (or until set). Garnish with strawberries if desired.

title: Skillet Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger onions green peppers and garlic. Bring to boil 4 cups water and 1/2 pound spaghetti broken into smaller pieces. Cook 12 to 15 minutes. Add hamburger. Stir in tomatoes and ketchup. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese. Serves 6.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening sugar and eggs. Mix alternately with flour fruits and nuts. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: In a bowl slowly mix the first 5 ingredients with a mixer. Add salad oil slowly while blending add celery seed and paprika.

title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Sprinkle cranberries with 2 tablespoons sugar; set aside. Sift remaining sugar flour baking powder and salt into large mixing bowl. In separate bowl beat egg milk and oil. Make a hole in center of dry ingredients; pour in liquid ingredients. Stir only until mixed; do not overmix. Add berries and lemon peel. Fill greased standard or extra-large muffin cups with mixture. Sprinkle tops of muffins with cinnamon sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 18 minutes for standard size muffins or about 22 minutes for extra large muffins. Yields 12 standard size or 6 extra large muffins.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Drops
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a saucepan over low heat melt 1 cup of the chocolate chips. In a large bowl beat sugars and margarine until fluffy. Add sour cream vanilla eggs and melted chocolate. Mix well. Add flour baking powder and baking soda a little at a time. Mix well. Stir in remaining 1 cup chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto parchment-lined cookie sheets 2-inches apart. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer in order and chill several hours. Toss when ready to serve.

title: Southern Icebox Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar slowly and beat then add vanilla. Fold in cracker crumbs and nuts. Pour into a buttered pan. Bake until golden brown (about 30 minutes). Cool. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut (also nuts if desired).

title: Chris' Corn Salad
instructions: Drain corn well also pimentos. Add onions (including tops). Toss all vegetables together lightly. Add mayonnaise. Refrigerate overnight. Keeps well.

title: Carol'S Rosettes
instructions: Beat eggs. Add to oil flavoring sugar and baking powder. Add slowly to 4 1/2 cups flour. Knead roll out and shape into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Baked Potatoes And Onions
instructions: Peel potatoes and make cross wise slices on them about 1/4 inch apart; do not cut all the way through. About every second slice insert a slice of onion sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place 1 tbsp. butter on top of each potato. Wrap in foil and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Tear into pieces and place in baking dish. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Crush Ritz crackers and pour on top. Melt butter and pour over top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: To make 1 cup tea mix 3 tablespoons mix to a cup of boiling water.

title: Homemade Chicken Soup
instructions: Put chicken in large 6-quart boiler with celery onions and salt and pepper; cook until chicken is done. Debone and cut up chicken; return to pot. Add carrots green beans tomatoes corn and all seasonings. Add potatoes okra cabbage and turnips about 30 minutes before soup is done. Makes about 6 quarts and can be stored in deep freeze.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Cream peanut butter butter and vanilla. Add powdered sugar. Mix well. Make into balls. Place on wax paper on cookie sheet for 2 days in refrigerator.

title: Ziti With Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook ziti in boiling water until al dente (still a little firm). Drain pasta and place in a large bowl; set aside. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute garlic until lightly brown about 1 minute. Combine garlic broccoli Parmesan cheese and heavy cream with ziti. Spoon mixture into large baking dish. Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake covered for 20 to 30 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Charleston Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend thoroughly and chill. Excellent for vegies. Every time I use this dip the recipe is requested.

title: Festive Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets. Cool. Dice potatoes. Pour oil over potatoes. Add vinegar salt pepper sliced olives diced pickles shredded carrots pimentos (diced) finely chopped green pepper grated onions and grated cabbage; mix well. Add mustard and mayonnaise. Mix well. Serve cold.

title: Brisket Of Beef Roast
instructions: Season meat well with salt pepper and garlic salt. Add onion soup mix to both sides. Place in a roaster or cake pan. Add amount of water wanted for gravy. Usually 3/4 to 1-inch deep. Cover tightly and roast in slow oven at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until tender. Takes 2 1/2 or 3 hours. Turn the meat in about 1 1/2 hours. Cool in refrigerator at least 1 day. Trim off fat slice and set back into gravy; reheat for serving.

title: (Hessen) Sauerkraut And Brats
instructions: Fry bacon chopped with onions until bacon is crisp and onions are translucent. In a Dutch oven transfer sautee mixture; next add sauerkraut and applesauce. Simmer over low to medium heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Brown the brats in the frying pan. (Cook thoroughly). Cut in half and place in sauerkraut. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Simple Stir-Fry For Turkey Leftovers
instructions: In large skillet saute vegetables and onion in oil for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp-tender. Combine stir-fry sauce and turkey. Add to vegetable mixture; heat thoroughly. Serve over rice if desired.

title: Garlic-Blue Cheese Vinaigrette
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a jar. Cover tightly and shake vigorously. Add blue cheese; stir mixture before serving.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Put in a meat loaf pan. Pat it down. Put a little ketchup on the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Yum-Yum Icebox Cake
instructions: Mix instant pudding mix with milk; fold in Cool Whip. Layer whole graham crackers in 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour 1/2 pudding mix over crackers; repeat ending with top layer of graham crackers.

title: Copper Penny Carrots
instructions: Mix vegetables. In a separate bowl combine soup oil vinegar and remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate overnight. Serve cold as a salad or hot as a vegetable.

title: Popsicles
instructions: Mix well and add 2 cups cold water. Freeze.

title: Giant Raisin Bran Cookies
instructions: Sift together Kelloggs Raisin Bran cereal flours and baking soda; set aside.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix instant pudding Jell-O and whipped cream well. Add pineapple and sour cream mixing well with other ingredients. Add marshmallows; stir in well. Chill for 2 hours then serve.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Separate and spread in two pizza pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Family Gathering Spaghetti
instructions: Cook and stir meat in a large Dutch oven until meat is brown. Drain off grease. Add sauce and mushrooms. (Add your own special touches onions black olives etc.) Cook a few minutes. Add spaghetti. Pour mixture into two ungreased casseroles. Cover and bake one in 375\u00b0 oven stirring occasionally until spaghetti is tender about 45 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with one cup of cheese and bake 5 minutes more. Freeze other casserole and bake another night. If having a large crowd for dinner bake both. Enjoy. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given by hand. When well blended drop by tablespoon on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes. Great cookies. The kids will love them. Easy for young cooks to make under adult supervision.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash and dry mushrooms. Remove stems. Combine drained and flaked crab parsley and pimento. Blend together mustard onion salt and mayonnaise. Toss mixtures together. Fill each crown with 2 tablespoons of the crab mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until hot.

title: Fried Chicken With Creamy Gravy
instructions: Rinse chicken pieces; pat dry with paper towels. In a plastic bag combine flour salt paprika and pepper. Add a few chicken breasts at a time to the bag. Shake to coat. Remove chicken from bag shaking of any excess coating in the bag. Reserve remaining flour mixture.

title: Mac Beef And Cheese
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion; drain off fat. Add 2/3 spaghetti sauce. Simmer 5 minutes. Combine sauce mixture with macaroni. Pour into casserole; top with remaining spaghetti sauce. Cut cheese slices diagonally. Arrange around edge of casserole facing points toward center. Bake on 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix Bisquick with 3/4 cup water. Add sausage and shredded cheese. Shape into walnut sized balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes on cookie sheets. Freeze leftovers. Reheat at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until warm.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter shortening and sugar. (Note You may use 1/2 cup of butter or 1/2 cup shortening in place of 1/4 each if you prefer.) Add egg and beat together. Sift flour with baking soda mix together well adding the vanilla and nuts. Divide the dough into four. Roll each into long rectangle tubes using wax paper. Chill overnight in refrigerator. Slice thin and bake on greased baking sheets at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for ten minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar in a bowl. Beat in eggs vanilla and buttermilk. Sift in flour soda and salt. Stir until blended. Add chocolate. Mix well. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until cake tests done. Let stand covered until cool.

title: Tomato-Lentil Delight
instructions: Cook lentils onion carrot and celery together in 4 cups water for 1/2 hour. Add other ingredients and simmer 1/2 hour.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottom only of 12 medium muffin cups. Beat egg; stir in milk oil and blueberries. Stir in remaining ingredients all at once. Stir until flour is moist. (Batter will be lumpy.) Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Sweet Potatoes And Apples
instructions: Peel apples. Layer potatoes and apples in a baking dish. Dot with butter and pour syrup all over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Multi-Nut Brittle
instructions: Butter a cookie sheet. Combine sugar water and corn syrup in a large saucepan. Cook over high heat to 280\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Add nuts and cook stirring to 300\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla until blended. Add baking soda and stir vigorously.

title: Texas Chili
instructions: Brown ground meat and onion; drain. Place in large pan. Add other ingredients. Simmer for 2 hours (if possible). When served top with shredded cheddar cheese and/or taco chips.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Lay ham out flat. Slice cream cheese and press with fingers on the ham. Put green onion to fit on cream cheese lengthwise. Roll up. Slice into 1-inch circles. Arrange on a serving plate.

title: Roast Pork Loin
instructions: Mix ingredients and rub thoroughly into the loin. Roast at 325\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours until tender. After meat has baked for 1 1/2 hours spread generously with topping.

title: Turtle Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine. Set aside. Mix eggs sugar flour and vanilla. Add chocolate mixture. Cook in waffle iron for 1 minute. Frost with chocolate frosting if desired.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake(Pretty And Delicious)
instructions: Combine sugar butter and egg in mixing bowl; cream well. Sift flour baking powder and salt together; add alternately to creamed mixture with milk. Beat well; blend in blueberries. Spread dough in greased 8 x 10-inch pan.

title: Corn Soup
instructions: Chop bacon and fry with onion. Drain and add corn salt and water. Reduce heat when corn breaks apart and cook 5 minutes. Add soup then milk. Heat to serving temperature.

title: Vienna Tarts(Kolachkee)
instructions: Cream butter and cheese until blended and fluffy. Add flour and knead to smooth dough. Wrap and chill several hours. Roll 1/8-inch thick into a rectangle. Cut into 2-inch squares. Place 1/4 teaspoon tart grape jelly in center of each; fold corner over and seal together tightly. Brush with egg yolk mixed with milk. Sprinkle with ground nuts. Place on ungreased baking sheets and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Saucy Asparagus
instructions: Combine soup and milk in saucepan over medium heat until boiling stirring frequently. Add asparagus. Cover pan and reduce heat to low. Cook until asparagus is tender (about 10 min) stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Greasy Bread
instructions: Cook bacon or pork and reserve all the grease. Spread liquid grease on rye bread both sides toast on grill. Stack the veggies on the toasted bread add salt and pepper to taste. If bacon was used for grease add it to the stack and cut as an open-faced sandwich.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high for 5 minutes. Then stir in sugar. Combine spices in pumpkin and fold in along with flour to first mixture. Spread onto a well-greased jelly roll sheet (15 x 10 x 1-inch). Top with one cup finely chopped walnuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Turn out onto towel. Roll up. When cool unroll and fill.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add vegetable oil and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with milk into egg mixture. Pour into 2 greased and floured bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until tester comes out clean. Freezes well.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix together and stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Hot Percolator Punch
instructions: Mix and put the first 4 ingredients in a 36-cup electric coffeemaker. Add in top basket the remaining ingredients. Let perk in coffeemaker as coffee.

title: Tortellini Primavera
instructions: Cook and stir mushrooms onion and garlic in margarine in large skillet. Add all remaining ingredients except tortellini mix well. Cook until mixture just begins to boil stirring occasionally. Stir in tortellini; cook until thoroughly heated. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cast A Spell Over Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Dip chicken in margarine (melted); coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Makes 6 servings. Preparation time 5 minutes cooking time 25 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Saute celery onion almonds and water chestnuts in butter. Mix rice soup and mayo together in bowl. Stir in the four ingredients that have been sauteed. Add the cut up cooked chicken and cheese. Spray a 9 x 13 pan with Pam and put mixture in pan. Top with crushed potato chips and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and pour in pie shell. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix well. Pour into greased pan (9 x 13-inches). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly and spread on batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Delicious served with whipped cream as a dessert.

title: Basil Chicken Salad
instructions: About 2 hours before or early in the day mix vinegar basil sugar and 1/4 cup oil in a large bowl. Set aside.

title: Nacho Popcorn
instructions: Melt oleo in saucepan; stir in paprika red pepper and cumin. Let cool for 5 minutes. Place popcorn in large bowl. Pour mixture on top; sprinkle on cheese and toss popcorn until all is coated.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water together. Add other ingredients. Put in dish and let chill overnight.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash drain and mash. Add all remaining ingredients except margarine and cracker crumbs. Place ingredients in buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Top with crumbs and dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. May be frozen. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Spoon into prepared crust. Top with second crust. Crimp edges to seal; slit top crust. Brush with egg if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and serve.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Rinse tenders. Cook chicken in dressing oil and minced garlic over medium-high heat until done. Make salad.

title: John'S Maple Candy
instructions: In large bowl mix all ingredients. Roll into little balls the size of walnuts. Refrigerate one to two hours. (Best if made a day ahead of serving time.) Also may be rolled in finely shredded coconut or chopped pecans and placed on waxed paper lined cookie sheets until chilled. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Crisco'S Super Crisp Country Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine milk and egg in medium bowl. Set aside. Combine in plastic bag; flour garlic salt Paprika black pepper poultry seasoning. Add a few pieces of chicken at a time. Shake to coat. Dip chicken in milk-egg mixture. Shake second time in flour mixture.

title: Scallop Casserole
instructions: Rinse scallops and pat dry with paper towels. Cook onion celery and green pepper in butter until tender. Blend in flour and seasonings. Add milk gradually and cook until thick stirring constantly. Add scallops. Place half of the rice in a buttered 1 1/2-quart dish. Cover with half of the scallop mixture and half of the cheese. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Clam Paste(Dip)
instructions: Soften cream cheese in a medium size mixing bowl at room temperature. Add rest of the ingredients and mix well. Serve with chips.

title: Green Bean Special
instructions: Combine sour cream and dressing; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill 4-5 hours before serving.

title: Leek And Potato Soup
instructions: Wash leeks and dice about 2 ounces of tender white hearts. Put aside. Cut rest of leek into 1/2-inch pieces. In pan add water potatoes leeks and onion. Bring to boil. Add milk salt and pepper. Simmer 30 minutes. Remove potatoes and leeks. Force through ricer or puree in blender. Return to soup pot. Add tender diced leeks butter and cream. Bring to boil. Stir. Do not allow to burn. Cook slowly for 15 minutes. Stir in cheese and seasoning to taste. Serve with crusty bread.

title: One Pan Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease bottom of a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Stir all ingredients in pan with a fork until moistened. Beat vigorously 1 minute. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Bake 55 to 65 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Run a knife or spatula around sides of loaf to loosen. Remove from pan.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain. Heat drippings; blend in flour sugar salt celery seed and pepper. Gradually blend in broth and vinegar. Cook stirring constantly until slightly thickened.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in an 8 x 8 or a round pan at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. This is a delicious side dish.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Saute the minced bell pepper and onion in butter. Add ground meat and other ingredients. Simmer for 30 minutes. Core bell peppers; boil until tender. Stuff with meat mixture. Top with grated cheese if desired. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Scampi
instructions: Brown shrimp in oil. Add vermouth garlic salt and pepper. Saute until liquid is nearly gone. Sprinkle with parsley and lemon juice. Serves 4.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Cut the ribs into serving pieces. Mix all of the remaining ingredients in a saucepan and heat to boiling. Pour sauce over meat. Chill for several hours or overnight. Bake covered in a 450\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Frosted Cashew Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. Mix baking mix brown sugar sour cream margarine egg and vanilla. Stir in cashews. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto a cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until no indentation remains when touched. Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheet.

title: Watermelon Rind Pickles
instructions: Select a melon with a thick rind. Remove outer green skin and pink flesh; use only the greenish white parts of rind cut in 1-inch cubes. Combine water and lime. Add cubed rind and soak overnight in refrigerator. Drain and rinse cubes in cold water several times then cover with cold water and boil for 30 minutes. Drain.

title: Abby'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix syrup sugar salt butter and vanilla. Add slightly beaten eggs. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle pecans over filling. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 45 minutes. You can top it with a bit of whipped cream or ice cream; but even plain nothing tops this!

title: Chocolate Chocolate-Chip Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter an 8-inch square glass pan. Melt the butter and chocolate in the top of a double boiler and stir well. In a mixing bowl combine butter and chocolate with sugar flour nuts baking powder and vanilla. Stir well. Add eggs and mix thoroughly. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into pan and bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix together Spry sugar and eggs; then add cocoa sour milk and flour. Last add boiling water. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Smoothie Chocolate Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: In 1-quart glass bowl combine chocolate and milk. Micro-cook covered until chocolate melts about 1 minute stirring once. Stir in sugar vanilla and salt. Fold in the nuts.

title: Mexican Meat And Potatoes
instructions: Brown stew meat in oil in a large pot. Cover meat with water and boil until tender. Add potatoes onions cumin garlic salt pepper and enough water to cover potatoes and onions. Cook until potatoes are done. Add stewed tomatoes. Let cook until thick like a stew.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Beat sugar shortening and egg with wooden spoon until smooth and creamy. Add cream of tartar baking soda and salt and mix again. Add flour gradually and mix well. Form the dough into balls about 1-inch in diameter and roll each ball in mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Place on ungreased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake for 9 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes about 36 cookies.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; beat in egg yolks. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with sour cream. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Beat vigorously; add flavoring. Pour into 10-inch tube pan greased and sprinkled with white sugar. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Slaw
instructions: Chop cabbage and peppers. Mix in other ingredients. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Crush walnuts fine melt butter and mix flour all together. Press firmly in 9x13 pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Rub bowl with cut garlic. Gradually add cream to cream cheese; blend until smooth. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Chill. Serve with unsalted crackers.

title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
instructions: Mix together the pudding 3 cups milk and Cool Whip. In a pot mix the margarine (melted). Add the sugar cocoa 1/4 cup milk and vanilla. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers. Layer pudding mix graham crackers pudding mix and top with chocolate mixture.

title: Corn And Lima Beans Succotash
instructions: Boil broth; add lima beans and corn. Cover and cook 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add pepper and sugar; cook for 4 minutes until you only have a little broth left. Stir in sour cream. Place in bowl and serve.

title: Teriyaki Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. This is a good recipe for cheaper cuts of steak. Also goes well on chicken or ground beef.

title: Pork Chop Bake
instructions: Brown chops. In casserole mix soup milk and water. Put browned chops into mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes. Good served with rice.

title: Rich Sweet Dough
instructions: Scald milk and margarine. Cool to lukewarm add sugar and salt add yeast mixture eggs and flour. Stir until stiff enough dough to knead. Let rise 1 hour. Punch down. Shape into loaves and let rise 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Dough can be refrigerated for 3 days.

title: Beer Venison Chops
instructions: Brown chops in bacon grease and pour off fat. Blend brown sugar catsup and beer. Pour over chops. Cook in an electric frypan until tender about 1 hour (may need to add a little water as it cooks down). Spoon sauce over chops and serve.

title: Orange (Tang) Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple juice with Tang and pudding mix. Mix fruits together and fold into pudding mixture. Chill.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop artichokes coarsely in processor or blender. Add 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese 1/2 package cream cheese 1/4 cup mayonnaise 1/4 teaspoon dill weed garlic and lemon juice. Process until smooth. Smooth into 10-inch pie plate. Process the balance of ingredients until smooth and add to plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain salmon and keep juice. To juice add enough milk to make 1 cup. Flake salmon and combine all ingredients. Pack into a greased loaf pan and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Codfish Cakes (Marinade)
instructions: Soak codfish in cold water overnight; discard water. Boil 1 quart of water; drop codfish in water. Turn fire off; let stand 10 minutes. Discard water. Cool and shred cod. Mix egg with 1 1/2 cups water and milk; pour over flour mixture and gradually make a soft paste. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Drop 1 tablespoon at a time in hot oil (deep fry). Very good as an appetizer.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown bacon chopped onions and green pepper. Saute until soft. Drain off half the grease. Brown hamburger. Mix together remaining ingredients. Bake in greased casserole for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Gooey Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and egg. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat powdered sugar cream cheese and eggs for 5 minutes. Pour over mixture in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan combine soup milk cheese garlic powder and pepper; add broccoli and carrot. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Cover; cook over low heat 5 minutes. Add spaghetti. Heat through. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Elegant Seafood Crepes
instructions: *You may substitute other fresh seafoods.

title: Quick And Easy Yeast Bread
instructions: Mix together 2 cups flour sugar and salt. Warm milk and water to 120\u00b0. Add yeast to milk mixture. Add liquid yeast mixture to dry ingredients. Add butter and eggs. Add remaining flour until correct consistency. Knead 5 to 10 minutes. Let rest to double in a warm place (about 20 minutes). Punch down; divide and shape. Place in loaf pans. Let rise again. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Saltwater Taffy
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine sugar water syrup salt and cocoa. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves. Continue to cook to hard ball stage (260\u00b0) without stirring about 1 hour and 25 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in butter and flavorings. Pour into buttered 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan. Cool until comfortable to handle 10 to 15 minutes. Butter hands lightly; gather small amounts of taffy into a ball and pull until candy becomes opaque and holds its shape. Pull each piece into a long strand about 1/2-inch thick. With buttered kitchen shears snip into bite size pieces. Wrap in waxed paper or plastic wrap. Makes 1 1/4 pounds.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Put Ritz crackers in food processor. Put crushed crackers in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour melted butter over top. Combine together (make sure all crumbs have butter on them). Flatten out evenly on bottom of pan.

title: Chicken With Apple Cream Sauce
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. In a large skillet over medium-high heat cook chicken in hot oil until browned on each side. Add juice concentrate lemon juice and rosemary. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until juices of chicken run clear. Remove chicken but keep warm.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake 1 hour in greased pan at 350\u00b0. Makes 1 loaf. Prick top of loaf when baked.

title: Fabulous Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Combine flour and beer thoroughly with whisk in large bowl. Cover bowl and let set at room temperature for at least 3 hours. Cut onions into slices and separate into rings. Stir into batter then fry in oil at 375\u00b0. (An electric skillet works best.) Turn once or twice until golden then transfer them to a preheated 200\u00b0 oven layering on brown paper bags or paper towels on cookie sheet. These stay crispy and crunchy for hours so you can make ahead and clean up the mess. They freeze and reheat well too if you have any left!

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Scrub cucumbers. Slice cucumbers onions and peppers. Let come to a boil in the solution. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until hot through. Pack in sterilized jars. Makes 7 pints.

title: Onion And Cucumber Salad
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onions thin. Cover with salt. Press with heavy object for 30 minutes. Pour off water. Mix sour cream and vinegar and pour over. Serve.

title: Butterscotch Fingers
instructions: Place butterscotch bits and milk in double boiler. After bits are melted boil 8 to 10 minutes then pour milk over Rice Chex and nuts; stir until coated. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.

title: Best Ever Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine the sugars oil and eggs in a very large bowl (I use a 10-quart bowl for plenty of stirring space). Combine soda baking powder salt and flour and add to the sugar mixture. Stir in the oats chocolate chips coconut and cereal.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix the oil eggs and sugar together. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Grease muffin tin and fill 2/3 full. Brush with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Egg Salad Sandwich Filling
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix lightly but well. Yields 8 sandwiches.

title: Cheese Pennies
instructions: Let margarine and grated cheese come to room temperature then mix. Add flour salt and onion soup mix. Mix together and divide into 4 rolls. Roll each one in foil and freeze. Slice thin and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Crescents
instructions: Soften butter; add nuts. Mix in sugar gradually add flour; take small amount of dough roll in hand and form crescent shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Roll in superfine sugar.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: In large bowl combine chicken onion pepers and soup. In greased 9x13 pan spread doritos in the bottom. Spread chicken mix over top. Pour 1 can of rotel over top cover with velveeta slices and add other can of rotel. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ground beef and eggs well; add bread crumbs salt and pepper thoroughly. Add in ketchup garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Shape into meat loaf. Pour very little ketchup over top for extra flavor. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until desired tenderness.

title: Wendy'S Style Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef in oil. Break meat into tiny pieces. Place soup and 1/2 meat into blender. Process on high until it resembles cement mortar. Place with unblended meat into 2 1/2-quart pan. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until flavors are blended.

title: Old Fashioned Cocoa Cake
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Beat first the flour ingredients at high speed of mixer 3 minutes. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with water to creamed mixture. Blend just until combined. Add candy. Pour into two greased and cocoa dusted cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Carolyn'S Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt margarine in oblong Pyrex pan. In bowl mix flour sugar and milk. Stir mixture in melted margarine. Add blueberries to mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening sugar and eggs. Add milk and vanilla. Sift flour cinnamon baking powder salt and soda together. Add to mixture and blend thoroughly. Mix in oats raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoons 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Sydnie'S Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Allow steak to soak in ginger garlic and soy sauce. Heat oil until hot. Cook steak in oil until brown. Turn heat to low and simmer steak 25 to 30 minutes. Add green onions and green pepper. Cook on high 10 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water. Add to steak and vegetables. Add the tomato. Let set for 10 minutes. Serve with white rice.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Mix all except dates nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoons onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown on top (dont overbake). Makes about 40.

title: Creamed Dried Beef
instructions: Cook beef with butter in 10-inch skillet on medium for 3 minutes or until edges curl. Gradually stir in flour. Add milk all at once. Stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more. Add Worcestershire sauce and pepper to taste. Spoon over buttered toast. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Cranberry Frozen Salad
instructions: Hand mix well. Line muffin tin with paper liners. Pour mixture into muffin cups. Freeze until firm. Store in Ziploc freezer bags. Thaw slightly before serving. Serves 12.

title: Lite & Easy Crustless Pumpkin Pie(Low Calorie)
instructions: In medium bowl sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften. In a small saucepan heat 1 cup of the evaporated Low Fat milk just to boiling. Slowly stir hot milk into gelatin. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Mix in remaining milk the pumpkin brown sugar pumpkin pie spice and vanilla. Set aside. Spray 10 inch glass pie plate with non-stick vegetable spray. Pour mixture into pie plate chill until firm.

title: Chiles Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet stirring to crumble beef; drain well. Stir in 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper and set aside.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Mix all and cook over medium heat stirring constantly just until the mixture comes to a boil. Makes 1 1/3 cups. Serve over gingerbread angel food etc.

title: Sparkling Holiday Punch
instructions: Combine cranberry juice and sugar. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add pineapple juice. Pour into punch bowl over a piece of ice. Add ginger ale just before serving. Makes 1 gallon or 32 punch cups.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Saute celery onion and green pepper until crisp-tender; do not brown. Add soups Cheez Whiz mushrooms and pimentos. Mix until well blended. Add chicken pieces and noodles. Pour into three-quart casserole. Sprinkle grated Cheddar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until center begins to bubble.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar water and cornstarch until thick and clear. Add dry jello. Cool completely. Slice strawberries and fold into jello mixture. Put in favorite pie crust. Top with Cool Whip. Makes two pies.

title: Five Can Casserole
instructions: Use a 13 x 9-inch dish. Place noodles in bottom of dish then layer of meat 1st can of soup layer of meat 2nd can of soup then ditto 3rd and 4th cans of soup with layer of meat. Pour Pet milk plus 1 can of water over mixture. Cover with grated cheese. Bake about 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients; mix well. Add egg and mix well. Add milk slowly and blend well. Start cooking on high heat stirring constantly. Reduce to medium heat stirring constantly. After thickened add vanilla. Blend well. Serve hot or cold.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt butter in skillet. Add sugar and curry powder. Add pineapple and syrup to skillet. Mix and simmer until sugar is melted. Put fruits in a buttered shallow pan or baking dish (1 1/2-quart). Pour sauce over fruit. Bake 1 hour. Makes 8 servings.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor bowl. Pulse to blend and then run continuous for 10 to 15 seconds. Makes 1 cup.

title: Minute Fudge Frosting
instructions: Stir over low heat until shortening and chocolate melts. Bring to full rolling boil; stir constantly. Boil 1 minute remove from heat and beat until lukewarm. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and spread over any cooled cake.

title: My Mother-In-Law'S Cheese Custard
instructions: Blend all but egg whites and brown sugar. Pour into two 9-inch pie shells. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Beef And Broccoli
instructions: Mix the m.s.g. soy sauce and ginger; set aside. Add chicken cube to water to make broth; set aside. Heat oil; saute steak and garlic for 3 minutes. Add m.s.g. mix chicken broth and broccoli pieces. Put cover on pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes. Thicken with cornstarch which was diluted.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello and hot water until dissolved. Add sherbet stirring well. Let set in refrigerator until thick. Add oranges and whipped cream. Chill.

title: Yummy Yams
instructions: Alternate layers of yams and banana slices in a 1-quart casserole ending with a layer of yams. Melt margarine. Stir in salt corn syrup and orange juice. Pour over yams and bananas. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Baste yams and bananas with liquid. Sprinkle with coconut. Bake uncovered 10 minutes or until coconut is browned.

title: Strawberry Banana Soup
instructions: Combine strawberries banana and 2 tablespoons sugar. Blend sugar. Mix sour cream and rest of sugar; whip and blend into milk and sour cream. Add wine. Whisk until well blended; fold in strawberries and bananas. Chill 2 hours. Yields 4 1/2 cups.

title: Oven Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut each medium size potato into about six pieces. Place in a baking pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix Bisquick and sausage with hands until well blended. Mix in cheese and roll into walnut-sized balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and stir in buttermilk until mix is a medium batter. Drop into cooking oil and deep fry until golden brown.

title: Pork Poor Boy
instructions: Rub roast with pepper; place in a shallow roasting pan. Roast uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes; slice thin. Slice bread lengthwise. On bottom half of bread layer spinach meat tomato cucumber avocado green pepper and alfalfa sprouts. Drizzle with dressing. Replace top of bread and serve immediately.

title: Cindy'S Baked Beans
instructions: Cut bacon into 1-inch squares. Fry and remove from skillet to drain. Place onion (chopped) into skillet with bacon grease. Cook until clear; add pork and beans (remove pork fat). Add sugar mustard and Worcestershire sauce to taste.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Saute curry powder in butter. Add sugar. Arrange fruit in baking dish in layers placing some sugar mixture between each layer. Bake 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Baste with mixture and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Rose Jar Potpourri(Makes 1 Jar)
instructions: Add 7/8 cup water. Knead dough about 10 minutes after mixing thoroughly. If dough is sticky add a little more flour. Roll out 1/4 inch thick. Cut in shapes with cookie cutters or shape freehand. Make coils balls etc. for trim to decorate. Moisten to stick to dough. Bake about an hour at 325\u00b0. Paint with water colors or food color. Make a hole with a straw before baking if you want to hang on the tree.

title: Patricia'S Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Thaw and squeeze out excess liquid from broccoli. Mix all ingredients together and put in a baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. It is done when toothpick put in center comes out clean. Rub top with 3 or 4 pats of margarine as soon as it comes out of oven.

title: Turkey Sloppy Joes
instructions: Cook turkey; drain off any liquid. Add the chopped vegetables and the rest of the ingredients. Simmer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Wilt a little onion and bell pepper in oleo. Add pepper and oleo. If you like cheese add a little. Boil squash in salt water. When done drain water and mash. Mix with other ingredients. Bake in greased casserole with a few cracker crumbs on top.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt margarine/ butter in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal. Stir until well coated. Using buttered spatula press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs beat well. Sift flour cocoa and salt. Add to first ingredients by hand. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 35 minutes at 300\u00b0. Remove from oven and spread marshmallows over cake. Bake 10 more minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove and cool completely. Ice.

title: Stewed Eggplant
instructions: Wash peel and cut eggplant into small pieces. Cut onion and bell pepper into small pieces. Enough water to cover; salt to taste. Stew down until tender or most of water is gone.

title: Spanish Style Green Beans
instructions: Remove strings from beans; wash beans thoroughly. Cut beans into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Cook beans in boiling salted water 15 to 20 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain and set aside. Saute green pepper and onion in hot oil until tender. Add tomatoes basil rosemary salt pepper and beans mixing well. Heat thoroughly.

title: Mother Cade'S Apple Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter well; add eggs one at a time. Beat well. After sifting flour measure and then add spices cocoa and a pinch of salt. Dissolve soda in water. Add nuts and apples last. Cook in a slow oven at 350\u00b0 in a greased and floured pan.

title: Fettucine
instructions: Combine garlic and olive oil. Cream butter and add to oil mixture. Combine egg yolks and cream to oil mixture. Boil fettucine noodles; drain well. Add mixture to noodles. Add salt and pepper.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch Cake
instructions: Beat cake mix brown sugar and peanut butter in bowl until crumbly. Reserve 2/3 cup. Beat remaining mixture water oil and eggs. Pour into pan. Stir nuts into reserved crumbly mixture. Sprinkle over batter. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: One-Step Coconut Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large bowl (or blender) and blend well. Pour into a buttered 10-inch pie plate and bake in a preheated oven for about 1 hour. When done the crust will be on the bottom the custard in the middle and the coconut on top.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix and press graham cracker crumbs and butter into bottom and up sides of pan.

title: Honey Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake bread until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. Cool in pan for 15 minutes then place on a wire rack. Cool completely. Slice and serve.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in bowl. Add eggs and vanilla. Blend well. Mix flour cocoa baking soda and salt. Gradually add to cream mixture. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 9 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Collard Greens
instructions: Wash greens and cut them. Place ham hocks in boiler with about 1 quart of water and let boil about 30 minutes. Then add oil salt and sugar. Add greens and cook over medium heat. Stir about every 10 minutes and cook until tender.

title: Broccoli Parmesan Fettuccine
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water with a cover for about 3 minutes; drain and plunge into ice water. Drain and set aside. Cook fettuccine according to directions; drain and place in a large bowl. Set aside.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugars together. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Sift together flour salt soda and baking powder. Stir into creamed mixture. Stir in rolled oats. Fold in gumdrops and nuts. Drop by teaspoons 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on wire rack. Yields about 6 dozen.

title: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
instructions: In a plastic/paper bag combine flour salt and pepper. Shake to mix. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly. Remove chicken and reserve excess seasoned flour. In large skillet heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat. Add chicken and brown on one side about 5 minutes. Add other tablespoon oil; turn chicken and brown on second side. Transfer chicken to a plate; set aside. Add margarine to skillet; melt and cook onions stirring until softened 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in remaining seasoned flour; cook stirring about 1 minute. Add chicken broth 2 tablespoons lemon juice and thyme. Bring mixture to a boil stirring constantly. Return chicken to skillet; reduce heat and cover. Cook chicken about 5 minutes. Remove chicken. Stir in remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice into sauce. Stir and pour over chicken. Serve chicken with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cook and stir milk and flour together until thick. Let it cool until cold. Add butter Crisco sugar salt and vanilla; mix with flour mixture and beat at least 10 minutes. Keep in refrigerator until cake is done and cold then frost.

title: Miracle Rugalah Dough
instructions: This dough will do anything where a pastry dough is needed. It can be used for a dessert canapes pie crust and etc. Keep a supply in the freezer at all times.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Put broccoli pieces of chicken (whole or cubed your choice) in buttered casserole dish. Mix soup and half and half together. Pour over broccoli and chicken. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Nuts
instructions: Beat egg white with cold water; beat until foamy. Stir in nuts and mix well until nuts are completely coated. Mix in bowl the brown and white sugars nutmeg salt and cinnamon. Pour over nut mixture and stir until nuts are covered. Pour on cookie sheet and bake 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Stir 3 or 4 times while baking.

title: Turtle Cake(Caramel Chocolate Brownies)
instructions: Put caramels in top of double boiler with the 1/3 cup of milk. Put cake mix in a bowl with margarine milk and nuts. Combine into stuff dough.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix and pour over the above. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let sit 15 minutes before serving.

title: Brisket With Parsley Sauce
instructions: Sear brisket in oil in a big pot (with a lid) browning both sides. When brown remove to a platter. Add vegetables garlic and pepper; saute until vegetables start to brown. Return meat to pot laying on top of vegetables. Add water or broth until about half of meat is covered. Cover pot tightly and cook on top of stove at slow simmer 2 1/2 hours (or in 325\u00b0 oven) until a fork pierces meat easily. Allow to cool in its juices overnight. Pour off all juice into a container and place in freezer until fat congeals and can be removed. Return defatted sauce to meat. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Harvey House Slaw
instructions: In large bowl make layers of cabbage green pepper and onions. Sprinkle 1 cup sugar over top.

title: Creole Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Boil peppers (opened from top and cleaned) for 5 minutes in salted water. Combine meat 1/4 cup onion celery salt egg and milk. Drain peppers and stuff with meat mixture. Place in 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Heat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Venezuela Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions and cool. While it is still warm add chopped onion vinegar corn oil curry powder and\tsalt. Chill for 3 hours or overnight. Add chopped celery peas which have been cooked and cooled and mayonnaise. Add chicken pieces or chopped boiled eggs although the salad is\tdelicious even without it. Serves 8 to 12 people.

title: Easy Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Boil egg noodles until tender. Using a casserole dish layer noodles beef sauce and cheese. Bake until cheese is bubbly at 450\u00b0.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: In one pot start cooking cut-up chicken in water. In heavy skillet make roux (1 cup oil 1 cup flour). Cook until dark brown stirring constantly. Over medium flame add chopped onion celery and garlic; cook slowly still stirring until very tender. Will make a thick gravy. Add roux mixture to chicken; cook till tender then add okra stewed tomatoes green onions and parsley. Cook 20 minutes. Serve over rice. Oysters or shrimp may be added if desired.

title: Frank-Bean Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix beans spaghetti sauce onion and cheese in\tan ungreased 1 1/2 quart casserole. Arrange frankfurters on top. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until bean mixture is bubbly and frankfurters are light brown.

title: Easy Macaroni Meal
instructions: Brown ground beef in a pan sprayed with Pam. Add tomato juice and seasonings. Cook over low heat. When mixture is boiling about 5 minutes gradually add the macaroni so that the tomato juice mixture continues to boil. Add green peppers and onion. Cover and cook until macaroni is tender about 25 to 30 minutes. Stir occasionally during cooking. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Pineapple Filling
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together then add the eggs one at a time beating well. Stir in pineapple and fold in the bread cubes. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Wild Rice
instructions: Rinse the rice. Place all ingredients together in a pot (with a tight lid). Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for about 45 minutes keeping lid on tight. Remove from heat and set aside covered for 10 minutes. Stir with a fork to fluff. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Paula'S Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes with jackets on. Peel as soon as possible. Mash up. Add the Italian seasoning. Mix well. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake until cheese is melted.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 425\u00b0 in unbaked pie shell for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Cook until knife blade comes out clean.

title: Sweet Potato Bake
instructions: Mix mashed sweet potatoes oleo sugar vanilla eggs and milk together. Put in 9 x 12-inch greased pan.

title: Purple Poke Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directed in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Poke holes in cake with knife at 1/2-inch intervals. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water and pour over cake in pan. Chill 3 to 4 hours and top with Cool Whip. Store in refrigerator.

title: Layered Taco Bean Dip
instructions: In a large bowl combine the bean dip and taco mix. Spread mixture in a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle chopped onions over mixture. Blend together Miracle Whip and sour cream. Spread over onions. Sprinkle sliced ripe olives on top. Chill. Serve with corn chips.

title: Kiss Of Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and lightly flour 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. In blender heat oats 1 minute. Combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Beat sugar and margarine until fluffy. Add eggs and lemon peel; mix well. Add dry ingredients alternating with milk mixing until blended. Pour into pan. Bake hour and 10 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Remove to wire rack. Cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. In a blender blend raspberries until smooth. Serve with pound cake. Makes 16 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar peanuts Karo syrup and salt. Microwave on High heat for 4 minutes. Take out; stir well. Put back in microwave 4 more minutes. Remove. Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon butter. Microwave for 2 minutes. Take out. Add 1 teaspoon baking soda. Stir. Pour on a greased cookie sheet. Cool.

title: Chocolate Fudge Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with nonfat cooking spray. In a large bowl combine apple butter sugar brown sugar vanilla and egg substitute and mix until blended smooth. Stir in cocoa flour and baking powder. Mix until all ingredients are blended. Spoon batter into prepared dish and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Makes 24 brownies.

title: Cinnamon Apple Dessert
instructions: Slice apples and place in an 8 x 8-inch square greased baking dish. Add raisins nuts and brown sugar. In a large mixing bowl stir together the flour sugar salt and baking powder. Add egg. Stir with fork until mixture forms balls. Spread over apple mixture evenly. Pour butter evenly over apple mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except sugar/cinnamon and raisins. Cut into shapes fancy or round. Bake until just done approximately 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Chili Rice
instructions: In a large skillet saute onion in hot butter until clear. Remove from heat and stir in hot rice sour cream cottage cheese bay leaf salt and pepper. Toss lightly to mix.

title: Quick Curried Shrimp
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and microwave at High for 11 to 13 minutes or until bubbly stirring every 4 minutes. Serve over rice. Yields 6 servings. Preparation time is about 5 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball 1
instructions: Mix butter and cream cheese thoroughly. Chop ends of green onions up and add to mixture. Form ball and roll in chopped pecans.

title: Imperial Salad Freeze
instructions: Mash bananas. Stir in other ingredients. Put into ring mold or Bundt cake pan or paper filled cupcake pans. Freeze well overnight or all day. Remove from freezer about serving time.

title: Aunt Lula'S Awful Good Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Cream together butter sugar and egg yolks. Add raisins and pecans. Add vinegar and vanilla mixing well. Fold in beaten egg whites. Put in an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Mincemeat
instructions: Chop tomatoes fine; drain off juice. Add same amount of water and scald. Pour off. Scald in same amount of water again. Drain then add apples (chopped fine) sugar raisins suet salt and vinegar. Cook until tomatoes are color of raisins. When cool add spices.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Stir in macaroni juice onions and spices. Bring to a boil and set aside. Brown ground beef and drain. Add tomato mixture and ground beef into a casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes uncovered. Add shredded cheese and return to oven for 10 minutes. Use whatever type of cheese your family likes. This is a great one dish meal.

title: Cold Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine ham crumbs potatoes eggs and parsley. Saute onion in butter; stir in mustard salt and pepper. Add to ham mixture. Rinse a bread pan in cold water; pack ham mixture into it. Turn out ham loaf onto a greased shallow baking pan. Mix orange juice concentrate and honey; brush over loaf. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Brush with rest of orange juice mixture and bake 20 minutes more. Cool cover and refrigerate.

title: Jeff Davis Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter or margarine. Blend flour salt and vanilla into mixture and beat well. Add eggs then stir milk into mixture. Line two 9-inch pans with pie crust. Pour in the filling and bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for another 30 minutes or until filling is firm. (I use 1 cup whole pecans or chopped pecans in bottom of crust.)

title: Terry'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugars and eggs. Mix salt and baking soda into flour. Add to creamed mixture. Add chocolate chips. Drop by large teaspoonfuls on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes. (Remove from oven when only starting to brown cookies will be soft.) If you let them brown completely they will be hard. Please do not substitute margarine or butter for the shortening. It will change the texture. These are also great with butterscotch or peanut butter chips. Enjoy!

title: Mexican Wieners
instructions: Cut hot dogs in small chunks. Boil hot dogs until heated through. Combine hot dogs and salsa. Stir to coat. May use stove top or crock-pot. Heat until ready to use.

title: 4-Day Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix per directions on box. Let stand 15 minutes. Cut the two layers in half to make 4 layers. Dental floss works great for cutting the layers.

title: Karo-Nut Pie
instructions: Mix flour with sugar and sift. Add melted oleo 3 beaten eggs salt and Karo. Mix all together; beat well and add the pecans. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheddar Meat Loaf
instructions: In a bowl combine ground beef oatmeal onion and seasonings. Blend in eggs and milk. Add cheese; mix carefully. Shape into shallow baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yummy!

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: In medium bowl combine cream cheese sour cream chilies onion Cheddar cheese and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Spread onto tortillas sparingly. Roll up. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight. Keep tightly covered.

title: Apple 'N Cheese Casserole
instructions: Place apples in a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Cream margarine and sugar. Add the flour; mix. Press the creamed mixture into the apples. Spread and press grated cheese into the mixture in dish. Pour milk/cream on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Add one egg at a time beating after each. Add dry ingredients then fold in carrots and nuts. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool completely before frosting.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for 2 days. Will keep in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Zucchini And Rice Boats
instructions: Cut a thin slice lengthwise from zucchini; hollow out using a grapefruit knife. Chop zucchini meat. Parboil zucchini shells about 5 minutes; drain on paper towels.

title: Fresh Corn Fritters
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees. Combine the buttermilk and Tabasco. Mix well. In another bowl combine the corn meal mix flour and Essence. Stir to mix. Add corn and buttermilk mixture to the dry ingredients. Mix well. Drop from a tablespoon into hot oil and fry until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes about 2 dozen small fritters or 18 medium size fritters.

title: Baked Chicken Mexican Style
instructions: In a pie plate beat eggs and salsa. On a sheet of wax paper combine the bread crumbs and spices. Dip each chicken piece in the egg mixture and roll in crumbs then dip again in egg mixture and again in crumbs. Set aside.

title: Peach Pudding
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients then mix peaches 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup of water. Dot with butter. Pour the butter over this and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Or Pork Roast In French Dip
instructions: Wash the roast and place in a crock-pot. Mix the remaining ingredients in 2 1/2 cups water and pour over roast. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Take meat out and shred. Put meat in individual French rolls. Put the juice in soup or salad bowls; use as a dip for the sandwiches.

title: Ham And Cheese Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Spread in greased 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut into rectangles.

title: Hawaiian Sandwiches(Method:  Foil)
instructions: Start with roll. Add cheese ham pineapple ham and cheese. Wrap in foil and bake in fire.

title: Berry Patch Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix cornstarch and sugar in saucepan. Stir in the water. Bring to boil stirring and cook for 1 minute or until mixture is somewhat clear. Add blueberries and pour into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish or 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon and 1 teaspoon of oil. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Combine milk and remaining oil and add all at once to flour mix. Stir until it forms a ball (or use processor). Drop by spoonfuls into fruit. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve hot or warm with cream or ice cream.

title: Quick Texas Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and pie filling until cherries are smooth. Add the cake mix; beat well. Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes. Cook covered in boiling water just until tender about 35 minutes. Drain peel and place in a large bowl. While potatoes are still warm mash with an electric mixer. Add butter bourbon orange juice brown sugar salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Beat until smooth and fluffy. Turn mixture into a greased 2-quart casserole. (May be made ahead up to this point. Cover and chill until ready to bake.) Sprinkle nuts around the edge to make a border. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie Filling
instructions: Mix sugar salt cocoa and cornstarch or flour until well blended set aside. Heat milk just till hot add sugar mixture and bring to a boil in a heavy saucepan stirring constantly. Beat egg yolks and add about 1/2 of hot mix while stirring. Add back to hot custard in sauce pan while stirring. Heat until boils again. Stir in butter and vanilla and cool. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Anise Almond Cookies
instructions: Lightly butter cookie sheet. Mix flour baking powder butter eggs and sugar. Beat well. Add vanilla sherry and anise seed mixing well. Fold in almonds; knead and form into 2 rolls 12-inches long x 2-inches wide. Transfer rolls to prepared cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Remove and cut diagonally while still hot. Replace in oven 10 minutes to dry out. Remove and cool.

title: Peanut Butter Bars Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix 1/2 cup sugar brown sugar peanut butter oil and egg in bowl with spoon until smooth. Stir in flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Divide dough in half. Shape one half into two strips about 15 x 1 1/2-inches and about 3 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Flatten strip to 3-inches wide with fork dipped in granulated sugar. Bake for 6 to 7 minutes for soft cookies or 8 to 9 minutes for crisp cookies. Cool 2 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining half of dough.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Defrost spinach and squeeze. Mix with the rest of the ingredients and put in hollowed bread center.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: If using cake mix prepare as directed on box. Dice cake in 1/2-inch cubes. Put into a small punch trifle or just a clear bowl. Layer pineapple over cake. Mix pudding and pour over pineapple before it sets. Layer the pie filling over the pudding and top with the whipped topping. Garnish with cherries and pecans. This is also good with cherry pie filling and chocolate or vanilla pudding. Leave out the pineapple though.

title: Green Bean And Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Stir well. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Toss gently. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: Wash and cap strawberries. Place in heavy Dutch oven. Add vinegar; stir. Boil 1 minute covered. Uncover and add sugar; boil 20 minutes or more depending on type of berries. Let set until completely cool or overnight. Put into regular jars and seal. Store in freezer or process in water bath for 5 minutes. They will stay brighter in freezer.

title: Banana Cake Bread
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Add banana flour and nuts. Mix together. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour until done. Yields 12 servings.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Wash and core lettuce and tear into large bowl. Cut up celery approximately 1 to 2 cups on top of lettuce. Chop green onions on top of celery (approximately 3 bunches). Spread peas on top of green onions. Spread mayonnaise over greens (approximately 1 cup) then cheese. Add Bac*Os last. Refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Oven Cooked Chitterlings
instructions: Lay chitterlings on heavy-duty foil. On top place onion pepper and other seasonings. Wrap in foil very tightly making sure ends are tightly closed. Put 2 inches of water in a roasting pan. Put foil wrapped chitterlings in pan. Cover well; bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. Check water level in pan; if low add 2 more inches. Bake 2 hours more (total of 5 hours).

title: Gene'S Ribs
instructions: Salt and pepper ribs. Cook ribs on grill until golden brown.

title: Cooked Smoked Ham
instructions: Place all ingredients in large pot. Add water to cover ham butt. Bring to boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Let cool in water then remove slice and serve. Great hot or cold!

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add water onion tomatoes bouillon cubes and spices. Let cook until onions are almost tender. Add cabbage and beans and cook until tender.

title: Chicken Almondine
instructions: Pick chicken from bone and mix with soup and sour cream. Place in a casserole dish. Crush Ritz crackers and put on chicken mixture. Put almonds on top of crackers. Melt margarine and pour over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned and bubbly about 20 minutes.

title: Caramelized Onions
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet; saute onions until golden brown. Sprinkle on sugar and continue to saute until onions are well browned and crisp. Drain on paper towel to remove excess oil; set aside.

title: Honey Baked Chicken
instructions: Brush chicken with 1/4 cup melted oleo. Place flour and chicken in plastic bag and shake to cover chicken. Arrange in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Combine remaining oleo honey lemon juice and soy sauce in small saucepan. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour over partially cooked chicken. Bake for 30 more minutes. Baste frequently. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain off grease. Add taco seasoning and water. Simmer about 10 to 15 minutes. Put in crock-pot; cut up Velveeta cheese and add to crock-pot. Then stir in Ro-Tel sauce. Heat on low until cheese is all melted. Keep hot in crock-pot and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Hot Chili Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover with chili. Top with shredded cheeses to cover chili. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts (30 minutes). Stir before serving. Serve with Doritos.

title: Orange Nut Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add well beaten eggs and part of the flour then the milk the rest of the flour and 1/2 cup pecans. Bake in layers.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Drain and stir in salt. Spread in greased 9-inch pie plate and sprinkle with cheese. Stir milk Bisquick and eggs together with fork until blended. Pour into plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Yield 8 servings.

title: Lemon Chiffon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Sift flour sugar baking powder and 1 teaspoon salt into bowl. Make well in center. Add oil egg yolks 3/4 cup cold water vanilla and lemon rind. Beat until smooth. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff peaks form (do not underbeat). Pour egg yolk mixture gradually over egg whites; fold gently until blended. Do not overmix.

title: Hershey Pie
instructions: Melt the Hershey in double boiler. Stir in Cool Whip. Put in crust. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Layer half the cake on bottom of a deep bowl. Cover with half the prepared chocolate pudding. Cover with half of chocolate bar broken into small pieces. Next cover with one container of Cool Whip. Repeat all layers. Sprinkle chocolate on top with a cherry. Refrigerate.

title: Coffee Azuki Jello
instructions: Mix and soften gelatine in cold coffee. Add hot coffee. Stir until dissolved. Add the tsubushi an and condensed milk. Pour into 9 x 9 pan. Refrigerate until set. Cut into squares.

title: Nana'S Quick Cake
instructions: Cut angel food cake in 3 layers. Mix Cool Whip condensed milk and lemonade. Let strawberries thaw. Spread 1 layer with 1/4 Cool Whip mixture then some strawberries. Top with second layer Cool Whip and strawberries. Top with last layer and spread sides and top with Cool Whip mixture. Save any leftover strawberries and when ready to serve place on top of cake. For best results let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Braunschweiger Roll(German Liver Sausage)
instructions: Blend sausage and 1/3 of the cream cheese together add rest of ingredients. Mold into ball on foil-lined bowl put into icebox overnight. Mix rest of cream cheese and a little sour cream. Use this to frost the ball. Then roll the ball in crushed nuts or parsley. Refrigerate or freeze.

title: Raspberry Bars
instructions: Mix the flour sugar butter and chopped pecans for crumbs; set aside 1 1/2 cups. Press remaining crumbs in pan. Spread preserves to within 1 to 1 1/2 inches of pan. Top with reserved crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Pecan Goodies
instructions: Mix egg whites sugar vanilla and salt together. Stir in pecans until pecans are coated. Lay on cookie sheet. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 275\u00b0.

title: Pistachio Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and Cool Whip together. Stir until well mixed. Add pineapple juice and all marshmallows and nuts. At Christmas time put red and green cherries on top.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Combine biscuit mix sugar cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Mix egg milk oil and pumpkin. Sir into dry ingredients just until well blended. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) about 20 minutes or until done.

title: Grandma Lucy'S Baked Beans(Serves 10 To 12)
instructions: In a large heavy skillet brown bacon. Remove bacon. Add onion to grease in the pan. Saute onion until soft. Add all other ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Pour into 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Turkey Quiche(For Men!)
instructions: Layer as listed first 4 ingredients. Bring the soup and milk to boil. Add eggs slowly. Pour over layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until center is firm. Cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dad And Bobbie'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer 5 minutes. Makes 32 ounces.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Combine and heat until sugar dissolves. Pour over beans and stir gently. Refrigerate overnight if possible. Good as long as it lasts.

title: Penne Pasta Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain off fat. Cook pasta in large saucepan; drain and return to pan. Add ground beef spaghetti sauce and 1/2 parmesan cheese. Mix well and pour into ungreased 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Top with 1/4 cup parmesan cheese and 2 cups mozzarella cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Mix ground beef onion and water in a heavy pan. Mix thoroughly. Boil until mixture is cooked in fine pieces and onions are nearly done. Add pepper salt chili powder and red peppers. Let simmer until cooked nearly dry. Add tomato juice and boil until desired thickness.

title: Dessert Tonight
instructions: In a big bowl add sugar and water. Add 1 teaspoon of almond flavoring. Mix and add 10 ice cubes. Mix and serve. May want to crush ice in blender.

title: Original German Sweet Chocolate Cake
