instructions: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg yolks. Stir in vanilla and chocolate; set aside. Mix flour soda and salt. Beat in flour mixture alternately with buttermilk. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into batter. Pour batter into 3 (9-inch) layer pans lined on bottoms with waxed paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed in center. Cool 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack. Spread frosting between layers and over top of cake.

title: Missouri Steak
instructions: Cut round steak as desired. Put in pan. Slice layer of potatoes on top of steak then slice layer of onions on potatoes. Cut peppers and cover onions. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour tomato juice over enough to cover. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until tender. Yummy!

title: Texas Cowboy Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add black pepper chili powder and hot sauce to taste. Add jalapeno peppers tomatoes and beans. Let everything simmer about 15 minutes then add cheese. It will take about 15 minutes to melt if its cut into pieces. Serve with hard rolls.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown round steak (cut in 1-inch cubes) in 2 tablespoons oil. Add next 9 ingredients. Add 2 cups hot water and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Add vegetables. Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Paprikash
instructions: Cut skinless and boneless breasts into cubes. Dice onions and saute in 1 stick oleo. Then add paprika to onions and mix until all are an orange color. Add chicken and salt and pepper to taste. Then add enough chicken broth to just cover the chicken. Add 4 bouillon cubes. Let simmer about 30 or 40 minutes. Stir occasionally. When chicken is done add the sour cream and stir slowly. Let simmer for 5 more minutes. Cook packaged dumplings in salted water. Add to chicken and blend. At this time also stir in another 1/2 stick oleo.

title: Chicken El Rancho
instructions: Dip chicken breasts into a bowl of Ranch dressing; coat generously. Then dip the chicken in bread crumbs. Place on a cookie sheet (or other cooking pan of your choice) and bake for 30 to 40 minutes depending on breast size. Its quick its easy and it tastes great! Serves 4.

title: Ground Meat Casserole - T.V. Channel 40
instructions: Brown meat onion and pepper together. Add tomato paste and corn. Mix with Kraft dinner. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until hot.

title: Fiesta Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and garlic lightly in salad oil in a large skillet; push to one side. Brown beef in same skillet. Stir in tomatoes beans chili salt hot sauce and chili powder; heat to boiling. Line pan with part of the tortillas. Cover with about 1/3 of the sauce. Continue to layer tortillas and sauce until used up. Cover with cheese. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serve bubbling hot.

title: Zucchini Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour cinnamon and salt. Add other ingredients with nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Peel potatoes and cut lengthwise in small strips. Dry with paper towels and place on cookie sheets that have been sprayed with Pam; do not overlap. Spray tops of potatoes. Bake potato strips for 1 hour turning at 15 minute intervals. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Bacon
instructions: Trim the bottoms of the Brussels sprouts and pull off any withered leaves. Cook them in boiling salted water until tender about 10 minutes; drain. Cut the bacon into 1-inch pieces and fry until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat from the pan. Add the vinegar to the pan and cook 1 minute over medium-high heat scraping up the browned bits in the bottom of the pan. Add the Brussels sprouts and toss until warm. Sprinkle with bacon.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Store all ingredients dry in airtight container. To serve place 1 1/2 tablespoons mix in cup and add 1 cup boiling water. Stir and enjoy. Makes 50 servings.

title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Saute sliced mushrooms in butter. Fry bacon until crisp remove from pan and set aside. In bacon drippings brown beef cubes well (almost burnt). Blend in flour. Add sugar salt thyme bay leaf peppercorns stock and wine. (If you dont like wine substitute more stock.) Cook for 1 hour. Add onions. Cook 1 hour more adding wine or stock as needed and checking salt and pepper.

title: Chicken With Sundried Tomatoes And Pasta
instructions: Cook the bow tie pasta and set aside. Mince the garlic and saute in the olive oil. Cut the chicken breasts into chunks and add to the sauteed garlic. Cook until the chicken is white and push to the side of the pan. Add the broccoli and cook for a couple of minutes. Add the sundried tomatoes seasonings wine chicken broth and butter. Simmer for about five minutes. Mix this with the cooked pasta and toss with some grated cheese to taste. Serve warm.

title: Rotel
instructions: Melt together. Serve warm with nachos or veggies. (Can freeze.)

title: Carrousel Salad Bowl
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on box. While still hot drizzle with oil and vinegar. Add onion salt pepper and cheese. Toss well. Gently mix in peas ham celery and mayonnaise. Chill thoroughly. Serve on salad greens.

title: Snow Cream
instructions: Puncture the eyes and drain off liquid. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about an hour. Hit the coconut with a hammer and it will split right open.

title: Sandy'S Shrimp Creole
instructions: Peel devein and wash shrimp. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and green pepper. Saute until soft; stir in garlic. Remove from heat; blend in flour until smooth. Add tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes. Gradually add water stirring to blend. Add shrimp and all remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer about 40 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl mix together apples celery nuts and grapes. Coat with mayonnaise. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Frozen Waldorf Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Set pineapple aside.

title: Waffles
instructions: Place egg whites in small bowl and beat at speed 2 for two minutes or until moist peak forms. Sift flour baking powder salt and sugar into large bowl then add the egg yolks milk and shortening or veg. oil. Mix at speed 1 for one minute. Add the beaten egg whites and mix at speed 1 for one-half minute. Bake on hot waffle iron until golden brown.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix hamburger and sausage together. Mix this mixture with the bread crumbs. Mix eggs milk half of the ketchup pepper salt celery seed garlic salt bell pepper and onion all together. Mix the 2 mixtures together. Add the milk to the meat mixture; mix well. Cook for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add oil sugar zucchini and pineapple; mix lightly but well. Add flour salt and baking powder. Mix until blended. Add nuts and raisins. Pour into greased bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Mexican Tamales
instructions: In serving dish (9 x 13-inch) place tamales (with wax paper wrappers removed) kidney beans chili and black olives. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. During the last 15 minutes put Doritos slightly crushed and Cheddar cheese on top of casserole.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and orange. Mix remaining ingredients. Add ground cranberries and orange. Refrigerate.

title: Sweet N' Sour Chicken
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cover with foil then add pineapple rings and green pepper rings and bake 1/2 hour uncovered.

title: Mary'S Best Pecan Pie
instructions: Make 9-inch pie crust and chill. Mix all ingredients together. Beat on Number 4 speed until well blended 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Pour into chilled pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes then reduce to 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Peel apples; cut in 1/8-inch slices. Arrange on crust. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Sift 1/2 cup sugar with flour; cut butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Cheese Squares
instructions: Grease a 12 inch x 15 inch pan. Mix cheese and spread 1/2 mixture into pan. Spread chopped pepper over first layer of cheese. Spread remaining cheese on top. Mix beaten eggs with milk and pour over second layer of cheese.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cut into 1 inch squares.

title: Sausage And Rice
instructions: Brown sausage onion and peppers; strain grease and add rice. Simmer on low heat.

title: Texas Ranger Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In mixing bowl cream sugars shortening egg and vanilla. In separate bowl sift together flour baking powder salt and baking soda. Add sugar to mixture and blend thoroughly. Stir in optional ingredients. On greased cookie sheet drop a teaspoon of dough at a time. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until cookies are set but not hard. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Yum Yum Relish
instructions: Chop the cabbage tomatoes onions peppers and salt down overnight. (Cover with water and 1 cup salt.) Drain next morning and pour boiling water over to cover. Drain well. Mix vinegar brown sugar mustard mustard seed ginger cinnamon and turmeric. Mix well and add vegetables. Boil until thickened about 45 to 50 minutes. Seal in jars.

title: Chicken Stock
instructions: Remove skin and cut chicken into pieces. In deep pot cover chicken with water. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer for 2 hours. Strain reserving chicken and vegetables. May be frozen. Serving size 1 cup.

title: Herbed Beef Kabobs
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients in a saucepan. Heat to boiling point and cool. Cut meat into 1 1/2-inch cubes and add to the mixture in a Ziploc bag along with pepper squares mushrooms and quartered onions. Mix well. Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Hamburger Bean And Bun Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Mix ground beef beans brown sugar and sauce. Pour into a casserole dish. Cut biscuits in half and set cut side down around edge of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until biscuits are brown.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Arrange boneless chicken in 11 x 7-inch baking dish and place a piece of cheese over each. Stir together soup and wine. Pour over chicken and cheese; sprinkle with stuffing on top and drizzle melted butter over all. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until chicken is tender. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Frozen Raspberry Mousse
instructions: Whip all ingredients in blender. Freeze overnight in ring mold. Unmold on round plate. Garnish with leaves and serve drenched with Chambord (raspberry liqueur) if desired. Serves 6.

title: Easy Pesto Sauce
instructions: Put basil and parsley in blender. Blend with 1/4 cup olive oil at low speed. Add cheese and remaining oil and blend. Add nuts blending until chopped. Use over spaghetti or in soups or vegetables.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix brown sugar corn syrup margarine and salt in a 4-quart pan. Bring to a boil; boil 5 minutes and remove from heat. Add vanilla and soda (this will swell). Pour on the popcorn; stir. Place in 225\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Cool. Store in covered container to keep crisp.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Leave cheese out to soften. Dice chipped beef and mix with parsley flakes then divide in half. Add rest of ingredients to 1/2 of the beef mixture. Mix well and form into a ball. Refrigerate to make manageable. Then roll ball into other half of beef mixture. Refrigerate. If you want to make a spread just add all ingredients together.

title: Pineapple-Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together pineapple milk pecans and lemon juice. Fold in Cool Whip. Divide between two crusts. Refrigerate before serving. Simple and delicious!!!

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pour in 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let cool 4 hours or more.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy skillet. Add brown sugar and stir until golden brown. Beat together egg yolks and cornstarch; add to milk. Add milk mixture to skillet and stir until thickened. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven until meringue is brown.

title: Fluffy French Toast
instructions: Beat flour sugar salt milk and eggs until smooth. Soak bread in batter until saturated. Cook in butter 12 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in oil. Add chicken corn broth and salsa. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice and cover. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Sprinkle with cheese and let stand for 2 minutes. Put in flat dish to melt cheese in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Eggplant
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1 1/2-inch slices. Dip each slice into egg then into crumbs and saute on both sides. Put half the slices into casserole dish. Top with half the cheese. Add remaining eggplant. Mix spaghetti sauce and water. Pour over eggplant. Add remaining slices over top; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Beef And Cabbage Taco Casserole - Fantastic!!
instructions: Brown ground beef drain and set aside. In the same beef skillet stir-fry the shredded cabbage over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in ground beef. Add green chili peppers taco sauce pepper and onion salt. Mix well. Mound into partially baked potato crust and bake for 20 minutes. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and bake for 2 to 3 minutes more or until cheese is melted. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serve with taco sauce.

title: Pecan Sandies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter or margarine sugar and vanilla for 3-4 minutes. Stir in flour and pecans just until blended. Roll into 1 inch balls. Bake on ungreased baking sheet for 20 minutes or until lightly brown around edges. Let cool and sprinkle on powdered sugar.

title: Crunchy Almond Chicken
instructions: Place almonds garlic and ginger root in a blender container. Cover and blend until finely ground. Mix almond mixture salt paprika cumin and pepper. Dip chicken into margarine then roll in almond mixture. Place chicken skin side up in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong pan. Cook uncovered in 375\u00b0 oven until thickest pieces are done 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid water and sugar. Add lemonade pineapple and strawberries. Mix well. When ready to serve pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale.

title: Fudge
instructions: Scald milk; add chocolate until melted. Put in sugar and syrup. Bring to boil. Remove from heat. Add rest of ingredients. Stir. Grease a 9 x 9-inch pan. Cool for 5 to 10 minutes. Stir until dull sheen. Pour in pan.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: While cake is still hot poke holes down in cake with wooden spoon. Drain pineapple and spread on top of cake. Cook pudding; pour over cake. It will be runny. When cake and toppings cool spread Cool Whip on top.

title: Spaghetti Meat Sauce
instructions: Brown ground meat and onions. Add mushroom slices tomato sauce tomato paste and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Quick And Creamy Salad
instructions: Pour powdered jello over cottage cheese and mix. Drain oranges and pineapple; stir in. Add Cool Whip and stir.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
instructions: Mix peanuts into melted chocolate chips and drop with a spoon on waxed-lined cookie sheets.

title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except cheese) and bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat cover and let stand 10 minutes tossing with fork 2 to 3 times. Place a layer of cooked mixture in a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Add a layer of cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Lite Fruit Salad
instructions: Reserve all juice but orange juice and mix it with pudding then mix with other ingredients and chill.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil 2 cups diced zucchini for 5 minutes in salt water drain well. Add all the above ingredients; mix together in a casserole dish. Mix well. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Pour in greased dish (Corelle Pyrex). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water and cool. When Jell-O is cool add fruit and let set up.

title: Chocolate Swirl Cheese Cake
instructions: Crust In cereal bowl use fork to cut butter into crackers. Stir in 2 teaspoons sugar. Transfer mixture to 16 ounce casserole. Press mixture against bottom and 1 1/2-inches up the side to form crust. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Quick Lasagne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Mix Ricotta and cottage cheese with parsley and garlic. Pour 1 cup of sauce into bottom of pan. Arrange 1/3 of noodles in pan touching but not overlapping. Spread 1/2 of cheese mixture over noodles; top with 1/2 of Mozzarella. Repeat layers starting again with sauce. Top final layer should be noodles. Cover with remaining sauce and Parmesan cheese. Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 hour.

title: Kathy'S Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Bake in greased tube pan in a 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Put sugar and milk in pan. Boil until it forms soft ball in cold water. Remove from fire and when it begins to cool add salt vanilla and peanut butter. Beat until it is creamy and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut into squares.

title: Icebox Fruitcake(Uncooked)
instructions: Melt butter or margarine and marshmallows. Mix all other ingredients in a very large bowl. Pour melted mixture over these other ingredients. Mix well; will have to use hands. Divide into 3 portions and shape each portion into a round log. Wrap in waxed paper and store in the refrigerator in Pringle potato chip cans. (You do not need to chop the fruit and nuts because when you slice it they will be chopped!)

title: Diabetic Spice Cookie
instructions: Boil water shortening raisins dates nutmeg and cinnamon for 3 minutes. Let cool. Then beat in eggs; dissolve salt soda and sweetener in the 2 tablespoons of water. Then add egg mixture. Drop by teaspoon on a cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes or until done.

title: Zucchini Bake
instructions: Fry hamburger peppers and onion until veggies are tender; add tomato zucchini and the spaghetti into large baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour; add cheese on top.

title: Mexican Fiesta Casserole
instructions: Grease a 10 x 14-inch casserole dish. Line bottom with 6 tortillas. Brown beef with chopped onion and garlic; season with chili powder pepper and salt. Mix beans and 1/2 cup water; stir into meat mixture. Pour 1/2 of mixture over tortillas. Cover with grated cheese. Add 6 more tortillas and the rest of the meat. Mix tomatoes and soup with 1/2 can water; spread over casserole. Bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Let set 5 to 10 minutes after removing from the oven. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Slice yellow cake up and put in a punch bowl. Pour a can of crushed pineapple over cake. Add pudding. Next add cherry pie filling. Top with Cool Whip and grated Hershey chocolate bar.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Let simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Houligan Pancakes
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan in oven. Mix flour milk and eggs; pour over melted butter. Bake 25 minutes at 425\u00b0. Serve with syrup or fruit. Can be increased many times. Recipe calls for salt; dont add salt.

title: Honey Scones
instructions: Stir together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in butter with pastry blender until fine crumbs form. With fork blend milk 2 tablespoons honey and egg. Turn all at once into flour. Turn out on floured board and knead a few strokes until dough holds together.

title: Polvorones
instructions: Cream oleo and shortening. Add vanilla and almond extract. Mix in sugar flour and pecans. Chill mixture for 1 hour. Roll into 1 inch balls and then roll out into crescents. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. They should brown only slightly. Remove from cookie sheet after cooling and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Homemade Silly Putty
instructions: Mix glue and starch well. Let the mixture dry a bit to make it workable. It may be necessary to add a little more glue or starch. This may not work well on a humid day. Store in an airtight container. Avoid contact with good clothing or carpet.

title: Rice Krispies Sweets
instructions: Cook brown sugar egg dates or raisins and salt in frying pan for 6 minutes. Keep stirring. When cool add 2 cups of Rice Krispies. Form into balls; roll in chopped nuts.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and cheese. Add eggs well beaten. Alternate mixing into mixture the milk and flour. Add vanilla; mix well. Pour into cake baking pan (greased and floured). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Play Dough
instructions: You need an aluminum saucepan.

title: Golden Mediterranean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Add salad dressing and toss.

title: Rock Candy
instructions: In a heavy saucepan combine sugar syrup and water and bring to boil. Remove from heat and add 2 to 3 teaspoons of cinnamon oil and red food coloring. Pour on aluminum foil-lined cookie sheet and allow to harden. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and break into pieces.

title: Barbecued Crock-Pot Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well; place in crock-pot. Place fryer parts in crock-pot and stir into sauce well. Cook on low overnight. Chicken will be tasty and tender.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Rinse mushrooms well in cold water. Drain. Put in tightly covered container. Add the dressing and shake well. Refrigerate overnight. Every once in a while shake the container to mix. Good and easy.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onions and garlic until vegetables are tender. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Bring to a boil then simmer 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. In a 2-quart casserole layer 1/2 meat 1 cup cheese and 1 cup chips. Top with last 1/2 meat and chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and bake 5 minutes more. Makes 4 servings. Preparation time 15 minutes.

title: Orange Roughy
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Dip fillets. Place in single layer skin side down on well-greased shallow pan. Combine potato chips and cheese. Sprinkle on fillets. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Crab Stew
instructions: Add 1 cup flour in enough oil to brown for roux. Brown to a very dark color. Add onions celery bell pepper garlic tomato paste and season to taste. Add water while cooking (enough to make a gravy about medium). Simmer for 30 minutes. Add crab bodies and simmer another 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: Combine the margarine brown sugar flour and nuts with a pastry blender. Remove one cupful to use for topping. Press remainder into buttered 8 x 8 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. To make filling beat the cream cheese sugar egg milk lemon juice and vanilla until smooth. Turn onto baked crust. Top with crumb topping. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Cool thoroughly.

title: Fruit Party Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Slice cookie dough about 1/4-inch thick. Place in circles in 10-inch pizza pan. Overlap slices slightly. Press dough together with fingers to form crust. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven but leave oven on.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese 'N Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions for 3 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile in large bowl combine cheeses spinach and eggs. Combine cooked noodles with 2 1/2 cups sauce; place half in a 3-quart casserole. Top noodle mixture with cheese mixture then remaining noodles and sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix taco dip and cream cheese with mixer in lg. bowl. Spread into a cake pan. Top with grated lettuce tomatoes cheese and (olives). Serve with Tortilla chips.

title: Rice And Spinach
instructions: Saute onions in olive oil or butter; add spinach that has been cooked until wilted rice pepper salt dill weed and water. Simmer for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Chicken In A Crock-Pot
instructions: Put carrots and onions in bottom of crock-pot. Add whole chicken. Top with salt and pepper and liquid. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours using 1 cup of water.

title: Bacon Coleslaw
instructions: Mix dressing and sugar in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Refrigerate. Serves 8.

title: Hamburger Gravy
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add enough flour to coat ground beef. You may add small amount of butter if needed. Mix well. Add peas. Slowly add enough milk to make gravy. I put this on toast.

title: Barbecued Hamburger
instructions: Combine crumbs milk and beef. Shape into patties. Brown in fat. Combine rest of ingredients and pour over patties. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes. Garnish with onion rings. Skillet or electric frypan works great!

title: Shrimp-Crab Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients top with cracker crumbs and bake 30 minutes at 350.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cream potatoes eggs sugar and condensed milk together well. Fold in nuts coconut raisins and corn flakes. Garnish with coconut; bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or according to the thickness of casserole.

title: Date-Nut-Bumps
instructions: Mix up ingredients for dough first then mix in dates and nuts. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto baking sheets. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Boil 3 minutes. Stir constantly. Remove from heat and beat until ready to spread. You may add 1 teaspoon of vanilla or butter flavoring.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape dough into small mounds. Bake 25 minutes at 300\u00b0. Roll in powdered sugar while hot.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans; set aside. Combine flour and the next 5 ingredients; set aside. In large mixing bowl beat sugar and oil. Add eggs water and pumpkin; beat well. Gradually add dry ingredients; stir just until blended. Stir in nuts and raisins (optional). Pour batter into greased loaf pans. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from oven to wire rack. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans. Let cool completely on wire racks.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into 6 pieces. Combine the sugar cinnamon and pecans or raisins; shake in a bag. Put 1/2 of the biscuits in a Bundt pan; sprinkle with 1/2 of the sugar and cinnamon. Do the same with the rest of the biscuits using all the sugar and cinnamon. Boil the butter and brown sugar for 1 minute; pour over cake. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Pig In The Blanket
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. First you get the rolling pin and the dough then you flatten the dough. Next you get the cheese; place on the dough. Place the wiener on the cheese. Roll the dough up. Cook the Pigs In The Blankets until golden brown. Remove from oven and butter.

title: Grits-Sausage Casserole
instructions: Bring salted water to a boil. Stir in grits. Reduce heat and cook for 4 minutes. Add cheese to grits stirring until cheese is melted. Combine eggs milk thyme and garlic. Add some of the hot grits to egg mixture stirring to blend. Stir egg mixture into remaining grits. Add cooked sausage. Pour into a buttered 8 x 12-inch dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Tuna Ball
instructions: Form all ingredients into a ball and roll in chopped pecans. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Nancy'S Nachos
instructions: Fry ground beef until browned; drain excess fat. Add chili seasoning and water according to package directions. Saute for approximately 5 minutes. Add tomato sauce and cook until meat looks \saucy\. Set aside. Line a plate with chips layer with meat onions green peppers lettuce tomatoes and picante sauce. Top with cheese jalapeno peppers black olives and sour cream. (Prepare enough chopped vegetables for 6 plates.)

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes in enough water to barely cover with bouillon cube. Cook until almost done. Add sour cream onions bacon and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. I prefer to add the onions and bacon after Ive put the soup in mugs.

title: Calypso Pie
instructions: Mix cookies with melted butter and put in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Mix coffee with boiling water and stir into ice cream. Spread over cookies and refreeze.

title: Navajo Tacos
instructions: Mix together. Try to mix in one direction like folding in. Raise in warm place for half an hour. Pinch off pieces of dough about the size of an egg. Pat and stretch into a circle about 8 inches across. Fry in about an inch of hot shortening in a frypan. Turn and brown the second side. Drain on a paper towel.

title: Sweet Potato And Apricot
instructions: Place cooked sweet potato halves into buttered baking dish. Combine brown sugar cornstarch cinnamon salt and orange peel in saucepan. Drain apricot juice into cornstarch mixture. Cook and stir over medium heat until boiling. Boil 2 minutes. Add apricots butter and pecans; pour over sweet potatoes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cool Mint Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell according to directions on package. Melt chocolate bars and spread into bottom of baked pie crust. Mix cream cheese white chocolate pudding and milk together in mixing bowl. Add 1/2 of Cool Whip. Then add mint flavor and food color until desired color. Pour over chocolate in pie shell. Top with remainder of Cool Whip. Chill for 30 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix well the pretzels sugar and melted butter. Place in a large Pyrex dish and bake for 6 minutes at 400\u00b0. Let cool. Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and sugar and spread on pretzel mixture. Mix jello with boiling water and let dissolve. Add strawberries. Let set until soft jell then pour on top of creamed mixture. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into small bite size pieces. Place in any container. Layer the rest of ingredients.

title: Canned Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Pour into water. Slowly bring to a boil. Pour over apples. Put in jars. Pressure at 5 pounds pressure 3 minutes or according to apple toughness.

title: Chocolate Macaroons
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Saute onion celery and carrots in butter. Simmer. Add other ingredients. Cut chicken into approximately 1-inch cubes and brown in butter or peanut oil. After all is cooked may want to thicken with cornstarch. I use my wok for this dish.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain and reserve liquid from oranges and pineapple. Mix all fruits and pecans in a large bowl and toss in separate bowl combine pudding mix and Tang with reserved fruit juices. Whip to make a thick sauce. Pour over fruit and allow to set overnight. (Whole frozen strawberries can be used but wait until just before serving to add them.)

title: Christmas Sparkle Punch
instructions: In bowl press strawberries through a sieve. Stir lime or lemon juice into pulp. Cover and chill. Place strawberry pulp into a large punch bowl. Carefully pour pop and grape juice over pulp stirring with an up and down motion. When serving garnish with lemon or lime slices.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Mix jello by directions on box. Place in refrigerator and let thicken but not gel. Mix strawberries sugar salt and pecans together by hand. Place in refrigerator and let chill. Tear cake into small pieces. When gelatin is thick mix in half of the Cool Whip. Add strawberry mixture and mix well. Place a layer of cake in large serving bowl. Spoon a layer of gelatin mixture alternate ending with jello on top. Spread the remaining Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with coconut. Refrigerate.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Combine ingredients in large saucepan. Simmer until onions are cooked. Serve with garlic bread apple slices and cheese cubes on the side. Makes 7 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Salsa
instructions: Put tomatoes peppers onions and garlic in food processor. (Remove skins from tomatoes; also remove seeds from peppers for milder salsa.) Add sugar salt and vinegar. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Put in jars. Heat lids before putting on jars.

title: Vegetarian Delight
instructions: In small bowl mix the peanut butter soy sauce 1 tablespoon water and honey; blend and set aside. In large skillet or wok heat oil over medium-high heat. Add carrots and onion; stir until onion is translucent 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except rice. Cook until vegetables are tender about 3 minutes. Add peanut butter mixture; cook until boiling 2 minutes. Stir in rice; cook until heated through. Arrange cashews on top.

title: Vegetable Yummies
instructions: Cut washed celery into 3 or 4-inch lengths. Fill ridges with choice of spreads above.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix cookie mix according to directions on box. Bake in greased pizza pan at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla and spread over cooled crust. Arrange fruit over that. Mix 2/3 cup sugar cornstarch orange juice and salt. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Reduce heat and continue cooking for 5 minutes and pour over fruit. Refrigerate. You can also use grapes cut and drained pineapple or blueberries!

title: Honey Glazed Chicken
instructions: Put all ingredients in saucepan (except chicken) and heat just to boiling. Pour over cut up fryer in flat baking dish. Let stand 1 hour. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes or until tender.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Pound chicken breast with mallet until 1/8 inch thick. Salt pepper and parsley to taste. On each breast place one slice of cheese and one slice of ham (or bacon). Roll up jelly roll fashion and secure with toothpick. Brown chicken roll ups in oil or butter until golden brown. Thin condensed soup with milk and pour over breast. Bring to boil over medium heat then simmer covered for 25 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cushaw
instructions: Wash cushaw well; remove seeds; cut into quarters. Put cushaw in a kettle filling half full with water. Add sugar on top of cushaw. Cook down until it becomes brown on the bottom.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Slice about 2 quarts cucumbers in bowl. Salt very heavily and let stand for 4 hours. Rinse in clear water then pour boiling water to cover. Let stand until cool enough to stand your hand in water. Drain until dry. Mix equal cups of sugar and vinegar; for instance 1 cup sugar for 1 cup vinegar. For one quart use 1 tablespoon pickling spice. For 1 pint use 1 teaspoon. Soaking cucumbers in a salt brine makes them crisp. Use 1 cup salt to 2 quarts water.

title: Southern Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Saute onion in butter. In large heavy pot add all ingredients except rice. Bring to boil stir in rice reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Gold Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and add the sugar gradually. Beat the eggs until thick and add to the butter mixture. Sift all dry ingredients and add alternately with the milk and vanilla. Bake in three 7-inch square layer pans. Moderate oven to 360\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: St. Paul'S Rice
instructions: Brown sausage slowly in a large skillet pouring off the grease as it accumulates. Bring 4 1/2 cups water to a boil. Add rice and soup mix. Boil 9 minutes. Remove from heat but do not drain. Mix browned sausage rice mixture green pepper onion and celery. Put into a large greased casserole and sprinkle paprika parsley and slivered almonds over the top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a saucepan combine milk margarine and brown sugar. Bring to a rolling boil for 4 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter vanilla and powdered sugar. Blend well and quickly until smooth with wooden spoon. This will be thick. Pat down smoothly into buttered oblong glass dish. Sets up immediately as it cools. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Opal'S Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Melt butter. In separate pan mix sugar flour and cocoa. Pour into butter. Stir well. Add eggs one at a time. Stir well after each one. Add milk and vanilla. Pour into deep-dish unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Rosy Spring Salad
instructions: Combine rhubarb water and sugar in a saucepan. Cook until tender. Pour this over gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Add orange juice and rind. Chill until syrupy. Add strawberries. Pour into an oiled container (6-cup mold). Chill until set. Makes 8 servings.

title: Wild Rice Patties
instructions: Make rice as directed on package. Mix all ingredients and fry in large frying pan. Serve plain or smothered in favorite sauce.

title: Cranberry Smoothie
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sour cream and cranberry sauce. Blend well. Pour in mold.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Mix 1 cup Coca-Cola margarine cocoa and salad oil in saucepan; bring to a boil. Reserve remaining Coca-Cola for icing. Add marshmallows. Stir until melted. Sift flour and sugar together. Pour cocoa mixture over flour mixture. Blend in buttermilk eggs and vanilla well. Do not use a mixer. Pour into a 12 x 8-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Yield 24 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Roast
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on low for 12 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add salt and pepper. Cook noodles drain. Add tomato soup ground beef and noodles together in a casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

title: Peanut Butter Frosting
instructions: Mix peanut butter butter and vanilla. Stir in powdered sugar cocoa and salt. Add milk stirring until you reach desired spreading consistency. Use on favorite cake.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Cook Ro-Tel and cream of mushroom soup together. Layer bottom of casserole dish with Doritos. Pour chicken Ro-Tel and soup in dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese has melted.

title: Mountain Mama Mud Slide Cake
instructions: In medium bowl combine butter flour and pecans; mix well. Put in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0; cool. In medium bowl mix cream cheese and sugar until fluffy then fold in 1 cup whipped cream. spread over baked crust.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and drain. Add taco seasoning and stir well. Layer 1/2 of the chips in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Then layer next ingredients in order hamburger meat beans soup tomatoes chips and cheese. Bake for 20 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken-Cabbage Stir-Fry
instructions: Marinate chicken in teriyaki sauce 30 minutes at room temperature. In wok combine sherry vinegar 1 tablespoon oil and ginger root. Add cabbage and bring to boiling. Reduce heat. Cook covered for 4 minutes. Add broccoli and apples. Cook covered 3 minutes more. Remove cabbage. Discard liquid in wok. Drain chicken. Heat remaining oil and stir-fry chicken 3 to 4 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix the last 9 ingredients together; stir until there are no lumps in the batter. Put thawed wings in batter and marinate overnight. Stir several times. Before deep frying stir again then fry until golden brown. Serve hot or cold. Serves 15 to 20 people.

title: French Onion Soup With Garlic Toast
instructions: Cut onions in half and cut into thin slices. Brown in Dutch oven with olive oil. Fill pot with onions and water. Simmer for 3 hours. Salt and pepper to taste. Add bouillon cubes if desired.

title: Tree Soup - Lo-Cal Low Cholesterol
instructions: Mix all together in large pot. Cook until tender.

title: Praline Bars
instructions: Line a large cookie sheet with graham crackers. In a saucepan put sugar and butter or margarine. Bring to a boil and boil only 2 minutes. Add nuts. Pour over crackers and spread evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill. Serve with chips crackers or bread cubes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Combine butter sugar and peanut butter and roll into balls. Dip in melted chocolate. Place on wax paper.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix together meat soup milk chopped onion and cheese. Layer in casserole with cooked macaroni. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chuck'S Chile Con Carne
instructions: Cook ground beef onion and garlic in 3-quart saucepan stirring occasionally until beef is brown; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except beans. Break up tomatoes. Heat to boiling reduce heat cover and simmer 1 hour stirring occasionally. Stir in beans. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered about 20 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Contains 415 calories per serving.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put sugar and cornstarch mixture in jello. Cook until thick. Let cool. Add 1 cup strawberries. Put into graham cracker crust. Let chill. Then put Cool Whip and 1 cup strawberries on top.

title: Cheese Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed on box omitting seasoning. Drain. Add 1 stick margarine and cut up cheese. Stir and pour in casserole dish. Crush crackers. Add softened margarine and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Mystery Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff; add 1/2 cup sugar gradually while continuing to beat. Roll or blend crackers to very fine crumbs and mix in along with 1/2 cup sugar and fold in nuts. Fold this into egg mixture and add vanilla. Pour into well-greased pie plate (9-inch) and bake 30 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven. When done set for 4 hours then top with whipped cream with pineapple mixed in. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Make Ahead Lasagna
instructions: Place 1 cup of spaghetti sauce in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer noodles ground beef cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese and remaining spaghetti sauce (ending with spaghetti sauce). Top with Parmesan cheese. Pour water around edges. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. Remove foil and bake 15 more minutes uncovered. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. May be made ahead and refrigerated overnight before baking.

title: Hot Sausage Bites
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease baking sheets. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl mixing well. Shape into small balls and place on baking sheets. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve while hot. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes approximately 3 dozen.

title: 14 Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda salt and cinnamon. Add sugar oil and eggs and mix well. Add carrots drained pineapple coconut and nuts.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Mix and put into boiler. Stir while cooking on low heat. Flavor with lemon rind and juice or lemon flavoring. Bring to a boil on low heat. Serve warm on plain vanilla or lemon cake.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Boil shells and let cool. Cook hamburger and onion over low heat until meat is brown. Drain. Pour sauce over mixture and simmer for 10 minutes. Grate cheeses. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan spread 1 cup of sauce. Stuff shells with the cheeses. Arrange in single layer in pan. Spoon remaining sauce over shells. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake with foil covering for 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6 people.

title: Benne Wafers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place the benne (sesame) seeds on an ungreased baking sheet and toast for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown. Watch close so that they dont burn. In a large bowl mix the brown sugar melted butter or margarine egg vanilla extract flour salt baking powder and toasted sesame seeds together until combined. Drop dough by 1/2 teaspoonfuls 1 1/2 inches apart onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 4 to 6 minutes until light brown. Let cookies cool for about 2 minutes before removing from baking sheets to a wire rack to cool completely. Store cooled cookies in an airtight container.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Cook noodles as box directions suggest. Brown hamburger and onion; drain grease. Mix all remaining ingredients and place in large baking dish. Cook for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. Add cheese and melt.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Heat allspice in water. Strain. Squeeze lemons and add with spices to tea. Strain and strain again for clearness. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk butter salt and grated chocolate. Cover until boiling point is reached. Boil to a soft ball stage. Add flavoring and cool. Beat until mixture is creamy thick. Pour into well buttered pan and cut in squares.

title: Mound Candy
instructions: Melt Eagle Brand milk and oleo in double boiler. Pour over next mixture of powdered sugar coconut and nuts. Put in greased pan and leave in refrigerator overnight. Take out and cut into small pieces; dip in next mixture of chocolate chips and paraffin and put on wax paper. Makes about 70 pieces.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In a large bowl stir eggs syrup sugar oleo and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Chinese Meatballs
instructions: Blend together ground beef salt pepper and ginger. Shape into 1-inch meatballs. Heat oil in wok or skillet; brown meatballs on all sides about 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Cook over moderate heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Cook 5 minutes. Serve at once with rice. Yields 4 servings.

title: Cranberry Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients together. In a separate bowl combine flour baking soda salt and spices. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and pour the pumpkin mixture in. Mix together only until the dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in cranberries and nuts. Pour into 2 or 3 medium size loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes.

title: White Chocolate Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat softened cream cheese with 1/2 cup of milk. Add 1 1/2 cups milk. Add pudding and Cool Whip. Beat well. Makes 2 pies.

title: Buttermilk Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pecan Rolls
instructions: Scald the milk. Add the shortening and sugar. Stir until dissolved then add the cold water. Crumble in the yeast stirring until dissolved. Add the egg and flour; knead to get rid of stickiness. Roll into rectangle. Add filling.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes until done. Put in baking dish and mix in all other ingredients. Top with 1 cup cornflakes and 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in order. Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 15 minutes. Will not turn golden brown. Do not overbake.

title: Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the 1/4 cup warm water. Heat 1 cup water honey and butter until it is warm. Pour into the dissolved yeast in bowl. Add salt and egg; mix well. Add flour and work into a dough. Let rise until doubled form into a loaf put in bread pan and let rise again. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes putting foil over it for last 10 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put into a 2-1/2 quart casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Will turn golden brown on top.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease bottom only of 13 x 9-inch pan. Remove 1/2 cup dry cake mix; reserve. Beat remaining dry cake mix butter eggs and sour cream in large bowl on medium speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Spread half of the batter in pan. Stir together reserved dry cake mix brown sugar pecans and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter in pan. Carefully spread remaining batter evenly over pecan mixture. (To make spreading easier drop batter by dollops over pecan mixture then spread.) Bake 30 to 33 minutes or until deep golden brown and cake springs back when touched lightly in center. Stir powdered sugar milk and vanilla until thin enough to drizzle stirring in additional milk 1 teaspoon at a time if necessary. Poke top of warm cake several times with fork; spread glaze over top of cake. Cool completely about 1 hour. Store covered.

title: Seafood Cocktail Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill two hours. Makes about 2 1/2 cups of dip.

title: Chicken Stew
instructions: Cover bottom of skillet with cooking oil. Make a roux by adding flour and browning. Saute onion and bell pepper in roux.

title: Icebox Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; pour into prepared graham cracker pie crust. Let sit in refrigerator overnight.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Beat 5 minutes. Pour into ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Mix a small amount of sugar at a time using drops of cream as needed to moisten. Add butter and vanilla. Shape into balls around cherries and dip into melted mixture of chocolate chips and paraffin. Let cool and enjoy.

title: Treet Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Onions can be added. May be used as sandwich spread or served on lettuce with crackers.

title: Butterscotch Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and set aside. Combine the remaining ingredients in large mixing bowl and beat 2 minutes. Pour 1/3 batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan then 1/3 brown sugar mix then another layer of first mixture etc. ending with last of brown sugar and nut mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix remaining ingredients well. Pour over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Put hot potatoes through ricer to remove lumps then beat in butter. Put potatoes in mixing bowl and beat in sugar. Add cocoa and beat throughly. Mix in vanilla salt and coconut. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. Place in refrigerator to harden candy. Keep in tightly closed container.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: In a 9x13 inch dish place a layer of sliced potatoes. Then add a layer of sliced onions. Make as many layers as you wish. Lay pork chops on top of potatoes and onions. Spread can of cream of chicken soup no water added on top of the pork chops. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Danish
instructions: Combine cheese egg yolks 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in bowl. Mix with electric mixer on high until creamy about 3 minutes. Set aside. Unroll 1 package dough evening in 13 x 9-inch pan pressing down to close perforations. Spread cheese mixture evenly on dough. Unroll other package dough evenly over filling. Whip egg whites with fork in small bowl until frothy; spread evenly atop dough. Sprinkle with remaining 3/4 cup sugar cinnamon for color and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Allow to cool and set; then slice into bars. Makes 16 to 24 bars.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix together the Raisin Bran sugar flour soda and salt. Make a hole; add the buttermilk oil and eggs. Mix with spoon. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Put in container and keep in refrigerator. Will keep 6 weeks.

title: Fresh Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion until tender; leave some water in the pan. Add chicken broth.

title: Peanut Butter-Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet.

title: Cool Whip Jello Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple; add Jell-O and dissolve. Add creamed cottage cheese. When it jells add the Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Carrot Fruitcake
instructions: Combine nuts fruit dates and raisins with 1/2 cup flour. Set aside. In a large bowl combine sugar and oil. Mix well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine baking powder baking soda cinnamon salt and remaining flour. Gradually add to sugar mixture. Spoon into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan to cool on a wire rack. If desired drizzle with confectioners sugar icing when cooled. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Mexican Slaw
instructions: Shred all together. Add sugar and vinegar. Cover 20 days in refrigerator.

title: Butternut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and shortening. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients with milk and water. Add flavoring and beat well. Bake in greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Start in cold oven at 325\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Clare'S Strawberry Delight
instructions: Prepare Dream Whip with milk and vanilla according to package directions. Fold in orange peel and nuts blending thoroughly. On waxed paper lined baking sheet spoon heaping tablespoonfuls of mixture to form 6 mounds. Shape center of each mound into a shell with back of spoon. Freeze until firm. Fill centers of each shell with strawberries. Yields 6 servings.

title: Quick Stroganoff
instructions: Cut meat across grain diagonally 1/4-inch strips wide. In a large skillet heat 2 tablespoons margarine; add 1/2 of meat. Saute quickly both sides stirring constantly. Remove with slotted spoon. Repeat with remaining meat and margarine. Move to side of skillet. Add onion. Cook stirring constantly until tender. Add drained mushrooms water and bouillon cubes. Bring to boil. Combine sour cream yogurt and flour in small bowl. Mix until smooth. Stir into skillet (using a whisk). Bring to boil and simmer 5 minutes stirring constantly.

title: Butterscotch Clusters
instructions: Melt together in heavy saucepan over low heat the butterscotch morsels and peanut butter. Stir constantly until well blended. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies; stir until well coated. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto wax paper. Let stand in a cool place until firm. Makes about 4 dozen confections 1 1/2 inches in diameter.

title: Potato Cheese Casserole(Servings:  18)
instructions: In large saucepan melt margarine. Saute onion until clear. Add sour cream soup and cheese. Stir until smooth. Gently fold in hash browns. Pour all into large casserole dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Stir together melted butter and cereal. Sprinkle over casserole and return to oven for an additional 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed. Bake in greased and floured tube cake pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Meatballs In Red Wine Sauce
instructions: Combine the first 9 ingredients in a bowl; stir well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Dredge in flour. Brown meatballs in batches in oil in a skillet over medium heat. Remove from skillet; set aside. Combine tomato sauce and remaining ingredients in a Dutch oven. Bring to a boil. Add meatballs. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 35 minutes. Yields 9 dozen.

title: Spoon Cake
instructions: Make cake according to box. Make 1 package pudding at a time according to box. In large serving bowl crumble 1/2 cooked cake on bottom of bowl. Top with 1/4 cup Kahlua. Add 1 box pudding (mixed). Add 1/2 Cool Whip. Add 2 crumbled Skor bars. Repeat layers.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut and mix into large bowl. Let stand in refrigerator so sugar in coconut will soak in rest of fruit. Refrigerate.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Crust Spread crescent rolls flat on pizza pan. Bake 6 to 8 minutes and let cool.

title: Chinese Almond Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar egg and almond extract. Blend ingredients well and add the dry ingredients a little at a time. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Spice Cake
instructions: Mash the bananas. Pour vegetable oil over the bananas and let stand while mixing cake. Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in banana mixture and mix well. Add dry ingredients which have been combined. Stir in raisins and pecans; mix thoroughly. Spoon into 3 greased loaf pans and bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Grandma'S Ginger Snaps
instructions: *Cookies baked with butter will be soft and chewy; cookies baked with Crisco will be crunchier.

title: Wilted Leaf Lettuce
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble reserving drippings. Add onions to drippings and cook until tender. Add vinegar 1/2 water sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt and bacon. Cook and stir until boiling. Pour hot dressing over lettuce; toss to coat.

title: Veggie People
instructions: Wash and slice vegetables. Arrange vegetable slices on a plate. Mix one tablespoon of cream cheese and your favorite food color (just a few drops). Using a toothpick dot eyes on veggies (mouth and nose too). Dip veggies into Ranch dressing for a fun snack. (Healthy too!)

title: Danish Apple Squares
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Add egg and milk mixture and blend. Divide dough into 2 parts. Roll half of the dough to fit 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or an oblong baking pan. Sprinkle bottom of crust of dough with corn flakes. Combine apples sugar and cinnamon. Spread mixture over corn flakes and put on top. Pinch together to seal edges. Beat egg white stiff and brush over top crust. Bake in 400\u00b0 or 375\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until golden. Drizzle confectioners sugar over the cooked crust (1 cup confectioners sugar 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and 1 to 2 tablespoons water).

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: This lets you concentrate on the food but is ready and perfect for after dinner!

title: Frozen Apples
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight. Cook until nearly tender. Cool and freeze. These apples are good for fried apple pies.

title: Never Fail Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Spoon cookie dough onto the pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cocktail Smokies
instructions: Wrap Smokies with bacon. Mix ketchup and sugar and pour over Smokies. Place in a pie plate or small baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix soups; bring to a boil. In a large baking dish put a layer of beef layer of potatoes and layer of onions until all used. Pour soups over each layer. Bake 1 hour in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Heat together beets and beet juice and water; mix together and stir in flour sugar salt pepper and vinegar. Cook stirring constantly until smoothly blended and thickened.

title: Double Quick Baked Beans
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a skillet. Add onion and cook over medium heat until soft stirring occasionally. Blend in ketchup molasses Tabasco brown sugar salt and dry mustard. Bring to boiling. Stir in baked beans. Put mixture into casserole dish. Put bacon across top of beans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until bacon is cooked.

title: Excellent Cookies
instructions: Sift into large bowl the flour salt soda and cinnamon; add the rest of the ingredients. Beat for 3 minutes on medium speed. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Quick Fudge Sauce
instructions: Place chocolate chips in blender container. In 1-quart saucepan combine cream water and sugar. Bring to boil. Add to chips. Cover and blend until smooth about 1 minute.

title: Creamy Timbale Tacos
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add beans chili and tomatoes. Heat all together then add the cheese (grated or cubed) and whipping cream. Heat and serve over Doritos with your favorite taco topping or just serve as a dip.

title: Hot Spiced Percolator Punch
instructions: Dissolve brown sugar in water. Pour juices and brown sugar mixture into automatic percolator. Place cloves and cinnamon in percolator basket. Allow to go through cycle. Serve piping hot.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix everything but ginger ale and sherbet. Chill. When ready to serve add ginger ale and sherbet.

title: Cereal Ice Cream Surprise
instructions: You will need 1 coffee mug.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut meat into strips 1/2-inch wide by 1 1/2-inches long. Dredge meat in mixture of flour salt and pepper and brown in margarine. Add chopped onions and brown. Drain can sliced mushrooms. Save mushroom liquid and add enough water to make 2 cups liquid. Set aside mushrooms until later.

title: Horseshoes
instructions: Knead the mixture made from the first 5 ingredients until it does not stick on hands. Put in Ziploc bag. Put in pan of cold water until it floats. Open bag; wrap in towel and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. Grind walnuts. Add sugar to your sweetness. Melt the oleo. Roll like pie dough on granulated sugar. Cut into 2 x 4-inch shapes. Put nuts on; roll and shape like horseshoes. Bake at 325\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Quick And Easy Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0; lay legs or wings around pan (side by side). Mix together seasonings and sprinkle all over chicken. Chop or slice onion and toss all over chicken. Mix together in separate bowl the soup and sherry then put spoonfuls all over top of onion and chicken. Put pats (tablespoons) of margarine or butter all across top of soup mixture. Cover pan or baking dish with foil and bake. Bake 1 hour or until chicken is very tender. Yum yum ... \The sauce (after chicken is done) goes great with rice or mashed potatoes.\ Enjoy.

title: Freezer Ice Cream
instructions: Prepare pudding mix according to package directions using 3 cups milk. Cook until thick. Add sugar gradually; add vanilla and salt. Add pudding mixture to beaten eggs beating constantly. Pour into freezer container. Add milk until 2/3 full. Freeze.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well. Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour. Drain; let stand 5 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Add Jell-O sugar and 1/4 cup water together. Beat egg yolks then the 3 cups of water margarine and lemon juice. Mix together well. Cook in double boiler until thickened. Pour into baked pie shell. Add meringue on top. Bake at 360\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and cream cheese until creamy. Add vanilla and salt then 1 egg at a time mixing well after each addition. Add flour. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Peanutty Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix sour cream and eggs; mix together well. Place 12 scoops of batter into bottom of a fluted stoneware cake pan rubbed with butter. Top with Reeses Cups. Place remaining batter on top. Microwave on High 11 to 14 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes; loosen from sides and invert on plate. Place peanut butter in microwave for 20 to 40 seconds or until melted. Drizzle over cake allowing it to run down sides. Place morsels and oil in microwave for 20 to 30 seconds or until melted and drizzle over cake. Sprinkle chopped nuts over cake.

title: Whip Cream Frosting
instructions: Heat to dissolve gelatin. Let cool. Beat vanilla and cream until thick. Add sugar then gelatin mixture gradually.

title: Champagne Dessert
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar. Add drained pineapple diced bananas walnuts strawberries and Cool Whip. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Freeze.

title: Baby Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar cinnamon soda and salt together. Stir in other ingredients until well blended. Add nuts. Bake in a greased tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add tomato paste mushrooms and season to taste. Grease 8 or 9-inch pie plate. Line with biscuits. Fill with meat mixture. Top with tomato and pizza cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 slices.

title: Chicken Casserole Oriental
instructions: Drain mushrooms reserve 3 tablespoons liquid. Melt margarine in skillet; saute onion until tender. Stir in green pepper celery chicken broth and soy sauce. Add chicken and mushrooms. Mix cornstarch and liquid from mushrooms; stir into chicken mixture. Add nuts water chestnuts and rice. Pour into 2-quart greased casserole. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until rice is soft. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Pepper and onion are optional.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and flour. Stir in lemon peel juice and margarine. Combine yolks and milk. Add to flour mixture; stir until all combined. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold egg whites into lemon batter. Transfer batter to a 1-quart casserole dish. Place on oven rack in a larger pan. Add hot water to oven pan 1-inch deep. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes or until golden. Serve warm! Serves 4.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo; mix with dressing. Spread half of it in an 8-inch baking dish.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Mix 2 cups of flour with the other dry ingredients including yeast. Put the Crisco in the warm water and add this mixture to the dry ingredients. Beat at medium speed on the mixer for 2 minutes. Add the remaining flour and mix with a wooden spoon until thoroughly blended. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Grease 2 large loaf pans and form dough into 2 loaves. Brush the top of each loaf with melted butter. Cover and set in a warm place to rise. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Remove from pans and brush all over with melted butter.

title: Kelly Cheese Squares
instructions: Soften butter and cheese to room temperature. Add remaining ingredients (except bread) and mix well.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix together and serve.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown meat in a greased skillet. Add onions potatoes and seasonings and cook until vegetables are done. If you do not have onions on hand you may use Liptons dry onion soup mix will not take much or any seasoning.

title: Special Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Line 12 muffin cups. Fill about half full. Bake at 350\u00b0 until well done.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Take crescent rolls and form a crust in 8 x 10-inch pan. Brown sausage. Layer sausage potatoes and cheese. Mix eggs milk salt and pepper; pour over layers. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Leek Soup
instructions: Cut off roots and dark green leaves of leeks. Chop white and pale green portions of leeks. Saute leeks in Dutch oven until limp. Add broth and potatoes. Simmer approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Breast Dinner
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add chicken and brown. Add soup water and vegetables. Heat to a boil and cover. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms With Crab Meat
instructions: Dice crab meat so it is tiny pieces; put lemon juice over or squeeze fresh lemon on crab meat. Put 2 to 3 tablespoons of sour cream with crab meat and mix. Stuff mushrooms with mixture; cover with Mozzarella cheese and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until mushrooms are soft and cheese is melted.

title: Mexican Chicken And Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in oleo. Pour in Ro-Tel. When mixture is hot remove from stove. Drain spaghetti. Put melted Ro-Tel mixture and chicken in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Green Bay Football Bars
instructions: Melt sugar and syrup until it bubbles (medium heat). Add peanut butter; mix. Add Rice Krispies; mix. Remove from heat and smooth into large cake pan.

title: Outstanding Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy; blend in egg and vanilla. Add combined oats flour soda and salt and mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Let cool 3 minutes and remove from pan. Yield 4 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Salad Dressing For Potato Or Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch salt pepper vinegar water and eggs in saucepan. Cook and stir on medium heat until thick and bubbly. Add mustard and mayonnaise to saucepan. Mix well. Pour over already prepared potato or macaroni salad.

title: Weight Watcher Gazpacho Cooler
instructions: Pour vegetable juice into an ice cube tray making 10 cubes. Freeze until solid. Cut 2 slices from cucumber and reserve for garnish. Pare and seed remaining cucumber then cut into pieces. In blender combine cucumber pepper onion lime juice vinegar garlic and hot sauce. Process on medium speed until smooth. Stir in seltzer.

title: French Pancakes
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender. Cover and process at Mix until smooth. Heat electric skillet. Brush with butter and pour batter in four pancakes. Flip when needed. Serve with butter and syrup. Could also be used as crepes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Cut cake in small pieces and place half in an oblong pan. Melt chips and after cooling add eggs and vanilla. Fold whipping cream into mixture. Pour half of mixture over the cake pieces. Put 1/2 of mixture over this.

title: Mexican Lasagne
instructions: Bake chicken at 350\u00b0 until done. Cut into narrow strips. Heat oil and briefly dip tortillas to soften; drain. Layer all ingredients in a glass lasagne pan as follows 5 tortillas 1/4 of chicken 1/4 of vegetables 1/4 of Mexican tomatoes and 1/4 of each of the cheeses. Repeat for 3 more layers; top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes before cutting. Garnish with fresh basil or cilantro leaves if desired. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Blend chili jelly and lemon juice. Bring to boil. Combine meat with finely chopped onion pepper and ice water. Roll into meatballs and drop into sauce. Simmer for 1 hour. Enjoy!

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Drain clams reserving liquid. Fry salt pork until crisp in large saucepan. Remove; add water potatoes onion and reserved clam liquid to fat in saucepan. Cook covered until potatoes are tender 10 to 15 minutes. Add milk cream clams and salt pork. Heat slowly just to boiling. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Float butter atop each serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spiced Apple Corn Fritters
instructions: In a deep heavy saucepan heat 4 inches of vegetable oil to 350\u00b0. In bowl with a heavy-duty mixer beat together corn egg baking powder salt and sugar on medium speed (can do by hand). Add 3 cups flour and mix on low speed until blended. Sprinkle in enough remaining flour so that dough is thick and does not stick to side of bowl. By hand knead in flour until dough is no longer sticky.

title: Salmon
instructions: You will need pint jars lids and rings.

title: Kale Soup
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in large pot. Add linguica and fry up then add half pot of water. Add potatoes; cook on high heat until boiling then add beans cabbage kale salt and pepper. Add some ketchup for color. Cook on medium heat until potatoes and soup are done about 20 minutes then turn to low and simmer.

title: Mystery Bars
instructions: Line cookie sheet with foil. Spray with Pam or equivalent. Place crackers on pan in a single layer (like a checkerboard). Mix and boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes. Pour mixture over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until crackers float and/or mixture bubbles. Take out of oven and immediately sprinkle with chocolate chips. Chips will melt and should be spread evenly over pan with back of a spoon. Sprinkle pan with nuts. Score individual crackers with knife. Refrigerate and finish cutting when cold. Keep bars refrigerated or in freezer.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Combine in large dish tuna noodles and pickles sliced up. Add mayonnaise to taste. Chill and serve.

title: Bacon-Cheese Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and spread on toast points. Broil 6 minutes at 2 inches from broiler. Serve hot.

title: Daffodil Cake
instructions: Beat 6 egg whites with 1 teaspoon cream of tartar until very stiff. Mix all other ingredients together and add to egg whites. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes in an ungreased tube pan. Invert cake when done.

title: Shake And Bake Mix
instructions: Mix well. Dip chicken etc. in milk or water. Shake in mixture and bake.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli and onion; cool. Fold in soup eggs and mayonnaise well. Add cheese broccoli and onion. Grease glass baking dish with butter or margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: V-8 Tomato Cocktail
instructions: Clean fish and sprinkle with salt and let stand overnight. In the morning rinse and pack in pint or quart jars. Add 1/2 c. mazola oil to each pint. Put on cover and process in pressure cooker for 90 minutes at 10 pounds of pressure.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Bring to boil in saucepan the margarine cocoa and boiling water. Pour in sugar and flour mixture. Add buttermilk beaten egg soda cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in greased and floured 11 x 16-inch cookie sheet with 3/4-inch sides. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Meringue Surprises
instructions: Beat egg whites on high until stiff. Gradually add sugar and beat until glossy. May add 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool a few minutes on cookie sheet before removing. Be careful not to burn. No fat or cholesterol.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil until light and fluffy. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with eggs. Fold in carrots and nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in 3 (9-inch) round greased and floured pans. Frost with a double batch of cream cheese frosting and decorate with pecan halves.

title: Praline Pie
instructions: Take coconut butter and pecans and place in iron skillet to brown. Mix cream cheese with milk with mixer. Fold in Cool Whip. Mix well. Layer cream cheese mixture coconut and pecans. Drizzle caramel topping. Repeat. Will make 3 small pies or 2 large pies.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and work with hands. Roll in balls; place on cookie sheet with wax paper. Chill for 1 hour. Melt almond bark and dip chilled balls and place back on wax paper until hardened.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix corn flakes and melted butter and cover bottom of pan. Layer the next 4 ingredients. Mix the remaining ingredients and pour over the top. Top with remaining buttered corn flakes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mound Bars
instructions: Lightly grease 11 x 17-inch cookie sheet. Mix first 4 ingredients well and spread in pan evenly. Freeze. Cut in small squares.

title: Quick And Easy French Dressing
instructions: Mix well and store in refrigerator.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine pudding milk and Eagle Brand milk; mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer Nilla wafers bananas and pudding repeating 3 times.

title: Cocoa
instructions: Place water and salt in a medium sized pan over low heat. Add sugar and cocoa stir to dissolve and heat for 10 minutes.

title: Cheese And Bacon Biscuits
instructions: Mix sugar and flour well. Mix buttermilk and soda together. Mix together all ingredients and make biscuits.

title: Pumpkin And Apple Casserole
instructions: Melt 3 tablespoons butter and combine with sugar cinnamon nuts and salt.

title: Peanutty Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Mix in large bowl at medium speed peanut butter corn syrup oleo eggs\tand vanilla until smooth. Reduce speed; beat in flour baking powder and salt until blended. Stir in 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips. Spread evenly in ungreased 15 x 10-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Melt rest of chocolate; drizzle over surface. Cut into bars. Makes 48.

title: Herbed Beef Stew
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a large kettle and brown well the beef chuck cut into cubes. Add mushrooms onions garlic salt dill basil thyme savory bay leaves and pepper. Saute slowly stirring occasionally until mushrooms and onions are tender. Now add can of beef consomme and cans of tomatoes. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Add 1 pound small white onions peeled and 1 bunch carrots peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks. Cover kettle and cook 45 minutes more or until vegetables are done. Now mix 6 tablespoons flour with 1/2 cup cold water until smooth and add gradually to the stew stirring occasionally. Continue to stir and heat until gravy is thickened.

title: A Round Of Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix thoroughly at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Place a layer of onions in the bottom of a greased dish. Cover with a layer of almonds then a layer of soup. Repeat the 3 layers; cover with crushed corn flakes. Pour melted butter over all. Cook until golden and the onions are soft at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve with crackers or fresh vegetables.

title: Sweet And Sour Cucumber Salad(Diabetic:  Low-Fat)
