instructions: Boil water vinegar sweetener pickle and salt. Place cucumbers and celery slices in a glass jar. Pour boiling liquid over. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain before serving. Yields 2 cups. Contains 20 calories per serving.

title: Lemon Rounds (Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream Crisco and sugar; add egg lemon juice (rind of lemon if desired). Combine flour with baking powder salt and crushed lemon drops. Add to creamed mixture. Mix on high speed with mixer until well-blended. Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes; remove from sheets and cool. Frost if desired. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix just before serving.

title: Bean And Burger Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease 2 cookie sheets. Brown ground beef and drain. Stir in pork and beans ketchup onion mustard and salt; simmer uncovered.

title: Rhubarb Rosy Swirls
instructions: Make a\tsyrup of sugar and water. Cook to a thin syrup and add the lemon juice and\tbutter. Pour this into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix 2 cups\tof Bisquick as directed on box for biscuits. Roll dough into a rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Arrange 3 cups finely cut rhubarb on dough and roll up like a jelly roll. Cut into 9 to 12 pieces and place in the syrup. Sprinkle with\tsugar and bake at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 until nicely browned. Serve with cream or ice cream. Best served warm.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix peanut butter and melted oleo in large bowl. Add sugar and Rice Krispies. Make balls and dip in melted chocolate.

title: The Cake That Won'T Last
instructions: Add all ingredients. Stir well but do not beat. Pour into Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Thai Chicken With Basil
instructions: Cut each chicken breast half into 4 pieces. Heat oil in wok or 12 inch skillet over medium high heat. Cook garlic and chilies in oil stirring constantly until garlic is golden brown. Add chicken; stir-fry 8 to 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center. Stir in fish sauce and sugar. Sprinkle with basil and mint. This has 5 grams carbohydrates.

title: Deviled Ham And Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. To serve place in bowl on tray along with choice of crackers breads carrot sticks or celery sticks.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Step 1 Mix cornbread mix as directed on box.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Cream shortening and butter. Add brown and white sugars. Blend. Add egg and vanilla. Beat mixture until light; add nutmeats. Blend in dry ingredients and mix well. Divide dough in 2 parts and make 2 rolls. Wrap in wax paper; chill overnight in refrigerator. Slice off and bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: French Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions about 1/8-inch thick and separate into rings. Roll each ring in flour then dip in mixture made of the eggs and milk. Roll in cracker crumbs and fry in a wire basket in furiously boiling cooking oil. Remove and drain.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat cherry pie mixture until cherries are in bits. Add eggs and cake mix. Beat until well blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Italian Salad Dressing
instructions: Add all ingredients together in a jar. Shake and add to salad.

title: Praline Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Place 2 teaspoons butter 2 teaspoons sugar and 2 or 3 pecans in each of 12 greased medium muffin cups. Sprinkle cinnamon in each cup. Stir baking mix and water to a soft dough. Drop dough by spoonfuls into each cup. Bake 15 minutes. Invert onto tray. Let pan remain over biscuits a few minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Good Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all together and set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Poppy Seed Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain. Brown butter in skillet; add poppy seed and almonds mixing well. Add noodles and toss lightly to mix.

title: Banana Oat Bread
instructions: Combine oats baking powder and salt in a bowl. Combine bananas honey oil and eggs in blender container. Process until smooth. Add to dry ingredients; mix well. Stir in pecans. Spoon into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until bread tests done. Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: Rinse cooked macaroni in cold water; drain well. Combine all other ingredients except paprika. Cover and chill. Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

title: Macaroni And Cheese For Large Numbers(14 To 16 People)
instructions: Thaw macaroni and cheese and mix in the remaining ingredients.

title: Almond Chicken(Stir-Fry)
instructions: Skin bone and cut up chicken breasts into 1/2-inch cubes. In a bowl mix ginger honey and cornstarch and blend in water soy sauce and sherry. Thaw pea pods. In a large skillet heat oil over medium heat. Add almonds stirring and cooking for about 3 minutes. Add chicken and cook just until meat turns white. Pour in sherry mixture and cook until sauce thickens. Add pea pods and stir until hot and glazed. Serve over rice. (Cashews may be substituted for the almonds.)

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Rub steak with flour. Season with salt and pepper. Sear in frying pan in oil. Remove and place in casserole dish. In the same pan saute onion and mushrooms. Pour over steak. Cover meat with 1 inch of water. Bake in oven covered for 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Potato And Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Spray large baking dish with Pam. Layer sliced potatoes then pork chops then another layer of sliced potatoes and mushrooms. Season if you wish to. Pour soup and liquid over this. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until tender. Add cheese and crackers to top of casserole. Bake in oven uncovered until cheese is melted and top is lightly browned.

title: Scalloped Onions
instructions: Place the first 4 ingredients in a 2-quart casserole in even layer. Combine soup milk salt and pepper; pour over all. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes then remove cover and bake 15 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Baked Hash Browns
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in 9 x 13 pan. Top with 1 cup of crushed corn flakes and dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Garlic Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate. Chill at least 3 hours. (Can serve at once.) Stir before serving.

title: Deviled Puffs
instructions: Prepare puffs and filling early in day. Fill at party time.

title: Green Pea Casserole
instructions: Saute onion. Drain half the liquid from the peas. Mix peas soup pimento and water chestnuts. Add onion. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch casserole. Top with cheese; crumble crackers in melted margarine and spread on top of cheese. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggnog Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tGrease and flour two layer cake pans. Combine flour sugar baking powder salt nutmeg eggs vanilla eggnog and butter into\ta large mixing bowl. Blend well at medium speed. Pour into pans and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken With Mushrooms
instructions: Brown chicken breasts in skillet in 1/4 stick butter on both sides. Remove from skillet and place in baking dish. Add celery mushrooms and mushroom soup. Add soup can of water. Cover and cook in a 350\u00b0 oven until tender. Continue to baste chicken so it will not dry out.

title: Fresh Orange Waldorf Salad
instructions: Grate peel of 1/2 fresh orange. Peel and cut oranges in bite-size pieces. Cut apple (do not peel) in bite-size pieces. Combine all ingredients and chill well. Serve on salad greens if desired.

title: Cranberry Candy
instructions: In a 2 to 3-quart pan combine cranberries orange peel and orange juice. Set over medium-high heat and cook for about 15 minutes or until cranberries soften and pop open. Cool. Whirl mixture a little at a time in a blender until smooth then force through a fine wire strainer; discard residue.

title: Banana Tea Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together the flour baking powder soda and salt. Cream the shortening; add the sugar gradually and continue working until light and fluffy. Add the eggs and beat well. Add the flour mixture alternately with the bananas a small amount at a time beating after each addition until smooth. Pour into a well-greased bread pan (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inches) and bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Magic Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix tuna oil from tuna cheese seasonings and 1/4 cup bread crumbs into beaten eggs. Turn into oiled 1-quart casserole and top with remaining crumbs. Dot with butter.

title: Herbed Seafood And Pasta
instructions: Clean and devein shrimp/scallops. Melt butter; add garlic and seafood. Cook 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from butter and set aside. Add half and half to butter in pan. Bring to boil; simmer 10 minutes. Add seafood parsley and seasonings. Heat well. Serve over cooked pasta surrounded by pepper.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
instructions: Bake a white or yellow cake; cool. Mix vanilla pudding milk and cream cheese with a mixer. Spread pudding mixture on cooled cake. Spread crushed pineapple on top of pudding mixture. Spread Cool Whip on top of pineapple. Top with coconut.

title: Banana Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs; beat well. Sift dry ingredients and stir into egg mixture. Add bananas and chocolate chips. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. (Caution Bananas will darken and become gooey if dough is treated like refrigerator cookies.)

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix together and cook till thick. Pour into a baked pie crust or Graham Crackers. Can double for 2 pies.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until browned; drain. Set aside. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Arrange on ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward center. Press over bottom and up sides to form crust sealing perforations completely. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese.

title: Chicken Broccoli Hot Dish
instructions: Mix stuffing according to package directions; pat down in a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Pour cooked chicken over stuffing.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar milk butter and peanut butter to a rolling boil then add oatmeal cocoa and vanilla. Beat until like fudge. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Pies(Makes 3 Pies)
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa Pet milk and the rest of the ingredients; mix thoroughly and pour into 3 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of 2 round ring pans. In a large bowl blend first 6 ingredients. Beat 1 minute at medium speed. Stir in remaining ingredients just until dry ingredients are moistened.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Nick'S Stew (Stefatho)
instructions: Cube meat 1 1/2 inches place in deep dish. Add water to cover and 3 teaspoons of salt. Soak overnight in refrigerator.

title: Bayou Seafood Casserole
instructions: Melt cream cheese and oleo in top of double boiler. Saute shrimp onion pepper and celery in 2 tablespoons oleo. Add cream cheese and oleo. Blend well. Add soup mushrooms seasonings crab meat and rice. Blend well. Place in oiled 2-quart casserole dish and top with Cheddar and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly. Freezes well for short time.

title: Easy Baked Shrimp
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp. Leave tail on and butterfly shrimp. Sprinkle Cheese Tid-Bits generously on shrimp. Dot with melted butter. Add pepper and garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Grape Salad
instructions: Refrigerate first five ingredients. Before serving time add mayonnaise vinegar and sugar.

title: Evelyn Pond'S Sliced Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onions thin and let stand 20 minutes in a weak salt water. Drain and add vinegar sugar and mustard seed and cook 10 minutes after coming to a boil.

title: Lamb Shish Kebab Marinade
instructions: Heat all together over medium heat and bring to a boil 8 to 10 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Stir in lamb and marinate 15 minutes or longer. Grill 10 to 15 minutes until done. Pour remaining marinade over lamb before serving.

title: Kathy'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding according to directions. Chill until firm. Add condensed milk and Cool Whip. Stir until well mixed. Put layer of wafers in bottom of a large bowl. Then add a layer of sliced bananas and cover with pudding mixture. Repeat.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Crisps
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup butter on stove. Add milk sugar and cocoa. Stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved. Bring to a boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Blend in peanut butter vanilla salt and oatmeal. Drop onto waxed paper by spoonfuls. Let cool. Makes 5 to 6 dozen. Store in airtight container.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Roast season and slow cook in crock-pot for 8 to 10 hours. Or cook until very tender in a pressure cooker. Remove the roast from juices and shred. Save juice for a later use. Return shredded meat to crock-pot and add the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook 4 to 6 hours. Discard bay leaf and serve on French rolls or sandwich buns.

title: Colorful Oven Vegetables
instructions: Place butter in a shallow 3-quart baking dish. Place in a 400\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes or until melted. Stir in thyme salt and pepper. Add the vegetables and toss to coat. Cover and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the vegetables are crisp and tender.

title: Cheese, Ham, Broccoli Strata
instructions: Cut 12 inch \doughnuts\ and \holes\ from bread; set aside. Fit scraps in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish lightly greased. Place cheese in layers over bread. Add layer of broccoli then ham. Arrange \doughnuts\ on top slightly overlapping. Sprinkle \holes\ in center. May add a few more bread scraps if it looks scarce.

title: Calico Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all together and simmer in crock-pot.

title: Jean'S Potato Soup(12 Servings)
instructions: In large pot saute onion in butter 3 minutes. Add potatoes water celery leaves salt pepper paprika and tomato sauce. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes are just tender stirring occasionally. In a small skillet combine oil and flour until smooth. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture is golden brown. Watch closely to prevent burning. Carefully stir into hot soup. Add parsley. Cook stirring occasionally for 5 minutes or until soup thickens.

title: Pecan Sandies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add water and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour and pecans. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Shape in balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Dinner In A Pepper
instructions: Cut tops off green peppers; discard seeds and membranes. Chop enough of the tops to make 1/4 cup. Boil whole peppers for 5 minutes drain well. Sprinkle inside lightly with salt. In skillet brown beef onion and the 1/4 cup of green pepper. Add tomatoes and cook until tender about 4 minutes. Drain off liquid. Add both corns salt basil and pepper to skillet. Mix well. Stuff peppers with the meat mixture. Toss crumbs with melted butter sprinkle on the top of peppers. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Low-Fat Cheese Ball
instructions: You can substitute 1 tablespoon of bacon bits if using low-fat dressing.

title: Bonbon Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into balls. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Raspberry Sauce
instructions: Puree ingredients in food processor then strain. Cover chill until ready to use.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Boil eggs. While macaroni and eggs are cooking cut up crabmeat. Have macaroni cool until warm. In pan mix macaroni eggs garlic powder onion salt salt and pepper. Add Miracle Whip until everything is covered and add crabmeat and cucumbers. Pour into bowl. Sprinkle paprika on top. Serve cold.

title: Caramel Bars
instructions: Melt caramels with milk slowly. Mix flour oats sugar soda salt and butter. Press 3/4 of mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Add chocolate chips and peanuts. Drizzle caramel over top. Crumble on remaining crumbs and bake 12 minutes more at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drain artichokes and chop. Mix together the sour cream mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese. Add to the artichokes. Place in ovenproof dish and sprinkle with paprika. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients as given and pour into 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. While warm frost with Icing.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Cut chicken into chunks. Mix chicken with sour cream soup and onion soup mix. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare stuffing mix according to directions using chicken broth for liquid. Place over the chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and rice in margarine until lightly browned. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat until rice is tender. Makes 8 servings.

title: Amish Cookies
instructions: Cream the first 4 ingredients. Add eggs and vanilla; beat then add dry ingredients. Make dough into balls the size of walnuts. Dip glass in sugar and press cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or just until brown (burn easily). Makes about 100 cookies.

title: Marshmallow Popcorn
instructions: In medium saucepan melt butter and brown sugar. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Immediately add marshmallows. Stir until melted. Pour over popped corn and stir until distributed evenly. Salt to taste.

title: Crab Rangoon Spread And Won Ton Crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly brush cookie sheet with butter. Cut won tons in half; arrange on sheet. Brush with butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes until golden brown. Cool on paper towels. Repeat until won tons are all done.

title: Easy French Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt in large bowl. Add yeast and water until dough is soft. Cover and let rise in place (85\u00b0) free from drafts for 30 minutes (until doubled). Turn dough onto heavily floured surface. Knead to smooth and elastic (5 minutes). Divide in half. Shape into 2 oval loaves. Fold over lengthwise and flatten with hands. Roll each with hands into a 15 x 2-inch loaf. Twist and place loaves on greased pans. Brush with butter. Cover and let rise in warm place (85\u00b0) free from drafts until doubled. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes until loaves sound hollow.

title: Ham And Cheese Strata
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan with 4 slices bread. Mix together all ingredients. Put half of this mixture on top of the bread in the pan. Place remaining 4 slices of bread on top and then put the rest of the cheese/egg mixture over them. Let stand in refrigerator covered overnight. In the morning bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt; place half of mixture in bottom of unbaked pastry shell. Add half of apples and sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon. Scatter bits of butter. Repeat until all apples are used. Squeeze juice of lemon and 1/2 cup water over top. Top with pastry crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Oreo Pudding
instructions: Step 1 Crumble Oreo cookies (save enough for topping). Place crumbled Oreos in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix syrup sugar and water over high heat. Bring to a boil and boil until hard ball forms. Remove from heat. Pour in egg whites and beat until thick and workable. Roll into 1/8-inch thick sheet on a mixture of flour and confectioners sugar. Spread with peanut butter. Roll up into a log chill and slice.

title: Date Bread
instructions: Mix soda and boiling water; add dates and let set 10 minutes. Mix in with remaining ingredients. Pour into a loaf pan sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until crusty and firm.

title: Peanut Butter Picnic Cake
instructions: Grease bottom of a 9-inch x 13-inch baking pan. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixing bowl combine flour brown sugar peanut butter and butter. Beat until crumbly. Reserve one cup. Add baking powder baking soda milk vanilla and eggs. Blend until smooth. Pour batter into pan. Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top. Sprinkle chocolate chips over crumbs. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand in pan until cool. Cut into squares

title: Poppy Seed Bread And Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients for 3 minutes. Pour into 2 loaf pans or 1 Bundt pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Grease pan and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix soup mayonnaise and milk. Heat to boiling and remove. Put 1 cup cornflakes in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish. Drain cabbage. Place on top of cornflakes. Pour soup mixture over cabbage. Melt margarine and\tadd with remaining cup of flakes. Tear cheese into strips. Put on top of cabbage then place remaining flakes on top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Turkey Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients lightly. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 40 minutes or until nicely browned. Makes 20 servings.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Wrap breasts with bacon. Arrange in a baking dish or 9 x 13-inch pan the dried beef on the bottom. Lay the wrapped chicken breasts over the beef. Combine the sour cream and mushroom soup. Pour over chicken. Bake in a 275\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. Can be made ahead and reheated.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine the first 9 ingredients mixing well. Shape into 1-inch meatballs. Cook in hot shortening over medium heat until brown; drain on paper towels.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar cornstarch salt and water stirring all the time until it turns clear. Take off of heat and add 4 tablespoons strawberry jello. Let cool. Put berries in crust and pour filling over it. Put in refrigerator until set.

title: Ground Beef And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add soup water rice and kix well. Pour into greased casserole dish and bake 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Snickerdoodles Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and Crisco and add egg. Sift flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Add to first mixture. Make into balls the size of walnut or smaller. Press down; sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar or colored sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients. Stir in walnuts and orange peel. Mix in separate bowl egg orange juice and oil. Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients stirring until just moistened. Pour into greased loaf pan (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until tested done (toothpick inserted comes out clean). Remove from pan; cool on rack. Wrap tightly and store overnight before serving.

title: Aunt Sara'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix jello and boiling water and place in refrigerator to thicken slightly.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix and pour over chicken beef or pork. Use with smoked sausage or wieners.

title: Cheese Broccoli
instructions: Precook broccoli. Mix rest of ingredients. Drain broccoli and pour soup and cheese mixture over broccoli in a 3-quart dish. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Ruby'S Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Mix together and dissolve the warm water salt and yeast. Add the cake mix and flour.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine onion cream of mushroom soup sour cream margarine and cheese; mix well. Thaw hash browns then add to cream mixture. Spread into 13 x 9-inch glass baking pan.

title: Chicken
instructions: Get chicken out of the freezer. Put it in a pan and cook it in the microwave for 2 minutes. Get it out then put on the crumbs and the barbecue sauce.

title: 7-Cup Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill before serving.

title: Taco Dip(Makes Double Recipe; 2 Pans)
instructions: In 2 small pie pans spread cream cheese. Add chili. Add shredded Monterey Jack then Cheddar cheese. Add chopped onions on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with large corn or tortilla chips small plates and lots of napkins!

title: Spiced Devil Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour spices soda and salt together. Then cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add beaten eggs and chocolate; beat thoroughly. Add sifted dry ingredients and buttermilk alternately. Add boiling water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 3 (9-inch) layers.

title: Turkey Burgers(Low Calorie)
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray the broiler with non-stick spray. Lightly combine turkey onion egg and parsley and garlic tarragon plus salt and pepper in a bowl. Form into 4 burgers. Broil 4-inch from heat until brown about 5 minutes on each side. 1 Burger = 4 Points.

title: Shrimp Toasts
instructions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp in saucepan until melted. Add shrimp. Spread on English muffins. Cut each half in six pieces. Freeze on cookie sheet. Cover or put in bags or plastic container and keep frozen. Broil 5 to 7 minutes until brown.

title: Savory Pot Roast
instructions: In a Dutch oven or deep pot brown roast on all sides to sear in 2 Tbsp. of hot oil. Stir in mushroom soup onion soup mix and 1 cup of water. Reduce heat o low. Cover and cook for 2 hours stirring often. Cook 45 minutes or until roast and vegetables are fork tender. Remove roast and vegetables. Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup of water until smooth. Gradually stir in soup mixture. Cook until mixture boils and thickens stirring often.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening; cool. Add sugar molasses and egg. Beat well. Mix dry ingredients together; add to mixture. Mix well. Chill very well. Roll into 1-inch balls; roll in sugar. Place 2-inches apart. Bake 8 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Fritos Chili Pie
instructions: Place 1 1/2 cups Fritos in baking dish. Arrange chopped onions and half of the grated cheese over Fritos. Pour heated chili over onions and cheese. Top with remaining Fritos and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Drain fruit well. Mix all of the above together. Chill for at least one hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Grate potato and carrots. Mix with remaining ingredients. Cook in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: New English Mulled Cider
instructions: Put cider in pan. Add cinnamon cloves nutmeg and brown sugar. Simmer 1 hour. Add lemon juice. Slice orange thin; add 1 orange slice to each cup and fill with cider. Serve hot or cold.

title: Baked Fish Fillets
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs with cheese. Spread fillets with melted oleo or butter; sprinkle with crumbs. Bake for 8 to 15 minutes until flaky (depends on thickness of fillets). Bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Reception Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple juice and dissolve Jell-O. When Jell-O is dissolved add cream cheese and all other ingredients except whipping cream. Whip the whipping cream until forms a stiff peak and fold into other mixture. Pour into mold or 9 x 12-inch dish and refrigerate.

title: Hershey'S Double Chocolate Mint Dessert
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease rectangular pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). In a large mixer bowl beat flour sugar butter eggs and syrup until smooth. Pour into pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until top springs back when touched. (Top may appear wet.) Cool completely in pan. Spread Mint Cream Layer on cake (see recipe). Chill. Pour Chocolate Topping over dessert (see recipe). Chill. Cover.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly the shortening butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown. Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Unusual Pasta
instructions: Simmer first 5 ingredients for several hours. Cook pasta according to box directions (use desired amount). Cook beans or use leftover beans. Mix everything together and serve.

title: Bridge Club Special
instructions: Mix flour chopped nuts and oleo together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let cool. Blend cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip; spread over cooled crust. Cook puddings using 1/2 milk in each pudding; let cool. Layer over cream cheese mixture. Spread Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with nuts. Chill and serve.

title: Pudding Pops
instructions: Prepare pudding mix as directed on package. Pour into six 5 ounce paper cups or pop molds. Insert wooden stick or plastic spoons. Place a small piece of plastic wrap over top. Freeze until firm. Press firm on bottom of cups to release pop and serve.

title: Antipasta Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Cover with garlic salt and enough oil to coat. Let set overnight for flavors to mix.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup Made With Ground Beef
instructions: Brown and drain hamburg. Cover with water. Add bouillon cubes and vegetables. Bring to a boil. Turn heat down. Let simmer for about 10 minutes. Add pepper and more seasoning to taste.

title: Blackberry Pie
instructions: Combine the blackberries sugar and tapioca in a large bowl and let set uncovered for 20 minutes. Spoon into unbaked pie shell. Cut the butter or margarine on top. Cover with crust. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce heat to 375\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes more.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Add flour apple pie filling and raisins or nuts to cake mix. Make it in 2 loaf pans greased slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut dough into 1/8-inch slices. Line a 14-inch pizza pan with slices overlapping slightly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool. Blend softened cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Spread over cookie crust. Arrange fruit over cream cheese layer. Glaze with marmalade or preserves which have been mixed with water.

title: Webb Stew
instructions: Boil hamburg until done. Place onion and potatoes in same pot and cook until done. Add tomato soup. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve when hot.

title: Hermits
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream butter and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs; blend well. Combine flour baking soda cinnamon salt allspice and cloves. Gradually blend dry ingredients into creamed mixture. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop batter by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from baking sheet to a wire rack to cool. Makes about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Salmon Mousse
instructions: Heat tomato soup; thoroughly blend cream cheese into soup (may need to use whisk). Soften gelatin in cold water. Dissolve gelatin mixture in hot soup and cream cheese; cool. Add all other ingredients. Pour into 1 1/2 quart fish-shaped mold and chill until firm. Unmold and serve with crackers or party rye.

title: Crab Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients; spread out in a greased shallow pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar oil and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with zucchini to egg mixture. Add nuts and raisins. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Freezes well. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Steak And Dressing
instructions: Stuff steak with dressing and tie with a clean string. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Drain. In meantime in medium bowl combine egg Parmesan cheese and butter. Add spaghetti; toss well. Put mixture in bottom of 9 x 3-inch pan.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix milk and sugar in large saucepan over low heat. Bring to boiling; cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove pan from heat. Add other ingredients. Stir with wooden spoon until marshmallows are melted. Pour fudge into buttered 8-inch square pan. Cut into squares when completely cool. Makes about 2 pounds.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients in order given except the butter and vanilla. Cook over boiling water until mixture thickens stirring often. Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla.

title: Baked Flank Steak
instructions: Set oven at 450\u00b0. Use flat baking dish large enough for steak. Set dish in oven for 5 minutes. Blend butter and seasoning and add to dish. When butter melts add steak. Bake 5 minutes and turn steak. Bake another 5 minutes (or more). Slice steak on diagonal and turn each slice in seasonings in dish. Serve in dish.

title: Grilled Ribs
instructions: Combine onion and oil in a 4-cup glass measure. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and microwave on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in chili sauce and next 5 ingredients. Cover and microwave on High for 4 to 5 minutes until slightly thickened stirring after 2 minutes. Set aside.

title: Creamy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen broccoli according to package directions. Drain reserving cooking liquid. Cook onion in reserved cooking liquid for 5 minutes or until tender. Do not drain. In screw-top jar combine milk cornstarch salt thyme and dash of pepper. Shake mixing well. Stir into onion. Cook and stir until bubbly. Stir in Neufchatel cheese. Add broccoli. Gently stir to mix. Turn into serving bowl. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Salad Supreme
instructions: Combine and serve in lettuce cups with thin slices of chicken on top. Garnish with stuffed olives (diced thin) or chopped ripe olives. Let chill in refrigerator. Makes great sandwiches.

title: Eight Layer Salad
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl in the order listed. Do not toss!

title: Ham Buns
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and spoon into hot dog buns. Wrap in aluminum foil and bake for 10 to 15 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Or cover buns with wax paper and heat in the microwave until heated with the cheese melted.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Cook bacon onions and beef. Drain off fat. Stir in seasonings. Add all the beans. Stir and cook 1/2 hour. Serve with crusty buns and salad.

title: Oriental Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise with curry lemon juice garlic salt and soy sauce. Mix first 4 ingredients with mayonnaise mixture. Just before serving add pecans and noodles.

title: Lemon Cheze Filling Or Frosting
instructions: Mix. Cook in double boiler until thick. Spread onto two-layer cakes.

title: Easy Nacho Dip
instructions: Layer in 10-inch glass baking dish cream cheese Hormel chili then Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Dip nacho chips.

title: Butterscotch Haystacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels in top of double boiler or you may use microwave. Add peanut butter. Stir. Pour over noodles. Mix thoroughly. Drop onto waxed paper by spoonful. Should look like small stacks.

title: Rice Meat Balls
instructions: Combine rice with beef egg onion salt marjoram pepper and 1/2 cup tomato juice. Mix lightly. Shape mixture into 18 balls and place in skillet. Add sugar to remaining 2 cups of tomato juice. Pour juice over meat balls in skillet. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 15 minutes basting occasionally. Makes 6 servings of 3 meat balls each.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Cook meat and onion. Then add all other ingredients. Cover and simmer one hour.

title: Chocolate Pizza
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and 14 oz. almond bark (I use microwave at 60% power). Stir in marshmallows cereal and peanuts. Pour onto greased or foil-covered 12 inch pizza pan. Top with cherries; sprinkle with coconut. Melt remaining 2 oz. almond bark and drizzle over coconut. Chill until firm. Store at room temperature.

title: Karen Lewis'S Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put peaches and juice in long cake pan. Sprinkle Jell-O over peaches. Sprinkle cake mix over Jell-O. Cut up butter over top of this. Pour water over this. Sprinkle nuts over top if desired. Do not stir or mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (about 30 to 45 minutes). Will be brown on top. Very rich!

title: W. W. Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in chicken broth until tender. Mix gravy mix in 1/2 cup cold water. Add to potatoes and stir until thick.

title: Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cook cut up tomatoes onions green peppers and basil until vegetables are done. Put through a colander. Add salad oil oregano sugar salt and tomato paste. Cook until thick like sauce. Put in jars seal and process for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Whacky Cake
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients into ungreased cake pan. Make 3 holes in dry ingredients. In one hole fill with oil; in another put vinegar; and in the last hole vanilla. Pour cold water over all and stir with fork until mixed very well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Holiday Carrot Cake
instructions: Blend all dry ingredients. Mix in oil eggs and carrots. Blend well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done approximately 50 minutes (or until toothpick comes out clean).

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in covered 1 1/2-quart dish.

title: Cocoa-Licious Cereal Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in a 5-quart saucepan on low until melted. Add marshmallows and melt until smooth. Remove from heat and add cereal coating well. Press firmly into lightly greased foil lined 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool. Turn onto cutting surface. Peel off foil and cut into squares.

title: Fried Salmon Patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Form into 10 to 12 patties and fry until medium brown in lightly oiled skillet. Drain on paper towels. Serves 4.

title: City Chicken Barbecue
instructions: You will need 12 to 15 wooden skewers 4 1/2 to 5-inches long.

title: *Diet Cake*
instructions: Cook raisins in 2 cups of water until dry. Mix all ingredients together; blend well. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Mix together first 10 ingredients. This is your marinade. Wipe meat with damp paper towels. Put meat in marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 3 days turning meat occasionally. Remove meat from marinade. Reserve marinade. Dry off meat with paper towels. Coat meat with 2 tablespoons flour.

title: Strawberry Shake
instructions: Puree 1/2 cup strawberries and honey in blender or food processor. Add milk and yogurt; blend until smooth. Pour into glasses; garnish each with whole strawberry. Yield About 2 cups.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix oatmeal and boiling water. Let stand 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Baked Western Omelet
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly spray a 10-inch glass pie pan with nonstick cooking spray. In medium bowl with wire whisk beat eggs with 1/4 cup of water until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients with rubber spatula. Scrape into prepared pie pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes until omelet is set slightly puffed and browned. Cut into 4 servings and serve at once. Yields 4 servings.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large container. Store in covered container. Use 1/4 to 1/3 cup of mix for each cup of hot cocoa. Use hot water mixed with cocoa mix to make hot cocoa.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Reserve 1 banana and 10 to 12 vanilla wafers for garnish. Combine 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt in top of double boiler. Stir in 4 egg yolks and milk. Blend well; cook uncovered over boiling water stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Spread small amount on bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with layer of sliced banana. Pour about 1/3 of custard over banana. Continue to layer wafers bananas and custard to make 3 layers of each ending with custard. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks form. Spoon on top of pudding spreading to cover entire surface sealing well to edges. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until delicately brown. Cool slightly or chill. Just before serving garnish with banana slices then wafers upright around edges of dish.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Saute ground beef pepperoni onion and green pepper lightly. Melt butter and place in 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Toss cooked spaghetti with butter. Cover with one can tomato sauce. Add half the cheese and half the meat mixture and all the mushrooms. Sprinkle with oregano and basil. Add remaining cheese and meat. Top with 2nd can of tomato sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 10.

title: Butter Pecan Torte
instructions: Beat together until smooth. Pour in cool crust. Put in refrigerator to set. Beat 1/2 pint of whipping cream and pour over the mixture. Sprinkle with 4 Heath bars (crushed).

title: Classic Meat Loaf(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: I also add chopped bell pepper and 1 tablespoon cooking oil.

title: Spaghetti Soup
instructions: Break spaghetti into bite size pieces and cook. Drain. Bring tomato juice just to boil. Add pasta and black pepper to taste. Serve.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine; add graham crumbs. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer remaining ingredients in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Molasses Crunches
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg and molasses. Add dry ingredients. Chill well. Roll into 1-inch balls then roll in sugar. Bake 12 to 15 minutes on greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients into a large bowl and mix well. Store mix in airtight container.

title: Rice-Cooker Seafood Jambalaya
instructions: All seasoning should be chopped fine; mix all into rice cooker cover and turn on. Cooks in 30 to 35 minutes. Stir completely and leave cooker on warm for few minutes. (Cook beef chicken pork sausage or crabmeat may be substituted.)

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Christmas Eve night cook sausage; drain. Beat eggs and milk well. Add bread cheese and sausage. Put in greased casserole and cover with foil. Place in the refrigerator. Christmas morning place casserole in cold oven at 350\u00b0. Cook uncovered 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Artichoke Squares
instructions: Butter an 8 x 8-inch glass pan with 1 teaspoon butter or margarine. Saute onion garlic and parsley in a little butter until onion is translucent. Meanwhile drain and chop artichoke hearts. While they are still \draining\ beat eggs until they are light. Add bread crumbs and seasonings. Mix well. Stir in cheese sauteed onion garlic and parsley and artichoke hearts. Put in greased pan. Bake 35 minutes at 325\u00b0 until it feels firm to touch. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: S'Mores
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange half of graham crackers on baking sheet. Top each cracker with 1 piece of the chocolate bars. Broil until chocolate is softened but not melted. Arrange 2 tablespoons marshmallows on each cracker. Broil until lightly toasted. Top with remaining crackers and serve. Makes 8 Smores.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Pour mixture into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Ez Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Parmesan cheese. Pour into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tempting Pretzel Snack
instructions: Break pretzels into pieces. Lay on cookie sheet. In a bowl mix other ingredients. Pour over pretzels. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes turning every 10 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Combine dry ingredients; stir in nuts and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients. Add to dry; stir until moistened. Spoon batter into prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until not moist in middle when tested. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans and place on wire racks; cool completely.

title: Individual Strawberry Shortcakes
instructions: Sift flour once. Measure. Add baking powder and salt and sift again. Cut in shortening. Add milk all at once and stir carefully until all flour is dampened. Then stir vigorously until mixture forms a soft dough and follows spoon around bowl. Drop 3/4 cup dough onto ungreased baking sheet*. Brush with milk (or cream). Bake in hot oven (450\u00b0) for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake about 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Dandelion Wine
instructions: Bring water to a boil add sugar and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Put in blossoms let stand until lukewarm. Add yeast dissolved in 1/2 cup lukewarm water. Let stand 7 days stirring in the morning and night. After 7 days strain through cheesecloth. Add raisins and lemon juice let stand 2 weeks. Do not stir! Strain after 2 weeks and put in bottles. Do not cap too tightly. Let stand for 3 weeks before drinking.

title: Barbecue Roast
instructions: Slash edge of meat sprinkle both sides with meat tenderizer and let stand 1 hour.

title: Fantastic Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip then add pineapple bananas and nuts. Chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix onion dip and cream cheese place in a 9x13 pan. Brown hamburger and add taco seasoning and water simmer for 5 minutes. Let cool. Put on top of cream cheese top with cheddar cheese shredded lettuce and tomatoes. Chill and serve with corn chips.

title: Easy Chicken-Plus
instructions: Pasta or rice can be boiled or cooked in chicken broth. Mix all ingredients add enough chicken broth to moisten to desired consistency. Add seasonings for your familys taste. (I use Cavenders Greek Seasoning and/or garlic salt.)

title: Herman'S Sidekick, The Pancake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients before blending in remaining ingredients. Mix just enough to moisten the dry ingredients. Use 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.

title: Tortilla De Patata Catalana(Potato Omelet Cataluna Style)
instructions: Peel potatoes; chop to bite size pieces. Soak in water for a while. Chop onion and crush garlic. Beat eggs; add salt and pepper. Use deep straight sided frying pan approximately 10 or 11 inches in diameter. Fry potatoes on medium heat in vegetable oil (they need not have color). Add onions and garlic when potatoes are half done. Remove from pan; drain potatoes and onions of excess oil and add to beaten eggs. Return 2 teaspoons oil to pan. Pour potato and egg mixture into pan; cook over medium heat until one side is set moving pan in circular motion. Cover pan with plate; invert omelet onto plate. Slide uncooked side of omelet into pan; continue cooking until done. Allow omelet to cool at least 30 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries in water until done (they will pop). While hot add sugar; stir until dissolved. Then add Jell-O pineapple and nuts. Pour in 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Let set overnight. In another bowl crumble up cheese in bottom then add marshmallows and whipping cream. Cover; refrigerate overnight. Before serving whip topping and spread over cranberries.

title: Great French Toast
instructions: Whisk all but bread in medium bowl. Add bread to egg batter and turn until thoroughly coated. Put in Pammed baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until center is done.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat the first 3 ingredients. Fold in apples nuts and vanilla. Sift and add flour cinnamon soda and salt. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar oleo and corn syrup. Bring to a rolling boil. Cool and add to beaten eggs. Add pecans. Put in pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until center is set. A toothpick inserted in center will come out clean.

title: Fruity Topped Pizza
instructions: Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices. Arrange cookie slices slightly overlapping on aluminum foil covered 14-inch pizza pan. Press edges to seal. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden. Cool; remove from foil onto serving dish. Combine cream cheese milk sugar vanilla and almond extracts until well blended. Spread over crust. Arrange fruit on cream cheese mixture. Glaze with combination of apricot preserves water and strawberry extract. Cut into wedges. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Greek Pizza
instructions: Lightly oil a cookie sheet with Pam spray and let frozen loaf defrost. Spread dough out and cover with crushed tomatoes and remainder of ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 20 to 30 minutes (until bottom of crust is lightly brown). Each package will make 2 pizzas.

title: Chocolate Cake Pudding
instructions: Sift together 1 1/2 cups sugar flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Mix together nuts milk butter and vanilla. Combine all ingredients and pour into a large greased pan.

title: Chinese Skillet Hamburger
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add onions to skillet and fry slowly until transparent. Add chow mein and hamburger; stir. Add mushrooms and stir. Sprinkle cornstarch over ingredients. Stir. Add soy sauce; stir. Simmer five minutes. Add wine.

title: *Yogurt(Marcat)
instructions: Pour milk in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and pour into a bowl. Let milk cool to 115\u00b0 (candy thermometer). Dilute Dannon yogurt with 1/2 cup warm milk and stir into milk. Cover and wrap in Turkish towel. Set in warm place for 4 hours. When custard consistency place bowl in refrigerator.

title: Banana-Nut Icebox Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks and lemon extract. Beat several minutes. Beat egg whites very stiff. Fold into mixture and add nuts. Crush vanilla wafers. Put into pan a layer of crumbs layer of custard then bananas (sliced thin); repeat to finish with the crumbs on top. Set overnight to chill. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: In saucepan add soup oil sugar vinegar salt mustard pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil then cool. Pour over carrots and seasoning. Chill about 2 hours before serving. Taste will be better after 1st day.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar together then add eggs. In separate bowl blend 3 cups shredded zucchini vanilla and ground cloves together then add to shortening mixture. Add water. Mix dry ingredients then add. Stir in nuts and raisins.

title: Crece-Fried Bread Dough (Italian)
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in lukewarm water (not hot). In a large bowl put the flour and add salt sugar and oil. Pour yeast mixture over flour; knead until smooth in texture. Let rise for 1 1/2 hours or until double in size.

title: Ham Hotrods
instructions: Spread mixture on hog dog buns. Wrap each in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill and then shape into a large ball.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Mix well and store in covered dish in refrigerator.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: Simmer raisins and water in small covered kettle for 5 minutes. Mix soda nutmeg and cinnamon with flour. Cream sugar margarine and shortening together. Beat eggs and add to creamed mixture.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: Cook mostaccioli in a large amount of boiling salted water for about 14 minutes or just until tender. Set aside.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter margarine Crisco and sugar. Add eggs beating after each egg. Blend flour and baking powder. Add flour mixture and milk to creamed mixture; continue to mix on medium speed. Add vanilla. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cake is done when toothpick comes out clean.

title: Peanut Cornflake Squares
instructions: Combine cornflakes and peanuts in large lightly buttered heat-proof mixing bowl. Place in slow oven (250\u00b0) for 5 to 8 minutes. Mix sugars syrup and water. Place over medium heat and let mixture come to full boil. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and butter. Place over low heat until mixture comes to a gentle boil to center of pan. Stir constantly. Pour hot mixture over warmed cornflakes and nuts. Mix well. Turn into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Press down firmly. Melt chocolate bits and shortening over hot water in a double boiler. Cool slightly and spread over cereal mixture. Cool in fridge until chocolate sets.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a punch bowl. Stir. Add crushed ice.

title: Appetizer
instructions: Mix first four ingredients and spread over beef. Roll up beef and refrigerate for at least one hour. Cut into 2-inch slices and serve.

title: Penuche(Candy)
instructions: Cook brown sugar white sugar salt corn syrup butter canned milk and water to soft ball. Remove from stove and add nuts and vanilla. Place pan in cold water to aid cooling process; stir occasionally. As candy loses it shine pour into a buttered pie pan. Cut candy while still a little soft.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over cabbage leaves; let stand for 5 minutes and drain. Season meat. Add onion rice and egg. Roll a portion of filling into each leaf; fasten with toothpicks. Place the rolls on rack in pressure cooker. Pour soup and water over rolls. Cook on 15 pounds of pressure for 8 minutes after jiggles.

title: Blueberry Creme Pie
instructions: Stir milk and lemon juice until thick. Fold in Cool Whip or whipped cream. Mix in washed blueberries. Spoon into a graham cracker crust. Chill. Top with Cool Whip.

title: German Farmer'S Breakfast
instructions: Dice and cook potatoes. Fry bacon and crumble. Saute onions in bacon grease. Beat eggs with the milk and salt. Cook until almost done and add potatoes bacon and cheese.

title: Lemon Jello Cake
instructions: Mix the above ingredients well for 3 minutes at high speed (in the order given). Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour the mixture in and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Mix buttermilk and pudding together then add Cool Whip and mix. Drain fruit and add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Family Garden Vegetable Soup
instructions: In food processor chop carrots parsnips and scallions. Mince garlic. Melt butter in large stock pot saute vegetables and garlic 5 minutes. Add chicken broth and potatoes. Cook covered 10 minutes. Add tomatoes parsley basil tarragon pepper and nutmeg. Cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Uncover and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt the butter. Mix all ingredients with butter. Refrigerate. Cut into pieces.

title: Refrigerator Yeast Rolls(Southern Living)
instructions: Combine milk shortening and sugar in saucepan. Heat until shortening melts. Cool to 105\u00b0 to 115\u00b0. Place yeast in a large bowl. Add milk mixture and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in 3 cups of flour. Cover and let stand at room temperature 1 1/2 hours. Add remaining 2 cups flour baking powder soda and salt stirring well. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 8 hours or up to 5 days!

title: Lasagna
instructions: Fry meat and drain. Add spaghetti sauce mushrooms and seasonings. Boil noodles. Mix cottage and Parmesan cheeses and egg. Layer meat sauce noodles cottage cheese mixture and Mozzarella cheese. Continue layering in that order until all is used. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in 1 stick of margarine. Mix with hash browns chicken soup and sour cream. Melt 2nd stick of margarine mix with crushed tube of Ritz crackers and set aside. Salt and pepper potato mixture to taste. Sprinkle with grated cheese and cracker topping.

title: Tomato Soup Salad
instructions: Bring soup to boiling point. Add cheese and let cool. Dissolve Jell-O in water and add. Add other ingredients. Pour into molds and allow to become firm. Unmold on lettuce.

title: Grammy Keef'S Homemade Brownies
instructions: Add shortening to chocolate. Melt in a double boiler. Beat eggs. Add sugar gradually. Add chocolate mixture and beat well. Sift flour and salt together; add to mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in a greased 8 x 12-inch pan for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grilled Rock Lobster Tails
instructions: Cut underside\tmembrane of lobster tails and around edges and remove. Insert skewers lengthwise through meat to keep tails flat during cooking. Place on grill about 4 inches from coals flesh side down 3 to 5 minutes. Turn brush meat with a mixture of pineapple juice and remaining ingredients and continue grilling until meat is opaque and tender.\tBrush meat several times during cooking and again just before serving. Serve with remaining sauce and lemon wedge.

title: Spicy Texas Casserole
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in skillet and brown. Mix all other ingredients with the meat. Bake in covered casserole at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove cover and bake another 15 minutes. Grated cheese may be added.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix self-rising cornmeal plain cornmeal and sugar; add boiling water and mix well. Beat eggs and milk. Pour into cornmeal mixture. Stir well. In 10-inch frying pan or baking dish melt margarine. Pour batter into pan. Scoop margarine over the top of batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until nice and brown.

title: Dip
instructions: Mix until smooth. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Frozen Raspberry Salad
instructions: Pour boiling water on gelatin in large bowl; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in raspberries (with syrup). Mix remaining ingredients; stir into gelatin mix. (Salad will be slightly lumpy.)

title: Cindy'S Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil one chicken with a pinch of rosemary. Bone and pull off bone. Cook two packages of chopped broccoli according\tto directions\ton packages. Put one layer\tbroccoli chicken salt and pepper to taste and Parmesan cheese. Layer twice. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Combine soda to milk and then add to mixture. Then add rest of ingredients. Drop from spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Miracle Diet Soup
instructions: Cut vegetables; cover with water in large pot. Boil for 10 minutes. Cover and lower heat; simmer until vegetables are soft. Eat as much and as often as you want. Can be frozen.

title: Lime-Cheese Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water add cold water. Let thicken slightly. Mix remainder of ingredients and add to jello. Refrigerate 2 hours.

title: Hamburger Pizzazz
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle into raw hamburger and form patties. Can also be used as a rub for chicken.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Toss with fork the sugar flour and corn meal. Add eggs butter milk lemon juice and rind. Beat thoroughly. Pour into shell. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 then 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Round Steak (Or Chuck)(Crockery Cooking)
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot cover and cook on low for 6 to 9 hours. Serve with mashed potatoes (rich gravy). More liquid if needed.

title: Country French Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet melt butter or margarine over medium heat. Add chicken; saute 5 minutes. Stir in water soup mix and lemon. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken and discard lemon. Combine sour cream cornstarch and dill weed. Add to skillet and bring to a boil stirring constantly until thickened. Return chicken to skillet until serving time. Serve over rice or pasta. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
instructions: In large bowl mix cornmeal salt and soda. Add remaining ingredients; stir just until blended. Turn into well-greased 12-inch round baking dish or skillet. Bake 40 or 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until set.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix with Ranch dressing.

title: Golden Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cook cauliflower in 1 cup water until tender; drain reserving liquid. Blend cauliflower and reserved liquid until smooth. Saute onion in butter in saucepan until tender; stir in flour. Gradually add remaining cup of water and the bouillon stirring until well blended. Heat; stir while thickening. Stir in blended cauliflower and shredded cheese. Cook until cheese melts. Add milk and nutmeg. Heat through; garnish with parsley. Makes 6 to 8 cups.

title: Mama'S Corned Beef Hash
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into small cubes and brown lightly in oil. Chop onion and saute in oleo.

title: Hawaiian Punch Jelly
instructions: Bring punch sugar and lemon juice to a boil. Remove from heat and add pectin. Return to heat and boil 1 minute. Seal in sterilized jars. Yield 5 six-ounce jars.

title: Chicken Veg
instructions: Use quantities to suit your needs. Cut up chicken or breast. Brown in heavy skillet with oil. Remove chicken then in skillet place cut up celery carrots onion and potato cut into quarters. Place chicken on top. Place lid on skillet and cook for 45 minutes or until veggies are cooked. Add a little water to bring to steam if needed.

title: Fruit Yogurt Swirl
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of electric blender. Cover and process until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve immediately. Makes 3 cups.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Combine and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Can be served with rice or chow mein noodles.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Cook raisins or apples. Make pie crust. Take a saucer and cut out some shells and fill the half crust with fruit. Fold over and pinch the edges together and fry. Fry until crust is brown. Good for an afternoon snack for school children.

title: Best Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy; add oil sugar zucchini nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour and cinnamon; pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done; cool for 15 minutes. Remove and cool on a rack. Best when 2 to 3 days old. Can be frozen.

title: Spicy Oyster Crackers
instructions: Combine Hidden Valley dressing and dill weed with vegetable oil. Toss with oyster crackers.

title: Aglio A Olio(Garlic And Oil Sauce With Tuna And Anchovies)
instructions: Boil large pan of water. When boiling add linguine; cook according to directions. While water is heating in a small saucepan put oil and garlic. Saute until golden. Add anchovies with capers; cook just until dissolved. Add tuna and heat. Turn off. Reheat one minute when linguine is done.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 12 muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.

title: Foil Packs
instructions: Wrap in aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. These are also good to cook in hot fire coals while camping. Cook for about 1 hour also.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Pour on top of spinach salad with bacon pieces and sliced hard-boiled egg.

title: Sweet Fern Tea
instructions: Pick sweet fern and hang to dry. Takes approximately 3 days to dry. When dry pick leaves off stems and crush; store in container for later use.

title: One Dish Dinner
instructions: Layer rice and corn in a baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour 1 can of soup and 1/2 cup water over corn. Add onion and green pepper. Crumble uncooked hamburger over onion and green pepper. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour another can of tomato soup and 1/4 cup water over meat. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake about 30 minutes longer.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie(Frozen)
instructions: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons milk in saucepan over low heat stirring until chocolate is melted. Beat sugar into cream cheese. Add remaining milk and chocolate mixture. Beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping (thawed) blending until smooth. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm (about 4 hours). Garnish with chocolate curls.

title: Cherokee Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion; cook until onion is transparent. Stir in seasonings and tomatoes. Add soup and rice; simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Place mixture in baking dish. Top with cheese strips. Broil briefly until cheese is melted. Yields 6 servings.

title: Pizza Spread
instructions: Mix well but do not beat! Spread on buns and put in broiler oven until cheese melts.

title: Quick And Easy Yellow Cake
instructions: Measure ingredients into a mixing bowl. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water until tender. Drain and rinse.

title: Double-Chocolate Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt 1 cup chocolate morsels in a heavy saucepan over low heat reserving remaining morsels. Set melted morsels aside. Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until fluffy; gradually add 1 cup sugar beating well. Add egg milk and vanilla mixing well. Add melted morsels mixing until blended. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients; gradually add to butter mixture mixing well. Stir in remaining chocolate morsels. Roll dough into balls one tablespoon at a time. Roll balls in 1/2 cup sugar. Place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. (Cookies will be soft and firm up as they cool.) Remove to racks to cool. Yields 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Amish Friendship Bread
instructions: Stir yeast and milk then add flour and sugar. Put in jar put plastic on top. Leave on counter. Stir it 2 times a day for 7 days with wooden spoon or plastic. After 7th day start the following process.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Combine first 11 ingredients in a large bowl; beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool loaves in pans for 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks. Drizzle bread with Orange Glaze. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Chris' Pasta
instructions: Saute mushrooms onions garlic and parsley in margarine. At same time warm 2 cans cream of mushroom soup and sour cream. Add mushroom mixture to soup and sour cream. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve over cooked egg noodles and garnish with shredded Cheddar cheese.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain well. Mix cornmeal flour egg corn peppers and onion in large bowl. Pour 1/2 cornbread mixture into greased pan (10 x 13-inch). Layer cornbread mixture with meat and cheese. Pour remaining cornbread mixture on top of meat and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (golden brown).

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except potato chip mixture. Pour into a large baking dish and top with potato chip-cheese mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven (preheated) for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add melted oleo and crushed crackers on top. Cook about 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Real Dill Pickles
instructions: Put dill weed and 1 to 2 sections garlic cloves in bottom of each quart jar. Add each cucumber (whole) to fill jar. Bring mixture of water vinegar and salt to boil. Pour over cucumbers. Seal with hot lid. Turn jars upside-down for 8 hours.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Sprinkle nuts figs and raisins with a small amount of flour. Cream the butter. Blend in molasses and honey. Add eggs. Sift baking powder remaining flour salt and spices. Add to batter alternately with milk. Bake 2 hours in greased 10-inch tube pan at 300\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Relish
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a medium size glass bowl and mix well. Cover and let stand at room temperature at least 30 minutes before serving. Or chill in the refrigerator overnight. Stir well and serve on hamburgers or as an accompaniment to meats. Store tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. Makes about 1 1/4 cups.

title: Poppy Seed Salad
instructions: Cut lettuce and green onions. In another bowl mix almonds and noodles. In a shaker or jar add sugar oil Accent salt vinegar poppy seed and pepper. Just before serving add noodles and almonds to lettuce then shake dressing well and pour over lettuce mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain. Place cooked turkey in 3-quart casserole dish. Pour in soup and broth. Add other ingredients. Toss lightly. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Potato Salad
instructions: Scrub potatoes and cook in jackets until fork-tender. Drain and cool. Remove jackets and cut potatoes to desired size. Dice hard-boiled eggs onion and celery. Combine with the potatoes. In a separate bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour over potatoes and eggs. Chill until serving time.

title: Chicken And Fruit Salad
instructions: Toss chicken celery grapes pineapple chunks orange segments and 2 teaspoons of pecans together gently. Mix salad dressing and salt with chicken mixture and chill. Place lettuce leaves and cantaloupe slices on plate and top with chicken salad. Garnish with remaining pecans. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice and broccoli according to package directions. Saute onion and celery in melted butter. Combine sauteed vegetables rice and broccoli. Melt Cheez Whiz in soup and 1/2 cup water in saucepan. Stir in broccoli mixture blending well. Spoon in greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cherry-Hot Muffins
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Add milk and egg; beat well. Add butter. Fold in 1 cup cherries. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot with butter.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Simmer until celery is tender.

title: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Heat oil and add onion pepper and garlic. Saute 4 minutes or until onion is soft. Add carrots. Cook covered for 2 minutes. Add zucchini squash chili powder oregano and cumin. Saute one minute. Add tomatoes water and salt. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer partially covered for 15 minutes. Stir in all beans. Simmer stirring frequently 10 minutes to heat through.

title: Cacciatore Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops in a frying pan with garlic seasoning or salt and pepper. Place in a flat 9 x 14-inch oblong shallow baking dish. Mix tomatoes and spaghetti sauce mix together. Pour mixture over the pork chops. Place onions on top. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Casserole
instructions: Put 1 can cream of celery soup (undiluted) in electric skillet. Slice potatoes on top of soup. Put cabbage on top of potatoes then green chilies on top of cabbage. Put another can of undiluted cream of celery soup on top of this. Cook until vegetables are done. Slice German sausage on top of this; cook just until sausage is warmed.

title: Buttercream Eggs
instructions: Cream butter with cream cheese. Add confectioners sugar and vanilla. Form into balls. Chill. Coat with melted chocolate.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onions drain. Add soup and vegetables. Pour in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Squash Pie
instructions: Mix all in blender. Pour into a 9-inch pie shell and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until knife inserted into center comes out clean like custard. I like to serve it very cold with Cool Whip in the summer.

title: Sweet Berry Muffins
instructions: Stir flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Set aside. Cream butter sugar and almond extract. Add eggs one at a time. Beat thoroughly after each. Add flour mixture; fold in berries. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Put together beef spices and tomatoes. Heat through. Cover bottom and sides with tortillas in 9x13 pan. Spread meat inside; top with tortillas. Mix cottage cheese mexican cheese and egg. Pour over tortillas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Serve with salsa sour cream lettuce tomatoes and onions.

title: Mama'S Gingerbread (Mrs. Ruth Clapp)(Molasses Cake)
instructions: Mix eggs brown sugar molasses shortening or margarine and boiling water. Add flour mixed with baking powder salt soda and spices.\tPour into 9 x 12-inch greased pan (will be thick when cut into squares) or can bake in muffin pans (24). Add raisins to batter after it is in the baking pan. Lightly press into the batter with a fork.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes less for muffins.

title: Crawfish Fettucine
instructions: Melt butter; add onions bell peppers celery and garlic and lightly brown. Add crawfish tails and cook approximately 15 minutes. Add cream cheese Tonys and noodles and let set for approximately 5 minutes. Cook noodles first (add parsley after crawfish has cooked). May add mushrooms if desired. When you add your half and half and cheeses cook on a low fire for approximately 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Soup
instructions: Saute Italian sausage onion and garlic cloves. Add stewed tomatoes beef broth water red wine carrots basil oregano and tomato paste. Cook for 1 hour.

title: Quick And Easy Pot Pie
instructions: Place biscuits in pie pan. Mix soup and chicken. Pour over biscuits and bake according to directions on biscuit can. Serve immediately.

title: Breakfast Souffle
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Mix all ingredients together. Add sausage to mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Chill overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs and mix well. Combine jam and buttermilk. Add alternately to creamed mixture with sifted dry ingredients. Fold in jam. Pour into well-greased tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until well done.

title: Unbaked Fruitcake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into small loaves. Roll in powdered sugar. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Bring to a boil all except popcorn. Let boil 5 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon soda. (It will foam.) Stir well. Pour over popcorn and stir well. Bake 1 hour at 200\u00b0; stir 2 times while baking. When done spread out on table to cool.

title: Sweet Potato Cobbler
instructions: Cover potatoes with water and cook until almost tender. Put into baking pan. Add sugar nutmeg cinnamon and butter. Put pie crust on top.\tSprinkle with\tsugar and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: V-8 Vegetable Dip
instructions: Beat all ingredients until smooth. Chill and serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Raspberry Fudge Truffles
instructions: Microwave chocolate morsels in a 4 c glass measuring cup at high 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until melted stirring every 30 seconds. Beat cream cheese at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Add melted chocolate preserves and liqueur beating until blended. Stir in vanilla wafer crumbs; cover and chill 2 hours. Shape mixture into 1 inch balls; cover and freeze 1 hour or until firm. Microwave chocolate coating in a 4 cup glass measuring cup at high 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until melted stirring every 30 seconds. Dip balls in coating; place on wax paper. Place white chocolate and shortening in a small heavy duty ziploc bag. Submerge in hot water until chocolate melts; knead until smooth. Snip a tiny hole in 1 corner of bag and drizzle mixture over truffles. Let stand until firm. Store in refrigerator or freezer.

title: Hearty Beef Stew
instructions: Mix well flour salt and pepper then roll meat in mixture and brown in oil using large Dutch oven then brown onions. Add water and carrots; bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours until meat is tender then add peas or beans. Cover and continue to cook until meat is completely done. Can be stored in freezer.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes cut into quarters. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper in a bag. Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in the bag coating potatoes with the dry mixture. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place potatoes in the pan. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Turn during baking. Sprinkle with chopped parsley when browned and tender. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hot Asparagus Salad(Serves 4)
instructions: Fry bacon bits in a skillet until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and reserve. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the drippings from the pan and discard. Trim asparagus and cut off tips. Cut stems on the diagonal into pieces 1 inch long. Add stems to skillet and cook over medium-high heat stirring constantly until they are crisply tender and bright green about 5 minutes. Add tips and cook 1 minute longer. Add vinegar sugar mustard salt and pepper then heat to boiling while stirring. Add bacon bits. Put lettuce in a warmed bowl. Pour asparagus mixture over. Sprinkle with eggs toss and serve warm.

title: Trailside Oatmeal Treats
instructions: In a large bowl cream first four ingredients. Stir in eggs milk and vanilla. Add flour soda salt and oatmeal. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips peanut butter chips walnuts raisins coconut or whatever you like. I use 1 cup chopped walnuts 1 cup raisins and 1 cup chocolate chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven about 12 minutes. Makes about 8 dozen.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening with sugars; add egg and pineapple mixing thoroughly. Add flavoring. Sift flour measure and sift with salt baking soda and baking powder. Add to first mixture. Add nuts. Mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Water Chestnut Casserole
instructions: Mix together all of the ingredients; put in a 2-quart casserole dish. Melt 1 stick butter (oleo) and stir in one row of crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle mixture over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Tortellini Salad
