instructions: Steam vegetables (broccoli and carrot) 3 minutes. Plunge into cold water and drain. Combine vegetables with tortellini pepper and onion. Combine remaining ingredients in plastic container with lid. Shake! Pour over broccoli mixture. Refrigerate and enjoy!

title: Beet Salad
instructions: Chop beets and prunes. Mix beets and prunes with walnuts. Add mayonnaise and salt to taste. Mix and put in refrigerator for 2 hours.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Saute bacon in a Dutch oven until brown and crisp. Add onion and cook until tender. Add water and potatoes; simmer until tender.

title: Cantonese Dinner
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Put meat and all other ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Cheesy Chicken
instructions: Separate crescent rolls into 8 rolls. Cut thawed chicken breasts into 3 pieces each. Lay 1 piece of chicken on each open crescent roll then sprinkle shredded cheese over chicken. Close ends to cover chicken. Place crescent rolls in 9 x 12-inch dish.

title: Vegetable-Cheese Bake
instructions: Place vegetables in shallow baking dish (10 x 6 x 2-inch). Blend soup milk and cheese; pour over vegetables. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Gold Rush Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter; pour in casserole. Pour potatoes over butter; add onions. Mix sour cream cheese and soup and spoon over potatoes. Sprinkle with crushed cereal or cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Cranberry Orange Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add eggs orange juice and oil. Mix well. Add nuts and mix. Add cranberries and mix. Pour into greased tins and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Yield 12 muffins (large).

title: Chicken Cordon Gold (Serves 6)(Preparation Time: 1 Hour)
instructions: Pound chicken breasts thin. Flour chicken breasts. Spread Boursin cheese on breasts. Top with Prosciutto. Roll up; secure with toothpick. Brown in 1/4 cup butter. Add 1/2 cup Galliano liqueur and chicken bouillon simmer 30 to 40 minutes. While chicken is cooking make rice. Saute mushrooms with remaining butter and Galliano. Serve on platter with chicken breast on rice. Cover with mushrooms and sauce.

title: Lazy Man'S Lasagna
instructions: Brown green pepper onion and hamburger in skillet. Season to taste with garlic powder. Cook macaroni as specified on box. Mix hamburger mixture spaghetti sauce shredded cheese and macaroni in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan (add mushrooms if desired). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour or until cheese is melted.

title: Hamburger Beans
instructions: Cook ground beef with onion pepper garlic and seasonings. Drain. Mix flour with meat. Add beans and parsley. Add barbecue sauce and mustard. Heat and serve.

title: Honey Cookies
instructions: In an electric mixer bowl beat eggs at high speed until very pale and airy about 3 minutes. Gradually add sugar and continue beating until the mixture forms a ribbon about 5 minutes. Add honey vanilla anise seeds grated orange and lemon zest beating after each ingredient. Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Add to the egg mixture and using a rubber spatula stir in gently to incorporate. Transfer dough to a lightly floured work surface and knead briefly. Press dough into floured molds (use your favorite holiday molds). Lightly tap molds to release imprinted cookie dough. Transfer to baking sheet. Position rack in the middle of an oven preheated to 300\u00b0. Bake until lightly golden and very crisp approximately 20 minutes. Transfer to cooling racks and let cool completely. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks. Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix well. Form into little balls. Put on greased cookie sheet (Pam works well). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mother'S Pineapple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Beat egg whites first. Set aside. Combine all other ingredients. Add egg whites last. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Lower heat to 350\u00b0 and bake until done. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle lemon pepper and salt on sirloin steak. Cook until tender.

title: Oven Omelet
instructions: In a large bowl beat the eggs milk and salt. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased 8 inch square baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 - 50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.

title: Texas Governor'S Mansion Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour baking powder soda salt and cinnamon in a bowl. In a very large bowl beat butter on medium speed until creamy. Gradually beat in both sugars for 2 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beat well and and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture until just combined. Add chocolate chips oats coconut and pecans. Drop by tablespoon onto lightly greased baking sheets spacing 2 - 3 inches apart.

title: Ravioli In Tomato-Basil Sauce
instructions: About 1 hour before serving in a 12-inch skillet over high heat to 8 cups boiling water add both packages of frozen ravioli. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook 15 to 20 minutes until ravioli are tender turning ravioli once so they cook evenly. Drain.

title: Best Banana Bread
instructions: Mix as given. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour in 2 loaf pans.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in Bundt pan for one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Refrigerator Dill Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers. Add salt and stir. Let stand 1 hour and drain (do not rinse). Stir in onion and green pepper. Combine sugar vinegar and celery seed. Heat until comes to a boil. Remove from heat and cool. Pour over cucumber mixture and stir. Put in gallon container and refrigerate.

title: Coconut Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake according to directions. While still hot poke holes all over cake. Spoon cream of coconut over cake. Spread Cool Whip over cake and sprinkle with coconut. Store in refrigerator.

title: Mud Cake
instructions: Five minutes before cake is done bring to a boil the first 3 ingredients. Add confectioners sugar. Beat well and pour over cake.

title: Beets
instructions: Drain beets reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Mix sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan. Blend in reserved beet liquid vinegar and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat; simmer for 2 minutes. Add beets and simmer for 15 minutes longer. Stir in butter before serving.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Combine flour and sugar. Add melted margarine eggs and vanilla. Mix by hand and add chocolate chips. Mix well. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. (Do not overcook.)

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake for 45 minutes at 375 degrees. Cook slice and serve.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon; when almost done add onion. Crumble bacon. Add brown sugar; stir until all the sugar is melted. Add beans (drain off any juice). Add remaining ingredients; stir until well blended. Cook in crock-pot on slow until desired thickness.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: In oblong 9 x 13-inch pan or long serving dish layer ingredients as follows

title: Grandma'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Shape into ball and refrigerate for a while until a little firm. Roll ball in chopped pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add a little milk if necessary. Place in baking dish and bake for 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Almond Joy Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 line cookie sheets with foil.

title: Tennessee Fried Shrimp
instructions: Peel turnips to white meat. Cut into slices similar to French fries. Rinse in cold water. Mix egg and milk. Roll turnip slices lightly in flour; dip in egg and milk mixture and in flour seasoned with Lawrys Seasoning. Fry in deep fryer at 300 to 350\u00b0 until golden. Serve with cocktail sauce.

title: Fabulous Fudge
instructions: Grease an 8-inch square pan. In medium saucepan combine butter evaporated milk sugar and salt. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 4 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Then remove from heat. Stir in vanilla morsels marshmallows and nuts. Stir vigorously for 1 minute or until marshmallows are completely melted. Pour into pan. Let it cool then cut it into squares.

title: Zuke Bread
instructions: Put together in order given. Pans must be greased and floured. Fill 2/3 full. Makes 4 medium loaves at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour 2 large loaves at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or 5 small loaves at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm with butter or cream cheese. Ummm!

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer all ingredients in the following order beans sprinkled with chili powder avocados mashed with lemon juice sour cream scallions taco sauce olives and cheese. Refrigerate covered. Best to make day before party. Serve with large taco chips.

title: Tasty Tipsy Tips
instructions: Preheat chicken fryer and saute meat until browned. Add salt flavor crystals caraway seed mushrooms onion and garlic. Cook for 3 minutes. Add Burgundy bourbon tomatoes and bouillon cubes and simmer for 25 minutes or until meat is tender. Serve with hot rice or whipped potatoes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Finger Salad
instructions: Prepare vegetables and put into large container. Combine oil vinegar salt pepper garlic powder and sugar; blend well. Pour over vegetable mixture. Marinate overnight turning periodically.

title: Barbecue Beef Brisket Or A Roast
instructions: Spread onions over top of meat. Make a sauce with the rest of the ingredients except potatoes and mushrooms and pour over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours then 1 hour before serving add potatoes and mushrooms.

title: Quesadillas
instructions: Set out bowls of Monterey Jack cheese green chilies avocado slices salsa and a saucepan of chopped chicken or turkey sauteed with a little chopped onion.

title: Roast Chicken With Automatic Gravy(Bob'S Own)
instructions: Prepare chicken by removing all the visible fat wing tips and tail. Wash thoroughly and dry well. Spray with oil inside and out. Sprinkle garlic powder over outside and in the inside. Put chicken in a small roaster uncovered. Roast at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes to brown. Blend both soups together; then add milk. When chicken is brown put soups over and around chicken. Add mushrooms and bake with cover on for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Raspberry Pie
instructions: Mash about 2 cups raspberries to measure 1 cup; place in a saucepan. Add sugar cornstarch and water. Bring to a boil stirring constantly; cook and stir 2 minutes longer. Strain to remove berry seeds if desired. Cool to room temperature about 20 minutes. Meanwhile for filling beat cream cheese whipped topping and confectioners sugar in a mixing bowl. Spread in bottom of crust. Top with remaining raspberries. Pour cooled raspberry sauce over top. Refrigerate until set about 3 hours. Store in refrigerator.

title: Gin Swizzle
instructions: Into 12 ounce Tom Collins glass put juice of lime powdered sugar and carbonated water (lemon-lime soda is okay). Fill glass with shaved ice and stir thoroughly with swizzle stick. Then add bitters and dry gin. Fill with carbonated water (soda) and serve with swizzle stick in glass. The individual is to do the final stirring.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Mix with all other ingredients except nuts. Place in freezer for about 20 minutes to firm up. Form into ball and roll in nuts.

title: Lo-Fat Easy Lasagne Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Brown ground beef and onion and drain. Stir in tomato sauce and spaghetti mix with meat until thick. Drain noodles. Combine cream cheese and milk in a saucepan until smooth. Stir in noodles and garlic. Pour in 9-inch dish. Spread meat mixture over. Top with cheese halfway through baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Caussolet(French White Bean Stew)
instructions: Brown the lamb chop. Saute all vegetables in the drippings. Place all ingredients in large pot. Cover with water. Bring to a slow boil. Cook until beans are soft replenishing water as needed. Should take 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Serve over rice. Add salt and pepper to taste. Feeds 8 to 10.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Add in order given. Bake in two 9 inch unbaked pie shells. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then lower heat to 350\u00b0. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Christmas Smells
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a stainless steel saucepan or crock-pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce to low with lid off and allow to simmer. House will be filled with a wonderful aroma.

title: Stack-Ups
instructions: Put meat onion and garlic powder (clove) in a skillet and brown. Add all other ingredients except rice and simmer 30 minutes. Add rice. Pour into crock-pot and cook on low for about 1 to 2 hours.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans. Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Melt brown sugar flour and butter together in iron skillet or heavy pan. Add hot milk and let boil. Stir in 3 beaten egg yolks and cook until thick. Take off heat and add vanilla and let cool.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In large bowl beat eggs until thick. Beat in sugar. Mix together butter flour cocoa vanilla coconut and nuts then add to egg and sugar mixture. Stir well with spoon. Pour into pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove immediately and spread with Marshmallow Creme.

title: Pound Cake Of Knowledge
instructions: Cream the shortening butter Crisco and butter and add sugar slowly. Add yolks then whites milk and flour. Add flavoring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients; spread in ungreased loaf pan 9 x 5 x 3-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Shortbread Crust
instructions: You also need a 9-inch pie pan greased on bottom but not on sides. Dust pan with flour. Tap out excess.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Salt and fry pork chops until browned evenly. Place rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place chops on top of rice. Pour chicken broth and 1 can water over rice. Slice onion and orange. Place a slice of each on each pork chop. Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes at 400\u00b0. Mix can of soup with 2 cups water. Add flour and make gravy. Pour over pork chops and serve.

title: Orange Roughy(Or Lemon Sole)
instructions: Rinse fish with cold water. Pat dry. Mix bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and thyme (optional). Spray baking pan. Soak fish in milk for 15 to 30 minutes before baking. Dip in crumb mixture. Place on baking sheet. Drizzle with melted butter or margarine. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mashed Chickpea Appetizer(Humus)
instructions: Open drain and rinse canned chickpeas. Mash in food processor or blender. Add mashed garlic salt and tahini paste. Blend until smooth. Add juice of 2 lemons and mix. If consistency is too thick to spread add 1 tablespoon water. Serve in a flat dish.

title: Strawberry Dip
instructions: Mix yogurt with cream cheese until smooth. Add Marshmallow Creme and mix until thoroughly blended. May be served immediately or store overnight. Serve with fresh whole strawberries preferably with stems on.

title: Coconut Cream Pie Filling
instructions: Mix flour salt egg yolks and milk. Bring to boil. Add vanilla coconut and butter. Put in baked pie shell. Beat egg whites for topping. Cornstarch can be substituted for flour.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Add sugar cocoa margarine and milk together. On medium heat let come to a boil and boil 2 minutes. Take off heat. As soon as mixture is removed from heat add peanut butter and vanilla. Mix until peanut butter is melted. Add oatmeal and mix well. Fold in pecans. Drop in desired size on wax paper. Let cool completely before removing from paper.

title: Magic Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Blend sugar and flour; add eggs and remaining ingredients. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until coconut is browned and pie is firm. Depending on the depth of your pastry pan there is enough for 2 pastry pans.

title: Karen'S Raspberry Jello
instructions: Heat applesauce; add Jell-O and mix until melted. Stir in frozen raspberries and chill until gone.

title: Apple-Filled Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Prick sweet potatoes with fork to allow steam to escape. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until fork-tender. Cut thin lengthwise slice from top of each sweet potato; scoop out inside leaving a thin shell. Set shells aside. In a large mixer bowl place hot sweet potato and remaining ingredients except apple chopped pecans and pecan halves. Beat at medium speed scraping bowl often until well mixed and no lumps remain (2 to 3 minutes). By hand stir in apple and chopped pecans. Place shells on 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan; fill shells with sweet potato mixture. If desired garnish each sweet potato with pecan halves. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Heath Bar Salad
instructions: Prepare pudding mix according to directions on box. Add broken up Heath candy bars. Fold in thawed Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated until serving time and refrigerate any leftovers (in case there are any).

title: Rhubarb Custard
instructions: Beat white of eggs and mix all together. Bake in an 8-inch pie pan.

title: Dona'S Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Best if mixed and refrigerated an hour before serving or overnight.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cube the bread; fry the sausage. Drain. Grate the cheese. Mix all ingredients together in a 9 x 12-inch dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Cut in squares and serve.

title: Cream Of Corn Soup
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Add onions and saute until soft. Add butter flour and milk. Cook until hot but do not boil. Add corn seasonings and cook until slightly thickened. Add cream and heat until smooth. Serves 6.

title: Spanakorizo(Spanish Rice)
instructions: Saute onion in oil until transparent. Add the rice tomato sauce spinach and parsley; stir well. Add the water salt and pepper and bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until rice is cooked. Before serving add the juice of half a lemon.

title: Super Cabbage
instructions: Mix celery soup milk Cheez Whiz pepper and salt. Pour over cooked cabbage. Mix bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Put in large buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle top with paprika. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pork Chop Skillet
instructions: Trim fat from pork chops and lightly brown in oil. Remove from pan. Mix soup with drippings in pan and add cheese. Simmer until cheese is melted. Place sliced potatoes in large oiled casserole and season with salt pepper and onion. Place chops on top of potatoes cover with cheese sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour 15 minutes. Turn chops once.

title: Granny'S Chocolate Marvel Cake
instructions: Into large mixing bowl sift together flour cocoa sugar baking soda baking powder and salt. In medium bowl stir together milk prunes vanilla egg whites or egg substitute and Cappuccino or coffee. Pour moist ingredients into dry blending well. Spray 2 (9-inch) round baking pans with nonstick spray. Divide batter equally between pans. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until center tests done with wooden pick. Let cakes cool in pans 10 minutes. Invert onto wire rack; cool. Use favorite fruit preserve between layers. Dust with confectioners sugar. Yield 12 servings.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops in skillet. Place in the bottom of oblong 2-quart baking dish. Cover with rice and also include V-8 tomato juice. Sprinkle with chopped bell pepper. Bake covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Mix
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add taco mix as directed on package; let cool completely. Just before serving add remaining ingredients and serve.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Wipe meat with paper towel. Over medium heat brown meat in oil and butter all over about 25 minutes. While browning towards the end add onion (roast and push to the side). Add all spices and salt; stir for about 1/2 minute. Then add liquid; bring to a boil. Reduce to simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours covered; turn occasionally. Do this roast on top of stove.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Blend together cream cheese and milk. Add vanilla and lemon juice. After mixing together pour into pie shell and chill. Top with pie filling before serving.

title: Baked Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Pour in greased casserole dish. Top with 1/2 cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter bottom and sides of a spring-form pan. Combine cracker crumbs 3 tablespoons sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Add butter and mix with fingers. Press into pan and set aside. Combine zest of lemon cream cheese and sugar. Whip until smooth and creamy. Add eggs and mix until creamy and well blended. Pour into crust and bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool 20 minutes. Mix 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon vanilla 2 tablespoons sugar and sour cream. Spread on top of cake. Bake 10 minutes then cool. Chill well. This can be served plain or with a fruit topping.

title: Four Hour Rolls
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Alternate flour and yeast water to creamed mixture until dough is stiff. Let rise about 2 hours or until double. Transfer dough to floured board. Knead for 3 minutes. Roll out dough to 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter; put small amount of margarine on roll and fold over. Let rise 1 hour. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage into skillet and cook over medium heat until done stirring occasionally. Drain on paper towels. Cut bread into 3/4-inch cubes. Place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle sausage over bread. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over mixture in pan. Chill overnight or at least 6 hours in refrigerator. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs and beat. Add flour with soda and buttermilk flavoring then bananas and nuts and beat well and bake. Grease and flour two 8 or 9-inch pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Fudge Frosted Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and 1 cup sugar. Add beaten eggs. Blend in cocoa and vanilla flavoring. Add flour and nuts. Mix well. Pour in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add flour salt pepper and curry powder. Drain mushrooms (save liquid); add water to make 1/2 cup. Stir into flour mixture. Blend in milk. Add mushrooms. Cook and stir until sauce thickens. Arrange broccoli and chicken in bottom of 9 x 13 inch dish. Pour sauce over top. Sprinkle on grated cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0 until bubbly at edges. Cool 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Hot Crossed Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine tuna peas cheese celery crumbs onion seasonings and 1 cup of mayonnaise; mix well. Spoon into 10 x 6-inch baking dish.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix well and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Spray pan. Use 2-quart dish.

title: Garlic Croutons
instructions: Rub bread slices with garlic and olive oil.

title: Sweet-Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients; form into small meatballs. Brown meatballs lightly. Cover. Cook over low heat for about 5 minutes. Drain excess fat.

title: Jellied Moose Nose
instructions: Cut the upper jawbone of the moose just below the eyes. Put in a large kettle of scalding water and boil it for 45 minutes. Remove it and plunge it into cold water to cool. Pick the hairs from the nose as you would feathers from a duck (the boiling loosens them) and wash the nose thoroughly.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Banana Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring first 2 ingredients to a boil. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes; cool before frosting.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole(For Microwave Oven)
instructions: Cook egg noodles as directed on package. In a 1 1/2-quart micro-proof dish add ham onion tarragon and butter. Cook covered on High for 3 minutes. Add soup noodles green beans and water. Cook covered on High 5 minutes. Top with bread crumbs. Cover and let stand 3 minutes before serving.

title: Lattice-Top Chicken
instructions: Combine soup milk seasoned salt chicken vegetables 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can onions. Place in 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Gumbo(8 To 10 Servings)
instructions: Place bacon in a large heavy cast-iron pot and cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove bacon; drain. Remove two tablespoons fat and add flour to make a roux stirring until light brown. Reserve. To pot drippings add onion celery peppers and garlic. Stir cooking until vegetables are just limp. Add chicken. Mix well; cover and cook for 25 minutes over low to moderate heat. Add pepper flakes bay leaves thyme and salt. Drain canned tomatoes reserving liquid and chop up. Add with liquid to chicken. Bring to a boil; add the roux and stir well. Reduce heat. Add fish shrimp okra crab meat and chicken broth. Bring to a boil; cover. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Adjust seasoning if necessary. Crumble reserved bacon and sprinkle over top.

title: Five Hour Beef Stew
instructions: Put meat and vegetables in roaster or Dutch oven. Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with tapioca. Stir. Add soup and water. Cover and bake 5 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Treasure Chest Bars
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Add brown sugar and sugar gradually to butter; cream thoroughly. Blend eggs; beat well after each and add vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk; begin and end with dry ingredients. Blend well after each addition.

title: Cajun Taters
instructions: Boil whole potatoes in skins in the shrimp and crab boil mix until tender. Cool. If you used white potatoes peel. If you used new potatoes you can leave skins on. Slice in 1/4-inch slices. Layer in casserole dish. Pour melted butter over each layer and sprinkle each layer with lemon and pepper seasoning. Crumble fried bacon over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until very lightly browned about 20 minutes.

title: Easy Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel and quarter apples; cut biscuits in half. Wrap each piece of apple in biscuit. Place each piece of covered apple in 13 x 9-inch pan. Boil water and add sugar. Stir. Add melted margarine. Sprinkle pie spice on wrapped apples. Pour hot liquid over apples. Bake until golden brown; 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Pears Dessert
instructions: Halve and core pears (dont peel; personally I just use canned pears). Spoon pecans into center of pears. In small saucepan combine corn syrup brown sugar butter water and salt and dissolve. Spoon over pears. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Baste frequently with syrup in bottom of dish. Serve with whipped cream. Serves 6.

title: Butter Rolls
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add boiling water and let cool. Add egg. Dissolve yeast in cold water; add to mixture. Mix salt with flour and add. Mix cover and refrigerate overnight or longer. Divide dough into 2 balls. Roll into circle 1/4-inch thick and 12-inch in diameter. Cut into 16 pre-shaped pieces. Roll up beginning at round edge. Place on pan with point underneath. Let rise in warm place 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 32 rolls.

title: Jim Ingoglia'S Tuna
instructions: Mix tuna and mayonnaise. Spread on bread.

title: Hot Fudge
instructions: Melt all ingredients in microwave oven until thick. Check and stir after each minute cooked.

title: Kind Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients; spoon onto cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 45 to 50 cookies.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Set aside. Grate cheese and set aside. Mix ice water and Bisquick with fork. Pour sausage and cheese into Bisquick and mix together. Form into small balls and bake on greased sheet at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Crispy Chicken
instructions: In small bowl beat together the egg and milk; set aside. Combine cornflake crumbs and next four ingredients. Dip chicken into egg mixture; roll in crumb mixture.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Quick Beefaroni
instructions: Brown meat; drain off fat. Add Miracle Whip sauce and cooked pasta. Simmer 10 minutes. Top with cheese.

title: Joyce'S Baked Beans
instructions: Put pork and beans in pan. Put in sugar and onions; stir well. Then put sliced bacon on top of the beans and bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 or 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream shortening; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs; beat well. Stir in pumpkin and water. Combine flour with baking powder soda salt cinnamon and cloves. Sift once then add to creamed mixture blending well.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in skin. Cool peel and shred. Combine cheese and butter in saucepan over low heat. Stir until almost melted. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream onion salt and pepper. Fold gently into potatoes and pour mixture in a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Chuck Bolling'S Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut the elephant into bite size pieces; this should take about 6 months. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Cook over kerosene fire for about 4 weeks at 465\u00b0. Makes 3800 servings.

title: Texas Cake
instructions: Cream together the eggs and sour cream. Add sugar flour salt and baking soda. Bring to a boil the margarine water and cocoa. Add to flour mixture. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes in an 11 x 17 x 1-inch pan.

title: All-Rite-Toe'S
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix potatoes cream of mushroom soup sour cream and cheese together. Bake in oven for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Carrot Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice 10 carrots. Cook 10 minutes. Break cauliflower into small florets. Cook about 6 minutes.

title: One Dish Meal
instructions: In a large kettle brown onions and celery. Put in other ingredients. Mix well. In a bowl mix together 2 cups corn flakes and 1/4 cup melted butter. Spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot in center and meat is done.

title: White Lasagna(Serves 10)
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter or margarine. Add flour and milk to make sauce. Cook slowly until slightly thickened. Add cayenne pepper and fresh parsley.

title: Sour Cream Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together in order as given. Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and smaller pan. Put 2/3 of batter in 9 x 5-inch pan and remaining in smaller pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy-To-Make Fudge
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add pudding and milk; bring to boil for 2 minutes. Stir in powdered sugar. Pour contents into an 8 x 8-inch pan to cool.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix soup milk and 1/2 cup of cheese over medium heat until cheese is melted. Mix chicken and onion 1/4 cup of cheese and enough of soup mixture to moisten. Roll up chicken mixture in crescent rolls.

title: Crawfish Casserole
instructions: Saute seasonings in butter until tender. Saute crawfish until tender. Add onions and soup. Add bread rice and water. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Chill pie shell. Cook and drain the bacon. Combine bacon cheese and drained corn and spread evenly over the bottom of the pie shell. In a medium bowl beat the eggs with the evaporated milk salt and pepper to create a custard. Pour custard over the bacon-cheese-corn mixture. Dot top with bits of butter. Bake on bottom shelf of the oven at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. You do not need to preheat oven. Let quiche cool 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain fat; set aside.

title: Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Beat egg well in a bowl. Add milk and melted shortening. Pour liquid over dry ingredients. Stir just enough to mix. Pour into greased rings and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Succotash
instructions: Fry meat. Mix everything together. Add water to cover the mixture. Bring to a boil and serve.

title: Linda'S Chocolate Surprise Cookies
instructions: Pour over crescent rolls. Top with 1 cup crushed pecans or walnuts for next layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Immediately after removing from the oven sprinkle 6 oz package of chocolate chips over the mixture. When they melt (3-4 minutes) spread with spatula all over. Slice into squares when cooled.

title: Lemon Sugar Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Add remaining ingredients and beat well together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 12 minutes at 400\u00b0; lower temperature to 300\u00b0 and bake 20 more minutes.

title: Beef And Bean Wraps
instructions: In skillet brown beef drain any fat stir in beans salsa veggies. Heat till veggies wilt but still crisp. Spoon about 1/2 c mixture down center of each tortilla add about 2 Tbsp cheese. Fold tortilla around filling. Serve with additional salsa and cheese.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Whip softened cream cheese with fork until creamy. Add pineapple onion pepper salt and 1 cup pecans. Mix well and form into a ball. Roll in remaining pecans. Wrap in foil and put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and 2 eggs pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese 2 eggs powdered sugar coconut and pecans well and pour over first layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 until center is set about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Turkey Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange cheese in checkerboard pattern on top of casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Homemade Salami
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Shape into rolls. Wrap in aluminum foil. Refrigerate 24 hours. Poke holes in foil and boil rolls for 1 hour. Cool and refrigerate 24 hours. Ready to eat.

title: Never Fail Cake
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar. Add beaten eggs and cocoa; mix well. Add sour milk or buttermilk and water alternately with flour and soda. Beat 150 strokes; add 3 tablespoons cold water and pinch of salt.

title: Pickle Relish
instructions: Heat until boiling; pour over pickles. Put in jars and cold pack 10 minutes.

title: Campbell'S Tomato Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender and put through sieve then add butter salt and pepper. Mix 12 tablespoons flour 16 tablespoons sugar 1 cup cream or milk mixed with flour and sugar. Add milk mixture when it boils. Boil 1/2 hour; stir often so it wont burn. Water bath 10 minutes.

title: Sausage Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine cherry pie filling cinnamon and water in a medium saucepan; heat slowly to boiling. Keep hot while making pancakes. Heat sausages as label directs; keep hot. Heat griddle. Cook pancakes. Roll around sausage; top with hot cherry sauce.

title: Easy Make Croutons
instructions: Place margarine in a 7 x 11-inch pan. Microwave on High for 1 minute. Stir in bread cubes and dried herbs. Microwave uncovered on High for 4 to 6 minutes stirring every minute. Let stand for 5 minutes to harden completely. Use for garnish for soups or salads.

title: Company Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and pepper in butter. Add meat and brown. Add tomato sauce. Cook noodles and drain. In another bowl combine cheeses and sour cream. Put 1/2 of noodles in a buttered 2-quart casserole. Spread cheese mixture over this. Top with remaining noodles and cover this with meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Light Dressing
instructions: Mix all together well. You may add 1 tablespoon of curry powder. Or add 1 tablespoon each of tarragon oregano and basil for Italian dressing.

title: Aunt Sally'S Texas Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar with electric mixer. Add eggs one at a\ttime beating well after each one. Add flour salt and vanilla and mix well. Bake in ungreased angel food pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Ice if desired.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix jello oranges and pineapple. Stir in Cool Whip. Mix together well. Chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Island Quencher
instructions: Place drink mix in pitcher or punch bowl. Add water and stir until dissolved. Add pineapple juice and grenadine; mix until well blended. Garnish with pineapple chunks and maraschino cherries.

title: Red Hot Sweet Pickles
instructions: Peel seed and cut cucumbers into rings or chunks. Soak in cold water mixed with 2 cups lime to cover for 24 hours stirring occasionally. Rinse very well in cold water and soak in cold water for 3 hours. Drain and simmer for 2 hours in the following mixture. Combine 1 cup vinegar 1 tablespoon alum 1 bottle red food coloring and water to cover. Drain and put following mixture on them. Combine 2 cups vinegar 2 cups water 10 cups sugar 8 cinnamon sticks and 8 ounces red hots. Bring to boil and pour over pickles. Let stand for 24 hours.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool 15 minutes. Poke holes in cake with a fork. Combine milk sugar and 1/2 cup coconut in pan. Boil and then simmer 1 minute. Spoon over cake. Let soak down in holes. Cool completely.

title: Veggie Casserole
instructions: Thaw vegetables. In large bowl mix vegetables soup sour cream milk 1/2 cup of shredded cheese and 1/2 can of the onions. Pour into covered 1 1/2 quart casserole. Sprinkle remaining cheese and onions on top. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Blueberry Muffins(A Low-Fat Recipe)
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar salt baking soda and powder. Combine egg whites yogurt applesauce and oil. Stir into dry mixture just until moistened. Fold in blueberries. Divide into 12 greased muffin cups. Bake for 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs or oats in pan evenly. Sprinkle coconut next then nuts then chips. Be sure they are layered evenly. Pour the milk over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into squares.

title: Sesame Steak Stir-Fry
instructions: In a large skillet heat 2 tablespoons salad oil. Saute sesame seed for 3 minutes or until golden brown. Place in shallow glass baking dish. Add onions soy sauce vinegar garlic bean sauce and ginger. Stir to combine. Marinate steak in mixture covered and turning occasionally in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight. Drain steak reserving marinade.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: *If using self-rising flour eliminate salt baking powder and soda.

title: Pierogi
instructions: Mix all ingredients with enough water to make medium soft dough. Knead well then roll out until thin. Cut into squares to make 50 pierogi. Place on each square 1 teaspoon filling. Fold in half to make triangle. (Seal edges with frothy beaten egg whites.) Pinch edges well to keep filling from escaping. Drop in salted boiling water; cook until all pierogi rise to the top and cook for 5 minutes. Drain well. Pour over browned butter or sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs.

title: Low Country Shrimp Boil
instructions: Combine water lemons onions and seasonings; cook at a rolling boil for 15 minutes. Lower to medium boil; add sausage. Cook 15 to 20 minutes then add potatoes. Cook 15 to 20 minutes then add corn. Cook 15 to 20 minutes; add shrimp. Cook 1 to 3 minutes; drain and serve.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to this alternating with beaten egg yolks buttermilk mashed bananas and pecans. Then fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done approximately 1 hour.

title: Granola Muffins
instructions: In mixing bowl combine the granola and the apricots pour boiling water over. Set aside. In another bowl stir together the flour sugar nuts baking powder and salt. Make a well in the center. Stir egg milk and oil into fruit mixture. Add all at once to flour mixture. Stir just until moistened. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Fill 2/3 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes about 18 muffins.

title: Mac And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and top with crumbled Ritz crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple with juice to hot (do not boil). Remove from heat and add jello buttermilk and Cool Whip. Can use any kind of jello molds or dish. Molds very fast.

title: Russian Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken pieces in baking dish (skin side down). Heat apricot preserves soup mix and dressing in saucepan. After preserves are melted pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Remove foil and turn chicken over. Continue baking for another 1/2 hour. Good served with white rice.

title: No-Peek Beef
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low for about 6 hours. Serve over rice or noodles. A Yummy Beef Stroganoff copy.

title: Souper Supper
instructions: Prepare soup as directed. Place all other ingredients in cooked soup and heat 10 minutes. Other vegetables and meats can be used.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add shortening and mix with fork and eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Roll dough out thin; cut into desired shapes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Graham Cracker Brittle
instructions: Line a large jelly roll pan with foil. Place graham crackers on jelly roll pan close together. Mix next 3 ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour over crackers and sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Break apart.

title: Fresh Start Punch
instructions: Mix sugar and spices. Add eggs; mix well by beating. Stir in chilled juices and ginger ale blending thoroughly. If desired add scoops of sherbet.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Cook zucchini in saucepan until tender and crisp. Drain well. Combine zucchini sugar milk flour vanilla and eggs in blender container. Process until well mixed. Pour in pie shell. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake a 425 for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350. Bake 30 minutes. Insert knife in center. If it comes out clean it is done.

title: E.Z. Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients in order listed. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Boiled Coconut Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; spread over warm cake. Place very low under broiler with heat turned low. Broil until it bubbles over the surface and becomes brown but does not burn. Icing for a 9-inch square cake.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Add salt to pumpkin then add it to creamed mixture. Mix together flour spices soda and baking powder. Add to pumpkin mixture. Bake in lightly greased tube pan approximately 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Snickerdoodles (Cookies)
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients then add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Chill dough. Form into balls and roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Combine all ingredients; store in jar or can. Dissolve 2 teaspoons of mixture in 1 cup boiling water to serve.

title: Crab English Muffins
instructions: Melt butter and Cheez Whiz in the microwave on Low heat. Add the other ingredients and mix well. Put mixture on top of 12 muffin slices it will be a little thick. Place on a cookie sheet and freeze. When youre ready to serve cut each slice into 1/4 and broil until cheese melts and is slightly golden (only slightly). Watch carefully.

title: Chicken Strata
instructions: Cut bread (6 slices) in cubes and place half in bottom of pan. Mix vegetables chicken and mayonnaise; pour over bread cubes. Place rest of bread cubes on top. Mix eggs and milk and pour over. Refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight then spread the soup and other 2 slices of bread over the rest. Cover and bake for 50 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from oven; spread cheese over and bake for 8 to 10 more minutes uncovered until cheese has melted. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and eggs until smooth. Add oil and blend. Add carrots pineapple and vanilla. Mix in sifted dry ingredients and nuts. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Hot Dog Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables coarsely. Add salt and let set overnight. Rinse and drain. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetable mixture. Heat to boiling and simmer for 3 minutes. Seal in hot sterilized jars. May substitute cucumbers for cabbage or tomatoes. Makes 8 pints.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 in a 9-inch stem pan.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend together. Roll into ball roll in crushed walnuts and chill.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Grease jelly roll pan and line with parchment paper. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs 5 minutes at high speed. Add sugar lemon juice and pumpkin. Sift flour baking powder spices and salt. Fold into egg mixture. Pour batter into prepared pan and top with nuts. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Turn immediately onto a clean linen towel that has been sprinkled lightly with powdered sugar. Roll lengthwise in the towel and cool.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Note If you use your own cooked pumpkin or squash you may need more flour up to 4 cups.

title: Mushrooms In Garlic Sauce
instructions: In 6-quart Dutch oven over medium heat in hot oil cook onion garlic rosemary and thyme until onion is tender. Increase heat to medium-high. Add mushrooms; cook until mushrooms begin to brown. Add soup and lime juice. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cook until mushrooms are tender stirring occasionally. Add wine. Cook 3 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Garnish with fresh rosemary and lime slices if desired. Serve with meat rice or noodles. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cracker Jack
instructions: Pop corn and put in huge bowl. Sort through and remove hard and unpopped kernels. Cook sugar margarine and syrup until thick about 3 minutes. Add the 1 teaspoon of soda and beat well. Pour over the popped corn and mix thoroughly. Spread out on greased cookie sheet. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 200\u00b0. Stir every 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Erin'S Favorite Cookies(Chocolate Mints)
instructions: Melt margarine add sugar water and chocolate pieces until melted. Let rest for 10 minutes. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add dry ingredients. Chill one hour.

title: Lemon Breadlubbock, Texas
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time. Add milk alternately with dry ingredients. Add rine and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes in 2 loaf pans that have been greased and floured.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Brown sausage and onion in skillet. Drain fat and add flour and mix. Pour in milk and stir over moderate heat until mixture thickens. Youre finished.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Add cheese and cool. Add ham or chicken celery peas and onion. Mix all ingredients together and moisten with salad dressing or mayonnaise.

title: Cold Oven Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and Crisco. Add eggs. Sift together all dry ingredients then add slowly to creamed mixture. Add vanilla using a Bundt pan. Place cake in cold oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cake set in pan for 10 minutes before removing.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve with fruit.

title: Deer Sausage
instructions: Combine ingredients and put through a meat grinder. Grind once for pork fat because it loses its texture if handled more; grind sausage made with beef fat twice. Wrap in 1 pound packages and freeze.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch cocoa and salt in a saucepan. Add rest of milk. Stir over medium heat constantly until it comes to a boil. Boil 2 minutes. Stir a small amount of mixture in the egg yolks then add to rest of mixture. Cook 2 more minutes stirring. Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Put meringue on and brown.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
instructions: Mix and pat out evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Nutty Cheese Bars
instructions: Base Stir together in a medium bowl until well mixed the butter cake mix (dry) and 3/4 cup chopped pecans or walnuts. Press mixture evenly into the 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Mix hot water and shortening together. Add salt and sugar. Gradually add flour and yeast mixture. Last fold in beaten egg whites. Put in greased bowl and let rise overnight in refrigerator. Make out about 2 1/2 or 3 hours before baking.

title: Our Favorite Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and syrup. Beat with mixer. Mix in pecans. Add salt and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and chilies. Put 1/2 mixture in greased Pyrex pan (8 x 8). Add chilies and cheese. Top with remaining mixture. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Butterscotch Apple Dip
instructions: In heavy saucepan over low heat combine sweetened condensed milk chips and salt. Cook and stir until chips melt. Remove from heat; stir in vinegar and cinnamon. Serve warm with apples. Makes about 1 3/4 cups.

title: Beef Tenders
instructions: Marinate 2 beef tenders for 2 or 3 hours in 1/2 bottle of soy sauce and salad oil or Italian dressing. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven (not broiler) for 30 minutes or longer depending on degree of rareness desired (30 minutes would be about medium). Do not turn meat.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Chill 8 hours or more. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Blend Ricotta and cream cheese with mixer. Add sugar; beat in eggs one at a time. Add lemon juice vanilla cornstarch flour and butter. At low speed stir until smooth. Fold in sour cream. Butter 9-inch spring form pan. Place in cold oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 exactly one hour 20 minutes no more no less. Turn off oven and let stand for 2 hours on bottom shelf. Do not open oven door. Cool before putting in refrigerator. Do not remove spring form pan until following day. Spread glaze on cheesecake.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown meat and drain. Add onion and cook until tender. Stir in tomato paste water garlic and seasonings. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. In a 12 x 8-inch baking dish layer half of noodles meat sauce Ricotta or cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Rice Krispie Squares
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal. Stir until well coated. Using buttered spatula or waxed paper press mixture evenly into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Kickin' Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix half-and-half hot pepper sauce and cumin. Peel potatoes and cut into thin slices or julienne shreds. Reserve 3 Tbsp. cheese. Alternate layers of potatoes chilies onion half-and-half mixture and cheese in a lightly greased casserole dish. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove foil. Arrange tomato slices on top and sprinkle with reserved cheese. Bake for five more minutes or broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is golden brown and bubbly. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve. Serves 6.

title: Sticky Buns With Dispatch
instructions: Start Saturday night for Sunday breakfast. Pam a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place frozen yeast rolls in pan. Sprinkle over the rolls a mixture of butterscotch pudding 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Dot with butter. Place in cold oven overnight. Do not open oven.

title: Quiche
instructions: Beat together first 3 ingredients. Layer last 4 ingredients in a large pie crust. Pour egg mixture over layered ingredients and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn heat down to 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Heat leftovers at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Carrot Ring
instructions: Cream shortening and brown sugar. Beat in egg and carrot. Add sifted flour and dry ingredients. Add water. Turn into greased 9 inch ring mold. Bake at 350 degrees until firm about 30 - 40 minutes. Serve with dinner.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Mix on medium speed the cream cheese oleo and powdered sugar; set aside. Slice 2 bananas in bottom of crust. Add pineapples and chopped cherries. Pour in filling. Top with Cool Whip cherries and chopped nuts. Refrigerate 3 hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Dream Bars
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients listed. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips in saucepan over low heat. Pour on top of peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Cut into squares.

title: Chocolate-Cinnamon Sheet Cake
instructions: About 5 minutes before cake is done melt butter cocoa and milk together in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add powdered sugar vanilla and pecans. Beat well and spread on cake while still hot. Leave cake in pan to frost.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain all vegetables well. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise. Stir into vegetables and put in 2-quart casserole dish. Top with sliced almonds. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until heated through. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Snack Pizzas
instructions: Slice the English muffins and place on a cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place pizza sauce cheese and the toppings of your choice on each slice. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in the oven and you have mini pizzas.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and then serve.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0. Cream cheese frosting tastes great on this cake.

title: Divinity Candy
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium-high heat boil sugar corn syrup and 1/2 cup water until a little forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.

title: German Chocolate Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake by directions on box. Put chopped nuts in bottom of pan followed by cake batter. Cream butter cheese and sugar together and pour on top of mix before baking. May have to drop cheese mixture by spoonfuls if too thick. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Cut the grains from the cobs. Add boiling milk butter salt and pepper to taste. Put in buttered baking dish. Dot with small pieces of butter and bake in cooker for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter and blend graham cracker crumbs and sugar together; press in 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Pea-Cheese Salad
instructions: Cook the frozen peas according to package directions. Drain and cool. In a large bowl combine peas cheese chopped eggs celery onion and sweet red pepper. Combine mayonnaise salt and pepper. Add to pea mixture. Toss to mix. Cover and chill 4 to 24 hours. Stir mixture well. Makes 6 side dish servings.

title: Gourmet Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll in ball and flatten with fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix eggs flour sugar and pineapple together. Melt butter and mix with bread cubes. Pour pineapple mixture into a casserole topping with bread and butter mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Bisquick Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Place all ingredients in mixing bowl. Beat with mixer 2 minutes. Pour mixture into 2 greased pie pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Check with a knife to see if done.

title: Tamale Enchilada Sauce
instructions: 1. In medium saucepan cook oil flour and seasonings over low heat. 2. Gradually add chicken broth and simmer the mixture about 30 minutes or until its thick. Makes about 6 cups.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Line casserole dish with Doritos. Pour mixture over Doritos. Top with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Spicy Grilled Catfish
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients; set aside. Place fish in a single layer in a lightly-greased fish basket. Combine butter and lemon juice; brush on each side of fish. Grill fish 3 to 5 inches from hot coals 5 minutes on each side basting with butter mixture when turned. Sprinkle each side of fish with seasoning mixture. Baste and grill 3 additional minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Oh So Good Corn Bread
instructions: Mix in order given and bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm in middle.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Line a large shallow casserole with uncooked meat. Sprinkle onion on top of meat. Add chicken soup (undiluted). Add one layer Tater Tots. Mix celery soup and water; pour over meat and Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Take half of dough and roll out to put in bottom of regular cake pan. Put your favorite pie filling on top. Roll out the remainder of the dough and place on top of filling. Beat egg white and put on top of the crust. Bake at 400 degrees for 35-40 minutes. Frost with powdered sugar frosting.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Start oven at 350\u00b0. Wash eggplant and peel. Cut into thick slices; dip in beaten eggs then into bread crumbs. Saute in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Place in 2-quart casserole 1 layer of eggplant then sprinkle a layer of Parmesan oregano and Mozzarella. Cover with tomato paste. Repeat until all eggplant is used. Last layer tomato paste and Mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Cook carrots tender-crisp. Add onions and peppers in Pyrex bowl. Combine remaining ingredients. Heat to simmer on low heat. Simmer 1 minute. Pour over carrots onions and green peppers. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cheddar Cheese Ball
instructions: Bring Cheddar cheese cream cheese and margarine to room temperature. Add milk onion pimento Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce. Beat until combined. Cover and chill 4 to 24 hours.

title: Crab Mold
instructions: Heat cheese and soup together until cheese melts. Dissolve gelatine in cold water. Add soup-cheese mixture. Add rest of ingredients and blend. Pour into mold and chill in refrigerator until firm. Serve on a bed of lettuce with crackers.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Bake cake as usual (see directions on box). Cool.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Mix vegetables and let stand 1 hour. Squeeze out the liquid. Add remaining ingredients. Cook 10 minutes pour into hot jars and seal.

title: Cherry Berry Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add ice cubes and stir until gelatin thickens. Remove any unmelted ice. Break up cranberry sauce with a fork. Stir into gelatin. Fold in sour cream until it is marbled into gelatin mixture. Pour into a 6-cup oiled mold. (I use Pam spray.) Chill for at least 4 hours. Unmold on bed of endive and serve.

title: Spinach Meat
instructions: Brown ground round steak and add can of spinach. In a separate bowl beat eggs; add flour and milk blended together. Stir in spinach and meat. Bake in a buttered casserole in a moderate (350\u00b0) oven for an hour.

title: Kathleen Cannon'S Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Sift the flour and salt together. Cut in the cold butter with a pastry blender until the pieces are as small as rice grains. Add the water a tablespoonful at a time until the dough is thoroughly moistened and combined. Gather it into a ball. Wrap it in waxed paper and chill it in the refrigerator.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Peel and slice cucumbers. Combine Miracle Whip vinegar sugar salt and pepper in a small bowl. Pour over cucumbers and toss to coat well.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and dry ingredients. Mixture will be stiff. Add vanilla; work nuts and apples in by hand. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Whipping Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with whipping cream and ending with flour. Mix just until blended after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean. Let cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan; let cool completely on a wire rack. Sift powdered sugar over cake. If desired garnish with strawberries and mint sprigs. Yield One 10-inch cake.

title: Lime-Cheese-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients. Cool until half stiffened. Add the milk cottage cheese pineapple and almonds. Fold in the mayonnaise. I usually add a few cut up maraschino cherries. A little horseradish is good too.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix mayonnaise warm water and soda. Mix well. Add sugar flour cocoa and vanilla. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0. Check after 20 minutes. Makes sheet cake or 2 (8-inch) layers.

title: Fresh Blueberry Pie  - No Bake
instructions: Dissolve cold water cornstarch and salt until it makes a paste. In a medium saucepan bring to boil the water sugar and 1 cup blueberries. Add cornstarch paste to mixture stirring and cooking until mixture thickens. Cool to room temperature. Fold in remaining blueberries and turn into cooked pie shell. Refrigerate until serving; top with whipped cream.

title: Cream Cheese Pastry
instructions: Unroll 1 package crescent rolls onto buttered baking sheet shaping into 13 x 9-inch rectangle. Mix together cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread over dough.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Beat egg mayonnaise and soup. Stir in broccoli onions and cheese. Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly. Best if let stand in closed container in fridge for at least a few hours before using. Will keep for weeks in refrigerator.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut up butter into pieces in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour rice over this then add soups. Add peas mushrooms and water to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil. Remove from heat and blend in peanut butter. Add corn flakes. Spread in greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle top with 1 cup chocolate chips. Melt under broiler 30 to 60 seconds then spread.

title: Knox Blox
instructions: Mix well and chill for about 1 1/2 hours in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut into squares.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl stir together flour baking powder salt ginger baking soda and cloves; set aside. In a large mixer bowl beat together brown sugar and shortening until well combined. Beat in eggs. Add pumpkin and milk; mix well. Add flour mixture to sugar-pumpkin mixture mixing well. Stir in chopped nuts and the raisins. Turn batter into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool thoroughly on a wire rack. Wrap and store overnight before slicing. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Oreo Sunday
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve about 1/2 cup crushed Oreos for top and mix remaining with margarine to form a crust in pan (press into pan). Spread softened ice cream over crust (work fast); add fudge sauce on top. Top with whipped topping. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Freeze.

title: Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Mix sugar in water; boil until dissolved then cool. Add pineapple juice orange juice lemon juice bananas and cherries. Freeze all this together until ready to use. Add 7-Up and let thaw until slushy.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: Heat the tea pot by rinsing with hot water. Bring fresh water nearly to a boil. Put 1 tablespoon dried or 2 tablespoons fresh herb leaves per cup into the tea pot. Add water and let steep for about 5 minutes. Cover the pot to enhance the flavor and retain the heat.

title: Mother'S Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs syrup oatmeal and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until an inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift flour with baking soda baking powder salt and spices. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl beat sugar with oil until smooth. Beat in eggs one at a time until smooth. Stir in pumpkin then flour mixture.

title: Corn And Hominy Casserole
instructions: Combine corn hominy green chilies sour cream salt pepper and 1/2 cup cheese. Mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle rest of cheese on top; cook for 15 more minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Makes same equivalent as a can of Eagle Brand milk.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Crumble cake and put half in bottom of large bowl. Next 1/2 of pudding then half of Cool Whip then half of candy bar. Repeat. Half recipe can be made. Freeze half of cake and use later.

title: Crab Fritters
instructions: Lightly toss wet ingredients. Add dry ingredients and mix with fingertips. Mixture should be loose and wet. Drop by spoonfuls into hot peanut oil and deep fry until golden brown. Serve with cocktail sauce.

title: Unfried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Put 1 cup yogurt into bowl. Put chicken into bowl of ice water. Boil chicken in yogurt then put in bag and shake to coat. Put chicken onto prepared baking sheet. Spray chicken lightly with Pam spray. Bake 1 hour turning pieces.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Mix all together and stir. Good over head lettuce.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix and chill. Serve with crackers or raw vegetables. Can be served from a hollowed out French bread loaf. Use cubed bread as dippers.

title: French-Style Peas
instructions: In large skillet with tight fitting lid melt 1 tablespoon butter. Spread 2 or 3 lettuce leaves in skillet. Add peas and chives. Sprinkle with salt sugar and pepper. Dot with remaining 3 tablespoons butter. Cover; cook over low heat for 30 minutes or until peas are tender. To serve discard lettuce leaves. Serves 8.

title: Dilly Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate for 6 ours or overnight. Great for a vegetable dip.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix sweetened condensed milk Cool Whip and lemonade until thoroughly blended. Add yellow food coloring until desired color. Pour into graham cracker pie shells. Chill.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the vanilla wafers in the pan followed by the pecans the chocolate chips the coconut and the milk; in that order. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until brown about 30 to 40 minutes. Cut immediately upon removal from oven; let set 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Mexican Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef in large skillet; drain. Add canned tomatoes and taco seasoning. Simmer covered for 5 minutes. Stir in 1/2 onions. In bowl combine cottage cheese 1 cup cheese and eggs. Place 3 tortillas on bottom of greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Overlap 6 tortillas around sides of baking dish. Spoon meat mixture evenly in dish. Top with 3 tortillas then cheese mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with lettuce tomatoes cheese and olives.

title: Peanut Patties(Microwave)
instructions: Combine sugar water salt and light corn syrup in a 2 quart glass measuring cup. Bring to a boil in the microwave oven (approximately 3 minutes).\tStir and add peanuts. Return to microwave oven and\tcook approximately 7\tto 9 minutes or until a soft ball stage (234\u00b0) is reached. Remove from oven; add butter vanilla and red food coloring. Cool and beat until creamy. Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet or make into two large patties.

title: Florida Orange Meringue Pie
instructions: Cook ingredients until thick. Add to baked pie crust. Add meringue and brown.

title: Easy Beef Brisket Barbecue
instructions: Rub brisket with salt. Place in a 9x13 baking pan. Mix rest of ingredients and pour over beef. Cover and bake in 325\u00b0 oven about 3 hours. Slice on the diagonal and serve with pan juices.

title: Pecan Piehouston, Texas
instructions: Heat ingredients together. Cook in unbaked shell until firm on top.

title: Crab Meat Au Gratin
instructions: In microwave Melt cream cheese and butter then mix in onion (chopped). Microwave for 1 minute. Add crab meat and remaining ingredients; stir together. Microwave for 1 minute. Stir. Microwave for 1 minute. Serve hot.

title: Rice Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except chicken) in buttered casserole dish. Cover top with chicken (unsalted). Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours covered.

title: Trifle Torte(Dessert)
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add lemon juice and chill until slightly thickened. Meanwhile prepare pudding mix with 1 cup milk as directed on package for pudding. Chill then fold in gelatin. Fold in container of the whipped topping blending until smooth. Place 1/3 of the cake cubes in 2 quart bowl. Top with 1/3 of the gelatin pudding mixture spreading evenly. Repeat layers. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and chill at least 6 hours. Use a 9 x 13-inch cake pan instead for a more cake-like dessert.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix and bake in greased pan at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Calzones
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over very warm water and let stand about 5 minutes to soften. Stir in brown sugar salt and butter. Add 2 1/2 cups white flour and beat with mixer 5 minutes. Beat in egg then mix in by hand remaining flour. Cover and let rise in warm place about 1 hour.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in double boiler. Add sweetened condensed milk and water. Cook until thick. Add vanilla and serve.

title: Saucepan Fudgies
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan melt chocolate and butter over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Cool slightly. Beat in sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Stir into mixture. Fold in nuts. Chill for about 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream the sugar and oil until thoroughly mixed. Beat eggs well. Add eggs salt and bananas. Add flour and soda. Add nuts or raisins if desired. (Soak raisins for about 3 hours and drain.) Bake in a large or 2 small loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tassies
instructions: Let cheese and butter set out at room temperature until it gets soft. Mix with flour and make out into 1-inch balls. Should make 48 balls. Spray pan with Pam!! Put into little muffin pans and press to fit pan.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Pour in pie shell. Cook until done at 425\u00b0.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Sprinkle pudding mix over pineapple and mix well. Pour remaining ingredients into pineapple mixture and stir well. Pour into serving dish and refrigerate overnight. (Mix by hand; do not use mixer.)

title: Indonesian Pork
instructions: Place metal rack or trivet in bottom of slow cooking pot. Sprinkle pork roast with salt and pepper. Put trivet in pot; pour hot water around pork roast. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or until done. Remove meat from pot. Place on broiler pan or ovenproof platter. Combine molasses mustard vinegar marmalade and ginger. Brush oven cooked pork. Brown in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes brushing several times with sauce.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix egg salt milk flour baking powder butter and sugar. Stir with long-handled wooden spoon. Add corn; let sit 5 minutes. Drop by teaspoons into hot fat; cook until puffy and golden brown. Drain on paper toweling; transfer to warm platter. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Boiled Cake
instructions: Boil sugar cold water margarine raisins salt cloves soda and cinnamon for 5 minutes. When cool add beaten eggs flour and chopped nuts and fruits. Bake in loaf pans that have been greased and floured. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 275\u00b0. Test at end of 1 1/2 hours.

title: Dirty Potatoes
instructions: Fry bacon in pot until crispy. Cut potatoes in cube size pieces. Take bacon out and put cut potatoes in bacon grease; fry potatoes until they start turning brown. Cut garlic into small pieces and saute with potatoes for about a minute. Turn down fire to medium to low.

title: Mom'S Flakey Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour until crumbly. Whip egg vinegar and water together. Stir into flour mixture. Knead together. Separate into 4 balls. Cover and let rest for 5 minutes. Roll out on floured surface to size needed for pie plate. Dough should be soft and pliable.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar vanilla and shortening until fluffy. Add eggs alternately with flour. Beat until well blended. Add lemon flavoring. Pour into well greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until center is done. Cool about 10 minutes on wire rack; remove from pan and cool completely.

title: Hot Fruit Casserole
instructions: Drain fruit. Arrange in large baking dish as desired.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Keep in covered bowl in refrigerator. This is very good with fresh vegetables or meat. Will keep for days. Serves approximately 16.

title: Plantation Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cook ground beef onion and garlic until meat is browned. Add seasoning and tomato soup; simmer covered 10 minutes. Add cheese cook slowly until cheese melts. Stir in rice. Cool. Cut peppers in half lengthwise cook in boiling salted water to cover 3 minutes. Drain and cool. Stuff with rice mixture. Wrap and freeze. To serve place partially thawed peppers in shallow pan. Cover with foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Linguine Supreme
instructions: Cook linguine; rinse in cold water and drain. Combine seasoning and salad dressing in large bowl. Add linguine and quartered tomatoes and cukes. Marinate overnight. Serve cold.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Cut onion into slices. Separate into rings. Dip onions into paste. Put in hot grease. Fry until done.

title: Arnie'S Cheesecake
instructions: Keep all ingredients at room temperature.

title: Never Fail Frosting
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and beat until light and fluffy.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese chips and almonds. Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with remaining ingredients. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for Pyrex.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to\t375\u00b0. Mix shortening butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by spoonfuls two inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10\tminutes or until light brown. Cool before removing. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix herb seasoned stuffing with 1 stick melted margarine and 1 egg. Mix cream of mushroom soup with 3/4 cup chicken broth. Mix cream of chicken soup with 3/4 cup chicken broth. Place in casserole dish 1 layer of stuffing 1 layer of chicken 1 layer of cream of mushroom soup 1 layer chicken 1 layer cream of chicken soup and 1 layer of stuffing. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Make the gingerbread cookie dough according to the label directions. Stir in the dried cranberries. Roll the dough into 1-inch balls. Arrange the balls on an ungreased baking sheet 2-inches apart. Lightly butter the bottom of a drinking glass then dip it into the sugar. With the glass flatten the balls one at a time. Dip the glass back into sugar after each cookie is pressed. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until firm. Remove to a wire rack and cool completely. Hands on time 30 minutes. Total time 45 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix flour baking powder water salt sugar instant pudding oil and eggs thoroughly. Pour 1/2 into greased 9 X 13 inch pan. Mix together brown sugar cinnamon and chopped nuts. Sprinkle 1/2 over batter in pan. Pour remaining batter and sprinkle with rest of topping mixture. Melt 1/8 to 1/4 cups oleo (margarine) and drizzle over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix together lemon jello boiling water and pineapple juice Let set slightly. Combine salad dressing diced apples celery whipped cream or dream whip pineapple and marshmallows. Fold into jello and let set.

title: Marinated Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage pepper and onion in a refrigerator bowl that has a cover. Sprinkle sugar over mixture. Do not stir. Bring other ingredients to a boil. Pour over cabbage mixture. Do not stir. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve mix ingredients together.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in a 2-quart casserole dish (greased). Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugars white syrup and vanilla. Stir in chopped nuts. Prepare 24 hours before serving. Serve with sliced granny smith apples strawberries your favorite fresh fruit.

title: Mace Cake
instructions: Put on other half of batter and sprinkle top with sugar nuts and mace very lightly. Bake 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Salami
