instructions: Mix all together very well. Store in a container in the refrigerator. Make sure it is kept very cold. On the second and third days knead and return to refrigerator. On the fourth day make into rolls and put on a rack in a pan. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 6 to 7 hours.

title: Rice Dinner
instructions: Place onion celery green pepper red pepper black pepper and curry powder with oil. Cook over slow fire. Add stew beef and cook until meat is brown stirring. Fill pan 2/3 full with water and let boil adding as much rice as needed. Cook slowly until rice is soft.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchilada
instructions: Saute onions in oil. Add chicken broth and chicken. Add salt and cumin; heat until hot. Make sauce of cream of chicken soup sour cream and a small amount of picante sauce. Heat until hot. Take chicken mixture (about 2 tablespoons) and roll up in tortillas; place in a buttered baking dish. Pour sauce over them and sprinkle cheese over top. Make a strip of picante sauce on top. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 until bubbling (about 30 minutes).

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Mash garlic add salt and the next 5 ingredients. Score meat 1/4-inch deep on both sides and rub in marinade refrigerate at least 8 hours.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Stir over medium heat until thick. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Oatmeal Drops
instructions: Sift together the flour salt sugar baking powder baking soda and cinnamon. Mix in the oatmeal and raisins. Beat in the oil egg and milk until well mixed. Drop by the teaspoon onto a cookie sheet spacing them 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes or until delicately browned. Cool on a cake rack. Makes about 36 cookies. Calories 75 per cookie. Low salt and low cholesterol.

title: Jean'S Enchiladas
instructions: Brown beef in 2 tablespoons butter. Saute onion and green pepper in 2 tablespoons butter and add to beef. To this mixture add flour chili powder and garlic. Mix. Lastly add the tomato sauce and undiluted consomme. Simmer over low heat stirring often. If the mixture appears too thick add the remaining 1/2 cup water. Serve hot meat sauce over tortillas. Serves 12.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Brown onions and beef in small amount of oil. Add tomatoes catsup vinegar salt and pepper. Cook 30 minutes on low heat stirring occasionally then add corn and potato. Simmer 5 additional minutes stirring frequently!

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breast
instructions: Remove skin and bone from chicken. Arrange in a shallow 2 or 3-quart baking dish. Place 1 slice of cheese on each piece of chicken. Stir together undiluted soup and water. Spoon evenly over chicken. Coarsely crush stuffing mix and sprinkle over top. Evenly drizzle with melted butter. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until meat is opaque throughout and is tender when pierced with fork. Serves about 8.

title: Bacon Potato Chowder
instructions: Cut bacon into pieces. Fry in heavy pot until crispy. Add onion and saute for 5 minutes. Drain grease leaving about 1 Tbsp. in pan for flavor. Add potatoes and water. Cook until potatoes are done. In separate bowl combine milk soup sour cream and seasonings. Add potatoes. Heat to serving temperature. Do not boil. Makes 4-6 servings.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and flour but do not sift. Add beer gently. Stir just enough to mix (not over 2 minutes). Put in greased and floured bread pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and roll to size of buckeyes. Chill. Melt chocolate and paraffin in double boiler. With wooden toothpick dip balls in chocolate mixture leaving top uncovered for buckeye \effect\. Refrigerate. Makes 16 dozen.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Stir 2 cups flour with the other ingredients. Slowly add 4 cups. Let rise in covered bowl; punch down. Make into rolls and let rise. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Dough may be refrigerated 3 to 4 days.

title: Ham Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour in deep unbaked pie shell. Cook 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Preacher Cookies
instructions: Combine butter sugar and milk in a saucepan. Boil for 3 minutes at a rolling boil. Stir in cocoa oatmeal vanilla and nuts or coconut. Beat well. Working quickly drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool 5 minutes. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in blueberries. Add milk egg and butter. Mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Batter will be lumpy. Do not overbeat.

title: Cheese Pie (No Bake)
instructions: Microwave on Medium until soft (small bowl) miniature marshmallows and milk (about 5 minutes). Let cool. In a large bowl blend soft cream cheese plus Cool Whip. Add vanilla. Next add the cool marshmallow mix (fold in). Pour into graham cracker pie shell. Cool in refrigerator for 2 hours.

title: Lemon Cups
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add lemon juice and peel. Add to combined egg yolks and milk. Mix well. Fold in egg whites and pour into greased custard cups. Bake in pan of hot water in 325\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or bake in greased shallow baking dish.

title: Corn Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine flour cornmeal baking powder salt mustard and cheese. Cut shortening with pastry blender to resemble cornmeal. Add milk; stir to form dough. Put on floured surface and knead 6 times. Pat to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 4-inch biscuit cutter. Place on baking sheet. Bake for 16 minutes or until brown.

title: Denver Biscuits
instructions: Scald and cool 1 pint milk. Cream and add 1/2 cup Crisco and 1/2 cup sugar. Dissolve 1 package yeast in a little warm water. Add to milk mixture. Add 2 1/2 cups sifted flour and let rise for about 2 hours.

title: Orange Muffins
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add sifted flour soda and salt alternately with buttermilk while beating. Stir in nuts raisins and orange. Grease and flour muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Makes 2 1/2 to 3 dozen muffins.

title: Skillet Pizza
instructions: In skillet brown meat; drain excess fat. Stir in pizza sauce oregano and garlic powder. Bring to boil; simmer. Remove from heat. Combine ziti and milk. In a 2-quart casserole layer ziti noodles meat sauce and cheese. End with cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake 20 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Curried Tuna Salad
instructions: Combine tuna celery pecans and pineapple; stir well. Combine mayonnaise and curry powder. Stir into tuna mixture. Cover and chill mixture. Serves 3.

title: Tuna Roll
instructions: Chop the parsley fine. Set aside 2 tablespoons of the parsley and add all other ingredients. Beat until thick and smooth. Season to taste.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Melt all ingredients together. Add coconut or nuts.

title: Lemon Lust
instructions: Blend with beater until flaky. Press into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Set aside to cool.

title: Spicy Cranberry Warmer
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in a double thickness of cheesecloth. Bring up corners and tie with a string; place with cider in large saucepan. Simmer covered for 5 minutes. Stir in sugar and simmer for 5 minutes. Add cranberry juice and heat to simmering. Serve hot in mugs.

title: Hershey Kiss Cookies
instructions: Sift together first 3 ingredients and set aside. In separate bowl combine margarine and peanut butter; blend well at medium speed. Add sugar and light brown sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat until smooth. Stir in flour mixture until well blended. Level tablespoon of dough into ball. Roll in granulated sugar. Bake 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove from oven and press Hersheys Kiss on top. Bake additional 12 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Bake
instructions: Brown ground chuck onion and green peppers. Drain grease. Add spaghetti sauce. Cook until done. Cook spaghetti noodles. Drain water. In casserole dish grease bottom of dish with margarine. Then put 1/2 of spaghetti noodles then 1/2 of spaghetti sauce. Top with 1 cup Mozzarella cheese 1/2 cup sharp Cheddar cheese and 1/2 cup mild Cheddar cheese. Repeat. Put in preheated oven at 350\u00b0. When cheese is melted it is ready to serve.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Sprinkle beef with onion celery and garlic salts paprika and tenderizer. Cover with foil for 24 hours. Add liquid smoke Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce. Re-wrap in foil. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 7 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease some cookie sheets.

title: Island Breeze Pie(Serves 6)
instructions: In medium bowl beat cream cheese on high speed until fluffy. Add 1 tablespoon pineapple juice and confectioners sugar; mix until well blended. Spread in bottom of graham cracker crust. Arrange mandarin oranges and pineapple over cream cheese layer; refrigerate.

title: Sausage Apple Ring
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix thoroughly with fork. Press lightly into greased ring mold then turn out onto shallow baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Old Time Bread Puddin'
instructions: Break bread into pieces and toss with melted butter and 1/4 c. milk. Place in 1 1/2 qt. baking dish. Beat sugar and egg yolks together until well blended. Add remaining 3 1/4 c. milk and mix well. Blend in vanilla cinnamon and raisins. Pour mixture over bread. Place dish in pan of water and bake at 300\u00b0 for 40-50 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add pinch of salt and gradually add 2 T. sugar. Beat until stiff peaks form. Spread whites on top of pudding. Return to oven. Raise heat to 350\u00b0 and bake until meringue turns brown.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook tomatoes well done along with chopped onions and peppers adding no water. Mix remaining ingredients; cook one hour or until mixture is as think as desired. Put into jars and process 10 minutes in hot water bath.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add oil and blend. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add carrots and blend well. Pour equal amounts into prepared 3 layer pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or in prepared 13 x 9-inch pan for 1 hour.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Roll pastry 1/8-inch thick. Line a 9-inch pan. Fold edges under; flute the edges with fingers. Beat eggs lightly. Add sugar and salt; blend well. Add vanilla and milk. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in hot oven at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce the heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Sprinkle nutmeg on top of custard before putting into oven.

title: Pot Roast Of Beef
instructions: Put vegetables in bottom of crock-pot. Salt and pepper meat then put in pot. Add liquid. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours (on high for 5 to 6 hours). Makes 12 to 14 servings.

title: Golden Fish Fillets
instructions: Lightly beat together egg mustard and salt in a shallow baking dish. Put the potato flakes in another shallow baking dish. Dip the fish fillets in egg mixture. Then roll in potato flakes to coat. Heat oil in a large skillet fry fillets for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until they are golden brown and flake easily with a fork. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hearty Beef Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook beef with 1 cup of water for approximately 2 hours; add onion and potatoes. Simmer 1 hour. Add all ingredients except corn and cream of mushroom soup. Simmer 45 minutes stirring often. Add corn and soup stirring until thoroughly blended and continue to simmer 15 minutes or so. Stir frequently to keep from sticking. Makes 24 generous servings.

title: Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello and sugar slowly in hot water. Add cold water and juice. Divide mixture into 2 containers. Freeze.

title: Quick Sticky Buns
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in an 8 or 9-inch square cake pan. Stir in sugar cinnamon corn syrup nuts and raisins. Place biscuit dough on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes until biscuits are well browned. Let stand 5 minutes. Invert on serving plate. Remove pan.

title: Tex-Mex Mini Chili Chicken Cups
instructions: Place chicken in a single layer in a saucepan. Add water to cover. Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer chicken for 20 minutes. Drain cool and chop chicken or shred with a fork. Mix with dressing and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

title: Eat-Your-Heart-Out Fudge
instructions: Cut a piece of foil big enough to fit inside and up over the edges of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish or pan. Place foil in pan and press against bottom sides and corners to fit pan. Stir in a large microwave bowl the powdered sugar milk and salt. Add the butter. Microwave uncovered for 1 minute on High. Stir. Microwave at High for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes longer or until bubbling. Quickly add chocolate chips peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until blended. Spoon into foiled pan and press into an even layer. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Peel off foil. Cut into small squares.

title: Sauteed Onions
instructions: Saute onions in butter until tender then put in baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese then crumble crackers on top and sprinkle again with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crackers start to turn brown.

title: Never-Fail Fruit Mixture
instructions: Drain juice from mixed fruits and discard. Drain juice from pineapple but save to use. Mix fruits together in bowl. Sprinkle pudding over fruit and fold in to blend. Add half of pineapple juice. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Just before serving add bananas cut in chunks. If it seems too thick add more pineapple juice. (I usually double the recipe and serve it in individual clear plastic 9-ounce cups.)

title: Pet Milk Fudge
instructions: Put sugar margarine and Pet milk in pan and let come to a boil. Boil 8 minutes stirring most of the time. Take off stove and add chocolate chips stirring until dissolved. Add Marshmallow Fluff. Stir this until all is dissolved. Add nut meats and vanilla.

title: Filled Cupcakes
instructions: With adult help turn oven to 375\u00b0. Put 12 paper bake cups into muffin pans. In a small bowl use the spoon to stir the cream cheese the 1/4 cup sugar nuts and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla until mixed.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix buttermilk and egg then add dry ingredients. Mix well. Can easily double or triple. Pour onto hot slightly oiled griddle and cook until bubbles are set. Flip over and let cook about 3 more minutes. Serve warm with maple syrup.

title: Chicken And Egg Noodle Soup
instructions: After chicken is done remove from broth and dice into bite-size pieces.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and blend with stuffing mix. Place 1/2 of the mixture in baking dish that has been coated with a nonstick spray. In a bowl mix cooked mashed squash soup sour cream onion and water chestnuts. Pour mixture into casserole dish. Top squash mixture with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Boil vegetables until tender. Put through sieve. Mix the remaining ingredients and add to juice. Bring to a boil. Cook for 15 minutes. Put in jars. Process in hot water bath for 20 minutes. When ready to eat add small amount of milk to each serving.

title: Dreams
instructions: Mix and bake in paper cups at 250\u00b0 for 25 minutes. They dont have to brown just set.

title: Cinnamon Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix flour sugars and cinnamon. Cut in shortening then mix buttermilk and raisins to make dough (dough should be moist but easy to knead). Make out biscuits and bake on greased baking sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch baking pan and pour some of the melted butter into the pan. Spread around the bottom evenly. Take\tcold crescent roll and wrap each apple completely. Place the covered apples in the pan on top of the butter. Sprinkle each with cinnamon. Pour sugar on top of all the apples. Pour remaining butter on top. Slowly pour Sprite on top and around pan. Sprinkle more cinnamon on apples. Sprinkle on nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until browned. Serve hot. Pour some extra caramelized syrup on top when serving.

title: Baked Smoked Ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place ham in roasting pan. Bake for about 3 hours.

title: Icebox Blueberry Pie
instructions: Prick pie crust with fork cover bottom with pecans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Beat cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth; fold in frozen whipped topping. Pour into pie crusts top with blueberry filling. Chill well before serving.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Soften cream cheese at room temperature. Chop green onions and peppers and mix in with cream cheese. Stir until well blended. Spread on the ham slices. Roll the slices. Refrigerate. Before serving cut into 1-inch pieces.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Stir softened ice cream into pudding which has been mixed with the milk. Put on the crust made from the crackers and margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put 9 ounces Cool Whip on top. Store in refrigerator.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli for 5 minutes drain. Add eggs mayonnaise onion cheese soup and salt and pepper. Pour in buttered casserole cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

title: Pork Wiener Schnitzel
instructions: Pound pork until very thin. Season flour with salt and pepper and dip pork into it then into beaten eggs then into bread crumbs. Saute in olive oil and butter until golden brown (about 5 minutes). Squeeze the juice of a lemon over all and serve immediately. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Mix everything together and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Pineapple Salad
instructions: In bowl combine sour cream honey and nutmeg; blend well. Place pineapple on platter lined with lettuce. Spoon sauce evenly over pineapple. Sprinkle with pecans. Chill.

title: Strawberry-Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 3 cups of boiling water. Add frozen strawberries and stir until melted. Add cranberry sauce and mix well. Chill until firm.

title: Quick And Easy Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and pour into two pie crusts. Chill and serve.

title: Artichoke Squares
instructions: Saute onions in oil from jars of artichoke hearts. Add remaining ingredients stirring well after each. Season with salt and pepper. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cream and vanilla in large skillet. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add 4 heaping tablespoonfuls peanut butter. Mix thoroughly. Butter 1 (13 x 9-inch) pan and add fudge. Chill until served. Makes 20 pieces.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and save for stuffing. Brush caps with melted butter. Put in lightly buttered pan and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Saute onion in butter and oil 3 to 4 minutes. Add scallions and stems; saute over moderate-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes. Turn off heat and mix in bread crumbs parsley tarragon and seasonings. Add 1/4 cup grated Swiss cheese and Parmesan cheese a spoonful at a time. Blend in cream just to moisten. Fill mushroom caps with stuffing. Top each with remaining 3 tablespoons of Swiss cheese. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Seafoam Salad
instructions: Drain pears. Warm 1 cup syrup to dissolve gelatin (instead of water). Set aside.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Put all ingredients except raisins and nuts in large bowl and beat well. Add raisins and nuts after beating and blend in. Put in 2 or 3 greased and floured loaf pans or one tube/Bundt pan. Fill loaf pans only a little over half full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Cut squash into small pieces and cook until tender. Do not overcook. Drain and put in baking dish. Immediately add butter and salt and pepper and onions. Combine milk and eggs and mix well with squash. Top with buttered cracker crumbs. Bake for about 30 minutes or brown in a 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Coney Island Hamburgers
instructions: Make hamburger patties fry slightly on both sides then fry onions lightly. In a roasting pan layer patties and onions. Pour bottle of ketchup mixed with water on top of patties and onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Taco Bake
instructions: Brown meat and drain off fat. Add soup salsa milk tortillas (which have been cut in 1-inch square pieces) and half of the cheese. Spoon into 2-quart shallow baking dish. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot. Sprinkle with remainder of cheese and serve. Serves about 4.

title: Pork In Garlic Sauce
instructions: Cut cutlets in half. Heat oil in large skillet. Season and lightly brown cutlets on both sides. Remove meat from skillet. Add onion and garlic to skillet; saute lightly about 4 to 5 minutes. Add flour and stir into fat until thoroughly blended and light brown. Add bouillon and mustard stirring in thoroughly until mixture is smooth then add meat. Cover and cook over low heat for about 30 minutes.

title: Hormel Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese into a pie pan then spread Hormel chili with no beans on top of that and then sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake or microwave until cheese is melted. If you microwave this it would be better to warm the cream cheese and chili mixture before topping with the cheese. Serve with corn chips or tortilla chips.

title: Blueberry Layer Cake
instructions: Cover the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan evenly with the pie filling. Top evenly with the remaining ingredients in the order given. Bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables until just tender. Put in greased casserole. Next mix onions cheese mayo and celery and spread over vegetables. Melt oleo and mix with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle on top. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Melt margarine. Add mushrooms peppers and onions to skillet. Stir until veggies are tender. Add tomato paste water and oregano; blend. Cover for 5 minutes. Simmer over low heat. Add 1 cup cheese. Mix well. Grease 10 muffin cups. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Press biscuits onto bottom and sides of muffin cups. Fill with vegetable mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Saucy Franks
instructions: Set hot dogs aside after scoring them. Melt margarine in saucepan. Saute onion and bell pepper. Add soup brown sugar vinegar and lemon juice. Cook for 5 minutes on medium-low heat. Add hot dogs. Cook for another 10 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 depending on size of hot dog package. Serve on buns. If sauce is too tangy add more brown sugar. Teens love this.

title: Lasagna Squares
instructions: Grease or spray with Pam an 8 x 8 x 2-inch square baking dish. Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in dish. Mix beef herbs paste and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Spoon evenly over top. Beat milk eggs Bisquick mix salt and pepper with wire whip. Whisk until smooth 1 minute. Pour into dish. Bake approximately 30 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Honey Spice Bars
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Batter will be stiff. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Fettucine Carbonara
instructions: In saucepan heat butter and oil together. Saute shallots over medium heat until soft about 5 minutes. Add bacon and continue to cook over medium heat for an additional 10 minutes or until bacon begins to brown; set aside.

title: Grandma'S Gelatin Fruit Salad
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine 1 cup boiling water and lemon gelatin. Add 1 cup ice cubes stirring until melted. Add pineapple. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; refrigerate until set. Repeat with orange gelatin remaining water and ice. Stir in marshmallows. Pour over lemon layer; refrigerate until set.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Measure all ingredients into large mixing bowl; beat on medium speed 1/2 minute. Pour into pan. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool before slicing.

title: Nell'S Brownies
instructions: Mix in bowl. Cream margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift together cocoa flour and salt. Stir into creamed mixture. Add nuts. Pour into a greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Seafood Cacciatore
instructions: Saute shrimp lightly with onion and garlic in skillet in oil. Add tomatoes tomato sauce salt other seasonings and bell pepper. Bring to a full boil. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Makes about 6 cups or 4 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole (1)
instructions: Place chicken in pot adding enough water to cover it. Bring to a boil and cover simmer 45 min. or until tender. Remove chicken from pot reserving 3/4 c. broth. Remove meat from bones and cut into pieces set aside. Fry corn tortillas in butter until warmed thoroughly. Layer tortillas in bottom of 9x13 inch pan. Layer chicken on top. Pour soups over chicken. Top with remaining tortillas. Then shred cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0F uncovered for 35 min. or till cheese melts.

title: Turkey Chili(Serves 8)
instructions: In a 4-quart Dutch oven brown ground turkey in oil. Add onion and cook until crisp-tender. Add tomato sauce cut up tomatoes kidney beans chili powder garlic salt cayenne pepper and ground pepper. Mix well. Cover and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 1 to 2 hours until mixture is hot and bubbly.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix next 3 ingredients together and pour over batter in pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Pinipig Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease the cookie sheets.

title: Overnight Potato Roast
instructions: In saucepan over medium-high heat bring potatoes and enough salted water to cover to a boil for 10 minutes; drain. In a bowl combine potatoes with 3/4 cup dressing salt and pepper. Cover and chill 3 hours or overnight. Heat oven to 350\u00b0; arrange potatoes in a single layer on baking sheet coated with buttered flavored cooking spray. Bake 25 minutes stirring frequently. Drizzle with remaining dressing; bake 5 minutes more. Toss with dill just before serving.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Melt butter dates sugar and egg. Cook 5 minutes. Add nuts and Rice Krispies. Roll in balls then roll in powdered sugar.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Saute beef cubes and onion in butter until meat is browned. Add bouillon and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until meat is tender stirring occasionally. Add mushrooms with liquid. Combine sour cream and flour; blend into meat mixture. Cook 5 minutes or until sauce is thickened. Cook noodles and drain. Serve stroganoff over noodles. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients in order given. Toppings can be varied to your taste. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Roasted Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white until soft peaks form. Mix in sugar flour and vanilla. Pour in pecans and stir until all are coated. Place pecans 1-inch apart on a cookie sheet covered with brown paper. (A brown paper bag works great.) Bake 30 minutes in a 250\u00b0 oven then turn off oven and let set in oven 30 more minutes. Remove from oven and loosen nuts from paper and let set to cool.

title: Pineapple And Cheese Delight
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together then add pineapple and cheese and place in casserole dish. Melt margarine and mix with crushed crackers. Sprinkle mixture on top of pineapple mix and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pour into casserole heat until bubbly in a 350\u00b0 oven about 25 to 30 minutes. Take out to sprinkle cheese on top. Return to oven until cheese is melted. Use a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Crumble flour pecans and melted oleo together. Press in 9 x 13 x 2 baking pan and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool completely.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and water; let it come to a boil. Stir in package of lime jello. Let sit until it is syrupy. Add all other ingredients and chill.

title: Linguine Paradise
instructions: Chop onion and green pepper. Heat olive oil and saute in a heavy pan. Add cubed chicken breasts and saute until light brown. Add 1 teaspoon of salt 1 teaspoon oregano and 8 ounces of tomato sauce; cook on low-medium heat. In saucepan melt butter and add minced garlic. Add scallops and shrimp and set aside. Add crushed tomatoes wine Parmesan cheese hot sausage (after browning) and remaining spices to the chicken mixture. Continue to cook for 30 minutes on low-medium heat. Add scallops and shrimp to sauce and cook for 20 minutes more. Add Mozzarella cheese. Cook sauce until cheese melts. Cook 16 ounces of linguine for 7 to 8 minutes; add garlic and oregano to boiling water. Serve sauce over linguine and garnish with fresh parsley. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Clams Casino Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in ovenproof dish for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Onion Hoe Cakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly. Add cold milk. Mix well. Drop 1 tablespoon of batter at a time in hot oil 1/4-inch deep. Turn only once as a pancake. Drain on a paper towel. Finished cake should be about 1/2-inch thick golden brown with curled edge. Perfect with seafood and vegetables.

title: Country-Style Scalloped Corn
instructions: Pour the melted butter eggs and drained corn into a large bowl; combine with rest of the ingredients; adding muffin mix last. Pour mixture into a 11x7-inch greased baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35-40 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Shortcake
instructions: Mix together and put in lined cupcake pan. Bake about 10 to 12 minutes at 450\u00b0. Makes 4. Spoon strawberries over the top when cooled.

title: Martha'S Banana Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and bananas. Stir in flour and soda. Bake in two grease and floured loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until done.

title: Bean Dip Supreme
instructions: Blend all ingredients and place in casserole dish. Top with grated Cheddar and Jack cheese. Bake for 3 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with tortilla chips or Fritos.

title: Butter Pound Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in a large round tube pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Will'S Favorite Chocolate Pie
instructions: Make pudding according to directions on package. Stir in Cool Whip. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Add more Cool Whip to the top before serving if desired.

title: Swedish Rye Bread
instructions: Add 1 package of active dry yeast which has been dissolved in 1/4 cup warm water. Mix the ingredients well then add rye flour and white flour. Turn out on well floured surface. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Knead until dough is smooth and satiny about 10 minutes. Place in lightly greased bowl. Cover and let rise in warm place until double about 1 1/2 hours. Punch down cover and let rise until almost double about 30 minutes. Turn out on lightly floured surface and divide into equal parts. Form into balls. Cover and let rest 15 minutes. Shape into two round loaves place on greased baking sheets cover and let rise until almost double about 1 hour. Brush loaves with slightly beaten egg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Yield 24 servings. Carbohydrate 33 g protein 4 g fat 3 g calories 173.

title: White Icing
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients in saucepan gradually adding milk. Let cool completely stirring occasionally. Cream together the shortening butter and 1 cup sugar. Add the vanilla. Beat with mixer until glossy. Beat well or will be grainy. Frosts large 2-layer cake. Keeps for several weeks in refrigerator.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Using food processor (or large chefs knife) finely chop fruits. Add sugar and chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Cut cherries into pieces. Mix milk and lemon juice. Fold in fruits Cool Whip and nuts. Put into 2 large graham cracker crusts. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Pies can be frozen.

title: Chocolate And Pecan Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl stir together flour crumbs sugar and salt. Add margarine; cut in until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in one beaten egg. Press evenly onto bottom of ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake 25 minutes or until golden. In large mixer bowl beat sweetened condensed milk cocoa remaining 1 egg and vanilla. Pour over baked layer. Sprinkle coconut then pecans over top. Bake 25 minutes or until set. Cool completely. Cut into bars. Makes about 24 bars.

title: Company Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine broccoli rice and remaining ingredients in bowl; mix gently. Spoon into prepared casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bun Recipe
instructions: Melt butter stout sugar and honey. Put to cool. Beat egg. Add when cool. Add spice mix peel and fruits. Add flour. Mix together until well blended. Put in greased bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until well done. Brush top with butter and sugar.

title: Melon Soup
instructions: Peel seed and dice melons. Puree cantaloupe and juice of lemon until smooth. Refrigerate covered for at least 3 hours.

title: Oven Stew
instructions: Mix well and bake in tightly covered baking pan at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serve over noodles or rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Almond Crescents
instructions: Combine flour and salt. Beat butter and shortening until softened. Add 1/2 cup powdered sugar vanilla and almond extract. Beat until fluffy. Stir in flour mixture and nuts. Cover. Chill about 1 hour.

title: Susanne'S Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Boil cabbage in large pot of water removing leaves as they soften. Remove leaves from water. Cut off large vein. Mix ingredients together. Make large balls. Place in leaf. Fold edges and roll. Line bottom of heavy pot with cabbage leaves. Place rolls in pot. Cover with cabbage leaves and 4 strips bacon. Fill pot halfway with saved water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Top with sour cream when served.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Press graham crackers 1/3 cup sugar and butter into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 3 eggs 3/4 cup sugar and cream cheese. Pour over crust and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cook pumpkin 4 egg yolks 3/4 cup sugar milk salt and cinnamon until heated well. Dissolve gelatine in cold water and add to pumpkin mixture. Cool and add 4 beaten egg whites with 1/4 cup sugar beaten into egg whites. Pour mixture into cooled crust. Can top with Cool Whip.

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cook chicken. Flake or cut in bite size pieces.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In plastic bag combine potato flakes pepper and poultry seasoning. In shallow bowl combine egg whites and lemon juice. Dip chicken a few pieces at a time in egg mixture. Shake chicken in potato flake mixture to coat. Place chicken in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Buttermilk Corn Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients in order listed. Heat 1 tablespoon Wesson oil in heavy iron skillet on top burner of stove until grease is hot but not smoking. Pour ingredients into skillet; place in preheated 400\u00b0 oven and bake for 30 to 45 minutes until brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Beans And Sausage
instructions: Saute celery onion and pepper in small amount of cooking oil or butter. Add to remaining ingredients. Stir until well blended. Simmer until consistency to serve over cooked rice.

title: Blueberry Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together blueberries last. Pour in greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan (if desired sprinkle top with cinnamon sugar). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

title: Zucchini Hot Dish
instructions: Place 1/2 of zucchini tomatoes and onion in a large casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add 5 slices of cheese and top with rice. Repeat layering with vegetables and salt and pepper; then add cheese and 6 slices of bacon. Bake 75 to 90 minutes at 350\u00b0 until tender.

title: Perfect Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Drain oysters reserving 1/4 cup of liquor. Combine crumbs and butter. Spread 1/3 of crumbs in greased 8 x 1 1/4-inch pan. Cover with half of the oysters. Sprinkle with pepper. Using another 1/3 of the crumbs spread a second layer. Cover with remaining oysters. Sprinkle with pepper. Combine cream oyster liquor Worcestershire and salt; pour over the oysters. Top with last of crumbs. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 40 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Eggplant Dressing
instructions: Cook eggplant in medium size boiler with water until tender; drain. Save water. Brown meat in cooking oil. Add all other ingredients; cook until tender. Add eggplant. If too dry add water from eggplant. Cook all until of a casserole consistency.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Bring potatoes water and onion to boil in large pot until done. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer 5 minutes. Add water as needed. Serves 4.

title: Bonnie'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Beat eggs lightly. Add sugar coconut butter milk and vanilla. Pour into pie shell and bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Serves 6.

title: Beet Salad
instructions: Drain beets. Cut into bite-size pieces. Add chopped eggs and mayonnaise. Stir well. Season to taste.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Slice sirloin while partially frozen to obtain very thin slices. When meat is completely thawed melt 1/4 cup margarine in skillet. Lightly brown meat over medium to medium-high heat. Remove from skillet. Over medium heat melt remaining margarine and saute onion and mushrooms. Add flour and seasonings and mix. Add and blend remaining ingredients. Lower temperature. Add meat and heat through. Serve over noodles.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Combine onion chicken Veg-All soup and pepper to taste. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with pie crust. Prick crust with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Shrimp Mini Pizzas
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl; stir in oil sugar salt and 4 cups of the flour. Beat until smooth. Turn dough onto floured surface. Knead in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Knead until smooth 3 to 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl; turn greased side up. Cover. Let rise in warm place until doubled about 45 minutes.

title: Connie'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet. Add other ingredients. Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Put into a greased casserole. Sprinkle top with grated cheese and the potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Simple Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients thoroughly with 1 can tomato sauce. Pack into a loaf pan. Chill about 1 hour. Unmold into baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 about 1 hour until cooked through. Pour 1 can tomato sauce over loaf. Bake 20 minutes more. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mee Mee'S Three Flavor Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and oleo. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Add flavorings. Add flour and soda a little at a time alternating with milk. Be sure to mix well after each addition.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Brown onion and bacon slightly in butter. Boil diced potatoes in water until soft. Add remaining ingredients and onion and bacon mixture. Simmer 5 minutes and serve in soup bowls.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle an 8 ounce package of Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and set aside. Mix last 6 ingredients. Combine the 2 mixtures and blend well. This may be baked in 4 coffee cans (1-pound size) well greased in a large Bundt pan or 2 bread pans. Bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven until the bread pulls away from the sides of the pan or shows done when tested with a straw.

title: French Bread Pizza
instructions: Lay bread open-face on cookie sheet. Spread with olive oil. Cover bread with pizza sauce. Cover sauce with grated Mozzarella cheese. Top with pepperoni and/or other favorite toppings. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Heat butter and water. When the mixture is boiling add the flour all at once. Stir vigorously until the mixture no longer sticks to sides of pan. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a well-greased cookie sheet (2-inches apart). Bake in a very hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 20 more minutes. Remove and cool. When ready to serve slit top and fill with vanilla pudding. Serves 12.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Mix all dry ingredients together. Mix the milk and vanilla with the banana mixture. Add dry ingredients slowly beating well. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Best cut the second day but I cant wait.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and its ready to serve.

title: Rigatoni With Vodka Sauce
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter and now flambee the vodka in the same pan (let it reduce). Add the heavy cream until it thickens spices pasta and tomato sauce. Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Nut Roll Dough For Crescents(Hungarian)
instructions: Mix these ingredients as for pie dough. Add 4 egg yolks which have been beaten. Add 1 can canned milk and mix. Add to flour mixture. Work dough well on floured board about 15 minutes. Cut in balls and roll in powdered sugar. Roll out as for the same size as a pie shell. Cut in tiny 2-inch squares and fill with Nut Filling. Apricot pineapple or lekvar can also be used in this same dough.

title: Chocolate Pies(This Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa. Add milk and bring to a boil. Beat egg yolks and add to mixture after it comes to a boil. Cook until thickens. Cool. Pour into 2 baked pie shells.

title: Mama'S Meat Loaf
instructions: You also need a 9 x 13 pan.

title: Strawberry Divinity
instructions: Cook preserves over low or medium heat until the mixture gets thin or melts. Combine sugar corn syrup and the melted preserves in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves. If sugar crystals form on sides of pan wipe them off. Continue cooking to the hard-ball stage (252\u00b0). Meanwhile beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; blend in jello. When syrup reaches 252\u00b0 pour in a thin stream over egg whites beating constantly with electric mixer on medium speed. Beat as long as possible using wooden spoon if mixture becomes too stiff for mixer. Add nuts and pour into lightly buttered square pan. When cool and firm cut into 36 pieces. If divinity has not hardened by the time it is completely cool put in the freezer for an hour or so. Makes about 2 pounds.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar milk cocoa and butter in pan. Bring to full boil for 2 minutes. Take off stove and add peanut butter vanilla and oats. Drop by spoonful onto foil.

title: Lime Sherbet
instructions: Blend all ingredients with rotary beater. Freeze in tray. When half frozen put in bowl and beat until fluffy. Return to tray and freeze.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Combine the 3 tablespoons of flour with chopped nutmeats and raisins; set aside. Combine all of the rest of the ingredients and pour into a greased and floured tube or large loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Good frosted with a cream cheese icing.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Put all ingredients except soda in heavy boiler. Mix well. Cook until peanuts begin to pop and syrup begins to turn darker. Set off heat and add soda. Stir quickly because the mixture foams. Have 3 tins well-greased. Pour mixture in each. Let set aside and harden. Do not put in refrigerator. When well hardened break into pieces.

title: Apple Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Combine first four ingredients and gently toss with dressing. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Corn And Olive Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese and dressing mix in a large bowl until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients except tortilla chips. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 4 cups spread but can easily be halved using 4 teaspoons of dressing mix.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix well with electric mixer until creamy. Frost cake and sprinkle with finely chopped walnuts.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and vanilla together. Stir in oil and add apples. Mix dry ingredients together and stir into apple mixture. If desired add nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Peach Crazy Crust Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar and milk. Pour into medium baking dish. Add peaches. (Do not mix up.) Cut margarine on top. Just before you take out of oven sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar. Cook in oven at 300\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until inside is done. (You may substitute any kind of fruit.)

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping blending well. Stir in chocolate chips. Spoon into crust; chill until set at least 4 hours.

title: Stuffed Squash
instructions: Cut squash lengthwise and boil until tender. Salt to taste. Spoon out the inside of squash. Mix with remaining ingredients. Place back in squash shell and bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with shortening and dust with flour; set aside. In large bowl sift all dry ingredients. Add mayonnaise water and vanilla. Beat very little. Pour into pan. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch salt and vinegar in a saucepan. Boil 5 minutes stirring often. Pour sauce over heated beets and let stand for a few minutes before serving.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Let milk get to near boiling. Stir in mixture of flour sugar and cocoa paste. Keep stirring until thick. Take off fire and beat until smooth. Add vanilla.

title: Pumpkin Nut Waffles
instructions: *May use butter margarine or canola oil.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Mix dry ingredients. Add flour to sugar mixture. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Tomato Jam
instructions: Cook tomatoes slowly for 1 hour. Add rest of ingredients; cook until it comes to a full rolling boil. Skim off top and put in jars.

title: Mexican Delight
instructions: Spread beans in 10 x 13-inch glass dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 of taco seasoning mix. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise and spread over beans. Sprinkle with other half of taco seasoning mix. Sprinkle with chopped tomatoes then onions and olives ending with grated cheese. Serve with tortilla chips. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients. Cut in peanut butter until crumbly. Mix together egg and milk; stir into dry ingredients. Pour into 9x5 inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Mix and shape in small muffin pans.

title: Beef In A Skillet
instructions: Cut steak into bite-size cubes; marinate in Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper about 30 minutes. Stir flour into steak and mix well. Brown in skillet with oil; add tomatoes and simmer about 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet with onion. In casserole dish place hamburger and onion layer of Fritos and layer of beans. Repeat then top with strips of American cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until the cheese melts into mixture. Serve hot.

title: Texas Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes. Cut in half and remove potato meat leaving potato skins empty.

title: Creme De Menthe Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine together and let cool. Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy. Add chocolate mixture and vanilla and flour. Beat well. Add 1/3 cup chopped nuts if desired. Bake in greased 10 x 15-inch pan for 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Test doneness with toothpick.

title: Zucchini Crunch
instructions: Cook zucchini sugar lemon juice cornstarch and cinnamon until zucchini is tender; drain liquid. Mix flour sugar and oleo like pie dough; put 1/2 in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top dough with zucchini mixture. Crumble rest of pie dough mixture on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Luby'S Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together graham cracker crumbs sugar and melted margarine. Divide graham cracker mixture equally between two 9-inch pie or cake pans. Press crumbs to line pan bottom and sides. Cook the crust shells 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. In large mixing bowl cream sugar and cream cheese. Add eggs one at a time while mixing. Add sour cream flour vanilla and lemon juice and mix well. Pour the filling mixture dividing equally into the prepared pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven cool and refrigerate. Makes 2 cheesecakes. (I used no fat sour cream and light cream cheese and the results were fine.)

title: Nelson Family Pepparkakor Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook syrup and spices. Let cool. Mix margarine and sugar until smooth. Add to syrup mixture. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour soda and salt. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight. Roll 1/16-inch of 1-inch and cut out Christmas shapes. Bake 5 to 8 minutes. Watch carefully.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: For substitute try pineapple juice lime juice. Chop finely in blender.

title: Your Own  Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind or blend together. Its better made at least the day before.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
instructions: Bone and skin chicken breasts. Boil until cooked. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sour cream and cream of chicken soup in rectangular baking pan (12 x 8-inch glass is best adjust baking time for metal pan). Stir chicken diced into cream mixture. Top with stuffing. Bake for 1/2 hour or until stuffing is lightly brown.

title: Lasagne Swirls
instructions: Cook noodles; rinse with cold water. Mix spinach 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese Ricotta cheese salt pepper and nutmeg. Spread about 1/3 cup of cheese mixture on each noodle and roll the noodles up. Saute garlic and onion until tender. Add tomato sauce sugar salt basil and oregano. Simmer uncovered 5 minutes or longer if you have the time. Place rolled noodles upright in a 2 quart casserole dish and pour sauce over. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes 50 to 60 minutes if cold. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Moon Cake
instructions: Bake in 9 x 13 pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool completely.

title: Blueberry Creme Pie
instructions: Mix Dream Whip as directed. The cream cheese and sugar should be blended together. Line browned pie shells with banana slices. Pour mixture over this. Top with blueberry pie filling. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Chicken And Artichokes
instructions: Season chicken with salt pepper and paprika. Brown 12 - 15 minutes in 4 Tbsp. butter or margarine. Remove chicken and place in casserole. Add 2 Tbsp. butter or margarine to skillet and saute mushrooms. Stir in flour bouillon and sherry. Cook 5 minutes stirring frequently. Arrange artichokes over chicken. Pour sauce over top. Bake covered for one hour at 375\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Butter hands and mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Press into buttered 8 x 8-inch square pan. Chill in refrigerator. Cut into 2 x 2-inch bars.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Cover bottom of 8-inch square pan with blueberries. Mix 3/4 cup sugar margarine flour and milk until crumbly. Pour over berries. Pour boiling water over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Kougel
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Mix all other ingredients together then mix in noodles. Cook at 350\u00b0 until brown on top or 1/2 hour. Can add as desired raisins or pineapple. Can also add different cheeses.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Pour into baking dish. Mix in Spanish rice. Top with plenty of shredded cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Eat with chips!

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Cook vinegar and Fasweet for 3 minutes and let cool. Pour over mixture and mix well. Let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: California Vegetable Medley
instructions: Cut cheese into cubes. Place in saucepan with 1/4 cup butter. Heat over medium heat until melted and smooth stirring often. Place vegetables in a 1-quart casserole dish. Pour cheese mixture over and mix well. Melt remaining butter. Stir in cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve immediately. Yield 4 to 6 servings. Preparation Time 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients for cake and add pineapple and pudding. Bake in a 9 x 13 pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake is done. Remove and cool. Poke holes in the cake and pour the pineapple juice over the cake. Mix softened cream cheese melted butter and powdered sugar. Add vanilla. Add milk as needed for desired creaminess of icing. Ice cake and refrigerate.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in buttered 2-quart casserole for 1 hour or until golden brown at 350\u00b0. Great for pitch-ins.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream mayonnaise and Ranch dressing. Combine all other ingredients and mix with dressing.

title: Shrimp And Feta
instructions: Heat butter or oil on medium heat in large heavy skillet. Saute shrimp approximately 1 to 2 minutes on each side until opaque. Transfer cooked shrimp with slotted spoon to warm plate and cover set to side. Saute tomatoes until tender on medium-low heat approximately 8 minutes. Add olives and saute for 2 minutes. Add 1/2 crumbled Feta and melt. Add shrimp and saute until warmed approximately 2 minutes. Add reserved Feta to mixture do not allow to melt completely. Serve as appetizer with chunk of crusty bread or over angel hair pasta as an entree.

title: Chicken Fettucine Alfredo
instructions: Heat butter and olive oil. Saute chicken onion and garlic. Stir in milk sauce mix tomatoes salt pepper and basil. Bring to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes until sauce is thickened. Serve with fettucine noodles and Parmesan. Makes 4 servings.

title: Finntastic Soup
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter. Add onion then ham and cook until onion is tender. Gradually blend in the soup and milk. Heat stirring occasionally until soup is hot. Do not boil. Add dill. Garnish each serving with cheese if desired.

title: Broccoli Chowder
instructions: Cook broccoli with 1 can chicken broth for 7 minutes until \tender crisp.\ Remove broccoli and chop in bite size pieces. Add second can of chicken broth and 1 cup milk. Add ham salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Stir in broccoli 2 cups milk cheese and margarine. Serve before it boils a second time.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Place all ingredients (except pie shells) together in a bowl and mix well. Spoon the mixture into the 2 pie shells. Place on a cookie sheet in a 350\u00b0 oven and bake for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Apple Pickle
instructions: Peel apples evenly and if perfect leave them whole. Otherwise cut in quarters. Heat the vinegar and sugar until it boils; skim well. Put the spices in a thin muslin bag and add to vinegar then add all the apples. Cook slowly until fruit is done. Put in fruit jars. Boil syrup down and pour over the fruit; seal while hot.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour thoroughly; add egg and mix well. Mix in rhubarb. Line pan with pastry; fill with rhubarb mixture and arrange pastry strips lattice fashion over filling. Bake in hot (400\u00b0) oven for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to moderate (350\u00b0) and bake 25 minutes longer. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Happy Home
instructions: Mix love and friendship slowly; add faith. Blend in patience then kindness and gentleness. Add hope; add generous amount of laughter. Bake with loyalty and serve daily topped with forgiveness. Serves any size family.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Bake 10 minutes in moderate oven then bake 50 minutes in slow oven.

title: Rice - Chinese Style
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Stir in vegetables and saute. Add rice and seasonings stir and top with peanuts.

title: Vegetable Sandwich
instructions: Mix gelatin and cold water with enough hot water to dissolve. Combine vegetables with salt and pepper; add mayonnaise and gelatin mixture. Let set in refrigerator overnight. Take out about one (1) hour before using and stir with a fork.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites and salt until frothy. Gradually add sugar. Fold in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased and floured pans. Put in oven. Turn off oven. Leave in 2 1/2 to 4 hours (or overnight). Store in airtight container to avoid tearing.

title: Meatballs
instructions: In large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Add ingredients except ground beef. Mix well adding ground beef. When combined shape into balls and place on greased pan. Bake 12 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: O'Henry Bars
instructions: In a large bowl combine oatmeal sugar shortening and syrup using a pastry blender. Press into a greased 9 x 13 pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool slightly. Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter and spread over baked mixture. Cool and cut into bars and refrigerate.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding according to directions. Fold in Cool Whip and Eagle Brand milk. Layer Nilla wafers bananas and pudding in large pan. Makes a very large pudding.

title: Tropical Fruit Slaw
instructions: Section oranges over a small bowl reserving juice. Halve sections if desired. Toss sliced bananas in orange juice; drain. In a large mixing bowl combine orange sections sliced banana pineapple cabbage and celery. Add yogurt; toss lightly to coat. Serve immediately or cover and chill up to 3 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Tiger Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes or until sauce thickens. Cornstarch may be used to thicken sauce even more.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla. Beat well.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes; cool and peel. Grate potatoes. Melt cheese with butter over low heat. Mix all ingredients together; put in casserole. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Line pan with tortillas. Add layer of bite-sized chicken layer of onion then layer of cheese. Add some of the soups and Ro-Tel that has been mixed together. Repeat until all ingredients are used up. Add cheese on top. Sprinkle with chili powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Dip chicken in egg then in crumb mixture. Melt butter in skillet. Add chicken to skillet; cook 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Arrange green pepper over chicken. Combine tomato sauce water and oregano; pour over chicken. Reduce heat to 200\u00b0 in skillet. Cover and cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Cover and cook until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger (if desired). Put in bottom of baking dish. Layer everything else in order. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cover the first 45 minutes. Put grated cheese on 15 minutes before its done.

title: Steamed Fish
instructions: Slice cabbage into bite size pieces; place in microwave-safe dish. Salt fish; place on top of cabbage. Top with grated ginger and green onion (to taste). Place bacon (sliced into strips) on top and in stomach cavity.\tMicrowave on High for approximately 15 minutes.\tHeat oil until smoky; carefully pour oil on top of cooked fish being aware of splatters. Serve immediately. Fish may also be placed on\ta couple of ti-leaves instead of cabbage.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt cocoa and oleo. Cream sugar flour and eggs. Add the cocoa mixture and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and while still hot spread marshmallow cream on top of cake.

title: Edna'S Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients stirring occasionally. Cook in heavy saucepan on top of stove with low heat covered for about 1 hour. Add sugar and stir well; then continue to simmer for about 1 more hour or until thick. Remember to stir occasionally. As mixture is removed from heat add butter and allow to cool. Mix well and add cinnamon to taste.

title: Blueberry Jubilee
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Add layer of cream cheese and milk which has been mixed together. Sprinkle with layer of chopped nuts. Add the can of blueberry pie filling. Spread Cool Whip over the top of everything. Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs.

title: Blue Cheese And Bean Salad
instructions: Cook beans just until tender; drain. Fry bacon until crisp. Combine green beans and bacon and remaining ingredients except cheese and toss lightly until well mixed. Stir 1/2 cup cheese into salad and sprinkle rest on top.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Slightly beat eggs before adding to mixture. Pour mixture into two eight-inch unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the oranges and discard juice. Drain remaining fruit saving juice. Use 2 cups juice to dissolve instant pudding. Pour over all fruit. Mix together.

title: Shark:  Marinated And Grilled
instructions: Blend Italian seasoning teriyaki sauce garlic and peanut butter until smooth; place shark or other firm fish steaks in marinade and seal tightly. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Refrigerate until ready to grill over medium heat or coals. Grill 8 to 10 minutes per pound turning and basting 2 times.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar milk syrup and salt. Cook over medium heat until soft ball stage is reached. Remove from heat. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Add vanilla chips and peanut butter. Stir until all are melted and mixture is smooth. Pour into buttered 9 x 12-inch pan to cool. Cut when cool.

title: Baked Beef Pizzaiola
instructions: Cut a chuck or round steak into pieces about 1 1/2-inches thick. Brown on both sides in olive oil.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Allow sausage and cheese to reach room temperature. Mix by hand all ingredients. Form into small balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Celery Seed Salad Dressing
instructions: Put in blender and mix well. Makes very good dressing.

title: Buffalo Claws
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in a small bowl except for crab. Arrange claws on a broiling pan and brush both sides of each claw with butter mixture. Broil 5 to 6 inches from heat for 3 to 4 minutes or just until crab is hot. Remove from oven and brush lightly with remaining butter mix.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Mix the cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on cooled pretzel mix. Dissolve strawberry Jell-O in the boiling water and cold water. Stir in unsweetened strawberries (mashed). Spread on cheese mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Let sausage come to room temperature. Mix all ingredients and form into balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Drain on paper towel. Serve warm.

title: Ground Oat Flour
instructions: Place Quaker oats in blender or food processor. Cover. Blend about 1 minute stopping blender occasionally to stir oats. Makes 3/4 cup.

title: Condensed Milk
instructions: Put in blender and mix until thick. Will be thick when cool.

title: Pecan Cookies
instructions: Mix together butter egg and sugar. Add vanilla pecans and flour. Mix well. Drop by small teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 until edges are brown. Take off sheet immediately and cool on rack.

title: Blueberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and sour cream. Sift in flour soda salt and baking powder. Mix well. Fold in blueberries. Spray Bundt pan with Pam and put half the batter in pan. Mix sugar pecans and cinnamon. Spoon half of this over batter and then pour the rest of batter on top. Put sugar mixture on top and mix with knife. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Sausage Pop-Ins
instructions: Fry sausage (crumbled into tiny pieces) until done. Drain. Add cream cheese and mix together. Take bread and cut off edges; spread sausage mixture onto bread. Roll up into triangles and wrap bacon around. Insert a toothpick to keep together. Place onto a greased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 until bacon is done. Cool and eat.

title: Mariner'S Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta spirals until done. Drain and cool. Shred crab. In a large bowl combine crab with pasta and mix well. Add the diced green and red peppers celery black olives and shrimp and toss well. Mix dressing with pasta salad until it appears evenly coated. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

title: Corn And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and bake in 1-1/2 quart baking dish at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cheesy Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix and pour into buttered 1-quart dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle top with a little more cheese. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients and mix well. Put into a greased 9x13 baking dish.

title: Mexican Fruit Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and eggs. Add flour and baking soda alternating with pineapple. Add pecans last. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 40 minutes. Cake will be very brown on top.

title: Tomato Catsup
instructions: Cook the tomatoes and onions until tender; put through sieve. Boil juice down 1 hour. Add the salt oils and vinegar; cook 1 hour. Add the sugar. Thicken with the clear-jel. Cook 1/2 hour more and can.

title: Braised Short Ribs
instructions: Clean ribs with cloth or paper towels; trim excess fat. Slowly heat Dutch oven. Add ribs fat side down half at a time. Brown meat well on both sides (about 45 minutes).

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Blend thoroughly the biscuit mix cheese and sausage with hands or mixer until moist enough to form a ball. Bake on cookie sheet for 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Balls can be frozen and thawed later for serving.

title: Sliced Strawberry Jam(1930)
instructions: Cut berries into slices. Put into large kettle; stir and bring to a full rolling boil over high heat. Stir constantly before and while boiling. Boil hard 3 minutes. Remove form heat and stir in pectin. Stir and skim by turns for just 5 minutes to cool slightly to prevent floating fruit. Pour quickly into hot sterilized jars. Seal. Makes 9 to 10 (8 ounce) jars.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Peel eggs. Cut in half. Remove yolk. In a small bowl crumble yolks; add pickle relish salad dressing and mustard. Stir well. Spoon yolk mixture into egg white halves.

title: Vicki'S Stuffed Squash
instructions: Wash and slice squash. Drop into hard boiling water. Bring back to boiling. Drain and run tap water over squash. Place in ice water until chilled. Drain again and put in freezer bags.

title: Kahlua
instructions: An ice ring can be in any shape or size. It is best to use lemonade or the punch you will be serving will be diluted. If you freeze flowers or leaves in the ice ring be sure that the flowers or leaves are not poisonous to your guests.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Brown meat and seasonings. Drain off any fat. Add soup and tomatoes. Simmer. Cook noodles as directed and drain. Layer meat mixture noodles and cheese. Repeat. Save some cheese for top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Orange Tea
instructions: Heat 2 cups water. Add dry ingredients. Dissolve. Add the remaining ingredients and enough water to make one gallon.

title: Mary'S Cornbread Veggie Pie
instructions: Cook and drain veggies. Press evenly in bottom of a 10-inch quiche pan. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix remaining ingredients except for Parmesan cheese. Beat until well combined. Pour into quiche dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife tests done 30 minutes.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring the oleo water and cocoa to a boil. Remove from the heat and add the flour sugar and soda. Beat in egg sour cream and soda. Pour into greased 1 x 15 x 1 1/2-inch cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 20 minutes.

title: Delightful
instructions: Add butter to cinnamon snacks to form crust. Bake for 5 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix Cool Whip cream cheese and sugar and spread on baked crust. Mix pudding with milk. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Cut Twinkies in half and cover bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice banana over Twinkies. Spread pineapple over bananas. Mix instant pudding according to directions and pour over pineapple. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Raspberry Bars
instructions: Baking Temperature 325\u00b0. Baking Time 50 minutes.

title: Nidow
instructions: In frypan heat oil. Saute onion until transparent about 5 minutes. Add tomato curry salt water and eggs. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serve immediately with sauce spooned over eggs. Eggs are pierced to absorb sauce.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix together well. Use 1/3 cup to a cup of boiling water.

title: Quick Pasta Primavera
instructions: Saute in a large skillet the mushrooms onion garlic and butter. Add remaining ingredients and cook until it begins to boil. Boil 8 to 10 ounces pasta. Add pasta to sauce. Heat and serve.

title: Broiled Feta Chicken
instructions: Combine yogurt garlic rosemary and pepper in a shallow dish. Add chicken; turn to coat. Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours.

title: Parmesan Chicken(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Mix egg and water. Dip chicken breasts into egg mixture then roll in crumbs. Brown chicken in skillet on both sides (butter or oil). Place in baking dish. Combine spaghetti sauce and oregano; pour over chicken. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese and garlic salt over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Serve over cooked fettuccine.

title: Ripe Tomato Chow Chow
instructions: Run through food chopper and cook until thick. Can hot.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: In crock-pot mix chicken Italian dressing mushrooms and soup. Cook on low until chicken is done. When ready to serve add sour cream garlic salt salt and pepper. Heat until sour cream is heated through. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Pour into a glass 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan. Chill until firm. Mix 1 (3 ounce) box of instant lemon pudding with 1 cup cold milk. Whip 1 pint whipping cream and stir into pudding mixture. Spread on top of Jell-O mixture.

title: Yeast Rolls (Basic)
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water (110\u00b0). After approximately 10 minutes add 1 egg and let set while mixing milk shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add 1 cup flour; beat well. Beat in yeast and egg mixture. Add remaining flour. Place in greased large bowl; cover. Place in refrigerator 2 hours or even overnight.

title: Plantation Salad
instructions: Marinate artichoke hearts for 2 to 3 hours in olive oil and lemon juice. Tear lettuce into\tbite-size pieces and combine with remaining ingredients in large salad bowl; add artichoke hearts with their marinade and toss lightly.

title: Homemade Reese'S Cups
instructions: Mix crumbs oleo sugar and peanut butter together. On low heat melt Crisco and chocolate chips. Press mixture into pan and pour chocolate over mixture. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients into pot and cook 40 to 50 minutes. Can be served over rice. Can add 1/2 pound shrimp to this.

title: Chicken Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Combine bread cubes and celery in greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan; place chicken over this and sprinkle with onion. Combine eggs soup milk and salt in a bowl; mix lightly. Pour over chicken. Combine flour and cheese; cut in butter. Sprinkle over soup mixture and chicken. Top with slivered almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Mix 3/4 cup sugar and flour. Caramelize 1/4 cup sugar. Heat milk. Pour milk in caramelized sugar. Add sugar and flour mixture. Add 3 beaten egg yolks and dash of salt. Add 3 tablespoons oleo or butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie crust. Top with beaten egg white meringue.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: In microwavable bowl mix powdered sugar cocoa salt vanilla and milk. Slice oleo on top of mixture. Cook 2 1/2 minutes on High then whip to mix evenly. Then pat into flat pan. Refrigerate until hard. Then cut and serve.

title: Dump It Cake(Makes 10 To 12 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Using baking spray or shortening plus flour grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Layer pineapple with juice fruit pie filling dry cake mix nuts and coconut. Top with small pieces of butter or margarine. Place in oven for about 1 hour. Check by inserting with a wooden pick which comes out clean when done. Remove from oven. Cool and serve.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Arrange in layers the chicken vegetables eggs and mixture of broth butter and flour. Flatten biscuits and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until biscuits are brown.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cut fruit; mix well with 1/2 flour salt and baking powder. Add sugar and pecans; mix well. Add eggs to which vanilla has been added. Bake on foil at 300\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool on foil before removing.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package. Drain and rinse. Add remaining ingredients and sprinkle with salad seasoning. Refrigerate.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Open and drain the beans. Combine ketchup sugar vinegar mustard dash of garlic salt and the bacon. Add the sauce to drained beans mixing well. Pour into baking dish. Top with sliced onion and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Very good!

title: Studge Pit Pie(Chocolate Fudge)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into two 9-inch unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Top each slice with Cool Whip as served if desired. Very rich but very good.

title: Vegetable Dish
instructions: Cook broccoli and spinach a little less than it says on package. Also add a little vinegar with water. Combine together after draining well. Add soup tomatoes and cheese then onion rings. Cook for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: In mixing bowl combine mayonnaise flour eggs and milk. Stir in crab onion parsley and cheese. Spoon into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Old Settlers Baked Beans
instructions: Cook beef until browned. Add onion; cook until tender. Add to remaining ingredients except bacon. Stir well. Pour into a 3-quart casserole and top with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Lay crescent rolls on cookie sheet (flat like pizza dough) and pinch seams together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese Ranch dressing and Miracle Whip together. Spread on crescent rolls. Mix all chopped veggies and put on top of cream cheese mixture. Press down lightly. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Refrigerate.

title: Corn Soup
instructions: Melt butter. Add curry rosemary and shallots. Add all corn and half and half. Add chives. Simmer 20 minutes.

title: Favorite Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Peel onion; cut into 1/4-inch slices and separate into rings. Place rings in large bowl. Cover with milk. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Drain on paper towels reserving 2/3 cup milk. Combine flour and salt; stir well. Add eggs reserved milk and 1 tablespoon oil; beat until smooth.

title: Pecan Squares
instructions: Beat ingredients and pour into pie shell.

title: Cherry Pudding
instructions: Cream shortening and add 1 cup sugar. Add milk alternately with flour mixture; beat until smooth. Pour into greased baking dish. Mix cherries 1 cup sugar and hot water. Pour over cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. For half recipe use half batter and all goo.

title: Seven Layer Gelatin Salad
instructions: In a bowl dissolve cherry gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1/2 cup cold water; stir. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Refrigerate until set but not firm about 30 minutes. In a small saucepan sprinkle unflavored gelatin over 1/2 cup cold water. Let stand for 1 minute. Stir in milk and sugar. Cook and stir over medium heat until gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Remove from heat. Whisk in sour cream and vanilla until smooth. Spoon 1 2/3 cups creamy gelatin mixture over the first flavored layer. Chill until set but not firm. Prepare remaining flavored gelatin as directed for cherry. Alternately layer flavored gelatin with creamy gelatin layer allowing each to set before adding next layer. Refrigerate overnight.\tTakes all day to make.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Heat enchilada sauce tomato sauce and water. Brown meat with garlic and onion. Add egg and olives. Add salt and 1/2 cup of sauce. In a casserole layer tortillas (dipped first in sauce) meat mixture and cheese. Pour over remaining sauce. Top with cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Beverly Anne'S Turkey Chili
instructions: Lightly oil large 2 to 3-quart boiler/saucepan. Saute ground turkey in saucepan for 30 minutes stirring when needed. Add onions chopped. Cover and simmer slowly.
