Add garlic salt pepper chili powder paprika and parsley after turkey has browned for about 1 hour. Stir mixture often. Add water tomatoes tomato sauce and more water as needed. Simmer covered for 2 hours or more. Season to taste.

title: Cinnamon Sweet Cake
instructions: Beat together oil egg and skim milk. Add sugar whole wheat flour unbleached flour baking powder and salt and beat until smooth. Spoon into an 8 x 8-inch Pam sprayed pan.

title: Crock Pot Potato Soup
instructions: Mix and heat all thoroughly in slow cooker on low for 6 hours or on high for 4 hours.

title: Beef Oven Stew
instructions: Place in bottom of a casserole dish with a tight fitting lid. Add in layers. Cover tightly and place in a 300\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. Dont stir.

title: Italian Garden Saute
instructions: In heavy 10-inch skillet melt butter. Add zucchini corn pepper onion and seasonings. Saute over medium heat stirring frequently until vegetables are tender and extra liquid has evaporated (8 to 10 minutes). Gently stir in tomatoes. Continue cooking just until hot yet firm. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and crumble. Saute onion in bacon grease. Add bacon pork and beans sugar Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Mix well. Bake in a casserole dish at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cinnamon Nut Coffee Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in small pan over very low heat. Mix sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. Remove margarine from heat and dip biscuits in it one at a time. Roll the biscuits in cinnamon-sugar mix. Place in baking pan or tube pan overlapping the biscuits slightly. Sprinkle with nuts and extra sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Beef Rouladen
instructions: Salt and pepper steak. Spread with mustard sliced bacon onion and dill pickle. Roll up and fasten with nails or toothpicks. Then brown in skillet. Put in roaster and cover with hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Thicken gravy with cornstarch.

title: Double Crust Pastry
instructions: Combine flour and salt; cut in shortening with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle cold water evenly over surface. Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Shape into a ball; chill. Yield Pastry for one double-crust pie.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk and baking powder and extract. Beat well. Add black walnuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger then drain. Add all ingredients (seasonings to taste). On low heat simmer for 1 hour. Mix frequently.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook this mixture of sauce water and syrup until it spins a thread. Add the peanuts. Cook until it looks golden brown stirring constantly. As your remove from heat stir in the soda. Immediately pour onto a greased jelly roll pan. Cool. Break in chunks.

title: Pecan Chewies
instructions: Add 1/2 box of sugar at a time to softened and creamed oleo; cream after each addition. Then add one egg at a time beating well after each addition. Add remaining ingredients except pecans. Beat well and then add pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Teatime Tassies
instructions: Blend together cheese and butter. Add flour. Mix as pie crust; chill at least 2 hours.

title: Fresh Fruit And Lychee Compote
instructions: Combine melon balls oranges apple undrained lychees strawberries and sugar in bowl. Toss with wine and lemon juice if desired. Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours. Toss gently before serving. Serve in stemmed goblets or sherbet dishes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening with sugar; add eggs one at a time. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk; add vanilla. Bake in a tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and salt together. Add nutmeg vanilla and milk beating well. Pour into pastry lined pie pan. Bake about 40 minutes or until knife inserted in sides comes out clean. Bake in hot oven at 450\u00b0 for first 15 minutes then moderate oven (350\u00b0) to finish.

title: California Quiche
instructions: Saute mushrooms celery and onion in butter until limp set aside. Beat eggs; add milk flour salt paprika and Tabasco and beat well. Stir in bacon cheeses and wine in mushroom mixture. Cover and chill.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Heat water; add jello and marshmallows. Stir until dissolved. Cool until thickened; add pineapple cottage cheese pecans and Cool Whip. Chill until firm. Serves approximately 10 to 12.

title: Chocolate Monster Cookies
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. In a small bowl combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Gradually add to creamed mixture mixing well after each addition. Stir in cornflakes oats and coconut. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Place 3-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes. Yields 7 1/2 dozen.

title: No Sugar Added Bourbon Balls
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers until fine add in finely chopped pecans Equal spoonful melted butter and bourbon. Mix well. Make into small balls put on wax paper lined cookie sheet and refrigerate until very firm. Melt chocolate in double boiler with oil and dip balls to cover. Set on wax paper to cool. Store in an airtight container in a cool place.

title: Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Sprinkle broccoli cheese and onion in pie plate. Slightly beat eggs. Beat\tin remaining ingredients then pour cream mixture into pie plate. Bake for 15 minutes. Bake for 30 minutes longer at 300\u00b0 or until knife comes clean inserted 1 inch from edge. Before cutting let stand 10 minutes. Serve in wedges.

title: Lazy W Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix margarine cocoa and the cup of water in saucepan and bring to boil. Mix flour and sugar together. Pour hot cocoa mixture into flour-sugar mixture (do not use mixer). Add buttermilk eggs cinnamon soda and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into 9 x 16-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Combine meat with all other ingredients except fat. Shape into 30 or 32 small meat balls. Brown in fat a few at a time. As they brown remove to a warm plate. When all are brown make a sauce as follows

title: Caponata
instructions: Simmer first six ingredients in covered skillet 15 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients then add to first and simmer 25 additional minutes or until mushy. Serve with crackers (sesame wheat etc). Freezes beautifully.

title: Mother'S Egg Dumplingswestboro, Missouri
instructions: Sift all ingredients together.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple chunks; stir in sugar flour and cheese. Place in lightly buttered casserole dish. Top with crackers mixed with margarine. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: In butter saute peppers and onions. Add garlic powder. Add sausage and brown. Drain excess oil. Spread on thawed bread dough and roll up. Set in bread pan or on sheet pan. Bake 30 minutes until brown. When done and still hot top with butter.

title: Pumpkin Pancakes
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl. In separate bowl add milk eggs oil and pumpkin. Mix that together with dry ingredients. Batter will be thick. Pour out on hot skillet or pancake mold.

title: Steak Burrito
instructions: In 4-inch deep 10-inch diameter pan heat oil at medium flame until it begins to smoke. Quickly add garlic onion and diced bell pepper. Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Quickly add diced potatoes and stir-fry another 3 minutes. Add meat and stir constantly until meat browns then cover pan. Five minutes later add salsa and equal amount of water; cover and simmer on low flame about 25 minutes (until meat is cooked). Heat each flour tortilla on dry griddle 10 seconds per side.

title: Baked Rice
instructions: Stir to mix. Place in a dish with cover. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple very well. Fold in marshmallows (colored ones give a colorful effect) and coconut. Can top with nuts and/or cherries.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese with Miracle Whip or mayonnaise. Add crab green onions and garlic salt. Chill before serving with crackers. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pudding with pineapple until it thickens. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Cover and store in refrigerator. Very good with dressing.

title: Baked Mexican Rice
instructions: In heavy casserole saute onion and garlic in olive oil (or spray casserole with Pam) until just soft. Add rice salt pepper and chili powder. Brown slightly. Add mushrooms chorizo and boiling stock (enough to come 1-inch above rice). Cover with a tight lid and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until liquid is completely absorbed. Sprinkle with cheese. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Pineapple Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients until coated. Refrigerate until cold.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in a tightly sealed container.

title: Plum Cake
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Sift together dry ingredients. Slowly add milk eggs and shortening. Beat well. Add salad oil vanilla and yeast mixture. Beat until dough comes off bottom of bowl. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in a greased bowl and let rise until doubled. Punch down dough and roll out. Place on cookie sheet (same size as dough). Cut each plum in half and slit into quarters. Be generous with plums. Sprinkle with sugar and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Take taco and cut number desired. Prepare hamburger as for tacos. Fill bottom of each taco shell with hamburger. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon chopped onion. Cover with shredded sharp Cheddar cheese.

title: Surprise Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello in all hot water. Add marshmallows. Stir until dissolved. Cool. Add cream cheese. Mix well. Add pineapple. Fold in whipped cream. Chill until set. Make cherry jello. Chill until ready to set. Pour over top of lemon mix. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan and cut in squares.

title: Pickle Roll-Em Ups
instructions: Spread a thin layer softened cream cheese on one side of ham. Trim ends off of pickles. Place the pickle on the edge of the ham. Trim off the ham to be the length of the pickle. Roll the pickle up tightly in the ham. Place a toothpick in each fourth of the pickle. Chill for 1 hour then slice the pickle into 4 slices.

title: Stuffs
instructions: Brown beef with garlic and onion. Prepare shells as directed on box. Drain on paper towels. Cover bottom of flat pan with Ragu. Stuff part of the shells with meat and part with cheese. Cover with Ragu and place in preheated 350\u00b0 oven until cheese bubbles. Serve with French toast and salad. Wonderful main dish!!!

title: Jiffy Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Heat together the first 5 ingredients. Cook until flavors blend. Add the noodles salt and pepper. Cook until noodles are done.

title: A Whole Bunch Of Tangy Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Mix remaining ingredients and add to first mixture and let set overnight. Makes 8 cups.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar cocoa soda and salt together in large bowl. Add oil vinegar vanilla and water. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Tortilla Dough
instructions: In bowl combine flour and salt; cut in shortening until mixture is fine crumbs. Add water gradually; toss with fork to make stiff dough. Form into ball. Knead thoroughly on floured board until smooth and flecked with air bubbles about 4 minutes. Cover; let rest 30 minutes. Roll into 12-inch circle. Fit into 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Layered Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in frozen strawberries pineapple mashed bananas and 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Pour half of mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch oiled pan. Spread with 8 ounces sour cream. Cover with remaining jello mixture. Chill until firm.

title: Hot Cabbage Salad
instructions: In skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserving drippings; set bacon aside. Add onion to drippings and cook until tender. Stir in vinegar water sugar salt and pepper; bring to boiling. Add cabbage and apple; toss to coat. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until cabbage is just wilted. Crumble bacon over top. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Microwave Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Place cucumbers and onions in 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish. Mix together sugar vinegar salt and spices. Pour over cucumbers and onions; cover tightly. Microwave on High for 7 minutes. Uncover stir and cook 2 more minutes. Cool; store in refrigerator or can in jars and seal. Heat jars in microwave half filled with water pack hot pickles in hot containers and seal.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Sift the flour baking soda and salt. Mix sugar butter and egg. Gradually add sifted ingredients to wet ingredients. Stir in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Patties(Fried)
instructions: In a large bowl mix the ingredients well. Batter should be a little thick. If too thin add a little flour to thicken. In a large skillet heat oil to very hot degree. Drop batter by tablespoon into hot oil. Fry 3 to 4 minutes on each side. When done place patties on paper toweling to absorb excess oil. (Do not try baking as batter will not cook inside.) Yield Approximately 14 patties.

title: Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients (flour salt and spices). Use some of flour mixture to dredge raisins and gumdrops (use scissors to cut gum drops and raisins before dredging in flour mixture).

title: Buckeyes (Candy)
instructions: Mix ingredients well with hands and form into small balls (walnut size). Place on waxed paper on cookie sheet. Refrigerate 2 hours.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Peel core and thinly slice apples. Set aside. Combine flour cornstarch sugar and cinnamon. Add apples to mixture and set aside while preparing crusts. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake for an additional 35 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Press into bottom of dish. In saucepan melt butter. Add powdered sugar and eggs; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Pour over crumbs. Place sliced bananas next. Pour pineapple over top of bananas. Spread Cool Whip on top of pineapple. Garnish with pecans and cherries. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Peel and quarter 6 potatoes. Shake in flour mixture in a plastic bag. Lay in a pan and bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0 turning over halfway through.

title: Strawberry-Raisin Scone Bake
instructions: Heat oven at 425\u00b0. Grease an 8-inch round cake pan. Combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Using pastry blender or fork cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk eggs and raisins; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. With floured hands pat half of dough into bottom of greased pan; press dough 1/4-inch up sides. Spread dough with jam. Top with remaining dough; spread evenly. Using sharp knife score dough into 8 wedges. Brush top lightly with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar if desired. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Mexican Avocado Cheese Pie
instructions: Butter a 9-inch pie pan. Line with tortillas overlapping in the bottom and extending 1/2-inch over the top edge. Place onion then tomato then chilies then shredded cheese on the tortillas. Combine the flour salt and baking powder with the milk. Beat the eggs and add to the milk mixture. Pour over the ingredients in the pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Place avocado slices on top like spokes of a wheel and bake 5 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting in wedges. Serve with salsa or taco sauce.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix ingredients as given. Pour into pie shell and bake 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Continue baking 45 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean. Cool completely. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

title: Creme De Menthe Cake
instructions: Mix cake batter as directed on package. Add 4 tablespoons creme de menthe to the batter. Bake the cake and cool. Spread the fudge topping over the cake.

title: Fruit Cocktail Pie
instructions: Make graham cracker crust and line pie pan. Save 1 cup of mixture to sprinkle on top. Melt marshmallows in milk. Add this to whipped cream and fruit cocktail (drain). Pour slowly into crust. Let stand in refrigerator.

title: Polish Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter well. Work in sugar gradually. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla. Add milk alternately with flour and baking powder (combined). Fold in cherries coconut and nuts. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Okra Gumbo
instructions: Cook onion and pepper in oil until tender. Add okra and other ingredients. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Stir frequently. Yields 8 servings.

title: Tub Of Junk
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Measure bread crumbs and 1/2 cup cream into bowl; let set for 5 minutes. Add egg spices and meat; mix all well. Shape meatballs the size of a plum; set aside. Melt butter in skillet; brown meatballs. As they are done remove from skillet. Add flour to the meat drippings from browned meatballs. Add 1/2 cup of cream and the milk to the flour mixture. Stir until smooth. Return meatballs to sauce; simmer over low heat for 25 minutes covered. Serve hot. Serves 4 people.

title: Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar syrup water and salt until forms soft ball in cold water. Add 1/4 mixture to well beaten egg whites. Keep beating. Replace sugar mixture over fire; continue cooking until reaches hard ball stage. Pour slowly over egg white mixture beating constantly. While beating lift candy into air often to let air in. Beat until gloss leaves. Spoon onto wax paper.

title: Brown Mountain Cake With Caramel Frosting
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour. Combine water cocoa and soda stirring well. Add to flour mixture beating well. Stir in vanilla. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 38 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Remove and finish cooling on wire rack.

title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat butter and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour and baking soda; mix well. Stir in oats nuts and coconut. (I bake the first half of the cookie dough without coconut and then add the coconut to the second half.)

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
instructions: Layer 1/2 head lettuce (about 4 cups) into bottom of a large salad bowl. Layer with carrots green onion and 3 hard-boiled eggs (reserve one for garnish). Layer with remaining lettuce bacon peas and radishes.

title: French Vanilla Pudding
instructions: Beat egg; mix in cream cheese. Cream and mix powdered sugar. Pour over crushed vanilla wafers. Top with Cool Whip. Serve chilled.

title: Spicy Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together in order listed. Oil and flour 2 loaf pans. Split between the two pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chicken Log
instructions: Combine cheese steak sauce and curry powder. Beat with mixer until smooth. Stir in chicken celery onion and parsley. Shape into log or ball and chill several hours. Roll in chopped pecans. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix together adding blueberries last. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10-15 mins. Fabulous!

title: Chicken-Grape Salad
instructions: Place chicken in a medium saucepan add 1/4 teaspoon salt and water to cover. Cook covered about 30 minutes or until done. Drain and cool. Slice into strips.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Jelly
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients in heavy pan over low heat to dissolve sugar. Bring to boil and add 1 box of Certo or Sure-Jell. Bring back to boil and cook for 4 minutes. Stirring all the time skim the foam from top. Add a couple drops of green food color. Pour into jars and seal. May also freeze. Use with cream cheese and crackers. Also good with meat.

title: Apple Tart
instructions: In a small skillet heat 3/4 cup sugar stirring constantly until it is liquified and just golden. Remove from the heat and quickly pour into a 10-inch pie plate; set aside. In a small bowl combine the flour cinnamon and remaining sugar. Arrange half of the apples in a single layer in a circular pattern in pie plate. Sprinkle with half of the sugar mixture. Arrange half of the remaining apples in a circular pattern over sugar; sprinkle with the remaining sugar mixture. Place remaining apples over all keeping the top as level as possible. Dot with butter. Roll out pastry to 9-inch; place over apples pressing gently to completely cover. Do not flute. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until golden brown and apples are tender. As soon as tart comes out of the oven carefully invert onto a large serving plate and remove pie plate. Cool. Yield 8 servings.

title: Orange Jello
instructions: Mix tapioca pudding vanilla pudding orange Jell-O and hot water. Cook over medium heat until thick (rolling boil). Cool. Add drained pineapple Cool Whip and drained mandarin oranges. When set top with walnut pieces.

title: Swiss Chocolate Walnut Sliced Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and cinnamon onto waxed paper. Beat butter sugar and egg in a large bowl until fluffy. Stir in chocolate and vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk mixing well after each addition. Refrigerate at least one hour. Divide dough into quarters. Spread walnuts on waxed paper. Shape each quarter of dough into a roll 1-inch in diameter. Roll in walnuts coating well. Wrap each roll in waxed paper. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into 1/4-inch slices. Arrange on lightly greased cookie sheets 1/2 inch apart. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 minutes or until firm. Cool on wire racks. Ice with icing (optional).

title: A-La-Smith Bread
instructions: Mix butter cream cheese and chopped garlic buds and spread on both French bread halves. Grate Jack cheese and sharp Cheddar cheese. Sprinkle over bread. Set on foil. Chop a couple of green onions over both halves. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Cactus Salad
instructions: Drain nopalitos and cut into 1-inch strips. Mix nopalitos onion garlic oregano olive oil lime juice tomatoes and cilantro. Refrigerate overnight. Arrange on a platter lined with romaine. Top with Feta cheese. Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Italian Sausage Bake
instructions: In a large covered skillet saute sausage and onions until sausage is cooked.\tAdd sliced potatoes and sliced zucchini. Add butter or olive oil and sprinkle Italian seasoning on top.\tCover and cook over low heat until potatoes are tender about 30 to 40 minutes. Add water if needed.

title: Green Noodles With Cream, Ham And Mushrooms
instructions: Melt 4 tablespoons of butter or margarine in a medium skillet. Add shallots or onions; saute 5 minutes until soft. Add ham and mushrooms; cook 2 minutes. Stir in cream parsley grated cheese salt and pepper. Reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Orange Frotho
instructions: Pour orange juice into blender. Add egg sugar and vanilla. Blend on high for 20 to 30 seconds. Pour into glasses and enjoy.

title: Sesame Steaks
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag or shallow glass container combine the first 7 ingredients; mix well. Add steaks; turn to coat. Cover & refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Drain & discard marinade. Grill steaks uncovered over medium heat for 5-7 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness. (For rare a meat thermometer should read 140 degrees; medium 160 degrees; well done 170 degrees).

title: Gone-All-Day-Stew
instructions: Mix together tomato soup water and flour until smooth; combine with remaining ingredients in slow cooker. Simmer 5 to 6 hours or overnight until meat is tender. More water may be added. Serve over noodles or in a bowl with corn bread.

title: Maw Maw'S Guacamole Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in blender or food processor. Chill before serving.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Mix scalded milk lard or butter salt and sugar together. When cool add eggs and cake yeast dissolved in 1 cup of lukewarm water. Stir stiff. Work in flour. Put in warm place to rise. Knead again and put in icebox. Use dough when desired. Shape and let rise 2 or 3 hours before baking.

title: Canned Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Pour liquid from can of sweet potatoes into pot and add a little water. Add cloves lemon and brown sugar. Boil all together until thin syrup forms. Add drained sweet potatoes. Cut in half and let boil for a few minutes. Put in serving dish and cover with whole marshmallows while hot.

title: Pecan Chews
instructions: Mix butter and brown sugar. Beat with mixer. Add eggs. Beat well. Mix in flour. Stir well. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Spoon and spread in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Almond Delight
instructions: Place whole graham crackers on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle almonds on top of crackers. Melt butter and add sugar. Boil until frothing. Cook 30 seconds more. Spoon over crackers. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crispy Tofu(Crisp Outside, Soft Inside)
instructions: Soak 4 blocks tofu in salted water overnight or 4 hours if cut in cubes. Cut each block into 9 to 12 cubes depending on size and drain. Dip-fry in hot oil (should be crispy outside and soft inside not hard). Dip or pour Peanut Dressing over Crispy Tofu when ready to eat.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Beat potatoes. Mix in all the spices vanilla eggs milk and butter. Mix well then add flour mixture. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Blue Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate to blend flavors about 1 hour. Offer sliced apples as dippers. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Baked Rice Pudding
instructions: Put rice raisins and salt in saucepan; cover with water. Cook until rice is tender and raisins are plump stirring often. Add more water if needed. Mix the eggs sugar vanilla nutmeg and milk together; blend well. Add to the rice mixture. Mixture must be rather on the thick soupy side as it will thicken while it is baking and still more after it is removed. Pour into a greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for about 20 minutes until it starts to bubble around the edges. The center will be very soft yet. Remove from oven; let set.

title: Basic Crustless Quiche
instructions: Melt butter in bowl. Whip eggs into butter. Add flour baking powder salt cottage cheese and 1/2 of Jack cheese. Add any optional ingredients (i.e. vegetables).

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients except marshmallows. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Pour bag of marshmallows over baked cake as soon as it is done. Put in oven until marshmallows begin to melt.

title: Easy Turkey Pot Pie
instructions: Prepare vegetables as directed on package omitting the salt; do not drain. Add onions soup and turkey to vegetables and pour into 2-quart baking dish. Prepare stuffing mix as directed on package. Spoon over turkey mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 4 to 6 dozen.

title: Greek Moussaka With Eggplant
instructions: Saute the onion until soft. Add meat and tomatoes; cook 5 minutes. Season to taste and remove from heat. Add eggs cheese and parsley. Saute the potatoes and eggplant in oil and butter until soft. In a buttered flat casserole put a layer of eggplant a layer of potatoes and a layer of meat and tomato mixture. Repeat layers. Cover with bechamel (white sauce). Place in preheated 325\u00b0 oven and bake 20 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Layer in a deep casserole. Dont mix. Bake for about 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Squash Pie
instructions: Drain cooked squash and mix in large bowl with other ingredients saving a small amount of margarine and stuffing. Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top and dot with margarine. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 1 hour or until crust is golden brown.

title: Diabetic Delight Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine rice and chicken. Sprinkle with salt and chill. Combine mayonnaise and garlic. Mix with rice and chicken. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly. Serve on lettuce with ripe olive garnish.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Make dressing; put in greased pan packed down. Put diced chicken on top. Put undiluted soup on top. Sprinkle cheese on top. Cover with foil or use a dish with lid. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Claire'S Chicken Wings
instructions: Marinate chicken overnight. Bake chicken for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0; turn over onto other side. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Split Pea Soup
instructions: In a large deep pot combine peas water ham shank onion chicken bouillon and seasonings. Simmer uncovered 1 1/2 hours. Remove ham shank. Trim meat off bone and return meat to pot. Stir in carrots and celery. Simmer uncovered an additional 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until soup reaches desired thickness.

title: Keleen'S Zucchini Bread
instructions: Add vanilla sugar oil and zucchini to the eggs; mix well. Sift together flour soda baking powder salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Blend flour mixture into egg mixture and blend well. Stir in nuts.

title: Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: Unfold 1 package crescent rolls and put into 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Mix the cream cheese sugar egg yolk and vanilla. Put on top of crescent roll then put other package of rolls on top of mixture. Brush with egg white. Sprinkle sugar and a little cinnamon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent roll dough in large jelly roll pan. Bake and cool. Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and Hidden Valley Ranch mix. Spread on cooled dough. Press chopped vegetables onto mixture. Cool. Serves several.

title: Vegetable Sandwiches
instructions: Cube first five ingredients very fine (may use a food processor but do tomatoes by hand). Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup warm water and then add the salt and mayonnaise. Combine with vegetables and stir until well blended. Refrigerate overnight. Mixture gels like jello. Makes approximately 100 finger sandwiches. Best to make just before you serve.

title: Crab Apple Pickles
instructions: Cook ingredients except for apples. Add apples and let simmer until apples are tender. Let stand a couple of hours and pack apples in jars. Heat juice and pour over apples.

title: Delicious Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine all ingredients. In a large baking pan shape into loaf. Cover with two strips bacon if you like that flavor. Pour one 8 ounce can of tomato sauce over all. Serves six. Enjoy.

title: Pepperoni Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Prepare hot roll mix according to box. Divide in 2 parts. Roll out in 2 rectangles. Cover both rectangles with beaten egg and a layer of pepperoni slices. Then cover with a layer of grated Provolone cheese. Roll up like a jelly roll. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Slice to eat when warm.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Drain olives. Dice ham. Chop bell pepper onion and tomatoes. Slice and halve cucumbers. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Chill for a couple of hours before serving.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Heat until mixture comes to a boil; pour over cabbage. Can be kept several hours in fridge.

title: Patio Chicken Salad
instructions: Add curry powder to juice. Stir in Minute rice straight from the box. Cover; remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes while rice takes in all the flavors. Fluff with a fork. Mix with remaining ingredients except mayonnaise. Chill. Add mayonnaise to rice mixture. Mix lightly with a fork. Garnish as desired. Serve on crisp greens. Serves 6.

title: Fruit Cookies(For Diabetics)
instructions: Sift flour and soda; set aside. Over medium heat bring water dates apples and raisins to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in margarine. Pour into bowl. Cool slightly. Stir in dry ingredients oats beaten eggs vanilla and walnuts. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk until thickened. Add sour cream and stir slowly then fold in Cool Whip. Put layers of bananas and wafers in bowl with mixture over each layer. Use extra Cool Whip for topping. Crush vanilla wafers and place on top of Cool Whip.

title: Party Punch For All
instructions: Pour in punch bowl the cranberry juice cocktail ginger ale and pink grapefruit. Chill. Add pineapple sherbet to float in bowl. This helps to chill punch and looks nice.

title: Tuna Hot Dish
instructions: Butter large casserole or deep baking dish. Line bottom with biscuits. Mix rest of ingredients together and pour over biscuits. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Brownies(Chocolate Indians)
instructions: In top of double boiler melt chocolate with margarine. Add to sugar; stir well. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add vanilla and flour; stir into chocolate mixture. Add nuts. Grease and flour a 16 x 7 1/2-inch pan. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. (Do not overbake.)

title: Snow White Nut Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together 6 times. Cream sugar shortening vanilla and almond flavoring. Add milk alternately with flour mixture to creamed mixture. Fold in hickory nuts then egg whites. Bake in two greased and floured 9-inch cake pans for 25 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Combine shortening sugar vanilla eggs and pumpkin. Blend thoroughly. Add other ingredients. Mix. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. \Recipe can be doubled.\

title: Sesame Stars
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and soda together. Combine the next 7 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Add flour mixture and beat until smooth. Stir in milk then seed. Drop by level tablespoonfuls and press out to 1/4-inch thick with bottom of glass. I use palm of hand. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Microwave Easy Lasagne
instructions: In a 2-quart glass casserole brown beef on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir once during cooking. Drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce and water. In another bowl combine Ricotta or cottage cheese egg and pepper.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cook first 6 ingredients in double boiler. When partly cooked add nuts and raisins. Bake crust; add cooked ingredients. Cover with meringue or whipped cream.

title: Caramel Squares
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Remove from heat. Blend in sugar. Cool a bit. Add beaten eggs and syrup. Add dry ingredients nuts and vanilla. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: No-Fuss Italian Tomato Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in heated olive oil until golden brown. Add garlic. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add puree. Season with thyme basil dash of paprika and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Pudding Sandwiches(Makes 22 Sandwiches)
instructions: Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mix; beat with wire whisk until well blended. Gently stir in Cool Whip and marshmallows.

title: Kool-Aid Play Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients adding boiling water last gradually.

title: Chop Suey(A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.)
instructions: Brown meat in oil. Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce. Cook 20 minutes. Add celery onions and soup stock. Cook until nearly done. Add bean sprouts. Cook 3 minutes. Mix together molasses 2 tablespoons soy sauce cornstarch salt and water. Add to vegetable mixture. Cook 5 minutes. Add small can of peas. Serve piping hot over rice.

title: Tallerina
instructions: Fry onion and bell pepper. Add sausage and hamburger meat to brown. Add garlic. Cook egg noodles until tender. Drain. Add corn and tomato sauce. Add fried ingredients chili powder salt and pepper. Put in casserole dish with cheese on top. Cook in slow oven (350\u00b0) for approximately 20 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Pineapple Pudding Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions in oblong dish or pan. Cool.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in casserole dish that has been greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Do not cover.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix in large bowl or container. Use 2 tablespoons per cup of hot water.

title: Sky-High Biscuits
instructions: Tips To lower fat content use skim milk. To lower salt content eliminate salt.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Cut up apples and put in a greased baking dish. Dot with butter and mix with 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Mix like pie crust all little crumbs over the apples then cover with crumb topping. Bake 3/4 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Ryan'S Wassail(Packed With Vitamin C!)
instructions: Using very large pot (or crock pot) bring all ingredients to a slow boil. Let simmer for 10 minutes and serve. Beverage may be chilled for different flavor.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Mix together the margarine sugar and eggs. Sift flour cinnamon soda and baking powder; add to sugar mixture. Add apples and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and add first 10 ingredients. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Layer noodles sauce and cheeses in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle top with parsley flakes. Bake 30 minutes (covered) at 350\u00b0. Bake 30 more minutes uncovered. Let set about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Combine seasonings in plastic bag. Shake potatoes and coat well with mixture. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Place potatoes in pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour turning once.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Arrange apples in greased square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Mix remaining ingredients; sprinkle over apples. Bake until topping is golden brown and apples are tender about 30 minutes. Serve warm and if desired with cream or ice cream.

title: Mexican Corn Bread #1
instructions: Mix meal flour baking powder salt eggs sugar oil corn onions peppers and cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Drain cherries. Mix milk margarine and vanilla. Add sugar a small amount at a time blending well until all sugar is used. Add nuts to mixture. (I use my hands to blend nuts mixture becomes very stiff dough.) Pinch off enough mixture to make a small ball around 1 cherry. Continue until mixture is used. Place on wax paper. Let stand 1 hour. In double boiler melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip each piece of candy in chocolate mixture until covered. Place on wax paper to set. Do not have chocolate mixture too hot. Makes 40 to 50 pieces. Keeps well.

title: Patio Potatoes
instructions: Mix the first 8 ingredients in a large saucepan over medium heat until creamy. Add the thawed hash browns and stir until theyre coated. Turn into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan and cover with the crushed corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Barbara Feldon'S Chicken In A Bag
instructions: You will need 1 brown paper bag.

title: Low Cholesterol Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small saucepan; mix well and cook over low heat uncovered until mixture reaches a boil. Reduce heat and cook for several minutes until mixture thickens. Yields approximately 1 cup. Spoon over ice milk or yogurt. Keep unused mixture in covered jar in refrigerator. Delicious.

title: Marinated Slaw
instructions: Place cabbage and onions in large bowl. Pour sugar over this. Mix in saucepan the next 6 ingredients. Bring this to a boil and pour over cabbage. Cover and marinate overnight. Drain marinade from cabbage before serving. Serve cold. Serves 12.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: Combine chicken and mushroom soups water and rice and put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken pieces on top. Dust with paprika and dot with butter sprinkle onion soup mix over all. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6 to 8 83/4 pork chops can be substituted for chicken.

title: No Fail Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine and cook over low heat stirring until chocolate melts. Blend well and cool.

title: Caesar Vegetable Medley
instructions: Heat oil in 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add vegetables and dressing mix to oil. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes stirring frequently until vegetables are crisp tender. This has 13 grams carbohydrates.

title: Guacamole Dip(Yields 4 Cups)
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese avocado onion lemon juice and seasonings. Mix until well blended. Stir in tomatoes. Chill. Serve with chips.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix limeade and milk together until well blended. Pour into pie crust and freeze.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Arrange apples in bottom of 9-inch layer cake pan. Sprinkle with the lemon juice. Combine sugar crumbs salt spices and butter in mixer. Beat about 1/2 minute on number 1 speed. Stop and scrape bowl. Beat on high speed about 1/2 minute longer. Sprinkle over apples. Bake about 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream ice cream or chilled custard pudding.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Place bones in a large kettle. Cover with water. Add salt. Tie garlic peppercorns onion celery leaves bay leaf and parsley in cheesecloth bag. Skim fat from broth. Add lentils. Cover and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes. Add diced carrots and pepper. Continue cooking for 30 minutes or until carrots and lentils are tender. Yields 6 servings.

title: Blueberry Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Set aside to cool. Stir in pie filling and lemon juice. Chill until partially set. Spoon half the gelatin mixture into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf dish. Chill until set. (Keep remaining gelatin at room temperature.) Combine dairy sour cream and sugar. Spread evenly over gelatin in loaf dish. Top with layer of remaining gelatin. Chill 4 to 5 hours or overnight until firm. Cut in squares and serve on crisp salad greens. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Amaretto Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Sprinkle nuts on bottom of pan. Mix remaining ingredients until light and fluffy; pour into pan. Bake for 1 hour or until tested done. Cool and invert. Prick top with toothpick many many times.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Frankfurters
instructions: Cut franks in quarters and cook slowly for 5 to 8 minutes. Chop onion coarsely. Cut green pepper in long thin strips and quarter tomatoes. Heat fat in a skillet; add onion green peppers tomatoes pineapple and pineapple syrup. Mix cornstarch with water. Add to mixture in skillet. Flavor with vinegar and stir in drained franks.

title: Apple-Ham-Cheese Casserole And Black Beans Pepper Relish
instructions: Place ham in casserole. Mix apples lemon juice 1 tablespoon sugar and spices. Spread on top of ham. Mix flour salt and 1/3 cup sugar. Cut in oleo with fork. Mix in cheese lightly. Spread over apple mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Uncover to brown 5 to 10 minutes more.

title: Mariachi Salsa Dip
instructions: Drain cottage cheese in colander. Place in small bowl and stir in salsa. Mix well chill and serve.

title: Cheesy Drummettes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grate Cheddar and Parmesan cheeses. Melt margarine in garlic powder. Mix bread crumbs cheeses salt and pepper. Dip drummettes in margarine. Coat drummettes with crumb mixture. Place on foil lined baking pan making sure pieces do not touch each other. Pour remaining margarine over chicken if desired. Bake uncovered for 40 to 45 minutes or until tender and brown.

title: Chicken Crisp Bake
instructions: Mix and place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with grated Cheddar cheese and potato chips. Crush potato chips and put on just before baking. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can be served hot or cold.

title: Chicken Cordon Blue
instructions: Beat chicken with clever until very thin. Top with 1 piece of\tham and cheese. Roll up and place in greased casserole dish. Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken. Bake at\t350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.\tServe over rice or buttered noodles.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Melt marshmallows in oil and margarine. Pour into popped corn. Stir well. Add M&Ms candies. Spread into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Give it time to set then turn onto waxed paper and enjoy.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash till tender. Drain. Add other ingredients reserving 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup crumbs. Mix together and pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle reserved crumbs and cheese on top of casserole and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30-40 minutes.

title: Goober Haystacks
instructions: Place chips in microwave dish and cook on High for 1 minute; stir. Microwave on High for 1 minute more. Stir until smooth. Add peanut butter and stir. Add peanuts and noodles. Stir until well coated. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper to cool. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Whiskey Pie
instructions: Bake crust for 10 mins. at 350\u00b0. Mix flour and sugar together. Beat eggs and butter together and then mix all other ingredients in. Fold in chocolate chips and pecans. Pour in pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Brush bottom and sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan with butter; sprinkle with 1/4 cup breadcrumbs. Beat cream cheese and Roquefort in a large mixing bowl at high speed of an electric mixer until creamy. Add Parmesan cheese and next 3 ingredients beating until blended. Add eggs one at a time beating just until yellow disappears.

title: Southern Cream Cookies(5 Dozen)
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add and mix well eggs vanilla and sour cream. This can be the store bought regular or nonfat or the best is soured whipping cream. Add after mixed together the flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Add nutmeats. Drop from teaspoon onto lightly sprayed (vegetable oil) cookie sheet. Spray the bottom of a glass or a cookie press. Dip into a mixture of 3 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Press cookies flat. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Holiday Cranberry Mold
instructions: Add 1 cup boiling water to cranberry sauce. Add 1 cup boiling water to jello. Mix until dissolved. Put cranberry and jello mixture together. Add nuts. Put 1/2 of mixture in a greased mold. Put in freezer to set. Spread sour cream over first layer. Add the rest of the mixture on top of sour cream. Refrigerate until set. You can use all low calorie and fat-free then omit nuts.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli until it is a dark green color and set aside. Saute onion in butter until tender. Add soup cheese and mustard; heat until bubbly. Place broccoli in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Pour soup mixture over top and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Add crushed crackers over mixture and bake for 5 more minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cake Icing
instructions: Stir until well blended; boil slowly without stirring until mixture will spin a long thread when a little is dropped from a spoon. Hold spoon high above saucepan. Meanwhile put into a large bowl of Mixmaster; beat 2 egg whites and blend together with other mixture. Put on cake and sprinkle coconut on top.

title: Miniature Cupcakes
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese egg sugar and salt; mix well. Blend in chocolate chips; set aside. Sift together flour sugar cocoa soda and salt. Stir in water oil and vanilla. Line miniature cupcake pans with paper liners. Fill each cup 1/3 full with cocoa mixture; top with 1 teaspoon cheese mixture. Sprinkle with ground nuts or chocolate shot if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Bread(2 Loaves)
instructions: The bread loaves may be frozen after cooling.

title: Punch (Frozen Slush)
instructions: Stir hot water into jello until dissolved. Add cold water orange juice lemonade pineapple juice and pop.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine corn meal flour and onion. Add egg. Gradually beat in milk or water. Drop from a spoon into hot fat where fish was fried. Fry until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Spread with butter and serve hot with fish. This makes about 16 small hush puppies.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add other ingredients except cheese. Mix well. Pour into well-greased baking dish. Cover with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot with nacho chips.

title: Steamed Mussels
instructions: Note Mussels should be scrubbed or \debearded\ right before cooking to retain their freshness.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Trim stem from eggplant but dont peel. Cut into 1/2-inch slices then cut into cubes. Place the eggplant slices in a bowl with salted water to cover. Weight eggplant down with a plate. Let soak 15 minutes. Remove seeds and membrane from pepper then cut into strips and chop coarsely. Cut zucchini ends then slice crosswise thinly. Heat oil in Dutch oven or large skillet. When sizzling add onions sweet pepper and zucchini. Cover and cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Combine garlic and parsley then stir into onion mixture. Drain eggplant thoroughly. Stir eggplant into mixture. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Add tomatoes salt pepper and sugar mixing thoroughly. Cover and cook for 5 to 10 minutes or until flavors blend. Serve hot.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt in a large bowl. Stir in liquids and mix making stiff batter. (Do not knead at this time.) Push dough aside and spray with Pam or grease with Crisco. Turn dough over to grease all sides. Cover lightly with foil and let stand overnight in warm place. (A cold oven is a good place to let it stand.)

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well and shape into 2 balls. Roll in chopped walnuts and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Three Meat Dumplings
instructions: Cook soup bone about 2 hours. Put liver salt pork onions and parsley through food chopper. Mix together with beef. Add eggs salt and pepper then mix. Add flour just to stick together (should be very moist). Drop by spoonful (size of meatballs) into hot broth; bring to a boil. Simmer 2 to 3 hours stirring often using only a wooden spoon. Keep covered. Very good served over boiled potatoes or toast.

title: No-Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Beat the cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip blending well. Spoon into crust. Chill until set at least 4 hours. Garnish with fresh strawberries if desired.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix pudding and milk until stiff. Fold in half of whipped topping. Pour into pie shell. Spread remaining topping on pie. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Drain Veg-All and place in a large bowl. Add onions and mix. Add mayonnaise and cream of chicken soup to mixture. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Cover mixture with crushed Ritz crackers (and 1 tablespoon of melted butter if desired). Bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Weight Watchers Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs for 5 minutes. Add bread sugar and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. I also add raisins and nuts.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix pudding milk sugar cream cheese and butter. Fold in the Cool Whip set aside. In large bowl layer the cookies then the pudding mix making three layers of each ending with cookies to look like dirt. Add artificial flowers to center when ready to serve.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Cut the first 3 ingredients together with pastry blender. In a large measuring cup beat egg. Add vinegar and fill cup with water. Add to flour mixture and mix to blend. These crusts can be separated into small bags and frozen to use at a later time (although they are best when baked fresh!). Makes 6 to 8 crusts.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Drain noodles and add butter and Parmesan cheese. Stir. Pat in bottom of casserole dish. Brown ground beef; drain. Add spaghetti sauce. Put cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese over noodles. Pour meat sauce over cheese. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix green beans and corn (drained); put in greased casserole. Mix soup sour cream Cheddar cheese onions and salt; spread over beans and corn. Mix melted margarine with crushed crackers and slivered almonds; spread on top of casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve on lettuce leaf or serve on crackers.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Add cornstarch to small amount of water. Add boiling water. Add jello and stir. Add sugar. Put strawberries in pie shell then pour mixture over this. Refrigerate until mixture has jelled. Top with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: Soft English Toffee Bars
instructions: Generously butter a jelly roll pan; line it with a single layer of crackers and set aside. In a saucepan boil butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes. Pour this over crackers and bake 7 minutes at 400\u00b0. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips on top. When melted spread chips evenly over crackers. Sprinkle with nuts if desired. Cool and break into pieces (or cut into 1 to 2-inch squares with a sharp knife).

title: Old Fashioned Pumpkin Pie(My Husband'S Favorite)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat eggs slightly. Add pumpkin sugar spices and salt. Beat until well blended. Slowly add milk and cream. Pour into shell. Bake 60 to 70 minutes or until knife inserted into center comes out clean. Cool. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli first then mix into all other ingredients except crackers. Pour into 2-quart greased casserole; add crushed crackers on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: Dice onion and mix with ground beef in a large skillet. (Season with salt and pepper.) Mix all other ingredients in a large pot and simmer until ground beef is done. Add ground beef to large pot and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Shakes
instructions: Combine boiling water and gelatin in blender container; process until gelatin dissolves. Add pie filling; process until smooth. Chill until serving time. Spoon into 12 (12 ounce) glasses. Add 1 scoop ice cream to each glass; mix gently. Fill glasses with milk; mix gently. Garnish with peppermint stick stirrers.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix in order given and let stand in refrigerator (not freezer) for 24 hours to season.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as to directions on box. Bake in a greased and floured sheet cake pan. While cake is still hot poke holes in cake and pour the coconut cream over cake. Mix cream cheese whipped topping and powdered sugar until smooth. Frost cake and sprinkle with coconut. Keep refrigerated. (This cake is very moist.)

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour into shallow baking dish. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 or microwave until heated through. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Mud Hen
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add 1 whole egg and 1 yolk. Gradually blend in flour. Add vanilla. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix pecans egg white (do not beat) and brown sugar. Pour over top of first mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar. Beat eggs; mix well. Sift flour soda baking powder and salt together. Add dry ingredients to first mixture. Add vanilla and oatmeal; mix well. Add chocolate chips and pecans. Drop on a cookie sheet and cook 10 to 12 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly and form into balls. Roll in chopped nuts. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Spaghetti Bake(Very Easy Dish That Kids Love!!)
instructions: In a big saucepan cook ground beef chopped onion and minced garlic until beef is browned and onion is tender. Drain off excess fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes tomato sauce mushroom stems and pieces sugar crushed oregano salt and crushed basil. Bring meat mixture to boiling. Boil gently uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes stirring sauce occasionally.

title: Cheese Cake Miniature
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes until smooth. Fill petit four papers to top. Bake 10 minutes or longer at 350\u00b0. Put a cherry on top with a little sauce.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice separate and drain. Add butter while rice is still hot. Add other ingredients. Pour in a baking dish and bake at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place in greased 8 x 8-inch baking dish and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Violet'S Ice Cream
instructions: *Or you can use 2 large packages pudding and 4 cans Milnot.

title: Corn And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions; drain. Mix crackers with butter. Reserve 1 cup to top casserole. Butter baking dish; mix all ingredients. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Balls
instructions: Knead together chicken cream cheese and lemon pepper. On each triangle of rolls put only enough mixture so the dough can be molded completely around it to form a ball. Roll in butter and then in a mixture of the croutons and pecans. Bake on cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook 2 minutes on High. Stir until lumps are removed. Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts or marshmallows; stir. Add vanilla. Pour on buttered platter. Let cool before cutting.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash potatoes; pare thinly and remove eyes. Cut potatoes into thin slices to measure about 4 cups.

title: Dawn'S Ice Cream Jello
instructions: Prepare each flavor separately as follows Dissolve each flavor with 1 cup hot water in small bowl. Add 1/4 of the ice cream until dissolved. Pour into serving bowl or mold; refrigerate until firm or freeze for 10 minutes and repeat with each flavor layer.

title: Molded Seafood Salad
instructions: Soften gelatine in cold water; stir over low heat until dissolved. Cool. Gradually add gelatine to combined cream cheese mayonnaise lemon juice and salt mixing well until blended. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Pour into lightly oiled 3-cup mold; chill until firm. Unmold. Garnish with additional chopped parsley and lemon slices if desired.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add other ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Yields 2 pies.

title: Pecan Tosses
instructions: Combine margarine cream cheese and flour and mix like pie dough. Divide into 36 small balls. Press each ball into bottom and sides of bite-size cupcake pans. Sprinkle half of nuts on crust.

title: Wednesday'S Chili
instructions: Heat oil and brown beef over medium high heat crumbling beef with fork until beef is done. Set aside. Puree onion soup in blender. Pour over beef stirring over medium heat until it has consistency of rice. Stir in spices. Add undrained beans tomato paste and sauce. Stir until well combined. Heat over low heat at least 20 minutes until hot and flavors have blended. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Marinated Steak
instructions: Stab meat on both sides. Put on light sprinkling of meat tenderizer. Leave whole. Marinate for 48 hours. Turn after 24 hours. Grill each side 1/2 hour. Baste with marinating sauce. Cut into pieces. Will marinate 5 to 6 pounds steak.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Put sugar and cocoa in a 4-cup measure and put margarine on top. Cook on High for 1 1/2 minutes until margarine melts. Stir. Stir in milk. Cook on High for 2 minutes then stir. Cook on High for 1 1/2 minutes longer. Sauce should boil for about 1 minute.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Put hash browns on bottom of dish. Mix all other ingredients except cheese and pour over hash browns. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into serving dish and refrigerate.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Lower the temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes until set.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and oil. Combine dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Add squash raisins and nuts. Stir well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done when tested with a toothpick.

title: Chocolate Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Nut Crescents
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add water and vanilla. Mix in flour. Shape into crescents on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. May also be dropped by teaspoon onto cookie sheet and decorated with a pecan half. Chopped pecans or chocolate chips may also be added.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Blend sugar syrup and oleo in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until it boils. Blend slowly into beaten eggs. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Pour into pie crust and bake for 30 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Combine all together. Mixture should be stiff. Cook in a greased loaf pan for at least 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Cookie Pie
instructions: Microwave marshmallows and 2 tablespoons milk in medium microwaveable bowl on high for 45 seconds. Stir. Marshmallows will be partially melted. Refrigerate 15 minutes to cool. Stir in 1 cup of the Cool-Whip. Pour 2 cups milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 1 minute or until thickened. Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups of Cool-Whip. Spoon into the pie crust. Arrange cookies over pudding mixture. Spread marshmallow mixture over the cookies. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Drizzle with chocolate topping just before serving if desired. Store leftover pie in refrigerator. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crab Pate
instructions: Heat soup over low heat. Remove. Dissolve gelatin in cold water; add to soup. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon into 4-cup mold. Chill until firm. Serve with assorted crackers. Simply scrumptious!

title: Gloria'S Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken and debone. In baking dish melt margarine. Add broth cream of celery soup and chicken. Mix well. Mix flour and milk together and pour over top of mixture. Bake at 325 to 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Grandma Henrietta'S Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Heat the oven to 375\u00b0. Line the pan you are going to use with aluminum foil and grease the foil. Pare the raw potatoes and slice them thin. You can put the slices into a pot of water to keep them from turning dark while you work. Drain before using. Place a layer of potatoes 1 inch deep in the baking dish. Sprinkle a portion of the flour over each layer; add part of the butter in bits and season with a dash of pepper. Repeat the layers until the required amount is used. It is best not to have more than 2 to 3 layers because of difficulty in cooking. Pour on the milk until it can be seen between the slices. Cover and bake until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Remove cover during last 15 minutes to brown the top. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Coconut Chess Pie
instructions: To butter add eggs milk and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Add sugar flour and coconut. Mix well again. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 300\u00b0 and bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Mix the dates sugar and margarine in a heavy saucepan. After the sugar dissolves continue to cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. Stir constantly while cooking. Remove from heat. Stir in the Rice Krispies pecans and vanilla. When cool enough to handle roll into bite-size balls. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Break bacon. Add all ingredients together and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or put in crock-pot for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Spread shredded raw cabbage over buttered oblong pan. Spread with raw meat out of casing. Cover with spices and blanket with sauce. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Mix and serve with grated cheese Italian beans bread and fruit.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Day Before Serving Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. In a large bowl mix first 5 ingredients with fork. With pastry blender cut shortening into mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs. With fork stir in bananas and eggs just until blended. Spread evenly in pan. Bake 55 minutes to 1 hour until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on rack. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Old-Fashioned Beef Stew
instructions: Thoroughly brown meat on all sides in fat turning often. Add boiling water Worcestershire sauce garlic sliced onion bay leaves and seasoning. Cover and simmer dont boil for 1 1/2 hours. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking. Remove bay leaves and garlic clove. Add remaining vegetables. Cover and cook 30 minutes more or until vegetables are done. Remove meat and vegetables and thicken liquid for gravy if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups In Mandarin Sauce
instructions: Pound chicken breasts very thin pat dry. Mix sesame oil rosemary mushrooms green onions salt and pepper. Place small amount of this mixture on chicken breast roll chicken breast around mushroom mixture roll in bread crumbs. Saute in small amount of oil until rolls are firm and chicken cooked through. Combine mandarin juice salt turmeric ginger and cornstarch in saucepan. Mix until well blended bringing to a boil over medium heat. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until thickened. Slice chicken rolls into 1/2-inch slices. Serve with heated mandarin sauce. Serves 4.

title: Pancit
instructions: Boil chicken skin and bone. Soak noodles in the broth and cut up the chicken.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar and vanilla; beat until fluffy. Fold in whipped cream. Put into pie crust. Chill for several hours. Top with berry filling.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs. Sift flour salt baking powder and\tbaking\tsoda. Add this to other dry ingredients. Add to sugar mixture a little at a time; this will be very stiff. Add vanilla last. Drop by spoonfuls on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Chicken Salad With Grapes And Cashews
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Debone and chop into bite size pieces. Mix chicken celery and onion together. Let set in fridge a couple hours. Before serving add green grapes (cut in half) cashew nuts and enough Miracle Whip to mix well. Add a dash of Worcestershire sauce and a dash of salt and pepper. Mix well; chill and serve.

title: Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Use 5-quart or 6-quart covered pan. Cover chicken breasts with water to top of pan. Add salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer to make broth. Add diced onions chopped celery and sliced carrots to broth. Remove chicken when done; cool and debone.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Roast pecans by placing them on a cookie sheet for 10 to 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Watch carefully to prevent burning. Combine chicken celery mushrooms water chestnuts pecans and about 3/4 bacon bits. Blend sour cream salt lemon juice and pepper into chicken mixture. Add enough mayonnaise to moisten salad thoroughly and toss lightly. Chill thoroughly. When ready to serve garnish top with the rest of the bacon bits. May be served in individual lettuce cups or on a lettuce-lined platter.

title: Green Beans And Mushrooms
instructions: Cut onion into thin vertical slices. Separate slices into strips; set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok over high heat (or use heavy skillet). Add mushrooms; stir-fry 1 minute. Use a slotted spoon to place mushrooms in a large bowl; set aside. Heat second tablespoon oil add onion and stir-fry 1 minute. Spoon cooked onion into bowl with mushrooms. Heat remaining tablespoon of oil over high heat. Add beans; gently stir-fry until bright green and glossy with oil. Reduce heat to low. Add broth and sugar. Cover and simmer until beans are tender 10 to 20 minutes depending on age and size of beans. Stir occasionally.

title: Jolly Roger
instructions: Flour chicken and brown in oil. Put rice and onion in greased casserole. Add mushrooms with juice. Arrange chicken on top. Mix water with bouillon and pour over top. Dot with butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove cover for last 5 minutes.

title: Steak Fingers
instructions: Cut round steak (against the grain) to the length and width of index finger. Sprinkle with garlic salt and Season-All (be sure to rub in). Place in container. Cover with Worcestershire sauce; cover with lid and marinate at least 1 hour. Mix egg and milk. Dip steak in mixture; roll in flour salt and pepper mixture. Deep fat fry 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown.

title: Bean And Leek Soup
instructions: Simmer the beans covered in half the stock for 2 hours. If all stock is absorbed during cooking add water so the pan is moist.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Mix refried beans with salsa and remaining ingredients. Layer in pan 1/2-inch thick. Micro until bubbly.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: In frying pan brown beef; add onions onion soup and 1/2 cup water and simmer until ground beef is done. Cook raw vegetables until tender. In large kettle add liquids and beef mixture; rinse pan good with all other ingredients and simmer good. Any other herbs or liquids can be added. Serve hot.

title: Hamburger Upside Down
instructions: Cook elbows until tender. In skillet melt butter. Saute onion and garlic until tender. Add beef and cook stirring until brown. Drain and stir in tomato sauce salt pepper and oregano. Simmer 5 minutes. Spread beef mixture into bottom of greased 2-quart casserole. Toss cooked elbows with grated cheese. Arrange on top of meat mixture and pack down. Combine eggs and milk; pour over elbows. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Stir together the melted butter crumbs and sugar. Press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake from 5 to 8 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Luscious Lemon Cream
instructions: In a small bowl beat eggs 1/2 cup sugar and ReaLemon juice until frothy. In medium saucepan combine remaining sugar and cornstarch. Gradually add water; mix well. Over medium heat cook and stir until thickened and clear; remove from heat. Gradually beat in egg mixture. Add vanilla. Cool. Fold whipped cream into sauce. Chill. Serve with fresh fruit. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 3 cups.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients together for 4 minutes with mixer. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Spinach Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix the sour cream soup salt pepper garlic and cheese together. Reserve some of mixture to put on top of casserole. Spread layer of mixture in bottom of 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Add layer of noodles then spinach. Repeat layers. Spread reserved mixture on top; sprinkle with paprika. Add a little Parmesan cheese if desired for color. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and 3 tablespoons sugar together. Spread in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Let cool. Blend cream cheese Cool Whip and 1 cup sugar together and spread over pretzels. Mix jello boiling water and strawberries together. Let cool in refrigerator and pour onto the cream cheese layer. Serve cold. Enjoy!!

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: In large bowl heat Cheddar Blue and cream cheese until smooth. Add milk onion Worcestershire mustard paprika and garlic salt. Chill and shape into ball. Roll in sesame seed or chopped nuts. Wrap in protective paper and chill.

title: Spiced Fruit Salad Ring
instructions: Simmer juice vinegar and spices for 10 minutes. Add fruit and simmer for 5 minutes. Soften gelatin in 2 tablespoons of cold water. Strain fruit and add jello and gelatin to hot juice. Stir until dissolved. When cool add fruits and mold in oiled salad mold. Chill. Serves 10 to 12. Excellent with ham or turkey.

title: Egg Popovers
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs with milk flour and salt until smooth and the consistency of heavy cream. Heavily butter custard cups or popover pans and fill each about 2/3 full of batter. Bake in preheated hot oven (425\u00b0) for 30 to 35 minutes or until puffed and brown. Serve at once with butter or marmalade.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Combine butter sugar and vanilla. Beat well. Add eggs and beat. Stir in flour. Gradually add chocolate chips pecans and coconut and mix. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Uncle George'S Crab Bites
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and spread on English muffin halves; can be frozen at this point. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Coffee Cake Muffins
instructions: Combine brown sugar walnuts 2 tablespoons flour cinnamon and butter. Set aside. Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Cut in shortening until it resembles coarse crumbs. Combine egg and milk; add to flour mixture and stir just until moistened.

title: Cherry Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cherries. Pour batter in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan reserving a small amount of batter. Top with cherries. Use reserved batter to put on top of cherries in small spoonfuls scattered around. Bake for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Butternut Pound Cake
instructions: *You can use all butternut flavoring.

title: Washington Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with a mixer until thick and light. Combine sugar and oil. Pour into eggs with mixer on medium speed. Stir together flour cinnamon soda and salt. Add to egg mixture with vanilla. Beat to mix. Stir in walnuts. Spread thinly sliced and pared ripe apples in a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour batter over apples spreading to cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Cool and spread with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Portuguese Corn Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water and one teaspoon sugar; let it stand for 5 minutes or until it doubles. Place regular flour in a large bowl add yeast and 2 cups warm water mix and knead for about 5 minutes. Cover and let it rise until it doubles in bulk. Bring 2 cups water and salt to a boil. Pour boiling water over corn meal flour and mix very fast. Cool. Make a well in the yeast mixture and add corn meal knead until dough is smooth about 10 minutes. Cover with a cloth and a blanket let it rise until double in bulk. Grease a 4-cup bowl sprinkle with regular flour place one-third of dough in the bowl turn and shake bowl until dough is smooth. Pour dough in a greased ovenproof pie plate. Do the same with the other two parts of the dough. Bake in a preheated 450\u00b0 oven for about 45 to 50 minutes. Remove from the oven and place loaves on a wet cloth and cover. The crusts will be soft. Makes 3 loaves. Portugal.

title: Southern Fried Oysters
instructions: Combine corn meal flour and pepper stirring well. Combine eggs and milk beating well with a fork. Dip oysters in egg mixture and dredge in flour mixture. Pour oil to depth of 2 to 3 inches in a Dutch boiler. Heat to 375\u00b0. Fry oysters in oil until golden turning once. Drain on paper towels. Yields 6 servings.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs jam and preserves. Sift together flour salt soda cinnamon allspice cloves and nutmeg. Add alternately with buttermilk. Fold in raisins and nuts. Bake in tube pan 1 hour at 250\u00b0 then at 350\u00b0 for 1 more hour.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Beat egg and milk together. Gradually pour over pudding. Add rice and stir over medium heat until it comes to a boil. Cool 5 minutes. Stir 2 times. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Italian Style Meat Loaf
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients; mix well. Place in a glass Pyrex bread loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Drain.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Form into patties or croquettes. Coat all sides with crushed crackers. Cook in hot skillet of oil until all sides are golden brown. Drain on paper towel on plate. Serve with ketchup.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with an electric mixer. Follow the directions on the cake mix box. Bake in greased 9 x 12-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or so. Cool and cover with following icing.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In skillet brown ground beef; drain. Add Sloppy Joes mix and tomato paste; cook as directed on Sloppy Joes mix package. Unroll dough; place one unrolled can of dough in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Press to seal perforations. Pour ground beef mixture over dough. Layer both cheeses over ground beef mixture. Unroll second can of dough. Press to seal perforations. Place over filling. Bake 20 to 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Biscuit Topped Italian Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Stir in water pepper tomato sauce and tomato paste; simmer 15 minutes stirring. Remove from heat. Add vegetables and 1 1/2 cups cheese.
