Spoon into greased 2-quart baking dish. Separate each biscuit into 2 layers. Place near outer edge of meat mixture overlapping. Sprinkle remaining cheese in center and around edge. Brush biscuits with margarine. Sprinkle with oregano. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Friendship Cake With Icing
instructions: Mix and frost cake.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: To start mix 1 1/2 cups flour with the oil and set aside. Mix ingredients in order. Add the flour and oil at the very end. Add chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or more. Makes 3 small loaf pans or 8 tin cans. When baking with cans cut baking time down.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: After mixing first 4 ingredients freeze. Before serving add ginger ale and strawberries.

title: Gram'S Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Rinse with hot water. Saute chopped onion in Wesson oil until transparent. Mix cooked spaghetti onion and tomato juice; simmer (best in iron skillet) covered until juice is absorbed 30 minutes plus. Stir occasionally.

title: Sue Bee Honey Mustard Sauce And Dip
instructions: Melt margarine in small saucepan; remove from heat. Add cornstarch and turmeric; mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients and mix well. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Bill'S Favorite  Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine sugar milk and cocoa in saucepan. Bring to a rolling boil. Boil for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Take off stove; add remaining ingredients and stir hurriedly. Drop tablespoonfuls onto wax paper. Cool then enjoy!

title: Pa Apps' Meatballs(From Medina High'S Class Of '69)
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Form into golf ball size balls and slowly brown in frying pan. After cooking store in plastic bags or containers in freezer and use when needed.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in oil until tender. Add beef and brown. Add all other ingredients. Cook and drain spaghetti and add to meat mixture. Pour in a large baking dish. Cover with cheese. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbly. Can be made weeks ahead and frozen.

title: Blueberry Snack Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix 1 cup flour butter and 10x sugar until smooth. Spread over bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients together. Spread over top of baked cookie base. Bake 30 minutes and cool. Cut into 2 1/2 x 1-inch bars. Makes 24 bars containing 115 calories each serving.

title: Blueberry Crisp
instructions: Mix together the blueberries sugar and cornstarch. Place in 1 1/2-quart baking dish (8 x 8-inch). Blend remaining ingredients together until crumbly and spread over blueberries. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serve warm with cream or ice cream. Frozen berries can be used.

title: Oatmeal Cookies For A Crowd
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Vermicelli Soup
instructions: Add diced potatoes to broth; cook about 7 minutes. Add vermicelli noodles and cook until done. Add 1 packet Vigo flavoring and prepared sauce.

title: Broccoli-Cheddar Meat Loaf
instructions: Finely roll 12 crackers. Mix cracker crumbs turkey onion 2 tablespoons chili sauce parsley and egg. On waxed paper pat meat mixture into 12 x 8-inch rectangle. Reserve 2 tablespoons cheese; sprinkle remaining cheese and broccoli onto meat mixture to within 1/2-inch of edge. Coarsely break remaining 12 crackers. Sprinkle over broccoli pressing lightly into meat. Starting at short end roll up jellyroll fashion using waxed paper to help roll; seal ends. Place loaf into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Last 5 minutes of baking spread remaining 2 tablespoons chili sauce over meat loaf; sprinkle with reserved cheese.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla. Stir over low heat until margarine is melted. Let come to a rolling boil and time 1 1/2 minutes. Add vanilla. I like to put this over a 9 x 13-inch yellow cake. Put holes in the cake and let it run all through the cake.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Mix all cheeses eggs parsley salt and pepper. Cook meat until no longer pink; drain. Add to cheese mixture. Cook shells according to box directions; stuff with mixture. Place in large baking dish or pan. Top generously with sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Knock 'Em Naked Bars
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients (will be crumbly). Press 1 3/4 of mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Melt caramels and milk in double boiler or microwave; blend. Pour over warm cake. Sprinkle chocolate chips and rest of cake mix. Bake 18 to 20 minutes more. Do not overbake. Cool in pan.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Beat margarine Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add flour and milk beating well after each addition. Add eggs all at once. Mix only until eggs are blended. Add flavorings. Pour into a well greased and floured tube pan. Put into a cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Cook onion and green pepper in butter or oleo until tender. Blend in soup and milk. Add chicken pimiento and pepper. Heat slowly; stir often. Serve over toast mashed potatoes or cooked egg noodles. You may add 2 boiled eggs cut after youre finished cooking. Makes 4 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread in milk; fry onion in butter and mix all together. Put in as much celery and parsley as desired. Bake in a loaf pan at 350\u00b0 until done about 1 hour.

title: Apple-Oatmeal Treats
instructions: First halve core and chop the apples. Put them in a steamer sprinkle with cinnamon and steam until tender usually about 10 minutes. (If you dont have a steamer try placing a strainer in a pot with about two inches of water and cover.)

title: Pizza Quick Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain off and put meat in the bottom of a 9 x 9-inch casserole dish. Pour pizza sauce over meat and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Russian Tea(Instant)
instructions: Use 2 heaping teaspoonfuls to a cup of hot water. Add pineapple juice to your own taste.

title: Chili Spiced Beef And Bean Stew
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet cook onions beef and sausage over medium heat until meat is browned. Pour off fat. Meanwhile in Dutch oven combine remaining ingredients except spaghetti. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Add browned meat. Cook stirring occasionally until stew is thickened (20 to 30 minutes). Meanwhile cook spaghetti according to package directions. Serve stew over spaghetti.

title: Hamburg Casserole
instructions: Press meat lightly in the bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan. Layer onion frozen peas cream of mushroom soup cream of chicken soup and Cheddar cheese. Place Tater Tots on top. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Makes 10 servings.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Place chops in baking dish. Slice potatoes and onions round; place on top of chops in layers. Pour sauce on top. Cover with tinfoil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Apple And Yam Bake
instructions: Grease a 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Mix together apple pie filing and sweet potatoes; pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs nutmeg and chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Coconut Bonbons
instructions: Mix coconut sugar softened butter desired extract and Eagle Brand milk. Form into balls. Refrigerate until firm and cold.

title: Spice Cake(Peppercake)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix baking soda and sour cream first and then add to rest of mixture. Spray Pam in a loaf pan and put mixture in loaf pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: In large bowl layer in order and refrigerate overnight. Mix well before serving.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Place meat in a 3-quart casserole and sprinkle generously with seasoned salt. Mix the cans of Campbells soup with the meat cubes and then add the remaining ingredients. Stir to mix. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve over noodles potatoes or rice. Makes 6 generous servings.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook butter brown sugar pecans and coconut in saucepan until butter is melted. Spread in hot pie shell. Return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Terry'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients. Mix well. Add the remaining ingredients and mix all of this well. Mold into a large loaf pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Enjoy!!

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Mix eggs oil and sugar. Add rest of ingredients saving nuts and apples for last. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. No need to ice; can eat plain or with whipped topping.

title: Ham Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Form into ball. Serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Sugarless Fruit Freezies
instructions: Bring fruit and water to a boil; boil 5 minutes. Add pats of butter and 1/4 teaspoon of salt; set aside to cool. Add remaining ingredients to fruit mixture. Bake in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch greased pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool; cut into bars. These bars freeze well.

title: Mincemeat Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl cream sugar shortening and eggs together and beat until smooth. Combine dry ingredients. Gradually add to the cream mixture. Crumble and stir in mincemeat. Drop by round teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on baking sheets that are lightly greased. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Curry And Rice
instructions: Put meat onions and potatoes in skillet with oil. Fry. Add salt tomato puree tomatoes curry powder and garlic. Simmer 1 hour. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery and pineapple. Separately combine Ranch dressing mix with mayonnaise and reserved pineapple juice. Add to chicken mixture and toss well to coat; chill.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: In glass pie plate layer beans meat and onion. Top with chilies cheese and taco sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When cool garnish with guacamole sour cream and olives. Serve with corn chips.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Dissolve first 3 ingredients together. Let cool. Mix pineapple sugar salt and lemon juice with first mixture and refrigerate until jelled. Add 2 boxes Dream Whip prepared as directed. Remove brown from 2 angel food cakes. Break in small pieces and line 4-quart bowl with wax paper. Put handful of mix then layer of cake. Keep layering until all is gone. Refrigerate overnight. Turn out on platter and frost with Dream Whip. Sprinkle with coconut flakes. Keep refrigerated.

title: Five Minute Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Cream butter in a small bowl. Add cocoa blend well. Gradually add sugar alternately with milk and vanilla. Beat until smooth and ready to spread.

title: Six-Layer Mexican Casserole
instructions: First Layer Place 6 uncooked tortillas on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Whipped Cream Icing
instructions: Cook cornstarch and milk until thickens like pudding. Remove from heat; cool to tepid. Measure into mixer bowl the oleo Crisco and sugar. Add slightly warm cornstarch mixture. Add the vanilla; whip at high speed until it looks like whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Nut Toffee Bars
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add egg and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla sifted flour and salt. Spread evenly on a greased 9 x 13-inch (or 10 x 15-inch) baking pan. Bake 25 minutes at 180\u00b0C (350\u00b0). Melt chocolate and spread while warm onto baked dough. Sprinkle with nuts. Cut into squares or bars while still warm. Makes 25 to 36 pieces.

title: Lasagna In A Bun
instructions: Cut top off of bun. Hollow out. Use crumbs for something else leaving 1/2-inch shells.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients by hand. Shape mixture around piece of pepperoni ham pickle olive canned onion etc. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Susan Lappen'S Crabmeat Pizza
instructions: Soften cream cheese and spread it out evenly on a pizza pan then mix horseradish and ketchup. Add celery and crabmeat. Spread mixture over cream cheese. Serve with crackers as a dip.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter; put in casserole. Mix together eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over onions; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden.

title: Best White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat eggs well and add to mixture. Chop nuts and fruits; mix with part of flour and fold into mixture. Sift remaining flour and baking powder together and fold in. Add flavorings and mix well. Pour into greased tube pan (paper lined) or small loaf pans. Place in cold oven and bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours. (Small loaves may be done in 2 1/2 hours.) This cake keeps well wrapped and in a tin for at least two months.

title: Squash Croquettes
instructions: Grate squash on coarse side of grater. Add salt and allow to stand for 30 minutes. Drain off liquid. Add other ingredients and mix well. Form into small patties. If too moist roll in flour. Fry on heavily greased griddle until slightly brown. Serve hot.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into bite-sized pieces. This should take about 4 months. Cook over kerosene fire for approximately 4 weeks or until tender. Add onions and pepper; cook until tender.

title: Baked Egg Custard
instructions: Combine Egg Beaters sugar and salt. Stir in scalded milk and vanilla. Pour into 5 ounce cups. If desired sprinkle with nutmeg. Set cups in a shallow baking pan. Add boiling water to a depth of 1-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serves 6.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain and flake salmon. Combine salmon egg mashed potatoes onion salt and pepper. Place in buttered loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Sourdough Hot Cakes
instructions: In large bowl mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pour 1/4 cup at a time onto a medium hot griddle lightly greased. When the top becomes dry looking (in 3 to 4 minutes) turn and cook other side another 3 minutes or until second side is golden brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Prime Ribs Of Beef With Au Jus
instructions: Remove any roast wrappings and wipe surface with paper towel. Peel garlic and cut into narrow slivers with tip of sharp knife. Poke holes all over fatty parts of meat and insert garlic. Rub roast with salt and pepper. Put roast rib side down in roasting pan. Place pan on middle rack of preheated 500\u00b0 oven. Roast for 30 minutes. Lower oven to 350\u00b0 and continue to cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours depending on doneness you prefer. Use a meat thermometer where it will not hit rib bone or fat.

title: Raspberry Jam Cake
instructions: Cream the butter sugar and eggs adding eggs one at a time. Add soda to the milk. Add sifted dry ingredients and add buttermilk alternately to creamed mixture. Mix jam in. Pour into two 9-inch layer pans and bake until it tests done.

title: Chili Beans
instructions: Wash and cook beans until tender about 3 hours. Just before beans are done place remaining ingredients in skillet and brown. Add to beans and simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Brownies
instructions: In small bowl combine eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Mix with a mixer for 1 minute until light. Add butter and continue beating until well blended. Add flour and cocoa mix well. Stir in nuts and spread in greased square dish. Put in microwave for 6 to 7 minutes. It well look dry but will spring back quickly.

title: Tender Pheasant
instructions: Flour pheasant. Brown in butter and oil. Place in a casserole which can be placed on a burner. Add broth. Cook at a slow heat for 2 1/2 hours. Saute onions and mushrooms in butter in browning pan. Add Worcestershire sauce catsup 2 tablespoons flour and the broth you cooked the pheasant in. Add sour cream last. Do not boil. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve over rice or pasta or potatoes.

title: Shrimp And Artichoke Soup
instructions: In a soup pot melt butter and saut onion until clear. Slowly add flour stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients and cook on low until soup begins to thicken. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly and mix with sugar syrup butter and vanilla. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie crust and bake 45 minutes or until lightly brown at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Drink Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Store in airtight container. To use add 1/2 cup of mixture to one cup hot water. Add marshmallows if desired.

title: Microwave Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Sift sugar and cocoa. Add milk and margarine. Microwave 2 minutes; add chopped nuts and beat until stiff. Spread onto slightly buttered pan.

title: California Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Place in large bowl the chicken celery almonds and pimiento. Blend mayonnaise lemon juice grated onion salt and pepper; add to bowl and toss gently with a fork. Place mixture in individual ramekins or a shallow oiled casserole. Toss bread crumbs with melted margarine and sprinkle over salad. Bake in a preheated oven at 375\u00b0 until heated through and lightly browned; about 30 minutes for a casserole or 15 minutes in ramekins. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pickled Squash
instructions: Soak first 3 ingredients in 2 tablespoons salt water for 1 hour. Mix next 4 ingredients together and bring to rolling boil. Add squash and onion; bring to rolling boil. Take off heat. Stir in peppers and can.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients until blended. Roll in parsley flakes for color. Chill overnight. Makes 2 balls.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries water and sugar 5 to 10 minutes. Pour over jello and stir. Let cool but not set. Add remaining ingredients and let set.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Sift flour cocoa (or spices) soda baking powder and salt together. Add flour alternating with buttermilk. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fettuccine, Ham And Cantaloupe Salad
instructions: *May be feta cheese with tomato and basil if you like.

title: Sukiyaki
instructions: Trim fat from meat save big pieces to render out for drippings. Using a very sharp knife cut meat across grain in slices 1/8 to 1/16-inch thick. (If slices are large halve or quarter them to make them bite size pieces.) Cut white onions into eighths. Slice green onions lengthwise then cut crosswise in 1 1/2 inch strips. Slice the mushrooms lengthwise stems too in pieces 1/8 inch thick. Wash spinach remove stems and cut large leaves in half. Mix together in a pitcher soy bouillon cube which has been dissolved in the 1/2 cup water m.s.g. sugar and salt.

title: Turkey Salad Pocket Sandwich
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Can be covered and refrigerated for several hours to allow flavors to blend. Use as sandwich filling for pita bread or your favorite sandwich bread.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13 in. pan. Bake in 400 degree oven for 25 minutes.

title: Chew Bread 1
instructions: Cream all ingredients together and spoon into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Three Bean Chili
instructions: Warm oil and seasonings in 4 quart pot. Add peppers and cook for 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and all beans and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Add water or juice as needed. Season with salt and pepper. Add cilantro or parsley. Garnish with shredded cheese.

title: Microwave Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in microwave for 10 minutes rotating dish 5 to 10 minutes (High). Cut meat off bone. Cook noodles; drain. Add to meat in casserole dish. Add cream of mushroom soup. Heat 4 minutes (High). Before serving warm add sour cream and Parmesan cheese.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and put into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole pan. Refrigerate immediately overnight. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Make Ahead Hot Chicken Salad Sandwiches
instructions: Boil chicken; bone and chop. Add mayonnaise onion mushrooms and eggs. Butter 6 slices of bread. Put buttered side down in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover bread with chicken mixture. Toast remaining 6 slices of bread and place on top of salad. Mix soup and sour cream. Spread on top of toast; sprinkle with paprika. Refrigerate 24 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Tea Loaf
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. When batter is prepared gently fold in blueberries nuts raisins and spices. Pour mixture into loaf pan either 3 small or 1 large. Bake according to package directions allowing 10 minutes less baking time. Turn out on rack and cool.

title: Peter Pan Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugars eggs and vanilla. Stir in Peter Pan. Sift dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture. Shape 1 teaspoon of dough and mash crisscross with fork. Bake 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Peel and core apples. Cut into matchstick slices. Pour rest of ingredients over apples and mix.

title: Venison Shish Kabob Marinade
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. This makes about 3 1/2 cup.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix together and cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Make in a 10 x 13-inch pan.

title: Sour Cream Burritos
instructions: Soak tortillas in Pace. Brown ground beef. Drain off excess fat. Stir in taco seasoning mix (no water) until meat is well coated. Shake off picante from each tortilla. Layer with beans meat and sour cream. Roll and place fold side down in baking dish. Cover burritos with excess picante and grated cheese. Bake until bubbly at 375\u00b0.

title: Sweet And Sour Appetizers
instructions: Mix all liquid ingredients (vinegar pineapple juice and water) brown sugar salt and cornstarch in saucepan. Bring to boil over low heat until the mixture thickens. Add browned chopped sausage green peppers and pineapple. Serve with toothpicks so that the guests may poke a sausage or pineapple chunk. I usually put this in a crock-pot to keep warm at parties. It is always a hit.

title: Elou'S Pot De Creme
instructions: Blend in blender pour in small cups and chill for a couple of hours. Garnish with whipped cream if you wish.

title: Banana Waffles
instructions: Beat all ingredients with hand beater until smooth. Pour batter from cup or pitcher onto center of hot waffle iron. Bake until steaming stops. Remove waffle carefully. Makes three 9-inch waffles.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans in a flat dish; spread sour cream on top of beans. Cut up tomato and shred lettuce. Put on top of sour cream. Spread salsa and top with shredded cheese. Use as a dip for chips.

title: Stuffed Portobellos(Low Carb)
instructions: Crumble sausage and cook until done. Set aside.

title: Rainbow Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook and drain pasta according to package directions. In a medium bowl combine pasta and all other ingredients. Mix well. Cover and chill thoroughly. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pecan Cups
instructions: Cream together margarine and cream cheese. Add flour and mix with fork or pastry blender. Form into 1 inch balls flatten and carefully press into 2 small greased muffin pans. Mix brown sugar pecans egg melted butter and vanilla to make filling. Fill pastry cups with filling being careful not to overfill. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool for 10 to 15 minutes; cup should then easily lift out of tins. Store covered in refrigerator. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Easy But Elegant Chicken Crepes
instructions: Combine all together in a saucepan; heat thoroughly. Fill each crepe with a heaping 1/3 cupful. Fold 2 sides over filling. Place crepes in buttered baking dish. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Quick Pot Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in bottom of pie shell except only use half of gravy and reserve half. Cover with top pie shell and prick 6 or 8 slits on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour or until golden brown. Heat remaining gravy and serve over serving slice.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all and cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until lumps together. Knead with a small amount of flour. Keeps in the refrigerator for a long time.

title: Sauteed Chicken Strips
instructions: In large heavy skillet over medium-high heat cook butter until bubbly and begins to brown. Add marinated chicken strips. Saute about 4 minutes or just until opaque throughout and lightly golden. Fold in parsley and chives. Immediately remove to warm serving plate. Makes 4 servings.

title: Date Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates. Let stand. Cream shortening sugar egg and flavoring. Beat in date mixture. Sift dry ingredients. Add together. Pour in well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Put shortening in skillet; heat and add hamburger. Brown hamburger. Add onion and cook 5 minutes stirring frequently. Turn down heat. Add remaining ingredients; cover and simmer 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve piping hot in bowls with crisp crackers. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Individual Chicken Pot Pies
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the Basic Chicken Stock bay leaf peppercorns and the parsley and thyme sprigs and bring to a boil. Add the chicken breasts and simmer until just cooked through about 20 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Strain the stock return it to the saucepan and bring to a boil.

title: Vegetable Curry
instructions: Place vegetables on a large plate. Sprinkle with mixed spices and salt. Melt butter in a heavy pan. Saute the onions and garlic. Add the spiced veggies and stock. Cover and bring to a boil simmer for about 20 minutes until all vegetables are tender. Serve with hot cooked rice. Enjoy!

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crunchy Peanut Bark
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave at 50% power. Add peanut butter. Mix until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well coated. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper and let set.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and debone. Mix together all ingredients. Pour in a baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Soften butter. Add sugar. Mix together. Add flour vanilla and nuts. Mix together and refrigerate. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Roll dough by hand into little balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Shrimp Stuffed Red Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise; cut out stems seeds and pulp. Drop into boiling salted water and cook uncovered for 4 minutes; remove and turn cut side down to drain.

title: Corn Oysters
instructions: Grate corn. Add eggs cracker crumbs and flour sifted with salt pepper and baking powder. Drop from a tablespoon into one inch of salad oil (hot enough to brown bread cube) 40 seconds; turn once. Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Chill shrimp; reserve a few nice shrimp and toss the remainder with celery eggs macaroni and pickle. Combine lemon juice mayonnaise catsup Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Toss with shrimp mixture. Serve on lettuce and garnish with reserved shrimp and additional egg (if desired).

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Coat a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick lengthwise slice from each zucchini. Chop the slices and reserve. Using a melon baller or small spoon and starting from cut side scoop out most of flesh from each zucchini leaving a shell. Chop together the flesh and add the reserved chopped slices. Reserve the zucchini \boats.\

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown the ground beef and onion together. Drain and put in crockpot. Add the corn hominy pinto beans red kidney beans tomatoes and green chili chopped tomatoes. (DO NOT DRAIN THE VEGETABLES.) Just open and dump in. Add ranch dressing mix (dry) the taco seasoning (dry). Stir together and cook at least 2 hours.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Drain juice off fruit. Beat eggs and mix all together. Pour in greased baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Oriental Chicken Salad
instructions: Prepare Ginger Dressing. Heat 1-inch oil in Dutch oven to 425\u00b0. Fry 1/4 of the noodles at a time turning once until puffed about 5 seconds. Drain.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Stew
instructions: In a 6-quart Dutch oven or saucepot heat oil and brown 1/2 of chicken. Remove chicken. Repeat with remaining chicken. Return chicken to Dutch oven. Stir in carrots celery onion potatoes and salt. Mix Lipton soup mix with water and apple juice; pour mixture over chicken and vegetables. Bring to a boil on high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 25 minutes until done and vegetables are tender.

title: Turbot Fish
instructions: Spray skillet with olive oil. Place fish in skillet. Sprinkle seasoning on fish. Saute slowly until tender.

title: Peanut Butter Pinwheel Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening vanilla and sugars. Add eggs and beat well. Then add dry ingredients that have been sifted together; mix well. Dough will be quite stiff. Roll out on floured area. Cover dough with layer of peanut butter and then roll in pinwheel fashion. Wrap waxed paper and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Slice and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Use immediately or cool and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Lime Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add pineapple drained reserving liquid and add water to make the 1 cup pineapple juice. Add pineapple and cottage cheese. Blend sour cream with mayonnaise. Add to mixture. Pour into oiled salad mold. Sets up quickly. Chopped walnuts or maraschino cherries or both may be added.

title: Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat softened cream cheese sugar and vanilla until well blended. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in pie crust and chill 4 hours.

title: Summer Pizza
instructions: Spread bread stick dough flat on cookie sheet. Bake. Remove from oven and let cool completely. Mix cream cheese Ranch dressing mix and mayonnaise together and spread over baked bread sticks. Grate raw veggies (of your choice) and spread/sprinkle on cream cheese. Cut in squares.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown sausage; drain. Mix all ingredients together and pour in a 2-quart casserole dish. I put in 2 dishes and freeze one. Bake covered for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Grilled Roast
instructions: Pour garlic onion powder and black pepper on wax paper and roll washed and clean roast in mixture. Wrap in oil and place on grill for 1 hour.

title: Drop Ginettis
instructions: Beat eggs real well (10 minutes). Add next 4 ingredients. Mix well. Add baking powder and flour; mix well. Flour lightly cookie sheet (one time only). Drop cookies by tablespoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Roundup Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and peanut butter mix well. Sift flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in oatmeal. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Press a crisscross on each cookie. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Dessert
instructions: Mix by hand the first 4 ingredients. Fold in the Cool Whip to the mixture.

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 things together. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13 dish. Sprinkle dry cake mix over top. Pour melted margarine over then sprinkle pecans over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with Cool Whip hot or cold.

title: Grandpa'S Tasty Codfish
instructions: Soak codfish overnight. Drain water. Replace with fresh water and boil. Boil potatoes and mash. Cook onions scallions and peppers together in frying pan then mix codfish potatoes onions scallions peppers and eggs all together. Once all ingredients are mixed make small balls and roll in flour. In a frying pan pour oil and heat until hot. Put in six \cake balls\ in frying pan with oil until brown all over. Repeat.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Prepare sugar cookie mix according to directions. Press on pizza pan with hands (not too thick). Bake as directed. Let cool. Cream together cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread on cooled crust. Layer fruit over topping in circles.

title: New England Boiled Dinner
instructions: Rinse and dry corned beef; trim off excess fat. Place in a Dutch oven. Cover with cold water; put on high heat. Add salt pork and peppercorns; cover and bring to a boil. When boiling lower heat and gently simmer for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and flour; add fruit cocktail and beat. Pour in buttered oblong baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cover with melted butter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Mountain
instructions: Clean and remove green stem of whole head of cauliflower. Put in 8-inch glass pie plate stem end down. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at High 7 to 8 minutes or until tender. Mix mayonnaise mustard and dry mustard in bowl. Pour mayonnaise mixture over top of cooked cauliflower. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Microwave at High 1 minute to melt cheese. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Burger Bundles
instructions: Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions. Combine milk and ground beef; mix well. Divide into 5 patties and place onto sheet of waxed paper. Pat and mold patties into rounds 6-inches diameter. Place 1/4 cup stuffing in center of each patty. Fold/draw meat over stuffing and seal edges. Place into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine and mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat bundles. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tomato-Basil Soup
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in container of an electric blender or food processor. Top with cover; process until smooth. Transfer mixture to a saucepan; bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Melt margarine in a small heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Gradually stir sauce mixture into tomato mixture. Cook over medium heat just until thoroughly heated (do not boil). Ladle soup into individual bowls. Garnish with fresh basil sprigs if desired. Yields 6 cups.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Grease a small casserole dish or 8-inch cake pan. Layer chicken Veg-All and soup in casserole dish. Mix margarine flour and milk. Pour over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Pour pie filling into large bowl. Mix remaining ingredients folding in Cool Whip last. Let set 4 hours or overnight in refrigerator.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients until creamy and well mixed. Pour into 3 (9-inch) cake pans well-greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Mints
instructions: Combine water and butter. Place over low heat until butter melts. Remove from heat; add salt and peppermint extract. Gradually add sugar and blend until desired consistency. You can use powdered sugar to roll the mints out for cutting or you can use a candy mold.

title: Vacuum Cleaner Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine cake mix and 1 egg. Stir together until dry ingredients are moistened. Pat mixture into bottom of well greased 15 x 10-inch jellyroll pan. Beat remaining 2 eggs lightly then beat in cream cheese and powdered sugar. Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour over mixture in jellyroll pan. Spread evenly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Cool pan on wire rack.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: For red punch use cherry Kool-Aid. For green punch use lime Kool-Aid.

title: Village Salad(Horiatiki)
instructions: Cut tomatoes into wedges. Place in salad bowl with next 5 ingredients. Season to taste with oregano salt and pepper. Pour over the dressing and toss.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Melt butter saute vegetables for about 5 minutes. Blend in flour; add stock. Bring to boil and simmer 25 minutes. Put mixture in food processor and put back in pot. Heat gently adding cream.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for 2 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Homemade Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; add sugar salt shortening and stir until sugar and salt are dissolved. Stir in flour and mix until all is well blended. Turn out on a floured surface and knead well about 5 minutes. Place in a greased pan covered with a cloth for 1 hour over a pan of warm (not hot) water and let rise until double in bulk. Knead down again; place over warm water again for about 30 minutes. Mold into desired shape. Let rise for about 45 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until done. Yields about 24 large or 36 small rolls or 2 loaves.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil chicken until done and tender about 25 minutes. Remove from pot. Reserve broth. Cook shell and curly pasta in the chicken broth. Drain pasta. Add chicken cucumbers pepper and green onions. Season with salt pepper and Accent. Add mayonnaise and stir well. Tastes best when chilled.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Simmer chicken breasts until tender. Remove and cool enough to handle (or cook the night before). Chop. In 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan arrange broccoli. Lay chicken over broccoli. Combine soup milk and mayonnaise and stir until smooth. Add cheese and lemon juice. Pour sauce over chicken and broccoli and cover chicken completely. Cover pan with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle crumbs on top before serving.

title: Broccoli And Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in greased casserole. Size depends on how thick you like. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Smothered Chops With Bacon Bits
instructions: Stir together 1/3 cup flour the salt and pepper in shallow dish. Coat pork chop with flour mixture shaking off excess. Heat oil in 12-inch skillet over medium high heat. Cook pork chops in oil about 10 minutes turning once until brown. Remove from skillet. Stir onion into dripping in skillet. Cook about 2 minutes stirring frequently until softened. Stir in 1 tablespoon flour. Cook 2 minutes stirring constantly; stir in half and half and bacon bits. Return pork chops to skillet. Cover and cook over medium low heat about 30 minutes stirring occasionally until pork is tender and slightly pink.

title: Stuffed Onions
instructions: Parboil onions about 15 minutes and drain. Mix meat salt pepper shortening and catsup. Remove centers of onions and fill with meat mixture. Arrange in baking dish; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove cover; sprinkle tops with crumbs. Dot with shortening and bake until brown.

title: Egg Sausage Souffle
instructions: Brown sausage; drain and cool. Beat eggs salt and dry mustard. Stir in milk. Add bread cubes cheese and sausage. Refrigerate 12 hours in glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Deli Chicken
instructions: In skillet cook onion. Add carrots potatoes and 1 cup broth. Cover simmer until tender (about 25 minutes) add more broth if needed. Cut chicken in quarters; add 5 minutes before end of cooking time.

title: Ice Box Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in pan and keep refrigerated.

title: Turkey And Dressing
instructions: Bake turkey at 350\u00b0 for 4 hours. Remove turkey from broth. Set aside. Crumble biscuits cornbread and crackers in large bowl. Add sage celery seed salt and pepper. Saute onion and celery in butter. Add to bread mixture. Add broth until of desired consistency. Spray bottom of casserole dish with Pam. Bake at 250\u00b0 for approximately 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: In a large boiler put first 7 ingredients. Cook until vegetables\tare tender. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth until tender. Drain. Add to chicken mixture and stir well. Then add cheese and more\tbroth if needed. Let simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Salad
instructions: Cook eggs vinegar and sugar in a heavy saucepan until thick. Cool completely. Add Cool Whip. Layer Cool Whip mixture sliced bananas and peanuts. Chill well before serving.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Pour corn into buttered casserole. Add flour sugar and salt. Blend with fork. Add eggs and blend. Add milk and blend well. Top with broken pieces of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Roman Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in oil in frying pan. Place chicken in 6-quart covered stove-top casserole. Saute garlic in frying pan until softened; deglaze with wine and add to casserole. Add bouillon bacon tomatoes and marjoram. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 40 minutes. Add artichoke hearts and simmer for 10 minutes. Skim off any fat from the surface. Combine flour and butter to form a roux and cook in a small saucepan for 2 minutes stirring until smooth and blended. Add roux to chicken and heat a few minutes. Add pepper as desired.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Brew tea. While hot add cinnamon nutmeg almond extract and ground cloves. Let stand 30 minutes until spices have dissolved. Add rest of water. Chill. Serve over ice. Makes 2 1/2 gallons.

title: Grandma'S Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Melt butter then add brown sugar and 1 tablespoon water. Cook until mixture makes a thick syrup. Add milk egg yolks and a mixture of white sugar and flour. Continue cooking stirring constantly until thickened. Pour into a baked pie crust. Cool and top with whipped cream.

title: Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine all but oil; mix thoroughly. Gradually add oil beating all the time. Bottle and store in refrigerator. Use on cabbage or greens just before serving.

title: Sugar Twin Apple Spice Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spray a 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish with Bakers Joy nonstick cooking spray. Mix flour pumpkin pie spice cinnamon baking powder baking soda and salt. Set aside.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Prepare corn bread according to package directions. Mix the last 3 ingredients. Put 1/2 of the corn bread crumbs in a bowl; add chopped pepper as first layer. Put two of the chopped tomatoes next then add layer of onions. Spread the other two tomatoes. Add the bacon. Next put the mayonnaise on top of the bacon. Spread remaining 1/2 of the corn bread crumbs on top and refrigerate. It will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Stir in vanilla. Sift dry ingredients. Gradually adding to cream mixture. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Bake at 350 degrees about 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Gourmet Pasta
instructions: Layer 1/2 noodles and 1/2 meat. Repeat in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes covered.

title: Golobki (Cabbage) Casserole
instructions: Place chopped cabbage in bottom of 3-quart casserole. Brown meat and onions. Pour off fat. Stir in rice salt and pepper. Spread meat over cabbage with spoon. Mix tomato soup with water and pour over mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 hours or until cabbage is soft. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place chicken onions and vegetables in a 2-quart casserole dish. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and blend thoroughly. Add chicken stock slowly and salt. Cook until mixture thickens stirring constantly. Pour over chicken mixture.

title: Easy Beef Tips
instructions: Take a package of boneless stew beef that has been cut into chunks. Add cream of mushroom soup dry onion soup mix and water. Mix all together in baking dish; cover tightly and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Cheese And Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes in liquid. Add salt and garlic. Boil for about 5 minutes then add milk and cheese. Simmer until cheese melts. Sprinkle top with paprika or black pepper.

title: Barbecue Sandwiches
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain. Add remaining ingredients (except rolls); mix well. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve on buns.

title: Microwave Jiffy Pizzas
instructions: Slice pitas into 6-inch rounds; toast under broiler. Place 4 rounds\ttoasted side up on waxed paper. Combine tomato paste water oil honey and spices in a small bowl; spread over top surface of pita rounds dividing equally among all 8.\tDivide salami among the 8 sprinkle with sliced mushrooms; top with cheese. Microwave on High uncovered about 4 minutes each batch or until cheese is melted; rotate 1/4 turn every 30 seconds. Makes 8 mini pizzas.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Mix the rest into the first. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove immediately from pans.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Cook onion and pepper until golden. Add rest of ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes. I add water as needed.

title: Rolls
instructions: Combine sugar margarine salt and hot water to melt margarine. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Combine mixtures. Beat eggs and add. Stir in flour. Cover and refrigerate. Will keep for several days. When you want rolls pinch off walnut-sized portions of dough working into a ball with floured hands. Place about an inch apart on greased pans. Let rise in a warm draft-free place covered with a lightweight dish towel for a couple of hours. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden (about 15 to 20 minutes). Makes 3 dozen.

title: Cookie Cups
instructions: You will need Pam (to grease bottom of muffin pan).

title: Blueberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water. Add pineapple and blueberry pie filling. Set in refrigerator until firm. Cream sour cream sugar and cream cheese. Spread on top of Jell-O and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Mix in egg salt and bananas. Stir in remaining ingredients. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut into squares.

title: Hot Cole Slaw
instructions: Bring to a boil vinegar water salt sugar spices and oil. Remove from heat. Add vinegar mixture to the beaten eggs and whipping cream. Cook for another 5 minutes stirring constantly. Pour over cabbage and pickle mixture and serve.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Put in large pot and add other ingredients. Mix well. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until seasonings are blended. If too thick add more tomato juice.

title: Welsh Plum Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients and fill greased pudding molds or baking powder cans leaving room for swelling. Cans are covered then boiled for 6 hours. Serve with a sauce flavored with brandy or whiskey.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced carrots until almost done. Drain. Melt margarine in pan and cook onion until tender. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly until cheese melts and thickens. Add to carrots. Sprinkle 2 cups buttered bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Freezer Peach Jam
instructions: Peel pit and finely chop peaches; measure 3 1/2 cups into a large bowl. Add lemon peel and ascorbic acid. Combine the 1/4 cup sugar and pectin. Gradually add pectin mixture to the peach mixture stirring vigorously. Let mixture stand 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Slowly stir the 3 cups sugar into the peach mixture; stir until sugar dissolves. Ladle jam at once into clean jars or freezer containers leaving a 1/2-inch head space. Wipe the rims and seal. Let the jam stand at room temperature for 2 hours. Chill and put in freezer. Will keep frozen 3 months. Makes 4 1/2 cups.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Using frozen pie crust or your own mix together all the sliced apples 3/4 cup sugar 3/4 cup flour 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg. Fill pie shell.

title: Surprise Shortcake
instructions: Slice strawberries; reserve some for the top of the cake. Crush half of the berries and mix with 1/2 cup sugar. Prepare the Dream Whip. Trim crusts from the bread. Butter one side of the bread; sprinkle with sugar. Measure 1/2 cup syrup from the berries and set aside. Line bottom of a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with bread buttered side up trimming slices if necessary to fit pan. Spoon half the strawberries on bread and 1 cup Dream Whip. Repeat until last layer from top. Last layer of bread should be buttered side down. Drizzle with syrup. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 3 hours. Invert onto serving platter. Frost with Dream Whip and garnish with remaining strawberries.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Let dough rise in a warm place until doubled. Punch down. Roll loaves together into one 15 x 12-inch rectangle. Layer ham and pepperoni on half of the dough (lengthwise). Sprinkle with onion and green pepper. Top with 1/4 cup of pizza sauce. Layer Mozzarella cappicola salami and Provolone over sauce. Sprinkle with basil oregano garlic powder and pepper. Spread another 1/4 cup of pizza sauce on top. Fold plain half of dough over filling and seal edges well. Place on a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Brush with melted butter. Heat the remaining pizza sauce and serve with sliced stromboli.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Drain liquid from pineapple and blueberries in medium saucepan. Add enough water to make 2 cups juice. Bring to a boil and pour over gelatin mix. Mix with nuts pineapple and blueberries. Congeal in a shallow 8 x 10-inch pan.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: In a 3 quart microproof casserole combine onion green pepper and butter. Cover with casserole lid and cook on HI for 4-5 minutes or until onion is transparent. Add tomotoes wine and flour; stir until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients except chicken. Cover and cook on HI for 7 minutes. Add chicken pieces immersing in sauce. Cover and cook on HI for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is tender. Stir once during cooking. Let stand 5 minutes. Remove bay leaf before serving. Serves 4-6. Total cooking time 31-37 minutes.

title: Five Can Casserole
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Place in an 8 x 8-inch square baking dish or pan. Toss bits of bread in melted butter and cover top of casserole with this mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. To make a 9 x 13-inch pan size casserole double this recipe.

title: Fruit Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine rolled oats flour sugar salt and cinnamon. Add melted butter to oatmeal mixture and mix with fork or pastry blender until well blended. Arrange fruit in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan or 2-quart baking dish. Spread oatmeal mixture on top of fruit. Bake 30 minutes or until tender and crust is brown. Serve warm or cold with milk cream whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Baked Alaska Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Foil line an 8-inch round pan; spoon in ice cream. Freeze firm. Combine biscuit mix and 3 tablespoons sugar. Beat together milk yolk and butter; add to dry ingredients. Stir until smooth. Spread in greased 9-inch round pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool. Place ice cream on shortcake; top with fruit. Place on board.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder mixing well. Combine shrimp celery onion and rice. Stir in mayonnaise mixture; toss lightly. Garnish with tomato wedges. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Etta'S Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Combine cream cheese and onion. Add sauerkraut sausage 1/4 cup bread crumbs and mix well. Shape in 1/2 to 1-inch balls. Roll in flour and dip in milk then in bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil for 1-2 minutes. Drain on paper towel. Can be frozen.

title: Beef Chop Suey
instructions: Brown steak in a little oil. Add celery onion and garlic to meat; simmer on low heat. Then add chop suey vegetables and bean sprouts (do not drain). Then add soy sauce and bouillon cubes. Simmer until meat is tender. Serve over rice and chop suey noodles.

title: Broccoli Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; debone it. Cook rice in chicken broth. Saute onion and bell pepper in butter. In a large casserole dish put rice chicken onion bell pepper broccoli Cheez Whiz and soup. Mix well and season with salt and pepper. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Can be frozen.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix the vanilla pudding. Cover the bottom of bowl with Nilla wafers and sliced bananas. Pour in pudding mix. Repeat until ingredients are gone. (Layer it.)

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: In a crock-pot melt Velveeta cheese. When melted add browned beef and jalapeno sauce. Serve as a dip with nacho chips. Add a little milk to thin it if it is too thick.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix and cook until thick stirring constantly. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 2 tablespoons oleo.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
instructions: Melt jello and sugar in water. Add frozen strawberries and mix well. If strawberries are large slit them.

title: Oven Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine cornflakes mustard pepper paprika and garlic powder. In a shallow bowl combine egg white and lemon juice; beat slightly. Dip chicken in egg mixture; coat with crumb mixture. Place in ungreased baking pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours until done. Do not turn during baking.

title: Husband'S Delight(Mine, For Sure!)
instructions: In a bowl mix cream cheese sour cream and onions; set aside. Brown the meat in butter; add tomato sauce sugar salt pepper and Worcestershire. Cook noodles according to package directions.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: In medium bowl place beans mushrooms and onion. In small bowl stir together the remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables and toss. Cover and chill until serving time.

title: Quick Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth; gradually add sugar. Beat until smooth. Add vanilla and sour cream; mix well. Fold in Cool Whip until well mixed. Pour into pie crust. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Pink Salad
instructions: Place cottage cheese in large mixing bowl. Add jello until completely dissolved. When the pineapple is completely drained add that to the cottage cheese mixture and mix completely by hand. Add walnuts and marshmallows. Add Cool Whip. Dont mix or whip it in. Fold in easily until blended well. Better if you refrigerate overnight.

title: Weight Watchers Chicken Ala Grecque
instructions: In medium bowl not aluminum combine chicken and lemon juice and turn to coat with juice. Let marinate 10 minutes. Combine flour and oregano on plate or in plastic bag. Remove chicken from marinade allowing juice to drip into bowl; reserve juice. Dredge chicken in flour mixture coating both sides.

title: Chocolate Sundae Cake
instructions: Melt margarine. Add flour and nuts. Mix well. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand until cool.

title: Broccoli-Stuffed Shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small skillet melt margarine over medium heat. Add onion; cook until onion is tender but not browned. Remove from heat; let cool. In a large bowl stir Ricotta cheese and egg. Add broccoli and Jack cheese. Mix well. In a large kettle of boiling water cook pasta 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm to the bite; drain. Rinse in cold water; drain again. Stuff each shell with 2 tablespoons broccoli-cheese mixture.

title: Strawberry Torte(Nice To Serve At Christmas!  Super!)
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk cool. Fold whipped cream into marshmallows and spread on cooled crust. Dissolve jello in hot water. Stir in strawberries. When thick spread on cream layer.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown bacon; add onion and saute. Stir in remaining ingredients and place in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be made ahead and baked later.

title: V B S 1984 - Africa
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Top with peanuts.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Combine butter eggs sugar baking soda vanilla cinnamon and flour in a large bowl. Beat until well mixed. Add apples and nuts. Stir to mix. Scrape into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 40 to 50 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Sift confectioners sugar over top. Cut into 36 squares. Enjoy!

title: Southwestern Chicken 'N Shells
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine vinegar salt and pepper; toss with beef. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes; drain. Place flour in a bowl; add beef and toss to coat.

title: Rice Krispie Buckeyes
instructions: Mix well Rice Krispies peanut butter powdered sugar and margarine.\tForm into small balls. Stick toothpicks into balls and dip into the mixture of chocolate morsels and Parowax which you make by melting in a double boiler.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Simmer till brown 1 hour. Serve in chafing dish.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until light. Add fruit cocktail with juice and dry ingredients; mix well and add nuts and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes in a greased jelly roll pan.

title: Favorite Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend softened cream cheese with drained pineapple. Add onion and green pepper. Form into ball. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Mix cherries and walnuts together. Cover cheese ball with mixture. Enjoy with favorite crackers and pretzel sticks.

title: Lemon Yogurt Sponge Torte
instructions: Spread the coconut on a large baking sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 4 minutes or until golden. Lightly grease a 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Line pan with waxed paper (grease the paper).

title: Icebox Bran Muffins
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs buttermilk Bran Buds in boiling water flour soda and salt; mix well. Add dry Bran Buds and raisins. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0 in muffin tins. (Texas size muffins 20 minutes.) Batter may be kept up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator in a covered container.

title: Easy Potatoes
instructions: Combine hot cooked potatoes and black pepper. Add melted butter and dill. Toss lightly and serve hot.

title: Catsup Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in fat until brown then add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in four layers at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes; cool.

title: Brownie Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix brownie mix biscuit mix water eggs oil & vanilla with mixer. Stir in chocolate chips pecans and raisins. Pour batter into 2 slightly greased non-stick loaf pans. Bake 45-50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Cool on wire racks 10 minutes longer. Serve warm with creamy cinnamon spread found in this book.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown onion pepper and hamburger meat. Combine meat ketchup mustard brown sugar and Worcestershire. Pour into pork and beans; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Line baking pan with foil. Salt and pepper chicken pieces. Dip in melted margarine. Coat with crumbs. Place in pan not crowded. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Do not turn.

title: On The Run Chicken Fingers
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Whisk buttermilk garlic celery salt and Tabasco. Pour mixture over chicken and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Mix breadcrumbs with paprika and cheese until well blended. Lift chicken strips one at a time out of buttermilk mixture and coat with breadcrumb mixture. Freeze breaded strips (do not allow them to touch) on a baking sheet until firm then package in a plastic freezer bag seal and return to freezer. To bake heat oven to 450\u00b0 and arrange frozen strips about 1/2-inch apart on a foil lined baking sheet sprayed with nonstick spray. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until crisp and golden. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Microwave Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Microwave chocolate and milk in a large bowl on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted stirring halfway through heating time. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir in vanilla and walnuts. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Christmas Card Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg. Beat until light and fluffy. Stir flour with spices and soda; add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Cover and chill until firm (2 hours). Remove from refrigerator. On floured surface roll dough 1/8-inch thick. Cut into shapes with cutters. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 1 to 2 minutes. Remove to rack. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Crumble cheese; add sour cream and juice of one large lemon; salt and pepper to taste. Chill before serving.

title: Cheddar Cheese Canape
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Lightly toast the muffins and then spread with mixture. Cut in 4 pieces and place on a cookie sheet in a 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and shortening; add sugar gradually. Add egg yolks and beat well. Mix flour soda and salt and add to the creamed mixture with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla pecans and coconut. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour into 3 round cake pans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Put egg yolks into a large bowl. Add sugar and beat until thick. Beat egg whites and set aside. Add remaining ingredients (except egg whites) to egg yolk mixture blending well. Fold in egg whites. Pour into ice cream freezer and freeze. Various fruits such as peaches strawberries etc. can be added.

title: Dutch Honey
instructions: Heat syrup and sugar on top of stove. When starts to boil remove from heat. Add milk stirring all the time until it gets hot. Use on pancakes or hot biscuits.

title: Polish Sausage
instructions: Cut Polish sausage into bite size pieces. Place all ingredients into a frying pan; cover and simmer 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Momma'S Butter And Egg Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Set aside. Bring 1 cup water and butter to boil. Turn off burner. Set aside. Let cool to warm. In a large bowl combine 1 cup cold water sugar salt and egg. To this add water butter and yeast (making sure the water is not too hot to kill the yeast). Stir in enough flour to form dough. Turn onto floured surface and knead for 10 to 15 minutes. Continue adding flour as needed. Set in a warm place to rise until doubled. Punch down and knead again. Form into rolls or loaf. Let rise until doubled. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown rolls about 25 minutes loaf about 1 hour. Cool on cooling rack.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Grease 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook butter sugar and onion until golden. Add broth and water; simmer 45 minutes. Top with garlic toast and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until toasted and cheese melts.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Heavenly Hash Brownies
instructions: Combine eggs sugar flour and vanilla. Melt butter and add cocoa. Add to egg mixture and beat well. Add nuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cover with marshmallows and return to oven until marshmallows are slightly melted. Remove from oven and pour chocolate frosting over marshmallows. Cool before cutting. Yields 48 brownies.

title: Blueberry Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix flour with sugar baking powder and salt. Combine egg and milk and add to flour mixture. Add shortening and mix only enough to moisten flour. Fold in cereal and blueberries. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 8 medium muffins. Muffins may be baked and then frozen. To serve thaw muffins completely then heat on ungreased baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar Crisco oleo and vanilla; add eggs. Beat well. Combine flour soda and salt and add to creamed mixture. Beat well. Stir in almond bark or chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 dozen cookies.

title: Chart House Bleu Cheese Dressing
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine first 6 ingredients and blend 2 minutes at low speed. Add mayonnaise and blend 1/2 minute at low speed then increase speed to medium and blend an additional 2 minutes. Slowly add Bleu cheese and blend at low speed no longer than 4 minutes. Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. If too thick thin with a little milk. Yield 2 1/2 cups.

title: Olive Cheese Puffs
instructions: Cream the butter and cheese. Add flour and pepper to form dough. Using 1 teaspoon of dough wrap around olive. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. (Can be made ahead and reheated.)

title: Party Cocktail Sausage
instructions: Heat jelly and sauce until jelly has melted then add the sausages and let simmer until sausages are heated through. You can also use barbecue sauce instead of the mixture. Can use in a crock-pot or fondue pot.

title: City Bakery'S Burgers(Veggie Burgers)
instructions: In a 10-12 inch nonstick frying pan over medium heat cook onion and garlic in butter stirring often until onion is golden; about 8 minutes. Add cumin and ginger; stir for 1 minute. Add mushrooms potatoes carrots and chopped cilantro. Stir often until carrots are tender to bite about 7 minutes. Add flour and stir for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Then mix in eggs and bread crumbs. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Red Wine Vinaigrette
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Mix beef onion soup mix sour cream egg and bread crumbs together. Roll into small balls and bake in oven at 320\u00b0 until brown. Put in crock-pot with 2 cans cream of chicken soup and 1 can water. Heat until hot.

title: Creamy Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat the cream cheese at high speed of electric mixer until fluffy. Add whipped topping peanut butter sugar and milk; beat well. Spoon into graham cracker crust. Chill at least 5 hours before serving. Garnish with peanuts if desired.

title: Tamal
instructions: Thinly slice the vegetables. Layer in casserole dish all vegetables seasoning each layer. Drizzle bacon drippings over top. Bake (with lid) in oven about 2 hours at 300\u00b0 or less. Cook slowly.

title: Mud Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Crush wafers and add melted butter. Mix well with a fork and press into a 9-inch pie plate. Bake for 10 minutes. Cool. Spread ice cream carefully onto crust. Freeze 1 1/2 hours or until solid. In a saucepan cook cocoa sugar 1/3 cup cream and butter until it is smooth and boils. Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla. Cool but do not let mixture get too hard to pour. Pour sauce over frozen ice cream base. Freeze at least 1 1/2 hours. Before serving whip remaining cream with 2 tablespoons sugar until soft peaks form. Add remaining vanilla and spread over pie. Garnish with chocolate shavings.

title: Peanut Butter Sandwich Filling
instructions: Soften peanut butter and blend with pickle bacon and mayonnaise. Yields 3/4 cup or makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Cream the cream cheese with the sugar. Add eggs beating until smooth. Stir in sour cream and vanilla. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool and then chill.

title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions; drain off grease. Slice potatoes and boil for 5 minutes; drain off water. Spray casserole dish with Pam. Line bottom of dish with potatoes and then hamburger. Mix cheese soup and Mrs. Dash together; pour over top of potatoes and hamburger. Mrs. Dash takes the place of salt and pepper. Crush crackers and sprinkle on top. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Smothered Steak
instructions: Brown steak on both sides. Place in casserole dish and cover with onion slices and soup. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolks one at a time. Mix soda and sour cream. Add to butter and sugar mixture. Add flour. Beat the 6 egg whites; add 6 teaspoons of sugar then fold into cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tall Boy Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion together. Drain excess fat. Salt and pepper to taste. Add 1 can of Tall Boy vegetable soup to the ground beef. Do not dilute soup; add straight to ground beef. Mix and let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve with creamed potatoes and rolls.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef salt cracker meal eggs pepper garlic and onions. Use enough cracker meal so meat mixture is sticky. Make into small balls and fry until brown.

title: Christmas Toffee
instructions: Spread nuts on greased 13 x 11-inch cookie sheet. Combine margarine and sugar. Melt and bring to a boil. Stir constantly until dark tan about 10 to 12 minutes. Pour toffee mixture over nuts. Immediately place broken pieces of chocolate bars on hot mixture and spread with a knife. Place in cool place or in refrigerator. Take out when hard and break in pieces.

title: Quick Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef until brown stirring to crumble. Drain. Spoon beef into 8-inch square baking dish and top with sauce and cheese. Combine bisquick mix & eggs beat until smooth. Pour mixture over casserole covering evenly. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Potato Casserole
instructions: Put frozen potatoes in well oiled 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken on top. Blend soup with remaining ingredients except paprika. Pour over the chicken and potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for at least 1 1/2 hours.

title: Plain Cake
instructions: Place cake mix pudding sugar margarine and water in bowl and blend well. Stir in eggs and mix. Add oil gradually beating all the while. Beat for 3 minutes. Bake in a tube pan that has been greased and floured at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool and frost with confectioners sugar and milk mixture.

title: Bridget'S Aztec Quiche
instructions: Spread all of Jack and 1/2 of Cheddar cheese on bottom of pie shell. Sprinkle green chilies over cheese. In a bowl beat eggs half and half salt and pepper together. Pour over cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes uncovered or until eggs set. Let stand before serving.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: To boiling water add salt; slowly add corn meal stirring constantly. Add milk eggs butter and baking powder. Bake in a buttered baking pan about 10 minutes in a hot oven. Serve hot.

title: Rice Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook onions and celery in oleo until tender. Add broccoli soup and milk. Heat. Add cheese rice salt and pepper to taste. Cook until it thickens. Pour in casserole dish. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: 1-2-3 Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In large bowl with fork or spoon mix flour baking powder and salt until well blended. Add milk and salad oil all at once; stir until dough forms a ball. With hand knead dough in bowl 10 times or until smooth.

title: Coconut Bonbons
instructions: Combine all ingredients and roll into balls. Melt 1 bag chocolate chips and 3/4 stick paraffin wax. Dip balls in this mixture and put on waxed paper.

title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell according to package directions. Allow to cool. In large saucepan combine gelatin cornstarch spices and salt. Stir in pumpkin and evaporated milk. Let stand 5 minutes to soften gelatin. Cook and stir for 2 more minutes. Remove from heat. Gradually stir 1 cup hot mixture into eggs and return to saucepan with other mixture. Cook and stir over low heat for 2 minutes. Do not boil. Remove from heat and stir in Equal. Pour into baked pie crust. Cover and chill 6 hours or overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Onion Mushroom Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine. Bake 1 1/2 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Indonesian Pork Chops
instructions: Trim chops. Rub heated skillet with fat. Season chops with salt and pepper. brown. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of fat. Combine peach juice vinegar brown sugar and seasonings. Pour over chops. Simmer covered for 30 minutes. Add peaches peppers and pimiento. Simmer covered five minutes longer. Serve over rice.

title: Apple-Oatmeal Crisp
instructions: Spread apples in greased pan; set aside. Mix oats sugar flour and cinnamon. Cut in margarine with fork. Sprinkle evenly over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until apples are tender. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Peanut Butter Icing
instructions: Cream together peanut butter and shortening. Add sugar and milk and mix together.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
instructions: Cream the first 3 ingredients then add peanuts. Blend well. Serve with sliced apples.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook tomatoes put through sieve grind garlic peppers and onions. Mix all other ingredients with this and cook until it is as thick as you want. Put in quart jars and process in hot water bath for 40 minutes. Total cooking time is about 3 hours.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar and cocoa into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Mix together. Make 3 holes (pockets). In the 1st hole put baking soda and salt. In the 2nd hole put vanilla and vinegar. In the 3rd hole put oil. Over all pour 1 cup of cold water. Stir gently until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls in hot oil or lard.

title: Captain Morgan Pineapple Nut Cake
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Stir in pineapple and walnuts. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube or fluted pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes until tester comes out clean. Cool 25 minutes; remove from pan. Finish cooling on wire rack.

title: Homemade Lemonade
instructions: Squeeze the lemon over the bowl with the juicer. Add the cup of water and 3 teaspoons of sugar. Mix. Pour into glasses. Add ice cubes. Serves 2.

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: Two cups raw rice is fried until golden brown. Then add onions green pepper and spices. Mix together with rice for about 5 minutes. Add water tomato sauce and diced tomatoes. Mix together (medium flame). \DO NOT STIR WHILE COOKING; RICE WILL STICK TOGETHER\. Let cook about 15 to 20 minutes or until all water has evaporated. Ready to serve and eat.

title: Spaghetti Meatballs And Sauce
instructions: Finely chop onion and lightly brown in saucepan in oil. Add tomato paste with 3 paste cans of water and stewed tomatoes. Let simmer for 1/2 to 1 hour adding warm water to keep level. Add salt sugar pepper sweet basil garlic salt (or garlic cloves) oregano and bay leaves. Let simmer 1/2 hour and add warm water as needed. Add meatballs.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt butter and brown sugar. Add to dry ingredients with nuts vanilla and egg. Drop on a greased cookie sheet. Bake until brown. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Tofu Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Mash tofu with fork. Add all ingredients and mix well. Roll into little balls. Bake on cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes. Can be stored in freezer.

title: Gold Rush Punch
instructions: Combine sugar fruit juices and water in pitcher. Stir until sugar dissolves. Chill.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating 3 minutes after each egg. Add milk alternately with sifted cake flour beating until well mixed and smooth. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into well-greased tube cake pan. Bottom of pan should be lined with wax paper. Place in cold oven set at 300\u00b0 and bake until it leaves side of pan (approximately 1 1/2 hours).

title: Creamy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli with onion 3 to 5 minutes and drain. Melt butter in separate pan. Add flour salt and milk. Heat until sauce is thick and smooth stirring constantly. Add cream cheese and stir until well blended. Place broccoli and onions in a 2-quart greased casserole and add cooked sauce. Sprinkle top with grated cheese. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour mixture. Add water to make soft dough consistency. Put berries in a 9 x 13-inch pan with sugar water and margarine. Bring to rolling boil. Roll out 2/3 of the dough thin on floured waxed paper. Cut into strips. Drop into boiled berry mix. Roll out remaining dough in strips. Put on top of cobbler. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or golden brown.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy. Drain and crumble. Cool bacon. Mix bacon with cheeses olives onions and mayonnaise. Place small amount on each slice of bread. Place in oven until cheeses melt. Serve warm. Great for brunch or midnight snacks.

title: Salmonelle'S
instructions: Drain salmon and reserve 1/4 cup liquid. Break apart salmon. Add egg and flour. Add baking powder to reserved liquid; beat until foamy. Pour into salmon mixture and stir until blended. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry until brown.

title: Cream Puff Cake
instructions: Pour water in saucepan and add butter.\tBring to a boil. Add the flour and stir until mixed. Remove from heat and let cool 2 minutes. Beat in eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Spread mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool.

title: French Fried New Potatoes
instructions: Clean potatoes. Wash well and cut one strip of peel off around middle of potato. Put in hot oil and cook until brown. Salt to taste.

title: Moon Cake
instructions: Place 1 cup water and 1/2 cup margarine in a saucepan. Bring to boil. Add 1 cup flour all at once. Lower the flame and stir rapidly until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat and cool a little while.

title: Ham And Cheese Appetizers
