instructions: Cut slices of bread in four. Spread each with mustard and top with ham cut to fit. Place drained pineapple chunks on ham and top with Swiss cheese. Cut to shape. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Serve at once.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Wash okra and pack it in jars. Add to each jar 2 buttons of garlic (slice or mash it slightly) 2 heads of dill and 1 hot pepper (Mexican chilian red). Combine first ingredients and heat to boiling. Pour over okra. Seal immediately.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut hard-cooked eggs in half lengthwise. Remove egg yolks; set egg white halves aside. In a small bowl use a fork to mash egg yolks. Stir in salad dressing mustard pickles onion and thyme. Spoon egg yolk mixture evenly into egg white halves. Sprinkle tops of eggs with paprika. Makes 12 appetizer servings.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Chop green tomatoes; place in drainer. Pour boiling water over tomatoes and let stand; drain. Chop onions and peppers. Combine tomatoes onions and peppers in a large canner. Add all other ingredients. Bring to a boil. Turn down to a simmer and cook for about 1 hour. Pack in cleaned jars; seal with canning lid and process for 15 minutes. Makes about 7 to 9 pints.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together beans sugar and mustard. Crumble bacon and add to beans. Add some bacon grease to taste. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes in a 13 x 9 baking dish.

title: Mim'S Seafood Bisque
instructions: Heat soups and milk. Add cream cheese and sherry. Add seafood and enjoy.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and nuts. Mix well. Add melted oleo and orange juice. Blend well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in powdered sugar. Chill until firm.

title: Oven Barbecued Steaks
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0 (medium). Cut steak into 10 equal portions. Pour oil into skillet. Brown each piece of steak on both sides. Transfer steaks to a roasting pan. Add onions to oil in skillet and brown lightly. Add rest of ingredients to make a barbecue sauce and simmer 5 minutes. Pour sauce over steaks in pan. Cover. Bake 2 hours or until meat is fork-tender.

title: Peanut Banana Muffins
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in bowl and make a well in center. Combine rest of ingredients and beat at medium speed until blended. Then add to flour mixture and stir just to moisten. Do not overmix. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full and bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix together in large container. Makes lots. To serve place 1/4 cup of mix in mug. Add boiling water. Stir and enjoy. Store in an airtight container. Makes a great Christmas gift! Give small amounts in colorful containers with directions attached.

title: Tamale Casserole
instructions: Unwrap tamales cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Line 11/2 qt. casserole with half tamales slices. Spread half chili over top. Cover with half of the onions hen half of chips and half of cheese. Repeat except for the cheese. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake 10 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 large servings.

title: Instant Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients until blended. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press each ball slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yield 2 1/2 dozen. (Lemon is very good.)

title: Quick Caramel Pie
instructions: Mix brown sugar and beaten egg. Add flour and milk alternately. Beat until smooth; add vanilla and butter. Cook in a double boiler stirring constantly until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue and brown; cool in refrigerator until served.

title: Ground Beef Grand Style
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Combine cheese soup milk catsup and meat. Pour into casserole and bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove from oven; place biscuits on top and bake 15 to 18 minutes until biscuits are brown.

title: Baked Fish Cordon Blue
instructions: Thaw fillets if frozen. Place 1 slice each of ham and cheese in center of each fillet. Cut to fit. Sprinkle with grated orange rind and white pepper. Roll into pinwheels and secure with toothpicks. Gently dip roll in beaten egg; coat with bread crumbs. Place in a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.

title: Chocolate Chip Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine bread cubes and 1/4 cup chocolate chips in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. In a separate bowl combine beaten eggs sugar salt milk and vanilla. Stir until well mixed. Pour mixture over bread. Sprinkle remaining chocolate chips over this. Place casserole dish in a pan of water and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Christmas Roll Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine; add sugar and vanilla. Dissolve sugar. Add dates and beaten egg. Cook 10 minutes on medium heat. Cool and add nuts and Rice Krispies. Roll in small balls then in coconut. Refrigerate or seal tightly. Yield 40 small balls.

title: Luscious Lemon Dessert
instructions: Combine flour margarine and nuts. Spread in 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cream the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Fold in 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over cooled crust. Prepare 2 packages pudding using only 3 cup milk. Pour over cream cheese mixture. Spread remaining Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Season chicken breasts. Place chicken breasts in large pot along with bell pepper celery and onion. Add water in pot until chicken breasts are covered. Let cook for about 4 hours until breasts are tender (falling off bone). Chop breasts into small pieces. Add mustard relish and mayonnaise to taste. Add eggs (chopped also into small pieces). Stir; ready to serve.

title: Grandma Simons' Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add broccoli rice soup water milk and Cheez Whiz. Combine and bake in greased casserole 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift together the first 5 ingredients. Add the vanilla vinegar oil and cold water; blend until moist then beat at medium speed with an electric mixer for 2 minutes. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add the Cheese Filling.

title: Herbed Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken breasts; reserve 2 cups of broth. Remove chicken from bone and tear into bite size pieces. Place in 3-quart baking dish. Combine soups and 1 cup of broth; pour over chicken. Mix margarine and remaining 1 cup of broth; stir in stuffing. Spoon over chicken. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Bombay Tuna
instructions: In medium bowl combine tuna apple celery green onion almonds and currants. Stir in mayonnaise chutney mustard and curry powder. Refrigerate. Great for summertime entertaining!

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together. Put drained pineapple in bottom of dish. Sprinkle flour/sugar mixture on top. Then cover with cheese. Mix crushed crackers with melted butter and layer on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Collards A La Italiana
instructions: Heat oil and add onion. Cook until soft. Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes longer. Season with salt and pepper and marjoram. Add collards. Simmer covered over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir frequently and add juice of tomatoes or water to keep moist. Sprinkle with cheese and serve hot. Serves 4.

title: Souperior Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients. In large baking pan shape into loaf. Bake 1 hour or until done. Makes about 8 servings. Also may use Lipton \Recipe Secrets\ beefy onion soup mix instead of onion or Italian herb.

title: Honey-Without The Bees
instructions: Put clovers and rose petals in colander; wash and drain. In large heavy kettle place all ingredients; bring to a boil. Turn down heat to low and cook another 5 minutes stirring constantly; strain. Pour into sterilized jars and seal. Makes 8 jars.

title: Frying Pan Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Mix sugar eggs salt and dates in with butter. Cook until thick and mash the dates while cooking (about 10 to 15 minutes). Remove from heat. Add pecans and vanilla. Add Rice Krispies. Mix well. Spoon out and roll into a ball about an inch in diameter. Roll in coconut.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon. Put into a buttered baking dish. Top with bacon. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes or until done.

title: Granola Bars
instructions: Stir and heat honey and peanut butter until melted. Remove from heat. Add oats raisins and carrots; mix well. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut in squares.

title: Spinach Supreme
instructions: Saute onion; stir in flour and milk. Add cheese. Mix with drained spinach. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Tenderize steak. Beat egg and milk. Combine with garlic salt salt and pepper. Cut steak into serving portions. Preheat vegetable oil on medium. Dip steak in flour egg mixture and bread crumbs. Brown both sides of steak until golden brown. Pour 3/4 can of gravy in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Place single layer steak on gravy in pan. Saute mushrooms in leftover oil and bread crumbs. Place mushrooms on top of steak. Pour remaining gravy over steak and mushrooms. Cover with foil. Cook 2 to 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a mixing bowl. Add berries eggs and oil. Mix well and pour into 3 well-greased and floured 1-pound coffee cans or 1 large and 1 small bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Place chicken into bowl. Pour buttermilk over; marinate for 1/2 to 1 hour.

title: Single Serving Pizza
instructions: Mix together the first 7 ingredients reserving 1/2 cup pizza sauce. Cut English muffins put on cookie sheet cut side down. Brown lightly. Turn muffins cut side up and spread with reserved pizza sauce covering the edges. Divide equal portions of the meat mixture onto each muffin and smooth to cover. Sprinkle the tops with grated Parmesan cheese. Broil for 5 minutes.

title: French Toast
instructions: Cut bread into 1-inch slices. Remove crust from each slice. Heat oil in 12-inch Dutch oven. Mix eggs nutmeg and salt in large bowl. Whip until eggs are frothy. Dip bread in egg mixture. Deep fry until\tgolden\tbrown.\tSprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Aunt Dina'S Chili Pie Casserole
instructions: Place 2 cups of corn chips in 2 quart baking dish or 13 x 9 x 2 inch dish. Arrange onion and 1/2 cup grated cheese on chips. Pour chili over. Then top with remaining corn chips and 1/2 cup cheese. Place olives on top or garnish with olives after baking. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. If you make this dish earlier in the day and have it refrigerated it will take longer to heat.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix the flour shortening sugar and salt with pastry blender. Beat the egg. Add the water and vinegar to the egg and mix well. Combine the two mixtures a little at a time until all the dry ingredients are moist. Mold together with your hands. Makes 2 double crust 9-inch pies and one 9-inch shell. May keep in refrigerator up to 1 week. May freeze.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Take out while still soft. M&Ms chocolate chips nuts etc. may be added as desired.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt. Blend in milk and egg yolks. Combine flour mixture with milk mixture. Cook on top of double boiler on medium heat until thickened. Add vanilla. Pour into serving bowl in layers then add bananas and wafers. Alternate. End with wafers. Can top with meringue. If so bake until golden brown.

title: Torre'S Cake
instructions: Combine butter flour and crushed almonds and mix well. Press in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until light brown. Cool.

title: Sun-Drenched Chicken Breasts
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet heat oil and brown chicken over medium heat for 10 minutes turning once; drain. Remove chicken and keep warm. In same skillet add wine and boil 2 minutes stirring brown bits from bottom of skillet. Stir in tomato and golden herb with lemon soup mix blended with water. Return chicken to skillet. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered 20 minutes or until chicken is done. Top with olives and parsley. Serve if desired over hot cooked rice or noodles. Serves 4.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix together the quick oats and boiling water and set aside. Cream together sugars margarine eggs and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Add oatmeal and mix well. Beat at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Overnight Scalloped Chicken Casserole
instructions: In a large bowl combine soup milk and cheese. Add chicken or turkey macaroni and eggs. Stir in 1/4 cup melted margarine. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Toss the bread crumbs with remaining margarine. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown. Yield 12 servings.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Combine beans in a small bowl. Mix together remaining ingredients (except onion) and toss with beans. Garnish with onion rings. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Carrot Bars
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Add vanilla. Mix dry ingredients. Add carrots and dry ingredients alternating; mix. Add coconut. Bake 20 minutes at 325\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift several cups of flour (3 to 4 cups) into large mixing bowl. Add butter to sugar into well made in center of sifted flour; cream. Add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla and salt. Work enough flour into mixture to make dough stiff enough to roll and cut. Place cookies on cookie sheet and bake until as brown as desired. Bake at about 350\u00b0.

title: Glazed Beets In Orange Sauce
instructions: Combine cornstarch and beet juice. Mix well. Stir in orange juice lemon juice salt and vinegar. Cook over low heat until clear and thickened. Add sugars and beets. Cook for 5 minutes and add butter. Stir until melted. Pour into serving dish and sprinkle with orange peel. Serve hot.

title: Smoky Bean Dip
instructions: Rinse and drain chickpeas. Puree with chopped green chiles barbecue sauce ground cumin and minced garlic. Cover and chill at least 1 day for best flavor.

title: Skillet Salad
instructions: Melt oleo in skillet. Add remaining ingredients and cover. Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Ingredients may be prepared early in day and mixed together in skillet 15 minutes before dinner. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mexican Crock-Pot
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with onion. Drain meat. Put in crock-pot with remaining ingredients. Mix together stirring well. Turn crock-pot on low. Simmer all day. Add tortilla chips as a side dish.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish combine peanuts sugar syrup and salt. Cook for 8 minutes in microwave on High. Stir well after 4 minutes. After the 8 minutes stir in the butter and vanilla; cook for 2 more minutes on High in microwave. Add the baking soda and quickly stir until light and foamy. Immediately pour the mixture onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Spread the mixture out until very thin. After it has cooled break into small pieces and store in an airtight container. Makes about 1 pound. You have to keep it hidden if you want some for yourself.

title: Caramel Marshmallow Krispies
instructions: Melt oleo milk and caramels. Dip marshmallows in caramel sauce. Roll in Rice Krispies. Store uncovered. Makes large batch.

title: Super Loaf
instructions: Stir everything together. Pour into a large loaf pan and let stand for 20 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: May add food color if you desire.

title: Awesome Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Spread half of apples into an 8 x 11-inch pan. Stir brown sugar into melted margarine. Mix all dry ingredients. Combine with sugar and margarine and mix well. Crumble half of oatmeal mix over apples in pan. Cover with rest of apple slices. Crumble remaining mixture over top of pan. Pour on orange juice. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Hamburger Barley Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain off fat. Pour in a large pot with all ingredients except potatoes and carrots. Simmer for 45 minutes. Put in carrots. Cook for 10 minutes. Add potatoes and cook for another 20 minutes or until done.

title: Myrtle'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar. Add eggs. Mix baking powder with flour; add to cake mixture. Add milk and flavorings. Pour into a greased and lightly floured tube pan and bake 1 hour and 25 minutes at 325\u00b0 or 300\u00b0.

title: Cheesy Tuna 'N Rice Muffinlettes
instructions: Combine rice cheese tuna olives onion parsley and Season-All. Stir in eggs and milk mixing thoroughly. Spray 6 muffin cups with Pam. Divide rice mixture evenly among cups. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Loosen with spatula and arrange on serving plate. Serve with Tangy Butter Sauce. Makes 6.

title: Fettucine, Peas And Mushrooms
instructions: In large pot boil water. Add salt oil and fettucine. Cook al dente. Drain. Cook peas until tender (if can hot). Saute mushrooms in butter and cream until tender. Toss with cheese peas and fettucine. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel cook and mash potatoes. Add cream cheese flour and eggs. Mix well; add parsley onion and garlic powder. Put in casserole with onion rings on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Veal And Mushrooms In White Wine Sauce
instructions: Pound veal into 1/4-inch thickness. Rub with garlic then sprinkle with flour. Saute veal in butter until brown. Add mushrooms wine and salt. Cook on low heat for about 15 minutes or until sauce thickens. Top with fresh parsley.

title: Main Meal Hominy Salad
instructions: Rinse hominy and drain well. Combine with remaining ingredients and chill well. Serve on lettuce; garnish with tomato wedges.

title: Chocolate Coconutty Delights
instructions: Note To make drizzling with chocolate easier put thin melted mixture in a plastic bag. Snip off a corner of the bag and drizzle chocolate coating through the hole.

title: Red Hot (Cinnamon) Cucumber Pickles
instructions: *The kind thats red all the way through. The ones with white insides will make a cloudy look.

title: Crunchy Cheeseroni Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Brown and drain ground beef. Add soups green pepper and pimento. Mix.

title: Hurry Up Pie
instructions: Mix the milk and lemon juice; let stand 5 minutes. Mix all ingredients well. Fill 2 graham cracker crusts.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
instructions: Coarsely crush cookies and reserve 1/4 cup crumbs. To remaining crumbs add melted butter and blend well. Press crumb mixture into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar and half thawed whipped topping. Spread over crumb layer in pan. Chill 30 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Ice Cream Sandwiches
instructions: Crush 4 graham crackers. Arrange 4 of the remaining crackers on work surface. Spread chocolate evenly over crackers. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of crumbs on each cracker and press gently into chocolate. Arrange remaining 4 crackers on baking sheet. Top each with 1/2 cup of ice milk. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on ice milk. Top with coated crackers chocolate side down. Freeze 30 minutes or until firm. Wrap and keep frozen until served.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Prepare beets by boiling for approximately 20 minutes with 3 inch of top and roots still on. Drain and place in cold water. Slip skins off; trim top and roots. If small leave whole. If not slice and place in clean jars.

title: Brownies
instructions: You make up at home and for Thanksgiving dinner. Get a brown potato that is white inside. Carve it out and throw away the peelings. Smash it good and put some milk in it. (I think thats how you make it.)

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Add flour sugar and brown sugar; beat until well blended. Blend in melted butter. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cake batter to directions. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and set aside. Beat sugar and cream cheese. Melt butter and pour into sugar mixture. Pour over your cake. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Top with cherries or strawberries.

title: Crust For Peach Cobbler
instructions: Stir and mix well. Drop on top of fruit mixture in baking dish. Cook for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Dredge steak in flour and seasoning mixture. Fry in hot oil until lightly browned on both sides. When all steak has been browned place in skillet cover with water and tomato sauce and season to taste. Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 1 hour or until meat is tender. Stir occasionally. Add onion slices for extra flavor before you cover and simmer.

title: Beanie Weanies
instructions: Melt Crisco in pan. Add onion and bell pepper. Cook until soft. Add brown sugar ketchup vinegar dry mustard salt and pepper. Simmer until sugar is dissolved. Pour mixture over hot dogs butter beans kidney beans and pork and beans. Stir until well coated. Pour into a large dish cover and cook 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Cheese Potatoes
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan combine cheeses butter onion (sauteed first) sour cream milk and Worcestershire sauce. Add flour; stir until sauce is creamy and smooth. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish layer potatoes; sprinkle with salts. Pour sauce over potatoes. Sprinkle cooked bacon on top. Cook in oven at 325\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until bubbly and brown.

title: Easy Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar flour and eggs. Mash bananas and add to mixture. Add nuts. Makes two loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Skillet Chicken Risotto
instructions: In 10-inch skillet brown chicken in hot oil for about 15 minutes. Remove chicken and drain all but 2 tablespoons fat from skillet. Add rice onion salt and poultry seasoning to skillet. Cook and stir until rice is lightly browned. Add mushrooms carrots and water. Place chicken atop rice mixture. Season chicken with additional salt and pepper.

title: Homemade Lasagne
instructions: In a medium bowl combine Ricotta eggs Parmesan cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Spread 1 cup of meat sauce into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer 1/4 of the lasagne 1/3 of the Ricotta mixture and 1 cup meat sauce and repeat twice. Top with remaining ingredients. Top layer should be Mozzarella. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes; uncover and bake 15 minutes longer. Let stand for 15 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute the onion celery and bell pepper in the garlic butter until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and stir. Cook until flour is no longer white. Watch it carefully to avoid burning. Add shrimp and cook just until shrimp turn pink. Add tomato paste stewed tomatoes water salt Worcestershire and Tabasco. Cook over low heat for about 15 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all and chill. Serve with chips or vegetables.

title: Unbaked Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt butter or margarine and marshmallows together. Add remaining ingredients separately and mix well. Press in container of your choice. Put in refrigerator 24 hours before serving.

title: Green Beans With Tomatoes
instructions: Fry bacon strips; leave grease drippings in pan. Remove bacon. Add diced onion and brown. Add green beans (drain 1/2 the can). Add tomatoes chopped; simmer. Add sugar salt and pepper to taste. Simmer. Crumble bacon strips and sprinkle over the green beans.

title: Jade Delight
instructions: Blend all ingredients except oil in blender at high speed. Add oil and blend until well emulsified. For a milder version omit the crushed red pepper.

title: Zucchini And Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and celery. Remove from pan; drain off fat. I rinse mine in water and drain. In same skillet add 1 tablespoon oleo and brown zucchini. In 1 1/2-quart casserole alternate layers of ground beef and zucchini. Sprinkle each layer of meat and zucchini with salt and pepper (easy on salt). In small dish stir tomatoes Worcestershire sauce and sugar. Mix well. Pour over casserole. Add cheese on top. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Toffee Butter Crunch
instructions: Melt butter in large pan. Add sugar syrup and water. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally to hard crack stage (300\u00b0). (Watch carefully after 280\u00b0.) Quickly stir in chopped nuts.

title: Caramel Cluster
instructions: Heat margarine in a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat until melted. Stir in sugar. Stir frequently with wooden spoon 4 to 5 minutes while mixture melts and begins to turn a golden color. Continue cooking 1 to 2 minutes longer stirring constantly. (Do not overcook; mixture will go from granular to smooth and margarine and sugar may begin to separate.) Remove from heat. Quickly add cereal and mix until coated; immediately spread on cookie sheet. Cool. Break into bite-size pieces.

title: Sausage Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage (drain). Melt cheese. Combine tomatoes and cheese with sausage. Serve with corn chips.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Sift cocoa and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Add milk and lay margarine sticks on top. Do not stir. Microwave on High for 6 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir thoroughly. Add vanilla flavoring and nuts. Stir until well mixed. Pour onto buttered platter. Cool in refrigerator for 1 hour. Cut and serve. Do not double this recipe.

title: Fun Bubbles Galore
instructions: Combine ingredients and refrigerate. Bring to room temperature before using about 4 hours.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown meat with diced onion; add celery. Cook covered. Simmer until meat is done. Add bouillon cubes. Add remaining ingredients; stir together. Serve over cooked rice. Sprinkle with chop suey noodles.

title: Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar and margarine; cream together for 6 minutes (no longer). Add Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter or chocolate chips. Mix well.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into greased bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add food coloring and cocoa. Mix salt and vanilla with buttermilk; add to creamed mixture alternating with flour. Mix soda and vinegar and fold in; do not beat. Pour into two greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Rings
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix grated cheese and margarine together. Mix all dry ingredients together and add to cheese mixture a little at a time. Using star disc of cookie press press out onto wax paper in a long stream. Cut with knife in approximately 2-inch strips. Turn these to form a ring and press together. This recipe makes approximately 25 dozen rings.

title: Alpine Pantry Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook bacon in a large Dutch oven until crisp. Remove cool and crumble or chop. Cook onions in bacon fat until tender. Add brown sugar mustard salt and vinegar; saute for 2 minutes. Add all beans and bacon. Stir in catsup. Mix well; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or longer. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Chicken Italian
instructions: Cover chicken and potatoes with oil garlic salt and salt. Add tomato sauce oregano and cheese. Bake 1 1/2 hours until potatoes are done.

title: Fresh Vegetable Salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Cover; refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with chips. Makes 4 cups.

title: Texas Chili
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in skillet. Add beef cubes and brown on all sides. Remove and set aside. Cook onion in oil from meat until tender. Add beef. Combine spices and stir in to beef mixture. Add beer broth and tomato paste. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Combine flour and water. Slowly stir into chili. Simmer 15 minutes.

title: Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Mix all ingredients except spareribs. Brown ribs over medium-high heat in a large skillet. Pour sauce over ribs. Cook covered until sauce thickens a little and meat is done. Uncover and cook until sauce thickens and is sticky.

title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables as directed; drain. Put into 2-quart casserole. Melt butter over low heat. Stir in flour and seasonings until smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat; stir in milk. Stir over low heat until thick. Sprinkle onion pimento and cheese over vegetables. Pour sauce over all. Sprinkle with crackers and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Quick Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients and chill. Serve with potato chips or fresh vegetables. Makes 3 1/4 cups. Preparation time is 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Syrup Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour syrup and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hunter Veal
instructions: Optional Serve with biscuits or over noodles.

title: French Bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. In large bowl dissolve sugar and salt in 1 cup warm water. Add shortening and yeast. Add flour and mix well with wooden spoon. Work dough with spoon at 10 minute intervals five times. Turn dough on floured board into 2 balls. Let rest for 10 minutes. Roll each ball into 12 x 9-inches then roll as for jelly roll. Place on greased baking sheet and score 6 times. Let rise for 1 1/2 hours (covered). Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Daddy'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat. Combine all ingredients in pot and simmer several hours. You may need to add more chili powder to suit your taste.

title: Steak Topping
instructions: Slice mushrooms lengthwise (leave button or small ones whole). Slice onion into rings. In medium skillet melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic powder seasoned salt and pepper and stir. Add mushrooms onion rings and beer or wine. Cover. Simmer until juice is fairly thick. Pour over sirloin (or other kind) steak.

title: Red Punch
instructions: Mix each package Kool-Aid with 2 cups sugar each. Mix all other ingredients except ginger ale in a dish pan. Pour in 2 gallon jugs and add enough water to fill. Pour into punch bowl and add ginger ale (cooled) last directly into punch bowl.

title: I Don'T Feel Like Cooking Beef And Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan and bake for 1 hour. This is delicious and low in fat (but high in sodium).

title: Rosh Hashana Sweet Potato-Praline Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Stir in potatoes. Mash smoothly. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Spread evenly in baking dish.

title: Lime Pineapple Cream Salad
instructions: Cream together jello and cream cheese. Pour over this mixture hot water and stir until smooth. Add pineapple and pecans. Chill until set. Serve with lettuce and mayonnaise.

title: 96 Apricot Bavarian
instructions: Dissolve apricot gelatin in boiling water. Add nectar. Let cool. Break angel food cake into small pieces. Add 1 1/2 cartons Cool Whip in gelatin mix. Blend well. Using 10-inch tube pan put layer of cake gelatin mixture and continue ending with gelatin mix. Cover and put in refrigerator for at least 6 hours. Unmold on cake plate and ice with remaining Cool Whip and garnish with halves of apricots. Serves 12.

title: Nacho Supreme
instructions: Spray a baking dish lightly with cooking spray. Place 1/2 bag of tortillas on bottom of pan. On top of tortillas spread chili. On top of chili add cheeses. On top of cheeses add diced vegetables. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake approximately 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: 5-Cup Salad
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in a large bowl and chill.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Cook raisins and water for 5 minutes then add sugar flour and vinegar. Stir all the time. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Garlic French Bread
instructions: Place butter and garlic in saucepan and bring to a simmer constantly stirring. Slice bread in half lengthwise. Spoon liquid on bread. Sprinkle with pepper. Add cheese and broil in oven to taste/sight. Serves 8.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together in the order given. Form a ball using about a teaspoon. Press lightly on cookie sheet with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Bundle Burgers
instructions: In medium saucepan cook stuffing according to package directions. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl mix the hamburger eggs and bread crumbs. Divide hamburger mix like you were making hamburger patties. Flatten each patty out. Put a scoop of stuffing in middle then fold the hamburger up around it and make a little bundle. Place in 9 x 11 baking pan. Mix the soup and milk together in small bowl. Pour over the bundles of hamburger. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Melt margarine and saute carrots celery and onion. Add broth and simmer for 30 minutes. Add soup cheese and seasonings. Simmer for 15 minutes. Add sour cream and sherry if desired. Blend well. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Smothered Hamburger Steaks
instructions: Season hamburger with salt and pepper. Shape into 4 large patties and brown in large skillet. Mix brown gravy mix with water it calls for plus 1/2 cup extra and bring to boil according to directions. Drain off grease from hamburgers. Pour gravy over hamburgers. Slice onion. Place over burgers. Bring to boil. Cover pan and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Coconut Chocolate Pie
instructions: Toast coconut. Mix with melted butter and chocolate. Press into a pie shell as for a crust. Chill. Spread with softened ice cream. Chill and serve in slices.

title: Diabetic Chocolate Pie
instructions: Place in saucepan. Bring to boil; cook over low heat slowly. When thickened add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Put in pie shell which has already been baked.

title: Creamsicle Dessert
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; stir in cold water. Chill until slightly thickened. Prepare pudding using 2 cups cold milk. Fold mandarin oranges thickened jello and 1 cup whipped topping into pudding. Pour into 6-cup ring mold. Chill 4 hours or until set.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Chicken Nachos
instructions: Use either boneless chicken breast (cooked) or diced frozen chicken.

title: Hearty Meatball Stew
instructions: Shape sausage into balls. In large skillet brown meatballs in oil carefully turning to brown evenly. Remove meatballs from skillet. Reserve 2 tablespoons meat drippings in skillet; stir in flour and pepper. Gradually add 1 cup water and chicken broth. Cook until mixture boils and thickens stirring constantly. Add carrots celery onion and meatballs. Simmer uncovered 20 to 30 minutes. Add corn; heat thoroughly. In large saucepan heat 2 cups water to boiling; add cabbage. Cover and cook 8 minutes or until crisp-tender; drain. Arrange cabbage on serving platter surrounding stew. Makes 6 servings.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Combine eggs cream sugar salt and vanilla in a bowl and beat with mixer. Pour mixture into ice cream freezer and add condensed milk and stir well. Add whole milk to fill line on can and stir. Put can in ice cream freezer and alternate layers of ice and rock salt. Churn until firm. Store remaining ice cream in freezer.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix and let marinate overnight. You can add or take away whatever you want.

title: Barbecued Meat Balls
instructions: Crumble bread in milk; add salt and pepper to meat. Form into medium balls; place them in a small casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the meat balls. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: 15 Minute Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown the meat. Add water and soups. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Blend sour cream and flour and add to the meat. Cook and stir until thick. Heat through but do not boil. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix above ingredients and cook moderately high. Stir. Peanuts will begin to pop and turn light brown around the edges when done. Remove from heat and add 1/2 teaspoon soda. Pour immediately onto buttered cookie sheet. Take up as soon as brittle will break and loosen from sheet.

title: Bacon Roll-Ups
instructions: Trim bread; cut in half. Mix cream cheese and sausage. Spread on bread; roll up. Wrap with slice of bacon; secure with toothpick. Bake on rack at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Not The Same Old Chicken
instructions: In a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish arrange chicken with thickest meaty pieces to outside edges of dish. In small bowl stir together mayonnaise onion soup mix dressing and preserves. Spread over chicken coating each piece. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High 18 to 22 minutes rotating dish 1/2 turn after 10 minutes. Allow to stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving so chicken absorbs flavor of sauce. Serve with rice if desired. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Buckeye Cookies
instructions: Mix by hand. If they do not hold together add 1 small jar of regular peanut butter. Roll into balls; refrigerate overnight.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Season to taste with 2 Chronicles 99 (spices). Mix like any fruit cake. Put in lined tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Miracle Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Brown quickly in a little oil and place in a baking dish. Combine maple syrup and ketchup. Pour this mixture over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tender. Then just sit back and wait for the compliments.

title: Apple Peekaboo
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix yellow cake mix to package directions. Pour cake mix into pan. Mix apples and sugar; pour over cake mix. Pour pint of cream over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Brown beef in small amount of fat. Mix in rest of ingredients except topping. Spread in pastry-lined pie pan. Spread Cheese Topping over filling. Bake about 30 minutes. Serve with sauce. (Sauce is remaining 4 ounces tomato sauce and 4 ounces chili sauce.)

title: Sugar-Free Fat-Free Banana Bread
instructions: Beat together until fluffy juice bananas eggs and flavorings. Add flour baking powder baking soda and cinnamon. Mix all until just blended. Add optional nuts or raisins or fruit bits. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes approximately.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Note This recipe is quick and great for diets!

title: Congealed Jello And Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add marshmallows and let them melt and puff up. Add cottage cheese mayonnaise nuts and pineapple. Pour into dish approximately 9 x 9-inch and chill.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream(Makes 4 Quarts)
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar gradually beating until mixture thickens. Add condensed milk vanilla and salt. Mix and chill 2 hours before freezing.

title: Chicken Pot Pie I
instructions: Mix soup milk veggies salt and pepper to taste. Layer chicken in pie crust then pour soup and veggies over top of chicken. Mix a little bit then cover with pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until crust is golden brown.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake in buttered casserole dish at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours until knife in center comes out fairly clean.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel and quarter sweet potatoes. Add water and cook until tender in saucepan. Place in baking dish with brown sugar white syrup and butter. Put into oven and let cook 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Then put marshmallows on top and let brown slightly.

title: Potato Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients reserve 1/2 cup cheese. Put in 11 x 13-inch pan. Top with reserved grated cheese. Cover and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Bake approximately 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients and chill. Great for apples pear slices and oranges too.

title: One Pot Meal
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain. Put in crock-pot. Brown bacon and onions and remaining ingredients to crock-pot. Stir well. Cover and cook on low heat four to nine hours. This can also be made in oven in a covered casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Pears With Creme De Menthe
instructions: In a large bowl place pear halves. Reserve the juice; add creme de menthe to individual taste. Blend carefully; pour over pears. Refrigerate until very cold. Just before serving add nuts and/or cherries. Use red or green to suit the occasion!

title: Fuzzy Navel Milkshake
instructions: Combine ice cream peaches and orange juice in blender. Blend only until mixed and dont worry about lumps of unblended peaches. Pour into tall glasses and garnish with strawberries. Makes 2 tall drinks.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Combine ingredients thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean when inserted.

title: Little Cheesecakes
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar eggs and vanilla well. Put cookie in foil baking cup. Fill 3/4 full with cream cheese mixture. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool and put pie filling on top.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar and flour with salt also. Then add eggs and add milk slowly. Then add vanilla.

title: Pasta Con Broccoli
instructions: Melt butter; add garlic cream and cheese. Heat until thickened while stirring constantly. Add broccoli mushrooms and noodles. Will thicken upon standing.

title: Pickled Peaches
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar and spices; boil 10 minutes. Cook peaches until tender in boiling syrup a few at a time. Pack in jars and fill with boiling syrup and seal.

title: Mark'S New York Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Prepare pudding using entire quart of milk. Cover bottom of a large glass trifle bowl with syrup. Break 1 cake layer into pieces and place on top of syrup. Spread 1/2 pudding mixture over cake pieces. Spread 1/2 Cool Whip over pudding. Sprinkle candy pieces over Cool Whip. Repeat layers ending with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Poke Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. When cool poke holes in top of cake with fork. Pour 7-Up evenly over top.

title: Baked Corn With Sour Cream
instructions: Saute onion in butter in large skillet. Blend in flour and salt. Add sour cream gradually stirring until smooth. Bring to a boil; add corn. Cook until heated through. Fold in half the bacon. Pour into greased baking dish. Top with parsley and remaining bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Coconut Almond Macaroons
instructions: In mixing bowl combine sugars; mix well. Work in almond paste until mixture resembles fine bread crumbs. Stir in salt vanilla cocoa and coconut; mix well. Add egg whites one at a time beating well after each addition. Line cookie sheet with brown paper. Drop or put through super shooter; make small mounds 1 1/2 inches in size. Bake 18 to 20 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until lightly colored. Cool by placing brown paper on damp towel; cookies will peel off easily. Place in airtight container so cookies remain chewy. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Combine salad dressing juice and seasonings; mix well. Pour over chicken. Chill several hours or overnight. Reserve salad dressing mixture; place chicken skin side up on rack in baking pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes brushing occasionally with salad dressing mixture. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Mom'S Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all together and store in tightly covered container.

title: Millionaires
instructions: Melt caramels in double boiler. Add the chopped pecans. Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet and chill. Melt chocolate and paraffin in double boiler. Dip caramels in chocolate and place on waxed paper.

title: Cinnamon Apple Mold Salad
instructions: Place candies and water in saucepan and cook over medium heat until candies are melted. Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot liquid. Let cool slightly and then add applesauce mixing well. Pour into mold and refrigerate until firm.

title: Spaghetti And Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef 1/2 of oregano 1/2 of onions and peppers pinch of garlic and dash of black pepper. Make into meatballs. Mix remainder of ingredients into a large saucepan. Put in meatballs and simmer for approximately 1 hour. Let cool and skim off fat that rises to the top. Can be refrigerated and frozen for future use several days later.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Cook oleomargarine sugar and dates in top of double boiler for 8 minutes; stir often. Add nuts and Rice Krispies; mix well. Cool mixture for about 45 minutes and then roll into balls (about the size of a large marble). Roll date balls lightly in confectioners sugar.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil sugar water corn syrup and cornstarch until thickened stirring constantly. Add strawberry jello powder. Remove from heat and cool. Place 1 quart fresh strawberries in baked 9-inch pastry shell. Pour cooled sauce over berries. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Top with whipped cream and serve.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Line pie pan with crust and fill with pears. Mix 1/4 c. sugar salt cornstarch lemon rind and juice together. Spread over pears. Mix remaining ingredients together with a fork until crumbly. Sprinkle over pears. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all of this together and pour in churn. Makes 4 quarts of homemade ice cream. Tastes like a Wendys frosty!

title: Apple Raisin Muffins
instructions: Grease twelve 3 1/2 to 4 oz. muffin cups. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large bowl beat oil and sugar with an electric beater for 2 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla beat 1 minute. In another bowl stir in flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Add dry ingredients to oil mixture. Stir just to combine. Stir in apples raisins and walnuts. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a cake tester comes out clean. Remove from oven and cool 5 minutes before removing muffins from cups. Finish cooling on rack. Muffins freeze well.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken Dressing
instructions: Melt margarine and crumble cornbread. Mix all except chicken. Add chicken last. Cook dressing and chicken in crock pot on HIGH for 45 minutes. Stir and continue to cook on LOW for 4 hours.

title: Best Chili
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and celery. Add ground beef and saute until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain and add kidney beans. Add tomatoes and paste. Add garlic salt and chili powder. Cover and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Stir in some of the reserved liquid if you like and make to desired consistency.

title: Carolyn'S Bologna
instructions: Mix well. Shape into 4 rolls. Wrap in Saran Wrap; place in refrigerator for 24 hours. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Kolbasi And Sauerkraut
instructions: Bake kolbasi in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour in pan with water to cover. Thoroughly rinse and drain sauerkraut. Place in part with 2 whole onions and salt pork; add salt and pepper to taste. Add water to cover; simmer 45 minutes. When kolbasi is cooked drain and cut into 4-inch pieces. Add to sauerkraut and continue cooking for 30 minutes. Brown flour in bacon fat. When golden brown add to kolbasi and sauerkraut and mix thoroughly.

title: Mock Chicken Salad
instructions: Ingredients must be very finely chopped. Mix all together. Serve as a vegetable or cracker dip or wonderful as a small sandwich filling.

title: Fresh Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together in large bowl.

title: Four Day Coconut Cake(Gordon Robinson'S Favorite)
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to instructions. Bake two 9-inch layers. Let cool overnight. Then separate two layers into four layers.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring to a boil the sugar water Karo syrup and butter then add salt peanuts and continue to boil to 290\u00b0. Remove from heat sift in soda and vanilla and stir well. Pour thin onto buttered cookie sheet. When cold break into pieces. Put into tight container for keeping.

title: Artichoke Torte
instructions: Saute onions and parsley in oil from 2 jars of artichokes. Mix eggs cheese crackers salt pepper and Tabasco sauce until blended smooth. Mix with onions and parsley. Cut up artichokes and add to mixture. Grease an oblong baking dish and fill with mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Serve hot or cold as an appetizer or vegetable.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breast
instructions: Place each chicken breast half on a sheet of waxed paper; flatten to 1/2-inch thickness using a meat mallet. Chop ham and Swiss cheese; add minced parsley and pepper to ham and cheese. Mix well.

title: Broiled Shrimp And Scallops
instructions: In a large bowl combine oil garlic parsley bread crumbs salt and pepper. Add shrimp and scallops to mixture; mix well until coated. Let stand 1 hour.

title: Beef And Cabbage Soup
instructions: Brown meat in a 3-quart saucepot until it loses its red color; drain off fat. Add vegetables except green beans and corn hot chili beans tomatoes consomme water Worcestershire chili powder and spices. Cover and bring to boil; simmer 40 minutes so vegetables are tender and flavors mingle. Add thawed green beans and corn; simmer another 10 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole *
instructions: Cook squash and mash. Mix squash and melted margarine. Mix dry ingredients with squash and margarine. Beat eggs and Coffee Rich and pour into 1 1/2-quart greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Buckeye Candy
instructions: Mix sugar peanut butter vanilla and butter together and roll into small balls. Double boil chocolate chips and paraffin wax until both are melted. Put toothpicks in balls and dip in chocolate. Place on wax paper and dry. Chill then serve. Makes 60 Buckeyes approximately.

title: Skier'S Sausage
instructions: Brown sausage and cut each link in half. Drain well. Butter a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine meat and apples and put into casserole. Sprinkle with salt pepper lemon juice and sugar. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Pour over it. Let set up for at least an hour in refrigerator before eating it.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Combine all ingredients then fold in whipped cream. Sprinkle each cup with nutmeg.

title: Cream Caramelle
instructions: Put sugar in saucepan and melt at medium heat. Then pour it into an aluminum mold trying to cover all the sides of mold while sugar is hot. Let it cool. Mix rest of ingredients and pour into mold.

title: Turtle Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In small heavy saucepan over low heat melt caramels with 1/3 cup sweetened condensed milk. Spread evenly on bottom of prepared pastry shell. In medium saucepan over low heat melt chocolate with margarine. In large mixer bowl beat eggs with remaining sweetened condensed milk water vanilla and salt. Add chocolate mixture; mix well. Pour into prepared pastry shell. Top with pecans. Bake 35 minutes or until center is set. Cool; chill and refrigerate leftovers.

title: Easy Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in deep baking dish. Make batter of sugar flour salt baking powder and milk. Pour over melted butter. Do not stir. Pour fruit over top of batter. Do not stir. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Quick And Easy Low-Fat Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Stew chicken for about 1 hour; cool and separate into small pieces. (This can be done ahead of time and placed in the refrigerator.) Cut flour tortillas into strips and strips into small dumplings. Place tortillas into chicken broth and add chicken; simmer until liquid is absorbed. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately. Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Candy Pickles
instructions: Day 1 Peel 15 large cucumbers. Cut into 1/2-inch thick slices. Remove center for ring. Put in lime water (8 1/2 quarts water 2 cups lime). Let stand 24 hours. Stir occasionally as lime settles.

title: Shoney'S Style Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and water. Cook until thick. Stir in jello; cool completely. Pour over berries. Put in pie shell and top with whipped cream or Dream Whip.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Cook cake at 350\u00b0 until pulls away from edges.

title: My First Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together shape into loaf and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix water and 1/4 cup sugar then shake yeast on top and let stand while mixing other ingredients (dont stir yeast). Cream Crisco and 1/4 cup sugar. Then add well beaten egg whites to Crisco and sugar. Mix well yeast mixture with Crisco mixture then add enough of the flour for a thin batter. Mix with electric mixer. Work in the extra flour gradually (by hand). The dough should be stiff enough until it doesnt stick to floured board or hands.

title: Waldorf Chicken Sandwich
instructions: In a medium bowl combine all ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Serve on whole grain bread. Makes 3 servings.

title: Roasted Pepper Salad(12 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Place peppers on baking sheet and roast until skins are black and peppers are soft about 30 minutes. Let cool slightly. Peel off skin. Cut peppers in half and discard stem and seeds; slice peppers thinly. Transfer to large serving bowl (preferably glass).

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Brown butter and flour. Add onion celery and pepper. Saute until light brown. Add okra and cook until okra is not ropey. Stir often. Add tomatoes hot water bay leaves garlic and crab meat in that order. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add shrimp oysters green onions and parsley. Season to taste. Simmer 1 hour and serve over rice.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Place cut up chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix broth and soup. Pour over chicken. Melt margarine. Add to flour and buttermilk. Mix well and pour over chicken. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Combine Bisquick and eggs adding milk until smooth. Line casserole dish with meat. Pour Bisquick mixture over meat and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Mix sugar and melted oleo well. Add flour and eggs; mix well. Add vanilla and pecans and mix well. Pour in greased and floured pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from oven and cool completely before cutting into squares. Makes 24 cookies.

title: Mah-Fry Chicken(Chinese Chicken)
instructions: Marinate cut up chicken for 1 to 2 hours in sauce made from the sugar ginger powder garlic salt soy sauce funju and egg. Drain chicken; dip in flour and fry in deep fat.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Stir in yeast mixture oil and buttermilk. (If using shortening cut into dry ingredients to resemble coarse cornmeal before adding yeast mixture and buttermilk.) Keep dough in refrigerator up to two weeks.

title: No-Cook Chow-Chow
instructions: Chop first 4 ingredients fine; measure after chopping. Mix salt sugar and vinegar. Pour over chopped vegetables. Let stand 6 hours. Pour into small jars. Do not deep seal.

title: Baked Egg Cups
instructions: Cook bacon until done but not crisp. Generously grease 12 muffin or popover cups. Line sides with bacon. Combine crumbs with margarine. Place 1 tablespoon of crumbs in bottom of each cup. Carefully place 1 raw egg in each cup. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle remaining crumb mixture over eggs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until eggs reach stage you prefer.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Stir oil sugar pepper and vinegar together; let set 1/2 hour in refrigerator. Mix rest of ingredients and serve on a lettuce leaf. Put dressing on just before serving.

title: Barbecue In A Pocket
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Brown hamburger meat; drain. Mix in barbecue sauce; heat. Roll out crescent rolls using 4 to make square on baking sheet. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on rolled rolls and spoon meat to within 1 inch of edge. Sprinkle remaining cheese and cover with other 4 rolls. (Rolled and squared.) Seal edges and brown. Serve with favorite vegetable and garnish with fruit.

title: Grandma'S Bread Pudding
instructions: About 1 1/4 hours before serving grease 1-quart casserole; set aside. In medium bowl with wire whisk or fork beat milk sugar vanilla salt and eggs until well mixed; add bread raisins and butter. Toss until bread is well coated. Sprinkle mixture lightly with cinnamon. Bake in preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes until knife inserted in center of pudding comes out clean. If you like serve with half and half. Makes 4 servings.

title: One Rise Monkey Bread
instructions: Using solid shortening or margarine grease a 12-cup fluted tube pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon dill. Lightly spoon flour into a measuring cup and level off. In a large bowl blend 1 1/2 cups flour and the next 6 ingredients. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in the remaining 1 1/2 to 2 cups flour. On a floured surface knead dough until smooth about 1 minute. Press or roll to a 15 x 12-inch rectangle. Using a pastry wheel or sharp knife cut dough into diamond shape pieces by cutting 1 1/2 to 2-inch strips. Dip each piece in melted butter and layer in prepared pan. Sprinkle each layer with 1/2 teaspoon dill weed. Cover and let rise in a warm place until light and doubled in size (45 to 60 minutes). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until deep golden brown. Cool 2 minutes before turning out.

title: Keir'S Famous Horseshoes
instructions: Fry turkey in pan with butter until lightly browned. Toast bread in toaster. Fry fries until golden brown. Heat cheese sauce on top of stove. Combine ingredients in this order on each plate bread turkey cheese sauce fries paprika. Enjoy!

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: In crock-pot empty corn milk and slightly beaten eggs. Roll crackers into fine crumbs. Add to other ingredients and stir well. Cook on high heat one hour stirring every 15 minutes or until thick.

title: Patty Sue'S Candy Coated Popcorn
instructions: Note This will not work in microwave!

title: Cocktail Cheese Ball
instructions: Put all cheeses together; let stand until room temperature. Beat until real creamy. Add Worcestershire sauce and onion; beat until well blended. Put in refrigerator until set and able to handle. Shape into ball. Roll it in crushed pecans or walnuts. Refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Jeff'S Special Dip
instructions: Mix drained tuna cream cheese and mayonnaise to a creamy but fairly thick consistency. Add onion and 3 tablespoons horseradish sauce. Mix and add salt and pepper to taste; chill. Serve with crackers or fresh vegetables.

title: Sweet And Saucy Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat crumbs onion egg garlic salt and parsley. Shape into small balls and brown in skillet with shortening. Pour off fat. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over meatballs. Cover and let simmer over low heat stirring occasionally for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Add salt and pepper (a little of both). Pour in casserole dish. Slice 1/2 stick margarine over top. Just before baking cover with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Eggs Diane
instructions: Bake in 8 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes until not runny and light brown on top.

title: Kahlua Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter sugar vanilla and flour. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in Kahlua corn syrup evaporated milk and pecans. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 until firm about 40 minutes. Chill.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients together. Pour into containers or casserole dish and keep in freezer.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Heat the first 4 ingredients until shortening melts. Mix lukewarm water yeast and teaspoon of sugar; set aside until first mixture cools. In large mixer bowl beat eggs. Add both mixtures and 8 cups flour; mix well. Pour melted butter over top and refrigerate. This will keep several days.

title: Old Fashion Candied Yams
instructions: Peel and cut yams in quarters. Place in medium sauce pan. sprinkle with sugar and nutmeg. Add water butter salt and vanilla. Cook and simmer over medium heat until liquid forms a syrup.

title: Quick Garden Cheese Soup
instructions: In large kettle or Dutch oven cook celery and onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually add water then bouillon cubes pepper vegetables and hash browns. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover for 15 minutes. Add milk and cheese. Cook and stir until cheese melts and the soup is hot.

title: Funfetti Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl; mix oil cake mix and eggs. Stir by hand until thoroughly moistened. Stir in candy bits from cake mix. Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. With bottom of glass dipped in flour flatten to 1/4 inch thickness. Bake at 375 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until edges are light golden brown. Cool for 1 minute. Remove from cookie sheet. Spread frosting over warm cookies. Immediately sprinkle each with candy bits from frosting.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Cream margarine; gradually add sugar beating with electric mixer. Add one egg at a time beating after each one. Stir in mashed pumpkin and milk. Combine flour baking powder salt and spice and add to cream mixture stirring just until moistened then stir in raisins and pecans. Spoon into greased muffin pan 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 22 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Bundles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare apple slices with apple peeler/corer/slicer. Cut slices in half. Unroll dough; separate into 8 triangles. Cut each in half to make 16 triangle strips. Place 3 to 4 apples at the wide end of each strip and roll up. Arrange bundles in pan or clay baker. Zest one teaspoon orange rind; set aside. Juice orange; pour into pan or baker but not over bundles. Drizzle bundles with butter. Mix zest sugar and cinnamon; spoon over bundles. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm plain or with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Potato Slices Baked With Onion Butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine butter onion soup mix and salt. Pour water into a 2 quart casserole dish. Scrub potatoes and cut into 1/4-inch slices (do not peel). Arrange a layer of slices in casserole; spread with a tablespoon of onion mixture. Repeat making 5 layers. Cover and bake 45 minutes to an hour or until potatoes fork-tender.

title: Upside Down Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Meanwhile brown ground beef green pepper and onion; pour off fat. Blend in pizza sauce mushrooms garlic salt and oregano. Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. In a small bowl mix eggs milk oil salt and flour. Pour over sauce mix and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Yeast Biscuits To Freeze
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water. Let stand 5 minutes or until bubbly. Add buttermilk to yeast mixture and set aside.

title: Vegetarian Lasagne
instructions: Saute onion in oil until soft. Add carrots and mushrooms. Cook until crisp-tender. Stir in tomato sauce paste olives and oregano.

title: Plantation Chowder(Our Favorite Winter Soup)
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in 3 1/2 cups boiling water; pour mixture over dried corn in a large saucepan. Let stand to reconstitute 2 hours. Pour additional boiling water over onions and cover. Let stand to reconstitute 10 to 15 minutes. Drain.

title: Raisin Cake
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients. Boil 3 minutes. Let cool. Add flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bubble Coffeecake
instructions: Shape pieces of dough into 1 1/2-inch balls (about the size of walnuts). Mix sugars and spices in a bowl. Dip balls into butter and roll in sugar/spice mixture. Place 1 layer of balls in a well-greased 10-inch tube pan sides slightly touching. Sprinkle with some of the nuts. Top with another layer of balls placing them in the wells created by the first layer. Sprinkle with more nuts. Continue until pan is near two-thirds full. Allow space for it to rise again. Allow to rise about 35 minutes.

title: Oven Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Boil together the first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes. Take off heat and add the soda. Stir well. Pour over the popcorn with the peanuts added. Put in pan and bake 1 hour at 200\u00b0 stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Blend in flour and stir in broth and milk. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rolls
instructions: Warm 1/2 cup milk. Dissolve the sugar and shortening in the milk; add yeast. (If using dry yeast substitute 1/2 cup water for the milk when dissolving the yeast.) Add 2 cups of flour to the yeast mixture; let stand for 45 minutes. Add remainder of milk and enough flour to make a soft dough. Mix and refrigerate. Roll out dough and let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Make into rolls and bake in a moderate (350\u00b0) oven until nicely browned. The dough will keep in the refrigerator for about a week.

title: China Town Chicken With Zucchini
instructions: Cook rice as directed then mix in green onions. While rice is cooking saute chicken and garlic in oil until chicken is white. Add soy sauce and cook for 2 to 3 minutes stirring some. Add zucchini and water chestnuts. Cook until zucchini is crisp-tender (2 to 3 minutes). Add water-cornstarch mix and stir until thick and clear. Serve over rice-onion mixture.

title: Barbecue Sauce(For Pork, Ribs Or Chicken)
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer about 45 minutes or longer. Brush on prepared ribs. Broil about 10 minutes on each side.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add sugar; continue beating until stiff. Add rest of ingredients; mix well. Drop cookies by teaspoon onto ungreased foil. Place cookies in oven and immediately turn oven off. Leave cookies in closed oven overnight.

title: Ranch Style Dressing
instructions: Blend everything together in a blender. Taste best after 1 day so flavors may blend.

title: Four Layer Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake mix as directed on package in 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine and heat until smooth the pudding mix milk and softened cream cheese. Spread this mixture over cooled cake. Drain crushed pineapple and place over cream filling. Place whipped topping over top and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Apricot Pecan Chicken
instructions: Line small baking dish with foil. Place chicken skin side up (may also use skinless chicken). Spread jar or apricot preserves over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Baste every 20 minutes. Sprinkle with pecans before serving. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Drain oranges (save juice). Add enough water to juice to make 2 cups of liquid. Heat mixture. Add jello and dissolve. Mix in 1 pint orange sherbet. Add mandarin oranges. Chill.

title: Natural Pick-Me-Up Elixir
instructions: Mix together and drink one in the morning and one at night.

title: Microwave Bread Pudding
instructions: Layer bread cubes. Sprinkle with brown sugar and salt mixture. Add optional raisins cinnamon or vanilla in 8 x 8 pyrex or microwave dish.

title: Jeff Davis Pie
instructions: Soften oleo; cream with sugar and flour. Add eggs and vanilla. Sprinkle nutmeg on top after you put into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Strain berries. Sweeten to taste. Save a few for garnishing. Add lemon ice and ginger ale and serve. If you use frozen berries do not strain or sweeten.

title: Valley Coleslaw
instructions: Combine cabbage green pepper and onion in a large bowl. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil in a medium saucepan and pour over slaw while still hot. Toss and refrigerate for several hours or overnight for full flavor.

title: Apple-Oat Crumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place apple slices in an 8-inch square baking pan and sprinkle with orange rind and juice.

title: Monster Cookie
instructions: Beat eggs; cream with margarine and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet with an ice cream scoop for giant cookie. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. For smaller cookie drop by teaspoon and bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: *Cook for a short time in microwave with water and a pinch of sugar.

title: Porcupines In Tomato Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl combine all the ingredients and shape into 2-inch balls. In a large skillet cook meat until balls are brown on all sides; drain on paper towels to remove excess fats. Place in a deep baking dish 9 x 13 x 2-inch. Prepare Tomato Sauce.

title: Sourdough Starter
instructions: Mix and let set out overnight to sour. Refrigerate for 5 days. Feed to make bread.

title: Bourbon Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Roll into small balls then roll in powdered sugar. Put in airtight bag or bowl. Before serving roll again in powdered sugar.

title: Cornflake Chip Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo and shortening; cream with sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift flour soda and baking powder. Stir in oats cornflakes coconut raisins chocolate chips and nuts. Batter will be stiff. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 8 dozen 2 or 3-inch cookies.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Heat vinegar sugar oil and salt over low burner until sugar is dissolved. Pour over drained vegetables. Let stand overnight. The amount of onions and celery is your preference. This salad keeps well in the refrigerator.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes and onions in water until tender. Add both cans of soup and cheese. Heat until desired temperature and serve.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain fat. Add tomato sauce and simmer. Cook shells according to package directions. Drain. Chop 1 cup Cheddar cheese and add to shells.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Butter both sides of bread and place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan or glass casserole dish. Brown sausage and drain. Spoon sausage over bread and sprinkle cheese over top. Combine eggs half and half and salt. Mix well and pour over cheese. Cover and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mom'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat jello and pineapple until jello dissolves. Cool slightly. Add buttermilk and other ingredients. Refrigerate several hours and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Dice squash and onion and steam until tender. Drain excess water. Mix squash soup sour cream and almonds. Spread evenly into casserole dish. Sprinkle dressing mix over top and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until topping is brown.

title: Creamed Turkey In Pastry Shell
instructions: In medium saucepan melt 2 Tbsp. of margarine. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat about 3 minutes or until tender. Remove mushrooms leaving juices in pan. Stir in cornstarch. Gradually stir in milk. Add remaining margarine salt pepper and onion salt. Stirring constantly bring to a boil over medium heat and boil for 1 minute. Stir in turkey and mushrooms until well mixed. Serve in puff pastry shells. Makes 6 servings.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix together well sugar Crisco eggs cocoa baking powder salt vanilla and syrup and add flour. Mix well and bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Saute onion garlic and mushrooms in margarine. Add soups and tomatoes. Heat. Add sour cream. Layer crushed Doritos chicken sauce and cheese alternately 2 layers each. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Citrus Sunshine Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl. Stir until blended. Serve immediately. Makes 16 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Zinger Cake
instructions: Bottom Layer Cut Zingers in half and place in 9 x 13-inch pan filling side up.

title: Cabbage Bean Soup
instructions: Salt and pepper ground chuck and brown in soup pot. Drain meat well. Cut cabbage into small strips and combine with meat and tomatoes. Add enough water to cover ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste. Add Accent sugar and chili powder. Cook until cabbage is tender.

title: Vanilla Butter Frosting
instructions: Mix powdered sugar and oleo; stir in vanilla and milk. Beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and water together and cook until thick. Add Jell-O and cool. Line baked pie crust/shell with raw fresh strawberries. Pour cooled mixture over strawberries. When ready to serve cover with Cool Whip.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Fry green peppers and onions in a small amount of oil until peppers start to change color. Crumble hamburger over peppers and cook until done. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in bowl. Bring to boil butter cocoa and cola. Add to flour and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dip chicken in eggs and roll in bread crumbs. Brown until partially cooked (light brown). Place in casserole dish. Pour tomato sauce and spice mixture over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Take from oven and spread with Mozzarella.

title: Hot Shrimp Salad Casserole
instructions: Combine shrimp celery water chestnuts eggs and onion. Blend mayonnaise lemon juice salt and pepper; stir into shrimp mixture. Place in greased casserole. Top with cheese and potato chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs milk onion and seasoned salt. Tear ham into small pieces; add egg mixture. Stir in cheese. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sailburg Steaks
instructions: Mix ingredients (except mushroom soup) together and form into patties. Brown and drain grease. Add cream of mushroom soup; simmer for 1/2 hour on each side. Serve over rice or noodles. Yields 4 servings.

title: Amish Rhubarb Bread
instructions: In a bowl blend all ingredients together. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 8 x 4-inch loaf pans. In a small bowl mix together 1/2 cup sugar (either white or brown) and 1 tablespoon butter or margarine. Sprinkle the mixture over unbaked bread. Bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes or until firm to touch.

title: Brown Sugar Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: 5 Layer Dinner
instructions: Layer in casserole in the order given. Salt and pepper each layer. More tomatoes may be added if needed. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Chill.

title: Supper Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Add salt pepper about 1 tablespoon garlic and onion; cook until done. Cook instant mashed potatoes (usually the serving for 8 is enough). Place ground meat at the bottom of a casserole. Be sure it is tall enough to layer. Layer the mushroom soup (do not add milk) on top of ground beef. Next layer green beans. On top layer mashed potatoes. Cover and bake 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 6.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in 1 tablespoon of oil. Blend meat tomato sauce beaten eggs bread crumbs and A.1. sauce thoroughly. Fold in diced Velveeta cheese and shape into loaf. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Maine Baked Beans
instructions: Wash beans and soak overnight. Need large bowl as beans will swell. Next morning place drained beans in crock-pot. Bury onion and score salt pork (make gashes in it). In beans add salt pepper dry mustard and molasses. (Be careful not to add too much molasses as will make beans hard.) Cover with boiling water and cook on high in crock-pot all day.

title: Hummingbird Cakeroswell, New Mexico
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl. Add remaining and stir until well mixed. Do not beat.

title: Chick'S Appetizer
instructions: Open and spread out uncooked rolls to cover a jelly roll pan. Bake it for about 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise and onion and spread on cooled base. Cover with chopped vegetables and press down on cheese mixture. Cut into squares about 1 1/2-inches wide and enjoy!

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese peanut butter sugar and milk. Mix until smooth and add one 8 ounce container Cool Whip. Freeze covered for 5 to 6 hours. Can be drizzle with chocolate before serving.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Bring coffee sugar and water to a boil. Boil slowly for 10 minutes. Cool and add vodka. Place mixture in two one-quart bottles and add 1/2 vanilla bean to each bottle. Seal bottles (tape will do) and store in a cool dark place for two to four weeks. Gently agitate daily.

title: Hamburger Bean Bake Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cook beef and onion; drain fat. Add salt pepper beans and soup. Heat to boiling. Place in a baking dish. Mix Bisquick with water. Roll and lay like lattice on top of mixture. Bake until Bisquick is brown.

title: Squash Pickles
