instructions: Slice squash in round portions. Add onions green peppers red peppers and garlic. Sprinkle with salt. Cover with 2 trays of ice and let set 3 hours. Drain real good. On stove heat the vinegar sugar celery seed mustard seed and turmeric. Add drained squash. Boil about 10 minutes. Seal in hot jars.

title: Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Blend cream cheese and 2 tablespoons butter until smooth. Add next 6 ingredients and mix well.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: In top of double boiler combine sugar salt and flour. Mix well. Gradually add milk. Mix well. Place over rapidly boiling water stirring until mixture coats spoon. Pour a little of the hot mixture into beaten egg yolks beating constantly. Add egg yolks to hot mixture in double boiler. Stir in rice and raisins; cook 2 minutes. Add vanilla. Put into baking dish.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Blend in one can tomato soup. Sift together all dry ingredients and add with raisins and nuts. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan or until done.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain off all grease. Add rest of ingredients and cook until cheese is melted. This can be baked or made in the electric skillet or on top of the stove. Add tomato juice as needed to make casserole creamy.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and baking soda. Add remaining ingredients. Combine well but do not beat. Turn batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Instead of doing drop cookies I put it all in my cookie pan with sides on it and cook it all in pan and cut a bar. Mix all ingredients well and pour in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0. Keep watching to be sure it does not overcook. Let it cool for a while before you try to cut them out. Glaze with 10x sugar mixed with lemon or orange juice.

title: Olive Balls
instructions: Mix cream cheese and butter in food processor. Blend in flour cayenne pepper and paprika. Wrap 1 teaspoon dough around each olive covering completely. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake for 20 minutes or until browned on top at 350\u00b0.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad
instructions: Place broth and rice in saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cool. Stir together with remaining ingredients and chill. Serve on lettuce leaf. Garnish with additional olive slices.

title: Winter Gingersnaps
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Butterfinger Torte
instructions: Beat together the first 4 ingredients. Whip the cream and fold into the mixture. Tear into pieces the cake and put 1/2 of it in a 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Put 1/2 of the mixture over the cake pieces. Put 3 large Butterfingers in food processor and break up. Sprinkle the candy on the cake and filling. Repeat the layering process using another 3 candy bars. Sprinkle with chopped nuts if you desire. Best when made the day before. Enjoy!

title: Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Put egg yolks with 1/3 of the butter in the top of a double boiler. Keep water in bottom of pot hot but not boiling. Stir the mixture constantly. When butter melts add another portion and as it melts and the mixture begins to thicken add the rest of the butter stirring all the time. As soon as the mixture is thick remove from heat and add seasonings. This sauce is delicious served over vegetables.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate or freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Melt cheese; stir in bean-bacon soup sour cream and onions. Cover and store in refrigerator. If you like hot dip add 2 jalapeno peppers chopped finely.

title: Jeff Davis Pie
instructions: Mix and pour in pie shell bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Then turn temperature down to 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes until top is brown.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops and place in baking dish. Slice onion over the top. Mash up tomatoes and add salt and pepper. Pour over the top of chops and onions. Cover dish and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve over rice.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour cocoa sugar soda and salt. Add other ingredients and mix well. Bake in square pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Ice with favorite icing when cool.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve the jello in the boiling water. Add the ice cubes cranberry sauce bananas apples and nuts. Mix and chill. Delicious and easy!

title: Whole Wheat Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Combine wet ingredients. Quickly fold together until flour is moistened. Spoon into greased muffin tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yields 1 dozen.

title: Cheesy Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Shape into small balls (1-inch). Place on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve in chafing dish to keep warm.

title: Pasta Con Broccoli
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Stir in garlic and mushrooms. Saute a few minutes. Turn heat down to low; stir in whipping cream Parmesan cheese and 1/2 of tomato sauce. Simmer a few minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in broccoli. Pour over half of noodles then add rest of noodles while stirring. (Do not soak up all of juice with noodles; it will get dry later.)

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to make tea; use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

title: Chocolate Cobbler
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients and pour into a greased 8-inch square glass baking dish. Mix together the next two ingredients and sprinkle over batter. Do not mix these two layers together. Pour 1 1/2 cup hot water over all this in pan. DO NOT STIR. Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or by itself.

title: Two-Minute Microwave Fudge
instructions: In microwave pan sift together sugar and cocoa. Pour in milk as to puddle. Lay on this the oleo. Do not stir! Cook on High for 2 minutes. Take out beat and add nuts.

title: Bacon Roll-Ups
instructions: Cut each biscuit into fourths. Flatten and spread with a dollop of mushroom soup. Roll up with 1/3 slices of bacon on outside. Secure with toothpick. Bake at 325\u00b0\u00b0 until bacon is done. Yields 120.

title: Mini Pizza Snacks
instructions: Arrange muffins on paper plates. Spread with spaghetti sauce. Top with cheese and sprinkle with oregano. Cook 2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Can put topping on this if preferred.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray an 8 inch square baking pan with Pam or Bakers Joy.

title: Persimmon Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat eggs pulp and liquid. Mix other ingredients. Add nuts and raisins. Beat well. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the first 6 ingredients until fluffy. When beaten together add eggs one at a time and vanilla. Pour into tube pan. Line bottom with wax paper and flour. Put in cold oven. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pasta Bolognese
instructions: In a skillet saute ground beef in 1 tablespoon oil until meat loses its pinkness then transfer to a pan. Peel and chop onion then dice celery and carrot. Chop ham into small pieces and saute in remaining oil with onion celery and carrot. Transfer to pan with ground meat and combine all. Add water tomatoes or tomato puree garlic salt pepper and thyme. Cover and cook for about 20 minutes then add the wine or chicken broth and cook for a few more minutes.

title: Spanish Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 2 frying pans cook bacon and ground beef separately. When the hamburger is cooked put in the onion. When the bacon is done cooking put in the green pepper. Put it on low heat. Put the cooked rice in a large mixing bowl mix the hamburger bacon onion and green pepper. Mix in the tomato sauce chili powder salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly and put in a 13 x 9 inch casserole pan. Make sure to spray cooking spray in casserole pan. Top with shredded cheddar cheese. Cover with foil. Bake 45 to 55 minutes until cheese is golden brown.

title: Wedding Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients\texcept nuts with blender. Add nuts (may need\tto use hands). Mold\tinto round shapes and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 until light brown. Roll in powdered sugar while hot.

title: Easy Classic Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook lasagna noodles as package directs. In bowl combine Ricotta Parmesan cheese and eggs; mix well. On bottom of a 15 x 9-inch greased baking dish spread 1/2 cup pasta sauce. Top with half each of the lasagna noodles Ricotta cheese mixture sausage pasta sauce and Mozzarella. Repeat layers. Top with parsley. Cover; bake 1 hour or until hot and bubbly. Uncover; let stand for 15 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients except jalapenos and simmer until excess liquid is reduced. Add jalapenos and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes the longer you simmer the hotter the salsa. Serve chilled. Pass the chips.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Combine onions garlic bay leaf red pepper tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce pepper sauce and beans in a large saucepan or Dutch oven. Bring to a boil. Reduce cover and simmer 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Serve over hot rice. Serve with hot pepper sauce if desired.

title: Beef And Potato Bake
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Add onion. Place beef and onions in a 9-inch baking dish. Add layer of Tater Tots covering beef. Spread soup over evenly and top with grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until Tater Tots are done.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut round steak into pieces. Trim fat. Roll in flour salt and pepper. Lightly brown in pan. Chop onion and then saute them. Add tomato soup plus a can of water and stir. Add meat. Cover and simmer 2 hours. Stir once in awhile.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Mix and simmer burger garlic salt basil salt stewed tomatoes and tomato paste. Cook noodles according to package instructions. Mix cottage cheese Parmesan cheese parsley flakes and salt. Layer in a greased pan. Layer noodles cottage cheese mixture shredded cheeses and meat sauce in 3 layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Spiced Carrots(4 To 6 Servings)
instructions: Cook carrots 5 minutes; drain. Cut in strips or lengths or whatever size you want I guess. I just left the baby carrots as they were. Combine other ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Strain liquid over carrots. Refrigerate 8 hours or more. Drain well and serve.

title: Cucumber Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients and serve as dip.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time. Add soda to flour. Add to butter mixture alternating with sour cream. Beat egg whites stiff and fold in.

title: Quick Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook Rice-A-Roni as directed except cut cooking time in half. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. If dry add a little milk.

title: Extra Special Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs; cover with cold water and let cool. Crack peel and halve eggs. Mix yolks and other ingredients. Fill egg halves. Garnish with paprika.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix hamburger meat flakes eggs salt pepper soy sauce garlic powder catsup and onion all together well. Make in 1 1/4-inch balls. Place on 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0; drain fat.

title: Oh-So Creamy Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan stirring until melted. Remove from heat and add rest of ingredients. Stir until mixture is well mixed and creamy smooth (about 1 or 2 minutes). Put into a greased pan and let set. Enjoy!

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Mix margarine with eggs. Add rest of ingredients. Pour into casserole dish (greased). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until done (lightly brown).

title: Jane'S Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind peppers and cover with boiling water. Let stand 15 minutes. Drain. Add sugar salt and vinegar. Simmer 30 minutes and can. Makes 6 to 8 pints.

title: Peppy Pizza Pasta
instructions: Brown sausage and onion; drain. In bowl combine all the ingredients except cheese. Pour into 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until cheese melts.

title: Black-Eyed Peas Salsa
instructions: Place peas in a colander rinse with cold water and drain. Combine tomatoes and next 7 ingredients in a medium bowl; stir in peas. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Place in a lettuce lined compote or bowl. Serve with tortilla chips. Yield 2 1/2 cups.

title: West Texas Tortilla Soup
instructions: Cook garlic in butter in large saucepan 2 minutes. Add cumin; cook and stir 1 minute. Add broth tomatoes picante and bring to boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 30 minutes. Remove from heat stir in cilantro. Place 1/4 cup of cheese in bottom of 8 soup bowls. Ladle 1 cup soup over cheese; top with tortilla strips. Makes 8 servings.

title: Soda Cracker Bars
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar and evaporated milk. Bring to a boil over medium heat and boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter to sugar mixture mix well. Add coconut and crushed crackers stir well. Cool slightly. Press mixture into a lightly buttered 8 x 8 inch glass baking dish. refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Cut into small squares.

title: Southern Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Simmer chicken until tender in about 2 quarts water salted to taste. Cut Crisco into flour; add egg then water 1 tablespoon at a time as needed. Mix well. Place on floured board and roll as for pastry shell. Let rest covered with kitchen towel for about 30 minutes. Cut in strips and drop into boiling broth with chicken. Cook for about 12 minutes or until done.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Arrange in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch dish. Layer chicken atop. Combine next 3 ingredients and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Meltaways
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together like for pie crust until crumbly. Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Beat eggs and stir in next 3 ingredients until well blended. Pour over hot crust. Return to oven and bake 20 minutes more. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place sheets of foil on countertop for cooling cookies. Combine shortening peanut butter brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Add egg. Beat just until blended.

title: Mushroom Turnovers
instructions: Mix cheese and butter thoroughly. Add flour and work in well until smooth. Chill at least 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large pan cook meat until tender 2 to 3 hours. When cool cut up meat in small pieces. Add back to broth the meat potatoes carrots and onion and cook until tender. Add peas corn and tomatoes. Cook on low heat for about 30 minutes. Use salt and pepper as you like. You can use some tomato juice if soup gets too thick. Left over beef roast makes good soup too.

title: Orange Honey
instructions: In a heavy medium saucepan on low heat warm the jar of marmalade and cornstarch; stir constantly. Bring to a boil about 1 minute until thickened. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: With rolling pin crush saltines to make fine crumbs. Combine meat saltine crumbs eggs 1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce black pepper and garlic. Add chopped onion bell pepper and tomato (save some for topping later). Mix thoroughly. Form into loaf shape and place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Pour remaining Worcestershire sauce over meat loaf and pepper lightly. Bake uncovered in a 400\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Turn oven down to about 325\u00b0 and bake for one to one hour and 15 minutes. Thirty minutes before meat loaf is done top with reserved onion pepper and tomato. Fifteen minutes before meat loaf is done pour a can of tomato sauce (or Italian style tomatoes) over meat loaf. Cook uncovered the last 15 minutes. Then enjoy!

title: Date Cake
instructions: Combine dates with water; cool to room temperature. Cream shortening and sugar until light. Add vanilla and egg; beat well. Sift flour soda and salt together; add to creamed mixture alternately with date mixture beating. Stir in nuts. Bake in greased and lightly floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan at 350\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Tarragon Chicken
instructions: Slice chicken in strips no larger than 2 1/2 x 1/2-inch. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper; let stand 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cornstarch and oil; turn to mix and let stand 20 minutes. Mix in egg whites and let stand 30 minutes. In a large skillet over medium high heat saute chicken in butter just until opaque throughout and a little golden about 5 minutes. Remove chicken with slotted spoon and keep warm. Add tomato vinegar cream and tarragon to pan. Increase heat to high and stir until mixture is blended and consistency of heavy cream. Put chicken back in pan with half the parsley and turn gently to mix. Heat through. Correct seasoning with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with remaining parsley. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Grandma Benson'S Coffee Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup milk. Mix remaining milk sugar egg salt butter and cardamom in a large bowl. Add a small amount of the flour and mix well. Add yeast and remaining flour beating with a wooden spoon until dough is smooth and firm. Sprinkle dough with a bit of flour; cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk about 2 hours. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Apricot Nectar Sheet Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in large bowl and beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased pan about 9 x 11-inches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hearty Chili
instructions: Cook and stir green pepper onions and garlic in 1 tablespoon oil in Dutch oven over medium heat until onions are tender about 5 minutes. Remove from Dutch oven.

title: Lime Torte
instructions: Chill Milnot overnight in refrigerator. Juice 2 lemons and grate 1/2 of 1 lemon. Set the jello and water in refrigerator until \soupy.\ Add sugar and coloring to lemon juice. Add jello and whipped Milnot. Roll crumbs and put in pan (line the bottoms and sides). Pour jello mixture in and sprinkle some of the crumbs on top. Set in refrigerator until firm.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Mix brown sugar oil and egg. Add rhubarb and sour milk; then add flour salt soda and walnuts.

title: Maple Syrup
instructions: Combine sugars and water. Dissolve while bringing to a boil by stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; cool and add flavoring. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Pears Preserve Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and beat. Add vanilla allspice and flour. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add dry ingredients. Fold in preserves and add pecans. Pour into tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan according to package directions. When cake is done and out of the oven poke holes all over the top of the cake. Stir jello into boiling water until dissolved; spoon jello mixture over cake and refrigerate until jello sets. Then cover with Cool Whip and refrigerate until serving.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
instructions: Blend shortening and oleo together in large mixing bowl on medium speed. Gradually add sugar. Beat until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat well. Sift flour and soda. Add gradually to mixture alternating with buttermilk. Begin and end with flour. Add coconut. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into batter. Pour into 3 greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Garlic Grits
instructions: Boil water rapidly. Add grits and salt. Stir in margarine and cheese while grits are cooking. Remove from stove. Beat 2 eggs in measuring cup. Add enough milk to make 1 cup. Combine with grit mixture. Put in casserole. Top with corn flake crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with dinner or burgers.

title: Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook chicken breast and cut into cubes. Cook pasta. Bring chicken broth water cream and butter to a boil. Stir in pasta. Cook for 5 minutes. Stir in broccoli bell pepper and carrots. Return to a boil and continue cooking for 2 minutes. Let stand for 8 to 10 minutes for sauce to thicken. Top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Black Bean & Corn Salsa
instructions: Serve as dip or as a dressing over lettuce (use sparingly).

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Pour cherries and juice into saucepan. Bring to a boil add sugar and Jell-O; stir until dissolved. Remove from heat and chill until partially jelled. Fold in Jell-O and nuts.

title: Tasty Baked Salmon
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Drain and flake salmon and place in a 9-inch baking dish. Pour sour cream all over. Cover with buttered bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. May be served with lemon. Serves 4.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add soup and meat together in a casserole dish. Top with Tater Tots. Bake according to Tater Tots directions. Shred Cheddar cheese on top and bake until cheese is melted.

title: Smokey'S Campfire Stew
instructions: Brown beef; add onion and cook until transparent. Add corn baked beans and barbecue sauce. Heat thoroughly. Serve as a stew or as a topping for baked potatoes. (This is best over a campfire but does well on the stove.)

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Put in casserole. Put crushed Ritz crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cousin Judy'S Cassola Salad
instructions: In a large saucepan add sugar flour and salt. Stir in pineapple juice and eggs. Cook over medium heat; stir until thick. Add lemon juice and cool to room temperature. Add mixture to acini de pepe. Let sit an hour. Add remaining ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Pumpkin-Mince Pie
instructions: Combine pumpkin sugar spice salt eggs and milk; heat until smooth. Spread mincemeat evenly over pie shell. Ladle pumpkin mixture carefully over mincemeat. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 300\u00b0 about 45 minutes until filling is firm in center.

title: Easy Potato Salad
instructions: Add potatoes to 1 quart boiling water. Return to boil. Cover and cook 2 minutes or until tender. Drain. Add remaining ingredients to potatoes and mix well. Season. Refrigerate.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Pop the corn; remove those that didnt pop. Melt marshmallows and butter. Add food coloring if desired. Pour over popcorn. Shape into balls. May wrap in plastic wrap and tie with colored ribbon for Christmas.

title: Cabbage And Noodle Dish
instructions: Peel and thinly slice onion. You should have about 4 cups. Melt butter in a large skillet. When it is hot stir in onion cabbage sugar salt and pepper. Cook over very low heat stirring occasionally for 15 to 20 minutes or until onion and cabbage are softened. Cook noodles as package directs. Drain. Sprinkle cabbage with a few drops vinegar to taste and toss to combine. Add noodles to skillet and continue to cook until blended and all is heated through. Serve.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and garlic. Pour off grease. Add tomato paste and tomatoes salt pepper and oregano. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cook noodles as directed on package. Alternate layer of meat sauce noodles and cheese in baking dish; beginning and ending with meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Cheese Knots
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Coarsely crush Rice Krispies. Melt margarine in small pan. Remove from heat and stir in Rice Krispies and cheese. Separate biscuits and cut each in half. Press each half in butter cheese and cereal mixture. With hands roll biscuit pieces into 8-inch stick. Gently tie to form a knot. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 6 to 8 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Aunt Winona'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Whip and chill cream cheese and sour cream. After chilled mix in remaining ingredients. Chill overnight.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: If you wish you may add some fine chopped green onion and green pepper. Oil a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover bottom with cubed bread. Fry the sausage; drain. Sprinkle over the bread. Layer the cheese and mushrooms (green peppers onions). Combine seasonings and milk with slightly beaten eggs. Pour over bread and sausage cheese mixture and refrigerate overnight. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Put 2 quarts salted water on to boil spaghetti. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash and slice mushrooms.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix pancake syrup and soy sauce. Pour over chicken. Cover pan with foil. Set in oven at 350\u00b0. Let chicken cook really good. When cooked remove sauce and foil. Let chicken dry under broiler. Cooking time is about 1 1/2 hours. Chicken is very tasty. Enjoy!

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spoon in casserole dish. You can sprinkle bread crumbs on top if desired. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake for about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Mix hot water sugar salt and butter together. Cool to lukewarm. Pour warm water in large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast. Stir until dissolved. Stir in lukewarm water mixture egg and 1/2 flour. Beat with mixer until smooth. Stir in by hand the remaining dough to make soft dough. Turn out on lightly floured surface and knead until smooth.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Pour in casserole dish.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish stir in sugar and corn syrup. Place in microwave for 4 minutes on High then stir in peanuts and microwave for 4 minutes. Then add butter and vanilla to mix blending well. Then microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. Then add baking soda; stir until foamy.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Pour pie filling in a greased 10 x 8-inch pan. Add pineapple. Spread in a layer. Sprinkle cake mix. Spoon melted butter over mix. Sprinkle coconut and nuts over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crab Melt
instructions: Melt butter and cheese over low heat; add lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and garlic salt; mix well. Process in blender until smooth. In bowl fold in crabmeat and pimientos; mix well. Slice bread into 1/2-inch slices and spread on crabmeat mixture. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve immediately. Makes 20 slices.

title: Real Lemon Cookies
instructions: Remove zest from lemon and chop. Squeeze and reserve juice. Grind oats in food processor to meal consistency. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line cookie sheets with foil. Cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add egg and lemon extract; mix well. Add combined flour baking soda and salt; mix well. Add lemon zest and juice; mix. Fold in ground oats. Drop by tablespoons onto prepared pans. Bake 10 minutes; rotate trays switch shelves and bake 10 more minutes. Cool.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Saute onion in oleo. Mix all ingredients and place in 2-quart casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend 1/2 minute or until ice is crushed. Serves 4.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Cream first 5 ingredients. Add salt soda flour rhubarb and nuts. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar and butter over the top. Bake in a greased and floured bread pan.

title: Cranberry Salad Mold
instructions: Wash drain and remove stems from cranberries. Put through food chopper. Add sugar. Let stand 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Sprinkle gelatin over orange juice and stir until dissolved over low heat. Combine gelatin mix celery apples and nuts with cranberries mixing well. Put in a 1-quart mold and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours. Serve with mayonnaise or whipped cream.

title: Golden Macaroons
instructions: In a large bowl combine flaked and shredded coconut until evenly mixed. (Flaked coconut should be broken into separate flakes with only a few very small clumps present.) In a medium mixing bowl combine sugar flour and salt. Add egg whites honey and vanilla. Whisk rapidly until smooth. Pour sugar and egg white mixture over coconut mixture. Stir with a wooden spoon then use hands and continue to blend until evenly mixed. Cover with plastic wrap; chill for 30 minutes.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: In medium bowl combine cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Blend in mayonnaise Worcestershire sauce celery salt and garlic salt. Stir in olives and onions. Cover; chill 2 to 3 hours for flavors to blend. When ready to serve shape cheese mixture into ball. Roll in pecans to coat. Serve with crackers. Makes 12 servings.

title: Shrimp Gumbo(Copied From New Orleans Recipe)
instructions: Saute okra in oil for 10 minutes. Add shrimp onions garlic and pepper. Cook about 5 minutes. Add water tomatoes and bay leaves. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove bay leaves and sprinkle in Tabasco. Place 1/4 cup cooked rice in each of 6 soup bowls. Fill with gumbo and serve (about 260 calories per serving).

title: Spicy Corn Casserole
instructions: In saucepan saute onion in margarine until tender. Add remaining ingredients mixing well. Transfer to a glass baking dish and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight. Put in cold oven and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Yields 8 servings. Great because it can be made ahead of time.

title: London Broil
instructions: Brown garlic in oil. Add other ingredients. Place pierced London broil in glass dish. Pour marinade over and cover. Marinate 24 hours turn once. Grill basting with marinade while cooking.

title: Pearly Gate Cake
instructions: Blend shortenin n sugah wid mixer. Sift flour bakin powder n salt 3 times. Now alternately add flour mixture n watah (2 tablespoons at a time) to the sugah mixture...add 1/2 uv aig whites...keep on puttin in flour n watah til all gone...now add remaining aig whites n extracts...mix n pore in three 9-inch layer pans...bake at 325\u00b0 fur 25 to 30 minutes...Cool n frost wid divinity icin.

title: Fat Free Chocolate Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan stir together sugar cocoa and cornstarch. Add milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Makes 1 cup.

title: Pumpkin Dip
instructions: Combine confectioners sugar and cream cheese in mixer bowl; beat until well blended. Add cinnamon ginger and pumpkin pie filling; mix well. Chill until serving time. Slice off top of pumpkin. Cut out center leaving shell. Place cold dip in pumpkin shell. Serve with gingersnaps.

title: Fr. Fischer'S Venison Stew
instructions: In a bowl coat the meat with flour. In large pot brown meat in oil. Add salt pepper onions celery bay leaf stewed tomatoes and water. Simmer until meat is tender about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Take bay leaf out. Add potatoes and carrots; cover and cook until all vegetables are tender about 25 minutes. Mix the cornstarch with 1/4 cup water; stir into stew and heat until it thickens stirring constantly.

title: Lemon Lime Nut Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-Os; add boiling water and mix. Add cottage cheese pineapple milk and walnuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Mile High Pie
instructions: Combine strawberries sugar lemon juice and egg whites in large bowl. Beat for 15 minutes or until very stiff. Fold in Cool Whip or whipping cream and vanilla. Spoon into pie shell. Freeze until firm. Serves 8. If using 2 pie shells the pie will not be as high.

title: Homemade Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix and put in ice cream freezer.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Arrange whole graham crackers closely in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix vanilla instant pudding and milk together. Pour over graham crackers. Chop the bananas up into bite size pieces onto pudding. Spread Cool Whip over the bananas. Spoon crushed pineapple onto Cool Whip. Arrange kiwi slices sliced strawberries or cherries and blueberries on top. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Fiesta Tamale Pie
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in butter and oil until onion is yellow. Add meat. Cook until brown.

title: Beef Cubes In Sour Cream
instructions: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes; roll in flour. Brown on all sides in a large skillet with a small amount of oil. Combine onions sour cream cheese and salt with 1/2 cup water and pour over the beef. Simmer covered for 1 3/4 hours or until beef is tender.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter Crisco and add sugar. Mix. Add sour cream. Mix. Sift flour adding the soda to the last cup. Alternate adding eggs and flour until all used. Add vanilla. Mix. Pour half of batter into prepared tube pan. Mix together the 2 tablespoons sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter and swirl through batter with knife. Pour remaining batter on top and bake in preheated oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour until particles are like fine crumbs. Add milk and stir with fork until dough leaves sides of bowl. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead just until smooth. Roll dough into large rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle fruit over dough. Roll up dough like a jelly roll. Slice dough into 16 slices 1/2-inch thick. Place in pan. Pour sugar syrup over rolls. Bake 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Easy Mexican Bread
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; drain and season the meat the way you like it. Mix the corn bread mix egg milk and corn until well blended. Grease a small skillet. Sprinkle with hamburger meat in skillet then cheese. Top with corn bread mix. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: This is an old-style praline not the creamy type found in New Orleans.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Salt pepper and butter chicken. Place in large covered baking dish. Pour in water. Cook on 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove chicken after cooking. Mix rice soup and broth in pan. Place chicken on top and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Sift first four ingredients together. Cream shortening and both sugars together until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat 1 minute at high speed. At low speed add nuts and then dry mixture; mix until well blended. Press and shape dough into 3 loaves 2-inches square and 5-inches long; wrap in Saran and chill at least 4 hours. (Keeps 2 weeks in refrigerator).

title: Butter Roll
instructions: For biscuits measure flour baking powder and salt into bowl. Cut in shortening thoroughly until mixture looks like meal. Stir in almost all the milk. If dough is not pliable add just enough milk to make a soft puffy easy to roll dough. Dust a rolling pin and rolling surface with flour. Pinch off a ball of dough larger than a golf ball but smaller than a tennis ball and roll it thin as you would a pie crust. Place 3 scant tablespoons of sugar in a strip across the center of the doughs circle. Place 3 pats of butter on top of the sugar; then sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon vanilla 1/4 teaspoon of nutmeg. Fold dough gently over the butter and sugar mixture and close the ends to seal. Place rolls seam sides down in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour warm milk or water over rolls and bake at 375\u00b0 until rolls are browned and sauce is thick.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together milk sour cream and pudding mix. Layer bananas and creamed mixture. Place in baked pie crust and chill. Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Fry meat about 10 minutes and drain. In separate bowl mix corn meal salt soda eggs and milk; add corn and mix well. Pour 1/2 of the batter into a pan; add meat onion pepper and cheese; next add the remaining batter over the meat mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Stuffed Bread
instructions: Brown sausage in pan. Pour off grease. Cook spinach until dry. Mix sausage spinach and cheese together. Cut bread lengthwise. Scrape out middle leaving crust. Put ingredients in bread crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (Wrap in foil before baking.) Let bread stand in foil 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Joan'S Pound Cake
instructions: Using an electric mixer blend eggs sugar and butter until fluffy and creamy. Sift flour four times. Blend in with ingredients. Beat until creamy; gradually add the milk. Now add your extracts. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake until cake tests done (60 minutes) at 350\u00b0.

title: Spa Soup
instructions: Cut up cabbage celery onions peppers and put in large pan (Dutch oven size).\tAdd 1 qt. water and simmer until vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes and cool. Store in refrigerator. Heat a bowl of soup anytime you feel hungry.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix beaten eggs butter flour sugar and milk. Blend in corn. Bake in open casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Stir a couple of times while baking. This may be topped with bread crumbs. Butter the casserole before baking.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into store bought or homemade pie shells. Cook until done at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in microwave or on stove. Saute onion and margarine then add soup sour cream about 6 ounces of cheese and heat slowly until mixed. Peel and layer potatoes in 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour sauce prepared over potatoes and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 30 to 45 minutes until heated through. Put rest of cheese on top for about the last 10 minutes. You can make 1/2 of this recipe.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Toss apples with lemon juice in a small bowl. Arrange apples in overlapping circles in a buttered 9-inch pie plate. Drizzle maple syrup over apples.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop by spoonfuls on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Drain canned vegetables. Chop bell pepper and celery. Slice onion into thin rings and separate. Mix sugar vinegar and oil together. Mix until sugar dissolves. Pour over vegetables and marinate at least 12 hours in refrigerator.

title: Lime And Ice Cream Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add melted ice cream and mix well. Mix in pineapple and nuts. Thic can be mixed in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Refrigerate.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid with water. Mix all ingredients together except ginger ale. Better if stored in container in refrigerator at least 24 hours. May be frozen. Add ginger ale just before serving. Makes approximately 3 gallons.

title: Easy Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand lemon juice and pineapple well by hand and chill for 30 minutes. Then fold in Cool Whip. Pour into crusts. Chill. Pies can be frozen.

title: Party Rye Slices
instructions: Brown the sausage and hamburger separately. Add the cheese and garlic salt. Stir until cheese is melted. Roll up in a long roll. Refrigerate. Slice and place on small 3 x 3-inch party rye slices. Broil until brown.

title: Scalloped Chicken
instructions: Saute celery and onion in margarine. Then pour over bread cubes. Add chicken. Mix remaining ingredients and pour into first mixture. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans which have been greased.

title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Mix together and put in crock-pot. Top with grated cheese or cheese slices. Cook 4 hours on low heat or 2 hours on high heat. Let stand at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Country Club Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs until thick and lemon yellow. In another bowl mix remaining ingredients; add to egg mixture. Fill greased small muffin pans 3/4 full. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Carrot Cake Deluxe
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine brown sugar salt eggs cinnamon oil and carrots. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes; blend in flour baking soda and nuts mixing well. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch (12 cup) Bundt or tube pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake 45 minutes until a toothpick inserted in cake center comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Slice bread and spread with olive oil and chopped garlic. Bake until crisp then sprinkle with herbs tomatoes and more garlic.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Meat Pie
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup of milk into flour to make thickening. Add all other ingredients except biscuits in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour thickening over mixture. Place biscuits over top. Bake until brown.

title: Shrimp Etouffee(Cajun French)
instructions: Start by making a roux. Place oil in large hot skillet (iron) or heavy pot. Add flour to hot oil gradually and mix well. Brown flour as dark as possible without burning. Put in salt and pepper. Add shrimp and stir to coat with roux for a few minutes. Add other ingredients; continue stirring for a few minutes. Start adding water and stir as you would to make gravy. Add water as needed and simmer for 20 minutes to desired consistency. Serve over rice. Serves 4 people.

title: Graham Cracker Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread into a greased 8 x 10-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut into squares while still warm. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute leeks and onions in butter. Add flour then potatoes broth and salt. Simmer until potatoes are cooked (may be mashed a little). Add sour cream when ready to serve. Spinach should be added after soup is done and before sour cream is added.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Very simple to make. Pour warm beer into dry ingredients a little at a time and mix well. Put in greased bread pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes; check at 45 minutes. Five minutes before done grease top of bread with butter.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Pop the popcorn (do not add salt). Put in a large casserole dish that has buttered bottom and sides. In a small heavy saucepan add oleo brown sugar and Karo. Boil 3 minutes. Add soda (this causes syrup mixture to foam). Pour over popcorn. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Pour out on wax paper. To keep fresh seal in a container. Tastes like Cracker Jacks.

title: Luscious Layers
instructions: Prepare pudding into each of four dessert glasses. Fold whipped topping into remaining pudding. Spoon over plain pudding in glasses. Garnish each with additional whipped topping if desired. Makes 2 cups.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and margarine. Dissolve soda into a little warm water and then into applesauce letting it foam over the other ingredients. Beat and add flour fruit and nuts. Batter to hold it together. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: In a 9 x 12-inch baking pan greased layer uncooked rice. Combine in a separate pan the mushroom soup celery soup and milk. Heat and pour over uncooked rice. Then place uncooked chicken pieces from 1 entire fryer or use all chicken breasts. Sprinkle onion soup on top of uncooked chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until well done. Depending on your oven you may not want to remove cover. But chicken gets nice and crispy if uncovered. Toss a salad make coffee and dinner is served.

title: Mounds Cake
instructions: Make the cake the day before you want to serve it according to package directions. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Allow to cool. Makes holes all over cake with long-tined fork or skewer.

title: Mace Bundt Cake
instructions: Cream butter\tadd sugar gradually.\tCream together until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time.\tBeating well after each addition. After last egg let batter rest a while measuring and sifting together 3 times the flour and the mace. Add to batter and blend stir in the nuts. Have ready a very heavily greased Bundt pan using 2 or 3 tablespoons of shortening; spoon batter in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: German Honey Pork Stir-Fry
instructions: Toss pork with flour to coat. Heat oil in a large skillet on high heat. Add pork and stir-fry about 3 minutes until browned. Remove from skillet and set aside. Reduce heat to medium. Add lemon juice honey and soy sauce to pan drippings. Simmer about 10 minutes until slightly thickened stirring often. Add snow peas onions and pork. Cook about 2 minutes more or until peas are crisp-tender. Makes 4 servings. Serve on a bed of hot fluffy rice.

title: Poppy Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken; cut into pieces. mix cream cheese soup 1 stick margarine and poppy seed. Add chicken. Pour into casserole dish. Top with crushed crackers and melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat oil and sugar together. Add eggs and banana beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients milk and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour in greased and floured loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool. Store overnight before serving.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and Crisco over hot water. Beat in well the sugar and eggs. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add to above ingredients. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Spice Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 12 muffin cups. Place raisins in small bowl. Pour enough boiling water over to cover; let stand 5 minutes. Drain raisins. Mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add oil pumpkin and eggs; mix just until combined. Mix in raisins and nuts. Put in prepared pans; bake about 25 minutes.

title: Big Cookie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put cake mix eggs and oil in a bowl. Stir together until moistened. Press mixture into pizza pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Bake for 15 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine sugar flour baking powder and milk in a mixing bowl. Stir until smooth. Pour melted margarine over sugar mixture. Do not stir. Arrange peach slices evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour sugar mixture over peaches. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Pour hot water over broccoli to bring out the green color. Drain well. Break into small pieces. Mix with remaining ingredients except bacon. Chill overnight. Before serving top with cooked crumbled bacon.

title: Old-Fashioned Blueberry Pie
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients mixing well. Add blueberries tossing gently. Set aside. Roll half of pastry to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Place in a 9-inch pie plate; trim off excess pastry along edges. Spoon blueberry mixture into pastry shell; dot mixture with butter. Roll remaining pastry to 1/8-inch thickness; transfer to top of pie. Trim off excess pastry along edges. Fold edges under and flute. Cut slits in top of crust for steam to escape. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until golden brown. Cool pie before serving. Yield 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Ham And Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Put 1/3 stick of oleo in the skillet. Put in onion and celery; saute. Add frozen broccoli; add soup and cheese. Add rice and mix. Put bread crumbs or crackers on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Snacking Cake
instructions: Grease cookie sheet. Mix cake and directed and pour mixture into cooking sheet and bake until done. While still warm coat top with peanut butter. Cool and then chill in refrigerator until peanut butter is firm. Melt chocolate and pour chocolate over top of peanut butter. Cool and chill until chocolate is hard.

title: Five Can Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix margarine\tbrown sugar and pretzels and spread in lightly buttered dish 9 x 13-inch or 11 x 7-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes and let cool.

title: Chicken Chipulos
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 F. Combine the soups chicken green chilies onion and sour cream in a medium size bowl. Set aside. Rip tortillas into bite size pieces and layer 1/3 onto bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Layer chicken mixture on top then a layer of cheddar cheese. Repeat two additional times making sure to end with cheese on the top layer. Bake in preheated oven for about one hour. Serves 6-8.

title: Almond Toffee Crackle
instructions: Melt butter and add sugar and nuts. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes on high. Pour into jelly roll pan (buttered). Let cool and crack up.

title: Chip Beef Hot Dip
instructions: Rinse beef. Shred real fine. Mix with the other items. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pasta La Cinenega
instructions: Saute onions garlic mushrooms basil parsley salt and pepper in white wine over medium heat. Blanch vegetables and set aside in large bowl. Add tomatoes to saute. Remove from heat adding spice to taste. Toss with vegetables and serve over linguine.

title: Squash Casserole No. 3
instructions: Cook squash until tender mash and drain. Melt margarine and pour over stuffing and mix. (If desired use half poultry stuffing and half cornbread stuffing.) Combine all ingredients and mix well reserving a small amount of stuffing for the top of casserole. Bake in greased baking dish for about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until carrots are cooked.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into small balls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. If frozen cook for 20 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Quick Corn Flake Candy
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup in heavy boiler. Place over heat until small bubbles form around edges; do not boil. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter; stir until blended. Stir in corn flakes. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been lightly sprayed with Pam.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Dice onion and eggs into small pieces. Cook bacon until crispy and break into small pieces.

title: Broccoli Oriental
instructions: Cook broccoli and chestnuts in medium pan covered in small amount of boiling water 10 minutes. Drain and keep warm. In same saucepan melt butter. Stir in soy sauce and pepper. Heat thoroughly. Pour over broccoli.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus and peas. Mix milk and soup and cheese together; add all the ingredients together then add chopped eggs. Place in buttered casserole. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
instructions: In mixing bowl cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs. Stir in cocoa flour vanilla and salt. Spread into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brownies test done. Cool completely. Spread Marshmallow Creme over cooled brownies.

title: Molasses Spice Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and brown sugar until light. Beat in eggs and molasses. Add sifted dry ingredients (except granulated sugar). Mix well. Chill several hours. Shape into balls the size of walnuts and roll in granulated sugar. Press down with floured tumbler. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 12 minutes. Makes approximately 4 dozen.

title: Pastrami Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix softened cheese with Accent Worcestershire sauce onions and small amount of chopped pastrami. Make into a ball. Roll in remainder of the chopped pastrami.

title: Cake For Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Mix together flour salt baking powder and sugar. Add milk egg vanilla and melted butter. Bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cookie Brittle
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine margarine vanilla and salt. Blend well. Gradually beat in sugar. Add flour and chocolate bits. Mix well. Press evenly into ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts over top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool then break into irregular pieces or cut in squares.

title: Irish Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Mix flour oatmeal baking powder and salt in large bowl. Beat egg with honey and milk and beat well. Pour into flour mixture and mix only until dry ingredients are moistened. This batter is not smooth. Spread batter in pan (greased) in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours or until crusty and tests done. Turn out to cool. While still warm brush top with butter.

title: Easy Caramel Apple Pie
instructions: Combine candies (each piece cut into 4 pieces) and flour. Add apples ice cream topping and lemon juice; mix well. Pour mixture into frozen pie crust. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 375\u00b0 on preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes. Do not refrigerate.

title: Fluffy Cheesecake Dessert
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs butter and sugar. Reserve 1/3 cup. Press rest of crumb mixture in bottom of 9 x 9-inch ungreased square pan. Prepare frosting mix as package directs. Blend cream cheese and\tsour cream in large\tmixer bowl. Beat in frosting gradually.\tPour over crumb mixture in pan. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Bake at\t300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.\tCool; refrigerate. Serve topped with pie filling. Makes 9 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Add oil and sugar to eggs. Then add vanilla. Sift flour salt soda and cinnamon together and add to mixture. Lastly add apples and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Mix & spread top with grated swiss cheese. Save a little bacon for top too.

title: Dave'S Mom'S Potato Pancakes
instructions: Place potato grating on a towel and wring the towel to extract as much moisture from the potatoes as possible. Place potatoes in a bowl and stir in eggs. Add flour salt and onion. Shape into 1/4-inch thick 3-inch diameter (small) patties. Saute in 1/4-inch or more hot oil. Turn and brown until crisp. Best served hot.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place alternate layers of potatoes cheese peppers and onions in greased baking dish.\tSeason each layer with salt and pepper. Mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup with milk. Pour over potatoes; cover. Bake for 1 1/2 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven. Remove cover and let brown slightly.

title: Classic Potato Salad
instructions: In large bowl stir together first 5 ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; toss to coat well. Cover chill. Makes 5 cups.

title: Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: In a large saucepot saute onion and garlic in margarine until translucent. Add potatoes and carrot; saute 5 to 10 minutes. Add stock and dill and simmer until all vegetables are tender. Remove vegetables from pot and puree in blender with cream cheese and milk. Return pureed mixture to pot. Stir in cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Reheat over low heat.

title: Chess Cake Squares
instructions: Melt margarine; add both sugars and vanilla to butter and blend together. Add eggs one at a time to mixture beating after each one. Fold in flour and pecans. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix in order given. Flour and grease pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool. These freeze well.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Mix pudding according to box directions. Layer strawberries pudding mix and angel food cake (crumbled up) in bowl or you can mix it all together. Cover with whipped cream.

title: Fresh Garden Skillet
instructions: Mix ingredients in the order listed. Fry in oil turning over as they brown. Cook until tender. Serves 4.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; cream butter and sugar. Add all ingredients together. Bake in crisp pie crust in moderate oven approximately 1 hour or until pie will not shake. Do not cook too dry.

title: Bread Popovers
instructions: Beat eggs. Add milk flour salt and butter. Do not beat too much. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve piping hot with butter or jelly. Yields 10 to 12.

title: Easy Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish so pieces dont overlap. Cover with mushrooms. Combine soup with sour cream and sherry. Pour over chicken completely covering. Dust with paprika. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 2 hours. Serves 8.

title: Edna'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream the cheeses and add pepper. Form into a ball and roll in the pecans.

title: Sweet Muffins
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Add soda to the buttermilk then add to creamed mixture alternately with the flour mixture. Place in greased tins and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix together and pour in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. In small bowl mix together 2/3 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Roll each piece of biscuit in mixture and put into Bundt pan. Bring to boil sugar cinnamon margarine\tand vanilla. Pour mixture over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and turn out\tonto waxed paper. Do not cut but pull pieces apart.

title: Chicken Fettucini
instructions: Chop chicken into small pieces while partially frozen. Chop onion finely. Also chop garlic sections. On medium heat melt butter and stir-fry chicken onion and garlic until chicken is no longer pink. Add salt and pepper; simmer. Boil noodles. Pour chicken onions and garlic in 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Also pour in all grease from chicken pan. Add soup and sour cream mix well. Add noodles; mix well. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Mushroom Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Cut pockets into thick part of breasts. Sprinkle with lemon juice and 1/2 teaspoon salt; set aside. Saute sausage celery and onion. Mix well with mushrooms bread crumbs parsley remaining salt and 1/3 cup broth. Place heaping tablespoonful stuffing into each breast pocket; secure opening with toothpick. Brush with butter and roll in bread crumbs.

title: Velvet Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and peanut butter. Gradually add sugar and cream well. Add unbeaten egg and extract. Sift flour and baking powder then gradually add to the cream mixture. Fill cookie press half full and form cookies on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes five dozen.

title: Easy Apple Pie
instructions: Melt margarine; add dry ingredients together and mix with egg apples and vanilla. Pour in deep pie shell. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Grandmother'S Cobbler For A Busy Day
instructions: Melt butter into rectangular casserole dish. Mix flour and milk; spoon into butter. Do not stir. Pour syrup off peaches into a saucepan. Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil.

title: Vegetable Garden Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Blend well using a fork. Pour oil (vegetable) to coat the bottom of a large heavy skillet. Cook pancakes on medium heat 3 or 4 minutes each side until nicely browned.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream margarine shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Sift together flour cocoa salt and baking powder. Add alternately with milk to first mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into a pan and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Copper Coin Salad
instructions: Peel carrots; slice in 1/4-inch rings. Cook or steam until tender-crisp; drain. Combine soup salad oil sugar vinegar salt dill seed and pepper in saucepan; bring to a boil to dissolve. In 1/4 cup of water dissolve 1 envelope gelatin and stir into hot soup until melted. In 2-quart container combine carrots green pepper and onion. Pour soup mixture over vegetables; mix well and let stand overnight.

title: Microwave Fish Fillets
instructions: Place margarine in rectangular dish or 10-inch square dish. Microwave at High (100%) until melted. Blend in remaining ingredients except fish. Coat both sides of fish with butter sauce. Arrange in dish. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave at High (100%) until fish flakes easily in center with fork 5 to 6 minutes.

title: Martha'S Fruit Topping
instructions: Wash strawberries and slice. Slice bananas and dip in lemon juice. Prepare instant pudding and stir in bananas. Put sliced strawberries in glaze and mix. Mix all together. Let chill if possible overnight.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots for 10 minutes then drain. Heat remaining ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Add vegetables to tomato soup. Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Meal In A Pot
instructions: Fry bacon crisp and break into small pieces. Brown hamburger and onion and drain. Put all ingredients into a crock-pot and slow cook for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Creamed Crab Meat
instructions: Remove spines from crab meat then melt butter; blend in flour and seasoning. Add milk; cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add crab meat and heat thoroughly; serve very hot over toast.

title: Chocolate Yogurt Melts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first 3 ingredients until smooth; add next 2 ingredients until mixed in. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful 2 inches apart on lightly sprayed baking sheets. Garnish with nut halves if desired. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until cookies are set. Cool on wire racks.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel core and slice apples. Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour water over apples.

title: Chop Suey Cake
instructions: Mix in mixer or blender until light. Spread over hot cake. When cool cover and chill in refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Cottage Cheese And Dill Dip
instructions: Place cottage cheese green onion snipped parsley dill weed Worcestershire sauce pepper and garlic powder in a blender container or food processor bowl. Cover and blend or process until smooth. Chill covered for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Snowman'S Punch
instructions: Combine sugar 2 cups water cinnamon and cloves. Simmer 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Serve hot or cold.

title: Spaghetti Sauce For 25
instructions: In large pot add water tomatoes paste basil oregano and garlic powder. Cook on medium and let boil. In large skillet brown beef then add onions and peppers. Let brown (be sure to drain grease off beef). Add meat to sauce and let simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: Szechuan Shrimp
instructions: Combine scallions bamboo shoots ginger garlic and Tabasco in small bowl. In second bowl combine sugar catsup sherry soy sauce and sesame seed. In a third bowl mix cornstarch and water. Heat oil to 400\u00b0. Add shrimp to hot oil; cook about 2 minutes. Remove to strainer. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil. Add contents of first bowl then second bowl shrimp and then cornstarch with water. Serve over rice.

title: Elvis Presley'S Homemade Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook together meat onion celery bell pepper garlic and tomatoes for 1 1/2 hours. Add mixed vegetables for 1/2 hour. Then mix in corn potatoes okra salt and pepper. Cook for 30 minutes longer. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Drain. Combine noodles and tuna add mayonnaise all chopped vegetables and salt. Heat on top of stove. Add cheese and stir until cheese melts. Put in casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs tossed with olive oil or with bread stuffing. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sweet And Sour Hot Dogs
instructions: Cut hot dogs in bite size pieces. Put jelly chili and mustard in crock-pot and mix. Stir hot dogs into mixture. Cover and cook on low 3 to 4 hours.

title: Tomato Dumplings
instructions: Heat tomato juice with salt sugar and pepper. Sift dry ingredients; add milk. Blend into a stiff dough. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot juice. Cook covered for 12 minutes. Do not overcook. Do not remove. Cover during cooking. Serve at once. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Pie
instructions: Line sides and bottom of pie crust with bananas. Mix Eagle Brand milk lemon juice and sugar with electric mixer until thickens. Pour over bananas. Sprinkle pineapple (may need to squeeze juice out with hands) over creamy layer. Spread top of pineapple with Cool Whip. Sprinkle coconut and pecans on top of pie. Garnish with cherries. Chill overnight before serving.

title: Shawn'S Chicken Surprise
instructions: Place chicken in greased baking dish. Mix 1/2 can water to soup and pour over chicken. Sprinkle bread crumbs and cheese over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup over chicken after 20 minutes and continue to bake for next 15 minutes. Turkey can be used in this recipe.

title: Casserole Corn Bread
instructions: Melt margarine. Saute onions and bell peppers. Mix cornbread mix with beaten eggs and both cans of corn. Then add that to the sauteed onions and bell peppers. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Whip sour cream with fork until creamy and spread on top of casserole. Then spread the 2 cups cheese on top of sour cream. Return to oven (lower to 350\u00b0) and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Delicious!!!!

title: Imperial Chicken
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Dip each breast in milk and dredge in bread crumb mixture. Arrange in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine butter garlic and lemon juice drizzle over chicken. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until tender. Serves 6.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix sugar pumpkin and shortening. Stir in flour baking powder baking soda cinnamon and salt. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until light brown 8 to 10 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Cool and spread with glaze. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Scalloped Corn Supreme
instructions: Heat corn and milk. Gradually stir in egg add minced onion 1 cup cracker crumbs salt and dash of pepper. Mix well. Pour into greased 9-inch round baking dish. Sprinkle buttered crumbs over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Old English Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Heat cider and sugar. Combine together all the spices and wrap in a piece of cheesecloth. (Will be easier to remove them after simmering.) Simmer over low heat 15 to 20 minutes or until flavored to your liking. Serve hot. Great for holiday parties!

title: Baked Raccoon
instructions: Parboil coon for 30 minutes in salt water; drain and place in shallow baking dish. Blend spices and liberally cover coon. Surround with sliced onions. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Place carrots and potatoes in juice and continue to bake until vegetables are tender. Uncover and broil to brown.

title: Royal Cherry Sauce
instructions: Drain cherries reserving liquid. Set cherries aside. Combine sugar cornstarch and reserved cherry liquid in a saucepan stirring until smooth. Add wine lemon juice and orange rind. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture thickens. Stir in cherries. Cook until thoroughly heated. Serve with poultry or ham.

title: Baked Potato Soup(Baked Potatoes Give This Soup A Delightful Flavor)
instructions: Scrub potatoes and remove any blemishes. Bake potatoes until partially cooked but still firm. Dice potatoes and set aside. Melt butter in a large saucepan. Add flour and stir until smooth. Add chicken broth and cook over medium heat stirring constantly. Add cream and milk; continue stirring until mixture begins to thicken. Add potatoes parsley chives salt and pepper. Cook 10 minutes until thickened. Serve with green onions cheese and bacon as garnish. Serves 6.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl combine green beans soup milk half of the onions and half of the bacon bits. Pour into 1 1/2-quart dish. Bake for 30 minutes then sprinkle remaining onions and bacon bits on top. Bake for 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Mix together flour sugar and salt. Add shortening until crumbly. Add vinegar and water to flour mixture and work in until ingredients are moist. Divide dough into balls. Roll out onto floured board and put into pie plates.

title: Orange Cream Fruit Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine fruits and set aside.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken and debone. Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice eggs on top of chicken. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Mix soup and broth and pour over chicken. Combine margarine flour milk mayonnaise and pepper. Pour on top. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend all ingredients except pecans and crackers thoroughly and shape into a ball. Roll in crackers and pecans. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Serve with graham crackers.

title: *No-Cook Strawberry Jam
instructions: Wash stem and thoroughly crush strawberries one layer at a time. Place in a large bowl. Thoroughly mix sugar into fruit; let stand for 10 minutes. Mix lemon juice and Certo well in a small bowl. Stir into fruit and stir for about 3 minutes. A few sugar crystals will remain.

title: Reuben Meat Pie
instructions: Prick the bottom and sides of pastry shell with a fork and bake at 425\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Sprinkle corned beef in baked pastry shell. Add cheese and top with sauerkraut. Combine the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Pour over sauerkraut in baked pastry shell. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes until set. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Micro Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Cook bacon slices for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until crisp with microwave at High. Allow to cool and crumble.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream the cream cheese until softened. Add Eagle Brand milk and stir well. Add lemon juice and stir well. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill. Cover with desired fruit topping.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook to soft ball stage. Pour over 3 quarts of popped popcorn. Make into balls. Add food coloring to make for different holiday.

title: Chicken Casserole Supreme
instructions: Shred dried beef into bottom of greased baking dish. Wrap chicken in bacon and place in casserole over layer of beef and sprinkle with pepper. Blend soup (undiluted) with cream and pour over chicken. Cover. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours or uncovered for 2 1/2 hours. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hot Salsa Dip
instructions: In a microwave dish mix salsa and cream cheese. Heat 2 minutes on High. Mix again with wire whip to blend. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and return to microwave. Heat on High until bubbly. Serve with tortilla chips. Very easy and delicious.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix chilies sour cream olives and half of cheese together. Divide mixture in half. To one half add the chicken. Roll into 12 tortillas. Place into a greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Cover with remaining mixture cheese and olives. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until heated. Serve with salsa shredded lettuce chopped tomatoes and sour cream.

title: Raspberry Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Do not preheat oven. In a large bowl combine cake mix sugar sour cream oil and eggs. Beat on low speed to blend then on medium for 4 minutes. Pour 2/3 of batter into greased and floured 12-cup capacity Bundt cake pan. Drop raspberries on top of batter and top with remaining batter. Place in cold oven; set temperature to 325\u00b0. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool cake in pan for 10 minutes then turn out on cooling rack. When cool spoon on Raspberry Glaze.

title: English Trifle
instructions: Add 1/2 cup sugar to strawberries and refrigerate. Bring milk just to boiling. Put whole eggs and egg yolks into mixing bowl and beat until light and lemon colored. Add 1/4 cup sugar and stir. Pour about half the hot milk into eggs beating vigorously. Return this mixture to rest of milk in pan and cook on low heat stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until mixture thickens and coats the spoon. (I add 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with just a little cold water to make the custard firmer.) Remove from heat. Add rum vanilla and almond extract. Stir to mix. Chill.

title: Buttermilk Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken into 1/4 cup buttermilk then roll in seasoned flour (salt and pepper). Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put chicken in pan skin side down. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Turn chicken and bake for 15 minutes. Blend 1 cup buttermilk and soup; pour around chicken. Bake 15 minutes more or until done. Serves 6.

title: Waldorf Red Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar eggs and vinegar. Make paste of food coloring and cocoa. Add paste to creamed mixture. Sift flour with salt. Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Add soda and vanilla. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until creamy. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff peaks form. Fold in nuts chocolate chips and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon on foil covered cookie sheet. Place in preheated oven and immediately turn off the oven. Do not open the door until morning. No peeking!!!

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients; add sherbet just before serving.

title: Pretzels
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Add yeast to water. Stir. Add the rest of the ingredients. Mix knead and shape dough. Brush with egg. Sprinkle with salt. Bake on a cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Gingered Honey Marinade
instructions: Mix all together and marinate meat in it for up to 24 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Roll dough into small balls. Flatten out on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Famous Chocolate Wafer Roll
instructions: Reserve 1 cup whipped cream and set aside. Spread each wafer cookie with cream and arrange in stacks of 4 or 5. Chill 5 minutes. Lay stacks on edge to make one long roll. Spread remaining whipped cream on outside of roll. Chill 3 to 4 hours covered (you can also put it in the freezer). Slice at an angle to get a striped effect and serve.

title: Dirt
instructions: Mix cream cheese margarine\tand sugar. In separate bowl mix pudding and milk then fold in Cool Whip. Combine the 2 mixtures. Take 1\tlarge bag of Oreo cookies and crush until they have the appearance of dirt. Alternate cookies and pudding mixture twice. Reserve some crushed Oreos for top. Very cute served in flowerpot with a silk flower stuck in the middle of crushed cookies.

title: Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook the grits according to package directions. Add the remaining ingredients. Stir thoroughly until cheese melts. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm.

title: White Potato Pie
instructions: Put potatoes in bowl; add butter sugar flour eggs milk salt and flavoring. Mix well and pour in an unbaked pie crust. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes then lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue to cook until browned.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Put carrots in 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with soup mix. Add water. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 until carrots are tender 1 1/2 hours. Add water if needed. Makes 10 servings.

title: Ham And Beans
instructions: Crock-pot ham shanks for 24 hours on low. Remove shanks save and chill stock. Remove fat from stock. To stock in crock-pot add the remaining ingredients and cook for 24 hours on low. Add the meat from the shank bones.

title: Cherry Tarts
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs salt and vanilla; mix well. Stir in sifted dry ingredients. Place heaping tablespoonful of batter in ungreased muffin cups. Work dough 1/3 way up sides of each cup. Fill with tablespoonful of cherry pie filling. Bake 15 to 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with whipped topping. (Makes 24 tarts.)

title: Melt In Your Mouth Blueberry Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking pan and set aside. In small bowl of electric mixer beat egg whites until stiff. Add 1/4 cup of sugar to egg whites and beat until sugar is well combined. Set aside.\tIn a separate bowl cream butter salt and vanilla.\tAdd remaining 3/4 cup sugar and egg yolks. Beat until light and fluffy. Sift together flour and baking powder. Add alternately with milk to butter and sugar mixture. Fold in reserved egg white mixture and blueberries. Pour batter into prepared baking pan and sprinkle the top with granulated sugar. Bake for 50 minutes. Makes 9 servings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa milk and butter. Bring to a boil on medium heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Mix well. Add oatmeal. Mix well. Spoon onto wax paper.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix shortening sugar and eggs thoroughly. Sift and blend together flour cream of tartar soda and salt; stir in shortening mixture. Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. These cookies puff up at first then flatten out. Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Pecan Sandwich Meat
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add water and soy sauce. Place in sprayed can and cover. Place in crock-pot with 1 inch of water. Steam on high 4 hours.

title: Italian Bow Knots
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients kneading together with hands until smooth. Divide into 3 portions. Roll each portion out separately (about as thin as pastry). Cut with pastry cutter or pizza wheel. Tie into bows and drop carefully into hot oil; fry to light brown. Drain on paper towels. Dip in boiling honey or powder with confectioners sugar.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute zucchini and onion in butter for ten minutes. Add next five ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar together. Add milk and eggs. Mix well then mix in mashed bananas. Add all dry ingredients. Spray 2 loaf pans with Pam. Pour batter evenly into 2 pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Done when inserted toothpick comes out clean.

title: Pancakes(Yields 12 Servings)
