instructions: Beat egg until fluffy. Beat in remaining ingredients until smooth. Grease griddle or pan. Heat on medium. Cook pancakes until dry around edges. Turn and cook.

title: Easy Chicken Teriyaki
instructions: Stir all the ingredients except the chicken together in a baking dish or pan. Add the chicken pieces and turn a few times to coat well with the sauce. With the flesh side facing down in the sauce cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Ranchy Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes; cut into squares. Boil until tender. Drain. Combine potatoes onion salt and pepper in a large bowl. Mix with dressing. Top with bacon and cheese. Serve while hot.

title: Cake That Doesn'T Last
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt or tube pan. Mix dry ingredients in large bowl and make well in center. Add other ingredients; mix well. Pour into pan and bake 65 to 75 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes and turn out of pan. Dust with powdered sugar or serve with whipped topping or frost. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Roulade
instructions: Pound meat between wax paper into 6 x 8-inch rectangles. With short side toward you lay one pickle spear and spread 1 heaping teaspoon of onion and a piece of bacon about 1-inch from the end. Carefully roll steak around the filling folding edges toward the center. Wrap 1/2 slice bacon around bundle. Secure with toothpicks.

title: Rosamarina Dessert(Ambrosia)
instructions: Cook rosamarina pasta to al dente rinse and cool. In saucepan mix together eggs drained liquid from fruit cocktail flour and sugar. Cook slowly constantly stirring until puddinglike. Cool overnight in refrigerator. The next day when all ingredients are cold mix rosamarina pasta reserved fruit cocktail pudding mixture and drained mandarin oranges together. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate until serving time. This makes a large quantity and is good for parties.

title: Rack Of Lamb De Simone
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients mixing well. Set aside. Place lamb fat side down in bottom of shallow roasting pan. Bake at 500\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until brown. Remove from oven. Place fat side up in roasting pan. Combine mustard and rosemary; brush on lamb. Cover lamb with bread crumb mixture. Insert meat thermometer making sure it does not touch fat or bone. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0. Bake until lamb thermometer registers 140\u00b0 for rare 160\u00b0 for medium or 170\u00b0 for well done.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring the sugar and syrup to a boil; take off heat and add peanut butter. Mix until it dissolves. Add corn flakes. Mix and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Almost Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. In skillet cook ground beef until brown. Drain. Add garlic salt pepper and tomato sauce. Simmer 5 minutes. In separate bowl combine all cheeses except Cheddar. Place 1/2 of noodles in bottom of 2-quart buttered casserole dish. Top with 1/2 of meat sauce and 1/2 of cheese mixture. Repeat. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Soy Wings
instructions: Mix sugar soy sauce and seasonings in a large bowl. Place wings in a large baking dish and pour sauce mixture over them. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 covered for about 1 hour. Bake uncovered for another 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook the macaroni until tender. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Seafood Chowder
instructions: Make cream base with butter flour and 2 quarts of cream or half and half. Saute vegetables and garlic in butter. Add to cream base. Add seafood to cream base. Add parsley and seasoning to taste. Simmer but do not boil. Add cream or half and half to thin.

title: Pistachio Torte
instructions: Combine until crumbly. Pat mixture into bottom of 8 x 12-inch pan or dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes.\tCool.

title: Easy And Quick Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Put into loaf pan. Pour 8 ounce can Hunts tomato sauce over top of mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Yields 6 servings.

title: Corn And Ham Chowder
instructions: Saute celery onion and ham in butter. Add remaining ingredients. Heat. Simmer 20 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Easy Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink. Drain off fat. Stir in corn tomato sauce enchilada sauce or salsa green chili peppers chili powder and salt into meat mixture. Cook until bubbly. Spoon 1/3 of meat mixture into bottom of 2 quart rectangular baking dish. Place 5 tortillas on top. Spoon 1/2 of remaining meat mixture over tortillas. Sprinkle 1/2 of cheese over meat. Repeat with remaining tortillas meat and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until hot all through. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Broccoli
instructions: Stir-fry chicken in mayonnaise (okay to add Ranch dressing also) about 8 minutes. Add broccoli and cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Instant Brunswick Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large pot or Dutch oven. Heat and serve. Makes 12 servings.

title: Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water; add cream cheese pineapple and juice and salad dressing. Add prepared Dream Whip. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Birthday Cake Icing
instructions: Beat margarine and shortening. Slowly beat in confectioners sugar. Gradually add milk and vanilla flavoring along with confectioners sugar. Cover with damp towel until used. Store in airtight container in refrigerator. Soften at room temperature to use.

title: Ming Chicken Crepe
instructions: Stir-fry sprouts mushrooms and pea pods in a wok or skillet in 1 or 2 tablespoons of oil for about 2 minutes until done. Set aside. Stir-fry chicken in oil. When nearly done add vegetables. Toss; remove to serving platter and sprinkle with uncooked green onions.

title: Candy Bar Pie
instructions: In pan melt coffee in water. Add broken chocolate bar pieces and stir over low heat until melted. Cool slightly and fold into Cool Whip. Fill pie crust and freeze 10 minutes before serving. Remove from freezer and serve.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: First cook eggs in hot frying pan sprayed with Pam. Turn over and cook slightly until done. Put on plate and chop into little pieces; set aside. Heat about 2 tablespoons oil in wok or frying pan and cook each vegetable separately until brown and hot. Take out of wok and set aside. Add about 1 or 2 tablespoons of oil in wok and brown desired choice of meat. Add cooked vegetables eggs and white rice to browned meat. Add desired amount of salt and pepper and mix thoroughly; may have to add about 2 to 3 tablespoons of oil to rice mixture. Mix together well. Add desired amount of soy sauce; mix well and serve.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix sour cream corn eggs and oil. Add corn meal baking powder and salt and stir in 1 cup of the cheese. Add onion and chilies. Mix well and put into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Sprinkle with rest of cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pork N Bean Cake
instructions: Put the raisins in the boiling water; set aside. Beat the eggs oil brown sugar white sugar and pork and beans. Add the raisins and water and the vanilla. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Rustica
instructions: In frying pan melt butter. Add chicken. Cook. Add water milk and soup. Stir to blend. Add remaining ingredients and simmer.

title: Nip It In The Bud Spuds
instructions: In a large bowl mash potatoes until smooth. Add the cream cheese in small pieces and the butter. Beat with mixer until well blended. Stir in sour cream.

title: Easy Bake Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash and pat dry chicken. Rub each breast with butter. In a Ziploc bag combine cornflakes and basil. Coat each chicken breast in cornflake mixture and place in casserole dish. Dot each chicken breast with a pat of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Juicy Cooler
instructions: Combine the juices and sugar in a pitcher. Stir until sugar dissolves. Add chilled sparkling water; stir. Serve over crushed ice.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large enameled canner or stainless steel. Cook until thick as you like stirring to prevent burning or scorching. Seal in hot jars. Process in hot water bath for 15 minutes. Makes about 7 to 8 quarts.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix together and put into 12 muffin cups Use paper liners. Drizzle with 2 Tbsp Hersheys syrup. Freeze. They taste surprisingly like a peanut butter cup.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil margarine milk and sugar for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add oats cocoa vanilla. Mix well. If mixture seems to soup add more oats. Drop mixture by the spoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Super Meat Balls
instructions: Put all ingredients except meat into a blender and blend until smooth. Mix into meat and shape into balls.

title: London Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in butter. Brown mushrooms. Place chicken in large casserole. Mix soups (undiluted); pour over chicken. Place mushrooms on top. Refrigerate. When ready to bake add wine. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Yields 12 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream cheeses together and form into a ball. Add Worcestershire dried beef and green onions. Mix all together to form a ball. Put ball on a plate and serve. For a 1/2 recipe subtract 1/2.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain well. Mix other ingredients and add to broccoli. Place in 3 quart casserole and top with crushed cracker crumbs. Cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Deluxe Cheesecake
instructions: Combine crumbs 2 tablespoons sugar butter and cinnamon in a medium bowl; mix well. Press into a 10-inch spring-form pan; set aside.

title: Candied Almonds
instructions: Beat egg white at high speed with an electric mixer until foamy. Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating 2 to 4 minutes or until stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves. Fold in almonds. Melt butter in a 9-inch square pan or larger in a 325\u00b0 oven. Add almonds to pan and bake stirring every 5 minutes 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Watch carefully! Cool in pan on wire rack.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix one box of pudding mix cream cheese club soda and eggs. Beat with an electric mixer at high speed for two minutes. Take out 1 cup of the batter and set aside. Pour remaining batter into a greased angel food or Bundt pan.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Mix 2/3 apple cider to 1/3 cranberry juice in crock-pot. Add 2 to 3 allspice berries 5 to 6 whole cloves and 1 to 2 cinnamon sticks. (Can put cinnamon sticks in a whole orange if desired.)

title: Chocolate Mint Fudge
instructions: In heavy gauge saucepan combine marshmallow cream sugar evaporated milk butter and salt. Bring to full rolling boil over moderate heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add mint chocolate morsels; stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth. Stir in nuts and vanilla extract. Pour into foil-lined 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm.

title: Old-Fashioned Butter Roll
instructions: Mix flour shortening water and 1 cup of milk. Roll out like pie crust. Mix butter 1 cup of sugar vanilla and lemon. Put butter mixture on crust; roll up like a jelly roll. Cook remainder of milk and sugar over low heat for 10 minutes. Pour over rolls. Cook at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Peachy Nut Cake
instructions: Place peaches in a greased 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly on peaches. Pour melted butter over mix. Add nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream if desired.

title: Orange Slice Christmas Cake
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cups of the flour with nuts and fruit. Cream oleo and sugar beat in eggs one at a time. Mix soda salt and flour; add to creamed mixture with milk add fruit and nuts. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven in well greased large loaf pan or two smaller ones for 2 1/2 hours. Turn out immediately and glaze with 2 cups powdered sugar and small can frozen orange juice.

title: Caramel Rolls
instructions: Thaw frozen bread dough overnight. Cut up one of the loaves in small pieces and place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together remaining ingredients. Pour this mixture over the bread in the pan. Cut up the second loaf and place over that. Let rise 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. To reheat warm in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes wrapped in aluminum foil.

title: Meatless Taco Salad
instructions: In large skillet add tofu and taco seasoning mix. Add the same amount of liquid as on the seasoning package directions.

title: Aunt Emily'S Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Line a pie pan with pie crust then put in rhubarb. Mix all together sugar flour butter egg and boiling water. Pour over rhubarb. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Best All-American Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter 13 x 9-inch pan. Soften butter. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Beat eggs vanilla and sugar. Add butter. Beat in flour mixture. Spread batter into pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sausage And Egg Bake
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet stirring until crumbly; drain. Layer bread cubes sausage and cheese in baking dish. Combine eggs milk salt and pepper in bowl; beat until smooth. Pour over layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until set. May place crescent roll dough in baking pan and on top of casserole and omit bread if preferred. Yield 8 servings.

title: Flank Steak(Rice As A Side Dish)
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Combine remaining ingredients as marinade. Marinate 4 hours or overnight. Broil 4 to 5 minutes each side (for medium-rare) brushing with marinade. Slice thinly across grain. (May serve as main course and/or appetizer at room temperature with rye bread.)

title: Green Beans And Tomatoes
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in bacon grease. Pour off excess grease. Add tomatoes and all other ingredients except bacon and beans. Cook stirring until veggies are soft. Add drained beans and bacon. Serve hot. Serves 6.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender. Blend on high. Cook like pancakes.

title: Blarney Stones
instructions: Bake cake according to box instructions in sheet cake pan. Cool completely. Cut into 2 inch squares. Mix sugar half and half and butter in saucepan. Bring to boil and boil 3 minutes; pour over powdered sugar. Thin with half and half; icing should be very thin. Ice top and sides of each square and roll in peanuts.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole With Topping
instructions: Mix and pour into casserole.

title: Chicken Chimichangas
instructions: Fry or boil the chicken breasts until done. Chop or shred chicken. Scoop 1/4 cup chicken and about 1/4 cup shredded Cheddar cheese onto a large flour tortilla. Fold up bottom over filling then fold in sides and roll up. Secure with toothpick if necessary. Heat oil in electric frypan or deep fat fryer. Cook each chimi until all sides are nicely browned.

title: Baked Sliced Apple Slices
instructions: Pare core and slice apples into eighths. Combine brown sugar bread crumbs cinnamon and nutmeg. Blend. Spread 1 tablespoon butter on entire insides of 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Fill pan with alternate layers of apples brown sugar mixture and orange juice ending with sugar mixture on top. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in a moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 15 minutes. Uncover; continue to bake about 1/2 hour longer or until apples are soft. Serve warm or cold with cream or ice cream.

title: Cornish Hens With Chestnut-Sausage Stuffing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet cook onion and celery in Italian dressing stirring until tender. Add sausage and cook 5 minutes or until browned. Stir in bread crumbs chestnuts pine nuts and herbs. Stuff hens with mixture. Close cavities with skewers and tie legs together with string. Place in roast pan on racks. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and roast 1 hour. Remove foil and continue roasting 15 minutes approximately until done.

title: Fruited Chef'S Salad
instructions: Arrange quartered hard-cooked eggs slivered ham or turkey and canned pineapple chunks on crisp lettuce. Sprinkle with a little crisp bacon. Serve with a favorite dressing.

title: Shrimp Creole With Rice
instructions: Saute first 3 ingredients in the oil or shortening. Combine next 8 ingredients. Add to first ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1/2 hour. Add shrimp an continue cooking until mixture is heated through. Cook rice according to directions on package. Serve hot shrimp creole over rice. Makes 50 servings.

title: Curried Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Transfer to a large bowl. Add chicken apples celery tomatoes and onions. In a small bowl combine picante sauce mayonnaise chutney and curry powder mixing well. Combine with pasta mixture; cover and chill. Serves 6.

title: Easy Turkey Lasagne
instructions: Brown turkey and onion together slowly. Pour off excess fat. Add spaghetti sauce garlic and oregano. Cook on simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Layer half the noodles in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Spread with half the Ricotta; add half the Mozzarella cheese and half the meat sauce. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 30 to 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Press into bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely. Combine cream cheese sugar 2 cups Cool Whip and vanilla. Beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth. Spread on crust. Combine pudding mix and milk. Beat with mixer 2 minutes. Spread over cream cheese layer. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Chill 8 hours and serve. Makes approximately 15 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix well; shape into a ball. Chill until firm.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl until well blended. Pour into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Creamed Cucumbers And Onions
instructions: Put cucumbers and onions in a bowl. Combine the mayonnaise sugar salt pepper and vinegar. Mix well and add to cucumbers and onions. Can be served immediately or refrigerated.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Preheat the oven at 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine 1/4 cup of the reserved pineapple juice (discard remaining juice or set aside for another use) the pineapple orange juice grated orange peel milk eggs brown sugar oil and poppy seed.

title: Wine Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken breasts breast bone side down in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Arrange mushrooms around chicken. Pour wine over chicken and sprinkle with parsley whole tarragon salt and pepper. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Yields 8 servings with 154 calories per serving.

title: Marinara Sauce
instructions: Simmer 20 minutes. Add tablespoon olive oil. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients except cheese and potatoes. Spread in deep pie dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add cheese mashed potatoes and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 15 to 20 minutes more.

title: Lindy'S Chicken Surprise
instructions: Boil chicken until meat comes off bones. Take bones out. Put in potatoes carrots onions mushrooms and celery; cook until tender. Add green pepper green beans and peas; cook 5 minutes. Add cabbage and cook until cabbage is done.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all together; can be served immediately or refrigerated.

title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Put sugar milk butter cocoa and salt in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in the rolled oats vanilla nuts and coconut.\tDrop from teaspoon onto waxed paper to make cookies.

title: Fried Liver With Bacon And Onion
instructions: In a large frying pan brown bacon and onion. Dip liver into egg mixture. Coat liver with bread crumbs. Add liver to bacon and onion mixture. Continue frying until well browned.

title: Macaroni Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve chilled with salad crackers or on a leaf of lettuce. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pint Size Pot Roast(4 Servings)
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Dredge meat. Reserve leftover flour. Brown meat in cooking oil in Dutch oven. Pour off drippings. Add water vinegar sugar and celery seed. Cover tightly and cook slowly for 2 hours. Turn and add more water if necessary while cooking. Add onion and continue cooking covered for 30 minutes or until meat is tender and onion is done. Remove meat and onion to platter and keep warm. Combine reserved flour and 1/4 cup water. Add to cooking liquid and cook stirring constantly for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain. Place layers in casserole in following order potatoes onion beef onion potatoes. Mix soup and milk. Pour over entire casserole; cover and cook in microwave for 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Cut crusts from bread. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon. Cut each slice of bread into quarters. Arrange in layers in prepared baking dish sprinkling each layer with raisins. Beat eggs just enough to blend thoroughly. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup sugar milk and vanilla. Continue stirring until sugar dissolves. Pour over bread and raisins.

title: Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
instructions: Mix the sugar peanuts and syrup in large glass container. Microwave 4 minutes on High; stir. Microwave another 2 minutes on High. Add margarine to mixture; microwave 1 1/2 to 2 minutes on High (1 1/2 minutes will give you a chewier candy; 2 minutes will turn out a crunchy candy). Add the remaining ingredients (baking soda vanilla and salt) quickly to the boiled mixture. Stir until mixture is \foamy.\ Pour onto buttered baking sheet; spread to desired thickness. After cooling break into pieces. So easy.

title: Baked Scallops
instructions: Butter a large casserole. Beat eggs; salt and pepper. Roll scallops in egg mixture then roll in cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corn Dodgers
instructions: Mix all together and fry in hot grease.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl together at one time. Pour into dish; chill for 3 hours. Serves 12.

title: Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: Beat all ingredients with hand mixer until smooth. (For thinner pancakes stir in 2 to 4 tablespoons additional milk.) Grease heated griddle with shortening. (Pastry brush can be used for this.) To check if griddle or pan is hot enough sprinkle few drops of water. If it bubbles and skittles around its ready. Use 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Cook until golden on both sides. Makes 10 to 12.

title: Vegetables In Foil
instructions: On large square of foil layer potatoes beans onions celery and tomatoes. Sprinkle with salt pepper basil garlic powder thyme and parsley flakes. Sprinkle with oil and cover tightly. Grill on low fire about 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Cherry Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Mix eggs sugar half and half and vanilla in a large bowl. Then add Jell-O cherries and pecans; then pour in a freezer container. Finish filling with milk. Freeze according to instructions.

title: Cherry Dessert(Serves 12)
instructions: Place cherry pie filling in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix and nuts over filling. Drizzle melted butter over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: He-Man Spanish Rice
instructions: In skillet cook beef onion green pepper and garlic until vegetables are tender. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover bring to a boil and cook over low heat 15 minutes or until rice is tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fluffy Frosting(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Combine sugar water sugar replacement egg whites and cream of tartar in top of a double boiler; beat at high speed for 1 minute. Set over simmering water in the bottom of the double boiler. Continue to beat at high speed for 4 to 5 minutes or until soft peaks form. Remove from heat. Add vanilla to frosting; continue beating at high speed 1 to 2 minutes or until thick enough to spread on a cooled cake.

title: Corn Cakes
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Drop onto hot skillet with a large spoon. (These are small pancakes.) Cook on both sides until golden brown. Serve with butter and syrup. Delicious! Make sure to cook some bacon up on the side!

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix together Nestle Quik and red food coloring and set aside. Cream together butter sugar eggs milk (butter or sour) flour and vanilla. Add coloring mixture slowly. Beat 10 minutes with electric mixer. Then mix together vinegar and soda; add to batter slowly by hand. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Micky'S Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare Jell-O according to package directions. When Jell-O begins to set add pineapple. Prepare Dream Whip according to package directions. Combine Dream Whip and cream cheese. Mix well. Spread over Jell-O. Combine sugar eggs lemon juice flour and pineapple juice. Cook until slightly thickened about 5 to 8 minutes. Pour over top of cream cheese. Sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Stir In The Pan Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients together and put into ungreased 8 1/2 x 11 1/2 baking pan. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 until pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Rinse and scrub potatoes. Pat dry. Prick a few times with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until soft. Cut a thin slice off the top of each potato. Carefully scoop out the pulp. Put in a bowl. Separate eggs. Add yolks to potato pulp. Stir and blend until smooth. Add butter and cream. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into potato mixture. Fill potato shells with mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Butterscotch Brownies
instructions: Combine sugar and Mazola. Add egg and beat well. Add nut meats and vanilla. Fold in mixed and sifted dry ingredients. Bake in a greased pan (8 x 8 x 2-inches) at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares while warm. Makes 16.

title: Squash Bisque
instructions: Cook to tender. Put through Foley food mill or blender. Serve hot or cold with a dab of yogurt.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in the boiling water. Let cool. Add the cranberries nuts pineapple and lemon juice. Pour into shallow pan. Chill until firm. You can add 3/4 cup chopped celery if desired. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: In a large container put cukes and onions; add 1/2 cup salt. Cover with ice cubes and refrigerate for 3 hours. Drain off liquid; set aside. Combine rest of ingredients in a large pan. Heat and add onions and cukes. Bring to a boil. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Strawberry Icebox Cake
instructions: Blend Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice; stir until thick. Add strawberries; fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Line pan with wax paper; cover with a layer of strawberry mixture. Add a layer of vanilla wafers. Continue until all mixture is used. Finish with a layer of vanilla wafers. Chill thoroughly. Turn out on cake plate.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: In a large bowl sift together first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients to dry ingredients. Mix all ingredients at once using a spoon. Bake 1 hour 10 minutes in a greased and floured Bundt pan.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix together sugar flour and orange rind. Add fruit and mix well. Put into pie crust. Dot with margarine. Cut strips from top crust and make a lattice top. Bake 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: On a platter layer beans and taco seasoning. Next layer sour cream and salsa. Add lettuce tomato black olives and cheese. Chill 1 hour. Pour chips in bowl and serve.

title: Uncooked Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except powdered sugar. Slowly add powdered sugar. Knead until smooth. Pack in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

title: Chicken-Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute carrots zucchini and onion in skillet sprayed with Pam. Add chicken. Mix in 1 1/2 cups stuffing seasoning 1 can mushroom soup and 1 can water (can add more water if you want it less dry). Put in 2-quart casserole. Cover with rest of stuffing. Makes approximately 8 servings.

title: Peanut Cream Candy
instructions: Mix sugars salt and cream. Boil gently without stirring to soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Cool to lukewarm (110\u00b0). Add peanut butter and flavorings. Mix until creamy. Drop by teaspoon onto a greased baking sheet. Cool.

title: Spinach Salad With Crisp Red Chiles(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Discard spinach stems and yellow or wilted leaves. Wash thoroughly and pat dry. Wrap in paper towels and enclose in plastic bag. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Do the same with watercress. Cut chiles crosswise into thin strips; discard seeds and stems. In a 10 or 12-inch frying pan stir in oil and chiles over low heat until chiles are crisp about 2 to 3 minutes. Lift chiles from oil and set aside. Save oil for dressing. If cactus pad has needles hold with tongs and scrape clean with knife. Peel pad if skin is tough. Cut cactus into 1/2-inch squares. In a 3 or 4-quart pan bring about 8 cups of water to a boil; add cactus and reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 5 minutes or until cactus is barely tender when pierced with fork. Tear spinach into bite sized pieces and place half of the spinach in a large salad bowl. Top with half of the watercress onion cactus radishes and cheese. Repeat layers to serve. Peel and pit the avocados; slice and arrange on top of the salad with the chiles.

title: Pistachio Pie(Delicious, Easy To Prepare Dessert)
instructions: On lightly floured surface roll out half of pastry and line a 9-inch pie plate. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Refrigerate pastry until ready to use.

title: Eggplant Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix crumbs oregano and garlic salt. Dip eggplant slices in butter then in crumb mixture. Place in single layer in greased jelly roll pan 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch. Spread evenly with tomato sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake until tender 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add taco seasoning and 2 cups of water. Add beans. Return to fire and cook 5 minutes. Add chips; mix well. Spread mixture into baking dish. Add cheese on top. Bake in oven until cheese melts.

title: Pecan Bars
instructions: Melt margarine and add sugar and eggs. Stir in flour and add nuts and vanilla. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a jar and shake. Refrigerate.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Microwave chili and cream cheese for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove and mix thoroughly. Return to microwave for another 2 minutes or until hot. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Microwave about 30 seconds or until cheese is melted. Serve with Tostitos chips. Easy and tasty.

title: Cocktail Quiche
instructions: Drain seed and chop peppers. Mix peppers and cheeses. Place in a 9-inch pie plate sprayed with Pam. Add salt to eggs and pour in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm.

title: Mediterranean Shrimp With Linguine
instructions: Prepare linguine and keep warm. In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat 2 tablespoons oil. Add shrimp and cook 4 minutes stirring frequently until shrimp is just pink. Using slotted spoon transfer shrimp to plate.

title: Appetizer-Quick Pizza Dip
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat cream cheese and Italian seasoning with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended. Spread on bottom of 9-inch pie plate. Top with 1 cup Mozzarella cheese pizza sauce additional 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and green and red pepper. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until mixture is thoroughly heated and cheese is melted. Serve with bread sticks.

title: Crusted Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets until done. Peel and mash (should be about 3 cups of cooked mashed sweet potatoes). Combine with sugar 1/2 cup melted butter eggs and vanilla. Stir until well mixed. Turn into greased casserole.

title: Chinese Pork Chops
instructions: Marinate 8 to 10 pork chops in sauce overnight. Place pork chops in shallow roasting pan and pour sauce over them. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Serve over hot buttered rice.

title: Greek Oven Fries
instructions: Scrub potatoes. Cut each lengthwise into 8 wedges. Place wedges in a bowl with cold water. Let stand 30 minutes. Drain. Pat dry with paper towels. Toss potatoes with oil. Place skin side down on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Combine oregano pepper and salt. Sprinkle evenly over potatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender and browned. Remove from oven and sprinkle with vinegar. Serve oven fries immediately. Yields 4 servings. Contains about 117 calories per 4 wedges.

title: Apricot Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in a Bundt pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Let set in pan 5 minutes. Turn out and glaze while hot.

title: Hershey Bar Pie
instructions: Melt candy bars in microwave oven. Mix with Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate until served.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Combine ingredients and cook on hot griddle.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Saute zucchini onion and oleo. Mix Stove Top dressing according to directions. Add cream of chicken soup and chopped carrots to the saute mix. Simmer for a few minutes. Put 1/2 of stuffing on bottom of baking dish. Add all other ingredients. Top with the rest of the Stove Top dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Of Fresh Vegetable Soup
instructions: In saucepan combine chicken broth onion one of the vegetable and seasoning combos following. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for the time indicated or until vegetables are tender (remove bay leaf if using broccoli). Place 1/2 of vegetables in blender cover and blend 30 to 60 seconds until smooth. Pour into bowl. Repeat with remaining mixture and set all aside.

title: Heavenly Pears
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Combine and mix first 5 ingredients. Pour into large deep baking dish. Place sliced peaches on top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Kentucky Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour into an unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: No Bake Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Combine the crushed crackers melted butter and sugar. Press into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Scald milk and butter in saucepan. Beat egg slightly; add sugar and vanilla. Stir into scalded milk. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 until pie barely shakes in crust. Shake nutmeg over pie before baking.

title: Jigglers
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water or juice. Pour into molds. Chill about 3 hours. Dip pan in warm water. Cut into shapes.

title: Perfect Creamy Cauliflower Soup
instructions: In heavy soup kettle melt butter. Add oil. Add onion scallions and garlic. Add celery and cauliflower. Add seasonings. Mix well and cook uncovered over medium heat for several minutes stirring frequently. Add water and miso. Bring to a boil. Simmer covered over medium heat for 15 minutes or until cauliflower is tender. Remove cover and cool slightly. Puree in small increments in blender until smooth and creamy. Reheat adding fresh ground nutmeg if desired. Serves 4.

title: The Best Horseradish Sauce
instructions: Mix together well. Cover tightly and refrigerate until serving time.

title: 3-Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well. Chill until firm enough to shape into ball. Roll in nuts and wrap with plastic wrap. Chill until firm. Serve with favorite crackers.

title: Brown Rice And Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot except almonds. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or automatic 4 to 5 hours. Serve with almonds on top. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cooked Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa then add canned cream and margarine. Cook until thick approximately 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Holiday Wreaths
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and cook stirring constantly until marshmallows melt and mixture is syrupy. Remove from heat. Stir in food coloring. Add Kelloggs corn flakes cereal. Stir until well coated. Portion warm cereal mixture using 1/4 cup dry measure. Using buttered fingers quickly shape into individual wreaths. Dot with red cinnamon candies. Yields 16 wreaths.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a large plastic bag add all ingredients. Close the bag and shake to cover potatoes with soup mix and oil. Empty potatoes into a shallow baking pan. Bake for 40 minutes until potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Cook broccoli slightly in salted water. Drain. Debone chicken and cut into bite size pieces. Put broccoli in buttered casserole. Put chicken over broccoli.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain and combine the first 4 ingredients. Add next 3 ingredients. Mix together and add remaining ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate. Better if made the day before.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Caution Skillet must be greased and hot before adding cornmeal mixture. Brown hamburger; drain off fat. Grate cheese; set aside. Combine onions hot peppers; set aside. Place a 9-inch iron skillet greased well in a hot oven. Mix all dry ingredients add eggs oil milk and corn. Remove hot skillet from oven. Put 1/2 of corn meal mixture in skillet. Spread cheese over mixture. Then sprinkle hamburger over cheese. Sprinkle onions and pepper over hamburger. Cover with rest of corn meal mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
instructions: Put sugar corn syrup water and butter in a saucepan. Boil to soft boil stage (236\u00b0). Cool then beat in the evaporated milk a little salt and vanilla. Stir in nuts and serve on ice cream pudding or cake. Makes 2 cups.

title: Oat Whole Wheat Pancakes
instructions: Stir dry ingredients to mix well. Add remaining ingredients except egg whites and stir. Fold in egg whites beaten. Cook on hot griddle.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Mix ingredients together to make sauce. Brown 1 1/2 pounds ground beef; salt and pepper to taste. Drain meat. Mix the sauce with the meat and simmer. Serve on bun or by itself.

title: Baby Cheesecakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place cream cheese sugar eggs and vanilla in large bowl and beat with electric mixer until smooth. Line muffin tins with paper liners and put one vanilla wafer in the bottom of each liner. Fill 3/4 full with cheese mixer. Bake 10 minutes and cool. Cover with pie filling. Chill.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cheese together. Mix in pineapple and juice. Put in baking dish. Top with melted butter and crushed crackers. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Fresh Lemonade
instructions: Squeeze lemons and oranges. Add sugar and enough water to make a gallon.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Add above ingredients to tea mixture. Serve hot. Makes 1 Gallon (16 cups).

title: Barbecue Ribs Ala Hartford
instructions: Mix together the seasonings and brown sugar. Roll ribs in this mixture. Pat any remaining mixture onto the ribs. Place ribs in a roasting pan. Mix together the vinegar and tomato soup and pour over the ribs. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn ribs and continue baking uncovered for another hour.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Mix together and form into small balls. Roll balls in coconut pecans or powdered sugar.

title: Quick Lemon Cookies
instructions: Sift flour with baking soda and salt. Cream shortening; add sugar and pudding mix. Cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs and mix thoroughly. Add flour mixture; beat thoroughly until well blended.

title: Green Bean-Mushroom Medley
instructions: Heat 1-inch water in 2-quart pan to boiling. Add beans and carrots. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and cover. Simmer until tender about 12 minutes. Drain. Cook and stir onion and mushrooms in margarine in 10-inch skillet over medium heat until almost tender about 5 minutes. Reduce heat; cover and cook 3 minutes. Stir in beans carrots salt m.s.g. garlic salt and pepper. Cover and cook over medium heat 5 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour salt baking powder and shortening. Mix yeast water and buttermilk. Pour out on floured board and roll out 1/2-inch. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Baja Lasagne
instructions: Saute onion in nonstick skillet. Add tomatoes chilies mushrooms beans chili powder and cumin. Simmer 10 minutes. Put half tortilla strips down. Pour 1/4 tomato mixture and 1/3 cheese over tortillas. Repeat layers ending with sour cream and last 1/4 of tomato mixture. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Put candy bars in freezer. Bake cake in sheet pan; cool. Make pudding 5 minutes before you start to layer (dont let it firm itself or it will be too hard to spread). Remove candy bars and shatter into little pieces. Now you are ready to layer. Use a punch bowl for serving dish.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions about 5 minutes. Mix together the soup mayonnaise chopped onion cubed Cheddar cheese and eggs. Pour broccoli and combined ingredients in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with crushed crackers and dot with butter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 50 to 60 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Tuna Cheese Log
instructions: In small mixer bowl beat together the cheeses. Stir in the celery onion mayonnaise hot pepper sauce and tuna. Shape the mixture into 5-inch roll 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Chill several hours or overnight. Before serving roll in chopped pecans. Serve with crackers. Makes 2 rolls.

title: Pineapple Frosting
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together; add other ingredients. Cook all ingredients until thick.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place brisket into oven bag. Add chili sauce and water. Mix well. Poke holes in top of cooking bag. Place in baking pan. Cook 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Serves 8.

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix and make in cakes. Place on wax paper and chill 15 minutes. Fry in oil. Makes 8 crab cakes.

title: Barry'S Pecan Pralines
instructions: Put 3/4 cup of dry sugar in a medium saucepan. Heat on medium-high until sugar melts and turns a rich brown (beer bottle brown). After sugar has melted and turned brown add evaporated milk being careful not to let it boil over. Once it settles down add remaining ingredients and heat to \soft-ball\ stage about 20 minutes on medium-high heat (electric stove) and close to high heat on a gas stove.

title: Mom'S Old-Fashioned Burnt Sugar Cake
instructions: Place 1 cup sugar in skillet and heat stirring constantly until sugar melts and becomes brown. Remove from heat.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Sift flour salt and soda. Add to mixture with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Recipe makes 1 loaf; can be doubled or tripled if more is desired.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick of butter; mix with graham cracker crumbs. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Set aside.

title: Fruity Parfait
instructions: You put into a tall glass each ingredient in a layer (in order given).

title: Quick And Easy Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine milk cheese corn and nutmeg in a medium bowl and mix well. Spoon evenly into a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle stuffing mix evenly on top. Pour melted butter evenly on top. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place breasts in casserole. Cover with soups and let bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hawaiian Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit and save juice. Add water to make 3 cups liquid. Add puddings and orange juice concentrate to liquid. Cook until thick; stir constantly. Cool to room temperature and then stir in fruit and sliced bananas. Chill.

title: Joe Froggers
instructions: Mix sugar and the shortening. Stir in remaining ingredients except sugar. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll dough 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured board. Cut into 3-inch circles; sprinkle with sugar. Place on well-greased baking sheet. Bake until almost no imprint remains when touched in the center 10 to 12 minutes. Cool about 2 minutes before removing from cookie sheet. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Tabouli
instructions: Boil stock add salt and bulgar. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat cover pot and let sit for 1 to 2 hours. Drain excess water. Chill. Toss with all other ingredients. Adjust to taste.

title: Carrot Cake(Makes 12 Servings)
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar oil salt soda cinnamon and vanilla. Add flour then carrots and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: 24 Hour Pea Salad
instructions: Combine lettuce onions celery peppers and peas. In a small bowl mix Miracle Whip and Worcestershire sauce. Spread on top of salad making sure you spread to the edges. Sprinkle cheese and bacon on top and cover with aluminum foil. Let sit in fridge for 24 hours.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Rinse the beans. In a large Dutch oven cover beans with with 6 cups cold water. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover; let stand 1 hour (or soak beans overnight in a covered pan). Drain and rinse the beans. In the same Dutch oven combine rinsed beans 6 cups hot water ham bone onion garlic bay leaf and red pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 hours or until beans are tender. Stir occasionally. Add more water if necessary.

title: Vidalia Onion Dip
instructions: Mix together. Dust with paprika. Bake at 300 degrees for 20 minutes or until lightly brown on top. Eat warm on crackers.

title: Alarm Chili
instructions: Cook ground beef in 2 1/2-quart saucepan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until well done stirring until crumbly. Remove ground beef with slotted spoon to paper towels to drain. Drain and wipe saucepan. Saute onion garlic and green pepper with 1/2 cup tomatoes in oil in saucepan for 3 minutes. Add oregano cumin chili powder cocoa sugar hot pepper and Tabasco sauce. Cook for 3 minutes. Add beans ground beef and remaining tomatoes. Simmer for 25 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Spaghetti Sauce(Pastor Burns' Famous Recipe)
instructions: Fry hamburger pepperoni onion celery and mango; drain. Pour fried ingredients in a large saucepan. Add spaghetti sauce. Simmer for 1/2 hour. Add mustard sugar salt pepper garlic Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper (optional); stir. Simmer for an additional 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Roasted Pecans
instructions: Turn oven to 300\u00b0. Put margarine in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Melt in oven then remove. Add Worcestershire sauce and mix with margarine. When oven is heated pour pecans into margarine-Worcestershire mixture and stir to coat pecans. Place in oven. Stir pecans every 10 minutes. Salt as needed. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Goulash
instructions: Brown hamburg and onion in skillet then add canned tomatoes and Ragu sauce. Bring to low boil then add cheese. Simmer until cheese is completely melted. Boil elbows until done then mix together.

title: Tune Up A Tuna
instructions: In a bowl stir soup eggs tuna and pimento. Set aside. Mix Bisquick mix and hot water. Knead dough on floured surface until smooth. Press dough into bottom and up sides of greased 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on dough. Add tuna mixture. Top with remaining cheese and garnish with additional pimento. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until center is set. Cool 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cook rice until almost soft. Cool then mix with rest of ingredients except soup. Stuff peppers with mixture. Place in casserole dish. Pour tomato soup over peppers. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sausage Dip - Mexican Style
instructions: Brown sausage and drain grease. Mix softened cream cheese with drained Ro-Tel. Add sausage last. Serve in a crock-pot with tostada style chips. Everybody loves this one!

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs then flour and soda. Mash bananas and whip until very light. Add bananas and nuts. Turn in well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Fried Ripples(Love Knots)
instructions: Mix ingredients. Roll as thin as pie crust. Cut into strips and splash and fry in deep hot fat until golden brown. Sprinkle with sugar.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Unfried Chicken And Fries
instructions: Place oven racks in middle and lower position. Heat to 425\u00b0. Coat a large wire rack and a large baking sheet with nonstick spray set rack in a roasting pan. To make breading mix first set of dry ingredients in large zip lock bag. Mix yogurt 1/2 tsp. salt and 1/4 tsp. pepper in a small bowl. Rub on chicken 1 piece at a time place in bag seal and shake to coat. Arrange on wire rack; coat chicken with nonstick spray. Cut each potato in 8 wedges. Season with remaining salt pepper and paprika. Place in a single layer on baking sheet; coat potato with non-stick spray. Bake chicken on middle rack potatoes on lower rack 30 - 35 minutes turning potatoes once until chicken and potatoes are cooked through and browned. Serves 4-6.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Make your favorite biscuit dough. Roll out thin on floured board. Cover dough with butter and sugar then roll dough up. Cut in slices about 1/2-inch thick then put in skillet. Cook in 425\u00b0 oven until well browned. Pour 1 cup sweet milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla mixed over rolls and bake again for a few minutes until bubbly hot. Can add nutmeg or spice of your choice.

title: Bacon Cheese Appetizers
instructions: You will also need wooden toothpicks.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Blend margarine cream cheese and sugar. Set aside. Blend milk and pudding. When it begins to thicken blend in cream cheese mixture. Add Cool Whip. Plug hole in pot with waxed paper. Line inside of pot with Reynolds Wrap. Layer mixture with cookies. Top with cookies. Decorate with a flower.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease 3 loaf pans and fill 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Preboil potatoes 15 minutes. Peel and cut into half lengthway pieces. Place in buttered baking dish. Combine sugar salt butter and water in a saucepan. Boil 3 minutes. Pour syrup over potatoes. Bake at moderate temperature 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. Baste occasionally. Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Let spinach thaw enough that it can be broken up well. Mix all ingredients and let sit about 2 hours. Serve with raw vegetables such as cauliflower carrots celery squash etc.

title: Baked Zucchini
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise. Sprinkle cheese over cut side. Separate onion slices into rings and place over cheese. Sprinkle thick layer of bread crumbs over onion. Bake cut side up on shallow baking pan in moderate oven about 50 minutes. Cut into desired serving size. Good way to use oversized zucchini.

title: Easy Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cook uncovered 6 minutes or until mixture boils stirring occasionally during last half of cooking time.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix Ranch style dressing mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar together. Pour over broccoli and cauliflower then let set overnight in refrigerator. Next day add bacon. Ready to eat!!

title: Fantastic Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter (if using melted chocolate mix with butter in pan) over low heat. Beat sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir flour baking powder and salt together. Add chocolate and melted butter and mix altogether. Put it in a 13 x 9-inch greased and floured pan and spread. Bake about 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven and let cool. Cut into squares.

title: Chili Con Queso(Nacho Cheese Dip)
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan. Add onions and garlic. Cook until tender but not browned. Add chilies and tomatoes. Lower heat and add cheese. Cook until melted. Stir in sour cream. Cook until heated but dont boil. Serving in a crock-pot works well.

title: Vegetable Lasagne
instructions: Saute onion in oil; stir constantly for 3 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce tomato paste sugar salt garlic oregano and beans. Beat eggs. Stir in remaining ingredients reserving 2 cups cheese for topping. In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan layer noodles tomato mixture and spinach-cheese mixture. Use 1/3 tomato sauce for first layer 1/2 noodles and 1/2 spinach mixture. Repeat layers. Top layer should be tomato sauce. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. May be frozen to use later.

title: Summer Chicken Salad
instructions: On salad plate arrange spinach leaves chicken fruit celery almonds and green onions. In a dish mix together the mayonnaise and orange juice; drizzle over chicken mixture. Garnish with orange slices and strawberries. Serves 2.

title: Dallas' Chocolate Chip
instructions: Cream butter vegetable shortening sugar and brown sugar for 5 minutes. Add next 9 ingredients. Put teaspoon size clumps on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Put rice in bottom of a baking dish; add beef consomme soup plus 1/2 soup can water. Place pork chops on top; salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Slaw
instructions: In saucepan mix together eggs sugar cream and vinegar. Bring to boil until thickened. Pour over cabbage and its ready to serve.

title: Polly'S Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cut core out of the cabbage. Place in a large pot with enough water to cover cabbage. Bring to a boil and continue to boil until cabbage leaves are soft. As it boils carefully remove so it doesnt take too long and the leaves dont get mushy. Drain cabbage in a colander.

title: No Bake Honey Crispers
instructions: Place a sheet of waxed paper on a baking pan that will fit inside your refrigerator. Measure coconut and place in pie pan; set aside. Measure powdered sugar peanut butter and honey and place in medium bowl. Use a rubber spatula to get peanut butter and honey out of the measuring cups. Stir with wooden spoon until well mixed. Add cereal and raisins. Stir well. By hand roll pieces of mixture into 1-inch balls. Roll balls in coconut and place on waxed paper in baking pan. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Check to test firmness. If not firm wait for 15 to 20 minutes more.

title: Tuna And Pasta Cheddar Melt
instructions: Cook pasta in broth and water in skillet until tender; do not drain. Add soup milk and tuna. Top with cheese. Mix bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle on top. Heat through.

title: Sweet And Crunchy Party Mix
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir and repeat. Add vanilla and soda and stir. Combine cereal pretzels and nuts in brown paper bag. Pour syrup mixture over all and shake sack to coat. Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Shake again and repeat. Spread out to cool. Add bag of M&Ms when cooled.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add Coke. Let jello set until soft set. Stir in cream cheese (broken into small pieces) and nuts. Finish letting jell. Makes 4 servings.

title: Aloha Pies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Stir well to coat fruit pepper and wieners with sauce. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Stir halfway through cooking.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt eggs and vanilla. Cook on low heat until thickens. Remove from heat. Slice bananas and layer them with wafers and pudding.

title: Fast Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Whip last 2 ingredients with a fork. Add ingredients together and put in a pan. If you want thick dough use 9-inch. For thinner dough use 9 x 13-inch pan. Press dough in bottom of pan. Add 1 large can of fruit filling for 9-inch pan or 2 large cans for 9 x 13-inch.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
instructions: In skillet saute the onion and bell pepper until soft. Add the other ingredients. Simmer for 1 hour or until all ingredients are done. Cook 1 package of spaghetti in boiling salted water until tender. Drain in a colander.\tServe the meat sauce over the spaghetti.

title: Frozen Peanut Butter Chocolate Pie
instructions: Pour half and half into large bowl.\tAdd pie filling mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended 1 minute. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping and chopped candies. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm about 6 hours or overnight. Remove from freezer and let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving. Store any leftover pie in freezer.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Brown chicken in butter; remove from heat. Place chicken soup water and spices in pan. Bring to a boil. Put rice in casserole dish; pour all except 1/3 of soup mixture over rice. Place chicken on top and then pour remaining soup mixture over chicken. Bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: New York Style Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Fold in sour cream.

title: Pork Chop-Rice Casserole
instructions: Salt and fry pork chops. Set aside. Place unwashed rice in baking dish. Add consomme bell pepper onion water and celery. Stir to mix. Lay pork chops on top and cover dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until rice is flaky and tender.

title: Seven Layer Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients in greased large casserole dish. Cover with diluted soup and thin layer of cheese and bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: No-Crust Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Pie
instructions: Cook chicken 3 to 3 1/2 hours. When done set aside to cool. Take meat from bones and cut up in cubes. Make a medium white sauce. Melt margarine in skillet over low heat. Blend in flour salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Cook over low heat stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth and heavy cream. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Cook peas and carrots as directions on package. Put chicken and vegetables in white sauce and mix well. Turn into pastry lined pie pan and bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until brown.

title: Homemade Cheese Soup
instructions: Boil cabbage\tcarrots celery onion soup and water until vegetables\tare tender. Set aside. In a skillet make white sauce with butter flour and milk; add to other mixture cook until smooth. Add cheese pepper and tomatoes.\tCook until cheese is melted.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt butter over low heat. Remove from heat and mix in sugar and syrup. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add pecans and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until well done.

title: Cheese Surprise Appetizer
instructions: Mix cheese butter and flour to form dough. Shape into small balls about 1 inch in diameter. Flatten ball with hands; place one olive in center wrap dough around it sealing edges completely. Freeze until just before ready to serve. (These must be frozen.)

title: Eye Of Round Roast
instructions: Put meat in a large size brown n bag. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour meat. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Mexican Fish Sticks
instructions: Arrange fish sticks in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Toffee
instructions: Butter square pan 9 x 9 x 2-inches. Spread pecans in pan. Heat sugar and butter to boiling stirring constantly. Boil over medium heat stirring constantly for 7 minutes. Immediately spread mixture evenly over nuts in pan. Sprinkle chocolate pieces over candy; cover pan to contain heat. Spread melted chocolate over candy while hot; cut or break into small pieces.

title: Angel Buns
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water in a medium bowl. Mix in Bisquick and milk until dough forms. Smooth into ball on surface dusted with baking mix. Knead 10 times; roll 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter dipped in baking mix. Place biscuits on an ungreased sheet. Let rise in a warm place about 30 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes until golden brown. Makes 9 to 11 buns.

title: Zucchini Bites
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Spoon mixture into well-greased mini muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Ladies Home Journal Award Winning Homestyle Baked Beans
instructions: Empty baked beans in a large bowl. Fry bacon to a crisp. Keep the oil. Saute onion and green pepper. Empty in bowl. Peel or squeeze the orange juice into bowl. Chop or grind the orange peelings. Place in the bowl. Stir in the oil from bacon in the bowl also. Stir in the Brer Rabbit molasses. Combine all the ingredients into bowl. Stir well. Place baked beans and all ingredients into a baking dish. Bake 45 minutes until thickens at 350\u00b0.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Heat margarine and milk; pour over sugar and salt and stir well. Dissolve yeast in water. Beat egg slightly and add to milk mixture. Combine the two mixtures and stir in flour. With lightly greased hands mold dough into a ball. Place in bowl rubbed with oil and store in refrigerator. About 3 1/2 hours before baking knead and make into rolls. Let rise until double in bulk about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Bake in a moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Eggplant Caviar
instructions: Bake or boil eggplants and cool them. When cold scoop out the centers and the chopped onion the oil and vinegar. Salt and pepper.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Soak All-Bran in milk molasses and egg which has been mixed together until soft. Add oil. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add to liquid ingredients gently stirring just until flour disappears. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine and microwave on High for 4 minutes the sugar and syrup. Stir and add peanuts. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Add butter and vanilla. Stir and microwave for 1 minute. Stir in baking powder. Stir gently until light and foamy. Pour onto lightly greased cookie sheet. When cool break into pieces.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken until done; dont salt. Pull off bones and put aside saving broth. Stir together dressing mixes onion and melted butter. In a greased 13 x 9-inch dish put a layer of dressing crumbs a layer of chicken and a layer of mushroom soup diluted with a can of broth. Repeat with another layer of crumbs chicken and cream of chicken soup diluted with a can of broth. Top with a layer of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: All cheeses should be at room temperature. Cream ingredients together. Shape into ball and roll in chipped beef.

title: Calico Bean Pot
instructions: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces. Fry until crisp. Remove bacon and drain. Reserve 2 tablespoons of fat in skillet. Add onion and beef to skillet. Saute until onion is tender and beef is brown. Add rest of ingredients.

title: Pistachio Salad #2
instructions: Mix well then add 16 ounce carton Cool Whip and mix. Chill 1 hour.

title: Cool Whip Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine Cool Whip cottage cheese and Jell-O (straight from the box). Blend thoroughly. Add the fruits and chill.

title: Becky'S Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Soften butter and mix all ingredients. Bake 50 - 60 minutes at 350.

title: Fish Souffle
instructions: Melt butter add flour and when smooth stir in milk. Cook until thickened. Add seasoning and crumbs. Cool. Add flaked fish to sauce and mix well. Stir in egg yolks and stiffly beaten whites. Put in greased baking dish and bake in moderately hot oven until firm.

title: Death By Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake brownies; pour coffee flavor over them as they cool. Make the pudding and let it set in refrigerator awhile. When brownies are cooled and pudding set layer as follows layer brownies (crumbled) layer pudding layer Whipped Creme top with crushed candy. Start next layer; depending on size of the dish you use you can get 2 to 3 layers.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream together cream cheese margarine and powdered sugar. Mix pudding and milk. Blend pudding and cheese mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. Prepare dirt by crumbling Oreos with rolling pin or food processor. Layer in cups or flowerpot 3 layers of Oreos and 2 of pudding mixture. Put gummy worms on top. Foil wrapped plant can be added if desired. Makes enough for two 5 1/2-inch pots.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Place beans in kettle; cover in water. Add 2 teaspoons salt; soak overnight or boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit for 1 hour. Drain. Add 2 quarts of water and ham hock. Simmer 2 hours. Add veggies and seasonings. Simmer 1 hour or place in crock-pot. Add juice of 1 lemon. Top with cheese and sour cream.

title: Cheese Strudel
instructions: Unroll one can of Pillsbury crescent roll dough on an ungreased cookie sheet. Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla until well blended. Spread filling on crescent roll dough. Unroll remaining crescent roll dough and place on top of filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Dredge pork in flour. Brown in oil until done. Remove from pan. For sauce saute onion in drippings. Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add water vinegar soy sauce and pineapple liquid. Cook over low heat. Stir until thick. Serve on skewers.

title: 24 Hour Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruits well. Combine with marshmallows and nuts; let set. Beat eggs until light. Gradually add sugar cream and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly. Cook in double boiler until smooth and thick stirring constantly. Cool. Fold in whipped cream. Pour over fruit mixture and mix lightly. Chill in fruit molds or bowls for 24 hours.

title: Near-Cast White Bean Soup
instructions: Cover beans with water and bring to boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Saute onion and garlic in oil for 5 minutes. Add to beans with other ingredients. Cook covered until beans are tender. Mash beans slightly and serve. Makes about 1 1/2-quarts.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix well first 5 ingredients and add Cool Whip.

title: Three Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except margarine and Parmesan cheese until stiff dough forms. Turn dough onto surface well dusted with baking mix. Gently roll in mix to coat. Shape into ball. Knead 10 times. Roll out 1/2-inch thick. Cut with 2-inch biscuit cutter dipped in baking mix. Place on greased cookie sheet. Brush tops with margarine and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Yields 1 dozen.

title: Chicken Salad(Easy - 20 Minutes)
instructions: Rinse lettuce; drain well. Tear into small pieces. Clean and slice mushrooms. Rinse tomatoes and cucumber. Cut chicken into small chunks. Cut tomatoes into wedges. Peel and slice cucumber. Chop nuts coarsely. Put all ingredients in a bowl. Garnish with watercress or parsley.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Chill in refrigerator until served.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Yields 2 1/2 cups.

title: Tater Tot Slop
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. In same skillet saute onions; add up to 1 cup water (not to runny); heat through. Cook Tater Tots then line the bottom of a casserole dish add meat mixture; top with cheese. Bake 350 until cheese melts.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and chill. This is a different dip from the regular dips. Serve with fruit.

title: John'S Favorite Pancakes
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in bowl; mix. Add remaining ingredients; mix with fork until large lumps disappear. Grease griddle. Heat on medium-high until a few drops of water sizzle. Pour batter onto hot griddle. Turn pancakes over when bubbles form and edges start to dry. Cook on other side until desired brownness. Serves 6.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and chill. Forms 2 balls. Roll in walnuts and serve.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Drain cabbage and place in buttered casserole. Sprinkle with pepper. Cover with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Sprinkle cheese on top and pour evaporated milk over ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly on top about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Angel Food Cake(Low Sugar)
instructions: Combine flour packet from cake mix with the unsweetened cocoa. Prepare the cake according to package directions. Fold the chocolate flavoring into batter. Bake in a tube pan (according to package directions). When cooled remove from pan.

title: Lime Gelatin Salad
instructions: Prepare jello as directed on the package using the juice from the drained pineapple for a portion of the liquid. Set until this jells. Soften the cream cheese and beat the jello into the cheese. Fold in the whipped cream mayonnaise drained pineapple and nuts. Pour into a jello mold and refrigerate until firm.

title: Recovery Soup
instructions: Saute beef in large 8-quart pot. Add onion and garlic. Drain off fat. Add all ingredients in order listed. Bring to a boil. Reduce to low heat and let simmer about 1/2 hour. Stir frequently. Good served with corn muffins.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and celery in butter until tender. Add all ingredients in 10-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes. As cheese melts you may need to stir to mix well.

title: Elephant Ears
instructions: Soften yeast in water. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Divide dough into 12 pieces. Let set 20 minutes. Roll out on lightly floured board. Stack with wax paper between each piece. Heat vegetable oil in large heavy skillet. Drop in hot grease after it has been stretched out in large circle. Turn once. Should be lightly browned. Surface will bubble or blister. Turn with spatula and broad knife. Place on paper towel. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture or top with canned fruit pie.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Cook onions and celery in chicken broth until done. Mix bread crumbs; add onions celery sage parsley flakes and eggs. Mix well. Add diluted soup and enough chicken broth to make the mixture slightly thin.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine and cream cheese. Add sugar and eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add vanilla and flour. Add salt. Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan. Place in cold oven and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Let cool for 15 minutes on wire rack.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Mix together and bake covered 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Then bake 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Blend soups together and set aside. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Stir rice into melted butter in casserole dish. Blend in 1/2 of soup mixture into rice. Mix chicken pieces into remaining soup mixture and spread on top of rice mixture. Top with paprika. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Do not drain corn. Pour into 9x13 glass or metal baking pan.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix Jell-O with boiling water. Pour in a flat dish. Cool but not jelled firm. Make crust with graham crackers and butter. Blend sugar cream cheese and vanilla together. (Whip milk separate.) Drain pineapple dry; add all ingredients to milk also Jell-O. Pour over crust and refrigerate overnight.

title: Guilt-Free Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine at medium speed until combined. Gradually add egg substitute beating well. Combine sour cream and baking soda; stir well and set aside. Combine flour and salt; with mixer running at low speed add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream mixture beginning and ending with the flour mixture. Stir in vanilla. Spoon batter into 10-inch tube pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted comes out clean. Cool in pan for 10 minutes; remove from pan. Cool on wire rack.

title: Favorite Homemade Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water with sugar. Set aside for 20 minutes. In a large bowl combine yeast mixture salt and oil. Stir in cracked wheat and flours. Mix well. On a floured board knead dough for 10 to 15 minutes. Let rise in a large oiled pan or bowl for approximately 2 hours. Punch down turn over and let rise again for 1 hour. Divide into 4 equal parts. Knead each part vigorously and shape into loaves. Place loaves into 4 greased bread loaf pans. Allow to rise for 30 minutes.

title: Yams On The Half Shell
instructions: Bake yams at 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Slice off top 1/3 and scoop out. Add all other ingredients except 1/2 marmalade. Whip with beater; replace in shells. Bake 15 minutes and drizzle with remaining marmalade during last 5 minutes. (Can be done ahead and frozen but better to refrigerate set out at room temperature a while before baking last 15 minutes.)

title: Grilled Asparagus
instructions: Wash and trim fresh asparagus; roll in olive oil. Sprinkle with basil oregano salt and pepper. Broil 7 minutes.

title: Lemon Tart
instructions: Whisk eggs sugar cornmeal and flour together. Mix melted margarine milk lemon juice and rind; then add together. Pour into pie crust and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Icebox Relish
instructions: Cut cabbages onions tomatoes and green and red bell peppers finely. Add salt and mix. Let set for 30 minutes or longer. Squeeze dry with hands or in a bag. Add remaining ingredients. Keep in refrigerator. Keeps several weeks.

title: Zippy Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise; remove yolks. Mash with fork. Combine with remaining ingredients; blend well. Refill the whites using approximately 2 teaspoons mixture per egg half. Makes 16 deviled eggs.

title: Scrumptious Chocolate Layer Bars
instructions: Combine chocolate chips cream cheese and evaporated milk in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until melted mixture is smooth. Stir in walnuts and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract. Blend well. Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients; blend until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press half of mixture in greased 13 x 9-inch pan; spread with chocolate mixture. Sprinkle rest of crumbs over filling. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool. Cut in bars. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Angel Kisses
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar gradually while continuing to beat. Fold in pecans and dates. Drop in teaspoons on foil-covered cookie sheets. Place in preheated 375\u00b0 oven turn oven off and leave overnight. Do not open oven. This requires 3 cookie sheets. Arrange oven racks to accommodate before heating.

title: Almond Chicken Salad
instructions: Saut onions in butter until light brown. Drain well. Combine chicken celery mayonnaise garlic salt black pepper and drained almonds. Toss lightly to coat ingredients evenly with mayonnaise. Serve chilled.

title: Sliced Pineapple Sparkle
instructions: In small pan combine water cinnamon and cloves; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Strain. Cool. Add sweetener and fruit juices. Chill. Serve over ice cubes with cinnamon sticks muddlers. Makes 12 cups.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Shred beef slightly and cover bottom of flat greased baking dish. Wrap chicken breasts with bacon and arrange on beef. Mix soup and sour cream together; pour over chicken. Bake uncovered\tat 275\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours or at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Add broccoli that has been cooked and drained. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Zesty Glazed Carrots
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add mustard sugar salt and parsley. Stir. Add carrots and stir until glazed about 5 minutes.

title: Grape Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together and shape into small balls. Cook until brown. Mix together jelly and chili sauce. Cook over moderate heat until heated through. Pour over meatballs. Simmer 60 minutes.

title: Tostada Casserole
instructions: Brown beef with green pepper and onion; drain well. Add green olives and seasonings. Place in shallow ovenproof casserole. Spoon sour cream over meat mixture then pour beans evenly over sour cream layer. Sprinkle with corn chips then cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through and cheese melts. Serve plain or over shredded lettuce or hot rice. Serves 6.

title: Blueberry Crunch Dessert
instructions: Pour undrained pineapple in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread blueberries over pineapple. Sprinkle 3/4 cup of sugar over this mixture. Sprinkle the box of dry cake mix on top of the sugar. Next drizzle the melted margarine over the cake mix. Then sprinkle the pecans over this. Finally sprinkle the 1/4 cup sugar over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Then stick with fork all over and bake for another 15 minutes longer.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar the margarine shortening and eggs in large bowl. Stir in flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls.

title: Francis Stevens' Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Peel and cook potatoes; drain and beat a little. Add sugar and butter and continue to beat. Add eggs vanilla and milk. Pour in casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 until done about 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and put in enamel container. Add 1 cup of salt and cover with boiling water. When vinegar and water come to a boiling point pack in jars. Add 1 tablespoon of salt to each quart jar. Cover with hot mixture and seal.

title: Cheese Tuna Muffins
instructions: Boil rice; drain. Add cheese and tuna. Add rest of ingredients. Put in cupcake pan for muffins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Over the top

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
