instructions: Grease and flour two 9-inch pie pans. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour contents into pans and bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Pies make their own crust.

title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Pour into greased deep dish pie pan. Top with 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Wings
instructions: In a saucepan combine sugar salt bouillon cube vinegar catsup and soy sauce. Bring to a boil over medium heat on stove top. Stir mixture to dissolve sugar and bouillon cube. Remove from heat. Place wings in a crock-pot and cover with sauce. Cover and simmer 5 to 6 hours. Remove wings and increase heat to highest setting.

title: Breadsticks With Rosemary And Sea Salt
instructions: Brush breadsticks with olive oil. Sprinkle with rosemary and salt. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for about 8 minutes. Remove from oven. Brush with additional olive oil. Add more rosemary and salt if desired to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Easy One-Dish Ham Or Chicken Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix broccoli soup 1 cup milk ham or chicken and onion powder in ungreased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix Bisquick and 1 1/2 cups milk. Pour evenly over soup mixture. Sprinkle with parsley. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 27 to 30 minutes or until light golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Crabbies
instructions: Thoroughly blend all ingredients. Spread on muffins. Quarter the muffins and freeze on cookie sheets. Keep frozen until ready to use. (May be stored in plastic bags.)

title: Male Chauvinist Chili
instructions: In large skillet brown bacon pieces until crisp. Remove from skillet; drain well. Brown sausage and ground chuck with onions over medium heat. Drain and place in crock-pot. Add bacon and remaining ingredients; stir well. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 12 hours. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Chop shrimp and combine with other ingredients mixing well. Chill before serving. Delicious with crackers or corn chips.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients; bake in unbaked pie shell at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Pour in spaghetti sauce and simmer 10 minutes or longer. Boil noodles drain and rinse. Mix beaten eggs with cottage cheese. In oblong casserole dish pour sauce (just enough to cover dish) layer noodles cottage cheese Mozzarella and top with sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Layers can be added by increasing recipe.

title: Raisin Cake
instructions: *Or 3 teaspoons allspice.

title: Carrots With Bechamel Sauce(Venezuelan Dish)
instructions: Cut the carrots in thin slices. In a deep pan pour the water salt and carrots (the water must cover the carrots). Boil them for 15 minutes or until cooked but firm. Drain them.

title: Summer Salad With Creamy Lime-Honey Dressing(Used As Dessert Or Salad)
instructions: In bowl stir lime juice water and sugar until sugar dissolves. Add banana; set aside. In large serving bowl layer blueberries (reserve 1/2 cup for garnish) nectarines strawberries bananas watermelon and grapes. Garnish with 1/2 cup blueberries kiwi and cherries. Pour lime-sugar syrup over fruits. Cover loosely and chill. To serve spoon an assortment of fruits and berries with some of the syrup into dessert bowls; top with Creamy Lime-Honey Dressing (recipe follows).

title: Herring Salad
instructions: Mix together; add a little of the juice and a little mayo* for moisture. Eat as side dish with rye bread or snack.

title: Deep-Dish Pizza
instructions: On lightly floured surface allow dough to stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Brown meat and drain. Add onion cook until tender. Stir in tomatoes paste Parmesan cheese and your seasonings. Simmer 15 minutes. Roll out dough to 15 x 11-inch and press onto bottom and sides of greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer cheese meat sauce and your choice of pizza toppings alternately. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Old Fashion Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil eggs and sugars. Mix flour spices salt baking powder and soda. Add flour mixture to oil mixture. Stir in nuts and apples. Mix well. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Gets better with age 1 or 2 days.

title: New England Skillet Dinner
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender in a large skillet. Add carrots cover and cook 10 minutes over low heat. Add remaining ingredients cover and cook 10 minutes or until cabbage is tender.

title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box. Fill paper muffin cups (set in muffin tins). Cream the cheese with sugar; beat in egg and salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop one rounded teaspoonful of mix into each cupcake. Bake according to package directions. Yields 30 cupcakes.

title: Spinach Salad Ala Rosemary
instructions: Wash dry and tear spinach into bite sized pieces. Add thinly sliced red onion. Peel and section the oranges. Add to the spinach. Pour the Catalina dressing (not too much). Toss and serve.

title: Taco Salad Bowl
instructions: In a medium skillet brown beef and minced garlic. Drain fat; add chopped green chilies and undrained whole tomatoes with meat in skillet. Uncover; simmer 30 minutes. Shred cheese and lettuce; chop scallions and tomatoes. In a large bowl put lettuce in; arrange chips around outer edge. Place meat on lettuce; sprinkle cheese around meat and add onion tomato and olives. Top off with sour cream.

title: Tastes Like Real Cow Butter
instructions: Beat with mixer until white. Then taste the difference.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Note To keep apples from browning place them in a large bowl of slightly salted water. Drain although this minimal liquid will not affect flavor or texture.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Boil water and dissolve Jell-O in it. Add Cool Whip and strawberries. Whip until frothy. Break cake into bite-size pieces and spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour strawberry mixture over cake. Chill until set. Makes 24 servings.

title: Pecan Mystery Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar vanilla and baking powder a little bit at a time. Blend in crackers and nuts by hand. Pour into buttered pie dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. refrigerate until cold. Top with whipped cream to eat.

title: Parsnips
instructions: Cut parsnips in quarters or cubes. Cook in boiling water until tender. Drain. In skillet brown parsnips lightly in butter; salt and pepper to taste. Turn off heat and add sugar.

title: Company Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix soups mushrooms and water in pan. Heat and mix well. Put aside 1 cup of mixture. Add rice to the remaining mixture and pour into roaster. Put chicken on top of rice and pour rest on top. Bake about 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican (Rosie)
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot until cheese melts. Serve over crushed chips of your choice.

title: Sausage Cheese Grits Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 3-quart baking dish. Bring water and salt to a boil in a large saucepan. Slowly stir in grits. Cover. Reduce heat and cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.

title: Spaghetti-Os
instructions: Select undented can of Spaghetti-Os in grocery store. Select a medium size saucepan from your cupboard (one large enough for contents of can). Open can with can opener (electric or manual whichever you can use). Pour contents in pan. Place pan over medium heat. Heat until hot and bubbly. Stir occasionally to prevent burning. Remove from heat. Eat directly from pan (this saves on dishes).

title: Green Tomato Crisps
instructions: Slice tomatoes 3/16-inch thick. Soak in lime water for 24 hours. Drain and soak for 4 hours in clear water. Change water every hour. In draining and changing the water extreme care must be exercised to keep from breaking as they are very brittle. I suggest letting the water run gently from the faucet on each piece to get rid of the lime. This takes time but the pickles are nicer.

title: Wild Rice Pilaf
instructions: Place sausage in a medium skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile in a saucepan bring water to a boil. Add rice and stir in mushrooms and sausage. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Ring
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 12-cup Bundt pan or angel food cake pan 10 x 4-inches. Beat all ingredients except glaze on low speed for 30 seconds scraping bowl constantly. Beat on medium speed 3 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Spread into pan. Bake about 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes then remove from pan. Cool completely. Drizzle with glaze.

title: German Chocolate Chess Squares
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Press in bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Set aside.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix the ingredients thoroughly. Pour into a buttered casserole dish.

title: No Cook Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Grease pan. Put cream cheese in bowl; let stand at room temperature. When the cheese is soft gradually add one half pound confectioners sugar; stir constantly. Add chocolate and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Gradually add other half of sugar. Stir until smooth. Stir in nuts. Spread in pan. Place in refrigerator for 2 hours or more. Makes about 36 pieces.

title: Armenian Pilaf
instructions: Melt butter brown 1/2-inch cuts of vermicelli. Meanwhile boil 6 cups of broth in large pot you have sprayed with Pam. After broth boils add hot browned vermicelli and uncooked rice; stir in. Boil with cover ajar for 10 minutes then simmer with cover until rice is cooked and broth absorbed. Stir at least twice during simmering. You can add cut up mushrooms or pecans to your liking.

title: Kulatch' Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Beat egg and egg yolks adding to cooled milk mixture. Add flour water and sugar. Knead. Raise 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes in bread pan.

title: Fruit Cake(Makes 5)
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well mixed. Grease and flour 3 tube pans. Fill pans approximately 2/3 full. Bake all 3 at once for 2 hours in 250\u00b0 oven. Allow to cool. Remove from pans and cook the other 2. Leave batter for last 2 cakes in a bowl on the cabinet until 1st cakes are finished.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in Bundt pan.

title: Aunt Marie'S Pineapple Pudding
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar; beat in eggs one at a time. Add pineapple and bread cubes. Mix well. Bake in a greased 8-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Great side dish with ham or pork.

title: German Waffles
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake on waffle iron as directed by manufacturer. Serve warm sprinkled with powdered sugar.

title: Easy Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pineapple and cranberry sauce. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and stir into fruit mixture. Top with marshmallows and refrigerate until set or overnight.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Brown chuck. Add celery onions rice mushroom soup chicken soup and water. Add soy sauce. Put Chinese noodles on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Put apples in pan. Mix the rest of the ingredients and pour over apples. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0 in 8 x 8-inch pan. Double recipe for 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Egg-In-A-Hole
instructions: You will need a drinking glass.

title: Hot Pecans
instructions: Melt butter. Add all other ingredients. Stir pecans in mixture. Drain and place on cookie sheet. Spread out and bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0 or until done.

title: Mini Bagel Treats
instructions: Mix night before or a few hours early to blend flavors. Spread on bagelettes and broil until brown and bubbly. If you like the flavor add a little garlic.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 1/3 cups warm water. Add flour sugar and salt. Add more flour enough so you can handle dough. When smooth and elastic from kneading cover in large bowl that has been greased. Let rise for 3 hours. Pat out dough into 3 squares. Put meat cheese onion etc. you desire on top. Roll up like jelly roll and seal edges. Brush rolls with beaten egg. Bake until brown in 400\u00b0 oven for about 25 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup margarine with soup. Blend sour cream onions and cheese into soup. Stir in potatoes. Pour into casserole dish. Mix cornflakes with melted margarine. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cottage Pie - St. Patrick'S Day
instructions: Lightly brown beef in large skillet with onion and parsley. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper to taste. Cook peas and carrots. Drain and add to beef and return to heat. Stir in beef gravy and celery. Mix well and heat through. Pour into a shallow 2-quart casserole dish. Beat 1 egg into 2 cups seasoned mashed potatoes. Spoon around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon chopped chives. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven until gravy bubbles and potatoes are lightly brown about 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Caramel Brownies
instructions: Combine cake mix 1/3 cup evaporated milk and melted butter and press half of dough into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Place gravy and beef chunks in skillet. Stir in mushrooms sour cream onions garlic powder pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer 10 minutes and serve over cooked noodles. Serves 4.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix into partly settled jello the pineapple and bananas. Cook flour sugar egg pineapple juice and marshmallow over medium heat until marshmallow is melted. Let cool (about 1 hour). Mix Dream Whip and cream cheese together and beat into cooled mixture until smooth and creamy. Put on top of jello.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Grease a baking dish. Peel and slice potatoes on the bottom of the dish. Sprinkle with grated cheese salt and pepper and sprinkle flour over potatoes. Add milk to almost cover potatoes. Add butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Or Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar margarine and Milnot to boil. Cook 6 minutes stirring constantly. Take off stove and add chips and marshmallows. Beat until marshmallows are melted and pour onto buttered cookie sheets. Work fast. Makes 5 pounds.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together. Beat in eggs; add pineapple and mix together. Fold in bread. Pour into a 9 x 13 pan; bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to an hour. Raisins may be added.

title: Sausage Lentil Soup
instructions: Brown scrambled sausage. Drain fat. Add the next nine ingredients. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until lentils and vegetables are tender. Stir in the mustard. Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Mix melted margarine pecans and flour. Press in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Muenster Chicken
instructions: Beat eggs; dip chicken in. Roll in bread crumbs. Brown in butter in a pan. After browning place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour in chicken broth. Salt and pepper each breast. Sprinkle grated up cheese over each and also mushrooms. Cook at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Cook a big pot of rice. Put breast on top of rice then some juice. Use 1/2 chicken breast per person.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour into pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix crumbs flour sugar and melted butter. Pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Add coconut and milk. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix chocolate chips and peanut butter; spread over top. Cool.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: In a large skillet cook and stir ground beef and onion in butter until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in flour salt garlic pepper and mushrooms. Cook stirring constantly 5 minutes. Stir in soup; heat to boiling stirring constantly. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream; heat through. Serve over noodles or rice. Serves 4.

title: Aunt Lucille'S French Dressing
instructions: Mix in a shaker or blender.

title: Caramel-Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl use a fork to beaten egg; stir in milk. Add sweet potatoes. Stir until smooth.

title: Southern Dumplings
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add butter and mix well. Add milk slowly and mix well. Roll on floured board to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with small biscuit cutter or in strips. Drop into boiling chicken or beef broth.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: In an oblong pan or sheet pan spray Pam on bottom then spread nuts on the bottom. Put coconut on top of the nuts. Mix cake mix as directed on the the box and pour over the coconut. Melt margarine and cream cheese together add powdered sugar and pour this over the cake mix. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. This cake is \ugly\ and looks different each time you make it but it is absolutely delicious.

title: Las Vegas Zucchini
instructions: Slice zucchini 1/2 inch thick. Slice onions. Boil 5 minutes. Drain and cool. Put in a casserole along with the shredded carrot. Mix sour cream soup and cheese. Pour over vegetables. Put pats of butter and croutons on top. Cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pink Punch
instructions: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in 2 quarts of hot water. Add pineapple juice. Mix well and chill. Before serving add ginger ale. May add red food coloring for the desired pink color. Makes 50 cups.

title: Karo Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Drain pineapple; remove juice. In a large skillet heat corn oil over medium-high heat. Add next 3 ingredients. Stir-fry 2 minutes or until tender-crisp. Remove. Stir-fry pork 1/2 at a time 3 minutes. Return pork to skillet. In a bowl stir together pineapple juice and remaining 5 ingredients. Stir into skillet. Add green pepper mixture and pineapple chunks. Stirring constantly bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute. If desired serve over rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and heat just until cheese melts. Do not boil. Serve over cauliflower or broccoli. Makes enough for 1 bunch. Makes approximately 6 servings.

title: Drizzlies
instructions: Mix margarine and graham crackers. Put in pan; then add ingredients 1 layer at a time in order given. Drizzle 1 can Bordens sweetened milk over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar and eggs. Stir in vanilla and vinegar. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until top is golden brown and crust is done.

title: Grandma Ruby'S Mystery Fruit Cake(Freezes Well)
instructions: *Save out about 1/2 cup for decoration.

title: Garlic Bread(Low-Fat, High Taste Garlic Bread)
instructions: Pour or brush oil into bread under broiler until golden (goes quickly). Rub toast with fresh garlic clove. Serve immediately.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook mixed vegetables as directed and drain. Add onion celery mayonnaise and 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese to vegetables. Pour into flat casserole dish. Mix Ritz crackers margarine and 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese together. Put this on top of vegetable mixture and bake at 300 for 30 - 40 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Chicken Spread
instructions: Blend together. Add mayonnaise as needed to spread.

title: Peanut Mounds
instructions: Melt combined morsels in top of double boiler over boiling water on stove or melt in large bowl in microwave following manufacturers directions for melting chocolate. When morsels are all melted and stirred together pour in salted peanuts. Stir until all peanuts are coated. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool and harden. Then enjoy!

title: Sumi Salad
instructions: Heat oil in skillet and toast almonds and seed until lightly browned. Combine with onions cabbage noodles and dressing. Cover and chill several hours for flavors to blend. Makes about 10 servings of 1/2 cup each.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut bell peppers lengthwise in half. Remove seeds. In medium bowl combine all ingredients. Stuff peppers; cover with foil. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until beef mixture is no longer pink inside. Makes 4 servings.

title: Creamed Chicken And Rice
instructions: Flour the chicken pieces and place them in a frying pan with shortening already hot. Brown the chicken on all sides. Set aside. When all pieces have been browned pour all grease off. Add the cream of mushroom soup to the pan. Return the fried chicken to the pan and let the chicken simmer for about 20 minutes. Prepare the rice according to cooking directions. When chicken is tender (use a fork to test) remove from heat. Place rice on platter and pour creamed chicken over it. Or place creamed chicken in separate container (preferably a platter) and place rice in bowl. Let individuals serve themselves placing creamed chicken over the rice.

title: Buck Eyes
instructions: In a large bowl mix butter peanut butter and vanilla with an electric mixer. In another bowl mix together powdered sugar and graham cracker crumbs. By hand mix the crumb mixture into the creamed mixture until no sugar is visible. Roll a small amount of mixture the size of a buck eye nut between your palms and place these on waxed paper on a tray. Be sure that the tray will fit on your refrigerator shelf. Refrigerate for several hours. Later mix paraffin wax and chocolate chips in top of double boiler. Pierce each ball and and roll in wax and chocolate mixture until just a small portion of the ball in not covered by chocolate. Use toothpicks to roll the balls in the chocolate. When coated place the balls on the waxed paper and refrigerate again. This is a large amount and a portion can be frozen for future use.

title: Grilled Potatoes
instructions: Mix mayonnaise garlic and seasonings in a large bowl. Add potatoes and onions toss to coat. Put potato mixture evenly into foil packets. Seal each side to form a packet. Place on grill covered 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: My ideas on dressing eels are get someone else to do it for you but if that fails Nail his head to the wall; cut around his body below the head. Take a pair of pliers and rip off his hide! By the way eel skins make a good stout tie for pony tails shoestrings or what have you.

title: Boursin Cheese
instructions: Soften cream cheese and butter. Blend well. Add spices. Refrigerate. Soften awhile before serving. Can be rolled into a ball and rolled in peppercorns.

title: Crawfish Creole
instructions: Preheat electric skillet to 300\u00b0. Pour in oil and saute onions celery and green pepper until tender but not brown. Add tomatoes tomato sauce bay leaves sugar salt chili powder and Tabasco. Mix well add crawfish. Cover and reduce temperature. Simmer 30 minutes or longer. Mix flour and water. Add to mixture and cook about 5 minutes longer or until thickened. Serve over cooked rice. Serves 6.

title: Beef-Spinach Casserole
instructions: Saute in skillet until beef and onio are brown and tender. Cook and drain. Combine beef spinach soup and sour cream. Season to taste. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rustic Reuben Salad
instructions: Combine greens tomato and croutons in a large serving bowl. Add remaining ingredients; toss lightly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Frozen Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff then add vanilla; add 1 cup sugar gradually. Then add 1 pint thawed strawberries juice and all. Continue beating at high speed for 15 minutes. Add Cool Whip. Fold into mixture. Crush vanilla wafers and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Save some for top. (Put in freezer. Ready to serve as soon as set.)

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown roast on both sides in 1 tablespoon corn oil. Remove from pot and saute onion bell pepper and celery. Return roast to pot and add 1 cup water. Cook approximately 1 hour. Pour off broth and put in refrigerator to chill and remove fat. Put back in pot and add tomatoes (fresh and canned) beans carrots Equal and black pepper. Cook until done. Cut beef into small pieces and serve over cooked rice.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix celery onion chicken mayonnaise chicken soup water chestnuts and rice together. In saucepan saute the almonds and Special K in butter. Spread over top of other ingredients. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Nut Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form in small balls. Refrigerate then slice.

title: Monkey Cake
instructions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Roll in sugar cinnamon and nut mixture. Layer in tube pan. Boil the margarine and brown sugar; pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Ginny'S Delight
instructions: Mix eggs milk salt and dry mustard. Layer bread cheese and ham into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour on egg mixture. Top with cornflakes. Drizzle with oleo. Cover and let stand in refrigerator for 24 hours (or overnight). Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Black-Eyed Peas And Rice
instructions: It is important to use the dried peas in this recipe for their nutlike flavor. Cook them to package directions and drain before measuring the 1 1/3 cups. Mix together the cooked rice peas garlic chilies and chopped onion. Butter a casserole dish and put 1/3 of the mixture in the dish. Combine Ricotta cheese and sour cream; spread 1/3 of the mixture over the layer. Top with 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat layers twice. Mix the last 1/3 of the cup of cheese with the black olives before topping off the casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Combine flour powdered sugar and oleo. Press into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients well and pour over baked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes longer.\tWatch closely bars tend to brown quickly. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and loosen sides after removing from oven.

title: More-Hamburger Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add remaining ingredients except noodles and cheese. Place a layer of noodles in a 10-inch baking dish. Top with hamburger mixture then cheese. Repeat layers. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Rice
instructions: Mix together. Cover dish and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Scrabble
instructions: Heat oven to 250 degrees. Melt butter in a large shallow pan over low heat. Stir Worcestershire sauce and seasoned salt. Add cereal and nuts and pretzels. Mix well. Heat for 45 minutes. Spread out on absorbent paper to cool.

title: Blueberry Slump
instructions: Mix blueberries water and 1/2 cup sugar. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Combine flour 1/4 cup sugar soda and salt. Cut butter into flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in buttermilk just until flour is moistened. Drop batter by tablespoons atop bubbling blueberry mixture making 6 dumplings. Cover pan tightly; simmer 15 minutes (dont lift lid).

title: Cranberry Apple Relish
instructions: Dice apricots into small pieces. Peel and section oranges; cut meat out of oranges squeeze juice from membrane. Save orange sections. Bring orange juice sugar cranberries and water to a boil then reduce heat and cook until berries begin to pop. Cool 5 minutes. Pour cranberry mixture over apricots and let stand 10 minutes. Stir in oranges and apple. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Will thicken upon standing. Makes 3 1/2 cups.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cream oleo sugar and corn meal. Add eggs vanilla vinegar salt and milk. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish sprayed with Pam place shredded carrots. Melt together all other ingredients except pineapple. Add pineapple with juice. Pour over carrots and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until thick and glazy.

title: Hard Candy
instructions: Sprinkle 18 x 24-inch strip of heavy duty aluminum foil with powdered sugar. Mix sugar corn syrup and water in large heavy saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Boil without stirring until temperature reaches 310\u00b0 or until drops of syrup form hard and brittle threads in cold water. Remove from heat. Stir in flavoring oil and coloring. Pour onto foil. Cool. Break into pieces. Store in airtight container. Makes 2 1/4 pounds.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: In saucepan bring milk to boiling. Stir in uncooked rice raisins and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cover; cook on low heat stirring occasionally for 30 to 40 minutes or until most of the milk is absorbed. (Mixture may appear curdled.) Spoon into dessert dishes. Add butter sugar and cinnamon if desired.

title: Granny'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Slice potatoes thin and boil until soft. Drain water and add margarine eggs sugar salt and milk. Beat on high until all lumps are gone. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into shells and bake at 400\u00b0 approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill. Serve on lettuce leaves. Garnish with slices of canned apricots.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix together in very large baking dish.

title: Hawaiian Bread Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water. Slice off top of Hawaiian bread and hollow out the center. Combine the ham cream cheese dressing dissolved bouillon and meat; mix well. Pour into hollowed out bread. Serve with crackers excess bread pretzels or vegetables.

title: Never Fail Pie Meringue
instructions: Cook until clear and thick the sugar cornstarch and water. Let cool. Beat egg whites with a pinch of salt plus vanilla until it forms a soft peak; add slowly 3 or 4 tablespoons sugar. Beat until it forms peaks then add to the cool cornstarch mixture; beat again until it looks like whipped cream. Put on top of your favorite pie and bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Dip For Fruit
instructions: Mix marshmallow cream with softened cream cheese. Fold in regular size whipping cream after it is whipped. Suggested fruit pineapple strawberries kiwi seedless grapes apples oranges bananas.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Put in a smaller bowl to serve.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread(Fall Bread)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease loaf pan. Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter. Combine orange peel orange juice and eggs. Add to dry ingredients mixing just to moisten. Fold in berries and nuts. Pour into greased pan. Bake 1 hour.

title: Mock Lobster
instructions: Place fish in a well buttered baking dish. Coat with the soup (do not dilute soup). Cook 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Take crackers and crush in plastic bag. Melt margarine. Add to crackers garlic powder and put over fish. Bake for another 10 minutes. Let stand for a few minutes before serving. Preparation time 10 minutes. Total cooking time 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mom'S Butterscotch Dumplings
instructions: In saucepan cook brown sugar light syrup water butter and vanilla until bubbly. Drop 6 biscuits into sauce and simmer 10 minutes uncovered. Cover and simmer 10 minutes more. (Can cut biscuits before dropping them into boiling sauce.) Serve warm in dessert dishes. Spoon sauce over top. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chili tomato and onion. Stir-fry until heated through (still crisp). Push vegetables to side of skillet. Add eggs. Cook and stir until eggs are almost set then stir in vegetables and cook 1 or 2 minutes longer. Season with salt to taste. Serve with flour tortillas either rolled or under. May be served with chopped potatoes and chorizo (Mexican sausage) fried.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Cook broccoli until tender. Cook rice. Combine all ingredients in casserole. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle top with grated cheese and heat until cheese melts.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs syrup vanilla sugar and butter. Blend well. Stir in nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Tomato Dressing
instructions: Shake all ingredients together. Store in refrigerator.

title: Rice And Meatballs
instructions: Shape into balls; put in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Combine hot water and beef seasoning packet. Pour over meat. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Turn meatballs halfway through cooking. Makes 16 to 24 meatballs.

title: Hawaiian Banana Pecan Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat. Combine with bananas orange rind vanilla and almond extract. Mix thoroughly; add milk finely chopped coconut finely chopped pecans and flour sifted with soda and salt. Bake in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch greased loaf pan for about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hostess Twinkie Cake
instructions: Make yellow cake and cut into 2 layers. Blend at high speed remaining ingredients then add 1/4 cup powdered sugar and blend.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain and chop fruit. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add lemonade and stir until melted. Chill until slightly thickened. Blend in Cool Whip and fold in fruit. Pour into 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Freeze until firm about 4 hours. Unmold and slice.

title: Molded Strained Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Cook cranberries in water until all the skins pop open. Strain through a colander to remove skins. Return to saucepan; add sugar and blend. Boil rapidly for 10 to 15 minutes or until a drop jells on a cold plate. Pour mixture into 1 large or individual molds and chill until firm.

title: Happy Endings Cake Or Best Rum Cake Ever
instructions: Before you start sample rum for quality good isnt it? Now select a large mixing bowl measuring cup etc. Check rum again to be sure rum is highest quality. Pour 1 level cup into a glass and drink as fast as you can. Repeat. With electric mixer beat 1 cup butter in a large fluffy bowl. Add 1 seaspoon of thugar and beat again. Meanwhile make sure rum is of finest quality. Try another cup (or two). Open 2nd quart if necessary. Add 2 arge leggs 2 cups fried druit and beat until high. If druit gets stuck in beaters just pry it loose with drew scriver. Sample rum again checking for tonscisticity. Next sift 3 cups pepper or salt (it really doesnt matter). Sample rum again. Sift 1/2 pint of lemon juice. Fold in chopped butter and strained nuts. Sample rum again. Add 1 babblespoon of brown thugar or whatever color you can find. Wix mell. Grease oven and turn pake can to 350 gregees. Now pour the whole mess into the boven and ake. Check rum again and bo to ged.

title: Applesauce Jello
instructions: Melt red hots in boiling water. Add jello. Mix until dissolved. Add rest of ingredients and refrigerate until it jells.

title: Bobby'S Rotel Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger with 57 Sauce. Drain. Cube Velveeta and melt in heavy saucepan with Ro-Tel tomatoes (I use extra tomatoes). Add hamburger that has been seasoned with Heinz 57. Mix well and eat with tortilla chips or Fritos.

title: Goofy Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake mix margarine and 1 egg in pan. Press mixture in pan pressing edges a little higher around the pan. In mixing bowl combine powdered sugar 2 eggs and cream cheese. Cream until smooth. Pour over cake mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes. Sprinkle powdered sugar over cake either cooled or hot.

title: Pull Apart Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix cinnamon and sugar together. Melt oleo. Place raisins in center of biscuit and roll into balls. Roll balls in melted oleo then in cinnamon-sugar mixture. Place in Bundt pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Saute chopped vegetables in margarine. Debone chicken saving broth. In a large pan put crumbled cornbread cooked rice cornflakes and sauteed vegetables. Pour chicken broth over this mixture until moist. Let sit for a few minutes so that cornbread can soak up broth. Add more broth if necessary so that mixture is nice and moist. Add deboned chicken and chopped eggs. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot. Stir. Finish baking until golden brown on top. This can be mixed up the day before you plan to bake it. Serves about 24 people.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie(Stagecoach Inn Recipe)
instructions: Melt the chocolate squares and butter over low heat. Add all the other ingredients and pour into the pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Graham Cracker Chops
instructions: Salt and pepper both sides of pork chops. Crush graham crackers until quite fine in texture. Coat each chop with graham crackers. Place in single file into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake covered in preheated oven for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn oven down to 250\u00b0 and bake for 2 to 3 hours longer. Serve with rice and vermicelli.

title: Herb Dip
instructions: Mix together until smooth. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Date Meringues
instructions: Beat egg whites (at room temperature) at high speed or an electric mixer 1 minute. Gradually add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves (about 2 to 4 minutes). Fold in dates coconut and pecans. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool on cookie sheets. Store in a loosely covered container. Yield about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Vegetarian Split Pea Soup
instructions: In large saucepan combine first nine ingredients; bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for one hour or until peas are tender stirring occasionally. Add salt and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes longer. In small batches puree soup in blender. Return to pan and heat for 5 minutes. Garnish with shredded carrots.

title: Cheesy Blueberry
instructions: Mix cornflakes and melted butter thoroughly in a 9-inch pie pan. Press evenly over bottom and side to form crust. Chill. In bowl beat cream cheese until smooth and light. Gradually add condensed milk. Blend well until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. turn into crust. Refrigerate 24 hours. Top with pie filling before serving.

title: Chocolate Pudding
instructions: In a food processor finely chop bread for 2 cups of crumbs. Mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs. Stir in milk. Add vanilla. Bake in a 10 x 10-inch baking dish at 350\u00b0 until firm. May be served with whipped cream flavored with Scuppernong wine.

title: Apple Or Cherry Pastry
instructions: Mix margarine sugar vanilla and flour together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with apple or cherry pie filling nuts cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Egg And Sausage Strata
instructions: Line a greased 9 x 13-inch pan with bread cubes. Brown sausage with onion and green pepper; drain. Stir in pimento; sprinkle over bread. In a bowl combine eggs milk Worcestershire mustard salt and pepper. Pour over meat mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Petite Cream Puff Appetizers
instructions: Have ready chicken tuna crab or ham salad or some of each.

title: Orange Pineapple Drink
instructions: Prepare orange juice as directed on can. Add pineapple juice and Kool-Aid prepared with sugar. Add 7-Up and ice to fill a 2 gallon container.

title: Delicious Chicken
instructions: In deep baking pan put chicken breasts bone side down. Sprinkle dry onion soup over top; pour in milk and bake 30 minutes. Turn chicken in broth a few minutes then turn over again and brown a golden brown. Bake 1 hour in all.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook the chicken in salted and peppered water. Cool and remove meat from bones. Put meat into buttered 9 x 13 casserole dish. Mix the soups and sour cream. Pour over the chicken. Top with full package of herb dressing. Drizzle with the melted butter then pour the chicken broth over top evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Applesauce Brownies
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs mix well. Sift dry ingredients together. Add alternately with applesauce to creamed mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with 2 Tbsp. sugar. 1 C. chocolate chips and 1 C. chopped nuts.

title: Nutty Broccoli Slaw
instructions: Crush noodles and place in a large bowl.

title: Pizza Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese in a greased pie pan. Sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder. Spread pizza sauce on top. Sprinkle with shredded mozzarella and cheddar (if desired). Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top. Serve hot with Doritos. Can add green peppers black olives and pepperoni to sauce if desired.

title: Boilermaker Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; saut until tender about 8 minutes. Reduce heat. Add chili sauce beer molasses vinegar bourbon and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until reduced to 2 cups stirring occasionally about 25 minutes. Stir in hot pepper sauce. Brush on during the last 10 minutes of grilling. If making ribs brush them often during the first part of cooking with a mixture of one part cider vinegar to 10 parts of water and a pinch of dried crushed red pepper; that will keep them moist (covers 3 pounds of meat). Can be made up to 1 month ahead. Cover; chill.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat egg whites with salt until stiff. Slowly add sugar and vanilla. Fold in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Put in oven; turn oven off and leave overnight.

title: Chili Rice Supper
instructions: Brown beef and onions in skillet. Add spices corn green pepper tomato sauce and water. Cover and bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Stir in rice reduce heat cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Mom'S Brisket
instructions: Put sliced onions into pan and brown. Trim fat off brisket and sprinkle paprika on both sides. Put fat side up over onions. Sprinkle onion soup mix over both sides and add water. Cook over a very slow burner for several hours covered. Enjoy!

title: Pork Chops Cacciatore
instructions: Trim fat from chops. Heat fat in skillet; when you have about 1 tablespoon melted fat remove trimmings. Brown chops; season with salt and dash of pepper. Place in an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Top each chop with onion slice. Combine next 3 ingredients; pour over chops. Cover with foil; bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1 hour. Uncover; top chops with green pepper. Bake 15 minutes. Serve with hot cooked rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Yuletide Almond Cookies
instructions: Combine cream cheese margarine sugar and extract mixing until well blended. Add flour; mix well. Chill several hours or overnight. With lightly floured hands shape level tablespoonfuls of dough into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool. Dip half of each cookie in chocolate; coat with almonds.

title: Mock Sour Cream
instructions: In blender whirl all ingredients at high speed until smooth. Makes 1 cup. Has 16 calories per tablespoon.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In large plastic bag add all ingredients. Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking or roasting pan; discard bag. Bake stirring occasionally 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish if desired with chopped parsley. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Cucumbers And Sour Cream
instructions: Slice cucumbers thin. Add all other ingredients and mix. May need a little sugar.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Add cracker crumbs and 1 stick of melted butter. Place in an 8 x 12-inch cake pan.

title: Parmesan And Garlic Potatoes For Four
instructions: Microwave potatoes. When done place in 9 x 13 baking dish and make slits in top of potatoes. Spread with lots of butter on top. Sprinkle with garlic powder and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Garlic And Artichoke Bread
instructions: On a floured board roll dough into a 12 x 18-inch rectangle (let rest 5 minutes if springy). Brush half the marinade over dough; sprinkle with artichokes 1 cup cheese garlic basil and oregano. From a long edge roll dough into a snug log; pinch seam to seal.

title: Jambalaya(Stove Top Recipe)
instructions: Use a 5-quart black iron pot. Pour oil in pot. Season hen with black pepper. Brown hen over high heat. Reduce to medium-high when oil clears. Continue browning until meat is brown and pot has a layer of brown on it. Add onions and the first teaspoon of garlic powder. Saute over low heat until onions are clear. Add water. Stir and bring mixture to a full boil. Turn fire off and allow oil to rise. Skim off as much oil as possible without skimming gravy. Add rest of seasonings and bring to a full boil again. Adjust seasonings to taste. All should be a little in excess to allow for the rice. Add rice. Bring to a relatively vigorous boil stirring to prevent sticking. Reduce heat to lowest setting. Cover and allow to cook 10 minutes. Remove lid and stir mixture allowing liquid to go down into rice. Replace the lid and cook for 20 minutes more. Remove lid and serve. Serves 8 adults.

title: Holly Cookies
instructions: Combine marshmallows butter vanilla and food coloring in top of a double boiler (or in a big heavy saucepan my pressure cooker bottom). Heat until marshmallows and butter are melted stirring frequently. Take from heat and gradually stir in cornflakes and stir until well coated. Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper. Decorate with cinnamon candies. Leave to dry several hours or overnight.

title: Sausage And Bean Chowder
instructions: Brown the sausage stirring to crumble and drain. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Supreme Cake
instructions: Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown and cake turns loose from pan.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Stir the 2 boxes of pudding and milk by hand or whisk (no mixer). Use 1 cup less milk than what directions on boxes call for. Usually you would use 3 cups for 2 small boxes of mix. Fold in Cool Whip and sour cream. Layer wafers sliced bananas and pudding mixture. Repeat! This makes 2 layers in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with crushed wafers.

title: Egg Pie
instructions: Mix together. Cook until thick. Pour into prepared pie shell.

title: Doughnut Muffins
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco; add egg. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Spoon into greased muffin tins and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from pan and roll in 6 tablespoons melted butter. Then roll in mixture of 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.

title: Weight Watchers Snickers Bar
instructions: Chop ice cream and add Cool Whip. Mix and add peanut butter and pudding; add Grape-Nuts. Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan. Freeze then cut into 8 squares. Each piece has 25 calories.

title: Charlie Brown'S Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate together. Place in a large bowl. Add beaten eggs vanilla sugar sifted flour and chopped nuts. Stir well. Pour into a greased baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Center should stay moist. Cool before cutting.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Mix in dry ingredients. Add raisins. Drop by rounded teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Mexican Layered Dip
instructions: Mix bean dip and green chilies. Mix sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning. Layer it all in a large casserole.

title: Pineapple Noodle Kugel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Parboil noodles in salted water rinse and drain. Combine eggs and melted butter (or margarine) and beat well. Mix in the sugar then the rest of the ingredients except the noodles. Mix well. Break up any lumps. Add the noodles and mix to combine everything. Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour in the kugel mixture. Bake 50 to 60 minutes until golden and done (a knife inserted into the middle of the kugel should come out clean). Allow to cool slightly cut into squares and serve warm.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat butter sugar and eggs until fluffy. Add vanilla. Add flour and salt until stiff dough consistency. Wrap in wax paper. Chill 3 hours or until firm. Cut cookies on lightly floured board; place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool on wire rack and decorate.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Saute onions green pepper and celery in margarine. Mix bread crumbs with the seasonings in a large bowl. Add sauteed ingredients and pour in broth; mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan and cover. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncover and bake for an additional 5 minutes. Yields 15 to 18 servings.

title: Molasses Crumb Cake
instructions: Reserve 1-1/2 c. crumbs; add liquid and mix into crumbs. Batter will be lumpy. Pour into greased and floured baking pan. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake tests done. Approximately 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Season chicken with salt pepper and ginger. Dredge with flour and brown by frying in oil. Add onion celery and tomatoes. Place in casserole dish cover and put in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until tender and brown.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Candy
instructions: In a pot boil cocoa sugar butter and milk for 1 1/2 minutes. Take off heat and add peanut butter and oatmeal. Stir well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on foil or wax paper. Let harden.

title: Steak And Gravy
instructions: Cut steak into strips. Roll in flour salt and pepper. Fry in skillet until done turning once. Remove steak into platter. Keep hot. Put a little flour in drippings in skillet; stir well. Then add milk enough to make gravy. Serve over steak.

title: Stuffed Round Steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small skillet melt 3 tablespoons butter. Add onion and celery. Cook and stir over medium heat until tender. Transfer to medium mixing bowl. Add bread crumbs salt pepper sage thyme and garlic powder. Dissolve bouillon granules in hot water. Add to crumb mixture and mix well.

title: Maria'S Flan
instructions: Melt sugar and pour in pan. Combine the other ingredients and pour into pan. Place pan in a slightly larger pan filled with enough water to just reach the top of the side after the pan containing the mixture is placed inside. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove and allow to cool. Invert pan onto a plate and tap gently until the flan drops to the plate. Chill and serve.

title: Small Apple Dumplings
instructions: Unroll crescents. Wrap 1 slice apple in each and pinch edges to seal. Melt margarine. Place dumplings in well-greased 9 x 13 pan. Drizzle butter or margarine over dumplings. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Pour Mt. Dew over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: French Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream thoroughly the shortening sugar and egg. In separate bowl mix flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Stir flour mixture into creamed mixture alternately with milk. Fill greased or paper lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Immediately after baking roll muffins in melted butter then into sugar and cinnamon. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Beat. Sift flour cocoa and salt together. Add to mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 35 minutes at 300\u00b0. Remove from oven. Spread marshmallows evenly over top. Return to oven for 5 minutes. Take out of oven and spread with the following frosting.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate for one hour before serving.

title: Chicken Salad Tostados
instructions: Boil whole chicken in water with head of garlic and onions and salt until cooked. Shred the chicken. Add mayonnaise onions black pepper salt and can of mixed vegetables to shredded chicken. Put chicken salad on top of tostadas and enjoy!

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Roast peppers under broiler until blackened. Cool and peel. Chop peppers onion and mushrooms. Cook vegetables in small amount of olive oil until tender in stock pot. Brown sausage and ground beef. Add vegetables and seasoning. Add garlic only after to avoid burning. Add tomato puree. Bring to simmer for 2 to 3 hours depending on how hot you want sauce. Remove hot sausage. Makes very large amount. May be frozen or use half the recipe.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix everything the day ahead except cheese and potato chips. Add cheese and chip mixture right before heating in a 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Serves 8.

title: Skillet Fried Fresh Corn
instructions: Cut corn off. Scrape milk starch from corn. Cover with water enough to cook. Salt to taste. Add the seasoning and sugar. Cook slowly after bringing to a boil to assure proper well done state. Let corn almost stick to skillet stirring constantly to reach some golden brown layer to mix in corn. It will almost appear scorched but it is delicious.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add egg milk soda baking powder and remaining ingredients. Roll out dough and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Macaroni-Hawaiian Style
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges; save juice. Cook macaroni in salt water; drain and rinse. Put in large covered bowl. Mix together sugar flour salt and eggs with reserved juice. Cook until thick. Pour hot sauce over macaroni. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve add fruit and Cool Whip.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Brown ground beef and garlic; drain fat. Blend next 4 ingredients in bowl; stir in ground beef. Fill each manicotti with about 1/4 cup cheese-meat filling. Place manicotti in single layer in 10 x 8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with any remaining filling. Cover completely with sauce. Sprinkle with oregano and Parmesan cheese. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer. Serves 4.

title: Adam'S Apple Pie
instructions: Roll out and put in pie tin. Slice apples in crust and add sugar. Put top on and cut holes in to let air out. Sprinkle top with sugar.

title: Cucumber Salad(China)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a salad bowl thoroughly add cucumbers and bell pepper. Chill well.

title: Cheesy Grits Casserole
instructions: Cook grits according to package directions. Add butter and cheese; stir until melted. Add Worcestershire sauce and 1 teaspoon paprika mixing well. Add a small amount of hot grits to eggs stirring well; stir egg mixture into remaining grits. Pour grits into a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon paprika. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Sift flour soda and salt together. Beat eggs well. Add sugar and beat until smooth. Add oil. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Stir in cereal and nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Batter will keep 3 weeks in refrigerator or may be baked and frozen.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients in a large bowl and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Garnish with red and green bell peppers.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and chill for several hours. Serve on bed of lettuce.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: In a large skillet combine everything except rice and cook until chicken is done. While this is cooking fix your rice according to package directions. When everything is cooked pour rice in with chicken and stir.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Put potatoes and other ingredients in greased baking dish. Cover with topping mixture.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Put in large pan and boil to desired thickness. Will keep in refrigerator for a long time.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Mix bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and parsley. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray Pam on tinfoiled metal sheet. Dip chicken in melted butter. Coat in crumb mixture. Place on tinfoil. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle garlic salt lemon pepper and oregano generously on both sides of chicken. Place in container; pour lemon juice over chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. Preheat gas grill. Place chicken pieces skin side up on grill. Cook chicken with cover down on low to medium heat 50 to 55 minutes or until done. Turn and baste about every 10 minutes; sprinkle with paprika. Makes 6 servings.

title: Coleslaw Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. Great on cole slaw and tossed salad.

title: Caramel Puff Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients except puff corn. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Add 1/2 teaspoon soda. Mix well with spoon until foamy. Spray a large paper bag with Pam. Pour in one bag Puff corn then 1/2 caramel mixture. Mix with spoon to coat corn. Dump in second bag and rest of caramel mixture. Mix with spoon. Microwave bag 1 1/2 minutes on High. Shake bag. Microwave another 1 1/2 minutes. Shake bag. Microwave another 1 1/2 minutes. Shake bag. Microwave 1 more minute. Shake bag and pour into large bowl. (Make sure when you shake the bag you shake it vigorously to get all pieces coated.)

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Pour into a baking pan. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake 1 hour.

title: Baked Potato Topping
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve on baked potato.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Chill until slightly thickened. Meanwhile overlap thin cucumber slices in the bottom of 8 inch square pan. Stir remaining ingredients into chilled gelatine. Set gelatine bowl firmly into ice and whip with beater until light and fluffy. Pile whipped gelatine on top of cucumbers. Chill until firm. Serve squares on a bed of lettuce with slices of tomato.

title: Texas Cornbread(Serves 12 To 15)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix together all ingredients in a large bowl. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Pour mixture into pan and bake until done 20 to 30 minutes. Cool slightly. Cut into serving size pieces. Best served warm.

title: Baked Pork Chops With Beans
instructions: Season the chops with salt and pepper; brown them well in a skillet. Place the chops in a shallow baking dish. Drain fat from skillet and saute the onion and green pepper in butter or margarine. Add the garlic baked beans chili sauce brown sugar Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Pour over chops. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Roy'S Chicken
instructions: Mix the soy sauce wine hoisin ginger lemon peel lemon juice and pepper. Pour into a large sturdy plastic bag. Add the chicken; seal bag and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Before cooking drain chicken and discard marinade. Arrange chicken side down in a single layer in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake uncovered in a 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Turn chicken over skin side up and cook another 10 minutes for breasts (20 minutes for legs and thighs) or until meat is no longer pink when slashed. Or instead of cooking barbecue over a low fire.

title: Chocolate Triple
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box. Let cool completely then crumble it into pieces. Add Kahlua to crumbled cake; set aside. Make pudding with 3 cups milk instead of the required 4 cups; chill. In a deep glass bowl put 1/2 the cake and Kahlua mix then 1/2 the pudding and 1/2 the Cool Whip. Continue these layers until used up. Top off with crushed candy bars. Each layer of Cool Whip should be topped with candy bar.

title: Impossible Lasagna Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10-inch pie plate. Layer cottage cheese Parmesan cheese cooked hamburg oregano bay leaves tomato paste and Mozzarella cheese evenly over the top. Beat milk and Bisquick for 15 seconds. Pour over the other ingredients. Bake until a knife comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Slice squash and cook with onions until tender. Drain. Add butter salt pepper and milk. Mix all together. Add beaten egg cheese and bread crumbs. Pour into a greased casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Neiman-Marcus Brownies
instructions: Mix pecan cake mix melted margarine and 1 egg and put in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese and 2 eggs well and pour on top of cake mix. Sprinkle with chopped pecans and bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 55 minutes.

title: Bourbon Franks
instructions: In a large saucepan mix all ingredients except franks. Cover and simmer at least 2 hours. Stir occasionally. Add franks and simmer until heated through. Serve in a chafing dish.

title: Microwave Rice Pudding
instructions: In a 2-quart microwave dish blend sugar cornstarch and salt. Stir in milk; mix well. Microwave on High for 7 minutes stirring every 3 minutes. Stir small amounts of hot pudding into well beaten egg then return to hot pudding. Microwave 4 minutes; stir after 1 minute and continue to microwave until thick then add butter and vanilla and stir in cooked rice.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Put in a greased casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt 1/2 pound Velveeta cheese with 1/3 cup milk. Pour over top after it cooks. Serves 10 to 12 easily.

title: Dirt Cake(Child'S Recipe)
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies with rolling pin and set aside. Mix together softened cream cheese 10x sugar and softened butter. In another bowl beat together the pudding and milk. Add Cool Whip and cream cheese mixture. In an 8-inch plastic clay flowerpot layer 1/3 of crumb mix 1/2 of cream mix 1/3 crumb mix and remaining cream mix. Top with crumb mix. Refrigerate overnight. Put flowers in center of full pot. Use trowel to serve. Add gummy worms (candy) for color.

title: Mary'S Easy Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: In skillet brown meat just until done. Drain off fat. Place meat in large casserole dish. Layer frozen vegetables over meat. Mix water with gravy mix; pour evenly over meat and vegetable layers. Spread mashed potatoes over other layers. Dot with margarine if desired. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Remove cover and bake an additional 15 minutes or until potatoes are slightly browned. Excellent one dish meal.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine corn green beans peas onion celery green pepper and pimento in a large bowl. In another bowl mix vinegar sugar oil salt and pepper together. Beat slightly to help dissolve sugar. Pour over vegetables and cover. Chill for several hours.

title: Welsh Lemon Curd(Ceuled Lemwn)
instructions: Be careful of your selection. Do not choose too young and take only such varieties as have been raised in good moral atmosphere. When once decided upon and selected let that part remain forever settled and give your entire time and thought to preparation for domestic use.

title: Cherry Supreme Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cherry pie filling; stir well. Add pineapple with juice; mix well. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until set.

title: Chocolate-Filled Cake
instructions: Heat water until hot. Drop in Better chocolate. Add margarine. Add chocolate mixture eggs and buttermilk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Christmas Cake Cookies
instructions: Discard date pits and cut dates in chunks. (I purchase the pitted dates.) Cut candied cherries in quarters. Slice candied pineapple in thin slivers. Chop walnuts and pecans coarsely (you can use almonds but you need to toast them until golden. You can also use Brazil nuts with the almonds but they are a little crunchy. You might vary the nuts to your liking.) Sift flour baking soda salt and cinnamon together. Start oven at 350\u00b0F or moderately hot. Cream butter until soft and creamy. Add sugar gradually and continue working until smooth. Beat in the eggs thoroughly then stir in sifted flour combination and all fruit and nuts.

title: Breakfast Balls
instructions: Roll into balls and bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. These can be made the night before or you can freeze them. Serve with jelly.

title: Choco-Peanut Parfait
instructions: Crush cookies. Combine with 1/2 cup melted butter. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Freeze 1 hour.

title: Potato Casserole(Aka Company Potatoes)
instructions: Let hash browns thaw at least 30 minutes. Mix all ingredients spread into casserole dish. Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

title: Aunt E'S Curried Chicken Bites
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into bite size pieces and place in pan with small amount of butter. Cover with wax paper and place in 400 degree oven for 6 to 8 minutes. (Chicken is done if it springs back when pressed with finger.) Combine with other ingredients. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Beef And Sour Cream
instructions: Cut steak into 1 inch cubes. Heat shortening on medium-high setting. Add onion and garlic and saute until onions yellow. Add meat and brown well on all sides. Pour off any fat. Add remaining items and blend. Cover and bake in 2 qt. casserole for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggnog Pudding And Pie Filling
instructions: Mix gelatin sugar and salt. Gradually stir in eggnog. Warm over direct low heat until gelatin is dissolved. Chill until mixture mounds when dropped from spoon. Fold in whipped cream flavorings and 1 1/2 cups fruit cocktail. Chill again for 5 to 10 minutes. Heap into pie shell; decorate with remaining fruit cocktail. Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in powdered sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add milk. Blend thoroughly into mix. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Can grate milk chocolate on top.

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in bowl mix well. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Make well in center. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add to scalded milk after cooled in bowl. Pour into dry ingredients. Mix well. Knead 15 to 20 times. Let stand for 10 minutes. Roll 1/4-inch thick on floured surface; cut into squares or triangles. Deep fry at 420\u00b0 until puffed and golden brown. Yields 24 servings.

title: Candy Apples
instructions: You will also need 8 wooden skewers.

title: Nut Cookies
instructions: Set oven at 325\u00b0. Combine ingredients and form nickel size balls.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Brown celery and onion in 1 tablespoon of soft margarine or defatted chicken broth. Combine all ingredients with mushroom soup. Pour into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top and continue baking until cheese melts.

title: Chicken Elegant
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cook over low heat for enough time for it to become hot and spices blended. Serve in Pepperidge Farm patty shells baked according to box directions. Serves 3. (Kandis favorite!)

title: Chicken-Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Pour package of rice in the bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle seasonings on top of rice (uncooked). Place boned chicken breasts on top of rice (8 halves). Mix soups and milk. Pour soup mixture over chicken and rice; sprinkle 1/3 cup grated Parmesan cheese over soup. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Aunt Betty'S French Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender; put in 1 or 2 containers. Makes 1 quart.

title: Ham And Cheese Pie
instructions: Prepare pie shell. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spread cheese strips on bottom of pie shell then top with onion rings and ham. In a bowl beat eggs flour salt pepper and cloves until well blended. Stir in cream and carefully pour over ham and cheese. Bake 15 minutes; reduce temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean. Remove from oven. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients add to creamed mixture. Add apples and nuts. (Mixture will be thick.) Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Forms a thin crust on top and need no icing unless desired.

title: Million Dollar Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix the sugar and flour. In a saucepan mix the water oil butter or margarine and cocoa. Bring to a boil; cook 1 minute. Pour over sugar and flour; beat well. Add the buttermilk eggs soda and dash of salt to the mixture. Pour into greased 9 x 14-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes. While cake is baking prepare icing.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix in a blender. Mix dry ingredients. Add honey vinegar lemon juice and onion. Add oil slowly mixing well. Makes 2 cups.

title: Delectable Rice Salad
instructions: Stir cream cheese into hot rice. Allow to cool. Stir in remaining ingredients. Garnish with additional nuts and cherries if desired. Allow to cool thoroughly before serving. Keep refrigerated. Put into a 10-inch casserole dish.

title: Pineapple Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in casserole. Beat eggs and add pineapple bread sugar and salt. Mix well. Turn into casserole and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until set.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Mix and mold into fingers; chill. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Do not brown. Makes approximately 50.

title: Garden Patch Special Veal Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 6-quart casserole. Cover and cook 5 to 6 hours at 325\u00b0. After 3 1/2 hours stir well and continue cooking. Remove from oven let cool for a brief time. Serves 10.

title: Mexican Sandwiches
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion until done and drain. Add remaining ingredients except rolls. Pinch bread out of center of rolls; fill with beef mixture. Wrap each roll in foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 2 dozen sandwiches.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Using desired amounts combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix well and store in a tightly closed jar. Use 2 teaspoons of mixture to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix together butter Crisco 3 cups sugar and eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and stir in. Roll into small balls size of small walnuts. Roll balls into sugar and cinnamon mixture. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned but still soft. Makes 10 dozen.

title: Spoon Bread Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add egg oleo sugar and salt. Mix. Then add flour; mix well. Keep in airtight bowl in refrigerator up to 4 days. When ready to use fill greased muffin tins 1/2 full. Let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in their jackets. Cool peel and dice. Hard boil and slice 3 dozen eggs. Add celery parsley sliced eggs and onion. Fry bacon until crisp. Combine beaten eggs sugar mustard salt pepper and vinegar diluted with water. Mix well. Pour egg mixture into hot bacon and drippings. Stir until mixture thickens about 20 minutes. Pour over potatoes and mix lightly. Add celery seed. Serve hot or cold. Serves about 120. This is the Oktoberfest recipe.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into tiny strips lengthwise. Cook in small amount of fat (until slightly soft); do not brown. Remove sprinkle with salt and arrange nests inside large deep muffin tins pressing firmly against sides and bottom. Bake in hot oven 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Use carrots parsnips macaroni spaghetti or fine noodles instead of potatoes. Fill with your favorite filling such as salmon tuna chicken cubes chicken ala king etc. and bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Make a paste of cocoa and vinegar; add to butter mixture. Add buttermilk with sifted flour soda and salt. Add vanilla and food coloring. Beat until fluffy. Pour batter into 3 greased pans sifted with flour.\tBake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat in medium bowl sugar pumpkin eggs and oil. Add dry ingredients flour soda cinnamon and baking powder. Pour into jelly roll pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and spread with cream cheese icing.

title: Marinated Shrimp
instructions: Boil shrimp in salted water until done; drain. Mix the rest of the ingredients in large covered bowl. Add drained shrimp and marinate in refrigerator for at least 3 days.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Stir constantly. Combine all ingredients (except Cool Whip) and cook over medium heat until smooth and thick. Remove from heat and cool completely. When cool add 1 cup Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: In large bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and vanilla. Mix in fruit and nuts. (May have to mix with hand.) Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake in preheated oven at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cool about 30 minutes. Loosen edges and remove from pan.

title: Orange-Blueberry Streusel Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and next 3 ingredients in a bowl; cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Set aside.

title: Knephla Soup
instructions: To half gallon water add bay leaves celery leaves and potatoes. Boil about 15 minutes. Add 1 gallon milk butter onion chicken base and salt and pepper to taste. Cook until onions are tender.

title: Southern Fried Chicken(With Cream Gravy)
instructions: Combine water and 1 tablespoon salt in a large bowl; add chicken. Cover and chill 8 hours. Drain chicken; rinse with cold water and pat dry.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa; mix and spread.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix together in order given. Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Candied Pineapple
instructions: Mix juice syrup and sugar; bring to a boil and cook until syrup spins a thread. Add pineapple chunks and cook approximately 45 minutes or until thick and candied.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Do not use a metal spoon or bowl for mixing. Do not refrigerate. If air gets in the bag let it out! Its normal for batter to thicken bubble and ferment.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine meal baking powder sugar and salt. Add slowly to 3 1/2 cups boiling water stirring briskly. As soon as mixture is smooth remove from heat. Stir in butter; cool. Form into finger shaped rolls. Fry in 2 inches hot fat at 375\u00b0 until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes about three dozen.

title: Angel Turds(Christmas Holiday Cookie)
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Cream thoroughly shortening butter confectioners sugar vanilla and almond extract. Add dry ingredients. Stir to blend. Add 1/2 cup chopped walnuts. Shape into small balls (1 teaspoon for each cookie). Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork if desired or leave in balls.

title: Hamburg Quiche
instructions: Brown beef in skillet. Beef forms crust in pie tin or quiche pan. Beat eggs slightly; add milk then mayonnaise then salt pepper and cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0. Bake 30 minutes. Test with knife like custard. Cool 10 minutes; cut in wedges. Serve.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Do not cook. Mix and keep cold.

title: Fudge Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla. Bring to a rolling boil. Boil for two minutes. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and beat. Ice cake.

title: One Bowl Macaroons
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix coconut sugar flour and salt. Stir in egg whites and almond extract. Drop by teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 18. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Make Ahead Salad Bowl
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Cover; chill several hours. Line a large bowl with lettuce. Spoon real mayonnaise mixture into center. Garnish with egg tomato and bacon. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Noodles
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Pull apart tenders into bite size pieces. Put chicken back into pan and bring to a boil adding cream of chicken and chicken broth. Cook about 10 minutes then add noodles and milk. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Beef Pie
instructions: Put beef in casserole dish. Precook potatoes in boiler until tender and drain water off; place potatoes over beef. Salt and pepper to taste. Add layer of chopped cheese. Dot with margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese and butter melt approximately 10 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter until fluffy. Add sugar gradually beating constantly then beat some more. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Dissolve soda in water. Add to 1/2 cup buttermilk. Add 1 cup flour alternately with milk/soda mixture. Beat well. Add remaining flour and milk alternately. Blend well. Add vanilla. Grease only bottom of pan. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. (Stick spatula every 1/2-inch vertically into batter to remove air bubbles.)

title: Calico Chicken
instructions: Skin and slice chicken. In large skillet cook chicken onion garlic and thyme in oil until chicken is done. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Top with Parmesan cheese if desired. Garnish with parsley. Makes 6 servings. (Fat 18%.)

title: Pickled Bologna
instructions: Bring to a boil for 1 minute. Pour over bologna in a gallon jug. Cool and keep in refrigerator. Stand at least 3 days.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Add and mix as listed. Bake in greased and floured pan for about 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Cajun 15 Bean Soup
instructions: Place beans in a bowl. Cover with water and the salt. Soak overnight. Make sure the bowl is big enough because the beans will expand a great deal.
