In the morning drain and place in a stew pot. Add about 2 quarts of water. Add the onion and garlic. Also add the tomatoes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Let cook until the beans are soft.

title: Tortilla Chip Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese on bottom of baking dish. Spread chili over cream cheese. Top with cheese. Bake or microwave until cheese melts.

title: Old Fashion Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler. Cook over medium heat until creamy stirring until done. Pour into greased pan. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Blueberry Cheese Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In small bowl combine cream cheese sugar and eggs. Beat until fluffy. Pour mixture into crust. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool. Spread pie filling on top. Chill 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown beef. Season to taste. Place meat in casserole dish. Sprinkle with onion and celery. Place rice over vegetables. Mix chili powder in tomato sauce and puree. Pour over mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until rice is cooked. Sprinkle cheese over top and bake just until cheese melts. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Veal Cordon Bleu
instructions: Pound veal with mallet to flatten and work in salt and pepper. Place cheese and ham slice on each cutlet; do not overlap cheese and ham. Top each cutlet with another and pound edges to seal. Roll in flour. Dip in egg and roll in crumbs. Saute in butter and oil until brown. Place in baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 35 minutes.

title: Veggi Link Spread
instructions: Combine; place in hot dog roll. Garnish with paprika. Makes 12 rolls.

title: Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Grease 14 x 2-inch pizza pan. On flour dusted surface roll dough into 16-inch circle. Press into bottom and 1 1/2-inch up sides of pan. Sprinkle with 3 cups Mozzarella. Crumble sausage over cheese. Top with oregano tomatoes mushrooms and remaining cheese. Place in 500\u00b0 oven. Immediately reduce to 400\u00b0. Bake 40 to 50 minutes. Remove pizza when crust is golden and sausage is cooked through.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Cut up apples and bananas into bite-size pieces. Mix marshmallows nuts and fruit cocktail all together in medium-size bowl. Whip cream very stiff and add to the mixture. Chill. Serve as a salad or dessert with cookies.

title: Coconut Dreams
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Mix first three ingredients until fairly smooth. (Use glass bowl or a crock never metal.) I cover crock of bread with a damp towel and place in a warm place for eight hours or overnight. Remove 1 cup of the mixture; store in refrigerator in a nonmetal container. Do not cover too tightly as it is powerful. To remainder of dough add salt sugar baking soda and salad oil mixing well. Begin adding the flour with a wooden spoon until the mixture is no longer shiny and begins to leave the sides of the crock. Begin mixing with the hands on a bread board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes. (May take longer.) Also the quantity of flour absorbed varies according to humidity. Oil bowl and the top of the dough which has been shaped into a ball.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Mix and knead. Let rise twice. Roll out. Spread with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 2 loaf pans with nonfat cooking spray. Sift the flour cinnamon salt soda and baking powder; set aside. Mix Egg Beaters sugar liquid Butter Buds and vanilla. Add sifted ingredients and blend in grated zucchini. Pour into loaf pans and bake 60 to 70 minutes. Yields 2 loaves (24 slices).

title: Quick Glass Lemonade
instructions: Mix ingredients and add ice.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. One-half cup celery may be added (chopped).

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour in pie crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Granola
instructions: Mix together the first 7 ingredients. In saucepan mix together the honey oil and vanilla; stir over medium heat until bubbly. Pour over dry ingredients; stir until well mixed. Bake on 2 or 3 large cookie sheets uncovered until golden brown approximately 20 to 25 minutes. Stir 2 or 3 times while baking especially in the corners. Also stir while cooling so granola will not stick together. Can add raisins to mix after cooling.

title: Zesty Italian Dressing
instructions: Shake all ingredients in a tightly covered jar. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Scalloped Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling salt water. Drain. Meanwhile cook onion in 3 tablespoons butter until soft. Stir in soup salt pepper cheese and carrots. Put in greased casserole. Toss bread cubes with butter.\tSpoon over carrots. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated approximately 20 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Raspberry Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions. Bake in greased pan. Mix cream cheese and 1 cup confectioners sugar. Fold in whipped cream with 1/2 cup confectioners sugar. Spread filling on cool cake and chill. Add raspberry pie filling and chill until used.

title: Skillet Lasagna
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet saute turkey and onions until meat just loses pink color. Remove from heat. In small bowl mix part-skim Ricotta cheese 1 tablespoon plus 2 teaspoons of Parmesan cheese dash of salt and pepper. Spread evenly over ground turkey mixture. Evenly distribute uncooked noodles on top of Ricotta cheese.

title: Tenderloin Au Poivre
instructions: Pierce meat with fork. Crush 1 tablespoon each green white and black peppercorns. Add salt garlic half the brandy and the melted butter. Mix thoroughly. Place the meat on a platter and rub the mixture well into the meat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours. Set oven to 450\u00b0. Place the meat on a baking dish and cover with the remaining peppercorns. Cook 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 400\u00b0 for another 20 minutes. This amount of time results in a perfect medium-rare. Cook longer for desired doneness. Remove from oven. Cover and let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Cut into 1/2 to 3/4-inch slices and place on serving platter. Heat the remaining brandy to just boiling. Pour over the meat light (flambe).

title: Hot Chicken And Chip Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients except cheese and chips. Put in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and chips. Bake 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mousse Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate with coffee in saucepan over very low heat. Stir until melted and smooth. Cool slightly. Beat egg whites as for meringue. When whites are in soft peaks add sugar gradually. Continue beating until meringue is very stiff and you cannot feel or taste any grain of sugar. Stir egg yolks into melted chocolate.

title: Gulliver'S Creamed Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flour and butter. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Blend butter with flour and add to corn. Mix well and remove from heat.

title: Minestrone
instructions: In a medium pot of lightly salted boiling water cook the noodles until just tender about 6 minutes. Drain; rinse under cold water and drain again. Set the noodles aside. In a large pot heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion carrot celery and garlic and cook stirring occasionally until softened about 5 minutes. Stir in the vegetable stock tomatoes potato rosemary basil oregano bay leaf salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer and cook partially covered until potatoes are almost tender about 8 minutes. Add noodles. Simmer 1 minute before serving. Garnish with parsley. Serves 8.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook Boston butt the day before (save broth). Run pork and drained canned chicken through chopper. Add all other ingredients except potatoes. We put potatoes in last to thicken. Yields 350 servings.

title: Italian Tomato Meat Sauce
instructions: Set out a large saucepan with tight fitting lid. Heat in saucepan 1/4 cup olive oil. Add and cook until lightly browned 1/2 cup chopped onion. Add and brown turning occasionally beef chuck and pork shoulder. Add slowly a mixture of 7 cups tomatoes sieved 1 tablespoon salt and bay leaf. Cover and simmer over low heat about 2 1/2 hours. Add tomato paste. Simmer over low heat stirring occasionally uncovered about 2 hours more until thickened. Before serving remove bay leaf and meat.

title: Black Bean Dip
instructions: Make ahead. Beat 10 minutes in mixer. Chill. Can be frozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and Kool-Aid in water. Mix together; add sugar and pineapple juice. Chill overnight. When ready to serve add 7-Up and pineapple sherbet. Serves approximately 30.

title: Basting Sauce (Tomato)(Good For Venison.)
instructions: Mix together and use as basting sauce.

title: Velveeta Cheese Fudge
instructions: Melt butter and cheese over low heat. Sift cocoa and powdered sugar and stir into melted mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into buttered container and cool. Mixture will be very thick. Makes a lot.

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: In hot skillet or wok saute onions carrots and bell pepper in vegetable oil until turning soft. If using a wok with a holding shelf move vegetables up on shelf and use remaining oil to stir-fry chicken.

title: Banana Nut Bread(Recipe Of Gladys Peterson)
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening well. Add eggs one at a time. Add mashed bananas then flour soda and salt sifted 3 times together. Add pecans and raisins and mix in well. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. When brown test with a straw for doneness. Makes 1 large loaf or 2 small loaves.

title: Turtles
instructions: Remove\twrappers from\tcaramels. Soften slightly in microwave.\tFlatten caramel pieces. In a double boiler melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Stir. Dip flattened caramel in chocolate to coat the bottom. Lay\ton wax paper. Put 2 pecan halves on top of caramel. Spoon melted chocolate on pecans to cover nuts and caramel.

title: Favorite Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube or Bundt pan. Cream butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash soup carrots onion sour cream and 2/3 of dressing mix. Place in a buttered dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Before the last 10 minutes of cooking combine remaining stuffing mix with butter and sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Aunt Rosie'S Grape Salad
instructions: Mix 5 ingredients together. Add grapes and stir. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Best Ever Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco until fluffy. Add one egg at a time beating after each one. Add vanilla and lemon juice. Beat 2 minutes. Add small amounts of flour to mixture. Beat until smooth. Pour into tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Cream shortening sugar salt and eggs. Add cold and boiling water 2 cups flour and yeast mixture. Beat well then gradually add remaining flour until well mixed. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate. Use as needed. Butter muffin pan shape and let rise in pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Rolls will keep up to two weeks.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Put hominy (I like yellow) butter salt pepper and grated sharp cheese in layers in heavy casserole. Bake until cheese has melted and is bubbly. You can layer as many times as you want. (Excellent for a cold winter night meal.)

title: Golden Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in hot water; add jello stirring well. Add cold water juices and extract. Add ginger ale just before serving. Freeze some in ice trays or ring mold to float in punch bowl. Slice lemons and limes for decoration.

title: Cucumber And Noodle Salad
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on box. Combine sliced peeled cucumbers (thin) chopped onion pepper and tomato. Add vinegar and mayonnaise in large bowl. Add cooked noodles. Mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Add cheese and mix before serving.

title: Honey Glazed Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in baking pan. Roll chicken in butter then arrange in single layer pan. Drizzle honey mixture over chicken. Baste 2 or 3 times; bake about 1 hour.

title: Tropical Punch
instructions: Puree a soft ripe banana in a blender. Add the orange juice and pineapple juice and blend together. Just before serving add the lemon lime soda and mix well. Put a spoonful of lemon sherbet in each glass and fill with punch. Makes about 1 quart.

title: Something Different
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs butter and 1/2 cup nuts together. Put in bottom of a pan. Whip together the cream cheese powdered sugar Cool Whip and pineapple then put on top of graham cracker crumbs.

title: Hot Pepper Lasagna
instructions: *Regular lasagna may be used. Sprinkle each layer with 1/2 to 1 teaspoon hot pepper flakes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Roll steak in 1/2 cup flour and (salt?). Pan-fry onions mushrooms and garlic in oil for 5 minutes. Add steak and brown. Remove meat onions and mushrooms from pan. Combine 2 tablespoons flour with drippings in the pan. Add bouillon and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until thickened. Add sour cream and heat slowly until gravy simmers. Add beef and vegetables and heat until hot. Serve hot on cooked rice toast noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Potatoes Au Gratin(Very Delicious And So Easy To Prepare)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray a baking sheet or dish with nonstick vegetable spray.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with cheese slices.

title: Mushrooms In Wine
instructions: Brown mushrooms in a saucepan in vegetable oil with salt thyme pepper and bay leaf. Add the wine. Cover and cook over low heat about 5 minutes. Remove bay leaf before cooking.

title: Cookies 'N Cream Pie
instructions: Pour milk into a large bowl. Add pudding and beat with wire whisk until well blended (1 minute). Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping and crushed cookies. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm (about 6 hours or overnight). Remove from freezer. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Store any leftovers in freezer.

title: Chicken, Artichoke And Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and paprika. Brown in 4 tablespoons butter and remove to a casserole which has a cover. Arrange artichoke hearts in between the chicken pieces.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: In baking bowl stir together the sugar and syrup. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts. Microwave for 3 minutes until light brown. Add butter and vanilla to ingredients mixing well. Microwave on High for 1 to 2 minutes. Add baking soda. Gently stir until light and foamy. Pour the mixture on greased pan.

title: Golden Baked Onion Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt 1 stick margarine in a large pot. Add all sliced onions. Saute until onions are soft and transparent. Do not overcook. Using a slotted spoon transfer onions to a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish (I use Pyrex). Mix together the soup milk and pepper until smooth. Pour over the onions. Top with grated cheese. Melt remaining stick of margarine. Dip one side of sliced bread in margarine. Put on top of casserole buttered side up. Continue with remaining bread slices covering casserole completely and overlapping bread slices. Bake uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes or until bread is golden brown. Serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Spicy Potato Soup
instructions: In large Dutch oven brown ground beef. Drain. Add potatoes onion and tomato sauce. Stir in water salt pepper and hot pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and soup has thickened.

title: (Dutch) Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix well and drop from teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Grasshopper Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Decorate with cherries and nuts. Chill thoroughly - best if made the night before serving.

title: Glorious Pie
instructions: Mix all the above and pour into two graham cracker pie shells. Let set 3 hours. In refrigerator before servings.

title: Potato Kugeli
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into well-greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hamburger Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in butter until transparent on medium heat. Add meat. Cook and stir until color is gone. Add flour salt pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup and stir in well. Add sour cream. Stir and simmer 15 minutes. Serve over hot rice or noodles. Garnish with paprika if you so desire. Leftovers are excellent over toast.

title: Szechwan Chicken
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl. Dredge chicken in cornstarch. Heat oil in wok or heavy large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and garlic and stir-fry until chicken is opaque about 5 minutes. Add soy mixture and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Mix in green onions. Serve immediately with rice.

title: Oatmeal Pie - 9-Inch
instructions: Blend ingredients together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until set.

title: Barbeque Hamburg
instructions: Saute ground beef onion and celery Add chili sauce ketchup mustard and butter. Salt and pepper to taste and dab of open pit.

title: Double Duty Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles. Brown sausage ground meat and garlic. Drain excess grease. Add spaghetti sauce. Mix cottage cheese with egg and parsley. Layer 1/2 noodles in two 8 x 8-inch baking dishes; spread with 1/2 cottage cheese mixture. Add 1/2 Mozzarella cheese and 1/2 meat sauce. Repeat. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 (2 2/3 x 2 2/3-inch) servings.

title: Special Chicken Stuffing
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and toss until moist. Put half mixture in bottom of 15 x 18-inch greased pan. Mix next 5 ingredients and set aside. Put chicken mixture over stuffing then top with remaining stuffing. Beat 3 eggs and 1 1/2 cups milk. Pour over mixture in pan and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before serving. Add chicken or mushroom soup (diluted with 1 can water or 2 cups chicken broth). Pour over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes uncovered. Remove and grate mild or sharp cheese over top and return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter in a medium cast-iron skillet on top of the stove and add brown sugar. Make sure it is spread evenly in the bottom. Drain pineapple and arrange pineapple in skillet. Put a cherry in the center of each pineapple.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Melt butter in saucepan. Add to flour mixture. Blend in eggs and vanilla; mix well. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle chips and nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool in pan; cut in bars.

title: Veal On Green Rice
instructions: Cut veal into serving size pieces. In shallow pan combine garlic and next 5 ingredients. Add meat and turn to cook well. Refrigerate and let stand for 5 or 6 hours.

title: Blond Fudge
instructions: Butter sides of a heavy 2-quart saucepan. Combine sugar milk and salt in pan. Heat and stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to a boil. Cook to soft ball stage stirring only if necessary. Remove from heat. Add butter and cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla. Beat vigorously until mixture begins to hold shape. Add Marshmallow Creme. Beat until fudge becomes thick and loses its gloss. Quickly stir in cherries and spread in buttered shallow pan or small platter. Score in squares while warm.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and Eagle Brand milk in a heavy saucepan. Add the remaining ingredients. Spread inside of a greased pan and chill 2 to 3 hours or until fudge is firm.

title: Mexican Bean Dip
instructions: Cover the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with refried beans. Mix the taco seasoning with sour cream. Spread over the refried beans. Layer in order the next 4 ingredients. Then top with Monterey Jack cheese. Chill. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Fried Corn, Tennessee-Style
instructions: Preparation Time 20 minutes. Cooking Time 15 minutes for rice and 10 minutes for beans.

title: Mama'S Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: You will need foil paper.

title: Make-Ahead Chicken Casserole
instructions: Marinate chicken in eggs for 2 hours in the refrigerator. Combine bread crumbs parsley salt and garlic powder in plastic bag. Shake chicken in bread crumb mixture and brown in oil. Drain and place chicken in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover with sliced mushrooms and top with cheese slices. Pour broth on top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be made up ahead of time but pour broth on just before baking.

title: Wedding Cake Icing
instructions: For decorating add desired food color.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs and pudding and pour in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle sugar over batter. Sprinkle nuts over sugar. Sprinkle chocolate bits over nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chickpea Salad
instructions: Pick over peas or beans and discard any stones. Place in colander and rinse thoroughly. Soak in water to cover overnight. Drain; rinse again. Place in saucepan and cover with fresh cold water. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer covered until peas or beans are tender but not mushy about 1 hour. Drain reserving 1/2 cup cooking liquid. Combine garlic onion parsley mint lemon juice oil reserved cooking liquid and salt if used in wide bowl. Add drained peas or beans; toss well and chill. May be refrigerated one or two days to allow flavors to blend. Adjust seasoning. Garnish with red onion. Makes 8 servings.

title: Big Mac Sauce(For Hamburgs)
instructions: Stir ingredients together (best if prepared the night before). Serve on hamburgs (on rolls) with chopped lettuce sliced tomato sliced onions and pickles.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding with milk; mix thoroughly. Add Cool Whip and vanilla. Mix well. Alternate graham crackers and pudding mixture. Make three layers. Use 9 x 13-inch dish.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Chop livers onions green pepper and celery. Cook beef liver shrimp pepper onions and celery in salad oil until tender but do not brown. Stir in rice and beef bouillon. Simmer 10 minutes. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 6.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: In a large soup kettle/pan saute onion 3 or more minutes. Add clam juice and juice from the potatoes. Add diced fish. Cook 15 minutes on medium-high until fish is mostly done. Add potatoes and turn heat down to medium-low.

title: Marinated Pork Loin Roast
instructions: Place roast in large plastic bag. Combine all ingredients in bowl. Pour over meat. Press out air and close tight. Marinate overnight turning occasionally. Remove roast and reserve marinade. Place roast on rack in shallow pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes per pound. Last 1/2 hour of cooking baste with marinade every 10 minutes. Heat and serve marinade.

title: Christmas Cutout Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt. Next add and cut butter into mixture with a mixer until fine. Finally add egg milk and vanilla. Mix well. Roll out and cut. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes until very lightly browned. Watch closely cookies tend to burn easily.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Boil milk and butter.

title: Praline Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. For praline layer mix 2 eggs brown sugar and vanilla until well blended. Add in coconut and pecans. Mix well.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix up all and roll into meatballs. Brown in oven on double broiler 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Saute onions in margarine; add green chilies. Thicken with flour; stir until smooth. Add soup and chicken broth. Stir over low heat until smooth. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place chicken pieces in dish and layer with noodles and cottage cheese; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese Velveeta cheese and 1/2 of the sauce. Repeat layers. Top with more Velveeta cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes a large casserole.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Drain spinach and squeeze out water. Mix all together. Best when made night before using.

title: Italian Zucchini Pie
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet cook hamburger and drain off grease. In another skillet cook zucchini and onion in oleo until tender (10 to 20 minutes). Stir in parsley and seasonings. In bowl beat eggs and add cheese. Spread a 9-inch crust with mustard. Pour vegetable and hamburger mixture into crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Cover with foil last 10 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Spread over bottom of casserole dish. Add soup and spread cooked potatoes over top. Sprinkle cheese on top of potatoes. Bake in oven for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sally'S Spicy Fruit Salad
instructions: Add to \Spicy Cherry Sauce for Ham\ recipe.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon. Beat sugar eggs and oil. Stir in strawberries and add flour mixture. Add nuts. Pour in bread pans about 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Oreo Dirt Dessert
instructions: Mix together and chill milk and pudding mix. Separate the filling of the cookies. Crush the cookies and set aside. Mix together chilled pudding cookie middles cream cheese and Cool Whip. Starting with cookie crumbs layer in a 9 x 13 pan. Chill and serve.

title: Herbed Mustard
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in sterilized jars and store in a cool dark place.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Unthaw broccoli and combine with Cheez Whiz. Add soup eggs mayonnaise and salt and pepper. Put in large casserole dish and top with a few cracker crumbs and butter. Cook 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Crock-Pot Pot Roast
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Spray large skillet with cooking spray. Add meat and brown meat on all sides. Place potatoes mushrooms carrots and basil in a 3 1/2 to 4-quart crock-pot. Place browned meat on top of vegetables. Sprinkle with salt. Pour condensed soup over meat. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 12 hours. Transfer meat and vegetables to serving platter. Serve the sauce over meat and vegetables. Yield about 5 servings.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream yolks with sugar. Beat egg whites and fold in with other ingredients. Add sugar and yolks (creamed). Add 1 cup ground walnuts. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 12 pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Trim all visible fat from chicken. Season chicken parts with pepper. Combine flour and paprika in medium bowl. Coat seasoned chicken with flour mixture. Spray a 13 X 9 inch pan with vegetable spray. Place chicken pieces skin side down in pan. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees until done.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix together. Bake in an unbaked shell at 350\u00b0 until it is crisp approximately 1 hour. Yield One pie.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: In saucepan brown beef and cook onion with garlic and cumin until tender. Stir to separate meat. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Makes about 5 1/2 cups.

title: 6 Week Cole Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage and cover with salt. Let sit 2 hours. Add green pepper celery mustard seed celery seed.\tBoil sugar vinegar and water.\tCool and pour over salad. Refrigerate for 2 to 6 weeks.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Put liquids in blender and mix. Add dry ingredients and blend. Mix until thick.

title: Creamy Baked Custard
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar and salt. Mix well. Add scalded milk gradually stirring constantly. Flavor with vanilla and nutmeg. Pour into a greased baking dish. Place in a shallow pan of warm water. Bake in moderate oven at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. A knife inserted will come out clean when custard is done.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Boil chicken breasts and small onion. When finished remove the skin from the bone and chop up the meat; get rid of the skin. Add rest of ingredients. Add orzo last and cook until tender.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan arrange ingredients in the following order pineapple with juice blueberries sugar dry cake mix and melted margarine. Sprinkle a small amount of sugar over the top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in butter; put in eggs and milk.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in pie crust.

title: Aaron'S Molded Salad
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk until very hot on stove. Be careful not to burn! Pour mixture over dry Jell-O and mix with mixer until blended. Blend all other ingredients. Pour into dish and let set. May be used as a salad or dessert.

title: Beefy Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper; drain fat. Mix with remaining ingredients. Mix well. Put in a casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Kay'S Bean Soup
instructions: Brown all sides of meat in shortening. Add next 3 ingredients and simmer over low heat for about an hour or until meat falls from bone. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until potatoes are done. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Creme Puff Rolls
instructions: Stir butter water salt and flour until it leaves the spoon. Take off and cool 10 minutes. Add 1 egg at a time; beat them in well. Roll out 1/2 tablespoon at a time. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add mustard brown sugar ketchup and pork and beans. Simmer 5 minutes on low heat. Serve over buns or bread.

title: Scott'S Favorite Spaghetti And Meatballs
instructions: Cook onion and minced garlic in oil until tender. Do not brown. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes then remove bay leaf. Add meatballs. Cover loosely and cook 30 minutes. Serve over hot cooked spaghetti with Parmesan cheese.

title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Pie
instructions: Heat egg yolks milk and butter. Mix together dry ingredients and pour into heated liquid. Cook until thick. Add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue. Brown in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Paprika Chicken
instructions: In skillet melt margarine; brown chicken about 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. Spoon off fat.

title: Dinner Rolls(Mrs. Tetterton)
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve yeast in warm water with 1 teaspoon of sugar. Add milk butter salt remaining sugar eggs and 3 cups of flour; beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic about 6 to 8 minutes adding additional flour as needed. Place in greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover; let rise until doubled about 1 hour. Punch dough down. Turn out on lightly floured surface; divide in half. Divide each half into 12 pieces. Shape in balls. Place in 2 greased 9 x 13-inch pans. Cover; let rise until doubled about 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Brush with melted butter. Yields 2 dozen large rolls.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cake mix puddings and cooking oil. Blend together and then beat 2 minutes. Add eggs; beat another minute. Stir in chocolate chips; pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Spinach Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Wash zucchini. Cut off stems. Drop in boiling salted water. Cover. Turn heat on low and cook for 10 minutes or less. Cool. Cut in half lengthwise. Remove pulp and chop. Cook spinach. Drain and squeeze dry. Combine flour milk zucchini pulp and spinach.

title: Fluffy Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese Cool Whip and dry Jell-O.\tAdd all fruits. Mix!

title: Almond Butter Crunch
instructions: In large saucepan melt butter. Add sugar syrup and water. Cook stirring constantly to hard crack (300\u00b0). Quickly stir in coarsely chopped almonds. Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch metal pan (no glass). Cool thoroughly; turn onto waxed paper. Spread with 1/2 melted chocolate. Sprinkle with 1/2 chopped almonds. Cover with wax paper; turn over and spread with rest of chocolate and sprinkle with nuts. Break into pieces after chocolate hardens.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Boil 1 cup sugar and 1 cup vinegar. Let cool. Pour over vegetables and keep in fridge.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in a large pan and put in oven preheated to 400\u00b0 until topping is prepared. Beat egg; stir in milk and oil. Add flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir just until flour is moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Spoon over apples and bake 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Pour berries into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Mix flour baking powder sugar milk and margarine together. Pour over berries; will have the texture of cake batter. Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar and cornstarch. Sprinkle mixture on top of batter. Pour boiling water over the top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Party Cake
instructions: Grease sides of two 8-inch layer pans. Line bottom of each pan with waxed paper dusted with flour. Sift together flour sugar salt and baking powder into a large mixing bowl. Add the shortening and 1/2 cup milk; beat 2 minutes on low speed of mixer. Add remaining milk vanilla and egg whites. Beat 2 minutes. Bake in a moderate 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Moo-Goo Gai Pan
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat oil and saute meat until it turns white (3 to 4 minutes). Push aside; add almonds. Stir until brown. Add scallions mushrooms green peppers and ginger. Stir-fry 2 minutes. Add peas; cook 2 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in some of broth. Add remaining broth sherry and soy sauce; add to chicken mixture. Cook until sauce is smooth and shiny about 4 minutes longer. (Beef bouillon can be substituted for chicken broth.)

title: Orange-Glazed Chicken Oriental
instructions: Whisk the first 5 ingredients in small bowl until cornstarch and honey dissolve. Heat oil in large heavy skillet over high heat. Add onion garlic and orange peel and stir-fry until fragrant about 1 minute. Add chicken and stir-fry until opaque about 3 minutes. Stir orange juice mixture. Add to skillet and stir-fry until chicken is cooked through and liquid thickens about 4 minutes. Season with freshly ground pepper and salt if desired. Serve with rice (and if desired thinly sliced green part of onion remaining).

title: Rhubarb Slush
instructions: Simmer rhubarb and water for 15 minutes. Drain keep juice. Add sugar jello and lemonade. Stir well. Add one cup vodka and freeze. Serve with cup or strawberry pop.

title: Broken Glass Torte
instructions: Use 1 1/4 cups water to each box of jello. Put in separate pans. Cut in small squares when completely set.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Holiday Breakfast
instructions: Blend eggs; add milk salt and mustard. Brown sausage and cube. Butter a 9 x 13-inch glass pan (or 2-quart casserole). Make 3 layers bread cheese and sausage. Pour well mixed egg mixture over top (add more milk to cover bread). Refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ham And Pea Soup
instructions: Boil moderately fast for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Stir occasionally to prevent scorching.

title: Pizza Swiss
instructions: Combine the flour salt and pepper and pound into steak. Brown slowly on both sides in hot fat. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over meat. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Place in baking dish and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Coconut Candies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop mixture by heaping teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Roll into balls. Let dry a while then roll again. Make the balls look nice then dip into dipping chocolate. I use part dipping chocolate and mix a few chocolate into it and a little paraffin.

title: Light Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and sugar in a large mixing bowl; add vegetable oil and next 4 ingredients. Beat at medium speed with an electric mixer 6 minutes. Stir in poppy seeds. Pour batter into a 10-cup Bundt pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan; drizzle with Lemon Glaze and cool completely on wire rack. Yield 24 servings (156 cal--27% from fat per slice. 2.8g protein 4.7g fat (1.1g saturated) 25.6g carbohydrate 0.1g fiber 0.2mg cholesterol 168mg sodium and 44mg calcium.

title: Chilled Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine apples bananas celery walnuts and coconut.

title: Reese Cup
instructions: Mix sugar margarine peanut butter and graham crackers; mix well. Roll into small balls and refrigerate. Melt paraffin and chocolate together. Dip balls into chocolate mixture. Set on waxed paper to cool. Makes 100 pieces.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Set chips and cheese aside. Mix all other ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove and top with chips and cheese; return to oven and cook until cheese is melted.

title: Capon Stuffing
instructions: Brown chopped onions and rice in margarine. Add water bouillon lemon juice and salt. Bring to a boil then simmer for 20 minutes. Add mushrooms. Salt cavity of capon and stuff.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Alternate layers (squash onion and dressing). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Cook lemon jello in boiling water. Mix cream cheese Dream Whip and sugar together real good. Add cooled lemon mixture. Pour over a graham cracker crust.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop peppers and onions; cover with boiling water. Drain immediately. Cover with cold water; bring to boil. Drain and add remaining ingredients. Cook for 10 minutes. Put in hot sterile jars and seal. No processing necessary.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Chicken Noodle Supreme
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour into greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 F. for 25 minutes. Easy but tasty.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar and cocoa. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour pecans and coconut. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 to 45 minutes. Spread topping at once over warm cake. Let cool. Frost.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix and chill dough. Roll into ball the size of walnut. Roll into mixture of 1/4 cup cinnamon and 1 cup sugar. Bake until brown and still soft 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix water and yeast. Add sugar salt oil and egg. Add flour gradually beating well after each addition. Grease the top with oil and let rise until doubled in size. Pour on floured board and knead. Shape into rolls and let rise again. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Put 1 stick margarine in a baking dish. Put in oven and allow margarine to melt.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan lightly with cooking spray. Melt margarine and pour into pan. Add other ingredients in layers as listed. Press lightly the first 6 ingredients before adding Eagle Brand milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool overnight before cutting into small pieces.

title: Amish Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat together first 5 ingredients. Sift together flour soda salt and cream of tartar. Add to mixture. Mix in vanilla. Roll into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with glass or spoon to flatten. Sprinkle tops of cookies with sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Blueberry Yogurt Shake
instructions: In a blender mix all ingredients until smooth. (Or use frozen berries skim milk and sweetener for a lo-cal shake.)

title: Coconut Torte
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy and add sugar; beat until stiff. Add crumbs and rest of ingredients. Bake in a large pie tin or cake pan at 350\u00b0 until done or golden about 20 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

title: Reunion Cake Pie
instructions: Make pie layer Into medium bowl combine corn syrup pecans eggs vanilla sugar dash of salt and 2 tablespoons melted butter. Mix well. Pour pecan mixture into lightly greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Busy Day Casserole
instructions: Combine all together. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Broth
instructions: Wash and cut hen into frying pieces. Salt and pepper chicken. Place in large saucepan and cover with water. Cook on stovetop until meat is done about 1 hour (45 minutes in pressure cooker). Remove chicken from pot discard celery and carrots; strain broth. Reserve chicken for other uses.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine catsup cracker crumbs and milk; let stand 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and shape into loaf. Bake on flat pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tomato Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons fat.\tCook vegetables at low temperature for about 1 hour. Add bacon and fat.

title: Dill Beans
instructions: Mix oleo and flour. Add liquid milk and cheese. Pour over beans and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hurry Up Hot Dish
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add both cans of soup and half of the noodles. Put in casserole and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle on remaining noodles and bake 10 more minutes.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain sliced carrots. Saute onion in 3 tablespoons of butter. Mix vegetables with soup and dash of pepper and Cheddar cheese. Cover with croutons mixed with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cheese Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease 10-inch pie plate. Thaw broccoli and drain well. Mix broccoli cheese and onion in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients 1 minute on high speed. Pour over ingredients in pie pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center of pan comes out clean.

title: Tex-Mex Spice Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and store in an airtight container for up to 3 months.

title: Fruited Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish spreading fruit and onions on top. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Tapenade(An Olive-Based Appetizer Spread From The Sunny South Of France.)
instructions: Mash the olives in a large bowl (they will look like crushed cockroaches) adding olive oil as necessary to make a thick paste. Chill. Serve in a shallow glass bowl decorated with parsley. Put the bowl on a tray and surround it with crusty French bread or pita triangles. Serves 8 people.

title: Chocolate Candy Bar Dessert
instructions: Mix cookie crumbs 1/4 c. sugar and melted margarine in 9x13\ pan. Press firmly into bottom of pan. Refrigerate 10 min. Beat cream cheese & remaining 1/4 c. sugar until smooth. Gently stir in half the whipped topping. Spread evenly over crust. Sprinkle candy bars over cream cheese. Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding. Beat with a wire whisk for 1 min. Pour over candy bar layer. Let stand 5 min. until thickened. Spread remaining whipped topping over pudding layer. Refrigerate 2 hrs. or until set. Garnish with additional chopped candy bars if desired. Cut into squares.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Chicken
instructions: Mix all together and bring to a boil. Brush on chicken as you barbecue. Makes enough for 10 halves. Will keep in refrigerator.

title: Russian Cream(Serves 12 To 15)
instructions: Combine half and half sugar and gelatin in 2-quart saucepan; let stand 5 minutes. Stir over low heat until gelatin is thoroughly dissolved; cool to lukewarm. Whisk in sour cream vanilla and almond extract until mixture is smooth. Pour into 6-cup metal mold. Refrigerate covered until set at least 4 hours. To unmold dip mold into warm water just until edges begin to liquify. Invert onto serving platter; surround with well drained Marinated Strawberries.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs oil sugar and vanilla together; add zucchini. Sift flour salt soda and baking powder; add to zucchini mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves. Nuts and raisins are optional.

title: Quick Cucumber Slices
instructions: Place cucumbers onions and salt in a bowl; cover with ice cubes and let stand together for 1 to 3 hours; drain well. Mix until dissolved sugar celery seed and vinegar. Pour over drained cukes. Place in jar cover and refrigerate.

title: Marvelous Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Cook coarsely chopped mushrooms in water and salt for 20 minutes. Add onions; simmer 3 minutes. Sprinkle in garlic powder; add salt and pepper to mix. Drain mixture; save stock.

title: Peach Kuchen
instructions: Sift dry ingredients and work in butter. Cover bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch pan and press firmly.

title: Macaroni Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Mix fruit juices sugar salt eggs and butter together and cook until thick and add to macaroni. Cool. Next morning add drained fruit and large carton of Cool Whip.

title: German Cabbage
instructions: Place cabbage in boiling salted water and boil for 5 minutes. Fry bacon pieces slowly until brown. Drain cabbage thoroughly. Mix onions and bell pepper with cabbage in bowl. Add bacon bits and drippings to cabbage. Add 1 tablespoon salad dressing or mayonnaise. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Blueberry-Nectarine Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Toss nectarines blueberries granulated sugar lemon juice and cornstarch in large bowl. Spoon fruit mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Mix flour and brown sugar. Mix butter into flour mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle over top of fruit. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Easy Meat Loaf
instructions: In medium bowl beat eggs slightly. Add evaporated milk and dry soup mix. Stir until well mixed. Set aside. Mix beef and pork in large bowl. Add raw onion if desired. Combine the liquid mixture with meats and blend well using hands works best. Add cracker crumbs until mixture can be handled to form loaf. Spread remaining crumbs on wax paper and roll meat loaf in crumbs. Place in sprayed pan. Cover bottom of pan with water around loaf. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 until heated through. Add water if necessary. Uncover after 30 to 35 minutes. Add water if necessary and finish baking until done. Do not allow pan to get dry during baking. Top should brown nicely while finishing. Oven temperature may be adjusted according to need. Yields 1 large or 2 small loaves.

title: Soft Jumble Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt three times. Cream shortening. Add sugar eggs and vanilla. Add flour and milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Put oil into deep frypan; add beef. Fry until browned. Add onion green pepper and brown gravy mix. Cover and cook until meat is tender.

title: Riviera Bean Salad
instructions: Drain bean salad and tuna. Mix well. Chill and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Frosted Strawberry Squares
instructions: Stir together flour brown sugar walnuts and oleo. Spread on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Check often and stir occasionally. Cool.

title: Corn Bread Sticks
instructions: Beat egg sugar and shortening together. Sift flour and meal together with salt and baking powder then gradually add to other mixture alternating with the clabber. Pour into iron cornstick pans and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Hot Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli. Cube cheese. Drain mushrooms. Chop onions. Dice garlic very small. In frying pan melt butter. Fry onions and garlic. In large bowl mix broccoli cheese mushrooms and onions. Beat in 2 eggs; mix well. Grease casserole dish and add mixture and smooth top. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top until covered. Lay 6 to 8 pats of butter on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. (When butter is melted and mixture bubbles casserole is done.)

title: Lasagna
instructions: Mix together ground beef spaghetti sauce spaghetti mix and oregano. In a large baking dish layer noodles meat sauce mixture parmesan cheese noodles mozzarella cheese meat sauce mixture noodles and top with mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-45 minutes.

title: Ranch-Style Baked Beans
instructions: Brown beef with the shortening in a large skillet. Stir with a fork to break up meat. Add soup mix water ketchup mustard vinegar pork and beans and kidney beans. Mix well. Turn into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be cooked in a crock-pot.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Heat all ingredients until bubbly. Serve with crackers.

title: Baked Tomatoes
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; remove bacon. Reserve pan drippings in skillet. Set bacon aside to drain. Saut garlic onion and mushrooms in skillet until tender. Stir in bacon flour and seasoned salt. Cut tomatoes into 1/2-inch slices. Place half of slices in a lightly greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon half of bacon mixture over tomatoes; sprinkle with 3 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Repeat layers and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Seafood Chowder
instructions: In a large pan saute the onion; add celery potatoes fish shrimp scallops and lemon juice. Simmer until potatoes are tender. Add the onion salt parsley basil and dill weed.

title: German Rolled Beef
instructions: Sprinkle meat tenderizers on each side and pound. Spread mustard thinly over meat; season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle chopped onion and pickle over each piece and place bacon over each piece. Roll up and fasten with toothpicks. Brown in small amount of fat. Add 1/2 cup water and simmer 1 hour or until tender. Use flour to make a paste to thicken gravy. Serve over meat.

title: Hot Pepper Vinegar
instructions: Place peppers in a glass container. Bring vinegar to a boil and pour over peppers. Put on a loose lid and let stand 1 week. Remove peppers and use vinegar as a condiment for French fries fish chile or whatever.

title: Fideo Soup
instructions: Put about 1/4-inch oil in pot over low heat. Add slightly crushed fideo. Cook until light brown. Turn off heat. Drain oil. Add garlic onion and tomato sauce. Stir quickly. Add boiling water and bouillon cubes. Return to a boil. Cover and lower heat to a simmer. Cook about 7 to 8 minutes or until noodles are done.

title: Easy Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Mix sugar and butter together with mixer on medium speed. Add 1 egg at a time to mixture. Add whipping cream then flour. Bake for 1 hour and 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Swiss Cheese Fondue
instructions: Toss cheese and flour in bowl. Heat wine and garlic in electric fondue pot just until bubbles form. Remove and discard garlic. Add cheese to the wine a handful at a time stirring with wooden spoon until each addition is blended. Stir in Kirsch and nutmeg. Keep fondue warm on low setting during dipping.

title: Pansy Pound Cake
instructions: You do not use baking powder in this cake. Dont use self-rising flour. Cream mixture until smooth. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Oatmeal-Brown Sugar Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg; add milk and oil mixing well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients. Add egg mixture mixing until blended. Stir oats into batter. For each pancake pour about 1/4 cup batter onto a hot lightly greased griddle. Turn pancakes when tops are covered with bubbles and edges look cooked. Makes 10 pancakes.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat and drain off fat. Add spaghetti sauce water salt Italian seasoning and sugar. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish layer 1/2 of sauce 1/2 of uncooked lasagne noodles 1 cup cottage cheese and 1/3 of Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers ending with sauce Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.

title: Sweet Potato Crunch
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into well-greased baking dish.

title: Cheese Rice Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and broccoli as directed on package. Blend all ingredients together in a Pyrex dish and sprinkle top with butter and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until thoroughly heated.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream the sugar and shortening. Beat in molasses and egg. Mix well. Add coconut and nuts; mix well. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly and remove from cookie sheet. Yields 30 cookies.

title: Smash Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix 1 of the eggs the butter and pecans. Press into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and set aside.

title: Braided Carrot Bread
instructions: Over low heat heat milk water and oleo until hot (125\u00b0). Stir into flour mixture (flour carrots wheat germ sugar salt savory and yeast). Mix to form soft dough; let rise 10 minutes. Divide into 3 pieces. Roll into 15-inch ropes. Braid together. Place on baking sheet and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Quickie Calzone
instructions: Roll out dough and put cheese and sausage on top; fold in half and pinch down edges to seal. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Debone and tear chicken into small pieces. Mix first three ingredients together. Place in a greased casserole dish suitable for oven baking. Then mix separately last three ingredients and spread on top of chicken mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until the casserole is bubbling around the edges.

title: German Slaw
instructions: Boil all the ingredients 15 minutes except cabbage and onion. Remove spice bag. Let mixture cool 15 to 20 minutes. Pour over cabbage and onion. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars butter eggs and vanilla until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Orange Cooler
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O into boiling water. Add cranberry juice. Pour over ice cubes in tall glasses and garnish with orange slices. Makes 3 1/2 cups or 4 servings.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Top with layer of coconut and top with maraschino cherries. Refrigerate and chill for at least 4 hours.

title: Rhubarb Strawberry Coffee Cake
instructions: In bowl mix together the dry ingredients; cut in butter. Mix buttermilk eggs and vanilla add to dry mix. Stir to moisten. Spread half the batter in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread cooled filling over batter in pan. Spoon remaining batter in small mounds on top of filling. Combine remaining sugar and flour; cut in butter. Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Brown beef and drain. Brown onion and green pepper. Mix all ingredients and bake for 1 hour.

title: Venison Salami
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Refrigerate mixture for three days taking it out to remix at least once a day. On the 4th day shape the mixture into small loaves about 2 1/2 x 6-inches long. Put on cookie sheet and bake overnight or 10 hours at 150\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil and bone chicken. Season to taste. Butter casserole dish. Put in chicken in small serving pieces. Add the soups chicken broth and stuffing mix over all. Dot with butter. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Yellow Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients together and chill. Serve over crushed ice.

title: Vegetable Sandwich Spread
instructions: Drain vegetables after chopping. Beat together cheese and lemon juice. Stir in vegetables. Great on crackers or in sandwiches.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Add the chili powder garlic powder and sugar to the browned and drained hamburger and onion. After mixing that add the tomato sauce and beans and sauce. Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread prepared cornbread (uncooked) over the top. Follow instructions on cornbread for cooking.

title: Sour Cream Pancakes
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder baking soda and salt. Combine sour cream and milk stirring well. In large bowl of electric mixer at high speed beat eggs until light and fluffy. At low speed blend in flour and sour cream mixture alternating beginning and ending with flour. Then blend in melted butter. Use 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Bring the sugar and vinegar to a boil; cook until sugar is dissolved. Cool and mix all ingredients together. Put in a quart jar and let marinate all night in the refrigerator. Turn jar each day to mix. This will keep for several weeks.

title: Balsamic Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine vinegar and garlic in small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil. Continue to boil until thick and syrupy about 8 minutes. Stir in rosemary. Season chicken with salt and pepper and place in a large heavy skillet skin side down and sear until brown 3 to 5 minutes. Remove chicken and pour off excess fat. Return chicken to pan skin side up. Place in oven and roast 10 to 15 minutes. Remove chicken from oven and turn on broiler. Brush chicken with reduced balsamic mixture. Place under broiler until glaze is bubbly 1 to 3 minutes.

title: Elegant Peach Delight
instructions: Combine cake mix and softened margarine and press in lightly greased 12 x 9-inch pan. Arrange peaches on top. Beat sour cream and egg yolks together and pour over peaches spreading to sides of pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Wakefield Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese and mayo. Mix in lemon juice chopped onions mustard and garlic salt. Fold in broken up crabmeat. Chill several hours (will thicken). Serve in carved out red cabbage with assorted crackers. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Velveeta Dip
instructions: Put cheese in a crock-pot on medium heat until melted. Add tomatoes and sausage. Serve. Pour over tortilla chips or as a dip.

title: Fasta Pasta - 10 Minute Pasta Sauce
instructions: In a heavy skillet add oil fresh tomatoes and 1/4 of wine. Saute until the tomatoes cook down until soft and tender. Add garlic onion basil and can of cooked tomatoes and rest of wine. Cook on high for 2 minutes then cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Pour over your choice of pasta and add Parmesan cheese.

title: Old Fashioned Egg Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat well. Pour in a 9-inch unbaked shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until pie is set.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan. Bring to a boil. (Do not overboil just to a boil.) Add peanut butter and vanilla to mixture and blend smooth then add Rice Krispies and mix. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Just mix well; do not beat. Bake at 350\u00b0 75 minutes.

title: Meal In One(Serving Size: 6)
instructions: Place Tater Tots on bottom and up side of 8 x 12-inch casserole. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Brown and drain beef. Place beef broccoli and 1/2 can onions on potato shell. Combine soup milk 1/2 cup cheese and seasonings. Pour over beef mixture. Bake covered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Bubble Bread
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt cake pan. Place frozen rolls in pan. Mix brown sugar and pudding mix; sprinkle over rolls. Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over brown sugar-pudding mixture. Spread pecans over this and pour melted butter over pecans. Place on cabinet overnight; do not cover. In morning bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Let sit in pan 10 to 15 minutes then turn out. Slice or pull apart.

title: Sweet Pepper Relish
instructions: Cap clean and wash peppers; grind peppers. Drain. Grind onions. Prepare big pot of boiling water. Put onions and peppers together and cover with boiling water for 10 minutes. Put 3 trays ice on until melted. Drain well. Put in big pot and add all ingredients except pickling spices. Tie spices in cheesecloth and let float in pickle while it cooks. Boil about 30 minutes. Jar and seal. Makes 9 quarts.

title: Frozen Strawberries
instructions: Mix strawberries and sugar together. Let stand 20 minutes. Combine pectin and water and boil 1 minute. Pour over berries. Mix well. Seal in freezer containers and freeze. Makes 5 pints.

title: Roadside Potatoes
instructions: Put potatoes through medium food grinder or food processor; dont overprocess. Mix together the potatoes green peppers onion cheese and flour. Add melted butter salt and pepper. Pour into greased casserole. Pour warm milk over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together eggs vegetable oil and sugar. Add zucchini. Mix well in large bowl with electric mixer. Add flour baking soda vanilla and nuts. Pour into 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool completely.

title: Lemonade Dessert
instructions: Use a prepared crust for pie or make one up yourself with graham crackers and margarine; add 1/4 cup sugar. May be pressed down in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Whip Eagle Brand and lemonade. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into prepared crust then refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Ranch Style Casserole(Mexican Food)
instructions: Brown meat onion and green pepper in a little oil. Add Ro-Tel mushroom soup Ranch Style beans salt and pepper. Mix well and heat about 5 minutes. In a large casserole layer meat mixture torn tortillas and grated cheese. Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except broccoli and bread crumbs. Add broccoli and mix. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to hour or until golden brown on top.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Polynesian Carrot Frappe
instructions: In a blender or food processor whirl the pineapple juice and carrots until smooth. Add the ice cream; whirl to blend. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Brunch Eggs
instructions: Beat eggs milk and sour cream until foamy. Add salt and pepper to taste. Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour in egg mixture. Top with shredded cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Persimmon Nut Bread
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well. Dust raisins and nuts with a little flour; add all dry ingredients raisins and nuts to first mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Test for doneness.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve orange gelatin in boiling water. Stir in frozen orange juice until completely dissolved. Add drained orange sections and crushed pineapple. Freeze until set about two hours. One hour before serving combine lemon instant pudding mix with one cup cold milk; fold in Cool Whip. Spread evenly onto gelatin and store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serves 12 -15 Use 13 x 9 x 2 inch dish.

title: Texas Cookie Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine the flour and sugar. Boil the oleo cocoa oil and Coke. Pour over the flour mixture. Add the salt buttermilk eggs vanilla soda and cinnamon. Mix together and pour in well oiled pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Mix eggs sugar oil and vanilla; beat. Stir in apples and pecans. Sift dry ingredients and add. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tested done.

title: Bounce Back Cocktail
instructions: Puree all ingredients on high in blender until smooth and frothy.

title: Mexican Hogies
instructions: Brown ground chuck; add onion bell pepper and salt; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Let\tcheese\tmelt then cool. Fill hogie\tbuns (or hot\tdog buns) and wrap in foil. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 400\u00b0. Can be frozen before baking.

title: Cucumber Salad Mold
instructions: Dissolve Jello in hot water. Cool at room temperature. Mix remaining ingredients together. Pour into Jello mixture. Pour into salad mold. Chill until firm. (Serves 6-8.)

title: Cajun Cole Slaw
instructions: Slice cabbage. Mix all ingredients together and add to the cabbage. Thin the mayonnaise with the beaten egg white and add to the slaw. (A little vinegar and/or sugar may be added according to your personal taste.)

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Spoon into sprayed muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mary'S Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix flour baking soda baking powder sugar salt currants raisins and caraway seed. Add buttermilk and eggs. Beat with a fork and stir into dry ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Makes 2 large loaf cakes.

title: Hawaiian Holiday Punch
instructions: Mix all together and serve. Can make ice ring using punch orange slices and maraschino cherries.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Prepare molding pans by putting waxed paper in them so that the ends of paper are above pans. Cut all fruit into smaller pieces. Crumble Ritz crackers. Chop nuts. Mix all ingredients except milk and marshmallows well. Heat water and stir in marshmallows to melt them. Then add dry milk and remove from heat. Pour over the other ingredients and mix well. Press cake mixture tightly into round angel food cake pan or small loaf pans. Allow to dry overnight. Remove from pan(s) and allow to air dry a few more hours or a day with bottom end(s) turned up. This can be frozen then.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Wash cook and drain spinach. Beat eggs. Add butter flour milk salt and baking powder. Stir in cheese onion spinach and mushrooms. Put mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and level mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and cool for 45 minutes. Cut into bite size squares.

title: Golden Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Saute onions and green pepper in butter. Add mushrooms soup milk and basil; mix well.\tLayer noodles cheeses chicken and sauce one-half at a time in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. This\tis an excellent\tdish to freeze; simply remove from freezer and place directly in oven. No need to thaw first.

title: Sausage Wrapped In Pastry
instructions: Combine flour fennel and salt in bowl. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut butter and shortening into pieces and add to flour. Use pastry cutter to cut to coarse texture. Add ice water 1 tablespoon at a time and toss with fork until mixture forms a ball. Makes 2 balls. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 30 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Jam
instructions: Wash green tomatoes and chop in food processor enough to make 2 cups. Boil sugar and chopped tomatoes 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Add jello; dissolve. Put into hot jelly glasses. Put 1/8 inch paraffin on top. Tastes like raspberry jam.

title: Turtle Candy
instructions: Melt caramels milk and margarine in double boiler. Remove and add pecans and vanilla. Drop on buttered wax paper. Chill in refrigerator. Dip in chocolate and paraffin melted together. Chill again on wax paper. Enjoy!

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: After following instructions in Proverbs 2314 pour batter into well-greased loaf pans and bake 50 minutes in preheated oven. Cool and slice after a few John 119.

title: Picante Pesto Pasta
instructions: Combine spinach Pace picante cheese pecans oil and garlic in blender or food processor and process until smooth. Toss spinach mixture with hot cooked pasta. Sprinkle with additional chopped pecans. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Bring syrup margarine nuts and cinnamon to a boil. Cook and stir about 30 seconds. Pour into small baking pan. Arrange biscuits in pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Invert at once onto a serving plate. (Please be very careful; this is a hot sugar syrup mixture and you can get a severe burn if it drops on your fingers.) If you dont want to invert it have an adult do it for you. Yields 10. Be careful; be safety conscious!

title: Sweet And Sour Wieners
instructions: Cut wieners into bite size pieces. Heat sauce and wieners thoroughly in crock-pot or saucepan on low. Serve warm from dish or on toothpicks. Excess sauce can be refrigerated and reused.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Peel and cut apples into bite size pieces; add next 5 ingredients. Mix mayonnaise sour cream sugar and vanilla. Pour over apple mixture and mix well.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Put the potatoes soup and onion in covered casserole dish. Microwave for 16 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add the remaining ingredients to the potato mixture. Put all in crock-pot and heat.

title: Orange-Glazed Ham
instructions: Place ham on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stud ham with cloves if desired. Combine orange juice concentrate brown sugar and mustard. Brush on ham. Bake uncovered 30 minutes to 1 hour or until thermometer registers 140\u00b0 basting occasionally. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Little Burgers
instructions: Mix together mustard mayonnaise Worcestershire sauce and onions. Slice rolls in half. Spread mustard sauce on bottom layer. Top with ham slices. Top ham with cheese. Replace top of rolls. Place back into foil pan. Slice in 12 sandwiches. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated and cheese melts.

title: Florabell Rominger'S Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Mix together shortening 1 cup sugar flour baking powder salt and milk. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix berries 1 cup sugar and boiling water. Pour over batter mixture to cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and mix well. Mix rice onion butter and oil in 1 cup of hot water. Cook rice mixture approximately 15 minutes.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Put everything in a large pot. Cook slowly until tender. Wash and scald 9 pint jars and lids. When vegetables are tender put in jars and seal while hot. Makes 9 pints.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash until tender and drain. Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish. Add melted stick of butter. Pour on extra cup of stuffing on top after mixing or crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Fire And Ice Tomatoes
instructions: Skin and slice 6 large ripe and firm tomatoes. Slice 1 large green pepper into strips; slice 1 red onion into rings. Place in bowl. Mix remaining ingredients except cucumber. Place over heat; bring to boil. Boil furiously only 1 minute. Pour over tomatoes while hot. Cool. Just before serving add 1 peeled and sliced cucumber.

title: Italian Love Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan. Mix Ricotta cheese sugar eggs and vanilla; beat until smooth. Spread evenly on top of cake batter. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix the ingredients together and pour in oblong pan.

title: Chicken Spaghetti 2
instructions: In a medium-sized skillet or saucepan lightly saute the onion celery green pepper and mushrooms; set aside.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crock-pot. Add water to cover beans (about 7 cups). Cook about 8 hours on high in crock-pot.

title: Butternut Squash Cake
instructions: In large bowl combine first 6 ingredients. Beat eggs. Add to spice mixture. Mix dry ingredients together. Slowly add to spice mixture. Beat 5 minutes. Add pineapple squash and nuts. Fold in. Pour in large greased tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool. Frost with Buttercream Frosting or your favorite frosting.

title: Hawaiian Cooler
instructions: Prepare frozen juices as labels direct. Pour over ice in a large punch bowl. Add ginger ale. Top with pineapple chunks and cherries.

title: Deviled Ham Tea Sandwiches
instructions: Mix all together. Make sandwiches. Cut off crust then cut as desired.

title: Family-Style Beef Brisket Dinner(Makes About 8 Servings)
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. In a 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan add onion recipe soup mix blended with water. Add brisket turning to coat with soup mixture. Loosely wrap with aluminum foil and roast 1 hour. Add potatoes and carrots; toss to coat with soup mixture. Reseal foil and continue roasting 2 hours or until brisket and vegetables are tender. Thicken gravy if desired.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until light and fluffy. Add sweetened condensed milk. Blend thoroughly. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with pie filling before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Orange Pineapple Freeze
instructions: Combine all ingredients; chill well. Continue as normal for hand or electric ice cream freezer. Makes 2 1/2 quarts.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat in oil with garlic. Stir in onion soup water tomato paste and sauce salt oregano and sugar. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Cook noodles. Rinse with cold water. Arrange alternate layers of meat sauce noodles cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese in a casserole. Repeat layers ending with meat sauce and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until Mozzarella is melted. Yields 6 servings.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix coconut and pecans. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake by directions on box. Pour on coconut and pecans. In saucepan heat margarine and cream cheese until mixture is warm enough to stir in confectioners sugar. Spoon on top of cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Dont cut until it is cold.

title: Patty Shells
instructions: Combine ingredients and shape into shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together vegetable shortening margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Sift together flour and baking powder. Add small amount at a time to creamed mixture alternating with the 1/4 cup milk. Mix well. Add vanilla and undrained pineapple. Blend well. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Place in cold oven. Set temperature at 350\u00b0 and bake 1 1/2 hours or until done to the touch. Remove from oven. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove from pan and pour icing over while still hot.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine in container with lid and shake vigorously. Keeps about 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Beat potatoes cream cheese sour cream salt pepper and garlic at high speed until smooth. Stir in chives. Spoon into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon paprika. Dot with 1 tablespoon butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Snow Ball Cookies
instructions: Mix oleo powdered sugar and vanilla. Add flour and nuts; mix well. Refrigerate chill shape into balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Shake gently in paper bag with powdered sugar. Store in closed container.

title: Peggy'S Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell (or use graham cracker crust). Mix peanut butter and powdered sugar. Press all but a little of this mixture into pie shell. Make pudding by instructions on box. Pour into shell. Let set. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle remainder of powdered sugar and peanut butter on top.

title: Tuna-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Prepare noodles as label directs. Meanwhile in 3-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot salad oil cook celery and onion until tender. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir undiluted soup milk and mayonnaise into vegetables in saucepan. Drain noodles; add with tuna and tomato chunks to saucepan and toss to coat. Spoon mixture into deep 2-quart casserole. In 1-quart saucepan over low heat melt butter. Tear bread into small pieces and toss with melted butter. Sprinkle bread crumbs over noodle mixture. Bake casserole 30 minutes or until hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Wash and pick fresh blueberries or thaw and drain frozen blueberries.

title: Wonder Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well. Put in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pull Apart Garlic Bread
instructions: Cut the 2 frozen dough into 96 pieces. Mix the next 5 ingredients together (not the bread dough). Dip bread dough into egg mixture; drop into an angel food or Bundt pan. Let rise overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Pour mixture over potatoes and toss to coat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Stir occasionally to absorb liquid.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Lay broccoli in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Place chicken pieces on top. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry and mix well. Pour over chicken and sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and melted oleo and sprinkle over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. This serves 6. Fluffy rice is an excellent accompaniment.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cook sugar milk and cocoa 1 minute. Cool and add margarine and vanilla and beat until spreading consistency.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and add juice to vanilla pudding mix; mix well. Add pineapple chunks fruit cocktail and bananas. If more liquid is needed add some fruit cocktail juice. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and serve with assorted crackers.

title: Spanish Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in pan that has been greased and dusted with corn meal. Bake in oven at 425\u00b0 until brown.

title: No Peek Chicken
