instructions: Mix together and place on bottom of buttered pan. Place raw chicken pieces on top any number can be used. Sprinkle with dry onion soup. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Shrimp Newburg
instructions: Throw together the butter or margarine and flour. Mix until smooth. Add mushroom soup mushrooms and cheese; mix until smooth. Add 2 tablespoons or more of cooking sherry. Add shrimp or lobster; sprinkle with parsley. Add a dash of garlic powder. Serve on hot rice or pastry shells. Simple and excellent.

title: Oregon Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute bacon and onion in large kettle. Drain seafood; add liquid potatoes and water to onion and bacon. Cook until potatoes are tender 10 minutes. Just before serving add seafood milk salt and pepper. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Layered Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash cauliflower and cut flowerets in bite-size pieces. Layer lettuce onions cauliflowerets and bacon. Mix mayonnaise and sugar well. Spread over top to edge of bowl. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese; then cover tightly. Refrigerate overnight and toss gently before serving. Serves 8.

title: Falafil Or Taamiyah(Lebanese; International)
instructions: Mix all ingredients very well and knead well. Let it stand covered for 2 1/2 hours. Let the oil get hot on high heat. Add a dash of baking soda to the falafil with tablespoon water. Mix well. Shape into small circles; pat with the palm of your hands then fry in oil for 3 minutes on each side or until brown. Drain. Serve with pita bread chopped parsley pickles tahini chopped tomatoes.

title: Bacon Mushroom Roll-Ups
instructions: Cook bacon first. In large skillet saute bacon mushrooms onion salt and pepper for 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in cream cheese; set aside. Cut crust off of bread and roll bread with rolling pin to 1/4-inch thick. Spread about 2 tablespoons of mixture over each slice of bread. Roll and use toothpick to hold in place. Refrigerate about 1 hour. Cut into 1-inch bites. Place on cookie sheet. Brush with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes!

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar milk margarine and cocoa for 2 minutes. Start counting the time when margarine is melted and starts to boil. Let boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add oats vanilla and peanut butter (crunchy or smooth). Beat until blended. Spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar and continue to beat until light. Add vanilla and sifted flour. Mix well and fold in chopped nuts. Shape into small balls on an ungreased baking sheet and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 18 minutes until light light brown. Roll in confectioners sugar. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Fill square baking dish with sliced apples. Mix together the ingredients and spread over apples. Melt butter and pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Prepare noodles. Combine corned beef mushroom soup and milk. Mix with noodles. Pour into casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Pineapple Goody(Yields 16 Servings)
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 for glass dish and at 350\u00b0 for metal pan.

title: Peach Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter and brown sugar in 9 x 9-inch pan. Lay peaches on brown sugar mixture. Pour batter over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Place cake mix and pudding in a large bowl. Add eggs oil boiling water and poppy seed. Place in 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. This bread freezes well.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Oil potatoes lightly and bake at 350\u00b0 until soft. Peel. Cream potatoes; remove strings (fibers). Add other ingredients. Blend until smooth. Pour in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Best if topped before baking.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Put sugar milk butter and cocoa into pan. Bring to a boil until it forms a soft ball. Remove from heat. Add oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. Let stand 1/2 hour until dry.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Ken'S Morning Salad
instructions: Add pineapple fruit cocktail oranges and bananas to instant pudding. Chill. A great brunch salad when fresh fruit is not in season. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Quick And Easy Sweet Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles. Slice into a large bowl. Add sugar and oil. Stir occasionally until sugar dissolves. Rinse jar and return pickles and syrup to jar. Refrigerate until crisp (about 2 days).

title: Breadsticks Italiano
instructions: Combine all ingredients except breadsticks; mix well. Place dough on cookie sheet according to package directions. Spread lightly with margarine mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with remaining margarine mixture. Makes 8 breadsticks.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: In baking dish break up bread slices. Brown sausage slightly drain. Spoon sausage over bread. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over bread and sausage. Beat eggs; add milk dry mustard salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour over mixture.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter. Add onion and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes. Blend cream and flour and add along with sherry Worcestershire salt pepper and paprika to taste. Add shrimp and put in large buttered casserole. Top with crumbs and bake in 350\u00b0 oven until brown 20 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Spice Chiffon Cake
instructions: Mix together flour sugar baking powder salt cinnamon nutmeg allspice and cloves. Set aside. In another bowl whip egg whites and cream of tartar until a very stiff peak forms. Set aside. To the dry ingredients add oil water vanilla and egg yolks. Mix until smooth. Pour egg whites into yolk mixture gently folding with rubber scraper until blended. Bake in 10-inch ungreased tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Towards last heat at 350\u00b0 until done. Invert let cool. Stays moist.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients until creamy. Beat in water egg and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients; mix well. Cover chill about 2 hours. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with tines of fork dipped in granulated sugar to form crisscross pattern. Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet; remove to wire rack. Cool completely. Store tightly covered. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: One Meal Dish
instructions: Scramble sausage in a large skillet and cook almost done. Chop green peppers and onions; cook until done. Add corn diced tomatoes Mrs. Dash seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for 10 minutes. Best served with cornbread.

title: Vegetables Parmigiana
instructions: Seed pepper and cut into chunks. Set aside. Heat oil; add eggplant zucchini peppers and onions. Cook until barely tender. Drain vegetables on paper toweling.

title: Cream Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Beat together eggs sugar milk and flour. Fold in diced rhubarb. Put into pastry-lined 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and dot with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix flour soda salt cinnamon and sugar in a large bowl and make a well. Place strawberries with juice eggs oil and pecans in the well and stir until moistened. Pour into loaf pans that have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Cool 30 minutes before removing bread from pans. This bread freezes well.

title: Pat-N-Roll Cookies
instructions: Mix and roll into balls. Press flat with glass or hand. Decorate. Bake 8 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: One Step Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. While the butter is melting mix together sugar flour and milk. Pour batter into melted butter and add any kind of fruit. Bake at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Mix sugar and Crisco until creamy. Add eggs milk flour and vanilla. Beat until mixture is creamy. Pour into two 9-inch cake pans. Bake 30 minutes or until bounces when touched.

title: Danish Puff
instructions: Cut margarine into flour until it is very fine. Add water; beat it until it forms a ball and leaves the sides of the bowl. Take this ball and divide it in two parts. Use ungreased cookie sheet. Press this mixture onto cookie sheet making two sections 3 x 12-inch. Make these two sections 3 inches apart on the sheet.

title: Sausage Balls(Makes About 120)
instructions: Grate or melt cheese. Mix all ingredients together using your hands. Roll into small balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet not touching. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into baking dish for muffins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Moravian Cookies
instructions: In large bowl mix together flour sugar and shortening. Make a hole in center. Pour in molasses. Add spices salt and soda. Blend well. Add hot water. (Add more flour if necessary to form a soft dough.) (These ingredients should all be mixed by hand.) Refrigerate overnight before baking. Roll out a fist sized ball of dough on floured surface. (Should roll very thin.) Cut with assorted cutters. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Broccoli Walnut Ring *
instructions: Grease 1 1/2-quart mold pan with margarine. Saute onion and garlic in margarine until golden. Dissolve starch in bouillon and add to saute. Cook until thick and smooth. Cool slightly. Beat egg yolks until light. Stir yolks broccoli and walnuts into saute mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff in separate bowl. Fold into broccoli mixture. Spoon into mold. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until firm at 350\u00b0. Wait 5 minutes after removed from oven before unmolding. Serve.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in 4 qt. casserole dish. Mix corn flour sugar and salt. Add eggs and beat until mixed. Add half and half. Pour into butter in casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees 30-40 mins. or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove yolks. Save whites. Whip egg yolks and remaining ingredients until smooth. Refill whites with egg yolk mixture. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Skin chicken and stew.\tCool and remove bone and cut into small pieces; set aside. Melt margarine and add stuffing mix; stir well. Place\thalf of stuffing mixture in bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish. Put\tcut-up\tchicken pieces on layer of stuffing.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Sausage Fondue
instructions: Spray 9x13 pan. Cube bread and put in bottom of pan. brown meat drain. Add mushrooms & pimentos. Beat eggs milk mustard and salt with beater. Put cheese on top. Add milk-egg mixture on top. Cover with foil & refrigerate over night. Next morning mix 1 can mushroom soup & 1/2 can milk. Spread over top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool before cutting. Do not cover when baking. Cut into squares.

title: Country Cornbread
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 8-inch cast-iron skillet. Mix cornmeal flour baking powder salt and sugar. Add and beat until smooth the eggs melted shortening and milk. Pour into heated skillet and bake 20 to 25 minutes until brown.

title: Grandma Bond'S Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Sift together first 4 ingredients. Add milk beaten egg and oil all at once. Add an optional 1 to 1 1/2 cups raisins or dates (water poured over raisins and cooled before adding to dough) or 1/2 cup grated cheese for making cheese buns. Stir this mixture with a fork just until mixed and not a second longer. Turn out onto a floured board. Sprinkle a little flour on top and on hands and knead just until it stops being sticky no longer. Cut into 12 biscuits and place on a floured cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Three Fruit Punch
instructions: Blend lemonade pineapple and strawberries for 7 minutes until smooth. Combine with ginger ale and pour over crushed ice. (May mix fruit in advance. Cover and store in refrigerator.) Combine with ginger ale just before serving.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Mix in a large bowl the peanut butter 10x sugar 1 stick melted butter (or margarine) and graham cracker crumbs. Press mixture into an 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and 1/2 stick butter together then spread over peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate 1 hour. Slice into squares.

title: Old Settlers Beans
instructions: Brown beef and onion in a large pot. Add all other ingredients and simmer for 25 minutes. This makes a hearty meal especially when served with hot cornbread and a salad.

title: Shephard'S Pie
instructions: Brown onion in hot fat; add meat and seasonings brown. Add Grandmas spanish seasoning. Add drained beans and soup; pour into greased casserole. Mash potatoes; add milk egg and seasonings. Spoon in mounds over meat. Bake in moderate oven (350 degrees) 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Grilled Vegetables
instructions: In 12-quart saucepan over high heat in 2-inches of boiling water heat zucchini onions peppers squash eggplants and 1 tablespoon salt to boiling. When water returns to boil remove peppers and squash to roasting pan. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer until zucchini is tender-crisp (about 5 minutes). Remove. Cover and cook remaining vegetables 15 minutes longer. Remove.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine together. Beat eggs add sugar. Add flour and chocolate mixture. Blend. Fold in nuts. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and cut.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger; add taco powder. In baking dish spread refried beans and hamburger in layers. Heat until warm. Remove from oven; spread sour cream cheese tomatoes lettuce and taco sauce (in layers). Ready to serve.

title: Sausage Baked Beans
instructions: Brown sausage. Put pork and beans in bowl. Add sausage and onion. Boil water sugar salt ginger and dry mustard. Pour over sausage beans and onion mixture. Put in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Fry meat. Drain off excess grease. Combine soup and tomatoes to meat. Mix well. Let cook 15 minutes in baking dish. Layer all ingredients. Put a layer of corn tortillas on bottom. Then meat mixture (part of it about 1/3) then onions then cheese continue until all gone. Leave some cheese to sprinkle evenly for topping. Bake at 300\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Let cool. Cut like a pie and enjoy enjoy!

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Combine butter sugar eggs dairy sour cream or half and half bananas and vanilla; set aside. Blend flour with salt and baking soda. Mix all together alternating with flour and bananas.

title: Easy And Delicious Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Mix frozen lemonade according to directions on can. Add to gelatin. Add pineapple juice. Stir thoroughly and pour over ice in punch bowl. Just before serving add ginger ale. Makes 20 cups.

title: Do Nothing Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box using only 1/4 cup water. Add pineapple juice and all. Pour into greased 10 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add catsup Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Stir. Put in casserole dish and top with cheese and biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Red Hot Dipping Sauce
instructions: In bowl combine all ingredients. Stir and let stand for 2 hours. Great for dipping fries on hot dogs and burgers.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Rinse shrimp; drain. Mix together. Roll in nuts and refrigerate.

title: Cranberry Tea
instructions: Put cranberries water cinnamon sticks and whole cloves in a large stock pot. Bring to a boil then simmer for about 25 to 30 minutes. (Dont be alarmed by the \popping\ sound the cranberries make as they brew.) After brewing remove pot from heat and scoop out large pieces of cranberries and spices with a slotted spoon being careful not to squeeze or press. Discard large pieces. Add sugar and juices to hot liquid. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Strain slowly through cheesecloth into a clean pot. Again dont strain by squeezing or pressing as it will cause the tea to be cloudy. Store in clean glass bottles. Will keep for weeks in refrigerator. Serve piping hot.

title: Easy Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; form into ball. Refrigerate overnight. Before serving roll in chopped nuts. Serve with crackers.

title: Egg Mcmuffin
instructions: Scramble eggs in skillet. Place eggs and cheese on English muffin. Heat in microwave or toaster oven. Makes 24 servings.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Butter 2 (15 1/2 x 12-inch) baking sheets. Combine soda water and vanilla; set aside. Combine sugar 1 cup water corn syrup in large saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally to 240\u00b0 by candy thermometer or when forms a soft ball when dropped into water. Stir in peanuts and butter. Cool until 300\u00b0 (or when dropped in very cold water separates into threads which are hard and brittle). Immediately remove from heat; stir in soda mixture thoroughly. Pour half the candy onto warm baking sheet and quickly spread evenly about 1/4-inch thick. Cool. Break candy into pieces. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Mix well roll\tin balls and\troll in sugar.\tBake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mandarin Jello
instructions: Drain orange juice into measuring cup. Add water to juice to make 1 cup. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add measured liquid. Add sherbet by spoonfuls stirring until melted. Chill until thickened. Fold in oranges; chill until set.

title: Roasted Potato Salad
instructions: Layer potatoes in single layer in shallow pan in small amount of oil. Roast potatoes in 375\u00b0 oven until golden. Add crumbled bacon onion pepper and eggs. Salt to taste. Add mayonnaise or salad dressing to taste.

title: Curried Ginger Salad
instructions: Cut cooked chicken into 1-inch cubes while warm. Mix together curry powder salt and lemon juice; toss with chicken and refrigerate until cool. Combine with grapes walnuts celery and candied ginger. Toast almond slices; cool. Approximately one hour before serving add sour cream and mayonnaise to chicken. Serve on lettuce leaves (red leaf or bibb).\tPlace 3 slices cantaloupe around base. Top with almonds a slice or two of ginger and a strawberry fan. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Skillet-Creamed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in large pieces. Mix other ingredients in 10-inch skillet. Add potatoes. On medium heat heat and stir until sour cream bubbles.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Mix with French dressing and Italian dressing garlic mustard Worcestershire sauce lemon juice and salt. Mix well. Set aside. Mix together rest of ingredients and marinate in salad dressing overnight. Drain well before serving. Salad will keep several days.

title: Aggie Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients stirring to dissolve sugar. Chill. Add orange and lemon rings and ice just before serving.

title: Deluxe Pecan Pie
instructions: In small bowl beat eggs slightly at medium speed. Beat in corn syrup sugar margarine vanilla and salt until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake 55 to 65 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.

title: Holiday Delight
instructions: Prepare gelatin in large bowl according to package directions. Place gelatin bowl on ice. Beat with rotary beater until fluffy and firm. Fold in whipped cream. Combine pineapple cherries and marshmallows with gelatin. Pour into lightly greased mold. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into ball. Roll in remaining pecans.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Mix all together and let cook until potatoes are tender. Let cool for a few minutes and serve.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in extra powdered sugar. Makes four dozen.

title: Bob Andy Pie
instructions: Mix eggs brown sugar flour margarine cream and vanilla. Mix well. Then add coconut and pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35-40 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Brownies
instructions: Place in mixing bowl the flour sugar cocoa baking powder and salt. Add next 4 ingredients and mix thoroughly. Beat 2 minutes on low speed. Stir in nuts. Spread batter in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Avoid overbaking. Frost or sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Zucchini, Tomato And Onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Layer onion tomato and zucchini in a 2-quart nonstick casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle each layer with seasonings and bake for 30 to 45 minutes (varies on how soft you want the vegetables).

title: Creamy Potato Toss
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce; mix lightly. Chill. Serve in lettuce-lined bowl. Makes 8 servings at 155 calories per serving.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour and dry ingredients. Add sugar to Crisco and cream until fluffy. Blend in one egg at a time. Mix until smooth and light after each. Stir in nuts and lemon rind. Add flour alternately with banana pulp. Blend well. Pour into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until brown. Cool on wire rack.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine graham crackers and 1 stick margarine. Press into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Beat sugar eggs remaining margarine and vanilla together for 20 minutes (no less). Spread mixture on graham cracker base. Slice bananas and lay on top. Top with pineapple. Spread Cool Whip on top of the pineapple and sprinkle with nuts and cherries. Chill 8 hours.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into quarters. Roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture. After you roll in sugar and cinnamon drop them in Bundt pans. Boil mixture of margarine brown sugar and granulated sugar together. Pour mixture over biscuits in Bundt pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn out of pan while hot. Do not cut. Pull puffs off cake.

title: Tamara'S Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken (removing any loose fat) and lay flat. Sprinkle (in this order) seasoned pepper garlic powder and parsley on one side of chicken. Put in skillet (seasoned side up). Pour soy sauce over chicken then pour water around chicken. Place lid on skillet steam chicken (approximately 5 to 7 minutes each side) turn twice. Remove lid and continue cooking until done (most of liquid should be gone when chicken is done). Approximate cooking time 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with your favorite side dishes.

title: Fresh Fruit Cake Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Resembles coarse meal. Slice peaches and plums but on top of cake dough spread jam over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until golden brown.

title: Football Fan'S Appetizer
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Stir together salad dressing and taco sauce; add to beef mixing well. Stir in 3/4 cup cheese and onion. Spoon mixture into 9-inch pie plate; top with remaining cheese. Insert chips around edge of pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with additional chips.

title: Lazy Pierogi
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions. Rinse the sauerkraut before cooking. When both are cooked drain but do not rinse. Melt stick of margarine and add the diced onion. Saute until golden brown. Add to the combined mixture of cooked noodles and kraut. Salt and pepper to taste. May be served with any meat but especially pork. Cooking time 15 minutes. Servings 4 to 8.

title: Mom'S Greatest Chili
instructions: Cook pinto beans all day on low heat. Season with salt pork. After pintos are done brown ground beef. Drain excess fat from meat. Add chopped onion; cook until tender. Add chili powder. Stir well. Then add ground beef mixture to pinto beans and add 1 large can tomato sauce. Simmer on low heat for about 1 1/2 hours. Keep stirred. Serve with cheese and crackers on a cold night. Best chili youve ever ate if cooked correctly.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Bring sugar oil and vinegar to a boil. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat. Let cool. Mix sauerkraut onions celery green pepper and pimentos. Pour vinegar mixture over all. Mix well. Refrigerate 24 hours. Will keep 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Appetizer Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flour and oil in large bowl. Using about 1 tablespoon of mixture for each meatball shape into balls. Roll each meatball lightly in flour to coat. Place in single layer on a baking sheet. Refrigerate 1 hour or up to 2 days.

title: Fruit Compote
instructions: Combine all fruit; blend well. Stir in pudding mix. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Use a slotted spoon to serve fruit mixture.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Set aside and while hot stir in oats and vanilla. Drop quickly by spoon on wax paper or greased pan until cool. Do not bake!

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and shape into ball. Chill about 45 minutes then roll in 1 cup of nuts.

title: Texas Nibbles
instructions: Combine dry cereals pretzel sticks and mixed nuts. In a saucepan melt margarine and combine with Worcestershire sauce smoke Tabasco sauce and seasonings. Toss with the cereals and nuts. Place in a shallow roasting pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Place on an opened grocery sack until dry and cool. Makes 8 cups approximately.

title: Fruity Yogurt Sipper
instructions: If using banana or peaches cut into chunks. In a blender container combine fruit milk yogurt and sugar. Cover and blend until smooth. With blender running add ice cubes one at a time through opening in lid. Blend until smooth. Makes 4 (about 8 ounce) servings.

title: Spicy Fried Zucchini
instructions: Mix egg and milk. Dip zucchini in the milk and egg mixture then dredge in the corn meal. Fry in the light oil in a heavy skillet until golden on both sides.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in salted water until tender; drain in large skillet. Saute onions. Add soup mix. Add cheese and heat until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in cabbage salt and pepper. Pour into ungreased 2-quart baking dish. In a small skillet use other tablespoon. Cook and stir bread crumbs until lightly browned. Then sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Billie'S Goodies
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over hot crust. Continue baking 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Pumpkin-Ricotta Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs lightly in a large bowl; add Ricotta cheese and beat until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients until well blended; then pour into pastry shell. Bake for 45 minutes. Cool completely on wire rack. Just before serving garnish with yogurt and pumpkin seed (optional).

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Let potatoes cool. Add all ingredients and mix well. Very easy and delicious.

title: Dot'S Dip(Shook)
instructions: Mix and cook in crock-pot on low until onion and pepper are done. Serve hot with favorite chips.

title: Pork Chops And Spanish Rice(Serves 5)
instructions: Cooking time is 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Italian Beef
instructions: Cut chuck roast in small pieces. Place in crock-pot. Pour juice from both jars pepperoncini over meat. Put 1 jar of pepperoncini in crock-pot with meat. Sprinkle dry Italian dressing over meat in crock-pot. Cook on high 8 to 10 hours until meat is tender and pulls apart easily.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pick chicken off the bones. Layer meat sour cream and cream of chicken soup. Crush Ritz crackers and melted oleo; mix the two and spread on top of mixture. Put in oven until Ritz crackers are crisp. Serves 8.

title: Lobster Pie(Microwave)
instructions: Lightly mix lobster pieces green pepper cheese eggs light cream and salt in medium bowl. Pour filling into 9-inch baked pie crust. Sprinkle with paprika. Cook on cook level 4 for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Turn 1/4 turn halfway through cooking time. Yield 6 servings.

title: Best Spinach Dip Ever
instructions: Mix sour cream Ranch Dressing mix onion soup mix water chestnuts cream cheese and chopped spinach in a bowl. Chill for 6 hours or overnight. Remove the top from the bread and make a bowl. Cut the carved-out bread top into bite-sized cubes for dining. Serve in bread bowl.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix Cheddar and cream cheese well then add other ingredients except for pecans. Shape into a ball. Chill then pat in pecans. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Meatless Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all cheeses and egg together set aside. Mix spaghetti sauce and water then heat. Cover the bottom of a cake pan with 3/4 cup of sauce then a layer of lasagna then a layer of the cheese mixture. Use 1/2 of it. Put another layer of sauce lasagna and cheese mixture sauce and a layer of lasagna in that order. Pour remaining sauce over the top. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 50 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes. You do not have to cook the lasagna beforehand.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring milk or half and half to a boil on medium heat.

title: Pecan Coffee Cake Ring
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Pour half of the honey into the bottom of a greased tube pan. Roll biscuits in chopped pecans and layer in pan overlapping slightly. Pour rest of honey on top. Bake 30 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture.

title: Harvest Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice; set pineapple chunks aside. Pour juice into a small saucepan; add sugar and flour. Bring to a boil. Quickly stir in egg; cook until thickened. Remove from heat and cool - then refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli 5 minutes; drain. Mix all together. Pour into casserole. Sprinkle cracker crumbs. Drizzle butter and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Cut the meat into 1-inch squares and saute in oil with onions. Add all ingredients. Add 1 can of tomato sauce with wine. Bring to a quick boil and simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours. Add potatoes after 1 1/2 hours. Let it cook another 30 minutes. The final stew mixture should be thick. Taste it for seasoning before serving. Makes 12 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and roll into 1-inch balls. Place on wax paper. Melt paraffin and chocolate mixture. Return to waxed paper and let cool.

title: Gyna'S Oven Barbecued Brisket
instructions: Rub whole brisket with garlic onion and celery salt. (You may use powder if salt is a problem.) Pour 4 or 5 tablespoons of Worcestershire sauce and liquid smoke on brisket. (Have large pieces of foil in roaster.) Wrap foil tightly and marinate overnight in refrigerator. Remove brisket (discard marinade); salt and pepper brisket. Cook 4 to 5 hours at 275\u00b0 to 300\u00b0. Remove brisket from juice to an open pan; cover with barbecue sauce made from 2 cups juice and 2 (more or less as desired) bottles barbecue sauce. Cook open for about 1 hour. Serve with this sauce.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Cream butter; add eggs and sugar gradually. Add dry ingredients and chopped dates. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 to 4 dozen. Believe it or not I get compliments every time I make these.

title: Chocolate Cookie Torte
instructions: You will need 1 (10-inch) spring-form pan.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Make pastry shell with fluted edge. Spread nuts over bottom of shell. Beat eggs; add sugar syrup salt vanilla and butter. Pour filling over pecans. Bake 10 minutes in very hot oven at 450\u00b0. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 35 minutes longer.

title: Wetbacks
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions; drain. Dutch oven works well. Add tomato sauce paste water and seasonings. Simmer 30 minutes. Separately cook 1 cup regular rice. Add to meat. Cook another 30 minutes. Make Ranch dressing.

title: Chicken And Rice Dinner
instructions: Wrap chicken with dried beef. Hold together with toothpicks. Mix with rest of ingredients and cook in a slow cooker on low all day or 3 hours on high. Chicken can be wrapped and left in refrigerator overnight before cooking. Serve with rice. Can be made low-fat by skinning chicken using low-fat sour cream low-fat soup and omitting dried beef.

title: Shrimp And Crabmeat Jambalaya
instructions: Saute shrimp celery garlic and onions in Dutch oven until shrimp are nearly done. Add crabmeat and 1 cup water and simmer about 5 minutes. Add 2 cups cooked rice. Mix and simmer together until done about 10 to 15 minutes. Add plenty of red pepper and salt to taste. Serves 6 to 10 people.

title: Snicker Bar Cake
instructions: Mix cake. Mix according to directions on package. Place 1/2 of mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Chicken Sauce
instructions: Mix together. Brush on chicken several times while barbecuing.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: *Example Strawberries apples kiwi fruit bananas cantaloupe etc.

title: Indian Casserole
instructions: Melt butter; stir in bread crumbs. Sprinkle over hominy and corn mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until crumbs are brown.

title: Almond Hershey Pie
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk in top of double boiler. Add almond bars. Stir until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Cool. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into baked pie shell. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Hot Pepper Butter
instructions: Clean peppers. Leave seeds in and run through food chopper. Combine salt sugar mustard and vinegar. Mix with peppers and boil 10 to 15 minutes then add flour and water. Mix well and cook about 5 minutes or until it thickens. Fill jars and seal. Makes 9 to 11 pints.

title: Beer Mustard
instructions: Mix all together well. Add stale beer to thin as desired. Pour into jars and seal.

title: Pie Crust Ii
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour and salt. Slowly add water until forms a ball. Roll into crusts. Yields 2 to 3 crusts.

title: Any Flavor Punch
instructions: Mix well and enjoy!

title: Baked Hash Browns
instructions: Pour soups and sour cream (mixed) over hash brown potatoes. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Never Fail Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken with plenty of water. Remove chicken and add cream of chicken soup. Start to boiling rapidly. Mix the flour mixture and water. Remove small amounts of mixture and roll thin. Cut\tor tear pieces and drop into rolling broth. Never stir vigorously. Push the dumplings with spoon.

title: Make Ahead Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Cut in shortening. Mix egg water and vinegar; stir into flour mixture. Chill well before you roll out the crusts. Place in pans and freeze. Makes 6 crusts.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Beat together the oleo peanut butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Sift together the flour and salt. Add the oats. Shape into balls. Bake. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Nonalcohol Beer Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Zucchini
instructions: Fry onion in butter and olive oil until tender. Add zucchini and cover until soft and cooked down. Pour off water. Salt and cover with cheeses. Cover and let melt. Serve.

title: Diabetic Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients. Pour batter into an 8 x 12-inch cake pan. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Combine mix milk eggs salt and pepper. Beat until smooth. Separate onion into rings. Dip into batter. (Additional milk may be added if batter thickens upon standing.) Fry in deep hot oil (440\u00b0) for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Drain; sprinkle with salt if desired.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flavoring and flour then fold in 7-Up. Mix well. Pour into well-greased Bundt pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Biscuit Barbecue
instructions: Grease muffin tin or spray with Pam or favorite cooking spray. Mash 1 biscuit dough in each muffin tin on sides and bottom to look like a tart shell. (10 biscuits 10 muffins.)

title: Apple Cinnamon Swirl Cake
instructions: Mix together last 3 ingredients and set aside. Blend cake mix and applesauce together until smooth; add eggs and beat 2 minutes. Grease Bundt pan sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar cinnamon and flour mixture in greased pan. Pour 2/3 of batter in pan. Scatter remaining sugar and cinnamon over batter. Put rest of batter on top and swirl with a knife to mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or when touched springs back. Allow to cool in pan 15 minutes.

title: Snow Crackers
instructions: Arrange on a baking sheet 24 soda crackers. Beat egg whites until frothy. Gradually beat in 1/4 cup sugar and beat until stiff. Stir in vanilla. Spoon \snow\ onto crackers. Spread to edge of each cracker. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Do not overbake!

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: For best meatballs select meat yourself and have it ground. Saute onions in fat for 5 minutes. Place in large mixing bowl with remaining ingredients and mix until smooth. Shape into balls about the size of a walnut using a tablespoon as a measurement in the wet palm of your hand. Fry meatballs in plenty of hot shortening (about 1/2 cup) with about six in the pan at a time. Keep turning to keep them round. After all meatballs are brown and well done pour off most of the fat. Add about a cup of water to the frying pan to scrape up all the browned bits. Pour this over the meatballs in the saucepan; cover with a lid and simmer for about 20 minutes. Can be made the day before.

title: Skillet Cabbage
instructions: Melt oleo in heavy skillet. Add cabbage; cover and cook about 10 minutes or until tender. Season with lemon juice caraway seed salt and pepper. Just before serving sprinkle with paprika. Serves 6.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time then add sour cream. Beat well. Add flour and soda a little at a time. Add beaten egg whites; slowly fold into mixture and add flavoring. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sweet Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in electric blender container; blend until smooth stopping to scrape down sides if necessary. Chill 1 hour. Serve with assorted fruits. Makes 4 cups.

title: Chocolate Syrup Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a tube pan. Beat separated egg whites until stiff; set aside. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. In a mixing bowl blend together sugar margarine and Crisco; beat until creamy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating after each. Add chocolate syrup. Alternately add milk and flour mixture to creamy mixture. Add beaten egg whites. Add flavoring last; beat well. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool; remove from the pan.

title: Sea Island Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch square baking pan; set aside. Melt butter. Add sugars and water; blend well. Stir in flour. Add egg and vanilla; blend thoroughly. Add nuts coconut and chocolate chips; blend well. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 30 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut into bars. Makes 16 bars.

title: Frozen Bananas
instructions: Spread celery with peanut butter. Optional dot with raisins.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: First Layer Mix flour chopped nuts and margarine together. Pat in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool.

title: Candied Pickles
instructions: Drain off alum water. Cover with apple cider vinegar and let stand 24 hours. Add to this 3 cups sugar for 3 mornings. Put in jars and seal. Do not heat anything.

title: Underground Ham
instructions: Combine ham margarine onion and Worcestershire and cook until onions are tender. Place in bottom of a medium-size roasting pan. In a saucepan heat together soup milk and cheese until melted. Place over top of onions. Mash potatoes using no salt or milk and mix with sour cream. Spread over top of mixture and sprinkle with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Favorite Curried Eggs
instructions: Melt butter in heavy deep saucepan. Saute celery until soft not brown. Drain mushrooms and add with curry powder to the celery mixture. Mix well. Saute 1 minute. Stir in the 4 cans of soup and bouillon cube. Add 2 cups milk and blend until smooth. Cook for 1 minute over medium heat.

title: Fennel Seed Biscuits
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Make a well in the center of the bowl and pour in water and oil. Mix well. Form into round biscuits. Brush with beaten egg. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Plain Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Add slowly the egg yolks flour vanilla soda salt and sour cream. Mix all ingredients together. Then fold in 6 stiffly beaten egg whites. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in a Bundt pan.

title: Chicken Nabori
instructions: Mix all soups and mushrooms. Pour rice and soup mixture into a flat greased 3-inch baking dish. Press in raw chicken. Cover with 1/8 to 1/4 cup melted butter and dust with paprika. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 275\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sipping Cider
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill well.

title: Rocky Road
instructions: Place in microwave the chocolate chips. Cook 5 minutes at 60%; do not stir. Remove stir and add marshmallows pecan pieces and raisins (optional). Line a dish with wax paper. Pour in mix. When cool just lift out and cut. Then place back into dish.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine sugar with margarine and oil; add eggs and mix well. Add all ingredients except chips. Combine well. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle chips on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch and cinnamon in a 2-quart saucepan. Stir in peaches and lemon juice. Cook until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir for 1 minute. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Keep peach mixture hot. Cut shortening into flour 1 tablespoon sugar baking powder and salt until mixture resembles fine bread crumbs. Stir in milk. Drop by spoonfuls into hot peach mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until topping is brown.

title: Boiled Spice Cake
instructions: Put sugar oleo eggs raisins boiling water soda cinnamon cloves and allspice in pan. Mix thoroughly and let come to a boil. Cool. When cool add flour and baking powder. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan at 350\u00b0 until done about 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients in double boiler and cook until thickened. Pour in baked pie shell. Top with meringue and bake in 425\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: E-Z Cinnamon Roll
instructions: Stretch a roll to 5-inch length. Roll in butter then cinnamon/sugar mixture. Tie in a knot. Place on well oiled baking dish. Continue until pan is filled. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mama'S Vegetable Soup
instructions: Scramble and cook hamburger meat in skillet. Cook macaroni cover with water and boil until done. Add all ingredients to macaroni and cook until done.

title: Light Vegetable Pizza
instructions: *Celery tomatoes green pepper cauliflower broccoli and carrots chopped fine.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Cook in saucepan until thick. Pour into pie shell and bake.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Heat bacon and butter until fat has run. Add onions and celery. Cook until light brown. Add chicken broth and bring to boil. Add potatoes salt and pepper and cook until tender. Add milk and bring to a boil. Add corn and lower heat until the corn is heated. Add the light cream and garnish with butter and parsley.

title: Applesauce Spice Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Blend then beat at medium speed 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove and cool on rack.

title: Kielbasa Rice
instructions: Combine in large pot 5 cups water salt yellow coloring garlic pimentos red pepper ground pepper Kielbasa onions butter and oil. Bring to boil add rice. Cover turn on low and simmer 20 to 25 minutes until almost all water is gone. Remove from heat uncover and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Browned Pressured Roast Beef
instructions: Slice meat about 1-inch thick. Be sure meat is cut right or will be stringy. Put salt pepper seasoning salt and garlic salt on both sides of meat. Not too salty. Flour both sides of each meat. Brown in frying pan until both sides are brown. Put meat inside of pressure cooker on meat rack. Add 1 1/2 cups of water and onion. Cook about 40 minutes on medium heat. When done use juice for gravy. If not thick enough add cornstarch that has been dissolved in water.

title: Labscotch
instructions: Alternate top 5 ingredients to form layers in a large greased casserole. Top with cracker crumbs. Cover with milk. Dot with butter. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Remove cover after 1 hour.

title: Cold Duck Punch
instructions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Noodles Romano
instructions: Cream Cheese Sauce Combine 1/4 cup butter parsley and basil. Blend in cream cheese and pepper. Stir in 2/3 cup boiling water. Blend mixture well. Keep warm over pan of hot water.

title: Date Balls With Rice Krispies
instructions: Heat the sugar margarine and dates over low heat until melted. Then add coconut chopped nuts vanilla and Rice Krispies. Mix well. Roll into balls and shake in powdered sugar.

title: Chicken-N-Rice
instructions: Place uncooked chicken in baking dish. Cover with uncooked rice. Add cream of chicken soup cream of mushroom soup and cubed cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until rice and chicken are tender (about 1 hour).

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Combine first three ingredients. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition then add remaining ingredients except for shells. Pour into 10-inch pie shells. Use two 9-inch frozen pie shells. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 40 to 45 minutes longer.

title: Herb Tomato Aspic
instructions: In saucepan sprinkle gelatin over 1 cup cold juice to soften. Place over low heat stirring until gelatin is dissolved. Remove from heat; add remaining juice vinegar and seasonings. Pour into low pan. Chill 4 hours or until firm. Serve as desired.

title: Buttermilk Pie(From The Files Of Mertis Adams)
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil in saucepan and pour into baked pie shell. Top with 3 egg whites beaten with sugar and bake.

title: Mozzarella Fried(Mozzarella Fritto)
instructions: Cut Mozzarella cheese into 1-inch cubes. Beat eggs with parsley salt and pepper. Roll cubes in flour and dip in egg mixture. Roll in bread crumbs; dip in egg and roll once again in bread crumbs. Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Fry in hot oil until bread crumbs turn a nice golden brown 2 to 3 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 40 to 45 pieces.

title: Maggie'S Winter Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Easy Coconut Pie
instructions: Thaw pie shells. Sprinkle coconut in bottom of pie shells. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over top of coconut. Bake at 325 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes. Yield 12-16 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: You also need wax paper.

title: Colcannon
instructions: Boil potatoes onions and chopped cabbage in salted water until tender. Drain well. Melt butter in heavy skillet. Saute boiled vegetables and parsley in butter. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Braunschweiger Mold
instructions: Mix braunschweiger 1/2 of the cream cheese pickles juice Tabasco sauce garlic salt Worcestershire sauce and mayonnaise thoroughly. Form into a round mold.

title: Rhubarb Nut Bread
instructions: Sift ingredients together in order given. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured loaf pans. Fill 2/3 full. Spread evenly over each. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until tester comes out clean.

title: Marinated Vegetable-Spaghetti Noodle Salad
instructions: Mix vegetables and spaghetti noodles. Pour Italian dressing and chill for 30 minutes. Add mayonnaise and chill 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with crackers or corn chips. Also good with hot dogs hamburgers or barbecue instead of potato salad.

title: Mother'S Plum Pudding
instructions: Chill jello hot water and dash of salt. Add raisins cooked prunes citron walnuts grapenuts cinnamon and cloves. Chill until firm. Serve with sweetened whipped cream.

title: Raspberry Grape Punch
instructions: Add Vernors and 1 quart raspberry sherbet and serve.

title: One Pot Dinner #1
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot. Bring to a boil. Simmer 15 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Chocolate Eclairs
instructions: In sheet cake pan layer graham crackers. Mix instant pudding and milk. Add Cool Whip. Add onto graham crackers layered in pan. (Can layer twice alternating crackers and pudding mix.) Add chocolate frosting on top.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Grease 9-inch pie plate or 9\tx 9-inch baking dish. Combine all ingredients mixing until zucchini are just coated with batter. Bake in preheated oven 350\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes or until lightly brown. You may cut into bite-size squares as hors doeuvres.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and dry ingredients. Stir\tin mashed bananas and pour in an 8-inch square pan (greased). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tangy Meatballs
instructions: Mix all together and form into meatballs. Bake on foil lined cookie sheet in 400\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes.

title: Sugarless Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients; sprinkle pudding and jello over mixture. Mix well and cover. Refrigerate overnight. Good with angel food cake.

title: Mexican Fiesta Casserole(For Microwave)
instructions: Cook ground beef 5 minutes on High and crumble. Mix soups and tomatoes. Layer in a 2-quart casserole dish half of tortilla chips beef onion and soup mixture. Bake until cheese melts and is heated through on Medium-high.

title: Pumpkin Fudge
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a heavy saucepan and heat until the mixture passes the fudge test. This test involves dropping a small amount into cold water and if it forms a ball the test is passed. Then add the vanilla and beat with mixer until smooth. Pour onto buttered cookie sheet or platter and cut when cool.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients then add shortening and milk. Beat well and then add milk eggs and vanilla. Beat and pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool then turn out on a rack.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Chop and cook cabbage until done; drain. Fry sausage drain off fat. Beat eggs add milk. Mix in bread crumbs. Add cabbage and sausage. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Mix sugar dates and flour until all dates are covered. Add eggs one at at time. Then add the other ingredients. Bake in two square pans (9 x 9 x 12-inch). Line pans with brown paper (grocery bags) and grease well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 33 to 35 minutes. When done cut into squares and roll in powdered sugar. Keeps very well do not freeze.

title: Pepper Chicken
instructions: Cook onion in butter until tender. Stir in pimentos peppers soup and chicken. Layer 1/2 of noodles 1/2 of chicken mixture and 1/2 of cheese in 4-quart casserole. Repeat layers. Bake 35 to 40 minutes (until cheese starts to brown) in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: For filling mix hamburger with sherry cornstarch pepper sugar and brown gravy syrup in a large bowl. Place oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add salt and ginger then the celery and onion. Cook about 3 minutes. Add mixed hamburger to skillet stirring constantly until the hamburger is in fine pieces. When hamburger is cooked place mixture in a colander and drain off excess liquid into a pan. Spread meat mixture out flat to let cool.

title: No-Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop on lightly greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes until brown.

title: Mushroom Roll-Ups Appetizer
instructions: With a rolling pin flatten each slice of bread. Set aside. Melt butter. Saute onions and mushrooms salt and pepper. (I use only a dash of salt and pepper.) Add cream cheese. Blend and cook 15 minutes. Cool and refrigerate if you want to finish making them later.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Stir and put in long dish in refrigerator to congeal.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix the ingredients. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake at 400\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until set.

title: Hot Tuna Bake
instructions: Place 4 slices bread in buttered 6-cup shallow baking dish. Drain tuna; combine with green pepper onion and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt in small bowl. Stir in half the shredded cheese. Spread over bread; top with remaining 4 slices bread. Beat eggs in medium-sized bowl; stir in milk remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and oregano. Pour milk mixture over bread; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. Press bread down into milk before baking. Bake in a moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until puffed and golden. Remove from oven; let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mississippi Mud Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time and blend in vanilla. Set aside. Combine flour and cocoa powder and beat into butter mixture. Fold in coconut pecans and chocolate chips.

title: Pasta With Gorgonzola And Tomatoes
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan. Add onion and saute until tender and translucent about 8 to 10 minutes. Add garlic and saute a minute or two longer. Stir in tomatoes (with liquid) basil and sugar. Cook until sauce thickens stirring occasionally about 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile mix butter and Gorgonzola together until well blended. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well and return pasta to pot. Stir Gorgonzola mixture into tomato sauce. Add sauce and 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese to pasta and mix well. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve remaining 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese with pasta at the table. Serves 4.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil by hand until blended. Add flour salt and soda. Mix well. Bake in oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch (ungreased) at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Place butter in a 2-quart baking dish. Microwave at High for 30 seconds or until butter melts. Add green pepper and the next 5 ingredients stirring well. Stir in potatoes. Cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap; fold back a small corner of wrap to allow steam to escape. Microwave at High for 12 to 14 minutes or until tender uncovering and stirring every 5 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Divinity
instructions: Combine and cook the first 3 ingredients until cracks in cold water or soft ball stage. Beat 3 egg whites with vanilla. Beat until stiff peaks form; then pour syrup mixture over egg whites and continue beating until thick enough to spoon onto wax paper.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together and let set overnight.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: High Peak Meringue
instructions: Beat egg whites salt and vanilla until frothy. Cook water cornstarch and sugar together until clear and thickened. Gradually add to egg whites beating all the while and beat at least 3 minutes after its added or until egg whites stand in peaks. Spread on pie and cook in oven as you do any other meringue on pies.

title: Creamy Strawberry Pie
instructions: Pour milk into bowl and pudding mix. Slowly beat with rotary beater or at low speed with electric mixer until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Blend in 1/2 cup Cool Whip. Fold in quartered strawberries.

title: German Chocolate Squares
instructions: In heavy saucepan combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk; cook over low heat. Stir constantly until caramels melt; set side. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In large bowl combine dry cake mix butter 1/3 cup evaporated milk and nuts. Stir by hand until dough holds together. Press 1/2 dough mixture into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked crust. Spread caramel mixture over chocolate chips; crumble remaining dough over caramel mixture. Return to oven and bake 15 to 18 minutes. Cool slightly. Refrigerate for 30 minutes in pan. Cut into bars and wrap. Makes approximately 24 bars.

title: Pumpkin Apple Ring
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs and blend in apples and pumpkin. Stir together flour baking powder soda salt and spices. Bake in tube pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 55 minutes or until done. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Sift powdered sugar over cooled cake.

title: Peanut Butter Fingers
instructions: Cream oleo and sugars until light and fluffy. Add egg. Beat well. Add 1/3 cup peanut butter and vanilla. Beat. Sift flour baking soda and salt. Alternate sifted ingredients and rolled oats to creamed mixture mixing well after each. Spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over top. Let stand 5 minutes. Spread melted chocolate over top of baked mixture. Combine powdered sugar and rest of peanut butter and milk to make thin icing. Drizzle over melted chocolate. Cool and cut in bars.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook rinse and drain spaghetti. Mix with rest of ingredients and chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Add broccoli to onion and cook to make broccoli tender; drain. In a medium saucepan melt margarine; stir in flour salt and pepper until well blended. Add milk gradually and cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add broccoli and remaining ingredients. Cook until cheese is melted.

title: Microwave Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Place popped corn in large paper grocery bag. (Dont pop in oil or salt.) In one quart measuring bowl mix together brown sugar butter corn syrup and salt. Cook 2 minutes on high stir. Cook 2 minutes more on high. Add baking soda to hot syrup and stir until mixture foams and thickens. Pour over corn in bag. Shake well. Fold top of bag down and close and cook as follows

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Pour into lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until slightly firm in center.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients together except the sugar. Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Add the flour mixture alternately with bananas. Turn into well-greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Brown 2 pounds ground beef in pan. Cut celery onions and green pepper into small pieces and saute in pan until soft. Add remaining ingredients and simmer slowly for several hours (covered).

title: Aunt Louise'S Quick Light Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into greased skillet or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Mexican Jubilee
instructions: Place bacon in skillet on medium heat. Dice potatoes green peppers and onion. When bacon is almost brown place potatoes peppers and onion in pan. When done pour tomatoes in bowl. Mash with potato masher then pour in skillet with other ingredients. Simmer 10 minutes. Eat over rice or noodles.

title: Easy Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine and pat into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Chill until firm.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Make it a point to do something every day that you really dont want to do. This is the golden rule for acquiring the habit of doing your duty without pain.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats and margarine. Let stand for 20 minutes. Mix all dry ingredients sugar dark brown sugar flour baking soda cinnamon and salt. Beat in eggs vanilla and milk. Add oat mixture to the rest of the ingredients. Place mixture in 9-inch square pan (greased). Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for about 55 minutes.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Put bacon in 3-quart casserole. Cover and microwave at High for 3 minutes. Drain all but 2 tablespoons fat. Add potatoes and onion. Pour in clam liquid. Cover and microwave at High for 8 minutes (stirring once). Combine flour and 1/4 cup milk. Add flour mixture remaining milk salt and pepper. Do not cover. Microwave at High for 9 minutes (stirring every 3 minutes) until thick. Stir in clams and light cream (or milk). Microwave at High 2 to 4 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Snickers Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix cake according to directions. Pour 1/2 of batter into pan. Bake 20 minutes. Melt caramels with butter and 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Spread on cake. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Pour remaining cake mix on top. Bake for 20 minutes at 250\u00b0 and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Little Brown Jug Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together shortening brown sugar and eggs. Stir in buttermilk. Sift together and stir in flour soda and salt. Add coconut or nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Yields about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix strawberries Jell-O Wesson oil and water thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time. Bake in tube pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Barbecued Beef On Buns
instructions: Place beef onion and celery in a Dutch oven; add water to almost cover meat. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat; strain and reserve cooking liquid. Trim and shred meat. Return to Dutch oven. Add 2 cups strained cooking liquid. (Save remaining cooking liquid and chill.) Skim and discard fat. Add catsup brown sugar vinegar and seasonings. Cover and simmer 1 hour stirring occasionally. If mixture becomes too thick add additional reserved cooking liquid. Serve on hamburger buns. Yields 15 to 20 servings.

title: Stuff
instructions: Mash out 1 pound ground beef into bottom of 10-inch skillet. Top with potatoes carrots and onion. Roll small meatballs out of rest of ground beef and place on top. Cover with the Cheddar cheese soup spreading it all over the top. Cover with lid and cook over medium heat for about 25 minutes or until potatoes and carrots are done. Goes real well with a side of white rice.

title: Hash Brown Omelet
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Remove from pan. Mix potatoes in pan and cook until underside is brown. Mix other ingredients together. Pour over potatoes. Top with cheese and bacon. Cook over low heat. This works well in an electric skillet.

title: Caramel Oatmeal Chewies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine oatmeal flour brown sugar soda and salt; mix well. Stir in margarine mixing until blended. Reserve 1 cup; press remaining onto bottom of pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Top with nuts and chocolate pieces. Mix caramel topping and 1/4 cup flour until smooth; drizzle over chocolate pieces. Sprinkle with reserved oatmeal mixture. Bake an additional 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown. Cool; chill until set. Makes about 32 bars.

title: Cocktail Bourbon Bites
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer. Serve warm with toothpicks.

title: Pork Surprise
instructions: Make a large slit in pork roast and add all ingredients except the noodles. Tie and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cook noodles and drain Remove roast; take out seasoning. Slice roast. Make a gravy with the seasoning and drippings enough for 1 cup finally then add water if necessary. Allow it to settle in a small bowl taking off any fat. Place meat on platter. Surround with noodles and pour gravy over noodles. Reheat in microwave for 10 minutes. Garnish with long slices of cooked carrots and fresh parsley. Garlic bread and jello top this meal off!

title: Chicken Casserole(Fast Recipe For Leftover Chicken)
instructions: Combine soup milk and 1/2 cup cheese and heat until cheese melts. Combine chicken with mix. Cover bottom of pan. Fill rolls with 1 tablespoon mix and place rolls on mix in pan. Cover rolls with remaining mix. Heat in 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: French Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Put in pan the chocolate and water. Stir over hot water until melted. Separate eggs. Beat the whites until stiff and set aside. Beat the yolks until thick and lemon colored. Beat in the chocolate and vanilla rum or brandy. Fold in the whites. Spoon in cocktail glasses. Chill 12 hours or more. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix cocoa and sugar together well. Put in large heavy pan. Stir in 1 cup hot water. Mix well. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture starts to boil. Boil cocoa and water mixture for 3 minutes. (Be careful it will bubble up and try to boil over; reduce heat a little.) Add the milk. Heat until milk is piping hot but do not boil! Add vanilla and serve. Delicious with whipped cream or marshmallows too.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Add butter slightly softened to brown sugar and cream it. Then add syrup and eggs beaten. Add salt and vanilla. When all is mixed add pecans and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0; then reduce heat to 325\u00b0 until filling is firm about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Seasoned Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Arrange a single layer of fish in a shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour half of the sauce mixture over the fish. Bake for 20 minutes basting with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with paprika and chopped parsley if desired. Yield 4 servings.

title: Sparkling Salad
instructions: To make frosted grapes for decoration; beat an egg white until frothy. Dip the grapes into egg white then immediately roll in sugar preferable superfine and then lay on waxed paper until dry. Use tinted sugar for more color variety.

title: Peanut Butter Meltaway
instructions: Mix peanut butter and oil. Spread over cake and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Heat together butter and cocoa; add powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread over cake. Refrigerate.

title: Rhubarb Muffins
instructions: Mix brown sugar oil egg vanilla and buttermilk in large bowl. Stir in rhubarb nuts and vanilla. In another bowl combine flour soda baking powder and salt then add to rhubarb mixture. Spoon batter into muffin pan.

title: Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Sift flour and salt into bowl. Add milk oil and egg. Beat until smooth. Cut onions into 1/4-inch slices and separate into rings. Dip each ring into batter. Drain excess batter into bowl. Drop into 1 inch of oil heated to 375\u00b0. Fry 2 to 3 minutes turning occasionally. Drain on paper. Leftovers may be cooled wrapped and frozen. Reheat in 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook chicken bouillon cubes and large onion in small amount of water. Cook spaghetti and lay in bottom of baking dish. Put chopped chicken and onion over spaghetti. Spoon mushroom soup over this.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Combine soda and buttermilk and let stand a few minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff. Cream sugar oleo and Crisco together. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add buttermilk and flour to creamed mixture alternately. Stir in vanilla. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites gently. Stir in pecans and coconut. Bake in three 9-inch layer cake pans that have been greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Test with toothpick in center of cake when it comes out clean cake is done. Cool and frost with the following icing.

title: Lucille'S Fancy Chicken
instructions: Remove skin from chicken except wings. Do not batter. Brown in butter both sides. Pour off juices. Add wine mushrooms garlic and water. Cook slowly until liquid is down and meat is done. Serve over rice.

title: Horseradish Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate any unused portion. This is especially good for dipping pretzels. It also makes a great dressing for potato salad.

title: Beer Batter For Seafood
instructions: Coat fish or other seafood in flour. Dip into batter and fry in hot oil.

title: Butterfinger Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.

title: Goodnight Kisses
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until frothy. Gradually add sugar until stiff. Use spoon and blend in other ingredients. Drop on aluminum foil lined sheets by teaspoon 2 to 3 inches apart. Put in oven and turn off. Leave 8 hours. Yields 30 cookies.

title: Chicken Divan For The Microwave
instructions: Place broccoli packages in oven. Microwave at High 3 minutes or until package is flexible. Layer broccoli in a glass pie plate. In medium bowl mix soup sour cream lemon juice soy sauce and garlic powder together. Stir in chicken and pour over broccoli. Set aside. Melt butter in small bowl or Pyrex cup for 45 to 60 seconds. Stir in Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High for 12 to 14 minutes or until hot.

title: Coconut Huts
instructions: In a saucepan combine dates marshmallows pineapple 12 of the vanilla wafers crushed and pecans. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until melted. Using the remaining wafers stack them 3 deep with filling (One wafer filling another wafer more filling another wafer and more filling). Cover with whipped cream and sprinkle with coconut. Store in refrigerator 24 hours to allow wafers to soften.

title: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Press half of the cookie dough into a well greased 9 by 9-inch square baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and press over first layer of cookie dough. Crumble and sprinkle the remaining half of the cookie dough over peanut butter mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. Cut into bars and serve when cool.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Layer in order in 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool before cutting. Lots of calories and fat! Yummy.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix together. Bake in two 9 x 13-inch pans (grease pans by using Pam spray.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mamaw Mandy'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream together cool whip & cream cheese. Add other ingredients. Mix well and chill before serving.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.

title: Baked Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Cube bread slices. Place in bottom of casserole.

title: Tuna Crunch Casserole
instructions: In 1-quart casserole blend soup and milk; stir in tuna eggs and peas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with potato chips or desired topping. Bake 5 minutes longer. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Mix and keep in refrigerator for salads.

title: Ham And Cheese Bake
instructions: Place 6 slices of bread on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with 1 cup of Cheddar cheese. Add ham broccoli and top with remaining bread. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; mix well. Blend in milk and mustard. Pour over bread. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and pepper with butter and oil. Add flour and milk to make sauce. Add cheese hominy and garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Sauce
instructions: Combine and cook in sauce pot until thick. Pour over warm cakes or vanilla ice cream.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Brown noodles in butter. Add rice and broth. Bring to a boil. Lower and stir. When broth is gone pilaf is done.

title: Beef-Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Brown beef and add tomatoes onion and celery. Stir until well mixed. Place a layer of cabbage on bottom of greased 2-quart casserole. Spoon layer of meat mixture over then add another layer of cabbage. Continue alternating layers ending with cabbage. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Butterscotch Morsel Pound Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients adding eggs one at a time. Beat well after each egg. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 starting in cold oven.

title: Salami
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Roll into a salami roll. Wrap in foil and refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Combine flour salt and pepper. Flour chicken and brown in hot oil. Add mushrooms onions and wine. Cook and cover over very low heat for 45 minutes. Serve with rice or pasta alfredo. Yields 4 servings.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion together drain if necessary. Add remainder of ingredients and simmer at least 30 minutes. May be served with grated cheese Fritos Doritos cornbread crackers or whatever. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Put the first 8 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Make a well in the center. Pour in the oil pumpkin and water. Blend. Add the eggs one at a time. Beat well. Pour into 3 greased coffee cans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pizza Muffins
instructions: In oil saute onion and garlic until soft. In a bowl mix sauteed mixture with egg and tomato juice. In another bowl combine flour baking powder salt oregano Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni. Quickly stir moist ingredients into dry ingredients until just moistened. Spoon into oiled muffin cups. Sprinkle tops with grated Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Serve hot from oven or reheat.

title: Alma'S Famous Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix and beat eggs together; add sugar Eagle Brand and the juice of 6 lemons in a bowl. Pour mix into pie crust and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; will be thick. Melt one stick of margarine in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour in mixed ingredients and spread in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Janet'S Cake Icing
instructions: Cream Crisco oleo vanilla and half of milk. Add sugar and rest of milk. Beat until stiff. Tastes like whipping cream. Freezes well.

title: Christmas Stew
instructions: Cook meat until done. Add all ingredients; simmer 30 minutes. Serve with cornbread.

title: Georgia Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine eggs sugar salt corn syrup butter and vanilla. Stir until well mixed. Spread pecan halves on crust and cover with filling. Place pie in oven and immediately reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until mixture is firm in center. Let cool before serving.

title: Louisiana Style Baby Back Ribs
instructions: Wash ribs in clean water place in pot with water covering ribs. Add meat tenderizer; cook on medium heat until meat changes color and remove. In a large bowl add remaining ingredients; mix well. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Douse meat heavily in mixture and place in large baking pan. Place in oven. Douse with sauce periodically. Cook for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Two Bean Chili
instructions: In a 6-quart kettle or Dutch oven over medium-high heat cook beef green pepper and onion with chili powder and pepper until beef is browned and vegetables are tender stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat.

title: Rich Shortcake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder sugar and salt; cut in shortening until mixture is like coarse crumbs. Combine egg and milk; add to sifted dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Place in greased pan and bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes; cool. Prepare strawberries and put on top of piece of cake; cover with Cool Whip.

title: California Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle onion soup over bottom of 17 x 13 x 2-inch buttered pan. Lay chicken on top of rice. Dilute mushroom soup with water or broth. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pecan Roll
instructions: Combine all ingredients kneading sugar in gradually. Roll into rolls; wrap in wax paper and freeze. Dip rolls into caramel and roll in pecans.

title: Chocolate Applesauce Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add oil raisins and walnuts. Mix all together. Bake in 2 loaf pans for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Corn
instructions: Salt and pepper fryer. Cook in pressure cooker 6 to 8 minutes or until tender. Add corn; stir occasionally until corn is done.

title: Sam'S Macienda Dip
instructions: In medium bowl with mixer at medium speed blend cream cheese and salsa until smooth. Cover; chill until serving time.

title: Cookie Crust
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium sized bowl beat sugar and 4 tablespoons of the butter with an electric mixer until light and creamy. Beat in flour egg yolk vanilla and cinnamon. When well mixed press into an 8-inch square on an ungreased jelly roll pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven; let cool completely. Crush into fine crumbs in a food processor or blender.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil 1 dozen eggs. When eggs have cooled down and are cold first peel the eggs. Cut the eggs lengthwise. Take the yolk out and put into a small bowl. Place the white of the eggs on a plate.

title: Old Fashioned Texas Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients together. Pour into a unbaked pie crust. Bake in oven 325 to 350 degrees approximately 50 minutes to one hour.

title: Creamy Chicken Breast
instructions: Arrange chicken in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with cheese. Mix soup and wine together. Spoon over meat. Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle with margarine. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. I serve this with rice cooked in chicken broth with added chopped pecans fresh parsley and diced red pepper.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in shallow pan. Coat potatoes with flour cheese salt and pepper. Bake one hour at 375\u00b0. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mom'S Chili
instructions: Saute in butter the onions and green pepper. Brown beef in skillet. Pour all ingredients into crock-pot. Salt to taste.
