title: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Let pickles salt onion ice water and ice cubes stand for 3 hours and chill. Drain and add the rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil and boil until the pickles are transparent in color. Fill the jars and seal. If you boil the lids they will seal right away.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender. Blend for 1 to 2 minutes. Makes about 4 cups. A favorite with the kids!

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Layer vegetables in order given in crock-pot. Season with salt and pepper. Add ground beef. Mix soup and water; pour on top. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high 2 to 4 hours. Stir once or twice.

title: Pumpkin Pound Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together twice. Blend salad oil and sugar thoroughly with electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add pumpkin and mix well. Turn the mixer to the lowest speed and blend in dry ingredients. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chili Chicken
instructions: In large skillet saute poultry in oil until no longer pink; set aside. In same skillet cook onion peppers and garlic until tender; drain. Stir in chili and stewed tomatoes; heat. Add rice and pepper sauce. Arrange chicken on top of mixture and simmer 10 minutes. Top with shredded cheese. Serves 6.

title: Italian Casserole
instructions: Brown beef with onion garlic and seasoning. Stir. Combine in 1/2-quart casserole with soup water and noodles. Place cheese around on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Delicious Graham Cracker Dessert
instructions: Cream together Crisco sugar and margarine. Add eggs and mix well. Add pineapple and nuts. Layer bottom of oblong dish with graham crackers then a layer of mixture. Begin and end with graham crackers. Pour partially jelled jello over dish and set until firm. Cut in squares. Makes a good \Make ahead dish.\

title: Crab Delights Fettucini
instructions: Cook fettucini as directed. Chop garlic and cook in butter until lightly browned. Add half and half and cook 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and cook an additional minute. Serve over fettucini.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Mix and pat in a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes until golden brown. Refrigerate a few hours.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetable mixture until they begin to get tender. Drain off liquid. Add uncooked onion and celery. Add mayonnaise and Cheddar cheese soup; mix well. Then mix butter and crackers. Take half of this mixture in casserole dish. Take the other half and spread on top of casserole. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix the eggs and bananas in a bowl. Sift the flour sugar salt and baking soda in separate bowl. Add to first mixture. Stir to mix and blend well but do not overbeat. Add the nuts. Stir well. Pour into a buttered loaf pan (9 x 5-inch). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until tests done with toothpick.

title: Orange Pineapple Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed. Drain pineapple and oranges; keep juices. In pan mix sugar eggs and flour. Add fruit juices; cook until thickened like pudding. Add fruits and macaroni to sauce. Refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve add Cool Whip. Mix well then add cherries and nuts if desired and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in water until thawed. Cook Minute rice as directed. Mix cheese margarine onion and cream of mushroom soup. Heat together just until cheese melts. Combine broccoli rice and cheese mixture and bake in buttered dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: In a 4-quart Dutch oven over medium heat cook ground beef onion pepper and garlic until meat is browned and vegetables are tender stirring occasionally to break up meat. Drain well to remove fat.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Slice potatoes and onions alternating each in a large baking dish. Pour soup over this with a little salt and pepper to taste. Bake about 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix and roll into balls. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy But Good Apple Pie
instructions: Place finely sliced apples in a baking dish. Melt margarine and add sugar and beaten egg and cinnamon all together. Place the bread strips on top of the apples and drizzle the mixture over the bread and apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Lemon Delight Cookies
instructions: Combine cake mix egg and Cool Whip and mix together. Roll in small balls. Roll balls in powdered sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Do not overbake.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Crunch 1 bag Doritos; add cooked and drained ground beef. Mix with rest of ingredients.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar Karo syrup and water in a heavy saucepan and boil to 250\u00b0. Add raw peanuts and butter and continue boiling to 300\u00b0. Remove from heat and add 2 teaspoons soda. Stir vigorously and spread thinly on 2 well-greased cookie sheets. When cool break candy into pieces and store in pan in an airtight container.

title: Chocolate Mounds Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour sugar cocoa and baking powder into a large bowl. Add oil egg yolks water and flavoring; beat until smooth. Add cream of tartar to egg whites; beat until peaks form. Fold into main batter. Pour into three 8-inch well-greased and floured layer pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until layers test done. Remove from pan; cool on rack. Spread Honey Coconut Filling between layers and top cake with Chocolate Frosting.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add applesauce with baking soda. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Saturday Night Chowder
instructions: Saute onion in oil. Pour clam chowder corn clams basil sauteed onion and half and half into large pot. Add tarragon and pepper to taste. Let simmer until ready to serve with oyster crackers. Serves 6.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix onions celery tomatoes tomato sauce bell pepper flour Worcestershire sauce (drained) peas and mushrooms. Sprinkle grated cheese on top and bake in oven until hot through. Sliced eggs may be used instead of cheese. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Put squash onions and bell pepper in salted ice water for 1 hour; drain well. Mix vinegar sugar mustard seed celery seed and turmeric powder together. Bring to a boil and put in squash onions and pepper. Boil another 10 to 12 minutes. Put pickles in jar and seal.

title: Easy Pudding Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order. Beat on high until fluffy.

title: Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and cool. Pour mixture into a 5 quart freezer container. Stir in pineapple juice orange juice bananas and lemon juice. Freeze until firm. Remove mixture from freezer several hours before serving. Should be slushy. Pour into punch bowl and stir in ginger ale.

title: Quick And Easy Play Dough
instructions: In a saucepan mix ingredients; heat until thickened. Stir constantly.

title: Mexicalli
instructions: Cook beef and drain. Saute onion and bell pepper. Add to beef and add salt and pepper. Add Ragu sauce. Mix together. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Cook and drain noodles. Place noodles on top of meat mixture. Top with cheese. Simmer another 20 minutes. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until browned; drain off fat. Separate crescent dough in an ungreased pizza pan with points toward center. Press pieces together. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese. In a bowl beat together the eggs milk salt and pepper; pour into crust. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over it. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Chopped onion can also be added.

title: Quick Barbecue Beef Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook ground beef and 1/2 cup onions in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce. Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Stir baking mix milk and eggs until blended. Pour over beef mixture. Sprinkle with remaining onions. Bake 25 to 27 minutes or until crust is light brown. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Montezumos Revenge(Rocky'S Chili)
instructions: Cook onions garlic bell pepper and hot peppers in beer while meat is browning. After the meat is browned add vegetables and spices and tomato sauce and cook slowly for about 2 hours.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put in greased baking dish in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Grease cookie sheet. Stir together flour soda cream of tartar and 1/2 teaspoon salt. In separate bowl beat butter for 30 seconds. Add 2 cups sugar milk and vanilla. Beat well. Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture beating until well blended. Form dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in a mixture of 3 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Place balls 2-inches apart on a cookie sheet. Flatten lightly with bottom of a drinking glass. Bake 8 minutes or until golden. Makes 66.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring the sugar and milk to a boil in a heavy saucepan. Boil for 3 minutes. Add the peanut butter and marshmallow cream and mix well. Pour immediately into a buttered 8 x 8-inch dish. Chill until set. Cut into small squares. Yield 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Hot Mexican Bean Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon; heat in a chafing dish or double boiler. Top with crisp bacon crumbled. Serve with corn chips or potato chips. Makes 3 cups.

title: Ragoux
instructions: Put heat on medium low and add onion margarine and cloves. When onions are golden brown add chicken (skin can be removed before frying). While chicken is browning make your meatballs. Roll meatballs in flour and brown in pan. Drain meatballs on paper towels. When chicken is golden brown add just enough water to cover the chicken. Add the chicken cubes. Put heat to medium high until water boils for 5 minutes then put down to medium low. Make sure water doesnt evaporate. Once meatballs are browned and drained add to the ingredients in the pot. Add water as needed. Cook for 3 hours.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder salt and baking soda. Cut butter into flour mixture. Thoroughly mix in buttermilk. Add raisins and caraway seeds. Knead dough lightly and form into a flat round loaf. Place in a greased and lightly-floured cake tin. (If you have a cast-iron skillet this is best!) Cut a cross in the top of the loaf about 1/2 inch deep.

title: Cherry-Coconut Bars
instructions: Mix butter flour and confectioners sugar until smooth. Spread thin with the fingers in an 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Mix the rest of the ingredients together and spread over the top of the baked pastry. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Tomato Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in 2 tablespoons fat. Place in casserole. To the drippings in the pan add celery and onion. Mix in all other ingredients. Pour over chicken and cover. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by small teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake approximately 13 to 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Separate eggs; mix together egg yolks and milk. Add lemon juice; mix well. Pour into pie crust.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Lightly brown hamburger; drain off grease. Place in crock-pot and add rice chopped onions green pepper salt chili powder Worcestershire sauce mushrooms crushed tomatoes and almost all of tomato juice. Mix well and turn crock-pot on high. It will be ready to eat in about 4 hours. This makes a good Sunday dinner.

title: Lite And Zesty Chicken 'N Rice
instructions: Place chicken in a baking dish. Pour salad dressing over chicken. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Place rice vegetables and 1/2 can of onions around and under chicken. Combine bouillon and Italian seasoning; pour over chicken and vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes; top with remaining onions. Bake 2 or 3 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 4. (I usually double the recipe.)

title: Pudding Stripe Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to package. Bake in 13 X 9 inch baking pan. poke holes at once down in cake with wooden spoon 1 inch apart. After holes are made combine pudding mix with sugar in bowl. Stir in milk. Beat on low for 1 minute. Quickly before pudding thickens pour 1/2 of pudding mixture over cake and into holes to make stripes. Allow pudding to thicken slightly. Spoon over the top. Swirl to frost cake. Chill 1 hour.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Blend onion jalapeno pepper oil and eggs in blender. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Italian Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown meat and drain. Add onion and cook until tender. Add tomato paste water salt and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes. Heat milk and cream cheese over low heat stirring until smooth. Stir in 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese green pepper garlic salt and noodles. In 1 1/2-quart casserole layer half of noodle mixture and meat sauce. Repeat layers. Bake for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese when serving.

title: Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cream together butter and sugars. Add and mix all other ingredients. Drop from teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Dieter'S Snack
instructions: Break broccoli into flowerets. Cut off ends of stems and cut up stems. In a jar pour mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Shake until blended. Pour over broccoli. Mix in sunflower seeds raisins and crumbled bacon. Can be stored in refrigerator indefinitely.

title: Church Window Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo and chips. Cool. Pour over marshmallows and nuts. Form in rolls. Roll in coconut.

title: Graham Cracker Muffins
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs sugar salt and butter. Pour hot milk over mixture and beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon mixture into greased small muffin pans filling them two-thirds full. Bake in a hot oven (425\u00b0) for twenty minutes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken With Buttermilk Gravy
instructions: In a shallow dish combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and paprika; set aside. Rinse chicken; pat dry with paper towels. Brush chicken with melted margarine. If desired sprinkle with salt and pepper. Dip chicken into crumb mixture turning to coat. Arrange chicken in a shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered in a 425\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until tender and no longer pink.

title: Chicken Adobo
instructions: Clean and cut chicken in desired size. Put in a medium size pot. Combine ingredients together. Cook on medium heat. Simmer until done.

title: Pesto
instructions: Put the basil olive oil pine nuts garlic cloves and salt in the blender; mix at high speed. Stop from time to time and scrape the ingredients down toward the bottom of the blender with a rubber spatula. When the ingredients are evenly blended pour in the cheeses and blend until the mixture is smooth. If pesto is too thick add to it a tablespoon or so of the hot water in which the pasta has boiled. Pour the pesto sauce over your favorite hot pasta.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream the butter; add sugar. Add the well beaten eggs. Sift the dry ingredients and blend the entire mixture. Spread thin in a greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Hot Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles; discard juice. Place all ingredients in a large crock or Pyrex bowl. Stir until sugar dissolves. Let sit 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Return to jar. Turn jar upside down every day for 5 days. Good for gift giving.

title: Saturday Night Spread
instructions: Brown meat and onion; add rest of ingredients and simmer 30 to 40 minutes. Serve on sandwich buns while hot.

title: Diet Salad
instructions: Mix fruit cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Mix well. Sprinkle jello a little at a time. Mix well then refrigerate.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix eggs oil cake mix and pudding. Stir 7-Up in by hand.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: Butter an oblong baking dish and add the first 5 ingredients. Over this mixture pour tomato soup and kidney beans. Cover the entire mixture with chili powder to taste. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Beat eggs Wesson oil and sugar together. Add flour soda salt and fruit cocktail. Mix well and bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Firecracker Chili Stew
instructions: Brown the beef cubes in bacon drippings for about 5 minutes. Combine browned beef bacon and remaining ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or until beef is tender.

title: Salted Peanut Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and slowly add brown sugar; beat well. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture mixing well. Stir in oats cereal and nuts. (Dough will be stiff.) Drop by teaspoon onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cook on wire rack. Yields 7 dozen.

title: Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
instructions: Mix together in order as given; beat until smooth. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake seven minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Evergreen Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid water and sugar. Add pineapple juice. Add ginger ale when serving. Yields 4 quarts.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into unbaked pie crusts. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 pies.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and cheese; gradually add sugar and cream until shiny. Add flour and eggs alternately beating after each addition; add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Cabbage Stew
instructions: Quarter the cabbage and cover with water. Add carrots and cook until half done. Next add turnips potatoes onion and Polish sausage and cook until tender. Salt to taste. Serve with corn bread. Serves 8.

title: Butter Rolls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients to make into biscuit type batter. Roll out onto lightly floured surface. Roll to thin crust. Spread softened margarine on top of crust. Sprinkle sugar all over butter. Roll up crust like a jelly roll. Slice into 4-inch rolls and place into deep baking dish. Cover with water and add vanilla. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until top is brown. Water will be a thick syrup.

title: Turtles
instructions: Lightly oil large baking sheet or cookie tin. Arrange 60 groups of cashew nuts 4 to each group. Allow caramel syrup to cool slightly in pan but be sure it is still liquid. Spoon tablespoon of liquid caramel over cashew nuts. Let cool 10 to 15 minutes. Spoon melted chocolate over top of each caramel turtle. Allow to cool completely until quite firm. Yields 60 turtles.

title: Easy Chicken Cordon Blue
instructions: Pound chicken breast until flat. Put 1 slice of ham and 1 slice of Swiss cheese on top and roll up. Secure with toothpick.\tChill for at least 1 hour. Roll chicken in flour then egg then bread crumbs. Place in a baking dish. Drizzle with melted butter and honey. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Grease one 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange rhubarb pieces in bottom of pan. Sprinkle dry gelatin over top. Sprinkle with sugar and then cake mix. Drizzle butter over top followed by cold water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve topped with whipped cream or frozen whipped topping.

title: Bobbie'S Pie Crust(For 9 Or 10-Inch Pie)
instructions: Sift flour and salt together. Blend in lard with pastry blender. Add water slowly tossing with fork until clingy then roll together with fingers until it forms a ball. Divide in two for top and bottom crust. Roll out on pastry cloth with a little whole wheat flour or wheat bran to keep from sticking.

title: Zippy Pasta
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Add onions green pepper Salad Supreme garlic and half of dressing. Refrigerate overnight. Just before serving add rest of dressing.

title: Chocolate Angel Icebox Cake
instructions: Cut the cake into 3 to 4 equal pieces. Cream together the butter and 2 1/2 cups powdered sugar until light. Blend in the egg yolks melted chocolate and milk with the rum and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Spread the filling between the layers of the cake. Whip cream until stiff. Flavor with the 2 tablespoons powdered sugar and the remaining vanilla. Frost top and sides of the cake with the whipped cream. Chill for 2 to 4 hours. Sprinkle with cocoa. Garnish with orange slices or berries if desired.

title: Sausage Roll
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Mix sausage green pepper egg and seasonings in bowl. Roll out 2 rectangles of dough to about 8 x 10-inch size. Spread all of mixture on top of both rolls almost to edges. Sprinkle Swiss cheese on top of both rolls and roll up lengthwise. Brush on egg white. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Kolacky
instructions: Cut lard into half the flour. Dissolve yeast and sugar in milk. Add beaten eggs to yeast mixture. Gradually add liquids to dry mixture (lard and flour) alternating with remaining flour. Knead in bowl (dough will be very sticky). Refrigerate overnight.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Flour and beat steak. Salt and pepper. Brown in a small amount of oil on both sides. Place in large pot and add remaining ingredients. Cook on top of stove on low heat for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours until tender.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Franks
instructions: Cook potatoes and onions with salt in boiling water 5 minutes; drain. Slice franks. Mix potatoes onions franks flour salt butter 1 can of Hunts sauce cheese and parsley together. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Pour remaining can of Hunts sauce over. Bake 35 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Rinse beans. Optionally soak them overnight. Put all ingredients in a large pot and add enough water to cover twice. Bring to a boil and lower heat to simmer. Cover pot and cook about 3 hours until beans are soft. Add oil and cook another 1/2 hour. Serve over steamed rice with plenty of butter and French bread. Serves 6.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Combine lettuce onions beans and cheese. Mix well and chill. Before serving add Fritos and dressing.

title: Hobo Dinner
instructions: You will also need a large piece of heavy-duty foil.

title: Apple Nut Bread
instructions: Gradually add sugar to well beaten eggs. Beat until light and fluffy. Combine dry ingredients. Add to sugar mixture alternately with oil and sour cream beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla apples and pecans.

title: Beef Broccoli Pie
instructions: In a medium skillet brown beef and onion; drain off fat. Stir in flour salt and garlic salt. Add 1 1/4 cups milk and softened cream cheese. Cook until smooth and bubbly. Add a moderate amount of the hot creamed mixture to the skillet and cook over medium heat until mixture is thickened 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in cooked broccoli; set aside. Line a 9-inch pan with pie shell. Cut Monterey Jack cheese into slices. Arrange slices on top of meat mixture. Adjust the top crust and put small amount of milk around on top crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. If the pastry browns too quickly cover edge with foil during last 10 minutes. Let pie stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Gradually add powdered sugar; beat until light and fluffy. Add in vanilla. Stir in pecans if desired or reserve them to sprinkle over top of frosted cake.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients together except the eggs and onion. Blend the eggs and onion in a blender then add to the other mixture. Bake in a greased or buttered pie dish at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Forgotten Roast
instructions: Place roast on large piece of tinfoil and arrange vegetables (enough for your family) around roast. Sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Spoon undiluted soup on top. Wrap loosely with foil making sure its sealed at the top and sides. Place in roaster pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Excellent with deer meat also.

title: Waldorf-Style Salad
instructions: In small mixing bowl sprinkle lemon juice over apples and toss lightly to combine; add celery raisins and mayonnaise and mix until thoroughly coated. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

title: Cranberry Tea
instructions: Boil water and sugar. Add the tea bags; steep for 6 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add whole chives and cinnamon. Leave spices in 30 minutes then remove. Add jello cranberry juice apple juice frozen orange juice and lemon juice. Will keep for several weeks. Heat and serve.

title: Ma Eva'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar vanilla and mix good. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour to make a stiff dough. Roll out and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Pesto Deviled Eggs
instructions: Halve eggs lengthwise scoop out yolks and place them in small bowl; set aside egg white halves. Add pesto and mayonnaise to yolks and stir until smooth. Spoon mixture into halved egg whites. Garnish each with a parsley leaf. Makes 12 halves.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Scrub and rinse potatoes. Cut into thin slices but not all the way through. Put potatoes in baking dish and fan out slightly. Sprinkle on salt; drizzle with butter. Sprinkle on herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese. Bake for another 10 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Drain kraut for 15 minutes. Place in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Store in refrigerator for at least 24 hours. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
instructions: Beat eggs and add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla; mix well. Stir together dry ingredients and add to mixture. Add nuts and raisins. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves 9 x 5 x 2-inches.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients until smooth. Layer cookies and bananas on bottom of large bowl. Add 1/2 of mixture. Repeat. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Chill then serve. Makes a lot! Great for a large crowd.

title: Mr. Nik'S Chocolate Chunk Cheese Cake
instructions: Melt butter and combine with 1/3 cup sugar and crumbs. Press into bottom of 9-inch or 10-inch spring-form pan. Heat in oven at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread pineapple evenly in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread pie filling on top. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top of pie filling sprinkling nuts over top of that if desired. Cut butter in slices and place across top. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a covered dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Remove and sprinkle with grated sharp or American cheese. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place sugar oil and pumpkin in a large bowl. Beat well at a medium speed. Add 1 egg at a time; beat well after each one. Sift together flour soda baking powder cinnamon and salt. Fold in batter and add nuts. Bake one hour.

title: G.P.'S Hobo Bread
instructions: Bring coffee to a boil. Remove from heat. Add baking soda and raisins. Cover and let sit overnight. The next morning add white and brown sugar nuts flour and salt. Mix well. Grease and flour 3 one pound coffee tins. Divide batter evenly between the three cans. (Slightly more than half full.) Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 65 minutes. Cool in cans for 15 minutes before removing. If necessary tap cans on bottom to release loaf. Turn loaf on side and slice into rounds for serving. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Aunt Mimi'S Tomato Relish
instructions: Put vegetables through food chopper using coarse blade. Add the remaining ingredients and cook over low flame for 4 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Lemon Broiled Rainbow Trout
instructions: Place fish fillets on lightly greased broiler pan skin side down. Brush fillets with melted margarine. Sprinkle approximately 1/2 tablespoon Old Bay Dash OLemon seasoning blend over each fillet. Broil 5 to 6 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Delicious Iced Tea
instructions: Bring the water and sugar to a boil. Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Spray a large casserole with vegetable cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
instructions: Fry the ground beef until just about done. Add onions and cook until onions are transparent. Drain and set aside. In large bowl melt the Velveeta cheese in the microwave. When melted where you can stir add the ground beef onions picante sauce and chili. Continue to heat until mixed well. Best if served hot with tortilla chips. If mixture becomes too thick you can add a little milk to thin. This makes a large amount.

title: Kraut
instructions: Put vinegar and salt in saucepan and boil until dissolved. You can add some water from the gallon to the vinegar and salt to help get dissolved. When salt is dissolved add this to the remaining gallon of water. Pack sterilized jars with chopped cabbage and cover with solution leaving 1/2-inch of space at the top of the jars. Put caps on jars and store in cool dry place.

title: Strawberry Soup
instructions: Place all ingredients except water in blender.\tProcess until smooth. Combine strawberry puree with water in saucepan; heat slowly until hot.\tServe warm or chill and serve cold.\tServes 8.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Empty ingredients into a 9 x 12-inch cake pan in the order listed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Summer Squash
instructions: Cook squash in small amount of boiling salted water for about 10 to 15 minutes until barely tender. Drain and cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out seeds. Arrange the shells in a greased shallow baking dish.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until ice is well crushed. Enjoy!

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook ground meat and drain off excess fat. Saute onion until limp. Add chicken soup and rice to boiling water and cook for 7 minutes. Add all ingredients together and bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Ribbon Jello
instructions: Dissolve lemon Jell-O in 1 cup hot water and 1/4 slice of the ice cream. Put in a 13 x 9-inch glass dish. When firm layer with thin layer of sour cream. Continue with next flavor doing the same thing. Each layer should have a thin layer of sour cream finishing with sour cream or whipped cream on top. First layer will take longest to get firm but next 3 go faster. When its finished it looks like a colorful ribbon.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in water until soft; drain. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Pastor Groover'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and simmer over low heat until onions are tender. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Michiko'S Salmon
instructions: Sprinkle Hawaiian salt on salmon and let stand. Melt butter and saute garlic. Add salmon and saute on both sides. Smother oyster sauce and mayonnaise on salmon. Add onion on the side of pan and stir-fry. Pour some onion on top of salmon. Cover and cook on slow heat until salmon is done.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine. Add sugars and mix well. Add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla and cream. Add flour salt and soda; mix. Add chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Peeto'S Brownies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa shortening eggs and vanilla; beat. Add dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes in 8 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Sugar Cookie
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs tartar soda almond flavoring and oil. Add flour gradually. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peaches 'N Cream
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt milk and vanilla pudding in large bowl. Beat 2 minutes. Pour into greased square pan. Place peach slices over batter in pan.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Beat sour cream and cream cheese until blended; add to hot potatoes beating until light and fluffy. If too stiff add a little milk. Season to taste with garlic salt. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Dot with margarine; sprinkle with paprika and brown. Can be made a day ahead and refrigerated. Heat in oven for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine cereals pretzel sticks and nuts in ovenproof pan. Blend butter and seasoning; pour over cereal mixture. Stir well. Bake 30 minutes. Stir once or twice. Spread on paper towels to cool.

title: Cream Cheese Roll-Overs
instructions: Stir olives into cream cheese. Spread on flour tortillas. Sprinkle with seasoning of choice. Roll up and slice into 1-inch slices. Put into fridge until ready to serve.

title: Italian Cheese Cake
instructions: Butter and flour a 9-inch spring-form pan. Cream together Ricotta and cream cheese. Add flour sugar lemon juice and vanilla beating well. Blend in eggs one at a time using low speed of mixer. Gently mix in sour cream then pour mixture into the pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn oven off leave in oven for 3 to 5 hours. Remove from oven top with any kind of pie filling. Cook 2 days before serving.

title: Milkless-Eggless-Butterless Cake
instructions: Boil first 7 ingredients together for 5 minutes. When cold add soda which has been dissolved in a little warm water. Add the flour. Mix well and bake in a loaf pan or large baking pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix chopped cabbage onion pepper and sugar. Combine remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and pour over cabbage mixture. Can be stored in refrigerator for days.

title: Shrimp And Chicken
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet over medium heat cook onion margarine and garlic until tender. With slotted spoon remove mixture to bowl. Rub chicken with salt and pepper. In same skillet cook chicken until golden on all sides. Stir in tomato sauce wine 3 tablespoons parsley basil and onion mixture. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add shrimp; heat to boiling and simmer until shrimp are pink and tender. Sprinkle with parsley. Can be served over rice.

title: Rancho Baked Beans
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add onions and simmer until golden brown. Add ground beef. Stir with a fork while onions brown. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Bake in hot 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and fruit. Combine dry ingredients and add slowly mixing well. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Use ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Will swell slightly as baking. Makes 6 to 7 dozen.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat. Cool slightly about 5 minutes. Add next 3 ingredients and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto foil on wax paper. Let cool.

title: White Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix well. Add sugar salt milk and oil. Mix well. Add enough flour to make a dough you can handle. Knead on floured board until smooth; place in oiled bowl turn one time to oil top and let rise 1 hour in warm place. Punch down and knead for about 5 minutes. Shape into 2 loaves; let rise until double in size. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 30 minutes. Brush top with butter; let stand 10 minutes before turning out on rack to cool.

title: Hello Dollys
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 12-inch dish. Mix graham cracker crumbs into melted butter. Place layer of coconut then layer of chocolate chips then layer of nuts. Spread Eagle Brand milk over this and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Delicious Meat Loaf(Salpicon Al Queso)
instructions: Place bread in small dish. Add hot evaporated milk. Use fork to crumble soaked bread. Set aside. Heat oil in medium nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic. Saute until tender about 5 minute stirring often to prevent burning. Place meat in large mixing bowl. Add sauteed onion mixture but do not mix. Froth egg yolks with fork and add to meat along with tomato sauce hot sauce cheese parsley salt and 2 tablespoons seasoned bread crumbs. Use wooden spoons to mix lightly and thoroughly. Add soaked bread. Mix again. Whip egg whites until soft peaks form. Fold into meat mixture. Place long piece of wax paper on work surface and spread remaining bread crumbs down middle. Place meat mixture on crumbs. Gently mold into loaf about 14 x 4-inches. Do not handle meat too much and do not press meat mixture firmly together. Pull up sides of paper to coat meat loaf with crumbs. Gently roll meat loaf onto greased pan placing at angle if necessary to fit. Sprinkle any remaining crumbs evenly over surface. Bake on center rack of 325\u00b0 oven uncovered 30 minutes. Pour Onion Topping over. Bake 40 minutes longer basting occasionally. Serve hot cut into slices. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Rosie'S Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add seasonings tomato paste tomato sauce and water. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Turn heat to low; cover and simmer for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Cook lasagna noodles in salted water for 10 to 13 minutes or until tender. Drain; pour cold water over them until they are cool enough to handle. Combine cottage cheese and egg. Place 1/2 of noodles in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread 1/2 of meat sauce over noodles then 1/2 of the cottage cheese mixture then 1/2 of the Mozzarella cheese slices and sprinkle with 1/2 of Parmesan cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Supreme Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Grind or process cranberries and orange (with rind). Combine. Mix Jell-O and sugar with water. Combine Jell-O with fruit. Add nuts. Chill.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Spread evenly in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Pour 1/2 cup water over apples. Then top with 1 1/4 cups of flour 2/3 cup sugar and 1/2 cup margarine. Bake for 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Seed peppers and grind or chop. Mix pepper with sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil for 6 minutes then add Certo. Prepare jars and lids for jelly. Pour into jelly glasses and cap. Wear gloves while preparing hot pepper.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Heat broiler. Mix mayo juice and seasoning. Place chicken on broiler pan; brush with 1/2 of mixture. Broil 5 minutes; turn then brush remaining mixture. Broil 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Fish Cake Pupus
instructions: Slice cucumber lengthwise and remove seeds. Put crab sticks inside cucumber and place halves together. Spread mayonnaise on one side of the Chikuwa and push cucumber through. Cut into 1/2-inch slices and serve with shoyu or mustard/shoyu sauce.

title: German Slaw
instructions: Arrange cabbage and onions in bowl. Bring to a boil sugar celery mustard salt and vinegar. Add oil; pour over cabbage and onions. Chill for several hours. This slaw will keep in refrigerator for 3 weeks.

title: Aunt Donna'S Vermont Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all together. Cook at 250\u00b0 for 6 to 8 hours covered. Last 20 minutes add 1 package frozen peas. Cook uncovered.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt margarine in dish (Pyrex type). Mix flour sugar eggs and milk; stir in corn. Pour into dish with melted margarine. Bake 30 minutes (per can) at 350\u00b0. (If recipe is doubled bake one hour.)

title: Italian Bow-Knot Cookies
instructions: Cut butter into flour. Stir in the sugar and baking powder. In a separate bowl beat eggs with milk and extracts. Add egg mixture to the flour mixture. Stir until mixed and turn onto a floured board and knead for 2 minutes. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Cut off small pieces of dough; roll pencil thin 6 inches long. Twist into a loose knot. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Perfect Microwave Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine bran flour baking soda salt and raisins in a large bowl. In another bowl combine egg yogurt molasses and honey. Stir egg mixture into bran mixture along with melted butter. Stir in walnuts. Fill paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Microwave 6 at a time for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes on High power. Yields 14 to 16 muffins.

title: Creamy Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Slice cookie dough thin and place on bottom sides and corners of 13 x 9-inch pan (do not grease or flour). Pack way up. Cream the cream cheese 1/2 cup sugar 2 eggs and vanilla until smooth. Pour on top of cookie dough. Mix together the 1 cup sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt 4 eggs and spice then add pumpkin and evaporated milk. Mix well and pour over cream cheese mixture. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until a toothpick can be inserted into center dry. Cool. Cut into squares. Garnish with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onion and garlic in hot oil. Add meat. Cook until browned. Blend tomatoes taco seasoning and chilies. Simmer 10 minutes. Drain fat.

title: Taboli
instructions: Soak wheat in 2 cups lukewarm water while preparing other ingredients. After chopping all ingredients drain excess water from heat. Combine all ingredients cover and allow to set overnight. Stir again before serving. This will serve about 10 to 12.

title: Orange Cream Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake cake mix according to package directions for a 13 x 9-inch cake.

title: Hamburg Barbecue
instructions: Combine all ingredients except hamburg. Brown hamburg while sauce is simmering. Drain hamburg. Put into sauce. Simmer at least 1 hour.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Blend together flour and sugar. Melt margarine; add Coca-Cola oil cocoa and marshmallows in saucepan over low heat. Stir until marshmallows are melted. Add to flour and sugar mixture. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Wash and grind cranberries. Add sugar. Drain in colander in refrigerator overnight. Next day cut red grapes in halves. Cut up pecans. Whip cream gradually. Add 1/4 cup sugar. Fold in cranberries. Add other ingredients.

title: Tasty Taco Pie
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add sauce and seasoning mix. Simmer 5 minutes. Unroll dough and press on ungreased 12-inch pizza pan. Prick bottom and sides. Bake 12 minutes. Cover crust with meat mixture and top with cheese and bake until melted. Top with lettuce tomatoes and olives. I put sour cream in the middle also.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients; stir in beans. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Chocolate Chip Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until soft. Slowly beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip; stir in chips a little at a time. Put in pie crust and chill for 4 hours.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add sugar oil zucchini and vanilla. Mix lightly. Combine flour salt soda baking powder and cinnamon. Add to the egg mixture; stir until well blended. Add nuts and raisins. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; add to cottage cheese along with the whip cream and pudding. Garnish with cherries.

title: Shrimp And Green Noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Shrimp in one layer in bottom of baking dish with salt and pepper. Saute mushrooms in 3 tablespoons butter and mix with flour and sour cream 4 tablespoons butter soy sauce and salt and pepper. Pour all of sauce over shrimp. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika. Bake 10 minutes until bubbly. Serve over cooked drained green spinach noodles.

title: Caramel Cereal Pops
instructions: In heavy 3-quart saucepan combine caramels and milk. Cook and stir over low heat until caramels are melted and smooth. Stir in the cereal and peanuts until well coated with caramel mixture. Press the cereal mixture into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Let stand about 1 hour or until firm. Cut into 2-inch squares. Insert a wooden stick into one end of each square. Makes 16 pops.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix remaining ingredients together in large mixing bowl. Spoon into pan. Bake for 35 minutes. Cool slightly before cutting into squares. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Stuffed Shells(With Spinach-Ricotta Filling)
instructions: Cook shells as directed. Drain and rinse.

title: Zucchini Creole
instructions: Simmer onion in butter in skillet. Add tomatoes and squash. Cover. Cook until tender about 10 to 15 minutes. Season and serve.

title: Spinach Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Artichokes go on bottom. Cover with spinach salt and pepper. Beat cream cheese butter and milk; spread over top. Refrigerate 24 hours. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Whiskey Sour
instructions: This recipe becomes a whiskey rum or brandy sour if the base is changed. Shake using 3/4 cup cracked ice. Strain into chilled glasses.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O completely in boiling water stirring 3 minutes. Add lemon juice lemon rind and ice cubes and stir constantly until Jell-O is thickened 2 to 3 minutes. Remove any unmelted ice. Using wire whisk blend in Cool Whip then whip until smooth. Chill if necessary until mixture will mound. Spoon into pie crust. Chill 2 hours. Garnish as desired.

title: Rice Dressing
instructions: Gently boil giblets for approximately 2 hours or until done. Cool and chop giblets and meat from necks. Discard bones and skin reserve liquid and add enough to equal 2 1/2 cups.\tBrown rice in margarine add vegetables and saute until onion is clear. Add giblets turn into a covered casserole add salt pepper and red pepper mixing well. Bake\tat 350\u00b0 approximately\t1 1/2 hours or until rice is done. Stir once during the baking process. Serves 6.

title: Cabbage Cold Slaw
instructions: Mix well and serve.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Separate broccoli into flowerets. Chop green onions. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Mix together. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease dish. Line bottom with 6 slices of bread (cut off crust). Put 6 slices of American cheese on top of bread. Blend eggs milk salt instant onion and dry mustard. Pour over bread and cheese. Set 5 minutes. Cook 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Then top with sliced tomatoes and partially cooked bacon or sausage. Broil until done.

title: Three Pepper Stroganoff
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips. Sprinkle meat with salt pepper and garlic. Roll in flour. Brown meat slightly in oil. Remove meat and drain. Add onions and mushroom soup and water. Mix well. Place meat mushrooms and onions in mixture. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add bell pepper strips. Cook 5 more minutes. Serve over noodles. Garnish with parsley tomatoes and mushrooms. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Congealed Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs; cool and grate coarsely. Mix cold water with gelatin. Heat until dissolved and set aside. Mix salad dressing lemon juice salt pepper and relish. Mix all ingredients into gelatin and chill until firm.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Combine sugar water and seasonings in 4-cup measure. Microwave at High for 4 to 6 minutes to form a light syrup. Combine with cider in 3-quart casserole dish. Microwave for 7 to 9 minutes until heated. Strain before serving. Makes approximately 2 quarts.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs jam and applesauce. Add soda to buttermilk and alternately add buttermilk and flour. Add spices raisins dates and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 plus minutes.

title: Baked Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except 3/4 cup cheese. Place in 2 quart casserole. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Polly Cakes
instructions: Combine eggs sugar flour baking powder and nuts. Stir to mix well. Fill paper baking cups half full in muffin pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes a dozen.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add one egg at a time beating well after each. Add milk baking powder salt and vanilla. Add one cup flour at a time beating well after each cup. Beat until real smooth and fluffy. Pour in greased tube pan. Place in cold oven. Turn heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Clara Stack'S Strawberry Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in one cup boiling water. Add partially thawed strawberries allow to soft set. Meanwhile roll cheese into balls and roll in finely chopped nuts. Add cheese balls and any unused nut pieces to jello.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well. Pour in Bundt cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Chicken Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk salt chicken veggies 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions. Place in an 8 x 12-inch dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Lay out crescent rolls. Cut into strips to lay on casserole (form lattice top). Bake uncovered 15 minutes longer. Top with remaining cheese and onions; bake 3 to 5 minutes longer.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Pour boiling water over ingredients and stir. Cool. Use in place of sweetened condensed milk in any recipe at a fraction of the cost.

title: Nojim Beef Enchilada
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain the oil. Add minced dry onion to the ground beef and mix. Add chopped olives and chili con carne then mix all together real well. Cook mixture and set aside.

title: Potato Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cover hash browns with hot water; let stand 10 minutes and drain. Lightly brown sausage; drain. Beat eggs; add potatoes and remaining ingredients. Pour mixture into well-greased baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Tuna Noodles Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 2-quart casserole. In casserole combine all ingredients except potato chips and butter or margarine. Combine chips and butter and sprinkle over the casserole top. Bake uncovered about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Snowball Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; gradually stir in flour. Add vanilla and pecans; blend well. Refrigerate 2 hours then roll into small balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden. Cool for 5 minutes then roll in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat sugar and eggs for 5 minutes. Slowly beat in salad oil then flour salt soda cinnamon and extract until well blended. With spoon stir in apples raisins and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done. Cool then remove from pan. Cover with Apple Glaze. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Vegetable-Rice Salad
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Add rice peas carrots and onion and toss.

title: Home Canned Pimientos
instructions: Peel peppers; pack in pint jar add salt. (They make some liquid add small amount of water if needed.) Seal jar. Place in pressure cooker; bring pressure up to 5. Turn stove off.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix all this together; blend good. Melt 1/2 stick oleo in pan. While still hot pour the batter in pan with melted butter. Then put peaches on top of this batter last. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown or until a knife comes out clean from cobbler.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and shape into balls. Roll in flour and brown in oil. Pour package of onion soup mix over browned meat balls. Add 2 cups of water and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Butterhorns
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar in lukewarm water. Combine remaining ingredients. Keep in refrigerator overnight. Divide dough into 3 sections; roll 1/4-inch thick and cut into 16 pie wedges each. Roll each section from large end and cover with plenty of butter. Let raise 2 hours. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Honey Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Combine hot water (or milk) honey salt and butter. Cook to lukewarm. Add beaten eggs and yeast. Add flour and knead until well mixed. Cover and let rise. Punch down and let rise again. Shape into 5 loaves. Let rise again until double in size. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes.

title: Delicious Dirty Rice(Yield: 4 Side Dish Servings)
instructions: Brown hamburger over medium heat stirring to break up meat until browned. Drain grease. In same pan saut garlic onions green peppers and celery in butter until onions are soft and opaque. Add cooked rice and cayenne pepper. Simmer over low heat until rice has absorbed liquid. Stir in parsley and green onion; salt and pepper to taste.

title: Drop Doughnuts
instructions: Preheat shortening in large pan. Combine butter sugar egg yolks milk and vanilla. Blend in butter. Use teaspoon to put into preheated shortening. Cook 2 to 3 minutes on each side.

title: Chicken N Dumplings
instructions: Boil leg quarters in 4 quarts of water until done. Place on plate to cool. Save broth. In a large mixing bowl sift flour leaving a depression in center. In depression place butter and pour in milk. Gently knead until well blended. Add flour and continue kneading until stiff dough forms. Add flour until no longer sticky. Lightly flour counter and roll out dough to 1 inch thick for thick dumplings and 1/2 inch thick for thin dumplings. Cut dough into 1/2-inch strips and cut into bite size pieces. Bring chicken broth to boil; add salt and pepper. Drop in dumplings. Bone chicken; chunk into pieces and cook with dumplings until thickened.

title: Easy Sticky Buns
instructions: Grease a 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle nuts on bottom. Place rolls on top of nuts. Sprinkle dry pudding over frozen rolls. Melt butter in small saucepan. Add sugars and cinnamon. Stir until dissolved. Pour over rolls in pan. Cover and let rise overnight. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove and invert onto serving plate. Makes 24 buns.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Chop onions and cucumber. Combine all in a large bowl. Chill overnight.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fat Free Pineapple Upside Cake
instructions: Spray 9-inch round cake pan with Mazola cooking spray. Add brown sugar corn syrup and lemon juice stir to combine. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 3 minutes. Arrange pineapple rings and cherries in pan; set aside. In large bowl combine flour cornstarch baking powder and salt. In medium bowl stir sugar and milk until sugar is dissolved. Add egg whites corn syrup and vanilla stir until blended. Gradually add to flour mixture; pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Immediately loosen edges and remove from pan. Makes 12 servings. Each serving 200 Calories 2 grams protein 47 grams carbohydrates 0 mg. cholesterol 160 mg. sodium.

title: Baked Apple Princess
instructions: Peel each apple 1/3 the way down from top. In individual custard cups place 1 apple and 1/4 cup of ginger ale. Sprinkle each apple with 2 teaspoons sugar cinnamon. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until soft not mushy. Place 2 teaspoons of margarine in center of each apple. Bake 1 more minute or until margarine melts.

title: Linguine With Chicken Scampi
instructions: Cook pasta. Cut chicken into 1/2-inch pieces. Dip chicken into beaten egg then bread crumbs which have been mixed with salt and pepper. Spread coated pieces on platter. (This can be done several hours ahead and refrigerated.)

title: Dump Cake
instructions: In a 13 x 9 x 1-inch pan layer pineapple cherry pie filling and dry cake mix. Cut butter and place over cake mix. Top with chopped pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: Mix first 10 ingredients by hand and bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes checking often. After cake has cooled combine cream cheese powdered sugar butter and vanilla. Mix well and frost cake.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
instructions: Layer apples in pie shell. Mix together apple juice cinnamon nutmeg and cornstarch in a small saucepan. Cook on low heat until thickened. Pour over apples and place second pie crust on top. Butter lightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits(Thanksgiving - Christmas Special)
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Cut into shortening.

title: Congo Cookie Bars
instructions: Mix well. Pour and shape flat onto one large cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. When done cool and cut into finger length bars.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Turn into oiled loaf pan. Bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: In a large bowl combine the corn eggs milk 3/4 cup cracker crumbs margarine sugar onion salt and pepper. Transfer to a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cracker crumbs. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Yield 6 servings.

title: Salmon Spaghetti
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter until tender. Add undrained salmon and wine; simmer for 3 minutes. Stir yogurt cornstarch pepper parsley and garlic together; add to skillet and cook for 3 minutes. Serve over cooked spaghetti; sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Baked Crab
instructions: Make white sauce by melting butter in small saucepan; stir in flour. Gradually add milk. Combine crab meat eggs and slivered almonds in 2-quart casserole dish. Pour white sauce over crab mixture. Stir to cover well. Add salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash drain and hull berries. Simmer 1 cup water with 2/3 cup of strawberries and cornstarch for 3 minutes stirring constantly. While cooling spread cream cheese over bottom of pie shells. Put remaining berries in pie shells. Cover with cooked mixture. Refrigerate until firm (2 hours). Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Spiced Peaches
instructions: Drain peaches reserve syrup. Combine peach syrup sugar vinegar cinnamon sticks and cloves in a saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 10 minutes. Pour hot syrup over peaches and let cool. Chill before serving. Store in refrigerator.

title: Baked Pork Chops And Dressing
instructions: Use large frying pan. Trim fat from pork chops. Brown chops in small amount of fat. Season with salt and pepper. Remove chops from pan. Cook celery and onion in butter until tender but not brown. Add water soup mix and sage. Simmer 6 minutes. Add bread cubes; stir until moistened. Turn into 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Top with browned chops. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Pasta With Broccoli In Sweet Tomato Sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan cook the broccoli in enough boiling unsalted water to cover until just tender 2 to 3 minutes. Rinse under cold running water drain and set aside.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain completely. Rinse slightly and let cool. Chop onion and celery; add to macaroni in a large bowl. Add tuna to vegetables; mix. Add lemon juice and mix again. Add mayonnaise parsley peas salt pepper and seasoning to bowl and mix. Chill; serve cold.

title: White Chili
instructions: Cook and stir onion garlic cumin and oregano in olive oil in large saucepan until onion is tender.

title: Cheese Hominy Casserole
instructions: Drain hominy and corn. Put soup Cheez Whiz and onions in boiler. Heat until cheese melts. Remove and pour over hominy and corn. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch dish. Top with corn chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pickle Meat
instructions: Mix together for 100 pounds to 120 pounds of meat. Cut meat into squares. Rub mixture all over meat. Pack in stone jar. Put a weight on top. Brine will cover meat. Let set about 2 or 3 weeks. When ready to eat slice and roll in flour and fry as chicken.

title: Peanut Butter Rice Krispies
instructions: Melt almond bark with peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies. Put into buttered jelly roll pan.

title: Seven Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce and place in bottom of 9 x 12-inch glass pan. Add next 6 ingredients in layers. Beat dressing mixture with mayonnaise and sugar. Put dressing on top of other ingredients. Cover with grated Cheddar cheese.

title: Can'T Lose Corn Pudding
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl mix together eggs milk cream butter and red pepper sauce; mix well and set aside. Put corn in another mixing bowl and sprinkle with flour sugar and salt. Stir to coat corn. Add the corn mixture to the egg mixture and stir. Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set. Stir the pudding 3 times at 15 minute intervals while baking. Serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: O. J. Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour bundt or angel food cake pan. Pour nuts over bottom. Mix all other ingredients together. Mix well. Pour batter over nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool. Glaze with the following recipe.

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs. Mix in rind from 1 orange and its juice. Add almond extract and vanilla. Gradually add flour mixed with baking powder. Bake at 375\u00b0. Do not brown. Ice with confectioners sugar icing.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar; mix well. Add pumpkin water and oil; mix again. Add dry ingredients and mix. For baking use 1 pound coffee or other similar size cans. Do not grease cans. Pour mixture into cans fill to halfway mark. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven turn cans upside down and let stand until cold. Bread will slide easily from can.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all together in greased bread pan. Bake 1 hour at 275\u00b0.

title: Hamburger And Macaroni
instructions: Fry up your hamburger; drain. Cook your macaroni but not too done; drain. Add your hamburger and tomato juice. Cook until hot.

title: Pumpkin Bread(For Bread Machine)
instructions: Add all ingredients in the order listed. Select white bread or light button on bread machine and push the start button.

title: Baked Fruit Casserole
instructions: Drain fruit; save juice. Arrange fruit in a large casserole dish. (Alternate fruit to produce color effect.) Set aside. Melt margarine in pan. Blend in flour fruit juice and sugar. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Add sherry. Pour over fruit. Garnish with cherry halves. Refrigerate overnight. Bake for 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serve hot to accompany main dish.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown bacon hamburger and onion. Add beans. Stir well. Add remaining ingredients and cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light. Add eggs one at a time beat well after each. Add vanilla. Crush crackers fine. Add to first mixture with baking powder milk and coconut. Mix well. Pour into 3 (9-inch) pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Roquefort Cheese Dressing
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Blend with a little of the oil. Stir in remaining oil alternating with lemon juice. When ready to serve add cheese.

title: Taste Tartar Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients and chill.

title: Memphis Cherry Pie
instructions: Whip together whipping cream cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix in 1/2 cup chopped almonds. Pour cream cheese mixture into shell. Chill until firm. Top with cherry pie fillings and remaining almonds.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Grease and flour a Bundt sheet or two 9 x 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 30 minutes or until well cooled before taking out of pan.

title: Pralines
instructions: Mix brown sugar and whipping cream in a deep microwavable bowl. Stir until smooth. Cook on High in microwave for 11 minutes and 45 seconds. Stir in butter. Add pecans. Drop by spoonful on waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
instructions: Use medium cucumbers. Wash and cut them into sticks. Pour boiling water over them; let stand overnight.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: In saucepan bring to a boil butter oil cocoa and water. Sift together flour and sugar. Pour chocolate sauce over dry ingredients and mix well. Add buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Pour into a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cream Chicken(Kay Honecker'S Mother'S Recipe)
instructions: Cook onion and butter until tender. Blend in flour slowly stir in broth and cream. Add spices cook and stir over medium heat until it thickens. Stir small amount hot mixture into egg yolks; return to hot mixture. Cook over low heat 1 minute. Add chicken and heat until hot throughout.

title: Thanksgiving Tomorrow
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients adding turkey broth or water if mixture is too dry. Place in lightly greased 1-quart casserole dish. Bake 35 to 45 minutes or until hot and lightly browned on top.

title: Frozen Nesselrode Mousse
instructions: In a large bowl let egg whites warm to room temperature. Add cream of tartar. Beat at high speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating well after each addition. Continue to beat until stiff peaks form.

title: Hot Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Roll chicken in cornstarch. Heat corn oil in frypan. Add chicken and brown quickly. Sprinkle garlic powder. Add tomato water chestnuts mushrooms onions and celery. Season with salt pepper or spice of choice. Add soy sauce. Stir and reduce heat to simmer and cook 5 minutes. Lightly toss chicken mixture with lettuce. Serve hot with rice. Serves 4.

title: Wolverines
instructions: In a medium bowl combine powdered sugar and salt; stir in peanut butter. Add vanilla stirring until blended. Shape into tsp. size balls and dip into chocolate. Refrigerate 20 minutes to harden. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Bonty-Hoss
instructions: Clean head and saw in pieces. Cover all meat listed with water; cook until done. Cool. Remove all bones then skin tongue. Cut all meat into small pieces. Now to make the Bonty-Hoss!

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger or turkey meat in a heavy saucepan & drain. Combine Rotel sauce hamburger & cheese.

title: Parmesan Broiled Tomatoes
instructions: Halve tomatoes crosswise and sprinkle with salt and pepper and a generous pinch of sugar. Top each with about 1/2 teaspoon Parmesan cheese and dot with 1/2 teaspoon butter. Broil about 6-inches from heat for 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Sister'S Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix all together and pour into iron skillet that has been greased and mealed (1 tablespoon meal). Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pina Colada Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine graham cracker crumbs margarine and coconut. Press into bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake 10 minutes. Cool. Drain pineapple in large bowl beat cream cheese eggs and sugar. Stir pineapple sour cream rum and coconut extract into cheese mixture. Pour into crust. Bake 50 to 55 minutes. Top with Pineapple Topping.

title: Celery Seed Fruit Dressing
instructions: Mix together sugar dry mustard salt onion and 2 tablespoons of vinegar. Add the salad oil slowly beating constantly. Add the remaining 3 tablespoons vinegar and the celery seed. Continue beating until dressing is thick. Makes about 1 1/2 cups dressing. May be used on lettuce salad.

title: Scalloped Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken; remove from bones. Cut into small pieces. Saute onions and celery in 1/2 cup butter for 5 minutes. Mix into bread with about 1 cup broth and 1 teaspoon salt. Place into greased baking dish.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat first 5 ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix with hand mixer milk and pudding mixture. Add butter sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip. Break up Oreos into a fine powder.

title: Jennifer'S Carrot Cake
instructions: Stir all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Monterey Chicken
instructions: Bake chicken at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven. Brush with barbecue sauce and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese melts. Sprinkle with bacon onion and tomato and serve.

title: One Egg Cake
instructions: Cream shortening add sugar and well beaten egg. Sift flour and baking powder; add to first mixture with milk. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or two 8 or 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This was my grandmothers recipe.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 3 tablespoons liquid. Combine sugar and flour and stir in reserved juice. Add cheese and pineapple chunks. Mix well. Spoon mixture into 1-quart buttered casserole dish. Combine melted butter and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle on top of casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until light brown. Serves 4.

title: Cranberry Orange Mold
instructions: Or use 1 cup each diced orange sections and chopped apple.

title: Peanut Butter Chews
instructions: Mix sugar butter and syrup together. Bring to a boil. Remove and add peanut butter and corn flakes. Spoon onto wax paper and cool.

title: Shrimp Delight
instructions: Rinse frozen shrimp. Remove tails. Saut shrimp in margarine until hot. Add tomatoes. Simmer together. Serve over rice.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: *Whole tomatoes are best when chopped up.

title: Toll House Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift together flour soda and salt. Blend butter sugars vanilla and water. Beat in egg. Add flour mixture; mix well. Stir in oats and chocolate. Drop by rounded half teaspoons on greased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles until they are done; drain. Run under cold water and drain. Cook carrots and vegetables in steamer or boil until tender around 8 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs (one at a time). Sift flour salt and soda together and mix with nuts. Mash bananas and add vanilla. Add flour nuts and bananas to creamed mixture and blend thoroughly. Pour into 2 oiled and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Combine Veg-All chestnuts onion mayonnaise salt and pepper. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle on cheese then cracker crumbs. Pour melted oleo over this and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Heavenly Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese condensed milk and lemon juice. Beat until smooth. Fold into whipped topping; add pecans and fruit that is well drained. Pour into 2 graham cracker shells. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Fruit Squares
instructions: Beat oil and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and flour. Mix well and spread on a raised cookie sheet that has been greased and floured. Score off 24 squares and put a tablespoon of pie filling in the center of each square. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar salt butter and Karo syrup. Pour in an unbaked pie shell. Place pecans on top of liquid. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Dressing
instructions: Slice celery and onions. Boil until tender and save liquid. Mix soups eggs bread crackers margarine and turkey drippings. Mix all together and season with salt pepper sage and garlic. Bake at 350 degrees until set and crispy on edges.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine the first 7 ingredients. Fold in oranges. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Just before serving fold in bananas and sprinkle with peanuts.

title: Tiny Ham Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Thinly slice tops off tomatoes. Remove pulp and drain shells on paper towels. In small bowl combine deviled ham sour cream and horseradish. Fill tomatoes with paste. Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Sweet Pickles
instructions: Slice onion in bottom of gallon jar. Fill with sliced cucumbers. Mix vinegar sugar salt turmeric celery seed and mustard seed. Pour over cucumbers and onion and refrigerate for 2 weeks.

title: Grape Jelly
instructions: Soak and wash grapes; remove stems. Crush grapes and add to water in a Dutch oven mixing well. Cover and place over high heat and mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Press mixture through a cheesecloth or strainer extracting 4 cups juice. Allow juice to sit overnight in a cool place. Strain juice through a cheesecloth. Combine juice and sugar in a large Dutch oven stirring well. Place over heat. Cook stirring constantly until mixture comes to rapid boil. Add pectin and bring to boil. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and skim off foam with metal spoon. Pour quickly into hot sterilized jars. Leave 1/2-inch headspace. Seal with layer of paraffin. Cover with lids. Yields 4 pints.

title: Microwave Potatoes
instructions: Put 3 pats of butter on bottom of dish. Cut potatoes into chunks. Put onion over potatoes. Add rest of butter on top of onion. Cover and cook for 12 minutes on High. Stir them and cook for 7 more minutes.

title: Kart-Wheels
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour butter powder sugar baking powder and just enough milk until dough forms (if dough seems dry mix in more milk 1 teaspoon at a time). Divide dough into 6 equal parts. Shape each part into ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; flatten slightly. Make an indention 1 3/4-inches in diameter about 3/4-inch deep in center of each flattened ball. Fill each indention with about 2 tablespoons of pie filling. Bake until edges begin to brown 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 6 Kart-Wheels. Fun for kids to make.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: The key word here is \dump.\ \Dump\ pie filling in ungreased cake pan. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on pie filling. \Dump\ dry cake mix on top of pie filling. Cut butter into small squares and place on top of cake mix here and there. Bake at 375\u00b0 until top of cake is golden brown.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar and cocoa; add milk. Cook on medium heat until boiling. Boil for 1 minute. Add peanut butter. Stir until melted; add vanilla. Add oats last stir until well mixed. Spoon out on waxed paper.

title: 5 In 1 Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate. Best if made the day before using.

title: Almond Roca Cookies
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients except chocolate bar and almonds. Spread on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. While warm spread the chocolate bar (melted) over top. Sprinkle the chopped almonds over. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Lemon Dill Cheese
instructions: Mix all together and store in a tightly covered container. This cheese keeps very well for a week at least but cannot be frozen.

title: Chocolate Chess Pies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa then butter vanilla cream and eggs. Beat together with mixer. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Crispix Snack
instructions: Melt oleo peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over Crispix. Put all in large bag with powdered sugar and shake.

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix in order as given above. Bake in large greased baking dish in a 400\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown. Do not overcook or the cornbread will be soggy.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli in microwave until tender (about 12 minutes). Drain well. Combine eggs soup mayonnaise cheese pepper and broccoli in casserole dish. Sprinkle crackers over top. Cover and bake for about 30 minutes. Uncover and bake about 10 more minutes or until heated thoroughly.

title: Microwave Chocolate Peanut Butter Clusters
instructions: Combine morsels in a 2-quart casserole dish. Microwave on High at 100% for 3 to 4 minutes or until melted. Stir halfway through the cooking. Stir in peanuts. Drop by teaspoons onto wax paper. Store in airtight container. Yields 4 to 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Canadian Brown Bread
instructions: Cook oatmeal and let cool. Add molasses sugar shortening yeast and salt. Flour to knead. Let rise. Pout in loaves and let rise a second time. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef And Broccoli
instructions: Heat oil in 12 x 8-inch dish at High for 2 minutes. Stir in beef garlic and ginger; cook at High 3 1/2 to 4 minutes. Stir twice. Add broccoli. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook at High 5 to 6 minutes or until broccoli is tender-crisp. Stir once. Blend cornstarch with broth and soy sauce until smooth; stir in beef mixture. Cook at High 3 to 4 minutes or until sauce is thicker; stir once. Yields 4 servings.

title: Casserole Italiano
instructions: In skillet brown and break up the hamburger. Add onion garlic and oregano; simmer. Pour off fat. Set aside. In casserole dish add tomato soup 2 cups of cheese salt water and cooked noodles. Mix together. Take hamburger and combine with other ingredients in casserole dish. Add remaining cup of cheese to the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Raspberry Fruit Mound
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup of boiling water. Add 1 cup of cold water. After this mixture cools add other ingredients. Pour into ring mold and let chill. Remove from mold when firm.

title: Jean Moore'S Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll thin. Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Cook in 325\u00b0 oven. Remove from cookie sheet while warm.
