title: Fancy Green Bean Casserole
instructions: *May substitute cream of mushroom soup and blend half the onions into the bean mixture placing the other half on top.

title: Chili Rellenos Bake
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain off fat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Halve peppers; remove seeds. Place peppers in 10 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese; top with meat. Repeat until all used. Combine milk eggs and flour. Beat until smooth; pour over chilies. Bake in oven for 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until knife inserted comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Good Ol' Chili
instructions: Crumble ground beef into slow cooker. Add beans onion and garlic. In medium bowl stir tomatoes with juice tomato paste water chili powder salt oregano cumin and pepper until blended. Stir into meat mixture. Scrape down sides of slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 3 1/2 to 4 hours or on low for 7 to 8 hours or until onion is tender.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening then beat in eggs one at a time. Add remaining ingredients beating well. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Remove meat from bones and tear into small pieces. Mix cheese soup and mayonnaise. Place layer of chicken in buttered casserole or baking dish. Add a layer of broccoli. Pour half the soup mixture over first layer. Add another layer of the remaining chicken; remaining broccoli and remaining soup mixture. Sprinkle Pepperidge Farm dressing over this about 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in preheated oven.

title: Scrambled Cabbage
instructions: Heat bacon drippings and oil in large skillet. Stir in cabbage celery onion green pepper and tomatoes. Sprinkle with sugar and salt. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Stir once or twice during cooking.

title: Yogurt Pie
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs sugar and melted margarine. Press into a 9-inch pie pan. Mix together the yogurt and whipped topping. Pour into crust. Top with fruit of your choice. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Salmon Ball
instructions: Drain salmon reserving 2 teaspoons oil. Combine cream cheese liquid smoke and oil. Stir in onions. Fold in salmon. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Parmesan Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to hot 450\u00b0. Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt in bowl. Stir in cheese. Add butter until mixture resembles coarse meal. Stir in enough buttermilk just until dough holds together. Knead dough slightly on a lightly floured surface. Pat or roll out 1/2-inch thick. Cut out biscuits with 2-inch cutter. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in preheated hot oven 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 10 biscuits.

title: Quick Chicken Dumpling Soup
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan combine soup and 2 2/3 cups of milk; bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat. In a bowl combine biscuit mix with remaining milk just until blended. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto simmering soup. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes. Cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes longer or until dumplings test done (do not lift lid while simmering). Yields 4 servings.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Boil water. Add 1/8 teaspoon salt and shortening. Add flour stirring until it is not sticky. Let cool. Add 4 eggs 1 at a time beating thoroughly after each. Place on cookie sheet about 1 rounded tablespoonful per cream puff. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and drain. Add onion tomatoes ketchup steak sauce and green peppers. Simmer for 30 minutes. Cook macaroni and drain. Add beef mixture salt and pepper to taste. Add soup and mix well. Pour in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Layer all the ingredients except the mayo and sugar. Spread the mayo over top like icing. Sprinkle sugar over mayo.

title: Paprikas Krumpli
instructions: Saute onions in oil. Add peppers and garlic. Later add tomato paprika and water as much as needed. Cook until ready 3/4 to 1 hour slowly until tender and thick. Stir once in a while.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Toss cabbage peppers onion and carrots together. Mix mayonnaise Old Bay vinegar and sugar. Add to mixture. Chill and serve.

title: Iowa Basting Sauce For Ham
instructions: Heat and stir until sugar melts.

title: Traditional Maryland Oyster Stew
instructions: In 4-quart pan cook oysters with liquid over low heat until edges of oysters just begin to curl. Add milk margarine or butter salt and pepper. Heat slowly until hot; do not boil. For extra zip sprinkle seafood seasoning on each serving. Makes about 6 cups of stew.

title: Randy'S Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all together and store in a jar.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Mix pudding according to box. Layer as follows graham crackers instant vanilla pudding graham crackers instant vanilla pudding graham crackers and chocolate pie filling.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese chopped ham onions and Worcestershire sauce with mixer. Shape into a ball. Roll in chopped nuts. Chill.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Butter a cookie sheet or line with wax paper. Cook sugars and milk over medium heat stirring until mixture starts to boil. Add butter pecans and soda. Cook stirring occasionally until it reaches the soft ball stage (when a bit of candy mixture dropped into cold water forms a soft ball) or 238\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Remove from heat and beat with a spoon until mixture is creamy and begins to thicken. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. (If mixture becomes too hard return to heat and add a little water.) Makes 24 small pralines.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into well-greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Place in oven and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwave Rocky Road Fudge
instructions: Combine chips and peanut butter in a large microwavable bowl. Nuke at 2/3 power for 5 minutes. Stir until melted and fold in marshmallows and peanuts. Spread in 13 x 9-inch cake pan and refrigerate 2 hours.

title: Oven-Roasted Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Line cookie sheet with foil. Brush with 1 teaspoon of oil. Cut potatoes lengthwise into 1/2-inch thick wedges. Transfer to a large bowl. Add remaining teaspoon of oil salt and pepper. Toss. Spread potatoes in single layer on prepared cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden and crisp. Makes 4 servings.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Trim crusts from bread and cut into cubes. Beat eggs and milk; add seasonings. Lightly butter a 2-quart casserole. Line bottom with 1/2 of the bread cubes and sprinkle with 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat cheese and bread layers then pour milk and egg mixture over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Top with remaining cheese and sprinkle with parsley. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes more. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Papagano
instructions: Cover chicken with water. Add 1/4 cup dried onion and 2 tablespoons salt. Cook to debone. Remove and cool. Cook noodles in chicken broth until tender; drain. Rinse in cold water. When chicken is cool debone and cut into good-sized pieces. Combine with noodles and rest of ingredients and toss with dressing. Chill; cut chestnuts into quarters ripe olives in halves and artichokes into quarters.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Combine milk and eggs and add to flour. Beat well. Pour into hot drippings in pan all at once. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. While roast is cooking chill mixture in refrigerator.

title: Penuchi
instructions: Put sugar and milk in saucepan and boil stirring constantly until syrup reaches soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add margarine but do not stir and set aside to cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla; beat until mixture is thick and creamy. Stir in nuts. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Coconut Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; add coconut. Mix thoroughly. Combine liquid ingredients. Stir into dry ingredients. Blend carefully. Let stand 20 minutes. Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Cornbread(Delicious!)
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Tahini Salad
instructions: Chop tomatoes and cucumbers medium fine. Prepare tahini by mixing it with 2 tablespoons warm water. Add lemon juice and mix tomatoes with other ingredients. Garnish with olive oil. Chopped onions and dried mint are optional.

title: Holiday Wreath
instructions: Combine marshmallows margarine and vanilla. Melt slowly on low heat. Add food coloring after marshmallows are melted. Stir to blend the coloring. Remove from heat. Stir corn flakes until all are green. Empty corn flakes onto tray covered with waxed paper. Using your hands mold the mixture into a circle. You can use cherries to decorate.

title: Quick Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti in 4 quarts of boiling water until tender. Drain. Brown hamburger in skillet. Mix spaghetti hamburger and spaghetti sauce together in pan. Heat until hot. Top with Parmesan cheese if desired. Serve with crackers or garlic bread.

title: Party Cheese Fondue
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small heavy saucepan; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thoroughly heated and cheese melts. Transfer to fondue pot; place over heating unit to keep hot. Serve with breadsticks apple slices or nacho chips.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Soak bread and rice in milk. Add remaining ingredients except tomato juice and tomatoes. Form into balls. Place in baking pan. Pour tomato juice and tomatoes over balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Saute rice in oil until golden; add remaining ingredients. Stir well then cover for 25 minutes or until dry on low heat.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in a large greased casserole dish. Cover with crust (recipe follows).

title: Meaty Chili With Beans
instructions: Combine ground beef onion celery and garlic in a Dutch oven; cook until beef is browned stirring to crumble meat. Drain. Add remaining ingredients; cover reduce heat and simmer 1 hour stirring frequently. Yield about 8 cups.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Fry meat and seasonings. Add tomato sauce hominy and chili powder. Simmer about 30 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese together and eggs vanilla extract almond extract. Add flour and sugar. Grease and flour bundt pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2-2 hours.

title: Economical Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk and vanilla to first mixture. Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rice Cakes
instructions: Use rice cakes as hush puppies or with butter honey jam etc.

title: Chicken And Rice Soup
instructions: Cook chicken until done in 8 cups of water. Take chicken out of water. Add all ingredients except for chicken and rice. Cook for 15 minutes. Add chicken and rice. Cook for 10 minutes.

title: Sausage, Peppers And Onions
instructions: Brown sausage on medium heat lifting from the pan frequently so it doesnt stick. After browning sausage add water to sausage to continue cooking. Remove seeds from green peppers and cut in strips. Slice onions. Add both to sausage and continue cooking until sausage is done. This is a very versatile recipe. Just increase or decrease the amount of sausage peppers and onions as you need.

title: Knock You Nakeds
instructions: Combine and mix well cake mix nuts 1/3 cup milk and butter. Press half of mixture into the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish; bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Melt caramel candy in top of double boiler with 1/2 cup milk (or microwave). When caramel mixture is well mixed pour over baked mixture. Cover with chocolate chips and pour rest of dough on top of chips. Bake for 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool before slicing.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Rinse and scrub potatoes. Pat dry. Prick with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done. Cut a thin slice off top of each potato. Scoop out pulp. Put in a bowl.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in salted water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup sour cream melted oleo and seasoning mixture (from Stove Top dressing). Butter casserole dish; put 1/2 bread crumbs from Stove Top. Add squash onion and carrots. Spoon on soup mixture; top with rest of bread crumbs. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gelatin Custard
instructions: Soften cream cheese for 20 seconds in the microwave. Add the sugar and mix it with a spoon until completely soft. Add the milk and keep mixing then add the fruit cocktail (with the syrup).

title: Banana Ginger Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare muffin pan with paper muffin cups. In medium bowl combine bananas maple syrup orange juice applesauce ginger and lemon. Mix the flour baking powder baking soda and salt together in a large bowl. Add the banana mixture and mix. Do not overmix. Spoon the batter into paper muffin cups filling each cup about 3/4 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Test with a toothpick. Cool. Makes 12 muffins. Calories 137. Fat 0.4 grams. Fat 3%.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach; drain and squeeze out moisture. Lay on paper towels to dry. Mix thawed and dry spinach with remaining ingredients. Chill for at least two hours. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Great Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream butter peanut butter sugars egg and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients; blend into creamed mixture. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Press 5 peanut halves atop each or crisscross with fork tines. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly; remove from pan.

title: Snickers Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Place pie crust in pie pan. Bake crust 5 to 7 minutes or until very light brown. Remove from oven and let cool. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Combine cream cheese condensed milk lemon juice and vanilla with a mixer until smooth. Add 1/2 cup of fruit and mix for 30 seconds. Pour into pie crust and chill in freezer for 2 hours. Top with remaining fruit and serve chilled.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Cook sausage until done. Crumble and then drain. Prepare 9-inch pie shell. Mix cheese and sausage. Sprinkle in shell. Lightly beat eggs in bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and add to egg mixture. Pour into shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Place foil around edges so it will not burn during this time.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Wash pare and dice eggplant. Cook in boiling salted water about 5 minutes. Drain and place in greased casserole.

title: Baked Potato Wedges
instructions: Wash potatoes and pat dry. Quarter each potato. Cut each quarter crosswise into 1/4-inch slices cutting to but not through bottom of potato to resemble a fan. Place each potato wedge skin side down on large baking sheet. Set aside. Combine all remaining ingredients and mix well. Brush tops and sides of potatoes with mixture. Bake uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Beat cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy. Mix in about 1/2 of the cake mix the egg and vanilla until smooth. Stir in remaining cake mix and nuts. Drop dough by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Strawberry Dressing
instructions: Heat to boiling the lemon juice pineapple juice and sugar. Remove from heat. Beat egg yolks well and add small amount of hot fruit syrup slowly. Return heated mixture to the hot syrup beating constantly with wire whip. Return to low heat and cook until thickened. Cool. Fold in whipped cream and nutmeg. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: In large mixer bowl stir flour soda and salt together. Add remaining ingredients except candy and mix at medium speed of electric mixer until well combined scraping bowl occasionally. Chill dough for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Jambalaya
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot. Add onion and cook over low heat to wilt (10 minutes). Add garlic celery and carrot. Cook stirring 1 minute longer. Mix in spices and herbs. Add bell peppers beans tomatoes with juice and vegetable broth. (I used dried vegetable broth or water.) Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook partially covered for 10 minutes. One-half hour before serving add zucchini and/or other leftover veggies and bring to a boil. Stir in rice cover and heat on low heat for 20 minutes only. Add parsley and serve. (I added some salsa to taste for an extra zing.)

title: Meat Ballsfort Morgan, Colorado
instructions: Put meat balls in oven a few minutes then drain.

title: Crabmeat English Muffins
instructions: Mix everything except muffins. Spread mixture on muffins. Put under broiler until brown and bubbly. Cut muffins into 4 pieces and serve.

title: Peanut Patties
instructions: Cook peanuts at 325\u00b0 until done (toasted). Mix sugar water and Karo. Cook mixture stirring constantly until it starts to boil. Let it boil until it reaches 236\u00b0 on a candy thermometer (or until it forms soft ball in cup of cold water). Take off heat and add oleo and vanilla. Beat until it starts to thicken. Add peanuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spray 9 x 13 pan with vegetable oil spray. Place all ingredients in large mixing bowl and beat with electric mixer on low for 1 minute. Scrape bowl and mix on medium for 2 minutes. The batter will look thick and well blended. Pour into pan smoothing top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool. Serve with chocolate glaze.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Cranberry-Apple Casserole
instructions: Butter casserole dish. Place apples (peeled cored and sliced) into bottom of dish. Pour sugar over apples. Pour cranberry sauce over apples. Mix brown sugar margarine nuts and flour. Pour over cranberries and apples. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Mix 1/2 can asparagus juice to soup mixture. Place rice in bottom of dish. Alternate layers of asparagus soup and cheese. Place pork chops on top with lots of butter. Cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until desired tenderness of chops. Cover with foil for the first 1/2 hour. Uncover so chops will brown.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes. Peel and mash. Add butter milk and salt. Place in a buttered casserole. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Push marshmallows down into mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until marshmallows are brown about 15 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Coco Lopez Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package instructions in 10 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0. While still warm poke holes in top with fork and pour Eagle Brand milk on top of cake. Let cool. After cooling pour Coco Lopez over cake. Refrigerate at least overnight. Ice cake with Cool Whip and sprinkle coconut on top. Keeps several days in refrigerator if you can resist! Serves 12 to 16 easily; it is very rich (and good!).

title: Baby Carrots With Horseradish
instructions: Cook carrots in 2 cups water or steam them over 2 cups water. Use 1/4 cup of the cooking water (drain the rest) and mix with onion horseradish mayonnaise salt and pepper. Arrange carrots in an ovenproof serving dish. Top with horseradish sauce cracker crumbs and dot of butter. Sprinkle on paprika. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Oven Baked Potatoes
instructions: Thoroughly wash potatoes and pat dry. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise. Sprinkle onions across top of 1 half and top with the other half. Wrap bacon slices around potatoes to hold them together. Wrap in aluminum foil and place in baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until tender.

title: Ben'S Favorite Casserole
instructions: Boil and drain potatoes. In a 9 1/2 x 13 1/2 x 2-inch casserole dish place ham in a layer followed by half of potatoes. Cover potatoes with cheese slices. Repeat potato and cheese layers adding salt and pepper as desired. Dot with margarine. Pour milk over top. May add more milk if you like. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese has melted and milk is bubbly.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together oleo Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each one. Alternate flour and 7-Up. Beat well after each addition. Add vanilla flavoring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes then reduce oven to 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Bake in Bundt pan. Remove from oven and let cool on a rack.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into ball. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken in just enough water to cover chicken. While chicken is boiling cook noodles. When chicken is done cut up into bite-size pieces or as desired. Measure out 2 cans of broth and mix it and the cream of mushroom soup together over heat until well mixed.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Place margarine oats and water in a large bowl; stir well. Cool completely. Add remaining ingredients stirring well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Let set out of oven for 5 minutes. Add topping.

title: Apple Butter(Microwave Oven)
instructions: In 2-quart glass casserole combine apples and cider. Microwave (High) covered 8 to 10 minutes stirring every 3 minutes until apples are soft. Transfer to food mill or blender for smoothing to even texture. Return to casserole; combine with sugar cinnamon pie spice and cloves. Microwave (High) 12 to 15 minutes stirring every 3 minutes until mixture thickens. Store in freezer or refrigerator in sterilized jars. Makes about 1 quart.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar syrup vanilla and milk together. Bring to a boil and let it boil for a few seconds. Remove from heat and let stand. Cool for about 10 minutes then add peanut butter and beat until creamy. Pour in a buttered dish and let cool.

title: Easy Mexican Dish
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet and drain. Combine the beans soup and tomatoes and add to the meat mixture. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole place a layer of chips on bottom. Add mixture and top with grated cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: In a large heavy skillet melt margarine. Add softened cream cheese. Blend well; add garlic powder and stir. Add crab meat; mix in slowly. Remove from heat.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Spread grated cheese on top.

title: Norwegian Christmas Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Sift cardamon flour and baking powder together (save out a small amount to mix with raisins and fruit). Add to mixture alternating the flour and milk. Mix raisins and fruits with flour; add to total mixture. Put into 1 large loaf pan or divide between 2 small loaf pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Bill Mcelwain'S Scallops With Lobster Sauce
instructions: In metal baking dish melt butter. Place scallops in butter. Add croutons and mushrooms. Toss to coat evenly. Sprinkle lightly with garlic powder and pepper. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare the pastry. Sprinkle bacon cheese and onion in the pastry lined pie pan. Beat eggs lightly and blend in cream salt sugar and pepper. Pour mixture into pie pan. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes later. Let pie stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Everyday Broccoli And Cheese Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken in skillet for 10 minutes or until done. Spoon off fat. Stir in soups milk and pepper. Heat to boiling. Add broccoli and reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is tender and broccoli is done. Stir occasionally. Can be served over linguine noodles.

title: Velveeta Salsa Dip
instructions: Heat in microwave for 5 minutes or 10 minutes in a saucepan. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Cornflake Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar coconut corn flakes nuts vanilla and salt. Spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 until brown.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Combine ingredients (except icing). Spread into cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool completely. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting. Refrigerate about 2 hours. Cut into bars. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Quick Dinner Rolls
instructions: Cut shortening into flour add milk. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown. Recipe makes 12 muffins.

title: Mexican Surprise
instructions: Spread jalapeno bean dip on plate then alternate ingredients in layers as listed. Dip with chips.

title: Banana Ice Cream Sandwich
instructions: In small mixing bowl combine pudding and milk. Mix on low speed of electric mixer until thickened about 2 minutes. Chill until set about 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream or topping. Spread 1/2 cup pudding mixture on 8 crackers. Top with remaining crackers. Freeze until firm.

title: Congealed Coca Cola Salad
instructions: Drain juice from cherries & pineapple into sauce pot. Add 1/4 cup water. Cook with Jell-o until it comes to a boil. Cool. Add cream cheese & beat. Add other ingredients. Refrigerate until congealed.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onions in margarine. Add to other ingredients. Put in casserole dish. Sprinkle buttered crumbs on top. Bake 30 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Crock-Pot Carolina Barbecue
instructions: Trim fat from roast and place in a 5-quart electric slow cooker. Sprinkle roast with salt pepper and crushed red pepper. Add sugar and vinegar. Cook on low 12 to 14 hours. To reduce cooking time follow slow cooker directions for cooking on high. When done remove roast from cooker and place in a large skillet reserving cooking juices. Flake or shred roast removing any fat or gristle. Mix meat some of the cooking juices and ketchup. Simmer mixture over medium heat until juices evaporate. Serve on lightly toasted hamburger buns. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Cheese Cookies
instructions: Blend butter cheese and flour. Add Rice Krispies. Mix well using hands. Roll into small balls and flatten on cookie sheet. Cook 15 to 20 minutes on 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Melt margarine; cook next 3 ingredients until tender. Add next 6 ingredients. Mix all together with chicken and spaghetti. Cook slowly for 20 minutes. Add chicken broth if needed.

title: Coconut-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla beating well. Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon together. Add to first mixture and mix thoroughly. Fold in oats coconut and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. (Suitable for freezing.) Makes 9 dozen cookies.

title: Betty'S Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion in skillet. Combine all other ingredients except tortillas and cheese in a large saucepan. Cook until blended and smooth. Add cooked meat and onion to saucepan. Either fry or bake tortillas until crisp. In a casserole layer meat mixture and tortillas. Top with cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Lazy Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add milk and pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart round baking dish. Empty can of pie filling in center (do not stir) and dot with butter. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 40 minutes or until golden color on top.

title: Yummy Chicken
instructions: In large pot melt butter garlic salt salt and pepper. Add chicken basting on all sides with butter mixture. Cover with lid and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Take out and add mushrooms. Bake until mushrooms are cooked (about 15 minutes). Put onion rings over top and then grated cheese. Bake uncovered until the cheese melts.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in loaf pan at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes until tender. Mash potatoes adding sugar and spice to taste. When potato mixture is cool enough to handle take a large marshmallow and with potato mixture form a ball. Dip in melted margarine and roll in graham cracker crumbs. Bake in baking dish greased with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 20 minutes or until potato balls will begin to crack and you can see the marshmallow melting.

title: Yummy Eggplant
instructions: Boil eggplant covered in water until tender; drain and mash. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased casserole. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lazy Daisy Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together until creamy. Sift flour and baking powder. Add to eggs and sugar. Bring to boiling point the milk and butter. Add this mixture plus the vanilla to above and pour into an 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Cream sugar eggs and oil. Add pumpkin and stir in dry ingredients; add nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter sugar Karo syrup and salt. Add well beaten eggs and stir in nuts. Mix well. Bake in raw pastry shell for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Chill. Serve with fruit of your choice.

title: Braised Leg Of Lamb
instructions: Insert slivers of garlic in top side of lamb. In heavy Dutch oven in vegetable oil lightly brown meat. Remove lamb from pot. Add chopped vegetables cover pot and simmer vegetables for 10 minutes. Return lamb to Dutch oven add broth and wine. Bring to a boil. Cover pot and place in 325\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until lamb is tender. Remove lamb from Dutch oven. Pour broth through sieve and press vegetables to get as much puree as possible. Remove fat by skimming or pouring over ice cubes. Measure broth. Thicken broth by using 1 tablespoon cornstarch for each cup of broth. Carve meat and serve with gravy. Number of servings will depend on weight of lamb.

title: Spaghetti Ham Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and run cold water over spaghetti. Mix dressing and salad seasoning together. Put spaghetti in big bowl and pour dressing over. Marinate overnight.

title: Spaghetti Crescent Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Stir in sauce mix and spaghetti sauce; heat until hot and bubbly. Combine Mozzarella cheese and sour cream. Spread spaghetti into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour meat mixture over spaghetti. Spoon cheese mixture over meat. Separate crust dough into two rectangles and place over cheese mixture. Combine Parmesan cheese and margarine. Crumble evenly over the dough. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Bread crumbs buttered can be substituted for the rolls.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Hollow out tomatoes. Turn upside down for a few minutes to drain. Chop tomato pulp. Add other ingredients to make a thick filling. Fill tomatoes and top with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Meat Loaf Substitute
instructions: Mix well. Place in loaf pan and steam 1 hour. Brown in oven.

title: Texas Barbecue
instructions: Sprinkle roast with salt pepper garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce. Roast covered 4 hours at 275\u00b0. Cool and pull apart. Combine 1 medium onion (chopped with the meat). Bring last 8 ingredients to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes. Pour over meat and onion mixture. Serve on warm buttered hamburger buns.

title: Connie'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream together the flour oil sugar and brown sugar until dry and crumbly and looks like pie crust. Take out 1 1/2 cups of dry mix and add cinnamon and chopped nuts.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes
instructions: Beat together until well blended. Pour into well-greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Banana Nut Chip Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar and then add the beaten eggs. Add remaining ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter And Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese and peanut butter with electric beater. Add sugar and milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Place in pie shell and chill.

title: Barbecued Shrimp
instructions: Crush garlic and blend with cooking oil salt ground pepper chili sauce Worcestershire sauce vinegar chopped parsley and hot pepper sauce. Use a blender if you have one. Rinse 3 pounds of shelled deveined large uncooked shrimp. Drain and arrange on 8 skewers. Set the skewers over a baking pan. Brush shrimp with the sauce. Cover with Saran Wrap and allow to stand overnight or at least 4 hours in the refrigerator. When ready to use broil for 10 minutes turning frequently and brushing with the marinade when you do. Serve on freshly cooked rice. Garnish with chicory and tiny skewers of orange sections olives and pickles. Makes 8 servings.

title: Mellow Fudge Squares
instructions: Mix melted butter and cocoa and set aside. Beat eggs. Gradually add sugar and salt. Fold flour into egg mixture. Next fold in cocoa and butter mixture above the vanilla and chopped pecans. Bake in greased floured large oblong cake pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven and immediate cut large marshmallows in half and place cut side down on cake. Return to oven (5 minutes) until melted. Let cool.

title: Chocolate Eclairs
instructions: Place graham crackers on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix 2 boxes of pudding and 3 1/2 cups milk for 2 minutes. Fold in Birds-Eye Cool Whip. Gradually layer pudding mixture and graham crackers ending with graham crackers on top.

title: Peanut Patties
instructions: Mix ingredients and cook to a soft ball stage. Add 2 tablespoons margarine a drop of red food coloring and 1 3/4 cups powdered sugar. Beat well and drop by spoonful on foil.

title: Aunt Matt'S Punch
instructions: Mix jello with water as directed on package. Add all juices and mix well. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Brown meats in hot fat. Add soy sauce and 1 cup water. Simmer 2 minutes. Add celery and onions. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Blend cornstarch and water. Stir into meat mixture. Add chestnuts bean sprouts and mushrooms. Heat through. Season. Serve over rice or chow-mein noodles. Makes 8 servings.

title: Zucchini Pickles
instructions: Mix zucchini onions and bell pepper. Sprinkle with salt and let stand 1 hour then drain. Combine sugar vinegar mustard seed celery seed and heat to boiling. Boil 2 or 3 minutes. Add squash to mixture then bring to boil for 2 or 3 minutes. Put in jars and seal. Makes 4 pints.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: In mixing bowl cream sugar and shortening until light scraping sides of bowl often. Add eggs one at a time. Add milk beating until smooth and fluffy after each addition. In medium bowl stir together flour baking powder salt and baking soda. Add flour mixture and mashed banana alternately to creamed mixture beating until smooth after each addition. Gently fold in chopped nuts. Turn into lightly greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 60 to 65 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool on wire rack.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Thoroughly mix and chill for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Follow steps on package for softer rice. Brown hamburger. Cook rice; mix all together. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Oreos 'N Cream
instructions: Crumble half of the Oreos onto bottom of 2-quart dish. Mix pudding with milk as directed then add cream cheese confectioners sugar and Cool Whip. Mix well then pour mixture onto crumbled Oreos in dish. Crumble remaining Oreos on top. Chill. Delicious!

title: Monte Cristo Sandwiches
instructions: Beat milk and eggs together in small bowl. In a skillet melt butter (about 2 tablespoons) until hot. Dip one side of bread into milk-egg mixture. Place in hot pan; add layer of ham slice cheese layer of turkey and slice of cheese; dip another slice of bread into milk-egg mixture. Place on top with dipped side up. Take spatula to bottom. Cook until brown. Carefully flip sandwich over to brown other side. Remove; add a pat of butter to the top. Delicious with syrup over the top. Looks like you just made a French toast sandwich.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potatoes. Add other ingredients. Stir well. Cook by spoonfuls in heavy skillet (iron) until brown. Use olive oil or vegetable oil.

title: Italian Delight
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions. Drain. Cook noodles according to package directions. Combine the hamburger and noodles along with the remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with cheese. Heat until warm.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Wrap each chicken breast with a strip of bacon. Cover the bottom of an 8 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish with the dried beef. Place breast on top of the dried beef. Mix the soup and the sour cream; pour over chicken. Bake uncovered for 3 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar evaporated milk butter Marshmallow Fluff and salt in a quart saucepan. Stir over low heat until blended. Bring to a boil over moderate heat being careful not to mistake escaping air bubbles for boiling. Boil slowly stirring constantly for 5 minutes to soft-ball stage.

title: Hillary'S Chippers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease baking sheets. Combine flour salt and baking powder on waxed paper. Beat together shortening sugars and vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer until creamy. Add eggs beating until light and fluffy. Gradually add remaining dry ingredients. Stir in chocolate chips. Add nuts if desired.

title: Mom'S Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Blend and mix well the eggs sugar and flour. Stir in the rhubarb. Pour into a prepared unbaked pie shell and cover with a lattice top. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream nonfat frozen yogurt or whipped cream.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Pop the corn and set aside in large roasting pan. Melt butter; stir in brown sugar corn syrup and salt. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda and vanilla. Gradually pour hot caramel over popped corn mixing well. Turn into two shallow roasting pans. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Pour into bowl; toss and stir while cooling. Store in tightly covered container. Makes about 5 quarts caramel popped corn.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Combine chicken soups sour cream and almonds. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Melt butter and crush Ritz crackers. Combine butter cracker crumbs and poppy seed. Spread cracker mixture over chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles approximately 45 minutes.

title: Summer Squash Bake
instructions: Wash and cut up the squash. Dice the onion and add to squash. Cook all in boiling salted water. Drain and mash with potato masher. Add about 3 tablespoons butter with salt and pepper to taste. Beat eggs. Stir a little hot squash into eggs before gradually adding eggs to squash. Mix in flour milk and last 2 tablespoons butter.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: 1. In a large non stick skillet saute onion and garlic in 1/4 c. chicken broth until cooked. 2. Add can of Ro-Tel tomatoes pureed tomatoes chicken broth green chilies chili powder Mexican seasoning and cumin. Add chicken and heat to boiling reduce heat and simmer 20-30 minutes. 3. Meanwhile cut tortillas into thin strips and add to soup mixture. Simmer 15 more minutes. 4. Garnish with cheese and sour cream.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix together in saucepan the flour butter salt pepper and milk. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick. Let cool. Add to the cool sauce mashed up salmon onion egg celery and bell pepper. Stir until well mixed. Add cracker crumbs to make stiff. Make heaping tablespoonfuls of salmon mixture into balls. Roll in cracker crumbs. Drop into hot oil until brown.

title: French Onion Soup - Dannenberg Style
instructions: Brown onion in frying pan. Then add green peppers to saute. Put mix in quart size pan. Put cold water into pan; heat to boil. (Add small noodles if desired.) Add 2 beef bouillon cubes or more for flavor. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Use a 3-quart ovenproof casserole pan. Press hamburger into bottom of pan. Stand Tater Tots up on meat (cover entire top). Mix soup and milk together. Pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. If using microwave microwave at High for 30 minutes. Stop during baking to turn several times so it cooks evenly.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine broth and 1 can of chilies in a large skillet; bring to a boil. Add chicken; reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is done turning chicken once. Remove chicken from cooking liquid reserving cooking liquid; cool chicken. Shred meat with two forks and set aside.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Bring 8 cups hot water to boiling. Add pasta. Reduce heat. Cook in gently boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Return to pan. Halve pepperoni; add to pasta. Stir in pizza sauce 3/4 cup Mozzarella cheese mushrooms olives and Parmesan. Transfer to a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes or until hot. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken for 1 hour. Take off the bones and put in the bottom of baking dish. Add soup to this. Pour Stove Top on top of the soup and chicken. Bake at 300\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes then bake 109 to 15 minutes longer uncovered.

title: Layered Pudding Delight
instructions: Mix pudding; let stand 5 minutes. Stir together with Cool Whip. Layer together in serving bowl with graham crackers. Make top layer graham crackers and top with cherry pie filling. Chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large skillet cook and stir meat onion and bell pepper until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain off grease. Stir in tomatoes rice salt chili powder and black pepper; heat through. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake in oven for 1 hour.

title: Raisin Carrot Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients with carrots raisins and pineapple. Mix in remaining ingredients and spoon into cups. Bake 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook all ingredients in pan until brown. Add the chicken and mushroom soups. Just before serving add the sour cream.

title: Norma'S Apple Squares
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Add water and lightly mix until blended. Divide in half. Roll out half of the dough and place in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Trim sides to halfway up the pan.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix seasoning packet from stuffing mix with melted butter. In a 2-quart casserole dish combine packet of bread crumbs from stuffing mix with corn milk and egg. Stir in seasoning mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli; arrange in buttered shallow dish or pan. Place chicken on top. Combine soup sour cream lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken. Melt butter; stir in crumbs and cheese. Top casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rum Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco. Add sugar and eggs one at a time beating after each. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add flour alternately with milk. Bake 1 1/2 hours in large tube pan at 300\u00b0. Spray pan with Pam.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet for 15 minutes. Drain excess fat. Add catsup cheese oregano garlic salt and salt. Simmer until most of liquid has evaporated. Serve on buns.

title: Monkey Cake
instructions: Take biscuits and cut into quarters. Put sugar and cinnamon in a bag. Put biscuits in the bag and shake. Place biscuits in a greased tube pan (layered).

title: Old-Fashion Pull Candy(Old Family Recipe)
instructions: Cook syrup in heavy skillet. (If using a candy thermometer boil at 260\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes). Test by dropping some from a spoon in cool water. It will string and bead on bottom like sticks. If a string of the syrup tinkles or clicks on glass it is ready. Pour syrup on buttered surface. Turn outer edges in until cool enough to handle. Grease your hands well with butter and pull until it turns almost white. Make it into rope-like sections and roll them in the chopped peanuts. Let cool. Cut into 2 to 3-inch pieces.

title: Grandma'S Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Pour 2 cups boiling water over first 5 ingredients and stir. Cool until lukewarm. Dissolve 1 tablespoon dry yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Add to batter add flour until thick enough (about 5 cups). Place in greased bowl. Cover with towel. Let rise until double in bulk. Punch down and let rise again in loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef onion and bell pepper until browned then add other ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Wilted Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine dressing onion and pepper; heat. Tear spinach in bite size pieces into salad bowl. Add crumbled bacon and cheese. Toss with dressing. Top with egg. Serves 6.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion. Drain excess grease. Add remaining ingredients add a small amount of water and simmer about 40 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Corny Snack Mix
instructions: In large bowl mix popcorn corn pops cereal and corn chips. Melt white chips. Pour over mixture \mix\. Spread onto wax paper cool. Store in airtight container. Very good!

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Bring water to boil. Make hamburger balls and put in water. When meat is done add spaghetti onion garlic salt salt pepper and tomato sauce. When spaghetti is done add Velveeta cheese and let melt then ready to eat.

title: Warm Gingerbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch square baking pan. Mix together the flour baking soda ginger and cinnamon. With electric mixer beat butter and brown sugar at high speed until pale brown and creamy. Break the eggs into butter mixture and beat until completely blended. Add half the flour mixture and mix at low speed. Add sour cream and mix. Add remaining flour and mix. Add molasses and mix until smooth. Fill prepared pan and bake about 30 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain juice from asparagus. In a 2-quart casserole dish alternate layer of asparagus eggs almonds and soup. Pour remaining soup over top of casserole and sprinkle with cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Mix all the ingredients together and let simmer 20 minutes.

title: Best Ever Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour and sugar into mixing bowl. Cut shortening into flour mixture. Blend in milk roll dough 1/4-inch thick on floured surface. Cut into biscuits. Place on baking sheet. Brush top with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Scallopini
instructions: Place chicken in nonstick skillet and add lemon juice. Season with garlic powder pepper parsley and onion powder. Cook chicken over high heat uncovered turning occasionally. Serve garnished with parsley sprigs.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: All cans of beans should be 16 ounce size.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Saute onions and celery in a small amount of margarine. Add broccoli. Add soup milk rice and Cheez Whiz. Stir and bake in lightly greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add flour soda and salt; mix well. Mash bananas and add the nuts. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Slice eggplant; leave skin on. Put eggplant in a pan; sprinkle with salt and cover with water (it takes out the bitterness).

title: Snitzel Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Add sugar and vinegar to drippings. After onion has been sauteed pour over beans and simmer for 20 minutes. Crumble in bacon. Set aside. Reheat when ready to serve.

title: Chicken-Turkey Casserole
instructions: Lightly mix all ingredients. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine hash brown potatoes sour cream onions and cheese all together. Place in baking dish. Melt butter or margarine. Crush corn flakes fine and mix with butter. Spread over top of potatoes and bake for about 1 hour. Serve and enjoy.

title: Italian Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Mix well. Make meatballs and brown. Add to spaghetti sauce or serve on the side. Serves 6 (2 each).

title: Homemade Sherbet
instructions: Mix. Put in ice cream freezer.

title: Olive Surprises
instructions: Cream cheese and butter. Add other ingredients. Chill about 20 minutes. Shape dough around each olive. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done. Good hot or cold.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Cake
instructions: Mix sugar cake flour and salt thoroughly. Add Crisco and mix on low. Add 2/3 cup sweet milk; mix on low until creamy. Add 1/3 cup milk and egg whites one at a time. Beat until blended. Add vanilla. Place in 2 lined greased 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Banana Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients with 1 gallon of water. Better if let set overnight.

title: Surprise Meringues
instructions: Beat egg whites salt cream of tartar and vanilla until soft peaks form. Add sugar gradually beating until peaks are stiff. Fold in chocolate pieces and nuts. Cover cookie sheet with plain paper sack. Drop mixture on paper by rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and freeze in molds. Will keep frozen for months.

title: Fruit Cocktail Dessert
instructions: Fold pudding into Cool Whip then add well-drained fruit cocktail (fresh).

title: Easy Sauerbraten
instructions: Saute meat and onion. Cover with Italian dressing water and broth. Simmer 3 to 4 hours or cook in crock-pot on low all day. Thicken sauce to gravy consistency with cornstarch and small amount of water. Serve over egg noodles or rice.

title: Apple Chip Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Sift flour soda cinnamon nutmeg and salt together. Add to shortening sugar and eggs then add buttermilk and apples.

title: Golden Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Combine ground round onion carrot and green pepper in a large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until beef is browned stirring until it crumbles. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Wipe drippings from skillet with paper towel. Return beef mixture to skillet; add peas and next 8 ingredients stirring well. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Spoon beef mixture into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Spread Potato Topping over beef mixture; lightly coat top with cooking spray. Bake uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Broil 5 1/2 inches from heat (with electric oven door partially opened) 1 to 2 minutes or until golden. Remove from oven; let stand 5 minutes before serving. Yields 6 servings (296 calories per serving).

title: Helen'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat milk butter and chocolate until butter and chocolate are melted. Sift flour salt and soda together. Add melted chocolate mixture to dry ingredients then add egg and vanilla. Blend well. Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan or loaf pan at 280\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef & Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni; drain. Melt 3 tablespoons margarine. Add flour seasonings and milk; cook 3 minutes. Stir in cheese; heat until melted. Add macaroni and dried beef. Heat 5 minutes. Pour into casserole. Melt remaining margarine; toss with bread crumbs. Top casserole with bread crumbs; broil until lightly browned.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve warm or cold with Melba toast or tortilla chips.

title: Arizona Mountain Soup
instructions: Rinse beans. Combine beans with 3 cups water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Let stand or cover and let stand overnight. Drain; add 5 1/2 cups fresh water to beans. Simmer covered for 1 hour. Cook onion and garlic in oil until tender. Stir in tomatoes rice salt paprika and pepper. Stir into beans. Bring to boiling. Cover and simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour or until rice and beans are done stirring occasionally. Will be thick. Makes 8 servings. Great for Lent.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue Beef
instructions: Add all ingredients to crock-pot and cook for 10 hours on low. Uncover for last hour to thicken. Shred beef and serve over buns. Freezes well.

title: Hanky Panky'S
instructions: Brown together the ground chuck and sausage continuously breaking into small pieces. Drain grease from the meat. Cut up Velveeta into chunks; melt together with meat. Add garlic salt and oregano to mixture. Serve warm on garlic rounds or miniature bread.

title: Chicken Breast Casserole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in baking casserole dish (9 x 13-inch). Place Swiss cheese on top of chicken. Pour mixture of soup and wine on top of cheese. Sprinkle top with stuffing mix and drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple - Walnut Bread(Lo-Cal)
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour soda and salt. Add alternately with orange juice. Beat after each addition. Stir in pineapple and nuts. Pour in two loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Contains 120 calories per 1/2 slice.

title: Sam'S Hot Dogs
instructions: Cook. Put hot dogs in and simmer until hot dogs are cooked. Serve warm with drinks.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Layer baking sheet with graham crackers. Melt butter and margarine. Pour butter mixture and sugar on the graham crackers. Sprinkle nuts on top and bake for 350\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Hog Maw(Pig Stomach)
instructions: Dice enough raw potatoes so that when mixed with sausage and onion they will fill the stomach firmly. Salt and pepper filling to taste. Fill the stomach and sew all openings shut. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for about 3 1/2 hours. If cooked faster the stomach might burst. About half an hour before serving remove cover and any grease and brown both sides. Slice to serve.

title: Quick Vegetable Salad
instructions: Chop lettuce in salad bowl. Then chop onion over lettuce. Spread English peas over onion. Cover peas with mayonnaise and sprinkle with plenty of Parmesan cheese. Stand cucumber slices around edge of bowl. Let chill.

title: Best Oven-Roasted Ribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Mix first 5 ingredients. Mix next 2 ingredients. Brush both sides of 4 slabs of baby-back ribs or 3 slabs of pork spare ribs with mustard then sprinkle with dry rub. Place on upper-middle oven rack. Place pan under ribs to catch drippings. Roast 2 to 3 hours for spare ribs 1/2 to 2 hours for baby-back ribs.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Stir in walnuts and cranberries. Combine eggs orange juice water and oil. Add to flour mixture. Stir until moist. Pat into a greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Amazin' Raisin Cake
instructions: Grease and flour two 9-inch round baking pans. In large bowl with mixer at low speed beat first 10 ingredients 2 minutes scraping bowl frequently or beat vigorously 300 strokes by hand. (Batter will be very thick.) With spoon stir in apples raisins and nuts. Spoon batter into pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 45 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove; cool. Fill and frost with 2 cups whipped cream.

title: Mayonnaise
instructions: Mix flour salt dry mustard and egg yolk together. Stir in vinegar then add milk. After cooked and cooled beat up 1 egg white and fold in.

title: Old-Fashioned Soft Sour Cream Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter to consistency of mayonnaise; add sugar gradually while continuing to cream. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla; beat until light and fluffy. Measure and sift flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream beginning and ending with dry ingredients. For 3-inch cookies drop by heaping teaspoons on well-greased cookie sheets well apart. With spatula flatten into circles about 2-inches in diameter. For super size 5-inch cookies use 1/4 cup measure of batter for each cookie. Flatten into circles 4-inches in diameter. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 30 (3-inch) cookies or 18 (5-inch) cookies.

title: Chex Buddy Mix
instructions: Microwave on High chocolate chips peanut butter and oleo for 1 minute. Stir and add vanilla and cereal. Place 1 1/4 cups powdered sugar in paper grocery bag. Add mixture; shake. Place on waxed paper.

title: Patty'S Salad
instructions: Blend and beat cream cheese and sugar. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Put in a bread pan and freeze. Slice to serve.

title: Sooner Cornbread Salad
instructions: Prepare cornbread according to package directions. Cool then crumble. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill at least 2 hours.

title: Perfect Spice Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cream butter and sugars until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and add eggs one at a time beating after each egg. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Put into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until center is done.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Let dates set 2 to 3 minutes in 1 cup boiling water and drain. Shape into balls; let set in refrigerator. Roll in coconut or melt 1 stick of wax and 1 package chocolate bits and dip them.

title: Spinach And Artichoke Appetizer
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake until hot and bubbly about 20 to 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serve on crackers or bread or with cut up fresh vegetables.

title: Oreo Delight
instructions: Crush cookie sand mix with soft ice cream. Pour into an 11 x 13-inch dish and freeze.

title: German Chocolate Cake(1993 Dairy Festival 1St Place)
instructions: Grease and lightly flour two 8 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans; set aside. In a saucepan heat chocolate and water until chocolate melts; cool. Stir together flour baking soda and salt. In a mixer bowl beat butter or margarine on medium speed of electric mixer about 30 seconds. Add sugar and vanilla; beat until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating on medium speed for 1 minute after each. Beat in chocolate mixture. Add dry ingredients and buttermilk alternately to beaten mixture beating after each addition. Fold in egg whites.

title: Strawberry Sour Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add cold water. Let this set until it begins to thicken. Add mashed bananas pineapple and frozen strawberries. Pour half of this mixture into a large mold rubbed with mayonnaise. Spread sour cream and let set for a few minutes then pour the other half of the Jell-O on top of the sour cream. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce leaf. Refrigerate overnight if possible.

title: Chocolate Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar. Blend in applesauce raisins and pecans. Sift together the flour salt cinnamon allspice cocoa and soda; add to cream mixture. Blend well. Pour into 3 greased and floured layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Frost with frozen coconut and a white frosting.

title: Glazed Fruit Dessert
instructions: In a bowl combine pudding and pineapple juice. Stir until thickened. Fold in pineapple oranges and bananas. Refrigerate until serving time. Garnish with whipped topping. Serves 6.

title: Prepared Mustard
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and add vinegar. Make a paste. Add rest of the vinegar and cook. If too thick add a little more vinegar and water to taste. This can be doubled if needed.

title: Lemon Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients by mixer for 2 minutes. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Blend by mixer for 2 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved. Arrange rolls in Bundt pan. Sprinkle with butterscotch pudding (not instant). Pour melted mixture over rolls. Cover tightly with foil. Let stand overnight on counter. Bake in morning at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Jalapeno Salsa
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix them up. Thats it! If its not hot enough add more jalapenos.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix the first 2 ingredients then stir in everything else. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: In a large cast iron skillet brown ground beef. Add onion and Ranch Style beans. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes over low fire. Place a handful of tortilla chips on a plate. Top with meat and bean mixture then cheese and then all of the rest. Be creative. Make it like you like it!

title: Praline Pecan Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl combine cake mix and butter at low speed until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup crumb mixture for topping. Press remaining mixture in bottom and 1 1/2-inches up sides of ungreased 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan. If necessary use floured fingers to press dough in pan.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in food processor. Chill and serve.

title: Norwegian Fish Balls
instructions: Grind fish several times and add a little milk slowly. Add beaten eggs. Beat until light and smooth then add salt nutmeg and cornstarch. Work good together. Make into small balls either fry in butter or boil in water.

title: Apple Anytime Cake
instructions: Mix Bisquick sugar cinnamon nutmeg egg milk and chopped nuts together. Fold in pie filling (any kind). Grease and flour an 8 x 12 pan. Spread mix evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix well and bake in pie shell till center is set. Cook 45 minutes at 325 degrees.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Supper
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain. In large skillet combine sausage green pepper onion and garlic. Cook 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and seasonings. Pour in black-eyed peas including liquid. Cover and simmer slowly for 20 minutes. Serve with grated cheese on top.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar milk and margarine in saucepan. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Take off stove; blend in the rest of the ingredients. Pour in baking dish to cool and then cut in squares.

title: Golden Ham Slice
instructions: Place ham slices on rack in an open roasting pan. Bake in slow oven (325\u00b0) 15 minutes. Drain pineapple reserving liquid. Combine cornstarch brown sugar and cinnamon. Add reserved liquid and cook stirring constantly until thickened and clear. Stir in pineapple and carrot. Spread mixture over ham slice and continue baking for 15 to 30 minutes longer.

title: People Puppy Food
instructions: Melt chocolate chips peanut butter and butter in microwave. Mix in cereal and sugar. Put 10x sugar on at once. Cereal will separate.

title: Calypso Beef Salad(Serves 4)
instructions: Combine the yogurt mayonnaise and ginger. Cover and refrigerate. Cut the asparagus into 1-inch strips. Cut the oranges into 1/2-inch slices and then into quarters. Separate the onion slices into rings and combine with asparagus.

title: Preacher'S Casserole
instructions: Brown beef onion and celery. Mix together all ingredients saving a few noodles to spread on top. Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 6 to 7.

title: English Rocks
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients and buttermilk. Mix well. Pour batter over nuts and fruit and mix thoroughly. Drop from teaspoon on baking sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. These keep well and can be frozen. Makes a lot but are delicious.

title: Mandarin Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie crusts. Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Downtown Fudge Pie
instructions: Over low heat melt butter and chocolate. Set aside. Beat eggs until light. To eggs add syrup sugar salt and vanilla. Now add slightly cooled chocolate mixture. Mix and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Dont overbake! Pie should shake like custard so it wont be stiff when cooled. Delicious served warm with vanilla ice cream. Tastes like a hot fudge sundae.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into small greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Scoutmaster'S Stew
instructions: Utensils 1 large pot 1 long spoon 2 to 3 sharp knives 1 tripod 1 easy chair firewood matches 2 to 3 Assistant Scoutmasters 1 rope with hook and 1 skillet.

title: Meatball Stew
instructions: Place the potatoes carrots onion celery and meatballs in a 5-quart slow cooker. In a bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Pour over meatball mixture. Cover and cook on low 9 to 10 hours or until the vegetables are crisp-tender.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Alternate cabbage onion and green pepper in layers in a bowl with tight fitting lid. Cover top of ingredients with 1 cup sugar 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon sugar salt and vinegar. Mix together vegetable oil celery seed and dry mustard seed. Stir and bring to a boil. Pour over cabbage immediately. Cover with lid and let set usually about 4 hours or overnight. Keeps for weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: You will also need 1 large glass punch bowl.

title: California Chicken
instructions: Take Cheez-Its crackers and grind into crumbs. (Use grinder food processor or mallet and bag for crackers.) Needs to be fine. Take chicken breasts and pound as flat as possible. Dip chicken in sour cream mixed with seasoned salt then roll in Cheez-It crumbs. Then take chicken and roll it up. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Roast Beef And Gravy
instructions: Rinse meat and tenderize both sides. Put in crock-pot and add onion soup mix and cup of water over that. Add all the soups. Cook on low in crock-pot for 8 hours or in oven at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Best served with rice.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Combine Greek seasoning and paprika with oils and vinegar in a small bowl. Mix well. Add mushrooms and marinate for several hours. Add onion tomatoes avocado celery and parsley. Chill 1 hour before serving. Add olives. Serve in bowls lined with lettuce leaves. Serves 4.

title: Snow Cake
instructions: Lightly grease and flour 3 (8-inch) cake pans; set aside. Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Blend until moistened; beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Spread batter evenly in three prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool on wire racks.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Brown onions in oil. Add remaining ingredients. Cook about 30 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients together. Cream the shortening with the sugar and add egg. Alternately mix the sifted mixture and the applesauce and chocolate chips with the cream mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan greasing entire pan. Mix together all the ingredients. Pour into pan mixing margarine into batter. Bake for 45 minutes until brown on top and crusty at edges.

title: Hodie Podie
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on low heat in crock-pot for 6 to 8 hours. Serve with cornbread and salad.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Cook seasonings until transparent. Mix cornstarch and milk together and add to seasonings stirring constantly. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add crabmeat and season. Mix cornflake crumbs and mayonnaise together and mix with crabmeat mixture. Pour into buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese together. Slowly sift in confectioners sugar. Stir in vanilla and lemon juice.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Mix flour meal sugar mustard and onion together. Combine egg and milk; mix with dry ingredients. Roll hot dogs in the dough mixture; fry in deep fat until golden brown.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Chill rice in refrigerator. In Farberware electric wok add 1 tablespoon of oil. Set heat control dial at 200\u00b0. When light goes out add egg and scramble. Remove and set aside. Turn heat control dial to 250\u00b0 and add remaining oil onions and garlic. Stir-fry about 1 minute. Stir in shrimp and water chestnuts; cook cold rice and soy sauce until well mixed then stir in peas carrot and egg. Stir constantly until hot. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain off fat. Add garlic bay leaf basil salt tomatoes and tomato paste. Add tomato juice to make consistency of spaghetti. Simmer one hour uncovered. Remove bay leaf and garlic. Cook noodles.

title: Easy Gingerbread
instructions: Melt shortening and set aside to cool. Beat eggs and set aside. Sift all dry ingredients together. Mix brown sugar shortening eggs and molasses. Mix with dry ingredients. Add buttermilk. Mix well and pour into an 8 x 8 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Dieter'S Delight Ambrosia
instructions: Blend cottage cheese with wire whisk. Sprinkle dry orange gelatin over mixture. Add oranges and pineapple. Fold together. Refrigerate overnight. Serves 12.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: Add gelatin to water set aside. Put yolks in double boiler stir in 1/3 c. sugar lemon rind and juice. Cook stirring over boiling water 5 minutes or until thickened. Stir in gelatin until melted. Remove from heat. Beat egg whites and salt until they form peaks. Slowly add 1/2 c. sugar while beating stiff. Gently fold in hot mixture. Turn into shell chill. Can be served with whipped cream.

title: Crawfish Patties
instructions: Grind all vegetables with crawfish tails in food processor. Add eggs salt and pepper to taste. Add bread crumbs and mix well. Form into patties then drench in flour (I prefer flour) or fish fry. Deep fry until brown. Serves about 10.

title: Beef And Rice
instructions: Make rice. Brown meat until done. Mix with rice and simmer to mix the flavor. Put grated cheese over top of rice and steak. Serves 4.

title: Mama'S Cherry Salad With Coke
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and bring to a hard boil. Pour over jello stir until dissolved. Add pineapple and juice. Allow to cool and add Coke. Pour into a large mold and chill overnight. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325\u00b0. In mixing bowl cream the Crisco and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs beating after each one. Blend remaining ingredients alternately beating thoroughly after each addition. Pour batter in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake for approximately 1 hour. Cool on wire rack. Remove from pan.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Saute pork and shrimp until browned. Add garlic and onion. Fold in vegetables (except cabbage) and cook 5 to 10 minutes. Add cabbage; cook 5 more minutes. Serve.

title: Ravioli-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix ravioli with sour cream. Cut thawed broccoli lengthwise. Put a layer of spears on bottom of dish. Pour ravioli mixture on top. Garnish with reserved broccoli. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Five Flavors Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar and eggs; beat well. Add flour and milk alternately ending with flour. Add extracts in milk. Bake in greased and floured 10-inch round tube pan for 25 minutes at 275\u00b0. Raise temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes more. Let cool in pan. Remove and punch holes in cake with toothpick.

title: Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Saute onions in 4 tablespoons butter. Add flour and water. When thick add Cheez Whiz. Combine cheese sauce broccoli and eggs. Pour into 10-inch pie plate and top with buttered Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Deviled Egg And Ham Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine ham green pepper onion mayonnaise red pepper vinegar and mustard. Mix until well blended. Set aside. Separate hard cooked egg yolk from whites. Place yolks in small bowl. Mash and stir into ham mixture. Chop egg whites and stir into ham mixture. Let stand 10 minutes to blend flavors. Line 4 plates with lettuce. Arrange tomatoes in fan shape around edge of lettuce. Spoon salad mixture onto lettuce. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Italiano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brush chicken with 2 tablespoons dressing. Place chicken pieces in flat pan skin side down; cover with\tremaining dressing and sprinkle with spices. Bake 30 minutes. Turn chicken; add mushrooms cheese and paprika. Bake another 30 minutes basting occasionally. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Brittle(Microwave Oven)
instructions: Measure peanuts sugar syrup and salt into a 1 1/2 quart glass bowl. Stir to blend. Microwave 8 minutes stopping and stirring several times. (I use a wooden spoon and leave in the dish.) Add oleo and vanilla and microwave an additional 2 minutes without stirring. Remove candy from oven and add soda. Pour candy onto a buttered cookie sheet and let cool. As candy cools run a knife around outer edges for easier removal from cookie sheet. Break in pieces.

title: Dried Beef Casserole
instructions: Combine all and mix well. Pour in greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cajun Rush'S Chargrilled Shrimp
instructions: Peel shrimp except for final tail section (provides a handle for eating). Mix all other ingredients in a flat casserole or baking dish and marinate shrimp in resulting sauce for a few minutes. When chargrill is good and hot place shrimp on grill. Watch carefully shrimp cook quickly (2 to 3 minutes). Turn shrimp after a minute or so and baste with marinade. Remove from grill as soon as they lose their translucency and turn whitish. Dont overcook! Baste again and serve immediately. Shrimp should be juicy and full of flavor.

title: Grilled Potato Wedges
instructions: Heat grill. In a bowl combine all above ingredients and mix until well coated. Place on grill and turn over every 7 minutes. Move to center of grill each turn. Grill for 20 minutes of until tender with knife.

title: Salad
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Add 1/2 of salad seasoning and 1/2 of salad dressing. Chill. Before serving add the rest of seasoning and salad dressing. Toss and serve.

title: Panned Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Melt fat in a frypan. Add the cabbage and corned beef. Cover tightly. Cook until cabbage is tender 5 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

title: Herbed Cheese Bread
instructions: Cut bread into slices (not all the way through). Put one slice Swiss or Jack cheese between each slice. Spread with butter mix. Put in foil boat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Remove sausage from casing and brown in skillet. Drain fat from sausage and add shredded cheese over sausage. Mix other ingredients together and then add sausage mixture and mix well. Roll into balls\tand place on ungreased cookie sheet.\tBake for approximately 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.\tMakes around 75.

title: Ruth'S Squash Pickles
instructions: Place squash onions and peppers in large container with 1/2 cup salt. Cover with water and ice cubes. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Mix other ingredients and bring to a boil. Drain squash mixture and rinse. Pour liquid mixture over squash and boil for 7 minutes. Pour into jars and seal. Makes 7 pints.

title: Cheesy Hamburger Hash
instructions: Cook beef in 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat about 5 minutes stirring occasionally until brown; drain. Remove beef and drippings from skillet. Melt butter in same skillet. Add potatoes. Cover and cook over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally until tender. Stir in beef tomatoes and seasoning. Cook stirring occasionally until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with cheese and parsley. Cover and heat until cheese is melted.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together and bake uncovered in buttered dish at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Collard Greens
instructions: Place water red pepper and meat in large pot and boil for 1 hour. Prepare greens by discarding damaged or yellowed leaves. Cut away tough stems from each leaf. Wash greens individually until water runs clear and free of dirt and grit. Collard greens are large and usually require cutting before cooking. To do so fold leaf in half at its center vein fold over once or twice then cut in half with scissors or a knife. Add remaining ingredients to meat in boiling water and then the greens. Cover and cook rapidly for about 30 minutes or until greens are tender yet firm. Serve with diced raw onions and vinegar. Yields 16 servings.

title: Ice Cream Cake Roll
instructions: Bake on cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 until done. Dont overbake. Turn out on towel covered with powdered sugar and roll. Cool then unroll and add ice cream. Reroll and freeze.

title: Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and 3 tablespoons sugar together. Press that into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes at 250\u00b0. Let that cool. Soften and mix cream cheese Cool Whip and sugar. Spread over crumb mixture and set aside. Mix jello in 2 cups boiling water with the frozen strawberries. Let stand until jelly-like. Spread on top of cheese mixture. Store in the fridge until ready to use.

title: Lemon Butter Trout
