instructions: Combine butter lemon juice parsley dill and black pepper. On a 12 x 12-inch square aluminum foil shape butter mixture into 1-inch log. Wrap tightly in foil and freeze for 1 hour. Broil trout meat side up for about 5 minutes. Serve topped with 2 slices herb butter. Serves 6.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve with apple wedges.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Mix well. Top with mixture of topping ingredients.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and sour cream. Mix next 4 ingredients together; add to Cool Whip mixture. Fold in fruit and freeze. Take out of freezer 15 minutes before serving. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Aunt Diane'S Terrific Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water. Drain. Combine macaroni tuna mayo veggies and salt. Blend soup and milk; heat through. Add to macaroni mixture. Add cheese and sprinkle some on top. Turn into casserole dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 uncovered about 20 minutes.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Mix well and place dough in a large greased bowl. Cover with a towel. Let stand overnight. In the morning punch down and divide into 3 loaves. Knead each loaf 12 times. Put into greased loaf pans. Let rise 4 to 6 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Brush with melted butter while hot if desired.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and soup mix together and chill for about 1 hour. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream margarine and peanut butter with mixer. Add 1 cup of the flour. Add sugars eggs baking powder and soda. Add vanilla. Beat until thoroughly combines. Beat in remaining flour. If necessary cover and chill dough until easy to handle. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in additional sugar. Place 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 7 to 9 minutes. Immediately press 1 Kiss into each cookie. Cool on wire racks. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Swiss Enchiladas
instructions: Saute onion until soft in oil. Add garlic clove tomato puree green chilies and chopped chicken. Season with salt and simmer 10 minutes. Fry tortillas fresh in about 1-inch of hot oil. Do not let them crisp as they are to be rolled. Dissolve bouillon cubes in three cups of hot cream. Dip each tortilla in this. Cover generously with chicken filling and roll up. Arrange rolls in baking dish and pour remaining cream mixture over them. Top with Jack or Swiss cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. If you wish garnish with avocado slices or hard-cooked eggs radishes and ripe green olives. Serves 6.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Corn Tamale Pie
instructions: Break tamales in pieces. Mix with corn and beaten eggs. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole; sprinkle cheese over top. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until center is firm. Garnish with ripe olives if desired.

title: Fried Pie Pastry
instructions: Mix all ingredients and divide into 10 balls. Roll out and use 2 teaspoons of fruit filling for each pie. Fry in deep fat or oil.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Beat egg yellows and add to milk. Mix sugar and flour together and gradually add to milk. Cook in a double boiler 45 minutes to 1 hour. Will thicken. Add vanilla flavoring to taste and yellow food coloring as desired. Pour through strainer and refrigerate.

title: Tagliatelle With Jumbo Prawns
instructions: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. 2. In skillet saute the shallot with olive oil & butter as soon as it browns. Add the shrimp and cook for four minutes. 3. Gently stir in the cream then turn off the heat. Add salt and pepper as desired. 4. Dress the pasta with the prepared sauce and serve.

title: Hash Brown Au Gratin
instructions: Thaw potatoes. In large mixing bowl combine potatoes salt pepper onion and cheese. In medium mixing bowl combine 1/2 cup melted butter sour cream and soup. Pour over potato mixture and mix gently. Pour into 3 quart buttered casserole.

title: Peach Praline Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Generously butter a muffin tin. Combine yogurt eggs and the large quick bread mix packet and 1/3 cup of the swirl packet (small packet). Beat until well mixed. Spoon into muffin cups filling about 2/3 full. Sprinkle remaining swirl mixture over top of each muffin. Bake for about 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center of muffin comes out clean. Remove from pan immediately. Serve warm with butter.

title: Baked Consomme Rice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a buttered casserole with cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch salt and milk. Cook until mixture begins to thicken. Take out 1 cup of this mixture and stir in beaten egg yolks. Pour back into saucepan. Cook at gentle boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla.

title: Angel Hash
instructions: Drain fruit and reserve juice. In large saucepan mix cornstarch and water. Add egg and juice; blend well. Cook over medium heat until thick stirring constantly. Cool thoroughly. Stir in Cool Whip nuts coconut marshmallows and drained fruit and pineapple. Place in serving bowl; cover and chill overnight.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Mix above ingredients; drop by spoonfuls into hot grease until brown.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a greased 9 x 13 inch pan bake 375\u00b0 for 75 minutes until brown and crispy.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Gradually add powdered sugar to butter. Cream well. Add 1 unbeaten egg vanilla and sifted flour. Stir in pecans and candied cherries. Chill 1 hour. Divide dough into 3 parts. Shape in rolls and roll in wax paper. Chill at least 3 hours. Slice for cookies and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 13 or 15 minutes until edges begin to show a little brown. Will keep in freezer for future use.

title: Grandma'S Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Place water in large warm bowl. Sprinkle in yeast stir until dissolved. Stir in sugar salt butter eggs whole wheat flour and enough all-purpose white flour to make stiff dough. Grease bowl and top. Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 2 hours or up to 3 days.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
instructions: Line muffin tins with liners. Mix cream cheese vanilla and sugar on medium speed until blended. Add eggs. Mix well. Pour over wafers filling 3/4 full. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Remove from pan when cool. Top with fruit nuts or preserves. Be creative.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar butter cocoa and milk in saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Mix all together and drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper. \Nuts or raisins may be added if desired.\

title: Potatoes And Onions
instructions: Wash and slice potatoes into 1/2-inch slices. Do onions same way. Place a potato slice then onion slice until all is placed in dish. Pour melted butter over potatoes and onions. Sprinkle salt pepper then paprika over ingredients. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Quick Brown Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour sugar salt and soda together. Add buttermilk. Pour batter into greased and floured 8-ounce coffee cans. Fill half full. Bake 45 to 60 minutes. Remove from can and cool. Use coffee cans or loaf pans; loaf pans will be longer to bake.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: If zucchini is large and old peel before using. Blend eggs oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Fold in nuts.\tSift dry ingredients and fold lightly into batter. Bake in loaf pans for about 1 hour in a 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Quick And Easy Spanish Rice And Beef
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet. Add tomatoes water corn and seasonings. Bring to a boil and boil about 2 minutes. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix Bisquick milk and cheese until a soft dough forms; beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. While biscuits are baking mix margarine and garlic powder; remove biscuits from oven and brush tops with margarine immediately (before removing from the cookie sheet). Serve warm. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits. These resemble the biscuits served at the Red Lobster.

title: Noodle Casserole
instructions: In pan put a small amount of Pam or cooking oil. Put cut up onion and ground meat in pan. Brown; then add tomatoes and tomato soup. Cook macaroni in boiling water until done. Mix all in a large bowl. Put in a 2 1/2-quart casserole and reheat in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Can be heated in microwave.

title: Cool Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in water with salt until tender. Drain. Mix all other ingredients together in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Pour mixture over carrots. Let stand 45 minutes. Store in refrigerator. Lasts \indefinitely.\

title: Shrimp And Noodle Bake
instructions: Saute garlic in small amount olive oil. Add shrimp for a few minutes. Add tomatoes and rotini. Put on serving dish and sprinkle with Feta cheese. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Chocolate Truffle And Caramel Pie
instructions: Combine crumbs pecans and melted butter. Press into bottom and up sides of 10-inch pie plate. Cook in microwave on High for 1 minute. Set aside to cool.

title: Broiler Icing
instructions: Mix all together; spread on any 13 x 9-inch cake. Put under broiler until brown.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Mix the last 5 ingredients and heat to boiling. Pack vegetables and salt in sterilized jars. Cover with vinegar solution. Place in water bath for 10 minutes.

title: Frosty Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cranberries pineapple sugar and marshmallows. Let chill overnight.

title: Big Boy Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash and stem the berries; set aside. Combine the sugar and 1 cup water. Stir in the paste made with the cornstarch and 1/2 cup water. Boil gently until thick and clear about 5 minutes. Stir in jello. Cool a little. Fold in the berries and pour into the baked pie shell.

title: Chicken Fricassee
instructions: Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry. Season with salt and paprika. Place sliced vegetables and bay leaf in crock-pot. Place chicken pieces on top of vegetables. Pour in chicken broth. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 12 hours.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add spaghetti sauce; let simmer. Boil macaroni. Cut Cheddar cheese into small pieces. Drain macaroni. Place in baking dish; mix ground beef and Cheddar cheese with noodles. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and a few pats of butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve with warm biscuits.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Saute meat and onion. Drain. Mix in remaining ingredients. If too thick add a little water. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Scald milk with sugar and shortening. When lukewarm add yeast and let stand about 5 minutes. Stir in 4 cups flour (or enough to make stiff batter) egg and salt. Sprinkle board with small amount of flour and work dough into ball. Let rise. Make out into rolls and let rise. Bake for approximately 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Saute onions until transparent. Remove from heat. Stir in flour salt curry powder and pepper. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid. Add water to make 1/2 cup liquid.

title: Sesame Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli in small amount of boiling salted water until tender about 15 minutes. Drain. In saucepan combine oil vinegar soy sauce sugar and sesame seed. Heat to boiling; pour over broccoli. Turn spears to coat. Serves 5 74 calories per serving.

title: Un-Fried Catfish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray the vegetable oil over the baking sheet 3 times to coat. Put the cornmeal thyme and basil on a large plate and mix well. Sprinkle 1/8 tsp. of the garlic powder 1/8 tsp. of the lemon pepper and 1 tsp. of the blackening seasoning on each catfish filet. Coat the filets thoroughly with the cornmeal mixture and transfer them to the prepared baking sheet. Dust each filet with 1/8 tsp. of paprika. Coat the catfish lightly with the cooking spray. Place the baking sheet on the bottom shelf of oven. Bake for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for about 5 minutes more until the crust is golden and the fish flakes easily.

title: Creamy Spinach Bake
instructions: In a bowl beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add the soup mix; mix well. Stir in spinach and onions. Transfer to a greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Combine cracker crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over spinach mixture. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Combine spaghetti sauce and water. Set aside. Combine eggs Ricotta cheese spinach and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese stirring well. Set aside. Spread 1 cup tomato mixture in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer half each of uncooked lasagna noodles spinach mixture Mozzarella cheese and tomato mixture; repeat layers. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover dish securely with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let lasagna stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Raisin Slaw
instructions: Mix apples with lemon juice in a large bowl. Add rest of ingredients and mix lightly.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Add onions; cook until tender. Butter casserole dish and line with crushed crackers. Add onions and soup in layers. Beat eggs; add milk salt and pepper. Pour over casserole. Sprinkle crackers and cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and bubbly.

title: Gourmet Goulash
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Add meat; brown well. Add onion. Combine other ingredients (except sour cream). Add to meat and onion; cook covered until meat is tender (about 1 1/2 hours). If desired add sour cream. Serve with parsley buttered noodles.

title: Quick Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: *Can substitute with tuna.

title: Low-Fat Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Stir together the first 5 ingredients. In another bowl with electric mixer cream margarine brown sugar and Sweet One. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients then raisins. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto baking sheets sprayed with Pam. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies. Calories 55 per cookie.

title: Banana Ice Cream
instructions: Dissolve Junkets in 2 teaspoons water; set aside. Mash bananas in a bowl and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Add bananas then the Junket mixture. Pour into freezing container of home ice cream maker. Follow freezing directions recommended by the manufacturer of the ice cream maker.

title: Holiday Wassail
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Makes 5 1/2 quarts.

title: Bananas Foster
instructions: Combine butter and brown sugar in a skillet over medium heat and caramelize. Add orange juice and creme de banana. Add walnuts bananas and rum; flame (optional) agitating pan slightly. Put ice cream into individual bowls and spoon mixture over ice cream. Serve warm. (Serves 6.)

title: Fresh Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients; chill and churn. Freeze.

title: Cheeseburger And Fries Casserole
instructions: In a 9 x 9-inch pan layer as follows hamburger soup French fries cheese hamburger soup and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Okra Salad
instructions: Fry bacon; drain. Fry okra. Chop onion tomatoes and pepper. Toss together and serve. No dressing. Tomatoes serve as dressing. Serve hot or cold (I like it better hot).

title: Fruit Shake
instructions: Pre-chill all fruits. Put all ingredients in blender; blend on medium speed for 30 seconds then whip at high speed for 10 seconds. Makes 3 servings.

title: Chocolate Fudge Candy
instructions: Mix first 4 items. Bring to a boil then lower heat to medium. Let cook until mixture forms a soft ball when dropped into cool water. (Stir frequently.) Pour into buttered dish and let cool. Cut into squares.

title: Garden Slaw
instructions: To make the dressing soften gelatin in 1/4 cup water. Mix sugar vinegar and spices in saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in softened gelatin. Cool until slightly thickened. Beat well. Gradually beat in oil.

title: Barbecue Deer
instructions: Place meat in casserole dish. Cover with water. Add vinegar pepper salt and lemon pepper. Cook 4 hours at 350\u00b0. Make sure meat is very tender. Drain. Add barbecue sauce. Good over rice or as a sandwich.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter eggs & sugar until creamy. Combine flour baking soda and cocoa add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix at low speed after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Spoon batter into greased tube pan. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: North Dakota Sunflower Pie
instructions: Beat together eggs brown sugar corn syrup sugar margarine vanilla and salt. Spread sunflower kernels evenly in the bottom of the unbaked pie shell. Pour in the sugar mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until center is almost set (it will jiggle slightly).

title: Sunset Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add pineapple juice and salt. Chill. When slightly thickened add pineapple and carrots. Chill in refrigerator until firm. Cut into individual servings and place on lettuce. May be served with a teaspoon of salad dressing on the side.

title: Chess Pie Or Tarts
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add cornmeal vinegar and vanilla. Add the eggs one at a time. Pour into 16 frozen tart shells. Bake for 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Papa'S Oyster Stew
instructions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Add drained oysters and heat until edges curl. Add milk salt and pepper. Heat but do not boil. Sprinkle each serving with paprika.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Brown the roast and put into a large cooking pot with lid. Add nutmeg cinnamon cloves onion wine and bouillon. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0 then add carrots and potatoes. Cook 5 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: After School Snack
instructions: Spread peanut butter over crackers then put marshmallows on them and microwave until marshmallows are melted.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas with fork. Add rest of ingredients (except nuts). Mix well; stir in nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel and chunk sweet potatoes. Cook until tender (add salt to water when cooking). While potatoes are cooking mix together corn flakes raisins nuts brown sugar and butter. Set aside. Mash the potatoes; add sugar milk eggs cinnamon nutmeg and beat well. Spoon into a greased casserole dish. Top with corn flake mixture. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Loose Meat Sandwich
instructions: Brown hamburg (loose). Add onion soup mix and chicken gumbo soup. Allow to cool down. Thicken if desired with cornstarch. Place mixture in hot dog buns and serve.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together well shortening eggs and sugar. Add dry ingredients and sour milk mashed bananas and nuts. Mix well. Grease loaf pan and coat with flour. Put batter in pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until golden brown. Let cool and remove from pan.

title: Fluffy White Icing(Frosting For  Chocolate Nugget Cake)
instructions: Boil slowly sugar water & cream of tartar without stirring until syrup spins to 8 inch threads. Keep saucepan covered first 3 minutes to prevent crystals from forming on sides of pan. Remove from heat.

title: White Icing
instructions: Beat butter and Crisco; add sugar a little at a time. Add warm milk 1 tablespoon at a time. Add vanilla. Beat almost 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Fish Fillets
instructions: You will need Saran Wrap.

title: Polish Kolaches
instructions: Blend yeast and sugar in a large bowl. Add melted shortening beaten egg yolks lukewarm milk mashed potatoes and water (from boiled potatoes). Blend. Add 3 cups flour salt baking powder and stir. Add remainder of flour and knead into a big ball. Place in a greased bowl. Let rise until doubled in size; place on floured board. Cut into buns the size of tennis balls and place on greased pan. Grease buns and let rise double in size. Make depressions on top of buns with fingers for filling; put in any fruit filling. Cherry pie filling with a powdered sugar glaze is a favorite. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix ingredients well adding enough sweet milk to make soft but not running. Drop small amounts from the end of a teaspoon into very hot oil. Cook until brown.

title: Joan'S Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and drain excess grease. Add spaghetti sauce and let simmer. Cook noodles according to directions on package. Cool slightly in cold water in order to be able to handle. Place a small amount of the sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 12-inch casserole. Then layer in the following order noodles sauce Cheddar cheese noodles sauce Mozzarella noodles sauce Parmesan and remaining Cheddar and Mozzarella. Bake about 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve hot.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Knead 10 times and bake for 15 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Lemon Bundt Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients for 4 minutes. Bake in well-greased Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or so. Let cool in pan 5 to 10 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix margarine oatmeal and boiling water together and let stand 20 minutes then add eggs white sugar brown sugar flour salt soda cinnamon nutmeg and vanilla. Beat well. Grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in long pan.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Combine pecan halves candied cherries seedless raisins and 1/2 cup flour. Let stand. Measure and sift together ground cloves nutmeg 3 1/2 cups flour allspice soda and cinnamon. Work until smooth. Beat together until light and fluffy butter and brown sugar. Stir in eggs one at a time. Add dry ingredients alternately with whiskey. Blend in fruit. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Store in layers separated by wax paper.

title: Muffin Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and pour into a greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Anzac Biscuits
instructions: Melt butter and syrup in a large saucepan. Mix bicarbonate of soda with boiling water and add to melted butter. This will froth up so make sure saucepan is large enough. Mix dry ingredients and add to saucepan. Mix well to make a firm consistency. Drop teaspoonfuls onto well-greased baking trays leaving space to spread. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Loosen on trays while still hot and allow to cool on trays then transfer to wire racks and allow to cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake and cool pie shell. Crush enough berries; add sugar and water and bring to boil. Thicken with cornstarch dissolved in water. Boil until clear. Remove from heat and add butter. Place remaining berries in pie shell. When mixture cools pour over berries. Do not put hot mixture over berries; it cooks them. Cool pie and top with whipped cream.

title: Boze Milosti(Divine Love Krispies)
instructions: Mix eggs with cream and water. Add to flour and salt. Stir and knead on floured board until smooth. Roll out very thin. Cut in diamond shapes (3 x 3-inch). Make a 2-inch slit in center of each piece. Fry in hot oil stretching dough still thinner as you drop into oil. Fry until golden. Dry on paper towels. Sprinkle with granulated sugar or drizzle with thin powdered sugar icing.

title: Salmon Ball
instructions: Combine salmon cheese salt horseradish grated onion lemon juice and Ranch dressing. Let chill. Shape into ball. Roll in nuts and parsley flakes.

title: Easy Tea Cakes
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar oil and vanilla. Stir in flour then drop by teaspoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Mediterranean Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken breasts with all ingredients for 6 hours. Better results are obtained if every chicken breast is cut in two halves and pounded to thin the breast to no more than 1 centimeter thickness.

title: Healthy Chili
instructions: Brown meat. Pour off any fat and saute onion and garlic with the meat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Rolls
instructions: Mix ingredients with mayonnaise to spread. Stuff buttered rolls. Wrap filled rolls in wax paper. Heat for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mom'S Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cook raisins and water to boil. Mix other ingredients together. Add raisins and water; mix in flour. Drop onto cookie sheet (greased cookie sheets). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Scallops De Jonghe
instructions: Combine crumbs onions parsley and seasonings. Add butter and sherry; mix thoroughly. Combine crumb mixture and scallops; toss lightly. Place in well-greased shallow 1-quart casserole. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Using a 3-quart pot boil rice cinnamon stick and the lemon peel in cold water on medium-high heat. Continue to cook until rice is soft and most of the water has evaporated. Remove cinnamon stick. Add milk sugar salt and vanilla. Continue cooking at medium-low heat stirring often until thick. Remove the lemon peel. Serve in 8 dessert dishes and sprinkle with the powdered cinnamon when serving.

title: Peach Muffins
instructions: Chop peaches; drain and set aside. Combine flour salt soda and sugar in mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil; stir until dry ingredients are well moistened. Add peaches and remaining ingredients. Stir until blended. Spoon batter evenly into greased or paper lined muffin pans filling 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes one dozen.

title: Creamy Cheesy Potato Soup
instructions: Cover potatoes celery and onion with water. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook on medium-high heat until potatoes are tender. Reduce heat to low and add soup cheese milk and margarine. Simmer until cheese has melted stirring occasionally.

title: Black Bottom Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch baking pan or place papers in cupcake pans. Beat together cream cheese egg 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt until fluffy. Stir in chocolate chips. In another bowl beat the remaining ingredients except the flour. Beat flour in last. If making in 13 x 9-inch pan pour batter into baking dish. Drop cream cheese mixture by spoonfuls into the batter. Bake approximately 45 minutes. If making mini cupcakes or regular-size cupcakes pour chocolate batter in until half full. Drop a small amount of cream cheese batter in center. For mini cupcakes bake 15 minutes. For regular-size bake 25 to 30 minutes. (Makes 24 cakes.)

title: Old-Fashion Caramel Pie
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar salt and flour well. Add milk. Mix and set aside. Melt 3/4 cup sugar in a heavy skillet over medium heat until melted and brown. Stir constantly. When sugar is melted add the milk mixture (sugar will crystallize). Stir until dissolved and of correct texture. Remove from heat. Add egg yolks vanilla and butter. Mix well and pour into baked pie shells. Add meringue and brown top. Makes 2 pies!

title: Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Separate the fiber from unwashed pumpkin seeds. Add to 2 cups pumpkin seeds the butter and salt. Spread in a shallow pan. Bake in very slow oven at 250\u00b0 until crisp and brown. Stir often.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. May be topped with cheese of any kind and sliced tomatoes for decoration.

title: Amazing Raisin Cake
instructions: Grease and flour two 9-inch round baking pans. In large bowl with mixer at low speed beat the first 10 ingredients for 2 minutes scraping bowl frequently. Batter will be thick. With spoon stir in apples raisins and nuts. Spoon batter into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Remove cool cakes fill and frost with 2 cups whipped cream.

title: Bad Bob'S Hot Wing Sauce
instructions: Mix together. Put over cooked wings.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Thoroughly grease angel food pan. Arrange frozen yeast rolls in bottom. Sprinkle over the rolls sugar mixed with cinnamon. Then sprinkle over it the pudding. Add nuts. Dot with butter or margarine cut into pieces. Place pan in cold oven overnight. In morning bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Turn out onto platter and serve.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients; pour into pie crust. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Reduce to 350\u00b0 for additional 40 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Egg Noodle-Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: Heat oil. Add onion and saute over medium heat for 3 minutes. Add water and bouillon. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally until bouillon is dissolved. Gradually add noodles and salt so that bouillon continues to boil. Cook uncovered for 3 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in broccoli and garlic powder. Cook 4 more minutes. Add milk cheese and pepper and cook until cheese melts.

title: Pot Pie Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking powder well and work in shortening. Add egg and water to make a stiff dough. Roll out 1/8-inch thick; cut in 2-inch squares and drop in boiling broth carefully so they dont stick. Cook 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sausage With Sawmill Gravy
instructions: Brown and drain sausage reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings in the pan. Blend in flour to make a roux. Add milk and blend until smooth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 2 minutes. Serve over hot open-faced biscuits.

title: Jerry Glenn'S Favorite Baked Beans And Sausage
instructions: Parboil sausage to eliminate some excess fats. Cut into 1-inch chunks. Mix all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Peel cucumbers and thinly slice. Add water vinegar and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Add salt pepper and onion powder to taste. Chill 3 hours to allow flavors to mix.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: In a blender or food processor blend the cookies until they are finely crushed. Cream together butter cream cheese and powdered sugar.

title: Apple Rolls
instructions: Melt butter in a bowl. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add buttermilk melted butter 6 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 egg and whole wheat flour. Stir to blend. Add the all-purpose flour. Knead dough until smooth and elastic. Let rise in a warm place for about 40 minutes. Punch down.

title: Squash Souffle
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine squash butter brown sugar salt pepper and orange peel. Beat until fluffy. Add egg yolks; beat well. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Carefully fold into squash mixture. Bake souffle in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes to 45 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk until thick. Add Cool Whip and sour cream and mix. Layer vanilla wafers thin slices of bananas and pudding mix in 8 x 12-inch dish. Repeat with another layer. Let set overnight.

title: Weight Watchers Crab Crostini
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a broiler pan with foil. Pick over the crabmeat to remove any cartilage. In a medium bowl combine the crabmeat bell pepper mayonnaise parsley chives lime juice mustard Parmesan cheese and hot pepper sauce and blend well.

title: Date Cake
instructions: Mix walnuts dates and soda in boiling water. Add to mayonnaise sugar flour cinnamon and chocolate. Bake in an 8 x 8-inch pan for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and microwave for 9 minutes. Add butter and vanilla. Microwave 3 more minutes. Quickly stir in baking soda until becomes foamy. Spread on greased cookie sheet. Let cool.

title: Deviled Ham Twists
instructions: Slice a zucchini longways. Prepare an egg wash egg 1 tablespoon flour salt and pepper. Dip zucchini in egg wash and fry both sides in a pan of oil. Roll up like a jelly roll and put toothpick in. Make a marinade of lemon juice and oil. Drizzle this marinade over the roll-ups.

title: Chocolate Streusel Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In large bowl sift together the flour sugar and cocoa. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add egg; mix well. Reserve 1 1/2 cups. Press remaining mixture on bottom of prepared pan. Bake for 10 minutes.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Cook sausage and ground beef. Drain. Melt cheese stir in taco sauce and soup. Add meat and heat until warmed through.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together all but chips and cheese. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with chips and cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with salad and rolls.

title: Mexican Baked Potato Skins
instructions: Bake potatoes until done. Coat a large nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray. Add margarine. Place over medium-high heat until melted. Add red pepper and green onions; saute until tender. Stir in corn chili powder salt and pepper. Saute until tender. Remove from heat and let cool. Stir in sour cream and cilantro; set aside.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Cook corn bread according to directions. Let cool. Chop vegetables. Mix all together. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Stir in margarine Parmesan cheese and eggs. Form into a crust on sides and bottom of a 10-inch pie pan. Spread cottage cheese over bottom of crust. Brown hamburger onion and green pepper until tender. Drain fat. Stir in tomato sauce tomato paste sugar oregano and garlic salt. Heat through. Pour over cottage cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over top and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Frozen Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Blend first 2 ingredients. Add the rest of the ingredients. Freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour batter into 2 loaf pans or 3 (1 pound) coffee cans which have been well-greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Slide bread out of pans or cans and cool.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with onion and green pepper; drain off fat. Add tomato sauce catsup and pepper; heat. Alternate meat mixture and cheese slices in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Arrange biscuits around edge of casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

title: S-O-O-O-O  Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies!!!
instructions: Mix all ingredients until moistened. Drop by teaspoonfuls (soup spoon) onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients (flour salt and soda). Set aside. Cream well shortening and oleo. Add and cream until fluffy the sugar vanilla and eggs. Add the flour mixture with 2 teaspoons milk. Mix very well. Drop walnut size balls of dough on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes; do not overbake.

title: Eggs Portugal
instructions: Whip milk eggs and dry mustard together. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer bread cubes; layer cheese on top then layer sausage over cheese. Pour egg mixture over all. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Before baking mix soup and broth together and pour over all. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Smoked Beef Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease square pan 9 x 9 x 2-inches. Mix 2 cups bisquick sour cream and water until soft dough forms. Beat 20 strokes. Spread in pan. Bake until golden brown about 25 minutes. Heat margarine in pan until melted. Stir in 1/4 cup Bisquick the onion and seasoning. Heat to boiling stirring constantly; remove from heat. Gradually stir in milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in 1 cup of cheese until melted. Stir in beef peas and corn; heat through. Spread over baked layer; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake until cheese is melted 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately. Yields 9 servings.

title: Strawberry Banana Bread
instructions: Cream oil and sugar. Set aside. Combine soda milk bananas and dry jello. Add this mixture to creamed mixture. Sift flour and baking powder and add to banana mixture. Add nuts if desired. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Mix all this together and roll into long roll then roll in chili powder.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Boil chicken with salt and pepper. Remove bones and skin and dice. Mix all ingredients thoroughly; salt and pepper to taste. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Chocolate Swirl Cheese Pie
instructions: Add sugar to cheese in bowl beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla. Measure 2 cups of cheese mixture; fold in chocolate. Pour remaining cheese mixture into well-buttered 10-inch pie pan or 9-inch square pan. Add spoonfuls of the chocolate-cheese mixture and zigzag a spatula through batter to marble it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes; cool then chill. Cut in wedges. Makes 12 servings.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Chop cabbage onion green pepper and carrots. Mix other ingredients and toss with vegetables; chill.

title: Fabulous Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: In microwave bowl combine chocolate chips with condensed milk and salt. Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes; stir thoroughly. Microwave for another 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in nuts and vanilla. Line an 8 or 9-inch pan with aluminum foil and put contents into pan. Cool to room temperature. Remove foil and cut into squares. Makes about 2 pounds. I do not refrigerate the fudge to cool it. It stays creamy if not refrigerated.

title: Peppered Rib-Eye Steaks
instructions: Brush steaks lightly with oil. Combine garlic powder paprika thyme oregano salt black lemon and red pepper; sprinkle over and press into both sides of steaks. Place in glass baking dish; cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Place steaks on grill over medium-low coals. Cover. Grill 16 to 20 minutes for rare to medium rare turning halfway through cooking time. Transfer steaks to warm serving platter and garnish with orange slices and parsley sprigs. Serve with spinach salad and Italian bread.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix everything together. Pour over chicken wings in baking dish or pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Recipe is for 3 pounds of chicken wings.)

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan and line with wax paper. Beat shortening and sugar well. Add eggs and mix again. Sift dry ingredients and alternate flour and milk. Stir in prunes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

title: Caldo Gallego Soup
instructions: Place ham chorizos and salt pork in water. Cook 30 minutes. Add greens and beans. Saute onion and pepper until transparent in olive oil. Add to greens. Peel and cut potatoes in small cubes. Add to soup. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for 1 hour.

title: Sugar-Free Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a well-greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Stir occasionally the first hour. Or microwave on Low for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Turn dish a quarter turn every 5 minutes. Stir occasionally the first 15 minutes. Serves 9. Diabetic exchange 1 milk and 1/2 fruit. Calories per serving 111.

title: Surprise Beets
instructions: Combine cornstarch and pineapple juice; add 3/4 cup beet juice. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Add rest of ingredients. Makes 8 servings.

title: Coconut Chess Bars
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together. Press into a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan. Pour the remainder of ingredients on first mixture after mixing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Tea Bread
instructions: Sift flour salt soda and cream of tartar together. Beat Crisco until creamy then add sugar gradually. Add eggs and beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with crushed bananas. When well blended pour batter into greased loaf pan 8 x 4 x 3-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Put flour on vegetables. Saute vegetables in butter and cook until tender. Add shrimp; cook until done. Add stewed tomatoes and season to taste. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve on rice.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix together pretzels sugar and melted butter. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Beat together the cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Pour over cooled pretzel mixture. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Pour over mixture.

title: Hidden Valley Party Mix
instructions: Combine mix and oil then add dill weed garlic powder and lemon pepper. Pour over crackers and stir. Put in warm oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Store in airtight container. Use your imagination. Use other kinds of small crackers your favorites.

title: Strawberry Shortcakes
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix Bisquick sugar margarine and milk until soft dough forms. Gently smooth dough into ball on cloth covered board dusted with Bisquick. Knead. Roll dough 1/2-inch thick cut with 3-inch cutter dipped in Bisquick. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown 10 to 12 minutes. Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff. Split shortcakes. Spoon strawberries between halves and on tops. Top with cream.

title: Beef Porcupines
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Roll into balls and brown in oil; pour tomato sauce over balls and add 1 can water. Simmer covered 5 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix together flour salt and sugar. Add eggs cocktail and juice and vanilla. Pour in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Quick Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix 3 tablespoons of butter with granulated sugar. Mix flour baking powder and salt thoroughly. Add to sugar mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Spread batter evenly in a greased 8-inch square greased pan.

title: Beans 'N Turkey
instructions: Cook beans until done. Brown ground turkey. Add tomatoes bouillon onion garlic cumin and chili powder. Mix all together heat through and enjoy.

title: Year Round Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix together cabbage onion pepper and pimento. Set aside. In pan mix honey oil vinegar sugar and salt. Boil hard 1 minute. Pour over slaw. Mix well. Seal in refrigerator for 3 days. Good until it is used up.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Add water to beet liquid to make 2 cups or to cover beets. Heat liquid. Add sugar vinegar and cinnamon. Heat to boiling and pour over beets. Cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Optional - add hard boiled eggs or slices of onion.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil sugar cornstarch and water until thick. Add Jell-O and cool. Pour over fresh strawberries in prepared pie shell (about 2 cups of halved strawberries).

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain both cans of fruit and pineapple; put in bowl. Save 1 cup of juice from pineapple. Cook 1 small box vanilla with 1 cup pineapple juice until its clear. Pour over fruit.

title: The Best Dinner Rolls
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and margarine. Add yeast (dissolved in water). Stir in flour. Cover and let set overnight. Divide dough into six balls; roll out and cut into pie wedges. Roll wedges to center. Let these stand until they double in size (2 to 4 hours). Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Make Ahead Crab Casserole
instructions: Combine crab with cooked noodles olives almonds chopped eggs and sherry. Fold in white sauce and season to taste with salt and pepper. Turn into buttered casserole and sprinkle mixture with cracker crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Spray casserole dish with Pam. Arrange layers of potatoes onions and soup mixture. Add salt pepper and paprika as desired. Dot with butter. Cover bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup flour with fruit. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add dry ingredients and fruit. Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Christmas Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine oil eggs water and pumpkin. Add dry mixture then add cherries and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Special Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat; add onion and cook 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and bake until bubbly at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix the ingredients. Top with Doritos. Make sure ground beef is cool before adding other ingredients.

title: Ice Cream Tortoni
instructions: Mix together almonds butter crushed vanilla wafers and extract. Reserve 1/4 cup mixture for topping. Sprinkle 1/2 of remaining mixture over bottom of a foil-lined 8 x 8-inch pan. Spoon 1/2 of the ice cream over crumbs. Drizzle with 1/2 of the preserves. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Repeat ice cream and preserves layers. Sprinkle with reserved 1/4 cup crumbs. Freeze until ready to serve. Cut into squares. Yield 9 squares.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Almonds
instructions: Bring 1-inch water to boil in large deep skillet. Add sprouts cover and cook over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Melt butter in skillet. Add lemon juice salt almonds and sprouts. Stir over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until sprouts are hot.

title: Bourbon Pecan Pie
instructions: Toss pecans and bourbon until coated; let stand 1 hour until most of the bourbon is absorbed. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix brown sugar and flour; beat in margarine until creamy. Beat in corn syrup eggs and salt; stir in pecan mixture. Pour into pie shell. Cover edge with 1/2-inch aluminum foil strip to prevent excessive browning. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil last 15 minutes.

title: Pork Chops Cacciatore
instructions: In a skillet brown pork chops. Slice pepper and add chopped onion drained mushrooms sauce and spices. Stir and cover. Simmer until pork chops are tender. Serve over wide noodles.

title: My Mother'S Old Fashioned Gingerbread
instructions: Cream together sugar molasses and margarine. Sift the dry ingredients. Start adding dry ingredients to sugar mixture. Add along the hot water and soda. When all is mixed well have eggs beaten and add at the last. Stir in good.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Sift flour and salt together. Cream butter or margarine and sugar; add unbeaten egg. Beat well and add sifted ingredients slowly. Blend well and add vanilla. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes (watch closely they burn easily) or until lightly browned. Let cookies sit for a few minutes before removing to rack.

title: Granola Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixing bowl cream butter granulated sugar brown sugar honey eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Mix in flour baking soda and salt. Stir in rolled oats coconut raisins wheat germ and nuts.

title: Dog Food Casserole
instructions: Season meat with salt and pepper. Spread meat in 9 x 13-inch pan; next spread corn. Pour soup (undiluted) over meat and corn. Top with Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ravioli
instructions: Cook meat onions and peppers. Boil macaroni and drain. Salt and pepper meat. Mix altogether and put in casserole.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Prepare instant pudding according to directions on box and add the sour cream. Break angel food cake in pieces and line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with pudding and sour cream mix Cool Whip and top with cherry pie filling.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Do not overbeat. Drop into hot 350\u00b0 oil and fry until hush puppies float to the top. You may need to turn over several times. Drain and serve hot.

title: Sweet And Sour Wings
instructions: Cut tips and sever wings to joint making two mini drumsticks. Dip wings in egg and then cornstarch to which garlic salt has been added. Brown wings and place in a 10 x 10-inch pan. Cover with sauce made of next 6 ingredients. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt butter. Mix sugar and eggs together; add melted butter. Sift together dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Beat. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Polish Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Saute onions in oleo then add to meat rice salt and pepper. Mix well. Core cabbage then boil head in water for 10 minutes. Drain and separate leaves. Place a large tablespoon of meat mixture in each leaf and roll up tucking in ends. Place rolls and bay leaf in baking dish. Mix soup with 1/2 can of water and 1 teaspoon sugar then pour over rolls. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 90 minutes. Check periodically and add more water if needed.

title: Skillet Chicken Salad
instructions: In 10-inch skillet melt butter until sizzling. Stir in chicken salt and pepper. Cook over medium-high heat stirring occasionally until chicken is browned and fork-tender (10 to 15 minutes). Stir in remaining ingredients except lettuce leaves and cherry tomatoes. On platter or individual salad plates place lettuce leaves. Place chicken salad on lettuce. Arrange cherry tomatoes around salad.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix butter brown sugar and flour to make the crumbs for the topping. Mix table syrup egg baking soda in boiling water. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Start baking at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into large chunks. Place in a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Pour butter over and toss until well coated. Sprinkle with paprika salt and pepper. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: German Potato Dumplings
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft enough to mash. Add other ingredients and mix well. Shape into balls. Roll lightly into flour and cook in rapidly boiling water for 15 minutes.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain well. Stir in eggs milk bread pieces salt mustard and cheese. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Must be mixed the night before and refrigerated.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Spread the fruit pie filling evenly in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Spread the dry cake mix evenly over the pie filling. Pour the melted margarine over the dry cake mix. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Enjoy!

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut up and steam cabbage in salt water until crisp; drain. Butter a casserole bottom and layer with cabbage. Nest cover cabbage with sour cream then a layer of shredded cheese then soda crackers. Continue to layer in this order until soda crackers are on top layer. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Mocha Sauce
instructions: In small saucepan over low heat melt butter. Stir in sugar whipping cream and cocoa. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in instant coffee and vanilla. Serve warm or cool. Cover. Refrigerate leftover sauce. Yields 2 cups sauce.

title: Chocolate Raspberry Brownies
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Melt butter and chocolate in a heavy large saucepan over low heat stirring constantly until smooth. Remove from heat. Whisk in sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix flour baking powder and salt in small bowl; add to chocolate mixture and whisk to blend. Stir in nuts. Pour 2 cups batter into pan. Freeze until firm about 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Meringue Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Beat egg whites cream of tartar and salt at high speed of mixer until soft peaks form. Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form. Sift cocoa over egg white mixture; fold in. Fold in mini-chips. Cover a baking sheet with parchment paper. Drop batter by level tablespoonfuls onto prepared baking sheet. Bake for 40 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Store in an airtight container.

title: Bread I
instructions: Make as any other bread. (Let rise work down etc.) Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tarragon Potatoes
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler peel away just enough skin from the circumference of each potato to form a stripe. Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Over high heat bring potatoes to a rolling boil. Reduce heat to medium; partially cover and cook potatoes 25 minutes or until tender. Drain potatoes. Meanwhile in a large bowl combine butter minced shallots minced fresh tarragon salt and ground black pepper to make a paste. Add warm potatoes to bowl. Toss ingredients gently until seasonings are evenly distributed. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix thoroughly and chill in ball. Roll in nuts.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; add pineapple and blueberries; congeal.

title: Old-Fashion Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift flour. Add sugar eggs shortening and vanilla. Work up like biscuit dough using milk as needed. Roll out and cut with shaped cutters. You can add nuts coconut or candied fruit if desired. Bake slowly at 350\u00b0. The thinner you flatten the crispier they are.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in greased tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar cocoa and salt. Melt butter; beat eggs. Add flour mixture to eggs and butter. Add milk and vanilla; beat good. Add coconut and pecans; stir well. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm.

title: Laura'S Homemade Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Stir flour with baking soda and salt set aside. In large bowl beat butter with sugar and brown sugar at medium speed until creamy and lightened in color. About 4 minutes. Add vanilla and eggs one at a time mix on low speed until incorporated. Gradually blend dry mixture into creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop by tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and dry pudding mix. Stir well. Add undrained pineapple marshmallows and nuts. Mix thoroughly. Pour into a serving dish and place in refrigerator for two hours.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Combine eggs butter raisins nuts coconut sugar and vinegar in a mixing bowl. Pour into a 9-inch pie crust and bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Mix together chocolate chips and butterscotch chips and melt. Pour melted chips over chow mein noodles and peanuts. Quickly form mound with fingers. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Pork Chop Dinner
instructions: Brown chops and place in baking dish. Top with chop with a slice of tomato and ring of bell pepper. Fill pepper ring with rice. Mix mushroom soup with 2 to 2 1/2 cans of water; pour over chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wholesome Banana Bread
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl; stir well and set aside. Combine sugar and oil in a medium bowl. Beat with mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes. Add egg and beat until light and lemon colored. With mixer running at low speed add flour mixture alternately with bananas beginning and ending with flour mixture. Blend well after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Pour batter into 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle with wheat germ on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cake tester is clean. Cool 15 minutes. Remove from pan; let cool completely before slicing.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Add margarine or butter to boiling water and stir over medium heat until margarine melts and water comes to a second boil. Combine flour and salt; add to water-margarine mixture all at once. Stir vigorously until mixture leaves sides of pan. Remove from heat and add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Drop mixture by teaspoons onto cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until light brown. Remove from cookie sheet and stuff with whipped cream pudding or custard.

title: Holiday Stuffed Turkey
instructions: To prepare stuffing In one quart saucepan over medium heat cook mushrooms and onion with savory and nutmeg in hot butter until tender. Remove from heat. Add broccoli stuffing rice and broth. Toss to mix well.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Chop cabbage and place in greased baking dish. Brown meat and onion. Stir in rice. Pour on top of cabbage. Mix soup and water and pour over other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Add more water if casserole is too dry.

title: Swiss Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Chicken Fettucini
instructions: Cook noodles until almost done; cut chicken into 1-inch cubes and saute in 1/8 cup oil with garlic mushrooms onions and salt and pepper to taste. When onions are tender and chicken has no pink add a jar of sauce and noodles. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Place in a Dutch oven (ovenproof) or very large covered ovenproof dish. Cover with slices of cheese until top is completely covered. Bake for 30 minutes covered and 30 minutes uncovered at 375\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Jiffy Brownies
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well and pour into greased and lightly floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut while still hot.

title: Angel Punch
instructions: Blend strawberries lemonade and ice cream in blender. Place in punch bowl. Pour ginger ale over blended ingredients and mix. Makes 25 small cups.

title: Marie'S Russian Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Store in airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over \very warm\ water. Stir to dissolve yeast. Stir flour and salt together. Add yeast mixture and oil. Stir until rough dough forms. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic (about 5 to 7 minutes). Shape into ball and place in greased bowl; turn to coat. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled about 45 minutes. Spread in 16-inch pan. Add toppings. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Tomato And Green Pepper Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in glass or plastic bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Melt butter; saute onion until clear. Add soup mushrooms with liquid and cheese (cut into chunks). Cook over low heat until cheese melts and all is heated. Add well drained cooked broccoli. Serve hot in chafing dish with Fritos and Wheat Thins.

title: Caramel Clusters
instructions: Stir butter or margarine caramels and milk over low heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Add chopped nuts coconut and corn flakes. Mix well. Drop by spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Pat crescent rolls down in pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Mix and spread cream cheese mayonnaise sour cream and Ranch mix. Top with diced veggies red pepper green pepper onions broccoli carrots or your favorite.

title: Stuffed French Bread(Prep Time:  15 Minutes)
instructions: Slice the bread lengthwise and remove inside dough. Combine all remaining ingredients and mix well. Fill the hollowed bread with the mixture. Re-assemble the loaf. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 3 hours or until ready to serve. Slice the loaf in 1-inch sections and serve. Serves 12.

title: Danny'S Chili
instructions: Cook ground beef with green pepper and onion. Add chili block and mix together in large pan. Add water. Add chili with beans and canned tomatoes. Cook slowly for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Let cream cheese reach room temperature. (May use microwave.) Mix lime jello (dry) with cream cheese. Add 1 cup boiling water; dissolve cheese mix completely. Add pineapple and pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Sugar Cream Pie
instructions: Cook sugar cornstarch and milk in double boiler until thick. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Stir until well blended; pour into pie crust. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Corn Curry
instructions: Combine margarine vegetables and curry powder in a skillet. Cook over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in sour cream and pepper. Heat thoroughly stirring often; do not allow to boil. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken With Plums
instructions: Skin chicken. Coat with flour. Brown chicken in a skillet. Place in a baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over the chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and graham crackers; add melted butter. Mix well. Pat on sides and in bottoms of deep dish pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Cool.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and boil 1 1/2 minutes. Add next 4 ingredients and mix well. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Shape ham loaf into balls. Bake for 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven. Baste with the mixture of pineapple brown sugar vinegar and mustard. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Hobo Stew
instructions: Mix all and heat. Eat with crumbled Doritos.

title: Chicken Breasts With Angel Hair Pasta
instructions: In small bowl whisk together salad dressing and mustard; set aside. In medium skillet saute chicken in butter until browned; transfer to dish. Keep warm. Pour wine into skillet; cook over medium-high heat scraping up any browned bits from bottom of skillet about 5 minutes. Whisk in dressing mixture; blend well. Serve chicken with sauce over pasta; sprinkle with parsley.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cut fruit and nuts into pieces (half cherry size); coat with flour and set aside. Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside. Cream softened butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and extracts. Beat until light and fluffy. Add sifted flour and egg whites; mix well. Pour over floured fruit and nuts and mix until all of fruit mixture is well covered. Spoon into well-greased and floured Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Put a pan of water on rack below cake for last hour of baking time.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Melt cream cheese and margarine over low heat. Add soup and onion; stir until smooth. Mix with potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: English Toffee
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Mix cocoa in well. Add beaten egg yolks. Fold in beaten egg whites and add nuts. Butter pan and spread layer of vanilla wafer crumbs on bottom. Pour in half of mixture by spoonfuls so it can be spread evenly over crumbs; add another layer of crumbs. Add rest of mixture and sprinkle top with remainder of crumbs. Let set in refrigerator 24 hours. Serve with whipped cream on top.

title: Savory Rice Pilaf
instructions: In 2-quart pan combine the rice and oil. Stir over medium heat until rice is golden brown (5 minutes). Add stock apple juice onion garlic lemon juice and thyme. Reduce heat to low; cover pan and simmer until all liquid has been absorbed and rice is tender about 20 minutes. Fluff with fork before serving. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Eclairs
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Add butter to water; bring to rolling boil. Stir in flour vigorously over low heat. Beat 1 minute until mixture forms a ball. Beat in eggs one at a time until smooth. Drop 1/4 cup of the mixture onto ungreased cookie sheet spacing 3 inches apart. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven; keep away from drafts. Allow to cool.

title: Carrot-Stuffed Patty Pan Squash
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blanch the squash whole in boiling water for 5 to 8 minutes or until tender. Drain and plunge into cold water to stop the cooking. Drain again. Cut off the stem end of squash scoop out a small amount of pulp and discard. Melt the butter in large saute pan and saute the onion for 2 minutes. Add parsley carrots garlic and water. Cook stirring constantly until water evaporates. Add the herbs cream cheese and lemon juice. Heat until cheese melts. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spoon the filling into the squash on a baking sheet and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through. Yield 6 servings.

title: Potato Cheese Casserole
instructions: Peel dice and cook potatoes for 8 minutes. Cut cheese into small chunks. Mix together all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place oleo in baking dish and place in oven to melt. Put blueberries and 1 cup sugar in saucepan; bring to a boil. In meantime mix remaining 1 cup sugar flour and milk together. Pour this mixture over melted butter. Do not stir! Pour hot berries over flour mixture. Do not stir! Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown.

title: Mrs. Dash Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Spread with mayonnaise and sprinkle with Mrs. Dash seasoning. Place chicken in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Crab Soup
instructions: Simmer vegetables in chicken broth 30 minutes. Add tomato paste and seasoning. Simmer 10 minutes. Remove cartilage and shell from crabmeat. Stir in soup. Heat and serve.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: Wash and drain chicken and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together the cranberry sauce dressing and onion soup and pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Baste during baking time. Serve with rice.

title: Fig Squares
instructions: Bake in 9-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cover with powdered sugar.

title: Roast Beef
instructions: Bake meat water and beef cubes for 4 hours at 300\u00b0. Add vegetables and cook 3 more hours at 250\u00b0. Meat is very tender and delicious.

title: Ambrosia Bowl
instructions: Peel oranges; remove white membrane. Cut oranges crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Drain pineapple saving syrup. Combine syrup and Cointreau; set aside. Peel bananas. Cut diagonally into 1/8 inch thick slices. In attractive serving bowl layer half the orange slices; sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar. Layer half the banana slices and half the pineapple chunks. Sprinkle with half the coconut. Repeat layers of fruit and sugar. Pour syrup mixture over fruit; sprinkle with remaining coconut. Decorate with maraschino cherries. Refrigerate several hours until well chilled. Makes 10 servings.

title: Zucchini With Cheese
instructions: Cut bacon and fry until brown. Add sliced zucchini and onion. Add enough water to cover zucchini. Add tomato sauce and cook until zucchini is tender. Just before serving lay cheese over vegetables and cover until melted and serve.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Whip eggs; add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish with Pam. Arrange potatoes and add onions. Crumble bacon. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with sliced butter salt and pepper. Cover foil and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done at 350\u00b0.

title: Mountain Rum Butter
instructions: Mix ingredients with even consistency. Let cool. Dust top decoratively with powdered sugar. Serve with plum pudding mince meat pies or brown bread.

title: Scotch Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs. Set aside. Peel. Divide sausage roll into 4 pieces. Roll out 1 sausage piece on floured board. Place egg in center of sausage meat and mold to egg until egg is encased in sausage meat. Brush sausage egg with egg wash and roll in bread crumbs. Deep-fry sausage egg rolls in hot oil until deep brown in color.

title: Salmon Casserole
instructions: Saute onions green peppers celery and mushrooms in melted butter until lightly browned. Add flour salt and pepper and mix well. Gradually stir in evaporated milk then water and cook until smooth and thickened stirring constantly. Arrange layers of salmon peas white sauce and potato chips in buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with layer of potato chips and dot with butter. Cover and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer or until top is brown.

title: Chinese Style Fried Rice
instructions: In a small saucepan bring 1 1/4 c water to a boil. Stir in rice and remove from heat. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile using a 10 in skillet cook egg (slightly beaten) in 3 Tbsp butter. Add 1/3 c chopped onion and the rice. Saute stirring over medium heat until mixture slightly browned. Mix 1/4 c water with 2 to 3 Tbsp soy sauce and stir into the rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake with mix. Crumble one of the layers in the bottom of a punch bowl. Mix pudding; when set spread it over the cake. Drain pineapple and spread over pudding. Spread pie filling over pineapple. Spread Cool Whip over this. Sprinkle chopped pecans over this and repeat the layers again.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream oleo Crisco sugar and salt. Add egg yolks and add soda to buttermilk. Add flour and milk alternating. Add vanilla pecans and coconut. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter. Bake in 3 layers at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler over hot water. Add corn syrup and rum. Combine crushed vanilla wafer crumbs powdered sugar and chopped pecans. Add to the chocolate mix and mix well. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes. Make 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place in tight container to \ripen\ for 3 to 4 days. Be sure to keep tightly covered.

title: Family Favorite Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa flour sugar and salt. Gradually add egg yolks and milk. Cook and stir constantly over medium heat until thickened. Filling will be slightly lumpy. Add vanilla and butter and beat with an electric mixer until smooth. Cool until lukewarm and pour into a baked pie shell. If you choose you may top with meringue and bake until brown or you may chill the pie and top with whipped cream.

title: Dijon Chicken With Double Cheese Bake(Can Do The Day Before And Just Bake The Day Of The Brunch!)
instructions: In greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan place bread. Layer with chicken mushrooms and cheeses. Meanwhile in large bowl whisk remaining ingredients. Pour over layered chicken mixture. Cover; refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Uncover; bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until set in center. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dumplins
instructions: Bring 1st 2 sugars and water to boil reduce heat - simmer 5 minutes. Stir in vanilla and pour over berries in a casserole dish. Combine other ingredients as making biscuits drop over berries. Sprinkle with 1 Tbsp. sugar. Bake @ 450 for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Bring everything except corn and baking soda to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Add baking soda; blend and pour over corn. Mix well. Spread lightly on 2 large cookie sheets. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles according to package. Fry onion oregano and hamburger. Pour off grease. Add sauce and paste to hamburger. Layer bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with cooked noodles. Sprinkle with cheeses and hamburger mix. Beginning with noodles repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes (until bubbly).

title: Brownies
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl and stir until blended. Turn into a slightly greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut into 16 (2-inch) squares while warm. Yield 16 (2-inch) squares.

title: Fried Potato Cakes
instructions: Combine potatoes flour egg milk and onion in bowl; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil in skillet. Brown on both sides pressing with spatula to flatten. Yields 12 cakes.

title: Dannon Fat-Free Muffins
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Gently stir in yogurt and milk blending just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fill lightly greased or paper lined muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes or until browned. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Ginger Molasses Cookies
instructions: Combine flour ginger cinnamon baking soda and salt. With an electric mixer set at medium low speed beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and molasses. Reduce speed to low and gradually beat in flour mixture until just incorporated. Chill until firm about 1 hour. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar and place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until edges just start to brown about 15 minutes. Cool on cookie sheet 2 minutes before removing to racks. Cool completely. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Almond Raisin Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add 2 beaten egg yolks. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add raisins. Mix together adding 1 cup milk and the extracts. Fold in 2 egg whites stiffly beaten. Bake in tube pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Drunken Dogs
instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer with hot dogs (regular) cut up for one hour.

title: Baked Chicken(Low Cholesterol)
instructions: Remove skin from chicken. Dip into margarine then roll in cracker crumbs. Place in a pan at 350\u00b0 for an hour or until done. Serves 4.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients with nuts. Add bananas. Pour into well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Simmer chicken in salt and water for 20 minutes. Shred breasts. In skillet melt margarine sour cream Ro-Tel soup onion and half of cheese. Dip tortillas in mixture until one side is covered. Stuff with chicken onion olives and more cheese. Fold and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour leftover mixture over stuffed tortillas. Add remainder of cheese over top. Bake uncovered 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ethel'S Dish
instructions: Mix pineapple fruit cocktail and pudding in a bowl. Add marshmallows; mix well then fold in Cool Whip.

title: Quick Pumpkin Pudding
instructions: Beat pudding and milk in large bowl. Refrigerate for 5 minutes. Then add pumpkin and pumpkin pie spice. Mix well. Spoon into dessert dishes. Refrigerate at 10 minutes. Top with whipped cream. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sparerib Combination
instructions: Cut ribs in serving pieces. Season with salt and pepper. Bake in oven until almost done. Remove from oven; add onions. Pour sauce and tomato sauce over ribs; add potatoes. Cook at 350\u00b0 in oven until done completely.

title: Blender Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: In a blender combine all ingredients (except coconut) and blend for\t3 minutes. Spray a large pie plate with Pam. Pour mixture into plate and allow to set. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Do not preheat oven.

title: Mary'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together the first 2 ingredients. Mix in the egg vanilla and almond. Mix together the flour soda and cream of tartar add to creamed mixture. Refrigerate 2-3 hours. Heat oven to 375. Roll dough out and cut into shapes. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet for 7-8 minutes. These are my favorite sugar cookies.

title: Sopa De Piscado(Fish Soup)
instructions: Heat oil and saute onion garlic celery cilantro and green chile. When vegetables are clear add fish and stir-fry with vegetables. Add 1/2 glass of water or enough to make soupy. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. This soup is quick and hearty but very spicy.

title: Parmesan Bread
instructions: Brush 1 side of each slice of French bread with melted margarine or butter. Sprinkle buttered sides of bread with Italian seasoning then with Parmesan cheese. Place bread slices cheese side up on the unheated rack of a broiler pan. Broil 4 to 5 inches from the heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese is golden and bubbly. Makes 8 slices.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain green beans and place in casserole dish. Sprinkle with black pepper garlic salt and a few dots of butter. Add mushroom soup and place French onion rings on top. Cover with foil. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Kentucky Pie
instructions: Spread chocolate chips in bottom of pie shell. Stir together butter sugar and flour. Beat in eggs one at a time and pour over chips. Add pecans pushing them down in the filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Can add a tablespoon of bourbon if desired.

title: Cheese Buds
instructions: With mixer blend cheese and butter. Sift flour and pepper. Gradually work into cream mixture with spoon. Roll out 1/2-inch thick. Cut into 1-inch rounds. Brush with egg white; top with pecans. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in hot oven preheated to 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Fill greased pie plate with apples. Sprinkle apples with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Combine remaining ingredients in mixing bowl and pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook grits in water with salt for 3 minutes. Add margarine and cheese and then eggs. Mix well and pour into a greased baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with Parmesan cheese and paprika. Let sit for a few minutes and cut into servings or spoon out. Serves 6 to 7 people.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together. Stir in whipping cream then rhubarb. Pour into crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Spread topping on and bake 15 minutes more at 400\u00b0.

title: Fruit Nut Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs 1 at a time. Add flour and milk 1/2 at a time then add remaining ingredients and mix well. Prepare Bundt pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. When cool ice with your favorite chocolate frosting.

title: Barbecue Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix all together; cook 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Crazy Cake
