instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients together into a well-greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Make 3 indentations in mixture. In one put 1 teaspoon vinegar. Put vanilla in the second and in the third put oil. Over all pour 1 cup cold water and stir until blended. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Cowpoke Beans
instructions: Wash and pick over beans; put in mixing bowl. Cover beans with cold water and soak overnight. Next morning put beans and water into Dutch oven and bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and simmer 3 hours or until tender. Add more water if necessary. Serves 8.

title: Party Ham Rolls
instructions: Melt butter; add mustard poppy seed and onion. Slice each roll with electric knife. Remove top and spread both sides with butter mixture. Combine ham and cheese and place on roll bottoms then cover with tops. Bake in roll foil container for 10 to 15 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. May be frozen and reheated.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and eggs. Add oil; mix. Sift together flour soda salt cinnamon nutmeg and allspice; add to egg mixture gradually. Fold in apples nuts and dates. Bake approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 (depending on your oven). Cook in tube pan; good with whipped cream.

title: Tangy Grilled Beef
instructions: Mix soup sugar lemon juice oil Worcestershire garlic powder & thyme. Place steak on lightly oiled grill rack over medium- hot coals. Grill uncovered to desired doneness (allow 15 minutes for medium) turning once & brushing often with soup mixture. Heat remaining soup mixture to a boil & serve with steak.

title: Pizzelle(Italian Waffles)
instructions: These are made with electric pizzelle iron.

title: Christmas Date Balls
instructions: Blend in saucepan and cook over medium heat the first 4 ingredients . Stir constantly. Cook for 10 minutes or until mixture is well away from sides of pan. Remove from heat and add the Rice Krispies pecans and vanilla. Make into balls and roll in coconut or chopped nuts.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except butter. Cook until thick; take off stove. Add butter and stir until smooth. Pour in pie shell. Beat egg whites. Add 6 tablespoons two at a time. Put on pie and brown.

title: White Bread
instructions: This makes 4 loaves. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Dissolve yeast and 2 teaspoons sugar in warm water. Set aside for 10 minutes. Mix hot water shortening salt and sugar in large mixer bowl; add milk. Add 2 cups flour to make sure the mixture is cool enough to add the yeast. Add enough flour to make a soft dough. Knead a few minutes. Let rise twice then work out in loaves. Let rise and bake.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger meat; drain. Mix meat with spaghetti sauce; cook until hot. Pour into casserole dish. Layer with sour cream then Cheddar cheese. Put rolls on top and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Easter Bunny Salad
instructions: Put a lettuce leaf on a plate. Put a peeled pear half upside-down on the leaf. Add 2 cloves for eyes and 2 almond halves for ears. Add 1 teaspoon cottage cheese for a tail.

title: Mom'S Potato Wedges
instructions: Scrub unpeeled potatoes well. Cut each potato in half lengthwise. Then cut into even wedges. Boil potato wedges for 5 minutes in salted water; drain and pat dry. Spread wedges in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet. Brush with oil; sprinkle on spices and herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for another 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown and cheeses are melted. Serve as snack or with any meat dish.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Place the jello pudding mix and water in a large saucepan and stir. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat stirring constantly. Mixture will become thickened and transparent. Chill just until set about 4 hours. Beat in the Cool Whip and stir in the mandarin oranges.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger first. Let cool then combine all and toss with dressing.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a pan. Add oil water and food coloring. Stir until smooth. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. When it sticks together in a ball and seems cooked through turn out onto a table and knead at once for at least 5 minutes. Store in a tight container. Do not refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. Mix soup cheese mayonnaise and onion flakes. Blend in eggs. Toss lightly with drained broccoli.

title: Quick And Easy Bucket Cake
instructions: You will also need a 1 gallon clear plastic bucket.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Place shrimp in a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with seasoning and lemon juice. Dot with butter. Broil on one side for 3 minutes; turn and broil for 3 minutes more. Serve with toast or garlic bread.

title: Pineapple Fluff
instructions: Mix sugar with cornstarch and add to egg. When well mixed add 1/2 cup of liquid from pineapple and cook (low heat) over hot water until thickened. Remove from heat and add 1 cup of crushed pineapple and set aside to chill then add 1/3 cup heavy cream and vanilla. Serve in sherbet glasses.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter. Add cereal and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Meltaway Cookies
instructions: Mix the cornstarch powdered sugar and flour. Cut in the oleo. To make a soft dough add almond and/or vanilla. Shape in small balls; roll in sugar. Place on baking sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass or cookie stamps. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chewy Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in saucepan. Remove from stove. Add rest of the ingredients. Stir until well blended. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Orangy Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and remaining ingredients. Mix until well blended. Chill. Serve over fruit compotes or fruit kabobs.

title: Yummy Fudge
instructions: Place butter in pan heat until melted. Add sugar and cream; blend well. Cook 8 to 10 minutes until soft ball stage. Add semi-sweet morsels marshmallow cream vanilla and nuts. Pour in buttered pan. Mix well and chill.

title: Chicken Chutney Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Stir well. Combine remaining ingredients and toss with dressing. Chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Mix with sugar Cool Whip and peanut butter. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate; let cool for 2 or 3 hours before serving. (You may use a baked crust if you wish.)

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Boil zucchini until clear. Do not add water. Add sugar lemon juice and pineapple. Boil for 6 minutes and remove from heat. Add peach and apricot jellos. Stir until dissolved. Put into hot jars and seal.

title: Ambrosia Mold
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Add enough water to measure 1 cup. Stir boiling water into Jell-O in large bowl until dissolved. Stir in measured liquid. Refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours until slightly thickened. Stir in whipped topping with wire whisk until smooth. Refrigerate 10 minutes until mixture will mound. Stir in pineapple oranges marshmallows and coconut. Spoon into 6 cup mold. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Orange Sponge Cake
instructions: Combine flour and 1/3 cup sugar; set aside. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored (about 3 to 5 minutes). Add orange peel and juice; beat until very thick. Gradually add 2/3 cup sugar and salt beating constantly. Sift flour mixture over egg yolk mixture a little at a time folding just until blended. Wash beaters. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating until stiff peaks form. Thoroughly fold yolk mixture into whites. Bake in ungreased 10-inch tube pan at 325\u00b0 for about 55 minutes. Invert cake in pan to cool.

title: Skillet Spanish Rice
instructions: Add onion rice and beef. Stir over high heat until lightly browned. Add tomato sauce and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and simmer 25 minutes.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Put beef in 9 x 9-inch pan fat side down. Add seasonings to taste cover with foil. Bake at 275\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Test; cook longer if needed.

title: Three In One Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Refrigerate. Serve cold or hot with tortilla chips or vegetable dippers.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix together. Grease loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown and has hollow sound when thumped.

title: Hominy Ole
instructions: Brown bacon and onion; add hominy. Saute a few minutes. Drain off excess grease. Blend in tomatoes taco seasoning mix cheese and Tabasco sauce. Heat thoroughly stirring until cheese melts. Serves 6.

title: Roasted Red Pepper And Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and dressing mix and spread on tray or plate. Layer red peppers over this then artichokes over peppers. Chill and serve.

title: Toffee
instructions: Combine ingredients in a small heavy saucepan. Boil up stirring constantly. Boil up several times until mixture nearly burns. Immediately pour into molds i.e. ice cube trays or candy/lollipop molds. Soak the empty saucepan in hot soapy water. Pick the hardened toffee out of the molds (around edges) and cool. Add flavors/spices orange/tangerine pulp half margarine/half peanut butter etc. If liquified boil over extra or youll get caramel instead of hard candy.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish alternate macaroni in 2 layers with 2 cups of cheese in layers; set aside. Prepare sauce by melting butter in medium saucepan; remove from heat. Blend in flour; gradually stir in milk then seasonings. Pour sauce over macaroni. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is melted and brown.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Cream the cream cheese; stir in remaining ingredients except green onions. Mix well. Stir in green onions. Serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Icing For Cakes
instructions: Put 1/2 box sugar in bowl. Add water and shortening. Blend on slow. Add vanilla salt and rest of sugar. Blend until smooth. This recipe will frost a 9 x 13-inch cake sides and top.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Place the ground beef in the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch square baking dish. Mix the undiluted soups together and place over ground beef. Place Tater Tots over this mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly approximately 30 minutes.

title: Diet Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 7-Up. Stir until dissolved. Add 7-Up just before serving. Yields about 50 servings.

title: Simply Pot Roast
instructions: In Dutch oven brown roast on medium heat. Add onion soup mix blended with water. Simmer covered turning occasionally 2 1/2 hours or until tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk cocoa and margarine for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Stir in oats and peanut butter. Drop with spoon on wax paper.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Place butter in 9-inch round (8-inch square) baking dish. Microwave on full power for 30 seconds or until melted. Stir in brown sugar and spread evenly in dish. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Arrange pineapple slices over sugar-butter mixture. Place cherry in center of each pineapple. Sprinkle nuts over pineapple slices. Prepare cake mix according to package directions using juice for liquid. Pour batter over pineapple slices. Microwave at 30% power for 7 minutes rotate pan. Microwave at full power for 3 to 4 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 1 minute on flat surface. Turn out onto platter and serve warm or cool.

title: Oriental Ribs
instructions: Put ribs in crock-pot. Mix all other ingredients together and puree in blender. Pour sauce over ribs and cook until done. Remove ribs and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour sauce over this and cook at 400\u00b0 until brown. Baste often with sauce from the pan.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream together Crisco and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour 1 cup at a time. Refrigerate for a while. Put on wax paper and roll out. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Captain'S Casserole
instructions: Heat first 3 ingredients in saucepan until cheese is melted. Combine rice oregano and pepper in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Drain tomatoes reserving 1/2 cup juice. Stir into rice with 1 cup water. Slice tomatoes; reserve several for garnish. Arrange tomatoes over rice. Add onion tuna and olives. Pour sauce over top. Sprinkle with chips. Arrange tomatoes on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg and water together. Mix bread crumbs cheese and onions together. Roll chicken in flour dip in egg wash and then roll in bread crumb mixture. Place on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Bake 30 minutes. Top with sliced cheese (turn chicken after 20 minutes). Bake until cheese is melted slightly.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix together all ingredients (except chips and nuts) at lowest speed. Then beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Pour into pan; sprinkle on toppings of chips and nuts and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pizza Rice Salad
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on package. Cool; lightly toss rice with remaining ingredients in large bowl using 1/2 cup dressing. Chill. Just before serving toss with remaining dressing. Makes 6 servings.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Pat crescent rolls on pizza pan (put points to center). Pat together good. Brown sausage and drain. Spread over rolls. Fry hash browns in sausage pan just until thawed. Sprinkle over sausage on crescent rolls. Sprinkle onion green pepper and cheese over potatoes. Beat eggs salt pepper and Parmesan cheese; pour over the ingredients in pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Mix all together and spoon in muffin tin about half full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 6.

title: Orange Loaf Cake
instructions: Sift together into bowl the cake flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add shortening and orange juice. Beat 2 minutes and add eggs beating after each one. Bake in loaf pan 60 to 65 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Company Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on package. Brown ground beef and onion; drain fat. Add ground beef to rice then add soy sauce mushrooms and soups. Mix well and place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish; bake 1 hour. May top with buttered bread crumbs or 1/2 cup slivered almonds. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Caramel Candy
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan combine sugar 1 cup half and half syrup and butter. Cook over medium heat until it comes to a rolling boil (7 to 8 minutes). Add remaining half and half until 245\u00b0 on candy thermometer or dropped in ice water forms a ball (35 or 40 minutes). Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan. Cover and refrigerate. Cut into squares. Melt chocolate; place 1 or 1 1/2 teaspoons of chocolate on each square. Place pecans onto chocolate and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Put chocolate in saucepan. Cover with 2 inches very hot tap water. Cover. Let stand 5 minutes or until chocolate is soft enough to stick toothpick through. When chocolate is soft but not dissolved drain water. Do not worry that some water clings. Add yolks. Stir with whisk and cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add butter salt and vanilla. Mix well and cool. Beat egg whites; gradually add sugar. Beat until stiff. Mix into chocolate. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Chip-Oatmeal-Walnut Brownies(A Cross Between Oatmeal Cookies And Brownies.)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of 13 x 9-inch rectangular pan. Prepare fudge-like brownies as directed except stir chocolate chips and oats into batter. Spread in pan. Bake 25 to 27 minutes. Cool completely for easier cutting. Store tightly covered.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Place sugar and cinnamon into a plastic bowl with a lid. Shake until mixed thoroughly. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Put one can of biscuits at a time into plastic bowl. Cover mixture. Take biscuits out and place into a greased Bundt pan. Repeat with remaining 2 cans biscuits. Melt 1 stick butter and mix with remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture. Pour over biscuit pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Invert on a plate and allow butter to drizzle over cooked bread.

title: Scalloped Eggplant Italian
instructions: Dip eggplant into beaten egg then into crumbs. Brown in hot oil. Place 1/4 of the eggplant slices in the bottom of a 2-quart casserole and top with 1/4 of the cheese slices. Combine the tomato sauce with the remaining ingredients and spoon 1/4 of the sauce over the eggplant and cheese. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used ending with sauce. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in a dish slightly buttered for 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar and butter until fluffy. Blend in water egg and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients. Mix well. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spoon out on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 14 minutes or until edges are golden brown.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: In a 2-quart microwavable dish melt margarine. Add brown sugar salt and corn syrup. Bring to a boil in microwave and boil on full power for 2 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir in soda. Stir well. Spray paper grocery bag with cooking spray. Pour in popcorn and pour syrup over popcorn. Close bag and shake. Microwave in bag on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Shake again and microwave for another 1 1/2 minutes; cool. Stir while cooling in large bowl. Serves many.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt together in saucepan butter and cocoa. Remove from heat. Mix in remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake exactly 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Snack Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet with spray Mazola. Place biscuits on cookie sheet. Flatten each biscuit with the bottom of a glass leaving a rim. Dip glass in flour to prevent sticking starting from the center of each biscuit. Use your fingers to push out dough to make it bigger.

title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole
instructions: In greased casserole layer bread pieces in large casserole dish. Add the sausage and cheese; add milk mustard and salt and pour over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Velvety Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook artichoke hearts according to package directions. Cook mushrooms in margarine until tender. Combine chicken mushrooms and artichokes and place in buttered flat casserole. Prepare gravy mix according to directions. Remove from heat; add margarine and cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Stir in wine and pour over chicken mixture. Combine melted margarine with crumbs and sprinkle over all. Bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender. Let cool and cut into bite size pieces and place in 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix soups and sour cream and pour over chicken. Top with Ritz crackers and pats of butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Creamy Shells With Ham And Broccoli
instructions: Cook shells; drain. Saute garlic in butter then add ham and broccoli. Cook until broccoli is crisp-tender approximately 5 minutes. Stir in cream. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. Stir in cheese. Lower heat and cook until cheese is melted. Toss with shells. Serves 6.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together except about half of the catsup. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Pour remaining catsup over the top and bake 20 to 30 minutes longer.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients then fold in Cool Whip. Chill several hours.

title: Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening vanilla and sugar together until light and fluffy. Continue creaming while adding eggs slowly. Sift flour baking powder and salt together and add alternately with milk to creamed mixture. Drop small portions on greased cookie sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Grape-Nuts Pudding
instructions: Scald milk. Add sugar and eggs. Mix well. Cook Grape-nuts in water until soft and mixture is thick (5 to 6 minutes). Add to milk mixture. Add butter and vanilla. Stir. Pour into buttered baking dish. Set in pan of water. Bake until custard sets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix baking powder salt soda and sugar together. Cut in shortening. Add buttermilk and yeast. Knead lightly; do not let rise. Shape and bake immediately at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and add soup tomatoes beans and American cheese. Line casserole dish with slightly crushed Doritos chips. Pour meat mixture over chips. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and cheese is melted. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Fry chicken coated with flour. Sprinkle salt and pepper on chicken. Cook until golden brown. Mix rice onions peppers and soup. Stir well. Put in large casserole. Stack chicken on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until all ingredients are cooked tender.

title: Hamburger Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain grease. Line the bottom of a casserole dish with Tater Tots. Spoon meat and onion mixture on top. Mix soups together and spread on top of meat. Cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Let melt. Serve hot. Serve with a green vegetable and your meal is complete.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Pack beets in hot jars filling within 1/2-inch to top. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to each jar. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil. Pour over beets and seal. Process in hot water bath 1/2 hour. Best if you wait 2 to 3 weeks before eating. This makes 2 quarts. Increase recipe as needed.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken and remove from bone (overnight in crock-pot). Place in large casserole dish. Add veggies and shredded eggs. Mix soup and chicken broth; pour on top. Add 1/2 cup more broth to keep from drying out. Mix flour milk and butter well; pour over chicken mixture. Do not stir! Cook at 400\u00b0 until top browns about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Date Pinwheels
instructions: Cream butter; add sugars vanilla and egg. Beat until light. Add sifted dry ingredients and mix well. Chill until firm enough to roll. Halve dough and roll each half on floured waxed paper. Spread with filling. Roll up tightly from end. Wrap in wax paper. Chill overnight. Freeze for easier slicing. Slice and bake on greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Remove core from cabbage. Place whole head in a pot with boiling water. cover cook 3 minutes or until softened enough to pull off individual leaves. Cut thick center stem from each leaf. Chop remaining cabbage. Saute onion in butter; add meat rice eggs and Saptini; mix thoroughly. Place a heaping tablespoon of meat mixture on each cabbage leaf. Tuck sides over filling while rolling leaf around filling. Place half the chopped cabbage on bottom of a large pot or Dutch oven or pan (oven). Fill with layers of the cabbage rolls. Cover with remaining chopped cabbage. Combine tomato soup and tomato sauce mix until smooth. Pour over cabbage rolls. Cover and bring to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Serve cabbage rolls with the sauce.

title: Salsa Dip
instructions: Mix salsa and cheese in crock-pot; heat until cheese melts. Brown hamburger meat in skillet; add to cheese and salsa. Serve with chips.

title: Chinese Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix and put in greased casserole the Veg-All bean sprouts water chestnuts cheese and mayonnaise. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix 1/2 bag of stuffing mix with 1/2 stick margarine; put on top of casserole after casserole has baked for 30 minutes. Return to oven and let crumbs brown.

title: Deluxe Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery salt and pepper; stir well. Combine remaining ingredients. Add to chicken mixture and toss lightly.

title: Festive Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate. Excellent as salad. Best as dessert. Delicious served over vanilla ice cream. Pretty for Christmas.

title: Easy As Pie Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into graham cracker crust. Freeze for 2 hours before serving.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on warm water; stir to dissolve. Add 2 cups flour and the salt. Beat thoroughly. Stir in remaining flour. Turn onto lightly floured board and knead until smooth. Place in lightly greased bowl; turn dough over to grease top. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled about 30 minutes. Turn onto board and knead enough to force out bubbles. Divide in half. Roll each half out and stretch to fit an oiled 12-inch pizza pan. Top with favorite toppings and bake at 425\u00b0. This recipe doubles and triples nicely to feed bigger crowds.

title: Fat-Free Old Fashioned Spice Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix in the ingredients one at a time stirring well after each addition. Pour batter into a 9 x 9-inch nonstick baking pan lightly coated with cooking spray and dusted with flour. Bake 30 minutes. Ice with Meringue Cream. Fat-free serving size is 1/5 of cake.

title: Aunt Ola'S Canned Grape Juice
instructions: Wash grapes and put in quart jar. Add sugar and fill jar with boiling water. Seal jar. Let ripen at least 4 weeks before using.

title: Salad
instructions: Cut vegetables. Combine with mushrooms olives and instant onion. Pour dressing over all and mix. Best if refrigerated overnight.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and stir in flour salt pepper sugar and onion. Add sour cream and stir until thick. Add grated cheese. Fold in beans. Pour in greased casserole. Add melted butter to crushed corn flakes and sprinkle on top. Bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until barely tender. Drain and mix together. Heat the remaining ingredients. Pour over drained carrots and add 1 green pepper or onion selected for color. May add celery. Let sit for 2 or 3 days. Keeps well.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with mixer until fluffy. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans or wire racks 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Let cool completely on wire racks. Spread Cream Cheese Frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake. Store cake in refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Temptations
instructions: Cream together the first 4 ingredients. Add egg and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Drop 1 rounded tablespoonful of dough into ungreased muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove from oven. While hot press one miniature Reeses peanut butter cup on each cookie. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Bourbon Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook on low heat for 1 hour. Can be made ahead.

title: Roasted Potato Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Blend olive oil and garlic in blender; coat potatoes. Bake in single layer on 2 cookie sheets until golden turning often (45 minutes to an hour). Meanwhile blanch pea pods; drain (stems and strings removed). Combine oil vinegar rosemary salt and pepper. Let potatoes cool slightly; toss with dressing pea pods and tomatoes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In large bowl combine filling ingredients. Mix well and turn into unbaked pie shell. Bake 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: Cut off tips of corn kernels into a large bowl. Scrape milk and remaining pulp from cob with a paring knife. Set aside. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Remove bacon reserving about 1/4 cup drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Add corn butter and remaining ingredients to drippings in skillet. Cook over medium heat 20 minutes stirring frequently. Spoon corn mixture into a serving dish and sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Yields 12 servings.

title: Stuffed Flounder Fillets
instructions: Wash fillets; drain well on paper towels. Saute celery and onion in butter. Add shrimp crab meat bread crumbs parsley and egg; mix. Spread on fish fillets. Roll up; place in lightly greased baking dish. Pour white wine sauce over fillets. Top with bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and additional chopped parsley. Refrigerate overnight at this point if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Spudnuts(Raised Potato Doughnuts)
instructions: Scald milk. Add shortening sugar and salt. When lukewarm add the yeast which has been softened in warm water. Add the egg and the potatoes plus 1/2 cup water to the mixture. Beat in the flour until the dough is stiff and leaves the side of the bowl. Let rise until triple in bulk. Roll out about 1/3-inch thick and cut with a doughnut cutter. Let rise on a floured board for 1 hour then fry in hot grease. Dip doughnuts in the following glaze.

title: Quick Hollandaise
instructions: Place egg yolks in blender. Blend with lemon juice salt pepper and cayenne pepper for 30 seconds. Add melted butter while blender is running (very slowly). If too runny microwave 15 to 20 seconds and re-blend. Repeat until desired thickness.

title: Frozen Mocha Marbled Loaf
instructions: Line a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan with foil. In a bowl combine the cookie crumbs and butter. Press firmly onto the bottom and 1 1/2-inches up the sides of prepared pan. In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese until light. Add milk and vanilla; mix well. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon half of the mixture into another bowl and set aside. Dissolve coffee in hot water; fold into remaining cream cheese mixture. Fold in chocolate syrup. Spoon half of chocolate mixture over crust. Top with half of the reserved cream cheese mixture. Repeat layers. Cut through layers with a knife to swirl the chocolate (pan will be full). Cover and freeze for 6 hours or overnight.

title: Chili Mac(30 Minutes)
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions in large skillet over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes. Pour off drippings. Stir in tomatoes 1/4 cup A.1. sauce and chili powder. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low and simmer (covered) 10 minutes. Stir chili into macaroni. Garnish with green onions and cheese. Makes four servings.

title: Mom'S Chicken Pie
instructions: In a pan cook the onion and cilantro (chopped). Add the shredded chicken peas and carrots tomato sauce and the chicken broth. Add 1/2 cup of water. Mix and cook for approximately 30 minutes until it gets a little juice. Set aside. Mix the baking powder and the flour. Add the stick of butter. Cutting it with a knife cut it in until it gets very crumbly. Knead the dough with your hands until it is easy to handle and doesnt stick to your hands. Roll it out and divide it in two. Cover a pie plate with half of it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes or until light brown. Set aside to cool.

title: Graham Cracker Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt margarine marshmallows and cherry juice in double boiler. Pour over crushed graham crackers and other dry ingredients. Mix well and pack in box (graham cracker box). Chill until firm. Keep refrigerated. Keeps for several months. I always chop the pecans.

title: Waffles
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar in large mixer bowl. Whip the eggs in small bowl; add milk and oil. Mix well. Beat into dry ingredients. Makes four large waffles.

title: Crockpot Beef Roast
instructions: Put beef roast in bottom of crockpot. Add mushroom soup onion soup mix and canned drink. Cook on high 6 to 8 hours. Good over rice or potatoes.

title: Yummy Cukes
instructions: Combine evaporated milk Miracle Whip vinegar and sugar. Mix together until well blended. Add remaining ingredients and stir until onion and cukes are well coated. Chill before serving.

title: Slush
instructions: Mix together and freeze.

title: Barbecue Slaw
instructions: Combine and heat until boiling. Stir constantly. Pour over 3/4 head of grated cabbage.

title: Mint Sauce
instructions: Place the mint in a pitcher or gravy boat and pour the boiling water over it. Wait 20 minutes so that the mint has time to infuse the water. Add sugar and wine or vinegar. Stir well and serve.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix all ingredients. Place in baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes. Serve warm. Best served with Triscuit crackers.

title: Halloween Mask Paint
instructions: Since Ive not time to be

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Salt and red pepper to taste. Make into lunch balls. Press onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Super Bowl Chili
instructions: In a 4-quart Dutch oven brown beef and pork. Drain off fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes onions green pepper garlic chili powder sugar red pepper vinegar and cumin. Cover and simmer 1 hour stirring frequently to avoid scorching. To serve ladle chili into soup bowls. If desired top each serving with shredded cheese and sour cream. Makes 6 to 8 main dish servings.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Blend butter flour and powdered sugar like pie crust and press in pie tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 until browned.

title: Dam Old Chile
instructions: Ray Davis the preachers father didnt care for chile like his mother and brother did and she made it at least once a week. When a bowl was set before Ray he would comment...\Dam Old Chile again!\

title: Napoleans
instructions: Thaw pastry per directions. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. On floured surface roll to 15 x 12-inches; cut lengthwise in thirds. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Prick with fork. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Stir together cheese 1/4 cup sugar and extract. Fold in whipped cream. Spread 2 pastry sheets with cheese. Stack. Top with remaining pastry. Stir 1/2 cup sugar and milk in small bowl until smooth. Spread over top. Drizzle with chocolate. Chill.

title: Cherry Sauce
instructions: Heat all ingredients in saucepan. Pour over poultry of your choice.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except butter. Using a small Teflon skillet on top of stove on medium heat melt 3 heaping tablespoonfuls butter. Pour half of batter in skillet. cover with lid. Keep check and when lightly brown turn and brown other side.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Boil macaroni according to package directions. Dilute soup with milk. In a large casserole dish put macaroni tuna soup mixture salt and pepper and dry mustard. Mix well. (If needed add more milk.) Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Cook approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Georgia Peach Pie
instructions: Add and stir ingredients together. Take half of the pie crust and put in bottom of a 10-inch pie pan. Save the other half for top of pie.

title: Double Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Rub potatoes with a drizzle of oil. Place potatoes on a microwave safe plate and microwave on high for 12 minutes rotating once. While potatoes cook add chopped bacon to hot skillet and brown until bits are crisp. Add scallions and cook together with bacon one minute more. Drain bacon and scallions on paper towel. Allow potatoes to cool enough to be handled. Preheat broiler to high. Cut potatoes in half and scoop out flesh in a small bowl. Smash potato flesh together with sour cream until combined using potato masher. Stir in cheddar cheese bacon and scallion. Season with salt and pepper. Scoop filling back into jackets of potatoes and place on a cookie sheet. Place potatoes in oven under broiler 6 inches from heat for 5 minutes.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar gradually. Beat until mixture thickens. Add remaining ingredients. Add favorite fruit if desired. Put into ice cream maker and churn until mixture hardens.

title: Picking Pork
instructions: Trim ham leaving small amount of fat for flavor during the cooking. All skin and brine should be removed. Rub the fresh ham with liberal amount of vinegar. Cover the ham completely with seasoned pepper pressing the pepper into the sides so most of it will adhere. Wrap in heavy duty foil tightly. Place in roasting pan and bake in 200 degree over overnight or at least 10 hours. When unwrapped the pork should fall apart or shred when pulled with a fork. Place on a large serving platter on a buffet table and your guests will \pick\ at it forever. Serve with your favorite barbecue sauce. Sounds too easy to be true or any good but it is out of this world in flavor and taste. Great for sandwiches. Save the juices from the ham and cook rice in it for the best rice you will ever taste. Everybody will love it.

title: Chocolate Chunk Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter a 9-inch baking pan. Melt butter and let cool. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Chop chocolate squares leaving some chunks as big as 1/2-inch. With an electric mixer set at medium speed beat the eggs and vanilla until frothy. Gradually beat in the sugar then the melted butter. Reduce speed and beat in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chunks. Pour batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake until edges start to pull away from the sides of the pan 30 to 35 minutes. Cool completely before cutting.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Saute ground beef with onion in skillet until crumbly. Add remaining ingredients except crumbs. Mix well. Place in casserole; top with crumbs. Bake at 359\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Yields 5 to 6 servings.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and Crisco. Add egg one at a time to sugar mixture. Sift together the flour salt and cocoa. Add to cream mixture. Add vanilla. Add pecans or walnuts. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and make 12 rows of marshmallows on it. Return to oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Then top with frosting.

title: Shirley'S Diabetic Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix biscuit mix and fructose. Add egg substitute and vanilla; mix well. Drop by teaspoonful on vegetable-sprayed cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Drain can of sauerkraut cut up. Add chopped vegetables and sugar. Stir and refrigerate.

title: California Casserole
instructions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan as follows 1/2 stuffing (cooked according to package directions) 1 can mushroom soup chicken chunks vegetables Cheez Whiz remaining 1/2 of stuffing 1 can mushroom soup. Pour 3/4 cup water over all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer vegetables. Add sugar to mayonnaise. Place grated cheese on top. Top with 8 slices crumbled bacon or Bac*Os. Let set in refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours.

title: Pineapple Bar Cake
instructions: Mix granulated sugar and melted butter or oleo. Beat eggs until foamy and mix with other ingredients. Sift flour salt and baking powder and add to mixture. Add the drained crushed pineapple. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or more. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into bars or squares.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Melt butter in pan stirring in sugars. Stir constantly until melted. Pour mixture over soft ice cream in big bowl. Mix well and store in refrigerator. In a mug pour 1 part mixture 1 part rum and 2 parts boiling water. Decorate with cinnamon stick and nutmeg.

title: Hawaiian Delight(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Combine mix oil pudding and eggs until well blended. Add 7-Up last and beat at medium speed until well blended (about 2 minutes). Do not overbeat. Grease and flour 3 cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion until done. Drain. Season to taste. Set aside. Fry tortillas in oil until flimsy. Spoon hamburger and small amount of cheese in the tortilla. Roll up and place side by side in a large casserole dish. For sauce take some flour salt pepper and chili powder. Mix together. Add water and tomato sauce. This is an experimental process because it all depends on how large of a pan you are making. The sauce needs to be thin enough and yet thick enough to have texture. Pour over rolled-up enchiladas and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes until all cheese is melted.

title: Mountain Dew Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add next 3 ingredients. Top with topping made from lemon pudding and Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix together sugar flour and soda. Add eggs and juice from fruit cocktail. Mix until smooth and fold in fruit from fruit cocktail. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Martian Pudding(Pistachio Salad)
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and pudding mix together. Add pineapple and mandarin oranges. Add cottage cheese. Chill.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain; add onion tomatoes tomato paste spaghetti mix and Italian seasoning to your taste. Cover and simmer 1/2 hour. Cook noodles and drain; rinse in cold water. Layer sauce noodles and cheeses in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fluffy Cranberry Salad
instructions: Add sugar to berries and chill 2 hours. Fold in other ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Spinach Onion Dip
instructions: Blend all together. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Yield 2 1/2 cups. Serve in hollowed out bread loaf with vegetables and break chunks for dipping.

title: Egg And Mushroom Soup
instructions: Wash mushrooms and soak in a cup of hot water; set aside. Beat eggs set aside. Boil chicken stock add mushrooms with the water in which they were soaked. Boiled 5 minutes. Season with soy sauce salt and Ajinomoto. Stir in the cooking oil and beaten eggs. Serve hot.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on the box in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or glass baking dish. While cake is still hot combine Eagle Brand milk and ice cream topping. Pour over cake and let cool. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with Heath bar (grated) or Sensations.

title: Quick Pig In A Blanket
instructions: Chop cabbage into medium pieces. Spread in bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Brown meat and onion. Stir in rice salt and pepper. Heat tomato soup paste and water to boiling and pour over other ingredients. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Waldorf Cole Slaw(Yields 8 Servings)
instructions: Achiote is annatto seeds cooked in vegetable oil or olive oil. On the island they would cook the seeds in lard. Annatto is the pulp of the tropical tree Bixa Orellana. Annato dye is used in coloring some cheeses and in textiles and varnishes. Caribbean and South American Indians use it for body paint.

title: Nachos
instructions: Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges. Deep fry wedges in oil until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Paint each wedge with about 1 teaspoon refried beans. Place on heatproof serving platter. Top with shredded cheese. Place in hot oven or under broiler just long enough to melt cheese. Top each chip with 1 teaspoon of guacamole then 1/2 teaspoon sour cream. Place a few pieces of diced tomato on top. Place more guacamole in center of platter. Serve with green and red chile sauce on the side. Serves 4.

title: Hamburger Relish
instructions: Chop all vegetables. Mix all ingredients except spice bag and vinegar. Boil 30 minutes in heavy pot. Tie a string around the top of the spice bag. Tie around handle and hang into vegetables. Cook until very thick. Then add vinegar and boil on low until there is no free liquid. Put into clean jars. Leave headspace. Can be put in freezer.

title: Four Layer Delight
instructions: Melt 1 stick butter in a square cake pan; add flour and nuts. Mix and press in pan; bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Add apples and nuts last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Mix juice of 1 orange and 1 cup sugar. Spread on cake while hot.

title: Marshmallow Spiders
instructions: Poke 8 pieces of 2-inch string licorice into each marshmallow end for legs. Melt over low heat 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Set spider of waxed paper and dribble a large spoonful of melted chocolate over marshmallow. Add 2 M&Ms for eyes. Cool and eat.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Mix together the cream cheese mayonnaise dill weed garlic powder and onion powder. Spread this on the cooled crust. Top with chopped raw vegetables of your choice.

title: Japanese Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order listed. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 pies.

title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in a large bowl whisk until smooth. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust.

title: Holiday Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Bake sweet potatoes at 400\u00b0 until soft about 1 hour. Let potatoes cool remove skins and mash with butter. Add milk salt cinnamon nutmeg and brown sugar. Mix thoroughly. Fold in beaten egg whites fold in nuts. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes in a greased casserole dish or pan. Top with marshmallows and broil until marshmallows brown.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sugar lemonade and pineapple juice. Freeze for at least 12 hours. Add 7-Up before serving.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces (scissors work really well). Put white sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon into a paper sandwich bag. Grease 10-inch or larger tube pan. Shake the biscuit pieces a few at a time in the sugar and cinnamon; transfer to tube pan.

title: Carrot Soup(Serves 4)
instructions: Simmer all ingredients except cream until vegetables are done. Add cream just before serving; heat.

title: Idiot Bars
instructions: Place crackers in jelly roll pan (ungreased) split and scored. Boil butter and sugar together\tfor 2 minutes; add pecans. Spoon over crackers and bake 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cut and separate as soon as possible and put on rack to cool.

title: Best Bean Salad
instructions: Bring sugar water and vinegar to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Drain all canned vegetables. Place all vegetables in a large covered bowl and pour dressing over it. Refrigerate overnight. This will keep for 2 or 3 weeks.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Place in 9 x 13 greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Favorite Meat Loaf(Microwave)
instructions: In small bowl combine tomato sauce brown sugar and mustard; set aside. In large bowl combine eggs onion crackers ground beef salt and pepper. Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce mixture; stir thoroughly. Place meat mixture in glass ring mold or 2-quart microproof round casserole. Put a microproof glass in center of meat mixture bottom side up. Pour remaining tomato sauce over top of meat. Cook uncovered on High (maximum power) for 12 to 14 minutes. Let stand covered 5 to 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat first 5 ingredients together with a spoon or mixer. Add next 3 ingredients then add oats and pecans. Drop on a greased cookie sheet about a teaspoon for each cookie. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and store in a tin to keep them crisp.

title: Grandmother'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Beat softened margarine until fluffy. Add sugar and continue beating. Add eggs and milk. Beat well. Sift together dry ingredients and add with vanilla. This well form a soft dough. Divide cookie dough and roll out very thin on floured board. Cut out and sprinkle with sugar. Bake on cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Hickory Nut Cake
instructions: Mix well and cook in 2 (9-inch) pans for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. (Or may use cake mix.)

title: Buttermilk Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with baking powder soda and salt. Add buttermilk and mix lightly with fork. Turn out on a floured board. Knead lightly 4 or 5 times and roll to 1/2-inch thick. Cut into rectangles 1 x 3-inches with floured knife. Drop into boiling chicken broth. Cover and boil gently for 12 minutes. Do not uncover during cooking. Serve immediately.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening and eggs. Stir in flour baking soda and vanilla. Mix well. Add chips and nuts. Mix well to distribute evenly through. Drop by teaspoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil the first 4 ingredients. Remove and add remaining ingredients. Mix together and drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cover rice with water and put lid on pan. Put on medium heat until pan lid is hot. Turn heat down to very low. No salt. Cook for 35 minutes. Fluff with fork. Cool with lid off. Put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Sift all dry ingredients into large bowl. Mix in shortening with pastry blender. Add milk then yeast mixture. Stir until thoroughly moistened. Turn onto floured board and knead a minute or two (no rising is required). Roll to desired thickness (1/2 inch is recommended) and cut into rounds. Brush with melted butter and bake on ungreased pan at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Baked biscuits freeze well.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Combine vegetables. Heat sugar and vinegar on low heat until syrupy. Add mayonnaise salt pepper and syrup to vegetables. Mix thoroughly. Chill for 1 hour or more before serving.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar and cinnamon. Add Crisco; mix well. Remove 1/2 cup of crumb mixture and set aside. Add remaining ingredients to rest of crumb mixture; mix well. Pour into greased pan. Sprinkle reserved crumb mixture over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Santa'S Punch
instructions: Pour orange juice pineapple and water in blender. On low speed add ice cubes one at a time until all ice is crushed. Add cherries; blend all ingredients well and serve immediately.

title: Maple-Sugared Pears
instructions: Combine pear juice brown sugar and oil in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in lemon juice maple syrup and cinnamon. Arrange pear halves cut side up in a small shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with pecans. Pour brown sugar mixture over pears and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Rascals(Spitzbuben)
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt baking powder and shortening as for pie dough. Add juice and grated rind of lemon and whole eggs and mix well. Roll out 1/2 of the dough to fit the bottom of a 12 x 18 x 1-inch greased cookie sheet. Spread a generous amount of good marmalade on the dough. Red raspberry and orange are very good. Roll out and use the other half of the dough to form lattice decoration for top. Bake in a slow oven at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Cut into 2-inch squares or diamond shaped pieces.

title: Pie Crust(Makes 1 Crust)
instructions: Mix together in a soft ball. Press into a 9-inch pie plate.

title: Baked Pineapple(Easy Rv Recipe)
instructions: Melt butter; add eggs. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a buttered 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until slightly browned and set.

title: Harvest Popcorn
instructions: In a large pan mix popped corn shoestring potatoes and nuts. Melt the oleo and add all seasonings. Mix well. Pour over popcorn mixture. Mix well. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes stirring once.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Blend Crisco sugar vanilla and orange rind. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour salt and baking powder; add alternately with milk. Pour batter into prepared 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: South-Of-The-Border Soup
instructions: Heat all together and garnish each serving with shredded Monterey Jack cheese. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Fresh Corn Pancakes
instructions: With a sharp knife cut kernels from corn. With back of a knife scrape cobs to release milky pulp. Make at least 2 cups. In a large bowl stir together flour sugar baking powder salt and pepper. In a small bowl beat together eggs milk and cooking oil. Add to flour mixture stirring only until flour is moistened. Stir in corn. Cook in hot oil 2 tablespoons batter for each pancake. Makes 24 pancakes. Serve with maple syrup.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix oatmeal sugar and oil and let set at least two hours. Add egg coconut and vanilla. Mix well and drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle pecans and coconut in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Pour over nuts and coconut. Cream the cream cheese sugar and melted margarine. Spread over cake mix. Bake 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Pizza
instructions: Flatten biscuits and place apple slices on top. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and dot with butter. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar water cinnamon and cloves; bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Add tea remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes. Strain; add remaining ingredients. Heat but do not boil. Serve hot. Yields about 8 cups.

title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
instructions: In large bowl mix pudding and 3 cups milk then mix in Cool Whip. In a 13 x 9-inch glass dish lay only enough graham crackers out to cover entire bottom then pour 1/2 of the pudding mixture on top of crackers and smooth out. Put another layer of graham crackers then pour the rest of pudding mixture on top and spread out. Put another layer of graham crackers. Mix 3 tablespoons milk into frosting in canister. Pour out onto top of crackers and spread out. Chill for at least 12 hours.

title: Old Fashion Lettuce Salad
instructions: Chop bacon strips and fry in skillet add vinegar and water and bring to boiling. Sprinkle salt and sugar on lettuce and pour boiling mixture over the lettuce.

title: Apple Pecan Cake
instructions: Mix apples and pecans with 1 cup of flour and set aside. Mix flour sugar oil vanilla and eggs together. Combine dough mixture with fruit. Pour into tube cake pan and bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Snowballs(For Christmas)
instructions: Mix whipping cream and sugar until soft peaks form. Add vanilla and mix well. Stack three or four vanilla wafers together. Cover each stack with whipped cream mixture. Cut cherries in half and place one on each snowball. Store in refrigerator.

title: Sweetheart Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ginger ale and ice cream in a large covered pitcher. Chill until ready to serve. Pour into bowl and add ginger ale. Float vanilla ice cream on top and serve.

title: The Absolutely Best Peach Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch; add water and peaches. Bring to a boil for one minute. Cool. Add bourbon lemon or sherry. Pour into a pastry-lined 9-inch pie dish. Make crisscross on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Serve alone or with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Avgolemono Soup(Egg Lemon Rice)
instructions: Cook rice in chicken\tbroth until tender. Turn down heat. Beat eggs and combine with lemon juice and cornstarch adding 2 cups hot water and mix\twell. Slowly add the egg mixture to the soup vigorously stirring with a wire whip for 2 minutes. Turn heat off. Use whole grain rice (Uncle Bens) or parboil rice.

title: Toothpick Appetizers(Makes 12 Servings)
instructions: While potato is still hot cut into 24 cubes. Sprinkle with wine and salt and pepper; set aside. Cut herring and mushrooms into quarters. Cut lox white fish and red or green pepper into 24 pieces. Cut cherry tomatoes and artichoke hearts in half. Cut cucumber into 6 (3/4-inch) pieces then into quarters. Cut baby corns into 12 pieces.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread graham cracker crumbs over bottom of pan. Sprinkle in layers the nuts chocolate bits butterscotch chips and coconut over the crust. Pour Eagle Brand milk over all. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and cut in squares. Delicious.

title: West Virginia Reunion Beans
instructions: Brown sausage. Saute onion and pepper. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Delicious Rolls
instructions: Mix together the shortening sugar and 1 cup boiling water then cool. When cool add 1 cup cold water and eggs. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water and add. Stir in flour and mix well. Place in greased bowl and let rise. Work down and make into rolls. Let rise again. Bake at 400\u00b0 until browned.

title: Sausage Pilaf
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Add celery onion and green pepper; cook until tender not brown. Stir in pimiento soup milk rice and seasonings. Pour into an ungreased casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes stirring occasionally with a fork. For topping combine bread crumbs and melted butter; sprinkle evenly over the top and bake uncovered 20 more minutes.

title: Walnut Pineapple Squares
instructions: Mix ingredients together until dough leaves bowl clean. Refrigerate for about 3 hours. Roll in granulated or powdered sugar; cut into squares fill and\troll. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Saute beef and onion. Drain. Combine with other ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Serve on heated hamburger buns.

title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook cauliflower and broccoli. Heat soups and cheese. Drain vegetables. Mix all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add onion rings last 5 minutes or microwave 10 minutes on High. Add onions and serve.

title: Kartoffelsalat Mit Wurst(Potato Salad With Sausages)
instructions: Cook potatoes; peel and cut into 1/4-inch slices. Cook bacon until crisp; set aside. Cook onion in bacon drippings. Stir in remaining ingredients except sausage. Bring to boil. Add bacon and pour over warm potato slices; gently toss. Serve with sausages. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Mix milk and flour. Cook until thickened. Add soup and cheese. Stir until cheese melts. Add chicken. Pour over cooked spaghetti. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Baker'S Chocolate One-Bowl Brownie Recipe
instructions: Microwave chocolate and margarine in large microwavable bowl at High for 2 minutes or until melted. Stir until chocolate is melted. Stir in sugar. Mix in eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes (do not overbake). Cool; makes 24 brownies.

title: Pound It Almost Instant Dessert
instructions: Mix everything but cake. Spread on pound cake slices. Broil slowly until bubbly. Garnish with cherry dipped in marmalade and rolled in coconut.

title: Strawberry-Nut Bread
instructions: Puree strawberries and pour into small pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Cool. Combine dry ingredients. Mix shortening sugar and eggs and beat until very light. Alternately add flour mixture and water on low speed of mixer. Stir in pureed strawberries and stir in nuts. Spread in a greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Test with toothpick. Cool for 10 minutes and remove from pan. Wrap with foil and keep at room temperature. Tastes better the next day. Freezes well.

title: Delightful Fruit Compote
instructions: Stir fruits together. In microwave heat apple jelly and water for 45 seconds or until jelly is melted. Drizzle over fruit and stir. Refrigerate.

title: Three Pepper Catsup
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add onion pepper jalapenos garlic and thyme. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender (about 10 minutes). Mix in catsup tomatoes and pepper. Cover and simmer until thick (about 5 minutes). Cover and chill. Makes about 2 3/4 cups. Keeps 2 weeks in refrigerator. Excellent on hamburgers and hot dogs.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water. Drain pineapple; add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Pecan Ozarks
instructions: Place sugar and egg whites on slow fire and beat until warm. Remove from fire and continue beating until mixture stands firm; fold in nuts. Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until firm.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Combine ingredients with whisk. Crush Wasa crackers and sprinkle on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Louisiana Beans And Rice(Serve As A Side Dish Or In Larger Servings As A Main Dish.)
instructions: In a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole dish combine oil onion green pepper garlic thyme and oregano. Cover with lid; microwave on High for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring once during cooking. Stir in beans soup ham and red pepper. Cover; microwave on High for 5 minutes or until hot. Stir. Reduce power to 50%. Cover; microwave 15 minutes or until flavors are blended. Serve over rice. Makes about 5 cups or 5 servings.

title: Gourmet String Beans
instructions: Drain beans and wrap 5 or 6 at a time with bacon. Place in a casserole dish and top with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and pepper in 2 tablespoons oil. Add ground beef and brown. Drain grease. Add soups water and 1 cup cheese. Cook spaghetti and add to mixture. Pour into a 3-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: In baking dish add ingredients by layers and top with more cracker crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake For Diabetics
instructions: Cook raisins in water until water disappears. Add applesauce eggs Sweeta and oil. Mix well. Combine dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into one large greased loaf pan or two small ones. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. This is like good raisin bread.

title: Southern Maryland Oyster Stew
instructions: Place oysters in saucepan add water and cook until oysters are plump and edges curl. Remove oysters and add to milk. Add salt and pepper then strained oyster juice. Add butter heat and serve with crackers.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine water sugar and cornstarch. Boil until thick and clear. Remove from heat and sprinkle dry jello over hot mixture and stir quickly. Pour in strawberries and mix. Pour into cooled pie shell; refrigerate. Also good using blueberries and blackberry jello.

title: Cranberry Sauce (For Ham)
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Heat over low heat mixing occasionally. Pour over baked ham slices.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
instructions: Arrange chicken in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish with the meatier portions along the edge. Combine remaining ingredients stir well and pour over the chicken. Cover with wax paper and place in the microwave. Cook on High for 12 minutes and then on Medium-low for 8 to 10 minutes. Let stand covered for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Carrots And Grapes
instructions: Cut carrots into 1-inch thick diagonal slices. In saucepan over medium heat cook carrots orange juice olive oil salt sugar and ginger to boiling. Cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes. Add cut grapes to mixture and cook 5 minutes more until carrots are fork tender. Drain and serve.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Mix large container of Cool Whip and 1 box instant vanilla pudding together for cake topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pennsylvania Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins and water 5 minutes and cool. Cream together eggs sugar vanilla and margarine. Sift together flour baking powder baking soda cinnamon nutmeg and allspice. Sift dry ingredients twice. Add to creamed mixture a little at a time beating thoroughly. (Batter will be stiff.) Add raisins and juice in which they were cooked and stir with wooden spoon. Stir in nuts. Drop by spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Makes about 5 dozen delicious cookies.

title: Barbecued Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender. Put in large casserole dish. Add beans stir in barbecue sauce. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cream Circle Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar cream and margarine in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil then boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla chips and marshmallow cream. Stir until melted. (Remove 1 cup of mixture and set aside.) Add flavoring and food coloring. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. (Pour cup of mixture which was saved on top) and swirl throughout with a knife. Cool for at least 2 hours in refrigerator before cutting.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients and blend with mixer until pineapple segments are broken into small pieces. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch or use two 9-inch round pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff For 60
instructions: Saute onion in butter until golden brown. Add ground beef and cook until browned stirring occasionally. Blend in remaining ingredients except sour cream. Heat until bubbling. Just before serving stir in sour cream. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add oil eggs carrots pineapple nuts and vanilla. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured tube pan.

title: Heart Smart Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Measure 1 cup of stewed tomatoes puree in blender (save remainder). Combine all ingredients except ground beef; mix well. Add ground beef; mix lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour. Before last 15 minutes of baking add remainder of stewed tomatoes to top of meat loaf. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Make Stove Top stuffing as per package directions and set aside to cool. In skillet break up sausage and fry until brown (as you would ground meat). Place on paper towels to drain away fat and allow to cool. When both stuffing and sausage are cool combine in large bowl. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place balls on cookie (ungreased) sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot or cold with finger foods for snack. Toothpicks may be placed in sausage balls.

title: Larry'S Fudge
instructions: Bring to rolling boil stirring constantly sugar milk salt and cocoa. Cook to 235\u00b0. Remove from heat; add vanilla and butter but do not stir. Cool to 110\u00b0. Add nuts if desired. Beat with wooden spoon until loses its gloss. Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan immediately.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple; save juice. Melt butter in pan (iron skillet). Add brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of juice. Add syrup to water to make 1/2 cup; set aside. Arrange pineapple in bottom of pan. Cream together the shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with the 1/2 cup reserved pineapple juice beating after each addition. Spread over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Invert plate. Serve warm.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan heat oil. Saut onion green pepper mushrooms garlic basil thyme paprika salt pepper and cayenne pepper for 3 to 4 minutes stirring constantly. Blend in tomatoes broth tomato sauce and bay leaves; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer for 10 minutes. Add fish and okra; simmer 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in shrimp; cook for additional 2 to 3 minutes. Remove bay leaves.

title: Minted Corn & Rice Salad
instructions: Prepare rice as label directs but do not add margarine and use only 1/2 tsp. salt. While rice is cooking prepare dressing In large bowl with wire whisk mix lemon juice oil pepper and remaining 3/4 tsp. salt until blended. Add hot rice to dressing and toss to coat. Cool slightly about 30 minutes tossing occasionally. Meanwhile in 5 quart dutch oven heat 3 quarts water to boiling over high heat. Add corn and cook 5 minutes. Drain. When corn is cool enough to handle cut kernels from cob. Add corn to rice with radishes peas mint and chives. Toss until evenly mixed. If not serving right away cover and refrigerate up to 8 hours.

title: Dutch Oven Lasagna
instructions: Heat Dutch oven. Brown hamburg in Dutch oven. Drain off excess fat. Add 7 cups hot water to hamburg. Bring to boil. Add macaroni and cook until tender. Add more water if necessary. Add tomato sauce paste and seasoning. Heat through stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Evenly distribute cheeses over top cover and heat through. Serve with garlic bread and salad.

title: Hot Clam And Cheese Dip
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and pimentos in butter for approximately 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Heat until cheese melts. Keep hot in a chafing dish. Serve with chips party rye bread cut into pieces or Melba toast.

title: Taco Chili
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Add all ingredients except chips and cheese to large pan. Simmer for 30 minutes. Ladle into bowls. Top with cheese and serve with chips.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Drain juice from beets and heat. Add sugar and vinegar. Put cornstarch in a small amount of water and add to the beet mixture. Add butter and beets.

title: Butter Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add flour. Add egg; beat well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 400\u00b0 until set.

title: Caramel Corn For Microwave
instructions: Pop the popcorn in brown store bag in microwave oven. Put butter corn syrup and brown sugar in saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat (stirring). Boil 2 minutes. Add vanilla and baking soda. Mix thoroughly and pour over corn in paper bag. Shake well. Microwave 90 seconds and shake well again; 90 seconds again and shake well. Microwave again for 30 seconds twice and shake well both times. Pour into large bowl. Enjoy!

title: Orange Gelatin Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add sherbet and mix well. When partially set add mandarin oranges and fold in Dream Whip. Pour into oiled 1 1/2-quart ring mold; chill. Serves 8.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Dough will be stiff at first. Roll in 1-inch balls. Roll in slightly beaten egg white and finely chopped nuts. Bake for 5 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove and quickly press thumb in center. Bake 8 more minutes. Remove and fill center with jelly or cherry half.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Boil water and salt; remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Let cool then knead. Store in airtight plastic containers.

title: Jennifer'S Easy Saucepan Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine and shortening. Stir in cocoa. Dissolve and remove from heat. Add eggs; beat well. Add sugar and flour. Stir well. Bake in greased square pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool before cutting.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Drain excess juice from all canned vegetables. Combine vegetables; add onion pepper and celery. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. combine sugar and liquid ingredients. Stir and pour over vegetables. Mix well; cover and refrigerate 8 to 10 hours.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and Crisco until fluffy. Alternately add flour and eggs until all flour and eggs have been added beating after each addition. Add flavoring and 7-Up; beat well. Pour into a cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Waffle Pizzas
instructions: In large bowl whisk together flours baking powder salt oregano thyme pepper and Parmesan. In another bowl whisk together milk and eggs until well blended. Pour liquid ingredients over dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Fold in olive oil. Spray waffle grids with Pam. Spoon 1/2 cup batter onto iron. Spread out. Close lid and bake. Serve topped with tomato or pizza sauce Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese olives onions mushrooms etc. Great for the kids!

title: Tortilla Appetite Teasers
instructions: Combine cheese and salsa. Add olives onions and seasonings. Mix well. Spread 1/2 cup cream cheese mixture on tortilla. Place second one on top of cheese mixture. Spread with 1/2 cup cheese mixture and top with third tortilla. Start over and repeat to make a second stack. Cover each with plastic wrap and chill. Cut each stack into 8 triangles. Serve with additional salsa if desired. Makes 16 snacks.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Place dry rice in Pyrex dish. Salt and pepper and fry lightly the chops. Place on top of rice and pour bouillon over. Put one tablespoon celery and onion on each chop. Then cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove foil and place one bell pepper ring on each chop; bake 10 more minutes then serve.

title: Hot Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients. Sprinkle with parsley. Top with corn flakes or chips. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Divinity
instructions: Mix corn syrup sugar water and salt in saucepan. Cook stirring until sugar is dissolved. Cook to firm ball stage or 248\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Pour about 1/2 of the syrup slowly over whites beating constantly. Cook remainder until 272\u00b0 on thermometer or soft crack stage. Add slowly to first mixture and beat until mixture holds its shape. Add vanilla and nuts and drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Yields 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar milk and butter 4 1/2 minutes. Add marshmallow and chocolate chips. Beat until firm. Pour in greased dish or pan.

title: Crazy Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in a greased 13 x 9-inch casserole. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Old Country Sausage Supper
instructions: In a skillet saute the bacon until crisp; remove bacon. Saute the potatoes onion carrots and lima beans in the remaining drippings until tender. Stir in the sausage; heat until meat is hot. Garnish with bacon. Serve in skillet. Serves 4.

title: Caramel Corn Pops
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine cereal and nuts in a greased large shallow baking pan. In a saucepan bring butter sugar and corn syrup to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Remove form heat; add vanilla and soda. Pour caramel mixture over cereal and nuts; stir well. Bake for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Pour onto waxed paper and break apart; allow to cool. Store in airtight container. Yields approximately 10 cups of snack mix.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: One half cup of the flour should be sprinkled over blueberries. Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add shortening milk and vanilla; beat. Add 2 eggs and beat. Fold in floured blueberries. Spread mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Over top of mixture sprinkle generously a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Serve warm with butter or cold. Either way its delicious.

title: Rice Salad
instructions: In bowl combine all ingredients. Add dressing and toss to combine.

title: Sourdough Starter And Bread
instructions: Mix yeast with 1/2 cup warm water. Mix sugar with 2 cups warm water and flour. Add yeast mixture. Let stand in glass jar covered with cloth for 5 days.

title: Chocolate Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch Bundt pan. In large bowl beat all ingredients except carrots and coconut until just blended constantly scraping bowl with rubber spatula. Increase speed to high; beat 2 minutes occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula. Stir in carrots and coconut. Spoon batter into pan. Bake 50 to 55 minutes until done. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes. Remove from pan.

title: Fudgy Bonbons
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt chocolate chips and butter in saucepan over low heat. Remove; add condensed milk. Stir in flour nuts and vanilla. Cover each candy Kiss completely with 1 tablespoon dough. Place cookies 1-inch apart on cookie sheet and bake 6 to 8 minutes. Do not overbake. Remove from cookie sheet and cool. Cookies will appear soft and shiny but will become firm as they cool.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Do not peel oranges! Cut oranges and apples into large chunks. Place all ingredients (except marshmallows) into a food processor. Process for one or two minutes until finely chopped and thoroughly mixed scraping down sides of container as needed. Stir in marshmallows if desired. Serve immediately or chill until ready to serve.

title: Kifli - The Easy Way
instructions: Cream the cream cheese with butter. Add flour; mix well and chill for 2 hours. Use 1/4 of dough at a time rolling out on surface sprinkled with powdered sugar to 1/4-inch thick. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Put small amount of apricot jam (or other of your choice) on each square overlap opposite corners of dough and pinch to hold. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Honey Butter Spread
instructions: Stir until well mixed; serve with hot biscuits.

title: Hamburger-Rice Casserole
instructions: In skillet brown hamburger meat onion and salt and pepper until meat is done. Mix remaining ingredients and add to meat and onion mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Quick Chinese Chicken
instructions: In a skillet with a tight fitting cover put the chicken breasts (skin side down if skin is on) water salt and pepper together and bring to a rolling boil. Skim off the broth and continue to cook on moderate heat; cover tightly for 35 minutes.
