Remove breasts; cool strain and measure broth (put in freezer for 10 to 15 minutes until fat comes to top and remove fat). After chicken is cool enough to handle remove bones and skin (if still on) and discard.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown hamburger and minced onion. Drain. Add tomato soup mustard ketchup and brown sugar. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Peach Custard
instructions: Mix together eggs butter sugar and flour. Fill crust with raw peaches (sliced). Pour mixture over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown and peaches are soft.

title: Shrimp Sauce
instructions: Mix all and chill. Will last forever in refrigerator.

title: Carolina Chewy'S
instructions: Cream butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Blend in flour and then add nuts. Spoon batter into a well greased lightly floured 9 x 13 inch pan and bake at 300 for 45 minutes. DO NOT OVERBAKE. Cut into squares and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Keep these covered well or they will get hard.

title: Linguini With White Clam Sauce
instructions: Saute garlic in saucepan in the oil until it floats. (Do not allow to brown.) Add clam juice to stop cooking. Add salt pepper and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add clams and half of the parsley. Cook the linguini according to package directions and reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking water. Melt 1 tablespoon butter with a small amount of olive oil and gently fold into the cooked and drained linguini with the reserved water and remaining parsley. Heat the clam sauce but do not boil. Serve over the linguini.

title: Wita'S Arroz(Spanish Rice)
instructions: Brown uncooked rice in oil in skillet stirring constantly. Add onion salt garlic and comino; brown for 1 more minute. Add tomato sauce and water. Cover with tight fitting lid and simmer for approximately 20 minutes or until rice is fluffy and liquid absorbed. Do not stir rice while simmering.

title: Chicken, Rice And Almond Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except butter and bread crumbs. Pat in buttered dish for baking and refrigerate overnight. Melt butter and add to bread crumbs. Sprinkle on casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mocha Cheesecake
instructions: Crush cookies. Mix with margarine and press into bottom of an 8 or 9-inch spring-form pan. Refrigerate.

title: Moon Bars
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir together flour nuts cocoa and baking powder; stir into egg mixture. Spread in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chili-Thon Chili
instructions: Scramble hamburger onions and green pepper. Drain excess fat. Add salt and pepper chili powder taco seasoning bay leaves to hamburger. Mix well. Add tomato sauce juice and diced tomatoes. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add pinto beans and taco sauce. Simmer for at least 1 hour. May add a little water if needed.

title: Summer Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Mix together cooked macaroni cheese celery and onion. Combine and stir macaroni mixture mayonnaise vinegar and pepper together. Chill. Serve garnished with pickle slices and pimientos.

title: Jello Applesauce Salad
instructions: Dissolve red hots in heating water. Add jello and applesauce. Chill until set. Top with Miracle Whip cream cheese and powdered sugar or NutraSweet.

title: Tuna And Noodle Casserole
instructions: In 2-quart boiling water and 1 teaspoon salt add noodles gradually. Cook until tender. Drain then rinse in cold water. Mix noodles with tuna soup milk and cheese. Top with tomato slices and crumbs. Bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Homemade Sloppy Joe'S
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add water sauces salt and pepper. Sprinkle with flour and stir in. Simmer slowly 1 hour. Serve on warm buns.

title: Yams
instructions: Place sliced potatoes in deep heavy pan. Add sugars syrup and butter. Then add lemon flavoring. Cook on top of range slowly until tender and syrup is thick.

title: Zucchini Frittles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by tablespoon into hot oil. Cook slowly 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Zucchini Soup
instructions: Brown sausage in a large Dutch oven. Drain off excess fat. Add celery and cook for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Add all remaining ingredients except green peppers. Simmer covered for 20 minutes. Add green peppers and cook covered for 10 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 quarts. Serve with garlic buttered Italian bread and grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Dinner
instructions: Crumble and cook meat in large skillet. Remove from pan. Saute onion and pepper until onion begins to get clear. Put meat back in pan and add peas and tomatoes. Simmer together for 5 to 10 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve with tossed salad and garlic bread for a complete meal.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; stir in relish and additional ingredients. Pour in dish and refrigerate overnight. Serves 10.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken breasts in melted butter. Roll in Parmesan cheese. Put in buttered baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until done. (Can sprinkle extra Parmesan cheese on top of chicken breasts.)

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Make a dark brown roux of flour and grease in a heavy pot. Add vegetables and garlic; saute until soft. Add tomato paste; mix well. Add remaining ingredients except shrimp parsley and rice. Simmer slowly for one hour covered stirring occasionally. Add shrimp; cook until done (5 to 15 minutes). Garnish with parsley and serve over rice.

title: Geri'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix in saucepan butter cocoa and water. Bring to boil and stir into flour and sugar mixture. Beat eggs. Add soda to buttermilk. Add eggs buttermilk vanilla and salt to warm mixture. Batter will be thin. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Pour Geris Chocolate Cake Frosting over hot cake.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Pour into grocery bag the unsalted popped corn. In a 2-quart bowl mix the brown sugar butter white syrup and salt. Cook on High 2 1/2 minutes; stir well. Cook on High 2 1/2 more minutes remove and add the soda. Stir well. Pour on popcorn in a sack; shake well.

title: Nachos
instructions: Spread beans in 9 x 12-inch pan. Spread hamburger on top. Cover with next 4 ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until warm. Top with sour cream.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese potato chips and almonds. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with saved ingredients. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake uncovered 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients; add Italian dressing.

title: Aunt Estelle'S Chicken Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken in 3 quarts water with salt and pepper to taste until well done. Cool and remove skin. Take meat off bones and put back in broth.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring water syrup and sugar to a boil. Add peanuts. Cook to 295\u00b0. Add soda and stir. (Cook in 3-quart boiler because when you add soda it will foam up.) Pour on greased cookie sheets. As soon as the edges begin to cool start pulling and stretching the candy as you would taffy. Break off edges as they cool and continue pulling center.

title: Batter Dip From Pancake Flour
instructions: Beat together. Good for chicken fish pork chops etc. Dip in wet batter and then roll in dry before frying.

title: Blueberry Pudding
instructions: Beat with fork. Mix\tsugar and egg first. Then add butter and milk then soda and flour. Mix well. Add berries. Stir. Put in 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: In a 5 1/2 x 3 x 2-inch bread loaf pan mix all ingredients and cover with aluminum foil and cook in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling water and drain well. Layer cabbage alternately with cheese in greased 2-quart casserole. Pour soup over cabbage and cheese. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until bubbly and crumbs are brown.

title: Whoopie Pies
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients. Add flour vanilla sour milk and hot water to the other ingredients. Drop mixture on cookie sheet by spoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Put in ungreased baking dish. Cover with topping.

title: Peach Almond Pie
instructions: Put into unbaked pie shell and bake.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix cubed chicken cream of chicken soup and sour cream in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix crackers melted margarine and poppy seed in plastic bag. Spread over top of chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until browned on top.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Combine tuna cole slaw mixture and grapes. Add enough lemon yogurt to moisten. Can be served on a lettuce leaf or however desired.

title: Shrimp Ala Marinara
instructions: Heat oil in skillet; brown garlic. Add tomatoes parsley basil salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 1/2 hour. Stir in tomato sauce garlic salt and shrimp. Cook uncovered for an additional 15 to 20 minutes. Pour over 1 pound of cooked spaghetti. Top with grated cheese. Buon appetito. Serves 4.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Heat all ingredients except roast to boiling. Add roast and bake at 325\u00b0 until tender. Tear apart roast and place on Italian bread. Cover with shredded Mozzarella and some of the peppers. I like to cook it the day before in a crock-pot.

title: Ladybug Cookies
instructions: Line cookie sheet with waxed paper. In small saucepan over low heat melt chips with frosting stirring frequently until chips are melted and mixture is smooth. Add food colorings; blend well.

title: Kool-Aid Sherbet
instructions: Stir sugar Kool Aid and milk until sugar is dissolved. Pour into shallow freezer container; cover and freeze for 1 hour or until slightly thickened. Transfer to a mixing bowl; beat until smooth. Return to freezer container; cover and freeze until firm. Remove from freezer about 20 minutes before serving. Yields about 3 cups.

title: Dee'S Mayo Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Beat by hand until it is mixed well. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done. Top with your favorite icing or pour powdered sugar mixed thin with milk on top and let cool.

title: Biscuits Supreme
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk all at once and stir just until dough is mixed. Roll out. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on cookie sheet. Bake in hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Steam or microwave broccoli until tender. Drain well. Combine all ingredients (except cracker crumbs) and blend with broccoli. Put in buttered casserole dish and sprinkle top with crumbs. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place slices of cheese over chicken. Mix soup and water together; pour over top. Spread crumbs on top then pour melted butter over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Korean Beef Stew
instructions: Rinse the beef with cold water and score with knife. Mix the soy sauce sugar kiwi sesame oil sesame seed black pepper and garlic to make the seasoning sauce. Marinate the meat in seasoning sauce for 15 minutes. Cut the carrots and radish into 2-inch pieces. Put the meat and sauce into a large saucepan and add 3 cups of water. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Add carrots and radishes; cook until tender. Serve with rice.

title: Seafood Fettucini
instructions: Melt margarine; stir in flour. Gradually add half and half; stir until thickened. Add cheese. Cook and stir until smooth. Fold in crab delights. Heat 3 minutes stirring occasionally. Toss fettucini with sauce. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: No Fail Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix water margarine and chocolate in a large heavy saucepan. Heat until chocolate is melted. Take from heat and add sugar eggs and sour cream mixing with a spoon. Sift in flour soda and salt. Mix well with a spoon. Do not overbeat. Stir in vanilla. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan in 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes. Test to see if top springs back when touched with your finger. Do not overbake.

title: Frosted Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in soda. Chill until partly set. Fold in pineapple marshmallows and bananas. Chill. Serve with topping.

title: Pineapple Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Pour into ready made graham cracker crust or crust of your choice.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Tabasco sauce and Worcestershire sauce may be adjusted to taste.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Divan
instructions: Place a layer of broccoli on bottom of casserole dish. Place layer of chicken on top of broccoli. Mix soup mayonnaise pepper lemon juice and curry powder together and spoon over chicken. Sprinkle cheese on top. Then over the cheese top with 1 cup buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Antipasto Rice(Servings:  4)
instructions: Combine water tomato juice rice basil oregano and salt in 2 to 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil; stir once or twice. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Stir in artichokes red peppers olives parsley lemon juice and black pepper. Cook 5 minutes longer or until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 8 servings.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients and pour in pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Fry strips and cut in 1-inch pieces. In a large saucepan boil water and bouillon cubes. Stir in sugar and cornstarch mix. Add oyster sauce and cook 1 or 2 minutes. Pour sauce over chicken strips and sprinkle with cashews and green onion slices. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Bread
instructions: Cream butter and 2 cups sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time until mixed thoroughly. Beat in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in flour sifted with baking powder and salt. In a separate bowl combine 4 teaspoons sugar cinnamon and pecans. Mix well. Spoon one-third of batter into greased bundt pan. Sprinkle with three-fourths of pecan mixture. Spoon in remaining batter and sprinkle with remaining pecan mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.

title: Rice And Corn Scallop
instructions: In a medium saucepan over low heat melt butter; add onion and cook a few minutes. Stir in flour. Slowly add milk keeping smooth. Cook stirring until thickened and bubbly. Stir in rice corn salt and pepper. Turn into an ungreased 1-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes. Sprinkle edges of casserole with parsley.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar gradually then add remaining ingredients. Should measure 10 cups. Put into freezer (electric) for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Crispy Fish Fry Batter
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and add to egg white. Add ice water. Mix until large lumps disappear. Rinse and towel dry 2 to 3 frozen fish. Spoon on batter. Deep fry in at least 1-inch of oil at 350\u00b0. Cook 7 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Homemade Mayonnaise
instructions: Blend all these ingredients in blender until smooth.

title: French Raspberry Pie
instructions: In a double boiler scald the milk with vanilla bean. Remove the bean. Mix the flour sugar and salt. Add a little of the scalded milk stirring until smooth. Add to the remaining milk in the double boiler and cook stirring until thickened. Beat together the egg yolks and the whole egg. Add a little of the hot mixture; stir until smooth. Add the remaining sauce. Cook over simmering water stirring constantly until the mixture has thickened. Strain the mixture. Cool and fold in the whipped cream. Turn into the baked pie shell; cover with raspberries. Melt the jelly over very low heat stirring; pour evenly over the raspberries. Chill.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook together until thick. Cool. Add berries and mix well. Pour into pie shell. Top with whipped cream when ready to eat. I like my berries sliced small or crush a little.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cook sweet potatoes about 25 minutes. Take cooked potatoes out to baking dish. Add sugars margarine and salt to water. Thicken with cornstarch dissolved in a little water. Boil until glassy (about 4 minutes). Pour over potatoes in baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apricot Muffins
instructions: In a small bowl combine apricots and water. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain and discard liquid. Set aside. In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add sour cream and mix well. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture just until moistened. Fold in orange peels nuts and apricots. Batter will be very stiff. Fill paper lined muffin pans 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Connie'S Popovers
instructions: Mix eggs milk salt and butter in medium size bowl. Add flour and mix until thoroughly combined. There should not be any lumps in mixture. Spray muffin tin lightly or grease with shortening. Fill muffin cups 1/2 full of batter. Put pan into cold oven and turn heat to 450\u00b0. Bake 30 minutes. Never open oven to peek during baking. After removing pan from the oven turn out popovers on wire rack. Poke holes in them with a toothpick to release steam. Serve immediately with butter honey or jam. Yields 12.

title: Low Calorie Drink
instructions: Add ice and blend in blender.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts; mix well. Add nuts mix again. Bake on a 9 x 13-inch greased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: Herman Duensing'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix cabbage pepper onion and celery in large casserole. Bring other ingredients to a boil and pour over the cabbage mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Keeps very well.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add food coloring eggs and vanilla. Sift flour cocoa and salt together 3 times. Add dry ingredients with buttermilk. Alternately beat until smooth. Mix vinegar and soda; fold into batter. Do not beat. Pour into 2 greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Asparagus Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes until almost tender. Add asparagus and cook until tender. When tender add cheese and simmer until melted. Thicken with flour and skim milk mixed together. Simmer until thick.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl. In another bowl combine egg zucchini oil and lemon peel. Mix wet ingredients with the dry ingredients just until moistened. Grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jerky(Beef Or Venison)
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Marinate 1 1/2 pounds meat cut in strips and fat trimmed away. (Marinate overnight.) Dry on racks in oven at 140\u00b0 about 12 hours. Keep oven door open slightly.

title: Calico Salad
instructions: Mix and drain first 3 ingredients. Mix next 4 ingredients and add to first 3 ingredients. Mix dissolve and pour the last 3 ingredients over vegetable mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Buttered Carrots And Celery
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a 2-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Drain. Add 2 tablespoons butter. Coat well. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Zucchini Crescent Quiche
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In 10-inch skillet cook zucchini and onion in margarine until tender about 10 minutes. Stir in parsley and seasonings. In large bowl blend eggs and cheese. Stir in vegetable mixture. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Place in ungreased quiche pan (or pie pan). Press over bottom and up the sides to form crust. Spread crust with mustard. Pour in vegetable mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chuck Steak With Vegetables
instructions: Place sliced onions in bottom of oblong baking pan. Put steak in pan and pour sauce over steak. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until almost done. Add potatoes and carrots. Bake until vegetables are tender.

title: Cherry Pudding
instructions: Mix oleo and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Fold in cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Curried Chicken Salad
instructions: Add soup mixture and rice to boiling water; simmer until water is absorbed. Stir to fluff. Cover and set aside to cool. When cold add remaining ingredients. Stir well and cover to chill.

title: Whiskey Slush
instructions: Place the tea bags in 2 cups boiling water; let stand until water is lukewarm. Squeeze bags and discard. Add 1/4 cup sugar; stir until dissolved. Add the 7 cups water lemonade and orange juice concentrates and whiskey. Freeze in a large Tupperware container at least 24 hours. Serve with 7-Up.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Melt oleo; add flour and nuts. Pack in long pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes; let cool.

title: Elegant Eggplant
instructions: Cook eggplant for 10 minutes until tender; drain well. Fry bacon until crisp. Stir in onion and potato; cook until onion is tender. Add eggplant and soup stirring well. Spoon into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients. Set aside. Whip the cream; add next 3 ingredients. Mix with cream cheese mixture. Chill.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix coconut and chopped nuts. Sprinkle in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix according to directions on package and pour over coconut and nuts. Melt margarine and add to cream cheese and powdered sugar. Spoon over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing.

title: Banana Nut Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Mix together thoroughly sugar shortening and eggs. Stir in buttermilk mashed bananas and flour then stir in soda and nuts. Pour batter in greased pan. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Fruit juices can be mixed together ahead of time and chilled but ginger ale should be added just before serving.

title: Getaway Salad
instructions: Stir pudding and pineapple with juice until well blended. Fold in the rest. Let set 2 hours before serving.

title: Fudgsicles
instructions: Combine pudding sugar milk and evaporated milk. Cook as directed on pudding package. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Put into molds and freeze 3 hours.

title: Meringue
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add lemon juice; add sugar gradually and beat thoroughly. Pile lightly on pie. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Use on any cream pie.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine flour baking powder sugar and salt. Set aside. Combine Bran cereal and milk; let set 2 minutes. Add egg oil and dry ingredients. Mix lightly. Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Tart Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch spring-form pan or 10-inch angel food tube pan. In a large bowl combine cake mix water oil and eggs at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at highest speed. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center. Cool cake in pan on cooling rack 15 minutes. Remove rim. Pierce top of cake with long-tined fork. Sprinkle with liqueur. Reserve 3 tablespoons of jelly; brush top of cake lightly with remaining jelly. Arrange strawberries pointed-ends-up in center of cake. Brush strawberries with reserved jelly. Spoon dollops of whipped cream around strawberries. Spread remaining whipped cream on side of cake. Garnish with mint. Store in refrigerator. Yields 16 servings.

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: Mix sugar and milk together. When boiling add dates. Stir until dates dissolve. Remove from heat; add margarine. Beat for a few minutes. Add nuts. Pour on a damp cloth then roll. Slice when cool.

title: Wheat-Germ Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat together oil sugar and eggs. Mix in orange peel vanilla and carrot. Combine wheat germ flour baking powder salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir into carrot mixture. Mix in raisins and pecans. Turn into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 60 to 70 minutes or until pick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan to rack to finish cooling. Serve with Cream Cheese Sauce. Yields 12 or more servings.

title: Lobster A La Newburg
instructions: Melt butter in top of double boiler and stir in butter. Add lobster meat then seasonings and sherry. Place over hot water. Beat egg yolks slightly; add cream and mix well. Combine with the lobster stirring to thicken.

title: Pie Corn Meal Apple Cake With Raisins
instructions: Cream butter with sugar in large bowl. Beat in eggs milk and vanilla. Sift flour corn meal salt and baking powder together. Alternate dry ingredients with liquid. Stir in raisins. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Put sliced apples on top (in rows). Sprinkle with mixture of cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Jambalaya
instructions: Cook bacon in saucepan until crisp. Do not drain off fat. Add rice then drained shrimp. Heat thoroughly.

title: Hot Artichoke Spread
instructions: Drain and chop artichokes. Mix with remaining ingredients; spread into a small attractive baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serve warm (with a knife) to spread on crackers.

title: Luscious Orange Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Add reserved orange juice a few drops at a time if mixture is too dry. Roll in small balls the size of walnuts. Roll each ball in extra confectioners sugar. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Party Wassail
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Heat thoroughly. Serve warm.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add cranberries and sugar. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water; add rest of ingredients. Combine all ingredients and knead. Let rise. Punch down and pat in pans. Makes 2 pizzas thick crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Tom'S Perfect Eggnog
instructions: Beat separately the yolks and whites of 6 fresh eggs. Add 1/2 cup of sugar to the yolks while beating and 1/4 cup of sugar to the whites after they have been beaten very stiff. Mix the egg whites with the yolks. Stir in 1 pint of rich cream and 1 quart of milk. Then add 1 pint of good bourbon whiskey. Stir thoroughly and serve very cold with grated nutmeg on each glass. Yield 6 pints of eggnog.

title: Old-Fashioned Nine-Day Slaw
instructions: Combine oil vinegar sugar celery seed salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and pour over chopped vegetables. Let stand at least 2 hours before serving. This will keep 9 days longer if refrigerated.

title: Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix sweet milk and vinegar together and let set while preparing the rest. Mix in bowl the sugar and flour. Bring to a boil the water shortening oleo and cocoa. Pour liquid vanilla soda and eggs over dry ingredients. Add milk. Mix well and pour into ungreased sheet cake pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage carrots and onion. Bring to boil sugar and vinegar; set aside to cool. Mix mayonnaise mustard and red pepper. Add vinegar to cabbage and mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Chill. This will keep several weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Aunt Ruth'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and cornstarch; add egg yolks. Mix in cream slowly. Cook until thick add butter and vanilla. Cream well. Pour into baked pie shell. Add meringue and bake at 400\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Celebration Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry shell; set aside. Beat eggs slightly in small mixer bowl; gradually add sugar. Add melted butter or margarine and bourbon or vanilla; mix well. Blend in cornstarch. Stir in pecans and chocolate chips; pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool 1 hour and serve warm with a dollop of Festive Whipped Cream (see recipe following). Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Scratch Lasagne
instructions: Mix together the cottage cheese Parmesan cheese parsley flakes beaten eggs and black pepper. Brown meat slowly and spoon off excess fat. Add spaghetti sauce to meat after browning and bring to boil.

title: Macaroon Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt butter. Remove from heat. Mix in salt vanilla sugar and eggs. Stir in coconut. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet. Cook for 15 minutes.

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a plastic bag. Toss until coated. Spread on sprayed cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes stirring often until done.

title: Hot Cranberry Cider
instructions: In saucepan bring ingredients to boil. Reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes. Remove spices and serve.

title: Icebox Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a graham cracker crust. Leave in refrigerator for several hours before serving.

title: Tandy Takes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. While warm spread peanut butter on top. Refrigerate until cool. Melt 8 oz. Hershey Candy bar or chocolate chips. Spread over cake. Cut into pieces.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat until light and fluffy the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Add to creamed mixture. Chill. Roll out on board floured with powdered sugar. Bake on greased cookie sheet for 8 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cut out with your favorite cookie cutters.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Slice steak into very thin strips. Brown then remove from skillet. Saute peppers onions and celery in skillet. Put meat back in skillet and add tomatoes and 1/2 cup water salt pepper and soy sauce. Simmer about 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours until meat is real tender. Serve over noodles rice or shells.

title: Cough Syrup
instructions: This is strong but effective. Stir all ingredients together well. Do not give to children 4 and under. Children over 4 give 1/4 teaspoon 2 times a day and adults take 1 teaspoon.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Put 1 stick of butter in bottom of casserole dish and melt in oven. Mix milk sugar and flour together. Add peaches to butter. Pour milk sugar and flour mixture on top of peaches and bake until golden brown.

title: Delicious Salmon Marinade
instructions: Salt salmon. Combine onions vinegar and water. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add salmon steaks in flat skillet. Do not layer fish as they will fall apart. Cook 20 minutes on low heat. Add spices and sugar; continue cooking for 5 minutes. Cool fish before removing from pan. The liquid will jell into an aspic. Recipe can be used for appetizer or a main dish.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients; stir in oats and nuts. Cream butter with sugars and eggs until fluffy. Add vanilla and dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Cut 1/2 cup butter into flour with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly 3 or 4 times.

title: English Muffin Appetizers
instructions: Blend softened butter and cheese. Add mayonnaise and seasonings. Drain and fluff crab meat. Add to cheese.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine pumpkin egg yolks (beaten) sugar and spices then very slowly add the egg whites (beaten) and the milk. Bake in low part of oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter until fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time and beat each. Sift together flour salt and baking soda and stir into mixture. Add sour cream and mix. Add extracts rum and brandy and mix. Pour into well-greased well-floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 to 80 minutes until done.

title: Easy Venison Meat Ball Casserole
instructions: Form venison into golf ball size balls. Slice potatoes onto top of venison. Slice Velveeta cheese and cover top of potatoes and venison. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

title: Biscuit Upside-Down Coffee Cake
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of margarine and pour into bottom of a tube pan or 8-inch round or square pan. Sprinkle in order the brown sugar nuts cherries and maple syrup. Set aside.

title: Brisket(An Old Family Recipe)
instructions: Wash the brisket. Mix salt garlic paprika and pepper. Rub spice mixture over both sides of the brisket. Put brisket in roasting pan uncovered and place under the broiler. If your oven can accommodate place it as far from the broiler as you can so that the searing can be slow. Remove when meat is slightly seared. Turn meat and repeat. Add onions and water. Cover and cook slowly on top of stove until tender (about three hours). Chill and remove fat. Slice meat cross grain and return to juice. Serve hot in juice or cold for sandwiches.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon. Arrange dried beef in a 9 x 13-inch pan (or smaller). Place chicken on dried beef. Combine soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Booyah
instructions: In a large pot combine chicken beef bone onions carrots celery salt pepper and water. Cover and cook for 2 hours. Remove beef bone and chicken meat from bones. Add cabbage and potatoes. Also add chicken meat; cook for 1 hour. Add tomato paste whole tomatoes and peas. Cover and simmer 1 hour.

title: Rocky Road Brownies
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup chocolate chips and butter over low heat. Cool. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour sugar baking powder vanilla salt eggs and chocolate mixture. Spread in an ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch square pan. Bake 15 minutes. Sprinkle with marshmallows nuts and remaining chocolate chips. Bake until marshmallows are golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean about 15 to 20 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into slices.

title: White Beans, Yellow Squash And Tomatoes Stew
instructions: In a heavy 6-quart Dutch oven heat the olive oil over medium heat for 1 minute. Add onions garlic and celery and cook uncovered until the onion and celery are soft 5 to 8 minutes. Add tomatoes squash lima beans wine and the seasonings. Simmer uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes. Add the white beans stir and simmer 5 minutes more. Stir in the lemon juice.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients. Add mayonnaise to moisten. Garnish with tomato sections and hard-boiled eggs.

title: Karen'S Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Mix apples with cinnamon and sugar; let stand. Sift dry ingredients and then beat in eggs oil and juice. Place half mixture in greased and floured Bundt pan. Add apples in middle. Add rest of cake mix. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Carbonnade Flamande(Round Steak With Gravy)
instructions: Cook onions in butter in heavy pan until tender. Remove and keep to one side. Brown meat on all sides then add cooked onions salt pepper garlic nutmeg thyme bay leaf beer and meat stock. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Remove meat and keep hot. Discard garlic and bay leaf. Blend flour butter and sugar together and combine with pan juices. Cook until thickened. Taste for seasonings. Adjust pour over meat sprinkle with parsley and serve with boiled potatoes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hawaiian Pudding
instructions: Crumble vanilla wafers in 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt butter and pour over wafers. Slice bananas over wafers. Mix Eagle Brand and lemon juice; pour over bananas. Cover completely. Drain pineapple and pour over mixture. Drain strawberries and place on pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Diabetic - Pioneer Cornbread
instructions: Beat egg until light and lemon colored. Add skim milk maple syrup and margarine. Combine cornmeal flour baking powder and salt in large bowl; stir to blend. Gradually add flour mixture to liquid. Pour into greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 9 squares.

title: Chinese Chicken And Rice
instructions: Dip chicken in flour and brown in hot oil. Drain and arrange in another skillet. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly done. Thicken with a mixture of cornstarch and water. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Spaetzle
instructions: In 6-quart Dutch oven over high heat heat 4 quarts water and 1 teaspoon salt to boiling. In medium bowl with whisk or spoon beat flour 1/2 cup water eggs and 1/2 teaspoon salt until smooth. Reduce heat to medium over boiling water with rubber spatula. Press batter through colander. Stir water gently so Spaetzle will not stick together. Boil 5 minutes or until tender but firm; drain.

title: Mints
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixer. Add more sugar to make firm. Roll between wax paper. Cut with center of doughnut cutter. Decorate as desired. May also be tinted with food coloring. Makes 125 to 150 mints.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes. Split potatoes in half. Carefully scoop out potato. Save shell. Mash the potatoes. Add sour cream 1 cup Cheddar cheese and salt and pepper. Refill potato shells. Top with remaining cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar eggs oil vanilla and half and half. Stir together remaining ingredients and add to the first mixture. Bake 1 1/4 hours or until done in a well-greased tube pan in a 325\u00b0 oven. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan. Pour hot icing over cake.

title: Applesauce Low-Fat Muffins
instructions: In a mixing bowl stir together flour baking powder soda cinnamon and salt. Make a well in the center. In a small mixing bowl beat egg slightly. Stir in applesauce orange peel orange juice and cooking oil. Add all at once to flour mixture. Stir until moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Spray 12 muffin cups. Divide batter evenly in muffin cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Bible Time Bread
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add shortening and use a fork to blend it in. Then add milk and mix well with your hands. Roll dough on floured surface and use any size cutter you choose. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 5 to 9 minutes. They brown very easily. Kids love this recipe.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Simmer hamburger spaghetti sauce tomato sauce water and seasonings for 1/2 hour. Add pepperoni and mushrooms and simmer for 1/2 hour. Cook noodles. Mix sauce and noodles in 2 (13 x 9-inch) pans. Top with cheese. Bake until cheese melts.

title: Heath Bar Dessert
instructions: Mix together and press in cake pan.

title: Baked Squash Souffle
instructions: Combine all ingredients together except butter. Mix well. Pour into a greased Pyrex dish and dot with the butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set (approximately 20 minutes). Serve immediately.

title: Buggy Wheels
instructions: Wash vegetables. Cut carrots into circles and celery into sticks. Attach carrots with toothpicks to front and back sides of celery to make wheels. Spread peanut butter inside celery sticks. Add raisins on top of peanut butter. Eat.

title: Rocky Road Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except marshmallows and melt over medium heat stirring occasionally. Cool until barely warm. Add marshmallows and mix well. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate until cool and cut into pieces.

title: Oven Pork Chops
instructions: Spread pork chops on both sides with mustard. Mix flour salt and pepper together in a pie pan. Dip pork chops in flour mixture and coat both sides. Brown in oil in skillet until brown on both sides. Place in a 9 x 13 dish and pour 1 can of soup and 1 can of water over chops. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Sauce is gravy.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise. Beat until smooth. Blend in remaining ingredients. Mix well chill and serve with crackers. Yields 2 cups. Best when refrigerated overnight.

title: Microwave Poppycock(It'S Oh, So Good!)
instructions: In 2 qt microwave safe bowl cook butter syrup and granulated sugar on high for about 14 minutes or to the hard ball stage. Syrup will have a butterscotch color when ready. Stir in vanilla.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and butter together. Set aside. Melt peanut butter and Reeses chips together. You may need to reheat chocolate. Line cupcake pans with 12 cupcake liners. Start with a spoonful of chocolate mix then peanut butter mix then chocolate mix again. Makes about 12 Reeses cups. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Combine chicken onion bay leaves salt and pepper; boil. Reduce heat; simmer covered until chicken is tender for 1 hour. Remove chicken; cool debone and cut into pieces. Add remaining ingredients; simmer 25 minutes.

title: Brown Bears In An Apple Orchard(Method:  Skillet Or Dutch Oven)
instructions: Pour applesauce into one large or two small skillets. If applesauce is too thick add up to 1/2 cup water. Heat applesauce until boiling. Prepare gingerbread batter according to package directions. (*You may also need eggs and/or oil.)

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix sugar pumpkin shortening and orange peel. Stir in flour baking powder baking soda cinnamon and salt. Stir in raisins and nuts.

title: Quick And Great 7 Can Soup
instructions: Drain meat well and add the 7 cans with juices. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours at least to allow the flavors to blend. Wonderful with cornbread and freezes great!

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Blend dry ingredients in bowl until well mixed. Combine oil eggs water and pumpkin; beat until well blended. Add dry ingredients slowly and beat well. Stir in nuts (walnuts or pecans). Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Red Potato Casserole
instructions: Slice potatoes. Mix remaining ingredients and put in 11 x 13-inch casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Neiman - Marcus Bars
instructions: Mix together cake mix 1 egg and butter; pat down in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and pat down. Top with 2 eggs vanilla cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix well and pour on top. Bake approximately 1 hour until brown. Cool before cutting.

title: Braunschweiger Spread
instructions: Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Stuffed Squash
instructions: Cook halved squash in pan with 1/2-inch water in bottom at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Make up white sauce. Season with thyme and basil to taste. Add garlic onion dash of Tabasco and mustard. Stir sauce to combine then add ham. Spoon creamed ham into squash halves. Return to oven until heated through. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Strawstacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels with peanut butter. Add Chinese noodles and mix thoroughly and drop by teaspoonfuls on greased paper.

title: Chile Relleno Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Layer chilies and cheeses in buttered 9 x 13-inch Pyrex baking pan (starting with chiles and ending with cheeses). Beat eggs. Add milk Bisquick and salt. Mix well. Pour over chilies and cheeses. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Uncle Louie'S Mexican Rice
instructions: In a large skillet saute rice in hot oil stirring constantly. As rice turns gold lower heat; add onion garlic chili powder cumin and green pepper. Saute until onion is glazed. Add tomatoes sauce cilantro salt and pepper then add hot water to rice slowly covering over the top 1/2-inch. Bring to a boil; turn down heat cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add more hot water during cooking if needed. If you choose to add meat add during simmer stage.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions in the boiling salted water for 20 minutes and drain. At the same time in 1 cup of water cook the celery with the onion soup until the celery is tender. Add it to the noodles along with the 2 cans of undiluted soups and the cut up boned chicken. Mix well. Pour into a large greased casserole. Sprinkle liberally with the bread crumbs parsley flakes and paprika. Put into 350\u00b0 oven until nicely browned.

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Microwave grits water and salt for 2 minutes or until grits are thickened and tender. Add butter bacon sauce and pepper. Stir in eggs; scrape mixture into medium baking dish sprayed with nonstick spray. Sprinkle with cheese bread crumbs and sprinkles. Bake until puffy and golden brown about 45 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until thick and foamy. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff. Fold in rest. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drop cookies onto sheet in small peaked chunks. Place in oven; turn oven off after counting to 5. Leave undisturbed until morning. Makes 40 small cookies. If you double recipe can use 1 1/2 cups nuts.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Cook over double boiler until it coats a spoon completely no longer about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Turkey Hind Quarters With Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Slice onion and place in bottom of baking pan. Place turkey on top of onion. Dilute mushroom soup with 1/2 can water. Pour the soup over all. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and pour in 9 x 13 pan. Spray with Pam. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Mushroom Sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan cook onion in butter until tender but not browned. Stir in flour. Drain mushrooms. Stir in mushrooms milk salt and pepper. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir in sour cream; heat through. Serve with poultry beef pork or burgers.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients then add corn. Cook about an hour at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0. This is a recipe of Sara Williamsons grandmother. It is so easy and delicious!

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Whiz all ingredients except poppy seed in blender. Remove from blender and stir in poppy seed. Chill and serve.

title: Party Mini Pizzas
instructions: Brown sausage and ground beef. Drain. Add cheese and stir until melted. Put small amount of mixture on rye bread slices not quite covering the top of each slice. Sprinkle with oregano. May be frozen prior to baking and kept in a Ziploc bag for future use. Bake on cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. If frozen bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese starts to bubble.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Caps
instructions: Soak mushrooms in cold water for a short time. Take out stems and chop in fine pieces. Lay caps on paper towels to dry. Saute onions stems garlic powder celery salt salt and pepper in butter. Add stuffing. Add enough herb seasoning to create the consistency or flavoring you desire. Mixture should be moist but not wet. Place caps on lightly buttered flat cookie sheet. Pack caps gently. Pour melted butter over all mushroom caps. Bake for 15 minutes in oven preheated to 350\u00b0.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine and chocolate or cocoa mixture. Beat eggs and sugar together. Add butter and chocolate mixture and vanilla. Gradually add flour and baking powder. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes longer if you want dryer brownies.

title: Banana-Pineapple Frosty Punch
instructions: Boil water and sugar; cool. Put bananas in blender with a little juice and puree. Mix everything together except 7-Up. Freeze in 3 equal portions. Take out of freezer 2 hours before serving. Mix each container with 1 quart 7-Up as needed.

title: Cold Cucumber Soup
instructions: Saute cucumbers and onions in butter until soft but not brown. Sprinkle with flour. Cook 3 minutes. Add chicken broth. Process in blender or food processor until smooth. Return to stove and cook 15 minutes. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Immediately before serving add cream. Sprinkle with cherries.

title: Perfect Potato Salad
instructions: Sprinkle potatoes with vinegar and sugar. Add onion pickle seasonings and mayonnaise. Toss to blend carefully. Fold in egg slices. Chill. Makes 4 servings.

title: Black Midnight Cake
instructions: Sift together flour cocoa baking powder baking soda and salt together. Add water vanilla shortening sugar eggs. Serves 8.

title: Pineapple Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Combine pudding mix pineapple with juice sour cream and sugar. Beat slowly with rotary beater or at lowest speed on electric mixer for 1 minute. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill 3 hours before serving.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Last Minute Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Spread cream cheese thinly on ham slice. Place pickle on edge of ham and roll-up. Cut into slices. Secure with toothpick if necessary.

title: Barbecue Tuna(Diet)
instructions: Combine and simmer about 45 minutes until celery is tender. Good with French-style green beans or bean sprouts.

title: Magnificent Mandarin Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add cold water. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in fruit. Pour into 9 inch round or square dish. Chill until set. Combine whipped cream salad dressing and marshmallows. Spoon over jello. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Pie, Texas Style
instructions: Mix the ingredients and pour into cookie crumb crust. Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: In 13 x 9-inch pan layer chicken soups sour cream and dry mix. Pour broth over stuffing mix and finish with melted butter or margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown about 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Pilaf Creole
instructions: Fry bacon until brown in a large saucepan or Dutch oven. Add onions and fry until onions are clear. Add tomato paste along with water. Bring to a boil and add shrimp. Add parsley flakes and garlic salt.

title: Pork Chops And Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Brown the pork chops in frying pan. Pour mushroom soup with one can of water. Simmer until tender.

title: Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Toss grated cheese and flour. Mix eggs milk and salt. Pour mixture into bowl with cheese and flour. Add broccoli. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cousin Corinda'S Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix like any other cake flour fruits with the flour given. Wine or brandy may be added if desired. Bake two hours in a slow oven. I added lots more fruit of all kinds and nut meats and then added a wine glass of brandy and one of wine. But do not add any more flour even though you add the extra liquid.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: *Can substitute part honey for sugar if you wish. I do.

title: Beef And Beans Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Put in baking dish. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serve as side dish or serve on a bun as a sandwich.

title: Edith'S Mock Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat well all except beans. Add beans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake until pie is firm about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: White Velvet Cutout Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese add sugar and egg yolks then add remaining ingredients. Chill for at least 1 hour. Roll out on lightly floured board. Cut into shapes. Bake at 350 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Divinity
instructions: Pray before you start!\tThen place in saucepan over low heat the sugar corn syrup and\twater.\tStir until sugar is dissolved;\tthen cook without stirring to 252\u00b0\t(a little dropped into cold water forms a hard ball). Remove from heat and pour beating constantly in a fine stream into the egg whites that have been stiffly beaten. Continue beating until mixture holds its shape and loses\tits gloss. Then add the vanilla and nuts. Drop quickly from tip of spoon onto waxed paper in individual peaks or spread in greased shallow pan and cut into 1-inch squares when firm. Makes about 1 1/4 pounds.

title: Chocolate Saltines
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with foil butter the foil and line with Saltine Crackers. Melt Butter and Sugar and boil 3 minutes. Pour sugar mixture over crackers and bake in preheated 350 oven for 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and immediately sprinkle the whole package of Chocolate Chips over crackers. Spread out chocolate as it melts to coat and entire pan evenly. Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate overnight. Break into pieces and serve.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in a large Tupperware bowl as listed. Then mix 2 cups of mayonnaise and 2 tablespoons sugar. Spread on top of the layered ingredients in the bowl. Sprinkle 4 ounces of Cheddar cheese on top. Put tight lid on and refrigerate for 8 to 10 hours. Serve.

title: Peach Fizz
instructions: Place the unpeeled peach with banana mineral water ice and vanilla if desired in a blender. Process on high speed until frothy. Serve in tall chilled glasses garnish with mint sprigs if desired. Makes 2 servings.

title: Veggie Wraps
instructions: Saute all veggies in 2 tablespoons olive oil till tender crisp. Sprinkle with seasonings. Add corn and black beans. Place veggies on warm wrappers with sour cream. Roll up.

title: Turkey Hot Dish
instructions: Melt butter add flour and milk slowly. Add soups when thickened add the cut up meat. Serve over split baking powder biscuits. A small can of peas or pea/carrot mixture can be added if desired.

title: Sugar Cookie Crust
instructions: Freeze cookie dough for 1 hour. Slice into 1/8-inch slices. Arrange slices slightly overlapping on bottom and sides of greased 9-inch spring-form pan. With lightly floured fingers seal edges to form crust.

title: Orange Cranberry Bread
instructions: Cream sugar applesauce egg whites orange juice and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Fold in cranberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Springtime Pie
instructions: Divide rolls into triangles and line a 9-inch pie pan. Fill with mixture of remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Baked Beef Stew
instructions: Grease an 11 x 16 x 2-inch baking pan. Cut beef into 1/2-inch cubes; sprinkle in pan evenly. Add 1 cup of tomato juice to pan; cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 hour in a 300\u00b0 oven. Take out and add vegetables in layers. Mix dry ingredients; sprinkle over vegetables. Add 1 cup tomato juice or more if needed. Again cover with aluminum foil. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 2 hours or until tender. Check beef for tenderness.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni rinse with hot water. Add remaining ingredients to your own taste. (This should be made the day before you need it for flavors to blend.)

title: Men'S Favorite Cole Slaw
instructions: Put shredded cabbage in bowl; mix in onion cottage cheese and mayonnaise. Toss thoroughly. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Fry sausage until brown; cut in small pieces and place in bottom of shell. Sprinkle with cheese. In bowl beat eggs; add cream and nutmeg. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Potted Plant
instructions: Mix together well and set aside. In a food processor or blender cut up fine 1 package Oreo or chocolate cream filled cookies (12 to 16 ounces). Press 1/2 of cookie crumbs on side of bowl. Pour in cream cheese mixture. Top with rest of crumbled cookies. Put foil around bowl to look like a potted plant.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Mushroom-Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Melt 1/4 pound of butter in a skillet. Add the mushrooms salt and pepper; cook stirring often until the mushrooms turn very dark and absorb all the butter. Remove from the heat and stir in 3/4 cup of the bread crumbs and the nutmeg. Divide the mushroom stuffing into 8 portions and place a portion in the center of each chicken. Fold the chicken around the stuffing and place seam side down in a shallow casserole dish. Melt the remaining 4 tablespoons of butter and brush over the chicken. Sprinkle with the remaining 3/4 cup bread crumbs. Pour on the cream and bake for 30 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Mom Bordies Strawberry Mousse
instructions: Custard In double boiler add 5 egg yolks 1/2 cup sugar and 1 cup of simmered milk. Cook until thickened.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Sift flour and add salt nuts and cheese. Add softened butter. Make in roll and place in refrigerator. When chilled slice into thin wafers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar baking powder and flour. Cut in butter. Add milk and stir only until mixed together. Spread in a greased baking dish (large enough so liquid wont boil over). Pour fruit 1 cup brown sugar and water over the batter. Bake about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. When baked crust will be on top.

title: Jello Pudding Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour and soda. Combine butter sugars vanilla and pudding mix. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour and stir in chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Holly Berry Salad
instructions: Boil red hots in water until candy is dissolved. Add jello; stir to dissolve. Cool. When slightly thickened add applesauce celery and nuts. Pour into well-oiled 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until set. Top each serving with dressing made of whipped cream mayonnaise cinnamon and green coloring.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cut broccoli into small pieces. Cook on low in chicken broth until tender. Combine remaining ingredients except cheese. Bring to a boil. Turn soup on low and add shredded cheese. Serve after cheese melts.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large skillet cook meat and onion until meat is lightly browned and onion is tender. Add salt and pepper. Add drained beans and soups; pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Mash potatoes while hot. Add milk and egg. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon in mounds over casserole. Sprinkle potatoes with cheese. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Shrimp
instructions: In a large skillet combine pineapple juice water lemon juice sugar cornstarch soy sauce and ginger. Over medium heat cook and stir until thickened. Add shrimp. Cook until pink. Add remaining ingredients except rice. Heat through. Serve over rice.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Wash squash trim ends and slice. Cook squash and onion in salted water. Drain well and mash. Mix sour cream cream of mushroom soup eggs and cheese (and mushrooms and/or bacon if desired) and pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers and pour melted butter on top. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Arrange in loaf pan in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip if desired.

title: No Crust Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Spray 9-inch pie plate with all-vegetable spray. Beat cream cheese and sugar; add biscuit mix. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add pumpkin and seasonings. Pour into pie plate; bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes or until center is set.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Butter a 9-inch pie pan. Blend all items and pour into pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until custard sets about 25 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt to consistency of corn meal. Add egg and vinegar to the 1/3 cup water and blend together. Then add to flour mixture and mix.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on package. Mix together eggs (beaten) evaporated milk sweet milk and salt. Add macaroni and pour into greased baking dish. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Spray pan with Pam.

title: Red And Green Apple Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except walnuts. Refrigerate. Sprinkle with walnuts if desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fish Stew
instructions: Cook diced bacon and onion until sauteed. Add tomatoes and potatoes; cook 15 minutes. Add other ingredients; simmer until done. Fish stock can be used for water. Serve.

title: Turkey Pie
instructions: Combine 6 ingredients together. Pour into bottom of pie shell and dot with margarine. Add layer of cheese and top crust. Bake until brown at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Pick over canned fish. Remove skin and bones. Add onion salt and pepper to taste. Separate eggs; add beaten yolks to mixture. Last add the beaten egg whites. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake for 3/4 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Green Bean Dinner In The Bag
instructions: Shake flour in large size Reynolds oven bag (14 x 20-inch); place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Add soup green beans chicken broth pepper and 1/2 can of onions to bag. Squeeze bag to blend in flour. Arrange ingredients in even layer. Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt and pepper. Place chicken in bag; sprinkle with remaining onions. Close bag with nylon tie. Cut six 1/2-inch slits in top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Meatballs In Gravy
instructions: Salt hamburger meat and dice onion into meat. Make into meatballs. Fry until brown. Make water gravy. (Brown flour in grease; add salt and pepper. Use water instead of milk.) Add bouillon cubes. Return meat to gravy; simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Break lettuce in a 9 x 12-inch glass pan. Layer rest of ingredients as listed. Mix salad dressing and sugar. Spread over top covering entire top. Sprinkle with cheese and refrigerate 8 to 10 hours before serving.

title: Venus De Milo Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add meat and brown. Drain fat. Add tomatoes and Veg-All. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water. Cook orzo and drain. Add to soup and let simmer for approximately 1 hour. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Aunt Lola White'S Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Soften oleo and cream cheese. Cream together with sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add vanilla and orange or lemon extract and flour; beat. Pour in well-greased (with Pam) Bundt pan. Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Salad
instructions: This is a super fantastic salad. Try it! Youll like it!

title: Rice And Garbanzo Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together chill and serve.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs milk and sugar together until well mixed. Add remaining ingredients; blend thoroughly. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix instant pudding and milk together. Add sour cream and whipped topping. Mix well. Make layer of vanilla wafers bananas and topping. Repeat until all topping is used. Set in refrigerator overnight.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Mix all together. More flour may be needed to roll out. Cut out and fry in hot Crisco.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Boil water and add noodles. Cook and drain. Cook ground meat with onion. Drain off grease. Add tomato sauce water sugar spices and salt. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Layer noodles sauce and cheese. Let cheese be on top layer and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: At Home Shake And Bake
instructions: Mix. Put in plastic bag. Wash off meat with water. (Do not dip in egg.) Put meat in bag and shake until covered. Bake on cookie sheet. Use any meat according to recipe.

title: Package Mix Pound Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix sour cream oil sugar water and eggs. Beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Bake in greased tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix well margarine brown sugar egg buttermilk baking soda flour vanilla and rhubarb.

title: Cranberry Liqueur
instructions: Chop cranberries 4 cups at a time in 2 (1/2 gallon) jars. Add sugar and gin cover and shake hard for 5 seconds. Store in a cool place. Shake each day for 3 weeks. Strain well. Makes 6 cups. Use nonmetallic lids.

title: Old Fashioned Ice Cream
instructions: Beat 2 egg whites until stiff and set aside. Beat rest of eggs with sugar and salt. Add milks and vanilla. Fold in egg whites and make in a gallon freezer. May add fresh or canned fruits.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add 1/2 can of onion rings. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onion rings; bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Spring Temptation Pie
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in medium bowl for 2 minutes or until completely dissolved. Stir in sherbet. Mix until melted. Refrigerate 25 minutes or until gelatin mixture is slightly thickened. Fold in whipped topping marshmallows and pineapple. Pour into crust. Freeze until firm or refrigerate overnight. May cover with plastic cover from graham crust pan. Makes 6 to 8 servings. If frozen leave at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Dropkin Quiche
instructions: Bake pie crust according to package. Pour in ingredients. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serves two people.

title: Lillian Green'S Pink Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix the sour cream and the few drops of red food coloring. Add all the other ingredients and stir well. If you use the colored marshmallows you may omit the food coloring. If desired you may use a smaller can of fruit cocktail and half the marshmallows. Is good for a week.

title: Picante Dip
instructions: Cube Velveeta. Combine with milk and picante sauce in saucepan over low heat. Heat until sauce is smooth. Serve with chips Bugles or vegetable dippers.

title: Cheese Roll(Club Member: Brandi Cook)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except peanuts. Make sure its mixed well then roll it into a ball. Roll onto wax paper with the peanuts. Keep it cool.

title: Pretzel Jello Dessert
instructions: Crush the pretzels. Mix with 3 tablespoons sugar and the 3/4 cup margarine. Press into a 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool.

title: Pork 'N Potato Bake
instructions: Brown chops on both sides. Meanwhile slice potatoes thin as for scalloped potatoes. Arrange potatoes in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Top with browned chops. Mix soup with milk and pour it over potatoes and chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for an hour. Serves 4.

title: Goulash
instructions: Boil macaroni then drain. While macaroni is cooking brown meat in a frying pan. Drain off most of grease. Next add celery onion peppers seasonings and tomato sauce. Heat good then add drained macaroni. Heat good making sure to stir well.

title: Orange Nut Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl. Add nuts melted shortening egg orange juice and peel. Stir until dampened but not smooth. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Boxcar Children'S Cherry Dumplings
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Unroll dough and divide dough into 4 rectangles. Roll each piece larger. Put 1/3 cup of the pie filling in center of each dough. Seal dumpling by bringing opposite corners up over cherry filling and pinch together. Do same with other 2 corners. Put dumplings into greased baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon sugar on each dumpling. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool before serving.

title: Wholesome Joes
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat brown beef with onion and garlic; drain well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes or until lentils are tender. Spoon 1/2 cup mixture into each bun. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Cook cauliflower until tender. Save 2 cups of water and dissolve bouillon in water set aside. Saute diced onions in margarine. Add 2 cans soup to onions and stir until smooth. Add broth and milk and stir until smooth. Cook over medium heat. In a saucepan cut up cheese into chunks and add about 2 cups soup mixture to cheese. Cook until cheese melts (stir). Add cheese mixture to soup mixture. Add vegetables salt and pepper to taste. Stir constantly.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: In saucepan heat together butter and water just to boiling stirring to melt butter. Sift together powdered sugar dry milk powder and cocoa. (If mixture seems lumpy sift again.) Add the butter mixture; stir until well combined. Stir in nuts. Turn into a buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Cover and chill several hours or until firm. Cut into squares. Makes about 1 1/2 pounds candy.

title: Peach Pie Supreme
instructions: Slice peaches and add to unbaked pie shell. Set aside. Mix remaining ingredients together and then pour over peaches. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Loaf
instructions: Grease loaf pan. Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Beat egg and then add juice. Mix. Stir in berries and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve with fresh fruit.

title: Freezer Cucumber Chips(Pickles)
instructions: In large bowl combine cucumbers onions salt and water. Let stand 2 hours. Drain liquid and squeeze the vegetables by handfuls to extract more moisture. Add remaining ingredients and stir until sugar is dissolved. Spoon into freezer containers. Cover tightly. Freeze at least overnight before serving. Thaw 4 hours and serve. Makes 3 pints.

title: Peanut Butter Crust
instructions: Melt marshmallows with peanut butter and butter in pan over low heat. Stir until melted and well blended. Remove from heat. Stir in corn flakes until well coated. Press firmly onto bottom and sides of greased 9-inch pie plate. Chill.

title: Homemade Fudge
instructions: Grease large platter or pan with butter oleo or Crisco. Mix sugar and cocoa together thoroughly. Add Karo milk salt and butter. Stir well until all is mixed well except butter. It will still be in large chunks. Cook (but do not stir) until butter melts then stir occasionally until candy forms soft ball in cup of cold water. Ive found this does not do well if I use a candy thermometer to test for soft ball. After soft ball is formed take off heat and add vanilla. Cool about 10 minutes then beat by hand with large spoon until candy begins to thicken. Add about teaspoon of cold milk every now and then if candy begins to get too thick to stir. Beat until it gets a glossy look add pecans and continue beating until very thick and pour on well-greased platter or pan. Let cool for about 30 minutes at room temperature and then cut in squares. Yields about 20 to 25 pieces depending on size you cut the squares.

title: Hamburger Gravy
instructions: Brown hamburger drain add onions salt pepper bouillon cubes soup and water. Simmer and serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Drain salmon before mixing and reserve 2 tablespoons juice from salmon. Mix salmon egg and onion until sticky. Stir in flour. Add baking powder to juice then stir into mixture. Form into patties and fry in hot Crisco.

title: Baked Potato Skins
instructions: Bake potatoes in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes or until well done (theyll give when squeezed). Remove from oven and let them cool a bit. Then slice in half. Scoop out insides and refrigerate until needed (they can be used later as hash browns). Add cheese or crumbled bacon bits to hollowed-out skin and rebake for about 10 minutes or until golden brown and cheese is melted. Serve with plenty of sour cream. Serves 4 people.

title: French Toast
instructions: Mix until frothy. Dip slice of bread in mixture and put in pan with 1 tablespoon butter. Fry until browned.

title: Dandelion Blossom Stir-Fry
instructions: Wash blossoms thoroughly in salted water (salt draws out any insects). Drain thoroughly on paper towel. Prepare pancake batter your recipe or packaged mix. Dip blossoms in batter and fry quickly in oil heated to 365\u00b0 to 375\u00b0; blossoms need only 1 to 2 minutes to fry crisp and browned. Drain on paper towel. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour over dressing mix. Sprinkle remaining dressing mix over and pour 1 can cream of chicken soup (undiluted) over. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Sprinkle 3/4 cup grated cheese over top the last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Shrimp And Artichoke First Course
instructions: Toss avocado with lemon juice until well coated. Drain. Remove center petals and chokes from artichokes. Spoon 1 tablespoon cocktail sauce into center of each one. Toss avocado with shrimp and spoon into artichokes. Top each with a tablespoon of cocktail sauce. Garnish with parsley sprigs. Serves 4.

title: Indoor S'Mores
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Heat corn syrup margarine and chocolate chips to boiling point in 3-quart saucepan stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour over cereal in large bowl. Toss quickly until all cereal is coated. Fold in marshmallows one cup at a time. Press evenly in buttered pan. Let stand until firm. Cut in squares. Makes 48.

title: Chicken And Beef Casserole
instructions: Place dried beef in large baking dish. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Arrange in prepared baking dish. Top each chicken breast with 1/2 slice bacon. Combine sour cream and soup in bowl; mix well. Spoon over chicken. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Bake covered for 1 hour longer. Yield 6 servings.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored gradually beat in 1/4 cup sugar. Add vanilla. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks form. Fold yolks into whites. Sift together flour baking powder and salt fold into egg mixture. Spread batter evenly over greased waxed paper-lined 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) about 12 minutes or until done. Loosen sides turn out on towel sprinkled with sifted confectioners sugar. Peel off paper and trim crusts. Starting at narrow end roll cake and towel together cool on rack. Unroll spread with favorite filling roll up. Makes ten (1-inch) slices. Filling may be any favorite jam.

title: Soft Macaroons
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine sherbet almond extract and dry cake mix; mix well. Stir in the coconut. Drop by tablespoonfuls 2-inches apart onto greased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Remove to wire racks to cool. Yield About 6 dozen.

title: Cranberry Marshmallow Salad
instructions: Add cold water to gelatin and let stand two minutes. Dissolve over hot water. Stir dissolved gelatin into cranberry sauce. Add pineapple celery lemon juice and chopped nuts. Chill until mixture begins to jell; fold in marshmallows.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Pie
instructions: Whip cream until soft peaks form. Cream together peanut butter cream cheese and sugar. Add melted butter whipped cream and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill 4 to 5 hours or until set. Top with hot fudge. Return to refrigerator until ready to serve. Can be frozen.

title: Karo Lace Cookies
instructions: Mix flour and coconut or nuts (I use nuts). Combine Karo brown sugar and butter in heavy sauce pan. Bring to boil over medium heat; gradually blend in flour mixture then vanilla. Drop onto foil-covered cookie sheet by scant teaspoonfuls 3 inches apart. Be sure not to put them any closer because they really spread while baking. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 8 to 10 minutes. Cool 3 to 4 minutes on wire rack until foil can be easily peeled off. Remove foil and place cookies on cooling rack covered with absorbent paper. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Marion'S Delicious Rice Pudding
instructions: In saucepan combine Milk Egg and Pudding Mix. Mix well. Add Rice Raisins Spices. Bring to boil over medium heat stir constantly. Remove from heat and cool 5 minutes. Stir twice. Pour into bowls. Cover with plastic wrap. Serve warm or cold with Cool Whip.

title: Fun Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: This is an excellent recipe for when the kids want to help make lunch. They can participate in most of the preparation.

title: Vegetable Canapes
instructions: Beat the cream cheese until fluffy. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Set aside. Cut two 1 3/4-inch rounds from each bread slice. Keep bread covered with damp towels while assembling. Spread each bread round with 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture. Top with assorted vegetables and watercress as desired. Yields 32 canapes.

title: Sugarless Health Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl add vegetable shortening to boiling water. Cool. Add eggs sweetener vanilla extract baking soda and flour. Mix well. Add raisins and chopped dates (or prunes). Mix well.

title: Oyster Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients soft enough (like pancake batter) to add oysters. (The bread could be whole or in a pancake form.) Use a colander to drain oysters. Lightly grease the pan. Pour mixture in pan or spoon to make small circles (like pancakes). Cook on medium to medium-low heat.

title: Strawberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift flour then measure. Sift dry ingredients together. Pour yogurt into measuring cup and add enough milk to make 1 cup. Combine yogurt oil and egg with dry ingredients. (Batter should be lumpy.) Add strawberries if desired. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 medium muffins.

title: Pineapple Au Gratin
instructions: Combine pineapple sugar cheese and flour in bowl; mix well. Spoon into baking dish. Top with cracker crumbs; drizzle with butter. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cauliflower Salad
