instructions: Cut cauliflower into bite size pieces. Add frozen uncooked peas cheese and dry dressing; mix. Stir well. Cover with mayonnaise in refrigerator. Before serving mix mayonnaise into other ingredients.

title: Italian Cheese Twists
instructions: In a small bowl combine margarine basil oregano marjoram and garlic powder; set aside.

title: Peanut Butter Surprise Balls(Kid'S Recipe)
instructions: Mix peanut butter and honey with wooden spoon. Add dry milk sesame seed and wheat germ; stir in. Crumble cornflakes in a bag. Shape dough around a raisin chocolate candy or anything you want then toss in bag and shake so cornflakes cover. Put in refrigerator after done.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine dry cake mix pudding mix sour cream eggs and oil. Beat 5 minutes. Pour half the batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan. Arrange half the apples on batter. Mix the sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle half on the apples. Cover with remaining batter then remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. After cooking in pan for 5 minutes remove from pan onto a platter.

title: Microwave Potato Salad
instructions: Combine potatoes and water in a 2-quart glass casserole; cover. Microwave on High 8 to 12 minutes or until tender stirring after 6 minutes. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Chill.

title: Layered Tostada Dip
instructions: Combine beans and chili powder. Mix well. Combine avocados salad dressing bacon onion and seasonings. Mix well. Layer bean mixture avocado mixture olives tomato chilies and cheese in shallow bowl. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 6 cups.

title: Tin Roof Pie
instructions: Stir together peanut butter and corn syrup in medium-size mixing bowl. Add Kelloggs honey and nut corn flakes stirring until well coated. Press evenly in 9-inch pie pan. Chill. Scoop softened ice cream into crust. Freeze until firm. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving. To serve top with chocolate syrup and peanuts.

title: Flubber
instructions: Mix together water and glue. Divide this into three separate containers. Pour the first Borax/water solution in the glue/water mixture. Part of it will form into a clump. Lift the first clump out and set aside. Repeat clumping process with remaining two Borax/water solutions. A little manipulation will make a smooth \Silly Putty\ type mixture. It oozes drips off the edge of tables forms strings bounces and stretches into sheets. Write on it with markers or transfer marker from paper onto it. You can even blow bubbles with it. Store in an airtight container. Mix some up and experiment.

title: Tomato Sweet Pickle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook on top of the stove until thick. Stir frequently to prevent sticking or burning.

title: Mom'S Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Generously cover stew meat with water and boil 15 minutes or until meat is tender. Strain liquid and chop the meat into spoon sized pieces. In a large stockpot place meat liquid fresh vegetables parsley bay leaves and water to cover. Add a few teaspoons of bouillon and simmer until vegetables are tender. Add all canned vegetables including liquid. Season with salt pepper and additional bouillon to taste. Heat to a simmer and serve.

title: Rhubarb Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Place rhubarb in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with gelatin sugar and marshmallows. Pour cake batter over marshmallows. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. Invert cake onto a serving plate. Serve with whipped topping if desired.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Brown pecans in butter for 5 minutes. Drain on paper towel until cool. Mix all of the remaining ingredients. Put in ice cream machine and let it churn for 5 minutes. Then add the pecans to the ice cream. Restart the machine and let churn until machine stops. Pack with ice and let it stand for 1 hour for best results.

title: Meat Loaf Supreme
instructions: Mix well and form into a loaf. Add sliced potatoes and carrots around the loaf. They cook from the juice of the meat loaf. Cook covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: Velveeta Salsa Dip
instructions: Microwave cheese and picante sauce in 1 1/2 quart micro- waveable bowl on high 5 minutes or until cheese is melted stirring after 3 minutes. Stir in cilantro. Serve hot with tortilla chips. Makes 3 cups.

title: Green Apple Crisp
instructions: Place the apple slices in the bottom of a butter baking dish. Sprinkle with the tablespoon of sugar and lemon juice. Combine the flour and the 2/3 cup sugar. Add butter and mix until it becomes a mass. Then spread completely over the apples. Sprinkle on cinnamon. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Spoon into serving dishes. Sprinkle with black walnuts and whipped cream.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Mix lemonade by directions on can. Add Hawaiian Punch then pour over ice ring and add ginger ale.

title: Creamy Beef And Macaroni
instructions: Brown and drain beef. Stir in spaghetti sauce macaroni and Miracle Whip. Heat. Top with cheese. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Jeanne'S Hot Dish
instructions: Place in greased casserole. Do not drain vegetables. Stir slightly. Bake about 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. This makes a large casserole.

title: Salsa
instructions: Chop cilantro and place in blender. Add 2 cans of stewed tomatoes garlic 1/2 cup green onions and tomato paste. Blend to count of 5 and dump into a bowl.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix French fried onion rings with remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add more onion rings on top and return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes. Remove skin and grate. Mix all other ingredients and pour into a buttered baking dish. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10. Can be frozen before baking.

title: Olivia'S Cookies
instructions: Break large graham cracker in quarters. Melt chocolate a few squares at a time in microwave. With tongs dip cracker in chocolate and lay on a cookie sheet that is covered with wax paper. Set in refrigerator a few minutes to harden. Store in covered container. Need not refrigerate.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: In a bowl with electric mixer combine sour cream cream cheese and sugar until well blended. Stir in cranberry sauce pineapple and pecans. Fold in topping. Place in slightly oiled 6-cup mold and freeze. To serve dip bottom of mold in warm water and invert onto platter. Decorate with parsley and serve. Salad should be only slightly thawed before serving. Serves 8. This may be put in cake pan and cut as needed.

title: Old Fashioned Cornbread Dressing
instructions: (I also use some sausage seasonings with chopped sage and chopped red peppers in it.)

title: Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Beat together cream cheese and butter until smooth. Blend in vanilla. Gradually beat in sugar.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Brown onion in margarine. Add soups broth green chiles and chicken pieces. Heat well.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. In a well put the eggs sugar vanilla oil and grated zucchini. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Use loaf pans.

title: Beef And Cheese Manicotti
instructions: For filling in a 10-inch skillet cook beef onion and garlic until beef is brown and onion is tender. Drain off fat. Stir in cottage cheese Parmesan cheese egg and 2 tablespoons snipped parsley. Set aside.

title: Rolled Biscuits
instructions: Mix ingredients until dough forms; beat 30 seconds. If after beating dough is too sticky gradually mix in enough Bisquick (up to 1/4 cup) to make dough easy to handle. Turn onto surface dusted with Bisquick. Roll in Bisquick to coat. Shape into ball; knead 10 minutes. Roll 1/2 thick. Cut with 2-inch cutter dipped in Bisquick. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Maw-Maw Charion'S Banana Pancakes
instructions: Maw-Maw puts Bisquick in a bowl and I break the eggs into the bowl. Maw-Maw then adds the sugar milk and vanilla. While she does that I get to smash the bananas until they are mushy. I give the mushy bananas to Maw-Maw and she mixes them in the bowl with the other stuff. Maw-Maw turns on the stove and whips the griddle with cooking oil. Know what! Maw-Maw Charion makes me Mickey Mouse shaped banana pancakes. I love them!! And I love her!!!

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium; cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Drain well and mash potatoes gradually stirring in salad dressing cream cheese onion powder 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper until light and fluffy.

title: Mexican Stew
instructions: In large Dutch oven brown meat in oil. Add broth picante sauce onion salt cumin garlic and pablano pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add tomatoes carrots and potatoes. Simmer for 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender or transfer to slow cooker and cook until vegetables are tender. For milder version eliminate pablano pepper.

title: Mother'S Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Mix eggs melted margarine and buttermilk together and stir into dry ingredients. Mix well and store in refrigerator to use as needed. Bake in muffin pans at 350\u00b0 for 25-30 minutes. Will keep for 30 days in refrigerator.

title: Vinegar Dumplings
instructions: Bring water vinegar sugar and nutmeg to a boil. Mix flour baking powder 3/4 cup water and oil. Pat into a ball. Roll out dumplings and cut in squares. Drop into boiling vinegar mixture and cook until tender.

title: Glory Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except the almonds or sunflower seeds and place in oiled casserole dish. Top with the almonds or sunflower seeds. Bake 35 minutes. Healthy and nutritious!

title: Peanut Butter Supremes
instructions: Cream the shortening and peanut butter. Add sugars and beat well. Beat in eggs. Sift flour salt and soda into the peanut butter mixture. Mix well. Make small balls from rounded teaspoonfuls of dough. Place 2-inches apart on cookie sheet and flatten with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Fudge
instructions: Grease side of pan. Combine sugar milk chocolate cream of tartar and salt. Stir well. Bring to a boil having thermometer reach 238\u00b0. Remove from stove. Add butter. When lukewarm add nuts marshmallow and vanilla. Beat and pour in buttered pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Special Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and press in bottom of large Pyrex dish. Mix remaining ingredients well with mixer and pour over top crust. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 until top is golden brown. Let stand 15 minutes then loosen edges and cut in squares.

title: Pecan Trout
instructions: Lightly flour fillets. In a large skillet melt 2 Tbsp. butter. Fry fillets over medium heat for 2 minutes on each side. remove fish from pan and keep warm. In a small saucepan melt 1/3 c. butter and add remaining ingredients. Stir until well blended. Pour sauce over trout. Serves 4.

title: Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and flour in a large mixer bowl. Bring Crisco cocoa oleo and water to a boil and pour over the flour mixture. Mix well and add vanilla cinnamon soda buttermilk and eggs. Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for at least 30 minutes.

title: Veggie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll out both rolls of crescents in a jelly roll pan. Press out seams and prick dough with a fork. Spread egg on dough liberally with pastry brush. Bake exactly 12 minutes. Let cool. Finely chop veggies. In separate bowl mix cream cheese and mayonnaise together and add Ranch dressing. Blend well. Spread mixture over cooled crust. Mix in bowl chopped veggies. Sprinkle evenly over cheese mixture. Sprinkle Cheddar over all. Press veggies and cheese lightly. Cover and chill at least 2 hours. Can be frozen up to 1 week. Thaw 24 hours before serving.

title: Chopped Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together. Form in a ball and roll in nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Yellow Rice Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice to package directions and layer bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Brown hamburger and drain; add chili powder pork and beans and onion. Heat until hot then layer on top of rice. Spread nacho cheese soup on top. Swirl soup into mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese melts into mixture. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Cherry Date Skillet Cookies
instructions: In heavy skillet melt butter over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes. Stir in sugar and dates. Remove from heat. Add egg and return to heat. Continue to cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients except 2 1/2 cups coconut. Stir until all ingredients are moistened. Let stand for 10 minutes. Shape into balls and roll in 2 1/2 cups of coconut.

title: Pecan Pie With A Twist(A Twist Of Lemon)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine eggs corn syrup vanilla extract and lemon juice. Mix with a fork until blended. Combine sugar brown sugar and flour. Mix well and then add to egg mixture. Stir in butter. Put pecans in pie crust and then pour the filling over the pecans. Bake for 1 hour. Cool before slicing.

title: Grandma'S Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Serves 14.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles Number 1
instructions: Slice vegetables thin. Add salt; cover with cracked ice and let stand 3 hours stirring occasionally. Drain. Combine rest of ingredients and pour over vegetables. Bring to a boil and pack in hot sterilized jars; seal. Makes 8 pints.

title: Rainbow Crayons
instructions: Put a foil baking cup in each cup of a muffin tin. Chop the old peeled crayons into 1/4-inch pieces and place them in the baking cups. Heat the crayons at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until the crayon pieces just begin to melt. Remove them before the colors mix together and become muddy. When the crayons have cooled peel off the baking cups. Crayons may also be melted outside in the sun on a hot day.

title: Pumpkin Roll(Alice Miser'S)
instructions: Beat eggs on high. Gradually beat in 1 cup sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Stir together flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Spread in greased and floured 15 x 10-inch cookie sheet and top with chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Brunch
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a mixing bowl; beat well at medium with electric beaters. Stir remaining ingredients and pour into a well-greased 9-inch quiche pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes; reduce to 350\u00b0 and bake about 20 minutes or until set. Cut into wedges to serve. Serves 6.

title: Berry And Pineapple Crumble
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Combine cake mix butter 1/4 cup sugar oats and cinnamon in large bowl. Rub together in fingertips until mixture resembles coarse meal and holds together in large moist clumps. Mix in pecans. Mix frozen blueberries pineapple with syrup and remaining 1/2 cup sugar in prepared dish. Cover fruit with cake mix topping. Bake crumble until fruit is bubbling thickly and topping is brown and crisp about 1 hour. Let stand 15 minutes.

title: Disappearing Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) round cake pans.

title: Stuffed Manicotti
instructions: Cook shells in boiling water with salt. Drain rinse in cold water drain and set aside.

title: Butterscotch Bars
instructions: Mix together brown sugar flour and butter in 8 x 12-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix together remaining ingredients and spread on first mixture. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut in squares.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken With Rice
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Stir in rice onion flakes salt soup and water. Place chicken breasts over top of mixture. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. Serves 6.

title: Home-Canned Bread And Butter Pickles(Consider Doubling Recipe.)
instructions: Wash cukes and slice into thin-medium thick rounds. Chop onions and peppers. Combine with cukes and salt. Let stand 3 hours then drain.

title: Crispy Buttermilk Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Line 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with foil. Spray foil with nonstick cooking spray. In shallow dish combine flour and lemon-pepper seasoning; mix well. Place buttermilk in another shallow dish. In third shallow dish combine corn flake crumbs and cornmeal; mix well. To bread chicken dip chicken in flour mixture to coat. Dip in buttermilk; dip in crumb mixture to coat. Place chicken in foil-lined pan. Drizzle with margarine. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Make ground beef and egg into 18 balls. Brown in oil. Drain off oil. Add pineapple juice. Cook slowly for 5 minutes. Add mixture of cornstarch soy sauce vinegar water and sugar. Cook until it begins to thicken stirring constantly. Add meatballs and chunky pineapple. Cut green peppers into thin slices lengthwise and put on top. Heat thoroughly and serve.

title: Shrimp Appetizers
instructions: Melt cheese in a sauce pan over very low heat. Add cream and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Remove from heat. Add shrimp mayo and grated onion. Spread on toasted bread and cut in squares rectangles or diamonds. Can be packaged in freezer cartons. Freeze at once. Broil until lightly browned.

title: Cheese Fingers
instructions: Cut cheese into strips. Roll strips in flour. Beat an egg; dip strips in egg mixture. Roll in untoasted bread crumbs. Be sure to coat cheese real good. Put in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Deep fat fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Hot Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Make balls. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Grandmother Busick'S Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into well-greased muffin pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes until golden brown. Makes 12 to 14 muffins.

title: Buttermilk-Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: In blender container combine buttermilk and mayonnaise. Process until thoroughly combined. Stir in remaining ingredients. Transfer to a bowl or jar that has a tight fitting cover. Refrigerate until ready to use. Just before serving stir well. Makes 12 servings.

title: Herbed Tomato-Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine biscuit mix and milk stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn out onto a floured surface; knead 3 or 4 times. Press into bottom and up sides of a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with tomato slices. Saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except paprika. Spoon mixture over tomatoes; sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Yields about 12 servings.

title: Molasses Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine beans ketchup molasses mustard and Worcestershire sauce in 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Egg And Sausage Delight
instructions: Cut bread into 1-inch cubes. Brown sausage and drain. Mix with cheese and bread. Blend other ingredients in blender. Pour over sausage mixture and stir. Pour into 9 x 13 baking dish. Cover with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour. Serves 12.

title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick margarine in 2-quart baking dish. Tear or cube stale bread. Sprinkle evenly in dish. Beat eggs. Add milk and sugar; mix well. Add raisins vanilla salt and spices. Pour over bread. Dot with 1/2 stick margarine. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve warm plain or with whipped topping or lemon sauce.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Combine margarine peanut butter sugar and syrup. Mix well. Roll in 3/4 inch balls and coat with dipping chocolate made by melting the chocolate chips and paraffin together. Coat the balls by inserting a toothpick into them and lowering them into the chocolate. Makes about 40.

title: Mystery Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a medium sized bowl. Sprinkle 2 or 3 more walnut halves chopped on top. Refrigerate covered. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Let set 10 minutes while you make icing.

title: Frozen Pickles
instructions: Mix well the cucumbers onions and salt. Let stand 2 to 3 hours. Drain and rinse well. Stir and dissolve the vinegar and sugar. Pour over pickles. Pack in containers and freeze.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake 1 hour covered at 350\u00b0.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all together; dough will be sticky but in a ball. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 11 minutes. Rotate sheets halfway through baking time. Careful not to burn bottoms. Cookies will harden as they cool.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
instructions: First Layer Mix together pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 425\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Three-Cheese Macaroni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole combine hot macaroni soup milk seasonings 1/4 cup each of the cheeses and 1/2 of the onions. Bake covered for 25 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining cheeses and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer or until onions are golden brown.

title: Mom'S Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. In large bowl mix butter Parmesan salt pepper and egg. Add spaghetti and toss to coat well. Spread evenly in 13 x 9-inch pan. Brown ground chuck in large saucepan adding onion pepper and garlic just as meat starts to cook. When meat is browned drain off fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce sugar and oregano. Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti layer. Top with meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 10 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Can be divided into 2 meals and frozen.

title: Apple Rolls
instructions: Bring the first 5 ingredients to a boil in saucepan. Continue to boil until the mixture has reduced to half. Peel and core the apples. Grate the apples. Make a biscuit dough and roll out to 1/2-inch thick. Spread with softened oleo. Sprinkle with sugar. Spread grated apples on dough; sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar on top of apples. Sprinkle cinnamon on top. Roll up like a cinnamon roll. Slice 1-inch slices and place in a greased baking dish. Pour syrup mixture over the rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Savory Steak Rub
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in a covered container. Rub over steaks before grilling or broiling. Will season four to five steaks. Yield 1/4 cup.

title: Family Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water.\tAdd mayonnaise and beat well with mixer. Then add the remaining ingredients and refrigerate. I usually double the recipe - it lasts for days. Great to make early.

title: Beer-B-Cue Sauce(Makes 1 Quart)
instructions: Bring to boil. Cook and stir 5 minutes. Add 1 medium onion thinly sliced and 1/2 lemon thinly sliced.

title: Low-Fat Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spray a cookie sheet with vegetable spray. In a medium-size bowl combine flour baking soda baking powder cloves and cinnamon. In a large mixing bowl beat sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add egg whites pumpkin and vanilla. Gradually stir in flour mixture; mix well. Fold in dates. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 60 cookies; 1 gram of fat per cookie.

title: Comforting Cookies
instructions: Preheat 350. In large mixing bowl combine oil eggs and vanilla. Add sugars and mix well. In separate bowl combine flour soda and salt. Add to sugar mixture beating until blended Stir in corn flakes quick oats chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by Tbsp. 3 inches apart in lightly greased cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack to cool. Makes 9 Dozen.

title: Red Velvet Cocoa Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and food color; blend well. Combine flour cocoa and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Stir baking soda into vinegar. Fold gently into batter (do not beat). Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Frost with Sour Cream-Pecan Frosting.

title: Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs. Beat well. Add applesauce. Blend flour soda salt and spices then blend in raisins nuts and gumdrops. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture blending thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Russian Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix together and keep in jar. Use spoonful in cup of water. Makes a nice gift.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt in large saucepan. Slowly stir in hot milk. Cook over low heat for about 10 minutes stirring constantly. Take beaten eggs; add a little amount of hot milk mixture to them. Then add egg mixture to milk mixture. Heat 1 minute longer. Chill for 2 hours. Then add heavy cream and vanilla. Stir well. Pour into ice cream maker and turn on. Use ice rock salt and water as directed.

title: Ruby Red Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve raspberry jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add raspberries and stir until berries are thawed and separated. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until set. Carefully spread with sour cream; chill. Dissolve cherry jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add pineapple and cranberry sauce; mix well. Allow to thicken slightly. Carefully spoon over sour cream mixture; chill. Cut into squares and serve on lettuce leaves. If desired top each with a dollop of mayonnaise and garnish with a mint leaf. Yield 12 to 16 servings.

title: Manicotti With Cheese
instructions: Cook manicotti (or shells) and drain. Cool in a single layer. Combine cheeses parsley salt and pepper for filling; spoon into manicotti. Spread a thin layer of spaghetti sauce in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange manicotti in single layer on sauce. (If the large shells are used put the open side down.) Cover with remaining sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Hamburger-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add tomato\tsauce.\tMix the cottage cheese and sour cream and in a\tgreased casserole alternate layers of hamburger noodles and sour cream-cottage cheese mixture. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Add and mix all ingredients then add extra for own personal taste. (All ingredients except molasses can be mixed with salt-free brands for those who are heart conscience.)

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels in boiler. Add peanuts and noodles. Drop by tablespoon onto cookie sheet. Let cool.

title: Honey Carrots
instructions: Wash and trim carrots. Cook in boiling water until tender and drain. Melt margarine in skillet; add sugar honey and carrots. Cook over low heat turning often until well glazed. Sprinkle with chopped parsley or mint and serve.

title: Honey Spareribs
instructions: Place ribs in large container. Blend ingredients and pour over ribs. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours turning ribs occasionally. Set oven at 300\u00b0. Arrange ribs on rack and bake 2 hours. Baste occasionally and turn once during cooking time. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Pat into ungreased oblong pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Arrange apple slices on crust. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar mixture. Blend sour cream and egg. Drizzle over apples. Bake 25 minutes or until edges are lightly brown. Can be served warm with ice cream.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix everything except popcorn in large saucepan. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda quickly stirring it in. Pour over popcorn. (I use a large stainless steel bowl.) Stir gently until popcorn is well coated. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir caramel corn every 15 minutes during the hour. Stir it gently a couple times after baking to keep it from clumping together.

title: Washington Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until very light and lemon colored. Beat in sugar vanilla and salt. Stir in butter melted in milk. Sift flour with baking powder and beat into egg-milk mixture very quickly. Pour into 2 buttered 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Turn out onto rack and finish cooling. Put layers together with jelly. Sprinkle top with confectioners sugar. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sweet 'N Low Brownies
instructions: Combine margarine and cocoa. Combine flour nuts baking powder and salt. In medium bowl beat eggs add Sweet N Low and vanilla. Beat in cocoa mixture. Fold in flour. Spray 8-inch baking pan. Spread mixture in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Turtles
instructions: Melt chips in a bowl in the microwave for about 3-4 minutes stirring once in the middle. Add peanuts and drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let set overnight.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish. Place casserole in a pan of hot water and bake for 1 hour until firm and golden. (Can serve with baked ham or pork chops.) Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cream Puff Shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine butter and water in saucepan and stir over moderate heat until butter is melted. Turn heat to low. Add flour all at once. Stir vigorously for about 1 minute or until mixture forms ball and leaves sides of pan. Remove from heat. Add unbeaten eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition with a wooden spoon or electric mixer on medium speed. Continue beating for 1 minute or until satiny smooth and spoonful breaks away sharply from rest of mixture.

title: Stickey Chicken
instructions: In small bowl thoroughly combine first 8 ingredients. Rub mixture into chicken inside and out patting mixture into skin to make sure it is evenly distributed. Place in sealable plastic bag seal and refrigerate overnight.

title: Reeses Cups
instructions: Mix powdered sugar peanut butter oleo and vanilla well with mixer and roll into balls. Chill. Melt paraffin wax and chocolate chips. Dip peanut butter balls in chocolate mixture and place on waxed paper to dry.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Boil potatoes. Drain. Put soup milk onions onion salt (if desired) salt pepper celery seed and garlic powder with potatoes. Bring to boil. Separate clams from clam juice. Put juice in soup mixture. Then add clams and let simmer approximately 20 minutes. Put in butter. Best if refrigerated overnight.

title: Oriental Wings(Makes 24 Appetizer Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut each wing at joints; discard tips. Wash drain and dry wings. Mix together soy and hoisin sauces rice vinegar honey Cajun seasoning and garlic. Dip wings in sauce. Arrange in single layer on foil-lined baking pan. Bake 20 minutes; remove from oven and turn spooning any remaining sauce over wings. Return to oven and bake until dark brown 20 to 25 minutes. Can be made ahead refrigerated and reheated in foil at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Yippity Yippity Dip
instructions: Cook meat onion green pepper garlic and spices until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain off grease. Add catsup tomato sauce and sugar. Simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain off grease again (this step is important). Add cheeses and mix well.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Drain liquid from salmon reserving 2 tablespoons. Put salmon in bowl. In a small bowl put egg salmon liquid and baking powder and beat until foamy. Add egg mixture to salmon and mix. Add flour seasoning and onion mixing after each ingredient. Shape into cakes and fry in vegetable oil or spray oil until brown. Makes 7 to 8 cakes.

title: Caramel Apples(Club Member: Ashley Wilson)
instructions: Wash and remove stems and blossoms from apples. In top of double boiler over hot water heat caramel salt and water until mixture is smooth. Keeping sauce over hot water place each apple in hot sauce. Spoon sauce over apples until apples are completely covered. Insert skewer in stem end. Remove apples from sauce and chill.

title: Grandma'S Holiday Cake
instructions: Chop raisins and dates. Pour the boiling water in which the soda has been dissolved over fruit. Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks then the spices and fruit then flour. Fold in the beaten egg white. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes in loaf pan in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and roll dough into small balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 until lightly brown. The cheese wafer has a nutty texture and taste. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies to look like dirt. Set aside. Mix vanilla pudding with milk and blend in Cool Whip. Set aside.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Strips
instructions: Cut chicken into strips. Drain pineapple chunks and reserve juice. Cut green pepper into strips. In medium skillet heat oil. Add chicken and brown on both sides 5 to 6 minutes. In a small bowl combine sweet and sour sauce mix reserved pineapple juice water and sugar. Pour over chicken. Add pineapple and green pepper. Cook covered over low heat for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Cucumber Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Refrigerate for several hours. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Quick Jam Cake
instructions: Mix well. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour. Ice with favorite icing.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Mix flour and cocoa. In a double boiler mix egg yolks and sugar; add flour mixture slowly add milk.\tBring water to a boil; reduce heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat; add vanilla and butter.\tPour into pie shell and chill.

title: Cherry Raspberry Sauce
instructions: In medium saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in reserved liquids from fruits. Cook over medium-high heat until mixture thickens stirring constantly. Cool slightly; stir in fruit. Excellent served over ice cream pudding or pound cake. Store in refrigerator.

title: Leavenworth Lemon Bundt Cake
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat cake mix pudding mix 1 cup water eggs and grated rind of lemon for 3 minutes. Pour into pan and bake 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Ray'S Ultimate Summer Fruit Stinger
instructions: Cut the top out of the cantaloupe like you would a Halloween pumpkin. Spoon out the seeds leaving the melon hollow. Drain fruit cocktail and pour into melon. Fill remaining area in melon with vodka. Replace cut-out top on cantaloupe and place in refrigerator for a minimum of three hours (overnight is even better). Pour contents from melon into a large bowl. Cut cantaloupe in half. Scoop out cantaloupe using a small melon scoop and add to fruit. Serve and enjoy.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Combine pudding and milk. Beat until thick then fold in nondairy topping.

title: Chocolate Butter-Cream Frosting
instructions: In a large bowl beat at high speed and cream butter; gradually add sugar. Beat until fluffy. Beat in egg yolks one at a time. Gradually beat in melted chocolate until creamy. If too soft refrigerate for 1/2 hour.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Add salt and pepper to meat. Cook hamburger meat until red color disappears. Cover. Set aside. Mix rice according to directions on box.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add egg one at a time beating at least 15 minutes. Fold in pineapple and bananas. Pour in graham cracker pie crust. Top with Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

title: Saucy Cheddar Veggies
instructions: Stir together soup cheese and pepper until smooth. Stir in vegetables. Bake in 1 1/2-quart casserole at 350\u00b0 about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: String Pie
instructions: Cook hamburger onion and pepper in a large skillet until meat is brown stirring well. Drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce and mix well.

title: Crisp Crusted Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry. Set aside. Beat egg and milk in bowl. In another bowl mix potato flakes garlic powder and Parmesan cheese. Roll chicken first in egg mix then in potato flakes mixture.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Press crescent rolls in 12-inch pizza pan and seal well. Spoon cooked sausage over unbaked crust; sprinkle on hash browns and then cheese. Beat next 5 ingredients together and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until crust is golden brown.

title: Green Tomato Marmalade
instructions: In blender mix together green tomatoes (ground) sugar and salt. Pour into saucepan and cook on store top on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes until transparent. Add Jell-O jar and seal.

title: Mud Hen Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in the order given except nuts brown sugar and egg white. Spread very thin in a shallow pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Beat reserved egg white stiff; add the brown sugar. Spread over nuts. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut into squares while hot.

title: Rice Custard Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first 3 ingredients. Stir in scalded milk. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Set dish in a pan of hot water 1-inch deep. Bake 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Cut buttered bread in half-inch wide strips. Arrange in layers in buttered baking dish. Sprinkle each layer with nuts. Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar salt vanilla and milk. Mix well and pour over bread. Garnish top with nuts and bake in slow oven. Bake 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Reuben Appetizer Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix baking mix milk and oil until soft dough forms. Press into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with sauerkraut and corned beef. Mix mayonnaise relish and catsup. Spread over corned beef. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake until cheese is bubbly and crust is golden brown about 12 to 15 minutes. Cut into 2-inch squares. Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Cook chopped onions in butter. Add cream of mushroom soup and milk. Heat and stir in sour cream and curry powder. Add chicken. Serve over rice with golden raisins tops of scallions almonds and chutney. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Bojangles Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and sugar. Cut in shortening and stir in buttermilk. Knead a few times; roll out and cut into biscuits. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions into rings. Beat the egg into the buttermilk. Dip the onion rings into the milk and egg mixture. Cover with flour.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Melt and cool butter; beat eggs until foamy. Add sugar brown sugar and flour. Mix well. Blend in cooled butter; fold in chips and nuts. Pour into crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Yum-Yum
instructions: Combine blueberries 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup water in a medium saucepan. Cook over low heat until berries are soft (about 10 minutes). Combine cornstarch and 3 tablespoons water in a small bowl. Add to blueberry mixture. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Set aside to cool.

title: Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Cut rhubarb into small pieces. Put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread sugar over rhubarb. Sprinkle the jello over the sugar. Add the marshmallows. Cream 1/2 cup sugar and Crisco. Add egg; beat well. Add the milk flour and baking powder. Drizzle this over top. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt and baking powder. Cut in butter. Add raisins. Combine buttermilk egg and baking soda. Stir buttermilk mixture into flour mixture. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Strawberry Fruit Salad
instructions: Using juices from fruit add the pudding mix. Blend with mixer until thickens slightly. You will pour this over all your fruit. You can use different fruit or add to what is here.

title: Apple Torte
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add egg and beat a few minutes. Sift together all dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Add apples nuts and flavoring. Bake in a large buttered pie plate at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream. Serves 6.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine corn\tmilk and melted butter. Add remaining ingredients and turn into a buttered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until lightly browned. Serves 12.

title: Sacramento Beef Pot Roast
instructions: Trim all excess fat from meat. Brown beef in its own fat in a large skillet; remove and set aside. Drain all but 2 Tbsp. fat from skillet. Saute onion in fat until soft. Place meat vegetables and seasonings in slow cooker; cover. Cook on low (190-200\u00b0) 10 hours or on high (290-300\u00b0) 5 hours or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Place meat and vegetables on a heated platter and keep warm. Turn heat control to high. Combine flour and water in a cup; pour into liquid in slow cooker; cover. Cook 15 minutes; pass sauce separately in a heated gravy boat. Serves 8.

title: Carrot Souffle
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar in carrots while hot. Beat eggs and put in carrots after cool. Add flour and baking powder and cinnamon. Pour into greased baking dish and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut sirloin in thin strips about 1/4-inch thick. Put in saucepan with just enough water to cover. Add 1 beef bouillon cube. Cook over heat until just done (about 10 minutes). Drain; set aside. Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Stir in meat and brown. Stir in flour pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Stir in soup. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat thoroughly. Serve over noodles.

title: Christmas Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine oil eggs 1/3 cup water and pumpkin. Sift together the dry ingredients. Gradually beat into first mixture. Stir in cherries and nuts; pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Quick And Easy Bread
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and let stand 10 minutes. Mix in milk salt and melted butter. Stir in flour until not sticky. Cover and let rise in warm place for 2 hours. Pinch into 2 equal balls. Place into bread pans or shape on cookie sheet. Let rise and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chris' Cherry Supreme Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients except eggs at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs one at a time and beat for 1 minute after each egg. Pour into greased and floured Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool 15 minutes in pan before turning out.

title: Pineapple-Lime Punch
instructions: Beat jelly until frothy. Add hot water and continue beating until jelly is dissolved. Add fruit juices. Chill. When ready to serve pour over ice in punch bowl and add ginger ale. Garnish with orange slices and maraschino cherries. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Banana-Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture alternately with banana blending well after each addition. Stir in nuts. Pour into well-greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Remove from pan. Cool on rack. Suitable for freezing. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook linguini according to directions. Chop tomatoes cucumbers and shrimp. Put a layer of linguini a layer of tomatoes cucumbers and shrimp and half bottle of Salad Supreme seasoning and half the Italian Zesty dressing. Mix thoroughly with hands. Repeat layering and pour remaining salad seasoning and Italian Zesty dressing over layers. Mix thoroughly with hands. Garnish with parsley and large shrimp.

title: Broiled Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in small skillet. Add chopped mushroom stems and onion. Saute 4 to 5 minutes. Remove mixture to bowl. Add remaining ingredients except 2 tablespoons melted butter. Mix well and set aside. Dip mushroom caps into reserved melted butter. Spoon about 1 to 2 teaspoons of filling into each mushroom cap. Preheat pan with rack in high position. Place stuffed mushrooms on rack with stuffing up. Broil 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Toss chicken celery grapes salt and mayonnaise. Serve on lettuce. Sprinkle with cashews. Garnish with grapes. Serve with Italian bread or crescent rolls.

title: Zucchini Relish(Canning Recipe)
instructions: Combine zucchini onions green and red peppers and salt in large cooker; mix well and let stand overnight. Drain and rinse good with cold water. Add remaining ingredients and boil 20 to 30 minutes. Ladle into hot jars and adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath 15 minutes. Makes 6 pints.

title: Trout Almondine
instructions: Clean and wipe but do not wash the trout after cutting into portion-size pieces. Mix flour salt white pepper m.s.g. and garlic powder. Dredge trout pieces in seasoned flour. Using a large heavy frypan heat 1/2 cup of the butter to bubbling point. Brown trout for 4 minutes on each side. Put trout in a warm oven to keep hot.

title: Orange Spiced Tea
instructions: Combine tea bags cinnamon sticks cloves orange and lemon peels in boiling water. Steep 20 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add pineapple juice and cranberry juice cocktail. Serve hot. Makes six 1-cup servings.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Brown the beef and season with salt and pepper. In a large saucepan warm the refried beans taco seasoning mix and water. Add salsa and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Scoop mixture into an ovenproof glass pan. Sprinkle with onion tomato and cheeses. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pasta Brie
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on package. Add olive oil and seasonings to whole tomatoes with juice. Heat well. Combine heated sauce with warm pasta. Toss with Brie. Serve.

title: Chocolate Chip And Walnut Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl stir together sugars flour baking powder and salt. In another bowl mix together milk butter eggs and vanilla until blended. Make a well in center of dry ingredients. Add milk mixture and stir to combine. Stir in chips and nuts. Spoon batter into greased muffin cups; grease the edges around cups. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until a cake tester comes out clean. Remove muffins from oven and cool 5 minutes. Remove from pans and cool on rack. Serve warm or cold. Makes 12 large muffins.

title: Ribbon Bologna Wedges
instructions: Have cheese at room temperature. Spread evenly over bologna and sprinkle each piece with nuts. Divide bologna into 2 stacks of 6 slices. Garnish tops with parsley. Cover both rolls with plastic wrap and chill. At serving time cut each stack into 16 wedges and insert a colored wooden pick in each wedge.

title: Easy Onion Steak And Potatoes
instructions: Brown steak in oil. In crock-pot stir in 2 1/2 cups of water beefy onion soup mix potatoes salt and pepper. Add meat and green beans in layers. Cook all day on low. Thicken with flour and 1/2 cup of water.

title: Busy Day Casserole
instructions: In bottom of casserole dish put 1 cup dry rice. Then layer hamburger meat. Add stewed tomatoes water corn (do not drain) onion and pepper. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered followed by 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Cream Cheese Fudge
instructions: Mix cheese sugar water and vanilla. Blend until smooth. Quickly add chocolate and nuts. Turn into buttered 8 x 8-inch dish. Spread and chill.

title: Easy Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over lard sugar and salt; let cool. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Add eggs that have been slightly beaten to first mixture. Add 2 cups of flour and then yeast and rest of flour. Mix and put in refrigerator for 4 hours. Then make into rolls.

title: Delicious Double Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Whip with wisp until creamy. Pour into ice cream freezer and freeze.

title: Sweet And Pungent Brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place brisket in baking pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Cover pan with foil. Cook in oven 3 to 4 hours. (Meat should be sliced across the grain halfway through roasting time.) Finger licking good!

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well and roll into ball. Roll in pecans.

title: Salad
instructions: Place all in large salad bowl in order given. Top with chilled dressing.

title: Marinated Grilled Chicken Breasts
instructions: In mixing bowl whisk together orange juice concentrate olive oil honey garlic salt pepper and lemon thyme. Place chicken in a plastic container with a lid. Pour marinade over chicken so that the chicken is coated. Keep in refrigerator for 2 hours to overnight.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars; add eggs and vanilla. Mix together with flour oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. Add chips candy and nuts. Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes. This is a very large recipe but recipe can be halved.

title: Revolutionary War Pound Cake
instructions: 1. Combine all cake ingredients mix well. 2. Divide into 3 round 9-inch cake pans that have been greased

title: Substitute For Two Or Three Eggs
instructions: Substitute water baking powder oil and flour for each egg in recipes calling for 2 or 3 eggs. May substitute milk or other liquids for water.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Add all ingredients (except ham). Beat until creamy. Add shredded ham into mixture. Roll into ball.

title: Beef-Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Mix remaining ingredients in a crock-pot. Add beef. Simmer 1 to 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Floating Island Supreme(Serves 8)
instructions: Place paper cups in muffin pans. Fill with ice cream. Sprinkle coconut over tops. Freeze; serve frozen.

title: Minted Fruit Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine all the ingredients except fruit; stir until sugar dissolves. Place fruit in large shallow dish; pour the mixture over. Cover. Chill 3 hours or overnight stirring occasionally. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Spray large skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Saute onions for 2 or 3 minutes. Add broccoli mushrooms oyster sauce parsley and water. Cover; cook 5 minutes until broccoli is tender. Trim all visible fat from beef. Broil thin slices. Add meat and vermicelli to skillet. Cook; stir until meat is heated about 1 minute.

title: 2-Minute Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: In 1 1/2 quart casserole stir sugar cocoa salt milk and vanilla together until partially blended (mixture is too stiff to thoroughly blend in all of dry ingredients). Put butter over top in center of dish. Microwave at High for 2 minutes or until milk feels warm on bottom of dish. Stir vigorously until smooth. If all butter has not melted in cooking it will as mixture is stirred. Blend in nuts. Pour into wax paper lined 8 x 4 x 3-inch dish. Chill 1 hour in refrigerator or 20 to 30 minutes in freezer. Cut in squares.

title: Hash Brown Baked Potatoes
instructions: Melt 1 stick oleo. Combine with soup and sour cream. Add all other ingredients and stir in potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients; drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Quick Beef And Vegetable Stew
instructions: In large saucepan combine all ingredients except peas. Simmer covered 20 minutes. Add peas and continue cooking 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
instructions: Wash and hull berries. Crush to make 1 3/4 cups crushed berries. If measure is short add water to berries.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Place cored and peeled apples in large baking pan. Mix butter sugar and apple pie spice. Divide evenly and put into center of apple. Wrap each apple in pie crust and sprinkle with remaining spice and sugar mix. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Combine marshmallows and pineapple. Add nuts and Cool Whip; then add dry pistachio pudding mix. Mix well and chill overnight.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order listed. Mix until well blended. Place in an 8-inch buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix all ingredients together. Roll into bite size balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for approximately 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chive Cheese Spread
instructions: Melt butter in medium saucepan. Stir in flour and salt and cook stirring constantly until bubbly. Stir in milk and continue cooking and stirring until sauce thickens and boils 1 minute. Add cheese. Stir until melted. Serve hot over cabbage.

title: Fastnacht Kuecheles
instructions: Put flour into large pan and let stand at room temperature until lukewarm. Push to sides of pan and make a well in the center. Soften yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar in 3/4 cup of milk. Pour into flour. Let stand in well until foamy then add remaining sugar and melted fat. Work ingredients to a dough adding a little more flour if necessary. Cover and let rise in a warm place until light. Turn onto a floured board and roll about half an inch thickness. Cut in diamond or squares and let stand on board until very light. If kitchen is very warm this will not be too long.

title: Holiday Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 10-inch tube pan; line bottom of pan with waxed paper.

title: Super Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown and set.

title: Dijon Potato Salad
instructions: Combine first four ingredients and pepper. Stir in remaining ingredients cover and chill. Makes 4 1/2 cups.

title: Raisin Sauce
instructions: Bring water to the boil. Add raisins and boil for 5 minutes. Stir in sugar; reduce heat to medium. Combine cornstarch and cold water and stir into mixture. Stir in next 4 ingredients and cook until thickened. Stir in vinegar. Serve sauce warm over cooked ham.

title: Low-Fat Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook grits in boiling water for 15 to 20 minutes. Add cheese liquid Butter Buds Egg Beaters garlic powder and Tabasco. Stir in chopped green chilies if desired. Pour into large glass casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly and cheese is melted. Yields 12 to 24 servings. Fat 2.2 g cholesterol 2.1 mg; calories 79 carbohydrates 8.3 g; protein 6.3 g; sodium 171 mg.

title: Zucchini Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add tomato sauce and spices. Cook slowly for 15 minutes. Wash squash and slice lengthwise. (I peel mine.) Mix egg cottage cheese and flour. Set aside. Parboil squash 3 minutes; drain.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Place all ingredients in order in a large bowl. Be sure to include any water left in the raisins and currants after boiling. Mix with a medium beater until well mixed. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased ring pan or 2 to 3 loaf pans.

title: Sunshine Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve orange jello in hot water according to package directions. Stir in carrot. Set bowl in refrigerator to chill. Meanwhile dissolve lemon jello with 1 cup hot water. Stir in cold water. Stir in pineapple and set on counter to cool.

title: Punch
instructions: Add first 4 ingredients together and cook 5 minutes. Mix jello as directed and add to mixture. Put in large or small containers and freeze. Remove from freezer and let thaw to a slush. Add a quart or more of ginger ale. Serves 35 cups.

title: Easy Banana Pudding(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Combine condensed milk with water. Add pudding mix and beat one minute. Fold in La Creme. Spoon one cup of pudding mix into a 2 1/2-quart glass bowl. Top with vanilla wafers then bananas. Repeat layers 2 times ending with pudding.

title: Fred'S Doritos Casserole
instructions: Mix ground beef soup Ro-Tel and onions. Grate cheese and set aside. In a large bowl you can bake in put a layer of Doritos then add layer of ground beef mixture then a layer of cheese. Repeat again ending up with a layer of ground beef mix and cheese. Bake uncovered for 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and nuts; set aside. Beat eggs in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar oil and vanilla; beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients stirring until mixed.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix and let set overnight.

title: Sunrise Salad
instructions: In a small bowl combine gelatin and water. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Combine pineapple and banana with gelatin; top with marshmallows and chill until set.

title: Heavenly Dip
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Cook over medium heat until smooth and thick. Cool completely. Fold in whipped cream. Delicious with fresh fruit.

title: Toffee Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter sugar yolk and vanilla; stir in flour and salt until blended. Pack into rectangular 9 x 13-inch greased baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Remove; immediately apply crumbled chocolate bar.

title: New Orleans Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add butter sugar syrup and salt; mix well. Add pecans and vanilla; blend. Pour into pie shell and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until a silver knife comes out clean when inserted in center of filling.

title: Chocolate Swirl Cheesecake
instructions: Melt chocolate. Let cool. Cream the cream cheese well. Whip in sugar vanilla and eggs (one at a time). Mix 2 cups of cheese mixture with melted chocolate. Grease large pie pan or 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Pour in plain mixture and swirl in chocolate mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or less. Do not overbake. Chill. This is a crustless cheesecake.

title: Chop Meat And Cheese Casserole
instructions: In a pan brown beef; drain. Add onion sauce chili powder and garlic; simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Separate biscuits; pat 5 on bottom of an ungreased casserole dish. Combine 1/2 cup cheese sour cream and egg. Mix well. Mix together meat and sour cream mixtures. Pour on biscuits. Arrange rest of biscuits on top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Layer 1 can green beans on bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle minced garlic over beans. Cover with cheese mixes. Layer bread crumbs. Pour olive oil over bread crumbs. Salt and pepper as needed or desired. Pour small amount of water to wet bottom of dish. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Brittle
instructions: Melt peanut butter chips white chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons butter in double boiler. Add pretzels and nuts. Line cookie sheet with foil. Spread cool break and store in tin.

title: No-Fat Fruit Dessert
instructions: Take cake out of its wrapping and place on a cake dish. With a serrated edged knife slice the top 1/2 to 3/4 inch off the cake and put aside. Cut inside the cake 1/2 inch from each side being careful not to cut all the way through to the bottom of the cake. Then pull out a tunnel all around the inside of the cake.

title: Granny Berrier'S Blackberry Dumplings
instructions: Combine blackberries sugar and lemon extract. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Turkish Delight
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth; set aside. In 9 x 13-inch pan spread one roll chocolate chip cookie dough. Spread cream cheese mixture on top of dough. Cover with remaining cookie dough by patting pieces of cookie dough with hands and laying it on top of cream cheese.

title: Pimento Cheese Spread
instructions: Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick (really thick). Add to cheese mixture and blend in. Pour into container and refrigerate.

title: Easy Mints
instructions: Combine margarine and water. Place over low heat until margarine melts. Remove from heat; add salt and extract. Gradually add sugar blending until desired consistency is reached. Knead until smooth. Add a few drops of the food coloring before kneading. (You can divide this and make several colors.) Roll and slice. Makes 1 pound of mints. Does not keep for long period of time. Very good.

title: Lincoln Cheese Log
instructions: Blend cheeses and horseradish chill. Form into log. Coat with pecans. Wrap and refrigerate at least 24 hours. Serve with rye crackers or party rye bread.

title: Beef, Beans And Rice
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add onion and rice brown slightly. Add remaining ingredients and place in casserole. Cover with lid or foil. Bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until rice is done and most of moisture is absorbed. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Corey'S Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Cream peanut butter margarine vanilla and brown sugar. Add eggs and flour. Mix well. Spread into an 8 x 8-inch pan greased well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Wonderful Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Grease Bundt pan. Place package of rolls in pan. Mix sugar pudding pecans and cinnamon; sprinkle on top. Pour melted butter on top. Let set overnight or about 7 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Lemon Coolers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix Cool Whip and egg in a large bowl. Dough may be mixed by hand since it is like cookie dough and very thick. Drop by teaspoonful into powdered sugar to coat. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Mix the onion and peppers in a large bowl with the carrots. Heat the remaining ingredients together until sugar is dissolved and smooth. Pour over carrots. Cover well; refrigerate at least 12 hours.

title: Baked Chicken Thighs
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan place preserves dressing and soup mix. Mix and heat slowly. Layer thighs in single layer. Bake at 400\u00b0 turning every 20 minutes or so in uncovered pan for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Tilt pan to remove fat.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and cream cheese. Add two eggs and beat until fluffy. Add sugar and beat well. Add remaining eggs and flour alternately. Bake in greased and floured pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Stir together salad dressing mustard celery seed salt and pepper. Add remaining ingredients; mix gently. Chill. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chuck Box Chicken
instructions: Combine salad dressing and egg. Set aside. Rinse chicken with water and drain. Dredge chicken in flour mixed with salt and pepper. Dip in dressing and egg mixture. Roll in cornflake crumbs. Arrange chicken pieces in foil lined broiler pan. Drizzle with melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 4 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Mix beaten eggs banana and lemon juice together; add to shortening mixture. Gradually add dry ingredients while mixing. Add chopped nuts. Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine flour and baking powder. Add vanilla to milk. Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs then milk alternately with dry ingredients. Fold in blueberries. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Sukiyaki
instructions: Prepare all items. Heat 12-inch skillet to 400\u00b0. Best if cooked at table with electric skillet. Melt suet and grease pan evenly. Add beef slowly until cooked and push aside in pan. Add soy sugar and stock. Allow to heat. Add other ingredients and cook. Add liquid as needed.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Brown meat onions and bell pepper. Add tomato sauce and seasoning. Allow to cook 5 minutes. Slice and salt eggplants then fry in a small amount of oil. Arrange slices of eggplant and sauce alternately in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Whip eggs and cheese together. Pour over casserole and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix sugar water soy sauce pineapple juice oil garlic and ginger powder. Saturate chicken wings good. Keep in refrigerator overnight or at least 8 hours. Shake well periodically.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Bring margarine sugar and milk to a full rolling boil in heavy 4-quart saucepan stirring constantly. Boil for 5 minutes over medium heat stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add remaining ingredients; beat until well blended. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool; cut into squares. Preparation time 5 minutes. Cooking time 20 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill. Roll in balls and dip in sugar. Press flat with bottom of glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hal'S Black Bean Dream Soup
instructions: Saute carrots onion celery and pepper in olive oil. Add beans and chicken broth. Add all spices. Simmer 2 hours plus or minus. Add ham or kielbasa. Simmer 38 minutes. Puree 1/2 of soup and return. Serve with parsley and sour cream.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix well and serve.

title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat the first 9 ingredients in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth and fluffy. Make a topping of the brown sugar cinnamon and chopped pecans or walnuts.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Cream butter and sugars add egg and vanilla. Mix flour and baking soda together and add to the mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto the cookie sheet and bake for 8 minutes or until browned.

title: Pizza Loaf
instructions: Roll out bread dough as for nut roll (do not let dough raise). Mix the egg oregano parsley and garlic salt; spread on rolled out dough then sprinkle with cheese and pepperoni. Roll up as nut roll and place on greased cookie sheet. Brush roll with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 35 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix eggs corn syrup melted chocolate sugar butter and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans and pour in shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Pie is done if knife comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugars salt egg and peanut butter in order. Mix together baking soda and flour and blend into peanut butter mixture. Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet. Press with fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for ten minutes.

title: Rice Cake Ricotta
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients with mixer on medium. See recipe for crust to follow. Bake in 10-inch pie plate at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs with 1 stick melted butter. Put in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together eggs 2 sticks butter powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat mixture for 15 minutes with electric mixer. Spread mixture over crumbs. Spread sliced bananas over mixture. Spread drained pineapple over bananas. Spread Cool Whip over bananas. Sprinkle with pecans. Top with maraschino cherries. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix well and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Stuff
instructions: Whip cream; add Eagle Brand and lemon juice; pour into crust and chill.

title: Crazy Crust Cherry Pie
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder water shortening and egg. Blend well at low speed. Spread batter in a 9-inch pie dish. Carefully spoon filling into center of batter. Do not stir. Bake 35 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Blend. When well blended chill and serve as needed.

title: Cheese Fondue
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Add yolks well beaten; cut in whites beaten stiff. Pour in buttered baking dish. Bake 20 minutes in moderate oven.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan combine chicken stock carrots celery onions and oregano. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Lower heat to medium and simmer for about 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from pan and set aside for 5 minutes. Cut or shred into bite size pieces. While chicken is cooling stir noodles into stock cook until noodles are tender. Stir in parsley and chicken. Low-fat.

title: Beans And Beef
instructions: Brown beef pepper and onion; drain. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts (boil in water for 30 minutes) and cut in bite-size pieces. Set aside. Mix soup water chestnuts butter curry and lemon in saucepan over medium heat until heated through. Place some sauce in bottom of casserole. Layer chicken broccoli and sauce until all used up. Top with slivered almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until heated through.

title: Chocolate Feather Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in a large bowl. Mix in other ingredients in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 3 tablespoons juice. Combine sugar and flour. Stir in the reserved pineapple juice. Add cheese and pineapple chunks. Mix well. Spoon mixture into a 1-quart casserole. Combine butter with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mississippi Fudge Cake
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt in bowl in a saucepan. Mix water shortening oleo and cocoa. Bring to a boil. Pour over dry mixture. Mix well. Add eggs milk soda and vanilla. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: East India Salad
instructions: Combine yogurt mayonnaise orange peel salt and curry powder. Chill. Pare section and dice orange into a large bowl. Toss lightly with yogurt mixture and add remaining ingredients. Chill before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Shirley'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender. Buzz on and off until vegetables are in tiny pieces and mixture blended. Store in refrigerator. It just gets better.

title: Ramen Noodle Cabbage Salad
instructions: Combine all salad ingredients in large bowl. Combine all dressing ingredients in separate bowl and shake well. Our over cabbage mixture.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a bowl; stir well. Divide into 6 equal portions shaping each into a 1-inch thick patty. Coat an electric skillet with vegetable cooking spray; heat to 320\u00b0. Add patties and cook 5 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towels; set aside and keep warm. (I put them in the oven on warm.)

title: Marshmallow Rice Krispie Treats
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients over low heat; keep on low heat. Dip marshmallow in hot mixture. Roll in Rice Krispies. Put on wax paper covered cookie sheet and refrigerate until caramel hardens. Makes between 50 and 60 treats.

title: Southwestern Corn Bread
instructions: In a food processor or blender coarsely chop corn; set aside. In a bowl combine flour cornmeal baking soda and salt. In a small bowl combine egg egg whites milk and oil. Stir into dry ingredients until moistened. Add cheese chilies and corn. Pour into a 9-inch square baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Serve warm.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: In saucepan mix sugar Karo and oleo. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Add peanuts to mixture and coat well. Add soda and vanilla.

title: Chicken Salad Filling
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Add lettuce to each sandwich.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Salt and cook sliced squash and onions over medium heat with no water. Mash and drain. Add sour cream pimentos soup and carrots. Melt 1 stick margarine and mix with stuffing. Line bottom of casserole dish with stuffing. Pour other ingredients over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown onions in butter and oil in large pot. Add meat. Brown well. Add garlic vegetables salt and pepper as you brown meat. When browned sprinkle mixture with flour; simmer for a few minutes.

title: Cream Cheese All Butter Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan or 12 cup Bundt pan. Beat butter and cream cheese until well blended; add sugar to cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in vanilla. Sift together flour and salt. Blend into creamed mixture. Spoon batter into prepared pan. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 5 minutes; turn out onto wire rack and cool completely. Dust with confectioners sugar if desired.

title: Bailey'S Irish Creme
instructions: Place all ingredients except whipping cream in bowl. Beat well. Add whipping cream. Beat 1 to 2 minutes longer.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening. Add beaten egg and molasses. Sift together dry ingredients and add to mixture. Mix well and chill for 3 hours or overnight. Form into balls the size of a walnut. Roll in powdered sugar and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on racks.

title: Chicken Wrapped In Bacon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with dried beef. Wrap the chicken breast with bacon strips and place on top of dried beef. Mix together sour cream and soup and pour mixture evenly

title: Southwest Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together; pack into a loaf pan. Spread catsup on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Shake flour in 10 x 16-inch Brown-in-Bag and place in baking dish. Add bouillon pineapple and juice green pepper strips and onion slices to bag. Combine brown sugar and cornstarch. Add vinegar and soy sauce. Mix until smooth and pour into bag. Turn bag gently to mix ingredients well. Combine remaining ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place meatballs in single layer in bag. Close bag. Puncture top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and add sugars. Stir in egg water and vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients oatmeal chocolate chips and raisins. Put on cookie sheet. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Sausage Stuffing Broccoli Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile in 10-inch skillet over medium heat cook sausage until browned and no longer pink stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid according to directions on package. Mix with Hawaiian Punch and pineapple juice. Add ginger ale when serving.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Beat the eggs well; add the salt milk and sugar and beat in the flour and baking powder with enough corn meal to form a soft batter; bake in shallow well-greased pans in a moderate oven about half an hour. The exact quantity of corn meal cannot be given; usually about two cups will be sufficient.

title: Zucchini Lasagna
instructions: In a large skillet cook beef and onion until browned. Drain fat. Add tomato sauce herbs salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Slice zucchini lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices. Arrange half of the zucchini slices in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Salt lightly. Beat Ricotta or cottage cheese with egg; spread on zucchini. Top with half the cheese mixture and half of the sauce. Layer with remaining zucchini cheese and sauce. Sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese. Pre-heat oven 350\u00b0. Bake uncovered 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly and zucchini is tender. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook hamburger and onion until brown (drain). Add salt and pepper. Spread in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Put the rest of ingredients in blender on high for 15 seconds. Pour in baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Mexican Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: Pound chicken breasts out flat. In middle put 1/2 to 1 whole green chile on chicken breast. Cover pepper with cheese and 1/8 to 1/4 teaspoon cilantro. Roll up and secure with toothpick.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat oil and sugar together; add eggs and beat until creamy. Sift dry ingredients together; stir into batter. Add remaining ingredients and stir to blend. Pour into buttered floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool in pan. Makes 2 small or 1 large cake.

title: Oreo Delight
instructions: Chop Oreo cookies fine; put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Make sure bottom is covered. Drip chocolate syrup over cookies. (Reserve some syrup for top.) Mix ice cream and Cool Whip together; pour over cookies. Sprinkle with peanuts then drip more chocolate. Freeze before serving.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix well; drop by spoonful. Bake 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Seven-Layered Salad
instructions: Tear half lettuce and put in the bottom of bowl. Add salt pepper and sugar. Add the sliced hard-boiled eggs then add the peas. Tear other half of lettuce; layer on top of peas. Crumble the bacon then add the grated Swiss cheese. Cover completely with mayonnaise. Put onions on top (chopped). Sprinkle paprika on top of onions. Cover and chill for 24 hours. Toss and serve.

title: Fruit Delight
instructions: Make jello as directed. Chill until thickens; fold in cocktail then chill!

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
