instructions: Beat well one egg. Beat in buttermilk and soda. Then beat in flour sugar baking powder salt and oil and mix well. Heat griddle and grease well. Pour from spoon slightly apart. Turn pancake as soon as they are puffed and bubbly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Mix
instructions: Layer ingredients into jar in order given. Press each layer firmly before adding the next ingredient.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks and egg until light. Add sugar gradually and continue beating. Add corn meal and blend thoroughly. Add cream and butter mixing well and finally the grated lemon peel. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes. This will make 8 tarts or a 9-inch pie.

title: Fruit Pudding Delight
instructions: Layer on bottom of a big deep dish or bowl first the angel food cake pudding Cool Whip and then fruit (strawberries). Repeat angel food cake pudding Cool Whip and then fruit (blueberries). Last layer whatever is left of angel food cake pudding and Cool Whip then fruit (raspberries).

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Louisiana Yam Cornbread
instructions: Sift flour with cornmeal baking powder salt and sugar; set aside. Combine eggs milk and oil in large bowl; beat until smooth. Add yams; beat until blended. Add flour mixture stirring only until flour mixture is moistened. Spoon into 2 greased 8-inch square pans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cut into squares. Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Combine ingredients in order given. Bake in greased jelly roll pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Crab Soup
instructions: Combine crabmeat soups and bouillon. Let come to a boil and add 1/2 cup sherry wine.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl beat Eagle Brand and peanut butter until smooth. Add biscuit mix and vanilla. Mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Flatten with fork. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned. (Careful not to overbake.) Let cool and store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Chocolate Frosted Ice Cream Roll
instructions: Grease a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Line pan with paper; grease paper and set pan aside. Sift first 4 ingredients together; set mixture aside. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) at high speed of an electric mixer until foamy. Gradually add sugar beating until soft peaks form. Set aside. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored; stir in flavorings. Fold yolk mixture into egg white mixture then gently fold in flour mixture. Spread batter evenly in the prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Brisket Rub(For 3 To 5 Pound Brisket)
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for black pepper. Add enough pepper to make a paste. Rub paste thoroughly over brisket (excess fat trimmed away). Wrap in HEAVY aluminum foil. Leave overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll in small balls and roll in powdered sugar. Put on wax paper and put in refrigerator.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix over medium heat with butter milk sugar cocoa stirring constantly. Bring to a boil. Boil one minute at a full boil. (Time it too little time they wont set well and too much boiling they are too hard). Remove from heat after one minute and add 1/2 cup peanut butter and 3 cups oatmeal and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Stir well then place by teaspoon full into waxed paper until set.

title: Apple Slices
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients like pie crust. Divide in half and roll for bottom of 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Place apple slices on crust. Mix last 4 ingredients in saucepan. Boil until slightly thickened. Pour over apples. Roll out second crust. Place over apples. Make a few slits in top crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Frost while still warm with a thin powdered sugar icing.

title: Oriental Shrimp Appetizer
instructions: Saute celery onion and pepper until soft. Add mushrooms. Mix all ingredients together except crumbs. Spoon into casserole. Sprinkle with crumbs. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons melted oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot on crackers.

title: Cucumber Sour Cream Salad
instructions: Sprinkle cucumbers with salt. Chill. Mix sour cream with remaining ingredients. Drain cucumbers thoroughly; add to sour cream and mix well. Serve immediately. Serves 8.

title: Fig Preserves
instructions: Mix ingredients. Cook slowly stirring often until boiling. Let cook about 20 to 30 minutes or until syrupy stirring often. Spoon boiling fruit into sterile jars and seal immediately.

title: Yummy Refrigerator Dessert
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers. Mix 1/2 of the crumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter and spread in bottom of 8 or 9-inch square Pyrex dish. Beat eggs until frothy and add confectioners sugar vanilla and 1/2 cup softened butter. Place egg mixture over crumbs; sprinkle 1/2 cup nuts over egg mixture. Top nuts with pineapple. Top pineapple with 1/2 pint stiffly beaten whipped cream. Sprinkle rest of cookie crumbs over whipped cream. Refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Top each serving with maraschino cherry.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Turn off heat. Stir in oatmeal nuts and vanilla. Beat until cool. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Noodles
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add salt and water. Stir in flour to make very stiff dough. Knead until smooth. Roll thin. Let dry for at least an hour then roll up like a jelly roll and slice 1/8-inch thick. Shake out strips and boil until done in chicken or beef broth.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed. Drop by spoonfuls on greased pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven until light brown about 10 minutes.

title: Simmering Potpourri
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. To simmer place 1/2 cup mixture and 2 cups water in a small saucepan on stovetop or in an electric potpourri pot. Add more water as needed.

title: Delicious White Bread
instructions: Mix yeast sugar salt oil and water (the water must be very warm 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0) in a large bowl. Add 3 cups of the flour and mix with electric mixer until well blended about 3 minutes. Stir in additional flour and mix with large spoon until dough pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl.

title: Hot Crescent Rolls
instructions: Mix dissolved yeast sugar eggs and warm water. Add oil salt and flour. Let stand 8 hours or overnight. Stir down in 3 parts. Roll out on floured board as pie crust; cut into eight sections (pie shape). Roll wide edge into the point (like crescent rolls). Place on cookie sheet. Let rise 6 hours (or less). Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash And Apple Casserole
instructions: Mix squash and apples in a 3-quart casserole. Melt 4 tablespoons butter and combine with brown sugar cinnamon and walnuts. Sprinkle over squash and apples. Dot with remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until tender.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut into sliced and lay on 12-inch pizza pan covered with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Finely grate vegies and mix well. Mix next 3 ingredients and pour over vegies. Toss well and chill.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add water and vinegar. Boil for 5 minutes. Add diced cooked beets and let stand for 30 minutes. Pat with butter and serve. Use more cornstarch if you prefer a thicker sauce.

title: Double Cheese
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. In large skillet cook meat onion and celery until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain off fat. Stir in tomato sauce and salt. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in cottage cheese sour cream and cream cheese then add noodles. Pour into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Slice tomato and arrange on top. Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Ground Beef
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in a large skillet until meat is browned stirring to crumble meat. (I add about 1/2 cup water. This makes the meat crumble real well. I then cook the water dry.) Drain. Add flour and seasonings. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes. Can be used for tacos burritos taco salad etc.

title: Shrimp Potato Stew
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan heat oil on medium setting. Add onions and cook until brown. Add shrimp and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in cubed potatoes parsley boiling water and salt and pepper. Cook for 60 minutes. Serve over rice. For better taste boil shrimp peelings in water for shrimp stock.

title: Frosted Lime Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Best Cherry Pie
instructions: Drain cherries but reserve 3/4 cup juice. Combine cherries juice sugar tapioca almond extract and red food coloring. Put in a large 9 or 10-inch unbaked pie crust. Dot with butter and lattice topping. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook sugar cornstarch and water until thick. Add jello; cool until almost stiff. Add strawberries. Pour in pie shell then chill. Top with whipped cream.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli or winter mix until tender; drain. Place into buttered 2-quart dish. Combine soup eggs cheese onion and Miracle Whip. Pour over hot vegetables. Toss croutons with melted butter. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Easy Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Combine first three ingredients in a small bowl. Stir in coconut egg whites and vanilla. Drop by tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto a cookie sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from cookie sheet and let cool on a wire rack. Yields 1 dozen cookies.

title: Hot Rice
instructions: Saute onions celery bell peppers jalapeno peppers and garlic until tender. Mix sausage in and cook until done. Cook rice according to package directions. Combine sausage/vegetable mixture rice and soup. Heat through. Serves 12.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add tomatoes paste water onion and seasonings. Simmer 10 minutes. Fry tortillas in hot oil until softened; drain. Place rounded tablespoonful of meat sauce and cheese on each tortilla. Roll up tightly. Place seam side down in an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Top with remaining sauce and cheese. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: *Hershey Pound Cake
instructions: Sift together flour and sugar. Add margarine and buttermilk with soda. Beat for 2 minutes. Add vanilla eggs and melted chocolate. Beat 1 minute. Add pecans. Bake 1 1/2 hours in a tube pan at 325\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Trim away any excess fat from steak and cut into 1/4 slices. Heat a large skillet until very hot with about 1 tablespoon butter and swirl to coat bottom of pan. Pan fry beef strips a few at a time 1 minute on each side or until steak is as done as you like it. Add remaining butter to skillet and stir in onions. Saute about 5 minutes. Push to 1 side stir in mushrooms and saute for 3 minutes. Add beef broth and salt and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Creamy Chipped Beef Casserole
instructions: Snip beef in bite size pieces. Brown in Crisco until edges curl; drain. Mix milk and soup. Add beef hash browns and 1/2 can onion rings. Place in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake covered for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove lid. Crumble remainder of onion rings over top. Return to oven for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Oriental Chicken Wings
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0.

title: Polish Babka
instructions: Scald milk add sugar and butter. Cool. Dissolve yeast with a little of the warm milk mixture in bowl and then add to remaining milk mixture. Add one half of the flour and beat well. Add salt to eggs and beat until thick. Add to mixture and mix well. Add the rest of the flour orange and lemon rind. Knead for 15 minutes then add the raisins and nuts. If dough is sticky add more flour. Cover and let rise in a greased bowl until double in bulk.

title: Confetti Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain well. Combine macaroni Spam cheese green pepper and onion. Stir well and chill. Combine mayonnaise milk vinegar and salt. Pour over macaroni salad and toss well.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Boil noodles until done. Drain and cool. Put a layer of lasagna noodles in 9 x 13-inch pan and then add 1/3 of hamburger or pork on that layer then 1/3 of the sauce 1/3 of cottage cheese and 1/3 of the Mozzarella. Do this 3 times so you should have 3 layers. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Hot Wings
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Place chicken in a bowl. Pour 1/2 bottle of hot sauce over chicken. Toss and let sit for 10 minutes then toss again. Put drummettes in a baking pan and pour barbecue and the other half of hot sauce then pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 35 minutes and uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Chowder - The Bounty
instructions: Cook broccoli covered in 1 can of chicken broth until tender. Remove broccoli from broth and chop coarsely. Add milk cream ham salt pepper and dry mustard to broth and broccoli. Simmer and stir occasionally. Saute onions and potato in butter. Add the other can of chicken broth and cook until soft. Add the potato mixture and the remaining ingredients to broccoli; heat just to serving temperature. Serves 6 or more if using smaller servings to accompany sandwich etc.

title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli using florets only. Add chopped onion and bacon pieces. Toss. Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar until well blended. Stir into broccoli. Sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: In covered pan cook potatoes in salted water about 20 minutes. While potatoes are cooking brown beef with onion and drain off fat. Add beans soup water salt & pepper. Mix together place in 2-quart casserole dish and set aside. When potatoes are done mash while still hot stir in egg and add enough milk to make fluffy. Season with salt & pepper and spread over meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Slice Italian bread lengthwise and place on a foil-lined cookie sheet. Spread with softened butter and sprinkle with garlic salt and basil. Top with shredded Mozzarella. Bake until crust is lightly browned and cheese is melted.

title: Cherry-Dump Cake
instructions: Layer as listed. May add 1 cup coconut if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Spread the cream cheese onto a large plate or platter. Pour the seafood sauce over the cream cheese and spread evenly. Next put the olives over the seafood sauce. Finally top it off with the shrimp. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Boo And Boo'S Favorite Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in oblong pan. Mix together flour sugar and milk; make into a batter. Pour into pan of melted butter and pour in fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Sausage Appetizers
instructions: Cut sausages in half crosswise. Wrap each in 1/2 strip of bacon securing with a toothpick. Place one layer in the bottom of a crock-pot and cover with a layer of brown sugar. Repeat until all sausages are used ending with sugar. Cook on low setting for about 4 hours.

title: Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Do not attempt to bake at a higher temperature or the brownies will burn. Generously grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium saucepan over low heat stirring constantly until the chocolate is nearly melted. Remove from heat and stir until smooth.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Melt margarine and marshmallows in double boiler. Pop popcorn and put into a large bowl. Pour marshmallow mixture onto popcorn; mix in M&Ms and peanuts. Press into large greased pan. Cool in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Onion Pockets
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rolls. On lightly floured board separate rolls into 4 rectangles each making a total of eight. Press perforated edges together. Place 2 to 3 tablespoons of mixture over half of each roll. Fold edges together. Press edge with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: The Best Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla. Gradually add the flour. Bake in a large greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Pizza Snack
instructions: Toast bread. Put tomato seasonings and cheese on toast. Broil for 1 to 5 minutes. Good with salad. Equals 1 bread 1 fat 1 meat 1/2 vegetable exchange on diabetic diet.

title: Crock-Pot Texas Hash
instructions: Brown beef drain off fat. Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Stir thoroughly cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours (on high for 4 hours). Serve with garlic and tossed salad.

title: Shrimp Chowder
instructions: Dice shrimp and set aside. Cook onion in margarine; add water potatoes and seasonings. Cover and cook 15 minutes until tender. Add milk flour and shrimp. Stir over low heat until thickened and shrimp are heated through.

title: Zucchini Bread(Two 9 X 5-Inch Loaves)
instructions: Stir until well blended. Add 1 cup nuts (walnuts). Pour into pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Amaretto Cocoa Mix
instructions: In a very large bowl combine all ingredients; stir until well blended. Store in airtight container. Yields about 19 1/2 cups cocoa mix.

title: Sherry And Miss Jessie'S Parson'S Rolls
instructions: Mix soda and\tdissolved yeast in buttermilk.\tCombine with other ingredients\tand knead. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on baking sheet. Let dough warm to room temperature (or may be placed in oven immediately). Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Cream together first three ingredients. Add creamed mixture to pudding mixture. In food processor crush one package Oreo cookies. Layer pudding and crushed Oreos. Save enough cookies to put on top. Can put Gummy worms through or on top or silk flower.

title: Country Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 of tomato sauce. Form meat loaf shape in a shallow baking pan. Pour remaining tomato sauce over top. Bake 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: *One cup of butter-flavored Crisco can be substituted for oleo and shortening.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Cream together oil eggs and sugar. Add food coloring and mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and blend with egg mixture. Add strawberries all at once and mix well. Stir in nuts.

title: Jalapeno Cheese Spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Fold 6-inch piece of aluminum foil in half; fold edges up to make a tray. Place nuts chili powder and cumin in tray; place on baking sheet. Bake nut mixture for 6 minutes until fragrant and begins to darken. Let cool.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Combine milk and egg. Add biscuit mix onion and 1/2 cup cheese. Pour into a greased 8 or 9-inch round pan. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup cheese on batter. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Angel Food Dessert
instructions: Slice loaves lengthwise into layers. Make filling of cheese cream sugar and extract. Spread on bottom layers. Top with pie filling then remaining cake layers next another layer of filling and then the balance of pie filling. Chill. Ice sides of cakes with Cool Whip. Do not ice tops. Makes 2 loaf cakes.

title: Heinz Orange Chicken Glaze
instructions: Combine ingredients. Brush on chicken or fish when grilling or broiling.

title: Swedish Beef Stew
instructions: In heated Dutch oven melt butter and 2 tablespoons margarine. Brown the beef. Remove meat add 1 tablespoon margarine and cook chopped onion 10 minutes. Add coffee broth brown sugar and anchovies. Bring to a boil. Add meat and spices. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 2 hours. Thicken with flour-water paste. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
instructions: Melt chocolate chips peanut butter and almond bark in microwave for 3 minutes. Stir in peanuts and drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper. Let cool before touching.

title: Curried Chicken Log
instructions: Cream the cream cheese until smooth with Worcestershire sauce lemon juice red hot pepper sauce and curry powder. Add celery parsley and 2 tablespoons almonds. Blend in chicken. Shape into a roll about 8 inches long on wax paper. Chill several hours or overnight. Just before serving roll in remaining chopped almonds. Place on serving platter; garnish with parsley and place crackers around log. Makes 10 servings.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter shortening eggs and salt. Add rest of ingredients. Roll into balls; flatten on cookie sheet with cup dipped in flour. Sprinkle sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0. Delicious.

title: Date Pinwheel Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; add brown sugar 1/2 cup granulated sugar vanilla and eggs and beat until light. Add sifted dry ingredients. Chill until firm enough to roll.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix together potatoes butter onion soup sour cream and 8 ounces of cheese. Put 4 ounces of cheese on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except bread crumbs. Put bread crumbs on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Diabetic Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Add Pet milk Sweet N Low and vanilla flavoring. Stir until mixed well. Pour in freezer container and finish filling with 2% milk. Freeze in hand or electric freezer and serve. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Granola
instructions: In a separate bowl blend the water oil honey vanilla and salt. Add liquid to dry and mix. Spread on 2 greased cookie sheets. Bake 1 hour or until dry and golden. When cool add raisins dates almonds etc. Store in covered containers.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery oranges and pineapple. Blend salad oil orange juice vinegar salt and marjoram. Add chicken mixture; chill for at least 1 hour. Drain if necessary. Add mayonnaise and toss. Sprinkle almonds on top. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
instructions: Mix ingredients and put into crumb crust pie shells. Bake on 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then on 275\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let sit in oven overnight.

title: Millionaire Turtles
instructions: Melt caramels in milk over low heat. Add pecans and mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoons onto heavily buttered cookie sheet. Chill in freezer.

title: Old Fashioned Cornbread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl and mix well. Cut in shortening until well blended. Combine egg and milk in small bowl until well blended. Add egg mixture to dry mixture. Mix well. Pour into greased square pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin Pudding
instructions: Beat pumpkin until well blended. Add sugar and flour; blend until smooth. Add eggs and beat. Add spices and milk. Stir in melted butter and mix well. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in hot 450\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Serves 16 to 20.

title: Sugar Glazed Cookies
instructions: Cream together the shortening butter white sugar and brown sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Sift flour salt soda and cream of tartar. Add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Take 1 teaspoon of dough at a time and form into balls. Dip top half in ice water then in granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. With finger press down the center of each ball. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Jack Pot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; add onion. Cook until golden. Add tomato soup water and noodles; cook until noodles are tender. Stir often. Season to taste. Add corn and 1/2 of cheese. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Butter Mint Salad
instructions: Mix dry jello with pineapple; mix well. Add marshmallows and mints. Refrigerate overnight. Next day fold in Cool Whip and mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill.

title: Creamed Spinach
instructions: On stove top in medium size pot melt 2 tablespoons butter then add 2 tablespoons flour 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of garlic powder. Mix well then add the cup milk. On medium heat keep stirring until mixture thickens and then add thawed spinach and mix well again. (Add 1 hard-boiled egg optional.) Cook a few minutes longer and serve.

title: Cream Cheese Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix together pumpkin sugar spices salt and ginger. Beat in 2 slightly beaten eggs milk and vanilla. Pour into 2 pie crusts.

title: Banana Salad
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch egg and weakened vinegar in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thick. Cool completely and pour over sliced bananas and chopped nuts.

title: Holiday Champagne Punch
instructions: Put frozen block of strawberries in punch bowl. Pour white wine over strawberries. Let sit until strawberries are thawed. Immediately prior to serving gently add champagne. Stir gently. When serving make sure each glass gets a piece of strawberry.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Mix sugar water and liquified bananas lemonade and juices together. Freeze in Ziploc bag approximately 1 to 1 1/2 hours before serving time. Remove from Ziploc bag and place in a large bowl. Pour ginger ale over frozen chunk. As this starts to thaw it makes a real good slushy drink.

title: Sharon'S Cran-Apple Crunch
instructions: Mix apples cranberries and raisins and put in casserole. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over fruit. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Aunt Margaret'S Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs milk and soda. Add sugar and shortening. Add vanilla. Add blended flour and baking powder. Bake dropped on greased cookie sheets 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Bean Pie
instructions: Cook navy beans until tender and can be mashed with a fork. Drain beans in strainer; place beans in blender while warm with milk and melted butter. Blend thoroughly. Add spices sugar and vanilla; mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt 1/2 cup margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in pan. Drain fruit arrange pineapple slices and maraschino cherry halves on sugar mixture. Mix cake as directed on the label with water eggs and 1/2 cup margarine. Do not substitute fruit juice for water. Beat as directed. Pour batter over fruit. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes until tests done with toothpick. Let stand 5 minutes for topping to begin to set then turn upside down on large plate. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Honey Cake
instructions: Combine sugar eggs oil and honey. Beat until very thick. Combine dry ingredients and sift 3 times. Combine pineapple juice and water bring to a boil and add baking soda. Add alternately with dry ingredients to egg mixture. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour into lightly greased 10-inch tube pan lined with waxed paper on bottom. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Croquettes
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water for 30 minutes or until tender. Drain and cool. Peel sweet potatoes and mash. Combine sugar and next 3 ingredients; stir sugar mixture and egg into mashed potatoes. Shape mixture around marshmallow and roll in corn flakes. Place in a single layer on a baking sheet. Cover and freeze 2 hours. Pour oil into a large skillet to depth of 1/2-inch; heat to 350\u00b0. Fry croquettes until golden brown turning once.

title: Freezer Cucumbers
instructions: Cover cucumbers and onions with 2 tablespoons salt and ice cubes and let stand for 2 hours in refrigerator. Drain real good.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Peel and slice apples and mix with the 3/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Arrange this mixture in pie shell. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with flour; cut in butter. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done. Cool. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream.

title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
instructions: Mix ingredients together in order presented. Cut shrimp down the middle. Take out black vein. Put stuffing in shrimp. Place each shrimp in a muffin tin. Bake for 10 minutes. When no longer shiny shrimp are done!

title: Lasagna Pizza
instructions: Prepare a recipe of pizza sauce or use a jar of pizza sauce. Butter 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Arrange 10 lasagna noodles in pan. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup cheese. Cover with remaining noodles. Spread pizza sauce evenly over noodles.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Brown chicken lightly in oil. Add water wine broccoli and soup. Bring to a full boil separating broccoli pieces. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Turketti
instructions: Mix all together; put in flat pan or dish. Top with cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine 1 1/4 cups water 1 cup sugar and oleo in heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved stirring constantly. Dissolve cornstarch in 3 tablespoons cold water. Add to hot mixture stirring constantly. Cook over medium heat until mixture is thickened and transparent. Beat egg yolks with milk and add a small amount of mixture into yolks. Add yolk mixture to saucepan mixture stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice and the lemon rind; cool slightly. Spoon into pastry shell and top with meringue.

title: Danish Sukkernodder
instructions: Beat sugar and butter. Add flour; knead. Roll into filbert-sized balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Donuts
instructions: Combine and deep fat fry.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Cream the 1 1/2 cups brown sugar egg and shortening together then add the milk flour soda and vanilla. Blend well then add the rhubarb. Put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with a mixture of 1/3 cup brown sugar and the cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Gold Drop Cookies
instructions: Spread half of the crackers with peanut butter. Top each with a second cracker. In the top of a double boiler melt butterscotch chips. Dip sandwich cookies into butterscotch. Place on wax paper to set. Yields 1 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute onion until tender in butter. Remove from heat and stir in flour. Drain mushroom liquid and add enough chicken broth to make 1 1/4 cups. Add cream gradually stirring until thickened. Add rest of ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Shrimp Stew
instructions: Saute onion pepper celery and garlic in margarine until clear; drain and set aside. In iron Dutch oven combine flour and oil. Cook on medium heat stirring constantly until light brown (darker for darker gravy). Add shrimp to roux; cook until pink. Add sauteed vegetables; cook and stir together for about 1/2 minute. Add 1 quart water stirring constantly. When smooth add salt black pepper and red pepper to taste. Simmer on low for about 20 minutes. Add water if too thick. Serve over rice.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In saucepan bring sugar cocoa milk and butter to boil. Let boil 2 minutes and add rest of the ingredients. Drop onto wax paper by the spoonful! Let cool.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: In a large saucepan mix butter water and cocoa. Heat to boiling. Take off heat; add flour sugar salt sour cream baking soda and eggs. Mix well and pour into 15 x 11-inch baking pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Pour icing over warm cake.

title: Buckeye Balls
instructions: Mix sugar vanilla softened margarine and peanut butter together. Knead and shape into balls. Place on tray on waxed paper. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Melt shortening with chocolate chips. Dip balls with a toothpick in chocolate 3/4 way. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Remove and store in a sealed container.

title: Peanut Butter Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese together. Add peanut butter. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crusts.

title: Asparagus And Mushroom Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in casserole dish. Pour 1 can of mushroom soup over chicken with 1/2 can water. Cook for about 40 minutes. While waiting cook noodles following package directions. Set aside. When chicken is done place chicken on plate and mix noodles with cooked asparagus and mushrooms in casserole dish. Add chicken on top of noodles and add last can of soup. Heat in oven another 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise; remove the yolks and mash. Combine chicken egg yolks celery mustard salt and mayonnaise; mix well. Stuff the whites with mixture; sprinkle with paprika. Serves 12.

title: Pizza Pie
instructions: Soften yeast in 2 teaspoons warm water. Mix the first 6 ingredients. Place in greased bowl and let rise until doubled in bulk (1/2 hour). Simmer remaining ingredients until dough is ready. Add 2 cups fairly thick tomato gravy. Roll out dough 1/4-inch thick. Let rise 15 minutes. Pour on the sauce and sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Remoulade Sauce For Shrimp
instructions: Mix well; add 1 cup salad oil. You can use blender for this. Pour over boiled peeled shrimp and serve on lettuce with crackers.

title: Bean Burgers
instructions: Spread each 1/2 bun with butter cover with beans and sprinkle with onion and cheese. Top with strips of bacon. Broil about 4-inches from flame until bacon is crisp.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain well. Cut up onion and green pepper. Combine ground beef onion green pepper and all remaining ingredients. Put in pot or dutch oven. Simmer 45 minutes or so. Recipe may be doubled. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Broccoli And Rice Dish
instructions: Boil broccoli until cooked. Cook rice. Add together with milk soup and onion. Heat dish in microwave or oven.

title: Raw Spinach Salad
instructions: Chill all ingredients. Carefully wash spinach leaves through 3 or 4 waters. Drain well and chill. Shred coarsely with kitchen scissors and combine with tomatoes green onions celery and salt. Drizzle dressing over the top and toss lightly until vegetables are well coated with dressing. Garnish with hard-cooked egg. Serve immediately on individual plates. Makes 5 servings.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Beat all ingredients well. Put into casserole. Refrigerate a day or two or freeze. Dice 2 sticks oleo on top and bake until bubbly hot in 350\u00b0 oven approximately 1/2 hour. Bake uncovered.

title: Date Nut Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients except powdered sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 in 8 x 10-inch greased pan for 30 minutes. Cool cut in squares and roll in the powdered sugar.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients then add crushed bananas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together crushed pretzels 1/2 cup sugar and 1/3 cup melted margarine and press in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes and cool. Mix the cream cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar and spread on pretzel crust. Mix strawberry jello dissolved in 2 cups hot water with strawberries and pineapple. When partly set pour over pretzel crust cream cheese and Cool Whip mixture. Refrigerate. Serves 12.

title: Hot Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind onions and peppers together. Heat sugar salt and vinegar to a boil. Add onion and pepper mixture; cook for 3 minutes. Fill hot sterile jars and seal. Makes about 6 pints. Use water bath for 15 minutes.

title: Fried Corn
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Discard all but 4 tablespoons of the bacon drippings. Add corn to frying pan and cook without stirring until bottom is well browned. Add milk and seasonings stirring until mixed thoroughly. Cover and cook over low heat for approximately 10 minutes. Arrange cooked bacon slices on top and serve.

title: Scallop-Rice Salad
instructions: Saute vegetables in olive oil. Add sea scallops and cook until opaque (10 to 15 minutes). Add lemon juice vinegar horseradish and hot sauce. Mix with cooked rice. Serves 2.

title: Lee'S Pancakes
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients together. Add egg yolk oil and water; blend. Fold in the egg whites. Cook in hot skillet on one side until bubbles appear. Turn pancakes to other side and brown lightly. Serve hot. Any leftover batter may be used the next day if refrigerated until ready to use.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar milk and margarine to rolling boil. Boil for 15 minutes. Beat in vanilla Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Company Pot Roast
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Trim fat. Cook in oil in Dutch oven until brown; remove. Mix remaining ingredients except water flour and lemon juice in Dutch oven. Return beef to Dutch oven. Cover and bake 3 hours and 30 minutes or until tender. Remove to heated platter. Skim fat from liquid. Shake water and flour; gradually stir into liquid. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in lemon juice; cook 1 minute. Slice beef thinly. Serve with gravy.

title: Sweet Potatoes With Marshmallows
instructions: Mash potatoes; blend in butter brown sugar cinnamon-sugar and salt. Add cream beating potatoes until creamy and fluffy. Turn into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish or shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Top with marshmallows; broil 1 to 2 minutes until marshmallows are lightly browned.

title: Oriental Fried Rice
instructions: In skillet melt margarine. Saute rice until golden (5 to 10 minutes). Stir in onions bacon sesame seed soy sauce sugar and salt. Heat 5 minutes. Add egg and blend well; cook about 1 minute. Serve immediately.

title: Quick Fudge Brownies
instructions: Melt 1 cup of the chocolate pieces; stir in graham cracker crumbs sweetened condensed milk egg and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in remaining chocolate pieces and nuts. Spread mixture in a well-greased and floured 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes. Cool on a wire rack; cut into squares. Makes 36.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix together oil eggs cheese and onion then add zucchini. Mix until well blended then add Bisquick. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in square baking dish for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown on top.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place 2 teaspoons of mix in a cup/mug and add hot water.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl blend sugar powdered sugar margarine and oil until well mixed. Add almond extract and eggs; mix well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. Gradually blend in all-purpose flour whole wheat flour soda salt and cream of tartar at low speed. By hand stir in almonds and brickle chips. Chill if desired. Shape large tablespoonfuls of dough into balls; roll in sugar. Place 5-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets; with fork dipped in sugar flatten in crisscross pattern. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes or until light golden brown around edges. Cool cookies 1 minute before removing from cookie sheets. Makes 3 1/2 dozen (4-inch) cookies. I make smaller cookies rolling balls about 1-inch makes 7 dozen small cookies.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes with margarine sugar and nuts. Form a ball around 1 marshmallow roll in crushed cornflakes. Just before serving warm sweet potato balls in a 350\u00b0 oven 15 minutes or until marshmallow has softened.

title: Fast Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; drop by spoon into greased floured muffin cups. Fill each cup 3/4 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cheesecake
instructions: In large bowl of electric mixer combine flour baking powder salt pudding mix butter egg and milk. Beat for two minutes at medium speed. Pour mixture into bottom of greased 9-inch deep or 10-inch pie pan. Arrange drained peach slices on top of batter. Shape like flower petals.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large skillet cook meat onions and green pepper until meat and vegetables are tender. Drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat and pour into 2-quart dish. Cover and bake 1 hour ungreased.

title: Finger Paints
instructions: Add enough water to cornstarch to make a paste. Add into boiling water and stir until clear; cool. Add soap flakes and powder. Divide and add food coloring. Store in airtight containers.

title: Cheese Pet
instructions: Alternate bread and cheese in buttered casserole. Beat eggs until thick. Add milk wine mustard and salt. Pour egg mixture over bread and cheese. Let stand for several hours or overnight in refrigerator. Let casserole return to room temperature before baking for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Mix pizza sauce tomato paste and water. Brown ground beef. Make 3 layers of macaroni beef cheese sauce and pepperoni in a 2-quart casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown ground beef in large skillet; add onions garlic and mushrooms. Saute until onion is golden brown. Put in slow cooker with all remaining ingredients. Stir thoroughly; cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Serve over hot buttered noodles or rice.

title: Big Lor'S Excellent Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Clean shrimp. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch glass dish in oven. Add salt garlic and parsley flakes. Mix well. Arrange shrimp in a single layer in the dish. Bake uncovered 5 minutes in oven at 400\u00b0. Turn shrimp. Sprinkle with lemon peel and lemon juice. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.

title: Herbed Black-Eyed Pea Salad
instructions: Cook peas in boiling salted water 15 to 20 minutes or until peas are tender. Drain and rinse under cold water until cool. Drain well; set aside. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Remove bacon reserving drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon; set aside. Add garlic to drippings in skillet; saute 1 minute. Add green onions and red pepper; saute until tender. Cool completely. Combine bacon pepper mixture peas mayonnaise vinegar oregano and pepper; stir well. Serve at room temperature. Yields 8 servings.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix 1 cup Quick Oats and 1 1/2 cup boiling water and set aside.

title: Scrumptious Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and beat for 1 minute. Pour into pan and bake 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Mckenley Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Top will be crusty on top when it is done. Makes 1 pie.

title: Rocky Road Fudge
instructions: Butter an 8-inch square or round baking pan.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Drain grease. Add other ingredients and cook until hot. Garnish with 1/2 cup grated cheese 1/4 cup diced olives and diced onion.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix whipped topping with milk; add lemonade. Whip until smooth. Pour into crust and chill overnight or 4 hours minimum.

title: Hash Browns With Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Butter dish. Add hash browns milk soup and margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Place onion rings and Cheddar cheese on top; bake 5 minutes more or until cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together the margarine (melted) graham cracker crumbs pecans and sugar in a large heavy saucepan. Add peanut butter coconut and vanilla. Form into balls about the size of a walnut. To make the glaze for the balls melt chocolate and paraffin wax in top of a double boiler with boiling water in the bottom. Using a fork carefully dip each ball into the glaze and place on wax paper to harden.

title: Pumpkin Pudding
instructions: Beat together pudding and milk. Refrigerate 5 minutes. Add pumpkin and spice. Mix well. Refrigerate 10 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Cut turkey into small pieces. Put into baking dish or pan. Add soup and milk. Put moist stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly. Serve.

title: Cheese Dip Or Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill 1 hour. Roll into ball; put chopped pecans on outside. Place in small bowl. This ball is softer than most.

title: Lime-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O by package directions and place in freezer until firm. Place Pet milk can in freezer. You only want to chill the milk so it will whip up. Do not freeze the milk. After it chills and Jell-O is firm place milk in chilled glass bowl and whip to firm consistency. Add whipped cream to Jell-O and fold until Jell-O is broken into small pieces. Add some grated cheese and pecan pieces and fold together then place in icebox until needed. Good with chicken dressing and holiday meals.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate. Cool; beat eggs. Add sugar chocolate and butter mixture. Add vanilla nuts and flour with baking powder. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Pour a large jar of marshmallow cream over hot brownies. Place under broiler until lightly browned (2 to 3 minutes). Cool and top with chocolate icing.

title: Granola Bars
instructions: Place oats in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes stirring at 5 minute intervals; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients; add oats and mix well. Spread mixture evenly into lightly greased jellyroll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool completely and cut into bars. Yields about 5 dozen bars.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Roll in shape of a ball or can pat in a shallow dish.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Mix together stuffing seasoning packet soup and broth. Put half of dry stuffing mix in bottom of casserole baking dish. Add layer of chicken. Pour half of soup mixture over chicken. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Cold Tuna Salad
instructions: After pasta has cooled and peas thawed mix all ingredients except mayonnaise. Add mayonnaise to desired consistency. Chill 2 hours or overnight. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
instructions: Combine shortening butter salt sugar and vanilla. Add flour and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Renkin
instructions: In a double saucepan combine soup cheese onion and green pepper. Cook slowly until cheese is melted and onion and green pepper are tender. Stir occasionally. Add egg Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper to taste. Cook slowly for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot on crackers. An excellent Sunday night dish.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Heat milk and flour until hot. Add cheese and heat until melted and thick. Mix Ritz crackers with melted butter. Cook veggies. In 13 x 9-inch pan place veggies. Pour sauce over and spread. Place cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. To reheat bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Violet Duggin'S Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Cook chicken until done with salt pepper water and margarine. Skin chicken; take off bone. Cut in small pieces. Add chicken broth to chicken. Add finely chopped onion and celery. Add 2 beaten eggs bread crumbs and sage (fresh from garden if you have it). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Appetizer
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Add Bisquick last. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch oblong Pyrex pan and bake until golden brown on top at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cut into finger-size squares about 40. Can also be used as a main coarse with salad or as a vegetable dish. Can be made ahead refrigerated then baked before serving. Stays well on a warming tray.

title: Stick Cookies
instructions: Melt chips; add nuts and noodles. Drop on wax paper and chill.

title: Boneless Chicken Italiano
instructions: Cut chicken and red pepper in cubes. Place chicken in baking dish. Mix all ingredients well. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3/4 to 1 hour. Serve with Italian bread and salad.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Note Extra cheese may be used if desired.

title: Chili Tomatoes
instructions: Layer tomato slices and green pepper rings in shallow glass dish. Shake remaining ingredients except lettuce in tightly covered jar. Pour onto vegetables. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Ham-Stuffed Manicotti
instructions: Age fresh duck 3 to 5 days in refrigerator. Bone duck breasts. With breast bone up slit meat along ridge of bone gently scraping and cutting meat away from breast bone making one perfect \fillet\ from each side of breast. (Bones may be used to make stock if desired.)

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: After cabbage is shredded salt well. Grate in carrots add chopped green pepper and grate onion so that only juice is added. Shake together in a large jar. Mix mayonnaise sugar pickle juice and water (if necessary to moisten) through cabbage mixture.

title: Meatballs With Tomatoes And Green Peppers
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and shape into 3/4 inch meat balls. Put in pan with tomatoes and onions. Blend together the soy sauce cornstarch sugar and water. Add to the pan and heat over medium-low heat until boiling. Reduce heat and cook 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Add 2 cups chopped green pepper. Cook 10 minutes or until meat balls are done. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Drop Sand Tarts
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients; mix well. Drop by teaspoons. Dip fork in a beaten egg and press down. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Fine cut peanuts can be added before cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Blend pears with juice and softened cream cheese in blender. Dissolve jello in 1 cup of water; add to other ingredients in blender. Blend. Pour in bowl or mold; place in refrigerator until set.

title: Tomato And Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Boil eggplant in water and salt (sliced); drain and mash. Blend eggs pepper onion oregano and saltines. Slice tomatoes and spread over top then sprinkle cheese. Bake in a buttered casserole for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Percolator Punch
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in percolator. In basket put the spices. Makes 30 cups.

title: Navy Bean Salad
instructions: Cook beans with seasoning and salt; drain. Add the other ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cracklin Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix lightly. Grease iron frying pan (medium size). Cook until top and side are brown and crisp.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Combine ingredients. For each serving add 1 cup hot water to 1/3 cup cocoa mix. Stir until blended. Store remaining mix in airtight container. Makes 28 servings.

title: Freezer Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers and onions; let stand 2 hours. Boil sugar and vinegar until sugar is dissolved. Let cool. Mixture will be thick. Drain cucumbers; sprinkle with celery seed. Add syrup to cucumbers and freeze in plastic containers.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
instructions: Pat crushed Oreos into 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve approximately 1/2 cup crushed Oreos for topping. Drizzle melted margarine evenly over cookies. Refrigerate for about an hour.

title: Gingerbread Men
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and spices. Mix molasses brown sugar egg and shortening. Add dry ingredients to make a soft dough. Chill for 1 hour. Roll on floured board and cut with floured cutters. Bake on greased cookie sheet in 375\u00b0 oven for about 12 minutes. Makes 18 (4-inch) dolls.

title: Coffee Souffle
instructions: Pour strong coffee over the marshmallows. Place over double boiler until they melt and mix well. Let cool. Whip the cream until stiff. Fold the cream into the coffee-marshmallow mixture. Put in sherbet glasses.

title: French Chocolate Silk Pie
instructions: Beat butter until fluffy. Add sugar and melted chocolate. Beat into first mixture. Add vanilla and eggs; beat one at a time. Add a dash of salt. Pour into pie shell. Top with whipped topping.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Blend cheese and butter. Stir in flour salt and paprika and mix well. Wrap 1 tablespoon of the mixture around each olive covering it completely. Arrange on baking sheet and freeze. Place in plastic bags and return to freezer.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Fill large salad bowl with shredded lettuce. Add in layers celery onion green pepper and peas. Spread over with mayonnaise. Sprinkle sugar over mayonnaise. Sprinkle cheese over sugar topping it with bacon.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Mix the rest together and pour over vegetables. Let stand several hours or overnight. Drain all 3 cans of beans before you pour other part over it.

title: Bake-A-Roux
instructions: Mix flour and oil together in a heavy ovenproof container. Place on center shelf in preheated 400\u00b0 oven. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Set timer; stir roux every 15 minutes. Roux should be a caramel color when done. Remove from oven; cool. Transfer to containers with tight fitting lids; store in refrigerator until needed. Roux may also be frozen. Yields enough roux for 4 to 6 pots of gumbo.

title: Broccoli Souffle
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes. Drain well. Combine soup mayonnaise eggs cheese and chopped onion. Mix well. Add cooked broccoli. Pour into greased baking dish. Top with crushed Ritz crackers and drizzle butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Enchilada Pie
instructions: Brown meat with oregano salt and garlic in a separate saucepan. Combine tomato sauce and enchilada sauce. Dip tortillas in heated sauce. Use 3 tortillas for bottom layer in greased 9 x 12-inch dish. Put layer of meat cheese and sauce beginning with tortillas and ending with cheese and sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Gooseberry Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and mix sugar and cornstarch together and add to eggs. Add other ingredients and mix well. Boil until thickened. Pour into prepared unbaked 9-inch crust. Cover with top crust. Brush with milk and sprinkle with a little sugar. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven.

title: Tiny Meat Pies
instructions: Cook onions peppers and chilies in oil with meat until meat is done but not too brown. Salt and pepper. Cool slightly. Add eggs and olives; season to taste. Chill overnight if possible. Prepare pie crusts. Roll dough thinly. Cut in 3-inch rounds. Place 1 tablespoon of filling on rounds and fold over; pinch together at edges with a fork. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes until brown. Yields 90 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine cocoa sugar milk and salt. Boil 2 1/2-3 minutes on medium heat. Remove from heat and add vanilla peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix thoroughly and drop onto wax paper.

title: Meat Filled Manicotti
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Cool in a single layer on foil. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet brown beef and sausage; drain fat. Stir together meat 1 cup Mozzarella eggs bread crumbs Parmesan cheese onion oregano salt and pepper. Fill each cooled pasta tube with 1/4 cup meat filling. Spread a thin layer of spaghetti sauce in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place filled pasta in dish. Cover with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and add additional Parmesan. Cover with foil. Bake for 45 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Skinny Sour Cream
instructions: Blend cheese with a dash of lemon juice and enough milk to make consistency of sour cream. Refrigerate until needed. Yields 1 cup.

title: Restaurant Style Potato Skins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pierce potatoes with a fork; microwave on High until they are soft approximately 10 to 12 minutes. Cut potatoes in half vertically. Scoop out inside of potato leaving 1/4-inch of potato shell remaining. Heat oil to 365\u00b0 in deep fryer or deep saucepan. Place potatoes in hot oil; fry 5 minutes. Drain potatoes on paper towel. Fill potato shells with cheese and bacon bits. Arrange on baking sheet. Bake for 7 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve hot with sour cream. Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick Cookies
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boiling point. Then add last 3 ingredients. Mix well. Drop spoonfuls on tinfoil. Let cool. No baking needed.

title: Chocolate Chipper Champs
instructions: Beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Gradually add combined flour soda and salt; mix well. Stir in candies and nuts. Drop dough onto ungreased cookie sheet. If desired press 3 to 4 additional M&Ms into each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. You may also press dough into a 9 x 13-inch pan and cook for about 15 minutes to make bars.

title: Jalapeno Cocktail Pie
instructions: Sprinkle onions pepper and garlic in well-greased 9-inch square pan. Cover with cheese. Pour beaten eggs over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm. Cool. Cut into squares or serve warm. Can be frozen.

title: Marinade For Meats
instructions: Let soak for 4 to 6 hours before cooking. Great for deer meat.

title: Chef Salad Supreme(This Salad Is Scrumptious.)
instructions: Clean lettuce and break into small pieces in a large bowl. Add cabbage either grated or broken into small pieces. Add cheese cucumber ham olives and tomatoes. Toss lightly. Top with egg slices and croutons. Use your favorite dressing. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Applesauce Jumble Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Drop by tablespoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. When cool frost with following glaze.

title: Chicken Rotel
instructions: Saute onions and peppers in margarine. Cook vermicelli in broth. Add cheese; stir until melted. Stir in onions and peppers; combine thoroughly. Add chicken tomatoes mushrooms Worcestershire salt and pepper. Mix well. Fold in peas. If mixture appears dry add liquids from peas and mushrooms or additional chicken broth. Turn into a large greased casserole dish. Bake 1 hour or until hot and bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: Spicey Cabbage
instructions: Shred the cabbage and slice the onion thinly. Layer this in a bowl and sprinkle the sugar on top. Heat the oil vinegar mustard celery seed and salt. When boiling pour this mixture over the top of the cabbage. Cover and let stand for 4 to 6 hours then mix and serve.

title: Roquefort Onion Tart
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake crust 8 to 10 minutes. Saute onions in oil until limp and golden. Transfer with slotted spoon to crust distribute evenly. Sprinkle Roquefort over top. Spoon egg and cream mix over and bake until set 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Note Varied dressings or other ingredients can be used.

title: Ham Salad Filling
instructions: Stir together all ingredients until well mixed. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Doctor Bird Cake(Banana-Pineapple)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8-inch tube pan. Sift together dry ingredients. Add pineapple and juice vegetable oil vanilla eggs and bananas. Mix well but do not beat. Pour batter into cake pan and bake 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cake will crack slightly on top. Dont worry. Cool in pan. It will remain moist for a long time. Serves 12.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix flour baking soda salt cinnamon and sugar. Mix well. Add eggs oil and strawberries. Pour into a greased bunt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar and cream of tartar. Stir in pecans chips and vanilla. Drop by spoonfuls on foil cookie sheets. Turn oven off when you place cookies in. Do not open for at least 8 hours.

title: Chinese Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into tiny balls. Place in a roasting pan. (If you are making them ahead you can freeze them at this point.) Bake at 275\u00b0 uncovered for 1 hour. Place a toothpick in each meatball to serve. You can substitute pretzel sticks for toothpicks. This is great at parties.

title: Jiffy Jello Cream Cheese Treat
instructions: Boil 2 cups of water and dissolve Jell-O into it. Soften cream cheese in microwave and stir until smooth and creamy. Slowly add Jell-O to cream cheese mixture and continue stirring until well blended. Add 2 cups of cold water; mix well and chill until firm. Serve and enjoy. Its delicious and has almost no carbs!

title: Italian Beef Soup
instructions: Thinly slice the steak. Heat oil in Dutch oven. Add onion and garlic; remove and brown beef well. Add the beef broth tomatoes and seasonings and bring to a boil. Simmer 1 hour. Add rice and cook 20 minutes. Then add the cabbage and cook 15 more minutes. Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Add water oats and butter or margarine together; let cool. Cream together brown sugar white sugar egg and egg whites. Sift together flour soda salt and cinnamon. Mix all together and add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 cup dates or raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Mix flour sugar and margarine; add milk. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Beat egg yolks slightly and add to mixture as it begins to thicken. Add salt and pepper to corn; add to thickened mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Mix beef soup sour cream chilies and 1/2 cup cheese. Line a 9 x 12-inch baking dish (ungreased) with chips. Cover with meat mixture and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Jogging In A Jug
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Go answer the telephone. Measure 2 cups of flour 1 teaspoon of salt and 3 tablespoons baking powder. Answer the door bell. Let Carson and Wayne in to fix the ceiling fan in the living room.

title: Fresh Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 4 long rectangles. Place rectangles crosswise in ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Press over bottom and 1 inch up sides to form crust. Seal perforations. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 14 to 19 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely.

title: Coney Dogs
instructions: Cook beef onion and pepper until meat is brown. Drain; stir in sauce beans chili powder and sugar. Bring to a boil reduce to simmer and cook 5 to 8 minutes. Cook weiners as usual. Place weiner in toasted bun and top with meat mixture. Top with choice of cheese onion and/or relish.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together the crushed pretzels melted butter and 1 cup sugar. Press into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish and bake 8 minutes in a 400\u00b0 preheated oven. Cool. Blend the softened cream cheese and 1 tablespoon sugar until smooth and fold in the cool whip. Spread on top of the cooled crust. Dissolve the strawberry jello in the boiling water. Add the frozen strawberries and stir until thawed. Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Spoon over the cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dredge chicken in salad dressing mix. Dip in mixture of margarine pepper sauce and vinegar. Arrange on baking pans and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Turn sprinkle with paprika and bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Zasu Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order given. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Butter Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake uncovered at 350 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat oil in large saucepan. Add red peppers zucchini onion and garlic; cook stirring until tender. Add tomatoes salt and pepper. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer stirring occasionally until vegetables are very soft about 20 minutes. Stir in parsley.

title: French Fish
instructions: Place fish in a shallow pan. Combine remaining ingredients and spread evenly over fish. Marinate in refrigerator 4 to 5 hours or overnight turning fish occasionally (optional). Bake fish uncovered in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Place under the broiler for 5 minutes to brown. Serves 4.

title: Baked Eggs Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10-inch round pan. Hand beat eggs milk onion oleo salt and pepper until blended. Pour into pan. Sprinkle cheese and bacon on top. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients except milk and vanilla in saucepan. Gradually add milk. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Add vanilla.

title: Sugar-Free Egg Custard
instructions: Scald milk. Beat together in medium bowl the eggs juice and salt. Stir in slowly the slightly cooled milk and vanilla. Pour into 6 custard cups and sprinkle with nutmeg. Place cups in large baking pan with 1 inch hot water on bottom. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted off center comes out clean. Serve warm or chilled. Serves 6.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Beat thoroughly. Put into loaf pan. Cover with 3 strips of bacon. Pour 8 ounces of tomato sauce over it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crawfish Or Shrimp And Crab Meat Fettucine
instructions: Saute vegetables in oleo. Add crawfish shrimp or crab. Cook 15 minutes. Add jalapeno cheese until melted; add half and half. Combine with cooked noodles in casserole dish. Top with grated American cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix melted butter with dry cake mix and 1/3 cup Pet milk. Put half of cake mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes only.

title: Easy Cheezy Scalloped Potatoes And Sausage
instructions: Cook potatoes per package instructions. Mix together. Slice sausage and add to the potatoes. Cook until sausage is warm stirring often. Add cheese stirring until well mixed. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix pudding mixes with milk. Mix with hand mixer according to directions on box. Put this in fridge to chill. Mix together in another bowl the cream cheese butter powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Crush Oreo cookies. Line bottom of clean flower pot with foil to cover the holes. Mix pudding mix and cream cheese. Mix together then layer crushed Oreos and the cream mix. If desired put gummy worms in or on top of dessert. You can also put a silk flower bush in the pot and serve with a clean trowel.

title: Anchovy Puffs
instructions: Blend butter and cheese. Add flour and chill. Roll very thin. Cut in rounds with small biscuit cutter. Spread each round with anchovy paste and a few pieces of pecans. Fold making a puff. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 45.

title: Holiday Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Drain and mash potatoes. Add cream cheese and margarine in small pieces. Beat until well mixed. Add sour cream and beat again. Combine milk eggs and onions. Add to potato mixture along with salt pepper and parsley. Beat until light and fluffy. Place in greased casserole and refrigerate overnight. Take out of refrigerator at least 30 minutes before cooking. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until hot enough to serve.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Mash potatoes while hot with milk. Blend in eggs and set aside. Lightly brown meat onion and seasonings. Add drained beans soup and tomato sauce. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Drop mashed potatoes topping in mounds over meat mixture. Bake uncovered in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Nutmeg Muffins
instructions: Combine flour salt baking powder and nutmeg in a separate bowl. Cream margarine sugar and egg. Add flour alternately with milk to margarine mixture. Beat well. Spoon into well-greased muffin tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen nutmeg muffins.

title: Orange Breakfast Flip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender until smooth; serves 1.

title: Chicken Enchiladas(President Bill Clinton'S Favorite Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oil in a skillet. Saute chopped chilies with minced garlic in oil. Drain and break up tomatoes; reserve 1/2 cup liquid. To chilies and garlic add tomatoes onion 1 teaspoon salt oregano and reserved tomato liquid. Simmer uncovered until thick about 30 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.

title: Bacon-Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms with a damp paper towel; remove and chop stems. In a skillet over medium heat fry bacon until brown. Remove bacon to paper towels and leave a small amount of grease in skillet. Add onion and chopped stems and cook until tender. Add crumbled bacon and the cream cheese to the mixture and stir to melt. Stuff mushroom caps with the mixture and cover with some Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 on slightly greased baking sheet for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Garlic Grits
instructions: Cook grits in 3 1/2 cups water. Add cheese; beat in eggs milk and garlic salt. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (Should be firm when knife is inserted.) You may sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Easy Microwave Cheese Sauce
instructions: Microwave cheese and milk in 1 1/2-quart bowl on High 4 to 6 minutes or until smooth stirring every 2 minutes. Serve over potatoes or vegetables. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Orange Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a large mixing bowl. Add shortening egg orange juice and grated peel of orange. Stir until mixture is dampened but not smooth. Pour into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in greased casserole. Cover with soup and 1 can water. Top with cheese cover with stuffing mix. Drizzle on butter. Bake 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and egg. Add 1 cup of flour vanilla soda and cream of tartar. Add 1/2 cup flour. Cover and chill for 1 hour.

title: Refrigerator Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk on low speed. Add sour cream and 1/2 of Cool Whip. Layer bananas wafers and pudding mixture. Top with rest of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Judy'S Jambalaya
instructions: Brown pork chops in 1 tablespoon olive oil in Dutch oven. Add sausage and continue browning until completed (5 to 8 minutes). Remove meat from Dutch oven; drain excess fat. Save small amount of fat to saute onions to golden soft texture. Add garlic and saute for 1 minute. Return meat to pot and add all vegetables Tabasco sauce and 3 cups liquid. Simmer 15 minutes in covered pot. Add 2 cups rice. Cover and simmer 20 minutes until rice is cooked.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
instructions: Mix together shortening 1/2 cup sugar and egg. Sift together the flour salt baking powder and nutmeg. Stir dry ingredients alternately with milk into creamed mixture. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. (I use the tiny muffins and the recipe yields about 36.) Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hamburger And Eggplant Casserole
instructions: In a small casserole dish put a layer of potatoes then eggplant then hamburger. Mix corn with eggs and flour. Pour this over the 3 layers and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ice Cream Cake Roll
instructions: Grease flour and wax paper 3 cookie sheets. Make angel food cake as directed on package. Pour into pans and bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. When cooked remove cakes immediately from pan and turn out onto a clean dish towel that has been sprinkled lightly with confectioners sugar. Peel off wax paper and roll cake in cloth working quickly and gently. Cool in cloth.

title: Charlene'S Fried Pies
instructions: Combine ingredients to make dough. Pinch off small ball and roll out in circle.

title: Green Pepper, Tomatoes, Cabbage And Cheese(Serves 4)
instructions: Heat fat in heavy skillet. Add onions; cook slowly 5 minutes. Place pepper on top; cook 5 minutes. Add halved tomatoes skin side down and place quartered cabbage on top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix and beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup mixture into 2 1/2-quart glass bowl. Top with 1/3 of the wafers bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice ending with pudding. Chill and keep refrigerated until used. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix sausage cheese and pepper until mixed. Add flour a little at a time until firm enough to make into balls. Roll into small balls; place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Casey'S Delicious Honey Rye Bread
instructions: Mix together milk honey salt and caraway seed; cool. When at room temperature add yeast. Add rye flour and 1 cup wheat flour; beat thoroughly! Add 2 1/2 cups wheat flour; mix to make a stiff dough. Turn out of mixing bowl onto a lightly floured board or counter. Knead until smooth and elastic. Form a ball and put into a greased plastic bowl (I use Pam spray). Turn the ball around in the bowl evenly allowing the coating to seal the bottom of the ball. Then place the bottom of this ball of dough now coated facing up in bowl. Cover bowl with a piece of plastic wrap. Store in a warm place (85\u00b0) until doubled. Takes about 45 minutes. Remove the dough from the bowl onto a lightly floured board or counter and divide into two equal pieces. Do not punch the air out of the dough. Shape into loaves and place in 2 greased (or Pam sprayed) 9 x 5 x 3-inch pans. Cover with plastic wrap.

title: Tea Syrup(Instant Tea)
instructions: Boil tea in water for 2 minutes; strain and add sugar and lemon juice to tea water. Stir until sugar dissolves. This makes a syrup which can be kept refrigerated up to 2 weeks.

title: Overseas Candy
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and cook over low heat until it forms medium ball not soft or hard when tested in cold water (not ice). Beat until stiff. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into deep pan until cool then remove and put in wax paper. The longer it stands the better it tastes. Let stand at least 5 weeks before eating. Makes 6 pounds.

title: Aunt Laura'S Zucchini Pickles
instructions: Soak zucchini in 2 gallons cold water and lime. Drain and wash at least 6 to 7 times to remove all trace of lime. This is important. Let sit in cold water 3 hours then drain. Mix sugar spices and 1 quart cider vinegar to zucchini. This will be watery on top and not mix well. Let stand overnight. Simmer 30 minutes and seal in sterilized jars.

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa butter and milk in a saucepan. Boil over medium heat for 1 minute. Stir constantly; fold in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and let harden. Work quickly hardening doesnt take long. Store in airtight container.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Add milk to the consistency of regular cornbread. Bake 55 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and put in bottom of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cream margarine sugar eggs and vanilla. Add zucchini. Alternate dry ingredients with milk; add nuts. Bake in greased tube or Bundt pan dusted with cocoa. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Pralines
instructions: Combine buttermilk and baking soda in a 5 qt. saucepan stirring until soda is dissolved; add sugar butter corn syrup and salt. Bring mixture to a boil; cook stirring constantly until mixture reaches soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Remove from heat and let stand until lukewarm (110\u00b0). Add vanilla and pecans to candy; beat until mixture begins to thicken and loses its gloss. Drop by Tbsp. onto a lightly buttered baking sheet or waxed paper; let stand until firm. Store in airtight container.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Simmer water with cinnamon stick and whole cloves 30 minutes. Strain. Mix tea and juice together. Add sugar and heat. Makes 1 gallon. Better to make a day ahead.

title: Spinach Bars
instructions: Sift together the flour salt and baking soda. Beat the eggs lightly and add them and the butter to the flour. Add the onion and the thawed drained spinach. Shred the cheese add it and mix well. Spread in a well-greased 8 x 11-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until nicely browned and crusty. Cut into small squares. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Happy Home Recipe
instructions: Take love and loyalty mix thoroughly with tenderness kindness and forgiveness. Add friendship and hope. Sprinkle abundantly with laughter. Bake with Florida sunshine on 350\u00b0 sandy beach. Serve daily; give generous portions.

title: Moist And Minty Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In small saucepan combine sugar butter and water. Bring just to a boil; remove from heat. Add 1 cup mint morsels and vanilla stirring until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth. Transfer mixture to large mixer bowl. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Stir in flour mixture. Spread in greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 25 to 35 minutes just until center is set. Cool completely. Cut in 2 1/4-inch squares.

title: Ginger Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg beating well. Add molasses. Dissolve soda in 1 cup hot water. Add alternately with salt ginger and flour to egg mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Frost with confectioners sugar icing.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Melt butter; mix well with flour nuts and 1/4 cup powdered sugar. Line a 10 x 12 x 2-inch pan with mixture. Add 1/4 cup powdered sugar cream cheese and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Mix pudding and milk; beat until thick. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Pretzel-Cheese Squares
instructions: Cut the cheese into small cubes. Insert a pretzel stick into each cheese cube and eat.

title: Bonbon Candy
