instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and mix well. Add pecans vanilla and coconut. Make into balls and chill. Melt paraffin and chocolate chips. When balls are cold put a toothpick in them and dip into chocolate mixture. (Heat chocolate mixture constantly.) Put balls on buttered pan.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed until smooth. Drain grated cucumber on paper towels to get rid of excess moisture. Fold into cream mixture with wooden spoon. Add 1 to 2 drops of food color of your choice. Cut bread into desired shapes using 2 to 3 inch cutter. Spread bread with filling. Top with bread. Garnish with cucumber wedge.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix together first five ingredients and 1/2 of Chinese noodles. Put in casserole dish. Spread the other 1/2 of Chinese noodles on top of casserole. Bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0or microwave 15 minutes on High.

title: Crunchy Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pot; seal with foil. Cook until foil looks like it going to pop.

title: Spiced Tomatoes
instructions: Place tomatoes in dish; cover with spices. Combine oil and vinegar and pour over tomatoes. Chill 1 hour (drain). Garnish with parsley and dressing.

title: Pizza Bubble Bread(Makes 10 To 12 Appetizers)
instructions: Sprinkle a greased 12-inch pizza pan with the cornmeal. Separate biscuits and snip each into 4 pieces. Place pieces in medium mixing bowl. Add sauce and toss to coat. Arrange dough pieces in an 8-inch circle in the pizza pan. Sprinkle with oregano and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in sauce pan and make a cream sauce by adding flour. Stir and cook while gradually adding milk. When mixture thickens stir in cheese red pepper sauce and salt. In buttered casserole layer asparagus sauce and sliced eggs. Top with crushed Ritz crackers and dot with butter. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 30 minutes or until bubbling and hot.

title: Bananas Foster
instructions: Melt butter in chafing dish. Add brown sugar and blend well. Add banana and saute. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Pour over banana liqueur and rum; ignite basting banana with flaming liquid. Serve over ice cream when flame dies out. Serves 1.

title: Cheesy Shrimp And Grits Casserole
instructions: Bring broth and 1/2 tsp. salt to a boil in a large saucepan and stir in grits. Cover and reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir together grits 3/4 cup cheddar and all of Monterey Jack cheese. Melt butter in a large skillet and add green peppers onion and garlic and saute for 5 minutes. Stir together onion mixture grits mixture shrimp and next three ingredients. Pour into a lightly greased 2 quart baking dish and sprinkle with remaining cheddar. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 -45 minutes.

title: Granny Evelyn'S Easy Sweet Pickles
instructions: Drain all juice from dill pickles. Slice dill pickles crosswise to form round slices about 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick. Layer slices back into dill pickle jar. Add sugar layer add layer of pickles add layer of sugar. Repeat layering process until finished.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar and canned milk for 6 minutes. Remove from heat and beat in chocolate chips margarine and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Let stand 6 hours before cutting. Makes about 4 pounds.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add cooked drained spinach. Remove from heat and mix in everything else. Make balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven (350\u00b0) for 15 minutes. May be made ahead and reheated. Double recipe for a party.

title: Banana Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Beat together oil sugar eggs and bananas; beat well. Add all other ingredients except chocolate chips. Beat well. Stir in chips. Bake in greased muffin tins in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Makes about 18 muffins.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Deep Dish Pie(People Who Don'T Like Rhubarb May Even Like This!)
instructions: Combine sugar flour and nutmeg; mix with fruit. Pour mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole; dot with butter and top with crust. Cut steam vents and sprinkle with additional sugar. Bake at 425\u00b0 until crust is brown and filling is bubbly about 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix the sugar vinegar oil onion parsley chives Worcestershire sauce mustard and pepper in a plastic container; shake well and chill. Pour over the spinach bacon and eggs seasoning to taste with salt and pepper if desired. Toss well and serve.

title: Baked Corn Dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter. Combine all ingredients and melted butter; mix together well. Pour into a large baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Old Fashioned Fudge
instructions: Mix together in a saucepan the sugar salt and cocoa. Add milk and syrup gradually. Boil gently stirring often until mixture reaches a soft ball stage. Drop in butter and let cool before beating. Add vanilla and peanut butter. Beat until mixture thickens and is hard to stir. Pour into buttered dish. Cool before cutting into serving pieces. Yields approximately 20 pieces of candy.

title: Trout Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend cream cheese margarine onion lemon peel horseradish mustard salt and pepper. Stir in fish. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or chilled. Mix parsley and pecans on plate or wax paper. Shape mix into ball and sprinkle with parsley and pecans. Chill until firm.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Sift flour salt and sugar. Cut in shortening. Beat egg and vinegar (or lemon juice); blend with milk. Pour into dry ingredients. Makes 2 crusts. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Yummy Swirled Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt the butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour until particles are like fine crumbs. Add milk and stir only until dough leaves the side of the bowl. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead just until smooth. Roll dough out into a large rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Drain any juice from peaches into the sugar water and sprinkle diced peaches evenly over the dough. Roll up the dough like a jelly roll. Slice dough into about 1/2-inch slices. Place in pan with the melted butter. Pour sugar syrup carefully around rolls. (This looks like too much liquid but the crust will absorb it.) Bake for 55 to 60 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Kentucky Venison Chili
instructions: Coarsely grind venison and brown in heated oil in a heavy pan. Add onion garlic and green peppers. Cook about 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add chili powder sugar tomatoes tomato sauce water and salt. Let mixture simmer about 1 1/2 hours. Add beans and allow chili to heat and additional few minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Dredge beef in flour and brown in butter. Cook onions in butter until limp. Add seasonings and water. Simmer covered for 45 minutes or until tender. Stir in soup and mushrooms and cook for 30 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat but do not boil. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Orange Glow
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and eat.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients in soup pot and heat until hot.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Beat in cocoa and food coloring. Sift together flour and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Sprinkle soda over batter. Pour vinegar and vanilla over batter and stir until blended. Bake in 3 greased and floured 8 to 9-inch cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Ice with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Pineapple Cranberry Squares
instructions: In a 9-inch square pan dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in pineapple cranberry sauce and wine. Chill until mixture thickens slightly. Fold in pecans. Chill until firm. In small bowl beat cream cheese with sour cream until smooth. Spread over gelatin. Keep chilled until serving time. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Orange Pecan Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and vanilla. Add sifted flour with soda and salt. Press into bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan. Spread marmalade on top. Sprinkle on pecans. Top with stiffly beaten egg whites. Arrange pecan halves on top. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until meringue is lightly browned.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain rinse then crush in pot until chunky. Add salt and butter to taste. Add milk and pepper. Add more milk to cover potatoes if needed. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Barbara'S Berry Pie
instructions: In large deep bowl beat 3 of the egg whites and cream of tartar until fluffy. Slowly add 3 tablespoons Fruit Sweet and beat until stiff. Spoon meringue into 9-inch pie pan spreading meringue evenly to form a crust. Bake this crust 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Cool.

title: New Method Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly add sugar milk vanilla and salt. Place over low heat stirring constantly. When steam shows remove from heat and pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until a silver knife comes out clean. (This custard pie never gets watery or soaks crust.)

title: Yorkshire Pudding
instructions: Place flour and salt in bowl and make a well in the center into which pour milk. Beat until fluffy. Beat eggs lightly. Stir into batter. Add water and continue beating until mixture light and fluffy. Permit to stand for 1 hour (optional). Beat it again. Have ready hot oven-proof dish (about 10 x 10-inch) containing about 1/4 inch melted butter or hot beef drippings. Pour in batter. It should be about 5/8 inch high.\tBake the pudding in hot oven 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 10 - 15 minutes longer.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Mix milk and Miracle Whip. Then mix in flour and sugar. Drop in greased muffin pan and bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together for 5 minutes. Add oil flour cinnamon baking soda and salt. Beat at medium speed until mixed. Add nuts and apples. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Cool. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 and grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Melt the butter and chocolate in saucepan over low heat stirring constantly. Stir in sugar and allow to cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating until well blended after each egg. Stir in flour vanilla and salt. Add chopped nuts and stir until well blended. Pour the mixture into prepared pan and bake 30 - 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In heavy pan melt sugar oleo milk and cocoa. Bring to a boil and cook about 2 minutes. Take from heat and add oats vanilla and peanut butter. Drop onto waxed paper by the spoonful.

title: Apple-Broccoli Salad
instructions: Toss all with salad dressing. Start with small amount and add until covered to taste. This salad can be made and tossed with dressing hours ahead of time.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken and remove from bone. Reserve broth. Cut chicken in small pieces and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Boil broth and cream of chicken soup then combine flour pepper butter milk and margarine. Mix to form a batter; pour mixture over chicken and spoon batter over top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. May add 2 chopped boiled eggs to batter.

title: Hot Cran-Apple Cider
instructions: In large kettle combine all ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Strain. Makes 25 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

title: Toasted Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Rinse seeds and pat dry. Spread on cookie sheet and let stand several hours to dry.

title: Butterfly Frosting
instructions: Combine egg white sugar and cream of tartar. Add boiling water and immediately beat at high speed until thick and fluffy.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Combine sugar and cream in a 4 cup measure. Cook on High 4 minutes or until mixture boils. Add chocolate and butter. Stir to blend. Cook 1 minute on High. Add some of mixture to beaten egg yolks. Stir egg mixture into remaining chocolate mixture. Cook on Medium 2 minutes. Whisk in vanilla. Store covered in refrigerator. Reheat at Medium 30 seconds or more.

title: Blueberry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Cream cheese until smooth and soft. Add milk. Mix well until smooth and creamy. Stir in lemon juice.

title: Tuna-Rigatoni Salad
instructions: In large pot of boiling water cook rigatoni 10 minutes. Add broccoli and carrots; cook 4 to 5 minutes longer until rigatoni and vegetables are tender. Drain and rinse with cold water; place in large serving bowl. Add tuna bell pepper mushrooms and tomatoes; toss to combine. In small bowl combine dressing mustard and black pepper. Pour half the dressing over ingredients in bowl; toss to mix well. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Toss with remaining dressing; mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Self Rising Flour
instructions: Blend all ingredients and mix well. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
instructions: Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Add peppermint oil and food coloring. Shape into 1/2-inch balls; roll in granulated sugar. Chill 1 to 2 hours or until firm. Mints may be frozen in an airtight container up to 2 months. Yields 6 dozen.

title: Sin Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix with butter 1 egg and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Press into a 9 x 17-inch pan for crust.

title: Zucchini Cornbread
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; add cottage cheese and next ingredients. Place in 2 baking pans 8-inches square. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Beef Sausage
instructions: Combine all ingredients; shape in a roll. Wrap in waxed paper. Chill several hours. Slice. Fry or broil or add to soups or casseroles.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Remove any unpopped kernels from popped corn. Place popped corn into a large roasting pan that is sprayed with vegetable oil.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients mixing well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Blend cream cheese margarine and sugar. Mix milk Cool Whip and pudding. Combine cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture. Take one 8-inch plastic flower pot and spray lightly with Pam. Put about 1-inch of crushed cookies on the bottom. Then add cream cheese and pudding mixture. Continue to layer and end with cookie mixture on top. Place straws in the pot and freeze. Put flowers in the straws and use as a centerpiece while cake is defrosting.

title: Ugly Duckling Pudding Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts in a large mixer bowl; beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cake pulls away from side of pan. Do not underbake. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Spoon hot Butter Glaze over warm cake or top with brown sugar.

title: Maple Nut Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour and granulated sugar in bowl. Cut in 1/2 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press into bottom of greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 15 minutes or until very lightly browned.

title: Marinated Mushrooms 2
instructions: Heat the oil in a small deep casserole and saute the onion and garlic until onion is transparent. Stir in tomato sauce wine water cloves saffron salt and pepper. Simmer covered for 45 minutes adding more water if necessary. Add the mushrooms to the cooking liquid and simmer 5 minutes more. Turn off heat cover and let cool. Refrigerate overnight. Serve cold or at room temperature.

title: Texas Barbecue Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes in half. Scoop out and reserve shells. Mix potato with other ingredients except cheese. Return to potato shells. Top with cheese. Place in conventional or microwave oven until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: At room temperature combine all ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Corn Dip
instructions: Mix all the ingredients well. Pour in to an 8 x 8 inch dish. Bake for 45 minutes at 425\u00b0. Serve with Tostitios.

title: Les Oreilles De Cochan(Pigs Ears - Cookies)
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add melted butter. Add flour sugar salt and stir until well blended. Pinch off a small ball of dough and roll out very thinly. Roll into cone shape pinching bottom together so that other end resembles a pigs ear. Heat oil in large skillet. Fry ears until brown. Drain on paper towel. Sift sugar over ears. Cool then enjoy!

title: Banana Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine bananas egg milk oil and cereal. Let stand 10 minutes. Stir to break up cereal. In a large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder baking soda salt and nutmeg. Add cereal mixture. Stir until moistened. Use greased muffin tins or cupcake papers and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Mix all ingredients but applesauce and baking soda into sugar mixture. Dissolve baking soda in applesauce and stir until frothy. Blend mixture with rest of ingredients and stir by hand. Place in a Bundt cake. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Walnut Cake
instructions: Make yellow cake as on the box; put maple flavoring and nuts in with liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 as on box. Ice cake; can put flavoring in icing.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill and serve on crisp lettuce leaves or use as a sandwich filler or serve with crackers.

title: Midnight Breakfast(Egg-N-Cheese With Potatoes)
instructions: Fry potatoes in skillet. While potatoes are cooking mix in small bowl the eggs and a little milk; stir until blended. When potatoes are done drain off excess grease. Pour eggs over the potatoes in the skillet. Season to taste. Stir until eggs are done or flip over like an omelet. When eggs are done add layer of cheese on top. Cover with lid just until cheese has melted. Serve with favorite meat and bread.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Cut steak and ham in bite size pieces. Salt and pepper; dip in flour and brown in cooking oil. Add chopped celery chopped onion soy sauce and juice drained from bean sprouts. Cook slowly and stir from time to time for about 1 hour. Add bean sprouts; cook about 20 minutes. Mix molasses with flour using enough flour to make thick consistency. Serve on rice. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Pesky Beef And Macaroni
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. While you cook the macaroni heat oil in a heavy deep skillet. Dice green onions and saute in the oil for about 5 minutes. Add the ground beef and sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper. Continue cooking until meat loses red color. Drain excess fat. Add the stewed tomatoes and chili sauce and heat through. Drain macaroni.

title: Triple Layer Brownies
instructions: Melt first 4 squares of chocolate and oleo; put aside. Combine eggs and sugar; add flour. Add melted chocolate and oleo. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Combine powdered sugar oleo and creme de menthe. Spread on first layer and chill. Melt the 2nd 4 squares of chocolate and 4 tablespoons oleo. Spread on chilled layer. Cut into squares before hardens. Mint flavor retained better if frozen.

title: Icebox Cookies No. 1
instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugars; add egg and beat well. Add vanilla and nuts. Add sifted dry ingredients; mix well and shape in rolls 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Roll in waxed paper. Chill several hours or overnight. Slice thin. Bake on greased cookie sheet in hot oven at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Raisin Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in raisins pecans and vanilla. Pour into pastry shell bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until set. Yields one 9-inch pie.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Prepare Plain Tomato Sauce. In large skillet heat oil; add sirloin salt and pepper. Brown well and remove meat with a slotted spoon draining well. Place meat in cooking sauce. Boil a large pot of water with salt and oil. Cook noodles until \al dente\ usually about 8 to 10 minutes. Combine Ricotta cheese eggs parsley oregano salt pepper and 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese; mix well.

title: Wanda'S Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Bring potatoes and onions to a boil; let boil about 5 minutes. Do not overcook as potatoes will become mushy. Drain in colander.

title: Fry Daddy Donuts
instructions: Mix 1 part milk to 8 parts sugar. Put holes in biscuits. Deep fat fry biscuits until brown. Dip donuts in glaze.

title: Venison Meat Loaf(Deer)
instructions: Mix all ingredients except tomato paste. Put in loaf pan. Top with tomato paste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly and brown.

title: White Chicken Chili
instructions: Saute veggies and mix with all ingredients. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix well. Press patties 5/8-inch thick. Dredge in flour then in beaten egg and then in cracker crumbs. Brown in skillet and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: No Crust Coconut Pie
instructions: Blend first 7 ingredients in a blender for 10 seconds. Scrape sides and blend for 10 additional seconds. Add 1 cup coconut. Blend for 5 seconds. Pour into a buttered pie pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes.

title: Venetian Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat 3 (13 x 9 x 2-inch) pans with nonstick cooking spray. Line pans with wax paper allowing paper to hand over the short ends; spray paper. Break up almond paste in large bowl. Add butter sugar egg yolks and almond extract. Beat with mixer until fluffy 5 minutes. Beat in flour and salt. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into almond mixture until well blended. Divide mixture into three equal parts. Add green food coloring to one red food coloring to another. Leave last portion yellow. Spread each part into a separate prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Immediately remove cakes from pans using waxed paper overhangs.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Soak poppy seed in milk overnight. Cream butter sugar and poppy seed mixture. Sift dry ingredients then add to creamed mixture.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
instructions: Begin with vanilla wafers and line bottom of dish. Alternate with bananas Cool Whip wafers etc. until you have reached the top of dish. End with a layer of Cool Whip. Refrigerate for 8 to 10 hours or overnight. Ready to serve and eat.

title: Bread Dressing For Chicken Or Turkey
instructions: Cook giblets in water until tender. When cool chop them fine. Saute celery and onion in butter. Mix all ingredients and add enough giblet water to moisten thoroughly. This makes enough to stuff a 12 pound turkey or it may be cooked on top of the stove in a cast-iron skillet. Stir continuously (add water or chicken broth as needed). Dressing may get crispy on the bottom if you like.

title: Spareribs
instructions: Roll ribs in\tflour salt and pepper. Fry spareribs. Add ginger and garlic.\tAdd sauce; cook for 1 hour.

title: My Favorite Chili
instructions: You will need a large kettle.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar and shortening until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour soda salt and baking powder; add to mixture. Add vanilla and cinnamon; mix well. Fold in coconut (optional). Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown. Makes about 75 cookies.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and put in greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Old Fashion Do-Nuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Do not roll too thin. Cut with donut cutter and fry in deep fat. Fry holes too.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain the beans well. Mix all ingredients well. Put salad mixture in a low flat dish.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat eggs slightly add sugar and cream. Add rest of ingredients all at once and mix thoroughly. (Sometimes the pumpkin sticks to the beaters scrape off and beat again.) Pour into 3 greased regular bread pans (will make 4 in smaller foil pans for gifts). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour test with toothpick.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: In a bowl combine sugar and flour. In a separate bowl mix cheese and pineapple (be sure to drain pineapple first). Mix both bowls together and pour into a 1 1/2-quart dish. Crush Ritz crackers on top of mixture. Melt the butter and drip on top of the crackers. Cover and place in fridge overnight.

title: Peggy'S Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package and put in casserole dish. Combine broccoli onions and celery and cook until tender. Drain and pour in with rice. Combine Cheez Whiz margarine soup and water. Cook until melted. Pour over rice mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Quickie Soup
instructions: Grill the chicken breasts and shred or dice. Put the chicken and all the other ingredients into a large pot and cook for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello and hot water. Add everything but the sour cream. Chill half until real firm. Then spread sour cream. Add the rest of jello mixture and chill.

title: Blackberry Pinwheel Cobbler
instructions: Combine sugar and water in saucepan stir well. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved. Set aside. Place margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish and place in 350\u00b0 oven until margarine melts. Set aside. Cut shortening into flour until mixture becomes coarse. Add milk stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough onto a lightly floured board. Roll dough into 12 x 9-inch rectangle. Spread berries over sprinkle with cinnamon. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Cut dough in 12 slices. Place in melted margarine. Pour sugar syrup over slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 12 servings.

title: Zesty Clam Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together saving clams until last. Chill. Sprinkle with paprika when ready to serve. Can be served with potato chips or crackers.

title: Beef And Rice
instructions: Brown first 3 ingredients lightly and remove. Stir-fry next 4 ingredients. Add beef mixture and next 3 ingredients; mix. At the end add sliced green onion; remove from heat.

title: Jalapeno Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix together and heat. Dip with tortilla chips.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt margarine. Add sugar beaten eggs vanilla salt and pecans. Place in unbaked pie shell and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces. Saute onions and celery in the margarine or butter. Add the soups chilies and tomatoes. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add the chili powder oregano and cumin. Simmer for 20 more minutes.

title: Good Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots. Saute onion in butter. Stir in flour salt dry mustard and milk. Add pepper and celery salt. In 2-quart casserole arrange layers of carrots and cheese ending with carrots. Pour on sauce. Top with crumbs. Bake 20 minutes or until hot throughout.

title: Mexican Finger Rolls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Grease an 11x7-inch baking pan. Separate biscuits and pat each one to a 3 1/2 inch oval shape. Place a strip of cheese on each. Wrap the dough around the cheese strip. Press all edges to seal. Place the rolls into prepared pan making 2 rows. Combine the margarine and taco seasoning mix. Brush over top of rolls. Press the corn chips onto top of rolls. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm. Inside these crunchy rolls is a surprise tunnel of melted cheese. These can be reheated by wrapping them in aluminum foil and placing them in a 400 degree oven for about 8 minutes. They can also be made ahead covered and refrigerated for up to 2 hours before baking. Makes 20 rolls.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Wash potatoes and prick several times with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Let cool. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise then scoop out pulp. Melt butter in heavy saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir until smooth. Cook 1 minute. Gradually add milk. Cook until mixture thickens. Add potato pulp salt pepper 2 tablespoons green onions 1/2 cup bacon and 1 cup cheese. Cook until thoroughly heated. Then stir in sour cream. Add extra milk if necessary. Serve with remaining onions cheese and bacon. Yield 10 cups.

title: Barbecued Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Melt 1/2 cup butter in skillet or cake pan. Coat potato slices with butter on both sides. Place directly on grill. Brown on one side. Turn and brown on other side. Serve hot and crisp directly from grill.

title: Peach Bavarian
instructions: Drain peaches reserving 2/3 cup juice. Chop peaches into small pieces; set aside. In a bowl dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water. Stir in reserved syrup. Chill until slightly thickened. Stir extract into whipped topping; gently fold into gelatin mixture. Fold in peaches. Pour into an oiled 6-cup mold. Chill overnight. Unmold; garnish with additional peaches if desired. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Apple Angel Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and fold in egg whites. Spread in crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with whip cream or ice cream if desired.

title: Oven Roasted Vegetables With Rigatoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large roasting pan. Add olive oil and toss to coat well. Bake until vegetables are tender stirring occasionally about 45 minutes. Add broccoli. Bake until crisp and tender (about 10 minutes).

title: 7 Can Soup
instructions: Just mix all together (with juice in cans). Heat thoroughly and serve with crackers or corn bread.

title: Cream Cheese Party Cupcakes
instructions: Beat cream cheese in a large mixing bowl until soft and creamy. Gradually add 1 cup sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in 1 1/2 teaspoons of vanilla. Spoon batter into paper-lined miniature muffin pans filling two-thirds full. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Soft Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add the beaten egg and molasses. Add the flour baking soda and spices. Mix well. The dough will be a little sticky. Shape the dough into balls the size of a walnut. Roll the ball in granulated sugar and bake for 7 to 8 minutes (no longer) at 350\u00b0. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Golden Beef Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spread crust with butter. Cook beef and onion until meat is browned. Spoon into pie crust. Whisk undiluted soup eggs milk salt pepper and thyme. Pour mixture into pie crust. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Dip For Strawberries
instructions: Combine cream cheese with marshmallow cream. Add vanilla or other flavoring. Add food coloring if desired. Serve with fresh whole strawberries.

title: Cowboy Bread
instructions: Mix self-rising flour and plain flour together. Add shortening and hot water. Make a dough. Put in cookie sheet in oven for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Dont forget to grease cookie sheet a little so dough wont stick.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour in the unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown and firm.

title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; add oil sugar and vanilla. Beat until foamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Combine flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and nutmeg. Mix and add raisins and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in greased and floured bread pans.

title: Vinegar Dressing(No Calories)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in measuring cup or cruet. Chill. Use to marinate cooked vegetables or a mixed green salad.

title: Seven Layer Bars
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Add and pack the graham cracker crumbs. Then layer the coconut chocolate chips peanut butter chips butterscotch chips and chopped walnuts. Pour condensed milk on top and bake in 350\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes until the top starts to brown. Cut while warm. Remove once cool.

title: Southern Chicken Casserole
instructions: Wash and dry chicken. In Dutch oven fry bacon until crisp. Remove bacon. Add chicken and brown well on all sides. Remove to a 2-quart casserole dish as pieces brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Add all ingredients but flour raisins and nuts. Mix really well. Now add flour mix. Add raisins and nuts now. Pour into 2 bread pans; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fried Mushrooms Parmesan
instructions: Heat 2 or 3 inches of shortening in deep frying pan. Combine flour cheese salt and garlic powder in medium bowl. Stir in water 2 tablespoons melted shortening and egg. Beat until smooth. Dip mushrooms in batter drain off excess. Fry in heated shortening about 3 minutes or until golden brown. Turn as needed for even browning. Remove and drain on paper towels. Salt lightly. Serve immediately.

title: Raspberry Jam
instructions: Mash berries. Mix with sugar and bring to boil over moderate heat. Boil 5 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Shut off heat and add Epsom salts. Remove from heat; stir about 3 minutes. Pour into sterilized jars and seal with melted wax.

title: Rice Meat Balls
instructions: Mix rice beef egg onion salt pepper and 1/2 cup juice. Mix lightly. Shape into 18 meat balls. Place in skillet.

title: Sour Cream Potatoes
instructions: Cream potatoes as usual with milk butter salt and pepper. Add rest of ingredients. Put in a large casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fudge Frosting
instructions: Cook sugar milk salt chocolate and corn syrup over low heat; stir constantly until sugar dissolves. Cover saucepan 2 to 3 minutes to dissolve sugar crystals on sides of pan. Uncover and continue cooking to soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Remove from heat; add butter and cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla extract and beat until spreading consistency. If frosting becomes too stiff add 2 or 3 drops of hot water.

title: Rowser'S Famous Melt-Away Teriyaki Steaks
instructions: Blend steak sauce and pineapple in blender until frothy. Pour over steaks and refrigerate for a minimum of 8 hours. Grill steaks on barbecue grill.

title: Can'T-Wait-For-Summer Sangria
instructions: Boil water sugar and cinnamon for 5 minutes. Cool syrup and cover. Cut up fruit with cooled syrup. Chill for several hours.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk alternately. Mix all other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix all (or fold) together. Spread in a Pyrex dish. Cover and freeze. Will keep for several weeks if kept frozen.

title: Soft Toll House Scotchies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drop by spoonful and space about 1 1/2-inches apart on cookie sheet. (Best results if using glass baking pan.) Bake for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Use same size jars. Mix well in pan over low heat until mixed and pour into buttered pan (big one). Cool and cut into squares.

title: Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except frosting and mix until blended. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes. Frost with Chocolate Frosting when cake is cool.

title: Grandma'S Gingerbread
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Blend in molasses. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour salt baking powder soda and spices. Add to creamed mixture alternately with hot water. Spoon batter into a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Havremakroner(Oatmeal Macaroons)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add beaten egg cream and extract. Mix well. (I use hand electric mixer and whip the first five ingredients until like whipped butter.) Mix flour and baking powder together and add to the butter mixture. Add oatmeal and mix well. Let batter rest 30 minutes. Place by rounded teaspoonful on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Cheddar Swiss Fondue
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat cook onion and garlic in hot margarine for 10 minutes stirring often. Stir in soup wine and caraway seed. Gradually add cheese stirring until smooth after each addition. Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot. Serve with pumpernickel or French bread cubes for dipping. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In saucepan steam broccoli until bright green and tender; drain. Arrange 1/2 of broccoli in 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with half of cheese and half of cracker crumbs. Repeat layers. Drizzle butter over top. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Wilma'S Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour water over oats. Cool. Cream shortening sugars and eggs. To this add dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly with water/oats mixture. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan for 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Pie
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl mixing well. Add to apples in large bowl tossing lightly to combine. Turn in pastry lined pie plate; dot with butter. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 425\u00b0 or until apples are tender.

title: Perfect Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Use rolling pin and put crackers in a plastic bag. Use approximately 1 1/2 packages of a 1 pound box of saltines. Combine crumbs margarine salt and pepper and spread 1/3 of buttered crumbs in a greased round casserole dish. Cover with half of the oysters. Using another 1/3 of crumbs; spread a second layer; cover with remaining oysters. Combine 1/2 cup milk oyster liquid and 1/4 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce (dash of Tabasco if desired). Pour over oysters. Top with last of buttered crumbs. Garnish with parsley. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Pot Roast In Foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place meat on a large piece of heavy-duty foil. Spread undiluted mushroom soup over meat and sprinkle dry onion soup mix on top. Wrap meat in foil sealing with double foil. Place seam side up in large baking pan. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until tender. When roast is done lift from foil and strain gravy. Slice roast. Place in serving dish. Spoon gravy over meat. Cover and keep warm in oven. Dilute gravy if too thick. Serve gravy with rice or noodles.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling water until tender. Drain. Combine carrots onion and pepper. Set aside. Combine soup vinegar oil mustard and sugar. Stir well. Pour over vegetables. Toss lightly. Refrigerate overnight. Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Piscataquis County Beef Stew
instructions: Braise 2-inch beef cubes in deep iron frypan in butter. Add onion and turn down the heat a little.

title: Sweet And Sour Spareribs
instructions: Place ribs on rack in large shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Everything Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Microwave Potato Salad
instructions: Place bag of potatoes on paper towel in microwave. Make 1-inch slit in one side of bag. Microwave on High 13 to 15 minutes turning over bag and redistributing contents halfway through cooking. Set aside to cool. Break eggs into 2 custard cups and pierce yolks well with fork. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave at 50% power for 3 to 4 minutes rotating cups halfway through cooking. Allow to cool and chop. Mix potatoes and eggs with all other ingredients.

title: Ruth'S Chocolate Pound Cake With Cream Cheese Filling
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating well. Blend in vanilla and add chocolate. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with dry ingredients.

title: French Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix until crumbly. Press into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Saute oil onions scallions green pepper celery thyme cayenne pepper bay leaves and garlic in a saucepan until celery is tender. Add tomatoes tomato paste and lemon. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp is pink. Serve over rice.

title: Romantic Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O (do not add water) and pineapple in saucepan. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add cream cheese; stir until relatively smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Mold and chill overnight.

title: English Muffin Appetizers
instructions: Split muffins; set aside. Mix remaining ingredients until well blended; spread on muffins. Bake on cookie sheet for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. May freeze before baking; bake at 375\u00b0 if frozen.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (batter will be very stiff) and pour into 9 x 14-inch pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 340\u00b0. Remove from oven and poke holes over entire cake. Pour glaze over cake and smooth so it goes into the holes. (This is done on hot cake.)

title: Pumpkin Puddin' Cake
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and pour into 15 x 9-inch pan.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine crumbs cheese and parsley. Mix together the butter mustard and sauce. Salt and pepper chicken. Dip in butter mixture then in bread crumbs mixture. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apple Cake American
instructions: Grease an 8-inch square pan. Slice 6 apples and spread in the bottom of the pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Mix remaining ingredients together in a bowl and pour over apples. Bake 60 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Cheese Sticks(Appetizer)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine cheese salt pepper and flour. Cut in margarine with pastry blender. Sprinkle with milk and toss with fork.

title: Crisco Icing
instructions: Alternate beating ingredients with flavorings at end to creamy consistency. Excellent for Christmas cookies.

title: Hunter'S Pudding
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Beat at high speed until light and fluffy. Add eggs cloves nutmeg and cinnamon. Beat until well blended. Add remaining ingredients. Mix at low speed until well blended. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour mix in pan and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Frankfurters In A Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Split franks lengthwise not cutting completely through. Fill each with a strip of cheese relish or catsup. Mix remaining ingredients with fork. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Spread in pan. Arrange franks crosswise on dough in pan curving slightly and pressing to fit pan. Press into dough slightly. Bake until bread is light brown about 20 minutes. To serve cut bread between frankfurters. Makes 3 or 4 servings.

title: Mamie Eisenhower'S Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar salt butter and milk. Boil 6 minutes. Put remaining ingredients in large bowl. Pour boiling syrup over ingredients in bowl. Beat until chocolate is all melted. Pour into a pan (do not butter pan) and let stand a few hours before cutting. Store in tin box.

title: Zucchini Salad
instructions: In a colander sprinkle zucchini with salt and allow to stand 15 minutes. Squeeze as much moisture as possible from zucchini. Combine remaining ingredients in ceramic bowl. Stir in zucchini. Chill at least one hour. Yield 4 servings. Carbohydrate 5 g protein 3 g fat 8 g calories 136.

title: French Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; add milk oil salt and sugar. Stir until sugar and salt is dissolved. Pour flour into large bowl; pour liquid into flour and work until dough becomes stiff. Knead by hand for 5 minutes. Put dough into greased bowl; grease top of dough. Cover with towel and let rise until double in size. Remove from bowl and punch down. Divide into 4 pieces and shape into long loaves. Brush with egg white and 1 tablespoon water. Let rise again for 35 to 40 minutes. Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Bake about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine above ingredients until well mixed. When ready to serve mix well with your favorite mix sour or 7 up.

title: No Cholesterol Honey Bran Muffins
instructions: Spray 12 large muffin cups with cooking spray. In large bowl stir flour bran cereal baking powder salt and raisins. In small bowl stir egg whites milk corn oil and honey until well blended. Add to flour mixture stirring until moistened. Let stand 3 minutes. Spoon into muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: In a bowl mix all ingredients except pie shell. Mound filling into unbaked pie shell; smooth surface with a spatula. Bake in a preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and continue baking for 20 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Serve hot or cold. Maybe even with whipped cream.

title: Upside-Down Onion Corn Bread
instructions: In skillet saute onion rings in butter until soft about 5 to 8 minutes. Spoon into bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Prepare corn bread mix according to package directions. Pour batter over onions and spread evenly. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Turn out onto serving plate. Cut into squares. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Molasses Doughnuts
instructions: Beat eggs. Add molasses sugar and butter. Sift dry ingredients and alternate with the milk. Add flour enough to make a soft dough that handles easily. Roll out on floured board to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with doughnut cutter and fry in fat at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Charlie'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni. Saute together butter and flour. Add milk to make a sauce. Melt the cheese into the sauce. Combine with macaroni. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 1/2 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven or until bubbly.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti in large pan of boiling salted water. Bring spaghetti to boil again for 5 minutes; stir. Cover tightly and let spaghetti stand 20 minutes. Drain in colander or large strainer. Rinse with hot water.

title: Chocolate Lush
instructions: Pull bite size pieces of angel food cake apart and put into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips. Fold in egg yolks. Add beaten egg whites with sugar. Fold in 1 pint of cream that has been whipped. Pour mixture over angel food cake. Chill. Keep refrigerated.

title: Caramel Custard (Flan)
instructions: Make a hot water bath to fit a 9-inch pie pan. Heat water as you preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. In a small frying pan over moderate heat melt the 1/3 cup sugar. Shake the pan instead of stirring contents. Once melted the sugar will caramelize quickly. As soon as this happens pour at once into a 9-inch pie pan. Tilt pan quickly to let the syrup flow over bottom and slightly up sides of pan. Use hot pads to protect hands from heat. If syrup hardens before you finish set pan on moderate heat until syrup softens then continue.

title: Divinity Candy
instructions: Boil sugar water corn syrup and salt until it forms a hard ball in cool water. Then proceed to pour slowly over the whipped egg whites while beating constantly. Beat until candy begins to harden. Mix in pecans and vanilla; drop on waxed paper.

title: Chicken Diven
instructions: Line bottom of greased pan with cut up chicken. In large pan heat Cream of Chicken soup Pet Milk oleo and chicken broth. In a large bowl mix packages of stuffing together. Then pour soup mixture over stuffing and mix together. Spoon over chicken in pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. (Great dish for church dinner because it is a BIG one.)

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Work in softened margarine. Make a well in center. Add eggs anise and vanilla. Mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and flatten slightly. Bake 7 to 8 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until golden brown. Cool.

title: See'S Fudge
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Slice butter into chunks. Mix sugar and milk together into pan and bring to a boil for exactly 5 minutes. Add the hot mixture to the other ingredients and mix. Put in a glass buttered dish (fits into an 8 x 10-inch plus an 8 x 8-inch). Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in greased baking dish. Place cheese slice over each piece of chicken. Mix soup and water; pour over chicken. Melt oleo and mix with dressing; cover the chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Grandma'S Chicken Soup
instructions: In a large pot bring water to a boil. Add chicken onions green pepper salt thyme and bay leaf. Lower temperature slightly if boiling too rapidly. After 20 minutes add potato carrots and celery. Cook partly covered until chicken and vegetables are cooked. Strain the broth. In the broth cook pasta. Cut up vegetables and chicken if desired and add to pasta and broth.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Chop all ingredients and mix with mayonnaise to make a smooth salad.

title: New Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix salt pepper and garlic with olive oil. Cut potatoes into 1/4 slices or 1/8 slices. Coat 10-inch glass Pyrex dish with oil or Pam spray. Add potatoes and mixture pasting each potato as placed in dish. Garnish with parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Mix 2 cans mushroom soup 2 cans chicken soup 4 cans water. Mix and bring to slow boil. Flour biscuits roll it out make circles. Mix chicken peppers and onions in center of biscuits fold it over crimp it. Drop into simmering soup dont stir let slow simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add one egg at a time beating well after each. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and bananas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 minutes.

title: Almond Filled Christmas Cookies
instructions: Mix the butter whipping cream and flour together. Chill then roll 1/8-inch thick. Cut with small 1 1/2-inch round cookie cutter (size of shot glass). Sprinkle with sugar; prick several times with a fork. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Dont let them brown.

title: Hearty Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all together and mix well. Cover tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until rice is tender. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Put together in percolator. Perk until done.

title: Beef Roulades
instructions: Cut steak into 12 long pieces. Pound with hammer or heavy saucer. Prepare stuffing as directed on package. Place 1/2 cup on each piece of meat. Roll up; fasten with toothpicks. Brown in large skillet in shortening. Pour off any fat. Stir in soup and water. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Stir occasionally. Uncover cook until gravy is desired consistency. Serves 12.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli until tender; drain well. Stir soup and sour cream together. Add remaining ingredients except bread crumbs to soup and sour cream mixture. Spoon into casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Italian Pepperoni Spaghetti
instructions: Chop sausage fine and heat 5 minutes in a large skillet. Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain off fat. Add tomatoes tomato paste water onion flakes and salt. Simmer in skillet for 20 minutes or until mixture thickens. Add seasoning and mushrooms and stir well. Cook for another 5 minutes. Serve over hot cooked spaghetti. Sprinkle each plate of meat sauce and spaghetti with grated Parmesan cheese. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pine Bark
instructions: Line foil-lined 9 x 13-inch baking dish with crackers. Melt brown sugar and butter in a saucepan stirring to blend well. Pour over crackers. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 7 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Torte
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine; add graham cracker crumbs and sugar. Mix well. Press into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. With an electric mixer beat cream cheese sugar milk and 2 eggs until smooth. Pour over crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Mix pumpkin egg yolks sugar spices and salt in a saucepan. Cook on medium heat until thickened. Remove from heat and add gelatin which has been dissolved in 1/4 cup water. Cool mixture. Beat 3 egg whites until stiff. Add 1/4 cup sugar. Fold into pumpkin mixture and pour over cheese mixture. Chill. Spread whipped topping on top of pumpkin mixture. Sprinkle with nuts or crumbs if desired.

title: Meatballs With Sauce
instructions: Mix together hamburger onion oatmeal salt and pepper. Shape into meatballs and brown. Mix ketchup water sugar vinegar and Worcestershire sauce together. Pour over meatballs and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Ding Dong Cake
instructions: Mix and bake as directed. Let layers cool.

title: Graham Cracker Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar; cream together. Add eggs one at a time. Add milk and graham cracker crumbs alternately. Add vanilla baking powder coconut and pecans. Put in 3 greased and floured cake pans and bake at 350\u00b0 until done (approximately 25 to 30 minutes).

title: Chicken With Italian Sausage
instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons of the olive oil until soft. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet saute the sausage in the remaining oil until they are browned. Remove and when cool cut into 2-inch lengths. Dry the chicken and season with salt and pepper. Saute chicken in the same pan until brown. Remove chicken and pour off all but 1 tablespoon oil. Add onions garlic sausage tomato paste and wine and scrape up all the brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Return chicken pieces to pan turning to coat them with the sauce. Simmer covered for 45 minutes. Serve over lightly buttered noodles. Serves 2.

title: Lo Mein Salad
instructions: Bring all liquid ingredients and garlic to a boil. Toss with warm rinsed spaghetti. Fold in sesame seed. Chill 24 hours. Before serving add scallions lightly steamed broccoli mushrooms and snow peas. (You can lightly saute these in corn oil if you prefer.) You can substitute or add ingredients such as carrots and asparagus. You can turn this into a main dish by adding ground beef pork chicken or shrimp.

title: Molasses Taffy
instructions: Place all ingredients in boiler and boil to 260\u00b0 or until a small amount of mixture dropped in cold water becomes brittle. Pour into a buttered pan. When cool enough to handle pull until a light color and mixture hardens. Cut with kitchen shears into bite size pieces.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Saute onions beef and green pepper. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until brown and drain. Add rice tomatoes and chili powder. Pour in casserole dish and place in 350\u00b0 oven covered. Cook about 1 hour.

title: Dried Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar (adding sugar slowly) and beat until smooth. Add 1 egg at a time to mixture and beat until fluffy. Sift together flour baking soda salt baking powder and nutmeg and add to creamed mixture together with buttermilk; mix well. Divide into 8 equal portions; bake 2 to 3 portions at a time in greased 8 to 9-inch cake pans for 12 minutes at 325\u00b0. Stack cake layers while they are hot; let cool. Stew apples being careful not to get them too dry; remove from heat and add 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla; mash apples thoroughly to the consistency of creamed potatoes. Let cool before icing cake.

title: Spicy Grilled Corn-On-The-Cob
instructions: Grill corn covered with grill lid over medium-high heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Turn often to cook evenly.

title: Mama'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix and bake in unbaked pie crust at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix 2 to 3 teaspoons in 1 cup boiling water. Serve hot.

title: Sweet And Sour Sausage
instructions: Cut sausage and place in 2-quart dish. Add hot water. Cover and cook in microwave on High for 5 minutes. Drain. Stir in chutney and sour cream. Reheat (before serving) on Medium for 2 minutes. Serve in glass cooking dish or chafing dish with wooden picks. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Boil ingredients for 10 minutes. Add 3 pouches Certo and boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and skim. Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice per directions. Add other ingredients reserving one cup of stuffing to sprinkle on the top. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. You may wish to layer rather than combine ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine beef bread crumbs egg chilies cheese and taco seasoning mix. Mix well and pat into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake uncovered. Remove and let stand 10 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix by directions on box. Add cinnamon brown sugar and honey and mix well. Bake cake in thin layers one at a time. Once each layer is done place on cake plate and add applesauce mixture to hot layers.

title: Greek Chili
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and simmer on low heat for 3 hours.

title: Curry Dip For Raw Vegetables
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill before serving with raw vegetables.

title: Shortcake Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour salt sugar and baking powder. Cut in shortening. Add milk. Either roll dough to 1/2 inch thickness and cut into biscuits or pat into a 9-inch square cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits test done.

title: Cheeseburger Rice
instructions: Brown meat and onion in large skillet on medium-high heat; drain fat. Stir in water catsup mustard salt and pepper. Bring to boil. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Sprinkle with cheese; cover. Let stand 3 minutes or until cheese melts. Garnish with lettuce leaves pickle and tomato slices.

title: Taco Chili Salad
instructions: Prepare chili according to package directions; cool. Reserve 2 1/2 cups chili. Wrap remaining chili tightly; freeze for later use. Fry tortillas in 2 inches hot oil pressing down centers with large ladle to form shell. Continue frying until crisp and golden; remove with tongs. Drain. Arrange greens in taco shells; top with chili process cheese food tomatoes avocado and olives. Serve with sour cream and additional process cheese food if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Shrimp Tree
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add crab and shrimp boil. Boil for 15 to 20 minutes. Add shrimp and bring to boil again. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain well. Chill shrimp. Peel and devein shrimp leaving the tails on if so desired.

title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake 1
instructions: Blend Duncan Hines butter mix sour cream sugar and oil and add eggs one at a time. Mix brown sugar cinnamon and nuts. Oil and flour cake pan. Then pour 1/2 batter in pan then add sugar mixture then add rest of batter. Bake at 320\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Dip For Fresh Fruit
instructions: Mix ingredients; ready to serve. Just dip fruit into mixture and eat.

title: Cherry Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients with sugar baking soda eggs and sour cream. Take 3/4 of the dough and spread into a greased jelly roll pan. Spread on top with pie filling. Roll out remaining dough on floured board and cut into strips. Make lattice work on top. Brush top dough with egg whites and sprinkle with nuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Cook any cake mix as directed. Cool. Mix flour and milk. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick. Cool. Add remaining ingredients. Whip together. Ice cake. It is surprising how much this tastes like a Twinkie. Best with yellow cake.

title: Easy Tater Casserole
instructions: Place hamburger in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread soups over the hamburger. Lay Tater Tots all over the top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Italian Crispy Broccoli With Fettucine
instructions: Heat oil in wok or skillet and add broccoli. Cook covered for 4 minutes stirring occasionally until tender crisp. Add red pepper flakes garlic and ham and cook stirring 1 minute. Transfer mixture to a bowl and add red pepper fettucine and chicken stock to the wok. Cook covered 3 or 4 minutes or until heated through. Add broccoli mixture and salt and pepper to taste and combine well. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Serves 4.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: Brown hamburger with salt celery and onion. Place in layers in baking dish (at least 2-quart) the meat beans and potatoes; repeat. Add tomato soup on top and dot with butter. Cover dish and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Peach Jello Pie
instructions: Bring sugar water and cornstarch to a boil then add Jell-O. Take off stove and cool. Peel and slice the peaches. Put in the crust. Pour the mixture over peaches and chill. Put Cool Whip on top. Serves 8 people.

title: Pink Surprise Pie
instructions: Cover apples with pineapple. Drain just before serving. Combine apples and pineapple; spoon into pie shell. Fold yogurt into Cool Whip; mound onto filled pie. Top with strawberries or red raspberries and garnish with daisies.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Stir in sauce. Simmer. Cook noodles. Combine egg and cottage cheese (mix well).

title: Tie-Dyed French Toast
instructions: Whisk together eggs and milk. Pour eggs evenly into 4 small bowls. Add desired amount of food coloring. Dip toast corners in each bowl. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large skillet over medium heat. Cook bread until brown on both sides. Repeat until all is gone.

title: Chicken With Rice
instructions: Line bottom of a large baking dish with bacon strips. Pour dry rice over bacon. In a bowl mix soups and water together; pour over rice. Arrange chicken on top and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Ham And Potato Scallop
instructions: Cut ham in serving pieces and place in greased dish. Slice potatoes 1/4-inch thick over ham. Melt butter in pan stir in flour then tomato juice and milk. Stir and cook until thick. Season with salt and pepper. Pour over potatoes and ham. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dip breasts in eggs salt pepper and then in bread crumbs. Brown in oil. In saucepan combine tomato sauce garlic powder and basil. Bring to a boil then simmer for 10 minutes. Add margarine to sauce and reserve crumbs from skillet (after browning breasts). Arrange breasts in 9 x 12-inch pan. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over breasts then pour sauce over all. Put Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: Mix cranberry sauce with Russian dressing and soup mix. Pour over chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick-N-Easy Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Grease pan or dish and set aside. Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Microwave until all is melted. Pour into greased dish and let sit until cool and firm. Cut into squares.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Beat together egg yolks and sugar until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in orange juice and melted butter. Stir in salt lemon rind tarragon and sweet potatoes. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; fold into sweet potato mixture. Turn into buttered 1 quart casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until set and lightly brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Holiday Pecan Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar brandy extract and egg yolks in food processor. Add flour and salt to butter and sugar and mix in food processor. Roll dough mixture into 1-inch balls. Coat in 2 egg whites saved from before then roll in chopped pecans. Put on greased cookie sheet. Press each ball with a deep thumbprint in middle of each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Check frequently.

title: Spice Bars
instructions: Mix raisins and water; boil 10 minutes slowly with 1 stick oleo. Let cool. Then add sugar soda flour generous teaspoon of cinnamon cloves and salt. Mix and bake in greased and floured pan 9 x 13-inch at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix onions tomatoes peppers Spam or ham and mayonnaise. Mix with cooked macaroni. Let set overnight or a few hours before serving. Drain macaroni before serving.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In large saucepan melt 3 tablespoons butter. Stir in flour; cook 1 minute. Remove from heat. Gradually add broth. Bring to boil for 1 minute. Stir in chicken and vegetables. Pour into greased 2-quart shallow baking dish. Place biscuit mix in medium bowl. Cut in 3 tablespoons softened butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in milk.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Brown meat with onions; drain well. Add cheese parsley flour onions and mushrooms. Stir these gently together. Spoon into pie shell. Beat eggs and milk together and pour over all in pie crust when youre ready to bake. You may make this ahead and pour milk and eggs on when ready to bake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let set for 5 minutes before cutting. Travels very well for potluck.

title: Sinful Salad
instructions: Mix together well and chill 3 to 6 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Clusters
instructions: Boil syrup and sugar. Add peanut butter and melt. Mix in corn flakes. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper and cool. No bake candy is ready.

title: *Cheese Bread
instructions: Scald milk; stir in honey or sugar salt and margarine. Cool to lukewarm. Measure water into a large bowl and sprinkle in dry yeast. Stir until dissolved then add to warm milk mixture. Add cheese and flour; mix well. Dough should be non-sticky to fingers smooth and satiny. Place dough into greased bowl and let rise until doubled. Punch down and divide into 2 portions. Let rise on bread board for 10 minutes.

title: Sausage Pasta
instructions: Place sun-dried tomatoes in one-cup of water. Cook sausage meat breaking into pieces while cooking. Remove from pan and drain grease. Saut chopped onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent. Add fresh chopped tomatoes and stir. Cook five minutes. Add sun-dried tomatoes and water stirring mixture together. Cook 10 more minutes. Add fresh peppers scallions and cooked sausage meat. Stir together. Add remaining ingredients (except pasta) to taste. Cook several minutes longer. Cook pasta. Place cooked pasta in a bowl and top with sauce.

title: Family Favorite Barbecue Beans
instructions: Mix all together and bake uncovered in oven approximately 1 hour. Do no cook in crock-pot or overcook. We like them juicy.

title: Pecan Roll
instructions: Mix in a large pan and then roll in coconut.

title: Choco Bananas(Guatemala)
instructions: Peel bananas put a frozen Popsicle stick into each banana freeze overnight. Cover bananas with chocolate coating. (Use method for melting chocolate on candy bag.) Serve.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Bake about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 1 pie.

title: Homemade Pizza Dough
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl allowing yeast to soften. Stir in oil and 2 cups flour. Add more flour until dough holds together. Grease your hands lightly and knead dough on floured board until smooth. Cover and let rise 45 minutes. Shape it to pans you are using or into individual disks all on greased pans. Brush with sauce and cover with ingredients. Let rise about 5 to 10 more minutes then bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. This recipe also makes a nice French bread loaf. My family makes individualized pizzas.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt cheese butter and vanilla together. Add powdered sugar and cocoa. Mix together; pat onto ungreased cookie sheet (2). Use a paper towel to pat out to catch excess butter. Let harden.

title: Beulah'S Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream well together margarine and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks. Add soda which has been dissolved in the water. Add lemon extract and mix thoroughly. Set aside. In a large bowl mix dates raisins pecans and candied fruits with about 1/4 of the flour. Mix remainder of flour into the sugar butter mixture then add fruit and nut mix and stir until thoroughly blended. Beat egg whites and fold in. Spray a large tube pan with nonstick spray. Pour in batter making sure it settles down into pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours until wooden pick comes out clean.

title: Devil Dogs
instructions: Mix all ingredients until blended. Drop by spoonsful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 350 oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Makes about 30.

title: Impossible Turkey Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle first 5 items in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into pie plate. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting. Refrigerate any remaining pie. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Avocado Magnificent
instructions: Place cubed avocado and diced tomato in a bowl. Squeeze lime juice over mixture. Lightly salt with 2 dashes of garlic salt. Blend well. Serve with garlic pita chips. Serves 2.

title: Vegetable Sandwiches
instructions: Drain juice from vegetables. Add vegetables to softened cream cheese and cut in mayonnaise. Season to taste. Spread on bread slices. Makes 6 sandwiches.

title: Ragu Turkey Wings
instructions: Coat wings with flour. Saut 1/2 of chopped onion in deep fat until clear. Add wings and fry until brown. Place wings in baking pan; cover with 1/2 chopped onion 1/2 chopped bell and 1 stalk celery chopped. Pour on Ragu sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (about 20 to 30 minutes).

title: Creamy Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each. Combine flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in vanilla and coconut. Beat egg whites add cream of tartar and continue beating until stiff. Fold whites into batter. Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 9 inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Canning Green Tomatoes
instructions: Slice the green tomatoes as you would if you were frying them. Place in wide mouth jar. Put 1 teaspoon salt in on top of tomatoes. Fill jar with\tlukewarm water leaving 1-inch headspace.\tSeal and place in lukewarm water bath and cold pack for 10 minutes. (Let water boil for 10 minutes.) Set off heat; cool and store. When ready to use open jar drain off water and prepare as you would fresh.

title: Rosamarina Salad
instructions: Cook the rosamarina as directed. Use large pot with lots of water. Add sugar eggs flour and salt to pineapple juice. Mix well and bring to a boil. Mix with rosamarina and cool in refrigerator overnight.

title: Chocolate Syrup(For Chocolate Milk Or Topping, Etc.)
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and salt. Add 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Store in refrigerator. Use in milkshakes or combine 2 tablespoons syrup with 1 cup milk and heat for hot cocoa.

title: Won Tons
instructions: Mix together all ingredients well. Let stand at least 1/2 hour so flavors blend. Place 1/2 teaspoon filling near center of won ton skin. Moisten edges and fold in triangles. Pinch to seal.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Cut hot dogs into bite size pieces. Mix beef hot dog pieces and all other ingredients in a large pot or bowl. Divide into 2 casserole dishes (2 to 3-quart size each). Bake for about 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: 1st Layer Mix 1 1/2 cups flour with 1 stick margarine and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Press into baking glass (9 x 13-inch) dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes until brown.

title: Fresh Pineapple Sherbet
instructions: **The juicy pieces of diced fresh pineapple give it a texture and flavor that makes it different...and better... than any other sherbet youve ever tasted. Good fresh ripe pineapple could have a completely green shell color or more often a shell with green and gold. The leafy crown should look fresh and green. The fruit should feel firm.

title: Chicken Fried Steak
instructions: Put beef slices between sheets of plastic wrap. With flat side of mallet pound until about 1/4 inch thick. Dip beef into the beaten egg and then into bread crumbs mixed with salt and pepper. Heat fat in heavy skillet over medium to low heat. Brown steak 8 to 10 minutes on each side. Place steaks on warm platter. Keep hot.

title: Gooey Marshmallow Puffs
instructions: Separate crescent rolls into 4 triangles. Dip marshmallows in melted butter; roll in combined mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place 1 dipped marshmallow on each crescent roll. Wrap to enclose marshmallow; seal edges. Dip in melted butter; place in muffin cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl; mix well. Drizzle over rolls. Serve warm.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Let set until sugar dissolves (while you are preparing your fruit and nuts). Mix your eggs with sugar mixture; mix until well blended. Mix in vanilla fruit and nuts. Sift flour salt and soda together; mix in with sugar and fruit mixture. Blend well. Bake in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Barbecue Potatoes
instructions: Using extra duty aluminum foil form platter type container. Alternate layers of sliced potatoes onions butter pats salt pepper and grated cheese. Wrap foil from end to end and close by crimping top together tightly. Place on a barbecue grill for 30 minutes along with other foods. Due to heat elements cooking time may vary. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
instructions: Add pudding mix to the milk. Add Eagle Brand. Stir in milk. Add Cool Whip; stir. Layer vanilla crackers and bananas beginning with the crackers. Pour some mixture over each layer. Refrigerate overnight (very important).

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add 1 cup sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg; beat well. Combine flour baking powder soda cinnamon and nutmeg; add to creamed mixture mixing until blended. Tint with food coloring if desired. Cover and chill dough.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Pour over boiling water and bring to a boil. Cook until thick. Refrigerate until cool but not set. Fold in fresh strawberries. Put in a baked pie shell. Top with whipped cream.

title: Porcupines
instructions: Soak rice for 1/2 hour in water. Rinse thoroughly and combine with other ingredients except tomato soup or puree. Mix thoroughly and shape into balls. Place in a roaster pan and pour 1 can tomato soup or puree over top. Add sufficient water to come to halfway up the meat balls in pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours. After removing the balls thicken the juice for gravy.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer the first 5 ingredients one by one. Dilute the can of soup with 1 1/4 cups of water and the 3/4 cup of Miracle Whip; mix well. Pour half of the liquid mixture over the layers in the pan. Lay the chicken pieces over rice and liquid mixture. Add the remaining liquid mixture on top of the chicken. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes a great meal.

title: Hot Drink
instructions: Mix sugar cinnamon lemon slices and water. Boil 5 minutes. Strain. Add lemon juice orange juice pineapple juice and apple cider. Heat but do not boil.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour stirring constantly until smooth. Remove from heat and slowly add milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Stir in corn egg and cheese. Pour into ungreased casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine water barbecue sauce bread crumbs egg parsley onion and celery. Add meat. Mix well. Put into meat loaf pan. Bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Four Way Meatballs
instructions: Thoroughly combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix lightly but well. Shape into 16 meatballs. Place in an 8-inch square baking pan. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Cranberry Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine boiling water and jello. Stir until dissolved. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into a 4-cup mold or 8-inch square dish. Chill until firm.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Brown the hamburger; drain. Combine with spaghetti sauce. Use a 9 x 14-inch Pyrex dish. Layer spaghetti cheese and meat sauce; repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a regular oven for 30 minutes or bake in microwave for 14 minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand a few minutes. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

title: Pear Pecan Salad
instructions: Drain pears. Boil 1 1/2 cups juice or use 1 cup juice and 1 cup ice cubes to set faster. Mix with Jell-O. Set to thicken in refrigerator. Beat together pears and cheese. (Dont drop the fibers from the pears back into the mixture; they will gather on your beaters. Throw the fibers away.) Add to thickened Jell-O. Mix in whipped cream and pecans. Refrigerate for a couple of hours or longer.

title: 7 Minute Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler; beat with mixer 1 minute. Then place over boiling water and beat for 7 minutes stopping a time or two to scrap sides. Do not over cook. Frosting should have more body than meringue but not stiff or thick-just creamy.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Pour beans in skillet. Chop onion and add to beans and barbecue sauce; place bacon on top. Cook in oven at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Little Mexican Pies
instructions: Spray muffin pans with cooking spray. In a skillet brown the ground beef then mix in the seasoning and sugar. Separate biscuits into 2 halves and place one half in each muffin cup.
