Press bottoms and sides to form a cup; spread meat mixture into cups and sprinkle tops with cheese. Bake according to biscuit pkg. directions until golden brown. Makes 16 servings.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: Mix sugar flour vinegar reserved pineapple juice and egg in top of double boiler. Cook until mixture is thickened. Chill until mixture is cool. Dice apples. Add apples and pineapple to cooled mixture. Fold in whipped topping. Add the cocktail peanuts just before serving.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Mix cream cheese and oleo together then add the flour. Chill for a few minutes. Makes 2 dozen balls which you shape in tart pans.

title: Pita Pizza
instructions: Wash and slice all raw vegetables. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Half each pita bread and toast on both sides until golden brown. Spread each half with 2 tablespoons sauce 1/2 of vegetable mix 1/6 cup Mozzarella cheese 1/2 teaspoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 tablespoon olives. Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese starts to bubble and turn slightly brown. Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix the Grape-Nuts and apple juice concentrate. Pat into a 9-inch pie pan. Bake for 10 minutes then cool before filling.

title: Green Jello
instructions: Prepare jello using half the water. Add cream cheese and smash with fork. Refrigerate until cool and slightly thick. Add prepared Dream Whip pineapple and nuts. Mix and refrigerate!

title: Ogre Sandwich
instructions: Open bun on cookie sheet. Place pastrami sauerkraut and Swiss cheese slices and heat thoroughly in oven. Will feed 2 if sandwich cut in half.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large saucepan. Stir well. Place over medium flame stirring constantly. Cook to soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Stir in juice and rind. Remove from heat. Add pecans. Stir until coated. Spread on wax paper and separate into clusters with a spoon. Let cool.

title: Lumpia
instructions: Simmer last 3 ingredients in a frying pan then add other ingredients. Add salt and nutmeg to taste. Cook until done. Scoop 1 tablespoon of the mixture into a lumpia skin and roll up. Glue with white of egg. Deep fry until brown.

title: Christmas Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Prepare 24 hours ahead of time.

title: Spicy Sugared Nuts
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix egg white and nuts stirring until nuts are coated and sticky. Mix the sugar cinnamon and a dash of nutmeg. Stir into nuts until evenly coated. Spread on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 30 minutes. Makes about 2 cups!

title: Chicken Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender in boiling water with 2 teaspoons salt. Drain. Cook onion and green pepper until tender. Add flour and blend. Add milk and cook over low heat until thick stirring constantly. Stir in soup. Add tuna. Pour in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in microwave.

title: Coconut Pecan Bars
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Cream butter well and add brown sugar eggs and vanilla; beat until smooth and creamy. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Stir in coconut and pecans. Spread in buttered 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into bars. Yield 3 1/2 dozen bars.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook spaghetti drain. Place in a buttered oblong casserole. Saute onion in margarine until soft. Remove from heat blend in bouillon cube mustard salt and pepper. Slowly add milk and soup; stir. Then add mushrooms with the juice. Mix in meat vegetables with sauce mixture spoon over spaghetti. Sprinkle the cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. If too thick add a little more milk. This can be frozen for future use.

title: Steak And Rice
instructions: In large saucepan cook steak in butter. Add soup mix and water to steak. Cover and simmer until sauce is a little thick (approximately 30 minutes). Pour over rice. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Depression Dinner
instructions: Mix together (like a meat loaf) and shape into patties (14). Wrap a slice of bacon around edge of each and secure with toothpick. Grill.

title: Cookie Pizza Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pizza pan. In large bowl combine cake mix 1 cup oats and 6 tablespoons margarine at low speed until crumbly. Reserve 1/2 cup crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs blend in egg. Press in prepared pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar beating well. Add eggs and mix well. Stir in sweet potatoes and water. Combine flour baking powder baking soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture mixing well. Fold in pecans and raisins. Spoon into 2 well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour or until it tests done.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine butter sugar and eggs. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients in order listed one at a time. Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Harvest Potatoes With Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a small bowl combine seasonings. Place 2 tablespoons melted butter in a 10-inch skillet (if handle is not ovenproof wrap with foil). Arrange a third of potato slices in circular pattern in skillet. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon of seasonings 4 teaspoons melted butter and 2 tablespoons onion. Repeat layers twice cover tightly with foil and press layers down. Bake 20 minutes. Uncover; bake 20 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Remove from oven; press layers down with a spatula. Let stand 10 minutes. Invert onto serving platter to unmold potatoes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs. Add mayonnaise soup and onion. Add to broccoli. Cut cheese into small pieces and mix throughout. Top with crackers. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Sprinkle coconut into bottom of pastry shell. Pour mixture over coconut. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
instructions: Season chicken with peppers and salt. Coat with flour. Brown in oil in large heavy pot. Remove chicken. Cook the 4 vegetables until soft. Put chicken back in pot and cover. Cook about 30 minutes. Add rice and mix together 2 or 3 minutes. Pour beer and water over and mix. Add 2 teaspoons salt and cook slowly until rice is done. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meat Loaf With Red Gravy
instructions: Mix together the first 6 ingredients until well blended. Then shape into an elongated loaf. Place meat loaf into a 9x13 pan or small roaster. Next pour tomato soup all around the meat loaf along with 1 can of water. Slightly mix water and soup with a fork. Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 1/2 hours or until juices run clear when forked. Baste with gravy one or twice during baking time. Uncover the last 15-20 minutes to brown.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Mix into 1/2 cup Crisco shortening with fork or pastry cutter. Add 2/3 cup evaporated milk and 1 beaten egg. Pour to desired consistency. Blend to mixture. Roll out walnut sized balls of dough to make small circles of thin crust. Add filling in middle of each crust then fold in half and crimp along the edges with fork to seal. Fry the pies in deep hot cooking oil until brown.

title: Ziti A La Nancy
instructions: Cook ziti and drain. Brown meat; stir in sauce and parsley. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Combine Ricotta Mozzarella egg salt and pepper; mix well. In a large deep casserole or crock-pot put a layer of sauce first then alternate layers of ziti cheese and sauce ending with sauce. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or in a crock-pot at medium setting for about 4 hours.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Bring all ingredients to the boiling point. Strain and serve hot in mugs.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil the sugar butter cocoa and milk; simmer. Add peanut butter vanilla salt and oatmeal. Quickly put on wax paper.

title: Cream Of Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large kettle or Dutch oven saute onion in butter until tender. Add flour; cook and stir until bubbly. Gradually add chicken soup; cook and stir until thickened about 5 minutes. Stir in the milk cream basil salt pepper and garlic powder. Add the vegetables; cook gently until heated through. Yields 8 to 10 servings (about 3 quarts.)

title: Pecan-Topped Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add vanilla. Combine flour baking powder soda salt and cinnamon. Add creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Mix well. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Carrot Soup
instructions: In a 3 to 4-quart pan combine oil and onion. Stir over medium heat until onion is limp. Add curry powder and flour; stir about 30 seconds. Add broth and carrots. Cover and simmer until carrots are tender when pierced 15 to 20 minutes. Add parsley. In a blender or food processor whirl about half of mixture at a time. Add salt and pepper to taste. Soup can be served hot or cold.

title: Marna'S Cheese Cake
instructions: Put cream cheese cottage cheese and sour cream in a large bowl; let stand until room temperature. Mix sugar flour and cornstarch in a small bowl. To the eggs add vanilla and lemon juice; have handy.

title: Shrimp Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Measure all ingredients into glass bowl. Stir thoroughly. Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve. Especially good on shrimp but may be used on other seafood. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Golden Ham Pie
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in the 1/4 cup salad oil. Remove from heat and blend in flour until smooth. Stir in 2 cups milk and chicken soup. Bring to boil and add diced ham and lemon juice. Pour into greased baking dish. Top with cheese biscuits made by mixing Bisquick and cheese with enough milk to roll out and cut into biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until brown.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix and serve on ice.

title: Ham Rolls(Hors D'Oeuvres)
instructions: With fork mix cream cheese with milk. Add Worcestershire sauce onion pepper basil and thyme. Stir. Spread cheese mixture on top of each slice of ham. Roll up the ham. Put in refrigerator to cool. Slice in 1-inch circles before serving.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and liquid ingredients separately. Pour liquid into dry ingredients and mix. Spoon into muffin pan about 3/4 full. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Test with toothpick at 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Stroganoff
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into bite size pieces. Melt butter on medium heat. Saute mushrooms garlic and onion until tender. Remove from pan.

title: Blackberry Yogurt Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Paper line or spray with Pam muffin tin. In a large bowl combine oat bran brown sugar and baking powder.

title: Pineapple Cream Cake
instructions: Make cake according to directions and bake in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Meanwhile drain pineapple; set aside. Take one small package pudding make according to directions. Then add 8 ounce package cream cheese and mix well. When cake is cooled spread mixture on top of cake then spread on pineapple. Spread Dream Whip on top.

title: Microwave Meat Loaf
instructions: The thyme marjoram and bay leaf are optional.

title: Spicy Zucchini Corn Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Coat 10-inch cast-iron skillet with oil. Heat over medium heat. Whisk milk eggs and chipotle in large bowl. Stir in corn muffin mix zucchini and cheese until just combined. Spread in hot skillet. Bake 21-23 minutes until set in center and top is evenly browned. Cool in skillet on wire rack at least 15 minutes before serving. Serves 6-8.

title: Quick Apple Betty
instructions: Spread apple pie filling in a baking dish. Mix margarine brown sugar and graham cracker crumbs together. In separate bowl spread crumb mixture over top of apple pie filling. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Brown crumbs.

title: Peanut Butter Temptations
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla mix well. Sift dry ingredients and blend in. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Shape batter in 1 inch balls. Place in ungreased tiny muffin tins bake 8-10 minutes. Remove immediately and press a peanut butter cup in each until only top shows. Let cool before removing from tins.

title: Limeade Dressing(Club Member: Leslie Jordan)
instructions: Blend all ingredients with rotary beater.

title: Mini Appetizer Pizzas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet brown ground beef and sausage. Mix onion into sausage and beef mixture and saute it until tender. When meat is browned and onion tender drain the grease out of the skillet. Stir processed cheese into meat and onion mixture. Continue cooking until the cheese melts. Arrange slices of bread on a cookie sheet. Place a heaping spoonful of the meat cheese and onion mixture onto each slice of bread. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Serve warm. Makes approximately 20 servings.

title: Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix dry ingredients very well. Add milk and cook until thick. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Refrigerate. Heat amount needed in microwave for ice cream or desserts.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix 1 stick melted butter 2 eggs and yellow cake mix. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and butter then add mashed bananas. Add eggs buttermilk (mixed with soda) sifted dry ingredients and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a well-greased loaf pan for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: Butterhorn Rolls
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar and salt. Cut in butter as for pie crust; set aside. Dissolve yeast in water. Add with the milk to the flour mixture; mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next day divide dough into four equal parts. On a lightly floured board roll each portion into a 12-inch circle. Brush with 1 tablespoon of melted butter and cut into 12 pie-shaped wedges. Roll up beginning with the wide end and place on greased cookie sheets. Repeat with remaining dough. Let rise in warm place until nearly doubled about 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Freeze in a plastic bag. Defrost as needed.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk with water; beat well. Add pudding mix and beat. Put in refrigerator for 15 minutes. Add Cool Whip and mix well. In a large 3-quart bowl spoon about 1/4 of the pudding mixture. Top with 1/4 of the fresh strawberries and 1/4 box of the vanilla wafers. Alternate layers ending with pudding mixture. Garnish with 6 crushed vanilla wafers and a few strawberry slices.

title: Punch
instructions: Fill a Bundt pan 1/2 full of Hawaiian Punch and a Bundt pan 1/2 full of pineapple juice and freeze. These will be used to float in the punch to keep it cold.

title: Stir-Fried Collard Greens
instructions: Remove stems of collards and discard them. Wash leaves thoroughly. Slice leaves into bite-size pieces by rolling several leaves together and cutting into 1/4-inch strips. Blanch greens in boiling water for 30 minutes. Drain well. Heat drippings in wok or large skillet until hot. Add remaining ingredients. Stir-fry until vegetables are tender about 4 to 5 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Soften yeast in water. In a medium bowl combine flour salt sugar and baking powder. With a pastry blender or 2 knives cut butter into flour mixture. Add yeast mixture and milk. Stir until well combined. Cover; set aside for 30 minutes. Roll or pat dough out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut into rounds with 3-inch cutter. Place biscuits on lightly oiled baking sheet. Prick tops with fork. Set aside for 45 minutes. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake biscuits until golden and firm on top 15 to 18 minutes. Serve warm. Yields 12 delicious biscuits. Perfect with any meal. Good recipe for beginner cooks. Happy eating.

title: Maduros
instructions: When selecting very ripe plantains the skin should be very black and they are slightly soft. Peel plantains and slice 1/4-inch thick diagonally. Heat 1-inch oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry until golden brown (2 to 3 minutes per side); drain on paper towels. Serve immediately.

title: Chex And Chocolate Party Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine cereal coconut and peanuts in large shallow pan. In 2-quart saucepan combine brown sugar butter and corn syrup to boiling. Without stirring boil 5 minutes. Stir in vanilla and baking soda. Pour over cereal mixture; stir until pieces are evenly coated. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Cool completely stirring frequently to break mix apart. Add chocolate chips and raisins. Store in airtight container. Makes 16 cups.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put sugar and water in saucepan. Dissolve cornstarch in as little water as possible and stir into sugar and water mixture; cook until thick and clear. Remove from heat. Add Jell-O and coloring. Place strawberries in bottom of baked pie shell. Pour filling over strawberries and chill.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Put sugar milk butter and cocoa into pan. Bring to boil; cook 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add oats peanut butter nuts and vanilla. Stir well and drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Let stand 1/2 hour to cool and dry.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Put in crock-pot and heat. Serve with chips.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Cut up and boil chicken. Lift chicken from broth; cool and debone placing chicken back into broth. At this point you may need to add more water. Bring to boil and add salt and pepper and bouillon cubes. While water is coming to boil prepare dumplings.

title: Asparagus, Petits Peas And Mushroom Casserole
instructions: If using fresh asparagus wash clean cut spears into approximately 2 1/2-inch lengths. Cover with water and cook just until tender about 10 minutes. Drain. Arrange around the outer edges of a buttered casserole dish stacking on each other. Drain peas and fill in the center of casserole. Mix grated onion mushrooms cream of mushroom soup grated cheese and pepper. Pour over asparagus and peas. Toss crumbs or potato chips over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until crumbs are brown. May be made ahead of time and refrigerated until ready to bake.

title: Belen'S Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken in a large pot. Wash peppers and remove seeds. In a small pot boil pepper in a little water until peppers are soft. Put peppers cumin garlic and water in a blender and blend until smooth. Heat stove to medium high. Heat oil in frying pan. Put chili sauce in a large bowl. Drain and separate boiled chicken. Dip tortilla in chili sauce. Fry tortilla in frying pan for 2 seconds on each side. Put chicken in fried tortilla and roll up like a burrito. Repeat for all tortillas.\tChop lettuce and tomatoes. Serve hot enchiladas with rice lettuce tomatoes sour cream and hot sauce.

title: Treasure Bran Muffins
instructions: In large bowl combine cereal and milk. Let stand 2 minutes. In small bowl combine oil and 1 egg; stir into cereal mixture. In medium bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add to cereal mixture stirring just until moistened. Fold in raisins. Spoon into greased and floured 2 1/2-inch muffin cups filling 2/3 full.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients with wire whisk to remove lumps. Add oil and next 3 ingredients stirring until smooth. Stir in chocolate morsels. Pour batter in Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Enjoy!

title: Milk Gravy
instructions: When sausage ham or bacon has cooked remove from skillet and keep warm. Pour fat that has accumulated in the skillet into a heat-proof measuring cup. Return 1/3 cup to the skillet. Add flour and cook over medium heat about 5 minutes until flour no longer smells raw. Add milk all at once and cook stirring constantly until gravy is thick about 2 or 3 minutes. Add salt.

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Fry bacon crisp. Remove from pan and dry on paper towel. Remove some of bacon grease. Add vinegar to frying pan. Cook to simmer. Put bacon back in pan. Pour over lettuce and stir. Eat while warm.

title: Squash Bake
instructions: Layer vegetables starting with squash then zucchini tomatoes and onion. Sprinkle with basil. Repeat in a 1 3/4-quart casserole dish sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Melt margarine and sprinkle over ingredients. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients adding sausage and eggs last. Pour into 2 (1 1/2-quart) casserole dishes. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Wieprzowina With Smietanie (Baked Pork Chops In Sour Cream)
instructions: Salt and pepper the pork chops on both sides and fry in margarine until brown; then place in casserole. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour mixture over the chops. Bake covered for 1/2 hour in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 4 servings.

title: Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice. Fold in pineapple and Cool Whip. Pour mixture in pie crusts. Put in icebox.

title: Brown Sugar Squares
instructions: Put in one bowl and mix 3 minutes. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peppercorn Chicken Breasts
instructions: Place chicken between sheets of plastic wrap. Pound with a mallet to about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle with peppercorns. Heat a heavy skillet; add butter and chicken. Cook turning once until chicken is done about 5 minutes. Remove chicken and keep warm.

title: Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Cook rice. Add thawed broccoli. Add soup cheese and milk. Saute celery in oleo and add. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Put shrimp in food processor; add egg salt and pepper. Process until blended. Slowly add heavy cream while processing. Remove from processor and add mixture to crab and carefully blend. Add mustard Worcestershire sauce Tabasco and onion. Shape into patties and put on cookie sheet. Refrigerate until ready to cook (at least a half hour). Fry until golden brown in oil.

title: Fried Corn Patties
instructions: In blender or food processor combine corn and water. Do not puree. Add eggs and process briefly. Put this mixture in bowl. Add all remaining ingredients except oil (it is for frying) mixing well. Heat oil about 1/2 to 1-inch deep in skillet. Drop 1 to 2 tablespoons of mixture into heated oil. Fry to 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Chocolate Fudge Parfait(Serves 1)
instructions: Layer strawberries and pudding in parfait glass. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Castillian Sauteed Broccoli With Olives
instructions: Cut broccoli into 2-inch lengths. Saute garlic in oil and butter in skillet for 1 minute. Add broccoli and stir-fry 5 to 7 minutes. Add olives. Stir gently. Cover and let steam for 3 to 4 minutes. Add salt.

title: Nutmeg Feather Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk and vanilla. Bake in 2 greased and floured square layer cake pans in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Potato Filling
instructions: Peel potatoes and grate. Drain in colander. Squeeze excess water out of potatoes. Saute celery onions and parsley in butter. Add grated potatoes and egg and season to taste. Stir and cook over low heat until potatoes are thoroughly cooked. Filling need not be completely done if baked in a casserole in oven. Filling can be put into any type of fowl.

title: Meatza Pie Casserole
instructions: Combine beef garlic salt bread crumbs and milk in bowl using fork to mix. Spread evenly in the bottom of 9-inch pie pan raising a rim about 1/2-inch around edges. Spread catsup over meat; arrange the drained mushrooms over catsup and cover with cheese. Sprinkle with oregano and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown meats and place in large stock pot with all other ingred. Simmer 4-5 hours.

title: Meat Spaghetti Sauce(A Recipe To Enjoy From The Kitchen Of Sarah Surina.)
instructions: Chop garlic and onion very fine. Saute in little oil until golden brown. Add tomato paste and water and simmer 2 minutes. Then add tomatoes oregano bay leaves sugar salt and pepper. In a separate pan braise pork bones and pork for 15 minutes. Then add them to tomato sauce. Let everything cook uncovered for 1 1/2 hours at a simmer. Brown the ground chuck in oil. Drain off fat and add meat to the sauce. Cook the sauce an additional 45 minutes skimming off the grease. Cook pasta.

title: Beans Supreme *
instructions: Wash and pick over beans. Put beans and next four ingredients in an electric bean pot. Mix well. Cover with lid and cook overnight 9 to 10 hours. Drain beans leaving as much liquid as desired. Add remaining ingredients and cook for 1 to 2 hours. Makes about 2 quarts.

title: Beef Soup
instructions: Steam ground beef garlic and onion together. Drain and put in a large soup pot. Add juice sugar bay leaf and cream of celery soup. Microwave carrots and celery until tender. Add to soup mixture. Simmer for 1/2 hour. Add salt and pepper. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Skin chicken breasts and cook in salted water until tender. Debone and cut in bite size pieces. Mix all together. Put in pastry lined dish. Cover with top crust. Make vents in crust and bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients well then roll out on floured board and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Strawberry Frozen Dessert
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0. Watch carefully stirring for 10 to 15 minutes. Spread in 10 x 13-inch pan and save some to sprinkle on top. Beat the next four ingredients. Beat 1 cup whipped cream and fold into mixture. Pour over crumbs and sprinkle remainder on top. Freeze until ready to serve.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix together apples pineapple small marshmallows and chopped pecans. Cook until thick the sugar juice from pineapple salt cornstarch egg butter and vinegar. Let cool and pour over apple mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Silly Putty
instructions: Pour starch in a bowl. Add glue and let set for 5 minutes. Add food coloring. Mix until starch is absorbed and color is spread smoothly. The more you mix the better it gets. Store in an airtight container overnight.

title: Hawaiian Pork Chops
instructions: In a large skillet quickly brown pork chops in 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Drain excess fat. Combine pineapple chunks and juice with barbecue sauce onion salt and pepper. Pour over pork chops. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Turn and baste chops. Stir in green pepper. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes longer or until chops are tender. Add more barbecue sauce depending on your taste.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish.

title: Ruth Baker Chip Dip
instructions: Add last four ingredients to taste. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Chill.

title: Heavenly Orange Fluff
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 1/2 cups boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and orange concentrate. Chill until partially set.

title: Spinach Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender; remove from skillet with slotted spoon. Stir in flour then milk. Puree spinach with consomme; add mixture to sauce. Add seasonings. Stir in cream; mix well. Heat just until simmering; stir in sherry. Sprinkle with almonds before serving. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Taco Bean Dip
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Mix with beans and taco seasoning. In separate bowl mix sour cream and taco sauce. Place meat mixture in greased 9-inch square pan. Spread sour cream mixture over beef mixture. Place cheese on top. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sparkling Cranberry Punch
instructions: In a large punch bowl combine cranberry cocktail and lemonade concentrate. Stir in sparkling water. Serve immediately. Makes 25 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

title: Bunny Sundae
instructions: Mix 3 or 4 drops of food coloring with the coconut. Use this for \grass\ in 4 small bowls. Cut 4 red or pink jelly beans in half. In each bowl put 2 scoops of ice cream. Use jelly beans for ears small red candies for eyes and nose and a miniature marshmallow for a tail. For a fluffier bunny cover ice cream with whip cream first. Sprinkle a few jelly beans on the coconut and enjoy!

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve with fruit.

title: English Silk Pie
instructions: Beat 1/3 cup butter or margarine with 6 tablespoons confectioners sugar until smooth. Add 3 eggs 1 at a time beating after each addition. Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Strawberry Pineapple Mold
instructions: Dissolve strawberry Jell-O in pineapple syrup. Add water to make 1 1/2 cups. Stir in lemon juice. Chill until thick. Halve berries and 1 cup pineapple chunks to mixture then chill until firm. Dissolve lemon Jell-O in water. Add lemon juice and salt. Cool and blend in sieved cottage cheese. Whip cream and fold in with walnuts. Put on top of layer. Fill center with berries and rest of pineapple chunks.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool. Add 2 tablespoons of vanilla and stir well. Add 1 quart of vodka and have fun!

title: Chocolate Covered Raisins
instructions: Spoon chocolate over raisins until well coated. Spoon onto mounds on wax paper.

title: Ham Loaves
instructions: Pour over loaves and bake 1 hour.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine peanuts sugar Karo syrup and salt in a microwave safe dish and cook for 4 minutes on high. Stir and cook 3 1/2 minutes more on high. Stir and add butter and vanilla. Cook for 1 1/2 minutes more. Stir in baking soda. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet and spread to desired thickness with a spatula.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Italian Rabbit Fettuccine
instructions: Rinse rabbit pieces in 2 tablespoons vinegar. Melt butter in a large skillet. Add the sliced onion rabbit and ham. Saute gently about 5 minutes on each side.

title: Shamrock Silk Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to package directions for filled one crust pie. Refrigerate remaining crust for later use. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine cream cheese sugar and flour mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Add chocolate eggs and 1/4 cup Irish mist liqueur; mix well. Fold in 1 cup whipped topping. Pour into pie crust lined pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean; cool. Combine remaining whipped topping 1 tablespoon Irish mist liqueur and food coloring. Spread over pie. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mash potatoes. Add sugar and eggs then other ingredients. Bake in unbaked pie shell at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Luscious Lemon Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in casserole dish; add shrimp (in shells) lemons cooking wine herb spice salt and Accent. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Biscuits
instructions: Saute sausage in skillet until brown; drain off fat. In a mixing bowl add cooked sausage to Bisquick and cheese stir until well blended. Add a little water to make mixture gooey. Make small balls and bake on cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs and add milk sugar butter vanilla and salt. Stir in rice and raisins. Pour into buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Foolproof Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In heavy saucepan over low heat melt morsels with Eagle Brand. Remove from heat; stir in remaining ingredients. Spread evenly onto wax paper-lined 8-inch square pan. Chill 2 to 3 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Sandra'S Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Combine sugar 3/4 cup warm water salt and oil. Add yeast. Stir well. Add flour. Mix to smooth soft dough. Knead lightly on floured board. Place dough in greased bowl; cover and let rise until at least doubled (about 2 hours). Make into rolls; brush with melted butter; let rise until very light. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Fruit Slush
instructions: Boil together 3 cups water and sugar. After coming to boil remove from heat and add cold water. Blenderize together the bananas pineapple and cherries. Mix all together with thawed orange juice concentrate. Freeze in individual plastic cups or 9 x 13-inch pan to scoop out. Let sit out several hours before serving for eating consistency.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Melt and set aside butter. Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Blend in egg and milk. Add butter. Mix altogether no more than 25 strokes quickly just until moist. Add blueberries. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Hot Cranberry Butter
instructions: Combine cranberries sugar and water in a saucepan. Heat to boiling stirring until sugar dissolves. Boil until the berries pop about 5 minutes. Add brown sugar and butter. Heat until dissolved. Serve hot on French toast waffles or pancakes.

title: Ice Cream Snow
instructions: Mix it all together with a wooden spoon and then share it with your friends immediately.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender drain and cool slightly. Mince pepper. Cut onion in round slices separate and mix with carrots. Mix other ingredients together and pour over vegetables. Marinate 12 hours or more.

title: Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Note You may use any vegetable you like.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease shallow baking dish. Mix ziti hamburger 1 1/2 cups marinara 1/2 cup Mozzarella and the Ricotta and Parmesan cheeses in casserole. Top with remaining sauce and Mozzarella. Cover and bake 45 minutes until hot. Serves 6.

title: Wild Rice With Mushrooms And Almonds
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add rice almonds onions and mushrooms. Cook and stir until almonds are brown about 20 minutes. Pour rice into a baking dish. Heat broth to a boil. Stir broth into rice mixture. Cover tightly and bake for about 2 hours in a 325\u00b0 oven until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender and fluffy.

title: Microwave Pecan Treats
instructions: Place milk and chips in microwave and melt. Take out and cool. Dump in marshmallows and pecans; stir. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

title: Blackberry Jam Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Beat in jam.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Cut into bite size pieces. Mix with soups sour cream and almonds.

title: Chocolate Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix all together in bowl and put in one (9-inch) pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients well so oil does not separate.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain. Cool at room temperature. Mix lettuce tomatoes onion cheese beans and oregano. Toss well.

title: Shipwreck Stew
instructions: Mix as listed and pour in a casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Method of combining is very important. Combine all ingredients except oil dissolving over low heat. Cool and add oil just when ready to combine salad. Shake to mix.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Arrange in greased baking dish in order listed. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered with foil for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer or until done. Serves 20.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender except cheese ham shrimp bacon and mushrooms. Pour into greased pie plate. Sprinkle with unblended ingredients and push them down below the surface of the egg mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Let set 10 minutes before serving.

title: Southern Sweet Potato Muffins
instructions: Combine the 1/4 cup flour and brown sugar. Using pastry blender or knife \cut in\ margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Set aside for topping.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook and peel potatoes. Dice them. Fry bacon and onions and remove from pan. Crumble bacon over potatoes. Drain off all but 1/2 cup of bacon fat. To this add vinegar sugar flour salt mustard celery seed and water. Cook until thick then mix with potatoes. This can be made a day ahead and reheated in a slow oven (300\u00b0). Makes 15 servings.

title: Quick Doughnut Drops
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar and beat until thick and creamy. Add salt butter dry ingredients and milk. Mix until smooth. Drop by teaspoons into hot oil. Fry until golden brown. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Roasted Potato Wedges
instructions: Wash potatoes and cut into wedges lengthwise. Put butter and oil in baking dish in 325\u00b0 oven to melt butter. Toss wedges in mixture to coat. Sprinkle with salt pepper and paprika mixture. Bake 1 hour turning potatoes occasionally.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and oil. Mix well until light yellow. Sift together flour and cinnamon. Stir into egg mixture. This will be very stiff. Add vanilla apples and walnuts stirring until well mixed. Pour into greased 9-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Blond Brownies
instructions: Sift flour once. Measure 1 cup. Add baking powder baking soda and salt. Sift again. Set aside. Melt margarine; then add sugar and mix well. Add egg and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Add nuts. Turn into greased 9 inch square pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips over top. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Cool in pan then cut into squares.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with chopped onion and bell pepper in skillet. Drain off fat. Put seasoning in tomatoes and pour into the meat mixture. Bring to a boil. Pour into casserole dish and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Muffins
instructions: Blend dry ingredients together. Beat egg and milk; add to mixture until moistened. Put into paper lined muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugars milk and butter; cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until marshmallows melt. Remove from heat. Stir 30 seconds longer. Pour into 8-inch buttered pan. Let cool.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Put 8 slices of buttered bread butter side down in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Add ham and cheese. Add other bread slices. Set aside. Combine the eggs salt pepper dry mustard and milk. Pour over bread cheese and ham. Refrigerate overnight (cover with Saran Wrap). Next morning mix corn flake crumbs and oleo. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt candy in double boiler. Cream sugar and oleo. Add eggs one at a time. Add candy; beat well. Mix flour salt and soda; add to this mixture with milk. Beat well. Add vanilla and pecans. Pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Southwestern Rice And Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a large salad bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar with flour in top of double boiler; add 1 whole egg and 3 egg yolks and add milk and blend thoroughly. Cook uncovered over boiling water until thickened. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Layer in baking dish custard wafers and bananas ending with custard. Stand wafers around edge of dish. Whip remaining 3 egg whites with 1/4 cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Spread over custard touching wafers all around. Bake at 425\u00b0 until delicately browned.

title: Dorothy'S Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar and vegetable oil. In another bowl mix flour baking soda salt cinnamon and baking powder. Combine with first mixture; mix then add pumpkin. Grease and flour pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes for sheet cake 35 minutes for layers (makes 2 layers). Frost with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Scald milk on stove top; do not boil. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with butter and set aside. Set milk off stove and add bread sugar and butter. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs. Add salt and vanilla. Gently stir bread mixture into egg mixture and pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Set dish in a pan of water on bottom shelf of oven. Put approximately 1 inch of water in pan. Bake for 1 hour. Insert wet knife into the pudding. If knife comes out clean it is done.

title: Ham And Egg Rolls
instructions: Peel eggs and cut in half. Roll each half of egg in slice of ham. Secure with toothpick. Arrange lettuce leaves around on plate. Arrange ham and egg rolls on lettuce. Decorate with pickles and mayonnaise. Makes 12 rolls.

title: Little Links In Pillows
instructions: Lightly grease two 12-cup muffin tins. Separate 2 cans of dough into individual biscuits. Place in pans. Sprinkle lightly with sesame seed. Top with 1-inch square of cheese. Press one sausage deeply into center of each biscuit. Bake 10 minutes in 425\u00b0 oven. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Makes 4 dozen biscuits. Can be frozen.

title: Holiday Fruit Ball
instructions: Cream together cream\tcheese and confectioners sugar. Add fruit and nuts. Mix well. Shape into a ball. Roll in 1 cup chopped nuts.

title: Hot Milk Sponge Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt together. Beat eggs and vanilla in a large mixing bowl at high speed until thick and lemon colored. At low speed add dry ingredients mix thoroughly. Heat milk and butter in saucepan just to boiling. Gradually add to flour mixture. Bake in two 9-inch layer pans greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove to wire rack. When completely cool ice with 7 Minute Icing. Sprinkle top and sides with coconut.

title: Heavenly Pie
instructions: Beat sugar into egg whites until folded in. Fold in pecans crackers and vanilla. Butter a 9-inch glass pie plate well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Brenda'S Tater Tot Hot Dish
instructions: Lightly grease baking dish and crumble hamburger on bottom. Add vegetables and mix hamburger. Put Tater Tots on top. Mix soups together and spread over Tater Tots. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. It should be brown and crisp. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Barbecups
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10 cups in a muffin pan. Mix chopped onion with ground beef and brown in a skillet. Drain off excess fat. Stir in barbecue sauce. Add brown sugar. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Place 1 biscuit in each greased muffin cup; press firmly in bottom and up sides forming rim around the top. Spoon about 1/4 cup meat mixture into each biscuit-lined cup. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges of biscuits are golden brown. Makes 10 servings.

title: Cooked Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour pudding mix and salt in a 3 quart heavy pan. Stir in egg yolks and milk. Blend well. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Spread small amount on bottom of 3 quart casserole. Cover with vanilla wafers. Top with layer of 2 sliced bananas. Pour about 1/2 of custard over bananas and layer all again with the rest of the custard on top. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks form. Spoon on top of pudding spreading over entire surface all the way to the edge. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk and blackberries. Bake in 3-layer cake pans. This is especially nice topped with chocolate icing.

title: Gumbo
instructions: Boil chicken sausage and onions until chicken and sausage are well done. Add seafood okra bay leaves thyme salt black pepper crushed red pepper and gumbo file. Serve over rice. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and simmer 1/2 hour. This is good for poultry beef pork and venison. Will keep for up to 6 months in glass jar in refrigerator.

title: Easy Bake Chicken
instructions: In glass dish or pan place 4 to 6 pieces boneless chicken. Mix together mushroom soup and wine. Pour over chicken. Place 4 to 6 pieces of Swiss cheese over top of chicken. Top with croutons. Pour butter over croutons. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered; 15 additional minutes uncovered.

title: Peanut Butter Fingers
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the chocolate chips; mix until blended. The mixture will be crumbly. Spread into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven; spread chocolate chips over hot cake. Let chips soften then spread evenly over bars. Cut into bars.

title: Cinnamon Bars
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolk then flour sifted with cinnamon. Pat into an ungreased 15 x 10-inch pan. Pour unbeaten egg white over surface; drain off excess. Sprinkle nuts over top pressing down lightly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into bars while hot. These freeze well. Yield 3 dozen.

title: Microwave Turkey Directions
instructions: Wash turkey. Rub with salt especially inside cavity. Place breast side down on large microwavable dish. Halfway through turn breast side up and cover leg and wing ends with aluminum foil to prevent overcooking.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix first five ingredients with salt and pepper and spread in greased casserole dish.

title: Banana Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs until frothy. Add sugar and beat well. Add milk and vanilla. Heat well. Stir in bananas. Pour mixture into container of 1 gallon. Save room at the top for ice cream expansion.

title: Spring Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender 15 to 20 minutes. Reserving water in pan remove potatoes to colander and rinse under cold water to cool. Drain and cut into 1/2 inch dice. Add carrots to reserved water and cook about 3 minutes until tender. Remove from water rinse and drain. Add fresh peas to reserved water and cook 3 to 5 minutes. If using frozen thaw and drain well; do not cook. Toss potatoes with sherry or broth vinegar tarragon salt and pepper. Add carrots peas and mayonnaise. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Ground Beef And Potato Casserole
instructions: Line casserole dish with 1/2 of beef half potatoes and a layer of onions. Repeat. Pour soup over it all. Cover and place in oven at 350\u00b0. Bake 2 to 3 hours or until tender.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: In large heat-resistant bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in yogurt with wire whisk. Fold in whipped topping with wooden spoon. Spread in crust. Refrigerate overnight or at least 2 hours. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Tanya'S Party Time Cheese Ball
instructions: You may add 1 (2.25 ounce) jar of Armour dried beef finely chopped.

title: Greek Rotini Salad
instructions: Cook pasta and drain; cool. Combine lemon juice olive oil spices and garlic in container. Mix until well blended and of a thick and creamy consistency. Chill. Combine cooled pasta with rest of ingredients and large bowl. Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to coat evenly. Serve immediately.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Add taco sauce to beef. Sprinkle 1/2 cup corn chips over pie shell. Put meat mixture over chops then spread sour cream. Add cheese on top of sour cream and top with remaining chips.

title: Meatloaf
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together salt and pepper to taste. Place in loaf pan. Mix tomato sauce vinegar and mustard for topping and pour over meatloaf. Bake 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crock-Pot Pizza
instructions: Layer and cook 5 hours. Add cheese last hour of cooking.

title: Cinnamon Apple Rings
instructions: Cut cored and pared apples into 1/2-inch rings. Cook all ingredients until apples are just tender. Chill. Instead of the cinnamon candies and red coloring use 12 whole cloves and green coloring. Makes a nice showing at Christmas.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil the sugar cocoa and milk for 1 minute. Add oatmeal coconut and peanut butter. Mix well. Spoon onto wax paper.

title: Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Reuben Loaf
instructions: Combine 2 1/4 cups flour yeast sugar butter and salt. Stir in warm water mix until soft dough forms. Add remaining flour if necessary. Turn onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth about 4 minutes. On lightly greased baking sheet roll dough to 14 x 10-inch rectangle. Spread dressing down 1/3 center of dough. Top with layers of beef cheese and sauerkraut. Make cuts from filling to edges of dough 1-inch apart on both sides of filling. Alternate sides folding strips at an angle across filling. Cover and let rise 15 minutes in warm place. Brush with egg white and sprinkle with caraway seed. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: No Bake Cherry Pie
instructions: Bring cornstarch sugar and water to a boil over low heat. Boil about 2 minutes until thick and clear. Stir in gelatin dessert until dissolved. Add cherries. Chill until mixture starts to set then fold in whipped topping. Pour into pie shells. Chill. Yield two 8-inch pies.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat slowly; spoon off excess fat. Add garlic basil salt tomatoes and tomato paste. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook noodles in large amount of boiling salted water until tender; drain and rinse. Beat eggs and add remaining ingredients except Mozzarella. Layer half the noodles in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread with half the Ricotta filling. Add half the cheese then half the meat sauce. Repeat layers reversing the last two. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until cheese on top is golden. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chocolate Caramel Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Pour 1/2 into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt caramels and margarine and can of milk in microwave and pour over baked cake add chips if desired. Add remaining cake batter and finish baking 30 more minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients; boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and oatmeal; mix well. Drop by spoon onto wax paper. Let stand to cool before handling.

title: Manhattan Meat Roll
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt into a mixing bowl. Cut in shortening with pastry blender until mixture resembles a fine meal. Add milk all at once and mix to form a soft dough. Use a lightly floured board. Put dough on the floured board and knead lightly about 20 times. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Place sugar cocoa milk and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and quickly add peanut butter oatmeal vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Let stand to dry.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken in pieces.\tPut 1 package of dry onion soup in bottom of\tcasserole dish. Add dry rice and layer of chicken pieces. Mix 1 can cream of chicken soup and 1 can of water; pour over chicken.\tCover and bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.\tUncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crush pretzels (not too fine) and mix with sugar and butter. Press into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Cook 6 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool. Cream 1 cup sugar and cheese then add Cool Whip. Mix well and pour over crust. Chill approximately 2 hours. Add 1 large strawberry Jell-O mixed with 2 cups boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Spread on top of salad; chill.

title: Cherry Breakfast Rolls
instructions: Add margarine water and milk that have been heated until just warm. Stir in sugar salt and dry yeast. Slowly add flour to make a soft dough saving 1/2 cup flour to add during kneading. Knead on floured board. Place dough in greased bowl turning once. Cover; refrigerate overnight. Divide into 20 pieces. Roll each piece into 15-inch strands. Wind into a coil. Allow to rise for 2 hours on baking sheet. Indent center and add about 4 cherries. Bake 12 to 14 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool. Combine powdered sugar vanilla and milk. Drizzle over cake.

title: Chicken-Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Layer asparagus water chestnuts almonds and chicken in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Combine next 4 ingredients mixing well. Spoon mixture over chicken sprinkle cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Blueberry Nut Crunch
instructions: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch dish and spread undrained pineapple over bottom. Add the blueberries. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup sugar. Crumble cake mix on top of fruit layer. Drizzle melted butter over top of dry cake mix. Top with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. After cake has cooked 25 minutes cut down through it in several places so juice can come to surface.

title: Beef Or Chicken Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients except wine and frozen peas together (season with salt and pepper) and stir well. Put in oven at 250\u00b0. Add 1/4 to 1/2 cup water after the first hour. After the third hour add either white or red cooking wine. Continue baking at 250\u00b0 for 5 hours. Stir every hour. The last hour put the box of frozen peas on top. Cook covered.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy saucepan. Stir in sugar syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil without stirring 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popcorn mixing well. Turn into two shallow 12 x 15-inch pans. Bake in preheated oven at 250\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Empty into large containers. Work fast. Break apart. When cool store in airtight container (Ziploc bags).

title: Anne'S Hearty Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In large pot brown sausage and ground beef together. Cover pot and drain fat. Add onions stirring until lightly brown. Drain rest of fat. Add all other ingredients and simmer approximately 4 hours stirring frequently. Serve over thin spaghetti or vermicelli.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Rinse raisins and nuts in boiling water. Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased muffin pan at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Batter may be refrigerated and used as needed.

title: Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Mix; press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Life'S Recipe
instructions: (A recipe passed on through the ages.)

title: Scalloped Hash Browns
instructions: Mix. Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole and cover with Italian bread crumbs. Drip stick of oleo over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
instructions: In microwave-proof bowl add margarine onion celery garlic and 1/2 cup bell pepper; saute. Stir. Cook slowly with top on stirring often. Add 1 1/2 cups water 2 cups chicken broth and 1 can shrimp bisque. Cook 20 minutes. Blend cornstarch with cold water. Add shrimp. Cook 15 minutes. Serve over rice. Serves 6 or 8.

title: Crock Pot French Dip
instructions: Mix together water soy sauce and all spices. Pour over roast and cook in crock pot on high for 6 to 7 hours or until tender. Remove and shred meat. Butter and broil rolls. Make sandwiches with meat and use juice in crock pot as dipping sauce.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Add shortening eggs and banana to dry ingredients. Add nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Preacher'S Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; add onions and celery. Cook until vegetables are transparent. Mix in remaining ingredients and pour into greased casserole saving 1/4 cup noodles for topping. Top with crushed noodles saved for topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Crazy Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles or macaroni; drain. Brown meat; pour off fat. Add season salt and all ingredients except cottage cheese and cheese in a 2-quart pan. Layer macaroni cottage cheese meat sauce and 1/2 cup cheese. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves at least 8 big eaters. Serve with salad or garlic bread.

title: Banana-Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine oil honey and eggs. Beat in bananas; set aside. In small bowl mix flour baking soda and salt. Add oats. Stir in chocolate chips. Add to banana mixture stirring just until moistened. Line muffin cups with paper baking cups or spray with nonstick spray. Fill 2/3 full. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 18 muffins.

title: Anytime Fruit Cobbler(Blueberry, Apple, Peach, Etc.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Pour small amount of the margarine in bottom of 8 x 12 baking dish (2-quart baking dish or 9 x 13 dish); set aside. Mix sugar flour milk and rest of butter together well. Pour into baking dish. Place fruit evenly over top of this. Do not stir!! Bake at 375\u00b0 until lightly browned about 45 minutes. Serve hot or cold. Store leftovers in fridge covered.

title: One Step Lasagne(Microwave Recipe)
instructions: Using cook/drain container cook ground beef for 4 to 5 minutes at 100% power. Salt; add water and sauce to beef. Mix egg Parmesan and Ricotta cheeses and parsley. In 9 x 13-inch dish or 2 smaller dishes spread 1/3 sauce. Cover with 1/3 dry noodles 1/3 cheese mixture and sprinkle with 1 cup Mozzarella. Repeat twice and top with remaining meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover tightly with double thickness of plastic wrap. Cook for 30 minutes at 50% power. Uncover; sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella and additional Parmesan. Cook uncovered at 50% power for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Allow to stand for a few minutes. Sprinkle with parsley and serve. Remember if using 2 small dishes cook only 1 at a time but for 1/2 the time.

title: Super Chicken Supper
instructions: Have chicken delivered from favorite local take-out service. Immediately destroy cartons and bags and other \tell-tale\ evidence of delivery. Place chicken on baking sheet. Liberally sprinkle spices over pieces. Reheat chicken in 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 oven. No one will ever know. Serve with tossed salad and bowls of pasta topped with butter and Parmesan cheese.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Use electric skillet at 400\u00b0. Add sugar syrup and butter; stir until sugar is dissolved (about 5 minutes) then add peanuts. Cook stirring constantly about 5 to 7 minutes. \Do not brown.\ Then add soda. Cut off heat; stir fast and pour onto buttered cookie sheet. When cool break into pieces.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Wash tomatoes and cut out stems. Slice about 1/2 inch in thickness. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Coat with corn meal and cook in heated cooking oil in skillet. Brown both sides. Serves 6.

title: Pork And Veal Casserole
instructions: Brown the meat. Add soup and water. Cook 1 1/2 hours slowly. Add rest of the ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. I often use all pork.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Brown onions and peppers with hamburg. Add tomatoes syrup salt pepper chili powder and bay leaf. Simmer 15 minutes. Blend cornstarch in meat mixture; add macaroni or rice. Put in 2-quart dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Add 1 cup cheese over last 15 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Put pecans in bottom of Bundt pan. Mix cinnamon and sugar. Roll the biscuits in sugar mixture. When well coated place in pan. Mix melted butter with remaining sugar mixture and pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix the spaghetti with all the other vegetables and pour dressing over mixture and serve cold.

title: Great Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix beef 1/3 cup of soup bread crumbs onion egg and salt. Form into loaf. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Blend remaining soup 2 or 3 teaspoons of drippings and water. Pour over loaf. Bake another 10 minutes.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Cream butter with sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add beaten egg yolks. Beat thoroughly. Add sifted dry ingredients and milk alternately in small amounts beating well after each addition. Add nuts then the stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into greased pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When cool frost with Caramel Frosting.

title: Santa Fe Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Mix all together and cook 2 1/2 hours.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Mix all but carrots onions and green pepper. Once marinade is mixed add carrots onion and green pepper. Chill overnight tossing occasionally. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
instructions: Cream butter 1/4 cup of powdered sugar and vanilla with a spoon. Blend in flour. Gradually mix in nuts. Shape into 3/4-inch balls rolling in palms. Place about 1/2-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes until light brown. Then move to wire rack. Still warm roll in powdered sugar. Cool. Roll again. Store in container. Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix and sift together flour and soda.\tAdd alternately with first 4 ingredients then add pecans and vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Set out cream cheese eggs butter or oleo and flour overnight so they will be at room temperature. Cream butter and cream cheese together; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Sift together flour and powdered sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture clings together. Press in to 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Beat together eggs white sugar lemon juice flour and baking powder. Pour over baked crust and bake 20 minutes longer. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Thunder Cake
instructions: To take this thunder cake you do it this way. You start counting when you hear thunder and then when you see lightning you stop counting. If your number is 10 that means it is 10 miles away and if it is that close you need to hurry up and make a cake. It is just a normal cake but you make it in a storm. It is done in a storm so it is a thunder cake and it is sort of a good recipe.

title: Delicious Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients with wire whisk. Gently stir in the Cool Whip. Layer bottom of pie crust with mixture. Mix 1 cup half and half and the pudding mix; let stand 2 to 3 minutes. Add the pumpkin cinnamon ginger and cloves; mix with wire whisk. Put over other layer in pie crust. Chill 2 hours.

title: Brussels Sprouts And Carrots
instructions: Cut large Brussels sprouts in half. Heat 1/2 cup water lightly salted to boiling. Add sprouts and carrots. Return to boiling. Reduce heat. Cook covered 10 to 15 minutes or until tender-crisp; drain. Return to saucepan.

title: Tender Soda Pancakes
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Beat eggs milk and melted butter just until blended and add to flour mixture. Beat until smooth. Using a 1/4 or 1/2 measuring cup drop batter on hot lightly greased griddle. Bake. Brush with melted butter and serve immediately. Makes 11 to 12 (5 1/2-inch) pancakes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook and drain 8 ounces lasagna noodles. Brown ground beef onion and garlic salt together. Drain. Add tomato paste tomatoes salt pepper and oregano. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Layer noodles meat and cheese. Make sure cheese is last layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients like pie crust. Divide and roll into 2 long strips on cookie sheet. Pat to 1/4-inch thick. Bring to boil 1/4 pound oleo and 1 cup water; add 1 cup flour. Remove from stove. While hot add eggs 1 at a time. Stir well after each addition. Add almond flavoring. Spread over pastry to 1/4-inch from edge. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Cool.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook hash browns according to directions on package. Mix hash browns and next 6 ingredients. Place in a 13 x 9-inch buttered casserole. Top with crushed corn flakes; dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Dip
instructions: Beat all ingredients together well. Dip with fresh strawberries.

title: Justin'S Slaw
instructions: Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil and then cool. Pour cooled mixture over the cabbage onion and pepper. Refrigerate. Can be kept several days.

title: Curried Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces (bite-size). Cut grapes in half. Add mayonnaise for desired consistency. Grapes should be one-third amount of chicken. Add curry powder to taste (sprinkle first). Decorate with slivered almonds. Serve on lettuce or use for appetizer on cocktail breads.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables and stir in vinegar mixture. Cover and chill at least 8 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Raisin Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring water to boil in large saucepan. Add rice. Cover and cook until tender. Drain rice rinse with cold water and set aside. Place 1 quart of milk sugar salt and raisins in double boiler and heat slowly. Blend cornstarch with remaining half cup of milk. Beat eggs until light. Add vanilla to eggs then stir into cornstarch mixture. Slowly add cornstarch mixture to milk mixture in double boiler cooking and stirring until mixture coats on spoon. Remove from heat and fold in rice. Chill.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix hamburger sausage eggs onion ketchup salt and pepper together. Add oats a little at a time. May add more than 3 cups. Divide in 1/2 to make 2 loaves. Put ketchup on top of loaves. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Spray loaf pans with Pam oil spray. Combine eggs oil sugar zucchini and vanilla; set aside. Combine other ingredients. Add to zucchini mixture; stir. Pour in pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Heat fat; add onions. Stir. Lower heat until onions are brown. Add remaining onions and celery. Add pepper and butter. Cook 5 minutes. Add hot sauce thyme basil and 1/2 cup stock. Cover. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes. Add tomatoes; stir. Lower heat. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce; simmer 5 minutes. Add remaining stock and sugar; stir. Simmer 15 minutes. Add shrimp. Turn off heat. Let stand 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Place all ingredients in the food processor and blend until very small chunks of vegetables remain. You may have to scrape the sides of the bowl a few times to get all of it chopped.

title: Venison Roast
instructions: Combine all ingredients into crock-pot until done.

title: Coconut Pie(Self Crust)
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar and eggs. Sift dry ingredients together. Alternately add milk and dry ingredients to shortening mixture. Add vanilla and bananas. Bake for 1 hour in loaf pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Tuna Casserole
instructions: Make macaroni and cheese ad directed on the box. Put in a casserole bowl and add tuna peas and cream of mushroom soup. Sprinkle crackers over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese And Bacon Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Stir in remaining ingredients except vegetables. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix in a bowl the sugar milk and flour. Pour peaches over. Melt butter in dish then pour into dish over the butter. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Arrange in 3-quart Pyrex baking dish. After cooking and deboning chicken break chicken into large chunks and place on top of broccoli. Mix undiluted soup mayo lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Top with bread crumbs tossed in butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Polly'S Cake
instructions: Mix together the cake mix eggs oil and mandarin oranges with the juice and bake as instructed on cake mix box. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour baking powder and salt. Add peanut butter and 2/3 cup milk. Mix until damp. Beat 2 minutes at low speed. Add 1/3 cup milk eggs and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Pour into greased cake pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and frost with Chocolate Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: M'Jaddara
instructions: Wash lentils under running water. Put them in a cooking pan with just one cup of water and bring them to boil over high heat 5-7 minutes. Lower heat and cook covered for 15-20 minutes or until water is absorbed.

title: Lauren'S Care-A-Lot Candy
instructions: Put peanut butter in a big bowl and mash with a spoon. Add the maple syrup and stir. Put in the sugar a little at a time and keep stirring. When you cannot stir any more use your hands. Squeeze and pound the candy until smooth. Now pour in the granola. Mix it into the candy with your hands. Break off little of candy. Make each one into a small ball about the size of a marble. Put the candy in the refrigerator. Leave it there for at least an hour. Now your candy is cold and crunchy.

title: Baked Hash Browns
instructions: Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish. Mix the ingredients and pour into the dish. Melt 1/4 cup butter and mix with 1/2 cup bread crumbs. Sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chicken Broccoli Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix soup and milk together. Mix chicken broccoli 1 cup of the cheese and 1/3 to 1/2 of the milk mixture. (Use enough soup mixture in the above ingredients to keep it moistened good.) Spoon mixture into each tortilla. Roll up and place in greased oblong casserole dish (size of dish depends on if using small or large tortillas). Pour rest of milk/soup mixture over all the roll-ups. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Top with onion rings and return to oven to be browned. (Can be prepared ahead and frozen baking at a later date. Allow a little more time for baking when coming right from the freezer. Add onion rings after it is hot and bubbly....brown.)

title: Thanksgiving Brown Sugar Brownies
instructions: Melt butter then add brown sugar. Add eggs flour vanilla and nuts. Mix and put mixture into oblong pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove and let partially cool. Cut into squares.

title: Paul'S Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Beat together eggs sugar and cooking oil. In another bowl sift together all dry ingredients. Add flour mixture alternately with pumpkin to beaten mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. See cream cheese frosting recipe.

title: Ham And Cheese Pinwheels
instructions: Unroll and separate crescent rolls into 8 rectangular shapes. Press the diagonal cut in each sheet to seal the dough. Spread each sheet with 1/4 teaspoon mustard (more or less to taste). Lay a piece of ham on top; sprinkle with grated cheese. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Roll in sesame seed. (If time allows place on a plate and refrigerate for a few minutes makes them easier to cut.) Slice in 1-inch pieces. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve warm. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix last three ingredients. Pour over first four ingredients. Chill.

title: Tricky Torte
instructions: Slice pound cake into 7 layers while cake is cool from the refrigerator. Melt chocolate bits and stir in sour cream. Evenly frost all layers including top layer. Top with sauteed almonds pressing lightly so they will not fall off when cake is sliced. Refrigerate.

title: Sylvia'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix at room temperature. Chill. Roll into ball then in chopped nuts. Can be frozen.

title: Easy Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil the chicken breasts in large pot filled with water 1/4 teaspoon salt celery carrots and onion. Remove the chicken from the pot saving the liquid celery carrots and onion. Remove the chicken from the bone and break into bite size pieces. Return the chicken meat to the pot. Add 1 can chicken broth and pepper. Bring to a rolling boil. Mix the Bisquick and milk in a large bowl. Roll out onto floured surface to about 1/2 inch thickness. Using your hands form 1 inch balls from Bisquick dough. Drop into boiling broth. Cook uncovered at gentle boil for 20 minutes. Check dumplings for doneness.

title: Toasted Pecans
instructions: Mix all but pecans together. Add to pecans. Spread on baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 20 minutes stirring after 10 minutes. Drain on paper towel. Cool.

title: Breakfast Bars
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Line 1 package rolls on bottom. Beat cream cheese; add yolk sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Put other crescent rolls on top and press edges together. Beat egg white and brush on top of rolls. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Sprinkle evenly in greased pan 9 x 13-inch.

title: Cheesecake Cookies
instructions: Mix brown sugar flour and chopped nuts together in a large bowl. Stir in melted butter and mix with your hands until light and crumbly. Remove 1 cup of the mixture to be used later as topping. Place remainder in an 8-inch square pan and press firmly. Bake at 350\u00b0 or about 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add molasses and egg. Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients; mix well. Roll in small balls; dip into sugar. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Pinch Cake
instructions: Place nuts in buttered Bundt pan. Take each biscuit and cut into 4 pieces. Roll each 1/4 biscuit in cinnamon and sugar mixture; cover well. Place sugared dough in pan placing layer of raisins after each can. When finished with all cans melt 1 1/2 sticks butter and pour over top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes then flip onto cake plate.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix jello as directed on box. Pour juices together and mix with jello mixture. Freeze. Remove from freezer about 1 1/2 hours before serving time. Allow to become slushy. Add ginger ale or Sprite.

title: Roasted  Pepper Pasta
instructions: Cook noodles as directed. Slice peppers in 1/2 and hollow out inside. Place hollow side down on a cookie sheet. Wipe olive oil on the outside of peppers and sprinkle with kosher salt. Broil until peppers turn black (approximately 15 minutes). Wipe skin off with a paper towel and thinly slice. In a pan add diced onion diced tomatoes garlic and fennel seed. Add peppers and toss with cooked pasta and fresh basil. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Tuna Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Drain tuna. Mix all ingredients except parsley and form into a ball. Sprinkle with parsley and then place in refrigerator to cool. Serve with crackers. Ball can also be rolled in nuts. Makes 12 servings.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Melt oleo in dish. Mix sugar flour milk and vanilla flavor. Mix all together and pour in on top of melted oleo. Put 1 cup of blueberries on top (last). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix applesauce and baking soda together. Mix cut up walnuts and raisins together with flour and set aside. Mix all the rest of the ingredients together with the applesauce mixture and raisin mixture. Pour into a tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well all of the ingredients and store in an airtight container.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese and sugar; beat at medium speed until smooth. Add peanut butter and vanilla; beat well. Set aside. Beat whipping cream until soft peaks form; fold into peanut mixture. Spoon into crust. Sprinkle with peanuts and chill.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Mix butter nuts salt vanilla and powdered sugar. Add flour. If too stiff add a little more milk. Roll into fingers and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pecan Pie
instructions: Blend Cool Whip Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice; drain crushed pineapple. Mix to other ingredients. Put in graham cracker shell and chill for at least one hour.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix and roll in 4 rolls; put in refrigerator. Slice and bake on ungreased baking sheet at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Good Walnut Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into roll. Let sit overnight in refrigerator. Slice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Chop up all ingredients and mix together. Pour Italian dressing over all and mix well. Let set for a couple of hours and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pat'S Husband Pleasing Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine tomato sauce water oats egg onion salt and pepper. Mix well. Add ground meats mixing lightly but thoroughly. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Drizzle ketchup over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Drain grease from pan. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Lentil Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Serve on spaghetti and cover with lots of cheese.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour in a 9-inch crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: After preparing bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all together in bowl; stir. Leave Jell-O in powder form. Very good.

title: Oatmeal Crispies
instructions: Mix margarine sugar and eggs. Mix soda salt and flour. Mix in oats and raisins. Drop dough by spoonfuls on baking pan. Leave room for cookies to spread. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: Mary Love'S Potatoes
