instructions: Boil the potatoes and mash. Mix all other ingredients with the mashed potatoes except almond slivers. Spoon into casserole dish (flat and shallow is best). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Add butter pats to top of casserole and sprinkle slivered almonds on top. Broil until bubbling. Serves about 8 people.

title: Cracked Wheat Salad *
instructions: In large saucepan combine water and bulgur. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer covered 20 minutes or until water is absorbed and wheat is tender but not mushy. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate uncovered until cool. Add pecans currants parsley olive oil orange zest can of mandarin oranges (or orange cut up) salt and pepper to taste and orange juice to taste. Serves approximately 12 side dishes.

title: Pimiento And Cheese
instructions: Shred cheese. Add pimiento chopped bell pepper salt pepper and sugar. Add mayonnaise and stir. Use enough mayonnaise to mix and be able to spread on bread.

title: Easy Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken in water. Remove and cut up chicken in smaller pieces. Return chicken to water and add butter soup salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Cut up one package of flour tortillas in long strips. Drop into boiling mixture. Boil for 5 minutes. Thicken with mixture of 5 tablespoons flour and cup of water. Easy quick dinner. Serve with hot cornbread.

title: Butter Crunch Candy
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan; add sugar corn syrup and water. Cook stirring occasionally until it reaches 300\u00b0 (hard crack). Quickly stir in nuts and spread out on cookie sheet. Cool then spread with melted chocolate. Break into pieces after it cools.

title: Baked Chicken Parmesan With Linguine
instructions: Grease baking dish. Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Put into a shallow dish. Dip chicken in eggs then in bread crumb mixture. Arrange chicken in casserole dish. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella. Bake until cheese is melted. Prepare linguine as directed on package; drain. Toss linguine with sauce. Top with chicken.

title: Kringla
instructions: Mix sugar and oleo. Add egg sour cream and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in dry ingredients. Chill dough until firm. Roll a teaspoon of dough on a floured board and make a figure \8\. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on bottom.

title: Chicken And Wine A La Sandra
instructions: In a frying pan melt butter. Add potatoes onion 1/4 teaspoon red pepper and garlic powder. Saute until tender then add bread crumbs. In a shallow dish put oil and garlic cloves. Pound cutlets and add a couple of tablespoons of stuffing. Roll and place flap down in baking dish. Add cooking sherry water and 1/4 teaspoon of red pepper. Cover with foil for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cook time 1 hour.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix thoroughly and bake in an iron skillet at 450\u00b0 until brown approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Blend first four ingredients and 1 teaspoon salt. Stir 10 cups of water in apples. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Add lemon juice and coloring. Put in pint jars and boil in bath water 15 minutes; quart jars for 20 minutes. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Eggplant With Cumin Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Heat butter in ovenproof casserole add eggplant. Sprinkle occasionally with salt and pepper while cooking until soft not mushy.

title: Pizza With Sun-Dried Tomatoes And Goat Cheese
instructions: Add garlic powder or crushed cloves to olive oil. Heat lightly and let sit. Hand shred chicken breast. Slice mushrooms and onions. Chop sun-dried tomatoes into small pieces. Use about 2 tablespoons of olive oil mixture to lightly saute mushrooms and chicken. Brush oil/garlic mixture onto pizza bread crust. Dont overdo it; brush lightly. Remove excess oil with a paper towel if it pools on bread crust.

title: Saucy Ham And Potato Bake
instructions: Saute onion in butter blend in flour and seasonings. Gradually add milk cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add 1 1/2 c. cheese; stir until melted. Toss potatoes in cheese sauce. Reserving 1 cup of potatoes. Pour into 2 qt. casserole dish. Arrange ham and reserved potatoes on top of casserole top with remaining cheese. Bake 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chip Or Veggie Dip
instructions: Cook eggs sugar vinegar and salt in a double boiler or thick pan until thick; whisk constantly. Cook and mix with softened cream cheese until well blended. Add remaining ingredients to your taste. Flavor improves if set overnight. Keep in fridge.

title: Green Bean Cheese Cake Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Add sour cream. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add green beans and pour into baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Heavenly Banana Pudding
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine pudding mix and milk. Beat for 2 minutes or until well blended. Add the sour cream and 2/3 container of Cool Whip. Beat for another minute. To assemble the pudding place a layer of vanilla wafers on the bottom of the container you plan to use. Can use a trifle bowl. Add a layer of sliced bananas next a layer of pudding. Repeat with a layer of vanilla wafers a layer of bananas and a layer of pudding. The top layer should be pudding. If you like a lot of vanilla wafers add another layer of them on the layer of pudding. Top with the remaining Cool Whip.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Cook oatmeal in water and set aside. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour in cooked oatmeal. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13 pan until done.

title: Sweet 'Tater Puffs
instructions: Add beaten egg salt and pepper to potatoes. Form in a ball around the marshmallows. Roll in flakes. Drop in piping hot Crisco until brown.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix flour and cocoa real good then add eggs and milk. Cook over low heat stirring constantly. When thick remove from stove and add butter and vanilla. Pour in a baked pie crust.

title: Paradise Salad
instructions: Drain canned fruits. Mix with cottage cheese and whipped topping in bowl. Add jello. Mix and refrigerate 1 hour. Can be easily doubled.

title: Seasoned Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and mash. Add green onion dip cream cheese butter milk and garlic salt beating at medium speed of electric mixer until smooth. Spoon potato mixture into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Peel wash and slice potatoes in baking dish. Beat eggs and milk together with salt and pepper; pour over potatoes. Grate cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown around edges.

title: Western Supper
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed. Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Heat thoroughly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Put remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add spaghetti. Toss. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Frozen Cucumbers
instructions: Slice up cucumbers; put into containers. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil; let cool. Pour mixture over cucumbers. Will keep for 1 year.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: In large saucepan cook onion and green pepper in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Combine onion mixture in bowl with chicken and peppers; set aside.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix all but 1/2 cup cheese together; spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Lemon Velvet European Ice Cream
instructions: Mix sugar and lemon juice. Add whipping cream and lemon extract. Add grated lemon rind. Add enough milk to fill up to fill line of ice cream freezer.

title: Diabetic Apple Or Pear Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl stir together fruit cinnamon tapioca shortening and concentrate; allow mixture to sit for 10 minutes. Pour mixture into pie shell; put on top crust. Bake 1 hour or until top crust is golden.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: In large bowl mix ingredients together. Pour into large casserole dish. Top with 1/2 box of crushed cheese bits cracker crumbs and 1 stick melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fettucine Florentine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender except noodles. Blend. Cook fettucine according to package directions. Put on warm plate and toss with sauce.

title: Viola'S Corn Pudding
instructions: Bring cream and milk to the boiling point. Remove from heat and add butter. Let cool. Beat each egg separately. Combine with sugar and salt. Add cream mixture. Stir in corn. Pour into a greased casserole and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Never Fail Rib Roast
instructions: Let meat stand out until room temperature. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place roast fat side up in a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with salt pepper and garlic to taste. Do not cover. Roast meat 1 hour; turn off oven and do not open oven door. Thirty minutes before serving turn oven on 375\u00b0 again. Carve in thin slices.

title: Zucchini Bread #1
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: The Best Pot Pie
instructions: Heat margarine over low heat until melted. Blend in flour onion salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in chicken and vegetables; reserve.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Cream cooked pumpkin sugar and lard. Add sifted ingredients and blend. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until light brown. Frost (if you desire) with 10x sugar and maple flavoring.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese mixing until well blended. Add remaining ingredients except nuts. Mix well and chill. Shape into ball; roll in nuts. Serve with crackers.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Brown meat and add all ingredients except rice. Bring to a full boil. Add rice; reduce heat and cover. Simmer for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Add vanilla and almond. Add flour and milk alternately. Pour in ungreased pan. (Do not preheat oven.) Start in cold oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Test. I use a tube pan.

title: Mother'S Tea Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar salt and eggs until light and soft. Mix and sift flour and baking powder. Add to the first mixture alternately with milk and vanilla beating well. Grease cup cake tins or line with paper baking cups. Fill cups 3/4 full. Bake at 375 for 15 or 20 minutes. Yields 12 cup cakes.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Add all ingredients except crust and blueberries in a large mixing bowl using a spoon to make sure its all mixed in (no electric spoons). Mix everything until its smooth. Then pour it in the graham cracker pie crust. Put the blueberries on top then chill in the refrigerator for at least 7 hours or overnight.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers together. Top with crushed crackers. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Frozen Strawberry Salad
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese together. Add strawberries pineapple bananas nuts and fold in Cool Whip. Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Freeze. Remove from freezer about 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix and chill. Makes enough for an army.

title: Cherry Jubilee
instructions: Mix together cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple in a large bowl. Add Cool Whip condensed milk nuts and marshmallows all together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish; chill.

title: Cornbread Pie
instructions: Brown onions and beef. Add other ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes. Put in casserole dish leaving space for cornbread topping.

title: Apple Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix together the first 2 ingredients until smooth. Add rest of ingredients and cook until thick. Allow to cool. Combine apples celery and nuts and pour some of the dressing on top. Stir and serve. Store balance of dressing in tightly covered container and keep refrigerated.

title: Ten Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Boil beef until done and remove from broth. If you want to\tremove\tgrease you need to let broth get cold and grease will be on top for easy removal. Put broth in large kettle (10 quart) to make soup. Add cabbage  green beans potatoes celery carrots onions and lima beans.\tAdd V-8 juice and cook 1/2 hour or until vegetables begin to seem done. Add corn peas and tomatoes last. Add water or beef bouillon as needed for flavor.\tCook another 1/2 hour and let stand for flavor. Add beef back in soup if desired.

title: Cheesy Turkey Stuffing Mix
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour stuffing mix into greased 2-quart baking dish. Add cheese turkey and pepper. In a separate bowl gradually stir milk into flour. Stir in eggs. Pour over stuffing mixture. Bake 50 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 4.

title: Cheese Dreams
instructions: Have margarine and cheese at room temperature. Cream well with mixer. Add flour salt and red pepper (cayenne) to taste; mix well. Add Rice Krispies last (by hand). Roll in wax paper (size of 50 cent piece). Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Cut in slices. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes. May drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet.

title: Sausage Gravy For Breakfast
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Simmer until thick. Serve over baking powder biscuits.

title: 5 Pound Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add one egg at a time. Add 1 cup of flour to mixture. Add 3/4 cup of flour to fruits and nuts. Mix the cream mixture with the flour fruits and nuts. Add flavorings last. Pour into greased and floured Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Easy Roast Beef And Gravy
instructions: Place roast in large piece of heavy aluminum foil. Empty soup mix over meat; add soup. Close foil so that steam does not escape but leaves an air pocket above meat. Cook at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes per pound. Yields 8 servings.

title: Pimento Cheese Spread
instructions: Cut cheese into small 1 inch pieces. In a large bowl combine all other ingredients and mash together thoroughly with a potato masher. Store in refrigerator.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in bottom of Pyrex casserole dish. Combine soup and sour cream and smooth over chicken. Combine crackers poppy seed and butter; sprinkle over top of the chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Solar Pickles(Canning)
instructions: Put grape leaves at bottom of 1 gallon glass jar (about 2). Put salt dill and garlic at bottom of jar also layering pickles grape leaves garlic and dill until you reach the neck of jar leaving 1/2 inch neck space. Pour cold water and vinegar over the top of pickles. Let pickle jar sit outside in sun for 48 hours. Store in refrigerator; good for 1 year. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Raisin Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter; add 2 beaten egg yolks raisins and pecans; set aside. Beat egg whites very stiff fold lightly into first mixture. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Where'S The Beef ? Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into large ball; wrap and refrigerate. About 1/2 hour before serving unwrap and sprinkle with paprika. You want the ball to be room temperature to serve.

title: Baked Rice Pudding
instructions: Mix all but Cool Whip. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool well. Cover with Cool Whip.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on box. After macaroni and cheese is done add mushroom soup then drain peas and tuna and add them to macaroni. Stir together and serve.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Melt butter in boiling water. Add flour and salt all at once. Stir vigorously. Cook stirring constantly until mixture forms a ball that doesnt separate. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating vigorously after each egg until smooth. Drop dough by heaping tablespoon 3 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake in very hot (450\u00b0) oven 15 minutes then in low oven (325\u00b0) for 25 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients in stock pot over low to medium heat. Start with tomato products mixing well then add spices to taste; mix well. Then add other ingredients. Let sauce simmer a few minutes then taste.

title: Beef And Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; set aside. Cook elbow spaghetti in 4 or 5 cups water for 7 to 9 minutes; drain and set aside.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach pat dry with paper towel. Mix in bowl with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Form into bite size balls and freeze or refrigerate until ready to use. Bake at 350\u00b0 on cookie sheet for 20 minutes.

title: Parmesan Bread Deluxe
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small bowl combine cheese dressing and onion. Spread a generous teaspoon of the dressing mixture onto one side of each bread slice. Arrange bread dressing side up on cookie sheets. Broil 2 inches from heat for 2 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to mix directions. Split cooled cake layers in half. Combine sugar sour cream and 2 cups coconut. Reserve 1 cup of this mixture for frosting. Spread sour cream mixture between layers and on top of cake. Combine reserved cup of sour cream mixture with Cool Whip. Blend until smooth. Spread on top and sides of cake. Sprinkle remaining coconut on cake. Store in airtight container in refrigerator for 3 days before serving.

title: Jello Pops
instructions: Dissolve in hot water then add cold water. Pour into Tupperware popsicle molds. Freeze hard. Makes 12.

title: Chicken Taco Pie
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Cut into bite size pieces or fry ground beef. Combine chicken or ground beef taco sauce soup onion garlic salt and pepper.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook together the broccoli onion and butter adding water as package directs. Drain; cool. Add soup milk rice and cheese. Put in baking dish; sprinkle with buttered crumbs or cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Onion-Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In large plastic bag or bowl add all ingredients. Close bag and shake or toss in bowl until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking or roasting pan. Bake stirring occasionally 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Makes 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Shortcake Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add 1/4 cup butter and shortening thoroughly working them into the flour mixture. Lightly mix in the sour cream with a fork. Add just enough milk to make a soft dough.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cook 2 minutes; boil then add 1/2 cup miniature marshmallows and 1/2 cup semi-sweet chips. This will go with the Jackie Cake.

title: Hot-Cold Slaw
instructions: Bring the sugar vinegar oil mustard salt and celery seed to a boil. Allow mixture to cool and pour over cabbage and onion. Refrigerate. Slaw will keep in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Hawaiian Toasts
instructions: Spread toast with butter. Place a slice of ham pineapple ring and a cheese slice. Cut each slice of toast in four with sharp knife. Place on a greased baking sheet; sprinkle with the curry powder and allspice and cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Wonderful W. W. Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together until lumps are removed and it forms a creamy consistency. Makes 8 servings 1/2 P. and 20 c.

title: Perfect Cornbread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add milk and eggs; beat until mixed well. Pour into a warmed greased iron skillet. Bake at 425 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

title: Polish Bow Ties(Kruiciki)
instructions: Combine yolks sour cream sugar vanilla and salt. Add flour and make a stiff dough. Place on floured board and knead until smooth but not sticky. Divide dough in two or three parts. Cover the parts with bowl. Roll one part of dough very thin. Cut into strips. Cut each piece in center and pull through center. Fry in deep fat. Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Nutty-Crisp
instructions: Place sugar butter and nuts in heavy skillet. Stir over low heat until nuts are toasted and sugar is caramel colored. Pour onto foil. Add salt. Let cool. Break into pieces and eat.

title: Pinch Me Bread
instructions: In plastic bag mix sugar and cinnamon. Open 1 can of biscuits and cut each biscuit into fourth. Place in bag with dry mixture. Shake until all pieces are coated remove and place in Bundt pan. Spread 3 tablespoons of hot mixture over bread. Repeat with second and third cans of biscuits. Spread remaining hot mixture over last biscuits and sprinkle with remaining dry mixture. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Let stand to cool for 5 minutes. To serve just pinch off pieces.

title: Romanian-Style Cheese Pastry
instructions: Mix together and sprinkle this mixture on top.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Have butter soft. Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add flour and baking powder. Add alternately with milk small amount at a time. Add flavoring. Beat egg whites and fold in. Do not beat. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini And Tomato Au Gratin
instructions: Use 1/2 teaspoon oil to prepare 2-quart casserole. Cut tomatoes in bite size pieces. Heat remaining oil in skillet. Add onion rings and cook until limp. Add zucchini slices cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes. Add tomatoes juice salt and pepper. Mix carefully. Turn into oiled dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until brown.

title: Party Dip
instructions: Mix and refrigerate. Goes well with chips and vegetables.

title: Cannelloni
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion. Add 1/2 jar spaghetti sauce 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and 1/2 cup American cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Cook noodles according to directions on package. Stuff noodles with meat mixture. Lay noodles in pan and cover with remaining spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix as given. Bake in greased loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Grilled Shrimp A La Waco
instructions: Cut bacon strips in half and wrapped peeled raw shrimp. Secure bacon with toothpicks. Place on grill for 15 to 20 minutes. Wrap jalapeno peppers with the shrimp to add some \spice.\

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Pull back husks to check condition of corn but leave silk in place. Leave 2 layers of husks on corn. Rotate 1/4 turn halfway through cooking on High power; 1 ear 2 to 3 minutes 2 ears 4 to 5 minutes 4 ears 6 to 7 minutes 6 ears 8 to 9 minutes 8 ears 10 to 12 minutes. If husks are removed paper towel is also a good steam holder.

title: Strawberries Romanoff
instructions: Combine sugar orange juice and rum and mix well. Pour over berries and refrigerate 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix together and let set overnight. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
instructions: Mix powdered sugar peanut butter and cereal together. Form into 1-inch balls. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip balls in chocolate.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat onions and seasonings. Add sauce and cook 20 minutes. Layer Doritos meat and cheese. Heat in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Pineapple Tea
instructions: Combine tea and sugar. Add boiling water to dissolve. Add pineapple juice water and lemon juice; chill tea. Pour 1/4-inch water into each section of 2 ice cube trays; freeze until firm. Place a cherry in the center of each cube in 1 tray; repeat with pineaple chunks in other tray. Pour 1/4-inch water over fruit. Freeze until firm. Fill sections with additional water and freeze until firm (freezing in stages prevents fruit from floating to top of cube). Serve tea over fruited cubes; garnish with mint sprigs if desired. Yields 17 cups.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Place cocoa and baking soda in separate cups and mix each with a little hot water. In a large bowl combine sugar shortening and eggs. Mix well. Add buttermilk cocoa and baking soda mixture. Add vanilla. Mix in flour until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Spicy Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill in refrigerator for several hours before serving.

title: Oh No, They'Re-Staying-For-Lunch Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken 1/2 of stuffing soup broccoli and sour cream in greased casserole. Mix thoroughly. Cover with rest of stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: In a large saucepan mix sugar salt and cornstarch; stir in vinegar. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Add butter onions and beets. Heat for 20 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix together and fry in oil.

title: Hamburger Yum Yum Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Add soups. Blend rice celery and water. Mix together and put in greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Add noodles last twenty minutes (either on top or stir in).

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Thaw potatoes slightly. Melt 1/4 cup margarine and mix with potatoes. Mix other 1/4 cup margarine with corn flakes. Mix remaining ingredients with potatoes. Top with corn flake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Dietetic Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender; cool slightly. Mash until smooth; stir in rest of ingredients including syrup from pineapple tidbits. Return to stove and reheat.

title: Fried Dry Pea Patties
instructions: Mash cooked peas; add eggs salt pepper onions and flour. Pour oil in skillet and heat to medium-high heat. Drop mixture by tablespoon into hot oil. Brown on both sides. Each serving contains 99 calories (47% fat).

title: Grandmother Hillhouse'S Funny Tasting Salad
instructions: Mix the first 2 ingredients together. Stir until jello dissolves completely. Chill until syrupy. Add next 3 ingredients. Chill until almost set. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Chill. Makes 6 to 8 cups.

title: Springtime Potato Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine potatoes celery eggs pickles onion and radishes. In another bowl combine mayonnaise sugar vinegar milk mustard and salt. Mix well. Pour over potato mixture; stir to coat. Chill. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Add apples flour baking soda and spices. Mix all in a bowl. Electric mixer not needed. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 loaves or Bundt cake.

title: Lemon-Thyme Pesto
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients in food processor gradually adding the olive oil. Process until smooth. If pesto is dry add more oil by spoonfuls. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Terrific over shrimp pasta or salad.

title: Quick Chicken And Rice
instructions: In a saucepan combine the soups and milk. Heat thoroughly. Add rice and pour in a lightly greased baking dish. Top with chicken and sprinkle with onion soup mix. Cover and bake 2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Easy New England Clam Chowder
instructions: In large saucepan cook and stir the bacon and onion until the bacon is crisp and onion is tender. Stir in soup and milk. Heat through stirring occasionally. Stir in clams and liquor lemon juice and pepper. Heat through. Serve with saltines. Serves 4.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Combine and mix well. Pour into unbaked pie crust and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spam And Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Melt margarine in a saucepan and add tomato sauce onion salt paprika and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add Spam and 3/4 cup of the cheese. Heat until cheese melts. Stir in cooked drained macaroni. Pour into a 2-quart pan or dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Night before Butter angel food cake pan. Dump in frozen rolls. Blend dry pudding brown sugar cinnamon and nuts. Scatter over dough. Cut butter into pats and arrange over top of pan. Cover with foil and leave on counter overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Candy(Tastes Like Reese'S Cups)
instructions: Melt margarine; mix all ingredients together except chocolate chips. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread on top. Chill; cut into squares.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Put beans through colander. Add enough mayonnaise for desired consistency. Add jalapeno pepper garlic salt Tabasco sauce and Worcestershire sauce to taste.

title: Old South Sweet Potatoes With Caramel Sauce
instructions: After creaming\tpotatoes add sugar vanilla and cream. Put in greased casserole dish make a well in the center and sprinkle with pecans. Bake\tat 350\u00b0 until hot and just before serving pour sauce over filling the well.

title: Creamed Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on package. Drain and chop. Cream together cream cheese and mushroom soup in large mixing bowl. Add spinach and cracker crumbs. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Chicken Salad
instructions: Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Midwestern Barbecue (Crock-Pot)
instructions: Put half of onions in crock-pot then add meat cloves water and remaining onions. Cover and cook overnight or 8 to 12 hours on low. Remove bone and fat from meat; drain. Put meat back into crock-pot. Add chopped onion and barbecue sauce. Cover and cook additional 1 to 3 hours on high or 4 to 8 hours on low stirring 2 or 3 times. Serve on large buns.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage brown and drain. Line a greased 13 x 9-inch pan with rolls and mash. Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine other ingredients and beat well. Pour over rolls. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes and let stand 5 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into fourths. Mix sugar and cinnamon in bag. Shake biscuits in mixture. Melt brown sugar and margarine and let boil 1 minute.

title: Ting-A-Lings Candy
instructions: Cream together the margarine eggs sugar and flavoring. Sift the flour include the baking powder. Sift one more time. Gradually add flour to margarine eggs and sugar. Mix. Add milk a little at a time. Add raisins. Grease a Bundt cake pan very well. Dust with flour all around. Shake out any excess flour. Add mix to pan slowly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Insert a toothpick to make sure it is baked through. Let the cake cool in the pan for 15 minutes on a rack! Then invert the pan and put cake on plate. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar. Makes 16 slices.

title: Pineapple Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix cake and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan as directed; cool.

title: Recipe For Happiness
instructions: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly. Add tears of sorrow and sympathy. Flavor with gifts of love. After pouring all this in your daily life fold in 4 cups of prayer. Serve with a smile at any time and it will satisfy the hunger of starved souls.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Add pineapple juice pineapple and lemonade. Mix and chill. Before serving add bananas and ginger ale.

title: Tacos
instructions: Scramble hamburg until brown. Drain off fat. Add onion taco seasoning and taco sauce. Mix and simmer for 15 minutes. Heat shells in oven at 200\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until soft. Fill shells with mixture.

title: Chocolate Almond Gateau
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt over hot (not boiling) water 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate morsels; stir until smooth. Set aside. In a large bowl combine sugar and butter; beat until creamy. Beat in melted morsels egg yolks vanilla and salt. Gradually add flour and milk; beat well. Stir in almonds.

title: Holiday Eggnog
instructions: Combine eggs milk vanilla and salt until thoroughly blended. Gradually beat in milk. Gently fold in whipped cream. Pour in a punch bowl and sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift flour soda spices and salt. Set aside. Mix other ingredients together and add the dry ingredients. Pour into 2 coffee cans bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Grandma Erickson'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Melt butter or margarine. Add sugars. Beat eggs and add to butter and sugar along with vanilla. Add dry ingredients followed by chocolate chips and walnuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until light brown. Makes about 4 dozen medium sized cookies.

title: Beef And Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain cooked squash. Brown ground beef and onion. Add to cooked rice. Season with salt and pepper. Make a sauce with milk margarine flour and one cup of the grated cheese. Mix the sauce with the squash and meat mixture. Place in casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt butter peanut butter and chips in large pan. Add Crispix cereal. Mix well. Put in large plastic bags and add confectioners sugar. Shake well to coat. Pour on cookie sheet to dry.

title: Tuna Noodle Bake
instructions: Blend butter and flour in heavy saucepan. Stir in milk gradually. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Stir in salt Tabasco Worcestershire onion and cheese. Cook until cheese melts. Layer broccoli and tuna in buttered casserole dish. Spoon cheese sauce over top. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Per serving 380 calories 20 g. protein 13.4 g. carbohydrates 83.3 mg cholesterol 423 mg potassium 27.9 g. fat and 929.3 mg sodium.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix sugar vegetable oil eggs and pumpkin together. Sift and add all other ingredients. Add nuts and raisins if desired. Pour into two greased and floured loaf pans or one Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fiesta Dip
instructions: Spread beans with chilies on serving plate. Mix together sour cream and taco seasoning; spread on top of beans. Mash up avocados and mix with seasoned salt garlic salt and lemon juice. Spread on top. Chill several hours. Garnish with sliced olives shredded cheese chopped green onions and chopped tomatoes. Serve with chips.

title: Egg-Sausage Casserole
instructions: In a skillet cook sausage until browned; drain off fat. In a saucepan melt the 1/4 cup margarine. Stir in flour and salt. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir in cooked sausage sliced eggs and drained corn. Pour mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Toss bread crumbs with melted margarine; sprinkle atop casserole. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: E-Z Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix thoroughly the dry ingredients then add vanilla butter and milk. Boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add jar of Marshmallow Creme and jar of peanut butter; mix thoroughly. Pour at once into a greased 8 1/2 x 13-inch pan.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and mix. Add eggs one at a time mixing after each one. Add milk. Crush wafers and add mixing well. Add pecans and coconut; mix well. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool completely before removing from pan.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix the ingredients and serve. (Do not add chips ground beef and dressing until serving time.)

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream and mix first 4 ingredients using egg yolks only. Add extract and at low speed beat in flour and milk alternately. Add coconut. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour in greased tube pan. Bake 2 hours at 300\u00b0. Cool 15 minutes in pan before removing. Sprinkle with 4x sugar or ice if desired.

title: One Bowl Rocky Road Brownies
instructions: Microwave chocolate and butter in large bowl until butter is melted approximately 2 minutes. Stir until chocolate is completely melted.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Bring margarine to room temperature and beat well. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla and beat thoroughly. Fold in flour and beat well. Roll in 1-inch balls and bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle liberally with powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain. Stir in cream of mushroom soup tuna salt and pepper. Heat on stove until well mixed and hot. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Serve.

title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Brittle
instructions: Melt sugar in a heavy skillet (iron works better). Stir constantly until melted. Stir in butter baking soda vanilla and peanuts. Pour onto a large buttered platter quickly and spread with forks to the thickness desired. It is very hot and thickens very fast. Let cool and then break up into pieces.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Cheez-Its crackers and oleo; spread in flat Pyrex dish. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Top with Cheez-Its crackers. Pour melted oleo over. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shells And Sauce
instructions: In large pan pour olive oil and onion; simmer. Add ground beef and sausage (brown). Add tomato puree and tomato paste. Cook about 2 hours on low heat covered. Cook shells as directed. Drain; rinse with cold water. In a large baking dish alternate layers of sauce cheese and shells. Cover bottom of pan with sauce first. End with sauce on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Summertime Potato Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise mustard dill weed salt and pepper to taste. Combine with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: *You may add more caramel extract to taste.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Brown beef lightly in butter. Add vegetables and seasoning. Cook about 5 minutes in wok or heavy skillet. Drain and cool. Place a heaping tablespoonful in middle of wrap. Spread to half of roll. Roll according to package. Deep fry until lightly golden brown (2 to 3 minutes). Serve with favorite seafood sauce (sweet and sour).

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 4 minutes. Do not boil hard. Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Mix well and drop onto wax paper by teaspoon. Cool 1 hour. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Quick Potato Soup
instructions: Bring hash browns onions chicken broth and water to a boil; heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in soups and milk and heat thoroughly. Garnish with cheddar cheese or cooked ham or bacon. Makes a crock pot full.

title: Baked Rice Dressing
instructions: Mix ground meat with the raw rice. Add onion bell pepper celery onion tops and parsley. Mix in soups and season with red and black pepper. Put into heavy casserole dish with close fitting cover in order to retain all the juice. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Tortilla Fingers(Appetizer)
instructions: Blend all ingredients except tortillas with a mixer or food processor until smooth. Spread mixture on tortillas and roll up. I usually cover and chill overnight. Cut into one-inch pieces. Serve with picante sauce.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Scald milk. Add margarine. Add to bread cubes. Add raisins. Beat eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Mix together with milk and margarine.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into loaf pan. Let rise 15 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Skillet Barbecue Chicken
instructions: In skillet saute chicken in oil. Add barbecue sauce 1 1/2 cups water and corn. Bring to boil. Stir in rice. Remove from heat. Let set 5 minutes. Stir. Salt to taste. Can add more barbecue sauce if needed.

title: White Chocolate Party Mix
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside. Heat chips and oil on Medium-high for 2 minutes in microwave. Stir once then microwave on High for 10 seconds and stir. Pour over cereal; mix and stir until smooth. Spread on three waxed paper lined baking sheets. Cool. Break apart. Store in airtight container.

title: Festive Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. Add cranberry sauce and pineapple with juice. Mix well and mold.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Mix eggs and\t1 cup sugar. Add pumpkin lemon juice salt nutmeg and cinnamon. When smooth beat in 3/4 cup flour and 1 teaspoon baking powder.

title: Coney Island Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Fry ground beef and onion until brown. Let cool. Put in blender until fine. Then add ketchup tomato sauce salt pepper mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Combine and simmer 1 hour. Can be frozen for later use.

title: Baked Chicken With Sauce
instructions: Dip chicken in 1/2 cup buttermilk. Then roll in flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Melt butter in 13x9x2 inch pan. Put chicken in pan skin side down and bake uncovered at 400 degrees for 30 minutes. Turn chicken and bake another 15 minutes. Blend remaining buttermilk and soup; pour over chicken. Bake 15 minutes more or until tender.

title: Rice Pilau
instructions: In heavy skillet heat and stir sugar until it browns and melts being careful not to let it burn. Add chicken turning to coat with melted sugar. Brown slightly. Add rice onion and seasoning stirring a little. Add water to cover. Simmer uncovered until rice is cooked adding water as needed. Let boil dry at the end. Serves 4.

title: Sweet And Sour Vegetables
instructions: In wok or large skillet heat oil and stir-fry carrots pea pods green pepper and onion until tender about 4 to 5 minutes. Add tomato water chestnuts and cucumbers slices and cook a few minutes.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Peel the avocado. Cut avocado into cubes about 3 cups. Put the avocado into a mixing bowl and cut it back and forth with a knife to make a coarse mixture. Add the other ingredients. Chill.

title: Caramel Pudding
instructions: Caramel together butter cream and sugar until real dark; turn off heat and add 5 quarts milk. Let caramel melt. Add remaining ingredients. Cook like cornstarch.

title: Lush Cake
instructions: Cut margarine into flour until it is like pie crust mixture. Add nuts and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Set aside to cool. Blend 1 cup sugar in cream cheese which has been at room temperature. Blend in Cool Whip and mix with electric mixer until well blended. Spread cream cheese mixture over cooled crust. Mix instant pudding and milk and beat until thick. Add on top of cheese layer. Chill 2 hours. Cut in squares.

title: Carrots Au Gratin
instructions: Cook carrots and onion in boiling salted water for 15 minutes. Drain reserving 2 cups of cooking water. Melt 2 tablespoons butter. Blend in flour; gradually add cooking water stirring until thick and smooth. Let boil for 2 minutes; remove from heat. Stir in cheese until melted. Arrange vegetables in casserole. Pour sauce over vegetables. Cover with bread crumbs. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lori'S Sauerbraten
instructions: Bring vinegar water spices salt and sugar to boil. Cool. Pour over uncooked meat and let it stand in covered plastic or crock-pot in refrigerator for 4 to 5 days.

title: Tostones(Fried Green Plantains)
instructions: To remove the skin form the plantain cut tips at both ends cut a slit along the length of the plantain and peel off. To facilitate easier handling some cooks dip plantains in hot water for 5 minutes and then remove the skin. Once plantains are peeled cut into diagonal slices about 1-inch thick. Reserve peels typically the unbroken skin of the plantain is used for flattening the tostones.

title: Favorite Banana Bread
instructions: Combine the cream cheese sugar and margarine mixing until well blended. Blend in banana and eggs. Add combined remaining ingredients mixing until just moistened. Pour into greased and floured (9 x 5-inch) baking loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until wooden toothpick comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Recipe For A Happy Day
instructions: Measure words carefully. Add heaping cups of understanding. Use generous amounts of time and patience. Cook with gas on the front burner. Keep temperature low; do not boil. Add dash of humor and a pinch of warm personality. Serve individually.

title: Baked Swordfish
instructions: Mix last four ingredients well. Marinate fish 1/2 hour in refrigerator. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 6 to 8 minutes per 1/2 inch. Baste halfway through with remaining marinade. No need to turn fish.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Blend oleo molasses sugar and eggs. Beat well. Sift together and add the rest of the ingredients to the oleo mixture. Refrigerate the dough for several hours. Make off into small balls; roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm or brown about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Fry hamburger. Drain. Add marinara sauce. Heat to a boil. In Pyrex dish layer sauce noodles (do not boil noodles) cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese and sauce. Repeat 3 layers. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream confectioners sugar and cream cheese in a mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add pudding mix and milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Sprinkle 1/2 the crushed Oreos on top.

title: Rural Salad
instructions: Peel tomatoes if desired and slice thinly. With tines of fork score cucumbers lengthwise and slice thinly. In shallow bowl arrange layers of tomatoes and cucumbers; sprinkle with cheese and olives. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over all. Chill before serving. If a tangier dressing is desired add 2 to 4 teaspoons of lemon juice or wine vinegar to the oil basil and pepper mixture. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sandra'S Rolled Sugar Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Stir together flour baking powder and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Beat butter and shortening for 30 seconds; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add egg milk and vanilla; beat well. Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture beating until well combined. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Working with 1/2 of the dough at a time on a lightly floured surface roll to 1/8-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes or until done. Makes 36 to 48. Dough can be frozen and used later.

title: Brocc-Cheese-Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute the onion green pepper and celery in margarine until tender. Add soup cheese and broccoli. Add rice and mix well. Place in 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. (Add mushrooms if you wish.)

title: Green Beans Supreme
instructions: Simmer onion slices in 1/4 cup of the butter until clear but not brown. Arrange half of\tthe beans that have been drained in bottom of buttered casserole dish. Spread half of mushroom soup and onions on top of beans then fill with remaining beans onions and soup. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Brown bread crumbs in rest of butter and spread on top of the casserole.\tBake 10 more minutes until crumbs are hot and slightly browned.

title: Snappy Tomatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and bake in a casserole for 35 minutes. Serves 4 to 6. Easy but very good.

title: Currant Cakes
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and chill overnight. Divide dough into 3 parts. Roll each out thicker than pie crust into a rectangle. Sprinkle sugar cinnamon and 1/3 box currants across each piece of dough then dot each roll with butter. Roll like a jelly roll. Flatten a little across top of roll with rolling pin. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Do not grease pan.

title: Pasta Sauce With Hamburger(4 To 6 Servings)
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add remaining ingredients bring to boil and simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti as per package instructions.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix vanilla buttermilk coloring margarine and eggs. Blend until moist. Add soda and vinegar. Beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Bake in two 9-inch greased and floured pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Frost with your favorite cream cheese frosting.

title: Heritage Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa on low until smooth and thickened. Pour into small bowl and cool. Add vanilla. Add sugar and milk alternately until desired consistency.

title: Cherry Cheese Cream Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk; stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into shell and chill for 3 hours.

title: Coconut Pie Surprises
instructions: Combine milk sugar Bisquick and margarine in blender for 3 minutes. Pour into greased pie pan; let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Leave in oven for 5 minutes longer. Remove and let cool.

title: Easy Fajitas(Fa-He-Tas)
instructions: Cut meat into cube-size pieces. Cook in large skillet (or wok) in oil with garlic and all spices about 10 minutes. Add bell pepper and onion. Cover and let cook about 10 minutes. Add tomatoes and salsa. Cover and let cook until meat and all veggies are tender (another 5 to 10 minutes). Stir occasionally. Serve with warm tortillas sour cream and salsa.

title: Ranch-Style Chicken
instructions: Mix soup broth chili powder and peppers together; simmer until hot and soup is completely melted. Add deboned chicken. Place Doritos chips in casserole dish and pour mixture over chips. Top with cheese and bake in oven until cheese melts. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and tear from bone. Mix soups milk and sour cream. Mix butter and broth separate. Put half of the stuffing mix and cover bottom of 9 x 12 pan. Pour a little melted butter and broth over it then take half of the chicken and put over dressing then a layer of soups milk sour cream ingredients. Keep layering until used all and last use remaining of dressing mix. Pour over remaining broth and butter. Put in oven with cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Make taco mix according to package. Layer in casserole bowl the ground beef Ro-Tel sour cream and chili beans. Shred or slice cheese to cover top and add chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until casserole is bubbly. Serve with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Chop onion and tomato into tiny pieces and set aside. Scoop the insides of the avocado into a bowl keeping one pit aside.

title: Western Brunch
instructions: Pour over filling; let stand 12 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch thick slices. Arrange cookie slices on lightly greased baking pan beginning 1/4 inch from groove of pan. Continue to arrange in circular pattern slightly overlapping. Press lightly together to seal. Place baking pan in oven. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Crust is done when edges just begin to brown; top of crust will not be browned.

title: Hawaiian Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream butter or oleo. Add sugar eggs and flour. Mix well. Add pineapple and coconut. Drop by teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until edges start to turn brown.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill several hours or overnight before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breaded Pork Chops
instructions: Add salt and pepper to bread crumbs. Beat egg and add milk. Dip chops in liquid and roll in crumbs. Put 3 tablespoons of fat into skillet and brown chops. Place chops in a baking pan or dish and add boiling water. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 more minutes.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix coconut sugar flour and salt. Stir in egg whites and almond extract. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Will not spread while baking. Bake for 20 minutes or until edges are golden. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Makes 18 cookies.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix flour cocoa and soda; set aside. Melt butter in saucepan; stir in sugar. Remove from heat. Add milk vinegar and vanilla; stir. Add dry ingredients; whisk until well blended. Pour into 2 (8-inch) round pans or 1 (10-inch) square pan. Bake about 20 minutes. Cool; frost with Coconut Pecan Icing.

title: Rice Krispies Crust
instructions: Mix ingredients and press into a 9-inch pie pan. Freeze. Fill with ice cream or chocolate mousse.

title: Berliner Kranse
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar well. Mix all egg yolks until smooth. A small amount of egg white may be added to egg yolk mixture. Add the egg mixture to the sugar and butter and blend well. Add the flour gradually as you may not need the full amount and you dont want the dough too stiff or it will not roll out well. Work the flour into your cookie mixture with your hands. They work better than a spoon. Take a small portion of dough and roll it into the size and length of a pencil. Cross one end over the other end of dough to form a wreath. Dip the wreath into raw egg white and then into sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until golden or lightly browned.

title: Hershey Brownies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar; add eggs chocolate flour and nuts. Beat well. Bake in jelly roll pan for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Candy Korn
instructions: Remove all the unpopped kernels from the bowl. Mix sugar syrup and butter. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly to 212\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until light caramel color or 290\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Pour over corn and nuts. Toss with 2 spoons until corn is dry. Break apart and spread on aluminum foil.

title: Vegetable Quiche
instructions: In a bowl combine rice 1/4 cup egg substitute and half of the cheese; mix well. Pat into the bottom and up sides of a 9 inch pie plate coated with non stick cooking spray set aside. In another bowl combine broccoli mushrooms milk margarine and remaining egg substitute. Pour into crust. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Return to the oven until cheese melts. Yield 8 servings.

title: Val'S Frozen Daiquiris
instructions: Combine and mix in blender. Mix with crushed ice (12 ice cubes). May add 1 package frozen strawberries.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a square 8-inch baking dish. Cook and stir ground beef until brown. Stir sour cream mayo cheese and onion; set aside. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms. Pat in pan pressing dough 1/2-inch up sides. Layer beef tomatoes and green peppers in pan. Spoon sour cream mixture over top. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Trim crust from 6 slices of bread. Butter bread and cut into strips. Line large casserole dish with bread. Brown 1 lb. sausage. Drain well on paper towel. Spread over bread. Grate cheese sprinkle over sausage. Beat eggs with milk salt pepper and dry mustard. Pour over sausage mixture. Let sit in refrigerator 8 hours at least before cooking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can be frozen after setting for 8 hours. before cooking.

title: Aunt Chris' Two Layer Cheesecake
instructions: Mix and line pan and sides.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a medium bowl. Dip zucchini in batter to coat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar and syrup. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients mixing well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Friendship Cake
instructions: Cream greeting and smiles thoroughly. Add handshakes separately; add love slowly. Sift in hospitality and fold in interest in others carefully. Bake in a moderate oven; serve warm to all new acquaintances.

title: Potato Supreme
instructions: Cook unpeeled potatoes in water in saucepan covered. Simmer until tender. Drain water and cool potatoes. Peel and coarsely shred. Mix cheese and melted margarine. Add potatoes and mix. Add onions and season with salt and pepper. Fold in sour cream. Pour into a greased baking dish and sprinkle with paprika. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. (May be made ahead and frozen before baking.) When ready to use remove from the freezer thawed and baked as directed.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Funnel Cake
instructions: In a small bowl whisk eggs to frothy. Gradually beat in milk. Add flour sugar baking powder and salt. Beat smooth. Put 1-inch of oil in large skillet and heat. Put part of batter in a funnel holding the bottom with finger. Then hold over the oil and make a lacy pattern starting in center. Fry until golden brown. Remove and drain on paper towels or brown paper. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve immediately while warm.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust for 1-crust pie; use to line 9-inch pie pan. Make high stand-up edge. Set aside. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed beat pumpkin evaporated milk eggs sugar cinnamon ginger and salt. Pour pumpkin mixture evenly into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake about 45 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack about 1 1/2 hours before serving.

title: Creamed Dried Beef(Breakfast)
instructions: Melt butter in a large frypan. Add beef. Saute for about 5 minutes on medium heat. Add flour and mix. Slowly add half and half soup and chicken broth. Salt and pepper to taste. If mixture is too thick add some more half and half. Heat through. Serve over toasted English muffins for breakfast. Very good over baked potatoes for dinner.

title: Sunny Mom'S Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into lightly greased casserole(s). Bake at 400\u00b0 about 1 hour until hot and bubbly. Serve with tossed salad and garlic bread. Makes enough for 2 meals for small family or 1 meal for large family. Freezes well.

title: Cheese Fondue
instructions: Scald milk; add butter cheese salt and pepper and mix well. Turn oven to 350\u00b0. Separate eggs; beat whites and yolks until thick. Slowly add yolks to cheese sauce and fold in egg whites and bread crumbs. Pour into ungreased baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Follow directions for stuffing mix. Add cream of mushroom soup and water to mix. Layer the pork chops in 9 x 13 pan. Top with stuffing mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Little Sausages
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except Smok-Y-Links) over medium heat in saucepan until well mixed. Cut Smok-Y-Links into fourths. Pour sauce and Smok-Y-Links into bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Put in crock-pot on low until hot. (Can use fondue pot on low.)

title: Rice-A-Roni Medley
instructions: Stir-fry sirloin strips in oil until cooked. Set aside. Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to package directions along with the rice water mushrooms and soy sauce. When the Rice-A-Roni is cooked add the meat and whatever cooked vegetables you like. Reheat until meat and vegetables are warmed. Sprinkle with chow mein noodles.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Let all ingredients except chicken come to a boil. Add chicken and pour into 3-quart casserole dish lined with crust. Put top crust on and bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Left Over Turkey Casserole
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cube in 1/3 cup hot water. Add to rest of ingredients and mix well. Bake in a 2-quart casserole dish (uncovered) for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Stir once or twice.

title: Banana Orange Nutmeg Bread
instructions: Mix juice and bananas. Cream margarine and sugar; add egg and banana mix. Stir in flour nutmeg baking powder and soda. Stir in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes in well-greased loaf pan.

title: Strawberry Whipped Cream Pie
instructions: Combine crackers egg whites and vanilla. Press into a greased pie plate and cook at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Let cool.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add oil milk and eggs. Then add prunes and vanilla. Add nuts. Beat 2 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Place all ingredients in a casserole dish; do not blend together until after cooking in microwave for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes in the microwave mix well. Add nuts place on waxed paper and place in the freezer for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 2 round cake pans according to directions. Cool and refrigerate to chill. Cut 1 layer into small pieces and place in punch bowl. Mix pudding according to package. Spread 1/2 pudding on top of cake. Add 1/2 berries; layer 1/2 of pineapple (drained) on top and add 1 sliced banana. Repeat with other cake layer ending with whipped topping. Chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle 1/2 of the pecans in a 10-inch Bundt pan sprayed with Pam; set aside. Combine sugar and cinnamon mixture. Cut each biscuit in half; roll each one in sugar-cinnamon mixture. Layer in the pan. Put other half of pecans on top. Combine brown sugar into melted margarine. (Boil 1 minute.) Pour over top of the raw biscuits. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in the pan then invert onto a platter. Serve warm.

title: Non-Alcoholic Sangria
instructions: Stir first 3 ingredients in a non-aluminum 4-quart bowl. Add fruit and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate. Makes 10 cups.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown ground meat onion celery garlic mushrooms and salt together. Drain grease off. Place creamed corn and any other vegetables desired in the bottom of a casserole dish. Add the ground meat mixture as the next layer. Spoon the mashed potatoes on as the last layer. Sprinkle with salt pepper parsley flakes chives and dot with butter. Bake until brown approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pistachio Pudding And Cool Whip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Refrigerate at least 24 hours.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and drop by spoonfuls on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 350 degrees. Serve warm.

title: French Toast Sandwiches
instructions: Slice bread 1/2-inch thick then butter. Make sandwiches. Dip in batter; fry until brown in oil.

title: Pumpkin Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Fold in 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or pecans. Pour into well-greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add onion seasonings and rice stirring constantly until rice is slightly browned. Pour rice into large casserole which has been sprayed with Pam. Cook chicken in saucepan until almost done then place it on top of rice. Add broth plus enough water to equal 2 cups. Cover and bake 20 to 30 minutes or until broth is absorbed.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix other ingredients and pour in pan over oleo. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Baby Orange Cakes
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions on package. Place well-greased paper cup (hot drink cups) on a baking sheet. Spoon in batter filling cups 1/2 full. Bake in a moderate oven about 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Brown first three ingredients. Add all other ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lazy Cobbler
instructions: Use whatever kind of fruit you choose or fresh fruit sweetened to your liking equal to 1 large can. Melt oleo in 9 x 12-inch baking pan or dish. Bring fruit to a boil. Mix ingredients. Pour over melted oleo. Pour hot fruit on next. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown or how you like it.

title: Christmas Eve Punch
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; chill. To serve add ginger ale stirring well. Yield About 4 1/2 quarts.

title: Eggnog Bread
instructions: Combine margarine sugar and eggs. Mix well. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Stir into butter alternately with eggnog mixing only until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in pecans raisins and cherries. Spoon into greased (with Pam) 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 minutes or until bread tests done.

title: Butterhorn Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dissolve yeast in 1 tablespoon warm water. Add other ingredients. Knead down and let rise once. Divide dough into 3 balls. Roll round and thin as pie crust. Spread with butter; cut as pie. Roll each piece starting from outer edge to point. Place far enough apart on pan so as not to touch when they rise. Let rise. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Brush with butter when removed from oven.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs and beat well. In a separate bowl combine flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. In yet another bowl combine pumpkin and milk. Add flour mixture and pumpkin mixture alternately to creamed mixture beating well after each addition. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Makes about 2 dozen. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: If using chopped ham add chopped green pepper and onion to taste. If using bacon crumble and add chopped mushrooms. Sprinkle over bottom of greased quiche dish or pie plate.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Chill 6 hours or overnight; mix before serving.

title: Old Fashion Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Add flour and milk to creamed mixture mixing well. Add flavorings and mix well. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour or until pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Reuben Balls
instructions: Mix corned beef sauerkraut (after well drained) and cream cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Roll mixture into walnut size balls. Dip balls into beaten eggs and roll in bread crumbs. Deep fry until golden brown. Put on paper towel to drip. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Best Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients; beat thoroughly. Pack into a loaf pan. Pour one 8 ounce can tomato sauce over all and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lynn Swann Cake
instructions: In Bundt pan mix cake mix and pudding dry. Fold in sour cream eggs oil and water. Add chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Barbara Bush'S Zucchini Soup
instructions: Chop unpeeled zucchini shallots and garlic. Melt butter or margarine in a heavy frying pan. Add chopped vegetables. Cook for 10 to 20 minutes (stir to keep from burning; you dont want it to brown). Put all ingredients except for table cream into blender and blend. Add table cream and blend.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Combine bacon drippings and flour in a large Dutch oven; cook over medium heat stirring constantly 10 to 15 minutes or until roux is the color of copper penny. Stir in onion celery and garlic; cook 5 minutes uncovered stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes tomato sauce water salt and pepper. Simmer over medium heat for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Add shrimp crabmeat and okra. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add oysters if desired and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice. Yields 4 1/2 quarts.

title: It'S A Mad Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour pineapple with juice in pan then sprinkle dry cake mix over pineapple. Sprinkle pecans over cake mixture. Melt butter or margarine and pour over pecans. Bake for 50 minutes. Cherry pie filling or apple pie filling may be substituted for crushed pineapple.

title: Pizza Waffles
instructions: Mix tomato sauce cheese 1 teaspoon oregano and 1/4 cup of water in 1-quart saucepan. Heat over medium heat stirring constantly until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly.

title: Blueberry Smoothie
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender. Blend for about 1 minute. Makes 1 large glass.

title: Grasshopper Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown or until knife comes out clean.

title: Copper Penny Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender. In a deep bowl arrange layers of carrots onion and pepper. Combine remaining ingredients in pan and bring to a boil stirring until well blended. Pour over carrots and refrigerate overnight.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on package. Melt margarine. Add onions and broccoli until broccoli is thawed. Remove from heat. Add rice cheese soup and milk; mix well. Cook 1 hour at 250\u00b0 covered.

title: Cranberry Salad(Easy)
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add other ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour into desired container and congeal.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: In small bowl combine cream cheese powdered sugar and margarine. Mix well. Add Cool Whip and mix well. In larger bowl combine pudding milk and vanilla; mix until thickened. Add cream cheese mixture to the pudding mixture. Crush cookies and spread half the bag on the bottom of 13 x 9 baking dish. Spread evenly. Spoon mixture on top of the Oreos and spread evenly carefully not mixing cookies into the pudding mixture. Top with remaining crushed Oreos. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Must be kept refrigerated.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Heat tomato soup. Soften Knox gelatine in hot water. Pour soup and gelatine into bowl and add mayonnaise and softened cream cheese. Mix well with electric mixer. Add diced vegetables and shrimp. Stir well and pour into bowl or mold. Chill 3 hours.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put can of cherries in bottom of rectangular cake pan and even out. Drain pineapple juice from can. Put pineapple evenly on top of cherries. Dump cake mix (dry) on top. Even out. Place pads of butter all over the top about every 2 inches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Old South Cucumber Lime Pickles
instructions: Mix pickling lime with water. Soak cucumbers for 24 hours stirring occasionally in lime water. Soak in crockery enamelware or plastic (not aluminum pans). Remove from lime water and rinse in 3 cool waters. Soak 3 additional hours in ice and water. Remove carefully to drain.

title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Allow chicken to bake for 10 minutes then flip and rotate chicken breasts. Season as desired and pour cooking wine over the breasts. Allow to cook for another 8 to 10 minutes or until done.

title: Tasty Baked Salmon
instructions: Drain salmon. Place in 9-inch pie dish. Pour sour cream over and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 450\u00b0 until cream becomes thick and has a few brown patches. Serve with lemon wedges. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Venison Pot Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper meat. Coat with flour. Brown meat and onion in fat. Add water. Cover and simmer for 3 hours. Add more water if necessary. Add potatoes and cook for 30 minutes or until potatoes and carrots are tender. Serves 6.

title: Hot Fruit Casserole
instructions: Drain fruit well. Mix in greased Pyrex dish except bananas. Heat sugar margarine and spices. Cool then add to fruit. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Add sliced bananas before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons brown sugar and nuts. Return to oven 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: White Chili(Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat until hot. Add onions and garlic; cook 20 minutes or until onions are golden; stir often. Add broth beans chilies jalapeno peppers lime juice cilantro oregano cumin and cinnamon; bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and cook 20 minutes. Add meat and cook 10 more minutes or until heated through. Top with cheese and tomatoes.

title: Peppers Stuffed With Corn
instructions: Cut stems off peppers and remove seeds then parboil for 2 minutes. Combine and fill peppers. Place in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Blend in Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and freeze for about 3 hours before serving.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients; pour into a well-greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Place sliced zucchini on top. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Potluck Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Put half of mixture in greased casserole dish. Add 1/2 cup grated cheese. Add rest of mixture. Top with grated cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Dessert
instructions: Make pudding according to directions on package. Put milk in bowl. Dip cookies in milk then put in bottom of rectangular pan to form a crust. Cover with pudding. Cover pudding with Cool Whip. Chill before serving.

title: Cauliflower Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients. Serve with fresh vegetables (pepper cucumber celery cauliflower etc.)

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion together. When tender drain. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Orange Glazed Carrots And Grapes
instructions: Cook carrots according to package directions omitting salt; set aside. Combine the brown sugar cornstarch ginger and salt in a saucepan. Gradually add orange juice stirring with a wire whisk until blended. Bring to a boil over medium heat; cook one minute stirring constantly. Add carrots and grapes; cook 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Ruthie'S Chicken And Ziti
instructions: In frypan saute scallion and garlic in olive oil (about 4 tablespoons). Cut chicken in big chunks and saute in separate pan oil and 1/2 cup chicken broth. Cook chicken until juice runs clear. Add scallion and garlic mixture broccoli and red pepper; cook until al dente. Serve hot with shredded Romano.

title: Kool-Aid Punch
instructions: When ready to serve add slowly the 7-Up or ginger ale. Mix in gallon jug as above. Then finish filling jug with water. Stir. Refrigerate. When ready to pour into punch bowl add 7-Up or ginger ale slow so as not to lose fizz.

title: Chicken Dish Elegante
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Put in oblong casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Carrot Nut Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon. Add sugar to corn oil beating well after each addition with an electric mixer at high speed. Beat eggs until very light. Gradually beat a little at a time into the oil-sugar mixture; continue beating until mixture is smooth and fluffy. Gradually stir in the sifted dry ingredients until thoroughly combined. Add the carrots nuts and pineapple. Mix well. Pour into two 9-inch round cake pans (oil and line bottom). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes. Cool on racks for 20 minutes before removing from pans. When cool frost with cream cheese icing.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Wash and clean peppers. Combine remaining ingredients except tomato soup and mix thoroughly. Fill pepper shells lightly with meat mixture. Place on rack in cooker; add soup. Pressure cook at 15 pounds pressure for 10 minutes. Reduce pressure. Serves 4.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together hamburg sausage pepper and salt. Do not overmix. Meat will get tough. Saute onion and pepper. Pour over meat. Mix eggs cracker crumbs and warm milk until moist. Pour over meat. Mix together. Do not overmix. Wet hands and roll loaf until slightly firm. Let stand 1 hour. Put foil in roaster and butter foil. Put 1 cup water in roaster (outside of foil). Put loaf in foil. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Uncover. Brown for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Cut each biscuit into fourths stir in jar of salsa. Pour into greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Cover with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Smothered Chicken
instructions: Cut up and deskin chicken. Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and half bake the chicken at 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix the soup and picante sauce. Blend until smooth. If mixture is thick add a little milk until you get a medium thickness. Drain grease off chicken and add mixture. Cook 30 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Lo-Fat Orange Broiled Chicken(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Wash and dry chicken breasts; place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine other ingredients; pour over chicken. Cover; refrigerate 2 hours basting occasionally. Drain reserving liquid. Broil chicken until crisp and brown; turn to brown on second side. Meanwhile heat marinade to serve hot over broiled chicken. Yield 6 servings.

title: Thom'S Tossed Salad
instructions: Tear leaves off lettuce and put in bowl. Quarter tomatoes and put in bowl with lettuce. Toss.

title: Buttermilk Hot Cakes
instructions: Beat eggs. Add buttermilk and soda; beat again. Add dry ingredients and beat well. Add melted shortening. Bake on heated griddle.

title: Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Blend the sugar salt and half of vinegar. Gradually add the oil beating constantly with electric mixer. Add remaining vinegar and celery seed. Chill. Excellent served over cut fruit such as apples pineapple bananas etc. Will keep in the refrigerator for days.

title: Pecan Delight Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add baking powder salt sugar and vanilla. Then add nuts and crackers. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes in a greased pan. Cover with whipped cream and place in refrigerator until served.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar alternate flour and buttermilk. Add eggs soda spices and cocoa. Add jam. Fold in raisins and nuts. Bake in layer pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Breaded Veal Chops
instructions: Pound chops well. Season with salt and pepper to taste then dust with flour. Dip chops in egg and then in bread crumbs. Fry in hot butter turning when brown. When done put chops in oven to stay warm.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients for crust. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix butter eggs powdered sugar and vanilla until creamy. Spread over cooled crust.
