Peel bananas dip in pineapple juice and layer on cake. Spread pineapple over bananas evenly. Frost with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix cornmeal sugar flour salt egg hot pepper or green onions and hot water. Drop 1 1/2-inch balls in oil (350\u00b0). Brown about 1 minute.

title: Zucchini With Cheese And Eggs(A Family Favorite)
instructions: Heat oil and add chives or onion; saute until golden. Add sliced zucchini turning frequently until tender. Add herbs to well beaten eggs and pour over zucchini. Cook very slowly over medium heat without stirring eggs until set. Sprinkle with cheese and slip under broiler to brown cheese lightly. Cut in wedges and serve very hot. (Chopped ham/bacon can be added to eggs.)

title: Old Fashioned Pumpkin Marmalade
instructions: Peel pumpkin and cut in small cubes discarding seeds and inner pulp. Add sugar and let stand overnight. Put lemons and orange through food grinder discarding seeds but reserving all juice. Add to pumpkin. Stir over low heat until boiling. Simmer until thick and clear about 3 hours. Stir frequently to prevent scorching. Pack in hot sterilized jars and process. Makes about 4 pints.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chop Suey Casserole
instructions: Brown meat onion and celery; cook slowly 20 minutes. Cook rice slowly in salted water; rinse in hot water 1 to 2 minutes then drain. Combine all ingredients plus 1/2 soup can water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Overnight Breakfast Sausage Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage; drain and\tcrumble. Butter 13 x 9-inch pan. Tear white bread into bite-size pieces and layer in pan. Layer sausage over bread. Combine mustard milk and eggs. Pour over sausage. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Combine cream of mushroom soup and\tmilk. Pour over casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Let set 15 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Beat egg and add sifted flour baking powder and salt. Add enough milk to make batter. Peel a few apples and core the center. Slice crosswise about 1/4-inch thick. Dip in the batter and fry slow in an aluminum skillet. Iron will get too hot and apples must be cooked soft pretty fast. Cover to get done. Uncover to crisp. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Eat hot!

title: Slop Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed in 2 (9-inch) round pans. Cool. Prepare pudding as directed on package. In large bowl or lid of Tupperware cake cover break up 1 cake layer with 1/2 of the pudding 1/2 of the Cool Whip and 1 Heath bar repeat and refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine shortening peanut butter brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Add egg. Beat just until blended. Combine flour and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed. Mix just until blended. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Flatten slightly in crisscross pattern with tines of fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes or until set and just beginning to brown. Do not overbake. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Remove cookies to cool completely.

title: Party Cheese Log
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Shape into log and roll in crushed pecans.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Heat and stir sugar water and syrup in saucepan. Cook over medium heat to soft ball stage (235\u00b0). Add nuts and salt. Cook to hard crack stage (305\u00b0) stirring often. Remove from heat; quickly stir in butter and soda. Pour immediately into 2 well buttered 9-inch pans. Spread with spatula. Break into pieces when cool. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Franks-N-Beans
instructions: Fry cut-up wieners and add all ingredients; simmer 20 minutes. Pour in a baking dish and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 in oven until cheese is bubbly.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump pineapple in 8 1/2 x 11-inch ungreased pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over pineapple. Slice butter evenly over cake mix; sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring first 4 ingredients to a boil. Add butter. Boil until soft ball. Add vanilla. Add peanut butter. Stir and pour in buttered pan.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put Ritz crackers over it. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press croissant dough into large 12 x 16-inch pan. Cook as directed per croissant package and cool. Mix room temperature cream cheese with dressing mix and mayonnaise. Spread over cooled crust. Top with vegetables (ex. broccoli cauliflower red and green pepper carrots green onion celery Cheddar cheese or olives).

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Skillet Franks And Apple Kraut
instructions: Slice franks crosswise 8 times cutting 3/4 of the way through. In large skillet fry franks in butter until slightly browned and curved. Remove and reserve. Add onion rings to butter in skillet. Saute until transparent. Add applesauce water and bouillon cube. Simmer stirring until cube dissolves. Add sauerkraut and celery seed. Mix well. Arrange franks on top of mixture and cover. Simmer 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Combine the flour soda and salt. In large bowl cream the margarine or butter and sugars. Add vanilla and eggs; beat well. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in chips and nuts. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool thoroughly before cutting in small squares.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Empty contents of beans. Add brown sugar smoke sauce onion and barbecue sauce of your choice. For added flavor add bacon. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. After 1 hour remove lid and stir contents. Cover and bake one more hour.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix in a 2-quart dish the green beans mushroom soup salt pepper and butter. Top if off with the onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Brownies
instructions: Combine flour sugar Egg Beaters or egg whites cocoa and applesauce or margarine until well blended. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread in pan sprayed with Pam (9 x 13-inch pan). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. May dust with powdered sugar.

title: Artichokes With Garlic Dip
instructions: Using a sharp French chef knife cut off and discard stems and tough bottom leaves of artichokes so they will sit upright. Cut off one inch straight across the top of the artichokes. Using scissors trim the sharp tips off each leaf. Rinse in cool water; drain and wrap individually in heavy-duty plastic wrap. Place each wrapped artichoke bottom side up in a custard cup. Rotating each cup and rearranging midway through cooking microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix cornbread mix egg and milk. Bake in an 8-inch square pan at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool and crumble. Combine tomatoes pepper onion pickles and bacon. Toss gently. Mix mayonnaise and pickle juice. Mix well. Layer half each of cornbread tomato mixture and mayonnaise mixture in a large glass bowl. Repeat layers; cover and chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Cook noodles; drain most of water. Mix all 3 cans together. In a dish layer noodles meat and cheese. Pour 1/2 of soup and Ro-Tel mixture over. Layer again and pour other half of soup and Ro-Tel mixture. Put in a 350\u00b0 oven. Top with cheese. Cook until it bubbles.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Spread on the bottom of an oblong casserole dish. Layer half of cheese on top of the sausage. Beat eggs with seasonings and sour cream. Pour over cheese and sausage. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until set about 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Fry bacon until crisp. Cool. Crumble into small pieces. Combine eggs cream salt pepper sugar and nutmeg with hand beater. Beat just enough to mix thoroughly. Sprinkle pie shell with cheese and bacon. Pour in cream mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce oven heat to 325\u00b0. Bake 40 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Honey-Orange Glazed Ham
instructions: Carefully remove peel from orange in long strips. Squeeze the orange reserving juice. For glaze in a small bowl combine 2 tablespoons of the orange juice the honey cinnamon and cloves; mix well.

title: Spiced Peaches
instructions: Drain peach syrup into saucepan. Add the cloves and cinnamon. Stud peach halves with remaining cloves and return to peach can. Bring syrup to a boil; boil rapidly until reduced to about 1/2 cup. Add brown sugar and vinegar. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour over peaches in can. Let stand several hours; drain. Can be used to garnish turkey etc.

title: Sherbet Fruit Twister
instructions: In blender container combine all ingredients. Cover; blend until smooth. Serve immediately. Makes 4 (1-cup) servings.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add egg; mix well. In a separate bowl combine flour and baking powder. Gradually add to butter mixture. Add coconut walnuts and vanilla extract. Mix thoroughly. Press 2/3 of dough into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Spread with preserves. Crumble remaining dough over preserves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden brown. Cool in pan on wire rack.

title: Sauerkraut And Chicken
instructions: Mix together all but sour cream in very large pan; make sure sauerkraut covers chicken and potatoes. Cover and cook over low medium for 1 1/4 hours at 350 degrees in oven. Stir occasionally. Serve directly from casserole with sour cream in separate bowl. Compliment dish with rye bread butter and cold beer.

title: Cinnamon Flop
instructions: Mix melted margarine with sugar. Beat in eggs. Sift flour with baking powder; add alternately with the milk beginning and ending with flour. Spread mixture in well buttered 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle top with brown sugar; dot with butter. Sprinkle with ground cinnamon. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Don'S Bread
instructions: In large bowl stir yeast and 1 tablespoon of sugar in warm water until dissolved. Add remaining sugar salt milk butter and 1 1/2 cups flour. Beat on medium speed with mixer for 2 minutes. Stir in enough flour to make a workable dough using all flour. Knead 10 minutes. Put in a greased bowl; cover and let rise 1 hour or double in size. Push down. Divide in half. Let set 2 minutes. Shape into loaves. Put in pan. Let rise 45 minutes. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Garden Skillet
instructions: Cook cauliflower in lightly salted water until tender (8 to 10 minutes). Drain. In large skillet melt butter. Add zucchini pepper and onion seasonings. Cook until peppers are translucent. Add cauliflower; cook uncovered over medium heat tossing occasionally until zucchini is crisp-tender. Add tomatoes and cheese. Remove from hat; toss until blended.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cream cheese mayonnaise and confectioners sugar in a bowl. Crush cranberry sauce with a fork; stir in lemon juice. Add to cream cheese mixture. Fold in whipped cream and nuts. Turn into an 8-inch square pan. Freeze until firm. Serve cut in squares on lettuce. Makes 8 servings.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix in cut vegetables and spices/dressing. Toss lightly. Chill overnight if possible tossing occasionally.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Peel and cut up apples. Slice bananas. Add oranges. Add 1/2 or 3/4 bag of marshmallows. Add the sour cream. Mix well and chill.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender jar and blend for 30-40 seconds. Store tightly covered in refrigerator. Yields 3-1/3 cups.

title: Bavarian Kraut Salad
instructions: Heat sugar and vinegar about 5 minutes. Let cool then pour over other ingredients.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Toss together and serve.

title: Red Beet Eggs
instructions: Dissolve sugar and salt in vinegar and water. Bring to a boil. Pour over beets and let stand overnight.

title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli and cauliflower; add chopped onions. Mix mayonnaise sour cream garlic powder and salt and pepper. Mix with vegetables and add peas. Serve cold.

title: Hot Lettuce Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients and add to heated bacon and grease. Stir until evenly thickened and put over cold lettuce. Serve.

title: Tutti-Frutti Fruit Salad
instructions: Wash all fruits. Cut in various shapes and sizes. Amount depends on number serving. Serve with toast and juice for breakfast; lunch with mixed greens and choice of meats/fish. Dinner appetizer or with ice cream for dessert.

title: Yams
instructions: Mix in a saucepan; cook until juice cooks down.

title: Cream Cheese Squares
instructions: Cream margarine; add brown sugar. Add flour and nuts to form crumbly mixture. Remove 2 cups for topping. Press remainder into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Blend sugar and cream cheese; add remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Yields 18 to 20.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Mix and sift flour baking powder and salt. Melt shortening add brown sugar and stir until well mixed. Allow to cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add dry ingredients nuts chocolate and vanilla. Pour into greased 10 x 15-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Wipe beef with damp cloth. Place in Dutch oven; cover with cold water. Add onion garlic bay leaf and peppercorns. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Skim any foam; cover and reduce heat to low. Cook approximately 3 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat; keep warm.

title: Summer Casserole(Serves 6)
instructions: Peel eggs and cut lengthwise. Arrange around edge of casserole dish. Peel tomatoes slice and put in center of dish. Make a white gravy of butter salt flour and milk. Stir until smooth and medium thick. Stir in cheese. Pour this mixture over tomatoes and eggs. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Serve.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Blend together until well mixed. Serve with crackers.

title: Christmas Cordial
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove cinnamon stick. Bottle. Add ice cube to each glass when served.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Heat chips until melted. Stir noodles to coat evenly. Drop by full tablespoonfuls on waxed paper and shape.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Peel okra tightly in jars. Put garlic cloves in each jar and pour boiling brine over okra in jar and seal. Hot water bath for 10 minutes in simmering water. Let sit several weeks before opening.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Candy
instructions: Bring sugar margarine and milk to a boil over medium heat. When it starts to boil cook for 4 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add peanut butter vanilla and oats. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed pepper. Let cool.

title: Chicken And Rice Delight
instructions: Combine soups rice and water in large casserole dish. Place pieces of chicken on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for one hour. Uncover. Sprinkle with paprika. Continue cooking uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar and milk and bring to a boil stirring constantly then cook without stirring to soft ball stage about 232\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat. Add butter and cool to lukewarm. Beat until thick and creamy.

title: Italian Baked Mushrooms(A Family Recipe)
instructions: Wipe mushrooms with wet paper towels. (Do not wash.) Slice thin. Combine with next 7 ingredients. Place in casserole and top with lemon slices. Cover.

title: Blender Pecan Pie
instructions: Put eggs sugar salt corn syrup butter and vanilla extract in blender and blend well. Add 1 c. pecans and blend just enough to chop nuts coarsely. Pour into pie shells and place pecan halves on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar. Add margarine. Put egg in a measuring cup and fill to 3/4 cup with milk. Mix like a pie crust. Divide in half and roll out. Put half in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Fill with sliced apples sugar and cinnamon. Cover with the other half of the crust. Bake about 50 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cranberry-Apple Salad
instructions: Dissolve strawberry jello in boiling water. Stir in whole cranberry sauce and lemon juice. Chill until partially set. Fold in chopped unpeeled apple and celery; chill until firm. Top with whipping cream mixed with mayonnaise.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Soften margarine. Mix all ingredients well. Bake uncovered in a large baking dish for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cajun Gingerbread
instructions: With mixer cream together butter and sugar; add egg and molasses. Mix until completely blended. Combine flour soda cinnamon ginger salt and cloves. Add flour mixture and boiling water a little at a time to the butter sugar mixture. Mix until well blended. Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Vegetable Beef Dish
instructions: Mix well all ingredients and bake in oven 1 hour or longer on moderate degrees (350\u00b0) or you may top with grated cheese if desired.

title: 3-Step Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla with mixer on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs mix well. Pour into graham cracker pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.

title: Tropical Dip For Fruit
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill. Serve with assorted fresh fruit. Yields 1 3/4 cups.

title: Bounty Boudin
instructions: Place ground mixture in large pot and cover with water. Bring to\ta boil; cover and simmer for 3 to 4 hours or until well cooked. Pour off\texcess\tliquid\tand reserve. Grind onions pepper celery and garlic using grinder or blender. Mix cooked meat with ground vegetables and add cooked rice. Use 1 large bowl; combine salt pepper and Accent; mix well with other ingredients sampling at random to assure uniformity of seasoning. If too dry add reserved meat liquid. Fill hot casings using either a sausage\tstuffer or a meat grinder attachment.\tTwist casing every 6 to 10 inches (first flip to right then to\tleft) to make links. Tie the ends. To heat place either in boiling water for 30 minutes or in microwave oven for 15 to 30 seconds. Freezes. Makes a ton.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening oleo and sugar. Then add eggs 1 at a time. Add flour and baking powder alternately with milk. Then add rum flavoring and coconut flavoring. Blend well. Bake in an angel food cake pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour then check. Do not check before 1 hour.

title: Potato Skins
instructions: Cut strips from potatoes about 2 to 4-inches long and about 1 to 1 1/2-inches wide leaving a little potato on the skin. Place on cookie sheet and brush with melted butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Brush with more butter and bake about 5 minutes more or until potato is tender and crisp. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Soak bread crumbs in milk. Cut butter and add grated cheese pepper and pimento. Combine all ingredients with beaten eggs. Put in buttered casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 10 people.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Mix eggs oil and sugar. Blend well. Add flour salt sugar and baking soda which have been mixed well. Add vanilla chopped apples and raisins. Pour into greased 8 or 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. While cake is still hot pur hot topping over in the pan. Let cake cool. When completely cool remove cake from pan.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Cut 4 ears of corn for whole kernel (about 2 cups). Cut 8 ears of corn for cream-style (makes about 2 1/2 cups). Mix together well. Add cream flour salt and pepper. Place in 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Ripple Ice Cream
instructions: Combine peanut butter honey extract and nutmeg. Layer ice cream and peanut butter mixture into metal bowl or other 2-quart freezer container beginning and ending with the ice cream. Freeze until firm. Scoop or spoon into serving dishes. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Dietetic Applesauce Cake
instructions: Boil raisins and water until dry. Beat oil and eggs together; add applesauce. Mix all dry ingredients together and add to oil mixture. Stir in raisins; mix well. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Cook and stir bacon and onion in 2-quart saucepan until bacon is crisp. Add enough water if necessary to reserved clam liquid to measure 1 cup. Stir clams clam liquid potatoes and pepper into onion mixture.

title: Impossible Broccoli Pie
instructions: Arrange broccoli in bottom of lightly greased 10x1-1/2-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat milk baking mix eggs and spices together about 15 seconds in blender (or 1 minute with hand mixer); pour into pie plate.

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Mix the jello boiling water and strawberries and refrigerate until slightly thickened. Then break the cake into chunky pieces and drop into the jello. Grease a large tube pan and pour the batter into it. When thick best if refrigerated overnight invert on cake dish and ice with whipped cream topping.

title: Fried Soft Crabs
instructions: Clean and wash crabs; drain well. Place breader mix and 3 crabs at a time in shaker bag. Coat well and place in hot deep fat. Cook until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Apple Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Add flour cloves cinnamon soda and salt to first mixture. Stir well. Add grated apples and stir well. Pour into 8 x 8-inch greased pan. Add sugar and nuts sprinkled on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Heat all ingredients on low until margarine melts. Keep warm. Stir well.

title: Spiced Sugared Nuts
instructions: Mix together in saucepan all ingredients. Bring to boil and cook without stirring to 236\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat and add 1 quart shelled nut halves (pecans or walnuts). Mix until all nuts are coated. Turn out on waxed paper and separate the nut halves from mixture while still hot. Let stand until cold.

title: Marilyn'S Tamale Dip
instructions: Mix onions tomatoes and tomato sauce in a saucepan. Simmer covered for 3 hours. Add tamales with sauce and all other ingredients. Top with cheese before serving.

title: Fat-Free Popcorn Treats
instructions: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or early in the day lightly coat a 6-quart Dutch oven spoon and 13 x 9-inch baking pan with vegetable cooking spray. Slice each piece of candy corn in half lengthwise. In Dutch oven over very low heat melt marshmallows stirring constantly with spoon. Remove from heat. Add popped corn stirring to coat evenly. Stir in candy corn. Using waxed paper press mixture evenly into pan. Let cool about 1 hour. Cut into 24 squares.

title: Squash Croquettes
instructions: Combine squash onion egg salt pepper and flour in bowl; mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil. Deep fry until brown; drain. Serve hot. Yield 32 servings.

title: Dieters' Stew
instructions: Brown meat; drain off all excess fat. Mix meat with remaining ingredients in a crock-pot. Simmer until done. Serves 8. One serving equals 203 calories and 15 grams fat.

title: El Pedregal'S Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl cream together butter and sugars. Add egg while mixing; add vanilla. Sift together flour baking soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg and add slowly to the sugar mixture. Stir in oats and raisins. Use an ice cream scoop to shape dough into balls and place 3 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Press each down lightly and bake 13 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 15 large cookies. You can drop by tablespoon for a smaller cookie. Cooking time remains the same.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and squeeze spinach until dry. Stir together spinach sour cream and mayonnaise. Add soup mix water chestnuts and onions. Blend well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Stir before serving with any bread or cracker.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and mix until frothy.

title: Apricot Cranberry Bread
instructions: Stir flour sugar baking powder and salt together in a large bowl. Add apricots and cranberries. Toss lightly until fruits are coated. Beat eggs milk melted butter and lemon peel together in a small bowl. Pour over dry ingredients. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake 60 to 65 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes in pan then tip it out and finish cooling on cooling rack or bread board.

title: Diet Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Arrange in layers in order given in salad bowl. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Toss before serving.

title: Shahee Dessert
instructions: Mix the milk and half and half cream. Add cardamom and food coloring (few drops) in it; let it boil on low heat for about 15 minutes. Add sugar; let it cook over low heat. Fry one slice of bread in deep fryer until it is brown. Dip it in warm milk and remove it before it gets too soft. Place it on a flat dish. Repeat the same process for the other slices. Place the slices side by side on the same flat dish and pour some leftover milk over them. Sprinkle dried milk powder over the slices. Cool them in the fridge.

title: Tater-Tot Casserole
instructions: Chop onion and cook in margarine. Spread raw ground beef in 9 x 13-inch glass Pyrex dish; spread onion and cheese over meat. Pour soup over onion and cheese then layer Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Ground turkey meat may be substituted for ground beef.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Combine mushrooms onion garlic and margarine in 2 quart casserole and cover. Microwave at High until tender 2 to 4 minutes. Shake beef flour salt and pepper in plastic bag until beef is coated. Stir beef and remaining ingredients except sour cream into vegetable mixture. Microwave covered at High for 5 minutes. Reduce power to Medium-high (70%). Microwave until beef is tender 20 to 30 minutes stirring after half the cooking time. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream until blended. Serve over noodles or rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tupperware Pie Crust
instructions: Use large Tupperware mixing bowl and seal. In regular Tupperware mixing bowl mix first 2 ingredients. Seal the bowl and shake. Add shortening; seal and shake until it reaches cornmeal texture (approximately 2 minutes). Add cold milk; seal and shake 30 to 45 seconds. Lightly flour and chill before rolling out.

title: Sweep Steak
instructions: Line baking dish with ample aluminum foil. Place meat in center. If desired surround with veggies. Sprinkle with onion soup. Tightly wrap foil around meat. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Energy Pancakes
instructions: In large bowl combine egg and milk. Add to egg mixture oil and vanilla; blend well. Mix in oats raisins sunflower and sesame seeds wheat germ bran and shredded apple. Refrigerate overnight. Batter will last about two weeks.

title: Breakfast Chocolate Syrup
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar and flour until well blended. Stir in milk gradually and mix well. Cook over medium heat until it thickens. It should be the consistency of medium white sauce. Stir in butter and vanilla. Serve with hot homemade biscuits and butter. The more butter the better.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in lightly greased pan. When done top with cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1 cup cold water and sugar. Chill until set. Add pineapple lemon juice and bananas. Let congeal in refrigerator and spread with topping.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Crush 1 1/2 cups Ritz crackers and mix with 1 stick of melted margarine.\tUse half of crackers in bottom of casserole. Saute onions and celery in about 1 tablespoon of the melted margarine.\tMix ingredients well and pour into casserole. Top with remaining cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

title: Gaelic Coffee
instructions: Warm glasses. Put 1 1/2 tsp. brown sugar in each glass and half fill with hot strong coffee which dissolves the sugar. Quickly pour a good measure of whiskey into each glass and layer a little cream.

title: Squash Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in 350 degree oven for 50 minutes.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix together and put into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan or dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 to 30 minutes or until browned. Cool.

title: Easy-Does-It Pickles
instructions: Mix vinegar sugar and salt and stir until sugar is dissolved. Add cucumbers peppers onion and celery seed and put into containers. Refrigerate for at least 1 day.

title: Fresh Green Beans
instructions: The amount of ingredients depends on how much you want. Slice green beans lengthways down the middle like French-style. Saut in a little water until almost tender. Add mushrooms. Cook until almost tender and water is cooked done. Add soy sauce and simmer about a minute.

title: Three-Day Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake cake mix using package directions for 2 (9-inch) round cake pans. Remove to wire racks to cool completely. Split layers into halves horizontally. Mix coconut sour cream and sugar in bowl. Measure and reserve 1/2 cup coconut mixture. Spread remaining coconut mixture between layers. Mix reserved coconut mixture with whipped topping. Spread over top and side of cake. Chill covered for 3 days before serving. Yield 12 servings.

title: Turkey Croquettes
instructions: Melt butter; blend in flour and gradually add milk and cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add a little hot mixture to egg and mix well. Stir into hot mixture and cook stirring constantly one minute. Add remaining ingredients and mix lightly. Chill thoroughly. Shape into croquettes and arrange in greased shallow baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Serves 4.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Combine egg milk and margarine. Combine milk mixture with dry ingredients. Stir until barely mixed. Spray nonstick frying pan or griddle with cooking spray or melt margarine in very hot pan/griddle whichever you prefer. Pour batter into pan/griddle. When air bubbles burst on top of pancake turn. Keep constant watch on pan/griddle; too hot will burn pancake and not cook centers evenly too cool will either make pancake stick or cook unevenly. Serve with pancake syrup warmed in microwave if desired.

title: Oyster Cracker Surprise
instructions: Place oyster crackers in a big Tupperware bowl. Mix all the other ingredients with the oil and stir; then pour over oyster crackers and place in refrigerator stirring once every 6 hours. Eat.

title: Corn Flake Chewies
instructions: Melt together white sugar brown sugar and corn syrup. Boil 1 minute. Add peanut butter and corn flakes. Mix and press into 7 x 11-inch pan. Cut into squares.

title: Honey Crunchers
instructions: Mix and roll into balls.

title: Spiced Autumn Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add ginger ale. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into a lightly oiled 8-inch square dish. Cover and chill until firm. Makes 9 servings.

title: Burrito Supreme
instructions: Warm tortillas on grill or in a skillet until slightly browned. Cook meat until done in skillet. Spoon approximately 2 tablespoons meat into tortilla. Add a heaping teaspoon of sour cream and guacamole inside tortilla. Pour about 2 tablespoons red chile sauce over the folded stuffed tortilla. Sprinkle lettuce tomatoes onion and cheese over red chile sauce.

title: Homemade Potato Salad
instructions: Place potatoes in a large Dutch oven and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Boil until potatoes are tender; remove from water and cool. Slice potatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add onion garlic celery and dill. Toss to coat well. Add mayonnaise a few tablespoons at a time until salad is mixed well.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring 3/4 cup of vinegar and 1 cup of sugar to a boil and pour over the other mixture. Chill.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and salt in skillet. Pour off excess grease. Add enchilada sauce and soup to beef. Layer tortilla strips and beef mixture in greased 10 x 10-inch baking dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quickie Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; pour off fat. Combine meat macaroni tomato soup mushroom soup and tomato sauce. Sprinkle top with cheese (grated). Bake in preheated oven (350\u00b0) for 20 minutes.

title: Brownies For A Crowd
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts. If desired flour and add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Thoroughly mix all ingredients except cheese. Press 1/2 meat in small loaf pan. Spread 2/3 of cheese over meat leaving 1/2 inch bare around edges. Place rest of meat on top of cheese pressing edges to seal. Bake for 35 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese; return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Southern Fried Turkey Wings
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Wash turkey wings; cut in half and cut tip off. Coat turkey with egg then with flour mixture. Fry in hot oil in skillet on medium-high heat about 15 minutes turning to brown evenly. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 1 hour. Remove cover. Turn to medium-high and cook 10 minutes more turning occasionally to crisp.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
instructions: Combine cheese mayonnaise and pineapple until creamy. Then combine rest of ingredients.

title: Bubble And Squeak
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cook drain and mash with milk and butter. Plunge cabbage into boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes. Drain and chop fine. Combine with potatoes and onion. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill for 2 or more hours. Roll into 1/2-inch balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until browned slightly.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix until just mixed. Spread in 8X8 pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes.

title: Chicken With Apricot Sauce
instructions: Mix preserves and dressing together. Place chicken in long Pyrex dish and pour sauce over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with topping.

title: Pecan Fudge Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat the first eight ingredients until smooth. Stir in nuts; pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until set. Cool completely. Garnish with whipped cream if desired. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken-Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients using enough chicken broth to moisten until very soft. Pour into baking dish. Dot with butter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until top browns. Serve with chicken or turkey.

title: Holiday Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes softened cream cheese and butter. Add remaining ingredients and place in oiled casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Will puff slightly. Can be refrigerated or frozen and baked later. Increase baking time accordingly.

title: Cherry Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Sift in dry ingredients. Add to cream mixture. Blend well. Spread batter in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread cherry pie filling on top. Sprinkle with coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake tests done. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Brown Bag Snack Beef Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown beef onions and mushrooms in garlic salt sage and butter. Drain this mixture and place a tablespoon of mixture on each crescent roll triangle. Sprinkle them with cheese; roll them up and bake about 10 minutes until brown. A good snack; can be frozen and eaten the next day at room temperature.

title: Orange Drink
instructions: This makes one gallon.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all three ingredients together well. Form into small 1-inch balls. Place in baking dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until uniformly brown.\tA broiler pan with rack works very well also. Excess grease goes to bottom. These make a great party food.

title: Flu Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients in a casserole raw meat and all. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cherry Crumb Cake
instructions: Measure 2 1/2 cups dry cake mix for topping. Combine remaining dry mix flour yeast water and eggs. Beat 100 strokes by hand. Spread evenly in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Top with cherry filling evenly. Mix reserved cake mix 1/4 cup sugar cinnamon and butter with fork until finely grained. Spread over filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Baked Seafood Casserole
instructions: Combine crab meat and shrimp with vegetables which have been chopped very fine.\tAdd mayonnaise. Add salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Mix\twell. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake in moderate oven 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: M&M Monster Cookies
instructions: Cream all ingredients except M&Ms and chips. Scoop cookies out with ice cream dipper. Making a firm ball place on cookie sheet. Bake 5 minutes then put more M&Ms on top. Bake 7 to 10 minutes more.

title: Teatime Tassies
instructions: Mix pastry dough with hands. Roll into big ball. Chill 1 hour. Mix into 1 inch balls and press to fit small ungreased muffin tin. (May spray lightly with Pam.)

title: Blueberry Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs well; add milk and shortening. Sift together flour salt baking powder and sugar. Add slowly to egg mixture stirring well. Beat until smooth. Fold in blueberries. Thin batter slightly with cold water. Spoon on hot griddle to form desired size. Brown on each side for 1 to 2 minutes. Yields 12 to 14 pancakes.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix sugar cake mix oil and nectar slowly. Add eggs one at a time. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven and let stand in pan until cool. Ice while still warm.

title: Date Cake
instructions: Finely chop the dates. Put baking soda over dates and hot water. When cool add to following mixture Cream the butter; add sugar eggs and vanilla. Combine salt and flour. Alternate flour mixture with dates and water then add walnuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 12 pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Gramma Grace'S Chili (Cinti Style)
instructions: Add all in large pot. Simmer for 3 hours. Well worth the wait!

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese then beat in mayonnaise and sugar. Fold in pineapple cherries marshmallows and Cool Whip. Put in refrigerator to set. I normally make a double batch.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and onion. Mix soups as directed and pour over potato mixtures. Add spices. Mix in cheese (I sometimes use partial soup 1/2 can with 1/2 cup cheese). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix together and pour into 1 1/2-quart greased casserole. Cover with corn chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stella D'Oro Anginetti Cream Puffs
instructions: *The cream puffs can be found in the cookie section of your local grocery store.

title: Cheese Snappy Wafers
instructions: Cut butter into flour until texture resembles coarse meal. Mix in cheese cayenne and salt. Fold in Rice Krispies. Pinch off small pieces place on ungreased cookie sheet and pat flat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Mix Kahlua dry pudding and milk. Layer cake Kahlua mixture Cool Whip and chopped bars of candy. Alternate layers. End with Cool Whip and crushed bars of candy.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl. Thirty minutes before serving mix in next 4 ingredients. Immediately before serving add the chow mein noodles. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Brunch Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place dough in ungreased casserole. Saute choice of vegetables in butter. Set aside. Lightly beat eggs. Cook and scramble in additional butter. Place eggs in unbaked crust. Layer with vegetables and ham. Top with cheese. Bake 15 to 17 minutes until brown and cheese bubbles.

title: Lasagna
instructions: In large skillet cook and stir meat until brown. Drain meat. Add tomatoes and break up with fork. Stir in tomato paste garlic salt oregano and basil. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir cottage cheese and 1/2 cup Parmesan. Set aside 2 1/2 cups meat sauce. In 13 x 9-inch pan alternate layers of noodles cheese and meat sauce. Spread reserved meat sauce over top. Bake uncovered 45 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In a 4 1/2-quart pot boil potatoes. Drain water and add remaining ingredients. Cook on low heat until cheese melts. Garnish with chopped green onions.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into bite size balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes.

title: Chocolate Krispies
instructions: Melt chocolate; add Rice Krispies. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper or pour into candy bar molds. Let cool until hard. Store in airtight container.

title: Blackberry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour baking powder salt cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Set aside. Cream together shortening and sugar; add eggs blackberries and buttermilk mixture mix well. Add flour mixture and blend well. Put in loaf or round cake pans. Bake until tests done with a toothpick (approximately 60 minutes).

title: Cold Dough Cakes
instructions: Work flour and Crisco together until crumbly. Add other ingredients. Work dough until it forms a ball and leaves bowl clean. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate overnight or for about 6 hours.

title: Crunchy Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Bring to a rolling boil and boil for 1 minute. Remove from stove and stir in 2 cups peanut butter. Pour over 3 cups corn flakes and Rice Krispies. Drop by teaspoon on greased wax paper.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
instructions: In shallow dish combine 1/2 cup soup and 1 cup milk. Set aside. On wax paper lightly coat chicken with the flour then dip in soup mixture. On another piece of wax paper dip chicken in stuffing on baking dish. Place chicken then drizzle the rest of soup oleo and lemon juice over chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Mom'S Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in frying pan after coating with Frying Magic. Place water at the bottom of a baking casserole dish. Chicken should be layered singly if possible. Place chopped onions on top of chicken. Cover with brown sugar. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Break egg over apples and mix lightly. Add sugar oil nuts raisins and cinnamon then add vanilla. Mix flour soda and salt and add to the above mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes using a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.

title: Rice Cereal
instructions: Heat rice in saucepan with a little milk (to make it creamy) and sprinkle with brown sugar to taste. Can also be done in microwave.

title: Microwave Fish Fillets
instructions: Put fillets into 10-inch pie plate. Season with lemon juice and pepper. Sprinkle with salt (if desired) after cooking. One half-inch fillet will cook in 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on Full power or 2 fillets 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Very Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Sift first 3 ingredients into a 9-inch pie plate. Add oil and milk and stir with a spoon.

title: Zucchini Burger Italiano
instructions: Cook zucchini uncovered 1 to 2 minutes. Drain. Cook meat onions and garlic until meat is brown and onions transparent. Stir cooked rice tomato sauce salt pepper and oregano into meat mixture. Combine egg cottage cheese and shredded cheese. Layer in casserole dish zucchini sprinkled with salt meat mixture cheese mixture and another layer of zucchini. Sprinkle with salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle cheese around edge. Bake 10 more minutes. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix broccoli onion bacon bits and raisins together; let set overnight covered in refrigerator. Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar together; let set covered in refrigerator overnight. Mix together; let set 30 minutes before serving.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Cook seasonings in oyster liquid. Heat milk and butter or margarine; do not boil. Combine all ingredients. Simmer until oysters curl at edges. Serves 2 to 3.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Place cup up canned tomatoes (drained) tomato sauce oregano basil honey and pepper in 3-quart saucepan. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Heat 4 tablespoons broth in large skillet over medium-high heat. Stir-fry garlic onion green pepper and chicken for 10 minutes until chicken is no longer pink inside. Add chicken and green peppers to sauce and simmer covered for 10 minutes. Add peas and balsamic vinegar and cook uncovered an additional 5 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump all ingredients together and mix well. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Prepare icing in a saucepan by cooking together the sugar margarine and evaporated milk for 10 minutes; do not boil. Remove from heat and add nuts and coconut. Spread over hot cake.

title: Garlic Butter
instructions: Wrap garlic in aluminum foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until garlic is very soft (like butter). Spread on anything you desire. Disney World reportedly adds it to butter or margarine to make a garlic spread for bread potatoes etc.

title: Strawberry Sauce
instructions: Wash and hull strawberries. Place in container of electric blender and process until smooth. Add sugar and brandy; process until mixed. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Tailgate Beans
instructions: Cook beef and bacon until done and pour off fat. Saute the onion in bacon drippings. Combine all ingredients. Bake in casserole or large pan at 350\u00b0 until bubbly (45 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Sift together flour ginger soda cinnamon and salt. Cream shortening and sugar beat in eggs and molasses. Sift dry ingredients over creamed mixture and blend well. Form teaspoons of dough into balls and coat with granulated sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix white cake mix according to directions and bake as sheet cake. Cream the cream cheese and set aside. Mix pudding and milk; add cream cheese. Fold into Cool Whip and spread on cooled cake. Spread on layer of pineapple and top with layer of coconut.

title: French Dressing From Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl until evenly distributed. Put mixture in foil packet or 1-pint glass jar. Store in cool dry place and use within 6 months. Makes about 5 tablespoons mix enough for 1 1/4 cups dressing.

title: Mashed Potatoes With Cheese
instructions: Mash potatoes. Spread extra butter in casserole. Mix all ingredients and put in casserole. Bake for 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. (If made in advance bake for 1/2 hour.) Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sweet-N-Smoky Brisket
instructions: Trim excess fat from brisket. Poke holes in brisket with tip of knife or large fork. Combine brown sugar and bottle of Claudes. Mix until mixture is syrupy. Spoon over brisket and rub into meat. Sprinkle seasoned salt and pepper liberally onto top of brisket. Wrap in foil. Leave overnight in a cool place. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours or until doone. Cook brisket with fat side up. Do not turn over while cooking. Slice meat with the grain while warm.

title: Turkey And Scalloped Potato Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Pour potato slices into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with contents of seasoning mix envelope and turkey. In a medium saucepan bring water to a boil. Stir in carrots peas milk and margarine; return to a boil. Pour over potatoes; stir. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake an additional 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Golden Fried Shrimp
instructions: Butterfly shrimp and wash under cold running water. Combine eggs and salt in a shallow bowl. Combine flour and cracker crumbs in flat pan. Dip each shrimp in egg mixture then roll in cracker mixture. Repeat procedure. Fry at 365\u00b0 for 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Boil hen for 1 hour or longer. Salt it as youre boiling it. Keep the good rich broth. Mix all the remaining ingredients together adding the broth slowly until it is a little mushy. Salt and pepper to your taste. Cook the pan of dressing for 30 minutes or more at 450\u00b0. Put the chicken on top the last 10 minutes. Cooking time can depend on how mushy you make the dressing from the broth. You dont want it to get too dry.

title: Shrimp Fettuccini
instructions: Saute vegetables in butter for 15 minutes covered. Add flour and cook 10 minutes. Add shrimp and cook 15 minutes. Add 1/2 Velveeta cheese (chopped) and cook until melted. Add jalapeno pepper and cook 10 minutes. Add half and half and cook until heated. Season to taste. Boil noodles and add to shrimp mixture. Put in a large well greased casserole. Top with rest of Velveeta and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and is bubbly.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops on both sides. In a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish arrange potato slices. Place browned pork chops over potatoes. Combine soups milk onion salt and pepper; mix well and cover pork chops. Sprinkle cheese over top. Cover; bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until pork chops are tender.

title: Spaghetti Chicken
instructions: Beat egg in bowl. Mix crumbs flakes and Parmesan cheese in separate bowl. Dip chicken in egg. Then in mix. Arrange chicken over Prego sauce in baking dish. Spoon some sauce over chicken. Bake covered for 1 hour at 400\u00b0. Top with Mozzarella cheese and bake uncovered until cheese is melted. Serve with spaghetti noodles.

title: Spritz Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Mix in egg peel and vanilla. Mix in flour and salt. Use cookie press with desired shapes. Bake 10 minutes or until golden. Cool; dip cooled cookies into chocolate and then into sprinkles. Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Grandmother Smith'S No-Fuss Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix salt sugar and yeast in a very large bowl (large enough for dough to rise) and add 2 cups of lukewarm water. Add half of the flour and mix in. Add egg and mix. Add melted butter. Add remaining flour and mix quickly. Cover with Saran Wrap and let rise 1 hour until doubled its bulk. Punch down and form into rolls. Let rise again for about another hour. Bake at 425\u00b0 on greased cookie sheet for about 20 minutes. This is a favorite at every family gathering.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Mix together cooked spaghetti butter Parmesan cheese Cheddar cheese and beaten eggs. Place mixture into a baking dish. Layer remaining ingredients in given order ending with spaghetti sauce on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: In a 9 x 9-inch glass dish spread refried beans to cover bottom.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; add soup mixture. Layer in casserole dish as follows Tater Tots meat and soup cheese and Tater Tots. Salt and pepper to taste and add onion powder. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine rice milk sugar salt margarine and raisins. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens (about 20 minutes). Stir in vanilla. Makes 2 servings. (I usually double the recipe.) Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Chill.

title: Our Favorite Fudge
instructions: Combine milk sugar and butter in a saucepan. Stirring often cook to 234\u00b0 or until forms a soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Stir until thick. Pour into greased dish (8 x 13-inches) and refrigerate until firm then cut.

title: Surprise Cupcakes
instructions: In one bowl beat cream cheese egg sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Add semi-sweet morsels. In a separate bowl beat flour sugar cocoa soda 1/2 teaspoon salt water oil and vinegar. Fill muffin cup 1/3 full with second bowl and top with 1 teaspoon of the cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with sugar on top (optional) and almonds (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Low Cholesterol Dip
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl beat cottage cheese on low speed of electric mixer until smooth. Add mayonnaise onion white pepper celery salt Worcestershire sauce garlic salt and hot pepper sauce. Mix well. Refrigerate covered at least 8 hours to let flavor blend. Serve with fresh vegetables such as carrot celery sticks broccoli and cauliflower.

title: Refrigerator Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk into a heavy pan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until boils. Turn heat down to prevent scorching. Cook for 10 more minutes. Remove from heat and immediately add chocolate pieces syrup butter and flavoring. Stir well until chocolate has melted and fudge is smooth and creamy. Add nuts; mix until blended well. Pour into unbuttered 8-inch pan surface. Will set rapidly. So spread quickly with spatula. Chill 1 to 2 hours or until firm cut into squares. Makes about 2 pounds to 2 1/2 pounds of candy.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle the rice in flat cake pan. Pour over the rice the soups and milk which have been heated together. Lay the cut up chicken over this. Sprinkle the dry onion soup mix over all. Cover with foil; bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 2 1/4 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
instructions: Separate eggs. Beat the whites until frothy. Add salt and cream of tartar; continue beating until eggs are stiff. Add the cornstarch to sugar and fold into egg whites then fold the flour into the eggs small amount at a time. Bake 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pita Crisps
instructions: Heat the oven to 400\u00b0. Combine the oil cumin cayenne pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Split the pitas in half. Brush the cut side of each half with the flavored oil. Stack the pitas and cut them into quarters. Spread them on a baking sheet in a single layer and bake until golden brown about 10 minutes. Transfer to a rack to cool. Fill with your favorite chopped meats and vegetables.

title: French Pound Cake
instructions: Separate egg yolks and whites. Cream the shortening and add sugar egg yolks vanilla and flour (a little at a time). Add milk slowly. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in batter. Butter and flour tube pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Layer Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk in top of double boiler or in microwave. In a large bowl combine by hand rest of ingredients except chips. Stir until dough holds together. Press half of dough into pan and bake 6 to 8 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked crust. Spread caramel mixture on top of chips. Spread remaining dough mixture over caramel and bake 15 to 20 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into squares.

title: Easy Fruit Cake
instructions: Combine in 4-quart saucepan the sugar raisins or substitute raisins and candied fruit. Add boiling water cinnamon salt and Crisco. Mix well and bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Chill thoroughly and add baking soda and water. Mix well and add flour. Mix well and pour in 8 x 10-inch greased pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Freezer Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Wash and brush cucumber and cut into slices. (Do not peel.) Place cucumber onion and pepper in plastic pan. Sprinkle with salt; mix well. Let set for 30 minutes. Drain well and put into plastic containers. Mix sugar and vinegar; heat to dissolve. Pour over cucumber mixture in containers. Seal and freeze.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix together. Cook 20 minutes. Makes 9 1/2 pints.

title: Macaroni Fruit Medley
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain and set aside. Cook egg sugar flour salt and juice from can of crushed pineapple until thick. Pour over macaroni and refrigerate overnight.

title: Korean Salad
instructions: Toss the spinach with the bean sprouts. Dice the hard-boiled eggs and fry; crumble the bacon and add to the vegetables along with the water chestnuts. Combine the salad oil sugar catsup vinegar Worcestershire sauce and grated onion in a food processor to make the dressing. Add salt to taste and mix with the vegetables.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion until brown. Drain and add seasoning and water stirring well. Boil reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Combine beans and half the taco sauce. Spoon half of this into pie shell and top with half of the meat mixture half the cheese and all the chips. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400 degrees. Cut into wedges and top with lettuce tomato and remaining taco sauce.

title: Egg And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Fit 1/3 bread lightly into greased casserole. Sprinkle 1/3 parsley onion and grated cheese on top. Make 2 more layers the same. Beat eggs lightly and mix with milk salt pepper and mustard worcestershire sauce. Pour over bread in casserole. Let stand 12 hours or overnight in refrigerator. Remove from refrigerator 2 hours before baking time and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 10-12 people.

title: Straw-Ba-Nut Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs with electric mixer at medium speed until frothy. Gradually add sugar beating until thick. Stir in condensed milk and vanilla. Combine strawberries bananas and pecans. Fold in whipped topping. Add fruit mixture to egg mixture; stir gently. Add food coloring if desired. Pour into freezer can of 1 gallon freezer. Add enough milk to fill can 3/4 full. Let ripen at least one hour.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak in bite size pieces and brown. Mix together all other ingredients except onion and green peppers. Add to meat and simmer 45 minutes. Add onion and green peppers and simmer 30 minutes longer. Serve over mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cut around core of cabbage. Put in pot of boiling water; remove leaves as they soften and drain on a towel. Wash sauerkraut and drain. Saute onion in 1/3 cup oleo. Put kraut on bottom of pan. Mix all ingredients and salt and pepper to taste. Trim thick part of each leaf so you can roll it. Use small amount of meat for each one. Roll once fold over one side finish rolling and push end of cabbage into meat mixture. Use leftover cabbage to put on top. Sprinkle paprika on top. Cover with 1/2 tomato juice and 1/2 water. Cover and cook 2 hours or longer I cook mine for hours. Better the next day.

title: Blueberry Dessert Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 12-inch pizza pan or 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl combine cake mix 1 cup oats and 6 teaspoons margarine at low speed until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs blend in egg. Press in prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Meanwhile to reserved crumbs in same large bowl add remaining 1/4 cup oats 2 tablespoons margarine nuts sugar and cinnamon. Beat until well mixed. Remove from oven and spread pie filling. Sprinkle crumbs on top and return to oven for 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Cool completely and cut into wedges or squares.

title: Marinated Chicken
instructions: Place chicken face up in a roasting pan. Cover with dry onion soup; cover completely with cranberry sauce. Cover. Marinate overnight in refrigerator. Bake as is at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove cover and brown as desired. Serve hot or cold. (Can be made as a single or double layer.)

title: Imitation Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Brown oil and garlic together. Add all ingredients; mix should be moist but not soggy. If appears too dry add small olive oil for additional moisture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Fruit Smash Punch
instructions: Mix gelatin with 2 cups of hot water. Add cold water and fruit juices; stir in sugar. Just before serving mash or whip bananas until smooth and creamy. Beat into mixture. Add ginger ale the last minute and serve.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix sour cream and mayonnaise; set aside. Place half of cornbread in bottom of large bowl. Top with 1/2 beans. In medium mixing bowl combine chopped tomatoes peppers and onions. Layer 1/2 this mixture over beans. Layer 1/2 of cheese bacon corn and salad dressing mixture. Repeat layers. Garnish as desired using cheese bacon crumbles black olives etc. Chill. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Melt-In-The-Mouth Cookies
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder and salt into a bowl and reserve. Put butter or margarine in large mixer bowl. Add brown sugar egg and vanilla. Beat with mixer or wooden spoon until light and fluffy. Beat in flour mixture with spoon or mixer blending until smooth. Stir in nuts. Drop by scant measuring teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 1/2 minute. Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Defrost creamed spinach by boiling 6 minutes. Season with nutmeg. Beat egg whites stiff with cream of tartar. Fold carefully into spinach and bake in a 1-quart souffle dish in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) until mixture is well puffed about 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Low-Fat Apple Spice Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix first eight ingredients. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan or 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Makes 24 servings.

title: Whipped Cream Icing
instructions: Cream water and flour over low heat. (Beat with whisk as it cooks.) Let cool. Combine butter shortening sugar vanilla and salt. Mix and whip both together until whipped look appears.

title: Pizza Sticks
instructions: Separate and unroll breadsticks. Place 3 pepperoni in single layer on 1/2 of breadstick. Fold the other 1/2 of breadstick over top of pepperoni. Seal end and twist. Place on ungreased baking pan. Combine cheese Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Sprinkle over top of each breadstick evenly. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with pizza for dipping. Great for parties or snacks.

title: Stir-Fried Pepper Steak
instructions: Trim fat from beef partially freeze and slice thinly across grain into bite size strips. For sauce stir together water soy sauce bouillon cornstarch and pepper. Set aside. Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Omit cooking oil and salt. Drain well. Spray wok or large skillet with nonstick spray. Heat over medium heat; add garlic to pan and stir-fry for 15 seconds. Add onion; fry for 1 minute. Add green pepper; fry 2 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Remove vegetables from wok. Put beef in wok; more oil may be necessary. Stir-fry 2 or 3 minutes. Push beef to sides and put sauce in center. Cook until thick and bubbly. Return vegetables to wok. Cook 1 minute. Gently stir in tomato wedges. Heat through. Serve right away over fettuccine. Serves 4.

title: Easy Homemade Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0 and melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix Bisquick Sprite and sour cream to make dough. Roll dough 1/2-inch thick and cut with biscuit cutter. Place in pan. Turn over in margarine to coat. Bake for 15 minutes until brown. (Great with honey and butter.)

title: Veal Stew-Bulgaria(Teleshko Zadusheno)
instructions: Cut veal in 1 inch squares. Cut carrots onions and celery into quarters. Cook veal vegetables and salt at low heat in 4 cups of water remove froth while water is boiling. When meat stock is free of froth cover and cook for 1 1/2 hours at low heat. Add potatoes after veal has cooked for 1 1/2 hours cook for another 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 4-6.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash and hull berries and reserve half of the best ones. Mash other half; add cornstarch and sugar. Cook until thick and clear. Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice; cool and add whole berries. Pour into pie shell; cover with whipped cream and few whole berries.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine crushed graham crackers with 1/4 cup sugar and 1 stick melted butter. Pat in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan to form crust.

title: Rouladen (Beef Roll-Up)
instructions: Lay steak on board. Spread thin layer of mustard and salt and pepper on each steak. Fill with bacon strips pickle strips and onion. Roll up and use toothpicks to hold together. Brown in a deep skillet on all sides. Slowly add enough water to fill skillet 1/2 full. Simmer for 90 minutes.

title: Dandelion Wine
instructions: Combine the blooms with the lemons and add the boiling water; let stand 3 days. Boil 20 minutes. When cool strain through a cloth. Add the sugar and yeast cake. Place in jars. Set aside to ferment. Rack off and seal. Be careful and be moderate.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Mom'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease and flour angel food or bundt pan. Combine first 7 ingredients. Mix 3 Tbsp. sugar with cinnamon. Layer 1/2 cake dough and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon mixture. Repeat. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Apple Nut Coffeecake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream. Fold in chopped apples. Spread batter in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Combine nuts brown sugar cinnamon and melted butter. Sprinkle over batter and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tomato Vegetable Soup
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan bring tomatoes broth and water to boil. Add vegetables and seasoning. Return to boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 1 hour until vegetables are tender. Yields about 5 1/4 cups.

title: Easy Vegetable Dip For Kids
instructions: Use with fresh vegetables such as carrots celery cucumbers parsnips zucchini peppers tomatoes radishes cabbage cauliflower turnips string beans onions.

title: Hamburger Goo
instructions: Brown beef in skillet and drain the fat. Add celery onion brown sugar vinegar dry mustard and ketchup. Sprinkle flour over mixture. Stir and mix well. Simmer for 20 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Put diced apples in pan with a little water to keep from sticking. Mix other ingredients without liquid. Pour powder mixture over apples. Top with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until covered with juices approximately 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Ham Hot Dish
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. Spoon rice into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Place broccoli over rice. Melt butter in a large skillet. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of melted butter over the bread crumbs and set aside. In remaining butter saute onion until soft. Add flour salt and pepper stirring constantly until bubbly. Stir in milk and continue cooking until sauce thickens and bubbles. Cook and stir for 1 minute; add ham and heat through. Pour over rice and broccoli. Sprinkle the crumbs over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with cheese; let stand 5 minutes before serving. Yield 8 servings.

title: Apple Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix together the oil sugar vinegar salt and pepper to make a dressing.

title: Scrambled Eggs Delight
instructions: Beat eggs. Mix in milk and seasonings. Add sausage bread cheese and mushrooms mixing well. Refrigerate overnight covered with foil. In morning heat oven to 350\u00b0. Remove foil. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve with toasted cinnamon toast orange juice or fruit and coffee.

title: Brownie Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Line the bottom of the 9 inch spring form pan with wax paper. Prepare the brownie mix as for chewy brownies. Bake for 35 minutes or until set.

title: Brittle Cracker Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place a layer of aluminum foil in an 11 x 16 x 1-inch pan; arrange a single layer of crackers over foil. Combine butter and brown sugar in a saucepan; bring to a boil and boil 3 minutes. Pour over crackers. Bake for 5 minutes or until crackers float. Remove from the oven; sprinkle with chocolate chips over the top. When chips have melted spread. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Mix soda and buttermilk. Add to creamed mixture. Mix oranges dates pecans and coconut in large bowl. Sift flour over this mixture and mix well. Add to creamed mixture and blend well. Bake in tube pan (greased and floured) for 2 1/2 hours at 250\u00b0. Keep refrigerated.

title: Appetizer Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese over slice of ham. Roll it up and slice into 4 or 5 sections. Stick party toothpicks through olive or cheese cube then through ham roll-up section. Continue to do this alternating cheese cubes and olives.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot except for noodles. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours (on high 4 to 6 hours). One hour before serving remove chicken from bone return meat to crock-pot and add noodles. Turn on high cover and cook 1 hour more.

title: Green Tomato Mincemeat
instructions: Chop tomatoes apples and raisins. Add balance of ingredients. Simmer 2 hours. Pack in pint hot pack jars boiling water bath for 25 minutes.

title: Custard Pie Recipe For 9-Inch Pan
instructions: Cream eggs sugar and salt together. Add milk and vanilla. Mix ingredients well and strain into pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake in oven preheated to 450\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes a very delicious pie.

title: Curry Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cook green onion in oleo in a large skillet over medium heat until tender. Stir in curry powder lemon pepper garlic powder and Mrs. Dash. Add tomatoes; cook over low heat until tender.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour baking soda cinnamon and salt; add to margarine mixture mixing well. Stir in oats and raisins; mix well.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: 6 to 8 pork chops

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed and drain. Mix with other ingredients. Cook in casserole dish until bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Cherry Dessert
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch cake pan; put pie filling evenly over bottom of pan. Cover with dry cake mix. Slice 1/4 pound butter over top of cake mix. Bake at 375\u00b0 until bubbly and brown. May be served with whipped topping.

title: Paul Newman Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix in 9 x 13-inch pan according to package directions. Remove from oven and punch holes in cake with fork or toothpick. Pour sweetened condensed milk over cake and let stand 10 minutes. Pour caramel ice cream topping over cake and refrigerate. Put Cool Whip on top of cooled cake and garnish with Heath candy bar pieces.

title: Jellied Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add cold water. Chill slightly; blend oranges cranberry and nuts until slightly thickened. Turn into 1-quart mold. Chill until set. Serve with sour cream or softened cream cheese blended with small amount of Cool Whip or whipped cream. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cheese And Spinach Puffs
instructions: In pan mix spinach and onion. Cook according to package directions. Drain well. Mix eggs cheeses salad dressing butter and garlic powder. Add spinach mixture and muffin mix. Cover and chill in refrigerator. Shape dough into one-inch balls and chill until serving time. Then place balls on baking sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown (about 10 to 12 minutes). Serve warm. Makes about 60.

title: Party Cheese Bake
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan put 3/4 of cracker mixture (butter and celery powder). Spread 2 cups lightly salted onions. Cover with 1 1/2 cups grated Cheddar cheese. Combine 3 cups scalded milk 3 lightly beaten eggs 1 teaspoon salt and dash of red pepper and pour over crackers. Sprinkle remainder of cracker mixture. Top with a light layer of Parmesan cheese and paprika. Bake for 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cut into 2-inch squares. Serves about 40.

title: Peppery Chicken
instructions: Combine olive oil soy sauce honey thyme paprika cayenne pepper vinegar allspice and pepper. Pour over chicken. Marinate in refrigerator for about 1 hour. Bake chicken at 375\u00b0 for 30-45 minutes or until cooked through. Surround chicken with sliced mushrooms spoon the sauce over them and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and let cool a few minutes. Roll cheese inside of ham (you will have 6 rolls). Place rolls in casserole dish. Mix soup margarine small amount of lemon juice and 4 dashes of curry powder together and pour this over the rolls of ham and cheese. Top with can of crushed onion rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes covered.

title: Crabmeat Imperial(Serves 4)
instructions: Remove cartilage and shell from crabmeat. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Saute onions and peppers in butter. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Place in shallow baking dish or in individual ramekins. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Pour dry ingredients into skillet. Add water and coloring. With skillet on medium-high stir until mixture pulls from sides of pan. Take dough from skillet and knead. Store in airtight container.

title: Non-Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil sweet milk cocoa white sugar and butter. Boil for 1 minute and take off stove. Add peanut butter and oats. Stir real good and drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except graham crust) until texture is smooth. Pour mixture into pie crust and refrigerate for 2 hours. Top with your favorite fruit topping caramel or even chocolate!

title: Date Ding Bats
instructions: Combine and cook slowly 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla cereal and nuts. Form into small balls and roll in coconut or powdered sugar.

title: Christmas Ornament Dough
instructions: Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup cold water in bowl. Mix salt and 2/3 cup water in an electric skillet or saucepan on low heat. Stir 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and immediately add the cornstarch and cold water mixture to the hot salt water. This forms an easy-to-handle dough. This dough will harden to a rock-like consistency. Great for rolling out and cutting into ornaments for all occasions!

title: Fast Yeast Rolls
instructions: Knead and roll out on flour. Cut out shape with top of glass or etc. Let rise 45 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken And Tortillas
instructions: Saut 1 chopped onion in oil. Add Chili Quick flour tomato sauce water salt and pepper. Cook slowly about 15 minutes. Add chicken. Fry thin strips of corn tortillas in oil until crisp. On a platter lay a bed of tortilla chips. Pour chicken sauce over tortillas and top with grated yellow cheese.

title: Tofu Salad
instructions: Crumble tofu. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Serve on bread or crackers. See Mustard recipe in Dairy Substitute & Sauces Section.

title: Old Fashion Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat together ingredients and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix in blender all ingredients except coconut for 3 minutes. Bake in a 10-inch pie tin at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Put the coconut on top before baking.

title: Beef Baked In Foil
instructions: Trim fat from meat; place on large piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil. Pour soup over meat. Bring 2 long ends of foil loosely up over meat and double fold. Turn up other sides and double fold. Place in baking dish. Cook for 3 hours in oven at 325\u00b0 or until tender.

title: Chicken Thighs With Honey Basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut a piece of aluminum foil 1/2 square foot for each thigh. Sprinkle the thighs with salt and pepper. In a skillet heat the oil and butter over medium heat. Brown the thighs for about 2 minutes on each side. Put a thigh in the middle of each foil square. Dissolve the honey in the warm chicken stock and drizzle the mixture equally over each thigh. Lay one-eighth of the garlic slices on each thigh. Cover with a loose layer of the basil leaves and wrap the foil snugly over top.

title: Martha Louise'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Parboil celery and onion. Mix all ingredients together. Put potato chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Mrs. Claus' Christmas Soup
instructions: Wash and soak bean mixture overnight. Drain off the water. Place beans in a soup pot. Add all other ingredients. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer for 4 to 5 hours or all day.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until done; mash. Add butter and cool enough to handle. Form balls with a marshmallow in center of each. Roll in chopped pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Yum-Chow
instructions: Boil macaroni until tender; drain. Melt oleo. Add meat onion green pepper salt and pepper. Cook until brown. Add tomato soup and water. Cook slowly for 15 to 30 minutes. Top with cheese triangle and melt slightly.
