title: All-Purpose Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour over cooked beef or pork ribs and heat in a moderate oven for about 20 minutes. Or mix with cooked ground beef and onion (fat drained off) for spicy Sloppy Joes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bill Lincoln'S Pot Roast
instructions: Start at about 9 p.m. Saturday night. Cut up onion and put in bottom of crock-pot. Trim roast; cut in half and salt pepper and flour all sides of roast. Put roast in pot. Put one can of golden mushroom soup on top. Put one can water on top of that. Add one can of tomato sauce. Set heat on high for about 2 hours then turn heat to low (dont forget). When you get up the next morning turn heat up on high again for about 2 hours.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix eggs with milk; add sugar and pour into crust. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwave Mexican Chili
instructions: Place margarine and onions in a large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on High 4 minutes. Stir after 2 minutes. Add ground beef. Microwave on High 8 minutes or until done. Stir often. Add chili powder beans and tomato sauce. Mix well. Microwave on High 4 minutes or until heated. Stir often.

title: Blueberry Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon together. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs bananas and sour cream. Beat until blended. Gradually beat in dry ingredients at low speed. Beat until smooth. Fold in berries and pecans. Bake approximately 1 hour. Test for doneness before an hour. Use sharp knife or toothpick.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Saute garlic and onion in butter. Add remaining ingredients. Use taco chips for dipping.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Combine apples raisins and marshmallows. Blend mayonnaise sugar and lemon juice. Fold into apple mixture.

title: Coconut Fruitcake
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Add fruitcake mix coconut raisins and nuts; mix well. In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and extract; mix well. Stir in the flour mixture alternately with orange juice.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients like pie dough; pat into 2 (9-inch) square pans. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients together in mixer or blender; pour over the warm crust. Bake about 25 minutes. Cut while warm into small squares. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Layered Spinach Salad
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients and set aside. In large bowl (trifle bowl looks great) layer spinach peas hard-boiled eggs bacon red onion and romaine lettuce and mayonnaise mixture. Then add a thin layer of spinach as last layer and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Measure flour. Add shortening and cut or rub into the flour. Add the milk a little at a time. Mix dough. Roll out about 3 inches thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on baking sheet and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Deviled Crab In Shell
instructions: In a saucepan saute the green pepper which has been trimmed and finely chopped. Also saute the chopped onion in butter for 10 minutes. Stir frequently. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in 2 tablespoons brandy 1 tablespoon each dry and prepared mustard 1/2 teaspoon salt and the white sauce. Stir in the crab meat and bread crumbs. Heat over low heat. Stir gently. Spoon into shells. Sprinkle tops with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Brown tops under the broiler for a few minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast on both sides. Mix Onion soup mix mushroom soup mushrooms and burgundy wine. Pour over browned roast and cook covered at 275 for at least 3 - 4 hours depending on size of roast.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Place cabbage in greased casserole dish about 3/4 full. Mix together remaining ingredients and spread over cabbage. Bake 2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Swiss Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine cracker crumbs and melted butter. Press into bottom and sides of 8-inch pie plate. Cook bacon; drain and crumble. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons bacon drippings. Add chopped onion to drippings. Cook until tender. Add the bacon onion Swiss cheese eggs sour cream salt and pepper. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with American cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until an inserted knife comes out clean. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Cut. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough into 1-inch balls roll in sugar and place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until brown. Take out of oven. Immediately top each cookie with candy kiss. Press down firmly so cookie crackers around edge. Cool. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: None Left Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until tender; cool and tear into small pieces. Mix chicken soup and sour cream together. Pour into ovenproof dish; cover with crushed crackers. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until bubbly and light brown on top about 20 minutes.

title: Egg White Angel Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Spread waxed paper on 2 cookie sheets. Beat the egg whites very very stiff then gradually add 1 cup of sugar. Add a tiny bit of vanilla. Add the chopped walnuts and chopped dates. With teaspoon place mixture on cookie sheets about an inch apart. Bake for 9 minutes until mixture has a slight film on it. Immediately remove from cookie sheet with a spatula.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix gently and put in greased casserole. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 until browned. May be mixed ahead of time. If you wish to make larger amount add 1 can drained green peas. Serves 6.

title: Cherry Salad Supreme
instructions: Dissolve raspberry gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in pie filling. Turn into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until partially set. Dissolve lemon gelatin in 1 cup boiling water.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time 30 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Spread crumbled sausage on bottom of 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the bread crumbs. Mix the eggs and milk together and pour over the mixture. Cover the casserole and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. It will keep 48 hours before baking. Put in cold oven at 350\u00b0 and bake for 40 minutes. Let stand 2 minutes before serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Meringue Blossoms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Whip egg whites until frothy. Beat in sugar gradually. Beat mixture until it forms stiff peaks. Drop from a spoon or pipe from a pastry bag with star tip onto ungreased cookie sheet. Turn heat off in prepared oven and put in cookie sheet. Do not open oven door for 1 1/2 hours or preferably overnight. Cool and store in tins. Serves 20.

title: Gingerbread Pancakes
instructions: Stir all ingredients together mixing well. Place on hot griddle or in frying pan turning once till done.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Put in large bowl and set aside semi-sweet chocolate German sweet chocolate marshmallow cream and nuts. Pour hot solution over chocolate in bowl. Stir until mixed. Spread in sheet pan. Let stand several hours. Makes approximately 4 pounds.

title: Sour Cream Cucumbers
instructions: Peel cucumbers and thinly slice. Layer slices in a bowl salting each layer well. Set aside for 15 minutes.

title: Mushrooms
instructions: Soak mushrooms for a few minutes then drain well and wash. Cut into pieces. In frying pan melt butter. Add mushrooms and garlic salt. Cook covered about 10 minutes on low heat. Add wine; cook another 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream the softened butter and sugar; add eggs. Alternate adding dry ingredients and crushed bananas then add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased and floured pan until toothpick comes out clean about 30 minutes to 1 hour depending on size of pan.

title: Most Requested Punch
instructions: Mix and boil the sugar and water. Add jello and dissolve. Add remaining ingredients. Freeze; thaw until slushy. When ready to serve add 3 (2 liter) bottles ginger ale 7-Up or Sprite.

title: Jenny'S Ham Rolls
instructions: Slice dinner rolls lengthwise. Layer ham and cheese in middle of rolls. Return tops. Melt butter. Add poppy seed mustard Worcestershire sauce and onion. Pour over tops of rolls and bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Asparagus And Pea Casserole
instructions: Grease or butter pan. Put most of crackers in bottom of pan. Add peas and asparagus. Spread cream of mushroom soup over vegetables. Sprinkle with almonds. Add 2 tablespoons asparagus juice. Dot with butter. Spread shredded cheese on top. Spread cracker crumbs over that. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 or more.

title: Angel Eggs
instructions: Carefully remove hard-boiled eggs from shell. Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove yolk from each egg. Put yolks in small bowl and mash them. Mix in the remaining ingredients. Carefully refill the white halves with the mixture. Arrange on a pretty plate and enjoy!

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in baking dish. Mix flour sugar and milk. Pour into baking dish. Now pour fruit over flour mixture. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Date Loaf Candy
instructions: Cook sugar corn syrup and milk until it forms a semi-soft ball stirring constantly. Add dates and cook until it forms a soft ball. Remove from heat. Add nuts and beat until very thick and creamy. Pour onto cold wet cloth. Roll up and chill. Slice when cool.

title: Cheesy Bacon Bites
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cream cheese bacon onion and pepper in batter bowl. Separate crescent rolls into 2 rectangles. Pinch seams together. Spread cheese mixture on each rectangle. Roll up starting at longest side and seal. Cut each roll into 16 slices. Place slices cut side down on flat sheet. Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm. Yields 32 appetizers.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix together well. Make tiny balls and place on well-greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until browned.

title: Microwave Corn Pudding
instructions: In a bowl beat egg sugar salt pepper and cornstarch. Add corn and milk blended together. Put into a buttered baking dish. Cook uncovered in center of oven for 5 minutes. Stir well from outside in. Cook 5 minutes more or until set. Let stand covered 3 more minutes. Serves 4.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan melt margarine. Spread graham cracker crumbs over margarine. Next spread chocolate chips over crumbs and then spread oats. Next spread nuts over oats and pour milk over all. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lime Cooler Bars
instructions: In a bowl combine 2 cups flour and the powdered sugar. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Pat into a greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Cream Cheese Cakes
instructions: Beat cream cheese until soft. Gradually add sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Stir in vanilla. Put 1 vanilla wafer in the bottom of a cupcake holder and fill to desired amount. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Refrigerate overnight and top with cherry pie filling.

title: Fry Bread
instructions: Combine eggs and milk in medium bowl. Stir in flour baking powder and salt. Mix well. Turn dough out onto a floured surface. Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into 3-inch squares. Gently place squares a few at a time in deep hot oil (375\u00b0). Fry until golden brown turning once. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm with butter and honey. Yields 2 to 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Layered Enchiladas
instructions: Use 9 x 11-inch baking dish. Cover bottom of dish with 1/2 cup enchilada sauce. Put 4 of the torn corn tortillas next. Arrange shredded chicken to cover. Add chicken broth 1/2 cup cheese green chiles and 1/4 cup olives. Top with rest of tortillas sauce cheese and black olives.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Mix together apple pie filling sugar nutmeg and cinnamon. Place in greased cake pan. Pour cake mix over top. Slice margarine and place on top of this. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Slice sugar cookie dough in 1/4-inch slices; place on a pizza pan. Edges will run together when baked at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes. Combine powdered sugar and cream cheese; spread on cooled cookie layer. Spread strawberry pie filling over cream cheese mixture. Arrange bananas and pineapple chunks around on top of strawberry filling. Top all with the Cool Whip. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cranberry-Orange Relish
instructions: Rinse cranberries well; remove any stems. Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender. Chop until finely grated. Add more sugar if desired. Chill at least three hours so flavors blend. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate-Citrus Cooler
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender; blend until smooth. Pour over crushed ice. Top with a small scoop of ice cream.

title: Peach Crunch
instructions: Place peaches in the bottom of a 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle with sugar then sprinkle with jello. Drizzle water over then sprinkle dry cake mix over the whole thing. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50-60 minutes. Note that this can be used with other fruit and jello.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine beef oats milk onion pepper and salt. Mix well. Shape into about 30 small balls. Brown in hot shortening; drain. Combine catsup Worcestershire vinegar sugar and water; mix well. Pour sauce over meatballs. Simmer 30 minutes over low. Heat until ready to serve.

title: Chili Salad
instructions: In salad bowl combine lettuce corn chips tomato pepperoni olives and cheese.

title: Seven Layer Untossed Salad
instructions: Layer the vegetables as listed. Spread mayonnaise on top of the vegetables. Sprinkle sugar on mayonnaise. Next put on crumbled bacon then add the eggs. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Hazel'S Sticky Buns
instructions: The night before serving Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan well. Spread nuts over bottom of pan. Sprinkle raisins on top. Sprinkle brown sugar over all. Arrange rolls on top with enough room to rise. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over rolls. Melt butter and add second 1/2 cup brown sugar and cinnamon. Pour over rolls. Leave uncovered overnight on counter. Bake next morning at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sherry'S Bacon Spaghetti
instructions: Brown bacon and set aside. Use about 1/3 cup of bacon drippings to saute onions. Add tomato sauce. When spaghetti is done drain and add sauce. Toss with bacon. A whole different taste to spaghetti.

title: Caribbean Banana Chicken
instructions: Flatten chicken arrange ham slice on top. Peel banana and cut into thirds crosswise and cut each third in half. Place 1 banana piece on top of ham slice. Roll chicken-ham-banana like an eggroll enclosing banana and ham inside.

title: Peach Delight Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 round pans 8 or 9 x 1 1/2-inches. Drain peaches reserving syrup. Add enough water to reserved syrup to measure 1 1/4 cups. Prepare cake mix as directed on package except substitute syrup mixture for the water. Pour batter into pans. Bake and cool as directed. Cut peaches into bite size pieces. Mix yogurt and whipped topping; fold in peaches. Fill layers with about half of the peach mixture. Spoon remaining peach mixture over top of cake. Refrigerate 2 hours or until chilled.

title: Easy One Dish Ham Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix broccoli soups 1 cup milk the ham and onion powder in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix Bisquick mix and milk. Pour evenly over soup mixture. Sprinkle with parsley if desired. Bake 27 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except eggs and milk. Stir while cooking over medium heat about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add eggs and milk. Mix well.

title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend together last 4 ingredients in separate bowl. When blended together pour over top of raw cake mixture. Bake as it says on box for time and temperature. Grease bottom of cake pan not sides. Rectangular cake pan works best. When cool sprinkle with 10x sugar.

title: Quick, Easy, Good Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together. Bake until bubbly and dried down good. Also good with wieners or franks buried in mixture.

title: Sugar-Free Cookies
instructions: Mix the eggs margarine sweetener and raisins together then add the dry ingredients which have been mixed together. Mix this together then add the applesauce and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light; add sugar oil and vanilla mixing until thick. Add zucchini and stir. Sift flour and other dry ingredients. Add to other mixture stirring well. Add nuts and lemon rind. Bake in greased cake pans or Bundt cake pan. Bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Blend soup milk and pepper. Arrange alternate layers of potatoes onion and sauce in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Dot top with butter. Cover. Bake in a moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover. Bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish lightly with Pam. Place breasts in single layer in pan. Sprinkle soup mix over chicken. Pour nectar over all. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Delicious.

title: Crab And Shrimp
instructions: Mix all together. Place in greased casserole and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 covered. Serves 6.

title: Christine'S Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes then peel and slice. Cook bacon until crispy; drain fat. Slice onions in same pan as you fried bacon and add water vinegar and sugar. Cover and simmer until onions are soft. Crunch up bacon into pan with onions. Thicken with flour or cornstarch and then add potatoes. Make all gone. Eat and enjoy.

title: The Best Fudge Ever
instructions: Mix butter Velveeta powdered sugar and cocoa together. Add vanilla; mix together. Spread the fudge into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let harden and then cut into squares.

title: Delicious Fried Onions
instructions: Slice onions into thick slices; soak for 30 minutes in bowl of milk. Dip onions into egg then flour. Drop onion slices into hot grease and brown. Salt before serving.

title: Chocolate Pudding Dessert
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and pat in 9 x 13 pan and bake at 300\u00b0 until slightly brown. Let cool. Mix cream cheese 4 1/2 ounces Cool Whip and sugar. Spread on crust. Spread 1/3 of 13 1/2-ounce Cool Whip on top. Mix pudding and milk until thick. Spread on top of mixture then spread remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Crystal Salad
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in saucepan and heat to boiling. Cook for 1 minute on medium heat. Cool. Stir in other ingredients. Chill thoroughly.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch flat cake pan. Bake cake mix according to package directions. While still warm puncture top with holes at 2-inch intervals. Carefully pour Kahlua over top of hot cake. Let cool; cut into cubes. Make up the chocolate mousse. Place 1/2 the cake cubes in bottom of pretty serving bowl. Top with 1/2 the chocolate mousse mixture. Top with 1 carton Cool Whip. Top with 4 crushed Heath bars. Repeat layers except reserve the last 4 crushed Heath bars to place on top of dessert when it is served. Cover with Saran Wrap. Allow to chill for at least six hours. Can be made a day ahead. To serve top with remaining Heath bar pieces and spoon out servings.

title: Cherry-Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Set aside. Combine cake mix cherry pie filling eggs and flavoring. Stir using a wooden spoon until all ingredients are well mixed. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until a wooden toothpick inserted in center come out clean. Set aside to cool.

title: Wheat Germ And Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine oil honey and molasses. Add 1 egg at a time beating after each addition. Add vanilla. Combine soy flour and milk powder. Add raisins nuts salt wheat germ and oatmeal. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients and blend well. Drop by teaspoons on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Gradually add sugar. Beat 5 minutes until sugar is dissolved. Add eggs one at a time plain flour and vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean. Can be baked in a 9 x 13-inch pan or tube pan. Let cool and then sprinkle with powdered sugar or add strawberries and Cool Whip.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pie crust. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 until set and pastry is nicely browned. Approximate cooking time 50 minutes.

title: Ginger Dressing For Fruit
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a small saucepan; gradually add juice stirring until smooth. Bring mixture to a boil over medium heat and boil one minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and cool. Pour over assorted fruits; toss gently chill.

title: B-L-T Soup
instructions: In an 8-quart pot lightly saute diced bacon. Do not remove drippings. Add margarine. Heat until melted. Add chopped lettuce. Saute 3 minutes. Add flour. Stir until well blended. Cook 2 minutes. Add chicken stock tomatoes nutmeg and pepper. Heat until boiling stirring to prevent sticking. When mixture begins to boil add half and half. Warm but do not boil. Serves 12.

title: Rancher'S Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into shell and bake until firm and slightly brown.\tThe center wont be as firm as the other edges but will set when cooled. (Do not overbake.)

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown ground round and onion in a Dutch oven or similar pan. Add the remaining ingredients EXCEPT rice. Bring mixture to a boil; reduce heat. Add rice. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Makes approximately 12 cups.

title: Viennese Toffee Torte
instructions: Mix cool whip and crushed candy bar. Split cake in half lengthwise. Fill and frost cake. Chill and serve.

title: One Egg Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg beating thoroughly. Add flour and milk alternately beginning and ending with flour. Add vanilla. Bake in 2 or 3 layer pans at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 25 minutes depending on number of layers. Cool. Ice with Chocolate Caramel Lemon Buttercream of Strawberry Seven Minute Icing.

title: Mrs. Jimmie Carter'S Cheese Ring
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well. Press into ring mold and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve unmold on plate. Fill center with preserves. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Bonbons
instructions: Melt butter slowly and add milk. Stir in sugar and salt. Add coconut and pecans. Chill until it can be easily handled. Roll in balls. Place in freezer until firm. Melt cocoa and Gulf wax together in the top of double boiler. Remove from heat and dip each candy into chocolate mixture with toothpick quickly and place on wax paper.

title: Hot Spiced Apple Cider
instructions: Fix in coffeepot. Put cider lemonade and orange juice in bottom of pot. Put sugar cinnamon sticks and spices in basket of coffeepot. Perk until done!

title: Watergate Cake With Impeachment Frosting
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a large bowl then beat at medium mixer speed for 2 minutes. Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool on rack.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Put in layers as given and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Use a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan or dish.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well being careful to prevent the cubed chicken from becoming shredded. Serve open face on a leaf of lettuce over a sliced croissant roll garnished with tomato slice dill pickle wedge and potato chips. This recipe keeps well overnight in refrigerator without losing its fresh flavor. Happy Eating!

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Melt margarine. Beat eggs. Combine all ingredients. Chill well. Roll into 1-inch balls and bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Do not add water boil syrup until it hardens (not brittle). Add water the last thing add soda to improve color. Pour over corn mix well and make into balls. Do not pop corn with oil just plain popcorn. Butter your hands very good to keep from sticking.

title: Christmas Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Spread in ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread frosting over bars while hot. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Fruit And Cottage Cheese Salad(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Fold together all ingredients. Do not add water to gelatin! Chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving. Change flavors by using another flavor of gelatin. Omit mandarin orange slices. You may fold in some of the fruit to match the jello flavor.

title: Green Salad
instructions: Dissolve marshmallows in milk in double boiler and bring to boil. Add jello and cream cheese and dissolve. Add pineapple; stir all together. Chill but dont jell. Add Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries and chopped nuts.

title: Toffee Squares
instructions: Cream butter then sugar and others except chocolate and nuts. Spread smoothly thinly and evenly on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 15-20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Melt the chocolate bits by sprinkling over hot dough. Spread chocolate with spatula. It then becomes icing. Sprinkle nuts over top. Cut into 2 inch squares while hot.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook instant rice in chicken broth and water by box instructions and set aside. Saute bell pepper and onion in margarine but leave crisp. Combine cooked rice peppers onions and chicken soup in casserole dish. Sprinkle top with shredded cheese; bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Chocolate Cherry Magic Cake
instructions: Use a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread marshmallows on bottom of pan. Prepare cake mix according to box directions. Spread batter over marshmallows. Sprinkle the dry jello powder over batter. Spoon canned cherry pie filling over. Drizzle water over but do not stir. Carefully place cake in a 350\u00b0 oven. Bake 75 to 80 minutes or until done (until toothpick comes out clean). Let cool at least 30 minutes in pan.

title: 5-Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Yogurt-Pineapple Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add yogurt lemon juice orange rind and coconut extract. Beat until smooth. Stir in pineapple. Cover dip and chill thoroughly. Yields 3 1/2 cups.

title: Sour Cream Chicken
instructions: Lay chicken breast in casserole dish. Place 2 slices of bacon on each breast. Mix sour cream with cream of mushroom soup. Pour over chicken. Do not cover. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Lemon Lime Rainbow Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as box says then pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0. While cake is in oven mix Jell-O as box says; let refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes. When cake is done poke holes in it while still in pan. Pour 1/2 the jello in the holes on cake. (Dont pour too much you dont want it mushy or real wet.) Turn cake over onto cake plate. Put icing on it and serve.

title: Chocolate Treat
instructions: Bake brownies and leave in pan. Top with softened ice cream. Put crushed Oreos on top. Place pan in freezer until ready to serve. Cut into individual pieces. Top with hot fudge whipped cream.

title: Cabbage Roll Casserole
instructions: Cook beef until lightly browned and crumbly. Mix in onion rice salt and pepper; cook 2 to 3 minutes more. Add soup and water; mix thoroughly. Put cabbage in a 2-quart casserole dish. Pour meat mixture over cabbage; do not stir. Cover and bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Beer Biscuits
instructions: *Not 1 bottle. The cook drinks the balance.

title: Scalloped Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: You will need a 6-cup baking dish (capable of being used on stove top).

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Broil beef 4 inches from heat for 4 minutes on each side until browned. Drain beef pat with paper towels. Spray large deep skillet with nonstick spray. Place the beef water tomatoes (with juices) thyme peppercorns and bay leaf in skillet. Bring to boil then reduce heat. Cover; simmer for 2 hours. Add carrots potatoes celery and onions. Cover; simmer over low heat 45 to 60 minutes more or until beef and vegetables are tender adding more water if needed as liquid evaporates.

title: Marilyn Mcconnell'S Meat Casserole
instructions: Mix the browned hamburger garlic salt onion tomato sauce salt and pepper into a pot and simmer 15 minutes. Mix the cooked noodles cream cheese and sour cream and stir into the meat sauce. Turn into a greased casserole; top with mushrooms and grated cheese. Bake for 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: German Chocolate Upside Down Cake
instructions: Grease baking pan. Place coconut and pecans in the pan.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Place 1 1/2 cups cereal in Ziploc bag and crush cereal into crumbs. Combine honey and peanut butter until smooth. Add cereal crumbs. Roll into 1-inch balls. Roll in remaining uncrushed cereal. Chill.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Form dough into 1/2-inch balls and place 1-inch apart on baking sheet. Press down slightly with fork making waffle patterns on top of each cookie. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash; drain well and mash. Combine all ingredients except 1/2 stick of margarine and 1/2 package of stuffing mix. Place all ingredients mixture in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Melt the 1/2 stick margarine and toss with stuffing mix. Spread over top of casserole. Bake uncovered for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Cookie Pie
instructions: Microwave marshmallows and 2 tablespoons milk in medium microwavable bowl on High 45 seconds. Stir. (Marshmallows will be partially melted.) Refrigerate 15 minutes to cool. Stir in 1 cup of the Cool Whip.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Cream eggs and sugar. Add oil; beat until creamy. Add flour salt baking soda and cinnamon. Fold in apples and nuts. Pour into 8 x 15 x 2-inch casserole pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Cheeseburger Soup
instructions: Brown beef; drain and set aside. In same pan saut onion carrots celery basil and parsley in 1 tablespoon butter until tender about 10 minutes. Add broth potatoes and beef; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Melt remaining butter in small skillet. Add flour; cook and stir for 3 to 5 minutes or until bubbly. Add to soup; bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes; reduce heat. Add cheese milk salt and pepper. Cook until cheese melts. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream.

title: Dried Beef Chip Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients into Food Processor and mix until creamy. Chill overnight. Serve with any crackers.

title: Ham-Potato-Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender in salted water. Drain (cut into small pieces) in large saucepan. Melt butter and saut onions until translucent. Add corn salt and pepper. Bring to boil. Adjust heat and simmer 20 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients like a cake; beat it. Pour into a 9-inch square baking pan or glass baking dish. Spread over it the berries 1 cup sugar (if unsweetened) and juice from the fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix together and put in buttered dish.

title: Cranberry Pie-Cake
instructions: Grease a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle cranberries 1/2 cup of the sugar and the walnuts over the pie plate in that order. Beat eggs thoroughly. Add remaining 1 cup sugar butter sour cream and flour; beat only until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour over cranberry mixture in plate. Do not stir. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven until brown on top about 1 hour. Makes about 8 servings. Quite good served warm.

title: Pamadour Pudding
instructions: Scald then cool milk. Combine sugar egg yolks cornstarch salt and vanilla and add to milk. Stir constantly over low heat until thick. Pour into casserole. Cover with meringue made by melting together 2 squares chocolate sugar and milk. When cool add this to stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla. Bake pudding in a pan of water about 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Devil'S Food Delight
instructions: Sift the first 4 ingredients into bowl. Add shortening milk and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer on slow to medium speed for 2 minutes. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl frequently. Add eggs. Continue beating 2 more minutes scraping bowl frequently. Pour batter into prepared pans. Cook at 375\u00b0. Makes 2 layers.

title: Indecent Cookie Bars
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together remaining ingredients and pour on top of crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Oregano
instructions: Put oil in baking dish lay potatoes in bottom of dish. Then add chicken salt and pepper. Sprinkle with oregano salt. Bake at 275 degrees for 2 hrs.

title: Sweetened Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir until smooth.

title: Strawberry And Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water. Bring to a boil. Add Kool-Aid and Jell-O. Cool. Add lemonade mix and pineapple juice. Set overnight and add ginger ale.

title: Cream Of Tomato Soup
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a 2-quart saucepan. Simmer 10 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Melt butter in a 2-quart saucepan; blend in flour. Stir in milk. Cook until thickened. Slowly add hot tomato mixture stirring constantly. Use a whisk to stir this helps.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine shortening eggs and sugar; beat well. Add the rest of ingredients. I roll these and use a cookie cutter but you can roll them in a ball and flatten with a glass dipped in sugar.

title: No Bake Peanut Oat Cookies
instructions: In medium saucepan mix sugar and cocoa. Add milk and butter. Put over medium heat and bring to a boil; boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto foil-lined sheet paper. Let stand until firm and cold. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Layer ingredients in order listed in a greased 9 x 13 dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Cabbage Pie
instructions: Saute chopped cabbage onion and mushrooms in butter. Spread softened cream cheese on bottom of pie crust. Add half of cabbage mixture and top with Mozzarella slices and top with 1/2 grated cheese. Add remaining cabbage mixture and top with Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix together with spoon and put in pie crust. Chill.

title: Puppy Chow For People
instructions: Melt morsels and peanut butter over low heat. Remove pan from burner. Add cereal and stir until well coated. Put 1 cup of confectioners sugar into very large Ziploc bag. Add cereal mixture. Add 1 cup of confectioners sugar. Seal bag and shake gently to coat cereal.

title: Foolproof Apple Cake
instructions: Combine apples and sugar in a bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir well. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine oil vanilla and egg white; stir well. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Stir in apple mixture.

title: Date And Nut Bars
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates and cool. Place shortening sugar salt spices eggs and cooled date mixture in large mixing bowl. Beat until thoroughly blended. Sift together flour and baking soda. Add with nuts to first mixture. Beat until blended. Place mixture in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Spread evenly. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool in pan and cut. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Charcoal Grilled Steaks
instructions: Combine. Pour over steaks and marinate 2 to 3 hours turning occasionally.

title: Snack Mix
instructions: Place popcorn pretzels cereal peanuts and raisins in a large bowl. Add margarine; toss to coat well. Sprinkle with gelatin; toss until evenly coated. Makes 10 cups.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In saucepan melt morsels and butter; stir in crumbs and nuts. Press half of mixture firmly into bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat cheese until fluffy; beat condensed milk vanilla and egg. Pour on top of pressed crumbs. Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool at room temperature. Chill before cutting. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Apricot Squares
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and oats. Cut in butter until crumbly. Pat mixture into 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan. (Save some of the mixture.) Spread jam over bottom layer. Cover with remaining crumbs. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Serves 12 To 14)
instructions: Saute onions in 1/2 cup butter until tender. Combine everything except stuffing and pour into two lightly greased casserole dishes. Melt remaining 1/2 cup butter and stir into stuffing mix to use as topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Stew
instructions: Cook chicken. Cool and pull chicken off bones. Cut in small pieces. Combine corn onion potatoes and soup in chicken broth. Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers in a 1-quart (Tupperware) casserole. Cook on High 4 to 8 minutes in the microwave. Serve hot on snack crackers.

title: Dried Beef Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Bake in a small baking dish at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Top with pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Low Fat Bran Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix flour baking soda baking powder and cinnamon in large bowl. Mix cereal milk and sugar in another. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in egg and applesauce. Add to flour mixture. Stir until moistened. Spoon in muffin tins sprayed with oil 2/3 full. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Quick Peanutty Popcorn Balls
instructions: In a saucepan mix corn syrup and sugar. Cook over medium heat; stir constantly until mixture comes to a boil and sugar is completely dissolved. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Immediately pour mixture over popcorn in large bowl. Stir until well coated. Grease hands and shape into 8 (2 1/2-inch) balls.

title: Shanghai Chicken Wings
instructions: Set aside wings. Mix rest of ingredients together. Pour over wings. Marinate 8 hours or more. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve warm with plenty of napkins.

title: Cranberry Fruit Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Combine cranberries and sugar; set aside. Stir together flour cereal baking powder salt cinnamon baking soda and cloves. Combine eggs milk and oil. Pour over dry ingredients. Add cranberries and nuts. Stir only until thoroughly moistened. Pour into pan(s). Bake 65 to 70 minutes (big pans) or until tester comes out clean. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: In heavy saucepan melt butter with milk. Blend in ground chocolate and salt. Remove from heat. Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer about 5 minutes or until smooth and glossy.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Melt butter in large flat casserole dish. Add soup water seasoning and rice. Lay chicken on rice mixture. Sprinkle with salt and 1 teaspoon paprika. Bake for 3 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar milk cocoa and butter to a boil. Add vanilla flavoring peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix well and drop on wax paper.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Boil water add tea bags. Set aside for 30 minutes. Add spices. Let set for 15 minutes. Add all the juices and serve hot.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Put margarine in an 8 x 10-inch baking dish and melt in oven. Remove. In a large bowl beat eggs well then add flour milk salt and baking powder. Mix well. Add cheese spinach and onion. Mix well. Put into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cut into squares when cooled about 20 minutes. Preparation time 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Drops
instructions: Mix butter milk sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add coconut and pecans. Form balls and freeze over night. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in top of double boiler. Keep warm and dip in this mixture. Yield 100 servings.

title: Mary'S Cheese Ball(Makes 2)
instructions: Combine all but last two ingredients then add onions. Divide in half. Form into balls. Roll in pecans.

title: Baking Powder Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Cut shortening into flour in which baking powder and salt were added. Add milk. Mix well. Roll out to 3/4-inch thickness. Spread with melted butter sugar and cinnamon. Roll as log. Cut about 1-inch thick and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until browned.

title: Mama'S Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add beaten eggs. Warm milk on stove then add egg mixture. Cook slowly in double boiler until milk coats spoon. Cool. Add 2 teaspoons vanilla. Makes 1 gallon ice cream.

title: Easy, Any Meat Casserole
instructions: Mix together macaroni meat peas cheese and onion. Mix soup and milk. Add to first mixture. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese and paprika on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Leave at room temperature 1 hour before baking. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Beat together for 15 minutes on medium speed oleo confectioners sugar eggs and vanilla. After beating together 15 minutes pour mixture into graham cracker crusts. Slice bananas. Put on top of each pie. Spread pineapple over bananas. Spread Cool Whip equal over both pies. Sprinkle chopped pecans over Cool Whip. Put a maraschino cherry on each slice and one on the middle. Drizzle chocolate syrup over pies. Cool in freezer 1 hour.

title: Pecan Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 3 (9-inch) layer cake pans. In a large bowl cream the butter. Gradually add the sugar; beat until fluffy. Add the beaten eggs and melted chocolate. Sift the dry ingredients; blend in alternately with the milk. Add the nuts and vanilla. Pour into prepared pans. Bake for 35 minutes or until the center of the cake feels solid. Cool and remove the layers from the pans. Fill and frost.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions and salt and pepper. Cook noodles until tender. In large baking dish combine ground beef and noodles. Pour spaghetti sauce over mixture; stir well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. During the last 10 minutes sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over casserole and finish baking.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Will need a spring cake pan.

title: Molded Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together gelatin sugar and salt. Let cool and add all ingredients except cream cheese and whip cream. Pour cream into bowl and cut cream cheese into small pieces. Whip together and fold into fruit ingredients. Chill 4 hours.

title: Cream Caramels
instructions: Bring sugar corn syrup butter and 1 cup cream slowly to a boil stirring constantly. Stir in gradually 1 more cup cream. Stir frequently as mixture begins to thicken constantly as it darkens. Cook to 254\u00b0 (a little dropped into cold water forms a hard ball). Pour into buttered 7-inch square pan with 1/2 cup broken nuts scattered over the bottom. When cold cut into squares. Makes 5 dozen caramels.

title: Baked Yams
instructions: Mash yams. Add juice from pineapple sugar and butter beating well. Add pineapple and pecans. Spoon mixture into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle on marshmallows. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Lazy Lady Bread Or Rolls(No Kneading)
instructions: Combine 1 cup boiling water and milk in a bowl; add 3 teaspoons sugar and margarine. Mix well. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add to milk mixture. Mix well; set aside. Sift flour salt and 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar together in large bowl. Make well in center; pour liquid ingredients into flour mixture. Mix thoroughly. Cover with waxed paper. Let rise until doubled. Divide in half. Shape into 2 loaves. Place in greased loaf pans. Let rise until double in bulk. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes longer or until golden brown.

title: Chicken And Port Wine Ragout
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with black pepper. Heat oil in a skillet large enough to hold chicken in one layer. Add chicken skin side down and brown on one side. Turn and brown on the other side. The time for browning is approximately 15 minutes. Add onion garlic parsley basil tomato sauce and 2/3 cup of wine. Cover and cook 25 to 30 minutes. Add remaining wine. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes and stir to blend. Serve over bed of white rice. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Mandarin
instructions: Coat chicken with flour. In skillet heat oil and margarine; brown the chicken. Drain off fat. Drain mandarin oranges saving juice. Mix juice with lemon juice honey soy sauce orange juice and ginger. Pour sauce over chicken cover and simmer 45 minutes or until tender. Remove chicken thicken with cornstarch. Add chicken and mandarin oranges. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Imperial
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken and salt in saucepan and blend over medium heat for 2 to 5 minutes until smooth. Salt chicken on both sides and place in an ungreased oblong pan skin side down. Brush chicken generously with sauce using about 3/4 of sauce. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover turn chicken and add the rest of the sauce and continue baking for 30 minutes or until tender. Yield 4 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix dressing. Pour over other ingredients. Stir well. Marinate overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt oleo and peanut butter. Add vanilla and sugar and beat well. Pour into a buttered cake pan and refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Fish In Tomato Sauce On Barbecue Pit
instructions: Place onions and parsley in olive oil and saute for a little while. Add garlic and then the rest of the ingredients except fish. Cook until the onions are nearly done. Pour sauce over fish to be baked on the pit in a boat made from aluminum foil.

title: Brown Sugar (Dark Karo) Peanut Brittle
instructions: Butter large cookie sheet and sides of 3-quart saucepan. In saucepan combine sugar brown sugar or dark Karo corn syrup water butter or margarine and salt. Bring to boil stirring to dissolve sugar. Clip candy thermometer to side of pan. Cook over medium heat with gentle boil to 275\u00b0 (syrup turns a deep golden color) stirring constantly. Stir in peanuts; continue cooking stirring often until 295\u00b0. Remove from heat; quickly stir in baking soda. Immediately pour hot mixture onto buttered cookie sheet. If desired pull with forks to stretch thin; cool. Break into pieces. Makes about 2 1/4 pounds of candy.

title: Recipe For A Happy Marriage
instructions: Flavor with frequent portions of recreation and a dash of happy memories. Stir well and remove any specks of jealousy temper or criticism. Sweeten well with generous portions of love and keep warm with a steady flame of devotion. Never serve with cold shoulder or hot tongue.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed. When cool crumble 1/2 of cake in punch bowl.

title: Sweet-Sour Cabbage
instructions: Cook in bacon grease. Add caraway seeds and 1 beef bouillon cube. Cook cabbage 15 minutes no more.

title: Swiss Fondue
instructions: Mix cheese with cornstarch salt pepper and paprika. In a chafing dish heat buttermilk with garlic clove over low heat. When hot remove garlic and add cheese. Stir constantly until cheese is melted. Serve from chafing dish. Each person helps himself from the common dish dipping chunks of bread speared on long forks into the cheese sauce.

title: Double Decker Fudge
instructions: Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with foil. Put 1 cup peanut butter chips in medium bowl. Set aside. In second medium bowl blend 1/4 cup melted butter cocoa and vanilla until smooth. Add 1 cup peanut butter chips. In heavy 4-quart saucepan combine sugar Marshmallow Creme evaporated milk and 1/4 cup butter. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until mixture comes to a rolling boil. Boil and stir 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Immediately add half of the mixture to bowl with peanut butter chips only. Pour remainder into cocoa mixture and stir to blend. Beat peanut butter mixture until chips are completely melted. Spread evenly in prepared pan.

title: Roxies Petite Gateaus
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream butter and both sugars add eggs and vanilla. Then mix together all dry ingredients; add to cream mixture mix well.\tAdd remaining ingredients; roll into balls place two inches apart on a cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes. Makes about 100 cookies.

title: Fruit Topper
instructions: Mix all together. Drop on fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tortilla Soup(Soup)
instructions: Drain pimentos reserving liquid. In medium saucepan cook onion and cumin in margarine over medium heat for 2-3 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Stir in reserved pimentos juice chicken broth corn and parsley. Heat to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Homemade Pizza
instructions: Mix crust by package directions. Bake until light brown 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Spectacular
instructions: In bowl empty the container of cottage cheese. Sprinkle with dry jello. Add pineapple and oranges. Mix and add Cool Whip. Mix again until thoroughly combined. Chill overnight.

title: Dorito Dip
instructions: Layer each of the ingredients. Make beans on bottom and cheese on top.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Stir all together and roll into a ball. Keep refrigerated.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: *I like Van Camps the best.

title: Sauerkraut
instructions: I cook my pork before and cut it up in small pieces then add to the sauerkraut mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 several hours.

title: Stuffed Hot Peppers
instructions: Clean hot peppers and take out seeds. Stuff with sauerkraut. Cook sugar vinegar and mustard seed until it comes to a boil. Pour over hot peppers that are packed in jars. Cold pack for 20 minutes.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
instructions: Combine beaten eggs brown sugar vanilla and water in bowl; mix well. Stir in flour and candy. Add coconut and pecans; mix well. Drop by tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool completely. Yield 24 servings.

title: Angel Crisp Cookies
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugars. Add other ingredients in order given. Roll into balls the size of a walnut; dip top in sugar. Place on cookie sheet sugar side up and bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Hull out loaf of pumpernickel bread and put dip in loaf. Use pieces of bread to dip with.

title: Hawaii Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into lined pie shell.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease cookie sheets. Combine in a large bowl all ingredients. Stir until moistened. Roll into balls about the size of walnuts. Place on cookie sheets about 1 1/2-inches apart. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until light golden brown. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Christmas Puffs
instructions: Beat egg whites with salt. Add brown sugar. Continue beating. Add pecans. Put on greased cookie sheet 1 teaspoon-size or small as possible. Bake 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions and add margarine. Put 1/2 batter in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 12 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Melt caramels with 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Takes 4 or 5 minutes in microwave. Pour melted caramels over baked cake mixture. Sprinkle chips and nuts over this. Add remaining cake batter and spread over top. Bake 30 minutes. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Orange Rice
instructions: Combine orange juice and salt in skillet bring quickly to a boil. Stir in rice. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Play Doh
instructions: Dip large macaroni into different food colors for a few seconds. Lay the macaroni on paper towels until it dries. Cut a piece of yarn long enough to make a necklace or bracelet. Wrap it at one end with transparent tape. Tie a piece of macaroni at the other end. String the macaroni. Then untie the piece of macaroni and tie the yarn ends together.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix fruit and nuts and coat with the flour baking powder and salt. Separate eggs and beat whites stiff; add last. Beat yolks and add to mixture with sugar beaten with yolks and add vanilla ad 1 cup of orange juice. Pour other cup of orange juice over cakes after baking before wrapping with foil. Grease tins (bread tins fruit cake tins or a tube pan). Bake 2 hours at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 in tube tin and others depend on the size of tin and the size you make the cakes. Small ones bake in 1 hour. Test with toothpick in center to see if done.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Blend Oreos cream cheese and sugar together. Mix until thick the pudding milk and vanilla. Add the Cool Whip. Layer in a bowl cookie mixture then pudding mixture and repeat ending with cookie mixture.

title: Raspberry Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Coat a 12-cup muffin tin or a 6-cup jumbo tin with vegetable cooking spray or line with papers. Mix flour baking soda and salt in a medium bowl; set aside. Beat melted butter and eggs until combined; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Mix in half of dry ingredients. Mix in yogurt; add remaining dry ingredients. Mix until incorporated.

title: Sunshine Golden Yellow Cake
instructions: In mixing bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add the 3/4 cup milk and the Crisco. Beat vigorously by hand or at medium speed of electric mixer for 2 minutes. Add eggs the 1/2 cup milk and the vanilla. Beat 2 minutes more. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch round layer pans or a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Melt 1 cup (8 ounces) of chocolate chips and margarine in saucepan. Mix flour sugar baking soda eggs and vanilla. Add melted chips and butter. Put mixture in greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle top with remaining chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Cookies
instructions: Mix zucchini sugar oil egg and vanilla. Stir in the rest of the ingredients. Drop mixture by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolk nutmeg baking soda and flour. Stir in milk and vanilla until a stiff dough forms. Chill 15 minutes if desired. Roll out on lightly floured board; cut with round cookie cutter about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes or until brown.

title: Old Fashioned Corn Meal Mush
instructions: Mix the corn meal flour and sugar with the cold water then stir into the boiling water to which the salt has been added. When thoroughly mixed cover tightly. Reduce the heat to the lowest point and let simmer for 30 minutes or longer stirring occasionally to prevent lumping. Then turn off the heat and let steam for 30 minutes without lifting the cover. Serve warm with milk or cream or pour into a greased loaf pan. When cool slice and fry. Serve with syrup.

title: Fish Soup
instructions: In large saucepan saute onion celery and garlic in margarine or batter until tender. Stir in tomatoes wine parsley salt pepper and thyme. Cover. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add fish and simmer for 7 to 10 minutes or until fish is opaque and flakes easily with fork.

title: Best Ever Banana Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Do not double recipe. Yields one 9 x 5-inch loaf.

title: Honey Nut Grahams
instructions: Melt the butter/sugar. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes. Pour mixture over grahams. Sprinkle nuts. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken. Remove meat from bones. Place meat in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix chicken broth with cream of celery soup and pour over chicken. Mix Bisquick with milk (mixture will be thin). Pour over chicken. Top with melted margarine. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon-Zucchini Rice
instructions: Bring broth water salt and pepper to a boil in saucepan. Add rice. Return to boiling. Lower heat; simmer covered 20 minutes. Set aside covered 5 minutes. Uncover and fluff rice with a fork. Add zucchini and lemon juice.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix together well. Roll out in 3 small rolls and put on shiny side of aluminum foil. Let stand 24 hours in refrigerator. Punch holes in bottom of foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in broiler pan.

title: Strawberry Pretzels
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes.

title: Raspberry Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in 13 x 9 pan at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Beef Tenderloin
instructions: Marinate beef for 30 minutes in combination of French vinaigrette dressing and Dales steak sauce half and half. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Place bacon on top of tenderloin. Cook 10 to 11 minutes per pound. Enjoy immediately. Sauteed mushrooms go great with this.

title: Ranch Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: In small mixing bowl beat the cream cheese and salad dressing. Mix until smooth. Add onions and mix well. Spread about 3 tablespoons over each tortilla. Top with ham slices. Roll up tightly and wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate until firm. Unwrap and cut into 3/4-inch slices. Yields about 7 1/2 dozen.

title: George Jr.'S Mustard Chicken
instructions: Heat butter and oil in casserole and brown chicken. Season to taste with salt and pepper and remove. In fat remaining cook onions until brown. Add flour milk mustard and chicken broth. Return chicken to skillet and cook under low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Cocoa Fudge
instructions: Butter pan and set aside. Stir together cocoa sugar salt and milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a full rolling boil. Let boil (do not stir) until soft ball stage (forms a ball when dropped in cold water). Remove from heat; add vanilla and butter but do not stir. Cool to lukewarm and then stir until fudge starts to thicken. Spread into buttered pan.

title: Beet Pickles
instructions: To cook beets wash and drain. Leave 2 inches of stems and the top roots. Cover with boiling water and cook until tender. Combine all ingredients except beets; simmer 15 minutes. Pack beets into hot jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Remove cinnamon. Bring liquid to boil. Pour boiling hot over beets leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process pints and quarts 30 minutes in boiling water bath about 6 pints.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Stir the flour into the sugar well. Add the pecans. Top casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sue Hammer'S Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and slice as thin as possible. Chop onions and peppers; combine cucumbers onions and peppers. Mix salt in enough water to cover. Let stand 3 hours. Combine vinegar sugar and spices. Bring to a boil. Add drained cucumbers onions and peppers. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Pack in sterilized hot jars. Cover with liquid and seal. Yield 12 to 15 pints.

title: Sinful Pie
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate. Mix the eggs and sugar. Add vanilla rum cinnamon and orange peel. Fold in melted ingredients. Pour into graham shell. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts and coconut in the bottom of the pan. Mix cake acccording to directions on box; pour over nuts and coconut. Beat powdered sugar and cream cheese together. Add melted margarine. Beat until smooth. Add vanilla and pour over cake mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Let cool 10 minutes and invert on a serving dish if desired.

title: Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Combine Parmesan cheese Cheddar cheese crumbs monosodium glutamate thyme salt basil and pepper. Blend well. Dip chicken pieces into melted butter. Roll in crumb mixture. Arrange chicken in single layer in ovenware dish. Cover with plastic wrap poking several holes in the plastic wrap. Cook chicken for 10 minutes. Serve hot or cold. May be garnished with parsley. Total cooking time 10 minutes. Recipe yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Schweinbraten(Roast Pork)
instructions: Sprinkle pork with onion salt marjoram and pepper. Secure on spit; insert thermometer. Adjust spit about 8 inches from heat source placing foil pan under pork to catch drippings. Roast 15 minutes or bake uncovered on rack at 350\u00b0 until the thermometer registers 170\u00b0 to 185\u00b0 according to family taste. Allow 35 to 40 minutes per pound for roasting. Shortly before serving combine in skillet the sauerkraut thinly sliced apples cider and butter. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until apples are tender. Garnish with extra apple slices and parsley. Serve with pork.

title: Tiger Butter
instructions: In a 2 quart microwave dish melt white chocolate at medium (50% power) stir in peanut butter. Spread this mixture on a waxpaper coated cookie sheet. Immediately melt a 6 oz. package of semisweet chocolate chips at medium power for 3 to 5 minutes and drizzle over the peanut butter layer. With knife swirl mixture. Refrigerate until firm then break into pieces.

title: Blueberry Pie Marnier
instructions: Spread 2 cups blueberries in pie crust. Refrigerate until well chilled. Simmer remaining 2 cups berries sugar water cornstarch and salt in heavy saucepan until thickened stirring constantly about 7 minutes. Remove from heat. Mix in Grand Marnier and butter. Cool completely. Pour blueberry sauce over berries in pie crust. Refrigerate until well chilled. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Dice up red onion. Mix 3/4 cup cheese pecans 1/2 cup bacon bits and 2 cups broccoli tops.

title: Apple Pandowdy
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry for 8-inch two crust pie as directed on package. Stir together apple slices and brown sugar. Turn into pastry lined pie pan. Top with butter and 3 tablespoons of the syrup. Cover with top crust which has slits cut in it. Seal and flute. Bake 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Make crisscross cuts about 1-inch apart through top crust and filling. Drizzle remaining syrup on top. Cover edge with 2 to 3-inch strips of aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning. Bake 25 minutes longer. Serve warm and if you wish pour on additional syrup.

title: Sunday Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 on Sunday morning before Sunday school. Peel carrots and potatoes and leave in large chunks; set aside. Pam the bottom of the roasting pan with lid. Put chuck roast in pan and place raw vegetables on top and around the roast. Sprinkle garlic salt and chili powder on meat and vegetables. Place onion rings on top and pour your favorite barbecue sauce over it all. Put in oven at 930 a.m. and you have a wonderful meal when you get home!

title: Cherry Pie
instructions: Combine juice sugar flour salt and lemon. Cook until thick; add butter. Pour over cherries in an 8-inch pastry lined pie pan. Cut strips of pie dough for twisted lattice top crust. Flute edge and trim. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. If fresh cherries are used increase sugar to 1/2 cup.

title: Tex-Mex Enchiladas
instructions: Prepare chili as directed on package using ground beef water and tomato sauce. Place approximately 2 tablespoons chili on each tortilla; roll tightly. Place seam side down in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Top with remaining chili. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with process cheese cubes and bake uncovered for 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on box drain and cool. Mix chopped eggs celery pimentos and onion; add to cooked pasta. Pour Italian dressing over mixture; add pepper and salt. Toss to coat. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Toss before serving.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
instructions: Wash scrape and slice carrots. Cook in boiling water until tender. Melt butter in skillet. Stir in mint leaves; let stand. Add carrots salt brown sugar and honey. Cook until well glazed. Turn often.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: El Slop O
instructions: Brown ground beef drain. Add onion and pepper.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Combine ingredients (mixture will be soft). Shape into walnut-size balls. Place in single layer on wax-paper-lined cookie sheets and freeze until solid. Store in freezer bags until ready to cook.

title: Bread
instructions: Take it out and roll it in hand. Put it in the black thing. Then put in the stove 5000\u00b0 for 40 minutes. After it cooks we eat its good!

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix all together. Form small balls. Roll in coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Creamy Egg Nog Pie
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine pudding mix 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg and egg nog. Mix well. Over medium heat cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in rum. Cool. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon into pie shell. Chill 4 hours or more.

title: Microwave Apples
instructions: Peel core and slice apples. In a 2-quart casserole dish place apples and water cover and microwave 10 to 15 minutes or until tender. Stir once during cooking. Stir in sugar and spices. Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Serves well warm or cold.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and powdered sugar; press firmly into bottom of a cooled 9-inch (deep) shell.

title: Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Drain pineapple liquid into a measuring cup. Add enough milk to make 1 cup. Combine egg and orange rind. In separate bowl sift together flour sugar baking powder salt and nutmeg. Blend milk mixture into dry ingredients along with melted butter mixing just until batter is blended. Stir in crushed pineapple. Spoon into lightly buttered muffin pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden and set. Cool slightly. Then remove from pan and serve warm. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Orange Chiffon Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Set out but do not grease a 10-inch tube pan. Stir flour sugar baking powder and salt. Make a well in the mixture and add egg substitute orange juice oil and orange peel and mix until smooth. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Pour first mixture slowly over egg whites and fold gently with spatula until just blended. Spoon batter into tube pan. Bake in lower third of oven for 50 to 55 minutes. Invert and let cool completely before removing from pan. Run a thin knife up and down between cake and pan to loosen and remove. Drizzle Orange Glaze over top and sides of cake. Makes 16 servings.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes
instructions: Prick potatoes and place in oven. Microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender. Cut potatoes in half. Carefully scoop cooked potato out of shells and into mixing bowl. Add butter milk salt and pepper. Mash until lump free. Fill potato shells; top with cheese and place on glass serving platter. Continue cooking on High for 4 to 5 minutes. Let stand 3 minutes before serving. Makes 4 to 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Salad
instructions: In a large pot cover sweet potatoes with water. Add salt and bring to a boil over moderately high heat. Cook until just tender about 10 minutes; drain well. Refresh with cold water and drain again.

title: Giant Tacos
instructions: Brown meat and chopped onions. Add other ingredients. Simmer about 20 minutes stirring several times. Put amount of regular Fritos on your plate that you think you need. Add the meat mixture sharp grated cheese chopped lettuce and fresh chopped tomatoes.

title: Hamburg Stuffing
instructions: Cook meat together in frying pan and put aside. Mix hot water bread Bell seasoning and onion powder. Add egg and mix. Add meat and mix together. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0 or use as stuffing for turkey.

title: Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in a single layer slightly overlapping. Combine remaining ingredients. Brush potatoes with 1/2 oil mixture. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes basting occasionally with the rest of the oil mixture. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Melt butter and cheese together (I use microwave) and beat with mixer until fluffy. Fold in picked crab meat. Freezes well. Will make enough dip for 15 hungry people along with other foods. Also delicious over baked potatoes.

title: Cherry Fruit Squares
instructions: Put 2/3 of dough in pan. Then put fruit filling on top then the rest of dough on top in globs. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Make a glaze of powdered sugar and water and drizzle over top.

title: Fireside Casserole
instructions: Heat large skillet. Add beef onion and garlic; brown about 5 minutes. Drain off fat. Stir in tomatoes beans cumin salt oregano Tabasco and bay leaf. Spoon mixture into 2-quart baking dish. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Uncover. Bake 15 minutes longer until heated through. You can add grated cheese and let melt and brown.

title: Hawaiian Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed. Drain juice from oranges pineapples and cherries. In small bowl mix together eggs flour sugar and salt. Mix into fruit juice and cook until lightly thickened. Cool then mix with macaroni. Refrigerate overnight. Add fruit and Cool Whip.

title: Prune Coffee Cake
instructions: Cut prunes into pieces discarding pits and set aside. Cream margarine and sugar until light. Add eggs beating well after each addition. Toss flour baking powder and salt into the mix. Add vanilla almond and milk alternating additions. Fold in prunes to distribute evenly.

title: 3 Bean Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon to a crisp. Brown onion and hamburger. Discard all grease. Drain kidney beans and butter beans. Add all ingredients together and cook to blend.

title: Mama'S Orange Julius
instructions: Crunch ice cubes and water in blender until fairly smooth. Add remaining ingredients and blend until smooth.

title: Apple Chunks
instructions: Place apples in casserole dish sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on High in microwave 7 to 8 minutes. I usually double everything.

title: Strawberry Shortcut Cake
instructions: Generously grease bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle marshmallows on bottom of pan. In a bowl combine strawberries syrup and gelatin thoroughly; set aside.

title: Chewy Squares
instructions: Mix and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut while warm.

title: Easy Low-Fat Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. With mixer beat cheese until fluffy gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Toss chips with flour and stir into cheese mixture. Pour into crust. Bake for 35 minutes or until center springs back when touched. Serve chilled. Refrigerate.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Add eggs and prunes. Sift flour salt soda and spices together. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk to prune mixture. Add vanilla and pecans. Pour into lightly greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Pour icing on cake while cake is still warm. Cake is best if baked a couple of days before serving.

title: Pecan Muffins
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt and pecans and mix well. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Fill greased muffin pans half full and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: In frying pan brown hamburger with onion salt and pepper. Drain off grease. Separately fix potatoes according to box. In casserole dish put browned hamburger. Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the hamburger. Place cheese slices on top. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Texas Corn Bread
instructions: Mix well all ingredients except for cheese. Put 3 tablespoons corn oil in deep iron skillet. Heat. Sprinkle with corn meal. Pour in half the batter. Sprinkle with the cheese then pour in remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour oleo vanilla eggs milk and coconut. Put in unbaked pie shell. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Favorite Carrot Salad
instructions: Combine carrots raisins celery and nuts. Blend mayonnaise and salt. Mix lightly with carrot mixture. Chill.

title: Breakfast Strata
instructions: Cook and crumble the sausage. Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch oven dish. Refrigerate 12 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm and golden brown on top.

title: Candy Basic
instructions: Make 3 balls in 3 bowls (after mixing together first 3 ingredients). Then add extract. Roll round balls and chill. Dip into melted chocolate (use double boiler) with toothpick.

title: Meat Ball Soup
instructions: Heat broth to simmer. Mix beef egg salt pepper and oregano. Shape in 1 1/2-inch balls. Drop in broth. Add onions celery carrots cabbage tomatoes noodles bay leaf basil and parsley. Simmer 35 minutes. Stir occasionally. Discard bay leaf. Stir in soy sauce. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar and vanilla. Add beaten eggs. Dissolve soda in boiling water. Mix flour oats raisins and nuts to first mixture. Drop onto greased cookie sheet by teaspoon. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Colorful Vegetable Medley
instructions: Place 1 inch of water in a saucepan; add carrots. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 4 minutes. Add asparagus; simmer 3 to 5 minutes longer or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Drain. In a saucepan melt butter over medium heat; stir in the vinegar Worcestershire sauce thyme and ginger. Add carrots asparagus water chestnuts and parsley. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients together 3 times. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Mushroom Roll-Ups
instructions: Cut off crust from each slice of bread. Roll slices thin and flat with rolling pin. Saute mushrooms in butter for five minutes. Stir in flour until well blended. Stir in cream or milk; cook stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in salt m.s.g. chives and lemon juice. Remove from heat. Place one to two teaspoons of the mixture on each slice of bread and roll up like a jelly roll. Butter the top side of each with the softened butter. Freeze. When ready to serve cut in half and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until light brown.

title: Divinity Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar Karo and water until it forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water. Beat slowly into well beaten egg whites (beat with mixer). Add nuts and vanilla. When it begins to thicken drop by the spoonful on heavy waxed paper. Pack in airtight bowl.

title: Sunday Cornbread
instructions: In a bowl mix cornmeal flour and sugar. Combine butter eggs and buttermilk together. Pour into dry ingredients and mix well. Pour in to a hot oil skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown.

title: *Old Fashioned Taffy
instructions: Combine together and boil until it forms soft ball in water. Grease plate; pour in and cool until you can pick up in hand and work with it. Pull until you cant pull anymore. Roll into sticks. Put on greased plate and cool then break it with knife. (It will be brittle.)

title: Shrimp Curry
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add celery and green pepper; cook until soft. Add soup shrimp water and rice; heat and add olives. Mix and serve.

title: Baked Apple Crunch
instructions: Arrange apples in greased 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with water. Combine tapioca sugar cinnamon raisins and pecans. Spread over apples. Mix oats flour and brown sugar; cut in butter or margarine until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Cover bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan with crushed Ritz crackers. Saute onions in margarine; put on top of crushed crackers. Beat egg and pour into a 1-cup measuring cup. Fill remainder of cup with milk. Add this mixture to cream of mushroom soup; pour over onions. Sprinkle with crackers or cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 minutes.

title: Freezer Pickles (Sweet)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let stand 2 hours Stir once in a while. Drain and rinse. Add 1 1/2 cups sugar stir to dissolve; add 1 1/2 cups vinegar mix and put in freezer cartons or jars and put in freezer. Let stand 1 week before using.

title: Coffee Cake(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Spray spring-form pan with vegetable spray. Combine ingredients except apple. Spread in pan. Arrange apple slices around outside edge of dough.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Thaw potatoes and pat dry. Spread rolls on the bottom and up the sides of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer sausage half of eggs onion pepper and then other half of eggs. Put cheese on top. Bake for 50 or 60 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
