instructions: Brown meat; drain off excess fat. Layer ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Combine macaroni eggs milk salt pepper and cheese in a bowl. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until set. Yields 4 servings.

title: Cheese Pie
instructions: Place one pie crust on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Slice the Mexican Velveeta cheese thin and place on uncooked crust leaving about an inch around edge. On top of Velveeta place the Montery Jack cheese sliced thin. Layer the green chilies and pinto beans on top of cheese. Top with second pie crust and seal the edges. Beat an egg and brush the top crust.

title: Split Lemon Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed using 8 or 9 inch round pans.

title: Spicy Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown the ground meat; boil the chicken with onion and pepper. Drain excess grease from ground meat and water from chicken. Add hot links; mix well. Heat enchilada sauce and refried beans. Dip tortilla in sauce; spread refried beans on tortilla. Add meat; sprinkle small amount of cheese and fold with seams side down. Add remaining cheese on top and pour remaining sauce over top. Bake until cheese melts. If desired sprinkle chopped olives sour cream and guacamole (spicy or mild). Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Eagle Brand Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix together all drained fruit and lemon juice. Mix together Eagle Brand and Cool Whip. Fold into fruit. Pour into pie crust. Decorate with green or red cherries according to season.

title: Grandma'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs raisins and vanilla and let stand for 1 hour. Mix oleo and sugars. Add eggs and raisins then add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Jim'S Little Ribs
instructions: Prepare ribs by wiping with wet towel. Place in single layer in shallow roasting pan. Roast at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes turning once. Prepare basting sauce. Mix all ingredients. Remove ribs from oven. Brush with sauce on both sides. Return to oven. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes longer or until tender. Baste from time to time while baking. Serves 4.

title: Souper Burger
instructions: Brown beef and onion in shortening; stir to separate meat particles. Add seasonings and soup. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes to blend flavors. Stir often. Serve on buns. Makes 6 servings.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Salt and pepper steak dip steak in flour and pound flour into steak with side of saucer until it wont hold any more. Heat oil in skillet and cut meat into serving size; brown. Remove steak and place in small roasting pan. Place tomatoes into skillet and heat through until thick. Add small amount of flour if necessary. Place cut vegetables over meat and cover with thickened tomatoes. Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until browned. Yields 6 servings.

title: Green Enchiladas
instructions: Fry ground beef and onions in large frying pan. Add the 3 cans of soup and milk to meat mixture. Mix well. Stir in green chilies and simmer while preparing tortillas. Dip tortillas in hot oil (or water) for a few seconds to soften. After all tortillas are ready spread bottom of baking dish with just enough meat mixture to cover bottom of dish. Layer tortillas on top of this overlapping tortillas. Spoon more meat mixture over tortillas and sprinkle with cheese. Put another layer of tortillas meat and cheese. Layer until all meat mixture is used ending with meat and cheese. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbling. (Chicken can be used instead of beef.)

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: In a large skillet saute onions and peppers in margarine. Add flour and cook until golden brown. Remove from heat; blend in milk salt and dry mustard. Return to heat; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add corn (drained) and egg (slightly beaten). Stir to blend. Place in a baking dish; sprinkle paprika on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Mozzarella-Tomato Canapes
instructions: Place Mozzarella slice on cracker. Sprinkle with some of chopped basil and top with tomato slice. Repeat with remaining crackers. Arrange on serving platter. Serve at room temperature. Makes 12 appetizers.

title: Marinated Cole Slaw
instructions: Begin by shredding (not chopping) cabbage. Spread onions and bell peppers over top of cabbage. Sprinkle with sugar. In a saucepan bring oil vinegar and all the dry ingredients to a rolling boil. Pour over the cabbage. Mix thoroughly. Cool before serving. Serves 10.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain well. In a large pan mix tomato paste and tomato special with chopped mushrooms chopped garlic and onion. Stir in drained meat. Simmer 2 to 4 hours.

title: Ham And Cabbage Cajun Style
instructions: In a large frying pan place oil sliced cabbage cubed ham sliced mushrooms crushed red pepper salt and pepper. Cook on medium heat uncovered stirring occasionally. Cook until cabbage is tender. Add Louisiana hot sauce to taste then cook another 5 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Drain and add cheese and oleo. Blend well and add sour cream. Pour into casserole dish and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Vanilla Pudding Dessert
instructions: Bake cake mix in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan as directed on package. Mix pudding until thickened and fold in drained pineapple. Pour mixture over baked cake. Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts. Can be made a day ahead.

title: Rice Cooker Jambalaya
instructions: Add all ingredients raw (do not cook before putting in cooker). Season to taste. Cook for about 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Heat water and Milnot until hot. Mix 3/4 cup sugar cocoa flour and salt. Add hot milk and cook until almost thick. Beat egg yolks. Pour 1/2 of mix in egg yolks. Stir pour back in pan and cook until thick. Pour in a 9-inch baked pie shell.

title: Melting Moments
instructions: Mix flour cornstarch and sugar in bowl. Blend in butter until a soft dough is formed. If dough is too soft to handle cover and chill. Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Roll in coconut. Place 1 1/2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Crush cookies into cake pan and pour hot butter over top. Cool.

title: African Chow Mein
instructions: Brown celery and onions in butter. Brown meat in small amount of fat. Combine all ingredients and put in well-greased large casserole. Stir once during baking. Bake for 2 hours at 325\u00b0. Makes 8 servings.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and ground meat until brown; drain. Add Ranch Style beans salt pepper and garlic powder. Simmer on low. Line a greased casserole dish with 6 corn tortillas pour meat and bean mixture on top. Add Velveeta cheese slices. Add remaining tortillas. Mix cream of celery soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes in separate bowl. Pour on top of casserole and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Hobo'S
instructions: Put hamburger patty on foil slice onion carrots and potato and put on top of hamburger patty. Salt and pepper. Wrap in foil and bake 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Prepare pudding according to directions on box but use only 3 cups of milk for 2 packages. Fold in Cool Whip. Line a 9x 13-inch baking dish with graham crackers. Pour half of the pudding mixture over crackers. Place another layer of graham crackers over the pudding mixture and cover with the remaining pudding mixture. Then top with a final layer of graham crackers. Place frosting in microwave for a few seconds to soften and spread over top layer of graham crackers. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Sugar-Free Punch
instructions: All juices and Sprite should be sugar-free.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Wash romaine; remove outside leaves. Break the tender leaves crosswise into pieces about 1-inch wide. Store in plastic bag in fridge until ready to use. When ready to serve place romaine in large wooden bowl. In a small mixing bowl combine seasonings lemon juice Worcestershire sauce sugar oil vinegar and 3 anchovy fillets which have been mashed or minced. Mix thoroughly. Break coddled egg over greens then pour salad dressing over all and toss lightly. Serve immediately on chilled salad plates. Top each serving with 2 anchovy fillets.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and refrigerate. Serve with assorted crackers or chips.

title: Cut-A-Shape Cookies
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix first four ingredients with wooden spoon or fork until creamy. Then fold in the next three ingredients until well mixed. Divide into 2 balls and chill for 1/2 hour. Roll out on pastry sheet lightly dusted with flour. Roll dough 1/8-inch thick. Cut out and place about 1 1/2 inches apart on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes depending on your oven.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Butter in cold skillet; add garlic sugar salt and pepper. Add meat and brown; drain. Add tomato sauce. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Cook spaghetti. Combine sour cream cream cheese and onion. Place spaghetti in greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Top with cream cheese mixture and then meat mixture. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: In microwave or double boiler melt the chocolate chips almond bark and a small amount of paraffin. Add the Spanish peanuts. Drop onto waxed paper; allow to cool.

title: Reuben Appetizers
instructions: Place bread slices on cookie sheet. Add corned beef sauerkraut dressing and cheese. Broil about 6 inches away from heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts. Garnish with olive slice or tomato slice. Serves 30.

title: The Best Chocolate Chip Cookies In The World
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place length of foil on flat surface. In large bowl beat shortening brown sugar milk and vanilla on medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Add egg; beat well. Stir together flour salt and baking soda. Gradually add to sugar mixture beating on low speed just until blended. Stir in chocolate chips.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers(Microwave)
instructions: Saute hamburg onion and garlic until onions are soft and clear. Mix in a medium bowl beef mix rice tomato sauce basil salt and pepper. Remove tops pulp and seeds from peppers. Fill each one with a fourth of mixture. Place in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at High 10 to 15 minutes or until peppers are tender and rice is rehydrated. Top with cheese during last minute of cooking. Stand 3 minutes. (I pour an additional 8 ounces tomato sauce over peppers before cooking.)

title: Marinated Green Beans
instructions: Combine sour cream and Italian dressing. Add beans tomato and onion. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Serve in lettuce if desired.

title: Sour Cream Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix onions salt and pepper with hamburger. Heat last 5 ingredients. When hot add Velveeta cheese until melted. Mix all together. If too thick add more milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbling hot. Last place more cheese slices on top to melt. One batch makes 1 roaster full!

title: Chicken Ala King
instructions: Saute green pepper and mushrooms in margarine. When cooked add sherry and chicken. Add cream sauce. Season to taste. Just before serving add egg yolks beaten in small amount of cream sauce. Simmer for 1/2 minute. Do not boil. After egg yolks are added serve over hot toast. Serves 4.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Thaw shrimp if frozen. Remove shells and devein. Gently pat dry with a paper towel. In a large skillet melt butter over medium heat; add onions garlic lemon peel lemon juice salt and hot pepper sauce. Cook until boiling point add\tshrimp and cook for about 5 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Serve with hot cooked rice top with parsley and lemon peel. Yield 4 servings.

title: Roast Chicken With Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut chicken in half. Arrange in roasting pan skin side up. Combine butter lemon juice oregano rosemary sage salt and pepper in a small bowl and mix well. Brush chicken with this mixture and bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Then you may want to broil 6-inches from heat for 3 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix chicken eggs pickles and chopped seasonings and season to taste. (Food processor may be used but dont chop too fine.) Add broth and enough mayonnaise to get a spreading consistency. Allow to chill at least 2-3 hours for flavors to blend. Spread on sandwiches or stuff into tomatoes or scooped out cucumbers for a refreshing summer lunch.

title: Molasses Butter Ball Cookies
instructions: In mixing bowl beat butter or margarine on medium speed of the electric mixer for 30 seconds. Add molasses and beat until fluffy. Add flour to butter mixture. Beat at low speed until well blended. Stir in nuts using about 1 tablespoon dough for each. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool when cookies are cool gently roll them in powdered sugar to coat. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Poor Man'S Fruitcake
instructions: Measure first 8 ingredients into a large saucepan and simmer together over low heat for 5 minutes. Cool. Sift flour baking powder and baking soda together. Add to first mixture. Fold in nuts and candied fruit. Pour into 2 loaf pans that have been greased and lined with wax paper or into a prepared tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours until cake tests done. If raisins and fruit on top of cake begin to brown too much cover with foil. Serve plain or frosted or with a hard sauce or lemon sauce.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine 1/4 c. orange juice and cornstarch; mix well. Stir in chicken cover and chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Easy Fruit Pudding
instructions: Spread 1 can 20 to 22 ounces fruit pie filling in 8-inch square dish. Microwave at High 7 minutes. In small bowl combine 1 box 1 layer cake mix 2 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/2 cup nuts. Cut in 1/4 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over fruit. Microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Pull cauliflower and broccoli into flowerets. Combine with green pepper and onions.

title: Blackberry Dumplings
instructions: In a large pot combine berries 1 cup sugar 1/4 teaspoon salt and lemon extract. Bring to a boil lower heat and simmer 5 minutes. Meanwhile in bowl combine flour baking powder nutmeg and remaining sugar and salt. Add milk stir until just mixed (dough will be thick). Drop by tablespoonfuls into mounds onto hot blackberry mixture. Cover tightly and simmer 15 minutes. Spoon into serving dishes. Serve with cream. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Rice Au Gratin Supreme
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a large bowl; mix well. Combine soup mayonnaise 1 cup cheese and milk. Stir into rice mixture. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of cheese and bake 5 more minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Add potatoes and eggs. Mix well.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak bread cubes in the milk. Mix hamburger and onion together. Add bread cubes after they have absorbed all the milk. Add salt and pepper to taste. Mix well and put in loaf pan.

title: Rice Krispie Date Roll
instructions: Melt margarine. Add sugar. Mix well. Add dates; stir in vanilla. Remove from heat; stir in Rice Krispies and dates. Form into balls and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms under cold running water and dry on paper towel. Brush outside of caps lightly with butter; place on greased baking pan or cookie sheet. Fill each cap with Spam spread. Heat 5 to 8 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl. Salsa can be kept to the side for individual use.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Cook onion mushrooms celery and garlic in butter. Stir in rice bouillon pepper and water. Bring to boil and reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add bacon.

title: Easy Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix dry cake mix with diet cherry Coke and stir until smooth. Spray a 9 x 13 cake pan with Pam. Put batter in and follow baking instructions on box. Unbelievably moist and low-fat.

title: Po Boy Ice Cream
instructions: Finish filling ice cream can with milk. Freeze.

title: Basil Grilled Chicken
instructions: Press 3/4 teaspoon pepper into the meaty sides of the chicken breasts. Combine 1/3 cup melted butter and 1/4 cup chopped basil and then stir well. Brush the chicken lightly with the melted butter mixture. Combine 1/2 cup softened butter 2 tablespoons basil Parmesan cheese garlic powder salt and pepper in a bowl. Beat with an electric mixer at low speed until the mixture is well blended and smooth. Transfer to small serving bowl and set aside. Grill chicken on an outdoor barbecue at medium temperature setting for 8 to 10 minutes on each side basting frequently with remaining melted butter mixture. Serve grilled chicken with the basil butter mixture and garnish with fresh basil sprigs. This recipe makes 4 servings in an hour of preparation time.

title: Cowboy Stew
instructions: Saute hamburg in skillet until brown. Pour off fat. In casserole dish add browned hamburg. Sprinkle some salt pepper and garlic powder over hamburg. Pour the jar of gravy over hamburg. Spread can of veggies over that. Now spread the mashed potatoes. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Real easy to make and very good.

title: Slow Cooked Italian Chicken
instructions: Place the chicken in a slow cooker. In a bowl combine the next 11 ingredients; pour over chicken. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or until chicken juices run clear. Remove chicken pieces and keep warm. Pour cooking juices into a saucepan; skim fat. Combine flour and cold water until smooth; stir into juices. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Serve over chicken and noodles. Yields 4 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir together first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour into pastry shells. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.

title: Black Beans And Rice
instructions: Wash beans thoroughly. Cover with water and put in large pot to soak overnight. Drain beans and place in crock-pot with 3 to 4 cups of water. Add all other ingredients except the rice. Cook on high for 1 hour then cook 8 to 10 hours on low. Remove bay leaf. Cook rice according to directions on package. Serve beans over rice. Garnish as desired. This is a low-fat high fiber meal.

title: Nick'S Favorite Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix chicken soup sour cream scallions and if desired peppers. Heat thoroughly. Set aside.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix well. Add 1 1/2 quarts ginger ale cold. Pour over ice cubes (recipe below).

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Blend together sugar and cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip apples nuts and snickers. Refrigerate.

title: Vicki'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until almost tender. Saute onion slightly. Combine all ingredients (except crackers) in a large baking dish; mix well. Crush crackers and place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Shape into long rolls and freeze until ready to cook. Slice thin. Bake at 350\u00b0 on ungreased pans until light browned.

title: Kaffee Kuchen (Coffee Cake)
instructions: Set aside the dough until it doubles in bulk. After kneading turn dough onto a floured board roll out and put on a large baking sheet. Cover with Strausseln Topping and let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown bacon pour off half of the grease. Add onion and garlic cook until onion is tender. Add ketchup brown sugar salt mustard and vinegar. Add drained beans. Mix well and bake in a covered dish at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Can add a little molasses.

title: Cookie Balls
instructions: Make into balls and dip in chocolate. Instead of using just Corn Flakes you can also use half Rice Krispies.

title: Butterfinger Favorite
instructions: Crush candy bars and set aside. Pinch half the angel food cake into small pieces and spread into a long Pyrex pan. In another bowl mix butter egg yolks and sugar. Fold in whipped topping. Mix until creamy. Spread 1/2 whipped mixture over cake pieces. Sprinkle 1/2 the crushed candy bars on top of cake. Repeat process to make 2 layers. Refrigerate.

title: Raisin Sauce
instructions: Bring first four ingredients to a boil. Mix remaining ingredients then add to first part and boil until thick. Makes 3 cups.

title: Party Meatballs(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Combine beef bread crumbs soup mix and eggs in bowl. Mix well. Form into meatballs. Place uncooked meatballs in a glass 9 x 13 baking dish. Set aside while preparing sauce.

title: Microwave Divinity Candy
instructions: In 3-quart bowl combine sugar corn syrup and water. Cook on High for 8 minutes or until mixture is clear; stir. Cook on High for 6 1/2 to 8 minutes longer or until syrup reaches 260\u00b0. Do not leave candy thermometer in oven.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine beans soup milk and half of onion rings. Pour into casserole dish. Cover with remaining onion rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Roast Pork Barbecue
instructions: Mix catsup water Worcestershire sauce onion sugar dry mustard salt black pepper and cayenne pepper in bowl. Pour over roast in roasting pan. Roast covered at 350\u00b0 for 4 hours. Let stand until cool; drain. Bone and pull roast apart; return to pan. Bake uncovered for 1 hour longer. Yield 8 servings.

title: Vanilla Or Chocolate Shake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Top with cover; process until smooth. Serve immediately. To make chocolate shake use 4 1/2 cups chocolate nonfat yogurt. Add 1/3 cup chocolate syrup. Omit vanilla. Contains 162 calories per serving.

title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 1 1/4-inch or 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Beat all ingredients until smooth 1 minute in blender on high or 2 minutes with hand mixer. Pour into pie plate and bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Spanish Sauce For Omelet
instructions: Melt margarine in a heavy 2 quart saucepan. Add salt. Saute onion until transparent. Add bell pepper slices over onions. Saute on low 3 to 4 minutes. Drain the tomatoes. Reserve liquid for paste. Add bay leaves. Add drained tomatoes. Add cloves. (Preferably in a small stainless steel tea bag for easy removal.) Simmer about 20 minutes covered. Prepare flour paste from reserved tomato liquid (add water to make 1/2 cup) and 1/4 cup flour. Remove bay leaves and cloves. Add most of paste in pockets. Stir. Test for thickness. It should fall off a tilted spoon easily. Add more paste if it runs off the spoon like a juice. Bring to boil. Cook the flour for 1 minute. Stir continuous. Adjust salt to taste. Enough for an 8 egg omelet.

title: Graham Treats
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler (dont let water touch boiler). Pour over dry mix. Drop over wax paper.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix together and put in unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: California Veg.  Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In skillet brown beef and onion drain and stir in salt and pepper; set aside. Saute zucchini and green pepper in the margarine for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Stir in dill weed. Separate dough and press over bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan or cake pan. Spoon meat mixture over crust. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese over meat. Spread zucchini mixture evenly over the meat. Top with tomato slices. Bake 10 minutes. Sprinkle remaining cheese over tomatoes and bake an additional 15 minutes. Cool 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with sour cream and alfalfa sprouts if desired. Serves 6.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Add 1 (20 ounce) can crushed pineapple drained and 1 can mandarin oranges drained. Mix well. Chill several hours.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Make patties big and fat and place in large skillet filled with mushroom soup. Mix with water or milk. Place one slice of onion on each patty and one slice of cheese on top of the onion. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Eclair Delight
instructions: Combine milk and pudding until smooth. Stir in Cool Whip. Refrigerate and line bottom of square pan with 1 layer of graham crackers. Spoon and smooth on pudding and Cool Whip. Place another layer of crackers then pudding etc. ending with a layer of crackers. Mix syrup and powdered sugar together and pour on top of crackers and pudding. Let sit in refrigerator 24 hours.

title: Quick Oreo Dessert
instructions: Roll cookies fine (filling also). Mix in Cool Whip and nuts. Chill at least one hour.

title: Turkey Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce in large bowl; add chopped celery grapes turkey pieces and seasonings. Toss together with mayonnaise.

title: Chili
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet; add meat garlic and onion. Cook stirring slowly until meat browns. Add remaining ingredients. Fold gently. Cover and simmer until chili is hot.

title: Chocolate Divine
instructions: Soften the gelatin in the water. Mix cocoa and milk. Heat over boiling water. Add softened gelatin and liquid artificial sweetener. Stir until dissolve; remove mixture from heat. Add vanilla. Combine ice water and dry milk in bowl and beat until mixture is thick. Beat gelatin until smooth and add to whipped milk. Turn into pan sprayed with Pam. Chill until firm. Yield 5 servings. Carbohydrate 6 g protein 4 g fat .2 g calories 40. One serving = 1/2 skim milk exchange.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle breasts with seasonings then cover with cheese. Fold breasts over. Dip in egg or milk then roll in bread crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Put flour cheese salt and pepper in a plastic bag. Pare and cut potatoes into halves. Moisten and place in bag. Shake bag until potatoes are covered. In baking dish melt 1 stick oleo. Place potatoes in melted oleo and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour turning once on the half hour.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar butter flour and milk. Bring to full boil. Boil 3 minutes hard. Remove and add the rest. Drop onto wax paper until cool.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding cornmeal mix last. Bake in a 9 x 13 pan at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve while hot.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa together. Combine milk eggs oleo and vanilla. Mix all together and cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shells and top with meringue and brown. Use one or two pie shells.

title: Sloppy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except water; add water last. Mixture will be thin. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Jared'S Dip
instructions: Heat together in crock-pot. Serve with chips.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cut all fruit into small pieces and chop nuts. Dust fruit and nuts with 1/2 cup flour. Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs then bourbon flour and spices. Mix well. Pour over fruit and nuts; mix. Drop on greased cookie sheet with teaspoon. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Cool and blend mayonnaise and mustard. Add other ingredients and mix well.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Tip These pickles are wonderful as a side dish for fish barbecues picnics or Sunday night sandwich suppers.

title: Isabuzzer Bars
instructions: Mix the ingredients together and press into square 8 x 8-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until golden on top.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in 2 quarts salted water for 6 to 8 minutes; drain. Cube (small) cheese and oleo. Crush crackers into fine crumbs. Mix together with evaporated milk into macaroni. Add salt and pepper to taste. I think pepper gives it the extra taste. Pour into a greased 8 to 9-inch square baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix all together. Boil to desired thickness. Put in jars. Seal. Pressure or cold pack for 10 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon together in a large Baggie. Cut each biscuit into quarters. Shake biscuit pieces in the sugar and cinnamon; layer in well-greased tube pan. (Optional Sprinkle nuts between layers.) Usually makes 3 complete layers. Melt butter in a saucepan. Add brown sugar; boil for 1 minute and pour over the top layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 15 to 20 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Aunt Alice'S Lemon-Lime Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a punch bowl. Add lemon slices for color. Very good punch!

title: Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water; sprinkle with the 1 teaspoon sugar. Combine milk and butter; whisk in sugar and salt. Whisk in the raised yeast (should be to the top of a 1-cup measure). In a mixing bowl mix the bread flour with the yeast and milk mixture. Now mix in the all-purpose flour; knead mixture for approximately 2 minutes. Put dough in a well-greased bowl; cover with plastic wrap. Set over a pot of hot water; let rise 55 minutes. Take out; knead and separate. Form into 2 loaves. Put into well oiled loaf pans; set over hot water to rise (they should be above the pans approximately 60 minutes). Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes; turn oven to 325\u00b0 and bake until done approximately 15 minutes. Cool out of pan on a wire rack.

title: Herman Starter(Friendship Sourdough)
instructions: Begin cycle over with days 1 through 4. Stir once daily. If not used on tenth day add 1 teaspoon sugar and repeat every tenth day until used. Remaining batter can be used or give 1 cup to a friend with instructions about feeding and care of Herman.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. In last 15 minutes put more grated cheese and crushed Ritz crackers on top to brown.

title: Glaze For Cakes
instructions: Mix together and bring to boil. Pour over cake while warm.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
instructions: Saut onion in butter and combine with cooked rice and broccoli. Heat soup and cheese in double boiler (so it wont burn). Mix all together in casserole and bake for about 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0 for baking in a Teflon-coated Bundt pan. Cream butter in a large mixing bowl then add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add sugar gradually. Continue creaming mixture until it is light and fluffy. Stir in flour frosting mix and pecans. Pour batter into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes. Cool 1 hour; remove from pan and let it cool 1 hour more.

title: Rhubarb Custard Bars
instructions: In a bowl combine the flour and sugar; cut in butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Meanwhile for filling combine sugar and flour in a bowl. Whisk in cream and eggs. Stir in the rhubarb. Pour over crust. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes or until custard is set. Cool.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix onions egg milk and meal. Drop by spoonful into hot shortening (also can be shortening left over from frying fish). Shortening should be over an inch deep. Turn once when browned. Remove to platter spread with paper towels to drain excess shortening. Serve with fried fish or any meat.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cut shortening in flour (like pie crust). Mix remaining ingredients together and add to flour mixture. Roll out on floured cutting board. Cut out shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barbecue Brisket
instructions: Cover brisket with spices. Wrap in heavy foil overnight. Change foil for baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 on top shelf with pan of water underneath. Cook 4 hours. Bring to boil vinegar sugar ketchup 1 teaspoon mustard and onion salt; add steak sauce and soy sauce. Change foil. Pour mixture over brisket and cook 1 hour.

title: Mini Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream first four ingredients. Add eggs and beat well. In mini muffin pan put in cupcake liners put 1 vanilla wafer in liner. Fill 2/3 full with creamed mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until set. Cool. Refrigerate. Top with cherry or blueberry pie filling or fresh fruit before serving.

title: Double Decker Jello Blocks
instructions: In large bowl combine Knox gelatine with flavored gelatin. Add boiling water; stir until completely dissolved. Stir in cream. Pour into shallow baking dish. Chill until firm. To serve cut into one-inch squares. Recommended pan size is 9 x 9-inch.

title: Burnt Sugar Cake
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup sugar and boiling water until mixture measures 1/2 cup. Cool. Cream together 1 cup sugar and butter. Add vanilla. Mix well egg yolks and milk. Add syrup mixture and dry mixture. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes in either 8 x 12-inch pan or 2 layer pans.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix and chill for two hours. Serve with any raw vegetables.

title: Easy Potato Au Gratin
instructions: Combine potatoes and celery in greased baking dish. Blend soup and mustard. Pour over vegetables. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Sausage Rolls
instructions: Work all together well; roll in ball. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done. Grease a cookie sheet lightly. Let the sausage get soft before working it. These freeze nicely.

title: Zippy Crisp Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brush chicken with salad dressing. Coat with combined crumbs and cheese. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake 1 hour or until tender. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Microwave Quick Fudge
instructions: Pour sugar into large glass microwave-safe bowl. Add margarine milk and cocoa; do not stir. Place in microwave oven 2 1/2 minutes until margarine melts. Take bowl out and add nuts and vanilla. Stir well. Pour into 8-inch dish. Place in freezer 10 to 15 minutes then cut into squares and serve.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour over chicken wings. Marinate 6 hours. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or grill on open fire basting frequently. Or put in crock-pot on low and cook.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Boil chicken in salt and pepper water. Let cool. Cook broccoli. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and 2 cups chicken broth. Salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Add wine and cream. Skin and debone chicken. Place broccoli in bottom of baking dish (9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish works well!). Add 1/2 of chicken then 1/2 of sauce. Add rest of chicken. Add 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese to sauce. Pour on top. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Cook until heated at 350\u00b0. Broil to golden brown (15 to 20 minutes).

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spray an 8-inch square baking pan with vegetable oil. In a large bowl blend together molasses brown sugar oil and spices. Stir in boiling water. Mix in flour; set aside. In a small bowl dissolve baking soda in 2 tablespoons hot water; stir to mix well. Add to batter. Bake in prepared baking pan 30 minutes. Remove from oven and slice into 12 equal portions. Serve warm.

title: Almond Puff Pastry
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut 1/2 cup butter into 1 cup flour. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons water over mixture; mix with fork. Round into ball; divide in half. On ungreased baking sheet pat each half into a strip 12 x 3-inches. Strips should be about 3 inches apart.

title: Creole Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle pork chops with \Pork and Veal Magic.\ Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Brown pork chops and transfer to a plate. Chop onion and bell pepper in a food processor and add to skillet and stir until golden. Add garlic and cook the mixture for 1 minute. Add 1/4 cup water and tomatoes. Stir occasionally for 15 minutes. Add the chops and any juices. Add salt and pepper to taste and simmer the chops for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender and no longer pink. Serve with rice and spoon the sauce over the rice. I added \Pork Magic\ to the original recipe.

title: Sour Cream Rolls
instructions: Mix until moist. Divide equally into cupcake wells. Melt margarine; pour over batter. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until brown. Makes 12 rolls. These can be frozen.

title: Skyline Dip
instructions: In a small casserole dish layer the cream cheese chili then cheese. Microwave for 4 minutes. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix together the sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix; set aside. In a 9-inch square casserole dish layer in the following order Refried beans (spread to cover bottom) guacamole green onions black olives cherry tomatoes sour cream mixture and Cheddar cheese. Chill; serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Stir together Cool Whip and Eagle Brand milk. Then add pineapple nuts and lemon juice. Stir together. Pour into graham cracker crusts and chill.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Follow directions on package for pudding except use 3 cups milk for the 2 packages. Fold in Cool Whip. Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers then the rest of the pudding mixture. Next a third layer of graham crackers then spread on chocolate frosting. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Mix peanut butter with shortening and add sugar. Then add vanilla. Next add eggs (one at a time). Next add milk and flour. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in Pam-sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Mix together cream of mushroom soup cream of chicken soup water parsley and rice. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange pieces of chicken on top of mixture. Sprinkle onion soup over top and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Do not peek it will be done at that time.

title: Cocoa Teabread(Kakao Tebrod)
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and cocoa. Set aside. Cream butter and add sugar creaming well. Add 1 beaten egg. Blend in dry ingredients. Chill 2 hours. Divide dough into 4 parts on ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with fork into a strip 1/4-inch thick. Beat 1 egg with 1 tablespoon cold water; brush lightly over strips. Sprinkle chopped almonds and sugar over dough. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until set. Cut in 1-inch bars and remove from baking sheet.

title: Best Pancakes I Ever Ate
instructions: Mix oil egg and milk. Sift dry ingredients and add to previous mixture. Thin the mixture to desired consistency with milk using a whisk. Fry on hot griddle at medium heat. Makes approximately 12 to 14 (3-inch) pancakes.

title: French Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 12 muffin cups. Mix thoroughly the shortening 1/2 cup sugar and the egg. Stir in flour baking powder salt and nutmeg alternately with milk. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ritz Cracker Dessert
instructions: Mix crumbled crackers margarine and chopped nuts; reserve 1/2 cup. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix pudding and milk; stir in ice cream. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup reserved topping. Freeze.

title: 5 Minute Fudge
instructions: Mix together milk sugar and salt in a saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Then boil five minutes stirring constantly remove from heat and add marshmallows nuts chocolate and vanilla. Stir until marshmallows melt. Pour into buttered 8-inch pan and cool.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Drain and wash shrimp. Mash with fork. Blend with softened cream cheese. Add other ingredients and mix well. Chill. Serve with bread sticks or chips.

title: Aaron'S Grilled Chicken
instructions: Combine oil lemon juice and lemon pepper in a recloseable plastic bag or shallow platter. Add chicken breasts to plastic bag and coat well with oil mixture. Allow to marinate for 30 minutes in refrigerator turning once after 15 minutes. Grill over low flame 7 to 8 minutes per side basting with any leftover marinade. When chicken juice runs yellow not pink meat is done.

title: Pizza Melba Rounds
instructions: Combine the ground chuck and sausage in large skillet. Cook until browned. Drain well. Stir in tomato sauce Italian seasoning and Tabasco. Add cheese in small chunks. Cook over low heat until cheese melts stirring constantly. Spoon small mounds of mixture onto Melba rounds. At this point the rounds can be frozen on a baking sheet and then transferred to plastic bags for cooking later. When ready to serve remove from freezer and place on baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees until bubbly. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over top of each round before baking. No baking is necessary if you do not freeze the rounds. Simply sprinkle the Mozzarella cheese over the top of the rounds while the filling is hot. Makes about 3 1/2 doz.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl; cut in shortening with a pastry blender. Add buttermilk and yeast mixture; stir until thoroughly moistened. Turn dough out onto floured board and knead 1 or 2 minutes. (No rising is required.) Roll dough out to 1/2-inch thickness and cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased baking sheet; brush with melted butter and bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and spices. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add peanut butter. Add nuts; form into a roll. Wrap in wax paper. Refrigerate several hours. Slice 1/8-inch to 1/4-inch thick. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Lemon Crinkles
instructions: In mixing bowl cream shortening with 1 1/4 cups sugar and salt. Add egg and extract. Combine thoroughly. Gradually beat in evaporated milk. Add dry ingredients and beat thoroughly scraping sides of bowl often. Chill 60 minutes. With wet hands shape into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are golden brown. Remove from oven. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Drain oysters; reserve liquid. Remove any shell particles. Set oysters aside. Lightly toss 1 cup of crumbs with melted butter. Add enough cream or milk to reserved oyster liquid to yield 2 cups liquid. Stir in salt and pepper. Line a shallow buttered 2-quart casserole with 1 cup of unbuttered crumbs. Arrange 2 cups of the oysters on the crumbs. Pour 1 cup liquid over all. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the chopped onion. Dot with 1/2 of the butter. Repeat procedure. Top with the buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Chocolate Almond Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until lemon colored. Beat in sugar and oil. Stir chocolate vanilla and zucchini into egg mixture. Sift flour with salt cinnamon baking powder and baking soda. Stir into zucchini mixture. Add almonds. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour in 2 well-greased loaf pans. Turn out onto rack.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Blend well and spread in pie pan all ingredients except shrimp and chili sauce. Cover with 1/2 bottle chili or cocktail sauce and crumble baby shrimp over top. Refrigerate and serve with crackers.

title: Barbecued Hot Dogs
instructions: Split hot dogs lengthwise. Place in shallow pan. Make sauce of other ingredients and cook for 30 minutes. Pour over hot dogs and cook uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix soup and broth together. Pour over chicken that has been placed in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Place cut up boiled eggs over this. Mix together flour and milk. Add butter (or oil). This makes a thin batter on top. Bake until golden brown at 400\u00b0.

title: Mayo Delight
instructions: Spread mayo on slice of bread and fold over. Eat middle out and feed crust to doggie.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0 (quick med). Beat eggs sugar salt butter and corn syrup together with rotary beater. Mix in pecan halves. Pour into pastry. Line pie pan. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until set and pastry is nicely brown. Cool. Serve cold or slightly warm.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Beat egg whites stiff. Mix in with spoon pecans chips sugar and vanilla. Line cookie sheet with foil and drop mixture by teaspoon onto foil. TURN OVEN OFF!! Place cookie sheet in oven and leave overnight.

title: Turkey Noodle Casserole
instructions: Mix all but margarine and bread crumbs in a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole dish. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix ingredients. Use 2 teaspoons to a cup of water.

title: Onion-Beef-Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all together and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup peanut butter with chocolate. Melt 1 1/2 cups peanut butter in a measuring cup in saucepan of water. Cut cupcake paper; place in pans. Put 2 tablespoons of chocolate in cups; let cool. Put 1 to 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on top 1 tablespoon on to just cover peanut butter.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots until almost tender. Drain and set aside. Chop onion and melt 3 tablespoons butter and salt. Add cream of celery soup salt and pepper. Add around 3/4 can of water. Heat until warm. Place carrots in casserole pan. Pour soup mixture over. On top add Mozzarella cheese. Melt 1/2 cup butter. Pour over bread stuffing then put on top of Mozzarella cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients on plate.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar margarine and cream. Add egg and flavoring. Mix until thoroughly blended.

title: Hot Tamale Dip
instructions: Mash tamales. Combine all ingredients and heat until cheese melts. Serve with chips.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream sugar butter and flour. Add eggs buttermilk and vanilla. Bake in unbaked pie crust at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Saute onion garlic and red pepper until soft. Add ground beef and brown. In a casserole dish add soup tomato sauce and seasonings. Add meat mixture and stir well. If you are using left over cooked meat just add it to the soup; do not cook again. Mash the potatoes and spoon over the soup and meat mixture around the dish leaving a hole in the middle to let steam escape. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes; the potatoes should be browned and mixture bubbling.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash and separate cauliflower. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble on top of cauliflower. To the bacon drippings add remaining ingredients. Mix together and pour over cauliflower and bacon. Chill for 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Herb Loaf
instructions: Mix flour salt baking powder and herbs. Cut butter into small pieces and rub into dry ingredients. Stir in the sugar; add eggs to the milk and stir into mixture. Mix well; put into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Carrot Bread
instructions: Sift flour sugar cinnamon baking soda and salt. Beat eggs well. Stir in shredded carrots and oil into eggs. Add flour mixture and chopped nuts.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on box. Mix all other ingredients together and toss with the macaroni.

title: Cheese 'N Broccoli Salad
instructions: In large bowl toss together all ingredients until well combined. Cover; refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Buttermilk Breakfast Scones
instructions: Stir together flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in dates. In a small bowl mix buttermilk egg and vanilla. Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture and stir to combine.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease bottom only of a 10 x 14-inch baking pan (dont use a smaller pan). Mix pecans and coconut and sprinkle in bottom of pan. Prepare cake mix per package directions. Pour over top of nuts and coconut. Mix remaining four ingredients and dab over cake batter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In skillet over medium heat cook bacon until crisp stirring often. With slotted spoon remove to paper towels. In drippings over medium heat cook green pepper onion and garlic until tender crisp. Remove to bowl. In same skillet brown ground beef. Add tomatoes with liquid rice water seasonings and green pepper mixture. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Stir occasionally. Sprinkle with cooked bacon.

title: Quick Lasagna
instructions: You will need 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Wild Mushroom Gougere
instructions: Boil mushrooms for 10 minutes reserve mushrooms and add butter to water used for cooking mushrooms. When butter melts add flour and mix until ball forms off the heat. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each egg. Mix in cheese and reserved chopped mushrooms. Place on cookie sheet in two thin loaves and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve hot or room temperature sliced. Omit mushrooms entirely for traditional gougere.

title: Death Row Salsa
instructions: Add all ingredients in a bowl mixing well. Chill and serve. This is best if used the same day.

title: Hot Percolator Punch
instructions: Pour first 3 ingredients into a 12 cup percolator. Place remaining ingredients in percolator basket. Perk through complete cycle of electric percolator. Serve with cinnamon sticks if desired.

title: Apache Cheese Bread
instructions: Cut the top off bread reserving top scoop out the inside. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. This will be a very stiff mixture. Fill the bread with the cheese mixture replace the top and place on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips or the bread you have scooped out. To save half the baking time heat the cheese mixture in a microwavable bowl in your microwave until cheeses melt and are thoroughly heated. Then pour into crust.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix sour cream cream cheese onions olives cheddar cheese and chiles. Spread on tortillas. Roll them up jelly roll style. Wrap each roll in wax paper and refrigerate for several hours. Slice like a jelly roll and serve. May have salsa on the side for dipping.

title: Eggless, Milkless, Butterless Cake
instructions: Boil the sugar water shortening raisins and apples together for 5 minutes. When cool add the remaining ingredients. Bake in a thick sheet in a slow oven.

title: Zucchini Nut Loaf
instructions: Mix bananas and sugar. Use electric mixer; mix all dry ingredients together and add oil and eggs. Add banana and sugar mixture and vanilla. Stir in zucchini and nuts. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes and turn out. Wrap in plastic wrap when cooled.

title: Strawberry Delite
instructions: Break up angel food cake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water add in defrosted strawberries. Pour mixture over cake. Fold 8 ounces Cool Whip into cake mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Top with 8 ounces Cool Whip to serve. Can be cut into squares or spooned out.

title: Mr. N'S Favorite Brownie Recipe
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add eggs and butter and stir. Mix in nuts and vanilla. Pour into 9-inch square pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar. Add eggs and molasses. Then add all other ingredients. Dough will be real thick. Make into balls. Roll in sugar and bake for about 8 to 10 minutes at about 350\u00b0 or 375\u00b0.

title: Yummy Bars(Cookies)
instructions: Melt butter in a 15 1/2 x 11 x 2 1/2-inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle German chocolate cake mix evenly over butter. Then sprinkle miniature marshmallows over the cake mix. Next sprinkle butterscotch chips over marshmallows and then coconut on top. Last drizzle condensed milk over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup mayonnaise beaten eggs cheese and onion. Mix well and add broccoli. Put in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with crushed crackers. Dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Yummy Potatoes
instructions: Mix potatoes with the next 5 ingredients. Pour potato mixture into greased baking dish. Sprinkle on top more bacon bits Parmesan cheese minced onion melted butter and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 15 minutes before serving.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Place mixture in large greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour leaving cover off last 15 minutes. This may have meat added by using 1 pound browned ground beef and crumbling bacon over top.

title: Kottbular(Swedish Meat Balls)
instructions: Stir bread crumbs into milk or water. Mix well. Beat in egg and onion. Add salt pepper nutmeg and ground beef. Mix thoroughly. Divide meat mixture into 50 to 60 even portions. Shape into small balls. Melt butter in skillet. Add meat balls. Brown thoroughly shaking pan occasionally to keep balls round. Add water. Cover skillet. Simmer 20 minutes. Yields 50 to 60 small meat balls.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Place all in a large pot and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer slowly over low heat at least an hour. Remove lid and cook down to thickness desired.

title: Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix chopped pretzels and melted butter. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool in refrigerator until set.

title: Cindy'S White Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Make a sandwich cookie out of peanut butter and the Ritz cracker. Grate a block of almond bark into the top of a double boiler; melt on medium heat. When almond bark has melted dip a cookie in with a fork. Bring cookie out supported on the tongs of the fork. Gently tap fork on the edge of the pan to remove excess almond bark. Scrape bottom of fork tongs with another fork. Place cookie on wax paper to dry; tap fork on top of cookie to make a pretty design.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix eggs sour cream salt corn and oil. Add corn meal bell peppers hot peppers and baking powder. Grease pan. Heat pan until hot. Pour half of mixture in dish. Sprinkle 1/2 of cheese over this; pour remainder of mixture over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add remaining cheese on top and let melt.

title: No Sugar Apple Pie
instructions: Place apple juice concentrate in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Combine margarine cornstarch and spices in a small bowl. Add small amount of apple juice; stir until well blended. Stir cornstarch mixture into apple juice. Pour over apples. Stir to coat all apple slices. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Place top crust over apples. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes longer.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Melt butter; mix with basil salt and pepper. Pour over veggies. Sprinkle over veggies the Parmesan cheese (enough to coat them entirely). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Take out and cut any cheese slices to place on top. Return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Never Fails Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour and salt; cut in shortening. Combine remaining ingredients and stir into shortening mixture. Let stand a few minutes. Roll dough on floured board to desired thickness. Makes 4 (9-inch) pie shells.

title: Saucy Meatballs
instructions: In large bowl combine beef cheese bread crumbs milk and egg; mix well and form into balls about 20 balls. Brown in a large pan with oil. Cook and drain excess fat. Sprinkle flour over meatballs stirring gently to coat. On medium heat combine; tomatoes sauce and salt. Cook uncovered for 25 minutes or until sauce is desired thickness. Serve meatballs and sauce over cooked noodles.

title: Chocolate Chip Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Beat sugar margarine eggs and vanilla until smooth. Add one cup chocolate melted. Mix well. Add flour oats baking powder remaining 1 cup chocolate and nuts mixing well.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Line 2 pie pans with pastry. Make crumbs by combining flour sugar salt and shortening. Dissolve soda in hot water and combine molasses. Add 3/4 cup crumbs pour into pastry lined pans and top with remaining crumbs. Bake in very hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes more.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Dissolve sugar and Jell-O in hot water. Drain pineapple and add enough water to pineapple juice to make one cup. Add to Jell-O. Refrigerate until a little hard.

title: Egg Yolk Biscuits
instructions: Beat egg yolks vanilla salt and water together until lemon colored. Stir sugar into flour; mix liquid and dry ingredients together. Knead on a floured board until surface blisters. Cut to 2-inch parallelograms and slit center from longest points of dough. Curl back tops to slit in opposite directions. Fry in deep hot pot until brown. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Party Biscuits
instructions: Cream the margarine or butter with the sour cream. Mix in the self-rising flour. Grease muffin tins or spray with no-stick. Fill small muffin tins about 1/2 full. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 15 or 20 minutes. Check for browning to suit you.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese add other ingredients. Chill at least 1 hour. Roll in chopped pecans. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Hot Asparagus Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with corn chips.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Spread in ungreased rectangular baking dish 13 x 9 x 2-inches. Layer ham and cheese over broccoli. Beat remaining ingredients with hand beater until smooth; slowly pour over cheese. Bake uncovered 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Baked Beans
instructions: Cook hamburger meat and onion in skillet and drain. Brown bell pepper and smoked sausage in skillet; drain. Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Stir and cook for 5 to 6 hours on high or overnight on low.

title: Dream Bars
instructions: Sift together and set aside 1 cup flour brown sugar and salt. Cut in until fine crumbled shortening. Pat into greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sift together and set aside 1/4 cup flour baking powder and salt. Beat until very thick eggs and brown sugar. Add to flour mixture chocolate chips and vanilla. Spread over baked mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield 32 (2 x 1-inch) bars.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil cut down heat and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Custard
instructions: Cook zucchini covered in salted boiling water until tender. Drain very well. Put in shallow baking dish. Beat together the egg sour cream salt pepper and half of the cheese. Pour over zucchini. Dot with butter and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serves 4 generously.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and water until dissolved. Add pie filling nuts and pineapple. Pour into oblong dish set until firm. Whip sour cream and cream cheese. Add sugar and vanilla. Beat until it stands in peaks. Spread over Jell-O. Chill well. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Hot Cider Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and heat to boiling point. Makes 3 quarts or 24 punch cups. Garnish with orange slices if desired.

title: Italian Stuffed Zucchini Boats
instructions: Boil zucchinis 7 to 10 minutes drain and let cool. Cut each zucchini in half lengthwise and scrape out pulp. Set zucchini aside and mash pulp and pour off liquid. Fry sausage and onion and drain well. Combine sausage with pulp mixture. Add egg and remaining ingredients and mix well. Fill zucchini halves with mixture. Sprinkle extra parmesan cheese on top of zucchini boats and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Mix all together. Bring to a boil on medium heat. Let cool and add 1/5th bottle vodka. Kahlua is ready to drink.

title: Yummy In The Tummy Chocolate Pudding
instructions: In a heavy saucepan combine chocolate sugar and milk. Heat and whisk constantly until chocolate is melted. Avoid scorching or burning the milk. If you have a double boiler use it.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix together the cheese. Shred chipped beef add to cheese. Add green onions. Mix all together. Serve with crackers.

title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter or oleo Crisco brown sugar and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Add the flour salt and baking powder alternately with the milk and vanilla. Fold in the chopped pecans. Bake in a large tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: In a mixing bowl cut flour and shortening into small balls; add water vinegar and sugar. Mix well. Place in refrigerator to chill or store up to 3 days. Yields 4 to 5 crusts.

title: Fruited Chicken
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients; add enough salad dressing to hold together. Chill well. Serves 8.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Heat water and sugar to boiling point; add jello. Dissolve over heat. Add pineapple; refrigerate to thicken. Fold in Cool Whip; add cheese and nuts. Refrigerate to congeal. Serve on lettuce as salad. Cut in squares; top with cherries for dessert.

title: Ant Killer
instructions: Mix into a paste. Coat one side of small squares of cardboard and put them where the ants are. When the paste gets dry replace with the fresh paste. Continue until all gone.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the oleo oil sugar powdered sugar and vanilla. Add the eggs. Sift and add the flour soda cream of tartar and salt. Roll in little balls. Press down. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan lay whole graham crackers down. Mix puddings milk and Cool Whip together and pour 1/2 of mixture on top of graham crackers.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Soak oats and sour milk for 15 minutes. Make sour milk by adding 1 tablespoon vinegar or lemon juice to 1 cup whole milk. Beat in egg sugar and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients; stir into mixture. Add the melted butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Holiday Stuffed Turkey
instructions: To prepare stuffing In 4-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot butter cook mushrooms and onion with savory and nutmeg until tender. Remove from heat. Add broccoli stuffing rice and broth. Toss to mix. Spoon stuffing mixture lightly into neck and body cavities. Fold shin over stuffing; skewer closed. Tie legs. On rack in roasting pan place turkey breast-side up. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part of meat between breast and thigh not touching bone. Roast uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 4 hours or until internal temperature reaches 180\u00b0 and drumstick moves easily. Baste occasionally with pan drippings. When skin turns golden cover loosely with tent foil. Makes 14 to 16 servings.

title: Lemon Glaze Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and pudding together. Mix or beat the eggs oil and water into the cake mixture for 4 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Uncooked Fresh Tomato Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients; chill 2 to 3 hours. Serve as a relish with meats fish or poultry. Yields 3 cups.

title: Health Pudding
instructions: Simmer all fruit and vegetables for approximately 15 minutes. Combine 1 cup water from vegetables and fruit with starch spices sugar and egg whites. Add to vegetables and fruit. Continue simmering and stirring until thickened.

title: Holiday Cranberry Punch
instructions: Mix together and serve in punch bowl.

title: Caramel Peanut Butter Dip
instructions: In a microwave-safe bowl microwave caramels and water on high for 1 minute; stir. Microwave 1 minute more or until smooth. Add peanut butter and mix well; microwave for 30 seconds or until smooth. Stir in peanuts if desired. Serve warm with apples.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Whip altogether. Pour in unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Foolproof Meringue
instructions: Beat egg whites with salt until soft peaks form; gradually add Marshmallow Creme beating until stiff peaks form. Spread over pie filling sealing to edges of crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Easy Brownies
instructions: Measure and sift together into bowl dry ingredients. Add melted butter eggs and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Fold in nuts and pour into greased and floured cake pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Let potatoes thaw. Then mix remaining ingredients into them. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Crush potato chips and spread for topping.

title: Brownie Mocha Torte
instructions: Stir up the \cake-like\ version (not fudge-like) and spread into two 9-inch layer cake pans (round). Bake as directed about 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Yogurt Crescent Rolls
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; set aside. Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in yogurt mixture egg and egg white. Combine flour and salt. Stir 2 cups flour mixture into yogurt mixture; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until smooth. Gradually stir in remaining flour mixture. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish put 1 cup uncooked (raw) rice. Sprinkle with salt. Combine in a mixing bowl the soups and 1 1/2 cups water. Pour half of mixture over uncooked rice. Place raw chicken (4 to 6 breasts) over rice mixture. Salt and pepper chicken then add the rest of soup mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 package of dry onion soup mix. Cover dish with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Lime-Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Boil together jello and pineapple juice. Stir in marshmallows until dissolved and add the rest of the ingredients. Let stand in refrigerator.

title: Holodetz(Jellied Pig'S Feet)
instructions: Wash pigs feet and hocks and place in a 4-quart pot filled with cold water. When it comes to a boil skim several times. Then add the peppercorns bay leaves and salt. Cook slowly for several hours or until meat falls off the bones easily. Remove the feet and hocks; let cool. When cool separate meat from the bones discard bones and place the meat in containers for molding. Strain the stock through a sieve or cheesecloth. Add the garlic to stock and taste for salt if needed. Pour the stock over the meat and refrigerate. When holodetz is jelled remove the fat which accumulated on the surface.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Grease bottom of pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: In a large skillet put sugar oleo and crushed pineapple and let bubble 5 minutes. Place sliced pineapple around in skillet and add cherries for color. Mix cake mix as directed on package and pour on top of pineapple. Bake until cake is done. Turn right side up on cake plate.

title: Grated Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and beat well (until light). Add milk and the butter which has been melted. Add vanilla salt and the sweet potatoes. Butter baking dish. Bake in moderate oven 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Mix together butter salt sugar and vanilla. Add flour and nuts. Mix until dough gets stiff. Shape into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool slightly. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix 1/2 pint of whipping cream with eggs and a dash of salt. Add corn and green chilies. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake uncovered for 45 minutes. Can be doubled; bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Spread sauerkraut in bottom of an oiled 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle half of caraway seed over sauerkraut. Layer corned beef slices over sauerkraut and drizzle dressing over all. Layer tomato slices and cheese over dressing. Toss bread crumbs and remaining caraway seed in butter and spread over cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti And Meatballs
instructions: In a large bowl combine first ten ingredients; mix thoroughly. With hands firmly shape into 1-inch meatballs.

title: Avocado Dunk
instructions: Peel avocados; mash pulp. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Cover; let stand for one hour. Serve with corn chips. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Apple Cinnamon Bread(Gram Newton'S Recipe)
instructions: Scald milk. Cool to lukewarm. Pour over sugar salt and margarine. In a mixing cup dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Add to above ingredients. Add 3 eggs and 2 cups of the flour and beat to mix. Add remaining flour and knead for 10 minutes. Let rise. Punch down. Separate into 2 loaves.

title: Berries Of Your Choice Pie
instructions: Blend together and press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate while preparing filling.

title: Mulled Apple Cider
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan (preferably nonmetallic) place the apple cider cinnamon sticks allspice cloves and orange peel and bring to a boil over moderately high heat. Adjust heat to that the mixture barely bubbles. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Strain the cider mixture into 4 mugs and put an orange slice and cinnamon stick in each mug if you like. Serves 4.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients together. Beat the egg then add with vinegar and water. Mix these ingredients together then blend in first batter. Chill batter before using. Makes from 5 to 7 crusts.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine onion bell pepper pimento soup Cheez Whiz and sour cream. Pour over drained beans and corn. Mix well and pour into large buttered casserole. Melt oleo and pour over 1/2 box crushed Cheese Nip crackers. Sprinkle on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until it bubbles. Real good!

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground meat and onion together; drain. Combine meat and soup. Place in bottom of casserole dish. Layer cheese on top then Tater Tots. Lightly salt and pepper the top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes or until the potatoes are brown.

title: Easy Holiday Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water in large bowl. Add frozen juices. Stir until well blended. Stir in 6 cups cold water and pineapple juice. Pour over ice ring in punch bowl. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Sloppy Joe Sandwiches
instructions: Brown together meat onions and bell pepper. Drain. In microwave melt together soup and cheese. Mix everything together for delicious sandwiches.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Mix with mixer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients and put in baking dish and cook at 350\u00b0 for 50-60 minutes or until done.

title: Cream Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix the margarine 1 egg and cake mix. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Set aside. Combine 2 eggs cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Spread over the first layer. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool on rack. Cut into 2-inch squares. Makes 24.

title: Surprise Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Allow to chill until partially set. Meanwhile thaw the strawberries. Stir strawberries and pineapple into jello. Add lemon juice. Chill until firm.

title: Mussel Soup With Saffron
instructions: Remove beards from mussels and rinse well. Heat a 6-quart pot with oil and garlic. Saute a few seconds. Do not burn. Add cleaned mussels and vermouth. Cook covered over medium heat. Steam mussels open about 4 minutes. Stir once. Strain mussels and save broth. Cool mussels on sheet. Return pot to stove. Add butter onion and celery until clear (saute). Add cream chicken broth clam juice and saffron. Heat to gentle simmer and cook 15 minutes. Remove meat from mussels. Discard shells. Add green onions and parsley to pot and simmer 2 minutes. Add mussels and any juices. Salt and pepper. Serves 4.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together as you would any cornbread. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Creamy Salsa Dip
instructions: Stir all ingredients until well mixed. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Cottage Cheese Sandwich Spread
instructions: Makes enough for 4 sandwiches. Mix together all ingredients. Chill.

title: Shrimp Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well. Roll into ball. Roll in chopped pecans and parsley flakes.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar. Cover tightly and shake vigorously. Makes 1 cup.

title: Cincinnati Chili
instructions: Combine the hamburger onions and 1 quart water; simmer together for 30 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered for 2 to 3 hours until thickened. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Cucumber Tea Sandwiches
instructions: In small bowl mix the first 4 ingredients. With fork score unpeeled cucumber lengthwise. Cut cucumber lengthwise in half then crosswise in very thin slices. With 1 3/4-inch round biscuit cutter cut 4 rounds from each slice of bread. Spread 1 side of each bread round with cream cheese. Top with 2 cucumber slices. Line jelly roll pan with damp paper towels. Place sandwiches in pan and cover with damp paper towels to keep bread from drying out.

title: Fried Potato Cakes
instructions: Prepare potatoes as if they were going to be served as mashed potatoes. Add egg and stir in onion. Add flour until potatoes are slightly stiff and will stay together in patties. Preheat oil in skillet. Fry patties until golden brown.

title: Easy Appetizer
instructions: In bottom of pie plate - layer softened cream cheese chili and cheddar cheese. Warm in microwave oven for 45 seconds or until cheese melts.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken then debone. Mix together onion cream of mushroom soup cream of chicken soup chicken broth and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Layer chicken sauce tortillas and cheese in a pan around 14 x 10 x 2-inches. Spray pan with Pam. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Yields 8. Top with sour cream before serving.

title: Railroad Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins in water for 5 minutes. (Set aside.) Mix butter sugar and eggs until fluffy. Mix remaining ingredients to butter mixture adding flour and raisins last. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Divinity
instructions: Boil ingredients until mixture makes a firm ball in cold water. Beat egg whites stiff adding a pinch of baking powder while beating. Pour syrup very slowly over egg whites. Add another pinch of baking powder beating all the while. Add vanilla while beating. Fold in nuts. Drop on wax paper.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Bake Jiffy corn bread mix as directed on box. Let cool. Crumble bread in large bowl. Add chopped pepper tomato onion mayonnaise lemon juice and salt. Stir well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Champagne Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a large frying pan and saute chicken 6 to 8 minutes until lightly browned. Lower heat. Remove chicken. Stir flour into drippings. Slowly add broth stirring to make a smooth sauce. Slowly add light cream stirring constantly. Stir in mustard and cook until sauce bubbles. Return chicken to pan and spoon sauce over each piece. Cover and simmer until cooked (about 10 to 15 minutes). Serve over rice.

title: Mccordie'S Fried Vegetables
instructions: Heat cooking oil or grease in skillet. Add potatoes and onion. Cook 5 minutes on low heat. Stir in okra squash salt and pepper. Cook stirring occasionally until tender.

title: Sue'S House Dressing
instructions: Mix together. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Put small can of Chinese noodles over top before serving. Serve over rice.

title: Petit Sucre
instructions: Beat powdered sugar and egg white for 15 minutes (no less) on medium-high speed (again no less than 15 minutes). Do not double!

title: Marshmallow Creme Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar milk and butter to a boil. Cook to medium soft-ball stage (236\u00b0) stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Then immediately add Marshmallow Creme nuts and chocolate chips. Stir until Creme and chocolate chips are melted. Pour into 9 x 9-inch square buttered pan. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Sunday Dinner Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in a Dutch oven; cover with water. Cover and bring to a boil. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until very tender; drain well. In a large mixing bowl mash potatoes. Add sour cream cream cheese 2 tablespoons butter salt onion salt and pepper; beat until fluffy. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. Dot with the remaining butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Yield 8 servings.

title: Capanada(Microwave)
instructions: In a 4-quart casserole saute onion bell pepper and celery in olive oil. Cover with wax paper and cook on High 30 minutes. Stir once or twice. Stir in eggplant. Cover and cook on High 30 minutes. Stir once. Add tomato sauce and paste. Cook on High 10 minutes. Stir in garlic olives vinegar sugar capers oregano salt and peppers. Cook on High 5 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter margarine and cream cheese together; beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Add vanilla. Gradually add flour; mix until smooth.

title: Strawberry Cookies
