instructions: Mix; drop on cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Strawberry Glaze
instructions: Stir together first 3 ingredients. Add strawberries. Bring to boil 1 minute over medium heat stirring constantly. Strain. Stir in juice and coloring. Cool slightly. Arrange whole strawberries on cheese cake. Cover with glaze.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mash avocados. Combine sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning (start with 1/2 package and add to taste). Combine all ingredients adding lemon juice and salt to taste. Serve with chips.

title: Italian Green Beans
instructions: Cook and crumble bacon; cook green beans using package instructions. Drain. Combine bacon and green beans in a medium bowl. Add salad dressing; toss. Serve.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Combine squash onion salt pepper sugar and flour. Beat eggs and add to squash. Then add melted butter. Drop by tablespoon into hot oil and fry at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Ring Salad
instructions: Wash cranberries; add 1 cup cold water. Cook until tender. Add sugar and cook for 5 minutes. Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water; dissolve in hot cranberries and add salt. Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Add nuts and celery. Mix thoroughly. Pour into oiled ring mold. Chill until firm. Unmold and place on a large salad plate. Place light lettuce around salad arrange shrimp in center or serve on a bed of chicory on individual plates and garnish with mayonnaise. Serves 8.

title: Honey-Mustard Swordfish
instructions: Arrange steaks in a baking dish. Combine wine and next 4 ingredients; pour over steaks. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour. Remove steaks from marinade reserving 1/4 cup marinade. Place reserved marinade in a small saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Hodge Podge Soup
instructions: Brown meat and onions; drain fat. Add the rest of the ingredients and their liquids; simmer for 20 minutes. Makes a good potluck dish served from a crock-pot.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Pop the corn; put in roaster and keep in oven on warm. Boil the brown sugar butter corn syrup salt cream of tartar and peanuts for 5 minutes. Add the soda; stir and put on corn. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring often.

title: Butter Roll
instructions: Melt butter. Add all ingredients together and pour over separated buns into a small baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar molasses and egg. Pour melted shortening over and continue mixing. Add 2 cups flour and soda; mix. Add raisins; mix. Add remaining flour spices and salt and mix well. Dough will be very stiff. Pour boiling water over mixture and blend thoroughly. Bake 12 minutes on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add egg one at a time then flour and milk starting with flour and ending with flour. Add baking powder and salt. Stir in nuts. Pour in tube pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Livers And Mushrooms
instructions: Cook together for 5 minutes bacon (cut in pieces) and butter. Remove bacon bits. Add chopped onion; cook 2 minutes and add chicken livers. Cook until light brown all over (until they look done). Add flour beef bouillon lemon juice and sliced mushrooms. Add cooking sherry; cook 2 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve on toast or rice. Serves 4.

title: 5 Minute Fudge
instructions: Mix milk sugar and salt together in pan. Heat to boiling; cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients; stir 1 to 2 minutes until marshmallows melt. Pour into buttered 9-inch square pan. Makes 2 pounds.

title: Easy Spinach Roll-Yes
instructions: Use whatever amount you choose.

title: One Dish Hamburger Supper
instructions: Make patties of hamburger meat and place on foil. On each pattie put a slice of potato and onion. Put extra ones all over. Put on large sheet of foil and fold and seal. Put in oven and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve with tossed salad and drink.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cream soup and cream cheese. Blend in shrimp and all the other ingredients. Serve with chips or raw vegetables.

title: Jiffy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook onion until soft in hot oil. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes. This can be doubled just fine.

title: Cheese Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash with onion until soft. Drain and add seasonings. Put in greased baking dish. Top with mixture of cheese milk and mayonnaise. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until light brown and cheese is melted on top.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute chopped onion in butter.\tSteam broccoli. Mix all ingredients and pour into a 9x13 glass baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Hummos Bi Tahini
instructions: Place ingredients into a food processor and blend well. Serve with Labanese bread.

title: Gotabki(Cabbage Rolls)
instructions: Remove core from cabbage. Scald cabbage in boiling water and remove leaves as they soften.

title: Sweet And Sour Vinaigrette
instructions: Heat the vinegar; add sugar and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat. Add oil and soy sauce. Mix in salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Put in blender or food processor to emulsify.

title: Spanish Pinto Beans
instructions: Boil beans until tender. In a large skillet put olive oil and heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Add the other ingredients and saute for 5 minutes. Pour this sauce over the beans and cook for 10 minutes. For better flavor add cut up lean ham to the sauce.

title: Russian Noodle Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter; set aside. Beat eggs add sour cream softened cream cheese sugar and salt. Add mixture to melted butter and vanilla. Fold in cooked noodles  1/2 cup raisins optional.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Pour first 4 ingredients into large mixing bowl; mix well and make into 1-inch balls. Place balls in refrigerator about 1 hour.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach; squeeze dry and set aside. Stir sour cream and mayonnaise together. Add vegetable soup mix and stir until well blended scraping sides of bowl periodically. Stir in spinach and water chestnuts. Add green onions and blend well. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours before serving. Serve with your favorite brand of crackers.

title: Hominy-Green Chilies Casserole
instructions: Reserve 1 1/4 cups cheese for topping. Toss all ingredients until well mixed. Pour into casserole dish; top with reserved cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 until cheese melts and is lightly browned and bubbly around edge of dish. Delicious!

title: Fudge
instructions: Boil butter sugar and milk for 11 minutes. Add marshmallow cream chocolate chips vanilla and nuts. Beat until stiff. Spread in buttered jelly roll pan. Cool for several hours. Yield 5 pounds. Very good!

title: Corn Pudding(Side Dish)
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Heat margarine in saucepan. Saute onion and green pepper for 10 minutes. Place in a large soup pot. Add broth tomatoes (cut into small pieces) bay leaf and thyme. Bring to a boil. Add the okra and pepper. Cover over low heat 15 minutes. Stir in the rice and chicken.

title: Chewy Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs; blend. Add flour blending in before you add vanilla and nuts. Bake 20 minutes at 325\u00b0 if fast oven and 350\u00b0 if slow oven.

title: Grilled Garlic Chicken
instructions: In medium bowl combine garlic mushroom mix with oil. Add chicken and toss to coat. Grill or broil until chicken is no longer pink. Makes 4 servings. Results guaranteed.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs thoroughly with sugar salt corn syrup and melted butter. Add pecans. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 50 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between outside and center of filling comes out clean. Cool pie before serving.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake(Microwave)
instructions: Things you will need Tupperware measuring cup set large Mix-N-Stor 2 cup measuring pitcher Vienese spatula olive dipper and 9-inch quiche pan.

title: Mom'S Spaghetti Meat Sauce
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain off excess grease. Add other ingredients and cook slow until real thick. Serve over spaghetti noodles or any other pasta.

title: Fruit Punch(Excellent)
instructions: Mix and pour over ice block; serve. Excellent!!!

title: Spinach Topped Tomatoes(Serves 6.  Easy.  Do Ahead.)
instructions: Cook spinach according to package; drain. Combine all ingredients except tomatoes. Make into small patties to fit on top of 1/2 tomato. Put on cookie sheet freeze then bag. To serve place patty on tomato half put in oven at 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes if frozen 20 minutes if thawed.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Cream together cream cheese mayonnaise Worcestershire sauce and garlic. Spread mixture on a rimmed plate. Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving layer avocado dip on cheese then spread picante sauce on avocado layer. Top with shrimp. Sprinkle with green onions and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Apple Crunch
instructions: Place sliced apples in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish and sprinkle with sugar cinnamon nutmeg and salt. In medium bowl combine butter flour and brown sugar. Spread mixture evenly over apples. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve immediately.

title: Captain'S Quiche
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Beat eggs and remaining ingredients. Drain hamburger then add to egg mixture. Pour into quiche pan and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dot'S Apple Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in the eggs. Sift all of the dry ingredients together and gradually beat into the butter/sugar mixture. Fold in the apples. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
instructions: Cook shrimp by boiling in water seasoned with salt and pepper 15 minutes. Drain peel and remove black veins. Melt butter in large skillet. Saute onions pepper and celery. Add dried parsley and Italian seasoning; cook until tender.

title: Crabmeat Quiche
instructions: Line a 9 inch quiche dish with pastry. Prick bottom and sides of pastry with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3 minutes; remove from oven and gently prick with fork bake an additional 5 minutes. Set aside.

title: Chicken With Capers
instructions: In a shallow bowl combine flour paprika salt and pepper. Dip cutlets in flour mixture. Saute chicken in butter and olive oil on medium-high heat until golden brown. Remove cutlets. Discard oil mixture. Add lemon juice and capers. Return cutlets to pan. Saute over low heat for about 5 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Embutido
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients blend thoroughly. Spread pork mixture on an 8 x 10-inch piece of leaf lard. Arrange slices of hard-cooked eggs chorizo de bilbao or Vienna sausage and raisins on pork mixture. Roll as for jelly roll. Wrap in cheesecloth or aluminum foil. Boil in soup stock for 1 hour or if wrapped in aluminum foil bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1 hour. Chill. Before serving remove wrappings and slice. Makes 2 rolls.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: In a large bowl mash salmon. Add all other ingredients. Stir until all is mixed together. If not stiff enough to drop from spoon add more flour. Heat oil in frying pan until hot. Drop by spoonful into hot oil. Brown on both sides.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all together with salad dressing.\tBetter made the day before you plan to serve it.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts. Stir in nuts. Shape into loaves 3-inches wide and 2-inches high. Chill overnight. Slice and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 370\u00b0. Yield about 6 dozen.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mini marshmallows may also be added.

title: Squash Rolls
instructions: Combine the warm water yeast and 1 teaspoon of the sugar in a small bowl. Stir to mix. Set aide. In a large bowl combine the melted shortening milk squash remaining sugar and salt. Mix well. Add yeast and 1 cup of the flour. Mix well. Continue adding flour until the dough is no longer sticky. Place in a well-greased bowl and cover with a dish towel. Allow to rise until double in bulk. This will probably take 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours. Punch down and knead until smooth. Pinch off portions about size of golf ball. Roll in palms of hands until round. Place on greased baking sheet. Cover with dish towel and allow to rise until light (probably about 45 minutes). Bake at 425 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and brush with butter. Makes about 15 rolls.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients. Add last 3. Stir until just moistened. Bake on griddle. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Combine all dry ingredients. Add alternately with the milk and vanilla. Add blueberries. Pour in pan and sprinkle with sugar. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tortilla Torte
instructions: Beat cream cheese with electric mixer for 30 seconds. Add 2 tablespoons diced chili deviled ham sour cream 2 tablespoons taco sauce and hot pepper sauce to cream cheese. Beat well until blended. Cover and chill.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except Fritos in large bowl. Refrigerate. Toss in Fritos before serving. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Sylvia'S Collard Greens With Smoked Turkey
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan bring the water and smoked turkey to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat and simmer covered for 1 hour. While the turkey is cooking wipe the collards with a damp towel then wash two or three times or until all the dirt and grit has been removed. Chop the greens into 1/2-inch pieces. You will have 10 cups of chopped greens. Add the collards oil salt black pepper sugar and red pepper flakes to the saucepan. Return to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes longer. Discard the turkey before serving or chop the turkey meat and add it to the collards. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Quick Italian Spaghetti
instructions: In a skillet brown ground beef and onions. Add next five ingredients; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add olives; simmer 5 minutes longer. Spoon over spaghetti; sprinkle with cheese and bacon bits if desired. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Caramel Bars
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients until crumbly. Melt caramels and Carnation milk. Put half of first mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove and sprinkle chocolate chips on top then pour the caramel mixture over and then sprinkle the rest of the cake mixture on top and bake 15 to 20 minutes more.

title: Barbecue Smokies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Simmer in crock-pot for 2 to 3 hours. Serve hot.

title: Senior Breakfast Cheese Grits
instructions: Stir grits slowly into boiling water salted in heavy saucepan. Return to boil. Reduce heat. Cook 3 to 5 minutes stirring often. When thick remove from heat. Add 1 package garlic cheese. When it melts add butter milk and eggs. Put in greased baking dish. Top with mild grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Let stand a few minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Angel Food Fruit Cake
instructions: Crumble angel food cake in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Slice bananas and layer on cake. Then cut up strawberries and layer on bananas. Separately mix 2 small boxes of instant vanilla pudding with milk (use directions on box). Then pour this over cake and fruit. Let stand 2 hours. When ready to eat top with Cool Whip.

title: Tuna Steak With Lime And Capers
instructions: Saute the tuna over high heat in hot oil and butter for 3-4 minutes on each side until barely cooked through. Squeeze the lime juice over the hot steaks. Cut into portions and garnish with capers and parsley.

title: Nutty Peach Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Layer all ingredients in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until top is golden brown. Let stand at least 15 minutes before serving. Serve warm or cool. If desired serve with Cool Whip or ice cream. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Kid'S Paint Brush Cookies
instructions: Let the Picassos do their own thing. A sure bet. The three year olds will win the Picasso Title.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Peel and slice carrots. Cook in salt water just until tender. Drain. Add pepper and onion. Mix soup vinegar oil mustard sugar salt and pepper. Pour over warm carrots. Refrigerate and marinate overnight or longer.

title: Pear Preserves
instructions: Mix pears with sugar then with vinegar. The vinegar keeps preserves from turning to sugar.

title: Pistachio Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and beat on medium speed for 5 minutes. Grease and flour loaf pans. Mix 2 tablespoons sugar 1 tablespoon cinnamon and 1 teaspoon nutmeg. Pour 1/2 the dough in the bottom of the pans. Sprinkle with the sugar mixture. Add the remaining dough on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Makes 2 large or 3 medium loaves.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water; beat egg well and add to water. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Put in well-greased muffin pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown approximately 30 minutes. Dough can be kept in refrigerator a few days. Bring to room temperature before baking.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Combine tomatoes onion sugar salt garlic cloves and white vinegar. Boil slow 4 hours. Cook in canner for 45 minutes in hot water bath. Makes 16 quarts.

title: New Orleans Red Beans(Sister Virginia'S Centennial Southern Surprise)
instructions: Note One large ham hock or 2 small ham hocks may be substituted if bone not available.

title: Southern Plantation Cake
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl. Beat together 3 to 4 minutes. Do not add any other liquid. Place in 3 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Cook together the margarine sugar syrup and salt for 3 minutes. Add soda and vanilla. Pour over popcorn and mix well. Put in baking pan and bake for 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Stir several times while baking. If desired add peanuts.

title: Orange-Pineapple Ice Cream
instructions: Mix condensed milk and pineapple in churn container. Add enough orange drink to fill the churn to the fill line. Churn according to manufacturers instructions.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: In large bowl place salmon drained. Remove bones and mash with fingers. Add next 7 ingredients and mix. In large frying pan heat oil. Shape mixture into the size of small hamburgers and fry until brown on both sides. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Serve warm or at room temperature. Cooking time Under 1 hour. Makes 12 patties.

title: Green Enchiladas
instructions: Dip tortillas in hot grease and lay on paper towel to absorb some of grease. Stuff tortillas with meat onions and cheese. Roll and place on cookie sheet or pan with sides. Mix rest of ingredients. Pour over tortillas. Sprinkle cheese on top. Place in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted and tortillas are thoroughly heated.

title: Poached Fish(Microwave)
instructions: Place onion and butter in 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes until onion is transparent. Stir in wine salt sugar tarragon and pepper. Add fillets turning to coat fish well with sauce. Top with mushrooms. Cover with plastic. Microwave at High 6 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes. Rotate and spoon sauce over fish at 1/2 cooking time.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Oriental Sauce(Serves 2)
instructions: Combine the sherry sesame oil 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 tablespoon ginger in a bowl and mix well. Add the shrimp. Marinate in the refrigerator. Combine the lemon juice rice vinegar 2 tablespoons soy sauce sugar and red pepper in a bowl and set aside. Stir-fry the garlic with 1 tablespoon ginger in the peanut oil in a large saucepan. Add the shrimp with the marinade. Stir-fry until the shrimp are cooked through. Stir in the lemon juice mixture. Cook until heated through. Thicken with a paste of cornstarch and water if needed for the desired consistency. Serve over the hot pasta.

title: Mashed Potato Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sugar butter flour and milk. Beat good and add cocoa cinnamon nutmeg vanilla potatoes and nuts. Bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan at 350\u00b0. Ice with Potato Cake Icing.

title: Spaghetti A La Zike
instructions: Cook spaghetti 12 minutes. Drain. Cut up tomatoes (or run through blender). Add to spaghetti. Simmer 15 minutes. Add chopped onion and bell pepper to ground beef and cook until beef is browned. Add mixture to spaghetti. Mix well. Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover with slices of cheese. Let stand several hours before baking for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening. Add sugar; beat until smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda; add to cream mixture with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Thaw pie crust for 10 to 15 minutes. While crust is thawing combine butter flour 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Stir in broth and milk. Cook and stir until thick then stir in peas and carrots and chicken. Pour into crust put a crust on top. Cut slits in top crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: You will need a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Wassail
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in crock-pot. Insert cloves into orange and put in mixture. Simmer slowly for 2 hours.

title: Raspberry Whip
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl for 2 minutes or until completely dissolved. Mix cold water and ice cubes to make 2 cups. Add to gelatin stirring until slightly thickened with the consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Remove remaining ice. Stir in 2 1/4 cups whipped topping with wire whisk until smooth. Spoon into 8 individual souffle cups or dessert dishes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix shortening into dry ingredients. Add milk and yeast dissolved in warm water. Mix until all flour is moist. Cover bowl and store in icebox. Use as needed. Make in small balls. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until done. The dough keeps in the refrigerator about a week.

title: Starter Juice For Friendship Cake
instructions: Make starter in one-gallon glass jar. Combine apple juice water sugar lemon juice yeast cherries and juice. Use container that has lid. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cover and let stand at room temperature stirring twice each day.

title: Honey Glazed Chicken
instructions: Stir together the 1/2 cup soy sauce onion garlic oil and ginger root. Place chicken in a plastic bag; set in a bowl. Pour the soy sauce mixture over chicken; close bag. Chill for 2 to 3 hours turning chicken occasionally to distribute marinade. Drain. Skewer the chicken neck skin to back. Tie legs securely to tail; twist wing tips under back. Place the chicken breast side up on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Roast in a 375\u00b0 oven 1 1/2 hours or until drumstick moves easily in the socket. Meanwhile combine honey and the 2 tablespoons soy sauce. Baste chicken with honey soy mixture during the last 15 minutes of roasting time. Makes 6 servings.

title: Neptune Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; rinse and drain. In a large bowl combine tuna salad dressing and Salad Supreme. Add pasta; toss to evenly coat. Stir in tomatoes and onions. Cover; refrigerate at least 3 hours. Stir before serving.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook chopped onion in bacon drippings until clear. Add next 6 ingredients and stir. Add beans; stir well. Put in casserole; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Escalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle with toasted crumbs. Bake 30 minutes until brown on top.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in baking dish. Spread with the mustard. Place a slice of cheese on each breast. Sprinkle with onion and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients until boiling remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Drop on wax paper. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Pink Pineapple Topping
instructions: Simmer over medium heat stirring constantly until candies dissolve. Chill. Serve as a sundae topping or on puddings or between sponge cake wedges.

title: Quick Apple Cake
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread apples over bottom of pan. Pour over beaten eggs; mix. Add sugar oil nuts and vanilla turning with fork. Add flour cinnamon soda and salt. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Old-Fashioned Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in\torder and pour into an uncooked pie shell. Dust with remaining nutmeg if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 until set (about 30 minutes).

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown hamburger or sausage. Drain. Split English muffins in halves. Spread pizza sauce on each half. Mix onion and green pepper with meat. Spread meat mixture on each half of muffin. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Banana Split Salad
instructions: Combine graham crackers and melted butter; press into long baking dish. Beat oleo vanilla eggs (one at a time) and powdered sugar until thick and smooth like icing. Pour into crust. Slice bananas over filling. Press into filling. Add pineapple and spread over bananas. Spread large container Cool Whip over pineapple. Cover with chopped nuts and maraschino cherries; refrigerate.

title: Creamy Baked Chicken
instructions: Place cooked chicken in baking pan. Pour soup over and sprinkle crushed cubes over top. Lay slices of cheese on top and bake for 1/2 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Mama Dixon'S Pound Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites with 3 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Cover and place in refrigerator. Cream Crisco and 2 2/3 cups sugar until light. Add egg yolks 2 at a time. Add flour and whipping cream alternately to mixture. Fold in egg whites. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Kraut
instructions: You will need a stone churn or large jar.

title: Pineapple Apricot Bread
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients; set aside. Combine sugar butter and egg; beat well. Add milk pineapple apricots and raisins; beat well. Stir in flour mixture and pecans. Pour mixture into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in a pan on a wire rack. Remove from pan. Yield 1 loaf.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar oleo and milk. Cook 20 minutes and bring to boil on medium; stir occasionally. Remove from burner. Beat peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme into mixture. Pour into buttered pan. Let harden.

title: Ghostbuster Cake
instructions: Follow directions on cake mix and bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Just before cake is done mix rest of ingredients. Cook in a pan on low heat until chocolate and marshmallows are melted; let come to a boil. When cake is done punch holes in it with a wooden spoon handle and pour icing over it while hot.

title: Chuck'S Chili
instructions: Cut steak into cubes and small strips. Cube onion and green pepper. In a large frying pan brown all the meat with 1/2 of the onion and green pepper over low heat. As the meat is browning add chili powder basil celery seed and 1/2 of the garlic. Add salt pepper and Texas Pete to taste. Also add cumin and cayenne pepper. Cut jalapeno into rings and add to meat as it cooks.

title: Reese Cups
instructions: Mix and spread in buttered pan. Melt chocolate chips and wax; spread on top.

title: Triple Layer Chocolate Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crumbs 1/4 cup cocoa sugar and butter; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

title: Alma'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Line pie shell with pecans. Beat eggs well. Add syrup sugar salt and butter; mix and pour slowly into shell. Bake in moderately hot oven at 375\u00b0 on lower shelf for about 40 minutes. Cool. Serve topped with spoonfuls of whipped cream. Makes one (8-inch) pie. Makes 6 servings.

title: Browned Beef Stew
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in heavy skillet or Dutch oven. Place flour salt and pepper in bag. Shake to mix then add meat and shake to coat meat. Empty all including extra flour into hot oil and add onion and brown well. Add chopped carrot and next 4 ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat 1 1/2 hours stirring as\tneeded. Add diced potatoes carrots and onions; cook\t1/2 hour longer. Add peas and continue cooking about 15 minutes. (You may use a can of English peas if you prefer.)

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix wet ingredients. Mix in dry ingredients except flakes and nuts. Stir in flakes and nuts. Stores in refrigerator several days. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pizza Pop-Up Pie
instructions: Brown and simmer the first 7 ingredients. Pour meat mixture into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with Mozzarella cheese.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix and pour into dish. Cover with bacon strips. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients thoroughly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Blend the cream cheese sugar Cool Whip and vanilla well; spread over. Slice the bananas and place over Cool Whip mixture. Spoon blueberry pie filling over bananas.

title: Festive Rice
instructions: 1. In a medium (2 qt.) saucepan bring broth to a boil. Add rice. reduce heat to medium-low; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. 2. Stir in butter-flavor sprinkles and all vegetables. Cover. Continue simmering 10 minutes. 3. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Sprinkle top with butter sprinkles and black pepper. 4. Fluff with a fork before serving. Makes 8 servings.

title: Kraut
instructions: Fill a quart jar with chopped cabbage. Stick a banana pepper pod in the center of the jar. Add a whole garlic and the vinegar sugar salt and alum. Fill each jar with hot water.

title: Chinese Green Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing and ginger root in a small bowl. Stir well and let stand 30 minutes. Combine Chinese cabbage and next 3 ingredients. Toss gently. Pour dressing mixture over. Serve. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover with bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Pasta Bake
instructions: Combine Ricotta cheese 1/4 cup Romano cheese bread crumbs garlic and parsley flakes; mix well. Spread 1 cup sauce onto 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Fill each shell with approximately 2 tablespoons cheese mixture; place shells on top of sauce. Spoon remaining sauce over shells. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and remaining Romano cheese. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix together thoroughly and pour into crusts. Let set in refrigerator until chilled and firm minimum 4 hours.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Layer as follows in a casserole dish cooked noodles cooked sausage sauce peppers mushrooms pepperoni and cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening at medium speed with an electric mixer until fluffy. Gradually add sugars beating well. Add egg and vanilla beating until blended.

title: Peek-A-Boo Squares
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla and almond. Add flour mixing well.

title: Honey Pecan Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat peeled and sliced apples (1/8-inch thick) with cinnamon and sugar. Sift together dry ingredients and set aside in medium size bowl. In large bowl mix together remaining ingredients at medium speed until smooth and gradually add dry ingredients mixing until smooth.

title: Sweet Pea Soup
instructions: Add peas and water or vegetable cooking water according to directions on package (or 3 cups water for every 1 cup peas) to a large stock pot. Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer 1/2 hour. Add vegetables and seasoning and cook until peas have disintegrated to creamy consistency and vegetables mash easily against side of pot.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Combine rest of ingredients together and add to the dry mixture. Use right amount of milk to make right consistency batter. Fry in deep hot fat (305\u00b0 to 375\u00b0) until done which will take about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Toss together cornbread crumbs and muffin crumbs in an 8-inch baking dish. Add sage celery salt pepper poultry seasoning. Mix well. In butter add onion. Cook just until tender and clear. Add entire mixture to crumb and seasoning mixture.\tBeat two eggs slightly.\tAdd to mixture. Add chicken broth. Stir until well combined. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 - 45 minutes.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf With Sauce
instructions: Heat to boil. Pour over loaf and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour basting occasionally. This is better the second day.

title: Big Peach Pie
instructions: Peel and slice peaches; grate 2 teaspoons lemon peel and squeeze 2 tablespoons lemon juice. Toss peaches with sugar lemon and 2 tablespoons flour. In another bowl mix flour corn meal salt and shortening; work to consistency of coarse crumbs. Add 8 to 9 tablespoons cold water. Divide into 2 balls one larger for bottom. Roll larger ball out to fit a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Spoon peach mixture over bottom crust. Add second crust. Make slits in it. Brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and bacon. Drain kidney beans and butter beans. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until warm (approximately 1/2 hour) covered.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Add 1 large sliced mild onion and lots of chopped celery.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat together all ingredients. Pour in a 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until brown and set. Insert knife in center should come out clean.

title: Oatmeal Apple Raisin Muffins #2
instructions: Baking Temperature 400\u00b0. Baking Time 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breast
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chicken. Put 1/4 of stuffing mix on half of chicken breasts. Fold other half over and secure with toothpicks. Put in lightly greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Eggplant Stacks
instructions: Pare as many Russet (Idaho) potatoes as desired. Cut lengthwise into 3/8-inch thick slices then cut slices into strips 3/8-inch wide. Rinse in cold water; drain thoroughly on paper towels.

title: Barbecue Chicken Breasts In Marinade
instructions: In bowl large enough to hold all the chicken pieces combine all of the ingredients except chicken breasts and branch of fresh rosemary. Mix well. Place chicken breasts into mixture and allow to marinate a minimum of 2 hours. The longer the chicken is allowed to sit in marinade the better; can be left overnight.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in large slices until almost done. Saute (brown) pork chops in 2 tablespoons butter. Coat bottom of casserole dish with soup. Put in pork chops. Drain potatoes and put over pork chops. Pour remainder of soup over chops and potatoes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Overnight Ham
instructions: Place ham (fat side up) in a covered roasting pan or you can use foil to cover. Add water. Put ham in a cold oven and preheat to 500\u00b0. When it has preheated for 15 mintues turn oven off. Dont open door but time it for 3 hours. Preheat oven again and then cook for 15 minutes. Turn oven off and dont open oven for 7 hours or overnight. Yum!

title: Zucchini Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Party Pinwheels
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Sprinkle on remaining ingredients. Then roll and wrap tightly. Chill 2 hours. Cut off ends. Cut diagonally into 1-inch slices. I add ham slices to the mixture.

title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert(Lighter Eating - 4 Points)
instructions: Evenly arrange 12 graham cracker in a 9 x 13 cake pan. In a large bowl combine dry vanilla pudding mixes 1 1/3 c. dry milk powder and 3 c. water. Mix well using a wire whisk. Blend in 1/2 c. cool whip and 1 tsp. vanilla. Mix gently to combine. Spread half of mixture evenly over graham crackers. Layer another 12 graham crackers over top. Evenly spread remaining pudding mixture over graham crackers. Top with remaining 12 crackers. In a medium bowl combine dry chocolate pudding mix remaining 2/3 c. dry milk powder 1 tsp vanilla and 1 1/4 c. water. Mix well using a wire whisk. Spread chocolate mixture evenly over top of graham crackers. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Just before serving spread remaining cool whip evenly over top. Drizzle chocolate syrup evenly over cool whip. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Combine butter and water. Stir until butter melts. Pour over stuffing and toss. Stir in 1/2 can onions. Spoon stuffing mix into 9-inch dish (spray the dish).

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Bring milk to a boil add butter then gradually stir in grits. Be sure to not use quick cooking grits. Resume boil and continue cooking. Stir all the while until mixture takes on appearance of cooked farina. Remove from heat season with salt pepper and beat hard with electric mixer for 5 minutes. Mixture will take on a creamy appearance. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole and allow to sit.

title: Hot Fruit Compote
instructions: Combine all fruit in baking dish (13 x 9-inch). Combine brown sugar butter and applesauce in saucepan; heat and stir. Spoon over fruit and sprinkle with 3 tablespoons of brown sugar and pecans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Seal with aluminum foil.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Hold yolk of 1 egg for top of pie. Mix with 1 tablespoon water. Stir all other ingredients. Put in pie crusts and bake for 1 hour. Check pie and bake for 30 minutes longer.

title: No Bake Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients until thickened. Layer with vanilla wafers and bananas in large Pyrex dish. Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Chip Butter Balls
instructions: Mix together the flour chopped pecans and chips; set aside. Cream the butter; add the salt and icing sugar. Cream. Add rum extract and cold water. Gradually add flour mixture and blend. Mold dough into balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. While warm roll in icing sugar. When cool sprinkle with additional icing sugar.

title: Fluffy Tapioca Dessert
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in saucepan. Add jello and pudding mixes one at a time and stir well until dissolved. Bring to a boil turn off heat and cool. Pour cooled mixture into 2-quart bowl. Add carton of Cool Whip and drained oranges. Stir slowly until blended. Refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Silk Pie
instructions: Whip the butter and sugar until light. Add the chocolate and vanilla. Beat until blended. Add 1 egg and beat 5 minutes. Add the other egg and beat 5 more minutes. Fill baked pie shell. Chill.

title: Extra Good Cornbread(Makes 1 Large Cake)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Put butter in pan and place in oven to melt. Mix all other ingredients and beat until smooth. Remove pan from oven. Pour batter into pan and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Lime Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in the boiling water and let sit until partially set. Whip the gelatin and then add the rest of the ingredients (except oil) in the\torder given in the list of ingredients. Pour\tinto 9 x 13-inch dish which has been oiled and let set until firm. Cut into squares to serve.\tServes 12.

title: Cranberry Mousse(Jello Salad)
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Drain pineapple setting the pineapple aside and adding juice to gelatin. Stir in cranberry sauce lemon juice peel and nutmeg. Chill until mixture thickens. Fold in sour cream reserved pineapple and pecans. Pour into glass serving bowl or an oiled 9-cup mold. Chill until set at least 2 hours.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Have sausage and cheese at room temperature. Mix uncooked sausage with cheese and Bisquick. Roll into 1-inch balls and place on a cookie sheet. (You can freeze now on the sheet. When frozen they can be bagged.) Bake at 400\u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes. You can bake and freeze them too.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Oil and flour tube pan. Mix ingredients 2 minutes. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Boil potato until done. Peel and mash well. Mix powdered sugar with potato until it is thick enough to roll out (takes about one pound). Sprinkle dough board with powdered sugar or on long piece of wax paper. Roll dough out thin and spread peanut butter. Roll up wrap in wax paper and refrigerate until cool enough to slice.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil vermicelli; drain and cool. Sprinkle Salad Supreme seasoning on vermicelli. Mix vegetables with vermicelli. Add Italian dressing. Mix well. Marinate in refrigerator at least one hour before serving.

title: Barbecued Beef
instructions: Brown meat until crumbly. Drain off grease and add onion green peppers sugar mustard vinegar salt and catsup. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve on hamburger bun.

title: Okra Gumbo
instructions: Clean okra and cut into big pieces. Chop the onions. Put fresh tomatoes in boiling water; let stand for about 10 seconds. Peel tomatoes and cut up. Heat oil or Pam in a deep cast-iron skillet. Add vegetables and enough water to boil okra. Add the oregano bay leaf and salt. Cook over medium heat until okra is done.

title: 20 Minute Cake
instructions: Simmer to boiling the margarine cocoa and water. Blend together in a large bowl the flour sugar soda sour milk and eggs. Add chocolate mixture to flour mixture. Bake cake in a 17 x 11-inch jelly roll pan (any smaller and cake will run over). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Bake 5 minutes more while you make frosting. Frost the cake immediately after removing from oven.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients together and spread in 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix together the confectioners sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip. Spread this mixture over graham cracker crust. Spread the pie filling on top of Cool Whip mixture. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Beef And Green Onion Quiche(Microwave)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat 1 egg slightly. Add 1/2 cup evaporated milk and stuffing mix. Toss lightly. Let stand a few minutes until most of the liquid is absorbed.

title: Cameo Shrimp
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Saute shrimp with garlic onion oregano salt and pepper until shrimp are red and onions are brown. Add wine and tomato sauce; cook for 5 minutes. Serve over hot buttered angel hair or spaghetti. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend cream cheese with seasoning. Pat into round or square flat shape. Roll on all sides in lemon pepper.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Chop up in bite size pieces broccoli and celery. Cover with water and cook until crisp and tender (do not drain). In large saucepan combine oleo flour salt and pepper. Cook and stir until flour is slightly browned. Add milk 1 cup at a time. When sauce starts to thicken add Velveeta. Stir and cook over medium heat until cheese is completely melted and sauce is fairly thick. Add cheese sauce to vegetables. Let set for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Mostaccioli
instructions: Mix it all together except for noodles and cheese. Cook for 3 hours. Cook mostaccioli noodles. Serve noodles with sauce over them and cheese on top.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Put first four ingredients in pan which oil has been added; brown meat. Add water bouillon cubes cover and simmer one hour. Stir in Worcestershire sauce celery potatoes onions and carrots. Cover and simmer one hour or until vegetables are tender. Thicken with flour water mixture.

title: Blackberry Jam Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and spices together; cream sugar and margarine and add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Fold in jam raisins and nuts. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Serves 8 or 10.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Combine sour cream cream cheese lemon juice horseradish and Old Bay. Stir over low heat until bubbly. Add green pepper and flaked crab meat. Continue to heat until crab is heated through. Serve with variety of crackers chunks of bread or fresh vegetables.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Place in lasagne pan. Drizzle melted butter over top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Easy and good for lots of people. Serves 12.

title: Candied Apples
instructions: Cook water and sugar to a thick syrup. Peel and quarter apples and put in pan. Add pinch of salt; pour syrup over apples. Slice margarine or butter over apples. Add 1/4 cup of red cinnamon candy hearts before cooking. This makes apples a pretty red color and adds flavor. Cook on top of stove on medium-low until clear (20 to 35 minutes). (Apples may be baked in a 350\u00b0 oven about 45 minutes but tend to be slightly watery.) Make in a 9 1/2-inch round pan. Serves 8.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix sauerkraut carrots celery green pepper onion and pimentos. In small bowl mix sugar and oil; pour over vegetables and mix well. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.

title: Easy Ham Salad
instructions: Alternating ham and salad olives press through a meat grinder. Add enough mayonnaise to moisten. (Needs to be easy spreading consistency.) Do not add salt.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan to make crust. Bake as directed on package 7 to 8 minutes (dont overbake). Cool then top with the following Cream the mayonnaise cream cheese and spices together then spread over cool crust. Top with finely chopped raw vegetables. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Chill before serving.

title: Down Home Potato Salad
instructions: Boil peeled potatoes and eggs. When potatoes are tender place in large bowl making sure not to retain any excess water. While potatoes cool peel eggs. Separate egg whites placing yellows in small bowl. With fork mash yellows adding mustard to make a creamy texture. Cut up egg whites and add to cooled potatoes. With a large spoon chop potatoes to desired texture. Add 2 teaspoons relish and desired mayonnaise and mustard to potatoes. Stir well. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Taco Burgers
instructions: In skillet brown meat; drain off excess fat. Add tomatoes chili powder Worcestershire sauce garlic salt sugar and dry mustard. Stir well breaking up large pieces of tomato. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer gently uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes or until thick. Spoon into toasted buns. Sprinkle with lettuce and shredded cheese. Makes 8 servings.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Place sugar flour soda salt and cinnamon in a large bowl; blend. Stir in Raisin Bran. Stir in by hand the oil eggs and buttermilk. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Bake what you need and keep the rest in covered bowl in refrigerator. Spoon out as needed. Do not stir batter if you refrigerate it. Keeps 6 weeks.

title: Grandma Bea'S Flan
instructions: Preheat oven to 225\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except sugar in blender and whip for 5 minutes. Dissolve sugar in saucepan and cook until caramelized. Pour sugar into 9-inch cake pan and pour custard on top. Place a low roasting pan half filled with water in oven. Set cake pan with flan mixture in the middle of roasting pan and bake for 2 hours and 5 minutes.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Shrimp
instructions: You can play with this recipe depending on the shrimp count. Depending on the size of the shrimp will depend on how many appetizers you will get. I usually cut the bacon in half and wrap around medium size shrimp (30 count). You can prepare this the day before and let marinate. Put the bacon wrapped shrimp on a cookie sheet making sure each is covered in the teriyaki baste. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. They are excellent!

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix well and put in refrigerator for 3 days. Mix each day and on day 4 roll into logs. Bake 8 hours at 175\u00b0 turning once. Put over pan for grease to drip.

title: Taco Pockets
instructions: You also need a dough press.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place sliced apples in baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over apples. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Beat egg; add milk salmon and crackers until you can make a loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Bundt Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients except pecans in mixing bowl and beat at high speed. Pour half the batter into well-greased Bundt pan. Sprinkle pecans over and add rest of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cracklin' Bread
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients together into bowl. Stir in mixture of egg and milk. Add cracklings; mix well. Pour into greased 8-inch baking pan or 10-inch iron skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until browned.

title: Squaw Corn
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Remove bacon from pan. Add onions chopped and cook 3 minutes. Add corn with liquid and heat through. Add eggs unbeaten one at a time and stir gently over moderate heat. Add bacon crumbled. Continue cooking until eggs are set. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook the chicken breasts and cut into bite size pieces. Mix chicken vegetables potatoes and soup in a 2 qt. casserole dish. In another bowl mix Bisquick milk and egg until blended. Pour this mixture over the chicken mixture. Bake at 425 for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreos; mix butter cheese and sugar then mix milk dry pudding and Cool Whip together. Then put both mixtures together. Layer cookies and mixture.

title: Gingerbread Men
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Stir in water. Mix together last 6 ingredients. Add flour mixture to liquid mixture 1/3 at a time. Knead. Cut into balls size of golf balls. Mold into shape of gingerbread man and decorate.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain cooked squash. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into buttered casserole. Cover with cracker crumbs. Bake 25 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: In a saucepan cook the onion in the butter until straw colored. Put the bread cubes in a large bowl. Pour in the milk and the onion. Set aside until milk has been absorbed. Add the chopped round steak chopped veal chopped pork salt pepper allspice nutmeg and eggs. With hands mix all the ingredients together thoroughly and shape into balls (1-inch). Roll balls in flour.

title: Chinese Chicken Salad
instructions: Blend soy sauce oil sherry honey and sugar. Pour 1/2 over chicken and let set 2 hours. Cook pasta (al dente) parcook (not all the way) the snow peas (you want them crunchy). Mix everything else together. Add cashews right before serving they may get soggy.

title: Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Chop broccoli into small pieces and steam until slightly crisp. Beat eggs and milk until frothy. Mix flour powder and salt. Stir into egg mixture. Mix well. Fold in broccoli cheese and onion. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased baking pan. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. May be refrigerated and reheated in microwave. Cut into squares.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain and cook with 6 cups stock until tender about 2 hours. In large pot heat oil; saute celery onion and garlic until soft. Add rice and saute 2 to 3 minutes longer. Stir in 1 cup stock from beans. Add beans and rest of liquid in which they were cooked. Add remaining ingredients except milk. Cook 1 to 2 hours. Blend milk with 1/2 cup soup broth add mixture to soup. Serve garnished with chopped green onions and a drop of sour cream.

title: Bird Seed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and save the broth; brown the chicken pieces in butter and add the onion bell pepper pimentos and mushrooms. In another pan stir the cream of chicken soup and Velveeta until cheesy. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. Spread spaghetti in baking dish and top with chicken adding cream mixture on top of chicken. Top layer with cheese mixture and bake until all cheese is melted.

title: Middle Eastern Style Dip
instructions: In covered blender or food processor combine all ingredients. Blend until smooth. Serve at room temperature or chilled with pita bread. Cut up fresh vegetables or use crackers for dipping. Makes 2 1/4 cups.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
instructions: In large bowl whisk eggs sour cream and green onions. Sprinkle bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish with 3/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Cover cheese with 1/2 the egg mixture then in equal portions layer as follows chilies jalapenos egg mixture chilies jalapenos and egg mixture. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Jello Pudding Dirt Cups
instructions: You will need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) plastic cups.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables as directed. Put in baking dish. Pour cream of mushroom soup (undiluted) over vegetables. Cover with American cheese slices. Crumble bread over cheese. Melt oleo and pour over bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bread is lightly browned.

title: Pan-Broiled Shrimp
instructions: Use fresh or frozen uncooked shrimp. Remove shell leaving tail. Remove black vein in back. Melt butter in pan; add seasonings. Stir-fry shrimp about 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Mix rhubarb 3 tablespoons flour and sugar. Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix brown sugar 1 1/2 cups flour butter and shortening with a fork. Crumble mixture over rhubarb mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown (30 to 40 minutes).

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook cool skin and debone chicken. Cut or shred into small pieces. Saute onion pepper and celery. Heat soup. Add sour cream and chopped chiles to soup. Add all ingredients thus far together. Mix to blend well.

title: Very Good Marshmallow Salad
instructions: Put small marshmallows in bowl. Add pineapple chunks. Add nuts and grapes. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Mother'S Golden Coconut Custard
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add cream or rich milk sugar vanilla butter and coconut. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes and 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until set and light brown. Top with meringue or just before serving decorate with whipped cream.

title: Best Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shell. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 then reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake about 45 minutes longer or until inserted knife comes out clean. Serve topped with whipped cream.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown beef; drain and add onions. Add everything except cheese. Simmer for 15 minutes top with cheese and serve.

title: Coffee Tortoni
instructions: Toast almonds and coconut until light brown. Fold 4 tablespoons sugar instant coffee and flavorings into whipped cream. Beat egg whites until white. Add 2 tablespoons sugar. Mix all together and put into cupcake liners and freeze.

title: Porcupine Meat Balls
instructions: Mix beef rice and spices. Roll into balls. Place in casserole dish. Mix soup and water. Pour over meat balls. Cook covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes.

title: Pistachio Orange Asparagus
instructions: In a saucepan bring 1 inch of water to a boil. Place asparagus in a steamer basket over water. Cover and steam for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender; drain. Place asparagus on a serving platter and keep warm.

title: Hawaiian Bread
instructions: In large bowl combine 2 cups flour yeast salt sugar dry milk and 1 1/2 cups water to make thick batter. Drop in eggs one at a time; blend. Work in 2 more cups flour. Break butter into several pieces; drop into mixture. Blend with 25 strong strokes with wooden spoon. Work in coconut and nuts. Add remaining flour 1/2 cup at a time to form a shaggy mass. Sprinkle board with flour; turn out dough. With rhythm of push turn and fold knead dough for about 7 minutes. Return dough to bowl cover with plastic wrap and leave at room temperature until double in size about 1 hour.

title: Custard
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and vanilla. Add to milk when scalding. Stir constantly until coats spoon. Strain in jar. Chill.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Cream together until smooth. Spread on cooled Apple Nut Cake.

title: The Best Sugar Cookie You Ever Ate Or Snitched!
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add next four ingredients together. Mix well. Add dry ingredients. Mix. Roll into balls. Smoosh down with warm glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes until lightly browned on edges. Frost with favorite icing. Yields 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Heavenly Waffles
instructions: Mix all together and bake in a preheated waffle iron. These are delicious and so light and crisp. Easy to stir up.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cover pepperoni with water and boil 5 minutes; drain. Saute onions in 1 1/2 tablespoons butter. Pour remaining butter in 11 x 7 1/2-inch casserole dish. Toss spaghetti in butter. Cover with 8 ounces tomato sauce 1/2 cup of Swiss cheese 1/2 of the pepperoni 1/2 of the sausage 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese and all of mushrooms and onions. Sprinkle oregano and basil over mixture. Top with remaining Swiss cheese pepperoni sausage tomato sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch tube or 12-cup Bundt pan. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan. Mix all cake ingredients together. Pour batter over nuts. Bake 1 hour; cool. Invert on serving plate. Prick top to allow cake to absorb glaze. Repeat until glaze is used up.

title: Baked Barbecued Shrimp
instructions: Leave shells on shrimp but slit down the back with a pear of scissors and remove vein. Wash shrimp well; pat dry and spread in shallow pan. Combine remaining ingredients except bread in small saucepan and let simmer for 10 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Pour over shrimp and mix thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate 2-3 hours stirring every 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Bake shrimp turning frequently until they just turn pink about 15-20 minutes; DO NOT OVERBAKE. Adjust seasoning. Serve in soup bowls with chunks of French bread to soak up the sauce and plenty of napkins.

title: Mint Juleps(20 Servings)
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a glass container; stir until sugar is dissolved. Cover; let stand overnight. Strain mixture in large pitcher discarding mint. To serve fill chilled glasses with shaved ice; add julep mixture and garnish with fresh mint sprigs.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 and lightly spray baking dish (shallow) with cooking oil. Soak breads in 1 cup water. Mash soaked bread with a fork. Put ground beef in a mixing bowl. Add bread onion parsley cheese egg salt and pepper. Mix well and dump into baking dish. Shape into a loaf. Bake for 30 minutes. Pour tomato sauce over meat; sprinkle with oregano. Bake for 20 minutes longer. Serves 4 to 6. Delicious served hot or cold.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Add tomatoes onions peppers salt and water together. Boil for 10 minutes. Add to that mixture the vinegar sugar and mustard. Boil for 10 minutes more. Add cornstarch and boil 10 minutes longer. Makes about 8 pints. Can and seal.

title: Pumpkin Pie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Remove 1 cup of the cake mix; reserve. In small bowl lightly beat 1 egg. In large bowl stir together remaining cake mix melted butter and the beaten egg. Press into prepared pan. In large bowl lightly beat remaining 3 eggs. Stir in pumpkin 1/2 cup of the sugar brown sugar evaporated milk and cinnamon. Pour over cake mixture in pan. To the 1 cup reserved cake mix add remaining 1/2 cup sugar walnuts and softened butter; mix until crumbly. Sprinkle over pumpkin mixture. Bake 50 to 60 minutes. Serve warm or cool. Preparation 15 minutes; total time 1 hour 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Cheese Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water until syrupy set in refrigerator. Let cream cheese soften to room temperature. Stir together sugar vanilla lemon juice and cream cheese; stir until smooth. Add jello. Whip chilled Milnot with mixer until fluffy. Stir in cream cheese mixture mix well.

title: English Walnut Pie
instructions: Bake in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.

title: Chicken-Bacon Bites
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Trim crusts from bread and discard. Flatten bread slightly with a rolling pin. Combine chicken spread and Worcestershire sauce and spread on bread slices. Cut each slice into four squares. Fold each square in half spread side inand wrap with piece of bacon. Place bites on a broiler pan. Bake 40 minutes turning halfway through. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm. Makes 2 dozen appetizers.

title: Sausage Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and onion; drain. Add other ingredients. Simmer until heated through but do not boil. Put in crock-pot on low to keep warm. Serve with warm tortilla chips.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cook hen in salt water (little onion and celery to taste). Make cream sauce of oleo flour and milk. Salt and pepper to taste. Saute green pepper in mushroom juice. Bone chicken and cut in cubes. Add cheese mushrooms onion green pepper cooked spaghetti and cream sauce. Mix well and bake in buttered baking dish for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 (or a little longer until brown).

title: Marinade(Good For All Types Of Meat From Venison To Chicken)
instructions: Mix ingredients in bowl and place meat in bowl. Cover and marinate several hours or overnight.

title: Fridgerated Lemon Cheese Cake
instructions: Put crumbs and butter together. Press into oblong pan. Sprinkle 1/3 cup crumbs on top of cake. Refrigerate.

title: Grandma'S Swedish Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all together in large roaster or crock-pot. Cover and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 or in crock-pot on medium or high for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Place meat on heavy-duty foil. Add all other ingredients. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator or for at least 6 hours. Cook in crock-pot on low heat for 10 hours.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan bring first 4 ingredients to a boil for 1 minute and remove from heat. Then add the remaining ingredients. Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Beat eggs lightly. Add sugar and salt. Blend well. Add milk and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Balls
instructions: Form meat into 1/2-inch balls; do not season. Place in shallow pan; microwave for 2 minutes. Turn occasionally until meat is firm; dont overcook. Drain. Melt jelly and catsup in electric skillet. Place meat in mixture; simmer slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Have toothpicks available for guests. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hot Chicken And Rice Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Stir until mixed well. Add next 6 ingredients. Mix well. Spoon into lightly greased dish. Combine corn flakes almonds and butter and sprinkle on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Italian Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef in large pan; drain. Add all the ingredients except cabbage green beans and macaroni. Bring to a boil. Lower heat; cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add cabbage green beans and macaroni. Bring to a boil; simmer until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Slum Gullion
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in 2 tablespoons oil; add meat and brown. Drain off oil and add salt and pepper tomatoes and catsup. Simmer 15 minutes. Cook macaroni; add and stir to mix. Simmer until served. Serve with tossed salad and French bread. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown steak chunks in oil. When done stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes or microwave 10 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Arroz Con Pollo Nuevo Mexicano(Chicken With Rice, New Mexican Style)
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup oil in a skillet; brown chicken pieces on all sides. Drain chicken and reserve. Add remaining oil to skillet. Add the rice. Cook stirring until rice is transparent and golden. Stir in garlic. Set chicken on top of rice. Pour in the broth or water and beer. Stir in cumin saffron salt and pepper. Bring to a boil; simmer covered until rice is tender and liquid absorbed. Stir in peas and reheat. Serves 6.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Combine sugar water and cinnamon. Bring to boil and boil for about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add oleo. Set aside. Sift the remaining dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening until mixture crumbles. Add milk all at once and stir just until flour is moistened. On lightly floured surface roll dough and cut into rectangles. Place apple on rectangle add some cinnamon and dot with oleo. Bring dough up around apple. Place in ungreased baking pan. Pour syrup over dumplings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes(For A Large Quantity)
instructions: Can do both recipes on an electric grill set at 400\u00b0. Turn pancakes when bubbles appear on top. Enjoy!!

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk in a saucepan. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes. Bake off heat. Add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix spice cake as directed on the back of the box then add blackberry preserves and then the remaining ingredients and mix well. Grease and flour a tube pan and pour cake mix evenly in pan. Top with walnut and pecan halves and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or using a toothpick and place in the cake and if it comes out clean the cake is done.

title: Souper Tuna Noodle Bake
instructions: In pan cook onion in butter until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until hot. Stir. Top with sliced cheese and croutons. Bake until cheese melts. Serves 6.

title: Black Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let sit a few hours. Serve chilled.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Heat milk over low heat. In bowl mix sugar flour and eggs. Beat well. Pour into heated milk. Cook over medium heat until mixture boils. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Pour custard into prepared crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yield 8 servings (each with 295 calories).

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions (do not overcook). Drain and rinse. Cook meat until done; drain. Return to skillet. Add salt pepper garlic and tomato sauce. Simmer about 5 minutes. Combine cottage cheese sour cream onions noodles and meat sauce in 2-quart casserole. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Italian Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients stir until smooth. Cover chill. Makes 1 1/4 Cups.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Mix vinegar peppers sugar and salt. Boil 1 minute and take off heat for 10 minutes. Add coloring and Certo. Let stand 10 more minutes then skim. Put in sterile jars and seal.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Bring tomato soup sugar vinegar oil and Worcestershire sauce to a boil. Pour boiled mixture over carrots onion and green pepper. Marinate overnight in refrigerator.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; take off bone and tear pieces apart. Boil noodles in chicken broth (save about 1 cup broth). Mix everything including the extra broth and pour into Pyrex dish.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all together; bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy gradually add sugar. Beat in sour cream and vanilla flavor (medium speed) until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip (do not beat). Pour in crust and chill 2 hours.

title: Corned Beef Sandwich
instructions: Makes 6 nice sandwiches.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix milk egg yolks and lemon juice together. Pour in pie shell. Top with meringue. Bake. Cool. Place in refrigerator until cold before cutting.

title: Onion Blossom
instructions: Take onion and cut in sections but not all the way through. Take butter and put between wedges. Sprinkle Cavenders and garlic salt on onion. Put in bowl and put waxed paper over onion. Cook in microwave on High for 5 minutes.

title: Grated Sweet Potato Pone
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Pour mixture into lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until slightly firm. Stir twice during cooking.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Separate from bone in small pieces. Place in\t12 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In a saucepan boil broth and\tcream of chicken soup.\tCombine margarine pepper flour and\tbuttermilk. Pour broth mixture over chicken then spoon batter over\ttop. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix sugar and flour together. Pour in milk; stir until smooth. Melt butter in a 2-quart dish (tall sides) in oven. Pour batter into dish. Pour peaches onto batter. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Fry bacon until very crisp then add onion and saute with a little water. Set aside and cook potatoes in large pan. When potatoes begin to get soft add the bacon onion salt and pepper. Cook until the potatoes begin to get soupy. You may add a little milk if desired.

title: Chocolate Wacky Cake
instructions: No eggs no milk cake.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook rinse and drain macaroni. Mix all ingredients in order given except mayonnaise and sour cream. Mix these in small bowl and pour over all. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo; add celery and onion. Cook until almost tender. Add seasonings Cheez Whiz and mushroom soup. Beat slightly. Combine with drained broccoli and rice. Bake in a greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles. Add topping of bread crumbs and cheese and brown.

title: Zucchini Supper
instructions: Beat eggs milk and Bisquick; mix until smooth. Add zucchini onion pepper and cheese. Mix well. Pour into greased 15-inch cookie sheet and bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Frosty Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in electric ice cream churn. Churn will cut off when ice cream is made (about 20 to 30 minutes). Simple easy and tastes just like a \frosty.\

title: Aunt Liz'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Blend together margarine flour and nuts. Spread into cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes; cool. Blend cream cheese and powdered sugar together. Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip. Spread on cooled crust. Mix chocolate pudding and milk. Mix according to directions on package. Spread on cream cheese layer. Spread Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle with chocolate curls.

title: Uncooked Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa margarine and milk. Heat to boiling point in a large saucepan stirring constantly. Boil 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add oats; beat well. Add vanilla and peanut butter; beat well. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Broccoli Carrot Cuts
instructions: Mix cream cheese dressing mix and mayonnaise. Spread out crescent rolls on cookie sheet and bake; cool. Spread mix over crescent sheet. Sprinkle with diced vegetables. Serve immediately.

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Cook meat in skillet (drain off fat). Add salt pepper butter garlic salt and tomato sauce. Simmer about 5 minutes; alternate layers of noodles and meat. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crispy Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Place popped corn in a large baking pan. Bring to a boil the sugar syrup and oleo in a saucepan. Cook 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add soda and extracts. Pour over popcorn. Stir. Place in oven and bake for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Slaw
instructions: Cut the cabbage and mix with the salt. Let stand for 1 hour then add cut up celery and pepper.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding as directed. Mix pudding milk and Cool Whip. Layer pudding mix bananas and wafers ending with wafers. Refrigerate.

title: Cajun Pasta And Chicken
instructions: Cook macaroni; brown chicken in 2 tablespoons oil. Remove and add peppers and onions. Remove and add remaining oil. Stir in flour. Stir until dark brown; add tomato to make thick sauce. Add chicken onion and pepper to sauce. Serve over macaroni.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Combine eggs oil and strawberries. Add to dry ingredients mixing well. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Mom'S Baked Crab Salad In Seashells
instructions: Combine all ingredients except buttered crumbs. Place in greased shells and sprinkle with buttered crumbs. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 until crumbs are golden brown. Serves 8.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Cut buttered bread into finger-width pieces. Arrange in layers in buttered baking dish. Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar salt vanilla and milk. Sprinkle with cinnamon (optional) and 1/4 cup cooked drained raisins (optional). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Special Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hazel'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Place bread in baking dish. Beat eggs milk sugar and salt together. Pour over bread. Add vanilla and mix in raisins. Place dish in a pan of hot water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Center of pudding should be firm. Insert knife in middle knife should come out clean if not cook longer. Serves 4.

title: Zucchini Italiano
instructions: Saute zucchini in butter 5 minutes; add remaining ingredients stirring gently. Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes. Yields 2 servings.

title: Deluxe Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in butter. Add chopped bacon for extra flavor.

title: Egg Noodles
instructions: For each egg add next 4 ingredients. Mix well. Add enough flour to make stiff dough. Roll dough out flat then cover with thin layer of flour; roll like jelly roll. Cut 1/2 way through lengthwise then make thin slices across. Drop into boiling chicken or beef broth then simmer 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
instructions: Place potatoes and ham in 2-quart casserole. Mix together soup milk and cheese heating until cheese is melted. Pour over potatoes and ham in dish. Place covered dish in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet saute onion and ground beef. Add mushrooms and seasoning. Cook a few minutes. Add broth and tomato juice then add beans. Simmer in skillet or put in a 2-quart casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Tasty Crescent Hamburgers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Add sour cream celery soup and crumbled onion rings to drained hamburger; mix well. Flatten crescent rolls out on flat surface 1 at a time. Place large spoonful of meat mixture in center of roll. Bring edges up over meat mixture. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake until brown; dont overcook.

title: Lentil And Barley Stew
instructions: Saute in oil celery onion cumin and garlic. Add water and lentils; cook 20 minutes. Add tomatoes barley salt pepper and herbs. Simmer 30 minutes. Add carrots and simmer another 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: *Add 1 at a time.

title: Creole Icing
instructions: Combine butter coffee cocoa and cinnamon. Gradually add sugar beating to spreading consistency. Makes 1 1/2 cups icing or enough for an 8 or 9-inch layer cake.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Combine yeast and water; let stand 5 minutes or until bubbly. Add buttermilk to yeast mixture and set aside. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add buttermilk mixture mixing with fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out on a floured surface and knead lightly about 3 or 4 times. Roll dough in 1/2-inch thickness; cut into rounds with a 2-inch cutter and place on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yield About 3 dozen.

title: Cucumber Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello sugar and lemon juice in hot water. Add cottage cheese salad dressing onion cucumber and ground nuts. Thoroughly mix all ingredients and place in mold. Chill several hours. Unmold before serving.

title: Pecan Cheese Treats(Serves 20)
instructions: Sift flour and pepper together. Soften margarine and combine with cheese; stir in flour and pepper. Mix until dough is smooth. Roll by hand into 35 to 36 small balls. Cut each ball in half to add pecan; shape dough around pecans. Put on ungreased cookie sheet and chill in refrigerator 15 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients using 3/4 dressing mix. Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining dressing mix on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Marble Squares
