instructions: Combine margarine water and chocolate in saucepan; bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in flour sugar soda and salt. Add eggs and sour cream; mix well. Pour into greased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.

title: Country Steak
instructions: Cut steak into strips and roll in flour; brown all sides. Add onion and green pepper. Salt and pepper. Add water and simmer on medium heat until tender about 1 hour. Take 2 to 3 tablespoons of cornstarch and water and make slightly thick paste. Add to steak to make gravy. Add water if necessary.

title: Orange Sticky Buns
instructions: Add grated rind of oranges to sugar. Melt butter and add to orange juice. Spray inside of Bundt pan with vegetable spray. Separate biscuits and dip in melted butter. Mix and then add sugar and rind mix. Place in pan in layers pouring any remaining juice and sugar over buns. Bake at 385\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Turn upside-down on serving dish. Be careful to avoid splashing of hot syrup.

title: Artichoke Parmesan Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line a 9 inch deep dish pie plate with pastry. Prick bottom & sides several times with fork. Bake 7 to 8 minutes until it begins to brown; set aside. Decrease oven temperature to 400 degrees.

title: Lemon Glaze
instructions: Heat milk and butter. Pour over sugar. Stir and add lemon juice. Pour on cake while hot.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut stems from green peppers and remove seeds. Cook in boiling water for 5 minutes. Mix ground meat with bread crumbs onions milk salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Fill peppers and bake covered for 45 minutes uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix butter cream cheese and water. Add sugar oil and eggs. Mix well with electric mixer. Add cake mix and mix thoroughly. Pour in bundt pan and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix flour baking powder soda and salt. Add sugar to shortening; mix well. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture gradually. Mix well. Spread in 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle with chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut into bars. Makes 48.

title: Persimmon Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Raspberry Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix above together as first layer. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes and cool.

title: One Dish Supper
instructions: Brown the ground beef add onions and bell pepeer pour off the excess grease. Add the cooked rice one can of the tomato soup. Cut the cabbage into about 4 inch pieces. Butter the bottom and sides of the pan cover the bottom with a layer of cabbage then rice and ground beef mixture then top with remaining cabbage and spread the second can of soup over the cabbage.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over shortening sugar and salt. Blend by cutting up shortening. Dissolve yeast in cup of warm water. Add to eggs and mixture. Add flour and blend well. Cover with foil and place in refrigerator at least 4 hours before rolling. Roll out as needed; cut rolls with biscuit cutter then fold in half. Let rise in pan 2 hours before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli. Heat butter onion mushroom soup and cheese until bubbly. Add rice and broccoli and mix well. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Dirt
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies. Mix together cream cheese butter and confectioners sugar. Combine milk pudding mix and vanilla until thick. Mix together pudding and cream cheese mixture then mix in Cool Whip. Layer Cool Whip mixture alternately with crushed Oreo cookies beginning with Cool Whip mixture. Chill.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix dry ingredients then add liquid. Mix. Add salad oil very little at a time. Pour over apples bananas canned pineapple grapes oranges peaches and strawberries.

title: Baked Ham In Paper Bag
instructions: You will also need 2 brown paper grocery bags.

title: Chocolate Or Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt. Scald milk. Add to sugar mixture a little at a time. Beat egg yolks stir in some of the hot mixture then add both mixtures together. Cook on low heat until real thick. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Add coconut. Beat egg whites until fluffy. Add 6 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Fold in 1/4 egg white mixture into pie and pour into baked pie shell. Top with remaining egg whites and bake until brown.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except carrots. Beat until smooth then add carrots. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes then remove from pans and let cool before icing.

title: Indiana Date Pudding
instructions: Boil the brown sugar and water for 3 minutes. Pour into a 9 x 13 pan. Mix together the sugar and oleo then add milk flour baking powder chopped nuts and diced dates. Spoon batter mixture by spoonfuls into water/brown sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Put all in casserole dish and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir. Continue baking covered for 30 more minutes.

title: Pineapple And Squash
instructions: Do not peel young tender squash. Combine with water sugar and vinegar. Cook until tender (do not overcook). Add pineapple and bring back to a boil. Spoon into sterilized jars and seal. Makes 3 or 4 pints. Serve chilled. (Something different.)

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Melt butter. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Serve as soon as removed from oven preferably with ice cream or Cool Whip.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add oil and prunes. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add nuts. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan. When cold turn out and sift powdered sugar over top.

title: Cheesy Grits And Vegetables
instructions: Prepare grits as directed on the package. Add cheese and margarine stirring until melted. Beat eggs in a small bowl. Stir a small amount of the hot mixture into eggs then combine eggs with hot mixture mixing well. Fold in thawed mixed vegetables. Pour mixture into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High power for 12 to 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated turning dish twice during cooking if not using a rotation table. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Shrimp Fettucini
instructions: Saute onion bell pepper celery and garlic in large pot. Add parsley and shrimp; cook 10 minutes. Add flour half and half cream and cheese stirring until cheese is melted over medium-low heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Boil drain and rinse noodles. Stir into shrimp mixture. Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch glass casserole dish; top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. (Crawfish can be used.)

title: Christmas Eve She Crab Soup
instructions: In top of double boiler heat milk mace and lemon peel. Let simmer 7 minutes. Add crab butter and cream. Heat over boiling water. Remove peel. Add cracker crumbs and seasonings and let stand. Add sherry and crumbled egg yolks to bottom of soup cup before serving. Serves 6.

title: Goulash
instructions: Cook onion garlic and bell peppers in oil. Add meat salt and pepper. Cook until done. Drain. Add tomato sauce tomatoes worcestershire. Simmer about 1 hour. Cook elbow macaroni. Mix with meat sauce. Cover turn heat off and let set. It if gets to dry just add a little water. Sprinkle cheese on each serving. Serve with salad and garlic toast.

title: Preacher'S Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Grease casserole pan (9 x 13-inch). Sliver onion on bottom of pan. Press hamburger over onion. Salt and pepper. Pour mushroom soup over hamburger. Add tomato soup over mushroom soup. Layer frozen Tater Tots over top. Sprinkle salt on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Oleta Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Whip softened cream cheese. Add sugar and beat until smooth. Add Cool Whip and flavorings. Mix well until fluffy but do not overbeat. Will be runny if overbeaten. Put in graham cracker shell and add cherry pie filling ring for decoration. Makes 2 pies.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash onions and bell pepper with salt and pepper in small amount of water until tender; drain. Mix soup milk egg cheese and cracker crumbs. Layer with squash mixture in a casserole. Top with bacon and more cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 2 layers as directed on box; let cool. Mix vanilla pudding as directed and set aside. Crumble 1 layer of cake in bottom of punch bowl then layer 1/2 pineapple 1/2 pudding mix 1/2 strawberries 1/2 nuts 1/2 coconut 1/2 Cool Whip and 1/2 of cherries. Repeat layers leaving enough Cool Whip nuts and cherries to sprinkle on top.

title: Burnt Sugar Pie
instructions: Brown 1 cups sugar until golden and add enough hot water to make a syrup. Then add to warm milk. Then add these ingredients mixed together in a small bowl. 1/3 cup sugar 1/4 tsp. salt 4 eggs separated (save the whites for the meringue) 1/2 cup or 6 Tbsp. cornstarch and 1/3 cup milk. Mix well and add to milk and cook until thickened. Pour into pie shells. Cover with meringue and brown in oven.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together thoroughly hamburger crackers and tomato sauce in a large bowl. Combine and mix together well egg salt pepper and onion or onion salt. Add egg mixture to hamburger mixture and mix together thoroughly. Shape in 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
instructions: Mix. Cut steak into 1-inch cubes. Clean fresh mushrooms. Soak meat and mushrooms for 2 hours. Saute meat and mushrooms. Serve warm.

title: Pasties (A Meat Pie)
instructions: Lay 1 pie crust flat. In center place 3/4 cup diced potatoes. Layer about 1/2 cup diced meat on top followed by 1/4 cup diced onions. Sprinkle with about 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper (more or less to taste). Bring edges of dough up over filling. Moisten with water and crimp to seal tightly. Poke 2 holes on each side of crimp to vent steam. Carefully pour 1/4 cup water into one of the holes. Place on cookie sheet and bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Perfect Pizza
instructions: Combine water oil sugar and salt in a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle yeast over water mixture until dissolved. Add flour gradually. Mix well after each addition.

title: Cherries Jubilee
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Spread pineapple in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add cherry pie filling. Spread dry cake mix over top. Melt butter and pour over this. Place in oven for 30 minutes. Take out and sprinkle nuts over top. Put back in oven for 30 minutes longer.

title: Whiskey Sours
instructions: Mix well chill and Enjoy!!

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put 1 stick or 1/2 cup margarine in a deep baking dish and set in oven to melt.

title: Sayyadiyyi(Fish With Rice)
instructions: Wash fish; salt inside and out. Let stand for 1 hour. Fry fish in olive oil. Set in platter. Remove heads from fried fish and boil in 2 cups water on medium heat about 1/2 hour. Strain liquid. Brown onions until golden brown in fish residue adding more olive oil if needed. Add rice cumin salt and pepper. Saute rice with onions for a few minutes. Add strained liquid to measure 4 cups. Add water if additional liquid is needed. Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Then simmer for 10 additional minutes until rice is done. Place rice on platter. Debone fish and put over rice. Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Goop
instructions: Mix everything and put into crock-pot and cook on high for two hours.

title: Soft Taco Shells
instructions: Combine ingredients in bowl; beat with rotary beater until smooth. Use 1/4 cup or 1/2 cup measuring cup of batter. Pour on hot griddle. Quickly smooth out batter in thin circle using the bottom of the measuring cup. If a hole appears just drop more batter in then smooth out. Bake until done.

title: Fried Plantain
instructions: Peel and slice plantain. Using large frying pan fry plantain until brown. (Be careful not to have frying pan too hot). Serve hot or warm. Can be served with rice and any type of meat.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in greased dish. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with slightly crumbled potato chips and shredded cheese. Bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion together and drain excess fat (if onion salt is used add after draining). Add salt (unless onion salt is used) and pepper to taste. Combine ground beef mixture tomato sauce oregano garlic salt Italian seasoning. Cook in slow cooker on low heat for 3 to 5 hours.

title: Chicken And Wine With Rice
instructions: Put chicken and water in roaster (no cover). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add both cans of soup and wine. (Mix soups together before adding to roaster.) Put soups and wine in roaster. Cook another 30 to 40 minutes. Serve chicken and sauce over bed of rice. Sauce also tastes great over green beans.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs lightly; add to meat oatmeal and chopped onion. Combine white horseradish salt dry mustard milk and ketchup. Add to meat mixture and shape into loaf. Place on flat baking pan and spread 1/2 cup ketchup on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add one egg and mix well. Stir in molasses. Stir soda into hot water and mix with molasses mixture. Add flour gradually to make a stiff enough dough to roll. Roll on floured board and cut out shapes with a cookie cutter. Put on greased cookie sheet and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt the first 3 ingredients together in the microwave or in the top of a double boiler. Pour over the cereal in a large bowl. Mix well. Put the powdered sugar and cereal in a grocery bag and shake well.

title: Curry-Cajun Spiced Chicken
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan combine honey water mustard melted oleo Cajun seasoning curry powder lemon juice and garlic; mix well. Add chicken turning to coat. Arrange in single layer. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink.

title: Southern Scripture Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven about 2 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Wiggle
instructions: Boil chicken in water (salted). Pick off bone. Mix Parkay pimentos peppers onions and mushrooms; cook tender. Add English peas and chicken. Cook noodles (curly noodles are best) in chicken broth. Mix all together. Add both sauces last. Simmer until well seasoned.

title: Scurry Supper Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger; place in large casserole dish for first layer. Layer 1 can drained corn then 1 can mushrooms and onions. Then layer drained green beans. Next place frozen Tater Tots side by side covering top of casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with hot bread and butter.

title: Low-Fat Hunter-Style Chicken
instructions: Saute bacon cut into 1-inch pieces in a large skillet until partially cooked then add onion and continue to cook until onion is tender. Remove bacon and onion and brown chicken breasts in drippings (there will be hardly any if you use turkey bacon). Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Drain any fat from pan and combine cooked bacon and onion with tomatoes Heinz 57 sauce and sugar and add to chicken. Cover and simmer 45 minutes basting occasionally. Great with hot rice.

title: Favorite Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch tube or Bundt pan. Cream butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar until light and fluffy.\tAdd eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and extracts. Beat well after each addition. Pour into prepared pan and bake 1 1/2 hours or until cake tests done. Cool in pan 5 minutes before removing to rack to cool completely. Freezes well. Yields 16 servings.

title: English Muffin Loaves
instructions: In a large bowl combine 3 cups flour yeast sugar salt and soda. Set aside.

title: Corn Cakes
instructions: Add cornmeal to water in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thick and bubbly. Sift together flour sugar salt and baking powder. Add to cornmeal mixture alternating sifted dry ingredients and milk; stir with large spoon. Stir in oil then add eggs. Stir well and fry like you would pancakes. I use a ladle to dip batter out. Serve with butter and your favorite syrup.

title: No-Crust Brownie Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Slowly add sugar and salt. Fold in cookie crumbs. Add nuts and vanilla. Pour into buttered 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool. Cover with Cool Whip and few cookie crumbs or grated chocolate.

title: Artichoke Spread
instructions: Chop artichokes. Add other ingredients. Bake in pie plate or small casserole 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and milk. Add melted butter flour salt and baking powder. Flour 2 cups blueberries and fold into batter. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans 9 x 5 x 3-inches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar syrup peanuts and water in heavy saucepan. Cook until peanuts turn brown and quits popping. Add soda and pour onto buttered platter spreading thin; allow to cool. Remove from dish and break. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cream oil margarine sugar and add eggs and raw zucchini and mix well; add vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk. Place batter in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Apple-Walnut Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Add flour soda and cinnamon; mix well. Fold in apple walnuts and coconut. Spoon into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool on rack 15 minutes. Turn into cake plate. Drizzle Buttermilk Glaze over warm cake.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli raisins and onion. In small bowl combine sugar vinegar and mayonnaise. Pour over broccoli mixture. Toss to coat. Refrigerate. Sprinkle with bacon and seeds before serving.

title: Rice And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage and drain grease. Mix all ingredients. Bake 350\u00b0 oven covered for 1 1/4 hour then 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Crock-Pot Potato Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients except evaporated milk and ham in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours. Stir in evaporated milk and ham during the last hour.

title: Waikiki Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat crumbs onion egg salt ginger and milk. Shape mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls. Brown meat and remove. Keep warm. Pour out fat from pan. Mix cornstarch sugar reserved pineapple juice vinegar and soy sauce until thick. Pour into pan. Cook over medium heat. Stir until it thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Add meatballs pineapple and green pepper. Heat and serve.

title: White Acre Peas Or Field Peas
instructions: Brown sausage in a little grease. Add peas salt pepper and liquid smoke. Boil for 1 1/2 hours on medium-high. Pour water until is about 1-inch above peas. Add water as needed. Let cook down last 15 minutes.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; add next 3 ingredients blending well. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in tube pan 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Be sure to grease and flour pan.

title: Cheesy Hash Browns
instructions: Mix together and place in a 9x13 inch pan. Add topping (below) and bake.

title: Bandito Buffalo Wings(Makes 2 Dozen Appetizers)
instructions: Place seasoning mix in heavy plastic bag. Add a few chicken pieces. Shake until well coated. Repeat to coat all pieces. Place in lightly greased baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until done. Serve hot with salsa for dipping.

title: My Mother-In-Law'S German Chocolate Icing
instructions: Beat egg yolks; add milk sugar and butter. Cook until thick (about 12 minutes). Take off heat; add remaining ingredients. Cool before putting on cake. (This is delicious on Duncan Hines German chocolate cake mix.)

title: Jerky
instructions: Cut all fat off meat. Cut into 1/8 to 1/4-inch strips. Combine above ingredients in bowl and stir until dissolved. Add meat strips and mix to coat all pieces. Let stand or cover and refrigerate overnight. Place meat strips (not overlapping) on cake racks in shallow rimmed baking pans. Dry meat at lowest temperature (160\u00b0 to 200\u00b0) until it has turned brown and feels dry and hard to the touch. Let cool. Store in airtight bags or in jar with a tight fitted lid. Chicken and turkey 4 to 5 hours. Beef and deer 4 to 7 hours.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in oil. Combine all remaining ingredients in large bowl; add onion and mix thoroughly. Put into a 2-quart casserole and bake uncovered in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa butter and milk in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil for one minute. Remove from heat; add peanut butter oatmeal vanilla and salt. Stir to mix well. Drop from a spoon onto wax paper. Let cool thoroughly; then they are ready to eat. Makes approximately 20 cookies.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: In large skillet over medium heat saute veggies. Add everything to veggies season with garlic and pepper to taste. Add soy sauce to make it your favorite soy taste. Serve with good French or Italian bread. A great way to make a good meal use up leftovers and stretch that before pay day meal.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Brown sausage and add onion. Add remaining ingredients except eggs & milk. Chill mixture. Roll in 3/4 inch balls. Dip in flour then egg and milk mixture then roll in additional bread crumbs. Deep fry. Drain and cool. May be frozen.

title: Lima Beans New Orleans
instructions: Cook lima beans following package directions. Drain if necessary. Add vinegar olive oil salt pepper parsley and garlic to limas in saucepan. Heat thoroughly and then mix in lemon juice. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Bobbie'S Fruit Compote
instructions: Pour pineapple and juice over all fruit in baking pan. Seal with double foil tightly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Minute Rice Meatballs
instructions: Mix soup with water. Combine remaining ingredients with 1/2 cup of soup mixture; mix just to blend. Shape into balls. Place in skillet and brown.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Blend sugar mayonnaise and vinegar. Beat until creamy. Pour over other ingredients. Chill. Best if made several hours ahead.

title: Nut Strips
instructions: Mix syrup and milk. Cut crust from bread and slice each in 3 or 4 slices. (Freezing bread or using old bread is good.) Dip each strip in syrup mixture then in nuts. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Neapolitan
instructions: Wipe chops with damp paper towel. In hot oil in large skillet brown chops well on both sides. Remove from skillet. Drain all but 1 tablespoon drippings from skillet. Add onion and garlic; saute until tender (about 5 minutes). Add tomatoes salt oregano basil and pepper; mix well mashing tomatoes with fork. Place pork chops in skillet. Arrange green pepper and mushrooms between chops. Simmer covered for 1 1/4 hours or until chops are tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Miniature Shrimp Quiches
instructions: Brush tart shells with a mixture of beaten egg and a little milk for a brown glaze. Divide the Parmesan cheese chopped shrimp and Swiss cheese among the tart shells. Mix egg yolks cream Tabasco and salt; fill shells with mixture. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cut desired vegetables etc.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cut up fryer into pieces of desired size. Sprinkle liberally with salt and lemon pepper. Add 1/2 teaspoon each of salt and pepper to 1 cup of flour in a paper bag; coat the chicken with the flour mixture. The true secret of taste is to give the seasoning time to take effect so place the covered chicken pieces in the refrigerator for a couple of hours or more. Cook in a deep fat fryer in oil at 375\u00b0. Remove when golden brown and watch closely as small pieces will be ready earlier.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine eggs bread crumbs tomato sauce parsley oregano salt pepper garlic and ground beef; mix well. Take 1/2 of the meat mixture and put in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Lay pepperoni and cheese on top. Add the rest of the ground beef sealing edges so cheese will not run out. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Aurel'S 4-Layer Dessert
instructions: Mix together flour margarine and nuts; press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0; set aside to cool.

title: Fajitas
instructions: Trim excess fat from beef steak. Prick beef with fork in several places. Mix 1/4 cup oil the vinegar sugar oregano chili powder garlic powder salt and pepper in ungreased square baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inches). Place beef in dish turning once to coat both sides. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours turning meat occasionally. Broil beef with top about 3 inches from heat about 8 minutes or until brown. Turn. Brush beef with marinade. Broil until done. Saute onions and peppers in oil. Cut beef diagonally into very thin slices.

title: Eldorado Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Rub with butter a 9-inch pie plate. Beat eggs until foamy. Add flour and sugars; beat until well blended. Blend in melted butter. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Bake for 25 minutes or until set and light golden. Serve in wedges with ice cream. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Amish Cheese Pie
instructions: While pie cools mix ingredients in blender then pour on top of pie. Put in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Remove and refrigerate until cold. Sprinkle top with almond slivers.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Wash spinach and drain well on paper towels. Break into smaller pieces in a large salad bowl. Add other ingredients.

title: Preacher Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and mix by hand. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Baby Tea(Ground Ivey,  For Hives)
instructions: Gather. Trim off bad leaves. Wash. Place in cooker. Add water enough to cover. Bring to a boil; drain off tea from leaves (run through fine strainer). Add sugar. Give to baby about 2 ounces at a time. Twice a day or 3 times if needed to make baby break out good. Baby will look a lot like having measles.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Saute beef until brown and crumbly. Drain excess fat; season with salt pepper garlic powder and Italian seasoning. Cook; drain and separate noodles. In a large baking pan spread a thin layer of sauce. Top with 1/3 noodles 1/3 cottage cheese 1/3 Mozzarella cheese 1/3 meat sauce and 1/3 Parmesan cheese. Repeat layering 2 more times ending with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add Prego spaghetti sauce and sugar cook until done. Beat egg and add to cottage cheese. Shred cheese.

title: Garlic Dip
instructions: Place cottage cheese in a blender with yogurt; process on medium speed until smooth. Combine with remaining ingredients and chill. Serve with raw vegetables.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine milk rice pudding mix raisins and egg in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to boil. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Pour into dessert dishes and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Ortega Chili Casserole
instructions: Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan. Layer Ortega chilies zucchini and cheese. Repeat 3 times. Beat eggs milk salt and pepper to taste. Add Bisquick to egg mix. Mix well. Pour over zucchini. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder baking soda and cinnamon together. Add oil eggs and salt. Beat for 2 minutes. Add carrots. Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) cake pans. Pour in batter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour; add milk and egg yolks. Add butter. Cook until thickens stirring always. Take off; add vanilla. Pour into unbaked shell and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Picnic Pecan Pie
instructions: Place sugar butter or margarine corn syrup and vanilla in a large bowl. Mix well. Stir in eggs; mix well. Add pecans; mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until firm. After it is cool slice and serve.

title: Applesauce
instructions: Peel apples. Slice into large pot (no cores stems or seeds) on medium heat. Add water while cooking as needed. Stir often. Keep some chunks in it if you like as apples melt down add cinnamon to taste. Turn on low. Put cover on and cook until you like it. Keeps pretty long in jars in refrigeration. (Can add other fruit if desired.)

title: Dennis' All-American Cornbread
instructions: Important to scald cream with butter; add to thoroughly mixed dry ingredients. Mix in eggs. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Allow to stand for several minutes before cutting. Yields 12 servings.

title: Yummy Bars
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix cake mix butter and evaporated milk. Pour 1/2 of batter in pan; sprinkle with 1/2 cup walnuts. Bake for 9 minutes at 350\u00b0. Meanwhile microwave 1/3 cup evaporated milk with caramels. After cake has cooled sprinkle chocolate chips over top of cake then drizzle melted caramel mixture over and melt together. Pour the other half of cake batter over. Sprinkle 1/2 cup walnuts on top. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Cappuccino Cooler
instructions: In blender combine coffee ice cream and chocolate syrup. Cover and blend until smooth. Serve immediately over crushed ice. Garnish with whipped cream. Makes 3 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Secret Teriyaki Sauce(Enough For 2 Lbs.  Meat)
instructions: Combine sugars shoyu water garlic and ginger in a 1-2 quart saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Remove pot from heat and cool. Whisk in oils to cooled marinade. Add 2-4 lbs. sliced beef flank or other meat thinly sliced and marinate overnight. Grill meat over charcoal for 3-4 minutes each side. Serve with rice.

title: Lemon Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugar. Add eggs to sugar mixture. Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with 1/2 cup of milk. Mix in nuts and peel of lemon. Bake in a loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or 2 small loaf pans and bake until done (less time).

title: French Salad Dressing(Yields 2 Cups)
instructions: Chop onion and bell pepper very fine. Set aside. Put salad oil sugar ketchup vinegar Worcestershire sauce and salt into blender. Mix well. Pour into bowl with onion and bell pepper. Chill until cold. Ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies 2
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat the butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Add the brown sugar and baking soda. Beat mixture until combined scraping the bowl occasionally. Beat in the eggs and vanilla until combined. Beat in as much of the flour as you can with mixer. Using a wooden spoon stir in any remaining flour. Stir in chocolate pieces and if desired nuts. Drop the dough by rounded teaspoons 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Hash In Pancakes
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Beat egg and add to milk. Mix rapidly with dry ingredients beating well. Grease an 8-inch skillet lightly. Pour in a small quantity of batter. Tip the skillet so that the batter covers the whole bottom thinly. Cook over moderate heat until under side is brown. Turn to brown other side. Grease again and make another pancake. This recipe will make four or five of these large thin cakes which are like French crepes but unsweetened. Spread each pancake with Chicken Hash and roll it up. Place in large shallow ovenproof dish sprinkle with a little cheese or buttered fine bread crumbs and brown in broiler 5 inches below the flame.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix in canner. Can then be stored for an all-winter drink. Use 3 or 4 teaspoons (heaping) to a cup of hot water. Enjoy!

title: South Coast Hominy
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and green pepper and saute for 5 minutes. Blend in flour and seasonings. Add milk and cook stirring until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Add grated cheese and stir until melted. Remove from heat; add olives and hominy. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish; sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crumbs are brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Tomato And Basil Linguine
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water cook linguine and broccoli until just tender 2 to 3 minutes; drain well. Transfer to a large bowl. Add all remaining ingredients except cheese and toss with linguine and broccoli. Serve warm at room temperature or chilled. Pass a bowl of grated Parmesan cheese on the side.

title: Pork Chops And Sour Cream
instructions: Brown chops in oil in skillet. Mix all remaining ingredients except onion rings and sour cream in bowl. Separate onion rings and place on chops. Pour mixture over chops. Simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes covered slightly. Add the sour cream and cook for 1/2 hour longer or until very tender.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Soften cream cheese; add chilies olives and Cheddar cheese. Warm flour tortillas and spread with cream cheese mixture. Roll the tortilla and chill through. Slice in 1-inch slices and arrange on a plate. Serve picante sauce on the side for dipping.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer pineapple coconut cake mix and pecans in that order in a 13 x 11-inch loaf pan. Dot with oleo sliced on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Dredge fruit in 1/2 cup extra flour. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs separately. Mix dry ingredients and add to butter and sugar. Add nuts and fruit. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 20 minutes at 270\u00b0 or 300\u00b0.

title: Chicken Ala King
instructions: Blend flour and salt; add broth and milk. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients to sauce; heat thoroughly.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Bake in a loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Dot top with pineapple cubes.

title: Bloody Cooler
instructions: Combine all in a blender. Blend until ice cubes are dissolved. Pour into large glass and garnish with a lemon wedge.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes With Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Wash cut off top and scoop out tomatoes. Saute in oil with onions. Add salt pepper and parsley. Wash and drain rice; add to onions with inside of tomatoes. Stir well for few minutes. Then stuff tomatoes with this mixture. Replace tomato tops. Place in a small deep pan so that tomatoes fit without any extra space. Pour 2 cups water over all. Bake for half hour at 375\u00b0. Baste the tomatoes with their juice and push them down in the pan since they have a tendency to rise. Continue baking and basting checking every 15 minutes. Tomatoes are done after there isnt any more juice for basting about 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool. Serve cold never warm!

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Dice and cook potatoes. Melt cheese and add mayonnaise soup and milk. Mix until well blended. Drain potatoes. Put in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour cheese over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Popsicle Mix
instructions: Mix and stir well. Store dry mix in 20 oz can with lid.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and mix well. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Penny Pincher Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and freeze in a plastic milk jug. Set Kool-Aid out of freezer about 1 hour before serving time. Cut away plastic jug. Place Kool-Aid in punch bowl. Add ginger ale and stir until slushy. Scoop in sherbet.

title: Caramel Candy
instructions: Measure sugar into a heavy 2-quart saucepan. Remove 2 tablespoons of the sugar and melt until amber in a small saucepan. Combine the milk and Karo with the 2 cups sugar. Heat on medium. Add melted sugar. Cook on medium heat until soft stage. Remove from heat. Add butter. Cool slightly. Beat on high speed until it holds its shape. Add pecans. Drop by spoonfuls on foil.

title: Cucumber Soup
instructions: Simmer above 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Cool. Puree in electric blender. Correct seasoning. Can be served cold or hot.

title: Rice And Sausage
instructions: Cook rice as you would normally (4 cups boiling water to 2 cups rice). When cooked combine sausage onion bell pepper and celery in large skillet. Cook for 4 minutes. Add tomatoes broth and seasonings. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Pour cornstarch mixture into skillet; continue to cook for about 3 minutes and pour over rice in a casserole dish.

title: Cold Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Rinse in cold water. Drain liquids out of both olive jars and mushrooms. Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Pour about 1/2 cup oil over mixture and stir. Add salt and pepper to taste. Chill before serving. If drys out overnight add a little oil before serving.

title: Sweet Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 225\u00b0. Mix Crispix popcorn and peanuts and set aside.

title: Yum-Yum Beans
instructions: Fry sausage and crumble in pieces. Mix sausage onions and beans then add soup paste mustard and sugar. Can be done in crock-pot or casserole in oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Mix together the finely crushed graham crackers and the powdered sugar. Melt together the peanut butter and 1 1/2 sticks margarine. Stir this into graham cracker mixture; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt together the chocolate chips and 1/2 stick margarine. Spread this over the mixture in pan; let harden at room temperature. Cut into bars.

title: Celery Salted Almonds
instructions: Up to 1 week ahead In 13 x 9-inch baking pan combine almonds butter or margarine and celery salt. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes until almonds are lightly browned stirring occasionally. Cool. Store tightly covered. Makes 2 cups.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Carrot-Macaroni Dish
instructions: Saute ground beef and onion in butter in skillet until brown. Add remaining ingredients\tand mix well. Pour into greased casserole.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Cajun Chicken
instructions: Pound meat portions to 3/8 to 1/2 thick. Sprinkle generously with seasoning. Spray an iron skillet with Pam. Brown pieces turning frequently until juices are clear when pricked. You may need to add a small amount of olive oil.

title: Mixed Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender. Drain well. Mix all ingredients together. Pour following dressing over vegetables and stir well.

title: Warm Potato Salad
instructions: Put potatoes and green onions into a large bowl. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-low heat until crisp. Remove to paper towel to drain. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon drippings. Add celery and bell pepper. Cook over medium heat about 2 minutes until crisp-tender. Add to potatoes. Pour vinegar into skillet. Add salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat until hot. Pour over potato mixture. Toss to mix well. Crumble bacon over top. Makes 4 servings.

title: Scioto Chapel Bread Dressing
instructions: The night before lay out bread slices to dry. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In the water cook onions and celery with salt and pepper to taste until tender. Tear dried bread into one-inch pieces and put in large bowl. Pour water/onion/celery mixture and the beaten eggs into the bread pieces and mix well. Pour in broth and mix again. Mix in turkey or chicken pieces if desired. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan and bake one hour or until it begins to turn tan and pulls away from pan sides. Serves 20.

title: Baked Chili
instructions: Brown turkey. Add beans enchilada sauce tomato sauce Fritos and 1 cup cheese. Put in an 8 x 11-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with sour cream and 1/2 cup cheese. Bake 5 minutes.

title: Artichoke Heart Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Put in refrigerator. Before serving mix 1 box mushrooms cut in pieces then serve.

title: The Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix shortening sugars egg and vanilla thoroughly. Measure flour and stir dry ingredients together. Blend into shortening mixture. Mix in nuts and chocolate pieces. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 minutes or until delicately browned (12 minutes for tablespoon and cookies). Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Cook onions and butter or drippings in covered saucepan shaking pan often. When onions are tender add rice water or stock. Boil 5 minutes. Add seasonings and chopped parsley.

title: Mandarin Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add 1 cup cold water and juice from oranges. Stir in sherbet until melted. Let stand until it starts to thicken then stir in oranges. Pour into mold (if desired) and chill.

title: Blue Crab Stuffing
instructions: Remove remaining shell and cartilage from crab meat. Cook bacon until crisp; crumble and set aside. Saute vegetables in bacon grease.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together. Add this mixture to beaten eggs; add milk vanilla vinegar and melted oleo. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies. Cream oleo sugar and cream cheese. Mix milk to pudding. Combine cream mixture with pudding mixture. Take mixture and fold in whip cream. In bowl or flowerpot layer cookies then cream mixture until full.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on bag only add celery and onions and cook until tender. Add rice soups butter salt and pepper. Mix well. Now stir in jar of cheese whiz and stir well. Pour in large greased baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Poppy Seed Torte
instructions: Place bowl and beater in freezer for 1/2 hour.

title: Sweet Potato And Apple Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice sweet potatoes. Cook until about half done. In a large buttered baking dish layer sweet potatoes apples and marshmallows. Sprinkle with mixture of sugar cinnamon salt and pecans. Blend cornstarch and water in a small bowl and pour over layers. Dot with butter and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Potato Puff Buns
instructions: Scald 1 cup of milk. Add to it the butter sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add 1 package of yeast. Blend in eggs potatoes and flour. Mix well. Place in a greased bowl. Mixture will be slightly sticky. Refrigerate until 2 hours before its needed. Roll out to 1/2-inch thick on floured surface. Cut and place on greased cookie sheet. Let rise for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Jubilee Chocolate Cake
instructions: Stir baking soda into buttermilk or sour milk until dissolved. Combine flour 1 cup sugar cocoa and salt in large mixer bowl. Add oil buttermilk or sour milk mixture and egg yolks; beat until smooth. Beat egg whites in small mixer bowl until foamy; gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating until very stiff peaks form. Gently fold egg whites into chocolate batter. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched in center. Cool in pan on wire rack.

title: Pumpkin Muffins(From The American Cancer Society Cookbook)
instructions: In bowl combine bran flour sugar cinnamon baking powder baking soda salt and raisins. Toss to mix. Add remaining ingredients. Stir just until combined.

title: Cinnamon Balls
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar flour and pecans. Roll into small balls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture. Makes 30.

title: Biscuit Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together cutting the shortening in well. Store in airtight container. Add water to necessary amount for batch of biscuits. Use as you would any biscuit mix.

title: Low-Fat Shortcake
instructions: Cut a piece of waxed paper to fit the bottom of a 9-inch square baking pan. Spray Pam on paper and sides.

title: Spiced Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spread on a cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated oven for 15 minutes at 250\u00b0. Stir once halfway through baking time. Remove from oven allow to cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Slice eggplant in 1/4-inch slices. Dip in slightly beaten egg and coat with breadcrumbs. Brown both sides in skillet with oil about 1 minute each side. Place browned eggplant on paper towels to absorb oil. In 9-inch round casserole dish place a layer of eggplant then spoon thin layer of sauce over and sprinkle Parmesan and Mozzarella over sauce. Use a dash of chili powder on each slice. Repeat layers and top with Mozzarella. Microwave for approximately 5 to 10 minutes. Serves 3 to 4 people.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Combine and store. Makes 20 cups. To make 1 cup mix 4 heaping teaspoonfuls of mix with 8 ounces boiling water.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in sugar and peanut butter. Slowly add milk and blend into mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into crusts and freeze until firm. Take out 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken-Rice Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice. Bring to a boil. Add rice. Cover; let simmer until rice is tender.

title: Spinach And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cut up cheese and butter in spinach. Mix in flour and eggs. mix together. Salt and pepper to taste. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until browned.

title: Cool Banana Split
instructions: In saucepan cook the vanilla pudding with milk according to pkg until bubbly. do not scorch. Stir constantly. When done put in glass bowl let cool in ice. Remove from refrigerator set aside.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook pie ingredients over low heat until thick stirring constantly. Pour into baked or graham cracker shell.

title: Pink Party Wedding Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lemon slices in a large punch bowl. Add ice. Garnish with lemon slices. Makes 32 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix everything; shape in loaf. Pour catsup on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut up cabbage removing hard core. Place cabbage in boiling water and parboil 5 minutes; drain. Alternate layers of cabbage soup and cheese in a greased casserole. Season and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Dot with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Surprise
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix crushed pretzels 1/3 cup sugar and margarine. Press firmly into bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Cook broccoli until tender. Drain. Add onions mushrooms soup mayonnaise milk bread crumbs and cheese to the broccoli. Stir and blend all ingredients. Season to taste. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken, Pasta And Pine Nuts
instructions: Drain and chop tomatoes. Reserve juices from tomatoes separately. Add oil onion garlic sun-dried tomatoes pine nuts and chicken to a non-stick saut pan. Cook 4 minutes over medium-high heat until garlic starts to brown. Add the brandy and stir well cook for 2 minutes. Add the chopped can tomatoes and basil. Cook 2 more minutes while stirring well. Add chicken stock reserved juice form tomatoes and cream. Bring to a boil and simmer 20 minutes. While the sauce is simmering prepare pasta. Drain pasta and return to pot. Pour sauce over pasta and stir until well combined over low heat. Add cheese and serve. Serve 4-6 people depending on portion size!

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Brown crumbs in butter. Add corn slightly beaten eggs soup onion and seasonings. Pour into buttered casserole or ring mold. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until firm and pulls away from side of pan. If baked in ring mold turn out on serving plate and serve with cooked Brussels sprouts in center.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Cool to lukewarm in bowl. Add yeast sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour; mix well. Let stand until bubbly. Stir in salt eggs oil and remaining 1 1/2 cups flour to form soft dough. Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl turning to coat surface. Let rise covered in warm place until doubled in bulk. Roll 1/4-inch thick on floured surface. Spread with 3 tablespoons softened butter. Sprinkle with mixture of cinnamon and 1/2 cup brown sugar. Roll as for jelly roll. Slice 1 1/2 inches thick; place in greased baking dish. Combine 1 tablespoon butter 1/4 cup brown sugar and water in bowl. Drizzle over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 12 servings.

title: Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Pour pie filling in 10 x 10-inch baking pan. Sprinkle cake mix and nuts. Cut margarine into 1/4-inch pats and cover the entire mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool. Then refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Rich Sunshine Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate temperature (350\u00b0). Beat yolks sugar water and vanilla until thick and light. Add flour. Have egg whites at room temperature. Beat egg whites and salt until foamy; add cream of tartar and continue beating until whites are stiff. Fold whites into the yolk mixture. Place batter in ungreased 10-inch tube pan; cover with brown paper. Bake for 15 minutes; remove paper and bake 45 minutes longer. Invert pan until cake is cool.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all but last 2 ingredients together and pour into large buttered casserole dish. Top with cornflakes mixed with margarine. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pork Loin Roast
instructions: Place roast on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. In a skillet saute the onion celery and garlic in oil until tender. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Spoon 1 cup sauce over roast. Bake 45 to 55 minutes longer or until a meat thermometer reads 160\u00b0. Let stand for 10 to 25 minutes before slicing. Serve with the remaining sauce. Yield 8 servings.

title: Crisp Crusted Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry. Set aside. Beat egg and milk in a bowl. In another bowl mix potato flakes garlic powder and Parmesan cheese. Roll chicken first in egg mix then in the potato flakes mixture. Melt butter in shallow baking pan. Roll coated chicken pieces in the butter and place them skin side up in the pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until juice from thighs runs clear when pierced with a fork. Transfer to serving platter. Garnish with celery leaves and celery slices and serve.

title: Cheese And Broccoli Dip
instructions: Heat cheese until melted. Add the cooked broccoli and sausage. Mix by hand until well blended.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Sift together flour and powdered sugar. Cut in butter until mixture clings. Press in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown.

title: Potato Donuts
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oleo and potatoes. Add milk. Add flour and baking powder. Mix until firm dough (may need more flour). Let set for 10 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream the butters. Beat in sugars. Add other ingredients. Roll into small balls. Smash with fork dipped in flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned on bottom about 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Cherry Surprise Balls
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy; gradually add powdered sugar beating well. Gradually add flour beating until blended. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Cover and chill 1 hour. Shape dough around each cherry half to form a 3/4-inch ball. Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while warm. Cool on wire racks. Yield 28 cookies.

title: Ann Bond'S Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground meat. Cook bacon. Combine ingredients in casserole dish. Cook only 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Combine ingredients (except shredded cheese). Put in dish. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together cornbread mix baking powder and salt. Add cheese onion peppers corn oil and sweet milk. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 until nice and brown.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon; set aside. Separate egg white from egg yolk and set mixer to medium speed. Beat egg white adding sugar 1/2 cup at a time until foamy then add the egg yolk and oil until blended. Next add flour mixture and mix until smooth then add carrots pineapple and pecans. Mix at low speed until well mixed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until tester comes out clean.

title: Sweet And Sour Dressing
instructions: Mix and shake well.

title: Sweet Potato Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients together. Mix together wet ingredients. Barely mix the 2 together. Pour into greased muffin tins and bake 20 to 25 minutes. Yield 2 dozen.

title: Beef For Sandwiches
instructions: Put beef roast in roaster; cover with water. Bake until tender. Pour off broth and refrigerate until grease separates. Throw away grease. As roast cools shred with a fork disposing of any fat or bone. (This may be done 2 or 3 days ahead.) To shredded beef add clear broth mushroom soup and dry onion soup mix and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or a little longer (I use a crock-pot).

title: Catnip Tea
instructions: Boil leaves and steep approximately 1 minute. Add sugar. Stir and serve hot. Good for a sleeping aid.

title: Honey Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place breasts in baking pan. Combine all other ingredients for sauce. Pour sauce over chicken.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix with water as needed. Drop by spoonful into hot oil until browned as desired.

title: Breaded Pork Chops
instructions: Mix eggs & milk together. Dip pork chops in egg mixture and then coat with cracker crumbs. Put oil in skillet. Brown chops on both sides. Place on foil lined cookie sheet and Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Cook ingredients over low heat stirring constantly for 10 minutes or until thick. Remove from heat and add 1 teaspoon vanilla and 3 cups of Rice Krispies. Roll into bite size balls and roll in coconut.

title: Amish Dressing
instructions: In a large bowl put bread cubes potatoes celery parsley and carrots. Add eggs well beaten. Then add 1 quart liquid which may be meat stock milk cream or condensed milk. Finally add 1 pint or more cooked diced chicken and toss lightly.

title: Pasta With Beans Soup
instructions: Brown meat in large Dutch oven or pan. Add onion tomatoes beans and broth; simmer 15 minutes. Just before serving add macaroni pepper oregano and basil. Serve immediately sprinkled with grated Romano or Parmesan cheese. I take the fat off the broth that makes it almost fat-free. Wayne loves this soup.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter margarine and cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in flour and salt. Add vanilla. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Place cake in cold oven and bake 2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Jalapenos
instructions: Heat a little at a time. Turn off heat if mixture begins to cook. Saute onions and celery in the butter. Add chicken; stir to break chicken up into pieces. Add 1 cup bread crumbs. Stir until moist. Add 2 eggs and mix well. Add 1/2 cup bread crumbs until mixture begins to stick together forming a ball. May need to add a few more bread crumbs if mixture is gooey. Needs to be more dry than wet. Salt and pepper to taste. Pack mixture into jalapenos. Should be enough to overstuff.

title: Quick Energy Pick-Ups
instructions: Crush graham crackers with your fingers onto sheet of waxed paper. Mix remaining ingredients thoroughly in bowl. Shape teaspoonful of the mixture into 1 inch balls. Roll balls in the graham cracker crumbs until coated. Arrange the coated balls on ungreased cookie sheet and refrigerate about 20 minutes. Makes 30 pickups.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Shred lettuce coarsely with knife. Fill serving dish 1/2 full of lettuce. In layers sprinkle the green pepper onion and celery. Add peas. Spread Miracle Whip and sour cream mixed together by hand over the peas. Sprinkle sugar over this. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese then bacon over top. Cover tightly with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Put in bacon grease the cut up onion and cook. Add vinegar salt brown sugar and mustard cover 20 minutes. Combine all beans in casserole and pour mixture over it. Sprinkle bacon on top. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Kisersmaron(Breakfast Dish)
instructions: Stir milk and flour together until smooth. Add yolks sugar butter and egg whites to mixture. Then add in the raisins. Add butter to skillet and cook as you would scrambled eggs. Serve with powdered sugar or a syrup of your choice.

title: Cappuccino Mix
instructions: In a medium-sized glass jar combine the nondairy creamer chocolate drink mix instant coffee sugar cinnamon and nutmeg; mix well.

title: Orange Glazed Chicken
instructions: Bake chicken in butter until brown about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Add orange juice honey salt mustard and paprika; mix all together. Brush over chicken. Bake another 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hot Italian Sausage Over Penne
instructions: Put 2 Tbsp. olive oil in saucepan and add garlic and shallots. Brown and add skinless sausage brown and drain oil. Add paprika & chicken broth. Let simmer until you have half of liquid left. Add cream and simmer until you have half of liquid left. Add remaining spices simmer 10 minutes. Cook penne until done drain and stir in mixture. Top with tomato green onion and cheese.

title: Summer Corn Salad
instructions: Run hot water over frozen corn to thaw. Drain well. Add all finely chopped vegetables to corn mix well. Add sugar vinegar salt pepper and celery seed. Mix to taste. Serve very cold. Yields 8 to 10 servings. Great with spaghetti.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Cook and drain potatoes. Stir in butter. Spoon half of the potatoes in casserole. Top with half of the bacon and half of the cheese then repeat. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Marbles
instructions: In large bowl let margarine soften. Then add sugar and coconut. Mix with hands. If not stiff enough to roll into marble-size balls mix more sugar and coconut until stiff enough to hold shape. Lay on wax paper on flat pan and stick with toothpicks. Freeze until you melt morsels and wax in top of double boiler. Remove balls from freezer and dip with toothpicks in chocolate mixture. Lay back on wax paper until cool. Enjoy eating and let the pounds take care of themselves.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Melt butter. Combine with eggs salt vanilla sugar and milk. Stir until sugar is dissolved; pour over bread cubes. Pour into a 9-inch square pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve cold with whipped cream or warm with sauce. If bread is dry heat in the milk slightly before adding the other ingredients. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Homemade Old Fashion White Bread
instructions: Set 2 2/3 cups of water aside. Empty yeast with a dash of sugar to dissolve yeast into 2 2/3 cups water after mixing all other ingredients then add water slowly to make dough. Be sure and knead dough very well. The more you knead the more the bread will rise approximately 5 minutes. Let rise 1 hour. Let rise 1 hour after placing them in pans. Bake.

title: Cheese Wheels
instructions: Mix grated cheese and margarine. Add flour; mix well. Add cereal and mix well. Shape in small marble size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten each ball with fork and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Grease lightly a square baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Spread broccoli in dish. Beat sour cream cottage cheese Bisquick margarine and eggs well with hand beater 1 minute. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Great Grahams
instructions: Spread peanut butter on graham crackers. Arrange marshmallows on top. Broil for a few minutes until marshmallows are golden brown. Then arrange raisins on top.

title: Christmas Wreath
instructions: Combine marshmallows butter vanilla and coloring in top of double boiler and heat until melted. Stir in cornflakes. Drop into waxed paper and shape into wreath. Decorate with red cherries or candy.

title: Pineapple Pretzel Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place crushed pretzels in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Pour melted butter carefully over top. Bake in preheated oven ten minutes. Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Fold in whipped topping. Spread over cooled crust. Combine pineapple and pudding mix. Spread over whipped topping layer. Chill until serving.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients; pour over meat as desired.

title: Corn Sticks
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Add egg milk and oil; stir until batter is smooth. Coat a cast-iron corn stick pan with cooking spray. Heat in a 425\u00b0 oven for 3 minutes or until hot. Remove pan from oven. Spoon batter into pan filling 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until bread is lightly browned. Yield 1 dozen (81 calories per corn stick).

title: Mrs. G.'S Chicken Rotel
instructions: Season and cook chicken so you will have 1 1/2 quarts broth. Strain broth and cook vermicelli in it. Add cheese and melt. Add tomatoes Worcestershire drained peas and mushrooms. Salt and pepper to taste. Add deboned chicken cut up in bite-sized pieces and put into casserole. Bake in moderate oven (300\u00b0) for 20 minutes. Serves 10 to 12. (Makes 2 large casseroles.) May be frozen and cooked later.

title: Baked Parmesan Cottage Potatoes
instructions: In a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan arrange potatoes and onions in layers. Melt oleo and drizzle over potatoes and onions. Combine garlic powder and Parmesan cheese and pepper together and sprinkle over potatoes. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes.

title: Eggplant And Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Soak bread in milk until soft enough to make mush. Add eggs and eggplant; mix well. Saute onions bell pepper and garlic in olive oil until clear. Add shrimp and crab meat; stir until shrimp are pink. Mix with eggplant mixture. Add salt and pepper. Pour into casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Refrigerator Cake
instructions: Heat first three ingredients until dissolved. Blend in chunky peanut butter. Place corn flakes in large bowl pour syrup mixture over flakes and mix together. Roll into balls and place on cookie sheet lined with wax paper. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Bread Pudding
instructions: Remove and discard crusts from bread; cut bread into cubes. Toss lightly with cream cheese cubes. Place in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs. Add milk syrup and salt. Mix well. Pour over bread mixture. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Baked Squash
instructions: Also make ahead and freeze.

title: Hot Cheese Surprise Appetizers
instructions: Grind cheese bacon onion and garlic together. Combine with mayonnaise and mustard until well mixed. Spread generously on bread. Place on cookie sheet and broil 6 to 7 minutes about 5 inches from heat.

title: Fudge Ecstasies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In heavy medium saucepan heat 1/2 of the chocolate chips the unsweetened chocolate and margarine or butter until melted stirring occasionally. Add eggs sugar flour vanilla and baking powder. Beat until thoroughly combined. Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are firm and surfaces are dull and cracked. Cool cookies on wire rack. Makes about 36.

title: Homemade Rolls
instructions: Stainless steel bowl is best. Pour water over yeast in bowl. In saucepan warm milk. Add sugar and salt; stir until dissolved. Pour over yeast mixture. Add enough flour to beat into smooth dough. Add melted shortening; beat until mixed then add enough flour to make stiff dough. Knead real well. Put back into bowl cover and let rise until double. Make out; put in deep pan (skillet) with melted shortening and margarine in it. Pinch dough dont cut dough. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Sausage Zucchini Bake
instructions: Brown sausage breaking into small pieces. Drain. Toss with 1 tablespoon of flour. Spread on the bottom of a baking dish.

title: Green Beans And Sour Cream
instructions: Layer beans onion rings mushrooms and sour cream in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Saute meat green peppers onions spices and tomato sauce. Simmer 15 minutes. Place noodles in 9 x 13-inch nonstick pan. Pour meat sauce over. Top with cheese then mushrooms. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let set before cutting. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Continental
instructions: Melt margarine. Saute\tonions and chicken until onions are soft. Add soup and broth; stir well. Add rice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Mix well crushed graham crackers 4 tablespoons powdered sugar and melted oleo. Pat in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 6 to 8 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool. Beat together cream cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar. Put on cooled graham cracker crust. Spread pie filling on top. Let set at least 1 hour. Serves 18 to 20 persons.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix the water jello pineapple and pie filling. Congeal.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Cream together the first 4 ingredients; pat in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Beat the eggs until light in color. Add the sugar; whip. Add the flour and lemon juice. Pour over crust; bake another 20 to 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes; sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Pizza
instructions: Make it into a circle. Throw it in the air. Put on the red stuff and cheese. Bake it really hot.

title: Anytime Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well roll ball in extra nuts.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and serve with lettuce for a light lunch; add crackers and fruit plate. Serves 2. Has 250 calories 10 fat grams; food exchanges equal 2 protein 1 bread 3 fats.

title: Hot Chili Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Cover with chili and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbles. Swirl after baking until you see cream cheese. Serve with king size corn chips.

title: Long John Silver'S Seafood Batter
instructions: Mix yeast and flour. Combine egg hot water and salt. Add the beer last. Combine both mixes. Drop fish into batter and immediately drop into hot oil. Dont let fish drain. Best if used with haddock flounder or perch.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until pie is set.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: Melt oleo over low heat and add sugar; stir until sugar is completely dissolved (not grainy). Add flour cocoa and rest of ingredients to pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: Butter and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix first 8 ingredients together and spread into pan. Cover with apricot preserves. Beat egg whites and sugar until stiff and spread over apricot preserves. Top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Dessert
instructions: Do not drain fruits. Mix together stir lightly. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together. Roll in chopped pecans.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine for 3 minutes. Stir in flour mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until vegetables are coated and mixture is bubbly. Stir in broth carrots and potatoes. Bring to boil then simmer stirring occasionally until vegetables are tender. Add milk; heat but do not boil. Stir in cheese until melted. Add pepper and salt.

title: Napfkuchen(Turban Cake)
instructions: Cream together butter lemon peel vanilla 1/2 cup sugar and egg yolks. Add milk slowly. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 1/2 cup sugar. Add flour and baking powder to creamed mixture. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Turn batter into mold. Bake about 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. For variety add 1/2 cup freshly ground poppy seeds or 1/2 cup rum soaked raisins.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Chop and thaw broccoli. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Boil chicken breasts until tender then pull apart and put on top of broccoli. Combine soup and Miracle Whip lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and top with bread cubes. Bake at 340\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt the margarine. Blend in the remaining ingredients. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool pie in refrigerator. Serve with Cool Whip if you desire.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Salad
instructions: Marinate chicken in plastic storage bag with enough Teriyaki sauce to cover all pieces. Place in refrigerator for 30 minutes to 2 hours. Cook marinated chicken in olive oil in skillet on medium heat until for about 10 minutes or until chicken is done (no pink inside). Let chicken cool. If you dont have a jar of red peppers roast red bell pepper on grill or in skillet turning about every 2 minutes until skin turns mostly black. Let cool and peel off skin. Slice pepper into 1/4 inch strips. If you have jar of peppers take them out one at a time and slice them into 1/4 inch strips until you have about one cup. Cut or shred chicken into small bite size pieces. Cut quartered artichoke hearts in half. Take off any `tough leaves. In a large bowl add lettuce chicken peppers artichokes cheese and noodles. Toss well and serve with dressing on the side. Serves 4 - 6 people.

title: Pepper Turkey Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and shape into a loaf. Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple and jello together and bring to a boil. Let cool ten minutes then add other ingredients. Let chill for four hours and serve.

title: Home Style Beef Vegetable Stew
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients over medium heat for 3 hours. Add water when needed. Add juice cabbage carrots potatoes onions and celery. Cook on medium heat for 2 hours. Add tomatoes peas corn and green beans. Cook 45 minutes longer. Salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy. May freeze and heat up weeks later.

title: Curry-Cajun Spiced Chicken
instructions: In a 3-quart rectangular baking dish combine honey water mustard margarine Cajun seasoning curry powder lemon juice and garlic; mix well. Add chicken breast halves turning to coat. Arrange in a single layer. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink. Serve chicken and pan drippings with hot cooked rice. Each serving contains 438 calories and 2 grams saturated fat.

title: Dump Cake(Microwave)
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a 1-cup glass measure (50% power) for about 4 minutes. In cake dish spread the strawberries evenly; sprinkle fresh ones with sugar then spoon on the pineapple (with juice). Sprinkle cake mix evenly over fruit then the nuts. Drizzle melted butter as evenly as possible over all. Set cake dish on an inverted oven glass pie plate to raise it a little nearer oven center. Cook on High (uncovered) about 10 minutes giving dish a quarter turn twice during cooking. Mixture should be boiling throughout. Set dish out on flat surface. Add a light sprinkle of grated nutmeg at this time. Serve slightly warm or at room temperature for best consistency and flavor plain or with milk or cream or topped with a small scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Heat Butter Buds in a nonstick skillet and brown chicken onion and garlic. Add all other ingredients except mushrooms. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes. Add mushrooms. Cook 10 more minutes. Remove chicken from pan and boil down sauce until slightly thickened. Serve over cooked pasta or rice. Serves 4. Contains 1.7 g. fat and 193 calories.

title: M&M'S Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine and sugars until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir in flour salt baking soda graham cracker crumbs and cinnamon. Stir in 3/4 cup of M&Ms raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet. Press a few M&Ms on top of each cookie. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Squares
instructions: Combine first three ingredients in a 3 quart glass bowl. Microwave on medium for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes or until morsels soften; stirring after 2 minutes. Stir until mixture is smooth. Stir in marshmallows and peanuts. Spread in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2 dish. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into a 2 inch squares. Store in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Tray Dip
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Refrigerate to blend flavors. Let set at room temperature for two hours before serving.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients until creamy. Add flour soda and salt. Shape dough into balls. Roll in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Top each cookie with a \Kiss\ or star chocolate candy and press down firmly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pasta And Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine macaroni chicken oranges celery salt pepper and mayonnaise. Add Blue cheese and toss lightly. Sprinkle with paprika and chill thoroughly.

title: Apple Pie In A Bag
instructions: Will also need large brown paper bag.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour in greased baking dish.

title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken celery toasted almonds salt onions lemon juice and mayonnaise. Place in casserole glass dish; bake at 325\u00b0 until hot. Remove from oven and add grated cheese and potato chips. Return to oven for about 10 minutes or until cheese has melted. Serve Hot!

title: Chocolate Cherry Bars
instructions: Grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan or a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. In a large bowl combine first four ingredients. Stir by hand until well mixed. Bake in jelly roll pan 20 to 30 minutes; in a 13 x 9-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cover with chocolate frosting.

title: Butter Sauce
instructions: Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Gradually add sugar beating. Add butter lemon rind and juice. Blend. Fold in the cream and chill. Serve desserts.

title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening in a mixing bowl. Gradually add sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add nuts and vanilla extract. Pour batter into a well-greased floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 90 minutes.

title: Fresh Grapefruit Salad
instructions: Scoop out sections of fruit from grapefruit and cut out membranes. Drain the grapefruit sections and save juice. Combine grapefruit juice with pineapple juice and add enough water to make 5 cups. Heat 2 cups liquid to dissolve gelatin. Add rest of liquid to fruit. Mix well and spoon into grapefruit shells or put into shallow pan. Refrigerate until firm and serve one shell per person. Or cut gelatin in pan into squares and serve on lettuce.

title: Chicken Orange Mandarin
instructions: In large skillet heat oil then add chicken stirring well for about 2 minutes. Add celery and cook until bright green. Add garlic powder green pepper and green onion stirring until done. In bowl mix teriyaki sauce cornstarch then add to skillet. Then add orange slices and pineapple chunks. Stir until thickened. Serve over white steamed rice. Serves 4.

title: Hot Kielbasa Dip
instructions: Microwave cream cheese until soft (1 minute). Stir in sour cream Worcestershire sauce milk and mayo. Add kielbasa. Cook on High 2 to 4 minutes stirring once. Stir in 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle with green onion. Serve with crackers vegetables or rye bread.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Cream margarine. Add sugar and peanut butter and mix in a bowl until it forms a ball. Add vanilla. Mix well. Chill overnight.

title: Grilled Potatoes And Bell Pepper Packets
instructions: Prepare barbecue (medium-high heat). Grease two large sheets of foil (heavy duty). Combine all ingredients in bowl and toss. Divide vegetables between the 2 pieces of foil. Seal packets tightly. Place packets on edge of grill rack cover and cook until potatoes are tender; about 30 minutes. Makes 2 servings.

title: Taco Submarines
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef in 10-inch skillet over medium heat until light brown; drain. Stir in sour cream water and taco seasoning mix. Reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Cut rolls in half. Spread with mayonnaise. Place lettuce on bottoms. Layer about 1/3 cup beef mixture 2 cheese slices and tomato slices on each sandwich. Cover top of roll. Secure with wooden pick. Makes 6 submarines.

title: Pizzadata(Italian Christmas Cookies)
