instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in Crisco; add water a little at a time enough to hold together. Chill.

title: Copper Penny Carrot Salad
instructions: Peel and slice carrots. Cook in salted water until tender. Cool. Mix oil sugar and vinegar and heat until sugar dissolves. Add peppers beans soup and Worcestershire sauce and onions. Heat to boiling. Pour mixture over carrots. Let stand overnight in fridge.

title: Golden Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine soup milk and pepper in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Arrange alternate layers of potatoes onion soup mixture and cheese. Dot top with butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover. Bake 15 minutes more or until potatoes are done.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: In a salad bowl combine kidney beans corn Niblets and pepper. Set aside.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix sugar with cream cheese. Add strawberries nuts pineapple and Cool Whip and fold in the sliced bananas. Freeze in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Remove from freezer awhile before serving. Keeps 4 to 6 weeks in the freezer.

title: Fried Catfish
instructions: Put ingredients in a bag and shake to mix (except fish). Drop fish fillets in bag and shake. Fry in hot oil.

title: Brookville Hotel'S Sweet-Sour Coleslaw
instructions: Discard outer leaves of cabbage. Shred the cabbage; sprinkle with salt. Cover and refrigerate for several hours (or days). Thirty minutes before serving combine the remaining ingredients and beat until cream holds a soft peak. Do not overbeat. Gently fold cream dressing into shredded cabbage. Chill. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs. Combine flour soda cinnamon and nutmeg in a bowl. Add alternately with the buttermilk to the sugar mixture. Mix well. Add vanilla nuts and prunes. Mix well. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Place shrimp in single layer in bottom of broiler pan.

title: Tavern Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour and sugar. Add beer and mix well. Spoon into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and pour melted butter over the loaf. Return to oven for 15 minutes. This can be frozen and reheated before serving.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large mixing bowl stirring with a spoon (not mixer) until dry ingredients are moist. Bake in 3 floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove and cool before frosting. (May use a 9 x 13-inch pan and frost; leave in pan.)

title: Frosty Sherbet Punch
instructions: Chill juice and ginger ale. Empty 1 can of each juice and 1 quart ginger ale in punch bowl. Add a quart of sherbet. Spoon liquid over sherbet until partly melted. Serve. When supply runs low repeat process.

title: Pistachio Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put it in the refrigerator for 1/2 to 1 hour.

title: Mexican Willies
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Spread on large tortilla shell. Roll. Refrigerate overnight. Slice and serve.

title: Spicy Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut off and discard wing tips. Cut each wing in half at the joint. Place in baking dish. Combine 3/4 cup picante sauce honey soy sauce mustard oil ginger and orange peel in small bowl. Mix well. Pour over chicken wings. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cut cabbage into small pieces and boil until tender then drain. Saute onion in shortening. Add butter and cabbage to onion and saut mixture. Mix in milk parsley salt pepper and nutmeg. Add eggs and cook until done. Add cheese and remove from heat when cheese has melted. Serve hot. Same recipe can be made with eggplant.

title: Green Bean Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Heavenly Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 275\u00b0. Sift one cup of the sugar with 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar. Separate eggs and beat whites until they stand in stiff but not dry peaks. Slowly add sugar beating until the sugar is dissolved. When meringue makes stiff glossy peaks spread it over the bottom and up the sides just to the rim of a well-greased 9-inch pie pan. Have the bottom about 1/4-inch thick and the sides about 1 inch thick. Sprinkle coconut around the rim and bake for one hour at 275\u00b0. It should be light brown and crisp. Cool away from drafts.

title: Carla'S Squash-Haters Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut the squash into chunks to boil. Brown the sausage. When the squash is tender mix all the ingredients together and bake in the oven for 30 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix together the oatmeal and boiling water; set aside to cool. Cream together the sugars and butter. Add eggs. Sift dry ingredients together; add everything to oatmeal. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Glaze while cake is warm.

title: Low-Fat Turkey And Noodles
instructions: Spray a skillet with spray; brown turkey and onions until done. Cook egg noodles as directed on bag. Drain. In a bowl mix soup turkey onions and noodles. Put in oven or microwave and heat.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients well; beat for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes (or until top is not sticky but toasted).

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Pour a little bit of gravy in bottom of baking dish. Prepare stuffing according to box. Mix cream of chicken soup and stuffing together. Lay 4 to 5 pork chops in bottom of baking dish. Top with stuffing mixture. Add remaining pork chops to top of stuffing. Fill in with any extra stuffing and pour rest of gravy over chops. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours or when pork chops are tender.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Split chicken breasts to make a pocket. Insert a slice of ham and a slice of cheese in each breast. Mix the flour with salt and pepper and coat chicken. Dip them in beaten egg and then coat in bread crumbs.

title: Turkey And Homemade Dressing
instructions: Thaw in refrigerator per directions/pound.

title: 2 Crust Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes; reduce to 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Patricia'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; debone and dice. Combine all ingredients. Place in casserole dish. Top with grated cheese or butter and bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine cinnamon and sugar. Toss biscuits in mixture a few at a time. Place coated biscuits in greased Bundt pan.

title: Baked Carrot Squares(Makes 16 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 8-inch square baking pan with nonstick coating agent or use nonstick pan. In medium-sized bowl combine flour baking powder cinnamon nutmeg salt and Sweet N Low. In separate bowl dissolve baking soda in Butter Buds. Add to dry ingredients. Stir in egg. Add carrots and raisins. Mix thoroughly. Pour into pan. Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool and cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Angie'S Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix all together. Freeze approximately 6 quarts. Refrigerate the rest overnight. Makes 4 gallons.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown chili meat with oil garlic and chili powder until meat is done. Add meat mixture into 1 quart boiling water. Then add remainder of ingredients. Cook on low for 3 to 4 hours adding more water as needed.

title: Mini Blends
instructions: Trim edges of loaf bread; roll out flat with rolling pin. Mix cream cheese sugar and egg with electric mixer. Spread real thin over bread. Roll up and cut in half. Melt margarine and dip rolled bread. Roll in 1 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes. Cool on wire rack. (They will stick to paper towel.)

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook together sliced zucchini and chopped onion for 5 minutes and drain. Combine soup sour cream and carrots. Fold in zucchini/onion. Combine stuffing mix with melted margarine.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Pack beans into pint jars; add a pinch of pepper to each pint. Add 1 clove and 1 head of dill. Combine remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Pour over beans and seal. Process in hot water bath for 5 minutes.

title: Mushrooms Filled With Blue Cheese
instructions: Clean the mushrooms and remove the stems (save for another use or chop finely and add to filling). Dip quickly into about a 1/2 cup lemon juice and set aside on paper towels. Combine sour cream curry powder and Worcestershire. Add cheese onion and pecans. Mix well. Pipe into prepared caps with a pastry bag fitted with a star tube. Cover with plastic wrap and chill. Just before serving garnish with sprigs of parsley or watercress.

title: Candy Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Mix candy nuts dates and coconut with flour; add to mixture. Add buttermilk mixture. Mix. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours and 10 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean. Cool a little before removing from pan.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Save 1/2 of chopped ham set aside. Mix all ingredients together. Form into a ball then roll ball in the chopped ham set aside. Chill overnight. Serve with your favorite crackers. Great appetizer.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Crust Cut butter into flour until well blended. Mix in chopped nuts. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan (buttered). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Saute sausage. Drain. Beat eggs with milk salt and mustard. Layer the bread cubes sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour egg mixture on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Place bacon across top during the last 5 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat Cheez Whiz and chicken soup until well blended. Add cooked broccoli cooked rice and water chestnuts. Put mixture into a baking dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Cookie Dunk
instructions: Pour milk into a leak-proof container. Add pudding mix. Cover tightly. Shake the container holding the top up and down very fast for at least 45 seconds. Spoon half of the pudding into 4 dessert dishes. Stand 4 to 6 cookies along the sides of the dish. Top with remaining pudding. Decorate the top with more cookies. Makes 4 individual servings.

title: Super Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes mash. Add all ingredients. Put in serving dish and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together in a large bowl; make a \well\ in center to add buttermilk soda and eggs. Boil water margarine and cocoa then add to mixture. Add vanilla. Pour in 10 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. (Check for doneness.)

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potatoes onion and water in saucepan. Bring to boil; cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Add carrots and broccoli; simmer 8 more minutes. Add milk and spices. Serves 6.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare the cake mix following the directions on the box. Bake in 2 pans. After cake cools use dental floss to split layers into 4 layers. Mix the first 3 ingredients thoroughly for the icing. Icing may be stored in refrigerator overnight. Spread icing over layers. (Keeps better in refrigerator.) May sprinkle extra coconut over cake after iced if desired.

title: Easy Bread Clay
instructions: Cut or tear crusts from bread and discard. Pour glue then water onto the slice of bread. Knead until dough doesnt stick to fingers (10 minutes). Divide into parts and add food coloring to each. Knead until blended. Work with only a small piece of clay at a time. Shape objects. Dry overnight. When dry spray with clear glaze or paint with clear nail polish.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream the oil and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time beating good each time. Sift together the flour soda and salt. Stir all ingredients together and add the vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Use a large pan.

title: French Vinaigrette Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients and 2 tablespoons water in blender until smooth.

title: Russian Honey Spice Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs thoroughly in a small bowl. Add sugar and stir well. Pour flour into a large bowl. Add egg mixture and baking soda; stir well. Add honey and mix for 10 minutes. Stir in raisins. Pour dough into pan; level it out and sprinkle with nuts. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick stuck in the middle of cake comes out clean. Serve with whipped cream or jam.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: 1st Layer One yellow cake mix (reserve 1 cup mix for later) 1/2 cup margarine and 1 egg. Mix together and press this mix in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Tenderloin And Dressing
instructions: Pound meat until flat and thin; season to taste. Dredge in flour and brown in hot oil. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine bread cubes sage onions milk eggs salt and pepper. Add hot water to skillet used to brown meat scraping bottom of pan. Add to dressing. Spread dressing over meat. Cover with mushroom soup. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 8 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. Drain and peel. Slice and set aside. Fry bacon until crisp. Set aside. Cook onions in grease until tender (not brown). Drain off all but 2 tablespoons of fat. Put flour sugar salt and pepper into grease. Stir and cook until flour is a little brown. Add vinegar and water; thickens slightly as it cooks. Crumble and add bacon back. Pour while hot over potatoes and stir. Sprinkle parsley on top.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Break cake into bite-sized pieces. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour pineapple over cake; sprinkle with pecans. Combine milk and pudding mix in bowl. Stir until thickened. Fold in whipped topping. Spread over layers. Sprinkle with coconut. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and bananas. Beat until well blended. Sift flour with baking soda baking powder and salt. Add alternately with sour cream to banana mixture. Stir just to blend. Stir in nuts.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Heat butter in skillet. Put cheese in between bread. Put in pan. Cook until nice and brown. Then eat it.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Combine meat tomato juice onion seasonings and 6 cups water in soup kettle. Cover and simmer 2 hours. Add vegetables; cover and simmer 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Cornmeal Muffins
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine dry ingredients. Make a well in the center; add all remaining ingredients. Stir just until mixed. Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Blend ingredients minus the egg then add slightly beaten egg. Form into bite size balls. Bake in 400 degree oven 10-12 minutes. Can be frozen. Heat before serving.

title: Cheese Crunches
instructions: Mix cheese and margarine. Add remaining ingredients; form into walnut sized balls. Flatten with fork onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Mandarin Orange Mold
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add lemon juice and sherbet. Chill until partially congealed then stir in undrained oranges. Pour into mold and refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Fry ground meat. Add margarine in with meat. Then fry chopped mushrooms and onion in meat and margarine. When onion is tender add Parmesan cheese garlic salt pepper and cooking sherry.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Combine mix sugar and yeast in mixing bowl. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Add milk stirring to make soft dough. Roll out on lightly floured surface to 1/2 inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter and place on baking sheet. Brush with margarine. Bake 425 degrees 10-12 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl mix flour and milk. Stir until mixed well. Batter will be stiff. Add mayonnaise and mix until blended in. If desired add blueberries cheese etc. and stir in. Bake in greased muffin pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Wendy'S Frosty
instructions: Put ingredients in refrigerator 1 hour before using. Put in blender blend and drink.

title: Stuffed Giant Shells
instructions: Brown the meat onion garlic salt and pepper until crumbly. Drain and cool. Stir in Mozzarella cheese bread crumbs parsley and egg. Cook shells until tender. Drain and stuff with meat mixture. Spoon 1/4 sauce over baking dish (9 x 13 x 2-inches). Place filled shells in dish side by side. Add water to remaining spaghetti sauce and pour over shells. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Heat 2 cups of water to boiling. Pour in oblong cake pan. Dissolve Jell-O. Add 7-Up; stir. Drain pineapple and oranges (keep only pineapple juice). Add to Jell-O with sliced bananas. Stir. Cover with mini marshmallows; set until firm.

title: Chicken Adobo
instructions: Place first 8 ingredients in a pot and simmer covered for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Drain and set sauce aside.

title: Fiesta Sandwich
instructions: Cut off the top one-third of loaf of bread and set aside. Then hollow out leaving 1/2-inch thick crust all the way around. Spread cut surfaces with bean dip. Layer as follows Colby Jack half the red pepper Monterey Jack with jalapeno olive slices tomato cubes Cheddar and avocado. Top with remainder of red pepper. Combine shredded taco cheese with salad dressing and spoon on top. Replace top of bread loaf. If desired heat in oven to melt cheese. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Beef Quiche
instructions: Place ground beef and cheese in unbaked pie shell. Mix last 7 ingredients together and pour over meat and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Sift together the first 4 ingredients. Mix shortening sugar egg and vanilla until creamy. Mix in pineapple and then flour mixture. Drop by teaspoon 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle cookies with a mixture of the nutmeg and 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown for 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Beryl'S Cookies
instructions: Beat butter until creamy. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well. Chill one hour. Form into balls and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 300\u00b0. Roll immediately in powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and cocoa. Beat egg yolks and combine with milk. Mix all together. Cook over low heat until thick and then pour in baked pie shell.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Tear chicken into pieces and place in pan. Heat milk and soup in saucepan until creamy and pour over chicken. (If vegetables are desired add 1 can drained mixed vegetables to soup mixture.)\tStir egg and salt and pepper into chicken broth and stir in stuffing mix. Spoon over top of soup and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Greek Sweet Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Scald milk; cool to lukewarm. Combine yeast milk and 1 teaspoon sugar in a large bowl. Sift in 1/2 cup flour. Stir until flour is dampened. Cover bowl\twith a clean cloth and set in a warm place for 1 hour. Add\tremaining flour 1/2 cup sugar 2 of the eggs and spices to melted butter. Stir into dough.\tKnead until smooth and elastic. Place in a greased bowl cover and let rise until doubled about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cashew Chicken Bake
instructions: On the day before the casserole is to be served mix all items together except the cashews. Place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole and refrigerate. Before baking cover top with cashews. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Honey Balls
instructions: Combine potatoes salt and 2 tablespoons butter. Add marshmallows. Chill. Shape into balls using 1/4 cup each. Combine 2 tablespoons butter and honey. Dip potato balls one at a time. Remove and roll in nuts. Place in Pam-sprayed casserole. Drizzle with remaining butter. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 10 servings.

title: Banana Salad
instructions: Mix the flour salt egg brown sugar and vinegar. Add water and cook until thickened stirring constantly. Cool. Spoon over sliced bananas and sprinkle with peanuts.

title: A Trifle Terrific
instructions: Slice still frozen cakes lengthwise 3 times per cake (4 slices if youve got the skill of a surgeon). Melt chocolate and coffee over low heat; mix until smooth. Add cognac. Cool. Whip cream until firm; fold into chocolate mixture. Carefully spread between layers then frost entire loaf. Cool in freezer. Remove from freezer only 10 minutes before serving.

title: Layer Salad
instructions: Cook carrots in a small amount of boiling salted water until tender-crisp; drain. Chill in refrigerator. Place lettuce in large glass bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Layer carrots celery peas onion olives and bacon over lettuce. Spread 1 cup Blender Mayonnaise over top. Sprinkle with sugar if desired. Garnish with parsley and additional olives. Serve with remaining mayonnaise. Can use 1 cup mayonnaise with 1/4 cup milk and 3 teaspoons sugar. Mix and pour on top instead of Blender Mayonnaise.

title: Confetti Slaw
instructions: In large bowl combine cabbage tomato green pepper cucumber and onion. In small bowl mix remaining ingredients. Pour dressing over vegetables. Toss to coat.

title: Cucumber Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Good for finger sandwiches or on rye crackers.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine together. Spoon into hot oil. Turn when brown. Drain on paper towel and serve.

title: Hamburger 4 Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger then add drained beans. Mix all other ingredients together and stir to blend. Mix with hamburger and beans. Bake in covered casserole for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Butter Rolls
instructions: Mix and bring to a soft ball (250\u00b0). Cook on high. Stir often.

title: Quiche
instructions: Line pastry shell with double thickness of heavy-duty foil. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Remove foil. Bake 5 to 7 minutes more or until pastry is nearly done. Remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0. In a small bowl combine eggs buttermilk and pepper; stir in vegetables cheese ham and onion. Pour mixture in hot pastry shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted near center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Layered Skillet Dinner
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a large skillet. Spread cabbage evenly over margarine. Sprinkle with onion and caraway seed. Arrange potato slices in skillet. Crumble beef in small pieces over potatoes. Pour tomato sauce over all. Cover skillet and cook on low heat for 30 to 35 minutes. Do not stir. If possible use 10 or 12-inch skillet with lid.

title: Creole Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Cook celery onion and flour in oil 5 minutes stirring as needed. Add broth tomatoes green pepper bay leaf thyme okra parsley salt and Tabasco; stir well. Cook 1 hour stirring occasionally. Add chicken and shrimp. Heat through. Serve over rice. Add Tabasco to taste.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant until tender in salted water. Drain real good and dump in bowl. Salt and pepper. Beat egg and put in 1 tablespoon butter crushed crackers milk and 1 cup grated cheese. Mix all together. Not real soupy but like a cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles (30 minutes to 1 hour).

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Stir to blend. If desired add one whole strawberry to each serving. Makes 12 generous servings.

title: Date Tea Cake
instructions: Cut off and discard a one-inch slice from the top of fruit. Pencil a zigzag guideline around top of fruit. With a sharp knife cut around fruit following the line to form a zigzag edge. Using a spoon scoop out pulp. Fill \cup\ with any type of salad or dessert such as orange mousse.

title: Fat-Free Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly spray a cool cookie sheet. Mix the first seven ingredients together. Stir in egg whites Karo syrup and vanilla; mix well. Add a few drops of water if mixture is too dry. Add raisins and drop by spoonful on sprayed cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Keep cookies in a sealed container.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0; turn oven down to 350\u00b0 and bake 10 additional minutes until golden brown. Let cool.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar and evaporated milk to soft ball stage. Pour over peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme. Mix thoroughly. Pour into pans.

title: Easy Tomato Rice Soup
instructions: In medium saucepan combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until rice is tender. Makes 3 (1 cup) servings.

title: Potato Puffs
instructions: Combine potatoes egg salt pepper and cheese. Shape into balls and roll in bread crumbs. Preheat shortening to 400\u00b0. Place potato puffs in a single layer in the fry basket. Cover and fry for 3 minutes or until brown. Lift basket and drain. Serve hot. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pizza Loaf
instructions: Beat egg slightly and add cornflakes and pizza sauce. Add hamburg and remaining ingredients and mix well. Do not include cheeses in this mixture. Divide hamburg mixture in half. Press half in 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Top with slices of Mozzarella cheese. Press remaining hamburg mixture on top of cheese slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Take from oven and cover top with shredded cheese. Return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Grease baking dish with melted butter. Place hash brown potatoes in dish. In another bowl mix together remaining ingredients. Pour over hash brown potatoes smoothly. Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Pastry For One Pie Crust
instructions: Toss flour salt and sugar to mix. Cut in shortening with pastry blender or two knives until mixture looks like coarse meal. Sprinkle with water. Gather into a ball with a fork. Roll on a lightly floured board to a circle one inch larger than the inverted pie pan. Ease pastry into pie pan; fold edges under even with the pan rim. Flute edges. To bake before filling prick pie shell with a fork. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 8 to 15 minutes or until done. Cool before filling. Makes one 9-inch pie shell.

title: Make Ahead Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Cool. Put in baking dish. Add other ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Let stand out of refrigerator 30 minutes.

title: Virginia Chunk Sweet Pickles
instructions: Make brine of a proportion of 2 cups salt to one gallon water. Boil and pour over cucumbers boiling hot. Let stand one week. In hot weather\tskim daily. Drain and cut in chunks. For the next three mornings make a boiling hot solution of one gallon water and one tablespoon powdered alum and pour over the pickles. On the fourth morning drain the alum water and heat 6 cups vinegar 5 cups sugar 1/3 cup pickling spice and 1 tablespoon celery seed to boiling point and pour over the pickles. On the fifth morning drain off this liquid and save; add 2 more cups sugar to the liquid and heat to boiling point; pour over the pickles. On the sixth morning drain liquid again and save; add one more cup sugar and heat; pack the pickles in sterilized canning jars and pour the liquid over until the jars are filled; seal while hot.

title: Heavenly Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken onion celery pineapple and raisins. Blend mayonnaise sour cream curry powder chutney and lemon juice. Combine with chicken. Chill. May be garnished with slivered almonds cherry tomatoes carrot strips or olives.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Liquifey in blender. Heat to boil and simmer or serve cold.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine. Top with remaining ingredients. Press down. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Chill if desired. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Add each ingredient and mix well. Place uncooked bacon strips across the top of bean dish. Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass Pyrex dish. Place in oven at 425\u00b0. Cook for 45 to 55 minutes. After baking turn broiler in oven on to finish browning action.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: In a skillet brown rice onion and oleo until light brown stirring constantly. Pour into casserole dish. Add mushrooms and beef consomme. Cover with foil and bake until liquid is absorbed about 45 minutes to 1 hour in medium oven.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine raisins and water; cook uncovered for 10 minutes or until raisins are plumped. Combine sugar and flour; stir into raisins. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles; cook 1 minute more. Remove from heat and stir in juice. Line 9-inch pie plate with pastry; add raisin mixture. Adjust top crust. Cut slits to allow steam to escape. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cover edge of crust with foil if it browns too quickly.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Combine brown sugar margarine and Karo syrup in small saucepan. Bring almost to a boil and cook for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Place popped popcorn in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour syrup mixture over popcorn; toss. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Stir and then bake another 5 minutes. Stir and bake a final 5 minutes. Makes a lightly sweetened snack that the kids love. Add more or less popcorn to taste.

title: Fruit And Oat Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 11 x 7-inch glass baking dish. Combine all ingredients except preserves. Mix well. Reserve 3/4 cup oats mixture press remaining mixture into bottom of prepared dish. Bake 10 minutes. Spread preserves evenly over partially baked base to within 1/2-inch edge of pan. Sprinkle with reserved oats mixture. Bake 20 to 22 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix well. Pour in buttered casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for about one hour.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix Veg-All onion cheese and mayonnaise together in a casserole dish. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Dot with margarine (about 1/3 stick). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients but bread crumbs. Place in a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well with sugar; add flour baking powder and nuts. Add apples. Bake in a greased and floured oblong (9 x 13-inch) pan until golden brown at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Slush
instructions: Mix everything together and place in the freezer. Dip out as you use and pour 7-Up or Bubble Up on it.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Blend until foamy.

title: Garden Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients; heat gradually to boiling point. Simmer for at least 4 hours or to desired consistency. Pour into hot jars; process for 5 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 2 1/2 pints. Serves 4.

title: Sock It To Me Cake
instructions: Mix all together adding eggs one at time. Add nuts last. Pour half of cake mixture in greased and floured Bundt or other cake pan. Make mixture of 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon; sprinkle over cake. Pour over rest of cake mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Glaze with 1 cup powdered sugar and 2 tablespoons milk.

title: Deviled Ham Pinwheels
instructions: Early In The Day In a small bowl combine deviled ham orange peel mustard and horseradish. With a sharp knife cut each slice lengthwise into 5 pieces each about 1/4-inch thick. Flatten each with a rolling pin. With a metal spatula spread about 2 tablespoons ham mixture over the entire surface of each slice. Start at the short sides of the bread and roll each jelly roll fashion. Cut each roll crosswise into 6 slices. Arrange in pinwheels on a large platter. Refrigerate until served.

title: Candy Bar Cookie Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cut candy bars in half lengthwise. Cut each half into 12 slices. Set aside.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake potatoes until tender. Melt butter in medium pan; slowly blend in flour with whisk. Gradually add milk whisking constantly; whisk in salt and pepper and simmer stirring constantly. Cut potatoes in half and scoop out the potatoes. Cut the potatoes in cubes. You can use some of the peel if you want to. When milk is hot add potatoes sour cream onion and bacon. Heat thoroughly and add cheese a little at a time as it melts. Sometimes add a can of cream of potato soup.

title: Gina'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat while cutting veggies. Wash drain and then boil veggies. Drain veggies and mix all ingredients into large pot. Bring to a boil and then turn down to simmer for 30 minutes. After draining veggies I cook on high a few minutes to get all the water out of them (keep stirring). Then I mix all ingredients. You can add more veggies sauces and spices as you like.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: Mix well and store in an airtight container. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per hot cup of water. If you like a shot of brandy rum or vodka may be added.

title: Ooey Gooey Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and butter together. Pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Spicy Cranberry Chutney
instructions: Combine cranberries raisins sugar cinnamon ginger cloves and water in a large saucepan. Cook 15 minutes until berries pop and mixture thickens. Stir in onion apple and celery; simmer 15 minutes longer or until mixture is thick. Cool; refrigerate. Makes 4 cups. Serve with poultry or pork.

title: Spicy Chicken
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat in 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook half of the chicken until browned stirring often. Remove; set aside. Repeat with remaining chicken. Reduce heat to medium. In same skillet in remaining 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook green pepper onion dried oregano paprika black pepper and red pepper until vegetables are tender-crisp stirring often. Stir in tomatoes soup and rice. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink stirring occasionally. Garnish with fresh oregano if desired.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cream cheese in mixer. Add Cool Whip and mix. Add sugar and whip good. Pour in cooled pie shell. Spoon fruit over mixture outer edge first.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to boil in saucepan the margarine water and cocoa. Cool. Add the sugar and eggs. Alternately add and mix the sour milk flour baking soda and salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Next Door Neighbor Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 14 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gypsy Stew
instructions: Brown and crumble beef; pour off excess grease. Add potatoes and onion. Add water to just cover ingredients. Add spices to taste. Simmer over low heat until potatoes are done. Can be done in a crock-pot.

title: Broccoli Cheese Pie
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Rinse in cold water. Beat egg yolk. Pour into macaroni Press mixture into bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream lard and sugars. Beat eggs 1 at a time into mixture. Add vanilla. Sift dry ingredients all together. Add milk. Put all together and mix. Dough will be stiff. Chill for 1 hour or overnight. Roll into balls the size of walnuts press with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. May be divided into 3 portions to which can be added nuts raw peanuts coconut or chocolate chips. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes a large batch of dough.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in an air tight container. To serve mix 4 teaspoons of mixture with hot water in a mug.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Mix the tomatoes and onion together. Spread about 1/2 of the crumbs over the bottom of a 10 x 3-inch deep casserole or metal baking pan. Gently spoon 1/2 the tomato mixture over crumbs. Sprinkle with 1/3 more crumbs. Spoon remaining tomato mixture. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs; dot with 1/2 stick of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Orange Cream Cheese Jello
instructions: Heat first 3 ingredients until cream cheese is melted. Refrigerate until nearly set. Then fold in Cool Whip.

title: Turtle Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour 1 cup brown sugar and 3/4 cup butter in processor until well blended and crumble. Press mixture evenly into ungreased 9 X 13 X 2 inch metal baking dish. Bake until crust is light golden about 15 minutes. Maintain oven temperature.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Put all desired ingredients into large punch bowl. Mix. Float thinly sliced oranges and cherries or strawberries on top.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix margarine and peanut butter. Let soften overnight. Put in Rice Krispies and powdered sugar. Form balls. In a double boiler melt 1 package of semi-sweet chocolate chips. Grate paraffin. Use prongs to dip peanut butter balls in chocolate.

title: Turkey Wild Rice Soup
instructions: In large kettle saute onion celery and carrots in butter until onion is transparent. Reduce heat. Blend in flour and cool until bubbly. Gradually add broth stirring constantly. Bring to a boil; boil for 1 minute. Reduce heat; add wild rice cream turkey parsley salt and pepper. Simmer for 20 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings (about 3 quarts).

title: Trash(Snack Mix)
instructions: In large bowl combine\tshredded wheat sesame nut mix and pretzel sticks. In small\tsaucepan over low heat blend light spread Parmesan cheese oregano basil\tand garlic powder. Pour over cereal mixture while stirring. Blend well. Spread mixture on a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Mexicali Dinner Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and add to combined milk egg and oil. Mix just until dry mixture is moistened. Stir in corn and cheese. Bake in a greased 9-inch square baking pan in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Grape Jam
instructions: Wash grapes and remove stems. Peel off skins and reserve; place grape pulp in a saucepan. Cook pulp over low heat for 6 to 7 minutes then press through a coarse sieve to remove seeds. Discard seeds; return pulp to saucepan. Add orange rind and juice sugar raisins and salt. Continue to cook over low heat stirring constantly. As mixture thickens add grape skins and cook 6 to 8 more minutes or until quite thick. Pour into sterile hot jars and seal while hot.

title: Coconut Caramel Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add coconut and pecans. Cook until golden brown stirring often. Combine cream cheese and milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Layer 1/4 cream cheese mixture in each baked pie shell. Drizzle 1/4 caramel topping and coconut mixture. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Cover. Freeze until firm. Let frozen pie stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cheese Soup #1
instructions: Beat the first 3 ingredients for 5 minutes. Boil the milk and broth. Stir in flour and onion mixture using wire whip. Add the Cheez Whiz with the mustard and salt and pepper to taste.

title: All-Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix the Nabisco All-Bran and boiling water together; cool. Cream the sugar and oil. Add the eggs to the cream mixture. Add Kelloggs All-Bran and the cooled Nabisco All-Bran. Sift together and add the flour salt and soda. Alternately add flour mixture and the buttermilk; mix well. Add by hand the white raisins. Mix all together. Store covered in refrigerator 3 to 4 days before baking. Fill cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 17 to 20 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Venison Cutlets
instructions: Pound steaks until meat is about 1/4-inch thick. Rub oregano into the meat. Mix milk and eggs in a bowl large enough to hold cutlets. Mix bread crumbs and pepper in second bowl. Dip cutlets in milk mixture then in crumbs coating both sides. Heat olive oil in a heavy saute pan and saute turning once until cutlets are browned and meat cooked. Serve with lemon wedges. Serves 2 or 3 people.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Layer all ingredients in order listed. Bake in 9 x 13-inch baking pan 1 hour. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Black Bean Dip
instructions: Combine onion and cilantro in food processor. Whirl until finely chopped. Add beans oil salt chili powder and ground hot red pepper. Process using on/off pulses until evenly chopped (do not puree). Scrape into bowl. Stir in orange juice. Serve immediately or refrigerate covered for up to 6 hours.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream butter sugars and 1/4 cup peanut butter. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Combine flour cocoa and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture and mix well. Divide dough into 24 pieces; flatten each into a 3-inch circle.

title: Chicken And Cashew Nuts
instructions: After cutting chicken into cubes marinate with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cut onion and squash into cubes. Mix sauce soy sauce oyster sauce sesame oil and tapioca powder with 1/2 cup of water and set aside. Saute onion until browning in 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil then add marinated chicken stirring until it is cooked. Add cut squash and onion; stir until half cooked then add mixed sauce. Keep it at a boil. Add toasted cashews and chili before you serve. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine the brown sugar white sugar and melted oleo. Add the eggs vanilla coconut and nuts. Mix the remaining ingredients well and add. Mix well with handle of wooden spoon. Drop from 1/2 teaspoon of measuring set for uniform cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 or 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and jello powder. Add oil water and eggs. Beat with mixer for 4 minutes. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch glass cake pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. As soon as you remove cake from oven stab with fork. Mix together lemon juice and powdered sugar. Pour over cake while it is still hot.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter well a 10-inch tube pan or a Bundt pan. In a large bowl mix butter cheese sugar and vanilla. Blend in the eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk to first mixture. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and pumpkin. Mix well. Combine dry ingredients sift and add to pumpkin mixture alternately with water. Grease two loaf pans and sprinkle with flour. Bake at 350 degrees until cake tester comes out clean (30 to 45 minutes). Cool loaf pans for about 30 minutes before removing loaves.

title: Sesame Chicken Kabobs
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; place in shallow container. Set aside. Combine next 6 ingredients in a jar. Cover and shake vigorously. Pour over chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Remove chicken from marinade reserving marinade. Alternate chicken and vegetables on skewer. Grill kabobs about 6 inches from medium-hot coals 15 to 20 minutes turning and basting often with marinade.

title: Fish In Beer Batter
instructions: Sprinkle the fillets inside and out with lemon juice. Mix the flour cornmeal dill or tarragon salt and paprika in a bowl. Add beer and mix until smooth. Dip the fish in beer batter and fry 8 to 9 minutes on each side.

title: Party Biscuits
instructions: Mix the cheese pimiento and onion together. Add Bisquick and water. Stir to make dough. Roll dough 1/2-inch thick and cut with small cutter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve with small slice of ham.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Mix Bisquick milk and cheese until soft dough. Beat 30 seconds by hand. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto unbaked cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for eight to ten minutes. Mix garlic powder with butter or oleo and brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet. This recipe from Red Lobster.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Cook raisins until tender. Drain. Mix sugar flour and sour cream. Add slightly beaten eggs and raisins; cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue or marshmallow cream.

title: Sausage Strata
instructions: Day before serving grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Saute sausage and green and red peppers until well browned. Drain off all fat. Add mustard to mixture. Arrange bread in bottom of pan. Top with sausage mixture and cheese. In large bowl lightly beat eggs. Beat in milk Worcestershire sauce pepper nutmeg and salt. Pour over layers in pan. Cover tightly. Refrigerate overnight. Next day heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake uncovered 40 to 50 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Fingers
instructions: Mix flour cheese and salt in a bag. Cut chicken into 1-inch strips. Dip in flour mixture. Heat oil in pan (enough to coat the bottom of the pan). Cook the chicken on moderate to high heat to gently brown one side and then turn the other turning only once.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix shortening until creamy; add sugar and eggs. Mix well. Mix flour cream of tartar and salt together. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture; mix well. Make 1-inch balls out of all dough. Roll in cinnamon sugar and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Ham Stew
instructions: Put vegetables and meat into a big pan with water. Add ham flavoring. Cook until vegetables are tender. Mix cornstarch and water; add to stew to thicken. Very good.

title: Oriental Peas
instructions: Melt butter; stir in flour. Gradually add milk and cream whisking constantly. With pan on high heat stir constantly until mixture comes to a boil and is smooth. Simmer still stirring 2 to 3 minutes longer or until the sauce coats the wires of the whisk heavily. Remove from heat; season with salt.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Freeze Oreos and thaw Cool Whip a day ahead. Mix and set aside the cream cheese margarine and confectioners sugar. Combine and beat for two minutes the instant pudding milk and vanilla. Fold the Cool Whip and the cream cheese mixture into pudding mixture. Crush the frozen Oreos in food processor until texture of dirt. Layer pudding mixture and Oreos (3 layers each) in 8-inch flowerpot (preferably new!) ending with a generous layer of cookies. Insert artificial flowers and serve with a trowel. Adjust recipe for larger or smaller pot.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix and vanilla. Add eggs oil and 7-Up. Makes 3 layers.

title: Chewies
instructions: Melt margarine with the box of sugar and then let it cool. Add eggs vanilla flour and nuts or coconut. Pour into a greased and floured 3 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares. Makes 36 small squares.

title: Gingerbread Sauce
instructions: Heat butter and brown sugar until brown. Beat yolks of 2 eggs and cream; add to sugar and butter mixture. Cook on low until thick.

title: Butter Pecan Torte
instructions: Melt butter and mix with crumbs. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Set aside. Cream together cake mix extract cornstarch eggs salt and oil. Add Jell-O mixture and blend well. Grease 2 loaf pans or 1 angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: No Bake Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix butter and cracker crumbs. Line bottom of pan.

title: Oregano Lemon Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan arrange chicken in a single layer skin side down. In a small bowl combine oregano salt and pepper. Whisk in oil lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. Drizzle half over chicken and bake for 20 minutes. Drain excess fat from the chicken. Turn chicken over and brush on the remaining mixture. Continue baking until done about 15 minutes.

title: Kentucky Wonder Pound Cake
instructions: Mix egg yolks oil and sugar. Add flour cinnamon and nuts. Mix well. Add pineapple orange juice beaten egg whites and pecans. Stir well. Bake in a tube cake pan at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Combine chocolate cake butter water oil and 1/2 of condensed milk in mixing bowl. Mix well. Pour 1/2 of batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Mix sugar 1 cup flour oil baking powder milk vanilla and egg; set aside. Add another cup flour to the blueberries (this will prevent berries from falling to bottom of cake). Add blueberry mixture to other ingredients; blend well. Grease and flour an 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pistachio Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. In a bowl whisk together the reserved juice and pudding mix for 2 minutes. This mixture will be thick. Stir in the pineapple fruit cocktail and mandarin oranges. Gently fold in the whipped topping. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Smoked Sausage Spaghetti
instructions: Cook noodles as directed. Cut smoked sausage in bite size pieces. Mix with spaghetti sauce and heat. Drain noodles; cover with sauce and top with grated Parmesan cheese and serve.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crumble 3/4 Oreos and place in large bowl. Set aside. Mix pudding as directed on box. Add and blend cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip to the pudding. Put cream cheese mixture on top of crumbled cookies. Put rest of crumbled cookies on top. Put gummy worms on top or fake flowers.

title: Pineapple Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese pineapple and green pepper. Sprinkle with Lawrys seasoned salt. Shape into a ball and serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Pour chocolate chips nuts butter and vanilla into large mixing bowl. Put marshmallows and water into top of double boiler and cook over boiling water until melted. Put sugar and evaporated milk in another boiler and bring to a slow boil for 8 minutes. Pour both hot mixtures into the mixing bowl with chips mixture and stir until melted. Pour into greased pan and cut into squares when cool.

title: Million Dollar Rice Salad
instructions: Put marshmallows in bowl and\tadd drained pineapple. Cream the cheese sugar and mayonnaise together until smooth. Add rice and cherries to marshmallow mixture. Fold in the whipped cream and nuts; chill.

title: Stuffed Spaghetti Squash(Microwave)
instructions: To Cook Squash Using an ice pick make 8 holes in squash in intervals around it. Weigh squash to determine microwave time at 6 to 7 minutes per pound. Place squash in a 2-quart rectangular dish. Microwave on High turning squash upside down midway through cooking. Let stand.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Lightly grease cookie sheets. In top of double boiler combine egg whites sugar and cornstarch. Cook over boiling water stirring constantly 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Add salt coconut and almond extract stirring until well combined. Drop by teaspoonfuls 1/2 inch apart onto prepared cookie sheets. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove to wire rack; cool. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef rice onion salt and pepper. Shape into balls. Place in pressure cooker. Mix tomato soup with water. Pour over meatballs. Jiggle for 10 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine pumpkin sugar salt and spices. Add eggs and milk. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 50 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool and serve with Cool Whip.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Add blueberries and toss gently to coat. Make a well in center of mixture and set aside. In a separate bowl combine milk and next 5 ingredients. Add to dry mixture stirring until just moistened. Spoon into muffin pans coated with cooking spray filling 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yields 1 dozen.

title: Blueberry Cream Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese lemon juice vanilla and powdered sugar. Fold in whipped cream. Line two baked pie shells with sliced bananas. Divide filling in half. Pour over bananas. Chill. Add lemon juice and sugar to pie filling. Pour over top.

title: Bean Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Mix well using a spoon. In large skillet add oil. When hot reduce heat to medium-low. Drop cakes into hot oil and fry until golden brown on both sides.

title: Our Almost Fat Free Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients until uniform. Adjust seasoning if desired. Add salt cayenne bitters etc. if desired.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Combine all in large bowl. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Creole Chicken And Mushroom Salad
instructions: Line a bowl with lettuce. Toss the first 6 ingredients together and place in the lettuce-lined bowl. Mix the last 6 ingredients well. Pour over the salad and toss lightly.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In 13 x 9-inch pan dump cherry pie filling; spread evenly. Dump pineapple on top of pie filling and spread evenly. Now dump box of yellow cake mix on top of fruit and level it out over top. Pour melted butter over top. Bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven. Top with Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook hamburger meat; drain. Add pork and beans in an oven pan add remaining ingredients mix well. Cook in oven about 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Oven temperature 350 degrees.

title: Fresh Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine ingredients in order listed. Pour into 1 quart baking dish and place in pan of water. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and stir in pecans. Put in unbaked deep dish pie crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter over low heat. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in spaghetti chicken and mushrooms.

title: Cornflake Candy
instructions: Cook sugar and corn syrup just until ready to boil. Stir in peanut butter and remove from heat. Immediately pour over the corn flakes that have been crunched down a little. Pour into buttered pan. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Bake in layers and use boiled frosting. (This was all the directions given.)

title: Peanut Butter Cupcakes
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add peanut butter and add vanilla and eggs. Beat well. Add flour salt and baking powder alternately with milk. Fill cupcakes 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Johnny Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl and stir to mix. Add eggs milk and oil. Beat with electric mixer just until smooth (dont overbeat).

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and run cold water over macaroni. Mix all ingredients together. Add mayonnaise and salt.

title: Barbecued Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs onion egg salt pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce together. Form into loaf. Put in shallow pan. Combine rest of ingredients in dish and pour over loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli and drain well. Combine soup mayonnaise eggs onion salt (lightly) and pepper. Add broccoli and pour into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cheese over this. Melt butter in pan and add stuffing mix. Spread bread crumbs over cheese and broccoli mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cover lightly with foil.

title: Kitty'S Squash Dressing
instructions: Put onion butter peppers (if using) and squash in a large skillet and cook until done (onions and squash will be real tender). Add cream of mushroom soup and quartered up cheese (at least 1/2 pound); mix all together and add to bowl of crumbled cornbread then mix all this real good. Spray a large casserole dish with Pam spray. Pour mixture in dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Gobs
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Add the water last.\tDrop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Mom'S Apple Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In a pan combine sugar and water. Cut shortening into flour until fine. Add milk; mix until a ball forms. Roll out into a rectangle. Sprinkle cinnamon over apples then spread over dough. Roll up dough (like a jelly roll). Slice dough into 16 slices 1/2-inch thick. Place in pan with melted butter. Pour sugar syrup carefully around rolls. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Can be made with other fruits.

title: Bev'S Nut Cake
instructions: Slowly melt margarine and marshmallows together. Mix all other ingredients in a very large bowl. Pour melted marshmallow and margarine mixture over nut mixture. Stir until well coated. Spoon and press mixture into a large tube pan. Refrigerate overnight. Cake will keep in refrigerator for several weeks if kept airtight.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar flour and salt. Add beaten eggs milk and vanilla. Pour into an unbaked pie crust. Cook for 10 minutes at 450\u00b0 then for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and sour cream together. Than add everything else to mixture. Spread mixture on flour tortillas and roll. Chill overnight in refrigerator. Cut in the morning. When serving have salsa to dip pinwheels into.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Candy(Microwave)
instructions: Melt margarine in microwave or over low heat. Add peanut butter sugar and graham crackers. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan that has been sprayed with Pam or similar product. Melt chocolate chips in microwave or over low heat and spread over mixture. Cut in squares after slight cooling. Tastes like Reeses peanut butter cups.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Sprinkle the cheese on top. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Sparkling Fruit Mold
instructions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl at least 2 minutes until completely dissolved. Refrigerate 15 minutes. Gently stir in cold club soda. Refrigerate 30 minutes or until slightly thickened. Reserve 1 cup pineapple for garnish. Gently stir remaining fruit into gelatin. Spoon into 6-cup mold; cover. Refrigerate 4 hours. Unmold. Garnish with reserved pineapple. Makes 12 servings.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend all ingredients except nuts; shape into a ball. Roll in the chopped nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Beef And Macaroni
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onions. Pour cooked macaroni over meat. Add ketchup salt and pepper. Mix together well. Stir in soup. Place in casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Place in a 450\u00b0 oven until cheese melts.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine everything but the nuts; beat 2 minutes. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Dry Jello Salad
instructions: Add jello to Cool Whip. Add cheese fruit and nuts if desired. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 2 quart casserole. In casserole combine uncooked rice and packet of seasonings with remaining ingredients except nuts; mix well. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover sprinkle with nuts and bake for 15 minutes or until rice is done.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients (including liquid from corn). Bake in buttered deep casserole at 400\u00b0 until barely pulls away from side of dish.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Lay chicken in bottom of buttered baking dish. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Crush crackers and spread over soup mixture. Melt margarine and pour over crackers. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Mushroom Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute mushrooms and onion in butter in skillet. Add lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and garlic salt. Cook until liquid is absorbed stirring frequently. Chill in fridge if desired.

title: Big Apple Pie
instructions: Measure 1 1/4 cups flour and 1 teaspoon salt into a bowl. Cut in 1/2 cup margarine with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal. Toss in cheese. Stir in ice water; mix lightly. Form dough into ball on floured board; roll dough to fit a 12-inch pizza pan. Transfer to pan; form a 1/2 inch rim. Combine brown sugar remaining 1/4 cup flour 1/4 teaspoon salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle half of mixture over pastry. Cut 1/4 cup of margarine into remaining mixture until crumbly; set aside. Arrange apple slices in circles on pastry overlapping slices. Sprinkle with lemon juice and crumb mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until apples are tender. Makes 1 (12-inch) pie.

title: Layered Taco Bean Dip
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the bean dip and taco mix. Spread mixture on a 10-inch tray or a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle chopped onions over mixture. Blend together mayonnaise and sour cream; spread over onions. Sprinkle sliced olives over top. Chill. Serve with corn chips. Makes 2 1/2 cups dip.

title: Momma Mimi'S Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake uncovered in large baking pan at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes. Serves 6 to 8. Enjoy.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack into a loaf pan. Bake 1 hour in a moderate oven (350\u00b0). Makes 8 servings.

title: Butter Baked Taters
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Melt butter in a saucepan. Add onion to butter and saute until tender. Halve potatoes lengthwise then slice crosswise into 1/8-inch thick slices. Immediately line up in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking pan with slices overlapping. Pour butter mixture over potatoes season with salt and pepper. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake an additional 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese is slightly browned and melted. Serves 4.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Put raw meat in large roasting pan. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour over meat. Cover. Cook for 4 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Ginger Ale Salad
instructions: Pour hot water over jello. Stir until dissolved. Add ginger ale. Pour into salad mold. Add fruit and nuts. Refrigerate until set up.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Note Cheese has to be at room temperature.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook noodles and drain. In saucepan over low heat melt butter. Add flour and stir smooth. Add milk. Stir smooth. Cook thick and add cheese. Put all together and pour in casserole. Top with bread crumbs.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Saute vegetables in oil. Add spices and beans; simmer for 20 minutes. Add olives last and top with sour cream.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Pat out package of crescent rolls on ungreased pizza or cookie sheet pan (join all rolls to make crust). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool thoroughly.

title: Full Of Beans Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl mix all ingredients except cheese. Add 1 1/2 cups cheese; mix again gently. Put mixture into an 8 x 8-inch glass dish coated with nonstick vegetable spray. Sprinkle dip with reserved cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with nachos.

title: Oatmeal-Cho Chippers
instructions: Place oats in food processor bowl or blender and process until finely ground; set aside. Cream butter. Add sugar and mix well. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Combine oats flour and soda; add to creamed mixture. Stir in chips. Drop by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Beef Vinaigrette Salad
instructions: Cut steak into thin bite size strips. For dressing; in a jar combine 1 tablespoon oil lemon juice salt Italian seasonings and pepper. Cover and shake well.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Drain all vegetables. Mix together soup sour cream onion pepper cheese and pimento. Crumble crackers and mix with melted margarine. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick Dip
instructions: Spread a thin layer of sour cream over the bottom of a shallow serving dish. Spread refried beans over the sour cream. Place chopped tomatoes over beans. Sprinkle cheeses over tomatoes. Yummy!

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a bowl combine margarine granulated sugar and eggs. In another bowl combine flour cocoa coconut and pecans and mix well. Blend thoroughly with sugar and egg mixture. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 X 13 inch pan. Bake 30 minutes. Remove to a wire rack. While cake is still hot spread on marshmallow cream. While cake is cooling combine milk confectioners sugar vanilla cocoa and margarine in a bowl. Let cake cool then spread with topping. Refrigerate until chilled then cut into squares. Keep refrigerated. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: French Potato Salad
instructions: Rinse potatoes and put them in a large saucepan with water to cover and salt to taste. Bring to a boil and cook 20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Do not overcook or the potatoes will be mushy. Drain the potatoes and let stand until ready to prepare the salad. The salad should be made while the potatoes are still warm. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1/4-inch thick slices. There should be about 6 cups. Put the slices in a mixing bowl and sprinkle them with the wine.

title: Herbed Spread
instructions: Stir all ingredients and use.

title: Purple Lady Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello; add other items set in mold until set 24 hours preferred.

title: Cheddar Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Roll into balls then freeze. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven and heat 20 to 30 minutes. Delicious!

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Chop apples. Add to sugar and let stand. Mix oil and eggs. Add flour soda cinnamon and salt alternately with apples and sugar. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in a tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: A La Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except sherbet) in punch bowl and mix well. Scoop sherbet into punch. Gently place ice ring (made from jello mold and water) in punch and enjoy!

title: Almond Bark Cookies
instructions: Melt almond bark following package directions; quickly mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper. Cool.

title: Thank You Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to box directions. Cool cake. Spread pudding on cake; chill until time to serve and then add Cool Whip to top. Serve.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Let set until it starts to set up. Whip with mixer until fluffy. Add frozen strawberries. Mix in small container of cool whip and nuts.

title: Crisp Pickles
instructions: Combine cucumbers onions and salt. Cover with ice and let stand 3 hours. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over cucumber mixture and heat just to a boil. Can.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add other ingredients and simmer for about 30 to 45 minutes. Enjoy!!

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add onions green pepper shrimp and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate several hours. Stir before serving.

title: Preacher Cookies
instructions: In a saucepan combine sugar margarine and milk; bring to a boil and stir constantly for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cocoa vanilla oatmeal and nuts if desired. Onto waxed paper drop mixture by teaspoonfuls. Cookies will get firm as they cool. These freeze well.

title: Cinnamon Swirls
instructions: Cut butter into flour and salt. Sprinkle water over mixture. Stir with fork until dough holds together. Form into a square and flatten to 1/2-inch wide hand (ball/square). Flour counter and roll out to 12-inches. Brush dough with melted butter. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over dough. Roll it up and seal edges or pinch together. Chill for 30 to 45 minutes (in plastic wrap). Cut into 1/4-inch squares. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Island Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken in broth with bay leaf and garlic clove. Cool; cut in small pieces. Cut eggs in small chunks. Set aside. Mix together next 6 items. Add chicken and eggs. Mix gently. Serve on lettuce. Adjust spices to taste.

title: Best-Every Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine filling ingredients in order given; pour into pie crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake an additional 40 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool.

title: Pork Chops In White Wine
instructions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Sear slowly on both sides in hot bacon fat. Remove from skillet. Stirring constantly blend flour into fat remaining in skillet. Add broth and wine. When very smooth return chops to skillet. Spread onion over chops. Cover skillet; simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Southern Style Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 12 muffin cups. In a large bowl combine flour cornmeal sugar baking powder and salt. In a medium bowl combine milk oil eggs and tabasco sauce. Make a well in center of dry ingredients; add milk mixture and stir to combine. Stir in corn. Spoon batter into muffin cups. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes on a wire rack. Remove from pans and serve warm.

title: Thanksgiving Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 3 round 8 1/2 inch cake pans. Mix cake flour baking soda baking powder cinnamon and salt; set aside. Beat cookies chopped pecans and butter in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally until crumbly. Divide among pans; press evenly on bottoms of pans. Beat sugar oil eggs and pumpkin in same bowl on medium speed 1 minute scraping bowl constantly. Gradually beat flour mixture into pumpkin mixture on medium speed 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Pour over pecan mixture in pans; spread evenly. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans to wire rack. Cool completely. Prepare Buttery Cream Cheese Frosting. Fill each layer with 1/3 cup of the frosting placing layers with pecan side down. Frost sides and top of cake with remaining frosting. Spread caramel topping over edges of cake allowing some to drizzle down the sides. Arrange pecan halves and candies on top of cake. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Baklava
instructions: Combine nuts sugar and spices. Trim phyllo to pan size. Place 6 phyllo sheets in a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan brushing each sheet generously with butter. Sprinkle a thin layer of nut mixture evenly over the phyllo. Cover with 4 buttered phyllo sheets. Continue alternating phyllo butter and nut mixture until all nuts are used. Top with 8 buttered phyllo sheets. Cut into diamonds or squares. If desired stud each piece with a whole clove. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes lower oven to 300\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer or until golden brown. Pour warm syrup over hot Baklava.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Hot Dogs
instructions: Layer potatoes onion and hot dogs ending with potatoes. Sprinkle cheese over top. Mix soup and milk together; pour over potatoes. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Cioppino Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except wine. Simmer covered about 1 hour stirring often. If sauce becomes too thick add a little more stock during cooking. During last 15 minutes of cooking add the wine. Makes about 3 cups. Delicious with baked or poached whitefish such as haddock sole hake etc.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients with an electric mixer. Shape into balls and chill. Dip chilled balls into the chocolate chips 2 teaspoons of butter and paraffin which have been melted together. Chill.

title: Annette'S Super Cornbread
instructions: Cube ham and brown in skillet. Mix together with all the other ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Combine 1 stick melted butter with 1/3 cup sugar and the graham crumbs. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350 degrees. Let cool. Cream 2 sticks butter with powdered sugar vanilla and eggs. Beat 15 minutes with mixer. Spread this mixture over crust. Slice bananas over filling. Spread on pineapple; top with cool whip. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries. Chill for several hours before serving.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar shortening cocoa and milk in saucepan. Place over heat; bring to boil. Let boil for 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop onto waxed paper with teaspoon.

title: Pizza Crust With Topping
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in medium bowl. Combine flour salt and sugar in separate bowl. Add flour mixture and oil to yeast. Stir well. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead until smooth and elastic about 6 to 8 minutes. Lightly grease bowl. Place dough in bowl; turn once to grease top surface. Cover and let rise until double in bulk about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix bread crumbs with seasonings. Coat each chicken piece with 1 tablespoon yogurt. Press 2 tablespoons coating mixture into each chicken piece. Bake for 30 minutes. Test for doneness.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni 7 to 10 minutes. Drain. Run under cold water; let stand. Chop up celery; grate cheese. Combine slaw dressing cheese celery and macaroni (drained). Sprinkle with chopped parsley. Stir well. Chill. Serve.

title: Cheesy Company Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine until tender. Add broccoli rice soup and 1/2 pound cheese cubed. Stir until cheese is melted. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Top with remaining cubed cheese; continue baking until cheese is melted.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Use sweet corn. Add milk butter or margarine flour salt and sugar. Beat eggs until light. Add to the mixture. Pour in buttered baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm like a custard.

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: The night before baking mix raisins soda boiling water and butter and let stand covered. Add remaining ingredients the next morning and mix well. Fill cans 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool until you can handle. Remove bread from cans and cool. Roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate or can be frozen. Excellent with cream cheese spread or butter.

title: Crested Gingerbread(Vintage Recipe 1937)
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening egg and molasses. Sift in flour ginger cinnamon cloves salt and soda; mix well. Add boiling water and beat until smooth. Add cold water and beat again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cranberry Apple Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine cranberries and apple cider. Cook and stir until cranberries pop (5 to 8 minutes). Combine sugar cornstarch and mace; stir into hot cranberries. Cook quickly stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Stir in apples. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile prepare basic pastry dough and line a 9-inch pie plate with half the dough. Turn cranberry-apple mixture into pastry lined pie plate. Dot with butter. Roll out remaining pastry for top of pie and finish in the usual way. To prevent over browning cover edge of pastry with foil. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Remove foil; bake for 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Cool on wire rack. A fluffy brandy topper makes this pie extra special.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Stir well and pour in a glass dish (size depends on how thick you want the pieces). Freeze overnight. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce leaf. Oh its so goooooooooood.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In large bowl combine soup milk and pepper. Add potatoes; toss to coat. Spoon into 3-quart oblong baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are fork-tender. Garnish with parsley. Makes 10 servings.

title: Chicken With Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Take skin off chicken. Wrap bacon around chicken. Place beef under each breast. Mix mushroom soup and sour cream together; spread over chicken. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours or at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Gladdy'S Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Rinse chicken under cold running water. Place in a large kettle almost covered with water. Add the next seven ingredients. Bring to a boil; cover and reduce heat. Simmer one hour or until chicken is very tender. Cool remove chicken from stock and strip meat from bones. Cut into bite size pieces; discard bones and skin. There should be about six cups of chicken. Strain the chicken from the chicken stock. When cold remove fat and discard.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: In baking dish put layer of cabbage and layer of corned beef. Mix other ingredients. Pour over top. Put in oven and cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Salad
instructions: Combine gelatin with 1 cup boiling water. Drain pineapple; measure juice and add water to make one cup. Add to gelatin. Chill until partially set. Soften cream cheese and add mayonnaise. Add to gelatin and stir well. Add other ingredients. Pour into mold or pan and chill.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together then slowly add to others. Pour into greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0 (check after 1 hour). Remove from pans immediately. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Spanish Style Squash
instructions: Heat oil. Fry onion and squash cubes until light brown. Add flour; stir until brown. Add tomatoes and stir. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and simmer. Do not overcook. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Ranch Style Hash
