instructions: Brown beef; add tomatoes green pepper onion and rice. Season with basil salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 25 minutes. Top with slices of cheese.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Combine all ingredients except candy in large mixing bowl. Mix on low speed until dough forms ball. Add a little milk if too dry. Chill. Shape dough into balls. Roll into sugar. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden. Press candy in center of cookie immediately after removing from oven. Cookies will be cracked looking.

title: Orange Soaked Angel Cake
instructions: Place cake on serving platter. Using meat fork pierce top of cake at 1-inch intervals. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl combine fruits. Set aside. Place apricot spread in small mixing bowl. Microwave on High for 45 seconds to 1 minute or until melted stirring once. Add water sugar and liqueur (or orange juice) to apricot spread. Mix well. Microwave on High for 1 to 2 minutes or until sugar is dissolved. Pour syrup over fruit. Toss to coat. Spoon fruit and syrup mixture over cake allowing syrup to soak into cake. Cover cake with plastic wrap. Chill 4 hours before serving.

title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown ground beef in oil; add onion and cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Combine sour cream soup catsup and Worcestershire sauce; add to ground beef. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture is thoroughly heated. Serve over noodles sprinkled with poppy seed. Yield 4 servings.

title: Cheese-Cranberry Bread
instructions: Mix cranberries and 1/2 cup sugar together until well blended. Blend flour 3/4 cup sugar baking powder and salt together in a large bowl. Mix in the sugared cranberries nuts orange peel and cheese. Beat the egg milk and butter together. Add to mixture in a bowl; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and mashed bananas then add mixed dry ingredients alternating with sour milk ending with dry ingredients. Then add nuts. Place in one large or two smaller bread pans greased. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Horse Crock
instructions: Make squares with pressed beef. Spread softened cream cheese over beef and make a roll of olives sliced down at bottom. Roll like jelly roll. Slice and serve on Ritz crackers.

title: Sour Cream Spice Cake
instructions: Sift 1 cup sugar flour salt soda and spices together into ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan. Level mixture off make three holes in it with a spoon. Put vanilla in one oil in second and vinegar in third hole. Pour sour cream over; mix well until flour disappears. Mix last 3 ingredients; sprinkle over batter in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake springs back when touched.

title: Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Mix together the nuts flour and oleo and press into an oblong cake pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Holiday Jam Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and mix well. Add jam and buttermilk alternating with flour and soda. Add fruit and nuts last. Stir well. Bake in three greased and floured 9-inch pans for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Frost with filling for jam cake.

title: Creamed Spinach(Diabetic)
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add spinach. Reduce heat and simmer covered about 5 minutes until spinach is wilted. Drain well and set aside.

title: Ham Stuffed Manicotti
instructions: Cook manicotti according to directions. Set aside. In a large skillet saute onion in oil until tender. Remove from heat. Add ham mushrooms half of the Swiss cheese and Parmesan. Set aside. In a saucepan saute green peppers in butter until tender. Stir in flour until combined. Add milk and cook until thick and bubbly. Mix a quarter of the sauce into ham mixture. Stuff shells with about 1/3 cup of filling each. Place in greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with remaining sauce; sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated thoroughly. Sprinkle with parsley and remaining Swiss cheese before serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Eggplant And Squash Casserole(Makes Small Casserole)
instructions: Steam vegetable. In casserole dish spread eggplant or squash. Sprinkle with black pepper. Sprinkle crumbled cornflakes over vegetable. Add grated cheese. Spreads undiluted mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. No salt!

title: Whackey Cake
instructions: Mix altogether and pour into ungreased 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Supreme Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain macaroni and return it to saucepan. Mix cheese powder and milk with macaroni. In a skillet saute onions and mushrooms until onions are tender. Add mushrooms and onion to macaroni mixture. Stir in chicken. Cook on medium heat until mixture is warm. Add sour cream parsley and black pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix sugar oleo salt eggs and vanilla. Add coconut pecans and raisins. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Bake slice and eat!

title: Oven-Roasted Pork 'N Vegetables(19% Calories From Fat)
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Generously spray roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place tenderloins in spray coated pan. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part on one tenderloin. Place carrots potatoes and onion around tenderloins. Drizzle oil evenly over meat and vegetables. Sprinkle with rosemary sage and pepper. Bake uncovered at 450\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until meat thermometer registers 165\u00b0 and vegetables are tender stirring vegetables occasionally. Yield 8 servings.

title: Chicken Crescents
instructions: Separate crescent rolls. Mix remaining ingredients. Spoon onto wide end of crescent. Roll up. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a large pan bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil (250\u00b0 on candy thermometer). Add peanuts and butter. Boil to 300\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from fire and add soda. Stir thoroughly and pour quickly without using a spoon to spread onto well-greased cookie sheet. Let cool then break into pieces. This recipe may be cut in half.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl beat egg yolks. Stir in sweetened condensed milk ReaLemon and rind. Pour into crust.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Add water cornstarch and sugar together and cook until thick. Then add Jell-O. Set aside until cool and slightly jelled. Put into refrigerator until cold. Then add sliced strawberries. Pour into a baked pie shell. Makes one large or two small pies.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: Chop cabbage; cut off corn. Chop onions and peppers. Add other ingredients and mix well. Simmer for about 25 minutes stirring constantly. Makes 9 pints.

title: Pot Roast With Gravy
instructions: Mix flour 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper; coat meat with flour mixture. Melt shortening in large skillet or Dutch oven; brown meat. Add water and vinegar. Sprinkle dill weed over meat. Cover tightly and simmer about 3 hours or until meat is tender. One hour before end of cooking time add potatoes and carrots; season with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Twenty minutes before end of cooking time add zucchini; season with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Serve with gravy. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: Wet bread in warm water. Mix with beef and ketchup; shape into balls.

title: Dessert Fajitas (Quick)
instructions: In a skillet pour 1/4-inch or less of vegetable oil and heat. Cut tortilla shells into pie shaped wedges. Add to the hot oil and fry until crisp. Remove and drain well. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with small bowl of honey or syrup.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain squash; add carrot onion sour cream and chicken soup. In another pan melt butter and add stuffing mix. In a casserole dish place 1/2 stuffing mix on bottom and pour over with squash mix. Sprinkle rest of stuffing on top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Soak corn tortillas in boiling chicken soup or broth until just wilted. Line baking dish with them and let them come up over sides. Layer the rest of the ingredients in dish in order listed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Good served with tossed green salad with avocados and chives and buttered French bread. Serves 6.

title: Pizza Mac
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions. Drain. In medium bowl blend milk and egg. Add macaroni and mix well. Spread evenly into greased 10 x 15-inch baking dish. Spoon spaghetti sauce over macaroni mixture. Top with remaining ingredients. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and macaroni is set about 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in tight container. When serving use 1/2 cup mix (slightly more if marshmallows were added) in cup; add hot water.

title: Pineapple-Pecan Salad
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Blend in orange gelatin creaming and mixing thoroughly. Continuously stirring add hot water. Cool 5 minutes. Add undrained can of pineapple chopped pecans and quartered cherries. Pour from mixing bowl into wax paper lined flat pan. Serve cut into squares.

title: Pineapple Date Bread
instructions: Beat egg slightly; add milk dates pineapple and salad oil. Stir. Add flour baking powder salt and sugar. Stir just to moisten do not beat. Pour into greased 9 1/2 x 5 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan and cool on rack. Wrap in wax paper and keep overnight before slicing.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt 1/2 cup butter and pour into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Add 1/2 the package of hash browns. In a separate bowl mix soup sour cream milk and onions. Pour half of this mix over the hash browns. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese on top. Sprinkle rest of hash browns on and pour rest of mix on top. Sprinkle rest of cheese on top then cover with crushed corn flakes. Pour 2 tablespoons melted butter over top and bake for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Mix cooked crisp crumbled bacon on top.

title: Crab Spaghetti
instructions: Cook garlic in hot oil and butter for about 30 seconds. Add basil. Cook for 1 more minute. Add wine. Simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in crabmeat and soy sauce. Serve atop hot pasta.

title: Microwave 5 Minute Snowy White Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar water cream of tartar and salt in 2-cup glass measure. Microwave 4 to 5 minutes on Medium-high or until mixture boils. Beat 2 egg whites in small mixer bowl until soft peaks form. Gradually pour in hot syrup; beat about 5 minutes or until thick and fluffy. Blend in vanilla. Frosts a 12 x 7-inch or two 9-inch layers.

title: Lynda'S Chicken Stew
instructions: Put water in a pan. Add chicken and gently boil until tender. Remove chicken from water and cool.

title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine in large bowl. Beat at high speed until thick and light colored 6 to 8 minutes. Whip 1/2 cup cream until thick. Fold gently into berry mixture. Put in graham cracker crust. Freeze.

title: Crock-Pot Stew Beef
instructions: Cook on slow in crock-pot for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Chocolate Nut Bars
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter. Press firmly into a 9-inch pie shell pan. Bake 8 minutes to 375\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Combine bacon onion and green pepper in 4-cup measure. Cover with paper towel and cook by microwave for 4 minutes stirring once. Remove from microwave; pour off fat. Mix in salt Worcestershire and cream cheese. Wash and dry mushrooms. Remove stems. Chop stems and add to bacon mixture. Fill mushrooms. In 2-cup measure heat bread crumbs and butter in microwave for 1 minute; stir until well mixed. Press buttered crumbs on top of stuffed mushrooms. place half the mushrooms in 6 x 10 inch baking dish filling side up. Add 1/4 cup hot water to baking dish and cook 2 minutes. Repeat with remaining mushrooms. Makes about 50.

title: Grasshopper Pie(1994 Bradley Farm Pie Of The Year)
instructions: Combine chocolate wafer crumbs and melted butter; stir well. Press into bottom and sides of a greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Let cool completely. Cut 3 mint candies diagonally in half; set aside. Reserve 10 whole candies for garnish. Chop remaining candies; set aside.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients (best to let the cream cheese set at room temperature to get soft). Season with Tonys and garlic powder to taste. Chill. Serve with chips.

title: Allie'S Squash Patties
instructions: Add all ingredients except eggs. Beat eggs and add to mixture. Mixture will be thin. Drop from tablespoons into hot fat in skillet. Brown on both sides.

title: Colombian Steak
instructions: Season the steaks with mustard pepper cumin and vinegar; let stand. In a frying pan heat the oil and saute the tomatoes onion garlic and oregano; add salt. In a large frying pan heat oil and saute the steaks until browned on both sides. Add the sauce and cook covered 10 minutes over low heat. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cedricks Casserole
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef. Add salt and pepper. Place half of shredded cabbage in casserole dish. pour browned beef and onion over cabbage layer. Put remaining cabbage on top of meat. Cover with tomato soup. Cover and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients in bowl. Store in refrigerator. Makes 16 tablespoons. Serve with sliced apples.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Cook beef until tender. Add carrots after beef is tender along with the rest of the ingredients. Simmer until all added ingredients are done. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix mustard salt sugar and vinegar. Add onion juice mixing well. Slowly add oil beating until thick. Add poppy seeds. Refrigerate.

title: Crunchy Crust Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add flavoring. Add flour. Beat well. Pour into a greased tube pan. Start in cold oven. Bake 60 to 90 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: 2 Minute Fudge
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in milk. Cook first 5 ingredients 2 minutes after it begins to boil. Cool. Add vanilla and nuts if you wish. Pour into greased pan.

title: Almond Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add salt and flour. Chill dough. Roll in 1-inch balls and roll balls in sugar. Stamp with cookie stamp. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks and sugar. Add remaining ingredients except egg whites and mix well. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter. Pour into 2 pie shells and bake at 300\u00b0 for 3/4 to 1 hour.

title: Tuna Mousse
instructions: Combine in a saucepan soup cream cheese and onion until the cheese melts. Mix gelatine in 1/2 cup of hot water and add to cheese mixture; blend. Add tuna celery and mayonnaise. Mix well; pour into jello mold (rub inside of mold lightly with oil). Chill until set. Serve with crackers.

title: Upside-Down Ham Loaf
instructions: Blend Crisco and sugar; spread over bottom of 8-inch skillet. Place pineapple on sugar. Combine ham eggs bread crumbs mustard onion and salt. Pack in skillet over sugar and pineapple. Cover and cook over very low heat for 25 to 30 minutes. Turn out on a large plate.

title: Cucumbers And Sour Cream(Agurkai Su Grietine)
instructions: Slice the onion and cucumber thinly. Mix remaining ingredients together and add to the cucumber and onion. Refrigerate at least 15 minutes before serving to blend the flavors.

title: Theresa'S Chili Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with potato masher. Add chili powder hot water tomatoes and your canned beans. Cook between low and medium heat for less than 30 minutes.

title: Raspberry Butter
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat all ingredients until well blended and smooth. Store in a covered container in the refrigerator. Bring to room temperature before serving. Yield about 1/2 cup.

title: *Fresh Cranberry Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; stir to dissolve. Add the cold water and allow to jell partially. Put cranberries and orange through a food chopper. Add sugar and mix well. When jello is partially set fold in the cranberry and orange mixture pineapple and pecans. Pour into a large mold and refrigerate. Serves 20.

title: Fudge
instructions: Bring to a rolling boil and boil 6 minutes stirring constantly evaporated milk and sugar.

title: Prego Miracle Lasagne(Preparation:  5 Minutes.  Cook:  1 Hour.  Stand:  5 Minutes)
instructions: In 2-quart baking dish (11 x 7-inch) spread 1 cup sauce. Top with 3 dry noodles Ricotta cheese 1 cup Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese and 1 cup sauce. Top with remaining dry noodles and sauce; cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Let stand 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup of boiling water. Cool. Add applesauce and thawed raspberries. Refrigerate.

title: File Kombo Choctaw(Modern)
instructions: Chop onion and tomato. Slice okra. Boil water; season chicken with salt and cayenne and brown. Remove chicken and add flour to broth; add onions and brown. Add tomato and cook a few minutes. Add water ham hocks chicken (cut up) and bay leaf. Simmer until tender. Add crayfish and okra and bring to a boil for 10 minutes. Stir in file. Serve with rice.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Crust Mix oleo flour pecans and sugar. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Cinnamon Nut Crescents(Makes 8)
instructions: Combine brown sugar walnuts butter and cinnamon in a small bowl. Unroll dough onto work surface and divide into crescents. Divide brown sugar mixture onto wide ends of crescent spreading to within 1-inch of the point. Starting with wide end of each crescent roll up loosely and shape into crescent. Place 1-inch apart on baking sheet. Bake rolls until golden 15 to 20 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes on wire rack. Combine confectioners sugar and water and drizzle over warm rolls.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Empty all cans into boiler including all juices. Heat a few minutes and serve.

title: Cabbage And Bacon
instructions: Dice the bacon; cook in a skillet until golden brown and crisp. Spoon the bacon from the fat. Add the chopped cabbage to the bacon fat; reduce the heat and toss the cabbage until just tender about 10 minutes. Add lemon juice and seasonings to taste. Turn into a warm serving dish. Garnish with bacon.

title: Vanilla Butter Frosting
instructions: Mix powdered sugar and margarine. Stir in vanilla and milk gradually; beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Ravioli And Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine margarine dill and beans. Fold in ravioli gently. Spoon mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spread Swiss cheese with mustard. Place mustard side down on ravioli mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves four to six.

title: Fudge
instructions: Put all ingredients in boiler; stir until comes to a boil (on medium heat). Stir and let boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat; beat 8 to 10 minutes. Pour onto buttered dish.

title: Orange Slice Cake(From The Files Of Dessie Bell Hayes)
instructions: Make cake batter with first 8 ingredients. Cut candies in pieces and dredge in 1 cup flour (this is extra flour 4 cups in all). Combine two mixtures and add nuts; mix in hands. Cover bottom of pan with 2 thicknesses of brown paper greased and floured. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Blend the shortening and sugar until creamy. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to the shortening mixture. Blend well; add mashed bananas lemon juice and nuts. Bake in well-greased No. 2 tin can (large size). Fill cans 1/2 full. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 50 minutes. Do not try to cut until cool.

title: Barley Hot Dish
instructions: Saute beef onion and celery. Add rest of ingredients except water. Bring to boil; add water as needed. Barley expands and absorbs water as it cooks. Turn into shallow large roasting pan (4-quart). Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour or longer until barley is tender. Check and stir occasionally adding water as needed.

title: Catalina Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients in glass baking dish and place chicken in mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Potato Supreme
instructions: Cook unpeeled potatoes in boiling salted water until tender (do not overcook). Drain and refrigerate covered overnight.

title: Blueberry Salad No. 1
instructions: Drain blueberries; using this liquid add enough water to make 2 cups liquid. Bring to a boil. Add jello mixing well. Add 1 1/2 cups cold water pineapple with juice and blueberries. Pour into mold and congeal until firm. Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese beating until smooth. Spread on top of jello mixture.

title: Banana Flip
instructions: Place bananas in blender and puree. Add milk cream maple syrup rum and lime juice. Continue blending until well mixed and frothy. Pour into tall stemmed glasses and decorate with orange slices. Serves 4.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Peel dice and cook potatoes until tender. Drain off excess water. Add diced eggs salt pepper mayonnaise mustard and onions if desired. Mix well. Potato salad can be served hot but is just as good served cold.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Soak strips of deer meat 2 hours. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Turn oven to warm and put strips of meat on cheesecloth in oven for 6 hours or longer.

title: Best Ever Play Dough
instructions: They keep longer if you store them in the refrigerator in paper bags. Do not remove the outside leaves until ready to use.

title: Mix Ahead Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni drain and add remaining ingredients to macaroni; mix well. Spoon into lightly greased 3-quart baking dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight or several hours. Remove from refrigerator and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Mix Bisquick and water; beat 20 strokes. Turn onto floured surface; knead 60 times or until not sticky. Press in pan; pinch edge.

title: Quick Microwave Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Arrange peppers in microproof pie plate. Combine remaining ingredients except tomato sauce and cheese; blend well. Stuff meat mixture in peppers. Pour tomato sauce over peppers. Cover with plastic wrap; cook on High 18 to 20 minutes or until peppers are tender and beef is done. Remove plastic wrap; top each pepper with cheese. Return plastic wrap. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Crispy Caramel Popcorn And Nuts
instructions: In large shallow baking pan stir together popcorn walnuts pecans and peanuts. Set aside. In heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan stir together brown sugar margarine corn syrup and salt. Stir constantly bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat stir in vanilla. Pour over popcorn mixture stirring to coat well. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Cool stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Store in tightly covered container. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients and form into a ball. Chill before serving.

title: Chicago Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Using frozen bread dough let dough thaw and rise until almost double in size. Punch down and shape into a ball. Place in a well-greased 12-inch cast-iron skillet. Do not grease the top half of pan. With greased fingertips smooth the dough around the bottom and up the sides of the pan. Spoon pizza sauce on the dough. Layer toppings. Cover with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cut and serve.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Beat together Miracle Whip and water. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add vanilla and beat. Bake at 350 degrees.

title: Mixed Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Pineapple Fluff
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan put the cracker crumbs. Dissolve the marshmallows in the milk on low heat. Let cool then add to the pineapple and Cool Whip. Pour over the graham cracker crumbs sprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Let cool.

title: Philadelphia Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Let all items set at room temperature. In bowl mix cheese and eggs; in different bowl mix milk and fruit (drain fruit). Combine mixtures then put the juice from the two lemons. Brown pie crust to your liking; let cool and pour filling in. Let set in icebox 6 to 7 hours then serve.

title: Crescent Bake
instructions: Brown burger in frying pan then add the sloppy joe mix tomato sauce oregano salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 min. Cover the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with 1 pkg. of the crescent rolls. Put meat mixture over the top. Sprinkle with the 2 cheeses. Top this with the other package of crescent rolls (I roll mine between 2 pieces of waxed paper). Bake at 350 degrees for 25 min. uncovered.

title: My Sig Chili
instructions: Brown meat quickly in olive oil. Transfer meat to bowl. Saute onion green pepper and garlic in same pan. Stir in beef tomatoes and spices. Heat to boiling. Stir occasionally. Reduce heat cover add 1/4 cup water and cook 2 hours stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook 45 minutes longer. Stir in beans and heat about 5 minutes. Put in bowls; sprinkle with cheese and Fritos.

title: Chicken In A Bag
instructions: Put flour in bag and shake. Place bag in 9x13 or larger pan. Season chicken with spices and place in bag. Throw in the vegetables. Mix the soups together add a little milk 1/4 cup if desired and pour over chicken. Tie bag and cut 5 or 6 slits in the top of the bag. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Fruit Mixture
instructions: Mix fruit all together and let chill. Serve on cake or ice cream.

title: Katie'S Jam Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and oats until crumbly. Press 1/2 of mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix jam with water and spread on top of first layer. Press second 1/2 of mixture on top of jam layer. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
instructions: Saute onion in butter in large heavy saucepan until tender. Add cabbage; cook and stir until softened. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer about 1 1/4 hours or until very tender. Makes about 4 1/2 cups or 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Meringue Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil and set aside.

title: House Dedication Punch
instructions: Make up the powdered drinks and the lemonade according to directions except scant the water slightly (to compensate for melting ice). Combine all of the ingredients. Some of the punch may be frozen in ring molds to be used in the punch bowl.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix margarine and graham cracker crumbs. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan or dish. Mix eggs margarine and powdered sugar. Let stand for 10 minutes. Smooth over graham cracker crust. Slice bananas on top. Add pineapple by sprinkling over bananas. Spread Cool Whip on top.

title: Shrimp Basilico
instructions: Heat oil in saut pan over medium heat. Add shrimp then add garlic; saut 10 seconds. Add basil and wine; cook until almost all wine has evaporated. Add cream; cook until liquid is reduced by half. Add lemon juice. Turn heat very low. Add butter. Cook until butter melts; do not let boil. Add salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with basil leaves. Serve with pasta or a good bread to soak up the sauce. Yield 4 servings.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order listed. Bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done.

title: *Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar milk and butter together for 6 minutes. Add chocolate chips and Marshmallow Creme. Beat until streaks of Marshmallow Creme no longer show. Pour into buttered pan. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Festive Fruitcake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Set aside. Combine eggs and water. Add all ingredients except corn syrup. Pour into tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 75 to 80 minutes. Cool for 30 minutes. Glaze with warm corn syrup. Will make 3 small loaves. Bake for 75 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk; set aside. Cream sugar butter and eggs together. Break nuts up cut candy and dates up and mix with 1 cup flour. Add this to sugar butter and egg mixture. Add buttermilk and remaining flour. Cook in slow oven 325\u00b0 in angel food cake pan for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Panned Broccoli
instructions: Wash broccoli and trim. Peel stems and cut into 2-inch lengths. Separate florets by cutting halves or quarters so they are of uniform size. Blanch (parboil about 10 minutes for stems less for florets). Plunge into cold water for about 3 minutes to set the color and texture. Saute onion and garlic in oil. Add drained broccoli and cook gently until tender-crisp. This will take only a few minutes. Season with pepper and lemon juice. Serve at once.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Thaw spinach and drain well. Add celery onion and chopped eggs to spinach. In smaller bowl put mayonnaise horseradish vinegar Tabasco sauce and salt. Mix well. Pour over spinach mixture. Add cheese and mix well. Best if made day before using.

title: Nutjammer Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Sift flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture. Chill dough 2 to 3 hours.

title: Krispie Jumbes
instructions: Mix everything together except Rice Krispies. Just stir Rice Krispies through the mixture. Drop by spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 13 minutes until golden brown. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Forgotten Beef Stew(A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.)
instructions: Put meat in baking dish and spread with onions then rest of vegetables. Blend salt sugar and tapioca. Spread over ingredients in pan. Pour liquid over all. Cover pan with foil. Crimp to seal. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 hours. Do not peek!

title: Turkey Steaks In Wine
instructions: Place each turkey steak between sheets of waxed paper and pound with meat mallet until about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired. Use a heavy skillet large enough to hold all turkey slices in one layer or use 2 skillets. Heat the olive oil and 1 tablespoon of the margarine. Add turkey garlic bay leaf and thyme. Cook over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes or until lightly browned on both sides. Do not overcook. Remove turkey to serving platter and keep warm. Leave other ingredients in pan. Add the wine to pan and cook over high heat until reduced to half. Stir often to mix in the brown particles in skillet. Add the broth and boil until reduced by half. Stir in remaining margarine capers and chopped parsley. Add the turkey back to the skillet and reheat briefly. Remove bay leaf before serving. Yield 4 servings. Carbohydrate 2 g protein 35 g fat 24 g calories 379.

title: Jack'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mash and beat cooked potatoes until smooth and fluffy. Add margarine and sugar; then beat. Add eggs flavor and spices. If mixture is too dry add sweet milk. Bake in an uncooked pie crust at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until slightly brown.

title: Wilted Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Boil together oil sugar vinegar salt celery seed and dry mustard. Layer shredded cabbage and onion rings in bowl. Pour sugar over top. Combine other ingredients bring to a boil and pour over cabbage. Refrigerate overnight. Keeps well.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Put sugar over the apples; let stand for 20 minutes. Mix oil and egg; sift flour soda and salt and add to oil mixture. Add apples and nuts; mix well. Bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Rice With Baby Lima Beans
instructions: Cook rice baby lima beans and dill in water until rice is done.

title: Cajun Pasta
instructions: Brown onion pepper celery and carrot in olive oil. When soft and slightly browned add tomatoes and spices. Cook on low.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies in food processor. Mix cream cheese and oleo until smooth with mixer. Blend in powdered sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Mix pudding milk and vanilla; add to cream cheese mixture. Line a flowerpot with foil. Layer in pot; start and end with cookies. Cookies crumbled cake and cream cheese mixture. Stick silk flowers on top.

title: Honey Popcorn
instructions: Bring to a boil. Pour over a large bowl of popcorn and mix well.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients in large bowl. Add liquids to flour mixture and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms. Remove stems chop. Mix chopped stems with cheese bread crumbs onions garlic parsley salt pepper and oregano. Stuff mixture in mushroom caps. Pour a little olive oil onto a baking pan. Arrange the mushrooms in oil. Pour the remaining oil over mushrooms. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8 people. Prep time 10 to 15 minutes. Baking time 25 minutes.

title: Noodles Alfredo
instructions: The menu will serve approximately 100 people (along with coffee tea and punch).

title: Italian Casserole
instructions: Brown beef; drain fat. Add water tomatoes and spaghetti mix. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Put meat in bottom of pan. Spread sour cream over meat then sprinkle Mozzarella cheese evenly over top. Open crescent rolls and lay out over top of cheese. Sprinkle Parmesan on top of rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until rolls are brown usually 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Kraut Salad #2
instructions: Cut kraut with scissors. Stir in sugar and let stand 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Cover bowl tightly and chill at least 12 hours before serving. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken for 24 hours. Cook chicken on grill basting with marinade. M-mmm good!!!

title: Couscous Stir-Fry
instructions: About 30 minutes before serving cut each zucchini lengthwise into quarters then crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices. Dice red pepper. Cut each mushroom into quarters. In a 2-quart saucepan heat 2 1/4 cups water to boiling. Add couscous; cover and let stand 5 minutes. In a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat in 1 tablespoon hot salad oil cook zucchini and red pepper until tender stirring occasionally. Remove to a large bowl. In 1 more tablespoon hot salad oil cook the mushrooms until tender. Remove to same bowl. In 1 more tablespoon very hot salad oil scramble non-cholesterol egg substitute into nickel size pieces. Add couscous and vegetables to scrambled eggs. Stir in soy sauce. Spoon into bowl. Garnish with 2 tablespoons chopped green onion if you like. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Spareribs
instructions: Place ribs on rack in large shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile combine sugars and cornstarch in a medium saucepan. Stir in ketchup vinegar and water. Bring to a boil. Place ribs back in roasting pan. Pour about 1 1/2 cups of sauce over ribs. Bake 30 minutes. Cut ribs into serving size pieces. Brush with remaining sauce. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mock Boursin Au Poivre
instructions: Blend cream cheese with garlic caraway seed basil dill weed and chives. Pat into round flat shape using plastic wrap. Sprinkle all sides with lemon pepper. Chill.

title: Ice Cream Bombe
instructions: Soften 1 pint orange sherbet. Spoon into chilled 2-quart metal mold or bowl. Freeze until firm (at least 1 hour). Soften pistachio ice cream. Spread over layer of orange sherbet in mold. Freeze until firm. Repeat with chocolate ice cream and the remaining orange sherbet. Cover mold with waxed paper. Freeze until firm.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
instructions: Drain all but 1/4 cup liquid from beans. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over beans. Heat.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 (9-inch) layers.

title: Garlic Boneless Chicken
instructions: Bring two pots of water to boil for spaghetti and spinach. Cook spaghetti. Heat oil butter garlic onion and basil. Saute chicken while spaghetti is draining. Boil spinach for two minutes. Arrange spinach over spaghetti then pour chicken mixture on top. Add Parmesan. Ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Crunch Bars(Reduced Calorie)
instructions: Spray an 8 x 8-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. In a double boiler combine 4 ounces of the chocolate the margarine and corn syrup. Cook over hot water until melted and smooth. Add cereal; stir to coat. Press mixture into prepared pan; cover and refrigerate until firm. In top of double boiler melt remaining 4 ounces of chocolate; spread over cereal mixture. Cover and refrigerate until firm. Cut into 16 equal portions.

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 9 x 17-inch pan in the oven. Beat eggs; add milk flour salt and baking powder and mix well. Stir in spinach cheese and onions. Bake 35 minutes. Remove from oven. Let sit about 45 minutes. Cut into 90 small squares.

title: Cheese Twists
instructions: Empty pie crust mix into a large mixing bowl. Add cheese and mix in with a fork. Sprinkle water over one tablespoon at a time. Mix lightly with a fork just until mixture holds together and leaves sides of bowl clean. Roll out on lightly floured surface to 1/8-inch thickness. Cut rings with small doughnut cutter or 2 different sizes of round cutters. Cut remaining pastry into 1/2-inch wide strips about 6 inches long. Twist strips once or twice and place 1 inch apart on large cookie sheets. Bake in a hot oven (425\u00b0) for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove carefully and cool on wire rack. When cool thread 2 or 3 strips through each ring and arrange on serving dish. Makes about 3 dozen sticks and 12 rings.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Cook chicken remove from bones and dice into 1-inch cubes. Place in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook frozen broccoli drain and layer over the chicken. Add a layer of processed cheese slices. Mix soup and milk and pour over cheese. Mix stuffing according to package directions and spread on top of the chicken mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Barbecued Shrimp
instructions: Saute all ingredients. Simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with French bread.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into small balls. Broil until brown.

title: Deviled Biscuits
instructions: Cut biscuits into 1/4 and put in a baking dish. Mix deviled ham with melted butter and spread over biscuits. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese to cover top of mixture. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Bleu Cheese Mousse
instructions: Beat egg yolks with half and half in saucepan over low heat until mixture is creamy. Remove. Soften gelatin in 4 tablespoons of cold water then dissolve over hot water and add it to the eggs. Force Bleu cheese through a sieve; add to gelatin mixture and cool. Fold in whipped cream and egg whites. Pour mousse into oiled 6-cup mold and chill for at least 2 hours. Unmold on platter and serve with crackers or toast rounds.

title: Blueberry Buckle
instructions: Mix together sugar shortening and eggs. Add milk flour baking powder salt and blueberries. Pour into greased pan. Mix together 2 cups sugar 1 1/3 cups flour cinnamon and butter. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: Mix brownie mix as directed on package. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Cook until tested done. Remove from oven and cool completely. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients in food processor using the steel blade. Form into a ball and sprinkle with flour. Chill covered for at least 1 hour. Roll out into desired shape and put into pie pan or other dish. Bake for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0 then fill.

title: Stewed Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken; place in pot. Add boiling water to half cover the chicken. Add seasoning. Bring to boil at medium heat then turn to simmer or low heat. Cover and simmer about 2 hours. Cook noodles or dumplings in the chicken stock.

title: Light As Lead Pancakes
instructions: Mix the flour soda and cinnamon in a medium mixing bowl. Add apple juice and egg whites. Slowly add milk stirring briskly until batter is of a pourable consistency. Warm frying pan and lightly grease with canola oil. Drop batter by 1/8 cup onto pan. Cook on both sides. Top with fruit yogurt applesauce heated jam thinned with juice or maple syrup. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Tater Chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Scrub potatoes with a vegetable brush under cool running water. Pat dry with paper towel. Place the potatoes on a cutting board. Carefully slice each one very thin. Place the potato slices in a single layer on a large nonstick baking pan. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Add the topping of your choice for Sesame Chips or Italian-style Chips. When chips have cooled slightly carefully remove them from the pan with a spatula. Makes 2 servings. Calories 220; fat a trace; cholesterol 0 milligrams.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put bread slices in buttered 13 x 9-inch casserole and pour beaten eggs and milk over them. Layer the diced vegetables and chicken. Pour soup mixed with mayonnaise over top. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Put cheese on 10 minutes before finished.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Put mix and milk in bowl; add eggs. Then add corn cheese pepper and onion. Heat oil; add to mixture. Mix well. Pour in heated pan. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. (This freezes well.)

title: Lasagna(Microwave)
instructions: For one 9-inch quiche 6 to 8 servings you will need

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: Mix meat salt milk bread crumbs and 2 tablespoons onions. Form into balls. Place in uncovered baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients pour over meatballs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Cook sugar water butter and vinegar in large pot until amber in center. Do not stir! When sugar mixture is amber stir in corn and spread on flat pans to cool. Break in pieces.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Heat the milk in a double boiler until forms a skim (light). While the milk is heating beat the egg yolks well then add the sugar\tand flour which have been mixed well. When the milk is hot remove the skim. Add the egg and sugar mixture slowly stirring constantly. When this\thas cooked long enough to lightly coat the\tspoon\tit is\tdone. Add vanilla. (Optional you can add beaten egg whites into this.)

title: Hawaiian Spareribs
instructions: Trim excess fat from ribs and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange in baking pan. Cook for 45 minutes. Drain off 3/4 of the fat leaving ribs in pan. In a skillet heat butter and oil. Saute onion until golden about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Using garlic powder and cinnamon and more salt and pepper to taste brush mixture on ribs. Cover with oil and refrigerate. On serving day bake ribs uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for one hour turning occasionally.

title: Chili For A Crowd
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain and mash. Place in a large kettle or roaster. Mix remaining ingredients with hamburger and onion. Stir well. Cook on medium heat stirring occasionally until heated through. Makes 85 (1 cup) servings.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup soup bread crumbs onions and egg. Shape into 6 patties. In skillet over medium heat cook until brown. Spoon off fat. Stir in remaining soup and mushrooms. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 20 minutes until done turning patties occasionally.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla. Sift flour and cornstarch and add. Drop by spoon on greased cookie sheet or roll into balls and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Add flour soda and salt. Fold in pecans and apples. Pour in greased tube pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Peach Jello Salad
instructions: Put pineapple with juice water and sugar in a pan. Bring to boil. Remove from heat and add jello. In separate bowl beat cream cheese with milk then fold in Cool Whip. When jello mixture is halfway congealed gently fold in Cool Whip mixture. Pour into lightly greased jello mold. Can be frozen.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in plastic bag and shake well. Coat chicken well and fry in deep fat until well cooked. Especially good for a picnic.

title: Nancy'S Roast
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on high setting for 6 hours. Turn over during cooking.

title: Mexican Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef then drain grease. Mix together ground beef chili-hot beans kidney beans salsa salt pepper Cheez Whiz tomato juice and as much chili powder as desired. Cook for 45 minutes or until done to own desire.

title: Celestial Snow Cake
instructions: Lightly grease and flour three 8-inch cake pans; set aside. Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Blend until moistened; beat at medium-high speed for 4 minutes. Spread batter evenly in the three pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool completely on wire rack. Ice with Celestial Snow Cake Icing.

title: Pecan Cake With Praline Glaze
instructions: Combine raisins and bourbon stirring well. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour. Cream butter. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs 1 at a time beating after each addition. Combine dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix well after each addition. Fold in pecans and raisin mixture. Pour batter in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan ten minutes. Remove to wire rack and drizzle glaze over cake. Cool.

title: Good And Fast Chocolate Cake(Less Than 30 Minutes)
instructions: While cake is baking in same saucepan cake was mixed in melt oleo cocoa and milk. Heat until boiling and add powdered sugar pecans and salt. Mix. Pour over cake as soon as it comes out of oven. Cover.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa. Add milk and water gradually stirring well. Cook in double boiler stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Beat egg yolks. Add a little of the hot mixture into the eggs until all are stirred into hot mix. Cook until it is creamy. Remove from heat. Add vanilla; pour into baked pie shell. Make meringue and pile lightly on pie. Brown in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Frozen Cappuccino Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese with an electric mixer on medium speed until fluffy (about 3 minutes). Add condensed milk and chocolate syrup (4 tablespoons). Beat on low until well blended. In a separate bowl dissolve coffee powder in hot water. Stir into cream cheese mixture. Fold in whipped topping and pour into crust. Cover and freeze overnight.

title: Wonderful Salad And Dressing
instructions: Drain artichoke hearts reserving marinade. Cut into quarters. Drain mandarin oranges discarding juice. Tear lettuce into pieces. Toss lettuce orange sections and walnuts. Pour dressing over and toss to blend adding artichokes.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add pineapple with juice then add the blueberry pie filling. Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Alternate layers of potatoes and onions in casserole. Season as you go. Mix soup and milk; pour over potatoes. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 about an hour.

title: Green Tomato Pie
instructions: Dip tomatoes in boiling water for 20 to 30 seconds. Remove core and peel. Cut in 1/4-inch slices. Combine tomatoes and 1/4 cup water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 5 minutes. With slotted spoon remove tomato slices. Mix 1 cup sugar flour cinnamon peel nutmeg and salt. Add to liquid in saucepan. Cook and stir just until boiling. Remove from heat and add butter. Gently stir in tomato slices. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Figgy Nut Pie
instructions: Pick 3 quarts (leave some on bush for birds bees and other insects) of fresh figs. Remove stems and thick skin. Mash up a bit. Add sugar and lemon juice and allspice. Bring to a boil and cook until figs are transparent 7 minutes (stir constantly). Grease an 11 x 14-inch pan. Pull apart the layers of the biscuits put a layer of biscuits spoon fig mixture over biscuits make another layer of biscuits and another layer of figs. Add nuts on top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Fantastic Baked Chicken
instructions: Whirl stuffing mix in electric blender turn onto wax paper and mix with cheese. Add garlic to butter in small saucepan and melt. Dip chicken pieces in batter then in crumbs. Place 1/2-inch apart in baking dish. Add any excess butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until browned and done.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix first five ingredients well and pour into a greased baking dish. Mix sugar butter flour and pecans; sprinkle on top of the casserole. Cook 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Let sausage stand at room temperature in bowl for 2 hours. Add Bisquick; mix well. Mix in cheese. Shape into small balls and place on baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Remove to cool. Makes about 60.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger with chopped onion for flavor. Place potatoes in bottom of square casserole dish. Sprinkle hamburger over potatoes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Spoon can of soup over top of hamburger. Pour 1 can of water over all. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove and place cheese over top. Bake an additional 5 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Boil Cookies Or Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil your sugar cocoa milk and butter for 1 1/2 minutes. After it has come to a boil take off heat and add oats nuts peanut butter vanilla and salt. Mix together well and spread on wax paper. Let cool until the cookies are hard enough to pick up.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Mix 1/3 cup sugar and flour and cut in butter until crumbles. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onions in butter over medium heat until transparent. Add ground beef; cook stirring until it has lost red color. Add flour salt pepper mushrooms and soup; cook for 5 minutes. Blend in sour cream. Serve over spaghetti or egg noodles. Garnish with paprika.

title: Pam'S Cake
instructions: Beat all together for 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes in a greased Bundt or tube pan. Remove while still warm.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie (1)
instructions: Add milk to eggs. Mix together with sugar flour & nutmeg. Mix in rhubarb. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50-60 minutes.

title: San Juan Muffins
instructions: Mix cattail flowers or pollen and flour baking powder and salt. Beat eggs; add oil honey and milk. Stir into dry ingredients just enough to combine the two. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until tested done.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Add oil water eggs and pumpkin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Aunt Serena'S Homemade Rolls
instructions: Make up like biscuits; leave in bowl. Let rise pretty big the first time then make out and let rise in pan a second time. Bake.

title: Strawberry Brownie Cheesecake
instructions: Put chocolate and butter in a large bowl; microwave on High for 2 minutes or until butter is melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted.

title: Robin'S Honey Moon Cake
instructions: Bake cake. Bring pineapple and sugar to boil. Pour vanilla over pineapple and sugar after cake cools. Mix Cool Whip and sour cream and put over cake. Cover with nuts and coconut. Top with cherries.

title: Polly'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix sugar and flour together. Mix in eggs then milk and butter. Heat this mixture until thick (stir constantly). Remove from heat and add vanilla. Let mixture cool then pour over layered bananas and vanilla wafers.

title: Non-Alcoholic Cocktail
instructions: Freeze ingredients until ready to use. Serve with ginger ale in cocktail glass.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix mayo milk and lemon juice in medium bowl. Stir in apples celery and nuts. Serve alone or over salad greens. Can add cooked chicken chunks or strips for heartier meal.

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 18 muffin cups with paper baking cups. In a small bowl mix cream cheese egg and 1/2 cup sugar. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and set aside. In large bowl mix flour 1 cup sugar and cocoa. Add water oil vinegar and vanilla. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Fill paper cups 1/2 full. Top each with 1 tablespoon cream cheese mixture and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until cream cheese is light golden brown. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan. Store in refrigerator.

title: Apple Nut Squares
instructions: Blend together eggs sugar and oil. Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon. Stir into egg mixture. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or a little longer. Cool and cut in squares and sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: In skillet over medium heat cook beef until browned stirring to separate meat. Drain off fat.

title: Kraut Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover and refrigerate 8 hours. Serve with hot dogs vegetables or meats. Yields 1 quart.

title: Herbed Beer Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar grated cheese and dried herbs. Mix well. Stir in beer and make stiff batter. Grease pan and sprinkle with cornmeal. Turn into pan (round or loaf). Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 65 minutes. Brush with melted butter. Turn out to cool on rack.

title: Hawaiian Casserole(Sweet And Sour Pork)
instructions: Cut pork in 3/4 inch cubes. Brown slightly in oil and sprinkle with soy sauce. Place meat in 2-quart casserole. Drain pineapple saving syrup. Add pineapple to meat. Add pineapple syrup and vinegar to skillet and heat. Mix sugar cornstarch and water and add to hot liquid and cook stirring until clear and slightly thickened. Pour over meat mixture. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Cook green pepper and onion in butter 3 to 4 minutes. Add to casserole and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage until done (10 to 15 minutes). In buttered casserole layer 1/2 cooked cabbage 1/2 cup cheese then 1/2 can cream of celery soup; repeat layers. Top with crumbled potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This is a good way to use leftover cabbage.

title: Oven Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Spray Pam Dry Fry on flat baking dish. Remove skin from chicken and place in baking pan. Do not overlap pieces. Mix all ingredients and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hour. If it gets too brown cover with foil.

title: Mexican Chocolate
instructions: Heat chocolate sugar coffee cinnamon nutmeg salt and water in 1 1/2-quart saucepan over low heat stirring constantly until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered stirring constantly (4 minutes). Stir in milk and heat through. Just before serving beat with hand beater until frothy. Top with whipped cream.

title: Jewel'S Poke Cake
instructions: Bake the chocolate cake according to directions; cook in 13 x 9-inch pan. Immediately after baking make holes with a wooden spoon in cake. Then while still warm pour milk and caramel over cake. Let cool. Spread Cool Whip very thick on top of cake.

title: Swiss Steak With Vegetables
instructions: Early in the day cut steak into large pieces. Mix flour salt and pepper. Pound into steak. Brown steak in skillet in hot oil on both sides. Add onion and brown a bit more. Add soup and water. Simmer about 30 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Spicy Chicken Nachos
instructions: Combine cooked chicken water picante sauce pepper and chicken seasoning in a saucepan and heat thoroughly. Fry tortillas lightly and drain. Distribute equal portions of the chicken mixture on the fried tortillas and top with a slice of cheese. Place completed tortillas on a sheet pan and place pan on a high rack of oven broiler. Broil until cheese bubbles. Remove pan and using a pizza cutter or large knife cut each tortilla into fourths. Garnish each section with sour cream. Serves 2 to 3.

title: Biscuit Coffee Cake
instructions: Dip biscuits in melted butter or margarine then in mixture of sugar chopped pecans and cinnamon. Put biscuits in a 9-inch pie pan and bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 10 servings.

title: Blender Apple Pancakes
instructions: Place egg sugar butter apple and milk in a blender. Blend. Add pancake mix. Blend. Turn onto hot griddle.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix melted margarine with all other ingredients. Pour into a greased dish and top with cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0. Should be done when bubbly.

title: Black Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Do not cook. Marinate steak 24 hours in refrigerator and 4 to 6 hours at room temperature. Broil steak and baste with marinade. Leftover marinade can be frozen.

title: Barb'S Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix 1 stick of butter with graham crackers. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat 2 eggs 2 sticks of butter and 2 cups of powdered sugar for 15 minutes. Spread mixture over graham crust. Cover with sliced bananas. Spread pineapple over bananas. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Cream margarine. Gradually add sugar. Add frozen juice and crushed wafers. Add nuts and vanilla. Shape into small balls. Roll in coconut and chill.

title: Cheesy Potato Bake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except corn flakes and 1/2 cup butter. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix crushed corn flakes and butter together and sprinkle over top to cover. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: In a large salad bowl layer ingredients in order given. Do not mix. Cover bowl tightly. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Toss before serving.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Add 1/3 cup mix (or to taste) to 1 cup hot water.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown the pork chops in the oil. Salt and pepper to taste. Place pork chops in baking dish. Saute onions celery and pepper in the oil.

title: Chocolate Strudel Bar
instructions: Combine flour sugar and cocoa. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Reserve 2 cups. Press rest on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Add eggs and beat until smooth. Defrost corn in microwave. Add corn and milk to sugar and egg mixture. Mix well. Add margarine. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Dorito Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken in water until tender (2/3 hour). Cool and remove from bone (can use boneless). Tear into pieces. Cook noodles in this water as directed on package. Drain. Combine cheese Ro-Tel soups and water in pan. Heat until melted. Layer noodles in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken over noodles. Place onion over chicken then crushed Doritos over onion. Pour cheese mixture over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Mix all together and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Crab And Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into a shallow baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Mincemeat Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour salt and soda. Cream shortening; add sugar. Cream together until fluffy. Add eggs; beat until smooth. Add mincemeat broken into small pieces. Add flour and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 12 minutes.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Sprinkle blueberries in pie crust. Mix the sugar eggs melted margarine flour and vanilla. Pour over the berries. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Chili
instructions: Saute onion and meat in oil until brown. Add remaining ingredients and simmer about 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine ground beef potatoes onion and water. Bring to a boil and simmer until potatoes are tender. Add canned vegetables except for creamed corn; heat until hot. Stir in creamed corn when ready to serve.

title: Pineapple Angel Food Cake
instructions: In saucepan over medium heat mix the pineapple with juice and the dry Jell-O; stir until it comes to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes; pour into a pan. Refrigerate until Jell-O is set enough to hold shape. When set stir in Cool Whip and spread on cooled cake. Keep refrigerated.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Fry meat with onion; add tomato sauce and spices. Let simmer 15 minutes. Let shells sit out 30 minutes. Roll sliced cheese up in shells. Lay in cake pan. Spread meat sauce over shells and lay cheese slices on top. Bake about 10 minutes or until cheese melts at 350\u00b0.

title: Mint Tea
instructions: Make tea base with water and tea bags. Dissolve sugar in tea; add mint. Mix orange juice and lemonade according to directions on can. Add to tea.

title: Fresh Orange Chiffon Cake
instructions: Sift flour. Measure lightly into cup; then sift again with sugar salt and baking powder. Make a well in center and slowly add oil blending well. Add yolks one at a time stirring until well mixed. Add orange juice and peel and beat with a spoon until mixture is smooth. Beat whites with cream of tartar until stiff. Pour yolk mixture into beaten whites and gently blend together. Bake in ungreased 9-inch tube pan in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes. Frost with Orange Cream Icing.

title: Hobo Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger until all is brown. Drain off grease. Put in chopped onion. Put in pork and beans. Simmer for about 15 minutes. Sprinkle in black pepper and salt to taste. Sprinkle in garlic salt just enough to give it the right taste. Ready to eat after you let it cool down.

title: Butterscotch Pecan Squares
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chips and milk. Mix rest of ingredients except nuts. Press 3/4 mixture in pan pour melted chips and milk on top. Crumble rest of topping and nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Reuben Meat Loaf
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine beef bread crumbs eggs onion pickle relish Russian dressing Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Mix with wooden spoon to blend. On a sheet of foil shape mixture into a 7 x 14-inch rectangle. Evenly layer corned beef sauerkraut and cheese over meat leaving 1-inch border around edges. Starting at short end roll up meat in jelly roll fashion sealing ends and using foil to help lift. Place seam side down in a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Double Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Combine flour soda and salt. Set aside. In pan melt butter. Add sugar and water just to a boil. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup of chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour. Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts. Spread into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool completely before cutting.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Mix ingredients together. Toss salad and add dressing and crushed Doritos just before serving.

title: Easy Haystacks
instructions: Melt the butterscotch morsels in double boiler being careful not to let water boil. Add nuts and noodles. Mix and drop on wax paper to cool. Enjoy!

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spread 1 side of each slice of bread with the combined Parkay spread and garlic salt.

title: Fast Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Luscious Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the sour cream and cook until thick. Cover and cool. Fold in sour cream; pour into prepared pie shell (9-inch) of your choice and chill for at least 2 hours. Top with whipped cream if desired or meringue.

title: Raspberry Yogurt Mold
instructions: Stir over low heat until the first 3 ingredients are well dissolved. Stir in lemon juice. Cool to room temperature. Stir yogurt into the cool jello mixture. Pour into a 6 cup mold. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ground beef. Mix well. Add ground beef lightly. Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour. Drain. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Ground Beef Grand-Style
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Drain. Combine softened cream cheese soup and milk. Add salt and catsup. Add to meat. Place in a 2-quart casserole and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Place biscuits on top and bake until biscuits are golden brown (about 15 to 20 minutes).

title: 3 Layer Cherry Pie
instructions: 1st layer Mix flour nuts and oleo. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cook till golden brown. Cool.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2 5/8-inch pan at 400\u00b0 until light brown on top.

title: Heavenly Fruit Dip
instructions: *May use frozen whipped topping thawed.

title: Turkey Ball
instructions: In big mixing bowl combine ingredients and mix well. Form into ball. Refrigerate. Serve with crackers or bread round pumpernickel or rye.

title: Chicken-Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Mix mushrooms bread crumbs chicken broth milk egg wine onion salt and pepper. Put into an ungreased 1-quart casserole. Cook uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven about 1 hour. Serve with Mushroom Sauce.

title: Anchor Steam Chili
instructions: Sweat onions until clear. Add beans and tomato paste. Cook until beans are done then add dried tomatoes. Mix beef with seasonings and cook until crumbled and brown and drain all grease. Add this mixture to beans then add all Porter and beer and cook 5 minutes.

title: 4 Layer Delight
instructions: Mix and pat into greased 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until light brown. Cool.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Lightly grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch sheet pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour sugar cocoa soda and salt in a large bowl.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: 1st Layer Green beans on bottom salt and pepper soup on top and onion rings.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
instructions: Cream sugar and vanilla. Roll 1 package crescent rolls into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour cream cheese mixture over top then roll other crescent rolls over top of cream cheese mix. Tuck in sides. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon over top. Drizzle melted butter over cinnamon and sugar. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fig Jam
instructions: Combine water and thinly sliced lemon; boil for 5 minutes. Add sugar and dissolve well. Add figs. Let come to a boil. Turn down and simmer for 45 minutes or more.

title: Georgette'S Swiss Fudge
instructions: Melt Chocolates and Oil in double boiler. Stir in Nuts. Pour in 9 x 9 inch waxpaper lined pan. Dont refrigerate. Cut when cool.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Remove stem ends and seeds from peppers. Saute onion in butter; add meat and brown. Mix in rice salt and pepper and one can tomato sauce. Fill peppers and arrange in baking dish. Combine sour cream the remaining can of tomato sauce and the sherry and pour over peppers. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and bake another 15 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Light And Easy Biscuits
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Use pastry blender to blend in Crisco. Add milk. Mix well. Roll on floured board about 1/2-inch thick. Cut out and bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Makes 10 to 12 according to cutter size.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook beef onion and garlic until meat is browned and onion is tender. Drain off excess fat. Mix tomatoes and tomato sauce in blender and add to meat mixture. Stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons parsley flakes the sugar and 1 teaspoon salt. Simmer uncovered 1 hour or until mixture is as thick as spaghetti sauce.

title: Chewy Date Balls
instructions: Melt margarine and butter. Add light brown sugar dark brown sugar and dates. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until dates melt (about 6 minutes). Remove from heat; add Rice Krispies and pecans; mix well. When cool roll into balls and then roll balls in powdered sugar. Makes about 214.

title: Fresh  Cabbage & Cheese Casserole
instructions: Coarsely slice cabbage Steam in small amount of water for about 10 minutes. Drain well.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Roll out dough. Mix the egg yolk parsley oregano pepper olive oil garlic and parmesan cheese in a 2 quart bowl using a whisk. Spread over the rolled out dough. sprinkle the cheese and your favorite toppings on top and then roll like a jelly roll with the seam side down. Brush with the egg white and bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes. Serve with warm pizza sauce. Enjoy...

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute bacon until brown and crisp. Add onions and potatoes and saute for few minutes. Sprinkle with flour. Add clam juice. Bring to boil about 15 minutes. Add half and half with salt and pepper. Add minced clams. Do not boil. Sprinkle with bacon. Serve immediately.

title: Classic Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine oil egg and milk. Stir dry ingredients together; add milk mixture and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan or 9-inch round pan. Sprinkle topping over batter. Serve warm.

title: Karan'S Karmel Apple Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese in the microwave and mix in brown sugar caramel flavoring and the vanilla. Serve with sliced apples.

title: Dieter'S Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Chop the egg. Mix together with onion green pepper salad dressing and imitation bacon bits. Spread on reduced-calorie bread. Add layer of lettuce and tomato.

title: Veal A La Celia
instructions: In a saucepan dissolve beef bouillon granules in boiling water. Add wine. Saute mushrooms in 1 to 2 tablespoons of margarine. Add mushrooms to bouillon mixture. Brown veal cutlets in remaining margarine on both sides. Drain on paper towel. Return veal cutlets to skillet. Dissolve cornstarch in warm water then add to mushroom sauce. Heat and stir and allow to thicken slightly. Pour over veal.

title: Almond And Hazelnut Chocolate Crescents
instructions: In medium bowl combine flour nuts and cocoa. In mixer bowl cream butter. Gradually add sugar; beat until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in the dry ingredients until well combined. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pinch off walnut-sized pieces of dough and shape into crescents. Place on 2 ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 15 to 17 minutes. Cool on wire racks. Dip half of each cookie into melted chocolate. Let chocolate set at least 1 hour. Sprinkle remaining half with confectioners sugar. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken. Dip in egg. Coat with corn flakes. Place in foil-lined 9 x 13-inch pan. Dot with butter. Sprinkle cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli. Put in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Add a layer of diced chicken. Add the soups and grated cheese. Top with bread crumbs; pour some melted oleo over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Strips(Serve Over Rice Or Noodles.)
instructions: In a large skillet brown the meat in oil stirring frequently. Cut meat into finger strips. Add tomato sauce and lemon-pepper seasoning to taste. Bring to a gentle boil; reduce heat and simmer about 5 to 10 minutes. Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Impossible Bacon Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Sprinkle bacon in plate. Beat milk Bisquick eggs salt and pepper together and pour over bacon. Bake until golden brown 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes and cut. Serves 6.

title: Italian Rum Cake
instructions: Wheres the rum! Lace each layer with rum.

title: Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Beat the cream cheese and oleo until smooth. Add vanilla and sugar. Mix. Spread on cake. Sprinkle top and sides with pecans.

title: Quick Fudge
instructions: Blend sugar and cocoa into mixing bowl. Place milk and margarine into bowl. Do not mix the milk and margarine. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir to mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir until blended. Pour into greased container. Place in freezer for 20 minutes or in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Cut and serve.

title: Cranberry Pecan Stuffing
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot margarine cook celery and onion until tender. Add broth. Heat to boiling. Remove from heat. Add stuffing cranberries and nuts. Toss to mix well. Use to stuff turkey following directions on turkey package. Serve with gravy. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: Mix and put in ice cream freezer.

title: Easy Quiche
instructions: In blender mix the first 6 ingredients. Pour into buttered 10-inch pie dish. Add cheese and meat and press below egg-milk mixture. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let stand 10 minutes before serving (or microwave 12 minutes and let set 5 minutes).

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients adding cornbread mix\tlast. Place in well-greased pan 9 x 13 x 2-inch.\tBake 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef in a large pan. Drain off grease. Add onions and some water. Simmer until onion is tender. Add flour; stir well. Add beans salt chili powder tomatoes and tomato sauce. Simmer 1 1/2 hours on low heat.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugars and beat well. Add eggs one at a time and beat again.

title: Black Bean And Rice Salad(Cursillo Recipe - Serves 60)
instructions: Mix together through cilantro. The remaining ingredients make up the dressing. Mix dressing together then pour over rice and bean mixture. Be careful not to break down rice. Mix well. Serve cold.

title: Becky'S Best Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all of the above together; stir well. Pour into a lightly greased 2 1/2-quart casserole or a 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Top with more grated Cheddar cheese and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 50 minutes. This freezes well.

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Lightly grease a casserole. Mix first 6 ingredients and place chicken on top. Sprinkle chicken with onion mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours covered with foil (secret dont peek).

title: Wacky Chocolate Cake(Sugar Free)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Take chocolate and melt. I put them in a glass or cup and put this in a dish of water and put them in the microwave for about 4 minutes. After you have the first 8 items mixed add the melted chocolate and apple cider vinegar. Bake approximately 25 minutes.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil. Crush the tomatoes by hand and add with juice to broth. Add cumin garlic salt pepper corn and cheese.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Mix well. Chill overnight. Do not grease pans. Roll in balls and dip in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes.

title: Mom'S Italian Zucchini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Slice zucchini thinly. Place a layer of zucchini in a shallow baking dish. Cover with 1/3 of the onion 1/3 of the cheese sprinkle with salt and oregano. Make 3 layers. Pour tomato sauce over the vegetables. Bake 45 minutes covered with foil. Remove the foil; sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese and bake 10 minutes longer. Serves 4.

title: Old Fashioned Corn Bread
instructions: Mix meal flour salt Crisco and buttermilk. Mix well and put in baking dish. Cook on 450\u00b0 until turns brown.

title: Salmon Pate
instructions: Blend salmon and cream cheese with lemon juice onion salt and horseradish until smooth. Mix in nutmeats. Mold in a small bowl lined with plastic wrap. Chill for several hours or overnight. Remove from bowl; carefully remove plastic wrap and roll in parsley. Serve with thinly sliced rye bread or crisp crackers.

title: No Bake Rum Balls
instructions: Melt chocolate chips. Add Karo syrup and sugar until mixed well. Add remaining ingredients together. Form into small balls. Place on lined cookie sheet with wax paper. Refrigerate for 12 hours or more. Store in airtight container.

title: Turkey Pitas
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together let marinate overnight. Brown meat drain off fat. Add cumin and garlic. Stir in cheese just before serving (hot or cold). Cut 8 pita pockets in half. Put equal amount of each mixture.

title: Ham Salad
instructions: Combine the ham with celery onion and pickle or relish with mustard mayonnaise. Heap on a bed of lettuce surround with hard-cooked eggs and garnish with chopped parsley. Serves 6.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook in large pot until vegetables are tender. Salt to taste.

title: Broccoli & Rice Casserole
instructions: 1. Saute onion in margarine. Cook broccoli for 7-8 minutes 2. Cook broccoli as directed on package. 3. Combine everything together and put in dish sprayed with pam. 4. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Hettie Pruitt'S Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Mix with remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole dish; top with marshmallows. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Indian Pudding
instructions: Combine the corn meal with the scalded milk. Add the sugar butter and salt. Let the mixture cool then add the lemon rind ginger raisins and eggs. Bake in a buttered 3-quart casserole set in water for 2 hours in a slow oven (300\u00b0). Very good!!

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut off tops of peppers. Remove seeds and membranes. In a large bowl combine beef rice onion celery pimento garlic salt and pepper. Fill peppers with meat mixture. Arrange in 3-quart casserole with one pepper in the center of the dish. Combine soup and basil; pour over peppers. Cover. Microwave on High (10) for 21 to 23 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over peppers. Let stand covered 5 minutes to melt cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Holiday Party Dip
