instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Cover and chill. Yields 2 1/2 cups.

title: Apple Pie Fritters
instructions: Heat oil (3 to 4-inches) in deep fryer or electric skillet to 375\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients except pie filling with electric mixer until smooth. Add pie filling. Mix on high speed for 1 to 2 minutes to break apples into chunks. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until deep golden brown about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or cinnamon and sugar mixture while still warm.

title: Crisp Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a shallow baking pan thoroughly blend all ingredients except potatoes. Add potatoes and turn to coat thoroughly. Bake stirring potatoes occasionally 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and flour thoroughly. Add Karo syrup pecans and vanilla. Stir and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Vegetable Soup
instructions: *They look like small green tomatoes with papery husks and sometimes can be found in supermarkets. Omit them if unavailable.

title: Good Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and beat with electric mixer until smooth. Add next 3 ingredients and mix. Pour into Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Remove from pan; wrap in foil. This can be baked in 3 layers and iced with cream cheese icing.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water 5 minutes and drain. Put in casserole and mix well with soups. Place sliced onion on top of broccoli mixture. Melt butter and mix with Stove Top dressing. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix together ingredients and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips and brown in a small amount of oil. Add broth onion celery and garlic. Simmer covered for 40 minutes. Add peppers mushrooms and tomatoes. Cook 10 more minutes. Mix soy sauce and cornstarch in 1 cup of water until smooth. Slowly stir this into the meat mixture stirring constantly until thickened. Serve over rice.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Butter a casserole dish. Mash squash and mix all ingredients together except bread crumbs. Put layer of crumbs in bottom of dish. Spoon mixture on bread crumbs and the rest of bread crumbs to top. Dot with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: The Ultimate Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients except pastry shell; mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0; continue baking 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean.

title: Cheesy Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Prick bottom and sides of crust with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3 minutes; prick gently with a fork. Bake 5 minutes longer. Cool.

title: Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers onions and peppers. Place in large crock. Sprinkle salt over vegetables and cover with water. Soak in crock overnight. Drain. Combine vinegar sugar celery seed turmeric powder mustard seed and spice in a large kettle. Bring to a boil. Put drained vegetables in syrup and cook 20 minutes. Pack into hot sterilized jars and seal.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ingredients thoroughly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sausage And Cheese Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Separate rolls into 2 large rectangles. Place in 13 x 9-inch pan (ungreased). Press over bottom and up sides (1/2 inch) to form crust. Seal perforations. Place sausage on crust; add bell pepper. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat milk eggs oregano salt black pepper and pour over cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Delicious Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute the margarine and the onion in a Dutch oven or other pot. Add water according to the amount of soup you want. Add bay leaves carrots potatoes and celery to your liking. Can add a generous amount of broccoli. Add cauliflower sugar chicken soup base Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. (Broccoli and cauliflower may be added after the other vegetables are a little tender.) Simmer soup until vegetables are done. Add milk mixed with a tablespoon of flour into soup. Bring to boil. Enjoy!

title: Four-Three-Two-One Cake
instructions: Beat egg yolks with 1 cup sugar. Beat shortening and other cup of sugar. Combine and add 1/2 cup flour. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add the milk and flour alternately. Then add the stiffly beaten egg whites. Makes 4 layers. Bake in greased and floured pans at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Blue Cheese And Olive Ball
instructions: Blend cheeses and butter. Stir in olives. Chill slightly. Form ball and roll in walnuts.

title: No Mix Bars
instructions: Spread in pan in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut after chilled.

title: Hot Virginia Dip
instructions: Combine first seven ingredients. Beat until smooth. Place in baking dish. Saute margarine and pecans for 1 to 2 minutes. Spread this mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or microwave on full power for 4 minutes. Its exceptionally good with bread sticks.

title: Buttermilk Dip
instructions: Combine yogurt and dressing mix. Cover. Chill before serving. Serve with Vegetable Dunkers.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening and eggs. Add vanilla wafers flour and baking powder. Add milk. Add coconut and nuts. Bake in loaf pan 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Two-Step Salsa Chili
instructions: Heat oil in a Dutch oven or large pot over medium heat until hot. Brown beef in batches. Return beef and accumulated juices to Dutch oven. Stir in tomatoes broth garlic salsa chili powder and oregano. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low. Cover tightly and simmer 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours until beef is tender. Serve with sour cream and green onions if desired.

title: Crusty Baked Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces; wash and trim excess fat. Pat dry. Beat egg and milk together in bowl. In separate bowl combine potato flakes garlic salt paprika poultry seasoning and cheese.

title: Ma Bea'S Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat liquid ingredients together then add the dry ingredients. You can add chopped nuts chopped dates or raisins. This makes one large loaf or 3 small ones. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Jiffy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Mix together milk sugar and flour. Pour into buttered pan. Sweeten peaches if needed and pour over other ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 until dough rises to top and browns.

title: Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in muffin cups in wells. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Crock-Pot Potatoes
instructions: Mix potatoes soup milk and 1/2 of the onions. Pour into greased crock-pot. Cook on low for 8 to 9 hours. (Recipe can be cut in half with some cooking time.) Pour remaining onions on top before serving.

title: Best Baked Beans
instructions: Thoroughly drain off beans in strainer. Mix with all other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Make cake according to box directions. Melt the brown sugar and butter in the 9 x 13-inch baking pan on the stove then sprinkle the drained pineapple in the pan. Add as many cherries as you wish then pour the mix in the pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until the top pops up when pressed. Remove from oven run a knife along the edges and turn the pan upside down on a long tray. Let cool and enjoy!

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling water until tender; drain thoroughly. In large skillet fry onion in 5 tablespoons margarine until tender. Add soup and mix well. Add cheese; heat and stir in cabbage salt and pepper. Transfer to 2-quart baking dish. In small skillet melt remaining margarine. Cook and stir in crumbs until lightly browned. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Danish
instructions: Spread 1 package crescent rolls in 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine cream cheese sugar egg yolk and vanilla. Spread on top cover with second can of rolls. Beat egg white slightly with fork and spread over dough to seal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crunchy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the cheese and potato chips in a large bowl. Pile lightly into buttered casserole. Sprinkle with cheese and potato chips. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Do not overcook. Dish should be crunchy.

title: Fastnacht
instructions: Add vinegar to hot fat. Fry donuts in lard.

title: Potato Delight
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins. Peel and dice up. Melt 4 Tbsp. butter and add cheese until softened. Blend in sour cream. Fold in potatoes and spoon into greased 2-quart casserole. Dot with 2 Tbsp. butter. Cover.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes wash and cut into quarter pieces. Boil potatoes for about 15 to 20 minutes and drain. Put potatoes in a 10 x 13 pan. Pour melted butter over potatoes. Melt the Cheese Whiz and pour that over the potatoes. Sprinkle bacon over the potatoes. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Eat with sour cream.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and butter well. Add eggs vanilla and pecans. Pour in 9-inch pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Reduce to 350\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. When done and still hot pour miniature marshmallows over cake and serve.

title: Virginia'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Put vinegar sugar oil salt and celery seed in saucepan; boil until sugar dissolves. Pour over vegetables while liquid is hot.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Mix together flour brown sugar margarine and nuts. Cook 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake in two layers per directions on box. Cool; split in\tlayers\t(I use long butcher knife). Mix remaining ingredients. Spread each layer with frosting stacking one at a time. This icing is runny but it soaks in. Put immediately in refrigerator. Let set 2 days. Can be frozen after 2 days too.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Prepare the noodles according to the instructions on the package. Combine the remaining ingredients and add to the noodles. Pour the mixture into a well-greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top the casserole with 1/2 cup crumbled potato chips or corn flakes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until the casserole is bubbly hot.

title: Lima Bean Dish
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add other ingredients and simmer until butter and sour cream blend. Place in a casserole and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar and mix well. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and mix thoroughly. Add chocolate chips and pecans. Bake in sheet pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Quick Minestrone Soup(Low-Fat)
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat combine all ingredients except cheese. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until very crisp-tender. Stir occasionally. Top each serving with 1 tablespoon of Parmesan cheese. Yields 6 (1 1/3 cup) servings.

title: Pear Bread
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Combine dry ingredients. Add alternately dry mixture and yogurt to egg mixture. Stir in pears and vanilla. Pour into buttered 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter sugars vanilla and pudding. Mix. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs then stir in chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Grits Souffle
instructions: Boil water and add salt sugar and grits. Cook 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add butter eggs garlic cheese and Tabasco and stir. Pour in 2 1/2-quart casserole; sprinkle with bread crumbs and paprika. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Split the eggplant lengthwise and hollow leaving a 1-inch thickness with skin intact. Saute garlic and onions in oil; then add pieces of eggplant and mushrooms and cook until tender. Stir in bread crumbs and blend in marinara sauce. Fill the eggplant with this mixture; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with pasta and a healthy smile.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into oblong baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown about 45 minutes.

title: Mark'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix peanut butter Crisco brown sugar vanilla egg and milk. Add flour baking soda and salt.

title: Pepper Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions however substitute chicken broth for the water. Stir in sour cream creamy Italian dressing water chestnuts jalapeno pepper and pepper juice. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Cover with Monterey Jack cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Heat oil in large skillet (ovenproof) over medium heat. Add pork chops cook 2 minutes on each side (turn only once) until lightly browned. Remove skillet from heat remove pork chops to a plate. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Mix together. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken and bay leaves then debone. Saute jalapeno peppers and onion in a large skillet. Add tomato. Sprinkle chili powder and garlic powder to taste. Cook a few minutes longer. In separate bowl mix cream of chicken soup and sour cream. Add tablespoon of mixture to vegetables. Add chicken to mixture. Stir to blend all ingredients. Fill tortilla with mixture and a little cheese. Roll and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan. Top with sour cream mixture and remaining cheese. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until tan. Cool.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook onion and squash. Add butter soup and cheese. Add sour cream last. Blend and pour into a dish. Put dressing mix on top. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fudge Cake
instructions: Put dry ingredients in mixing bowl; add vanilla water buttermilk butter and eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Grease and flour Bundt pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when done.

title: Tuna Hobos
instructions: Mix together tuna celery cheese parsley and pimiento. Set aside. Mix together lemon juice mayonnaise salt and Worcestershire sauce. Spoon over tuna and toss lightly. Divide mixture evenly among bottoms of buns. Put tops on wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 4 and has about 490 calories per serving.

title: Tailgate Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Combine butter Dijon mustard minced onions and poppy seeds. Spread both sides of bun with spread and layer cheese ham and then cheese. Wrap in foil and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put in an insulated container to keep warm until you get to the tailgate party.

title: Pork And Bean Bake
instructions: Turn beans into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange chops over beans. Dash chops with salt and pepper then spread tops lightly with mustard. Sprinkle brown sugar atop and spread with catsup. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Place onion slices atop each chop. Bake 15 minutes. Serves 5 or 6.

title: Mom'S Potato Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine all of the ingredients. Refrigerate for 2 hours then enjoy!

title: Crab Rangoon
instructions: Warm cheese until soft. Combine all ingredients. Place 1 tablespoon in center of wonton wrapper. Fold over corners. Seal with scrambled egg.

title: Cloud-Topped Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In heavy gauge saucepan combine evaporated milk sugar salt and butter. Bring to a boil over moderate heat. Boil 8 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter morsels. Stir until morsels melt and mixture is smooth. Spread into foil-lined pan (9-inch square pan). Chill 30 minutes.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix well. Use 1/3 cup for 1 cup water.

title: Lemon Green Beans
instructions: Place green beans in a large saucepan and add just enough water to cover add salt and bring to a boil. Cook for about 5 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Melt butter and add remaining ingredients. Marinate steaks at least 1 hour at room temperature. Grill 4 minutes on each side.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown onions in butter. Add tomatoes; simmer for 10 minutes. Add lima beans into mix and mix well. Pour mix into baking dish. Cut bread into squares and put on top of dish. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Hot Chicken Salad(Recipe From Club Luncheons)
instructions: Bake 5 to 10 minutes more (until cheese is melted but no longer!).

title: Soft Gingerbread
instructions: Combine molasses brown sugar butter and water in a saucepan; bring the mixture to a simmer stirring several times. Set aside to cool. Sift together the flour baking soda ginger and nutmeg. When the molasses mixture has cooled to lukewarm stir it into the flour mixture beating well with a wooden spoon until it is smooth. Add the sour cream then the egg mixing well. Pour the batter into a buttered and floured 8-inch square pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Breast
instructions: Dissolve soup in water. Place apple in breast cavity; pour soup over breast. Pour orange juice over breast. Spice to taste. Cook 3 hours (2 covered and 1 uncovered). Cut warm.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in boiling water until tender. Remove chicken from broth. Strain broth reserving 2 2/3 cups. Bone chicken and cut into small pieces; set aside. Combine chicken soup with half the broth; mix well and set aside. Combine mushroom soup with remaining broth; mix well and set aside. Combine stuffing mix and butter. Reserve 1/4 cup for garnish. Spoon half of remaining stuffing mixture into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; top with half the chicken. Cover with chicken soup mixture. Repeat layers. Pour mushroom soup over layers. Sprinkle with reserved stuffing mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove casserole from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Uncover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Freezer Blueberry Jam
instructions: Crush blueberries to 2 cups. Blender works well. Combine all ingredients in a large pan and boil 2 minutes stirring continuously. Pour into jars. Let stand 24 hours then freeze.

title: One Egg Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Beat for 3 minutes on medium speed. Pour into two 8-inch cake pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Best Banana Muffins
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening well; add eggs and bananas. Combine flour soda and salt. Add to the banana mixture blending well. Pour into greased muffin tins. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Kielbasa Supper In A Skillet
instructions: Bring the kielbasa celery soup water rice and margarine to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Stir in the peas and mushrooms. Cover and cook for 20 minutes. Before serving stir in Swiss cheese.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Add soup and milk to sauteed vegetables. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth water. Add chicken diced to soup mixture. Melt Velveeta in microwave then add to soup mixture; or melt Velveeta in cooked spaghetti for easier melting. Then mix all together. Add an additional can of cream of mushroom soup or celery to increase richness. Also you may add black olives grated Cheddar cheese and mushrooms to spaghetti.

title: Cheesecake Dip
instructions: Beat cheese Equal and milk until blended and smooth. Fold in Cool Whip and vanilla. Store in refrigerator. Great with fruit!!

title: Church Windows
instructions: Melt chocolate bits and margarine and add peppermint then cool. Mix marshmallows and nuts and mix in chocolate mixture in large bowl. Roll into 2 logs on waxed paper in coconut. Wrap and refrigerate 24 hours then slice.

title: New England Baked Beans
instructions: Rinse beans. Cover with water and soak overnight. To same water add remaining ingredients. Cook in pressure cooker at 15 pounds pressure for 25 to 30 minutes in covered beanpot. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 5 to 6 hours or in covered slow cooker at low temperature for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Chicken Marengo
instructions: Rinse chicken. Pat dry. Cut into serving pieces. Peel onions. Clean mushrooms. Slice. In a skillet heat butter. Add chicken pieces and saute until well browned on all sides. Transfer to a Dutch oven or other pot. Saute mushrooms and onions in skillet until lightly brown. Sprinkle with flour. Stir well to combine. Add wine water and crumbled bouillon cube. Bring to a boil stirring. Pour over chicken. Cover with lid. Cook for 20 minutes. Dip tomatoes in hot water. Peel. Cut into wedges. Add to pot.

title: Hamburger Medley Soup
instructions: Simmer meat; pour off excess grease. Add margarine sliced onions and water and cook 1 1/2 hours then add tomatoes and cut up vegetables and seasoning. Cook until done about one hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: In medium skillet cook and stir ground chuck and onion over medium-high heat until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain thoroughly. Add taco seasoning mix to meat mixture as directed on package. Layer ingredients as desired on serving plate and enjoy.

title: Tomato-Spinach Soup
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan over high heat heat all the ingredients to boiling except pasta. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 20 minutes. Add dry pasta to soup. Simmer 5 minutes more or until pasta is tender. Add more water if needed. Makes 6 servings or 6 cups.

title: Penuche
instructions: Line a loaf pan with plastic wrap. Combine sugar cream and salt in a saucepan. Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Let simmer without stirring until a candy thermometer registers 240\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Cut butter into small pieces and scatter on top of hot syrup. Do not stir. Let cool to 110\u00b0. Add vanilla. Beat mixture with electric beater until the candy is very thick and loses its sheen 3 to 5 minutes. Press mixture into prepared pan and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate. When firm cut into squares.

title: Sauteed Green Beans And Mushrooms
instructions: Melt margarine in a 12-inch nonstick frying pan. Add onion and saute at medium temperature until clear. Add green beans mushrooms garlic powder and herb seasoning. Cover and cook at medium temperature for 15 to 20 minutes stirring occasionally until green beans are cooked but not limp.

title: Heat Wave
instructions: Stir and put in chimney glass.

title: Cranberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with boiling water. Add remaining ingredients. Stir all together; pour into mold and refrigerate to set.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix. Lightly spread over first layer. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Be careful not to overcook. Golden brown.

title: Cooked Lettuce
instructions: Wash and cut up lettuce. Cut up onion. Add butter. Add water. When almost done sprinkle salt and pepper to taste. Eat with corn bread.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Beat eggs; add oil sugar vanilla and grated zucchini. Combine flour salt baking soda cinnamon baking powder nuts and cocoa. Add alternately to wet batter. Divide batter into 2 loaf pans and bake 1 hour.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Combine buttermilk eggs and soda; beat well and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients; stir in buttermilk mixture. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hot Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin pan cups. Mix brown sugar cinnamon and butter. Prepare biscuit mix. Fill muffin cups two-thirds full. Make depression in each muffin; in it place 1 teaspoon brown sugar mixture. Top each muffin with 1 teaspoon drained pineapple. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until browned and done. Makes 12.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cut up wieners can be added.

title: Pineapple Bread Pudding
instructions: Blend softened butter eggs and sugar. Add pineapple. Cut bread slices into small sections. Add to mixture until all bread is soaked. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Good with ham.

title: Pizza Sandwiches
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight to blend flavors. Spread on bread of your choice. Place on cookie sheets and bake at 400\u00b0 for about 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Baked Beans(Microwave)
instructions: Put bacon into glass baking dish. Cover with a paper towel. Cook in microwave 3 minutes on High. Combine beans mustard onion ketchup and brown sugar in a quart glass casserole. Cover with glass lid or plastic wrap. Cook 8 minutes on High. Stir occasionally. Top with cooked bacon. Cook covered for 2 minutes on High.

title: Hello Dolly Dessert
instructions: Mix ingredients all together except milk and pat into a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex baking dish. Pour condensed milk over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm about 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream in small squares.

title: Tuna Dinner
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese per package directions. Stir in milk and soup. Gently fold in tuna and peas. Heat until peas are done. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Fry zucchini in skillet with shortening until brown (zucchini should be dipped individually in beaten eggs and water mixture then dipped in flour). Layer in 8 x 8-inch pan (or larger depending on size of zucchini) and put 1 tablespoon of sauce on each piece. Between each layer sprinkle cheese. Continue until done then leftover sauce can be evenly spread over top of zucchini and sprinkle again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour covered with foil and 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Sugar-Plum Cake
instructions: Cream butter in large mixer bowl at high speed of mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Gradually add sugar. Continue creaming at high speed until light and fluffy. By hand fold in flour cherries almonds coconut and raisins; then fold in frosting mix and pudding mix. Pour batter into well-greased Bundt pan 10-inch tube pan or 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes. Do not invert! Cool 2 hours and remove from pans.

title: Italian Crme Cake
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks (well beaten). Add flour soda and buttermilk and mix well. Stir in nuts coconut and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gently fold into batter. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake is done.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and cornstarch together with enough cold water to make paste. Heat milk to boiling. Add egg mixture and cook until thick. Remove from heat and add 3/4 cup coconut butter and vanilla. Pour into pie crust and top with meringue and remaining coconut. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Whiskey Cake
instructions: Swirl into cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until done.

title: Bacon 'N Egg Crepes
instructions: Cut bacon into pieces and fry until crisp or fry then crumble. Drain well. Whisk together the eggs and cream. Stir in bacon onions and seasonings. Pour into a hot buttered pan. As portions cook gently lift with spatula so that uncooked portions can flow to bottom. Avoid constant stirring. Sprinkle cheese over eggs when eggs are almost totally cooked. Spoon egg mixture into crepes and roll. Garnish with sprig of parsley. Serve with hash brown potatoes and green grapes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Drop by tablespoons into hot oil about 375\u00b0 until golden brown on all sides. Drain on paper towels.

title: Fiesta Appetizer Pie
instructions: In a bowl mash avocados with lemon juice. Spread mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9-inch pie plate. Spread sour cream evenly over avocado mixture. Spoon taco sauce over sour cream layer. Sprinkle green onions over taco sauce. Top with cheese. Cover and chill for several hours. Serve with chips. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Orange Glazed Chicken(This Is Frank'S Favorite Dinner - Mmm Good!)
instructions: In a bowl mix together orange juice orange rind butter or margarine salt dry mustard and ginger. Place chicken in large shallow baking pan. Pour glaze over chicken parts.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add the next 9 ingredients; simmer for 1 hour. Add cheese to top of each serving.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar and shortening together. Add beaten eggs hot water and soda. Add flour baking powder and vanilla. Refrigerate dough. Drop from teaspoon. (If desired one cup chocolate chips can be added.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Bananas Foster French Toast
instructions: Combine eggs cream and vanilla. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Dip bread in egg mixture then sprinkle both sides with sugar mixture. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter and 2 teaspoons of oil in large nonstick skillet. Add bread in batches and cook until golden brown 1 1/2 minutes on each side adding oil as necessary. Transfer to plate and keep warm. Add remaining 3 tablespoons of butter to skillet. Toss bananas with remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture. Add bananas to skillet and cook over high heat until they begin to caramelize 2 minutes. Add water and cook until mixture is slightly thick; pour over French toast and sift confectioners sugar on top. Makes 6 servings each containing 550 calories and 31 g fat.

title: Pork Chops A L'Orange
instructions: Pour rice in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour orange juice over rice then put chops on rice with chicken soup all over. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Elephant Soup
instructions: Cut elephant into bite-size pieces. (This takes about two months.) Cover with brown gravy. Cook over kerosene for 4 weeks at 450\u00b0. This will serve 3800\tpeople. If more are expected add the rabbits. (But only if absolutely necessary as most people do not like to find a hare in their soup.)

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Brown beef onion and green pepper; drain. Put spaghetti on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir in margarine and eggs. Put Parmesan cheese and cottage cheese over noodles. Spread ground beef over cheeses. Place mushrooms over meat. Stir sugar oregano and garlic salt into sauce and pour over. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese And Shrimp
instructions: Layer in order in glass dish. Chill and serve with crackers.

title: Praline Cookies
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients stirring well. Add flour and salt stirring well. Stir in pecans. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. (Do not overbake). Yield 3 dozen.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook noodles by package directions in salted water. Drain well. Meanwhile melt butter in wide frying pan over high heat until butter is lightly browned. Add 1/2 cup of the cream and bring to a rapid boil. Boil until slightly thickened. Reduce heat to medium. Add noodles and mix gently by tossing or folding. Add 1/2 of the cheese and 1/2 cup of the remaining cream. Lift and mix pasta gently. Repeat with remaining cheese and cream. Season with salt pepper and garlic salt to taste.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir in the onion broccoli and muffin mix stir until well blended. Pour into a 13 x 9 inch baking pan coated with cooling spray. Bake for 27 minutes or until set. If using a glass baking dish lower temperature by 25 degrees. I serve this dish at breakfast potluck but it is great anytime of day! Enjoy hot or cold.

title: Frito Pie
instructions: Crush Fritos. Cover bottom of casserole pan sparingly with Fritos. Layer with Fritos chili and cheese. Repeat layers if pan is deep. Cheese should be on top of pie. Place in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 35 minutes making sure cheese on top doesnt get too brown.

title: Heavenly Hash Cake
instructions: Add melted butter and cocoa to sugar. Add vanilla and enough Pet milk until thin enough to spread on cake. Cut in squares.

title: Jalapeno Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Melt butter and shortening. Add sugars and mix well then add remaining ingredients. Spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Roast Turkey With Herb Butter
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl or a food processor. Blend until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Chocolate Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. Cool for 1/2 hour. Poke approximately 30 holes in the cake with end of a wooden spoon. Pour 1 can sweetened condensed milk and 1 jar of Mrs. Richards butterscotch/carmel sauce over cake. Refrigerate. Just before serving frost with Cool Whip and 2 crushed Heath bars.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chicken. Fold chicken in last. Put in buttered casserole dish and top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Turkey Bake
instructions: Grease baking dish. Mix turkey and stuffing together and place in bottom of dish. Pour gravy/soup over mixture. Add the broccoli and mushrooms and sprinkle with 1/2 of the cheese. Pour sour cream over the casserole. Top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered with foil. Remove foil and put Cheddar cheese over dish and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes. Great recipe for those Thanksgiving leftovers!

title: Hopi Fried Bread
instructions: Add water to make dough stiff. Roll out; cut in triangles and deep fry in hot fat.

title: Made-Over Pickles
instructions: Pour juice off pickles leaving the garlic. Heat remaining ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Pour over pickles and refrigerate.

title: Monkey Cake
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients. Bring to a boil and set aside. Mix next 2 ingredients. Place in plastic bag. Open 2 packages biscuits and quarter; place in plastic bag and shake. Grease tube pan lightly. Put quartered biscuits in pan. Pour half of the buttered mixture over them. Do the same with the other 2 packages. Pour remainder of butter mixture over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes. Turn on dish.

title: Basil Butter
instructions: In a food processor chop the basil. Add butter lemon juice and pepper; blend until smooth. Drop by half tablespoons onto a cookie sheet; freeze. Remove from cookie sheet and store in freezer bags. Use to flavor chicken fish or vegetables. Makes 4 dozen butter balls.

title: Tomato Bisque
instructions: Peel and seed tomatoes. Saute onion in butter and add the chopped tomatoes bay leaf sugar cloves salt pepper and basil. Simmer stirring occasionally until tomatoes are thoroughly cooked about 25 minutes. Remove bay leaf and cloves and transfer soup to blender or food processor to puree. Add cream and milk and heat. Serve topped with toasted buttered croutons. Sprinkle with chives.

title: Microwave Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Lightly butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine sugar butter and milk in a 2-quart glass bowl. Cook on High (maximum power) 11 to 14 minutes or until small amount dropped in cold water forms soft ball (234\u00b0 on a microproof candy thermometer). Stir in chocolate pieces and Marshmallow Creme until thoroughly blended. Stir in nuts and vanilla. Pour into prepared pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into pieces.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown the hamburger meat. Combine all other ingredients and heat until melts. Add meat and mix well. Tear each tortilla into about 4 small pieces and line the pan with these. Pour the soup mixture over tortillas. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add sauce. Meantime boil noodles according to directions and drain.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender. Put box of Stove Top mix in a 9 x 11-inch casserole dish. Cut cooked chicken breasts in small pieces and put on top of stuffing. Pour cream of chicken soup on top of breasts. Pour about 1 cup of chicken broth from cooked chicken on top of soup. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

title: One Bowl Brownies
instructions: Microwave chocolate and margarine in a large microwave bowl on High for 2 minutes or until margarine is melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir sugar into chocolate until well blended. Hand mix in eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and nuts until well blended. Spread into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out with fudgy crumbs. Do not overbake. Cool in pan. Cut into squares.

title: Nellie Reed'S Seafood Casserole
instructions: Boil haddock fillet for 15 to 20 minutes being careful to keep it whole. Saute scallops in butter with dash of paprika. Boil lobsters for 20 to 25 minutes. Pick off meat. Flake haddock. Mix haddock lobsters scallops shrimp and clams in a dish; mix lightly.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Place pastry shell in glass pie dish; fill shell with pie filling. Put in microwave. Cook for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Prepare fruit and nuts chopping into medium size pieces. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of flour. Mix with fingers until pieces are separated. Add more flour if necessary. Sift remaining flour with spices and other dry ingredients. Cream butter; stir in sugar gradually then the beaten eggs. Add flour alternately with orange juice. Pour batter over floured fruit and nuts and mix thoroughly. Bake in wax paper-lined pans in sizes and shapes desired. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Cool in pans. Makes 12 pounds.

title: Teacher'S Delight Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased tube pan.

title: Italian Beef And Peppers
instructions: Cut partially frozen steak against the grain in paper thin slices. Heat olive oil until very hot in a large skillet or wok. Stir-fry steak over high heat (it will be done in about 60 seconds). Remove from pan with a slotted spoon. Reduce heat to medium and stir-fry garlic onion and peppers for several minutes until crisp. Add tomatoes Worcestershire sauce and oregano; cover and let simmer for 5 minutes. Return meat to pan add parsley and season to taste with herb salt and pepper. Cook until the meat is heated through. Serve with rice or buttered noodles.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Cut artichokes into pieces. Add mayonnaise cheese garlic powder and Tabasco. Mix. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish or pan. Sprinkle paprika over and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spoon onto Ritz crackers.

title: Root Beer
instructions: Dissolve sugar in lukewarm water. Add root beer extract and compressed yeast. Mix and bottle; cork and seal tightly. Set in warm place. Root beer is ready for use in 10 to 12 hours. It is better if allowed to stand for several days. Store in a cool place.

title: Tuna Quiche
instructions: Beat eggs. Add half and half. Mix in horseradish lemon juice salt and basil. Stir in tuna peas water chestnuts green onion Jack cheese and 1 cup Cheddar. Pour mixture into greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Top with remaining Cheddar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife comes clean. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve. Serves 12 to 18 or 60 hors doeuvres.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bake on a greased baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove at once from baking sheet and cool. Store in an airtight container. Makes 24.

title: Penny'S Vegetable Soup
instructions: In large pot with a little water simmer vegetables and onion. While vegetables are cooking drop small ground beef balls into boiling water in a separate pot. When vegetables are tender; drain meat balls and add to mixed vegetables. Add juice spices sugar and salt; simmer together 45 minutes to blend flavors. Makes a large pot of soup.

title: Deluxe Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large saucepan. Mix well; gradually add water and lemon juice stirring until smooth. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Gradually stir into lemon mixture. Add butter; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon rind. Pour into shell. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar at high speed first until foamy. Gradually add 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar beating until stiff peaks form. Stir in vanilla. Spread over hot filling sealing edges of crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Cool.

title: 1 Pot Pork Chop Supper
instructions: Brown the pork chops in a skillet. Pour off excess fat and add the rest of the ingredients. Stir to mix cover and simmer 45 minutes until tender.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Mix all ingredients gently until bread crumbs are well coated. Place mixture in greased 9 x 10-inch or 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool or serve slightly warm.

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
instructions: Wash cucumbers and cut into sticks. Set aside and let set 4 to 5 hours. Drain and pack solid in pint jars. Add remaining ingredients for solution. Bring to boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Pour boiling hot over cucumbers and seal. Process in boiling water 5 minutes.

title: Chewy Cake
instructions: Cream butter with eggs then add other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Tortilla Stack-Ups(Appetizer)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly butter two 8-inch cake or pie pans. Place 1 tortilla in each pan. Combine cheeses in bowl. Sprinkle 1/4 of cheese mixture on each tortilla. Sprinkle 1/4 of onions and chiles on each cheese layer. Repeat cheese and onion-chili layers until there are 4 layers in each pan. Top with fifth tortilla. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake stacks uncovered in oven for 20 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes. Slice into wedges. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Yummy Apple Cobbler
instructions: Mix together margarine egg flour and sugar. Set aside. Peel core and slice apples into a 7 x 9-inch glass baking dish. Mix lemon juice with apples. Trim crust from bread and cut into finger-size strips. Place strips over apples. Pour sugar mixture over top of strips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Broccoli Cheese Chicken
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat.

title: Swiss Green Beans
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter stir in flour salt pepper sugar and onion. Add sour cream gradually stirring constantly. Cook until thick. Fold in drained beans and heat. Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish; cover with cheese. Combine cornflake crumbs and melted butter sprinkle over cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool 20 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Fettuccine With Peas And Ham
instructions: In a large pot bring 5 quarts of water to boil. In frying pan melt butter over low heat. Add the onion and saute until translucent. Add ham and cream. Simmer stirring frequently another 5 minutes. Season to taste. Keep warm. Add peas and pasta to boiling water until pasta is al dente. Drain pasta and peas. Arrange on platter. Pour cream mixture over the top and toss well. Serve at once.

title: Quick Turkey Curry
instructions: Cook onion in butter or margarine. Add soup and milk; heat and stir until smooth. Stir in sour cream and curry powder. Add turkey; heat but do not boil. Garnish with snipped parsley. Serve over hot cooked rice. If desired offer curry condiments of chutney raisins and toasted slivered almonds. Makes 4 servings.

title: Peach Crunch
instructions: Arrange peaches in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Pour 1/4 cup liquid over peaches. Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over peaches. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until topping is golden brown. Serve with cream as desired.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain off excess fat. Pour into casserole dish. Add the 2 soups Tater Tots water and cheese (if desired). Mix well. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Halusky
instructions: Fry cabbage in oil until cabbage cooks down and starts to brown. Season to taste while cooking. Garlic powder can be added if desired. Saute onion in margarine. Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain. Add onions and cabbage. Mix gently. Serve with sour cream if desired. Flavor enhances as stored. Freezes well.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix well. Shape into balls. Roll in nuts coconut and/or mini chips. Refrigerate after.

title: Baked Orange Roughy For One
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Sprinkle the onions in the bottom of a well buttered gratin dish. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Place the fillet on top of the onions. Dot the fillet with 1 tablespoon butter. Top with mushrooms sprinkle with parsley and then add broth. Place buttered wax paper over the top (buttered side down). Tuck the wax paper around the fillet not just over top of dish. Bake for about 10 minutes or until fish is tender.

title: Lazy Cake
instructions: Fix box of cake mix as directed. Punch holes in cake while warm. Pour the Eagle Brand milk over top of cake. Let cool and spread Cool Whip over top of cake. Sprinkle coconut over top of Cool Whip.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain vegetables. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch dish daub soup over top slice cheese and put on top and then sprinkle stuffing mix and drizzle melted oleo over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix and let set several hours or overnight.

title: Skillet Lasagna(Serves 6)
instructions: Use electric skillet. Brown ground beef in butter. Sprinkle with 1/2 package of spaghetti sauce mix. Spoon cottage cheese over meat and top with 3 cups noodles (uncooked) in a layer; sprinkle remaining spaghetti sauce mix. Sprinkle basil leaves parsley flakes and salt. Pour tomatoes tomato sauce and water over top. Make sure all is moistened. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 35 minutes or until noodles are tender. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over top and cover; let stand 5 minutes.

title: Working Women'S Stroganoff
instructions: Cut steak into 1-inch strips and place in crock-pot. Add soups and mix well. Let cook from 4 to 8 hours. (If desired 1 hour before serving add 1/2 cup of carrots and 1/2 cup peas.) Serve over noodles rice potatoes or biscuits.

title: Monster Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to slow 325\u00b0. Lightly grease 2 large cookie sheets. Break chocolate bars into squares then cut each square diagonally in half. Set aside 1/2 cup pecan halves; coarsely chop remainder. Stir together the flour and baking soda on wax paper to mix well. Beat together the butter peanut butter granulated sugar and brown sugar in medium size bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla until mixed. Stir in flour mixture until blended; stir in chopped pecans.

title: Cloud Nine
instructions: Beat egg yolks; add 3/4 cup sugar lemon juice and rind. Cook over low heat until thickened. Add 1 envelope unflavored gelatin that has been soaked in 1/4 cup cold water. Let cool. Fold in well beaten egg whites that have been beaten with 3/4 cup sugar.

title: Swiss Bliss
instructions: Place steak in casserole dish with well fitting lid. Add butter soup mix bell pepper and tomatoes. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over steak. Cover well and bake about 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Deviled Carrots
instructions: In a large frying pan with cover melt butter. Add carrots which have been peeled and cut into even julienne strips. Sprinkle with salt. Cover tightly and steam in the butter until tender 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cut up vegetables. Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Danish Goulash
instructions: Brown cubes and onions. Add salt 2 1/2 cups cold water sugar and bay leaves. Cover. Simmer 1 1/4 hours. Remove bay leaves. Stir in flour and water mixture. Serve over mashed potatoes rice or noodles.

title: Blitz Kuchen Cake
instructions: Combine shortening and brown sugar. Beat in eggs and yolks. Sift together flour cloves cinnamon soda baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour milk. Mix well. Grease and line with wax paper a large tube pan. Pour in batter. Spread with mixture made with 2 egg whites and 1 cup brown sugar and beat until stiff then sprinkle top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Have oven shelf below center so topping on cake will not brown too much or nuts scorch.

title: French Bread With Herb Butter
instructions: To make herb butter chop all herbs in food processor. Add softened butter and mix together. Pack into crocks. The butter will keep up to 2 days in the refrigerator or can be frozen for future use. Cut bread lengthwise into halves and spread each half with softened herb butter. Put them on a baking sheet and toast in the oven until crispy. Slice and serve immediately. After cooled this is good served with a cold pasta salad.

title: Skillet Potatoes
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Place in skillet with butter; add onions parsley and green pepper. Salt and pepper to taste. Fry until brown on medium-low heat. Stir often.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Add bananas. Sift flour and soda add to mixture. Pour in chopped nuts. Pour mixture into greased loaf pan. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan when slightly cool. (The bread is better when let mellow two or three days.)

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. In separate bowl combine eggs oil and strawberries. Add to dry ingredients mixing well. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake for 1 hour or until bread tests done. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast and water sugar egg and salt. Then beat well. Add 1/2 cup flour Crisco and then rest of flour. Knead well. Pour in greased pan and let rise. Punch down and refrigerate. Make rolls out and put on greased pan and let rise. Bake in preheated oven at 425\u00b0.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Wash potatoes heat water and add salt (1/2 tsp. to one cup water.) Add potatoes cover and boil until done. Leave peels on. When done cool and remove peels and eyes. Cut into cubes. Mix mayonnaise vinegar mustard salt and pepper in a 4 quart glass bowl. Add potatoes celery and onions. Toss. Add eggs. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Serves 10.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix together butter flour and confectioners sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes (or until golden). Beat lemon juice sugar salt and eggs for 3 minutes. Pour over hot crust. Bake 15 to 20 more minutes. Allow to cool. Cut into squares. Yummy!

title: Texas Trash
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and stir constantly until mixture boils. Set aside. Mix the remaining ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Stir all together until cereal is moist. Bake in long pan stirring occasionally at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Soup
instructions: Brown meat lightly with medium pieces of onion. Drain and put in large pan. Add all other ingredients except for chips and cheese; simmer for approximately 1 hour until meat is tender. Add cheese and chips on top. Serve immediately. Serves 8.

title: Jellied Cranberry Mold
instructions: Dissolve orange and lemon jello in boiling water. Chill until syrupy.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook hamburger until done and drain. Then peel and dice potatoes and cover with water. Cook until potatoes are tender. Also add the onion and celery while cooking potatoes. Add the 1/2 gallon of milk. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chile Canapes
instructions: Spread chiles in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread cheese over chiles. Beat eggs milk salt and Bisquick until smooth. Pour over chiles and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into squares. Serve warm.

title: Microwave Spanish Rice
instructions: In a 3-quart casserole dish crumble beef. Add remaining ingredients and mix well cutting tomatoes to distribute evenly. Cover. Microwave on High 12 to 14 minutes stirring after 6 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chili Hominy Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients except bread crumbs. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hot-Cross Buns
instructions: Combine 1 cup flour yeast sugar and salt in larger mixer bowl fitted with dough hooks. Heat milk water and butter in saucepan over medium heat (120\u00b0). At low speed add milk to dry ingredients; beat until smooth 1 minute. Beat in egg and 1/2 cup flour at a time to make a soft dough. Add cinnamon and soft raisins and beat for about 8 minutes. Place in large greased bowl and rise in warm place 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Punch down. Grease 2 cookie sheets. Divide dough into 16 equal parts and shape into balls. Arrange 8 balls 2 inches apart on cookie sheets. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake 10 to 15 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Mushroom Croissant Appetizer
instructions: Saute mushrooms in a small amount of butter and cool. Mix mushrooms with cream cheese and seasonings. Unroll croissants and cut each croissant in half long ways. Spoon a small amount of mixture onto large end of croissant. Roll up. Place in ungreased cookie sheet and bake 10-12 minutes at 350.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large mixing bowl beat egg yolks with Eagle Brand milk real lime and food coloring (optional). Pour into prepared pastry shell; bake 30 minutes. Cool; chill. Top with whipped cream or whipped topping. Store in refrigerator. Preparation time 10 minutes.

title: Honey Sand Balls
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat together butter 1/2 cup of powdered sugar and honey. Add flour nuts vanilla and salt. Mix thoroughly using hands if necessary. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place 1 1/2-inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 14 to 16 minutes or until cookies are barely tinged with brown. While cookies are still warm roll them in powdered sugar. Cool. Roll cookies in powdered sugar again. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Cream-Style Corn
instructions: Combine corn melted margarine needed amount of water corn meal sugar salt and pepper in 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish. Cover tightly with glass lid or plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir well and rotate dish 1/2 turn. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Stir well. Let stand covered for 3 minutes.

title: Veal Marsala Scallopini
instructions: Flatten veal and coat with cheese. Saute meat and garlic in butter until golden brown. Add butter as needed. Remove meat and garlic; set aside. In same butter saute mushrooms and set aside on top of veal. To the butter add pepper broth and wine; stir until all brown. Add veal and mushrooms to pan; cook 1 minute over high heat. Serve at once. Serves 4.

title: Sopaipilla
instructions: Mix all ingredients together as making pie crust. Roll out dough very thin cutting into small squares. Drop in hot oil and cook until golden brown and puffs. Turn over and brown. Drain; then sprinkle with cinnamon sugar or drizzle with honey.

title: Moo-Goo-Gai-Pan (Wok Chicken)
instructions: Set heat control to 350\u00b0; add 1 tablespoon oil when light goes out. Add peas mushrooms and onions and stir-fry 2 minutes; remove to mixing bowl. In small cup mix together cornstarch salt ginger and pepper; set aside. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to wok. Add chicken and cornstarch mixture. Stir-fry until chicken turns white. Stir in mushroom mixture and soy sauce; stir-fry until hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain. Pour drained broccoli back into cooking pan. Stir in cheese and 1 stick margarine until melted. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Melt other stick of margarine. Stir in Ritz crackers. Spread over broccoli and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Caramelitas
instructions: Mix and put half of crumbs in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Then sprinkle with 1 cup chocolate chips and 1/2 cup chopped walnuts. Mix 3/4 cup caramel ice cream topping and 3 tablespoons flour. Spread evenly over chips and nuts and then add rest of crumbs. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: In a large stockpot combine and whisk together until smooth all 8 cans of soup. Add chicken broth. Add tomatoes salsa green chiles onion garlic chili powder salt and pepper. Bring all ingredients to a full boil; reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Add cilantro and chicken breast chunks. Simmer another hour.

title: Spice Bars
instructions: Mix together well the Wesson oil honey and sugar. Add after sifting together the flour salt soda and cinnamon. Then add beaten egg and chopped pecans. Mix together well. Dough will be thick. Pat out until even in a cookie sheet with sides. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. After its cooled spread a little powdered sugar icing on top and cut into squares.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown bacon and onion; pour off fat. Brown hamburger. Mix together brown sugar vinegar catsup and dry mustard with meat and onion. Simmer 15 minutes. Pour over beans which have been put in a large casserole. Add bean juices. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Baked Eggplant
instructions: Adds tomatoes to cubed eggplant cook slowly until tender remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Use just enough Ritz crackers to take up moisture. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 - 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Grease casserole; arrange broccoli and top with chicken. Blend soup mayonnaise curry powder and lemon juice and pour over all. Top with a sprinkling of cheese and crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve with rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles and drain. Brown ground beef with onion oregano and chili powder and drain. In a pot mix all ingredients with ground beef. Let simmer about 20 minutes. In a casserole dish cover the bottom with sauce then place 1 layer of noodles and sauce on top. Then add cheese. Continue with each layer until dish is full. Do not put top layer of cheese until lasagna has baked at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Remove lasagna top with cheese and its ready to eat.

title: Vegetable Lasagna(Serves 9)
instructions: Saut zucchini and carrots separately in 1/2 tablespoon olive oil each until tender-crisp. Combine eggs and Parmesan in 3 bowls. Stir in 1/3 egg mixture separately into spinach carrots and zucchini. Spoon 2/3 cup sauce into 9-inch square baking dish. Place half of the noodles over the spaghetti sauce. Spread spinach into dish then top with 1/3 Provolone then carrots top with 1/3 Provolone then zucchini and top with 1/3 Provolone. Top with remaining noodles and spaghetti sauce. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle some Provolone on top. Bake 10 minutes longer. Cool before cutting.

title: Apricot Crumb Cake
instructions: Cream real butter and cream cheese. Add sugar gradually beating well after each addition. Add eggs and beat slightly. Add milk to which vanilla has been added. Blend then add dry ingredients. Spread 1/2 batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread with apricot preserves. Spread rest of batter over this. Bake at 350\u00b0. Top with Lazy-Daisy frosting using real butter for best flavor. Serve warm or cold with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Ridgefield Country Club Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender until consistency of thick salad oil. Add poppy seed if desired. Refrigerate and use as needed.

title: Chicken Enchiladas Casserole
instructions: Slightly brown onions in butter. Combine with soups and broth. Add pieces of chicken. Mix well. Grease a large baking dish. In baking dish place layer of tortillas then layer of chicken mixture then layer of grated cheese. Repeat layers until casserole is filled with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Five Can Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Following your favorite yellow cake mix recipe substitute pineapple juice (drained from can of Dole pineapple) for water. Also substitute butter for vegetable oil.

title: Cranberry-Nut Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening. Combine egg juice and peel. Add to dry ingredients. Mix enough just to moisten. Fold in berries and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch greased and floured pan.

title: White Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water for 5 minutes in mixer. Add sugar shortening salt and 3 1/2 cups warm water. Mix. Add yeast mixture. Add 2 cups flour and beat in mixer until smooth. With a spoon add 8 or 9 more cups of flour. Knead until smooth and let rise until double in size. Knead down; let rise again. Make 3 or 4 loaves. Let rise again. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
instructions: Place everything in crockpot and cook on low until melted and hot approximately one hour. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Swedish Heirloom Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and butter until light and fluffy; add 1 cup powdered sugar and salt and cream well. Blend in flour. Add water and vanilla and mix well. Stir in almonds. Shape into 1-inch balls and slightly flatten. Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until done. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Apple Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. Sift together next 4 ingredients. Add to creamed mixture and then add vanilla. Mix all ingredients well. Bake in a greased 9 x 12-inch pan for 45 to 55 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Can be baked in two 9-inch pans for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and ice.

title: Bobby'S No Name
instructions: Cook meat and drain. Add Worcestershire sauce and barbecue sauce. Cook and add beans bell pepper and onion; cook until done. Spread cheese on top.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and then add rest of ingredients. Pour into a hot greased pan. Bake in a preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Good with chili and other Mexican dishes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix in separate bowls the dry ingredients then moist ingredients. Gradually add the dry to moist mixing very well after each addition. Pour batter into two 9-inch round floured and grated pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese soften to room temperature. Whip until fluffy. Gradually add sweetened condensed milk while continuing to beat until well blended. Add lemon juice and vanilla flavoring. Blend well. Pour into prepared crust. Chill 2 to 3 hours; top with strawberry pie filling.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shells. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until middle is firm.

title: Chili
instructions: Fry bacon and crumble. Fry green pepper and onion until tender but not burned. Fry hamburger. While you are frying the meat put rest of the ingredients in a large kettle. When everything is fried mix it all together in the kettle and bring to a boil. Cut heat and simmer for about 20 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Italian Veggie Mixture
instructions: Drain vegetables and cans of beans. Combine in large bowl and add salad dressing. Let sit for a couple of hours then serve.

title: Strawberry-Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix the juice of the 2 lemons with the can of Eagle Brand milk. Stir until thick. Pour into pie shell. Mix strawberries and cool whip together. Pour over lemon/milk mixture. Chill.

title: Pickle Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables using a coarse blade. Sprinkle with salt. Let stand overnight. (Do not use aluminum pot.) Rinse and drain next day. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over mixture. Heat to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Seal in sterilized jars. Makes 8 pints

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients together; pour into crust and chill for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake in loaf pan at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. Cool and enjoy.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon Pie
instructions: Mix gelatin 1/4 cup sugar and salt in saucepan. Add milk and egg yolks; cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Add peanut butter; stir until blended. Chill. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar beating until stiff. Fold into chilled peanut butter mixture then fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into 9-inch pie crust which has cooled. Chill until firm. When ready to serve drizzle chocolate syrup over top.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in cooking oil. Mix with other ingredients. Pour into greased casserole and top with bread crumbs. Dot with oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Custard Topping
instructions: Separate eggs placing yolks in a large bowl. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Set aside. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar milk flour pumpkin and spices. Blend thoroughly. Fold into egg whites gently. Cover cake.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together adding nuts last. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Grease bottom of 9-inch deep dish or 10-inch pie plate. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large bowl. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into prepared plate. Place drained peaches over batter keeping at least 1/2 to 1 inch from edge of plate.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy saucepan; gradually stir in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Beat egg yolks; gradually stir about 1/4 of hot mixture into yolks. Add to remaining hot mixture stirring constantly. Cook 30 seconds. Remove from heat; stir in butter vanilla and coconut. Pour into pie shell.

title: White Bread Or Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; add sugar salt egg and oil. Mix with mixer until foamy just until mixed. Mix until it forms a bowl. Turn bread over in bowl and cover. Let rise for 1 1/2 hours or until it doubles in size. Knead down and place in greased pans; cover and let rise 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Yogurt Shake
instructions: Yields about 2 1/2 cups. Place all ingredients into blender or food processor. Whirl until smooth.

title: Strawberry Meringue Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix* orange juice water egg yolks and grated orange peel; beat 4 minutes on medium speed of electric mixer. Pour into two greased and wax paper lined 9 x 1 1/2-inch round cake pans. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar to soft peaks; gradually add the 1 cup sugar beating to stiff peaks. Gently spread meringue evenly over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes; cool completely.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mash up buns. Add other ingredients using almost all of the milk. You want it soupy so after baking it wont be real dry. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. If your oven cooks fast and/or hotter adjust temperature for your oven.

title: Buckeye Candy
instructions: Mix sugar butter and peanut butter together and roll in balls. Put in refrigerator until firm. Melt chocolate in double boiler. After balls are chilled dip in chocolate only 3/4 of ball making eye on top. Put on waxed paper. Keep cool. Makes 200 balls.

title: Five Minute Fudge
instructions: Combine milk and sugar in saucepan. Heat to boiling. Cook for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add marshmallows chopped walnuts semi-sweet chocolate bits and vanilla. Stir until marshmallows are melted. Pour into buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan. Garnish with walnut halves. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix the margarine sugar and cocoa. Add 1/2 cup milk. Bring to a rapid boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add 1/2 cup peanut butter and 2 cups quick oats 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Mix well and drop on wax paper by a teaspoon.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Oreo Delight
instructions: Crush cookies and pour half into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese butter and sugar together. Add milk (using a mixer). Add the pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour this over the crushed cookies. Top with remaining crushed cookies. Chill at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to a boil and cool margarine cocoa and water. Sift together sugar flour and salt. Combine eggs milk vinegar and soda. Add alternately the sifted dry ingredients and the coated mix (margarine and cocoa) to the eggs milk vanilla and soda mixture. Bake in 12 x 18-inch pan for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sticky Pecan Buns
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan with margarine. Arrange frozen rolls inside. Sprinkle 1 box of butterscotch pudding dry over rolls. Sprinkle cinnamon and pecans over this. Melt the margarine with the sugars and pour over the rolls. Lightly cover with towel and let set overnight. In the morning uncover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Delicious!

title: Snow Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cook on medium heat until thick. Pour mixture into a large bowl of clean snow. Stir well. Keep adding clean snow until the desired consistency of ice cream.

title: Gelatin Gems
instructions: Add juice to gelatin. Add water and stir until gelatin is dissolved. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and chill until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Venison Or Moose Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Brown meat and onion in butter. Mix in the rice dill salt and pepper. Put cabbage leaves in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and dry. Place meat mix in middle of leaves. Fold and secure with pick. Place in shallow baking dish. Pour tomato sauce over. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Earlier in the day Bake cake in 13 x 9-inch pan according to box directions. Make 3 packages of mousse. Use a large bowl and follow directions on back of package.

title: Shells A La Thom(8 To 10 Servings)
instructions: Prepare sauce (recipe follows) and keep warm. Melt butter in large skillet over low heat. Add Ricotta and stir until melted. Add cooked pasta turning until well coated. Sprinkle parsley and Parmesan or Romano cheese over top and toss gently. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to platter. Ladle some of Savory Italian Tomato Sauce over top and serve immediately.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Heat oil to 375\u00b0. Blend ingredients together and dip franks into batter. Fry about 3 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Surprise Icing
instructions: In a large thick saucepan combine flour and sugar. Blend in slowly egg yolks and milk. Add margarine (cut in chunks) and vanilla. Cook over medium heat until thick. Stir constantly to prevent scorching (about 12 minutes). Remove from heat and add coconut. Beat and cool. Spread on cake and allow to set several hours for extra moistness.

title: Spiced Tea Punch
instructions: In a large pot (4-quart) combine water sugar cinnamon cloves and allspice. Boil and simmer 10 minutes. In 2-quart pot add boiling water and tea bags. Make tea and pour in first pot. Add pineapple juice orange juice and lemon juice. Serve hot or chilled.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes; turn the pan around at 6 minutes.

title: Fresh Veggie Cocktail
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mint in a container of an electric blender. Process until smooth; chill. Serve with fresh mint if desired.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Sift together sugar flour and salt. Beat eggs and add to dry mixture a little at a time. Add Pet milk sweet milk; pour in slowly vanilla.

title: Ranch Potato Salad
instructions: Combine potatoes with celery and onion. Combine dressing mix with water and mayonnaise. Add to potatoes and toss to coat.

title: One Loaf Bread
instructions: Mix water and yeast together and set for 15 minutes. Add sugar salt oleo and egg; mix well. Add enough flour to make a smooth batter. Add 1/2 of flour at a time until all of the flour is used making a stiff dough (more flour can be added if needed). Pour dough out on a well floured board and knead until small blisters under surface of dough. Place dough in a greased bowl to rise. Cover with towel let rise to double in size 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan crumble raw ground beef. Add onion soup mix and a little water. Add\tfrozen\tvegetables cream of mushroom soup and 3/4 can of water. Mix all together. Arrange frozen Tater Tots on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Green Tomato Jam
instructions: Bring tomatoes and sugar to boil in saucepan stirring constantly and boil for 5 minutes. Take off stove and add package of Jell-O. Stir until Jell-O is dissolved. Seal in 1/2-pint jars and store in the refrigerator.

title: Asparagus Mushroom Bake
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large skillet; saute mushrooms and onion until tender (15 minutes). Remove vegetables. Add 3 tablespoons butter to skillet; heat until bubbly. Combine flour bouillon nutmeg salt and pepper. Stir into butter. Gradually stir in milk and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until it boils; boil and stir 1 minute. Cut asparagus spears into thirds. Drain any liquid from mushroom mixture. Stir asparagus mushroom mixture and lemon juice into sauce; pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine crumbs and 1 tablespoon butter; sprinkle over vegetables. Bake uncovered in a 325\u00b0 oven until asparagus is tender about 45 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Crock Pot Cheddar Chicken
instructions: Cover chicken breasts with both cans of soup (do not dilute soup). Cook on low 6-8 hours.

title: Little Molasses Cookies
instructions: Dissolve soda in boiling water. Mix molasses soda and water shortening egg cinnamon cloves ginger and salt with part of the flour. Add sugar and sift remainder of flour and mix together with all the ingredients. Roll into good size balls and roll in sugar. Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all and pour into pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes then turn temperature down to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Chicken
instructions: In medium bowl combine chicken with onion soup 1 tablespoon oil 1 tablespoon soy sauce garlic and 1 teaspoon cornstarch. Marinate 20 minutes.

title: Ritz Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites with a fork. Add vanilla and sugar; beat. Fold in Ritz cracker crumbs and chopped pecans. Pour into a 9-inch greased pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool and top with Cool Whip. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Zucchini Or Carrot Bread
instructions: In a large bowl cream the oil and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add zucchini or carrots or both (2 cups total) and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients (pineapple is optional) and beat until well combined. Pour into two loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Squash Casserole(Serves 8)
instructions: Cook squash and onion in saucepan with water until tender. Drain and place in casserole. Sprinkle cheese salt pepper and sugar over squash. Add Cheese Sauce. Top with bread crumbs. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Lumpia
instructions: Fry hamburger and drain oil. Add the shredded vegetables (coleslaw) vinegar and shoyu. Mix and cook for a few minutes. Keep it crunchy; dont overcook. Add garlic salt and black pepper to taste. Let cool. Place 1 to 2 tablespoons hamburger mixture on lumpia wrapper and roll tucking in sides before you reach the end. Pan-fry in 1/2-inch of oil.

title: Crunchy Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cheese mayonnaise and other ingredients. Chill. Roll into balls and cover with nuts.

title: Dump Cake Recipe
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and DUMP into a Bundt pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for an hour or until a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool for about 10 minutes and dump firmly--like slam it down on a cutting board to get it out of the pan. Good by itself or SUPER with ice cream.

title: Chalupas
instructions: Cook dry pinto beans as usual. Set aside. Brown ground beef in skillet. Add 1/2 small onion tomato sauce chili powder and salt and pepper to taste. Cover and let simmer 30 minutes. Fry tortillas crisp in oil and drain.

title: 7 Minute Frosting
instructions: Place all ingredients except vanilla in double boiler. Beat 1 minute with electric mixer. Cook over boiling water beating constantly until mixture forms peaks about 7 minutes. Remove from heat add vanilla and beat until of spreading consistency. Will frost tops and sides of two 9-inch layers or one 10-inch tube cake.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Spread cream cheese onto platter. Next spread cocktail sauce then top with green onions and shrimp. Serve with crackers.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Peel and cut apples into small slices or small chunks. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon and set aside. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour half of batter into a greased tube pan. Place half of apple mixture over it then pour in remaining batter. Top with remaining apple mixture. Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Mix altogether and refrigerate.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Take one can of crescent rolls and press in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown in oven at 375\u00b0.
