Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and Ranch dressing together and spread on top of crust. Chop vegetables and layer on top of crust/sauce mixture. Top all with cheese and bacon bits. Cut in squares and serve.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inch. Cook and stir ground beef and onion until beef is brown. Drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spread in pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean about 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Refrigerate any remaining pie. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Festive Make-Ahead Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni shells according to package directions; rinse and drain. Toss macaroni with oil to prevent shells sticking together. Put lettuce in one layer in a 3-quart glass or clear plastic bowl; top with cooled macaroni then egg slices. Sprinkle with pepper. Add in layers the ham peas and cheese. Spread dressing carefully over the top to edge of bowl. Cover tight with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Before serving sprinkle with parsley. Toss salad at table before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and discard. Wash mushrooms. Stuff mushrooms with sausage. Put in baking pan. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until sausage is brown.

title: Artichoke Salad
instructions: Toss together the artichokes tomatoes peppers and onions. In a separate bowl whisk together the remaining ingredients and pour over the vegetables. Serve over a bed of greens. Yield 25 portions.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook for 40 minutes.

title: Cabbage Rolls(Golabki)
instructions: Wilt cabbage leaves by scalding in boiling water to which 2 tablespoons vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt have been added. Drain. Cool in cold water and pat dry. Cut out heavy ribs. Saute onion in butter until transparent. Combine meat egg rice and seasoning. Spread each leaf with about 2 tablespoons of the mixture. Fold the two opposite sides and roll starting with one of the open ends. Place in pan. Add butter and 1 cup hot water. Simmer slowly for 2 hours. Cabbage rolls may be served with mushroom sauce tomato sauce or sour cream. They are more delicious if served reheated the next day.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: This is one of those quick salads. Run hot water over the peas. Drain them & add mayonnaise a few tablespoons at a time to get the peas to stick together. Then you cube up some Cheddar cheese & chop some onions & add to the peas. Some like more cheese than onions (I do). Mix them up & chill.

title: Boiled Icing(A World War Ii Recipe)
instructions: Boil together water vinegar and sugar until it spins a thread. Pour slowly over stiffly beaten egg whites and beat until creamy. Add lemon juice.

title: Ziti Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion and mix with spaghetti sauce; set aside. Cook ziti noodles; drain. Mix thoroughly in a large bowl the balance of ingredients.

title: Cheesy Chilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat with green pepper onion and garlic in 10-inch skillet; drain. Add beans tomato sauce picante cumin and salt; simmer 15 minutes. Spoon small amount of meat mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish spreading to coat bottom of dish. Top with 6 tortillas overlapping to cover bottom of dish. Top with half the remaining meat mixture; sprinkle with one cup of cheese. Cover with remaining tortillas overlapping to cover cheese; top with remaining meat mixture. Cover tightly with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Surprise
instructions: Early in day or up to 1 week ahead Place ice cream in refrigerator to soften slightly about 30 minutes. Chill small cookie sheet in freezer.

title: Peach Chutney
instructions: Coarsely chop peaches. Combine sugar honey vinegar and mace. Tie cloves and cinnamon stick in cheesecloth bag. Add to peach mixture. Simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove spice bag. Pour chutney in glass bowl and chill. Cover.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Add lemon juice to milk and set aside. Combine flour and sugar in mixing bowl. Cut in margarine. Add 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon; mix. Reserve 1 cup of this mixture. Add the rest of the spices baking powder and soda; mix. Add egg and milk beat until smooth. Spoon 1/2 cup of reserved mixture in the bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Spoon in batter. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Deluxe Nacho Platter
instructions: In a medium saucepan melt butter and cook onion and bell pepper over medium heat stirring occasionally 3 minutes or until tender. Stir in water rice and Spanish sauce and cumin; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer stirring occasionally 10 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir in 1 cup cheese and chilies until cheese is melted. Let cool slightly in a large round shallow broiler-proof baking dish. Layer 1/2 each of the chips rice mixture tomatoes olives and 1 cup cheese. Repeat layering ending with cheese. Broil 1 minute or until cheese is melted. Top with sour cream.

title: Eagle Brand Butterscotch Logs
instructions: Melt the butterscotch bits over low heat. Stir in the milk. Add the vanilla and pecans. Shape into \large\ roll and roll in powdered sugar. When firm and cool slice.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms and remove stems. Mix mayonnaise bacon bits and minced onion together. Spoon into mushrooms then sprinkle cheese mixture on top and bake at 425\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage in a skillet stirring over medium heat until brown. Drain well and set aside. Butter an 8 x 13-inch baking dish. Line with crescent roll dough pressing dough firmly into the pan. Sprinkle the cooked sausage and the cheese over the dough and set the pan aside.

title: Bavarian Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tomatoes and 1/4 cup flour. Form small balls roll in flour and brown in oil. Add remaining flour and tomatoes. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together in large bowl. Add oil eggs water and pumpkin; mix just enough to eliminate lumps. Some will remain but should be just small ones. Makes 2 loaves. Bake in greased and floured loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Licken Good Pork Chops
instructions: Combine the flour salt dry mustard and garlic powder. Shake chops in mixture. Brown in oil. Place browned chops in oven pan. Add soup. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch square pan with vegetable oil. Spread prepared apples in the bottom of the pan. Cover with lemon juice and honey. In medium-size bowl combine flour oats oil and spice. Spread over apples and pour apple juice on top. Bake for 35 minutes and serve.

title: Scallop Linguini
instructions: Marinate scallops in lemon juice parsley and garlic salt for 15 minutes. Cook linguini according to package directions. Saute scallops in 1/4 pound butter for 8 minutes or until done. Add heavy cream; cook until hot. Add linguini. Top with Parmesan cheese. Serve.

title: Cranberry Fruit Bread
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder soda and salt together. Cut in shortening until crumbly.

title: Zesty Nibbles
instructions: Place crackers in plastic container. Warm oil. Add seasonings to oil. Pour mixture over crackers and toss gently. Cover tightly and let stand for 24 hours. Do ahead. Preparation time 5 minutes. Makes 8 cups.

title: Play Doh
instructions: Cook until thick and smooth. Store in plastic Baggie.

title: 5-Minute Mex-Cheese Snacks
instructions: In a large bowl combine cheese and salsa. Stir until well mixed. Slice bread lengthwise. Cover each half with cheese and salsa mixture. Broil 5 minutes or until golden brown. Add green chiles and black olives if desired. Slice and serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Tea Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly first 3 ingredients. Stir in milk. Sift and stir in flour baking powder and salt; stir in blueberries. Spread batter in greased and floured 9-inch square pan.

title: Steamed Fish
instructions: Place butter and lemon juice in a 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Microwave on High for 30 to 45 seconds until melted. Arrange fish pieces thickest end towards outside. Sprinkle with 1/2 the salt pepper and paprika. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 8 minutes. Halfway through turn fish and sprinkle with other half of salt pepper and paprika.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix butter and sugar. Blend (with food processor if possible). Add bananas and nuts. Sift flour and add to mixture. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pralines
instructions: Prepare ahead of time. Cut open a brown paper bag and grease with oleo. Make 40 to 50 small piles of pecan halves on the greased bag. It will take 1 pint to 1 quart of pecans.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Cook noodles; rinse and drain. Mix next 8 ingredients well. Add noodles and last 4 ingredients. Mix well. Chill until ready to serve.

title: French Vanilla Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Place banana slices in crust. Pour milk into bowl. Add pudding. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Gently stir in 1 cup of the Cool Whip; spoon into crust. Refrigerate 4 hours. Top pie with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Great Potluck Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Thaw vegetables. Save 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup onions. Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake 5 minutes uncovered.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir contents of vegetable seasoning packet margarine and water in bowl. Add stuffing crumbs; stir until water is absorbed. Mix soup chicken vegetables and thyme in 2-quart casserole. Spoon stuffing over chicken mixture. Bake for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in pan and add flour. Mix well and add mushroom soup celery soup and mushrooms; set aside but keep warm. Boil remove from bone cut up and set aside the chicken. Take 2 1/2 cups of the broth from the chicken and cook rice by using directions on box using broth instead of water. Use a casserole dish and layer the mushroom mixture chicken and the rice. Alternate until all is used. Put slices of cheese on top. Put in oven long enough to melt cheese. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Pan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in pie crust. Top with ready crust. Pat butter on top. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ribbon Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of hot water. Cool add applesauce and dash of cinnamon. Pour half in a long dish. Let congeal in refrigerator. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise celery and pecans. Spread on congealed jello. Top with remaining jello congeal.

title: German Skillet Supper
instructions: Brown beef in margarine. Add other ingredients. Cook covered over low heat 30 to 35 minutes without lifting the cover until rice is tender. Serves 6.

title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
instructions: Beat eggs to blend. Add salad oil sugar and vanilla. Beat to thick and foamy. Stir in zucchini and crushed pineapple. Set aside.

title: Richard Simmons' Classic Citrus Salad
instructions: To make dressing whisk together vinegar mustard sugar salt pepper and olive oil. To make salad arrange remaining ingredients in serving bowl. Pour dressing over salad. Toss.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate with shortening. Beat eggs with sugar until thick. Sift together 1/2 cup sifted flour baking powder salt and vanilla. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread In A Can
instructions: Mix the eggs oil and sugar and add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients together. Grease soup cans well and fill 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Candied Brie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with apples pears and crackers.

title: Rueben Casserole
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into chunks. Boil approximately 10 minutes or until fork can be easily inserted. DO NOT cook until soft!

title: Picadillo
instructions: Place hamburger in large pot. Season with garlic oregano salt pepper and vinegar. Add onions peppers and tomatoes. Cook over medium heat. Chop and fold ingredients as it cooks. (Do not stir until it is fully cooked.) When ingredients look well cooked add capers olives and raisins.

title: Slime(A Fat Free Dessert)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Chill and enjoy!

title: German Sandwich
instructions: Combine ingredients except bread dough and cook at low heat stirring occasionally until done. Drain and cool. Roll out bread dough 3/8-inch thick; cut into rectangles 3 x 6-inch. Place 1/2 cup meat mixture on one end of each rectangle. Fold over and seal. Place on greased cookie sheet and let rise. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Fat-Free Rocky Road Brownies
instructions: Add ingredients one at a time; beat well after each addition. After adding marshmallow cream stir just enough to create brown and white swirls. Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch brownie pan lightly coated with cooking spray. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 18 minutes.

title: Fettucini Parmesan With Vegetables
instructions: Place chopped tomatoes onion carrot thyme parsley and pepper in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer 5 minutes. Add asparagus pieces to saucepan. Pour in vinegar and simmer mixture uncovered for 15 minutes. Add reserved tomato seeds and juice and continue cooking until most of the liquid has evaporated and asparagus is tender about 15 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook wild rice in as little water as possible until tender. Brown beef and onion; drain well. Blend all ingredients except almonds. Bake in greased casserole at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Mix together shortening sugar egg and vanilla. Beat well then add sour cream. Add flour mixture until well blended. Roll out on floured surface about 1/4 inch thick. Cut and sprinkle with sugar. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 425\u00b0 for about 12 minutes. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Low-Fat And Low-Cholesterol Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: Toast bread crumbs. In large bowl crumble corn bread and add toasted bread crumbs. Add onions celery and seasonings. Add hot broth to make a soft moist mixture. Mix well. Add margarine and milk; mixture should be very soft to allow for loss of moisture during baking; add more broth if necessary. Spray 9 x 12-inch baking pan with vegetable spray. Pour mixture in and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix all together. Drop by spoonfuls into hot fat and brown. Very good when eaten with maple syrup or pancake syrup.

title: No Peek Stew
instructions: Mix together in large roasting pan; cover. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Walnut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fully blended. Slowly beat in eggs. Sift flour salt and soda. Add to egg mixture. Blend in nuts vanilla and sour cream. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Cool in pans then invert onto wire racks.

title: Chocolate Chip Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Coat bottom and sides of an 8 inch pie plate lightly with butter. Combine chocolate syrup and chocolate chips in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on HIGH until hot about 45 seconds. Stir until smooth. Reserve 1/4 cup of the chocolate mixture. Combine remaining chocolate mixture and cereal in a medium bowl and mix to coat cereal. Press mixture over bottom and up sides of prepared pie plate. Freeze until firm about 15 minutes. Combine reserved chocolate mixture and the sour cream in a small bowl and mix well. Spread half the ice cream in the prepared pie plate. Drizzle with half the sour cream mixture. Top with remaining ice cream and drizzle with remaining sour cream mixture. Freeze pie covered until firm about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Mix together the soups and milk in a bowl. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 inch glass dish; layer ingredients as follows tortillas chicken cheese chillis onion and half the soup mixture. Repeat. Cover with remaining cheese. Refrigerate overnight or for 3 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 1 hour.

title: Fresh Raspberry Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar cornstarch and water. Bring to boil until thick. Then add Jell-O and pour over fresh raspberries in pie shell. Top with Cool Whip. Fresh strawberries can also be used with this recipe.

title: White Chicken Chili
instructions: Boil chicken in enough water to cover until chicken starts to separate from the bone about 30 minutes. Remove chicken from broth; shred and set aside. Saute onion garlic and cumin in oil. Add green chilies and saute. Add beans onion mixture and spices to chicken broth and simmer 1 hour. Add chicken and 1/2 of Monterey Jack cheese. Serve with remaining cheese.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Sift the first 4 ingredients together. Cream the shortening sugar and eggs. Add apples nuts and vanilla. Stir in the flour mixture. Pour batter into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Poke holes on top of the batter with a fork. Sprinkle top of batter with a mixture of 1/8 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Turn pan on side to cool. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Mix well to combine all flavors. Makes 4 servings.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Add eggs one at a time; mix well. Add chopped nuts. Grease Bundt pan. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon or more of sugar in bottom of pan. Sprinkle a few nuts on the sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Can add coconut to this cake.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Reserve a few French fried onions to add later. Cover dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Pour remaining onions on top. Leave uncovered. Bake another 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Choconut Caramel Bars
instructions: Melt choc. chips and shortening. Stir until mixture is smooth. Pour 1/2 of the mixture into an 8 in. foil lined square pan; spread evenly. Refrigerate until firm (15 min.). Melt caramels butter and water. Stir until caramels melt and mixture is smooth; stir in nuts until well blended. Pour into choc. lined pan. Spread evenly and refrigerate until tacky (15 min.). Top with remaining choc. (Re-heat if necessary.) Spread evenly to cover caramel filling. Return to refrigerator and chill until firm (1 hour). Cut into 1 by 2 in. rectangles. Keep refrigerated.

title: Farmer'S Salad
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Mix well. Place in a covered container. Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Yield 7 cups. Makes 9 servings.

title: Maude Rutley'S Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients for crust with a fork. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Mix well then divide the dough in half. Tear 2 sheets of waxed paper as large as your cookie sheet. Roll 1/2 of the dough between the two sheets. Fit rolled dough onto an ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Mom'S Donuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill dough at least 1 hour. Fry in hot Crisco oil. Sugar while warm.

title: Chops And Dumplings
instructions: Brown meat. Season with salt and pepper. Add onion on top and water. Cover skillet; simmer until tender. Drain off excess fat. Add 1 1/2 to 3 cups water. Meanwhile make dumplings. Stir milk and flour only until blended. Drop by spoonfuls onto hot meat (not in the liquid). Cook 10 minutes uncovered then cover tightly and cook 10 minutes longer. Thicken liquid with flour for gravy.

title: Apple Pie In Bag
instructions: You will need one large cooking bag (20 x 14-inch) with nylon tie. Prepare pie crust mix as directed for 9-inch pie crust. Line pie plate with high fluted edges. Peel core and thinly slice apples. In large bowl toss apples 1/2 cup sugar 3 tablespoons flour and cinnamon. Fill pie shell with mixture; pile high in center. In small bowl with hands knead butter remaining 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup flour into soft dough. Pull dough into small pieces; flatten each slightly and arrange on top of apple mixture. It is not necessary to completely cover apple mixture. Insert several wood skewers (4-inch tall)* so bag will not touch top of pie while baking. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place pie in bag; close with nylon tie. Cut 6 1/2-inch slits in top of bag. Place on cookie sheet. Set on center rack. Be sure bag does not touch oven sides racks or walls. Bake for 1 hour or until brown. Remove from oven. With shears cut bag open. Take out pie; bottom of pan will be greasy. Sit on wire rack to cool. Serves 8.

title: Simple Potato Dish
instructions: Cut potatoes into chunks. Place on heavy-duty foil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and soup mix. Dot with butter. Seal foil well. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Chewy Pecan Brownies
instructions: Melt oleo and sugar together in saucepan. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift in flour and cocoa; add pecans. Pour into 8 or 9-inch square pan. Start in cold oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes careful not to overbake.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Popovers
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Generously grease muffin cups. Beat eggs slightly; beat in flour milk and salt just until smooth (do not overbeat). Fill cups about 1/2 full. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes; decrease oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 15 minutes longer. Immediately remove from cups and serve hot.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Mix eggs apples lemon juice vanilla and oil together until mixed well. Add the rest of the ingredients until all are combined well. Bake at 325\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan for about 40 minutes. Cut and serve when cool.

title: Pumpkin Pecan Pie
instructions: In small mixing bowl combine eggs pumpkin sugar corn syrup vanilla cinnamon and salt; mix well. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Top with chopped pecans. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 40 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Chill. Serve topped with whipped cream. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Mix all ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Calzones
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Coat a baking sheet with a nonstick spray. Unroll pizza crust on a cutting board and stretch dough into a 12-inch square. Cut in quarters (youll have four 6-inch squares).

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Cream the margarine and peanut butter. Add brown sugar and mix well. Add eggs and mix until well blended. Stir in dry ingredients until blended then chips and nuts. Spread batter in greased and floured 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut when cool into 36 bars.

title: Chicken Breast
instructions: Layer chicken (uncooked). Cover with cheese; add soup and cover with Stove Top dressing (cooked). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes with foil. Remove foil; bake 20 minutes until brown.

title: Zucchini-Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Add eggs beat well. Stir in zucchini. Set aside. Combine flour soda baking powder salt cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Add to zucchini mixture. Stir until thoroughly combined. Stir in raisins. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on greased baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. These cookies can be frozen for later. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Ham And Cheese Rolls
instructions: Set oven at 300\u00b0. Mix first 5 items. Spread on rolls and cut in half. Put cheese and ham in rolls. Bake 20 minutes. Can be frozen.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening butter and brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients together and add them alternately with milk starting and ending with flour mixture. Stir in nuts. Pour mixture into paper-lined 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours or until straw inserted into center of cake comes out clean.

title: Egg White Meringue
instructions: Add a little cold water to cornstarch to make a paste. Stir into boiling water. Cook until thick. Cool. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add salt then sugar gradually. Beat in cold cornstarch. Put on pie. Brown in oven.

title: Delicious Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind up cranberries. Mix with apples. Add sugar. Let stand for 30 minutes. Add whipped cream marshmallows and chopped nuts. Mix all together. Pour into glass baking dish or casserole and freeze. Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion in a small amount of water until tender. Drain well. Puree in blender until smooth. Add additional ingredients except egg whites. Stir. Whip egg whites until stiff. Fold into squash mixture. Cover with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Place in a 2-quart casserole and bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dobbin
instructions: Mix ingredients as given. May be used as dessert or salad.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream and blend well the shortening sugar honey and egg. Mix and stir in sifted dry ingredients. Chill. Roll thin and cut. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Ice cookies.

title: Jello Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let set until jelled.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar egg lard and molasses well with mixer. Stir in rest of ingredients. Roll in ball size of walnut. Dip first in water then in sugar. Place sugar-side up on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. Chill for 30 minutes in icebox.

title: Oreo Cookie Pie
instructions: Crumble up Oreo cookies. Melt butter. Add cookies to butter in long cake pan making a crust.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Sift flour and sugar into bowl. Blend in butter with fingertips until well mixed. Pat evenly into bottom of an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat well. Pour into pie crust and chill. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add Philadelphia cream cheese. Then add strawberries and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Jessie'S Bundt Cake
instructions: Grease a tube pan and flour. Combine cake mix dry pudding oil water and eggs. Mix well for about 8 minutes. Add vanilla and butter flavoring. Pour batter in pan alternately with layer of sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool 8 minutes. Ice cake while warm.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Dream Squares
instructions: Mix butter sugar and flour. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients and spread on cooked cookie mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Creamy Peanut Butter  Pie
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat the cream cheese sugar and peanut butter until smooth. Fold in the whipped topping. Coarsely chop half of the peanut butter cups; stir into cream cheese mixture. Spoon into crust. Quarter remaining peanut butter cups; arrange over top. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours before cutting.

title: Chess Pie Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and egg together with hands. Press into greased oblong pan.

title: Budget Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat and onion in hot oil. Place uncooked noodles on top of meat. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the noodles. Do not stir. Bring to a boil. Turn heat low. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until noodles are tender. Serves 6.

title: Russian Cabbage
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter until slightly brown. Add tomatoes salt and pepper. Put half of cabbage in greased casserole. Alternate layers with tomato mixture. Sprinkle bread crumbs and cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Ummm good!

title: Texas Trash
instructions: The Lord is my Shepherd I shall not want.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients; spread on English muffins. Cut into quarters if desired. Freeze on cookie sheet for an hour. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cooked Chocolate Fudge Icing
instructions: Combine butter sugar cocoa and milk in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil and cook one minute more. Add vanilla and confectioners sugar. Beat with a mixer until thick or stands at a peak.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mash potatoes and mix all ingredients together. Beat until light and frothy. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Quick Apple Cake
instructions: Add brown sugar spices and eggs. Beat 1 minute. Add apples; beat 2 minutes. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Stir together flour sugar and salt. Mix with pastry cutter or by hand cheese butter and dry ingredients. Add water slowly just enough to hold the dough together. Roll out part of the dough on a floured board. The dough should be as thin as a pie crust. Cut into strips. Place on a cookie sheet and bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until strips are lightly brown. Good with salads or snacks.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add other ingredients. Pour half of mixture in a dish and let congeal. After this has congealed spread one cup sour cream over this. Then pour other half of mixture and let congeal.

title: Swede Cookies
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients. Sift together flour baking powder and baking soda. Mix all ingredients together. Roll into a tubular shape. Refrigerate until stiff. Cut into slices and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Mix and top with Velveeta slices or strips. Heat until cheese melts.

title: Pineapple Stuffing
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Stir in pineapple; fold in cubes. Turn in 2 quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Layered Avocado Dip
instructions: Smash avocados in an 8 or 9-inch pie plate. Cover avocados with sour cream. Pour taco sauce over sour cream just enough to cover sour cream. Sprinkle with grated cheese on top. Refrigerate. Serve with chips.

title: Spanish Potato Omelet
instructions: Heat oils in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add potatoes to hot oil. Turn with spatula several times to coat all slices with oil.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Add peanut butter sugar and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crusts. Refrigerate. Can be frozen.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Please use 1 large bowl. Mix marshmallows and sour cream together. Then add mandarin oranges (chopped up) and crushed pineapple. Drain the juices first. Then mix together with large can of peaches (chopped up and drained of juices). Mix all together. On top put coconut walnuts and red cherries.

title: Company Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Place each piece of chicken between two pieces of wax paper and flatten to 1/4 inch using rolling pin or meat mallet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Easy Fruit Cake
instructions: Empty cake mix in bowl add eggs applesauce salt flavoring. Beat 3 minutes.

title: No-Fry French Fries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450\u00b0. Line jelly roll pan with foil. Spray with vegetable cooking spray. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch wide slices. Toss potatoes with oil garlic salt and pepper to coat well. Bake 40 to 45 minutes tossing once or twice until potatoes are crisp and golden. Makes 4 servings.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Peel and grate potatoes onion and garlic. (I use a blender.) Combine all ingredients in bowl stirring in egg flour and seasonings. Use approximately 1/3 cup batter per pancake. Fry in skillet on medium-high temperature until edges are firm and starting to brown. Turn over and repeat on other side. Serve with butter sour cream or applesauce. Makes 8 to 10 (4-inch) pancakes.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Put aside 1/4 cup noodles. Combine remaining noodles soup water seafood celery water chestnuts and half the almonds. Put into a casserole. Top with remaining noodles and almonds. Bake uncovered 370\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Dunbutter Biscuits
instructions: Mix together; pour into muffin pan (ungreased). Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add can of French fried onions (less 1/2 cup) and can of mushrooms. Put in ungreased 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole. Heat can of mushroom soup (undiluted) to a boil. Stir in 1/2 cup sour cream. Pour over meat in casserole. Top with remaining 1/2 cup French fried onions. Cut biscuits in half and edge casserole with cut side down. Mix egg 1/2 cup sour cream salt and celery seed; pour over biscuits and across top of casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Layer Salad
instructions: Layer first 7 ingredients in order given. Combine mayonnaise and sugar. Spread evenly over top of salad. Sprinkle on dressing. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours. Toss before serving.

title: 5 Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: You may substitute flavorings.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Put croutons in bottom of casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese; add sausage and beaten eggs. Mix milk dry mustard and soup; pour over previous layers. Sprinkle mushrooms over soup mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bonnie'S Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Peel and grate the potatoes the next day. Melt margarine. Add half and half and salt. Mix all ingredients into the grated potatoes. Add grated cheese. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle additional cheese on top the last 15 minutes of baking time.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In 3-quart baking dish combine soup milk thyme and pepper. Stir in vegetables and chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes until bubbly. Cut each biscuit into quarters. Remove dish from oven stir. Arrange biscuit pieces over hot chicken mixture. Bake 15 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. (I like to sprinkle Parmesan cheese on biscuits before baking.) Makes 5 servings.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Brown ground chuck with onion flakes and drain. Stir in flour. Mix in corned beef broken up. Add remaining ingredients. Cook for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel and slice 4 cups of apples. Place in a baking pan. Sprinkle with water cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Blend together sugar flour and melted butter or margarine then spread over the top. Bake uncovered approximately 40 minutes. Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Espresso Chocolate Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat cook and stir coffee and chocolate until chocolate is melted. Add sugar and butter; cook and stir until sugar is dissolved and the butter is melted. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Serve over ice cream. Makes 1 cup.

title: Kentucky Hot Brown
instructions: In a 4-quart heavy sauce pan melt butter. Mix in flour until mixture is smooth. Add milk in small amounts at a time; cook until sauce is thick. Add Tabasco sauce and Parmesan cheese. Remove from heat. Take out 1/2 cup sauce and add to beaten egg yolks. Mix well and return to the remainder stirring constantly. Add all cheeses. Remove from heat. Toast six slices of bread on both sides. Slice each piece in half and place on a heat-resistant plate. Layer with chicken or turkey ham of your choice sauce tomato and 2 slices of bacon. Top with paprika. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Pie Crust To Freeze
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour. Mix egg and vinegar in cup. Finish filling with water. Mix into flour. Makes 5 crusts. Freeze until ready to use.

title: Light 'N Crisp Waffles
instructions: Preheat waffle maker. Put all ingredients except egg whites in a large mixer bowl. Beat on low until moistened. Increase to medium; mix until smooth. By hand gently fold in beaten egg whites. Pour 1/2 cup (125 mL) batter in center of grid. Close waffle maker; bake until golden 3 to 3 1/2 minutes. Repeat. Serve hot with your favorite topping. Yield ten 6 1/2-inch (16.25 cm) waffles.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and cheese slowly adding sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time until mixed thoroughly. Combine flour and salt; add to mixture a small amount at a time until thoroughly mixed. Add vanilla. Cook in tube pan greased and floured at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan 10 minutes then remove.

title: Phil'S Famous Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in a 5-quart pan. Drain and rinse in cold water. Chop chestnuts and pepperoni. Add ingredients and season to taste. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 5 quarts.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
instructions: Using blender mix cake mix margarine vanilla and 1 egg. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and 2 eggs and pour on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Topping forms crust on cake.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients until they form a dough. Roll out to 1/4-inch thick; cut into squares. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Leave in pan to cool for a few minutes before moving to a cooling tray. Dust with extra fine sugar.

title: Pig Licking Good Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oil and eggs together. Beat two minutes at medium speed. Cut oranges into small pieces Add oranges and juice to cake mix. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage in heavy skillet; crumble and drain. Beat eggs; mix in milk salt and mustard. Break bread into small pieces. Stir into egg mixture. Fold in cheese and sausage. Pour mixture into 9 x 13 Pyrex that has been buttered. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Venison Shipwreck
instructions: In a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole slice potatoes. On top of potatoes add venison or hamburger. Add sliced onions kidney beans and soup. Salt and pepper to taste as you make layers. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove lid and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Red Potato And Egg Salad
instructions: Combine the potatoes eggs scallions and carrots. Add the parsley caraway dill salt and pepper. Toss lightly.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Place all ingredients in a covered casserole. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Wildcat Stinger
instructions: Combine in a mixing glass half filled with ice cubes. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with lemon rind worm or olive.

title: Strawberry Fig Preserves
instructions: Mash figs; add jello and sugar. Bring to boil and cook slow for 45 minutes. Pour into jars. Seal.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: In large skillet saute the onions in the margarine until slightly browned. Next add the meat and cook until brown. Now add the flour salt pepper mushrooms garlic powder olive oil and dill weed. Cook 5 minutes. Next add the mushroom soup and allow to simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream after it has been beaten thoroughly. Now allow this to simmer until thoroughly heated. Do not boil. Serve with medium-wide noodles. This goes well with spinach salad and red wine.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Grease a 9 x 9-inch pan. Pour ingredients in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: No-Bake Maple Walnut Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Then boil 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Drop on waxed paper and cool.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Pour in unbaked crust. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Put pie in and reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake until apples are tender 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Lemon Fantastic
instructions: Blend flour oleo and 1/2 cup nuts and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Low Fat Pie Crust
instructions: Sift flour & salt. Combine in measuring cup the oil and water. Beat with fork or wisk until thick and creamy. Pour over flour all at once. Toss and cut with fork until blended. Form into ball. Save 1/4 of crust. Roll out 3/4 until it fits your pie pan. Place in pan and prick with fork. Flute edges. Roll remaining crust and cut into leaf shapes for top of pie.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Let cream cheese get to room temperature. Whip in bowl. Add Jell-O; mix then add water 1 cup at a time. Add frozen strawberries thawed drained and chopped. Mix. Add nuts and mix again. Put in mold (Tupperware mold). Put in refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours. Make sure it is very firm. Garnish with Cool Whip and fresh strawberries.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake in 9 x 12-inch prepared pan for 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Unbaked Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil. Boil exactly 2 minutes. Take off heat. Add salt vanilla oats and coconut. Stir like mad. Drop on wax paper.

title: Paprikas Csirke(Hungarian Stewed Chicken)
instructions: Rinse chicken and cut up. Rinse chicken parts and sprinkle with salt. Finely chop onion and saute in shortening (not butter) until tender. Remove from heat. Add paprika and mix well. Add chicken parts and mix well to coat chicken. Return to heat. Simmer covered on low heat until chicken is tender (water need not be added). For a creamy gravy mix flour into sour cream and blend into sauce.

title: Corn Topper Casserole
instructions: Place beans in layer on bottom of 2-quart buttered casserole. Sprinkle onions on top. Spread undiluted soup over them. Add ham. Bake in hot 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Impossible Custard Pie
instructions: Mix in order in blender. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes in 10-inch greased pie pan (glass). This makes two pies.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Pour into a pan the first 3 ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix completely and drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Sausage Stew
instructions: Cut sausage potatoes and carrots into bite size pieces. Simmer sausage until done in a deep pot. Add potatoes and enough tomato puree or sauce to cover. Cook over low heat for 1/2 hour. Keep it covered. Drain peas. Add peas and carrots and cook covered over low heat until all are tender.

title: Crispy Potato Wedges
instructions: Place potatoes in large bowl; add cold water to cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spray a nonstick baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray. Set aside. Drain potatoes in a colander. Spread on a double layer of paper towels. Cover with a second layer of paper towels. Press down on the towels to dry potatoes. Transfer potatoes to a clean large bowl. Sprinkle with oil pepper and salt; toss gently to combine. Arrange seasoned potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes using a spatula turn potatoes; sprinkle with garlic salt. Bake until golden about 20 minutes turning baking sheet after 10 minutes for even browning. Serve immediately with ketchup on the side.

title: One Bowl Macaroons
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Drop from teaspoon (1-inch apart) onto well-greased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Remove at once from baking sheets. Makes about 2 dozen macaroons.

title: Layered Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Layer first 5 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan in order given. Pour water over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breast in water until tender. Drain; cool and save broth. Pull meat off bones. Place in casserole dish. Combine soups and milk. Pour over chicken. Top with dressing mix. Sprinkle with broth until it is moist. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sherry Wine Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all of the above ingredients well. Pour into a greased tube pan. Bake until toothpick clean.

title: Fat-Free Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water until done. Leave some water. While still on stove break up cheese. Cook until melted.

title: Hawaiian Pineapple Crush
instructions: Put into blender and frappe until slushy. May add 1 banana for extra flavor if desired.

title: Pineapple-Apricot Cheesecake Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and brown sugar. Stir in flour and nuts. Reserve

title: Green Bean Moussaka
instructions: Put green beans in 2-quart casserole. Brown meat; drain fat. Stir in tomato sauce garlic and cinnamon. Spread over green beans. Combine eggs and cottage cheese. Spread over meat. Put olives and Parmesan on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Almond Biscotti
instructions: Stir together flour baking soda baking powder and salt in large bowl. In a separate bowl mix sugar butter eggs zest of oranges and lemons vanilla and almond extract. Mix contents of both bowls together and then add sliced almonds. Grease two baking sheets with Crisco. Take a handful of dough and form a 4-inch wide and 3/4-inch thick biscotti on a sheet of floured waxed paper. The length can be as long as you can fit on your baking sheet. Set the baking sheet on top of the dough then flip over and peel of the waxed paper. Put in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until light brown. Mix egg white and powdered sugar and brush on biscotti and put back in oven for 10 minutes until golden brown. Remove from oven and cool. Cut with serrated knife crosswise into 1/2-inch slices and place the cookies on their sides on the baking sheets. Bake 15 minutes longer. Transfer to racks and cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Pork Chop Skillet
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet. Add pork chops and brown 2 minutes per side. Remove pork. Put onion in skillet and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add sauerkraut gravy and butternut squash. Cover. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 8 minutes. Stir and top with pork chops. Cover and simmer 4 to 5 minutes or until pork is no longer pink near the bone. Makes 4 servings.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush Oreos and put in a bowl. In another bowl blend the pudding with the milk; fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate mixture for 2 to 3 minutes for pudding to thicken. In large bowl cream the cream cheese butter and powdered sugar (until creamy). Take the pudding from the refrigerator and add it to the cream cheese mixture. Stir until mixed thoroughly. Starting with the crushed cookies layer the mixture and the cookies. Top and bottom layers should be cookies. Arrange gummy worms on the surface of the mixture; stick the flowers in the middle and dig in!

title: World Famous Buckhall Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Simmer on low for 45 minutes or until warm. Great over chicken. Enough for a large crowd.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Line bottom of casserole (9 x 13-inch) with bread. Beat eggs; add milk and beat once again. Combine with ingredients in order listed and pour over bread. Cover and cook for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into buttered pie pan. Drain peaches saving syrup. Arrange peaches over batter. Beat the cream cheese sugar and peach juice until smooth. Spread over peaches to within 1-inch of edge of batter. Sprinkle top with sugar and cinnamon.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Party Dip
instructions: Combine onion and cream cheese. Thin with dressing. Serve with cauliflower or fresh vegetables.

title: Ship Wreck Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in small amount of oil. Add ground beef and cook until brown. Add seasoning to taste. Add corn soups and half of cheese. Simmer for a few minutes mix with cooked noodles. Pour into a large casserole dish and add remaining cheese to top. Bake at 350 degrees until cheese melts and is bubbly.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Line pan with dried beef. Roll chicken breasts and put a slice of bacon around each one. Put in pan. Mix cream of chicken soup (dont add water) and sour cream. Pour over chicken and sprinkle with paprika. Cook for 3 hours covered at 300\u00b0 (last 30 minutes uncovered). If you warm over warm it slow.

title: Pistachio Crunch Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding eggs oil and sour cream in large mixing bowl. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. In another bowl combine brown sugar cinnamon and pecan pieces. Mix good with hand. Sprinkle half of this in greased Bundt pan. Spoon batter over this. Sprinkle the remaining half of sugar mixture over batter. Place in cold oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Blend onion celery leaves parsley flour butter salt pepper and milk in blender. Arrange potato slices in a 2-quart casserole dish. Pour mixture over potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Cappuccino
instructions: Combine in large bowl. Store in airtight container. 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup hot water.

title: Springtime Asparagus
instructions: Mix mushrooms dressing and lemon juice in large nonstick skillet. Cook on medium heat 5 minutes. Stir frequently. Top with asparagus. Cover. Reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer 5 minutes or more. Sprinkle with almonds.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to package directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool 15 minutes. While cake cools bring to a boil in medium saucepan the milk sugar and 1/2 cup of the coconut. Boil 5 minutes. Punch holes in cake with fork and spoon hot coconut milk over cake. Cool completely.

title: Biscuits Supreme
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together; cut in shortening with pastry blender. Add milk all at once; stir only until the dough will follow fork around the bowl. Turn out on a floured surface. Knead gently for 1 minute. Roll out 1/2 inch thick and cut with a biscuit cutter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes in a greased baking pan.

title: Banana Split Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs at medium speed until frothy. Gradually add sugar beating until thick. Add skim milk and salt. Mix well. Pour egg mixture into a large pot. Place over low heat. Cook stirring constantly until heated thoroughly. Combine egg mixture condensed milk evaporated milk and vanilla. Stir well. Add bananas cherries and nuts. Freeze in a 1 1/2 gallon freezer. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes after freezing.

title: Orange Cranberry Relish
instructions: Cut orange into eights removing seed. Grind orange and cranberries and add water and sugar. Relish may be stored in refrigerator for weeks or in freezer 6 months.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except crumbs. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with crumbs and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. For crumbs melt 2 tablespoons butter and add 1 cup cracker crumbs. Mix with bread.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Put garlic and salt in salad oil for 1 hour. Mix together the cider vinegar and lemon juice. Remove garlic clove from oil (if desired) and gradually add vinegar mixture to oil and beat until frothy. Mix in 4 hard-boiled eggs to a pound of spinach. Add generous amount of crisp crumbled bacon. Use fresh spinach only. Wash very thoroughly to eliminate sand and cut off stems. One pound of spinach serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Grind zucchini to make 10 cups. Combine with ground peppers and onions. Sprinkle salt over vegetables. Let stand overnight in fridge. The next morning rinse in cold water; press out. Add turmeric nutmeg celery pepper cornstarch vinegar and sugar to vegetables. Cook gently 20 to 30 minutes. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal immediately. Put in water bath to seal lid for 30 minutes. Makes 8 pints.

title: Quick Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients together; reserve 1/2 cup for topping. Add the 1/2 cup additional flour baking powder and baking soda to the first mixture; mix well. Add the egg vanilla and buttermilk to the mixture; mix well. Place in greased 9 x 9-inch cake pan. Sprinkle the topping on; bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Date Cake
instructions: Cream butter with sugar and eggs. Add bananas and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Blend well. Stir in dates and nuts. Pour into tube loaf or layer pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Baked Summer Squash
instructions: Wash and trim squash. Shred with shredder or in food processor to measure 4 cups.

title: Uncle Bob'S Pink Salmon Dip
instructions: Mix well together. Spread on crackers or toast and serve.

title: Jager-Eintopf(Hunter'S Stew)
instructions: *Ground beef should only be ground once and be the leanest you can get.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and let stand for 4 hours.

title: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Saute onion garlic and green pepper until soft. Add mushrooms and carrots. Saute 3 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Add jalapenos Worcestershire and Pic-a-Pepper sauce to taste. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Uncover and simmer for 10 minutes. Taste for spice (hotness). Serve in bowls and top with your choice of cheese.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Separate eggs; reserve about 1/4 cup coconut. Whip egg whites. Combine all other ingredients; cook over low heat until thickened; pour into pie shell. Top with egg whites; sprinkle with 1/4 cup coconut. Brown on broil for about 2 minutes.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Pour into a saucepan together; simmer. Make 6 servings of Minute rice. Pour simmered beans over rice to serve. Allow to set a few minutes to mingle flavors.

title: Cappuccino Mix
instructions: Mix well add 3 to 4 tsp. per 8-10 oz. cup of water.

title: Ham And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Mix together eggs milk dry mustard salt and mushrooms. Grease a casserole dish. Alternate layers of bread cheese and ham. Pour milk and egg mixture over and let stand overnight. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Puff Pastry
instructions: Melt butter in 1/4 cup boiling water. Add flour and a dash of salt. Stir good until it forms a ball. Remove from heat and add 1 egg and cheese. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet (bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes). Stuff with chicken ham or tuna salad.

title: Hickory Smoked Brisket
instructions: Place brisket on a large piece of aluminum foil. Sprinkle generously with 1/4 cup liquid smoke and spices. Wrap well. Put in crockpot. Cover and cook on low 10 - 12 hours or high 4 to 6 hours. Slice brisket into thin slices. Serve warm with juices poured over brisket.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. In large bowl mix butter salt Parmesan pepper and egg. Add spaghetti and toss. Spread evenly in 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown meat adding onion green pepper and garlic. Drain off fat. Stir in sauce sugar and oregano. Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti layer. Top with meat mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella. Bake another 10 minutes.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender. Drain. Peel and cut potatoes in half lengthwise. Place in a greased shallow baking pan. Set aside.

title: Cheese And Chipped Beef Log
instructions: Combine ingredients and put chipped beef on top. Serve with crackers.

title: Cabbage Au Gratin
instructions: Cut up cabbage and cook in salted water until tender. Make a white sauce with the butter flour and milk.

title: Hungarian Nut Crescents
instructions: Mix salt with flour in bowl. Cut in butter until mixture makes coarse crumbs. Blend together in separate bowl sour cream egg yolk and vanilla. Gradually add to flour mixture mixing well. Chill until firm enough to handle about 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Divide dough into 3 parts. Roll each part on a lightly floured board into a 9 to 10-inch circle about 1/8-inch thick. Cut each circle into 12 wedges. Mix nuts sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle 3/4 of the mixture over the wedges. Roll from widest end to the point. Brush with egg white and sprinkle with remaining nut mixture. Bake on greased baking sheets at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Yield 3 dozen.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Boil the syrup water and 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar. Boil and add the marshmallows and vanilla. Boil and add 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar so you will have 3 cups all together (powdered sugar). Do not add last 1 1/2 cups sugar until it boils. Pour over popcorn. (I use my turkey roaster full of popcorn.) Shape into balls. Use oleo on your hands or use 2 Baggies over your hands. Two drops of red or green coloring may be added for Christmas.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix vegetables; bring to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes. Place in pint jars and process 5 minutes at 5 pounds of pressure to can. Makes 8 pints.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Cream together oil sugar egg and vanilla. Add dry ingredients which have been blended together. Add nuts. Spread in greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut in squares. If desired top unbaked dough with 1/2 package chocolate or butterscotch chips or Holiday M&Ms.

title: Apricot Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix eggs oil sugar and apricot nectar juice. Pour batter into a well-greased and floured Bundt tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown. Let set in pan 15 minutes and then turn out. While still warm drizzle the topping over cake.

title: Macaroni And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook the macaroni in salted water until tender about 8 minutes. Add the tomatoes and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Onion Cheese Supper Bread
instructions: Saute onion in oil until tender but not brown. Combine egg and milk. Add to biscuit mix and stir until moistened. Add onion half of cheese and parsley. Spread dough in a greased 8-inch round cake pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and parsley. Drizzle butter over top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Rainbow Punch
instructions: Mix 1 can each lemonade orange juice and grape juice with water as directed on cans. Pour each juice into an ice cube tray setting aside any juice that is leftover. Freeze. About 15 minutes before serving mix second can of lemonade and combine with ginger ale in punch bowl. Add remaining reconstituted fruit juices. Makes 2 quarts or 12 to 14 servings.

title: Judy'S Cocktail Meat Balls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well and then add next 4 ingredients. Mix well and shape into 1-inch balls.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix and roll into little balls and sprinkle with sugar. Place cookies on cookie sheet. Press down with fork. Bake at 300\u00b0 until faintly brown 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Gluten Steaks
instructions: Gradually mix liquid ingredients into dry ingredients and knead dough. Roll half at a time on board on wet surface. Slice off 1/2-inch at a time. Keep your hands wet and press slices flat. Drop one at a time into broth and cook 25 minutes. Keep cover on and stir once in awhile.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Mix all in dressing jar. Serve over green salad.

title: Hot Jambalaya
instructions: Saute ham sausage and vegetables in butter until soft. Stir in stock tomatoes Ro-Tel and seasoning. Bring to a boil and add rice. Cook until rice has absorbed liquid 40 minutes for whole grain rice or you may use Minute rice and reduce time. Stir in steamed shelled shrimp. Have the deli department of your grocery steam shrimp to save time.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Remove crust from bread. Butter on both sides; break into pieces and place in bottom of 9 x 13 casserole dish. Fry sausage and crumble; set aside to drain. Sprinkle sausage and cheese on top of bread. Combine milk eggs and salt; beat well. Pour on top of casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: In an ovenproof skillet cook sausage until lightly browned. Add eggplant onions and green peppers. Cook until tender-crisp. Stir in rice broth tomatoes and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Fluff lightly with a fork. Remove bay leaf.

title: Homemade Lemonade
instructions: In a half gallon pitcher put the 2 cups of hot water and the sugar. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add lemon juice and the 4 cups of cold water. Add ice to make a half gallon.

title: Corn Bread Chili Pie
instructions: Combine in skillet and brown the beef and onion. Add tomato soup salt corn chili powder and peppers. Mix and simmer 15 minutes. Put in greased casserole and top with corn bread topping which has been mixed acccording to directions on mix. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Russian Chicken
instructions: Mix Russian dressing preserves and onion soup. Pour over chicken and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken - Polish Style(Kurczeta Po Polsku)
instructions: Sprinkle the chicken with salt; let stand 1 hour. Chop the livers finely. Combine with bread crumbs egg salt to taste dill weed pepper and as much milk as needed for a loose sour cream-like consistency. Fill cavity of chicken with crumb mixture; truss. Place chicken in\troasting pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Baste often with melted butter.

title: Cheesy Chicken Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir together all ingredients. Pour into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake 1 hour. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar; add flour and nuts and mix. Set aside 1 cup of the mixture for topping. Press remainder in bottom of 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Blend sugar and cream cheese until smooth; add egg milk lemon juice and vanilla. Beat well. Spread over bottom crust and sprinkle with reserved 1 cup topping. Return to oven and bake 25 minutes more. Cool then chill and cut into triangles. May double recipe and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Makes 20 to 25 bars.

title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add sifted flour alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Measure all ingredients into a large bowl. Mix together. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 40 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Beef-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in skillet until beef is browned. Add salt pepper oregano and tomato sauce. Simmer slowly. Combine cottage cheese cream cheese sour cream and green pepper. Place half the noodles in bottom of greased 3-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese mixture; add remaining noodles. Pour meat mixture over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan and let brown slightly. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Freeze Peaches
instructions: In large bowl mix orange juice and sugar. Then slice peaches in bowl. Make sure all peaches have juice on them. Put in container and freeze.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In medium bowl blend together soup and sour cream; set aside. In large bowl toss together chicken onion 4 ounces Cheddar and picante sauce. Moisten with about 1/4 of soup mixture. Divide chicken mixture evenly among tortillas by spooning across center. Blend broth into remaining soup mixture. Cover bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish with some soup mixture. Roll tortillas tightly and place seam side down in single layer. Spread with remaining soup mixture and sprinkle with remaining 4 ounces Cheddar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour half of batter into pan. Spread half of cheese on batter. Add remaining batter and top with rest of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until brown around edges.

title: Nut Puffs
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0 slow oven. Mix together butter sugar and vanilla. Stir in flour and nuts. Form dough into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake about 30 minutes. While still hot roll puffs in confectioners sugar.

title: Scalloped Potatoes  With Ham
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice thin. Make white sauce with margarine flour and milk. Put half the potatoes in a greased 2-quart pan. Cover with half the sauce seasonings onion and ham. Add remaining potatoes seasonings onion and ham then remaining sauce. Cover and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking until top is browned. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Mix yeast margarine egg water and sugar in large bowl. Add flour and mix well. Cover and refrigerate. Use as needed.

title: Zucchini Hot Dish
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for approximately 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Keep a close eye on this casserole after 45 minutes of baking; it browns quickly!

title: Dirt Pie
instructions: Crush cookies in food processor until it looks like dirt. Set aside. Cream oleo powdered sugar and cream cheese. Mix milk and instant pudding. In a large bowl layer cookie crumbs to start and use cookie crumbs to top.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and extract; beat well. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Chill for 1 to 2 hours. Shape into 1 1/4-inch balls. Place 2 1/2-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 11 to 13 minutes or until lightly browned (do not overbake). Cool 1 minute on pan before removing to a wire rack. Yield 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Monkey Bread-Cinnamon Pull Aparts
instructions: Dip each biscuit in melted margarine and then in mixture of sugars nuts and cinnamon. Stand on edge in 9 x 5 x 4-inch loaf pan. Make 2 side by side rows. Sprinkle with remaining sugar mixture. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes more or until golden and biscuits are done. Cool 5 minutes and turn out on serving plate. Great for Saturday morning breakfast or cold winter evening treat.

title: Creole Eggs
instructions: Saute onions peppers and celery in a large skillet in 4 tablespoons melted butter. Add tomatoes chili powder salt and pepper. Cook until thick. In a separate pan melt 2 tablespoons butter. Add flour and blend thoroughly. Add milk and stir until thickened to make a white sauce. Combine with tomato mixture. Slice eggs in round slices. In a buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass baking dish place a layer of white sauce and tomato mixture and a layer of eggs alternately until ingredients are used ending with sauce. Top with buttered plain toasted bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

title: Roquefort-Sherry Mayonnaise
instructions: Process the egg yolks mustard and vinegar in a food processor or blender just to combine about 30 seconds. With the machine running pour the oil in a thin steady stream through the feed tube to make a thick mayonnaise. Add Roquefort and process just until combined (not smooth). Season to taste with salt and pepper. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Spice Cake With Apple Pie Filling
instructions: Mix pie filling cake mix and eggs together. Put 1/2 batter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 sugar and cinnamon over it. Put remaining 1/2 batter in pan and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 sugar and cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Breakfast Rolls
instructions: Roll crescent rolls out flat. Spread slightly with butter. Sprinkle with nuts. Mix butter honey and confectioners sugar and set aside. Separate each roll and roll up crescent style. Place in sprayed 8 x 12-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown. Drizzle honey mixture on warm cooked rolls not hot rolls.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Combine sugar syrup butter and salt in a 2-quart dish. Bring to a boil in microwave. Boil on High for 2 minutes. Add vanilla and soda. Stir until smooth. Put corn in a paper sack. Pour mixture over corn. Shake well. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High. Shake again. Return to microwave. Cook on High 1 1/2 minutes. Shake again.

title: Milky Way Ice Cream
instructions: In heavy saucepan melt candy bars in 2 cups milk. Cool. Beat egg and add sugar. Beat well again. Add vanilla remaining milk and half and half. Combine mixtures and mix well. Pour into gallon freezer can. Add extra milk if needed to come to fill line. Freeze according to freezer directions.

title: Peel A Pound Soup
instructions: Dice or cube all veggies. Place in a large pot. Add water; add seasonings and simmer until thick. Can add other vegetables if you like. Only 97 calories per serving.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Mix together in crock-pot the white almond bark chocolate chips cocoa and vegetable oil. Melt together then blend in cocktail peanuts until somewhat stiff probably 2 large packages. Then drop onto wax paper and cool. Can add paraffin to make shiny.

title: Grandma Hardin'S Christmas Jam Cakegroves, Texas
instructions: Cream butter and sugar and add eggs. Add other ingredients and beat all until they are blended. Cook at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa together. Remove from heat and stir in sugar and eggs. Mix well. Add flour salt chopped nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Spoon batter into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle marshmallows on top of warm cake. Cover with your favorite chocolate frosting. I like to use this

title: Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over potatoes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Grilled Corn-On-The-Cob
instructions: Peel and cut up eggplant. Dip in beaten egg and roll in a mixture of flour and Italian bread crumbs. Brown in oil and drain on paper towels. Put a layer of eggplant in a baking dish. Add each additional layer in order spaghetti sauce (Ragu) Parmesan cheese Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle dried minced onion and chili powder on top. Repeat layers. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

title: Dressing For Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix well and bring to boil. Simmer for 3 minutes. Pour over cabbage bell pepper and onions. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Easy Sticky Buns
instructions: Mix together brown sugar butter and corn syrup. Spread in bottom of two 8-inch square baking pans. Mix together pecans cinnamon and white sugar. Divide in half for each tube of rolls.

title: Herb Dip For Vegetables
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let set in refrigerator several hours.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash butter salt pepper and onion; add beaten eggs. Alternate layers of squash bread crumbs and cheese in a 1-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce(Makes 6 To 7 Quarts)
instructions: Grind peppers and onions. Cook 1/2 hour in oil. Put through a sieve then add to juice. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until thickened. Put sauce in sterilized jars and seal. Process 15 minutes in pressure canner.

title: Magic Chocolate French Fudge
instructions: In top of double boiler melt chocolate over hot water; stir occasionally. Remove from heat. Add sweetened condensed milk salt vanilla extract and nut meats. Stir only until smooth. Turn into waxed paper lined 8-inch square pan. Spread mixture evenly and smooth surface. Refrigerate about 2 hours or until firm. Turn candy onto cutting board to cut. Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken Feed
instructions: Melt almond bark. Mix all ingredients together well and drop on wax paper. Leave until firm. Put in plastic bag or airtight container. Can be frozen. Great for all ages.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Heat oil in large saucepan. Saute the onions garlic and green pepper until softened. Add the mushrooms and saute until tender. Add the ground beef and pepper. Cook until meat loses its red color. Drain well. Add tomato sauce tomato paste basil oregano parsley and bay leaves. Simmer 1 1/2 hours or until sauce has thickened. While cooking if sauce becomes too thick add small amount of water as needed.

title: Egg Yolk Pie Pastry
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Place egg in cup size measure. Add enough water to make a scant cupful. Beat. Sprinkle egg water mixture over flour mixture and mix with a fork until crumbly. Form into 5 or 6 pie portions. Roll out on floured board in pie shapes. Make into pies.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: Put butter in cold heavy skillet. Melt slowly; add eggs sugar salt and dates. Cook slowly stirring constantly and mashing dates for 12 to 15 minutes or until very thick. Pour over Rice Krispies and mix well. Cool and form into balls or figures. Roll in coconut. Yields 25 servings.

title: Apple Good
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and lightly dust with flour one baking dish 9-inches square and 2-inches deep.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding dry with pineapple and juice. Add marshmallows. Add Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Rice Broccoli Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl and spoon into a lightly oiled casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo; add onion and celery and saute until clear. Add broccoli and stir. Add soup; stir and simmer several minutes. Add Cheez Whiz and mix. Add rice; stir and simmer. Bake in buttered casserole at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Winter Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: In an 8-quart kettle melt butter and cook onions until tender about 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in ground beef. Add garlic. Cook until brown. Add remaining ingredients. Bring soup to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer soup covered for 1 1/2 hours. Make day or 2 before serving. Stretch by adding more carrots potatoes or other vegetables.

title: No-Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Use a rectangular (8 x 13-inch) pan or glass dish for crust. Mix cheesecake according to directions. Mix in softened cream cheese Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice. Fold in other ingredients until well blended. Pour in crust; chill for at least an hour. Top with your favorite pie filling.

title: Lucky If You Get A Bite
instructions: Mix flour and butter and bake in long cake pan until light brown. Mix cream cheese and brown sugar and spread over first layer when cool. Mix vanilla instant pie filling with milk. Beat until thick then spread over second layer. On third layer spread Cool Whip and pecans.

title: Dip For Raw Vegetables
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Chill before serving. May be made several days ahead of time.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook spinach and drain well. Stir in all remaining ingredients. Chill mixture. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Place butter sugar milk cocoa and salt in heavy saucepan over low heat until butter melts. Stir frequently with wooden spoon. When butter has melted and starts to boil let boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add oats peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper to cool.

title: Gingerbread Boys
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Blend in molasses water flour salt soda ginger nutmeg and allspice. Cover; chill 2 to 3 hours. Roll dough 1/4-inch thick on lightly covered floured cloth board. Cut with cutter. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Press raisins into dough for eyes nose and buttons. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove immediately from cookie sheet. Cool and decorate.

title: Beef Tips
instructions: Combine stew meat with other ingredients. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
instructions: Chop bell pepper and onion. Drain corn and mix together with mayonnaise. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Blueberry Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar vanilla blueberries and milk. Freeze. Whip frozen mixture then fold in heavy cream. Return to freezer.

title: Shrimp Souffle
instructions: Layer shrimp bread and cheese in greased casserole. Pour over oleo and egg mixture. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered. Makes 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Prebake a pastry shell. Hull and wash strawberries. Place 3 cups strawberries in the baked and cooled shell. In a saucepan simmer together 1 cup strawberries and 2/3 cup water for 3 minutes. Mix together the cornstarch in 1/3 cup water. Add the cornstarch mixture and 1 cup sugar to the cooked strawberries. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute. The mixture will start milky and then turn clear. Pour the mixture over the strawberries in the pastry shell and cool. Serve with whipped cream

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring water and margarine to boil. Stir in flour until it leaves edge of pan and forms a ball (only about one minute). Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm. Beat eggs one at a time and blend with flour mixture. Spoon out cream puffs on cookie sheets. Puffs should be size of biscuit. Bake 40 minutes or until golden brown in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Oreo Cookie Balls
instructions: Crush cookies real fine. Mix with cream cheese. Form into balls. Chill for 30 minutes. Dip into melted almond bark. Store in refrigerator.

title: Scratch Pancakes
instructions: Stir all ingredients in a medium bowl and spoon onto hot griddle. Quick easy and good!

title: Salmon Patties Or Loaf
instructions: Remove bones and break into chunks. Add crackers beaten eggs seasoning onions and some liquid from salmon. Mix thoroughly and shape into patties or loaf. Either fry or bake in greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
