instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and pour in baking dish. Top with brown sugar pecans and 1/3 cup butter. Spread on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cherry Cupcake
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar vanilla and eggs until creamy. Put paper liners in the cupcake pan. Put Nilla Wafers into paper cup liner then pour 2/3 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Put cherry pie filling on top and chill.

title: English Cookies
instructions: Mix together and drop by spoonfuls onto buttered pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Potato Cheese Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk salt chicken vegetables 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 onions. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Unwrap rolls. Separate into 2 rectangles. Press together perforated cuts. Cut each rectangle lengthwise into 6 strips. Lattice over casserole. Bake uncovered 15 minutes then top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Cranberry Swirl Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in pineapple and cranberry sauce. Chill until partially set. Spoon into 8 inch square dish. Spoon sour cream on top and stir to swirl. Chill until firm. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Pastitsio
instructions: Cook onion and turkey in skillet over medium heat until onion is soft and turkey is no longer pink. Add tomato sauce and spices. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients; beat 3 minutes. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bite Size Apple Pies
instructions: Place cinnamon and sugar in a gallon size plastic bag and shake mixing well. Set aside. Unroll crescents and cut each in half longways. You should now have 16 pieces. Slice apples into 8 equal pieces and place into sugar mixture. Shake to coat well. Place apples onto crescent dough and roll them up wide end first. Put onto cookie sheet. Pop into 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 16 mini pies.

title: Gau (Chinese Mochi Cake)
instructions: Combine Mochiko sugar and baking soda. Add coconut milk and water. Mix well. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Pour batter into a greased pan and top with sesame seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Microwave Peanut Patties
instructions: Boil on High for 3 minutes. Stir and add 1 1/2 cups raw peanuts. Cook on High for 9 minutes (soft boil). Add 2 tablespoons of butter and 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Add a few drops of red food coloring. Stir until cool and thick. Drop on wax paper.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook macaroni as package label directs; drain.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together. Put in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cocoa Sheath Cake(Excellent)
instructions: In a big bowl sift together the sugar and flour. Mix in saucepan and bring to a boil the oleo cocoa Crisco and water. Pour over flour and sugar and mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in greased pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Raspberry Pie
instructions: You will need 1 baked pie shell or 1 graham cracker crust. Mix sugar cornstarch or clear jel and water. Bring to boil. Boil a little then add raspberry jello mixing well. Cool then add raspberries. May need to use less water with frozen berries. Put in pie shells and chill. Top with whipped topping or whipped cream.

title: Best Yet Cracker Jacks
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients. Boil for 5 minutes. Add soda and stir into 5 quarts popped corn. Spread on well-greased cookie sheet. Place in a 225\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Stir frequently. (Peanuts may be added if desired.)

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion add peppers. Mix eggs milk and oil. Add bread mix and corn. Pour half of batter into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread meat mixture sprinkle cheese. Add rest of batter. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven approximately 45 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef in a large skillet. Drain and place in a 4-quart crock-pot. Saute onion and bell pepper in skillet until onion is clear. Add to crock-pot along with remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cook on high setting 3 to 4 hours or low setting for 6 to 8 hours. This can be frozen and is also good in taco shells.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Drain pineapple chunks and reserve. Pour syrup into small saucepan. Add sugar lemon and orange slices and cinnamon. Bring to simmer; cook 5 minutes. Add cranberries; simmer until they begin to burst. Stir in drained pineapple chunks. Serve warm or cold. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Creamy Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile for sauce in a medium saucepan cook the mushrooms and onion in the butter (or margarine) until vegetables are tender. Stir in cream cheese salt and pepper. Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Gradually stir in milk and chives; heat through. Pour sauce over pasta. Toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Venison Stroganoff
instructions: Brown venison cubes in butter. Stir in onion soup mix. Add water parsley garlic powder pepper and oregano. When meat is tender add 1/2 cup of sour cream. Blend 1/4 cup cornstarch with small amount of water. Stir into meat until thickened. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Flour each side of roast. Brown on each side in pan. Add 3/4 cup water. Simmer covered 3 to 4 hours. One hour before done add carrots potatoes onions and seasonings to taste garlic etc.

title: Oven Omelet
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Beat eggs milk and salt. Add bacon cheese and onion. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake uncovered 40 to 45 minutes or until omelet is set and top is golden brown.

title: No Bake Strawberry Yogurt Pie
instructions: In a bowl mix yogurt and Cool Whip and crushed strawberries (save some to spread on top if desired) together. Pour into graham cracker Ready-Crust. Chill; serve. Makes a nice light dessert.

title: Molasses Crinkles
instructions: Mix shortening sugar egg and molasses. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill dough. Roll into balls. Dip in sugar. Sprinkle with 2 or 3 drops of water. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Oven-Barbecued Ribs For 4
instructions: Salt and pepper short ribs. Place in layer in shallow baking pan. Add water. Cover with foil. Bake 1 1/2 hours in hot oven at 400\u00b0. Saute onion and garlic in butter. Add tomato puree salt celery salt Worcestershire sauce mustard and liquid smoke. Simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove ribs from oven. Drain off some fat if desired. Spoon sauce over ribs. Bake uncovered 30 minutes.

title: New York Brass Rail Cheesecake
instructions: Blend well in large mixer bowl. Butter a deep 10-inch spring-form pan. Line the bottom with crushed lemon cookies. Pour batter into pan. Place cake pan into a larger pan of hot water half the depth of the cake pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 80 minutes or until completely set. Let cool thoroughly before removing from spring-form pan.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in casserole. Cover with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hungry Jack Beef Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown ground beef and drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles. Place cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Use 8 x 8-inch greased pan.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 4 long triangles and place crosswise on ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Press over bottom and up the sides to form a crust. Seal perforations. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Cream together butter sugar eggs and buttermilk. Set aside. Sift together flour soda baking powder and spices. Add flour mixture to the first 4 ingredients; mix well. Add prunes vanilla and nuts. Blend well and pour into pan of choice. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and molasses. Add sifted dry ingredients (not sugar). Beat until smooth. Roll into small ball and drop into sugar. Put on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugars egg and vanilla until fluffy. Add in flour soda and salt. When well mixed add in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop teaspoon of dough on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: E-Z Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: In saucepan combine soup water and cheese. Heat until cheese melts. Stir occasionally. Add remaining ingredients and heat.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Melt butter and cool. Add all other ingredients one at a time. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 40 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Party Salad
instructions: Dissolve cherry jello in boiling water. Add Knox gelatine pineapple and blueberry pie filling. Pour into 9 x 11-inch rectangular dish. After this mixture is firm spread with Cool Whip. Can be used in a mold.

title: Breakfast Bundt Rolls
instructions: Place in bundt pan in above order. Put in cold over overnight. In the morning bake at 325\u00b0. Do not preheat oven. Bake 30-45 minutes. Then invert on plate while hot. If you have a gas stove you can place the rolls in the microwave overnight.

title: Champagne Punch
instructions: Use punch bowl with large piece of ice. Have plenty of fruit mixed well. Use fruit like pineapple bits orange slices lime and strawberries.

title: Soup Au Giraumon Squash
instructions: Wash meat with lemon and rinse with warm water. Cut and combine all ingredients into a casserole with enough water. Boil and cook until everything is tender for about 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Serve warm.

title: Our French Onion Soup
instructions: Peel the onions and chop roughly. Melt the butter in the pan; fry the onions. Once brown sprinkle flour and stir well. Pour wine and water over them; allow to boil. In a large ovenproof bowl place 1 slice of bread then 1 slice of cheese and so on. Pour the contents of the pan over the bread and cheese; cook in oven for 35 minutes at 325\u00b0. Mix and serve. Top with Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Add 1 egg at a time. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Grease and flour 3 loaf pans.

title: Grandmom'S Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Cut tomatoes and onions into thin slices. Stew until tender. Jar while hot.

title: Butterhorns
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add eggs sugar salt and butter. Then add flour. Let rise. Roll out into a circle and cut into pie shape. Roll up from wide edge. Let rise. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apricot Wafer Pie
instructions: Combine cookie crumbs and 2 Tbsp. melted butter. Spread 3/4 of the crumbs on the bottom of a 7x11-inch pan.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use 3 teaspoons per 6-ounce cup of hot water. Sweeten if desired. Makes 4 pints.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix pineapple flour and sugar together and pour into a greased dish. Melt margarine and add crackers and cheese. Pour over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Berry Shortcake
instructions: Combine all cake ingredients except strawberries and whipped cream. Beat at medium speed until well mixed. Spread in a greased and floured 9-inch square baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely. Cut into squares. Split if desired and serve with strawberries and whipped cream.

title: Brioches
instructions: In bottom of pan pour molasses and water. Mix the first 4 ingredients then add shortening as to make pie shells and milk. Roll dough in 1 large piece; spread over it small apple pieces and walnuts. Form a roll; slice approximately 1-inch thick. Drop in molasses and water mixture. Cook for 35 minutes at 250\u00b0.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook noodles until tender drain. Soak in cold water. While noodles are soaking dice tomatoes and slice onion into rings. Slice broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Drain noodles and mix well. Chill at least one hour before serving.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients well; add buttermilk eggs and fat. Put in hot skillet. Cook at 425\u00b0 for 17 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Overnight Salad
instructions: Cook egg sugar vinegar and butter until thick; let cool and then pour over whipped cream. Mix in remaining ingredients.

title: Chili
instructions: Steam hamburger meat in covered skillet until rawness is gone; stir several times. Drain off grease and extra liquid. Add chili mix stew mix cumin tomato sauce beans onion and garlic. Add 2 cups water also make up the extra that you poured off of liquid. You can add salt but is hard on high blood pressure but is good with no salt added. Crackers is enough. Cook in crock-pot about 2 1/2 hours. Freezes well.

title: Bite-Size Cubed Deer
instructions: Be sure to wash your meat. Tear your cubed deer into bite-size pieces and sprinkle with your meat tenderizer. Then batter your pieces in the flour and drop into hot oil. Cook until pieces begin to float. Take them out and serve with side dish of your choice.

title: Chocolate Banana Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Cream butter or shortening. Gradually add brown sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add beaten eggs and blend well. Add dry ingredients alternately with banana pulp a little at a time beating well after each addition until smooth. Pour half of batter in well-greased 8-inch square pan. Melt chocolate chips in a saucepan and spread over batter. Cover with remaining batter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan. Frost with Butter Frosting.

title: Easy Pot Roast
instructions: You will also need 1 Reynolds oven bag (large size).

title: Spinach With Cheese
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions. Drain spinach. Crumble in cream cheese and mix well. Add raw egg and a little Parmesan cheese. (Stir in a little and sprinkle a little on top.) Put in casserole dish. Bake 30 minutes at 400 degrees or until casserole gets bubbly.

title: Mud Pies
instructions: Crush Oreos mix with melted margarine. Press into cake pan. Let ice cream sit at room temperature for 1/2 hour; spread on crust. Freeze 2 hours. Pour warm hot fudge topping over ice cream. Freeze until needed. Top with whipped topping and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Fresh Mushroom Soup
instructions: Chop the onion fine and cook in butter until brown. Slice mushrooms and add. Stir until done. Add flour and stir to coat mushrooms. Continue cooking for 5 minutes at medium-high heat stirring occasionally to keep from burning. Add beef stock stirring continuously. Reduce to medium heat; cook ten minutes (do not boil). Add cream and spices. Stir and serve.

title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
instructions: Mix oil chocolate and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients; stir in. Chill dough in freezer until firm; store in freezer.

title: Doris'S Strawberry Cake
instructions: Sift together well cake mix and jello. Add eggs oil strawberries water. Mix well. Makes two layers. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Reese'S Cups
instructions: Mix well with hands. Pack in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin and pour over mixture. Cut in squares before paraffin gets too cold.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
instructions: Unroll 1 tube of dough into bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Press to sides of pan and press all seams together.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream shortening brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Blend until creamy. Blend in egg. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough 3 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes. Remove to cooling rack. Makes 3 dozen 3-inch cookies.

title: Raisin Buttermilk Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs lightly. Crumble in sugar making sure there are no lumps. Beat until light. Stir in salt cinnamon and buttermilk until well mixed. Spread 1 cup raisins in each pie shell. Pour 1/3 custard mixture (about 2 cups) into each shell. Bake on lowest rack in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm or cool. Pies freeze well. When cool wrap airtight and freeze. Will keep about 1 month.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Make teaspoon size balls. Place balls on a tray. Eat when you like.

title: Guacamole Burgers
instructions: Mash avocado in small bowl. Stir in lemon juice onion 1/2 teaspoon salt and hot pepper sauce. Form ground beef into 6 patties. Pan-broil on both sides or broil in oven. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Place each patty on bun half. Top with tomato slice avocado mixture lettuce and bun top. Makes 6 servings.

title: Papas Enchiladas(Pinked Potatoes)
instructions: Boil medium size potatoes until soft; peel and dice. Fry bacon until crisp; remove from skillet. Add vinegar salt chili powder to bacon fat; add diced potatoes and heat thoroughly. Turn onto heated platter garnish with crisp bacon. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook the broccoli as directed on package. Drain and place on the bottom of an 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Mix soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder together and pour mixture over broccoli and chicken breasts in baking dish. Melt margarine and add bread crumbs to moisten. Arrange shredded cheese and bread crumbs to the top of the dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes and serve.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. I use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine cornmeal and red pepper in bowl. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Spoon into 8X8 baking pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 450 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cut into 2 inch square.

title: Matthew'S Waffles
instructions: Sift flour and dry ingredients. Beat egg yolks and add butter and milk. Pour liquid mixture into dry and combine with just a few strokes. Batter should have a pebbled look.

title: Wedding Cake Frosting
instructions: Put all ingredients into bowl. Add hot water a few drops at a time while beating with mixer until spreading consistency. Frost cake. (It will form a smooth glossy crust as it dries but icing will stay moist.)

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix the sugar and eggs and the molasses together and then add the cooled margarine.

title: Chocolate Brickle Sheet Cake
instructions: Boil stirring constantly the cocoa margarine and water. Blend remaining ingredients. Bake 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Remove from heat. Frost immediately.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Cream all together and pour into greased pan 13 x 9-inch. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake in greased casserole dish until set in 350\u00b0 oven. This recipe was given to me by Sams aunt who is 92 years young.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer in order; lettuce cauliflower sugar onion crumbled bacon and cheese. Cover and let stand overnight. Add 1 cup mayonnaise before using and serve.

title: Velveeta Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed but not too soft; drain. Cube cheese and 1/2 stick butter. Mix together and layer broccoli cheese and butter in 1-quart casserole. Melt 2/3 stick butter. Roll or crumble Ritz crackers not too fine; add to melted butter. Mix until coated. Top broccoli with buttered Ritz crackers. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 6.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ingredients thoroughly; put into loaf pan. Cover with 2 strips bacon (optional). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: No Bake Pie
instructions: Let ice cream soften slightly. Mix in milk. Add the instant pudding and stir well. Pour the mixture into the pie shell. Put in freezer until firm. Remove 10 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Turkey Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except crust); set aside.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Seal in Tupperware in refrigerator until ready to use. These freeze well so you can roll them cut them and place on a cookie sheet until frozen then place in Ziploc bag.

title: Microwave Chicken With Wild Rice
instructions: Reserve 1 tablespoon of rice seasoning mix. Combine remaining seasoning with rice mushrooms sherry and 1 1/3 cups of hot water in a 7 x 11-inch glass baking dish. Cover. Microwave on High for 15 minutes. Stir rice and seasoned chicken with reserved seasoning mix. Arrange chicken skin side up over rice. Sprinkle with paprika and cover. Microwave on High for 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink near bone turning dish every 5 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Sift flour once. Measure. Add baking powder. Sift 3 times. Cream butter. Add sugar gradually and cream. Add egg yolks. Add flour alternately with milk a small amount at a time. Beat after each addition.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares(Recipe Served At Club Meetings)
instructions: Combine flour oats 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup margarine in a bowl. Mix until crumbly. Press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Grits-Sausage Casserole
instructions: Will need 2-quart baking dish.

title: Cabbage Au Gratin
instructions: Cook cabbage 7 minutes in boiling salt water--drain thoroughly. Make cream sauce from butter flour and milk. Cook until smooth and thick. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup grated cheese. Add sauce with cheese to the cabbage. Mix well. Pour into greased casserole sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 350 degree oven. Serve hot.

title: Cream Cheese Tarts
instructions: Let cream cheese soften; beat with eggs and sugar until smooth. Place vanilla wafers in foil cupcake papers in muffin tin. Fill about 1/2 to 3/4 full. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until puffed. Cool 3 to 5 minutes then cover with cherry pie filling. Chill and top with Cool Whip. Makes about 18 tarts.

title: German Chocolate Earthquake Cake
instructions: In a saucepan put 1 stick oleo and cream cheese. Heat until warm enough to stir in a box of powdered sugar. Mix well. Spread over cake mix as evenly as possible. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Can be turned out on cake plate.

title: Crispy Eggplant
instructions: In small bowl stir together first 3 ingredients. In shallow dish or on sheet of waxed paper combine next 3 ingredients. Brush both sides of eggplant with real mayonnaise mixture; coat with crumb mixture. Place in shallow roasting pan or on baking sheet. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven 15 to 17 minutes or until browned. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Easy Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ketchup. Put in pan. Put ketchup on top. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Double Fudge
instructions: Line an 8-inch square pan with foil. In a micro bowl place peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk. Microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes; stir after 1 minute. Repeat until chips are melted and mix is smooth when stirred. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Spread evenly into prepared pan.

title: Baked Party Ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel skin from ham; trim fat. Score ham in diamond pattern. Insert cloves in cross pattern. Pack brown sugar over ham. Bake 30 minutes. Heat pineapple juice and marmalade in pan over medium heat. Remove from heat. Add bourbon. Remove ham from oven and pour pineapple sauce over ham. Bake 1 1/2 hours basting frequently.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix scalded milk and shortening together until melted. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix all ingredients together adding enough flour until thick. Knead until bread texture (10 minutes). Refrigerate overnight. Roll into balls and let raise until doubled. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Tomato Crisp
instructions: Cut tomatoes into small wedges and put in large bowl. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and spices together and sprinkle over tomatoes. Add lemon juice and toss well. Spread evenly into buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole. Blend remaining 1/2 cup sugar flour salt and butter into crumbs. Mix in chopped nuts and sprinkle over top of tomato mixture. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes.

title: Artichoke Quiche
instructions: Drain artichokes and save oil. Beat eggs add oil artichokes and remaining ingredients. Save some cheese for the top. Put in a small baking pan and top with remaining cheese. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 12.

title: Custard Mystery
instructions: Beat to a cream and add beaten egg whites last to which has been added 1/4 teaspoon salt. Put in baking dish and set in a dish of hot water. Bake in moderate oven 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Morning Eggs
instructions: Remove crust from bread. Cut bread into cubes. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Combine eggs and milk in a large bowl. Mix well. Pour over bread. Sprinkle with cheese salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with bacon. Bake for 1 hour. Serve immediately.

title: Spider Legs
instructions: Melt chips over low heat add nuts and noodles and stir well. Drop teaspoons onto waxed paper.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: For filling in a medium saucepan combine sugar cornstarch and salt; gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Reduce heat; cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Separate egg yolks from whites; set whites aside for meringue. Beat egg yolks slightly. Gradually stir 1 cup of the hot mixture into yolks. Return egg mixture to saucepan; bring to a gentle boil. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Stir in butter or margarine vanilla and 1 cup flaked coconut. Pour hot filling into baked pastry shell.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix and place in greased casserole dish and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cover to bake.

title: Kernes' Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all except tomato sauce together well. Place in greased baking dish. Pour tomato sauce over top. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute celery onion and pepper in one stick of butter. Add remainder of ingredients and mix until cheese melts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown onion in melted margarine. Add broccoli. When broccoli is thawed add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into baking dish. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Let all cheeses stand out at room temperature. When soft beat cheeses in mixer. Add onion Worcestershire sauce mayonnaise and 1/4 cup pecans. Mix well then chill in refrigerator for 2 hours. After chilled form into ball. Cover ball with parsley remaining pecans and slices of olives. Serve with party crackers.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and celery. Drain and mix with other ingredients. Put in casserole dish and bake for 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Put apple juice and cranberry juice in 30 cup percolator. In percolator basket put sugar cinnamon cloves and salt. Perk and serve.

title: White Fudge Cake
instructions: In small saucepan melt white chocolate and hot water over low heat; cool. In large mixer bowl combine flour sugar soda baking powder salt butter and buttermilk; blend at low speed until moistened. Beat 1 minute at medium speed scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs melted white chocolate mixture and vanilla. Blend; beat 1 minute at medium speed. Stir in pecans and coconut. Pour batter into 2 (9 inch) round layer pans which have been greased and floured on the bottom only. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Strawberry Pudding Pie
instructions: Cook pudding according to package directions. Remove from heat. Add dry jello and stir. Let cool and thicken a few minutes. Fold the strawberries into cool pudding mixture. Pour into pie shell or graham cracker crust. Chill and top with Cool Whip.

title: Lasagna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in salted water. Drain! Cook beef until brown. Stir in tomato sauce sugar salt garlic salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Combine the cottage cheese sour cream cream cheese green onions (chopped) and green pepper. Spread half the noodles in two (2-inch deep) sheet pans. Moisten with some of the meat sauce. Cover with cheese mixture. Top with remaining noodles then meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 100.

title: Crispy Confections
instructions: Combine caramels and water in a 4-cup glass measuring cup. Microwave at High 1 to 2 minutes; stir well to combine. Combine the cereals and coconut in a large bowl; pour caramel mixture on top. Toss well until coated. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Midnight Cake With Vanilla Frosting
instructions: Blend together Crisco and sugar until fluffy. Blend in eggs. In a saucepan heat water and then slowly add cocoa stir until smooth. Sift together flour salt soda and baking powder. Add to the Crisco/sugar mix alternating with the cocoa mixture. Blend in vanilla and mix well. Pour batter into an 8 x 8-inch square pan that has been greased and lined with wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Let cool before frosting.

title: Asparagus Bacon Quiche
instructions: Line the unpricked pastry shell with a double thickness of heavy-duty foil. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes; remove foil. Bake 5 minutes more. Remove from the oven and set aside. Cook asparagus in a small amount of water until crisp-tender about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain well. Arrange the bacon and asparagus in the crust. In a bowl beat eggs. Add cream 1/2 cup cheese onions sugar salt pepper and nutmeg. Pour over asparagus. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes longer or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Esther'S Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop or grind peppers. Boil for 5 minutes. But do not scald onions. Add these after scalding; drain. Add vinegar and sugar and onions. Add salt. Boil for 1/2 hour stirring once in a while. Seal in sterilized jars.

title: Green Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Combine cereals pretzels and nuts in a large microwave cooking bag. Combine margarine\tWorcestershire\tsauce and seasoned salt in a small bowl. Microwave on High for 1 minute or until margarine is melted.\tPour over cereal mixture. With bag open microwave on High for 3 minutes. Shake. Microwave on High another 3 minutes.

title: Tex Mex Chops
instructions: Brown chops in large skillet in oil over medium heat approximately 5 minutes. Turn chops; add salsa and chiles. Lower heat; cover and simmer gently 8 to 10 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cranberry Bar Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir together the flour oats brown sugar and baking soda. Stir in the margarine or butter and mix thoroughly. Reserve 1 cup of the flour-oat mixture for the topping.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Grease a baking dish and place a row of potatoes in it and sprinkle with salt pepper flour and dot with butter. Add a row of onions and sprinkle again. Pour scalded milk over and last layer of potatoes and dot with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. We like to add a layer of thinly sliced ham!

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Mix together milk salsa and soup. In baking dish layer tortilla strips chicken and sauce; repeat layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Flake crabmeat into large bowl. Add bread crumbs lime juice egg Worcestershire dill and scallions. Mix well. Shape into eight patties. Refrigerate 30 minutes until firm. Melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook patties 4 to 5 minutes on each side until browned. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Tropical Punch
instructions: (*Do not dilute frozen fruit juice.)

title: Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight. Pour over cream cheese. Serve with crackers.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl cream together butter and 1/2 cup of confectioners sugar until fluffy. Add 2 cups of flour. Beat until blended. Spread evenly over bottom of well greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. (It will be a little difficult to spread around but work with it.) Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello and water and then add other ingredients except sour cream. Do not drain fruit. Jell half of the mixture in a pan. When well set spread sour cream on top. Pour other half of jello over sour cream and jell until set.

title: Chicken Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cream cheese and melted margarine until smooth. Add chicken salt pepper milk chives or onions and pimento. Mix well.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until silver knife comes out clean.

title: Ham And Glazed Apples
instructions: In a large skillet melt margarine until sizzling. Stir in brown sugar and Dijon mustard. Add apples. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until apples are crispy-tender about 5 to 7 minutes. Place ham in the same skillet. Arrange apples on the steak. Cover. Continue cooking until ham is heated through 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Strawberry Fluff Pie
instructions: Combine strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar. Stir in sour cream and lemon juice. Beat egg whites with salt until foamy. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating until stiff peaks form. Fold into strawberries-sour cream mixture. Pile into baked pie shell. Freeze several hours or overnight. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Champagne Salad
instructions: For each serving place crisp lettuce leaf on plate. On top of it place upside down 1 chilled pear half. Make bunny with narrow end for face. For eyes 2 raisins for nose 1 red cinnamon candy for ears 2 blanches almonds and for tail cottage cheese ball. (Cute huh?)

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Bring water to a boil and add cloves and cinnamon sticks. Cover and let stand 1/2 hour. Remove spices and tea bags and add sugar. Stir until dissolved. Add lemonade orange juice and pineapple juice. Mix well. Makes approximately 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Pepperidge Farm Chicken Breasts
instructions: Combine in flat bowl sour cream onion soup mix and Worcestershire sauce. Stir to blend. Crush stuffing mix. Dip chicken in sour cream mixture and then put in stuffing mix to coat.

title: Japanese Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Quick Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients until well blended; fold in Cool Whip. Layer with pudding mix first then wafers bananas then pudding mix until all used up. Crush cookies and spread on top.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix well. Pour into ice cream freezer; add milk up to line. Mix well and freeze in freezer. (Very yummy.)

title: Hamburg Pie
instructions: Saut onions in frypan. Cook the hamburg with onions. Add desired seasonings. Before putting in pie crust add 2 tablespoons Bisquick. Beat eggs and cottage cheese together. Pour over the top and bake in moderate oven until done.

title: Apple Raisin Bread
instructions: Blend well and pour into 2 greased bread pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Beat together potatoes sugar eggs vanilla and melted butter. Pour into greased casserole dish. Combine brown sugar flour soft butter and nuts. Sprinkle on top of potato mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Mix cornmeal flour salt and pepper. Cut stems off okra and slice. Coat okra in flour mixture. Coat tomatoes and mix with okra. Fry in hot skillet until golden brown.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease a Bundt pan. Lay frozen rolls on the bottom. (It looks meager but dont put more or it will rise over pan edge.) Mix pudding sugar and nuts; pour over frozen rolls. Melt butter and pour over rolls and dry ingredients. Cover with towel; leave it out overnight to rise by morning. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Invert and serve warm.

title: Oriental Chicken And Rice
instructions: Stir-fry chicken until done. Meanwhile for sauce in a small saucepan combine brown sugar and cornstarch. Stir in water vinegar soy sauce bouillon garlic powder and ground ginger. Add green pepper and pimento; cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Remove from heat; keep warm.

title: Italian Wedding Soup
instructions: Heat chicken broth cut up chicken spinach and cooked meat balls. Cook until spinach is done. Add pasta and bring to boil. Boil 5 minutes. Turn off heat. Beat eggs and Parmesan cheese. Pour on top of soup. Cover with lid. Let sit for 10 minutes.

title: Glenda'S Clam Chowder
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients and liquid drained from clams. Cook until vegetables are tender. Lower heat to low. Add clams and milk. Cook slowly 15 minutes. Make roux of cornstarch or flour and water to thicken. Cook until thickened on low.

title: Fresh Cranberry Relish
instructions: Rinse cranberries; drain. Grind in blender all ingredients in the order listed.

title: Hot Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind peppers. Combine vinegar and sugar. Heat to a boil and add peppers and onions. Cook 10 minutes. Pack in jars.

title: Cinnamon Toast Cobbler
instructions: Drain peaches reserving 1 cup syrup. Combine cornstarch and salt; slowly blend in reserved syrup. Cook and stir until mixture comes to boiling. Reduce heat; cook and stir 2 minutes. Add lemon juice 1/4 cup butter and peaches. Heat just to bubbling. Turn into a 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Cut bread lengthwise into 1-inch strips; dip into 1/4 cup melted butter then into a mixture of sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Arrange over peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until toasty. Makes 6 servings.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion until tender; drain and mash well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cook 30 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. I usually use more squash and use 3/4 to 1 cup of other ingredients.

title: Easy Toffee(Variations And Substitutions Are Listed At The End.)
instructions: Line a large cookie sheet with foil. Lay crackers on foil in a solid cover crackers touching. Boil butter and brown sugar together for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Pour over crackers spreading to cover them all. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes; do not allow sugar mixture to burn. Remove from oven and allow to sit about 3 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over candy and spread with a spatula or fork as chocolate begins to melt. Refrigerate. Chocolate will harden in about 30 minutes and candy can be broken into pieces (usually in 1 1/4-inch squares with a pizza cutter when candy just firms for less crumbs).

title: Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in a 3-quart dish. Cover and microwave at High 4 minutes; stir well. Return to microwave at High 7 to 9 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring once.

title: Pepperidge Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and bring to a boil 1 stick margarine and 2 cups stuffing mix. Put margarine in baking dish and melt. Put stuffing in melted margarine and stir well. Take out 2/3 cup mixture and save for top. Pour chicken mixture in baking dish. Spread remaining stuffing on top and bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Seafood Jubilee
instructions: Boil fettucini as per instructions on box. Melt butter in skillet. Lightly saute scallops and shrimp in skillet and add Old Bay to taste. Divide fettucini onto 2 platters and top with grated Mozzarella shrimp and scallops; use pimento pieces for garnish. Hurry into preheated oven until cheese is melted. Bon appetit!!

title: Old Fashioned Blackberry Cake
instructions: Mix sugar shortening and eggs thoroughly. Sift together flour soda cloves cinnamon and allspice. Add sour milk to above and mix completely. Add blackberries and blend softly. May add nuts and raisins if desired 1/2 c. each. Frost with a creamy caramel frosting. Use as a substitute for Jam Cake-- it is just as good.

title: Easy Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: This recipe has been a family favorite for the Pace/Mueller families for the past 30 years.

title: Bologna Salad
instructions: Grind all ingredients. After grinding add 2 tablespoons of dill vinegar. Mix in salad dressing to spreading consistency. Refrigerate. (Tastes very much like ham salad.)

title: Pioneer Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and pour over eggs and milk. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Garnish with parsley pimiento strips and pepper rings. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugars. Add eggs and continue beating until fluffy. Add flour soda salt baking powder and vanilla. Mix until well blended. Add rolled oats and drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet about 2-inches apart. Bake until done (12 to 13 minutes) at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together eggs sugar butter and buttermilk. Add dry ingredients crushed bananas vanilla and pecans. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: More! Casserole
instructions: Cook meat in shortening until it turns white. Add onion peppers (optional) salt oregano tomatoes chili powder and vegetables. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain and combine with meat mixture. Spoon mixture into two 2-quart baking dishes and cover evenly with shredded cheese. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 9 to 12 servings. Better made 24 to 36 hours before cooking to season.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in bowl. Sprinkle salt and pepper then sprinkle hot sauce on top to taste. Dip.

title: Zucchini Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add tomato sauce and seasonings. Bring to boil and simmer 5 minutes. Slice zucchini crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. In small bowl combine cottage cheese and egg. In greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan place half the zucchini and sprinkle with half the flour. Top with cottage cheese mixture and half the meat mixture. Repeat layer of zucchini and flour. Sprinkle with cheese and remaining meat mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until heated through. Remove from oven and sprinkle with additional cheese if desired. To cut more easily let stand 10 minutes before serving. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cranberry - Banana Bread
instructions: Place cranberries in medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat 5 minutes or until cranberries begin to pop. Uncover and remove from heat. Combine sugar and oil in a medium bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer 2 minutes or until well blended. Add egg and egg whites; beat until light and lemon colored. Combine dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with bananas mixing well after each addition. Fold in cranberries. Pour batter into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove from pan and let cool on wire rack.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into lightly greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Mix together water sugar and yeast then add to flour egg and oil. Pour into greased muffin pans. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Chex Mix
instructions: Combine Chex cereal nuts and pretzels in 13x9x2-inch baking pan. Set aside. Stir together remaining ingredients gently stir into cereal mixture until evenly coated. Bake at 250 degrees about 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on paper towels to cool. Makes about 8 cups.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Mix together and warm until cheese is melted.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt butter peanut butter and chips together. Mix well. Pour over Rice Chex and mix well. Sprinkle powdered sugar over and mix or shake to coat.

title: Low Calorie Tomato Juice Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients with mixer or blender. Beat until well blended. Refrigerate. Makes 1 cup. Contains 25 calories per tablespoon.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Place cream cheese and butter in a large mixing bowl. Blend with an electric mixer on low speed until combined. Stop the machine. Add confectioners sugar a bit at a time blending with the mixer on low speed until the sugar is well incorporated. Add the vanilla then increase the mixer speed to medium and blend the frosting until fluffy.

title: Glazed Beef Balls
instructions: Heat ketchup water and apple jelly. Drop in meat balls. Make them small. Simmer until done (about 45 minutes). Turn balls after 20 minutes for even glazing. Top with sour cream.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine in medium saucepan. Add 1 box brown sugar and stir until dissolved. Remove from stove. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add flour and mix then vanilla and nuts. Mix well by hand. Pour in greased oblong pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Let cool a while. Cut into squares and roll in confectioners sugar until covered.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Mix squash and onion in large bowl. Mix all together. Place in large casserole. Top with 1/2 cheese grated and mixed with 2 cups bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12. Can do ahead.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
instructions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add flavoring; mix well. Add coloring. Mix well. Put white sugar in mold. Add approximately 1 teaspoon dough to mold making it level. Push out of mold onto wax paper pretty side up. Air dry 2 to 3 hours. Layer between wax paper and refrigerate or freeze until ready to use.

title: Red Rice
instructions: Cook and break bacon into small pieces. Put aside. Cook tomatoes onion sugar and salt until heated. Add rice. Cover and cook until rice is tender. Stir bacon pieces into rice and serve.

title: Almond Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add flour and almond extract. Line a 9-inch cake pan with foil. Spread batter evenly. Sprinkle almond slivers on top. Bake for approximately 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Cool. Lift foil out of pan; peel away foil.

title: Delicious Brownies
instructions: Combine the oleo and cocoa. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake on a large cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Do not overbake. Ice with powdered sugar fudge frosting.

title: Italian Potato Salad
instructions: * More oil and vinegar may be added to taste once mixed.

title: Crab Cheese Puff
instructions: Mix ingredients together except muffins. Cut eight muffins in half; toast under broiler. Spread thin layer of crab meat mixture on each muffin piece. Put under broiler until spread starts to bubble. Serve hot. This is a great appetizer.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Spray 11 inch x 7 inch pan with Pam. Spread blueberries on bottom. Sprinkle lemon juice on berries. In a small bowl combine 3/4 c. sugar flour baking powder and salt. Work butter into mixture until crumbly. Add milk. Mix with spatula. Spread over berries. Mix together cornstarch and 3/4 c. sugar. Sprinkle over mixture. Pour boiling water over mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Covered Spiders
instructions: Melt the chips in saucepan over low heat. May add 1 tablespoon water if necessary. Stir in noodles raisins or nuts carefully so as not to crunch the noodles. Spoon onto wax paper. Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Stir soup until smooth. Add milk and pepper. In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole alternate layers of potatoes onion sauce and cheese. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover. Bake 15 more minutes.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts. Freeze in electric freezer for 20 minutes. Add nuts and continue freezing until done.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar. Continue to beat until stiff. Add chocolate bits and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Heat oven at 250\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn oven off; put cookies in oven and leave overnight.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Mix in first five ingredients for sauce. Boil chicken and cut into pieces. Clean and cut broccoli or use frozen package thawed. Stir-fry broccoli. Mix chicken broccoli and sauce. Top with cheese. Bake for 1/2 hour in 9 x 12-inch pan at 375\u00b0.

title: My Favorite Pound Cake
instructions: All ingredients at room temperature. Cream together Crisco butter eggs vanilla and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add this to creamed mixture. Now add milk gradually as needed. Mix until batter is fluffy. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured tube pan for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Mustard Barbeque Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let come to a boil. Store in glass quart jars with plastic tops to keep from corroding metal. If you triple the recipe it will be 2 quarts.

title: Arkansas Mudd
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread with Marshmallow Creme while still warm.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites and fold in. Use 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Blend deviled ham olives mustard and Tabasco. Form in ball on serving dish. Chill. Combine cream cheese and milk and frost ball with mixture. Keep chilled. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving time. Trim with parsley.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Top with chopped tomatoes sliced green onions.

title: Crazy Corn
instructions: Mix margarine syrup sugar and salt in large saucepan over low heat until melted. Bring to boil. Boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add vanilla and soda; mix well and pour mixture over popcorn. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3/4 to 1 hour stirring every fifteen minutes.

title: Gumdrops
instructions: Soak gelatin in 2 tablespoons of water. Cook sugar and syrup until it reaches 280\u00b0. Do not stir while cooking. When it reaches 280\u00b0 add gelatin and lemon juice. Remove from heat. Divide the mixture into 3 parts. Add food coloring and flavorings to each mixture. Pour into square pan so that the depth of the gumdrops will be about 1-inch. When firm cut into squares or strips and roll in sugar.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix brown sugar butter corn syrup and salt in a 2-quart glass bowl and place in microwave on High until it boils. Stir occasionally. Boil mixture 2 minutes. Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Spray a large grocery bag with Pam. Put the popcorn in the bag and pour the caramel mixture over corn. Fold down the top of the bag and shake well. Place bag in microwave and cook on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove bag and shake well. Place bag in microwave and cook another 1 1/2 minutes still on High setting. Take out and again shake well. Place bag one more time in microwave; cook on High for only 1/2 minute. Place caramel corn on counter top or wax paper to cool.

title: Cole Slaw With Dressing
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; bring to boil and season to taste. Pour while hot over salad of cabbage carrots and onion. Chill thoroughly before serving.

title: Texas Jalapeno Grits
instructions: Cook grits as labeled on box. Add half the grits in a deep casserole dish sprayed with Pam. Mix sour cream and jalapenos together. Add half of that on top of grits then add half of each cheese. Repeat the same way again. Finish on top with the cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. In a large pot add all ingredients. Simmer for 1 hour.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Saute vegetables in margarine. Add remaining ingredients except pork and beans bacon and pepper. Cook on low 5 minutes. In a large mixing bowl place pork and beans. Add vegetable mixture and mix together well.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Stir in flour soda and salt. Mix well. Add chips and nuts. Stir. Make out in balls and bake at 325\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Peel and slice eggplants; flour first then dip into egg batter then dip them in bread crumbs. Heat oil; fry eggplants on both sides. Remove from pan and place them on absorbent paper toweling. (This is to remove the excess oil.)

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Let cheese and sausage come to room temperature. Mix all ingredients. Form into balls and bake in 350\u00b0 oven until sausage is done and slightly brown.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together; cut in butter and Crisco until crumbly. Stir in milk.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Put raisins in a small pan and cover with water. Let boil slow for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Mix sugar and flour together; then add to other mixture adding buttermilk last. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Needs to cook slow so you may want to reduce heat to 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Bake Dish
instructions: In a quart casserole dish mix all ingredients. Sprinkle cheese and cracker crumbs over mixture. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Grease pan. Take cooked chicken off bones and place in bottom of pan. Heat and pour over chicken the cream of chicken soup and chicken broth mixed together. Mix flour milk baking powder and melted margarine. Pour over mixture. Do not stir. Bake 45 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt 8 candy bars and 1 stick oleo in double boiler until smooth; set aside. Cream sugar and 1 stick oleo; add eggs one at a time beating until smooth. Add flour buttermilk and soda. Add Milky Way mixture vanilla and chopped nuts. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan for 40 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour then measure. Add baking powder and salt. Sift 5 or 6 times. Cream the margarine and Crisco. Add sugar. Cream thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add flavoring and bake in a greased and floured pan for 1 hour and 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Meat Souffle
instructions: Beat egg yolks; add meat liquid butter salt and pepper. Fold in well beaten egg whites. Bake in buttered pan for 1/2 hour in a moderate oven. Turn out on hot platter and serve plain or with mushrooms or tomato sauce.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Heat oil and add beef until red color disappears. Add vegetables. Cook 3 to 5 minutes while stirring.

title: Cake Doughnuts
instructions: Beat eggs. Add 1 cup sugar and melted Crisco. Add 1 cup milk. Mix flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Combine dry and liquid ingredients stirring only until smooth. Roll dough to about 1/2-inch thickness on a floured board. Dough should be soft. Cut with floured doughnut cutter.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. In large bowl mix salad dressing and Salad Supreme. Add vegetables and spaghetti; mix well. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Apple Nut Squares
instructions: Beat together in medium size bowl the eggs sugar and oil. Sift together and mix in the flour salt soda and cinnamon. Fold in diced apples and chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in lightly greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Can be topped with powdered sugar sprinkled lightly after baking.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 25 minutes. Allow to cool 5 minutes. To serve cut with a pointed knife.

title: Cereal Bread
instructions: Prepare cereal bread as directed adding 1/2 cup raisins and 1/4 cup grated orange rind with the cereal and substituting 1/2 cup orange juice for 1/2 cup milk. Bake about 1 hour and 5 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese And Pecan Danish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Unfold pastry; roll to 15 x 10-inch rectangle. Place in 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.

title: Creamy Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain. Mix noodles tuna sour cream milk salt and pepper in a 2-quart casserole. Mix bread crumbs cheese and margarine; sprinkle over tuna mixture. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Muffins
instructions: Drop from spoon into muffin pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sauce 2
instructions: Heat together chocolate and water in small saucepan over low heat until chocolate is melted. Stir in sugar until smooth. Bring to boiling; boil for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla until butter is melted. Serve warm or at room temperature. Sauce will thicken slightly on standing.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces. Coat well with flour salt and pepper. Let stand in flour for 15 minutes. Remove chicken from flour and soak in mixture of egg and milk for 15 minutes. Roll in flour and deep fry in peanut oil; top with sauce cashews and green onions.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over salad. Mix well. Serve and enjoy.

title: Banana Punch Slush
instructions: Boil sugar and 6 cups of water and cool. Add orange juice lemonade pineapple juice water and bananas. Freeze. Take out frozen mixture 3-4 hours before serving to make it slushy. Add ginger ale before serving.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Thaw out lemonade. Mix all ingredients well. Pour into crust and refrigerate until well chilled.

title: Korean Barbecue Sauce(Kun Koki)
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chicken or meat. Marinate boneless chicken or meat for 1 hour or more. Broil pan fry or charcoal. Serves 6.

title: Savory Flank Steak
instructions: Sprinkle one side of flank steak with salt and pepper parsley garlic and cheese. Roll steak up tightly jelly roll fashion and secure with string. Brown on all sides in shortening in large skillet or Dutch oven.

title: Tropical Salad
instructions: Drain liquids from peaches and pineapple; add water to make 4 cups. Drain liquid from Mandarin oranges discard. Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups liquid heated to boil. Add remaining 2 cups liquid and fruits. Pour into 3-quart Pyrex dish or individual molds. Garnish with orange slice and touch of mint or Cool Whip.

title: Eggnog
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and salt until frothy. Gradually beat in milk vanilla and nutmeg. Sprinkle more nutmeg on top.

title: Banana Nut Muffins
instructions: Beat together the oil and sugar. Add the eggs and bananas. Beat well. Sift together the dry ingredients. Add to banana mixture with buttermilk and vanilla. Beat well. Stir in nuts. Pour in greased muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

title: Frozen Fruit Slush
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 5 minutes and cool. Add rest of ingredients and freeze. Eat when slightly frozen.

title: Baked Round Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving size pieces. Roll pieces in flour. Fry in vegetable oil in pan until brown. Season with salt and pepper. Put meat in small roaster. Add flour to drippings in frypan to make gravy. Add water if not right consistency. Pour gravy over the meat pieces in the roaster. Slice 1 large onion and place in roaster. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours and then serve.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve the Jell-O with 1 cup boiling water. Add the strawberry juice pineapple strawberries and bananas. Pour half of the mixture in dish. Allow to gel. Spread sour cream. Pour remaining mixture and refrigerate.

title: Kyenam(African Fish Dish)
instructions: Soak bay leaves peppercorns and cloves in 1/3 cup of oil overnight. Rub cleaned fish with salt and black pepper and then the flavored oil. Bake in a hot pan or in the oven or grill on a charcoal fire. Then fry onion tomatoes tomato paste and red hot pepper in the rest of the oil. Add dried shrimp or anchovy. Place the cooked fish on a bed of plain boiled rice and coat with the tomato onion and pepper sauce. Decorate with French-fried onions sliced green peppers fried plaintain sliced hard-boiled eggs etc. Serves 4.

title: Homemade Baked Beans
instructions: Mix the beans brown sugar and catsup. Put the bacon across the top of the beans in a baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Pioneer Stew
instructions: Cook beef onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain corn beans and tomatoes. Add liquids chili powder and salt to meat and cook until liquid is reduced to about half. Add corn beans and tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in cheese and serve.

title: Fruity Banana Pudding
instructions: In oblong baking dish layer cookies. Slice bananas on top of cookies. Slice strawberries on top of bananas. Mix pudding as directed on box and pour over fruit. Repeat layers and sprinkle remaining (crush) cookies on top.

title: Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Set aside. In a bowl stir together flour 1/2 cup sugar baking powder nutmeg and salt. In another bowl combine egg milk and 1/3 cup melted butter. Add to flour mixture. Stir until moistened. Fill greased muffin pan (or line with baking cups) 2/3 full. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Immediately dip tops into 3 tablespoons melted butter then dip or sprinkle tops in cinnamon-sugar mixture.

title: Breakfast Rolls
instructions: Split dinner rolls in half lengthwise. Butter bottom half. Layer shaved ham over bottom. Top with single layer of Swiss cheese then single layer of American cheese. Replace top. Combine melted margarine and poppy seed. Pour over top. Cut individual rolls apart. Wrap in foil and refrigerate overnight. Next morning bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Pour boiling water over jello in large bowl to dissolve well. Add softened sherbet and Cool Whip. Mix well with beater or in a mixer. Add crushed pineapple and oranges. Place in a 9 x 12-inch dish. Cool until set and serve. (Makes a large amount.)

title: Carrot Saute
instructions: To capture the true sweet flavor of carrots melt butter or margarine in a heavy skillet. Add carrots. Sprinkle with a little salt. Stir and cover. Cook over medium heat (only about 5 minutes). Stir a time or two and replace lid quickly. Serve at once. Test for doneness.

title: Easy Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate for several hours. Makes a large salad.

title: Tortilla Cheese Canapes
instructions: Spread all ingredients on tortillas one at a time. Roll and chill overnight. Slice crosswise in 1/2-inch slices.

title: Beef And Potato Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion together. Place in a 9 x 13 inch cake pan. Top with generous amount of potato rounds sliced about 1/2 inch thick. Add 1 can of water to the 2 cans of mushroom soup and mix well; pour over potatoes. Salt generously and bake covered 1 hour at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Pound chicken until thin. Combine eggs salt and pepper. Dip chicken in egg mixture and then in bread crumbs. Brown quickly in oil. Drain chicken and put in casserole pan. While chicken is cooking stir tomato sauce basil and garlic. Heat to boiling. Simmer 10 minutes. Add margarine. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Cover. Cook 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Uncover and put Mozzarella cheese on top; bake until cheese melts (approximately 5 minutes). Serve with side of spaghetti.

title: Meatballs And Sauce
instructions: Mix first ten ingredients together for meatballs. Shape into balls roll in flour and fry in skillet until brown on both sides. Remove and place in baking dish.

title: Favorite Salad
instructions: Drain tomatoes. Save juice. Add water to make 2 cups. Heat 1 cup to boiling. Stir in Jell-O. Add the other cup when cool. Mix tomatoes and cottage cheese. Add to gelatin mixture.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Remove crusts from bread and spread with margarine. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and set aside. Cook sausage until browned stirring to crumble. Drain well. Spoon over bread slices. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine eggs half and half and salt; mix well and pour over cheese. Cover casserole and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl mix first 4 ingredients then add rest. Grease and flour 2 bread loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Make-Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain and mash. Add cream cheese salt and pepper mixing well. Put in greased two-quart casserole. Top with pats of butter. Cover. Potatoes may be stored in refrigerator for several days.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well. Roll about the size of a quarter. Put on cookie sheet and bake in a 250\u00b0 to 275\u00b0 oven. These may be made ahead of time. Roll out put on cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen put in a Ziploc bag and return to freezer. Take out as needed and cook by directions.

title: Creamy Vanilla Pudding
instructions: Combine cornstarch and sugar; stir in milk. Cook in microwave on High for 7 minutes. Beat half of the hot mixture into the eggs. Blend egg mixture into remaining hot mixture. Microwave 2 1/2 minutes or until thickened. Stir in butter and vanilla. Can use in banana or pineapple pudding recipe.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line a 9-inch spring-mold pan with any graham cracker crust recipe off box. Beat above ingredients with mixer in order listed. Bake in spring-mold pan for 45 minutes. After 45 minutes turn oven off and leave in for 2 hours. Do not open oven door throughout this process.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla eggs Nestle cream and rum. Throw off excess water from cream after chilling. Take 1/3 of mixture mix with peaches or fruit cocktail. Dice cake; place 1/2 layer on bottom of dish. Pour fruit on top of cake. Add rest of cake on top. Pour rest of cream on top of cake. Garnish with cherries or crushed nuts. Place in refrigerator to chill and serve.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar and oil mix together. Add remaining dry ingredients. Add zucchini; mix. Pour into 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Barb Taft'S Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and pudding together. Drain pineapple then add it. Add nuts and marshmallows.

title: Diane'S Texas Grits
instructions: Bring water to boil; add grits. Slow boil for 10 minutes. Add butter. Beat eggs; stir in slowly. Add Mexican Velveeta; mix and mix. Pour into shallow baking pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown on top.

title: Cream Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into chocolate pie shell. Cover with cherry pie filling or sweetened berries. Refrigerate. Its easy!

title: Pineapple Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening together. Add eggs and beat well. Add bananas crushed pineapple and nuts then mix well. Sift flour soda and salt; mix with egg-fat mixture. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes 1 large or 2 small loaves.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Heat soup; add cream cheese. Continue heating until melted. Remove from heat. Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water and combine the gelatin mixture with tomato soup mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into lightly greased ring mold. Chill overnight. Unmold and serve with Ritz crackers.

title: Layered Nacho Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream and taco seasoning. Starting with beans layer ingredients in order listed. Serve with nacho cheese or corn chips.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well. Boil until a bit dropped in cold water forms a firm ball. Dissolve the baking soda in hot water and butter. Pour over the popped corn (already popped and which the unpopped kernels have been removed). Stir well; form into balls.

title: Oven Steak Supper
instructions: Place meat in center of 3-foot length of aluminum foil. Sprinkle meat with soup mix. Cover with vegetables. Dot with butter; sprinkle with salt. Fold foil and seal securely to hold in juices. Place on baking sheet. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4.

title: Twinkie Surprise
instructions: Layer split Twinkies in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Slice bananas and layer over Twinkies. Mix milk with pudding; spread over bananas. Spread pineapple over pudding. Top with Cool Whip and cherries. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Pickled Green Beans
instructions: Wash drain and cut up beans. Pack beans lengthwise into jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. To each pint add 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 clove garlic and 1 head dill. Combine remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Pour boiling hot water over beans leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Adjust lids. Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Yields about 4 pints.

title: Tater Tots Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Bake Tater Tots in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Grease casserole dish and add Tater Tots ground beef and mushroom soup; mix well. Top with cheese. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes until bubbly. Quick dinner and easy.

title: 24 Hour Coleslaw
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl and refrigerate at least 24 hours before using. Keeps well in refrigerator for at least two weeks.

title: Party Mix
instructions: *Cook pecans with very small amount of margarine in a 350 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Watch closely so they wont get too done.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake yellow cake mix as directed on box in a 9x13 pan. Let cool then crumble half cake in a punch bowl. Prepare pudding according to box. Layer on top of cake with half of the cherry pie filling half of the pudding half of the pineapple half of the bananas and half of the cool whip. Repeat layers starting with the cake. Garnish with chopped pecans coconut and cherries.

title: Spinach Cauliflower Toss
instructions: In a small frying pan toast nuts over medium heat shaking pan often until nuts are golden (3-5 minutes). Set aside.

title: Scalloped Chicken And Oyster Dressing
instructions: Cook chicken in water until done about 1 hour. Cool. Remove meat from bones.

title: Fried Potatoes And Onions
instructions: Cover and fry potatoes in small amount of Wesson oil until tender. Just before they start to brown add the diced onion. Cover and leave covered for about 5 minutes. Then uncover; turn heat up to lightly brown potatoes and onion.

title: Rhubarb Crumble
instructions: Mix together; press 1/2 in 9-inch pie plate. Save remaining for top.

title: York Sensational Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. (If using a glass pan heat to 325\u00b0.) Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. In a large bowl with spoon or wire whisk stir together butter sugar and vanilla. Add eggs. Stir until well blended. Stir in flour cocoa baking powder and salt and blend well. Reserve 2 cups batter. Spread remaining batter in prepared pan. Arrange peppermint patties in single layer over batter about 1/2-inch apart. Spread reserved 2 cups of batter over patties. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely in pan on wire rack. Cut into squares. Makes about 36 brownies.

title: Alaska Snow Crab Louis Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crab. Chill thoroughly. Serve with crab. Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Fresh Apple Cake With Butterscotch Chips
instructions: Mix apples sugar and eggs together. Add oil nuts flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. Mix until well blended then add butterscotch chips. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Brisket Of Beef
instructions: Lay brisket in roasting pan. Mix soup and water together. Pour half over meat. Add potatoes and carrots in pan with roast. Pour the rest of the soup over veggies. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in slow oven at 250\u00b0 to 275\u00b0 for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Goobers
instructions: Cream together the peanut butter and butter. Add the powdered sugar. (May add a few drops of water if needed.) Roll into round balls and place on cookie sheet. Yields 50 to 60.

title: Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Blend in sugar and wheat germ. Combine egg oil and pineapple and add to flour mixture. Stir only until moistened. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 approximately 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the Crisco. Add sugar; continue creaming. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Add vanilla then the sifted dry ingredients alternately with the milk. Bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a large angel food pan at 325\u00b0.

title: 7 Layer 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Arrange in layers in clear salad bowl. Start with spinach. Sprinkle with salt pepper and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Add layers of bacon and eggs. Then add lettuce. Sprinkle again with salt pepper and 1 teaspoon of sugar.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix all together except beef gravy and form into 20 patties. Line pan with foil. Put patties on foil and cover with foil. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. When done drain off grease and pour beef gravy over patties. Leave in oven uncovered long enough to warm.

title: Holiday Cherry Cakes
instructions: Add sugar and butter; add eggs then flour and lemon. Pour on a greased pan; mark off 20 servings. Put pie filling in center of each section. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch cookie sheet.

title: Hot And Sour Soup
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan (medium-high heat) heat broth olives tofu and green onions. Blend cornstarch with water until smooth; stir into broth gradually. Heat to boiling stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Remove from heat. Slowly pour beaten egg into soup while stirring gently in one direction. Stir in remaining ingredients before serving. Serves 4.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add crushed pretzels and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Spread in glass baking dish. Bake for 10 minutes at 250\u00b0. Let cool.

title: American Goulash
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions and drain well. Brown meat onion and pepper. Add cooked and drained macaroni seasonings tomatoes and tomato soup. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Mix crumbs with melted margarine and sprinkle over top. Grate cheese over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Kraut
instructions: Put 1 teaspoon salt in bottom of quart jar. Fill with cut cabbage. On top of cabbage put 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 teaspoon vinegar. Fill jar until cabbage is covered. Seal tight. Let stand for a few weeks. Jar may leak a bit the first week or so.

title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream shortening. Gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk. Mix well. Add extract and mix thoroughly. Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness on a floured surface. Cut with a 2 1/2-inch round cookie cutter. Place on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Sprinkle with sugar if desired. Cool. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Add few drops of food coloring if desired to make any color you want. Pour over an ice ring. Serves 50.

title: Tahitian Punch
instructions: In large bowl mix juices; drop in sherbet by spoonfuls. Add beverage and mix a little then serve.

title: Red Hot Jello Salad
instructions: Melt red hots in 2 cups water. Add dry Jell-O and applesauce. Chill until set.

title: Heavenly Hash Browns
instructions: Mix all ingredients in greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients until crumbly and put in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix together remaining ingredients. Pour this mixture over first mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Tear one loaf thawed bread into irregular pieces and place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the mixture of brown sugar pudding butter and cinnamon over the bread pieces. Tear up the second loaf of thawed bread and layer on top. Cover with a wet towel and let rise about four hours. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Turn upside down immediately. Nuts and raisins may be added with the brown sugar layer.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Add sour cream and vanilla; mix well. Add rest of batter ingredients and mix until very smooth. Pour half of the batter in greased tube pan. Sprinkle half of the filling mixture on top of batter. Pour rest of batter over filling mixture and top with rest of filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine 1 cup mashed strawberries with 1 cup water in a saucepan. Boil for 5 minutes. Add 1 cup sugar and the cornstarch which has been dissolved in the 1/3 cup water. Boil until mixture turns clear approximately 5 minutes stirring constantly. At this time 4 drops of red food coloring may be added if desired. Cool glaze. Add remaining berries to glaze and toss gently to coat. Arrange in pie shell and refrigerate. Garnish with whipped cream before serving.

title: Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook grits according to directions on the box. Add the cheese margarine seasoned salt and Tabasco. Stir until cheese and margarine are melted. Add 3 beaten eggs. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl toss together the graham cracker crumbs and the melted 1/2 cup butter. Press crumb mixture onto bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
