In a small bowl beat the remaining 1/2 cup butter about 30 seconds until softened. Add powdered sugar; beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs. Spread egg mixture over crumb mixture. Slice bananas lengthwise into halves and arrange over egg mixture. Spoon pineapple over bananas. Spread Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts if desired. Cover; refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop ham into small squares. Chop the green stems of onion. Mix with cream cheese. Roll into a ball. (Optional Roll in chopped nuts.) Serve with crackers.

title: Turkey In A Sack
instructions: Spread turkey heavily with mayonnaise using pastry brush. Place in brown bag. Fasten bag ends together. Place bag on rack in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done. Chicken or small birds may be used instead of turkey. Split sack containing bird. Bake 10 minutes.

title: White Sangria
instructions: Mix together and serve cold.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix together and shape into balls (size of large marble). Brown; pour sauce over meatballs in large casserole dish.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and add cracker crumbs. Reserve 1/2 cup. Grease 2-quart casserole dish. Add grated zucchini onion egg garlic powder cheese salt pepper and unreserved cracker crumbs and butter. Mix well. Top with the reserved 1/2 cup cracker crumbs and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease 2-quart casserole. Pour mixture into casserole and top with buttered croutons. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Overnight Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole in the following order bread cubes cooked sausage green peppers and cheese. Beat together eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over layers. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Salmon Divan
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium saucepan over low heat melt butter. Blend in flour onion powder and sugar. Mix until smooth. Cook and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat. Gradually add half and half stirring until smooth with each addition. Cook and stir over medium to high heat until sauce just comes to a boil and is thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in sherry.

title: Layered Dip
instructions: Spread beans on shallow pan or dish. Combine sour cream and salad dressing mix and spread over beans. Add layers of tomatoes chilies ripe olives shredded cheese and avocado if desired. Serve with thick corn chips.

title: Chocolate Mint Brownies
instructions: Combine chocolate and butter; cook over low heat until melted stirring constantly. Let stand 10 minutes. In bowl beat eggs with electric mixer. Gradually add sugar and beat well. In separate bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Add chocolate mixture and flour mixture to eggs and sugar. Stir in chopped pecans and vanilla. Spoon into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until pick comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Cook seasoning in butter until transparent. Add soup and water. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add salt and peppers and crawfish tails. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Add green onions to it before eating each time. This will add color for looks and seasoning. The Etouffee is better if cooked a day before the planned meal.

title: Taco Salad Dip
instructions: Place layer of jalapeno and Cheddar cheese dip into center of serving plate and spread almost to edge of plate. Mix taco seasoning and mayonnaise together. Place on top of first layer. Place shredded lettuce around outside of platter. Place all remaining chopped vegetables on top of cheese mixture. Place shredded pepper cheese on top of everything. Now serve with nacho chips and enjoy.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix in a medium pot the first 3 ingredients. Combine and add remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat and stir (about 3 to 5 minutes). It will look like a \globby\ mess and youll be sure its not turning out but it will. When it forms a ball in the center of the pot turn out and knead on the lightly floured surface. Store in an airtight container or plastic bag.

title: Salami Bread Sticks
instructions: Spread cream cheese in middle of salami slice. Roll around bread stick. Cut sticks in smaller sizes after rolled. Do this just before you serve or bread sticks will become soggy.

title: Chunky Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook beef and onions. Drain off fat. Combine in 2-quart saucepan with juice from drained tomatoes and spices. Bring to boil then simmer 20 minutes. Add tomatoes and paste. Bring to boiling; serve over spaghetti.

title: Texas Torte (Or Mexican Fudge)
instructions: Beat eggs. Add flour salt and milk; mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Pour into greased 8 x 12-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Love Balls
instructions: Mix coconut and milk together. Roll into balls then roll in dry small box of Jell-O. Place in an airtight container and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Skillet Torte
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 10 inch iron skillet with aluminum foil allowing extra foil to hang over edges. This will be used later for removing torte from skillet. Cream together the butter 3/4 c. sugar brown sugar and cocoa. Add eggs and beat well. Gradually add flour and then add almond extract mixing well. Pour into foil-lined skillet. Sprinkle almonds over top of batter and then sprinkle the 1 tablespoon sugar over the top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of torte. Do not overbake. This should have the texture of a brownie. Remove from oven and then remove torte from skillet using the foil. Do not remove the foil while torte is still warm. Melt the vanilla chips with 1 tsp. shortening. Drizzle over torte. Melt the chocolate chips with 1 tsp. shortening and drizzle over torte. When cool remove foil carefully and plate.

title: Waffles
instructions: Add soda to eggs and buttermilk. Add dry ingredients which are sifted together. Add melted butter. Beat until smooth.

title: Corn Casserole Dish(Serves 6 Or 8 People)
instructions: Combine all these ingredients together and bake for 30 minutes in the oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Put in greased casserole dish. Top with 1/4 cup fine bread crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon of melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Good as side dish for prime rib.

title: Caramel Bars
instructions: Roll out cookie dough. Pat out dough in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 12 to 14 minutes at 350\u00b0. While warm put morsels over the cookie dough. Put back into oven for 5 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan; heat to a slow boil. Cool and store in Ziploc bag and freeze. The sauce will not totally freeze so you can take out as much as you need.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together; cut in shortening or butter until mixture resembles coarse corn meal. Add milk and mix briefly or until dry ingredients are moistened. Place on a floured board and knead gently about 10 times; roll out to about 1/2-inch thickness. Place on baking sheet and bake at 450\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 2 dozen biscuits.

title: Tuna-Macaroni Toss
instructions: In a 5-quart saucepot cook macaroni as directed; drain. Return to saucepot; keep warm. Meanwhile in 2-quart saucepan over medium heat melt butter or oleo. Add onion and cook until tender stirring occasionally. Stir in flour until blended; cook 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk bouillon salt and pepper. Cook until thickened and smooth stirring constantly. Stir in tuna and heat through. Gently toss macaroni in saucepot with tuna mixture. Spoon mixture into warm bowl; garnish with parsley.

title: Sausage
instructions: First cut it cut it cut it. Then you cook it long long. Then you eat it.

title: Busy Woman'S Dream
instructions: Crumble raw beef in bottom of 10 x 10-inch casserole dish. Spread soup evenly over top of meat. Place Tater Tots on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly and Tater Tots are brown.

title: Haddock Delmonico
instructions: Place serving portions of fish in a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch greased baking dish. Combine margarine lemon onion and seasonings and pour over fish. Cook until fish flakes at 350\u00b0 (approximately 25 minutes). Remove serving portion onto plate and top with melted cranberry sauce garnished with parsley.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Save juice from the fruit. Add water to make 3 cups. Put juice and water in pan and add pudding mixes. Cook until thick. Set off stove and cool for 20 to 30 minutes. Stir 1 time. Pour over fruit and chill.

title: Hobo Dish
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Crumble hamburger on bottom of greased casserole dish. Add salt and pepper. Layer potatoes carrots onions and celery. Combine water with soup and pour over vegetables. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Impossible Chicken Pie
instructions: Lightly grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Sprinkle chicken mushrooms onion salt and cheese in pan. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour in pan.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Mix until smooth sugar salt egg and Crisco. Dissolve yeast powders in warm water. Add to first mixture. Then add plain flour. Knead until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or until yeast rises. Knead and cut with biscuit cutter. Put in greased pan and let rise 45 minutes. Bake at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Baked Green Beans
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and put into baking dish approximately 8 x 8-inch size. Cut 4 strips bacon into pieces. Lay on top of bean mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered and then 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Shrimp Appetizers
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in Cheez Whiz until fairly smooth. Mix in garlic and mayonnaise. Fold in shrimp. Spread on English muffins. Freeze until firm (about 1 1/2 hours). Cut each muffin in eighths. Place in freezer container and keep in freezer.

title: Easy Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Roll dough into 9 x 12-inch rectangle. Spread with margarine and sprinkle with cinnamon. Spread chopped apples raisins and pecans over dough. Roll up like a jelly roll. Cut into one-inch slices. Place on oiled baking sheet and let rise until nearly doubled in size. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes or until done. Calories 183.

title: Oven Chicken And Pasta
instructions: Melt butter in a 10 x 15-inch baking dish in a 400\u00b0 oven. Stir in onion garlic basil and pepper. Place chicken in butter mixture; then turn over. Bake until chicken is done about 45 minutes.

title: Pat-In-Pan Pie Crust(No Rolling!)
instructions: In medium bowl combine flour sugar and salt; add oil and milk. Blend well. Pat into 9-inch pie pan fluting edges if desired. For baked pie crust bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes to fill with desired filling and bake as filling recipe requires.

title: Glaze For Fresh Raspberry Or Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine the water sugar cornstarch and gelatin in a saucepan; bring to a boil and cook until thickened. Cool. Pour glaze over fruit in pie shell and chill.

title: Butterscotch Chews
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar eggs and dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Add vanilla and nuts. Place in a greased pan (about 8 x 10-inch). Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle with 4x sugar while warm.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Break the crackers into small pieces and place in a medium bowl. Drain the juices from the salmon over the crackers and toss. Add the salmon to the bowl with the crackers. Add the eggs onion pepper and salt. Toss to combine.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat together the sugar syrup salt flour and eggs. Add vanilla nuts and butter. Pour into a 9-inch deep dish unbaked pie crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Portobello Mushrooms
instructions: Combine tomatoes cheese 1/2 teaspoon oil rosemary pepper and garlic in small bowl.

title: Sausage Cheese Quiche
instructions: Cube bread into 9 x 13-inch pan. Put sausage on top of bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat eggs and 2 1/4 cups milk and pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next day mix 1/2 cup milk with mushroom soup and pour over top. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Spicy Pecan Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a large bowl combine dry ingredients including nuts. In a smaller bowl combine liquid ingredients. Add liquid to dry and mix only until moistened throughout. Spoon batter into lined muffin cups. Bake 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: In skillet combine browned beef and spices with tomatoes in skillet. Heat through. Cover bottom and sides of 13 x 9-inch baking dish with tortillas. Pour beef mixture over tortillas. Place a layer of tortillas over beef mixture. Combine cottage cheese and Jack cheese; pour over tortillas. Bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining ingredients over top. Serve with sour cream and salsa if desired.

title: Haystacks Candy
instructions: Melt peanut butter and butterscotch chips. Mix in noodles and nuts; coat well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Place in refrigerator to chill.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well. Add eggs and zucchini. Sift together the dry ingredients and add. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Wash and clean chicken backs and gizzards leaving fat on backs. Split backs in half. In a large pot cook for 45 minutes the chicken backs gizzards celery onions green pepper potatoes salt pepper garlic powder carrots and water. Add the remaining ingredients after the mixture cooks. Okra may be omitted if you dislike it. Cook for another 15 minutes. Serve in bowl or cups. Soup will be thick like a stew. Good with corn bread or crackers. Good hearty eating. Enjoy!

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Cook at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Ladyfinger Cake
instructions: Line 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan with ladyfingers. Do not pull each one apart. Line up in sheets (single sheets). Line the sides first and then the bottom filling in the large cracks.

title: No Salt Oven-Baked Chicken
instructions: Spray an oven pan with Pam. Place chicken breasts in pan. Mix the vegetables with the cream of mushroom soup. Sprinkle Mrs. Dash and Parmesan cheese over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until juices run clear.

title: Alabama Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cook all ingredients except spices and shrimp in oil for 5 minutes. Add 1 cup of water and cook down for 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except shrimp; cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Add water if needed. Add shrimp and cook 20 minutes longer. Serve over cooked long grain rice.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together in a saucepan. Will be thick. Add 2 cups water. Cook to full boil. Cool for 5 minutes.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Whip until fluffy. Gradually add milk lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill before garnishing top with pie filling.

title: Cherry Gelatin-Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook together the water and cranberries. When soft add sugar and cook 5 minutes. Pour mixture over gelatin. Let cool. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into mold. Chill well.

title: Salmon Fritters
instructions: Pour juice of salmon into measuring cup. Set aside. Put drained salmon into mixing bowl. Add 1 egg; use fork to break up salmon taking out bone. Mix real well. When gummy add flour and mix well with fork. May add pepper. Take 1/4 cup of salmon juice and add 1 heaping teaspoon baking powder to juice; beat with fork. It will foam. After foaming add to salmon mixture. Mix well (it will be thin).

title: Jerry'S Lemon Garlic Chicken
instructions: Pour 1/4 cup oil into 9 x 13 x 2-inch Pyrex baking dish. Flour and salt chicken pieces and place the pieces skin side down in a single layer. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn chicken and pour sauce over chicken. To make sauce use the 1/4 cup olive oil and add all other ingredients to it. Bake another 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Barbecue Seasoning
instructions: Saute onions until brown. Combine all ingredients in large pot and bring to a simmer. Do not boil. Makes about 2 quarts. Keep in refrigerator up to 10 weeks.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix and put in punch bowl; add ginger ale when ready to serve.

title: Banana Crunch Cake
instructions: Blend eggs sour cream bananas and yellow cake mix for 2 minutes. In a separate bowl mix oleo frosting and rolled oats together for the filling.

title: Jay'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Put all ingredients in large bowl and mix well with both hands. Form into ball and roll in chopped pecans. This recipe makes two cheese balls.

title: Dandelion With Bacon Dressing
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly. Cook in small amount of salted water until tender and drain well. Chop if leaves are large. Add onions. Cook bacon until crisp. Remove and set aside. To bacon drippings add vinegar mustard sugar salt and pepper to taste. Add to hot vegetables. Garnish with egg slices and reserved bacon crumbled. Serves 4.

title: Cabbage Skillet
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add cabbage onion and tomato sauce. Add 2 cans of water. Add garlic salt and pepper. Simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over rice. Serves approximately 5.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix together rice green pepper and onion. Put in glass baking pan (with a lid). Place chicken on top of rice pour all soup on top of chicken. Add salt and pepper if desired. Cover and cook at 375\u00b0 in oven until chicken is done (about 1 1/2 hours).

title: Garlic Pretzels
instructions: Mix first three ingredients put broken pretzels in bowl and pour oil mixture over the pretzels. Soak 10 minutes then stir often. Pour on a cookie sheet and bake for 5 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Make Ahead Pie Dough
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in shortening with pastry knife until it resembles cornmeal. Combine egg vinegar and water in a bowl. Stir into flour mixture. Divide dough into 4 equal parts. Shape into balls. Wrap tightly and chill. May be frozen for 1 week in refrigerator.

title: Pita Bread
instructions: In mixing bowl combine warm water yeast sugar salt and olive oil. Mix well. Gradually work in enough flour to make a soft dough that leaves the sides of the bowl and does not stick to hands. Turn onto a lightly floured board. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl. Cover and let set 20 minutes. Shape dough into balls about the size of oranges and flatten slightly. Place the balls on floured surface and keep covered with a dish towel to prevent dough from drying. Let set 5 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: In a shallow casserole dish combine fruit sugar 1 tablespoon flour and cinnamon. In a medium bowl mix 2/3 cup flour baking powder and brown sugar. Cut in butter until mixture is the size of small peas. Stir in milk until moistened; add more if necessary. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto fruit. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted into crust comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Flaming Toilet Paper
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Blend soup milk and chili powder in saucepan. Crush chips.

title: Charlotte'S Cheese Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup of cheese and butter. Spread in 8 or 9-inch greased dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Pour butter over cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fast And Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 12 to 16 cookies.

title: Quiche Divan
instructions: Place broccoli in the bottom of the pastry shell. Cover with chicken and cheese. Beat together eggs cream salt and pepper. Pour over the broccoli chicken and cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool slightly before serving.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix beans soup and mayonnaise; pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly and brown on top.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into 2 greased bread pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0; glass pans bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Banana Split Pudding
instructions: In a bowl whisk milk and pudding mix for 2 minutes. Add banana strawberries and pineapple. Dollop with whipped topping. Drizzle with chocolate syrup sprinkle with pecans. Top with strawberries and bananas.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Peel chop and core apples. Fill crock-pot with apples. Sprinkle with sugar cinnamon salt and cloves. Cook on high for 12 hours or to desired thickness. Yields 4 cups.

title: Swedish Rye Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over molasses oatmeal brown sugar and shortening. Mix well and let stand until lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Mix together. Gradually add flour rye flour and salt. Knead well. Let rise in warm place. Form into 2 loaves. Let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve proudly.

title: Chili
instructions: Ground beef with onion celery green pepper salt and pepper then add remaining ingredients and bake at 300\u00b0 for two hours.

title: Wassail
instructions: Heat cider with cinnamon stick to boiling; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in rest of ingredients and simmer 5 minutes longer.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.

title: Hot Spiced Tea
instructions: Simmer all ingredients except fruit slices together for 15 to 20 minutes or until ready to serve. Add sliced lemon and orange to punch bowl when ready to serve. Serves 15 to 20 people.

title: Ham And Chicken Casserole
instructions: In skillet saut onion in butter until tender. In large bowl combine ham chicken peppers olives soup sour cream salt pepper and onion. Fold in noodles. Pour into greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Holiday Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add egg and sour cream. Add dry ingredients mixing well. Fold in dates nuts and cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Melt margarine. Mix sugar and eggs. Add coconut buttermilk and margarine. Mix well. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Brown meat onion and garlic together. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot. May garnish with Cheddar cheese or sour cream.

title: Cocoons
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Mixture should be very stiff and in a large round shape. Pinch off small amount and roll into cocoon shape. Place on a large cookie sheet close together but not touching (Cocoons will not rise). Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while hot.

title: Mac Gregor Bay Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place chicken breasts in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Layer Swiss cheese slices over chicken. Mix together 2 out of the 3 soups with milk. Place soup mixture over the cheese. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Take dish out of oven and sprinkle bread crumbs over chicken. Bake for another 15 minutes.

title: Thai Chicken Salad
instructions: Make Peanut Sauce; set aside. Remove chicken from bones and cut into bite size pieces (about 3 cups). Toss lettuce chicken parsley and onions in large bowl. Place lettuce mixture in center of large serving plate. Arrange noodles around edge of plate. Sprinkle peanuts over lettuce mixture. Drizzle sauce over salad. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Turkey Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients and press into greased 9 x 6-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Contains 180 calories per serving.

title: Killer Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan; spread pecans and coconut on bottom. Mix cake according to directions on box. Spread over nuts and coconut. Melt the cream cheese and margarine together (microwave is easiest way). Add the box of confectioners sugar. Pour this mixture over the cake batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool and serve out of pan. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Crackles
instructions: Combine cocoa oil and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and other ingredients. Chill dough. Shape in small balls and roll in powdered sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Put the ingredients into a large mixing bowl in order given without mixing. With electric mixer blend and then beat at high speed for 5 minutes. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan; pour batter into the pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cool in the pan before removing.

title: Janie'S Easy Lemon Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan. Combine butter pecans and coconut; spread on bottom of pan. Combine cake mix sour cream eggs water oil lemon and extract; beat for 2 minutes. Spoon on top of other batter in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove to platter drizzle with glaze that has been made with 1 cup powdered sugar and 2 teaspoons lemon juice.

title: Molasses Crinkles
instructions: Cream Crisco and brown sugar. Add the rest of ingredients and mix well. Roll dough into walnut sized balls. Dip in sugar and place sugar side up and 3-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle cookies with water for a cracked surface. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done. Dont overbake or they will be hard. Can chill dough overnight.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Drain beets reserving 2 tablespoons juice. Set beets and juice aside.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix butter sugar and eggs; beat until light and fluffy. Add almond extract. Stir in flour. Add baking powder until smooth. Spoon pie filling over cake in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon. Pour into baking dish. Lay bacon strips on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Apricot Pie
instructions: In large bowl sprinkle apricots with lemon juice. Combine sugar flour and nutmeg. Add sugar mixture to apricots; toss to coat fruit. Fill a pastry-lined 9-inch pie plate with apricot mixture; dot with butter. Put on top crust. Seal and flute edge. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Check to see if crust is browning. If brown cover edges with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for another 25 minutes until golden brown. Cool on rack before serving.

title: Marguaritas
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into chilled glasses. Put slice of lime on rim of glass.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown onion in margarine. Combine with soup broth and chilies. Add chicken and heat. In large baking dish (9 x 13-inch) place a layer of tortillas layer of soup mixture. Repeat layers as needed. Top with cheese. May be frozen. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: K'S Cajun Seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Fill a shaker for daily use. Store remainder in a tightly covered container. It has a long shelf life and can be used on all kinds of recipes.

title: Fish Soup
instructions: Over medium heat cook potatoes onion garlic and bay leaves in a saucepan for 5 minutes until onions are translucent. Add remaining ingredients except fish. Boil until vegetables are tender. Add fish and heat until cooked through. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Beat eggs and add to rest of mixture. Bake on lightly greased griddle.

title: Skewered Lamb (Souvlakia)
instructions: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes and place in marinating dish. Mix all other ingredients and pour over meat. Cover and refrigerate overnight stirring occasionally.

title: Old Fashioned Lemonade
instructions: Wash fruit and slice thinly. Remove seeds. Place lemon slices in a large bowl. Cover fruit with sugar. Let stand for 10 minutes then press firmly with potato masher to extract juice. Add water and continue to press fruit until liquid is well flavored. Add ice cubes. Yields 1 gallon.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix last four ingredients together. In a large pan or marinating dish marinate chicken wings for at least 24 hours in the fridge. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes turning frequently.

title: Chicken Chimichangas
instructions: Combine chicken sauce onions and spices and simmer 5 minutes in saucepan. Brush tortillas with margarine. Spoon meat mixture and cheese in tortillas. Fold and place in 9 x 12-inch aluminum pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Garnish with olives.

title: Italian Beef In The Crock-Pot
instructions: Cut roast in small squares. Place roast bouillon cubes garlic salt and Italian dressing in crock-pot. Add enough water to almost cover all beef. Cook on low for 8 hours.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream together the first 4 ingredients. Add eggs vanilla and sour milk mixing until well blended. Sift dry ingredients and add to moist mixture; mix in zucchini last. Spoon into greased and floured 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan and sprinkle top of cake with chocolate chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Orange Salad #1
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add orange juice sherbet and oranges. Refrigerate.

title: Double Chocolate Walnut Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour a large baking sheet. In a bowl whisk together flour cocoa powder baking soda and salt. In another bowl with an electric mixer beat together butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat until combined well. Stir in flour mixture to form a stiff dough. Stir in walnuts and chocolate chips.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add crushed crackers peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well pour in buttered pan.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine in a large bowl the broccoli rice onion butter celery soups and melted Cheeez Whiz; mix well. Pour into greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Yummy Coconut Bars
instructions: Mix together crackers butter and sugar. Press into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake for 10 minutes while mixing coconut milk and vanilla. Spread onto cracker crust and return to oven for 10 minutes more. Spread chips over coconut and return to oven to melt slightly. Remove and immediately spread chips out smoothly over top while hot. Cool and cut before cold. Store in airtight container.

title: Cranberry Apple Orange Salad
instructions: Empty cranberries into large mixing bowl. Chop remaining ingredients coarsely in food processor or blender. Add to berries and marinate overnight or several days.

title: Cream Cheese Croissant Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Unroll 1 can of dough. Press in bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan to form crust. Firmly press perforations to seal.

title: Lurline'S Shoe Peg Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Spray a large casserole dish with Pam. Pour ingredients into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and let gel. Whip dry whipped topping and cream cheese. Spread over gelled mixture. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Chapati
instructions: Knead the dough as you would pizza dough only this time with only flour and water. You may add or reduce the water or flour to make a soft nonsticky dough. The softer the better. Using a rolling pin spread small piece of dough to make it flat and circular. Spread some oil on it as we do donuts. After rolling spread it again and lay it on a cooking pan (should be heavy). Cook one side until it has brown spots. Turn it and apply some oil. When the other side is brown do the same. Turn again and cook both sides until golden brown. Store in a tight place. Keep them warm and soft. Serve warm with chicken or beef (or any) soup.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Put chipped beef in cold water for 1/2 hour before cooking. Place chipped beef in bottom of pan. Wrap bacon around chicken. Combine sour cream mushroom soup mushrooms and pimentos. Pour mushroom sauce over chicken. Cook for 2 hours at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Uncover the last 30 minutes.

title: Vinegar Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugar together. Add all remaining ingredients. Beat until blended. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Before baking flatten with a flat bottom glass dipped in ice water. Bake 350 for 8 minutes or until edges are lightly golden. Makes 3 dozen depending on size. Sprinkle powdered sugar on cookies.

title: Spinach Pie
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on package. Drain well. Press with fork in strainer. Beat eggs and add salt pepper Parmesan cheese cooled spinach Ricotta cheese and shredded Muenster. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Line greased pan with crescent rolls; put in mixture. Form lattice crust on top with extra dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 until dough turns brown.

title: 1950'S Mystery Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix and sprinkle on top. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0 until tests done.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Drain corn reserving liquid. Add enough milk to liquid to measure 1 cup. Combine egg milk mixture and corn. Combine dry ingredients. Mix just until moist. Drop batter from tablespoon into 375\u00b0 deep fat. Fry until brown 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on paper towel. Serve warm maple syrup with fritters.

title: Pot Stickers
instructions: For filling Squeeze cabbage to remove as much moisture as possible; place in large bowl. Add pork onion water soy sauce cornstarch ginger sesame oil and sugar; mix well. Place 1 rounded teaspoonful filling in center of each pot sticker wrapper.

title: Coffee Crumb Cake
instructions: Combine sugar salt flour and baking powder. Mix well. Add Wesson oil. Take out 1 cup and to this add cinnamon and set this aside for use as topping. To 1 egg beaten with a fork add enough milk to make 1 cup. Add this along with vanilla to flour mixture and mix with an electric mixer to make very smooth. Pour batter into rectangular baking pan (13 x 9-inch) and sprinkle crumb mixture over batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. When cool sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix molasses butter and sugar with boiling water. Add sifted flour and baking soda to the spices. Add well beaten eggs then stir in raisins and nuts. Bake in loaf or square pan for 40 minutes at approximately 350\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy adding sugar gradually. Blend in vanilla. Add eggs one at a time. Add buttermilk. Sprinkle pecans in bottom of a 9-inch unbaked pastry shell and pour filling over. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Best if served at room temperature.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Sausage Stars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blot sausage dry with paper towels and combine with cheeses salad dressing olives and red pepper.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions and bell peppers and drain. Add tomato paste water and mushrooms. Add garlic to taste. Add oregano and parsley flakes. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Simmer over low heat for 30 to 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Prepare noodles according to package and serve together.

title: Grape Gelatin Salad
instructions: Mix gelatin and water in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Add pineapple then blueberry pie filling. Let mixture congeal thoroughly.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix together in a jar. When ready to serve add 2 to 3 tablespoons to a cup of hot water.

title: Water Chestnut Dip
instructions: Mix the sour cream cream cheese Miracle Whip and water chestnuts. Add the rest of the ingredients to taste. Mix all well. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Homemade Sauerkraut
instructions: Wash cabbage well and drain. Cut in half and decore. Slice cabbage into very thin slices. Mix salt with cabbage. Pack very tightly (stomp) into a 3 gallon stone jar. Make sure juice (water) is above cabbage 1/2 inch. Invert plate on top of cabbage to weight it under water so as not to float. Cover jar with cloth. Let stand for 5 days. Taste for sourness (if not enough let sit a couple more days). Put into large pot and bring to a boil. Place in glass jars with seals and lids to can.

title: Blackberry Custard Pie
instructions: Cook blackberries; add sugar and stir. Add margarine and stir. Mix 1/2 cup milk and flour stirring until the mixture is not lumpy. Combine blackberries and flour mixture and cook until done. Pour mixture into pie shell. Let cool then top with 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip.

title: Heavenly Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Reserve coconut milk and grate coconuts. Sift flour sugar baking powder and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Repeat sifting. Beat egg whites with remaining salt until stiff peaks form. Whip the cream until stiff and fold lightly into egg whites with wire whisk.

title: Creamed Peas
instructions: Wash beans well cover with water 3 to 4 times height of beans bring to boil then simmer 1 hour or until bean skins slip off easily. Drain and rinse twice. Place in baking dish add remaining ingredients and then water to well above top of beans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours then at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours. Check to make sure liquid covers beans but do not stir. Leave in oven overnight. Reheat the following day.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Heat cream cheese in double boiler or fondue pan. Add remaining ingredients. Serve warm. Enjoy!

title: Pork Chops Pizzaiola
instructions: Sprinkle chops on both sides with black pepper. Heat in heavy skillet. Add chops and brown 5 minutes per side. Add garlic mushrooms tomatoes and green pepper. Place chops on top of vegetables. Add wine or broth. Sprinkle with oregano. Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes until chops are no longer pink and vegetables are crisp. Good served with buttered noodles.

title: Liver Paste
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Cook onion and chicken livers until onion is transparent and livers are pink; do not fry. Put liver mixture with juice in the blender. Add hard-cooked eggs. Blend well until smooth. Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Add salad dressing. Mix well. Refrigerate. Very good.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into a lightly greased 1-quart baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Stuffed Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise and remove the yolks. Mash yolks with the cream salt and pepper. Stuff the egg whites with egg yolk mixture and serve.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar with the Snowdrift. Beat eggs. Mix soda and water flour cinnamon raisins and oatmeal. Bake.

title: Picnic Baked Beans
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Combine with remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into large baking dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until hot. Yield 10 servings.

title: Ohelo Berry Pie
instructions: Mix fruit sugar and tapioca in bowl. Place\tin uncooked pie crust.\tDot with butter; cover with top crust.\tCut slits in crust for steam to escape. Bake at 400\u00b0\tfor 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Beat together cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning. Stir in Cheddar cheese green chilies and onion. Chill.

title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as package directs. Brown sausage. When sausage is almost done add onion and bell pepper to it and saute until tender. To cooked rice add sausage mixture cheese milk and pepper; mix well. Place in casserole dish and microwave on High for 10 minutes with cover and lightly stir enough to mix. Microwave on High another 5 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Melt butter. Add all ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees or until straw comes out clean.

title: Savory Sauerkraut
instructions: Mix all ingredients and heat well. Serve.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Add cream of tartar. Gradually add sugar. Continue beating until stiff peaks form. Add vanilla. Break crackers into large pieces and fold in. Add nuts. Pour into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Spread pie filling over cooled cake. Cut into servings and top with Cool Whip or any whipped cream.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: In a bowl beat butter and sugar with an electric mixer on medium speed about 4 minutes or until fluffy. Stir in chocolate and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating on high after each addition and scraping sides of bowl constantly. Transfer to baked pie shell. Cover; chill for 5 to 24 hours or until set. If desired top with unsweetened whip cream and chocolate curls.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Fry meat; crumble and drain. Put in large baking dish. Cover with sauce then layer with cheese. Mix eggs Bisquick and milk and pour over the top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Heavenly Fruit Salad
instructions: Refrigerate for 12 hours.

title: Quick Danish Pastry
instructions: In saucepan bring water to boil. Add butter. Stir and simmer until butter melts. Remove from heat and add almond extract. Stir in flour until blended. Return to low heat; cook and stir 1 minute or until dough follows spoon around pan. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs 1 at a time. Beat well after each addition until well combined. Spread evenly over crust in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until brown. Remove to rack to cool. (Pastry will fall forming custard like filling.) Spread with Sugar Glaze.

title: Ribbon Icebox Dessert
instructions: Line bottom of\ta 9 x 13-inch pan with half of graham crackers. Cut to fit if necessary. Beat powdered sugar and 3 tablespoons cream.\tSpread\ton crackers and top with remaining crackers. Chill. Heat to boiling water and juice. Add jello and dissolve. Cool until partially set. Divide into 2 parts. Add 3/4 cup of evaporated milk to one part and beat at high speed until fluffy. Pour over crackers. Chill. Add 3/4 cup water and fruit to other part. Pour over whipped layer and chill until set. Cut into squares.

title: Carrot Cake And Icing
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients (first 6 in list). Separately beat sugar into oil (room temperature) on high speed. When the mixture is fluffy add eggs at room temperature one at a time. Gradually add dry ingredients to liquid. Bake in a 10 x 15-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or use 9 x 13-inch or an 8-inch square pan. A Bundt pan would require more time. Test the cake for doneness by inserting toothpick to see if dough is cohering or lightly touch the top to see whether it springs back.

title: Ambrosia Balls
instructions: Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 to 12 minutes until set (not brown) at 400\u00b0. While warm roll in confectioners sugar. Cool. Roll in sugar again. Makes 4 dozen. Different and delicious!

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut flowerets off broccoli; cut in very small pieces. Add raisins bacon bits and sunflower seeds. Mix Miracle Whip with vinegar and sugar. Mix with broccoli mixture. Top with separated purple onion slices (optional).

title: Country Spoon Bread
instructions: Beat eggs in a large bowl. Add corns sour cream butter and muffin mix and stir. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with cheese and bake 15 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In large skillet mix margarine sugar milk and cocoa. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat add peanut butter vanilla salt and oatmeal. Mix well. Drop from spoon onto wax paper. Let cool.

title: Cheesy French Bread
instructions: Cut French bread into slices but not through bottom crust. Insert thin slice of cheese between each. Melt margarine; combine with minced onion and poppy seed. Pour over top of bread. Sprinkle with paprika. Wrap loosely in foil leaving open at top. Heat in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sausage-Greens Pie
instructions: Brown 1 pie shell. To ground sausage add eggs Mozzarella cheese Ricotta cheese salt pepper and garlic. Mix well. Blend in greens. Pour into brown pie shell. Cut remaining uncooked pie crust into strips. Lace over top of the green sausage mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Chocolate Peanut Delight
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine dry cake mix butter milk and egg. Add 3/4 c. of peanuts. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. In a mixing bowl beat the cream cheese peanut butter sugar condensed milk and vanilla until smooth. Fold in 3 cups whipped topping. Spread over the crust; top with the remaining whipped topping and peanuts. In a microwave-safe bowl heat chocolate chips and butter on high for 1 minute or until melted. Stir in vanilla until smooth; drizzle over cake. Refrigerate for 2-3 hours before cutting. Yield 12-15 servings.

title: Traveling Junk Food
instructions: In saucepan combine the first 4 ingredients. Cook until sugar melts. In a 9 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish mix the last 3 ingredients. Pour liquid mixture over dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until crisp.

title: Cranberry Cheese Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixer bowl combine flour oats 3/4 cup sugar and margarine; mix until crumbly. Reserving 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture press remainder firmly on bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix together all of the ingredients.

title: One Minute Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Boil sugar margarine milk and cocoa together 1 minute; add vanilla. Beat until cool or ready to spread.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add eggs milk oil and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in boiling water. Batter will be thin. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool. (Frosting may be found on back of Hersheys cocoa box.)

title: Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Drain and cool. Collect all ingredients in a large bowl. Stir to mix but avoid mashing. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Put potatoes in a baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes at 425\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheeses. Bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Italian Cheese Log
instructions: After cheese has softened mix in onion black olives and garlic. Refrigerate until hard enough to shape into log. Roll log in chopped pecans or walnuts.

title: Baked Fish Delmar
instructions: Combine butter lemon juice onions salt and parsley flakes. Place single layer of fish in sprayed 8 x 11-inch baking pan. Pour mixture over and bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Ten minutes before finished sprinkle paprika over fillets.

title: Scotch Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter and add sugar. Blend thoroughly. Add egg yolk and vanilla. Sift flour and baking soda and mix well with first mixture. Spread in ungreased pan and then prick deeply with a fork. Bake in a 250\u00b0 moderate oven for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Oven Porcupines
instructions: Mix meat rice 1/2 cup water onion salt garlic powder and black pepper. Shape the mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls into balls. Place meatballs in long pan or baking dish. Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Angel Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs with hot water. Once the eggs cool for about 15 minutes peel the eggs. After you peeled the eggs cut them in half then take out the yolk and put them in the bowl. After youve taken out the yolk and put it in the bowl add some mustard and mayonnaise and mix it with a whisk. After youve mixed it up thoroughly put the yolk back in each egg equally. Then powder some paprika on it...and Voile!..Angel \Deviled\ eggs.

title: Chicken And Rice Bake
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except chicken) together. Pour into a Pam sprayed 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Put chicken pieces on mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cover loosely with foil. Test chicken with a fork if tender and if liquid is absorbed. If desired uncover last 15 minutes to brown chicken.

title: Polish Sausage Stir-Fry
instructions: In wok or large skillet heat oil. Add potatoes and carrots. Stir-fry a little; add onions. Stir-fry and cover a few minutes. Add broccoli mushrooms and sausage stir and mix. Add seasonings; cover and cook until vegetables are done. Stir occasionally.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix with mixer on low. Refrigerate for a couple of hours.

title: Carrot Bread
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add sifted dry ingredients to this mixture. Add carrots packed firmly. Add vanilla and nuts. Turn into well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chuck Wagon Slaw
instructions: In large bowl combine mayonnaise and seasonings. Add cabbage and beans mixing lightly but thoroughly. Cover and chill to blend flavors. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Simmer together until veggies are well done about 1 hour.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions making 2 (8-inch) layers. When completely cool split both layers. Combine sugar sour cream and coconut and blend well. Spread between layers and on top of cake. Seal in airtight container and refrigerate 3 days before serving.

title: Snow Covered Almond Crescent Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Beat butter sugar and almond extract until well blended. Add flour and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats and almonds. Use level tablespoonfuls. Shape dough into crescents. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 14 to 17 minutes until light golden brown. Remove warm cookies to wire rack. Sift with powdered sugar. Cool completely. Store tightly covered. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Fresh Pear Cake(Super Moist)
instructions: Combine pears and 2 cups sugar. Let set for a few hours or overnight. Stir occasionally to extract juice. Mix remaining ingredients easily with big spoon. Grease and flour bundt pan. Bake at 325 to 350 degrees for about 70 to 90 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Chicken
instructions: Combine flour salt pepper and onion salt (to taste). Roll chicken in seasoned flour. Melt butter in skillet; brown chicken on both sides. Remove chicken to casserole dish. Combine soup and sour cream. Spoon over chicken. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Riveria Garden Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and cheese according to directions. Add sour cream and Miracle Whip; mix. Add vegetables salt and pepper. Mix again lightly and chill.

title: Classic Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Add salt and cook for 20 minutes or until done but not overdone. Cool slightly. Add other ingredients adjusting amounts to individual taste. After potato salad is mixed sprinkle with paprika and chill. Serves 20.

title: Stay-Crisp Vegetable Slaw
instructions: Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Mix vegetables; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cold water. Mix sugar vinegar celery seed salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Stir in gelatin and cool until slightly thickened; beat well. Gradually beat in oil. Drain vegetables. Add dressing and toss until coated. It will keep for a few days in refrigerator.

title: Apple Carrot Muffins
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; stir in carrots apples and almonds. Make well in center of mixture and combine egg oil and vanilla; stir until moistened. Spoon into muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Great with coffee in the mornings.

title: Gilbert'S Favorite Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil fryer until tender. Remove bones and skin. Cut up and place in 2-quart baking dish. Mix broth and soup stirring until smooth. Sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken and pour broth mixture over it. Melt butter and mix with flour and milk. Pour this mixture over chicken and bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Noodle Casserole
instructions: In large skillet brown beef with onion and garlic. Drain well. Mix in tomatoes oregano salt and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Mix in zucchini. After 10 minutes blend in noodles.

title: Meringue Kisses(A Melt In Your Mouth Cookie)
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff not dry. Add sugar gradually while blending with mixer. Blend in vanilla then fold in chocolate chips. Drop onto cookie sheet lined with brown paper. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool before removing from paper. Can be colored with food coloring for special occasions. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Combine eggs cornmeal salt corn milk and vegetable oil in bowl; set aside. Cook ground beef until browned. Drain set aside. Pour half cornmeal mixture into a greased 10 1/2 inch iron skilled. Sprinkle evenly with ground beef pour on salsa and top with cheese. Pour the rest of batter over top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand. Serves 6-8.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Make filling first so it can cool. Melt Kraft caramels and margarine in a saucepan. Add Eagle Brand milk; stir often and cool. Mix German chocolate cake as directed. Pour half the batter in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and cool. Pour filling over cake layer; sprinkle with pecans and chocolate chips. Pour remaining batter on top and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dowen'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Throw it all in a bowl and stir real well. Divide between 2 (9-inch) pie pans and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes (or until lightly browned). It actually makes its own crust so the hardest part is cleaning up the kitchen! Serves 4 men or 12 ladies.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole dish mix all ingredients together until well blended. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until liquid is set and top is a golden brown. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Anita'S Lasagna
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients well. Boil a 1 pound package of lasagna noodles. Spread 1 tablespoon of sauce thinly in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan. Put one layer of noodles down; put close together - no need to overlap. One layer should require 3 or 4 noodles. Sprinkle with grated cheese of choice. Spread 1/2 the cheese filling as a layer over the noodles. Cover with 4-5 slices of cheese. Then add another layer of noodles sprinkle with grated cheese and cover this layer with sauce. Add another layer of noodles grated cheese rest of cheese filling and sliced cheese. Add the last layer of noodles grated cheese and sauce. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30-40 minutes or in 400\u00b0 oven for 20-30 minutes or until the cheese filling appears to be firm. Allow to cool for 5-10 minutes. Serve with any leftover sauce.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar Karo and water in heavy pan cook over medium heat slowly. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook until soft ball stage (238\u00b0). Add peanuts and salt. Cook to hard crack stage (298\u00b0) stirring constantly. Peanuts turn to golden brown stir with wooden spoon about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter soda and vanilla. Stir slightly. It turns yellow. Pour onto buttered jellyroll pan; flatten. Cool. Break into pieces. Put into airtight container.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise together. Spread mixture over ham slices. Place a dill spear at one of ham slice and roll it up. Secure with a toothpick. Let chill for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Christmas Ornaments
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add 1 tablespoon water extra if needed to form a dough. Roll between plastic to about 1/8-inch thick. Use hollow cookie cutters; put on rack to let dry. Use a straw to put hole in top of each ornament. When dry tie with ribbon; hang on tree.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Cook melted butter and brown sugar 2 minutes. Add milk; cook 2 minutes. Cool. Add confectioners sugar and vanilla. Beat and spread.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar. Add 2 cups of hot water; stir to dissolve then add the other 6 cups of cold water. Stir. Add pineapple juice and stir. Just before serving add 2 quarts of ginger ale.

title: 15-Minute Super Sundae Pie
instructions: In a mixer bowl stir slightly softened ice cream until smooth. Spoon the ice cream until pie crust is almost full and cover with the inverted plastic lid. Place pie in freezer for several hours until hard.

title: Ice Apple Tea
instructions: Place tea bags in pitcher. Cover with boiling water. Leave for 5 minutes. Squeeze tea bags and discard. Stir in honey until dissolved. Stir in apple juice. Chill or add ice cubes to glasses. Drop a lemon slice and mint sprig in each. Makes 4 servings.

title: O'Henry Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oats. Stir in oats and pat in 9 x 13-inch greased Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Take out of oven and run knife around sides.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix soups broth and onion soup mix and heat on top of stove. Mix in rest of ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. You may top with bread crumbs or crushed corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves about 6.

title: Low-Fat Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Except for pie shell and garnish beat all ingredients in a large bowl with mixer until smooth. Pour into pie shell. Bake 50 to 55 minutes until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack then chill about 4 hours or up to 2 days. Just before serving garnish with whipped topping; sprinkle cinnamon and pecan halves.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Toss peaches with 1/3 cup sugar and cinnamon. Spoon into a lightly greased 9-inch deep pie plate and set aside. Combine flour and remaining sugar. Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle on top of peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 or 40 minutes. Based on 6 servings each serving contains 283 calories; 8g fat; 79mg sodium; 21mg cholesterol.

title: Symphony Pie
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and melted chocolate together. Pour into ready-made crust. Freeze or refrigerate.

title: Crispy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix above ingredients together until light and fluffy. Add 1 cup sifted self-rising flour and mix well. Then stir in 1 cup rolled oats (not instant or quick cooking) 1/2 chopped nuts and 1/2 cup raisins.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cut lettuce and tomatoes into small pieces. Cut Longhorn into cubes. Crumble up the chips. Brown the ground meat. Chop the onion and green pepper. Mix everything together then add the dressing. Good cold or at room temperature.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding milk and condensed milk in bowl and beat until thick. Add whipping cream. Place wafers and bananas in bowl. Pour pudding mixture over wafers and bananas. Chill about 1 hour. Spread Cool Whip on top.

title: Coney Island Wiener Sauce
instructions: Brown hamburg and onion; drain. Add spices and boiling water. Simmer 2 1/2 hours.

title: French Cheese Rolls
instructions: In a small bowl beat cream cheese with electric mixer until soft. Add milk; continue beating until smooth. Cut crusts from bread. Roll over each slice once with rolling pin to flatten slightly. Spread each bread slice with cream cheese mixture and 1 tablespoon preserves. Roll up each slice jelly roll fashion. Wrap rolls individually in waxed paper or plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight or at least 2 hours.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Tenderize meat. Cut into thin strips; trim fat. Brown lightly in butter. Remove meat from pan. Add onions and mushrooms; cook until tender. Add meat tomato juice salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 50 minutes until fork-tender.

title: Foil Packs
instructions: Clean and peel ingredients. Tear off pieces of foil about 12 to 15 inches long one for each serving needed. Place a mixture of the chopped veggies in foil equal to a serving size. Crumble ground beef over the veggies; salt and pepper. Wrap with rolled seams to keep in steam. Place packs on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In saucepan melt butter on low heat. Remove and add flour dry mustard and salt. Mix well. Add milk and heat on medium heat until sauce thickens. Add cheese and heat until cheese melts. Stir occasionally. Crumble bread crumbs over top and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0.

title: Quick Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon. Reserve 2 teaspoons drippings. Saute green peppers and onion in drippings for 2 minutes. Add beans mustard catsup and sugar; mix well. Simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Combine bacon and stir into beans. Yield 4 servings.

title: Chicken Salad Supreme
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and mustard. Toss dressing lightly with remaining ingredients and chill. Serves 4.

title: Eggplant Appetizer
instructions: Peel eggplant. Cut into 1-inch cubes. Heat oil and start cooking chopped celery then add eggplant green pepper onion and garlic. Cook until tender. Add nutmeg curry powder and oregano to taste. Then add Worcestershire sauce tomato paste salt and pepper. Serve hot or cold on crackers or bread.

title: Pickle Wraps
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese with garlic powder. Spread on ham or turkey slices (or your meat of choice) put a pickle in the middle and roll up.

title: Homemade - Hand Churned Fruit Ice Cream(Strawberry - Peach)
instructions: Churn in hand churn with crushed ice and plenty of salt.

title: Midnight Cake
instructions: Cream shortening add sugar gradually and cream until fluffy. Blend in well beaten eggs slowly. Add hot water to cocoa and mix until smooth. Stir to dissolve completely. Sift flour salt soda and baking powder together and add to cream mixture alternately with hot water and cocoa mixture. Blend in vanilla. Pour into a 8-inch square pan; bake 30-55 minutes in a moderate oven 320-350\u00b0.

title: Yankee Noodle Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In skillet sprayed with butter flavored cooking spray brown frankfurters green pepper and onion until tender. Combine with noodles tomato sauce brown sugar substitute mustard and pepper. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Claudia Sanders Yeast Rolls
instructions: Sift flour and salt together. Work in butter. Set aside. Dissolve yeast in water. Combine the yeast egg and sugar. Add yeast mixture to flour mixture. Shape into rolls and place on a greased baking pan. Let rise 2 1/2 hours. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 425\u00b0. Makes 12 rolls.

title: Rinderrouladen
instructions: Pound beef until 1/4 inch thick. Cut into pieces 7x4 inches. Lightly sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Spread each piece with 1 Tbsp. mustard. Place 1/2 strip bacon down center of each piece. Sprinkle with onion and snipped parsley. Place 1/2 of a pickle on narrow end of each piece roll up. Fasten with wooden picks. Heat oil in 10 inch skillet until hot. Cook rolls over medium heat until brown on all sides. Add 1/4 cup water 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper. Heat to boiling reduce heat. Cover and simmer until beef is tender about 1 hour. Remove rolls and keep them warm. Add enough water to liquid in skillet if necessary to measure about 1 cup. Mix 2 Tbsp of flour and 2 Tbsp of water then stir gradually into broth. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir for 1 minute and add water if needed. Serve rolls with gravy. Garnish with parsley springs and serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and pineapple (drained). Add marshmallows and nuts. Stir. Mix in Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

title: Chris' Breakfast Delight
instructions: Mix the ingredients in a blender or mixer.

title: Baked Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine egg and milk; stir well and set aside. Combine cheese flour paprika salt and pepper; mix well. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Dip in egg mixture and dredge in flour mixture. Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish; pour margarine over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole dish. Mix all other ingredients together and pour into casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour uncovered.

title: Self-Frosting Double Fudge Cake
instructions: Empty dry cake mix into bowl. Add eggs and pudding. Mix well. (Batter will be thick.) Spread into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle top of batter with sugar then chocolate chips and top with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Or Caramel Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla. Over medium heat stir until sugar dissolves. When mixture comes to a boil boil for 4 minutes. Add vanilla; cool and beat.

title: Chili Con Questa Dip
instructions: Brown beef; add all the other ingredients except cheese. Simmer 5 minutes. In a double boiler melt cheese and add to the browned beef mixture. Serve in chafing dish or small crock-pot with Doritos chips.

title: Clifford'S Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in refrigerator to chill before serving.

title: Cherry Cheer
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Fold in whipped topping. Chill for about 1 hour before serving.

title: Aria Pork Chop Dinner
instructions: Sear pork chops quickly on both sides. Put seared pork chops in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan (greased). Place rice on each pork chops. Top with mushrooms green bell peppers onion salt and pepper. Now take your whole tomatoes and open it up like a flower and place over the top of each pork chop. Pour remaining juice in baking pan. Optional toppings are Parmesan cheese or sharp Cheddar cheese. Place your Aria Pork Chops covered in the oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Uncover and bake another 10 or 15 minutes or until tender.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. In a plastic bag or bowl mix 3/4 cup sugar and cinnamon and shake until pieces are coated. Layer in greased Bundt pan. Between each layer pour melted butter and brown sugar and sprinkle with chopped nuts and cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Delight
instructions: Place apples in ungreased pan. Mix other ingredients together with fork and sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 in ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Store in a large container. To serve add 1/3 cup mixture to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli. Melt margarine. Mix rest of ingredients. Pour over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers thoroughly using a vegetable brush; drain on rack. Slice unpeeled cucumbers into 1/8 to 1/4-inch slices; discard ends. Add onions and garlic. Add salt and mix thoroughly; cover with crushed ice or ice cubes; let stand 3 hours. Drain thoroughly; remove garlic cloves. Combine sugar spices and vinegar; heat just to boiling. Add drained cucumbers and onion slices and heat 5 minutes. Pack hot pickles loosely into clean hot pint jars to 1/2-inch of top. Adjust jar lids. Process in boiling water for 5 minutes (start to count processing time as soon as water in canner returns to boiling). Remove jars and complete seals if necessary. Set jars upright to cool.

title: Sausage Egg Casserole
instructions: Spread bread crumbs in bottom of casserole dish. Brown sausage and layer over crumbs. Beat eggs milk salt and mustard. Pour over sausage. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
instructions: Boil for 1 minute the sugar cocoa milk and oleo; remove from heat. Add oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. Stir and drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

title: Crushed Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until done.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserve drippings in saucepan. Crumble bacon set aside. Add potatoes celery onion salt thyme pepper clam liquid. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. In quart jar with lid add flour to milk. Shake well. Stir into vegetables mixture. Cook over medium heat 15 minutes or until thickened. Stir in clams gently stirring frequently. Do Not Boil. Garnish each serving with bacon. 4 servings.

title: Indian Fry Bread 2(Makes About 2 Dozen)
instructions: Put flour baking powder and salt in a large bowl. Mix well. Add water and stir until dough begins to form a ball. On a lightly floured surface knead dough lightly 2 to 3 minutes. Do not over work. Place in a bowl and refrigerate 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar milk butter eggs and vanilla. Mix well with mixer. Spoon in lightly greased 2-quart casserole.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening in large mixer bowl until light. Add sugar; beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Mix baking cocoa food coloring and water in small bowl to make paste. Stir into creamed mixture. Mix flour and salt together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with mixture of vanilla and buttermilk beating well after each addition. Sprinkle with soda; drizzle with vinegar. Stir gently until mixed; do not beat. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool. Spread frosting between layers and over top and side of cake. Garnish with coconut. This is a beautiful Valentine or Christmas treat. Yield 12 servings.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Cut in lard with a pastry blender. Add liquid one or two tablespoons at a time. Makes 2 double crust pies.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: In a large bowl mix vinegar 4 cups water garlic bay leaf spices and salt. Add eggs on onion rings. Cover. Refrigerate for several days.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except the grated cheese. Pour into a greased 3-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle the grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Save some of the caps from the mushrooms for topping. Cut up the rest of mushrooms. Brown the croutons in half of the butter. Place in 8 x 8-inch pan. Saute onion and cut up mushrooms in remaining butter. Spread evenly over croutons. Over this spread the undiluted soup. Top with the mushroom caps. Sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Good with steak.

title: Very Blueberry Pie
instructions: Make a smooth paste of water flour and salt. Boil 1 cup of the blueberries with sugar and 1/2 cup water. Add the flour paste and stir until it thickens. Remove from stove and cool. When cool add the remaining blueberries and put into baked pie shell. Refrigerate. When cold garnish with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Nut Torte
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Combine sugars and slowly add to egg whites. Fold in flavorings. Combine crackers and nuts; fold into eggs. Pour into two well-greased (1 tablespoon each) pie pans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes (no longer). Will be light in color but darkens as cools. When cake is cooled slice bananas on top until covered (5 or 6). Cover with whipped topping making certain to cover completely and seal edges. Sprinkle over topping 1/2 cup chopped pecans and 1/2 cup maraschino cherries chopped fine. Refrigerate.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Drain chopped vegetables. Add seasoned vinegar and cook very slowly for about 1/2 hour. Pack into hot jars and process for 15 minutes. This makes about 6 pints.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix oleo shortening water and cocoa. Let come to boil and set aside. Put sugar flour eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla in bowl and pour in cocoa mixture. Stir up. Put in a 9 x 12-inch greased floured pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Wild Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Sift together the dry ingredients. Toss in blueberries. Stir in mixture of egg milk oil and rind. For perfect muffins do not overmix. Batter should look lumpy. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full.\tSprinkle tops with a little powdered sugar. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until muffins are\tpuffed and golden. Run a knife around inside of each cup to loosen muffins and serve at once. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Chuck Wagon Stew (Gene Aaron'S Special)(Texarkansas Southwest Regional)
instructions: Brown hamburger and chopped onion together. Add beans corn soup and tomatoes. Simmer about 20 minutes. Serve with plain or jalapeno corn bread.

title: Crock-Pot Chili
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Put in crock-pot with all other ingredients except beans. Cook on low setting 8 to 10 hours. Add beans last hour.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Boil together all ingredients. Add cooked rice and simmer.

title: Glorified Pork Chops
instructions: In a skillet in hot oil cook half of the chops 10 minutes until browned. Remove; set aside. Repeat with remaining chops. Spoon off fat. In skillet combine soup and water. Return chops to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until chops are no longer pink. Serve over rice.

title: Easy Stew
instructions: Pour all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low for 8 hours. Delicious served over rice.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all. Put in loaf pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Waldorf Chicken Salad
instructions: Line 2-quart salad bowl with spinach. Sprinkle egg on spinach. Arrange grated carrots around edge of spinach. Arrange chicken celery apple walnuts and raisins in center. Serve with Honey Mustard Dressing on the side.

title: Lenten Mocha Cake
instructions: Add sugar oil cocoa and mix then dry ingredients and vanilla. Mix well. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Frost with powdered sugar or chocolate frosting.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 15 3/4 x 10 1/2-inch jellyroll pan. Line with waxed paper and grease again. In medium bowl combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In large bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually beat in 1/3 cup sugar one tablespoon at a time until sugar dissolves and stiff glossy peaks form. In another bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg yolks until lemon color. Gradually beat in 1/2 cup sugar. Beat in flour mixture and pumpkin pie filling. Gently fold into beaten egg whites. Spread batter in pan. Bake 15 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Spread a clean towel on counter. Sprinkle towel with ground walnuts. Turn cake immediately onto towel. Remove waxed paper. Roll cake in towel from short end. Cool.

title: Hot Cheese Chowder
instructions: Saute celery onion and green pepper in butter in Dutch oven until tender. Add chicken broth potato and carrot; bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Kahlua Dip
instructions: Mix and refrigerate at least overnight. Great on fruit especially strawberries. Was a big hit at a graduation party.

title: Grilled Chicken Or Turkey Breast
instructions: Make marinade of all ingredients.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Soak yeast in warm water. Mix liquids and white sugar together. Add 2 cups flour; beat until smooth then add rest of flour and mix well. Let stand 4 hours. Roll out and spread with oleo brown sugar and cinnamon. Let rise until double in size. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in hot oven.

title: Hot Clam Dip
instructions: Melt butter; put onion and pepper (chopped) in it with oregano and parsley. Simmer until onion and peppers are soft. Add clams with lemon juice. Cook for 10 minutes more. Add bread crumbs and mix well. Put into a square tin dish and add American cheese on top of it. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Serve warm with crackers. And enjoy!!!

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Cook without stirring until a rolling boil. Remove from heat. Stir and test in ice water for very soft ball. Cool to lukewarm by placing saucepan in ice cold water. When cool beat. Mixture will lose shine and get a little thick. May seem a little thin but begin to frost cake the icing will harden quickly. Place frosted cake in airtight cake box.

title: Smoked Sausage Sauerkraut Casserole
instructions: Heat oil in skillet and fry chopped onions. Add sauerkraut and simmer for 2 minutes. Add water and sausage; cook until done. Stir in grated potato carrot salt and sugar. Cook 4 to 5 additional minutes.

title: Vegetable Squares(Vegetable Pizza)
instructions: Flatten crescent rolls in cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool. Mix mayonnaise cream cheese and Ranch dressing. Spread on dough. Cut vegetables and cheese in small pieces and spread vegetables on top. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Creamy Potluck Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender. Drain. Rinse with cold water; drain again. In a large mixing bowl stir together the soup sour cream cream cheese and butter. Add 1/4 cup of Cheddar cheese 3 tablespoons of green onion skim milk parsley garlic salt and pepper. Stir mixture to combine. Stir in potatoes. Place in 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until heated through. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake until cheese melts. Sprinkle with remaining green onion.

title: Spicy Rice
instructions: Soak rice in hot water for 15 minutes. Rinse in colander and let drain. Saute rice in butter until golden. Puree tomatoes onions and garlic in blender with chicken stock. Combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil then simmer until the liquid is absorbed. Add peas. Simmer 15 minutes.

title: Banana Cooler
