instructions: In electric blender combine half the ice the lime juice sugar pineapple juice and banana. Blend with cover on at high speed until smooth. Add remaining ice; blend more. Serve in stem glass. Yields 1 serving.

title: Fudge
instructions: Butter large heavy pan well. Mix chocolate butter sugar and milk. Stir over medium-low heat to soft boil. Cut heat off. Add marshmallow vanilla and nuts. Set in cold water. Beat until there is change in color. Pour into buttered Pyrex dish or jelly roll pan. Makes 5 pounds.

title: Turkeyburger Pizzarella
instructions: Combine ground turkey egg garlic salt onion flakes 2 tablespoons tomato sauce and Italian seasonings. In a 10-inch quiche pan sprayed with Pam spread turkey mixture to line the bottom and sides to form crust. Bake in a preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Remove from oven and drain surface grease and pour on remaining tomato sauce with added Italian seasonings (if desired). Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for 7 minutes. To serve cut into pizza shaped wedges.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until smooth. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after each. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add to creamed mixture. Place flour and coconut to cream mix. Makes a very stiff dough. Mix by hand. Put in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Chipped Beef Spread
instructions: Blend softened cream cheese and milk together. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread can be refrigerated at this point. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until it looks like it is going to brown. Serve with crackers as a spread or dip.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix like on package. When it comes out of oven poke holes all over. Pour Eagle Brand milk all over. Cool. Ice with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Honey Walnut Bread
instructions: Scald 1 cup milk. Add 1 cup honey and sugar. Stir over medium heat until the sugar is dissolved. Cool the mixture. Beat in the butter and eggs. Sift together the flour salt and baking soda and stir into the batter. Beat well. Add the walnuts and orange rind. Pour the batter into a floured and buttered loaf pan and bake the bread in a moderately slow oven at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Cool the bread for 15 minutes in the pan and then turn it out on a wire rack to cool. Serve thinly sliced with butter or cream cheese.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef crackers milk onions and salt. Make into small meatballs. Roll in flour. Brown in oil. Drain. Make sauce. Drain pineapple. Add enough water to pineapple juice to make 1 cup. Mix vinegar brown sugar soy sauce lemon juice and cornstarch. Cook until thick. Add bell pepper pineapple and pimento. Pour over meatballs. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Layer cheese chilies cheese and sausage in 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat eggs milk and flour; pour on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon-Sour Cream Tarts
instructions: Prepare pudding according to package directions. Cool and stir together with sour cream; chill. Drain raspberries reserving 2/3 cup syrup. Mix sugar and cornstarch in small saucepan; gradually stir in reserved syrup. Cook and stir until mixture thickens and boils. Remove from heat and chill.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Use food processor to mince meat. Cook all ingredients in crock-pot for 4 hours on high or 8 hours on low.

title: Sugar Cream Pie
instructions: Cook the sugar flour oleo and half and half and set aside. Bake the pie shell in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Place the cooked filling into the partially baked shell and bake for another 25 minutes. Sprinkle nutmeg or cinnamon on top. Cool and enjoy.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Use only spices you might like in sauce.

title: Date Carrot Cake
instructions: Drain pineapple well. Beat margarine and sugars until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. Beat in pineapple carrots dates and vanilla. Combine flour soda cinnamon ginger and salt. Gradually beat in flour mixture until well blended. Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 50 to 60 minutes until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Serves 20.

title: Marinated Cucumbers, Onions And Tomatoes
instructions: Alternate cucumbers onions and tomatoes in bowl with lid. Mix equal parts vinegar (white or wine I use red wine) and water. Mix vinegar water sugar salt and pepper all together; pour over cucumbers onions and tomatoes. Stir a few times while marinating 2 to 3 hours at least before using. Vinegar mixture should cover the vegetables.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken soup sour cream carrot and onion. Melt margarine and stir in stuffing mix. In 9 x 13-inch greased pan layer chicken mixture then stuffing mix and remaining chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0) until firm. Tasty with buttered cracker crumbs on top of dishes.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar; beat well.\tAdd vanilla and lemon juice. Add egg and beat until light. Add flour soda and salt; alternate\twith buttermilk. Drop by tablespoonful and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Top with raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Broccoli-Red Pepper Salad(Christmas)
instructions: Peel broccoli stalks cut into 1/4-inch size pieces. Cook stalks in boiling water 1 minute. Add flowerets cook 1 to 3 minutes until crisp-tender. Rinse in ice cold water and drain. Mix last 5 ingredients. Toss with peppers. Serve cold. Serves 12.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix well. Form into small balls. Heat in heavy skillet 2 tablespoons oil. Add meatballs a few at a time. Brown slowly turning gently to brown evenly. Remove meatballs when brown. To drippings add 1 cup water stock or consomme. Bring to a boil stirring to loosen browned particles. Combine 1 tablespoon flour and 2 tablespoons cold water. Blend until smooth. Slowly add to skillet stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Add meatballs. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Place cleaned fryer hen in Dutch oven with water and poultry seasoning (generous amount); salt and pepper if your diet allows. Cook until meat falls away from bone. Let cool and then remove meat from bone. Add remaining ingredients to chicken sprinkling slivered almonds on top of salad.

title: Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef. Partially cook macaroni. Drain broth. Add chopped onion to meat and cook 3 or 4 minutes. Add tomatoes tomato sauce and 1 cup water. Cook for about 5 minutes. Add macaroni catsup and 1/2 cup water. Simmer until macaroni is done.

title: Weiner-Cheese & Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake for one hour at 350\u00b0. Do not add salt.

title: Chicken And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Place rinsed chicken into skillet with tight fitting lid. Add onion and 1/2 cup of water. Simmer until tender about 1 hour. Cool and dice.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Cook jello sugar cornstarch and water until thick. Cool. Place peaches in pie shell. Pour mixture over fruit. Cool and enjoy.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of pan. Mix sugar and butter in bowl. Stir eggs until blended. Add bananas buttermilk and vanilla. Stir in flour baking soda and salt until moistened. Stir in nuts. Pour into pan. Bake 8-inch loaf for about 1 hour; bake 9-inch loaf for about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Loosen sides. Remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing. Wrap tightly; store at room temperature up to 4 days or refrigerate up to 10 days.

title: Fruit Cake Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into 3 or 4 logs. Coat with confectioners sugar. Refrigerate until firm enough to slice. Store in refrigerator.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger with onions. Drain. Add to cooked and drained macaroni in large casserole dish. Mix tomato soup and onion soup mix. Add enough water to make mixture soupy. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Running Board Zucchini Chicken
instructions: Brown the chicken pieces in the 3 tablespoons of olive oil. Remove pieces from pan and add all other ingredients except bouquet garni salt and flour. Fry briefly stirring constantly. Add chicken and bouquet garni and simmer covered until chicken is done about 30 minutes. Remove bouquet garni. Season to taste with salt. Thicken with a flour and water paste if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. Best if allowed to remain in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Sprinkle pie crusts evenly with 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg. Bake in a preheated 475\u00b0 oven for 2 minutes. Remove from oven and gently press crusts down while warm; set aside. Heat milk and evaporated milk in a large saucepan over medium heat. (Do not boil.) Process eggs sugar vanilla and salt with remaining 1 teaspoon nutmeg in a blender until smooth. Turn blender on high; add half of hot mixture in a slow steady stream. Stir egg mixture into remaining hot milk mixture. Pour evenly into pie crusts. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 425\u00b0 and bake 15 minutes. (Pie will not be set.) Cool on a wire rack 45 minutes. Chill. Yield 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Hello Dollies
instructions: Melt 1 stick of margarine in a square Pyrex dish. Add 1 heaping cup graham cracker crumbs. Next add chocolate chips pecans and coconut. Pour in 1 can Eagle Brand milk and stir. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool then cut into squares.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cookies
instructions: Mix together shortening brown sugar sugar and eggs. Mix well. Add raisins drained fruit cocktail nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Sift together flour soda baking powder cinnamon cloves and salt. Mix all the ingredients and drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Sandwich
instructions: Chop separately in food processor the first 5 ingredients then drain. Melt gelatin in 2 tablespoons vegetable juice; heat to melt. Add to vegetables. Stir in mayonnaise. Allow to stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Bake shell according to instructions provided. Mix all dry ingredients together in saucepan. Add rest of ingredients and cook over low heat until thick. Pour in baked pie shell.

title: Hot Crabmeat Appetizer
instructions: Combine all ingredients except almonds mixing until well blended. Spoon mixture into 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Company Brussels Sprouts
instructions: In a skillet fry bacon just until cooked. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Add remaining ingredients; cook and stir over medium-high heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until Brussels sprouts are crisp-tender. Yields 4 servings.

title: Bill'S Beef Dip
instructions: Mix all the ingredients with the cream cheese. If desired sprinkle nuts on top. Serve with wheat crackers.

title: Sweet Muffins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a muffin tin. Beat egg. Stir in milk and oil. Add the remaining ingredients. Beat for 20 to 25 minutes. You can mix these the night before. Kids love them.

title: Pacific Coast Bake
instructions: Saute onions in margarine. Stir in rice and salmon. Add combined mayonnaise and egg; mix lightly. Layer half the salmon mixture Parmesan cheese and broccoli in 1-quart casserole. Cover with 1 cup Cheddar cheese. Repeat layers ending with broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar cheese; continue baking until cheese is melted. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Choose-A-Fruit Twist
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls and seal perforations to form 2 rectangles. Pat each into an 8 x 4-inch rectangle. Spread cream cheese on each and top with preserves and nuts. Cut each rectangle into four 8 x 1-inch strips. (You will have a total of 24 strips.) Fold each strip in half and twist; they will be 1 x 4-inches. Place on a lightly greased foil-lined baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Combine warm sweet potatoes with 1/4 cup margarine milk 2 eggs 1 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl. Beat until smooth. Spoon into shallow baking dish.

title: Soft Caraway Rye Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar and salt. Mix the two types of flour and the caraway seed together and add to the warm yeast liquid. The dough will be stiff; knead about 5 minutes then divide it into 12 pieces. Roll each piece into a long rope and form into a pretzel. Place on greased cookie sheet. Brush with water and sprinkle with salt. Do not let dough rise. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325\u00b0. Remove the wing tips and break each wing into two pieces. Place in a shallow baking dish. Mix the remaining ingredients and pour over the wings. Bake for 1 hour and serve in the baking dish.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. Put frozen vegetables in strainer. Drain pasta over frozen vegetables. After all water has been drained from pasta and vegetables pour into desired bowl. Pour salad dressing over pasta and vegetables; mix together. The flavor comes out better when prepared overnight.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Note If strawberries are in season you may substitute them for one or all of the fruit.

title: Kiss My Grits
instructions: Brown crumble and drain sausage. Mix all together in a 2 qt. baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until browned.

title: Italian Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Combine beef roast water salt and onions in a large roasting pan. Cover and cook at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours until done. Remove roast and cool (save the juice). Slice then layer in a covered dish. Add all spices to the juice you saved from the roast. Bring to a boil and pour over meat. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Serve on French bread.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: To make meatballs combine all ingredients (mixture will be soft) and shape into walnut size balls. Place meatballs in a single layer on wax paper-lined cookie sheets; freeze until solid (overnight). Store frozen meatballs in freezer bags until ready to cook.

title: Eggnog Quick Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Grease bottom only of a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or three 5 3/4 x 3 1/4-inch loaf pans. Beat eggs in large bowl. Blend in sugar eggnog butter rum extract and vanilla. Stir together flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Mix into eggnog mixture; stir to just moisten dry ingredients. Pour batter into prepared pan or pans. Bake bread in large pan for 40 to 60 minutes or until a tester inserted in the center comes out clean. Breads baked in the smaller pans require 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and then remove bread from pan. Cool completely. Wrap tightly and store in the refrigerator.

title: Corned Beef Cracker Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together excluding 1/2 the chopped pecans. Put the mixture into a pie plate and sprinkle remaining pecans on top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm on crackers.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Unroll crescent rolls and separate dough into 16 triangles. Cut each apple into eight wedges.\tWrap a crescent roll triangle around each apple wedge and place in a greased 13 x 9 baking dish.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Brown crust according to package directions. Peel and dice tomatoes. Put into pie crust. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Crumble bacon on top. Mix together cheese and mayonnaise. Put on top of mixture.

title: Recipe For Happiness
instructions: Mix all of these together and bake in oven of Forgiveness for two Prayer hours. Then cool on table of Understanding.

title: Chicken 'N Hash Brown Bake
instructions: Thaw hash browns overnight in refrigerator. Layer in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place chicken and mushrooms over the hash browns. Stir together the sour cream broth soup bouillon onions red pepper and garlic. Pour over all. Sprinkle with paprika and almonds. Bake uncovered for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Cut up fryer and brown in butter. Combine remaining ingredients and boil 4 minutes. Place chicken in roaster and pour sauce over. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hour or until chicken is tender. Baste often.

title: Woodchucks
instructions: Make a white sauce with the first 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Serve on toast.

title: Frosting
instructions: Bring milk brown sugar and butter to boil. Let cool. Add vanilla. Spread on any kind of cake.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Hollow out bread (round loaf). Tear bread in bite size pieces.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Cook over medium heat. Bring to boil. Cook 5 minutes. Stir until chocolate melts. Remove from heat. Add 1 tsp. vanilla. Beat with beater until thick. Use sauce hot or cold.

title: Two Handed Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: This makes a large batch. Beat eggs. Mix with sugars peanut butter margarine soda and vanilla. At this point youll probably have to use hands. Add oats M&Ms and chocolate chips. Mix. Roll in balls and press down on cookie sheet with palm of hand. Glass will smash the M&Ms. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Pour some bacon grease in and mix.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix according to box. Add cream and margarine. Pour half of batter in greased and floured pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Almond Bread Pudding
instructions: Break up bread into pieces. Cover with half and half. Let stand 1 hour.

title: Pistachio-Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix together crushed pineapple and pistachio pudding mix. Add miniature marshmallows nuts and cherries. Fold in Cool Whip. Let set chilled for several hours.

title: June'S Date Tea Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour boiling water over dates and let cool. Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg. Add soda to the date mixture after it has cooled. Add flour salt and the cool water to the creamed mixture and beat. Stir in date mixture and continue to beat until smooth. Fold in nuts. Put in greased loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done in center. Loosen sides and cool slightly on wire rack. Wrap securely in foil. Serve with cream cheese whipped with a small amount of orange juice and a dash of orange flavoring.

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: You will need baking cups.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill then make into balls.

title: Crock-Pot Pizza
instructions: Brown hamburger chopped onion and green pepper. In bowl mix hamburger mixture mushrooms spaghetti sauce and pizza sauce. Shred Cheddar and Mozzarella cheeses. Layer twice in crock-pot noodles meat/sauce and cheese. Cook on low approximately 1 1/2 hours until cheese is melted and mixture is heated through. May also be baked in oven at 350\u00b0 until mixture is heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Seven-Layer Dip
instructions: In a large skillet brown ground beef. Set aside to drain and cool to room temperature.

title: French Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In casserole dish place first 3 ingredients. Pour mushroom soup over this. Place in oven until bubbly hot.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs butter and sugar. Press firmly into 9 x 13-inch baking dish; reserve some crumbs for garnish. Blend thawed orange juice with milk; fold in Cool Whip and oranges. Do not beat. Pour mixture over crust; top with reserved crumbs. Refrigerate or freeze until serving.

title: Shrimp Spaghetti
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp or you may use thawed frozen shrimp. Have ready cooked spaghetti; set aside. In heavy 3 quart saucepan melt butter over medium heat (5 to 7 minutes). Add remaining ingredients except spaghetti tomatoes and cheese. Stir to blend. Cook over medium heat until shrimp turn pink (5 to 7 minutes). Add cooked spaghetti. Continue cooking until spaghetti is heated through. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat and add tomatoes. Cover and let stand until tomatoes are heated through. To serve Sprinkle with cheese. Serve with salad and garlic bread. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Hot Surprises
instructions: Divide sausage into 8 pieces and flatten out. Rinse peppers and cut stem from top. Split pepper on one side; open up and remove seeds. Cut a strip of cheese to fit inside each pepper and stuff peppers. Lay one pepper on each sausage patty and enclose completely with sausage. Cook in a large skillet until done turning several times. Drain on paper towels. Be careful when you first bite; the cheese inside will be hot.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning. Spread mixture on a round serving platter. Top with lettuce tomatoes cheeses and black olives. Place some tortilla chips around dip near edge of platter. Pour the rest of the chips in a bowl and dig in. Enjoy!

title: Mother'S Nut And Jam Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Mix remaining ingredients as listed. Place in cake pans. Yields approximately 4 layers. Bake at 300 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Sausage Cake
instructions: Cream sausage and sugar. Sift dry ingredients and add in order. Batter will be stiff. Pour into 9 x 13 baking dish and bake for approximately 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Watch closely the last 10 minutes of baking time as it may easily burn. Cool and refrigerate until used. This cake freezes very well.

title: Cherry Crumb Pie
instructions: Mix cherries juice from can plus enough water to make 1 cup and rest of filling ingredients. In saucepan cook until mixture boils becomes thick and is clear-looking. Pour into unbaked pie shell.

title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Note Amount of ingredients may be adjusted according to the size of the roast.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in order. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Press flat with bottom of glass dipped in sugar; be sure to dip glass in sugar between each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies.

title: Microwave Fast Chocolate-Pecan Fudge
instructions: Line square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch with foil; set aside. In medium micro-proof bowl microwave butter on High power 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until melted; add cocoa and stir until smooth. Stir in confectioners sugar and vanilla; blend well (mixture will be dry and crumbly.) Stir in evaporated milk. Micro on High 1 minute; stir. Micro an additional 1 minute or until mixture is hot. Beat with wooden spoon until smooth; add pecan pieces. Pour into prepared pan. Cover; chill until firm. Cut into squares. Store covered in refrigerator. Makes 4 dozen squares.

title: Carolina Meat Pie
instructions: Cut ham finely; cut veal into 1-inch cubes and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Put in pot with butter or lard and when hot add meat. Brown well; add onions and cook few minutes. Add carrots. Sprinkle with flour and when brown add boiling water. Combine with ketchup and simmer for 1/2 hour or until meat is tender. Add potatoes and cook until they are tender and stew is rich and thick.

title: Olive-Pecan Chicken Slaw
instructions: Melt butter in a wide frying pan over medium heat. Add pecans and cook stirring often until nuts turn a darker brown. Drain on paper towels. Combine Mustard Cream Dressing cabbage chicken apple pimentos olives and celery. Season to taste with salt. Sprinkle pecans over top of slaw.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice; cook broccoli just until tender. Saute onion in margarine until tender. Add Cheez Whiz and soup and stir until blended. Add broccoli and rice; pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cathedral Window Candy
instructions: You will need waxed paper.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: First wash berries. Next grind them. Spread sugar over berries. Let stand while mixing other ingredients but do not stir. Peel apples and grind. Mix with pineapple. Make jello with hot water. Mix all the ingredients together and refrigerate for at least 24 hours.

title: Chip Bars
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle in graham cracker crumbs. Place coconut and chips on top of crumbs. Drizzle milk over top. Sprinkle on nuts. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mandarin Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients well. Serve on lettuce leaf. Yields 6 servings.

title: Grandma Austin'S Custard Pie
instructions: Pour into unbaked crust and bake until firm at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Place the beans in a large bowl or pot and cover with water by 2 inches. Let soak for 8 hours or overnight. Drain and set aside.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix the banana cream pudding mix as directed on box. Add the condensed milk and mix well. Stir in the Cool Whip. Put a layer of the pudding mix in a large size dish followed by a layer of rolled wafers and then a layer of bananas. Continue until mixture is gone ending with pudding. Refrigerate. This will keep a week or more.

title: Orange Roughy Italiano
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Add onion zucchini and oregano. Saute over medium-high heat stirring often for about 4 minutes. Place tomato and fish over vegetables in skillet. Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper. Cover skillet reduce heat and simmer until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork about 1 1/2 minutes. Serve immediately. Top with grated cheese just before serving. Serves 4.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan in a 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top evenly with remaining ingredients. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until lightly browned. Cool before cutting. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Preheat wok. Heat oil. Cook meat; add onion and eggs. Stir-fry. Immediately add rice and mix. Add other vegetables and sprouts. Mix. Add soy sauce salt and m.s.g. Stir quickly and serve.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Melt shortening. Add brown sugar and mix well. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add dry ingredients chocolate bits and nut meats. Pour into greased pan and bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Seafood Enchiladas
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat and maintain at a boil. Put the olive oil and garlic in a saute pan and cook over medium heat just until the garlic begins to brown. Remove the saute pan from the heat and pour in the wine. Return it to the heat. Cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until the wine has been reduced by half. Stir in the lemon juice and tomato. Remove the pan from the heat.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar nuts baking powder and salt. Beat eggs slightly. Stir in oil zucchini and lemon peel. Add to dry ingredients. Stir until moistened. Spread into 2 greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Turtle Cake(Keena'S Turtle Cake)
instructions: Grease and flour (use cocoa instead of flour) a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour half of batter into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Meanwhile melt caramels milk and magarine together and stir into a caramel sauce. When cake is finished pour caramel mixture over cake (reserve 1/2 cup for top if desired). Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips. Pour remaining cake mix over top. Bake 20 more minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with remaining caramel sauce and nuts if desired.

title: Four Layer Sabbath Delight
instructions: Blend together peanuts flour and butter. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Imambayildi(The Priest Fainted)
instructions: Remove the stems of the eggplants leaving 2 cm. Peel the eggplants leaving lengthwise bands 2 cm. wide (to prevent the eggplant crumbling while cooking). Fry in olive oil turning them on all sides (they may be previously treated with salt to prevent them absorbing too much oil while cooking). In a frying pan brown the onion which has been cut into small pieces. When the onion and garlic begin to turn brown add the chopped parsley. Split the eggplants lengthwise removing some of the seeds if necessary spreading the two halves apart. In the cavity put the mixture of garlic onion and cooked parsley. Garnish each eggplant with a tomato ring then place in a baking dish. Place the water and remaining oil in the bottom of the dish if none remains make a sauce with 2 or 3 tomatoes. Place in a warm oven for 30 minutes. Serve cool.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and sugar together. Flatten out in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potato and onion. Melt butter. Add flour salt and pepper. Gradually add milk; cook until thick. Drain potatoes. Save water and mix with milk mixture. Cook for 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Rockefeller
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Combine spinach with other ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Saute the onion in a little margarine until tender. Mash up the Swiss steaks and add them and their juice to the pan with the onion. Add the seasonings the cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese and spaghetti sauce. Heat until cheeses melt. Let cool long enough so that the ingredients do not run out of the shells they theyre stuffed. Stuff the cooked shells. Put a layer of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a large 11 x 13-inch casserole dish. Put a single layer of stuffed shells in. Top the shells with more spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Pinwheels
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Separate dough into 4 rectangles. Firmly press perforation to seal. Place 8 pepperoni slices on each rectangle. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese. Starting at shortest side tightly roll up each rectangle. Pinch to seal. Slice each roll into 4 equal slices. Pinch dough together on one side to seal. Place sealed side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with warmed pizza sauce if desired.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Bring to boil white vinegar and sugar. Cool. Rinse and squeeze sauerkraut. Add pimentos water chestnuts onion and celery to sauerkraut. Pour cooled vinegar and sugar liquid marinade over sauerkraut ingredients. Refrigerate. Put in jars or etc. Marinate 24 hours before serving. Will keep long time refrigerated.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: In food processor chop up all ingredients. Put in large pot. Boil 5 minutes. Turn heat down and simmer 30 to 45 minutes. Put in clean warm jars and seal with lids.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Sift together flour soda cloves and nutmeg. Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Add tomato soup plus enough water to equal 2 cups. Add nuts and dates. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Beat slowly all but vinegar and oil. Pour oil and vinegar very slowly. Stir or shake. Can be stored in refrigerator or not.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Prepare macaroni dinner as usual. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl; mix well. Stir in macaroni and cheese. Spoon tuna mixture into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion until tender. Drain and mash. Add crackers cheese milk eggs sugar salt and pepper. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with crushed cracker crumbs for garnish before baking.

title: Low-Fat Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix whipped topping according to directions. Mix vanilla pudding with low-fat milk according to directions. Mix together 1/2 of the whipped topping and the sour cream then add this to the vanilla pudding. Layer dish with vanilla wafers and bananas. Place a layer of wafers on top of pudding mixture then spread the rest of the whipped topping over the wafers. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Texas Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute onion rings in saucepan in a little butter until almost transparent then place in 2-quart casserole. Put other ingredients into the same saucepan and heat stirring until cheese melts. Pour this mixture over the onions. Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs or Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Very good with ham and pork dishes.

title: Pork Cutlets
instructions: Dip pork cutlets in beaten egg and roll in cracker crumbs. Brown the cutlets in shortening in skillet. Put into baking dish adding a bit of the shortening and bake covered for 1 hour at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0.

title: Scotcharoos
instructions: Bring Karo and sugar to a boil. Take off burner. Add peanut butter. Mix with Rice Krispies. Pour in 13 x 9-inch cake pan.

title: Sicilian Pizza
instructions: Dissolve yeast packet from hot roll mix with 1 cup water. Add flour hot roll mix and eggs. Let rise a minimum of 2 hours. Must be covered with Saran Wrap. Spread dough into large (17 x 11 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) greased pan. Top with sauce cheese and topping(s) of your choice. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Squash Oregano
instructions: Slice small squash halfwise (long). Pour melted butter over each half. Sprinkle with salt pepper and oregano. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tender-crisp.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Texas Trash
instructions: Over low heat melt butter in skillet. Add Worcestershire sauce and salt. After mixed add other ingredients. Stir until evenly coated. Place in covered container and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 stir occasionally while baking.

title: President Truman'S Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar one half cup at a time. Add eggs one at a time. Combine flour and salt. Add small amount at a time. Add buttermilk. Batter should look like a cake mix that needs more flour.

title: Down Home Pancakes
instructions: Blend all dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Drop onto hot griddle. Serve with syrup or jelly and hot coffee on Sunday morning.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Place first 5 ingredients into a bag and mix. Place chops in and shake. Brown chops in oil. Add juice from pineapple chunks and add vinegar. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Cook at low heat at least 40 minutes. Add pineapple and warm.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Brown sausage in a large skillet. Do not drain. Sprinkle in flour and stir over medium heat until all the whiteness is gone. Add the milk and stir constantly until thick adding the salt and pepper as you stir. Add more milk if it gets too thick. Serve over hot biscuits. Makes 2 to 4 servings.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in large pot of boiling water until tender but firm. Drain in colander. Rinse with cold water. In large bowl combine macaroni onions tomato green pepper and sliced olives. Toss lightly. Add enough fat-free salad dressing. Toss lightly; salt and pepper to taste! Place in refrigerator. Chill for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon reserving 3 tablespoons grease. Crumble bacon; set aside. Add flour to grease in skillet; stir until smooth. Cook for 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Gradually add milk mixture and bacon to potato mixture. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: In largest bowl of electric mixer cream one cup of the butter with shortening and sugar until mixture is fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla and stir in pineapple and juice. Blend well.

title: War Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour an 8 x 4-inch baking pan. Place brown sugar water raisins oleo cinnamon and cloves in a heavy-bottomed saucepan and bring to a boil. Cook gently for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let cool until mixture is warm to your finger. Sift together the flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Add them to the cooled sugar mixture beating until no drifts of flour are visible and batter is smooth. Stir in walnuts. Spread evenly in baking pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes. Turn onto rack to cool completely.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix lemon pie filling and Cool Whip. Then add to the rest of the ingredients. Add 1 c. of mini-marshmallows. Mix well and chill.

title: Chewy Brownie Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream shortening sugar water and vanilla. Beat in the eggs. Combine flour cocoa salt and baking soda. Gradually add to creamed mixture and beat just until blended. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes. Do not overbake. Yield 3 dozen.

title: New Orleans Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring rice milk and cream to a boil; cover and cook until most of milk is absorbed and rice is tender. Add all other ingredients except egg yolks and whole eggs. Stir some of the rice mixture into eggs and pour egg mixture into rice mixture and stir. Pour into 2-quart buttered casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Yukova
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain grease. Put cabbage on top and pour 1/2 c. of water over and sprinkle with soy sauce. Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes. Add crumbed noodles and flavoring and 1/2 c. water. Sprinkle with soy sauce. Stir. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until noodles are cooked. Stir often. I use more hamburger if I want leftovers. Adjust cabbage quantity for your taste. Quick and easy recipe.

title: Homemade Play Dough
instructions: Mix flour salt and cream of tartar in heavy pan. Add water oil and food coloring subject to color. Heat for 3 minutes then knead. Store in airtight containers.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef celery onion and pepper. In large boiler combine remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Drain beef mixture and add to boiler. Cook until potatoes are soft on low heat approximately 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook cabbage leaves in boiling water for 5 minutes and then drain. Combine ground beef bread crumbs onion eggs and seasonings. Shape into rolls and wrap with cabbage leaves. Pour soup into skillet and add cabbage rolls. Cover and bring to a boil. Simmer 35 minutes spooning sauce over rolls occasionally.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Grease 8 x 8 baking dish. Put rice in bottom of dish. Sprinkle seasoning on top. Pour chicken broth over rice. Put chicken breasts on top of rice. Cover with can of soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Indian Stew
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add all other ingredients; cook slowly stirring to prevent burning about an hour or cook in crock-pot. Serve over rice.

title: Seasoned Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Clean potatoes and quarter; cut into 1/4-inch thick. Place potatoes in mixing bowl. Add 3 tablespoons oil 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Toss potatoes and lay flat on jelly roll pan; sprinkle with cheese mixture. Place in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Flip occasionally with pancake turner to prevent sticking. Serves 4.

title: Spreciones(Or Egg Cookies)
instructions: Beat sugar eggs salt and lemon peel until mixture thickens. Add flour gradually until mixture is thick but not dry. Roll into small balls making a peak at the top of each cookie. Brush with beaten egg and top with an almond sliver. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Rice-A-Roni Salad
instructions: Cook and cool Rice-A-Roni according to package. Add remaining ingredients; mix and enjoy.

title: Cheese Surprises
instructions: Mix cheese butter and flour with a fork. Form into a ball. Flatten the ball and place an olive in the center and wrap the dough around it sealing the olive inside. Freeze these cheese balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Watercress Salad With Ginger-Lime Dressing
instructions: Add all ingredients and toss lightly.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of loaf pan 9 x 5 x 3-inches. Beat all ingredients in large bowl on low speed scraping bowl constantly 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally 4 minutes. Spread in pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean about 55 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Grease casserole dish. Drain peaches and put in casserole. Combine sugar flour butter and salt. Mix until flaky. Put mixture over peaches. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 and bake for 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Drain kidney and butter beans slightly. Saute bacon; add beef and onion. Fry until brown. Drain off fat. Mix with other ingredients. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 or cook in crock-pot early in the morning.

title: Rhubarb Cobbler
instructions: Mix together in saucepan the sugar and tapioca. Stir in water and rhubarb. Bring to a boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Place in baking dish. Dot with butter and cinnamon. Drop spoonfuls of biscuit dough onto hot fruit. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm with cream.

title: Cheddar Cheese Cornbread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add onion and mix together. Add buttermilk and shortening. Mix together. But do not beat. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in an iron skillet.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce(For Cake Or Ice Cream)
instructions: Melt the chocolate with oleo. Add sugar milk and salt. Cook until slightly thickened then cool.

title: Chicken Bundles
instructions: Mix all the above. Separate crescent rolls. Put some of chicken mixture in center of triangle of crescent roll and place another crescent roll on top and pinch together. Place bundles on cookie sheet. Melt 5 to 6 tablespoons of butter and spread over crescent rolls. Crush 1/2 cup of corn flakes and spread over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown. Heat the other 1/2 can of chicken soup with 1/4 cup water and serve over bundles.

title: Open-Faced Hamburgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Using a fork spread meat mixture on slices of bread or Subway buns or hamburger buns out to all edges. Place on baking sheet. Bake in oven at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until meat is done through. (Bottom of bread will be toasted.) Remove from oven and cover with slices of cheese. Return to oven for a minute or two until cheese melts. Serve immediately.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Clean and wash all fruit. Cut fruit into bite size pieces. Add orange juice and toss. In another bowl mix raisins nuts and cinnamon. Spoon fruit salad into 10 small bowls. Sprinkle one teaspoon of raisin nut mixture over each fruit salad. Makes 10 servings.

title: Homemade Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Add all ingredients except peaches in a saucepan. Mix together with mixer. Heat just until sugar dissolves over low-medium heat. Let cool down to room temperature. Add peaches; stir and freeze in 4-quart electric churn for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in 2 cups water. Drain and reserve liquid. Blend next 5 ingredients. Stir into raisins. Add remaining ingredients including raisin liquid. Mix well and pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean when inserted in top. Makes 18 servings. Each 1 bread 1 fruit plus 2 fat exchanges.

title: Cheese Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Mix together for the sauce the skim milk cream soups enchilada sauce and green chilies.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and cook over medium heat until thick. Remove from stove and add oleo or butter coconut and vanilla flavoring. Stir well then pour into 8 or 9-inch baked pie shell (crust). Top with beaten egg whites saved from egg yolks. Sprinkle coconut on top. Brown in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar syrup water salt and butter. Cover and bring to a boil. Remove cover. When mixture reaches soft ball stage add peanuts. Stir frequently to prevent scorching. Cook to hard crack stage.

title: Short And Simple Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice cream cheese condensed milk and vanilla at medium speed until well blended. Pour into pie crust. Chill for 3 to 6 hours. Top with cherries. Slice and serve.

title: Swedish Meatballs In Micro
instructions: Mix together the beef crumbs milk egg soup mix salt and nutmeg. Shape meat mixture into 40 balls. Place 20 at a time in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High (10) for 7 to 9 minutes rotating dish half turn after 4 minutes. Remove meatballs from dish; keep warm reserving meat drippings. Repeat for other 20 meatballs. To 1/4 cup drippings in dish add flour stirring until smooth. Gradually stir in milk and brown Bouquet sauce. Microwave at High (10) for 4 to 5 minutes stirring every minute until thickened. Add sour cream; stir well. Return meatballs to dish mixing to coat evenly. Microwave at High (10) for 1 to 2 minutes until hot. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: No Cook Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Sift cocoa and sugar together. Set aside. Melt butter and cheese together (microwave is great). Pour melted butter and cheese over sifted cocoa and sugar. Mix well. Add nuts and mix. Spray jellyroll pan with Pam. Pat mixture in pan. Place in refrigerator to set. Cut into squares.

title: Beat-N-Eat Frosting
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and add it to all of the other ingredients. Beat until it is very fluffy.

title: Pineapple Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender. Serve as dip for shrimp crab or lobster.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Layer the asparagus 1/2 chips and 1/2 cheese; repeat. Put soup on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cover raisins with boiling water; let stand 5 minutes; drain. In mixing bowl combine sugar cinnamon salt and cloves. Stir in sour cream eggs and lemon juice. Stir in raisins last.

title: Pumpkin Gingersnap Pie
instructions: Pour milk and pie filling into large bowl; beat with wire whisk until well blended about 1 minute. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Crunchy Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Break cauliflower into small pieces. Dice heart of cauliflower. Cut broccoli bite size including heart. Dice onion; chop pepper.

title: Microwave Potatoes
instructions: Wash and scrub potatoes (amount is up to you; leave skins on). Prepare baking dish with Pam spray. Put first layer of potatoes in dish. Sprinkle with salts and pepper (amount depends on you). Layer more potatoes and sprinkle with salts and pepper. Place patties of margarine over top of potatoes. Lightly cover with plastic wrap being sure to leave 1 end open for steam to escape. Microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes; stir. Microwave for 8 to 10 minutes more until tender. Serve hot.

title: French Toast
instructions: Mix nutmeg cinnamon vanilla eggs milk and brown sugar together. Dredge the bread through mixture. Place on hot griddle. Cook until brown. Turn bread over and cook until brown.

title: No Bake Fruit And Cereal Bars
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In a large saucepan stir together the brown sugar and honey. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Set aside 1/3 cup dried fruit bits. Stir in cereal and remaining mixed fruit bits until well coated. Spread into prepared baking pan. Press reserved 1/3 cup dried fruit bits onto surface. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and heat on top of stove until hot. Pour in casserole dish.

title: Texas Lime Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine cracker crumbs brown sugar and butter. Press onto the bottom and up the sides of 2 greased 9-inch pie plates.

title: Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: Combine all but nuts in saucepan. Bring to a full boil on high heat stirring constantly. Reduce heat and boil 3 minutes stirring constantly. Add peanuts; beat until thickened. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Makes 15 to 20 pieces.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix as a pastry crust. Mixture will be loose. Put in bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Dip
instructions: In medium bowl combine soup broccoli tomato sour cream and mustard. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving. Serve with crackers and vegetables.

title: Four-Decker Mocha Dessert
instructions: In mixing bowl cut butter into flour until crumbly; stir in 3/4 cup of the peanuts. Press mixture evenly over bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes; cool. In a small mixer bowl beat cream cheese on low speed of electric mixer until fluffy; beat in powdered sugar and half of the thawed whipped topping. Spread over crust; chill. In large mixer bowl combine both pudding mixes and milk beat with rotary beater 2 minutes. Spoon a top of cream cheese layer in dish. Chill or freeze until firm several hours or overnight. Top with remaining thawed whipped topping. Sprinkle with grated chocolate and remaining chopped peanuts. (If frozen let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.)

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Bake in sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Baked Apples
instructions: Core apples. Do not peel. Make cuts down the sides of the apples to allow them to breathe. Place in shallow baking dish. Place red candies into each apple. Microwave on High until tender (4 to 6 minutes). Serve in decorative dessert dish topped with ice cream.

title: Orange Liqueur
instructions: With no white on the rind blot dry with paper towels. Put rind into a quart jar. Add 2 cups of vodka screw on top and store for 2 days in a cool dark place. Remove peel add sugar and shake until sugar dissolves. Add 1 cup vodka and stir. Close jar and store again for 1 week at least.

title: Apple-Cranberry Relish
instructions: Put all fruit and peel through a grinder or food processor. Add sugar to taste. Refrigerate several hours. Serve as a sauce with ham turkey or as a salad.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes and onions until tender; add salt and oleo. Cook 2 minutes. Add milk. Do not cook.

title: Snicker Cake
instructions: Make cake according to directions. Put 1/2 the batter in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 25 minutes or until \just\ done. Meanwhile melt milk caramels and oleo. Remove cake from oven and cool a little. Pour melted caramel mixture over cake. Top with chips and nuts. Dot remaining 1/2 of batter on top. Return to oven for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chili Enchiladas
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain off fat. Mix chili into meat mixture. Line bottom of baking dish with flour tortillas. Pour meat and chili mixture on top of tortillas; repeat layers until all gone. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tumbleweeds
instructions: Combine white chocolate and peanut butter chips in a 2-quart glass bowl. Microwave on 50% power for 4 minutes or until melted; mix well. Stir in peanuts and potato sticks.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: In large heavy pot saute garlic and onion in oil. Add all other ingredients except peas macaroni and cheese. Bring slowly to a boil lower heat and simmer 1 hour stirring often. When vegetables are tender add peas macaroni and cheese. Remove from heat and let stand 20 minutes. Serves 8 to 10. Freezes well.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Soften cheese; grate the Cheddars or buy it already grated. Add ingredients to all cheese. Mix with hands. Roll into 2 large or 4 small rolls. Refrigerate before cutting.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix together the condensed milk and undiluted lemonade. Slowly stir in Cool Whip then the juice from 1 lemon. Blend well. Spoon into pie shells. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Blender Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender; mix well. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Stay Up All Night Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease a Bundt pan; then sprinkle with the chopped nuts on bottom of pan. Arrange rolls evenly over the nuts. Sprinkle dry pudding over the rolls. In a small bowl combine sugar melted margarine and cinnamon. Cover rolls with the sugar mixture. Place in a cold oven to remain overnight. In the morning remove rolls from oven. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Return rolls to oven and bake for 25 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Fresh Salsa Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients in food processor. Process until chunky. Keeps for\tseveral weeks in refrigerator.\tServe with baked tortilla chips for great nonfat snack!

title: Holly Cookies
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows in a double boiler. Blend in food color and vanilla. Pour over cornflakes and mix very lightly with a fork (do not crush the corn flakes). Drop by teaspoon a small amount on a cookie sheet or plate. Decorate with 3 red hots on each \holly leaf\.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Drain broccoli combine ingredients mix well. Spoon into 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Libby'S Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour oats baking soda cinnamon and salt. Cream butter. Add sugars beating until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Alternate additions of dry ingredients and pumpkin; mix well. Stir in morsels. Drop by spoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Chess Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and flour in a large bowl. Add eggs and buttermilk; stir until blended. Stir in butter and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set. Cool on wire rack. Yield one 9-inch pie.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Measure and sift together flour soda and salt. Cream margarine; add sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; stir until thoroughly mixed. Stir in mashed bananas. Fold in dry ingredients and nuts. Place in a well-greased bread pan (2) or 4 small bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Skillet Corn And Tomatoes
instructions: In a skillet put tomatoes. Add corn. Stir. Add pepper and salt butter and oil. Stir well. If desired you can add leftover chopped chicken and then add 1 tablespoon basil and 1 teaspoon nutmeg. Stir well. Add 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese. Let cheese melt. Stir well.

title: Pecan Puffs
instructions: Grease cookie sheet. Beat egg white until stiff; fold in brown sugar and pecans. Mix then spoon out on cookie sheet. Put in oven at 450\u00b0 for 1 minute. Turn oven off. Let set 12 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown onion garlic and meat. Add to next 7 ingredients; simmer 1 hour. Cook lasagna noodles as package directs and drain. Put a little sauce in 9 x 13-inch pan and then layer noodles sauce sour cream cheese etc. End with sauce and top with Mozzarella and Parmesan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Scald milk with margarine in pot (do not boil) or double boiler. Beat eggs sugar and flavoring with electric mixer. Pour milk/margarine over this mixture and beat. Pour in pie shells. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0; turn down and bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken-Cheese Enchiladas
instructions: Combine soup chilies and onion. Cook on low 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Add sour cream. Fry tortillas. Fill with mixture and a sprinkle of cheese. Roll separately and put in oblong cake pan. Pour remaining sauce over rolls and sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Brunswick Soup
instructions: Flour chicken. Saut in oil until golden brown add onions tomatoes water seasoning and all other ingredients. Simmer until tender.

title: Cherry Cobbler Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 11 x 7-inch pan. Mix flour and baking powder. In a large bowl beat butter and confectioners sugar with electric beater. Beat in egg and lemon peel. Mix on low and gradually add flour. Remove 2/3 cup of dough.

title: Emergency Cake
instructions: Cream eggs and sugar. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture mixing well. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan spread onion soup mix. Spread 1 cup rice over top. Over that place chicken. Add mixed water and soups. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove foil and brown for about 20 minutes.

title: Millionaire Salad
instructions: Combine cream cheese and sugar in mixing bowl; mix well. Add pineapple rice pecans salad dressing and marshmallows; mix well. Fold in whipped cream gently. Yields 10 servings.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: After raisins are cooked down add cream then add sugar and flour mixed. Cook until partly thick and add vanilla and butter. Pour in baked shell and add meringue and bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cherry Scrap Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box. After it cools crumble up in large bowl. Pour over cake your prepared instant pudding then add pineapple sliced bananas nuts cherries and top with Cool Whip.

title: Southern Style Shredded Pork(Sauce)
instructions: In large saucepan combine all sauce ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Pour sauce over meat. Turn to coat. Cover; refrigerate 8 hours or overnight turning occasionally.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Cube chocolate cake. In a 3-quart size trifle bowl layer half the cake cubes 2 cups chocolate pudding 1 cup whipped cream and half Heath bar pieces; repeat layers.

title: Sour Cream Christmas Cookies
instructions: Bake at 355\u00b0. Dont let them get brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix stuffing butter and water lightly and put half in buttered 9 x 12-inch dish. Mix next 5 ingredients and put in casserole over stuffing mixture. Cover with remaining half of stuffing mix. Beat eggs and milk; spread over casserole. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Take out 1 hour before baking. Spread mushroom or mushroom-chicken soup over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes uncovered. Sprinkle with grated cheese and return to oven for 8 minutes.

title: Zucchini Saute
instructions: Use a food processor or hand grater to grate the zucchini. Saute in the margarine and Creole seasoning. Cover and let the zucchini set in its juices. Umm delicious!

title: Fudge Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine all except pecans and beat. Stir in nuts and pour into crust. Place nut halves on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in large casserole. Top with cheese and crushed potato chips. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Dip each piece in melted margarine and coat with finely crushed potato chips. Place in baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Meringue Jewels
instructions: Beat egg whites until foam is stiff. Gradually add sugar. Continue until egg whites form stiff peaks. Add vanilla then nuts. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until light or golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Yields 12 to 18 cookies.

title: Awesome Slow Cooker Pot Roast
instructions: In a slow cooker mix cream of mushroom soup dry onion soup mix brown gravy mix and water. Place pot roast in slow cooker and coat with soup mixture. Cook on high setting for 3 to 4 hours or on low setting for 8 to 9 hours.

title: Low Calorie Shake 'N Bake
instructions: Mix and use as substitute for original Shake n Bake.

title: Chicken Soup With Potatoes
instructions: In a large saucepan saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in broth and potatoes; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 15 minutes or so until potatoes are tender. Stir in chicken salt and pepper. Combine flour and milk until smooth. Stir into pan; add milk. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Sprinkle with parsley and chives.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix above ingredients well and pour in pie shell. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes.

title: Steak And Potato Supper
instructions: Dredge steak in flour. Brown well on both sides in hot fat. Place meat in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Pour off excess fat. Scrape up brown drippings left in pan and add to meat. Sprinkle onion parsley salt and pepper over all. Add tomato sauce. Cover and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 4 generous servings.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix together. Pour in graham cracker pie crust and freeze.

title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs to mixture. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to butter mixture alternately with milk. Add flavoring and mix well. Place dough on floured board and knead to cutting consistency. (Add up to 1/4 cup flour if needed.) Roll dough to 1/2-inch thick and cut as biscuits. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Mix all together except the eggs. Let stand in fridge until chilled or overnight. Before serving add chopped tomatoes head of lettuce and eggs.

title: Ribbon Salad
instructions: Prepare lemon Jell-O according to package directions. Pour into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Chill until set. Drain fruit cocktail reserving syrup. Place syrup in a saucepan. Bring to a boil; remove from heat. Combine cold water and unflavored gelatin. When gelatin is softened add to hot syrup. Stir until gelatin is completely dissolved. Add cottage cheese. Add drained fruit cocktail. Mix well. Spoon over chilled lemon gelatin. Chill until set. Prepare strawberry gelatin according to directions. Pour over cottage cheese mixture. Chill until set. Unmold onto lettuce-lined serving platter. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crab Seviche
instructions: Mix all ingredients cover with lemon juice and stir. Heat until hot. Serve with saltines or tortilla chips hot or cold.

title: Black Forest Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Prepare prune puree. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat a 3 to 4-quart Bundt or other tube pan with a vegetable cooking spray. Set aside. Into a large bowl sift together flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Set aside. In another bowl whisk eggs with the prune puree milk and vanilla. Set aside. Pour boiling water in measuring cup. Stir in Espresso powder and soda. Stir in eggs and water mixture into flour mixture. Mix just until blended. Pour half the batter into prepared pan; sprinkle cherries and walnuts evenly over batter. Evenly pour in remaining batter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes until pick inserted into cake comes out clean. Cool in pan on rack for 15 minutes; invert onto rack. Remove pan and cool completely. Dust with powdered sugar. Place on serving plate. Fill cake center with additional cherries. Makes 16 servings.

title: Mud Pie
instructions: Crush Oreos; cover bottom of pan with 1/2. Mix pudding as directed. Mix in cheese and Cool Whip. Spread over crushed Oreos. Sprinkle remaining cookies over top and refrigerate.

title: Easy Cran-Orange Relish
instructions: Cut oranges into chunks rind and pulp removing all seeds. Wash and pick over berries. Place oranges cranberries and sugar in the bowl of a processor. Process until coarsely chopped. Refrigerate until serving time. Freezes well.

title: Spinach Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Chop and saute onions. Add flour and cook 2 minutes stirring constantly. Add blended mix of milk. Stir in spinach to desired consistency. Steam peppers with tops cut off 5 to 7 minutes. Fill peppers with mixture. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ruth'S Western Barbecued Beans
instructions: Combine ground beef salt pepper and garlic. Saute in cooking oil in large skillet over medium heat until lightly browned. Add onion and brown a few minutes longer until onion is golden. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Pour into bean pot or 9-inch square baking dish. If desired garnish top with onion rings and drizzle with a little catsup. Bake in a slow 325\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Ham Puffs
instructions: Beat together flour baking powder and eggs until well blended. Mix in potatoes and ham. Heat oil to 350\u00b0 and drop batter by teaspoon into oil. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: Cass County Corn Bread
instructions: Heat oil in pan in oven while mixing other ingredients. Mix all ingredients (except oil). Add heated oil last. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes in 8 or 9-inch pan. Serves 8.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Beat egg whites and 1/2 cup sugar until they form fluffy peaks. Beat egg yolks 1/4 cup sugar and vanilla until light yellow. Fold egg whites into egg yolks and add flour. Pour onto cookie sheet which is greased and has wax paper in it. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Remove from cookie sheet onto lightly powdered sugar towel and remove wax paper. Roll up in towel and let cool for 5 minutes. Unroll and put jelly on it. Then roll it up again without the towel. Place toothpicks in it to help hold it together.

title: Mounds Candy
instructions: Mix sugar coconut milk and butter together. Press into oblong pan and chill. Cut into small squares. Dip in coating mix.

title: Aunt Winnie'S Glazed Lemon Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Homemade Chili
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion together until done. Drain off all grease. Add remainder of ingredients and cook on medium heat 20-25 minutes.

title: Hominy Salad
instructions: Rinse hominy and drain well. Combine with remaining ingredients and chill well. Serve on lettuce garnished with tomato wedges and more mayonnaise if desired.

title: Tangy Beef Salad
instructions: Combine oil vinegar wine Worcestershire sauce garlic and onion salt in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch microwave-safe baking dish. Partially freeze steak; slice diagonally across the grain into thin slices and cut into 2-inch lengths. Place steak in marinade; cover and marinate at least 2 hours in refrigerator. Cover with wax paper; microwave at Medium-high (70% power) 5 minutes; stir. Microwave at Medium-high 3 to 5 additional minutes or to desired degree of doneness stirring after 2 minutes. Remove from oven; let stand 5 minutes. Drain steak; discard marinade.

title: Grandma Majernik'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In a bowl combine first 3 ingredients with a wire whisk and set aside. In another bowl beat oleo and both sugars to a grainy paste. Add egg and vanilla. Then combine dry ingredients with oleo-sugar mixture. When well mixed add chocolate chips and nuts.

title: Whipped Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter\tsugar and eggs. Add flour and whipping cream alternately. Bake in large tube pan for 1 1/2 hours or until done at 325\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Scampi(Microwave)
instructions: Place butter in 2-quart casserole and microwave on High until melted. Stir in parsley lemon juice garlic and salt. Add shrimp and toss to coat. Cover and microwave until shrimp is pink and tender (do not overcook or shrimp will be tough) about 4 to 5 minutes stirring twice. Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

title: Chicken Tamales
instructions: Process cornmeal oat bran baking powder salt cumin chili powder and margarine in food processor until blended. With machine running pour in broth; process until blended. Let stand 20 minutes. Combine chicken tomato sauce and 2 tablespoons chilies in small bowl.

title: Taco Pizza
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Stir in tomato sauce and taco mix. Simmer 5 minutes. Press dough on 12-inch ungreased pizza pan and prick bottom. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes until golden brown. Fill with meat mixture. Cover with cheese. Bake until cheese melts. Top with remaining ingredients and top with sour cream.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and spread in 13 x 9-inch ungreased pan. Beat together remaining ingredients and spread onto cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Easy Cherry Pie
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Mix together sugar flour and milk. Pour batter over melted butter in pan. Pour filling on top. Bake until golden brown on top at 350\u00b0. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Pretzel Dessert
instructions: Mix pretzel crumbs butter and sugar together and press in the bottom of square dish. Mix up 1 package of Dream Whip according to directions on the package. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar. Fold this mixture into the prepared Dream Whip. Spread over the crumb mixture in the bottom of your dish. Top with 1 can of cherry pie filling or your favorite fruit. Sprinkle pretzel crumbs over the top and chill.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water and drain again. In a mixing bowl beat (with electric mixer) Ricotta Mozzarella Romano cheese egg whites parsley and pepper until fluffy.

title: Poor Man'S Filet Mignon
instructions: Combine first eight ingredients and 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce. Form into 12 thick patties. Wrap a bacon slice around the sides of each patty and secure with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until desired doneness is reached. Baste frequently with remaining barbecue sauce the last 30 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs. With rolling pin crush vanilla wafers. Add wafer flour alternately with milk. Add coconut. Fold in pecans. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour mixture into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Maple Sugar Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine all ingredients except last 2. Pour into the pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 45 minutes or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool to room temperature. Refrigerate. Garnish with whipped cream if desired. Yields 8 servings.

title: Three Berry Kuchen
instructions: Spray 10-inch round spring-form pan with cooking spray. Combine in bowl 1 1/2 cups flour baking powder baking soda and salt. In large bowl whisk egg whites sugar applesauce yogurt and lemon zest until smooth. Add flour mixture all at once to wet ingredients. Stir until blended. Place in prepared pan. Place berries on top of batter. In small bowl combine remaining flour and brown sugar. Cut in cold margarine and mix until evenly blended. Put topping on batter. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool 20 minutes before serving. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix together; form into 1-inch balls. May freeze at this point. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes if thawed; 30 minutes if frozen.

title: Sunshine Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl. Add dressing and toss again. Serve immediately.

title: Dinosaur Bone Explorer
instructions: Pretend chocolate chips are dinosaur bones. Use the toothpick as your digging tool. How many \bones\ can you retrieve. Brush off the cookie crumbs with the paintbrush. For a party game children can race against the clock to see who can find the most bones.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix in bowl the 3 cans of soup. Take out 1 can of the mixed soup. Add the uncooked rice to the cans of soup mix. Put into a greased pan or casserole. Lay chicken pieces on top of rice/soup mixture. Pour 1 can of mixed soup over the chicken. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until chicken is tender brown and crispy.

title: Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions until done. Add barbecue sauce brown sugar and beans. When hot and bubbly cut biscuits in halves. Pour meat mixture into casserole dish. Poke biscuit halves in mixture and cover with grated cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until biscuits are done and cheese is melted.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in brown sugar corn syrup and salt. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil without stirring 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda and vanilla. Pour over popped corn mixing well. Turn into 2 large shallow pans (with sides) or roaster pans. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven; cool. Break apart and store in tightly covered container.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Boil 5 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla.

title: Cheese Bites
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Prepare pie crust as directed on box; add cheese to dry ingredients. Shape mixture around olive onion or nut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet or shallow baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Puffs
instructions: Combine butter water salt and garlic powder in saucepan. Heat until water is boiling and butter is melted. Add flour all at once. Remove from heat and stir mixture quickly until dough comes away from sides of pan. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir broccoli into dough. Chill 2 hours or overnight. Pour oil into deep skillet and heat to 375\u00b0. Drop heaping teaspoonful of mixture into oil. Brown on one side about 2 minutes then turn and brown on other side. Drain. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve hot.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar Parkay and Milnot. Bring to a full boil stirring constantly. Continue to cook boiling 5 minutes over medium heat. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme nuts and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Over Night Sticky Buns
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients well. Spray bundt pan with Pam sprinkle nuts or raisins on bottom of pan. Layer frozen buns on top of nuts or raisins. Sprinkle butterscotch pudding over rolls evenly. Pour oleo mix over rolls. Cover with a paper towel. Let stand at room temperature over night. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Invert immediately on plate. Enjoy!!

title: Refrigerator Cake
instructions: Mix first five ingredients and press into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Mix sugar Cool Whip and cream cheese and spread over crust. Mix pudding with 3 cups milk. Spread over cheese mixture. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Lazy Day Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix pudding mix and fruit cocktail. Mix all together.

title: Corn Meal Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar in bowl. Add egg and beat well. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Drop dough from teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until light brown.

title: *Easy Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour milk and mayonnaise in bowl; mix well. Fill greased muffin cups. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 12 servings.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all together by hand. Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Creamy Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Can also add sliced artichoke hearts.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Grease an 8-inch pie pan. Mix in this order. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until light brown.

title: Red Skin Potatoes
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam spray. Wash potatoes and cut in half. Coat potatoes with onion soup and oil by putting in a bag and shaking until all potatoes are coated. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. (Need not add any liquid.)

title: Ripe Tomato Relish
instructions: Chop or cut in small pieces. Mix all ingredients and boil for about 2 hours slowly or until thick. Stir often to keep from sticking. Cook in porcelain pan. Seal while hot. Yields 6 to 7 pints.

title: Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix Hidden Valley with oil pour over crackers stirring well to coat evenly. Bake 15-20 minutes at 250\u00b0. Stir halfway through baking. Use for snacks with soups or party appetizers.

title: Wassail
instructions: Combine cider brown sugar and fruit juices in large pot and add spices. Bring to a boil lower heat and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Strain to remove spices.

title: Potato Dish
instructions: Place potatoes in large bowl let thaw a little bit. Add melted oleo and mix well. Add cheese mix through. Mix sour cream and soup together. Blend it together with onions and potatoes and cheese. Spread into 9x12 baking dish. Sprinkle corn flakes over top. Bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes.

title: Yeast Waffles
instructions: The night before dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup of the water. Mix milk remaining water yeast mixture sugar salt margarine and flour. The next morning stir in the eggs and baking soda.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in skillet with butter. Cut potatoes in 1/2-inch cubes and spread in baking dish. Cover with half the meat. Add half of soup and a sliced onion. Season with salt and pepper. Repeat layers using remaining ingredients. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Barbecued Beef For Buns
instructions: Cook the meat long and slow until tender; cool. Remove fat and bone; shred the meat. Skim most of the grease off the broth. Return the meat to pan. Combine the remaining ingredients and simmer a half hour. Add to shredded meat and simmer another hour. This makes about 20 sandwiches. It freezes real well so you can double the recipe.

title: New England Fish Chowder(Without Salt Pork)
instructions: *Low-fat milk cream and butter may be substituted.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer refried beans then mix sour cream mayonnaise and taco mix. Layer on top of beans. Layer cheese lettuce tomatoes onion green pepper and olives on top.

title: Peanut Brittle
