instructions: In a 1 1/2 quart microwave safe container stir together peanuts sugar syrup and salt.\tMicrowave on High for 4 minutes. Remove from oven and stir. Return to oven and microwave on High for 4 more minutes. Remove from oven stir in butter and\tvanilla. Return to oven and microwave on High for 2 minutes more. Remove from oven\tand quickly stir in baking soda (mixture becomes foamy). Immediately pour onto a lightly greased surface spreading thin.\tWhen cooked break into pieces. Yields 1 pound.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown meat with salt pepper and garlic salt to taste; add onion. Add tomato juice 2 cans of water beef base and cabbage and cook for 2 hours. Add potatoes and vegetables and cook for 45 minutes.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Arrange strawberries and mint leaves in ring mold. Add 1/2 inch water. Freeze until firm. Combine sugar and citric acid powder in 1-gallon jar. Fill with water. Cover and shake to dissolve sugar. Chill until serving time.

title: Barbecued Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 4 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Quickie Dip
instructions: Stir together in saucepan over low heat until mixture is smooth and hot. Serve in chafing dish or in a crock over a candle to keep warm. Serve with nacho chips. A great quickie dip for those unexpected social occasions.

title: J.L.M. Ham Salad
instructions: Hard-boil eggs. Drain pimentos. Put all ingredients through meat grinder. Mix well. Add Miracle Whip to ground mixture until texture is to your taste. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Chop chicken and broccoli using knife or food chopper. Place in bowl. Add bell pepper garlic cheese mayonnaise dill and salt to bowl; mix well. Unroll package of crescent rolls. Use a roller or fingers to seal perforations in dough. Repeat with other package of rolls. Place dough beside each other on cookie sheet. Seal seam between the 2. Place mixture on the center of the dough. With your hands form a loaf shape with the mixture. Fold up edges of dough to cover mixture. Cut slits in dough on top of the \loaf\. Brush with egg whites. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake for 25 to 28 minutes. Cut into pieces. Enjoy!

title: Orange Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar. Melt oleo salt juice and coconut. Beat well and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until light brown.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch and water into medium size saucepan; cook until clear over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add red food coloring and jello. Cool and mix with strawberries. Put in 9-inch baked pie shell. Refrigerate until cool 4 hours or longer.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs until creamy. Put flour salt soda and cinnamon into creamy mixture. Add vanilla nuts and apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Pie(No Crust)
instructions: Put apples in pan. Mix 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon; pour mix over apples. Mix flour egg 1 cup sugar butter and walnuts. Pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Cook onion in butter until softened. Blend mandarin juice and cornstarch together. Add to onion along with salt and lime juice. Cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens. Add pimiento and combine with hot cooked beans. Serves 4.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix Bisquick with enough milk to make a moist dough. Mix in cheese and sausage. Form into 1-inch balls. (I drop by spoon.) Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown but not overdone. Yields about 5 dozen.

title: Marshmallow Frosting
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in top of double boiler. Place over boiling water and beat with egg beater 10 minutes or until thick adding marshmallow as it begins to thicken. Beat until smooth. Remove from fire; add flavoring. Beat until thick and nearly cold. Add baking powder. Continue to beat until thick enough to spread on cake without running.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Stir together and bake until bubbly or brown on top. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Roast Wild Duck(Serves 6)
instructions: Singe and clean ducks. Cut out oil sac at base of tail; cut off neck at body leaving on neck skin. Wash ducks under cold running water. Dry. Rub cavities with salt.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. Great for party tray dip. Serve with carrots celery broccoli cauliflower green pepper and cucumbers.

title: Layered Tostada Dip
instructions: Combine beans and chili powder; mix well and spread in bottom of container. Combine avocados Miracle Whip bacon onion and seasoning. Spread on top of bean layer. Spread a layer of tomatoes then olives and a layer of cheese. Dip up with your favorite corn chips. Makes 6 cups.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add eggs oil pineapple and bananas until moist. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla and walnuts. Spoon batter into 3 (9-inch) pans which have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Remove from pan and cool completely.

title: Bean And Pasta Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until light brown. Add beans and simmer 15 to 20 minutes then add tomato sauce oregano and basil. Cook 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Ham And Potatoes Au Gratin Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine potatoes au gratin and ham in medium bowl; place in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes. Top with onions; bake an additional 2 minutes.

title: Pasta Chicken
instructions: Cut up fryer; boil in 4-quart pot. When tender remove from liquid (bone out). Add onions bell pepper tomatoes and sweet peas. Cook spaghetti. Add to the mixture and cook in the chicken broth until spaghetti is done. Add salt pepper and Velveeta (cubed). Let stand covered until cheese is melted.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all together. Cut up fresh fruit and dip.

title: Easy Crab Dip
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese on a serving dish or tray. Pour cocktail sauce onto cream cheese. Chop crab meat and spread on sauce. Sprinkle with oregano (optional).

title: Grape Juice Lemonade
instructions: Combine ingredients in the order given. Chill 1/2 hour. Serve in each glass a thin slice of lemon with seeds removed. Serves 8.

title: Shrimp Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Line pie crusts with Swiss cheese. Saute shrimp with garlic and green onions. Place atop the Swiss cheese. Whip eggs gradually adding the cream and milk mixture. Pour egg mixture over shrimp. Bake for 10 minutes; reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes longer.

title: Monkey Balls
instructions: Cut biscuits into 4 pieces and roll into balls. Combine white sugar and cinnamon. Roll the biscuits in the sugar cinnamon mixture.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt. Set aside. In large bowl combine margarine peanut butter sugars and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Stir in chocolate chips. Spread evenly into a well-greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake for about 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. After cooling you can frost with a chocolate frosting.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Do not leave out any ingredients!

title: Dirt Pudding
instructions: Melt butter and pour over Oreo cookies. Mix pudding and milk together using mixer. Cream powdered sugar and cream cheese together using mixer. Add powdered sugar and cream cheese mixture to the pudding mixture. Add Cool Whip. Add Oreo cookies mixture. Put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Crush remaining Oreo cookies and sprinkle on it. Let set 4 to 8 hours or overnight.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well. Shape into loaf. Place in pan and bake about 2 hours at 325\u00b0. Bacon slices may be placed on top before baking. Loaf may be shaped around sticks of Cheddar cheese.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
instructions: Mix together the oreos and melted margarine and press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve 1/4 cup for the top. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. Mix together the cream cheese powdered sugar and 8 oz. of Cool Whip. Spread over the cookies. Mix the chocolate pudding according to the instructions on the box and spread over the the cheese mixture. Chill for about 1 hour. Before serving pour on the remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with the rest of the crushed cookies.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain and add kidney beans chili powder and salt. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Toss remaining salad ingredients with dressing adding tortilla chips last. Mix in hot meat mixture and serve immediately. \Expect raves!\

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Pour into crust and freeze 3 to 4 hours.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes 1/2 cup butter onion salt pepper sour cream soup and cheese. Stir well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish and top with corn flakes mixed with the remaining 1/4 cup butter. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Holiday Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Add flour salt and baking soda; mix well. Add cherries juice dates and nuts; mix well. Shape into balls about the size of a quarter and roll in powdered sugar. Place on a greased cookie sheet (sprayed with Pam). Place in preheated 375\u00b0 oven. Bake for 10 minutes or until golden. Makes 10 to 12 dozen. They freeze well.

title: Peanut Butter Cereal Treats
instructions: Spray 8 or 9-inch pan with spray. Pour cereal in large bowl.

title: Tomacaroni Stew
instructions: Heat oil and brown cubes of meat. Remove meat and cook onions and garlic until golden brown. Put meat back in with onions and garlic. Add salt pepper and tomatoes. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Add undrained peas and mushrooms. Stir in the uncooked macaroni. Cover and cook for 15 minutes or until macaroni is tender.

title: Carlton'S Favorite Soup
instructions: Saut beef and drain on paper towel; press out any grease. Place in very large soup pot. Add remainder of ingredients in order given ending with cabbage. Simmer until done about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in salty water and drain. Spread broccoli in 14 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch dish. Spread 1/3 cup grated cheese over broccoli. Place chicken on top of cheese. Mix broth Miracle Whip and soups. Pour mixture over top of chicken. Spread remaining cheese over chicken and top with croutons. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles about 30 minutes.

title: Light Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Combine flour and sugar. Cut in margarine with pastry blender or knife until mixture is crumbly. Set aside. Mix together corn syrup hot water and baking soda. Divide liquid evenly into two 9-inch pie shells. Divide evenly and add the crumbs. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake about 20 minutes longer or until firm.

title: Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add soup sour cream and mushrooms. Pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix cornbread and pour on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: White Whipped Cream Cake
instructions: Sift together the first 4 ingredients. Set aside. Beat in a large bowl the egg whites and salt until stiff. Fold in the whipping cream water and vanilla. Fold into dry ingredients. Makes two 8-inch layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Scotch Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together; add flour and knead with right hand until it forms a dough. Knead a little longer and press into a buttered tin. Prick top with a fork and bake at 275\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a pale brown. Cut in squares or fingers while warm and leave in pan to cool.

title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Mix flour sugar 1/4 cup cocoa baking powder and salt in an ungreased 8-inch pan. Stir with a fork. Add milk and oil; stir. Sprinkle brown sugar 1/4 cup cocoa and chocolate chips over batter. Mix vanilla and water. Pour evenly over top and bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Rolled Chicken Breasts
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Wrap beef slices around each chicken filet. Wrap 1 slice bacon around beef on each filet; secure with toothpick. Arrange in baking dish. Mix sour cream and soup in bowl. Spoon over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Top with mushrooms. Yield 8 servings.

title: Mushroom And Artichoke Chicken
instructions: In shallow pan or plastic bag combine first four ingredients - dredge chicken in seasoning. Heat oil in skillet add chicken brown 3-5 minutes each side. Then arrange chicken in 2 quart baking dish. Tuck artichoke around chichen. In skillet add mushrooms onions and saut 2-3 minutes. Add stock and sherry bring to a boil. Combine flour and water. Reduce heat add to skillet. Stir constantly 2-3 minutes at a simmer. Pour over chicken. Cover dish. Bake at 375 degrees for 40 minutes. Serves 2 or 4.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray baking dish with Pam. Dip chicken in margarine. Coat with combined breadcrumbs and cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Slice banana into pie shell. Prepare pie filling mix as directed using 2 1/2 cups milk. Fold in 1/2 cup of the whipped topping and pour over banana in shell. Chill at least 3 hours.

title: Teri'S Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook and squeeze spinach until dry. Stir together the spinach sour cream mayonnaise soup mix water chestnuts and green onions. Add garlic powder to taste. Cover; good to chill overnight. Good served in hollowed out round French bread bowl. Dip with bread pieces crackers or vegetables.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Mix flour butter and sugar in small bowl. Press into prepared pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes in a 13 x 9 pan.

title: Rice And Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except crumbs and margarine. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with combined crumbs and margarine. Bake 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar and pour over salad. Add bacon bits right before serving. Delicious!

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Beat the cheese and mayonnaise together until smooth. Combine it with drained fruits. Whip the cream in chilled bowl until soft peaks form. Blend in powdered sugar to taste. Fold fruit mixture into whipped cream. Pour and smooth into a 9 x 13-inch freezer-proof pan. Freeze for 2 to 3 hours until firm. Cut into squares and serve with garnish.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion; add other ingredients. Put in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until rice is done.

title: Irresistible Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove cake from oven and poke holes in the cake with handle of wooden spoon. Already have caramel topping and Eagle Brand milk mixed together. Stir again and pour over cake while hot. Let cake cool. Ice with Cool Whip. Sprinkle crushed Heath bars on top (they crush better if frozen). Refrigerate; serve cold.

title: 7Up Salad
instructions: Mix lime jello with boiling water. Add sugar stir and cool. Add 7 up stir and partially set. In another bowl mix pineapple and cream cheese. Pour over jello mix with fork. Sprinkle with pecan pieces. Let jello set completely before serving.

title: Mexican Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients fry and serve hot.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken And Vegetables
instructions: Heat oil in wok at medium-high (325\u00b0) for 1 to 2 minutes. Add chicken; stir fry 6 to 8 minutes. Remove the chicken from wok; reserve pan drippings. Add broccoli carrot celery green pepper mushrooms and water to wok; stir-fry 6 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Remove vegetables from wok. Combine pineapple juice and next 6 ingredients in a small bowl. Add to wok; cook until thickened stirring occasionally. Add chicken and vegetables to the sauce in wok. Reduce heat to low (225\u00b0) and simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over hot rice.

title: Pumpkin Treats
instructions: Mix together sugar eggs oil and pumpkin. Blend well. Mix in salt cinnamon baking soda baking powder and flour. Stir in nuts. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch dish.

title: Light But Rich Custard Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar salt vanilla and scalded milk. Slowly pour mixture into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between edge of pie and center comes out clean.

title: Jello And Cool Whip Easy Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Pour 2 1/2 cups milk into large bowl. Add 2 packages Jell-O instant chocolate pudding. Beat with a wire whisk until well blended. Mix in 1 tub of Cool Whip (thawed). Layer brownies cubes pudding and Cool Whip mixture raspberries or strawberries and additional 1 tub of Cool Whip in large glass bowl. Refrigerate 1 hour. Makes 16 servings.

title: Turtle Nut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Put 1/2 of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes. Melt caramels milk and butter. Stir pecans or walnuts into caramel mixture. Pour caramel and nut mixture over the cake. Sprinkle with chips. Pour reserved batter on top. Bake 20 minutes or until cake is springy to touch.

title: Chocolate Syrup Brownies
instructions: In a bowl cream together butter sugar and eggs until very creamy. Add salt. Stir in flour mixing well to blend. Add chocolate syrup vanilla and chopped nuts. Turn mixture into well greased and lightly floured 9-inch square pan; smooth top.

title: Orange Fruit Dip
instructions: In a bowl whisk milk orange juice concentrate and pudding mix for 2 minutes. Let stand for 2 minutes or until soft-set. Whisk in sour cream. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Serve with fresh fruit. Yield 2-3/4 cups.

title: Hermit Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add egg yolks beating lightly. Add flour baking powder and cinnamon sifted together. Add brandy nuts and dates; fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces. Crumble bacon and add. Add onion and raisins. In a separate bowl mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Use as a dressing over salad. I find that this makes more dressing than is needed. This salad is good warm after adding bacon or cold.

title: Cereal Christmas Trees
instructions: In large saucepan heat butter and marshmallows over low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and food coloring. Fold in cereal until evenly coated.

title: Cocoroons
instructions: Fold sugar and salt gradually into egg whites. Fold Post Toasties and coconut gradually into mixture. Add almond extract. Drop from teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen cocoroons.

title: Teriyaki Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Marinate chicken or beef in the mixture for 24 hours before cooking or grilling.

title: Orange Sherbet Punch
instructions: In punch bowl combine first 4 ingredients. Place ice in bowl. Add chunks of sherbet. Garnish with orange slices. Serves 20 to 25 punch cups.

title: Farfalle, Turkey Sausage, Peas And Mushrooms
instructions: In large pot bring 6 quarts of salted water to a boil.

title: Easy Cheesecake
instructions: Use large pan.\tCan be cut in 1/2.

title: Black Oil Cake
instructions: Combine in large bowl first 4 ingredients. Stir well then add remaining ingredients. Mix well then add 1 cup boiling water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix oil and eggs. Then fold in Mandarin oranges with juices. Pour into two 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Let cake completely cool before icing.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix together and shape into loaf. Refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight. Slice and roll in flour; fry in butter until brown. Place in\ta baking dish and add 1 can cream of mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice. Add all other ingredients. Pour into graham cracker crusts. Chill in refrigerator 2 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients and toss well. Serve with dressing.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Melt sugar in hot water. Cool. Add juices. Mash or blend bananas until real smooth. Add lemon juice. Combine all ingredients except ginger ale and freeze.

title: Crabmeat Omelet(Virginia Seafood Council)
instructions: Sure! Crabmeat for breakfast! Drain and flake about 6 ounces. Slice green onions with tops very thin. Cook 2 or 3 minutes in 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet. Beat eggs. Add skim milk salt pepper and paprika. Pour over onions and cook slowly until firm and browned on the bottom. When done sprinkle with crabmeat fold over and turn out on a hot platter. Makes 4 servings and each portion contains only about 215 calories.

title: Chocolate Torte
instructions: Slice pound cake six layers deep. Combine chocolate and coffee; melt in microwave. Stir often until mixture becomes slightly warm. Beat into Cool Whip. Ice each layer and then whole outside. Refrigerate two hours. Slice and enjoy.

title: Good And Spicy Meatballs
instructions: Combine Rice Krispies onion catsup eggs salt and pepper. Mix in ground beef. Shape in 1 1/4-inch balls place in single layer in foil-lined greased baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 12 minutes or to slight brown. Combine remaining ingredients in large saucepan. Cook over low heat 10 minutes stir frequently. Add meatballs continue to cook 10 to 15 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles if desired.

title: Orange Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juice off fruit and save. Mix pudding water and Tang. Add fruit juice until dissolved. Pour over fruit.

title: Whoopie Pies
instructions: Mix and drop tablespoon of batter on ungreased sheet. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and pecans. Set aside. Beat eggs; add sugar oil and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in dry ingredients just until moistened. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool 10 minutes in pans. Turn out on rack.

title: Black Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to use. Serve with tortilla chips as a side salad or appetizer.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: In a large casserole dish layer shredded lettuce thin sliced onion peas cauliflower and salad dressing. Spread dressing mix (do not mix) cheddar cheese (shredded) and bacon bits on top.

title: Peach Betty
instructions: Arrange peach slices in a 9-inch round dish. Sprinkle with flour and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Combine brown sugar bread crumbs 1 teaspoon cinnamon and nutmeg. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add oats and walnuts. Crumble mixture over peach slices. Do not cover. Microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes. Let stand uncovered until lukewarm. Makes 6 servings. Freezable.

title: Orange Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour salt and grated rind. Add fruit juice and cook in double boiler for 10 minutes stirring until thickened. Add butter and egg yolks beaten lightly. Cook for two minutes and cool. Pour into a baked pastry shell top with a meringue and brown in a slow oven.

title: Bean Sprout Spinach Salad
instructions: In a small sauce pan whisk together the first 5 ingredients cook and stir over low heat until mixture reaches 160 degrees. Remove from heat cool.

title: Never Fail Icebox Rolls
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add boiling water. Put yeast in lukewarm water and melt. When sugar and shortening are completely cooled stir in yeast and water. Add well beaten eggs. Add flour which has been sifted with the salt. Mix well and put in large covered container in the refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Use 1/4 cup flour to coat walnuts. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan. Combine all ingredients except walnuts in large mixing bowl blending together. Beat for 3 minutes. Add walnuts and stir until blended. Pour into pan and bake 60 to 70 minutes or until cake springs back. Cool in pan 15 minutes.

title: Polynesian Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice; cool to room temperature. Combine salad oil vinegar soy sauce salt celery and onion. Stir in rice. Fold in water chestnuts mushrooms and oranges just until blended. Chill thoroughly. Enjoy!

title: Copper Kettle Carrots
instructions: Make marinade from soup Worcestershire sauce salad oil sugar vinegar mustard and Tabasco sauce. Drain carrots and pour boiling marinade over carrots pepper and onions which have been layered. Marinate overnight. Can be heated or served cold. I use 1 3/4 quart Corning Ware dish for this.

title: Rocky Road
instructions: Melt chocolate and peanut butter chips together. Stir in marshmallows and melt. Add walnuts. Pour into tinfoil-lined 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate until hard. Remove from pan pull off tin foil and cut into squares.

title: Grilled Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine marmalade ketchup and soy sauce; mix well. Pour mixture over chicken and coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Heat grill; cook chicken on medium turning frequently until done.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Blend in the egg. Sift flour and add to mix. Spoon drop onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Take a fork and press dough out. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Rice Pulao
instructions: Make ghee or clarified butter by melting butter and discarding solids. Pour into a 5-quart nonstick saucepan. Add onion cloves cardamom cinnamon peppercorns and bay leaves. Cook stirring over medium heat until onion is golden brown. Reduce heat and sprinkle with 3 tablespoons of water. Stir once.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together sugar and oil. Add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla chopped nuts and bananas. Add buttermilk and soda mixture. Blend in salt and flour. Add coconut flakes if desired. Bake in greased and floured tube pan 9 x 12-inch pan or muffin pan at 325\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Good Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all together and place in uncooked pie shell. Cook approximately 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Turmeric Sliced Pickles
instructions: Put a handful of salt over the cucumbers and onions; let stand 4 hours or overnight. Bring mustard celery seed sugar and vinegar to a boil. Add pickles. Cook 3 to 5 minutes. Do not let them get soft. Add turmeric to taste. Very good.

title: Amaretto Cheese Cake
instructions: Combine graham crackers and melted butter. Sprinkle into mixture some crushed almonds. When mixture is moistened by butter press into 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Toss shrimp in seasoned flour. Shake off all excess flour.

title: Avocado Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients except avocados stirring well. Cover and chill. Just before serving add avocados and toss gently. Serve with tortilla chips. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Veal Chops With Creamed Mushrooms
instructions: Salt chops and brown on both sides in fat. Place in a baking dish. Brown all mushrooms in butter with parsley and garlic. Stir in sour cream. Mix well and pour over chops. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Red Chocolate Cake
instructions: Dissolve cocoa in melted shortening; add beaten egg. Then sift sugar flour and soda. Add alternately to other mixture with sour milk. Add vanilla and beat. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Creamy Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Deviled Egg Salad
instructions: Cut eggs in half. Remove yolks and mash with a fork. Add seasonings and dressing to yolks. Mix until well blended. Refill egg whites with yolk mixture. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Spaghetti Squash
instructions: Microwave Cut squash lengthwise. Place in covered microwave dish and microwave 10 minutes. Once done with a fork scrape the inside of the squash. It should string out like spaghetti. Sprinkle with bacon strips and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Blueberry Peach Crumb Cake
instructions: Layer peaches and blueberries in the bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish. Combine cornstarch sugar and nutmeg; sprinkle over the fruit. Combine graham crackers and margarine mixing well. Sprinkle mixture over fruit. Cook using the appropriate settings.

title: Pull-Apart Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water in large bowl. Pour boiling water over shortening and dissolve. Add sugar salt eggs flour and dissolve yeast. Mix well and refrigerate overnight or until dough is thoroughly chilled. Roll dough out to 1/4-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Dip each biscuit into melted butter and stand biscuits on sides in two greased Bundt pans. Let rise 2 to 3 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When serving just pull apart and enjoy!

title: Delicious Carrots
instructions: Cut carrots in half lengthwise then crosswise. Combine with salt and water in frying pan. Heat to boiling and cover. Cook 10 minutes. Uncover and cook for 3 minutes until liquid evaporates. Add butter lemon and syrup. Cook 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Vegetarian Lasagne
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Thaw spinach. Saute onion in oil until soft. Add carrots and mushrooms; cook until crisp-tender. Stir in tomato sauce paste and oregano. Grease a 13 x 9-inch casserole. Layer 1/2 of noodles cottage cheese spinach sauce mixture and 1/2 of the cheese slices. Repeat placing remaining 1/2 of Monterey Jack on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Lacy Funnel Cake
instructions: Heat oil to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except confectioners sugar. Select funnel with 1/2-inch opening in small end. Swirl batter into hot oil starting in center and working outward to make 6-inch lacy spiral. Fry 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Can keep warm in 200\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Can also top with fruit flavors.

title: Cherry Pie Filling
instructions: Will make 2 pies.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Prepare bread crumbs (remove crust if desired). Mince onion and green pepper. Break eggs into a large bowl; beat slightly with fork. Add meat. Toss very lightly until just blended. (Overmixing tends to toughen loaf.) Add bread crumbs green pepper and onion. Measure horseradish and next 4 ingredients into meat. Combine lightly but well with fork. Shape meat into an oval loaf right in the bowl. Turn into greased loaf pan and smooth into shape. Spread meat with 1/2 cup catsup. Bake in a moderately hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain and mix in 1 can tomato sauce. In casserole dish spread beef mixture in bottom. Spread corn and green beans on top of beef. Then spoon mashed potatoes over top and spread smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be topped with shredded Cheddar last 10 minutes of baking. Easy and filling!

title: Jello Cake
instructions: Combine eggs Mazola oil vanilla and salt. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Cool slightly; add to first mixture. Add cake mix. Stir until smooth. Pour into tube pan (greased). Cook for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0 in preheated oven. Cool on rack.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Sift powdered\tsugar.\tPlace powdered sugar margarine and cocoa in glass dish and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Remove from oven and add milk vanilla and nuts if desired.

title: Plum Good Appetizers
instructions: Heat all 3 ingredients until almost a boil stirring constantly. Then reduce to low heat for 30 minutes. Keep warm in small crock-pot and serve with cocktail picks. Servings 20.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Take 3 cups corn stir in 3 eggs that have been beaten well. Add flour salt and pepper. Stir in milk and mix thoroughly. Butter dish and pour in and top with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake in hot oven about one hour. Serve hot.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugar and butter. Add egg yolks one at a time and cream well. Add buttermilk alternating with soda and flour mixture. Fold in beaten egg whites coconut and pecans. Bake in 9 x 13 pan for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Nine Bean Soup
instructions: Sort and wash bean mix. Place in Dutch oven. Cover with water 2 inches above beans; soak overnight. Drain. Add water and all remaining ingredients. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 2 hours or until beans are tender. Stir occasionally. Adjust seasonings. Get out the soup bowls and French bread and enjoy!

title: Poke Salad Greens
instructions: Use only the new tender leaves of the poke salad plant. Pick and wash greens. Put in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Boil a short time; drain and wash greens. Repeat 2 more times. Then put greens in fresh water and cook until 1/3 done. Cook chopped green onions in bacon grease until transparent; add drained poke salad greens and some cooked bacon bits. Season to taste with salt and pepper and let simmer in small amount of bacon grease for a few minutes.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Boil squash 10 minutes. Make cornbread; add rest ingredients. Pour into greased casserole dish. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: In skillet cook onions and peppers together for 5 minutes. Add rest of the ingredients and cook until water is absorbed and ingredients are done. For beef or frankfurter rice add ground beef (1 pound) or cut up frankfurters with onions and peppers.

title: Baby Ruth Bars
instructions: Bring to a boil the sugar and syrup. Immediately add the peanut butter and mix well. Stir in Rice Krispies. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with the butterscotch and chocolate chips which have been melted together.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion; drain. In large bowl mix cream of chicken and mushroom soup (do not add water) dry enchilada mix Ro-Tel tomatoes (do not drain) and browned meat and onion. Place taco shells in greased pan and fill with meat mixture. Cover with grated cheese and bake. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (35 minutes).

title: Garbage Cake
instructions: Put pineapple in a 9 x 13-inch pan then place pie filling on top. Sprinkle over that the cake mix then the chopped nuts. Slice over that the margarine and bake. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. The cake may be served either warm or cold and with or without whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into a 9 x 13 greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta; drain. Mix in 1/2 cup Kens or Wish-Bone Caesar dressing and 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard and horseradish; marinate overnight. Add all other ingredients. Stir in Maries sour cream and dill dressing (jar). Makes 12 servings.

title: Buster Bar Dessert
instructions: Melt oleo and add to crushed Oreo cookies. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Save 1 cup crumbs for topping. Refrigerate until cold. Cover with soft ice cream and put in freezer to harden. Spread peanuts over ice cream and pour syrup over peanuts. Carefully spread Cool Whip over chocolate syrup. Last sprinkle reserved crumbs on top. Return to freezer for at least 12 hours or overnight.

title: Sugarless Three Bean Salad
instructions: Combine the beans green pepper onion celery and pimento. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour dressing over bean mixture and stir. Refrigerate in covered container for 12 hours before serving stirring occasionally. This salad will keep for several days in the refrigerator. Yields 16 servings.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Mix and bake until all cheese is melted. Serve with taco chips.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs beaten to blend with melted and cooled butter vanilla both sugars and salt. Stir together both flours with oats baking powder soda and cinnamon. Combine with the wet mixture and dried fruit mixture. Mix well.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Arrange cucumber slices in large shallow dish. Sprinkle with salt between layers. Place plate over them with a weight to hold it down. Let stand at room temperature about 2 hours. Squeeze out liquid with hands combine with other ingredients and chill several hours before serving. Excellent with beef. More onion may be added if desired.

title: Chocolate Torte
instructions: Layer 1 Mix together the flour margarine sugar and chopped pecans. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes 1/2 cup margarine onion soup sour cream and cheese. Stir well. Spoon into a 2 1/2-quart casserole.

title: Cream Cheese And Raspberry Coffee Cake
instructions: In a large mixer bowl beat cream cheese sugar and margarine with an electric mixer on medium speed until fluffy. Add half of the flour all the eggs milk baking powder baking soda vanilla and salt; beat about 2 minutes or until well blended. Beat in the remaining flour on low speed until well mixed. Spread evenly in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased and floured baking pan. Spoon preserves in 8 to 10 dollops on top of batter. With a knife swirl preserves into batter to form a marbled effect. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool slightly on a wire rack. Sift powdered sugar atop. Cut into squares; serve warm.

title: Homemade Tomato Catsup
instructions: Crush tomatoes through colander. Combine all ingredients. In a large pan cook slowly until thick. Put in jars and seal.

title: Salad Dressing(Potato Salad)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook until thick. Cool. When mixture is cool add 4 or 5 heaping tablespoonfuls salad dressing. Mix well. Add cooked potatoes and mix.

title: Date Cake
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Homestyle Chicken 'N Biscuits
instructions: Spray an 8 x 12-inch pan. Spread Tater Tots potatoes in bottom of baking dish. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine chicken 1 cup cheese soup and milk. Pour into baking dish. Bake covered for 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile combine in bowl biscuit mix 2/3 cup milk and 1/2 of fried onions to form stiff dough. Spoon biscuit dough in 6 mounds around edges of dish. Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Top biscuits with remaining cheese and onions; bake 1 to 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pat'S Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients; pour in graham cracker crust. Put in refrigerator. Delicious.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Sift flour soda salt cocoa and sugar into ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan. Spread around. Make 3 wells in the mixture. In one put the oleo another the vinegar and another the vanilla. Pour 1 cup cold water over all and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Cool and frost in pan. Use any kind of icing.

title: Orange Congeal Salad
instructions: Mix orange jello and boiling water together well then cool. Mix in cream cheese and mayonnaise. Cool 5 more minutes then add Cool Whip crushed pineapple and pecans. Let jell 3 hours in the refrigerator.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Heat soup; add gelatine to cold water and then to soup. Remove from heat. Cream the cheese; add mayonnaise. Add grated onion soup and crab last. Chill in mold. Serve with wheat thins.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Spoon into prepare pie crust. Cover with top crust. Crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust and brush with egg if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

title: No Bake Fruitcake
instructions: Place milk in saucepan along with marshmallows and melt over low heat. Mix remaining ingredients together. Put marshmallow mixture and remaining ingredients together. Press into a greased pan.

title: Mary'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together the margarine Crisco and sugar. Add baking powder vanilla and eggs one at a time. Add milk and flour alternately beating well each time. Batter is very thick like whipped cream. Grease and flour a large tube pan. Place in cold oven and turn heat to 350\u00b0. Bake 1 1/2 hours. Do not open oven during cooking time.

title: Creamed Beef On Toast
instructions: Braise meat; sprinkle with flour. Stir until mixed well. Have milk coming to a simmer in saucepan; do not boil. When milk comes to simmer remove then pour slowly over meat and flour. Stir. Add water to get correct thickness. Add salt and pepper to your taste. Serve on toast.

title: Easy Green Onion-Potato Soup(For A Light Supper, Serve With Crusty Bread And A Green Salad.)
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium heat saute onions and garlic in oil stirring occasionally for 5 minutes or until onions are wilted. Add broth; bring to rolling boil. Remove from heat; stir in milk potatoes and carrot. Cook until just thoroughly heated. Season with pepper sprinkle with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Graham Streusel Coffee Cake
instructions: For streusel\tin a medium mixing bowl combine graham cracker crumbs chopped nuts brown sugar and cinnamon. Stir in melted margarine or butter. Set aside.

title: Baked Herbed Potatoes
instructions: Mix Parmesan cheese basil and pepper. Halve potatoes lengthwise. Brush cut surfaces with lemon-butter mixture then dip into cheese mixture. Place coated side down in a spoke pattern on a glass pie plate. Microwave on High at 14 to 16 minutes rotating dish one-half turn once until potatoes are tender and edges lightly browned. Hold plate up to check. Let stand 2 minutes. Makes 4 side dish servings. Per serving 109 calories.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place chicken and place in 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Sprinkle rice over chicken. In a bowl mix together soups and water. Pour over chicken and rice. Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over top. Cover tight with foil. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Yummy Coconut Cake
instructions: Make cake mix according to directions in a 13 x 9-inch pan. When it has cooled boil milk sugar and 1/2 cup coconut for 2 minutes continually stirring. When this mixture has cooled poke holes in cake and spoon mixture over top of cake. Put Cool Whip on top of the cake and sprinkle remaining coconut on top of the Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Banana Pudding Pie
instructions: *Or use sugar-free reduced calorie pie filling.

title: Stuffed Tortillas
instructions: Let cheese soften. Mix olives and green chilies with cheese. Spread on flour tortillas. Roll up and chill several hours. Cut in desired size slices. Serve with picante sauce.

title: Festive Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 7-Up well. Let stand about an hour. Add 7-Up. Stir and serve. Orange or lemon sherbet can be added by tablespoonfuls as desired.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Boil bell pepper hot pepper vinegar and sugar to high boil. Add Certo and boil 1 minute (a rolling boil that cannot be stirred down). Strain. Add red or green food coloring to color desired. Makes 6 half pints.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix the flour salt and baking soda. In another bowl mix margarine and peanut butter. Add both kinds of sugar; mix well. Add eggs and beat well. Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mixture. Drop dough mixture from a teaspoon on baking pan. Flatten with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until light brown.

title: White Potato Pie
instructions: Add sugar to potatoes and butter. Beat egg yolks a little add milk and lemon. Mix well. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into potatoes. Pour into pie crust and bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Then bake at 350\u00b0 until center is set. (Knife blade comes out clean.) Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Crush crackers; press most of them into shallow pan. Mix powdered sugar butter and eggs together and beat well. Pour mixture over crumbs. Spread on crushed pineapple. Add nuts to whipped cream and spread over pineapple. Spread remaining cracker crumbs over top. Chill for several hours. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pretzels
instructions: Mix in large bowl the dill weed Mrs. Dash Ranch dressing and butter oil. Add pretzels. Stir for 20 minutes. Let set for 10 minutes. Transfer to another bowl or bag. Leave open for 1 hour then seal.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour half the batter into hot greased pan. Add cheese. Pour remaining batter over cheese. Bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chow Mein Chop Suey
instructions: Boil Samin with 2 tablespoons of bacon drippings until done. Rinse in cold water and drain. Samin should be separated and set aside. Brown strips of pork steaks including bones (for flavor). Add carrots and water covering carrots cooking about 15 minutes on medium heat then add string beans and mushrooms. Cook another 15 minutes then add onions last about 10 minutes. Add more water to cover vegetables and simmer about 10 minutes. Mix shoyu and cornstarch to make gravy (slightly thick); set aside on low heat. Saute Samin in sesame seed or olive oil until lightly browned. Spread Samin on platter and pour chop suey over.

title: Apple Fruit Bread
instructions: In a bowl combine the flour sugar baking soda nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Combine egg apple juice raisins walnuts and cherries. Bake in a greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients except the flour and vanilla in a saucepan and stir until boiling point. Save some of the milk for thickening. Add flour to the rest and boil 1 minute. Add vanilla in before you put it in the pie shell.

title: Impossible Green Bean Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. If using fresh green beans cook in boiling salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) uncovered for 5 minutes. Then cover and cook 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Mix beans mushrooms onion garlic and cheese in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand mixer). Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook packages of Lipton rice and sauce according to directions. Mix in chicken and broccoli; pour in pan. Cover with cheese; bake until cheese melts at 350\u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Heavenly Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake in 2 round pans. Divide cake in half. Place 1 piece in the bottom of a punch bowl. Put half of the pudding on top of the cake. Put half the Cool Whip on top of the pudding then put half of the Heath bars on top of the Cool Whip. Repeat.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix butter sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting. Stir flour and salt together; blend in. Mix in nuts. Chill dough. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Roll dough in 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet. (Cookies do not spread.) Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not brown. While still warm roll in powdered sugar. Cool; roll in sugar again. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Place undrained tomatoes chili peppers coriander seed and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a blender. Cover; blend until mixture is smooth. Add sour cream. Cover and blend just until combined; set aside. Combine chicken cream cheese onion and 3/4 teaspoon salt; set aside. In a skillet heat oil. Dip tortillas one at a time into hot oil for 10 seconds or until just limp. Drain on paper toweling. Spoon chicken mixture on tortillas; roll up. Place seam side down in a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour tomato mixture atop. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Remove foil; sprinkle with shredded cheese. Return to oven; heat until cheese melts. Makes 6 servings.

title: Yummy Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift together sugar flour soda and salt. In a saucepan combine butter cocoa and water. Stirring constantly bring to a rolling boil over medium heat. Add to dry ingredients mixing well. Stir in buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Pour into a greased 15 x 10-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Tacos
instructions: In heavy skillet cook until well done the meat chopped onions salt garlic powder and cumin stirring often so meat will not be lumpy. Drain off grease and put 2 tablespoons of the meat into the taco shell then add other ingredients in order as listed putting picante sauce on last. Makes 9 tacos.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
instructions: In saucepan cook bacon until crisp. Set bacon aside. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons drippings from saucepan. Add onion; brown. Add potatoes and water. Cook covered about 15 minutes or until potatoes are done. Blend in chicken soup milk and salt. Heat but do not boil. To serve garnish with crisp bacon sliced or crumbled and parsley flakes. Serves 4.

title: Lazy Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Butter a 2 or 3-quart casserole. Spread half of the cabbage in bottom of casserole. Saute onion in small amount of fat until soft but not brown. Add meat and cook until browned lightly. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix in the rice. Mix well. Spread meat mixture over cabbage. Top with remaining cabbage. Top with soup. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Cucumbers
instructions: Combine the cucumbers and onion. Stir together the sour cream vinegar sugar and salt; toss with vegetables. Cover and chill stirring occasionally. Makes 3 to 4 cups.

title: Mexican Pinwheels
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot fairly dry with paper towels. Sprinkle equal amounts of vegetables on top of cream cheese mixture. Roll tortillas tightly. Chill at least 2 hours. Cut rolls into 1/4-inch pieces. Discard ends. Serve with spirals facing up and with extra salsa if desired.

title: Sloppy Joes(8 To 12 Sandwiches)
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain grease. Add other ingredients and simmer for 1 hour or longer stirring occasionally. A crock-pot is ideal. Serve in warm toasted hamburger buns with pickles.

title: Smoked Game Recipe
instructions: The game soaks in the refrigerator 6 to 8 hours. Then smoke as directed.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directed on box. Grate the chocolate into batter; mix gently. Grease and flour 10-inch Bundt pan. Place 4 cups of batter into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Let cool then spread with frosting.

title: Chocolate Rocky Road Pie
instructions: Combine pudding mix and milk in 4-cup glass measure. Cook at Medium for 6 to 8 minutes or until pudding is thickened; stir until smooth. Cool 5 minutes. Fold in marshmallows and nuts. Turn into prepared crust; chill until firm. Garnish if desired with toasted coconut or chopped nuts.

title: Eileen'S Pot Roast
instructions: Place brisket in roasting pan and sprinkle with granulated garlic. Using next 3 ingredients place them in a small bowl and add water to dissolve them and make a solution. Pour this solution over the brisket placing some in the pan. Add your soy sauce by pouring over meat and into pot. Add carrots celery and potatoes (if wanted). Add water to top of roast.

title: Pineapple Cuts
instructions: Mix shortening salt and flour together like for pie crust. Add milk and roll into ball. Divide in half. Roll out half of dough to make pastry bottom. Put in medium size cookie sheet like bottom of pie crust.

title: Blackberry Butter
instructions: In food processor process the butter and berries to a smooth puree. The butter will be a deep pink color. Spoon butter into cute serving dish and refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Serve with a small butter spreader to accompany scones or homemade rolls.

title: Sheri'S No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Let butter stand until soft. Mix softened butter and sugar well. Add water cocoa vanilla and oatmeal. Mix well. Take about 1 tablespoon of mix and roll into a ball. Roll each ball in the powdered sugar.

title: Spinach Rolls
instructions: Saute spinach briefly in butter. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Cool in a large bowl of cold water; set aside. Saute onion and red pepper with 3 tablespoons butter until tender (about 5 minutes). Combine spinach onions red pepper 1 1/2 cups shredded Mozzarella Ricotta cheese 1/2 cup Parmesan and egg; set aside. Melt 1/4 cup butter in saucepan. Stir in flour. Add pepper and salt. Stir in milk and cream and remaining Parmesan. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil and stir until thick. Remove noodles from water. Pat dry with paper towels. Spread about 1/2 cup spinach mixture over each noodle. Roll up jelly roll fashion starting at short end. Spread a small amount of sauce on bottom of buttered 2-quart rectangular baking dish. Place rolls in dish. Spoon remaining sauce over rolls. Sprinkle with remaining shredded Mozzarella. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix together the cake mix instant pudding eggs sour cream and oil. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spoon half the mixture into pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and half bag of chocolate chips. Add the rest of the mixture spreading evenly. Sprinkle top with remaining sugar cinnamon and chocolate chips. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Bea'S Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix sifted flour and baking powder into a large bowl. Add sugar. Pour in oil and the eggs. Mix everything together with a fork. Next add the raisins and caraway seed and mix. Now mix in the milk. Start with 1/2 cup. The trick is not to make the bread too wet. Mix it with a large fork then knead it with your hands. Add milk as needed. Bake 3/4 to 1 hour in metal pie pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Buttercream Icing(For Cakes Or Cupcakes)
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Add vanilla. Gradually add sugar beating well on medium speed. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl often. When all sugar has been mixed add milk and beat on high speed until light and fluffy. Keep icing covered with a damp cloth until ready to use. Also food coloring or cocoa can be added to make different colors or flavor.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well; add sugar flour and buttermilk beating after each addition. Add melted margarine and vanilla. Cook at 300\u00b0 until done or about 1 hour.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Sift together flour and powdered sugar. Cut in oleo until mixture clings together. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Hobo Supper
instructions: Arrange 4 large thick hamburger patties in a casserole dish. Top each patty with a thick slice of onion. Thinly slice 3 large potatoes over meat and onions. Pour large can of Veg-All over the mixture. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Low-Fat Vegetable And Cheese Omelette
instructions: Heat pan to medium temperature. Saute vegetables in oil until soft. In a bowl whip whole egg egg white and milk until fluffy. Remove vegetables from pan and begin cooking egg on low heat. After about 2 minutes add vegetables and shredded cheese. Season to taste. Cover and continue to cook until egg is firm and cheese is melted. Slip spatula under half of firm omelette and fold over. Slide out of pan onto plate.

title: Krispy Indian Corn
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat; add marshmallows. Heat until smooth and completely melted stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Add cereal; stir until well coated.

title: Veggie Treats
instructions: Place aluminum foil on the bottom of a baking pan. Unroll crescent roll dough on foil. Pinch together pre-made creases to create a solid sheet of dough. Bake according to directions until golden brown. Cool.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and slice thin. Chop onions and peppers. Combine with cucumbers and salt. Let stand 3 hours and drain. Combine vinegar sugar and spices. Add drained cucumbers. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Pack while hot into sterile jars and seal.

title: David'S Dad'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Put in blender as in order given. Blend well and refrigerate overnight. Store in refrigerator.

title: Grape Dumplings
instructions: Mix water shortening baking powder and add flour until a stiff dough is made. Roll out very thin on floured board; cut into pieces 2-inches long and 1-inch wide. Add sugar to grape juice and bring to a boil. Drop dough pieces into grape juice and cook 5 minutes at boiling heat then simmer 10 minutes with lid on pot.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Break up broccoli and cauliflower into bite-size pieces. Chop up onion and thaw peas. Add dressing.

title: Russian Borscht
instructions: In a very large pan slowly boil meat and onion in water for about an hour. Add thinly sliced beets and boil 1/2 hour. Add tomatoes carrot celery and parsley and boil 1/2 hour. Add Italian spinach and potato and salt and pepper to taste. Boil until potato is done and serve.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening. Dissolve yeast in warm water; mix with buttermilk (room temperature). Add mixture to dry ingredients and mix well. Roll out 1/4-inch thick. Cut with round biscuit cutter or juice glass. Dip in melted butter or margarine and let rise 1 hour. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until done. Makes 2 to 3 dozen.

title: Gooseberry Pie
instructions: Combine berries tapioca and sugar. Pour into pie shell. Dot with butter if desired. Cover with top pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue to bake until brown about 45 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Combine first seven ingredients mixing well. Pour into baked pie shell. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven 40 minutes.

title: Company Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in salted water until just tender. Reserve 1/2 cup liquid. Arrange carrots in shallow baking dish. Combine the reserved liquid with salad dressing onion and horseradish. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour sauce over carrots. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs; dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Spotted Dog
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small pan bring sugar and water to boil until thick (about 5 minutes). Set aside. In 8-inch square pan layer half the bread cubes syrup raisins and apples. Repeat layering. Pour on the oleo set aside. In medium bowl combine eggs milk and seasonings. Pour over layers and ingredients. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on during last 5 minutes. Allow to cool 15 minutes. Scoop into 9 serving dishes. Top with frozen yogurt. Per serving 329 calories and 9 g fat.

title: Tuna
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Turn into a small skillet or baking dish. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Asparagus Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add all but first and last 2 ingredients (asparagus almonds and chicken). Simmer until cheese melts. Place chicken in a layer in a casserole. Also layer with asparagus and sauce. Repeat all layers ending with sauce. Top with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly 30 to 45 minutes. If cold 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored. Add honey salt and milk; mix well. Serve cold. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in tightly covered container.\tMix 5 teaspoons in 1 cup boiling water.

title: Potica Strudel
instructions: Dissolve yeast in about 4 tablespoons warm water and 1 teaspoon sugar. Mix all of the other ingredients in a large bowl. Add yeast mixture; mix then place on board. Add a little flour and knead your dough until smooth. Divide dough into 3 equal balls. Roll each one out and fill with your favorite filling nut raisin apple or cherry. Roll up slowly with cloth. Place on cookie sheet. Let rise in warm place for about 1 hour. Melt butter and paint on top of Potica Strudel. Bake in a moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes and then at 350\u00b0 for an additional hour.

title: Cafe Swiss Mocha
instructions: Put all ingredients in a jar and shake to mix. To use add 1 level tablespoon to 6 ounces of boiling water.

title: Dinner In A Dish
instructions: Lightly fry the hamburg peppers onion salt and pepper. Add beaten eggs corn and tomatoes. Put in a baking dish and cover with crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: 8 Layer Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in order listed in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange croutons in single layer in bottom of dish. Sprinkle cheese and mushrooms evenly over croutons. Cook sausage in a large skillet breaking into chunks until browned about 15 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Place sausage over cheese and mushrooms. Beat eggs milk soup and mustard. Pour over sausage. Bake until set about 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Serve hot. This can be prepared ahead and refrigerated overnight.

title: Zucchini Stir-Fry
instructions: Wash and slice thin 2 cups zucchini. Chop 1 small onion fine. Melt butter in skillet on medium heat. Add vegetables and stir-fry until tender.

title: Pineapple Pimiento Salad
instructions: In medium mixing bowl combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into 8-inch square pan or into serving bowl. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serve on lettuce. If desired garnish with maraschino cherries. Serves 4.

title: Mama'S Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice tops off the tomatoes and hollow out. Leave just enough meat in tomato for the shell to hold its shape. Place in baking pan. Mix in large bowl tomatoes onions and bell peppers. Add 16 oz. can of tomatoes salt and pepper.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Remove seeds from peppers. Remove core from tomatoes. Peel onions. Chop and grind vegetables. Let drain overnight in colander. Combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients except bacon slices. Pour into dish. Top with bacon slices and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix Miracle Whip Italian dressing and Parmesan cheese together well. Cook noodles; drain. Add remaining ingredients to noodles in large bowl. Pour dressing over and toss lightly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Delight
instructions: Pour milk into small bowl. Dip cookies one at a time into milk. Layer cookies in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add a layer of Cool Whip and then cookies ending with Cool Whip. Sprinkle top with chocolate chips and nuts (optional). Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Cauliflower Cheddar Casserole
instructions: Combine soup milk and eggs. Stir in half of the cheese the bread crumbs parsley pimento onion salt and pepper. Chop cauliflower and stir into soup mixture. Turn into 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top with remaining shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake 5 more minutes.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Chop lettuce. Layer ingredients in order. Refrigerate 8 hours before serving.

title: Chrusciki Twists
instructions: Add salt to egg yolks beat until thick and lemon colored. Add sugar and flavoring. Add sour cream and flour alternately beating well after each addition. Add more flour if needed (dough should not be too moist and must and should be able to roll out easily). Roll out on floured surface until 1/8-inch thick. The cookie is more crisp with a thinner dough. Cut into strips about 3 to 4-inches long. Make a slit in the center of the strip and pull one end through it. Fry in a hot oil until slightly brown. Drain on paper. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Play Dough(Good Enough To Eat)
instructions: Mix and knead all of the ingredients. Fun to make things from it and then eat it.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Use 13 x 9 x 2 sheet pan.

title: Chicken Rotel Spaghetti
instructions: Stew chicken breasts. (Save 1 quart of broth.) Cut or tear chicken into bite size pieces. Cook onion and pepper in margarine over low heat. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth (do not drain spaghetti). Melt diced Velveeta in onion and pepper then add mixture to spaghetti. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
instructions: In large bowl combine chicken celery and onion. Mix well. Add soup salt pepper and lemon juice. Mix mayonnaise with water and add to chicken. Turn mixture into 9-inch square pan. Top with chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Apple Cake Supreme
instructions: Cream sugar and vegetable oil together well. Add eggs one at a time vanilla and sherry. Mix well. Beat in flour and in last cup add soda baking powder and salt. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes in large pan. While hot top with glaze.

title: New Orleans Muffuletta
instructions: Cut bread in half horizontally; cut off a 1/2 inch slice from cut side of the one bread half. Drain pickles and stuffed olives. Brush sides of bread with oil. Layer bottom slice of bread with salami half of pickles and olives the cheese the rest of pickles and olives and ham and lettuce. Put on top of bread. Cut. Makes 6 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil in electric skillet. Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: German Ell Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add sugar. Stir in salt milk and margarine. Gradually add flour stirring well. Add yeast mixture; stir very well.

title: Ladyfinger Cheesecake
instructions: In a bowl combine contents of crust mix packages butter and sugar. Press into bottom of an ungreased 10-inch spring form pan. Arrange ladyfingers around edge of pan.

title: Aunt Eva'S Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into 1 to 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until silver knife inserted in corn custard comes out clean.

title: Abbie'S Cookies
instructions: Cover bottom of large cookie sheet with graham crackers. Sprinkle chopped pecans on top. Bring to boil the margarine and sugar; boil for 3 minutes. Pour over crackers and nuts. Bake for 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take cookies out of pan immediately; put on wax paper sprayed with Pam. If sticking to pan put back in oven a few seconds. Cool completely; put in an airtight container.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Mix all well. Place in medium baking dish. Sprinkle 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Double Decker Fudge (Aunt Gussie'S)
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan combine sugar Marshmallow Creme milk butter and salt. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly. Heat mixture until it boils. Boil for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Divide mixture; stir until melted. Pour on top of chocolate mixture. Cool and cut into pieces.

title: Latkes
instructions: Grate onion. Peel potatoes and grate. Combine onion and potatoes; rinse and drain in a sieve. Squeeze out excess liquid. Put in a bowl and stir in egg flour salt and pepper.

title: Pecan Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into one-inch balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm and then again when cooled.

title: Pasta With Roasted Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spread veggies cut in 1/2-inch wedges in large pan. Add olive oil and toss to coat. Bake. Turn often until brown and tender about 35 minutes. Then add parsley thyme salt and pepper. Cook pasta al dente. Spoon out 1/2-cup pasta cooking water. Reserve. Drain pasta. In serving bowl toss pasta with 1/2 of the veggies reserved liquid and cheese. Spoon rest of veggies on top. Serves 4 as a main course.

title: Congealed Cranberry Salad
instructions: In large bowl dissolve Jell-O in hot water; add cranberry sauce breaking berries apart with spoon. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and stir until evenly distributed. Pour into 11 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish and refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares and serve. Can use a mold. Contains 147 calories 4 to 7 g fat.

title: Madam Pele'S Pie (Ohelo)
instructions: Blend sugar and cornstarch and add berries. Cook stirring constantly until thick and clear. Cool. Beat cream cheese until soft and smooth. Blend in sugar and salt. Add eggs; stir well. Blend in milk and vanilla and stir well. Spread berry mixture over pie shell. Pour cream cheese mixture and nuts into pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce oven to 325\u00b0 and bake 45 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Combine sugar flour and cocoa in sauce pan. Stir well. Add milk. Cook on medium heat until desired thickness. Remove from heat.\tAdd butter and vanilla. Serve over hot buttered biscuits.

title: Fresh Rhubarb Delight
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter. Add egg and milk. Pat dough into pan on bottom and sides.

title: Shrimp Saute
instructions: Saute shrimp in butter and lemon for a few minutes. Add onions mushrooms and broccoli. When broccoli is done add spices then mix cornstarch with milk or wine. Slowly add to pan stirring until it begins to bubble. Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until sauce thickens stirring occasionally. Serve over cooked pasta. Sprinkle with freshly grated cheese.

title: Best Brownies(Cake Like Brownies)
instructions: Mix until light and fluffy oleo sugar salt and eggs. Add all at once syrup and flour. Beat until smooth and add nuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes on 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Frost if desired.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Beat 3 minutes. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fiesta Dip
instructions: Cut cheese into small cubes. Mix all other ingredients. Pour into dish. Put cheese on top. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Combine cocktail orange lemon and pineapple juice. Mix sugar and water until sugar is dissolved; combine with juices. Serve in a punch bowl with ice.

title: Pancakes - Thin
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Add milk and eggs. Cook pancakes one at a time in a medium skillet using 1/2 tablespoon of butter piping hot. Pour 1/4 cup (slight) batter in skillet and tip skillet to allow thin batter to coat the skillet. When brown on one side turn and brown other side. Turn out on plate. Spread with sugar or jelly and roll up.

title: Nut Rolls
instructions: Crumble 1 1/2 cakes yeast with 2 tablespoons lukewarm water; set aside 5 minutes. Beat 4 egg whites until stiff with 1 cup sugar blended in with ground nuts for filling. Add butter 3 tablespoons sugar 3 whole eggs and sour cream then add sifted flour. Mix altogether well. Cut dough in 3 pieces roll dough out on floured table. Spread nut filling on dough; roll out then pinch sides together. Let rise 1 hour. Brush beaten egg over rolls; bake 1/2 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 3 rolls.

title: Country Green Beans
instructions: In saucepan combine all ingredients. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until beans are tender. Serves 4.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers. Mix all other ingredients in well. Shape into balls; dip in powdered sugar. Store in closed container.

title: Coffee Jello
instructions: Mix gelatin in cold coffee until dissolved. Add 1/3 cup sugar and mix with hot coffee until dissolved; add vanilla. Let set.

title: Santa'S Chocolate Martini
instructions: Spoon a thin layer of cocoa mix onto a plate. Dip the rim of a martini glass into a small plate of water. Shake glass to remove excess water. Dip the wet rim into the cocoa mix. Stand the glass upright and chill in the freezer. Combine gin and creme de cacao with ice in a small pitcher. Stir gently to chill. Strain into a prepared glass. Garnish. Serve immediately.

title: Country Chicken Camp Stew
instructions: Boil onion and chicken until chicken comes off the bones. Pick off the bones and cut up chicken. Discard bones. Add potatoes tomatoes salt and pepper. Cook until potatoes are in pieces. Add barbecue sauce and ketchup. Stir well. Let simmer for 30 minutes on medium heat.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in a greased casserole dish. Top with 6 tablespoons melted butter that has been combined with 1 roll of Ritz crackers crushed and the remaining 1/2 package of slivered almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and oil together. Blend in two sugars then the eggs. Sift flour salt soda and cream of tartar together. Stir into the creamed mixture. Add vanilla mixing well. Place small balls of dough on greased cookie sheet flattening them with the bottom of a small flat bottomed glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Layered Nachos
instructions: Mix together refried beans and taco seasoning. In large casserole dish layer each ingredients in the order given. Serve with chips (like a dip).

title: One Step Lasagna
instructions: Combine water and spaghetti sauce in bowl. Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with 1/2 cup of sauce mixture. Layer noodles on top of sauce. Spread 1/2 of the Ricotta and 1/2 of the Mozzarella over the noodles. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Repeat layers. Cover with rest of Parmesan cheese. Cover pan with heavy-duty foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Let stand on rack for 10 minutes covered.

title: Butter Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar then add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flavorings and flour using mixer until cake is ready for pan. Bake in a well-greased and floured tube pan for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Fritos Pie Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Pour off grease. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste beans chili powder and 1/4 cup onions. Simmer 15 minutes. Pour Fritos on 4 plates. Top with cheese and remaining onions. Spoon chili over. Serve with sour cream.

title: Caramel Popcorn Balls(Microwave)
instructions: Microwave popcorn according to directions. Pour into large mixing bowl. In a 1-quart dish pour 1/2 cup of caramel topping and 1 cup of marshmallow cream. Microwave on Medium for 20 seconds. Stir together well. Drizzle caramel mixture over the popcorn. Cover your hands with 2 small plastic bags. Mix the popcorn and caramel together well. Let stand 5 minutes. With bags on hands form popcorn mixture into balls pressing firmly. Drop each ball on a separate square of wax paper. Roll popcorn balls in the paper (or cellophane) and twist the ends to close. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Christmas Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles; discard liquid. Slice each pickle lengthwise into quarters. Repack pickle strips in jar adding ingredients alternately with pickles. Cover; let stand at room temperature for 1 day. Refrigerate; shake jar frequently to dissolve sugar. Jar will be about 2/3 full of liquid and pickle strips will be crisp.

title: Shrimp And Rice Salad
instructions: Boil 1 1/2 cups water with salt; add Minute rice. Let stand 5 minutes. Add all ingredients except mayonnaise. Chill for 1 hour. Add 1/2 cup mayonnaise.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken legs diced onion bouillon some garlic salt and salt. Save the broth and debone all the chicken. Discard fat.

title: Mini-Mistakes
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Combine rest of ingredients except bread; mix well into meats. Spoon onto bread. Heat at 350\u00b0 until bread gets golden brown and meat mixture is heated through.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken(4 Servings)
instructions: Cook chicken for 10 minutes in skillet with hot oil; turn. Combine soup and milk; stir in lemon juice and pepper. Pour over chicken; top each piece with lemon slice. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Chicken Catch A Man
instructions: Boil chicken for 1 hour or until done. Cook broccoli. Cut chicken and broccoli into bite size pieces. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan put 1 layer of chicken 1 layer of broccoli and 1 layer of cheese. Repeat layers. Then spread both cans of soup over all. Cover with stuffing and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour or until bubbly.

title: Chicken Almondine
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Take out and add bread crumbs or crumbled potato chips. Bake 5 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix milk and puddings until smooth. Set aside. Cream the margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar together; blend into pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer with crushed Oreos beginning and ending with Oreos.

title: Snake Nuts
instructions: Put in shaker metal is best shake with ice.

title: Drop Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar shortening oleo and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Drop batter by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Combine meat egg onion and salt. Shape into 1-inch meatballs. Combine chili sauce jelly and lemon juice. Cook over medium heat until jelly melts stirring constantly. Add meatballs to sauce and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until done.

title: Onion Cheese Custard
instructions: Scald milk and stir in cheese until melted. Beat whole eggs with seasoning and onion (more onions if desired) and add to cheese mixture. Put in casserole in a pan of water and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Mother Reeves Icebox Cookies
instructions: Divide dough into 4 portions. Place on pieces of wax paper then roll.\tChill.\tSlice and bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Chicken Firecrackers For 8
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Scoop out center of French rolls. Fill rolls with chicken mixture. Wrap in foil shaping each roll as a firecracker. Cook on coals about 20 minutes turning often.

title: Kaluha
instructions: Boil sugar and water 15 minutes. Mix coffee with 1/4 cup warm water. Mix sugar water coffee mixture and vanilla bean. Let cool. Store with vanilla bean.
