title: Homemade Biscuits
instructions: Grease bottom and sides of bread pan. Mix first 4 ingredients. Form a ball. On a floured surface roll dough and cut out biscuits. Place biscuits in the greased bread pan. Cook at 450\u00b0 until brown. Remove from oven and top with melted margarine. Serve hot.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Put the sugar milk and butter in a saucepan and bring to a rolling boil. Pour over oatmeal cocoa coconut and nuts which have been mixed together. Stir in vanilla. Drop on waxed paper by teaspoonfuls.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks milk and flour. Add other ingredients. Fold in egg whites (beaten well). Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Barbecued Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Combine onion celery and green pepper in a 3-quart casserole. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High 2 minutes. Add rice soup mix tomatoes salt and pepper; stir well. Spread evenly in casserole with onion mixture. Sprinkle each pork chop with barbecue seasoning spice. Place on top of rice-tomato mixture. Cover with plastic wrap; microwave at High 5 minutes. Rotate dish 1/4 turn. Microwave at Medium 15 to 20 minutes. Let stand covered 3 to 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Meatballs Espanole
instructions: Combine beef bread crumbs onion celery Worcestershire sauce egg 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt and pepper; mix thoroughly. Form into meatballs (12). Place in greased shallow baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole
instructions: Mix first seven ingredients together. Put into well-greased casserole dish. Cover and bake for approximately 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. After baking 30 minutes stir and then return to oven and bake 30 minutes more. Brown the sausage drain and place on top. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Rice Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in a casserole dish and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Seasoned Potatoes
instructions: Wash and split potatoes. Roll skin side in melted margarine and seasoning salt. Place cut side down and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes. Do not turn over.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Press into 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Hearty Corn Chowder
instructions: Break up sausage meat and saute in kettle until crisp and crumbly. Remove meat and reserve. To fat add onion; cook about 10 minutes. Add milk potatoes and bay leaf. Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add salt pepper and corn. Just before serving add meat and heat through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Lemon Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together adding more juice as necessary.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: In heavy saucepan dissolve cornstarch in water; stir in sweetened condensed milk and egg yolks. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat; add margarine and vanilla. Cool slightly. Slice 2 bananas; dip in ReaLemon brand and drain. Arrange on bottom of prepared crust. Pour filling over bananas; cover. Chill 4 hours or until set. Spread top with whipped cream. Slice remaining banana; dip in ReaLemon brand. Drain and garnish top of pie. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Place peaches in greased baking dish. Work remaining ingredients to consistency of fine crumbs; sprinkle over peaches. Bake for 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Chop shrimp coarsely. Add all remaining ingredients except bread and mix well. Pinch out the center of bread in chunks. Reserve chunks until ready to serve.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add salts pizza sauce tomato sauce tomato paste and catsup. Combine with cooked macaroni. In large greased casserole dish put half of meat mixture in dish; sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Cover with rest of meat mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Jellied Chicken Or Tuna Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Soften gelatine in cold water in measuring cup. Put cup in pan of boiling water stirring until gelatin is dissolved. Stir into mayo. Mix well with tuna or chicken mixture. Pour into 1 1/4 qt. ring mold or individual molds. Chill for 2 hours or longer. No salad dressing is needed. Serve with lots of watercress garnish.

title: Do Nothing Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Do not drain pineapple. Pour into a sheet cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Aunt Donna'S Double Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops with salt. Lay in flat pan. Pour sauce over top. Place pineapple ring and cherry on each pork chop. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Watch to see if dry. Serve with warm applesauce.

title: Chicken Fricassee
instructions: On wax paper combine flour salt paprika and pepper; coat chicken pieces with flour mixture. In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot oil cook chicken until lightly browned on all sides. Remove to casserole dish. Saute celery carrots and onion with drippings in skillet and cook over medium heat until tender stirring occasionally. Add to casserole. Mix soup with milk and pour into casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender. Cover with foil and bake for 15 to 20 more minutes. Enjoy!

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add cream of tartar and 1/2 cup sugar. Fold in 1/2 cup sugar pecans 1/4 cup cocoa and vanilla. Pour into lightly greased pie plate. Bake 25 to 35 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool.

title: Very Easy Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Blend in bananas eggs and vanilla. Sift flour baking soda and salt together. Add to banana mixture alternately with buttermilk mixing after each addition. Add nuts and mix. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese slices. Put 1/2 of batter in greased pan. Arrange slices on top of this. Cover with remaining batter making sure all the cheese is well covered. Cook at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Apple Pecan Pancakes
instructions: In a bowl combine flour brown sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon. Stir in milk egg yolks and vanilla. Add apple and pecans. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; fold into batter. Pour batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto a hot greased griddle. Turn when bubbles begin to form and the edges are golden brown. Cook until the second side is golden brown. Makes about 12 pancakes.

title: Strawberry Soup
instructions: Mix strawberries and sour cream. Beat slowly until well mixed. Add grenadine vanilla and sugar while mixing until smooth consistency. Add half and half last mixing only until well blended. Chill and serve. Shake well before serving. Serves 6.

title: No Bake-Oatmeal Cookies(Preacher Randy'S Favorite)
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa then add milk and margarine in heavy saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to boil and cook 3 minutes stirring constantly. Start timing when boiling begins. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and vanilla. Mix until all melted then add oats. Drop onto wax paper and let cool. Enjoy.

title: Chicken With Dried Beef
instructions: Bone chicken breasts and cut in half; set aside. Arrange dried beef in shallow baking pan large enough to hold chicken in 1 layer. Wrap a strip of bacon around each breast half; arrange over beef. Saute mushrooms in butter and spread over chicken. Combine soup and sherry and mix until smooth; pour over chicken. Cover baking pan with aluminum foil and bake chicken at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Uncover; increase heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for an additional 20 to 30 minutes basting several times. Yield 3 to 4 servings.

title: Microwave Cubed Steaks With Vegetables
instructions: In 12 x 8-inch dish combine potatoes carrots and vegetable beef soup. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at High 6 to 8 minutes or until carrots begin to tenderize stirring once. Arrange meat over potatoes and carrots. Sprinkle with onion soup mix. Cover with wax paper. Microwave 5 minutes. Reduce power to 50% (Medium). Microwave 10 to 15 minutes or until meat is no longer pink rearranging once. Makes 4 servings.

title: Indian Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix oleo milk and sugar and boil 1 minute. Take off burner and add peanut butter vanilla oatmeal and cocoa. Beat until thick. Drop by tablespoons onto wax paper or buttered cookie sheet.

title: Lemon Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine; gradually add sugar beating at medium speed until well blended. Add lemon rind lemon juice and next 3 ingredients; beat well. Combine flour baking soda and cream of tartar; gradually add to creamed mixture beating well. Add oats; mix well. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets coated with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool on wire racks. Yields 40 cookies. Calories per cookie 45; fat 1 1/2 gm.

title: Tuna Roll
instructions: Mix tuna well with mixer or blender. Add remaining ingredients except nuts. Shape into a log and cover with nuts. Serve with crackers and/or celery.

title: Sunday Chicken Supper(Crock Pot - 6-8 Hours On Low)
instructions: Layer first 5 ingredients in crock pot. Heat oil in skillet and brown chicken on all sides. Transfer to slow cooker top with bacon. In a bowl combine remaining ingredients and pour over top. Do not stir. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours until vegetables are tender and chicken juices run clear. Remove chicken & veggies from pot. Thicken juices for gravy in a sauce pan if desired. Return chicken & veggies to slow cooker. Drizzle with gravy. Yield 4 servings.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Mix pineapple and marshmallows. Let stand at least 24 hours. Mix and stir several times. (I use pineapple sauce and leave marshmallow mixture on counter and stir often. This makes the mixture very smooth.)

title: Spiced Percolator Punch
instructions: Pour juice and water into an 8-cup percolator. Place remaining ingredients in percolator basket. Perk through complete cycle of electric percolator. Makes 1 quart.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet. Cook potatoes until almost tender and lightly browned. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour milk over all. Boil gently until milk is absorbed. Sprinkle with cheese and allow to melt. Stir. Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until brown and bubbly. Makes 8 servings.

title: Apple-Sausage Pancakes
instructions: Heat griddle over medium heat or heat electric griddle to 375\u00b0. Heat the sausages in skillet as directed on package. Heat the pie filling in saucepan over low heat. Keep the sausages and pie filling warm over very low heat while you prepare pancakes. Grease the hot griddle with shortening if necessary using pastry brush. Prepare pancakes as directed for thinner pancakes on baking mix package except after mixing for each pancake pour 1/4 cup batter in an oval shape (about 5-inches long and 3-inches wide) onto the hot griddle. Continue as directed on package. Spread each pancake with butter and wrap it around a hot sausage. Place folded side down on plate and top with a spoonful of apples.

title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken wings. Pour over the chicken wings. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix all listed ingredients together. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pioneer Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes and put them in kettle. Add 1 teaspoon salt. Cover with water and simmer. After 15 minutes begin testing with fork. When potatoes are soft and flaky remove from heat drain and peel.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook and mash squash; add soup sour cream grated carrot onion salt and pepper. Butter casserole dish. Cover bottom with crumbs. Add squash mixture. Cover with additional crumbs and dot with chunks of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Extra-Crispy Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs oil salt and vanilla. Add dry ingredients; mix until smooth. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Italian Hot Dip
instructions: Blend cream cheese and Italian seasoning. Set aside. Put cream cheese in the bottom of a 6 to 9-inch pie pan. Push cream cheese down to form crust look. Add 1/2 of the Mozzarella cheese then spaghetti sauce. Top with remaining Mozzarella and chopped peppers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with breadsticks to dip.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple. Add jello. Cool. Add buttermilk pecans and Cool Whip. Use 9 x 13-inch dish. Chill until set.

title: Caesar Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender. Sprinkle salad with Parmesan cheese and lemon juice.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Add vinegar and sugar to celery onion and carrots. Stir well. Add peas last. Mix together with Kraft mayonnaise.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies(Makes About 5 Dozen)
instructions: Thoroughly cream oil sugars eggs and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter. Sift dry ingredients and stir into mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with back of fork to make crisscross. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 between 5 and 10 minutes depending on your oven.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Bring to a simmer for approximately 20 minutes. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Surprise Apple Pie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Put in pie pan. Mix flour sugar nuts melted margarine and eggs. Spread over apples. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Elegant Steak And Rice
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips. In a large skillet (ovenproof if desired) brown meat in oil using high heat. Add onions. Saute until tender-crisp. Blend soup water liquid from mushrooms and garlic salt. Pour over steak. Add mushrooms. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 1 hour or until steak is tender (or cover and bake at 350\u00b0). Serve over beds of fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Strawberry-Kiwi-Tea-Sprite Punch
instructions: Put tea in bags in Sprite bottle. Return lid and set some place out of the way for 2 days. Do not shake Sprite.

title: Easy Cut Out Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugar with fork. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Stir with fork. If dough becomes too stiff dust hands and mix with hands. Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours to chill then roll out cut out and bake at 350\u00b0 for 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pat out in a 9-inch pie pan.

title: Jim And Ed'S Creme De Menthe Brownies
instructions: Mix thoroughly first 6 ingredients. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 13 x 9-inch pan. Test for doneness with toothpick. (Toothpick must be withdrawn clean and dry.) Cool completely.

title: Paul'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground chuck. Add onions and green peppers while browning. In large pan combine remaining ingredients and start to cook over low heat. When meat is brown add to pan mixture and cook over medium heat about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Five Flavor Cake
instructions: Cream margarine shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat eggs; add to mixture. Mix baking powder and flour together. Add dry mixture alternately with milk. Stir in flavorings. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine. Add mushroom soup mushroom pieces and cheese cut into small chunks. Separate cook and drain broccoli; add to mixture. Serve with crackers or potato chips. May be kept warm in crock-pot fondue pot or oven.

title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
instructions: Butter 13 x 9-inch pan. Line with graham crackers. Mix 1 (6 ounce) French vanilla pudding instant pudding mix with 3 cups milk. Fold in 9 ounces Cool Whip. Pour over graham crackers in 2 layers ending with crackers on top. Frost with 1 cup sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/3 cup cocoa and 1/4 cup milk. Cook 1 minute. Add 1/4 cup butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Spread over pudding mixture.

title: Pasta Shells
instructions: Brown meat and drain; add Prego. Simmer. Cook shells; while boiling prepare stuffing.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine hot water and oatmeal. Let stand 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Beat until well blended then add oatmeal. Mix again. Pour into 9 x 13-inch loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Green Soup
instructions: Mix well sugar and mayonnaise in small bowl. In a large bowl add gelatin and hot water; stir. Add sugar/mayonnaise mixture crushed pineapple cottage cheese (curd size your choice) evaporated milk and walnuts. Mix refrigerate and serve.

title: Canned Okra To Fry
instructions: Put okra vinegar and salt into large pan. Put just enough water to cover okra. Bring to a boil. Boil for 6 minutes covered. Pack into sterilized jars and seal. You dont need to process.

title: Ice Cream Blizzard
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Add crushed Oreos or Butterfingers or M&Ms or Reeses Pieces etc. Whatever type blizzard you want. Freeze in regular ice cream freezer. Enjoy!

title: Richard'S Chicken Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and pour into a greased casserole. Mix other ingredients and pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Blend butter and sugar. Mix dry ingredients; add half to the batter. Blend. Add zucchini then other half of the dry ingredients and vanilla. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes (1 loaf) or 25 to 35 minutes (2 loaves).

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all the vegetables in a large bowl and set aside. Make celery seed dressing from the remaining ingredients; stir to dissolve. Pour dressing over vegetables and toss to mix. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Serve on salad greens.

title: Martha Washington Cake
instructions: Combine in large bowl cake mix jello oil and eggs. Mix by hand. Drain pineapple. Save juice. Fold pineapple in cake mix. Pour in greased floured pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 15 minutes then 335\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove cake from oven and pour juice over top and chill for 1 hour. Spread with Cool Whip and cherry pie filling.

title: Wild Rice Salad
instructions: Prepare rice per directions on box and let cool. Combine veggies and rice. Dress with Zesty Italian salad dressing to taste.

title: Indian Squash
instructions: If you like hot food add a small green chili pepper. Stir vegetables in skillet and add a very small amount of water. Cover and steam until tender. Stir when about half done. (An electric skillet is very good for preparing this dish.)

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Beat pudding sugar and milk until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Make 1 layer of whole graham crackers (dont break). Layer the pudding next. Repeat 2 more times. Spread icing on top. Refrigerate at least 24 hours.

title: Spring Garden Dip
instructions: Blend sour cream Miracle Whip sugar salt and pepper. Stir in vegetables. Add garlic salt to taste. Chill. Makes 2 cups. Serve with vegetable dippers.

title: Hot Bacon Potato Salad
instructions: Heat 1-inch water in 3-quart saucepan. Add potatoes. Cover; heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Simmer about 25 minutes or until almost tender. Drain. Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Mix potatoes bacon onions and celery in large bowl. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over potatoes and toss thoroughly. Place into pan. Cover with foil. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes stirring once.

title: Homesteader'S Quick Bread
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt baking powder soda and oats in a bowl. Add eggs molasses and buttermilk. Mix well. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into two greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Blend together and pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Super Easy Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Arrange rolls in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon then the dry pudding mix; then with the brown sugar. Shave the margarine over rolls then sprinkle with nuts. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand overnight.

title: Fudge Krispies
instructions: Combine chocolate chips margarine and corn syrup in medium saucepan. Stir over low heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and sugar. Add Rice Krispies and mix lightly until they are well coated. Spread evenly in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and chill until firm. Cut into 1 1/2 inch squares.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well. Stir in white syrup and sugar until smooth. Add vanilla and butter. Stir in pecans whole or chopped. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes or until done.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Sift flour with salt and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Add vanilla and almond extract. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tested done. Cool 15 minutes on rack then remove from pan.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies(Canaan Elementary Favorite)
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening vanilla lemon extract and eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes on a cookie sheet.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Layer all ingredients in a large pan. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving. Makes a large amount.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar well. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each one. Combine salt and baking powder with flour; sift. Add to shortening alternately with milk. Add coconut and coconut flavor. Bake in tube or Bundt pan 1 hour and 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool 15 minutes in pan then turn out on plate. Glaze with powdered sugar-water glaze. Drizzle on cake. Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Catfish Gumbo
instructions: In an 8-inch cast-iron skillet brown chopped onion. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes. Add all other ingredients except catfish and cook approximately 5 more minutes reducing liquid by half. Reduce heat to simmer and add catfish. Cook for 8 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into a buttered Pyrex baking dish.

title: Creamy Chicken Spread
instructions: In a small mixing bowl combine first 7 ingredients; mix well. Stir in chicken eggs and green onions. Shape into an 8-inch x 2-inch log. Garnish with pimentos and onions. Cover and chill. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving. Serve with crackers and snack bread. Makes 3 cups.

title: Babe'S Chili
instructions: Saute meat until brown; drain off fat and add all vegetables except kidney beans. During last 20 minutes add beans.

title: Baked Potato Spears
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise into thick slices. Cut slices into strips. Brush with dressing.

title: Salmon Heloise
instructions: Pour salmon juice into a glass and set it aside. Add one egg to the salmon and enough flour to make it thick. Take a fork and mix it all up. Do not add any salt. Measure 1/4 cup of the salmon juice and add to it one heaping teaspoon of baking powder. Mix with fork. Quickly dump this into the thick salmon mixture and stir with fork.

title: Mushroom Polonaise
instructions: Put in loaf pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Quick Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw and drain broccoli. Add rice milk and cheese and mix well. Pour into casserole dish and cover generously with bread crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings and may be frozen.

title: Zabaglione Parfaits
instructions: Early in day or up to 1 week ahead in double boiler over hot (not boiling) water with portable mixer at high speed or hand beater beat egg yolks and sugar until very thick about 5 minutes. Add Marsala and continue beating until mixture is fluffy and mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon. Cover and refrigerate until mixture is slightly cooled about 30 minutes.

title: Refried Beans
instructions: Wash and drain beans. Soak overnight. Drain and rinse. Add salt and lard. Cook slowly with water to cover beans on medium heat until tender. Add water if needed. When tender drain and save liquid. Mash the beans. If beans are too dry when mashing add some reserved liquid.

title: Quick And Easy Seafood Salad
instructions: Mix together well. Add more seasonings and mayonnaise if desired.

title: Party Cheese Ball(Yield: 5-Inch Ball)
instructions: Combine cheeses mayonnaise sherry Worcestershire sauce and all salts. Blend until smooth. Add olives. Cover and chill until firm. Shape cheese mixture into ball. Combine parsley and pecans and roll ball into mixture. Cover and chill.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix as you would for any cookie recipe. Drop by large tablespoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chili Tamale Soup
instructions: Brown meat; drain grease. Add rest of ingredients and 1 cup water. Simmer until thickened. Serve with crushed Fritos or any corn chips on top.

title: Saltine Cookies
instructions: Line cookie sheet with single layer of saltines. Melt margarine and sugar and pour over saltines. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and put chocolate bits on top. When melted spread evenly and add chopped nuts.

title: Beef Ole
instructions: Brown beef; add chili powder. Combine all ingredients and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until sauce thickens. Serve over a bed of Fritos on a dinner plate.

title: Fudgsicles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into freezing containers such as ice cube trays. Partially freeze only enough to stick toothpicks in each individual compartment. Return to freezer until frozen.

title: Sausage-Mushroom Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spread croutons in a\tlightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside. Cook sausage until browned stirring to crumble; drain well. Sprinkle sausage over croutons. Combine eggs milk soup mushrooms and mustard; mix well and pour over sausage. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight.

title: Mary Knowles' No Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients over low heat in a 3-quart saucepan until marshmallows melt. Stir in dates raisins walnuts mixed fruit and cherries. Stir until well blended the mixture of cracker crumbs cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Press into a pan lined with wax paper. Let cool for 2 days. Cover tightly.

title: Crayfish Bisque
instructions: Brown roux until very dark brown. Add all other ingredients and 2 quarts of water. Let come to a boil and simmer slow for 40 minutes then drop in a few slices of lemon.

title: Remarkable Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk; cook over medium heat. Bring to boil. Cook exactly 5 minutes (no longer). Remove from heat. Add chocolate chips. Stir until melted then add marshmallow cream and vanilla. Immediately pour into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Roll in small balls place on greased cookie sheet and flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Irish Cream
instructions: Beat eggs etc. in blender adding cream last. Refrigerate and when cold enjoy.

title: Old-Fashioned Raisin Squares
instructions: Empty box of raisins into a pot. Add water until raisins are covered. Stir in sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Bring to a boil and simmer until raisins are large and soft. Stir in 2 to 3 tablespoons flour depending on how much water remains in the raisins. Set filling aside to cool.

title: Peanut Butter Shortbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. In a bowl mix all ingredients with fingers until mixture resembles coarse meal. Press mixture into ungreased 8-inch round pan. Use fork to prick decorative wedges in the dough. Bake 1 hour or until brown. Cut into wedges while still hot. Makes 16 wedge-shaped cookies.

title: Salsa Sauce
instructions: Simmer for 1/2 hour.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Stir in butter beaten eggs and Parmesan cheese. Form spaghetti mixture into a crust in greased 10-inch pie plate. Spread with cottage cheese. Cook ground beef and onion until done. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Pour meat mixture into spaghetti crust. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Barbecue Beef Brisket
instructions: Line a flat ovenproof casserole with heavy-duty aluminum foil. Place the brisket in the casserole. Sprinkle generously with garlic powder pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Cover with sliced onions. Cover with additional foil and seal edges. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour per pound of meat. Remove top foil and drain off fat. Sprinkle meat and onions with brown sugar. Blend the catsup with the hot water and pour over meat and onions. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for another 40 minutes. Slice thinly across the grain to serve.

title: Fruitcake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks then dry ingredients alternately with liquids. Add lemon extract then fold in egg whites. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Frozen Peppermint Cheesecake
instructions: Combine first three ingredients and firmly press into a 9-inch pie plate and chill. Beat cream cheese at high speed with electric mixer until firm. Add condensed milk mint candy and food coloring; beat well. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into prepared pan. Cover and freeze until firm. Garnish if desired. Yields one 9-inch pie.

title: Ham Delights
instructions: Blend oleo poppy seed Worcestershire sauce mustard and onion together. Split party rolls. Spread top and bottom with mix. Chop very small the ham and cheese. Spread ham and cheese on rolls. Cut into small squares. Wrap in foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Dirt
instructions: Chop and crush Oreos. Cream margarine sugar and cream cheese. In another bowl make pudding with milk and vanilla pudding mix. Fold in Cool Whip. Then fold in cream cheese mixture. Layer in glass bowl crumbs filling crumbs filling and crumbs. You can decorate the top with artificial flowers to make it look like a plant. I sometimes put the bowl in a basket and it really looks real.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa milk and butter in a skillet and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and add peanut butter and Quaker oats. Mix well and quickly spoon onto wax paper. When cool store in refrigerator to keep chocolate from turning white.

title: No Frost Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Add soda to dates. Pour hot water over them. Cream butter and sugar and add dates eggs flour salt cocoa and vanilla. Beat well. Add 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Pour in a greased floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the rest of the chocolate chips and all of the nuts over the top and bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Chicken With Walnuts
instructions: Cut chicken into 1/2-inch cubes and mix with unbeaten egg white and 1 tablespoon cornstarch.

title: Baked Shrimp
instructions: Put in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Add all other ingredients except sour cream. Pour 1/2 Jell-O mixture in dish and congeal. (Do not put other 1/2 in refrigerator.) After congealed spread sour cream on top and pour other 1/2 Jell-O mixture on top and congeal.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Thaw frozen broccoli by placing under running water for a few minutes. Squeeze out excess water. Grate cheese and place in microwavable bowl. Add broccoli and cream of mushroom soup. Mix well.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Saute squash and onion until tender; drain well. Add soup and sour cream. Melt margarine; stir in stuffing mix. Spread half the stuffing mix in greased casserole dish. Pour in squash mixture; cover with remaining stuffing mix. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Delicious Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: While browning pie crust; mix sugar cornstarch salt egg yolks and milk and cook filling until thick. Add vanilla butter and coconut and cook filling until butter is melted. Pour into baked pie crust.

title: Strawberry Trifle
instructions: In a large bowl cream together cream cheese and confectioners sugar; add sour cream and vanilla; set aside. In a small bowl whip the cream vanilla and sugar; fold whipped cream into cheese mixture. Add cake pieces; set aside. Combine strawberries sugar and almond extract or liqueur. Layer together in large glass bowl starting with strawberries then adding cake mixture. Continue layering finish with strawberries. Cover with plastic wrap; chill well. Yields 24 servings.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: In large bowl cut butter into dry cake mix; set aside 1 cup. Press remaining mixture into 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Spoon pie filling over cake mixture. In small bowl combine reserved cake mixture and coconut. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly before cutting into 3 x 1 1/2-inch bars.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain off grease. Put ground beef in casserole dish. Chop onion and layer on top of meat. Spread soups over onions. Add frozen Tater Tots to top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Brown the ground beef. Add taco seasoning mix (as package directions indicate) and let simmer for a short time. Press crescent rolls on bottom and up the sides of a 10-inch pie pan. (Or use a small glass lasagna pan or cake pan.) Sprinkle with 1 cup crushed chips. Spoon meat mixture over the rolls. Spread sour cream next. (If you used a larger pan increase the amount of sour cream.) Layer chopped onion tomato and lettuce. Cover with cheese. Top with 1 cup crushed chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Taco-Tex Mix Dip
instructions: Mash avocados with a fork and add lemon juice salt and pepper. In a separate bowl mix sour cream mayonnaise and taco mix. On a pie plate or other deep dish plate arrange as single layers in the following order bean dip sour cream mixture avocado mixture cheese tomatoes and olives. Serve as a dip with plain tortilla chips.

title: Lemon Chiffon Salad
instructions: In large bowl dissolve Jell-O with the boiling water then add combined pineapple/cold water. Stir well. Put in refrigerator to set to a syrup stage (to speed this up you can put in freezer for about 1 hour). When Jell-O has reached this stage beat well with electric mixer. In separate bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually add enough of the Jell-O until cream cheese is runny. Add to remaining Jell-O along with the Cool Whip. Beat until fluffy and airy (this stage is important). Then beat in pineapple and fold in walnuts. Pour into either large mold or a dish. Refrigerate to set.

title: Pepperoni Pinwheels
instructions: Separate dough into 4 rectangles. Firmly press perforations to seal. Place 8 pepperoni slices on each rectangle. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of cheese. Start at shortest side. Tightly roll up and pinch to seal. Slice each rectangle to 4 equal slices. Place sealed side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with warm sauce if desired. Makes 16.

title: Baked Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onions 1/4-inch thick. Separate into rings and soak in cold salted water about 30 minutes. Drain and dry on paper towels. Melt butter or margarine and combine with crumbs and seasonings. Mix egg with cold water and beat well. Dip onion rings in prepared crumbs in egg and again in crumbs. Arrange on greased baking dish and dot with a little extra butter. Cover and bake in hot oven 10 minutes. Uncover and bake about 20 minutes until crisp and brown. Serve immediately.

title: Zucchini Soup And Dill
instructions: Steam zucchini 10 minutes. Saute onion and garlic in oil until tender. Remove zucchini from heat; refresh it under cold water. Set aside 12 rounds of zucchini; puree the rest along with the onion and garlic in a food processor or food mill using some of the stock to moisten. Pour into soup pot along with stock and stir together. Reheat over medium heat and stir in dill and lemon juice. Season to taste. Garnish each bowl with a dollop of yogurt and 3 rounds of zucchini.

title: Terriaki Chicken
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together well. Pour over wings and set overnight in refrigerator turning often. When ready to cook place in baking dish and bake in 350 degree oven for about 1 hour or until done. Pour off marinade and let dry 15-20 minutes.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese brown sugar nuts and vanilla together. Spread mixture on serving plate surrounded by apples.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat shortening sugar and eggs. Add mixed flour baking powder soda and salt. Add mashed bananas. Add chopped nuts if desired. Bake in a well-greased loaf pan 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Pizza Appetizer
instructions: Combine apples and cinnamon in bowl. Spoon apples evenly over pizza shell. Drizzle with margarine. Sprinkle with raisins nuts and cheese. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Serve warm or cold.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix together the sugar vinegar salt and celery salt. Heat to dissolve sugar and salt. Cool and pour over sliced vegetables. Refrigerate 4 or 5 days then freeze.

title: Canned Beets
instructions: Cook beets until tender. Peel and cut up. Boil 4 cups of water (use same water that beets were cooked in). Combine sugar and vinegar. Bring to boiling point. Add beets and cook until hot. Fill jars with beets add juice and 1/2 teaspoon of salt then seal.

title: Decadent Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Line a 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan with vanilla wafers. Melt 4 Milky Ways and 2 tablespoons milk over hot water. Stir until smooth. Cool.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy adding sugar 1 teaspoon at a time. Beat until very stiff. Add vanilla and food color (if desired). Fold in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet that has been lined with foil. Put in preheated 300\u00b0 oven and turn oven off. Leave in oven until cool or overnight.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Cover bread crumbs with milk for 5 minutes. Add sugar eggs butter salt and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into a buttered pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Cream Fillings
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt and 1/4 cup milk on top of double boiler. Scald remaining milk and add to mixture. Cook over hot water until thick. Beat the egg yolks slightly and add a little of hot mixture. Stir egg mixture into cream filling. Cook 2 minutes longer. Add butter and vanilla. Spread 3/4 cup coconut in bottom of baked pie shell. Pour cream filling over it. Cover with meringue and sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup coconut over its top before browning. Can use microwave until thick stirring frequently.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tortilla Pie
instructions: In a large skillet cook beef onions and green peppers until beef is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain off excess fat. Stir in cumin jalapeno peppers garlic salt salt and pepper. Stir in chopped tomatoes with liquid chopped olives and raisins. Sprinkle flour over mixture; stir until blended. Heat to boiling stirring constantly; boil one minute.

title: German Meat Balls
instructions: Combine beef bread half onion 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper. Mold into balls. In Dutch oven combine remaining onion sugar raisins kraut gingersnaps and tomato sauce. Add meat balls; simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling salt water until tender; drain thoroughly. In large skillet saute onion in 5 tablespoons margarine until tender. Add soup and mix well. Add cheese. Heat and stir until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in cabbage salt and pepper. Transfer to an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.

title: Concord Grape Pie
instructions: Squeeze pulp from skins of grapes until you have enough to make 1 1/2 cups pulp. Save skins. Put pulp in pan over a slow heat until seeds begin to separate from pulp. Strain through a sieve. Add skins to the strained pulp. Add sugar and flour. Mix together. Bake between 2 crusts for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Blend thoroughly and pour over ribs 20 minutes before they are done.

title: Macaroni & Cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pour into greased baking dish. Cook at 300\u00b0 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into dish.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Bake as a drop cookie.

title: Apple Dip
instructions: Mix together and eat! Very good with sliced apples or fruit. For color add 1 dry pkg. of kool-aid.

title: Solvang Cabbage
instructions: Simmer ingredients together about 2 1/2 hours.

title: Curly-Noodle Dinner
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet brown ground beef; drain off fat. Stir in pork seasoning from noodles stewed tomatoes and corn. Break up noodles; stir into beef mixture. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until noodles are tender.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Boil all ingredients together.

title: Tortellini And Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach and drain well. Boil tortellini until they rise to top of pot of water. In a medium saucepan melt butter and add Milnot; stir. Gradually add the shredded Monterey Jack cheese. Sauce will be thin. Mix the spinach into the sauce then add tortellini and put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 until Mozzarella begins to turn brown and bubbly. (Can make night before).

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Sort and wash beans; place in a Dutch oven. Add ham bone and water; bring to a boil and boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 1 hour. Return mixture to a boil cover reduce heat and simmer 3 hours. Remove ham bone; remove and discard fat and bone. Shred meat and return to bean mixture. Stir in onion and next 11 ingredients. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Remove 1/2 cup beans; mash beans and return to Dutch oven stirring well. Serve beans over rice. Top each serving with green onions. Yield 10 cups.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Line a large casserole dish with 1 package of flour tortillas. Pour meat mixture over and sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Wild Apple Snow
instructions: Sprinkle sugar over apples. Add egg whites and beat with electric beater until light and frothy. Pour into freezer tray and freeze. Serve in dessert dishes topped with warm vanilla pudding.

title: Creamy Lemon Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar salt and flour. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens. Add yolks; cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon juice and rind butter and vanilla. Pour in pie shell. Make meringue; spread on pie. Bake for 10 minutes in 450\u00b0 oven. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes; cool.

title: Easy Cherry Pie
instructions: Mix together cherry pie filling and pineapple. Spread to cover bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle cake mix. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Chocolate-Covered Cherry Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl stir together the first 5 ingredients. In mixer bowl beat together margarine and sugar on low speed of mixer until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture; beat until well blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down center of dough with thumb. Drain cherries reserving juice. Place a cherry in the center of each cookie. In small saucepan combine chocolate pieces and sweetened condensed milk; heat until the chocolate is melted. Stir in 4 teaspoons of reserved cherry juice. Spoon about 1 teaspoon frosting over each cherry. (Frosting may be thinned with additional cherry juice if necessary.) Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes or until done. Remove to wire rack; cool. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Boil sugar syrup butter and water until it spins a long thread. Pour this on corn and shape into balls.

title: Skillet Lasagne
instructions: Lightly brown meat in a 10-inch skillet at 350\u00b0 on a temperature controlled burner; drain off any excess fat. Sprinkle 1/2 of spaghetti sauce mix over meat. Spread cottage cheese in layer over meat. Arrange uncooked noodles over cottage cheese. Sprinkle with remaining spaghetti sauce mix basil parsley flakes and salt. Add tomatoes with liquid and spread over noodles being sure all is moistened. Cover tightly and cook at 225\u00b0 on temperature controlled burner for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over top; cover and let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Poor Folk'S Beans
instructions: Clean and wash pinto beans. Put almost a gallon of water in large stewer or pressure cooker. Put the beans in the water. Add bacon grease or shortening chili powder and black pepper. Cook 45 minutes to an hour in pressure cooker or simmer until tender. If using a stewer cook for about 2 to 3 hours. When done add tomato sauce and salt. Simmer until desired thickness is reached. (Delicious served with Chili Relish.)

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: Spread bread dough out on cookie sheet like pizza dough. Brown and drain sausage. Sprinkle sausage and cheese on dough; cut in half lengthwise and roll up like jelly-roll. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool slightly and slice.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix ingredients together and make into patties. Put in 2-quart baking dish and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Pour off fat. Add 1/2 cup water to remaining mushroom soup; pour over patties. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Far-East Tuna
instructions: Makes enough canape spread for 24 Melba toast rounds or dry crisp crackers.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except the Jiffy cornbread mix. Be sure to add it last. Grease a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Arroz Blanco(White Rice)
instructions: In a heavy kettle or pot heat 2 cups water with 2 teaspoons salt. When water is at a rolling boil add rice. Stir and bring to a second boil. Let it cook uncovered at high heat until water is absorbed (about 5 to 8 minutes). Add 3 tablespoons olive oil. Stir and simmer covered on low heat for 10 minutes more or until tender.

title: Spritz
instructions: Cream butter sugar and egg yolks with dash of salt. Add extract and flour; mix well. Put in cookie press. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Shoepeg Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill for several hours.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Combine and put in coffee jar. Store in cabinet until ready to use. When ready add hot water to cup and stir. Amount of mixture added to cup of water may vary according to taste.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Form into balls. Press flat. (Dip in extra flour if desired. It makes it crunchier.) Fry in oil over low heat until golden brown on both sides about 6 to 8 minutes.

title: French Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix sugar eggs butter and spices. Add raisins coconut and pecans. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Sue Hill'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together and add 1 cup pecans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix together and add dressing last.

title: Zucchini Stew
instructions: Add ground chuck zucchini garlic peppers and onions in large Dutch oven. Cook slowly for 15 minutes stirring frequently. Add the remaining ingredients. Cook until thick approximately 2 hours. May be served on Italian bread as a covered sandwich.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Place peas in strainer and run hot water over. Put in layers in order and refrigerate. Eat the next day.

title: Cranberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix eggs margarine and sugar. Add flour baking powder baking soda salt and almond flavor alternating with sour cream. Mix well. Put 1/2 batter in 10-inch tube pan. Add 1/2 cranberries and nuts. Then add remaining batter. Top with rest of cranberries and nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in cake comes out clean. Cool.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Crush potato chips with rolling pin. In medium-size casserole dish put in drained tuna. Pour crushed chips over the tuna. Mix soup with 1/2 can water and pour over chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Stick knife into casserole periodically. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Baked Rice A La Fox
instructions: Saute pepper and onion in one stick margarine. In a large bowl combine all other ingredients. Add pepper and onion. Transfer everything into a large casserole dish with a cover. This will be very watery prior to cooking. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Red Glazed Pork Loin With Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Line roasting pan with foil. In small skillet melt jelly over low heat about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in garlic tomato paste Dijon mustard dry mustard and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Place pork loin on roasting pan brush with half jelly mixture. Roast pork loin in oven 20 minutes. Quarter the potatoes cut carrots into 1 inch lengths. In large bowl toss potatoes carrots with oil salt basil and remaining pepper. Place potatoes and carrots around pork loin. Brush rest of jelly mixture on loin and vegetables until tender. Cook for 1 1/2 hours stand for 5 minutes.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except orange jello. Then sprinkle in orange jello just stir enough to mix in jello.

title: Rhubarb Pudding
instructions: Mix together and put in bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add butter corn meal salt vanilla and corn syrup. Beat hard for about 3 minutes. Add pecans. Place in pie shell and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 15 minutes then reduce heat to low (about 300\u00b0) and bake about 45 minutes more.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix everything together. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese a little bit. Mix onion green pepper and celery salt. Drain pineapple and mix in. Form in a ball and put walnut pieces on.

title: Mom'S Favorite Sloppy Joes
instructions: In a large frying pan brown the ground beef; season with salt and pepper to taste. In a separate pan saute onion in butter to make a sauce. When onion is soft turn off burner. Drain any grease off the meat. Put meat back in a large pan. Pour sauteed onion over meat. Mix in the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with choice of bread or bun.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut into 1/4-inch slices the tomatoes. Combine remaining ingredients and mix until smooth. Mixture may have to have more milk to make consistency of pancake batter. Dip the tomato slices into batter and allow excess batter to drip back in bowl. Fry in 2 inches oil (375\u00b0) in large skillet until brown turning once carefully. Use tongs to turn. Drain in colander to keep tomatoes from becoming soggy. Stand up like wheels in serving dish.

title: Boursin Spread
instructions: In large bowl mix many minced onions lots of capers some caraway seed a little butter about a dob and a half of paprika a glick of anchovy paste and a really big glob of Neufchatel cheese (can use cream cheese one 8 ounce package). Cool for a little while and serve on bread or crackers.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add taco seasoning. Put refried beans in the bottom of a 2-quart oven-safe dish. Place the hamburger mixture on top. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Stir while hot then mix in sour cream. Serve warm with nacho chips.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Put all ingredients in large mixer bowl; beat on medium speed until mixed well. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute broccoli and butter (also onion and celery if used). Add Cheez Whiz and soup. Mix well. Put rice in baking dish. Cover with mixture; mix slightly. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding mix with Cool Whip. Add pineapple (including juice) nuts and marshmallows. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Favorite Eggless Pancakes
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Combine milk and oil. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. (Batter will be lumpy.) Bake on hot griddle. Makes about 12 silver dollar-sized pancakes or eight 4-inch pancakes.

title: Easy Ice Cream
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into ice cream freezer and freeze.

title: Pickled Peaches
instructions: Make a syrup of spices and vinegar. Let come to a good boil. Pour over peaches that have been put in stone jars. Repeat for 8 mornings. On the 9th morning put peaches in glass jars and pour hot syrup over them and seal.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package directions. Drain; rinse quickly in cold water. Let cool. Peel apple; dice. Rinse green onions. Slice finely. Dice cucumber.

title: Oven Baked Rice
instructions: Mix the ingredients. Put in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serves 6 people.

title: Chicken Chausseur
instructions: Have all ingredients cut up before starting. Get water boiling for the fettucini. Heat large electric frypan and melt margarine. Add wine and chicken strips. Cook until white. Start adding vegetables. Start with carrots and let cook a few minutes before adding the rest. Start cooking the pasta. When carrots soften a bit add all the rest of vegetables except the tomato. Do not overcook. You want the vegetables to be tender-crisp. Mix the flour and water until smooth and add to vegetables and stir. Add spices to taste. Meanwhile cook the pasta. Last add the tomato just to heat. Serve the chicken and vegetables over the fettucini.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add 1 egg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Dinner
instructions: Peel and cut up potatoes carrots and onion. Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Place chicken on top. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water and pour over chicken. (You may need more liquid.) Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients very well except for the sour cream and the cinnamon-sugar mix. Fold in sour cream and mix very well. Grease and flour Bundt pan or funnel pan. Pour in half of batter. Sprinkle cinnamon-sugar mix over this half. Pour remaining batter over and sprinkle the top of it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Carol'S Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Put oil in skillet and heat; saute peppers and onions until onions are clear. Remove from oil put chicken in in small strips. Let stand there and cook until brown they cook quick.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Mix ingredients well and press into small tins.

title: Homemade Mac And Cheese
instructions: Put all ingredients in a prepared 9 x 13 pan and stir. Place in oven at 350\u00b0. Bake 1 hour. Every 15 minutes pull out of oven and stir. Place back in oven; repeat process for that hour.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Spread 1 package crescent rolls in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat together cream cheese 1 cup sugar and vanilla until well blended. Spread over crust. Spread other package crescent rolls on top. Make a crumbly mixture out of oleo 3/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over the top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Tabouli
instructions: Combine bulgur and boiling water in a medium-large bowl. Cover and let stand until the bulgur is tender (20 to 30 minutes minimum). Stir in remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve cold with tortilla chips.

title: 7-Up Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix cake ingredients together and put in 3 (9-inch) cake pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until done.

title: Hot Tomatorie Chile
instructions: Melt the butter in a Dutch oven then add the onions green peppers and celery. Cook until onion is tender but not brown. Add the ground beef and cook until beef loses red color breaking up with a fork. Add the tomatoes tomato paste salt monosodium hot sauce and chili powder. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes longer. Serve with crisp salted crackers. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine brown sugar sugar butter and shortening; beat until fluffy. Add vanilla and egg. Stir in flour baking soda and salt mixing it well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 1 minute and remove from cookie sheet. Makes 4 dozen. (Calories 100; fat 6 g; sodium 70 mg.)

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon; remove. Saut onion and celery in grease. Add flour and stir. Add water and vinegar; cook until it boils. Add rest of ingredients except eggs. Pour over potatoes and mix well. Place eggs on top. Chill.

title: Cauliflower With Bacon And Cheese Sauce
instructions: Wash cauliflower. Trim and cut into florets. Drop into boiling salted water and cook 10 minutes or until just barely tender. Drain and place into serving dish. Keep warm.

title: Northern Potatoes Salad
instructions: Cut up potatoes. Put in bowl. Cut celery and put in bowl. Cut radishes up. Put in bowl. Dice onion up. Put in bowl. Dice the eggs up. Put in bowl. Mix Miracle Whip mustard milk and sugar together. Pour over salad. Mix and slice eggs on top.

title: Oriental Pepper Steak
instructions: Marinate the thin slices of sirloin in 3 tablespoons soy sauce 1 tablespoon oil and pepper for 3 hours.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into uncooked pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes; then at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Cinnamon Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk. Fold in flour-coated cherries. Bake in an 8 x 12-inch sheet pan or 8-inch tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Frost lightly with creamy white frosting.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook shells according to directions. Cool in cold water and drain. Combine ingredients as given. Stuff shells with tablespoon of cheese mixture. Arrange in pan. Cover with sauce and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Add milk eggs and shortening to meal. Mix thoroughly. Pour in greased shallow pan. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Beef Borsch
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch pieces and place in Dutch oven or large pot. Add water salt pepper and bay leaf. Cover tightly and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Remove bay leaf. Add celery onion garlic vinegar sugar and thyme and simmer 15 minutes. Thinly slice cabbage; add and continue to cook covered until meat and cabbage are tender. Drain beets reserve liquid; combine with flour to blend. Stir into soup and cook stirring constantly to thicken slightly. Add beets and simmer another 3 to 5 minutes. Serve sour cream on top of individual servings. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Blend soup and milk. Save 1/2 of mixture. Stir together the remaining soup rice water salt pepper celery flakes and parsley. Pour into ungreased baking pan. Arrange chicken on rice mixture. Pour other 1/2 of soup mixture on top. Cover; bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Cinnamon Bread
instructions: Mix oil and sugar. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased loaf pan for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Yogurt Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine cucumbers and onion slices in a bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over slices. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings 1/2 cup each. Contains 36 calories per serving. Food Exchange 1 Vegetable.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Cover raisins with water and boil 5 minutes; drain. Melt oleo add sugar flour eggs (beaten) and vanilla. Mix well and add drained raisins. pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak raisins in water for 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat milk and butter in saucepan until butter melts. Do not boil.

title: Corn Bread And Sage Dressing
instructions: Cook corn bread the night before and leave out along with bread slices to dry out.

title: Sauerkraut Casserole
instructions: Combine bacon and onion in casserole dish. Add kraut tomatoes and brown sugar. Stir together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese peanut butter sugar oleo and vanilla until smooth. Fold in whipped cream or Cool Whip. Gently spoon into crust. Garnish with crumbs if desired. Refrigerate.

title: Grilled Ham Steak
instructions: In a small saucepan combine the preserves mustard lemon juice and cinnamon. Cook and stir over low heat until thoroughly combined about 2 to 3 minutes. Score fat edges of ham. Grill over medium coals for 8 to 10 minutes per side brushing with glaze during the last few minutes of grilling.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in microwave 10 minutes.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Heat grease 2-inches deep very hot. Mix batter. Pour through funnel into hot grease moving in circular motion then crisscross. Brown lightly. Remove and drain. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Sinfully Good Cake
instructions: Bake yellow cake mix according to directions in a 13 x 9-inch pan. When cake is baked poke holes in cake and pour hot mixture over hot cake.

title: White Fluffy Frosting(For Maraschino Cherry Cake)
instructions: Mix sugar cream of tartar and egg whites in top of double boiler. Mix well with spoon. Place over boiling water and beat with rotary beater until icing will stand in tottering peaks. Remove from water add vanilla and beat to right consistency to spread. May add chopped nuts to batter or a tint of pink. Cut cherries in half to decorate top of cake.

title: Erma'S Meat Loaf For Freezing
instructions: Blend celery onions and green pepper in blender. Add other ingredients in a large pan. Shape into any size loaf pans according to servings needed. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serves 36.

title: Pasta With Shrimp And Fennel
instructions: Saute fennel onion garlic & salt in olive oil for a few minutes. Add wine (or chicken broth). Continue cooking approximately 5-10 minutes (dont rush this time make sure the fennel is softened once tomatoes are added in the next step the acidity of the tomatoes will stop the cooking process of the fennel). Add Italian style tomatoes basil and Italian parsley. Continue cooking for a few minutes. Add shrimp; cook only until shrimp turn pink. Combine linguine with sauce and serve. Top with Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Pineapple Cake Frosting
instructions: In a saucepan combine all the ingredients. Cook and stir until thick. Cool. Spread between 2 layers of yellow cake baked according to the package directions.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Arrange Twinkies in a 13x9 pan. Make jello according to package directions. When jello begins to stiffen after approximately 30 minutes in refrigerator add 1 container of cool whip to jello and mix together using mixer. Use 1/2 of the strawberry slices to layer over Twinkies. Then pour jello/cool whip mixture over Twinkies & strawberries. Chill for 2-4 hrs. before serving. Top with 1/2 tub cool whip and rest of strawberry slices.

title: Macaroni And Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender. Drain. Cook frozen vegetables according to directions on package. Drain; chill. Combine sour cream mayonnaise vinegar salt celery seed and Tabasco sauce in large bowl. Add macaroni vegetables and onion. Toss to mix thoroughly. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: In large bowl mix all ingredients. Form into biscuits. Add additional flour to dough if sticky. Place biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet. Allow space between. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown on bottom (approximately 12 to 15 minutes). Enjoy with a pat of butter.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: In a big pot stir bacon until cooked. Add water onion and potatoes. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Hot Pot
instructions: Peel and slice yams in 1/4-inch slices. Layer yams beans and bacon in casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Linda Brown'S Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk. Add sour cream Cool Whip and crushed pineapple. Layer wafers bananas and pudding mixture and cover top with cherries.

title: Fluffy Tapioca Parfaits
instructions: Prepare fluffy tapioca cream as directed on Minute tapioca package; cool. Layer cooled tapioca with your favorite ready-made jam or jam made with Sure-Jell fruit pectin.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Mix well and chill in refrigerator for a day.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onions until tender. Drain and mash well. Add margarine soup sour cream carrot salt pepper and half of stuffing mix. Pour in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining stuffing mix over squash mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together the butter Crisco sugar and eggs. Mix together the flour salt baking powder and cocoa. Add flour mixture to butter mixture rotating with milk. Beat until smooth. Add vanilla. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Fried Dill Pickle
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Drain dill pickles. Put flour in plastic bag. Beat egg and milk together. Place pickles in milk and egg mixture then in flour bag. Shake. Fry in oil until brown.

title: Chicken Bundles
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl blend cream cheese and 2 tablespoons butter until smooth. Add chicken salt pepper milk and onion; mix well. On ungreased cookie sheet pinch edges of 2 crescent rolls together to form a square. Make 4 squares. Put 1/4 of mixture on each square. Bring ends of square up and twist. Pinch seams closed. Brush tops with remaining 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 4.

title: Banana Sugarless Cookies(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Cream margarine. Add bananas egg and vanilla and mix until combined. Sift dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture and stir well. Stir in oats and walnuts. Chill 1 hour then drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: In medium bowl combine eggs potato celery pimiento and onion. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients mixing thoroughly. Pour yogurt mixture over potato mixture and toss gently to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least one hour.

title: Easy Squash Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all of the above into a greased casserole dish. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Warm bouillon and water and pour over gelatin and lemon Jell-O stirring until dissolved. When cool add to other ingredients. Pour into an oblong dish or two loaf pans to a depth of about one inch. Chill. As mixture begins to set stir to prevent vegetables from settling to the bottom. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cheesy Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Thaw potatoes. Mix all ingredients in bowl and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with nonstick coating. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Vickie'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar brown sugar and shortening. Add eggs and peanut butter. Mix in baking soda and flour. Form small balls (about the size of a quarter). Place on cookie sheet. Smash with sugar dipped fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Fruit Topping
instructions: Cream the cheese until smooth. Add Marshmallow Whip until the mixture is creamy. Luscious over melon balls strawberries and other fruit.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour baking pans; measure all ingredients into a large mixing bowl. Blend 1/2 minute at low speed scraping sides of bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes on high speed; scrape bowl occasionally. Pour into pans. Bake.

title: Chocolate Delite
instructions: Stir flour melted margarine sugar vanilla and 1/2 cup finely chopped nuts together. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan to cover bottom and sides. Press into corners. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Stir in rum and syrup. Shape into small balls. Roll in sugar sprinkles or nuts. Store in airtight container in refrigerator for several days before serving.

title: Orange Icing
instructions: Combine first three ingredients until smooth. Stir in sugar until smooth.

title: Sour Cream Apple Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour brown sugar and butter. Blend at low speed until crumbly. Stir in nuts. Press 2 3/4 cups crumb mix into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. To remaining mix add cinnamon soda salt sour cream vanilla and egg. Blend well. Mix in apples. Spoon evenly over base. Bake 25 to 35 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Grandma'S Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Boil one small potato. Cut in half and mash this. Pour powdered sugar in a little at a time. Work until this is like pie dough. Roll thin with a glass on waxed paper (using a little powdered sugar to keep it from sticking). Spread on a thin layer of peanut butter. Roll it up (as in a jelly roll). Cut into pieces and chill.

title: Medallions Of Pork With Wild Mushrooms And Berries
instructions: Melt 1 stick of butter with the chopped garlic. Add the mushrooms; saute over medium heat until partially cooked. Add the cranberries blueberries and Port; continue to cook for another 5 minutes or until mushrooms are soft. With a slotted spoon remove the mushrooms and berries; set aside on a warm platter.

title: Beefy Bean Soup
instructions: In a saucepan simmer cabbage and onion in the water covered for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Stir in the undrained beans soup and mustard. Stir in corned beef; heat thoroughly. Serves 4 to 6 folks.

title: Skillet-Barbecued Chicken
instructions: In large skillet over medium heat stir 1/4 cup water and all ingredients except chicken until well combined. Add chicken; cook about 1 hour over medium heat turning occasionally until well browned.

title: Sponge Sandwich
instructions: Mix well. Put 1 teaspoon drop on a lightly floured cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Eleanor'S Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onion together. Add tomatoes soup and sauce. Cube cheese; add to other ingredients. Cook macaroni and celery together. Add to other ingredients. Bake in large casserole dish in 375\u00b0 preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Italian Noodle Casserole
instructions: Crumble brown and drain meat. Add next 8 ingredients; simmer 15 minutes over low heat. Place noodles in casserole. Pour meat sauce over noodles. Sprinkle cheese evenly over top. Arrange mushrooms on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let set 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Pineapple-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Line bottom of 8 x 10-inch pan with pineapple. Sprinkle with sugar-flour mixture. Cover with grated cheese. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top of cheese. Pour melted margarine over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: In saucepan melt over low heat the butter cocoa and vanilla. Cool. Combine dry ingredients and set aside. In mixing bowl put sugar and eggs and beat until creamy. Add cocoa mixture and mix well. Add dry ingredients slowly and mix well. Bake in greased 9 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Mix as\tyou would a fruit cake. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Test with toothpick.

title: Creamed Tuna On Toast
instructions: Drain English peas and tuna. Lightly stir into creamed soup. Heat slowly stirring once or twice. Pour over plain toast.

title: Oyster Cracker Dillies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Let stand for 2 to 4 hours stirring frequently until all oil is absorbed. Store in jar with tight lid.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown hamburger with chopped up onion; drain. Add refried beans can of tomatoes (chopped up small) tomato sauce and spices. Let simmer on low heat until thick. Heat 1/4 cup oil; cook tortillas one at a time for 15 to 20 seconds each side. Put on paper. Let drain. Shred mild Cheddar. Set aside. After mixture thickens put about 1 or 2 tablespoons in each tortilla with 1 tablespoon shredded cheese and roll up. Put in ungreased baking dish. Cover with remaining sauce and cheese and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Stir together sugar oil eggs and pumpkin. Sift flour salt soda baking powder and spices together add to oil mixture mix well and add water. Grease and flour 3 loaf pans pour in batter and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Chex Chocolate And Peanut Butter Snack
instructions: Pour cereal into a large bowl and set aside. Combine chocolate pieces peanut butter and margarine in 1-quart microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth stirring after 1 minute. Stir in vanilla. Pour chocolate mixture over cereal stirring until all pieces are evenly coated then pour cereal mixture into plastic bag with powdered sugar. Seal and shake until all pieces are coated. Spread on waxed paper to cool. Makes 9 cups.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and place in a covered jar. Use 2 or 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

title: Baked Fudge(Dessert)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Beat eggs. Add butter and vanilla. Mix with dry ingredients and nuts. Beat well. Pour into an 8 x 10 x 2-inch glass pan. Place pan in pan of larger size in hot water. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is firm and crusty. Serve with real whipped cream.

title: Lime Soup
instructions: Simmer for 1 1/2 hours the first 8 ingredients. Remove chicken from bones. Strain broth. Saute in oil the onion and pepper. Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Add broth and juice of limes. Stir in coriander or parsley. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add chicken. Heat through. Garnish with tortilla chips and lime slices and sprinkle lightly with cheese. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Company French Toast
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Stir in sugar and cinnamon. Place bread in double layers over sugar mixture. Beat eggs and milk; pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven covered for 35 minutes. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes. Cut into squares and invert onto plate. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with syrup. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Scotch Shortbread
instructions: Sift flour with sugar. Cut in butter using electric mixer or pastry blender to form dough. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan or 2 (9-inch) cake pans. Bake 5 minutes at 375\u00b0 and then 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: South Of The Border Easy Tex Mex Patio Party Spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place nuts chili powder and cumin in aluminum foil and bake for 6 minutes until it is fragrant and it begins to darken. Let cool.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix poppy seed with hot water and set aside. Mix and beat all other ingredients well. Add poppy seed and water mixture. Bake in 2 greased loaf pans at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix together and bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taglarima
instructions: Brown meat; add onion green pepper tomato paste and water. Simmer 15 minutes. Add noodles and 2/3 cheese. Place in baking dish and top with remaining cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Danish Apple Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour into a greased pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Drain. Stir in butter until melted. Add Parmesan cheese and egg. Mix well. Form mixture into crust in a greased pie pan or small cake pan. In a skillet cook ground beef onion and green pepper until vegetables are tender. Drain off any grease. Stir in undrained tomatoes tomato sauce sugar oregano and garlic salt. Heat through. Spread tomato mixture over spaghetti crust. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hollywood Pie
instructions: Dissolve marshmallows in warm milk. Add pineapple. Cool. Whip cream. Fold into pineapple mixture. Pour into graham cracker crust. Sprinkle top with crumbs. Cover and refrigerate overnight or several hours. Makes deep dish pie.

title: Busy Day Strawberry Cobbler
instructions: Combine sliced strawberries and 3/4 cup sugar. Let stand for 20 minutes or heat slightly to partially dissolve sugar. Melt margarine in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sift together flour and 1 cup sugar. Stir in milk. Some lumps will remain. Pour into baking dish with melted margarine. Add strawberries. Do not stir. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Speedy Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Blend in brown sugar. Add salt. Cook over low heat stirring constantly 2 minutes. Then add milk and continue stirring until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Add powdered sugar. Add vanilla; mix well. Spread on cake. If icing gets too thick add small amount of milk or cream. May add pecans or walnuts if you like.

title: Pecan Puffs
