instructions: Mix well. You may roll in small balls or fingers. If rolled in balls make indenture with thumbs before baking. Fill indent with desired frosting or Hershey Kiss. If rolled in fingers roll in powdered sugar after baking. Bake at 350 for 8 - 10 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Cool slightly on pan but if using Hershey Kisses put on cookies while hot. Dont frost until they have cooled completely.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Tear bread. Place pieces in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Brown sausage. Spoon over bread. Sprinkle cheese. Beat together the eggs and milk. Pour over mixture in baking dish. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Cheese will rise to top during baking. May be prepared the night before.

title: Marinated Broccoli
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in an airtight container. Let marinate all day or overnight. Good with other vegetables also.

title: Greens Gumbo
instructions: Pick the greens removing all dead leaves and large stems. Wash them several times. Place the greens in a large pot along with the bacon onions parsley celery green pepper and water. Bring to a boil; lower the heat and cook covered for 1 to 2 hours until the greens are tender. Drain the greens reserving the cooking liquid. Discard the bacon. When the greens are cool enough to handle divide them in half. Coarsely chop half and put the other half through a blender or processor. In the pot without liquid saute the scallions garlic ham and sausage in the vegetable oil for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch pan. Frost with any chocolate frosting.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Leave a short stem on fresh okra (small pods best). Pack okra into clean quart jars. Into each jar add 1 clove garlic 1 tablespoon pickling spices 1 teaspoon dill seed and 1 hot pepper (optional). Mix first 3 ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour hot liquid over okra and seal.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Cook beef in cold water just enough to see it in the bottom. Mash with potato masher or egg beater. Cook till dry. Add oregano chili powder l large can tomato sauce 1/2 bottle Ketchup 1 large can tomato juice 1 cup diced onions or more; salt and pepper to taste 2 pkg. sloppy Joe Mix. Mix until all is blended. Serve on hot dogs.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: In large bowl stir entire can salmon with the liquid. Flake the salmon with fork. Mix eggs or egg whites in bowl. Add bread crumbs and remaining ingredients together. Add these to the salmon. Form patties and shape into cones. Place in Pyrex dish lightly greased. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Two minutes before baking is complete add slices of Swiss cheese on top of each croquette.

title: Tortilla-Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and tear into small strips when cool. Cut tortillas in small strips. Mix together the onion and the chilies. Mix together the soups and evaporated milk. Grease a 9 x 13 inch pan and spread bottom with a layer of soup mixture then a layer of chicken onion and chilies tortilla strips and cheese; continue ending with cheese. Sprinkle with paprika and cover with foil. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12-15.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Spread pecans and coconut on bottom of pan. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour on top of pecans and coconut. Mix cream cheese confectioners sugar and margarine with mixer. Spoon onto cake mix leaving 1/2-inch from edge. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Crab, Shrimp, Rice Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients (except bread crumbs) together. Place in casserole and top with bread crumbs. Bake 1 hour.

title: Easy Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an oiled 13 x 9 baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Macaroni Deluxe(This Is A Great Macaroni Dish.)
instructions: Boil one chicken skin and bone it. Save the broth.

title: Hot Spiced Citrus Punch
instructions: In large saucepan pour boiling water over sugar tea bags cinnamon and allspice. Steep 5 minutes; remove tea bags. Stir in fruit juices; heat. Remove cinnamon sticks. For garnish float clove-studded lemon cartwheel slices in punch. Makes about 14 cups (twenty-two 5 ounce servings).

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Let spaghetti cool before adding rest of ingredients. Make ahead. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Burritos
instructions: Brown ground beef and pour off fat. Add seasoning mix tomatoes dried minced onion and refried beans. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Thaw tortillas if frozen. Heat at 425\u00b0 for 3 to 5 minutes. Fill tortillas with filling. Fold and roll. Sprinkle cheese on top. Heat in 325\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes.

title: Quick Vichyssoise
instructions: Heat soup milk and bouillon cubes over medium-low heat. Add grated onion and blend. Let cool and fold in sour cream. Chill well. Sprinkle with chives or onion tops prior to serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chewy Honey Brownies
instructions: Cream the oleo and sugar in small mixer bowl; blend in honey and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Combine flour cocoa and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture. Fold in nuts; pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edge of pan. Cool. Frost with Honey Frosting.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil then add both jellos. Refrigerate until cold and add celery pimentos and pecans. Prepare Dream Whip and beat in cream cheese until creamy. Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish or into a jello mold. Chill until firm.

title: Fresh Apple-Date Nut Cake
instructions: Combine in large bowl the sugar oil eggs salt and flavorings. Beat well. Then add flour soda apples dates and pecans. Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Pour liquid from salmon into bowl. Add egg milk lemon juice and beat well. Add crackers bread and flour. Let stand a few minutes until bread crumbs are soft. Add onions and salmon. Mix well. Add salt and pepper. Let stand 5 minutes. Shape into balls and deep fry until golden brown.

title: Spicy Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Beat in egg pumpkin and vanilla. Mix in dry ingredients including nuts into creamed mixture. Mix until well blended. Pour into 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 35 minutes. Frost with Spicy Frosting while still warm not hot.

title: Kip'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together. This sauce is good on grilled ribs.

title: Old Timey Cocoa Fudge(From Cocoa Can)
instructions: Sift sugar cocoa and salt. Into a large saucepan add milk. Bring to boil stirring frequently. Cook to soft boil. Remove from heat; add butter. Cool to lukewarm then add vanilla. Do not stir after removing from fire until cool then beat until mixture thickens. Pour into 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; add eggs and oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple pecans and bananas. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans and let cool on wire racks. Spread with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Chicken And Brown Rice
instructions: In a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium heat in the oil brown the chicken on both sides. Remove the chicken from the pan.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli and cauliflower until nearly done. Heat the soups and Cheez Whiz and stir together. Mix all ingredients except onion rings together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes adding onions for the last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Fruit Bars
instructions: Line bottom of a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan with coarsely chopped nuts. Put on top of nuts pineapple and chopped cherries. This will not be as thickly covered as the nuts. Cream butter brown sugar eggs flour and vanilla. Mix as any cake. Spoon over fruit and nuts. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut in squares while still hot. Cool. Store in a tightly sealed tin.

title: Easy Italian Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Drain excess grease. Mix together the salt pepper oregano dry mustard and thyme. Add to the beef mixture. Mix well. Pour the tomato juice over the beef mixture and add the broken uncooked spaghetti. Press spaghetti under juice with spoon. Cover and cook over medium heat approximately 25 to 30 minutes or until juice is cooked up.

title: Mississippi Fried Chicken
instructions: In colander rinse chicken; salt and pepper and let stand to drain. In plastic bag combine flour salt pepper and baking powder. Shake chicken in mixture until well coated. Refrigerate for 6 hours; put 1-inch of cooking oil in skillet. Cook on medium to high heat.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all together and bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chip Dip
instructions: Cook sugar vinegar and egg until thick. Stir in cream cheese onion and pepper. Beat until creamy.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Put margarine and squash in pan (no water). Cook until almost tender (6 to 8 minutes). Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in egg and cheese. Put in casserole dish. Crush potato chips. Put on top of squash mixture. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sole Or Flounder Parmesan
instructions: Arrange fish fillets in a single layer in a nonstick baking dish. Combine all remaining ingredients except paprika and parsley. Spread over fish. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes just until the fish flakes easily. Sprinkle liberally with paprika and serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Add fruit with one cup of sugar for different flavors.

title: Flaky Pie Crust(For Double Crust)
instructions: Mix flour and salt together in bowl making a well in center. Mix oil and milk together then pour into well in flour mixture. Stir with fork until all flour is mixed in. Split dough in half. Roll out half at a time between 2 sheets of waxed paper. Peel off top sheet of waxed paper and invert pie plate over crust. Turn over and peel paper off.

title: Cherry Sauce
instructions: Bring mixture to a boil and thicken with cornstarch thickening. Great to serve warm over gingerbread.

title: Candied Pecans
instructions: Mix together; place in baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes stirring every 2 to 3 minutes. Be careful not to burn.

title: Carolina Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage pepper and onion. Then in a saucepan bring dressing ingredients to a boil then pour over cabbage mix. Cool cover and refrigerate. Gets better with age. Great on foot long Coney Islands.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup tomato soup with ground beef uncooked rice egg (beaten) onion parsley and salt. Shape into balls about 1/2-inch in diameter. Brown in 2 tablespoons shortening with 1 small clove in skillet. Blend in rest of soup and 1 cup of water. Cover; simmer about 40 minutes or until rice is tender stirring occasionally.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: In a 3 or 4-quart pan saute onions and garlic in oil until the onions are translucent. Add tomatoes chicken stock tomato juice and water. Season with chili powder cumin and salt to taste. Cover and simmer 45 to 60 minutes. Just before serving bring liquid to a boil. Add tortillas and cheese. Cover remove from heat and let sit 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately. Yield 6 servings.

title: Cookies With Pancake Mix
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Mix in egg and vanilla. Stir in pancake mix and chocolate chips. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream 3 cheeses together in mixer. Add drained shrimp and all other ingredients and beat until evenly mixed. Divide mixture in half and form each into a ball with hands. Roll completely in pecan gems. Wrap in foil and chill.

title: Butter Mint Salad
instructions: Mix mints marshmallows and pineapple. Sprinkle jello and mix. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Add Cool Whip and freeze.

title: Sandy'S Chicken Stew
instructions: Put olive oil in stew pot. Place chicken in pot brown the chicken lightly. Add oregano adobo seasoning and Sason seasoning. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add salad olives bay leaves onions garlic potatoes and carrots. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add tomato sauce. Cover and cook until done.

title: Peach Jam
instructions: Boil for 15 minutes. Add 2 small boxes or 1 large box orange jello. Put in jar and seal with paraffin wax.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients; blend well but do not overbeat. Bake in greased 8 x 16-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef And Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Drain off grease. Add tomato soup and ground beef; mix together. Put in 2-quart casserole dish. Put green beans on top of beef.

title: Sauce Soubise
instructions: In saucepan cook onion in butter until tender. Stir in soup and milk. Heat; stir occasionally. Makes about 2 cups. Serve over cooked meats chicken or vegetables.

title: Wheat Germ Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Beat eggs. Add oil sugars and maple flavoring. Beat until thick and foamy. Add flour mixture; stir just until blended. Stir in zucchini. Divide mixture evenly between two 5 x 7-inch loaf pans. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sesame seed over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Test with toothpick. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Turn out onto racks to finish cooling.

title: Pie Pastry
instructions: Add shortening to flour and salt blend well. Put egg in liquid measuring cup and beat well. Add vinegar and enough water to fill cup to 3/4 full. Add to flour mixture and mix well. Makes 3 shells.

title: Newt'S Nutty Bread
instructions: Place 2 tablespoons of whole wheat flour in a cup with 1/4 tablespoon of baking powder and 1 pinch of salt. Add 1 tablespoon of chopped walnuts and stir. Add 1 tablespoon of honey and 1/2 of a beaten egg and 1 tablespoon of milk. Add 1/2 tablespoon of oil and stir all of the ingredients and when finished stirring place it in a pan and cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except nuts) well. Add nuts last. Line 4 (1 pound) coffee cans with wax paper. Spray cans with Bakers Joy or grease them before lining with wax paper. Pour each can 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into a ball (2 small or 1 large). Crush the nuts. Roll cheese ball into nuts. Place ball in refrigerator for a few hours.

title: Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Dissolve bouillon cube in 1/2 cup hot water. Split tenderloin lengthways; do not cut all the way through. Set aside. Mix all other ingredients together well. Stuff tenderloin with mixture. Wrap stuffed tenderloin with strips of bacon securing ends with toothpicks. Place in baking dish. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Place on hot grill and grill for 30 to 40 minutes. Slice crossways. Serve hot with your favorite gravy or dry as desired. Makes 6 servings. Preparation time 200.

title: Sante Fe Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in large pot. Add remaining ingredients. (Dont drain juices.) Heat until hot. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Velvet Lemon Sherbet
instructions: Stir. Pour into gallon ice cream freezer and add whole milk to line. Freeze in ice cream freezer as usual until frozen.

title: Double Chocolate Rum Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well with electric mixer (2 to 3 minutes). Pour into well-greased Bundt pan (can use Pam spray) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes and turn out onto cooling rack. Allow cake to fully cool. Drizzle melted frosting ingredients over top of cake.

title: Croutons
instructions: Spread out bread cubes evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan. In saucepan melt margarine. Add the package mix and garlic. Mix well. Drizzle mixture evenly over bread cubes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and parsley. Toss to coat and combine. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Stir once during baking. Let cool until crisp. Store in airtight container.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix ground beef bread crumbs salt pepper and egg. Shape into 4 oval patties each about 3/4-inch thick. Cook patties in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat turning occasionally until brown about 10 minutes. Drain. Add onion broth and mushrooms. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until beef is done about 10 minutes. Remove patties. Keep warm. Heat onion mixture to boiling. Mix water and cornstarch; stir into onion mixture. Boil and stir 1 minute. Serve over patties. Makes 4 servings.

title: Can Can Chicken
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together (add more chicken to taste). Put mixture in a large pot and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 7 minutes until rice is tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with sugar. Beat in eggs. Sift flour with baking powder; add flour mixture to butter sugar mixture. Chill 2 hours before rolling. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Pepperoni And Cheese Stromboli
instructions: Roll out dough into a large rectangle approximately 12 x 15-inch. Layer pepperoni and then cheese on top of dough. Sprinkle with oregano and basil. Roll up beginning at wide edge. Pinch edge of dough into roll and seal well. Lightly grease dough roll and then sprinkle with garlic parsley salt. Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until dough is golden brown. Cut into 1/2-inch slices before serving.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until the ingredients form a soft ball. Remove from heat and work with hands until smooth and even. Divide and mix in desired food coloring. Store in airtight containers.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Brown 1/2 cup white sugar in heavy skillet. Combine the other sugar flour egg yolk milk butter and vanilla in double boiler and heat. Pour caramelized sugar into mixture stirring until smooth and thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Make meringue with 3 egg whites and 3 tablespoons sugar and brown.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a crock-pot and cook on low for 7 hours. Makes great sandwiches.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Pour over meat and vegetables. Cover pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 4 hours. Dont peek.

title: Pretzel Jello
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and chill until just set. Mix together next 3 ingredients; press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese and sugar; fold in Cool Whip. Spread over pretzel crust. Next spread Jell-O mix over this; chill until Jell-O is completely set.

title: Pear Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Sift flour salt baking powder baking soda and nutmeg together and mix with the first 3 ingredients. Then add the yogurt or buttermilk and pears and vanilla. Mix all. Pour in greased 5 x 9 x 3-inch pan. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Chip Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except graham crackers. Crunch graham crackers on wax paper and roll balls in the crumbs. Refrigerate.

title: Low-Fat Chili
instructions: Cook turkey until brown. Add seasoning mix and onions then tomatoes and remaining ingredients. Cook 30 minutes.

title: Easy Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Mix together preserves soup mix and dressing. Pour over chicken and bake in casserole dish for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Penny'S Veggie Bars
instructions: Press dough from 1 package rolls on ungreased cookie sheet into a 9 x 12-inch rectangle. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 10 to 15 minutes. Repeat with other package of rolls. Cool completely.

title: Scottish Scones
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in oats and nuts. Add milk; mix until just moistened. On lightly floured surface roll dough to circle 1/2-inch. Cut into 10 wedges; place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Cream margarine and honey until light and fluffy. Serve with warm scones. Makes 10 scones.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
instructions: Cut up onions and bell peppers and mix together. Add corn and mix well. Add mayonnaise and sour cream and mix well. Add chopped tomatoes. Peel tomatoes and fold in.

title: Microwave Eggplant Caponata
instructions: Layer the eggplant slices in a large colander sprinkle both sides of each layer lightly with salt. Put a plate on top so it rests on the eggplant and put something heavy on the plate. Put the colander over a shallow bowl and let stand 1-2 hours to drain the excess moisture.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and roll in pecan chips.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Pick over crab to remove any shells. Blend with milk parsley salt bread crumbs eggs and Worcestershire sauce. Form into cakes and fry in butter on all sides. Serve with lemon wedge and tartar sauce.

title: Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Spread softened ice cream onto bottom of crust; freeze until firm. Spread fudge sauce evenly over ice cream. Cover with Cool Whip. Freeze 4 hours or until firm. Let stand approximately 30 minutes before serving. Spread fudge sauce on top of Cool Whip if you wish.

title: White Chili
instructions: Combine beans broth garlic and 1/2 of the onion in large pot. Bring to a boil; then simmer for 3 hours or more adding more broth if needed. In skillet heat oil saute remaining onion; add chilies and seasonings cook thoroughly. Pour into bean mixture and add chicken simmer for an additional hour. Serves 8 to 10. Top with grated cheese salsa and sour cream.

title: Don'S Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Season crawfish tails with salt and pepper and set aside. Melt oleo in heavy pot. Add onions bell pepper and celery; cook until onions are wilted stirring constantly. Add crawfish fat 1 1/2 cups water and crawfish tails. Bring to boil and cook over slow heat for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Dissolve cornstarch into 1/2 cup of water; add mixture. Add onion tops and parsley; cook another 10 minutes. Let set a few minutes. Serve over cooked rice. Serves 4.

title: Eastern Shore Crab Soup
instructions: In a 10-quart soup pot fill with water to 8 quarts. Simmer all ingredients (except potatoes mixed vegetables and crabmeat) about 2 hours. Add potatoes and mixed vegetables. Cook until tender. Add crabmeat. Enjoy!

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring butter and water to a rolling boil. Beat the remaining ingredients in mixer then add boiled mixture. Beat well. Pour in a cooking pan with side. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Can use a sheet cake pan.

title: Roasted Sweet Corn Syrup
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until onions are sauteed about 5 minutes. Place onions in a food processor or blender. Add corn and 1/2 cup of milk and process until smooth. Pour mixture into a large saucepan and add remaining milk. Heat very gently for about 5 minutes. Dont boil. Serve hot garnished with pepper slivers.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; store in a tightly covered container. To serve use 1 to 2 teaspoons mix per cup.

title: Hot Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mash cheese and Crisco; cream well. Add flour and salt. Mix well. Roll into small balls. Chill 1 hour. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Balls will flatten as they cook.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Remove pits from cherries reserve juice. Drain juice from pineapple combine with cherry juice and bring to a boil. Pour over jello stir until dissolved. Add no water stir in cherries pineapple nuts cream cheese and Coca-Cola. Chill until set.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Sift the flour once; add baking powder soda salt and spices and sift together three times. Cream butter thoroughly. Add sugar and cream together until light and fluffy. Add egg raisins and nuts and beat well. Add flour mixture alternately with applesauce a small amount at a time. Bake in a greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: California Hot Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cook broccoli until still crisp. Heap upon a platter. Cover with sauce consisting of mayonnaise prepared mustard and vinegar.

title: Spiced Apples
instructions: Peel apples and cut into chunks or thick slices. (To keep from darkening apples can be placed in a bowl of saltwater after they are sliced.) Place sugar water and several red hots in heavy saucepan; stir well and simmer. Add generous sprinkle of cinnamon and enough food coloring to make the solution bright red. Add part of the apples (drained if they have been soaked) and cook until tender. Remove and continue with the remainder. Then cook the syrup until thickened and pour over apples in casserole or dish and chill. They keep well in the refrigerator.

title: Chinese Salad
instructions: Chop ingredients and put in plastic bag. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Grease baking dish. Put chicken in bottom of dish. Mix soups broth and vegetables. Pour over chicken. Top with crust.

title: Cheddar-Jalapeno Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour baking powder salt and paprika. With pastry blender cut in butter and shortening until coarse crumbs. Stir cheese chiles and milk into flour mixture until ingredients are blended and forms a soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board. With lightly floured hands pat dough into a 10 x 4-inch rectangle. With floured knife cut rectangle lengthwise in half. Cut each half crosswise into five 2-inch squares. Cut each square diagonally in half to make 20 triangles. Place biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 13 to 15 minutes until golden. Serve warm.

title: Lo-Cal Breaded Chicken
instructions: Rinse and drain chicken. Mix together on a plate bread crumbs and spices. Pour 1/2 bottle of dressing on a plate. Dip chicken in dressing and then into bread crumbs. Turn to coat both sides. Place on a shallow baking dish and cover with foil. Bake at 350- 400 degrees for approximately 1 1/2 hours. Uncover the last 15 minutes to brown.

title: Broccoli Cheese Cornbread
instructions: Beat eggs mix other ingredients with the eggs. Put in greased iron skillet at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: B'S Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Soak raisins in hot apple juice (juice can be simmered in mulled wine spices for 15 minutes; strain and add raisins). Combine sugar oil and eggs; add pumpkin and mix well. Combine dry ingredients; add to pumpkin mix. Add milk and vanilla and beat thoroughly. Add pecans and raisins and mix well. Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with cream cheese; also good toasted.

title: Ellen'S Oriental Chicken(A Ft. Lewis, Washington Special)
instructions: Put sauce in electric skillet. Roll chicken around in skillet to coat each piece with sauce using 5 tablespoons of sauce for 9 chix pieces. Cover with airtight lid. Heat skillet to approximately 250\u00b0 just so sauce bubbles gently. Turn chix pieces every 10 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cut green pepper garlic and onion into small pieces; simmer in small amount of oil. Add crushed tomatoes tomato puree tomato paste and tomato soup. Stir well. Add garlic salt oregano red pepper salt pepper and 1 teaspoon sugar. Bring to boil. Simmer two hours stirring often.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: In saucepan but oil cleaned and peeled shrimp and chopped garlic. Saute until shrimp is cooked. In the same pan add butter. Squeeze 2 lemons. Add parsley and black pepper to taste. When all is blended together add chicken broth; let simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Add bread crumbs; stir. Cook another 5 minutes. Serve over cooked rice or thin spaghetti.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cookies
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail; save syrup. Cream next 4 ingredients until fluffy. Add egg along with 1/3 cup fruit cocktail syrup and beat well. Add all remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa butter milk and dash of salt in pot. Bring to hard boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Drop spoonfuls on waxed paper. Allow to cool.

title: Chicken And Potato Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 475\u00b0. Spray a 10 x 15-inch pan well. Place potatoes in single layer and cook for 15 minutes. Mix rosemary and garlic in small bowl. Put chicken breasts on top of potatoes and add rosemary garlic salt and pepper. Bake chicken and potatoes until tender.

title: Quick & Tasty Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in large bowl. Add more salad dressing if needed.

title: Cracker Salad
instructions: Mix all together and add salad dressing as much as you want.

title: Barley-Corn Summer Salad
instructions: Cook barley 1/2 hour in boiling salted water. Mix all ingredients together. Dress with vinaigrette dressing. Taste for salt and pepper. Chill and serve.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: In large skillet stir meat until brown. Blend in onion soup flour and tomato paste. Stir in water. Simmer covered for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Serve over noodles.

title: Memere'S Ragu
instructions: Brown flour in frypan using fork to stir bottom constantly until golden brown. Set aside to cool. Cook deer meat in kettle with onion celery and spices until meat is tender. Add cold water a little at a time to browned flour to make sauce. Gradually add to meat and broth gradually to thicken. I cook potatoes and carrots in broth before thickening. Add more cinnamon and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spanish Noodles
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp.\tBreak into small pieces. Add ground beef to bacon in frypan. Stir and cook on medium heat until meat is done. Add salt and pepper if desired.

title: Cream Of Crab Soup
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour salt pepper parsley and nutmeg; stir 1 minute (do not brown). Add milk; stir until thick. Add crab meat. Remove from fire. When ready to serve reheat and add heated cream and dry sherry.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; save juice to add to pie filling. Drain cherries and oranges (blot on paper towel). Pour all fruit in bowl; set aside. Add pie filling pineapple juice and 1/4 cup orange juice to small bowl. Beat on low speed several minutes and add to fruit.

title: Marinade For Salmon
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Brush over fish and broil 10 to 15 minutes or until fish flakes. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Mix flour salt and shortening. Add water and egg making a soft dough. Roll out and let dry for about 1 hour. Drop in hot broth after cutting.

title: Barbecued Frank Sandwiches
instructions: Combine chopped onion and butter; simmer until tender. Add next remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered for about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve on buns. Makes 4 servings.

title: Artichoke Dip In A Bread Basket
instructions: Cut top from loaf. Scoop out center leaving a 1/2-inch shell. Set shell aside. Cut remaining bread into 1 to 1 1/2-inch cubes. Place on 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Broil 6-inches from heat (with electric oven door partially opened) 2 to 3 minutes or until golden stirring once. Set aside.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet drain off fat. In deep casserole dish combine hamburger rice tomatoes and salt; mix well. Cover and bake for 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Combine and mix well. Pour into 9 x 13 inch cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: White And Black Bean Salad
instructions: Saute onion in oil until crisp-tender over medium heat. Remove from heat and cool until warm. Stir vinegar red pepper parsley garlic NutraSweet Spoonful salt and pepper into onion. Pour onion mixture over combined beans in bowl; mix well. Garnish with pepper rings.

title: Boiled Cheese
instructions: Add soda to cottage cheese; mix and let stand 20 minutes. Melt oleo and stir in flour. Add cheese and milk. Cook on low heat until cheese is melted and slightly thickened. Add caraway seed. Let cool and refrigerate.

title: Mrs. Field'S Cookies
instructions: Cream together the butter sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix. Put small amounts of oatmeal in blender until it turns to powder. Mix together the flour oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. Mix together all ingredients. Add chocolate chips and grated Hershey bar. Add chopped nuts. Roll into golf ball size rounds. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Makes 112 cookies.

title: Pretzel Fried Chicken
instructions: Dry pieces of chicken with paper towels. Mix eggs and milk thoroughly. Place finely crushed pretzels in paper sack. Dip each chicken piece in egg-milk mixture; then place in sack of crushed pretzels. Shake until each piece is completely coated. Then drop chicken into 350\u00b0 vegetable oil and fry until a rich golden brown. Place fried chicken pieces on aluminum foil-lined large flat baking dish in 300\u00b0 oven for an additional 35 minutes. Serve piping hot. Serves 6.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Freeze. Bake directly from freezer to oven. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Let set for a couple of minutes if too soft.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix well in order given. Spread in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set. Rich but oh so good.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine in long cake pan. Stir sugar cocoa eggs flour and vanilla. Then add melted margarine and stir well. Pour into pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all together in a baking dish putting crushed corn flakes on top of casserole. You can dot the casserole with butter if you want to or leave plain and bake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate cheese and mix with cream cheese. Mix remaining ingredients except pecans. Mold into a ball then cover with crushed pecans.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: With a sharp knife cut beef across grain into thin strips approximately 1/8 inch thick. Combine soy sauce garlic ginger in a large bowl. Add beef to mixture toss and set to the side. Heat oil in large skillet or wok adding beef and toss over a high heat until browned. Taste the meat to see if tender. If not then cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over a low heat. Once tender add vegetables and toss until tender (approximately 10 minutes). Mix cornstarch with water and add to pan stirring until thick. Once thickened and tomatoes and heat through. Serve.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt margarine. Add cottage cheese eggs mayonnaise and grated cheese together. Next add muffin mix and thawed and drained broccoli to mixture. Bake in a large pan for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pork Roast
instructions: Mix all other ingredients with enough water to cover; let stand at least 4 hours. I put the marinade in a deep bowl in the fridge overnight then put all in crock-pot and put on low and cook until done. Parboiled potatoes added to crock-pot and cooked in marinade are good.

title: Peanut Brittle(Microwave)
instructions: Mix sugar corn syrup peanuts and salt. Cook on High 8 minutes in measuring cup. Add butter and vanilla flavoring and stir really well. Cook on High 1 to 2 minutes or until light brown. Add baking soda. Takes 12 minutes.

title: Tony Tiger Bites
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows in a saucepan. Add peanut butter and Frosted Flakes. Spread evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fabulous Fargozas
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients into a bowl. Make a well in the center. In a separate bowl beat egg with butter and stir into milk. Pour all at once into flour well. Stir just to moisten ingredients adding cheeses (about 15 full circular strokes that scrape bottom of bowl; batter will look lumpy). Grease a baking sheet. Spoon lumps of batter onto baking sheet. Bake in a hot 425\u00b0 oven for about 25 minutes or until well browned. Makes about a dozen rolls.

title: Olive Sandwich Spread
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients. Spread on bread bagels or crackers. Yields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; reserve 1 1/2 cups for topping. Mix crumbs with liquid ingredients. Put into prepared raw pie crust. Top with reserved crumbs. This makes a wet bottom pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Coconut Sheet Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed in oblong pan (9 x 13-inch). As the cake cooks bring the milk sugar and 1/2 of 14 ounce package coconut to a boil. Remove cake from oven when done and punch holes in the hot cake. Pour hot liquid over cake. Cool completely. Spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with remainder of coconut on top. Let stand until completely cool before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Swiss Steak With Vegetables
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Sprinkle mixture over meat; pound in with meat mallet. In Dutch oven brown meat slowly on both sides in Crisco. Remove from heat. Add 1/2 cup water and Worcestershire sauce. Cover tightly; cook over low heat for 1 hour. Add potatoes and carrots. Cover; simmer until meat and vegetable are tender about 1 hour more adding more water if needed. Remove meat and vegetables to platter and keep hot. Skim fat from meat juices. Add enough water to juices to make 2 cups. Thicken with water and flour mixture and stir into meat juices in Dutch oven. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with meat and vegetables. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cherry Pie Filling Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Will keep for 2 or 3 days.

title: Winner'S Spaghetti
instructions: Saute vegetables. Add cream cheese and milk. Combine 1/2 meat sauce with cooked spaghetti. Place in 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Top with cream cheese mixture and remaining meat sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with onions. Bake 15 more minutes.

title: English Custard Sauce
instructions: Beat the eggs with the sugar and 3 tablespoons of the milk. Heat the rest of the milk to lukewarm. Beat the warm milk into the eggs. Pour into a double saucepan or a bowl standing over a pan of simmering water. Cook without boiling until custard thickens enough to thinly coat the back of a spoon. Stir frequently. Pour into a cold jug and stir in the vanilla. Serve hot or cold sauce will thicken slightly on cooling. Serves 4.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan press raw hamburger in bottom of pan 6 torn tortillas beans onions cheese and 6 more torn tortillas. Mix can of soup and then measure 1 soup can full of milk and mix. Pour this over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Fish Fillets
instructions: Place thawed fillets in shallow baking dish. Saute minced onion in margarine. To this add salt pepper bread crumbs and cheese. Toss onion mix with fork then press small amounts over each fish fillet and press down firmly. Pour 1/2 cup milk around fish; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quiche
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain and put in pie crust. Beat milk and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Pour over hamburger in pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Gone All Day Stew
instructions: Mix together soup water and flour until smooth. Combine with other ingredients in covered roasting pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Make-Ahead-Potatoes For A Crowd
instructions: Peel cook and mash potatoes. Combine rest of ingredients and add to mashed potatoes. Place in a buttered casserole and refrigerate until ready to use. Then bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Soft Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine sugars vanilla and eggs until light and fluffy. Mix in flour baking soda and salt. Stir in chips. Drop from teaspoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix stuffing according to directions. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with stuffing. Layer green beans then chicken. Put rest of stuffing on top. Mix soup with milk or broth. Add mushrooms. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef `N' Cheese Wraps
instructions: Spread one side of each tortilla with cream cheese. Top with carrots and Monterey Jack cheese. Layer with beef and lettuce. Roll up tightly and wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Cut into 1-inch slices.

title: Pepperoni Spaghetti
instructions: Instead of hamburger in your spaghetti try pepperoni. Cut pepperoni in half and just add them to your sauce. It gives it a new twist and its quick.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs. Add milk salt grated cheese and mustard. Beat again. Stir in bread and sausage. Pour into greased 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Ham And Noodles
instructions: Melt cheese in milk over low heat. Cook noodles and drain. Add ham to cheese mixture. Heat through. Put noodles in a large bowl or casserole dish. Pour cheese mixture over noodles and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pan Yerba Y Caseosa
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl. Care should be exercised to assure water is not too warm or you will kill the yeast. Scald milk. Add cheeses onion and margarine. Stir until the mixture is entirely blended. Add sugar salt dill weed and parsley. Cool mixture and add with eggs and at least 1 cup of flour to yeast. Mix with a continuous motion adding flour until the entire unit is well mixed but not too stiff.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan over low heat. Cool. Stir in both sugars and buttermilk. Mix well. Add eggs flour and vanilla. Mix well. Add pecans. Pour into one 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes.

title: Easy Light Rolls
instructions: Combine Crisco sugar and salt. Pour boiling milk into ingredients and stir until dissolved. Cool. Soften yeast in warm water in which 1 teaspoon of sugar has been added. Add to liquid ingredients. Add egg and flour stirring thoroughly. Let rise until doubled. Punch down and shape into rolls. Let rise again until doubled in size. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
instructions: Mix oil chocolate and sugar plus 1 egg at a time. Add vanilla. Add flour salt and baking powder. Chill. Roll in powdered sugar. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Mexican Meat Pie
instructions: Brown meat with onion and pepper. Add tomatoes salt and pepper. In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer 1/2 each of the tortillas meat beans and cheese. Repeat layers. Top with soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix and margarine until crumbly. Pat into 13 x 9-inch pan (not too hard). Sprinkle next 4 ingredients over this. Pour milk over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Secret is to cool completely.

title: Chicken And Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Bake chicken in oven whichever way you choose. Take skin off before cooking. Make homemade mashed potatoes using low-fat milk and fat-free sour cream. Add pepper for flavor. Use the canned gravy (low-fat). Serve with vegetable and rolls.

title: Shrimp Cantonese With Rice
instructions: While rice is cooking saute shrimp in butter for 1 minute or until pink using a large skillet. Add celery and onions. Cook stirring 2 minutes. Add spinach and Chinese vegetables. Cover and cook 1 minute.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: With meat in bowl add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Shape into miniature meatballs; brown in skillet. When thoroughly browned add to sauce. Simmer for 15 minutes. Pour into casserole and refrigerate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Stir occasionally. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk cocoa and margarine for 2 minutes in a large kettle. Add vanilla; remove from heat. Add peanut butter; mix. Add oats; mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper or any size you prefer. The mixture gradually hardens.

title: Cucumber Vichyssoise
instructions: Place onion cucumber and raw potato in saucepan; add broth parsley and seasonings. Bring to boil; cover and let cook until potato is barely tender (about 10 minutes). Put through blender and chill thoroughly. When ready to serve stir in cream and serve in chilled soup bowls.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Mix salt with cabbage; let stand one hour. Squeeze out excess water and add carrot and green pepper. While cabbage is standing make the following dressing.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Toss with dressing (recipe follows). Refrigerate until serving time. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs then add sugar salt and cocoa (if chocolate) and beat until real thick. Add vanilla whipping cream and half and half. If container isnt full enough you can add some milk.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Saute the leeks in the oil in a large saucepan until golden. Add garlic and 1 can of beans with their liquid. Mash up the beans with a fork. Add the second can of beans with their liquid but do not mash the beans. Stir in the water salt and pepper and simmer covered for 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix spices sugar and baking powder. Put butter into hot cooked potatoes. Add soda to buttermilk; mix all together. Beat eggs well and stir in. Pour into unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Breakfast Cheese And Sausage
instructions: Brown sausage drain. Add vegetables. Cook 5 minutes drain. Set aside to cool about 10 minutes. Stir sausage mixture cheese and bread crumbs.

title: Crunchy Potato Wedges(Serves 4)
instructions: Tip Instead of cornflakes you can substitute equal amounts of Parmesan cheese and dry breadcrumbs.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Add shortening. Mix well by hand. Dissolve 2 cakes yeast in 3 tablespoons warm water. Add this and 1 3/4 cups buttermilk to flour. Mix well. Store in airtight container in refrigerator. When ready to use roll as for biscuits. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Make Ahead Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. After cooking potatoes mash them well. Add the cream cheese sour cream butter salt and pepper. Whip or beat with electric mixer. (If too thick add a little milk so they are fluffy.) Grease with margarine a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Add potatoes. Dot with bits of butter. Sprinkle with Lawrys seasoned salt. At this point it can be baked for 25 minutes or if doing ahead cover refrigerate and bake the following day. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: In a large heat resistant bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in yogurt with wire whisk. Fold in whipped topping with wooden spoon. Spread in crust. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Refrigerate leftovers. Serves 8.

title: Hot Asparagus Canapes
instructions: Trim bread crust. Roll bread thin with rolling pin. Blend cheese and egg and spread on bread. Place each asparagus spear on bread slice and roll up. Fasten with toothpick. Dip in butter. Put on cookie sheet and freeze. Slice in 3 pieces each. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Baked Potato Fans
instructions: Cut potatoes crosswise into 1/8-inch slice cutting only 3/4 through. Place cut side up in greased oblong baking dish 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inches. Brush with margarine; sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven brushing with butter once or twice for 45 minutes. Mix cheese and bread crumbs; sprinkle on paprika. Bake until tender 20 to 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain. Layer Tater Tots and hamburger in large baking dish. Top with soup. Bake for 1 hour. Place cheese slices on top about 10 to 15 minutes before done. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Dream Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for four minutes. Pour into pan very generously greased with solid vegetable shortening and floured. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Loosen from sides of pan remove and cool before icing with Buttercream icing.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Melt cream cheese and 1/2 cup margarine in large skillet. Brown onion celery pepper and mushrooms in remaining margarine. Add shrimp; saute until shrimp are pink. Drain slightly. Add soup garlic salt red pepper pepper sauce crabmeat rice and melted cheese along with cream cheese and margarine mixture. Combine gently. Place in shallow casserole dish. Top with Ritz cracker crumbs and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Becky'S Corn Chowder
instructions: Brown sausage and onion; drain and set aside. Cook potatoes in boiling water about 15 minutes or until tender. Add creamed corn kernel corn milk seasonings sausage and onions. Simmer 20 minutes.

title: Candied Yams
instructions: Stove top directions Pour sweet potatoes and liquid into 2-quart saucepan. Cook until potatoes are heated through. Drain liquid and set aside. While sweet potatoes are heating combine butter or margarine and brown sugar in 1-quart saucepan and cook until hot but not boiling. Add nuts to sauce if desired and pour over hot sweet potatoes. Stir just to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs and pumpkin together. Beat until creamy. Add half of dry mixed ingredients until smooth and mix by hand other half into the batter. Pour into greased large jelly roll pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Chocolate Earthquake Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to the instructions on the box. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Company Squash Casserole
instructions: Place squash and onion in boiling salted water to cover. Cover and cook 5 minutes; drain well and set aside. Melt 3 tablespoons oleo in a heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Add cheese and stir until melted. Combine squash mixture cheese sauce and mushrooms; spoon into lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Melt 2 tablespoons oleo and stir in cracker crumbs and pecans. Sprinkle over squash. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pork With Cider
instructions: Thoroughly dredge pork with flour. Heat oil in a large frypan until hot. Carefully add pork. Cook until browned on all sides. Remove pork; drain on paper towels. Place in casserole.

title: 1 2 3 4 Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in bowl. Add eggs one at a time while slowly blending. Blend milk and sifted flour a little at a time continuing to blend. Add baking powder and extract. Continue to beat at medium speed for about 6 to 8 minutes. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured cake pans and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli in food processor (fine). Combine with onion raisins and crumbled bacon. Mix with Miracle Whip vinegar and sugar.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Drop from spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Sweet Potatoes In Orange Sauce
instructions: Boil until barely tender (with jackets). Peel and slice. Make sauce.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in skillet and drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Heat in skillet until bubbly. Add 1/2 cup shredded cheese. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Cut biscuits in half crosswise and place cut side down on top of casserole. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup shredded cheese over biscuits. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Line bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan with graham crackers. Layer vanilla pudding banana Cool Whip strawberries pineapple and coconut. Chill and serve.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Flour chicken. Fry in small amount of grease. Pour rice in bottom of casserole dish. Place chicken pieces on top of all the other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs vanilla and vinegar. Sift dry ingredients and add buttermilk and food coloring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Short Cookies
instructions: Mix all well with hands. Divide into 2 parts. Wrap in foil and chill overnight. Slice or roll in balls and flatten. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Nuts may be added.

title: Moist Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix until well blended; spoon into well-greased and floured large loaf pan. Bake 1 hour or until done.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour sugar milk and eggs. Beat until smooth. Pour approximately 1-inch of oil in skillet heating until very hot but not smoking. Pour 1/3 cup batter into funnel (with opening of 1/4-inch) plugging hole with finger. Hold funnel over skillet remove finger and dribble batter into hot oil. Move funnel in a slow circular motion forming spirals. Fry funnel cake 1 minute or until edges are golden brown; turn with slotted spatula and fry until golden. Drain on paper towels. Repeat process with remaining batter. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve warm. Yield Twelve 4 to 5-inch cakes.

title: Chocolate Eclair Pie
instructions: Line approximately a 9 x 13-inch shallow baking dish with graham crackers. Prepare instant pudding by package instructions. Combine vanilla pudding with Cool Whip. Melt icing in microwave or on stove top (dont get it too liquid; melt enough to spread). Cover graham crackers with pudding mixture then cover pudding mixture with chocolate icing. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving. You can use all low-fat ingredients.

title: Pam'S Orange Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine sugar and water in a medium saucepan. Add orange slivers and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves and syrup boils. Lower heat and continue to cook for 8 minutes. Add butter and stir until melted. Cool slightly. Add reserved orange juice and eggs. Add dry ingredients to sugar-syrup mixture and mix until flour mixture is blended. Do not overmix.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Combine the cranberries and sugar. Let set for 4 hours. Dissolve the jello in the hot water. Add to the cranberries after they have set. Mix in the marshmallows nuts and pineapple. Put in your jello mold and chill.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Cook and bone the chicken; cut into bite size pieces. Do not use any salt. Mix the chicken with the rest of ingredients. Spray or grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and pour chicken mixture into it; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 10.

title: Scalloped Apples
instructions: Melt the butter and add the crumbs. Mix the sugar spices and grated lemon rind. Put 1 quarter of the crumbs in bottom of a buttered baking dish. Cover with half the apples. Sprinkle with 1/2 the sugar mix then add another 1/4 of the crumbs the remainder of the apples and rest of the sugar mix. Add the lemon juice and the water and put the rest of the crumbs on top. Cover; bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Cream all ingredients together. Roll into small balls. Bake for 10 minutes or until light brown at 450\u00b0.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Stir together flour baking powder baking soda and 3/4 tsp. salt. Set aside.

title: Pear Pie
instructions: Line a 9-inch pie plate with pastry. Pare core and slice pears into large bowl. Combine sugar flour cinnamon and nutmeg; pour this over pears after sprinkling with lemon juice. Toss all together and pour into pastry lined pan. Dot with butter. Place top crust over pears. Cut slits for escape of steam. Seal edges and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil chicken and cut into small cubes. Mix celery soup and cream of chicken soup in a pan. Add sour cream and bouillon cubes. Heat until bouillon cubes melt low heat. Mix chicken cheese peppers and one cup of mixture. Mix well. Cover bottom of 9 x 15-inch glass baking dish with Pam cooking spray. Cover bottom of dish with soup mix. Dip the tortilla into soup mixture place chicken mixture into center of tortilla. Leave about one inch on right side. Fold up bottom and fold each side over one another. Place folded side down on dish. Pour remainder of soup mixture over tortillas. Top with more cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Let set for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Snowball Candy
instructions: Melt butter and mix with cream cheese. Add nuts powdered sugar and vanilla; mix well. Roll in little balls. Roll balls in coconut. Put in refrigerator and chill.

title: Brownies
instructions: There is no baking powder or soda in this recipe. Mix all ingredients together well. Bake about 20 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 and frost with thin icing.

title: Lemon Chicken And Rice
instructions: Saute chicken and onion in butter until chicken is lightly browned about 5 minutes. Stir in cornstarch cook 1 minute. Add broth carrots lemon juice and salt; bring to a full boil. Stir in pea pods parsley and rice. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Cooking time 25 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients stirring with a wire whisk to remove large lumps. Add oil and next 2 ingredients stirring until smooth. Stir in chocolate morsels. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Yield One 10-inch cake.

title: Venison Marinade
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Marinate venison overnight.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs. Add flour salt and soda. Drain juice from fruit into batter. Fold in fruit by hand. Sprinkle coconut over top of batter. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Six Week Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Roll in cinnamon and sugar after removing from oven. Use butter as needed. Will keep six weeks in refrigerator.

title: Blond Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients. Then fold in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Dust top with powdered sugar when cooled. Delicious!

title: Crunchy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking soda and salt. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat butter margarine sugars egg milk and vanilla in bowl until blended. Stir in flour mixture alternately with oil until mixture is thoroughly mixed. Stir in corn flakes oats and chocolate chips. Drop by heaping teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Sausage
instructions: Bake sausage in oven for 35 minutes. Place ingredients in crock-pot or saucepan and simmer until completely dissolved stirring often. Cut cooked sausage and dip in sauce for snack or put sausage in sauce and serve.

title: Swedish Ginger Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream butter and sugar. Add egg and beat until light and fluffy. Add orange peel corn syrup and water; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients; stir into creamed mixture. Chill dough thoroughly.

title: Mexican Pizza(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cook ground turkey through. Add taco seasoning. Spray baking sheets with cooking spray. Place 5 tortillas on sheets. Top each with refried beans and ground turkey. Top each with another tortilla. Spread with approximately 2 tablespoons of salsa or picante sauce shredded cheese olives and chilies. Bake at 400\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Cut into 4 slices and serve. Makes 5 servings.

title: Creamy Holiday Fudge
instructions: In top of double boiler melt chocolate over boiling water stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Add milk salt and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Spread mixture evenly into waxed paper lined 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board. Peel off paper and cut into squares. Tightly cover any leftovers. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Flaky Pastry
instructions: With a fork mix the first 4 ingredients. In a small bowl beat 1/2 cup of water and remaining ingredients together. Add to first mixture and blend with fork until dry ingredients are moistened. With hands mold dough in a ball and chill at least 15 minutes. Refrigerated dough can be rolled at once. Dough can be stored in refrigerator up to 3 days or frozen until ready to use. Makes two double-crust 9-inch pies and one 9-inch shell.

title: Fern'S Cake That Won'T Last
instructions: Mix by hand sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour salt cinnamon and soda. Add first mixture then add nuts pineapple and bananas until creamy. Bake in well oiled and floured pan (tube or Bundt) 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Batter will be stiff and difficult to mix but it can be done and worth the effort. Cake will be very heavy like a fruit cake. Serves 16 to 18.

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Bars
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Press into bottom of 9x13. Melt chocolate in double boiler and quickly spread on top of peanut butter mixture. Cool in fridge 30 minutes. Remove and cut into squares. Return to fridge to allow chocolate to harden completely. Servings 50 or more.

title: Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter with brown sugar until fluffy; blend in grated peels and spices. Put molasses in saucepan and bring to a boil; pour into butter mixture and blend well. Add beaten eggs; beat until thoroughly mixed. Sift all dry ingredients except powdered sugar and salt and add to butter mixture stirring vigorously until dough is smooth and pliable. Wrap in waxed paper and chill 1 hour.

title: Spinach And Mushroom Sauté
instructions: In 5 to 6-quart Dutch oven melt butter over medium-high heat. Add shallot and garlic; saut 2 minutes. Add mushrooms; continue to saut until tender about 4 minutes.

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Combine meat rice and onion salt. Shape in small balls. Heat soup and water in skillet. Drop balls in mixture. Cook 30 minutes until meat is done and rice fluffy.

title: Chicken St. Louis
instructions: Melt oleo in small roaster. Pour rice on melted oleo. Put chicken breasts on top of rice. Pour on soup and 1 can water. Sprinkle packet of seasoning mix (from Uncle Bens) over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Trim fat from meat and cut in bite-size pieces. Coat meat in flour and brown meat in oil. When meat is brown add instant beef broth and 4 or 5 cups water. Cook in crock-pot for 3 hours or until meat is tender. When meat is tender add rest of vegetables celery salt garlic powder seasoned salt and onion powder. When vegetables are tender thicken broth to make gravy.

title: Mound Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Combine condensed milk and cream of coconut. Punch holes in cake while warm and pour mixture over cake. When cake is completely cool spread whipped topping over top of cake and sprinkle coconut over cool whip. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: 4Th Of July Dessert
instructions: Note Allow each layer to gel about 2 hours before next one is made.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Use 1 to 2 tablespoons to a cup of hot water.

title: Cranberry-Orange Relish
instructions: Wash and cut oranges (do not peel) into quarters and remove seeds. Wash and pick over cranberries. Put cranberries and oranges through fine blade of food grinder. Stir in sugar. Cover and refrigerate. This can be made several days ahead.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and both sugars. Add peanut butter and mix. Add eggs and vanilla and beat together well. Sift soda and flour together and add to the first mixture. Mix well roll into rectangular loaves and chill. Slice place on cookie sheet and press out with floured fork. Dough freezes well with little or no thawing before it is sliced. This dough makes a soft cookie or a crunchy cookie depending on baking time. Very light color will produce a soft cookie golden or medium brown will produce a crunchy cookie. This is my mothers recipe.

title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients blending thoroughly. Chill. Serve in lettuce cups.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add pineapple salt onion pepper and 1 cup nuts. Shape into ball and cool overnight. Roll in remaining nuts. This ball can be re-shaped after use and stored in the refrigerator for over a week.

title: Palm Springs Dressing
instructions: Finely mince (tops and all) the green onions. Stir into the sour cream. Add lemon juice mayonnaise cheese salt and pepper. Allow to stand several hours before serving. Makes 4 generous servings.

title: Crock-Pot Cornish Hens
instructions: Put all in crock-pot with hens on top. Salt and pepper. Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Dollie Kingery'S Cracker Jack Popcorn
instructions: Mix ingredients over low heat stirring constantly. Pour over the popcorn and place in a large greased pan and bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Pour out onto wax paper and let dry. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Barbecue Rice
instructions: Saute celery onion and oleo. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Bring the first 3 ingredients to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes until thickening consistency. Pour half into a large shallow baking dish. Add potatoes and top with remaining syrup. Sprinkle brown sugar on top of this. Add dots of butter and some lemon wedges if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes basting often.

title: Fancy Walnuts
instructions: Place all ingredients in large flat frying pan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until water disappears. Pour onto cookie sheet and let dry.

title: Broccoli Rigatoni
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package. Cook broccoli according to package. Cool and mix together. Melt Velveeta cheese in saucepan. Add milk and oleo; mix together. Mix with broccoli and rigatoni. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad Cake
instructions: Beat all together (include syrup from fruit salad) for 3 minutes with electric mixer. Dont grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Spread icing on cake when warm (full of holes).

title: Teri'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first nine ingredients until well blended. (I use my hands.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Combine catsup brown sugar vinegar mustard and nutmeg. During the last 1/2 hour of baking time pour over top of meat loaf and continue baking.

title: Low-Fat Homemade Tortilla Chips
instructions: Cover a baking sheet with foil and spray with vegetable cooking spray. Stack tortillas on top of each other and cut into eighths. Spread pieces on baking sheet and spray lightly with vegetable spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Roasted Vegetable Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place leeks in a shallow roasting pan and drizzle with olive oil and chicken broth. Sprinkle with thyme salt and pepper. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Basic Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into freezer. To make peach ice cream use 1 quart peaches. Add 1/2 cup more sugar and use only 2 quarts milk.

title: Golden Chicken
instructions: Prepare chicken for roasting. Melt butter in saucepan. Add onion and celery cook until tender. Stir in seasoning and stock. Remove from heat. Add corn flake crumbs tossing lightly. Stuff chicken place in center of foil. Brush with syrup from peaches. Bring foil together over chicken. Place in shallow roasting pan. Roast in 450\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour. Open foil and flatten in pan. Place drained peaches cup side up around chicken and baste with pan drippings. Roast about 20 minutes longer. Yield 4 servings.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese and condensed milk together. Add lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate. Pour cherry pie filling on top when ready to serve.

title: Copper Pennies Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender. Drain and cool. Layer carrots pepper onion and pimentos. In a saucepan mix soup oil sugar and seasonings. Boil about 3 minutes stirring until sugar is dissolved. Pour over vegetables. Cool cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Neiman-Marcus Squares
instructions: This will be a thick paste. Mix and press into 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan greased and floured. Mix 3 eggs 1 box cream cheese and 1 box powdered sugar. Pour over first layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs 5 minutes. Gradually add sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Fold in dry ingredients that have been sifted together. Line a jelly roll pan with wax paper. Spray Pam on wax paper. Fill pan with mixture and spread evenly. Top with chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Turn out onto clean tea towel that has been sprinkled with powdered sugar. Peel off wax paper. Roll up towel immediately and cool. Unroll and spread with filling.

title: Maple Chicken
instructions: In a large saucepan put chicken and all other ingredients except the rice. Cover. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Add rice. Cook for 20 minutes or until rice is done. Yields 4 servings.

title: Quick Peach Pie
instructions: Melt margarine in baking dish. Peel peaches cut into pieces and place in melted butter. Mix together the remaining ingredients. Pour this batter over the sliced peaches and butter. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust rises to top and browns.

title: Apple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time mixing well after each addition. Blend in vanilla. Add combined flour baking powder and baking soda alternately with sour cream mixing well after each addition.

title: Chocolate Banana Pudding Pie
instructions: Microwave chocolate milk and margarine in medium microwave bowl on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes stirring every 30 seconds. Stir until chocolate is melted. Spread evenly into crust. Refrigerate for 30 minutes until chocolate is firm. Arrange banana slices over chocolate. Pour milk into large bowl; add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 1 minute. Let stand for 5 minutes. Spoon over bananas. Spread with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for 4 hours until set. Store leftover pie in refrigerator. Makes 8 servings. Preparation time 20 minutes.

title: Frozen Cucumbers
instructions: Mix sugar salt and vinegar. Pour over vegetables and soak overnight. Next day put in containers and freeze.

title: Mom'S Communion Bread
instructions: Beat 140 strokes no less and no more. Roll out and cook at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Immediately cut into bite size pieces leaving about 4 strips to be broken at time of Communion.

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Fry bacon. Boil 1/4 cup vinegar and 3/4 cup water. Add to blended 1/3 cup bacon grease 1 tablespoon flour 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/3 cup sugar. Pour over lettuce onion and bacon.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Melt oleo in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Beat eggs; add sugar and vanilla and mix together. Pinch bread into chunks and combine into milk mixture. Pour in baking dish over melted oleo. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done in the middle.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Layer potatoes (sliced) the onion (sliced thin) and then layer cabbage (wedged). Salt and pepper as you layer. Add 1 tablespoon meat grease butter and water according to how much you cook. Then put the corned beef on top of the cabbage and be sure to have the pan with airtight lid. Let cook for 1 hour and 10 minutes on low heat.

title: Stuffed Cantaloupe Salad
instructions: Cut melons in half lengthwise and scoop out seeds; spoon cottage cheese into each half. Top cheese with strawberries and blueberries. Thick Fruit Dressing spooned over servings makes 4 servings.

title: Indian Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix in baking dish. Dot with bits of butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can add layers of cracker crumbs.

title: Orange Orange Salad
instructions: Mix dry Jell-O powder with Cool Whip thoroughly. Add cottage cheese and fruits. Stir to blend. Refrigerate until set.

title: Mincemeat Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs mincemeat and flour; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Cherry Supreme Pie
instructions: Mix all together and press into ungreased large pie plate. Bake this crust at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool.

title: Summer Fruit Basket
instructions: Make a 2-inch strip in middle of watermelon from top to just above center. Slice watermelon from top to just above center on each side of the middle strip. Remove husk on each side. Scoop out insides on each side. Can make edges scalloped or jagged with carving knife. Use melon baller to make cantaloupe and honeydew balls. Cut strawberries in half. Quarter and peel oranges. Fill watermelon with fruit.

title: Torte Pie Crust
instructions: Beat egg whites and vanilla until foamy. Gradually add 1 cup sugar beating to stiff peaks. Mix together nuts cracker crumbs and baking powder. Fold into the egg whites. Spread into a well-greased 9-inch pie plate building up the sides. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until dry on outside. Serve with strawberries and whipped cream or serve with strawberry pie filling.

title: Cheese Clam Chowder
instructions: Drain clams and reserve liquid. Add enough water to measure 1 1/3 cups and heat to boiling in 1-quart saucepan. Dissolve bouillon cubes in the boiling liquid.

title: Oven Stew(This Stew Is Even Better With Homemade Biscuits!)
instructions: In a double boiler scald milk. In a separate pan heat the oysters in their own liquid but do not boil! Combine in double boiler and add butter salt and pepper. Stir and remove from burner. Ready to eat! Serves 4.

title: Creamy Chicken Breasts
instructions: Use a 13 x 9-inch baking dish lightly greased. Layer chicken; put cheese on top. Combine soup and milk (thick). Spoon over chicken. Sprinkle on top the stuffing mix and drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (50 to 55 minutes).

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and marshmallow cream. Add Cool Whip. Serve with strawberries apple slices banana slices grapes pineapple chunks cantaloupe etc.

title: Barbecue
instructions: In a pan combine beef brown sugar mustard pepper water vinegar and butter. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add salt ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chili Soup
instructions: In large saucepan brown beef and cook green pepper and onion with chili powder until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat stirring occasionally. Makes about 6 1/2 cups.

title: P. T.'S Beans
instructions: Combine all in a casserole dish. Top with sliced bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms With Sherry
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and chop finely. Melt 1/2 of butter and cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients with exception of lemon and sherry. Place into mushroom caps. Place on flat pan; add sherry remaining butter and drop of lemon juice on each mushroom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Shish Ka Robert
instructions: Blend all ingredients except beef. Pour over beef and marinate overnight or at least 4 hours. Remove meat from marinade.

title: Tropical Salad Mold
instructions: Dissolve jello in cup of boiling water. Drain liquid from canned fruit into a cup. Finish filling cup with white wine. Add to jello mixture stir then add fruit. Refrigerate until set. Serves 4.

title: Deviled Ham Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll in 1/2 cup nuts or parsley flakes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat the eggs and mix with the first 5 ingredients. Put in greased casserole. Cover with thick layer of Cheddar cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cranberry Christmas Punch
instructions: Dissolve cherry gelatin in boiling water. Stir in lemonade. Add cold water and cranberry juice cocktail. Do not add ginger ale until you are ready to serve. Pour punch over ice cubes or ice ring that has been frozen with additional cranberry juice. This will keep the punch from becoming diluted as the ice melts.

title: Roast Duck
instructions: Wash duck; dry inside. Rub salt inside and out. Rub pepper inside only. Sprinkle caraway seed inside and out. Place duck on rack in roasting pan. Have oven turned to 400\u00b0 for half hour then turn oven down to 350\u00b0 for 3 hours. All fat will be in the bottom of the pan and your duck will be crisp on the outside and juicy inside. Serve with wild rice broccoli spears and crisp green salad.

title: Fried Frog'S Legs(Modern)
instructions: Beat egg; mix in cornmeal salt pepper and onion powder. Dip frogs legs in batter and pan-fry in hot lard for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
