instructions: Thoroughly cream shortening sugars eggs and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter. Add dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture. Add chocolate chips. Mix them into dough. Drop by teaspoons or make into balls and put on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down a little with hand or glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until done.

title: Chicken Breast Supreme
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt and paprika. Place in 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan. Dissolve chicken bouillon cube in boiling water. Add wine instant minced onion curry powder and pepper. Pour over chicken.

title: Double Chocolate Nuggets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cake mix oil and eggs. Stir in chocolate pieces. Drop a teaspoonful onto an ungreased cookie sheet. If desired top each cookie with a pecan half. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until cookies test done with a toothpick. Cool on cookie sheet about 1 minute then remove to rack to finish cooling.

title: Stuffed Turkey Mushrooms
instructions: Remove the stems on the mushrooms and chop. Heat liquid Butter Buds in a skillet and cook the onion and ground turkey. Add the chopped mushroom stems and other ingredients. Cook this mixture about 5 minutes. Stuff this mixture into the mushroom caps and sprinkle with the grated cheese. Preheat your broiler and place in oven for 2 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts. Yields 20 stuffed mushrooms.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Melt sugar and butter. Add milk and boil 3 minutes. Cool and add powdered sugar until thick enough to spread.

title: Microwave Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix baking mix paprika salt and pepper; coat chicken. Arrange pieces skin side up in rectangular microwavable dish 12 x 7 x 2-inch with thickest parts to outside edges. Cover with waxed paper and microwave on High 10 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Microwave 8 to 12 minutes longer.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream margarine. Add sugar. Beat until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Sift all dry ingredients together. Add to mixture alternately with buttermilk starting and ending with flour.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and jello and set aside while preparing fruit. Mix fruit and cheese mixture. Lightly mix one medium sized carton Cool Whip and pour in mold or container (for me a mold does not work because it does not set enough for a mold). Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Will keep for 3 or 4 days.

title: Basil Bread Sticks
instructions: Cut loaf in half (5 x 4-inch). Then cut each half in half (sandwich style). Cut each sandwich style half into 3 (1-inch) wedges 5-inches long total of 12 wedges 1 x 5-inch long. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread mix on all cut sides of bread wedges. Space on ungreased cookie sheets and bake at 425\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes or until brown. Serve warm.

title: Peanut-Cheese-Raisin Sandwiches
instructions: Spread one side of bread slices with butter. Broil 6-inches from heat until lightly browned. Set aside. Combine peanut butter and remaining ingredients stirring well. Spread mixture on untoasted side of 5 bread slices. Top each with another slice toasted side up. Yields 5 servings.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions. Cut chicken in chunks. Grate cheese. In a lightly greased 2-quart casserole place a layer of broccoli. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder; spread on top of broccoli. Place a layer of chicken on top of soup mixture; sprinkle with cheese. Sprinkle bread crumbs over all; dot with butter. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Smash bread down and roll into large rectangle (10 x 15-inch). Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with oregano. Lay on cheese and meat slices. Sprinkle with additional Cheddar cheese.

title: Crunchy Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Mix until blended reserve 1/4 cup. Press in pie pan to form crust. Add ice cream and sprinkle 1/4 cup on top. Put in freezer 4 to 6 hours. Ready to serve.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix pumpkin beaten egg yolks sugar salt and spices. Gradually add scalded milk and mix thoroughly. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour mixture into unbaked crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Pecan Pie
instructions: Place vanilla caramels water and oleo in the top of a double boiler. Heat stirring frequently until the caramels are melted and the sauce is smooth. Combine slightly beaten eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Gradually add the caramel sauce mixing well. Add pecan halves. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0; continue baking for 30 minutes. The pie filling will appear to be very soft while hot but will become firm as it cools.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix flour sugar margarine and pecans. Press into baking dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix Dream Whip according to directions. Beat in powdered sugar blend in cream cheese and pour over the crust. Refrigerate at least 2 or 3 hours until well set. Spoon cherry pie filling over top.

title: Quick And Easy Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cup biscuit mix sugar and pecans in mixing bowl. Add milk egg vanilla and oil. Beat by hand mixing well. Pour onto greased 8-inch round baking dish suitable for microwave cooking. Combine remaining ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle over batter. Micro cook 4 to 7 minutes on High. Rotating dish a half turn after 2 minutes. Check for doneness at 4 minutes. The cake is done when the top is almost dry and springs back when touched. Cool 15 minutes; drizzle with Orange Glaze. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Beat in eggs and add nuts coconut vanilla wafers (crushed) and vanilla. Bake at 270\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Cream Deuteronomy with Jeremiah 620 until light. Add the 3 Jeremiah 1711 one at a time beating after each addition. Add the 1 Samuel 1425. Sift and measure Judges 151. Take 2 cups of it and sift it with the Leviticus Amos and 2 Chronicles. Blend the remaining Judges 151 with 1 Samuel 3012 Nahum and Numbers and set aside. Add the sifted mixture to the creamed mixture alternating with Judges 525. Stir in the reserved mixture of 1 Samuel Nahum and Numbers. Bake in a loaf pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Glaze top with additional 1 Samuel 1425 and slivered toasted Numbers.

title: Salted Nut Rolls
instructions: Cream the marshmallow cream and vanilla together. Blend in the powdered sugar. Begin blending with mixer then work in with hands until all the sugar is blended in. Shape into rolls 1/2 x 1 1/2-inches long. Freeze rolls 2 to 3 hours until frozen hard. Melt the caramels with the cream. Dip rolls in caramel and then in chopped dry roasted peanuts. Lay out on a tray and freeze. After they are frozen put into a large plastic bag and keep frozen until you need them.

title: Noon On The Equator (Non-Alcoholic Drink)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in cocktail shaker and add ice cubes. Shake well and strain into glasses. Makes 1 serving.

title: Crunchy Imperial Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend crumbs cheese parsley garlic salt and pepper. Dip each piece of chicken in butter then in crumb mixture. Arrange in open shallow baking dish. Place any remaining ingredients over chicken. Bake one hour. Do not turn chicken.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat the egg yolks; stir in the sweetened condensed milk lime juice and a few drops of green food coloring. In a small bowl stiffly beat 1 egg white; fold into the milk mixture. Turn into baked and cooled 8 or 9-inch pastry shell. Beat 3 egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy; gradually beat in the sugar one tablespoon at a time until meringue is stiff but not dry. Spread on top of pie sealing carefully to edge of shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until meringue is golden. Cool. Chill before serving.

title: Slim 'N Trim Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preparation Combine ingredients and pour into a 9-inch pie shell. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes. Yield Six 117 calorie servings.

title: German Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour sugar butter cocoa baking soda salt eggs milk and vanilla. Beat at medium speed until blended. Stir in pecans. Drop dough into 1-1/4 inch balls on ungreased cookie sheet. flatten slightly. Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until almost set. Cool slightly; remove to wire rack. Cool completely. Prepare filling. Spread flat side of one cookie with 1 heaping tablespoon of filling; cover with flat side of second cookie. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup and remaining ingredients; shape into 6 patties. In skillet brown patties (use shortening if necessary); pour off fat. Blend in remaining soup and 1/3 cup water. Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until done. Stir often. Makes 6 servings.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain well. Stir in eggs milk bread pieces salt mustard and cheese. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased casserole pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Reception Punch For 100
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add orange and lemon slices if desired. Pour over ice in punch bowl.

title: Low Country Stew
instructions: Place sausage in very large deep pot. Cover with water then add corn red pepper Old Bay seasoning and Old Bay seasoning bag. Cook for 30 minutes. Add potatoes and beer. Cook for 1 hour then add shrimp. Cook for 30 minutes.

title: Angel'S Delight
instructions: Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water. Let stand until starts to gel. Beat Milnot until whipped. Add jello mixture. Beat well. Pour over crushed vanilla wafers. Use 9 x 13-inch pan. May top with a few crushed wafers.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan. Add onions. Cook until soft (10 minutes). Add rice. Put rice mixture into casserole dish. Add consomme and mushrooms. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Do not cover.

title: Baked Pineapple Chicken
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Combine reserved juice with garlic cornstarch Worcestershire sauce mustard and rosemary. Arrange chicken in shallow baking pan. Broil chicken until browned. Stir sauce pour over chicken and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Arrange lemon and pineapple slices around chicken. Spoon sauce from baking pan over chicken and continue baking 5 minutes longer. Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Pineapple Walnut Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour all ingredients into a bowl and mix thoroughly by hand. Pour into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Or pour into 11 x 16-inch cookie sheet and bake a 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Red Pepper Jelly
instructions: Bring sugar vinegar peppers and juice to a boil. Boil 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add Certo and green or red food coloring. Stir. Put in jars and seal. (Use only Certo.)

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Soak together for 1 hour in large bowl poppy seed and milk; add and beat the eggs oil sugar and almond extract. Mix separately both flours milk powder and baking powder. Add dry ingredients to wet. Mix. Bake in greased and floured cake pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. If desired ice with xxxx sugar icing with lemon juice.

title: Chili-O-Dip
instructions: Brown beef with bell pepper. Add other ingredients and bring to a boil. Serve with chips. (May pour into crock-pot to keep warm.)

title: Blackened Catfish
instructions: Put spices in a 1 gallon food storage bag. Close bag and shake well. Put 1 fillet in bag at a time and shake. Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add oil and heat over medium heat. Add catfish fillets skinned side up and cook 4 to 5 minutes until lightly blackened. Turn with spatula. Cook 4 to 5 minutes longer until fish feels firm. Serve with lemon slices.

title: Carrot Pennies
instructions: Slice and cook carrots until tender. Combine oil vinegar sugar and soup. Bring to a boil. Pour over carrots onion and peppers. Best if marinates overnight. Will keep for several days.

title: Barbecue Beef Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook ground beef and 1/2 cup of the onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce. Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with cheese.

title: Chicken Ramen
instructions: Cook chicken debone and cut into small pieces (reserve 1/2 cup liquid). Cook noodles; drain and add packet. Cook broccoli; drain.

title: Breakfast Brunch
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain well. Line a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with crescent rolls. Press edges together. Sprinkle with sausage and Mozzarella cheese. Combine remaining ingredients and beat well. Pour over sausage and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes then sprinkle with 1 cup grated Cheddar cheese. Put back in oven for 5 minutes.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Butter casserole dish. Tear dried beef and spread in bottom of dish. Wrap bacon around rolled up 1/2 of chicken breast. Place on beef. Mix soup and sour cream together. Pour over chicken. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 250\u00b0 to 275\u00b0 for 3 hours uncovered.

title: Tomato Marmalade
instructions: Select 4 quarts of firm ripe tomatoes. Peel and slice thin. Wash 6 lemons slice and remove seeds leaving the peel on. Put in a saucepan with the tomatoes lemons raisins and sugar. Cook slowly for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until mixture is thick. Put in small glasses (sterile) and cover with paraffin.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onions. Add other ingredients and simmer for at least 1 hour.

title: U.S. 31 Barbecues
instructions: Cook meat slowly until tender and falls apart. Mix all ingredients and cook in slow cooker for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. This is better if you can slow cook overnight.

title: Ice Cream Wafers
instructions: Blend sugar and shortening. Add egg beaten until velvety. Add flour and salt. Beat vigorously. Add flavoring. Mix.

title: Italian Zucchini
instructions: Wash zucchini and remove ends. Do not peel and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Cut onion and pepper into rings. Heat oil in 12-inch skillet. Place zucchini in skillet and brown lightly on both sides. Add onion and green pepper. Sprinkle in salt garlic salt pepper and oregano. Top with tomatoes. Cover and bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle cheese over vegetables. Simmer 15 minutes or until zucchini is tender and a fairly thick sauce.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
instructions: Sprinkle flour over meat and place in crock-pot. Cut up veggies and place on meat.

title: Gingerbread Dumplings
instructions: Bring applesauce to a boil. Add enough water to gingerbread mix to make a thick batter. Drop batter by spoonfuls into boiling applesauce. Cover and cook slowly until gingerbread is baked.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Chop up the vegetables. Blend other ingredients and mix with vegetables.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar. Add rest of ingredients to egg mixture and mix well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 12 x 2 1/2-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. While hot cover with marshmallow cream. Let cool.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken(Light)
instructions: Place chicken pieces skin sides up in ungreased rectangular pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over chicken. Cover and bake in 375\u00b0 oven 30 minutes. Spoon sauce over chicken; bake uncovered until thickest pieces are done about 30 minutes longer. Yields 6 servings 204 calories each.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello and Knox gelatine completely in boiling water. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cool until firm then cut into squares.

title: Cornbread(A.K.A. Yellow Brownies)
instructions: Combine Bisquick cornmeal and sugar. Add eggs then add milk. Beat well. Mix in melted butter or margarine. Place batter in greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Special Veggie Casserole
instructions: Bake at 300\u00b0 until bread crumbs are brown about 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan combine sugar milk butter and cocoa. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until mixture comes to a full boil (3 to 4 minutes). Quickly drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool completely. Store in refrigerator. Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Hot Mocha Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.\tStore mix in an airtight container.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and peanuts and cook 4 minutes on High. Add vanilla and butter. Cook 4 minutes more on High or until caramel colors. Add soda; pour onto greased cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Divan Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 425\u00b0. Remove pie crust from freezer. Invert one crust onto waxed paper and let thaw.

title: Nectarine-Brandy Sorbet
instructions: Puree nectarines in blender to measure about 3 to 4 cups. Add sugar; heat slowly in saucepan until sugar dissolves. Stir brandy lemon juice and zest into puree and pour into canister of ice cream freezer. Freeze according to manufacturers directions. Makes about 10 servings.

title: Boiled Ham Dinner
instructions: Cook ham (can use leftovers) with carrots and potatoes seasoned with a little garlic powder salt and black pepper. When these lack about 15 minutes cooking add quartered onion and cabbage. Lay these on top and steam until cabbage is cooked.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in baking dish. Mix sugar flour baking powder and milk together. Add cherries to the mixture. Pour in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients with wire whip. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish and freeze overnight. Take out of freezer 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Can be refrozen. Can use strawberry cherry or blueberry filling.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add eggs oil and strawberries. Stir until moist. Spoon into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Do not cook too long just until edges are starting to harden and draw away from the sides. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. A favorite for Afghanistan.

title: Meat And Cheese Tortillas
instructions: Cook ground beef until brown and crumbly; drain. Combine meat cottage cheese 1/2 cup Italian sauce green pepper onion olives and flour. Season and mix well.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Place torn lettuce pieces on bottom. Cauliflower pieces on next layer. Combine mayonnaise sugar and Parmesan cheese. Mix thoroughly. Spread mixture on top of lettuce cauliflower and onions. Seal. Refrigerate overnight. Add bacon just before tossing.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta and cool. Cook bacon and crumble or chop. Combine all ingredients. Marinate several hours in refrigerator. Add dressing and a little garlic powder.

title: Dessert Or Salad
instructions: Mix all together and chill thoroughly before using. Can be frozen and served as dessert.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients but cheese. Pour half in large greased skillet. Then add grated cheese. Then pour remaining mix on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and then dump rest of ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes with 1 teaspoon of salt until tender. Drain and mash potatoes. Blend in rest of ingredients. Put in 3-quart casserole. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Red, White And Blue Jello Salad
instructions: First Layer Make 1 box raspberry jello with 1 3/4 cups hot water as usual. Pour into mold. Set 2 hours.

title: Polish Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and form into very small balls. Place in oblong pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Cover them for the first hour of baking.

title: Pat'S Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients as listed. Add nectar last. Mix well pour into a greased and floured bundt pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels melted butter and 1/4 cup sugar. Press in 9 x 13-inch dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cool COMPLETELY. Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip together. Spread over crushed pretzels. Chill in freezer until completely firm (not frozen). Dissolve Jell-O in water. Stir in strawberries. Mix until thawed then add pineapple. Chill until firm.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Mix and simmer to thickness desired.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa milk and butter. Boil rapidly 1 1/2 minutes stirring all the time. Add oatmeal nuts and vanilla. Drop while hot on wax paper. Cool. Yields 50 cookies.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: 1. Grasp tick with thumb and finger and gently pull.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chow mein noodles. Put in ungreased casserole dish; sprinkle chow mein noodles on top with a little margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot about 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8. Freezes well.

title: Uncle Jim'S Whipped Turnip Puff
instructions: Mix all ingredients together very well. Spoon into greased 6-cup casserole dish and brush the top with a little butter. Bake in 375\u00b0 moderate oven for 1 hour. Enjoy!

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Divide mixture into 4 equal parts. Make a roll out of each part. (Roll will be approximately 2 inches in diameter and about 3 inches long.) Wrap each roll individually in foil being sure the dull side is out. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Punch holes on bottom of each roll and place on a broiler pan. Put 1/2-inch of water in bottom of pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Let cool enough to handle re-wrap and refrigerate. (Can also be frozen.)

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Place potato slice on large piece of foil; cover with onion. Add seasonings. Sprinkle with cheese and bacon and dot with butter. Wrap foil tightly. Cook about 1 hour on grill or until potatoes are done; turn several times. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Pot Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in Crisco. Stir in green beans soup and seasonings. Pour filling into onion pastry lined pie plate. Bake as directed.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Beef Porcupines
instructions: Combine rice-vermicelli mix with ground beef and eggs. Shape into meatballs in large skillet. Brown meat balls and drain off grease. Combine contents of seasoning packet and water. Pour over meat balls. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until thick gravy forms.

title: 7-Up Pork Chops
instructions: Season pork chops. Place in a shallow pan. Pour 7-Up over them. Sprinkle soup mix on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. LIGHTEN-UP BONELESS CHICKEN BREAST

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Thaw and drain the spinach. Melt the butter. Add all the ingredients and mix well with hands. Roll into balls and cook at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Ladyfinger Dessert With Cream Cheese And Pineapple
instructions: Cream the cream cheese; add sugar and mix until smooth. Add well drained pineapple then the Cool Whip.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spoon into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and celery; drain well. Set aside. Cook onion slowly in butter until tender. Add soup milk and cheese. Cook over medium heat stirring well until cheese melts. Stir in rice broccoli and celery. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish which has been buttered. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Best Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar. Whip until light beating well after each addition. Add 2 eggs at a time. Add flour and milk alternately then add vanilla with mixer on low speed. Pour batter into slightly greased and floured 10-inch tube pan; bake 1 1/2 hours to cook. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Cheddar Cheese Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: English Muffin Pizza
instructions: Place English muffins on cookie sheet. Spread pizza sauce on top of each muffin half. Add pizza topping as desired. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes or until muffin is toasted and cheese is melted.

title: Vegetable Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain and cool. Add vegetables and mix well. Combine milk vinegar sugar mayo salt and pepper. Add to macaroni mixture. Chill at least 4 hours before serving. Better if left overnight. Keeps well. Serves 10.

title: Vickie'S Cheesy Bacon Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes in oven or microwave until done. Slice into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Dot with butter or margarine. Salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese. Crumble bacon on top of cheese. Bake approximately 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 until cheese is bubbly. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Italian Beef Sandwiches
instructions: In a deep baking pan place roast and 1-inch of water. Sprinkle with salt and cover with onions. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat from pan. Reserve and chill broth. Refrigerate meat until firm. Cut into very thin slices. Place in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

title: Tomato Casserole
instructions: Add sugar tomato paste tomatoes and garlic. Cook down until \dry enough\. Add bread crumbs until \dry like you want it\ (about 1 cup). Bake in a Pyrex dish. Freezes well.

title: No Bake Cake
instructions: Crumble cake and spread evenly in bottom of large pan 9 x 13-inch. Pour pineapple over top; heat milk and marshmallows until dissolved. Pour over the layer of pineapple. When ready to serve put Cool Whip over top. Then sprinkle with coconut.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients except All-Bran. Mix All-Bran milk oil and egg whites together and let sit 5 minutes. Stir dry ingredients into wet mixture. Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups or line cups with paper liners. Bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Layer noodles sliced hard-boiled eggs peas and tuna. Heat mushroom soup and milk to boiling and pour over mixture and top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Kisses
instructions: Combine all ingredients except candy kisses. Mix until dough forms. Shape into balls (1 teaspoon). Roll in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss. Press down firmly so that cookie cracks around the edge.

title: Bev'S Lemon Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour margarine and powdered sugar in small bowl. Press evenly in bottom and about 3/8-inch up sides of an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. (If dough is sticky flour fingers.) Bake 20 minutes. Beat remaining ingredients in a medium bowl on medium speed until light and fluffy. Pour over hot crust and bake until no indentation remains when touched lightly in center about 25 minutes. Let stand until cool; cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Makes 25 squares.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread mixture in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl with hands; shape into a large ball. Roll in ground pecans and parsley flakes. Freeze 24 hours.

title: Elegant Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into greased casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about an hour. Sprinkle paprika on top also before baking if desired. Serves 8.

title: Date Nut Torte
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl mix dates walnuts flour and sugar. In small bowl at high speed beat eggs for 5 minutes or until thick and lemon colored. Stir into date mixture. Batter will be very thick. Spread evenly in well-buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until wooden spoon comes out clean. Cool and then cut into squares.

title: Slow Cooker Brisket
instructions: Place brisket in crock-pot cutting meat if necessary to fit into pot. In a bowl stir together all other ingredients and pour over meat. Cover; cook on low heat setting about 10 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat reserving juices; cover to keep warm.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes melted margarine sour cream soup onion and cheese. Put in a 13 x 9-inch pan and top with crushed potato chips. Pour the reserved 1/4 stick melted margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients. Add 5 slices white bread cubed and one No. 2 can crushed pineapple drained. Mix all thoroughly and bake in a greased 1 1/2 quart casserole for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Good with ham.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Pour olive oil into wooden salad bowl. Squeeze approximately 2 tablespoons of lemon juice into bowl. Whisk together. Add salt pepper Parmesan and a pressed clove of garlic to taste. Toss with rest of ingredients and enjoy!

title: No-Peek Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In a large bowl mix long grain rice mushroom soup celery soup water parsley and curry powder. Pour into baking pan or casserole. Place chicken on top. Sprinkle with onion soup mix. Cover and seal with foil. Bake for 2 1/2 hours. Do not open until ready to serve. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lite Mushroom Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes; dry prick with fork and bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 65 minutes or until soft.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix everything together but chocolate chips. Add chips last. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese and marshmallow cream together with a mixer. Cut up fruit and serve with dip at room temperature.

title: Sausage Minestrone Soup
instructions: In a large kettle or Dutch oven brown sausage onion and garlic. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients except beans spaghetti and cheese. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 1 hour. Stir in beans and spaghetti. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 10 minutes or until spaghetti and green beans are tender. Serve with Parmesan cheese. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 4 servings.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Crumble cookies in blender. Cream together cream cheese sugar and margarine. In another bowl mix the pudding with the milk and Cool Whip. Combine cream cheese with pudding. Put paper plate in the bottom of a clay flower pot and starting with the Oreo cookie crumbs alternate layers of pudding and cookies ending with cookies on top. For a touch of realism add artificial flowers and a spade for decoration. Can also use gummy worms.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Add Velveeta and margarine. Stir until blended over low heat. Pour into casserole. Crumble Ritz crackers; mix with 1/2 stick margarine. Top the broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites in a bowl; set aside. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks. Beat well. Sift flour. Measure. Sift again with soda and salt. Alternately add flour and sour cream to egg mixture a little at a time. Fold in beaten egg whites and vanilla (almond and lemon if desired). Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients thoroughly until mixture boils stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add baking soda and vanilla. Mix well. Pour over about 6 quarts of popped popcorn. Add peanuts to taste. Put in a large roasting pan and bake 1 hour at 250\u00b0 stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Yum Yum Dessert
instructions: Mix together the flour butter nuts and sugar and pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool. Combine the powdered sugar 2 cups topping and cream cheese in electric mixer and beat at low speed until well blended. Spread on cooled bottom layer. Beat the 2 packages of instant pudding with 3 cups milk and spread on cream cheese layer.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Mix butter and sugar together until creamy. Add spices and blend thoroughly. Mixture must be kept in the refrigerator.

title: Peanut Butter Roundups
instructions: Blend shortening sugar and brown sugar. Add and beat eggs. Add and blend the peanut butter. Stir into mixture the flour salt and soda. Add oats. Add last the Rice Krispies. Make small balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Press with a fork to make crisscross. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until the way you like them.

title: Baked Chicken With Sour Cream
instructions: Wrap each chicken piece with a slice of chipped beef then wrap with bacon. Place chicken in greased casserole dish and pour soup/sour cream mixture over. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve with green salad or fruit salad.

title: Simple And Delicious Sesame Seed Dressing
instructions: Toast seeds in 200\u00b0 oven until light brown. Combine next 5 ingredients in blender. Add vinegar and oil slowly. Pour into a jar. Add seed and refrigerate. Best the next day! Enjoy!

title: Mexican Trash Appetizer
instructions: Mix together the above ingredients. Season with salt pepper and garlic powder. Add 4 tablespoons vinegar and 6 tablespoons oil. Marinate. Chill. Drain and then serve with tortilla chips.

title: Grandma'S German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in water; set side to cool. Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Add cooled chocolate. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with milk to the creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in a greased and floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool and turn onto a cake plate.

title: Chicken And Macaroni Cheese Casserole
instructions: Melt butter with onions in saucepan. Add soup and milk. Add cheese (1/2 cup). In a 9 x 12-inch pan have chicken and macaroni. Stir in soup mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add 1/2 cup cheese. Bake until melted.

title: Butterscotch Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients then add those remaining. Cook over medium heat until thick in double boiler. Pour into two prebaked pie shells and top with meringue. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Spanish Bean Soup
instructions: Dice potatoes and onion. Combine all the ingredients in large pot with lid and simmer for 3 hours. Serve with Cuban bread.

title: Cherry Torte
instructions: Beat egg whites very stiff along with cream of tartar. Slowly add sugar and vanilla. Fold in nuts and crackers. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour in and spread evenly. Bake about 24 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Cool. If using Dream Whip whip and spread on torte. Top with pie filling. Chill 4 hours. Can be kept several days in refrigerator without getting soggy.

title: Frozen Cole Slaw
instructions: Boil sugar vinegar water and seeds for 1 minute and let cool completely.

title: Blue Cheese Meat Loaf Roll
instructions: Tear the bread into small pieces. Combine bread and milk; stir in cheese and 1 egg. Set aside.

title: Grilled Chevron Chops(Beef Goat Chops)
instructions: Marinate loin or rib chops in a mixture of equal amounts of balsamic vinegar olive oil and dijon mustard for several hours in the refrigerator and then barbecue.

title: Ribbon Cake
instructions: Sift flour and cream of tartar 3 times. Beat all together. Divide into 3 parts leaving 2 layers white. To third part add molasses. Add cinnamon cloves nutmeg and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt oleo and cocoa. Stir in sugar eggs flour salt and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Cool. Butter a pan (do not flour). Take out of oven and cover with marshmallows. Let them melt. Put on icing.

title: Unbelievable Lemon Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put all ingredients except coconut in blender and run on low speed for 3 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch pie pan. Let stand for 5 minutes. Sprinkle coconut on top. Place in oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool before serving.

title: Raisin Filled Cookies
instructions: Cook box of raisins with enough water to cover raisins. Add sugar and cornstarch to thicken; cook for 7 minutes. Set aside to cool. Cream sugar shortening and eggs; add vanilla and milk. Add baking powder and salt to flour. Mix well. When dough is stiff enough roll out thin. Cut with cookie cutter; put on ungreased cookie sheet. Put a spoonful of raisins on and then put another on the top. Make a vent on top and bake 6 to 10 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Sherry Cake
instructions: Mix all for 5 minutes. Pour in a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes and remove. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. If desired place slices of bacon on top.

title: Chicken Creole
instructions: Cook chicken with bay leaves. Remove bay leaves; debone and chop the chicken. Combine vegetables half the oleo tomato sauce and seasonings; simmer until vegetables are tender. Add the chopped chicken. Melt the remaining oleo in a skillet; blend in the flour and cook until brown. Add 1 cup broth stirring until thickened. Add to the chicken mixture and serve over rice or noodles. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate County Line and Colby cheeses. Leave setting at room temperature for 2 hours. Blend together with remaining ingredients. Form into ball. Sprinkle with paprika and roll in crushed walnuts. Chill.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix first three ingredients until blended and pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Brush beaten egg over the top of bread and continue baking for 15 minutes more. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast in shortening in Dutch oven. Combine onion soup mix with 2 cups water. Pour over roast; simmer turning occasionally for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. Add vegetables and cook until potatoes are tender. Remove roast onto serving dish. Blend flour and remaining water. Stir into gravy. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until thickened.

title: Hot Mulled Cider
instructions: Simmer all over low heat 30 to 40 minutes. Serve hot or warm. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Snappy Wieners
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Score wieners diagonally. In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Arrange wieners in sauce turning to coat well. Bake covered for 30 minutes or until heated thoroughly.

title: Chocolate Amaretto Pound Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. With Crisco shortening grease Bundt pan. Sift flour salt and baking powder together; set aside. Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add egg yolks extracts and cocoa; beat until smooth. Add sifted ingredients alternately with sour cream beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Gently blend in egg whites. Add Amaretto. Mix well until creamy. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour or until done. Let cake stand in pan 20 to 30 minutes and then invert onto wire rack. Top cooled cake with sifted powdered sugar. Add cherries on top for final holiday touch.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar egg water and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Beat thoroughly. Add flour and oatmeal. Add pecans. Drop by teaspoonfuls. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir to blend thoroughly. Season to taste with black pepper. Refrigerate.

title: Oriental Salad
instructions: Combine sugar Accent salt pepper vinegar and oil together. Mix and chill. Combine cabbage onions and noodles. Mix together. Toast almonds and sesame seed in 350\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes or until brown. Sprinkle on top of cabbage mixture. Toss salad with dressing right before serving.

title: Persimmon Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients except eggs in blender or food processor (hand mixer). Blend until smooth. Add eggs and blend for only a second or two. Pour into pie crust and bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until filling is set.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter 2 loaf pans (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch). Sift the flour sugar baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon together in a large bowl. Stir in the walnuts. Make a well in the center of these ingredients and add the oil eggs and pumpkin puree. Stir until the ingredients are well blended then fold in the raisins and rum. Spread the batter into prepared pans and bake for 1 hour. Allow to cool in the pans before removing and cutting. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Cranberry Refrigerator Cake
instructions: Mix together cranberries banana and sugar. Set aside. Place 1/2 of the crushed wafers in bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cream together butter and confectioners sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Spread over the crumbs. Top with a layer of the cranberry-banana mixture adding the nuts and spreading whipped cream over it. Cover with remaining wafers and chill overnight.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Place thawed potatoes in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Mix 1/2 butter soup cheese sour cream onions salt and pepper; pour over potatoes. Mix remaining 1/2 butter with crumbled corn flakes. Top casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad No. 1
instructions: Combine cranberries sugar and cold water; boil until berries are tender. Remove from heat and add jello which has been dissolved in boiling water. When berries and jello mixture has cooled add celery apples and nuts. Mix and pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Arrange pecan halves on top to decorate. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken broth and soup together. In oblong or square pan layer soup tortillas soup tortillas and soup. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover; sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Broccoli Slaw
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in medium size bowl. Combine last 3 ingredients in separate bowl. Mix well pour over salad blend and refrigerate.

title: Smoked Shrimp
instructions: Melt margarine and pour into pan. Place shrimp in margarine. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Place on smoker for 1 hour. Serves 5 or 6.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Place chops in an ovenproof pan. Place a lemon slice on each chop then a spoon of sugar on each slice of lemon then a tablespoon of catsup on top of the sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Discard all hard corn kernels. Use a large pan (such as turkey roasting pan) to mix in. Combine syrup sugar water vinegar and salt; cook slowly stirring constantly to 270\u00b0 or to hard ball stage (test by dropping a spoonful in cold water). Remove from heat; add vanilla and oil stirring only enough to mix. Pour over popped corn stirring constantly until all corn is coated. Slip Baggies on both hands; grease lightly. Work quickly; shape lightly into balls. Put popcorn balls on wax paper to cool then wrap each in its own Baggie.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients by hand except pecans. Form into a ball and roll in pecans until covered.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: In large skillet cook meat and onion until meat is lightly browned and onion is tender. Add salt and pepper. Add drained beans and soup; pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Mash potatoes while hot; add milk and egg. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon in mounds over casserole. Sprinkle potatoes with cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pineapple Spread
instructions: Blend cheese and mayonnaise until smooth. Stir in ginger and pineapple. Chill. Let set at room temperature 1/2 hour before serving. Yields 3 cups. (Best if made a day or two ahead of time.) Serve with crackers or as a filling for small sandwiches.

title: Mekluba
instructions: Saute onions in 1 1/2 teaspoons of oil until transparent. Remove onions and set aside. Place meat or poultry in reserved oil. Saute until lightly brown then cover with water. Bring to a boil and skim off foam. Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt 1/2 teaspoon of pepper and bay leaf. Simmer for 1 hour. Add onions. Reserve the stock.

title: Reuben En Croute
instructions: In saucepan over medium heat cook onion in 1 tablespoon butter until tender. Stir in sauerkraut 1/4 cup mustard and caraway seed. Melt remaining butter. Stack phyllo dough sheets brushing butter in between each layer. Top with layers of corned beef cheese and sauerkraut mixture to within 1 inch of edges. Roll up from long edge jelly-roll fashion tucking in ends and brushing seams with butter. Place roll seam side down on greased baking sheet. Cut slits on top of roll in 12 even sections about 1/2-inch deep. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Popeye For Breakfast
instructions: Split and toast an English muffin. Top with a poached egg on each half. Saute a small package of frozen spinach (well drained) with garlic in a little olive oil. Put this on top of the poached eggs. Top with shredded Mozzarella cheese. Microwave long enough to melt the cheese. Great breakfast to start your day!!

title: Carbonara
instructions: Stir-fry sausage and ham until lightly brown. Remove from wok. Have all ingredients ready and measured. Add hot spaghetti to meat with butter and parsley. Mix well. At once pour in eggs and continue to blend quickly lifting and mixing the pasta to coat well. Sprinkle in the 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and a dash of pepper. Mix again. Serve and top with additional Parmesan cheese.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In nonstick skillet over medium-high heat cook chicken 5 minutes or until done and juices evaporate stirring often. Add soup and salsa. Heat through. Place tortillas on 2 baking sheets. Top half of each tortilla with about 1/2 cup soup mixture. Spread to within 1/2-inch of edge. Moisten edges of tortillas with water. Fold over and seal. Bake 5 minutes or until hot.

title: Christmas Eggnog
instructions: Beat egg yolks until thick. Mix in both milks gradually. Blend in salt and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold in egg whites and rum flavoring. Pour into chilled punch bowl. Garnish with sprinkling of nutmeg and whipped cream if desired.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Mix together ingredients and pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle 1 box yellow cake mix over pumpkin. Melt 1 3/4 sticks margarine; pour over cake mix. Sprinkle 1 cup chopped pecans on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Herb Casserole Bread(1 Loaf)
instructions: In a large bowl combine 2 cups of flour sugar salt basil oregano garlic powder and undissolved yeast. Heat milk water and margarine to 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0. Margarine need not melt. Add to dry ingredients. Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer. Add 1/2 cup of flour. Beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Stir in enough remaining flour\tto make stiff batter.

title: Shrimp Remoulade
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Blend well. Add 5 pounds cleaned shrimp; mix well. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Serve with crackers or may be served as a shrimp salad on lettuce.

title: Marshmallow Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together with a mixer until smooth.

title: Caramel Cakewiches
instructions: Fold banana into Cool Whip. Chill. Combine caramels with milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until caramels are melted; stir in bitters. To serve top cake slices with banana mixture then with warm caramel sauce. Makes 6 servings.

title: Smothered Pork Chops
instructions: Put pork chops in casserole dish. Pour remaining ingredients over them. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fudgsicles
instructions: Mix as directed on pudding package. Pour into popsicle molds. Freeze. Makes 12.

title: Borscht
instructions: Put bay leaf and parsley in cheese cloth bag. In a 6 to 8-quart pot melt butter. Add onions and saute until soft. Stir in the beets. Add red wine vinegar sugar tomatoes and juice 1/4 teaspoon salt pepper and 2 to 3 cups beef stock. Cover and simmer undisturbed for 45 to 50 minutes. Add remaining stock cabbage and bring to boil. Add meats bay leaf and parsley; simmer partially covered for 30 minutes. You can cut the cooking time by using canned beets drained of half of their stock then cut the cooking time by 20 minutes. Serve with real coarse bread and butter.

title: Eclair Cake - 2
instructions: Mix pudding as directed minus 1 cup milk. Add Cool Whip. Layer graham crackers pudding mixture and another layer of graham crackers.

title: Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Place spareribs in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Chop onion; brown in fat. Add remaining ingredients; cook slowly 20 minutes. Pour over spareribs. Continue baking about 1 hour.

title: Pear Honey
instructions: Peel pears and cut up. Grind pears with large cutter. Cook juice and pears together; add sugar. Cook until thick (1 hour approximately) stirring frequently. Add pineapple; cook 20 minutes or longer. Put into hot jars and seal. Makes 8 pints.

title: Pizza
instructions: Dissolve yeast before measuring anything but yeast is last ingredient to go in. Stir with wooden spoon or mix with hands. Knead dough until it feels good (the more you knead the better it is). Let rise for 2 to 3 hours in covered bowl.

title: Creamy Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine cheese nuts and garlic in mixing bowl; stir to blend. Divide into 3 parts and shape into 3 balls. Coat 1 ball with chili powder one with parsley and one with nuts. Chill before serving.

title: Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together until crumbly; spread in flat pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes stirring several times. Remove from oven; press firmly into desired pan. Chill. Fill with either chocolate or butter pecan ice cream. Reserve some crumbs for topping.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix eggs butter and sugar well. Add flour and stir in milk and flavoring. Pour into 2 9-inch frozen pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes sour cream soup 1/4 cup margarine onion cheese salt and pepper in bowl; mix well. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cornflakes crumbs; drizzle with 1/4 cup margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. May omit topping if preferred.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute gently onion in butter. Add next three ingredients. Stir in hot milk. Simmer slowly for about 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Put in blender for 1 minute. Before serving sprinkle with grated cheese and pop under the broiler to brown. Yields 6 servings. Very tasty.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Beat eggs and add other ingredients to make a waffle-like batter. Heat 2-inches of vegetable shortening in a 9-inch iron skillet to 350\u00b0. It must be very hot. Pour the batter through a funnel into the skillet going round and round in a coil-like pattern until the pan is covered with batter ropes. Fry brown. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Serve with molasses.

title: Seafood Stew
instructions: Fry bacon. Drain grease from bacon to be added to stew. For those who want to cut down on fat use only 1/2 pound of bacon. (Note You can nibble on cooked bacon while you cook.)

title: Easy Hamburger Goulash
instructions: Cook ground beef in skillet with onion and garlic. Pour off grease. Add spaghetti and beans; let simmer until good and hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Melt 1/2 stick of margarine with the cheese. Crush crackers in a plastic bag. Put 1/2 of the cracker crumbs in butter and cheese mixture. Pour over broccoli. Put the remainder of the cracker crumbs in the remaining butter (melted) and sprinkle over broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Polynesian Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken with seasoned flour. Brown chicken well in hot butter in large skillet. Drain pineapple reserving 1/4 cup syrup. Combine reserved syrup brown sugar and vinegar in small bowl; pour over chicken. Turn chicken skin side down if using frying pieces. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until fork tender about 20 minutes. Move chicken to side of skillet. Add the pineapple water and salt. Bring to a full boil. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Makes 4 servings.* Flour may be seasoned with 1/4 teaspoon each pepper and ground nutmeg or 1/2 teaspoon paprika and 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger.

title: Dietetic Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in a tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Defrost 2 regular (9-inch) pie shells. Combine margarine sugar and flour. Beat with mixer until blended. Add to this the eggs vanilla flavoring and buttermilk. Continue beating with mixer until well blended. Pour equal amounts into pie shells. Sprinkle cinnamon/sugar mixture over the top of pies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool completely before cutting.

title: Earline'S Shrimp Salad
instructions: Drain shrimp. Mix all ingredients and serve. The more shrimp the better.

title: Granola Snack Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat together butter sugar and corn syrup until light and fluffy. Blend in egg and vanilla. Add oats and chocolate chips; mix well. Press into pan. Bake 20 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool and cut into bars. Makes about 3 dozen bars.

title: Quick Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Stir in yeast and buttermilk and roll out. Cut into biscuits. Do not let rise. Bake at 500\u00b0 or 475\u00b0.

title: Crispy Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups grated cheese enchilada sauce chili tomato paste water onion and all but 1 cup corn chips. Pour into lightly greased oblong baking dish. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread sour cream over top sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Make a circle of remaining corn chips around edge. Bake an additional 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Chilies Rellenos Bake
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain fat. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. Place 1/2 of chilies on bottom of a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Top with meat mixture. Arrange remaining chilies on top. Combine eggs milk flour and 1/2 teaspoon of salt until smooth. Pour over chilies. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until browned and knife inserted off center comes out clean. Serve with taco sauce.

title: Strata With Ham
instructions: Spread butter on both sides of bread then cut into cubes. Combine bread ham cheeses salt and pepper; stir well. Beat eggs until foamy. Stir in milk. Add eggs and milk to other mixture; stir well. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Garden Spiral Salad
instructions: Cook rotini; drain and rinse with cold water. Mix all ingredients except dressing. Add dressing just before serving.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In a large pot bring water to a boil. Add macaroni stirring occasionally and cook until done. Rinse and drain. Add and mix together well seasonings butter cheese and milk. Pour into large baking pan and top with cheese and butter chunks. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 1 hour until bubbly and lightly browned. Makes 10 servings.

title: Better Than School Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to box directions. Let cool. Poke holes all over cake (opposite end of a wooden spoon works great). Drizzle entire can of milk over top of cake. Fill holes and pour all over. Let milk soak in and do the same with caramel topping as with the milk. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle top of cake with smashed up candy bars.

title: Fluffy White Frosting
instructions: Heat corn syrup to boiling. Combine egg whites salt and vanilla in bowl. Beat until egg whites are stiff. Slowly pour in boiling syrup continuing to beat until frosting is fluffy and hangs in peaks.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Remove the chicken from the bone; chop in small pieces. Mix remaining ingredients with chicken and chill.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Mix together pineapple cherries and coconut. Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Add pecans. Top with margarine. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: In a large mixer bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in Eagle Brand milk until smooth. Stir in ReaLemon and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill 3 or 4 hours until set. Top with pie filling.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Mix together sugar vinegar cooking oil salt and pepper. Pour over drained beans and toss well. Refrigerate overnight. Drain before serving. Serve on chopped lettuce in salad bowl.

title: Corn Chips(Fritos)
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. In measuring cup or bowl add boiling water to oil. Stir together and pour onto dry mixture all at once. Quickly gather into soft dough and divide in half. Roll out on cookie sheet very thin. Score and bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown around edges. Serves 16.

title: Zucchini Freezer Jam
instructions: Cook zucchini 6 minutes. Add other ingredients. Bring to a boil; cook 6 minutes. Pour into 1/2 pint jars or pints. Seal and turn upside down. Let stand 24 hours. Freeze.

title: Linguine With Tomatoes And Basil
instructions: Combine tomatoes Brie basil garlic olive oil salt and pepper in a large bowl. Set aside covered at room temperature for 2 to 4 hours.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat all until creamy. Frost cooled cake.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Beat well. Pour in 2 layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Cake
instructions: Spread 1/2 cookie dough in 13 x 9-inch pan which has been greased with butter. Mix remaining ingredients and spread over dough. Spread remaining dough over filling. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Apple Torte
instructions: Beat egg. Gradually beat in sugar. Sift flour and baking powder together; add egg mixture apples and nuts. Put in greased pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream together the sugars shortening and eggs. Sift in dry ingredients. Mix in remaining ingredients and separate into 3 parts. Roll each part in long rolls in wax paper. Refrigerate overnight. Slice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Country-Style Cube Steak
instructions: Coat meat with mixture of flour salt and pepper; brown in oil with onion and green pepper. Stir in brown sugar mustard catsup water vinegar and Worcestershire. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until meat is tender. Serves 4.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Sift flour once; measure and add baking soda and salt. Sift into measuring bowl. Add butter brown sugar and granulated sugar; cut with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Remove 1/2 cup and set aside. Combine egg and buttermilk; add to dry ingredients and beat to blend. Pour into greased and lightly floured 13 x 9-inch pan; combine chopped bars nuts and reserved crumbs and sprinkle over the top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean.

title: Fried Tomatoes In Milk Gravy
instructions: Fry bacon and remove from frying pan. Dredge sliced tomatoes in 1/2 cup flour salt and pepper. Fry. Make milk gravy with last three ingredients. Place fried tomatoes in 9 x 13-inch dish; add crumbled bacon and cover with milk gravy and serve.

title: Chess Cakes
instructions: Melt on low heat the oleo and light brown sugar. Remove from heat; put in mixing bowl and beat in in this order 1/2 cup sugar 4 eggs (one at a time) flour mixture vanilla and pecans. Cut into bars while warm and roll in powdered sugar. Keeps well in airtight container.

title: Sea Island Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 9-inch pan. Melt margarine in saucepan on very low heat. Remove. Blend in sugar and stir in flour then add egg and vanilla; beat well. Add nuts coconut chocolate and stir to combine. Pour into pan and bake 30 minutes. Cool in pan and cut in squares.

title: Banana Crunch Punch
instructions: Heat sugar in water just until it dissolves. Add remaining juices to mixture. Mash bananas or put in blender. Add to mixture. Mixture can be frozen in plastic containers. Thaw the frozen mixture until it is slushy then add ginger ale. Makes 60 servings.

title: Eggnog
instructions: Also you will need a rotary eggbeater.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with next 4 ingredients. Cream shortening and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add molasses; beat well. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Add flour mixture; beat until smooth. Pour into 8-inch square pan or 7 x 11 1/2-inch oblong pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with whipped cream. Excellent.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Place small amount of chicken down center of tortillas. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons of salsa over chicken and roll up; place the seamed side down in baking dish. Mix sour cream and soup and pour over tortillas. Cover with thinly sliced cheese; cook until it melts and bubbles. Do not brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in salt water until tender. When cool cut into small pieces. Cook celery onion and bell pepper in mushroom soup. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. Mix thoroughly the chicken pieces with all other ingredients including spaghetti and mushroom soup. Pour 1/2 of mixture into casserole; cover with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Add second layer of mixture; cover with remaining cheese. Put into a 325\u00b0 oven; bake until cheese is melted. Serves 8 people.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Add extra egg if dropped cookie is desired. Add 2 tablespoons sour cream if a soft dropped cookie is desired.

title: Artichoke And Crab Dip(Microwave Recipe)
instructions: Mix chopped artichokes and crab with cheese and mayonnaise in a 2-quart glass dish. Microwave on High for 5 to 8 minutes stirring once until bubbly. Serve with crackers.

title: Creamed Clams Over Linguine
instructions: Open cans of clams; reserve clams. Mix clam juice with milk until it makes 2 cups. Melt margarine in a skillet; add chopped onion and simmer until onion is soft. Add flour and mix with onion. Add the milk and clam juice mixture and cook until the sauce is thickened. Add clams mushrooms and Mrs. Dash seasoning to taste. Add parsley before serving over linguine. Also sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top before serving.

title: Sweet And Sour Cucumbers
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 45 minutes to blend flavors stirring occasionally. Make one hour before serving or up to 2 days ahead.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage in skillet and brown; drain well. Line bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch pan with crescent rolls (pinch perforations to seal). Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well and pour over sausage. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until set. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Blend pineapple and bananas until smooth. Add water sugar lemonade and orange juice. Freeze. Remove 30 minutes before serving. Then add cold ginger ale.

title: Linguini With White Clam Sauce And Broccoli
instructions: Start cooking linguini according to package directions. While linguini cooks make sauce. In a heavy 2-quart saucepan cook oil and garlic about one minute over moderate heat until garlic just starts to turn golden. Add clam liquid parsley oregano thyme salt and pepper. Reduce heat to moderately low and simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low stir in clams and heat thoroughly. Remove from heat. Meanwhile when linguini is almost cooked add broccoli to the pot and cook a few minutes until tender but still firm. Drain linguini and broccoli in a colander. Put into a large warmed shallow bowl and pour clam sauce over pasta. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with grated cheese. Serves 4.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef; stir in onion tomatoes chilies and chili powder. Simmer for 10 minutes. Line a 9 x 13-inch dish with 6 tortillas; spread meat mixture over tortillas and top with the remaining tortillas. Sprinkle grated cheese over tortillas. Heat soup with 1/4 cup of water to make pouring consistency. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with sour cream and taco sauce.

title: Mom'S Best Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs then flour and baking powder. Press into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Go all the way up the sides and corners to the top.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Mix cream cheese with milk and gradually add sugar. Blend well and mix in vanilla.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Drain 2 cans yellow hominy. Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup. Saute 1 medium onion in 1/2 stick oleo. Add Cheez Whiz (for a milder taste use 1/2 jar jalapeno and 1/2 jar plain Cheez Whiz). Mix all together. Pour into casserole dish (2-quart). Top with crushed corn chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Like Stuff Cabbage
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with foil lightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours. (May like a little more sauce.)

title: Angel Food Cake Roll
instructions: Mix angel food cake as directed. Pour half cake mixture onto a jelly roll pan (or shallow cookie sheet) that has been greased and lined with wax paper also greasing wax paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 until slightly brown. Sprinkle powdered sugar onto a cotton towel and invert cake onto this carefully removing wax paper. Roll cake up and allow to cool.

title: Microwave Cheese Shrimp Puffs
instructions: Arrange crackers on napkin-lined plates. In bowl microwave butter for 10 seconds to soften. Add cheese and blend. Stir in egg yolk and shrimp.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites salt and cream of tartar together then gradually add sugar. Fold in nuts and vanilla. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Let cool.

title: Norwegian Meatballs
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients; mix well. Form meat mixture into small balls. Brown lightly in small amount of butter then bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until firm and brown.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small saucepan combine first 3 ingredients; gradually stir in milk. Add butter stirring constantly. Bring to a boil over medium heat; remove from heat. Stir in the next 3 ingredients. Toss vegetables. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with topping and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Company Pickle Chunks
instructions: Cover cucumbers with boiling water. Let stand until next morning. Drain. Repeat this procedure next 3 mornings. On the fifth day drain and slice in 1/2-inch pieces. Combine remaining ingredients. Bring to boiling and pour over cucumbers. Let stand two days. On the third day bring to boiling the cucumbers and liquid. Seal in hot jars. (It is best to use a stone crock for soaking.)

title: Cranberry Jello Salad(Heritage Recipe)
instructions: Dissolve Jello in water. Liquify cranberry sauce and hot water in blender. Mix rest of ingredients together and let jell in oblong dish.

title: Phillippine Flank Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients except steak. Add steak and marinate 12 hours or overnight turning occasionally. Broil a few minutes on each side until medium or medium-rare. Do not overcook. Slice diagonally across the grain in very thin slices. Serves 4.

title: Neiman-Marcus Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix margarine 1 egg (beaten) and pecans together and press in bottom of buttered glass dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Cool in dish and cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Confetti Shrimp
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp; lightly dust with flour. Combine eggs cream salt and pepper; dip shrimp into mixture then roll in coconut. Deep fry in hot oil (375\u00b0) about 3 minutes. Serve immediately with apricot or plum sauce.

title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook sugar water and syrup in large saucepan until soft ball stage (235\u00b0 to 240\u00b0). Add peanuts and butter. Continue cooking until hard ball stage (300\u00b0 to 310\u00b0). Keep stirring. Cook over medium-high heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add baking soda and vanilla stirring rapidly.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add broth from turkey or chicken until dressing is as thin as you like. Will thicken when baked. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Hot Spiced Wine
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Stir to dissolve sugar or honey. Heat to just below boiling point. Mull for at least 15 minutes. Strain if desired. Serve in large mugs.

title: Tortoni Squares
instructions: Combine almonds butter crumbs and extract. Remove 1/3 cup of this mixture and set aside.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Combine vegetables tossing lightly. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium saucepan; bring to boil over low heat stirring occasionally. Pour over vegetables stirring gently to blend well. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in baking casserole dish. Mix flour sugar and milk. Pour on top of melted butter. Mix 1 tablespoon flour with peaches and juice. Pour over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let set a few minutes before serving.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Place sugar in bowl. Add cooking oil and eggs; beat well. Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Add flour mixture to egg mixture and blend in vanilla. Add pecans and apples. Pour batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Serve warm and topped with ice cream or whipped cream. Yield 15 servings.

title: Ham And Cheese Quiche
instructions: Bake pie shell 5 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let cool. Spread chopped ham on bottom then add chopped Swiss cheese over ham. Combine light cream salt and eggs. Blend mixture until smooth. Pour mixture over ham and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Noodles
instructions: Beat eggs with a fork. Add salt baking powder flour and water. Stir until moistened. Roll out. Let dry and cut. Now cook.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and vanilla together until fluffy. Add egg yolks.

title: Spice Cake
instructions: Stir flour and sugar together. Add spices and mix well. Add eggs and oil. Mix in baby food. Pour in prepared tube or loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Sister'S Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Place blueberries on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer pineapple over berries. Put sugar over top. Sprinkle cake mix over. Drizzle melted butter over. Top with chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: In top of a double boiler saut onion and green pepper in butter (both chopped). Add the remaining ingredients. Cook until cheese has melted. Serve hot with crackers or party rye.

title: Eddie'S Own Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix together and store. Use as wish. Mix 1/2 cup of mixture with 1/2 cup hot water.

title: Sausage Dipnederland, Texas
instructions: Brown sausage then add beef and onion and brown both.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and bring to boil while stirring; boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add jar of marshmallow and 12 ounce jar of peanut butter. Stir until smooth. Add nuts. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch greased pan and let cool.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook asparagus as directed on package; drain. Wrap each ham slice around 2 to 3 asparagus spears. Place in an ungreased baking dish (10 x 6 x 2-inch). Mix soup and wine; pour over ham rolls. Bake uncovered until bubbly for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well and drop by teaspoonfuls into medium-hot oil. When bottom turns golden brown turn and brown the other side. Serves 8.

title: Microwave Sugar Pie
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together mix well. Then add the rest. Cook approximately 9 to 12 minutes in the microwave. Stir while cooking. The mixture will bubble up and when it is thick like pudding pour into a baked (9-inch) pie shell. Time in the microwave may vary according to bowl size and microwaves. Make only 1 pie at a time.

title: Danish Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add and beat egg yolks. Add flour. Roll out to 1/8-inch thickness. Use cookie cutters and decorate as desired. Cook at 375\u00b0 until golden brown. Yields approximately 4 dozen.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream margarine oil and sugar; add eggs vanilla and buttermilk. Add flour cocoa soda baking powder salt cinnamon and cloves. Stir in zucchini. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with chocolate chips and nuts. Sprinkle sugar over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Very moist. Freezes well.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Mix crushed wafers powdered sugar and pecans. Add butter and orange juice. Mix well. Roll out in small balls and then roll in coconut. Store in refrigerator overnight. (They freeze well.)

title: Mamaw'S Pizza Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients crushing herbs in hand. Thin with a small amount of water to preference. It is not necessary to heat this sauce before using to top the pizza.

title: Lite Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix well for 2 minutes. Pour batter into a 9x13 greased & floured cake pan. Bake for 35-45 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cooled frost with 1 can \low fat\ fudge frosting.

title: Purdue Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; dissolve soda in sour cream; add with all remaining ingredients to creamed mixture and beat until well blended. Pour into 8 or 9-inch tube pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Soup
instructions: Boil chicken or turkey carcass 2 or 3 hours. Remove bones and salvage as much meat as possible from the bones and add back to chicken or turkey stock. Then add all the above ingredients and cook until well done.

title: Pineapple Squares
instructions: Bring to a boil and cook until thick (about 5 minutes). Let cool.

title: Whole Wheat Health Bread
instructions: Mix flour cracked wheat and oats. Combine 3 cups flour mixture wheat germ sunflower seeds yeast and salt. Mix water (120\u00b0) cottage cheese molasses honey and oil. Add to 3 cups of flour mixture. Beat 3 minutes with electric mixer. Stir in rest of flour. Rest 10 minutes. Knead 10 minutes. Place in oiled bowl covered. Let rise for 1 hour. Shape into 3 or 4 loaves. Let rise. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Blend sour cream mayonnaise lemon juice salt and pepper. Pour over other ingredients after combining them.

title: Raisin Bars
instructions: Combine and boil for 3 minutes raisins shortening salt sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Cool. Add flour soda nuts and vanilla. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm. Can be plain or frosted.

title: Banana Split Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine milk and Cool Whip. Fold in pie filling bananas pineapple and nuts.

title: Chicken Apple Saute
instructions: Dip apple slices in mix of 1/2 water and lemon or lime juice. Heat oil in nonstick skillet. Saute chicken until no longer pink and remove from pan. Saute green pepper onion and celery until tender-crisp. Return chicken to pan; cook for 1 minute. Combine remaining ingredients; add to mixture. Cook until sauce thickens. Makes 3 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Sift flour and baking powder. Mix warm potatoes with sugar salt and shortening. Add flour and mix thoroughly. Roll on bread board to about 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with cutter and place on floured baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until slightly brown.

title: Pat'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine cocoa sugar and flour in medium saucepan. Set aside. Beat yolks. Gradually stir yolks and milk into mix. Add butter. Cook over medium heat until thick. Stir constantly. Remove and add vanilla. Put into shell. Beat egg whites. Wait 6 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
instructions: Split shrimp and season with salt black pepper and cayenne. Set aside. Melt oleo or oil and add onion celery bell pepper and garlic. Cook slowly in uncovered heavy pot until onions are wilted. Add seasoned shrimp; let simmer stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in water and add to mixture. Cook 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve over cooked rice. Serves 4.

title: Deviled Clams
instructions: Scrub the clams and open with a shucking knife or place in a baking pan. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven until shells open enough to remove clam reserving the broth. Do not bake the clams! Remove the clams from shells and chop up or use the frozen or canned ones. Oil the inside of the scrubbed clam shells. Mix the remaining ingredients together until well blended then divide among the shells. Place them in a shallow baking pan and bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven until golden brown approximately 25 minutes. If pan-frying place the filled clam shells upside down in a large heated and buttered saucepan and fry covered over medium heat until golden brown approximately 8 minutes. Yields 12 deviled clams (I usually serve 2 per person). These are delicious either baked or pan-fried.

title: Southwestern Gourmet Salad
instructions: Heat chili powder in olive oil for 2 minutes; remove from heat and add Tabasco Worcestershire vinegar salt and sugar. Stir into beans and let stand for 30 minutes to several hours. Mix other ingredients into beans when cold and chill until ready to serve. Before serving line bowl with broken lettuce and place bean mixture in center.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Place melted butter in a shallow dish or pie pan. Combine remaining ingredients except chicken in another shallow dish.
