Roll chicken pieces in melted butter coating each evenly then roll in crumb mixture coating each completely. Place chicken pieces about 1 inch apart on rack of broiler pan. Broil in preheated broiler turning once halfway through cooking time until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork 25 to 40 minutes.

title: Mama'S Noodle Pudding
instructions: Boil noodles until tender; drain and rinse noodles with hot water (tap water). Add 2 sticks of margarine to noodles and sugar. Beat eggs; add noodles sour cream and cottage cheese. Mix well. Grease Pyrex baking dish with margarine. Pour mixture in dish. Take corn flakes crumbled add 1/2 stick margarine and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle over top of pudding. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes after pudding starts to cook.

title: Lasagne By Ellen
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add tomatoes tomato sauce spaghetti sauce mix and garlic salt. Bring mixture to boiling. Simmer uncovered about 10 minutes. Cook noodles until tender; drain.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Dip chicken into butter and roll in crumb mixture. Bake uncovered fat 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spinach Madeleine
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions; drain and reserve liquid. Melt butter and add flour stirring until smooth. Add onion and cook until soft. Add liquid and stir to avoid lumps. Cook until smooth and until melted. Combine with spinach. Place in casserole and top with buttered crumbs. This freezes well. Serves 6.

title: Marinara Sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.

title: Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients. Roll level tbsp into balls. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork. bake at 350\u00b0 for 10-12 min. makes about 2 dozen.

title: Overnight Coffeecake
instructions: In large bowl cream butter with sugars until smooth. Add eggs and buttermilk; beat until slightly fluffy. Stir in flour soda baking powder cinnamon nutmeg and salt; mix well.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Makes 1 pie.

title: Soft Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift together the first 6 ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add egg mashed bananas nuts rolled oats and raisins. Drop on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. If you like a frosted cookie frost while the cookies are warm with an icing of confectioners sugar shortening milk and vanilla. These cookies freeze well.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar beat well with electric mixer. Add cream cheese beat until light and fluffy. Alternate adding flour and eggs beginning and ending with flour. Stir in vanilla.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Boil sugar and vinegar until sticky. Pour over remaining ingredients; stir good. Chill.

title: Pecan Pie 2
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Add 1 egg at a time. Mix well. Add vanilla syrup and pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

title: White Cake
instructions: Sift the flour salt and baking powder together. Add remaining ingredients except egg whites. Beat 1 1/2 minutes on low and 1 1/2 minutes on high. Add unbeaten egg whites. Beat another 1/2 minute. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
instructions: Cook and stir sugar and syrup until mixture comes to a full rolling boil. Remove from heat and cool; then stir in Carnation milk. Serve over ice cream or cake.

title: Iowa Ham Balls
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine ham beef eggs milk and graham cracker crumbs. Using a 1/3 cup measure shape mixture into 2-inch balls. Place in two large shallow roasting pans. Combine all remaining ingredients and pour over balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour basting frequently with sauce. Yield about 15 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Melt sugar and syrup together. Bring to boiling point then turn off heat. Add peanut butter and let melt. Add corn flakes. Drop on wax paper and shape into balls.

title: Death By Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Chop 1 (8 oz.) package of chocolate and set aside. Microwave the remaining squares until melted (at 30 second intervals mixing after each to prevent burning) and mix until smooth. Stir in sugar butter eggs and vanilla. Add flour and baking powder and stir until well blended. Stir in chopped chocolate and nuts. Drop by 1/4 cup-fuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12-13 minutes or until cookies are puffed and feel set to the touch. Cool on cookie sheet for one minute then transfer to wire rack to cool completely. Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Pineapple Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread the pineapple into a greased 10 x 12-inch pan. Spread the cake mix over the pineapple; scatter the pecans over the cake mix and top with butter pieces. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Stir margarine sugar and cinnamon over low heat until it forms small bubbles. Remove from heat and stir in crumbs. Press in 9-inch pie pan. Chill. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Blend in milk 1/3 cup lemon juice and vanilla. Stir until thick. Line crust with 3 sliced bananas. Turn filling into crust and chill until firm. Dip 2 sliced bananas in 2 tablespoons lemon juice and place on top of pie.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan. Cook over medium heat 15 minutes. Stir. Serve over fruit gingerbread or ice cream.

title: Festive Rice
instructions: In a medium nonstick saucepan bring broth to boil. Add rice. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 4 tablespoons Molly McButter and all vegetables. Cover continue cooking 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes or until water is absorbed. Sprinkle with remaining Molly McButter and pepper to taste. Fluff with fork and serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Cheese Spinach Puffs
instructions: Combine first two ingredients. Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain all liquid. Combine next six ingredients. Add spinach and muffin mix and stir well. Cover and chill for one hour. Form batter into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Low Cholesterol Apple And Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: In a medium bowl stir together flour oat bran brown sugar baking powder baking soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. Set aside. In a small bowl combine buttermilk egg whites and oil. Add to dry ingredients; stir just until moist. Stir in apple. Store batter tightly covered in refrigerator for 5 days. To bake spray muffin cups with nonstick spray coating. Spoon about 1/4 cup batter into each muffin cup. Bake 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Make 12 muffins. 124 calories per muffin.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
instructions: In medium saucepan bring carrots honey and 1 cup water to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cover with lid slightly ajar and simmer until water is evaporated and carrots are tender stirring occasionally. Season with salt. Garnish with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tortoni
instructions: Combine almonds butter vanilla wafer crumbs and almond extract. Mix thoroughly. Reserve 1/4 cup for topping. Line an 8-inch square or round pan with aluminum foil. Sprinkle 1/2 crumbs on bottom. Spread 1/2 of ice cream over crumb layer. Spread 1/2 of apricot preserves over ice cream mixture. Repeat; sprinkle top with reserved crumbs. Cover with foil. Place in freezer. Makes 9 generous servings.

title: Delicious Brat Casserole
instructions: Saute celery until partially done. In well buttered 2-quart casserole dish place potatoes thinly sliced. Cut brats into 1-inch pieces and cook thoroughly. Drain grease off and place on top of sliced potatoes. Place celery and green beans over brats. Mix milk with soup. Stir well and pour over ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour covered and 30 more minutes uncovered.

title: Pittsburgh Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Melt margarine over potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic powder salt and pepper. Stir. Place in oven; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. When potatoes are tender sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and stir. Return to oven until cheese melts. Will serve 4 hearty eaters.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar well.\tDissolve mixture in hot water. Add cold water and orange juice. Chill until ready to serve. Add Seven-Up and\tstrawberries just before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Citrus-Beer Punch
instructions: Remove peel from the 6 lemons and set aside. Juice lemons. You should have about 2 cups juice. In a large saucepan stir together sugar and water. Bring to boiling. Add reserved lemon peel. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Remove and discard peel. Add lemon juice and grapefruit juice to sugar mixture. Transfer to a 2 1/2 to 3-quart pitcher; cover and chill completely.

title: International Aid Stew
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 4 hours. Keep covered for entire baking time.

title: Blueberry Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup sugar with butter and graham crackers. Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese eggs and 1/4 cup sugar. Pour over crackers and bake for 25 minutes. Let cool. Spread pie mix on top of mix and top with Cool Whip.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Slice carrots\tand cook until tender.\tDrain and cool. Alternate layers of carrots pepper and onions. Blend remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oil in bowl. Add dry zucchini; stir and add dry ingredients and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool. Makes two loaves.

title: Sweet Potato Dish
instructions: Mix well and pour into baking dish.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Easy Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Add blueberries and gently mix. Place in one of the pie crusts. Top with other pie crust. Let crust set at room temperature so it is easy to handle. Pinch edges together with fingers or fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Chewy Shortbread Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease an 8-inch square pan. Combine flour and sugar. Using pastry blender cut in oleo until mixture resembles fine meal. Press into a greased pan. Bake for 20 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Meanwhile combine eggs brown sugar and vanilla; beat well. Stir in soda walnuts raisins and coconut. Spoon over hot crust. Spread to cover evenly. Return to oven; bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes or until top is set. Cool completely and cut into 20 bars.

title: Bagogi
instructions: Slice roast thin and marinate overnight. Grill meat and reserve the marinade for dipping meat in or to pour over steamed rice.

title: Michelle'S Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Add the first 4 ingredients and mix them thoroughly. Sift together and stir in flour and salt. Make into balls. Dip into slightly beaten egg whites. Roll in nuts if desired. Bake 5 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Cut celery 3 to 4-inches long. Mix all the preceding. Use decorating tube to fill. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add salt pepper garlic powder and oregano. Then add tomato sauce and simmer. Cook lasagna noodles and blanch in cold water. Grease baking dish. Beat eggs; add cottage cheese. Line baking dish with noodles; cover with meat sauce then cottage cheese then Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers ending with Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle heavily with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Italian Vegetable Cheese Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350. Use 2 quart baking dish. Combine eggplant tomatoes. zucchini artichoke hearts and cheese. In small non-stick skillet heat oil and add garlic. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Mix in pasta sauce. Pour sauce over vegetables. Cover and bake 45 minutes. Cool slightly. Serve.

title: Maui Onions Baked With Chicken And Broccoli(This Is An Original Recipe)
instructions: Place half the broccoli in a greased baking dish and season with salt pepper and garlic powder to taste. Preheat skillet on medium heat; add butter and onions. Saute until onions are translucent. Add onions to sour cream and place 1/2 of the mixture on prepared broccoli. Then top with half the chicken and half the cheese. Repeat for second layer ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serves 3 to 4.

title: Hot Sausage Cheese Puffs
instructions: Cook sausage in large skillet breaking up the meat. Cook until no longer pink; drain and let cool. Add sausage to large mixing bowl and add cheese Bisquick mix and water. Mix well until blended. Roll into 1-inch balls and place 2-inches apart on a cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for approximately 10 minutes or until puffed and slightly browned. Cool completely. Best when dipped in pizza sauce.

title: Best Ever Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar brown sugar butter oil egg and vanilla in large mixing bowl; mix well. Combine flour salt soda and cream of tartar. Add to creamed mixture mixing well until blended. Stir in cereal oatmeal and pecans. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on greased cookie sheet 1-inch apart; flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Pour nuts and chips in unbaked pie shell. Beat eggs sugar syrup and butter together. Pour over nuts and chips and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spread evenly on bottom half of buns. Broil until meat is cooked and edges of buns are toasting. Watch very closely. During last 2 minutes put 2 strips of cheese crisscrossed on top of each bun. Brown tops of buns.

title: Blueberry Banana Bread
instructions: Wash and drain blueberries. Toss with 2 tablespoons flour. Sift together remaining flour baking soda powder and salt. Cream butter and gradually beat in sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add flour mixture and bananas alternating in 3 parts. Stir in blueberries. Spoon into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done. Makes one loaf.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press together the crescent rolls onto a cookie sheet or jelly roll pan (17 1/2 x 12 1/2-inch). If there is extra dough you can make a square and put it in a pie pan or whatever you might have. Bake according to directions until golden brown; cool. Beat the cream cheese dry dressing and mayonnaise with mixer. Mix and spread onto cooled crust. Add chopped raw vegetables cut fine to cover. You may use any variation of the following carrots cauliflower green and red peppers onions broccoli fresh mushrooms red and white radishes celery green and black olives and cucumbers. Grated sharp cheese and eggs may also be used if desired. Sprinkle celery seed over all. Slightly press all vegetables into the mixture with a spatula when finished. Make the day before; cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate.

title: Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix baking mix cheese and milk until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until brown. Mix butter and garlic powder; spoon over biscuits.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add soup enchilada sauce and milk. Simmer for about 10 minutes. In a lasagna dish layer sauce and tortilla shells with the first layer being sauce. Place cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving. Garnish servings with lettuce tomato etc.

title: Shortcake
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar. Cut in shortening. Add milk last. Press in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Block Party Beans
instructions: In a large Dutch oven brown beef over medium-high heat. Drain fat. Add onions and celery; cook until tender. Stir in soup tomato paste and ketchup. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Spoon into a large kettle or roaster. Add all remaining ingredients; stir well. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes about 25 servings.

title: Low-Fat Lemon Supreme Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except powdered sugar and lemon juice. Beat well. Pour in Bundt pan sprayed with Pam. Cook according to directions on cake box. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Mix powdered sugar and enough lemon juice to make thick paste. Pour on warm cake.

title: Baked Chili Rellenos
instructions: Slip a strip of cheese in each chili pepper. Arrange 1/2 of chilies in baking dish; sprinkle with half of grated cheese. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Carefully pour egg milk and flour mixture over all. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for about 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Buffet Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Thaw potatoes. Combine in a large bowl with 1/2 cup melted butter. Combine the next 6 ingredients. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan casserole and top with cornflakes and 1/4 cup melted butter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mad Hatter Meatballs
instructions: Saute the green pepper and onion in the butter until tender. Stir in the soups and water. Heat to boiling then simmer. Combine the remaining ingredients and shape into balls. Drop meatballs into sauce and cook slowly for 1 hour. Good served with rice.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening. Add sugar gradually; beat until smooth. Add egg yolks; beat well. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla. Stir in coconut and pecans; fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into 3 greased and waxed paper-lined 8-inch cake pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes; cool.

title: Spicy Bean Salad
instructions: Cook fresh beans in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Remove from boiling water and plunge into ice water until cold. Drain. In large bowl combine green beans pinto beans butter beans and red onion rings. In jar with tight fitting lid combine vinegar oil garlic sugar and red chili pepper flakes. Shake well. Pour dressing over salad. Stir and cover. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until chilled. Serve on lettuce-lined plates if desired.

title: Kraft Cheese
instructions: Work soda in the dry cheese curds. Melt butter in pan. Add cheese curds; stir constantly until cheese is melted and smooth. Add the hot cream a little at a time. Add salt last. Pour in box or pan suitable for slicing. Cheese making is delicate and does not always turn out. We found this recipe good as a spreading cheese when it didnt get slicing consistency.

title: Melvin'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except tomatoes and let set overnight. Add tomatoes right before serving.

title: Chicken Or Turkey Turnovers
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables in small saucepan of salted water for 5 minutes; drain. In a bowl stir together cream cheese milk and pepper until smooth. Fold in meat and cooked vegetables. Unroll crescent rolls. Seal perforations to form 4 rectangles. Put filling mixture in center of rectangle. Pull corners to point over center and pinch to seal around mixture. Place turnovers on ungreased baking sheet. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Hash Brown Potato Bake
instructions: Mix soups sour cream and onion in large bowl. Add frozen hash browns and toss to coat evenly. Place mixture in a greased 9 x 11-inch pan. If desired mix cornflakes and melted butter. Sprinkle over the mixture. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 30 minutes or until done.

title: Angel Sweetie
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter over low heat. Remove from heat; blend in egg. Stir in sugar nuts and marshmallows. Blend well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in coconut. Chill. Recipe makes about 48.

title: Mom'S Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Layer in casserole dish. Break up hamburg and cook until brown; drain off fat. (Season with garlic and onion powders.) Put drained hamburg on bottom of casserole dish. Put drained corn on top of hamburg. Put tomato soup on top of corn. Put mashed potatoes (make instant according to box) on top of tomato soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Pour jello in water and stir. Add lemon juice and gelatin. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. When set cut into squares.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Wash zucchini. Blend together sugar oil and eggs. Stir in zucchini. Add remaining ingredients except pecans. (Save some flour to toss pecans.) Beat and mix well. Add floured pecans.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except pie mix. Spread half in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Put pie mix on top and spread with rest of dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Drizzle powdered sugar frosting on top.

title: Pickled Fish(Very Good)
instructions: Soak cut-up fish in salt brine (use 1/2 cup salt to 2 gallons water) for 24 to 48 hours. Turn several times a day. Drain fish and soak in white vinegar until fish turns white 24 to 48 hours. If fish is fat soak longer.

title: 7 Day Sweet Pickle
instructions: Clean cucumbers (leave whole). Drop into hot water. Repeat the following 3 days (total 4 days). On the fifth day slice crosswise 1/4-inch thick; drain. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Drop cucumber slices in hot syrup. Let set 2 days turning to get all slices in syrup. Heat and fill clean hot jars. Seal.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients except biscuits. Cook 6 to 7 biscuits according to directions. Pour mixture over crumbled biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 until a little brown. Do not overcook.

title: Chicken And Pork Adobo
instructions: Place cut pork and chicken in a large saucepan. Add vinegar garlic pepper soy sauce onion bay leaves and water. Cover and cook slowly until most of the sauce is evaporated. Drain; save. Separate the pieces of onion from the pork and chicken and saute in the lard until brown. Add the pork and chicken and fry until brown. Add the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes; serve hot. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cajun Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and bell pepper in oleo. When done mix with corn and add seasoning. Cover and heat in microwave for 10 minutes. When 1/2 done stir thoroughly and continue cooking until done.

title: Flowerpot Cake
instructions: You will need an 8-inch flowerpot hand shovel and silk flowers.

title: Vinegar Candy
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and vinegar. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Boil mixture until brittle stage. Pull and cut into small pieces. Butter plate and wrap later.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on package and drain well. Mix cream of mushroom soup eggs mayonnaise and cheese. Put in casserole dish in layers. First put half of broccoli in casserole dish. Next put 1/2 of soup eggs mayonnaise and cheese mix. Repeat broccoli then cheese mix. Top with crushed Ritz crackers; pour melted butter over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix for 2 minutes. Pour in greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour (or less) at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Ma-Ma'S Glorious Potatoes
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix other ingredients and pour into pan. Put crushed barbecue potato chips on top and bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Rice, Sour Cream, Mushroom Pilaf
instructions: Saute mushrooms and peppers in pot until tender not brown. Add water. Stir in seasoning packet. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice and sour cream. Bring to a boil. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 1 minute. Stir before serving.

title: Cabbage And Noodles
instructions: Saute butter cabbage and onions until they are soft. Cook noodles. Add noodles to the mixture. Toss them together and serve.

title: Spicy Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Blend well then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until tests done and cake begins to pull away from sides of pan. Do not underbake. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Remove from pan and finish cooling on rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar if desired.

title: Vinegar Pie
instructions: Sift flour and sugar together. Add vinegar egg yolks and lemon then hot water. Cook and stir until it boils. Put in baked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken
instructions: Cut 4 thin slices of lemon; set aside. Squeeze 2 teaspoons juice from remaining lemon; set aside. In 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot oil cook chicken 10 minutes until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat.

title: Baked Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Trim pork chops well and cut a deep slash in the meaty side of each chop. Chop apples with peel onion and celery rather fine. Mix with parsley salt pepper sage and thyme. Spoon as much stuffing as possible into each pocket; do not tie or skewer. Place in buttered baking dish with cover or use foil. Sprinkle with salt pepper and sage. Cover and bake 1 1/4 hours. Remove cover and bake another 20 minutes or until chops are brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ranch Pretzels
instructions: Stir together first 4 ingredients and microwave 2 minutes on High. Stir into oil mixture and mix well the Hidden Valley Ranch powder. Pour over pretzels evenly and stir occasionally for 1 hour so pretzels will be seasoned. Put into container and cover.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine; add chopped onion. Let onion brown then add meat salt and pepper. Cook and stir until meat turns brown. Pour rice into casserole dish then beef consomme salt and pepper to taste. Then add browned meat (dip out of margarine). Cover and cook for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Gooey Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil brown sugar and Karo until sugar is dissolved; stir occasionally. Add margarine and milk. Cook (stir occasionally) until firm ball stage. Add the soda; this will foam up. Stir and pour over the air popped corn.

title: Country Apple Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except catsup. Shape into loaf. Cover with catsup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Chess Pie No. 2
instructions: Cream butter with spoon. Add sugar and mix well. Stir in vanilla flour and salt. Beat until well blended. Stir in egg yolks and then the milk gradually. Pour into 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45-60 minutes.

title: Coffee Cake(Made Easy)
instructions: Pull off pieces of dough; roll in melted butter sugar and cinnamon mixture. Put in round cake pan or bread pan. Let raise 45 minutes approximately. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers; slice about 1/4-inch thick. Combine first 4 ingredients. Let stand uncovered at room temperature for 3 hours. Drain. Combine remaining ingredients in large kettle; bring to a boil. Add drained vegetables; heat thoroughly but dont boil. Pack at once into hot sterilized jars and seal at once.

title: Dried Apple Cake
instructions: Add 2 cups sugar to apples. Mix sugar butter and eggs together. Mix dry ingredients together and add to the apple mixture. Mix well. Pour into prepared pans and bake in a 300 degree oven for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese Lime Pie
instructions: In large bowl beat cream cheese at medium speed until smooth. Beat in 1/2 cup of milk. Reduce mixing speed to low and add pudding mix (undiluted) limeade concentrate and the remaining milk. Beat until blended. Fold in the whipped topping. Spoon mixture into the prepared graham cracker crust. Refrigerate pie until firm enough to slice at least 4 hours.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Pour water over shortening. Add molasses sugar and egg. Add sifted dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Bake in greased and floured 8-inch square pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut into squares and serve with Cool Whip.

title: Twinkie Delight
instructions: Layer a 9 x 13-inch pan with Twinkies. Mix jello in boiling water according to directions. Pour jello over Twinkies.

title: Cereal Christmas Trees(From Betty Crocker Cookbook)
instructions: In large saucepan heat butter and marshmallows over low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and food color. Fold in cereal until evenly coated.

title: Elephant Tracks
instructions: Combine scalded milk 1/4 cup sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Add to first mixture. Stir in egg. Add flour; work until smooth. Put dough on floured board; let rest 10 minutes. Mix together sugar and cinnamon. Roll dough out into rectangular shape; brush with butter. Sprinkle with some of the cinnamon sugar mixture. Roll and cut slices 1-inch thick. Put a generous amount of sugar on board. Roll each slice until flat 5 to 6-inch circle. Put on greased baking sheet and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Tomato Sauce
instructions: Blend tomatoes at a low speed until smooth one can at a time. Return to cans. Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic and parsley. Saute until you can smell garlic. Add tomatoes slowly. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat stir in salt and pepper and simmer stirring occasionally about 35 to 40 minutes or until thick.

title: Finksa Kakor(Finnish Cakes)
instructions: Mix thoroughly butter sugar and almond flavor. Stir in flour. Mix thoroughly with hands. Chill dough. Roll out 1/4-inch thick. Cut into strips 2 1/2 inches long and 3/4 inches wide. Brush tops with slightly beaten egg white. Sprinkle with sugar and almonds mixture. Carefully transfer several strips at a time to ungreased baking sheet. Bake just until delicately golden brown at 350\u00b0 for 17 to 20 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Line bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish with bread buttered side up. Spread sausage evenly over bread.

title: Can'T Believe It'S A Cookie
instructions: Stir together the 3 ingredients until mixed. Drop by spoonful into greased cookie sheet; flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Wait 5 minutes before you remove from sheet.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Wrap chicken with cheese. Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish (glass). Pour soup over top. Melt butter. Pour 1/2 butter over soup then dressing over top (dry). Then drizzle remaining butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Taco Pie
instructions: In large pan brown ground beef; drain. Stir in seasoning mix water and olives; simmer 5 minutes. Meanwhile separate dough into 8 triangles. Place triangles in ungreased 9-inch pie pan pressing to form a crust. Sprinkle 1/2 of corn chips over bottom of crust. Spoon meat mixture over crust and corn chips. Spread sour cream over mixture and cover with cheese and then remaining corn chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Carb Free Potato Salad
instructions: Break cauliflower up and steam in single layers for 5 minutes in microwave stopping half way to stir. Cool completely then cut in bite size pieces. Peel and chop hard boiled eggs; add celery and onion and an other vegetables you would ordinarily put in your potato salad. Mix mayonnaise or miracle whip and mustard (if preferred) to desired consistency adding salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with paprika and enjoy with no carb guilt! Close your eyes you will never know the difference.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli part way. Arrange in greased baking dish (9 x 13-inch). Put chicken on top of broccoli. In separate bowl combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry. Pour mixture over chicken. Sprinkle cheese over this then top with bread crumbs and butter mixture and sprinkle parsley over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and bake in either 2 layers oblong 9 x 13-inch pan or Bundt pan at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Cook and drain hamburger. Mix all ingredients and cook on crock-pot for 6 to 8 hours on low.

title: No-Fat Low-Salt Soup
instructions: In a large pot mix all ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover 5 minutes. Simmer for one hour checking water level occasionally.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except rice. Bring mixture to boil; add rice. Turn off heat and cover until rice is done.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with Ritz cracker crumbs sprinkled with butter. Return to oven for a few more minutes.

title: Cranberry Whip
instructions: Mix all together. Add Dream Whip last.

title: Biscuit Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large black skillet melt butter in oven until completely melted. Remove skillet and swirl around butter so that bottom and sides are covered. In separate mixing bowl put all remaining ingredients and mix gently. Pour mixture into skillet with butter. Do not stir! Bake for 30 to 45 minutes until crust is golden. Serve plain or with vanilla ice cream. Transfer leftovers to airtight container. Reheat in microwave. Better the next day!

title: Butterscotch Pecan Rolls
instructions: Combine scalded milk 1 tablespoon sugar salt and shortening; cool. In medium bowl combine warm water remaining 1 tablespoon sugar and yeast. Add cooled milk mixture egg lemon rind and about 1 cup flour. Beat until smooth. Knead in remaining flour until dough springs back when indented not very long. Let rise in warm place until double in bulk. Roll out; spread with 1 1/2 tablespoons melted margarine.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and milk well. Add cream cheese. Blend well. Add powdered sugar. Fold Cool Whip into mixture. Fill pie crust. Freeze and serve frozen. You can drizzle chocolate syrup over top.

title: Cheese & Rice Casserole
instructions: Get some pork- or veal- Schnitzel. Wash the meat; dry with a paper towel and rub with pepper salt and just a little brown sugar. Cook in (real) butter in an open pan on both sides until the meat is done and takes on a nice brown. Set aside and keep hot. In the meat juice left in the pan cook fresh mushrooms (about a pound for 2 Schnitzel; any kind of mushrooms will work but the white mushrooms you get in any supermarket or if you collect your own a mix of wild forest mushrooms seem to be best) until the liquid is mostly gone adding pepper salt and small amount of sugar if desired (too much will spoil the mushrooms) to taste. Stir in fresh cream (unwhipped) until you get a thick sauce. Pour on top of the Schnitzel. Serve with french fries or croquettes.

title: Senator Russell'S Pumpkin
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pour into oblong Pyrex dish and cover with topping.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Slice cookie dough into 3/4-inch slices. Cut each slice into quarters. Place each quarter into ungreased 1 1/4-inch muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. (Dough will rise during baking.) Remove from the oven and immediately press a Reeses cup into each cookie. Cool before removing from pan. Refrigerate until firm. Yields 4 dozen.

title: Sunday Spice Cake
instructions: In large bowl mix sugar flour cloves allspice nutmeg cinnamon salt molasses Crisco and milk (2/3 cup). Beat 2 minutes. Then add baking powder soda eggs and 1/2 cup milk. Mix for 2 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Doctor Bird Cake
instructions: Mix together the flour sugar baking soda cinnamon and salt. Add the oil pineapple vanilla eggs and bananas. The mixture is stirred to blend not beaten. Pour into greased 9-inch tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Cool completely in pan before removing.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Homemade Egg Substitute
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients. Mix well. Use as a substitute for eggs. Yield 1 serving equivalent to 2 eggs.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook margarine according to directions. Drain. Beat eggs in 2-quart casserole dish. Add milk salt and pepper. Mix in cooked macaroni and the cheese; stir well. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until done. Serves 8 to 10 .

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients into a mixer bowl and mix slowly for 1 minute. Turn mixer to medium speed and beat for 10 full minutes. Put into a well-greased and floured tube pan.

title: Checca With Shrimp
instructions: Cook pasta and set aside. Heat oil and garlic in skillet until garlic is golden brown. Add stewed tomatoes and simmer for 1 minute. Add basil and season with salt and pepper. Add shrimp and cook for 2 more minutes. Toss over pasta. Serves 4 to 6. This can be made with or without shrimp or with sliced chicken breast.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes in 3/4-inch slices. Dip into egg then into bread crumbs or flour to coat then carefully into egg mixture and into bread crumbs again. Melt butter in frying pan. Add tomato slices and cook slowly until brown on both sides and until tomato is tender. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Strawberry Refrigerator Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix cake per box instructions and bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Dissolve jello in boiling water; add cold water. While cake is still warm poke deep holes through top of cake with meat fork toothpick or skewer about 1 inch apart. Slowly drizzle jello over cake. Cool in refrigerator. To serve top with whipped cream. Add fresh berries and nuts if desired.

title: Hearty Cabbage Soup
instructions: In a flameproof casserole with a tight fitting lid layer bread cabbage onions and garlic. Spoon in tomatoes. Sprinkle cheese over top. Carefully pour stock into casserole so as not to disturb layers. Cook covered over medium heat for 30 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheesy Sausage Quiche
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake pastry shell 4 minutes. Remove from oven; reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. In medium skillet brown sausage; remove and drain on paper towel. Reserve 2 tablespoons fat; cook and stir onion and green pepper in reserved fat until crisp-tender about 2 minutes. Stir in drained sausage. Spoon into partially baked shell. Sprinkle with cheese. In medium bowl beat eggs until well blended. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 to 10 minutes; cut into wedges to serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Combine the corn flakes and melted oleo. Put half in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add the cabbage. Mix together the remaining ingredients. Pour over the cabbage. Sprinkle remaining corn flakes over top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Beat together the peanut butter and margarine. Add sugar stirring until well combined. Gently stir in Holiday Rice Krispies cereal. Press dough evenly into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray. Chill in refrigerator about 30 minutes.

title: Butterflied Lamb In Mustard Sauce
instructions: Split 1 hogie roll. Remove about 2 tablespoons of bread crumbs from middle of roll. Cook 2 slices bacon crisp. Paint inside of roll with mayonnaise. Place bacon on roll then 4 oysters (raw) on top of bacon. Roll and seal in aluminum foil. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Slice in thirds and serve.

title: Low Country Shrimp Boil
instructions: Fill large pot one-half full of water with 3 bags of shrimp/crab boil 2 beers squeeze lemon and lime in and throw in rinds. Bring to hard boil and let boil 10 to 15 minutes. Add sausage and cook 12 minutes. Then add corn to sausage and cook another 8 minutes.\tThen add shrimp to corn and sausage and cook 6 minutes. DO NOT OVERCOOK THE SHRIMP.

title: Wedding Cookies
instructions: Mix in large bowl first 6 ingredients. Let set in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Form balls and bake 15 to 20 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Chicken Mushroom
instructions: Place chicken\tthighs\t(skin removed) in baking pan. Bake at\t350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Mix can of cream of mushroom soup with 3 tablespoons shoyu. Pour mixture over chicken thighs after 1 hour then cook 15 minutes more.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: In large bowl stir together milk and syrup. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into an aluminum foil-lined 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Cover; freeze 6 hours or until firm.

title: Caramel Filled Chocolate Cookies
instructions: In small bowl mix flour cocoa and baking soda. Blend well. In a large bowl beat 1 cup of sugar brown sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs. Beat well. Add flour mixture and blend well. Stir in pecans. Shape about 1 tablespoonful of dough around 1 Rolo candy covering completely. Roll balls in sugar. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 7 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until set and slightly cracked. Cool.

title: Layered Taco Appetizer
instructions: Mix refried beans with taco seasoning mix. Mix sour cream with avocado mayonnaise and salt and pepper. Grate cheese and shred lettuce and dice tomatoes. Layer all ingredients on platter in order listed. Serve with chips.

title: Quick Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat; add onion soup. Mix in tomato sauce and water. Cook 1/2 hour or longer. Cook noodles until tender; drain and let sit in cold water until used. Spread meat sauce in bottom of pan. Alternate noodles sauce and cheese until all used. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: In skillet brown beef in 2 tablespoons margarine. Transfer meat to plate. In same skillet add remaining margarine and cook mushrooms and onion until tender. Return meat to skillet; add water and steak sauce. Heat to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer 50 to 60 minutes until meat is tender. Stir in sour cream. Serve over noodles. Makes 4 servings.

title: Garden Pie Or Quiche
instructions: Steam the first 3 ingredients until tender. Beat together milk Bisquick eggs salt pepper and thyme. Grease a 9-inch pie tin put vegetables in pie tin. Spread shredded cheese over this. Pour Bisquick mixture over this. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes (ovens vary so play it by ear). Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. If using cauliflower instead of broccoli use 1/2 teaspoon curry powder instead of thyme.

title: Easy Apple Cake
instructions: Combine chopped apples and 1 1/4 cups sugar. Let stand 1/2 hour. Sift dry ingredients. Blend oil sugar and egg. Blend the two mixtures; add chopped apple mixture. Pour into greased 9-inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or topping.

title: Cream Cheese Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Press out 1 roll of cookie mixture into brownie pan to cover bottom of pan evenly. Mix cream cheese sugar eggs and vanilla. Pour cream cheese mixture over cookie layer. Take other cookie roll and break off clumps of cookie dough. Drop on top of mixture scattering clumps all around. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Squares are done when cookie dough looks cooked and before cream cheese turns brown. Cream cheese should look light beige. Better to undercook. Enjoy!

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend softened cream cheese powdered sugar and peanut butter. Fold in Cool Whip and Dream Whip thoroughly. Pour into graham cracker crusts or chocolate crumb crusts.

title: Peanut Butter-Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat first 6 ingredients together until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients. Bake until light brown.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast sugar and shortening in one cup of better than lukewarm water. Set aside. Mix flour and buttermilk.

title: Home Baked Cheesy Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven o 350 degrees. Prepare rice according to package directions. Fold cheese into hot rice and stir to melt cheese. Add milk and blend well. Fold in chicken and broccoli. Pour into 1 2 qt. ovenproof casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake for 15 minutes and serve.

title: Ginger Ale Salad
instructions: Soften cheese over hot water. Add gelatin and mix thoroughly. Heat ginger ale to boiling and slowly pour over cheese-gelatin mixture. Beat until smooth. Chill until syrupy. Add Worcestershire sauce. Fold in whipped cream or Cool Whip. Turn into 2-quart mold or individual molds. Chill until firm. Garnish with whipped cream or Cool Whip and chopped pecans. Makes 8 servings.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Place the egg whites in top of double boiler. Add all ingredients except vanilla. Place over boiling water. Have mixer in hand and start beating as soon as you place egg whites and other ingredients over boiling water. Beat until thick and fluffy. Add vanilla. Spread over 3 cake layers.

title: Mrs. Bailey'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugar and shortening. Add the remaining ingredients. When cake is completely mixed add 1 cup boiling water. Bake at 360\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Use either a 9 x 13-inch pan or two 9-inch pans.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients; add oil and eggs. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes in 9 x 1`3 x 2-inch pan.

title: Creamy Vanilla Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Beat on low speed until well blended. Beat on high speed for 2 minutes 1 or 2 drops of food coloring may be add. This frosting works well in a decorator tube.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Plain Boiled Rice
instructions: Wash rice 2 or 3 times rubbing gently between the hands and drain very well. Put rice and water into a saucepan of at least 2-quart capacity. Cover and bring to a boil over a medium-high heat. As soon as it is boiling turn heat to medium-low and stir the rice with wooden spoon from the bottom up and around the edge. Scrape down the grains on the edge of pan. Cover and let boil slowly until water is absorbed. Stir gently once again and simmer over very low heat for 20 or 30 minutes. Makes 4 cups cooked rice; 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheese Balls(Appetizer)
instructions: Melt butter. Add slowly to flour. Cheese block needs to be hand shredded. Do not buy already shredded cheese. It will not work with this recipe.

title: Inspiration Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Add shortening milk and vanilla. Beat with electric mixer for 1 1/2 minutes. Add egg whites and beat for 1 1/2 minutes. Grease and lightly flour 2 (9-inch) spring-form pans. Sprinkle bottom of pans with chopped walnuts; spoon 1/4 of batter into pans on top of nuts. Sprinkle grated chocolate reserve over batter. Pour remaining batter and spread evenly over chocolate layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Goof Balls
instructions: Put the condensed milk confectioners sugar coconut and nuts into a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Cover and chill 3 hours. Roll into balls (about 1 teaspoon mixture). Cover and chill 8 hours. Melt chocolate and shortening in a double boiler. Remove from heat. Drop balls into chocolate mixture one at a time. Refrigerate until hard.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel and cube eggplants. Soak in cold salted water. Drain and cook down in 3 tablespoons bacon grease until tender about 2 hours. In another pot cook remaining ingredients. Mix cooked eggplants and meat mixture together. Add bread crumbs or rice to absorb liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 until well heated. Can be frozen.

title: Toffee
instructions: In saucepan melt butter. Add sugar and nuts. Bring to 300\u00b0 to 310\u00b0. Pour into large cookie sheet with edges. Spread evenly. Place Hershey bars on toffee and spread when melted. Let cool.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Coat bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch pan with mayonnaise. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water and add remaining ingredients. Mix together well and pour into pan. Refrigerate until set.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients together then add dry ingredients and mix well. Roll into balls; then roll balls in additional granulated sugar. Place balls on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 - 12 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients for 5 minutes. While cooking mix oatmeal and cocoa. Add oatmeal and cocoa to ingredients. Add vanilla before adding oatmeal and cocoa. Drop out on wax paper.

title: Salt Water Taffy
instructions: Grease cake pan. Mix sugar and cornstarch in 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Stir in Karo water salt and margarine. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until boils and sugar is dissolved. Continue cooking (not stirring) until temperature reaches 260\u00b0 or until a hard but plastic ball is formed. Remove from heat. Stir in flavoring (and coloring desired).

title: Apple Burritos
instructions: Put apple pie mix in flour tortillas and roll up. Place in pan.

title: Easy-Do Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes and slice into logs. Spray baking dish with Pam. Place potatoes in bottom of dish. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Cherry Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Mix all together in microwave. Pour into pie shell (raw) and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes until slightly brown.

title: Easy Pumpkin Pie Without A Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender and pour into pie plate that has been sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until set. Cool.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt 5 tablespoons margarine. Stir in brown sugar water and pecans. Add maple flavoring and stir. Separate each can crescent dough into 4 rectangles; seal perforations. Spread with the 8 tablespoons softened margarine. Combine cinnamon and sugar; sprinkle over dough. Starting at shorter side roll up each rectangle.\tCut each roll into 4 slices forming 32 pieces. Place in prepared pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Invert immediately to remove from pan. Serve warm. Makes 32 small rolls.

title: Bread Dip
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and Old English cheese. Add garlic salt. Add enough beer to make thin consistency. Hollow out bread. Pour mix into bread. Dip bread cubes in mix.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese sour cream oregano garlic powder and red pepper in bowl; mix well. Spread in a 9-inch pie plate. Top with pizza sauce. Sprinkle with pepperoni green onion and green pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Serve hot with crackers or bite sized fresh vegetables. May be prepared 24 hours ahead to allow flavors to blend; store in refrigerator. Reheat covered with foil for 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Mix and spread in pie pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Lemonade Stand Pie
instructions: Beat concentrate in large mixer bowl on low speed for 30 seconds. Gradually spoon in ice cream; beat until blended. Gently stir in Cool Whip until smooth. Spoon into crust. Freeze 4 hours or overnight until firm.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat all ingredients and pour into two unbaked pie shells. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Make 4 layers in a flowerpot ending with cookies. Put a silk flower in the pot and add some gummy worms.

title: Creamy Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak bread in enough water to cover. Cream butter and sugar well. Add yolks of eggs (if you want a meringue on top) or all of eggs (if you want a whiskey hard sauce). Add milks vanilla and salt. Squeeze out bread well and put into mixture. Add raisins or fruit if desired. Bake in a slow oven (about 200\u00b0) for 1 1/2 hours or until the pudding rises and is brown on top. Make meringue and put on top of pudding running it into the oven for about 10 minutes. Or make a whiskey sauce by mixing confectioners sugar with butter and whiskey to taste.

title: Kielbasa, Sweet Potato And Apple Casserole
instructions: Cut kielbasa or sausage into 1/2-inch pieces. Fry until well done. Mix salt flour and sugar together and blend with cold water. Arrange layers of sliced potato sliced apple and kielbasa or sausage in baking dish pouring flour and sugar mixture over each layer. Top with apples and kielbasa or sausage. Add drippings. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 until apples and potatoes are tender about 45 minutes.

title: 1-2-3 Stew
instructions: Place meat in a covered casserole. Mix two soups together and add to meat. No water please! Cover. Place in a 300\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. Serve over rice with French bread and a salad for a superb supper. Serves 6.

title: Barbecued Pot Roast
instructions: Sprinkle beef with meat tenderizer according to label directions; place in Dutch oven. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over beef. Cover pan tightly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours or until beef is tender. Make gravy from pan drippings if desired.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add one egg at a time beating well after each one. Sift dry ingredients. Stir in raisins then add to butter and sugar mixture. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 until edges brown. This recipe doubles or triples easily for big batches.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream the shortening and brown sugar well. Add molasses and egg. Mix well. Gradually blend in dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Fill press. Form cookies on ungreased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Green Chili Stew
instructions: Brown meat in 1 teaspoon hot oil. Add all other ingredients except potatoes and simmer for 3 hours. If you are using potatoes finely dice them and add after stew has cooked for 1 hour.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box. Reserve 2 cups of cake batter. In remaining batter add 1 stick of melted margarine and 1/2 can of Eagle Brand milk. Pour mixture into a large oblong cake pan. Bake 25 minutes. Put caramels and the other stick of margarine and the rest of the Eagle Brand milk in double boiler and melt. Add nuts and pour over cake that has been cooked. Then pour remaining 2 cups of batter over caramel mixture and return to oven to finish baking.

title: Koch Kasse-German(Cooked Cheese)
instructions: Put all ingredients into a saucepan and boil until all the cheese is melted. Good as cheese spread.

title: Pear Crisp - Kids In The Kitchen
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place pears or apples in greased shallow 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Pour water over your sliced pears or apples.

title: Garlic Oyster Crackers
instructions: Place crackers in large bowl. Stir in dressing mix dill weed garlic salt and lemon pepper. Pour oil over all; stir. Let stand 1 hour. Stir frequently until all oil is absorbed.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Mix eggs with milk salt and pepper. Cook sausage; drain. Press rolls into circle in pizza pan. Add sausage potatoes eggs cheese and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mile-High Strawberry Pie
instructions: Crush berries. Add sugar and let sit for 30 minutes. Put berries lemon juice and egg whites in large bowl and beat with electric mixer on medium speed until stiff peaks form. (This may take 15 minutes.) Fold in the whipped cream gently. Pile high in pie crust and freeze before serving.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Separate eggs saving whites. Beat egg yolks with sugar milk and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture and place in unbaked pie shell. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Melt butter in a small pan. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and seasoned salt. In a large flat pan combine cereals pretzels and nuts. Pour butter mixture over cereal stirring to coat all. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Cool. Store in airtight can.

title: Pancit (Filipino)
instructions: Boil chicken breasts and pork together. Reserve broth. Cut into cubes or strips. Saute garlic onions and meat in oil. Add remaining vegetables. Season with salt and soy sauce. Put vegetables aside. Add noodles to broth and cook to medium soft. Add the vegetables and meat and mix. Do not overcook. Serve hot. Pancit should not have a lot of liquid when serving.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Soak rice for 1/2 hour. Put milk in pot; add rice and simmer for 45 minutes stirring constantly. In separate bowl add eggs Carnation milk sugar and vanilla; beat together. When rice is cooked add these ingredients and when it comes to a boil shut it off.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Excellent.

title: Candy
instructions: Combine frosting mix syrup vanilla and boiling water in bowl. Beat on high speed until stiff peaks about 5 minutes. Beat at slow speed and blend in powdered sugar. Stir in nuts. Drop on waxed paper. When firm turn over and allow to dry 12 hours. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch milk salt and butter. Cook until thickened. Pour when cool into baked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut cauliflower and broccoli into florets. Combine dressing of mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. One hour before serving combine dressing with vegetables. Garnish with raisins sunflower seeds and bacon.

title: Chocolate Banana Drop
instructions: Sift first four ingredients together. Mix shortening with next three ingredients until creamy. Mix in chocolate then mix in flour mixture alternately with bananas. Drop by teaspoons 1 1/2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Yield 5 dozen.

title: Honey Sand Balls
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat together butter the 1/2 cup powdered sugar and honey. Add flour nuts vanilla and salt. Mix thoroughly using hands if necessary. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place 1 1/2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 14 to 16 minutes or until the cookies are barely tinged with brown.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine in large bowl all ingredients but chocolate chips. Beat into creamed mixture. Add chocolate chips and mix just until mixed. Drop tablespoons about 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies or 11 to 13 minutes for crisp cookies. Cool and then remove.

title: Make Ahead Company Breakfast
instructions: Place cubed bread in bottom of greased casserole. Fry sausage; chop into fine pieces and drain. Beat eggs milk and dry mustard. Add cheese. Sprinkle sausage over bread then add egg mixture. Cover tightly and chill overnight. Put in cold oven and set temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in 4 cups water. When potatoes are tender mix 2 tablespoons flour in 1/2 cup water until thick; add to potatoes. Beat egg and add to potatoes. Add 1 to 2 cups milk; simmer until hot.

title: Sister Rit'S Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Mix self-rising flour plain flour eggs and salt with just enough cold water to make a stiff dough; roll real thin. Cut in small pieces and drop in chicken broth. (You can take chicken out and tear off bone; set aside and make dumplings in broth.) Drop a few in at a time and let cook before you drop any more. Dont stir dumplings hard. From top take spoon and push them down into broth. Stir from bottom slowly. When they are done if gravy is not thick enough while cooking sprinkle a little flour over them and push down with a spoon.

title: Early American Brown Bread(No Eggs!)
instructions: Mix whole wheat flour white flour brown sugar baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Stir milk mixture gradually into flour mixture until well blended. Spoon batter into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Swedish Pudding
instructions: Dissolve rennet tablet in water. Warm milk to tepid. Mix eggs sugar flour and vanilla together. Pour warm milk into 2 to 3-quart casserole dish. Add egg mixture and stir to mix. Add dissolved rennet and stir. Let stand a couple of minutes to set. Bake at 450\u00b0 until pudding raises up about 1 hour or until knife comes out clean. Cool. Serve with fruit or whipped cream.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Saute butter and onions on stove. Add Cheddar cheese mushroom soup and sour cream. Mix well until all cheese is melted. Pour over Tater Tots in casserole dish. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Bake sweet potatoes in 350\u00b0 oven until done. Peel and mash potatoes. Scald milk and add vanilla sugar and butter. Add cinnamon nutmeg and orange juice. Mix well. Add milk mixture to potatoes. Put layer of potatoes in casserole. Add a layer of marshmallows. Top with remaining potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 until very hot. Add top layer of marshmallows and brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Raisin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2-quart round casserole. In a bowl mix flour sugar baking powder salt and baking soda. Stir in raisins with a fork. Blend in buttermilk and melted margarine until evenly moist. Put into greased casserole. Cut an \X\ lightly on top. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick put in comes out dry. Remove from bowl and cool on wire rack. Makes 16 servings.

title: Butter Brickle Cake
instructions: Sift together first 4 ingredients in bowl. Add shortening milk and vanilla to dry ingredients. Beat with electric mixer on slow to medium speed for 2 minutes. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl frequently. Add egg whites. Beat 2 more minutes scraping bowl. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Easy Beef Roast
instructions: Dust the roast in the seasoned flour. Place in a large roasting pan. Sprinkle the dry soup mix over the roast then one can of mushroom soup. Around the edge of the meat pour the 2nd can of soup and the consomme and the mushrooms. Seal tightly with foil or lid of roaster. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours or until tender. Slice meat in thin slices. Serve with gravy over rice noodles or with mashed potatoes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Pour into greased 1-inch cookie sheet; bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Ice while hot.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Melt 2/3 stick margarine and mix with onion salt pepper cream of chicken soup sour cream Cheddar cheese and hash brown potatoes. Use a large bowl to mix. Melt 1/4 cup melted margarine and stir with crushed corn flakes. Grease a large 13 x 9-inch casserole dish and place potato mixture in it. Spoon corn flakes and margarine over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Will have a golden brown top. Freezes well after baking.

title: Gypsy'S Delight
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Add tomato paste salt sugar Worcestershire sauce and oregano. Mix well. Add corn and put in small buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cold Limas In Sour Cream
instructions: Mix chill and serve.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs beating until thoroughly blended. Add vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add mixing at low speed until blended. Add nuts. Store in 2 rolls in refrigerator or freezer.

title: Tuna Burgers
instructions: Flake the tuna in a mixing bowl. Add the chopped celery onion American cheese and salad dressing. Spread on split buns and place on a preheated broiling pan. Broil until the cheese melts. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Nut Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and soda. Beat eggs slightly. Add vanilla and pineapple; stir well. Add the dry ingredients and mix well by hand. Then add chopped nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 2 tablespoons syrup. In top of double boiler beat egg yolks slightly. Add reserved syrup sugar vinegar salt and butter. Place over hot (not boiling) water. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens slightly and barely coats a spoon (about 12 minutes). Cool to room temperature.

title: Bacon Horseradish Dip
instructions: Combine soup mix sour cream bacon horseradish and mustard. Mix well. Cover. Chill at least 2 hours. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Seafood Pizza Dip(Serve 12 Or More)
instructions: Soften and spread cream cheese on large serving dish or two smaller dishes. Spread cocktail sauce over top leaving a small margin of cream cheese around the edge. Crumble crab meat and arrange shrimp over sauce. Place olives and mushrooms on top of seafood layer. Sprinkle cheese across top. Arrange crackers around \pizza.\

title: Chili-Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan over low heat. Serve warm with Frito chips.

title: Pumpkin Torte
instructions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs 1/3 cup sugar and butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together eggs 3/4 cup sugar and cream cheese. Pour over crumbs in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Glazed Whole Apricotshouston, Texas
instructions: Drain apricots reserving 1/2 c. of the juice. In a large skillet or saucepan add the apricot juice and all the ingredients above. Heat slowly at a simmer turning apricots often until glazed over. Drain stick whole cloves in end and use to garnish poultry or pork (Thanksgiving turkey).

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 Cream together butter shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Mix in separate bowl flour salt baking powder and cocoa. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla beating after each addition. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Pour batter into pan and bake 1 1/2 hours. This cake doesnt need frosting but the Chocolate Gloss can be added if desired.

title: Low-Fat Taco Dip
instructions: Mix salsa and refried beans and spread in a 9 x 13-inch glass casserole dish. Mix taco seasoning with sour cream and spread over beans. Top with shredded lettuce chopped tomatoes chopped onion and approximately 1/2 cup fat-free cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix dry mustard mayonnaise and yellow mustard together; set aside. Grate cabbage and carrots together. Sprinkle with salt. Drain excess juices off. You will have to squeeze the mixture by hand. Place in a bowl. Combine grated onion celery seed sweet pickle juice sugar and vinegar; add to mixture of mustard and mayo. Fold into cabbage.

title: Myrtle Sizemore'S Egg Custard Meringue Pie
instructions: Beat 6 egg yolks and 2 whole eggs slightly. Add sugar flour and cornstarch. Add hot milk gradually. Add margarine and vanilla. Pour mixture into uncooked pie shell. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0 until firm. Dont overcook.

title: Don'S Bavarian Pot Roast
instructions: Pour beer over roast and bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over roast; continue baking at 350\u00b0 covered until meat is well done. Use broth to pour over meat when served.

title: Forget Me Not Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight jar.

title: Bee'S Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine first three ingredients and refrigerate overnight (dressing). Pour the dressing over the other ingredients just before serving. Serve chilled.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello water and juice. Add fruit. Chill until set. Mix pudding and milk then add Cool Whip. Top jello mix with the pudding mix and top with chopped pecans.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Cook the dates and water; cool slightly then add the vanilla. Set this mixture aside. Mix together the next 6 ingredients. Add the water and oil to dry ingredients. Use a little more than half on the bottom of a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with dates. Spread the remainder on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Salisbury Steak Deluxe
instructions: In a bowl combine the soup mustard Worcestershire sauce and horseradish; blend well. Set aside. In another bowl lightly beat the egg. Add bread crumbs onion salt and pepper and 1/4 cup of the soup mixture. Add beef and mix well. Shape into 6 patties.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Boil water and sugar until syrupy. Add cranberries and cook until they burst. Remove from heat cover and let stand 10 minutes. Remove cover and cook another 5 minutes. Cool and chill. Add fruit marshmallows and nuts to cooled cranberries and thoroughly chill.

title: Barbecue Shredded Beef
instructions: Cook meat until very tender in a small amount of water to which 3 teaspoons salt has been added. While meat is cooking make sauce. Melt shortening and add onion; cook until tender but not brown. Add remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Shred beef and add to sauce. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns. Makes 10 to 12 sandwiches.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O with water and orange juice.

title: Knobby Apple Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and mix. Add dry ingredients. Stir in apples nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Different Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins peel and slice. Mix all ingredients together. Begin with layer of potatoes in casserole. Spread with dressing mixture and continue alternating ending with mixture. Refrigerate. Keeps well.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a 1-quart casserole. Stir in water and butter using water at room temperature. Cook in microwave for about 1 1/2 minutes stirring every 30 seconds. Stir halfway through cooking time. (This will get quite thick.) Remove from microwave stirring thoroughly. Blend in vanilla.

title: Easy Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a greased 10-inch square casserole. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream together butter and sugar. Mix flour baking powder and baking soda together. Add to the butter/sugar mixture. Mix well. Add potato chips and vanilla. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Oreo Peanut Butter Crunch Squares
instructions: Finely crush 20 of the cookies; mix with butter. Press firmly onto bottom of greased 8 inch square baking pan. Coarsely chop remaining cookies; set aside. Drop spoonfuls of marshmallow creme evenly onto crust to within 1/2 inch of outer edges. Sprinkle with chocolate chunks peanuts and chopped cookies. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until marshmallow creme just begins to brown. Cool completely. Cut into 2 inch squares. Makes 16 servings.

title: Low-Fat Gelatin Dessert
instructions: Mix jello with Cool Whip that has been defrosted. Drain pineapple and add to mixture. Add cottage cheese and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cranberry Pear Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine rice pears cranberries 1/3 cup of the brown sugar and 2 tablespoons of the flour. Spray a 2-quart baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Place rice mixture in bottom; set aside. Combine remaining flour remaining sugar and oats in a bowl. Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add pecans and coconut; blend well. Sprinkle over rice mixture. Bake 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serve warm. Top with frozen vanilla yogurt if desired. Makes 8 servings. Each serving has 271 calories.

title: Play Doh
instructions: Boil water and salt. Add salad oil alum and food coloring. Add flour. Add flour gradually. Mix well. Knead when cool. Add more flour if sticky.

title: Oh So Easy Meat Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine ingredients together; pour into uncooked pie shell. Place another pie shell on top; press edges down with a fork. Cut slits in top crust. Bake 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Matt'S Horseradish Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients; chill. Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Cajun Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken strips with garlic powder. Set aside. Simmer all other ingredients 15 minutes. Add chicken. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat well eggs sugar and salt. Add white syrup waffle syrup vanilla and butter to eggs and sugar. Mix. Add pecans or more if desired. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Filling will be raised and brown.

title: Griffith'S Shortbread Old Frostburg Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix flour and sugar together in mixing bowl. Cut in unsoftened butter until it forms small pea size lumps. Dump ingredients on cool marble slab. Will still be powder. Start pounding and working until you form a soft dough oily to touch. Form a ball. Roll out on unfloured slab to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut into rounds with biscuit cutter. Lift carefully with cake turner to ungreased cool cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned around bottom edge. Cool on wire rack. Wrap cookies in wax paper to best preserve buttery taste.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in punch bowl. Chill before serving.

title: Peanut Butter Apple Crisp
instructions: Peel and slice apples into greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Pour water and lemon juice over apples. Combine sugar flour salt and oatmeal. Blend in butter and peanut butter. Mix until crumbly. Spread evenly over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until crust is crisp and apples are tender. Serve hot or cold with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Powdered Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll into walnut size balls and press with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Savory Salmon Luncheon Pie
instructions: Prick pastry shell with tines of a fork; bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Drain salmon reserving liquid; remove bones and skin. Flake salmon and place in bottom of pastry shell; sprinkle with lemon juice. Saute onions and parsley flakes in butter; sprinkle over salmon. Mix liquid from salmon with eggs milk and remaining ingredients; pour over salmon. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until firm. Serve hot. Serves 6.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Add all ingredients into large pot. Cook good. Serve over rice. Add salt and pepper for taste.

title: Foolproof Beef And Broccoli
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat in hot oil cook beef and garlic until meat is brown. Add onion; cook 5 more minutes stirring often. Stir in soup water and soy sauce. Heat to boiling point. Add broccoli. Reduce heat to cover. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Grease the bottom of a Bundt or tube pan. Add nuts to bottom if desired. Place frozen rolls in pan. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over rolls. Melt butter sugar and syrup until sugar melts (can be microwaved). Pour mixture over rolls. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover tightly with foil and let rise 2 to 3 hours or overnight. Bake covered 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand at least 10 minutes before turning onto cake platter.

title: Peaches And Cream Cheesecake
instructions: Slice peaches in bowl. Add 1/4 cup sugar and set aside. Mix the first 7 ingredients for 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased deep 9-inch pie plate. Drain peaches reserving syrup. Place peaches on batter in pie plate. In separate bowl mix for 2 minutes the cream cheese 1/2 cup sugar and peach juice. Spoon over batter within 1-inch of plate. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1/2 tablespoon cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Italian Dressing And Vegetables With Rice
instructions: Put Italian dressing in a skillet; add vegetables. Cook for 20 minutes. Can be served over rice.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O and water stirring to dissolve. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into 5-cup mold. Chill until set. Makes 8 servings.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Sift in dry ingredients. Add milk; mix until well blended. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into greased bread tins. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Upside-Down Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Thoroughly cream together 1/2 cup sugar and margarine. Blend in flour baking powder and salt. Gradually add milk mixing well. (Dont worry about lumps.) Spread batter in greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Distribute cherries evenly over batter. Pour on cherry liquid. Sprinkle cherries with remaining 1/2 cup sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until light brown.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix first seven ingredients and shape into small bite size balls. Melt the wax and chocolate chips in pan then dip balls in this mixture and place on wax paper to cool.

title: Oreo Surprise(Desserts)
instructions: Crush entire package of Oreos to fine consistency (potato masher works fine for this). Saving out 1/2 c. of Oreo crumbs for later use. Mix remaining crumbs and melted margarine and press into bottom of 9x13 baking pan. Push firmly with a spoon or spatula. Place in refrigerator for 5 minutes.

title: Frog In A Log
instructions: Spray frying pan with Pam; take bread and pinch out the center (just a small hole). Put bread in skillet. Drop egg in middle of the bread (where the hole is). Add salt and pepper; let it brown and turn over. Eat it hot.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks thoroughly. Add milk and beat again. Sift flour with salt and sugar. Add to egg mixture. Cook stirring constantly. Add butter and let mixture cool then add vanilla. Mix in shredded coconut. Turn into baked pie shell. Cover with stiffly beaten egg whites to which has been added 6 tablespoons sugar. Sprinkle with coconut and brown in a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken And Rice
