instructions: Add all soup mixture together to make up 32 ounces. Add water to make up the differences. Melt margarine in a 9 x 12-inch saucepan. Pour over rice evenly in pan. Place chicken in pan on top of rice. Pour soup over chicken. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Best Broccoli Soup
instructions: Bring water to boil. Add broccoli celery and carrots; boil 2 to 3 minutes. Drain; set aside. In same kettle saute onion in oleo until tender. Stir in flour to form smooth paste. Gradually add broth and milk stirring constantly. Bring to boil; boil and stir 1 minute. Add vegetables and remaining ingredients. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Famous Broccoli Casserole Surprise
instructions: Cook broccoli\tand rice. In separate saucepan combine remaining ingredients; add enough milk to make the mixture pour like thick soup. In casserole dish layer rice broccoli and sauce until dish is full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joe'S
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Add rest of ingredients and simmer.

title: Pepper Steak Oriental
instructions: Cut meat in 1/2-inch strips 2 inches long. Brown meat garlic etc. in skillet. Add tomatoes in center of pan. Cook covered for 5 minutes. Add cornstarch and water; cook until thickened. Serve with rice.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat onion celery and green pepper in large pan. Drain off fat by spooning. Add the soup sauce water and seasoning. Simmer 30 minutes with lid ajar. Add beans when chili is done; heat through. Thin with water if needed.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Take center and seed out of peppers. Drop into boiling water; let stand 5 minutes without boiling. Fry onions in margarine until golden brown. Add hamburger and garlic; stir with a fork. Cook and drain rice. Add rice to meat; let cool. Put mixture into peppers; cover with tomato soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Bean Dip
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients. Heat until hot. Pour into 6 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle onions on top followed by olives and finally the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes. Serve with Doritos or other taco-style chips.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Save 1 cup broth. Cut up meat and mix with 1 can soup and sour cream. Pour mixture into casserole dish and top with the Stove Top mixed with 1 cup broth and melted stick of margarine. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken until tender then debone. Cut up chicken and put in casserole. Combine soup and broth and pour over chicken.

title: Grandma'S Fruit Cake Recipe
instructions: Combine butter and sugar. Add eggs to this mixture then other wet ingredients (milk lemon juice and vanilla). Sift flour cinnamon cloves mace baking powder and soda together and set aside. Cut up pecans orange peel pineapple citron cherries almonds raisins and currants in a large bowl. Cover pans with waxed paper (Bundt or angel food pans) and spray where you cant cover. Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine the dry mixture with the wet mixture then include it with the cut up fruits and nuts. Thoroughly mix together and pour into pans and bake for 4 hours very slow.

title: Double Baked Potatoes
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Bake potatoes until tender; let cool. Scoop out pulp leaving about 1/4-inch in shell. Mash pulp in large mixing bowl with crumbled bacon and remaining ingredients; mix well. Put back into shells and sprinkle with paprika. Microwave for 5 minutes until heated through and serve. (These can be done in the morning and then re-heated.)

title: Super Bowl Pizza
instructions: Toast muffins in oven. Take the muffins out of the oven and top with spaghetti sauce. Then top with pepperoni and olives. Top with cheese and bake until cheese is melted. Remove from oven. Enjoy.

title: Cheese Sauce For Baked Potatoes
instructions: Blend flour in melted butter; make a thick and smooth cream sauce by adding milk gradually and stirring constantly. Season with Worcestershire Tabasco and salt. Add cheese and stir until cheese melts. Add onions or top potatoes with onions before pouring sauce over. A different way to serve baked potato and one men especially enjoy.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix onion and cabbage and set aside. Mix the rest of the ingredients and add to cabbage and onions. Marinate for 15 minutes or more.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Separate egg whites from yolks. Mix yolks with Eagle Brand. Squeeze juice from lemons. Mix with Eagle Brand and yolks. Pour into pie crust. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Appetizer Spareribs
instructions: Have sparerib racks cut into 3-inch lengthwise strips. Cut strips into individual ribs. Place in a shallow baking pan. Blend together molasses and mustard. Stir in lemon juice soy sauce Worcestershire and cayenne. Mix well. Brush spareribs with part of the sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours brushing often with remaining sauce. Drain on paper towels.

title: Vegetable Frittata
instructions: Heat 3 teaspoons oil in skillet. Add onion; cook until tender. Remove onion and set aside. Lightly beat eggs in bowl. Add onion spinach cheese and seasonings. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons oil in same skillet; add egg mixture. Cook 5 minutes or until browned lightly.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange dried beef in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Wrap a piece of bacon around each chicken breast. Mix cream of mushroom soup onion soup mix and sour cream. Spread over chicken breasts. Cover and bake 1 hour at 275\u00b0. Uncover and bake 2 more hours.

title: Marie'S Black Bean Soup
instructions: First soak beans overnight. Boil with full quart of hot water. Fry chopped onion garlic chopped green pepper and bacon. Add to beans; salt and pepper to taste. Do not salt until tender. Add mixture to beans which should have some liquid and let simmer for 1 hour.

title: Chicken-Vegetable Soup
instructions: Remove fat from chicken backs and boil backs with onions celery and Herb-Ox broth for 30 minutes. Combine string beans carrots limas and tomato paste. Cook 20 minutes (until vegetables are tender). Add okra potato corn and macaroni. Cook 10 minutes. Serve with corn bread.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Simmer for about 1 hour. Bottle and keep refrigerated.

title: Red Mush
instructions: Boil. Add 2 small packages strawberry jello and 1 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Honey Sugared Pecans
instructions: Toast pecans in moderate oven (350\u00b0) 10 minutes stirring once. Butter sides of heavy 2-quart saucepan. Combine sugar water honey salt and cinnamon. Heat and stir until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to boiling. Cook to soft ball stage (236\u00b0) without stirring. Remove from heat; beat until mixture begins to get creamy. Add vanilla and nuts; stir gently until nuts are well coated and mixture becomes thick. Turn out on buttered baking sheet. With 2 forks separate nuts at once.

title: Deliciously Easy Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions with following modifications Add flour to dry mix and blend well. Substitute equal amount of applesauce for vegetable oil and equal number of egg whites for whole eggs. Bake in pan of your choice sprayed with cooking spray. Frost if desired. Low calorie; low fat.

title: Cheese And Shrimp Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into ball. Serve with different kinds of small crackers.

title: Bac-On-Ion Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a well-greased 10 inch skillet. Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown on top. Remove from skillet immediately.

title: Recipe For Happiness
instructions: Mix all together with concern. Bake in oven of forgiveness for 2 prayer hours then cool on table of understanding and serve with compassion.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Squeeze chopped onions pickles and parsley in a cloth to eliminate excess juices. Stir all the materials together.

title: Grape Ambrosia
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Pour into an 8-inch cake pan; chill until firm.

title: Cheesy Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine beans chili sauce brown sugar and mustard. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart rectangular baking dish. Arrange onion slices on top. Bake until hot and bubbly about 35 minutes. Remove from oven; sprinkle cheese over all. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Beef Balls In Onion Cream
instructions: Cook onions in oil until tender but not brown. Add meat balls and brown on all sides. Pour off fat then stir in soup. Cover and simmer stirring occasionally 30 minutes. Just before serving stir in sour cream.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Roll into balls and flatten with fork after mixing. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl combine shredded cheese chicken soup sour cream chopped onion 1/4 cup butter salt and pepper. Mix well. Fold in thawed hash brown potatoes. Turn mixture into prepared baking dish. Toss together corn flakes and 1 tablespoon melted butter. Sprinkle over potato mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 1 hour or until casserole is golden brown and potatoes are tender.

title: Fat-Free Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl combine dry ingredients. Stir in egg whites corn syrup and vanilla until well mixed. Add raisins. Batter will be stiff. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls. Bake 10 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Stew chicken until tender. Remove bones; cut into bite size pieces and return to broth. Cut shortening into flour. Add enough milk to make dough as for biscuits. Roll out to about 1/8-inch thickness. Cut in strips then into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Drop a few at a time into boiling broth. Stir gently occasionally as dumplings are being added. Lower heat. Cover. Cook 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to set 2 hours. Broth will thicken.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa milk and margarine in saucepan. Put on medium heat; cook until it starts to boil. Remove from heat. Cool for 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients; stir well. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Cool.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir together white sugar and Karo syrup. Micro on High for 5 minutes. Take out and add peanuts micro for 4 more minutes. Take out and add oleo vanilla soda and salt. Stir and pour on greased cookie sheet. Cool and break.

title: Country Fried Steak
instructions: Salt and pepper steak. Roll steak in flour. Melt margarine in skillet until very hot-brown steak in margarine. Place in 3 quart baking dish Make gravy in skillet with 1 can mushroom soup 3 1/2 cans cold water and onion. Mix well until hot. Pour over steak. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350 degree oven.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until firm in center.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Heat the two ingredients until blended and smooth. Put into 9 x 13 pan. Cool then cut into pieces.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook potatoes drain and place in mixing bowl. Melt margarine and pour in potatoes. Mix well. Put other ingredients into mixture and mix well. Pour into 2 small unbaked pie shells. Bake at 200\u00b0 until done.

title: Delicious Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and milk. Cook until thickened. Add well beaten egg yolks. Cook 2 minutes longer then add 1 cup coconut. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into a baked pie crust. Take egg whites and beat well. Add 2 tablespoons sugar; beat 2 minutes longer. Cover with meringue. Add coconut on top of meringue. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cinnamon Pancakes(Serving For 4 To 6 People)
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt ground cinnamon and sugar into a mixing bowl. Beat together egg yolks and milk. Add vegetable oil while mixing then add all at once to dry ingredients; stir just until smooth. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold into batter.

title: Crispy Cole Slaw
instructions: Chop cabbage green pepper onion carrot and red pepper. Mix vinegar solution real well and pour over cabbage mixture. Mix well and seal in a Tupperware bowl. Serve after 24 hours. Keep one month in refrigerator or freeze.

title: Potato Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Crumble yeast into bowl; add 1/2 cup lukewarm water. In bowl cream shortening sugar and salt thoroughly. Blend in mashed potatoes; blend in eggs. Add the remaining lukewarm water. Add most of sifted flour gradually mixing thoroughly. Add maybe 1/2 cup more flour to take stickiness from dough. Knead on lightly floured board. Round up and set dough to rise in greased bowl. Cover with damp cloth. Keep dough at 80\u00b0 to 85\u00b0 until double in bulk (about 2 hours). Punch down; make up desired amount of dough by letting it rise again double in bulk about 45 minutes.

title: Mile High Strawberry Pie
instructions: Whip together the berries sugar egg whites lemon juice and salt for 15 minutes with electric mixer. Whip the cream; add vanilla and fold into strawberry mixture. Pour into pie shell. Freeze. Top with additional berries to serve.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Roll out like biscuits (except thinner) and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Beat margarine on high until creamy. Add sugar 1 cup at a time on high. Add eggs 1 at a time on high; beat well. Add flour and alternate with cream as from the container (do not whip). Just add to flour and beat well. Use a greased and floured tube pan. Place in COLD oven. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Cool in pan 10 minutes.

title: Buffalo Style Chicken Pizza
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces (1/4 to 1/2 inch). Thoroughly cook in frying pan. Add barbecue sauce and vinegar; add Red Hot to taste. Prepare your favorite pizza crust (I buy premade dough from Wegmans). Spread Blue cheese dressing on crust to coat. Spread chicken and sauce over crust. Sprinkle cheese over top. Add chopped celery to top and baked until crust is golden brown.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Cube cheese and put in a microwave safe bowl. Add rotel. Then add bacon bits. Melt on high 5 minutes take out and stir. Reheat for 5 more minutes take out and stir. Keep heating and stirring until melted. Serve with Bite size tortillia chips.

title: Chicken And Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in large casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees. Can be made ahead of time and heated at time of serving.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening; add sugar and beat until smooth. Add egg yolks one at a time and continue to beat. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla coconut and nuts.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Heat sweet potatoes in saucepan. Mash. Combine sugar margarine pineapple and cinnamon and add to sweet potatoes. Pour into baking dish and cover with miniature marshmallows. Heat until marshmallows are light brown. Serve warm.

title: Finger Gelatin
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water or juice. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill until firm about 3 hours.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar chocolate margarine evaporated milk and salt in 2-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until it bubbles. Boil and stir 1 minute. Take off heat. Stir in oats peanut butter and vanilla. Drop with spoon onto wax paper.

title: Sausage Yummy
instructions: Brown sausage and drain well. Mix thoroughly with cream cheese. Spread one package crescent rolls to make bottom crust and place in a 9 x 11-inch greased baking pan. Spread meat mixture on top of unbaked crust. Spread the other package of rolls on top to make crust. Pinch crusts together around edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown about 10 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. May be frozen before baking.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain artichokes well. Squeeze out all the juices. Break artichokes into small pieces; add mayonnaise and cheese. Mix well. Add garlic powder salt and lemon juice and mix lightly. Place in shallow baking dish (quiche pan). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown on top. Remove from oven; blot top with paper towels. Serve hot with crackers. Serves 8.

title: Best Ever Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil until thickened. Place sweet potatoes in a buttered dish and top with the remaining ingredients. Bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Top with marshmallows and return to the oven to melt.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: If fresh corn is used boil corn for 5 minutes. Dip in cold water. Cut from cob and measure. Combine all ingredients and boil gently for 20 minutes. Pack while boiling into hot sterilized jars. Be sure vinegar solution covers all vegetables.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Break cake into small pieces and line bottom of punch bowl with cake. Pour some pudding over cake then some cherry pie filling pineapple sliced bananas and then Cool Whip. Start layering again until punch bowl is full. (Goes a long way.)

title: Chiffon Dream
instructions: Blend at low speed the lemon Jell-O 1 tablespoon sugar and 3/4 cup water until dissolved. Add 1 cup ice and stir by hand until partially dissolved. Add 4 ounces cream cheese and blend at high speed until smooth about 1 minute. Pour into pie crust. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Swirl into lemon mixture until pie crust is full. Pour remainder into a bowl. Chill until set; spread with Cool Whip.

title: Winter Wonder Log
instructions: Prepare pudding mix with milk. Let stand 5 minutes. Blend in 1 cup whipped topping. Spread mixture on wafers. Stack in groups of 8 or 10. On plastic wrap place stacks together on sides to form the log. Wrap and chill 2 to 3 hours. Unwrap and frost with remaining whipped topping. Garnish; slice diagonally. Serves 8.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar eggs vanilla flour soda and salt; mix well. Fold in pecans and apples. Bake in tube pan 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Amazing Raisin Cake
instructions: In a large bowl on low speed combine first 10 ingredients. Mix 2 to 3 minutes. Mixture will be heavy. Add apples raisins and nuts. Pour batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Top with whipped cream when served. I used red Roman apples.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef drain fat. Add next seven ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti according to directions. Serve with grated Romano cheese.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients on large round plate. Serve with tortilla strips.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cake
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients; mix 2 minutes. Pour into 8-inch greased pie dish. Drain peaches; save the liquid. Arrange peaches over batter. Combine the cream cheese 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons peach juice. Beat for 2 minutes; spread over peaches. Combine 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breaded Pineapple
instructions: Mix all together (if too dry add 1/2 cup milk). Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Blend sugar margarine and peanut butter. Roll into balls and chill. Melt chocolate and paraffin wax in double boiler. Dip balls into mixture with toothpicks. Place on wax paper to dry.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Melt butter; let cool completely. Mix with other ingredients. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 pies.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and butter; add eggs. Stir in dry ingredients and add nuts. Make 2 rolls and wrap in waxed paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Slice 1/8-inch thick and bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute onion until tender. Add in flour then pepper wine potato and clams. Cook until thickens. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Add cream. Return to heat. Be careful not to boil.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
instructions: Mix spices together and sprinkle over apples; melt margarine. Mix with 3/4 cup water. Pour over apples. Pour apple mixture into pie crust. Cover with top crust and bake at 350\u00b0 until apples are tender and crust is brown.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Boil chicken and bouillon with onion and water to cover chicken. When done take chicken out. Mix 1/4 cup flour and about 1/2 cup water in a shaker. Mixture should be a smooth consistency. Bring broth back to a boil. Slowly add flour mixture until gravy thickens. Break chicken apart; put in casserole dish. Pour gravy over chicken. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 until gravy is simmering. While waiting mix Bisquick and water forming a dough mixture. Roll and flatten to 1/4-inch thick. Cut out biscuits; place in casserole. Bake until brown about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Parmesan
instructions: Wash broccoli removing tough ends. Peel stems if tough. Split broccoli into separate flowerets. Cut pieces so they are no more than 3 inches long. Put broccoli into steamer basket. Steam for approximately 10 minutes or until broccoli is bright green but still tender-crisp in texture. Remove onto heated serving dish. Cover.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in top of double boiler or microwave for 1 minute. Melt and stir. Separate eggs and beat whites until stiff; set aside. Beat yolks; add salt almond extract and vanilla. Stir again. Whip heavy cream until stiff; set aside. Blend everything to egg yolks. Add everything to egg whites. Add chocolate egg whites and heavy cream. Fold carefully. Pour into another serving bowl. Refrigerate 6 hours.

title: Crazy Bread
instructions: Mix well. Pour into greased and floured bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mrs. Michigan Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and form into balls. Place in baking dish and pour 1 can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted) and 1 small can mushroom pieces (drained) or you can use tomato soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Pineapple Layer Cake
instructions: Mix and spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Jackie'S Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes with celery onions and garlic in 2 1/2 cups water. When potatoes are tender add margarine cheese and milk. Mash with potato masher until creamy. Salt and pepper to taste. Top with crumbled fried bacon.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Coat the chicken in a mixture of the flour salt pepper and paprika. Combine eggs and milk. Dip coated chicken in this and then roll it in bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Place chicken bone side down in baking pan. Drizzle with melted butter. (Also butter bottom of pan.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Lightly beat eggs milk and sugar. Add cans of corn and mix together. Pour into greased baking dish. Top with crushed saltines. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes until center is set or microwave for 10 minutes or until center is set.

title: French Bread Braids
instructions: In large mixer bowl combine 3 cups of flour salt sugar and dry yeast. Add shortening and warm water. Blend at lowest speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in remaining flour to form a stiff dough. Turn out on well-floured surface. Knead until smooth about 3 minutes. Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size about 1 hour. Punch down dough; divide in half. Divide each half into three parts. Form each part into a strip 14 inches long. Braid the three together sealing ends. Place on greased cookie sheet. Repeat with other half. Brush with mixture of egg white and water. Cover loosely and let rise until light and doubled in size about 45 minutes. Brush again with egg white mixture. Poppy or sesame seed can be sprinkled on. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Baked Salmon
instructions: Drain salmon; flake in large pieces. Arrange in bottom of medium sized shallow casserole. Mix together remaining ingredients. Spread over salmon and bake in a moderate oven at 400\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Serves 4.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in peelings until done. Peel potatoes while they are still warm then let potatoes cool and cube them. Mix in all ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Southern Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly grease baking sheet. Put the flour into a large mixing bowl. Make a well in the center. Add the lard and buttermilk. Start working the flour into the milk and lard squeezing the mixture through the fingers until a soft dough is formed. This will be a sticky dough. Lift the dough from the bowl and place on a well-floured surface. Sprinkle a little flour on top of the dough and start folding gently kneading and turning the dough until it is no longer sticky. Pat the dough to a thickness of about 1/2 inch. Cut with a 2 inch cutter. Place on the baking sheet. If a crispy outside is desired the biscuits are placed about an inch apart. For a soft biscuit place with the edges touching. Bake for about 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Best served hot from the oven. Yield 8 to 10 biscuits.

title: Shrimp Platter Dip
instructions: Use a 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix cream cheese sour cream mayonnaise catsup and cocktail sauce. Spread over platter then pour cocktail sauce next shrimp. Sprinkle Mozzarella. Next layer chopped tomato pepper and onion. Chill.

title: Dip For Fresh Fruit
instructions: Beat cream cheese and marshmallow creme together until blended well. Add vanilla. If too thick add small amount of milk.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: In a skillet saute the onion and pepper in the butter. Add tomatoes mushrooms and oregano. Add ground beef. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Place 1/2 of the spaghetti in a greased 13 X 9 X 2 baking dish. Top with half of the mixture. Sprinkle with 1 c. shredded cheese. Repeat layers. Mix the soup and water until smooth. Pour over the casserole. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook your rice then cook your broccoli. Mix rice broccoli can of Ro-Tel cheese and onion in casserole dish. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top of casserole. Cook in microwave 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Marinate chicken wings 3 days turning periodically. Layer wings in pan; pour a little marinade juice over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours turning wings over every 1/2 hour.

title: Broccoli Corn Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli. Mix butter with cracker crumbs; reserve 1/2 cup. Mix remaining crumbs with broccoli corn and seasonings. Turn into a buttered shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with remaining 1/2 cup butter crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Jello Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients except milk and lemon juice in a pot and bring to a boil stirring often. Cool completely.

title: Country Chicken With Onion Biscuits
instructions: Combine chicken bacon mixed vegetables tomatoes and 1 cup cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Blend soup and milk in bowl. Pour over casserole. Bake covered at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Drop Onion Biscuit Dough by spoonfuls into 12 biscuits on top of casserole. Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Top with French fried onions and 1/2 cup cheese. Bake for 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts. Yield 6 servings.

title: Beef Stroganoff Sandwich
instructions: In a skillet brown beef and onion; drain. Add salt garlic powder and pepper. Cut bread lengthwise in half; butter both halves. Place on baking sheet. Remove meat mixture; stir in sour cream. Spoon onto bread. Sprinkle with tomatoes green pepper and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese has melted about 20 minutes.

title: Cupcake Cones
instructions: Prepare the cake mix as directed on the box. Fill the cones about 1/2 to 3/4 full with batter. Bake on a cookie sheet using the temperature and length of time indicated for cupcakes. Let the cones cool then frost and add jimmies to frosting. Makes 24 cupcakes.

title: Cottage Cheese Luncheon Salad
instructions: Season cottage cheese with salt and pepper. If very moist drain. Add radishes chives and mayonnaise. If too dry moisten with a little cream or extra mayonnaise. Mix well. Chill.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown beef. Boil peeled potatoes until done. Mix water soup and gravy. Put layer of beef layer of mixed vegetables layer of potatoes and 1/2 soup and gravy mixture. Do this again ending with gravy mixture on top. Bake at 500\u00b0 until it simmers.

title: Old-Fashioned Southern Chicken Or Turkey Dressing
instructions: Mix cornbread celery onion and seasonings. Add well beaten egg and butter; mix thoroughly. Moisten with hot chicken broth until soft. Pour into a well-greased baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or use to stuff a 10 to 14 pound turkey.

title: Hash Brown Cheddar Bake
instructions: In a large bowl combine hash browns sour cream chicken soup Cheddar cheese onion salt and pepper. Mix well. Place mixture in a large baking pan. Combine crushed cornflakes and margarine. Sprinkle on top of potato mixture. Place in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Wonderful dish to serve with barbecue steaks or London broil.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a jellyroll pan. Mix Spry sugar eggs bananas and vanilla thoroughly. Blend dry ingredients into banana mixture. Spread into pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy. Add flour. Mix well. Add milk melted margarine and vanilla. Put coconut in unbaked crust and pour filling over coconut. (When you put the filling over the coconut the coconut seems to go through the pie better.) Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned but still a little shaky.

title: Homemade Finger Paint
instructions: Add starch to water. Stir over heat until thick. Add detergent and stir well. Divide into small jars. Color with tempera paint or food coloring. Keeps in refrigerator.

title: Shepherd Pie
instructions: Brown meat onion and garlic. Drain and add tomato sauce Worcestershire sauce and vegetables. Mix and pour into casserole dish. Top with mashed potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a 3 qt. casserole dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Zucchini Marmalade
instructions: Boil zucchini and water for 6 minutes then drain. Add sugar lemon juice and pineapple. Boil for 6 minutes. Add jello; bring back to boil. Pour mixture into hot jars and seal.

title: 6 Week Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix water and 100% bran and let stand. Sift together flour salt and soda. Cream sugar Crisco and eggs (1 at a time). Add All-Bran and buttermilk. Combine all of the ingredients and mix only until moistened. Spoon into greased muffin tins (2/3 full). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Batter may be covered and refrigerated for up to 6 weeks. Recipe may also be halved.

title: Apple Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Grease a casserole dish with margarine. Place apples in bottom of casserole and sprinkle lightly with few drops of lemon juice. Spread cranberries over this and sprinkle sugar over top.

title: Cream Cheese Danish
instructions: In a 9 x 13 baking dish sprayed with cooking spray layer 1 can crescent rolls (pinch together seams). Mix cream cheese and cup of sugar for middle layer. Layer other can of crescent rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until rolls begin turning brown. Mix together milk and powdered sugar; drizzle on top while warm.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine butter and cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually add sugar and continue beating until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Pour batter into well greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan. Place in cold oven and set temperature at 325\u00b0 and bake an hour and 20 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool 15 or 20 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Tart
instructions: Take a 9-inch pie crust; bake and remove from oven. Brush with Dijon mustard. Meanwhile cook broccoli as directed. Drain and chop. Mix with cream eggs salt cayenne nutmeg and cheese. Pour into prepared crust. Sprinkle around edges of top with sunflower seeds if desired. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until set. Serve hot warm or at room temperature.

title: Tex-Mex Layered Dip(Serves 12)
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Separately mix next 3 ingredients. Layer jalapeno bean dip avocado mixture sour cream mixture green onions tomatoes and olives (mixed together) and cheese.

title: Chicken Taco Soup
instructions: Boil chicken until done. After it cools shred with fork. In large saucepan combine olive oil taco seasoning onion garlic and chicken. Cook until onions are clear. Combine all ingredients and cook until thoroughly heated. Serve in individual bowls with corn chips and top with shredded cheese.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Do not drain fruit cocktail. Mix first 5 ingredients together. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Before putting in oven mix together nuts brown sugar and coconut; sprinkle over top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Cheese And Egg Sandwiches
instructions: Cut sandwiches into small triangles or into fancy shapes with cookie cutters or make open faces and cut in fancy shapes.

title: Tammy'S Potatoes
instructions: Wash and cube unpeeled potatoes; place in frying pan. Add the remaining ingredients; cover and cook over medium heat stirring often. When potatoes are tender remove cover and cook until water is cooked out.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 in a greased and floured Bundt pan.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate with the coffee. Combine flour baking powder and salt in a bowl. Beat chocolate mixture and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. On low speed beat in dry ingredients. Refrigerate until firm at least 2 hours. Grease cookie sheets. Roll teaspoonful of cookie dough into the confectioners sugar after forming ball with cookie dough. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until tops are just set. (Do not overbake.) Cool on sheets for 1 minute then transfer to racks until completely cooled. Makes approximately 5 dozen.

title: Picnic Cake
instructions: Beat eggs stiff and add sugar gradually. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately beating well after each addition. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Emporium Chili
instructions: Lightly brown onions and meat; break up meat in small pieces. Add puree and everything except kidney beans. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add beans; cook 5 minutes longer. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Put the first six ingredients into a roasting pan and mix with hands. Mix together the oil butter Worcestershire sauce and salts in a saucepan; heat but do not boil. Then pour over the other mixture. Stir well. Bake covered in 200\u00b0 oven for 2 hours and 10 minutes stirring every 20 minutes.

title: Hot Pinto Beans
instructions: Wash beans well and place in large saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Add salt pork salt pepper onion peppers and chili powder. Cook on medium heat until beans are tender or cooking time of about 3 or 4 hours and adding water when needed.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Saute mushrooms in their juice in a heavy skillet. Add oregano rice and butter. Chop finely and add ALL of green onions including the top green part. Into a large casserole put beef consomme and hot water. Add all other ingredients and bake approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour at 450\u00b0. When it is finished all the liquid will be absorbed.

title: Shepherd Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Saute onion and green pepper in drippings in a large skillet over moderate heat for 10 minutes or until onion is golden. Add beef and saute breaking meat up with a spoon about ten minutes until lightly browned drain off fat as it accumulates.

title: Cherry Swirl Coffee Cake
instructions: In bowl blend sugar eggs butter shortening baking powder and extracts on low speed. Increase to high speed and whip for 3 minutes. Stir in flour. Spread 2/3 batter over bottom of greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan greased. Spread pie filing over batter in pan. Drop remaining tablespoons over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden. While baking prepare a glaze of 1 cup confectioners sugar and 1 or 2 tablespoons milk. Drizzle over cake while warm. Is best when served immediately.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Mix soup water and rice. Place in a buttered casserole dish salt and pepper fryer pieces and place on top of rice mixture. Place cover on dish and bake 1 1/2 hours or until fryer is tender.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (or 325\u00b0 for glass dish). In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine. Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top evenly with remaining ingredients. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Cabbage Stir-Fry
instructions: Finely chop pepper green onion tops and dark green leaves from cabbage. Cook in Dutch oven with 2 tablespoons bacon drippings and 1/2 cup water. Cook until tender. Chop remaining white cabbage and onions; add to pot. Cook for 5 minutes. Add tad of water if needed.

title: Canopies
instructions: Mix all together (can make ahead) and put on bread. Broil until cheese melts. Serve warm.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Store in airtight sealed container. Mix about 4 teaspoons of drink mix with boiling water in a cup. Yields 1 gallon.

title: Rose'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine sugar water and lemon juice in small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Cool completely. Combine fruit in salad bowl. Add lemon mixture; mix gently. Chill for several hours to overnight. Yield 8 servings.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into pie shells. Bake about 30 minutes or until set and browned. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Our Favorite Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into crust. Chill at least 4 hours. Add pie filling to top of pie.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix margarine 1/2 cup powdered sugar and the vanilla. Stir in flour nuts and salt until dough holds together; shape into 1-inch balls. Place about 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until set but not brown about 10 to 12 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while warm; cool. Roll in powdered sugar again. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Turkey Cordon Bleu
instructions: Combine broccoli water and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir in stuffing mix. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Meanwhile place turkey slices in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cover each with a slice of ham and then a slice of cheese. Spoon broccoli stuffing over cheese. Cover loosely with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Meanwhile heat gravy and serve with turkey. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mexican Pan Bread
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil in oven-proof skillet. Leave half of sauteed mix in unheated skillet and put other half in medium bowl with chili powder cumin green pepper salt cooked beans and stock egg cornmeal and baking powder. Mix well and pour into skillet over onion mixture. Do not stir so that onion will stay on bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Hot Cakes
instructions: Mix well and cook on hot griddle.

title: Curried Shrimp
instructions: Slice onion. Finely chop garlic. In a large skillet heat butter and oil over moderate heat. Add the onion and saute until soft about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and saute for 2 more minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well and make into a ball.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix and bake in same plate. Sift flour and salt in pie plate. Boil shortening and water. Add hot mixture to flour. Mix with fork until all flour is moist. Work with hands and pat into shape. Flute edges. Prick with fork and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes one (8-inch) pie shell.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine butter sugar and milk in saucepan. Place over heat; stir until it reaches a boil then boil for 6 minutes. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered pans. Let stand overnight before cutting. Makes 5 pounds.

title: Spinach New Orleans
instructions: Cook spinach as directed. Drain. Add cream cheese onion 1/2 stick butter nutmeg and salt to taste. Place in casserole. Cover with Pepperidge Farm dressing. Pour 1/2 stick butter melted over dressing. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Olive Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cheese and flour. Add butter and mix thoroughly. (If dough seems dry work with hands.) Mold 1 teaspoon dough around each olive. Shape into ball. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Chill at least 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes onion cream cheese salt pepper egg and flour. Beat with mixer until fluffy. Put onion rings on top when ready to bake. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chiffon Pie
instructions: Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Combine egg yolks 1/4 cup sugar 1/4 cup water and salt in top of double boiler; blend. Add gelatin. Place over boiling water; beat constantly with rotary beater until thick and fluffy about 5 minutes. Cool place peanut butter in bowl; add remaining 1/2 cup water gradually beat until smooth. Add vanilla to egg yolk mixture; blend. Chill until slightly thickened but still syrupy about 10 to 15 minutes. Beat egg whites until foamy; add remaining 1/4 cup sugar gradually beating until stiff. Fold into peanut butter mixture. Turn into crumb crust. (You may use baked pastry shell.) Chill until firm. Makes 6 servings.

title: Near East Barbecued Beef
instructions: Remove all fat from meat. In a bowl combine the onion garlic soy sauce sugar pepper and oil. Pour mixture over the strips of beef and coat well with your hands. Broil the marinated meat turning once until tender (about 5 minutes on each side).

title: Skillet Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown beef in skillet. Add green pepper and onion until tender. Add rest of the ingredients and mix well.

title: Hearty Vegetable Barley Soup
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan brown meat in oil. Add onion and garlic and continue cooking until onion is tender. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except green beans. Cover bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 50 minutes stirring occasionally. Add green beans and continue cooking 10 minutes or until meat and barley are tender. Additional water may be added if soup becomes too thick. Makes twelve 1-cup servings.

title: Crunchy Asian Snow Peas
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil (approx. 5 quarts). When water begins to boil add snow peas just until color changes about 15-30 seconds. Immediately drain into colander and rinse well with cold tap water. Snow peas should be crisp and a beautiful green color. In a large bowl combine oyster sauce soy sauce and sesame oil. Add snow peas to mixture and toss well to coat. Add chopped scallions. Refrigerate. Serve cold.

title: Cottage Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix all together very well. Roll out on floured board very thin. Cut in squares 2 1/2 x 2 1/2-inches. Fill each square with your favorite Solo fillings. Fold in triangle; place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine beef 3 tablespoons steak sauce egg bread crumbs garlic and salt. Form into 24 meatballs. In a large skillet brown meatballs well in oil and then drain. Add remaining ingredients except cornstarch and green pepper. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in 1 tablespoon water. Stir in mixture. Add green pepper. Simmer uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Stir together oats flour and salt. Cut in butter until crumbly. Pat dough in bottom and up sides of a quiche dish or 9-inch pie plate. Set aside.

title: Choc-Oat-Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats chocolate morsels and nuts. Mix well. Drop by rounding measuring tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 9 or 10 minutes. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack. Cool completely. Yields 5 dozen (2 1/2-inch) cookies.

title: Poppy'S Toll House Cupcakes
instructions: Combine butter brown sugar vanilla and granulated sugar; beat until creamy. Beat in egg. Sift together and stir in flour baking soda and salt. Spoon by rounded tablespoonfuls into paper-lined 2 1/2-inch cupcake cups. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken. When thoroughly cooked shred meat. Discard bones and skin. In medium saucepan saute onion in margarine. Add chicken soups chili or salsa and heat through. In large glass baking dish layer tortilla chips chicken mixture and then cheese. Repeat layers. Put in 350\u00b0 oven and bake until top is slightly boiling and brown.

title: Noonies Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar; add egg then flour soda and cream of tartar. Add the nuts and cinnamon. Roll in a long roll; wrap in wax paper. Set in icebox for 12 hours. When cold slice and put on cookie sheet and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Crabmeat Spread
instructions: Roll ingredients into a ball and chill. Serve with cocktail sauce over it. Use any kind of crackers.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together sugar eggs margarine flour and bananas. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Rice Au Gratin
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Add milk up to \full line\ of ice cream freezer. Serves 10.

title: Fried Stuffed Jalapeno Peppers
instructions: Split peppers; clean out all seeds. Fill the 2 halves with softened cream cheese and freeze. When frozen dip in batter and deep fry. These are delicious! Use any batter recipe or buy a prepackaged mix.

title: Eggplant Balls
instructions: Peel and cut eggplant.\tPlace in boiling water and cook for 1/2 hour or until soft. Drain in colander for 1/2 hour. Combine all ingredients except sauce and peppers. Mix and shape into balls. Place in heated frying pan with oil and fry until slightly brown. Place on flat baking sheet. Fry peppers and place on eggplant balls scattering over top. Add sauce to top of peppers; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in preheated oven. Makes 60 balls. After frying place in sauce instead of meatballs.

title: Low-Fat Apple Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray bottom of 12 medium muffin cups with vegetable spray. In a large bowl beat milk yogurt egg whites whole egg vanilla and lemon zest.

title: My Mom'S Goulash
instructions: Cook hamburg in water until done then brown. Add tomatoes; cook 10 minutes. Then add macaroni. Cook 8 minutes long enough for macaroni to cook. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise mustard lemon juice salt and pepper in large bowl; blend well. Add potatoes eggs apple ham cucumber and onions; toss gently to mix.

title: 1-2-3 Fudge Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a saucepan on low heat stirring constantly with a wire whist. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and beat until smooth. Great for ice cream!

title: Puddin'Wich
instructions: Combine yogurt and peanut butter. Spread onto graham crackers or cookies. Top with another cracker. Wrap in plastic wrap. Freeze.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Place sausage; drain. Separate crescent rolls and place on 12-inch pizza pan (points towards center). Press over bottom and up sides; seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with cheese. In a bowl beat eggs milk salt and pepper; pour into crust. Sprinkle Parmesan over all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: A Cup Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into prepared cake pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden bubbly.

title: Glazed Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white very stiff. Add sugar and salt; add pecans. Coat well. Place 2 tablespoons butter on cookie sheet; melt and spread around. Place coated nuts on sheet. Place in oven at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Watch carefully; turn over once.

title: Green Bean And Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together in large bowl. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle crackers over top. Melt margarine and pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Goulash
instructions: Brown beef. Add tomatoes sauce and seasonings. Let simmer. Cook macaroni until done. Then add macaroni and cheese to sauce. When cheese is melted dinner is ready.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix Ranch dip sour cream and cream cheese. Refrigerate. Spread chilled sour cream mixture onto tortillas. Sprinkle with parsley olives and peppers. Tightly roll tortilla; wrap in foil. Refrigerate for a day. Unwrap and cut into pinwheels. Place on serving plate garnished with fresh parsley or lettuce leaves.

title: Popover Chicken Tarragon
instructions: Brown chicken in 2 tablespoons of the cooking oil; season with salt and pepper. Place chicken in a well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In bowl beat eggs; add milk and the remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Stir together the flour tarragon and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Add to egg mixture. Beat until smooth. Pour over chicken. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until done.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add sherbet and stir until dissolved. Add bananas mandarin oranges and pineapple. Pour into a 2-quart ring mold. Chill until set.

title: Two Egg Hot Water Sponge Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until lemon colored. Add sugar beating until light. Sift dry ingredients together then add to egg mixture. Mix well. Add 1/4 cup boiling water a little at a time then add the remaining 1/4 cup boiling water (all at once) and the flavoring.

title: Honey Dressing For Fruit
instructions: Add the lemon juice to the honey. Stir in the well beaten eggs. Mix together thoroughly. Cook over simmering water until thickened. Mixture will become clear stirring constantly. Cool. Fold in the whipped cream. Serve with an assortment of fruit.

title: Supreme Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender and chop into bite size pieces. Crush crackers. Place half of crushed crackers in bottom of baking dish. Mix chopped chicken together with water chestnuts soups and sour cream. Pour into baking dish 9 x 9-inch. Cover with remaining crackers and sliced butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Almond Butter Cookies(Yields 475 To 500 Cookies)
instructions: Mix almond butter butter and sugars until well blended. Add eggs baking soda and salt. Mix well. Add flour and vanilla. Roll dough out into logs and cut into 1-inch slices. Put on cookie sheets ungreased and press down but not flat. Dough should be of a consistency that you can be able to roll into a log. If of softer consistency add more flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar margarine egg cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Add soup with water and soda. Add flour. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 in a greased and floured loaf pan for approximately 1 hour.

title: Joann'S Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Fry potatoes until golden brown. Fry bacon until crispy. Crumble bacon into small bowl then pour over top of fried potatoes. Cut cheese into small cubes and pour over top of potatoes and bacon. Cover and place in microwave until cheese melts. Cool for 3 minutes then dip fries into Ranch dressing.

title: Chicken Imperial
instructions: Combine all ingredients except butter and chicken. Dip chicken pieces in melted butter then in crumb mixture coating well. Arrange pieces in shallow roasting pan. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Do not turn chicken.

title: Cherry Supreme Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice into condensed milk; stir until thick. Add vanilla flavoring. Fold in whipped topping. Put filling into crusts mounding up filling on sides. Spread cherry pie filling on top of pies but do not spread all the way to the sides. Chill and serve.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Saute sausage until done breaking meat into small pieces as it cooks. Drain and set aside. Beat eggs in bowl. Add milk salt and mustard.

title: Never Fail Dill Pickles
instructions: Fill jars with cucumber spears. Put powdered alum on top with dill seed and crushed garlic. Mix and boil the water vinegar and salt. Pour hot liquid over pickles. Screw lid on tight no need to process. Good to eat in a few days.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar oil and eggs. Sift together soda salt and flour; add to egg mixture. Add apples walnuts coconut and vanilla. Pour into 10-inch tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Using juice heat and mix with Jell-O. Cool. Whip the whipping cream and cream cheese. Fold in with the other ingredients adding pineapple. Pour into salad mold. Chill until set.

title: Cherry Dumplings
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Set aside until needed.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken into beaten eggs and roll into bread crumbs. Melt butter in frypan and brown chicken on both sides. (Do not try to cook done just brown.) Put browned chicken into casserole dish; pour Ragu sauce over chicken. Cover with grated Mozzarella cheese evenly. Sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 covered. Sprinkle with more Parmesan cheese when removed from oven. Serve hot.

title: Gumbo
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in skillet over medium heat. Stir in onion and celery until tender. Add flour salt and pepper. Stir like gravy until mixture is like paste. Remove from heat and combine all other ingredients in large pot. Stir in onion mixture. Bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours stirring occasionally. Serve over rice.

title: Zucchini Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all ingredients except zucchini thoroughly then fold in the zucchini. Pour into greased pan and bake 30 minutes until brown. Cut into 2-inch squares; serve warm. Also delicious refrigerator cold.

title: Southern Corn Meal Dumplings
instructions: Mix flour and meal and work in Crisco like pie dough. Add eggs to milk and add to flour. Add more milk if not enough to handle. Roll out and cut in 1-inch pieces and drop in chicken broth that is boiling. When you add last dough cover and turn fire out.

title: Eggs And Cheese
instructions: Place eggs cheese salt and pepper in a covered jar and shake well. Heat butter in skillet until melted over medium heat. Coat skillet with butter. Pour egg-cheese mixture into hot skillet. Cook over medium heat without stirring. Turn with spatula when eggs begin to firm on bottom. Cook 5 to 8 minutes or until eggs are firm. Serve warm.

title: Microwave Chex Party Mix
instructions: Add oleo Worcestershire and seasoned salt in a small bowl and mix. Pour cereal nuts and braids into plastic bag add oleo mixture and shake until thoroughly mixed.

title: Mint-Chocolate Malted
instructions: Place chocolate pieces in saucepan; add 1 cup of the milk. Heat and stir over low heat until chocolate pieces melt. Stir in remaining milk malted milk powder vanilla and mint extract; heat through. Beat with rotary beater until frothy; pour into cups or mugs. Serves 6.

title: Ziti Bake
instructions: Prepare spaghetti sauce. Meanwhile in 8-quart Dutch oven prepare ziti macaroni as label directs; drain. Set aside.

title: Percolator Punch
instructions: Mix and pour into 30 cup percolator. In top of percolator put 4 1/2 teaspoons whole cloves and 4 sticks cinnamon. Perk!

title: Enchilada Bake(Microwave)
instructions: Crumble beef in a shallow casserole dish (2 1/2-quart). Sprinkle with minced onion and garlic. Heat uncovered on Medium-high for approximately 6 minutes. Stop to stir occasionally to break up meat. Drain fat.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cut broccoli in pieces. Place all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish; cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or 1 hour. Stir once or twice during cooking. Add more milk if casserole appears dry.

title: Norwegian Pound Kake
instructions: Mix margarine and sugar until grimy. Mix baking powder with the flour. Add eggs and flour alternately then add vanilla. Sprinkle top with chopped nuts and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Test with toothpick.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Thaw bread completely. Slice lengthwise in approximately 7 slices. Dip each slice in butter then cheese. Arrange bread slices around greased angel food cake pan. Let rise. Bake 25 minutes until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tCombine first four ingredients; mix well. Blend in flour. Spread evenly over jelly roll pan. Mark lightly into squares. Drop pie filling into center of each square. Bake until lightly brown 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Sift confectioners sugar over top.

title: Meat And Potato Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Peel and slice potatoes and onions in thin slices. Layer meat potatoes and onions in a casserole. Mix soup salt and pepper; pour over the other ingredients. Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter until soft. In 2-quart casserole dish layer 1/2 the onion 1/2 the cheese and 1/2 the crackers. Repeat layers. Casserole can be refrigerated at this point and baked later. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecued Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except bacon in a 2-quart baking dish. Top with uncooked bacon. Bake uncovered for 1 hour. Delicious.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in oleo until mixture is crumbly. Add egg and orange juice all at once; fold in nuts and cranberries. Grease pan well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from pan; cool on wire rack.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Mix all together. Pat into squares 1/2 thick. Cut with knife. Place 3-inches apart on pan (closer to be soft). Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hot Spicy Chicken
instructions: Mix 2 teaspoons soy sauce sherry cornstarch and salt. Marinate chicken at least 1 hour the longer the better. Mix remaining soy sauce sherry vinegar chicken broth sugar and cornstarch; set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in wok. Cook peanuts until browned; set aside. Add 2 tablespoons of oil to wok and heat. Cook chili peppers until charred on medium heat. Increase heat to high and cook chicken for 2 minutes. Add onions peanuts and cornstarch mixture. Cook until sauce boils and thickens.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in casserole. Can be frozen at this point. Mix 1/2 stick oleo and corn flakes for top. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lace Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add vanilla and oatmeal. Drop on cookie sheet 1/2 teaspoon of dough 2-inches apart. They spread. Bake 5 to 6 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let sit a couple of minutes before removing. Tastes good and looks pretty.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Cream margarine and peanut butter. Add sugar. Knead with fingers. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips in double boiler and pour over peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Southwestern Success
instructions: Prepare rice. In a large skillet brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except rice and cheese. Remove from heat. Add cooked rice. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients. Mix the cranberries and confectioner sugar and let stand 1/2 hour. Then fold into muffin batter. Fill 12 well greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Florida Spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook pasta 7 minutes from boiling. Heat tomato sauce and garlic in saucepan. Mix with drained pasta and place in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Lay cheese on top and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Drizzle melted margarine over top. Bake 25 minutes. Dont overcook.

title: Everyday Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add milk and vanilla. Make dough soft but easy to handle. Chill. Roll 1/2 inch thick. Cut your favorite designs. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cook raisins and water 5 minutes. Save 5 tablespoons juice. Add soda when cool. Beat oleo and sugar.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Soak oats in buttermilk 5 minutes. Beat in the eggs; stir in the brown sugar. Sift flour baking powder salt and soda together and stir into mixture. Stir in the oil. Grease muffin cups and spoon in the muffin mix. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Jan'S Bean Delight
instructions: Throw it together and cook forever in crock-pot.

title: Black Bottom Pie
instructions: Mix gelatine sugar and salt together in pan. Add egg yolk 3/4 cup milk and chocolate. When chocolate is melted use mixer on low speed to get smooth. Let cool (not jelled). Whip milk (cold) until peaks form. Add chocolate mixture. You may fold together with the mixer. Pour into a graham cracker crust. Chill.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and put in 2-quart casserole. Cover with foil and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Uncover and sprinkle with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake 30 more minutes.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple and jello in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and let cool but do not let it jell. When cool add buttermilk and Cool Whip. Pour into a serving bowl.

title: Hot Baked Fruit
instructions: Place prunes apricots and pineapple in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Combine cherry pie filling water and sherry or juice. Pour over fruit. Mix well. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Delicious with meats.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Freeze overnight. Let set 30 to 40 minutes before serving.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Set aside. Beat egg yolks. Blend in lemon juice and milk. Add sugar flour and salt. Beat until smooth. Fold in whites. Pour into ungreased 1 quart casserole dish. Place dish in a pan of very hot water one inch deep. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve warm or cool and add whipped cream or ice cream if desired.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken. Remove from broth and let cool. Boil rice onion carrots celery spices and butter in chicken broth (vegetables should be crisp). Remove chicken from bones. Add the chicken to the prepared rice. Heat and serve.

title: Fat Free Oven Fried Potatoes
instructions: Spray the bottom of a baking dish with Pam cooking spray. Spread potatoes in dish; spray potatoes. Spread onions on top of potatoes; spray with Pam. Continue the same procedure with the green peppers. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 until tender.

title: Vegetable Cream Soup
instructions: Peel and cut carrots potatoes and onions to desired size. Cover with water and boil (steam) until soft. Add milk to vegetables and bring to a boil. Add a pinch of soda and can of diced tomatoes. Add a light thickener made with cornstarch and milk. Bring to a boil again. (When milk is added stir frequently or it will stick; also be sure to add baking soda before tomatoes.)

title: Scotcheroos
instructions: Bring to boil sugar and Karo syrup. Take off heat and add peanut butter. Mix with Rice Krispies. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Skillet Chicken
instructions: Coat cutlets with nonstick cooking spray and place in heated skillet. Saute on each side for 2 minutes. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Add oil to skillet and saute garlic; return chicken to skillet and simmer for 5 minutes. Ready in 20 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Also great over pasta.

title: Stove Top Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Leave in pot and mix in margarine salt and pepper to taste eggs and milk for consistency desired. Add cheese. Let simmer long enough for cheese to melt.

title: Chicken 'N Dumplings(For 4 People)
instructions: Put water chicken salt pepper and bouillon cubes in a large pot. Boil until chicken falls off bone. Remove all bones from chicken and pot. If dry add 1/2 cup hot water. Take 1 cup of broth from chicken. Add flour to medium bowl. Push around edge of bowl. Put 2 tablespoons of broth into center of bowl. Add flour with teaspoon. Stir together to make ball size dumplings. When through put on medium flame. Cook 1 hour.

title: Almost Sugarless Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese with small amount of saved pineapple juice. Beat in pineapple. Add pudding. Stir in cherries pecan pieces and Cool-Whip. Mix well. Pour into Pie shell and refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook the rice and cool; then mix all ingredients together. Add salt to taste. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Beef Hash And Eggs
instructions: In 12-inch skillet heat oil and butter over medium heat. Add potatoes and cook without stirring for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with thyme salt and pepper and cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender and lightly browned. In small bowl with fork gradually stir beef broth into flour until smooth. Pour evenly over potatoes. With spatula firmly flatten and cook without stirring for 5 minutes until sauce is thickened. Next stir in roast beef. Make shallow indents in hash and break an egg into each one. Cover and cook 3 to 5 minutes until eggs are cooked as desired. Sprinkle with parsley or onion and serve.

title: Shrimp Perleau
instructions: Cut up shrimp if large. Fry bacon in pan. Add onion bell pepper and celery. Cover and cook on low heat until tender. Add shrimp salt pepper Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco. Cook 6 minutes. Add cooked rice. Stir well to mix. Will serve 6.

title: Pepper Cheese Grits(Even Those Who Don'T Like Grits, Like This!)
instructions: Stir grits into boiling salted water. Cover and cook slowly 25 to 30 minutes. Add all cheese except 3/4 cup and stir until melted. Blend a small amount of grits into beaten eggs then stir eggs into grits. Add garlic powder if used. Pour into a greased two-quart casserole; sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Baked Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes; mash until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and beat until light and fluffy. Cool and cover. May be kept in the refrigerator up to 2 weeks.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook meat onion and garlic until meat is browned. Drain off fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes tomato sauce tomato paste basil and salt. Cover; simmer 15 minutes stirring often.

title: Honolulu Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate topping and 1/4 cup of the nuts. Pour int 8 x 11-inch cake pan. Sprinkle with nuts saved and chocolate topping over the top. Freeze until firm and slice.

title: Black Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Mix cocoa in hot water; add margarine eggs and vanilla. Bake in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients. Chill for 1/2 hour. Form into rolls to be sliced. Chill again. Slice and bake as desired for 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Coffee Can Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add all liquids and pumpkin. Stir until smooth. Grease and flour four 1 pound coffee cans. Fill half full with batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mary Wolf'S Nut Roll
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter until it looks like coarse meal. Add yolks and sour cream. Blend well with hands. Cut dough into 6 sections wrap in wax paper and chill overnight.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: In bowl combine graham cracker crumbs pecans raisins cherries and pineapple. In a pan combine marshmallows milk and butter. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until melted. Pour over pecan mixture and mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in coconut.

title: Russian Fluff
instructions: Fry hamburg and onion. Add other ingredients and mix. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetarian Tomato Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in cooking oil. Add chopped tomatoes water paste bouillon spices and cooking wine. Simmer. Chop vegetables using whichever vegetables you prefer. Add generous amounts to sauce. Simmer 2 to 3 hours stirring occasionally. Serve hot over pasta.

title: Hot Clam Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve hot with Melba toast crisp crackers etc.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix flour salt tartar water and oil in large pan. Cook over low heat. Use wooden spoon to stir until mixture is like dough. Remove from heat. Cool. When cool add flavoring and coloring. Knead until smooth.

title: Braggin Best Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl cream margarine vegetable oil and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.

title: Spiced Apple Muffins(15 Large Muffins)
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; make a well in center of mixture. Combine milk shortening and egg; add to flour mixture stirring just until moistened. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins filling 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in order given. Serve with Doritos.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in dressing overnight. Roll chicken in crushed crackers and then in Parmesan cheese. Melt margarine in casserole dish. Place coated chicken in casserole dish. Spread remaining crackers and cheese over the top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Uncover and continue cooking until brown.

title: No-Cook Noodles Lasagne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine browned ground beef oregano and spaghetti sauce. Layer sauce noodles and a mixture of eggs cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle 1 cup of Mozzarella cheese between layers. Reserve 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese to sprinkle on top of casserole after baking. Pour water evenly into 4 corners of dish. Cover with foil. Bake 1 1/4 hours. Sprinkle on cheese. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Parmesan Chicken Picatta
instructions: Rinse chicken pieces with water; do not dry. Coat chicken with combined Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chicken for 5 minutes on each side or until lightly browned and tender. Remove chicken to platter. Keep warm. Reduce heat to medium. Add wine to skillet; stir to loosen drippings. Remove from heat and serve over chicken.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli in chicken broth at least 5 minutes. (Can use frozen broccoli also.) Saute onion and carrots in margarine until clear. Add flour to make a roux (thickening sauce). Add pepper to taste. Add half and half. Cook until thickened.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs for 5 minutes. Add sugar pumpkin and lemon juice. Stir together the flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Fold flour mixture into pumpkin mixture. Spread in greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Top with 1 cup chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out on a towel sprinkled with 10x sugar. Starting at narrow end roll towel and cake together. Cool and unroll.

title: Cherry Cheese Cake Ice Cream
instructions: Prepare no bake cheese cake crumbs according to package directions using margarine and sugar; set aside. Prepare cheese cake filling according to package directions using milk; fold in whipped topping. Spoon half of the filling mixture into a large bowl. Cover with prepared crumbs and cherry pie filling. Top with remaining filling mixture. Pull metal spatula through mixture several times to marble. Do not overmix. Cover and freeze 6 hours or until firm. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving. Scoop into individual dishes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Cream sugar eggs and oil. Add dry ingredients with fruit cocktail; mix well. Place coconut in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan and pour cake batter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes.

title: Baked Eggplant
instructions: In small bowl combine mayonnaise onion and pepper. Brush on both sides of eggplant; dip in cracker crumbs. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in 350\u00b0 oven turning once until browned about 30 minutes. Serve hot. Always soak sliced eggplant in salted water about 30 minutes before cooking.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast with water. Mix rest of ingredients; mix well. Let set 10 to 15 minutes. Roll out on greased sheet tray. Makes one normal size pizza crust.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Combine the egg and milk; mix well. Stir together the flour cornmeal salt and pepper. Dip tomato slices in egg mixture and dredge in cornmeal mixture. Fry tomato slices in hot oil until browned turning once. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

title: Jewish Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles for 10 minutes. Drain then add butter sour cream cottage cheese eggs sugar and vanilla. Add 1 can crushed pineapple (do not drain). Mix together and put in greased pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. May sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar before baking.

title: New England Squash Pie
instructions: Combine squash sugar eggs milk and spices. Pour into a pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until of a custard consistency about 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake until done 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool before serving. Yields 2 pies.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix together pudding mix and milk. Fold in cool whip. Put in a single layer of crackers of bottom of a 9x13 dish. Add 1/2 of pudding mixture. Place another layer of crackers on top of pudding mix. Add remaining pudding mixture. Place another layer of crackers.

title: Cloud Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in a medium bowl; mix well. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Combine egg and milk; add to flour mixture stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead dough 3 or 4 times. Roll dough to 1/2 inch thickness and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Tuna Quiche
instructions: Bake pie crust at preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Distribute tuna over the bottom of pastry shell. Sprinkle cheese and onion over tuna. Beat eggs; add milk lemon juice and seasonings. Pour over tuna mixture. Bake on cookie sheet 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 12 to 15 minutes or until top is golden. Remove from oven and let set a few minutes before cutting.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Spray shallow baking dish with cooking spray.

title: Stack Up Ole
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add green pepper. Cook until tender. Combine process cheese picante sauce and milk in saucepan. Stir over low heat until process cheese spread is melted. Add meat mixture and olives. Mix well. Place one tortilla in baking dish. Top with 1/4 of meat mixture. Repeat layers ending with meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve garnished with sour cream and tomato wedges.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Thaw and drain broccoli. In a large bowl mix broccoli mushroom soup mayo egg and Velveeta cheese. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Set aside.

title: Everybody'S Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put into a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Aunt Karilene'S Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Roll out bottom crust of pastry and fit into 9-inch pie plate. Break Ritzs coarsely into pastry-lined plate. Combine water sugar and cream of tartar in saucepan; boil gently for 15 minutes. Add lemon juice and rind. Cool.

title: Christmas Divinity
instructions: In top of double boiler over hot water melt shortening; add cocoa and stir until smooth. Set aside over warm water. In large saucepan combine sugar syrup and water; cook over medium heat stirring until sugar dissolves. Lower heat slightly and cook uncovered without stirring to 260\u00b0 (hard-ball stage). Remove from heat. Immediately pour syrup in a thin stream into egg whites beating on high speed of electric mixer. Add vanilla; beat until candy begins to hold its shape. Quickly blend in cocoa mixture nuts and cherries. Drop by teaspoons onto wax paper.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Boil the dates in the water. Let cool 1/2 hour. Cream the butter and sugar. Add the remaining ingredients. Add date liquid alternately with flour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Heavenly Cake
instructions: Crumble cake in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Make pudding as directed on package. Add 3 tablespoons Cool Whip. Pour over cake crumbs and add strawberries. Add the remaining Cool Whip and top with coconut and nuts.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
