instructions: Brown hamburger meat and drain. Add all ingredients together in large boiler. Can double recipe. Cook on low heat 1 1/2 hours or until done. Continually Stir.

title: Beefy Baked Beans
instructions: Combine ground beef and onion; cook until meat is browned and crumbles. Drain stir in remaining ingredients. Put in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini And Peppers
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook onion in hot oil for 5 to 8 minutes or until tender. Stir in zucchini roasted pepper water and cumin. Reduce heat; simmer covered for 3 to 5 minutes or until zucchini is crisp-tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl; top with cheese. Yield 6 side-dish servings.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Line the bottom of the pan with waxed paper and grease it too. Drain salmon and remove skin and bones. In a small skillet; cook celery and onion in butter or margarine until tender but not brown. Stir in bread crumbs. Remove from heat. In a medium size bowl beat eggs slightly. Stir in bread crumb mixture milk parsley Worcestershire sauce and salt. Fold in salmon and lemon juice until well blended. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake for 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Let loaf stand for about 3 minutes. Loosen around the sides with a spatula and turn out onto a heated serving platter. Carefully remove waxed paper. Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Drain liquid from beans; mix ingredients all together. Chill if desired and serve.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and taco seasoning. Refrigerate 8 hours. Spread in bottom of bowl. Sprinkle shredded lettuce over cream cheese mixture. Put diced tomatoes on top of that. Sprinkle shredded cheese over all. To serve put nacho chips around sides of bowl.

title: Broccoli-Onion Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain well; set aside. Cook frozen or fresh onions in boiling salted water about 10 minutes or until tender. Drain; set aside.

title: Easy Dill Onion Bread
instructions: In small mixer bowl combine 1 1/2 cups of the flour with the yeast. In saucepan heat milk sugar butter salt dill seed and onion until warm stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Cool if above 115\u00b0. Add to dry mixture. Add egg. Beat at low speed for 1/2 minute scraping bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. By hand stir in remaining flour. Cover. Let rise until doubled 30 to 45 minutes. (An easy way to do this is to put bowl in your oven and add a pan of hot water on lower shelf and close the door). Stir down. Spread evenly in a well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or a large round casserole. Let rise until nearly doubled about 30 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cover loosely with foil if bread browns too quickly. Remove from pan. Cool. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Mushroom Casserole
instructions: Cook mushrooms in butter. Add rice. Heat on low for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in soup spinach and cheese. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Stir before serving. Top with extra cheese. Makes 5 cups.

title: Cinnamon Apple Rings
instructions: In skillet combine sugar candies and water. Stir over medium heat until sugar and candies dissolve. Core the apples; cut crosswise in 1/2-inch rings. Add to syrup. Simmer gently until transparent but not soft. Cool in syrup.

title: Fermented Fruit Cake Or Friendship Cake
instructions: Day One Pour starter into glass gallon jar. Add can of sliced peaches and juice (cut each slice into four pieces). Add 2 1/2 cups sugar. Stir. Cover jar loosely and keep at room temperature. Stir every day for ten days. All the sugar may not dissolve for several days. Dont cover airtight.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Fry bacon partially drain. Fry hamburger and onions in bacon fat. Combine all ingredients and put in baking casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamed Leek Soup
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan cook the leeks or onions in a small amount of boiling water covered for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender; drain and save water to use later. In same pan melt margarine and stir in flour bouillon granules and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Add milk and the saved 1 cup water. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minute more. Add shredded cheese; stir until cheese is melted. Add cooked onions; heat through. Serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Calico Bean Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Chop bacon in 1 inch pieces and cook until browned. Drain on paper towels. Chop onion and add to ground beef and brown. Drain and rinse all beans except the pork and beans. Drain beef add reserve beans pork and beans (undrained) barbecue sauce and all except 1/4 of bacon and mix well. Spoon mixture into baking pan and top with remaining bacon. Bake 45 minutes.

title: Apple Squares
instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar while continuing to beat. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add oil and vanilla. Fold in apples. Pour into a greased 9 x 15-inch pan. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook beans until soft not mushy. Put all including juice in roaster and mix (if too much juice add gradually). Bake at 425\u00b0 for 2 hours covered. Stir and check every 1/2 hour. To brown bake uncovered last 1/2 hour.

title: Homemade Sloppy Joes
instructions: Simmer ingredients in a large nonstick skillet for 1 hour. You can cook this in a crock-pot for 4 to 5 hours while you are away from the house. Calories per serving 121. Fat per serving 1 gram. Protein per serving 16 grams.

title: Baked Bean Quintet
instructions: In Dutch oven brown meat and onion. Add bacon and rest of ingredients. Stir gently with a spoon to mix. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine cornstarch garlic onions and salt. Add chicken and toss to coat the chicken. Prepare broccoli (steam) and drain in a large skillet. Add 1/2 the oil to chicken mixture. Stir-fry until chicken loses its color about 2 minutes on high heat. Add oil and pepper. Stir-fry 1 minute. Add broccoli. Stir-fry. Add chicken broth. Simmer 1 minute. Serve over rice (hot). I add cut onions sliced potatoes cabbage snow peas and yellow squash.

title: Bob Evans Breakfast
instructions: Brown sausage; drain on paper towel. Take 6 slices of bread and break up on bottom of pan. Put sausage on top of bread. Put cubed cheese on top of sausage next sprinkle onion green pepper and ham on top of cheese (optional). Take milk and eggs and beat. Pour over everything in pan. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Let cool for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix oil sugar and eggs for 2 minutes. Add flour and milk alternately. Add vanilla and coloring. Pour into greased and floured pans. Makes 3 layers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely before icing.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugars egg and vanilla until light and fluffy. Sift together dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture. Add oats raisins and nuts. Mix well. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Rub ribs with crushed garlic; cut into serving size pieces. Place the ribs in a large shallow pan; set aside. Heat oil in a skillet; add onion and cook until tender stirring occasionally. Blend in tomato sauce water lemon juice Worcestershire sauce brown sugar salt and pepper; bring to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Pour sauce over ribs and marinate 2 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator. Remove ribs from marinade (reserve for brushing) and put on grill or in a basket broiler 5-inches from coals. Grill 1 hour or until done turning and brushing frequently with marinade.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease one bread loaf pan. Combine all ingredients. Stir with a spoon about 60 strokes. Stir in nuts. Pour into pan. Bake for 45-55 minutes. Use a toothpick to check for doneness. Cool for 15 minutes. Top with powdered sugar frosting thinned to a drizzle topping consistency. Let cool completely before slicing.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
instructions: Cut up broccoli; peel and chop stems. Simmer in 1/2 cup of the water until just tender. Add soup seasonings and water. Cook until well blended and hot but not boiling; stir occasionally. Stir in grated cheese until melted. Serve hot.

title: Beer Batter Fish
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Blend until smooth. Cover fish with batter; fry until golden brown.

title: Onion Rings
instructions: Cut onions in rings. Mix all ingredients except onions together. Dip onions in mixture. Deep fry until brown.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Stir in berries. Chill until slightly thickened. Mix sugar pretzels and melted margarine; put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. This will be bubbly when taken from oven. Set aside to cool. Soften cream cheese. Add powdered sugar; beat together. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread mixture over cooled crust in pan. Spread slightly thickened jello mixture on top. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Fredie'S Apple Cake
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Stir into the next 6 combined ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle on top. Let stand for 1/2 hour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Place apples close together in an 8-inch square pan and pour soda over them. Sprinkle cinnamon and nutmeg over them and bake until soft. Try strawberry or raspberry cream soda. Serve with a peak of whipped topping. Apples are good hot or cold.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange chiles in a layer over bottom of dish. Cover with cheese. Blend eggs salt milk and Bisquick mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise sugar and vinegar to make dressing. Marinate broccoli in dressing. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. (Keeps well overnight or several nights!) Before serving add bacon and raisins.

title: Progressive Farmer Fruit Cake
instructions: Empty cake mix into bowl and add applesauce eggs salt and juice. Beat 3 minutes or until creamy and smooth. Combine fruits and nuts and dredge them in the flour. Stir into the batter. Line 2 (8 x 4 x 3-inch) loaf pans with a triple thickness of waxed paper and grease well. Pour batter into pans and bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours and 45 minutes. Cool cakes on a rack until thoroughly cool. Remove from pans leaving paper attached to cakes. Wrap cakes in aluminum foil and refrigerate or freeze until ready to use. Yields 2 large or 4 small loaves.

title: Grape Syrup
instructions: In small bowl stir jam until smooth. Stir in syrup until well blended. Delicious over pancakes waffles or pound cake. Will keep in refrigerator.\tYields 1 1/2 cups.

title: Ziti
instructions: Boil shell macaroni until done. Drain. Mix the cheese eggs salt pepper basil and shells. Top with Prego sauce. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Brussel Sprout And Tomato Salad
instructions: Cook brussel sprouts according to directions on pkg. Mix vinegar oil chervil salt and pepper in tightly covered jar. Pour over hot brussel sprouts. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Before serving add sliced tomato or cherry tomatoes or grape tomatoes. Sprinkle with snipped parsley.

title: The Fitt Ball
instructions: Mix together the cream cheese Accent onions Worcestershire sauce and 1 bag of dried beef; mix well with those little hands until well blended. (It will be firm.) Roll into a ball and roll in the remaining dried beef. Can be made 5 days ahead. I keep remaining dried beef and roll it a second time before serving.

title: Potato And Carrot Packets On Grill
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes and carrots about 1/4 inch. Peel onion; slice thin. Tear off 4 pieces of heavy-duty foil about 18 x 12-inches. Rub some butter into the center of each piece. Distribute evenly the potatoes carrots and onion onto the foil. Add salt pepper and pats of butter. Fold up packets closing off the ends. Place on a hot grill and cook for about 45 minutes turning once during cooking.

title: Schaum Torte
instructions: Sprinkle salt over egg whites and beat until frothy. Add cream of tartar and beat until the bowl can be turned upside down and hold the whites. Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time and beat until dissolved. Just before the last tablespoon of sugar add vanilla vinegar and almond extract. Then beat in final tablespoon of sugar. Scoop with large kitchen spoon a full helping of meringue. Dent and swirl. Put on brown paper (grocery sacks or parcel post) that has been greased with cooking oil. Put brown paper on cookie sheets and bake at 225\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours. Turn off and cool in the oven. Be careful not to burn. This can only be done on a dry sunny day!

title: Nana'S Baked Spaghetti(Great For Picnics And Buffets)
instructions: Cook beef and drain well. Cook onion and green pepper until soft in lightly coated fry pan; use olive oil. Season with garlic powder if desired. Cover bottom of pan with a layer of sauce. Layer with cooked spaghetti. Next a layer of ground beef onion and green pepper. Top with sauce. Continue layers until pan is full ending with a layer of spaghetti. Cover with sauce. Top with large amount of Cheddar cheese to make a thick layer. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until hot through and cheese is melted. Cover with foil if cheese gets too brown. Serve with extra sauce if desired.

title: Old Fashioned Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar mixed with cornstarch or flour. Mix and add milk and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until set and slightly brown.

title: Garbage Cake
instructions: Mix pie filling pineapple and nuts together. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle dry cake mix over the pie filling mixture. Cut butter into approximately 10 to 12 pats and place on top of cake mix. Do not stir. Cover with coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 until coconut is golden brown.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Mix baking mix milk and cheese until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream margarine oil and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and sour milk and beat well. Mix all dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Beat well. Stir in zucchini. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Top with 1/2 cup chocolate chips.

title: Cucumber Dip
instructions: Cream cheese should be softened. Grate cucumber. Drain well. Add cream cheese and mix well. Add nuts and enough mayonnaise to moisten. Mix until combined.

title: Fried Pie Crust
instructions: Knead real well. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix with sweet milk or buttermilk; fry in hot oil. Makes large serving.

title: Parmesan Biscuits
instructions: Dip each biscuit into butter; roll in Parmesan cheese to coat. Arrange biscuits in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with dill weed. Bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown and crusty. Makes 20 servings.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inches. Heat 1 inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) to boiling. Add broccoli. Cover and heat to boiling. Cook until almost tender about 5 minutes; drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli onions green peppers and cheese in pie plate.

title: Mock Pate
instructions: Mix liverwurst chopped onions and mayonnaise into a ball using milk and Tabasco sauce to soften cream cheese. Cover ball with the cheese mixture and roll it in the minced parsley. Cool to firm it and serve with crackers.

title: Bubble And Squeak
instructions: Cook bacon in skillet; remove bacon. Mix together potatoes cabbage and seasoning. Flatten mixture in skillet. When browned on one side turn and brown on the other. May add crumbled bacon to mixture.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and fill graham cracker crust. Chill.

title: Peppered Pan Potatoes
instructions: In small bowl combine salt pepper basil and thyme. Place 2 tablespoons of butter in 10-inch nonstick skillet. Line the bottom of skillet with overlapping slices of potatoes in circular pattern; sprinkle with part of salt mixture 2 tablespoons of onion and 4 tablespoons of butter.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix and pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until knife inserted into center comes out clean.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 11x7 inch baking dish. Cook beef and onion in large skillet until beef is browned drain. Stir in taco sauce water chilies and seasoning mix. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cook stirring occasionally for 3 to 4 minutes. Layer half of broken shells on bottom of prepared baking dish. Cover with half of meat mixture. Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly and cheese is melted. Garnish with chopped tomatoes sliced green onions and sour cream. Yield 8 servings.

title: Nonfat Eggnog
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat heat 5 cups milk Egg Beaters and sugar until thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and rum extract. Cover and chill. Just before serving thin with one cup skim milk and garnish with cinnamon and nutmeg. Serves 8.

title: Batter Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine flour milk egg salt sugar and baking powder. Mix thoroughly. Cut boneless chicken into 1/2-inch strips. Sprinkle with salt and dip into batter. Fry in deep hot fat until done and golden brown.

title: Doubly Good Yeast Rolls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix 2 minutes on low speed of electric mixer and set aside. Combine flour with remaining ingredients in a large mixing bowl; mix 3 minutes with electric mixer at medium speed. Add yeast mixture and mix well at medium speed. Cover and let rise in warm place until dough has doubled in bulk. Punch dough down; cover and refrigerate overnight. Shape in desired rolls and brush with melted butter. Let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) free from drafts about 2 hours or until doubled in bulk. Bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients. Put in ovenproof dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown on top. Top with slivered almonds.

title: Old-Fashioned Pumpkin Gingerbread
instructions: Mix brown sugar margarine granulated sugar and orange juice in a bowl until smooth. Add egg whites one at a time until blended. Stir in pumpkin corn syrup and molasses.

title: Parmesan Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine the flour cheese salt and pepper in a plastic bag. Place 6 to 8 pieces of potato in bag at a time. Shake to coat. Place coated pieces of potato in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish in which you have melted the butter. Put potatoes in a single layer. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. After 1/2 hour turn potatoes and sprinkle with remaining flour and cheese mixture. When done they will be golden brown crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. Preparation time 15 minutes; cooking time 1 hour. Quick and easy. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Deep Fry Batter
instructions: Add water to make a thin batter. If cooking fish cut and salt. Dip in batter and deep fry until done.

title: Chewy Tan Bars
instructions: Melt margarine; add sugars egg and vanilla and beat well. Add nuts; stir in flour salt and baking powder. Spread in an 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Bessie'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook sliced squash 7 - 10 minutes or until fork tender; drain and mash slightly. Mix all ingredients together except cheese and bread crumbs. Pour into casserole dish and top with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered.

title: Deviled Ham Puffs
instructions: Blend cream cheese baking powder milk and egg yolk together. Toast bread on one side. Spread untoasted side with deviled ham. Cover with a mound of cheese mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until puffed and slightly browned.

title: Sour Cream Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in medium saucepan. Whisk in milk until smooth then yolks until blended. Stir in lemon peel and juice. Add butter and whisk constantly over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes just until boiling. Remove from heat and stir 1 minute longer. Cover with plastic and cool. Stir in sour cream until blended. Pour into pie shell. Cover loosely and refrigerate at least 6 hours or up to 2 days. Before serving add garnishes. Serves 8.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Cook meat onions and pepper until pink is gone. Add taco seasoning and Ranch dip then the rest of ingredients. Use as much water that you need to make the consistency you want. Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour. Top with grated cheese of choice.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in pan and blend in flour. Add milk and other ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring until smooth and thick (approximately 7 minutes). Serve over broccoli or cauliflower.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Mix together tomato paste tomato sauce Ragu package of spaghetti sauce mix and cooked ground chuck. Cook noodles in large amount of water until tender; drain and rinse. Mix eggs cottage cheese parmesan cheese salt parsley flakes and pepper. Layer noodles. Spread cottage cheese filling Mozzarella cheese and meat sauce. Repeat steps until done. Top with cheese. Bake at 375 degrees about 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes. Use for barbecued chicken or beef. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Sausage Treats
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into approximately 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender. After thoroughly mixing remove half of the ingredients to another container. Add ice to the top of the blender and mix with the remaining half of the ingredients. Repeat with other half and serve.

title: Baked Brie In Bread
instructions: Slice top of the bread off. Scoop out bread from crust. Cut or tear bread into pieces and toast to serve with Brie. Butter inside of crust. Layer the Brie mushrooms garlic and toasted almonds on the inside of crust. Place the top back onto the round. Loosely cover with aluminum foil. Place the round on a cookie sheet. Heat in a 300\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until cheese has melted and ingredients are easily mixed. Keep aluminum foil on top and return to oven. Heat thoroughly (about 10 to 15 minutes or more). Serve with toasted pieces of bread.

title: Stuffed Veal Cutlets(Vitello Cotoletta Ripieni)
instructions: From my husbands Aunt Dora.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake until brown on top at 375\u00b0.

title: Luscious Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots; drain. Make cheese sauce in normal manner. In buttered baking dish put alternating layers of carrots sauce and onion rings. Reserve some onion rings for topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 20 to 30 minutes. Put remainder of onion rings on last 5 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Glazed Ham
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil over medium heat stirring occasionally. Set aside. Slice away skin from ham. Score fat on ham in diamond design and stud with whole cloves. Place ham fat side up on rack in a shallow roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer making sure it does not touch fat or bone. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Baste every 15 to 20 minutes with sauce. Yields 10 to 14 servings.

title: English Connection Scones
instructions: In large bowl combine flour sugar salt and baking powder. Cut butter into pats and combine with flour until it resembles fine bread crumbs. Add whipping cream. Turn on floured bread board. Knead lightly 3 or 4 times. Pat out to 1-inch thick. Cut out round with glass or cutter. Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 12 scones.

title: Green Beans And Carrots Almondine(Microwave)
instructions: Combine carrots green beans bouillon cube and water in 2-quart casserole cover and cook on High in microwave for 12 to 14 minutes until tender-crisp stirring twice while cooking. In a 1 cup measuring cup cook butter and slivered almonds until lightly browned. Add lemon juice and toss with cooked vegetables.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll crescents and press firmly in a pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool. Mix cream cheese and dressing until smooth. Spread over cooled crust. Top with lettuce tomatoes cheese boiled eggs or your favorite salad toppings.

title: Frozen Grapes With Frangelico
instructions: Remove stems from grapes and wash thoroughly. Place grapes on a tray lined with paper towels and freeze until hard. Serve in dessert dishes with a glass of Frangelico or with a little Frangelico sprinkled on the grapes.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Heat first 4 ingredients until sugar is melted; do not boil! Combine all remaining ingredients. Pour liquid over vegetables and mix well. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder salt sugar and cinnamon. Beat eggs and beat in milk butter bananas and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and stir until blended. Bake each pancake on a hot lightly oiled griddle pouring out 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake. Flip once when brown.

title: Sweet Pickles(8-Day)
instructions: Wash cucumbers and put into crock whole; cover with boiling water. Repeat with boiling water 3 mornings. The fifth morning drain then slice or cut in chunks or slice longways.

title: Southern Spoon Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Add milk. Cook in double boiler until fairly thick. Remove from heat; add beaten egg yolks and butter. Cool somewhat. Add the stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into a baking dish or casserole; bake in a slow oven (325\u00b0) for about 45 minutes. Serve immediately. Add plenty of butter at the table as for any hot bread. Especially good with baked or fried ham.

title: Trail Bars
instructions: Spray 13 x 9-inch baking pan with no-stick spray. Measure out cereal. Cut up fruits and nuts and have all measured and ready to add before melting marshmallows. Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir almost continuously until melted and well blended. Remove pot from heat and quickly stir in remaining ingredients stirring until well coated. Pour into sprayed pan and allow to cool. Cut into bars and wrap each bar in foil for hiking. These travel and keep well.

title: Pasta Bruccoleri(On A Healthy Note)
instructions: Steam vegetables. Cook pasta. Saute garlic in 1/4 cup of chicken broth. Add steamed vegetables pasta and remainder of chicken broth to garlic. Add margarine (optional). Sprinkle grated Parmesan over pasta to serve.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add flour and eggs. Beat well. Add buttermilk and flavoring. Pour into 9-inch uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Green Party Salad
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk in top of a double boiler. Pour hot mixture over lime gelatin stirring until dissolved. Stir in cream cheese. When cheese is dissolved add pineapple. Cool. Blend in mayonnaise whipped cream and nuts (if desired). Chill until firm. Serves 12.

title: Marshmallow Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until fluffy. Serve with any kind of fruit.

title: 4 Layer Pudding
instructions: First Layer Mix flour margarine and nuts until crumbly. Press in 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 on top rack for 20 minutes. Set aside to cool.

title: Cherry Crunch Cake Bars
instructions: Mix oleo flour and nuts and put in long pan. Press it out to make a crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and confectioners sugar and pour over crust after crust cools. Pour cherry filling over filling and refrigerate.

title: Parmesan Potato Casserole
instructions: Lightly grease shallow baking dish. Cook potatoes and drain. Return to pot add butter and mash. Add milk eggs cheese parsley salt and pepper and mash until smooth. Spoon into prepared dish. Bake uncovered 35-45 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: Combine flour sugar egg reserved pineapple juice and vinegar. Cook over medium heat until thick. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Mix with remaining ingredients and 1/2 of the nuts. Sprinkle with remaining nuts on top. Refrigerate until served.

title: Easy Cheesecake
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; add cream cheese 1 tablespoon sugar and lemon juice. Place in refrigerator to set slightly. Crush crackers to make crumbs; add 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Place graham cracker crumb mixture in the bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Save about 1 cup of crumbs for topping. Whip chilled milk; add 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Add cream cheese mixture and mix well. Pour over crumbs and sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Place in refrigerator overnight.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook rotini until al dente or firm. Drain and rinse with cold water then drain thoroughly. Empty pasta into large bowl. Add 1/2 cup of prepared dressing. Mix well.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Cake With Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Bring the following items to a boil butter water salad oil and cocoa. Pour over sugar and flour. Add buttermilk soda eggs and vanilla. Pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Stir-Fried Steak
instructions: Cut steak with the grain into 2-inch wide strips. Then cut each strip across the grain into 1/4-inch thick slices. In a medium bowl combine the steak and soy sauce 1 tablespoon oil and 2 teaspoons cornstarch. Stir to coat steak and set aside.

title: Supreme Hot Chicken Sandwiches
instructions: Set out 8-inch square pan. Blend flour into soup in saucepan. Add 3/4 cup milk and heat to boiling stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in chicken pimiento and onion. Cool slightly. Spread mixture in pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 4 squares. Place one square on each of 4 bread slices. Cover with remaining bread slices. Smooth edges with metal spatula. Cut each sandwich in half to form rectangles. Beat eggs with 1/4 cup milk. Dip sandwiches on all sides in egg mixture then in potato chips. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: All-Bran Rolls
instructions: Mix shortening sugar All-Bran and salt in bowl add boiling water. Let stand until lukewarm add well beaten eggs; mix with first mixture. Add yeast that has been dissolved in the lukewarm water then flour. Roll out on well floured board about 1/2-inch thick cut with biscuit cutter. Fold over halfway for pocketbook rolls brush with melted butter before folding. Let rise and bake on cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Can be refrigerated up to 2 weeks. Keep a damp cloth over top. Can be made in any shape. These are good light rolls that I use often.

title: Sunshine Cake
instructions: Beat yolks till thick and lemon color. Add water and beat. Add sugar gradually and beat thoroughly. Add flour sifted with baking powder and salt. Mix until smooth; add vanilla. Beat egg whites till foamy; add cream of tartar and beat until stiff. Fold into cake batter. Bake in an ungreased tube pan at 325\u00b0for 50 to 60 minutes. Invert pan to cool. Remove cake and frost.

title: Easy Low-Fat Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Cook carrots and celery with salt and pepper until tender in separate pot. Combine all other ingredients and cook on medium heat 15 minutes. Add drained carrots and celery; cook on low 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Mix ingredients together and spread evenly into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Cut up vegetables in a large bowl. Add the jar of pimentos; cut if big pieces. Add the bottle of dressing. Add as many Bac*Os as you want. Season with the seasoning to your taste.

title: Three Bean Chili
instructions: In 4-quart saucepan or Dutch oven brown ground beef with onions and green pepper; drain. Add tomatoes tomato sauce tomato soup and taco seasoning mix; blend well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in beans; simmer an additional 15 minutes to blend flavors stirring occasionally. Makes 7 (1 1/2-cup) servings.

title: Char'S Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Bake ribs in a 350\u00b0 oven until done. Top with sauce and brown 1/2 hour.

title: Ranch Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and dressing mix. Serve with your favorite fresh vegetables.

title: Lemon Bisque(Yields 10 Servings)
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add sugar salt juice and grated rind. Refrigerate. Whip the milk until stiff. When the Jell-O is slightly congealed add it to the whipped milk. In a casserole pan put a layer of crumbs; pour the Jell-O mixture over crumbs and cover the top with more crumbs. Refrigerate until firm; cut into 3-inch squares.

title: Pecan Pies
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together and pour into pie shells; bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes then turn temperature down to 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: First Layer Work together flour margarine (oleo) and pecans. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown lightly at 400\u00b0 and let cool.

title: Opryland Bread Pudding
instructions: Break bread in small pieces in baking dish (about 1 1/2-quart). Sprinkle cinnamon over bread and add raisins and melted butter. Toast bread mixture lightly in 350\u00b0 oven. Mix eggs sugar milk and extract; add to bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes or until solid.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Steam raisins in boiling water 25 minutes. Drain. Mix remaining ingredients. Add flour; mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Use another pie shell to make strips for top of pie; dab dots of butter. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Oven Stew
instructions: Cut up carrots potatoes and green pepper. Put in heavy roaster. Salt and pepper to taste. Add seasonings and tapioca. Cover tightly and bake at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours.

title: Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs. Stir in milk vanilla and dry ingredients (well sifted). Stir in nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on buttered baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
instructions: For German Chocolate Cake Mix Base Mix cake mix with 2 of the 4 eggs. Mixture will be thick. Put stick of butter in 9 x 12-inch cake pan and melt in oven. Make sure all of pan gets greased by butter then pour the excess into cake mixture. Mix well.

title: Snowflakes
instructions: Cream margarine cream cheese and sugar well. Beat in egg yolk vanilla and orange rind. Gradually blend in flour salt and cinnamon which have been sifted together. Fill press. Form cookies on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake. Remove at once.

title: Cheezed Potatoes
instructions: Place top chafing pan in water jacket. Melt butter. Add onion and saute. Place layer of potatoes in pan. Add salt and cover potatoes with layer of cheese. Repeat layers until all are used. Pour the bouillon over this. Cover pan and cook slowly 25 to 30 minutes until cheese is melted and piping hot. Serve with salad or cold cuts. Serves 4.

title: Civitan Fruit Cake Cookies(Tv Recipe)
instructions: Mix cake mix oil flavoring and eggs in a large bowl until smooth. Add fruit cake bits. Roll in soft balls about the size of\twalnuts. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until slightly brown. Remove from cookie sheet.

title: Pineapple Layer Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks and egg. One at a time beating well after each.

title: Chuck'S Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla and beat. Sift dry ingredients together and stir in. Add chocolate chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 16 minutes.

title: Canuck Pie
instructions: Line a 10-inch pie pan with pastry. Combine meats and cook stirring until meat particles separate about 10 minutes. Boil potatoes and onions together until tender. Drain and mash adding some of the potato liquid. Add the spices meat and some of the pan drippings. Combine well. Turn into the pastry-lined pan. Cover with top crust. Cut slits in top crust; bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When reheating use 350\u00b0 oven for a few minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Wally'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat in bacon drippings. Add tomato sauce and seasonings. Add enough water to make correct consistency. Simmer for 45 minutes. Never use a lid when making chili. Simmer longer for a more spicy chili. Do not put beans or anything else in this chili. It will only take away from the flavor.

title: Italian Vegetarian Stew
instructions: In large skillet use part of the oil and brown zucchini onions and mushrooms. Salt and pepper to taste. Set aside in a dish. In the same skillet add remaining oil if needed and fry green and red peppers. While peppers are frying pour crushed tomatoes in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Put in green beans and cook until tender (do not overcook beans). Add salt pepper and red crushed pepper to taste. (Should have a bit of a bite to it.) When beans are al dente combine all veggies to sauce. Bring to a boil. Take off heat and let set for 5 minutes. Serve over pasta or eat plain with bread.

title: Confetti Punch
instructions: Combine juices sugar and mint leaves. Chill. Strain. Pour mixture over ice in a bowl. Pour ginger ale and soda water in on sides of bowl to create foam. Add fruit sherbet scoops to float on top.

title: Scotch Pancakes
instructions: Beat the eggs until frothy. Add salt sugar vanilla and almond. Alternate flour milk and yogurt. Add any optional ingredients. Just before cooking add baking powder. Stir briefly until the lumps are out. Cook on a very hot griddle without oil. These pancakes are magic; they dont stick because of the baking powder. Serve hot and add fresh fruit maple syrup or yogurt.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add all ingredients to large loaf pan; shake ketchup over top and pieces of block cheese. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. (It will thicken when done.)

title: Real Rice
instructions: Heat oil and garlic on high. Stir in rice to coat with oil. Add water (it will sizzle). Cook on high to boil off water (about 8 to 10 minutes). Uncover and stir the liquid. It should be almost gone. Turn off heat and let stand. Serve with Spanish or Chinese recipes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine sugar oil and eggs; beat well. Add can of pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients add to mixture and then add water. Mix well. Raisins and nuts may be added if desired. Makes 2 loaves 3 medium loaves or 4 small loaves. Grease pans and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven; large loaves for 1 hour medium loaves for 40 minutes and small loaves for 30 minutes. Toothpick comes out clean when done.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees until done and brown on top. Let loaves cool slightly in pans. Pour glaze over loaves and cook completely in pan before removing. Makes 3 small or 2 large loaves.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Prepare noodles as directed. Drain and mix ingredients together. Put mixture into a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Brown beef and onion; add paste and seasonings. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Spoon onto buns. Top with cheese. These open-faced sandwiches can be placed in a 400\u00b0 oven until cheese melts.

title: Cherry Cheese Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare brownie mix as directed on package except bake 20 minutes. Beat vanilla egg milk and cream cheese in a large bowl until smooth. Pour over baked brownie layer. Bake until topping is set approximately 25 minutes. Cool 2 hours. Top with pie filling. Store in refrigerator. Cut in squares to serve.

title: Frank Alper'S Man'S Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Day before or early in the day in saucepan make sauce. Combine salt pepper tomato juice cayenne mustard sugar bay leaf vinegar Worcestershire garlic and oleo. Simmer 10 minutes then refrigerate.

title: Toscas
instructions: Cream 6 tablespoons butter and add gradually 1/4 cup sugar. Blend in 1 cup sifted flour. Divide into 12 small ungreased muffin tins. Press into bottoms and halfway up sides of cups. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Festive Carrot Apple Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Refrigerate. Can be made several hours before mealtime.

title: Banana Pudding 1(Noncooked Kind)
instructions: Mix pudding mix and milk. Add Cool Whip and sour cream. Crumble vanilla wafers in pan or dish. Layer wafers bananas and mixture.

title: Breakfast In The Car
instructions: Stuff pita pocket with cream cheese fruit and nuts. Place on a paper towel and microwave on High 20 seconds. Pack up and eat on the go. Yields 1 serving.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain well. Arrange broccoli and chicken in casserole dish. Combine cream of mushroom soup cream of celery soup mushrooms and rice. Pour over the chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle cheese over soups. Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until bubbly and the cheese is melted.

title: Garden Salad
instructions: Bring sugar oil vinegar salt pepper water to boil. Remove from heat. Cool. Drain canned vegetables. Mix all vegetables. Pour cooled liquid over vegetables. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving. Will keep a week.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add tomato paste tomato sauce basil parsley flakes oregano and garlic salt to hamburger. In separate bowl mix cottage cheese salami and eggs.

title: Camp Potatoes
instructions: Peel and chop potatoes. Chop onion and green pepper. Place potatoes onion and green pepper on heavy-duty foil; dot with butter. Sprinkle salt and pepper over top. Fold foil up around potatoes. Be sure to seal edges of foil well. Grill covered over medium coals for 35 to 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Hot Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger and chopped onions. In a six quart kettle mix all ingredients together. Simmer for forty-five (45) minutes.

title: Nacona'S Cookies
instructions: Soak raisins in beaten egg and vanilla mixture until soft. Cream butter and white and brown sugars. Add raisin and egg mixture. Sift in dry ingredients. Add oats and nuts. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put away in a covered container while still a little warm.

title: Stickies
instructions: Thaw frozen bread but do not let raise. Pick thawed pieces off one loaf of bread and put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Sue'S Cream Biscuits
instructions: Mix together all dry ingredients. Cut in butter or margarine. Beat eggs (save a little of the white to spread on top of dough) and add to mixture. Toss on a lightly floured board and roll to about 3/4-inch thickness. Use a floured biscuit cutter to cut biscuits. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet and brush tops with egg white and sprinkle lightly with sugar. Bake for 15 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Mix flour 2 tablespoons sugar salt and butter like pie crust and pat in a 9 x 9-inch square pan. Mix apples 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Spread over crust.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except sugar in blender. Pour into pot with sugar and cook until it becomes thick. Pour into 2 uncooked pie crusts and bake for 30 to 45 minutes on 400\u00b0.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake I(24 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C). Lightly grease one 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cream together 1/3 cup of the cocoa white sugar and 1 cup of the butter or margarine until light and fluffy. Add the eggs and 1 teaspoon of the vanilla and beat well. Mix flour baking powder coconut and chopped pecans together. Stir flour mixture into the egg mixture and stir until just combined. Pour batter into the prepared 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0F (175\u00b0C) for 40 to 50 minutes. Smooth Marshmallow Creme over top of cake while still hot. Let cake cool completely then ice with Chocolate Icing.

title: Cornmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugar in large bowl. Add egg and beat well. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Drop dough from a teaspoon on a greased baking pan. Bake in moderate oven (300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0) about 15 minutes until lightly browned. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Mom'S Munchers
instructions: Cream margarine; add sugar eggs and remaining ingredients. Butter a cookie pan and drop by small spoonfuls 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Ragtime Rocky Road
instructions: Melt chocolate bars in top of double boiler over warm water; stir in marshmallows and nuts. Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan. Chill. Cut when firm. Yields 16 squares.

title: Margaritas
instructions: Put all in blender add ice blend and serve.

title: Beef Dip
instructions: Soak dried beef in hot water for 1 to 2 hours (to get out salt). Ring out water. Rinse. Mix cream cheese and shredded cheese. Mince beef. Chop pepper. Mix all ingredients together. Heat in oven at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with Triscuits and enjoy!!

title: 5-Cup Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter add sugar and beat well. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour alternately with milk; begin and end with flour. Add flavorings.

title: Baked Ham Steak
instructions: Put ham steak in a microwave baking dish. Cover with waxed paper and cook on Medium for 4 minutes. Remove from oven. Drain and reserve juices. Mix juices with brown sugar and mustard. Spread over top of steak. Cook uncovered on Medium for 2 minutes. Cover loosely and let stand for 2 or 3 minutes before serving.

title: Country Style Cole Slaw
instructions: In large bowl stir together the first six ingredients. Add the next four ingredients and toss to coat well. Cover and chill for several hours. If desired serve in a bowl lined with lettuce leaves. Makes about 8 cups.

title: Cajun Rice
instructions: Cook rice and set aside. Brown sausage in skillet with onion. Add Cajun spice and drain kidney beans. Add to rice mixture and serve.

title: Beef Tips And Rice
instructions: Place roast in a pan which has a cover. Season both sides with salt and pepper. Cover the pan with foil crimping edges around pan. Place the lid on the pan. Do not add water and do not peek! Bake 30 to 45 minutes per pound at 275\u00b0 if roast is thawed and at 300\u00b0 if roast is frozen. The secret to the success of this roast is not looking.

title: Chicken And Biscuits With Gravy
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Remove skin from chicken and place in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Spread undiluted soup over chicken. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove cover and arrange biscuits on top of chicken. Continue baking at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until biscuits are browned.

title: Creamy Apple Squares
instructions: Mix and pour over the apples. Mix reserved cake mix with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind the cranberries up and soak in sugar for 2 hours. Then mix the marshmallows pineapple pecans and Cool Whip with the berries.

title: Orange Bread
instructions: Combine sugar pecan and orange rind in a small bowl. Separate each biscuit; place a cream cheese square in center of one half and top with remaining half. Pinch sides togehter. Dip in butter and dredge in sugar mixture. Stand each biscuit on edge in a lightly greased 12 cup bundt pan. Spacing evenly drizzle with remaining butter and sprinkle with remaining sugar mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately invert onto a wire rack. Combine powdered sugar and orange juice spoon over warm bread. Serve immediately. Yield 1-10 inch coffee cake.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix soups and sour cream together. Divide in half. Add chilies onion 1/2 the cheese all the chicken to 1/2 the mixture. Roll mixture in tortillas and place in baking pan. Cover with remainder of sauce and grated cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet And Tangy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Let stand for several hours to blend flavors. Makes about 1 1/4 cups sauce. Use on spareribs or chicken.

title: Saltless Seasoning Salt
instructions: Mix together. Cover. Store in a dry place. Use as you would regular seasoned salt.

title: Flake Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking powder soda and salt. Separately cream butter and sugars. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour mix and cereal last. Dont over-blend the cereal. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased sheet; bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Angel Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff; add 2 Tbsp. of granulated sugar at a time then same with powdered sugar beating at high speed after each addition. Butter and flour 9-inch pie pan and spread meringue evenly in pan. Bake 300 for 45 - 50 minutes until lightly browned. Meringue will rise above pan but center will fall as it cools. Cool and fill.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Drain pineapple reserving 3 tablespoons of juice. Combine sugar and flour. Stir in reserved juice. Add cheese and pineapple. Mix well. Spoon into greased 1-quart casserole.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Makes 2 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stir-Fry Ground Meat With Celery And Broccoli
instructions: In heavy large skillet or wok at high heat stir-fry meat until done then add vegetables and stir-fry until broccoli turns color about 2 or 3 minutes. Add spices and remaining ingredients except cornstarch and water. Stir to blend. Add the cornstarch mixture and reduce heat to simmer. Cook until sauce thickens. Remove from heat and serve over rice or noodles.

title: Pumpernickel Dip
instructions: Hollow 1 loaf of pumpernickel bread to make a bowl. Fill with dip. Cut another loaf of bread into 1-inch cubes to use for dipping. This also makes a great dip for veggies.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Mix sifted flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk. Beat until smooth. Pour in greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch (or 1 1/2-quart) baking pan. Spoon fruit over. Sprinkle with sugar. Pour juice over all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all together and bake.

title: Fabulous Make-Ahead Party Potatoes(Make These Once, And You'Ll Be Famous For Them!)
instructions: Peel cube and cook potatoes until tender 20 to 25 minutes. Drain well; mash until smooth adding a little milk if necessary (a KitchenAid-type mixer works well). Mix cream cheese sour cream and seasonings (except paprika) together. Beat into potatoes with whisk or blender until fluffy. Taste for seasoning adding what you think is necessary. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish; sprinkle top with grated cheese dots of butter and paprika. Cool cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. (Flavor is best if casserole is refrigerated a day or two before serving.)

title: Seafood Okra Gumbo
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp saving shells. Set shrimp aside in refrigerator. Boil shrimp shells in 2 quarts of water for several hours to make a stock. Set aside. In a heavy skillet heat 2 tablespoons of oil and saute the okra until all ropiness is gone about 1/2 hour. Set aside.

title: Hot Spiced Grape Punch
instructions: Combine grape juice with water sugar cinnamon and ginger. Heat slowly stirring until sugar is dissolved. Blend in lemon juice. Serve with lemon slices pierced with cloves.

title: Donna'S Frito Pie
instructions: Put layer of chili on bottom in dish (4 cans). Cover with layer of Fritos chopped onion and bits of cheese. Repeat process of layering chili Fritos onion and cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serves several. (Serve with salad and hot bread.)

title: Harvest Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini in boiling salted water. Drain well. Saute beef and onions together until browned. In 2 1/2-quart casserole dish add rice and seasoning over 1/2 the zucchini. Cover with beef mixture and spoon over the cottage cheese. Add remaining zucchini then spread soup over all. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until bubbling. Serves 8.

title: Lavosh
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients; add sesame seed. Cut margarine into flour; add milk. Shape dough into small round balls. Roll out thin using lots of flour with rolling pin. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 8 to 12 minutes. Brush off excess flour after cooling.

title: Pastel Wine Cake
instructions: Beat for 3 minutes all ingredients on medium speed. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle confectioners sugar over cooled cake.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix together the graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Press into pan. Mix the cream cheese powdered sugar and 1/2 cup milk until smooth. Spread on crust. Mix the Cool Whip 1 cup cold milk and vanilla together. Spread on cream cheese. Let set about 5 minutes. Spread pie filling on top. Chill and serve.

title: Cherry Date Holiday Bars
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cherries. Place in buttered pan; bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Remove from oven; stir well. Cool until you can handle. Shape into balls around cherries and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Country Style Chicken Kiev
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Dip chicken pieces in butter. Set remaining butter aside. Roll in crumbs. Place in shallow casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. To leftover butter add remaining ingredients. Pour over baked chicken. Bake 20 minutes more or until done. Serves 4.

title: Curried Fruit Compote(Armenia)
instructions: Drain fruit well. Mix butter brown sugar and curry powder. Dot over fruit. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and refrigerate for at least one day. Warm over at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour until bubbly.

title: Herb Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix cut up chicken soups chow mein noodles and evaporated milk. Place all of this mixture into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan or 2 smaller casserole dishes. Saute the onion and celery in margarine until onion and celery are soft. Combine this with seasoned stuffing mix and spread over the top of the chicken mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Blend tomato soup and mayonnaise. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Makes 2 1/2 cups dressing.

title: Pear Lime Mold
instructions: Add enough water to syrup to measure 1 cup. Bring to a boil. Stir into gelatin until dissolved. Chill until slightly thickened. Mash pears beat in cream cheese until smooth. Add to gelatin. Mix well. Fold in 1 1/2 cups whipped cream. Chill until set.

title: Homemade Mayonnaise
instructions: Combine everything except oil in blender pitcher. Blend at medium speed until smooth.

title: Short-Cut Baked Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. In hot butter in small skillet saute onions until tender about 5 minutes. In 2-quart casserole or bean pot combine onion with rest of ingredients except salt pork; mix well. Make cuts in salt pork every 1/2 inch. Place in center of beans. Bake covered 1 1/2 hours; stir occasionally. Makes 8 servings.

title: Southern Corn Pudding
instructions: Stir flour into corn; add slightly beaten egg. Add the milk; dot with butter on top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Remove skin and all visible fat from chicken. Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels. Combine honey and mustard in a small bowl and pour over chicken. Bake 25 minutes. Turn chicken and bake 15 to 20 minutes longer basting every 10 minutes until meat is tender. Total preparation time is 10 minutes and cooking time is 45 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Hungarian Pork Paprika
instructions: Cut boneless pork in strips. Combine flour paprika salt and pepper. Toss with meat. Brown meat garlic and onion in hot oil. Stir in tomatoes. Cook uncovered over medium heat for 20 minutes or until meat is tender stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Take 1/2 cup of mixture from skillet. Blend with sour cream then add sour cream mixture back into remaining mixture in skillet. Do not boil. Serve over noodles. Very good with chicken or beef.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. If making in advance add bananas just before serving.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potatoes and add beaten egg and flour and mix. Drop by tablespoon in hot oil. Cook in oil until golden brown on both sides. Good with applesauce.

title: Tex Mex Dip
instructions: Mash first 4 ingredients and mix together. Mix together sour cream mayo and taco seasoning mix. Spread bean dip in shallow serving dish. Top with avocado mixture. Layer with sour cream mixture; sprinkle with chopped onions olives and tomatoes. Cover with cheese. Serve with taco chips.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Put ingredients in a crock-pot. Stir well and let simmer for 4 to 8 hours. May serve as soon as hot. If you dont want to wait for the crock-pot heat quickly on the stove and let simmer for a few minutes.

title: Plains, Georgia Roasted Peanuts(Even Elephants Like Them)
instructions: Melt butter or oleo in microwave in glass baking dish. Spread nuts in a single layer. Mix to coat with butter. Cook uncovered 8 minutes (Medium High 600W) or until golden brown. Stir occasionally (so peanuts do not burn). Spread nuts on paper towels and sprinkle with salt. Stir to coat peanuts. Cool and serve.

title: Zucchini Bread Or Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 for loaves or 375\u00b0 for muffins. Beat eggs slightly and stir in sugar oil zucchini and vanilla. Add flour salt baking soda baking powder and cinnamon. Stir in pecans. Pour into well-greased pan or paper liners. Bake loaves 50 minutes (makes 2). Bake muffins 24 minutes (makes 24).

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Place roast in roasting pan. Combine remaining ingredients except pepper slices and hard rolls. Pour over roast. Roast in a 325\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove from oven. Slice beef thinly and return to juices for 2 hours on low temperature. Green pepper slices may be baked along with sliced beef in last oven stage. Serve on hard rolls along with juices.

title: No Sugar Applesauce Raisin Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in water until water is dissolved. Add applesauce eggs oil then remaining ingredients. Mix well by hand. Put in 8-inch square pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Mix soups and water together in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour in rice and spread out. Layer chops on top. Bake 1 hour covered at 350\u00b0.

title: Mom'S Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and salt. Add bananas milk and flour alternately. Bake in 2 loaf pans for about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cranberries and sugar. Let stand overnight to drain in colander over pan. Discard liquid. Mix marshmallows walnuts grapes and whipped cream. Transfer ground cranberries into this and fold in. Chill for 24 hours for best texture.

title: Bacon Cheese Puffs
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Beat well. Add baking powder and bacon bits. Place 6 crackers at a time in a circle on a paper plate. Top each cracker with 1 teaspoon cheese mixture. Heat on Medium 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute in 1 cup margarine until soft the onion celery and pepper. Add the frozen chopped broccoli and the mushroom soup. Cook the rice in 2 cups water with 1 teaspoon butter and the salt for about 15 minutes. Add Cheez Whiz to rice. Mix all together with sauteed mixture. Put into lightly buttered casserole; top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake for 40 minutes at 300\u00b0. Makes 4 quarts.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Seafood Scampi
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet. Saute on medium-high the onion green pepper and garlic for 3 minutes. Add crab mushrooms lemon juice parsley and lemon pepper. Add noodles and toss.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together and let thaw and stir together. Cook for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mushroom And Spinach Soup
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in heavy large saucepan over medium-low heat. Add minced onion and garlic; saute until onion is tender about 8 minutes. Increase heat to high. Add all mushrooms and thyme and saute until mushrooms release their liquid about 5 minutes. Add chicken stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 20 minutes. (Can be prepared 1 day ahead. Cover and refrigerate. Bring to simmer before continuing.) Add spinach and parsley to soup and stir until wilted. Season soup to taste with salt and pepper. Ladle into bowls and serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheese Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients together. Combine liquid ingredients together. Pour liquid mixture into dry ingredients. Mix batter only until moist. Add cheese. Drop into greased muffin tins. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 muffins.

title: Carol'S No-Fail Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Heat 1 large can of cherries or any other type of fruit juice and all. Mix all ingredients. Melt 1 stick of butter in a 2-quart baking dish. Pour the mixed batter over the top of the melted butter then pour hot fruit over batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mock Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix boiling water and jello together and let cool. Mix in strawberries and pour into a cooked pie crust. Place in refrigerator to jell. Top with cool-whip or whipped cream.

title: Beef Noodle
instructions: Brown meat in skillet. Add butter garlic salt sugar pepper and tomato sauce and simmer over low heat 15 to 20 minutes. Combine the onions cream cheese and sour cream. Using a 2-quart casserole alternate the layers of beef mixture cream cheese mixture cooked noodles and grated cheese and repeat. Sprinkle top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Custard
instructions: Place rhubarb in bottom of unbaked pie crust. Mix sugar flour and salt together. Sprinkle over rhubarb. Stir gently to coat. Mix beaten eggs and melted butter together. Pour over rhubarb. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: In a heavy pan (I use a Dutch oven) cook the small pieces of stew meat on a low heat covered for 30 minutes. Uncover and raise heat to brown. Remove meat. Add 1 cup water and bouillon. Simmer onion and chili powder. Add tomatoes and Ranch Style beans. Stir meat back in and simmer 30 minutes or more. Serve with tortilla chips. Top with grated cheese.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Boil in salt water the chicken; cool and debone. Set aside. Heat all chicken soup milk green chilies onion salt pepper and garlic powder. Set aside. Layer in 2-quart casserole dish lightly greased large flour tortillas chicken soup mixture and grated cheese. Layer until all ingredients are used up. Top with cheese. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour until cheese is melted and food is heated through.

title: Individual Chicken Bake
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients; divide equally into 6 (6 ounce) custard cups coated with cooking spray. Cover loosely with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Uncover and let stand 5 minutes. Remove chicken from custard cups. Top each serving with cranberry sauce.

title: Swedish Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 9 X 13 greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. While cake is baking make the frosting. Soften 1/2 stick margarine and 1-8 oz package of cream cheese to room temperature. Add 1 cup brown sugar and beat until smooth. Spread on cake while STILL HOT ! Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Peel and slice potatoes in casserole dish. Top with ground beef and 2 cans of cream of mushroom soup. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt. Set aside. Beat eggs with a rotary beater about 5 minutes until heavy peaks stay on beater when lifted. Beat in sugar a little at a time. Gently mix in water and vanilla. Gently mix in flour mixture.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: In a large bowl stir together eggs corn syrup chocolate sugar margarine and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Yield 8 servings .

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries in food grinder. Put in sugar. Let dissolve. Grind apples and oranges. Stir into cranberries. Melt Jell-O in 1 cup hot water then 1 cup cold water. Mix all together and let jell in icebox.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend cream cheese smoked beef Tabasco sauce Worcestershire sauce and chopped onion together with blender. Shape into ball. Mix parsley and pecans. Press onto cheese ball. Refrigerate. (Best when made night before.) Serve at room temperature with \party crackers\.

title: Sesame Seed Dips
instructions: Put dry ingredients in a bowl. Add milk and mix well. Turn out on well-floured board and sprinkle with flour until desired consistency. Knead about 10 times. Roll out making a rectangle. With a floured knife cut in strips approximately 1/2 x 4 inches.

title: Rose Roggie Chocolate Cake
instructions: Add hot water to chocolate. Cream the butter. Add sugar a little at a time and cream thoroughly. Add sour milk eggs and chocolate. Add dry ingredients sifted together. Bake in two 9-inch round pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in shallow baking dish or pan. Mix flour sugar and milk. Pour into melted butter. Do not stir. Add can of fruit and juice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown. Crust will rise to top.

title: Cream Cheese Brownie Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Soften crust according to package directions; place in pie pan. In medium bowl combine cream cheese sugar vanilla and 1 egg; beat until smooth. Set aside. Reserve fudge packet from brownie mix for topping. In large bowl combine brownie mix oil 1 tbsp. water and remaining 2 eggs. Beat 50 strokes with spoon. Spread 1/2 cup brownie mixture in bottom of crust lined pie pan. Spoon and carefully spread cream cheese mixture over brownie layer. Top with remaining brownie mixture and spread evenly. Sprinkle with pecans.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream sugar and butter as for making cake. Add egg yolks and white and beat well. Add water and vanilla and beat again. Pour into a pie plate lined with pastry and bake until filling sets about 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Fill large pot with water and season with salt pepper parsley and brown sugar. Add the ingredients and cook for several hours. Makes a large amount and it freezes well.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into quarters. Combine flour cheese salt and pepper. Moisten potatoes with water and roll in the mixture coating them well. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for one hour. Turn once during baking. When golden brown sprinkle with parsley. Makes 6-8 servings.

title: Judy Weisgerber Grandma'S Red Cinnamon Cucumber Pickle Rings
instructions: Peel and slice cucumbers into rings 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick; remove seeds. Mix lime and water add cucumber rings and soak 24 hours. After cooking rinse and drain. Cover with fresh water; let stand 3 hours and drain.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Bars
instructions: Mix together and pat in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with 1 (12 ounce) bag chocolate chips melted. Chill.

title: Roast Beef Perfection Prime Rib
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Place roast on rack in shallow baking pan rib side down. Sprinkle with salts and pepper; place roast in oven and cook 1 hour. Turn off. Keep the oven door closed! Forty-five minutes before serving turn the oven to 300\u00b0.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Drain whole corn. Melt butter and add to sour cream in a bowl. Add eggs Jiffy mix and both corns. Mix well. Pour in 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Lazy Man'S Stew
instructions: Put all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake for 3 hours at 325\u00b0. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Super Lemonade
instructions: Slice oranges and lemons thinly. Barely cover with water. Let stand an hour. Take out pulp and discard rinds. Dissolve acid in 1 cup warm water and add to the mixture along with the pineapple. Dissolve sugar in enough water to make 3 gallons and add to the fruit mixture.

title: Tang Pie
instructions: Mix Tang milk and sour cream until smooth and orange in color. Add half of the Cool Whip and blend well. Pour into pie crust and refrigerate until ready to eat. Spread remaining Cool Whip on top.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Pour over chopped cabbage. Mix tomato soup with 1 cup of water. Pour over beef and cabbage. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in a covered casserole dish.

title: Party Chicken
instructions: Have \Carl\ purchase an 80 to 100 pound hog then have him cut it in half lengthwise. To begin with start 1 bag of charcoal in the large cooker grill then add as needed. A 100 pound pig takes about 7 hours to cook. Flip the pig one time. The first 3 1/2 hours cook him belly side down. Baste with sauce. Use Loudell Pafford Sizemores sauce submitted by Larry Sizemore found in this book. Note Ingredients and directions are together on this recipe.

title: Sugarless Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Sprinkle pudding and gelatin over mixture. Mix well and cover. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: By hand mix together first four ingredients. Pour half of batter into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with the brown sugar/cinnamon mix. Pour remaining batter on top. Twirl and swirl the batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chinese Style Fried Rice
instructions: Bring 1 cup of the water to a boil in saucepan. Stir in rice. Remove from heat; cover. Let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile cook egg in margarine in a 10-inch skillet until set. Ad onion and the rice and cook and stir over medium heat until rice and onion are lightly browned. Combine remaining water and soy sauce. Stir into rice. Makes 3 cups or 4 servings.

title: Butter Cookies And Jelly
instructions: Mix flour and butter in a bowl with hands. Add yolks and then sugar. Mix again and roll into small balls. Use finger for hole; add jelly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes on top rack and 5 minutes on bottom rack.

title: Glorified Rice(Like Dessert)
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving syrup. In saucepan combine uncooked rice water pineapple syrup and salt. Stir to moisten rice. Bring quickly to boil; cover; simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes. Add pineapple and lemon juice; cool. Stir in marshmallows and banana. Fold in cream and cherries; chill. Serves 8.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: In a saucepan cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrots. Fold in drained squash and onion. Sprinkle crackers on top. Dot with melted butter or margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Mix Miracle Whip cheese and oregano. Spoon over chicken and bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Smoked Tuna
instructions: Stir to make paste. Serve with Wheat Thins or favorite cracker as appetizer.

title: Pork Chops Supreme
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Trim excess fat from pork chops. Place chops in a baking dish. Salt well. Top each chop with a lemon slice and a thin onion slice; sprinkle generously with brown sugar. Pour one tablespoon catsup over each chop. Cover and bake one hour. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer basting occasionally.

title: Jazzed Up Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all together and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour in a 275\u00b0 oven. Stir through 2 or 3 times while baking. Be careful not to burn or scorch. Remove and let cool.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix and cook eggs sugar and lemon juice mixture until thick stir constantly to keep from burning and sticking to pan. Remove from stove put in refrigerator and let chill. Then add to fruit the marshmallows and nuts. Beat Dream Whip and add to this mixture. Pour into a dish and let set. Chill.

title: Diet Shake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Whirl at high speed until frothy and blended.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: In a large pot of hot water boil together the carrots potatoes and celery for 10 minutes; drain and add beef chicken and chicken broth. Simmer for 5 minutes. Cut tortillas in strips. Cook corn tortillas in Crisco oil until crispy. Dab with paper towel and remove grease. Top each serving with Mozzarella tomato and tortillas.

title: Quick And Easy Pork
instructions: Place pork chops in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chop onion and bell pepper and place on pork chops. Mix can of mushroom and can of chicken soup together; pour over pork chops. Cover pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tomato Ketchup
instructions: Combine tomatoes tomato paste onions and green pepper in saucepan. Simmer 30 minutes. Empty tomato mixture into food processor or blender. Blend thoroughly. Return to saucepan. Add other ingredients. Bring to a boil. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir often. Yields about 5 cups.

title: Superb Crab Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese and mayonnaise with electric mixer. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Makes 2 cups.

title: Sausage Rolls
instructions: When margarine is frozen grate into flour. Mix with enough water to hold together. Roll out a small piece of dough. Put sausage inside and roll up. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn temperature down to 375\u00b0 and bake for 15 minutes. Makes estimated 3 dozen.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs. Add butter flour sugar and salt mix well. Stir in milk and corn. Pour into a greased 1 1/2 qt. baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until a knife inserted near center come out clean. Yield 6 servings.

title: Fried Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Roll out into small balls. Freeze until ready to use.

title: Spiced Oat Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coat baking sheets with nonstick cooking spray. In small bowl combine flour baking powder pumpkin pie spice and salt. In mixing bowl with electric mixer at high beat butter and brown sugar until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat 1 minute. Stir in squash. Gradually stir in flour mixture oats and raisins until combined. Drop dough by 1/4 cupfuls onto baking sheets. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until lightly golden. Remove to wire racks. Cool for 1 hour. Repeat with the remaining dough. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Ever Crisp Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers and cover with lime and water. Let stand 24 hours then rinse in cold water. Let soak 3 hours longer in water drain off water and cover with a mixture of the remaining ingredients. Leave overnight and in the morning put on stove. Boil for 35 minutes. Pack in jars and seal.

title: Orange And Pineapple Sherbet Punch
instructions: Combine pineapple juice ginger ale and gelatin mixing well. Add both sherbets to drink mixture and serve. Yields 20 to 25 (6 ounce) glasses of punch.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cranberries and sugar; let set overnight. Mix marshmallows and pineapple in separate bowl. Next day mix all together and fold in Cool Whip.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake in Bundt pan for 55 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bottom of a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan spread pecans and coconut. Mix cake as directed on package. Pour over nuts and coconut. Mix butter powdered sugar and cream cheese and pour over unbaked cake and spread. Bake 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wipe mushrooms and remove caps. Saute whole caps in oil. Chop mushroom stems. Cook spinach according to package directions along with chopped mushrooms. Drain and squeeze to eliminate excess water. Combine with egg whites and bread crumbs. Fill mushroom caps with spinach mixture. Place caps in an oiled ovenproof dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Use as garnish around roast meat or chicken. Also may be served as an appetizer.

title: Squash Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients; bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fudge
instructions: Put sugar milk and butter in pan; boil until soft ball stage. Put chocolate chips and marshmallow cream together in pan then pour other mixture over it. Mix it. Add nuts and vanilla; mix well. Place in pan; cut in squares or drop onto wax paper.

title: Ham Deluxe
