instructions: In square greased dish arrange stuffing. Top with broccoli then cheese then ham then eggs. Pour white sauce over this and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one-half hour.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt the chocolate in the boiling water and let cool. Cream the butter and sugar until light. Add the egg yolks one at a time beating after each. Add the vanilla and chocolate. Mix until blended. Sift together the flour baking soda and salt. Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture alternately with milk beating after each addition. Fold in the egg whites. Pour into three greased and floured round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Dressing Hot Dish
instructions: Spread ground beef into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix chopped onion celery and Stove Top with combined melted oleo and water. Spread over hamburger layer. Next spread the chicken soup and celery soup over the dressing. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cut into squares.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and drain off grease. Salt and pepper to taste. Set aside. In small mixing bowl mix tomato sauce chili powder onion and sugar and set aside.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Stir with a fork and roll between wax paper. Makes one 9-inch crust.

title: Yellow Squash Relish
instructions: Dissolve salt in the 2 quarts of water in enameled or stainless steel pan. Add squash and onions and soak 12 to 18 hours. Drain for an hour but do not wash or rinse. Combine remaining ingredients in a kettle or pan and boil for 5 minutes. Put in hot jars and seal. Makes 5 pints.

title: Amish Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine and sugars. Beat 2 eggs into oil. Add to sugar mixture and add remaining ingredients. Form into small balls and roll in sugar. Put on lightly greased cookie sheet. Mash crisscross with a fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Basic Fluffy Pancakes
instructions: For Variation for Buttermilk Pancakes Use buttermilk in place of sweet milk and 1 teaspoon of baking soda instead of baking powder.

title: Ragu Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook onions garlic and peppers in oil for 1/2 hour. Put through blender until liquified. Wash and core tomatoes; put into blender until liquified. Boil everything together to desired consistency. Add one large can tomato paste for added flavor and body. Mix well. Put in hot sterile jars. Also freezes well. Use as you would any commercial sauce. Makes 30 pints.

title: Ham Salad Filling
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spread between buttered bread slices. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Steak Stroganoff
instructions: Remove fat from meat and brown. Cut into bite size pieces. Add mushrooms and gravy. Cook noodles and drain. Serve steak and gravy over noodles.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature until softened. Beat until fluffy. Gradually add Eagle Brand milk while stirring. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Add lemon juice and vanilla. Stir until well mixed. Turn into prepared crust. Chill 2 or 3 hours (do not freeze) before garnishing top of pie with cherry pie filling or cherry glaze.

title: Raspberry Bars
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add combined dry ingredients and mix well. Press half crumb mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Spread with preserves. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Frozen Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Mix well and press firmly on bottom of an 8-inch square dish. Chill 15 minutes. Combine the milk pumpkin pumpkin pie spice and pudding. Blend with electric mixer on low speed for 2 minutes. Fold in the whipped topping. Spoon over crumb crust in dish. Freeze for 4 hours. When ready to serve let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Cut into squares. Garnish with a dollop of whipped cream and sprinkle of nuts. Store any leftover dessert in freezer.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Combine cream cheese and butter; cream until smooth. Add powdered sugar beating until light and fluffy. Stir in vanilla.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Cook ingredients except coconut until thick. Add coconut and pour into 8-inch baked pie shell.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Beat egg and sugar. Melt shortening and chocolate together. Add vanilla nuts and raisins then add flour and milk alternately to make batter. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 420\u00b0 oven for 6 to 10 minutes.

title: Southern Spoon Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Heat water butter sugar and salt to boiling in saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in cornmeal and cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat and place in large bowl. Whisk in milk until smooth. Add eggs and baking powder. Pour into pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until puffed and golden brown. Makes 12 servings.

title: Gumbo
instructions: Saute onions garlic bell pepper and celery in 2 tablespoons of oil. Using stock from chicken add chicken okra and sausage pieces. Bring to a gentle boil. Add sauteed ingredients. Add bay leaf and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli\taccording to directions on box; drain. Mix broccoli with cooked rice. Put\tin large baking dish. Sprinkle onion over mixture. In a saucepan heat Cheez Whiz and soup together. Pour over mixture in baking dish. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm or hot.

title: Hamburger Pepperoni Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain grease. Add Ragu sauce. Add water to thin this. Cook rigatoni noodles as directed on package. In a large casserole dish that has been well-greased add in layers the noodles hamburger mixture sliced cheese and pepperoni. Will make 2 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together flour soda baking powder and salt. Cream shortening sugar and egg. Beat thoroughly. Add dry ingredients alternately with orange juice. Add raisins nuts apples and orange rind. Pour into 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix flour margarine and 3/4 cup chopped nuts. Press in 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool. Mix cream cheese sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over cooled baked crust. Mix milk and 2 packages instant pudding; beat for 2 minutes. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with remaining chopped nuts.

title: Pineapple Bake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Add pineapple. Stir in bread cubes. Bake in a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until lightly brown. Serve hot or cold. Great with ham!

title: Easy Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Cut wieners into bite size pieces. Add wieners and barbecue sauce. Simmer.

title: Lime Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water; cool. Mix remaining ingredients; stir into gelatin mixture. Chill until firm. Yields 20 servings.

title: Raisin Hermits
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and mix well. Add beaten eggs and then soda dissolved in hot water. Sift flour measure and sift again. (Reserve a little of the flour you may not need it all.) Add cinnamon raisins and nuts to flour and combine mixtures. Drop and bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 10 to 12 minutes. Try one cookie first and add more flour if necessary.

title: Apricot-Mustard Grilled Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Season tenderloin with salt and pepper. In small bowl stir together the preserves and mustard. Grill pork over a medium-hot fire brushing with mustard mixture frequently turning once or twice until just done about 15 minutes.

title: Brownies Low Calorie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place ingredients in a bowl and stir until blended. Put in greased pan. Bake 30 minutes. Cut in squares while warm.

title: Stick To Ribs Fruity Oatmeal(Dietetic)
instructions: Bring water to boil. Add oatmeal and salt. Stir and cook 1 minute. Stir in pineapple cottage cheese and flavoring. Bring to a boil. Serve with sweetener and milk as meal plan permits. Yield 1 serving.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Layer vegetables in dish (with a cover). Combine soup vinegar and oil and pour over vegetables. Refrigerate over night.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Finely chop all vegetables. (A food processor is ideal for this.) Combine with all remaining ingredients and refrigerate 24 hours. Makes about 4 1/2 cups. Serve this soup chilled with one can of the following assortment of garnishes finely chopped green onions chives or croutons.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Boil chicken and use chicken broth to make the rice. Debone chicken and cut into chunks. In large skillet or wok mix all ingredients cook until hot stirring often.

title: Quick Broccoli Soup(Makes 4 Cups)
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until heated.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and mix well. Spread evenly onto tortillas and roll up. Wrap and chill before slicing and serving with picante sauce.

title: Walnut Party Balls
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Blend in egg yolk. Sift flour into creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla and cherries. Shape into small balls. Beat egg white until foamy. Dip balls in egg white let drain then roll in chopped nuts. Place on lightly greased baking sheet and bake in hot oven at 400 degrees for 15 to 18 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove to wire racks to cool.

title: Creamy Ham Casserole
instructions: In a medium saucepan melt 3 tablespoons butter; stir in flour and add milk all at once. Cook until thickens stirring constantly. Add cheese and sour cream to sauce and stir until cheese melts. Combine with cauliflower ham and mushrooms. Put in 2-quart casserole. Combine remaining butter (melted) with bread crumbs and sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes or until hot.

title: Peanut Butter Sheet Cake
instructions: Boil water peanut butter oleo or butter and salt. Pour over mixture flour sugar baking soda vanilla eggs and buttermilk or milk with vinegar or lemon juice added. Mix well. Pour into greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken Wings
instructions: Place chicken on cookie sheet in one layer. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour turning once. Combine rest of the ingredients and toss with chicken wings. Serve hot or cold.

title: Light Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Process until smooth stopping once to scrape down sides. Pour into small saucepan; cook sauce over very low heat stirring constantly until thoroughly heated. Mix thoroughly with cooked fettuccine noodles.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in pan with oil. Add garlic and onion. Saute until meat loses its pinkness. Drain off fat if any. Add cabbage carrots salt peppercorn bay leaf broth and water. Heat to simmer. Cook until cabbage is tender about 10 minutes. Add peppers and soy sauce. Simmer 5 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Avocado Dip
instructions: Put on flat serving tray. First refried beans then mix sour cream avocado and taco seasoning and put that on the beans. Then top in order chopped lettuce onion tomato grated cheese and sliced black olives. Serve with your favorite chips.

title: Spiced Beets
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add liquid. Add to boiling beets. Cook until thickened.

title: Busy Day Chicken
instructions: 1) Pour rice into baking dish.

title: Kahlua Dip
instructions: Combine marshmallow cream and cream cheese; blend well. Stir in\t Kahlua. Chill covered overnight.\tServe with sliced fresh fruit.

title: Stay Soft Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Blend cocoa sugar and cornstarch. Add milk and cook slowly until thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat add vanilla and butter. Stir gently until cool and thick enough to spread.

title: White Hot Chocolate
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup of the half and half or light cream vanilla baking pieces or chopped candy coating stick cinnamon and nutmeg in a medium saucepan; whisk over low heat until vanilla baking pieces or candy is melted. Remove stick cinnamon. Add remaining half and half or light cream. Whisk until heated through. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and almond extract. Serve warm in cups or mugs; top with slivers of vanilla-flavor candy coating and sprinkle with cinnamon if desired. Makes 5 (6-ounce) servings.

title: Uncooked Relish
instructions: Let stand overnight and put in jars and seal.

title: Cherry Jubilee Salad
instructions: Add all ingredients and chill!

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Place partially thawed hash brown potatoes in bottom of a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut up 1/2 cup butter in small squares and spread over potatoes. In a large bowl mix chicken soup onion sour cream and cheese. Spread over potatoes and spread with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; remove from bone and cut into bite-size pieces. Melt butter in large casserole. Cover bottom of dish with a layer of Ritz cracker crumbs. Add a layer of chicken pieces. Mix soup and sour cream together. Cover chicken with soup mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ambrosia Shake
instructions: Pour boiling water over tea bags. Cover and brew for 5 minutes. Remove tea bags and chill. In a 5-cup blender combine tea pineapple and ice cream until smooth. If desired garnish with flaked coconut. Makes 5 servings.

title: Divinity
instructions: In small bowl beat egg whites with salt (speed 7). Transfer egg whites to large bowl. Place on revolving stand. Pour gradually beating constantly. Pour in fine stream. After all syrup is added increase speed. Beat until mixture has glossy stage. Add vanilla. Beat at speed 3 until mixture forms peaks. It is ready when tested by dropping teaspoon of hot mixture into a cup of water reaches medium hard-ball stage. Add walnuts or pecans if desired. Pour into buttered Pyrex dish and cut into squares or drop from teaspoon.

title: Honey-Mustard Dressing
instructions: In a small bowl stir together all ingredients. Cover and chill to store. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Aunt Grace'S Bananas And Peanuts
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until thick. Add a little oleo and milk or Milnot after cooking. Roll bananas in mixture then in chopped nuts.

title: Beef Cabbage Soup
instructions: In a 20 quart container put onion and green peppers in 2 gallons water and bring to a rapid boil. Add meat tomatoes beans beef base pepper salt sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Stir well.\tAdd cabbage. Bring to boil\tand then simmer for 30 minutes. Makes 5 gallons.

title: Squash Or Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in small baking dish. Add squash and onion. Pour mixture over all and bake approximately 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Just before removing from oven sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: In mixing bowl stir together Bisquick cheese and pepper. Stir in egg until mix is just moist. Fold in zucchini. Cook \rounds\ in skillet until brown.

title: Southern Pralines
instructions: Break grahams into single cookies. Place side by side on cookie sheet. Put pecan\ton top of each cracker. Boil butter and sugar for 2 minutes. Spoon mixture over grahams and bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take off sheet immediately.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Roll Ritz crackers fine. Melt butter. Mix together. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan; save some cracker mixture for topping.

title: Taco Dip Supreme
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef. Season with salt and pepper. Place in bottom of glass bowl. Layer tomatoes and avocados on top of ground beef. Then layer cheese. Fold in taco sauce. Spread sour cream on top. Serve hot with taco-flavored Doritos.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to box and drain. Saute onion and celery in margarine. Cook rice as directions on the box. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Defrost spinach. Squeeze out excess water. Mix with remaining ingredients. Chill at least 2 hours before serving or overnight.

title: Zucchini Squash Fritters
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop by tablespoon into 1/2-inch oil in skillet. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towel and serve. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Mom'S Rice Soup For Whatever Ailed You(Especially Good For Flu And Stomach Upsets)
instructions: Brown whole onion in butter and very little water. Some salt may be added. Add at least a quart more water and bring to a boil. Add rice and cook about 15 minutes (not more or less) then add macaroni and another pinch or so of salt; cook about 10 to 12 more minutes. Stir often. Dont leave it.\tAdd water if needed. Now add 2/3 quart of tomato juice. You cannot hurry Rice Soup. If you dont have 1/2 hour to stand near dont start to make it.

title: Skillet Mac And Beef
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat cook beef and onion until beef is browned and onion is tender stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. Add macaroni. Reduce heat to low. Heat through stirring occasionally. Makes about 4 1/2 cups or 4 servings.

title: Shrimp And Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; rinse and drain. Combine pasta with remaining ingredients. Cover; chill for at least 8 hours. Toss well before serving.

title: Company Salad
instructions: Toss chill and serve.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Cover bottom of pie shells generously with pecan pieces. Measure all ingredients into large bowl. Beat thoroughly and pour over nuts in pie shells. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes and at 350\u00b0 an additional 25 minutes. Do not overbake!

title: Nasturtium Butter
instructions: Whip together all ingredients then fold in coarsely chopped nasturtiums. Form into pats and logs and wrap in plastic. Can be frozen.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Sprinkle shredded vegetables with salt and let stand 1 hour. Drain mixture if water accumulates. Combine sugar and other 4 ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to boil; boil 3 minutes. Cool and pour over cabbage mixture and let stand 3 minutes. Stir well. Package in plastic freezer bags or containers and freeze. To serve remove desired amount and thaw in refrigerator. Serves 10.

title: Lemonade Jello
instructions: Combine sugar lemon jello and boiling water. Add lemonade. Place in freezer to semi-gel. Whip Cool Whip with jello mixture. Place in Bundt cake size mold.

title: Savory Pork Steaks
instructions: In skillet brown steaks on both sides in shortening. Pour off drippings. Season with salt and pepper. Reserve 1/4 cup of broth; pour remaining broth into skillet. Add onions carrots and potatoes. Sprinkle with basil. Cover and simmer 45 to 60 minutes or until meat and vegetables are tender. Drain juice and add water to make one cup (to make gravy). Combine flour and reserved broth; add to pan juices. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Pour gravy over meat and vegetables. Makes 4 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Simmer raisins and water over medium heat until raisins are plump about 15 minutes. Drain raisins saving liquid. Add enough water to reserved liquid to measure 1/2 cup. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix thoroughly the shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Blend in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Old-Fashioned Banana Pudding
instructions: In microwave bowl mix sugar margarine flour and salt then add milk and flavor to mixture using a large spoon. Cook in microwave until filling is thick. Separate eggs and beat yolk with a spoon and slowly mix in filling. Pour filling over layer of wafers and bananas. Add teaspoon of sugar to egg whites and whip until stiff and cook in the oven until topping is brown.

title: Cold Carrots
instructions: Heat everything except carrots in saucepan to dissolve sugar. Pour over carrots; marinate for 48 hours in refrigerator. You can serve carrots cold or if you prefer you can heat them in your microwave. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Macaroni Caprice
instructions: Place 2 cups macaroni in a 2-quart greased casserole. Cover with a layer of green beans a layer of ham and remaining macaroni. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until bubbling hot and slightly browned at 350\u00b0. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: Boil chicken in water. Cut into bite size pieces and return to broth. Add remainder of ingredients except tortillas. Boil for 10 minutes and then add tortillas. Boil until tortillas are soft.

title: Kentucky Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a tube pan. Sift flour and sugar together. Make a well in flour. Add egg yolks and oil; mix. Fold in egg whites and add rest of ingredients mixing well. Bake for 1 hour and 35 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Tropical Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift flour and all other dry ingredients together except sugar. Prepare carrots pineapple and nuts. Grease and flour 3 (9-inch) round cake pans. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs lightly; beat in sugar. Stir in oil dry ingredients carrots and 3/4 cup pineapple. Stir in nuts and coconut. Spread evenly in pans. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until sides shrink and top springs back when touched. Sprinkle with powdered sugar; decorate with grated orange peel.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Set salt for 3 hours over cucumbers and onions. Drain and put into large container and add the rest of the ingredients to onion and cucumbers. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: *Ingredients may be to your preference.

title: Apple Pecan Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease muffin pans. Sift together flour soda cinnamon and salt into a bowl. Combine sugar oil egg lemon juice vanilla and lemon peel in a large bowl. Whisk to blend. Mix in dry ingredients apples and pecans. Spoon batter into muffin pans. Bake about 35 minutes. Test center with toothpick. If it comes out clean muffin is done. Turn muffins out onto a rack. Cool slightly. Serve warm.

title: Travis House Oysters
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 2-quart shallow casserole or 6 to 8 individual casseroles.

title: Cream Cheese Pom Poms(A Holiday Cookie Tray Favorite!)
instructions: Cream sugar cream cheese and butter. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flavorings flour and baking powder. Mix well. Roll into 1 1/2-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan; add butter and stir until melted. Add flour and salt all at once stirring vigorously. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture leaves sides of pan and resembles mashed potatoes about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat; cool about 1 minute. Add eggs one at a time thoroughly beating with a spoon after each addition until smooth. Drop heaping tablespoons of mixture 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Shape in rounds with peak in center. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Place olive oil in hot skillet saute onions and garlic. Add chopped mushroom stems and saute. Add breadcrumbs parsley and wine. Lay mushroom caps stem end up in ungreased baking sheet. Heap teaspoon of filling in each mushroom. Top with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Apple Dessert
instructions: Place apples in buttered 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle dry jello over apples. Combine flour sugar and butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over apple-jello mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Nutty Numbers
instructions: Mix all the ingredients; shape into numbers or letters. Cover with chopped peanuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Kugel-Noodle Pudding
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Mix rest of ingredients. Pour over noodles and mix lightly. Pour into lasagna pan and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Let sit 20 minutes before cutting.

title: Little Lunch Pizzas
instructions: Split one English muffin and toast on medium toaster setting. Top each muffin half with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce and 1 tablespoon of cheese. Put microwavable paper towel on microwavable dinner plate or paper plate. Put muffin halves on paper towel. Microwave uncovered on High for 30 to 45 seconds until cheese is melted. Cool about 2 minutes before eating.

title: Cherry Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. While oven heats use to melt margarine in a 9-inch square pan. Blend in mixing bowl 1 cup sugar and baking powder; add milk and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Pour over melted margarine. Do not stir. Pour the cherries and syrup over flour mixture trying to distribute cherries evenly. Do not stir. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over cherries. Do not stir. Bake 1 hour.

title: Pecan Clusters
instructions: In a large bowl cream together butter brown sugar sugar and salt. Blend in egg and vanilla. Stir in flour and pecan pieces. Beat until well blended. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased baking sheet. Bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let cool.

title: Pineapple Jello Mold
instructions: Add boiling water to gelatine (mix well). Add softened cream cheese while mixture is still hot. Add sugar and beat until smooth. Add Cool Whip and beat. Add pineapple (juice and all); beat until smooth. Put into Bundt mold. Garnish with strawberries.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Brown ground beef with onion and drain. In a large bowl mix together soup ketchup Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Stir in water. Add hamburger and rice. Mix well. Wash peppers; remove tops and seeds. Place in a glass baking dish and fill with stuffing mixture. Bake for 45 minutes. Top with cheese in the last 10 minutes.

title: Ginger Beer
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in a little warm water with a teaspoon of the sugar. Place the sugar and chillies the thin rind of the lemons with the juice in a large pan and pour over them the 3 quarts of boiling water. Add the cold water when all the sugar has dissolved and then add the yeast. Allow to stand for 24 hours.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix soup with 1 cup of milk. Place cubed chicken in the bottom of a pan. Sprinkle Veg-All on top of chicken. Pour in soup mixture.

title: Pecan Fingers
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and powdered sugar. Blend in 1 1/2 cups flour. Press evenly in bottom of ungreased baking pan 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread over hot baked layer and bake 20 minutes longer. Cool; cut into bars. This recipe will serve 15 people.

title: Best-Ever Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together eggs oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased loaf pans and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a toothpick comes out dry when tested. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Gazpacho Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables 5 minutes or until tender. Put garlic paprika olive oil and a little salt and pepper into the container of the blender cover and start motor. Remove the cover and gradually pour in the cooked vegetables. Replace the cover and blend soup for 10 seconds or until it is smooth. Stir into the soup 1 cucumber cut into tiny dice and the black olives; chill. At serving time put an ice cube in each plate and pour over it the chilled gazpacho. Sprinkle the soup liberally with chopped parsley and garnish it with tiny croutons.

title: Brownies
instructions: Beat the butter sugar and eggs. Add the syrup flour and soda. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Almond Bark Candy
instructions: Melt bark in microwave. Add peanut butter. Stir and pour over marshmallows peanuts and cereal (which has been mixed in a large bowl). Stir well. Spread out and cut into squares or drop by spoon on wax paper.

title: Sunflower Shapes
instructions: Grind in food mill; cut with cookie cutters. Chill. Makes 24.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix well. Store in covered container. Use 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup hot water (or to taste).

title: Three Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and bacon. Drain and add to rest of ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes or put in crock-pot on low for a few hours.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large mixer bowl beat egg yolks with sweetened condensed milk lime juice and food coloring until smooth. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool. When completely cool top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Jalapenos(Appetizer)
instructions: Drain peppers and slice in half lengthwise; take seeds out. Soften cream cheese in microwave; mix in other ingredients. Stuff each pepper half. Place on baking sheet and put in a 350\u00b0 until the cheese melts. Great with before dinner drinks!

title: Black Russian Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease Bundt pan. Mix all ingredients; near the end stir by hand. Add raisins and nuts. Bake about 1 hour. Test with toothpick. Turn cake onto plate. Poke holes in cake; spoon glaze over warm cake. Refrigerate immediately. If wrapped tightly with Saran Wrap and foil this cake will keep well. Serve with ice cream.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Mix jello with boiling water then add 7-Up. When partially set add drained pineapple marshmallows and sliced bananas. Place in large Pyrex dish and congeal.

title: Bar B Q Hash
instructions: Boil meat until it comes off the bone.

title: Old-Fashion Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Pour Pet milk in a large mixing bowl; add sugar. Add 1 1/2 cans cold water. Stir in all ingredients while pouring water. Add vanilla and add table salt (optional). Stir ingredients well. Pour ingredients into ice cream freezer can. Place top on container. Place ice around can and rock salt. Turn and move ice and rock salt as needed. Freezing Time 12 minutes.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Combine well and pour into regular size or miniature muffin pan.

title: Weight Watchers Tortilla Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oleo. Add remaining ingredients except cheese and tortillas and cook in crock-pot or simmer on stove for 1 hour. Add cheese and tortillas and simmer 10 minutes more.

title: Lasagna
instructions: In bowl mix sauce and spices together. Set aside. In another bowl mix Ricotta cheese and eggs. Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan the sauce uncooked noodles Ricotta cheese sauce and Mozzarella cheese until pan is full. Top with sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Trifle
instructions: Layer fruit in bottom of glass bowl. Combine milk and sour cream; add pudding mixture and beat until well blended. Spoon over fruit and top with almonds.

title: Easy Cookies
instructions: Mix all together. Drop by teaspoon full on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch salt and water. Cook until clear stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add food coloring and jello. Stir until dissolved. Let cool. Place whole or sliced strawberries in pie shell. Pour sauce on top. Chill until firm. Top each slice with whipped topping.

title: Five Flavored Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs which have been beaten until lemon colored. Combine flour baking powder and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Stir in flavorings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Shape into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Cider Pie
instructions: Mix sugar with flour. Add cider water and 2 well beaten egg yolks. Cook until thick and pour into baked pie crust. Use 2 egg whites and 4 tablespoons sugar for meringue and place in oven just until meringue is browned.

title: Quick Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter and evaporated milk in electric skillet. Set temperature at 280\u00b0. Bring mixture to a boil and boil 5 minutes stirring constantly. Turn off skillet. Add marshmallows peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until marshmallows and peanut butter are melted and blended. Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan. Cool before cutting into squares.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine in a saucepan. Add and warm to spreading consistency the mushroom soup grated cheese and mayonnaise. Place broccoli in baking dish. Pour soup mixture on top. Crumble Cheez-Its crackers over top. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Punch
instructions: Put sherbet and frozen juice in punch bowl and add cold ginger ale and 7-Up. Stir occasionally.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package then drain. Combine all other ingredients with noodles. Place in baking dish and top with grated cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter in mixing bowl; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Blend in molasses. Sift together flour ginger cinnamon and baking soda. Gradually add to creamed mixture; chill dough.

title: Jiffy Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Brown ground meat; drain any excess grease. Add bouillon cubes and chopped onion. Add 1 cup of water; cook until onion is tender and bouillon cubes are dissolved. Continue cooking until all the water is cooked out. Remove from heat. Add soup to the meat mixture. Prepare the macaroni and cheese dinner following directions on box. Mix with meat and soup mixture. A little milk can be added if too thick. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) until bubbly.

title: Fantastic Frozen Strawberries
instructions: Put cleaned berries in a large bowl with sugar. Mix carefully. Mix Sure-Jell with 1 cup water and boil 1 minute. Pour over berries and mix carefully. Let stand 10 minutes. Put in freezer bags or containers.

title: Braised Lemon Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops. Season with salt and pepper. Combine catsup water and brown sugar. Pour over pork chops. Place a lemon slice on each chop. Cover tightly and cook slowly on top of range for 45 minutes or until meat is done.

title: French Bread Sandwich
instructions: Cut French bread in half then into sections. Spread mayonnaise. Place a piece of lettuce on each piece then the filling (turkey celery and apples mixed with mayonnaise aji and a little sugar). On filling put cubed cranberry sauce and almond slivers.

title: Turkey And Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and mushrooms; cook 2 minutes until the onion is translucent. Add water and broth; stir in rice mix and seasoning mix. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes until the rice is tender. Add sherry and boil 1 minute. Add turkey. Reduce heat to low.

title: Evelyn'S Ham Biscuits
instructions: Mix together butter mustard poppy seed Worcestershire and onion. Use tiny day-old party rolls. Open them and spread mixture on both sides of roll; top each half with a small piece of ham. Put small piece of Swiss cheese between halves before closing. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted. Makes 20 to 24 tiny sandwiches.

title: German Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt caramels with 1/3 cup Pet milk. Mix 1/3 cup Pet milk cake mix pecans and melted margarine. Pat 1/2 (or slightly more) of cake mixture in bottom of greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake 6 minutes. Remove from oven then sprinkle chocolate chips on top followed by caramel mixture. Place dropfuls of remaining cake mixture. Bake 18 minutes. Cool and eat! Enjoy.

title: Mincemeat Fingers (Loaf)
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy. Sift remaining ingredients and add to mixture. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until done. Test with toothpick.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes butter and eggs mixing well. Combine sugar flour and salt; stir into potato mixture. Combine buttermilk and soda; add to potato mixture mixing well. Stir in vanilla. Pour filling into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until set. Serve warm or cool.

title: Hot Fruit Compote
instructions: Cook the oleo brown sugar curry powder fruit juice and flour until thick. Add pecans and cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Super with ham chicken turkey and roast beef.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Aerate the flour and sugar in a large bowl. Mix the oil water margarine and cocoa in the microwave for 2 minutes. Dissolve the soda in buttermilk. Add the cocoa mixture to the flour mixture; mix well. Add eggs mix well. Add buttermilk and vanilla; mix well. Pour into a 10 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until done.

title: Orange Almond Salad
instructions: Toss and coat over low heat in Teflon pan until caramel coating sticks to almonds. 1/4 c. slivered almonds 1 Tbsp. + 1 tsp. sugar.

title: Noble'S Sicilian Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Saute onions in oil and melted butter 5 to 8 minutes until soft. Add tomato paste. Stir until blended. Add 1 cup wine and stir. Pour in the 2 cans tomatoes with juices. Stir in mushrooms and pepper. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Add herbs and red pepper. Simmer until sauce thickens to preferred consistency adding more wine if you like. Season with salt and sugar. Serve hot over chicken or pasta. Makes about 2 1/2 quarts about 165 calories per cup.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients with mayonnaise and a spoonful of sour cream. Shred lettuce on individual plates. Add some chicken salad. Then place some grapes and pineapple chunks around the salad. Great salad.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Prepare rice. Cook broccoli slightly and drain. Saute onion in margarine. Combine all ingredients saving some cheese for top of casserole. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan uncovered for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Prepare and bake cornbread as directed on pkg. Cool completely and crumble into medium bowl. To the crumbled cornbread add tomatoes bell pepper onion corn and crumbled bacon. Stir in mayonnaise. Add salt pepper and garlic powder to taste.

title: Mom'S Judy Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Stir until all is dissolved. Add ice cubes; stir until melted. Let gel in refrigerator until semi-soft. Add cottage cheese nuts and pineapple (make sure pineapple has been well drained). Thoroughly stir and let gel.

title: Pork Chop Skillet Meal
instructions: Heat fat in skillet. When hot add chops. Move to medium heat and complete browning on both sides approximately 15 minutes. Place a slice of onion and one pepper ring on each chop. Place one tablespoon rice in each ring. Pour tomatoes around meat and add celery. Place cover on skillet when steaming about 8 minutes. Remove to low heat and let simmer for 60 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Creamy Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes. While cooking soften cream cheese and blend in milk salt and butter or margarine until smooth and creamy. After potatoes are done drain mash and add cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet. Drain fat. Add tomato sauce. Stir in all ingredients except red pepper and mesa. Add red pepper. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. Stir mesa flour into 1/4 cup warm water to make a thick but flowable mixture. Add mesa mixture. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes more.

title: Karrot Kake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Drain off 1/4 of the juice from pineapple. Add juice and remaining ingredients to dry ingredients; mix well. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except almonds. Spread in ungreased 8-inch square pan or ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake 15 minutes. Serve hot with crackers. Refrigerate leftovers. Yields 8 to 12 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes eggs 1/3 stick of butter white sugar milk salt and pepper in a bowl and mix well. Put mixture in a baking dish. For topping combine brown sugar flour pecans and 1/2 stick melted butter. Mix well and spread over potato mixture. Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; mix until well blended. Grease 6 (6 x 12-inch) miniature loaf pans. Evenly distribute batter in each pan. Bake on middle shelf in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until top springs back to the touch.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Dissolve sugar in liquids over low heat. Add salad mix and cool. Pour over sauerkraut and chopped vegetables. A glass jar is good for storing overnight in refrigerator before serving. Keeps well.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and set aside. Melt 3/4 stick margarine. Crush 1 stack Ritz crackers and mix with melted margarine. Press into a casserole dish (save a few crackers for top). Pour in casserole dish and sprinkle a few crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Chip Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together; add apples. Stir until apples are well coated. Add nuts. Stir well. Add well beaten eggs and oil. Mix with hands when batter is stiff. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour 20 minutes. If too done try at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour 10 minutes.

title: Savory Meat Loaf And Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Mix 1/2 soup beef 1/2 can fried onions and Worcestershire sauce thoroughly. Shape into 8 x 4-inch loaf. Place potatoes around loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir potatoes spoon remaining soup over meat loaf. Bake 25 minutes or until done. Stir potatoes again. Sprinkle on remaining onions over meat. Bake 5 minutes or until golden. Serves 8.

title: Peachy Pecan Bread
instructions: Drain peaches reserving 1/4 cup juice. Chop peaches and reserve 1 cup of peaches. In a blender puree the rest of peaches along with butter eggs and lemon juice. In a bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt; combine this to the pureed peaches. Fold in the reserved peach pieces and nuts. Pour mix into an 8 x 4 x 2-inch greased pan and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Spread with peach preserves and cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove to rack.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients but poppy seed. Add water as needed; stir in poppy seed.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Boil the peaches until tender. Cut 1 stick butter up and place on the bottom of baking dish. Blend flour sugar milk baking powder and salt. Pour batter over butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until batter turns golden brown.

title: Date-Nut Bread
instructions: Pour soda and boiling water over dates and raisins. Set aside. Cream the butter and sugar. Add vanilla then egg. Beat well. Add flour and mix. Pour in fruit mixture (including water) and nuts. Mix. Bake in a buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Scald milk and let cool. Sift together sugar and flour. Beat eggs. Add butter and potatoes milk and yeast mixture. Add liquid to dry mixture. Mix 1 hour before baking. Knead and shape into rolls. Let rise and bake at 450 degrees for 12-15 minutes.

title: Pork And Spinach Pie
instructions: Place pie shell on baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and reduce heat to 325\u00b0. Spread cheese on bottom of shell and set aside. In a skillet brown sausage; drain off fat. Stir in stuffing mix and spinach; spoon over cheese. Beat together eggs and milk and pour over sausage in pie shell. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes until knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve with your favorite chips.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Grease a 13 x 9 pan. Then layer most of the croutons cheese and sausage in the pan. Beat eggs 2 1/2 cups of milk and mustard. Pour mixture over ingredients in pan. Cover pan and refrigerate overnight.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix together brown and white sugar flour salad oil nutmeg and salt. Take from this mixture approximately 1 cup. Add 1 teaspoon cinnamon and chopped nuts.

title: Rich Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Pour into mixing bowl and let cool. Then add sugar to mixture. Add egg. Sift flour once measure into sifter and add salt. Slowly add flour mixture and 1 1/2 cups of milk. Beat 1 minute. Mix soda with 1/4 cup of milk; add to mixture along with vanilla.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Whip potatoes and other ingredients with beater and place in buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with topping and bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cover beans with water and soak over night. Drain off water and add fresh water until it is about 2 inches above beans. Add tasso or ham hocks onion and bell pepper and cook until beans are tender. Remove 1 cup beans and mash. Add mashed beans bay leaves and sausage back to the pot and cook for 15 minutes. Add Tonys salt and pepper to taste. Serve over rice.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and sugar until light; blend in banana and egg until creamy. Stir in Bisquick nutmeg and nuts just until moistened. Do not over mix. Put into greased 9 x 5 x 3 pan or 4 small pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or 30 minutes for small pans. Cool in pan 10 minutes and remove from pan.

title: Jalapeno Cake
instructions: Mix together and spread thin layer on each tortilla. Stack layers and cover with cream cheese.

title: Lemon Cake Pie
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add egg yolks. Add remaining ingredients (flour lemon juice lemon rind and milk). After thoroughly mixed fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into unbaked pie shell (9-inch). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until firm in center.

title: Onion And Fennel Soup Au Gratin
instructions: In 1 quart nonstick saucepan melt margarine; add onions and fennel. Cook over medium-high heat stirring frequently until onions are translucent about 2 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water the dissolved broth mix and pepper; bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to low and let simmer until flavors blend about 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: You can use strawberries peaches blueberries cherries or pineapple.

title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with no stick cooking spray. Dip chicken in spread; coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Lo-Cal Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain and mix fruit then mix juice and pudding mix (if mixture is too thick add either fruit juice or water). Pour mixture over fruit and chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar and margarine by hand to make crumbs. Set aside 2 cups of the crumbs. Mix boiling water corn syrup and baking soda. Stir into the crumbs. Batter will be thin. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Place the 2 cups of crumbs over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: 4-Star Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream butter or shortening sugar and salt. Blend 1/2 cup cocoa into 1/3 cup water and add to first mixture. Add alternately to the mixture the sifted flour cold water and vanilla. Fold in 3 egg whites beaten stiff with 3/4 cup sugar added. Add to cake mixture gradually. Add last the soda mixed in 1 tablespoon boiling water. Bake in loaf or layer pans in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Two Season Squash Medley
instructions: In a large skillet heat butter and oil over medium heat. Add vegetables garlic and thyme. Cook and stir until tender about 15 minutes. Add garlic salt and pepper.

title: Lynn'S Famous Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Fry ground beef and drain. Combine ground beef Cheez Whiz and chicken soup; pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Cover the top with the Tater Tots. Sprinkle with garlic salt to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hard Candy
instructions: Boil sugar syrup and water to 310\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add oil and coloring. Stir. Pour onto buttered pan. Cut in small pieces. Drop in powdered sugar.

title: Broccoli, Cheese And Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook rice. Melt butter. Add onions or onion soup mix. Stir in creamed soups and Velveeta cheese. After cheese has melted stir in broccoli. Add to cooked rice in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Mix well and cook for about 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and broccoli; drain. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake until bubbly at 350\u00b0 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Dice eggs into small cubes. Combine chicken celery salt pepper and eggs with mayonnaise in a large bowl. Garnish with olives. Chill and serve.

title: Hot Texan Cake
instructions: Bring water cocoa and margarine to a boil. Add cocoa mixture to flour sugar salt and cinnamon mixture and blend. Add vanilla eggs buttermilk and soda. Beat altogether and put into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Golden Chicken
instructions: In a skillet brown chicken in oil. Add remaining ingredients; cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Chewy Bars
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour on a buttered floured pan (13 x 9-inch). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange-Lemonade
instructions: Squeeze oranges and lemons. Put juice in 2-quart pitcher. Add water to make 2 quarts. Slice used orange and lemon halves into quarters. Add to juices. Add sugar to taste. Serve cold with mint sprigs in each glass.

title: Lasagna Swirls(Serves 8)
instructions: Cook noodles. Mix ingredients together then spread about 1/4 cup of mixture along length of noodle. Roll it up and stand on end in a greased 2 1/2 deep casserole dish. Pour sauce over noodles. Bake uncovered for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Squash
instructions: Boil squash for 10 to 15 minutes in salted water. Brown ground beef. Split squash lengthwise; rake out the middle of squash. Combine meat onions celery bread crumbs middle of squash and cheese together. Add salt and pepper. Put in squash shells with tomato sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pasta And Bean Soup
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in olive oil. Add tomatoes celery carrot and chicken stock or water and simmer about 1 hour. Add beans parsley and sweet basil and simmer 15 minutes. Cook any kind of small macaroni separately. Drain pasta. Mix together with beans. Add Parmesan or Romano cheese. Good luck.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cover raisins with boiling water and cook 5 minutes. Drain reserving 6 tablespoons juice. Cream shortening and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs and beat until smooth. Sift flour with salt soda and spices. Mix with oatmeal and add to first mixture alternately with raisin liquid. Add raisins and nut meats. Drop on greased baking sheet at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Add water. Mix next 4 ingredients into a crumb-like texture. Sprinkle over top of apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are done. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over shortening sugar and salt. Blend. Add beaten eggs. Sprinkle yeast in warm water and stir until dissolved. Combine with egg mixture. Add flour and place in refrigerator for at least 4 hours. When ready to bake roll out and place on greased pan. Let rise until double. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Stir corn meal in rapidly boiling water. Cover and cook over boiling water 45 minutes; stir occasionally. Cook garlic onion and green pepper in oil until tender; add meat and cook until done. Add remaining ingredients. Pour layer of corn meal mixture into greased baking dish; cover with meat mixture; top with rest of corn meal mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Icebox Cake
instructions: Line bottom of 8 x 11-inch pan with more than half of the wafer crumbs. Cream butter and sugar. Add the eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Spread over crumbs. Crush and sweeten berries and spread next. Top with whipped topping then with remaining crumbs. Chill overnight.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in oleo until limp not brown. Add onions to other ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes. Top with slice of French bread and cheese.

title: Brunch Eggs(18 To 20 Servings)
instructions: Beat eggs and milk together. Heat soup enough to smooth. Add sherry mushrooms green pepper and pimento. Scramble eggs in butter until softly firm. Put in buttered 3-quart casserole. Layer eggs soup mixture and cheese; repeat. Dash with paprika. Put in cold oven; turn heat to 250\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour or until hot. Can be prepared the day before and refrigerated before baking.

title: Two-Cheese Seafood Linguini
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain. While pasta is cooking cook garlic and oregano in butter in a saucepan stirring frequently for about 1 minute. Add chopped tomato and continue cooking stirring occasionally for 3 minutes or until tomato is cooked through. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cook over medium heat stirring frequently until Blue cheese is melted and sauce is hot. Place hot-cooked pasta on a serving dish and top with sauce. Yields 3 to 4 servings.

title: Almost Heaven Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Bake in 13 x 9 inch sheet cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pizza Macaroni
instructions: Spray a 1-inch side pan (jelly roll or cookie sheet). Brown beef vegetables and spices in skillet. As soon as vegetables are wilted and meat loses red color add the soups and grated Parmesan cheese. Cook 15 minutes. Prepare macaroni according to directions. Drain and air dry. Beat together milk and egg. Stir into macaroni and spread in pan (greased). Cover with beef and tomato mixture. Sprinkle 1/2 pound Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let set and cut into 8 large squares.

title: Cornflake Macaroons
instructions: Beat egg white gradually adding 2 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Stir in remaining 6 tablespoons sugar and other ingredients. Place by rounded teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 18 cookies.

title: Coney Island Sauce
instructions: In a medium saucepan cook the meat crumbling with a fork until it loses its red color. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer stirring constantly for 30 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

title: Beef With Peppers
instructions: Heat pan; add oil and garlic (crushed). Add beef cut in small thin strips. Brown. Add salt pepper and soup stock; simmer a few minutes.

title: Devil'S Food Cake With Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Spray two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans with nonstick coating and dust lightly with flour; set pans aside. In a large mixing bowl combine flour 1 3/4 cups sugar cocoa powder and baking soda. Add milk margarine and vanilla. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed about 30 seconds or until combined. Beat on medium to high speed for 2 minutes scraping sides of the bowl occasionally. Thoroughly wash the beaters. In a small mixing bowl beat the egg whites until soft peaks form (tips curl). Gradually add the 1/4 cup sugar beating until stiff peaks form (tips stand straight). Fold into the batter. Pour the batter into the prepared pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool cakes in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes. Remove cakes from pans and cool them thoroughly on wire racks. Spread the Chocolate Frosting between the layers then frost sides and top. Makes 12 servings.

title: Kolacky
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in vanilla. Combine flour and salt; add in fourths to butter mixture blending well. Chill dough until easy to handle. Roll dough to 3/8-inch thickness on floured surface. Cut out 2-inch circles (or other shapes). Place on ungreased baking sheets. Make a thumbprint about 1/4-inch deep in each cookie. Fill with jam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 13 minutes or until delicately browned on edges.

title: Chinese Sparerib Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and brush on cooked ribs. Broil for 5 minutes; turn ribs over and repeat. Use the remaining sauce as a dip when serving.

title: Chocolate Delite
instructions: Melt oleo; add flour and nuts. Press in bottom of 9x15 inch dish. Bake in slow oven until brown. Set aside to cool. Mix cream cheese sugar and 1/2 container of Cool Whip together. (If too stiff add milk.) Spread on top of cooled crust. Mix pudding with milk. Put this on top of cream cheese layer. Add other 1/2 container of Cool Whip; sprinkle with about 1/2 c. nuts. Chill for several hours. Serves 12.

title: Sweet Potato Pecan Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl mix together the sweet potatoes sugar 1/2 cup butter eggs vanilla milk and nutmeg until the mixture is smooth. Transfer to lightly buttered 2-quart baking dish. In a bowl stir together the brown sugar flour remaining butter and pecans. Sprinkle the mixture over sweet potatoes. Bake for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix cornflakes with butter. Put 1/2 of this mixture in buttered casserole dish. Put shredded cabbage on top of cornflake mix. Combine milk cheese mayonnaise and soup; pour over cabbage. Top with remaining cornflake mixture and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cream Frozen Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in milk. Turn into freezing tray and freeze 3/4 to 1 hour (until slushy). Whip cream until stiff. Add partially frozen Kool-Aid mixture to whipped cream and whip just enough to mix well but keep as cool as possible. Return quickly to freezing tray and freeze at coldest point with no more stirring.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in hot milk. Pour over bread crumbs. Mix well. Add squash salt and pepper. Stir in beaten eggs and pour in greased baking dish. Cover with grated cheese. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until set.

title: Heavenly Fudge
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients until no traces of milk powder or cocoa remain. Turn mixture into an individual loaf pan or a 10 ounce custard cup and place in freezer until firm. Makes 1 serving. Calories per serving 135.

title: Beef And Potato Bake
instructions: Apply evenly in greased 2-quart baking dish the potatoes and 1 tablespoon of onions. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt 1/8 teaspoon of pepper and parsley flakes. Mix ground beef milk cracker crumbs catsup 1/4 cup onions 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper. Spread evenly over potatoes. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until potatoes are tender (50 to 60 minutes). Serves 4 large helpings.

title: Quick Whole Wheat Bread(Makes 1 Loaf)
instructions: Dissolve the sugar in lukewarm water. Stir into the yeast and leave in a warm place for 10 to 15 minutes until frothy. In a large bowl mix the flour with the salt and rub in the margarine. Beat the yeast liquid into the flour to form a dough. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead by folding the dough toward you then pushing away with the palm of the hand for about 10 minutes until firm and elastic. Place the dough in bowl. Cover with lightly oiled polythene and leave to rise until double in size (1 to 1 1/2 hours in warm place). Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 2 minutes until firm. Shape to fit a lightly greased 450-g/1-pound loaf pan; cover with oiled polythene and leave in a warm place for about 45 minutes until the dough is just rounded over the top of the pan. Heat the oven to 450\u00b0. Bake the loaf for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown and sounds hollow if tapped underneath. Cool on a wire tray.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs; beat until fluffy. Add almond extract. Stir in flour; mix until smooth. Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Turn mixture into pan. Spoon the pie filling onto the cake in 16 spots spacing 4 spoonfuls evenly in each direction. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden. Filling will sink into the cake while baking. Cut into 16 pieces to serve. Dust with powdered sugar and spoon slightly sweetened whipped cream over each serving. Great served warm!

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in casserole about 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or less time if meat is boneless.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Blend for 1 minute the eggs Bisquick butter milk salt and pepper. Pour into 9-inch pie plate. Add remaining ingredients and push under with a spoon. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Easter Ham
instructions: Score or puncture ham with knife or meat fork. Place pineapple rings around on top. Place cherries in center of rings. Secure with cloves. (May need toothpicks too if skin is thick.) Make a mixture of pineapple juice and cherry juice. Add handful of brown sugar. Heat slightly until sugar dissolves and pour over ham. Cook 2 to 3 hours less it heats thoroughly. May use Brown-in-Bag. It really keeps the moisture in!

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix well. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Pork Chops Ol
instructions: In a large skillet brown pork chops on both sides in oil; sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper. In a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish combine rice water tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Mix well. Arrange chops over rice; top with green pepper. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours or until meat juices run clear. Uncover; Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Yields 4 - 6 servings.

title: Awesome Applesauce Brownies
instructions: Melt butter sugar and chocolate in medium saucepan over low heat. Stir often. Remove from heat and stir in eggs applesauce and vanilla; mix well.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Combine and pour into 9 x 13-inch loaf pan. Dab butter and 1/2 cup brown sugar on bottom of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into a bowl. In large mixer bowl cream shortening with sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add sour cream and flour mix; blend well. Add oats raisins and nuts. Bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Drop on cookie sheet by spoonful. Keeps for a long time (maybe).

title: 5 In 1 Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients and serve on lettuce leaf with Ritz crackers.

title: Valentine Red Velvet Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar margarine and Crisco. Mix flour cocoa and baking powder together. Add eggs into sugar margarine and Crisco one at a time. Add flour and milk to mixture beginning and ending with flour. Add flavoring. Pour into pan. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0 usually 2 hours.

title: Five-Cup Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and allow to stand in refrigerator for several hours before serving. Standing overnight is best.

title: Corn Bread Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Save 1 cup broth. Pull chicken off bone. Cut into bite-sized pieces. Set aside.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour mixture into casserole. Bake 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Blend next 7 ingredients in blender. Add to spinach; mix. Pour into pan sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and paprika on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: White Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Serve with chicken or pork.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: This recipe has an interesting true story with it. While I was chaperoning the mass media class on their annual trip to New York City we went to lunch at Planet Hollywood. Two of us decided to eat light so we would have room to share a dessert. The White Chocolate Bread Pudding sounded good so that is what we ordered. Well let me tell you after one bite I was sure I made a mistake I should have ordered one by myself. It was the best dessert I have ever tasted not real sweet just out of this world. Grrreat!!! While devouring mine slowly a man came to our table to ask our opinion of the food. We told him how good it was and asked him if he worked here. He told us he was the manager. Well you can guess what we asked him next - Could we get the recipe for this dessert? He said hed try. Five minutes passed and he returned with this recipe. We were so happy to get the recipe little did I realize it was set up to serve a restaurant. Im sure if you have the time to work with this recipe and break it down to feed less you will not be sorry. I know I wasnt.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain peaches and apricots. In 9 x 13-inch pan cut peaches and apricots in small chunks. Stir in strawberries. Stir in orange juice. Add lemon juice. Slice bananas into mixture. Put fruit salad into a couple of containers and put into freezer. Before eating thaw until just barely crunchy. If thawed completely it will be too soupy.

title: Old Time Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Cream margarine with sugar and egg. Add yeast and water to the mixture. Mix in flour one cup at a time to make a spongy batter. (An electric mixer works fine.) Place in airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use. To bake preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Place heaping tablespoonful of the dough into greased muffin tins. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. This mixture will keep up to 5 days in the refrigerator. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Arrange potatoes in a buttered glass casserole. Sprinkle with flour salt and onion. Mix lightly. Stir in milk and dot with butter. Cook covered 15 to 18 minutes stirring every 4 minutes. Rest covered for 5 minutes. Sprinkle cheese evenly over top and garnish with paprika or parsley flakes.

title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Clean seeds; discard fiber. Wash seeds. Place in shallow layer in roasting pan and roast in a 250\u00b0 oven until golden brown about 30 to 40 minutes. Stir occasionally. Sprinkle with salt if desired.

title: Best Ever Cake
instructions: Mix all together; put in 9 x 13-inch cake pan greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Oreo Cookie Ice Cream Cake(Grandchildren'S Special)
instructions: Put Oreos in a plastic bag and crush into crumbs with a rolling pin. Spread half the Oreo crumbs in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Spread softened ice cream over Oreo crumbs. Top with remaining Oreo crumbs. Chill until set. Before freezing you can drizzle with chocolate syrup. When serving you can offer choices of hot fudge whipped cream cherries nuts - the gooier the better!

title: Jane'S Sweet Dough(Mix Today And Bake Tomorrow.)
instructions: Mix 2 cups flour 1/4 cup sugar salt and dry yeast. Combine in a saucepan milk water and margarine and heat to very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to dry ingredients and beat. Add eggs and more flour to make stiff dough. Cover with plastic wrap and towel. Set aside 30 minutes. Mold in your desired shape round loaf or try braiding. Refrigerate 2 to 24 hours. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Avery'S Best Ever Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cream shortening and sugar together. Slowly add boiling water. When almost dissolved add the cup of cold water. When this mixture is lukewarm add the yeast and allow to dissolve. Add beaten eggs flour and salt; mix well. Refrigerate overnight. Roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with biscuit cutter. Brush tops with melted butter fold over and rebutter. Place in warm place 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Poke Cake
instructions: Prepare cake as directed. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0. Cool about 15 minutes. Poke holes in cake. Mix Jell-O with water. Pour over cake. Chill 3 hours. Frost with lite Cool Whip.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Blend baking mix and milk. Turn onto a flour dusted surface and knead about 10 times. Pat or roll 1/4 inch thick rectangle shape 8 x 14-inches. Spread with soft butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar mixture. Roll as you would jelly rolls. Cut 1 inch pieces. Place in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Turn oven on at 425\u00b0. Bake for 15 minutes. Makes 15 rolls.

title: Chicken Fold Overs
instructions: Cook chicken and remove from bone. Separate 1 large can biscuits to 20 pieces.

title: Walnut Garlic Linguine
instructions: Heat oil garlic and walnuts in skillet over medium heat. Stir until walnuts are lightly toasted. About 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cook pasta and drain. Add pasta parsley salt cheese and basil to walnut mixture. Toss and Serve.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips cheese and almonds. Place in large square or rectangular dish. Top with cheese potato chips and almonds. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole Supreme
instructions: In a saucepan saute the mushrooms with the butter. Add the mushroom soup and heat to a boil.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with fresh raw vegetables.

title: Squash Relish
instructions: Chop first 6 vegetables fine. Mix well and add 2 tablespoons salt. Let stand for 1 hour. Mix salt with vegetables. Bring sugar vinegar water and mustard and celery seed in cloth and let stand alone while vegetables are sitting. Drain vegetables and add to liquid. Boil 25 to 30 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Drain. Add tomato sauce catsup and pepper. In 1 1/2-quart dish alternate meat and cheese. Arrange biscuits on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Crab And Corn Soup
instructions: Shred crab meat. Mix corn with chicken stock and bring to a boil. Stir in crab meat and sherry. Gradually stir in beaten egg yolks. Mix cornstarch with water and stir into soup. Bring to a boil constantly. Beat egg whites and fold into soup. Cook for a few minutes. Add salt and pepper.

title: Rolled Oats Cake
instructions: Mix oatmeal and water together; set aside to cool. Cream the butter sugars and eggs. Add the flour cinnamon and soda. Mix in oatmeal mixture. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine the dry ingredients and set them aside. Cream together the remaining ingredients. Add the dry ingredients half at a time. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Cloud Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder sugar and salt into a large mixing bowl. Cut in shortening with pastry blender. Combine egg and milk in bowl; add to dry ingredients. Stir lightly with fork.

title: Cantaloupe Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt in top of double boiler; stir in milk. Cook over boiling water stirring until thickened. Cook 15 minutes more stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Line bowl with wafers; top with sliced cantaloupe. Pour some custard over cantaloupe; continue layers ending with wafers. Serve warm or chilled. Serves 6.

title: Lemon Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Graham Cracker Cream Pie
instructions: Combine graham crackers softened butter 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Pat into a 9-inch pie plate reserving 1/4 cup for topping.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Cook hamburger and drain. Add taco seasoning; simmer 10 minutes. Spread refried beans on bottom of the pie crust; add the seasoned meat. Spoon taco sauce over the meat; sprinkle tomatoes and chopped onions over the sauce. Cover with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut tomatoes in halves. In small bowl mix remaining ingredients thoroughly and press on top of tomato halves. In shallow baking dish bake tomatoes until softened about 15 to 25 minutes (time will depend on firmness of tomatoes). Topping should be lightly browned. If not tomatoes may be placed under broiler. Makes 4 servings.

title: Divinity Fudge
instructions: Place sugar syrup and water in pan over medium heat. Stir only until sugar is dissolved. Cook until a little tried in cold water forms a soft ball (236\u00b0 to 238\u00b0). Beat egg whites on high speed until stiff. Continue beating and pouring in 1/2 of the syrup. Continue beating while cooking the rest of the syrup until it forms a hard ball when tried in cold water. Pour rest of syrup in egg white mixture and continue beating. Add vanilla and nuts. Continue beating by mixer or beat by spoon until candy is thick enough to drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

title: Country Fried Chicken
instructions: Soak chicken in ice water for about 1/2 hour. Drain well and cover with buttermilk 1/2 to 1 hour. Take out of milk and place on paper towel. Heat oil (I use vegetable oil with 1 tablespoon margarine). Dredge chicken in flour with salt and pepper. Fry to your satisfaction or doneness. Place lid on skillet for about 10 minutes at end of frying (optional). Drain on paper towel or as is.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Slice and brown meat. Add vinegar water brown sugar salt soy sauce\tand pineapple juice. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes or until meat is tender. Blend cornstarch in 1/2 cup water. Stir into meat mixture and cook until clear and thickened. Add pepper onion and pineapple. Cook 2 minutes. Serve over hot rice. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Place sugars butter eggs and vanilla in bowl. Attach bowl and flat beater; turn to speed 2 and mix 30 seconds. Stop and scrape bowl. Turn to speed 4 and mix 30 seconds. Sift flour salt and baking soda together. Gradually add flour mixture to sugar mixture on stir speed 2 minutes. Increase to speed 2 for 30 seconds. Add chocolate chips on stir speed for 15 seconds.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Crush the Post Toasties in a low flat bowl. Pour the evaporated milk in another. Dip the pork chops in milk then in the crushed Post Toasties. Add salt and pepper. Cook on a lightly greased cookie sheet for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Cheesy Cauliflower Italiano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour salt garlic powder and pepper. In a greased casserole dish layer 1/2 of each in the following order cauliflower onion flour mixture butter pieces olives Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Repeat layering with second half of ingredients adding parsley after olives. Sprinkle with paprika. Combine wine and milk. Pour over and bake uncovered 40 to 45 minutes until bubbly and golden.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Separate rolls in a baking pan making sure dough sticks together and there are no holes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes and cool. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise dill weed horseradish and chopped scallions. Spread mixture over crust. Chop finely any fresh vegetables. Sprinkle on top cream cheese. Pat lightly. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Cut to serve.

title: Stuffed Pepper Cups
instructions: Cut off tops of green peppers; remove seeds and membranes. Precook green pepper cups in boiling salted water for about 5 minutes; drain. (For crisp peppers omit precooking.) Sprinkle inside of cups generously with salt.

title: Bavarian Sausage Skillet Supper
instructions: In a large skillet saute coleslaw mix and carrots until crisp tender. Add water bring to a boil. Stir in remaining ingredients and return to a boil. Cook for 8 minutes or until noodles are tender stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with caraway seeds if desired. Approx. 5 servings.

title: Mexican Fiesta
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet stirring to crumble; drain well. In a large bowl combine ground beef and all remaining ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and sour cream. Pour into a greased 9 1/2 x 15-inch casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread sour cream over top; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Deep Dish Apple Crisp
instructions: Prepare apples by peeling and slicing as you would for a regular pie in a large pie plate. Use enough apples to fill the plate. For topping beat 2 eggs add sugar and butter. Beat well. Fold in flour which has been sifted with baking powder and salt. Add vanilla. Spread mixture over apples and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until done (about 45 minutes).

title: Mock Sausage Patties
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in medium size bowl and blend well with hands. Beat egg white with fork and add to mixture; mix with hands. Shape into 12 patties. Broil 3 to 4 inches from broiler for 4 to 5 minutes until light brown on nonstick cookie sheet. Turn and broil 2 to 3 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Linguine Salad
instructions: Cook and drain linguine. Pour cool water over linguine and let drain again. Mix ingredients and toss well. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Smoked Sausage Roll-Ups
instructions: Heat sausage links through but not to boiling point. Drain; let cool as they can be handled with fingers to roll up. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds. Place warm sausage on each strip of dough and roll up to the opposite point. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with mustard or ketchup. Makes 48 snacks. Kids love these and are easy to fix.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Combine lettuce tomatoes and onion in large bowl. Add kidney beans and hamburger. Crush Doritos chips and add to salad. Pour dressing over and add cheese. Toss before serving.

title: Turkey And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to medium heat. Combine wild rice brown rice and 5 cups of chicken broth and cook until done. In a large bowl toss rice turkey and mushrooms.
