Add cream butter chestnuts extra chicken broth onion and garlic with salt and pepper to taste. Pour into a baking dish and sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese. Bake for about an hour.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Boil celery onion and bouillon until tender. Add rest of ingredients and simmer. Thicken with cornstarch.

title: Sausage Onion Squares
instructions: Cook sausage and onion until brown; drain. Mix Bisquick milk and 1 egg. Spread in 9 x 13-inch greased Pyrex pan. Top with sausage mixture. Mix sour cream salt pepper and 1 egg. Pour over sausage. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cool cut into squares.

title: Chicken Keiv
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a saucepan melt butter. Combine crumbs cheese and spices. Dip chicken in melted butter and roll in crumbs. Place skin side up in a baking dish. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes. Add wine green onions and parsley to remaining butter (about 1/2 cup). When chicken is golden pour butter sauce mixture over chicken and return to oven for 5 minutes.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix together ingredients; chill overnight. Roll into balls. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 50 Spinach Balls.

title: Frozen Banana Punch
instructions: Mix all but bananas. Process bananas and a little juice in blender. Add remaining juice and freeze.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: To prepare corn remove husks and silk. Place in boiling water. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove; plunge into cold water. Drain; cut corn from cob. Do not scrape the cobs. Combine all ingredients except mustard and flour. Boil for 15 minutes. Mix mustard and flour. Blend with water as for gravy. Add to corn mixture. Boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Pack into hot sterile jars. Seal at once. Yield approximately 6 pints.

title: Orange Candy Slice Cake And Icing
instructions: Cream butter and sugar add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Add 1 cup buttermilk beat well add soda to other 1/2 cup buttermilk and add to mixture. Combine dry ingredients; add orange slice halves add dates and nuts; blend. Line a tube pan with well-greased brown paper. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine oil eggs sugar zucchini and vanilla in a large mixing bowl. Blend well. Stir flour soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. Do not beat. Stir in nuts.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes. Add sugar pumpkin and lemon juice. Mix dry ingredients together in separate bowl and fold into pumpkin mixture. Grease jelly roll pan and line with waxed paper. Spread batter into pan and sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Turn upside down onto a confectioners sugar-covered dish towel. Remove waxed paper immediately and roll up in towel. Cool completely.

title: Wedding Noodles
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add noodles. Bring to a boil again. Take off burner. Stir 2 to 3 times during forenoon. (Start as soon as they start seating guests.)

title: All American Dinner
instructions: Drive to McDonalds and stop at first window. Say \I would like 2 cheeseburgers 2 large French fries and 2 large Dr. Peppers\ then drive to second window and pay the person at that window. Finally drive to third window and pick up food.

title: Petite Pizza
instructions: Mix together and spread on thinly sliced French rolls. Place under broiler until bubbly. Watch carefully as they burn easily. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Cook broccoli and place in 9 x 13 pan. Add cooked chicken and stir. In a saucepan heat soup and cheese stirring until melted. Stir mayonnaise into the soup mixture. Pour the soup mixture over the chicken and sprinkle with lemon juice. Mix the bread crumbs and melted butter in a small bowl and pour over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Okra And Rice Dish
instructions: Place okra rice water and salt in pot; cook 30 to 40 minutes. Turn into greased baking dish; add tomato sauce. Bake 10 minutes in preheated 375\u00b0 oven. Yields 4 servings.

title: Rice Pudding(Top Of Range)
instructions: Combine rice milk sugar and butter; cook on medium heat until thickened about 30 minutes stirring often. Add vanilla and pour into serving dish.

title: Aunt Jennie'S Chicken
instructions: Slice each breast in 2 thin layers. Wet then dip each piece in bread crumbs and fry in butter or oil just until crisp on each side. Lay chicken in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix all ingredients that are left and pour over the chicken. Cover and bake until sauce thickens about 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Add all the other ingredients. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Paul'S Watercress Salad
instructions: Wash and cut stems off watercress. Drain thoroughly. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Fold in sour cream (do not defrost peas). Garnish with sliced avocado and sprinkle of paprika. Serve immediately. Serves 6 to 10.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening and eggs. Stir in flour soda and vanilla. Mix well. Add chips and nuts; mix well to distribute evenly. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 9 dozen cookies.

title: Kasha
instructions: Bring water to boil in a pot; cook the bow ties. Drain and cool. Put kasha in a wide mixing bowl; add the beaten egg. Mix with a fork until the egg is fully absorbed and all of the grains of kasha are slightly moistened. Let this mixture dry overnight or place in a skillet over moderately high heat and stir the kasha until it is dry and the grains separate from each other. In a large saucepan heat the olive oil and saute the onions and mushrooms until they are light brown and soft. Bring 2 cups salted water to a boil in a large pot. Add the kasha; cook until the kasha has absorbed all of the water. Mix in the sauteed vegetables and bow ties. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve warm.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Sift together the flour baking powder cinnamon and salt. Combine oil and sugar. Mix well; add 4 eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add dry ingredients gradually. Fold in finely chopped apples and vanilla. Pour into 3 (9-inch) layer pans which have been greased well and lined with wax paper. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chess Squares(Oh-So-Good)
instructions: Mix the ingredients together well and pat into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed lightly with butter-flavored Pam.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together (using an electric mixer) the sugar shortening eggs and salt in a large mixing bowl. While continuing to mix add the milk and the nutmeg and then add sifted flour baking soda and baking powder.

title: Chicken Breast With Vegetables
instructions: Cut chicken and vegetables in bite-size pieces. Put 3 tablespoons of soy sauce and cornstarch over chicken and let stand for 1 hour. Fry chicken in 3 tablespoons of oil for about 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove chicken from pan and set aside.

title: Strawberry Candy
instructions: Mix Jell-O pecans coconut condensed milk and vanilla. Shape mixture. Chill 1 hour. Roll chilled berries in red sugar. Dye slivered almonds for stems.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Stir well to dissolve. Add cherry pie mix. Stir and chill. While this is setting prepare the following Dissolve lemon Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Meanwhile beat cream cheese with salad dressing. Fold into lightly thickened lemon Jell-O along with whipped cream and crushed pineapple juice and all. Then add miniature marshmallows. Pour over cherry layer and allow to set overnight. Put into square cake pan.

title: Calico Beans - Old Settlers Beans
instructions: Drain beans. Save bean liquid and use if necessary as beans bake. Brown bacon ground meat and onion; drain off any fat. Mix together brown sugar catsup vinegar or dry mustard. Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions on package; drain and place in casserole. Cook rice according to directions on package; place in casserole with broccoli. Saute onions in butter. Blend onions and soup into casserole. Add salt and pepper and the dash of milk. Place cheese into casserole; cover with cracker crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and stir well. Pour into pan and refrigerate.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Cover potatoes with saltwater; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cook about 30 minutes. Cool slightly. Peel and coarsely shred potatoes. Set aside. Combine cheese and 1/4 cup butter in saucepan. Cook over low heat until cheese melts. Combine potatoes cheese mixture sour cream onions salt and pepper. Spoon into shallow 2-quart casserole. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: People Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt together margarine chocolate chips and peanut butter. Pour mixture over Crispix cereal. Put powdered sugar in a grocery bag. Put in cereal mixture and shake vigorously. Enjoy.

title: Dip For Fresh Fruit
instructions: Let cream cheese soften and mix with marshmallow cream and flavoring. This is delicious with any fruit.

title: Mary'S Chicken Delight
instructions: First boil chicken then drain and separate. Keep 1 cup of broth. Melt margarine in a 3-quart casserole dish. Put a layer of dressing and then chicken. Pour cream of chicken soup (undiluted) on top. Layer again with dressing and chicken and then cream of celery soup (undiluted). The last layer should be dressing. Pour chicken broth over all. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sugar Glazed Walnuts
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine melted butter brown sugar and cinnamon. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir and microwave on High for 1 more minute. Add nuts and mix to coat. Microwave at High for 3 to 5 minutes. Spread nuts onto wax paper and cool slightly. Refrigerate in airtight container.

title: Red Velvet Gabriella Cake
instructions: Combine dry cake mix with eggs oil buttermilk cocoa and food coloring. Beat together. Do not add ingredients on cake box. Bake according to cake box instructions. Frost with canned cream cheese frosting.

title: Hawaiian Pork Chops
instructions: Put barbecue sauce evenly over the meat. Put 1 tablespoon brown sugar on each chop. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done. Serve on rice using the sauce cooked with the meat.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook green beans and drain. In casserole layer beans sauce and water chestnuts. Repeat layers. Top with slivered almonds. Bake in moderate oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Spiced Tea(Serves 30)
instructions: Mix well and store in closed jar.

title: Chicken Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend with fork the cream cheese lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. Add onions (a little sugar salt pepper and celery seed may be added if desired). Add chopped chicken last. Form a ball. Cover with about 1/2 to 3/4 cup chopped pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Put in ungreased casserole dish. Combine soup salad dressing margarine egg and onion. Mix well. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle top with cheese and crackers. Press into casserole. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven until top is brown. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Shrimp Barbecue
instructions: Wash and clean shrimp well but do not shell. Place shrimp in large pan that is at least 2-inches deep. Melt butter; add to it the pepper garlic and lemon juice. Pour this over shrimp. Cover with foil. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours. Turn oven off and let shrimp marinate in warm oven until ready to serve. Serve shrimp in liquid mixture with green salad and French bread. Be sure to dip the bread in butter sauce!

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Crumble bacon; set aside. Cook onion in reserved bacon drippings until tender but not brown. Stir in beans bacon and remaining ingredients. Combine well. Pour into ungreased 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix butter and sour cream; add egg. Combine flour thyme salt and baking powder and add to first mixture. Mix thoroughly. Pour in greased baking dish. Saute onion carrots pepper and mushrooms in margarine; add chicken and soup. Spread over top of dough and bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Orange Marmalade Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar. Stir in orange peel. Beat egg; add milk marmalade and butter. Stir into dry ingredients. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Let stand 10 minutes then bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until tests done.

title: Irish Fruit Soda Bread
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in a saucepan including juice from pineapple. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook 10 minutes then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Cool. Into a large mixing bowl sift together dry ingredients and spices. Add cooled raisin mixture and eggs. Beat well. Bake in a greased 10-inch tube pan or 2 loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Fill pie plate 2/3 full with sliced peeled apples. Mix 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon then sprinkle over apples. Mix the last 4 ingredients well and pour over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Aunt Marion'S Hawaiian Short Ribs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300\u00b0. Mix the flour with two tablespoons salt and pepper to taste. Dredge ribs in the flour mixture. Heat butter and oil in a large skillet; add ribs and brown on all sides. Transfer the ribs to a roasting pan placing them in a single layer. Sprinkle with sliced onions. Combine the catsup water vinegar soy sauce Worcestershire sauce sugar chili powder and remaining salt and pepper. Pour over the short ribs and onions. Cover and bake for three hours or until the ribs are very tender. Carefully skim off all traces of fat. Serve ribs with noodles or rice. Serves five.

title: Easy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients except corn butter salt and pepper. When the other ingredients are almost done add corn and other ingredients to taste.

title: Sugar-Free Bavarian Cream Pie
instructions: Mix 1 cup 2% sweet milk and 1 box sugar-free instant vanilla pudding. Add the coconut and Cool Whip to first mixture; mix well. Put into a graham cracker crust. Chill overnight or for several hours.

title: Almond Bark Cookies
instructions: In a double boiler melted almond bark. Stir in peanut butter and remove from heat to cool slightly. Stir in peanuts; mix well. Stir in Rice Krispies and marshmallows; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper until set.

title: Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Bring first three to a boil. Add 1 cup self-rising flour; mix and press in pie pan.

title: Morning Eye Opener
instructions: Combine all ingredients; beat with fork just until thoroughly combined. Pour into tall glass. Makes 1 serving.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and cheese. Blend in egg yolk and vanilla. Add dry cake mix 1/3 at a time mixing well each time. Cover and chill for 30 minutes.

title: Crispy Chicken
instructions: Put cornflakes in a bag with the rosemary and pepper and use a rolling pin to crush and mix them together. Remove all skin from chicken rinse and dry pieces thoroughly. Dip in milk; roll in cornflake crumbs.

title: Tortoni - An Italian Delight
instructions: Separate eggs. Turn each white into small bowl of electric mixer. Refrigerate yolks. Let whites warm to room temperature 1 hour. Mix 1/4 cup water with sugar in 1-quart saucepan stirring over low heat to dissolve. Boil uncovered without stirring to 236\u00b0 on candy thermometer (syrup spins 2-inch thread when dropped from spoon).

title: My Own Weird Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Take 2 bananas and 1 each of lemonade and orange juice and put in blender for mixing. Repeat till bananas orange and lemonade are well mixed. Add pineapple juice then sugar and boiling water mixture. Pour into 3 containers for freezing. When ready to serve add each frozen portion to one 32 oz. 7-Up.

title: Old Fashioned Pancakes
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice together. Combine and sift flour sugar salt baking powder and soda. Stir in soured milk egg and melted butter. Fry small patties.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Make a graham cracker crust using finely crushed crackers margarine and sugar. Line a 10-inch pie plate reserving 1/4 cup crumbs for garnish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Southern Baked Beans
instructions: Add onion and bell pepper to pork and beans. In a bowl mix together brown sugar mustard ketchup and worcestershire sauce. Then mix with pork and beans in big pyrex pan. Put bacon slices on top. Bake at 550 until brown.

title: President'S Choice (Aunt Helen'S Chicken)
instructions: Cut chicken into serving size pieces; brown in oil. Remove to casserole dish. Add onion to hot oil; brown lightly. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in shallow casserole pan. Mix flour 1 cup sugar baking powder and milk together. Pour over butter. Place peaches on top of butter. Sprinkle sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
instructions: Blend gelatin and cold water. Mix remaining ingredients together in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring until it boils. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in softened gelatin. Cool.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cut roll of cookie dough into 9 slices and then quarter the slices. Place in an ungreased miniature cupcake tin to form a cupcake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven and place one peanut butter cup in the center. Cool and then remove from pan. Refrigerate. Makes 36 cookies.

title: Bavarian Brownies
instructions: Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Combine cake mix oleo milk and egg. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Batter will be thick. Spread in pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until done; drain. Mix all ingredients together. Crush crackers and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ground Meat Casserole
instructions: Spray Dutch oven or casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray. Crumble ground beef in bottom then slice potatoes in 1/4 inch slices and spread over ground beef. Chop onions and sprinkle on top of potatoes. Add mixed vegetables. In a bowl mix tomatoes tomato sauce and vegetable soup. Stir and pour over all ingredients in Dutch oven. Bake at 375 or 400 degrees until potatoes are tender. If casserole starts to get dry add a little water to finish baking.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat together then add 4 c flour 1 tsp soda and 1 tsp cream of tartar. Mix well. Chill. Roll in balls. Press with a glass bottom dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0for 10 minutes.

title: Budget Stretcher
instructions: Boil water onions tomatoes and seasoning until onions are tender. Add spaghetti and cook until tender. (Better second day!)

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into pie crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Pumpkin Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together through the evaporated milk. Pour into 9 x 13 inch plan. Mix 1 yellow cake mix and one cube margarine together so it is crumbly. Sprinkle over pumpkin mixture. Then sprinkle chopped nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until knife comes out clean. Top with Cool Whip or whipped cream. Very moist. Serves 15.

title: Soft Taco Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown beef in 10-inch skillet on stove top breaking into dime-size or smaller pieces; drain well. Stir in seasoning mix and 1 cup water. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium-high. Simmer for 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in Salsa Con Queso thoroughly.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Melt margarine in pot. Mix flour raisins sugar baking soda and salt in bowl. Add margarine beaten eggs and buttermilk; mix with spoon. Form in a ball and pat to cake size on baking sheet. Bake for 1 hour in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown onion in butter (lightly). Add soups broth and chilies. Add chicken and mix well. Arrange in casserole layer of tortillas layer of chicken mixture layer of cheese. Repeat layering until all is used. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until brown.

title: Manicotti With Butternut Squash Filling
instructions: Cook manicotti shells until al dent. Carefully rinse in cold water and reserve. Steam squash until tender. Mash thoroughly. Heat oil in a sautoir and saut onion and garlic until translucent. Add cabbage and sugar and continue to cook until cabbage is wilted. Add vegetable stock and squash and cook uncovered for 5 minutes. Add the Ricotta cheese and soy sauce and remove from heat. Mix well. Load mixture into piping bag and fill manicotti. Pour heated tomato sauce into baking dish and place filled manicotti on top. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered in a 325\u00b0 oven. Yield 4 portions.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix the first three ingredients together and spread on cookie sheet. Top that with chopped lettuce onion cheese and tomato. Eat with nacho chips.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Melt butter with milk then add caramels and chocolate chips to melt. Add nuts. Bake 1/2 cake mixture 15 minutes. Pour other mixture on top of cake then pour other half of cake mix. Bake at 300\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients and freeze. Serve frozen.

title: Mint Brownies
instructions: Cream and combine in order sugar 1/2 cup butter or margarine eggs Hersheys syrup vanilla salt and flour. Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Kotlety Pozharskie(Ground Chicken Cutlets)
instructions: In a small bowl combine the 5 slices of bread and 1/4 cup of milk. Soak the bread for about 15 minutes then squeeze the bread dry with your fingers.

title: Helen Gray (Pugs) Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Heat vinegar sugar and salt; pour over pickles. Store in refrigerator.

title: Taco Dip(Microwave)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and microwave. Serve with chips.

title: Four Layer Dessert
instructions: Combine flour nuts and butter. Mix well. Press into bottom only of 13 x 9 in. baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely. Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar until well blended. Fold in the Cool Whip. Spread over the crust and chill. Prepare chocolate pudding as directed on pkg. Spread over cream cheese layer. Chill completely. Prepare vanilla pudding as directed on pkg. Pour over chocolate pudding. Chill completely. Spread additional Cool Whip over top.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together well. Pour through a funnel into hot grease (a Fry Daddy works well). Cook on both sides until brown. Drain on paper towel. Add toppings and eat while warm.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: In skillet brown ground beef; add tomato sauce garlic salt and pepper. In small skillet saute onions in butter until tender. Stir in sour cream and cream cheese. Cook over low heat until cheese melts. In 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish layer cooked fettucine.\tSpoon sour cream mixture over noodles and top with meat mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chiles Rellenos(Stuffed Bell Peppers)
instructions: Cook ground beef and add spices if desired then drain grease and put aside.

title: Sandy'S Hearty Beef Cheese Crescent Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large fry pan brown beef onion and green pepper. Drain off fat. Stir in tomato sauce beans and salt. Simmer while preparing crust.

title: Hot Hamburger Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain. In saucepan mix ground beef mixture with all ingredients until cream cheese melts and mixture is hot. Do not boil. Serve in chafing dish or small crock-pot to keep warm.

title: Exotic Chicken Salad(Serves 10)
instructions: Mix together lightly and add dressing mixture.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Combine dissolve and add vegetables. Marinate overnight.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Drain salmon; reserve 3 tablespoons liquid. Flake fish. Combine salmon and liquid crumbs celery onion and egg. Mix well. Form into 5 patties. Fry in lightly greased skillet.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Bring sugar salt and evaporated milk to a boil and boil for 6 minutes (be sure to stir while cooking). Add rest of ingredients. Take off stove and stir until well mixed and mixture starts to thicken. Spread into a large cookie sheet.

title: Crab Munchies
instructions: Beat egg with mayonnaise Worcestershire sauce and seasoning. Add crab meat and bread crumbs. Shape into crab tenders. Broil about 6 inches from heat until golden brown. Makes 15 Crab Munchies.

title: Mint Julep Jelly
instructions: Combine bourbon water and sugar in top of double boiler. Place over boiling water. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat. Add Certo. Pour into glasses. Add fresh mint sprig to each glass. Seal. Makes 4 to 5 (8-ounce) glasses.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: In bowl combine sliced peaches with sugar as desired. Mix next 3 ingredients together in a small bowl then combine gently with peaches. Heat till just hot in a saucepan over medium heat. Pour into a 8 in round baking dish. Cut up butter and drop over the fruit. Add Biscuit Topper. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 min or topper is done. Serves 6.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain and chop artichokes. Mix all ingredients except paprika and spread in dish. Sprinkle paprika on top. Heat at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Layered Dessert
instructions: Beat together until thickened. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Decorate with chocolate sprinkles or shavings of chocolate. Chill.

title: Julie'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Chop onion and hamburger. Cook on high until hamburger browns. Take off burner. Add Ragu sauce. Fill both jars of Ragu 1/2 full of water and shake. Pour into pot. Cover sauce water and hamburger with onion salt and 1 tablespoon sugar. Cook for 1 hour on medium heat stirring often. Cook noodles as directed on box while sauce is cooking. Drain noodles before serving with sauce.

title: Mixed Fruit With Honey Sesame Dressing
instructions: Mix strawberries pineapple cubes and kiwi fruit; toss with Honey Sesame Dressing. Chill.

title: Hawaiian Ribs(6 Servings)
instructions: Sprinkle ribs with garlic. Brown 20 minutes in 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Toasted Pecans
instructions: Mix salt and water. Bring to a boil and add pecans. Boil for 1 minute drain. Spread pecans on cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until crisp.

title: Lemon-Mint Ice Tea
instructions: In a 2-cup glass container place the tea bags. Fill with water and microwave for 3 minutes. Let sit for 10 minutes then add to 2-quart juice container along with the lemonade to make 2 quarts and chill.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Lightly mix in food processor or by hand. Should be chunky. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with melba rounds or crackers.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add taco mix tomato paste salt and water. Simmer 15 minutes. Roll flour tortillas stuffed with meat mixture and chopped olives. Cover with cheese followed by diced chilies then remaining meat mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Easy Vegetable-Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cook halved peppers. Combine kidney beans broccoli and cheese. Fill each pepper half with the mix. Pour sauce over and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or cook in skillet 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Between waxed paper crush crackers into coarse crumbs with rolling pin. Mix well with salt garlic salt and marjoram in a shallow bowl. Beat egg and water in another shallow dish. Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and then coat well in the crumb mixture. Place in moderately buttered shallow pan about an inch apart. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Twelve chicken pulley bones can be substituted for breasts in which case baking time needs to be 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0. Yields 12 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Sticks
instructions: Cut butter and cream cheese into flour as for pie crust. Add milk and knead dough for 2 minutes with electric beater or 4 minutes by hand. Refrigerate dough overnight. Using 1/4 of the dough at a time roll on a floured board to thickness of pie crust. Brush on evaporated milk; sprinkle with sugar and nuts. With a pastry cutter or sharp knife cut into strips 2 inches long by 1 inch wide. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes; immediately remove sticks to cooling racks.

title: Meat And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Make medium white sauce by melting 4 tablespoons butter. Add flour and stir until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Cook stirring until smooth and thick. Remove from heat and add cheese. Stir until melted. Add cooked noodles ham and peas. Put into baking dish. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8. Beef or chicken is good too.

title: Double Bran Gem Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners. In a bowl combine wheat and oat brans whole wheat flour baking soda baking powder cinnamon and nutmeg. In a separate bowl combine all other ingredients. Pour onto dry mixture and mix until just combined. Scoop by 1/4 cupfuls into prepared muffin cups. Bake 14 to 16 minutes or until toothpick comes out sticky but not wet.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and eggs. Add ground raisins. Add flour soda and salt. Add oatmeal. Make into balls and flatten a little. Cookies stay moist and makes a big batch.

title: Sweet N Sour Pork Chops
instructions: In a large skillet brown chops in shortening. Spray a shallow 3-quart baking pan with vegetable cooking spray. Remove chops to baking pan; season with salt and pepper. Add carrots.

title: Petite Cherry Cream Cheese Tarts
instructions: Mix well. Place 1 vanilla wafer in bottom of each cupcake paper in muffin pan. Fill cups 3/4 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool thoroughly. Spoon cherry pie filling on top.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Grease Bundt pan with butter. Beat eggs one at a time in the butter and sugar. Sprinkle Bundt pan with 1/4 cup sugar. Pour 1/2 of batter into pan. Spread blueberries on batter. Use remainder of batter over blueberries. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer with lettuce and spread with mayonnaise. Put a thin layer of sliced onions on top. Sprinkle with sugar and then frozen or cooked peas. Add a layer of shredded Cheddar cheese and 1 layer of fried crumbled bacon. Let set several hours or overnight.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Pour boiling water over spices and tea and let steep for 15 minutes. Remove tea and spices and add sugar and fruit juices. Serve hot.

title: Easy Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Cream one cup of sugar with butter then add flour baking powder salt and milk mixing well. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Pour blackberries over batter. Sprinkle remaining sugar over berries. Pour boiling water over top then bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until golden brown. Serve plain or with cream.

title: Weight Watchers Orange Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Cool Whip. After mixing well fold in Cool Whip. One half cup serving equals 1 fruit 1/2 protein and 20 calories.

title: Kid'S Blowing Bubbles
instructions: Mix ingredients. Use wands or circled fingers to dip into mixture and blow bubbles.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown chops in skillet then put them in shallow baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Dissolve bouillon in hot water. Sprinkle rice over chops. Pour 2 cups water over rice. Top with diced vegetables. Sprinkle top with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fish Brine
instructions: Soak overnight. Cover fish with brine. Wash salt off air dry and smoke.

title: Baked Ham
instructions: Place ham fat side down in shallow microwave baking dish. Cook on High for 21 minutes; turn ham over. Drain pineapple slices reserving juice. Combine 2 teaspoons juice with brown sugar to make paste. Spread over top of ham. Place pineapple slices on top and stud with cloves. Attach pineapple with toothpicks if necessary. Cook on High 8 minutes. Let stand covered with foil about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Drain macaroni. Mix all ingredients together. Mix well with mayonnaise until it is creamy.

title: Diabetic Apple Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given in a large bowl (except nuts). Pour into a lightly greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This is good served warm with ice cream. Makes 16 servings.

title: Tuna Fish Casserole
instructions: Mix tuna fish cream of mushroom soup cream of celery soup and English peas in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Add 3/4 cup crushed potato chips to mixture. Add salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle 1/2 to 3/4 cup of crushed potato chips on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: In large skillet cook the meat and onion until meat is lightly browned and onion is tender. Add salt and pepper. Stir in drained beans and soup. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spoon in mounds of mashed potatoes over casserole. Sprinkle potatoes with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Crusty Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed. Add cream cheese beating well until light and fluffy. Alternately add flour and eggs beginning and ending with flour. Stir in vanilla.

title: Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Sift together first four ingredients. Mix shortening sugar and eggs; beat until fluffy. Stir in dry ingredients alternately with mashed bananas. Add chocolate chips last. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until done. They will be light in color.

title: 5-Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Soak first 4 ingredients together. Combine all ingredients until well blended. Serve with crackers or chips of choice.

title: Bread In A Jar
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; beat in eggs pumpkin and water. Sift together flour baking powder soda salt and spices. Add to pumpkin mixture. Stir in nuts. Pour mixture into greased widemouth pint jars filling 1/2 full. Place jars on a baking sheet in the oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. When bread is done remove one jar at a time. Wipe sealing edge of jar with paper towel or cloth and screw cap on tightly. The heat will vacuum seal the jar and the bread will keep for up to 1 year. This recipe makes 8 pints.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix broccoli and seeds bacon and onion. Then mix sugar 1/2 cup mayonnaise and 1 tablespoon vinegar. Pour over broccoli mixture.

title: Simple Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Place strawberries in 2-quart casserole. Cook in microwave oven on Full power for 2 minutes. Stir in fruit pectin. Cook on Full power for about 2 minutes or until a few bubbles surface.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and Crisco. Add sugar and vanilla. Beat well and add egg yolks. Beat well again. Combine flour and soda. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk starting and ending with flour. Add coconut and pecans. Fold in egg whites. Put in three 8-inch cake pans. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool before frosting.

title: Fluffy Jello
instructions: Pour jello into large mixing bowl. Pour in hot water. Mix. Beat in sour cream. Blend in favorite fruit or pie filling. Chill until molds.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs over top and then sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream first four ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients and blend at low speed for 1 minute. Shape into balls. Bake on ungreased pans. Press 1/2 Pecan in center of each ball before baking. Bake at 350 degrees for 5 to 8 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in unsalted water. Drain and mix with soup milk shrimp cheese and onion. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with chips and if desired paprika and more grated cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes until bubbly hot.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and pork in skillet; drain off grease. Stir in tomatoes paste salt pepper and garlic.

title: Corn-Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix corn and beans together. Put in casserole. Mix soup cheese onion sour cream and salt. Put on top of vegetables. Add crackers to top. Melt oleo; pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Bake in pie shell for 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and serve with crackers.

title: Boston Baked Beans(In Memory Of Winnie Miller)
instructions: Cook white beans until done. In a casserole dish combine beans tomatoes and sugar. Place bacon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve hot with cornbread.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and butter together then add bread crumbs milk and salt. Place in glass 2-quart casserole dish and just before baking add raisins vanilla and cinnamon on top. Bake 1 1/2 hours or until set in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Blond Brownies(Chew Bread)
instructions: Mix butter sugar and eggs. Add flour and vanilla. Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. May add 1 cup coconut 3 cups chocolate chips or 1 cup nuts.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Separate the eggs. Beat egg whites until very stiff adding sugar as you beat; set aside. Beat yolks until light colored and fluffy. Add lime juice and beat together. Add the condensed milk and beat 3 to 4 minutes. Fold in beaten egg whites until blended. Pour into pie shell and freeze. Remove later and top with whipping cream. Return to freezer. Freeze again. Let it sit out of freezer for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Mix vinegar red wine water sugar salt pepper sliced onion mustard seed cloves and bay leaves in a large deep bowl. Wipe meat with a damp cloth and place in bowl. Let stand in refrigerator for 2 days turning the meat.

title: Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar milk and butter to soft ball stage stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Add chocolate Marshmallow Creme vanilla and nuts. Beat until chocolate is melted and blended. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Apple-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine oats flour whole wheat flour baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon. Stir in raisins and apples. In a large bowl combine egg honey oil and milk. Stir in dry ingredients. Mix to form smooth batter. Drop batter onto ungreased cookie sheets using rounded teaspoonfuls. Dip fingers in water and press dough down. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Butterscotch Bubble Bread
instructions: Butter angel food cake or Bundt pan. Dump in frozen rolls. Blend pudding mix brown sugar spices and nuts in a bowl. Scatter over dough. It will sift down between rolls as they thaw and rise. Cut margarine in thin pats and arrange on top. Cover with foil and go to bed leaving covered pan to rise on counter at room temperature. Next morning preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake in center of oven for 35 minutes. Remove from pan and turn onto a large plate.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine sugars vanilla and egg. Stir in dry ingredients. Add nuts last. Divide dough in half and roll into 2 rolls 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Wrap in wax paper and chill at least 2 hours or overnight. Slice in 1/4-inch slices and bake on ungreased cookie sheet in a 425\u00b0 oven for 7 minutes. Remove immediately from cookie sheet.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle pecans then coconut in pan. Mix cake mix as directed on box then pour cake mix batter over pecans and coconut. Beat until smooth with mixer the cream cheese oleo powdered sugar and vanilla. Spoon in heaping tablespoonfuls this mixture over top of cake mix avoiding the sides of the pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cake will set as it cools. Its ugly but delicious!

title: Chewy Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat eggs until lightly foamy; add sugar vanilla and margarine until creamy. Add flour baking powder and salt. Mix at low speed until blended. Stir in pecans. Mixture will be stiff. Bake for 25 or 30 minutes. Cool 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Combine peaches 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Put into an 8-inch square baking dish. Combine flour 1/3 cup brown sugar oatmeal 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and margarine; mix until crumbly. Crumble over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Chill and serve with chips or fresh vegetables.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature until softened. In medium bowl beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Slowly add sweetened condensed milk beating until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla until well mixed. Pour into crust. Chill 3 hours until firm. Top with cherry pie filling. Makes 1 pie.

title: Pina Colada
instructions: In blender combine pineapple juice cream of coconut and vodka; blend until smooth. (Can be made ahead. Cover and refrigerate up to 4 hours.) Before serving puree in blender with ice. Serve in tall glasses. Garnish with flowers or fresh fruit. Makes 16 servings.

title: Ann'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions and set aside.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese and peanut butter together. Slowly add powdered sugar and milk alternately. Mix well. Gently fold in two (8 ounce) cartons frozen whipped topping (thawed). Spoon into pie shells. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts and freeze until solid. Serve frozen.

title: Orange Nut Ring
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Stir in all but 1/4 cup of the pecans and raisins. Add egg shortening orange peel orange juice vanilla and milk. Mix just until blended. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Glaze while warm with mixture of

title: Favorite Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Saute onion until golden. Remove from heat; stir in hot rice sour cream cottage cheese bay leaf salt and pepper; toss lightly to mix well. In a greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish layer half the rice mixture then half the chilies then sprinkle with half the cheese. Repeat. Bake uncovered 25 minutes or until bubbly and hot. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: String Bean Casserole
instructions: Chop onion and saute in butter. Add other ingredients in casserole dish. Put cheese on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Put French fried onions on top of dish and cook 5 minutes longer.

title: Bachelor'S Pie
instructions: Combine onion celery beef and pepper in big skillet with a little cooking fat in it. Brown slowly and stir constantly. When browned add the rest of the ingredients; stir until pretty hot again and pour into a greased baking dish. Then on top spread some mashed potatoes. Bake at 390\u00b0 until brown.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Use Bundt pan.

title: Deer Mcnuggets
instructions: Cut deer into 2-inch strips. Fill large bowl with milk. Add all seasonings. Add meat. Refrigerate up to 6 hours flour and fry. (Every deer you see will be swimming in this marinade.)

title: Squash Raisin Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix eggs butter and squash in large bowl. In another bowl mix sifted dry ingredients then add wet ingredients and raisins. Stir just until batter is moistened throughout. Spoon into 12 muffin cups and bake 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Carrot Cake Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Melt butter in microwave 20 seconds. Mix all ingredients together with mixer at high speed until well blended.

title: Holiday Spread
instructions: Grind Spam and olives. Mix with other ingredients. Store in refrigerator. Serve with crackers.

title: Broccoli Casserole(Mark Davis' Favorite Dish)
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Cool and drain broccoli. Add all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Spray a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish with Pam or lightly grease dish. Pour all ingredients in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Coca-Cola Chicken
instructions: Place fryer in saucepan; add Coca-Cola catsup salt and pepper. Cook for about 45 minutes over medium heat.

title: Coke Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to instructions on box. Grease and flour a pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until the edges turn loose.

title: Apple Relish
instructions: Mix together; let boil for 15 minutes. Pack in jars and seal. Makes 8 pints.

title: Reduced Fat Broccoli Quiche(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time 45 minutes.

title: Spanish Omelet
instructions: Saute tomato green pepper and mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter until tender; drain. Combine eggs water salt and pepper; stir briskly with a fork until uniformly blended. Stir in vegetable mixture 2 tablespoons picante sauce and bacon. Heat a 10-inch omelet pan or heavy skillet over a medium heat until hot enough to sizzle a drop of water. Add 1 tablespoon butter and rotate pan to coat bottom. Pour half of egg mixture into skillet. As mixture starts to cook gently lift edges of omelet with a spatula and tilt pan so uncooked portion flows underneath. Fold omelet in half and place on a warm platter. Repeat procedure with remaining 1 tablespoon butter and egg mixture. Serve with additional picante sauce if desired.

title: No-Peek Chicken
instructions: Mix and pour into casserole dish. Lay 4 chicken breasts on top of mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 package Lipton onion soup mix. Cover with foil. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. No peeking!

title: Energy Tonic
instructions: Mix well and pour in juice jars. Keep in refrigerator; drink 1/2 cup morning and night.

title: Quick Manicotti
instructions: Cook shells; rinse in cold water. Drain and set aside. Saute beef and garlic; drain grease. Add cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese salt and mayonnaise; stir well. Stuff manicotti shells with meat mixture (a baby spoon works real well for stuffing shells). Arrange shells in greased baking dish.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Drain beets reserving 1/3 cup liquid. In a saucepan combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Stir in reserved beet liquid vinegar and butter. Cook and stir until mixture thickens. Add beets and heat through. Makes 4 servings.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Mix eggs buttermilk and Crisco then mix with dry ingredients. Bake in muffin tins at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Stores well in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks. This recipe makes a lot 1/2 recipe may be plenty.

title: Easy Fudge Brownies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir all ingredients except fudge topping and mint extract until just moistened. Pour mixture into a 9 1/2 x 13-inch glass casserole dish which has been sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Let cook about 10 minutes and then spread fudge topping on top. If you like a mint taste stir in mint extract into the fudge topping before it is spread over the brownies.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Blend together oil vinegar sugar parsley flakes seasoned salt Italian seasoning and onion. Cook noodles; drain. Cut up cauliflower green peppers broccoli and carrots. Mix all and refrigerate.

title: Date Loaf Candy
instructions: Cook sugar and cream until forms soft ball stage; add dates and cook until dates melt. Add nuts; beat until stiff. Pour mixture on wet towel and roll and cool in icebox then cut in slices.

title: Chili-Cheese Bars
instructions: Grease pan. Layer cheese and chilies. Blend eggs flour and milk. Pour over cheeses. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Pigs In Blanket
instructions: Sprinkle Old Bay on oysters. Slice pimento into 12 slices placing one on each oyster. Wrap oyster in slice of bacon and skewer. Broil about 8 minutes or until bacon is golden brown and crisp.

title: Rhubarb Crunch Cobbler
instructions: Mix brown sugar oats flour and margarine with cinnamon until crumbly. Press half of mixture into 9 x 9-inch pan. Cover with rhubarb.

title: Blondies
instructions: Melt sugar and margarine together. Add flour eggs vanilla and pecans. Stir everything together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Extras
instructions: Cream butter sugar brown sugar eggs maple flavoring and peanut butter. Blend in pudding flour baking soda and salt. Add chocolate chips. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet in 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Time Approximately 1 hour. Makes approximately 4 dozen cookies.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together raw apples brown sugar and water; let set about 10 minutes. Then add remaining ingredients. Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Marguerites
instructions: Boil the sugar and water. Beat egg whites stiff and pour the frosting over them. Add the other ingredients. Pile the mixture on butter-thin crackers and brown in a very slow oven. Dainty and delicious.

title: Gallon Jug Refrigerator Bread
instructions: Heat milk to lukewarm and stir in yeast. Mix together flour soda and sugar. Add in the oil and the milk-yeast mixture. Stir together thoroughly using a nonmetal spoon. Put mixture in a wide mouth jar. (Sun tea jar will do.) Put in refrigerator loosely covered. After 3 1/2 hours stir down; put lid on jug. Dough is now ready to be used or can be kept in refrigerator up to 4 weeks. Bread can be made into rolls loaves or cinnamon rolls. After having enough flour worked in to be workable (no need for second rising) bake at 375\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: New Year'S Day Dip
instructions: Mix peas and tomatoes. Serve with Tostitos as they have just the right amount of salt.

title: Crescent Rolls
instructions: Put first 6 ingredients together and cool. Add one cup sifted flour to yeast mixture and 3 eggs; beat together well. Stir in 3 1/2 cups flour and make soft dough. Knead 5 minutes. Put in greased bowl and cover. Let rise 2 1/2 hours. Make 3 balls. Let stand 10 minutes. Roll each ball in 12-inch circle like pie. Brush with butter. Cut in 12 pieces like a pie. Start from bottom and turn up to make crescent shape. Put on greased sheet and brush with butter. Let rise 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until browned.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix sausage cheese and biscuit mix. Shape into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Best Biscuits
instructions: Put flour baking powder and sugar into mixing bowl. Stir with fork. Slowly add 1 to 1 1/2 cups cream stir constantly just until dough comes together. Place dough on floured board and knead for 1 minute. Put dough flat to 3/4-inch to 1-inch thick. Cut with 2-inch round cookie cutter or drinking glass. Brush both sides with melted butter. Place buttered biscuits 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 18 minutes until browned.

title: Quick Fruit Salad
instructions: Pour a large can of fruit cocktail in bowl; do not drain. Add all other fruits you like cutting them in small bite size pieces. Sprinkle the box of pudding over the fruit mixture and mix well.

title: E T'S Raspberry Cordial
instructions: Mix whiskey and raspberries together and let stand for 10 days in covered container. Strain and throw away raspberries. Bring sugar and water to a boil. Cool. Add to whiskey and then add lemon juice. Strain again and bottle. Doesnt need to be refrigerated.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients then add fruit cocktail and vanilla. Mix well and put in baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar and pecans on top. Bake 45 minutes at 300\u00b0 in glass dish.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Add pudding and milk then beat until smooth. Add Cool Whip and vanilla. Chill. Grind cookies in food processor. Layer cookies and cream mixture in a clean plastic flowerpot. End with cookies. Place an artificial flower in center of pot and serve with a clean garden shovel. Oreos will look like dirt. Peanut butter cookies will look like sand. If using peanut butter cookies then put in a clean plastic sandpail and use a sand shovel to serve with (plates can be small Frizbees).

title: Fish Florentine
instructions: Cook spinach in water to cover until tender 5 minutes at most. Remove from heat and drain thoroughly. Spread in bottom of buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon pepper. Spread fish fillets over spinach. Combine mayonnaise with lemon juice and salt; stir to mix well. Pour over fish and spinach to coat evenly. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 25 minutes until fish is done not dry. Serve hot with fresh lemon quarters.

title: Poppy Seed Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Mix together in large bowl all ingredients. Beat 2 minutes. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Blushing Apple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter and put in bottom of pans. Sprinkle brown sugar over the butter. Arrange apples on butter sugar coating.

title: Cherry Crisp Squares
instructions: Mix sugar flour oats and margarine together to make a crumb mixture. Spread half of mixture in the bottom of an 8-inch pan. Spread cherry pie filling in pan; add remaining crumb mixture over top of cherry filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. When cool serve with whipped topping or ice cream.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar and milk into a 5-quart kettle. Bring to boil and cook for 3 minutes then take from heat and stir in peanut butter. Add oats and vanilla (do fast). Spoon onto waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Chill rice in refrigerator. In wok or large skillet add 1 tablespoon of oil. When heated to 200\u00b0 add egg and scramble. Remove egg and set aside. Add 2 tablespoons back to skillet or wok and cook onion and garlic until cooked about 1 minute. Stir in shrimp and water chestnuts. Cook until shrimp curl and turn pink about 4 minutes. Stir in cold rice and soy sauce until well mixed then stir in egg. Stir constantly until hot. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets; peel and dice. Melt margarine and stir in flour. Add milk slowly stirring constantly. Stir in cheese. Put potatoes in a greased casserole. Pour sauce over them and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Beat sugar eggs and salt until creamy. Add Carnation milk cream and vanilla; beat low. Pour into cold freezer can. Add 2% milk to full line on can. Freeze.

title: Apple Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine bread dry milk baking powder baking soda and apple pie spice\tin blender. Blend until bread is crumbled. Add applesauce eggs and bran. Blend thoroughly. Stir in raisins. Spoon batter into nonstick muffin cups sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake for 25 minutes in preheated 375\u00b0 oven until golden brown. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Sticky Finger Chicken Wings
instructions: Simmer chicken wings in enough soy sauce to cover bottom of electric skillet until half done. Mix ginger and garlic with soy sauce after removing drummettes to cookie sheet. Add brown sugar to soy sauce mixture and bring to a boil. Pour over drummettes on cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Makes 60 wings.

title: Pa. Dutch Cole Slaw
instructions: Put cabbage and carrots through shredder. Mix remaining ingredients well and mix with shredded cabbage and carrots.

title: Barbecued Beef On A Bun
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except rolls) in a Dutch oven. Cover and simmer over low heat for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Shred by using fork.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach well drained. Squeeze with hands to remove water. Mix all ingredients 24 hours in advance. Refrigerate.

title: Oh Boy Waffles
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and sugar into a bowl. Put eggs milk and oil into a blender or mixer bowl. Beat liquid ingredients until smooth then add the sifted dry ingredients and combine well. Bake on a hot waffle iron.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Mix well and pour in a greased dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Chile Con Carne
instructions: Mix meat with seasonings and put in pot after shortening has been heated. Let it cook until done on a medium heat. Add 1 cup of water onion chopped bell pepper and tomato sauce also beans. Let this simmer for 10 minutes. A serving for 6.

title: Barbecue Sandwiches
instructions: Cook for 10 minutes and serve on buns.

title: Bavarian Cole Slaw
instructions: Toss sliced/shredded vegetables in bowl. In small saucepan bring to boiling vinegar sugar salt celery seed and dry mustard. Pour hot dressing over vegetables. Toss thoroughly. Cover and chill for 4 hours. Toss before serving.

title: Date Butterscotch Chews
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add brown sugar and heat slowly stirring constantly until blended. Cool slightly. Add egg and vanilla; mix. Sift flour with baking powder. Stir into mixture in pan blending thoroughly. Stir in dates and nuts. Spread in greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool. Cut into small bars. Roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Apricot Casserole
instructions: In a 2 quart deep casserole dish that has been greased with butter layer the above ingredients in the following order apricots brown sugar crackers and butter. Top layer should end with crackers and butter. When all the layering is done you should have 3 layers of apricots. Bake at 300 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter; remove from heat. Mix ingredients except onions using only half of the cheese. Place in casserole dish. Bake with lid on for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Layer with the other half of cheese. Top with 1/2 can Durkee fried onions.

title: Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Boil ribs for 10 minutes (no seasoning). Put into large pan. Sprinkle with seasoning. Slice bell peppers and onions over meat. Cover pan with foil; cook in oven for 45 minutes. Pour off juice and baste with barbecue sauce. Reheat under foil and enjoy.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Bake chicken breasts. Remove meat from bones and cut in small pieces. Mix chicken soups and sour cream. Spread chicken mixture in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Crush crackers and mix with melted margarine and poppy seed. Spread cracker mixture over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: English Cucumber Soup
instructions: Wash but do not peel cucumbers. Cut them into 1-inch chunks and puree along with remaining ingredients in a blender or food processor. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: 2-2-2 Casserole
instructions: Brown ground meat. Season to taste. Place half bag of crushed chips in bottom of pan. Mix together meat soup tomatoes and olives. Pour on top of crushed chips. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Top with remainder of crushed chips. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Top with sour cream and serve.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour salt and baking powder; set aside. Use an electric mixer to cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in eggs. Add flour mixture and mix on low speed until thoroughly combined. Stir in vanilla or lemon juice and zest. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and chill for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 325 degrees. On a floured surface roll dough to 1/8-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes and place on ungreased cookie sheets and refrigerate until firm 15 minutes. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until edges start to brown. Cool on wire racks; decorate as desired.

title: Lorna'S Russian Tea
instructions: Combine sugar water cloves and cinnamon in a saucepan. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer covered 20 minutes.

title: Cucumber Stick Pickles
instructions: Mix lime in 2 gallons of water. Pour over cucumbers and soak 24 hours. Rinse well. Slice onions and bell peppers. Cover with ice water. Let stand for 3 hours and drain. Combine vinegar sugar salt celery seed and pickling spice. Pour over cucumbers; let stand overnight. Bring to a boil for 20 minutes; put in jars and seal.

title: Cincinnati-Style Chili
instructions: Heat oil. Add onion. Cook stirring until tender. Add beef or turkey and cook until browned. Add chili powder cinnamon cumin allspice cloves bay leaf chocolate broth tomato sauce and vinegar. Stir to mix well. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours until thick stirring occasionally. Serve over spaghetti. Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese. Makes 8 servings.

title: Seashells And Mushrooms And Basil Cream Sauce
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. While pasta is cooking heat a nonstick skillet over high heat. Add mushrooms. Sprinkle with basil garlic powder and pepper. Cook 5 minutes or until mushrooms are tender stirring frequently.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and 1 stick of butter until crumbly. Pat in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass dish.

title: Vegetable Noodle Casserole
instructions: In a large bowl combine soup sour cream onion salt and pepper. Add the broccoli cauliflower noodles and 1/4 cup cheese; mix gently. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: S'More Pie
instructions: Prepare chocolate pudding mix. Stir in chocolate pieces until melted. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Pour into pie crust. Top with marshmallows. Refrigerate 8 hours.

title: Strawberry-Angel Food Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 1/2 cups boiling water. Stir in strawberries sugar and salt. Chill until mixture begins to thicken; fold in Dream Whip. Cover bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan with cake pieces. Pour mixture over cake. Refrigerate 4 to 5 hours to set. Yields 10 to 15 servings.

title: Double Chocolate Crinkle Tarts
instructions: Melt chocolate chips; cool to room temperature. Sift together flour and salt. Blend together shortening margarine and 1/4 cup melted chocolate. Mix in dry ingredients. Divide dough into 12 baking cups in a muffin tin and press evenly around. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool.

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. I like to use more onion and garlic salt.

title: Mushroom Sauerkraut Soup
instructions: Soak dried mushrooms in cold water for 2 hours. Drain and cut into small pieces. Add with the water sauerkraut juice and onion; cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Add potatoes brown flour in oil. Stir constantly or the flour will scorch. Add about a cup of the soup to the flour mixture and stir constantly to make zaprashka add to the soup. Cook slowly for another 2 to 4 minutes.

title: Bacon And Cheese Toast Bars
instructions: Combine egg mayonnaise cheese Worcestershire sauce dry mustard pepper and hot sauce in a bowl; mix well. Stir in bacon. Trim crusts from bread; toast lightly on both sides. Spread toast evenly with cheese mixture. Cut each slice into 3 strips. Sprinkle with paprika. Place on a baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Yield 24 bars.

title: Uncle Dan'S Popcorn Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine popcorn shoestring potato stix and nuts in large roasting pan. Set aside. Combine butter dill Worcestershire sauce lemon pepper garlic powder onion powder and red hot sauce in small bowl; pour over popcorn mixture stirring until evenly coated. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Stirring once. Cool completely; store in air tight container.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients. Beat with hand mixer until smooth. Place in buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients and cool slightly until thick but not solid. Add rest of ingredients. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Salmon-Asparagus Divan
instructions: Drain salmon reserving liquid. Break into chunks. Saute mushrooms in butter. Blend in flour. Add half and half and reserved salmon liquid. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened. Add seasonings Parmesan cheese and salmon. Heat gently. Spoon over hot cooked asparagus. Garnish with toast triangles. Makes 6 servings.

title: Indian Succotash
instructions: Combine ingredients season and heat. Makes 6 servings.

title: Soft Clay
instructions: Mix flour salt and alum together in a bowl. Add oil and colored hot water. Mix everything until it is cool enough for you to use. If clay dries out wrap in a damp cloth put in a plastic bag and let stand for a couple of days.

title: Irish Potatoes Glorious
instructions: Peel wash and cut potatoes in rings. Put 2 tablespoons of butter in skillet. Cover the skillet with rings of potatoes and lightly brown the rings on one side.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and margarine with sugar. Cream well. Add eggs one at a time. Beat after each one. Add flour milk and flavoring all at once. Beat batter until smooth. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Start in cold oven.

title: Pear Salad
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender; blend thoroughly. Pour into bowl. Cover with miniature marshmallows and refrigerate until set.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook the chicken until tender drain and cut into bite-size pieces. Set aside. Cook broccoli until tender-crisp and place in buttered casserole dish. Scatter chicken over the broccoli. Mix the soup with mayonnaise and lemon juice and spread over chicken. Mix melted butter with the bread crumbs. Spread grated cheese over soup mixture and top all with the buttered crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 in covered dish.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water. Add the frozen strawberries; stir occasionally until thawed. Add the pineapple and bananas. Pour half into 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill firm. Spread evenly with the sour cream. Pour remaining gelatin on top. Chill firm.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Make up dough. Separate into 2 halves for crust and topping. Combine ingredients on top of crust alternating starting with pizza sauce. Cover with remaining dough. Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until dough is done.

title: Curried Chicken
instructions: In a large pan saute apple onion garlic and curry powder in butter until tender. Gradually add flour then cream and bouillon. Cook and stir until sauce boils for about 1 minute. Add seasonings and chicken; cook for 10 minutes. Serve on a bed of rice (about 3 to 4 cups).

title: Nutritious French Fries
instructions: Clean and boil potatoes for 20 minutes. Peel and shape into French fries. Then place on cookie sheet slightly sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle with sea salt. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 50 minutes. Turn after 25 minutes with a spatula.

title: Grandmother'S Dressing
instructions: Mix together and put in greased baking dish. Bake until golden brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Popovers
instructions: Beat eggs; add milk then flour sifted with salt. Add shortening and beat smooth with eggbeater.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and cookie sheets to 375\u00b0. Boil sweet potatoes in water until easily pierced by fork. Cool slightly. Place cooked and peeled potatoes in large mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer until smooth. Stir in butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in spices salt and evaporated milk. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake on preheated cookie sheet near center of oven for 70 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack to insure a crispy pie shell when cooled.

title: Rocks
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and soda and mix well. Add salt and flour and mix. Add nuts and raisins or dates. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10-12 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Quick Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat in large skillet or heavy pot; pour off any fat. Add onion tomato juice mushrooms water and seasonings. Cook until boiling; cover and\tsimmer\tuntil at least half the liquid has evaporated. Add noodles and simmer until almost dry.\tStir in sour cream and heat a short time over low heat;\tdo not boil.

title: French Meringue Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add vinegar and continue beating. Slowly pour in sugar while beating. Add the chocolate chips (mini chips are better). Drop by teaspoons on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and serve.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut cookie dough into 1/8 inch slices. Arrange cookie slices slightly overlapping on aluminum foil covered 14 inch pizza pan press edges to seal. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool remove from foil onto serving plate. Combine cream cheese milk sugar and vanilla until well blended. Spread over crust. Arrange fruit on cream cheese mixture. Glaze with combination of apricot preserves water and strawberry extract. Cut into wedges.

title: Chocolate Clusters
instructions: Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beer Rolls
instructions: Mix together put into greased muffin pans. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Seven Layer Cookies(From 1975 Edition)
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 12-inch pan. Spread one layer of ingredients as listed. Pour milk on top. Pat mixture down. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes and cool before cutting.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into a ball. Refrigerate to cause firmness and serve with crackers.

title: Manhattan Clam Chowder
instructions: Dice vegetables and saute in butter; add flour and stir thoroughly. Add clams. Gradually add water and let mixture come to a boil. Add potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes. Add tomatoes catsup spices and let simmer for additional 30 minutes or until done.

title: Missionettes Taco Soup
instructions: Brown and simmer ground beef or chicken with the taco seasoning. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until you are ready to serve. (This can be done in a crock-pot.)

title: Four Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans and mix together. Mix ingredients together. Store in large jar or Tupperware sealed airtight. Refrigerate. Keeps 10 days. Serve on lettuce leaf or with cooked pasta as a salad.

title: Chicken Quiche Amandine
instructions: Place chicken and almonds in pie shell then Swiss cheese. Beat eggs slightly in medium bowl. Blend in milk salt mace and pepper. Pour over cheese. Sprinkle on Parmesan cheese. Bake in a preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Tomatoes With Corn Pudding
instructions: Core tomatoes. Scoop out seeds and pulp. Sprinkle shells with salt and pepper. Invert on paper towels and drain 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fudge Or Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla together thoroughly. Stir over low heat until chocolate and margarine are melted. Then stirring constantly bring rapidly to a full boil. Boil to 220\u00b0 or until a small amount forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.

title: Crispy Coconut Balls
instructions: Melt butter add marshmallows. Stir in cereal. Roll in coconut.

title: Apple Streusel Cobbler
instructions: Spread apple filling in buttered 9-inch square baking pan. In bowl beat eggs. Add condensed milk melted margarine cinnamon and nutmeg; mix well. Pour over apples. In a bowl combine sugar and flour; cut in cold margarine until crumbly. Add nuts and oats. Sprinkle over custard. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool. Serve warm with ice cream if desired.

title: Juicy Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with aluminum foil. Mix cereal salt and pepper. Dip chicken in milk; roll in cereal salt and pepper mixture until well coated. Place chicken skin side up in pan. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake until chicken is done about 1 hour. Do not turn chicken.

title: Springerle Cookies
instructions: Mix all together and chill overnight. Roll out and cut. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour then bake for about 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a large bowl beat milk and peanut butter until smooth. Add Bisquick mix and vanilla; mix well. Shape into balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet; flatten with fork. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Peel core and slice apples. Set aside. Cream butter eggs and sugar. Gradually mix in the rest of the ingredients adding apples last. Can sprinkle additional cinnamon on top. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Best when served warm with milk. No icing needed.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare instant rice before mixing. Add other ingredients to rice. Mix well and place in ungreased baking dish. May add more cracker crumbs mixed with melted butter on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Tapioca Pudding
instructions: Combine eggs milk sugar tapioca and salt together in saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Stir in vanilla; cool.

title: Indian Corn Stew
instructions: Saute onions and pepper with butter for 5 minutes. Add ground beef and brown. Add corn sugar salt and tomatoes; simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in blended flour and water; cook for 15 minutes. Serve with salad corn muffins and mixed fruit.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer on top of stove for 20 minutes.

title: Microwave Pecan Or Peanut Brittle
instructions: Place sugar syrup butter in a microwave safe 2-quart bowl. (Ive found 2-quart Pyrex measuring cup great.) DO NOT STIR!! Place in microwave on High for 5 minutes. Take out and stir in paraffin wax square. Then stir in desired nuts. Cook on High for 6 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir in 2 teaspoons baking soda. Pour into pans sprayed with Pam. (If microwave is slow you may have to cook a little longer.)

title: Rigatoni Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix vinegar sugar and spices together. Cook rinse and cool pasta. Mix all together. Put cucumber and onion slices on top. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours. Stir before serving.

title: Mashed Potato Bake
instructions: Cook drain and mash potatoes. Add remaining ingredients and beat until fluffy. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Corn Bread And Sausage Stuffing
instructions: In a large skillet melt butter. Add onion celery and bell pepper; saute 5 minutes. Stir in poultry seasoning thyme and garlic powder. Combine corn bread vegetable mixture and sausage. Add broth; toss gently. Spoon into 13x9-inch baking dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with turkey gravy if desired.

title: Corn Bread Pie
instructions: Brown beef and onion in large skillet. Add soup water seasonings corn and green pepper. Mix and simmer 15 minutes. Fill greased baking dish 3/4 full with mixture leaving room for corn bread topping.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Mix together thoroughly margarine sugar and eggs. Add sour cream. Sift flour salt and baking powder together and add to cream mixture. Add vanilla. Mix powdered sugar nuts and cinnamon together and set aside. Pour half batter into lightly greased Bundt pan and sprinkle with half nut mixture. Add remaining batter and sprinkle nuts on top. Increase oven temperature to 350 degrees. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes. Let cool. Invert onto dish. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken In Phyllo Dough
instructions: Flatten the chicken breast halves between sheets of plastic wrap until they are 1/4-inch thick. In a bowl combine the cheeses pepper parsley tarragon and 8 tablespoons butter cut into bits. Form the mixture into eight 3-inch oval patties. Arrange 1 patty on each of the chicken breasts and roll up tucking in the sides to enclose the filling completely. Brush 1 sheet of the phyllo with some of the remaining butter melted and cooled and top it with another sheet. Brush the sheet with the butter and arrange 1 of the chicken rolls in the center of a short side. Roll the phyllo tucking in the sides to enclose the chicken completely; put the package in a baking dish and brush it with butter. Make other packages with the remaining phyllo butter and chicken rolls in the same manner and bake the packages in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven basting them with the pan juices occasionally for 40 minutes or until they are golden.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix well. Store in airtight container. Add 4 or 5 spoonfuls to each cup of boiling water. Top with mini marshmallows.

title: Almond Delights
instructions: Combine ingredients in order. Drop by teaspoon on prepared cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Crust Mix well the flour butter and nuts. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let cool.
