title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together in mixing bowl. Add buttermilk vanilla nutmeg and beaten eggs. Mix well. Pour into an unbaked pie crust and bake 50 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chocolate Covered Nougats
instructions: Mix condensed milk 4x sugar butter vanilla and nuts; chill thoroughly. Roll into small balls. Melt paraffin in a double boiler first. Add chocolate and melt. Beat until smooth. Dip balls into mixture until coated on all sides. Drop on wax paper.

title: Buttercream Icing
instructions: Mix together milk and flour; cook over very low heat until thickened. Let cool. Take butter and sugar and cream until fluffy then add the cooled milk and flour mixture and beat until smooth and creamy. Add vanilla (can use lemon juice and yellow food coloring for a change); blend again.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Bring broccoli and rice to a boil. Saute margarine and onion. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Dish
instructions: Layer in baking dish in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Swiss Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper. Top each chicken breast with cheese slice.

title: Travie'S Special
instructions: Melt some carob chips. Put a little peanut butter on animal crackers. Dip in melted carob and enjoy.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Place all ingredients except ham and cheese in blender. Blend well. Pour into a 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with ham and cheese over top. Press gently below surface with back of spoon. The pie pan will be extremely full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let set ten minutes before cutting.

title: Sis' Pie Crust
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together well with a pastry cutter. Add ice water; mix thoroughly to make dough. Divide dough in half. Roll on floured surface to desired size.

title: Dressing For Potato Salad
instructions: Bring vinegar water sugar mustard salt and pepper to a boil. Remove from heat and cool. Beat eggs and fold into mixture. Cook until thick like pudding. While still hot stir in salad dressing. Can use with hot or cold potatoes.

title: Orange Candy
instructions: Put 1 cup of sugar into a heavy frying pan and stir with a wooden spoon over medium heat until the sugar is melted and caramelized to a golden brown color. Add the water and stir until the sugar completely redissolves. Add the remaining 2 cups sugar evaporated milk and salt. Place over low heat and stir until the mixture begins to boil. Cook stirring frequently until it reaches the soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm without stirring. Add the orange peel and nuts. Beat until the candy loses its gloss and will holds its shape when dropped from a spoon. Pour into a lightly buttered 8-inch square pan and cool until set. Cut into squares before candy becomes too firm.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until thick. Stir constantly then cool. Add mixture to drained cherries and sliced bananas.

title: Nutty Apricot Snack Loaf
instructions: Soak apricots in warm water for 15 minutes. Drain cut in pieces. Sift flour baking powder salt and soda together. Cream shortening; add gradually sugar creaming well. Blend in egg. Beat well and add water that the apricots were soaked in and orange juice. Mix well. Blend in sifted dry ingredients. Fold in walnuts and apricots.

title: Cheese Buttons
instructions: Allow margarine to soften at room temperature. Combine with other ingredients and mix thoroughly. Roll into balls the size of a small marble. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Will be about the size of a quarter. Bake at 325\u00b0 until light tan about 18 minutes.

title: Date Bars
instructions: Mix first six ingredients into fine crumbs. Press half of mixture into a 9x13 greased pan. Boil dates sugar and water until soft. Cool. Pour over top of crumb crust. Sprinkle remaining crumb mixture over the top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Combine chocolate and milk in double boiler. Heat over hot water until chocolate melts; stir to blend. Remove from stove and add powdered sugar and nuts. Cool slightly. Form into balls; roll in coconut. Makes 25 balls.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cheese until light and fluffy. Add milk; blend thoroughly. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Top with pie filling just before eating.

title: Peaches 'N' Cream
instructions: Mix Bisquick egg margarine and milk. Pour into a greased pie pan. Place peaches on top of batter. Mix cream cheese sugar and peach juice; beat for 2 minutes and spoon on top of peaches (not to edge). Mix and sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Noodles
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt into a mixing bowl. Place beaten eggs into a cup and fill cup with cream or canned milk. Make a well in flour and pour in egg mixture. Mix with fork until dough forms a ball and sticks to the fork. Divide dough into 2 parts and enough flour to roll out. Cut into desired size and drop into boiling water. Stir often and cook uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Marvalyn'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak bread with milk combine all ingredients and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Mix and bake yellow cake. Let cool. Cut in small squares. Place in bottom of punch bowl. Layer with strawberry glaze fresh strawberries and crushed pineapple. Top with Cool Whip. Repeat until punch bowl is full.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Stir in egg; mix until smooth. Stir in molasses and milk. Stir in dry ingredients. Chill dough. Roll into balls 1-inch in diameter. Roll balls in sugar. Place two inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Shrimp Supreme
instructions: Cream butter and flour. Add milk; make a thick cream sauce. Add Worcestershire sauce catsup bay leaf red pepper and lemon juice. Salt and pepper to taste. Add cooked shrimp; allow to get very hot. Serve in a ring of ice. Serves 6.

title: Mimi'S Easy Six-Layer Bars(Makes 48 Pieces)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 9 x 13-inch pan melt margarine by warming oven and watching. Remove when melted and sprinkle with graham crackers then in order layer coconut and chips. Drizzle condensed milk throughout. Add chopped nuts. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove and cut when slightly warm into 48 squares. Also great with butterscotch chips and slivered almonds.

title: Butter Bran Bread
instructions: Mix together and let cool until lukewarm. Dissolve 2 packages yeast in 1 cup warm water. Add 2 or 3 cups whole wheat flour; mix well. Add 1/2 of 5 or 6 cups white flour. Mix well and add rest of flour. Makes 2 (2 pound) loaves.

title: Zucchini Casserole(New To Us)
instructions: Cook whole squash 5 minutes in salted water. Cool and slice thin; sprinkle with salt (if you like). Mix yolks sour cream and flour; fold into whites then mix with squash. In a 12 x 7 x 2-inch dish layer 1/2 the squash mix with 1/2 of the cheese and 1/2 of the bacon. Repeat and cover with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and pour juice into a saucepan. Mix pineapple with marshmallows and set aside. In saucepan add juice flour sugar egg and vinegar. Cook until thickened. Cool. Mix well with Cool Whip and juice mixture. Fold in marshmallows and pineapple. Add diced apples and peanuts. Taste best if made ahead of time.

title: Thanksgiving Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and applesauce. Sift together flour soda cinnamon cloves nutmeg and salt and stir into shortening mixture. Add nuts raisins and cut up candy. Pour into greased tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet or wok. Add meat (cut in thin strips or small pieces) garlic onion salt pepper sugar and soy sauce. Stir-fry until meat is tender and hot about 1 to 2 minutes. Add rice. Stir-fry 5 minutes. Add peas and carrots. Stir well into rice-meat mixture. Push rice-meat mixture to sides of skillet or wok; add beaten eggs and cook briefly before stirring through rice-meat mixture. Continue to stir until eggs are completely cooked. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Swiss Mocha
instructions: Combine; sift and store in airtight container.

title: Stir-Fry Cabbage
instructions: Heat oil in a large heavy skillet. Add cabbage and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Add pepper and stir 5 more minutes. Reduce heat; cover and continue cooking 5 minutes longer. Add sugar vinegar and seed and continue cooking and stirring 2 to 3 additional minutes until heated. Nice to serve with pork or corned beef.

title: Potato Basque Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan brown sausage over medium heat. Add onion and cook 5 minutes. Add rest of ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 6.

title: Asparagus Rolls
instructions: Trim crusts from bread slices; spread each with cheese. Cook asparagus until just tender. Chill. Lay one piece asparagus diagonally across slice of bread. Turn opposite corners over asparagus overlapping. Press firmly to seal. Wrap several sandwiches together in waxed paper. Place in covered container and chill for several hours.

title: Lemon Mousse
instructions: Add beaten egg yolks to hot water and beat until foamy. Add superfine sugar until dissolved. Then add lemon juice and zest. Dissolve plain gelatin in cold water then heat to dissolve completely. Add the gelatin mixture to the egg yolk mixture blending gently. Place in the refrigerator and let set (not fully). Add the whipped egg whites and whipped cream by folding into the lemon/gelatin mixture that is not yet fully set. Let set fully and then serve garnished with whipped cream.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix ingredients together and empty in pie shell. Cook at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Manwich Pizza
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Mix with Manwich sauce. In a 9 x 13-inch pan place biscuits and press together until bottom is covered. (This may take a few minutes.) Cover with ground beef mixture and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Pound flour into steak. Brown in hot oil. Add tomatoes onion and celery. Cover and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven at 300\u00b0 until tender (2 to 2 1/2 hours) uncovering the last 1/2 hour to cook down sauce to a rich thickness.

title: Angel Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside. Stir flour sugar and baking soda together. Cut in shortening until size of peas. Mix buttermilk with yeast-water. Add to flour mixture. Stir until moistened. May now be covered and refrigerated overnight to be shaped and baked later.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix flour and margarine or butter until its crumbly. Add nuts. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden (about 12 minutes). Let cool then add layers one at a time.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix grape jam and chili sauce in large heavy pan. Roll meat into very small meatballs. Cook in sauce for 1 hour. Serve hot over rice or serve with toothpicks for party.

title: Setting Sun Summer Cooler
instructions: Spoon grenadine evenly into 2 glasses. Combine juice and soda; pour gently into glass. Serves 2.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Press cookie dough firmly into the bottom of a pizza pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 10 to 13 minutes (or until brown).

title: Cabbage Au Gratin
instructions: Boil cabbage for 5 minutes in water. Drain well. Combine butter salt and flour in saucepan. Cook over low heat; stir constantly until bubbly. Gradually add milk; cook stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Add cheese to white sauce and pour over cabbage. Sprinkle bread crumbs and butter over cabbage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Pound chicken until 1/4-inch thick. Cut butter lengthwise into 4 sections. Place one piece of butter at narrow end of chicken breast. Sprinkle with parsley and onion salt. Roll up in jelly-roll fashion starting at butter end. Dip in beaten egg. Then dip in bread crumbs. Refrigerate 1/2 to 1 hour. Place in baking dish. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken In A Basket
instructions: Brown chicken in olive oil and butter and garlic when browned. Add rosemary salt and pepper. Cook 4 to 5 minutes on low. Remove chicken and saute mushrooms. Deglaze pan with sherry and add green olives (as many as you like). Add chopped parsley. Hollow out round bread and slightly toast in oven with butter and garlic. Put chicken with mushrooms and olives in bread. Pour sauce over this. Wrap tightly in foil. Bake for 20 minutes at 375\u00b0 and serve.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix thoroughly. Chill. Serve with assorted raw vegetables. Looks pretty in a hollowed out purple cabbage.

title: Sangria
instructions: Pour wine over cut up fruits and soak for 2 to 3 hours (chilled). Add orange juice and club soda and Cointreau. Chill and serve.

title: Crab And Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients except 2 cups cheese together. Consistency should be like tuna salad; add more mayonnaise if too dry. Put in large casserole dish top with remaining 2 cups cheese and bake for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 6.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Place rice in baking dish. Pour undiluted French onion soup in and mix well. Place chicken on top; pour mushroom soup (prepared according to can) over top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Roast Ala Grecque
instructions: Cut off root ends and a thin slice from stem ends of onions. Peel and rinse; slice thinly and set aside. Wipe meat with a damp cloth. Coat evenly with a mixture of the paprika salt and pepper. Heat fat in saucepan or Dutch oven with a tight fitting cover. Brown meat on all sides slowly over medium heat. Lift meat. Layer the onions into the pot and place meat over onions. Cover tightly. Cook over low heat for about 3 hours or until meat is tender. Makes a delicious gravy that is served over rice or mashed potatoes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water; add frozen strawberries juice and all. Add bananas and pineapple juice and all. Put 1/2 of mixture in dish and let set. Spread with sour cream and add rest of mixture.

title: Yellow Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed on box. Add rhubarb and sugar. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour whipping cream over top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for at least 55 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Peel the potatoes and then slice them thin. Make a white sauce out of the butter flour and milk. Put half of the potatoes in a greased 2-quart casserole; cover with half of the sauce salt pepper and onion. Add the remaining sauce. Cover and bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking until top is browned.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350 degrees for hour. May top with pecans.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat cream cheese and milk until smooth. Blend in 1/2 cup nuts and remaining ingredients. Shape into one large or two smaller balls. Roll in remaining nuts. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate. Keeps several weeks so can be made in advance.

title: Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix eggs cheese and sugar. Pour over mixture in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Almond Macaroons
instructions: Mix ground nuts sugar and unbeaten egg whites together. Cook over moderate heat stirring constantly for about 8 to 10 minutes; dont boil mixture. A good test is to pull a knife through batter if both sides stay clean the batter has reached the right stage of thickness. Remove from heat. Add extract.

title: Cashew Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Brown meat and onion with salt and pepper. Add meat to noodles; discard any grease in pan. Saute mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter until lightly browned; add mixture. Also add celery and olives milk and soup. Mix and put in casserole. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Then put chow mein noodles and nuts over top. Bake uncovered for another 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into 8-inch square pan. Whip milk into Dream Whip. Add cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Spread over graham cracker crust. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cook and cool the carrots. Mix carrots with onion and green pepper. Stir together remaining ingredients and add to vegetables. Let stand in refrigerator before serving.

title: Candied Yams
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes up; put in pan with water on stove. Turn heat to medium high; cook for 15 minutes. Add sugar margarine and cinnamon; cook until juice thickens.

title: Grandma Annie'S Cookie Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a cookie sheet that has a 3/4 to 1 inch edge around it. Mix flour and baking powder together - set aside. Mix margarine sugar milk vanilla. Mix in eggs one at a time. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture - blend thoroughly. Stir in chips. Spread mixture in cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes. Cut into squares like brownies.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Stir together the ingredients and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until brown and firm (about 45 minutes). This pie is easy to make and is similar to a pecan pie.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving with your favorite raw vegetables. (Also good with wheat and rye bread or crackers.)

title: Chicken Pineapple Spread
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve liquid. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Thin mixture to desired consistency with pineapple juice. Spread on crackers or toast squares.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and roll in chopped pecans. Makes 2 balls.

title: 7 Layer Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes on a greased sheet pan. With hand mixer combine cream cheese vanilla pudding and milk until thickened then spread over cooled cake.

title: Russian Salad
instructions: Mix jello water cream cheese and marshmallows in pan. Cook over low flame until dissolved. Set aside to cool. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Won Tons
instructions: Mix cream cheese crab and onions. Place in wrap fold and fry until crisp. (Fold in triangle.)

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter and pour over cereal. Stir until well coated. Let cool. Place in box tin or bag with confectioners sugar and toss.

title: Sesame-Ginger Chicken
instructions: Combine sesame seeds grated ginger honey and soy sauce in a bowl. Flatten chicken between plastic wrap using a mallet. Coat grill rack with cooking spray. Cook for 4 minutes on each side. Baste frequently with sauce. (May also be used as a marinade. Marinate for a few hours and then cook on grill. Dont marinate overnight; it will be very strong!)

title: Banana Oat Bread
instructions: Cream butter gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine dry ingredients add to creamed mixture alternating with milk and mashed banana beginning and ending with flour mixture. Fold in oats raisins and nuts. Spoon batter into two greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes then remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Wash zucchini and cut off ends. Cut into 1/4-inch slices. Place slices in saucepan and cover with water. Add lemon juice and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer for 1 minute. Drain. Combine with ham that is cut into strips. Add parsley nuts garlic powder salt and pepper. Spread into buttered pan. In bowl combine half and half eggs and cheese. Mix and pour over zucchini. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Giblet Gravy
instructions: Remove liver and set aside. In a saucepan place the giblets and neck in lightly salted water to cover; add a few celery leaves and onion slices if desired. Cover; simmer for 1 hour or until tender. Add the liver; simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until tender (turkey livers will take 20 to 30 minutes). Remove and chop the cooked giblets. Discard neck.

title: Cereal Snack
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix first 4 ingredients in ungreased jelly roll pan. Heat margarine and honey until melted. Stir in cinnamon and salt. Pour over cereal mixture and toss until coated. Bake for 15 minutes stirring once. Stir in coconut; let stand for 5 minutes. Loosen from pan. Sprinkle with additional salt if desired.

title: Cream Cheese And Chutney
instructions: Blend together and serve with sesame crackers.

title: California Cheese Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes onion and bouillon in water for 20 minutes. Add cream of chicken soup California Blend vegetables and mushrooms. Simmer 30 minutes on very low heat. Add Velveeta cheese stirring constantly. Serves 6.

title: Mixed Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine broth potato and carrots in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Cook 5 minutes or until cabbage is crisp/tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Jello Poke Cake
instructions: Prepare cake batter as directed on package. Pour into well-greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool cake in pan 15 minutes then pierce with utility fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Meanwhile dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cold water and carefully pour over cake. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Cover with Cool Whip and garnish with fruit if desired.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook potatoes and onions. Add corn and milk. Season to taste. Simmer 30 minutes.

title: Chalupa Dip
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Layer as follows refried beans and avocados mashed with the juice of lime; salt and picante to taste (2 1/2 cups of this mixture are needed). Mix sour cream with mayonnaise and add then layer black olives green onions tomatoes and grated cheese.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute chopped onion in butter until limp. Add flour and blend until brown. Add tomatoes minced pepper celery bay leaf Worcestershire sauce sugar and salt. Cover and cook over low heat until thickened. Add shrimp to sauce and simmer 20 minutes. Serve with fluffy rice. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Herbed Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Combine 3/4 cup of cold water flour bouillon granules salt basil and oregano. In a large skillet or wok stir-fry onion and garlic in hot oil until tender. Remove. Stir-fry chicken half at a time for 3 to 4 minutes adding more oil if needed. Remove chicken from skillet or wok. Add zucchini and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Add bouillon mixture and tomatoes; cook and stir until bubbly. Add chicken and onion. Cook 1 minute more. Serve with rice or chow mein noodles.

title: No-Bake Date Cookies
instructions: In a blender add 1 cup of coconut; cover and turn on low speed until chopped. Empty onto sheet of waxed paper. Repeat with the remaining cup of coconut; set aside. Put walnuts in blender cover and run on low speed until chopped. Empty into bowl. Put eggs sugar and salt in the blender; cover and turn on high speed for 2 minutes. Add dates; cover and turn on high speed until dates are chopped. Pour into a large heavy skillet; cook over low heat stirring constantly for 10 minutes. Remove from heat; add Rice Krispies chopped walnuts and vanilla. When cool enough to handle pinch off portions and with dampened hands form into 1-inch balls. Roll in chopped coconut. Yields 4 dozen cookies.

title: Mom'S Style Beenie Weenies
instructions: Slice hot dogs and fry with onions. Do not brown. Add pork and beans brown sugar ketchup mustard and Worcestershire sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Mix sour cream soup and mushrooms. Place chopped turkey in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan and pour mixture over. Crumble crackers over top. Melt butter and pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crackers are browned (about 30 minutes).

title: No Name-No Sugar Cake
instructions: Boil dates and prunes in the water 3 minutes. Add margarine and raisins. Cool. Mix flour soda salt spices and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender. Place half and half and water in the top of a double boiler. Add cheese salt and pepper. Heat until cheese is melted. Add broccoli. Mix cornstarch and water in small bowl. Stir into cheese. Crumble bacon and sprinkle on top. Serve warm.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and pour into dish.

title: Chocolate Brownie Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix the crushed pineapple marshmallows and instant pudding well. Stir in Cool Whip.

title: Linkrens Kage(Norwegian Pound Cake)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs then sour cream. Sift if you wish remaining ingredients together and add. Bake in 2 greased loaf pans approximately 45 minutes until golden. Stand in pans until cool remove and wrap in foil to store.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Melt margarine in a skillet. Saute onion green pepper and garlic 3 minutes. Add lemon juice parsley and lemon pepper and stir 3 minutes. Add and toss fettuccine and shrimp until it is heated through.

title: Georgia Peanut Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with sugar and peanut butter. Add vanilla and egg beating until fluffy. Stir in baking soda and salt. Blend in flour. Mix until a stiff dough forms. Shape into walnut-sized balls. Place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Press with fork crisscross to flatten. Sprinkle with peanuts if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Creamy Spam And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Spray 2 quart casserole with cooking spray. Cook macaroni. Combine macaroni broccoli and Spam in sauce pan. Combine milk cornstarch and pepper. Bring to a boil; cook until thickened. Add cheese; stir until melted. Mix sauce with macaroni broccoli and Spam; spread in pan. Combine bread crumbs and margarine. Sprinkle on top. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Sift flour soda salt baking powder and cinnamon together. Beat sugar oil and eggs in mixer bowl until frothy. Add flour mixture; beat well. Stir in pumpkin and 1 cup pecans. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in 9 x 13 Pyrex bowl. Press into bottom of bowl and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool completely before adding filling.

title: No Peek Beef Stew
instructions: Arrange meat in bottom of pan. Cut vegetables into good sized chunks. Layer vegetables on top of meat. Mix tomato sauce with 1 cup water 1 teaspoon sugar salt and pepper to taste and 3 tablespoons tapioca. Mix well and pour over meat and vegetable mixture. Seal with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours. Dont look!

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
instructions: Cut cucumbers lengthwise and place in jars. Boil solution for five minutes and pour over pickles in jars. Seal tight and put in boiling water bath for 5 minutes. Makes 6 pints.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Whip egg yolks. Blend in the salt sugar flour and milk. Fold in the whipped egg whites (quite stiff but not dry). Fry the pancakes until they are light brown on both sides.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash in water to cover; add 1/4 teaspoon salt if desired. Combine drained squash with soup onion egg and cheese. Pour into greased baking dish and sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes or until browned in preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Apple Crisp(Serves 1)
instructions: In a small bowl combine apple and crumbled Melba toast. Mix diet sweetener and cinnamon. Add to apple mixture. To make cream combine Hi-Energy Vanilla Supplement and water. Pour over apple mixture.

title: Hot Beans
instructions: Cook together the first 3 ingredients until sausage browns. In a large bowl mix remaining ingredients. Pour all ingredients in a large baking dish except bacon. Spread bacon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Katsu
instructions: Debone chicken thighs. Place in bowl; add sake and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for about 10 to 15 minutes. In a separate bowl beat 1 to 2 eggs and add salt and pepper to taste. Dip chicken thighs into egg batter then roll in panko flakes and deep fry in hot oil. Cut into bite size strips and serve with tonkatsu sauce if desired. Makes about 3 to 4 servings.

title: Toni Mazzetti
instructions: Cut meat into small pieces and fry until brown. Simmer. Dont forget salt and pepper. Dice vegetables and simmer until done. Add to meat and simmer. Cook noodles and drain. Salt noodles before cooking. Mix all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Spiced Peaches
instructions: Drain peaches and save some syrup. Combine syrup vinegar and spices. Bring to a boil. Simmer about 10 minutes. Pour mixture over peaches and let cool. Store in refrigerator.

title: Multi-Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef bacon and onion in skillet; drain. Add all ingredients into a casserole dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Livers
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup margarine in heavy saucepan. Add onion and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes. Add rice and stir until rice just begins to brown. Stir in boiling broth. Remove from heat and let stand covered for 10 minutes. Add a little more broth if mixture is too dry. Saute livers in remaining margarine after dusting them with flour until done. Add seasoning. Stir gently into rice mixture.

title: Marinated Baked Or Grilled Chicken
instructions: In 8-inch square glass dish stir together salad dressing lemon juice honey Worcestershire sauce and paprika.

title: Fruited Turkey Salad
instructions: Mix the turkey grapes celery onions oranges and water chestnuts. In a separate bowl mix yogurt and soy sauce then pour over turkey mixture. Toss then cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Cranberry Chicken With Walnuts
instructions: Combine chicken celery cranberries walnuts soup mayonnaise rice onion and eggs.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Heat Cheddar cheese soup and milk at medium heat in saucepan until smooth. Slice potatoes and onion thin. Layer potatoes and onion in casserole dish. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes and onion. Add salt and pepper to taste. Dot with butter. Sprinkle paprika over cheese sauce and butter. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Grandmother Hogan'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix ingredients in order listed. Roll dough to desired thickness and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread hash brown potatoes in 13 x 9 pan. Combine and heat the butter onion soup sour cream cheese salt and pepper in saucepan until well mixed. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Old Fashioned Icebox Cookies
instructions: Mix all together. Form into rolls and refrigerate or freeze until ready to bake. May add nuts or raisins.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar; add well beaten eggs. Add prunes water and milk. Add flour to mixture to which nuts have been added. Bake in slow oven for 1 hour.

title: Mary'S Chicken
instructions: Thoroughly wash chicken and remove skin. In a large kettle cover bottom with oil; sprinkle parsley flakes to cover bottom; sprinkle garlic salt dash of pepper salt and oregano. Place chicken on high heat for 1 minute. Turn over then high heat for 1 minute. Put on lowest heat cover and simmer for 1 hour turning every 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Earl'S Meat Gravy
instructions: Coat or roll chicken or squirrel in flour. Use 10-inch frying pan. Melt shortening. Place meat in pan. Sprinkle on salt and pepper. Cook covered turning occasionally until tender and brown. Remove from pan.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit except strawberries and mix fruit with dry instant pudding. Let set overnight. Before serving slice 2 bananas. Mix well and serve.

title: Lettuce-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer as listed in large flat-bottomed bowl. Seal and refrigerate overnight. Toss before serving.

title: Flank Steak
instructions: Slice steak on the diagonal (1/2-inch thick). Marinade overnight. Do not use an aluminum pan. Place steak on skewers alternating with onion. Cook 20 to 25 minutes over hot coals.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Put the meat onion and fat in a saucepan. Stir and cook until the meat has lost its red color and has browned slightly.

title: Cinnamon Candy Punch
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a small saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 5 minutes or until candies melt stirring occasionally. Cool completely (about 1 hour).

title: 5 Layer Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Crush wafers and put in the bottom of 9-inch square pan. Cream together butter sugar and eggs. Spread evenly over crushed wafers in pan. Add sliced strawberries to form third layer. Top strawberry layer with Cool Whip. Sprinkle crushed wafers on top of Cool Whip. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Vinegar Pie
instructions: Mix flour with 1/2 cup sugar. Add water gradually and cook on top of double boiler for 15 minutes stirring constantly or until thick. Combine remaining 1/2 cup of sugar with egg yolks and salt and mix well. Add the hot flour mixture to the yolk mixture. Return to double boiler and cook 3 more minutes or until mixture is thick. Add butter extract and vinegar. Mix well and remove from heat. Place plastic on top of custard.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni until done; drain. Add onions celery celery seed and eggs. In another bowl mix sugar and mayonnaise until creamy; add vinegar salt and pepper and mix. Pour over macaroni and mix thoroughly.

title: Shrimp Gumbo
instructions: In a large pot (8 quarts) chop bacon into small pieces. Add onion and garlic then saute. Add all other ingredients except for shrimp and simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Add shrimp and cook 15 minutes. Serve over rice. (If thicker gumbo is preferred 2 to 3 tablespoons of flour may be added.)

title: Rouladen
instructions: Pound steak to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into 6 pieces and season with salt and pepper to taste. Spread lightly with mustard. Place bacon onion and pickle slice on each piece of meat. Roll up firmly and tie with white cord. Dredge each roll in flour. Heat butter in a heavy frying pan and brown rolls on each side. Lower heat and add wine and water. Cover and simmer about 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Add a little additional wine if moisture is needed during braising. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Candy Strawberries
instructions: Combine Jell-O pecans and coconut. Stir in condensed milk and vanilla; mix well. Chill 1 hour. Shape mixture into strawberries. Roll in red decorators sugar if desired. Insert sliced almonds colored with green food coloring in top of berries to form leaves.

title: Blueberry Buttermilk Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add wet ingredients. Mix well. Fold in blueberries. Bake 20 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Heat water and butter to a rolling boil. Measure flour and mix salt in. Stir flour into water mixture. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball (about 1 minute). Remove from heat. Let cool 10 minutes.

title: Yogurt Milkshake
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender or beat by hand until thick and smooth. This is a delicious tart drink refreshing on a hot day.

title: Cheesecake Miniatures
instructions: You will need paper or foil muffin liners.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Cream oleo and Crisco with electric mixer. Add vanilla. Gradually add sugar one cup at a time beating well on medium speed. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl often. When all sugar has been mixed in icing will appear dry. Add milk and beat at medium speed for 2 or 3 minutes. Will frost your favorite boxed cake mix.

title: Easy Lemon Squares
instructions: *If you like more lemon flavor add some lemon extract to lemon juice.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar. Add onion mayonnaise salt and celery seed to taste. Toss. Fold in 2 hard-cooked eggs sliced and chilled. Serves 4.

title: Creamy Corn Chowder
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven. Add garlic onion and peppers. Cook for 1 minute. Add corn potatoes and broth. Bring to a boil.

title: Grilled Dove
instructions: Dress doves. Mix lemon pepper and Zesty Italian dressing. Marinade doves for 4 hours then wrap doves with bacon strips and cook on grill until done. Very good.

title: Salem Hermits
instructions: Cream butter sugar and molasses until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. In another bowl combine flours spices baking soda and salt. Beat into butter mixture alternately with the coffee. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into lightly buttered 10 x 15-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Brisket
instructions: You will need a Reynolds cooking bag.

title: Venison Chili With Beans
instructions: Heat butter or bacon fat. Cook onion and garlic until onion is soft. Brown meat in pan. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook slowly over low heat for an hour or more.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: Wash and grind up cranberries in blender (dont get them soupy) and mix with 1 cup sugar. Set aside for a while. Empty jello and unflavored gelatin into 6 x 10 pan. Stir in hot water until dissolved. Add pineapple juice or water or mixture of both to equal 1 cup. Let jello set in refrigerator until slightly solid. Add cranberries crushed pineapple celery and walnuts. Let set in refrigerator until solid.

title: Fruited Butter
instructions: Mix well and spread on muffins crackers breads bagels etc.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Cover dates with hot water and soda; let stand. Cream butter and sugar; add egg cake flour and chopped walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Black Bean Gazpacho(Soup)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine tomatoes juice ham beans cucumber or squash chopped pepper green onion and dressing. Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours. If desired serve with bottled hot pepper sauce. Makes 4 main-dish servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Place the strawberries in pie shell. Cook the sugar water and cornstarch until thick. Add jello. Pour over sliced strawberries and chill. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add lightly beaten eggs then the flour and baking powder that have been sifted together. Reserve 1/4 cup of the flour mixture. Add extracts. Dredge the candied fruits in the reserved 1/4 cup of flour. Fold in fruit and pecans into the batter and pour into a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. (I use Pam spray which I spray on liberally.) Place in a cold oven and bake at 250\u00b0 for approximately 3 1/2 hours or until an inserted toothpick comes out clean. (When my cake has cooled I remove it from the pan turn it right side up and make numerous holes in the top with a toothpick. I then pour either bourbon rum or peach brandy into the holes. Finally I wrap the cake in tinfoil and place in covered cake plate.)

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix in large bowl or 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with 2 cups crushed corn flakes. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: English Plum Pudding
instructions: After all dry ingredients have been mixed together add the soda with just enough water to make a mixture. Lay out a 12 x 14-inch cloth and lightly flour before putting the mixture in it. Use 1/2 mixture in two 12 x 14-inch cloths. Tie up into a ball. Boil in open pan for 3 hours. Add water as needed. Be sure to put a saucer or plate in bottom of pan.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Crumble 1/2 of cake in glass baking dish. Mix milk and cream cheese together until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread mixture on crumbled cake then 1/2 of cherry pie filling. Crumble more cake and repeat mixture and cherry pie filling. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour cinnamon nutmeg cloves and baking soda. In large bowl mix together margarine artificial sweetener and egg. Mix in dry ingredients alternating with applesauce. Fold in bran raisins and nuts; mix thoroughly. Drop onto greased cookie sheet by tablespoon. Lightly flatten with a fork (dipped in milk). Bake for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Bi Hon(Serves 12 Or More)
instructions: Soak Maifun rice sticks in cold water while preparing vegetables. Cook meat in small amount of water until dry. Salt may be added while cooking. Add onion; cook a few minutes more. Add carrots celery garlic salt and pepper to taste. Add rice noodles and about 1/2 cup water. Add a little more garlic salt and cabbage. Add enough soya sauce to give a light brown color. Cook until water is gone. Add some cooking oil (about 1 tablespoon) to give a slick texture.

title: Best Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine 1/2 the shrimp and remaining ingredients in blender until fluffy and smooth. Coarsely chop remaining shrimp and fold into mixture. Refrigerate. Better to sit overnight.

title: Tropical Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix juices; take part of juice mix in blender with banana. Add back to juice and mix. Serve chilled with ice and 7-Up.

title: Sicilian Meat Roll
instructions: Combine eggs crumbs juice parsley oregano salt and pepper. Add beef; mix well. On waxed paper pat meat to a 12 x 10-inch rectangle. Arrange ham atop meat leaving a small margin around the edges. Sprinkle cheese over ham. Starting from short end carefully roll up meat using paper to lift. Seal edge and ends. Place roll seam side down in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Place cheese over roll. Return to oven until cheese melts. Serves 8.

title: Fresh Apple Bread
instructions: Combine 1 cup sugar and shortening. Cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Combine 2 cups flour soda and salt. Combine buttermilk and vanilla. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture beating well after each addition. Combine pecans and 1 tablespoon of flour and stir well. Stir pecans and apple into batter. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Combine 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle evenly over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mammy'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix egg yolks and milk in saucepan. Heat over low heat. Mix cocoa sugar flour and salt together. When milk is lukewarm stir in sugar mixture stirring constantly over medium heat until thick. Stir in vanilla and butter. Place in precooked pie shell. Beat egg whites and place on top of pie. Brown lightly.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix powdered sugar and cocoa. Make a hole in center. Put stick of margarine and marshmallows in hole. Microwave 2 minutes on High. Take out and stir in milk and vanilla. Stir until well mixed. Then add nuts. Pour in buttered dish to set. Refrigerate until firm.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend for about 1 minute. Store in refrigerator.

title: Chicken-Dorito Casserole
instructions: Layer Doritos in long baking pan. Place chopped chicken on Doritos then cheese onion and another layer of Doritos. Mix liquids together and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly in large bowl. Add 3/4 cup brown sugar pumpkin salt and spices. Mix well. Stir in evaporated milk. Pour mixture into shell. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Reduce oven to 375\u00b0. Bake 30 minutes longer or until thin bladed knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Combine pecans 1/2 cup brown sugar and margarine. Mix well. Spread over cooled pie. Be certain all custard is covered. Place under broiler (5 inches below) and heat for 3 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble. If overcooked top will become syrupy. Cool.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper; coat with flour. Brown chops onion and green pepper in shortening in skillet. Place rice in greased casserole; top with tomatoes. Arrange chops onion and green peppers over tomatoes; cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until liquids are absorbed. Yields 6 servings.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn #2
instructions: Using a 4-glass dish add the brown sugar margarine vanilla corn syrup and salt; cook sauce on High for 2 minutes. Stir; cook 3 minutes more on High. Stir. Add the baking soda. In a brown paper bag add the popcorn then add sauce and stir. Put paper bag in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. Take out bag and shake. Put back in microwave for 1 minute. Pour onto wax paper; let harden.

title: Quick Spoon Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls in greased muffin pans. Do not let rise in pans. Just pop into preheated 400\u00b0 oven and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Dough will keep in fridge for several days. Do not stir when removed from the fridge. Just bake as directed.

title: Percolator Punch
instructions: Combine liquids in a percolator. Fill percolator basket with cinnamon cloves and brown sugar. Bring to boil for approximately 5 minutes. Heating brings out the flavor and aroma. An ice cube or two will bring the beverage to drinking temperature.

title: Cranberry Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender. Set aside. Melt butter and add cranberry sauce. Cook until sauce is melted. Stir and mix in with carrots and cook until warmed through.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli as directed omit salt. Do not drain. Add all other ingredients stir well. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Makes 7 1/2 cups.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Line bottom of dish with half of Oreos. Prepare pudding as instructed and blend with cream cheese and Cool Whip. Spread over layer of Oreo cookies. Sprinkle remaining cookies on top.

title: Bean And Pea Salad
instructions: Pour over salad mixture and refrigerate. Colorful and will keep 3 or 4 days in fridge.

title: Cauliflower Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and let set until chilled.

title: Hearty Chicken Fettuccine
instructions: In saucepan blend flour liquid Butter Buds skim milk and chicken broth. Add minced garlic and salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until sauce thickens. Stir in Parmesan cheese. Combine sauce with chicken and mushrooms. Fold into cooked pasta. Serve immediately. If sauce is too thick add more evaporated skim milk and chicken broth. Serves 6.

title: Carrot Ring Mold
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake 20 to 30 minutes in round ring mold which has been well-greased at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Fill center with Creamed Broccoli.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes and chop. Boil eggs and chop. Mix all ingredients together and chill in fridge.

title: Fruit Sweets
instructions: Grind and mix. Form into 1-inch rolls. Roll in powdered sugar coconut and ground walnuts. Slice and serve. If preferred whole walnuts can be mixed with the fruit.

title: Special Club Sandwich
instructions: For each sandwich spread 3 toast slices with dressing. Cover 1 toast slice with Cheddar cheese chicken lettuce and second toast slice. Top with Swiss cheese tomato bacon and third toast slice. Cut into quarters and secure with toothpicks. Makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Cracker Candy
instructions: Mix sugar and milk; bring to a boil. Remove from heat; add crackers vanilla and peanut butter. Let stand for 5 minutes then pour into buttered dish. Let cool in refrigerator and cut into squares.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Mix together and keep frozen.

title: Light Pumpkin Pancakes
instructions: Make this batter about 30 minutes before serving. In large bowl mix first 7 ingredients. In small bowl combine egg whites milk pumpkin and 2 tablespoons oil. Add to flour mixture. Stir just until flour is moistened. Heat griddle over medium heat until drop of water sizzles; brush lightly with oil. Pour batter by scant 1/4 cupfuls onto hot griddle making a few pancakes at a time. Cook until tops are bubbly and edges look dry. With pancake turner turn and cook until undersides are golden. Place on warm platter. Repeat until all batter is used brushing griddle with more oil if necessary. Serve pancakes with syrup if desired. Makes about 16 pancakes.

title: Smoked Sausage Sandwiches
instructions: Pierce sausages in several places with a fork; place in a medium frying pan. Pour water to cover; bring to boiling. Cover reduce heat. Simmer very slowly for 10 minutes; drain.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix altogether except for the 1/2 cup nuts. Save other 1/2 to roll cheese ball in. Chill and serve with favorite crackers.

title: Six Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar oil water and dressing and pour over vegetables. Let stand overnight.

title: Non-Dairy Ciambellone
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add oil. Add 1/2 of flour and 1/2 of white grape juice and beat well. Add salt baking powder anise and lemon juice and rind. Mix well. Slowly add the rest of the flour and grape juice and beat.

title: Banana Split Squares
instructions: In 2 quart saucepan melt butter. Stir in crumbs and sugar. Press mixture into bottom of pan.

title: 5 Can Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken into small pieces. Mix with noodles milk celery undiluted soup and celery (if used). Pour into casserole and top with buttered bread crumbs or crushed potato chips. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. (May be prepared a day ahead of serving; refrigerate until cooked.)

title: Fudgy Cocoa Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. In a medium saucepan melt butter over low heat. Remove melted butter from heat add cocoa and stir until well blended. Add sugar and mix well. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Stir in vanilla flour and salt; mix but do not overbeat. Fold in nuts. Spread in prepared pan and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Frost if desired.

title: Strawberry-Buttermilk Freeze
instructions: Combine 1 1/4 cups fresh or frozen strawberries buttermilk and sugar in food blender. Chop until smooth. Pour the mixture into an 8-inch square pan and freeze 1 to 2 hours or until slushy. Combine beaten egg whites vanilla and frozen strawberry mixture in blender and process until smooth. Return mixture to pan and freeze until firm. Allow to stand at room temperature for about 20 minutes before serving. Garnish each serving with fresh strawberries if desired. Yields 1 quart.

title: Chocolate Dream Cake
instructions: Sift flour and sugar into mixing bowl; blend well. Bring to rapid boil the margarine shortening water and cocoa; pour over flour and sugar mixture and blend well. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour in greased and lightly floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 35 to 40 minutes or until done. Sheath pan may be used also. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Summer Pork Stew(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: Brown pork in oil in large pot. Add tomatoes salt and pepper. Bring to boiling. Lower heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Meanwhile shuck corn; break each ear into 4 pieces. Halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices. Add corn to pot. Cover and cook stirring occasionally 10 minutes. Add zucchini. Cover and cook stirring occasionally 5 to 8 minutes more or until zucchini is tender-crisp.

title: Cake That Won'T Last
instructions: Mix well in bowl; do not use mixer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased and floured Bundt pan.

title: Gingered Carrots And Apples
instructions: Put carrots in pan of boiling water and simmer until just tender and crisp or steam the carrots. Do not overcook. Saute onion in margarine or the broth 2 to 3 minutes. Add sliced apples and saute 4 to 5 minutes. Add apple juice carrots sugar lemon juice salt nutmeg and ginger. Cover and simmer 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Cindy'S Chicken
instructions: Put boneless chicken breasts in ovenproof dish and cover with barbecue sauce. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes until done. Top with sliced ham and Monterey Jack cheese. Put back in oven until cheese just barely melts. Serve immediately.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and cook over medium heat stirring frequently until thickens. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Chocolate, Oatmeal, Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine in a saucepan the sugar and cocoa. When thoroughly mixed add the milk or cream and margarine. Place over low heat and let margarine melt stirring constantly. When it starts to boil let boil hard for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in the oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. Drop by spoon on buttered plate or wax paper. Place in refrigerator for 1 hour or until cool and hard. Makes approximately 3 dozen.

title: Sour Cream Lettuce Salad
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Stir in flour and blend thoroughly. Add sour cream and cook stirring constantly until mixture begins to thicken. Add sugar salt and vinegar. Pour hot sauce over lettuce leaves and mix. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme together until smooth. Add dry Jell-O to taste and for color. I usually use 1 to 2 teaspoons.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt 4 tablespoons butter in small saucepan. Add onion and saute. Add flour and water and cook until thickened. Stir in Cheez Whiz and heat until smooth. Gently toss sauce with broccoli in mixing bowl. Stir in beaten eggs. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Toss cracker crumbs in remaining 2 tablespoons melted butter and sprinkle on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pork Chops
instructions: Flour pork chops on each side. Spread each side with mustard. Flour again. Brown on both sides with a little oil in a nonstick pan. Drain and add rice soup and 1/2 can water. Cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Put pork chops on platter and serve remaining liquid over potatoes like gravy. Try this youll love it.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugar. Add molasses cinnamon ginger and salt. Stir in flour. Form into tiny balls press flat with fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet. Add 1 1/2 cans tomato sauce and taco seasoning. Mix well. Crumble 2 cups corn chips on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread hamburger mixture over corn chips. Mix rest of tomato sauce with refried beans. Spread beans over hamburger. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put cheese and 1 cup corn chips on top and bake another 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together and simmer for 15 minutes. Bake wings at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Pour away juice and grease. Pour sauce over chicken. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Baste occasionally.

title: White Texas Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add unbeaten egg whites. Sift flour baking soda and salt together then add to shortening and sugar alternating with buttermilk. Add vanilla. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a floured jelly roll pan (17 x 11-inch).

title: Salad Provencale
instructions: Combine meat rice celery and onions. Blend remaining ingredients except tomatoes. Stir into rice mixture. Chill. Arrange on salad greens if desired and garnish with tomato wedges. Serves 6.

title: Quick Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook noodles until tender; drain. Add cream of mushroom soup Velveeta and chicken. Cover and allow cheese to melt. Mix well and simmer for 10 minutes. (It may be necessary to add small amount of milk or water to avoid mixture becoming too thick.)

title: Baked Corn Dish
instructions: Saute butter onion and bell pepper. Mix corn pimento rice and egg. Add onion and bell pepper salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add grated Velveeta cheese on top when almost done.

title: Frozen Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: In a medium bowl combine pumpkin syrup salt ginger cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir in pecans.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Add 4 eggs to all dry ingredients. Mix well. Add oil. Beat well. Add orange juice and vanilla and beat until smooth. Drain apples. Pour half of batter into greased and floured pan. Take drained apples one at a time and place in batter all around the cake. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar mixture on top of that. Pour remaining batter apples and cinnamon mixture as first time. Place in oven for 1 hour or until done.

title: Strawberry-Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels 1/4 cup sugar and butter. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Mix cream cheese and 1 cup sugar; add whipped topping. Spread over cooled pretzel mix. Heat pineapple juice to boiling. Dissolve Jell-O; add strawberries. Cool until mushy; spread over cream cheese mix.

title: Fruit Glaze Pie
instructions: In a saucepan mix 1/2 quart fruit (mashed) sugar cornstarch and water. Cook over medium heat stirring until thick and clear. Remove from heat and cool. Place rest of fruit in pie shell. Pour cooled fruit on top. Chill until firm 2 hours.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Put Tater Tots in large cake pan. Pour mixture over top. Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Sprinkle dry jello over Cool Whip and mix well. Fold in cottage cheese pineapple and nuts. Chill.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all but sour cream together; mix well then fold in the sour cream. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. (Be sure to grease casserole dish.) Remove from oven and cover with cheese and onion rings. Put back in oven until cheese melts.

title: New England Boiled Dinner
instructions: Place meat into a large pot cover with cold water. Cover pot bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 1/2 hours. Cut cabbage into 6 pieces and remove core. Add all vegetables to meat. Cook until meat and vegetables are tender about 1 hour. Serve on large platter with meat surrounded by vegetables. Serve with either dinner rolls or hard rolls.

title: Peanut Butter N Banana Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl stir together flour sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon. In another bowl combine mashed bananas milk peanut butter oil vanilla and egg. Add to flour mixture stirring just until all ingredients are combined. Pour batter in two greased and floured 9-inch baking pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Remove from pans; cool thoroughly on a wire rack. Wrap and store overnight before frosting. Frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
instructions: Lightly grease the bottom only of a 9 1/4 x 5 1/4 x 2 3/4-inch loaf pan. Set aside. In large mixing bowl combine all ingredients except small chocolate chips and walnuts; blend well on medium speed. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan. Cool completely.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Toast bread then butter. Cut in cubes and put in deep dish. Beat eggs and add remaining ingredients. Pour over bread. Put dish in pan with water and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Mix chicken soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Dot with butter. Crumble crackers on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Mix first 3 ingredients for batter and pour into pan. Pour desired canned fruit over batter. Sprinkle sugar over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 until browned.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and rice together in amount of water directed on Minute rice package. In another bowl mix all ingredients except the cheese. When rice and broccoli are completely cooked mix with other ingredients. Put half the mixture in a casserole dish. Put a layer of cheese then remaining rice mixture and top it off with the rest of the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until cheese is hot and bubbly.

title: Sue'S Oven Baked Burritos
instructions: Mix cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Cook until cheese is smooth and melted. Brown ground beef and onion. Drain off grease. Put desired amount of beef on burrito shell. Pour small amount of cheese over beef and roll up. Put rolled burritos in oblong casserole dish. Pour remaining cheese mixture over all burritos. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1/2 hour or until heated through.

title: World'S Best Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar oleo and oil. Add eggs. Mix dry ingredients with flour. Mix all together. Refrigerate 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake until light brown.

title: Holiday Potatoes
instructions: Mix butter and cream cheese. Add 1/2 cup of Cheddar and all other ingredients. Spread into 11 x 7-inch dish. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Hamburger-Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef onion and pepper until tender (undrained). Steam cabbage; drain and prepare soup and drain. Mix all ingredients except 1 package of soup seasoning. Pour in large casserole dish; sprinkle with last seasoning package. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat 4 to 5 minutes or until thickened. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Shaker Cheddar Bread(Makes One Loaf)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flours baking powder and salt together into a large mixing bowl. Cut the butter into 4 or 5 bits. Blend it into the flour mixture by pressing it in with the tines of fork until the mixture resembles a coarse meal. Stir in the grated cheese.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad
instructions: Seed and chop tomato; chop bell pepper. Slice 2 green onions and mushrooms and mince garlic. Place tomato bell pepper green onions mushrooms and garlic in a large bowl. Stir in peas and next 3 ingredients. Cover and chill stirring occasionally for 8 hours. Drain salad and spoon onto lettuce lined platter. Sprinkle with bacon and 1/3 cup sliced green onions. Yield 8 servings.

title: Four Minute Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk and butter. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil mixture 4 minutes. Add chocolate and marshmallows. Beat until fudge thickens. Add nuts. Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan. Top with walnut halves. Cut into squares. Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Orange Chicken With Almonds
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Brown in butter on both sides. Add orange juice concentrate and water. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer until chicken is tender. Remove chicken to serving platter. Sprinkle with toasted almonds. Keep warm.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cook spinach as directed and drain well. Mix together cottage cheese; cut into pieces margarine beaten eggs flour salt and 1 cup of Cheddar cheese. Add spinach to mixture and put into casserole. Top with remaining Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lime Chicken Breast
instructions: Trim fat from chicken and cut out middle tendon. Pound between waxed paper to flatten slightly. Combine in a bowl the olive oil lime juice garlic 2 tablespoons cilantro salt and pepper. Pour over chicken and marinate for at least 1 hour. Grill or broil chicken for 2 minutes on each side. Remove and place on platter and sprinkle remaining cilantro.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix soup vegetables and chicken in a 9-inch square dish. Top with biscuits. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Vegetarian Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Soak the lentils for 12 hours. Place in boiling water and cook until tender. Heat the butter in a frying pan and fry the onions peeled and cut into slices until brown. Remove them from the pan. Add the flour and fry a few minutes; gradually add the water in which the lentils have been cooked. Stir and bring to the boil; add salt pepper herbs and flavoring. Turn the lentils into a pie dish or meat tin. Moisten with as much sauce as required. Cover with plenty of well mashed potatoes and bake in the oven for 1 hour with the \regulo\ at mark 7. The remainder of the sauce may be thinned with more vegetable stock and served with the pie. Beans or peas may be used in place of the lentils.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add cocoa then add remaining ingredients. Bake in unbaked pie crust at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until pie is firm in the middle.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Add to browned ground beef the onion green pepper chili powder and garlic salt. Drain. Mix with ground beef the egg sour cream tomato sauce and Cheddar cheese. Separate biscuits and place half in a deep casserole dish. Pour mixture in. Place remaining biscuits on top. Sprinkle another 1/2 cup of Cheddar cheese on top.

title: Chili
instructions: Fry hamburg and onions and drain. Add sauce ingredients. Add tomatoes kidney beans chili powder and cumin. Stir well; cook on low heat until seasoned and hot.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Brown meat. Drain fat (if any). Add all of the ingredients except kidney beans. Simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Add kidney beans.

title: Hamburger Dip
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in bacon grease. Cook hamburger and sausage slowly until done not brown. Drain. Add onion and bell pepper to meat mixture. Add Ro-Tel and relish to mixture; let set about 10 minutes. Cut up cheese and let melt. Add to meat mixture. Keep hot.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix juices and tea together in a large pot. Tie up spices in bag and drop in mixture. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Soak beans overnight in water. Drain and add fresh water enough to cover beans plus 2 or 3 inches. Bring beans to a boil with ham hock and sliced sausage. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add remaining ingredients and continue to cook for 1/2 to 1 hour. Serve over rice.

title: Cherry Jello
instructions: Drain and chop cherries; save juice and add to water to make 1 1/2 cups. Heat to boiling and dissolve jello. Slowly beat in cranberry sauce and 3 tablespoons lemon juice. Fold in chopped cherries. Put in square pan and freeze. Whip cream; add sugar and lemon rind and beat until stiff. Fold in mayonnaise and 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Spread over jello and freeze.

title: Ambrosia Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries and sugar. In a large bowl combine the marshmallows apples grapes pecans and pineapple. Add cranberries and mix well. Fold in whipped cream. Cover and chill. Sprinkle with coconut before serving. Yield 12 to 14 servings.

title: Blender Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Cut up chocolate in small pieces. Put in blender. Add other ingredients. Cover. Blend on low speed until larger pieces are chopped. Stop and stir with long-handled spoon. Cover and blend on high speed until thick and creamy. Makes 3 cups.

title: Pork Chops Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place chops in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with salt. Put 2 or 3 onion slices on each chop then one thin lemon slice on each chop 1 tablespoon of brown sugar and last 1 tablespoon ketchup. Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 hour. Uncover and bake 30 minutes more basting several times.

title: Easy Doozits
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Roll into 1/2 inch balls and chill. Roll in confectioners sugar when ready to serve. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Biscuit Mix
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar. Cut shortening into mixture until it resembles coarse corn meal. Store in covered container. Will keep unrefrigerated up to 6 weeks.

title: Baklava
instructions: Combine. Cook syrup to medium consistency. Pour over pastry while still warm.

title: Sandra'S Cucumber Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix sugar and vinegar.\tPeel and thinly slice cucumbers and onions. Add salt. Do not add water. Soak for 2 hours and drain. Add sugar\tand vinegar mixture to cucumbers and onions. Put into containers and freeze. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Caponata(Serves 10 To 15 As Hors D'Oeuvre)
instructions: Cut eggplant into cubes. Dust with salt; drain in colander. Saute celery and onion in olive oil for about 15 minutes. Saute eggplant for 10 minutes. Place all in a 2-quart kettle. Add balance of ingredients except salt and pepper. Simmer for 20 minutes or until liquid evaporates. Season with salt and pepper. Chill. Serve on lettuce with brown crackers.

title: San Francisco Chops
instructions: Using 1 teaspoon oil brown chops on both sides. Remove meat and add garlic for 1 minute. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chops in skillet and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes until tender and sauce is thick.

title: Chicken Franchese
instructions: Rinse chicken in cold water. Mix flour pepper salt and garlic. Dip chicken in flour mixture; then in beaten eggs. Fry chicken in 1/4 inch of oil until lightly brown on both sides. In a small sauce pan combine chicken broth lemon juice and cornstarch and cook until slightly thick. Drizzle sauce over chicken breast and serve.

title: French Veal Stew
instructions: *Or 1 cup dry white wine 1/2 cup chicken broth and 1 tablespoon tomato paste.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat onion pepper and garlic in oil. Drain. Add all ingredients except beans; cook for 1 1/2 hours on top of stove. Add beans cook for 1 more hour on medium heat stir occasionally.

title: Fruit Spritzer Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl. Makes 27 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream the sugar and butter. Add the egg and vanilla; beat well. Sift together the dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture. Stir to a smooth dough. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Roll dough to 1/4-inch thick. Flour cutters. Decorate with colored sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Twinkies
instructions: Divide into 2 cookie sheets.

title: Lava Flow(From The Kannapali Maui Marriott)
instructions: In bottom of glass put 2 ounces blended strawberries. Blend remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over strawberries to form swirled effect.

title: Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; stir. Add oil and beat. Stir in celery seed and onion. Let stand 24 hours.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: In skillet over medium-high heat saute onion and celery in margarine until slightly tender. In large bowl combine celery mixture cornbread bread cubes turkey broth giblets salt poultry seasoning pepper and egg. Spoon dressing into lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook over medium heat until filling thickens. Pour in a 9-inch cooked pie shell.

title: Lemon Curd
instructions: Beat eggs into melted butter; then stir in sugar. Beat until thoroughly combined. Add lemon juice and rind gradually. Cook in the top of a double boiler over simmering water until thickened stirring constantly. Let cool. (Curd can be stored in the refrigerator for a week.) Use as a spread on bread or cookies. Makes 2 cups.

title: Pizza Sandwiches
instructions: Cook sausage and veggies until red is gone and veggies are tender; drain. Add Velveeta and stir until melted into the mixture. Spread on cocktail slices of bread. Freeze. When ready to bake put frozen slices on cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake about 10 minutes.

title: Double Fudge Chip Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously butter 2 large or 5 to 6 mini loaf pans and lightly dust with flour.

title: Party Carrots(Microwave)
instructions: Place carrots and water in 2-quart dish. Cover with plastic wrap; microwave on High 10 minutes stirring 1 time. Stir in honey and lemon juice. Cover and microwave on High 5 minutes. Microwave butter 30 seconds; stir in flour. Add this to carrots. Stir well; add raisins pineapple and apples. Microwave on High 5 minutes. Rest 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Molly Morgan
instructions: With mixer beat eggs well and gradually add sugar. Add next 4 ingredients and mix well. To serve use 8 ounce glasses. Pour 2 tablespoons of mix in each glass and then add 7-Up and ice.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla and melted chocolate. Blend in thoroughly. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Pour batter into lightly greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake in slow oven (300\u00b0) 1 1/2 hours. When done let stand 10 minutes in pan then remove cake from pan to rack and cover loosely until cool. Makes 16 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sweet potatoes and mix well. Arrange half of meat mixture in greased loaf pan; cover with sweet potatoes and top with remaining meat mixture. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) about 1 hour. Serves 10.

title: Candy Loaf
instructions: Work all into a loaf. Place in pan about 2 inches deep. Let stand in refrigerator 24 hours. Slice and serve.

title: Giggle Jigglers(Kids)
instructions: In large bowl mix gelatins together. Add boiling water and stir until completely dissolved. Pour into 13 x 9-inch baking pan and chill until firm. To serve cut into 1-inch squares or into various shapes using mini cookie cutters.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart bowl place broccoli and water. Microwave on High 7 minutes. Set aside. In a 3-quart pan microwave for 6 minutes the oleo onion and celery uncovered. Add soup evaporated milk and Cheez Whiz. Microwave on High 7 minutes covered stirring. Add salt cayenne and black pepper. Add rice and cooked broccoli. Microwave on High 10 to 12 minutes stirring uncovered. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Microwave on High 2 minutes uncovered.

title: Squash Puffs
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Drop by teaspoon into hot oil and deep fat fry.

title: Zucchini Burgers
instructions: Mix ground beef shredded zucchini bread crumbs and egg. Form into eight 1/2-inch thick patties. Brown on both sides in a large nonstick skillet for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in sliced zucchini tomatoes and potatoes. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes turning patties and stirring 2 to 3 times until vegetables are crisp and tender.

title: Cheese Sauce For Veggies(For Broccoli And Cauliflower Especially.)
instructions: Heat yogurt mayo and mustard on stove top or in microwave. Add cheese and heat until melted. Stir during heating to keep smooth. Serve over broccoli cauliflower baked potatoes you name it!

title: Lo-Cal Punch
instructions: Add water according to directions on juice can. Mix and chill.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Peel and cut up tomatoes. Mix all ingredients together. Can as you would other vegetables.

title: Easter Eggs
instructions: In medium size mixing bowl cream together butter vanilla and salt. Blend in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Gradually blend in sugar. Blend well after each addition until mixture becomes very stiff. Turn mixture from bowl onto a clean board. Carefully knead the remaining sugar until all is used. Mixture should be smooth and not sticky. Cut the mixture in half. Roll out each piece into long lengths. The length rolled out is determined by the thickness of the egg you want. Cut the rolled out lengths into the size of the egg you want to make. Form the cut edges to shape the eggs.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Cottage Cheese Muffins
instructions: Fold cottage cheese and egg together. Add the flour salt baking powder and sugar. Stir to combine. Add milk and stir lightly then gently stir in the blueberries. Spoon into muffin pan. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Zucchini And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients; place in a well-greased 8-inch square baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Meringue Coconut Kisses
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff; add brown sugar and vanilla. Continue to beat until blended completely. Fold in rest of ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from pan immediately. Will keep in a closed container for several days but they most probably wont be around that long! Delightful flavor.

title: Coleslaw Ala Salmon
instructions: Combine the bell pepper onion cucumber purple cabbage and green cabbage in a cool glass or ceramic bowl after chopping up. Add salmon vinegar and mayonnaise. Stir it up and serve.

title: Electric Skillet Chicken And Rice(Low-Fat)
instructions: Spray skillet with cooking spray (Pam). Preheat skillet to 325\u00b0. Place chicken pieces into skillet and brown on both sides. Season with salt and pepper. Remove chicken from skillet. Reduce heat to simmer.

title: Strawberry And Raspberry Pie
instructions: You will need aluminum foil.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Mix the hamburger sausage egg rice and onion together good.

title: Asiago Cheese Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Put in a 2 quart baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes or until warmed through. Serve with crackers or crusty French bread. Try spreading dip on bread slices top with additional cheese and broil for a second way to serve.

title: Zucchini Cake And Glaze
