instructions: Combine eggs oil sugar and vanilla; mix well. Combine dry ingredients; add to oil mixture mixing well. Stir in grated zucchini. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done in greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Allow to cool 20 minutes before removing from pan. Glaze if desired.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
instructions: Put peppers and 1/4 c. cider vinegar in blend and blender until thin and soupy. Add sugar and 1 c. cider vinegar. Put in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. SKIM. Add the pectin and a few drops of food coloring. Reheat and boil hard for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Fill jars to 1/2 inch from top and seal with paraffin.

title: Tomato Bisque(A Wonderful Winter Soup.)
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Chop into small pieces and set aside. Saute the carrots and celery in the bacon fat until tender and drain. Combine in a large pot the chicken broth tomatoes (crushed) sauteed carrots and celery bacon spices and salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 45 minutes or until all the flavors have blended. Remove from heat and puree in a blender. Return to pan and add the cream. Heat for several minutes but do not boil. Serve immediately with fresh hot French bread.

title: Basic Pancake Recipe
instructions: In large bowl beat egg. Beat in remaining ingredients until just mixed. Heat lightly greased frying pan over medium-high heat. Pour batter from large spoon and flip when puffed and bubbles begin to pop. Cook second side until golden brown. Makes 10 (4-inch) pancakes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all together except for 1/3 cup margarine and corn flakes. Pour into 3-quart baking dish. Top with remaining margarine and corn flakes mixed together. Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. (I sometimes add a can of mixed vegetables and some ham or Polish sausage chunks to make it a 1 dish meal.)

title: Potato Cheese Soup
instructions: In large pot saute onion in margarine. Add potatoes and cover with water salt and pepper to taste. Cook until potatoes are almost done. Mix soup with 1/2 soup can of water until smooth. Pour into potatoes. Add frozen mixed vegetables. Cook until potatoes and vegetables are done. Turn off heat and add Velveeta cheese. Stir until melted.

title: Sweet Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast on both sides. Saute onion (chopped). Add all to roast. Bake slowly at 325\u00b0 approximately 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Swiss Chicken Bake
instructions: Place breasts in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Combine soup and sherry and pour evenly over cheese. Spoon stuffing mix evenly over all. Dot with butter. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Serves 6.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients. Remove from heat; add flour and stir. Add 1 egg at a time stirring thoroughly. Add salt and walnuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes; cool and slice. Cut bacon into 1/2-inch pieces. Fry slowly until brown. Reserve 1/2 cup bacon grease; add flour. Gradually stir in liquids. Add onion seasonings and potatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add salt to taste. Cover and let stand for 4 hours before serving.

title: Roman Style Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers in halves; remove stalks and seeds and cut into thin slices. Place onion and oil in skillet and simmer until transparent. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes. Add peppers salt and pepper; cover and cook slowly 30 minutes adding water if necessary stirring frequently. Serves 4.

title: Marshmallow Creme Fudge
instructions: In a heavy pan combine milk sugar salt and butter stirring constantly over medium heat. Cook to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add chocolate chips Marshmallow Creme vanilla and nuts. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Baked Zucchini Filling
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in greased 11 x 7-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until firm. Can also be baked in 13 x 9-inch pan and cut into squares to serve as an appetizer.

title: Chicken And Wine
instructions: Salt chicken. Mix all other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve on rice.

title: Chocolate Fudge Sauce
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in 2-quart bowl 2 minutes on high. Add sugar salt and milk to melted mixture. Stir. Cook 3 minutes on high until mixture comes to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from stove. Stir extracts into sauce. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Rocky Road(Candy)
instructions: Line an 8-inch square pan with foil. Grease the foil with butter. In the top of a double boiler melt the chocolate over barely simmering water stirring constantly. Remove from the hot water and stir in the marshmallows coconut and walnuts. Pour the candy into the prepared pan and using a spatula spread it into an even layer. Chill in the refrigerator for about 3 hours or until the candy is firm. Remove the candy from the pan. Peel off the foil and using a sharp knife cut the candy into 1-inch squares.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Heat in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring often.

title: Spaghetti Casserole(Oven: 350~ For 15 To 20 Minutes.  Yields 6 Servings.)
instructions: Brown ground chuck. Add next 9 ingredients and simmer 2 hours. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Combine meat sauce spaghetti chunks of cheese and olives in 3-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar and add egg yolks. Beat well. Add flour baking powder and sour cream a little of each at a time. Beat well. Fold in egg whites. Beat 90 minutes at 350\u00b0. Turn out on wax paper while still hot.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Break spaghetti into 3-inch pieces and cook as directed. Do not overcook. Chop all vegetables very small. Add vegetables Italian dressing and Salad Supreme to drained spaghetti. Let rest in refrigerator at least 24 hours. The longer it stands the better it tastes. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Old Fashion Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; sift again. Combine milk and bran; let stand until liquid is absorbed by bran. Add egg and shortening. Add dry ingredients. Do not beat. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 15 to 18 medium-sized muffins.

title: Chocolate Lush
instructions: Combine with fork and press into 9 x 13-inch pan flour and butter or margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or brown. Beat with mixer the cream cheese 10x sugar and Cool Whip. Pour over cooled crust. Combine with mixer pudding and milk. Pour thickened mixture over cream cheese mix. Top with Cool Whip (small) and sprinkle with pecan chips and cherries. Refrigerate for at least 3 to 4 hours.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Scald the milk. Mix the dry ingredients and gradually add the scalded milk. Cook over hot water until the mixture thickens. Stir constantly to prevent lumping. Separate eggs and beat yolks slightly. Add hot mixture to the beaten egg yolks. Return to saucepan and cook until thick stirring constantly about 5 minutes. Remove from stove and cool. Add shredded coconut and pour into cooled baked pie shell. Top with meringue and sprinkle with coconut. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Starter For Sourdough Bread
instructions: You will need a large glass jar and cheesecloth.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into pieces. Dice onion. Put potatoes and onion into a large pan; just barely cover with water and simmer until very soft. Drain and mash by hand. There should still be small lumps. Put back into pan and cover with milk until very fluid and soup consistency. Add herbs salt and pepper to taste. Heat over very low heat just until slightly bubbling. Pour over cheese cubes in bowl and serve with crackers.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust until light brown. Layer tomato and onion. Mix cheese and mayonnaise. Spread over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Breaded Pork Chops(An Easy Meal Is Pork Chops.)
instructions: In a bowl mix egg yolk salt and milk. Moisten chops with damp cloth. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the cracker crumbs and dip into mixture. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on chops and place in baking dish. Add water. Cover and bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven turning chops several times. Serves 4.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large pan. Cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 hours or until thickened stirring occasionally. Remove cinnamon sticks and pour into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Adjust lids. Process 15 minutes in a boiling water bath. Yield 4 1/2 quarts. (Process tomatoes in blender or food processor for a smoother sauce.)

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Mix the cornmeal milk eggs and corn together. Brown ground beef and drain. Pour half of the cornmeal batter into greased 15 x 9-inch pan or skillet. Put in layers the cheese meat onion and pepper. Pour on remaining batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Sweet Cabbage Haluska
instructions: Chop or grate cabbage until fine. Put into a heavy skillet with butter; cook over low heat until lightly browned and tender. Fry onion in butter until lightly browned. Add to cabbage. Combine with the cooked noodles.

title: Dilly Bread
instructions: Heat together the egg onion butter and cottage cheese then cool slightly. Mix yeast and water together and add to egg mixture. Then add the remaining ingredients. Pour into a casserole dish (1 1/2 to 2-quart) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Fast Fixin' Swiss Steak
instructions: Place steak in shallow roasting pan. Pour tomatoes over top of steak. Slice carrots onion and celery; sprinkle over steak. Cover with tinfoil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Let potatoes thaw; mix all other ingredients together. Then add potatoes. Put in casserole and top with crumbs and melted butter or margarine. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Place dried beef in bottom of lightly greased casserole dish. Place chicken on top of beef. Lightly sprinkle salt pepper celery seed and rosemary on the chicken. Cover with another layer of dried beef. Mix soup and sour cream together; pour on top of chicken and beef. Bake in oven for 2 hours at 325\u00b0 or for 1 hour at 400\u00b0.

title: Chicken Gumbo Sloppy Joes
instructions: Cook hamburger meat and drain off excess fat. In skillet with hamburger add soup ketchup mustard salt and pepper. Heat this mixture until it bubbles then serve on a hamburger bun.

title: Cherry Torte
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until frothy. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff; add vanilla. Fold in soda crackers and broken nuts. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let cool.

title: Big Cookie
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in mixer. Stir in chocolate chips. Pat mixture in 2 pizza pans. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: One Dish Chicken And Stuffing Bake
instructions: Mix stuffing 1/2 cup boiling water and 1 tablespoon margarine. Spoon stuffing across center of 3-quart shallow baking dish. Place chicken on each side of stuffing. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Bake uncovered an additional 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

title: Golden Nuggets
instructions: Cook and drain carrots. Mix all ingredients; marinate overnight in refrigerator.

title: Unstuffed Cabbage
instructions: Crumble beef into 4 to 5-quart Dutch oven. Add onions and cook over medium-high heat until beef is browned (5 to 7 minutes). Quarter and core cabbage. Cut in strips (1 inch wide). Add to meat. Cover and cook over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes until cabbage wilts.

title: Quick Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Soak yeast in warm water. Pour milk over sugar and salt. Add yeast stir in shortening eggs and 2 cups flour. Cover. Let rise 15 minutes. Stir in rest of flour. Knead lightly. Divide dough in half. Roll out on flour surface into a thin circle. Spread dough with softened butter brown sugar nuts raisins and cinnamon. Roll up and slice about 1 inch thick. Let rise 20 minutes in pans. Bake at 425\u00b0. 15-18 minutes. Frost with icing made with butter milk and powdered sugar.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Melt chips in top of double boiler over low heat. Stir until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in milk butter and vanilla. Blend until butter is blended with chocolate. Stir in nuts. Spread mixture immediately into a lightly oiled 8-inch square pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Tostada Dip
instructions: Saute ground beef; add onion and taco seasoning. Mix as directed on package. In crock-pot put ground beef mixture refried beans tomato and Cheddar cheese soup. Let simmer; stir occasionally. Add grated cheese on top before serving.

title: Butterfinger Cookies
instructions: Bake on 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients by hand and pour into greased 8 or 9-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 (glass dish 325\u00b0) for 30 minutes.

title: Coffee Jello
instructions: Dissolve envelope of unflavored jello in cold water. Add sweetened coffee and lemon juice. When cool cover and refrigerate to harden. Serve with whipped cream or topping or vanilla ice cream. This sounds strange but its very good.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Boil the shrimp in Tonys seasoning until they are cooked. Drain them and mix the shrimp chopped vegetables lettuce sauce mayonnaise olive oil and Tonys well. Serve on a bed of lettuce with Captains wafers.

title: Quick Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium saucepan. Heat over medium heat; bring to boil then simmer 15 minutes.

title: Beer Batter Fish
instructions: Beat 1 egg white until stiff fold into other ingredients. Dip fish and deep-fry.

title: Sausage Gravy And Biscuits
instructions: Brown in heavy skillet 1 pound sausage. Leave some bits to stick to bottom of skillet and brown. This gives good flavor and color to gravy. Remove browned sausage to plate. Leave about 1/4 cup of drippings in skillet. (If too lean add margarine to make 1/4 cup.)

title: Taylor'S Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half; skin legs and 8 thighs (optional). Bring to boil in 4-quart pan for 15 to 25 minutes. Remove and place in shallow pan. Cover with sauce. Grill or broil until brown.

title: Creamed Beets
instructions: Combine vinegar butter salt pepper and 1 tablespoon water in saucepan. Bring to boiling point. Stir in sour cream and beets. Cook over low heat until beets are heated through.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Beat egg lightly add water then salmon bread crumbs onion salt melted butter. Mix well. Mold into a loaf. Bake in a greased pan at 325\u00b0. Serve plain or with tomato sauce.

title: Trish'S Polska Kielbasa Soup
instructions: Combine chicken broth water Polska kielbasa and carrots. Simmer for one hour then add cabbage and broccoli. Simmer until tender then add instant potatoes to desired thickness. Pepper to taste. Knorr all-purpose seasoning to taste.

title: Ice Cream Peach Pie
instructions: Make Jell-O; mix 1 cup of ice cream until well blended. Add Cool Whip and fold in peaches. Pour into pie shell. Keep in fridge 3 to 4 hours before serving. Substitute with your favorite flavor.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and bone chicken breast break into pieces. Cook Rice-A-Roni as directed on pkg. Combine above with soup and mayonnaise. Put in greased casserole dish. Bake 350\u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Cream egg yolks with sugar. Mix dry ingredients. Add milk and dry ingredients alternating. Add salt. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in batter.

title: Three Cheese Spinach Roll-Ups
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook noodles according to package directions. Cool in a bowl of cold water; set aside. Saute onion and red pepper with 3 tablespoons of butter until tender about 5 minutes. Combine spinach onion red pepper 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella Ricotta 1/2 cup Parmesan and egg; set aside.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Orange Delight
instructions: Put orange sections in bowl. Mix with cinnamon and honey. Add coconut. Let flavors blend at room temperature for 10 to 30 minutes.

title: Linguini With Clam Sauce
instructions: Chop parsley and garlic together. Heat oil; add chopped parsley and garlic. Saute 10 seconds. Add clams and liquid. Add pepper to taste. Heat through about 5 minutes. Pour over cooked linguini.

title: Potato Ring
instructions: Cook potatoes and mash; add remaining ingredients. Put in ring mold; sprinkle with caraway seed. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown or make potato pancakes and fry in skillet. Serves 8.

title: Baked Stuffed Red Fish
instructions: Melt shortening in frying pan. Add bread crumbs. Stir until crumbs are golden brown then add seasonings and salt.

title: Healthful Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugars. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla. Mix together all dry ingredients (dont sift). Add to creamed mixture. Stir in raisins pecans and carrots.

title: Firecrackers
instructions: Place about 1/4 cup of potato salad in center of each slice of boiled ham. Roll up. Secure with toothpicks. Stick a\tsmall sprig of parsley in one end of each roll for a fuse. Kinda purty and real easy.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Saute onions and green peppers in 3 tablespoons of oil until onions are yellow. Add ground beef and brown. Drain off grease and add salt pepper chili powder rice and tomatoes. Mix well and pour into casserole dish. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Asparagus, Shrimp And Shells Bake
instructions: Cook pasta to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain. Meanwhile heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 2-quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Melt margarine in medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add garlic; cook about 1 minute. Stir in flour salt and pepper until well blended; cook until bubbly. Gradually add milk stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens. Reduce heat to low. Stir in 1 cup of the cheese. Cook stirring constantly until smooth. Remove from heat. Add cooked pasta shrimp asparagus and parsley; toss gently to mix. Pour into sprayed casserole. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover; sprinkle with remaining 1 cup cheese. Bake uncovered an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until casserole is bubbly and cheese is melted.

title: Kool-Aid Punch
instructions: Place all ingredients except ginger ale in a 1-gallon container. Add enough water to make 1 gallon. Freeze several hours before serving; remove punch from freezer. Allow it to get to a slushy stage.

title: Sausage Puffs
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Form into 1-inch balls; place on cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Skillet Apples
instructions: Over medium heat in a 10-inch skillet melt butter. Then add sugar and cornstarch mix well. Add water cinnamon and apples; cover for 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Spoon sauce over apples occasionally.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together in a pan. Add milk and butter. Bring to a boil. Boil for one minute. Remove from heat and stir. Cool for about 5 to 10 minutes. Add vanilla. Put on cake.

title: Lime Punch
instructions: Follow\tdirections on\tpackage to dissolve jello then add sugar. Stir well. Add can of frozen lemonade then add pineapple juice water and food coloring. Refrigerate.

title: Foiled Trout
instructions: Chop the vegetables fine and saute them in 1/4 cup butter until tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Split and clean the trout; stuff each with the vegetables. Dot with butter and place 3 inches from the broiler. Broil 4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Place fish in foil. Crimp edges of foil to seal. Oil the foil. Place on buttered cookie sheets and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole #2
instructions: Mix Bisquick corn egg oil and milk. Pour half mixture into a greased pan. Sprinkle chilies and cheese on this. Pour the rest of the mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Creamy Ham Quiche
instructions: Line a 9-inch quiche dish or pie pan with pastry. Trim excess pastry around edges. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3 minutes. Remove from oven. Gently prick with a fork. Bake 5 minutes longer. Let cool on a rack. Place ham in pastry shell. Top with cheese and sprinkle with nutmeg. Beat eggs until foamy. Stir in half and half and seasonings. Pour over cheese in pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm. Yields 1 (9-inch) quiche.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Layer in pan. Cover with 1 bag stuffing. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. May add vegetables if desired.

title: Pecan Pork Loin Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Melt oleo and put apples or raspberries (or fruit of choice) into melted oleo mixture; then pour first mixture over it in a 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Curried Limas And Chicken Wings
instructions: Pick over beans and rinse under running water. Combine beans and water in a large kettle; cover and soak overnight. Bring soaked beans to a boil over low heat. Partially cover and simmer 35 minutes or until beans are almost tender. Cut each wing at joint to separate the 2 large sections. Melt butter in a large skillet; add the wings and cook slowly until brown. Remove wings to paper toweling to drain when brown. Add onion carrots curry powder and cinnamon to fat remaining in skillet. Saute until onion is tender. Stir in flour and salt. Drain beans reserving liquid. Reserve 2 cups; if needed add enough water to have 2 cups of liquid. Add remaining liquid to flour mixture; cook stirring constantly until thickened and boiling. Add milk and peas; bring to a boil. Combine beans chicken wings and curry sauce in a 3 to 4-quart baking dish. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until beans are tender stirring halfway through baking.

title: Jefferson Davis Pie
instructions: Combine coconut raisins and pecans; place in uncooked pie shell. In a bowl whisk together margarine salt vanilla sugar eggs milk and flour. Pour in pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour until top is golden brown. Makes 8 servings.

title: Potpourri
instructions: Simmer on the back burner during the day and evening. It gives a lovely fragrance throughout the house.

title: Treasure Cookies
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs peanut butter and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and soda. Mix thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from baking sheet at once. Yields 3 dozen cookies.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Put rice on bottom of 9 x 9-inch casserole dish. Set aside. Brown pork chops. Put pork chops on top of rice. Put a thick slice of tomato green pepper and onion on each chop. Sprinkle with spices and pour beef consomme on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Pops
instructions: You will need 4 wooden sticks.

title: All Time Favorite Grape-Nuts Pudding
instructions: Combine eggs sugar salt and vanilla in mixing bowl. Add scalded milk gradually mixing thoroughly. Pour into six custard cups or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with Grape-Nuts. Dot with butter. Place custard cups or casserole in pan of hot water. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serves six.

title: Sour Cream And Cranberry Pork
instructions: Slice the pork into about 2-inch thick slices. Make an indentation in each slice. Combine parsley and garlic and pack into the indentations. Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a medium frying pan and saute the pork slices in the hot butter first on the unstuffed side and then turning onto the stuffed side. When lightly browned remove from the pan and set aside. Melt remaining butter in the same pan. Add the flour and milk to make a smooth sauce. Return the meat to the pan; cover and simmer 20 minutes turning once. Add sour cream and the cranberry sauce and heat through. Serve over a platter of noodles. Serves 4.

title: Shoe Maker'S Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a saucepan over a medium flame heat the apples without water until very tender stir occasionally. Watch closely or will burn. Mash the apples and sugar to taste. Add raisins melted butter and then the yolks. Gently fold in egg whites and mix well. Butter a 9-inch spring-form pan and sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the bread crumbs to make an even coating. Pour half the apple mixture in the pan and sprinkle the top with the other 1/2 cup of bread crumbs. Then add remainder of apple mixture and top with the other 1/2 cup crumbs. Bake for about 50 minutes until the cake is firm and light brown. Remove cool and remove ring. Serve cut into wedges with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Parboil the zucchini. Cut each zucchini in half lengthwise. Scoop out seeds and discard. Scoop out zucchini meat and dice. Mix zucchini with bread crumbs shredded cheese onion and eggs. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Stuff zucchini shells with this mixture. Top with shredded cheese or Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour until golden brown on top.

title: Granny'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook eggs vinegar and sugar in double boiler on low heat stirring all the time. When thick take off heat and add 2 Tbsp. butter. Cool mixture. Add whipped whipping cream. In another bowl add pineapple fruit cocktail marshmallows cherries and nuts. Mix with cream mixture. Keep in refrigerator. Freezes well too.

title: Candied Yams
instructions: Cut up sweet potatoes and place in a lightly greased shallow baking dish. In a small pan melt butter. Stir in cornstarch salt and cinnamon. Cook and stir for a minute or 2; pour evenly over potatoes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Cranberry Tea
instructions: Place tea allspice cinnamon and nutmeg in a bag and steep in boiling water for 5 minutes. Stir in the cherry gelatin and let mixture cool. Add the orange juice lemon juice cranberry juice and the sugar. Mix until sugar is dissolved. Serve warm keep any extra in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Barely cook broccoli; place in buttered casserole dish. Add a layer of chicken pieces. Cover with sauce (soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder). Put sauce over chicken. Cover with 1 1/2 cups grated Cheddar cheese. Top with bread crumbs mixed with 2 tablespoons melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt Hershey bar in microwave. Mix with Cool Whip and pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Gismonda
instructions: Pound out chicken breasts. Dip in beaten eggs and seasoned bread crumbs. Fry in oil until done. Clean and slice mushrooms. In a separate pan saute mushrooms in butter. Cook spinach according to directions on box. Drain thoroughly. Heat au jus wine and cornstarch. Add mushrooms to au jus.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Cook drain and cool pepe in refrigerator. Drain fruit and save all fruit juices. In saucepan cook eggs flour sugar and juices until thickened. Cool in refrigerator. Mix all fruit pepe and marshmallows with thickened pudding like. Fold in Cool Whip. Delicious . . . Delicious.

title: Rocks
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and beat. Whip egg whites and fold in. Mix in vanilla. Remove 1/4 cup flour and put aside. Sift flour with cloves nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Mix 1/4 cup flour with nuts and raisins to separate them. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture. Stir well. Add soda in water and mix. Add floured nuts and raisins. Mix well. Drop by spoonful about size of unshelled walnut on cookie sheet. Do not smooth down. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Keep in covered can. Makes 12-14 dozen cookies.

title: Sweet And Spicy Curry Dip
instructions: In a 1-quart saucepan heat the chutney and curry powder for 1 minute stirring frequently. Cool slightly. In a small bowl combine curry mixture and pepper sauce. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Leaves(Greece)
instructions: Brown meat and onions until meat is crumbly and onion golden in color. Add rice and rest of ingredients; simmer 10 minutes. In separate container boil cabbage until slightly tender. Separate leaves and cool. (If cabbage leaves are too large cut in half.) Place one heaping tablespoonful of filling on each leaf and roll in ball shape. Arrange a few of the outer leaves in medium kettle. Arrange cabbage rolls close together in kettle over leaves. Add chicken broth or water to cover. Place a heavy plate over rolls so they will not break during cooking. Cover kettle and cook for 35 minutes or until rice is tender. Pour off all liquid reserving it to make Egg-Lemon Sauce (Avogolemeno Sauce).

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Layer uncooked chicken in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Place frozen broccoli on top. Add undiluted soup mix. Place on top of broccoli. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Crumb crackers and sprinkle all over pan. Melt butter and pour over entire pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese-Rice Fondue(More Like A Souffle)
instructions: Heat rice Cheddar cheese and milk until cheese melts. Add margarine salt and pepper. Add beaten egg yolks and then the beaten egg whites. Pour into a greased baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine ground beef and chili powder in large skillet; cook over medium heat until browned. Stir in next 5 ingredients; cook covered for 5 minutes. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole.

title: Hot Chili(For Cold Days)
instructions: Brown meat in oil; drain. Combine all ingredients. Serve with crackers and cheese. Grate cheese on chili.

title: Frozen Fruit Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water; let cool. Add juice and fruit. Pour into trays; let freeze. Thaw 20 minutes before serving. Scoop into glass and pour 7-Up over top.

title: French Toast(Baked)
instructions: Line the bottom of greased 9 x 13 pan. With 1/2 of the bread cubes layer; put the cream cheese on top. Beat the eggs syrup milk and oleo and rest of bread. Pour over bread cubes. Let set. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Mock Chicken Loaf
instructions: Saute onion and celery in margarine until tender. Then add garlic powder and savorex stirring until softened and mixed. In a large mixing bowl combine bread crumbs cream eggs cottage cheese oats and gravy mix. After blending add the sauteed onions and celery. Bake in 2 large loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until nicely browned.

title: Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Place biscuits into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer ground beef pizza sauce and cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick Midget Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into loaf and place in microwavable pan. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook at Medium power for 14 to 16 minutes.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Pour milk into double boiler. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and flour. Pour into milk and cook until thick. Cool custard. Beat egg whites and vanilla. Add to custard.

title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Beat eggs and add brown sugar and milk. Add salt vanilla baking powder and cinnamon. Stir altogether. Stir in the oatmeal. Put in a large lightly buttered baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Punch For All
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients then add sugar and water. Stir all together. Can be stored in refrigerator. Before serving add ginger ale. May also use as needed. Add 1/4 cup ginger ale to 1 cup punch. Refreshing!

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar eggs oil and vanilla. Mix in rest of ingredients. If dough is too stiff add a very small amount of milk. The dough should look dry but hold together when rolled in hands. Roll in small balls and flatten on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Be careful when you take from cookie sheet for they tend to break until cool. Makes large batch. This is an old old recipe. In fact I used to store them in a lard can or in a dishpan covered with a cloth. Very good.

title: Never-Fail Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs thoroughly. Add mixed together flour and sugar. Add milk and beat. Add corn and melted butter. Pour into well-buttered casserole. Cook in 400\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Do not stir.

title: Gapirotada(Bread Pudding)
instructions: In the medium saucepan bring the water brown sugar and cinnamon to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 3 minutes. Stir in butter. Cut toast in 1-inch pieces. Fold into the sugar mixture along with raisins and nuts.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar until well blended. Cut cake in half to make 2 layers. Spread cream cheese mixture between layers; pour glaze and strawberries over top. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together all other ingredients except Cheddar cheese. (Do not drain broccoli.) Pour batter over butter. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan. Can prepare ahead and refrigerate until ready to bake.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Cook and drain potatoes. Beat cream cheese sour cream and milk at medium speed. Add hot potatoes gradually beating constantly. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Pheasant Steak
instructions: Use only the breast of pheasant. Cut into steaks. Roll steaks in flour mixture. Cook in 1/4 cup butter which has been melted in a skillet. Cook 3 to 5 minutes turning once. Prepare at least 1 pheasant per hungry rancher! The other parts can be used in casseroles.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Sift together the dry ingredients; add well beaten egg and melted shortening and enough milk to make fairly moist stiff batter. Drop by spoonful into boiling liquid. Cover very closely; cook 18 minutes. Delicious!

title: Snow Ice Cream
instructions: Beat first four ingredients together until well blended. Gently fold in fluffy clean snow until the liquid is mushy thick. Eat immediately. Serves 4.

title: Salsa (Hot)
instructions: Combine and simmer about 20 minutes. Process in hot water bath for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: In mixing bowl soften cream cheese on Medium (50%) for 2 minutes. Blend in 1/3 cup sugar 1/2 teaspoon flavoring and egg. Pour into cooked pie crust. Microwave on Medium-high (70%) 6 minutes rotating once if necessary.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and 1/2 cup brown sugar. Add water vanilla and egg yolks (reserve egg whites in separate bowl) and beat 2 minutes. Beat in flour salt baking soda and powder. Spread batter in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Beat egg whites until they form soft peaks then add 1/2 cup brown sugar. Spread over chips and sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake for 35 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Christmas Morning Wife Saver
instructions: In a buttered 9 x 13-inch glass dish place 8 slices of bread. Cover with bacon then cheese and top with bread to resemble a sandwich. Beat eggs in bowl; add remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. In the morning melt butter (or margarine) and pour over top. Add crushed corn flakes. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let sit 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8.

title: Spice Cider
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large pan or kettle. Heat just to boiling and then simmer 10 to 15 minutes. You can also use a large coffee pot placing spices in basket. Perk and serve.

title: Oreo Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Crush cookies (food processor works well) spread 1/2 of crumbs over 9 X 13 pan. Let ice cream and cool whip soften in large bowl add vanilla and mix well. Spread over crumbs and sprinkle with the rest of crumbs. Keep in freezer. Keeps well.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat the eggs sugar vanilla and oil until fluffy. Add zucchini to the mixture. Sift flour and add soda salt baking powder and cinnamon. Add crushed pineapple raisins and nuts. Place into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Fruit Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Combine fruit flour sugar lemon juice 1/2 teaspoon of salt and orange juice. Put into greased cake pan.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: In a medium bowl combine first four ingredients. Add apples and celery. Toss to mix well. Cover and chill. Just before serving sprinkle with walnuts. Makes 5 cups.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Spread pecans and coconut in a greased 9X12 inch pan. Mix cake mix as directed on box. Pour over pecans and coconut. In a separate bowl melt cream cheese and butter together. Add powdered sugar to this mixture. Pour over cake mix. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes.

title: Stir Fry Veggies #3
instructions: Heat broth in a wok. Saute onion garlic and ginger root until onion is transparent. Add carrots celery and broccoli. Mix well. Add 3 tablespoons water cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes over high heat. Add water chestnuts and scallions. Cook 1 minute more then add bean sprouts and soy sauce. Stir until well mixed and sprouts are heated through. Vegetables should be tender yet crisp. Must serve immediately. Makes 2 servings.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed; drain. In large bowl combine spaghetti dressing vinegar onion pepper pimentos and salad seasoning. Mix thoroughly and chill well before serving.

title: Favorite Chicken Breast
instructions: Whisk juice and dressing mix together. Marinate breasts in 1/2 juice mixture for 2 to 24 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cranberry Pineapple Salad
instructions: In a bowl dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Break up and stir in cranberry sauce. Add pineapple orange juice and lemon juice. Chill until partially set. Stir in nuts. Pour into 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish. Chill until firm. Cut into squares. Serve on lettuce with a dollop of mayonnaise. Yields 12 servings.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spoon pie filling evenly into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cover with pineapple. Sprinkle cake mix over pineapple. Pour melted butter over top. Sprinkle with coconut and pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Let stand 24 hours in refrigerator so that flavors will blend. Delicious served with fresh vegetables cut up. Also good served with ???.

title: Magically Moist Chicken
instructions: Brush chicken on all sides with Hellmanns real mayonnaise. Place bread crumbs in large plastic food bag. Add chicken one piece at a time; shake to coat well. Place on rack in broiler pan. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender. Makes four servings.

title: Pie-Cake Mix Dessert
instructions: Pour pie filling into an 8 or 9-inch baking pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Pour melted margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

title: Lo-Cal Blueberry Jam
instructions: In a saucepan mash blueberries. Stir in pectin and lemon juice. Bring to a boil; boil 1 minute. Remove from heat; stir in sweetener. Stir for 2 minutes. Spoon into jars. Cool; cover seal and refrigerate. Yield 1 1/2 pints.

title: Raisin-Nut Bread
instructions: Mix walnuts raisins baking soda and salt with a fork. Add shortening and water. Let stand 20 minutes. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Add to this mixture the eggs vanilla sugar and flour mixing only to blend. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake 1 hour.

title: Betsy Goodie Bar
instructions: In top of double boiler over simmering water melt chocolate with butter. Remove from heat. Beat in dry milk powder peanut butter and vanilla with wire whisk or beater until fairly smooth. Stir in peanuts and raisins. Spread in buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 48 2-inch bars.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use 3 teaspoons of mix for 1 cup of tea.

title: Barbecued Chicken(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix all ingredients for sauce in saucepan. Heat thoroughly. Parboil chicken. Dip chicken in sauce and cook on grill until done. This sauce is delicious so serve the sauce in a small bowl on each plate for dipping the chicken while eating. Be sure to have potatoes and bread with this so you can dip that too.

title: Chocolate Bread Pudding
instructions: Place into 1 1/2-quart baking dish the bread cubes. Blend together other ingredients and pour over bread. Place baking dish in pan of hot water (1 inch deep). Bake until done about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 6 servings.

title: Oreo Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Line bottom of oblong glass baking dish with 1/2 the cookies. Mix ice cream and Cool Whip with mixer; pour 1/2 over cookies in dish. Add remaining cookies then cover with remaining ice cream and Cool Whip mixture. Cover and let freeze overnight. Set out of freezer a few minutes before serving.

title: *Bean Soup
instructions: Cover beans with water and baking soda overnight. Drain. Place beans in pot with water. Add paprika onions carrots and celery. Bring to a boil. Add 1/4 cup oil. Let it boil for 5 minutes. Cover and simmer for 2 hours or until tender. Add tomato sauce and stir. When beans are tender (not mushy) add salt pepper and parsley. Tastes better the second day.

title: Oven Fried Chicken With Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt margarine in baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch) in oven. Mix baking mix salt paprika and pepper; coat chicken and place skin side down. Bake uncovered 35 minutes. Insert clove in each peach half.

title: Stuff
instructions: Brown meat. Drain grease. Add corn beans and seasoning mix. Cook until good and hot in greased casserole with cornbread mixture on top. Sprinkle cheese on top. Mix cornbread according to box directions. Bake until bread is done or lightly brown. Bell peppers and onion are optional.

title: Pancit
instructions: Cook garlic in oil until barely brown. Add celery and carrots and stir-fry about 1 minute. Add zucchini onion and pork. Stir-fry about 1 minute. Use 1 packet from noodles to flavor. Cook noodles according to directions on pack but use only 1 flavor packet. Drain noodles and toss together with stir-fried vegetables. Season with soy sauce to taste.

title: Busy Day Dinner
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer gently covered for 30 minutes. Add more water if a thinner stew is desired.

title: Aunt Catherine'S Cracker Pudding
instructions: Cook all together; beat whites of eggs for top. Brown in oven.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Spoon dough onto cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until slightly brown.

title: No Bake Fudge Cookies
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar milk and butter. Boil for 1 minute. Take off heat then add peanut butter oats cocoa and vanilla. Stir together very well. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Let stand 1 hour. Makes 4 dozen. More like candy than a cookie.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Press the rolls on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. After cooling spread mixture on top. Top with broccoli cheese or whatever you would like for a topping (vegetables finely chopped are great)!

title: Lemon Rice
instructions: Melt margarine/butter in saucepan. Add rice; cook 1 to 2 minutes stirring until rice grains become opaque and glisten. Add water bouillon cube lemon peel and salt; stir until cube is dissolved. Cover. Cook over low heat about 10 minutes. Remove lemon peel. Stir. Continue to cook until liquid is absorbed about 20 minutes until rice is tender. Combine eggs and grated cheese. Stir into hot rice. Cook over low heat 2 to 3 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice Bake
instructions: Grease bottom of 2-quart casserole dish. Spread wild rice over bottom of dish. Sprinkle rice seasoning evenly over top of rice. Place chicken on top of rice. In saucepan heat soup and water until boiling. Pour soup evenly over chicken. Sprinkle Mrs. Dash on top to taste. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake another 20 to 30 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender. Serves 4.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender. Drain. Arrange stalks in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Lay chicken on top. Combine next 3 ingredients and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes until heated.

title: Healthy Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Place bread evenly in 8-inch square baking dish coated with cooking spray. Layer ham red pepper and cheese over bread and set aside. Combine milk and next 4 ingredients. Pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours. Remove from refrigerator; let stand 30 minutes. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Texas Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for melted butter and mix well. Pour into ungreased 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes. After bread is done pour melted butter over top evenly and allow to soak.

title: Pickle-In-A-Blanket
instructions: Will also need toothpicks.

title: Oriental Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: About 40 minutes before serving prepare thin spaghetti as label directs; drain. Meanwhile cut red pepper and cucumber into matchstick-thin strips. Thinly slice green onion. Set aside.

title: Pan Coating
instructions: Mix together well; store in container in refrigerator. Very good for preparing cake pans.

title: Creamy Pepper Dip
instructions: In medium bowl stir cream cheese until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover; refrigerate until serving time at least 2 hours. Serve with fresh vegetables or crackers for dipping. Makes about 1 1/4 cups. Do not double recipe.

title: Baked French Toast
instructions: Butter both sides of bread. Lay half of bread on bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with raisins. Top with remaining bread slices. Mix eggs with milk; add vanilla cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour over bread slices. Poke holes in bread with fork so bread will soak up egg mix. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and heat. Fill large size tortillas with mixture of the olives onions cheese and chicken. Roll tortillas and place in a baking pan opening side down. Pour sauce over tortillas; sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar syrup water salt and peanuts in a 2-quart glass bowl. Microwave on High for 5 minutes; stir. Microwave for 13 minutes or until syrup separates into threads. Stir in margarine soda and vanilla until light and bubbly. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet; spread into a thin layer. Cool and break into pieces. Yield 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Chunky Ham Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package and drain. Mix together soup milk cheese salt pepper and ham. Add macaroni and mix well. Pour into buttered dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with cheese lightly.

title: Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking soda and salt together. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually creaming until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks; beat until very light. Add vanilla and lemon extract; blend well. Add dry ingredients alternately with combined buttermilk and vinegar. Beat until batter is smooth. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into greased 7 x 10 x 2-inch loaf pan or 2 (8-inch) layer cake pans. Bake loaf at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes; layers at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Frost with Orange Frosting.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Thaw and drain vegetables in colander. Combine cream of mushroom soup sour cream and 1/2 cup of Swiss cheese. Stir in the vegetables. Put into the microwave on High for 8 minutes. Be sure to cover with wax paper. Take out of the microwave and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of Swiss cheese and can of Durkee French fried onions. Cover with wax paper and microwave for 3 minutes on High.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: *I prefer to use the low-fat or fat-free cream cheese!

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into baking dish. Pour 1 or 2 cups broth that chicken was cooked in over mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: U.M.W.'S Cranberry Salad For 36
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in first amount of cold water. Dissolve cherry jello and sugar in hot water. Add gelatin and stir until all ingredients are thoroughly dissolved. Coarsely grind cranberries and oranges. Finely chop apples and celery. Thoroughly mix all ingredients except lettuce and refrigerate in rectangular pans overnight. Cut into serving squares on lettuce leaf.

title: Chocolate Chip Dessert
instructions: Dip each cookie in sweet milk and layer cookies in pan. Put cool whip between layers. Can add nuts on top.

title: Lemon Bar Cookies
instructions: Mix milk with lemon juice and rind. Set aside. Mix flour baking powder salt butter or margarine sugar and oatmeal. Pat mixture in bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan saving 1/3 mixture for top. Pat firmly. Pour lemon/condensed milk mixture over cookie mixture. Pat remaining crumbs on top firmly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut into squares when cool. Decorate with cherry bits. Store in airtight tin in refrigerator.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Blend sugars and shortening. Add egg and vanilla. Mix in dry ingredients. Stir in nuts and pineapple. Drop from spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Ice with confectioners icing made with pineapple juice.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Mix 1 cup Bisquick and water until a soft dough. Pat in an 8 x 8-inch pan pressing up sides.

title: Chicken And Yellow Rice Combo
instructions: Combine chicken badia sazon seasoning salt and pepper cut up bell peppers onion and drained mixed vegetables (if used); cover with 2 cups water and cook on medium heat until done and there is approximately 1 cup of water remaining in the pot. Then add 2 cups of rice and 3 cups of water; boil on medium heat for 20 minutes. Turn heat down to low; cover with lid for 20 more minutes until rice is done.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Mix together and drop by tablespoonful on greased pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown.

title: Broccoli  Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a 13 x 9 glass pan for best results. Its very moist and needs to be baked thin. Grease pan well and bake for 30 minute at 400\u00b0.

title: Millet Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in covered casserole dish for one hour at 350\u00b0; or bring to boil on stove top and simmer 1 1/2 hours.

title: Diet Cake
instructions: Cook together until dry the box of raisins and two cups of water. Cool. Add rest of ingredients and bake in greased and floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Philadelphia Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients until thick and smooth. Add more confectioners sugar to your desired consistency.

title: Sausage And Rice
instructions: Cut sausage in chunks combine with next four ingredients in large skillet on medium heat. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in peas and mushrooms. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Simmer covered for 20 minutes or until rice is cooked.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread rolls on a cookie sheet. Bake 7 to 8 minutes at temperature on package. Cool. Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and dressing mix; spoon on rolls. Sprinkle chopped vegetables on dressing and add cheese on top. Chill for 2 hours; cut in small squares and serve. You may also cut the squares before adding vegetables because it is easier.

title: Easy Caramel Bars
instructions: Thaw but dont raise 2 loaves bread dough. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Tear one loaf of dough in pan. Mix butter brown sugar pudding mix milk and cinnamon together. Pour over dough. Sprinkle nuts over the top. Tear second loaf and place pieces on top of filling. Let rise at room temperature for 2 1/2 hours. Bake 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chocolate Chip Crisscross Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add egg and vanilla. Sift flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt and add to creamed mixture. Add nuts and chocolate chips. Roll dough into 3/4-inch balls. Press with fork dipped in flour on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening brown sugar and eggs. Mix flour salt baking powder and soda together then add to creamed mixture. Add vanilla and oats. Mix well and place in refrigerator until chilled. Roll into balls about the size of walnuts then roll balls in powdered sugar. Place approximately 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes.

title: Ras-Cranberry Ice
instructions: Poach cranberries in water for 10 minutes then run through sieve with raspberries. Add Equal and lemon juice; place in 1/2 to 1 cup containers. Place in freezer until very slushy. Serve.

title: Turkey Vegetable Noodle Soup
instructions: Add vegetables to turkey broth along with salt and noodles; simmer 15 minutes. Add turkey; heat thoroughly and serve. Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Chicken
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a casserole dish (except margarine and stuffing). Combine margarine and stuffing and put on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hot Cheese And Crab Dip
instructions: Cut cheeses in small pieces; combine in a saucepan with milk. Stir over low heat until cheeses melt. Stir in wine and crab; heat through. Serve in chafing dish with Shredded Wheat wafers. Makes 3 cups.

title: Cinnamon Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening 1 1/2 cup sugar and eggs. Stir in flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Chill for 1 hour. Shape into small balls (a little larger than marbles). Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown. They will rise and fall just before they finish baking.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pudding mix with Cool Whip. Stir in drained pineapple and marshmallows. Refrigerate until set.

title: Simple Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix together 1/4 cup of the mushroom soup bread crumbs egg and onion. Shape into 6 patties. Cook patties over medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Set aside. Drain off fat. Stir in remaining soup mixture and mushrooms in skillet. Reduce to low. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until patties are cooked completely through.

title: Beer Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients well adjusting the sugar according to how sweet a biscuit you want. Pour into greased muffin tins. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with honey butter.

title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar with wire whisk until smooth. Stir in Cool Whip; spread on bottom of crust.

title: Shrimp Souffle
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; stir in flour until blended. Gradually stir in milk. Add salt paprika and curry powder. When sauce is thick and boiling stir in shrimp. Beat well in a separate bowl the egg yolks. Stir part of the sauce into them. When well blended pour this mixture into the saucepan. Stir the sauce over very low heat for a minute to permit the yolks to thicken slightly. Remove from heat and add Worcestershire sauce. Cool. Whip egg whites with 1/8 teaspoon salt until stiff. Fold lightly into the sauce. Bake in ungreased 9-inch baking dish at 325\u00b0. After 10 minutes increase heat slightly. Bake until firm for about 35 minutes.

title: Simple Basic Yeast Dough - No Kneading
instructions: Add yeast to water; let stand a few minutes. Stir to dissolve. Combine milk margarine and sugar; heat to about 120\u00b0. Cool; add eggs salt and 2 cups of flour. Beat thoroughly. Stir into yeast mixture. Blend in remaining flour; beat 5 minutes. Do not knead. Brush with shortening. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Turn out on lightly floured surface. Knead 1 minute. Shape into rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Braised Onion Sauce
instructions: Melt butter. Add onions and cook them over medium heat until they are soft and transparent. Stir in the sugar; reduce the heat and cook very slowly for about 1 hour. Stir in the wine; cook briefly and pour over cooked pasta. Sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Manicotti With Spinach And Cheese Crepes(12 Entree Crepes)
instructions: Put spinach in mixing bowl with salt pepper garlic powder onion powder nutmeg Ricotta cheese eggs 1 1/2 cups Jack cheese and Parmesan cheese. Stir to mix well. Divide mixture evenly among crepes and roll up. Place crepes in a single layer in greased shallow baking dish. Cover with foil. Dish can be refrigerated at this point. Before serving bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Remove foil and sprinkle with remaining Jack cheese. Bake uncovered 5 minutes more or until cheese has melted.

title: Yule Bowl
instructions: Stick the oranges full of the cloves and bake until soft. Pour the rum and sugar over them and set them aflame (do this in a flameproof pot). Extinguish with the cider add the spices and keep hot over a low flame or in a crock pot until ready to serve. Very elegant in a punch bowl. Serves 10-12.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Make pudding. Mix pudding with Cool Whip. Chop up fruit of your choice and dip into mixture.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar salt and flour.\tAdd chocolate melted in scalded milk. Cook until thick then add butter and eggs. Cook 2 minutes longer and add vanilla. Cool before putting in baked pastry shell. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chili Verde
instructions: Put all in crock-pot without water. Cook on low for 3 to 4 hours. Before serving add flour and water for gravy. (If not hot enough add 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper.) Adjust seasonings to taste.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Stew chicken with salt onion and celery. Bone and cut chicken into small pieces. Cook broccoli and drain. Place broccoli in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Place chicken in next. Mix soup mayonnaise lemon juice curry powder salt and pepper. Pour over broccoli and chicken. Top with bread crumbs and cheese. Cook covered 45 minutes or until bubbly in 350\u00b0 oven. Freezes well. Thaw and cook.

title: Mrs. Lewis' Meat Loaf
instructions: Steam cook for 1 1/2 hours in electric skillet.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables as package directs and drain well. Mix in celery onion cheese and salad dressing. Put in a 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle herb-seasoned crumbs on top and cover with margarine.

title: Eclair Dessert Squares
instructions: Line 9 x 13-inch buttered pan with whole graham crackers. Make pudding according to package directions then mix with Cool Whip. Pour half the pudding mixture over the graham crackers. Place another layer of crackers over the pudding and top with remaining pudding. Cover layer with graham crackers. Top with chocolate icing and refrigerate for 2 days.

title: Stuffed Baked Potato
instructions: Bake 6 large potatoes 1 1/2 hours at 400 degrees. Cut lengthwise into halves. Scoop out the potato leaving the skin intact. Mash all the potatoes in a bowl and add all ingredients with the exception of the cheddar cheese and dash of paprika till fluffy. Can add a small amount of milk if needed but do not get this mixture too loose.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix and pour into punch bowl over ice ring.

title: Cyclops Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat butter and peanut butter with electric mixer until smooth. Add the 1/2 cup sugar and brown sugar and beat until fluffy. Add the egg milk and vanilla. Beat well.

title: Dessert Pizza
instructions: Mix the cookie mix as directed on the box. Put into a deep pie plate. Cook until done; let cool. Mix the cream cheese sugar and vanilla; spread over the cookie. Add your favorite fruit slices on top.

title: Mary'S Brownies
instructions: Beat eggs until frothy. Add sugar and mix well. Melt together the margarine and chocolate; cool slightly and add to first mixture. Mix together dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Sherbet Punch
instructions: Combine Kool-Aid with water stirring until dissolved. Add sugar and juice of 1 lemon. Slice lemon thinly and add to mixture. Stir until all ingredients are well blended. Place the 3 scoops of sherbet on top of the punch (it will blend in). Serve well chilled. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli while preparing or earlier in the day. Brown ground beef and drain fat. Fill 9 x 13-inch pan with Tater Tots (enough to cover bottom of pan). Cook Tater Tots as directed on bag. Let broccoli thaw. Put ground beef on top of Tater Tots. Put broccoli atop beef. Mix milk and soup; pour over layers. Top with cheese and bake for 35 to 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serve when slightly cooled.

title: Chutney Glaze
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Baste on ham last 45 minutes of baking basting frequently.

title: Fire N See Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles. In large dishpan mix pickles sugar garlic hot sauce and red pepper. Let stand for 2 hours stirring occasionally. After this put back into pickle jar with new pickle juice. Refrigerate.

title: Sopaipillas
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut shortening into dry mixture. Add enough water to make soft dough but not sticky. Knead well. Let stand about 30 minutes. Roll out into 1/8-inch thick. Cut into 3-inch squares. Fry in deep fat. Serve with honey.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Thinly slice the potatoes (about 1/4-inch). Add to salted water and boil 5 minutes. Drain. In mixing bowl whisk together the soups and milk. Add onions pimentos and pepper to taste. Spray a 2 or 3-quart oblong casserole with nonstick spray. Put potatoes in bottom of casserole. Put all other ingredients on potatoes and top with cheese.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 9 x 13-inch baking dish with tortillas. Brown ground beef with onion. Mix soup beans and tomatoes. Layer meat on top of tortillas. Next add layer of soup mixture. Top with grated cheese. Bake until bubbly hot.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream; add vanilla. Dont overbeat. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a greased and floured Bundt or angel food pan.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In center of each tortilla place 1/4 cup chicken 2 tablespoons cheese and 1 tablespoon salsa; roll up. Arrange seam side down in 8-inch square baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake 25 minutes or until heated.

title: Oven Roasted Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash potatoes. Place potatoes in small roasting pan. Drizzle olive oil over potatoes. Sprinkle garlic salt and pepper over potatoes. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes until tender and browned.

title: Pineapple Banana Deluxe Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add 7-Up. When partly set add pineapple marshmallows and sliced bananas. When completely set spread topping.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and beat until mixture is smooth. Bake in a well-greased cake pan in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Ice cake while hot.

title: Granny'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar add eggs. Mix dry ingredients together and add to sugar and egg mixture. Roll out and cut out various shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. When cool frost with powdered sugar and lemon glaze that has been tinted an appropriate color.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In mixing bowl combine flour cinnamon soda salt baking powder and nutmeg. In another bowl combine zucchini sugar cooking oil and lemon peel. Mix well. Add flour mixture. Stir just until combined. Stir in nut meats. Pour batter into loaf pan 8 x 4 x 2-inch. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes on wire rack. Remove from pan. Let cool and wrap. Let stand overnight before slicing.

title: Snickerdoodles Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and blend well. Stir together dry ingredients and stir into mixture until well mixed. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts and roll into mixture of 2 teaspoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Bake until light brown. These cookies puff up at first then flatten out. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Press coconut and pecans into bottom of pan. Mix cake mix and pour on top of this. Mix the cream cheese oleo and powdered sugar. Drop by spoonfuls on top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Plate Of Pasta
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil. Add broccoli and can of chicken broth. Then add parsley oregano basil salt and peppers. Bring to simmer for 10 minutes or until broccoli is done. Pour over cooked pasta toss and serve.

title: Lima Beans In Sour Cream
instructions: Cook beans until tender. Rinse in hot water. Put in a large greased casserole dish. Add butter salt brown sugar mustard molasses and sour cream. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale. Chill. When ready to serve add ginger ale.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass pan). In medium saucepan melt morsels and butter. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press half of mixture firmly onto bottom of heavily greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

title: Annie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar margarine butter and Crisco. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour baking powder and milk alternately ending with flour. Fold in flavoring on low speed. Bake in a tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 275\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and finely chop to 1/3 cup. Cook and stir stems onion and pepper in 3 tablespoons margarine until tender (5 minutes). Remove from heat; stir in crumbs salt thyme turmeric and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon margarine in shallow baking dish until melted. Fill caps. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0 broil setting or at 550\u00b0 3 to 4 inches from heat for 2 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Just-Like Campbell'S Tomato Soup
instructions: Saute onions in oleo; stir in flour salt pepper and sugar. Cook until smooth and bubbly stirring constantly. Gradually stir in tomato juice. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Fill jars and cook 30 minutes.

title: Millionaire Cake
instructions: Mix together and beat with spoon for 2 minutes. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Lemonade Cake
instructions: Prepare and bake cake according to directions on box. Cut the 2 layers in half to make 4 layers. Mix other ingredients; frost cake and refrigerate for 2 days.

title: Las Vegas Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix margarine and eggs. Pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together cream cheese powdered sugar eggs and nuts. Pour on top of other mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch buttered glass pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. The last few minutes of baking put crushed potato chips and a little grated cheese on top. Freezes well. Any vegetable can be substituted for beans. Serves 12 people.

title: Nanny'S Dump Cake
instructions: You will need a long pan 2 1/2-inches deep 13-inches long by 9-inches wide metal (may have to cook longer).

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a 3 quart greased casserole dish. Pour mix over the top of ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to an hour or until golden brown. Serves 6.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: In order given layer in 9 X 13 pan. Mix 2 cups mayonnaise 2 Tbsp. sugar 2 Tbsp. Parmesan cheese. Spread over salad as frosting. Top with 4 oz. grated cheddar cheese. Cover lightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Dip For Fruit
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Serve with slices of apples pears bananas etc.

title: Mushroom Delight
instructions: Simmer onions in margarine until soft. Add chopped celery and sliced mushrooms. Simmer together 3 minutes. Add soup and flavor packet from noodles. Add boiled noodles. Combine all in casserole; top with cashews. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 (dont overbake).

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cube about a large walnut size. Put in ice water and let stand at least 1 hour. Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Put Parmesan cheese and flour in a paper bag and shake. Salt and pepper to taste. Remove potatoes from ice water and put in bag; shake good. Arrange in the melted buttered baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0. After 1/2 hour turn and continue baking for another 1/2 hour. Serves approximately 6 to 8.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Cream 1/2 cup sugar and the shortening. Add the next 4 ingredients; beat until smooth. Pour into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan or baking dish. Pour onto this batter the berries with the juice and 1/2 cup sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. The crust will rise to the top.

title: Settler Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Crumble bacon and add with onion to meat. Place in a casserole dish; add remaining ingredients. Mix and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crescent Cheeseburgers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large frying pan brown ground beef; drain. Stir in chili sauce soup mix salt and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Spoon hot meat mixture over triangles. Roll up; start at shortest side of triangle and roll to form 2 triangles. Place a cheese triangle over each meat-filled crescent. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 17 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 8 sandwiches.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to directions. Cook bacon until crisp; crumble. Add onion green pepper and mushrooms to bacon fat and cook until tender. Stir in flour chicken broth cream and pimiento. Simmer until sauce thickens. Add salt and pepper. Combine sauce chicken bacon and cooked spaghetti. Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Green Chili Sauce
instructions: Cook on top of stove until desired thickness.

title: Chicken Meatballs
instructions: About 1 hour before serving preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch metal baking pan. Chop bread until fine crumbs form (you will have about 1 cup crumbs). Grate enough onion to equal 1 tablespoon. Finely shred carrots to equal 1/2 cup. In large bowl mix bread crumbs onion shredded carrots ground chicken salt and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley. Shape chicken mixture into 20 meatballs. (Meatball mixture is very moist and sticky; for easier shaping use wet hands.) Place meatballs in baking pan; bake 25 minutes or until meatballs are lightly browned and cooked through.

title: Sausage Meatballs
instructions: Combine sausage bread crumbs egg celery and onion in a bowl; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening with sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with apples. Add nuts. Pour in loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Salmon Caesar
instructions: In medium bowl beat together eggs milk and soup. Stir in croutons flaked salmon green pepper and onion. Pour into buttered 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set in center.

title: Marinated Mussels(Cozze Di Marinati)
instructions: Drain and rinse mussels. In saucepan combine celery 2 tablespoons minced onion garlic parsley 1/2 cup olive oil vinegar pepper salt and onion. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Add mussels to hot liquid; cool. Let marinate overnight in refrigerator. Arrange a small platter with a bed of lettuce if desired. Place mussels on platter and sprinkle chopped garlic and sliced onion on top. Pour some of the marinade over top of mussels along with the olive oil. Serve with garlic bread or on an antipasto platter if desired. Makes 6 servings.

title: Papa Wood'S Sugar Popcorn
instructions: Scoop out the seeds from the pumpkin. Wash the seeds. Pat dry on a paper towel. Salt the seeds. Grease a cookie sheet with 1 to 2 tablespoons butter. Spread seeds on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until seeds are golden brown and crispy.

title: Hot Slaw(As Told To Me By My Mother)
instructions: Put 1 stick of butter in pan and cut cabbage (pepper and salt it). Cook until tender. Mix together a scant tablespoon of flour vinegar sugar and milk.\tSet cabbage off after it has become tender and pour this mixture over it return to cook until flour is cooked but do not boil. MMMMMMMM GOOD!

title: Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Stir together jam and buttermilk. Freeze firm. Break up mixture whip until fluffy and refreeze. Enjoy.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown meat in oil. Add soy sauce and water. Simmer 2 minutes. Add celery and onion and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Will need 1 cup water to thicken. Blend cornstarch and water to thicken and add remaining ingredients. Heat thoroughly. Serve with rice or chow mein noodles.

title: Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Place corned beef then sauerkraut Miracle Whip and cheese on 4 slices of bread. Top with other bread slices. Spread butter on outside of bread. Grill in skillet or on griddle until browned and cheese melts.

title: Chilli Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add salt and pepper to taste. Mix with chilli and tomatoes. Pour into a 9 x 11-inch baking dish. Mix corn meal egg and milk. Pour over top of chilli mix. Bake at 450\u00b0 until top is brown and cornbread done.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Melt caramels in evaporated milk. Pour evenly over baked layer of cake and sprinkle with milk chocolate chips and chopped nuts. Pour remaining batter over top. Return to oven and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes. Check cake by inserting a toothpick in center. It should come out clean.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Layer the first 4 ingredients in a dish in order listed. The remaining ingredients will be cooked for a sauce. Combine remaining ingredients in pan; cook over low heat until thick. Cool and pour over Apple Salad. Mix together just before serving.

title: Peaches And Cream
instructions: Mix egg flour pudding and butter to make crust. Spread on bottom of pan and pour drained peaches on top. Mix sugar cream cheese and 3 tablespoons of peach juice until creamy. Pour over peaches. Sprinkle cinnamon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is golden brown.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Prepare Jell-O. Stir in cream cheese while hot. Add all ingredients. Cool a bit and stir in whipped cream. Chill until firm.

title: Marinated Pasta Salad
instructions: Marinate in refrigerator overnight before serving. I stir several times during first few hours to make sure seasonings get into pasta.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Saute onion pepper and mushrooms in Italian dressing. Push to one side. Cook chicken in Italian dressing just until no longer pink inside.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Place chicken in 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine all ingredients except for cornstarch and water. Pour over chicken. Cook at Medium-high (70%) for 20 minutes until chicken is done turning after 10 minutes. Remove chicken and cover to keep warm.

title: Preserved Children
instructions: Mix the children and dogs well together. Put them on the field stirring constantly. Pour the brook over the pebbles sprinkle the field with flowers and spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun. When brown set away to cool in the bathtub.

title: Reese'S Brownies
instructions: Prepare Duncan Hines double fudge brownie mix as written on box. Place either 2-inch or 2 1/4-inch foiled cupcake papers on a cookie sheet or in muffin tins. Fill each cupcake paper 3/4 full.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick butter and saute vegetables until transparent. Add the remaining ingredients and cook 5 minutes. Add cut up chicken. Cook slowly for 3 to 4 hours covered. Cook 2 (7 ounce) packages spaghetti. Add to mixture. If too dry add more broth. May add small can mushrooms and/or ripe olives and 1/2 pound grated cheese.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Combine cornstarch soy sauce vinegar sugar ginger and garlic powder; set aside. In wok or large skillet stir-fry chicken in hot oil for 2 or 3 minutes. Add peppers and cook 3 minutes. Add pineapple and juice then stir in cornstarch mixture. Cook over low heat and stir until slightly thickened. Serve over rice.

title: Smothered Steak
instructions: Put steak flour salt and pepper in crock-pot. Stir well. Layer the remaining ingredients in order. Do not stir while simmering in crock-pot. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Then low for 8 hours or on high for 5 hours. Stir together when ready to serve it over rice.

title: Chicken Broccoli
instructions: Bake chicken breasts at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Remove skin and bones. Cut into strips. Cook broccoli as directed on package. Place in well-buttered casserole dish; lay chicken strips on top. Mix soup with mayonnaise and pour it on top of chicken. Sprinkle with bread crumbs then cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
