instructions: Break angel food cake into pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Pour jello over the cake in the pan. Press the mixture into the cake. Refrigerate about 3 hours. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit well then mix all ingredients together. Let sit in refrigerator overnight for best flavor. Makes a lot. Recipe may be halved.

title: Mounds Coconut Candy
instructions: Melt butter and mix with sugar and Eagle Brand milk until smooth. Remove from heat and add coconut. Line a pan with wax paper. Roll mixture into balls and freeze until firm. (If you need to wait for the pans refrigerate until ready to use again.) Melt chocolate and paraffin and dip coconut ball in the mixture. Put on wax paper until firm.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa and stir into hot milk. Cook until thick. Add beaten egg yolks stirring well. Add vanilla and oleo and beat again. Pour into baked crust. Top with whipped egg whites made from 3 egg whites and bake.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Sift together the first five ingredients. Add Crisco oil eggs vanilla and grated zucchini. May add nuts and raisins if desired. Mix ingredients. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve with chilled raw vegetables or with crackers or bread. Makes 3 cups. Can be made a day ahead to blend flavors.

title: Shimmering Tropical Fruit
instructions: Drain Tropical fruit salad; reserve juice. Add enough water to make 1 3/4 cups liquid. Heat liquid to boiling. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Chill until slightly thickened. Stir in fruit salad. Pour in 1-quart mold or 8 foil muffin pan liners. Chill until firm. Unmold onto plate to serve. Garnish as desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Microwave Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Melt butter in a large bowl then combine sugar cocoa and milk; microwave for 2 minutes. Stir well and add vanilla and nuts. Refrigerate until set about 2 hours. Kids and men love this candy!

title: Chicken And Linguine
instructions: Put flour salt and pepper in a paper bag. Take chicken one piece at a time place in bag and shake until chicken is coated with flour mixture. Brown coated chicken in olive oil. When all of the chicken is brown drain off excess oil. Sprinkle onion soup over chicken. Pour wine and water over chicken. Simmer covered over low heat for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Quesadilla(1 Serving)
instructions: Heat oil in a nonstick skillet; add 1 tortilla. Layer with half the Cheddar cheese all of the chicken and mushrooms and half the Monterey Jack cheese. Top with the second tortilla. Cover and heat until cheese melts and bottom tortilla is crisp and golden brown. Turn over; sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Cook until bottom tortilla is crisp and golden brown and cheese is melted. Cut into wedges; serve with sour cream and salsa if desired.

title: Mary Ollie'S Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Before adding the ginger ale pour out a portion of the punch into a container to freezer. Serve the punch over the frozen punch.

title: Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Mix together the margarine flour and nuts. Press into bottom of 13x9 pan. Bake in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes. Cool thoroughly.

title: No Fail! Pie Crust
instructions: Whip 1 cup softened butter. Gradually add 1/3 plus cup milk. Mix flour with salt and sugar. Add flour mix. Do not overmix. Consistency should be coherent but not too sticky dough. (Can finish mixing with hands.) Let rest 1 hour minimum in ball. Roll out with minimum of flour on floured surface. Brush with egg mixture. Sprinkle cinnamon/sugar on top if wanted.

title: Christmas Cranberry-Orange Salad
instructions: In large bowl dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Stir in cranberry sauce cold water lemon juice cinnamon and cloves. Refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened then stir in the oranges. Pour into a 5-cup mold or glass dish. Refrigerate until completely firm.

title: Flour Icing
instructions: Cook flour and milk to thick paste. Refrigerate 1 hour. Beat shortening vanilla and sugar until creamy. Mix with flour paste and whip until thick.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Cook on medium heat until dough is right consistency for use (about 3 to 5 minutes). Stir constantly while cooking. When it thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pan pour out on countertop and knead for 1 minute. Store in plastic bag.

title: Chicken And Pasta Toss
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Rinse under cold running water; drain. In medium salad bowl combine pasta spinach chicken cherry tomatoes mushrooms and Parmesan cheese. In small bowl whisk together oil mustard lemon juice garlic salt 3 tablespoons water and 1/8 teaspoon pepper until smooth. Pour over pasta mixture; toss lightly. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Texas Sheet Cake And Frosting
instructions: In large bowl mix flour sugar and salt. Bring to boil margarine water and cocoa. In small bowl mix eggs milk vinegar vanilla and soda. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into greased sheet cake pan (11 x 18 x 1-inch). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Harvard Beet Spice Cake
instructions: Beat butter with sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Blend beets in blender until smooth. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with beets to butter mixture mixing well after each addition. Fold in nuts.

title: Pink Lemonade Pie
instructions: Beat lemonade and Cool Whip together for 2 minutes. Add the sweetened condensed milk; beat with other ingredients for about 3 minutes. Pour into shell; refrigerate several hours.

title: Delicious Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven at 325\u00b0. Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add remaining ingredients except pecans. Mix until combined. Stir in pecans. Form into balls the size of a walnut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Do not overcook. Let cool before removing from pan. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pecan Tassies
instructions: Soften cheese and margarine. Add flour. Mixture will be very stiff. Form into ball and store covered in refrigerator for 1 hour. Shape into 24 one-inch (walnut size) balls. Place in tiny ungreased muffin tins. Press against bottom and sides of cup to form small pastry cups.

title: Edwards Mansion Orange Muffins
instructions: Mix flour sugar and baking powder in large mixing bowl. Add the following ingredients in the order given one at a time while stirring shortening soft butter beaten eggs milk and orange juice.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Brown beef until crumbly but not dry. Before beef is done push to one side of pan and saute onion green pepper and celery. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Cover pan tightly and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve hot over toasted buns. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Teresa'S Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate.

title: Mom'S Fudge Sauce
instructions: Mix together butter and cocoa. Add sugar 1/2 cup at a time. Over low heat gradually add evaporated milk. Bring to boil and continue to boil for 4 to 5 minutes. Stir often. Add vanilla. Remove from heat and serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Chicken And Rice Pilaf
instructions: Place chicken breasts in baking dish. Mix dressing and preserves and pour over chicken. Sprinkle on onion soup. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Log
instructions: In serving dish layer the following ingredients in this order Frito Lay bean dip guacamole sour cream chopped tomatoes chopped black olives shredded Cheddar cheese and chopped green onions. Chill and serve. Scoop bites with corn chips.

title: Alene'S Meringue
instructions: Add water before beating. Beat until foamy but not stiff. Then add 8 tablespoons of sugar one tablespoon at a time beating well between each addition.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Cut in shortening. Dissolve yeast in the 4 tablespoons very warm water. Add yeast and buttermilk to the flour mixture. Mix well. Place in refrigerator to chill. When ready to bake roll out to 1/4-inch thickness on a well floured board using a floured rolling pin. Cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Dip into melted butter and fold over to make \pocketbooks.\ Place on ungreased baking sheet or pan. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until lightly browned. Dough does not have to rise before baking and will keep in the refrigerator for a couple of days.

title: Beef Tater Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Make an even layer of uncooked ground beef in bottom of 9-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper to taste. Cover with onion slices. Add 1 layer of frozen Tater Tots completely covering beef and onions. Add soup pouring it evenly over mixture. Top with grated cheese. Bake 1 hour. Cut into squares. Serves 6.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Crumble sausage into a large saucepan. Cook over medium-low heat. Add onion; cook and stir until transparent. Drain discarding all but 3 tablespoons of the drippings. Stir in flour. Cook over medium-low heat about 8 minutes or until mixture turns golden. Slowly add milk. Add seasonings and cook stirring until thick. To serve slice biscuits and spoon gravy over halves. Serves 6.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Stir together dry ingredients add eggs. Slowly stir in buttermilk and then butter. Add raisins. Bake 1 hour 10 minutes in greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Jalapeno Pie
instructions: Line pie plate with jalapenos. Cover with grated sharp Cheddar cheese. Heap and round to top of pan. Beat eggs and pour over top of cheese. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and sugar. Cool. Add unbeaten eggs and mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a greased shallow pan at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter and sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add extract. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Alternately add flour mixture and milk beating until blended after each addition. Wrap dough into foil or plastic wrap and chill several hours. Roll out part of the dough at a time 1/8-inch thick on floured board. Cut with 2 1/2-inch cookie cutters. Sprinkle with granulated sugar and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until edges are brown. Cool on racks. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Chicken Soup (Greek Egg-Lemon Soup)(Greek; Heart Healthy.)
instructions: Cover fowl with water and chicken broth and heat gradually to boiling point with onion and celery. Cook until fowl is tender about 1 1/2 hours adding salt when half done. Remove fowl from broth and set aside on warm platter. Strain broth; bring to boiling point. Stir in rice; cover and simmer over moderate heat until rice is cooked. Stir the contents frequently while rice is cooking. Cool soup slightly and blend with the following Egg-Lemon recipe. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add 1 egg at a time; beat until smooth. Add flour gradually; beat until smooth. Add flavoring (of your choice). Add 7-Up. Pour into greased cake pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven (preheated) for 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients and let stand 12 hours in refrigerator. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix all ingredients except the margarine. Melt margarine in pan. Leave some margarine in pan put the rest in the mix. Cook in an oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Tapioca Jello Salad
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients together until thick; let cool. Mix the Dream Whip according to package directions. Add the Dream Whip drained pineapple and oranges to the cooled jello.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Roll into balls the size of walnut. Place on shallow baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Spread pie filling in bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry cake mix nuts and butter. Mix until crumbly. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake 40 minutes or until golden brown at 350\u00b0. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie(1 Pie)
instructions: Beat egg whites stiff. Add sugar like angel food cake. Add rest of ingredients.

title: Stack Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugar and shortening. Add egg molasses and buttermilk and mix well. Sift together the flour soda salt baking powder and ginger and add to the other mixture. Mix well. Add vanilla. It makes a dough. Divide into 5 equal balls and roll out as for pastry to fit 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool and stack with dried apples.

title: Brown Sugar Fudge Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and gradually add sugar beating at medium speed. Add eggs beating well after each addition then add chocolate and beat well. Combine flour soda and add to cream mixture stir in vanilla. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8 inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick is inserted in center and comes out clean. Cool on wire racks spread creamy chocolate frosting between layers and on top.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust; crimp edges to seal. Slit top crust. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Hunan Vegetables(Hot And Sour)
instructions: Combine ginger garlic and black beans in a small bowl and set aside. Blend stock soy sauce vinegar and sugar in another bowl. Bring pot of water to boil. Fill another bowl with ice water. Blanch cauliflower for 1 minute then plunge into ice water. Repeat process with remaining vegetables.

title: Cheese Stars
instructions: Mix together cheese and margarine. Sift together flour salt and pepper. Combine and chill in refrigerator. Roll out like cookie dough and cut into small star shapes with a cutter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Heat milk and cream just to scalding in a medium size saucepan. Stir in corn and liquid salt paprika pepper and thyme. Saute green onions in butter slowly. Then add oysters and liqueur; cook slowly for 5 minutes or just until edges of oysters start to curl. Stir into the scalded milk mixture. Heat very slowly just to boiling.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Combine all the chopped vegetables in a large kettle and mix well. Sprinkle with salt and allow to stand overnight. The next day drain off liquid. Tie pickling spices in a piece of cloth or cheesecloth. Combine the vinegar sugar pickling spice bag and all other spices in a large kettle. Simmer 20 minutes. Add the vegetables to the mixture and cook over low heat until almost reaches boiling point. Pack the hot chow chow in hot sterilized jars and seal at once. Allow to stand 2 weeks before eating.

title: Lemon Yam Puff
instructions: Cook unpeeled whole yams in boiling water for 30 minutes or until tender; drain. Peel and mash until smooth. If dry add a little hot water. Add remaining ingredients and beat until light and fluffy. Transfer to a greased 2-quart casserole dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Melt margarine in large shallow pan. Stir in salts and Worcestershire sauce. Add cereal pretzels pecans and peanuts; mix until all pieces are coated. Bake for 1 hour. Spread on paper towels and allow to cool. Store in airtight containers.

title: Creamy Summer Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate 15 minutes before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: In a medium bowl combine spinach sour cream mayonnaise soup mix water chestnuts and green onions. Cover; chill. Serve with bread crackers chips etc. Makes 3 cups.

title: Carrots Au Gratin
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook carrots in 1/2-inch boiling salted water for 10 minutes. Combine crackers onion salt green pepper and black pepper. Alternate carrots and crumb mixtures in greased 1 quart baking dish. If any carrot liquid is left spoon over top. Pour butter over and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 20 or 25 minutes or until cheese melts. (Can be made the day ahead and then put in oven when ready to use.)

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well in large bowl all ingredients. (May have to add more bread crumbs if mushy.) Put in bottom of Dutch oven or large type pan and add water to the bottom 1 inch. Cook at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour covered uncover and cook additional 1/2 hour. Add catsup to top of meat loaf during last 1/2 hour if desired.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Arrange toast in buttered dish (use deep dish). Break into pieces if you must. Sprinkle with raisins; stir the rest altogether (except 2 tablespoons of sugar). Pour over toast and let stand (10 minutes). Keep pushing down in milk mix so it soaks up milk. Mix cinnamon and sugar and sprinkle over top. Cook at 350\u00b0 until top is brown and knife comes out clean when tested 25 minutes is good timing. Serve warm or cold with vanilla sauce (very good) if desired.

title: Sensational Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Slice beef across the grain (will slice more easily if frozen 1 hour) very thin slices. Cook 1/2 the beef with 1/2 the onion in 1 tablespoon oleo in a skillet over high heat. Remove from skillet and repeat with remainder of beef onion and oleo. Return all beef to skillet. Stir in soup and paprika. Heat through stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; stir in sour cream. Heat through. Serve over noodles.

title: Hot Ham And Cheese Rolls
instructions: Cut ham and cheese into 1/4-inch cubes. Chop eggs; combine all ingredients. Spread into 12 frankfurter rolls. Wrap in foil and heat in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix milks and pudding mix; fold in Cool Whip.

title: Bountiful Bean Stew
instructions: Rinse beans. Cover with water; boil 2 minutes. Let stand 1 hour then simmer covered 50 minutes until beans are tender. Add all the rest of the ingredients except cheese. Simmer 30 minutes until carrots are done. Stir in cheese just before serving. Serves 8.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix the first 2 ingredients together. Spread on bottom of dish then spread apples over this. Mix the 1/2 cup flour and 1/2 cup sugar together and spread over the apples. Melt the butter and pour on top. Bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and part of onion. Drain. Add kidney beans and taco seasoning. Simmer. Combine lettuce tomatoes remaining onions and cheese in large bowl. When ready to serve add Fritos ground beef mixture and dressing. Mix well and serve.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs oil and vanilla. Beat until soft and fluffy. Combine all dry ingredients and stir gradually to creamed mixture. Chill for 4 hours or longer. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass or fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Mama'S Dumplings
instructions: Combine flours and egg. Add enough cold water to make a stiff dough. Drop into boiling chicken broth. You may drop them from a teaspoon or roll them out using a little self-rising flour. Reduce heat to medium and cook until tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Cornstarch Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar well together; add the milk then the cornstarch and flour sifted with the salt and baking powder. Add last the whites of the eggs beaten to a stiff froth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Use rather shallow pans.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add seasonings and stir well. Add other ingredients. Cook on low for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Serve over taco chips or Mexican cornbread. Top with sour cream and/or grated cheese.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Simmer water cinnamon and cloves for 5 minutes. Add fruit juices tea and sugar. Dont boil just simmer!

title: Mexicali Chili
instructions: Brown beef. Add to beef and cook until tender the onion pepper garlic and chili powder. Add soups water cheese and salt. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes stirring often.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Measure water into large bowl with cover sprinkle dry yeast and dissolve in water. Add margarine sugar and egg in order listed; blend well. Add flour slowly and blend well. Cover bowl and store in refrigerator until 1 1/2 hours before serving time. Spoon dough into greased muffin pan and let double in size. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown. Serve hot. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Crunchy Chicken Breasts
instructions: Dip chicken in oil. Roll in crushed Cheese Nips. Place in casserole dish. Cook at 375\u00b0 for an hour turning chicken halfway through cooking time.

title: Spicy Shrimp And Noodle Soup
instructions: Thaw shrimp if frozen. Peel and devein. In medium bowl combine lemon juice chili powder cumin and pepper. Add shrimp. Toss to coat. Let shrimp stand for 20 minutes at room temperature stirring occasionally.

title: Fudge
instructions: Place powdered sugar cocoa milk and butter in mixing bowl. Cook for three minutes in microwave on high covered loosely. Remove bowl and mix with spoon to completely blend ingredients. Add vanilla nuts and marshmallows. Pour into a greased 9 inch paper plate and allow to cool 40 minutes in refrigerator before serving.

title: Baked Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Scald cabbage in salted hot water; drain well. Mix remaining ingredients and form 12 to 14 beef balls. Place in cabbage leaves; fold and roll up. Fasten with toothpicks. Place in buttered casserole dish. Pour 1 1/2 cups water over cabbage rolls and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove cover; bake for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Cook milk sugar cocoa and margarine until margarine melts. Stir in peanut butter vanilla and oats. Mix all together and drop on wax paper. Cool until firm.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms and remove stems. Saute mushroom caps in butter (both sides) and drain well. Combine the bacon olives and juice in food processor. Stuff mixture into caps. Place on baking sheet. Sprinkle cheese on top of each. Heat broiler to 500\u00b0 and place in oven for 5 minutes.

title: Garden Pizza
instructions: Flatten the crescent rolls in a large jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Mix the cream cheese with the salad dressing. Mix with seasoned salt garlic powder and oregano. Place mixture on cooled crust. Top with whatever vegetables you desire. Spread the cheese on top. Refrigerate 2 hours ahead. Keeps 3 to 4 days in refrigerator.

title: Overnight Casserole
instructions: Put altogether; soak overnight. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lite Strawberry Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix strawberries in blender. Fold in Cool Whip and Sweet N Low. Chill.

title: Peaches N' Cream Cheesecake
instructions: Combine flour pudding mix baking powder salt egg milk and butter in large mixing bowl. Beat at high speed 2 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch deep dish pie plate. Drain peaches well. Arrange peach slices decoratively atop batter.

title: Bet'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Combine ingredients. Bring to a boil; simmer at least 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Chop Suey
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet. Drain grease. Add diced celery bean sprouts bouillon salt and pepper. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Make a smooth paste of cornstarch brown sugar and soy sauce. Stir into meat and cook another 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thick. Serve hot over Chinese noodles or rice.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Cook onion in butter until tender. Add cheese and soup. Stir until melted. Place broccoli in a casserole dish and pour soup mixture over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and cold milk until thickened. Add sweetened condensed milk and then fold in Cool Whip. Let set until thickened. Layer cookies bananas and then pudding. Add another layer of cookies bananas and pudding. Top with cookie crumbs if desired.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Layer potatoes in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Melt butter in saucepan with onion and salt. Pour butter mixture over potatoes and bake for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle cheese over potatoes then parsley. Bake for 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Remove bones from chicken and arrange in oblong casserole dish. Sprinkle with the onion coarsely chopped. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese (or other cheese). Combine Ro-Tel tomatoes and soups. Pour over mixture in casserole. Top with crushed Doritos. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 40 minutes. For extra spice decorate with rings of jalapeno pepper before serving or serve with picante sauce.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large bowl; blend until smooth. Pour mixture into a large greased slightly pan; bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. In my oven it bakes in about 50 minutes.

title: Fresh Tomato Sauce
instructions: Chop tomatoes removing seeds. Saute onion in margarine. Stir in tomatoes garlic parsley salt basil and pepper. Puree mixture in food processor or blender. Serve over pasta or fresh vegetables. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Meatballs For Spaghetti
instructions: Blend all together; form into balls dropping into boiling sauce. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes before stirring (because if you stir as you drop you can form balls). Cook for 20 to 25 minutes until done.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Retain 3 to 4 tablespoons liquid and put over corn. Put corn in greased casserole and add liquid. Mix remaining ingredients and spread over corn. Crush 1 package crackers and mix with 1 stick melted oleo and spread over top of casserole. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until well browned.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs. Add the rest of the ingredients into buttered casserole. Bake 1 hour until toothpick comes out dry. Enjoy.

title: Play Dough For Kids
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture gathers on spoon and forms dough. This will take about 6 minutes. Dump onto waxed paper until cool enough to handle and knead to form a pliable mass. Store in covered container or plastic bag. Food coloring may be added to make different colors. Yields 2 pounds play dough.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Cook and stir chicken in hot oil in large skillet until well browned. Add peppers cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Pour small bottle of Italian dressing over mixture and refrigerate overnight. Drain excess liquid the next day if needed. Add jar of salsa.

title: Bacon Sandwich
instructions: Get an apple (make sure there is no worm holes). Get a knife. Peel off skin. Get peanut butter. Take your knife and put peanut butter on your apple. Be sure to clean up your mess before your Mom sees it!

title: Danna'S Chewy Bar Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter. Gradually add sugars beating well. Add eggs; beat well. Combine flour baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture stirring well. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Spread in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Cut into 2 x 1-inch bars; cool on wire racks. Yields about 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving pieces. Season with salt and pepper and roll in flour. Heat oil in large skillet or Dutch oven. Brown meat on both sides. Add onion celery green pepper tomato soup and water. Simmer on low flame about 45 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Artichoke Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients in layers in a large salad bowl. Spoon small amount of artichoke oil over salad; refrigerate.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Cook everything together over a double boiler until thick and smooth. Pour into pint jar.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Pour over berries. Bake at 350 degrees until done.

title: French Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white brown sugar and vanilla. Dip pecans in mixture. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake one hour at 225\u00b0.

title: Diet Breakfast Tortilla
instructions: Microwave potato for 2 minutes and dice. Scramble egg. Spray pan with cooking spray (Pam) and brown onion and diced potato together. Place egg and potato mixture in a warm flour tortilla. Serve with picante sauce. Food exchanges 1 protein 1 1/2 breads 1 fat.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Spread the pie fillings in the bottom of a 9 x 11-inch cake pan mixing in the lemon juice and cinnamon. Sprinkle the dry cake mix on top. Melt the oleo and pour on top covering all of the mixture. Sprinkle the pecans evenly over the top.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients until clear. Add Jell-O; stir. Add strawberries and pour into pie shell. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Beat the potatoes good. Add margarine cream cheese sour cream and chives.\tMix all together. Pour in casserole dish and bake until slightly brown.

title: Cheesy Chowder
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cube in water. Add potatoes mixed vegetables and onion. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Sauerkraut And Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add raw rice V-8 juice seasonings sugar and green peppers. Pour\tmeat mixture into greased oblong casserole dish. Cover with the sauerkraut. Sprinkle with brown sugar.\tPour 2 cups warm water over all in the casserole.\tCover and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: White Chocolate Clusters
instructions: Melt white chocolate. Mix Rice Krispies pecans and pretzels. Stir until coated. Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper. Let sit until firm.

title: Vinegar Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well. Add and mix in dry ingredients and pecans. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Halibut Steaks With Tangy Mustard Sauce
instructions: Arrange halibut steaks in a large shallow baking dish. Combine orange juice and next 5 ingredients in a small bowl stirring well. Pour over steaks. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour turning once.

title: Cereal Killer Cookies
instructions: Combine oatmeal and Brickle chips. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Combine firmly packed brown sugar granulated sugar and margarine in mixing bowl and beat until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Continue beating until blended. Add dry ingredients. Beat until combined. Add oatmeal/candy mixture. Stir until well mixed. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or until slightly brown. Cool one minute. Transfer to cooling rack.

title: Holiday Eggnog
instructions: Beat egg yolks to light yellow. Add bourbon and rum slowly beating mixture constantly. Add sugar then milk. Fold in whipping cream then very stiffly beaten egg whites. Top with a sprinkling of cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Veggie Pizza(Sara'S Favorite)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Press crescent rolls on large cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Mix cream cheese dressing mix mayonnaise and seasonings. When crescent rolls are cool spread with cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle chopped veggies and shredded cheese then top with shredded cheeses. Cut in squares to serve. Excellent!

title: Family Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Cut chickens in half. Clean and dry well. Combine salad oil (or margarine) vinegar water salt pepper and poultry seasoning. Heat just to boiling and set aside. Place chicken on grill over gray coals. Brush with sauce mixture every 5 minutes or as often as necessary to prevent burning. Cook until tender. When leg bone turns easily in the socket chicken is done. Yield 10 servings.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Blend all ingredients and place in a greased and floured 4-cup pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until brown on top. Loosen sides with a knife and let stand 5 minutes before turning out of pan.

title: Creole Dinner
instructions: Place bacon on\tbottom\tof pan. Distribute steak in layer over bacon. Add layer of onions carrots and potatoes. Add water. Cook covered for 45 minutes on slow heat.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour 1/2 batter in 2 skillets. Sprinkle cheese on top of each. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Oriental Chicken And Cashews(Microwave)
instructions: Heat oil in 12 x 8-inch dish at High 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Meanwhile combine chicken garlic soy sauce sherry cornstarch and ginger. Add to dish and cook at High 4 to 5 minutes; stir twice. Add green pepper and cashews. Cook covered with plastic wrap at High 3 to 5 minutes or until chicken and green pepper are tender; stir once. Let stand 3 minutes before serving. Serves 2.

title: Celery Almondine
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add celery salt and pepper. Cover and cook until celery is crisp and tender. Shake pan frequently to prevent scorching. Add green onion tops and onion. Cook 2 minutes longer. Combine flour and broth; blend into celery mixture. Stir and cook until sauce begins to thicken. Stir in milk and simmer about 2 minutes. Add almonds; toss gently. Sprinkle with coarsely ground pepper. Serves 6.

title: Men Love It Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Set aside. Soften cream cheese with juice from crushed pineapple. Mix pineapple celery and nuts together. Let jello set until thickened. Then add pineapple nuts celery and cream cheese mixture.

title: Dee'S Apple Butter Bread
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar. Blend in eggs. Mix dry ingredients in a separate bowl. Mix soda and buttermilk in a cup. Add dry and wet ingredients alternately to creamed mixture. Stir in apple butter and pecans. Pour into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 20 minutes more.

title: Seven Layer Casserole
instructions: Mix and cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Ley Mill Lemon Pudding
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a pie dish. Put the bread crumbs to soak in the milk at least one hour before cooking. Then place in pie dish. Add the sugar lemon rind and juice and the beaten white of an egg and stir carefully so that it does not curdle. Bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Bring raisins and water to a boil; cook 5 minutes (simmer). Set aside to cool. Sift all dry ingredients together except sugar. In a large bowl cream butter or margarine and sugar together; cream well. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Add dry ingredients then add cooled raisin nut mixture. Add chopped nuts. Chill dough in refrigerator. Drop by teaspoon on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 370\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes. Good and easy.

title: Lemon Whippersnaps
instructions: Mix well together. Grease cookie sheet. Drop by teaspoonful onto plate of powdered sugar. Roll dough to coat. Place balls 1 1/2-inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Fig Preserves Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Combine all liquids. Sift dry ingredients together and add to liquids. Mix well. Add nuts and figs. Stir until well blended. Pour batter into lightly greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 hour. When cake is done cool in pan for 10 minutes and make sauce for cake.

title: Apple Juice With Mint
instructions: Mix apple juice with 3 parts water. Stir in lemon juice and chopped mint. Blend until mint leaves are fine. Chill and serve.

title: Cream Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Peel and boil potatoes until done and drain and mashed. Add all ingredients except butter and Cheddar cheese. After mixed pour into casserole dish and top with butter; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and top with Cheddar cheese; return to oven until cheese is melted.

title: Date Nut Jello
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Chill until firm.

title: Lettuce And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce apart. Break cauliflower apart into bite size pieces. Take mayonnaise and spread over to seal. Fry bacon crisp drain and crumble. Dice onion and put on top of bacon. Put grated Parmesan cheese on top. Add sugar on top of cheese. Let stand overnight. Dont toss until ready to serve.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix mashed potatoes butter eggs milk vanilla and sugar. Put in casserole dish. Top with nuts brown sugar flour melted butter mixed together. Spoon over the potato mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Blueberry Batter Cake
instructions: Sprinkle berries with lemon juice. Pour evenly in well-greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cream 3/4 cup sugar and butter. Sift flour baking powder and 1/2 of salt together. Add alternately with milk to creamed mixture. Pour batter over berries. Combine 1 cup sugar cornstarch and rest of salt. Sprinkle evenly over cake. Cover cake with boiling water. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Helen'S Famous Brownies
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Fold in chocolate and nuts. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Macaroni Salad
instructions: Blend lemon juice into mayonnaise. Combine with remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: *Not frozen this is found on the grocery shelf.

title: Graham Toffee Bars
instructions: Prepare cookie sheet first. May want to spray with Pam for easy cleaning. Line cookie sheet with graham crackers in a single layer. Bring butter oleo and sugar to slow boil and boil for 5 minutes. Immediately spoon butter mixture over graham crackers spreading with back of large spoon to make sure all crackers are coated. Sprinkle the nuts generously over the crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Adjust to your oven as these have a tendency to overcook around the edges of the pan. Remove from oven and transfer immediately to wax paper to cool. When cool break into pieces and store in airtight container.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: In skillet brown chicken parts in shortening. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until chicken is tender stirring now and then. For an extra bright touch garnish chicken with lemon slices. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lemon Poke Cake
instructions: Place cake layers top sides up in 2 clean 9-inch round cake pans. Pierce cake with large fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Stir boiling water into gelatin in medium bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved. Carefully pour 1/2 of the gelatin over 1 cake layer. Pour remaining gelatin over second cake layer. Refrigerate 3 hours.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Boil cabbage long enough to loosen leaves. Peel leaves and set aside. Mix hamburger tomato sauce rice and seasonings. Make small balls of meat put inside cabbage leaves and roll. Stick toothpick in them to hold together. Place in deep pot. Pour tomato soup and kraut (drained) around the edge. Cook for 2 hours.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Heat milk add butter and salt. Cool slightly and add the corn meal and baking powder which have been sifted together then the beaten eggs and chopped onion. Stir well together. Place the corn in a greased casserole and put the corn meal mixture over mixing ever so slightly. Mixture should be very thin. If necessary add a bit more milk. Bake uncovered in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 45 minutes or until nicely browned.

title: Milky Wonder Cake
instructions: Melt candy bars in 1 stick of butter. Beat other stick of margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and soda alternately with buttermilk; mix until smooth. Add melted candy bars and mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. (Start checking for doneness after 1 hour.) Frost if desired.

title: Classic Green Bean Bake
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine soup soy sauce pepper milk and beans and 1/2 can of onions. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes until hot. Stir. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix thoroughly; will be quite moist. Make into small meatballs and brown in deep fat. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of fat and add 1 can of beef bouillon (2 cubes). Add meat. Baste and simmer on the stove for 20 minutes or bake in oven for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: In the pan that you are going to bake in melt the margarine. Then pour it into a large bowl and add your corn sour cream and eggs (and peppers and onions if desired). Stir in cornbread mix and pour into your pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Norman Clark'S Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries in boiling water until skins split. Run water and cranberries through a sieve to separate skins discard skins. Add sugar to cranberries stir until dissolved. Dissolve gelatin in cold water add to cranberry mixture. Refrigerate until soft set add nuts pineapple and grapes. Pour into mold or serving bowl. Refrigerate until set. Serve with whipped topping (optional).

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix Bisquick sugar egg and milk. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Stir in the nuts and bananas. Pour the mixture into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Broccoli Puff
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cook broccoli until done. Drain. Beat biscuit mix milk eggs and salt until smooth. Stir in broccoli and cheese. (Save a little cheese to sprinkle on top.) Pour into dish and bake for an hour or until knife inserted comes out clean. Makes 6 servings.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix German chocolate cake as directed on package. Put 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Butter and sugar cake pan and the crust wont be dry.)

title: No Fuss Caramel Corn
instructions: Place popped corn and peanuts in large brown paper bag. Set aside. Combine brown sugar butter corn syrup and salt in a 2-quart glass bowl or casserole dish. Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes stirring after each minute until mixture comes to a boil. Microwave 2 minutes more. Stir in baking soda. Pour syrup mixture over popped corn and nuts. Close bag and shake well. Microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes. Shake bag again. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes more. Shake bag and pour caramelized corn into large bowl. Separate when cool.

title: Caramel Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients together with mixer until creamy. Chill. Serve with apple and banana slices. Also good with grapes.

title: Cauliflower Dip
instructions: Mix all well. Delicious served with vegetable trays for parties.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast Bake
instructions: Brown sausage; drain fat. Spread bread cubes in a buttered 9 x 12-inch dish. Sprinkle sausage over bread. Add cheese. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well and pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: In a bowl mix the cottage cheese and dry Jell-O then the crushed pineapple whipped cream and then nuts. Chill.

title: Michele'S Truffles
instructions: Melt chocolate with butter slowly in double boiler or heavy saucepan. Remove from heat and add liquor stirring well until all liquor is absorbed. Refrigerate at least 40 minutes or until mixture hardens. Shape into marble sized balls and roll in chocolate jimmies.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cook cake mix by directions. Cook pineapple and sugar together until syrupy. After cake cools put some of pineapple on cake plate. Put one layer. Poke holes in it. Put pineapple on layer. Top with other layer. Poke holes and put remaining pineapple. After it cools put Cool Whip completely for icing.

title: Martha'S Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat. Drain in colander. Saute bell pepper and onion in same skillet. Combine meat bell pepper onion and pork and beans. Add barbecue sauce to make soupy. Put in a 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles. Turn heat down to 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Crisscross
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat butter and sour cream until light and fluffy. Add flour and mix well. Cover and chill dough about 1 hour or firm enough to handle. Dough must be well chilled. Divide dough in half. Leave other half in fridge until ready to use. Roll dough to an approximate 10 x 8-inch rectangle. Place this rectangle on a greased baking pan. Spread 1/2 of filling lengthwise down the center of rectangle. Sprinkle with 1/2 the nuts.

title: Mock Swiss Steak
instructions: Blend together the first 4 ingredients and put into baking dish. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes in three 8-inch cake pans. Slice layers in half.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Cream the cream cheese. Pour hot jello into cheese. Add nuts and drained pineapple. Add Cool Whip and cool.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and take meat off bone; cut into bite-size pieces. Saute onion and garlic in butter until tender. Cut tortillas into fourth or sixths. Dip in hot Crisco. Remove fast. Blend Ro-Tel tomatoes and soups. Add onion. Butter casserole dish. Put layer of tortillas on bottom. Add soup mix; then layer of chicken. Repeat layers until dish is full. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Steak And Gravy
instructions: Pound steak with a knife or saucer well. Roll in flour pepper and salt. Brown on both sides in hot oil or shortening. Reduce heat. Add a small amount of water and simmer until tender. Keep enough water in pan for gravy.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool 10 minutes remove from pan.

title: Papa'S Rock Cornish Hens
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place hens in a lightly greased 9x13 in. baking dish. Stuff each hen with lemon half and 1/4 of sliced leeks then sprinkle with seasonings. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until hens are cooked through and juices run clear. Let stand 10 minutes then remove lemon & leeks.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix vinegar brown sugar salt butter lemon juice water Worcestershire sauce mustard pepper and ketchup. Bring to a boil for 20 minutes (uncovered). Add onion and liquid smoke. Bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0.

title: Grilled Basil Chicken
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in container of an electric blender; process 30 seconds. With blender running gradually add oil in a slow steady stream. Reserve 1/4 cup basil mixture. Brush chicken with remaining basil mixture. Cover; refrigerate 30 minutes. Cook chicken covered with grill lid over medium for 30 minutes or until done basting twice with reserved basil mixture. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Slice tomatoes in thin slices. In bowl beat egg then add milk. Add flour salt pepper and garlic and whip mixture until smooth. Melt margarine in heavy skillet over medium-low heat. Dip tomatoes a slice at a time in batter and place in skillet. Fry until brown on both sides.

title: Garden Souffle Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Add cold water vinegar mayonnaise and pepper. Beat to blend well. Pour into freezing tray. Place in freezer 15 to 20 minutes or until firm about 1 inch around edge and soft in center. Pour into a bowl and whip until fluffy and thick. Fold in onion and vegetables. Pour into a 1-quart mold or individual molds. Chill until firm. Unmold onto salad greens. Makes about 4 cups. May be doubled and put into a 2-quart mold for crowd.

title: Old-Time Fresh Peach Crumb Pudding
instructions: Peel and cut peaches into quarters. Combine 1/2 cup of the sugar and\t3 tablespoons\tof the flour and mix with the peaches. Turn into a 10\tx 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix the remaining sugar and flour.\tAdd butter or margarine and cut it to crumb consistency.\tSprinkle crumbs over peaches. Bake in a preheated moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 1 hour or until peaches are tender and crumbs are brown. Garnish top as desired with sliced fresh peaches. Serves 8.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer ingredients in the order given spreading each. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 48 to 55 minutes. Use a big tube pan.

title: Old-Fashioned Hominy
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a stone jar or enamel pan (nothing else!). Soak for 15 hours until the husks come off easily. Drain. Wash in cold water several times removing the husks. Place in a kettle and cover with water. Bring to a boil then simmer until tender changing the water 3 times in the process. Store in the freezer.

title: What Shall We Do With The Leftover Turkey
instructions: Butter 2 slices of bread. Cut into small cubes and set aside. Cut remaining bread in cubes. Place half of unbuttered cubes in bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine turkey ham vegetables seasonings and mayonnaise. Spoon over bread. Place remaining unbuttered cubes over mixture. Combine eggs and milk; pour over all. Chill for 1 hour or overnight. Spoon soup over top and sprinkle with the buttered cubes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set. Sprinkle shredded cheese over top during the last few minutes of baking. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Makes 6 healthy servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients using mixer. Put in greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Deviled Turkey Drumsticks
instructions: Shake mixture of flour chili powder and salt and pepper to taste in paper bag and add turkey legs to coat. Brown in shortening.

title: Chicken In Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Spray oblong Pyrex baking dish with Pam. Mix soup sour cream sherry and mushrooms. Layer 1/3 of this mixture in bottom of dish. Place chicken on top then pour on rest of soup mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 3/4 of an hour. Cook 8 ounces of medium egg noodles. Pour mixture over. Sprinkle on chopped parsley. Enjoy!

title: Pralines
instructions: Cook in pot until mixture crystallizes. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Christmas Festive Cookies
instructions: Combine and sift together all dry ingredients except rolled oats. Add rolled oats pineapple cherries and nuts until coated well. Add melted Crisco eggs and milk. Drop from teaspoon about 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 10 to 12 minutes or until brown as desired. Makes approximately 6 dozen.

title: 24-Hour Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients in large salad bowl in the order listed. (A clear bowl allows you to see the layers.) Be sure everything is very dry before starting your layers. Cover the top completely with dressing.

title: Finger Jello
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O and gelatine in hot water. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Seven-Minute Frosting
instructions: Place all ingredients except vanilla in double boiler. Beat 1 minute with beater. Place over boiling water and cook beating constantly until frosting forms stiff peaks about 7 minutes. Dont overcook. Remove from boiling water. Pour into mixing bowl. Add vanilla. Beat until spreading consistency about 2 minutes.

title: Delmonico Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes. Chill and peel them. In a 13 x 9-inch pan grate potatoes.

title: Cookie Cake
instructions: Combine milk and egg. Add mix and chopped pecans. Pour into pan and top with chocolate chips and Heath bits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let set for 1 day.

title: Fluffy Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix milk with softened cream cheese and stir in pumpkin; blend well. Mix together pumpkin pie spice and brown sugar (or Sugar Twin) and blend well with pumpkin mixture. Add vanilla now if desired. Whip in pudding and fold in Cool Whip lite. Garnish with chopped pecans.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Melt oleo stir in flour and pecan pieces. Press into pan and bake at 250\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.

title: Crust For Fried Pies
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking powder then add shortening. Use a fork to mix the shortening in. Mix well. Add milk and mix. Make into 2-inch balls and roll out on floured surface. Makes 10 fried pies.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Combine flour and salt; coat chicken. Brown in hot oil; drain. Transfer to crock-pot. Stir together lemonade brown sugar catsup and vinegar. Pour over chicken. Cover; cook on high for 3 to 4 hours. Remove chicken; pour liquid into saucepan. Return chicken to crock-pot; cover to keep warm.

title: Swedish Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order by hand. Pour into an ungreased unfloured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven 350\u00b0. Blend sugar and oil add mashed bananas and eggs one at a time add vanilla. Mix flour soda allspice and cinnamon together then slowly add to the other ingredients and mix well. Bake 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 3 small loaf pans.

title: Cherry Cream Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese soften; beat until fluffy. Gradually add milk while mixing. Add lemon juice and vanilla. Blend well. Pour into crust. Chill 2 to 3 hours then garnish top with cherry pie filling.

title: Pineapple Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter Crisco and sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time. Add coconut flavoring and pineapple alternately with flour and milk; beat well. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes starting in cold oven.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine soup egg mayonnaise cheese seasoning and onions. Mix well. Add broccoli and mix well. Spoon into 1 quart greased baking dish. Dot with butter and sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 5.

title: All-American Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Spray a 9-inch deep dish pie plate with vegetable cooking spray.

title: Scotch Scones
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll mixture out to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Cut in circles or wedges. Brown and slowly bake on sparingly greased griddle (not too hot).

title: Sweet Potato Favorite
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put into a casserole dish.

title: Butterscotch Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Sprinkle pecans in 8 x 13-inch pan then sprinkle butterscotch pudding over pecans. Next sprinkle cinnamon over top. Place frozen dough balls on top. Melt oleo and brown sugar together; pour over rolls. Cover pan with Saran Wrap; let set in refrigerator overnight. Next morning bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Turn rolls upside down on platter when taken from oven.

title: Beet Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatins in hot water. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 X 13 pan or dish. When set spread with 1 cup salad dressing 1 cup chopped celery and 1/2 cup chopped green onion mixed together.

title: Sweet-N-Sour Cuke Relish
instructions: Whisk together vinegar sugar salt and pepper in a nonreactive bowl. Add cucumber tomato green pepper and onion. Toss; cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 2 days.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar cocoa and milk 2 minutes. When it comes to a rolling boil remove from heat; add vanilla margarine peanut butter and oatmeal. Drop by spoonful on wax paper. Let cool. Add a little more oatmeal if the mixture does not seem thick enough.

title: Mayonnaise
instructions: In a blender or a food processor with a metal blade process all ingredients until smooth. Refrigerate covered for at least 24 hours before using. Yields 1 cup.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Bake spareribs meat side up sprinkle with salt and topped with lemon slices at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Drain fat. Refrigerate. Combine remaining ingredients. Grill ribs 6 to 8-inches from heat. Turn and brush with sauce after 15 minutes. Cook 15 minutes longer basting frequently. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: White Icing
instructions: Place first 5 ingredients in iron skillet. Beat for 2 minutes on low speed. Then on beat and whip for 5 more minutes. Take off and place vanilla in icing. Beat for 1 to 2 minutes. Spreads beautifully. If you want you may spread coconut on top and sides of layers.

title: Beef Noodle Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.In a greased casserole dish layer noodles. Mix together in bowl the can of tomatoes tomato soup hamburger and seasonings to taste (onion salt pepper bell pepper oregano). Layer this mixture over noodles. Mix together sour cream cream cheese and green onion (if desired). Layer this on top. Cover and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Defrost potatoes. Add celery potato soup and sour cream and mix well. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley flakes. Bake in slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours uncovered.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in baking dish and cook for 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix beef crumbs onion egg salt pepper and 1/2 can of tomato sauce. Form into loaf and put in casserole dish. Combine rest of sauce and all other ingredients; pour over loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Baste often.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Mix all together in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Peanut Butter Roundups
instructions: Beat shortening and sugars together until creamy. Add eggs and peanut butter. Beat well. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture mixing well. Stir in oats.

title: Fudge Eclaire Pie
instructions: Mix pudding according to directions. Fold in Cool Whip. Starting with graham crackers on bottom layer crackers then pudding (making at least 5 layers). Frost with frosting and refrigerate. Best if made 3 days in advance! Its worth the wait!

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine wet ingredients and mix well. Blend dry ingredients and mix both together. Grease 2 loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Cheese Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast with sugar and 1/4 cup water. Mix 5 cups flour with salt and make a well and add 1 1/2 cups water butter and yeast. Stir and turn out with 1/2 to 1 cup flour. Knead 10 to 12 minutes. Cover and let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Punch down and knead in the cheeses. Halve and let rest 10 minutes. Roll into a rectangle (11 x 6-inch) and let rest 2 to 3 minutes. Roll up and place in 8 x 4 x 2-inch well-greased bread tins. Let rise until top of tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool before slicing.

title: Seafood Quiche
instructions: Saute onion and shrimp in butter until shrimp are curled and pink and onion is translucent. Pour in crab meat and stir. Pour mixture in pie crust. Beat together the eggs cream salt pepper and mace. Pour over seafood in crust. Dot the surface with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes until nicely browned and very puffed. Good hot or cold. Settles as it cools. Serves 4.

title: Cheddar Broccoli Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the broccoli cheese and onion. Combine the mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Pour over broccoli mixture and toss to coat. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Just before serving stir in the bacon. Yield 8 servings.

title: Mushroom Supreme
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter. Dissolve beef cubes in water. Set aside. Melt butter and blend with flour. Add cream salt pepper and beef broth. Top with cheese and bread crumbs before baking in a buttered casserole 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers and mix with 1 1/2 sticks melted butter. Pat into 9 x 13-inch dish. Beat 2 sticks butter confectioners sugar and eggs together. Put on top of vanilla wafer mixture. Slice bananas on top of cream mixture. Drain crushed pineapple and put on top of bananas. Next spread on Cool Whip. Then you can decorate with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg biscuit mix potato flakes and flavoring. Mix thoroughly. Roll into balls about an inch in diameter. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until light brown. Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Chop onions into bite-size pieces and place in 2-quart buttered casserole dish. Chop butter into small pats and place evenly over onions. Place cheese slices on top. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. The cheese will melt and hold the onions together. Take out of oven and sprinkle French fried onions on top. Return to oven and bake for 10 minutes.

title: Beef And Cheddar Soft Tacos
instructions: Cook beef in skillet until browned. Pour off fat. Add soup and salsa and heat through. Spoon about 1/3 cup meat mixture down center of each tortilla. Top with Lettuce. Fold tortilla around filling. Serve with additional salsa or rice.

title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger (drain off excess fat). Add flour mushrooms and cream of chicken soup. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir in sour cream and heat. Serve hot over cooked noodles.

title: Sara Lind'S Wassail
instructions: Simmer 30 minutes and serve hot.

title: Texas Pecan Candy Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in tube pan in 250\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Waikiki Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef crumbs onion egg salt ginger and milk thoroughly. Shape into meatballs. Melt shortening in a skillet; brown and cook meatballs. Remove meatballs. Keep warm. Pour fat from a pan. Mix cornstarch and brown sugar. Stir in reserved pineapple juice vinegar and soy sauce until smooth. Pour into a skillet. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir for 1 minute. Add meatballs pineapple and green peppers. Heat thoroughly.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken debone and shred. Cook milk flour and butter until thickened. Cool. Add chicken noodles mayonnaise eggs and almonds. Stir together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45-60 minutes.

title: Green Chili Corn Cakes
instructions: About 15 minutes before serving In a medium bowl mix the corn meal flour sugar baking powder and salt. With fork stir in milk egg and green chilies just until mixture is moistened. (Batter will be slightly lumpy.) In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat add 1 tablespoon salad oil until hot. Pour batter into skillet by scant 1/4 cupfuls making a few corn cakes at a time. Cook until lightly browned on both sides. Repeat adding more oil if needed. Makes 12 corn cakes 9 calories each.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
instructions: Mix oil shortening cocoa and granulated sugar. Blend in one egg at a time until well mixed. Add vanilla; stir in flour. Chill several hours or overnight. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Drop teaspoonfuls of dough into confectioners sugar. Roll in sugar and shape into balls. Place about 2 inches apart on well-greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Do not overbake! Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

title: Steve'S Hot Buffalo Wings
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer covered for an hour.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Heat broiler with rack 5-7 inches away from heat. Mix mayo lime juice and taco seasoning. Place chicken on broiler pan and brush with half the mayo mixture. Broil 5-7 minutes turn and brush with remaining mayo mixture. Continue broiling 8-10 minutes or until tender.

title: Boston Clam Chowder
instructions: Saut onion celery and green pepper. Put in large soup pot. Add milk clams and juice soup potatoes and seasonings. Simmer until potatoes are soft. (Check frequently for scorching.) Just before serving add crumbled bacon if desired. Yield 16 cups.

title: Chicken Feed
instructions: Melt butter add remaining ingredients. Pour over cereal and mix. Cover and bake 1 hour at 225 degrees. Uncover and bake 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Bran-Apple Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix flour baking powder cinnamon and salt in large bowl. Mix cereal and milk in another bowl and let stand for 5 minutes. Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in cereal mixture and egg. Add to flour mixture stir just until moistened. Stir in apples. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Roquefort Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until blended using salt and pepper to taste. May be made ahead. Keeps several weeks in refrigerator.

title: 1-2-3 Beef
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into casserole. Cover. Bake 1 1/2 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven. Can be served over mashed potatoes rice or noodles.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients with salt; let stand overnight. Drain and rinse with 4 changes of water.

title: Chunk-Of-Cheese Bread
instructions: Bring the water cornmeal and salt to a boil stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and add molasses and butter. Cool to lukewarm. Soften the yeast in 1/2 cup warm water then add to the cornmeal mixture and blend thoroughly. Gradually add the flour and stir to form a stiff dough. Knead until smooth and satiny about 5 minutes.

title: Pizza Delights
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet cook sausage over medium heat; drain off fat. Stir in pizza sauce ketchup and garlic powder. Set aside. Press biscuits into 20 well-greased muffin cups. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons of the meat and sauce into each biscuit. Top with Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 20 muffin size pizzas.

title: Pizza Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread over pizza crust.

title: Cream Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt oleo in a large skillet or Dutch oven. Stir in corn. When corn is completely thawed add cream cheese stir until melted. Pour into casserole and bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in this order Crisco and sugar then eggs salt food coloring flour and milk alternately. Then add vanilla. Beat continuously while adding ingredients.

title: Ginny'S Gingerbread
instructions: Line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with wax paper that has been greased. Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg then molasses. Combine thoroughly and add dry ingredients and water alternately until all have been added. Continue to beat until thoroughly mixed. Pour into pan and bake 35 minutes. Oven 325\u00b0. Yield 15-24 servings.

title: Ham Pinwheels
instructions: Mix together except for ham. Spoon onto ham and roll; fasten with toothpicks. Freeze for a couple of hours at least. Then cut and serve.

title: Spinach Balls(Party Finger Food - Make Ahead)
instructions: Cook spinach and drain thoroughly. Mix all ingredients and chill. Shape into balls (1 to 1 1/2-inches) and freeze on tray. Put frozen balls into container and use as desired. Cook on a tray for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool a little. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Put this in an oblong casserole dish. Crust the vanilla wafers. Add a little butter. Press in the dish and bake 5 minutes or so. Let cool. Add the bananas (sliced crossway). Mix the cream cheese confectioners sugar and pineapple (drained). Mix this and put over the bananas. Next layer cherry pie filling. Use all. Next layer Cool Whip; use all. Sprinkle with chopped pecans and place cherries about on top to decorate. Keep chilled.

title: Easy-Good Peach Dessert
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan pour 2 large cans sliced peaches and juice. Sprinkle with cake mix. Sliver oleo over top. Scatter crushed nuts over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. When cool top with Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream (refrigerate).

title: Frosty Fruit Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine sugar buttermilk salt and vanilla until well mixed. Gently stir in drained fruits. Pour into 9-inch square pan and freeze until firm. Cut into squares at serving time.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Microwave margarine in a 4 quart microwave safe-bowl on high for 1 minute or until melted. Add sugar and milk; mix well. Microwave on high for 5 minutes; stir after 3 minutes. Mix well scrape bowl continue microwaving on high for 5 1/2 minutes stirring after 3 minutes. Remove from microwave stir in chips until melted. Add remaining ingredients; mixing well. Pour into buttered 13 x 9 baking pan. Let cool and cut. If you want peanut butter fudge add 7 or 8 ounces peanut butter instead of chocolate chips.

title: Christmas Bread(Julekake)
instructions: Heat 1 cup milk and 1 teaspoon sugar and dissolve yeast in it. Add 1 cup flour and stir well. Let rise to double or 1/2 hour. Heat other cup of milk to lukewarm and add salt sugar beaten eggs and cardamom. Add butter. Mix in 5 to 6 cups flour and work in more on the table if needed. Add fruit and raisins before the last cup of flour. Let rise until doubled. Make into round loaves or braided ring. Put in greased pans and let rise to less than double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 4 loaves.

title: Beef And Rice Porcupines
instructions: Mix beef onions salt and pepper. Form into small balls. Fry in hot Crisco or Wesson oil. Turn frequently until light brown but not crusty on all sides. Add tomato soup and water. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: My Favorite Brownies
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels and butter on low heat stirring constantly. Let cool. Stir in eggs brown sugar and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients. Add to mixture stirring until blended. Fold in marshmallows nuts and semi-sweet morsels. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Center should be springy when taken out of oven. Be careful not to overbake.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients mix well pour into a square baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a bowl. Roll into bite size balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown (about 10 to 15 minutes).

title: Rabbit In Beer
instructions: Place cut-up rabbit in a paper or plastic bag with lightly salted flour. Brown the floured rabbit in margarine. Remove meat from the pot and blend in two tablespoons flour in the remaining fat. Drain liquid from the can of mushrooms and add enough water to this to make about 1 cup. Add this to the pot gradually and cook until thickened. Stir in beer and return the rabbit. Cover and cook until meat is tender. Add mushrooms and green beans; continue cooking until heated.

title: Yogurt Fluff
instructions: Pour boiling water into blender container. Add gelatin and blend at low speed until dissolved about 1 minute. Combine and add water and ice cubes to make 1 cup. Add to gelatin and stir until ice is melted then blend in yogurt and vanilla. Chill in dessert glasses or bowl until set about 1 hour. Makes 5 servings (35 calories per serving).

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until it bubbles and the butter and brown sugar are melted.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine first 4 ingredients. Cut in butter until crumbly. Press 1/2 into a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Cover with apples. In saucepan combine sugar cornstarch water and vanilla. Cook and stir until thick and clear. Pour over apples. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes or until the apples are tender. Serve warm with ice cream if desired. Yields 8 servings.

title: Faye'S Ham Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 2 baking sheets. Sift 1/2 cup of flour onto wax paper. Heat water salt and 1/4 cup butter until butter melts. Bring to a full boil. Add sifted flour all at once. Stir over low heat about 1 minute or until mixutre leaves side of pan and forms a ball. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Beat eggs one at a time into mixture beating until smooth after each addition.

title: Jello Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Drain the juice from the crushed pineapple. Heat juice until boiling add jello to dissolved. Add ice cream stir until smooth. Add crushed pineapple and refrigerate overnight. Stir when ready to serve.

title: French Onion Burger
instructions: Mix egg into ground beef blending well. Stir in soup mix. Divide mixture into 6 equal parts and form into balls. Press balls into patties. Fry broil or grill to desired wellness topping with cheeses near the end of cooking time. Serve burgers on French bread.

title: Mom'S Strawberry Pie And Sweet Crust
instructions: Cook sugar starch and water until thick. Remove and add strawberry jello. Pour over strawberries in crust and cool.

title: Italian Cucumber Salad
instructions: Toss together all ingredients with bottled Italian salad dressing.

title: Chicken Crunch
instructions: Blend broth into soup in 2-quart casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Persimmon Bread
instructions: Sift all 5 dry ingredients in mixing bowl. Make a well in center. Add eggs butter bourbon persimmon puree nuts and raisins. Mix the dough until it is quite smooth. Butter and flour pan; fill about 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pan then turn on rack.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Lightly combine all ingredients and allow to set 1/2 hour. Add more milk for thinner pancakes. Cook on lightly greased hot griddle.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain. Blend chicken onions and mayonnaise in saucepan. Blend in soups and milk. Heat and stir until smooth. Add cheese and heat until cheese melts. Put noodles into mixture. Transfer to casserole dish and bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Taco Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400`. Dice chicken and dredge in taco seasoning (may place chicken/seasoning in plastic bag and shake to coat). Saute onion and chicken in margarine until brown. Prepare rice according to directions and drain. In a casserole dish arrange rice around edges and place chicken and onions in the middle. Combine tomatoes and salsa and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 40 minutes or until cheese is browned. May be served in warmed fajitas or over taco chips.

title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cook potatoes in salted water. Mash until all lumps are gone. Add salt pepper onion salt sour cream and cream cheese. Whip until light and fluffy. Cool. Will keep up to 12 days in refrigerator. Place in buttered casserole and top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Never Fail Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put into saucepan; add 2 cups hot water. Cook until clear. Cool. Pour over 1 quart of strawberries in a baked pie shell. Top with whipped cream.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and margarine in big pot. Put the remaining ingredients in pot and mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Holiday Yam Bake
instructions: Drain yams; mash well. Drain pineapple; reserve juice. Add juice to yams. Add sugar and butter; beat well. Stir in pineapple and pecans. Coat inside of 1 1/2-quart casserole with Pam. Spoon in mixture. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with marshmallows. Bake for 10 minutes longer. Serves 8.

title: Christmas Stollen
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; add sugar salt eggs butter and half of the flour. Beat 10 minutes at medium speed on mixer or by hand. Blend in rest of flour almonds and fruits. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled about 1 hour. Stir down batter by beating 25 strokes. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. On well floured board divide dough in half press each half into a 10 x 7-inch oval sheet. Spread with 2 tablespoons soft butter or margarine. Fold each in two length-ways firmly pressing edges in place on greased baking sheet. Brush top with slightly beaten egg whites mixed with 1 tablespoon water. Let rise in warm place until light. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. When cool frost and decorate with almonds and cherries. Makes 2.

title: Onion Pie
instructions: Saute onions in 1/2 cube butter. Crush crackers and put into pie pan. Melt 1 1/2 cubes butter. Add to crackers. Mix to form a pie shell.

title: Gourmet Green Bean Bake
instructions: Cook and drain beans. In 1-quart casserole dish blend soup milk soy sauce and pepper until smooth. Stir in beans and 1/2 can onions. Sprinkle 1/2 can onions on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl combine applesauce sugars vanilla and Egg Beaters until well blended. Add flour mixture and stir until well blended. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Recipe makes 5 dozen cookies. Ultra low-fat.

title: Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Mix applesauce soda and water and add to creamed mixture. Add flour salt baking powder cinnamon nutmeg and cloves and mix well. Then add gumdrops raisins nuts and final 1 c. flour. Mix well and bake in 9 inch tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours 15 minutes. (Paper bottom and grease sides.) Let cool a few minutes then remove from pan. This cake is just like fruitcake but doesnt have the fruits.

title: Harvest Potato Boats
instructions: Cook sausage until no longer pink. Drain fat. Add carrots beans zucchini and onion. Saute until crisp-tender. Season to taste. Cut large cross in each potato. Squeeze until opening is large enough to hold filling. Spoon a generous serving into each. Top with sour cream.

title: Chicken Florentine
instructions: Cook spinach and drain completely. Melt butter; stir in garlic basil and marjoram. Blend in flour. Add cream stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Remove from heat; stir in spinach. Place mixture in a 2-quart baking dish. Cover spinach mixture with chicken.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
