instructions: Saute butter and onion until transparent; mix remaining ingredients except cheese. Put all into 2-quart casserole; top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Zippy Curry Dip
instructions: In a bowl combine the first 8 ingredients; mix well. Refrigerate until serving. Yield About 1 cup.

title: J R'S Parfait Pies
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Stir constantly. Gradually add ice cream until very thick. Some chunks of ice cream may not completely melt this will give it a swirled look very pretty. Pour into ready to use crusts. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. JR prefers them frozen.

title: Cran-Apple Carrot Muffins
instructions: Combine flour sugar soda cinnamon and salt in a large bowl. Then add carrots raisins cranberries pecans coconut and apples.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift together flour salt and soda and set aside. Cream together shortening sugar and bananas. Add to creamed mixture the eggs and mix. Add flour mixture and mix well. Add nut meats and vanilla. Grease and flour 2 large loaf pans. Divide batter into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour but check it sooner by inserting a straw into the center of the loaves.

title: Debbie Greenberg'S Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Mix bread stuffing melted margarine and hot water. Place half of mixture in greased 12 x 8-inch dish. Combine cooked chicken onion celery and mayonnaise. Place in dish over bread mixture. Top with remaining half of bread stuffing mixture.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut butter into dry cake mix until crumbly. Stir in coconut; pat mixture lightly into 9 x 13-inch pan building up slight edges. Bake 10 minutes. Arrange apple slices on warm crust. Mix sugar and cinnamon sprinkle on apples. Blend sour cream and egg yolks. Drizzle on apples (topping will not completely cover apples). Bake 25 minutes or until edges are light brown (do not overbake). Serve warm.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 6 tablespoons of juice. Combine flour and sugar and stir in reserved juice in a small bowl. Put pineapple and cheese into a large bowl and stir together. Then add flour mixture and stir. Mix well. Spoon mixture into a 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Combine melted butter or margarine and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Favorite Beef Loaf
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients. Add ground beef. Mix well. Shape mixture into a loaf in a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 1/4 hours. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine; add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish; melt 1/4 stick margarine and add 2 cups Ritz cracker crumbs stir to coat well. Put on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese mixture is bubbly.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients to beef. Keep warm in a fondue pot. Serve with corn chips or flour tortillas.

title: Fresh Strawberry Soup
instructions: Puree all ingredients except mint in blender. Put in bowl; cover and\tlet stand in\trefrigerator for 6 hours or overnight.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Beat eggs. Stir in milk. Sift together flour baking powder salt and soda and beat in shortening. Dip apple slices into fritter batter and drop into the hot grease.

title: Holiday Bread
instructions: Mix together milk egg oil and vanilla. Set aside. Mix together sugar flour baking powder and salt. Add to milk mixture. (Use one of the last four ingredients or your own flavor.) Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or 3 mini loaf pans. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Hot Taco Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients; add to a casserole dish. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Granny'S Spanish Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper the roast. Brown in 3 tablespoons of oil or shortening. Mix garlic chili powder ketchup Worcestershire sauce and water. Pour this over the browned roast. Add onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until tender. Serve with rice. Gravy is delicious.

title: Scallops St. Jacques Mornay
instructions: Saute scallops in butter mushrooms and white wine. Add garlic cream and tarragon. Thicken with roux. Top with Swiss cheese and broil to a golden brown.

title: Calico Dip
instructions: Cut off top or round loaf. Pull inside of bread out (with fork) in dip-sized pieces. Mix ingredients and spoon into hollow loaf. Replace round top; wrap in foil and bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Before serving place small pieces of bread pulled from loaf on cookie sheet and place under broiler just long enough to lightly toast and harden pieces. Remove lid from loaf and dip pieces into cheese mix. When bread bits are gone tear off pieces of loaf to eat.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Beat together shortening sugar and eggs. Add mashed bananas. Add 2 cups flour 1 teaspoon soda pinch of salt vanilla and nut meats. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ann'S Pecan Pie
instructions: In a medium size bowl beat eggs (with a fork for 1 minute). Add sugar; mix. Add Karo syrup. Add melted margarine; mix well. Add the chopped pecans; mix well. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Top with whole pecans. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn up to 350\u00b0 and bake until golden brown (about 20 to 30 minutes).

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Rinse breasts\tand pat dry. Combine cornflake crumbs seasonings\tand Parmesan cheese in a plastic bag. Dip chicken in milk and place in the bag of crumbs. Shake until coated. Place chicken in foil-lined baking dish and drizzle each piece with melted diet margarine. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Zesty Biscuits
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Spoon into muffin tins and bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Melt butter. Put in bottom of a 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Put both cans of cherry pie filling in butter. Sprinkle dry cake mix over that. Add coconut and nuts on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes to golden brown.

title: Beef Tips For The Working Mom
instructions: Mix soups together. Add beef tips and place in crock-pot. Cook all day. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cook mixture until thick. Beat with mixer until smooth. Put in pie shells and cool.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine eggs sugar Karo butter and pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 or 350\u00b0 for 40 or 45 minutes.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking powder together. Combine eggs milk potatoes and butter. Beat well then add to first mixture. Fry as for regular pancakes.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar milk salt cocoa and butter to a boil then add oats peanut butter and vanilla. Spoon on wax paper. Let cool.

title: Shortbread Cookies
instructions: Use festive cookie cutters. The kids will enjoy decorating the cookies for all the holidays.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Combine 2 cups flour and 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles cornmeal. Spoon flour mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; pressing mixture evenly and firmly into bottom of dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is lightly browned. Combine 1/2 cup flour and baking powder; set aside. Combine eggs 2 cups sugar and lemon juice; beat well. Stir dry ingredients into egg mixture and pour over baked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for additional 25 minutes or until lightly brown and set. Cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup powdered sugar and cut into bars. Yields about 2 dozen bars.

title: Mickey'S Favorite Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar together. Add eggs beating after each one. Sift dry ingredients together and add to cream mixture. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Prepare potatoes as you would for mashed potatoes then add other ingredients. Put in baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crispy Cheddar Treats
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour cheese margarine and salt. Mix with electric mixer until well blended. Stir in rice cereal. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Place balls 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Flatten balls into thin circles using the heel of your hand or a flat bottomed glass. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat buttermilk to lukewarm; add soda. Stir in melted butter sugar and salt. Add 2 cups flour. Stir in yeast. Add eggs. Beat thoroughly. Add remaining flour and raisins.

title: Colcannon
instructions: Melt the butter; add onion and cover with a round of greased paper. Put lid on saucepan and cook over a slow heat for 10 minutes but do not allow to color. Add the mashed potatoes chopped cabbage pepper salt and milk. Mix all together well and reheat thoroughly stirring all the time. Pile up in a hot vegetable dish. Score with a fork.

title: Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients except cheese. In a shallow baking dish shape half of the mixture into loaf. Cut 4 slices of cheese into strips. Arrange on top of meat. Top with remaining meat. Press edges together to seal. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining cheese slices.

title: Chicken Almond
instructions: Mix rice soup and water. Crumble and brown sausage; drain. Saute onion and pepper lightly. Add all ingredients with almonds. Put in casserole and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all together adding ginger ale when ready to serve.

title: Banana Chiffon Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt into mixing bowl. Make a well in dry ingredients and add in order oil egg yolks banana and lemon juice. Beat until smooth. Add cream of tartar to whites. Beat egg whites to very stiff peaks. Do not underbeat. Gradually and gently fold banana mixture into egg whites just until blended. Do not stir. Pour into ungreased 10-inch tube pan 4-inches deep. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes.

title: Grilled Garlicky Chicken Breasts
instructions: Mix salad dressing mix and cheese. Moisten chicken in water; dip in dressing mixture. Grill over medium-hot coals 15 to 20 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Quick Saucy Stir-Fry
instructions: In a large skillet heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Stir-fry vegetables for 4 to 5 minutes until tender-crisp; remove. Add remaining oil to skillet. Stir-fry chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until tender. Return vegetables to chicken and remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients except rice. Mix well. Serve over hot cooked rice. Serves 4.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla and cream well. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add baking soda salt flour and sour cream. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes in a greased and floured tube pan.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low until cheese is melted (usually takes 1 to 2 hours).

title: Sad Cake
instructions: Mix all together and bake in lightly greased pan at 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes or until cake puffs up and then flops. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Picante Sauce Dip
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese and picante sauce.

title: Hot Sausage Sandwiches
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Put in microwave for about 1 minute because this helps to drain more. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Put in fridge overnight.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in salt water. Drain well and mash squash. Add rest of the ingredients. Bake in greased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Asparagus Roll-Ups
instructions: Trim off crusts from bread. Flatten bread with rolling pin so each slice is really thin. Beat together 2 cheeses (which have been softened) and egg. Mix well with rotary beater until smooth. (Leave some lumps of Bleu cheese.)

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Stir in soup. Add extra Italian seasoning if desired. Cook spaghetti and drain.

title: Black Bean Vegetable Chili
instructions: Place eggplant in colander toss with salt and let sit for 1 hour to remove moisture; pat dry. Heat 1/4 cup olive oil saute onions zucchini peppers and garlic for 10 minutes. Place remaining 1/4 cup olive oil in separate skillet. Over medium-high heat saute eggplant until tender approximately 10 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon to casserole with other ingredients. Add to casserole tomatoes broth 1/2 cup parsley basil and spices. Cook over low heat 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. After 30 minutes add black beans corn dill and lemon juice. Cook an additional 15 minutes. Adjust seasonings and stir in remaining 1/2 cup parsley.

title: Pork Marinade
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Coat pork tenderloin with sauce and let soak for 1/2 hour. Bake as usual.

title: Stuffed Giant Shells
instructions: Brown meat onion and garlic. Drain and cool. Stir in Mozzarella cheese bread crumbs parsley and egg. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Coca-Cola Salad For Diabetics
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Drain pineapple; add juice to Coca-Cola and bring to a boil. Pour over jello and stir until dissolved. When slightly warm add cream cheese and beat until thoroughly mixed. Sweeten strawberries to taste with Sweet One. Add to mixture and beat slightly. Add pineapple and nuts; stir until mixed. Add mayonnaise and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Creamy Pork Chops And Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place potatoes and onion in an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Mix soup and milk. Pour into casserole. Top with pork chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cheri'S Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter. Mix all other ingredients except fruit. If mixture is too soupy add more Bisquick to thicken. Prepare fruit and add to center of mix. Do not stir! Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pink Party Salad
instructions: Heat juice marshmallows and Jell-O. Cool. When cooled add cheese nuts and cream. Chill overnight. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Melt margarine and pour in sugar to dissolve. Add milk and potatoes to mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Beat eggs and add to mixture. Mix well. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: E-Z Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and stir in vinegar ketchup and mustard. Pour over meat and bake.

title: Cornbread Dressing(For Turkey)
instructions: Crumble cornbread. Add bread cubes and rice. Saute onions and celery in margarine until tender. Add to cornbread mixture. Add beaten eggs boiled eggs and margarine. Add spices and soup. Add pecans last. If dressing is too dry add either bouillon or water to moisten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (dont overcook). Dressing should be quite moist when done.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a large bowl put the sugar and flour. In a saucepan put the oleo Crisco water and cocoa. Bring saucepan ingredients to a boil. Add to sugar and flour. Mix well and add the eggs and buttermilk with the soda dissolved in it. Beat well. Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Buttermilk-Garlic Dressing
instructions: Whisk together mayonnaise and buttermilk. Stir in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate covered at least 8 hours.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients. Add 1 egg at a time. Add strawberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: Layer with onions then homimy and chili then cheese. Add juice until moist. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Russian Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken breasts in pan with canola oil. Place in baking dish skin side up. Brush Russian salad dressing over the chicken and add one can of drained apricots. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown and tender (approximately 1/2 to 3/4 hour). Serve over a bed of wild rice and garnish with steamed broccoli.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and add the rest.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll out thin and let set for 20 minutes. Add to boiling broth. Add enough milk for juice. Never stir!! Cook until done.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Mix well. Add pineapple salt and vanilla. Dissolve soda in boiling water and add to mixture. Stir in flour one cup at a time. Bake at about 350\u00b0.

title: Chinese-Style Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Add chicken vegetables and garlic. Stir-fry until chicken is cooked through. Mix cornstarch ginger broth and soy sauce until smooth; stir into skillet. Stirring constantly bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute.

title: Barbecue Pork Ribs
instructions: Use a 4-inch deep large roasting pan. Place your pork ribs in bottom of pan. Peel and cut onion in half. Place 1/2 onion on each end of pan. Cover completely with barbecue sauce (onion and ribs). Place aluminum foil over pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 35 minutes.

title: Cabbage And More
instructions: Heat oil. Add all ingredients except cabbage and sugar. Cook 20 minutes. Add cabbage and 1 cup water. Cook 20 minutes more or until tender. Make corn bread and get down!

title: Fresh Orange Juice Delight
instructions: Soften the gelatin in warm water. Combine the orange juice and gelatin with Equal or sugar. Refrigerate until jelled. Cut the gelatin into small cubes; serve in champagne glasses. Garnish with the grated orange rind.

title: I Can'T Believe It'S Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix egg butter and pecans. Grease sheet pan. Press ingredients in pan.

title: *Carrot Cake
instructions: Grease and flour tube pan. Mix together oil eggs and sugar. Sift together all dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture then add nuts and carrots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Use Carrot Cake Frosting (found elsewhere).

title: Reese'S Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips. Press into buttered pan. Melt chocolate chips. Pour over peanut butter mixture. Cool cut and serve.

title: Jezebel Sauce
instructions: Mix horseradish and dry mustard well. Mix in remainder of ingredients. Makes 4 cups. Good on sliced ham. Will keep in refrigerator for years.

title: Rosemary'S Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese soften and mix with sugar and 3/4 bowl of the cool whip. Add butterfinger candy bars. Put this mixture into the crust and top with the remaining cool whip. Garnish with more crushed candy bars. Freeze for 4 hours.

title: Easy Beef Goulash
instructions: Heat oil. Brown beef; drain. Sprinkle uncooked noodles over meat. Combine water tomato sauce and onion soup and pour over noodles. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer for about 30 minutes or until noodles are tender. Add water as needed.

title: Blackberry Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and add sugar. Add eggs and beat in well. Add remaining ingredients and mix until well blended. Pour into greased pans. Bake for 55 minutes for large loaf pan or 30 minutes for small loaf.

title: Angels Delight
instructions: Dissolve marshmallows in hot milk. Layer ingredients in an oblong pan starting with crumbs mixed with vanilla and marshmallow mixture then whipped cream and pineapple. Top with layer of graham cracker crumbs. Serves 12.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli pieces for 7 minutes in microwave. Cook pepper pieces and onions for 5 minutes in microwave. Mix other ingredients into vegetables. Cook all (broccoli and vegetables) and other ingredients another 5 to 10 minutes to taste tenderness. Or may bake in oven for 30 to 45 minutes to taste tenderness and with rest of oven-dinner main meat dish.

title: Stuffed Peppers(Microwave)
instructions: Combine beef and onion and microwave 2 to 3 minutes. Add rice tomato sauce celery and salt to taste. Stuff the peppers and place each on a square of plastic wrap. Twist the corners together. Place into a casserole dish and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave for 8 minutes.

title: Scallop And Mushroom Pie
instructions: Cut cleaned scallops into half but do not cut the red coral. Simmer in milk with salt and pepper (to taste) for 15 minutes. Strain; reserve milk. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and mix well. Gradually stir in warm milk. Avoid lumps. Add mushrooms (cut in pieces). Add the sherry and the scallops. Place in ovenproof dish. Cover top with mashed potato. Dot with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 until the top is lightly browned about 20 to 30 minutes. Garnish with parsley. Soft rolls can be added to scallops if available.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar and milk in a large glass bowl. Microwave on High for 4 minutes; stir well. Continue cooking for 1 1/2 to 3 minutes on High or until boiling and sugar dissolves. Stir in remaining ingredients until melted. Pour into buttered 8 x 8-inch dish. Cool; cut into squares. Makes about 3 dozen fudge squares.

title: Appled Roll
instructions: Make 2 cups of biscuit dough sweeten with 1 tablespoon sugar. Roll out as for pie crust.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl beat together eggs and sugar. Add all other ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Crumble streusel topping over batter and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Cream shortening peanut butter egg milk vanilla and sugars. Add soda salt and flour. Shape into balls; roll in sugar and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Top each with a chocolate star immediately; press firmly so cookie cracks around the edge.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: In a large bowl combine strawberries 1/4 c of the sugar and lemon juice. Crush with a potato masher until strawberries are almost pureed. Set aside.

title: Mexican Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In skillet brown ground beef chili powder salt and garlic salt until light brown. Drain. In a small bowl combine sour cream mayonnaise and onions.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and cinnamon. Cut biscuits in fourths. Put in large bowl with sugar and cinnamon. Seal bowl and shake. Melt margarine and pour over this in a Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine spinach bacon eggs onion and dressing to moisten; toss lightly.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Pick meat from bones and add chicken back to broth. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add celery carrots peas and onion. Thicken broth with flour. Top with biscuit; bake in 375\u00b0 oven until biscuits are done.

title: Straw Hat
instructions: Cook and drain meat then mix all other ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake 45 minutes at 400\u00b0. On plate sprinkle with chips. Top with meat mixture and then sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.

title: Slim Sour Cream
instructions: Process all ingredients except scallions. Scrape in bowl and add scallions.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies(Club Member: Brad Smith)
instructions: In large bowl mix sugar and unsweetened chocolate; add eggs one at a time until all blended well. Mix in vanilla. Mix flour baking powder and salt; add slowly to chocolate mixture. Cover and chill 2 hours. Drop mixture by rounded teaspoonful into confectioners sugar lightly coating. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes; set aside to cool.

title: Cool Lime Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O marshmallows sugar and hot water. Leave out of refrigerator until marshmallows are dissolved. Cover and refrigerate until thickened. Add whipped cream pineapple cream cheese and nuts. Chill before serving.

title: Judy'S Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain water from artichoke hearts and chop them. Place all ingredients in bowl. Mix at medium speed with electric mixer. Pour in Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve with bagel chips or tortilla chips. Double for large group.

title: Poppy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts and pull chicken from bone. Crush Ritz crackers. Use 1/2 of Ritz cracker crumbs in bottom of casserole. Place chicken on top of crumbs. Mix sour cream and cream of chicken soup. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Put other half Ritz cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Virginia Peanut Soup
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add onion and celery; saute for 5 minutes. Do not brown. Add flour until mixture is well blended. Add hot chicken broth and cook for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Put butter sugar and unbeaten eggs in bowl. Beat and blend very well. Add sour cream sifted flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Blend well. Last make a thin paste of Hersheys cocoa and hot water. Blend all this into the batter. Stir well and pour into 2 (9-inch) greased layer cake pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Put layers together with any chocolate frosting or whipped cream.

title: Mashed Potato Buns
instructions: Let rise; shape into buns and put into greased pan and let rise until light and about double in size. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 25 to 30 minutes. This is large portion. I use 1/2 of recipe.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Molasses Krispies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add molasses and egg and mix well. Combine dry ingredients and add to above. Mix well. Chill. Make into small balls. Roll in sugar. Flatten with a fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes.

title: T. C. Soli'S Texas Salsa
instructions: Proportionate downward to fit your need.

title: Meat And Bean Dish
instructions: Brown beef with onion and peppers; drain well. Stir in other ingredients; simmer 10 minutes.

title: Italian Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes in half. Score cut surface. Place melted butter in bottom of baking pan. Place potatoes cut-side down in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tender. Turn potatoes and brush Italian dressing onto cut side. Bake cut-side up 5 additional minutes. When done brush on more salad dressing.

title: Crispy Chip Chicken(Mom Or Dad Will Help With Hard Parts.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Placing chips in Ziploc bag and using a rolling pin crush into coarse crumbs (about 2 cups). Set aside.

title: 14-Layer Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating between each addition. Add half the flour and half the milk. Mix well. Add remaining flour and milk. Mix well and add vanilla. Grease (using butter) and flour pans. Put 2 or 3 tablespoons of batter in each layer enough to cover bottom. Layers do not have to brown. Bake at 350\u00b0 until dry. Cook about 6 at a time by putting them on both racks of the oven. Do not wash pans between layers. Wipe with paper towel and regrease with butter and flour. Have chocolate filling ready and pour over layers as they get done.

title: Chicken Broccoli Vegetable Saute
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in 1 tablespoon olive oil cook chicken 15 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove chicken and keep warm. In same skillet in remaining olive oil cook broccoli carrots and mushrooms 5 minutes stirring often. Stir in soup milk and pepper. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes or until chicken is tender and vegetables are crisp-tender.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: In large skillet brown beef; drain. Add barbecue sauce and onion. Separate biscuits and roll flat with rolling pin. Place each biscuit in muffin pan cup. Spoon meat into biscuits; sprinkle each with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 12 to 15 minutes or until biscuits are brown. Kids love these; they like to help with the rolling of the biscuits too!

title: Fried Dough
instructions: Let bread dough thaw. Break off pieces and flatten. Fry in hot oil about 5 minutes until golden brown; turn over and fry other side. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar powdered sugar or spread with jelly or jam.

title: Blueberry Muffins(Low-Fat And Special Diet)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Add blueberries and toss. Make well in center; set aside. Combine milk and next 5 ingredients. Add to dry mixture and stir. Spoon in muffin pan sprayed with cooking oil. Fill 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour shortening sugar and salt. Mix very well. Combine vinegar water and egg and add to flour mixture. Mix with hand until it forms 1 large ball. Chill 15 minutes. Divide into 6 balls. Roll on lightly floured board. Makes 6 single crusts or 3 double. Unused crust may be frozen or refrigerated.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix margarine and crumbs. Heat soup. Remove from heat and add mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Cut broccoli stalks in half lengthwise. Place broccoli in bottom of 12-quart casserole. Spread chicken over broccoli and add sauce. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tuna Mousse
instructions: Heat undiluted soup. Add cream cheese and stir until dissolved. Soften gelatin in lemon juice and off heat add to hot soup. Let cool. Drain tuna and stir into the soup mixture along with the other ingredients. Grease a 6-cup mold with mayonnaise or vegetable spray. Add tuna mixture and chill. Unmold and serve. Great with toasted pita or party rye.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and mashed bananas; mix well. Mix dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients and milk to creamy mixture. Mix well and fold in nuts. Pour into 2 well buttered 9-inch pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together in order flour sugar soda cinnamon salt oil eggs vanilla apples and chopped nuts. Pour in Bundt pan and bake 2 hours in a 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients; press into regular cake pan. Freeze.

title: Osgood Pie
instructions: Separate eggs. Cream\tsugar and oleo. Add slightly beaten egg yolks and stir. Add raisins and pecans. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in first mixture. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake in a slow 325\u00b0 oven until set in center. Dont overcook.

title: Aunt Ruth'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Grate 2 quart casserole. Bake for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Grate cheese and mix with stuffing mix. Put on top. Bake about 5 more minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions. Drain well. Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Add all ingredients except stuffing mix. Mix well. Pour over broccoli. Top with stuffing mix. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Emergency Bars
instructions: Melt the margarine on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle cake mix over the top. Arrange in layers on top; marshmallows chocolate chips and Rice Krispies. Drizzle condensed milk over the top and bake at 350\u00b0f. 180\u00b0c. gas mark 4 for 20-25 minutes.

title: Winter Fruit Salad
instructions: Dressing In a blender or food processor combine sugar lemon juice onion mustard and salt. Process until blended. With machine still running add oil in a slow steady stream until mixture is thick and smooth. Add poppy seeds and process just a few seconds more to mix.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. In bowl combine graham cracker crumbs cocoa sugar and butter. Press evenly to bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. In large mixer bowl beat the cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually add sweetened condensed milk beating until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. In small bowl toss 1/2 cup mini chips with flour to coat. Stir into cheese mixture. Pour into prepared pan. Sprinkle remaining chips evenly over top. Bake for 1 hour. Turn oven off; allow to cool in oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Cool to room temperature. Refrigerate before serving. Cover and refrigerate leftover cheesecake. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Miracle Whip Spice Cake
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: E-Z Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish.\tMix milk sugar baking powder and flour. Put fruit in hot melted butter then pour batter on top. Do not stir.\tBake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Tomato Aspic Salad
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water and vinegar. Mix tomato juice onion salt and pepper. Boil 5 minutes. Add horseradish lemon juice and sugar. Add softened gelatin; stir until dissolved. Cool. Add cabbage celery green pepper and pimento. Mix well. Pour into mold. Chill until firm.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Pour rice in bottom of casserole dish. (Season lightly with salt.) Cover with onion and bell pepper. Place pork chops on top. Pour soup and water over pork chops. Liquid should cover top of pork chops. Bake until rice is done. Easy and delicious!

title: Nuts And Bolts
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients in a large roasting pan. Add the cheese oil and Worcestershire sauce. Mix the 3 salts together and sprinkle over mixed ingredients. Mix well. Bake covered 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Bake uncovered at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Store in airtight container.

title: Steak Teriyaki
instructions: Cut meat into bite size pieces or 1/2-inch strips. In large bowl add chopped garlic ginger brown sugar pepper oil water and soy sauce. Mix well. Sprinkle tenderizer on steak and pour mixture over steak. Let set overnight stirring at least once.

title: Spiced Cucumber Rings
instructions: Peel seed and slice cucumbers. Use cucumbers that are too big for other uses (those that have turned yellow are okay). Mix together 1 gallon water and the lime. Pour over cucumbers; let stand for 24 hours. Wash thoroughly. Put into ice water for 3 hours; drain. Make syrup with the sugar vinegar and food coloring. Make a spice bag with the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil the vinegar sugar coloring spices and candy. Pour cucumbers into the mixture; bring back to boil. Let stand for 24 hours. Bring back to boil; boil for 30 minutes. Pack into clean hot jars. Adjust lids. Process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath. Yields 8 pints.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Put in a 9 x 13-inch shallow casserole (greased). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fantastic Bubble Recipe
instructions: Combine. Shake and let settle 4 hours before using. (Non-toxic.)

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease and lightly flour 2 (8 1/2-inch) round baking pans. Stir together flour and baking soda. In mixing bowl beat shortening about 30 seconds. Add sugar and val; beat until well combined. Add eggs one at a time beating 1 minute after. Stir in cooled chocolate and sour cream. Add dry ingredients and 1 cup water alternately to beaten mixture; beat after each addition. Turn into prepared pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes on wire racks.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil sugar margarine and syrup slowly for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla salt and baking soda. Pour over popcorn and stir well. Put in very large pan and bake for 40 minutes at 250\u00b0. Stir every 10 or 15 minutes. Let cool and store in airtight container.

title: Jean'S Chicken
instructions: Place rice in bottom of pan. Place chicken on top. Mix together soups milk and water and pour over chicken and rice. Sprinkle onion soup over all. Seal tightly with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; form ball. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Chocolate Nut Clusters
instructions: In medium microwave-safe bowl place chips and shortening. Microwave at High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth when stirred. Stir in nuts. Spoon heaping teaspoonfuls of mixture into 1-inch paper candy cups or paper-lined mini muffin cups filling each cup half full. Refrigerate until firm. Peel off paper cup if desired. Makes 14 to 16 candies.

title: Pasta Fagoli(Italian Soup)
instructions: Brown garlic in 2 tablespoons oil. Add beans remainder of the oil and all the seasonings. Cook pasta as directed. Drain almost half the water off the pasta. Add other ingredients plus the crushed tomatoes. Stir and heat 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 quarts.

title: Apple Torte
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt soda and cinnamon. In large bowl mix oil sugar flour and eggs. Add apples and nuts (thick mixture). Mix well and place in 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle caramel bits on top. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve topped with whipped cream or ice cream. Freezes well.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Cube the bread and toss with the onion. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Add the shrimp crab celery and mayonnaise. Place in bowl and decorate.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Cream sugar and vanilla together until fluffy. Blend in remaining ingredients except cinnamon and 1 tablespoon sugar. Pour into prepared pan; sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake for 1 hour. After cooling this bread may be wrapped and frozen.

title: Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugar until smooth. Chill batter to firm. Add other ingredients. Roll in dime size balls. Dip bottom of glass in sugar and press each cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 9 dozen.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Preheat to 350\u00b0. Combine cake mix and gelatin add oil and milk eggs one at a time strawberries pecans and coconut. Bake for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Put in meat and spaghetti in pan and cook two hours. Then put in the rocks. Then you eat it.

title: Oriental Spinach Salad
instructions: Tear spinach into bite size pieces. Add water chestnuts bean sprouts eggs and bacon. Toss together.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix everything but eggs and milk; beat. Add eggs and milk; bake 12 minutes at 450\u00b0 or 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half; remove yolks. Mash yolks with a fork. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Refill whites with mixture.

title: Blue Cheese-Red Wine Dressing
instructions: Mash cheese with fork. Mix remaining ingredients. Stir into cheese gradually. Serve over salad greens.

title: Easy Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Place in baking dish layering in order. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onions in skillet and drain. Spread in a 9-inch pie plate. In a bowl beat milk eggs baking mix and salt and pepper by hand 1 minute. Pour over meat in pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and top with tomato sauce and cheese. Bake another 5 to 8 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Sour Cream Cornbread
instructions: Mix and bake at 400\u00b0 in Pyrex pie dish. This dish can be put on the table.

title: Turkey Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a mixing bowl combine all ingredients. Mix together. Place in a loaf pan or free form in a larger baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes until loves are lightly browned and cooked through.

title: Bacon Rolls
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Drain well and crumble. Remove crusts from bread and spread butter on each slice. Down middle of each slice of bread put a line of crumbled bacon and sprinkle with cheese and parsley then paprika and a dash of cayenne pepper. Roll each slice up tightly and fasten with a toothpick. Broil until brown.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Saute chicken and veggies in 2 tablespoons oil. Mix in casserole dish with Ranch dressing. Top with biscuits of your choice. Bake at 350\u00b0 until biscuits are brown.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Sprinkle the cucumbers lightly with salt. Let stand 10 minutes. Rinse drain and place in serving dish. Meanwhile combine the vinegar sugar and pepper and let stand 5 minutes. Pour over cucumbers and sprinkle with the parsley. Chill 2 hours. Yields 6 servings.

title: Gooey Cake
instructions: Mix and spread in 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish.

title: Sour-Cream-Pineapple Coffee Bars
instructions: Mix 2/3 of cake mix with brown sugar and margarine. Add cinnamon if desired. Mix until crumbly. Beat eggs slightly. Add sour cream and remaining 1/3 box of cake mix. Batter will be slightly lumpy. Grease and flour oblong pan. Put half of batter into pan. Cover with brown sugar mixture. Top with half of pineapple. Repeat layer and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Cook ingredients until thick. Pour in cooked pie crust. Cover with meringue and brown.

title: Grill Rub
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Delicious rubbed on beef or pork and grilled.

title: Turmeric Slaw
instructions: Heat vinegar and sugar until sugar is dissolved. Pour over other ingredients while warm. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Hot Brown Sandwich
instructions: Melt butter and stir in flour; cook over low heat blending until smooth. Stir in salt and pepper. Gradually add broth and milk; cook stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Add cheese; simmer about 10 minutes. Sauce will be thick.

title: Coffee Lover'S Freeze
instructions: In heavy saucepan combine sugar and milk; bring to a boil stirring until sugar is dissolved.\tRemove from heat; let stand until cool. Combine milk mixture coffee vanilla and 1 cup whipping cream; mix well. Pour mixture into loaf pan and freeze until slush consistency about 1 to 2 hours. Beat remaining whipping cream until stiff peaks form; do not overbeat. Just before serving stir slush mixture; spoon into dessert dishes filling 2/3 full. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix broth and soup together. Lay chicken in pan; pour soup mix over it. Mix flour milk and margarine together; pour over chicken and soup mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: 15 Minute Chicken And Rice
instructions: Boil chicken on stove first for an hour. Cool chicken pick off meat and chop. In a crock pot add chicken some of the broth from boiling 5 carrots 4 stalks of celery 1 onion 4 garlic cloves chopped1 1/2 to 2 c. peas. Season with regular and season salt pepper sprinkle of sage. Cook on low overnight. Great for Sundays.

title: One Bowl Brownies
instructions: Microwave chocolate and margarine in large bowl at High 2 minutes or until margarine is melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir sugar into melted chocolate until well blended. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until wooden pick comes out almost clean. Do not overbake. Cool in pan. Cut in squares. Makes 24 brownies.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Pour 2 teaspoons margarine in bottom of tube pan then add 3 tablespoons nuts. Add remaining nuts sugar water and margarine in saucepan. Heat to boil and add cinnamon. Cut biscuits in fourths. Place fourths of biscuits in pan. Pour or sprinkle half of heated mixture on biscuits then place another layer of biscuits and remaining mixture on top. Bake.

title: Simmered Round Steak And Vegetables
instructions: Pound trimmed meat with mallet. Cut into serving pieces. Set aside. Mix 4 tablespoons flour salt and pepper in plastic bag. Add beef and shake to coat meat. Heat cooking oil in large skillet. Add beef and flour mixture. Brown over medium heat. Layer onion green pepper and carrots over beef and sprinkle with basil. Add wine and heat to boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer 1 hour until meat is tender. Transfer beef and vegetables to serving plate. Place cold water in small bowl. Blend 2 tablespoons flour and stir into drippings in skillet. Stir in bouillon granules. Cover and use medium heat until thick and bubbly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cooked Icing
instructions: Measure sugar cold water and unbeaten egg into top of double boiler. Place over rapidly boiling water and commence beating at once. Beat until light and fluffy and holds its shape about 7 or 8 minutes. Remove from fire and continue beating until thick.

title: Round-Ups
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the flour sugar salt baking soda and baking powder. Stir in cream and eggs; mix just until combined. Stir in raisins or dates if desired. On a lightly floured surface knead dough 10 to 12 times. Pat to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cabbage Ramen Slaw
instructions: Brown last 4 ingredients together. Mix cabbage onions chicken noodles and almonds then sprinkle seasoning from noodles and mix. Add oil and vinegar and mix again. The flavors mix together better if its refrigerated overnight.

title: Frozen Corn
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Mix bread crumbs with garlic and olive oil. Spread over cut tomatoes. Sprinkle with Romano or Parmesan cheese. Broil just until barely brown. Remove from heat. These can be done ahead then put back in oven to warm through before serving.

title: Veal Cordon Bleu
instructions: On each piece of veal place a slice each of ham and cheese. Roll up carefully beginning at narrow end. Secure with wooden picks. Mix flour salt pepper and allspice. Coat rolls with mixture. Drop rolls into egg then into bread crumbs. Heat the fat in a 10-inch skillet. Brown the veal rolls about 5 minutes. Add the water. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and simmer about 45 minutes. Remove cover the last 3 to 5 minutes to crisp the veal. Makes 4 servings.

title: Wandering Jesus
instructions: May be rolled or dropped about 1 heaping teaspoonful. Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Carrot Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large pot or Dutch oven stir in onions and cook until soft. Stir in carrots chicken stock tomato paste and rice. Simmer gently uncovered for 30 minutes. Puree in blender. Stir in cream. To serve simmer stir in butter (optional) and season to taste. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Wash chicken and pat dry. Melt shortening in large skillet. Coat chicken with flour. Cook in shortening over medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until light brown. Remove chicken; set aside. Add onion rings green pepper and garlic to skillet; cook and stir over medium heat until onion and pepper are tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Add chicken to sauce. Cover tightly; simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until thickest pieces are fork-tender. Can serve with hot fluffy rice or spaghetti. Makes 4 servings.

title: Homemade Egg Noodles
instructions: Beat the first 3 ingredients with a fork until smooth. Add evaporated milk to equal amount of egg yolk mixture. Add flour until you cant stir then knead. Quit just before it starts flaking.

title: Tangy Frozen Fruit
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Freeze overnight. Thaw slightly before serving. Can use small muffin tins (spray with Pam; pop out and store in freezer. May be used as light dessert or as a frozen salad.

title: Easy Can Soup
instructions: Brown onion and hamburger; drain grease. Put \cans\ in pot; do not drain. Add water. Add browned onion and hamburger. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Chef'S Salad
instructions: Wash all vegetables; drain and cut. Combine all ingredients in large salad bowl. Garnish with hard-cooked egg slices if desired. Serve with desired dressing. Zesty Italian is a favorite.

title: Fresh Apple Bread
instructions: Blend eggs sugar and oil. Add soda and salt to flour. Add chopped apples to sugar and flour mixture and mix well. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Cranberry Orange Cooler
instructions: Combine cranberry juice cocktail orange juice and water in a pitcher. Stir to mix. Chill. Pour into glasses and garnish with orange slices if you wish. Makes 9 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Cocoa-Cola Icing
instructions: Put butter cocoa and cola in a pan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add sugar vanilla and nuts; spread on cake while hot.

title: Amish Barbecue(Pork, Turkey, Chicken)
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour over meat. Cook covered at 375\u00b0 for 1 or 1 1/2 hours until meat is tender.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Add broccoli and onion and stir until broccoli thaws and separates. Add low-fat cottage cheese mayonnaise and mustard. Makes 3 cups or 6 servings with 40 calories per serving.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and shortening. Add eggs then add buttermilk and flour alternately. Also add soda to flour. Bake in 3 bread loaf pans at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut wax paper and put in bottom of pans.

title: Cake For Diabetics
instructions: Put strawberries on top of cake. Mix jello and pour over cake. Refrigerate and let jello set. Serve with prepared low calorie Cool Whip.

title: Raw Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise Hidden Valley and sour cream good and let stand 24 hours. Mix with vegetables.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Fry and drain ground beef. Cook noodles and drain. Saute green pepper and onion. Mix all ingredients together and put in a casserole dish. Top with Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Freezes well!

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Dissolve gelatin Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water. Add cold water pineapple juice and ginger ale. Stir and chill. (Can add orange sherbet to chilled punch.) Makes 30 servings. Add any type Kool-Aid to give any flavor.

title: Broccoli-Onion Deluxe
instructions: Cook broccoli and onions in boiling salt water until tender (about 8 minutes). Drain. Melt butter or oleo blend in flour salt and pepper. Add milk all at once cook and stir until bubbly. Blend in cream cheese. Remove from heat stir in wine. Fold in vegetables. Put into 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven from 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle almonds over top.

title: Cinnamon Twists
instructions: Bring cream to boil; add shortening sugar soda and salt. Mix well; cool. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix yeast with cream mixture. Add flour; knead until smooth. Cover with damp cloth 5 minutes. Roll into rectangle 1/4-inch thick. Spread with butter.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Sprinkle dry pudding mix over ingredients and mix. Add 1 large container of Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries and nuts.

title: White Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: In large saucepan bring butter and water to boil. Remove from heat. Stir in flour sugar eggs sour cream almond extract salt and baking soda until smooth. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 22 minutes or until cake is golden brown. Cool for 2 minutes.

title: Pecan Meltaways
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream the butter sugar and vanilla; mix well. Combine the flour and salt; add to creamed mixture. Stir in pecans. Chill. Roll into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar while warm. Cool and roll in sugar again. Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Fantastic Dessert
instructions: Combine first three ingredients mixing well. Press flour mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes; let cool completely

title: Sock It To Me Coffee Cake
instructions: Beat eggs sour cream oil and water into cake mix. Beat well. Pour half of batter into small tube pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Sprinkle over batter in pan. Add rest of batter. Sprinkle with a little sugar. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put Stove Top stuffing crumbs in a 1 1/2-quart pan. Combine water margarine and seasoning from Stove Top and bring to a boil in a medium saucepan. Pour liquid mixture over crumbs and mix well. Make a hole in the center of the crumb mixture by pressing with a spoon. Fill the hole with chicken. Blend soup and milk then pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Jerry'S Salad
instructions: Mix together. Fold in 1 large bowl Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Mixture may be refrigerated up to one month. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mom'S Brownies
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add eggs chocolate syrup flour and baking powder. Pour in jelly roll pan (or 9 x 13-inch pan). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Yam Apple Casserole
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar and pineapple juice. Then add lemon juice and butter. Mix well. Peel and slice apples. In a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole dish alternate layers of sliced yams apples and pineapple chunks. Pour sauce over. Bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour stirring 2 or 3 times during cooking. Garnish top with sliced pineapple and cherries.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels margarine and sugar. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Italian Spaghetti With Olive Oil
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. In frying pan as spaghetti cooks add garlic to oil. Brown. Drain spaghetti. Pour oil-garlic mixture on top of the spaghetti. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and as much cheese as desired.

title: Endive With Caviar
instructions: Combine first four ingredients; beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Spread in middle of endive leaves and lightly sprinkle with caviar. Makes 8 servings.

title: Apple Crunch Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold juice and cinnamon and chill until thickened. Fold in apple celery and nuts. Spoon into 6-cup mold or bowl. Chill until firm about 4 hours. Makes 5 cups or 10 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie (Lo-Cal)
instructions: Mix Rice Krispies peanut butter and honey for crust and set aside. Mix pudding according to box directions. Place sliced bananas over crust then spread pudding over this alternating until pie pan is full. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Turkey Smoked Sausage Rice Skillet
instructions: Cut sausage into serving size pieces. Set aside. Saute mushrooms carrots and zucchini in margarine in skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes. Add tomatoes with juice water basil thyme and sausage. Reduce heat to low cover and simmer 5 minutes. Mix rice into liquid cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes stirring after 4 minutes. Serves 4. One serving 3 1/2 protein 1 vegetable 1 bread and 1/3 fat.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: Go to Foodland nearest you. Go directly to frozen foods section and find Riches homemade rolls. Follow directions. When your family tells you how great they are simply wipe your forehead and say \Nothing is too good for my family.\

title: Hamburger Surprise
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Cook macaroni separately. After all are done mix in casserole dish. Add grated cheese on top. Bake until cheese melts at 325\u00b0.

title: Santa'S Whiskers
instructions: In bowl cream together butter and sugar. Blend in milk and rum extract. Stir in flour candied cherries and pecans. Form in 2 rolls each 2 x 8-inches long. Roll in coconut. Wrap in wax paper and chill overnight. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes or until edges are golden. Makes 5 dozen.

title: German Cake
instructions: Cream the soft margarine. Add sugar. Mix in egg vanilla and milk. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add to sugar mixture.

title: Baked Spanish Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. In a large skillet over medium heat fry bacon crisp. Drain on paper towels. Crumble and set aside. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons bacon drippings. In hot drippings cook onions and green pepper until tender. In a measuring cup drain tomatoes; add enough water to tomato liquid to make 1 3/4 cups liquid. Cut up tomatoes. To onion mixture add liquid tomatoes tomato sauce sugar and salt; heat to boiling. Remove from heat and stir in rice. Pour into casserole. Cover casserole and bake 35 minutes or until rice is tender. Fluff rice with fork. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes. Garnish with bacon.

title: Baked Carrots
instructions: Scrape carrots; cut into 2-inch pieces. Cook in salted water until tender; drain saving 1/2 cup liquid for sauce. Arrange carrots in buttered casserole. Mix mayonnaise horseradish onion pepper and water; pour over carrots. Dot with butter (3 or 4 tablespoons). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Katie'S Pumpkin Pie Filling
instructions: Mix together. Put in crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Vern'S Light Desserts
instructions: Mix margarine flour and sugar well. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes at 325\u00b0 until light brown. Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar well. Add 1/2 of Cool Whip in the cheese mixture. Cool. Mix the dry puddings together and beat with milk. Pour over cheese mixture. Put the rest of Cool Whip on top of all and sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Finish filling freezer with whole milk. Mix peaches and 1/2 cup sugar in blender until mushy.

title: Garlic Grits
instructions: Cook grits by directions on box. Add butter and cheese while hot. Stir until melted; blend well then add milk and eggs beaten in milk. Add milk and egg mixture to grits. Bake in buttered 6 x 10-inch casserole dish at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill until ready to serve.

title: Hush Puppy Dumplings
instructions: Mix dry ingredients first. Blend egg with buttermilk. Mix all ingredients together. Let set for a few minutes. Will be stiff batter. Roll into balls. Put in hot fat (375\u00b0) and fry until brown.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Bring syrup to a boil. Cook 1 minute. Let stand until cool and pour over cabbage mixture. Freeze. Will stay firm and not turn dark.

title: Spinach Bars
instructions: Drain spinach. In large bowl mix together the eggs flour milk and baking powder until smooth. Stir in spinach onion bacon cheese and mushrooms. Melt butter into a baking dish. Pour mixture into dish. Sprinkle with crushed fried onion rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly and cut into small squares. Makes about 40 bars. Reheats well.

title: Sweet-Sour Carrots
instructions: Arrange carrots in casserole. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer for 15 minutes and strain. Pour over carrots. Cover and chill for 24 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Seafood Gumbo
instructions: In a large pot combine butter and flour. Cook slowly stirring constantly until brown. Add water tomatoes okra corn (cut into thirds if large or half if small cobs). Cook slowly (simmer) for 1 hour. Add crab oysters shrimp fish cayenne bay leaves salt and pepper. Cook 15 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach; squeeze all water out. Mix the rest of the ingredients together all except the bread. Refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve hollow bread out and save inside pieces. Pour spinach dip in hollow. Take inside pieces of bread and break up in chunks and lay around bread loaf to dip in spinach dip. Enjoy!

title: Butterfinger Bars
instructions: Mix together. Put on cookie sheet or cake pan. Melt 1 package chocolate chips. Pour on top. Eat.

title: Keebler Peach Crunch
instructions: Arrange drained peaches in a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Combine rest of ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Topping will be crunchy when done. Good served with ice cream or Cool Whip. Or eat it cold right out of the refrigerator. So good youll want to eat it any way. Fast and easy too!

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Saute corned beef onion and green pepper. Pour into casserole dish. Add 1 or 2 cans soup. Sprinkle cheese on top. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Pour melted butter evenly over casserole. Bake and brown at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Serve with green peas.

title: Roast And Gravy
instructions: This recipe works well when you put the roast in frozen but it can be done with out freezing the roast. Salt and pepper the roast on top and bottom. Place in roasting pan and cover with foil. Place in 375 degree oven and cook for 1hour then turn down to 200 degrees and continue cooking for 3-4 hours. Remove from oven if the roast isnt brown remove foil and return to oven to brown. When the roast is done place on platter. For gravy place pan with drippings on stove top and heat on med-high heat to brown. In a jar shake up water and flour until well blended when drippings are browned well pour in water and flour heat stirring until thick. May need to add more salt and pepper to gravy. Serve roast with hot biscuits and gravy!!!! 4 Note The secret to this recipe is to cook at a low temp. for a long time.

title: Hearty Beef Stew
instructions: Trim all fat from meat. Put all ingredients in slow cooker; mix thoroughly. Cover and cook on low for 12 hours (or on high for 5 to 6 hours).

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Mix together sugar and oil. Blend in egg vanilla and milk. In separate bowl combine flour salt cinnamon and baking soda. Add to moist ingredients. Stir in rhubarb and nuts. Divide batter between 2 well-greased 8 x 4-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until bread tests done with wooden pick. Turn out onto rack to cool. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Orange Sauce(Very Good Over Ham)
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Stir in orange juice and cook until thick and clear stirring constantly. Add orange peel. Makes 1 1/4 cups. Can be made up ahead of time.

title: Company Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add cream cheese sugar salt and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Beat in sour cream. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool and chill.

title: Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in oil add remaining ingredients and simmer on low heat for 1 hour.

title: Oriental Rice
instructions: Fry peppers onion and carrots until onions are transparent. Put in large bowl. Cook rice; add to bowl. Brown chopped meat; add to bowl. Scramble the eggs together and cook; add to bowl. Mix all ingredients together and add soy sauce until everything turns a nice brown.

title: Crab Ball
instructions: Wash celery and separate stalks. Carefully cut off both ends. Fill celery with peanut butter. Add raisin \ants\ to the peanut butter. Serve.

title: Chili Sauce For Hot Dogs
instructions: In large skillet on low heat cook ground beef until browned constantly beating meat to a very fine consistency. Add seasoned salt while cooking. Pour into strainer to drain well. Use 3 tablespoons drippings and return to skillet. Saute onion until clear and tender. Add drained beef. Toss well. Add remaining ingredients. When mixture reaches boil lower heat to simmer for 1 hour. Quick cool by setting pan in ice before storing overnight in refrigerator. Remove solidified fat before reheating. Makes 30 servings.

title: Easy Carmalitas
instructions: Press cookie dough into the bottom a well greased 9 by 13-inch baking dish. Top uniformly with unwrapped caramels. Sprinkle chocolate morsels evenly over caramels. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Beef Fried Rice
instructions: Fry beef cubes. Saute vegetables until soft. Soft scramble eggs and add vanilla. Fry rice in soy sauce and butter or oil. Combine all ingredients salt and pepper to taste and serve. Any kind of meat fish or chicken may be substituted for beef.

title: Buttered Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Add sugar. Beat well. Then add eggs one at a time. Sift flour. Add salt soda and baking powder. Add alternately with buttermilk to the first mixture. Add vanilla then beat well. Pour into well-greased tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 about 1 hour or 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Dry Mix
instructions: Mix well and store in airtight container. Put 1/3 cup of mix in cup; fill with hot water. Add marshmallows if desired.

title: Crab And Corn Bisque
instructions: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the flour and cook stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Add the vegetables and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Add the broth (crab juice and water mixture) 1 teaspoon salt pepper and bay leaves. Stir in the crab milk and Old Bay and bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove from heat and fold in the Worcestershire sauce and remaining salt to taste. Yield 4 servings.

title: Frozen Fruit Cups
instructions: Mix. Pour in muffin pan with paper liners and freeze. When frozen in you may take out of pan and put in plastic bag.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all together; serve on whole wheat toast or buns.

title: Janet'S Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Cut stems from mushrooms and set mushroom caps aside. Saute mushroom stems and onion with sausage until tender. Let cool slightly and add bread or cracker crumbs. Spoon into mushroom caps and place on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until caps are tender about 15 minutes.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Mix eggs sugar flour and butter. Pour in milk and flavoring. Cook in unbaked crust 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Boil in saucepan or microwave the oleo Crisco and water. Pour this over flour sugar and salt. Add buttermilk soda eggs and vanilla to first mixture.

title: Bread Dough Clay For Fun
instructions: Mix well salt and flour. Add hot water. Knead well. Shape into desired figures and bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Great project for little children vacation bible school prints/projects/painted name tags and even for at home.

title: Sausage-Cheese Chips
instructions: Coarsely chop kielbasa and set aside. Arrange chips on greased 12-inch pizza pan. Sprinkle sausage and cheese evenly over each chip top with chilies. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 until cheese melts 3 to 5 minutes. Serves 6; 40 calories each serving.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Cream the butter sugar and extracts. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with preserves and sour cream. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 5 x 9-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Joe Obey'S Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together and knead until firm and elastic. Let raise 10 minutes. Punch down. Let raise until double. Put in bread pan and raise again. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet Potato Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except flour. Add flour. Work in gradually. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Cook at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix mashed sweet potatoes sugar eggs vanilla and margarine (first 5 ingredients). Pour into buttered casserole dish. Mix brown sugar flour and margarine. Spread on top of potatoes. Top with pecans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Johnson Meat Loaf
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Mix meat thoroughly with hands until all signs of egg are gone and tomato sauce is completely mixed in. Shape into loaf. Place in loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 400\u00b0. Halfway through cooking spread catsup on top of meat loaf to brown.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Sift flour and next 4 ingredients. Cut in butter with 2 knives or pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Stir in raisins and seeds. Mix together vinegar and milk. Make a well in flour mixture and add liquid all at once stirring with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn out on a lightly floured board. Knead gently 8 to 10 times. Shape into a ball. Place in greased pie plate. Cut a cross from side to side. Brush top with milk. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then 375\u00b0 for 30 more minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Robert E. Lee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 3 (8-inch) round layer pans. In large mixer bowl mix butter sugar eggs and vanilla until fluffy. Beat for 5 minutes on high speed scraping bowl occasionally. On low speed mix in flour baking powder and salt alternately with milk. Pour into pans. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Strawberrioca
instructions: Thaw and drain strawberries. Add water to juice to make 2 1/2 cups. Mix liquid tapioca sugar and salt. Let stand 5 minutes. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Cool 20 minutes. Stir in berries and fold in 8 ounces Cool Whip.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well. Add beaten eggs. Add flour and mix well. Add nuts. Shape. Refrigerate and slice. Bake at 350.

title: Red Raspberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with hot water. Add applesauce and thoroughly mix. Add raspberries. Refrigerate until set.

title: Double Chocolate Chip Cookie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla beat well. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture. Stir in chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 9 minutes.

title: Sharon'S Lemon Delight
instructions: Combine the margarine flour and pecans. Mix and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let this cool. Combine the Eagle Brand milk and lemonade concentrate. Fold in 1 container Cool Whip and spread over the cooled crust. Refrigerate 30 minutes then spread the can of lemon pie filling on the second layer. Top this layer with more Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Keep refrigerated.

title: Pumpkin Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening; gradually add sugar. Cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well. Sift flour baking powder salt and spices together. Stir in dry ingredients and mix until blended. Add raisins and nuts.

title: Angel Food Roll
instructions: Mix to pea size the flour and oleo. Blend the remaining ingredients and add to flour mix. Form into 6 balls and chill overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: In large bowl stir together first five ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Toss to coat well. Cover and chill. Best if sits overnight before serving. Makes about five cups.

title: Apple-Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes; cool and peel. Butter sides and bottom of 9 x 13 baking dish. Slice sweet potatoes 3/4-inch thick and place on bottom of dish. Peel and slice apples; place layer on potatoes. Pour half the syrup over them; sprinkle with cinnamon. Repeat the potatoes and apples with the apples on top. Pour remainder of syrup over them; sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter. Add 1/4 to 1/2 cup water. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbling. Serve hot or room temperature. If you dont have fresh apples you may substitute apple pie filling and omit the water.

title: Smoked Salmon Rolls
instructions: Blend cream cheese with sour cream. Gently fold in caviar and spread on slices with mixture. Roll up and cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths. Serve chilled. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple-Lemon Punch
instructions: In large pitcher combine juice lemonade and soft drink. Serve over ice cubes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients to soft ball stage around 15 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Put in buttered baking dish and let set.

title: Ranchers Pasta
instructions: Soften tomato halves using package directions; cut in strips. Heat oil in large skillet; add garlic and saute 2 minutes. Add olives tomatoes and oregano. Cook 2 more minutes. Add grated cheese and pasta mix until blended. Serve.

title: Dove Pie
instructions: Brown doves in butter first. Then cook covered with small amount of liquid (water or bouillon) until tender and breast can be easily pulled off the bone. Saute mushrooms and onions in butter until just soft. Combine dove meat with vegetables and olives and add enough brown gravy mix so that the mixture is juicy and moist but not too thin and runny. Spray PAM in a 9x13-inch pyrex dish and spread mixture evenly into dish. Top with crisscrossed strips of pastry sheets which have been rolled out quite thin. Spray with PAM. Bake at 350 degrees until the pastry is puffed and golden brown. Yield 12 to 14 servings.

title: 15-Minute Chicken And Rice Dinner
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add chicken and cook until browned. Remove chicken. Add soup water paprika and pepper. Stir. Heat to a boil. Stir in rice and broccoli. Top with chicken. Season chicken with additional paprika and pepper; cover. Cook on low heat 5 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars butter and shortening; add eggs and the soda dissolved in 1 tablespoon boiling water. Mix well. Add flour and nuts. Dough may seem a little dry. Pack dough in a wax paper lined 8 x 8-inch square pan; cover with wax paper and refrigerate overnight. Cut dough into thirds; cut each third into 1/4-inch (or less) slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 12 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Spray 8 ramekins or other ovenproof dishes with nonstick spray. Set on a baking sheet and set aside. In top of a double boiler or heatproof bowl over simmering water stir together the cream of chicken soup Cheddar cheese soup and mayonnaise. Stir well using a rubber spatula until the Cheddar sauce has a smooth airy consistency about 5 to 8 minutes. Stir the drained potatoes into the sauce. Evenly divide the potato mixture among the prepared ramekins and generously sprinkle the tops with paprika. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes or until they are bubbly and the paprika darkens a little. Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them stand a few minutes before serving.

title: Court Bouillon
instructions: Brown flour in oil. Add onion bell pepper and green onion and saute. Add tomatoes tomato sauce 2 cups water salt and pepper. Heat mixture throughout. Add fish cut into 2-inch squares and stir only once! Stirring will break the fish. Serve over rice.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Add salad dressing and vanilla. Add water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix warm water and yeast together until dissolved. Stir in sugar salt oil and egg. Add flour 1 cup at a time mixing well. Do not knead. Let rise until double in size.

title: Munching Peanut Brittle
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole stir together sugar and syrup. Microwave on High 4 minutes stirring one time half-way through. Stir in peanuts; microwave on High 4 minutes until light brown stirring once. Add butter and vanilla; blend well. Microwave on High 1 minute. Peanuts will be lightly brown and syrup very hot. Add baking soda and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet or unbuttered nonstick coated cookie sheet. Let cool 1/2 to 1 hour. When cool break into small pieces and store in airtight container. Makes about 1 pound.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: Soften gelatine in cold water. To the beaten egg yolks add 1/3 cup sugar lemon juice and salt. Cook in double boiler over hot not boiling water stirring constantly until of custard consistency. Add softened gelatine and stir until dissolved. Add grated lemon rind. Chill until mixture is consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites to which the remaining 1/3 cup sugar has been added. Pour into baked pastry shell or crumb crust. Chill until firm. Serve with whipped cream if desired and chopped walnut meats. Yields one (9-inch) pie.

title: No-Peek Chicken
instructions: Pour all ingredients over chicken breasts in a 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish. Cover with foil. Bake for 3 hours in a 250\u00b0 oven.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mash bananas and add sugar - let stand about 15 minutes. Sift flour add baking powder salt and dissolve soda in about 1 Tbsp. of water. Add shortening to banana and sugar mixture and beat thoroughly. Add dry ingredients soda beaten eggs and nuts. Stir only until mixed.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Trim and shred cabbage. In a bowl add cabbage onion salt and boiling water. Let stand for 1 hour. Drain into colander and press water from vegetables. Put into large serving bowl. Add vinegar and toss. Season with pepper and serve.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Blend sugar and cocoa. Add butter and milk. Boil for 2 minutes. Add peanut butter oatmeal and vanilla. Stir. Drop from a teaspoon onto waxed paper then let cool 45 minutes.

title: Vegetable Appetizer Pie
instructions: Open rolls and spread flat on two cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 until slightly brown on bottom. Remove from oven and sprinkle on grated cheese while crusts are still warm. Combine cream cheese mayonnaise and dressing mix in a bowl; spread evenly over the two baked crusts. Add any combination of chopped vegetables and press down into the filling. Refrigerate overnight for best flavor. Cut into finger-serving sized pieces and serve. Makes 90 small pieces.

title: Hobo Stew
instructions: Brown ground beef in small amount of oil. Cook pepper and onions at same time. Add all other ingredients; simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Appetizer Ribs(Microwave)
instructions: Cut ribs into 1-rib pieces. Place pieces in 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover and cook at Medium-high or cook power 7 (70%) for 15 minutes. Drain fat; turn and rearrange ribs. Combine the remaining ingredients; pour over ribs. Cover; cook covered at Medium-high or cook power 7 (70%) for 10 minutes. Test for thorough doneness; add more cooking time if necessary. Serve hot. Makes 36.

title: Diet Chicken
instructions: Add water to chicken and mix spices together. Add 1/2 spices to top of chicken and cook 30 minutes. Turn and add rest of spices. Cook until done.

title: Cooked Cabbage
instructions: Shred the cabbage into small strips. Put in a frypan with little water. Sprinkle on a little red pepper and a little sugar. Place bacon strips over the cabbage or you may use butter or margarine. Cover and cook 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Mix butter sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Stir flour and salt together; blend into butter mixture. Mix in pecans. Chill dough 30 minutes to 1 hour. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheet (cookies dont spread). Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not brown. While still warm roll in confectioners sugar. Let cool and roll again. Makes 4 dozen. Dont use self-rising flour!
