title: Tastelicious Impossible Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; blend sugar flour and baking powder. Add eggs and mix. Add remaining ingredients and pour into greased pie pan. It makes its own crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Seven Bean Soup
instructions: Add enough water and choice of seasonings. Mix all ingredients in a large crock-pot. Simmer on high for 1 hour. Reduce heat to low and simmer until tender as desired. Serve warm with soup crackers.

title: Baked Eggplant
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch baking dish alternate layers of tomato juice sliced eggplant (which have been sprinkled with salt and pepper) garlic and parsley. Top all with cheese and strips of green pepper. Cover with foil slash the top of foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Burrito Pie
instructions: About 1 hour before serving fry tortillas one at a time in salad oil about 30 seconds on each side until lightly browned and blistered. Drain on paper towels. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In same skillet over high heat fry hamburger and onion until done. Drain then add green chilies refried beans taco sauce and salt. In 9-inch pie pan place 1 tortilla; top with 1/4 of bean mixture and 1/4 cheese. Repeat 3 times. Bake for 30 minutes or until heated through. Top with lettuce tomato and more taco sauce. Sour cream is also good with it.

title: 9 Day Cole Slaw
instructions: Put in saucepan sugar celery seed dry mustard salad oil and vinegar. Heat until sugar is dissolved. Cool and pour over cabbage. Mix.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let stand overnight.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order listed. Blend throughly and shape into loaf and place in greased pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done for 1 hour.

title: Catsup(Diabetic)
instructions: Puree first 4 ingredients. Pour mixture into pan; add vinegar salt and sweetener. Tie spices loosely in cheesecloth and add. Simmer uncovered until reduced by about half. Remove bag of spices.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Cook and stir first 4 ingredients in hot oil over medium-high heat until tender but not browned about 5 minutes. Stir in beans with liquid cooked rice salt and pepper. Reduce heat and stir gently until beans are hot. Makes 5 servings.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13 inch dish sprinkle in rice add chicken onion and salt. Spoon soup over chicken pour water cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour and 25 minutes. You may sprinkle Paprika on top if desired.

title: Chicken Hawaiian
instructions: Skin chicken breasts. Make marinade stirring together pineapple juice garlic soy sauce parsley and chicken stock. Place chicken in a baking dish and cover with marinade. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours. Remove chicken from refrigerator 1 hour before cooking and allow it to come to room temperature. Leave chicken in same pan and place in oven at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until lightly browned or cook on grill until done. Serve with a slice of pineapple. Or cut into 1 inch cubes served on wooden toothpicks alternating chicken with pineapple chunks.

title: Sausage--Potato Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage. Prepare hash browns according to package directions using 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. Stir together sausage hash browns and cheese. Pour in a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Whisk together eggs milk and remaining 1 teaspoon of salt. Pour evenly over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Harvest Loaf
instructions: Mix all in one method. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Reduce heat after 1/2 hour.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Beat with mixer until smooth. Add nuts if desired. Pour onto buttered plate or waxed paper. Refrigerate to set.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix brown sugar shortening margarine vanilla and egg yolk. Stir in flour and salt until dough holds together. Shape into 1-inch balls. Beat egg whites slightly. Dip each ball into egg white; roll in nuts. Place about 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Press thumb deeply in center of each. Bake until light brown about 10 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet; cool. Fill thumbprints with jelly. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Phyllis'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together. Top with crushed potato chips. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and bananas. Stir in dry ingredients and nuts. Place in well-greased and floured loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Marinade For Brisket Roast
instructions: Double all ingredients except barbecue sauce. Mix and pour over roast and let it stay in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 1/2 hours. Open foil and cook 1 hour. Cool and slice thin.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook vanilla pudding. Add milk and raisins; let stand 10 minutes. Add about 1 1/2 cups cooked rice and a small amount of cinnamon. If pudding gets too thick add a little milk.

title: Dill Dip For Raw Vegetables
instructions: Chill for 1 hour.

title: Nacho Shrimp Dip
instructions: Slowly melt cream cheese and salsa stirring continuously. Stir in rest of ingredients. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Zucchini Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Beat eggs sugar vanilla and oil. In another bowl sift together flour salt baking soda powder and cinnamon. Add grated zucchini to egg mixture alternating with flour mixture. Add nuts and raisins. Bake in greased and floured pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sour Cream Clam Dip
instructions: In a medium bowl stir together sour cream chopped onion Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Spoon into shallow serving dish. Swirl cocktail sauce over top. Serve with crackers cocktail bread or chips.

title: Cream Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients blending well. Shape into balls and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until slightly brown. Remove and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix peanut butter and shortening into cake mix. Add eggs and water. Mix well. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hamburger
instructions: Make hamburger into patties. Coat with flour and brown lightly in oil. Add mushroom soup and simmer for about 15 minutes.

title: Swiss Cheese Corn
instructions: Cook corn in boiling water 2 to 3 minutes. Drain well. Combine corn with evaporated milk egg chopped onions salt pepper and shredded cheese.

title: 3 Baked Bean Hot Dish
instructions: Brown the hamburger bacon and onions. Add the ketchup brown sugar mustard and salt. Bake 4 hours in crockpot.

title: Fresh Plum Bubble
instructions: Combine plums and pineapple tidbits in a 10-inch ovenproof baking dish. Mix sugar and cornstarch together and stir into fruit mixture. Dot with butter/oleo and bake in a 400\u00b0 preheated oven and top with biscuits. Brush biscuits with melted butter/oleo and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Continue baking at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes longer. Serve warm. This is a great dish for brunch or can be topped with whipped cream or ice cream for dessert.

title: Shrimp In Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour. Stir in milk. Stir until sauce thickens and boils. Add salt pepper cheese soup and shrimp. Bring to a boil. Place in baking dish. Top with slices of Cheddar cheese and bake 10 minutes until cheese melts at 400\u00b0. (Can be served over noodles etc.)

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
instructions: Place chicken in large greased baking pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place sauerkraut over chicken. Top with Swiss cheese. Pour dressing evenly over cheese. Sprinkle with crushed rye chips; cover with foil. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Surprise Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter with electric mixer. Beat in brown sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Blend in vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients until blended. Arrange English walnut halves on cookie sheets about 2-inches apart. Shape dough into balls using 1 tablespoon of dough for each. Press each ball onto walnut half. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until cookie tests done. Cool to warm.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese softened sharp cheese and pimento cheese. Mix well until blended. Add chopped green peppers onion Worcestershire sauce lemon juice and salt. Mix well. Chill. Shape into a ball and roll in chopped pecans.

title: Alda'S Hot Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Melt cheese into meat. Add picante sauce to mixture. Keep hot in slow cooker and serve with nacho chips.

title: Crab And Shrimp Quiches
instructions: Bake pie shells until light brown. Line the shells with the Swiss. Combine the beaten eggs sour cream and chowder in a bowl; mix well. Stir in shrimp crab meat mushrooms and seasonings. Pour evenly into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits in half.\tDip each piece in melted butter to cover. Roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Layer covered biscuits in Bundt pan that has been buttered. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese And Onion Appetizer
instructions: Mix all together thoroughly and spread on bread slices. Put on greased cookie sheet. Broil for just a few seconds or until lightly brown.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Jelly Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into a large flat pan (greased and floured). Bake in moderate oven until top rises and is brown. Turn out on a towel and spread with jelly; roll immediately.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray muffin tins with Pam. Stir dry ingredients together. Set aside. Combine egg milk and oil mix well. Remove quarter cup of dry ingredients and sprinkle over blueberries. Stir gently. Set aside. Combine liquid and dry ingredients stir until smooth. Add blueberries and stir gently. Fill muffin tins 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus and layer in casserole dish. Place mushrooms on top of asparagus. Spread soup over the two adding seasoning salt and garlic salt (sprinkle small amounts) then slice eggs on top and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Carol Channing'S Hello Dolly Bars
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.\tSprinkle in a layer each of graham cracker crumbs coconut chocolate\tbits and nuts. Pour condensed milk over the nuts. Cook in pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and cut into 16 squares. Delicious!

title: Moo Goo Gai Pan
instructions: Fry chicken for 30 seconds. Boil bok choy 1 minute. Add vegetables and garlic to hot oil. Stir-fry 1 minute. Add chicken. Stir-fry 1 minute. Add sauce and bring to a boil. Serve with rice.

title: Icebox Fruitcake
instructions: Roll crackers into crumbs. Chop cherries and pecans. Melt margarine and marshmallows. Combine marshmallow mixture with crumbs and cherry liquid. Add cherries raisins and nuts. Mix well. Form into long roll on wax paper (will be sticky). Roll in wax paper and then roll in aluminum foil. Refrigerate. Cut into slices as needed. Yield 3 large rolls.

title: Reese'S Cup Candy
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Add graham cracker crumbs peanut butter and confectioners sugar mixing well. Pat down firmly in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan (a slightly later pan may be used). Melt the Hershey candy bar and smooth on top. Let cool before cutting.

title: Christmas Fruit Tea
instructions: Pour first 5 ingredients into (30-cup) electric percolator. Place nutmeg cinnamon and ginger in percolator basket. Perk complete cycle; let stand 1 hour. Serve hot. Yields 1 gallon.

title: Mary'S Potato Salad
instructions: Peel cube and cook potatoes until real tender. While cooking put on eggs to boil. Dice vegetables. Drain water off cooked ingredients. Add onions pickles and 5 eggs to potatoes. Then stir in mustard mayonnaise salt and pepper. Slice 6th egg in slices and place on top of salad.

title: Cocktail Dogs
instructions: Cut hot dogs in little pieces. Mix jelly and mustard together; pour over hot dogs in crock-pot and let simmer at least 2 hours. Better if left in crock-pot all day!

title: Deviled Ham Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Blend together cream cheese egg yolk onion baking powder salt and horseradish. Toast bread on one side. Spread onto toasted sides with deviled ham and cover each with a mound of the cheese mixture. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until puffed and brown. Serve hot. These can be prepared ahead and frozen. Thaw and bake. Melba toast may be substituted for the bread.

title: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Mix cake mix yeast salt and warm water. Add 3 cups flour. Use the remaining flour to knead dough. Knead 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Orangey Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix all ingredients except beets in microwave dish covered. Microwave 3 1/2 minutes. Stir until smooth and thickened. Add drained beets and microwave 1 1/2 minutes. Stir and serve hot.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients in order given.

title: Disgustingly Rich Brownies
instructions: Grease the inside of an 8 or 9-inch baking pan. Melt the butter over low heat. In the mixing bowl stir the cocoa and sugar together then stir in the melted butter. Add the eggs and vanilla and stir again. Now add the flour and salt; mix just until smooth not too much. (If adding chocolate chips now is the time.)

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Pour over broccoli. Add cheese; let set overnight in refrigerator. Add bacon. May add salt and pepper before serving. Garnish with red onion slices (optional). Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Green Beans
instructions: Leave 1 tablespoon bacon fat in pan. Add onion; brown lightly. Combine cornstarch salt and mustard in cup. Drain beans and reserve 1/2 cup liquid. Stir bean liquid and vinegar into dry ingredients and add to pot. Stir until it boils. Add beans and bacon; heat thoroughly. Garnish with egg slices or finely chopped egg.

title: Mother'S Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add 1 egg at a time beating after each. Mix flour baking powder and salt together. Add alternately with milk. Continue beating at medium speed scraping sides of bowl with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon. Add vanilla. Bake in 11 x 7-inch pans (3) for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cake cool. Frost with Mothers Coconut Cake Frosting (recipe follows).

title: Deviled Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except radishes or cucumbers in kettle in which macaroni was cooked. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until heat through. Stir in radishes or cucumbers. Serve hot. Ingredients can be combined and served cold also. Yields 6 servings.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Prick potatoes with a fork and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool slightly and cut potatoes in half. Scoop out potatoes leaving a thin shell. Put pulp in a small mixer bowl and add cheese and seasonings. Beat until smooth. Add milk and beat until fluffy. Pipe or spoon mixture into shells. Sprinkle with paprika and place on cookie sheet. Cover loosely with foil. Bake for 10 minutes then uncover and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Boiled Icing
instructions: Let sugar water and vinegar cook to soft ball. Pour 1/2 of syrup slowly over stiffly beaten egg whites. Continue beating. Return remaining half of syrup to stove. Cook until hard ball stage. Pour slowly over other mixture beating continuously until proper thickness to spread.

title: Quick Chicken Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine vegetables soup and chicken. Transfer to an ungreased 9-inch pie plate. In another bowl combine egg milk and biscuit mix just until moistened. Pour over chicken mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine the Karo and sugar; boil to 300\u00b0 or until brittle when a little is dropped in cold water. Add the soda and vanilla to the candy and spread thickly on oiled pans containing a layer of roasted peanuts.

title: Lemon Curd
instructions: Place sugar egg yolks and lemon juice in a medium saucepan over low heat. Whisk to combine then switch to a wooden spoon. Cook slowly stirring constantly until mixture thickens and coats back of spoon. Cook a few minutes more but do not allow to boil. Remove from heat stir in butter and zest and let cool. Cover with plastic wrap and chill until ready to use. Makes about 3 cups. This is a tangy topping for gingerbread scones and crumpets.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Slice cookie dough into their slices. Arrange slices in greased pie pan or oblong glass casserole dish. Make sure slices come up the sides. Bake according to cookie dough directions. Let cool then fill with cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla mixture. Top with fruit arranging it beautifully.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion. Add all remaining ingredients except noodles. Simmer 5 minutes. Mix in noodles. Pour in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: In a medium size bowl mix vanilla pudding and juice from oranges and pineapple. Mix until smooth. Add oranges and pineapple. Chill. Add slices of bananas and marshmallows before serving.

title: Holiday Dessert
instructions: Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Cauliflower Medley
instructions: Wash cauliflower. Break into flowerets. Cook covered in small amount of boiling salted water about 10 minutes. Cook Brussels sprouts and onions according to directions. Combine all vegetables in lightly greased 9 x 13 dish.

title: Potatoes, Shredded, Smothered, Covered And Trashed
instructions: Take 1 cup of shredded potatoes or hash browns. Cook to a light brown along with the onions. After they are light brown take one slice of cheese and slightly melt it in the potatoes and onion. Then take some leftover chilli pour it over the potatoes onion and melted cheese. Throw in the tomatoes and eat.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients. Pour into casserole. Sprinkle cheese on top. Crush crackers and sprinkle over cheese. Melt margarine. Spread over crackers. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Line a cookie sheet with foil and spray lightly with Pam. Place crackers salty side up on cookie sheet. In a saucepan boil butter and brown sugar for 2 to 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Then add the almond extract. Pour mixture over crackers and bake for 6 minutes. Take out of oven and top with broken pieces of chocolate. Spread evenly as chocolate begins to melt. Cool completely in refrigerator then break apart.

title: Spicy Walnut-Raisin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare pastry. Beat eggs sugar salt cinnamon nutmeg cloves corn syrup and margarine with hand beater until blended. Stir in walnuts and raisins. Pour into pastry-lined pie plate. Bake until set 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Blanche'S Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugar. Stir in and beat the egg milk and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Chill for 1 hour or longer. Drop by spoon 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Chocolate
instructions: Place chocolate chips coffee and water in a 4-cup measuring bowl. Heat for 3 minutes in a microwave. Remove from oven and stir in remaining ingredients. Heat for 4 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Nutty Fingers
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour vanilla and nuts. Roll into fingers. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 8 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar margarine sour milk and eggs together. Add soda baking powder vanilla and enough flour to roll. Cut with cookie cutters or glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Barbecue Steak
instructions: Cut round steak into 6 pieces. Brown slowly. Blend vinegar Worcestershire sauce catsup water salt and pepper. Pour over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mrs. Upson'S Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except blueberries. Stir in blueberries. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Yield 1 dozen blueberry muffins.

title: American Goulash
instructions: Cook macaroni in salt water until tender and drain. Brown meat and onion in fat. Add macaroni meat and all remaining ingredients in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with crushed corn flakes or bread crumbs. Bake until nice and brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot and cook until chicken and rice are done.

title: Pink Lima Beans
instructions: Wash and soak lima beans for 30 minutes. Cook 1 1/2 hours. Wash meat\tand cook in separate pot until tender.\tAdd meat green pepper tomato sauce black pepper and salt to lima beans. Season to your taste. Cook 1/2 hour longer.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop artichoke up fine and combine with other ingredients. Bake in a greased pie plate for 20 minutes at 350 degrees. Serve hot with crackers or chips.

title: Jello-Sicles(Child-Approved; No Drip)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well until Jell-O and sugar are dissolved. Add 2 cups cold water. Stir and pour into popsicle forms or small paper cups with popsicle sticks in them. Freeze.

title: Pecan Delights
instructions: Spray miniature muffin pans with Pam. Mix all ingredients well and drop by spoon into muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown. Makes approximately 2 dozen.

title: Vegetable Pizza Squares
instructions: Press rolls together in a jelly roll pan to make crust. Bake until brown. Mix the cream cheese mayonnaise and dressing together and spread over cooled crust forming filling. Sprinkle the raw vegetables over filling and top with the shredded cheese. Cut into squares.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt butter; stir in remaining ingredients. Microwave 2 minute or until melted; pour into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill cut into squares.

title: Eggplant Caponata
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet on medium-high. Add celery and onions and cook for approximately 5 minutes until onions are limp. Add eggplant cubes and saute just until tender. Add tomatoes wine vinegar a little sugar salt and pepper. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; stir in capers and olives. Cover and chill until serving time. Serves 6.

title: Hamburger Pizza
instructions: Mix Bisquick and water and pat into 11 x 17-inch jelly roll pan; add pizza sauce ground beef and grated cheese. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Last 5 minutes add slices of American cheese.

title: Mushroom Chicken
instructions: Place fried chicken in deep pot on low flame or low setting. Pour both cans of soup over chicken and let it simmer; this makes gravy over the chicken and makes a delicious meal served with rice and a nice salad.

title: Grandma'S Herbed Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except lemon pepper together. Form into a ball and cover with lemon pepper. Wrap cheese ball in wax paper and refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Hamburger A La Roni
instructions: Brown hamburger meat until done. Drain grease off hamburger. Then add tomatoes. Stir well. Then add cooked elbow macaroni. Serves for 6 people.

title: Teriyaki Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Blend together until smooth. Makes approximately 1 quart.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and equally divide into two loaf pans. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Toast
instructions: Put bread in toaster until golden brown. Spread peanut butter on bread all over. Sprinkle sugar all over peanut butter. If you want put butter after it is golden brown.

title: False-Kick Punch
instructions: Combine juice sugar and extract. Stir until sugar dissolves. Chill. To serve pour ginger ale in juice. Serve over ice.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients and set aside. Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk (begin and end with dry ingredients). Add vanilla bananas and nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Eggplant Patties
instructions: Place cubed eggplant in saucepan with enough water to cover. Heat until water comes to a boil then cook 3 to 5 minutes. Place eggplant in a bowl and add cheese bread crumbs parsley garlic salt pepper and eggs. Blend well. In a skillet add the oil and heat. Drop eggplant mixture by spoonful in pan to size of hamburg. Fry on both sides and add more oil as needed.

title: Out-Of-The-Garden Pizza
instructions: Allow cream cheese to set at room temperature 30 minutes or until soft. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate rolls into 8 triangles; place on greased 12-inch pizza pan with elongated triangle points toward center. Press dough together to form crust. Brush with beaten egg. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until brown. Cool.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and mix with stuffing. Put 1/2 in baking dish and small pieces of chicken in a layer over stuffing. Pour 1 can broth over chicken. Mix sour cream with undiluted cream of chicken soup and spread over chicken. Add remaining stuffing and pour second can of broth over this. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Funfetti Party Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. In a large bowl combine cake mix margarine and eggs. Stir by hand until thoroughly moistened. Stir in nuts and candy bits from cake mix. Spread in greased pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 13 to 17 minutes or until light golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool completely. Frost cooled bars with frosting. Sprinkle with candy bits from frosting. Cut into bars. Makes 48 bars.

title: Crock-Pot Roast And Vegetables
instructions: Place roast potatoes carrots and onions in a crock-pot. Mix water salt pepper and flour together to form a gravy and pour over first four ingredients. Cook on low for 6 to 12 hours and on high for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Cora'S Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions. Grease pan. Layer in pan the nuts coconut and chocolate chips. Pour cake mix on top of ingredients.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine oil eggs sugar zucchini and vanilla in a large bowl. Stir in flour and cinnamon. Blend well (do not beat). Stir in nuts. Spoon batter in a well-greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Drain clams; reserve liquid. Fry salt pork until crisp in a large saucepan; remove. Add water potatoes onions and reserved clam liquid to fat in saucepan. Cook covered until potatoes are tender about 10 to 15 minutes. Add milk cream clams and salt pork. Heat slowly just to a boil. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Float butter atop each serving.

title: Mother'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients as listed. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Princell Ann Stuffing
instructions: Trim bread; let dry out completely. Soak bread in water; press out water thoroughly. Chill overnight in cloth bag with heavy weight on top to press out any remaining excess water. Put pork through food chopper using medium blade; cook over low heat until pink color shows. Put turkey liver through chopper; cook with pork until lightly browned. In a separate small skillet cook the celery and onion in butter or oleo until onion is transparent. Crumble bread in large mixing bowl; add pork and liver together with drippings. Add celery onion and eggs. Mix well. Season with salt pepper and monosodium glutamate. Will make enough stuffing for 12 pounds dressed turkey.

title: Baked Artichoke Spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Drain and chop artichokes. In a medium bowl combine all ingredients. Place in a decorative ovenproof shallow dish and bake about 15 minutes until bubbly. Serve with crackers or bread rounds toasted.

title: Lemon Tea Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake for one hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Add melted butter to cake mix and 2 eggs. Mix well. Spread in bottom of a large pan. Blend 2 eggs and cream cheese together. Add the powdered sugar. Spread on top of cake mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Beat cream cheese and butter at high speed until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar beating at low speed until smooth. Stir in vanilla and pecans. Yields 3 1/2 cups. Makes enough for 3 (9-inch) cake layers. Preparation time 5 minutes.

title: Dijon-Roasted New Potatoes(Lighter Eating - 3 Points)
instructions: Coat a 9 X 13 baking dish with cooking spray. Heat over to 425\u00b0. Whisk together oil mustard paprika thyme salt and pepper in a large bowl. Add potatoes and stir until they are coated. Transfer potatoes to the baking dish and roast 15 minutes. Stir and roast another 15 minutes.

title: Mulled Cider
instructions: Add all of the cider orange juice cinnamon sticks and cloves together in a large pot and simmer for 15 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Alfredo Sauce(Very Low-Fat)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the container of an electric blender; process until smooth. Heat thoroughly over very low heat; dont cook just heat. Combine this with various vegetables for a low-fat meal. Serve with the pasta of your choice.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapples reserving 3 Tbsp. of its juice. Combine sugar and flour. Stir in reserved pineapple juice. Add pineapple and cheese. Mix well. Spoon mixture into greased casserole dish. Combine melted margarine and cracker crumbs stirring well. Sprinkle crumbs over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned. You may double this recipe.

title: Walnut Roast
instructions: Saute chopped vegetables with sage salt and soy sauce in 1/4 cup water. Blend flour and sunflower seeds with 2 cups water. Add to sauteed vegetables and simmer a few minutes. Place in bowl bread crumbs walnuts and brown rice. Add sauteed vegetables and sunflower mixture. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until well browned. Serve with Chicken-like or Cashew Gravy. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Mix together until cheese is soft to work with. Wash and take stems out of mushrooms. Chop 4 or 5 of the stems real small and add to cheese. Spoon cream cheese into center of mushrooms and serve.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add cold water and the rest of the ingredients. Chill until firm.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into bite size pieces. This will take about 2 months. Reserve trunk as you will need something to store the pieces in. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Cook over kerosene fire for about 4 weeks at 465\u00b0. This will serve 3800 people. If more are expected add the 2 rabbits but do this only if necessary as most people do not like hare in their stew.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Fry out 1 pound hamburger meat; drain off all grease and add one large onion. Mix everything together in crock-pot and cook six to 8 hours.

title: Tomato Herb Sauce With Crabmeat And Scallops
instructions: Over medium heat heat oil. Add onion; cook until soft for 2 minutes. Add garlic; cook abut 1 minute. Add chicken broth and seasonings. Heat to boiling; cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes with juice; return to boiling. Cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add crabmeat and scallops. Cover and cook until scallops are tender. Serve over pasta.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Clean and slice strawberries; add glaze (set aside). Spread cookie dough on pizza pan. Bake until golden brown. Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Spread over cooled cookie dough cream cheese mixture then strawberries and glaze. Refrigerate for about 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole dish. Put rice (uncooked) in casserole. Sprinkle dry onion soup on top. Add 2 cups water and stir. Place chicken on top. Mix mushroom soup with 1/2 cup water. Pour over breasts or strips. Season with salt and pepper. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Drop by spoon into hot oil and deep fry until brown. (Makes 12 to 15.)

title: Frozen Cole Slaw
instructions: Add salt to cabbage. Let stand one hour; squeeze out extra juice. Boil last 7 ingredients 1 minute; let cool to lukewarm then pour over squeezed cabbage. Pour into containers and freeze.

title: Pan Burritos
instructions: In a saucepan combine the first 6 ingredients; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. In a skillet brown the beef. Drain; stir in 1/3 of the sauce. Spread another third on the bottom of a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Place 3 tortillas over sauce tearing to fit bottom of pan. Spoon half of meat mixture over tortillas; sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups cheese. Add 3 more tortillas. Spread refried beans over tortillas; top with remaining meat. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups cheese. Layer remaining tortillas; top with the remaining sauce. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Serve with taco sauce sour cream chili peppers chopped onion and/or guacamole if desired. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Vienna Bread
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together; let set 10 minutes. Add 3 cups flour. Beat smooth and bubbly. Let stand 20 minutes. Add oil salt and 9 cups flour. Knead until smooth. Let rise until double about 1 hour. Punch down and cut into 5 pieces. Let rest 10 minutes. Form into loaves and place on floured pan. Let rise until double. Just before putting in the oven slash 4 or 5 times or 1 slash longways. When done brush with butter and cool uncovered. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rio Grande Beans
instructions: Mix thoroughly beef bread crumbs egg salt pepper and 1 teaspoon chili powder. Shape firmly into 16 meatballs. In 8-inch skillet brown meatballs pour off fat. Add onion and remaining chili powder. Cover; cook over low heat 20 minutes or until done. Add beans. Heat; stir occasionally. Garnish with cheese. Makes 3 cups.

title: Old-Time Jam Cake
instructions: If self-rising flour is used omit soda and baking powder and use sweet milk. This makes a 3 or 4 layer cake.

title: Pumpkin Cake Bars
instructions: Mix eggs pumpkin sugar and spices together; pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top. Drizzle melted butter over mix; sprinkle nuts over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cover with foil loosely the first half of baking time (to keep from browning too soon). Cut into squares and serve with cream.

title: Crock-Pot Venison
instructions: Place all ingredients except carrots and rice in crock-pot. Cook on high setting for 3 to 4 hours. Add carrots and rice; simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 additional hours. Place on low until ready to eat. Delicious with corn bread.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems and inside of mushrooms. Mix all the other ingredients in a bowl. Stuff mushroom caps and place in a casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Ham Delights
instructions: Mix together all ingredients (not the rolls). Cut rolls in half; spread with mixture. Wrap each roll with aluminum foil. Bake for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pecan Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add baking powder and sugar and beat into egg whites. Fold in crushed vanilla wafers and chopped nuts.

title: Shrimp And Fettucine
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and garlic and cook slowly until onion is soft. Add parsley thyme and cayenne. Add raw shrimp and cook about 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake in 12-inch Dutch oven for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Breakfast
instructions: Scramble eggs and set aside. Cook bacon crumble and set aside. On medium-high heat melt 1 tablespoon of butter. Place 1 tortilla shell in pan for 30 seconds. Turn shell quickly. Put 1/4 of scrambled eggs 1/4 of crumbled bacon and 1/2 slice of cheese on half of the tortilla shell. Fold other half of shell over fillings. Remove from heat. Makes 4.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Finely chop cabbage; add salt and sugar. Stir somewhat; add onion and stir again. Add milk and salad dressing and stir well. Let the flavors blend awhile for better flavor.

title: Citrus Cooler(Especially Refreshing On A Hot Summer Afternoon)
instructions: In blender container combine half of the cold water half of the orange-grapefruit or orange-pineapple juice concentrate and half of the lemon sherbet. Cover and blend 15 seconds. Pour into 3 tall glasses. Repeat with remaining water concentrate and lemon sherbet. Carefully fill glasses with chilled ginger ale. Stir gently. Makes 6 servings.

title: Baked Peaches
instructions: Combine the honey sugar butter lemon juice and cinnamon. Set aside. Peel and pit peaches. Place peach halves in baking dish. Fill cavity with honey mixture. Pour water around peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes. Pour over angel food cake or ice cream. (This also goes really well with meats such as chicken or roast pork.)

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Into a large bowl sift the flour with baking soda and salt. Add sugar egg vanilla and butter. With wooden spoon or electric mixer at medium speed beat until smooth and well combined (about 1 minute). Stir in walnuts and chocolate pieces. Drop by the teaspoonful 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Remove to wire rack. Cool. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Snowball Cookies(Makes 3 Dozen)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl combine all ingredients except powdered sugar. Beat at low speed scraping bowl often until well mixed. Shape rounded teaspoonful dough into 1-inch balls. Place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 18 to 25 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm and when cool.

title: Tortilla Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Soften cream cheese 4 to 5 hours. Combine all ingredients except mayonnaise; mix well then add mayonnaise for a smooth consistency. Layer with flour tortillas. Wrap in plastic wrap and leave overnight in refrigerator. Cut with a sharp knife into 1/4-inch slices and serve.

title: Collards 'N Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops and season to taste. Put pork chops into Dutch oven or large pot with a lid. Add the chopped collard leaves and the remainder of the vegetables along with a small amount of water. Cover tightly and steam for 30 minutes checking liquid level frequently. Pour cream of mushroom soup over all the ingredients in the pot. Put the lid back on the pot and simmer until all the vegetables are tender. Its very good.

title: Cheesecake Dreams
instructions: Grease an 8-inch square pan. In small bowl mix first 3 ingredients. Stir in melted butter and combine well. Reserve 1/3 cup crumbs. Pat remaining gently into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix 1 stick margarine and the crumbs. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat eggs 2 sticks margarine and powdered sugar together for 15 minutes. Spread mixture over unbaked crumb mixture. Add sliced bananas and pineapple then a layer of whipped topping. Sprinkle cherries and nuts over topping. Put in refrigerator overnight.

title: Devil Nuts
instructions: Put nuts on a shallow baking dish in a 300\u00b0 oven. Pour other ingredients over nuts stirring occasionally. Drain on paper towels.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix beans with taco seasoning then layer beans and then sour cream. Add cheese on top. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 12-inch dish.

title: Jean'S Thing
instructions: Melt sugar and Karo until dissolved. Stir in peanut butter. Remove from heat. Add corn flakes. Mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Sets up real quickly. Ready to eat.

title: Pinwheel Cookies(Yields About 7 Dozen)
instructions: Mix sugar butter eggs and extract. Stir in remaining ingredients. After dough is mixed divide into halves. Stir 1/2 teaspoon green or red food coloring into one-half. Cover both halves and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together cold and store in covered container in refrigerator. These keep for months and are truly delicious!

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and oil together. Add 1 egg at a time with carrots then pineapple and nuts. Gradually add dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese with lime Jell-O. Bring water to boil and pour over Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and chill.

title: Egg Ribbon Soup
instructions: Bring the broth to a boil in a medium size saucepan over medium heat. Meanwhile lightly beat the eggs in a mixing bowl; rinse stem and chop the fresh greens or drain the frozen spinach well. Add the greens to the broth and bring the liquid back to a simmer. Whisking constantly pour the beaten eggs into the soup. The eggs will curdle into ribbon shaped strands. Season to taste with salt and pepper and remove the pan from the heat. Ladle the hot soup into bowls and sprinkle Parmesan over each portion.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Mix cream cheese chives and onion flakes. Take one piece of ham 1 piece of cheese and spread with cream cheese mixture. Roll up pinwheel style and secure with 5 toothpicks. Repeat procedure with rest of the ingredients. Chill for one hour. Slice each roll into 5 pieces. Yields 50 rolls.

title: Giant Chalk Sticks
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix well. Pour into small waxed paper cups. Remove cup when mixture has hardened.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger meat seasoning to taste. Add soups and enchilada sauce. Add together with meat and seasoning. Put bag of chips in baking dish. Pour mixture over chips. Sprinkle cheese over. Bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Date Roll
instructions: Cook in heavy boiler for 20 minutes. Add dates and butter. Cook until you can pull it from the sides of the boiler with the spoon. Remove from fire; add pecans and vanilla. Beat until it creams then pour it on a damp cloth and shape it in a roll.

title: Ham Pie
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in oil until tender. Add cream of chicken soup and water. Mix in ham. Simmer until blended. Put biscuits on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until biscuits brown.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add taco seasoning mix according to package directions. Add can of drained chili hot beans. Cook for 15 minutes on low. On plate layer tortilla chips lettuce bean and beef mixture cheese sour cream salsa onion and olives. Enjoy! Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Creamy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Combine water and all vegetables. Cook until well done. Add cheese and canned chicken soup. Simmer until well blended.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Save some beef to roll the cheese ball in. Shape into a ball and chill.

title: Chicken Spread
instructions: To softened cream cheese add all ingredients. Form into any desired shape. Cover with nuts.

title: Best Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Simmer raisins in 1 cup water until plump (15 minutes). Drain raisins reserving the liquid and add enough water to make 1/2 cup. Mix shortening eggs sugar and vanilla. Blend in the 1/2 cup raisin liquid. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet by rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 6 1/2 dozen.

title: Mike'S Favorite Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients together and shape into a ball. Roll ball in nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Quick And Easy Pound Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar and continue beating. Add flour. Heat milk and oleo together. Add to mixture and mix well. Add vanilla or lemon and baking powder. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Check to see if it needs to cook a few minutes longer.

title: Doritos Chicken
instructions: Crush Doritos and just cover bottom of 2-quart baking dish. Mix all other ingredients except cheese and place on Doritos. Crush more Doritos on top of this. Add cheese on top. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Aunt Verda'S Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Dredge fruit in flour. Add salt coconut and nuts. Add milk and mix thoroughly. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated 275\u00b0 oven. Store cooled cookies in an airtight container about 5 days before serving then enjoy! Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Shrimp And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute shrimp for 6 to 8 minutes in butter. Mix the sauces. Follow instructions on the package for the Hollandaise sauce and mushroom sauce for the quantity of liquid but use half and half instead of milk. Layer broccoli in baking dish (flat). Cover with shrimp. Pour sauce over. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Can sprinkle Italian bread crumbs 5 minutes before done.

title: Easy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In ungreased 2-quart casserole place chopped broccoli and water chestnuts. Cover with cream of chicken soup. Mix bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and butter; sprinkle on top of soup. Bake uncovered for one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Brandied Caramel Flan
instructions: Melt in heavy skillet to form light syrup. Coat 10-inch pie dish (deep) on bottom and partially up sides.

title: David'S Favorite Goulash
instructions: Cook noodles; set aside. In large saucepan combine all ingredients except noodles and simmer 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Combine noodles with rest of ingredients. Pour into casserole dish and cover. Cook in oven for 30 minutes or so until desired thickness of juices. Serve with bread and butter and tossed salad.

title: Chili Dog Sauce
instructions: Cook and drain ground beef with onion. Mix spices and water and add to ground beef. Add water to keep thin. Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Barbecue Shrimp
instructions: Combine all except shrimp. Heat and pour over washed shrimp. Cover and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Serve with French bread.

title: Low Country Boil
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil with lemons. Drop in boiling water the potatoes and cook 10 minutes. Add the corn and polish sausage and boil 10 minutes more. Last add the shrimp and boil about 2 minutes or until the shrimp turns pink.

title: Meatball Hoagies
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot for 1 1/2 hours on low heat. Serve on hoagie buns or your choice. For a large crowd.

title: Shrimp Crab Casserole
instructions: Dice green pepper onion and celery. Saute in 2 tablespoons butter until soft. Add 1 pound crab meat and 1 pound shrimp. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Drain spinach in colander to remove excess water. In mixing bowl combine all ingredients.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Brown the ground beef with the onion and pepper and drain off fat. Mix the beans with the BBQ sauce add beef and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Date And Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Mix together dates water and baking soda and set aside to cool. Cream together butter and sugar in a separate bowl. Add 2 well beaten eggs to creamed mixture and mix well. Add cooled date mixture. Then add sifted flour salt baking soda and baking powder. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan greased and floured. Sprinkle top with chocolate chips nuts and sugar. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pauline'S Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown beef in skillet with onion chili powder Worcestershire sauce and salt. Spread in baking dish. Cover with diced potatoes green peas and corn. Mix juice from corn and peas with 1 small can of tomato paste. Mix the cornmeal with the egg and buttermilk. Spoon over mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes (until corn bread is brown).

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Rinse blueberries from mix with cold water and drain. Arrange peach slices in ungreased 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle blueberries over peaches combine water and brown sugar in liquid measuring cup. Pour over fruit. Combine muffin mix pecans and melted butter in large bowl. Stir until blended (mixture will be crumbly). Sprinkle crumb mixture over fruit. Sprinkle contents of topping packet from mix over crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: George Strait'S King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together the first 4 ingredients and set aside. In a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole layer the ingredients in the following order chicken tortillas onions soup mixture and top with cheese. Bake for 1 hour or until mixture is bubbly.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Coat the bottom and sides of a large roasting pan with a nonstick vegetable spray. Place popped corn in pan.

title: Macaroni-Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add macaroni soup and milk. Stir in banana pepper and olives. Salt and pepper to taste. Cut or shred cheese into mixture. Bake in 1 or 2 casserole dishes. Top with squares of Velveeta. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: White Bean Soup
instructions: Heat oil in a large heavy saucepan. Saute onion and garlic until onion is tender. Add chicken broth beans salt Italian seasoning basil and pepper. Bring to a boil; simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Puree in blender until smooth; return to saucepan. Slowly stir in evaporated milk; heat through. Top with fresh basil. Yield About 4 cups.

title: Blueberry Dessert
instructions: Mix together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Chop raisins figs and almonds. Sift together flour salt and sugar. Cream in butter. Beat in water and eggs. Add raisins figs and almonds. Stir in honey and spices. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients; shake well. Store in refrigerator.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Drain spinach and squeeze. Mix all ingredients.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients except egg then add egg and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage 'N' Potatoes
instructions: Mix together Cheez Whiz and sour cream. Add onion parsley flakes and salt. Slice smoked sausage in half then cut in small pieces. Mix together potatoes sausage and cheese mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake Bonbons
instructions: In saucepan combine\tjuice molasses and raisins and simmer 5 minutes.\tRemove from heat and add fruit peel. Cream butter sugar and\tegg one at a time.\tStir together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Add orange mixture and nuts and mix well.

title: No-Knead Bread
instructions: Dissolve dry yeast in warm water; add remaining ingredients one by one. Mix by hand until moist. Seal in Tupperware fix-n-mix bowl until seal pops off. Divide into 4 loaves. Cover with towel and let rise 1/2 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Zesty Potato Salad
instructions: Combine potatoes celery bacon Parmesan cheese onion and salt; mix lightly. Gradually add dressing to softened cream cheese mixing until well blended. Pour over potato mixture; mix lightly. Spoon gently into serving bowl; chill several hours.

title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a saucepan; add sugar and milk. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter vanilla and oatmeal. Drop by spoonfuls on aluminum foil. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Beef And Noodle Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Place butter in a shallow dish. Microwave at High for 4 to 5 seconds until butter melts. In another shallow dish mix cornflake crumbs Parmesan cheese chives and parsley. Dip chicken in butter then crumbs to coat. Arrange chicken pieces bone side down in shallow pan. Microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes. Turn over. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes longer until juices run clear. Let stand for 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder sugar salt and baking soda; set aside. Mix egg orange juice melted shortening and hot water in a bowl. Add flour mixture. Fold in cranberries and nuts. Mix until it holds together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean after being inserted.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and oleo together. Add flour and mix well. Form into 24 small balls and press into bottom and sides of small ungreased muffin tins. Put a few broken nuts into bottom of tarts and add filling.

title: Pecos Pasta
instructions: Prepare elbow macaroni according to package directions. Drain. In a large skillet melt butter; add green pepper and onion. Cook until tender (do not brown). Add Hormel chili corn seasoned salt and pepper. Simmer on low heat 5 minutes. Stir in cooked macaroni; top with shredded cheese. Cover and heat on low 5 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chip Dip
instructions: Put cream cheese in a bowl and start with 1/4 cup of milk. Mix and keep adding milk until the mixture is fairly smooth and the thickness is to your liking. I like mine fairly thick so that it stays on the chip. Then stir in onions. You can add as many or as little onion as you want it is what you like best. Add salt and pepper to taste if desired.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: The egg custard recipe was told to me by a Great Aunt before she died. This is not a standard recipe and may take some \trial and error\ to perfect this one. The instructions are written as she told them to me. She used this basic recipe for chocolate coconut and other flavors as well. But my family enjoys it just as a vanilla cream egg custard.

title: Rhubarb Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add egg alternately and sift dry ingredients with buttermilk and vanilla. Stir in fruit. Pour into 9 x 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle on top 1 cup white sugar; mix with 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake for 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix until smooth. Add additional milk to thin if necessary. Batter should resemble pancake batter. Working in batches dip tomato slices into batter allowing excess batter to drop back into bowl. Fry in 2 inches of hot oil (375\u00b0) in a large heavy skillet until browned turning once carefully with tongs. Transfer to colander to drain.

title: Ham Dip
instructions: Mix or grind the ham. Mix ham with mayonnaise chili sauce mustard and sugar. Serve with crackers or potato chips.

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
instructions: Pick crabmeat place in large bowl. Add parsley and crumbs. Beat together egg mayonnaise mustard salt pepper and baking powder. Pour this mixture over the crabmeat parsley & crumbs. Mix well. Shape into balls - flatten. Fry until brown.

title: Harry'S Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine margarine butter cream cheese and sugar; beat well until fluffy. Add dash of salt and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and mix well. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10 inch tube pan. Place pan in a cold oven and set at 275\u00b0. Bake for 1 1/2 hours until done. Cool in pan.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: In a large mixing bowl melt marshmallows and butter in microwave. Stir well and add cereal. Mix until well coated. Press in a 9 x 13 buttered pan. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Corned Beef And Chip Casserole
instructions: Mix noodles soup milk corned beef cheese and onion. Pour into a 1 1/2 quart greased baking dish. Top with potato chips. Bake for 15 minutes in a 425\u00b0 oven.

title: Hot Chili Dip
instructions: Brown beef and onions in a skillet season with salt and pepper. Place beef and onions in slow cooker add chili Ro-Tel tomatoes and beans. Stir cover and cook for 2 hours on high setting. When ready to serve top with cheese olives and green onions. Serve with tortilla chips. Serves approximately 25.

title: Pineapple Cheese Pie
instructions: Soften cream cheese at room temperature. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into (ready made) graham cracker crust or Keebler cookie crust. Refrigerate before serving. Yields 2 pies.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour slowly with fork until well mixed. Slowly mix in ice water a little at a time mixing well. With hands shape into a ball. Chill 1 hour. Roll on floured surface. Makes 4 crusts.

title: Neb'S Orange Cake
instructions: Grease tube pan (medium size) or loaf pan and place wax paper in the bottom. Grease again and dust lightly with flour. Shake out excess flour. Mix sugar shortening eggs and orange rind; add buttermilk and flour soda and salt. Add nuts and dates.

title: Disgustingly Rich Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 then grease an 8 or 9-inch baking pan. Melt butter over low heat. Stir cocoa and sugar together. Then stir in the melted butter. Add the eggs and vanilla and stir. Now add flour and salt and mix just until smooth. Spread in pan and bake for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Cream sugar and shortening. Add beaten egg water salt and softened yeast. Add flour a little at the time and mix well.

title: Go To School Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients. Cut into cookies and bake on a cookie sheet 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Easy Gravy
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium-sized storage container or plastic bag. Store tightly covered at room temperature. Shake or stir before using to make gravy (recipe follows). Yields about 1 3/4 cups.

title: Kaposzta(Stuffed Cabbage Leaves)
instructions: Fill each empty can with water and add. Cover pot tightly and cook for approximately 2 hours on very low flame. Serve hot.

title: Mom'S Fudge(Formerly Kathy'S Fudge)
instructions: Mix sugar milk cocoa and salt in a deep heavy saucepan. Bring to a rolling boil. Stir constantly. Test for soft ball stage every 2 to 3 minutes. At the soft ball stage remove from heat. Add butter vanilla and Karo syrup. Beat with electric blender until glossy (4 to 5 minutes). Pour into a buttered platter to set.

title: Hot Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cook slow for 30 minutes.

title: Fire Beef
instructions: Combine oil soy sauce water peppers garlic powder and sugar. Next marinate thin strips of meat in sauce for at least 2 hours. Grill or stir-fry meat. Serve with buttered toast squares or crackers.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Mix pineapple with juice and vanilla instant pudding until blended. Fold in Cool Whip. Fill and frost entire cake.

title: Broccoli Salad Supreme
instructions: Cut broccoli to bite size pieces. Place in bowl with the grapes seeds bacon and onion. Next mayo sugar and vinegar. Toss gently. Chill 2 to 4 hours.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix together well. Stir into box of Jiffy cornbread mix. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle top with grated cheese the last 5 minutes of baking time.

title: Baked Bean And Ham Casserole
instructions: Arrange chops in single layer on rack in pan. Put into a 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or so. Take out and heap stuffing on each chop; continue cooking for 35 to 40 minutes longer (depends on thickness of chops).

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix hamburger egg and cracker or bread crumbs together. Add milk and onion. Mix all together. Bake in loaf pan. Make holes on top of hamburger and pour catsup in them. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Date Delight
instructions: Let milk dates and marshmallows set 15 minutes. Add enough graham crackers to make mixture thick enough to handle. Divide mixture into 2 parts. Form into rolls. Roll in crumbs on waxed paper. Refrigerate in waxed paper. Garnish with whipped cream.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Sift dry milk and powdered sugar into a bowl. Add other items. Mix well and press into pan. Chill for 1 hour or until firm. If desired mix sugar cream cheese and dry milk by hand until smooth. Add other items; mix well and press into a 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Bring to a boil the sugar vegetable oil and vinegar. Cool and pour over vegetables. Can be kept a couple of weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Noodles
instructions: Cut and drop in hot water until done. After noodles are tender drain and rinse in cold water. Put them in your favorite broth chicken beef pork turkey etc.

title: Eva St.  Clair'S Apple Sliced Cinnamon
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Make syrup of sugar and water. Add red devils. Pour over apples. Stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until apples are done.

title: Kolachi
instructions: Melt oleo and cool. Put yeast and sugar in large bowl. Add warm milk and mix. Let stand about 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients in order given. Mix well. If tacky add a little more flour. Knead for 5 minutes on a floured board. Cut in four pieces and form four balls. Knead each ball for 3 minutes and set in lightly floured bowl. Cover with a heavy towel.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Separate eggs reserving egg whites. Beat egg yolks with sugar milk and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture. Place in unbaked pie shell and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Short Ribs Mexicana
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Sprinkle with seasoning mix. Brown in skillet. Add remaining seasoning mix juice and water; stir well. Cover tightly; simmer for 1 hour or until tender. Makes 2 servings.

title: Southwest Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Sprinkle cornmeal onto bottom of greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Spread dough into pan. Pre-bake 5 minutes. Spread with combined tomato sauce and chili powder. Top with green and red pepper chilies and cheese tossed with cilantro. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Cover bottom of 11 x 15-inch pan with graham cracker crust. Reserve 1 cup of crumbs. Slice bananas crosswise and layer over crust. Slice ice cream in 1/2-inch thick slices and place over bananas. Sprinkle ice cream with nuts. Freeze until firm.

title: Dutch Butter Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl with hands. Spread in shallow 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake about 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Watch while they are in the oven so they dont get too brown. Cut in 2-inch squares.

title: Fudge Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake on 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cucumber Dip
instructions: Combine softened creamed cheese and cucumber. Beat until smooth. Add seasonings and chill.

title: Cinnamon Pickles
instructions: Pour lime over cucumbers and cover with water. Stir occasionally. Let stand 24 hours. Drain and rinse well. Set in ice water for 3 hours. Drain rinse and cover with 2 cups vinegar red food color 1 tablespoon alum and 8 1/2 quarts water. Set 3 hours. Drain do not rinse! Discard juice. Heat but dont boil 2 cups vinegar 8 cinnamon sticks 2 cups water 20 ounces red hots and 10 cups sugar. Pour over cucumbers. Bring to a boil once a day for 3 days. On 4th day seal in jars. Ready to eat in 1 week.

title: Cheesy Potato Pancakes
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet and arrange the first layer of potatoes so that they cover the skillet overlapping. Next season lightly and add a layer of cheese. Repeat. End with a layer of cheese. Cover the pan and cook at a medium heat for 40 to 50 minutes. Loosen and serve. Garnish with orange and apple slices.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with vegetable oil to keep rice from sticking. Line dish with instant rice evenly over bottom. Sprinkle dry soup mix over rice. Pepper chicken parts and place on top of rice and dry soup mix. Mix water and soup and pour over chicken. Lift corners of chicken to let liquid down to rice. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for about one hour.

title: Roast Wild Goose 1
instructions: Dress goose and soak several hours in salt and water. Put a small onion inside and plunge into boiling water for 20 minutes. Stuff with chopped celery chopped eggs mashed potatoes bits of fat pork or other cold meat a little butter a raw turnip (grated) a tablespoon of pepper vinegar small chopped onion and pepper and salt to taste.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Then pour over ice.

title: Chinese Noodles With Broccoli(Low-Fat)
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a saucepan. Add the minced garlic; cook stirring over medium-high heat until garlic is just golden. Stir in ginger; continue cooking for 5 minutes. Stir in chicken broth and hoisin sauce. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 2 to 3 more minutes. Serve over pasta with a sprinkling of low sodium soy sauce and a scattering of chopped scallions or red pepper flakes. Toss broccoli with pasta.

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening sugar molasses and eggs. Sift dry ingredients. Add to sugar mix. Stir in oats and raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Spray roasting pan with nonstick spray. Mix soups and milk. Pour half into roasting pan. Sprinkle with the rice. Place chicken on top. Sprinkle contents of seasoning packet over chicken. Pour rest of soup over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 until chicken is done approximately 1 1/2 hours.

title: Yum Yum Dessert
instructions: Line the bottom of a bowl with 1/2 of the cake. Spread 1/2 of the crushed pineapple including juice over cake. Mix and beat pudding with the milk and pour 1/2 over the cake mixture. Slice one banana thin on top of pudding. Spread 1/2 of Cool Whip on top. Repeat process with 2nd layer.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Add the 2 cups water to the mincemeat and cook for a few minutes. Cool. Before adding flour put the soda in mincemeat. Line pan with paper. Cream together the shortening sugar and eggs. Add the flour salt and all ingredients. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Fifteen minutes before done glaze with syrup.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Layer in pan and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pineapple Wassail
instructions: Combine all ingredients; bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix flour with baking powder and salt. Mix together cereal cinnamon and melted butter or margarine; set aside. Combine sour cream and soda; set aside. Cream butter or margarine and sugar together beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla. Alternately add flour mixture and sour cream mixture beginning and ending with flour. Pour half of the batter into a greased 9-inch square pan; top with half the cereal mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 9 servings.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Add sugar to beaten eggs. Pour in milk. Add cooked rice raisins vanilla and salt to taste. Bake until set in a moderate oven.

title: Potato Chip Pecan Crunch Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter sugar and vanilla. Add crushed potato chips and pecans; stir. Stir in flour. Form into small balls using 1 tablespoon dough. Press balls flat on greased cookie sheet with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes or until light brown.

title: Joe'S Punch
instructions: All ingredients except champagne can be mixed together ahead of time and chilled. Add cold champagne just before serving.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together in saucepan and cook until thick stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add oleo and vanilla. Spread while warm on cooled cake. This frosting is not as sweet as the non-cooked ones.

title: Easy Tartar Sauce
instructions: Add relish to mayonnaise. Serve at once. This is a fast and easy tartar sauce.

title: Hungarian Goulash Soup(Not Just A Soup - A Meal!)
instructions: Trim all visible fat from the round steak and brown in the olive oil and garlic clove. Drain fat. Add to stock pot with tomato sauce onions vinegar beef bouillon paprika caraway seeds marjoram bay leaf salt pepper and water. Bring to boil and simmer 2 hours or until beef falls apart with a fork. Remove steak shred and return to pot. Add diced potatoes and simmer until tender - approximately 1 hour. Serve in soup bowls with dark bread and unsalted butter. Serves 8.

title: Marinated Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Pour over cabbage and refrigerate overnight. Even better after 2 or 3 days.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter until \tender.\ Add water the juice from the clams diced potatoes and carrots. Simmer on medium heat 15 to 20 minutes until vegetables are tender. Stir in the mushroom soup and evaporated milk and simmer until hot. Add the clams and corn; heat and serve.

title: Chocolate Whipped Cream Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 2 (9-inch) or 3 (8-inch) layer pans. (Save one layer for another dessert.) Cool and divide layer in half. Fill and cover with following Combine and sift confectioners sugar cocoa and salt. Add to 2 cups whipping cream; chill at least 2 hours. Add vanilla and beat until stiff. Fill layers slightly and cover sides and top of cake. May be frozen. Then add garnish of toasted almonds (sliced) chopped walnuts and shaved chocolate. Will thaw in 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Heat undiluted mushroom soup. Dissolve gelatin in hot water; mix with soup. Add cream cheese and blend well. Add shrimp celery green onions and mayonnaise. Place in salad mold and refrigerate overnight. Unmold and serve with crackers. Makes 20 servings.

title: Broccoli With Basil Mushrooms
instructions: Cook broccoli spears according to package directions. Drain well. Melt butter in small saucepan; add basil and mushrooms. Cook and stir until thoroughly heated. Spoon over broccoli.

title: Linda'S Mexachili Dip
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients and add to the vegetables. Chill 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chicken Breast Scampi
instructions: Cut raw boneless chicken breast into approximately 2 ounce chunks (like huge shrimp) and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat. Add garlic scallions parsley dill oregano salt and pepper. Cook on low heat for 2 minutes then pour the mixture over chicken breasts. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Separate chicken pieces and cook for another 10 minutes. Turn on broiler to brown chicken for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve over rice or cooked spaghetti.

title: Crawfish Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add green onion and simmer 1 minute. Add flour and simmer 2 minutes. Heat cream and add to flour mixture. Simmer 5 minutes. Add crawfish shrimp and remainder of ingredients except Mozzarella cheese. Pour into buttered baking dish and sprinkle with Mozzarella and more Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: German Kraut Noodle Skillet
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water with salt. Drain. In frying pan braise onions in butter. Add kraut and cook until lightly brown. Add noodles to kraut mixture. Add cheese and sour cream just before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together and pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch dish.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Fry sausages drain and cut in half. Add fruit and juices. Mix up last 4 ingredients in cup. Add to sausages and fruit. Stir and heat until thick.

title: Chicken Delight(Serves 6)
instructions: Line baking dish with beef. Place chicken on top. Mix soup sour cream and mushrooms. Spoon over chicken. Place half slice of bacon on chicken pieces. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: No Fail Pie Crust(Really)
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour with pastry blender. Add salt. Cut in more until completely blended. Add water a little at a time until mixture forms a ball. You may not need all the water. Never touch dough with your hands when mixing. Roll out.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown and break up hamburger. Add the onion garlic and oil. Mix corn meal with 1 cup of tomato puree. Add this mixture tomato puree salt and chili powder. Cook stirring often 15 minutes. Take off heat. Add beaten eggs milk and olives. Mix well. Put in lightly greased 3-quart baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0.

title: Papier-Mache
instructions: Mix water and flour in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Mixture should be the same thickness as heavy cream. Coat a mold* with one layer newspaper strips which have been dipped in water. Then dip strips in flour mixture and lay over first layer of strips until mold is well coated. Let stand until strips on mold are dry and hard. Paint over the strips if you like.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in bowl. Stir until it makes a batter. Pour into loaf pan. Dot top with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chili-Day Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet until meat is thoroughly brown. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Season with salt pepper onion powder and chili powder according to your taste.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jello into boiling water. Add frozen orange juice and juice from pineapple and enough water to make 1 1/2 cups. Let stand in refrigerator until it begins to congeal. Add can of cranberry sauce drained pineapple and nuts. Mix and pour in mold and let congeal.

title: Cocoa Krispie Roll
instructions: Cook syrup and sugar until mixture bubbles. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and 2 tablespoons butter. Add Rice Krispies. Press firmly on wax paper on cookie sheet (spread it out over whole cookie sheet).

title: Brown Bag Fried-Fish
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in brown paper bag. Dip fish in milk. Then place in brown bag and shake. Deep fry in 375\u00b0 cooking oil deep enough to float fish. Remove fish when it floats.

title: Edna'S Brownies
instructions: Beat eggs oil vanilla and water together. Mix dry ingredients together (dont prepare pudding; add mix to dry ingredients). Combine dry ingredients with creamed mixture. Add the walnuts.

title: Peaches And Creamy Dip With Waffle Wedges
instructions: Place all ingredients except waffles and cinnamon in blender and process until smooth. Set aside. Toast waffles and cut each waffle into 6 wedges. Place cream cheese mixture in a small serving bowl and sprinkle with cinnamon. Serve with waffle wedges for dipping. Makes 24 wedges and about 3/4 cup cream cheese mixture.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine. Boil sugar milk and margarine. When it begins to boil time for 2 minutes and then take off the stove. Add peanut butter and Fluff and oatmeal and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Stir until peanut butter and Fluff melt. Pour into a pan and refrigerate.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and mix well; add broken vanilla wafers; add coconut and pecans. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into pie shells and garnish with mandarin oranges. Refrigerate.

title: Sausage Spaghetti
instructions: Cut sausage in bite size pieces. Brown sausage and onions; add peppers and cook a few minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Cook for several hours. Add water if needed although thick sauce is best. Serve over spaghetti. You can alter ingredients to suit yourself. Add 1 tablespoon sugar to remove bitter taste of tomato paste if you desire. Italian seasoning may be added.

title: Spiced Red Cabbage
instructions: Place cabbage in a large kettle of boiling saltwater. Boil for 1 minute. Drain. Return to kettle; stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until cabbage is tender. Remove bay leaf. Yield 6 servings.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash potatoes. Mix cream cheese then add other ingredients and whip until light and fluffy. Pour into ungreased casserole; sprinkle French fried onions over top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until brown. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Cauliflower With Shrimp Sauce
instructions: Wash cauliflower and break into flowerets. Cook covered in small amount of boiling salted water for 10 to 15 minutes. Drain. Heat soup over low heat stirring frequently. Add 1/2 cup sour cream; cook and stir just until hot. Add 1/4 cup toasted slivered almonds; pour sauce over hot cauliflower. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Easy Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: For other flavors instead of milk use strawberry drink or any other type drink.

title: Potatoes, Onion, Mushroom Au Gratin
instructions: Cook potatoes the night before with jackets on. Cool peel and cut in cubes. Heat butter in large kettle and saute mushrooms until brown. Stir in flour milk cream or evaporated milk consomme and grated cheese. Also add seasoned salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Cook stirring until smooth and thick. Remove from heat and add potatoes and drained onions. Mix. Spoon into shallow pan or 4-quart casserole. Cover in fridge overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In a 2-quart saucepan melt butter and chocolate over low heat. With wire whisk beat in 2 cups sugar and 3 eggs until blended. Stir in flour salt nuts and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Spread evenly in pan. Beat cream cheese remaining 1/2 cup sugar 1 egg and 1 teaspoon vanilla until well blended about 3 minutes. Drop 6 dollops of cream cheese mixture on top of batter. Swirl with a spatula to marbleize.
