Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool pan on wire rack. Cut when completely cool.

title: Pig-Pickin' Cake
instructions: Grease and flour three cake pans. Mix eggs oil and cake mix. Fold in oranges and juice thoroughly. Pour into cake pans and bake at 325\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks well (save whites for top of pie). Add milk and stir well. Mix flour cocoa and sugar all together. Add slowly with egg and milk. Put on top of the stove and cook on low heat until thickened then add butter and vanilla. Pour in uncooked pie shell and cook at 350\u00b0 until thickened.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except carrots in a bowl until well blended. Stir carrots in last. Pour into a Bundt pan that is greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until tested done.

title: Chocolate Candy Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar and soda in a mixing bowl and set aside. Place water and margarine in a 4-cup batter bowl. Microwave 2 minutes at Full power. Add cocoa and blend well. Cook 1 minute and 30 seconds at Full power or until mixture boils. Gradually stir liquid mixture into flour mixture. Stir in buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Pour into greased 10-inch square baking dish. Cover with wax paper and microwave 8 minutes at Full power. While warm prick surface with a fork. Spread with Chocolate Candy Frosting.

title: Creamy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Prepare noodles according to directions. Drain. Prepare sauce. In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot butter cook mushrooms and onion until tender. Do not brown. Stir in remaining ingredients except macaroni and bread crumbs. Heat thoroughly. In 2 1/2-quart baking dish combine sauce and macaroni. Toss to coat evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Chuck Wagon Beans
instructions: Drain beans; reserve liquid. Fry bacon pieces until crisp. Add onion to brown during last few minutes.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Drain juice from fruit and heat to dissolve the jello. Add cheese then add Cokes pineapple cherries and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Vegetable Stew
instructions: In a stew pot begin sauteing onions garlic potatoes and eggplant in butter. Salt and pepper lightly. When potatoes begin to get tender add celery broccoli carrots and Burgundy. Steam until all vegetables begin to be tender then add zucchini tomato paste mushrooms molasses and dill. Cover and simmer over low heat about 20 minutes. Correct seasoning. Serve piping hot topped with sour cream and freshly chopped parsley.

title: Shrimp-Rice Salad
instructions: Drain shrimp and chill. Combine rice water chestnuts celery olives and onions in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice soy sauce ginger and curry powder. Mix well. Pour over rice mixture and mix well. Chill at least 1 hour. Fold in shrimp. Serve on lettuce and garnish with tomato wedges.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Sift dry ingredients together except soda. Add dry ingredients to pecans. Add soda to buttermilk and eggs. Add this to creamed mixture. Now add flour. Blend well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Yields 3 small or 2 large loaves. Bake in 9 x 7 x 3-inch large pans or 6 x 3 x 3-inch small pans.

title: Taco Seasoning
instructions: Mix together. Store in air tight container. Add 2 tablespoons to 1 pound of hamburger. Can also use a couple of squirts of ketchup while mixing with burger.

title: Curds And Whey(Dravle)
instructions: Heat sweet milk until it comes to a boil. Beat eggs into the buttermilk and add slowly to the hot milk. When cheese settles turn down heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Turn heat up and cook 1/2 hour or more. Add sugar and raisins. Thicken with cornstarch mixed with cream or milk. When cooking handle very gently so as not to break the cheese curds. Use a wooden spoon to stir. You may turn cheese chunks gently several times while cooking.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Chop first 4 ingredients. Pour melted butter over and set aside. Combine rest of ingredients then pour chopped mixture in. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes then reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and bake 1 1/2 hours longer (2 hours total baking time).

title: Meat And Potato Pie
instructions: Combine meat green pepper onion egg bread crumbs and seasoning. Mix lightly. Press meat mixture onto bottom and side of a 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Drain excess fat from meat shell. Mash hot potatoes with milk and butter. Stir in cheese and parsley. Fill hot meat shell with potato mixture. Continue baking 15 minutes more.

title: Grilled Swordfish Steaks With Pesto
instructions: Baste fish with pesto sauce. Grill 10 minutes total per inch of thickness approximately 5 minutes per side.

title: Aunt Bea'S Favorite Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put batter in your favorite cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Add vinegar over soda set aside. Cream shortening sugar and eggs together. Make paste with food coloring and cocoa. Then add to cream mixture. Then add flour vanilla salt and buttermilk. Mix well. Fold in vinegar and soda mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Pecan Dessert
instructions: Mix pie filling water and nutmeg. Pour into greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with pecans. Top with biscuits. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Ham Viennese With Rice
instructions: While rice is cooking saute ham in butter for 2 minutes (use a large skillet). Add onions and celery. Continue cooking until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in soup mustard and dill weed; heat thoroughly. Add sour cream just heat through do not boil. Serve over a bed of fluffy rice.

title: Cherry Clafouti
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease an 8-inch square baking pan or 9-inch deep dish pie plate. Drain canned fruit reserving 1/2 cup syrup. If the fruit is large pieces cut it into pieces the size of cherries. Put the flour sugar cornmeal baking powder and cinnamon into a bowl. In a separate bowl lightly beat eggs. Stir them and reserved fruit syrup into flour mixture. Stir in chopped fruit. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 40 to 45 minutes. Serve hot sprinkled with confectioners sugar.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Mix first five ingredients. Stir in applesauce flour soda and vanilla. Beat at low speed. Add raisins and nuts. Mix well. Bake in greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Supreme Chocolate Cheesecake
instructions: Combine crumbs and margarine. Press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Combine cream cheese and milk mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Blend in chocolate and vanilla; pour over crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Loosen cake from rim of pan. Cool before removing from pan.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Heat last 4 ingredients to dissolve sugar. Cook sauerkraut 15 to 20 minutes. Cool and drain juice. Pour heated mixture over all. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Million Dollar Pie(Will Make 2 Pies)
instructions: Cook and cool pie crusts and set aside. Combine first 6 ingredients. Fill pie crusts and refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Enjoy.

title: Honey-Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange chicken pieces in shallow baking pan skin-side up. Combine margarine honey mustard salt and curry powder and pour over the chicken. Bake 1 1/4 hours basting every 15 minutes until chicken is tender and nicely browned. Good served with rice.

title: Lime-Pear Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot juice and water. Blend in blender the pears cream cheese and hot Jell-O. Cool and add 1/2 large carton Cool Whip. Makes 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: In a bowl combine lima beans soup celery and milk. Pour in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer or until the bread crumbs are lightly browned. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Mix baking mix milk sesame seed and egg. Beat vigorously 30 strokes. Spread in bottom and sides of pie plate (do not spread onto rim). Cook and stir beef until brown; drain. Mix in pepper and tomato sauce. Heat to boiling and reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Spoon into pie plate. Top with onions; sprinkle with cheese. Bake until crust is golden brown and cheese is bubbly about 20 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Combine chicken pimento pepper onion and mushrooms. Add broth soup salt and pepper. Mix. Add 2 cups Cheddar cheese and spaghetti. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 9 x 13 pan for 1 hour.

title: Gourmet Corn Bread
instructions: Whip together oil and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 9-inch square pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. This can be frozen ahead (uncooked). Grease pan.

title: Pork Stew With Olives And Green Beans
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Season pork with salt and pepper. Add pork to pot and cook until brown stirring occasionally using slotted spoon. Transfer pork to plate. Add remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil to pot. Add onions and saute until tender. Add garlic and cook for 3 minutes. Return pork to pot. Add tomatoes with juices chicken broth white wine and spices. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered about 1 hour. Add olives and cook 45 minutes. Add green beans cook until tender about 8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Fruity Frappe
instructions: Place prepared drink mix yogurt and fruit in a blender. Blend on high speed until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Cashew Noodles
instructions: Cover bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with 1 can of noodles. Mix together cubed chicken celery green onion chicken soup and milk. Spoon over noodles and cover with 1 can of noodles and cashews. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sauce For Meatballs
instructions: Mix together and serve over meatballs.

title: Cheese Stuffed Celery
instructions: Combine cheese water green pepper and pimento. Fill crisp celery ribs with a knife. Serve chilled as an appetizer or salad accompaniment.

title: Divinity Fudge
instructions: `Boil sugar water and salt to hard boil stage. Place Marshmallow Creme in bowl. Pour boiling mixture over Marshmallow Creme beating until slightly stiff. Fold in nuts and vanilla. Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper or pour into oblong pan. Cut into squares.

title: Chow Fresh Cabbage
instructions: In Advance Shred cabbage. Dissolve cornstarch in 2 tablespoons of chicken broth and add m.s.g. sugar and pepper. Arrange ingredients on a tray in the order in which they will be used.

title: Drop Noodles(Spaetzle)
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Beat together egg and water. Add flour mixture; stir until smooth (batter should be very thick). Bring to a boil 2 quarts water and 2 teaspoon salt. Spoon batter into boiling water by 1/2 teaspoon dipping spoon into water each time. Cook only one layer of noodles at a time. After noodles rise to the surface boil gently for 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from water and place in warm bowl. Toss with melted butter or serve with gravy.

title: Easy Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cut up chicken in small pieces. In large bowl combine all cans. In large baking dish spread cut up chicken. Cut tortilla in strips and lay on top of chicken. Pour soup mixture over all and soak tortillas thoroughly for 1 hour. Cover with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated.

title: Pecan Pies
instructions: Mix sugar flour and syrup. Add butter then well beaten eggs. Add pecans and flavoring. Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Crisp Dill Slices
instructions: Cut pickles in crosswise slices. Cover with brown sugar in bowl. Cover bowl and refrigerate 24 hours before eating. Pickles get very crisp and crunchy when mellow.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Cook onion green pepper and garlic in butter until soft. Add flour salt and chili powder; stir until smooth. Add tomatoes and meat stock or water. Cook until thick and smooth about 5 minutes. Strain if desired (reserve vegetables). Makes 3 cups.

title: Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Wash slice and cook mushrooms until tender. Drain. Cook flour and butter together until brown. Add stock onion and bay leaf. Cook about 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove onion and bay leaf. Add mushrooms. Add salt and pepper to taste and reheat.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: About 25 minutes before serving Put carrots and salt in medium saucepan over medium heat in 1 inch boiling water. Cook for 15 minutes or until tender but still firm. Drain. Add butter sugar and nutmeg. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until carrots are glazed. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together over low heat. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Put marshmallows on top of done cake. Over low heat mix the confectioners sugar milk cocoa butter and vanilla. Stir well. Pour over the top of the marshmallows.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix and pour in buttered casserole. Place boneless chicken breast pieces on top. Sprinkle 1 package Lipton dry onion soup mix on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: 1936 Caramel Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring slowly to a full boil stirring constantly. Boil hard for 2 minutes (2 1/2 minutes on a rainy day). Cool to lukewarm. Add vanilla and beat until creamy.

title: Chilean Sea Bass
instructions: Rinse bass in cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Lightly season fish with salt and pepper; coat with flour. Heat oil in skillet. Add fish and cook until lightly browned about 1 minute per side. Transfer to plate; set aside. Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook about 1 to 2 minutes. Add tomatoes lemon juice bay leaves rosemary oregano and coriander; cook on high for 3 to 4 minutes. Add fish and gently press into tomato mixture. Cover and cook over medium heat until fish is no longer opaque in center 8 to 10 minutes. Remove bay leaves and serve with rice.

title: Spam Salad
instructions: Grate Spam in large mixing bowl; add chopped vegetables. Season to taste. Mix in enough salad dressing to desired consistency for spreading on favorite bread for sandwiches or serve with favorite crackers. If serving with crackers I sprinkle top with paprika and slice green olives on top as a garnish.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix flour with sugar salt and beaten egg yolks. Stir in milk a little at a time so the mixture wont be lumpy. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat add butter and vanilla cool. Beat egg whites until foamy add sugar gradually and beat until stiff but not dry. Pour over cooled filling into shell. Cover with meringue and bake at 325-350 degrees until golden brown.

title: Green Tomato Relish
instructions: Grind first four ingredients together and let stand overnight in 1 cup of salt. Drain off as much juice as possible. Add remaining ingredients from brown sugar on. Boil until thick. It must be stirred often to keep it from sticking or burning. Stirring also helps juices evaporate. Place in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Pralines
instructions: Cook together until syrup forms a soft ball when tested in cold water. Remove from stove and add 1 1/2 cups pecans 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 tablespoon butter. Beat until mixture begins to hold shape. Drop by spoon on wax paper that has been sprinkled generously with salt.

title: Tater Tot And Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with chopped onion in skillet stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Combine soup and milk in bowl; mix well. Fold in green beans. Stir in ground beef mixture. Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with French fried onions. Arrange single layer of Tater Tots over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Yield 8 servings.

title: Out Of This World Chocolate Pie
instructions: Place chocolate bar in top of double boiler and melt over hot not boiling water. Stir occasionally until fully melted. Remove from bottom of boiler and let stand until slightly cooled. Simply fold the Cool Whip into the chocolate gently but fully. Pour into pie shell. Place in refrigerator for several hours before serving.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Bake about 20 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken And Rice Salad
instructions: Cook rice (Minute rice will do). Stir in mayonnaise celery green onions and cauliflower (flowerets broken into small pieces) then stir in chicken and salt and pepper to taste. Chill before serving. May need to add a little more mayonnaise if it appears too dry.

title: New England Dinner
instructions: Place carrots onion and celery in a 5-quart slow cooker. Place the roast on top; sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. Add soup mix water vinegar and bay leaf. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 9 hours or until beef is tender. Remove beef and keep warm; discard the bay leaf. Add cabbage. Cover and cook on high for 30 to 40 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Meanwhile melt butter in a small saucepan; stir in flour and minced onion. Add 1 1/2 cups cooking liquid from the slow cooker. Stir in horseradish and remaining salt; bring to a boil. Cook and stir over low heat until thick and smooth about 2 minutes. Serve with roast and vegetables.

title: Hollywood Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in their jacket until tender. While still hot peel and roll each in melted butter then in grated cheese. Place in well buttered shallow baking dish and heat under broiler until lightly browned.

title: Apricot-Glazed Cornish Hens
instructions: Mix apricot preserves and orange juice in small bowl. Remove giblets from hens. Place hens on rack in roasting pan; sprinkle lightly with salt and paprika. Roast hens in preheated 350\u00b0 oven until thickest parts are fork tender and drumstick meat feels soft when pressed 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Baste frequently with sauce during last 30 minutes of cooking time. Saute green onions in 2 tablespoons margarine in medium saucepan until tender about 2 minutes. Stir in rice; cook according to package directions substituting chicken broth for water and omitting salt. Stir parsley into rice. Saute cashews in 2 tablespoons margarine in medium skillet until golden about 2 minutes; stir into rice. Spoon rice onto serving platter; arrange hens on rice and serve.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook the chicken breast and then shred it; cook the chilies. Crush the chilies and then put a little salt in the chilies to taste. Fill the tortillas with chilies the chicken and chopped onion; fold the enchilada over. Put sour cream and cheese on top. Heat in the oven briefly or heat in the microwave if needed.

title: Albacore Tuna Fettucine
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water. cook broccoli until tender-crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon to serving bowl. Add fettucine to same pot of boiling water and cook until tender. Drain and add to broccoli. Stir in albacore tuna. In same pot combine remaining ingredients stirring until sauce is smooth and heated through. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour over pasta mixture and toss.

title: Herbed Pot Roast
instructions: Dredge roast in flour and brown in vegetable oil in Dutch oven. Place onion slices on top. Combine sherry water and catsup and all herbs. Pour over roast. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add potatoes and carrots and cook 1/2 hour more or until vegetables are tender. Serve with liquid over beef. Smells so good; you cant wait to eat!

title: Baked Ham
instructions: Have the butcher slice the ham in dinner slices before the purchase.

title: Spicy Beef
instructions: Cook meat onion and garlic. Add rest of ingredients except cheese and chips. Simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over chips with cheese on top or stir together and serve immediately.

title: Crab Canapes
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well and spread over muffin halves. Cut each in 4 sections; place on cookie sheet and freeze. Store in plastic container or bag up to 4 weeks until ready to use. Place canapes under broiler and heat until lightly brown and bubbly.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Let the cheeses set out at room temperature to soften. Mix the 3 cheeses with Worcestershire sauce salt and onion flakes thoroughly. Combine minced pecans and parsley together. Add half of this mixture to the cheese mixture; chill. Shape into a ball after chilling then roll in remaining parsley and pecan mixture.

title: Cinnamon Candy
instructions: Cook to hard crack; take off fire. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon oil. Stir very well. Pour into molds. Let cool.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine and simmer until margarine melts. Good with chops ribs roast and chicken.

title: Savory Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak into strips and coat with mixture of flour salt and pepper. Brown strips in oil in large skillet. Drain tomatoes reserving liquid.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Let cool and store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Joan'S Bean Dip
instructions: Spread beans on bottom of 9 x 13-inch container or pan. Then add remaining items in layers. Sprinkle cheese on and top with olives sliced. Serve with taco chips.

title: Deviled Chicken Breasts(Serves 4)
instructions: Toss chicken breasts and breadcrumbs in large Ziploc bag to coat. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Brown chicken on each side for 3 minutes or until golden brown. Add wine savory salt pepper and mushrooms. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove chicken and mushrooms with slotted spoon and place on serving plate. Add lemon juice and honey mustard to skillet; stir well. Cook 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serve sauce over chicken.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Bake rolls at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool. Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and dry dressing. Spread over crescents. Add vegetables and top with cheese.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Combine other ingredients together then add hamburger mixture. Place in greased casserole and bake for 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Break up vermicelli in melted butter and brown. Add consomme and water. Add rice. Heat until hot. Cover and cook 45 minutes with lid on. No peeking! Add almonds mushrooms and chives. Bake 45 minutes in casserole at 350\u00b0. Serves 16; may be halved.

title: Wylene'S Sherried Beef
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer 3 to 5 hours. Serve over rice or noodles. This is very good served over Wylenes Wild Rice Baron.

title: Barbecued Meat Balls
instructions: Combine meat milk and crumbs. Form into balls. Brown in hot fat. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over meat balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Ricotta Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a ball. Roll dough between wax paper making a crust for a 10 x 13 inch pan and leaving enough dough for lattice on top. Line the dough on bottom and sides of pan. Pour in filling. Make lattice for top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until knife comes out clean (as a custard pie). Use a glass pan to make it easy to store.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Blend eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Gradually stir in scalded milk. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife in center of custard comes out clean.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Bake
instructions: Brown chicken\tbreasts. Cook\tnoodles broccoli and carrots separately. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish mix noodles broccoli and carrots. Place chicken breasts on top. In pan the chicken was browned in add soup and milk. When warm pour over casserole and bake 45 to 60 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Roll
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate over low heat stirring. Cool slightly; stir in powdered sugar and egg. Beat to creamy and glossy. Put in marshmallows and nuts to coat. Put coconut on wax paper and roll mixture in it. Shape into roll. Make into two rolls. Slice. No bake.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and Crisco oil until creamed. Add eggs one at a time. Add instant pudding mix and Seven-Up. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Carrot Loaf
instructions: Stir together first 6 ingredients. In another bowl stir together next 5 ingredients. Stir flour mixture into carrot mixture. Add nuts and raisins. Spoon into a greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Remove. Cool on wire rack. Wrap and store overnight before serving. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Primavera Salad
instructions: Remove broccoli leaves and tough ends and discard. Wash good and cut in 1-inch pieces. Cook in boiling water covered for 1 minute. Drain immediately and plunge in ice cold water to stop the cooking process. Drain pat dry and chill. Cook pastry from package directions. Drain. Rinse with cold water and drain again. Combine pasta and Versatile Vinaigrette and toss to coat. Place in a large Ziploc bag and chill for 2 hours or overnight. Wash spinach and remove stems. Combine spinach pasta broccoli turkey and remaining ingredients; toss gently.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Mix in a clean bowl; let stand for 6 hours. Add it and let stand for 3 hours; make sure the mixture bubbles up.

title: Fried Peach Pie Mix
instructions: Remove seeds. Chop peaches peeling and all with a food chopper until they are in very very small pieces. Boil sugar and vinegar until sugar is melted. Add chopped peaches and cook until mixture is of spreading consistency. Pour into clean hot jars and seal. Makes 5 pints. Use as filling for fried pies.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Whisk together oil and dressing mix in a large bowl; pour over crackers tossing to coat. Spread mixture on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes stirring after 7 minutes. Yields 6 cups.

title: Rabbit Salad
instructions: Cut up the rabbit meat into small pieces. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill about 1 hour in the refrigerator.

title: Seafood Pasta Salad
instructions: Combine dressing and cheese. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Chill. Serve with freshly ground black pepper.

title: Chinese Spinach
instructions: Heat oil soy sauce lime juice sugar and pepper in large skillet. Add garlic. Stir-fry over medium high heat about 1 minute or until garlic is light brown. Add onion; stir-fry 1 minute. Add spinach water chestnuts and pimiento. Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes or until spinach is tender. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt. Add milk and oil. Pat dough into bottom on greased pizza pan. Mix pizza sauce water and seasonings. Spread over dough then sprinkle on onion mushrooms (well drained) hamburger and cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Dump Dessert
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan; spread can of pineapple. Spread can of pie filling next. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly on top then sprinkle brown sugar then pecans. Last slice stick of butter and arrange over top of all. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sauerkraut
instructions: Boil together until well done. Next; add one stick of margarine and 1 bag of croutons. Add salt pepper and poultry seasoning to taste. You need enough croutons to make it hold together. Roll into balls and bake until done.

title: Jalapeno Pie
instructions: Chop peppers. Shred cheese. Layer peppers and cheese in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Pour eggs over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares. Serve warm. The more jalapenos the better.

title: Candy Quickies
instructions: In double boiler put Chinese noodles butterscotch chips and peanut butter. Add peanut butter and butterscotch chips. Blend. Stir in noodles. Spoon on wax paper to cool. Spread peanut butter between Ritz crackers and then dip in melted white chocolate. Dip Ritz crackers or wafer thin crackers in mint flavored white chocolate.

title: Mom'S Bar-B-Q
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions with celery. Salt to taste. Add rest of ingredients and simmer until it thickens.

title: Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Boil chicken for an hour. Drain water but save. Let chicken cool. Add all other ingredients except noodles to chicken broth and boil again. Remove chicken from bones and add meat to soup. Boil at least 1 hour; add noodles and serve.

title: Buttermilk Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: In a casserole layer ingredients in order listed topping with soup. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Make sauce of mayonnaise soup eggs onion cheese and vinegar. Pour over broccoli in a 2-quart casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Connie'S Easy French Bread
instructions: Put yeast in 1/2 cup of warm water and mix. Add sugar salt shortening and hot water. Stir in the flour one cup at a time and mix after each cup. After all the flour is added let dough set for 15 minutes then stir again and let set again for 15 minutes. Do this 4 times (takes 1 hour). Let dough set covered until it doubles. Form into 1 loaf and put on floured baking sheet. Brush the top with cold water and make 5 slashes diagonally in top of loaf with sharp knife. Let loaf rise for 30 minutes and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Dipped Cinnamon Crisps
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut each unbaked shell into 8 wedges. Place on ungreased sheet. Bake for 4 to 7 minutes or until golden brown. In small saucepan over low heat melt chocolate chips and shortening stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Place pan in warm water to keep chocolate soft. Line baking sheets with waxed paper. In plastic bag combine sugar and cinnamon. Gently shake a few wedges at a time. Dip wide end of each wedge in melted chocolate. Place on waxed paper and refrigerate until chocolate is set.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Place soft tortillas cut in quarters over bottom and sides of pan. Mix browned hamburger onion soups green chilies and sauce. Layer in pan with tortillas and cheese on top each. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until bubbly.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together (better if done by hand). Roll dough into small balls and place on cookie sheet. Press each ball with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Refrigerate overnight. Roll out. Whip one egg white and spread over dough. Sprinkle with sugar and chopped nuts. Cut with pizza cutter. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Moist And Tasty Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing thoroughly. Shape firmly into loaf. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour then glaze with catsup and continue baking approximately 15 more minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in Bundt pan or until done.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.\tCombine brown sugar oats and 3 cups of\tflour.\tWith fingertips work in the shortening. Press half the mixture\tinto bottom of a well greased 10 x 15-inch roasting or baking pan. Combine apples with remaining flour 1 teaspoon of cinnamon and the sugar; spread on top of the oat mixture. Add and press down remaining oat mixture. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon and bake for 40 to 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Alternate vanilla wafer crumbs and milk. Fold in pecans and coconut. Bake 2 hours in Bundt pan at 275\u00b0. Cool completely before removing from Bundt pan.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients reserving small amount of grated cheese to sprinkle on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Dessert
instructions: Put bite size pieces of angel food cake into a 9 x 9-inch dish. In a separate bowl combine pudding and milk. Add ice cream. Beat until well blended then spoon over cake. Refrigerate.

title: Cranberry Cooler
instructions: In a 2-cup liquid measure or small pitcher combine cranberry juice nectar and orange juice and stir well. Divide ice into each of two 10 ounce glasses. Pour half of the cranberry mixture and half of the club soda (or seltzer) into each glass. It makes 2 servings about 3/4 cup each.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in oleo until clear. Cook broccoli according to directions; drain. Mix broccoli with soup and Cheez Whiz. Add to onion celery and oleo. Stir in rice. Season and mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Christmas Ornament Clay Bake(Dried In An Oven)
instructions: Tempera paint a basic printing medium can be purchased in a liquid form or a powdered form. The dry tempera must be mixed with a liquid. Mix powdered tempera directly with liquid starch or make paste using 1/4 cup water and 1 teaspoon dry wheat paste (wallpaper paste). Then add 1/4 cup of liquid starch to achieve proper consistency. Mix in powdered tempera for color.

title: Oyster Cracker Delight
instructions: Put all ingredients except crackers in a large container that will seal tightly. Mix dry ingredients into oil well. Add oyster crackers; shake then let set a few hours and shake again. Do not open for 24 hours.

title: Piggie Peach Custard Pie
instructions: Slice the peaches on the bottom of an unbaked pie shell. Mix well the sugar eggs flour and butter and pour slowly over peaches. Bake 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 or bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Raspberry Jelly
instructions: Put all together in large pan. Let boil stirring slightly until skin forms on top. Take off heat and skim off top layer of skin. Throw away. Put in jelly jars. Put wax on top and put paper on top then cover tightly.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent roll dough on an 11 x 15-inch ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 11 to 13 minutes until light brown. Cool. Blend cream cheese with salad dressing. Spread cream mixture on top of baked crust. Sprinkle chopped vegetables on top of creamed mixture. Top with 2 cups of grated Cheddar cheese. Serve cold.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients but optional bread crumbs. Gently pat into crab\tcakes.\tRoll cakes in bread crumbs if desired. Fry in cooking oil over medium heat until brown.

title: Coke Salad
instructions: Drain all juice from the pineapple and cherries and heat until it bubbles around the edge of the pan. Use this to mix the jello. Dissolve all jello then add Coke. Mix well and let stand in refrigerator until it starts to congeal. Mix in cream cheese (cut into small cubes) pineapple cherries and pecans. Let stand in refrigerator at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Mama'S Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Put cucumbers onions and peppers in large crock or pan. Mix ice and salt; pour over cucumbers. Let set for 3 hours; drain and put in pot. Pour remaining ingredients over cucumbers. Bring to a boil. Put in jars and seal.

title: Oatmeal Chip Cookies
instructions: *Or use 1 cup butter Crisco in place of the butter and shortening.

title: Pistachio Fluff
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Crush Ritz crackers into crumbs. Melt butter. Put on cracker crumbs spread in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes then cool. Mix pudding milk and softened ice cream together. Pour onto crust. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with pistachios and cherries on top.

title: Refrigerated Dill Cucumbers
instructions: Make a brine by combining water vinegar and salt and bring to a boil. Let cool. Quarter cucumbers lengthwise and put in a large bowl with dill and peeled garlic cloves. Pour cooled brine over cucumbers. Cover bowl and weight contents down if necessary to keep cucumbers covered with brine. Put bowl in refrigerator 4 days. Put pickles and brine in jars. Must keep refrigerated. Will keep several months.

title: Frosia
instructions: Wash and dry basil leaves. Stack leaves and chop finely. Crack eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork. Add the basil bread crumbs Parmesan cheese salt and pepper and stir to mix. Let set a few minutes and if mixture appears dry add 1 or 2 more eggs. Mixture needs to be consistency of heavy pancake batter.

title: Praline Sauce
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil; cook stirring constantly 1 minute. Remove from heat; stir in pecans and vanilla. Cool slightly; serve warm over slices of pie. Yields 2 cups.

title: Oatmeal Crust
instructions: Sift together flour and salt. Cut in other ingredients with a pastry blender beginning with the butter. Blend it until mixture resembles coarse crumbs then stir in oats. Sprinkle milk over mixture. Stir lightly and form into ball. Turn out on lightly floured board. Roll to form circle. Fit into a 9-inch pan. Crimp around edges. Prick sides and bottom if using for a cream pie. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. May also be used unbaked for custard or chess pies.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine or shortening peanut butter egg and white sugar together. Sift together and stir in flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Chill dough. Make balls size of large walnuts. Place 3-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Flatten and crisscross with a floured fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Mix jello with 2 cups hot water. When dissolved add 3/4 cup cold water. Add strawberries and chill until set. Mix pudding according to directions on box. Chill until set. Layer cake jello and pudding in a punch bowl or very large glass bowl. Finish with whipped cream on top.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup brown sugar and coconut. Put in an 8-inch round greased and floured cake pan or smaller. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of brown sugar and coconut over top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in preheated oven at 350\u00b0. Frost while warm.

title: Scallops And Linguine
instructions: Cook linguine to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with hot water. In large bowl combine scallops lemon juice and garlic. Sprinkle with parsley dill weed salt and pepper; toss gently. Cover; refrigerate 10 to 15 minutes to blend flavors. In large saucepan melt butter. Drain scallops well; saute 3 to 4 minutes coating well with butter. Add cream heating thoroughly about 1 minute. Over medium-high heat add linguine to scallop mixture tossing gently to distribute scallops and heat thoroughly. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ham Salad For Sandwiches
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Salad is ready for sandwiches.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix everything well. Put in a covered bowl overnight in refrigerator. Mix with fruit before serving. Chop all fruit and sprinkle with Fruit-Fresh. Mix well in a large bowl.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat to boiling then cool and let stand a few hours for flavors to blend. Just before serving reheat and strain out spices.

title: Almonry Biscuits
instructions: Mix sugar flour baking powder and oats together. Melt margarine and syrup over low heat. Add baking soda and milk to melted mixture. Add dry ingredients and mix. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Fudge Mallow Raisin Candy
instructions: Microwave chocolate and peanut butter in 2-quart bowl for 2 to 3 minutes or until melted. Stir after each minute. Fold in marshmallows and raisins. Pour into foil lined 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm.

title: Mexican Chili
instructions: In large skillet brown beef onion green pepper and garlic. Stir in rest of ingredients. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain green limas and kidney beans. Mix all ingredients; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (If mixed ahead of time the flavor is better.) Good for carry-in dinners in a slow cooker.

title: Pineapple Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine all the dry ingredients; add oil eggs and carrots. Mix on low speed until well blended; stir in pineapple and nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans; cool completely on wire racks. Frost with cream cheese.

title: Chicken Dip
instructions: Mix all the ingredients the night before serving. Serve with cubed bread or crackers.

title: Pizza Quickie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Pat biscuits on cookie sheet until very thin. Bake for 4 minutes. Brown meats separately; drain grease. Rinse and then chop vegetables. Spread sauce over biscuits. Top with desired toppings; meats first and then vegetables. Sprinkle with both cheeses. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes until cheese is bubbly. Substitute with slices of barbecue bread for French bread style pizza.

title: Hamburger In A Skillet
instructions: Saute rice in margarine until golden brown. Add meat onion and celery and brown. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Peach Smash
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender container and blend until well mixed and frosty. Pour into chilled glasses. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine eggs with pumpkin; mix all dry ingredients together. Mix with pumpkin and egg. Bake in greased and lightly floured loaf pan for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Fill a salad bowl 1/2 full with the lettuce. Make 1 layer each of the onions green peppers celery and peas. Spread the mayonnaise and cheese over top. Top with the bacon. Refrigerate 8 hours.

title: Artichoke Delight
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 45 minutes.

title: Banana Teething Biscuits
instructions: Combine all ingredients; stir until smooth. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour in greased loaf pan. Cool; remove from pan. Cut into sticks. Rebake at 150\u00b0 until hard and crunchy.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour into pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes and reduce heat to 400\u00b0 until pumpkin is set.

title: Rocky Road Brownies
instructions: Prepare and bake brownie mix using package directions. Sprinkle marshmallows over hot brownies. Combine chips and milk in saucepan. Cook until smooth stirring constantly. Drizzle over brownies. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Barbecued Pork
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker; cover and cook on high 8 hours. Shred meat with fork. Mix into sauce and heat through. Serve on hamburger/sandwich buns with grated cheese and cole slaw on top.

title: Flag Dessert
instructions: Slice 1 cup of the strawberries. Set aside. Halve remaining strawberries and set aside. Line bottom of 12 x 18-inch baking dish with cake slices. Top with 1 cup sliced strawberries 1 cup of the blueberries and all of the whipped topping. Place strawberry halves and remaining 1/3 cup blueberries on whipped topping to make flag design.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Boil all ingredients except Cheez Whiz and broccoli until tender. In another container cook broccoli florets until tender. Add Cheez Whiz to soup mixture and then add broccoli. Serve immediately.

title: Pickled Squash
instructions: Place squash and onion in enamel pan cover with water and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons salt. Let stand one hour stirring a few times. Drain well and mix squash with remaining ingredients and bring to a good boil.

title: Ham Salad(Made With Bologna)
instructions: Grind all ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Moisten with salad dressing. One-half pound cheese (grated) may be added.

title: Strawberry Dream
instructions: Tear angel food cake into pieces and place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix jello according to directions on package using 3 cups of water. Pour this over cake pieces. Add strawberries and pecans on top of this. Mix instant pudding according to package directions using 3 cups of milk. Pour over the strawberries. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Cracked Wheat Rolls
instructions: Place 1 cup whole wheat kernels in blender. Cover; blend on highest setting for 1 1/2 minutes or until kernels are coarsely ground. Combine cracked wheat and 1 1/2 cups warm water; let stand 15 minutes stirring once or twice. Drain pressing out excess liquid.

title: Cowboy Stew
instructions: Brown meat with celery bell pepper onion and garlic. Drain fat. Add all other ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve over Fritos corn chips or rice.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck. Add onion sauce water and spices. Cook rotini as directed while meat sauce simmers. Drain pasta. Place in baking dish. Top with meat mixture. Layer pepperoni on top. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with garlic bread.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cream oleo oil and sugar. Add eggs vanilla and milk. Blend well. Mix dry ingredients together; add to creamed mixture. Stir in zucchini. Sprinkle with nuts and chips after pouring batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes. (No need for frosting; zucchini makes cake moist too.)

title: Carrot-Potato Combo
instructions: Boil potatoes and carrots. Cool; grate. Combine soup sour cream butter cheese salt and pepper. Combine with potatoes and carrots in casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley. Cover; bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Sweet Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pie crust shells with mixer. Put in pie crust shells. Sprinkle generously with cinnamon or nutmeg. Bake at 425\u00b0 for the first 15 minutes; reduce heat to 375\u00b0 and bake 25 minutes more. Total baking time is 40 minutes. Yields two (9-inch) pies.

title: Annie'S Shrimp Fettuccini
instructions: Add onions and celery to melted butter in a large heavy sauce pan. Saut for 10 minutes until onion is clear. Add flour and mix well. Cook until thickened. Add parsley and shrimp. Cover and cook for 20 minutes stirring constantly. Add cream cheese and garlic. Mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook covered on low heat for 20 minutes stirring constantly. Mix in cooked and drained noodles. Pour into a buttered 3 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes.

title: Jimmie'S Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet on medium. Season fryer. Mix thoroughly. Drop egg on fryer. Mix coating every piece. Place one at a time into flour coating each piece. Drop skin side up into medium hot oil. Fry 3 minutes. Turn and fry 3 more minutes. Cover with lid. Check fryer and turn 3 or 4 times every 4 minutes. Uncover and let chicken get golden brown and crispy.

title: Bountiful Black Bean Soup
instructions: In large saucepan combine beans with enough water to cover by 1-inch. Bring to boil over high heat. Boil 1 minute. Remove pan from heat. Cover tightly and let stand 1 hour (or soak beans overnight in large bowl with enough cold water to cover by 1-inch). Drain beans.

title: Peach Yogurt Shake
instructions: In blender container combine all ingredients except peach slices and mint. Cover and blend on medium speed until smooth.

title: Easy White Sauce
instructions: Crumb together with pastry blender all ingredients. Store in refrigerator indefinitely. As needed spoon out a little into hot liquids peas or other vegetables. Stir as it thickens. Saves on another dirty pan.

title: Kool-Aid Dessert
instructions: Mix the Clear Jell with enough water to make a smooth paste before adding to main amount of water. Cook until clear. Add 2 (3 ounce) packages of orange jello. When cool add fresh frozen or canned fruit.

title: Zucchini Appetizer Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients; spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool; cut in squares. Enjoy!

title: Pour Pizza
instructions: Lightly brown hamburg and onion. Season with salt and pepper. Combine flour salt pepper oregano eggs and milk making a soft batter. Grease a 9x13 pan and sprinkle lightly with cornmeal (or flour).

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter and brown and white sugars until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat very well. Add vanilla and sifted dry ingredients. Mix well. Add coconut. Spread into 2 large (9 x 13-inch) well greased pans about 1/2-inch deep. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Cut in squares while still warm.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix zucchini noodles vegetable soup water Worcestershire sauce salt and oregano. Put in 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes stir and then bake 7 more minutes.

title: Mock Whipped Cream Frosting
instructions: Cream butter Crisco sugar and vanilla. Cook milk and cornstarch together. Cool. Add cooked mixture to creamed mixture beating constantly until light and fluffy.

title: Chicken Tarragon
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with paprika. In a large skillet brown chicken in 2 teaspoons butter. Place the vegetables in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with chicken. Melt the remaining butter. Stir in the tarragon lemon juice salt and pepper. Pour over chicken and vegetables. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes until vegetables are tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix everything together and put in a 3-quart casserole dish. Cover top with bread crumbs and pour 1/2 of the margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. This recipe makes enough for 30 people.

title: Dad'S Prime Rib
instructions: Rub garlic all over roast. Generously salt and pepper roast. Roast in a 400\u00b0 preheated oven for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 15 minutes per pound.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Chill 3 hours. Roll into ball. Serve with crackers.

title: Grandmother'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs. Add milk and soda mixture alternately with sifted flour and nutmeg. Add vanilla. Roll out not too thin; cut with cookie cutter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until just done but not too brown. May be iced or sprinkled with sugar if desired. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt if Crisco is used instead of butter.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix together and store in refrigerator.

title: Meat-Shell Potato Pie
instructions: Mix thoroughly 1/2 cup soup beef onion egg bread crumbs parsley and seasonings. Press firmly into 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes; spoon off fat. Frost with potatoes. Top with remaining soup cheese and bacon. Bake 10 minutes more until done. Makes one 9-inch meat pie.

title: Nut Kipferl
instructions: Mix flour sugar and walnuts. Cut butter into fine particles. Add vanilla and work by hand to form a ball and dough holds together. Chill 1/2 hour.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken and debone; place in large casserole dish. Mix chicken soup and 1/2 cup water. Pour this over deboned chicken. Slice boiled eggs on top of this. Melt butter. Mix flour and milk; shake real well. Pour this over the first mixture; be sure to cover good. Pour 2 cups of broth over mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Turn broiler on to brown the top. Delicious.

title: Fancy Corn Bread
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients. Beat eggs; add milk and melted butter. Add corn peppers cheese and onion. Mix thoroughly. Pour into greased pan. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Have butter soft. Cream and add cheese then add salt and red pepper. Press through star cookie press. Bake at 375\u00b0 until barely crisp.

title: Banana Creme Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar; set aside. Scald milk in top of double boiler (water boiling in bottom pan) on low heat. Add flour and sugar mixture. Stirring occasionally cook for 7 minutes. Stir in two eggs (well beaten first) and vanilla; cook 3 minutes. Let cool.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs flour bananas soda salt flavoring and nuts. Mix. Pour into prepared loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 or until done.

title: Mexican Rice
instructions: Combine water dry mustard and bouillon granules in a 2-quart casserole. Stir in rice and chopped green peppers. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Let stand 3 minutes. Stir in chopped green chives. Fluff with a fork before serving. Yields 6 servings. Contains 97 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

title: Blue Cheese Log
instructions: Bring cream cheese Blue cheese and butter to room temperature. Mix together. Add remaining ingredients. Shape into a log on wax paper. Refrigerate until firm. Before serving cover with sliced almonds which have been toasted in oven with butter. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Crush graham crackers and mix with powdered sugar in bowl; set aside. Melt peanut butter and margarine in medium saucepan. Add to graham crackers and powdered sugar mixture. Mix well and pat into the bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Let set in fridge.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: *You can use 3/4 cup brown sugar and 3/4 cup white sugar.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix last 3 ingredients. Pour over vegetables and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Salt can be added to taste.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Place pie crust upside down in a square baking dish or pan. Pour peaches over pie crust. Sprinkle cake mix over peaches. Slice butter over cake min. Bake in oven for 45 minutes until golden brown.

title: Corn And Asparagus Bake
instructions: Cook asparagus slightly less time than package directions. Drain corn reserving liquid. Stir flour into melted butter; blend well. Stir milk and corn liquid gradually into flour mixture. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Add cheese egg parsley salt and celery salt; stir well until mixture thickens. Add almonds. Remove from heat. Layer corn asparagus and sauce in a greased 3-quart baking dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix beaten egg butter and Parmesan cheese with drained pasta. Pat down in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with cottage cheese.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion; drain. Add mushroom soup and rice. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Uncover and stir for a few minutes topping with chow mein noodles. Soy sauce may be also used on top.

title: Better Than Potato Salad
instructions: Cook rice to package directions. Transfer to bowl. Cover and chill. Add mayonnaise or salad dressing celery onion mustard and salt to chilled rice. Mix well. Cover and chill. Stir in remaining ingredients before serving. Makes 6 to 8 generous servings. A great alternative to potato salad for picnics or family reunions.

title: Easy Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Empty cake mix into a large bowl. Mix well with eggs water and oil. In another bowl mix candied fruit raisins and walnuts in 2/3 cup flour so they dont sink to bottom of cake. Mix batter and fruit mixture together. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean when inserted. Remove from oven. While cake is warm drizzle with mixture of 1 cup of powdered sugar and a few tablespoons of warm water. Decorate top with maraschino cherries pieces of green fruit from fruit mixture and walnuts.

title: Honey Rose Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together the first six ingredients. Sift flour cinnamon and salt together. Add alternately with part of the buttermilk to creamed mixture. Add vinegar and soda to the last part of the buttermilk and mix well. Add red food coloring to complete mixture and pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Corn Plus Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper. Grease glass dish. Pour ingredients in (except 1/2 of the cracker crumbs and 1/2 cup cheese). Mix well then add remaining topping. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Hummus(Chickpea Spread)
instructions: Start your food processor and then put in garlic. As soon as garlic is minced put in chickpeas lemon juice salt tahini and cold water. Blend until smooth. Add more cold water if you want it thinner. Empty contents into a shallow 6-inch wide bowl. Smooth contents. Sprinkle with paprika and cumin then drizzle oil over it. Best served at room temperature. Dip with pita bread.

title: Hot Salsa
instructions: Blend peppers onions garlic cumin and cilantro with a small amount of tomato juice from your can of tomatoes. Blend in blender until your cilantro is well blended. Put tomatoes in and blend for 10 to 20 seconds. You dont want it real mushy. Cook in a pot on top of stove on medium heat for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Lasagna
instructions: Mix Ricotta cheese with salt pepper grated Parmesan cheese parsley and spinach. Cook lasagna and drain. Spread tomato sauce on bottom of pan layering alternating lasagna mixture and tomato sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until light brown. Mix next 3 ingredients together and spread on cooled crust. Mix last two ingredients as directed on pudding box. Spread on cream cheese mixture. Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: Corn Flaked Chicken
instructions: Rinse off chicken and pat dry. Melt butter; set aside to cool. Crush the corn flakes with a rolling pin. Blend together the butter and paprika. Dip the chicken pieces into the butter mixture then roll the pieces in the corn flakes covering all sides. Place the chicken on a cookie sheet and place in oven at 350\u00b0. Cook for about 1 hour or until crisp.

title: Hillbilly
instructions: Boil noodles until soft and set aside. Brown meat with onion. Season. Make a layer of 1/2 of the noodles in the bottom of a 2 quart greased casserole dish. Place 1/2 of the meat on top. Pour 1/2 of the corn over the meat. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of green pepper and a thin layer of cubed cheese over this. Repeat the entire process. Pour the tomato soup over all and top with more cheese. Bake uncovered. Serves 12.

title: Ruth'S Potato Salad
instructions: Mix together in order. Chill and serve.

title: Black Olive Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken. Cook turning occasionally until browned about 5 minutes per side. Add tomatoes garlic parsley thyme broth and lemon juice to skillet; stir well. Cover skillet. Place skillet in oven. Bake chicken for 20 minutes basting occasionally with sauce. Add olives to skillet. Bake for 10 minutes longer or until juices run clear when meat is pierced with a knife. Sprinkle cayenne pepper over top just before serving.

title: Pecan Munchies
instructions: Fold pecans in egg white mixture until well coated. Place on slightly greased baking sheet at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn oven off and leave for 30 more minutes.

title: Mondel Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and vanilla until thick and creamy. In a separate bowl mix all dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients with egg mixture. Add oil and mix well. Add nuts. Grease and flour a cookie sheet. Shape bread into two loaves and bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 35-40 minutes. Slice diagonally and put back into the oven to toast for 5-10 minutes.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Put in crock pot. Pour barbecue sauce over chicken and cook in crock-pot overnight on low.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate until time to serve.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Soak ground vegetables overnight or at least for 4 hours. Mix with 1/2 cup plain salt; drain well. Combine and bring to boil the spices water sugar and vinegar. Simmer for 5 minutes. Put into jars and seal.

title: Fruit Topped Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs mix until blended; pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set; cool. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Top with fruit. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Sausage Soup Micaele
instructions: In a large kettle or dutch oven saute carrots and celery in 1/4 c. (1/2 stick) butter until vegetables are softened. Add leeks and cabbage and saute 3 minutes. Stir in chicken stock bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix together until well blended. Stir in 10 ounces 7-Up. Mix and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Turkey Quiche
instructions: Press leftover stuffing into a 9-inch pie plate forming a crust. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Venison Tenderloins
instructions: Whip eggs and milk together. Dip tenderloin in mixture and coat with corn flake crumbs. Season with salt and pepper. Put in pan and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. When the top and sides are nicely browned turn over. Serves 4 people.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add taco seasoning and water. Simmer 5 minutes. Place in a dish in layers as follows beans cheese hamburger salsa sour cream tomatoes and onions.

title: Peanut Butter Oat Bars
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the butter 1/4 cup peanut butter brown sugar corn syrup and vanilla; gradually add the oats. Press into a 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Cool on wire rack for 5 minutes. Meanwhile for topping melt chips and 1/3 cup peanut butter in microwave for 1 minute. Stir until blended and spread over warm bars. Cool completely and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours before cutting.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Pour over loaf. Baste with sauce while cooking. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 2 hours.

title: Pinto Beans
instructions: Soak dried beans overnight. Rinse well. Cover with 2 qts. of water more or less. Add onion vinegar and oil. Simmer 3 hours or longer. Add carrots and potatoes. Simmer until all is cooked then add salt & pepper to taste. 20 minutes before serving gently slip in eggs to poach. (1 egg per person.)

title: Spinach Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased 9x13 pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes till golden brown. Serves 12.

title: Chocolate Puffs(A Macaroon-Type Cookie)
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar gradually and continue beating until blended. Add salt and vanilla. Fold in melted chocolate coconut and nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake in slow oven (300\u00b0) for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Cover cucumbers onions and salt with cold water and ice cubes. Let sit about 3 hours. Do not use metal container. Mix sugar vinegar turmeric and celery seed and simmer 30 minutes. Pour cold water off cucumbers and pack in jars; cover with hot liquid. Process 10 minutes in hot water bath.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: In a large bowl soak the bread crumbs in cream and milk; mix meat. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls. In a large skillet brown and cook meatballs in oil. Combine beef consomme (1 can) and heavy cream to make sauce.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Parmesan Chicken Wings
instructions: Dip chicken wings in butter then in combined dry ingredients. Put on foil-lined cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 to 50 minutes. Yum!

title: Thistle Dip
instructions: Puree undrained artichoke hearts in blender or processor until very smooth. Transfer to bowl and blend in sour cream garlic onion salt and red pepper. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Sprinkle with paprika and serve with crackers.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Saute first four ingredients in oil. Remove from the saute pan. Then brown the ground beef with 1 teaspoon salt and pepper. Drain off any fat. Combine cornstarch with water. Mix with soy sauce. Add to meat and vegetables. Cook and stir until thickened. Move mixture to the side of the pan. Add boiling water and instant rice; add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and remove from heat; let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork; then serve.

title: Yellow Squash Muffins
instructions: Wash squash thoroughly; trim off ends. Cut squash into one-inch slices. Cook in small amount of boiling water for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Drain well and mash. Measure enough of the squash to equal two eggs and butter. Stir well and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl; make a well in center of mixture. Add squash mixture to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Spoon into greased muffin pans filling three-fourths full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Baked Potatoes
instructions: Prick potatoes with fork and wrap in foil. Fill the crock pot with potatoes. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or high 2 1/2 to 4 hours. Do not add water. No oven to heat up and they stay hot.

title: Texas Style Spanish Rice
instructions: In a skillet saute onion and green pepper in oil for about 2 minutes. Add rice and stir until coated with oil. Add tomatoes turmeric cumin salt garlic powder and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Add cilantro if desired. Yield 6 servings.

title: German Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cake mix according to directions substituting milk for water. Sprinkle coconut and pecans in pan. Pour cake mix over coconut and pecans. Melt cream cheese and margarine together. Add sugar and vanilla. Mix well (until easy to pour). Pour over cake mix. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sunspot Banana Gems
instructions: Cream sugars and margarine. Beat in egg bananas oil and yogurt. Grate vegetable. Stir in dry ingredients until all is moistened. Add grated vegetable raisins and nuts (optional).

title: One-Pan Tomato Basil Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet prepare Rice-A-Roni mix as package directs except simmer 10 minutes. Stir in chicken basil broccoli and tomato. Cover and continue to simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Sprinkle with cheese before serving if desired. Serves 4. Ready in 30 minutes.

title: Corned Beef And Cabbage
instructions: Cook corned beef in oven at 300\u00b0 until tender. Or cook in crock-pot overnight. Cut cabbage into thin wedges; cook with beef until done. Season to taste.

title: Jiffy Cobbler
instructions: In a small pan about 8 x 8-inches put 1/2 box Jiffy cake mix in the bottom. Pour pie filling over the bottom layer. Over this layer put the rest of the cake mix. Place butter on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. For a crunchy crust mix cake with butter and add 1/4 cup pecans or walnuts for flavor.

title: Alabama Biscuits
instructions: Put sugar milk salt and shortening in saucepan. Stir over low heat until shortening melts. Remove and stir until lukewarm. Sprinkle in yeast and dissolve. Add flour and baking powder. Stir until smooth (about 30 strokes). Let stand.

title: Firecracker Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in large skillet until meat is brown and onion is tender; discard pan drippings. Add chili powder cumin and salt; stir well. Cook meat mixture over low heat for 10 minutes. Spoon meat mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Layer beans tortillas and cheeses over meat mixture. Chop tomatoes and spread tomatoes and chiles over cheeses. Pour soup over tomatoes. Cover baking pan and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Four Layer Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour over chilled mixture. Put remainder of Cool Whip on top of pudding topping and sprinkle with chopped pecans.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients except corn in blender. Stir in corn. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain grease. Add onion and cook until tender. Add tomato paste. Let simmer for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Boil macaroni until tender. Combine both ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix fruit with sugar. Let stand 30 minutes. Melt butter. Make batter with remaining ingredients. Pour batter over butter then pour fruit and juices over batter. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until brown.

title: Copper Dollar Salad
instructions: Cover the carrots with water and cook 7 minutes ONLY! Drain. While the carrots are cooking mix other ingredients together. Pour this over the drained carrots tossing real good. Put in refrigerator and this is good for 4 weeks. The longer it is in the fridge the better it tastes.

title: Rio Grande Pork Roast
instructions: Rub surfaces of roast with garlic pepper. Place roast in a shallow pan and place in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven; roast for 30 minutes. To make basting sauce combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl; stir to mix well. Pour basting sauce over roast and continue to roast basting occasionally until meat thermometer inserted registers 155\u00b0 about 20 to 30 more minutes. Remove roast from pan and let rest 10 minutes before slicing to serve. Remove pan drippings to a small saucepan; add enough water to make one cup and bring to a boil. Boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve sauce on side with roast. Serves four to six well with leftovers.

title: Easy Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain if necessary. Add all other ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed except omit 1/4 cup of water and add 1/2 cup Eagle Brand milk to mix. Pour 1/2 the batter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Take out of oven and have ready the caramel mixture. Melt caramels in 1/2 can Eagle Brand milk. Pour over first 1/2 of cake in pan sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over the caramel mixture. Add remaining batter. Bake until done. You may ice cake with chocolate icing. This is a very rich cake.

title: Raspberry Buttermilk Muffins
instructions: Combine flour salt baking powder and sugar. Cut in butter until mixture resembles crumbs. Add egg and buttermilk. Mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in berries. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Crumble cornbread. Add all the other ingredients. Mix well and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until browned.

title: Pork Chop Mein
instructions: Saute onions and celery in oil for 5 minutes. Add pork broth soy sauce and molasses. Simmer for 15 minutes. Add bean sprouts. Stir in cornstarch blended with a little broth. Cook until thickened. Serve on chow mein noodles or rice.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes; drain. Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Have ready onion cheese and jalapenos. Mix first 7 ingredients and set aside.

title: No Bake Fudgies
instructions: In medium saucepan combine sugar cocoa margarine milk and salt. Bring to boil and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter vanilla and oats. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
instructions: Cream together the first 3 ingredients. Add flour corn meal and vanilla. Mix well. Add pineapple and coconut. Bake in pie shells until done at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients cutting bacon into smaller pieces. Pour into a baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: In a dishpan combine ingredients in the order listed adding one at a time. Mix thoroughly between each addition. Using a small ice cream scoop or tablespoon place mound of dough on greased cookie sheet. Flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool before removing from sheet. This is great for parties because it serves 80.

title: Grandma Foland'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all together and chill. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 9 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a loaf pan with cooking spray. In large bowl beat oil and 1/3 cup sugar. Add banana and chopped walnuts mixing well. In another bowl beat egg whites until foamy. Slowly add 1/3 cup sugar beating until whites form peaks. Fold whites into batter. Pour into loaf pan. Bake 55 minutes.

title: Hoppin' John
instructions: Combine water and black-eyed peas in large saucepan. Cook until almost tender about one hour. Add more water if needed. Heat Crisco shortening or Crisco oil in medium skillet on medium heat. Add green pepper onion garlic cumin and thyme. Cook and stir until browned. Add tomato paste and chili powder. Stir. Add a little water. Stir. Pour into beans. Add rice bacon salt and pepper. Stir. Add enough water to cover by 1 1/2-inches. Cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Contains 740 calories fat 15 g (131 cal or 18% of total calories) sat fat 3 g (<5% of total calories) carb 129 g protein 26 g chol 5 mg and sodium 365 mg.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Press into 9x13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine and put in casserole.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Combine buttermilk baking mix milk and cheese with a wooden spoon until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Drop dough by heaping tablespoons onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Beef Oriental
instructions: Brown onions and celery in butter. Add rice and beef and brown. Combine next 6 ingredients in 2-quart casserole dish. Add mixture which has been browned. Stir in bean sprouts lightly. Bake covered for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes. Serve with noodles with soy sauce.

title: Mother Hershey'S Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Heat 5 cups milk to scalding. Combine separately the cornstarch cocoa sugar and salt. Stir in the 1/2 cup milk until smooth. Gradually stir the mixture into the hot milk and stir until smooth and thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Serve warm or cold. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pork Chop Borracho
instructions: In a large frypan fry pork chops seasoned with salt pepper thyme and onion salt. Stir in water with flour. Let simmer for about 10 minutes. Add beer brown sugar and raisins. Let simmer for half hour or until meat is tender. Add pears on top of meat and add a bit of juice; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with small dumplings or noodles. Yields 4 servings.

title: Caramel Layer Chocolate Bars
instructions: Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine 1/3 cup evaporated milk and caramels (50) in top of double boiler. Cook over hot water stirring often until caramels melt and mixture is smooth.\tSet aside.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown beef in oil; add garlic and cook until yellow. Add soy sauce salt and 1/4 cup water. Cook for 45 minutes. Add vegetables and cook ten minutes longer. Mix cornstarch in 1 cup cold water and add to beef mixture. Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 more minutes. Serve over hot fluffy rice.

title: Christmas Caramels
instructions: Combine sugar salt corn syrup and 1/3 of the cream. Place in saucepan and stir over moderate heat until the sugar dissolves. Reduce the heat and continue cooking without stirring until a candy thermometer reaches 236\u00b0. While the syrup is cooking heat remaining cream over hot water in a double boiler. When the syrup reaches 236\u00b0 slowly add half of the remaining cream and let it reach 236\u00b0 again. Add remaining warm cream and cook stirring until the temperature reaches 242\u00b0 to 244\u00b0.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Mix well and store in jar.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
instructions: Roll pastry very thin to fit an 8-inch plate. Set aside. Mix apples apple juice concentrate cornstarch and spice and stir until apples are well coated.\tAdd lemon juice if desired to\tkeep apples lighter colored.\tPour into the pastry lined pie pan and top with the second crust or pastry strips. Seal the edges and\tcut slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Makes 8 servings.\tOne serving (including the crust) equals 220 calories 1 1/2 fruit exchanges 1 bread exchange 2 fat exchanges.

title: Perfect Pot Roast
instructions: In 6-quart Dutch oven in hot oil cook roast until browned on all sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in mushroom soup onion soup mix and 1 cup of the water. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 2 hours or until meat is tender turning occasionally. Add vegetables. Cover. Cook 40 minutes or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender. Remove roast and vegetables to platter. Over medium heat cook sauce until slightly thickened. In cup stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth. Gradually stir into Dutch oven. Cook until mixture boils and thickens stirring constantly. Serve with roast.

title: Stay Up All Night Coffee Cake
instructions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Sprinkle nuts in bottom. Arrange frozen rolls on top of nuts. (Keep rolls frozen.) Sprinkle dry pudding mix over rolls.

title: Peanut Butter Roll Candy
instructions: Mix powdered sugar with just enough milk until dough consistency. Roll out on board coated with powdered sugar. Spread with peanut butter. Roll into a log. Slice into 1/4-inch pieces.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugars salt syrup and peanuts in bowl. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir; microwave on High for 4 minutes. Add vanilla and oleo; stir. Microwave on High for 1 minute. Add soda; stir. Pour into buttered pan. Let cool and break into pieces. Be sure to use glass bowl when making candy.

title: Squash Casserole(Yellow Summer Squash)
