instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a buttered casserole dish. Top with reserved crumbs and bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Combine ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Pumpkin Torte
instructions: Mix the graham cracker crumbs melted butter and 1/2 cup of the sugar. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt and cinnamon before adding other ingredients. Grease cookie sheet and cover with wax paper. Pour mixture in pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. While hot roll and place in freezer for 15 minutes. After cooling down remove wax paper. Spread on filling and roll again.

title: Angel Cherry Lemon Dessert(Great Summertime Dessert.)
instructions: Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with angel food slices 3/4-inch thick. Pour the 2 cans cherry or blueberry filling over the sliced angel food cake. Mix lemon pudding and milk until thick. Fold in sour cream; pour this over the pie filling spreading it out so it is covered. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Mexican Goup
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. In large pot add beef chili beans tomato juice rice onion chili mix salt and pepper together and mix well. If too thin add rice (up to 1/2 cup) to thicken. Stir often until rice is tender and mixture boils. On your serving plate place a small bed of lettuce. On top of that place some Frito chips and your goup. Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.

title: Swedish Almond Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and shortening until fluffy. Add 1 cup powdered sugar; mix well. Combine flour and salt and stir into shortening mixture. Add water vanilla flavoring and nuts. Chill dough about 1 hour then roll into small balls and flatten. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 12 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Mix salt vinegar and sugar. Heat until boiling. Pour over green tomatoes onions bell peppers and hot peppers. Let set for awhile. Put in a large pot and bring to a boil just long enough for them to change colors. Then seal in hot jars.

title: Choc-Full Of Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs water and vanilla; beat well. Add combined oats flour cocoa baking soda and salt; mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and chopped milk chocolate. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until cookies are set. Do not overbake. Cool for 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack and cool completely. Store in an airtight container. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Cheesecake Cupcakes
instructions: Beat together all ingredients until light and fluffy. Fill lined cupcake pans 3/4 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Top with about 1 teaspoon of any pie filling and return to oven for 10 minutes. Cool and keep refrigerated.

title: Tangy Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; set aside to cool. Soften the cottage cheese with salad dressing. Add pineapple coconut nuts and banana. When gelatin begins to thicken add the cheese mixture then fold in the whipped cream. Pour into mold and chill until firm.

title: Elegant Dessert
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan as crust. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let cool. Beat the cream cheese powdered sugar and small Cool Whip and spread on crust. Prepare the pudding as directed on box. Spread on cream cheese mixture. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Spread the large Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle top with chopped pecans.

title: Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Brown hamburger lightly in skillet. Add onions salt and pepper. Blend soup and milk until smooth. In casserole dish put layer of noodles and cheese. Sprinkle parsley and meat mixture. Repeat layers. Pour soup mixture over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove and top with chow mein noodles and almonds. Brown 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Magnum Chili
instructions: Mix together and simmer for a few hours.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain all the canned vegetables well. Add the celery onion and green pepper. Heat the oil sugar and vinegar to a boil. Cool it and then pour over the vegetables. Refrigerate overnight or longer. This will keep a long time in the refrigerator.

title: Frosting For Banana-Nut Cake
instructions: Cook milk and flour stirring until thick. Cool. Cream Crisco butter powdered sugar and vanilla with mixer at high speed until light and creamy. Add cooled flour mixture and beat fast 5 minutes longer. This frosting is not too sweet and tastes like whipped cream.

title: Pralines
instructions: In a large boiler combine sugar milk salt and water. Boil to soft ball stage; add nuts and butter. Boil to firm ball stage. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Stir until it no longer is glossy on top. Spoon out on wax paper.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
instructions: In large Dutch oven saute onion and celery in butter over medium heat. Add water potatoes carrots and spices; cover. Reduce heat when mixture comes to boil and continue cooking over lower heat until hard vegetables become soft enough to eat with spoon about 20 minutes. Mash mixture with potato masher until lumpy. Add half and half and cheese; blend in. Continue cooking until cheese has completely melted. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Marilyn'S English Pasties
instructions: For dough mix first 3 ingredients. Mix well. Add water and mix as little as necessary and use as little flour as you can when rolling out the dough. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until crust is golden brown. Make a small slit in the top of each pastie. When you remove from oven put a little water oleo mixture into slit (1 teaspoon oleo and 1/2 teaspoon water for each pastie). Let sit for a few minutes.

title: Steak And Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in margarine in 8-inch skillet. Remove from skillet with slotted spoon and set aside. Sprinkle steaks with salt pepper and thyme leaves and fry them in the margarine remaining from onions add more margarine if needed. When steaks are done as desired remove from skillet and set aside. Return onions to skillet and add mushrooms saute mushrooms. Add half and half to skillet with mushrooms and onions. Heat sauce to boiling stirring frequently. Serve steaks covered with mushroom sauce along with Twice Baked Potatoes and Radishes and Peapods.

title: Sherried Chicken Breasts
instructions: Arrange chicken breasts in greased large baking dish (9 x 14-inch). Put cheese slices over chicken. Mix soup and sherry. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle herb seasoning over top. Cover with melted margarine. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 or until chicken is done.

title: Chicken Wings With Onion Soup And Corn Syrup
instructions: Wash wings very well. Put in frying pan not fat. Pour water over dry onion soup. Mix well. Pour over wings. Add corn syrup. Fry. Use low heat and fry about 1 hour. Add more water if necessary. Cover at all times.

title: Broccoli Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and let set in fridge. over night. When ready to serve cut center out of Hawaiian Bread. Put dip mixture in center of bread. Slice bread from center and slice bread around dip.

title: Mary'S Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Use 3/4 of crabmeat with cream cheese; blend well and make ball (with hands). Mix 1/4 crabmeat left with sauce and pour on top. Garnish with parsley.

title: Peachy Cornbread(Spoon Bread?)
instructions: Grease a 2-quart casserole dish. Put sour cream in a large bowl. Beat in egg and stir in butter or margarine. Add cornbread mix and peaches. Mix lightly just until blended. Turn into casserole dish. Put casserole in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 and reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake 65 to 70 minutes until golden brown and puffed. Serve hot from dish with large spoon. Eat with fork.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugars eggs and vanilla thoroughly. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add dry ingredients gradually to creamed mixture mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup M&Ms candies; reserve remaining candies for decorating. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet. Decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&Ms candies. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. After baking some of the candies may be slightly cracked. This adds texture and interest to your cookies still the same delightful flavor. Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Peanut Butter Play Dough
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a large bowl and mix well. Knead the dough until holds together in a ball. (If the dough is too sticky add a little more powdered milk. Knead again.) Make into fun thing or roll out and cut with cookie cutter then eat it.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together then add remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly using electric mixer and pour in 2 pie shells. Bake for 50 minutes at 325\u00b0. Keep a close watch on pies.

title: Aunt Sammies' Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together. Add syrup salt vanilla pecans and butter; pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake until filling is set. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 320\u00b0. Put the pecan halves on top of pie.

title: Corny Corn Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan (ok to use Pam). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cut in 9 squares. Enjoy while hot.

title: Aunt Zena'S Three P Salad
instructions: Combine at last minute before serving.

title: Basic White Bread
instructions: Combine milk sugar salt and butter in small saucepan. Heat over low heat until butter melts and sugar dissolves; cool to lukewarm.

title: Pina Colada Cream Salad
instructions: In a 2-quart pan boil water; remove from heat. Add jellos; stir until dissolved. Add juice and rum extract. Chill until thickened but not set.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large heavy pot. Bring to a boil. Simmer on low heat until the liquid comes together in a smooth sauce probably about 1 hour. Put in jars and seal. Try some on beans peas meats. Very good!

title: Cheesy Broccoli Tuna Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook noodles in water for 20 minutes. Blend soup and milk into smooth sauce. Add onions and mushrooms; drain noodles. Layer 1 1/2 cups noodles 1/3 cup tuna and 1 cup broccoli in a 2-quart casserole. Pour in 1 cup sauce and repeat layers. Bake 20 minutes. Add cheese and bake 15 more minutes.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Grind peppers. Add all ingredients except Certo. Boil 10 minutes. Remove from fire. Add Certo. Fill sterile jars and seal. Serve over block of Philadelphia cream cheese. Dip with crackers.

title: Oven Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into 4 portions. Mix flour and salt. Pound into meat. Set aside remaining flour. Brown meat in small amount hot shortening. Place meat in shallow baking dish. Blend remaining flour with drippings in skillet. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Cook stirring constantly until mixture boils. Pour over meat. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 2 hours or until tender. Top with cheese. Return to oven for a few minutes. Serves 4.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and margarine in microwave. Spread on top of mixture; refrigerate or place in freezer for 30 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Orange Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Grate 1 1/2 teaspoons of the colored zest from the orange and squeeze 2 tablespoons juice. Combine the flour soda and salt. Beat butter sugars and orange zest until fluffy. Beat in egg yolk vanilla and orange juice. Beat in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chips with a spoon. Drop by teaspoonfuls about 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake until edges start to brown. Let stand on baking sheets for 1 minute and remove to wire racks.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Shape into walnut size balls and place on a cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Diet Cheesecake
instructions: Make jello as directed. Blend with cottage cheese until smooth in blender. Mix altogether and let set like regular jello.

title: Luscious Flan
instructions: Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar into heavy saucepan. Place over medium heat cooking stirring constantly until sugar melts and syrup is light golden brown. Pour syrup into 6-oz. custard cups. Let cool. Combine milks in medium saucepan and heat until bubble from around edges of pan. Combine egg substitute 1/4 cup sugar and almond extract. Beat well. Gradually stir about 1 cup hot milk into egg mixture. Add remaining milk stirring constantly. Pour mixture evenly into custard cups. Cover with aluminum foil. Place custard cups in shallow pan and pour hot water to depth of 1 inch into pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Remove cups from water and chill at least 4 hours. To serve loosen edges of custard with spatula invert onto plates. Arrange assorted fresh fruits around the sides. Yield 6 servings (154 calories per serving with 1/3 cup fruit).

title: Pecan Bits
instructions: Blend altogether at low speed. Press into small muffin tins.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Boil whole chicken until the meat falls off the bones. Remove skin and bones. Keep meat in broth over medium heat. Saute onion celery bell pepper and green onions in butter. Add this to the chicken. Cut up the smoked sausage into bite-size pieces and add to the pot. Add the eggs (whole). Add desired spices. Allow pot to simmer.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

title: Quick Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Combine flour milk and 1 cup sugar. Pour over butter. (Cook or let come to a boil the peaches and sugar.) Pour over batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown. Do not stir as you pour in pan. (If peaches are not juicy enough add some water. Dont have cobbler too dry.)

title: Double Butterscotch Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter or lard and dry pudding until fluffy. Beat in brown sugar eggs and vinegar. Stir in flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Fold in pecans and butterscotch morsels. Drop by teaspoonfuls about walnut size and flatten out a little with wet fork on greased baking sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms in margarine. Add broth and heat to boiling. Add noodles salt and pepper. Heat for 3 minutes. Add frozen broccoli and cook for about 5 minutes. Add cubed cheese and cook until melted. Add milk after pan has been removed from heat.

title: Four Cheese Macaroni
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes until tender. Drain and return to pot. Add milk cheeses and white pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly about 5 minutes or until the cheeses are melted.

title: Tomato Soup For Company
instructions: Add together simmer. Serve with plain croutons.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix well. Chill thoroughly. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spread cookie dough on a pizza pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Mix milk and lemon juice until thickened. Mix in cream cheese until well blended. Spread on cooled cookie dough. Place fruit on as desired strawberries kiwi fruit bananas grapes peaches etc.

title: Apple Cheese Casserole
instructions: Arrange apple slices in dish. Combine other ingredients and pour over apples. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chew Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom Meat Balls
instructions: Mix soup with water. Add 1/4 cup soup/water to ground beef. Add egg bread crumbs onion parsley flakes salt and pepper. Mix well. Shape into small balls. Brown in 1 tablespoon canola oil then pour remaining soup/water over meat balls and simmer 25 minutes.

title: Strawberry Salad Deluxe
instructions: To gelatin add 2 cups boiling water then all the remaining ingredients except for sour cream. Place half the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan and chill for 1 hour. Spread sour cream over mixture; add remaining gelatin fruit and nut mixture. Chill until firm. Serves 12.

title: Pork Chops And Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in skillet; add onions and chops. Brown lightly on both sides. Put sliced potatoes in buttered 2-quart baking dish. Arrange chops over potatoes. Add soup and milk to onions in skillet. Blend until smooth. Pour over chops. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and continue baking for 30 to 40 minutes until potatoes are done.

title: Almond Slices
instructions: Mix to a froth eggs oil vanilla and sugar. Add to the mixture of flour baking powder and salt. Let stand about 10 minutes. Shape into 2 long narrow rolls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes on a greased cookie sheet. Let cool slightly then cut into 3/4-inch slices and put under broiler to brown on each side.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and bananas. Mix thoroughly. Add sifted dry ingredients mixing well. Add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stoney'S Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all together until smooth and creamy. Grease and flour large tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 minutes. Test with broomstraw until broomstraw comes out clean.

title: Fran'S Ham Loaf
instructions: Dissolve over heat; pour over loaf. Baste twice during last hour of cooking. Serves 10.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook chicken in seasoned water in a large pot. Remove chicken. Boil noodles 8 to 10 minutes. Cube meat. Mix chicken noodles and peas. Make smooth mixture of mayo and dressing. Mix in. Stir all of Parmesan cheese and add olives. (You need large mixing bowl. Keeps ten days in refrigerator.)

title: Fireside Coffee Mix
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. In a cup of boiling water measure out the amount of mixture to suit your taste.

title: Tea Muffins (Low Calorie)
instructions: Sift flour salt baking powder cinnamon together. Add flakes. Beat egg and add water and Sweet & Low and salad oil. Stir in dry ingredients mix well as possible. Add raisins. Line muffin pans with paper liners. Divide batter evenly in muffin pans for 12. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch dish. Slice carrots potatoes and onions. Put in dish. Salt and pepper. Place pork chops on top. Season with salt and pepper. Pour soup over mixture. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tindall Goulash
instructions: Brown hamburger. Cook macaroni. Grease casserole with butter. Layer 1/2 macaroni Velveeta hamburger corn tomatoes other 1/2 of macaroni and top with Velveeta. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf(With Egg And English Pea Sauce)
instructions: Drain salmon and reserve liquid then break fish into small pieces. Mix with all other ingredients until well blended. Shape into a loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Slice and serve hot with egg and pea sauce.

title: Sour Cream Dip
instructions: Mix all of this together in a bowl.

title: Hurry Up Biscuits
instructions: Mix together well. Put on floured board. Knead a little and make small balls. Place in greased baking dish. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. A good morning biscuit!

title: Vegetable Beef And Biscuit Casserole
instructions: In 10 or 12-inch skillet cook beef until browned. Spoon off fat. Stir in soups water vegetables and Worcestershire. Spoon into 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 until hot and bubbling (10 to 15 minutes). Cut biscuits into quarters. Remove dish from oven. Stir; arrange biscuits on top of hot mixture and top with cheese. Bake until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine oil vinegar and sugar. Shake well. Slice cucumbers and onion. Sprinkle with salt pepper and dill weed. Let stand for 30 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Log
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 5-inch cookie sheet and line with wax paper. Mix ingredients and pour on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped walnuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out onto towel sprinkled with 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Pull off wax paper. Roll like a cinnamon roll in towel. Cool in fridge. Unroll fill with filling and reroll.

title: Clam Cakes
instructions: Sift flour in big bowl. Beat egg and add to flour. Add salt and baking powder. Add strained clams (save clam juice). Add milk to clam juice to equal 1 cup of liquid. Mix liquid in with dry ingredients. Add milk as needed until its a little thicker than pancake batter. Shape into small cakes. Fry in vegetable oil until golden brown.

title: Easy And Delicious Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer jam or preserves onion soup mix and pineapple slices. Pour salad dressing over top. Let set for several hours. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: David'S Taco Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except relish and salad dressing. Mix jalapeno relish and salad dressing until pinkish in color. Pour over salad and toss.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat and onion and drain well. Mix in soups and seasonings. Simmer for about 30 minutes covered. (I use electric skillet.) Cook enough spaghetti or noodles to feed your family. A few minutes before serving stir sour cream into meat sauce and heat through; do not boil. Serve sauce over pasta.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
instructions: Mix eagle brand milk and kool-aid together then add cool whip and mix together until blended. Pour over into crust. Refrigerate.

title: Family Reunion Baked Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight in twice their volume of water. Rinse beans and cook in Dutch oven until just soft (about 30 minutes). If your water is hard add 2 Tbsp. soda during cooking. Put all other ingredients in crockpot stir and cook on low setting for 30 minutes. Add cooked beans and cook at low temperature until beans are dark brown 6 to 8 hours.

title: Orange-Coconut Apple Crisp(Microwave)
instructions: Arrange apples in an 8-inch square glass baking dish. Sprinkle with orange juice. Combine brown sugar flour and orange rind in bowl. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly using pastry blender. Add coconut and toss to mix. Sprinkle brown sugar mixture over apples.

title: Chicken And Cheese Enchilada
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In center of each tortilla place 1/4 cup chicken 2 tablespoons cheese and 1 tablespoon salsa; roll up. Arrange seam side down in 8-inch square baking dish. Top with remaining salsa and cheese. Bake 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix together the shortening sugar egg and vanilla. Stir in sifted dry ingredients and add nuts and chips. Drop by teaspoons 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Homemade Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain well. In large saucepan boil water; add cabbage. Cook until half done. Add rest of ingredients; simmer 30 minutes. Add more water if needed. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Hawaiian Haystack
instructions: Melt butter in microwave. Add flour stir in milk. Cook on High for about 8 minutes or until thick and glossy stirring every 3 minutes.

title: Tuna Pot Pie
instructions: In skillet melt margarine. Add chopped onion. Stir occasionally for 3 minutes. Add thawed peas and carrots tuna and beans. Cook for 1 minute. Stir in soup mix blended with milk. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to low and simmer uncovered 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted. Pour into 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Twist corn twists to form lattice design over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until corn twists are done.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: First cream the butter and sugar together. Add vanilla. Add flour and salt and mix well. Stir in potato chips and pecans. Drop from spoon onto an ungreased cookie sheet. With spoon dipped in water flatten each cookie. Bake 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix flour butter 1/3 cup corn syrup the granulated sugar and salt in large bowl. Spread evenly in pan. Blend cream cheese until smooth. Beat in eggs until well blended. Beat in 1 cup corn syrup and the vanilla until smooth. Pour over dough. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until edges are light brown and filling is set. Spread with jam. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Cut into 2-inch bars. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Shred cabbage chop onions and set aside. Remove seasoning package and save. Saute noodles in small amount of butter. Toast sunflower seeds and almonds until lightly browned. Add cooled noodles sunflower seeds and almonds to cabbage toss to mix. Combine oil vinegar sugar salt pepper and seasoning in small bowl. Mix well with whisk. Pour over cabbage. Chill.

title: Beef With Sour Cream
instructions: Remove bone and fat from steak. Cut meat into thin narrow strips. Dredge in flour; using large skillet quickly brown meat on all sides in hot oil. Add onions broth thyme mushrooms liquid from mushrooms and peas. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through; do not boil. Serve over hot rice.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Stir all the ingredients together. Let set in fridge for 24 hours. Cook at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Will keep in fridge for 5 to 6 weeks.

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare your favorite pastry. Stir together sugar flour nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Mix with apples. Turn into ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Dot with butter. Unfold pie crust over fruit; fold edges under just inside edge of pan. Bake 1 hour or until juice begins to bubble through slits in crust.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions. Combine dessert topping mix with milk and vanilla. Beat until stiff. Add cream cheese and beat until thoroughly mixed. Add pineapple. Frost cake with this mixture. Refrigerate until served.

title: Chocolate Cashew Butter
instructions: Blend or grind nuts until fine in blender or food processor. Add half of the butter. Cover and blend about 3 minutes more or until mixture is spreadable. Scrape down sides as necessary. Transfer mixture to a small mixing bowl. In small saucepan melt remaining butter and chocolate over low heat stirring constantly until melted. Dissolve coffee in the water. Stir chocolate and coffee into nut mixture. Makes 1 cup.

title: Hungarian Coffee Cake Pull Apart Rolls
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup brown sugar 3 tablespoons cream and 3/4 stick margarine. Bring to boil and pour in ungreased Bundt pan or angel food cake pan. Sprinkle in it 1 cup pecans or less. Melt 1/2 stick margarine and with tongs or fingers dip frozen balls in margarine. Then roll in mixture of 1/2 cup white sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon. Place in pan stacking haphazardly. Cover with cloth. Set in cold oven and by morning they should be ready to bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Snowball Treats
instructions: Thoroughly mix the first 3 ingredients together. Add corn flakes. Shape into small balls. Roll in powdered sugar and coconut. Chill or serve immediately.

title: Cream Curry Vegetable Crisp
instructions: One and one-half cups or one can of corn one cup cracker crumbs salt and pepper to taste three eggs beaten separately and cream to make soft. Bake in buttered pan.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: In a 1 1/2 qt. casserole dish combine ingredients. Brush chicken with bitter and salt & pepper. Place chicken on top of rice. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Rich And Meaty Chili
instructions: In frying pan brown ground beef; drain. Put drained beef and remaining ingredients into a 6-quart pot. Cover the pot. Let simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Stir every 15 minutes. Serves 16.

title: No Bake Pumpkin Cream Pie
instructions: Combine pie filling mix sugar spice milk egg and pumpkin in a saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full bubbling boil. Remove from heat and cool 5 minutes. Stir twice. Pour into pie shell and chill 4 hours in refrigerator. Garnish with whipped cream and nuts.

title: Mushroom Baked Chicken
instructions: Shake pieces of chicken in flour mixture until coated. Brown in frying pan with shortening or oil so it doesnt burn. Place pieces when browned in a roaster.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cut up cranberry sauce; fold in whipped cream mayonnaise and other ingredients. Freeze. Cut in squares to serve.

title: Settlers Beans
instructions: Brown bacon beef and onion; drain. Drain beans and add to meat mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy Beef Burgundy
instructions: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes. Use heavy casserole or Dutch oven. Add all ingredients except mushrooms. Stir slightly to mix. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours. Add mushrooms about an hour before serving. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Garlic Lovers Pasta And Chickpeas
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Set aside. Cook macaroni according to directions. While macaroni is cooking heat the olive oil and margarine in a small saucepan. Add cayenne pepper and stir until blended. Add minced garlic and saute on low heat until garlic is soft. Then add chickpeas and coat well. Keep warm.

title: Hill Of Beans Salad
instructions: Put bacon in 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes stirring after 2 minutes. With slotted spoon remove bacon and place on towels to drain. Blend sugar and cornstarch with bacon drippings. Stir in salt pepper and vinegar. Microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes until thick. Add drained beans onion and celery slices to sauce in casserole stirring well. Cover. Microwave on High for 6 minutes stirring after 3 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Sprinkle bacon on top. Preheat before serving. Even better the next day. Makes 4 servings.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Remove bones and skin from salmon; drain and flake (reserve liquid. Add slightly beaten eggs. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into a well-greased baking dish or loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until center is solid. Serve hot with Egg Sauce.

title: Key Lime Macadamia Dream Pie
instructions: To make crust combine cookie crumbs finely chopped nuts sugar and melted butter. Press into a lightly greased 9-inch pie plate using the back of a spoon. Chill.

title: Orange Coconut Balls
instructions: Crush wafers and add all ingredients. Stir until moist. Form in 1-inch balls and roll in powdered sugar. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Fruit Cocktail
instructions: Cut enough fruit to fill large Tupperware cake taker 8 to 10 quarts. Use medium or heavy syrup. This will make about 18 pints. Add 1 maraschino cherry cut in half to each pint. Process 15 minutes in pressure cooker at 5 pounds or for the fruit that takes the longest in your fruit cocktail. Use sterilized jars and raw pack.

title: Cowboy Burger
instructions: Butter insides of split buns; place butter side down in hot frying pan to brown. Heat chili in small saucepan. Shape meat into round patty 1/2 inch thick and place next to bun in middle of hot pan turning only once when the red juices seep to the top. Place bun halves on a warm platter browned sides up. When other side of patty has been seared slip meat onto the bun and cover with the hot chili beans. Sprinkle with grated cheese and top off with raw onions.

title: Hamburger Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef in kettle drain. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 1 hour.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Melt the margarine in a deep saucepan. Add onion; cook slowly until golden brown. Add clams in liquid. Skim if necessary. Add potatoes salt and black pepper to taste. Cook until potatoes are tender. Remove the mixture from heat and slowly add milk and cream which have been heated. Serve immediately. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Toasted Coconut Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients well. Add wet ingredients all at once. Mix well. Pour into 9 x 5-inch greased loaf tin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tested done. As an alternative pour into muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 1 loaf or 12 muffins.

title: Chocolate Easter Eggs
instructions: Boil potato until tender. Remove from water. Let stand to cool. Mash and add sugar until firm. May add nuts cherries or dried fruits. Roll into shape. Cover with melted chocolate. Makes 6 servings.

title: Percolator Punch
instructions: Mix pineapple juice cranberry juice water and brown sugar in a large 30 cup coffee pot.

title: Marinated Broccoli
instructions: Place all in a zip lock bag and marinate for 24 hours chilled. Enjoy.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar and melt again. Add cream and allow to boil one minute. Remove from heat beat in powdered sugar and add vanilla.

title: Red Crab Soup
instructions: Place water in large stockpot. Bring to a boil. Add first 5 ingredients. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Add potatoes. Cook 20 to 30 minutes more. Add tomatoes paste and water (2 cups). Simmer 10 minutes. Drain peas and add with crab meat. Simmer 10 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook 10 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted water. Drain and mash the potatoes. Add the butter or oleo and the milk (like you make mashed potatoes or use leftovers). Add all other ingredients. Mix in enough salad dressing or mayonnaise to make it moist. Add more salt if needed.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Mix beef onion 1 cup water and garlic. Cook on 100% power in a 3-quart microwave dish for 5 minutes. Stir once. Cook covered on 50% power (Medium) for 20 to 24 minutes or until beef is tender; stir once. Skim off the fat grease. Stir in rest of water tomatoes paprika chili powder seasoned salt and soy sauce. Cook covered on High for about 4 minutes or until heated through. Mix sour cream and flour; slowly stir in 1 cup of the hot mixture. Mix all. Put in casserole. Cook uncovered on High for about 6 minutes.

title: Oven Meatball Stew
instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients; shape into meatballs. Brown in hot oil. Place in casserole dish. Add 1 tablespoon flour to oil and add tomato juice. Pour over meatballs; place diced vegetables on top. Salt to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix flour sugar and cocoa. Then add water. Cook until all thickens. Serve on bread or biscuits.

title: Hearty Beef Stew
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in vegetable oil; cut steak in cubes and flour with dry seasonings. Brown meat in oil with onion and garlic until all sides of meat brown and flour is saturated. Add can of consomme and Worcestershire sauce; stir as it thickens. Add 1 more can of any liquid. Gravy and meat should simmer at least 1 hour. Add peeled pared and sliced vegetables. Cook 1 to 2 more hours. Add water if too thick. Should be beefy and thick.

title: Chicken Rosemary
instructions: Dip each piece of meat into margarine. Roll in flour salt and pepper. Place in shallow pan that has been greased. Sprinkle lightly with rosemary. Add a small amount of water to cover bottom of the pan; cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Italian Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shake in a covered container and chill.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Place chopped rhubarb in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch ungreased pan. Mix jello and sugar; sprinkle over rhubarb. Now put a layer of marshmallows over this. Mix yellow cake by the directions on box. Pour this over all ingredients in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. This is very easy and very very good!

title: Real Good White Fudge
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in heavy 4-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved and reaches a boil. Boil for 10 to 15 minutes to softball stage (238\u00b0 candy thermometer). Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm about 45 minutes. Add vanilla and beat until begins to lose its gloss and holds its shape. Stir in nuts and cherries. Turn into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Makes 5 pounds.

title: Caramel Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt butter; add coconut and pecans. Cook until golden; set aside and cool. Combine cream cheese and milk; beat well until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer 1/4 mixture in pie crust then 1/4 caramel topping then layer 1/4 coconut pecan and butter mixture. Then repeat. (Makes 2 pies.)

title: String Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine drained beans and cream of mushroom soup; pour into a baking dish. Sprinkle and cover onion rings over bean mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly hot. Serve hot.

title: Magic Marshmallow Crescent Puffs
instructions: Combine sugar and cinnamon. Separate rolls into 16 triangles. Dip marshmallow in melted margarine then roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture. Wrap a triangle around each marshmallow squeezing edges of dough tightly to seal. Dip in margarine and place margarine side down in deep muffin cups. Place on foil or cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan immediately. Top with glaze.

title: Baked Yam And Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Combine cranberries sugar orange slices orange juice and pecans in a 2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Place yams on top and bake another 20 minutes. Try using freshly peeled yams. Place chunk yams in casserole and add in this order cranberries orange juice and slices sugar and salt and bake until done (about 45 minutes to 1 hour) at 375\u00b0.

title: Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: Remove bone from leg of lamb; mix Sauce.

title: Barbecued Hamburger
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Combine celery and onion with beer. Cook until tender. Add ketchup mustard sugar vinegar salt and pepper. Great Sloppy Joes!

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Fill buttered baking dish with sliced apples. Pour over top the batter made with remaining ingredients. Bake in moderate (350\u00b0) oven until brown. Some like to eat this with cinnamon and milk over it.

title: Chocolate Covered Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat mix the sugar and Karo syrup together. Heat until sugar is liquified. Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Mix together. Fold in the Rice Krispies mixing until they are all covered. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Flatten evenly into pan using wax paper.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: In a warm bowl add yeast water sugar salt and Crisco. With your hand mix a small amount of flour to yeast mixture. Add flour until you have a soft dough. Knead in bowl 50 times. Let rise double. Punch down. Put on dough board. Pat out with your hand or roll out and cut. Put melted butter on each biscuit and fold over. Place on a greased pan and bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Chex Mix Snack
instructions: Melt oleo in pan (use oblong roasting pan). Mix all ingredients well; put in oven. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours stirring every 15 minutes. Good holiday snack.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix eggs salt nutmeg sugar and vanilla. Slowly stir in hot milk. Pour at once into pie shell. Add dash of nutmeg on top of custard before baking. Bake in hot oven at 475\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to 425\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes longer or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix and serve in a round of bread or a purple cabbage that is cut out for a bowl.

title: Shrimp And Tortellini
instructions: Boil shrimp in Old Bay seasoning until cooked. Peel shrimp. Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and set aside. Melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat; add minced shallot and basil. Cook about 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add shrimp pasta and cheese. Toss gently. Yields 4 servings.

title: Emma Doherty'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Add eggs and half and half or milk if dough is too dry. Add vanilla. Blend dry ingredients eggs and vanilla together.

title: Heavenly Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until slightly frothy; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into unbaked cream cheese pie shell. Should make 2 pies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with Cool Whip after it has cooled.

title: Stay A Bed Stew
instructions: Place all ingredients in a casserole. Cover tight with foil or a lid. Bake in a 275\u00b0 oven for 5 hours. Yields 6 servings.

title: Fire House Round Steak And Coca-Cola Gravy
instructions: Dice onion and cook in skillet with corn oil until soft. Remove from skillet cut round steak into 1 x 2-inch cubes and brown in skillet. Add onion tomato sauce and Coca-Cola stir. Drop steak in and bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer and cover. Cook about 2 hours or until steak is tender enough to cut with a fork. Remove lid and thicken gravy as desired by cooking openly. This may be served as steak gravy with rice or creamed potatoes.

title: Booger Hollow Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until nice and smooth. Drop by spoonfuls. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Makes 2 dozen biscuits.

title: Chicken And Mushroom Quesadillas
instructions: Cook mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter until tender. Add green onions and chicken and mix well. Butter one side of a tortilla. I place mine butter side down on my George Foreman grill but you can also place the tortilla in a large frying pan. Place half of chicken mixture on tortilla. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese and Season-All. Place another buttered tortilla on top (butter side up). Close grill and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or if pan-frying brown on one side flip (good luck!) and brown the other side. Use remaining tortillas chicken mixture and cheese to cook another quesadilla. Cut quesadillas into wedges with a pizza cutter and serve with sour cream.

title: Cheese Mix
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Serve with crackers or Triscuits.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix and pour in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift and add flour baking soda and baking powder. Add oatmeal chopped nuts and chocolate chips. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet and bake about 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mom'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Soak cubed dry bread in scalded milk 5 to 10 minutes. Add sugar butter salt vanilla and nutmeg. Add slightly beaten eggs. Mix very well. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking pan or glass baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 in pan for 1 hour or at 300\u00b0 in baking dish for 1 hour until firm. Cool and eat warm add added touch if wanted 1/2 cup chopped apples. This is an excellent pudding from generations.

title: Fantastic Fondue
instructions: Mix milk and cream cheese in electric mixer. Heat in saucepan and add garlic salt. Slowly add Parmesan cheese and stir until smooth. Transfer to fondue pot and keep heat on low. Serve with cubed French bread and veggies.

title: Citrus Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender; process until well blended. Pour mixture into a bottle; refrigerate up to 1 month. Yield 1 1/2 cups.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add tomato sauce and seasoning. Add 2 cups of water. In a 13 x 9-inch pan put small amount of sauce on bottom. Layer sauce uncooked noodles cottage cheese and grated cheeses until full (usually 3 full layers). Top with extra sauce and cheese. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 until cheese bubbles. Serves 10.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Dessert
instructions: Cut soft butter into the flour. Add chopped pecans. Press into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let cool.

title: Golden Lamb Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add onion. Add small amount of oil. Mix well. Gradually add small amount of vinegar and oil alternating ending with oil beating well. Use mixer or blender.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in one 9-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter and arrange pineapple in pan. Sift into one bowl flour sugar and shortening. Use slightly over 1/2 of the milk. Beat 2 minutes. Add remaining milk egg and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Turn into prepared pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chili Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken and save broth water. After chicken is done; debone and boil spaghetti noodles in broth water. When spaghetti is done drain and add the remaining ingredients.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix well and bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Caribbean Fudge Pie
instructions: Cream the butter with brown sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add melted chocolate chips coffee powder and rum. Stir in flour and walnuts. Turn into pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with a few walnuts after baking.

title: Sweet And Sour Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients well in a pint jar or container. Refrigerate for a few days before using. The longer kept the thicker and better. May be served on lettuce Waldorf or fruit salad cabbage slaw or shredded carrots and raisins.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Melt margarine soup and cream cheese. Layer 1/2 potatoes into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Layer 1/2 can of mushrooms 1/2 sauce and 1/2 cheese. Layer rest of the potatoes mushrooms and sauce. Place the rest of the cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wyoming Salad
instructions: Make slaw from grated cabbage carrot and onion.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine eggs sugar vanilla and nutmeg. Add melted butter then cream; mix well. Stir in cubed bread and raisins. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Pour into well-greased deep pan 9 x 13. Bake 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown. Pour Butter Vanilla Sauce over pudding.

title: Easy Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients together well. There are 2 ways to use mixture. Bake this way; use 2 loaf pans (9 x 5-inch) greased and floured and bake for 1 1/4 hours. Or use three 1-pound coffee cans greased and floured and bake for 1 1/2 hours. If using coffee cans omit water in your mixture. Also when using coffee cans after cooling use knife around tins to loosen bread. They may be hot when coming out of cans so be careful.

title: Mickie'S Waffles
instructions: Sift cake flour baking powder sugar and salt together. Add milk eggs and butter. Mix well with wire whisk or spoon.

title: Mock Kentucky Fried Chicken
instructions: Wipe chicken dry. Combine dressing flour lemon juice salt and butter into paste and coat chicken evenly. Stack pieces in bowl and cover to marinate. Combine pancake mix with spices. Dip chicken pieces into milk then into pancake mix. Dust off excess. Heat oil and fry until brown. Place in shallow pan and put remaining milk over. Seal with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Baste again with milk during the last 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Dream Cake
instructions: In large bowl mix together cake mix fruit cocktail and eggs; beat well. Bake in greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cake tests done. Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Turn out on wire rack or serving plate to complete cooling. Top with lemon glaze.

title: Yiayia'S Spanakopita(Spinach Pie)
instructions: Brown onion in olive oil. Beat eggs and add to spinach. Break up Feta cheese in crumbled pieces and mix with cottage cheese. Add to spinach. Add browned onions; season with pepper. Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan and place 10 sheets phyllo into pan brushing each with melted butter. Spread spinach mixture on top. Cover with 10 sheets of phyllo buttering each phyllo as you add it. Butter top well and cut into squares about 2 x 3-inches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Large Spiced Pound Cake
instructions: Mix butter and shortening until soft. Blend in nutmeg and vanilla. Stir in sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in flour. Grease and flour the bottom of a tube pan. Only use a 10-inch tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or less at 325 degrees.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Combine beans and seasoning mix. Spread on platter. Layer remaining ingredients in order. Serve with corn/Tostitos chips.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and let stand overnight.

title: Green Slime(A Fast One Dish Salad)
instructions: Mix together in square 9-inch dish. Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve. Could be made the night before.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Chop pepper onion and eggplant into small pieces and brown in 3 tablespoons butter or olive oil. Add tomatoes salt pepper brown sugar Cheddar cheese and bread crumbs. Simmer all of the ingredients until thickened. Pour into greased casserole dish and cover with grated Cheddar cheese and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a heavy saucepan combine peanut butter and butter and warm over low heat stirring until well blended. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar and eggs beating by hand until mixed. Mix baking powder salt and flour and add to the dough. Stir in vanilla. Pat dough onto a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 30 minutes. Place Hershey bars over the hot baked pastry. Let melt and spread evenly. Cool before cutting into squares. Store airtight. Makes 36.

title: Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Cover pie shell with sliced bananas. Pour in chocolate pudding mix. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for at least an hour and serve. Great for diabetics.

title: Coconut Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Combine eggs coconut flour and milk to make batter. Dredge chicken in batter to coat. Fry chicken pieces in oil until golden brown turning often. Drain on paper towel or brown paper bag. Serve with sweet and sour sauce. Can be made ahead and frozen. Reheat at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Puffy Omelet(Makes About 4 Servings)
instructions: Separate yolks from whites and beat yolks with milk salt and pepper until foamy. Fold in stiffly beaten whites.

title: Nanny'S Dumplings
instructions: Boil hen to make good rich broth. Mix ingredients together and work it together until it can be rolled out thin. Cut dough into small pieces (approximately 1 1/2 x 2-inches). Have broth in a rolling boil and drop dumplings in broth one at a time shaking boiler frequently; do not stir. If broth is hot enough dumplings should be done in 4 or 5 minutes. Put deboned chicken pieces in broth before adding dumplings to broth. This will feed family of 6 to 8. Good luck!

title: Peach Topped Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream together 1/4 cup Crisco and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Combine the 1 cup flour brown sugar salt and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Stir in the creamed mixture alternating with the milk. Spread the batter evenly in a greased and floured pan. Arrange peaches on top of batter. Combine the 1/3 cup flour brown sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Cut in Crisco and nuts. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Store in tight container. Use 2 to 3 tablespoons per cup of water. Heat water first if using microwave then add mix.

title: Stuffed Squash
instructions: Hollow out centers of squash and place in baking dish. Combine meat bread crumbs egg salt and pepper in a mixing bowl. Stuff into squash. Mix soup and milk together and pour over stuffed squash. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until tender (usually 45 minutes).

title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
instructions: Mix together brown sugar flour and salt\tfor the coating on pork chops. After you have put this dry mixture on pork chops mix the soy sauce vinegar and water together and pour over\tpork chops that you have placed in a baking dish. Chop bell\tpepper\tand onions; sprinkle\tevenly\tover meat. Cover with foil. Cook for 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Halibut Steaks
instructions: Stir together dressing and mustard. Brush 1/4 cup sauce on both sides of fish; reserve remaining sauce. Arrange fish in an 8-inch square baking dish with thickest portions toward outside of dish. Cover with plastic wrap and vent. Microwave on High 4 to 7 minutes turning dish after 3 minutes. Let stand covered for 2 to 3 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Serve with remaining sauce. Serves 4.

title: Eggplant-Grilled With Fresh Herbs
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients and let stand for 1/2 hour to season oil. Wash eggplant and trim top and bottom. Cut in 1/4-inch slices; do not peel. Arrange on a platter in single layer. Sprinkle both sides with salt and let sit about 30 minutes to remove bitterness. Light the grill. With a cloth or paper towel wipe the grate with oil (corn oil is preferable to olive oil which burns easily). Place eggplant directly on the grate. As the eggplant starts to score (pick up the lines of the grate) brush lightly with the prepared marinade. Flip and brush again. Just before removing from grill top each slice with tomato and cheese. Serve hot as side dish or entree with bread and salad.

title: Baked Pork Chops In Vermouth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place pork chops in 9 x 11-inch pan. Arrange mushrooms and onion around the chops. Sprinkle salt pepper and coffee evenly on the pork chops. Add vermouth until it comes up to the edge of the chops but does not cover. Place in oven and bake for 45 minutes. When chops are done remove from pan and place mushrooms onions and remaining liquid in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and add cornstarch solution. Cook until thickened. Place some of the sauce on a plate with a pork chop on top. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with a Rice Pilaf. Sauteed cinnamon apples also goes great.

title: Garlic Pickles
instructions: Cover cucumbers onions and salt with ice; let soak 3 hours. Pour off water. Mix remaining ingredients. Add cucumbers and onions to vinegar mixture. Bring to a boil. Boil 5 or 10 minutes. Fill hot jars and add 1 clove garlic 1 sprig dill or 1 teaspoon dill seed. Seal jars and let stand for a few days.

title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add eggs mix well. Fold in flour and milk. Add extract. Place batter in a well greased bundt pan. Place in a cold oven. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Grilled Catfish
instructions: Mix olive oil and sesame seed. Brush fillets with mixture. Place on hot grill. Cook 5 or 6 minutes on each side. Add salt pepper and lemon juice to fish before removing from grill.

title: Company Salad
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add ice water drained pineapple (reserve juice) bananas and marshmallows. Pour into a large flat dish. Chill until firm.

title: One Step Lasagna
instructions: Combine water and spaghetti sauce in bowl. Cover bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with 1 1/2 cups sauce. Arrange layer of uncooked noodles slightly overlapping on top of sauce. Spread 1/2 the Ricotta and 1/2 the Mozzarella over noodles. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Add another layer of sauce. Repeat with another layer of noodles the remaining Ricotta and Mozzarella and 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Top with layer of noodles. Pour remaining sauce over spreading evenly to cover edges of noodles. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan. Cover tightly with foil. Set on baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knifes goes easily through pasta. Let stand covered on rack for 10 minutes.

title: Potato And Mozzarella Pie
instructions: Peel cook and mash the potatoes. Season with butter salt and pepper. Butter a deep pie plate. Sprinkle lightly with flour and spread the mashed potatoes on the bottom. Cut cheese into 1/2-inch slices and arrange half the slices on the potatoes. Cut the tomatoes into 1/2-inch slices and arrange all of them on the cheese. Sprinkle with oregano basil salt and pepper. On top arrange rest of Mozzarella and Parmesan and pour over all the melted butter. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Minnesota Loganberries(Better Known As Baked Beans)
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Then add soda. Boil for 10 minutes. Drain and add rest of ingredients and enough water to cover. Pressure cook 15 pounds for 30 minutes or bake 6 to 8 hours. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together the margarine vanilla eggs sugar and vegetable oil. Add flour baking soda salt and cream of tartar.

title: Cream Cheese & Chicken
instructions: Mix cream cheese and soups then add chicken. Put in a 8 x 8 dish and cover with crumbled Ritz crackers and butter mixture. Bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender then drain. Combine eggs milk soup mayonnaise and cheese saving some cheese to mix with cracker crumbs. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Crumble Ritz or Town House crackers and add the remaining cheese. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Patties
instructions: Cook until soft ball in water. Beat until it begins to set and add parched peanuts.

title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Split and rinse chicken breasts and remove any skin. Dry chicken on paper towels. Slice mushrooms and mince 1 garlic clove. Begin cooking linguine according to directions on box.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar cornmeal vanilla butter and vinegar. Mix well. Let sit for 10 minutes then stir gently. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Put potatoes in 1 1/2-quart ovenproof casserole with 1 tablespoon oil. Mix other ingredients and pour over potatoes. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove from oven. Sprinkle top with corn flakes or potato chips. Dot with butter. Bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Save juice and add to Jell-O orange juice hot water and cranberry sauce. Chill until Jell-O is slightly thick. Add then pineapple celery and pecans. Refrigerate for several more hours.

title: Cherry Kucha
instructions: Mix flour sugar and baking powder. Cut in margarine with blender. Set aside 1 cup of the crumb mixture. Beat eggs slightly. Add milk and vanilla. Add this mixture to larger crumb mixture and mix. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon pie filling on top. Sprinkle with cup of reserved crumbs. Bake for 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Tuna Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs until done. Separate egg yolk from egg white. Mix mayo salt pepper sweet pickles sugar and tuna together with egg yolk then place ball of mixture into egg whites.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Toss all ingredients and bake at 250\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir mix every 15 minutes.

title: Kumquat Pie
instructions: Beat Cool Whip and condensed milk add lemon juice beat until thick. Add kumquats. Pour into pie shell and refrigerate.

title: Overnight Egg Casserole
instructions: Place bread in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese; set aside. Brown sausage and drain. Sprinkle over cheese and bread. Beat eggs milk mustard and soup; pour over mixture. Cover and refrigerate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Incredible Hulk Punch
instructions: Cut sherbet in several pieces. Put in punch bowl; add juice and ale. Stir often. (Yes its green.)

title: Peppy Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise into 1-inch wedges. Pour coating mix into a plastic bag; add salt. Dip potatoes in melted butter and place in bag and shake. Place potatoes on a well-greased baking sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Hershey Chocolate Bar Pie
instructions: Break up candy bars in a bowl. Microwave until melted. Add 1/2 of the Cool Whip and stir. Spread into cookie crust. Cover the pie with the rest of the Cool Whip and refrigerate.

title: Cabbage
instructions: Cook the cabbage for 5 minutes. Add the sour cream and the dry mustard. Mix and let set for awhile before serving.

title: Chili Sauce Meatballs
instructions: Mix ground beef salt pepper paprika Worcestershire sauce corn flakes and eggs. Roll into balls. Bake 15 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Mix chili sauce grape jelly and lemon juice. Add meatballs and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Fresh Sauteed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems and wash mushrooms thoroughly. Melt margarine in heavy skillet with lid. Place mushrooms in skillet then add all ingredients. Stir and cook on low with lid for approximately 30 minutes. Serve with grilled steaks. Ingredients should be adjusted to satisfy individual taste.

title: Connie'S Cornflake Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add rind and eggs then milk and flour alternately. Then add cornflakes raisins and nuts (grated coconut optional). Drop by teaspoon about 2 inches apart on well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Make pie shell. Heat chocolate pieces milk and butter in 1-quart saucepan over low heat stirring constantly until smooth. Set aside.

title: Broccoli, Cauliflower, Tomato Casserole
instructions: Steam broccoli and cauliflower 3 or 4 minutes. Break into bite-size pieces. Drain well. Add cherry tomatoes soup and cubed cheese. Mix gently. Bake in 1 1/2-quart round casserole dish. Top with stuffing mix and grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Stir baking mix milk and cheese until mixture forms soft balls. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Combine butter and garlic powder. Brush over warm biscuits.

title: Cheesy Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ham cheese broccoli and soup in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Stir remaining ingredients until dough forms. Drop by spoonfuls over broccoli mixture. Bake uncovered 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden brown. Makes 4 large servings.

title: Corn Bread - Fluffy
instructions: Mix well and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and chocolate. Stir in milk butter and egg yolks. Stir over medium heat until thickened. Pour into baked pie shell. Make meringue of 4 egg whites and sugar. Brown in oven.

title: Dilled Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine cucumbers and onion in a shallow serving dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Potato And Onion Bake
instructions: Wash white baking potatoes (about 4); slice thin and put in glass baking dish. Slice onion thin and put on top of potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic powder onion powder salt and pepper. Dot with 1/2 stick of margarine. Cook in microwave (covered with Saran Wrap) for about 7 minutes. Take out. Uncover carefully and stir. Re-cover and cook about 7 to 8 minutes more. Let sit covered for 2 to 3 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Apricot Carrot Bread *
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan with cooking spray. In large mixing bowl combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt. In medium size bowl combine beaten egg sugar applesauce carrots and vegetable oil. Add all at once to dry ingredients; stir just until moistened (batter will be thick). Fold in apricots. Pour batter into pan and bake 45 to 50 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Wrap loaf and store overnight before slicing.

title: Turkey Sloppy Joes
instructions: Cook ground turkey onion and pepper in a frying pan sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. When brown drain meat and rinse with hot water. Also rinse the pan with hot water. Return meat to pan. Pour on the Manwich sauce. Warm until ready to serve.

title: Microwave Lo-Cal Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Place chicken breasts in 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Combine mushrooms tomatoes green peppers onion wine garlic oregano salt and pepper. Pour over chicken. Cook covered at Medium-high for 20 minutes turning dish after 10 minutes. Remove chicken to serving plate. Cover to keep warm. Combine cornstarch and water. Add to liquid in baking dish. Cook uncovered at High for 2 to 3 minutes stirring. Mix sauce and chicken and serve. Makes 4 servings. Contains approximately 139 calories per serving.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: *Do not use self-rising flour.

title: Shrimp Sauce
instructions: Mix until it looks and tastes right!

title: Yummy Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook pasta in 4 cups boiling water with oil. In a 10 x 13-inch pan combine soup cream cheese tuna onions and frozen vegetables.\tAdd pasta and blend well. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Garnish with parsley and paprika. Serves 6.

title: Barbecued Meat Sandwich
instructions: Fully cook meat (leftover meat from roast is best). In saucepan stir in all sauce ingredients until hot. Add meat and serve on buns with mayonnaise (potato rolls are best).

title: Zarda(Sweet Saffron Rice)
instructions: Boil rice with a pinch of turmeric until well cooked making sure that no hard kernel is left in rice. Drain in colander. Prepare a syrup using the water sugar and saffron.

title: Aunt Bea'S Tomato Soup
instructions: Heat tomatoes to boil add soda and milk. Season with butter salt and pepper.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Cut stems from mushrooms. Finely chop enough stems to measure 1/3 cup. Cook and stir chopped mushroom stems onion and green pepper in 3 tablespoons margarine until tender about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in bread crumbs salt thyme turmeric and pepper.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Soak overnight in water the cucumbers onions peppers and 1/2 cup salt. Drain. Bring to a boil then put cucumbers in the water and boil again then put in jars.

title: Pizza Bites
instructions: Mix margarine and garlic; spread on muffin halves. Cut each muffin half into 4 wedges; do not separate. Place 1 slice pepperoni and 1 tomato half on each muffin wedge. Place in broiler pan. Mix cheese and oregano; sprinkle over muffin wedges. Set oven control to broil. Broil muffin wedges with tops about 5 inches from heat until cheese is melted about 2 minutes. Cut to separate into wedges. Makes 6 servings 65 calories per serving.

title: Sin
instructions: Whip and spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Serves 10.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Put apples in buttered baking dish. Add water and cinnamon. Work other ingredients together until crumbly and spread over the apple mixture. Bake uncovered in moderate oven 35 to 40 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or plain cream.

title: Festive Fruit Trifle
instructions: Thaw berries 1 package separately. Drain peaches. Cut pound cake lengthwise in half. Cut each half crosswise into 1/2-inch slices. Prepare vanilla pudding as directed using only 2 1/2 cups milk. Add almond extract. Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip until blended. Add juice from 1 package berries to orange juice.

title: Chunky Apple Pound Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of loaf pan. Mix all ingredients and beat 30 seconds. Spread in pan. Bake about 55 minutes.

title: Quickie Apple Dessert
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine; add beaten eggs. Stir in apples. Combine flour salt soda nutmeg and cinnamon. Add to apple mixture and mix well. Pour into lightly greased glass pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or with sauce.

title: Congo Squares
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake in a greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares when nearly cool.

title: Rigatoni
instructions: Boil above ingredients. Brown ground hamburg; add to sauce. Cook. Cook rigatoni noodles; drain. Alternate layers with sauce in baking dish. Put Mozzarella cheese throughout. Put white American cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Place ingredients in large bowl.

title: Jif Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine Jif Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Add egg; beat just until blended. Combine flour salt and baking soda; add to creamed mixture at low speed. Mix just until blended. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten slightly in a criss-cross pattern with tines of fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7-8 minutes or until set and just beginning to brown. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Microwave Peanut Clusters
instructions: Put in a 1 1/2-quart glass pan the almond bark milk chocolate chips and dark chocolate chips or semi-sweet chocolate chips. Melt in microwave on High for 3 1/2 minutes. Add salted dry roasted peanuts to the chocolate mixture. Mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonfuls or tablespoonfuls onto wax paper. Let cool. Makes a large batch (about 60). Half a recipe may be made. Simple and delicious!

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 475\u00b0. Scald the milk and oleo. Beat eggs sugar salt and vanilla together. Add scalded milk (do not boil). Mix well. Pour into pie crust shell. Then put crust in oven and pour filling in. Bake for 5 minutes at 475\u00b0. Reduce heat and bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Remove from oven and cool. Pie will be shaky but will set as it cools.

title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: With cream cheese at room temperature beat until light and fluffy. Beat in sweetened condensed milk. Add lemon juice and vanilla; beat well. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate until firm about 3 hours. Top with cherry pie filling.

title: Corn Flake Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop with a spoon on greased tin and bake in a moderate oven.

title: Veggie Casserole(Fast!)
instructions: Microwave veggies until they are almost done. Add the soup; stir together. Place in casserole dish; sprinkle cheese in and stir. Sprinkle onion rings over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 until hot through and cheese is melted about 30 minutes.

title: Cheap But Good Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs one at a time. Add milk flour soda salt and cocoa that has been dissolved in warm water. Add vanilla. Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans at 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice Bake
instructions: Flour and brown chicken. Put rice salt and pepper in casserole. Add onion and mushrooms. Place chicken pieces on top. Pour bouillon over all. Dot with butter. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Custard Angel Food Cake
instructions: Bake Lemon Custard Angel Food Cake as directed. Frost top and sides with cooled vanilla pudding (cooked type). Sprinkle toasted coconut over top and sides. Chill before serving.

title: Charlotte'S Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Mix all other ingredients together and place in crock-pot or in heavy saucepan and simmer for a couple of hours. (Can use other vegetables of your choice and even more tomatoes if desired.) This recipe is very easy and delicious!

title: Browned Rice(Delicious Rice Dish, Guaranteed To Please Company.)
instructions: Bring margarine bouillon and water to a boil in large skillet. Add rice. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until done. Remove from stove. Add 5 tablespoons soy sauce. Cut up green onions and onion tops. Add onions and nuts to taste. Serve.

title: Stuffing
instructions: For this versatile stuffing recipe use day-old bread. Stuffing made with soft fresh bread becomes mushy with cooking. If you have only fresh bread on hand place slices in a 150\u00b0 oven for a few minutes until dried throughout.

title: Overnight Walnut Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar butter shortening and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Shape dough into long rolls. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Slice about 1/2-inch thick and bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 11 minutes.

title: Delicious Biscuits
instructions: Mix together the flour baking powder cream of tartar salt and sugar. Cut in shortening. I slowly pour in milk; add eggs. Bake in hot oven for 10 to 15 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Cook meat in large iron pot. Remove and drain all but 2 tablespoons of grease. Add chopped onions bell pepper garlic and celery. Cook until soft. Add spices tomatoes rice and beer. Add meat and then enough water to cover rice about 1-inch. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cover. Cook until rice is done about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Applesauce Bread
instructions: Mix together flour baking powder baking soda salt allspice and cloves; set aside. Combine oil and sugar. Beat until well blended. Beginning and ending with dry ingredients add dry ingredients alternately with applesauce to sugar mixture. Fold in nuts raisins and coconut. Pour in a greased 9 x 5-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes on a rack.

title: Meat Loaf Surprise
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pack half of mixture in an ungreased loaf pan forming a trench in the middle. Fill the trench with your favorite bread stuffing and cover with the remaining meat. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger add diced onion. Cook until transparent. In large pot add tomato juice tomato paste chili powder cold water salt sugar worcestershire sauce kidney beans and browned hamburger onion mix. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. (Can be frozen.)

title: Hawaiian Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs. Stir in bananas. Combine dry ingredients and mix in undrained pineapple and coconut. Bake in 2 large or 3 medium loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. This freezes well.

title: Cry Babies
instructions: Boil sugar molasses and raisins until raisins are plump. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Spiced Fruit Cider
instructions: Bring to a boil. Simmer. Strain spices and serve warm.

title: Egg And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Place croutons in greased casserole. Top with cheese. Cook sausage in skillet and drain. Then place sausage over cheese. Beat eggs and mix with mustard milk soup and mushrooms. Pour over sausage and bake in preheated oven at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Best if prepared and refrigerated overnight.

title: Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: Bring oil sugar vinegar pepper salt and mustard to a boil. Reduce heat and add eggs. Cook stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Remove from heat. Blend in salad dressing or mayonnaise.

title: Chipped Beef And Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese; mix together with all ingredients except pecans. Put in casserole dish; top with pecan halves. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes. Serve as a spread for crackers.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large pot brown meat with onion. Drain. Add salt and pepper. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Popcorn Balls
instructions: Mix corn syrup and sugar in small saucepan. Heat to boiling; stir until sugar dissolves. Remove. Stir in peanut butter. Pour over popped corn. Mix until coated. Shape into balls with greased hands. Makes 10 balls.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes and combine in large bowl with butter; add salt pepper onion soup sour cream and cheese. Blend thoroughly and pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with melted butter and flakes. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Chicken
instructions: Mix everything and spread on chicken. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Crock-Pot Beans
instructions: Mix all in a crock-pot. Cook 4 to 6 hours. Start on high then low. Stir occasionally.

title: Jello Pound Cake
instructions: Mix jello in boiling water. Let cool. Mix cake mix jello mixture oil and 4 eggs. Beat 5 minutes. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done. Leave cake in pan and cover with powdered sugar. Mix together orange juice and sugar. Pour over cake while hot. Let stand in pan until cool.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix the broccoli cauliflower onion carrots ripe olives and cherry tomatoes in a large bowl. Pour on salad dressing and chill. Cook pasta according to directions; drain well. Mix with vegetables; sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Sweet Minglers
instructions: Open a large Ziploc Baggie and place on counter. Place a sifter securely in Baggie. Measure the powdered sugar into the sifter. Sift and set aside.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix together hamburger bread crumbs milk egg soup mix salt and nutmeg. Shape into balls. Cook in glass Pyrex baking dish. Cook 20 meatballs at a time. Cover with wax paper. Microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes. Rearrange after 3 minutes. Remove keep drippings in the pan. Repeat until all meatballs are cooked.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Pour into a prepared 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with 6 ounce package butterscotch morsels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Reese'S Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Combine flour and baking soda; add to cream mixture. Stir in semi-sweet chocolate and Reeses chips. Drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly before removing cookies. Makes 5 dozen 2 1/2 inch cookies.

title: Chicken Jambalaya
instructions: Cut the meat off the bones and store in the refrigerator until you are ready. Combine the seasonings (next 6 ingredients) in a small bowl and set aside.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix sugar mayonnaise and vinegar in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate and serve chilled.

title: Divinity Candy
instructions: Boil sugar water and corn syrup until it spins a thread. Beat egg whites until stiff. Slowly pour syrup over egg whites. Beat until egg whites stand in peaks. Add nuts and vanilla. Beat until it thickens. Drop candy onto waxed paper by spoonfuls.

title: Corn Bread
