instructions: Stir together the flour corn meal sugar baking powder and salt. Add eggs milk and oil or melted shortening. Beat just until smooth (do not overbeat). Turn into a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 or 9 servings.

title: Pineapple Delight
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into dish.

title: Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Mix soup-spaghetti mix in hamburger. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with 1 package crescent rolls. Add layer of hamburger mixture and layer of cheese. Top with other package of crescent rolls. Brush top with milk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until rolls are brown.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix well the pineapple juice milk and lemon juice then fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Onion Wine Soup
instructions: Saute onions and add beef broth and celery leaves. Bring to a boil then cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Puree mixture in blender. Return mixture to saucepan and blend in wine vinegar and sugar. Bring to boil and simmer 5 minutes. Reduce heat. Stir in cream parsley salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: 24 Hour Cold Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage onion celery seed and sugar. Set aside. Combine vinegar salt and dry mustard in saucepan. Bring to boil then add vegetable oil and bring to boil again. Pour liquid over cabbage ingredients. Pack lightly and cover tightly. Store in refrigerator for 24 hours. Will keep for 7 to 8 days if kept refrigerated.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut each biscuit into fourths. Put sugar and cinnamon in plastic bag. Shake. Shake biscuit pieces a few at a time in cinnamon mixture. Layer them in a well greased bundt pan. Sprinkle raisins and nuts over each biscuit layer. Top with nuts and raisins. Melt brown sugar and butter. Boil for one minute. Add vanilla. Pour over biscuits. Bake in 350 degree oven for 35 minutes. Let stand for 15 minutes before removing from pan. Pull apart with a fork.

title: Quick Yeast Bread
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix together the water yeast sugar shortening and salt. Gradually stir in the flour until thoroughly mixed. Cover this bowl; let mixture rise for 30 to 45 minutes. Punch down and shape into rolls with floured hands or put in a greased loaf pan and let rise until doubles in bulk. Bake at 425\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Boil shrimp; drain. Add all ingredients and mix well.

title: Vietnamese Fried Rice
instructions: In large skillet add first 7 ingredients. Stir-fry until tender and hot. Mix in meat. Add rice and stir-fry 5 minutes. Add vegetables stirring well.

title: Ginger Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar egg and dark molasses. Mix well and add ginger cinnamon baking soda and flour. Chill and roll in ball about the size of a walnut. Then roll in granulated sugar. Put on ungreased cookie sheet; bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Marty'S Almost Chinese Vegetables
instructions: Place tomatoes in large saucepan. Break up tomatoes with side of spoon. Add drained green beans bean sprouts and mushrooms. Add Mrs. Dash to taste and heat over medium fire until hot. Serve immediately.

title: Mustard And Applesauce Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Skin chicken; coat with mixture of mustard and sugar. Place in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with seasonings. Spread applesauce over chicken. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix melted butter and 1 egg and pat into greased 9x 12-inch pan. Cream the cream cheese 2 eggs and powdered sugar and pour into pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle a little powdered sugar on top after baking.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar. Beat until light. Whip sour cream and fold into egg mixture. Add raisins nutmeg salt and lemon juice. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake for another 20 minutes or until filling is set and tests done with toothpick.

title: Crab A La Lorraine
instructions: Blend ingredients well. Spread on 16 muffin halves. Freeze slightly and cut each into 6 wedges. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned.

title: Glennie Nell'S Roast Christmas Possum
instructions: Combine one food from each of the groups below

title: Gumdrop Hermits
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut gumdrops into small pieces totaling 1 cup. Use ice water to dip knife to prevent sticking. Cream shortening; gradually add sugar. Beat until fluffy. Sift dry ingredients together; add alternately with milk and egg. Add gumdrops and vanilla. Drop with teaspoon on greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown on bottom.

title: Cathy'S Champagne Punch
instructions: Combine in large punch bowl; serve.

title: Melon-Strawberry Compote
instructions: Combine semi-defrosted melon and strawberries. Pour lemon-lime soda over and lightly toss. Spoon into eight sherbet glasses and garnish with fresh mint leaves. Makes 8 servings.

title: Honey Dijon Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken breast halves in salad dressing coating well. Combine bread crumbs and cheese then coat chicken with crumb mixture. Place on a nonstick pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Banana Chocolate Cake
instructions: Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk. Mix rest of ingredients and bake in a 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch square pan in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Frost with your favorite frosting.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potatoes onions parsley celery carrots and turnips with salt and water. Bring to boil and cook gently until potatoes are tender. Cook on simmer stir frequently and watch closely. Sticks to bottom of pot very easily. Make a white sauce.

title: Pastel Banana Bobs
instructions: Peel bananas; cut crosswise into 4 pieces. Insert wooden ice cream stick in each piece. Place on baking sheet. Freeze until bananas are firm about 2 hours.

title: Country Biscuits
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Mix in buttermilk. Roll out and cut to desired thickness. Place in greased pan (bacon grease gives it a great flavor). Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Never Fail Meringue
instructions: Blend cornstarch and cold water in a saucepan. Add boiling water and cook stirring until clear and thickened. Let stand until completely cold.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Set oven to 425\u00b0. Wash blueberries; drain. Line 9-inch pie pan with pastry and flute edge. Combine vinegar sugar flour and nutmeg with berries. Turn into pastry shell and dot with butter. Cover with pastry. Seal edge. Bake pie 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 375\u00b0 and bake 25 minutes longer.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Boil sugar and molasses together for 5 minutes (not any longer); remove from heat. Add butter and baking soda. Stir mixture until it becomes foamy. Pour over the popcorn. Mix well. Wet hands with cold water and shape into balls.

title: Orange Pumpkin Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl beat sugar oil and eggs. Stir in pumpkin and orange peel. Sift together flour baking soda salt baking powder and allspice. Add to mixture in bowl. Add orange juice and nuts. Pour into 12-cup Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Sift powdered sugar on top if desired.

title: Rice With Black Beans
instructions: Cook and stir onion in hot oil in saucepan until tender but not browned. Add tomatoes beans oregano and garlic powder. Bring to boil. Stir in rice. Return to boil. Reduce heat and cover; simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 8 servings. One serving equals 170 calories 7 g protein 32 g carbohydrate 3 g fat 0 cholesterol 340 mg sodium and 4 g dietary fiber.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Melt butter in 1-quart saucepan. Add onion and cook until tender. Add salt pepper and flour; blend well. Add parsley celery potatoes and water. Mix thoroughly. Cover and place over high heat about 5 minutes. Reduce to low and cook 15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add milk and heat thoroughly. Serves 6.

title: Paul'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except jello. Sprinkle jello over mixture; stir then chill for several hours.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Flatten the cookie roll into a 12-inch pizza pan. Punch holes in crust before baking. Bake at 325\u00b0 until brown (about 7 minutes).

title: Smash-Um-Forget-Um Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven. 350\u00b0. Mix together above ingredients. Roll into balls. Squash on cookie sheet. Put in oven. Turn OFF oven. Leave cookies for 5 min.

title: Pork Chops-Barbecued
instructions: Brown chops lightly in very little oil. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over chops and bake 1 hour covered at 350\u00b0.

title: French Chocolate Pie
instructions: Cream butter with sugar. Stir in cooled melted chocolate. Add eggs one at a time beating at high speed 5 minutes after each addition. Fold in thawed Cool Whip. Pour in pie shell. Chill until firm 2 hours.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Put potatoes in mixing bowl and add eggs. Mix well. Gradually beat in sugar; stir in milk butter lemon rind and lemon juice. Add cinnamon and nutmeg. Mix thoroughly. Stir in raisins. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 until light brown and well set.

title: Hamburger Barbecue
instructions: Fry hamburger pepper and onion. Add remaining ingredients and cook on low heat 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Mix to dissolve and pour over hot cake. (I punch holes in the cake before pouring mixture over cake.)

title: Mandle Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar in blender. Add egg and mix thoroughly. Add dry ingredients which have been mixed together. Add extract and blend thoroughly. Separate dough into four even amounts. Drop food coloring in desired amounts. Put through cookie press onto ungreased sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar butter syrup and vanilla. Add to beaten eggs then add pecans. Pour into pie pan lined with good rich pastry shell (unbaked). Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients in casserole dish. Top with mayonnaise. Grate cheese of your choice on top.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook the cranberries with the 1 1/2 cups water and sugar until thick. Let cool. Pour 2 cups boiling water over the Jell-O; let it cool. Add drained pineapple celery apples and nuts to Jell-O. Mix well. Add the cooked cranberries. Put into large dish and refrigerate. This salad will keep for several days.

title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In large mixing bowl blend together all ingredients. Pour mixture into pie shell (9-inch). Bake at 375\u00b0 until sharp bladed knife inserted near center comes out clean 50 to 55 minutes. Cool. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Cook beef until tender then shred or chop beef. Put back into liquid and add all seasonings. Cook on low all day. Stir once or twice.

title: Brownie Dessert
instructions: Prepare brownie mix and mousse according to package directions. Layer in clear bowl a layer of brownies (optional pour Kahlua over brownies) a layer of mousse and a layer of Cool Whip; sprinkle with crushed Heath bars. Repeat until you reach the top of bowl.

title: Velveeta Fudge
instructions: Over medium heat in large saucepan melt margarine and cheese. Spread stirring constantly until mixture is smooth. Blend powdered sugar and cocoa into cheese mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Mix well and spread into buttered pan depending on thickness you want 13 x 9 x 2-inch or 15 x 11-inch. Yields 6 1/2 pounds.

title: Dairy Queen Ice Cream
instructions: Soak the Knox gelatine in the cold water. Heat the whole milk until hot but not boiling. Remove from heat. Add the gelatine vanilla sugar and salt. Cool. Add the whipping cream. Put in refrigerator to chill for 5 or 6 hours before freezing. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Let set overnight in refrigerator. Next morning add bananas and nuts. Mix well.

title: Barbecued Hot Dogs
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add onion and celery. Cook until yellow. Add remaining ingredients and blend. Cook slowly for about 15 minutes. Put the hot dogs in a flat baking dish. Prick them with a fork. Pour sauce over them and bake for about 20 minutes until bubbly in a 350\u00b0 oven. Bake uncovered.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Pack firmly into loaf pan. Top with 1 can mushroom soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Yields 8 servings.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together except for 1/2 of the cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with rest of cheese near end of baking time.

title: Chicken Tarragon
instructions: Lightly brown chicken in butter. Remove chicken. Place mushrooms soy sauce and tarragon in butter. Saute. Add whipping cream. Stir. Add chicken. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Dottie'S Almond Bark Candy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Turn off. Put bark in glass dish and melt in oven. Mix all ingredients together making sure its mixed well. Drop on cookie sheets lined with wax paper by the teaspoon. Put in the refrigerator until hard. (They harden quickly.) Layer in tin can with wax paper between layers.

title: Old Fashioned Irish Stew
instructions: Have the meat cut in pieces as desired for serving size. Cover with about 4 cups water (boiling); bring slowly back to boiling point. Add the seasonings. Add the carrots cut in strips or thick slices; let simmer for 45 minutes. Add onions and potatoes; let simmer until potatoes and meat are both tender about 1 hour. Garnish with chopped parsley when serving. To be served with a salad and a dessert of shamrock ice cream molds and little cookies.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli according to package; add a little butter. Add Minute rice to mixture; cover for 3 minutes. Pour Cheese Spread over mixture for serving.

title: German Rye Bread(If You Like Dark Rye Bread, This Is The Recipe For You.)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup water. Mix rest of water with molasses and salt in a large bowl. Mix rye flour cocoa and caraway seed together. Add yeast and melted butter and 1/2 of the flour. Beat until smooth. Knead in remaining flour until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise until double. Punch down. Shape into loaves and let rise again until double. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Dish
instructions: Use a glass baking dish (spray with Pam). Place broccoli on bottom of dish. Place chicken on top of broccoli. Mix soup and mayonnaise together. Spread on top of chicken. Sprinkle cheese on top of soup; sprinkle on bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Salad Supreme
instructions: Soak lime jello in cold water for 10 minutes. Combine lemon juice from lemons pineapple juice and sugar. Bring to a boil. Add softened jello and let cool. Add cottage cheese and pineapple. When mixture starts to thicken add whipped cream. Beat well. Serve on crisp lettuce with mayonnaise chopped nuts and paprika.

title: Maryland Crab Cakes
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine parsley mayonnaise mustard cayenne salt and Worcestershire; mix well. Stir in crumbs and egg. Add crab meat; mix well. Shape into patties; refrigerate 1 hour. Melt butter or oleo in skillet; saute cakes until golden brown on both sides.

title: Hollandaise Sauce (France)
instructions: Into a blender place yolks salt mustard lemon juice and Tabasco sauce. Blend for 3 seconds. Then while blender is going pour in the melted butter which should be hot. (The temperature of the butter is the secret; make it very hot without burning it and the Hollandaise Sauce will thicken immediately.) Serve on vegetables poached eggs (Eggs Benedict) or meats.

title: Hanky Panky
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage together; drain. Put back in skillet. Add seasonings and cheese. Melt cheese on low and stir. Put heaping spoonful of mixture on party bread and spread. Place on cookie sheet and bake now or freeze.

title: Carol'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pour Pet milk over noodles and let stand while preparing. Cube the cheese. Mix together everything except potato chips. Add chips to the top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. A family favorite - and great to bring to shut-ins!

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all of this together and place in a 9 x 11 x 2-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top (I use Italian cheese seasoned). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until bread crumbs are lightly browned.

title: Apricot Delight
instructions: Pour into saucepan pineapple water and gelatin. Let come to a ripple. Add cream cheese; stir until cream cheese is almost dissolved. Set aside to cool. Pour into a mixing bowl and set in the refrigerator for about 15 or 20 minutes. Whip the Dream Whip and add to the cooled pineapple mixture. Add nuts and celery. Pour into mold. Best if chilled overnight.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Layer 1 Cut butter into flour until crumbly.\tStir in nuts. Pat down firmly. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Honey Pecan Fried Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in marinating dish and cover with buttermilk. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Do not rinse the buttermilk off the chicken. Combine flour garlic salt and cayenne pepper in large bowl. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and allow to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Salad
instructions: Cook rhubarb with 1/4 cup water and 1/2 cup sugar until it can be mashed. Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add all ingredients to jello. Add 1/2 cup cold water.

title: Meal In One
instructions: You will need foil.

title: Sweet And Sour
instructions: In a 1-cup measuring cup add enough water to reserved juice to measure full cup. In medium saucepan heat juice and water adding brown sugar vinegar carrots soy sauce and salt. Stir. Add garlic; bring to boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer about 6 minutes. Mix water and cornstarch; stir into sauce. Add pineapple your choice of meat and green pepper. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly.

title: Hamburger-Macaroni
instructions: Brown burger in heavy pan. Add onion soup milk and salt and pepper. Cook about 30 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes. Add cheese. Turn off burner. Cook macaroni according to directions on package. Drain well and pour in bowl. Add sauce.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. In mixing bowl combine sugar butter salt and milk. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in egg and yeast. Gradually add flour to form a stiff dough.

title: Mexican Spoon Bread
instructions: Dissolve cornmeal in milk in a saucepan. Stir over heat to scalding point. Simmer until thickened. Add salt stir in sugar butter corn chilies and cheese. Allow to cool a few minutes. Add eggs and baking powder. Pour into greased two-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until top is puffy and brown approximately 10 servings.

title: Orange-Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Combine first four ingredients mixing until crumbly. Set aside. Combine next seven ingredients in a medium mixing bowl stirring well. Make a well in the center of mixture. Combine orange juice milk oil and egg. Add to dry ingredients; stir just until moistened. Spoon mixture into greased muffin pans filling 3/4 full. Sprinkle with cinnamon mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Yogurt Waffles
instructions: Mix together eggs yogurt and oil. Add flour soda and salt. Mix together until smooth. Add water adding additional water if necessary to make the right consistency for your waffle iron. Makes 2 1/2 large waffles.

title: Chicken Breasts In Lemon Sauce
instructions: Dredge chicken breast with flour salt and pepper. Place in skillet in which butter has been melted and garlic sauteed. Brown on both sides. Add wine and lemon juice. Cook 5 minutes or until done.

title: Coffee Cream Pie Filling And Crust
instructions: Combine and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until melted the coffee water and miniature marshmallows. Beat egg yolks slightly. Add coffee mixture slowly to beaten egg yolks stirring constantly. Return to saucepan; cook over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes stirring constantly. Chill until mixture begins to set like soft pudding. Beat chilled mixture at medium speed until smooth. Fold in with beater the whipped topping and almond extract. If too stiff add some whole milk until smooth. Spoon into cooled crusts. Garnish with dry instant coffee crystals.

title: Easy Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Wash and dry chops. Place in baking dish. Mix catsup and water. Pour over chops (may need more if using more chops.) Place 1 teaspoon brown sugar on each chop with 1 lemon slice on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until chops are done. These are delicious and very easy to prepare.

title: French Cherry Pie
instructions: Beat sour cream and milk with beater until smooth. Add vanilla pudding mix and almond extract; beat 1 minute. Pour into pie shell; chill 15 minutes. Spread pie filling evenly over pudding. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Country Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and pat in 10-inch pie plate.

title: Easy Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix thoroughly after each addition. Turn into well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes. Check doneness by inserting toothpick. When it comes out clean its done!

title: Baked Broccoli Spears
instructions: Boil broccoli 5 minutes. Strain well. Beat eggs cheese soup and mayonnaise together. Fold into the broccoli. Pack them in greased casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well saving out some cheese for top. Spread in large 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Add cheese to top of casserole during last 15 minutes of baking. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Cut Twinkies in halves and place cream side up. Pour crushed pineapple and juice over Twinkies. Cut up bananas on crushed pineapple. Cover pineapple with thawed Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Refrigerate until ready to eat.

title: Baked Peaches
instructions: Place peaches in lightly greased pie baking dish. Combine dry ingredients. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar slowly and mix well. Beat in egg yolks. Sift flour and baking powder and add alternately with milk and honey mixture. Beat well. Add raisins and figs which have been coated with flour. Fold in egg whites which have been beaten stiff. Bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 in a well-greased tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Two cups brown sugar one cup milk and butter size of walnut. Stir while cooking. Boil 20 minutes then add flavoring and a cup of chopped nuts. Beat until creamy and spread on buttered tin to cool.

title: Scotch Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly combine sugar and butter. Add molasses and eggs. Combine dry ingredients and add gradually to butter mixture. Roll out on lightly floured board and cut with large cookie cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and brush with topping.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste mushrooms and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Cook spaghetti; drain. Add margarine to spaghetti; toss to melt margarine. Place half of the spaghetti with half the meat mixture; repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbling around edge. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Cooked Frosting
instructions: Cook milk and flour until thick; stir while cooking. Beat sugar butter Crisco and vanilla until fluffy like whipped cream. Add to cooled flour mixture and beat until all sugar is dissolved and looks fluffy. Will store 3 to 4 weeks in refrigerator. Just whip again before use. Great on chocolate cake!

title: Potato Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line bottoms of 2 (9-inch) layer pans or a 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong pan with waxed paper cut to fit. Prepare mashed potatoes. (Easy way is to follow directions for 2 servings on package mashed potatoes.) Measure and set aside. Gradually beat sugar into shortening until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Add vanilla and potatoes. Add sifted dry ingredients and milk alternately about 1/4 of each at a time beating smooth. Stir in walnuts.

title: Zucchini Jack Casserole
instructions: Slice zucchini into 1/4-inch thick rounds (about 7 cups); set aside. In a large bowl beat eggs with milk baking powder and flour until smooth. Stir in parsley garlic onion chiles cheese and zucchini. Spoon egg mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Toss croutons in melted butter then sprinkle over top. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand at least 10 minutes before cutting. Makes about 10 servings.

title: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
instructions: Drain water chestnuts. Cut bacon slices into thirds. Wrap each water chestnut in 1/3 slice of bacon. Place two on a toothpick. Continue with remaining water chestnuts and bacon. (Tedious! But can be done a day ahead. Cover and refrigerate.) Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Drain grease and discard. While these are in the oven combine remaining ingredients. Heat until sugar is dissolved. Pour sauce over drained water chestnuts. Return to oven for 20 to 30 minutes. These are wonderful hot appetizers!

title: White Punch
instructions: Boil water; add sugar. Blend bananas lemonade and pineapple juice. Add this to the water/sugar mixture. Freeze. When ready to serve add 2-quarts ginger ale.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream until smooth. Spread on platter. Cover with taco layer. Layer chopped vegetables on top of cheese and taco sauce. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top. Serve with restaurant style tortilla chips. Makes 12 servings.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and peppers; mix and pour 1/2 into greased pan. Spread peppers over batter; sprinkle with 1/2 of cheese. Cover with remaining batter. Top with remaining cheese. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Orange Cider
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 6 quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated. Serve hot. May garnish with cinnamon sticks if desired.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put peaches in greased 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar. In mixing bowl cream together margarine and sugar. Stir in flour. Add egg and vanilla and mix well. Spoon mixture over peaches. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Gradually beat in sugar. Add Pet milk; cook until it thickens slightly. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Place in freezer. Finish filling up freezer with milk (3/4 full). Freeze until hard.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in part of the butter. Mix rest of ingredients in mixing bowl. Add onion. Place in casserole and bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put corn flakes on top and drizzle rest of butter and additional cheese if desired. Bake 15 more minutes.

title: Taffy
instructions: Boil until brittle when dropped into cold water. When cool pull.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: For first layer melt oleo and mix with flour and 1/2 cup pecans. Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Refrigerate 1 hour then add second layer.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine meat egg and cracker crumbs. Mix well and form into loafs and place in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 1/2 hour baste with sauce and bake 1 more hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Salmon Cheddar Pie
instructions: Very lightly mix the salmon Cheddar cheese eggs and seasonings in mixing bowl. Pour equal amounts in each pie shell. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until firm. Serve with dollop of sour cream and fresh fruit.

title: Company Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Cool. Add pineapple bananas and marshmallows. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish and chill until firm.

title: Baked Acorn Squash
instructions: Combine apples walnuts raisins honey and cinnamon. Divide ingredients between squash halves. Dot with butter. Bake in a pan of water at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cover with foil and bake another 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Hamburgers, Arkansas Style
instructions: Mix and let stand 1/2 hour. Spread on buns without packing covering edges of buns well. Broil until done.

title: Mike'S Own Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Boil ground chuck until cooked. Mix tomato sauce chili mix sugar salt and pepper. After ground chuck is done drain and add to tomato sauce mixture. Simmer for about 45 minutes. Boil noodles until done. (Try to get noodles and sauce done at the same time.)

title: Red Raspberry Ring
instructions: Drain raspberries reserving liquid. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add ice cream by spoonfuls and stir until blended. Stir in raspberry syrup and lemonade concentrate. Chill until partially set; add pecans and raspberries. Turn into 6-cup mold; chill until firm.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie
instructions: Combine butter flavored shortening brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed on electric mixer until creamy. Beat egg into creamed mixture. Combine flour salt and baking soda and mix into creamed mixture until just blended. Stir in chocolate chips (and nuts if youre using them).

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Grease a pie dish and fill with apples. Mix cinnamon and 3 tablespoons of sugar together. Sprinkle over apples. Beat the 3/4 cup sugar and butter until creamy. Add salt and baking powder. Mix in egg flour and nuts. Mix together thoroughly. Drop the batter by tablespoons over the top of apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie(Strawberries Are So Good In A Pie.)
instructions: In a small bowl mix cream cheese with milk. Spread into a baked pie shell. Wash and stem whole strawberries then place in pie shell covering shell.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Blend ingredients in large mixing bowl with mixer. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes one 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Ms. Louella'S Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all together and make into little balls. Place on cookie sheet and flatten a little with a fork dipped in water. Bake in slow oven 250\u00b0 to 275\u00b0 until done (8 to 9 minutes depending on cookie sheet and oven).

title: Thrifty Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour once measure and add baking powder. Sift again. Put shortening sugar eggs and flavoring in a large bowl of an electric mixer. On high speed beat 2 1/2 to 3 minutes; then turn to low. Mix milk and flour alternately about 1/3 cup milk and flour at a time. Just mix long enough to get mixed good. Bake in a well greased and floured tube pan for an hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Bean Special
instructions: Brown and drain beef. Add remaining ingredients mixing well. Place in a 3-quart baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 10.

title: Beef And Macaroni
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain off grease. Put in Miracle Whip spaghetti sauce and cooked macaroni. Heat on medium heat stirring occasionally. Top with cheese. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and add cut up cabbage. Bake in a large greased pan or baking dish at 350\u00b0 covered for 2 hours.

title: Refrigerator Mustard Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers into quarters and keep in jar in refrigerator.

title: Dill Weed Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well. Refrigerate for awhile before serving.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into small pieces; combine with other ingredients. Stir well. This salad is best if prepared and refrigerated at least 3 or 4 hours before serving.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Blend cottage cheese and milk until smooth. Stir in Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix and dill weed. Chill and serve with your favorite vegetable.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Mix applesauce sugar vinegar and spices together and mix until well blended in crock-pot. Turn on high and cover. After 4 hours remove lid and finish cooking until thick enough to spread. Cook 8 to 10 hours.

title: Chicken Balls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients mixing well; shape into 1-inch balls. Fry in a small amount of hot oil over medium heat until brown. Drain on paper towels. Tie whole cloves in cheesecloth and set aside. Combine 1/3 cup brown sugar and cornstarch in a large saucepan. Gradually add water stirring until smooth. Add pineapple juice and lemon juice; cook stirring constantly until smooth and thick. Add meatballs and whole cloves. Simmer on low 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove cheesecloth bag. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Grandma Haynes' Biscuits
instructions: Mix 1/5 can lye in 6 cups cold water and dissolve in enamel pan. Put 1 pound lard or other grease into lye water and boil until fairly thick (like candy); add 2 tablespoons ammonia water and 1 tablespoon borax; when cool beat well until white. Harden 2 weeks before using.

title: Curry Dip For Vegetables
instructions: Blend all together and let stand.

title: Momma'S Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugar. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with well beaten eggs. Beat well. Add vanilla and sour cream; mix well. Pour into greased and floured cake pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: No Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt margarine and marshmallows in top of double boiler. Add graham cracker crumbs. Add chopped cherries raisins and pecans. Pour 2 tablespoons cherry juice over mixture and press back in cracker box. Refrigerate.

title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Wash and bake potatoes. Melt oleo. Stir in\tmilk. Remove from heat. Add soup.\tTake potatoes from shell and\tbeat in milk mixture.\tPut filling back into shells and bake until heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ribbon Jello
instructions: Add 1 cup boiling water to 1 package of Jell-O; let dissolve. Take half the Jell-O (1/2 cup) and add 3 tablespoons of cold water; pour into a 9 x 13 dish. Let set. To the other 1/2 cup of Jell-O add 1/3 cup sour cream and shake until smooth. Scoop foam off sour cream and Jell-O. Mix and pour. Let set. Keep doing same with each layer.

title: Quick Cherry Crunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix juice and tapioca and let set 15 minutes. In a large pan melt butter. Stir in sugar flour oatmeal salt baking powder and soda. Place 1/2 mixture in bottom of 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Layer cherries on top of this layer. Pour on cherry juice and tapioca mixture. Top with remaining sugar and oatmeal mixture. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until brown.

title: Apricot Chews
instructions: Mix together; stir well. Drop on well greased cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Freezes well. Serve as candy or cookie.

title: Marshmallow Popcorn Balls
instructions: Melt margarine over low heat using a large pan (or microwave). Add marshmallows and stir until all are melted. Add peanut butter. Pour whole mixture over the popcorn. Stir until well coated. Form into balls with greased hands. Can also use plastic bags on hands to form balls. Makes 15 balls.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix and set aside chopped nuts 1/2 cup sugar cinnamon and cocoa. Cream margarine and 1 cup sugar. Add eggs and sour cream. Sift flour baking powder baking soda and salt and mix. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Put 1/2 batter into tube pan then add 1/2 cinnamon mixture on top and cut through with knife. Add rest of batter and then rest of cinnamon. Grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Frozen Banana Smoothie
instructions: In blender container place all ingredients. Cover; blend on high speed 2 minutes. Decrease speed; blend 1 minute longer or until frothy. Garnish with mint leaves.

title: Mom'S Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes and boil in water enough to cover potatoes. Boil until potatoes are tender to touch. Drain off water and add butter milk salt and pepper. Let set long enough for butter to melt. With mixer beat potatoes until light and fluffy. If potatoes seem too stiff add a little milk and stir.

title: Peach Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix together butter flour baking powder vanilla eggs and 2 cups sugar. Pour 1/2 the batter into a large greased cake pan and spread evenly. Cover this with a mixture of the peaches cinnamon and the remaining sugar. Pour the remaining batter over this. Bake for 50 minutes. If you like walnuts mix in 1 cup to the batter.

title: Cookies And Cream Dessert
instructions: Pour crushed cookies in 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Mix other ingredients and pour over crushed cookies. Place in refrigerator and serve next day. Optional Top with Cool Whip and extra crushed Oreos.

title: Chitterlings
instructions: Wash chitterlings. Pull off all excess fat. Split open chitterlings and clean thoroughly. Wash in several waters.

title: Low-Fat Fudgy Brownies(Yields 25 Brownies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray an 8-inch square baking pan with nonstick coating and set aside. Combine all ingredients except flour and walnuts in bowl and beat to blend with electric mixer on low. Stir in flour and spoon into pan. Sprinkle with chopped nuts if using. Bake for 30 minutes or until center springs back when gently touched with tip of finger. Cool brownies in pan or wire rack. Cut into squares.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pat into cakes. Fry or bake.

title: Cherry-O Cheese Pie
instructions: In medium bowl beat softened cheese until light and fluffy. Gradually mix in sweetened condensed milk until thoroughly blended. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Turn into crust. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours. Top with chilled pie filling.

title: Welsh Rarebit
instructions: Cut up cheese and add water. Heat in a saucepan until cheese melts. Add butter salt and flour which has been thickened with a little water. Bring to a boil. Pour over saltine crackers.

title: Chili Popcorn Seasoning
instructions: Add all ingredients into a shaker type dispenser and mix well. Shake container several times before sprinkling over warm popcorn.

title: Basic Quiche
instructions: Sprinkle cheese and meat into pie shell. Beat the remaining ingredients. Pour over cheese and meat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: German Raisin Pie
instructions: Crust Crumble enough pecan sandies for pie crust. Blend these with just enough butter to hold crumbs together. Press this mixture into an 8-inch pie pan. Set aside.

title: Lynn'S Bean Dip
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet. Drain grease off. Add all other ingredients. Heat and mix thoroughly. Serve with taco chips. Great in small crock pot for parties.

title: Spam Hash Brown Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine potatoes melted butter salt pepper and garlic powder. In another bowl combine cheese Spam soup sour cream milk onion and green chilies. Mix well. Add Spam mixture to potato mixture; mix well. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with potato chips. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serves 8.

title: Yummy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat together margarine and sugar until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Add flour soda cinnamon and salt; mix well. Stir in oats and raisins; mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack. Makes approximately 4 dozen cookies. Makes 30 servings. Preparation time 035.

title: Cherry Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sugar together. Add a few spoons of Cool Whip so you can spread it onto crust easier. Spread pie filling on top of cream cheese then cover with Cool Whip. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Family Noodles Alfredo
instructions: Cook noodles to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain and rinse under hot water. Combine butter and milk in large saucepan. Heat until butter melts. Stir in cooked noodles stirring gently until heated through. Remove from heat. Toss with Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle lightly with parsley flakes on top of noodles.

title: Marshmallow Lime Chiffon Pie
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Combine egg yolks sugar lemon juice and salt. Stir over very low heat until slightly thickened. Remove from heat; blend in gelatin. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat 2 egg whites to soft peaks. Gradually beat in 1/3 cup sugar. Fold in 2 cups miniature marshmallows. Pour in baked pie shell. Sprinkle on top 1/2 cup flaked coconut.

title: Spam Potato Bake
instructions: In shallow baking dish prepare potatoes according to directions on box. Cube Spam and add to mix. Stir in green beans. Bake according to box directions.

title: Chicken Salad(Easy To Make - An All-American Favorite)
instructions: Toss together chicken celery lemon juice and seasonings. Mix in mayonnaise. Carefully fold in eggs. Chill thoroughly. Arrange a mound in each lettuce cup and garnish with olives or little pickles and parsley. Makes 6 servings.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples and sugar. Add oil nuts eggs and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add to apple mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch well greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Enchilada
instructions: Layer the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with Doritos. Mix all ingredients together and pour over the layer of Doritos. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered until hot and the cheese is melted.

title: Squash With Apple Filling
instructions: Pierce squash with fork in several places and bake whole until they are soft but still firm. Let cool until comfortable to handle. Cut squash in half and scoop out seeds. Fill squash cavity with apple pie filling and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg to taste. Dot with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 until hot about 20 minutes.

title: Ginger Ale Salad
instructions: Place the jello in bowl with about 1 teaspoon chopped ginger. Pour boiling water over and stir. Let stand about 5 minutes then add the ginger ale. Place in refrigerator until like maple syrup (about 45 to 60 minutes). Place the grapes grapefruit and orange in lightly oiled pan. Sprinkle with about 1 teaspoon chopped ginger. Lastly pour jello over fruit and chill. Serves 6.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Cook rice in 3 cups water and salt for 20 minutes. Add cooked and drained spinach onion 1/3 cup cheese salt and pepper. Stir in herbs and melted butter. Put mixture in casserole dish and add eggs beaten with milk. Sprinkle with remaining cheese dot with butter and bake 1 1/4 hours.

title: Mrs. Carraway'S Fresh Coconut Cake(From The Files Of Dessie Bell Hayes)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add dry ingredients with milk water vanilla and beaten egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix all this together. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with rice.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Butter baking pan 7 x 11-inches. Mix crumbs with melted butter. Press into buttered pan. Sprinkle on chocolate chips then nuts and then coconut. Pour milk evenly over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool on rack. Cut when cold.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Mix cocoa and sugar. Add milk and butter; cook for 2 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Stir in oats and drop spoonfuls onto wax paper until set.

title: Buttermilk Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Use the juice and enough water to make 1 cup liquid. Heat and pour over gelatin stirring until it is dissolved. Slowly stir in buttermilk. Add pineapple oranges pecans and whipped topping. Chill.

title: Sausage And Cornbread Pie
instructions: Cook sausage onion and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat until meat is browned stirring to crumble meat; drain. Add tomatoes chilies corn and chili powder; simmer 20 minutes. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish; set aside.

title: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Blend all spices with the flour. Rub spice blend into boned skinned breasts. Let chicken sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. Cut into pieces.

title: Oatmeal Scotchies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl combine flour baking soda salt and cinnamon; set aside.

title: Bacon & Egg Lasagna
instructions: In a skillet cook Bacon until crisp. Remove with slotted spoon to paper towel. Drain reserving 1/3 c. drippings. In drippings saute Onion until tender. Stir in Flour Salt and Pepper until blended. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Spread 1/2 cup Sauce in a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Layer with four Noodles a third of the Egg Bacon Swiss Cheese and white sauce. Repeat layers twice. Sprinkle with Parmesan Cheese. Bake uncovered at 350 for 35 - 40 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with Parsley. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting. Yield 12 servings.

title: Sausage And Cheese Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Layer bread cubes on bottom of flat baking dish. Beat eggs. Add milk salt and dry mustard. Place sausage and cheese over crumbs. Pour milk and egg mixture over all. Chill overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Bake uncovered.

title: Homemade Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni until tender. Take off of stove. Drain macaroni. Put in your cheese while hot. Turn stove on low to let cheese melt. Add your butter and milk and let all this melt together. Its very good.

title: Pecan Cookies
instructions: Mix pecans and confectioners sugar well. Add sifted flour and baking powder and continue to mix well. Add teaspoons of vanilla. Add whites of eggs that have been stiffly beaten. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet and bake until slightly brown. Have your oven a little less than 250\u00b0.

title: Angge'S Salad
instructions: Combine condensed milk cherry pie filling and pineapple. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill until set.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together adding Accent to taste. Great with celery carrot sticks cucumbers etc.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand at least 1 hour to blend flavors. Refrigerate.

title: Ham And Cheese Flips
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in small bowl set aside. Separate biscuits and place on ungreased baking sheet. Press or roll each biscuit into a 5-inch circle. Spoon 1/2 cup ham mixture onto half of biscuit. Brush edges with water. Fold dough over filling and press edges with fork to seal. Make a 1-inch crescent shaped slit on top of each turnover. Brush with milk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 5 servings.

title: Sarah Barbre'S School Rolls(Home Recipe)
instructions: Pour warm water in mixing bowl. Stir in sugar. Sprinkle yeast in and stir. Add oil. Mix flour dry milk and salt together; add to mixture. Beat well. Let dough rest awhile then roll out and cut. Place on greased pan and let rise. Bake at 450\u00b0 until light brown. Brush tops with butter. This dough may be let rise only once because the yeast has been upped in it. Rolls buns loaves cinnamon rolls or doughnuts may all be made from this dough.

title: Slushy Lemonade
instructions: In blender container combine lemon juice sugar and water. Add ice to make 4 cups. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses. Serve immediately.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and cover with sugar. Let set several hours. Mix Jell-O and boiling water and add other ingredients. Mix together with cranberries.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in bowl. Add cucumber onion green pepper vinegar mayonnaise and cottage cheese; mix well. Pour into serving bowl. Chill until set. Yield 6 servings.

title: Baked Grits Souffle
instructions: Cook grits; add margarine cheese milk and egg yolks. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered until set. Can be prepared the day before and refrigerated until time to bake.

title: Judy'S Potatoes
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl then add potatoes. Mix. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with melted margarine mixed with crumbled corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Freezes well.)

title: Twinkie Dessert
instructions: Put the Twinkies into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare the pudding mix with 2 cups milk. Pour over Twinkies. Cover with the Cool Whip. Sprinkle the Heath bars over top and refrigerate.

title: Giovanni Peppers
instructions: *More sweet than hot but do to suit own taste.

title: Crust Baked Chicken
instructions: Coat an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 2 3/4-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat whites chili powder salt and pepper in a bowl. Place bread crumbs on plate. Dip chicken in egg. Coat with crumbs. Place in baking dish. Oven bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Contains 156 calories; 1 gram fat; 470 sodium and 13 mg cholesterol.

title: Grandma'S Hot Dish
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add soup water and chow mein noodles. Stir all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or less.

title: Greek Salad For Two
instructions: In large bowl mix both lettuces and two cheeses. Place on salad plates and arrange vegetables so they look nice. Pour dressing over and serve with croutons.

title: Pieroghi
instructions: Potato Filling Boil potatoes and mash. Add grated cheese onion salt and pepper (no milk).

title: Pickle Squash
instructions: Soak squash in 2/3 cup salt with just enough water to cover squash. Boil syrup 15 minutes. Then add squash and bring to a rolling boil. Put in jars and seal.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Pour dressing over broccoli olives and tomatoes. Cover. Marinate in refrigerator 3 hours; drain. Add noodles cheese and Bac*Os. Toss lightly and serve.

title: Jello Pie
instructions: Make jello according to package directions. When it is half set blend in the whipped cream and whip the cream and jello together. Pour into the pie crust. (Optional Put Cool Whip on top or creme de menthe for decoration.) Cool in refrigerator for approximately 3 to 4 hours.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Soften cream cheese and butter. Beat cream cheese eggs butter and sugar together. Drain whole corn. Add remaining ingredients to mixture. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch dish at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Mamaw'S Oatmeal Cake
instructions: In boiling water add oats. Let stand 20 minutes then add butter and sugars. Mix with this the eggs vanilla flour soda cinnamon and salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Salmon Burgers
instructions: Drain salmon; flake in small pieces. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape into 5 patties. Brown on both sides. Best served on toasted hamburger buns.

title: Divinity Candy
instructions: In saucepan over low heat dissolve sugar water Karo and salt stirring. Cook without stirring to 248\u00b0 firm ball stage then remove from heat and pour slowly over the stiffly beaten egg whites. Add vanilla and continue beating with\tmixer until mixture will hold its shape and loses its gloss. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Put a pecan half on each spoonful.

title: Hot Asparagus Rolls
instructions: Cut off bread crust and slightly flatten with palm of hand or rolling pin. Mix together cheeses and egg; spread on bread. Place 1 asparagus stalk on each bread slice; roll up and secure with toothpick. Roll asparagus rolls in butter; put on cookie sheet and freeze. When completely frozen slice each roll into 3 pieces. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0 and bake about 15 minutes. They will keep warm in oven forever.

title: Sister Lorene Carroll'S Chocolate Fudge Icing
instructions: In a mixing bowl with a fork stir sugar and cocoa well. Pour all other ingredients in medium size saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly; boil for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge
instructions: Soften butter. Add eggs 2 at a time. Beat in between. Gradually add sugar. By hand stir in flour 3 1/3 cups frosting and walnuts. Pour in greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes. Cool for 1 hour then remove. Cool to room temperature before adding glaze.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix water oats and margarine and let stand 20 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. When you remove from oven pour on topping and broil a few minutes until topping is bubbly. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Low Country Boil
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a 3-gallon kettle and fill 1/3 of kettle with water. Boil 30 minutes. Can do earlier in day so seasonings can blend. Fifteen minutes before serving bring to a brisk boil. Add sausage and cook for 5 minutes. Add corn and cook 5 minutes. Blend in shrimp and cook for last 4 minutes. Strain away pot liquid and serve immediately in large bowl. Serve with cocktail sauce. Let guests peel their own shrimp. Place small bowls on table for hulls.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Saute butter onions celery and garlic. Cook rice according to directions. Add Rotel cream of mushroom soup Cheese Whiz jalapenos and green pepper. Add salt to taste. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Canned Cherry Pie
instructions: Mix the ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Pour hot thickened juice over pitted cherries. Mix lightly. Pour into pastry-lined pie plate. Dot with 1 tablespoon butter. Cover with top crust which has slits cut in it. Bake until nicely browned and juice begins to bubble through slits in crust. Serve warm. Cover edges of pie with aluminum foil to keep edges from getting too brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a brownie tin. Mix all of the ingredients together in a bowl. Pour into the greased brownie tin. Bake for 35 minutes or until brown. Cut into squares.

title: Busy Mom'S Potatoes
instructions: Wash potatoes. Cut into quarters. Place potatoes oil and dry soup in a 1/2-gallon Ziploc bag. Vigorously shake the bag until the potatoes are thoroughly coated. Place potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Cheesecake Squares
instructions: Spread one package of the crescent rolls in the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 13 inch pan. Beat the cream cheese 1 cup sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread over crust. Spread very carefully the second package of the crescent rolls over the top of the cream cheese mixture. Be sure to cover completely. Pour the melted butter over the top crust.

title: Death Of Chocolate
instructions: Prepare brownies and cool. Prick with fork and pour Amaretto over brownies. Prepare instant pudding. Break brownies into pieces.

title: Fluffy White Frosting
instructions: Mix the ingredients except for the milk in a suitable bowl. While beating add milk a little at a time until you get a fluffy consistency.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Pops
instructions: Melt chocolate margarine and syrup in small saucepan over low heat stirring until smooth. Remove from heat. Insert drinking straws (15) into marshmallows. Dip each marshmallow into chocolate turning until well coated. Scrape off sides of marshmallow. Roll in nuts coconut nonpareils or cereal. Place on greased waxed paper. Chill. Makes 15 pops.

title: Shrimp-Crab Casserole
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper with part of milk. Beat out lumps. Add cheese to rest of milk in a double boiler. When cheese has melted add flour mixture and Tabasco sauce. Stir until smooth and thickened. Add shrimp and crab meat. Pour in casserole; top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 minutes.

title: White Fruit Dip
instructions: With an electric mixer fluff the cream cheese. Add and mix marshmallow cream and vanilla. Chill if desired and serve with fruit.

title: Mulled Wine Blueberry Sauce
instructions: Pour the wine into a large skillet over high heat. Add the peppercorns allspice vanilla lemon zest lemon juice cinnamon sticks and nutmeg. Bring to a boil; cook over high heat until the wine is reduced to 2 cups about 15 minutes. Strain and return to the pan. Add the blueberries and sugar. Bring to a boil again. Reduce the heat; cook just until the berries pop. Use as a topping for pancakes fruit shortcakes or spoon over ice cream. Makes 3 pints.

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: First mix all of it together and then put it into 2 graham cracker crusts. Let chill for 40 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans in bowl with hands. Form a ball. Roll in pecans. Refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: *Can also use 6 chicken breasts 4 ounces apricot preserves 3 ounces dressing and 1/2 package onion soup mix.

title: Sweet Potato Chips(Microwave)
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes into thin slices. Sprinkle slices with cinnamon and sugar. Microwave on High for 4 or 5 minutes.

title: Main Dish Tater Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes onion butter and bay leaf over medium heat in a nonstick pan; stir almost constantly. Add chicken broth. Cook on medium heat for 30 minutes. Mix milk and flour in blender; add to potato mixture and cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add sour cream and stir until smooth. Garnish with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows pour over and mix with remaining ingredients.

title: Meat Loaf Hot Dish
instructions: Mix all together and put in a 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 then put mushrooms on top of meat loaf and make mashed potatoes and layer it on top of mushrooms and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake for 30 more minutes.

title: Country Breakfast Pie
instructions: Place bacon in a 9-inch pie plate. Cover with paper towels. Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp. Remove bacon. Reserve drippings in pie plate. Crumble bacon and set aside. Spread potatoes in pie plate. Microwave uncovered at High 6 to 7 minutes. Combine eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over potato mixture. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap. Microwave at High 6 to 7 minutes giving dish a quarter turn after 3 minutes. Sprinkle cheese and bacon. Cover and microwave at High 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes then cut into wedges. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening with sugar; beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each egg. Mix flour salt and baking powder. Add flavoring. Pour in tubed pan which has been greased and floured. Place in cold oven and then turn heat to 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 and bake for 60 minutes and then check to see when done. Takes about a total of 80 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: \Nuke\ each bag of vegetables for 5 minutes in microwave. Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over vegetables. Mix together. Add 3/4 of the cheese and 3/4 of the onions. Mix well. Add salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Sprinkle remaining cheese and onions on top and put back in oven for about 5 minutes until top is crunchy and crispy.

title: Very Berry Punch
instructions: Pour juice into punch bowl; slowly pour carbonated beverage down side of bowl to prevent loss of carbonation. Scoop sherbet and float on punch. Makes 24 servings.

title: Blue Ribbon Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs shortening butter and sugar. Mix together dry ingredients and combine with first mixture. Roll balls in sugar. Bake on greased cookie sheet after pressing ball down a little with bottom of sugared glass. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Yogurt Shake (Fat Free)
instructions: Blend in blender until mixed. Add vanilla chocolate or fruit.

title: Quick Fudge
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix ingredients in a double boiler over medium-high heat until melted. Spread in cake pan then refrigerate. Yields 2 pounds.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix and add 1 package Good Season Italian Dressing (prepared as directed) and 4 Tbsp. Salad Supreme Seasoning.

title: Italian Pita Triangles(Diabetic Appetizers)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brush pitas with margarine. Sprinkle with garlic powder basil and cheese. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cut into wedges; serve immediately. Yields 8 appetizers (1/4 pita round).

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: In a large saucepan combine green pepper onion tomatoes soy sauce water and pieces of steak. Bring to a rolling boil and turn down to low heat. Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Can also be cooked in crock-pot. Serve over rice.

title: Grandpa'S Secret Salted Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage into bite size pieces. Add Hawaiian salt and massage into cabbage until leaves turn darker green. Add brown sugar and grated ginger and mix well. If too salty drain out liquid and mix in ice cubes.

title: Impossible Chicken Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inches. Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in pie plate. Mix chicken 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese garlic powder oregano basil and tomato paste. Spoon over Parmesan cheese. Beat remaining ingredients in blender on high speed for 15 seconds with hand beater for 1 minute or until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake 30 minutes. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake 5 to 8 minutes longer or until knife inserted comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter and shortening until soft and creamy. Gradually add sugar and beat 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating until yellow disappears.

title: Grandma'S Waffles
instructions: Sift before measuring the flour. Resift with baking powder salt and sugar. Beat well the egg yolks. Add melted butter or oil and milk. Combine liquid and dry ingredients with a few swift strokes. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold into batter. Bake until golden.

title: Shoepeg Corn Salad
instructions: Mix vegetables together. Make marinade of sugar vinegar salt and oil; pour over vegetables. Refrigerate for 3 or 4 hours. Keeps 2 weeks refrigerated. Tastes best if made 2 or 3 days before serving.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Combine butter and sugar. Add 1 egg at a time beating after each. Slowly add flour with baking powder mixed into flour. Alternate adding flour and milk. Beat in oil and vanilla. Fold coconut into batter. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven. Let cool in pan.

title: Blueberry Sauce
instructions: Rinse fresh berries and drain well. In saucepan melt sugar and cornstarch. Add water and lemon juice. Stir until dissolved. Add berries and bring to a boil for 1 to 2 minutes or until clear and slightly thickened stirring carefully to avoid crushing berries. Serve warm or chilled over pancakes or white cake.

title: Quick Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast and about 1/2 of flour in the water. Beat about 2 minutes. Add egg salt Crisco and sugar. Let rise about 40 minutes. Stir down roll out and cut. Let rise to double in size. Bake.

title: Christmas Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine fruits pecans and 1/2 cup of sugar. Stir remaining sugar and flavoring into whipped cream. Chill thoroughly.

title: Mocha Walnut Cookies
instructions: Microwave 6 ounces chocolate chips. Dissolve coffee in water. Cream together sugars butter and dissolved coffee. Add egg and melted chocolate chips. Gradually add flour soda and salt; mix well. Stir in chocolate chips (and nuts if desired). Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops in skillet on both sides. Place in flat baking dish. Add Pepperidge Farm crumbs to drippings in skillet. Stir to absorb drippings. Spoon on top of each chop. Pour milk around chops not over dressing or it will float off. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered. Chops will absorb milk and dressing will brown.

title: Chicken Divan Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Place cookie sheet in oven to preheat. In a medium saucepan combine butter flour and pepper. Cook over low heat until mixture becomes thick and bubbly. Gradually stir in broth and milk until mixture begins to thicken; add cheese and stir until melted. Stir in chicken and broccoli. Pour mixture into pie shell.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Place softened butter sugar and egg in large mixing bowl. Beat until well creamed. Add chocolate; blend. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk/vanilla mixture to the butter and sugar mixture. Beat only long enough to form a soft dough about 2 minutes. Add nuts and beat a few strokes. Drop from teaspoon on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 to 12 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Banquette Of Chicken
instructions: Melt butter. Add chicken. Cook until seared but not brown. In a small bowl combine flour nutmeg salt pepper and dill weed. Sprinkle over chicken and stir. Cook over a low heat for 5 minutes. Do not brown. Add carrots onion and chicken broth. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and cook uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Slowly stir in half and half to make a creamy sauce. Serve over pasta or rice. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles using package directions. Saute ground beef and sausage in skillet until brown. Drain off drippings. Add tomato sauce and seasoning mix. Simmer for 10 minutes. Place 1 layer of noodles on bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole. Spread layer of ground beef sauce cottage cheese and Mozzarella over noodles. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Meal Muffins *
instructions: Sift together the dry ingredients. Beat together the egg and milk and add to dry ingredients along with oil stirring just enough to dampen. Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Dissolve coffee in water and cool. Add vanilla bean and vodka. Pour into container. Cover. Let stand for 30 days. Turn upside down once a week. Bottle. Makes great Sombreros Black or White Russians.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix egg and milk together. Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Shape into loaf and put into large loaf pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Drain excess grease. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Montana Tea
instructions: Mix and store in airtight container.

title: Burrito Casserole
instructions: Mix together the hamburger taco seasoning and refried beans. Mix the sour cream and mushroom soup together. Put half of the mushroom soup mixture then hamburger mixture then shells then other half of mushroom soup mixture then cheese. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0. Eat with lettuce tomatoes salsa and French dressing.

title: Sugarless Applesauce Cake(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Combine raisins fruit and water in a saucepan; cook uncovered until water is evaporated and fruit is soft. Set aside to cool. In a large bowl mix flour baking soda salt nutmeg and cinnamon. In another bowl mix eggs applesauce sweetener oil and vanilla. Add nuts and reserved fruit mix. Stir into dry mix. Pour into a greased 10-inch tube pan or 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Snicker Salad
instructions: Chop apples and snicker bars into very small pieces. Mix cool whip and cream cheese thoroughly then add apples and snickers. Mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Paprikash
instructions: Season chicken with 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Heat oil in large skillet. Add chicken and cook over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes until golden turning once. Remove with slotted spoon. Put onions and garlic in skillet and cook over medium heat 4 to 6 minutes stirring occasionally until onion is transparent. Add tomatoes water paprika caraway seed and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to boil. Return chicken to pan 20 to 25 minutes over medium. Stir occasionally. Remove chicken. Stir sour cream and flour into pan. Whisk until smooth. Boil until thickened. Spoon sauce over chicken. Serve with noodles.

title: Oriental Chicken
instructions: Combine lemon juice soy sauce sage ginger salt and pepper in casserole. Let chicken stand in this mixture for several hours in the refrigerator turning occasionally. Remove chicken from marinade (save). Coat with flour and brown in hot fat. Return chicken to marinade in casserole. Add onions and juice. Cover. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Swedish Tea Ring
instructions: Soften yeast in water; add sugar salt butter and eggs. Slowly add flour; beat well scraping sides of bowl. Mix until just stiff enough to knead. Turn dough onto floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Coat a bowl with butter and place dough in it. Cover with a damp tea towel and allow to rise approximately 30 minutes. Work dough down lightly re-cover and allow to rise again for 30 minutes Turn onto floured surface and roll into a 1 1/2-inch thick sheet. To make filling brush butter on dough. Mix sugar pecans and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over dough and roll as a jelly roll; cut into thirds. Braid thirds together and shape into a ring. Cover with a warm damp cloth and let it treble in bulk. Preheat oven to 425 degrees and bake for 30 minutes. Cool slightly. Mix remaining ingredients to make a glaze and brush on top of bread and serve.

title: Beef Cabbage Soup
instructions: Brown beef in oil. Add 2 cups of water bouillon cubes cabbage green pepper and garlic. Bring to a boil; simmer 1/2 hour. Add remaining vegetables. Cook until vegetables are done about 1/2 hour.

title: Fudge Sauce Topping
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Blend in water. Add milk. Bring to a boil. Boil gently until thick 3 to 4 minutes stirring often. Remove from heat. Add oleo and vanilla. Cover and chill. Makes 2 cups.

title: Spoon Bread For Two
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Melt margarine in small casserole. Add boiling water to self-rising corn meal; mix well. Add beaten egg buttermilk and sugar; mix well. Pour into heated casserole. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Brown meat and mushrooms in butter. Add salt sugar tomato sauce and paste. In a separate bowl mix cottage cheese cream cheese onions pepper and sour cream. Put 1/2 of mixture in bottom of casserole dish. Layer with noodles and beef mixture.

title: Impossible Turkey Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Sprinkle turkey mushrooms onions salt and cheese in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (about 1 minute) in blender on high speed. Pour into pie plate. Bake about 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Italian Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bottle. It is better to let it marinate for a couple of days or more. I triple this recipe and keep in refrigerator for days.

title: Blueberry Buttermilk Muffins
instructions: In small bowl combine buttermilk melted butter and eggs until blended.

title: Perfect Pastry Mix
instructions: Mix flour and salt into bowl. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Store in covered bowl in refrigerator for 1 month or less. Toss with fork to lighten before measuring. Mix 1/4 cup pastry mix with 2 or 3 tablespoons cold water for each 9-inch crust.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Wesson oil together and heat well. Holding cup high add 1 pint of Wesson oil in thin stream beating constantly.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs oil sugar and vanilla until thick. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 2 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Butter Cookies For Christmas
instructions: Put powdered sugar in a little at a time. Place well mixed dough in icebox and store overnight. Roll thin on a floured board and cut out shapes. Bake 5 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. (May be cut in half). Makes a lot.

title: Peach Cobbler Supreme
instructions: Melt butter in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Sift together dry ingredients. Add milk and stir well. Pour into the baking dish. Do not stir. Top with peaches including juice. Sprinkle nutmeg cinnamon and lemon peel over peaches but do not stir. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 40 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Winter Squash Dish
instructions: Mix ingredients; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cube the bread; brown in the butter. Put on top of squash. Place almonds on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Cheese Puffs
instructions: Combine ingredients. Let set overnight in refrigerator. Shape into balls the size of walnuts. Place on baking sheet. Cook in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 until brown. Yields approximately 75 to 100.

title: Sesame Flounder
instructions: Place fillets in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Drizzle with lemon juice; sprinkle with pepper. Saute onion green pepper and celery in apple juice concentrate until crisp-tender; spoon over fillets. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Put chops in pan. Season to taste. Slice onion on meat. Mix orange juice and catsup well. Pour over chops. Cover and bake 2 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Lemon Velvet Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients well. Bake in a tube pan that has been greased and floured. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Easy Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and sour cream in mixing bowl. Blend in dry jello. Add pecans and drained fruit cocktail. Put this mixture in a pan or dish. Chill in refrigerator for several hours.

title: Raspberry Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream the butter and brown sugar. Combine the oats flour baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Press three-fourths of the mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 in. baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0F for 11-13 min. or until set and edges begin to brown. Meanwhile in a small mixing bowl beat cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs vanilla; mix well. Spread over crust. Drop preserves by spoonfuls over cream cheese mixture. Spread evenly mix nuts and oats. Sprinkle over preserves.

title: Payday Bars
instructions: Combine syrup and sugar in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir constantly. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla. In a large bowl combine peanuts and cereal. Pour hot mixture over cereal and nuts. Stir carefully to coat the cereal. Put mixture into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Press down evenly with a rubber spatula. When cool cut into 24 squares.

title: Pumpkin Pie With Butterscotch Pudding
instructions: Place pudding powder in saucepan. Add spices and mix. Add milk gradually stirring constantly. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and is thickened. Remove from heat. Add pumpkin and mix thoroughly. Turn into 9-inch pie shell. Chill until firm.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Dip meat in flour brown. Add onion garlic and mushrooms; combine soup and seasonings; pour over meat. Simmer until tender about 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

title: P. T. A. Punch
instructions: Place frozen juice in punch bowl. Add 1 cold Mt. Dew in punch bowl and keep adding as needed. This punch has been served for all PTA and PTSO functions at Walker Elementary and Northside High School for the past 12 years. Im sure the tradition will continue with Northside Middle School. The students think you spend a lot of time on it and they love it; you will love it too.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream(Tastes Like A Frosty)
instructions: Let La Creme thaw enough so that you can mix it in with the other ingredients. This will make 4 quarts. Place in ice cream freezer and freeze as any other ice cream.

title: Lime Treat
instructions: Mix gelatin as directed. Drain pineapple and add to jello along with cottage cheese. Chill until jello is set. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Harriet'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Reserve 1/4 cup nuts and 1/2 cup parsley. Combine remaining ingredients until well mixed with beater or with hands. Determine if you want 1 large or 3 to 4 smaller cheese balls. Rip off approximate number of sheets aluminum foil and spread out on counter with piece of Saran Wrap on top of each. Divide nuts and parsley equally on Saran. Divide cheese mixture. Shape into ball; roll in parsley/nut mixture. Wrap in Saran then foil bringing up to top like Hersheys Kiss. Freeze. Thaw to serve. Great with Wheat Thins or Ritz.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Cut dough into 4 sections and then break into pieces as you dip into the following mixture. Melt margarine; add sugar and cinnamon. Place cherries and nuts into bottom of angel cake pan. Pour dough into pan. Set oven at 200\u00b0 and let dough rise for about 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Ursula'S Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut in strips twice the size of a French fry. Use a heavy saucepan. Almost cover with water; put lid on loose. Cook 10 minutes. Take cover off. Add butter salt cinnamon and sugar. Cook 1 hour slow on medium heat. Add Karo syrup. Cook 1 more hour. Occasionally give saucepan a good shake to keep from sticking. Never stir! The longer you cook the better they are!

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix wet ingredients and add dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0. Makes 1 loaf and 1 layer cake.

title: Love Knots
instructions: Combine sugar eggs milk and vanilla in mixer until creamy then add flour and baking powder a little at a time to mixture to make dough. Knead the dough about 5 to 10 minutes. Roll into knots and bake for 12 minutes. Rotate trays from bottom to top. Do not overbake. They must be white not brown. Let cool.
