title: Maple-Raisin Crisps
instructions: Mix oats and brown sugar in bowl. Add oil egg and maple flavoring; mix well. Sift in flour baking powder and salt; mix well. Stir in raisins and pecans.

title: Marshmallow Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain can fruit well. Add ingredients into bowl. Mix with wooden spoon or spatula. Mix well. Set in refrigerator for 2-3 hours to set. Serve cold.

title: Chile Con Queso
instructions: Combine Velveeta and milk in a medium saucepan over medium/low heat. Stir often as cheese melts. Be careful not to burn it. When cheese is melted add the remaining ingredients but not the tomatoes. Continue to cook over medium/low heat for 7 minutes stirring often to prevent burning. Stir in tomatoes and remove queso from heat. Pour queso into a serving dish top with crumbled ranchero cheese and serve with tortilla chips for dipping. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Guacamole Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients but tomato in blender; mix well. Add tomato and chill.

title: Make Ahead Oriental Salad
instructions: Drain canned vegetables well. Combine in large bowl with pepper onion and celery. Stir gently. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Cover and chill 24 hours before serving. Drain before serving.

title: Cold Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Stir well. Toss with remaining ingredients.

title: Icy Punch
instructions: Bring sugar and water to a boil. Remove from heat and add jello. Let cool slightly and add pineapple juice and orange juice. Freeze in Tupperware container. Let thaw about 4 hours before serving. Add ginger ale or 7-Up until slushy.

title: Egg And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Cream together cheese and butter spread on slice of bread and cut it in quarters. Beat eggs well; add milk salt and pepper. Put bread with cheese mixture on it in well-greased casserole. Pour egg and milk mixture over it and let stand overnight. Bake uncovered in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: In a skillet break up the meat and fry until done stirring constantly. Drain off grease. Stir onions into meat and saute a few minutes. Put meat mixture in a casserole. Add 2 cups of beans and 1 cup of brown sugar. Spread catsup on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in tube or Bundt pan at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Rice Pudding
instructions: In mixing bowl combine pumpkin sugar salt and spices. Stir in eggs. Add evaporated milk. Mix well. Stir in rice and raisins. Pour mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Place casserole in pan with water to depth of 1 inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Stir mixture until well combined. Bake 50 to 60 minutes more or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain. Beat eggs with milk salt mustard and pepper. Place bread slices in a buttered 9 x 12-inch casserole. Cover with cheese and a layer of sausage. Pour egg mixture over layers and sprinkle with a little extra cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Ham Caribbean
instructions: Trim fat from ham. Slash edges of ham at 1-inch intervals. Place on a rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Crab Mold
instructions: Mix cheese mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce. Add the rest. In a saucepan put the cream soup and Knox gelatine and add 3 tablespoons water. Mix together on low heat until gelatine dissolves. Let cool. Mix in all other ingredients. Pour into mold. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers on a platter.

title: Wedding Champagne Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in punch bowl or large bowl. Chill in freezer until slushy. Add orange slices to punch 5 minutes before serving.

title: Rouladen
instructions: Serve over egg noodles rice or salt potatoes.

title: All Day Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper roast and brown uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes in a deep roasting pan. Add onion soup mix 3 cups boiling water and brown gravy to make gravy. Add onion carrots and potatoes cut up to pan. Cover. Turn oven to 225\u00b0; let cook for the day.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: If making peanut butter fudge omit cocoa and add 1-1/2 cups peanut butter in place of pecans.

title: Mexican Independence Day Tamale Pie
instructions: In large skillet brown meat with garlic powder drain. In large bowl mix meat with remaining ingredients except cornbread mix and cheese. Spoon meat mixture evenly into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Fold cheese into prepared cornbread mix. Top meat mixture with cornbread and cheese mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Oyster Cracker Snacks
instructions: Put crackers oil and spices in a double paper bag and shake well. Store in a Tupperware container.

title: Drunken Stew
instructions: Mix soup onion mix and wine. Pour over meat. Cover and bake 3 hours in 300\u00b0 oven.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Cook onion bell pepper beef salt pepper and chili powder until done with lid on it. Then add rice. Place in pan to bake. Pour peas in center of mixture. Dab butter then pour tomatoes over top of all this and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Three Thing Pie
instructions: Dissolve Hershey bar in double boiler. Fold in Cool Whip stirring well. Put in pie shell and chill overnight.

title: Strawberries And Cream Cake
instructions: Generously spread one cake layer with frosting. Top this with all of the sliced strawberries. Spread the rest of the frosting on the second layer. Do not frost the sides of the cake. Decorate the top of the cake with whole strawberries. Refrigerate the cake until you are ready to serve it.

title: Karen Kuhlman'S Country Club Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until knife soft. Chop into bite size pieces. Add mayonnaise celery relish pickle juice mustard dill weed salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate overnight. Garnish with hard-boiled eggs.

title: Chili Enchiladas
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cans chili 2 tablespoons onion and 1 cup cheese; set aside. Spoon 1/3 cup of chili mixture in center of each taco shell. Roll up; place seam side down in ungreased baking dish (11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch). Spoon remaining chili over all. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and onion on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Combine water oats and butter. Let stand 20 minutes. Beat sugar and eggs together. Add to oat mixture. Beat in remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool cake 15 to 20 minutes. Put topping on cake and put under broiler for 1 to 2 minutes until it bubbles.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Saute seafood in 2 tablespoons butter. Add sherry gradually. Add white sauce; stir to blend. Place in casserole. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Mix the cans with the ginger ale and add either the champagne or sherbet just before serving.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
instructions: Mel butter in saucepan. Add flour and stir. Add milk salt pepper and mustard. Stir until thick. Add cheese and stir until melted. Meanwhile cook potatoes until almost tender. Drain. Pour potatoes in casserole bowl. Pour cheese mixture over potatoes. Add ham mix. Dot with ham cubes. Bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Marshy Muffins
instructions: Mix together as normal muffins except mash 1/2 cup blueberries and add to ingredients. Add the rest of blueberries by hand and mix in. Sprinkle muffins with granulated sugar before baking. Pour into greased muffin cups and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Sweet Potatoes Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.

title: Karen'S Chili
instructions: Cook beef and sausage. Add all ingredients to crock-pot and cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Layer in order listed in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 35 to 45 minutes until bubbly.

title: Carrot Chicken With Rice
instructions: Add crushed garlic butter lemon juice salt pepper and honey to chicken; cook until lightly brown. Add mushrooms and carrot; cook 5 minutes on medium heat. Serve over rice with broccoli pieces.

title: Crustless Egg Custard
instructions: Cream eggs and sugar. Add remaining ingredients; beating well. Pour into a lightly greased and floured 10-inch pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients then add slightly beaten egg and fruit cocktail. Put into cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Put in jar or coffee can and stir until well blended. To make 1 cup or mug put 2 teaspoons in cup; add hot water.

title: Creamy Tacos
instructions: Brown ground meat in large skillet. Drain fat. Mix in Ro-Tel and cream. Cook on low heat. Cream will scorch easy. Cut cheese into cubes and mix into meat mixture. Let simmer for 20 minutes or so. Cajun seasoning can be added for spicier taste. Pour over Fritos and eat.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes on low.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Balls
instructions: Mix bread crumbs with hamburger; shape into balls and brown. Mix tomatoes soup water spices seasonings onion green pepper and celery. Add meat balls; simmer for several hours. Serve spaghetti with meat balls and sauce. Yields 6 servings.

title: Hunter'S Stew
instructions: Let each person in camp fix their own dinner. Wrap in 2 layers of foil. Put veggies on foil first. Season and put meat on top. Wrap foil. Cook over coals for 1 hour.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar peanut butter and egg. Drop and press down with fork on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Ohio State Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Combine cocoa boiling water and soda; let cool while creaming shortening. Add sugar gradually creaming thoroughly. Add cocoa mixture after each egg. Add unbeaten eggs. Add milk and flour alternately beginning with flour and ending with flour. This makes a large cake. Can be made in three layers. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Almond Brittle Bars
instructions: Cream butter or margarine until light and fluffy. Beat in the vanilla. Add the sugar slowly and continue creaming until well blended. Beat in the egg yolk. Stir in the flour and combine thoroughly. (Do not beat in or the cookies will be tougher.) Pat mixture into a lightly greased 15 x 10-inch baking pan.

title: Spanish Rice(Arroz Con Tomate)
instructions: In skillet cook green pepper onion garlic basil and rosemary in hot oil until vegetables are tender. Stir in rice chopped tomatoes salt pepper and 2 cups water. Cook covered over low heat for about 20 minutes or until rice is done. Makes 4 servings.

title: Granny'S Barbecue
instructions: Cook meat until tender; flake and finely chop meat. Blend all ingredients in large bowl except catsup and barbecue sauce. If mixture is a little sour add more sugar. Add catsup and barbecue sauce as needed. Boil until thick stirring often. Pour over meat and simmer 10 minutes. Serve over buns with cole slaw if desired.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Trim crusts from bread and butter lightly on one side. Crumble sausage and cook until lightly browned. Drain. Lay out 6 slices of bread in a 3-quart casserole buttered side up. Sprinkle half of the sausage and half of the cheese over bread. Repeat with bread sausage and cheese. Beat together eggs milk and salt. Pour over sausage and cheese. Press down on bread until milk comes through. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until puffed and brown. Serves 6.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Chop seasonings. Fry sausage. Add livers and fry until done. Add seasonings to meat and cook for about 10 minutes. Add 1 cup of water and let boil. Add cooked rice. Add Accent garlic salt and pepper to taste. Prepare Uncle Bens rice according to directions on box. Add to other ingredients.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Marinate with Season-All salt lemon juice and any other seasonings you want. Cook in low oven (150\u00b0) covered overnight or until done. Serve with barbecue sauce.

title: Decorator Icing
instructions: Beat Crisco salt and water until thoroughly mixed. Then add cornstarch flavoring and powdered sugar one cup at a time. Beat for 5 minutes or until icing is very creamy. Great for decorating cakes. Keeps well in a sealed bowl in the refrigerator.

title: Juicy Meat Loaf
instructions: Pour milk over cracker crumbs and mix all ingredients together. Bake uncovered for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Filled Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Cream shortening and sugars. Beat eggs and vanilla until fluffy and add to shortening mixture. Mix well. Stir in sour milk (which can be made by adding vinegar or lemon juice to whole milk) and flour mixture. Stir well. Chill dough in refrigerator for several hours. Turn out dough on lightly floured surface; roll and cut with biscuit cutter. Place a teaspoon of filling on each bottom piece. Seal with another. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Clusters
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a full boil for one minute stirring constantly. Add vanilla and peanut butter; stir until smooth. Add oats and mix well. Cool slightly until mixture holds shape. Drop by tablespoons onto wax paper or use 1 teaspoon for dipping up then push off with a second teaspoon. Allow to cool then store in a tightly covered container.

title: Hoosier Pudding
instructions: Slice cake crossways into 3 layers; separate. Prepare pudding using 2 1/2 cups milk. Stir in 2 cups Cool Whip. Spread 1/2 pudding mixture on bottom layer; top with 1/3 pineapple and cherries (split in half). Repeat with second layer. Place third layer on top. Frost entire cake with Cool Whip. Garnish with pineapple and cherries. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Chris' Mayonnaise
instructions: Whizz egg yolks in blender with a dash of vinegar then pour in oil in a thin stream until mixture emulsifies. Add more oil and a small amount of vinegar until desired texture then add mustard garlic salt pepper and tarragon.

title: Pepparkakor
instructions: Sift together flour baking soda salt ginger cinnamon and cloves onto waxed paper. In a large bowl of electric mixer with the mixer at high speed beat the butter granulated sugar and 1 egg until light and fluffy. Add molasses and lemon peel. Beat until well blended. With wooden spoon stir in flour mixture; mix with hands until well blended and smooth. Divide the dough into 4 parts. Wrap each part separately and refrigerate overnight.

title: Rice Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Top with cheese and paprika. Bake in moderate oven until bubbly and cheese has melted. Based on 6 servings 268 calories per serving; 10 g. fat; 555 mg. sodium; 91 mg. cholesterol.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Heat butter; brown mushrooms slightly. Heat cream in a separate pan. Take off heat; stir in egg yolks vigorously a little at a time. Still stirring add Mozzarella and 1 cup Parmesan. Salt and pepper to taste. Add cream and cheese mixture to ziti and mushrooms. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan on casserole. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Lazy Pot Roast
instructions: Place beef in a roaster or casserole. Sprinkle a package of dry onion soup mix over meat. Add soup mixture. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 until tender (about 45 minutes per pound). Serve with the gravy that has formed.

title: Quick Nut Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts. Heat over low heat stirring constantly until smooth. Add nuts and mix well. Spread quickly in buttered 9 x 5-inch pan. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Saut onions and peppers in butter. Combine all ingredients. Pour in casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Blend flour salt and shortening with pastry blender until it resembles coarse meal. Then add water stirring with fork. Bake at 425\u00b0 until golden brown 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Speedy Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl; beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until well blended. Pour filling into pastry shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center of the pie comes out clean. Cool.

title: Sour Cream Banana Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar together. Add mashed bananas to creamed mixture. Sift together flour soda baking powder and salt. Add the beaten eggs and flour mixture to the first mixture; mix well. Fold in the 6 ounces of sour cream and nuts. Bake in two greased 8 1/2 x 5-inch loaf pans for one hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Country Brunch Skillet
instructions: In large skillet cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon; crumble and set aside. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons bacon drippings. Add potatoes green pepper onion salt and pepper to drippings; cook stirring occasionally until potatoes are browned and tender (approximately 12 to 15 minutes).

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add marshmallow cream; mix well. Stir in Cool Whip topping; mix until smooth. Pour into 8-inch baking dish and place fruit selected on top. Or serve plain. Refrigerate for 4 hours. Make own graham cracker crust for 8-inch baking dish.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix salmon and egg with fork. Add 1/2 cup sifted flour and stir (mixture will be thick). Add pepper onions and Worcestershire sauce. In the 1/4 cup salmon juice put the baking powder; beat with fork until it foams. Pour this into salmon mixture and mix with fork.

title: Gazpacho Salad
instructions: Sprinkle cucumbers with 1 teaspoon salt; let stand for 30 minutes. Combine next 6 ingredients in large salad bowl. Next add mushrooms and scallions. Drain and pat dry cucumbers; add to the bowl then add parsley tomatoes and green pepper. Cover; chill 4 hours. Just before serving add Swiss cheese and toss then. Add garnish of hard-boiled egg slices.

title: * Catch-All Casserole *
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water for 15 minutes; drain. Mix in corn string beans tomatoes tomato sauce and cheese. Cut in small pieces. Brown hamburger and add to mixture. Bake in greased casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and freeze.

title: Hashed Brown-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes in colander. Let stand until completely thawed and excess moisture has drained off. Combine sour cream soup and butter. Mix well. Add salt onion and cheese; mix well. Blend in potatoes. Place mixture in shallow 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle buttered crumbs on top. Bake uncovered in preheated oven (350\u00b0) about 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Do not assemble over 2 hours before baking.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In medium bowl mix the crushed pretzels melted butter and 3 tbsp. sugar. Press firmly into 10 inch dish pie pan or casserole dish. Bake 8 minutes. Set aside to cool.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Mix together until well blended. Spread on 8 slices of ham. Roll and fasten with toothpicks. Chill for 12 hours. Slice and serve.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine milk rice sugar and salt in large pot. Cook over high heat stirring occasionally until boiling. Reduce to medium heat for 45 to 60 minutes; stirring every few minutes so mixture does not stick to bottom of pan.

title: Carrots
instructions: Combine margarine sugar allspice pepper and lemon juice in pan over low heat until blended. Drain carrots and add to pan. Simmer about 3 minutes until flavors are blended. Serve immediately.

title: Sesame Seed Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients; roll 1 1/2 inch in diameter. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate. Slice 1/4 inch in thickness. Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Homemade Beans
instructions: Cook beans until done. Cook onion pepper and bacon. Combine ingredients with beans and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Melt butter and chocolate. Remove from heat; stir in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; beat lightly just until blended. Dont overbeat. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread batter in pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Cool. Cut.

title: Chocolate-Pecan Fudge
instructions: Melt butter in medium saucepan. Remove from heat; stir in cocoa. Stir in confectioners sugar and vanilla. Add evaporated milk. Stir constantly over low heat until warm and smooth. Add pecan pieces. Pour into foil lined 8-inch square pan; chill. Store covered in refrigerator. Makes 5 dozen squares.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon and crumble. Cook beans and drain. Chop onion. In casserole dish add soup beans onion bacon and cheese. Top with french-fried onions. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Ita'S Fajitas
instructions: Cut fajitas in thin strips; season with meat tenderizer and garlic salt to taste. Set aside in refrigerator. Slice next four ingredients into thin strips. Brown fajitas in oil. Add sliced vegetables and cook until tender. Pour over hot iron skillet and squeeze orange over fajitas. Serve sizzling hot.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Remove cartilage from crab meat. In a large bowl blend the cream cheese sour cream salad dressing lemon juice Worcestershire dry mustard garlic and milk. Mix until smooth and creamy. Fold crab into mix with 2+ tablespoons of Cheddar cheese. Pour into greased 1-quart baking bowl. Top with remaining Cheddar. Bake at 325\u00b0 until brown and bubbly (approximately 30 minutes). Best served with stone wheat crackers.

title: Pat'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix and bring to a boil in a heavy pan the sugar oleo and milk. Stir constantly until soft ball stage (10 to 12 minutes). Remove from heat and add peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme. Stir well. Add nuts if you like. Pour into a 10 x 15-inch pan.

title: Sandy'S Fabulous Corn Stuff
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. On stove top melt butter in casserole. Mix in creamed and plain corn sour cream and Jiffy mix. Bake in 2-quart covered casserole (8 x 8-inch) for 1 1/2 hours covered and 30 minutes uncovered. Makes 6 servings.

title: Texas French Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in a jar. Shake vigorously. Makes 1 quart.

title: Broiled Fish Fillets
instructions: Arrange fillets in broiler pan. Brush with lime juice. Broil for 6 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients in small bowl. Mix well. Spread over fillets. Broil for 2 minutes longer. Makes 3 servings.

title: Impossible Vegetable Pie
instructions: Set oven to 400\u00b0. Heat 1-inch salted water to a boil. Add broccoli. Cover and cook until almost tender (about 5 minutes). Drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli cheese onion and green pepper in greased 10-inch pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach and squeeze out water. You may also use a microwave to defrost but do not cook. Add sour cream Ranch dressing chopped water chestnuts and spinach. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving. Serve in hollowed out pumpernickel round loaf. Cut hollowed bread pieces to dip.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Melt butter; add green pepper and mushrooms. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove pepper and mushrooms. Blend in flour milk broth and seasonings and cook stirring constantly until sauce boils. Add chicken pepper and mushrooms. Cook until chicken is heated. Serve hot over biscuits.

title: Mamaw Atwood'S Pound Cake(Club Member: Laine Shoemake)
instructions: Put in long greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Boil macaroni until cooked drain and rinse in cold water. Put macaroni in boil. Add all ingredients; mix well. Salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Cherry Nut Salad
instructions: Pour Eagle Brand condensed milk into large bowl; add cherry pie filling pineapple (drained) Cool Whip and pecans. Mix well with spoon and refrigerate overnight.

title: Meat Balls And Baked Beans
instructions: Combine milk ground beef cracker meal egg chopped onions garlic salt salt and mustard; mix thoroughly. Shape into balls. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until done.

title: One Dish Fruit Salad
instructions: A little coconut and other fruit may be added.

title: Russian Tea Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in covered jar or container until ready to use. (Makes a great going-away gift for college etc.) For 1 serving place 1 to 2 teaspoons mix in micro-proof cup. Add water or cider; cook on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Makes 64 servings.

title: Broccoli-Ham Ring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Coarsely chop ham broccoli onion and parsley. Coarsely grate cheese; mix all ingredients except rolls and set aside. On flat stone or cookie sheet arrange crescent rolls in a circle with bases overlapping and point to the outside. There should be a circle about 3-inches in diameter in center. Spoon filling over bases at the center. Fold points of triangle over filling and tuck under bases at the center. Filling will not be completely covered. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Add 1 cup chopped onion to sausage after all grease is removed and cook stirring often for 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
instructions: Cut and steam broccoli. Melt cheese and mix with broccoli. Add heavy whipping cream. Salt and pepper to taste. Water or milk can be added to reach desired consistency.

title: Hot Salad Dressing(Can Be Used For Lettuce Or Endive.)
instructions: Fry bacon and set aside. Blend the flour into the grease and brown. Add the vinegar and stir until thickened. Mix together the sugar and pepper; add to the mixture. Pour over the beaten egg yolk; mix well. Put on heat again and cook 1 minute longer. Add the bacon bits and stir. Pour over salad while still hot.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Combine syrup sugar and water and vinegar. Boil until syrup hairs. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour over popcorn. Form into balls. Eight ounces of chocolate syrup can be added to sugar water and syrup mixture in beginning.

title: Barb'S Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes; dice celery onion and carrots. Cook carrots celery and onions for 5 minutes. Then add potatoes and cook 10 minutes longer or until potatoes are done. Add oleo salt and pepper to taste.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into crusts. Chill and serve.

title: Purple Cow Shake
instructions: Pour juice and milk in blender. Add ice cream. Blend 30 seconds. Serve.

title: Fideo Mexicano (Vermicelli)
instructions: In a large skillet add enough cooking oil to cover bottom. Add the vermicelli (crushing the noodles a little) into the heated cooking oil. Stir on medium high to brown the vermicelli.\tAdd onions and continue to stir until onions are translucent. Add the remaining ingredients mixing well. Put on lowest heat cover and cook until vermicelli is soft (about 15 to 20 minutes). During this period DO NOT STIR as it will make the pasta mushy.

title: Macaroni Sauce
instructions: Put tomatoes in large saucepan. Let it come to a boil crush it and let it boil for about 40 minutes uncovered. Add drippings from Meatballs and\tSausage and the meat.\tLet boil for another 1/2 hour with the meat. At same time you add the meat add the basil about 3 to 4 leaves or 1 teaspoon dry and salt. Then put in the tomato paste with the water and sugar and\tlet boil another 40 minutes. Stir often\tthoroughly. Serve with your favorite pasta. Skim sauce if necessary.

title: Asparagus Supreme
instructions: Make a sauce with butter flour and milk. When thickened and smooth remove from fire. Add chopped onion and cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Add beaten egg yolks and blend well. Carefully add the asparagus cut in small pieces. Season to taste. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour into a buttered casserole dish and bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for about 30 minutes or until center is slightly firm. Serves 6.

title: Spinach And Artichoke Dip
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together in a glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes covered. Serve hot with tortilla chips salsa and sour cream.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container or blender. Process until smooth. Store in refrigerator. Makes approximately 1 cup about the same amount as a can of commercial type but at a lower cost. Use in pies candies frostings and desserts.

title: Spice Marinade For Meat
instructions: Mix ingredients together and set aside in a covered jar for whenever you need it. When youre ready to marinate the meat for every 3 to 4 pounds of meat put 2 tablespoons of the dry mixture 1 medium onion 2 garlic cloves 2 tablespoons olive oil and 2 tablespoons lemon juice in a food processor and blend. Smear over the meat and let marinate in the refrigerator overnight or at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours before grilling.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients; put into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake for 2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix the flour and potatoes together. Add the eggs and salt. Fry the pancakes to a crispy brown.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut steak into four pieces trim fat. Coat steak with flour. In dutch oven pour oil and brown meat over medium-high setting. Add tomatoes soup celery salt and onion rings. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook over a low heat for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Strawberry Milk Shake
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender. Cover and blend (liquefy) until smooth. Makes about 2 (8-ounce) servings.

title: Lemon-Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and shortening. Gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine sour cream and milk. Stir until smooth. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream mixture. Mix just until blended after each addition. Stir in lemon and vanilla extracts. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Thicken Strawberries
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together with cold water. Add everything else together except berries; cook until thick. Pour over berries.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine and shortening with electric mixer for 30 seconds. Add 1/2 of the flour egg sugar milk baking powder vanilla and salt. Beat until thoroughly combined. Beat in remaining flour. Divide dough in half. Cover and chill for 3 hours.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with 1 can of pecan and coconut frosting or German chocolate frosting.

title: Turkey Pot Pie
instructions: In a large bowl mix all the ingredients and set aside. Then use my Never Fail Pie Crust recipe and make 2 pie crusts. (The recipe makes 3 crusts you can save the remaining dough in a Ziploc bag. It will keep for days in refrigerator or you can go ahead and roll out crust in an aluminum pie pan and put in plastic bag and freeze for later use). Use a deep pie pan. Spray with nonstick spray. Lay first crust then pour in turkey mixture. Then fold top crust and make 3 cuts 1 1/2 inches long at a slant. Move 1/2-inch on each side and repeat. Then open crust and lay over the top. Gently go around the pie and tuck the top crust behind the bottom crust. Use fork and press together or finger fan around crust. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine; gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg and beat until mixture is smooth. Combine flour and soda; add to peanut butter mixture mixing until well blended. Shape dough into 1 inch balls and then place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheets. Flatten into 2 inch rounds with a fork in a cross hatch pattern. Bake at 350\u00b0 for\t8 to 10\tminutes or until firm.\tTransfer to wire racks to cool. Yields 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Mini Meat Loaves Wrapped In Bacon
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except bacon. Shape mixture into 6 loaves. Crisscross 2 half slices bacon on each loaf. Tuck ends under loaf. Place on shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered for 50 minutes.

title: Green Pea-Bacon Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Mel'S Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients in large mixing bowl in order given. Add mayonnaise until desired consistency. Add milk. Mix well. Chill. Enjoy!

title: Lemonade Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add flour alternating with lemonade. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes. After baked brush with lemonade.

title: Never Fail Divinity Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and water together and boil until mixture will spin a thread when dropped from a spoon. Have egg whites beaten stiff and pour half of syrup into egg white a little at a time beating hard. Return other half of the syrup to heat and cook until it will form a ball when dropped in a cup of cold water. Mix all together beating well and add nuts salt and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Pour into lightly greased pan or dish. When cold cut into squares.

title: Roast Beef And Gravy
instructions: Cover the bottom of baking pan with foil. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Season roast with salt pepper and garlic. Place in pan with dry soup mix around. Add soup and cover with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes per pound or until done. If more gravy is desired double sugar dry soup mix and cream of chicken soup. Gravy is delicious!

title: Momma'S Eggplant Fritters
instructions: Peel and slice eggplant. Cook in water over medium heat about 30 minutes; drain rinse and mash eggplant. Add eggs and salt and pepper to taste. Melt butter; add to eggplant mixture. Add enough cornmeal to form patties. Heat 1/4 inch of oil in skillet to frying temperature. Drop from spoon into heated skillet. Cook approximately 15 minutes until browned on both sides.

title: Angel Food Trifle
instructions: Alternate 3 layers each of cake pieces pudding and whipped topping in a 3-quart serving bowl. Garnish the top with the almonds and cherries for a festive holiday dessert. Best to refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Yields 15 to 20 servings.

title: Turkey Chilli(Low-Fat)
instructions: Brown ground turkey onion salt and pepper. Add chilli seasoning chilli beans and salsa. Add tomato juice if you want thinner chilli. Simmer about 1 hour and serve.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Spread 1/2 crumb mixture in bottom of large pan (9 x 13-inch). Pour in jello. Cover with rest of crumbs. Place in refrigerator and chill.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chopped chicken in 9 x 13-inch pan. Drain veg-all and sprinkle over chicken. Chop eggs over veg-all. On top of stove melt butter in large pan and blend in flour and seasonings. Stir in broth and milk. Boil 1 minute. Pour over chicken mixture. Top with biscuits. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven till biscuits are done.

title: Donna'S Hot Dish
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water until tender then drain. Put macaroni and rest of the ingredients into baking dish mixing well. Top with cheese. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight.

title: Green Beans Caesar
instructions: Cook beans. Cut into 1-inch pieces. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Toss beans with salad oil vinegar onion salt garlic and pepper. Pour into ungreased 1-quart casserole. Stir together bread crumbs cheese and butter. Sprinkle over beans. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes or until heated.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat; spoon off fat. Add next 5 ingredients. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook noodles according to package; drain. Combine rest of ingredients except Mozzarella cheese. Set aside. Place half the noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; spread with half the cottage cheese mixture. Add 1 package Mozzarella cheese and then half the meat sauce. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be made ahead and refrigerated. If so allow 15 minutes longer in oven when baking. Layer noodles cheese mixture Mozzarella cheese and meat mixture. Repeat.

title: Cream Cheese Chewies
instructions: Mix together. Pour over cake and bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all dry ingredients together. Cut shortening into dry mixture until it resembles fine crumbs. Add milk; stir gently until the dough holds together. Turn onto lightly floured board and knead about 12 strokes. Do not overwork the dough. Just roll it into balls using your hands or use a rolling pin. Arrange biscuits about 1 inch apart on a baking sheet; bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Lebkuchen
instructions: Mix together the honey with 1/4 pound sugar. Boil skim and cool. Then add sifted cake flour. In separate pan mix the brown sugar and 1/4 pound white sugar eggs spices and soda which has been dissolved in brandy citron orange peel lemon peel grated lemon rind and baking powder. Mix the nuts with the all-purpose flour and add to the batter.

title: Indian Candy Was-Nah
instructions: Mix well refrigerate 1 hour. Roll into small balls and serve or store in refrigerator.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes in 9 x 14-inch baking dish. Sprinkle onion over potatoes. Melt butter pour half over potatoes and onion. Put cheese soup and sour cream in boiler and heat until well mixed. Pour over potato mixture and stir well. Add rest of butter to bread crumbs. Spread on top of mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Coleslaw Dressing
instructions: Mix last 5 ingredients together and add to cabbage several hours prior to serving. Makes enough for a family of 8.

title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter or margarine in an 8 x 11 x 2-inch size pan. Set aside.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: In large skillet brown steak. Add tomato sauce pepper strips onion and mushrooms. Sprinkle with seasonings; simmer for 45 minutes. Serve with rice or creamed potatoes.

title: Claire'S Peanut Butter And Jelly Sandwich
instructions: Spread lots of peanut butter on one side of each piece of bread. This will keep the jelly from soaking through the bread. Put lots of jelly on top of the peanut butter on one slice of bread and place the other slice of bread peanut butter side down on top of the jelly. Flip the sandwich over so that the slice of bread with jelly on it is now on top. This allows gravity to pull the jelly down to the peanut butter on the other slice. Help gravity out by \smooshing\ the slices of bread together so that the jelly sort of sticks to the peanut butter. Dont cut the sandwich. Its ready to eat. Just take a bite and offer some to a passerby.

title: Green Chili Canapes
instructions: Mix and spread on bread. Broil until puffy and brown.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Crumble 1/2 cake in bottom of punch bowl or large glass pan then pour 1 pudding mix prepared over cake then 1/2 pineapple then 1/2 can pie filling 1/2 coconut and 1/2 pecans. Repeat with remaining ingredients in layers. Chill overnight. Drain maraschino cherries chop and place on top for looks.

title: Pepperoni Bites
instructions: For filling In a bowl combine Mozzarella cheese pepperoni and pizza sauce. Set aside.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in gallon container that is airtight. To make 1 cup hot cocoa use 3 tablespoons of mix per 1 cup boiling water; stir. Top with marshmallows.

title: Cheerio Nuggets
instructions: Combine sugar butter syrup and salt in a saucepan and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until bubbly around edges. Continue stirring 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda until mixture is foamy.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Melt margarine and blend in brown sugar. Cook over low heat for 2 minutes stirring. Add milk and continue stirring until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Blend in powdered sugar gradually. Add vanilla and mix well.

title: Grounded Skroodles
instructions: In large Dutch oven fry bacon until crisp. Remove from pot and set aside. Saute onions in bacon grease. Add ground round; sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt and fry until browned. Stir and mash while it is frying until it becomes crumbly. Return bacon to pot and add the next 10 ingredients (green peppers tomatoes tomato sauce tomato paste salt pepper Italian seasoning Worcestershire sauce Parmesan cheese and sugar). Mix together and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes. Stir occasionally. Cook noodles according to box. Drain and add to sauce. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Honolulu Seafood Salad
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Immediately drain in a colander. Rinse with cold water and drain.

title: Unbelievable Lasagne
instructions: In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan spread about 1 cup sauce; arrange a layer of uncooked lasagne. Top with some sauce Ricotta Mozzarella Parmesan and sauce. Repeat. End with a final layer of lasagne; pour remaining sauce. Make sure all lasagne is covered. Top with Mozzarella and Parmesan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Allow to stand for 15 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Easy Beef Burgundy
instructions: Mix all ingredients in dutch oven or other large pot. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours stirring occasionally. No need to brown meat. Serve over noodles or rice.\tMakes large quantity.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread the rolls in a lightly greased 12 pizza pan pressing the perforations to seal them. Combine the eggs bacon cheese and mushrooms pour over the crust. Bake at 375\u00b0f. 190\u00b0c. gas mark 5 for 12-15 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: *Reserve 1/4 cup crumbs to sprinkle on top.

title: W. W. Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Add all other ingredients. Beat on low speed until well beaten or blended. Divide evenly into 2 cake pans. Spray pans well with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add jam then eggs milk and flour. Mix by hand and add other ingredients. Mix and bake in 4 greased and floured pans and bake at 375\u00b0 until done. Cool in pans for 10 minutes then cool on racks.

title: Mint Patties
instructions: In mixer bowl add Karo margarine and extract. Beat. Stir in sugar one cup at a time. Turn out onto sugared surface. Knead adding sugar until stiff. Divide into 2 sections. Add food coloring. Roll into 1-inch balls. Flatten with a fork. Let them sit on waxed paper overnight.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix flour butter and nuts; press out in baking dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Sidewalk Paint
instructions: Mix cornstarch and water. Add food coloring and stir. Repeat to make more colors. Washes away with water.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix all together with mayonnaise and dill pickle juice to taste.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Grind tomatoes onions and peppers in food processor and chop; pour off juice. Add to vinegar brown sugar and salt. Cook for 15 minutes stirring to prevent sticking. Mix the cornstarch and mustard with enough water to make a paste. Add to mixture and cook 2 minutes. Then add mayonnaise. Stir well. Fill hot sterilized jars to top and seal airtight.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix and form into balls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: German Bacon Slaw
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Dice or crumble bacon and reserve 2 tablespoons drippings. Combine drippings with vinegar mayonnaise salt and pepper. Toss cabbage with onion green pepper and celery. Add dressing just before serving. Garnish with bacon bits. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1 cup cracker crumbs saved to\tsprinkle on top of casserole.\tBake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Bake
instructions: Cook peeled potatoes in boiling water until tender but not mushy. Drain and cool. Combine next four ingredients in medium saucepan. Stir in apricot nectar hot water and orange peel. Bring to full boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in butter. Cool slightly; stir in pecans. Cut sweet potatoes in halves and place in casserole. Pour sauce over potatoes so all are glazed. If desired cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake covered in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until sauce is bubbling. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Blend together 1 cup mayonnaise 1/2 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons vinegar. Mix vegetables and raisins together and chill. Just before serving add 1 cup chopped nuts and 1 pound bacon (cooked crisp and crumbled).

title: Finnish Pancakes
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix milk and eggs lightly with beater then add sugar salt and flour. Pour batter over melted butter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 23 minutes. Serve with maple syrup jelly or butter.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil sugar and water for 5 minutes. Add butter. Pare potatoes; slice and arrange in buttered baking dish. Pour over 1/3 syrup and bake until brown in moderate oven (350\u00b0) basting twice with remaining syrup. Serves 6.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Mix mustard salt pepper and flour. Dredge steak in mixture. Brown well in fat. Put into roasting dish and sprinkle meat with onions carrots Worcestershire sauce brown sugar and tomatoes. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Fred'S No-Cook Strawberry Jam
instructions: Clean strawberries and crush thoroughly one layer at a time measuring 4 cups into a large bowl. Combine pectin with 1/4 cup sugar. Gradually add pectin mixture to fruit stirring vigorously. Set aside for 30 minutes stirring frequently.

title: Florida Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix cornmeal flour salt baking powder and pepper in bowl. Add milk and eggs. Stir to blend. Add onion and blend. More milk or cornmeal may be needed after onion is added to produce desired consistency. (Hush Puppies should be fried after fish is fried as heat should be reduced somewhat for them.)

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook meat onions and peppers together; drain. Mix flour and tomatoes. Add meat to vegetable mixture then spices and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes. Cook noodles and drain. In 2-quart baking dish sprayed with nonstick spray layer noodles cheese and meat mixture. Sprinkle evenly with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Stir together crumbs sugar cocoa and butter. Press onto bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. In a larger mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk then peanut butter chips until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Pour over crust. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until center is set. Cool. Refrigerate.

title: Nutty Ham And Cheese
instructions: Combine cream cheese pecans onion and garlic salt. Spread on roll. Layer remaining ingredients. May be heated in foil.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Cook cherries pineapple and sugar to boiling point. Add jello to hot mixture stirring well to dissolve jello. A few drops of red food coloring may be added if desired. When partially congealed add nuts and refrigerate.

title: Cheese Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes with jackets on. Cool peel and grate. Melt butter and mix with soup; mix all ingredients except potatoes. Mix well. Add potatoes and mix again. Bake in a 3-quart casserole 1 hour at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: A Good Teacher
instructions: Mix this together in a crock-pot. Boil on low for 5 months. Then add a spot of glue and a sprinkle of baking soda. Drop on the floor and youve got a good teacher.

title: Herbed Lentils And Rice
instructions: Combine broth lentils onion uncooked rice wine and seasonings. Stir 1/2 of cheese into lentil mixture. Turn into 1 1/2-quart ungreased casserole. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until lentils and rice are tender stirring twice. Top casserole with remaining cheese; return to oven. Bake until cheese melts.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Combine cranberries and sugar. Dissolve jello in hot water; add syrup and chill slightly. Add cranberry mixture pineapple nuts and celery. Pour into mold chill until firm. Serve on crisp lettuce. Pass mayonnaise.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Fry ground beef with onion and drain off fat. Combine spaghetti sauce to beef. Cook lasagna until done; drain off water. In a large cake pan put a layer of lasagna then a layer of beef and sauce then one each of the cheeses until everything is used usually about 3 layers. Then put into the oven about 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Mexican Cheese Bake
instructions: Beat milk eggs and Bisquick together until smooth. Before pouring into dishes sprinkle 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese into each dish. Pour Bisquick mixture over cheese dividing equally between the two dishes. Bake 25 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mash bananas fine; add lemon juice. Mix in buttermilk. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs then vanilla. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hacienda Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese salsa and salt until well blended. Spread cheese mixture in microwaveable pie plate or bowl.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan. (Do not grease.) Test for doneness with toothpick.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain and beat eggs with milk salt and mustard. Add bread cubes cheese mushrooms and sausage. Pour into greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 1/4 cups boiling water. Drain pineapple and mix into jello. Mix cranberry sauce into jello. Let set slightly and add nuts.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Slice bananas and sprinkle with lemon juice. Strain the juice from the cans of fruit and mix the dry instant pudding in and stir. Pour over fruit and refrigerate.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Pour into greased 11 1/2 x 8 1/2 baking pan. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes until edges are golden brown.

title: Shoepeg Corn Salad
instructions: Mix vegetables together. Mix oil sugar salt and vinegar together and pour over vegetables. Best prepared 24 hours before serving.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Cook peas drain and cool. Cut up hard-boiled eggs. Combine all ingredients and add enough mayonnaise to hold together. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Hamburg Soup
instructions: Fry hamburg with chopped onion. Drain excess grease. Add tomatoes and enough water to make 2 quarts. Add barley salt parsley and pepper. Simmer for 1 hour. Add mixed vegetables and simmer for another 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Beat condensed milk and cream cheese to a smooth consistency. Pour in large bowl containing drained fruit cocktail pineapple tidbits mandarin oranges and diced apple. Blend thoroughly. Chill or freeze an hour before serving. Yields 15 servings.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Heat margarine in a heavy saucepan or skillet. Add and saute onion and pepper. Add flour; stir and cook until bubbly. Add chicken broth milk salt and pepper to taste. Cook stirring constantly until smooth and thickened. Add chicken and parsley. Heat through and serve over rice noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate. Add Rice Krispies. Stir until coated. Press into a greased 9-inch pie pan.

title: Quick Pepper Jelly
instructions: Combine jelly and pepper in small saucepan. Cook stirring over low heat until jelly melts about 5 minutes. Transfer to small bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.

title: Marinated Slaw
instructions: Mix cabbage with onion and pepper.

title: Slumgullion
instructions: Heat shortening in skillet. Brown beef; drain. Combine all ingredients except pickle in slow cooker; stir. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours or high 3 to 4 hours. Stir in chopped pickle. Makes 8 servings.

title: Snicker Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together place in pie pan and freeze.

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Pizza
instructions: Beat margarine and peanut butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds in a medium-size bowl. Add 1/2 cup of the flour sugar brown sugar egg and vanilla. Beat until thoroughly combined. Beat or stir in remaining flour. Press dough evenly onto a 12 or 14-inch pizza pan that has been lightly greased forming a rim around the edge. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with marshmallows and chocolate chips. Bake 5 to 8 minutes more or until marshmallows are puffy and lightly browned. Immediately sprinkle with M&Ms. Cool cut into wedges. Makes about 10 slices. Kids love it!

title: Artichoke Heart Dip
instructions: Mince artichoke hearts very fine or use food processor. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake in greased dish at 375 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Seafood Salad(Serves 10)
instructions: Pour the ingredients in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add over top a package Pepperidge herb stuffing mixture then pour 1/2 cup melted butter over stuffing. Bake uncovered 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Hershey'S Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour pan (two 9-inch or 13 x 9 x 2). Stir together flour sugar cocoa baking powder baking soda and salt in mixing bowl. Add eggs (which are at room temperature) milk oil and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Mix in the boiling water or hot coffee (I prefer coffee). Batter will be thin. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes for round pans or 35 to 40 minutes for rectangular pan. Check with toothpick. Cool and frost. Great with peanut butter cooked icing.

title: Low-Fat Cabbage
instructions: Cut cabbage up in small parts. Bring water to a boil with bouillon cubes and pepper. Add cabbage; cover with lid and let simmer for 10 minutes on medium heat.

title: Sugar-Free Rhubarb Crisp
instructions: Mix rhubarb water cinnamon 1/4 cup flour and 24 packages Equal. Pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix 1 cup flour oatmeal 24 packages Equal and oleo. Put this topping on top of the rhubarb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Melt butter for later. Combine Crisco in boiling water; add sugar and salt and let cool. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Beat in egg; add to first mixture and flour. Mix well. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Knead and roll on floured board to 1/4-inch thick. Cut in various sizes. Dip one piece at a time in melted butter and drop around in Bundt pan. Let set for 1 hour then bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add flour and blend well. Add milk slowly. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add corn and sugar. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add eggs. Mix thoroughly. Turn into greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Spinach Bake
instructions: Combine spinach cottage cheese and nutmeg. Fold stiffly beaten egg whites through the spinach mixture. Pour into a nonstick baking dish or use pie plate sprayed with Pam. Top with diced Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes (until firm).

title: April'S Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef in large pot. Drain off fat. Add seasoning mix and tomatoes. Cook for approximately 30 minutes. Add Ragu sauce and heat thoroughly. Serve over noodles.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; add onion and garlic. Add salsa and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes. Tear tortillas into bite size pieces. In buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish layer half of the tortillas half of the meat and half of the cheese; repeat. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Garnish rim with chopped tomatoes and 3 dollops of sour cream down the center.

title: Calico Bean Bake
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon shortening until tender. Add catsup and remaining ingredients. Turn into 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar syrup and salt. Mix well. Stir in melted butter vanilla and pecans. Pour into pastry shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until firm. Makes 3 regular pies.

title: Spaghetti Squash With Meat Sauce(Microwave)
instructions: Cook ground beef 3 to 4 minutes in a 2-quart casserole on full power. Drain fat. Add onion carrots celery and garlic; combine well. Cover and cook 8 minutes longer or until vegetables are soft; stir several times while cooking. Add remaining ingredients except Parmesan cheese and squash. Cook covered on full power 5 minutes then at half power 15 minutes. If sauce is too thick add additional water.

title: 5 Minute Cobbler
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan melt butter at 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl mix sugar milk and baking powder. Pour mixture over hot melted butter. Place canned fruit of any kind evenly over batter. Pour juice over all. Then sprinkle 1/2 cup of sugar over that. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit 15 minutes. Serve topped with ice cream or whipped cream. (Personally I like pears used with this best.)

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Stir sugar and chopped nuts into Master Mix. Combine milk and beaten egg; add to mix and blend well. Bake in greased loaf pan in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) about 1 hour. Yields 4 x 6-inch loaf.

title: Fried Pie Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients like regular pie dough. Then add milk and egg and mix.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
instructions: Mix and press mixture of cake mix butter and egg into 9 x 12-inch pan. Then mix together powdered sugar butter eggs and cream cheese until creamy. Pour over cake mix. Top with chopped pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Mix
instructions: Combine ingredients. Top with 1 cup grated cheese and 3/4 cup potato chips. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: White Lasagne
instructions: In a large skillet melt 2 tablespoons butter. Saute mushrooms until lightly browned. Add wine and tarragon and cook over medium heat until juices have evaporated. Set aside.

title: Hawaiian Meatballs
instructions: Cut bell peppers in strips. Season ground beef with salt and ginger. Make approximately 16 small balls. Combine egg and water. I dip each ball into mixture and then roll in flour. Saute in hot oil in large frypan (brown). Add brown sugar cornstarch or flour vinegar and soy sauce. Heat stirring constantly until sauce thickens. Boil 3 minutes and add meatballs peppers and pineapple in syrup. Cover and simmer approximately 30 minutes.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flour 7-Up and extract. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pop'S Spanish Rice
instructions: Saute pepper and onion until tender. Add beef; cook. Add tomato sauce and chili powder. (Needs to be extra spicy; rice will absorb hot taste.) Add rice and 1 to 1 1/2 cups water. Stir. Cover and cook for 20 minutes over low heat. Stir occasionally.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles; save juice. Cut pickles lengthwise in quarters then in half (8 pieces each pickle). Put back in jar; layer with peppers and garlic. Dissolve sugar in pickle juice (save 1/2 cup of juice; dont use). Pour rest over pickles. Set at room temperature for 24 hours then put in fridge.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots covered in small amount slightly salted water about 15 minutes. Add green pepper cover and cook 3 minutes more. Drain pineapple; save juice. Combine sugar cornstarch and salt; stir in reserved juice vinegar and soy sauce. Cook and stir until bubbly. Stir in vegetables and pineapple; heat thoroughly.

title: Cherry Pie Cake Or 1, 2, 3 Cake
instructions: Grease an 8 x 10-inch square cake pan. Put in cherry pie filling first. Next cake mix then melted margarine. Sprinkle brown sugar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocoladamias
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan heat margarine or butter and half of white baking bar or pieces over low heat just until melted stirring occasionally (mixture will separate). Meanwhile coarsely chop remaining white baking bar or pieces; set aside. In a mixing bowl beat with an electric mixer until foamy. Add sugar then beat on high speed for 1 minute until light. Add margarine mixture flour vanilla and baking powder. Beat until thoroughly combined scraping sides of bowl often. Stir in nuts and remaining chopped white baking bar or pieces.

title: Pecan Bars
instructions: Beat eggs and stir in sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a well-greased 8-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool on board. Cut into squares.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 360\u00b0 for 45 minutes in greased pan.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients well. Add the flour. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Put in a 450\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Fill large cooking pot at least 1/2 full. Brown ground beef and drain. Mix together all other ingredients except macaroni and potatoes. Cook around 30 minutes then add macaroni and potatoes. Serve when potatoes are tender.

title: Bottom Of The Bag Pie
instructions: Take 1/4 cup of cereal powder crumbs; set aside. Mix remaining crumbs and butter to make crust for pie. Pat mixture into bottom of greased pie pan. Then add pie filling on top; spread evenly. Sprinkle the 1/4 cup cereal crumbs on top. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Sourdough Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients then add flour one cup at a time to make a firm dough.

title: Methodist Corn Bread
instructions: Sift the first 6 ingredients together then add the egg oil and buttermilk. Stir only until moist. Pour into greased iron skillet that is lined with bacon. Bake for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0; bake for 15 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Octoberfest Sausage Brunch
instructions: Combine eggs\tcream\tmustard salt and pepper until well blended. Add 3/4 cheese sausage and pepper.\tPour mixture into 8-inch square baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake until cheese melts. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil water; add chicken breasts and cook for 30 minutes. Cut up into chunks. In an 8 x 10-inch or larger pan layer casserole Broccoli cut into medium-size pieces; chicken and water chestnuts; soups mixed together with milk and poured over chicken. Sprinkle crackers and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all except catsup together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done. Spread catsup on top and bake for about 10 minutes.

title: Korean Barbecued Beef(Bulkokee)
instructions: Cut beef diagonally across grain into 1/8-inch slices.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa. Add eggs and vanilla beat until smooth. Mix in flour. Add butter and mix thoroughly. Pour into a greased 13x9 pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Won Ton
instructions: Fry hamburger and pork; drain fat. Chop finely and add other ingredients. Lay a won ton wrapper on flat surface. Put about 1 tablespoon filling just below the center and wet edges of dough. Fold one corner of the dough over the filling to make a triangle and pinch edges of dough together to seal. Pull corners base together and pinch to seal. Repeat this process until all wrappers are used or filling is used.

title: Colonial Fried Chicken
instructions: Combine flour and seasonings; roll the chicken in the flour mixture. Using a Dutch oven or other heavy deep pan fry the chicken in shortening at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes on each side or until tender.

title: Tomato Appetizers
instructions: Place tomatoes in bowl of chilled vodka. Serve on toothpicks with kosher salt.

title: Orange Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add one egg at a time beating well after each addition. Add orange juice beat well. Add flour beat well. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour or until done. Yields 15 servings.

title: Brandy Slush
instructions: Mix together and freeze. Serve with 7-Up. Garnish with cherry or orange slice.

title: No-Bake Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar milk and butter in pan. Boil. Cook 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Stir. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: World War Ii Pudding
instructions: Cream shortening vanilla and dark Karo syrup. Add beaten egg. Beat well. Add pudding mix and beat again. Measure flour salt and baking powder. Add to first mixture alternating with milk.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together folding in sour cream. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Bacon
instructions: Cook bacon over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently until crisp. Stir in pecans and cook 1 minute until roasted. Drain all but 1 tablespoon fat from skillet; remove bacon and pecans to a paper towel. Add Brussels sprouts and stir to coat with remaining bacon fat. Stir in apple juice cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer 8 to 10 minutes (for frozen) or 10 to 12 minutes (for fresh). Before serving add bacon pecans salt and pepper.

title: Big Batch Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Knead flavor packet about 10 seconds. Mix cookie mix flavor packet egg and flour in a large bowl until moist (dough will be stiff). Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in nuts. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until set 9 to 10 minutes. Immediately and carefully press thumb in center of each cookie. Cool completely on wire rack. Fill thumbprints with frosting and candies. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Heat corn and milk together until hot. Gradually stir in eggs. Add 1/2 cup cracker crumbs and minced onion to taste; mix well. Pour into a buttered round casserole dish.

title: Christmas Cheer Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water; bring to a boil. Continue to cook for 5 minutes. Cool. Combine juices. Add cooled sugar-water mixture.

title: Butterscotchies
instructions: Melt chips and add peanut butter. In large bowl get ready marshmallows and chow mein. Grease 9 x 13 pan. Pour chips and peanut butter over noodles. Mix and spread in pan.

title: Cauliflower Broccoli Bake
instructions: Combine all except for 2 tablespoons butter and stuffing. Fold in veggies and gently toss. Put in casserole dish. Mix stuffing and butter and sprinkle over vegetable mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour into parbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes or until firm almost to the center.

title: Orange Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange chicken breasts in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Drizzle the butter evenly over the chicken breasts and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Aunt Rose'S Dilly Creamy Cukes
instructions: Peel and thinly slice cucumbers; slice onion and set aside. Mix sour cream vinegar sugar salt pepper and dill weed. Add cucumbers and onions; mix well and chill.

title: Easy Summer Punch
instructions: Chill ingredients thoroughly. Combine ginger ale and grape juice in punch bowl. Add fresh strawberries to float in punch as a garnish.

title: Hearty Italian Sausage Soup
instructions: Brown sausage green pepper and onion. In soup pot combine other ingredients except macaroni and cheese. Add browned ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes. Add uncooked macaroni and simmer until tender about 10 minutes. Before serving sprinkle cheese on top. Serves 4.

title: Celery Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients in soup pot and boil until tender. Cool; put in blender with 1/2 teaspoon margarine. (Only 14 calories per cup.)

title: Hamburger Pie Casserole
instructions: Brown the hamburger and onion in oil. Place in a casserole dish. Add tomato soup and green beans. Spread mashed potatoes on top. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Aunt Agnes' Real Coconut Cake
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients. Let stand 2 hours stirring frequently until sugar is dissolved and \milk\ is drawn (it gets really juicy). Punch holes in layers with fork stack and fill layers. Refrigerate leftovers. Better made one day ahead.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Brown and drain sausage and beef. Add cheese and let melt then add spices. Spoon onto bread and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve or freeze.

title: Hostess Cupcake Filling
instructions: Beat for 15 minutes. Use pastry bag; insert into cupcakes. Frost.

title: Oreo Cookie Cake
instructions: Mix pudding and milk. Place in refrigerator. Crush cookies (keep out 1/2 cup for garnish). Place remaining crushed cookies in 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour melted margarine on top; mix and press into pan. Mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip and place on top of crust. Chill for 30 minutes. Put pudding onto cream cheese mixture. Spread second 1/2 of Cool Whip on top of pudding. Sprinkle reserved cookie crumbs on top.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: In a pie plate or shallow bowl combine butter mustard worcestershire and salt. In a plastic bag combine bread crumbs and cheese. Dip chicken in butter mixture then shake in crumb mixture. Place in an ungreased 13 X 9 baking pan. Drizzle with any remaining butter mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Prepare cake and pudding according to package directions. Then crumble one layer of cake in bottom of punch bowl. Pour one-half of pudding mix over cake. Crumble other layer of cake into bowl and pour rest of pudding mix over that layer. Add pineapple then cherry pie filling then topping. Sprinkle nuts on top and chill.

title: Old Southern Grated Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: In a heavy iron skillet melt butter. Mix all ingredients adding the beaten eggs last. Bake in skillet at 375\u00b0. Stir several times while baking. Bake 40 minutes. The iron skillet makes a crunchier crust.

title: Mama'S Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar milk and cocoa in saucepan. Bring to boil. Cook 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter and stir until frosting begins to thicken. Spread on layers.

title: Sam'S Pesto Sauce
instructions: In a blender or food processor whirl to a paste the basil parsley pine nuts olive oil and cheese. Add salt and pepper blend to a smooth consistency. Serve with cheese tortellini or linguine.

title: Twinkies Delight
instructions: Split Twinkies lengthwise and arrange with split sides up in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare pudding as directed on box. Pour over Twinkies. Layer bananas on top and top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Charlie'S Crayfish
instructions: Chop onions bell pepper and celery. Melt margarine in pot; add chopped vegetables. Saute. Add crayfish; squeeze juice of lemon over crayfish. Sprinkle with Tonys seasoning. Simmer for 20 minutes covered. Add soups Ro-Tel Worcestershire Tabasco and soybean sauce. Simmer 20 minutes covered. Serve over rice.

title: Raspberry Bars
instructions: Cream the butter and brown sugar until fluffy. Mix dry ingredients (except oatmeal) and stir into creamed mixture. Add oatmeal and 1 tablespoon of water. Mix until crumbly. Firmly press half of mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread with jam. Stir 1 tablespoon of water into remaining half of crumb mixture. Sprinkle over top. Pat smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Yogurt(Homemade)
instructions: Boil milk until it comes to boil then take off stove and put in bowl. Add already done yogurt (called starter) then when boiled milk gets cooled down somewhat (when you can count to ten and still hot but not too hot) mix together with milk. Cover well and leave 2 hours or more.

title: Tuna Italian
instructions: Cook onion in small amount of oil until tender but not brown. Add soup milk and cheese; heat and stir. Break tuna into chunks add with remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese and paprika. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Top with minced parsley and ripe olive slices. Pass lemon wedges to squirt over. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pecan Delight Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add vanilla salt and sugar. Beat until incorporated. Add crackers and pecans. Pour in greased pie plate and bake 30 minutes. Let pie get completely cool. Top with whipped topping. Chopped pecans may be sprinkled on top.

title: Grilled Sesame Chicken Breasts
instructions: Wash chicken pieces pat dry and set aside. Combine all remaining ingredients in shallow pan (or ziploc bag). Mix well. Add chicken turning to coat; cover and marinate in refrigerator 4 hours. Remove chicken from marinade reserving marinade. Grill 4 to 5 inches from medium hot coals 12 to 15 minutes basting frequently or broil in oven.

title: Chicken 'N' Rice(On The Grill)
instructions: Place each chicken breast on 14-inch square of double thickness heavy duty aluminum foil. Mix soup and rice spoon over chicken breast. Sprinkle with paprika if you wish. Wrap securely in foil. Place on grill 5 inches from hot coals. Cook about 40 minutes or until done turning once.

title: Cajun Spices
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in a tightly covered container. Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Unfold fillets and place one at a time between 2 sheets of wax paper; pound with a flat-surfaced mallet until about 1/4-inch thick. Combine flour salt and pepper; coat breast fillets with mixture. Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat; add chicken and cook 3 to 4 minutes per side until done.

title: Peppermint Rounds
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well. Add egg and vanilla beating well. Combine flour and salt; add to butter mixture. Stir in oats and candy. Cover and chill 1 hour. Divide dough in half. Roll each to 1/8-inch thickness on a surface dusted with powdered sugar. Cut with a 2 1/2-inch cookie cutter; place on greased foil-lined cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Chop ice cream into small pieces and then add other ingredients. Serves 35.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Add milk to make stiff batter. Drop by spoon into hot fat and fry until brown. Especially good with fish.

title: Potato Cake (Chocolate)
instructions: *Put chocolate squares in oven or microwave to melt.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Combine sugar and shortening then add bananas and eggs. Mix well. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk then add to mixture. Add salt and nuts. Mix well. Gradually add flour a little at a time while mixing well. Pour in greased and floured bread pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: German Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oil water and eggs together on low speed with mixer about one minute. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl. Continue beating on low speed for 2 minutes. Add container of frosting and continue beating on low speed for two more minutes. Grease bundt pan and pour in batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Let cake cool in pan.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Dice or slice the potatoes. Add remaining ingredients except milk. Simmer to well done. Mash lightly. Add milk. Cook just to boiling.

title: Rice Turkey Casserole
instructions: Put all into a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Stir together and bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Beans And Beef
instructions: Cook bacon. Brown ground beef. Mix bacon and beef with all other ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend all ingredients and form ball. Roll in finely chopped nuts. Chill.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan. Mix flour baking soda salt and cinnamon in a large bowl. Whisk oil and eggs in another bowl until blended and smooth. Stir in sugar and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture until blended. Stir in apples nuts and raisins. Spread evenly in pan. Bake 40 to 50 minutes until top is golden. Let cool on wire rack. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Salted Peanut Crisps
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix thoroughly in bowl shortening brown sugar eggs and vanilla. Set aside. Stir in another bowl flour salt and baking soda. Mix the dry ingredients into the shortening mixture. Stir in the salted peanuts. Drop by rounded teaspoons about 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet. Grease the bottom of a glass. To flatten each cookie dip glass in sugar and press down on cookie. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Apple Slice Cake
instructions: Beat sugar and eggs together. Add flour salt and soda. Stir in other ingredients. Bake in glass dish for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Punch
instructions: Mix 2 cups sugar Kool Aid and pineapple juice. Add ginger ale and ice. Serve.

title: Busy Day Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place rice in bottom of casserole. Lay chicken pieces on top. Mix soup and water and pour over chicken. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Put peanut butter butter and chocolate chips in bowl. Place in microwave for 2 to 3 minutes or until it comes to a boil. Stir in powdered sugar to desired thickness. Spread onto buttered platter.

title: Horseradish Sauce
