instructions: Melt margarine and stir in flour. Slowly add broth stirring. Stir in rest of ingredients and simmer until thickened. Do not boil.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all together. Spread on tortillas. Roll up tortilla and slice about 1-inch thick. Serve with hot sauce or salsa.

title: Rainy Day Dinner
instructions: Combine all in pan. Add water. This is delicious with meat broth or beef bouillon cubes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Great Gramma Smith'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar salt ginger molasses and shortening. Dissolve soda in water and add flour. Mix all together and let stand until thoroughly cold. Roll into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Date Pecan Balls
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add vanilla and mix well. Add flour and mix. Mix in pecans and dates. Roll teaspoonfuls of dough in balls. Refrigerate balls for 1 to 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 on greased cookie sheet for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and roll balls in powdered sugar. Sprinkle them again with powdered sugar when cookies have cooled.

title: Round Steak Sauerbraten
instructions: Cut meat in 1-inch squares. Brown meat in 1 tablespoon hot shortening. Remove meat from skillet. Add gravy mix and 2 cups water. Bring to boiling stirring constantly. Stir in next 6 ingredients 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Add meat. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove bay leaf. Serve on noodles. Makes 5 or 6 servings.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in oleo. Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Combine remaining ingredients with onion celery and broccoli. Pour into a greased shallow 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Picnic Beans
instructions: Drain beans and place in 2-quart casserole. Dice bacon and fry until crisp. Remove bacon from pan. To the bacon grease add the water sugar dry mustard and onions. (If bacon is very fat all the grease does not have to be used.) Simmer 10 to 15 minutes stirring frequently. Pour over beans; add bacon and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 1 hour. Stir once or twice while baking.

title: Deep-Dish Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger and onion. Drain grease. Add water and tomato paste. Simmer 10 minutes. Spread biscuits in dish that is greased to make crust. Pour mixture over biscuits and add cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Baskin Robbins Dessert
instructions: Mix ingredients and press into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Rinse and drain. Mix together green pepper onion carrot and pimiento and add to macaroni. Mix together Eagle Brand milk sugar vinegar mayonnaise and salt. Pour over macaroni mixture. Refrigerate before serving. Makes lots!

title: Cabbage Surprise
instructions: Cut cabbage into small wedges. Boil until tender. Drain. Fry bacon until crisp. Crumble and sprinkle over cabbage along with cheese.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: In a saucepan combine all of ingredients. Bring to a boil; simmer 10 minutes. Cool. In a quart jar layer 9 shelled hard-cooked eggs and 1 medium onion sliced. Fill jar with pickling brine. Cover. Refrigerate 48 hours before using. Keeps 2 months refrigerated.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Microwave first 3 ingredients for 3 minutes. Turn and bake 3 minutes more. Add last ingredients. Stir and microwave 10 minutes. Microwave on High setting.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Melt margarine in large saucepan. Add onion and green pepper. Saute for 5 minutes. Add hamburger; cook stirring until lightly browned. Add mixed vegetables soup and 3 cans of water. Add any diced leftover vegetables desired. Stir in pasta. Season with salt pepper sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until vegetables are tender and soup is thick. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Bernaise Sauce
instructions: Boil together vinegar wine shallots 1/2 tablespoon dried tarragon and seasoning until reduced to 2 tablespoons. Strain reserving liquid and cool. In a blender put yolks lemon juice and reserved liquid. Mix at high speed. While mixer runs add butter in a steady stream. When blended add fresh tarragon. Keep warm on top of double boiler to thicken. Great on steak and shrimp kabobs!

title: Jimmy Carter Cake
instructions: Layer #1 Work flour and margarine together as for pie crust. Add peanuts and press into bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Lazy Daisy Cake
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and vanilla. Beat until thick. Add sifted dry ingredients. Heat milk and butter to boiling point. Add to mixture. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Roll and cut into very small biscuits or put into a cookie maker. Sprinkle with sesame seed; cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. In separate bowl mix flour potato chips and remaining ingredients until blended. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Chicken-N-Dressing Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in boiling water until tender. Remove from broth. Strain broth reserving 2 2/3 cups. Bone chicken and cut into small pieces. Combine chicken soup with half the broth; mix well. Combine mushroom soup with remaining broth; mix well. Combine stuffing mix and butter; reserve 1/2 cup for garnish.

title: Jb'S Hearty Breakfast Waffles
instructions: In a very large bowl stir together the flour oats baking powder cinnamon and salt. In a small bowl stir together the eggs milk butter and brown sugar. Add to flour mixture and stir until blended.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Saute onion and celery in bacon drippings until onion are limp. Add next five ingredients. Cook 2 minutes. Add potatoes mayonnaise eggs and bacon. Toss lightly. Serve hot and garnish with olives.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients by hand. Take out 1 cup crumbs for top. Mix remaining ingredients. Mix liquid and pour over crumbs. Beat and put in pan. Put crumbs on top and bake for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Beef Noodle Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in butter. Add garlic sugar salt pepper and tomato sauce. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Mix onions with cream cheese and sour cream. Cool meat mixture and noodles. Grease 2-quart casserole dish. Alternate layers of noodles cheese mixture and meat mixture. Repeat. Sprinkle top with grated cheese. Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Snicker Doodles Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening 3 c. sugar eggs & vanilla.

title: Mawe'S Fudge
instructions: Put in skillet cocoa sugar and salt and stir. Add butter vanilla and milk. Bring to a boil stirring frequently. Cook to 232\u00b0 or soft-ball stage. Remove from heat and beat until thick. Turn into buttered pan. Cut squares before it gets too hard.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Then add the rest of ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool and frost with cream cheese.

title: Sauteed Trout
instructions: Heat butter in large skillet; add fish and brown on one side about 3 minutes then turn over and cook until flaky. Place fish on a heated platter. Place almond slivers and lemon juice in skillet and cook 2 to 3 minutes until almonds are toasted. Pour almond mixture over fish.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Arrange apple slices in a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan and sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine flour sugar cinnamon and oatmeal. Add melted butter and mix until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until apples are tender and top is golden brown. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Lasagna With Cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute mushrooms onion and garlic in olive oil. Split this mixture in half and set one aside. Add to the remaining (in large skillet) the tomato sauce paste and tomatoes. Add also the oregano basil salt pepper bay leaf red wine and fresh cilantro. Let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Red Devil
instructions: Make toast; put aside. Heat soup with a little milk. Add grated cheese; stir until cheese is melted (should be a little thick). Arrange toast points on plate; spoon mixture onto toast. This is good for lunch with a salad.

title: Bourbon St Beans
instructions: 1. Soak beans overnight. Drain water and place beans in crock pot. Add fresh water until beans are covered. 2. Saute onions garlic and peppers in olive oil and add to crock pot. 3. Add worcestershire sauce and slow cook for 2 hours. 4. Add hot sauce salt and pepper to taste. Dice ham and add before slow cooking for 2 hours or until beans are at desired consistency.

title: Ice Cream Cake(Low-Fat!)
instructions: This cake should be made 2 days ahead. In 3 bowls break cake into bite-size pieces. Sprinkle each bowl with one box of dry Jell-O. Layer in tube pan as follows

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Drops
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Shape into balls and chill for awhile. Melt chips Hershey bar and paraffin over low heat or double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate. Cool on wax paper.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Sift together sugar flour soda salt cinnamon nutmeg and cloves. Add to dry ingredients oil eggs and vanilla. Beat well then add apple nuts and raisins. Mix well. Pour into greased pans (1 Bundt or 2 loaf or 4 mini). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or so 35 to 40 minutes for mini pans.

title: Holy Guacamole!
instructions: Slice avocadoes in half; remove skin and toss; remove pit and save. Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Blend until mixture is slightly lumpy. To keep guacamole from turning brown either squeeze juice of 1/2 lemon over top or place avocado pit in mixture. Cover tightly and refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Frozen Caramel Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese and Eagle Brand together. Add Cool Whip to mixture. Pour 1/4 of this mixture into each pie crust. Drizzle 1/4 of caramel on top of each pie. Melt margarine in skillet add coconut and pecan pieces stirring until toasted. Sprinkle 1/4 of this mixture on top of caramel on each pie. Repeat each step using remainder of cream cheese caramel coconut and toasted nuts. Freeze and serve frozen.

title: Cheese Ball Appetizer
instructions: In a medium bowl combine all ingredients except nuts. Beat until smooth and creamy. Shape into 2 balls approximately 4 inches. Roll cheese balls in chopped nuts. Store in refrigerator. Serve with crackers.

title: Burger Pizza
instructions: Combine ground chuck bread crumbs liquid nonfat dry milk onion egg and salt. Mix lightly but thoroughly. Press on 12-inch pizza pan. Form 1/2-inch rim around edge. Spread pizza sauce over meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheeses and choice of pizza toppers. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Drain off fat. Cut into wedges. Makes 1 (12-inch) pizza.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and shape into meatballs. Place in a baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the meatballs; bake for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onion. Add salt pepper oregano and red pepper. Let simmer for 5 minutes. Add jar of Ragu sauce. Let simmer for 30 minutes. Prepare spaghetti according to directions.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Melt sugar and butter in double boiler. Mix other ingredients. Cook at 325 for 25 minutes. Line pan with wax paper and turn out on waxed paper while hot. When cool cut into squares.

title: Chicken And Chorizo Chili
instructions: In one large pot on medium heat add 1/2 cup of vegetable or corn oil add onion peppers parsley chicken chilli powder salt pepper ground cumin and brown sugar; stir and let mixture cook for about 10 minutes continuing to stir occasionally. Add garlic and pork chorizo beans and all the tomatoes. Continue to cook on medium heat stirring often about 30 minutes or until tomatoes get soggy. Serve with tortillas or hearty bread. Feeds 8-10 people.

title: Low-Fat Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cinnamon flour baking soda and baking powder together; set aside in a small bowl. Grate and drain carrots. Mix sugar and applesauce together in bowl. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add carrots and mix well. Mix in a little at a time the flour mixture to blend until all of the flour mixture is added.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Melt chips milk and salt over low heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour in wax paper lined 8 or 9-inch square pan. Chill for 2 hours or until firm. Peel off paper and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Beat all ingredients just until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake in preheated oven about 30 minutes. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Cream shortening and add sugar. Beat in eggs and blend in syrup. Stir in flour and nuts. Bake in 11 x 16-inch greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Pre-pare jello according to package but only use 3 1/2 c. water. Partially set jello. In mixing bowl on low speed beat cream cheese and crushed pineapple. Add jello. Fold in softened ice cream or sherbet. Then fold in Cool Whip. Pour into mold. Chill. Decorate with drained cherries. Make a day ahead.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar cinnamon and margarine. Reserve 3/4 cup for top. Press remaining mixture in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish covering sides and bottom. Heat flour and cherries until thickened. Pour over crumb-lined dish. Top with meringue made from egg whites. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream if desired. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Beat together. Pour into deep baking dish. Add 2 cups fresh fruit. Slice 1 stick butter and place on top of fruit. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pasta And Fagiolo(Pasta And Beans)
instructions: Prepare spaghetti twists as directed; drain and put into 3-quart casserole. Heat sausages and 1/4 cup water to boiling; cover and cook 5 minutes. Remove cover; continue cooking until well browned. Drain sausage on paper towel. Cut into 1-inch chunks and add to casserole. In sausage dripping cook onion and garlic until tender stirring occasionally. Add kidney beans tomatoes with liquid oregano and 1/4 cup water. Heat to boiling; reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add bean mixture to spaghetti mixture; mix gently. Cover casserole and bake 50 to 55 minutes until hot and bubbly. Makes 8 servings; 455 calories a serving.

title: Choco-Nut Delights
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Cream butter and sugars. Cream well. Add egg and vanilla. Mix well. Blend in dry ingredients. Spread in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Sprinkle immediately with chocolate morsels. Let stand 2 minutes. Spread to cover.

title: Glazed Beef Short Ribs
instructions: Trim excess fat from ribs. Make two vertical deep cuts into meat on each rib. Combine ribs with tomato juice sugar vinegar salt celery seed Worcestershire sauce and onion. Grate 2 teaspoons peel from orange. Squeeze to get juice. Add peel and juice to beef. Mix well; cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 1 hour and 20 minutes or until beef is tender. Transfer ribs to platter. Cover to keep warm. Spoon off surface fat from sauce. Mix flour with water and stir into sauce. Cook stirring until it thickens. Pour over beef. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Combine diced chicken tomatoes cheese onions and seasonings. Dip chips into chicken broth and line them along flat baking dish; sides and bottom. Cover with chicken mixture. Add soup and bake until completely hot at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. For less spicy and moist drain Ro-Tel tomatoes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Stuff each pepper with ground meat mixture. If any meat mixture is left you can make balls. In a Dutch oven put 2 cans of tomato soup and juice from whole tomatoes and 1 can of water. Cook on top of stove on medium heat for 1 hour (covered). Use tomato soup mixture for gravy.

title: Spinach Mushroom Squares
instructions: Cook onions and mushrooms in butter in a large skillet until soft. Beat eggs until frothy. Stir in cooled onions and mushrooms spinach bread crumbs soup 2 tablespoons cheese and spices until well combined. Spread mixture in a buttered casserole dish and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

title: Swedish Steak
instructions: Use beef that is not too fatty or cheap. Choose a middle grade of beef. Put enough margarine in pan so meat will not stick; brown on both sides. I put a little vinegar on both sides to cut enzymes. Also I put Adolphs tenderizer on with spices. When meat is browned cover with water enough to cover all meat in frying pan but not to overflow the sides. Cut up celery and onion; put in with meat. Keep water enough so will not run dry. Turn every so often to keep even cooking. When you can cut meat with fork and it looks tender and really falls apart it is done. You can put thickener in if you want. Put 2 tablespoons flour in 1/2 cup water into a covered jar; shake well. All flour lumps will smooth out. You may have to ad more flour. Cover pan while cooking on low flame; simmer. Continue your dinner with a salad and another vegetable.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar a little at a time. Add vanilla oil zucchini and pineapple a little at a time. Mix together the flour baking soda baking powder cinnamon and allspice. Add to zucchini mixture a little at a time. Stir in mixture of fruit and nuts. Pour into 2 greased floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Test with a toothpick; bake longer if necessary. Let set on rack for 10 minutes before removing from pans. Cool thoroughly. Loaves can be wrapped and frozen for weeks.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Measure 1/2 cup pecans; set aside. Cream the cream cheese; add remaining ingredients. Form into ball. Roll in 1/2 cup pecans. Refrigerate before serving. Serve with Town House crackers.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. While hot mix with oil and vinegar. Mix in remaining ingredients slowly. Chill before serving.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: In a large bowl blend pudding milk and Cool Whip. Using a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan put a layer of graham crackers then pour half of the mixture and spread evenly. Add another layer of graham crackers then use the other half of the mixture and a layer of graham crackers. Frost. Freeze for 2 hours. Set out 1/2 hour to 45 minutes before serving.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Mix and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pecan Puffs
instructions: Beat egg whites. Add sugar vanilla then the pecans. Drop 1/2 teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and pecans. Set aside. Beat eggs lightly in a large bowl. Add sugar oil and vanilla and beat until creamy. Stir in pineapple and zucchini. Add dry ingredients and stir until well moistened. Spoon into 2 well-greased and floured 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pans 10 minutes then turn out on rack and cool thoroughly. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Mini Peanut Butter Tarts
instructions: Combine butter sugars egg peanut butter and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Beat until smooth.

title: Peach Cheesecake
instructions: Mix together whip cream cream cheese vanilla lemon juice and sugar. Spread into crust. Top with peaches and cover with glaze. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash in salted water until soft. Drain well. Mash squash. Stir in onion eggs 2 cups of cheese and 1 1/2 cups crushed crackers. Place in a 9 x 9-inch greased casserole dish. Top with remaining crackers and cheese. This can be made 2 days in advance just refrigerate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until puffed and light brown.

title: Mountain Dew Cake
instructions: Mix cake pie filling oil eggs and Mountain Dew. Makes 3 layers. Cook for 30 minutes at temperature on cake mix box. Can also be made in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Chocolate Creams(Marquise Au Chocolat - France)
instructions: Break chocolate up. Place in basin over a pan of warm water. Add brandy water and vanilla. Stir and mix well. When smooth add butter in small pieces add 3 egg yolks only.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts With Spinach, Ricotta And Cheddar
instructions: Saute onion in a teaspoon butter and combine with the other ingredients. Place breasts skin side up. Loosen skin from one side of breast and stuff 1/3 cup of filling under skin. Continue with other breasts. Bake in buttered dish for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown. Cool and slice for serving.

title: Red Rice Supreme
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp in a large iron skillet. Fry sausage in a separate pan until done. Discard sausage drippings. Pour off excess bacon drippings but leave enough to cover the onion and bell pepper and saute on medium high heat for 3 minutes. Add tomatoes water and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Cover skillet; lower heat and cook for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Add cornstarch mixture stirring until thickened. When thick and creamy add rice crumbled bacon and sausage. Mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 25 minutes.

title: Squash Puffs
instructions: Combine squash and egg. Add all other ingredients except oil and mix until well blended.

title: Spareribs And Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown ribs in skillet. Have ribs cut in pieces. Add ingredients. Place in covered baking pan. Bake approximately 1 1/2 hours. Put kraut in pan. Lift meat so kraut will be under ribs. Cook for approximately 30 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Brown Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In a microwave-safe dish combine onion garlic and olive oil. Cook uncovered on High for 1 minute. Stir in rice (if uncooked rice is used add water) orange juice water chestnuts and tamari. Microwave uncovered on High for 5 minutes. Stir in broccoli and mushrooms. Cover and cook on High 4 to 5 minutes until liquid is absorbed.

title: Microwave Macaroons
instructions: Combine ingredients in 2-quart glass mixing bowl. Microwave on High 6 or 7 minutes until mixture loses its gloss. Stir 3 or 4 times. Drop by teaspoon on to waxed paper pressing to form cookie. Cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Fat-Free Chips
instructions: Mix together herbs. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Fill a small bowl with cold water. Add 4 wonton skins to boiling water at a time. After 20 seconds remove and add to cold water. Arrange on a clean towel to drain. Continue with all wrappers as desired.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Cook the chicken breasts (with skin left on) in the water until tender. Remove chicken. Add the bouillon cubes and chicken soup to broth. Heat until it comes to a rolling boil. Debone chicken and add back to broth.

title: Terrific Grilled Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken overnight in the refrigerator with Italian dressing in a covered pan. Grill at medium to low heat until chicken is golden brown and tender 15 to 25 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
instructions: Press the four crescent rolls into 9-inch quiche pan. Combine the rest of the ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Crackers
instructions: Roll thin as possible. Cut into squares and bake a light brown in a quick oven.

title: Butter Pound Cake Made Simple
instructions: Mix well bake in greased and floured Bundt pan 1 1/4 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Mix and pour batter in one large pie plate or tin. Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar about 2 tablespoons flour and 1 stick butter to moisten well. Put this on top of pie. Bake slow at 325\u00b0 or 350\u00b0 for about 40 or 45 minutes.

title: Yum Yum Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Mix thoroughly; put in baking dish.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar flour and soda and mix well. Add fruit cocktail; pour in greased baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients but cherries together and chill overnight. Garnish with cherries before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Judi'S Ham Chowder
instructions: Bring cauliflower and chicken broth to a boil. Simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in soup and cream over low heat. In small bowl mix flour and water until smooth. Stir into soup mixture. Add pepper parsley and ham. Heat thoroughly. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Spaghetti
instructions: Heat 3 Tbsp. oil in wok brown the ginger and 1/2 c. green onion then add meat and brown together. Mix together the bean (or hoisin) and soy sauces add this mixture to the meat and stir fry briefly. Then add rice wine sugar MSG and 1 Tbsp. sesame oil. Add the chicken broth and simmer for about 3 minutes until the sauce becomes thick and shiny. Put mixture in a serving bowl and set aside.

title: Pasta Putanesca
instructions: Cook and drain linguine. Drain tomatoes and cut in half squeezing out as much liquid as possible . Combine tomatoes and olive oil in skillet. Bring to boil and add remaining ingredients one at a time stirring frequently. Reduce heat and cook until sauce has thickened. Serve over hot pasta with additional cilantro. Serves 4.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain butter beans and kidney beans. Mix everything together and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef with large onion. Mix other ingredients in slow cooker add beef and onion. Cook in slow cooker for several hours.

title: Dessert Taco Chips
instructions: Shake tortilla chips with cinnamon nutmeg and sugar in large bag. Drain mandarins and pat dry with paper towels. Place chips on platter. Surround with orange sections. Put pie filling in small dish for dipping.

title: Peach Shake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender or a food processor until smooth! Serves 1.

title: Nut Strudel
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Mix butter sugar sour cream egg yolks and flour with the yeast and water. Mix dough well and let it rise for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Mix nuts and confectioners sugar together. Beat 4 egg whites until stiff and add to nut mixture. If too thick add a little milk. Roll dough 1/8-inch thick and spread with nut mixture. Roll tight. Let rise again until double in size. Bake in a greased pan at 350\u00b0 for about 20 or 25 minutes. Makes 2 rolls. Can be iced.

title: Penny Carrots
instructions: Combine soup sugar vinegar oil Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Bring to a boil. Cook for 15 minutes. Do not scorch. Layer carrots pepper onion and celery. Pour sauce over and serve cold.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Orange Glazed Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt and sugar and sift. Add quick oats; set aside. Combine egg milk and margarine and add to dry ingredients stirring just enough to dampen flour. Distribute batter evenly into 12 greased muffin tins. Sprinkle with a little brown sugar and bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from pans; cool inverted on rack.

title: Aunt Myrtle'S Goodies
instructions: Melt the caramels with the milk and set aside. Combine the flour oatmeal brown sugar baking soda and salt. Melt the butter and pour over the flour mixture mixing well. Divide in half and spread half the dough in the bottom of a 9 x 9-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10-15 minutes.

title: Savory Turkey Loaf(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix turkey tomato juice oats egg onions celery salt and Worcestershire sauce together. Place in greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 2 (1 pound 4 ounce) loaves. I add a handful of pecans and raisins (if you have).

title: Chicken Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook shells according to directions on box. Prepare Stove Top stuffing according to directions; then combine with the chicken and mayonnaise. Stuff shells with this mixture. Place stuffed shells in a large baking dish. Cover with the cream of chicken soup diluted with 3 cans of water (or broth from cooked chicken). Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes in a 4-quart baking dish (until soup is real bubbly). Remove from oven and enjoy.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Preheat electric skillet to 380\u00b0. Dredge meat cubes in flour mixed with salt and pepper. Brown meat in 2 tablespoons butter. Add chopped onion garlic and mushrooms; brown slightly. Lower heat to 300\u00b0 or lower; add vinegar sour cream cream of chicken soup Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces and pepper. Mix with meat. Cover; cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Serve over noodles spaghetti or rice. Serve with a nice green salad. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Layered Overnight Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into bite size pieces and place in oblong dish or large deep glass salad bowl. Continue to layer remaining ingredients in order listed ending with peas. Spread mayonnaise over peas and seal to edges. Sprinkle sugar over mayonnaise then cheese. Then top with bacon crumbs. Seal tightly. Do not stir.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
instructions: Stir together all ingredients until blended. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Remove to wire rack to cool. Yields 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Pork Chops With Rice
instructions: Brown chops and season with salt and pepper. Remove from pan and pour off any excess grease. Add to same pan the soup and milk. Mix well scraping bottom of pan. Add Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil. Shut off. Add onion and celery to prepared rice. Put rice mixture in buttered casserole dish. Top with pork chops. Pour soup mixture over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Macaroni Salad For A Crowd
instructions: Mix carrots onion and green pepper together and add to cooled macaroni.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes sugar and egg; put in baking dish. Mix brown sugar and pecans. Put on top of potatoes. Melt butter and pour over nuts and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dump cherry filling in the bottom. Sprinkle dry cake mix over the filling. Put pats of butter over that layer. Sprinkle coconut over the other layers. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Pretzel Salad(This Was So Good!)
instructions: Mix together pretzels 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine. Spread evenly into 9 x 13-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Cream together 1 scant cup sugar and cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip and layer on top of pretzel mix. Cook pudding; cool and layer on top of 2nd layer. Mix jello in hot water and let partially set up. Add raspberries. Pour over top of all and chill until set.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and lemon peel. Mix and add dry ingredients alternating with milk. Mix 2 to 3 minutes. Grease bottom only of 2 loaf pans. Pour into loaf pans and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In large skillet brown ground beef and onions. Drain fat. Stir in the rest of ingredients except cheese and tortillas. Layer half the tortillas on bottom of 11x7 baking dish. Spread 1/2 the meat mixture over and sprinkle with 1/2 the cheese. Repeat layers. Bake 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in large bowl. Beat well. Add zucchini and drained pineapple mix well. Mix dry ingredients. Stir into zucchini mixture until blended. Divide between 2 5x9 inch loaf pans. Bake 350 degrees about 1 hour.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In a bowl combine veggies chicken soup and thyme (salt optional). Pour into an ungreased deep dish (9 x 13). Combine biscuit mix milk and egg. Pour over chicken mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Plantation Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Stir in sugar and salt. Add syrups oleo and pecans. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Freezer Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix cabbage with salt and let stand 1 hour. Add rest of vegetables. Pour cool dressing over slaw. Place in containers and freeze.

title: Linguine With Clam Sauce
instructions: In large pot steam clams in 1 cup of water. Remove clams and strain juice in pot. Remove clams from the shells and add to juice. Simmer juices with butter wine oil garlic salt and pepper. To the bread crumbs add salt pepper garlic salt parsley and cheese. Add more bread crumbs to the seasoned juices to thicken the juices into the sauce. Cook pasta al dente and drain. Top with clam sauce.

title: Tuna Ball
instructions: Cream the cream cheese Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Drain tuna and add to mixture. Add celery onion and shredded cheese. Make into balls. Roll in chopped nuts and refrigerate.

title: No Cook Divinity
instructions: Combine mix corn syrup vanilla and water. Beat on high until peaks form about 5 minutes. Then gradually on low speed blend in sugar. Stir in nuts. Drop on lightly buttered dish. When outside feels firm turn over. Dry at least 12 hours. Makes about 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Artichoke Moussaka
instructions: Saute lamb and onion in butter over medium high heat until meat loses its redness. Add wine tomatoes parsley pepper cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Simmer uncovered stirring occasionally for about 35 minutes or until liquid evaporates. Remove from heat; skim off extra fat and stir in 3 tablespoons Egg Sauce. Spread meat mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour artichokes into colander; thaw in hot running water; drain and quarter. Press into meat. Spread remaining Egg Sauce over all; sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or refrigerate until needed then bake 50 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Cut into squares. Serves 12.

title: Shrimp Toasties
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except muffins) and spread on English muffin halves. Place in freezer. Just before serving remove from freezer and slice each English muffin half into 8 pie shaped wedges. Place wedges on cookie sheet and broil for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Holiday Fruitcake
instructions: Generously grease and flour 10-inch (12 cup) Bundt pan. In large bowl combine eggs and water. Beat well with mixer. Add remaining ingredients by hand stirring until combined. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 80 to 90 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes. Invert on cooling rack. Cool completely. To store wrap tightly in foil or plastic wrap. Refrigerate. If desired glaze with warm corn syrup and decorate with candied fruit and nuts.

title: Deviled Eggs Spread
instructions: Cut eggs in half and remove yolks. Mash yolks and 1 egg white with fork. Stir in mayonnaise mustard onion and 1 teaspoon chopped parsley. Chop remaining (3) egg whites. Place chopped egg whites on serving plate. Spread egg yolk mixture on top. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and set aside. Saute onions in bacon fat until soft. Add potatoes 2 cups water salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until tender. Stir in corn with liquid and milk. Blend flour with remaining 1/2 cup water until smooth then stir into chowder. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until it thickens and heats thoroughly. Serve sprinkled with bacon and paprika. Serve 4 to 6. Freezes well.

title: Magic Quiche
instructions: Layer bacon cheese and vegetables in buttered 10-inch pie plate. Blend eggs milk flour and seasonings. Pour over other ingredients. Let sit 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until brown.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 20 minutes.

title: Peachy Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Place sweet potatoes into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Place peaches on top of potatoes; sprinkle brown sugar over peaches. Pour 2 tablespoons peach liquid over sugar.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine egg milk 2/3 cup cracker crumbs 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Stir in corn onion and pimiento. Mix well. Turn into 1-quart casserole. Toss butter with rest of cracker crumbs; sprinkle on top of corn mixture. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Jello
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Stir in cranberry sauce. Chill until thick. Stir in sour cream and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Chocolate Mousse Pie
instructions: Cream together the butter and sugar until well blended. Melt the chocolate. Let cool. Add to butter and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time beating 5 minutes after each one. Fold in the Cool Whip. Spoon into the pie shell. Sprinkle with chopped nuts if desired. Top with Cool Whip as if it were meringue. Refrigerate 6 hours before serving.

title: Low Fat Turkey Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook broccoli for 5 minutes. Arrange in bottom of sprayed baking dish. Top with turkey. Combine soup with milk until smooth. Pour over turkey. Top with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Fruit Trifle(Makes 12 Servings)
instructions: Cut the pound cake in half lengthwise from top to bottom then cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices.

title: Grandma'S Apple Pie
instructions: Core and pare apples. Cut in quarters then slice thin. Line 9-inch pie pan with crust. Mix sugars flour and spices. Rub a little sugar mixture on crust in pan. Arrange apples in pan heaping slightly in center. Sprinkle evenly with remaining sugar mixture; scatter lemon peel over surface. Dot with butter. Adjust top crust; trim edges and flute. Cut slits in center to allow steam to escape. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until apples are tender and crust is golden brown.

title: Buffalo Chip Cookies
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat well and add flour baking powder salt and soda. Add oatmeal corn flakes pecans and chocolate chips. Make a large dropped cookies about 9 to a sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 minutes.

title: Beer Batter Fried Chicken(Serves 4)
instructions: In a bowl mix flour salt and baking powder. In separate bowl beat together beer egg and 2 teaspoons salad oil; stir into flour mixture. Coat half of chicken with batter. Meanwhile in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat heat 1/2 inch salad oil to 370\u00b0 (frying temperature). Fry chicken until brown and tender approximately 20 minutes turning once with tongs. Drain on paper towels or brown bag. Repeat with remaining chicken.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
instructions: In a medium bowl with a wooden spoon stir together the flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Add brown sugar with the back of spoon. Stir until all lumps are tiny. Stir in oats. Make a well in the center. Add corn oil unbeaten eggs water vanilla and raisins. Stir vigorously until the dry ingredients are moistened. Drop by level tablespoons 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned about 13 to 15 minutes. With a wide spatula remove at once to wire racks to cool. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Fresh Tomato Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large heavy boiler. Saute onion in butter for 4 minutes. Reduce to low heat. Add flour and stir until smooth. Gradually add water. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbly. Add the next 7 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 to 40 minutes. Remove and discard bay leaf.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes partially. Grate potatoes in 12 x 9-inch dish. Mix in cheese sour cream green onion and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow For People
instructions: Melt peanut butter chocolate chips and margarine in microwave. Pour onto cereal. Coat with sugar.

title: Sausage And Squash Casserole
instructions: Dice and cook squash until tender. Brown sausage. Add squash sausage butter cheese bread crumbs and soup. Put into casserole dish. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together. Freeze to right consistency to roll in nuts and top with cherries. Makes 2 large or 3 small balls.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the juice from the pineapple. Slice the bananas. Mix all the ingredients. Keep refrigerated.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Stir just until moistened. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking pan. Sprinkle with blackberries. Pour juice over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Top with ice cream or cream if desired. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Food Processor Popovers
instructions: Fit processor with a steel blade. Add all ingredients and process 2 1/2 minutes continuously.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar a little at a time. Put in pumpkin and beat well. Add water and oil. Add flour soda nutmeg cinnamon and salt (which have been sifted together) last. Blend well. Pour into well-greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour until a toothpick comes out clean. Use 2 loaf pans or a large tube pan.

title: Candy
instructions: Use double boiler and melt chocolate chips and butterscotch morsels. Add peanuts. Drop from teaspoon onto wax paper.

title: Flavorful Chicken Or Pork Chops
instructions: Mix all ingredients (looks gross but wait until you taste!). Let chops sit in mixture covered for 30 minutes. Broil or grill and baste often with liquid. Wow! Can repeat with chicken. Wonderful too!

title: Pineapple Cheese Spread For Sandwiches
instructions: Soften cream cheese and blend in the other ingredients well. Makes 3/4 cup.

title: Natchitoches Meat Pie
instructions: Fry meat in butter until done. Add onion and pine nuts and continue frying until onion is transparent. Add vinegar until slightly sour. Add salt and pepper. Let completely cool. Put about 1 teaspoon of filling in center of dough and bring edges to center. Brush with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden. Serve slightly warm. Yields 30 to 40.

title: Chicken Fingers
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chicken strips well. Dip chicken strips into mixture and dunk into hot deep fryer grease. It is done when golden brown.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Mix ingredients roll out and cut with doughnut cutter. Fry in deep fryer until browned.

title: Tuna-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole. Layer as follows noodles tuna mushroom soup noodles celery soup and tuna. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Frito Casserole
instructions: Heat the chili. Using a round baking dish cover the bottom with a layer of Fritos then a layer of tamales topped with 1/2 cup chopped onion. Pour 1/2 of the chili on top of all of this and add 4 slices of cheese. Repeat in the same order with the remainder of the ingredients beginning with chopped onion. Bake at 350\u00b0 until casserole is hot and cheese is melted.

title: Zucchini Squash Casserole
instructions: Arrange squash in dish. Saute onions and garlic in the oil. Add tomatoes seasonings and vinegar. Bring to a boil and simmer 1 minute. Pour tomatoes and onion mix over squash. Top with the cheese and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Pumpkin Delight
instructions: Into a greased 13 x 9 pan pour pumpkin sugar evaporated milk eggs cinnamon nutmeg and allspice. Over the top sprinkle cake mix pecans and butter. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot with Cool Whip.

title: Bird Treats
instructions: Be careful in your selection. Do not choose too young. When selected give your entire thoughts to preparation for domestic use. Some wives insist upon keeping them in a pickle others are constantly getting them into hot water. This may make them sour hard and sometimes bitter; even poor varieties may be made sweet tender and good by garnishing them with patience well sweetened with love and seasoned with kisses. Wrap them in a mantle of charity. Keep warm with a steady fire of devotion and serve with peaches and cream. Thus prepared they will keep for years. Author Unknown.

title: Chicken Salad Pie
instructions: Bake pie crusts for 10 minutes and set aside. Mix chicken and all other ingredients except potato chips and cheese. Pour in crusts. Cover with cheese and top with potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet; add seasoning mix and water to the meat and drain off the grease. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and let simmer about 15 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Mix 1/2 jar sauce in same pot. Pour half the mixture in long dish. Pour remaining sauce over mixture. Sprinkle 1/2 each bag of cheese over mixture. Pour remaining spaghetti over this. Pour 1 jar sauce on top. Sprinkle remaining cheese. Add mushrooms. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Family Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine flour baking powder and salt in large bowl. Cut in Crisco using pastry blender (or 2 knives) to form coarse crumbs. Add milk. Mix with fork until particles are moistened and cling together. Form dough into ball. Transfer dough to lightly floured surface. Knead gently 8 to 10 times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with floured 2-inch round cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes. Yield 12 to 16 biscuits.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together including bacon drippings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: *Corn oil is very important; do not substitute!

title: Sour Cream And Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and margarine with sugar vanilla and lemon extract until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Sift flour and soda together and add alternately with sour cream to egg mixture mixing at low speed. Blend well but do not overmix. Pour into 9-inch tube pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Southern Fried Chicken
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag combine the first five ingredients. Add chickens a few pieces at a time and shake to coat. In a large skillet heat 1/4-inch of oil on medium-high; fry chicken in batches for 18 to 20 minutes or until juices run clear turning once. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Oyster Appetizer
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Place drained oysters in baking pan. Sprinkle with bacon pieces. Bake until bacon is crisp. Remove from oven. Sprinkle liberally with Cheddar cheese. When cheese is fully melted serve with thin slices of French bread.

title: Kuntry Kassrole
instructions: Put out ground heffer in bottom of big bakin dish. Sprinkle ungun over this. Sprankle rice over this. Lay carats over this. Lay taters over this. Sprankle peas over this. Poor cut up maters over this. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Smuther with grated cheez and bake nother 15 minits and then...chow down!

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: You will also need an 8 to 10-inch plastic flowerpot or pail and a plastic or silk flower.

title: Carrots
instructions: Mix all together. Keeps several days.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar egg milk bananas and Bisquick. Then beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Batter may be still slightly lumpy. Stir in walnuts. Pour into well-greased loaf pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes until a toothpick stuck into center comes out clean. Crack in top of bread is typical. Cool before slicing.

title: Vegetable Bake
instructions: In a 1-quart casserole stir can of cream of mushroom soup milk soy sauce and dash of pepper until smooth. Mix in corn lima beans and French fried onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot. Top with remaining can of onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Chic-And-Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix chicken celery grapes and apples well. Serve on bed of lettuce. Garnish with tomatoes or avocados. No set amount. I like the taste that the avocado gives this easy dish. It is a meal in itself.

title: Cheese Zucchini Crisps
instructions: Combine corn flake crumbs cheese and seasonings in plastic bag. Dip zucchini in butter and shake in bag to coat. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until crisp. Serves 4.

title: Peach And Berry Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix muffin mix and 3/4 cup milk. In another bowl mix peaches sugar extract and cornstarch. Pour into buttered baking dish. Dot with butter and pour muffin mix on fruit. Bake about 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Holiday Eggnog
instructions: In large bowl beat eggs until light and foamy. Add sugar and salt beating until thick and lemon colored. Stir in rum and cream. Chill at least 3 hours. Before serving sprinkle with nutmeg. Yields 12 servings (1/2 cup each).

title: Zonda'S Cheesecake
instructions: Blend cream cheese lemon juice and milk. Fold in whipped cream. Crush vanilla wafers and put in pan. Add enough butter to make the crumbs hold together.

title: Chocolate Turtle Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches with shortening; lightly flour. Make cake mix using water oil and eggs. Pour half of batter into pan. Bake 25 minutes. Heat caramels and milk in 1-quart saucepan over medium heat about 10 minutes stirring frequently until caramels are melted. Pour and spread caramel over warm cake in pan. Sprinkle with pecans and chocolate chips. Spread with remaining batter. Bake 30 minutes. Run knife around side of pan to loosen cake. Cool completely about 1 hour. Store covered at room temperature.

title: Pasta And Clams
instructions: Heat oil; saute garlic and onion. Add tomatoes mushrooms wine and seasonings. Cook for 1 minute. Add spinach and clams with a little clam juice. Cover until spinach wilts and is tender. Add cooked pasta and serve with Parmesan cheese. Serves 2.

title: Salmon Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Remove any bones from salmon. Flake salmon; add crumbs cheese onion and parsley. In separate bowl beat together 1 cup milk eggs dash of salt and pepper and lemon juice. Add milk mixture to salmon and mix well. Place in buttered 1 1/2 quart flat casserole and set this dish in another larger flat dish containing 1 inch of hot water. Bake for 1 hour or until set. Make sauce by mixing soup 1/4 cup milk and Worcestershire sauce. Heat sauce and serve over casserole.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook until soft. Do not drain. Cook 4 1/2 cups chopped broccoli until tender. Do not drain the broccoli. Put into the potato mixture. Add 3 tablespoons parsley flakes. Mix 2 1/4 cups milk and 3 tablespoons flour. Add to potato mixture then add 3/4 pound cheese cubed. Simmer until melted.

title: Hazelnut Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until boiling.

title: Ceasar Salad
instructions: Wash and dry romaine; mix with a whisk the garlic anchovy paste mustard Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Add egg yolk and oil and mix again. Pour dressing over lettuce. Add cheese and croutons and eat immediately.

title: Beef Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Lightly brown beef; add onion celery and peppers and cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients; cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Glorified Cabbage
instructions: Heat the cabbage and onions in heatproof bowl. Mix in saucepan the sugar oil vinegar mustard and salts. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Pour over cabbage and onions. Mix well.

title: Alpine Chicken
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper. Dredge chicken with flour mixture and brown lightly on all sides in oil in a skillet. Add water and bouillon cubes; cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from pan. Combine egg and lemon juice and blend into stock in skillet. Add parsley and heat gently (do not boil). Serve over chicken. Makes 4 or 5 servings.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook spinach as directed on package. In saucepan saute onion until softened. Pour cooked spinach in casserole dish. Mix Philadelphia cream cheese and onions until blended. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and place in oven for 20 to 30 minutes and serve.

title: Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring margarine or butter water and cocoa to boil. Pour over flour sugar and salt. Mix well eggs sour cream and baking soda and beat in. Pour in well-greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Peel and cook 7 medium-sized potatoes. Cook drain and refrigerate. Mash after chilled but leave lumpy.

title: Beets
instructions: Peel and grate cooked beets. Melt butter. Add flour. Bring to boiling point. Add lemon juice salt and sugar. Mix with beets. Boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Add sour cream heat and serve with main dish.

title: Sweet And Sour Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and cut into chunks. Sterilize four 1 quart jars. To each jar add 4 slices of onion 2 pieces of celery and 2 heads of dill. Fill jars with cucumber chunks. Dissolve sugar and salt in vinegar and water. Bring to a boil. Cover cucumbers in jars. Seal at once and for best results do not use for 30 days.

title: Luscious Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oil on low heat. Wash and dry pork chops. Mix all dry ingredients and spread mustard on pork chops. Dip in flour mixture; fry until brown. Pour chicken soup and milk over chops. Cover and simmer until done.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar butter and Crisco; add beaten eggs and vanilla. Mix all together. Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet; bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes about 10 dozen.

title: Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in kettle; bring to a boil and stirring boil 1 minute. Stir in sugar and bring to a boil that cant be stirred down. Boil hard for 1 minute. Remove mixture from heat; stir in rum and lemon juice. Let stand 5 minutes. Skim off foam and pour into hot sterilized jars. Seal. Yields 3 pints.

title: Savory Chicken Pie
instructions: Fold chicken pimento and Veg-All together. Mix fat and flour together. Cook until smooth and golden. Add milk and stock whipping until smooth and thick. Add seasoning and fold into chicken vegetable mixture.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Cook chicken and vegetables stirring constantly 5 minutes. Add Cup-a-Soup blended with water. Bring to a boil then simmer 5 minutes until sauce thickens. Serve over hot vermicelli or rice.

title: Apple Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Break up cranberry sauce with fork. Add jello mixture. Chill until very thick. Fold in apples and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Tangy Tomato Dressing
instructions: Combine cornstarch salt and V-8 juice. Cook until thickened. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover chill refrigerate. Makes about 1 1/3 cups.

title: Apple'S Temptation
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender until it is creamy. Pour into individual cups and chill for 2 hours.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. You may sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired. Place crumbs and seasoning in a plastic bag and shake to mix. Brush or dip each piece of chicken in margarine or milk. Place in a bag and shake to coat. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes or until tender and no longer pink. If browning too rapidly you may place aluminum foil loosely over top. Serves 6.

title: Chinese Almond Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add an egg and almond extract; beat well. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press top of cookie slightly and brush top with beaten egg. Press sliced almond on center or sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes until light brown.

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Brown ground meat and drain. Add all other ingredients. Do not drain. Bring to a boil then simmer a few minutes. Easy and ready to eat.

title: Jack'S Coffee
instructions: Add sugar and cream as desired.

title: Chess Squares
instructions: Mix partially melted margarine with cake mix. Mix in 1 egg and knead into dough. Press in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix sugar cream cheese and 3 eggs. Pour over dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until filling is set and golden brown.

title: Grandma Donabella'S Sauce
instructions: Pour the tomato sauce into a large Dutch oven type saucepan (6-quart). Remove casing from pepperoni and cut into 1/4-inch slices. In a skillet which has a covering of olive oil place the cut up pepperoni. Brown each side then add to tomato sauce. Begin heating mixture on low. Using that same skillet prepare the pork chops first browning on each side then cooking for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Quick Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In a casserole dish mix the green beans soup dip and the corn. Melt the butter; crumble the Ritz crackers into the butter. Sprinkle the Ritz cracker mixture on top of the bean mixture. (Try to cover the beans entirely.) Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until the topping is brown (topping should be lightly crispy). Makes about 8 servings.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13 inch pan. As soon as it comes out of oven punch holes all over the top with a meat fork (try not to hit bottom but its alright if you do). Mix condensed milk and pina colada mix together and pour over cake. Chill overnight. Before serving frost with whipped dessert topping.

title: Spinach And Mushroom Salad
instructions: Mix together spinach and lettuce. Add all other ingredients except croutons. Toss well. Add croutons just before serving. Toss lightly.

title: Oriental Meatballs
instructions: Mix. Fry meatballs until done in small amount of oil. Set aside.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: *To sour milk use 1 tablespoon vinegar and add milk to make 1/4 cup sour milk.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add egg sour milk with soda then flour vanilla and salt. Last add cocoa dissolved in the hot water. Pour in 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Chicken Crunch Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs and margarine. Place mixture in buttered 9 x 12-inch pan. Brown bread crumbs lightly in margarine; sprinkle over casserole and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator for 1 hour before baking. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Chocolate Dream
instructions: Mix flour melted oleo and pecans. Spread on bottom of casserole dish 9 x 13-inch. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Corn-Corn Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add eggs sour cream corn and oil. Mix well. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Cook in a greased pan for 15 to 20 minutes. Better served hot.

title: Divinity
instructions: Beat egg whites and set aside. Cook sugar syrup and water until it threads from spoon. Slowly pour over egg whites. As candy begins to set up add vanilla and nuts.

title: Mint Marshmallow Jello Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple marshmallows and lime jello together. Let set overnight. Then add the whipped Dream Whip and the crushed buttermints. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Mix pudding milk sugar and Cool Whip well. Layer bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with graham crackers. Pour half of pudding mixture over crackers. Cover with another layer of graham crackers. Cover with rest of the pudding. Top off with graham crackers.

title: Southwest Chicken And Rice
instructions: Brown chicken in oil. Remove from skillet. Cook peppers and onion until tender and crisp. Stir in remaining ingredients and chicken. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serve over rice.

title: Crabmeat-Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook spinach until separated; drain well. Grate Cheddar cheese; set aside 1 to 2 ounces to top casserole. Put 3 eggs in a large mixing bowl and beat lightly. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Turn into a 12 x 8-inch dish that has been sprayed with nonstick coating. Top with reserved grated cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Makes six generous servings.

title: Easy Cheesy Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Add grated cheese and blend. Add buttermilk egg and oil; stir until thoroughly blended. Fill greased muffin pan about 2/3 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Stir and bake in a casserole dish at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve with party rye bread or crackers.

title: Macadamia Cheddar Balls
instructions: Note An easy make-ahead with two different cheeses plus crunchy Macadamia nuts.

title: Chicken Continental
instructions: Saute chicken mushrooms and garlic in oil for 2 to 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except rice and bring to a full boil. Stir in rice. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 5 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix soup and broth together. Drain vegetables. Add to soup. Add chicken. Stir lightly. Pour into 9 x 9-inch casserole dish.

title: Pound Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased loaf pans and bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn oven up to 325\u00b0 and finish baking (approximately 3/4 to 1 hour more).

title: Easy Chicken Breast
instructions: Skin and debone chicken breast after splitting it in two. Pound with a saucer or meat tenderizer until its even in thickness. Sprinkle with salt and the basil on both sides. Fry in preheated butter until the pink disappears. Reduce heat to simmer and pour the wine and water over this. Simmer covered for about 30 minutes. Make gravy with juice and pour over the meat.

title: Mom'S Muffins
instructions: In a bowl combine sugar flour baking powder and salt. Make a well in center. Combine eggs milk and oil and pour into well and mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. (Do not overmix.) Spoon into greased muffin cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Graham Wafer Pie
instructions: Combine graham wafer crumbs granulated sugar and butter. Blend together and reserve 1/3 of this mixture for top of pie. Press the remainder into pie tin with even thickness as for rolled pie crust.

title: Cinnamon Oatmeal Muffins(Low-Fat)
instructions: Line 12 muffin cups with paper liners. Set aside. Combine and mix milk and oatmeal. Add oil egg whites sugar spice and zest. Stir until blended.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients well in processor or by hand. Place in bowl. Refrigerate. Serve as spread with crackers.

title: Picante Corn Bread
instructions: Heat an 8-inch cast iron skillet at 425\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Set aside. Combine buttermilk eggs and picante sauce. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until moistened. Remove skillet from oven. Add butter and return to oven 1 minute or until butter melts. Pour mixture into hot skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden. Serve immediately.

title: Carrot And Broccoli Soup
instructions: Steam broccoli and carrots until tender. In separate saucepan combine melted margarine flour and salt. Add milk. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring until smooth. Mix together sauce and vegetables until well coated. Place in serving dish.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients with enough milk to make soupy. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Pour into an 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Double Chocolate Nougats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix oil and eggs. Stir in chocolate pieces. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. If desired top each cookie with pecan piece. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute then remove.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Layer broccoli on bottom of casserole dish. Mix together soup mayonnaise eggs and onion. Pour over broccoli. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Drain all beans except baked beans. Brown bacon with onion and drain fat. Mix sugar vinegar mustard bacon and onion with the beans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: In large skillet brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in seasoning mix and hot water. Simmer over low heat about 10 minutes. Stir.

title: Gumbo A La Creole
instructions: In large gumbo pot make a roux with oil and flour. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until roux is a dark caramel color. Remove from fire and add remaining ingredients except shrimp 1/2 cup green onions file and rice. Boil for about 2 hours or until meat is tender and gumbo is thickened. In the last 15 minutes of boiling add reserved green onions and shrimp. Remove from fire and add file. Serves 5 or 6.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Boil a few potatoes and set aside. Also have ready a can of celery soup and can of chicken noodle soup or cream of chicken. Cut broccoli in small pieces; cook in boiling salted water until well done. Drain water from broccoli and add other ingredients. If this isnt thick enough thicken accordingly. Just before serving add about 5 slices of American cheese and melt. Does well in crock-pot after ingredients are mixed.

title: Old Fashioned Raisin Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter well. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour; save 1/2 cup to dredge raisins. Add flavoring and fold in flour. Add raisins to batter and mix well. Line a tube pan with wax paper. Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Bake one hour at 300\u00b0; lower heat to 250\u00b0 and bake 2 hours longer. Remove from oven; leave in pan 10 minutes before removal.

title: Chicken Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill and spread on crackers.

title: Blueberry-Peach Cobbler
instructions: Slice and peel peaches and place in a baking dish. Sprinkle blueberries over peaches. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar over fruit. Mix flour and remaining sugar and cut in butter. Pour over fruit. Bake around 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Add pecans and bake until golden brown (about 10 or 15 minutes).

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Chop all vegetables. Saute in 1/4 cup oil. Add rice and meat. Scramble 2 eggs then add with soy sauce salt and pepper. Mix all together stirring frequently over medium heat.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread pineapple over pan. Add berries and 3/4 cup sugar. Sprinkle cake mix over mixture. Drizzle melted oleo over cake mix. Sprinkle nuts over cake mix then 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Take knife and cut through cake to mix. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer.

title: Rice Krispies Cookies
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder. Set aside. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Mix until creamy and fluffy. Add vanilla then flour. Place Rice Krispies in pan. Drop batter by teaspoonfuls into Rice Krispies roll into ball and lay on cookie sheet 1-inch apart pressing them slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Watch carefully it spreads a little and sometimes a little more flour is required so test to your liking.

title: Mrs. Joan Pepper'S Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine mustard Worcestershire lemon juice and mayonnaise. Stir in water chestnuts and vegetables. Put in 2-quart casserole crumbs on top. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: In a greased casserole arrange the broccoli and chicken slices. Mix together the soup mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour this over the top. Then sprinkle grated cheese on top. Melt butter and mix with the dressing mix and put on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: First boil your fryer in seasoned water until done then carefully debone and chop into chunks.

title: Tomato Aspic
instructions: Bring 4 1/2 cups juice to a boil. Add other ingredients and boil about 10 minutes. Strain out vegetables saving juice. Combine juice and soften gelatin. Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold and chill. Serves 10.

title: Aunt Liza Ellen'S Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine white sugar brown sugar and eggs. Add oats coconut flour salt baking powder soda vanilla and nuts. Mix well Shape into cookies and bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients thoroughly. Add milk and corn. Mix again and pour into baking casserole about 2 inches deep. Pour melted butter on top and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Taffy Apple Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Remove 1/2 c of cookie dough and reserve for another use. Roll dough into a 14 inch circle. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until cookie is lightly browned. Let cool for 10 minutes then loosen cookie from pan. Cool completely. Blend peanut butter cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla together until smooth. Spread on cooled cookie. Peel core and slice apples. Soak apples in Sprite to prevent browning. Arrange apple slices on cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon. Heat caramel and drizzle over apples. Sprinkle chopped nuts over pizza. Cut into pieces and serve.

title: Moo Goo Gai Pan
instructions: With a sharp knife slice across width of chicken breasts to make very thin pieces. In medium bowl mix well chicken cornstarch sherry ginger monosodium glutamate and salt.

title: Cranberry Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars; add egg milk and orange juice. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Combine with liquid ingredients and blend well. Stir in nuts and cranberries. Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 12 dozen.

title: Grilled Yam Slices
instructions: Scrub the skins but do not peel. Trim the ends. Slice yams lengthwise into 3/4-inch thick slices. Rub with oil. Grill on open or closed grill over a medium-hot fire approximately 10 minutes per side or until tender when pierced.

title: Copenhagen Cabbage
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Drain fat. Blend next 4 ingredients. Add to meat. Put 2 cups of cabbage into a 2-quart casserole dish. Add 1/2 of meat mixture and repeat layers. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies(Makes 48 Servings)
instructions: Mix cream cheese butter and sugar. Add walnuts. Fold in flour. Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet and flatten with a wet finger. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cookies are very fragile.

title: Yankee Bean Chowder
instructions: Soak the beans until they swell (couple of hours). Drain and put in kettle with 3 quarts of fresh water. Add the onion and bring to a boil. Adjust the heat and simmer until beans are just tender (1/2 to 3/4 hour). Add other vegetables and seasoning and cook until vegetables are tender (about 25 minutes). Add milk last. Serve as soon as it is hot. Makes 12 to 15 servings. (Half it for family of six.)

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese lemon juice onion milk and horseradish. Fold in crabmeat. Pour 1/3 in casserole dish. Layer American cheese. Pour the remaining crabmeat mix on top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Blend Crisco sugars peanut butter eggs baking soda and salt. Gradually add flour while mixing. Bake in a preheated oven at 375\u00b0 on a cookie sheet for approximately 8 minutes or until done.

title: Pig Picking Cake
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup reserved orange juice with cake mix and oleo. Add eggs one at a time; beat for 1 minute. Add oranges and vanilla. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan or in 3 small cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Form ingredients into ball. Top with cocktail sauce. Serve with crackers.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well and chill overnight for best flavor.

title: Bean And Weenee
instructions: Cut hot dog wieners into bite size pieces then mix all of the ingredients into pot. Cook over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes until mixture thickens or wieners are done.

title: King'S Arms Tavern Old Fashioned Raisin-Rice Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2-quart casserole. Combine sugar and nutmeg; add to milk and eggs and beat well. Fold in rice lemon juice vanilla and melted butter. Prepare a pan of boiling water. Put casserole in water then pour in mixture. Sprinkle raisins in mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 to 45 minutes. Test with a knife. Dont overbake.

title: Hungry Boy'S Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle onion celery and green pepper in bottom of an 8-inch baking dish. Crumble ground beef on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Stir in pork and beans catsup water salt and garlic salt until well blended. Reserve 1/2 cup of bean-meat mixture. Return casserole to oven for 10 minutes while preparing biscuits. Arrange biscuits without centers on casserole. Spoon reserved bean-meat mixture in hole of each biscuit. Top with the biscuit hole. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Chess Tarts
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl stir together the flour and salt. Using a pastry blender cut in the shortening until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the water over the mixture. Gently toss with fork. Push moistened dough to the side of the bowl. Repeat using 1 tablespoon of water at a time until all dough is moistened. Form dough into a ball. On a lightly floured surface flatten the ball of dough to slightly less than 1/8-inch thick. Cut into 4 (12-inch) circles. Place dough circles in fluted tart pans. Place tart pans on a baking sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 7 minutes or until pastry is set but not puffed.

title: Lasagne
instructions: May substitute 10 ounces frozen spinach thawed and drained instead of beef.

title: Cracker Snack Mix
instructions: Put all in a large brown bag add dressing and oil shake and mix very well. Pour onto paper toweling to absorb some of the oil. Store in airtight container.

title: Mother'S Gingerbread
instructions: Cream together the sugar and shortening. Add the egg and molasses. Mix together the flour soda salt ginger and cinnamon and add to the shortening mixture. Pour into a greased and floured 8 or 9 inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Mix Mozzarella cheese Ricotta cheese and egg together. Stuff manicotti shells with cheese mixture. Layer in a greased baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over noodles. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Sour Cream Peach Pie
instructions: Combine peaches flour sour cream salt and sugar. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then decrease heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes longer. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar before baking if desired.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer all ingredients in order given. Broil a few minutes to melt cheese.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Chop eggs and add remaining ingredients. Mix well; chill. Serve with toasted bread or crackers.

title: Apple Torte Cake
instructions: Blend eggs sugar and oil with fork; add dry ingredients and blend. Add apples and nuts mix well. Dough will be stiff. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in milk. Add cake mix and eggs; beat on medium speed until well combined. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool 10 to 15 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Zucchini Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with stuffing mix; set aside. Cook squash until fork-tender. Drain well. Add soup salt and pepper sour cream and chopped onion and mix with the drained squash. In a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish (sprayed with liquid shortening) place 1/2 the stuffing mix in bottom. Spoon on squash mixture. Top with rest of stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Roll in rolls and wrap in tin foil. These are good to freeze and take out when needed.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce and spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer rest of ingredients in order given. Add sugar to Miracle Whip and pour over top. Top with cheese. Cover well and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours or longer before serving. Can garnish with parsley.

title: Peanut Butter Creams
instructions: Combine sugar condensed milk and peanut butter in a medium mixing bowl; stir until well blended. Stir in chocolate morsels and chill until firm. Shape into 3/4-inch balls and roll each in decorator candies.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt margarine with chips and peanut butter. Pour over Chex and stir gently. Put in paper grocery bag and pour over powdered sugar. Shake bag until coated.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare two 9-inch cake pans. In large bowl beat first 8 ingredients with mixer at low speed. Then beat at medium for 5 minutes. Pour into pans and bake approximately 25 to 30 minutes. Over medium heat heat syrup to boiling. Beat egg whites to soft peaks. Slowly pour in hot syrup beating until mixture is fluffy. Add salt and vanilla. Ice cakes and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Prepare jello as on package; chill to set. Take half and add fruit. Add cheese to the other half and beat. Put first mixture in mold to set then cover with second mixture. Sprinkle with nuts.

title: Layered Lettuce Salad
