instructions: Combine mayonnaise and sugar. Tear lettuce into small pieces and place in bowl. Layer celery eggs pepper onion bacon mayonnaise and cheese.

title: Chicken A La King(A Dish Truly Fit For A King!)
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a large skillet. Add celery and mushrooms. Saute until tender. Blend in flour and let simmer 1 minute. Slowly add Chicken Broth. Cook about 3 to 5 minutes stirring constantly until thick. Add Chicken Mix milk and pimiento if desired and parsley flakes. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice. Garnish with slivered almonds. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: In a large shallow baking pan place chicken skin side up in a single layer. In a bowl mix together salad dressing soup mix and preserves. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven basting occasionally about 1 hour or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease. (Pour remaining sauce over chicken when serving.) Makes 8 servings.

title: Jazzy Jambalaya
instructions: In a heavy 4-quart saucepan brown sausage over low heat. Drain tomatoes reserving liquid. Add water to make 1 1/2 cups. Add to sausage and tomatoes the shrimp and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and stir. Reduce heat to low. Simmer 30 to 35 minutes or until liquid is absorbed stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf. Ready to serve.

title: Saveybars
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients. Sift and add the next 6 ingredients. Stir in raisins nuts and vanilla. Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Frost with thin coating of confectioners sugar icing while warm.

title: Cabbage And Beet Bake
instructions: Trim stems and roots from beets. Peel beets; cut into julienne strips. Layer cabbage onion and beets alternately in a 3-quart baking dish. Combine wine and remaining ingredients stirring well. Pour over cabbage mixture. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender stirring every 30 minutes. Yield 7 servings (64 calories per 1 cup serving).

title: Sweet Pickled Beets
instructions: Cook beets and place in jars with 3 or 4 cloves. Heat sugar and vinegar to boil pour over beets and seal. Very good!

title: Crock-Pot Steak And Gravy
instructions: Place seasoned steaks in crock-pot with cups of water and soup mixed. Cook on low overnight. Serve with rice.

title: Nature Crackers
instructions: Place ingredients into bowl and mix. Mix with a fork and knead. Roll onto sprayed Pam cookie sheet to approximately 1/4-inch thick. Score and prick with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown and crispy.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Boil chicken and salt to taste cool then remove skin. Pull chicken from bones and put in greased baking dish. Layer chicken soups and sour cream. Put crushed Ritz crackers on top pour melted margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Kahlua
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Simmer 1 hour. Cool and mix in vanilla and vodka. Makes 1 1/2 quarts and is better than commercial Kahlua.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and salad oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not actually beat with a mixer. Stir in vanilla pineapple and nuts. Finally add the bananas. Spoon the batter into 3 well-greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Then turn onto cooling rack. Cool completely before frosting. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Ham And Cheese Pinwheels
instructions: Mix cream cheese with small amount of mayonnaise and dash of salt. Spread on ham and roll. Chill then slice to be served on Ritz crackers.

title: Basic Cream Sauce(Fat-Free)
instructions: In medium-size saucepan over medium heat bring milk wine pepper and nutmeg to a simmer stirring to prevent scorching. Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook stirring constantly 3 to 4 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Makes 2 cups.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Cut zucchini in half. Scoop out inner part of zucchini. Put in a bowl and chop. Add bread crumbs grated cheese and enough oil to moisten. Mix well and fill zucchini halves. Bake at 350\u00b0 until zucchini are cooked. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over zucchini halves a few minutes before removing from oven.

title: Eggnog Bread Pudding With Jack Daniels  Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 9-inch square baking pan and set aside. Spread bread slices generously with softened butter and cut into squares. Scatter over bottom of pan. Beat eggs and sugar. Pour in eggnog while stirring and mix well.

title: Soy-Oat Waffles
instructions: Soak soybeans several hours or overnight in sufficient water to keep covered. Drain; discard water. (Soaked drained soybeans may be kept in the refrigerator for a week or stored for longer periods in the freezer. Keep on hand for use at a moments notice.) Combine all ingredients and blend until light and foamy about half a minute. Let stand while waffle iron is heating. The batter thickens on standing. Blend briefly.

title: Conch Fritters
instructions: Combine flour and dry ingredients. Add a little water at a time to batter consistency. Add conch green pepper and onion; mix well. Spoon batter into skillet of hot oil over medium heat to form small balls the size of hush puppies. Turn occasionally until golden brown. Drain and serve.

title: Grandma Harveys Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and milk in large heavy pan and slowly bring to a rolling boil. Cook for 10 minutes stirring if necessary to bring down. Remove from heat and add all the chocolate chips marshmallows and butter.

title: S-2 Bars(Sumptuous And Sinful)
instructions: Mix together graham crackers peanut butter powdered sugar and melted butter. Spread this evenly in ungreased pan. Melt chocolate chips (to make richer add approximately 1/2 cup melted butter). Spread melted chips on top of other mixture. Let cool. Serve immediately or chill until served.

title: Rice Consomme
instructions: Place ingredients in a casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until liquids are absorbed.

title: Jonnie'S Sandies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; and water and vanilla; mix well. Blend in flour and nuts. Chill 4 hours. Shape in balls or fingers (make sure dough is cold at all times). Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325 degrees about 20 minutes. Remove from pan; cool slightly. Roll in confectioners sugar. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine peanut butter Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Add egg. Beat until blended.

title: Corned Beef 'N Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute cabbage celery and onion in olive oil. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Spoon into 2-quart casserole. Cover. Bake at 40 to 50 minutes until thoroughly heated. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lindsay'S Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Cook chicken and tomatoes in Pam until liquid cooks out. In another frying pan on medium to low heat spray Pam. Lay tortilla shell in pan and add chicken mixture on one side of shell. Sprinkle cheese on top of chicken. With spatula fold over other side on top of chicken and cheese. Flip tortilla shell and brown on other side. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Glazed Pecans
instructions: Cook sugar and orange concentrate until soft ball stage in heavy saucepan. Add vanilla and pecans. Cook until all water cooks out. Spread on wax paper and let cool. Separate with 2 forks while cooling.

title: Turkey Creole
instructions: In 12-inch skillet over medium heat in hot salad oil cook onion green pepper and garlic until onion and green pepper are tender-crisp about 5 minutes. Add 2 cups water tomatoes with their liquid chili powder salt sugar oregano leaves and pepper. Heat to boiling. Stir in rice. Reduce heat to low; cover skillet and simmer for 25 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Stir in turkey and heat thoroughly. Yields 4 servings.

title: Italian Steak
instructions: Mix the ingredients together in a pan. Cook the steak in this mixture over a low heat until done.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Add celery and onions to mixed vegetables and cook until tender as directed on package. Drain. Add mayonnaise and cheese and mix well. Place in lightly buttered casserole. Sprinkle with Ritz cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Raspberry Streusel Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour oats sugar baking powder and salt. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Reserve 1 cup oat mixture for streusel. Set aside. Press remaining oat mixture onto bottom of ungreased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 10 minutes. Spread jam over crust; sprinkle evenly with chocolate chips. Combine reserved oat mixture and almonds; sprinkle over chocolate pieces patting gently. Bake 30 to 35 minutes; cool completely. Drizzle with melted chocolate. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients together in a bowl. Form meat mixture into patties. Place patties in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes before grilling. Place on outdoor grill. Baste patties with barbecue sauce while cooking. Cook for about 5 to 7 minutes on each side.

title: Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Boil ribs with 1-inch piece of fresh ginger until cooked. Drain. Soak ribs for 1 hour in remaining ingredients. Remove from marinade. Place in single layer on broiler pan. Broil until browned.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Saute onion green peppers and celery to remove stiffness. Add mushrooms and 2 cups raw shrimp. Cook rice (1 cup) in saucepan using mushroom liquid for part of liquid. Combine rice to shrimp mixture in casserole and fold in 1 cup sour cream. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until hot.

title: Yum Yum Chilli
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Drain off grease. Add chopped onion celery and green pepper. Saute for 5 minutes. Add rest of ingredients and simmer for an hour or more. Picante sauce can be added if desired.

title: Peach Supreme
instructions: Make Jiffy cake mix according to instructions and bake in oblong baking dish. This will make a very thin layer of cake in bottom of pan. Cool. Mix instant pudding according to directions. Add 8 ounce package cream cheese; beat until smooth. Pour over cake arrange sliced peaches on top of pudding. Cover peaches with Cool Whip and refrigerate. It is usually best if made a day ahead of time and allowed to cool overnight. Peaches can be substituted with pineapple strawberries etc.

title: Yam Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine first seven ingredients and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with butter brown sugar and pecans. Bake an additional 25 minutes. When cool serve with whipped cream.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix juices according to directions. Add ginger ale and sherbet when ready to serve.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan melt butter and chocolate square. In a bowl stir together next 4 ingredients. Add to chocolate mixture then add vanilla. Stir together. Pour into 9-inch glass pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Autumn Harvest Bisque
instructions: In a kettle cook onions leeks and celery in 3 tablespoons butter over moderate heat stirring for 5 minutes or until softened. Add carrots squash turnips apples and stock; bring to a boil and simmer 45 minutes or until vegetables are soft. In small saucepan melt 6 tablespoons butter over moderate heat. Add flour and cook roux stirring 3 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Add 1 cup soup liquid in a stream stirring. Stir mix into soup pot. Add cider nutmeg sage rosemary salt and pepper; simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in cream and Gruyere. Ladle into heated bowls and garnish. Serves 6 to 8. Makes 9 cups.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Combine sugar and molasses. Cream butter and sugar. Add well beaten egg milk and vanilla. Mix and sift dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Chill dough until firm enough to handle. Roll out on floured surface to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with cutter and bake on buttered cookie sheet 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Breaded Veal Panne
instructions: Trim veal scallops to remove any tendons from edges. Using a flat veal pounder or meat mallet pound veal until very thin and almost doubled in size. Pat dry with paper towels; set aside. In a medium bowl combine bread crumbs salt and pepper; set aside.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into a ball and roll in crushed nuts. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Put cider in pan. Add sugar and cinnamon sticks; stir. Put other spices in cheesecloth and tie securely. Add to cider mixture. Heat on stove until hot; simmer on medium-low heat for 20 minutes. Remove spices. Serve hot with cinnamon stick.

title: Cajun Red Beans And Rice Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine rice red beans tomato green bell pepper red onion and garlic; mix well. In small jar with tight-fitting lid combine the oil vinegar chili powder seasoned salt salt pepper and hot sauce and shake well. Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to coat. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour to blend flavors. Makes 12 servings.

title: Seasoned Crackers
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl; mix well. Pour over crackers in bowl; toss to coat well. Place in airtight container. Let stand several hours for better flavor. You can add more garlic and dill weed if you like.

title: Tarts
instructions: Combine flour and salt. Cut in shortening and butter until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle milk (1 tablespoon at a time) over mixture. Stir with fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Shape into balls (about 3/4-inch). Place into ungreased mini muffin pans and shape to make tarts. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Yields 60 tarts.

title: Sesame Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg and milk together. Combine flour baking powder salt paprika and sesame seed in a paper bag. Dip the chicken pieces in the egg mixture and then shake in the paper bag. Place the chicken pieces skin side up in a baking dish so that they do not touch each other. Pour melted butter over and bake 1 hour.

title: Sugarless Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients beating well. Let stand 5 minutes so that oats will absorb moisture. Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let stand 1 minute on cookie sheets; transfer to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Melt butter; cool slightly. Mix all ingredients. Use chocolate coconut or lemon to flavor to taste (1 tablespoon cocoa or 1/2 cup coconut or 3 tablespoons of lemon juice) and omit vanilla. For plain Chess Pie just use vanilla.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream butter until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in sugar. Beat in egg until well blended. Stir in milk. Sift flour with baking powder and nutmeg. Add all to batter at once and stir until well blended and smooth. Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle top of cookies with sugar mixed with ground nutmeg. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from pan while warm and cool on rack.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice to sweetened condensed milk. Fold in whipping cream and strawberries. Do not beat. Add flavoring to taste. Place in baked pie shell. Chill.

title: Cherry Coke Jello
instructions: Bring 1 Coke to boil; pour over Jell-O and dissolve. Add remaining Coke; mix well. Add pineapple and nuts; mix well. Refrigerate until jelled and enjoy.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Drain vegetables. Mix all ingredients and let set overnight.

title: Easy Pickled Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms and cut in half. Place in Pyrex bowl pour dressing over. Microwave for 4 minutes. Let cool and refrigerate for 12 hours.

title: Peach Custard Pie
instructions: Combine above ingredients. Place about 8 peaches sliced (fresh or canned) in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Pour mixture over peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until custard sets and is slightly brown.

title: Mama'S Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Cook syrup sugar and water until it makes a hard ball. Pour over egg whites that have been stiffly beaten. Beat this mixture until stiff enough to spread on buttered wax paper. Spread peanut butter on top of mixture\tand roll up like a jelly roll. Wrap wax paper around roll and cool completely before cutting into slices.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream together oleo sugar cocoa vanilla and eggs. Add flour nuts and coconut; mix well. Spread in a sheet pan. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Store in jar with tight lid.

title: Caramel Apple Sauce
instructions: Melt caramels. Add sour cream. Cut up apples and pour caramel over for easy eating or put stick in apples and dip. Caramel will remain soft.

title: Yams With Orange Sauce
instructions: Cook yams until tender in water. Remove skins and slice into greased casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over yams. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pumpkin-Pecan Bread(Rich Raisin-Filled Loaf)
instructions: About 2 1/2 hours before serving or a day ahead grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Kid'S Pizza
instructions: Split an English muffin in half. Place 1 tablespoon of pizza sauce on top of each half. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Place under the broiler until the cheese melts.

title: Cool Orange Delight
instructions: Mix cottage cheese with orange jello and mix well. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Add crushed pineapple and mandarin oranges well drained. Chill and serve. Serves 6.

title: Ginger Water
instructions: Mix sugar and ginger. Add vinegar then water. Chill. A great thirst quencher!

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables. Mix vinegar oil and sugar; pour over vegetables. Mix well; let stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes in microwave. Peel off skins and cut into chunks. Place potatoes in large mixing bowl. Add all ingredients and beat until smooth. Spoon into foil potato boats. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 5 to 10 minutes. Top with Cheddar cheese and heat until the cheese melts. Yields 20 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Vodka Slush
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Mix all ingredients together and freeze for 24 hours. Stir a couple of times while it is freezing. Put a couple of scoops of slush in cup and add 7-Up.

title: Pickly Porcupines
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix ingredients together and shape into balls. Brown in oven for 15 minutes. Pour 2 cups tomato juice over them. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Parmesan Twist
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2 baking sheets. In medium bowl beat together the Parmesan cheese and butter with electric mixer until mixture is fluffy; add sour cream and beat. In small bowl combine flour and seasonings. Beat flour mixture into cheese mixture. Knead dough lightly and divide in half. On lightly floured surface roll out dough into 12 x 6-inch rectangles; cut into twenty-four 6 x 1/2-inch strips. Holding each strip by ends gently twist the pastry 2 or 3 times and place on prepared baking sheets. Bake the twist in the oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. But before you put in oven and before you separate them brush with yolk and water mixture and sprinkle with sesame seed or poppy seed.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Mix well. Marinate several days before serving.

title: Frying Pan Cookies
instructions: Put in large heavy frying pan and cook like scrambled eggs (about 5 minutes) oleo sugar dates and egg. Remove from heat and add nuts Rice Krispies and vanilla. Let cool and form into balls and roll in coconut.

title: D. D.'S Cheese Cookies
instructions: Crumble by hand and make into small balls. Bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until slightly browned.

title: Chicken Tortellini Soup
instructions: In large pot combine water chicken broth soup chicken carrots onion vermouth garlic basil and oregano. Bring to a boil; add tortellini. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Add broccoli. Simmer an additional 5 to 10 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Serve with cheese. Makes 10 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

title: The World'S Easiest Peanut Clusters(Microwave)
instructions: Mix and melt in microwave for 3 minutes. Drop in clusters on waxed paper.

title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease an oblong glass baking dish. Peel devein and clean shrimp. Leave the tails intact. Lightly mix the seasoned crumbs with the crab meat. Add beaten egg mixing in lightly.

title: Chicken Rice Bake
instructions: Combine soups and milk. Heat. Add rice. Pour into pan. Lay chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top of this. Cover with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Beat egg. Add milk and corn. Add sifted flour baking powder salt and dab of pepper. Mix well. Stir in fat. Drop by tablespoon into hot deep fat and fry until golden.

title: Cherries Jubilee
instructions: Beat together first 5 ingredients. Pour into chilled crust. Chill about 1 hour. Top with cherry pie filling (you can also use blueberry pie filling).

title: Low Country Boil
instructions: Fill large stock pot 1/2 full with water over gas cooker. Heat to boiling. Add crab boil seasoning then potatoes carrots and onions. Boil for 20 minutes. Add sausage and corn. Boil 10 minutes. Turn down heat and add shrimp. As soon as they turn pink remove all ingredients from water and serve. Have butter for corn and seafood sauce available. Great for Super Bowl parties.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: In large greased casserole put chicken in bottom of dish. Mix broth and soup together. Sprinkle bird with frozen vegetables. Next pour in soup mix. Mix flour and buttermilk together. Add oleo salt and pepper. Pour over bird mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Munching Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir the peanuts sugar corn syrup and salt together in a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole. Place in microwave oven and cook 7 to 8 minutes on High stirring well after 4 minutes. Add the butter and vanilla to hot syrup blending well. Return to oven and cook 1 minute more. Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot. Add soda to mixture and gently stir until light and foamy. Pour mixture on lightly greased cookie sheet. Let cool 1/2 to 1 hour. When cool break into small pieces and store in airtight container. Makes approximately 1 pound. (If using roasted salted peanuts omit salt and add peanuts after first 4 minutes of cooking.)

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together. Form into loaf. Place in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix and pour over loaf. Baste often. Start baking at 350\u00b0 or microwave on Medium-high for 22 to 24 minutes.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Pour cherries into a 9-inch deep dish pie crust. Mix remaining ingredients well and pour over cherries. Bake for 70 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese-Filled Coffee Cake
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Mix flour 3/4 cup sugar and salt. Beat egg yolks and blend in sour cream butter and yeast. Stir this egg yolk mixture into flour to make a soft smooth dough. Knead for 5 minutes on floured surface. Put in a bowl; cover. Let rise until almost double.

title: Hot Onion-Cheese Canapes
instructions: Remove crusts from bread. Cut each slice into quarters. Combine mayonnaise cheese and onion. Spread on bread. Broil about 4-inches from heat until lightly browned. Mixture will keep several days in refrigerator. Yields 32 squares.

title: Soft Ginger Cookies
instructions: Sift together the first 5 ingredients and set aside. In large mixing bowl beat margarine; gradually add sugar. Beat until fluffy. Add egg and molasses. Beat well. Stir in dry ingredients. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls (about one heaping tablespoonful).

title: Easy Chicken Supreme
instructions: Place chicken in shallow baking dish. Top each with 1/2 slice of cheese. Mix soup with 1/2 can of milk and pour over chicken. Mix stuffing with melted butter. Spoon over soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with rice.

title: Delicious Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all contents together by shaking in a large container. For each cup use 1/4 cup mix and fill cup with boiling water. Add marshmallow if desired.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all but the cheese together and bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top with grated cheese and bake for 10 minutes longer.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in greased shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry items. Add melted butter mixing until crumbly. Sprinkle crumbs over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; drain grease. Mix taco seasoning mix with 1/3 cup of water. Simmer for 5 minutes. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Rol meat inside shells. Cover with tomato sauce in pan then put shredded cheese onions and olives and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks and add milk. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with flour getting out all lumps. Add to egg mixture. Warm in saucepan stirring well. Caramelize the other 1/2 cup sugar in heavy skillet; brown do not burn! Add butter to make a syrup. Pour this into other mixture. Cook until thick. Pour into prepared pie shell. Beat egg whites until stiff; put on top of pie.

title: Super Amazing Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and peanut butter. Gradually add sugars and blend until mixed. Add eggs one at a time and beat until smooth. Stir together flour and soda and add to creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop from a teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Slightly flatten dough with back of spoon. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 6 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix with fingers the first three ingredients and spread in a 9 x 10-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Quickies
instructions: Mix together and drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt butter peanut butter and chocolate chips. Coat Rice Chex. Put in a large bag with powdered sugar. Shake; refrigerate. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crisp Corn Sticks
instructions: Sift corn meal. Add salt and soda; mix. Add oil; stir. Add buttermilk and syrup; stir well. Fill thoroughly greased iron corn stick pans; bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Makes 9 sticks. Easy to add to for large family.

title: Grandma Kinney'S Plain Cake
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Makes 2 layers or a 9 x 13-inch cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Neiman-Marcus Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix margarine egg and pecans and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan which has been greased and floured. Then mix powdered sugar cream cheese eggs and coconut. Pour this mixture over cake mixture and bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Alternate sliced potatoes and sliced onions in casserole dish. Place browned pork chops on top covered with can of tomato soup together with 1 soup can water. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Roast Beef Round Up(For Leftover Roast Beef.)
instructions: Brown onion in fat and stir in flour. Add water catsup chili powder instant bouillon cumin and salt stirring to combine. Cook slowly stirring often 12 to 15 minutes or until thickened. Stir in beef and green pepper strips; cook slowly for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve with corn bread squares; top with cheese if desired. Yield 4 servings.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and stir into dressing. Divide and place half onto bottom of 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Combine squash onions soup chestnuts and pimientos; pour over dressing. Cover squash with remaining dressing and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Venison Stir-Fry
instructions: Put the first 6 items in a skillet over medium heat and saute until all ingredients are cooked. Add a little water if it starts to stick. Season to taste. Add the remaining ingredients. Stir in and blend well. Season again to taste. When rice is hot and all ingredients are blended remove from heat. You can prepare this dish in an electric wok regular wok or in a regular skillet.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add flour and salt alternating with milk to mixture; beat well. Fold in pineapple with juice. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes until done. Do not preheat oven. Bake in cold oven.

title: Susie'S Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes butter celery and carrots until potatoes are tender. Mix flour with milk to make thicker to personal preference. Add flour mixture to pan stirring constantly to prevent sticking on the bottom. Stir 3-5 minutes then add cheese. Add salt and pepper anytime while potatoes are cooking.

title: Southern Spoon Bread
instructions: Stir the cornmeal and salt into the boiling water and mix well. Beat in the butter eggs and milk.

title: Creole Burgers
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Add soup prepared mustard catsup salt and pepper; mix well. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes or until flavors are blended stirring occasionally. Toast and butter buns. Serve ground beef mixture on buns. May top with lettuce if desired. Yield 6 servings.

title: Fruit Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and juices. Heat to a boil; boil until thick. Mix together oranges pineapple bananas grapes and marshmallows. Pour pudding mix over and stir. Refrigerate.

title: Chopped Chicken Livers
instructions: Simmer chicken livers in enough water to cover (I add bouillon to water). Saute onion in 3 tablespoons butter or oleo. Place livers and eggs in bowl and chop together. Add the onion mixture and mayonnaise for desired consistency. Season to taste with salt pepper and paprika. Chill. Serve with Melba rounds. Can be garnished with thinly sliced red onion.

title: Rosemary-Thyme Potatoes
instructions: Peel and chop potatoes. Toss with a little oil. Add rosemary and thyme. Sprinkle in pepper. Microwave 10 minutes. Add butter flavored salt and more pepper. Toss and microwave more if needed.

title: Crab Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Let all set at room temperature for 15 minutes. Mix all together. Quarter muffins and spread thickly. Freeze 30 minutes on sheet before using. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes in foil. Double recipe = 92 snacks.

title: Hot Chicken Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Put in pie tin with pastry on bottom and top. Bake until golden brown.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Pour the melted mixture over the popcorn and candy. Press tightly into a large lightly greased Bundt or angel food cake pan. (Pam can be used.) Let set until firm or refrigerate to set quickly.

title: Chicken, Red Grape And Apple Salad
instructions: Combine chicken grapes apple celery raisins and onion in a bowl; toss gently. In a separate bowl combine yogurt mayonnaise lemon juice celery leaves and salt. Add to chicken mixture; toss gently to coat. Cover and chill. Serve on individual lettuce-lined serving plates. Makes 6 servings (1 cup each).

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Bake at 325\u00b0. Cook 2 hours covered then 1/2 hour uncovered.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In plastic bag add all ingredients. Shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty contents into shallow baking dish. Bake stirring occasionally for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired. Makes about 8 servings.

title: 2 Minute Fudge
instructions: Stir in confectioners sugar cocoa salt milk vanilla extract until blended in 1 1/2-quart dish. Top with butter. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir smooth. Blend in nuts. Pour into buttered 8-inch square dish. Chill. This recipe is for microwave.

title: Tarragon-Tanged Shrimp
instructions: Place cooked shelled deveined shrimp in a large serving bowl with cooked rice torn romaine lettuce orange slices halved cherry tomatoes and sliced onion. In a small bowl whisk together oil frozen orange juice vinegar olive oil garlic powder salt tarragon leaves crushed and pepper. Toss with shrimp rice and lettuce.

title: Bell Pepper Steak And Rice
instructions: Mix tomatoes soy sauce and tomato sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer while browning the steak. Add bell peppers to cooking steak. Drain grease; add tomato mixture. Simmer for 1 hour. For a thicker sauce add a little cornstarch. Serve over rice.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Put pepper garlic and dill in a pint jar. Stack whole green beans in jar. Bring to a boil water vinegar and salt. Pour over beans. Put in hot bath 10 minutes.

title: Apple Pandowdy(Serves 6)
instructions: Melt oleo. Add sugar and egg then dry ingredients. Stir. Bake in greased pie plate for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hearty Chili
instructions: In a large saucepan cook beef chopped onion and garlic until beef is brown and onion is tender; drain off fat. Stir undrained tomatoes tomato sauce chili powder salt and pepper into browned meat in saucepan. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add drained beans to saucepan. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. To serve place some rice in the bottom of chili bowls. Top with chili cheese and optional onions and sour cream. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Cook 1 minute. Stir while cooking. Add remaining ingredients. Make out in patties. Refrigerate. Can be frozen. This makes a large amount.

title: 7-Up Cake And Icing
instructions: Beat all ingredients together; add the 7-Up last. Pour into a tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Beef Enchilada Rice
instructions: Brown meat onion and green pepper together in a skillet until cooked then drain well. Mix in a large bowl the rice spices picante sauce and tomato juice. Fold in the cooked meat mixture. Place in a greased casserole dish and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and sprinkle the top with the cheese. Return to the oven and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Melt butter. Mix well with flour and nuts. Line a 10 x 12 x 2-inch pan with mixture. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Combine sugar cream cheese and 1 cup Cool Whip; spread over crust. Mix pudding and milk; beat until thick. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining Cool Whip.

title: Sweet Dill Pickles
instructions: Put sliced pickles back in jar. Bring to boil last four ingredients and pour over pickles. Let stand overnight in refrigerator before serving.

title: Polish Potatoes
instructions: Heat potatoes in juice; then drain. Saute onions in oleo. Add to potatoes. Pour in salad dressing and stir with rubber spatula. Add salt and pepper. Then add dry parsley flakes.

title: Sugarless Gingerbread
instructions: Combine shortening and molasses; add egg. Stir until thoroughly blended. Mix and sift dry ingredients and add alternately with hot water. Pour into well-greased and floured 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 16.

title: Mississippi Corn Bread
instructions: In a bowl mix together sour cream corn and oil. Stir in cornmeal salt baking powder and eggs. Pour batter into well-greased 9-inch square pan or 12-cup muffin tin. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes for bread or 20 to 25 minutes for muffins.

title: Crab Cakes With Shrimp
instructions: Pick over the crab meat to remove any cartilage or shell. Leave the lumps as large as possible. Shell and devein shrimp. Put the shrimp in a food processor or blender and add the egg cream salt and pepper. Blend as finely as possible. Pour and scrape the mixture into a mixing bowl. Add the crab meat green onion mustard Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce. Blend gently but thoroughly. Shape the mixture into 10 cakes. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a nonstick skillet and add the cakes several at a time. Cook over medium heat about 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Serve with Parsley Butter. Refrigerate the cakes when you first make them to get them good and cold before cooking.

title: Sad Cake
instructions: Combine eggs and vanilla; beat well. Mix Bisquick brown sugar and cinnamon then beat 2 minutes. Combine pecans and coconut into the other ingredients. Bake in a 9 1/4 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. If you want a glaze combine milk and powdered sugar with vanilla flavoring and spread over warm cake.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and place firmly into a loaf pan. Bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix well. Use on a salad made of spinach mushrooms sliced eggs and bean sprouts.

title: Emmie'S Bread
instructions: Add yeast and warm water in mixing bowl. Add crisco sugar salt and mix well. Add enough flour to make right consistency for kneading. Knead until air bubbles are out. Dough not sticky. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Swedish Pancakes
instructions: Melt butter or margarine. Mix all ingredients together until blended. Heat lightly greased frypan. Pour in just enough batter to cover the bottom of the pan. Turn when lightly browned. Serve rolled up with your favorite filling. Makes about 5 (9-inch) pancakes.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients until thoroughly blended. Add cornbread mix stirring until just moistened. Pour batter into a 10-inch cast-iron skillet coated with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Yields 10 wedges. (Note May bake bread in square baking dish.)

title: Pizza With Hamburger Crust
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. In a bowl mix beef bread crumbs and oregano. Stir in 1/2 cup tomato sauce. Spread mixture in bottom of 10-inch pizza pan. Pour 1/2 cup tomato sauce on top. Spread on top of beans and cheese. Bake uncovered 20 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Asparagus Parmigiana
instructions: Drain asparagus. Arrange in shallow baking dish. Saute onion and garlic in oil until golden brown. Add salt Tabasco sauce and tomatoes. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Add thyme and tomato sauce. Simmer 20 minutes. Pour sauce over asparagus; place Mozzarella cheese over top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Sausage Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except cheese. Pour in baking dish. Cover with cheese. Let stand in refrigerator. Bake at 350\u00b0 until desired brown stage.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Mix together; pour into pan or dish sprayed with Pam and freeze.

title: Peppercorn Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Now make a well and pour in cream-style corn evaporated milk and egg in that order then mix together. Pour into greased baking dish 1/2 of the mixture (9 x 12-inches). Place enough cheese over entire mixture then scatter onions chives and sweet peppers over the cheese. Pour in the remaining mixture then repeat procedure with cheese onions chives and peppers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Skillet Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add potatoes and water. Sprinkle sugar over all. Cook uncovered on medium heat stirring often for about 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Layered Derby Day Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese sour cream mayonnaise bouillon and ground red pepper; blend until smooth. Let mixture stand 15 minutes to dissolve bouillon; stir.

title: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in water until soft. Drain and mash with electric mixer until smooth. In small bowl blend cream cheese and sour cream until smooth. Pour cheese mixture into potatoes and mix until really smooth. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Dot with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until top starts to turn a little brown.

title: Mexican Dip With Chips
instructions: Layer baking pan with cream cheese or sour cream then layer each ingredient except for cheese. Cook 20 to 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Take pan out and mix ingredients. Add cheese and put in oven until cheese melts. (Serve with chips.)

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix first five items together. When jello is set top with cream cheese and sour cream. Mix these together until fluffy then put on jello.

title: Norwegian Gold Cake
instructions: Mix flour and shortening at low speed. Add eggs 1 at a time. Mix well. Sift sugar salt and baking powder. Add to cream mixture. Beat well. Add almond flavoring and beat for 2 minutes at low speed. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 in a lightly greased and floured Bundt pan. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cooled.

title: Creole Okra
instructions: Wash and cut okra into 3/4-inch pieces. Chop onion and bell pepper. Saute onion and pepper until tender in oil. Add stewed tomatoes and Ro-Tel tomatoes; add okra. Stew on low setting in skillet or cook in baking dish in oven until okra is tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pam'S Party Punch
instructions: Mix jello in 9 cups boiling water. Mix 4 cups sugar in 5 cups boiling water. Combine. Add 2 large cans pineapple juice and ReaLemon. Freeze. When ready to use mash mixture with potato masher and add desired amount of 7-Up or ginger ale.

title: Crescent Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar almond extract and egg yolk until smooth. Spread 1 package crescent rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread cheese mixture on top. Put second package of crescent rolls on top. Brush top with egg white and sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with fresh fruit such as strawberries.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Cook and debone chicken. Reserve 1 cup broth. Combine soups chilies and spices to broth. Blend well. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cover bottom of 2 1/2 to 3-quart casserole dish with 2 cups chips. Spread 1/2 chicken over chips; then half sauce and then half cheese. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hungry Jack Beef And Bean Round-Up
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In skillet brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce brown sugar and beans. Heat until bubbly. Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Cut each biscuit in half. Place biscuits cut side down over hot meat mixture in spoke fashion around the edge of casserole. Sprinkle cheese over biscuits. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 22 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cucumber And Dill Salad
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine yogurt lemon juice dill and honey. Chill for 15 minutes. Just before serving peel and seed the cucumbers. Slice thinly then gently combine with yogurt mixture. Divide greens among the salad plates (4). Top with cucumber mixture.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Drain the salmon reserving the liquid. Flake the salmon and remove the skin and bones. In a large bowl combine the salmon reserved liquid eggs salt and corn flake crumbs to make a firm mixture. Blend in the baking powder. Shape into croquettes and fry until lightly browned. Serves 4.

title: Raves Review Coconut Cake
instructions: Blend cake mix pudding water eggs and oil in a large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and nuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Frost with Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Reserve juice from any fruit used in salad. Add to mayonnaise; mix thoroughly. Add honey Dijon dressing; mix until smooth. Store in refrigerator.

title: Cabbage Birds
instructions: Select 8 tender white cabbage leaves and pour boiling water over them to make pliant. Mix ground beef tomato pulp rice eggs salt and pepper. Work mixture with hands and shape into rolls. Wrap cabbage leaves around meat rolls pinning each end with toothpicks. Place in stewer (side by side). Pour hot water over just enough to cover with 1 tablespoon of oil to season cabbage. Put on lid and simmer until tender. Remove from stewer with egg turner and place on platter carefully. Serve with sauce made of gravy they were cooked in by adding thickening made of 1 tablespoon flour or cornstarch and enough water to mix to smooth paste. Cook until thick as heavy cream. Let cool slightly before serving. They will slice like cold meat.

title: Norwegian Meatballs
instructions: Melt butter. Add onions and fry until soft and translucent.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Grind tomatoes peppers and onions using a coarse grinder. Add remaining ingredients and cook until thick (about 2 hours). Stir frequently to prevent burning. Pack in hot sterilized jars and seal immediately. Very good on cooked greens. Great on hot dogs. Makes 4 pints.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine; add flour milk and baking powder. Pour batter in greased pan and add fruit. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown and set. You may use any other fruit.

title: Lila'S Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar and salt together. Combine oleo water and cocoa\tin a pan until melted.\tPour into flour and sugar mixture. Add the\trest of the ingredients. Mix well. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan. Last 5 minutes start Quick and Easy Chocolate Frosting.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add flour butter and milk. Add coconut. Pour into partially baked pie shell and bake about 45 minutes or until firm at 325\u00b0.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Pour pie filling in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Add pineapple. Sprinkle cake mix over pineapple. Pour margarine or butter over cake mix. Add coconut. Sprinkle pecans over entire cake. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hot Onion Salad
instructions: Peel onions and slice 1/4-inch thick. Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Separate onion into rings and saute in bacon drippings until tender-crisp. Sprinkle with salt pepper and flour. Stir gently. Add vinegar and cook until slightly thickened. Sprinkle with bacon crumbs and parsley. Serve warm.

title: Chinese Noodles
instructions: Chop vegetables. In electric frypan fry onion and celery in oil. Dissolve broth in 2 cups of water and pour over onion and celery. Add chopped carrots; let simmer until tender. Add more water if necessary. Cook noodles in separate pot until tender. Add noodles and gluten to electric frypan. Keep adding water as necessary. Add broccoli and cover to steam broccoli until tender. Serve with soy sauce.

title: Sparkling Lemonade
instructions: Soak lemons in hot water for about 15 minutes. Dissolve sugar in 1 cup boiling water and cool. Squeeze juice from lemons. Combine fresh squeezed juice with dissolved sugar water. Pour into 2-quart pitcher and add sparkling water. Check for sweetness but added sugar will not dissolve well. Add ice and garnish with lemon slice.

title: Crustless Cheese Pie
instructions: Cream the cheese; add other ingredients. Beat until creamy and smooth. Bake in 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then lower temperature to 250\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes more.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: In mixing bowl stir together the pumpkin brown sugar eggs and oil until well mixed. Combine the flour oats cinnamon baking powder and baking soda. Add flour mixture to pumpkin mixture and mix well. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Set aside. Boil together the sugar and canned milk for 8 minutes; start timing after it comes to a boil. Pour hot mixture over chips mixture and stir until well blended and chips are melted. Pour into buttered pan. Cool. Makes about 5 pounds.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a stainless steel or glass bowl. Cover and chill thoroughly at least 4 hours. Serve in chilled cups. Top with croutons. Makes 6 servings.

title: Dressing Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Brown onion in margarine. Mix in all the rest of ingredients. Put into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 1 hour.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all and bake at same temperature you bake regular cornbread.

title: Meat Cabbage Casserole
instructions: In medium skillet saute onion in butter until soft but not brown. Add meat. Cook until loses pink color. In a 2 quart buttered casserole dish layer carrots and half of cabbage. Sprinkle with salt. Add meat mixture; press down slightly. Add remaining cabbage. To spaghetti sauce add Worcestershire sauce and chives. Pour over top of casserole. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until cabbage is soft. Add cheese to top. Bake uncovered for another 5 to 8 minutes until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and shortening. Add sugar and mix well. Add egg yolks one at a time and beat until fluffy. Combine flour and soda and add to mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into 3 floured and greased pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Mix by hand all ingredients. Grease and flour a 9x13 pan. Pour batter in pan.

title: E. Z. Fudge
instructions: Melt all together and pour into buttered pan or dish. Cool thoroughly and cut into pieces.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients with a small amount of the milk. Add the egg yolks the rest of the milk margarine and vanilla. Bring to a boil over medium heat until thick stirring constantly. Pour into a pre-baked crust. Top with meringue if desired. Recipe works well when doubled too.

title: Pie Crust (4)
instructions: With a fork mix first 4 ingredients in a separate bowl. In another bowl beat egg water and vinegar. Combine the 2 mixtures until all ingredients are moistened. With hands mold dough into a ball. Chill at least 15 minutes. Dough can be left in the refrigerator up to 3 days or frozen until ready to use.

title: Grannie'S Griddle Scones
instructions: For variations add currants or raisins.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter adding sugar a small amount at a time. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour coconut milk canned cream and vanilla at low speed adding the baking powder with the last of flour. Bake in 9-inch pans 30 or 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Polish Beans
instructions: Brown bacon kielbasa and onion in drippings from bacon. Toss with remaining ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Benihana Ginger Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and process until smooth. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Cook garlic onion pepper and mushrooms in a small amount of oil. Add tomatoes and bouillon; simmer 10 minutes. Add water chestnuts. Twenty to 30 minutes before serving add rice celery leaves and thyme. Add shrimp at the end so they wont shrink up too much.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in juice of blackberries. Add lemon juice. Pour in bottom of round cake pan. Add berries. Separate cinnamon rolls; place over top of berries. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until sauce is bubbling and rolls are golden brown. Garnish with Cool Whip.

title: Sugar Jumbles
instructions: Sift together flour sugar salt and baking soda. Mix eggs shortening butter and vanilla; add dry ingredients. Mix until creamy. Add nuts and chocolate pieces. Stir until well blended. Drop rounded teaspoon on a greased baking sheet until light brown 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Layered Taco Bean Dip
instructions: Place in 9 x 13-inch pan in order given. Serve with chips.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mushrooms and bring to a boil (stovetop or microwave). Add marinade to mushrooms cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Mix well. Pour into a tube pan. Cook at 325\u00b0.

title: Peppermint Meringues
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat egg whites until foamy. Sprinkle with salt and cream of tartar; beat until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff peaks form about 7 minutes. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased foil or paper-lined baking sheets; sprinkle with the crushed candy. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Turn off heat; leave cookies in the oven with the door ajar for at least 1 hour or until cool. Store in an airtight container. Yield 3 dozen.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine egg milk 2/3 c cracker crumbs salt and pepper. Stir in corn and onion. Mix well. Put in 1 qt. casserole dish. Toss melted butter with remaining cracker crumbs. Sprinkle on top of corn mixture. Bake at 350 for 65-70 minutes.

title: Neiman-Marcus Brownies
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and egg. Spread into buttered and floured 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan. Mix powdered sugar cream cheese and eggs. Put on top of cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: In a blender combine orange juice milk water sugar and vanilla. Cover and blend until smooth. With blender running add ice cubes one at a time through opening in lid. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately. Yields 4 to 5 servings.

title: Bubba'S Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Add butter to eggs. Combine dry ingredients and add to butter and egg mix. Add buttermilk and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 18.

title: Deluxe Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Combine peaches and 1 cup of sugar stir well and set aside. Beat eggs with an electric mixer at medium speed until frothy. Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar flour and salt; stir well. Gradually add sugar mixture to eggs beating until thick. Add milk mix well. Pour egg mixture in a large saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and coats metal spoon (about 15 minutes). Remove from heat and set pan in cold water; stir gently until cool. Stir in cream and vanilla. Add peaches stirring well.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Dump undrained pineapple in pan and spread evenly. Dump pie filling on top of pineapple and spread evenly. Dump dry cake mix on top of pie filling and spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts (if desired) over the top. Place slices of butter over top of cake. Bake 48 to 53 minutes. Serves 24.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add salt; slowly add sugar vanilla and then chocolate chips. Mix thoroughly and drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Put cookies in all together. Turn off heat and leave in oven overnight.

title: New England Corn Chowder
instructions: Chop salt and pork. Strain fat into soup pot. Discard rendered scraps. Add onions and saute until tender. Add flour mixing well. Cook without browning 3 to 4 minutes. Add chicken stock slowly stirring until smooth. Add corn. Cook potatoes separately. Drain and add to chowder. Add hot milk and cream. Season to taste. Enjoy!

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix first six ingredients. Add mayonnaise and pile lightly into buttered aluminum or glass 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle with cheese and potato chips. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 mins. or until heated thoroughly.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 or until topping is bubbly and browned some. Combine chicken chicken soup and milk; mix well. Add mushrooms celery noodles almonds and pimento. Saute onions in the butter. Add seasonings and mix well. Mix all together. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes to blend flavors. Put in greased 2-quart casserole. Mix egg whites to yolks; mix in cheese. Put this over casserole.

title: Lo-Cal Tuna Crispies
instructions: Drain tuna. Mix all ingredients in bowl until texture is even. Shape into 2 equal patties. Fry in nonstick pan until crispy brown on both sides.

title: Mary Hunsaker'S Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Add 1 small can shrimp. Chill. Serve with crackers and/or vegetable sticks.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Salad
instructions: Set jello as directed on package; refrigerate until almost set. Soften cream cheese with a fork and a little cream. Whip 1/2 pint of whip cream until stiff (may substitute Dream Whip). Whip jello; mix jello and whipped cream together. Beat in cream cheese with a spoon. Fold in crushed pineapple and refrigerate until set. Put in mold.

title: Cottage Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and Crisco. Add egg. Sift together about 1/2 cup flour with baking soda baking powder and nutmeg. Add alternately with milk. Add more flour until batter is heavy enough to stand in peaks. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
instructions: Prepare pudding mix with 3 1/2 cups milk using package directions. Stir in 2 tablespoons whipped topping and sour cream. Layer vanilla wafers banana slices and pudding mixture alternately in a 9 x 13-inch dish ending with vanilla wafers. Top with remaining whipped topping. Chill covered for 24 hours. Yield 15 servings.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Pour mixture over pork chops. Put foil over all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Then uncover and cook at same temperature for 15 minutes. (Can bake potatoes at same time.)

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Cream the butter peanut butter and sugars. Beat in egg and vanilla. Mix well. Blend in dry ingredients.

title: Easy All Occasion Punch
instructions: Put sherbet in a bowl approximately 30 minutes before serving. Just before serving pour Hawaiian Punch over softened sherbet and fold.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix and put in 1/2 gallon jar. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Cajun Heath Cake
instructions: Sift together flour and sugar; set aside. Place margarine cocoa and water in a pot; bring to a boil. Pour hot mixture on flour and sugar; mix well. Add buttermilk soda vanilla and eggs. Mix well. Pour in greased and floured oblong pan (9 x 13-inch). Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Add marshmallows to whipped cream. Drain pineapple pineapple chunks fruit cocktail and mandarin oranges; add grapes sometimes bananas and a few apples. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Spaghetti Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix all together in a casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Upside-Down Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix the brown sugar and dry mustard together; sprinkle it all over the bottom of a loaf pan. Set the peach halves in the loaf pan with the rounded bottoms sitting on the sugar. Now mix the ground ham and beef with the bread crumbs beaten eggs pepper and milk; pack it all into the pan right over the peaches. Bake the loaf in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Cool in the pan for about 10 minutes before turning it out with the peaches on top.

title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat egg shortening butter vanilla and 1/2 of cake mix until smooth then stir in remaining cake mix until smooth. Roll dough out; cut squares. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Poke fork holes in when fresh out of oven. Put ice cream between and freeze.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding with milk. Set in refrigerator for 15 minutes until it starts to set. Beat Cool Whip into pudding mix.

title: Steak Strips And Mushrooms
instructions: Cut steaks into 1/2 x 2-inch strips. Heat 3 tablespoons of the butter in frying pan. Over high heat saute meat 3 to 4 minutes tossing constantly until meat is cooked to your liking but do not overcook. Remove to warm platter. Add 3 tablespoons more butter to pan. Add green onions and mushrooms to pan. Saute over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove to platter with meat. Keep warm. Add wine and broth to pan. Over high heat boil scraping the brownings from the pan into sauce. Taste and add salt and pepper. Add lemon juice. Also add any juices from meat on platter. Boil over high heat until juices are a glaze about 1/4-inch deep in pan. Whisk in remaining butter. Return meat and mushrooms to pan. Toss and cook over high heat until mixture is hot. Sprinkle with chives and serve immediately.

title: Flossie Johnson'S Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage in salted water 8 minutes and drain. Saute onion and green pepper in bacon drippings. Mix cabbage bacon onion green pepper soup milk and cheese and turn into casserole. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly. Makes a lot and can be easily halved.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake in 3 greased and floured cake pans at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Old-Fashioned Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine flour baking powder and salt. Using fork or pastry blender cut shortening into flour until consistency of coarse meal. Add milk; stir with fork until mixture leaves sides of bowl and forms a soft moist dough.

title: Oatmeal Molasses Cookies
instructions: Sift together the 8 cups flour salt and soda. Mix oatmeal sugar and ginger. Stir in melted shortening molasses eggs water sifted dry ingredients nuts and raisins. Work dough by hand until well mixed. Add 1/2 cup flour if needed. Roll portions of dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with 3 1/2-inch cutter. Place on lightly greased sheets. Brush with water and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tofu Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except buttered crumbs. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion; drain. Salt and pepper to taste. Put in a baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and add to broccoli. Top with Pepperidge Farm cornbread stuffing mix. Dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tater Appetizers
instructions: Take each Tater Tot and wrap with 1/2 slice bacon and 1/2 slice cheese. Pierce with toothpick. Broil.

title: Jeff Davis Pie
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar; add flour salt and vanilla. Beat well. Add eggs; stir in milk. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes until firm.

title: Cheese-Dried Beef Ball
instructions: Mix together. Shape in ball and roll in parsley flakes.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine and roll into balls. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Xnipec Salsa (Dog Breath)
instructions: Soak diced onion in lime juice for at least 30 minutes. Add chilies and tomato and mix; salt to taste and add a little water if desired. Yields 1 1/2 extremely hot cups.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inches. Cook and stir ground beef and onions in skillet until brown; drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spread on plate. Beat milk baking mix and eggs until smooth 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake 35 minutes. Top with tomatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 5 to 8 minutes longer. Cool 5 minutes.

title: Tater-Topped Casserole
instructions: In a skillet cook onion celery and ground beef over medium heat until the meat is no longer pink and the vegetables are tender. Drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spoon mixture into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread soup over meat. Top with Tater Tots. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

title: Italian Creme Cake
instructions: Cream oleomargarine and Crisco; add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda and add to cream mixture. Alternate with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla; add coconut and nuts and fold in egg whites. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and use cream cheese frosting.

title: Zucchini Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls onto a greased griddle or frypan. Fry until golden brown.

title: Rotel Dip(Club Member: Clint Hudson)
instructions: Brown meat and put the can of Ro-Tel tomatoes in a crock-pot. Melt cheese; pour meat and cheese into crock-pot and stir. Keep crock-pot on low. Serve with corn chips.

title: Grandma'S Lemon Cream Pie
instructions: In a saucepan mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Add milk gradually and stir until smooth. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until smooth and thick about 10 minutes. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks then gradually add yolks to remaining hot mixture. Continue cooking stirring constantly about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter lemon peel and juice and blend thoroughly. Pour hot filling into pie shell. If made with a baked pie shell top with meringue. If a graham cracker crust is used serve with whipped cream.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add barbecue sauce; mix well. Drain beans and add; stir well. Add catsup for the liquid taste and color. Cook to the consistency desired.

title: Recipe For A Happy Church Family
instructions: Mix thoroughly with faith. Bake in moderate oven of tolerance. Cool. Cut in equal portions; garnish with smiles. Serve in everyday life God community and country.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients together in saucepan. Heat over low heat until it comes to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Beat Marshmallow Cream into mixture. Add peanut butter and blend well. Spread mixture into shallow pan and refrigerate cut into bars.

title: Bachelor'S Banquet
instructions: Carefully remove cardboard container from T.V. dinner. Set oven temperature as indicated on box. Remove foil over wrap if necessary. Place contents in oven. Gently cook meat potato and veggies until overly dry. Wash down with a cool sip of white wine. Continue to sip wine until meal tastes good. Then call Dominos pizza for the main coarse. And then pray for a woman in your life!

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; let stand 3 hours. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Pour into 4 (1 pound) coffee cans well greased. Fill about 1/2 full. (I use small loaf pans.) Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done when tested.

title: Cabbage Roll Casserole
instructions: Fry sausage and drain. In a medium casserole dish place cabbage onion rice soup water and sauerkraut. Mix well. Add sausage. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes without lid. Reduce oven to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let stand 10 minutes and serve.

title: Apple Walnut Ring Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Mix sifted flour baking soda salt cinnamon and mace. Gradually stir two mixtures together. Stir in vanilla apples and nuts. Batter will be stiff. Spoon into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Classic Coke Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter and flour a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Combine flour and sugar. Combine butter cocoa and Coke. Add to flour and sugar mixture stirring well. Add buttermilk eggs soda and vanilla. Fold in marshmallows. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Frost while warm.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixer bowl beat egg yolks with sweetened condensed milk. Stir in ReaLime brand and food coloring if desired. Pour into prepared pastry shell; bake 12 minutes. Cool. Chill. Top with whipped cream. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Wacky Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients (first 6) into bowl. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bohemian Cabbage
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except sour cream in skillet. Cover tightly. Cook 5 minutes or until cabbage is crisp-tender. Stir in sour cream; heat through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Surprise
instructions: Combine cornstarch sugar chicken bouillon cube water vinegar pineapple juice soy sauce and butter. Cook and stir until mixture boils; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Group cooked meatballs shrimp and chicken livers in the sauce. Heat through. Serve hot!! Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

title: Rigatoni And Tomatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except rigatoni and cheese. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Prepare rigatoni as directed on package; drain and immediately toss with tomato mixture. Serve immediately or chill. Sprinkle with cheese before serving.

title: Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Frost with Pillsbury vanilla frosting (ready to spread) and 3 ounces cream cheese.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Stir cranberries until spreadable. Put 1 layer jellied cranberries l layer Cool Whip and 1 layer crumbled crackers. Alternate until cranberries and Cool Whip are gone.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix zucchini onion and cheese. Mix Bisquick eggs and oil together. Pour in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (uncovered).

title: Tostito Pie
instructions: In a skillet brown the ground beef and drain. Add 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce and the taco seasoning. Stir well. Line the bottom of an 11 x 8 x 2-inch pan with 2 cups corn chips that have been crushed. Set remaining chips aside. Spoon meat mixture over the corn chips. Combine the remaining tomato sauce and refried beans and spread over the meat mixture. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Take out of oven and sprinkle remaining corn chips and Cheddar cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve sugar in Jell-O and water. Add celery nuts orange cranberries and pineapple. Stir well and chill until set.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Combine tuna carrots zucchini apple and onions. Mix in mayo mustard and poppy seeds and toss lightly. Cut pita bread in half to form pocket; fill with tuna mixture and serve.

title: Strawberry Sparkle Cake
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add frozen block of strawberries stirring to break up and mix berries. Place cake widest side down on a serving plate. Cut a 1-inch layer from the top and set aside. Cut around cake 1 inch from outer edge to 1 inch from bottom then cut around cake 1 inch from inner edge to 1 inch from bottom. Gently remove the section of cake between the cuts tearing it into small pieces. Fold pieces into strawberry mixture and pour it into cake shell. Replace the cake top.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion together; drain. Add cooked rice and other ingredients. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Roll the steak in flour and brown in the margarine. Place meat in a large roaster and cover with the water 1 cup Burgundy stew mix gravy mix salt pepper and dash of Worcestershire sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 until almost tender. Add the mushrooms onions 1 cup Burgundy and more water if needed. Bake until tender. Good served over rice.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Cream the butter with sugar. Add egg apples and vanilla. Add dry ingredients sifted together. A few raisins or nuts are optional. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix together. Put into buttered 1 1/2-quart serving dish. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Angels On Horseback
instructions: Slice raw hot dogs down the middle. Place shredded Cheddar cheese inside. Wrap with raw bacon strips held with toothpicks. Cook under broiler until done.

title: Old Miss Coffee Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions. Bake 10 minutes. Remove. Sprinkle nuts warm syrup cinnamon and margarine over cake. Return to oven. Bake 15 minutes. Drizzle with frosting when done.

title: Scampi Butter
instructions: Mix all ingredients into softened butter. Do not heat butter to blend in ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to use. Scampi butter not used in cheese sauce can be used to prepare shrimp scallops sirloin steak or chicken.

title: Lola Phillips' Lemon Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Let cool. Beat eggs lightly in a large bowl. Add vegetable oil and salt. Add dissolved jello. Mix in lemon cake mix and beat for 2 minutes. Bake in an oiled and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. When done pierce cake all over every 2-inches while still hot. Mix powdered sugar and lemon juice. Pour over hot cake. This will soak in and make a glaze when cold; do not frost. May be topped with ice cream or whipped cream. Cake is better if baked 2 days ahead of serving.

title: Easy Ghost Cookies
instructions: Melt almond bark in microwave on low heat; stirring constantly. Dip each cookie in melted almond bark and place on wax paper. Place two chocolate chips on warm candy coated cookie for eyes. Cool and serve!

title: Sherry'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Melt butter and pour over stuffing mix. Stir until well mixed. Pour 3/4 of mix into 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Pull chicken into bite-sized pieces and cover in dish. Cover with stuffing mixture.

title: Sister Lila Cobourn'S Vinegar Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add dry ingredients egg vinegar and water. Cook in top of double boiler until thickened stirring constantly.

title: Apple Pecan Cake
instructions: Mixing by hand combine sugar and eggs. Add flour to mixture; add vanilla. Mix well. Add pecans and apples. Batter will be thick. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until top of cake is golden brown.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Drain liquid as best as possible from pineapple. Put pineapple in large bowl. Add box of powdered lime Jell-O. Mix well. Add tub of Cool Whip. Mix well. Add cottage cheese. Refrigerate approximately 1 hour and serve chilled.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine cornmeal sugar garlic powder and onion. Combine milk and eggs. Add to mixture. Layer mixture sausage corn and cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef ground pork onion and garlic in large saucepan or Dutch oven until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain off all fat. Add tomatoes and break up with fork. Stir in tomato sauce 2 tablespoons parsley flakes the sugar 1 teaspoon salt and the basil. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered 1 hour or until mixture is consistency of spaghetti sauce. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cottage cheese 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese 1 tablespoon parsley flakes 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and the oregano. Reserve 1/2 cup meat sauce for thin top layer. In ungreased baking pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches layer 1/4 each of the noodles remaining meat sauce the Mozzarella cheese and cottage cheese mixture; repeat 3 times. Spread reserved meat sauce over top; sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. (If desired lasagne can be covered and refrigerated several hours at this point.) Bake uncovered 45 minutes. (Allow an additional 10 to 15 minutes if lasagne has been refrigerated.) For easier cutting let stand 15 minutes after removing from oven.

title: Chicken In Apple Mustard Sauce
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts and brown in margarine in skillet. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook 10 to 12 minutes or until chicken is tender. Makes 4 servings with 250 calories per serving.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0; cool.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch with 1/4 cup water. Then add the rest of the water and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and boil until it thickens.

title: Tuna Linguini
instructions: Cook linguini. Drain. Mix 1 can mushroom soup 1 can chicken soup 3/4 cup milk and 2 tablespoons wine in an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Stir in half of linguini 1 can mushrooms and 1 can tuna. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of cheese. Repeat with remaining ingredients in a second pan. (Cook 1 dish uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbly about 30 minutes.) Wrap second dish and freeze. About 1 1/2 hours before serving remove pan from freezer and unwrap. Cook uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 80 to 90 minutes.

title: Pastry(Home Ec. Dept.)
instructions: Sift flour. Measure add salt and cut into Crisco with a pastry blender. Add lemon juice to slightly beaten egg. Then add water to liquid and mix well. Sprinkle lightly on dough. Mix well. Roll out to form pie shell.

title: Baskin-Robbins Pie
instructions: Mix flour nuts and margarine in pie plate and press to bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl except carrots. Add carrots last. Grease and flour three 8-inch layer pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Depending on individual oven you may bake up to 45 minutes.

title: Linda'S Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix together eggs cottage cheese salt onion margarine and broccoli. Add cornbread mix last. Put in well-greased baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20-30 minutes until brown. Serve hot.

title: Vegetable Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables using coarse blade. Sprinkle with salt; let stand overnight. Rinse and drain. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables. Heat to boiling. Simmer 3 minutes. Seal in hot sterilized jars. Makes 8 pints.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla. Beat together. Add flour baking soda and salt and mix well.
