Stir in oats chocolate chips coconut and nuts. Mix well. Drop by tablespoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 10 minutes. Cool 1 minute and remove to wire racks. Cool. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Peanut Soup
instructions: Heat chicken broth to boiling. Add peanut butter stirring until smooth. Add salts and sugar. Stir in cream or evaporated milk. Heat; do not boil. Top with chopped peanuts. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Pie
instructions: Butter pan; add sliced cranberries. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and nuts; add to pie. Beat eggs until light; add 1 cup sugar and flour. Cream oleo and shortening; add all ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with whipped cream.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Slice beef across the grain into very thin trips. In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook 1/2 the beef and onion until meat is no longer pink and onion is tender; set aside. Repeat with remaining margarine beef and onion. Return meat mixture to skillet. Stir in soup and paprika. Heat through. Stir in sour cream. Serve over hot cooked noodles. Makes 6 servings.

title: Applesauce Pie
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in a Dutch oven over medium heat stirring often 35 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat and discard lemon. add butter and vanilla cool. Fit one piecrust into a 9 inch pie plate. Pour applesauce mixture into crust. Roll remaining piecrust to press out fold lines and cut into 1/2 inch strips. Arrange strips into a lattice design over filling fold edges under and crimp. Bake at 425 degrees for 30-35 minutes.

title: Bacon Corn Bread Muffins
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Add corn meal; combine egg milk and bacon to dry ingredients. Fill muffin tins (greased) 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Emerald Isle Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup of boiling water; dissolve marshmallows in pineapple juice. Add to jello. Chill until it starts to jell. Then add pineapple cottage cheese whipping cream (whipped) and nuts. Chill until firm at least overnight.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Grease and flour pans. (Will make 2 cakes in loaf pans or 3 in coffee cans.) Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick Caramel Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease the bottom of Bundt pan with Crisco. Put 1/2 of the nuts in the bottom of the pan. Drop in all of the frozen balls of dough spreading around in the pan. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over dough balls; top with remaining nuts. In a bowl cut the sugar and butter together; sprinkle these crumbs over top. Set in cold oven at night. (Prepare at bedtime if you want to use in morning.) In the morning bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour or until done. Let stand in Bundt pan about 5 minutes then invert pan on serving plate. Best served warm.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Heat small can of crushed pineapple (do not drain) with apricot nectar. Pour over jello and stir thoroughly. Chill until firm then fold in 1 small package Dream Whip and cottage cheese.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Drain the peas. In bowl add the next 4 ingredients. Place in covered bowl and refrigerate until ready to serve (1 to 2 hours).

title: Beef 'N Cheese Foldover
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Stir in barbecue sauce; set aside. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Unroll dinner roll dough into 4 long rectangles on ungreased cookie sheet. Overlap long sides. Press perforations and seal. Pat to form 15 x 13-inch rectangle. Spread meat mixture lengthwise in a 4-inch wide strip down center of dough to within 1 inch of ends. Top meat with cheese slices. Fold shorter ends of dough 1 inch over filling. Bring long sides of dough rectangle over filling overlapping edges. Pinch edges to seal. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chili Like Wendy'S
instructions: Brown beef in heavy pot; drain off fat. Crumble into small pieces. In a large pot combine beans tomato sauce celery tomatoes onions pepper spices seasonings and water. Add cooked beef. Bring to a simmer over low heat. Cook stirring every 20 to 30 minutes for 2 to 3 hours. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese when serving.

title: Cheese And Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Add vegetables continue cooking 5 minutes; drain. Set aside to cool 10 minutes. Stir together sausage mixture cheese and bread cubes. Place in a greased 8 1/2 x 12-inch baking dish. Beat milk and eggs. Pour over sausage mixture. Cover and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Chicken Angel Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta nest until done. Drain. Meanwhile brown chicken slightly in olive oil. Remove add onion celery pepper and chives. Saute. Place pasta in casserole. Top with cheese then onion mixture then chicken. Pour milk over. Spoon soup over each piece of chicken. Bake 375\u00b0 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar butter eggs vanilla and milk; mix well. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole dish. Cover with topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Easter Eggs
instructions: Boil and mash potato. Add confectioners sugar vanilla and coconut or peanut butter. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Shape into eggs and refrigerate overnight. Cover with coating chocolate.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Drain juice from fruit cocktail mandarin oranges and cherries. Mix all fruit into large bowl. Mix in marshmallows and sour cream. Put coconut in last. Stir and cover. Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Craban Sauce
instructions: Cook cranberries following instructions on the bag and either separate half or cook half reducing sugar and water by half. As cranberries are simmering add the tangerine peel to the water. Squeeze some of the juice from the tangerine and also add to the water. When cranberries are done let cool and remove tangerine peel. Add mashed banana and mix thoroughly. Chill.

title: Jalapeno Casserole
instructions: Mix soups and boned chicken in saucepan; heat. Pour over Doritos chips in large 11 x 13-inch casserole dish. Top with grated cheese and sliced jalapenos. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Serve and enjoy.

title: Black And White Cheesecake Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt 1 1/2 cups of chocolate chips in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes on High. In large bowl combine sugar and butter; beat until creamy. Add eggs vanilla and salt then add melted chocolate and flour; mix well. Spread into foil lined 9-inch square pan.

title: Shredded Carrot Salad
instructions: Peel and shred or grate carrots. Add marshmallows pineapple raisins and coconut. Mix lightly. Combine carrot mixture with mayonnaise; carefully fold in whipped cream. Refrigerate at least one hour. This freezes well!

title: Strawberry Yogurt Whip
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water. Chill until slightly thickened. Add yogurt and beat with rotary beater until mixture is light and fluffy. Pour into punch cups or individual dishes. Chill about 2 hours. Makes 8 servings.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix Veg-All corn celery onions and mayonnaise. Put in casserole dish. Add cheese. Top with Ritz crackers and margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mock Sukiyaki
instructions: Brown the steak; add beef broth vegetables and soy sauce. Cover; simmer 10 minutes or until tender. Stir often. Combine 1/4 cup water and cornstarch. Stir into mixture. Simmer until thickened. Serve over rice.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Heat pineapple juice and dissolve jello in warm pineapple juice. Cool slightly. Cream the cheese. If necessary add small amount of cream. Whip the cream. Add slightly cooled jello to cream cheese. Add whipped cream. Add other ingredients. Chill to set.

title: Sourdough Bread And Starter
instructions: Let stand out of refrigerator 8 to 12 hours. (This doesnt rise only bubbles.) Take out 1 cup to use in making bread. Return remaining to refrigerator. Keep in refrigerator 3 to 5 days. (I keep mine in refrigerator from one week to the next week.) Take out and feed again. If not used to make bread throw away 1 cup or give to someone as a starter. Must feed every 3 to 5 days.

title: Old-Time Sugar Cream Pie
instructions: Combine sugars salt and flour. Add cream and vanilla mixing until smooth. Pour into pastry shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake in very hot oven (450\u00b0) for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Use fruit for garnish preferably strawberries.

title: Candy Coated Carrots
instructions: Boil carrots until just tender. Drain and set aside. In pan combine butter and brown sugar; mix well over low heat. Stir until bubbly. Add Tabasco and salt. Remove from heat. Add lemon juice and carrots. Stir gently to coat well. Serve warm or cold.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. Stir in blueberries. Add milk egg whites and Ultra Promise. Mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. The batter will be lumpy. Do not overbeat. Spoon batter into 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups (sprayed with Pam). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until tops spring back when lightly touched. Serve warm.

title: Dump Cake(Black Forest)
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Add marshmallows over bottom of pan. Mix Duncan Hines cake mix. Pour over marshmallows. Spoon can of cherry pie filling over chocolate cake mix. Sprinkle nuts over the top. Cook for 45 to 60 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Italian Beef
instructions: Cook in crock pot until meat falls apart. Take the meat out place on a plate and take two forks and shred the meat then put back in juice. Serve on Bun with chips pickles or over rice with vegetables.

title: Zucchini Goulash
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package adding the cubes of zucchini and peeled tomato quarters. Drain. Brown ground beef and onion. Drain off excess fat. Add cooked macaroni zucchini and tomatoes. Add pepper brown sugar margarine milk packet of cheese and seasoning mix to taste. Stir to combine all ingredients. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Combine sugar eggs oil salt and cinnamon. Pour over apples and let stand 20 minutes. Mix flour soda and nuts. Add mixture to apples. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven in 10 x 13-inch pan or 9 x 13-inch pan for 50 minutes.

title: Chocolate Syrup
instructions: Boil for 4 minutes. Take off heat. Excellent for chocolate milk hot chocolate and ice cream topping.

title: Bojangles' Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in Crisco; mix in buttermilk and work until smooth. Roll out thick and cut. Dip in melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Yields about 10 big biscuits. Very good!

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients starting with softened oleo. Mix with wooden spoon. Chill dough 1 hour or overnight. Shape dough into balls size of walnuts. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes about 10 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Thaw hash browns for 30 minutes. Add all ingredients; mix well. Add additional shredded cheese on top if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Butter Mints
instructions: Cream together margarine milk and butter flavoring until fluffy and stir in sugar replacement. Knead or work with hands until smooth. Roll in small balls and press each ball into mold. Unmold on wax paper. Yield 45 pieces; calories per 3 pieces 56.

title: Pistachio Biscotti(Makes About 40 Biscotti)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 2 baking sheets. In small bowl combine flour baking powder and pistachios. With electric mixer beat egg and egg whites until frothy. Gradually beat in sugar and vanilla until very thick and pale yellow (about 5 minutes). Fold flour mixture into egg batter until well combined.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots. Mix in all ingredients. Top with crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all casserole ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Crumble topping over the top of the potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. I always double the topping due to everybody wants the topping with the sweet potatoes. If you do this just double the recipe for the topping. I usually cut the butter to 3/4 cup instead of 1 cup.

title: Yellow Gold Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender but not soft. Combine with remaining chopped ingredients and marinate at least 24 hours before serving. Serve hot or cold.

title: Tangy Mustard Cauliflower(Microwave)
instructions: Place cauliflower and water into 1 1/2-quart glass casserole. Cover with glass lid. Microwave 9 minutes on High. Drain.

title: Cheese Carrot Casserole
instructions: Scrape and slice carrots. Cook until tender. Drain well; melt cheese and butter together with carrots. Put all together in a buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with buttered Ritz cracker crumbs on top. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until bubbly.

title: Desserts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Make pie crust or unthaw 2 pie crusts. Beat eggs slightly then add remaining ingredients. Pour into pastry lined pie pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Scallop Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes in 11 x 14-inch baking dish. Slice onion on top. Bring butter flour and milk to a boil and gradually add cheese to mixture. Add salt. Add this mixture over potatoes and onion. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

title: Diabetic Apple Pie
instructions: In sauce pan blend apple juice concentrate and cornstarch. Cook and stir until the mixture boils is clear and thickens. Stir in butter and spices. Pour thickened mixture over apples. Put filling in unbaked pie shell and top with pie crust. Bake in a preheated oven at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Turn heat down to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 45 minutes more or until crust is brown.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix in dish the pudding fruit cocktail crushed pineapple and miniature marshmallows. Stir in Dream Whip. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Combine first 7 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese; then cornflakes. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Frozen Lemon Mousse
instructions: Cook egg yolks sugar grated lemon rind and lemon juice for three minutes stirring constantly. Fold in evaporated milk that has been chilled and whipped and the stiffly beaten egg whites. Place 1/4 inch of graham cracker crumbs in bottom of 8 inch square dish. Pour in mousse. Place another 1/4 inch layer of crumbs on top. Cover with plastic wrap and place in freezer preferably overnight. Do not remove until ready to serve.

title: Sausage Noodle Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage and onion over medium heat and drain. Mix soup cheese evaporated milk salt oregano and pepper in 3-quart bowl. Stir in meat mixture and 3 cups cooked noodles. Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish. Top mixture with bread crumbs and pour melted margarine over it. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly hot. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Frozen Yogurt Pie
instructions: Grind graham crackers into fine crumbs. Add sugar and melted margarine. Press into pie plate and chill 1 hour or bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes and then cool thoroughly. Fold whipped topping and yogurt together and spoon into crust. Chill and serve.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: You will need 2 (10-inch) skillets and a baking pan.

title: Oat Pancakes
instructions: Combine oats flour sugar baking powder and salt in mixing bowl. Make a well in center. Combine eggs milk oil and lemon juice. Pour into well and stir just until moistened. Pour batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto a lightly greased hot griddle. Turn when bubbles form on top of pancakes. Cook until second side is golden brown.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup oleo melted with graham cracker crumbs. Put into pan (9 x 13-inch). Beat egg remaining oleo and powdered sugar for 5 minutes. Spread over crust. Cover with sliced bananas; spread crushed pineapple on that. Cover with topping. Put nuts and cherries on top. Refrigerate overnight or for 6 hours.

title: German Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Combine cake mix 1/3 cup milk and melted butter. Press 1/2 of this mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 6 to 8 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly. In double boiler or microwave melt caramels and remaining 1/3 cup milk. Remove cake. Sprinkle chocolate chips over crust followed by nuts then melted caramels. Crumble remaining cake mix over all and return to oven for 15 to 18 minutes. Cool in refrigerator 30 minutes. Makes 36 bars.

title: Ugly Duckling Cake
instructions: Combine the cake mix fruit cocktail with syrup 1 cup of the coconut and eggs in a large mixer bowl. Blend then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until cake springs back.

title: Creamy Corn Italiano
instructions: In saucepan cook onions with garlic oregano and basil in margarine until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Heat; stir occasionally. Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

title: Fat-Free Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Use an 8-inch square nonstick pan or a regular pan coated with a nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl combine cornmeal flour baking powder and baking soda. In a small bowl beat egg whites until foamy. Add to flour mixture and blend thoroughly. Pour into pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until springy to the touch.

title: Canatappi With Prosciutto, Artichokes And Sun-Dried Tomatoes In
instructions: Heat oil and rosemary in skillet. Add sun-dried tomatoes and artichokes to oil and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Add Prosciutto. Saute 1 minute. Add canatappi and toss with other ingredients until well mixed and canatappi is lightly and evenly coated with rosemary oil. Saute another minute then portion pasta into 4 bowls. Garnish with fresh rosemary and freshly ground pepper. Serves 4.

title: Salmon Jay'S Way
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix salt flour and garlic powder well. Press the mixture on all 4 sides of the salmon fillets. In a heavy ovenproof skillet add the oil and once it is hot add the fillets browning them lightly on both sides. Place the skillet in the oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Do not overcook. Serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Blend until creamy. Blend in egg. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Spiced Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit syrup into saucepan and put the fruit itself into a bowl. Add sugar vinegar and whole spices to the syrup and boil for 5 minutes. Pour syrup and spices over the fruit and cover\ttightly. Put in refrigerator and let stand at least 4 hours.

title: No Peek Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients well in a 2-quart casserole (I use a roaster). Cover. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Dont peek until it is done. Serve over rice or noodles. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Company Hash
instructions: Make a dark roux using oil and flour. Saute the onion celery and garlic until they are clear. Add the rest of the ingredients including the meat and simmer for 30 minutes. While the meat mixture is cooking parboil carrots and potatoes. Add to meat mixture after 30 minutes. Cook for 5 minutes and add the additional 1/2 cup Claret wine. Cook for additional 5 minutes. This may be served over rice noodles or bread. Serves 6.

title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In large size mixing bowl blend together all ingredients. Turn mixture into pie shell. Bake in a 375\u00b0 (moderate) oven until sharp-bladed knife inserted near center comes out clean 50 to 55 minutes. Cool. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve cold with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

title: Winter Relish For Tacos
instructions: Boil until it is thick. The longer you boil the better it is. Spoon on taco shells after all other ingredients are on. Yummy.

title: Karo Sweet 'N Sour Pork
instructions: Drain pineapple reserve juice. In large skillet heat oil over medium high heat. Add pepper onion and garlic; stir-fry 2 minutes or until tender-crisp. Remove. Stir-fry pork half at a time 3 minutes. Return vegetables to skillet.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Saute onions and celery in margarine until tender. Remove from skillet and brown ground meat. Drain. Add onions and celery back to meat; stir in tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce. Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle rice over meat mixture. Add a little water if necessary. Place lid on skillet and simmer until all liquid is gone. Fluff with fork and serve. Great with chips and picante sauce.

title: Pork Barbecue
instructions: Cook meat for 3 to 4 hours until done. Let cool but not cold then shred apart and add to cup of broth sugar vinegar and onion. Cook for 1 hour or so. Then serve on buns.

title: Baked Fish
instructions: Season fish; coat with flour and saute in 4 tablespoons butter 8 to 10 minutes. Saute mushrooms. Brown sliced potatoes in 4 tablespoons butter. Place in a glass baking dish. Layer fish then egg slices mushrooms and potatoes on top.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container. Use 1/3 c. mix to 2/3 c. water when making hot chocolate. Makes a great gift with the Chocolate Coffee Spoons (below).

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell in 400\u00b0 oven. Mix sugar and cornstarch in 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Stir in water gradually. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils; boil and stir 1 minute. Add the beaten egg yolk to hot mixture; boil 1 minute. Remove from heat; add margarine lemon juice and food coloring (optional). Pour into pie shell. Spoon meringue over hot pie filling carefully sealing meringue to edge of crust. Bake until brown.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Layer fruits in large glass bowl in order given. Spoon orange juice on top. Cover and chill for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until soft but not brown. Add 5 cups thinly chopped potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Barely cover with water. Cook until potatoes fall apart and become thickened. Remove from heat. Mash with potato masher or fork. Add vinegar and condensed milk. Reheat to serving temperature but do not allow to boil. Serve with crackers cornbread or cornsticks. Serves 4 or 5.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the first 4 ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients except flour. Add flour. Roll dough into balls then in sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil noodles and put in 13 x 9-inch pan. Add soups chicken and peas in same pan. Stir to mix ingredients. Add cheese on top with cracker crumbs. Cover with foil and cook at 350\u00b0 in oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Never Spoil Cole Slaw
instructions: Boil vinegar oil and salt. Set aside to cool. Mix remaining ingredients. Sprinkle sugar over cabbage. Pour liquid mixture over cabbage mixture; mix thoroughly. Refrigerate in Tupperware covered bowl. Will keep 3 or 4 months.

title: Hot Chicken Salad(Serves 10)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the potato chips. Place in 13 x 9-inch dish. Top with chips and place in refrigerator overnight. Remove to room temperature for 1 hour before baking at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Can be made ahead and froze.

title: Microwave Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Microwave margarine and marshmallows on Full power in large glass mixing bowl for 2 minutes. Stir to combine. Microwave on Full power 1 1/2 to 2 minutes longer. Stir until smooth. Add cereal. Stir until well coated. Press into well buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. When cool cut into squares.

title: Clara'S Deluxe Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Beat sugar and eggs until thickened and pale. Stir in oil. Sift together flour baking soda baking powder and cinnamon. Stir into egg mixture. Fold in carrots and nuts. Spoon batter into pan. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Turn onto cake rack to cool. Frost.

title: Macaroni And Cheese With Ham
instructions: Layer into buttered 1 1/2 to 2-quart baking dish 3 layers each of macaroni onion ham and cheese. Sprinkle with salt and pepper ending with top layer cheese salt and pepper. Pour milk over all. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Zucchini Flan
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet; add onion. Cook stirring until onion is wilted. Trim and discard ends of zucchini; slice into thin rounds and add to skillet. Cook briefly; stir. Spoon mixture into buttered casserole. Blend cream egg yolks egg and nutmeg. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour mixture over zucchini. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until custard is lightly set. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Rhubarb Cake #2
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in spray-greased 10 x 13-inch pan in which only bottom of pan has been greased. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mixer on high speed until smooth. Pour batter into greased and floured angel food cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let cool 10 to 15 minutes then turn out onto plate.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello with boiling water. Add frozen berries. Place in refrigerator until slightly jelled. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Wellington
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute chicken in butter. Roll out pastry shells between wax paper until fairly thin.

title: Pineapple Dream Cake
instructions: Make angel food cake according to directions on box. Cut cake in three layers. Put all other ingredients in bowl (except pineapple) and mix at medium speed until thickened. Do not overbeat. Spoon in pineapple evenly throughout mixture. Spread each individual layer generously.

title: No Bake Fudge Brownies
instructions: Melt over hot (not boiling) water the chocolate morsels. Stir until smooth. Add milk chocolate wafers and 1/2 cup nuts. Stir until blended. Press into foil-lined 8-inch square pan. Press remaining 1/2 cup nuts into brownies. Let stand at room temperature until firm. Cut into 2-inch squares.

title: Mississippi Mud Slide
instructions: Combine margarine flour and nuts. Mix well. Press in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes (or use graham cracker crust).

title: Campfire Stew
instructions: Cook stewed potatoes; drain half of water. Add both cans of soup. Make patties of meat of your choice real small half the size of normal patties. Drain grease. Add to soups and potatoes.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix together the cake mix oil and water. Then after its mixed together put the chips in. Drop onto cookie sheet. Cook 8 to 12 minutes on 350\u00b0.

title: Oven Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Combine tomato sauce cranberry sauce brown sugar vinegar Worcestershire sauce and chili powder in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes or until slightly thickened.

title: Golden Carrot Ring
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling water then drain thoroughly. Mix all other ingredients together and combine with carrots. Spread butter thoroughly over inside of 9-inch ring mold. Line with greased wax paper then pour carrot mixture into mold and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Turn onto a large plate and fill center with any other vegetable such as peas mushrooms etc. Serves 12 to 14 easily for a buffet.

title: Flip-Flop Bean Salad
instructions: Important You will need a Tupperware or similar tight fitting bowl that wont leak when turned upside down.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger drain and add taco seasoning. Chop lettuce tomato and add cheese chips and seasoned hamburger. Pour dressing over top and stir together.

title: Yum-Yum Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed and bake in a rectangular pan. Mix instant pudding as directed and beat together with cream cheese. Layer cream cheese/pudding mixture on top of cake. Follow with a drained can of crushed pineapple then Cool Whip. Sprinkle with crushed nuts and coconut. Decorate with cherries and chill for 1 hour before serving. Yum-yum!

title: Russian Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Simmer onion soup mix Russian dressing and water for 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt in microwave for 5 minutes stirring and turning once. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Fruit Jumbles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream shortening and brown sugar until light; stir in egg yolk vanilla and syrup from maraschino cherries. Blend or sift together flour and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Add dates raisins coconut quartered maraschino cherries candied pineapple and walnuts. Combine thoroughly. Drop from a teaspoon onto greased baking sheets. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Creamy Chef'S Dressing(Low-Fat)
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Blend or process until smooth. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Buttermilk Fudge
instructions: Mix soda with buttermilk; stir well. Add to sugar in a large boiler. Stir in corn syrup; add butter. Cook until medium ball is formed (240\u00b0). Remove from heat. Beat well. Add nuts. Pour out on buttered surface or drop by spoonfuls.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine. Add sugar gradually and cream. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and cream. Add flour salt and baking powder. Chill dough overnight or a minimum of 4 hours. Roll on floured board and shape with cookie cutters. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit. Beat egg yolks; add other ingredients (sugar pineapple juice and vinegar). Mix well and cook until thick stirring constantly. Let cool.\tWhen cooled add fruit marshmallows and 1 cup Cool Whip. Let set overnight in refrigerator. This is real good.

title: Clete'S Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Heat butter in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Saute onion in butter. Stir in whipping cream; heat to boiling. Stir in 2 tablespoons cheese 1 teaspoon nutmeg 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes stirring frequently. Heat water and 1 tablespoon salt to boiling in large kettle; add fettuccine noodles. Boil uncovered until tender but firm. Drain fettuccine. Mix fettuccine and sauce; top with 2 tablespoons cheese and 1 teaspoon nutmeg. Serve with pepper. Makes 4 servings.

title: Herbed Tomatoes
instructions: Peel tomatoes cut crosswise in half. Place in deep bowl sprinkling each layer with seasonings and herbs. Combine oil and vinegar and pour over tomatoes. Cover chill an hour or more basting often. Drain. Yields 12 servings.

title: Date Loaf
instructions: Crumble all but 4 graham crackers very fine; chop nuts fine. Chop pitted dates and cut marshmallows into small pieces. Combine all ingredients together and form into a long roll; crumble remaining 4 crackers and roll in those. Wrap in waxed paper and place in refrigerator at least 1 hour. Slice and serve with whipped cream.

title: Canned Beets
instructions: Cook and peel beets (cook approximately 60 minutes) until knife-tender but dont check very often because they will bleed and be dry. Dip into cold water and peel. Slice and put into jars.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Rinse a large bowl with hot water then pour warm water into bowl. Sprinkle yeast over warm water. Add sugar and salt and stir until completely dissolved. Add egg butter and 3 cups of flour mixing with a wooden spoon or mixer at medium speed. Beat very hard for 2 minutes or until smooth. Gradually add 1 cup of flour beating hard after addition. Using hands work remaining 2 cups of flour into dough until dough is smooth and elastic. After working in all flour return dough to large bowl. Brush top of dough with 1 teaspoon melted butter. Cover and let stand until it doubles in size. If using immediately punch dough down and shape into medium size balls. Let rise again before baking. If not using immediately punch dough down and refrigerate.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage. Add other ingredients; mix well. This makes a large amount and is ideal for cookouts.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar in mixing bowl. Add eggs mixing well after each addition. Beat until fluffy. Combine cocoa flour baking powder and salt. Add vanilla to milk. Add milk mixture alternately with flour mixture to butter mixture. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Fish Pickles
instructions: Sprinkle salt over the tomatoes pepper onions and hot pepper. Let stand overnight. Drain off liquid. Squeeze out all the liquid so it wont be too salty. Mix sugar mustard seed and vinegar. Heat until sugar dissolves. Then add vegetable mixture. Heat until vegetables change color. Stir and let boil about 5 minutes. Put in jars and seal. I put the filled and sealed jars in hot water bath for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Salad
instructions: Melt marshmallows in milk in double boiler. Pour hot mixture over gelatin; stir until dissolved. Stir in cream cheese. Add pineapple. Cool. Blend in Dream Whip. Refrigerate until set. (May use any flavor gelatin.)

title: Pecan Rolls
instructions: Use about 1/3 refrigerator dough. Roll out dough into a 12 x 7-inch oblong pan. Spread surface with the soft butter. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Cut into 12 slices. Place in pan coated with the melted butter brown sugar and pecans. Let rise 25 to 35 minutes. When baked turn pan upside down onto serving plate for a few minutes.

title: Vanity Fair Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar coconut and milk. Pour mixture into pastry shell and bake for 1/2 hour.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak into strips. Sprinkle with garlic. Brown beef in margarine in a large skillet. Add mushrooms. Cover with bouillon and cook 30 minutes. Prepare rice or noodles at this time. Stir in onion and peppers; cook 5 minutes. Blend flour water and soy sauce. Stir onto meat and vegetables; cook until thickened. Add tomatoes and stir gently. Serve immediately over rice or noodles.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken and debone; remove skin. Put chicken into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour the celery soup and chicken broth over chicken. Mix the flour and milk together until lumps dissolve. Pour over chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook beans according to package directions. Set aside.

title: French Tomatoes
instructions: Put tomatoes in flat dish and cover with onion pepper and parsley. Cover with the dressing.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with onions and celery. Add both soups and stir until well mixed. Place mixture in a large baking dish. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Cover the top with Tater Tots. Bake at 400\u00b0 until Tater Tots are golden brown.

title: Minced Clam-Cheese Dip
instructions: Allow cream cheese to soften at room temperature. Drain clams and reserve liquid. Mix clams softened cream cheese and other ingredients until creamy. Add reserved liquid by spoonfuls until desired consistency is obtained. Serve with crisp crackers or potato chips.

title: Glazed Acorn Squash
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cut each squash lengthwise in half; remove seeds and fibers. Place squash cut sides up in ungreased rectangular pan 13 x 9 x 2. Spoon 1 Tbsp. of maple syrup and 1 Tbsp. whipping cream into each half. Bake uncovered about 1 hour or until tender.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple well. Put in casserole dish. Mix sugar and flour sprinkle over pineapple. Grate cheese put over this. Then crumble crackers real fine add next. Melt butter pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage Twirls
instructions: Combine biscuit mix milk and butter in large bowl until blended and refrigerate dough for 30 minutes. Divide refrigerated dough into two portions and roll out each portion on wax paper to 1/8 inch thick rectangles each about 10 x 7 inches. On each of the rectangles spread half the uncooked sausage over dough and top sausage with half the peppers and onions if desired. Roll lengthwise into a log. Place both logs wrapped in freezer until hard enough to cut easily about one hour. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut each log into 24 thin slices and place on non-stick baking sheets. Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove twirls from oven. Reheat to serve.

title: Individual Cheesecakes
instructions: Mix 5 minutes at medium speed with mixer. Fill a cupcake tin with cupcake papers. Put a vanilla wafer cookie in the bottom of cupcake paper. Fill each cupcake paper 3/4 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Garlic Chicken With Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta; drain well. Rinse chicken and cut into 3/4-inch pieces. Stir together chicken broth cornstarch salt and pepper. Preheat wok. Add onion garlic oregano and thyme; stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add mushrooms and zucchini; stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes. Add oil then chicken to wok. Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes. Add sauce; fry until thick and bubbly. Cook for 2 minutes more. Stir in tomato veggies and pasta.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix ingredients and store in tightly covered jar. To serve add 1 1/2 to 2 teaspoons to each cup of boiling water you use.

title: Something Really Delicious(Spinach Bread)
instructions: Let frozen bread dough rise according to package directions. Cook spinach; drain and squeeze out excess liquid. Let cool. Remove sausage from casing and crumble it. Cook and drain off grease. Let cool. Combine cooled spinach sausage cheeses and seasonings. Roll each loaf of bread dough into a rectangle about 9 x 12-inches. Do not stretch too thin. Spread half of spinach mixture lengthwise down the center third of each rectangle. Dot filling with butter. Fold over one side of dough then fold over the other side to overlap. Pinch to seal tightly; seam should be on top. Fold ends under and seal tightly to keep filling from running out. Place each loaf on a cookie sheet and form into a slight crescent shape. Brush with egg white. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 25 minutes or until golden. Loaves should sound hollow when tapped. Let loaves stand about 5 to 10 minutes to firm up cheese. Slice with serrated knife. Loaves freeze well after baking. Reheat in oven.

title: Texas Impossible Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Beat in butter sugar flour baking powder and salt. Beat well. Add milk vanilla and coconut; beat well. Pour mixture into 2 pie pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes its own crust.

title: Mexican Hamburger
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Then in a bowl mix Ro-Tel Cheddar cheese cream of chicken cream of celery and cream of mushroom. In a long Pyrex dish place Tostitos in bottom. Place hamburger meat on top of chips. Slice Velveeta and place on hamburger then pour remaining ingredients over. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Raisin Bread(Low-Fat)
instructions: In a large bowl combine all dry ingredients including raisins. Mix together egg substitute nonfat milk and vanilla. Add liquid mixture to dry mixture and mix well. Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Let stand for 5 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Serves 20. Contains .3 grams fat and 112 calories.

title: Corn Flake Kisses
instructions: Cook sugar and Karo until sugar melts. Add peanut butter and mix well. Pour over corn flakes and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Easy Spaghetti
instructions: Cook onion pepper and beef in skillet until brown. Mix in the can of spaghetti until the spaghetti is warm.

title: Chippy Oatmeal Raisin Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat sugar margarine eggs and vanilla until creamy. Gradually add flour and mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread into pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool completely and cut into bars.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar; beat. Add Karo syrup; beat. Add nuts salt and vanilla. Put in unbaked pie shell; dot with butter or margarine. Bake for 50 minutes in slow oven (325\u00b0). Pie will seem not done (or loose) after baking but will settle and firm as it sets.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Add milk to eggs. Then add sugar and corn. Stir in flour paste mixture and melted butter. Put in well-greased pan (8 x 8-inch). Flavor with nutmeg (sprinkle on top). Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Combine oleo and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Sauce
instructions: Bring vinegar garlic red and black pepper to a boil; reduce heat and add butter and lemon juice. Let simmer 5 minutes; remove from heat and let cool. For white sauce add mayonnaise at room temperature to 1 1/2 pints of Sauce recipe and shake in quart jar.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Over low burner cream peanut butter confectioners sugar and butter. Remove from heat and fold in Rice Krispies. In a double boiler melt 12 ounces chocolate chips with oil. Spread peanut butter mixture in a cookie sheet and pour melted chocolate on top. Refrigerate 10 minutes; cut in squares and serve. Store in refrigerator.

title: Quiche
instructions: Brown ham or bacon with peppers onion and mushrooms. Put in pie shell. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour into pie shell over meat mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Soak peas overnight drain. Place ham and peas in large pot; bring to boil. Skim if necessary. Add other ingredients and simmer for 3 hours. Remove ham bones and bay leaves. Pour soup into blender and process until smooth. Dice ham and return to soup. If too thick add canned chicken broth. Serve hot with croutons.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips and press mixture into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread over mixture. Refrigerate until firm then keep at room temperature for easier cutting.

title: Crab Meat
instructions: Mix crab meat soup and peas. Put in casserole. Sprinkle top with pepper grated cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Frank And Kidney Bean Bake
instructions: You can leave franks whole or cut in half or quarter. Mix with the last 5 ingredients. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Pour juice off pineapple and cherries; boil juice 5 minutes. Add gelatins and allow to melt. Chill until slightly thick. Add softened cream cheese nuts pineapple and cherries; stir. Add cola and stir. Pour into refrigerator dish. Chill until set. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Chiffon Cake
instructions: In 1 bowl sift flour sugar baking powders and salt together. Make well in dry ingredients and add egg yolks (what is left from whites) oil water and vanilla. Mix well.

title: Plunk-It Cake
instructions: Layer biscuits in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix other ingredients in microwave (enough to melt). Stir well. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Chocolate Cookies Or Candy
instructions: Cook sugar butter and milk. Boil 1 full minute. In bowl mix remaining ingredients. Stir all together and drop by tablespoon on wax paper.

title: Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Crumble the cornbread into a roaster pan; add onion celery eggs and cream of chicken soup. Also add sage and salt. Mix well so all is combined. Pour enough chicken broth over dressing so that it is moist but not too soupy. Cover and bake for about an hour checking to make sure its not becoming dry. If so add more broth.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 275\u00b0. Brown and drain hamburger and onions. Prepare rice. Combine all ingredients but green peppers. Boil salted water for peppers. Boil peppers for 5 minutes. Immediately dunk them in cold water. Place peppers in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Pour other mixture over them. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all together and bake in a loaf pan greased for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool in pan before removing from pan.

title: Roasted Fries With Honey Mustard Sauce
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise into four wedges. Combine 1/4 cup mayonnaise garlic powder and salt; toss with potatoes coating evenly. (Ziploc bag works great and less mess.) Bake potatoes on greased baking sheet at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn potatoes and bake an additional 15 minutes or until browned and crisp. Combine remaining 1/2 cup mayonnaise mustard and honey; stir well. Serve as dipping sauce for hot potatoes. This sauce is also good served with fried mushrooms.

title: *Nut Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each addition. Stir in cinnamon flour and baking powder. Stir in walnuts. Turn batter into a greased 10 x 14 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a hot 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes until cake tests done. Remove from oven and while hot pour cool Syrup over it. Cut into diamond shape.

title: Hamburger Broccoli Casserole
instructions: While browning ground beef cook broccoli. Mix two soups together and heat. Put half of browned beef into 8 x 11-inch casserole covering bottom of dish. Layer in half of the chopped broccoli onion rings cheese and soup. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until mixture bubbles. Serves four to six. Tastes great with tossed salad.

title: Savory Beef Patties
instructions: In a measuring cup break up bread then add enough milk to measure 1 cup (just to moisten bread). Combine all ingredients and form into small patties. Roll in flour and fry on both sides. Place patties in small baking dish and add gravy to cover. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Skiers Sausage
instructions: Mix all together. In baking dish cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 min. Serves 6.

title: Surprise Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Lay out 4 slices of bread and top each with 1 1/2 slices of cheese. Top cheese with bacon and onion. Top each with 1 1/2 slices of cheese and bread. Press down hard on each and prepare as you would a regular grilled cheese sandwich. If you wish tomato slices may be added. Serves 4.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Make brownies according to package directions; allow to cool. Make chocolate mousse. Crumble brownies. In trifle bowl or large glass bowl place 1/2 of the crumbled brownies at the bottom; place 1/2 of the chocolate mousse over the brownies 1/2 of the Heath bars over the mousse and 1/2 of the Cool Whip over the Heath bars. Repeat the whole process starting with the brownies one more time saving some of the crumbled Heath bars for the top. You should have a layered effect.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Heat oil and butter in large kettle. Add onions and celery and cook until soft. Add remaining ingredients. Add fish; cover and simmer 1 hour.

title: Deluxe Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix together powdered sugar granulated sugar margarine and oil then add remaining ingredients. Blend well. Make into 1-inch balls. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Yields 6 dozen.

title: Scalloped Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain corn. Save liquid. Mix liquid with flour. Pour into corn in mixing bowl. Add sugar beaten eggs and melted margarine. Mix together well. Put in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix milk and pudding together and let stand. Cream the cream cheese margarine and powdered sugar. Fold Cool Whip into creamed mixture. Add pudding to mixture. Layer half of cookie crumbs in bottom of bowl or pan then layer pudding on crumb mixture. Cover with remaining crumbs. Decorate any way you wish.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Beat together the cream cheese sugar and butter. In another bowl combine pudding milk and Cool Whip until thick. Mix with first mixture. Layer bowl flowerpot or toy wheelbarrow with a layer of crumbs pudding etc. ending with crumbs on top. Top with gummy worms and silk flowers. Chill and serve with a spade or shovel.

title: Jalapeno Jelly
instructions: Mix green peppers with jalapeno peppers in food processor or blender. In large pot mix sugar vinegar and gelatin. Add the blended peppers. Bring to a boil stirring continuously. Lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes stirring all the time. Cool slightly and put in jars. Place in refrigerator to cool. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken in hot oil until it turns color. Place chicken in casserole dish or electric skillet. Cover with spaghetti sauce. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serve over hot rice.

title: Butternut Layer Cake
instructions: Beat first 4 ingredients for 10 minutes at high speed. Add flour and milk alternately beating after each addition. Bake in three 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 until top springs back to touch about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix flour powdered sugar and butter till it clings together. Press into 9x13 in. baking pan. Bake at 350 degrees until lightly browned. mix eggs sugar lemon juice and rind baking powder and flour. Pour into crust and bake 350 degrees for about 25 minutes. Cool. Shift on powdered sugar as desired and enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Bars(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Combine butter fruit juice fructose and banana. Beat egg pumpkin and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and stir into pumpkin mixture. Add raisins and nuts. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan well coated. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Creamy Spinach Bake
instructions: Place spinach in saucepan with 1/2 cup boiling water. Return to a boil cover. Lower heat to a simmer. Cook for 4 minutes until spinach is broken up. Drain but do not press all liquid out. Put spinach onion salt pepper cream cheese basil and egg in blender or processor until just blended. Pour into buttered 1-quart casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until knife in center comes out clean. Serve hot.

title: Apple Turnovers
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine flour sugar salt and cinnamon. Cut in Crisco until well mixed. Sprinkle water in one tablespoon at a time until it forms a ball. Roll out into 5-inch squares. Put 2 tablespoons of filling in middle. Moisten edges with water. Fold it into a triangle. Seal edges with fork and bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Carob Pudding
instructions: Blend 2 cups milk with other ingredients. Pour into saucepan. Add other 2 cups milk and cook until thick stirring often. Serve hot or chill and serve.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: In a food processor crush cookies until fine. Set aside. In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese butter and sugar until smooth. In another bowl mix pudding and milk until well blended. Fold into cream cheese mixture. Fold into cool whip. In flower pot alternate layers of cookie crumbs and pudding mixture ending with crumbs. Chill several hours or overnight. Decorate with silk flowers or gummy worms.

title: Classic Banana Cream Pie
instructions: In heavy pan dissolve cornstarch in water. Stir in condensed milk and egg yolks. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat; add margarine and vanilla. Cool slightly. Slice 2 bananas dip in lemon and drain. Arrange bananas on prepared crust. Pour filling over bananas; chill 4 hours or overnight. Spread top with whipped cream. Dip third banana.

title: Icebox Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large glass bowl; set aside.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage drain well. Place cabbage in baking dish. Alternate layers of cabbage soup milk and cheese. Dot with butter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 30 minutes.

title: Sugarless Fruitcake
instructions: Combine raisins fruit and water in saucepan. Cook uncovered until water is evaporated and fruit is soft. Set aside to cool. In a large bowl combine flour soda salt and cinnamon. In another bowl combine eggs applesauce sweetener oil and vanilla. Add nuts and reserved fruit. Stir into dry ingredients and blend thoroughly. Pour into a greased 10-inch fluted tube pan (9 cup size). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Spiced Carrot Strips
instructions: Place carrots in a saucepan; cover with water. Cook until tender approximately 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Combine butter sugar salt and cinnamon; pour over carrots and toss to coat. Serve immediately. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Woodchuck With Dumplings
instructions: Cut woodchuck into serving size portions. Simmer in salted water for about 1 hour. Remove meat and roll in salted flour. Brown in a large skillet. Add water to the skillet to cover the meat and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix everything except 1/2 cup cheese. Pour into an 8 or 9-inch round or square pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until skewer comes out clean and crust is browned. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Peach Pie With Praline Biscuit Crust
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring often. As soon as it boils pour mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Set aside. Combine margarine brown sugar and nuts until crumbly. Set aside. Combine flour 2 teaspoons sugar and shortening until crumbly. Add buttermilk. Mix until dough is made. Spread dough on floured board and roll out into a rectangle. Spread pecan mixture onto dough. Roll dough up into a jelly roll. Cut into 1/2-inch slices. Top peach mixture with roll slices. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Butter Tarts
instructions: In bowl cream margarine sugar corn syrup vanilla and salt. Stir in eggs currants or raisins. Fill tart shells almost full. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool on rack before removing from pans.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix butter sugar and peanut butter. Roll into small balls. Refrigerate until set. Melt chips and paraffin in double boiler. Dip balls into chocolate with toothpick. Set on wax paper to cool.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Stretch pinch together and spread onto a pizza pan. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Tomato Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar until creamy add vanilla. Add one egg at a time. Add flour baking powder and salt. Add in tomato juice. Add flour to raisins so they wont stick to the cake. Mix in circular movement. Pour mixture in 9 x 4-inch pan in 350\u00b0 oven. Bake for 50 minutes. Let it cool for 10 minutes before taking it out and serving.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix in order given in a 1-quart greased baking dish. Top with 15 crushed Ritz crackers. Melt 1/2 stick of oleo and drizzle over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Peel avocado and remove pit. Mash with fork. In bowl combine all ingredients thoroughly. Cover and chill. Serve as dip for corn chips.

title: Heavenly Delight
instructions: Break cake into bite-size pieces. Mix milk and lemon juice together. Mix Cool Whip with lemon-milk mixture. Gently fold in strawberries. Mix with cake until cake is coated. Store in refrigerator 6 hours or overnight.

title: Crabmeat Toasties
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients. (Heat cheese in jar in microwave or in jar in very hot water until cheese is soft.) Spread on split English muffins (12). Freeze to set. Keep frozen or use now. Remove from freezer; cut into 4 equal parts and broil 10 minutes on low shelf. Watch them so they dont overcook.

title: Spiced Tea Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Using solid shortening or margarine grease and flour a Bundt pan. In large bowl blend first 8 ingredients. Beat 2 minutes at high speed. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake. Cool upright in pan 15 minutes. Turn out onto serving plate. Spoon the glaze over the cake and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Cream together butter and brown sugar until fluffy. Combine popcorn and pecans in a shallow baking pan. Add the butter mixture by spoonfuls and mix into the popcorn mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 stirring two to three times until crisp about 8 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain off grease. Add all ingredients in large pot; let simmer for 1 hour.

title: Potato-Ground Beef Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet stirring until crumbly. Drain. Add green pepper soup salt and pepper. Set aside.

title: French Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon. Mix with apples; put into unbaked pie crust. Mix until crumbly the butter brown sugar and flour. Spread on top of apples. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Pull-Apart Coffee Cake
instructions: Spray Bundt pan with vegetable spray. Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans and half the brown sugar in bottom of pan. Cover with cinnamon. Separate frozen rolls and place in pan. Add 1/2 cup pecans remaining brown sugar cinnamon and dry pudding mix. Drizzle melted butter on top. Add additional cinnamon and remaining pecans. Cover and allow to rise overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 12 to 16 servings.

title: Yummy Cornbread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl. Mix egg and creamed corn together. Stir into dry ingredients. Slowly add milk to obtain consistency of thick pancake batter. Pour into greased nonstick pan filling halfway. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Can also be cooked like pancakes in a skillet for a delicious spoon bread.

title: Cheese Rice
instructions: In pan add butter. When butter is hot add cloves cumin and bay leaf. When bay leaf turns brown add peas and coriander powder. Add washed and drained rice. Stir well. Add salt and water. When water starts to boil cover with lid to simmer and cook rice.

title: Sharon'S Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter. Add eggs vanilla and sugar. Add flour and soda. Add sour cream and add the bananas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Easy Hollandaise
instructions: Mix first three ingredients in food processor with steel blade. Slowly pour in butter while processor is running. Reheat in double boiler with a little water.

title: Stove Top Meat Loaf(No Egg)
instructions: Season flour with 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper. Crumble beef in a large bowl; add parsley flakes 1/2 tablespoon black pepper and oregano; mix well. Add cornflakes and mix well. Add enough V-8 juice slowly to bind mixture; mix well and form into large round loaf. Dredge in seasoned flour. Brown on both sides in skillet with olive oil using medium-high heat. Place bay leaves on top. Pour 1 cup of V-8 juice over loaf. Cover. Lower heat to medium-low. Baste frequently using extra V-8 juice as needed. Cook for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Place 4 or 5 noodles in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread 1/2 beef and bean mixture on top of noodles. Top with 4 or 5 noodles. Spread rest of beef and bean mixture on top. Top with rest of noodles. Combine water and salsa. Pour on top of everything. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Combine sour cream onion and olives. Spoon over casserole. Top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer uncovered or until cheese is melted.

title: Christmas Wreaths
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan melt butter and marshmallows over moderately low heat stirring constantly. When melted remove from heat and stir in 1 tsp. of the food color and the vanilla. Add more food color if desired. Stir in corn flakes. Drop mixture onto waxed paper 1 Tbsp. at a time. Decorate with red cinnamon candies. Let stand 30 minutes until cool. Makes 40 wreaths.

title: Macaroon Pie
instructions: Spread sliced fruit in a greased pie pan. Cream other ingredients and spread over fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Marge T.'S Croutons For Caesar Salad
instructions: Cut French bread into 1-inch squares. Simmer garlic and oil about 5 minutes. Cool down oil. Place croutons oil and garlic in Ziploc bag. Shake it place on tray. Bake at about 300\u00b0 until golden brown. Then add to Caesar Salad.

title: Holiday Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease sheets. Mix together the sugar butter eggs flour vanilla and soda. Divide dough into 4 equal pieces. Form each section into an 8-inch roll. Roll each piece into almonds and slice into 16 cookies. Place 2-inches apart on greased sheets. Make indentation with spoon in center of cookie to hold jam. Fill with favorite jam. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Dream Bars
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar flour and melted butter together and pat into greased and floured 9 x 6-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Chinese Chews
instructions: Beat eggs until thick. Add sugar flour baking powder and salt; mix well. Add nuts and dates. Bake in an 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into small squares while still warm. Shape squares into balls or roll in powdered sugar or coconut.

title: Shortcut Frozen Salad
instructions: Prepare pudding according to package directions using 2 cups of milk. Stir in Cool Whip mayonnaise and lemon juice. Fold in fruit cocktail marshmallows and pecans. Freeze in 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Sweet Rice
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package. In a 2 or 3-quart saucepan bring water butter or margarine and salt to a boil. Stir in rice. Cover on low heat (just below boiling). Cook 20 minutes. Add milk sugar and vanilla.

title: Hawaiian Pudding
instructions: Mix crushed vanilla wafers and melted butter. Press into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Slice bananas over crumbs. Pour sweetened condensed milk over bananas. Spoon drained crushed pineapple over all. Cover with container of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with small can coconut. Then sprinkle chopped nuts over coconut. Decorate with 6 to 8 maraschino cherries. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Turkey Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan partially cook bacon; stir in onion. Cook until onion is tender. Stir in water undrained tomatoes turkey potatoes carrots thyme salt and pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 to 35 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Mash slightly to thicken.

title: Salsa
instructions: Chop in blender. Cook until thickened. Put into hot jars with hot lids.

title: Reese'S Chewy Chocolate Pan Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. In large mixer bowl beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt. Gradually blend into creamed mixture. Stir in chips.

title: White Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a large mixing bowl let egg whites stand at room temperature for 30 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Catsup
instructions: Chop vegetables. Add salt and let set overnight. Add sugar vinegar spices and turmeric. Cook slowly for 1 hour and put in jars and seal. Makes about 15 pints.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Sift together flour and sugar. Stir in marshmallows and set aside. Bring margarine cocoa and Coke to a boil. Remove from heat and pour over dry ingredients. Stir in buttermilk baking soda and beaten eggs. Pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Mix eggs cooking oil and carrots together and add to dry ingredients. Beat hard. Bake in 2 layer pans at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with Cream Cheese icing.

title: Joanne'S Tamale Pie
instructions: Brown ground meat onions and garlic. Add corn tomatoes and chili powder. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir in tomato juice yellow corn meal and olives (drained). Heat to simmering point. Place in a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar; stir until well blended; cool. Add egg and mix well. Stir in dry ingredients; add vanilla and nuts. Spread in well-buttered 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Cool; cut in squares. Makes 16.

title: Light Pumpkin Cheesecake
instructions: Coat bottom of a 10-inch spring-form pan with cooking spray. Wrap outside bottom and sides. Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add the Ricotta cheese and cream cheese; pat smooth. Pour into a large bowl. Stir in pumpkin; set aside.

title: Mock Sour Cream
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender on high until smooth.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix 1 stick of margarine with potatoes. Add sour cream onion celery soup (as is) cheese salt and pepper. Pour into 13 x 9-inch baking dish.

title: Seafoam Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white until foamy. Mix in sugar and vanilla. Fold in pecans. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn oven off and leave in oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Let cool. Place in sealed container.

title: Dolly'S Fresh Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all except apples and nuts. Batter will be stiff; mix well. Stir in apples and nuts. Pour into a bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rhubarb Crumble
instructions: Cook first three ingredients until thick and clear. Add few drops of red food coloring. Mix other ingredients except rhubarb until crumbly. Press half of mixture into a greased baking dish. Add 4 cups of diced rhubarb then glazed mixture then rest of crumbly mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peel-A-Pound Soup
instructions: Cut up ingredients and cover with water. Bring to a boil; boil hard for 10 minutes. Turn heat down; simmer 2 to 3 hours or until vegetables are tender.

title: Frozen Yogurt Pops
instructions: Puree all ingredients in blender. Pour into 6 (4 ounce) paper cups. Freeze until partially frozen. Stand a wooden stick or a straw (cut in half) in the center. Freeze solid. To eat peel the paper cup off.

title: Bonnie'S Blackberry Pudding
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter. Add flour baking powder salt and milk. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with 2 cups blackberries (or any kind of fruit). Sprinkle 1 cup sugar on top. Pour 2 cups boiling water over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In a large bowl beat eggs sugar syrup butter and salt until smooth. Stir in pecans and pour into shell. Bake 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0 and bake 35 minutes or until center is firm. Remove from oven and cool.

title: Easy Ambrosia
instructions: Grate peeled apples; add pineapple coconut and sliced bananas. Add orange juice and 1 can water. Add enough sugar to sweeten to suit your taste. Cover the bowl and let flavors mesh overnight.

title: Hawaiian Haystacks
instructions: Layer ingredients desired on individual plates (let people self serve). Go easy on the Chinese noodles. Put gravy over all.

title: Mom'S Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy. Stir in eggs pumpkin and water. Sift flour baking soda baking powder salt and spices. Gradually stir dry ingredients into pumpkin mixture. Turn batter into 2 greased and floured bread pans. Bake 90 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle on top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
instructions: In a souffle dish spread bean dip over bottom of dish. Cover with guacamole.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli and onion until soft. Season with salt and pepper. Add chicken broth and milk. Make thickening with milk and flour; add to soup when just beginning to boil. Add the cheese and serve. Do not let it boil or it may curdle.

title: Lazy Day Sweet Pickles
instructions: Pour all juice off pickles and reserve. Empty pickles into bowl and chunk the pickles. Return pickles to jar. Add 1 cup of juice. Add the sugar. Re-seal and refrigerate. Every few days shake jar. Pickles will make their own syrup. Should be sweet and crunchy in approximately 2 weeks. If not quite sweet enough to your taste add 1/4 to 1/2 cup more sugar and continue to refrigerate. Enjoy.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown beef. Add beans and heat thoroughly. Place lettuce in large bowl; top with tomatoes onion avocado cheese and Doritos. Just before serving add beef dressing and toss.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown the ground beef with the cumin. Chop the tomatoes. Slice the ripe olives. Slice the onion in rings. Chop the avocado if using. Mix them together and add as much picante sauce as you like for dressing. Break up the tortilla chips into fairly small pieces and toss in last.

title: Delicious Venison Roast
instructions: Put contents of gravy mix into large pot. Add water. Mix well. Add onion soup mix. Put roast in pot; add bay leaves. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for 3 to 4 hours. Potatoes celery and carrots should be added last 1 1/2 hours. Shred leftover roast while it is still warm; add barbecue sauce and serve on buns for another meal.

title: Easy Stroganoff Skillet
instructions: In skillet brown beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender (use shortening if necessary); stir to separate meat. Drain fat. Blend in soup and sour cream. Add remaining ingredients; bring to boil. Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes or until noodles are done. Stir again before serving. Makes 5 (1 cup) servings.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Heat cider cloves allspice cinnamon and sugar to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Strain and serve hot with orange slice in cup.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Pour vinegar solution in jar. Seal. Hot bath until all the green of cucumber has turned color.

title: Quick Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water to prevent noodles from sticking together. Brown the ground beef. Season meat with garlic and pepper. Add 1/2 cup of the cheese. Add the tomato soup peas carrots corn and water.

title: Molasses Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix together flour ginger and soda. Set aside. Blend together sugar molasses egg and oleo. Add dry ingredients and mix. Stir in chips (semi-sweet peanut butter or butterscotch) and nuts. Shape into balls and roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Lemon Broccoli Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until tender. In skillet combine chicken soup milk lemon juice and pepper. Cook until done.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Chill approximately 1 hour. Add Jell-O and/or nuts if desired.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: In large bowl mix 1/2 jar sauce Ricotta cheese 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and 6 ounces Mozzarella cheese. Add cooked and drained mostaccioli.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Allow cheeses to soften. Mix together Cheddar Roka and cream cheeses. Add onion and garlic powders to taste (be generous). Cover and refrigerate overnight. Make one large ball or several small balls of cheese mixture. Roll in chopped nuts. Serve with flavored crackers. This recipe will freeze.

title: Enchiladas In A Skillet
instructions: In a large skillet cook beef and onions over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain. Stir in the soup enchilada sauce milk and chilies. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Add clams and juice. Add Ritz crackers and spices. Put in a buttered dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine flour baking soda and salt in small bowl. Beat butter granulated sugar brown sugar and vanilla in large mixer bowl. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in morsels and nuts.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender. Put into greased casserole. Mix onion celery cheese and margarine; spread over vegetables. Melt margarine and mix with crackers. Sprinkle over top. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Meatball Stroganoff
instructions: Combine hamburger 1/2 green bell pepper 1 onion 1/2 cup mushrooms and egg. Roll into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls. Bake or fry until brown.

title: Impossible Chicken Vegetable Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0; grease pie plate (9 x 1 1/4-inch). Mix chicken zucchini tomato onion and cheese. Spoon evenly into pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients 15 seconds in blender on high speed 1 minute with wire whisk or hand beater or until smooth. Pour evenly over chicken mixture. Bake about 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Serves 6.

title: Honey-Mustard Dressing
instructions: Blend mayonnaise with honey and mustard; whisk in vinegar and cayenne. Add more vinegar if a thinner consistency is desired. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Bluefish Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl (except oil). Form mixture into cakes. Fry or saute fish cakes in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Dough For Fried Pies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Roll out walnut size pieces of dough. Add your choice of filling and deep fry. Makes 24 pies.

title: Hearty Cheese Grits
instructions: Combine water and salt; bring to a boil. Stir in grits; cook until done following package directions. Remove from heat. Add butter and 3 3/4 cups cheese; stir until cheese melts. Add a small amount of hot grits to eggs stirring well; stir egg mixture into remaining hot grits. Pour grits into a lightly greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese; bake an additional 5 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

title: Creamed Cabbage Soup
instructions: In a large kettle combine first 5 ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer until vegetables are tender. Meanwhile melt butter in a medium pan. Add flour salt and pepper; stir to form a smooth paste. Gradually add cream and milk to flour mixture stirring constantly. Cook until thickened. Continue cooking 1 minute longer. Gradually stir into vegetables. Add ham and thyme; heat through. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Turkey Pie With Cornbread Topping
instructions: Combine soup 1 cup milk peas carrots pimiento and turkey in saucepan; heat through. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Combine flour cornmeal baking powder and salt; cut in shortening. Mix egg and remaining milk; add to flour mixture. Mix well; pour over turkey mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until topping is golden brown.

title: Big Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat together butter and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Then add and mix thoroughly the flour oats soda and salt. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans. Bake cookies (2 to 3 tablespoon size) in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until edges brown. Cool on racks completely. Yields 2 1/2 to 3 dozen cookies.

title: Delicious Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl. Add eggs milk oil and vanilla. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Remove mixer. Stir in boiling water (batter will be very thin). Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes on rack. Remove from pan. Cool completely.

title: Deluxe Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; set aside. Combine dry ingredients; cut in shortening with pastry blender until resembles coarse meal. Add yeast mixture and buttermilk to dry ingredients and mix well. Turn dough out on a floured surface; knead lightly 4 to 5 times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on greased baking sheet. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen biscuits. May freeze leftovers. Wrap in foil to reheat at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Open foil last 5 minutes.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Stir together flour baking powder sugar cream of tartar and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Make a well in center; add milk all at once. Stir just until dough clings together. On a lightly floured surface knead gently 10 to 12 strokes. Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with a 2 1/2-inch cutter dipping cutter into flour between cuts. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Serve warm. Makes 10 (2 1/2-inch) biscuits.

title: Cheesecake By The Bite
instructions: Put 1 Macadamia nut in the bottom of a mini-muffin paper. Drop a spoonful of cheesecake on top. Bake.

title: Angel Dessert(Easy)
instructions: Cut top off cake (thin). Hollow out cake by slicing around the edge. Fill reservoir with softened sherbet or choice. Place top back on cake. \Ice\ with Cool Whip. Place in freezer until ready to serve. Great made ahead and freezes well. Slice and serve. Very attractive on plate. Can use filling to coordinate with punch for parties.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Combine and mix the first 7 ingredients in a blender. Pour over carrots pepper and onion. Marinate overnight or longer.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Saute onion until tender in oleo. Add next 5 ingredients. Place tomatoes in bottom of greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Add layer of onion and bread mixture. Top with bread crumbs and oleo. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield 5 to 6.

title: Super Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine spinach cream cheese picante sauce green onions and cumin in saucepan. Cook over low heat until cheese is melted and mixture is hot. Stir in tomato and bacon; heat through. Transfer to microwave-safe serving dish. Sprinkle with cheese and microwave until cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Hungry Jack Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat; drain. Add onion brown sugar barbecue sauce and beans. Pour in rectangular baking dish. Tear biscuits into 20 pieces instead of 10 and arrange on top of meat-bean mixtures. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until browned on top.

title: Molded Cranberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; add water to pineapple syrup to make 1/3 cup liquid. Soften jello in syrup.
