Cook cranberries in 1 cup water until skins pop; drain and add 1 cup hot juice to gelatin mixture. If needed add boiling water to make 1 cup puree cranberries and stir in sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Chop celery and nuts and add along with 1/2 cup pineapple ground orange and juice of 1/2 lemon to gelatin mixture.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Bake pie crust and cool. Combine cream cheese and 1 tablespoon sugar; beat until smooth. Spread in bottom of crust. Puree half of strawberries. In saucepan combine pureed strawberries remaining sugar and cornstarch. Cook and stir over medium-low heat until mixture thickens and becomes clear (7 to 10 minutes). Remove from heat. Stir in remaining strawberries. Let cool 10 minutes. Pour into pie crust and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Simmer celery and onion. Combine all ingredients and place in casserole dish. Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Mix all other ingredients and pour into dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat cook beef and chili powder until well done stirring to separate meat. Remove from heat and drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients except corn muffin mix. Heat to boiling; reduce heat to low cover and cook 5 minutes. Pour into 2-quart casserole.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Into bacon drippings in pan make sauce from the water vinegar mustard cornstarch and sugar. Cook sauce together with celery and onion and pour over potatoes. Serve warm.

title: Pork Balls And Kraut
instructions: Mix pork rice salt and pepper; form into small balls. Spread half of sauerkraut in bottom of a casserole. Place meatballs on this. Top with the rest of the kraut. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Favorite Light Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Scald (dont boil) milk and water; pour over shortening and salt. Cool to lukewarm. In a separate bowl dissolve yeast and sugar in lukewarm water. Add to mixture. Add 4 cups flour and beat well. Add remaining flour. The mixture should not be too sticky. If so add a little more flour. Cover and let rise to doubled size. Turn onto board and knead. Make 3 large loaves or 5 small loaves. Put into loaf pans and let rise to double size. Then bake at 350\u00b0 until top is brown. When cool slice and butter slices. May wrap with foil and freeze. Reheat when desired. For a whole wheat bread use 1/2 of flour whole wheat.

title: Seattle 3 Leaf Salad
instructions: Add first seven ingredients. Whisk sugar mustard salt vinegar and oil together. Pour on dressing just before serving. Add seed last. Toss gently.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt in large bowl; set aside. In a saucepan add 2 cubes butter 1 cup water and 4 tablespoons cocoa. Bring to a boil and add to flour mixture. Mix well. Combine 2 eggs beaten 1/2 cup sour cream and 1 teaspoon baking soda. Add to the rest of the ingredients. Place in a jelly roll pan that has been sprayed with Pam and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. When cake is removed from oven and just warm add topping.

title: Crawfish Cornbread
instructions: In a pan saute crawfish bell pepper and onions in margarine. In a mixing bowl combine cornmeal soda baking powder salt eggs and milk. Add grated cheese and sauteed mixture. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 12 servings. Contains 186 calories per serving.

title: Pink Fruit Freeze
instructions: Combine cream cheese ice cream and salad dressing until well blended. Fold in fruit cocktail and nuts. Pour into 9-inch pan and freeze until firm. Place in refrigerator 15 minutes before serving. Cut in squares and garnish with cherries.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix the last 5 ingredients well then blend in the meats. Just before baking drizzle 1/3 cup orange juice over the top. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 3/4 hour. (Sometimes I cover it with foil half the time then remove the foil for it to brown).

title: Kheema(Ground Meat)
instructions: Place chopped onions garlic and ginger in blender with 3 tablespoons water and blend to smooth paste. Set aside. Heat oil in a 10 to 12-inch skillet over medium heat. When hot add cinnamon stick cloves black peppercorns bay leaf and the red peppers. In about 10 seconds when peppers turn dark add paste from blender keeping your face averted. Fry for 10 minutes. Add small amount of water if food sticks to the bottom of the skillet. Add the coriander cumin and turmeric and fry another 5 minutes. Now put the chopped tomatoes in fry for another 2 to 3 minutes and add the chopped meat and salt. Fry on high heat for about 5 minutes. Break up all the lumps in the meat and brown it as much as you can. Add 1/2 cup water and lemon juice. Bring to boil and cover. Simmer for one hour. Serve with chapatis or parathas.

title: Sweet And Sour Aspic
instructions: In a saucepan blend together sugar water vinegar and salt. Bring to a boil. Soften gelatin in cold water and add to sugar-vinegar mixture. Place celery pecans pimientos asparagus lemon juice and onion in shallow greased pan. Add heated mixture and chill in refrigerator until set. Serve on bed of lettuce and garnish with mayonnaise and paprika. Very good. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt the butterscotch chips in a saucepan over medium heat. When the chips have melted add the peanut butter and remove from heat. Stir well. Pour in chow mein noodles. Mix thoroughly. Drop the mixture by teaspoon onto waxed paper. These will form \haystacks\. Let the haystacks cool and harden for 1/2 hour in refrigerator. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar eggs Crisco baking soda baking powder cream of tartar nutmeg and vanilla together. Add 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup sour milk. Alternate between two until all used. Bake 1 cookie to test for flour content. If spreading occurs add a small amount more flour until firm when baked. Sprinkle top with sugar before baking. Bake at 375\u00b0 until done.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Casserole(7 Servings)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except onion rings. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Top with onion rings and bake 20 minutes.

title: Miracle Whip Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13 in cake pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cherry Pie Filling Cake
instructions: In small saucepan combine sugar butter and milk. Bring to a boil stirring constantly and cool. Stir in chocolate bits and marshmallow cream. Beat until thickened and smooth. Spread on cake.

title: Pan-Fried Liver And Onions
instructions: In a wide frying pan over medium heat cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon from pan; drain and keep warm. Pour off and reserve all but 2 tablespoons drippings. Add onions to drippings in pan and cook over medium-low heat stirring often and adding more drippings as needed until onions are golden (about 25 minutes). Season to taste with salt and pepper. Remove onions from pan and keep warm.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour mixture into lightly greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Best Banana Bread
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well. Mix rest into first mixture. Pour in greased bread pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken With Herbs En Casserole
instructions: Saute bacon in skillet until crisp; remove. Drain on towel. Crumble. Saute chicken in bacon fat over medium heat until brown. Place in casserole and sprinkle crumbled bacon over top. (Can have 2 layers if necessary.) Melt butter in same skillet (after chicken is all sauteed) then remove from heat. Stir in flour salt pepper celery salt sage and thyme. Dissolve cubes in water; stir this into the ingredients in the skillet and add milk. Stir over low heat until thickened and smooth. (Dont turn your back on it or it will get lumps!) Pour this over the chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours uncovering for the last 15 minutes. Serves 6 people.

title: Wild Rice Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a saucepan. Simmer on low heat for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Spicy Sausage And Lentil Stew
instructions: In a Dutch oven combine lentils 5 cups of water and seasonings. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer covered for 35 minutes. Meanwhile in a skillet cook sausage and onion until meat is lightly browned. Add to stew with remaining ingredients. Simmer covered for 15 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Easy Beef Pot Roast
instructions: Put roast into crock-pot sprinkle with salt and pepper and onion soup mix (or sliced onion). Do not add water. Cover pot set on low for 3 to 4 hours or until roast is well done and tender. Meat juices can be used for gravy. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: The Best Grilled Salmon Steaks
instructions: Place salmon in a large pan. Mix all other ingredients (except wood chips) and pour over top. Allow to marinate 3 to 4 hours turning once. Soak wood chips in water for 1 to 2 hours. Grill over charcoal adding wood chips onto fire at same time as steaks. Cook about 5 minutes per side brushing frequently with reserved marinade. Enjoy!

title: Cabbage Au Gratin
instructions: Cook cabbage 5 to 7 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Place cabbage in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine soup milk cheese salt and pepper. Mix well and pour over cabbage. Combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over cabbage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Berlin Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a large skillet cook bacon until crisp. Drain reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside. In the same skillet cook onion in the reserved drippings until tender. Add spinach and heat through.

title: Amaretto-Pecan Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients and beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add nuts toward the end. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0. When cake is done remove from oven and immediately pour following glaze over hot cake (still in pan).

title: Rosie'S Un-Fried French Fries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0. Slice each potato lengthwise into 1/4 ovals then slice each oval lengthwise into matchsticks. Coat a baking sheet with 3 sprays of vegetable oil. Combine the egg whites and cajun spice in a bowl. Add the matchstick potatoes and mix to coat. Pour the coated potatoes onto the prepared baking sheet and spread them out into a single layer leaving a little space between. Place the baking sheet on the bottom shelf of the oven. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the fries are crispy turning them every 6 to 8 minutes with a spatula. Servings 4. Fat gram per serving 0.5. Calories per serving 291.

title: Fresh Asparagus Salad With Lump Crabmeat
instructions: Trim about 2-inches off the end of each asparagus stalk. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the asparagus and cook until just tender 2 to 3 minutes depending on the size. Transfer the asparagus to a bowl of ice water to cool for 2 minutes. Drain and pat dry.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix together ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Grate Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Add 1/4 cup extra lemon juice to batter if you desire really lemon taste.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well and refrigerate overnight. Toss together the remaining ingredients. Pour dressing over salad to toss.

title: Bean Burrito Appetizers
instructions: Cook onion in a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat stirring constantly until tender. Stir in mashed beans salsa and next 4 ingredients. Set aside bean mixture.

title: Idiot-Proof Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine soups rice onions and water. Dump into rectangular casserole. Arrange chicken pieces on top of rice. Sprinkle dry soup on top. Season with salt and pepper or Tony Chachere seasoning or Morton Natures Seasons. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Uncover and brown chicken pieces.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook rice before putting in mix. Cook squash drain. Add all ingredients except half of cheese. Mix. Bake at 350 degrees until bubbly. Sprinkle rest of cheese on top and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Add eggs; beat well. Stir in bananas; mix well. Add the dry ingredients alternating with the buttermilk. Stir in nuts. Turn into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Big Mama'S Party Mints
instructions: Cream butter sugar and cream cheese. Add peppermint then continue to add 1 drop at a time to taste if necessary. Divide into sections to color. Add paste coloring to desired shade; do not use liquid coloring. Mold into desired shapes using mint molds press mini cookie cutters fingers etc. Place on paper towels and cover with paper towels. Let sit out on towels overnight to dry. Seal in airtight container then mints or dough can be frozen. Beat if made up several days in advance and refrigerated until ready to mold. Serves 70 to 75.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter with both sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Add dry ingredients. Stir in Bits o Brickle. Spread in well-greased 9 x 12 glass baking dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cool cut into bars.

title: Ham Or Steak-Vegetables
instructions: Fry ham or steak until brown on both sides in a large skillet. Lower heat. Add 1 quart can of tomatoes. Wash peel and cut potatoes into medium-large cubes. Slice carrots and cut onions into 4 pieces. Break broccoli into small pieces. Add vegetables. Cover and cook on low heat until tender. Add salt and pepper to season.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove and reserve stock. Bone chicken. Cook celery and onion in stock. When celery is cooked add noodles and cook until tender. At this point you may need to add a little more water or part of a can of cream of celery soup or your favorite kind.

title: Ribbon Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar 6 tablespoons margarine and 1/3 cup milk in heavy saucepan; bring to a full boil stirring constantly. Continue boiling 4 more minutes over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate chips until melted. Add 1/2 of the Marshmallow Creme and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Beat until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Repeat with remaining ingredients substituting peanut butter for chocolate chips. Spread over chocolate layer. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except margarine; dot margarine around mixture; put in covered casserole dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix everything together in a large bowl. Cover and chill for a few hours or overnight. Serve.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a storage container. Then put 1/3 cup into hot water. Stir and enjoy.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt margarine in a 4-quart saucepan; use low heat. Add the marshmallows and stir until melted. Remove from heat and stir in the cereal until well coated with the marshmallows. Put in a well greased 13 x 9-inch pan and press down evenly with a greased spoon. Cool and cut into squares. Serve in a piece of waxed paper as they are a little sticky.

title: Chocolate Crunch Cookies
instructions: Cover bottom of well buttered 9 x 13-inch pan with crackers. Crush well some amount of crackers and sprinkle over top. Sprinkle nuts over crackers. Combine sugar margarine and 2/3 of chips. Bring to a boil for 2 or 3 minutes and pour carefully over crackers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until bubbly all over. Sprinkle remaining chips while hot. When they are soft spread to frost. Cut in small pieces while warm.

title: Ham And Cheese Kabobs
instructions: Clean and cut pineapple into cubes. Cut cheese into balls (with melon baller) and cut ham into triangles. Arrange on toothpicks. Serves 24 to 30 people.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Thaw broccoli in colander under running cold water. Saute onion in butter. Combine soup and milk; stir well. Add to sauteed onion. Add Cheez Whiz and broccoli; stir well. Heat for 30 minutes on low heat stirring often to prevent scorching.

title: Stream Apple Pudding
instructions: Mix together. Grease bowl. Put dish into a crock-pot; fill halfway with water. Cook on high\tfor 3 hours or until done.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add flavoring. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Spoon batter into greased 10-inch tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Garden Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Air Bread
instructions: Mix yeast sugar 6 cups flour and salt together. In pan heat the milk oil and honey to 120\u00b0. Pour this liquid into dry ingredients and add beaten egg whites. Add another cup of flour and beat with wooden spoon.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In 9 x 13-inch pan layer sauce noodles vegetables and cheese. Repeat layers. Pour water over the top. Cover; bake 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let stand for a few minutes before serving. Serves 8.

title: Weight Watchers Hopping John (Rice And Beans)
instructions: In 2-quart nonstick saucepan heat oil. Add bell pepper and onion; cook over medium-high heat stirring occasionally until softened 3 to 4 minutes. Add 1 cup water peas bacon salt pepper and hot sauce. Stir to combine and bring to boil. Add rice and stir to combine. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand until liquid is absorbed about 5 minutes. Fluff with fork before serving.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Cook until tomatoes are done or longer if you want it thicker. Put in size jars you prefer.

title: C.M.P. Cake
instructions: Pat in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Garlic Dressing
instructions: Mix all in blender. Substitute 2 tablespoons paprika for garlic for French dressing. Makes 3 cups.

title: Royal Cheesecake
instructions: Blend ingredients and press firmly against bottom and sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: In bowl mix clams with lemon juice; set aside. (Drain clams of juice.) In skillet melt butter; cook onion and garlic until soft. Mix in clam sauce bread crumbs and Mozzarella. Add clams to mixture. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 in a casserole dish for 20 minutes or until bubbling. Slice Italian bread thin and serve dip on top.

title: Mock Indian Pudding
instructions: Crumble Shredded Wheat into a greased baking dish. Beat eggs add milk. Stir in molasses salt and cinnamon. Pour over biscuits. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve plain or with whipped cream. Ice cream is also good.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Mix sugar flour baking powder and salt. Beat 1 egg hard and pour over dry ingredients. Mix to make crumbly. Sprinkle over sliced apples in 9 x 11-inch pan. Melt butter and pour over apple and crumb mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Cream shortening; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with milk. Add flavoring. Pour into well-greased and floured pans size 9 x 15-inch. Top with enough sliced apples to cover batter. Sprinkle apples with 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup melted butter. Bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 45 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 12 servings. If you only want 1/2 of recipe use an 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Cream shortening and brown sugar; add flour and oatmeal. Line a pan 9 x 12 x 2-inch with this mixture reserving one cup of the mixture for the top of Kuken. Boil the apples in 1/4 cup of water. When partly done add one cup sugar and 2 tablespoons cornstarch. Pour into pan sprinkling reserved crumbs over top. Bake 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Magnifique
instructions: In a large skillet brown chicken and mushrooms in margarine. Stir in soup garlic and seasonings. Cover and simmer 30 minutes stirring now and then. Blend in sour cream and heat slowly. Serve plain or over rice.

title: Enchilada Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients in crock-pot. Heat until cheese melts. Serve as a dip with tortilla chips Fritos or Doritos.

title: Lettuce Loaf Bread
instructions: Beat sugar oil eggs and lemon rind. Add sifted flour baking powder salt ginger and lettuce to sugar mixture. Beat well. Stir in nuts. Bake in greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan at 375\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool 15 minutes in pan. Remove and sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

title: White Cake Good For Wedding Or Birthday
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flavorings and hot water. Beat 1 minute. Add salt flour and water alternately. Beat egg whites stiff. Sift baking powder over batter and fold in beaten whites with mixer on slow speed. Bake at 325\u00b0 in 3 (9-inch) pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan until it springs back when touched lightly. Cool 10 minutes in pans. Remove from pans and ice with favorite icing.

title: Fried Cornbread
instructions: Mix. Get grease hot and pour batter into skillet. Brown and turn. (When bubbles pop its ready to turn.)

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Place sliced strawberries in baked shell. Combine water sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Cook stirring constantly until boils. Cook 2 minutes longer. Add the jello after removing from heat and stir. Pour over berries. Let sauce cool before pouring.

title: Ribbon Jello Mold
instructions: Cream filling Bring milk and sugar to a boil. Blend until smooth. Dissolve Knox gelatine in cold water. Add to milk and sugar. Add sour cream and vanilla. Blend until smooth.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream first 5 ingredients well. In a separate bowl mix next 2 ingredients to create a paste; then add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Alternately add flour salt and buttermilk. Mix well. Combine vinegar and soda in a separate bowl then pour into batter. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes in three 9-inch greased and floured cake pans. When cooled frost.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan melt butter. Saute onion celery and potatoes until tender. Add milk. Simmer for about 30 minutes. Put in bowls or cups. Garnish with parsley flakes. Serve. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Brown bacon in large pot (you want the bacon to crumble). Set aside. In bacon grease fry onions and bell pepper until they are soft. Add rice shrimp and bacon (crumbled) back to the pot with onions and bell pepper. Mix well. Put in enough soy sauce to turn rice brown. Mix and serve.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Break eggs in mixer; beat well. Add the sugar and oil and beat on medium speed. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk with which the soda has been dissolved. I cook the prunes and then I fold them in with the nuts and mix until they are all through the cake. Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 approximately 45 minutes.

title: Chow Mein Chicken Casserole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a large skillet. Add red bell pepper garlic and mushrooms. Saut until tender. Stir in green onions and next 5 ingredients. Pour into a lightly greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with chow mein noodles. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: Let cream cheese stand at room temperature until softened. Chop up dried beef in blender. Mix all ingredients together and shape into 2 logs. Chill.

title: Steamed Shrimp
instructions: Wash shrimp in cold running water. Place in a large pot. Add the 2 stalks celery onions and lemons for every 3 to 4 pounds of shrimp; do not add any water. Use only what hangs onto the shrimp when you wash them. Sprinkle liberally with Old Bay seafood seasoning. Cover pot and cook on top of stove over medium heat. Stir frequently; the shrimp on the bottom cook first so keep turning them over until they are all pink and tender. Remove from heat. Drain (there will be a lot of fluid). Peel and eat.

title: Perfect Play Dough
instructions: Combine all ingredients until smooth. Cook over medium heat (a heavy-bottomed saucepan works best) until it \almost burns\ stirring constantly. It will be quite stiff. Knead on counter when cool enough to handle. Lasts several months if kept in a tightly closed plastic container.

title: Zucchini Rounds
instructions: Mix Bisquick and cheese together. Add to beaten eggs and stir until moistened. Fold shredded zucchini into mixture. Melt butter or margarine in skillet. Drop 2 tablespoons of mixture for each round into skillet and cook 2 or 3 minutes on each side.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and pour half into a greased and floured 9 x 13 pan. Combine cinnamon and brown sugar. Sprinkle half over cake batter. Pour remaining batter over cinnamon mixture. Top with remaining cinnamon mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Combine powdered sugar vanilla and milk. Pour over hot cake.

title: Mama Voyles' Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the ingredients together but add flour last. Add eggs one at a time. Pour into tube pan. Cook for 1 hour and 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Sugar Imprint Cookies
instructions: Mix all. Refrigerate overnight. Roll dough into small balls (smaller than a walnut). Roll balls into sugar. Press flat with a glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Milky Way Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream 1 stick butter and sugar and set aside. Melt 1 stick butter with candy bars in double boiler and set aside. Add eggs to\tsugar and butter. Put soda in buttermilk then add to candy bar mixture. Combine with butter and sugar. Add flour a little at a time. Beat and add nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Shrimp And Crab Dish
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Breaded Chicken
instructions: Mix wine with cream of chicken soup; set aside. Mix margarine with bread crumbs; set aside. Dip chicken pieces into soup mixture then roll in the crumbs. Place chicken on cookie sheet and bake for 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix well and drop by teaspoon 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on rack. You can add raisins chopped nuts or coconut if you like before cooking.

title: Cream Potato Puff
instructions: Combine cream cheese and potatoes mixing until well blended. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a saucepan. Simmer until mixture comes to a boil stirring constantly. It has a tendency to stick and scorch. Boil 1 minute. Makes one pint.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes carrots celery and onion in water until tender. Add salt pepper bacon milk and butter. Bring to boil.

title: Mom'S Christmas Fudge
instructions: Put sugar milk butter and salt into large saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Cook at moderate rate stirring occasionally until it forms a soft ball. Remove from heat immediately and set pan in cold water. Dont stir or beat until candy is thick creamy and loses its shine. When at setting point add cherries and nuts and fold in quickly. Pour into buttered 8-inch pan and let stand at room temperature until firm. Cut into squares. Makes 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients together; add other ingredients. Mix everything together except sour cream. Pour 1/2 of mixture in large Pyrex and let chill. Then spread sour cream and pour remainder on top. Chill.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix all ingredients in a bowl to form a ball. Roll out on floured board. Cut with glass 2 1/2-inches in diameter. Place on greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix well. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Italian Pork Chops
instructions: Select or ask your butcher to cut 1 pork chop per person 1 1/2-inches thick. Brush each pork chop with Caesar or Italian salad dressing. Roll each pork chop in a generous amount of Progresso bread crumbs. Place on a broiler pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Blend shortening sugar salt and egg. Add dry ingredients and nuts to this mixture. Blend well. Shape into a roll about 2 1/2-inches in diameter. Roll in waxed paper and chill in refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Cut thin slices of chilled dough. Put on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Yield 8 dozen.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Put the cucumbers in lime and water overnight. Wash out 3 or 4 times. Mix sugar vinegar salt turmeric and pickling spice. Put cucumbers in mixture. Let stand for 3 hours. Boil cucumbers for 30 minutes. Pack in jars.

title: Homemade Soup
instructions: Mix the hamburger potatoes and onions; cook until done. Mix all other ingredients. Let simmer for about 1 hour. Good to eat with cornbread.

title: Cream Cheese Chicken
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts with hands. Make a mixture of half and half of grated Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Cut cream cheese in approximately 1-inch slices. Melt butter in pan. Set aside and cool slightly. Dip chicken first in butter and then in Parmesan cheese and bread crumb mixture to coat. Place cream cheese at edge of chicken piece and roll. Place uncovered in a baking dish. Sprinkle with small amount extra butter on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Low Calorie Custard
instructions: Beat eggs sugar salt and vanilla; stir in milk. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Contains 79 calories per 1/6 recipe.

title: Old-Fashioned Sour Cream Drops
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs. Stir in sour cream and vanilla. Sift together and stir in flour soda baking powder and salt. Chill dough at least 1 hour. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet and bake until delicately browned just until when touched with finger almost no imprint remains. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Makes about 5 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Tally-Ho Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender.

title: Old-Fashioned Potato Soup
instructions: Put the potatoes and onions in a kettle with the salt and cover with cold water (4 cups). Bring to the boiling point. Cover and cook gently for 20 minutes. Transfer to a blender and puree the vegetables or simply mash them to a pulp in the water. Add the milk and season to taste with salt and plenty of pepper. Garnish liberally with chopped parsley.

title: Beer-Batter Flounder
instructions: In medium bowl mix beer flour cornmeal parsley salt and pepper. In skillet over medium heat add 1/2-inch of canola oil. Dip flounder fillets in batter. Place in hot oil. Fry until golden (about 3 minutes each) turning once. Drain on paper towels.

title: Quick Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts. Cook on low heat until butter is melted. Remove from heat add nuts and beat. Pour in a container that has been buttered. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Apple Dumpling
instructions: Cut apple in eight pieces. Separate crescent rolls. Peel apples and roll each piece in a crescent roll. Spray a baking dish with Pam. Put rolls in dish. Combine butter water sugar and bring to a boil in a saucepan. Pour over rolls. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together the butter sugar and vanilla. Add flour then add crushed potato chips. Drop by spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for about 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pecan Candy
instructions: Melt chips together over very low heat. Once melted add pecans. With a tablespoon immediately drop candy one by one onto waxed paper.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Blanch flowerets and stems 2 minutes and drain. Mix broccoli cheese sour cream mayonnaise beaten egg yolks butter salt pepper and nutmeg thoroughly. Fold in beaten whites. Pour in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with seeds if desired. Bake 45 to 50 minutes until set at 350\u00b0. Cooks like a souffle but does not fall; remains like a quiche filling. Freezes very well.

title: Healthy Banana Pudding
instructions: Add milk eggs vanilla and flour in blender. Mix until well blended. Pour into 2-quart double boiler. Do not add Equal at this time (it is important that you let it cool as Equal breaks down in heat). Slice bananas. Put alternate layers of vanilla wafers and bananas in large serving dish.

title: Breakfast Sausage Egg Bake
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Add soup. In a bowl beat eggs milk and pepper then add to sausage mix. Put in a greased 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Grease well a large paper bag (grocery bag). Put cleaned whole chicken inside. May salt and season to taste. Lay sliced carrots and potatoes around chicken. If preferred may stuff chicken with your favorite dressing. Tie paper bag and place in baking pan. Roast in oven for approximately one hour at 350\u00b0. Super easy! Complete meal in a bag!

title: Cocktail Wienies
instructions: Put sausages in crock-pot and cover with barbecue sauce. Heat on medium for 20 minutes. Drain. Put 6 slices of bacon on top of sausages then cover with brown sugar. Simmer at least 2 hours.

title: Bourbon Pecans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecan halves. Place in saucepan and bring to rolling boil on low heat. Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from stove add pecans and stir until pecans are well coated and sauce begins to crystallize. Spread pecans on waxed paper separate and let cool.

title: Turtle Brownies
instructions: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk on top of a double boiler. Stir mixture until melted. Combine cake mix remaining milk and softened margarine. Blend mixture until cake holds together. Stir in nuts. Press 1/2 of cake mixture in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate pieces on top. Pour melted caramel evenly over top. Crumble remaining mixture over caramel. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool slightly and cut into bars.

title: Sweet-Sour Pork
instructions: Brown pork in oil. Cover and cook over low heat a few minutes. Drain pineapple; set fruit aside. Combine juice sugar cornstarch vinegar water and soy sauce in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Add salt if desired. Pour the sauce over the meat and stir in pineapple green pepper and onion. Simmer until vegetables are tender about 10 minutes. Serve with white or brown rice. Serves 4.

title: Granola
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Have ready a 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine oats coconut almonds sesame seed sunflower seeds and wheat germ in large mixing bowl. Set aside. Combine honey and oil. Stir into dry ingredients. Spread in ungreased pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Stir in raisins. Remove to another pan to cool stirring occasionally. Makes 6 cups.

title: Mexican Corn Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill. Serve with Frito chips.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Combine first six ingredients. Add meats and mix. Shape into 1 inch balls. (Can be frozen at this point.) Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes (or longer if frozen).

title: Apple Pizzas(Makes Four 6-Inch Pizzas)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place flour and butter in the bowl; combine until butter disappears. Add sugar and salt; pour in the cold water. Blend together with hands. Knead the dough and then divide into 4 equal pieces. Roll out pieces and form small circles. Cut apple slices and put slices on the \pizzas.\ Sprinkle slices with sugar (1 teaspoon) and cinnamon. Place pizzas on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Corn Meal Mush
instructions: Mix cold water and corn meal together in top of double boiler. Stir in boiling water and salt. Cook stirring constantly until it boils. Cover and cook over the boiling water until mush is thickened about 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve hot with whole milk.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Add flour alternately with milk. Roll nuts candy orange slices and dates in flour. Add to batter. Bake in tube pan at 250\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Santa Clara Scones
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour baking powder baking soda and salt in a large bowl. In another bowl beat sour cream egg sugar and lemon peel until well blended. Add butter to the flour mixture and cut in with a pastry cutter or rub in with fingers until mixture looks like fine granules. Add prunes and apricots and toss to distribute. Add sour cream mixture and stir with a spoon until a sticky dough forms. Drop dough by 1/3 cupfuls 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Cool loosely covered with a dish towel on wire rack. Makes 10 to 12 scones.

title: Hostess Peas
instructions: Dice bacon and saute until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet. Saute onion in the bacon grease. Remove onion from skillet. Put peas butter water and lettuce in skillet and cook until lettuce is wilted. Add bacon and onion. Heat through and serve.

title: Cabbage Burger Bake
instructions: Quarter and shred cabbage (you should have about 8 cups). Spread half in buttered shallow 12-cup baking dish. Saute bacon just until fat starts to cook out in a large frying pan. Remove; drain and set aside for later. Stir onion and rice into bacon drippings in frying pan; cook stirring constantly over medium heat until onion is soft and rice is lightly browned. Spoon over cabbage in baking dish. Shape ground beef and pork into 1 large patty in same frying pan. Brown 5 minutes on each side then break up into crumbs. Cook stirring often a few minutes longer or until no pink remains. Spoon over rice mixture in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with remaining cabbage.

title: Strawberry Sour Cream Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in 3/4 cup boiling water; cool slightly. Add strawberries (slightly thawed) pineapple (drained) and banana (mashed). Pour 1/2 of mixture into mold and let stand in refrigerator until firm. Spread with sour cream and put remaining jello on top. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Clam Chowder Soup
instructions: Simmer onion celery and potatoes in small amount of water in a large saucepan until tender. Melt butter in small saucepan over medium heat. Blend in flour sugar salt and pepper. Stir in milk gradually. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Stir in vegetable mixture. Add clams. Cook over low heat until heated through.

title: Orange Marmalade Sauce
instructions: Boil 5 minutes\tand chill. This sauce is delicious on ice cream.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Place cooked beans in casserole. Add a little liquid from beans. Add undiluted soup. Place bacon and cheese on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Overnight French Toast
instructions: Combine eggs milk baking powder and vanilla. Pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: 4 Bean Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in a heavy covered casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Uncover and bake 1/2 hour more.

title: Uncle Sonny'S Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix vegetables meat and cheese with pasta. Add Salad Supreme and dressing. Stir and chill. Enjoy!

title: Kathy'S Cranberry Salsa
instructions: In medium saucepan combine cranberries sugar chili powder lime juice and jalapenos; heat to boiling over medium heat stirring occasionally. Simmer stirring occasionally for 4 minutes or until cranberries are tender and mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Stir in scallions and cilantro. Let stand at room temperature until mixture has cooled. Enjoy during the holidays with your favorite tortilla chips.

title: Broccoli Olive Linguine
instructions: In a large saucepot of boiling salted water cook regular and spinach linguine as packages direct. While linguine is cooking in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat heat oil. Add garlic and saute 1 minute until softened. Add broccoli pepper flakes and chicken broth. Cover and cook about 6 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Drain linguine and place in a large serving bowl. Add broccoli mixture and olives. Toss well; sprinkle with cheese.

title: Oven Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Preboil spareribs about 30 minutes (dont overcook). Drain and cool. Line large baking dish or roaster with onions. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs. Refrigerate overnight. Cook next day uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or more.

title: Chili-Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients; shape into a good-sized loaf. Spread ketchup on top to taste. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or microwave 15 to 20 minutes on High turning occasionally. (Use a round pan for microwave.)

title: Siopad
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. When dissolved add sugar and 2 1/2 cups flour to make a soft sponge. Beat thoroughly with a wooden spoon. Set aside to rise until double in bulk (about 30 to 40 minutes). Add remaining flour and 1/4 cup fat to sponge and mix well. Turn onto a slightly greased board using remaining 1/4 cup fat and knead until smooth. Divide dough into 24 to 36 pieces depending on desired size. Form into balls; flatten one ball with heel of hand and put filling in the center. Gather the edges together and seal. Lay on square piece of paper sealed side under and set aside for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Barbecued Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add 1/2 can tomato sauce and mix well. Mix 1 1/2 cans remaining tomato sauce with water vinegar brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Shape meat mixture into loaf and place on rack in roasting pan. Spoon some sauce over top and place in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done basting often. Yields 8 servings.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar peanuts and syrup in microwave bowl and cook on High for 3 minutes. Remove and stir. Cook on High for 3 more minutes then stir well and add margarine and vanilla. Cook on High for 2 minutes. Add soda stirring quickly onto pan sprayed with cooking spray. Allow to cool and break into pieces.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients. Mix remaining ingredients and add to first mixture. Chill for about 2 hours.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Mound the potato salad on a large platter. Cover the potato salad with the shredded lettuce then arrange the remaining vegetables in an attractive pattern on the lettuce. Place the anchovies and shrimp on top of the salad. The entire salad is then sprinkled with the vinegar then the blended oil. Sprinkle liberally with oregano over all and serve at once. Toasted French or Greek bread is served with the salad. Each person serves himself from the beautiful salad platter. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Lorna Doone
instructions: Mix crushed Lorna Doone cookies and butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix vanilla pudding butter pecan ice cream and milk; pour over Lorna Doone mixture. Let it set in freezer until firm. Spread container of Cool Whip on top. Crush Heath bars and sprinkle on top. Put in freezer 2 or 3 hours then serve.

title: Amish Barn Soup
instructions: Saute together the chopped onions and margarine. Bring to a boil the water and add bouillon cubes. Add noodles and cook 3 minutes. Then add broccoli and salt and cook until tender. Stir in garlic powder milk Velveeta and black pepper. Heat until cheese melts.

title: Onion And Sour Cream Dip
instructions: Mix onion soup mix with sour cream just before serving. Serve with potato chips or crackers of your choice.

title: Tangy Butter Sauce(For Cheesy Tuna And Rice Casserole)
instructions: Mix all ingredients heat and pour over casserole as desired.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in top of double boiler. Beat without cooking for 1 minute. Place over boiling water and cook until stiff peaks form beating constantly. Remove from boiling water Add vanilla beat until spreading consistency.

title: Hermit Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all these ingredients and put in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with 1 package Ritz crackers browned in 1/2 stick margarine.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
instructions: Place one breast at a time between pieces of plastic wrap. Flatten using flat side of meat mallet and then roll with the rolling pin until 1/8 inch thick. Peel off wrap. Flatten other breast the same way. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Divide chives and parsley among the chicken. Place one slice of cheese and one slice of ham in each piece of chicken. Roll up chicken secure with toothpick. Dip each piece in flour; egg; then bread crumbs. In medium skillet heat 1 1/2-2 inches oil to 340\u00b0. Cook chicken in hot oil about 10 minutes or until golden brown. Stir soup and milk together. Heat for about 10 minutes. Pour a tablespoon of the mixture over the chicken. Garnish with parsley.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Cut biscuits into fourths. Shake biscuits in a bag with granulated sugar and cinnamon. Layer biscuits in a tube pan. Sprinkle chopped nuts between layers. Melt brown sugar and oleo; boil 1 minute. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Chicken Bake
instructions: Mix altogether. Bake in casserole dish covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Easy-Do Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk and butter in a large heavy saucepan; heat to boiling. Stir constantly about 5 minutes over medium heat or until mixture reaches soft ball stage (238 degrees); remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients; stir vigorously until will blended. Pour into greased 13 x 3 x 2 inch pan. Cool; cut into squares. Makes about 3 pounds of fudge.

title: Frosted Pumpkin Mousse
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and whip until smooth. Pour into a bowl or 3-cup mold in and freeze. Allow to soften briefly at room temperature before serving. Yields 6 servings.

title: Lucille Stock'S Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and oil. Mix well. Add vanilla and poppy seed. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to mixture alternately with milk. Pour in greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place biscuits in a greased bread pan layering as necessary. In a saucepan bring sugars cinnamon and margarine to boil. Boil 1 minute. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Turn out onto serving plate.

title: 5 Step Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in 9-inch unbaked pie crust at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate. This is good.

title: Mexican Manicotti
instructions: In a bowl combine the uncooked beef beans chili powder and oregano. Spoon into uncooked manicotti shells; arrange in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine water and picante sauce; pour over shells. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover; spoon sour cream over top. Sprinkle with cheese onions and olives if desired. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Yields 8 servings.

title: Marie'S Invention
instructions: Brown sausage hamburger and garlic. Drain. In a separate pan add tomatoes salt/pepper celery seed and oregano. Leave on until hot. Add Cheddar cheese soup stirring until cheese melts. Cook noodles as directed. Mix meat into sauce. Layer in pan alternating layers of sauce and noodles. Bake 350\u00b0 until hot. Garnish with parmesan cheese.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter 2-quart casserole dish. In medium saucepan cook onion and celery in butter until tender. Stir in soup and milk. Remove from heat; stir in tuna and pimento. Prepare noodles as label directs (drain). Combine noodles and tuna mixture in casserole. Bake 25 minutes; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes more until bubbly.

title: Salmon Loaf Mousse
instructions: Clean and flake salmon. Add well beaten egg yolks and remaining ingredients in order (except egg whites). Mix well. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold egg whites gently into salmon mixture.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 10-cup 10-inch tube pan. In sifter mix flour cocoa powder baking powder and salt. Sift into large bowl. In large bowl with mixer at high speed beat butter until fluffy. Gradually beat in sugar beating until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Alternately beat in flour mixture in fourths and milk in thirds beginning with flour. Beat in grated chocolate and vanilla extract.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Layer as follows noodles beef cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Repeat until all is used. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Pour all ingredients into large pan on top of stove. Cook over medium heat until red hots are melted. Stir often so red hots wont stick to bottom of pan. Serve hot.

title: Fat-Free Fancy Fried Rice
instructions: Pour eggs into nonstick skillet sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Cook until set in 1 large pancake. Remove from pan cool and cut into thin strips; reserve.

title: Almond Bark Cookies
instructions: Put almond bark in 200\u00b0 oven and melt. Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: The Best Two-Crusted Apple Pie In New England(Apple Country Pie)
instructions: Whip into loose meringue dribble over pie. Bake at 350 degrees approx. 1 hour. Let cool 1 hour before serving.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Core tomatoes and mash up. Cook tomatoes celery onions and red pepper until tender. Put through sieve and add remaining ingredients; seal.

title: Green Bean-Corn Casserole
instructions: Place drained green beans and corn in 9 x 9-inch dish. Mix soup sour cream cheese and onion; spread on top of vegetables. Melt oleo; mix in almonds and crackers. Pour on top of cheese soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour; microwave for 2 to 3 minutes before baking to cook onion.

title: Apple Stuffing
instructions: Saute celery and onions in margarine. Add remaining ingredients; toss lightly. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Mix all together; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with cinnamon.

title: E-Z Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook pasta. Blend other ingredients in pasta and mix all together. Sliced olives are a good addition. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Carrot And Pecan Cake
instructions: Beat sugar and oil in mixer bowl until smooth. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition. Mix flour salt cinnamon soda and baking powder in bowl. Add to egg mixture; beat well. Add carrots gradually mixing well. Stir in raisins and pecans. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool. Spread frosting between layers and over top and side of cake. Garnish with additional pecans. Yield 12 servings.

title: Orange Upside-Down Cake(6 Servings)
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grate 1 tablespoon of colored zest from oranges. Peel oranges cutting away all white pith right down to the flesh. Cut sections away from membrane. Melt 4 tablespoons butter and brown sugar in a 9-inch cake pan. Arrange orange sections in sugar. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Beat remaining 8 tablespoons butter and granulated sugar until fluffy. Beat in zest eggs and vanilla. Beat in half the flour then milk and finally remaining flour. Spread over oranges. Bake until toothpick stuck in center comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 3 minutes; turn onto a platter. Leave 1 minute before removing pan.

title: Drop Mayonnaise Biscuits
instructions: Pour 2/3 full in greased muffin pan after mixing ingredients well. Cook approximately 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 6 biscuits. Double recipe to make 12.

title: Ms. Diane'S Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and slice. Put in large enamel pot and add pickling lime and cold water. Soak for 24 hours. Drain and wash all remaining lime from pickles. Soak for 3 hours in ice water. Drain good and then add sugar vinegar salt and celery seed. Tie up pickling spices and cloves or use a tea bag holder. (This prevents them from being next to the pickles which causes discoloration.) Soak overnight. Bring to a boil and cook for 30 minutes. Put in warm jars and seal.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple juice into a bowl; add pudding and Tang. Mix well. Toss with fruit.

title: Tofu Sandwich Filling
instructions: Drain liquid from tofu. Mash tofu and add chopped carrots onion celery and olives. Mix together and add salad dressing or mayonnaise to desired texture. Add garlic powder to desired taste.

title: Hawaiian Salad
instructions: If whipping cream is used whip according to directions on package or substitute the Cool Whip for the whipping cream. Fold fruit into mayonnaise.

title: Filled Cookie Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together cover and chill several hours or overnight. Use flour to roll and cut in circles fill and cover with another circle; crimp edges to seal.

title: Angel Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 items together. Dissolve Jell-O in 1/2 cup boiling water. Mix all ingredients together. Put in a bowl to congeal.

title: German Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef and next 9 ingredients. Roll in 2-inch balls. Brown in oil. Drain. Add soup and bouillon. Cover; simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Add sour cream. Heat through. Serve on noodles.

title: Baked Spinach
instructions: Combine all and bake in greased baking dish. Set the dish in pan of water while baking. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Bachelor'S Stew
instructions: Season stew meat as desired. Put meat in a bag with flour and shake until well coated. Brown meat in oil; drain excess. Add mushroom soup and package of dry mix plus 1 soup can of water. Simmer on low to medium heat about 15 to 20 minutes. Great over wide egg noodles or rice.

title: Dressing
instructions: Heat soup and giblet water. Pour over all the other ingredients and mix.

title: Curried Chicken Bake(Low-Cal)
instructions: In a small saucepan melt margarine and add remaining ingredients except chicken. Cook stirring until sauce thickens. Spray a small baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place chicken in a single layer. Brush with curry mixture. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until brown and cooked 35 to 40 minutes basting with pan juices every 20 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together except cheese and chips. Place in a 9 x 13-inch dish and cover with cheese and chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Economical Punch
instructions: Mix sugar and hot water until sugar is melted then add lemon juice pineapple and grapefruit juice and 6 cups cold water. Refrigerate. Punch is better if made the day before using. When ready to serve add lime sherbet (1 quart per bowl) and ginger ale slowly. Have everything cold. Do not add ice cubes. Makes enough for two punch bowls.

title: Cranberry Quencher
instructions: Combine cranberry-apple and pineapple juices in a large container or punch bowl. Stir in lemonade concentrate. Garnish glasses with pineapple cranberries and/or mint if desired. Yields 6 quarts.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in top of a double boiler. Stir until dissolved over boiling water. Pour warm mixture into whipped cream. Add defrosted strawberries and nuts. Crush wafers. Put a light coat of the crumbs in bottom of 2 ice cube trays. Pour in strawberry mixture. Cover the tops with more crumbs. Cover with waxed paper or Saran Wrap and allow to stand overnight in freezer. (This keeps indefinitely in freezer.)

title: Smoked Chicken
instructions: Soak chickens overnight in water pickling salt onion powder black pepper lemon maple flavoring and bay leaf. Rub on and in chickens brown sugar onion or garlic powder and black pepper then smoke.

title: Good Punch
instructions: Makes 2 1/2 gallons.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar margarine and canned cream over low-medium heat stirring constantly until it starts to boil. Let boil for 5 minutes. Take off heat and add peanut butter chips and Marshmallow Creme. Stir stir and stir. Pour into a buttered pan. Makes 6 pounds. Stir entire time; will scorch easily. Wont harden if rainy!

title: Fish Dish For 2
instructions: Serving Suggestions Serve with salad corn on the cob dinner rolls.

title: 5 Layer Dinner
instructions: First you hard-cook some eggs (more than one for each person). Use 3 for 2 5 for 3 and so on depending on how many eggs you have on hand how hungry you are and maybe on how expensive eggs are at the time. Take the shells off the cooked eggs cut the whites into smallish pieces and mash the yolks in a separate dish. Keep them warm.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Saute shrimp and shallots in butter and oil. Add garlic when you turn shrimp (turn shrimp when they are pink halfway through). Serve as is or on top of pasta.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter. Beat in eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Form in small balls or use a dipper. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Do not press balls down. They will spread.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers; slice thin. Chop onions and green peppers. Combine with cucumbers and salt. Let stand 3 hours; drain.

title: Rosemary Walnuts
instructions: Melt butter; add next 3 ingredients. Pour over walnuts stir to coat. Place nuts on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. (Be careful not to burn.)

title: Wassail Drink
instructions: Boil water and steep tea bags for 10 minutes. Discard tea bags and combine remaining ingredients. Boil and serve warm. Very nice at Christmastime.

title: Homemade Hummus
instructions: Soak beans in 6 cups water overnight then rinse well. Drain. Place beans in crock-pot (high) for 10 to 12 hours until quite soft. Cook also with 3 cloves of the garlic 5 cups of water onion and Mexican seasoning mix. When done place beans in food processor (use a slotted spoon so most of broth is left in crock-pot). Blend with lemon remaining 3 cloves garlic white miso olive oil cayenne and tahini. Add more broth little by little as needed to make a smooth paste. You can find miso and tahini at health food markets. This makes great sandwiches with mayo avocado sprouts and grated carrots.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in medium-large saucepan. Bring to a boil until slow rolling boil is maintained for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Place popped popcorn in large roaster pan. Slowly drizzle syrup over popcorn (and peanuts if chosen). Bake in slow oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. (Stir the mixture every 15 minutes through baking time.) Cool and enjoy!

title: Cheese Fondue
instructions: Rub saucepan with garlic then discard clove. Heat wine adding cheese slowly. When cheese melts add Kirsch. Stir in figure 8 pattern. Add cornstarch. Stir until thickened. Serve with cubed French bread.

title: Uncle  Thanksgiving Dressing
instructions: Fry onion celery peppers and olives in a liberal amount of shortening--Mom uses butter--until celery is rather soft. Season with salt and pepper. Crumble bread and pour drippings from the bird on bread. Mom uses chicken bouillon cubes. Add mixture and mix. Moisten well and season to taste. Place in oven in greased baking dish till browned. 350 degrees about 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Add 3 cups of hot water to large boiler. Place 6 to 8 noodles in boiling water with teaspoon of butter. Cook approximately 20 to 25 minutes and drain. While noodles cook brown ground beef; drain well. Add sauce to ground beef and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Molded Vegetable Salad
instructions: Dissolve salt and sugar with jello and boiling water. Stir cream and mayo into cooled jello. Add mashed cottage cheese and all other ingredients. May add pimento or small amount of red pepper for color. If doubling recipe use less mayonnaise.

title: Summer Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Shrimp And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion celery and mushrooms in oleo. Put cooked rice into a mixing bowl; add all ingredients and mix.

title: Mama'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Cook on medium heat until thick stirring often. Bake pie crust as directed. Slice strawberries into crust. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar. Pour mixture over strawberries. Top with Cool Whip. Delicious!

title: Barbecued Chicken With Glaze
instructions: In large screw-top jar combine tomato sauce olive oil orange juice vinegar oregano salt peppercorns and garlic. Cover and shake vigorously to blend.

title: Snickers Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients; stir into sugar mixture. Fold in chopped Snickers. Spoon into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan; sprinkle with chopped Hershey bars. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Yields 2 dozen squares.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine water sugar and cornstarch in pan. Mix until smooth and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Cook 2 minutes or until mixture is clear and thick. Add Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Put while hot over berries. Pour into baked pie shell; chill until set.

title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine all filling ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Mashed Potatoes(Kid'S Stuff)
instructions: Get a bowl of hot water on stove and then put macaroni in and wait until it starts boiling on 9\u00b0. Put cheese in and stir before it boils then get macaroni out and enjoy.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Form dough into balls. Place on cookie sheet and press down with glass dipped in sugar. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease pizza pan. Mix pizza crust mix together according to directions. Cook ground beef and drain. Spread dough in pizza pan. Add sauce meat cheese and any other topping you may like. Finally you fold outside of pizza into middle. Place in oven for 30 minutes or until middle is done.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Cut cucumbers into large pieces; soak in 2 gallons of water and 2 cups of household lime for 24 hours. Wash in clear water and then soak in clear water for 4 hours. Mix remaining ingredients and let cucumbers stand in this mixture overnight. Then boil hard for 40 minutes. Pack in hot jars and process for 15 minutes in boiling water bath.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Combine rice seasoning packet from rice mix and hot water; place in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside. Sprinkle pork chops with pepper and place over rice mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover. Combine soup and milk and pour over casserole. Bake 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Chicken Fiesta
instructions: Sprinkle chicken tenders (or any part of chicken) with Creole seasoning. Brown in 2 tablespoons butter. Remove and set aside. In same skillet brown sausage and vegetables until vegetables are tender. Cook Rice-A-Roni according to directions. Combine the cooked Rice-A-Roni and sausage mixture. Add the Mexicorn and the soups. Stir in 1 cup of cheese. Pour this mixture into a casserole dish. Place the chicken pieces on top of the casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut steak into small strips. Brown in\tgrease\tor oil. Add to\tsteak the onion and green pepper also in strips. Brown with steak. Turn skillet down to 300\u00b0 and add beef broth and onion soup mix. Let simmer until steak is tender approximately 30 minutes. If desired thicken steak and broth mixture. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Combine egg confectioners sugar butter and vanilla. Beat for 20 minutes. Line 9 x 13-inch baking dish with vanilla wafers; cover with sliced bananas. Pour egg mixture over all. Spread layer of crushed pineapple then Cool Whip. Top with cherries and nuts. Cool until firm.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage; crumble bread in bottom of baking dish. Beat other ingredients together; pour over bread and sausage. Put grated cheese on top of mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve hot. Great for brunch.

title: Easy Crab Asparagus Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 10-inch quiche dish or pie plate. Layer crabmeat asparagus and onion in prepared pie plate. Top with cheeses. Season with pepper. Combine flour baking powder and salt in large bowl. With pastry blender or 2 knives cut in butter. Add milk and eggs; stir until blended. Pour over vegetables and cheeses. Bake about 30 minutes or until filling is puffed and knife inserted near center comes out clean. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Marinated Roast(Sirloin)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except roast. Makes enough to marinate about 4 pounds of meat. Marinate 2 to 3 hours at room temperature. If you run out of sauce to cover while cooking use Wish-Bone garlic dressing. Cook roast on grill 20 minutes per pound. Keep basting with marinade sauce while cooking.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Combine fat beef and onion in skillet. Cook until beef is brown; drain. Add salt and pepper. Stir in catsup and tomato sauce; heat thoroughly. Turn into 8-inch square (1 1/2-quart) casserole dish. Cut cheese into strips; spread over meat. Top with biscuits. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

title: Lemon Gelatin Cake
instructions: Combine mixes oil and water. Beat 4 minutes. Add eggs one at a time. Bake in oblong pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef And Broccoli
instructions: Stir-fry beef garlic sugar and salt in hot oil. Stir in sake and soy sauce; cook covered 2 to 3 minutes. Remove meat and set aside. Add broccoli and 3/4 cup water to skillet (or wok). Bring to boiling; stir and then cook covered 2 to 5 minutes more. Add meat. Combine cornstarch and 1/2 cup cold water. Pour into center of mixture. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes or until thick and bubbly. Serve with hot cooked rice. Serves 4.

title: Apricot Chicken
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Pour over chicken breasts in 9 x 13-inch pan and marinate for 24 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cover for first hour then uncover last half hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole. Cook squash and onions together. Add butter. Mix in pimento soup sour cream and stuffing mix reserving enough stuffing mix to garnish top.

title: Kentucky Pie
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients except pecans and chocolate chips. When other ingredients are mixed well add pecans and chocolate chips and blend with a spoon. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. If you double the recipe it will make 3 pies.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in a well-greased pan for 35 minutes at 400\u00b0. Freezes well.

title: Honey B'S Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt oleo in large skillet or large round pan (10 to 12 inches). Stir in brown sugar until it melts. Remove from fire. Add drained pineapple slices (reserve juice) and arrange with cherries and pecan halves. Mix cake batter according to directions substituting pineapple juice for water. Pour over mixture in pan and bake according to cake mix directions. Let stand 3 minutes. Turn upside down on serving plate.

title: Pea Pickin' Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs mandarin oranges with juice and cooking oil. Bake 3 layers for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0; cool layers. Frost with a mixture of pineapple pudding mix and Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Texas Chili
instructions: Brown beef onions pepper and garlic. Drain off fat. Stir in rest of ingredients simmer for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pecan Balls(Makes 5 Dozen)
instructions: Mix butter sugar salt and vanilla. Work in flour. The last bit of flour may be worked in with hands. Add nuts. Chill dough.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Cream together until smooth.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Mix shortening peanut butter sugars and egg until well mixed. Add vanilla. Stir in flour mixture. Chill dough; roll into balls about the size of a quarter. Place on cookie sheet; flatten with a fork dipped in flour making a crisscross design. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Deanna'S Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Mix white cake mix by directions adding 1 cup coconut to cake mix. Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan with chopped nuts. Pour cake mixture over nuts and bake per directions on cake box. Take baked cake from oven. While slightly warm poke deep holes all over cake. Pour 1 can Coco Lopez into all the cake holes then pour 1 can Eagle Brand milk into cake holes. Separate cake from edge of pan with knife and add both milk and Coco Lopez here as well. Cover and place in refrigerator. When completely cooled cover with Cool Whip. Cake is best served after it has been refrigerated for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Creamy Noodles And Rice
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot butter cook carrots and onion until tender stirring often. Add water soup mix and rice. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed stirring occasionally. Stir in cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple in dish. Mix cheese sugar and flour. Spread over pineapple. Cover with melted margarine. Sprinkle crumbs. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or 325\u00b0.

title: Popey Biscuits
instructions: Mix all together. Roll out and cut. Place on cookie sheet; brush with butter. Bake at 450\u00b0. Makes 31 biscuits.

title: Glenn'S Cabbage Stuff(Stew)
instructions: Cube potatoes. Cut cabbage; slice onions. Saute onions in margarine until clear. Brown cubed meat and add to onions. Add cubed potatoes and cut cabbage. Steam all together. Add dried red peppers last for crispiness. Season as desired. When using smoked sausage no other seasoning should be needed. Cooks in about 30 to 40 minutes (1 dish meal). Serve with bread sticks.

title: Crab And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat oil in Dutch oven or other ovenproof container. Saute celery onion carrot mushrooms and green pepper until onion is transparent. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Let simmer 5 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: 6 Layer Casserole
instructions: Grease 2 quart casserole dish layer as above and bake 3 hours at 300 degrees.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Saute for 3 minutes in 3 tablespoons butter onion celery and green peppers. Mix with other ingredients. Put in casserole dish and cover with crushed crackers that have been mixed with the 1/2 cup oleo. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Combine beef with flour and brown slightly in fat. Add tomato sauce catsup salt and pepper. Put into an 8 or 9-inch square pan and top with cheese and biscuits. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Passover Cheesecake
instructions: To make crust press macaroons on bottom and sides of a greased spring-form pan. Set aside until ready to fill with batter.

title: Honey Pork Oriental
instructions: Cut the pork into 1-inch squares. Brown the pork in 2 tablespoons oil stirring frequently for 15 minutes. Combine 1 envelope brown gravy mix 3/4 cup water 1/4 cup honey the soy sauce red wine vinegar ginger and garlic salt. Add to the skillet. Cover and cook for 20 minutes. Add carrots and cook for 15 minutes more. Add the green pepper and onion; cook for 10 minutes. Serve over rice. (Very sweet and tender.)

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Put Ritz crackers on top and melted margarine on top of crackers. Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Delicious Zucchini
instructions: Place zucchini slices in a buttered oblong casserole dish. Place tomatoes green pepper and onion between zucchini slices. Sprinkle salt Beau Monde seasoning pepper cheese and sugar on top. Drizzle butter evenly over the top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

title: Oreo Cookies Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix together and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: French Toast
instructions: Beat eggs. Add milk flour and sugar mixing well. Dip bread into mixture coating both sides. Cook on griddle until brown on both sides. Serve with syrup or powdered sugar.

title: Salted Peanut Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix melted margarine and egg; pat into 9 x 13 pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put marshmallows over crust. Mix peanut butter chips syrup and 1/4 cup margarine together and microwave 2 minutes. Pour over marshmallows. Press in salted peanuts.

title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
instructions: Use as much of the ingredients as desired.

title: Chocolate Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa milk and butter. Cook until butter melts and bring to a rolling boil. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter oats and vanilla. Spoon on wax paper. Nuts may be added.

title: Simple Strawberry Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans. Combine flour salt and soda; set aside. Beat eggs in large mixing bowl. Add oil sugar gelatin and buttermilk; stir vigorously until well-blended. Add flour mixture and blend well.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding with mixer as directed. Fold in Cool Whip. Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cover bottom with a layer of graham crackers. Add a layer of pudding mixture. Add another layer of graham crackers. Add the rest of the pudding mixture. Add a final layer of graham crackers on top.

title: Banana Split Brownie Pizza
instructions: Mix cream cheese pineapple and sugar. Spread over brownie. Spread strawberries and bananas over pizza. Sprinkle with nuts and drizzle chocolate topping over pizza.

title: Tuna And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain and combine with tuna mayonnaise vegetables and salt. Blend soup and milk; heat and stir in cheese until melted. Add to noodles. Pour in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish; top with almonds. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Divinity
instructions: In a 3 qt microwave safe bowl cook sugar syrup and hot water for 12 minutes and 30 seconds on high until a fine thread is formed when dripping mixture from a spoon.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and sugar in a large bowl. Fix Dream Whip according to directions on package. Combine both mixtures in a large bowl and beat for 3 to 4 minutes adding vanilla. Put cream mixture in crust. Top with pie filling and let chill before serving.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Make chocolate cake according to directions in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool. Crumble cake with a fork. Make pudding according to directions. Thaw Cool Whip. Crush candy bars. Layer in trifle bowl or other tall glass container 1/2 of cake mix 1/2 of pudding 1/2 of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the crumbled candy bars. Repeat another layer with other half of ingredients.

title: Condensed Milk
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Can be used in all recipes calling for condensed milk

title: Mike'S Fried Turkey
instructions: Prepare the turkey as for baking. Do not fry the heart liver or gizzard as they become too hard to eat. Chop the bell peppers into small pieces. Put them in a blender with 3 tablespoons of water and liquify. Melt the butter and oleo in a saucepan. Strain the liquified bell peppers through a fine strainer or a paper towel into the pan with melted butter and oleo. Strain the Italian dressing like the peppers into the pan. Add the 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon mustard hot sauce Worcestershire sauce and the bottle of onion juice to the pan. Bring the mixture to a slight boil. Let cool a bit (until you can handle).

title: Coconut Icebox Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While still warm pierce cake every 1 1/2 inches with wooden spoon handle. Boil sugar and milk together for 1 minute. Pour in holes and\tover cake. Cool. Spread Cool Whip over cake and sprinkle thawed coconut on top. Chill overnight.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Saute onion celery and green pepper until soft about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic. Fry about 5 more minutes. Remove pan from direct heat and slowly stir in flour. Add parsley bay leaves salt cayenne and tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes. Add shrimp; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Serve over cooked fluffy rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook cool and drain broccoli. Mix remaining ingredients. Fold in broccoli. Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Rice Dish
instructions: Arrange in layers in the order given in a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Bread
