instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and baking soda. Mash bananas with a fork and add lemon juice. Cream shortening and sugar well until light. Add sifted ingredients and milk alternately. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into 2 or 3 greased pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Mom'S Doughnuts
instructions: Mix together. Fry in oil. Glaze with mixture of powdered sugar and water.

title: Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix cheese and Miracle Whip until creamed. Then mix in bacon Parmesan and onion.

title: Italian Breaded Round Steak
instructions: Take round steak put in egg and milk mixture and let soak for a while. Put bread crumbs on paper or plate. Add salt pepper garlic powder and Italian seasoning. Put cut pieces of steak into bread crumb mixture about one teaspoon each of seasoning. After breading let dry for 15 minutes. Heat skillet; add 1/4 cup of oil to hot pan. Cook on medium until preferred doneness. Very good.

title: Chewy Charlies
instructions: Mix margarine canned milk sugar and cocoa in saucepan and boil for 2 minutes. Remove from stove and add oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well and drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper to cool.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Core apples and cut into bite sizes. Combine apples chunks with Cool Whip slivers of Snickers bars and drained crushed pineapple. Chill until ready to serve. Makes many servings.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cheese Cake
instructions: If you have Tiara pans cook in them. If using regular layer cake pans cut out circle 1-inch in from the edge of cake layer and at least 1/2-inch deep.

title: Gazpacho Dip
instructions: Blend oil and vinegar. Add salt garlic salt and pepper. Stir. Mix with olives green chiles tomatoes onions anad avocados. Chill for several hours for flavors to mix. Serve cold with tortilla chips. Very good!

title: Holiday Popcorn
instructions: Toss together popcorn nuts apricots and raisins. Blend syrup brown sugar and salt. Pour over popcorn mix; toss lightly until evenly coated. Put on buttered jelly roll pan. Heat in 250\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Line 9-inch pie plate with pastry. Prick bottom of pastry with fork. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven 5 minutes. Remove from oven; sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Layer 1/2 the broccoli over Parmesan cheese. Continue with layers of 1/2 Swiss cheese and onions; repeat with remaining broccoli Swiss cheese and onions. Beat eggs. Add chicken broth cream salt and Tabasco; mix well. Pour over broccoli mixture in pastry shell. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of Parmesan cheese. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0. Reduce heat to 325\u00b0; bake 20 to 25 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.

title: No-Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt marshmallows in cream. Add all ingredients to cream mixture. Pack in cracker box (lined with wax paper) and chill.

title: Corn Bread Salad
instructions: Crumble corn bread; add salt pepper onion tomatoes green pepper celery and bacon. Add only enough dressing to moisten. This recipe is good with most everything but especially good with beans and vegetables.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Beat until smooth. Can be baked in an iron skillet. Place 1 tablespoon of oil in skillet and heat. Then pour in corn bread mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Canadian Cheddar Cheese Soup(Serves 4)
instructions: Melt the butter in a 3-quart saucepan over moderate heat. Reduce the heat to low; add the onion and carrot and cook covered for about 5 minutes or until the onion is soft. Stir in the flour and cook 3 or 4 more minutes. Gradually add the chicken broth stirring constantly. Stir in the mustard and paprika.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and peanut butter. Add sugars blend. Add beaten egg then dry ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 60 small cookies.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix salt with cabbage; let stand for 1 hour. Squeeze out excess water. Add carrot pepper and celery.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Put all ingredients except water in a bowl. Mix two minutes. Add hot water and beat two minutes more. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Or pour into 2 (9-inch) cake pans; bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Creamy Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breast; bone and tear into small bite-size pieces (set aside). Set aside 2 cups of chicken broth. Melt 1/2 stick margarine; coat the croutons of stuffing mix with the melted margarine. Divide in one-half; set aside. Add the vegetable seasoning packet to 1/2 cup chicken broth and boil 5 minutes; set aside. Blend together the cream of chicken soup and sour cream (do not beat). Set aside.

title: Vanilla Fudge
instructions: Mix pudding sugar milk and margarine together in a medium heavy saucepan. Stir until smooth. Cook and stir to a rolling boil. Boil an additional 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in nuts. Beat until candy loses its gloss. Pour into buttered pan. When cooled and hardened cut into squares.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan line with heavy-duty foil leaving enough foil in center to seal. Place pork chops in bottom of pan. Pour cream of mushroom soup over the pork chops; sprinkle with salt and pepper and pour water over soup. Cut margarine into small pieces and place on top of the soup. Sprinkle with cheese and seal. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Burger Beans
instructions: Lightly fry onion and pepper in small amount of cooking oil. Stir in ground beef and cook until meat loses red color. Mix with other ingredients and bake for 30 minutes or until light brown on top in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Norma'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put broccoli in baking dish. Place chicken over broccoli. Mix mayonnaise curry soup and cream. Pour over chicken. Add cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot.

title: Jessie Cakes
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan; add brown sugar when melted. Do not cook. Stir in sugar well. Take off stove burner; add well beaten eggs stirred in lightly. Then add flour nuts and vanilla. Pour mixture in well-greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 minutes. Cut in squares. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Raise once; shape (two hours first one hour second). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Philadelphia Cream Cheese Kolachy(A Bohemian Cookie)
instructions: Cream butter and cheese. Add flour sifted with baking powder. Mix thoroughly. Roll out thin and cut with small glass. Fill center with solo filling. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes to a light brown.

title: Granny'S Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool and cut.

title: Banana-Nut Salad
instructions: Combine sugar and flour. Add egg; mix thoroughly. Add butter vinegar and water; mix thoroughly. Cook over hot water stirring constantly until thick and smooth. Cool. Dip bananas in cool dressing and roll in nuts. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sausage Balls(Appetizer)
instructions: Let sausage get to room temperature. Mix all ingredients with hands until it is all mixed thoroughly. Roll into bite-size balls. Put on cookie sheet and freeze. After freezing put in plastic bags. Can be kept in freezer indefinitely. When ready to use take from freezer and place on cookie sheet. Cook immediately in 350\u00b0 oven for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Squash Patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil. Mix well. Drop by tablespoons into 1/8-inch of hot oil. Flatten patties to 1/4-inch thickness. Cook until golden brown.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Mix and let set at least 12 hours. Then add

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Blend together shortening eggs vanilla brown sugar and sugar. Then add sifted flour salt baking soda cinnamon and nutmeg. When all mixed together put uncooked oatmeal in. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie Filling
instructions: Scatter pecan halves in prepared tart shell. Bring sugar and corn syrup to a rolling boil. Remove from heat; stir in butter and finely-cut chocolate. Beat eggs. Pour syrup mixture slowly into eggs whipping constantly. Pour filling over pecans making sure that they are well-covered with filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes until filling is set and a table knife inserted into center comes out clean.

title: Spicy Mayhaw Chicken Drummettes
instructions: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry. Combine soup dressing and jelly; mix well. Heat to melt jelly. Place chicken pieces in uncovered baking dish; spoon sauce over chicken pieces. Bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. (The remaining sauce can be kept refrigerated for about 2 weeks.)

title: Deep Dish Pan Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Brown hamburger and onion; drain well. Add pizza sauce from box tomatoes and optional ingredients. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Mix pizza dough according to directions on box. Add a little more flour and vegetable oil to make more. Put in a 10 x 13-inch pan; bring dough up on sides. Pour hamburger mixture on dough. Add grated cheese. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix the first 2 ingredients together in a big mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients except chips; mix well. Add chocolate chips to batter. Pour into well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Crispy Scallop Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly coat 1-quart casserole with vegetable spray.

title: Chocolate Syrup Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cookie Pizza
instructions: Spread sugar cookies on an ungreased pizza pan and bake according to instructions on back of cookie package until done. Let cool. In medium bowl stir cream cheese with spoon or use mixer to eliminate lumps; add strawberry yogurt and mix until smooth. Spread cream cheese mixture over cool cookie pizza. Cover with fruit. Just before serving spray whipped topping on. Enjoy! Its so-o-o good and easy.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together well. Add eggs one a time beating well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients and combine the two mixtures. Flour raisins and nut meats. Add to the above mixture. Pour into layer pans and bake in slow oven (300\u00b0) for about 1 hour or until cake leaves side of pan clean.

title: Banana Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and freeze.

title: Dynamites
instructions: Mix meat eggs and bread crumbs together. Form into hot dog shape. Dice peppers onions and celery. Coat bottom of pan with small amount of oil. Add onions to meat and brown. Add all except tomato juice into slow cooker. Add just enough juice to cover. Add red pepper sauce to taste (hot or mild). Let simmer in slow cooker for 5 to 6 hours. Makes large batch. Can freeze. Serve in hot dog rolls or over rice.

title: Easy Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Set aside 1 cup of dry cake mix. Stir together remaining dry cake mix 1 egg and oil. (Mixture will be crumbly.) Press crust mixture lightly into bottom and three-quarters of the way up the sides of a greased pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch or spring-loaded round).

title: Impossible French Apple Pie
instructions: Add together in blender and blend for 30 seconds. Pour over apples. Top with streusel.

title: Milk Frappe
instructions: In blender mix all ingredients until liquid is thick and foamy.

title: Buttermilk Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix all well except flour. Add flour one cup at a time until you have a very stiff dough. Place into a large bowl and let rise until doubled. Punch down and let rise the second time. After second rise make into rolls; place into a well oiled baking pan. Let rise until almost doubled. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: World'S Greatest Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine butter and sugars until creamy. Add egg and oil mixing well. Gradually add flour salt and baking soda. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Salmon Ball
instructions: Mix and shape into ball. Chill 2 hours. Roll in chopped nuts. Serve with crackers.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine water 1/4 cup salsa margarine and stuffing. Mix well and place in 2-quart saucepan. Arrange chicken on top of stuffing. Pour remaining salsa on meat. Loosely cover dish. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Sauce For Basting
instructions: Sprinkle chicken generously with garlic salt; set on rack in foil-lined shallow baking pan. Baste chicken with sauce. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn and baste during baking.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix well the first 4 ingredients and pour over orange sherbet. Serves 50.

title: School Day Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Pour into casserole dish and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven until bubbly approximately 25 minutes.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream first three ingredients. Add rest and form into 2-inch thick rolls rolled in flour and then in wax paper. Place in flat dish and then in refrigerator overnight or freezer. Slice thin and bake on greased sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Mashed Potato Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well. Sift dry ingredients in separate bowl. Add chocolate to hot mashed potatoes. Add to sugar eggs and margarine mixture. Then add dry ingredients and milk. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in 375\u00b0 oven. Frost as desired.

title: Coconut-Pineapple Spread
instructions: Beat cream cheese at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in coconut and preserves. Cover and refrigerate. Yield 1 1/4 cups.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Sift together the first 5 ingredients. Work mayonnaise and sugar together with a spoon until smooth. Add water and vanilla to dry ingredients. Mix all ingredients together and beat until smooth. Turn into greased pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Carolyn'S Picadillo(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Unusual flavors make this tortilla filling a winner!

title: Texas Gold Bars
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients well. Pat in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix the last three ingredients well; pour over cake mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cut into squares. This will melt in your mouth.

title: Vanilla Pie Pudding
instructions: Melt butter and add milk and the sugar. Mix in the rest of the ingredients with a wire whisk until smooth. I then use a spoon stirring constantly until thick.

title: Frozen Fruit Dessert
instructions: Cover the cherries pineapple nuts and marshmallow with mayonnaise. Then mix according to package directions. Mix Dream Whip and fold into fruit mixture. Freeze overnight in a 9 x 13-inch Tupperware container.

title: Brandied Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Pour the fresh cleaned cranberries into a shallow 9 x 13-inch pan in a single layer. Sprinkle 2 cups sugar over the berries; do not stir. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool to room temperature. Uncover and pour the brandy or cognac over berries. Sprinkle an additional 1/2 cup sugar over all and stir well. (Eliminate 1/2 cup sugar if you prefer it tart.) This keeps in the refrigerator \forever.\

title: Peek-A-Boo Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each addition. Add vanilla baking powder and flour. Mix well. Spread 2/3 batter in 10 x 15 x 1-inch jelly roll pan which is greased and floured. Spread entire can of fruit filling over batter. Drop by tablespoons the remaining batter. Some filling will show between spoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool. Dust with powdered sugar after cool.

title: Banana Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine in bowl bananas egg milk oil and cereal. Let stand 10 minutes. Mix with dry ingredients. Sift together flour baking powder baking soda salt and nutmeg. Spoon into greased muffin pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Combine cream cheese 1/2 cup sugar and 1 egg in bowl; mix well. Set aside. Combine margarine 3/4 cup water and chocolate in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Using mixer stir in flour 2 cups sugar 2 eggs sour cream soda and salt. Pour into well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture over chocolate mixture. Swirl into batter with knife. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Scrub the potatoes with vegetable brush under running water until clean. Boil whole with skins on until tender. Let cool. Remove skins and slice potato.

title: Mom'S Chile Con Queso(Dip Or Spread)
instructions: Cook cheese in double boiler; melt stirring occasionally. Mixture thickens as it heats. Mix in sauce and chiles. Let sit for several minutes. Serve hot with restaurant style chips.

title: Pumpkin Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast; set aside. In a small pan heat and stir pumpkin milk sugar 2 tablespoons butter and salt until warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to flour-yeast along with egg. Beat on low for 30 seconds. Beat on high for 3 minutes. Stir in enough flour to make moderately stiff dough. Knead about 6 to 8 minutes. Place in a greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover; let rise until doubled about 1 hour. Roll into a 12 x 10-inch rectangle.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Boil mixture of the first 5 ingredients for about 5 minutes. Add the soda; stir well. Pour over popcorn which has been popped. Bake for 1 hour at 250\u00b0; stir every 15 minutes. (Easiest to bake in a large roaster.)

title: Berry Trifle
instructions: About 4 hours before serving mix in bowl the cream cheese milk sugar and vanilla extract until smooth. Then fold in the Cool Whip. Separate ladyfingers into individual cookies. Mix orange juice and liqueur. Drizzle over ladyfingers to moisten.

title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole
instructions: Grease a large glass pan; layer bottom with croutons. Top with crumbled sausage and cheese. Combine eggs milk and seasonings; pour over croutons sausage and cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Mandarin Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in one bowl. Pour into ungreased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. When cake is done poke holes in top of cake. While still hot pour topping over cake. Let cool and serve.

title: Hershey'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients in large bowl. Add eggs milk oil and vanilla. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. Stir in boiling water. (Batter will be thin.) Pour into 2 (9-inch) greased and floured pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Cool completely and frost.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: In a small bowl combine the egg and milk. In a shallow dish combine the crackers thyme paprika and pepper. Set aside. Skin chicken and wash. Pat dry with paper towel. Dip chicken pieces one at a time in egg mixture then roll in cracker mixture.

title: Microwave Pecan Brittle
instructions: Place sugar Karo salt and pecans in a microwave-safe bowl. Stir. Microwave 4 minutes. Remove bowl. Stir again then microwave 4 additional minutes. Remove bowl. Add butter and vanilla. Stir. Microwave 2 minutes. Remove from microwave. Add baking soda. Pour contents onto buttered piece of aluminum foil. Cool about 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Banana Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl combine water and Eagle Brand stirring until well blended. Add pudding; beat until well blended. Chill for at least 5 minutes. Slice bananas and allow to stand in lemon juice while pudding is chilling. Once the pudding has set fold in whipped cream until well blended. In a glass bowl layer pudding vanilla wafers and bananas. End with pudding.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables. Mix with peas (uncooked). Mix together rest of ingredients. Pour over vegetables and set overnight.

title: Fruit Crisp
instructions: Mix apples with brown sugar to taste. Cover with cake mix. Melt and pour margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle with crushed pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is golden brown.

title: California Cake Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix cornbread using all the liquid and egg called for if using a mix. Mix ingredients for cake using all the liquid and egg called for. Combine batter in a large mixing bowl and beat with hand mixer until smooth.

title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
instructions: Mix pineapple juice ketchup cornstarch and set aside. Cook water and sugar on medium heat until melted reduce heat then add pineapple juice; stir well until thick. Serve when eggrolls are still hot.

title: See'S Fudge
instructions: Combine the first four ingredients in a bowl. Combine the remaining ingredients in medium saucepan; stir mixture until boils. Boil for 6 minutes stirring constantly. Pour over mixture in bowl. Stir until chocolate and butter melt. Pour into a greased square cake pan. Place in fridge to harden.

title: Meredith'S Chicken
instructions: Line 9 x 13-inch pan with sliced dried beef. Wrap each half breast with 1 slice bacon. Place on dried beef. Mix sour cream and soup. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Can be made ahead and baked 2 hours at 250\u00b0.)

title: Broccoli Souffle
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Add all other ingredients and mix. Put in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with 1/2-inch crushed Ritz crackers. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for about 35 minutes

title: 15 Minute Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken celery onion nuts salt pepper mayonnaise and 1 cup of potato chips. Put in casserole. Put remaining chips on top. Pour on soup and egg slices. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix unsweetened chocolate sugar butter and milk together in a saucepan. Boil for 1 minute.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1-quart glass container combine sugar and corn syrup and stir. Cook on high 4 minutes. Add peanuts and stir well. Cook on high for an additional 3 1/2 minutes. Add butter and vanilla stirring well. Cook on high 1 minute. Add baking soda and stir gently until light and foamy. Pour mixture immediately onto buttered cookiesheet. Spread thinly. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Caramelized Onions
instructions: In medium skillet heat margarine or butter over medium-low heat until melted. Add onion. Cover and cook on medium-low heat until onion is tender about 13 to 15 minutes. Uncover; add sugar. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until onion is golden stirring constantly about 4 to 5 minutes. Serve hot over burgers prime ribs or beef steaks.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with hot and cold water. Cool until it begins to gel. Add pineapple bananas and marshmallows. Gel until thick. Mix cook and cool pineapple juice sugar flour and egg. Spread on top of thickened Jell-O. Mix softened cream cheese and whipped topping. Spread on top of salad. Garnish with coconut or nuts.

title: Liver And Potato Casserole
instructions: Cut liver into 1 inch pieces;\tflour salt and pepper. Fry until done. Fry potatoes and onion until tender. Mix soup with milk. Mix liver and potatoes together in a large baking dish. Pour soup mixture\tover and bake at 350\u00b0 until hot.

title: Vegetable Potato Soup
instructions: Saute bacon until light brown and crisp. Drain and set aside. Saute onion in drippings until golden. Combine stock onion and bacon in soup kettle. Add vegetables and potatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes to blend flavors. Season to taste. Heat onion rings under broiler. Use onion rings as garnish. Serves 6.

title: Hamburger Casserole(April, 1995)
instructions: Heat oil; saute onion over medium heat. Add hamburger and brown. Stir in roni and tomatoes. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick butter with graham cracker crumbs. Press down. Beat eggs powdered sugar and 2 sticks butter; mix 15 minutes. Pour over crust. Slice bananas all over mixture. Add pineapple and cover with Cool Whip. Decorate with cherries and nuts.

title: Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Sift ingredients together; mix until crumbly. Add egg and blend well. Spread more than half on cookie sheet. Place fruit filling on top of flour mixture. Top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Apple juice and ginger ale should be chilled. Thaw orange juice and lemonade. Mix all ingredients ginger ale last and serve.

title: Mom'S Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. In large bowl mix sugar and spices except nutmeg. Add pumpkin milk eggs to sugar and spice mixture. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle nutmeg over top and bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake until firm about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Black Beans And Rice Salad
instructions: Combine the rice beans tomatoes cheese (if desired) and parsley in large bowl. In a cup whisk the dressing and lime juice; pour over the rice mixture; toss lightly. Serve on lettuce. Serves 4.

title: Party Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water. Mix in ice cream until completely melted. Chill until almost set. Stir in strawberries.

title: Jam Bars
instructions: Grease 8 or 9-inch micro-safe dish. Cream shortening and sugar. Add all but jam and blend well. Press one-half mixture into dish. Micro 4 minutes. Spread jam over baked mixture. Crumble rest of mix over jam and press lightly. Micro an additional 6 minutes. Cool and cut into small bars (32).

title: Sour Cream Baked Chicken
instructions: Spray a baking pan with Pam. Place one piece of chicken in palm of hand and spread evenly with sour cream. Place each piece in pan one at a time with sides touching (sour cream on bottom). When all pieces of chicken are in pan sprinkle with salt and pepper. Spread remaining sour cream over top. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours for sour cream to tenderize chicken. To bake preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle chicken with bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake 1 hour. Serve with rice a green vegetable and salad.

title: Cooky-Jar Gingersnaps
instructions: Measure flour ginger soda cinnamon and salt into sifter. Cream shortening until soft in medium size bowl. Gradually add sugar creaming after each addition until mixture is fluffy. Beat in egg and molasses. Sift dry ingredients over creamed mixture; blend well.

title: Five-Hour Stew
instructions: Put meat in bottom of baking dish or dutch oven. Layer vegetables on top. Sprinkle onion soup mix over the top. Spread both cans of soup over the top. Cover. Bake 5 hours at 250\u00b0 if using frozen meat. Bake 5 hours at 300\u00b0 if using thawed meat.

title: Italian Cookie
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter or oleo. Add well-beaten eggs. Add Ricotta cheese and vanilla. Sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Do not make dough stiff. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes (approximately 12 minutes).

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans on bottom of a pizza pan. Mix sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning together. Spread over beans. Cut green onion tops and all and put over mixture. Dice the tomato and add over top. Sprinkle finely shredded Cheddar cheese over all. Serve with your favorite taco chips.

title: Chocolate Kisses
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Roll in 4x sugar.

title: Venison Stroganoff
instructions: Remove fat from meat and cut into strips 1/4 inch wide and 1 1/2 inches long. Brown meat in 3 tablespoons butter; add onion salt and pepper in pan or heavy skillet. Add bouillon; simmer 1 1/2 hours until tender. Saute mushrooms in rest of butter until lightly browned. Add flour and add to liquid in meat pan stirring constantly until thickened. Add mustard and sour cream to pan; mix well and heat to boiling and pour over bed of rice.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. In a large bowl combine cake mix cherry pie filling almond extract and 2 eggs. Stir by hand until well blended. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until it tests done. Cool.

title: Cream Of Coconut Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix egg whites milk oil and 1 can coconut. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan about 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Make holes in warm cake with fork. Pour cream of coconut over cake when cool. Combine second can of coconut and Cool Whip and frost cake while still in pan. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Mix the first 8 ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt oleo; mix with crackers. Spread on top of first mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrot Cake Frosting
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Frost cake and serve.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in salt water until tender. Drain well. Place broccoli in bottom of casserole dish. Mix together soup mayonnaise egg and onion. Pour this mixture over broccoli. Add grated cheese. Top with stuffing mix and dot with small pieces of margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix margarine and dressing. Put 1/2 in bottom of a 9 x 13 dish. Place chicken on top of dressing mixture. Pour soups and chicken broth over chicken. Put the remaining dressing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Pour into a greased Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Taco Potatoes
instructions: Brown meat and add bell pepper onion seasoning mix and water. Cook until water cooks out and vegies are tender. Serve 1/4 meat mixture over a 3 ounce baked potato. Top with Cheddar cheese lettuce tomatoes and sour cream. Can also top with taco sauce or picante sauce if desired.

title: Cold Cucumber Soup
instructions: Heat butter in heavy skillet and saute onion garlic and cucumber until onion is tender about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with flour. Stir well. Gradually stir in broth. Add salt and bring to boil. Cover and simmer until cucumber is tender. Cool. Puree mixture in batches in blender. Stir or whip in sour cream dill lemon rind and mace. Chill several hours.

title: Cucumber Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water; cool. Puree cucumbers in food processor. Combine mayonnaise and sour cream; mix well then stir into gelatin mixture. Chill until slightly congealed then fold in cucumbers. Pour into mold or Pyrex dish depending on how it is to be served. Chill in refrigerator until firmly congealed.

title: Light Lemon Chicken
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon margarine in skillet. Add chicken and brown for 3 minutes. Add broth peel tarragon and juice. Reduce heat cover and simmer until meat is no longer pink 10 to 12 minutes. Remove chicken to serving dish. Melt 1/2 tablespoon margarine stir in flour and add juices. Bring to a boil and stir until it thickens. Pour over chicken and serve immediately.

title: Waffles
instructions: Separate eggs. Beat whites. In another large bowl mix all the ingredients until smooth. Fold in beaten egg whites. Cook as instructed by waffle iron.

title: Chicken Wings Supreme
instructions: Remove tips off wings. Place in baking dish.\tCombine all ingredients and pour over wings. Marinate overnight.

title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: In one or two cup glass measure combine chocolate pieces and milk. Heat in microwave oven on High (100%) power for 45 to 60 seconds. Stir until smooth. If necessary return to microwave for 15 seconds. Stir in vanilla. Serve warm.

title: Lasagna Casserole
instructions: Add first mushrooms to spaghetti sauce. Add spaghetti sauce mixture to ground beef. Add beaten eggs to Ricotta cheese. Spread a layer of sauce mixture over bottom of dish. Place noodles on top of this and spread Ricotta mixture over noodles. Place a layer of meat sauce over Ricotta. Add cheeses on top of this. Start with another layer of noodles ending with grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Taku Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use 2 heaping teaspoons of mixture per cup of hot water. Recipe from the \Taku Lodge\ in Alaska.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except crackers. Pour over crackers. Toss lightly until crackers are covered. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Chinese Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except margarine almonds and corn flakes. Put in a 2-quart casserole. Melt margarine and add corn flakes and almonds. Sprinkle on top of chicken mixture and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Enjoy!

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes drain and slice 1/4-inch thick. Keep warm. Cook bacon and drain saving 4 tablespoons drippings. Add bacon to potatoes. Cook onion in reserved drippings until tender about 5 minutes. Stir in flour salt pepper and sugar. Then add vinegar and water. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Pour over potatoes and serve warm.

title: Malt Shoppe Pie
instructions: Combine ice cream and Cool Whip. Blend well. Reserve 8 Whoppers for garnish and crush remaining Whoppers. Add 1 cup crushed candy to ice cream/Cool Whip mixture. Spoon mixture into pie crust. Top with remaining crushed candy. Freeze 4 hours.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix corn green beans sour cream soup cheese onions and pepper in casserole dish. Mix crackers and oleo and put on top of casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 10-12 people.

title: No-Fail Divinity
instructions: Mix sugar corn syrup water and salt in 2-quart casserole. Cook in Radarange oven 19 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Candy thermometer should ready 260\u00b0. If not cook 1 or 2 minutes longer. While syrup cooks beat egg whites very stiff in a large bowl. Gradually pour hot syrup over egg whites and continue beating at high speed until thick and candy starts to lose its gloss. Beating may require about 12 minutes. Add vanilla and nuts to beaten mixture. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. Yields 7 dozen pieces. Tint with food coloring for the holiday season. Be sure to stir candy syrups at least once during cooking so that the heat is equalized and the candy looks smooth.

title: Chuck Wagon Stew(Easy And Hearty)
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add vegetable soup and beans. Heat for 15 minutes. Serve piping hot with rolls and a tossed salad.

title: Tropical Garden Punch
instructions: Chill ingredients. Combine in a punch bowl. Yield 15 servings.

title: Buttermilk Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: In large bowl beat shortening until creamy. Gradually add sugar beating until mixed well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Blend in vanilla. Sift flour. Add in thirds to\tsugar-egg mixture alternately with buttermilk (begin and end with flour). On low speed add melted chocolate\tmixing\tuntil well blended. Pour batter evenly into greased 10-inch tube pan or large Bundt pan. Bake for about 1 1/2 hours or until\tcake tester inserted in center comes out clean at 300\u00b0. Cool for 10 minutes on rack in pan. Invert cake on rack to cool completely. Frost if desired with Dark Chocolate Frosting recipe.

title: Chewy Gooie Cookies
instructions: Stir ingredients together. Put into well-greased cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Do not overbake. Score and let cool before slicing and removing from pan.

title: Doughnuts
instructions: Mix ingredients as if it were a cake. Cut out and fry in shortening.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Beat all ingredients together. Pour into pan. Bake approximately 1 hour or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from pan. Cool before slicing.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Add all ingredients into a blender. Blend at high speed for 1/2 minute. Remove and add coconut. Pour mixture into 2 well-buttered and floured glass Pyrex pie plates (9-inches). Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes. Let stand for 1 hour or longer.

title: Shrimp Creole - Low-Fat
instructions: Coat a large saucepan with pan spray. Saute onions green pepper and celery until tender. Stir frequently and add a small amount of water if necessary to prevent drying. Add remaining ingredients except shrimp. Heat until sauce just starts to boil. Remove and discard bay leaf. Reduce heat. Add shrimp and heat through. Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 375\u00b0. Pour butter in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until brown. Let cool; cut into squares.

title: Top Of The Stove Cake
instructions: In a large Dutch oven bring water 2 cups sugar and 4 tablespoons butter to a boil. In a bowl or saucepan mix remaining butter (melted) remaining sugar egg milk vanilla flour and cocoa. Pour this batter into the boiling sauce; turn down low. Cover and cook for 15 to 20 minutes. When done sprinkle top with broken pecans.

title: Duftners Favorite Meal
instructions: Rinse chicken; pat dry. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heat butter and oil in large skillet. Brown chicken all over. Season with salt. Remove chicken. Drain 2/3 of fat; return to pan and season with pepper and herbs. Cover with onions. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake 2 to 3 hours.

title: Angel Food Ice Cream Cake(Diabetic)
instructions: Cut the cake in half. Tear half of the cake into small pieces and set aside. Cut the other half into 12 to 14 thin slices. Arrange in the bottom of a wax paper lined 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan overlapping the slices as needed. Spread softened ice cream over cake pressing down to smooth. Gently press the small cake pieces into ice cream. Cover and freeze. Just before serving slice strawberries and sweeten with sweetener to taste. Cut dessert into squares and top with strawberries. Makes 15 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and place in casserole dish. Top with topping and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie
instructions: Heat apple juice; thicken with cornstarch. Stir in margarine and cinnamon. Pour thickened apple juice over apples; stir carefully. Sprinkle with salt. Pour into pie shell; cover with crust. Brush top with melted margarine or milk; sprinkle with additional cinnamon. May use unpeeled grated apples if desired.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Stir catsup mustard brown sugar onion and molasses in beans. Top with bacon and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Supreme
instructions: Combine mayo flour and seasoning. Gradually add milk. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until thick. Add 1 cup cheese and stir until melted. Place broccoli in 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Cover with chicken and sauce. Top with crispy rice squares. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. (Double this for a 13 1/2 x 8 1/2-inch baking dish.)

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients with spoon. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream can be served on top.

title: Sausage Bean Stew
instructions: In a 4-quart Dutch oven place all ingredients except spinach. Cover and cook over medium heat for 45 to 60 minutes or until barley and lentils are tender. Stir in spinach and heat through.

title: Sausage Biscuits
instructions: Prepare biscuit mix according to directions. Roll out thin. Sprinkle sausage on top and roll into oblong strip. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients; beat well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 15 minutes at 400\u00b0 then reduce to 300\u00b0 and continue to bake until firm.

title: Good And Simple-To-Make Punch
instructions: Chill juices. Pour over sherbet that has been cut up. Mix sherbet until punch can be poured.

title: Shrimp With Garlic And Tomatoes(Scampi Con Salsa Pizzaiola)
instructions: Wash shrimp under cold water. Drain thoroughly. Heat oil in large skillet and saute garlic over medium heat until golden. Remove garlic and discard. Add chopped tomatoes oregano parsley salt and red pepper. Cook for 10 minutes add shrimp and cook an additional 5 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally. If sauce looks too dry you can add a little water. Heat thoroughly and place in serving dish. Serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings. Great with fresh Italian bread.

title: Caldo Gallego
instructions: Combine the smoked pork potatoes collard greens dry beans salt pork and water in a large stock pot. Bring to a boil then reduce heat cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours until beans are tender. Remove the pork shank from the pot and remove the meat from the bones. Dice the meat and return to the pot. Wash the unto to remove salt. Dice. Heat the olive oil in a heavy skillet and fry the diced unto until it melts; remove any unto that does not melt and discard.

title: Nuts And Bolts(Great Snack.  Kids Love It!)
instructions: Place in a large turkey roaster. Pour liquid mixture over cereals and thoroughly coat turning. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 2 hours turning every 15 minutes. Makes 2 largest Tupperware containers and stores well. Excellent for Christmas gifts.

title: Peanut Butter Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: In small mixer bowl beat together cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add peanut butter and milk; beat until smooth and creamy.\tPrepare dessert topping mix according to package directions; fold into peanut butter mixture. Turn into prepared crust 5 to 6 hours or overnight.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice in milk; add sugar vanilla and egg. Stir constantly. Add a dash of cinnamon and with sweet milk to taste. Its good warm or cold.

title: Kama'S Cherry Fruitcake(Best Fruitcake I'Ve Ever Eaten)
instructions: Grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) pans. Line with foil (allowing a 2-inch overhang) and grease again. Sift flour sugar baking powder and salt into a large mixing bowl. Add fruits and pecans; toss until well coated. Turn mixture into prepared loaf pans pressing to pack tightly. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 3/4 hours or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 15 minutes then remove from pans and take off foil. Brush loaves with corn syrup while still warm. Cool thoroughly. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Special K-Bars
instructions: Bring to a boil sugar and corn syrup; take off stove. Add peanut butter then add to Special K. Spread on a cookie sheet. Melt chips and spread over the other mixture.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut top off peppers scoop out seeds. Cook in boiling water salted about 10 minutes. Drain and place in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Meanwhile mix hamburger eggs onions garlic salt and bread crumbs. Mix together. Place mixture into pepper. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Pour tomato sauce on top of pepper and bake another 15 minutes.

title: Divine Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and water to hard ball (260\u00b0). Pour into beaten egg whites. Add vanilla; beat until it holds its shape and becomes slightly dull. Drop onto waxed paper. Do not drop too soon or it will not hold its shape. It is delicious!!!

title: Idaho Potato Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl cream margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in potatoes and vanilla.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Mix last 3 ingredients together and pour over salad. Leave in refrigerator overnight then toss.

title: Hot Chicken Dish
instructions: Saute onion celery and green pepper in the margarine. Add the soups and water to pan; stir. Heat until hot. In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan arrange chicken chunks. Then pour over the croutons the mixture of sauteed ingredients and soups. Cover with foil and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove foil; bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
instructions: Line a 9 x 16-inch Pyrex baking dish with the crackers. Beat the pudding with the milk. Fold in the Cool Whip. Spread half of this over the crackers. Spread remaining pudding mix over the crackers. Make another layer of crackers. Spread topping over top and let stand overnight.

title: Crab And Shrimp Delite Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese in microwave. Stir in onions and celery along with a few drops of Worcestershire sauce. With a knife or small spreader spread mixture in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Pour the cocktail sauce over cream cheese and spread. Spread drained and rinsed shrimp and crab over top. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Serve with Breton crackers.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except almonds. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Elaine'S Cornbread And Corn Medley
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. After 30 minutes put cheese on top and bake for remaining 10 minutes. Great for a potluck when you cant think of anything to bring. Can be served hot or cold. Best hot though. You can spray Pam in pan if you want. Makes easier to get out of the pan.

title: Feather Dumplings
instructions: Add butter to beaten egg. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Drop by teaspoons into boiling broth and cook covered 18 minutes.

title: Green Tomato Goulash
instructions: Fry all ingredients in bacon grease or Crisco until its done. You can even can this but dont use bacon grease or Crisco; use water.

title: Dove Or Quail In Wine Sauce
instructions: Salt and pepper birds. Dust with flour and brown in oil. Place onions and celery in bottom of large Dutch oven. Put bay leaves inside each bird and dot with butter. Pour wine and water over birds. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 about 2 hours or until birds are fully cooked. Baste often. Serve with long grain or wild rice.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Bring stew to boil using 2 cups water. Simmer for 4 hours. Mix 1 cup meat broth with remaining ingredients; boil 20 minutes. Pour over cooked meat that has been shredded. Simmer for 1 hour; let stand 2 hours to bring out the flavor. (Add water as needed in the 4 hour cooking time.) Serve on buns.

title: Strawberry Pie Filling
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and water and cook until thick; add jello. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with lots of strawberries. This is enough for 1 pie; to double add whole package of jello.

title: Whipped Cream Frosting
instructions: Mix together. Beat 12 minutes with mixer.

title: Ann'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar add molasses and soda beat until foamy. Add eggs and beat well. Add water and all dry ingredients beat until smooth. Allow to cool several hours or overnight in refrigerator. Roll out and bake in 400\u00b0 oven 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pecans and apples; blend. Fold in pecans and apples. Bake in layers at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Big Pretzels
instructions: Mix together the oil garlic powder dill weed and dressing; mix. Break pretzels. Put on cookie sheet. Pour mixture over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. After 10 minutes turn. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Sour Cream Bran Muffins
instructions: Cream oleo; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs sour cream and molasses. Mix well. Stir in raisins. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Add to mixture. Add bran stirring just until moist. Spoon into baking cups or greased muffin tins. Fill 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Very good!

title: Mushroom Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Curried Rice-A-Roni
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to directions on box. Put in a large bowl and add mayonnaise olives artichokes and curry powder. Serve warm or cold.

title: Fresh Fruit Delight
instructions: Peel and slice peaches and bananas; sprinkle with Fruit-Fresh to keep from turning brown. Drain pineapple chunks. Slice strawberries; reserve a few for garnish. Cut cantaloupe and honeydew. Mix all fruit together. Mix pudding and 3/4 of Cool Whip together.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
instructions: Mix all but last 2 ingredients together. Roll into small balls. Mix together 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Roll balls in the cinnamon sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Easy Pizza Buns(Snack)
instructions: On ungreased cookie sheet place halved buns (as many as desired). Butter buns. Put one slice of cheese on each. Put 1 to 2 tablespoons sauce on each. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve.

title: Chicken Liver Pate
instructions: Saute liver and diced onions in 1/4 cup butter. Then put all ingredients in a food\tprocessor and blend well. Add salt to taste. Serve with crackers.

title: Low-Fat Pizza
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar salt and small amount of flour. Stir until smooth. Sprinkle 1/4 cup flour on counter. Gradually stir in remaining flour. Remove dough from bowl and knead in last of flour. Knead until smooth. Divide dough in half roll into circles and put on 2 pizza pans. Pierce with fork. Let rise 10 to 15 minutes. Bake crust 15 minutes. Then top with your choice of green peppers low-fat ham ground turkey breast low-fat pizza sauce no-fat Mozzarella cheese and sliced tomatoes. Bake 10 minutes. After prebaking crust you can cover with foil and freeze for later. Thaw while the oven preheats and then add your toppings. Bake at 400\u00b0. Contains 5 grams of fat in the whole pizza.

title: Mini Cheese Balls
instructions: Freeze the dried apricots and apples for 1 to 2 hours and you will be able to chop them much more easily.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Add enough flour to make stiff dough. Roll into small balls. Place on baking sheet and press down with tumbler dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Sourdough Bread Starter
instructions: Mix 3/4 cup sugar 3 tablespoons instant potatoes and 1 cup warm water; then add 1 package yeast. Put in jar with lid on. Refrigerate 3 to 5 days. Take out and feed the following 3/4 cup sugar 3 tablespoons instant potatoes and 1 cup warm water. Mix well; add to starter let stand out of refrigerator 8 to 12 hours. Take out 1 cup to make bread and return mixture to refrigerator. Keep in refrigerator 3 to 5 days and feed again.

title: Hershey Bar Cake
instructions: Melt bars in syrup over boiling water. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Mix soda with milk and add alternately with flour. Blend in chocolate and vanilla. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Cover with powdered sugar.

title: Real Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine flour and sugar together then add egg yolks milk and vanilla. Stir slowly over low heat preferably in double boiler until it strikes a boil. Let cook about 2 minutes. Remove from heat; add bananas and wafers. Let cool.

title: Coffee Chicken
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken breasts. Brown in butter in hot skillet. Then place in casserole dish. Mix rest of ingredients and simmer in same skillet until well blended. Pour over chicken. Bake covered for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Cream butter and eggs first then add cake mix. Spread out in cake pan. Put a layer of chopped nuts over mixture.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Put 1/3 of bread cubes in bottom of pan then chicken mixture then rest of cubes. Pour a mixture of 2 beaten eggs and 1 1/2 cups of milk over chicken and bread. Refrigerate 4 hours or more.

title: Fruit Swirl Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all ingredients. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Place 2/3 of the batter in pan spreading evenly. Add 1 can cherry apricot or blueberry pie filling spreading over the batter. Drop remaining batter by tablespoonfuls onto pie filling. Bake until light brown 20 to 25 minutes. Drizzle with glaze while warm (1 cup powdered sugar and 1 to 2 tablespoons milk).

title: Creamed Chicken With Vegetables
instructions: In skillet cook onion in butter until tender. Stir in soup and milk. Add chicken. Cook until tender. Stir in vegetables and potatoes. Heat through.

title: 16-Bean Soup
instructions: Quick Soak Method Sort and rinse beans into large pot. Cover beans with 3 cups hot water. Bring to boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat; cover and let stand for 1 hour. If you wish you can microwave beans in a covered 2 1/2 to 3-quart pan for 10 minutes.

title: No-Fat Banana Bread
instructions: Mix bananas and egg whites in a large bowl. Stir in flour sugar and baking soda. Add the apple and put into a greased (Pam sprayed) loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan to rack; let cool.

title: Quick Fat Free Dessert
instructions: Put 1/10 of cake (1 slice) on dessert plate. Place fruit on top. Put 2 tablespoons Cool Whip on top. Drizzle 1 teaspoon chocolate syrup over top. Fat 0 grams. Calories 150 to 200 (depending on fruit.)

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Mix yeast and water in large bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients except flour. Stir. Add 5 cups flour and stir. Add rest of flour and stir real good. Seal burp and let stand until seal pops off. Grease and flour hands and divide into 3 loaves. Cover with a towel. Let stand 40 minutes. Time varies depending on how many loaves you are making. You can make bread doughnuts dinner rolls sweet rolls cinnamon rolls or tea rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a preheated oven until golden brown.

title: Huckleberry Cheesecake
instructions: Mix well crushed graham crackers sugar and butter. Pack lightly in 9 X 13 pan.

title: Light Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients. Add to dry ingredients stirring just until flour is moistened (batter will be lumpy). Bake on hot griddle. Yield 4 to 5 servings.

title: Strawberry Cream Cake
instructions: In double boiler sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften; heat over hot water until dissolved. Stir in sugar extract and berries. Refrigerate until slightly thickened. Then fold in whipped cream; refrigerate until stiff enough to spread. Use to fill and frost sponge layers. Sprinkle with coconut. Refrigerate until served. Makes 8 servings.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake in greased pans for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Breakfast Patties
instructions: On medium heat in nonstick skillet cook onion and apple in oil for 5 minutes stirring until soft. Let stand until cool. In bowl combine turkey thyme fennel allspice pepper and nutmeg. Add cooled onion and apple. Shape into patties. Heat nonstick skillet on medium heat. Cook about 3 1/2 minutes per side until browned and done.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Bake half the cake mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan; let cool. Beat pudding cream cheese and milk; spread on top of cake. Spread on crushed pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip.

title: Fishy Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Fruit 'N Yogurt Dazzler
instructions: In small saucepan combine egg yolks honey water and cornstarch; mix well. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat cook and stir 2 minutes longer. Spoon mixture into a small bowl.\tCover with plastic wrap; chill mixture without stirring for several hours.\tAt serving time fold\tegg yolk mix into yogurt blending well. In a large glass bowl or individual parfait glasses layer fruit and yogurt mixture ending with yogurt on top. Sprinkle with toasted coconut. Garnish with whole fruit if desired. Makes about 10 servings.

title: Creamy Carrot Soup
instructions: Cook onion in butter in Dutch oven over medium heat stirring constantly. Add carrots and 1 cup broth. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender. Carefully spoon into blender; process until smooth. Return to Dutch oven; add remaining broth half and half pepper and salt. Cook over low until thoroughly heated stirring constantly. With a wire whisk stir in yogurt at room temperature and dill weed. Serve hot or chilled.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour baking powder baking soda cinnamon and salt. In a large mixing bowl stir together egg whites bananas sugar and oil. Stir flour mixture into banana mixture just until moistened. Spray an 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan with nonstick spray coating. Spread batter in prepared pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool bread in the pan for 10 minute. Remove from pan and cool thoroughly on a wire rack.

title: Desperation Dinner
instructions: In a large pot brown the sliced sausage and onions. Open all the cans and add to the pot; dont drain. Cover and cook on medium to low as long as you want. It is ready in about 20 minutes but can be started in the morning and cooked all day in a low crock-pot. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheesy Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni until slightly tender; drain. Set aside. Brown ground meat and onion in small skillet. Add tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes. Oil a 1-quart casserole dish and spoon in 1/3 of meat mixture. Add cooked macaroni then remainder of meat mixture. Spread cheese soup over all. (May be frozen unbaked.) Cover tightly and bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly. Serves 4.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Simmer onion and butter. Mix ingredients with sauce. Cook slowly 1 1/2 hours.

title: Egg Nog
instructions: Put in blender and blend until mixed well.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in stick of margarine. Add cooked rice. Combine with remaining ingredients and turn into greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana-Walnut Scones
instructions: Preheat oven to 400.

title: Chicken And Stuffing Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions but do not let stand. Spoon stuffing across center of 2-quart shallow baking dish. Arrange 3 chicken pieces on each side of stuffing overlapping if necessary.

title: Diet Strawberry Pie
instructions: Fill cooled pie shell with sliced strawberries. Combine Jello 7 up and cornstarch in saucepan. Heat until thickened. Let cool and pour over berries. Top with De zerta Whip Topping.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Saute onion and butter. Mix broccoli cornbread mix eggs and cottage cheese. Mix with butter and onion. Stir in baking powder. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cut in squares and serve while hot.

title: Hungarian Chicken
instructions: Put macaroni chicken and cheese in pan; pour broth over it. Mix melted oleo with bread crumbs and put on top. Brown in a 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in bananas and nuts then flour baking soda and salt. Spread in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean about 55 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool thoroughly before slicing.

title: Freeze Punch
instructions: Bring to a boil sugar and water. Remove from heat and add both packages of jello. Then stir in pineapple juice and add 2 cans of water. Freeze. Remove from freezer 4 hours before serving. Add ginger ale or 7-Up.

title: Clusters
instructions: Melt chips and pour over peanuts and noodles. Drop on waxed paper.

title: Company Vegetable Casserole
instructions: In bowl combine beans corn sour cream cheese and onion. Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish. Combine butter crumbs and almonds sprinkle over vegetables. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Saute beef until brown; drain. Drain and rinse beans. Chop tomatoes and onion; tear lettuce into bite size pieces. Combine all ingredients. Toss well. Serve at once. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Griddlecakes
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Combine the egg milk and fat. Add gradually to the dry ingredients; stir only until batter is smooth. Drop by spoonfuls onto a hot greased griddle. Cook slowly until the surface is covered with bubbles turn and cook until the bottom is well browned. Yields about 18 medium-sized griddlecakes.

title: Individual Cheese Cake
instructions: Combine softened cream cheese sugar lemon juice and vanilla. Mix until well blended. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition.

title: Layered Green Salad
instructions: Use a large glass salad bowl and layer from the bottom up the ingredients. Let stand covered in refrigerator overnight. Do not mix! Each person is supposed to serve by reaching through all layers to get a little of each.

title: Chocolate Pecan Butterballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine margarine confectioners sugar cocoa vanilla and flour. Beat until well mixed. This will be a thick mixture. Work the pecans into the cookie dough. Roll the dough into balls about 1 inch in diameter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Coat with confectioners sugar as cookies are removed from baking sheet. Place on rack to cool. Coat with confectioners sugar again after the cookies have cooled. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Lemon Cake Pudding
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and salt. Stir in 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon rind lemon juice egg yolks and milk. Fold in the beaten egg whites. Pour into 1-quart baking dish. Place dish into pan of water 1-inch deep. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool. Can then be refrigerated after it is cool.

title: Jalapeno Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add onion and all peppers. Use enough buttermilk to make to consistency of cornbread. Test batter by putting a small amount in hot grease or oil. If it does not rise well add a little more baking powder. If the hush puppies are too greasy or break apart add a little more flour.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop cranberries oranges and pecans. Drain crushed pineapple. Add all ingredients together stir. Pour into Pyrex dish and refrigerate until jelled.

title: Chicken Crunch Ole
instructions: Mix soup water and hot pepper sauce. Dust chicken with flour; dip in 1/2 cup soup mixture. Roll in chips. Place on rack in shallow baking pan. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Heat remaining sauce; serve with chicken. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Baked Steak
instructions: Dont salt meat. Put meat in a deep baking dish and cover with a mixture of canned soups. Sprinkle dry onion soup on top. Wrap the baking dish completely in foil. Bake 3 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: German Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and set aside for 2 hours. Bring to a boil the remaining ingredients. Pour over the cabbage mixture and mix well. Let stand several hours or overnight.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage until done drain. Melt 1 stick of butter and add a little flour as though making gravy. Cook just until flour and butter is well blended. Stir in enough milk to make a thin sauce. Bring to a boil and add cheese. Stir until cheese is melted. Use a baking dish and layer 1/2 of cabbage then 1/2 sauce. Repeat layers. Melt stick of butter and stir in cracker crumbs. Sprinkle on top of casserole and bake until crackers are brown.

title: Broccoli Soup 1
instructions: Cook frozen broccoli in water until tender. Add soups. Mix together and warm until desired temperature.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and milk in large heavy saucepan. Slowly bring to a boil and boil for 8 minutes. Remove from heat; add butter chocolate chips and marshmallows. Mix until chips and marshmallows are melted. Add vanilla and nuts; blend. Spread in large ungreased pan and let cool. Cut into bite size pieces.

title: Caramelized Pineapple(Servings:  8)
instructions: Cut pineapple in half. With a sharp grapefruit knife cut pulp from shell without damaging the shell. Cut pineapple pulp into 1-inch cubes. In a skillet over medium heat toss cubes with brown sugar until caramelized. Serve in hollowed out pineapple shell.

title: Brunswick Stew(Serve With Barbecue Or Seafood)
instructions: Place meat in large heavy pot. Season with salt and pepper. Add onions and cover with water. Cook until meat falls from bones (several hours). Remove from heat and allow to cool. Tear meat into shreds and return to stock.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop up cranberries; place in colander and place in bowl. Pour sugar over cranberries; let drain overnight. (Discard juice in bowl.)

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Arrange in two layers in a greased baking dish the corn mixed with the eggs salt and onion. Cover with cracker crumbs. Dot with butter. Pour over with milk. Bake in moderate oven at 325\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour. Serves 4.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Make lemonade according to directions. Mix all ingredients together and serve.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Delight Pie
instructions: Heat all but 3 squares of the chocolate with 1/4 cup milk in large microwavable bowl at High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Stir until completely melted.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine margarine sugar milk in a 2 1/2 qt. saucepan. Bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat; stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate pieces until melted. Add marshmallow cream nuts and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Pour into greased 9x13 inch pan. Cool at room temperature.

title: Crab Melt-A-Ways
instructions: Split and cut muffins in quarters. Mix ingredients and add 1/2 pound crabmeat. Spread on muffin quarters and freeze single on cookie sheet for at least 1/2 hour. Put in freezer bags and freeze until ready to use. Broil until bubbly and golden brown about 10 to 15 minutes. Makes approximately 48.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cover onions and cook in butter in a 3-quart saucepan over low heat until tender about 20 to 30 minutes. Add water pepper thyme bay leaf and broth. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Set oven control to broil. Place 1 slice toasted bread in each of 4 ovenproof bowls. Pour in onions and broth; top with Swiss cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place bowls on cookie sheet. Broil with tops of bowls about 5 inches from heat just until the cheese is melted and golden brown.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix and let stand for 30 minutes. Make balls and fry in deep fat.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In baking dish place green beans. Top with soup and milk. Top with the French fried onions. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Mert'S Summer Fish
instructions: The trick to this recipe is speed. Pour powdered Italian dressing and flour into a bag. Shake well. Add fish and shake well. Place fish in hot corn oil. Fry approximately 5 minutes on medium-high heat or until golden brown.

title: Chinese Chicken
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Add remaining ingredients to rice. Toss gently. Bake in buttered casserole in 350\u00b0 oven 30 to 35 minutes. This can be prepare a day ahead and refrigerated and baked before serving.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Grease 12-cup muffin tin. Mix cereal and milk; let stand 5 minutes. Beat in oil and egg. Add rest of ingredients and stir until moist. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Upside-Down Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In large bowl mix first 7 ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pumpkin mixture. Drizzle melted butter over the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream. Freezes well.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Beat 10 minutes egg sugar oil juice and vanilla. Sift in dry ingredients. Fold in nuts. Coat apples with sugar and cinnamon. Fold into batter. Bake in Bundt or tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cornstarch Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter powdered sugar and vanilla. Mix in flour and cornstarch. Form into 1 inch balls place on baking sheet and flatten slightly.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl and place in a 13 x 9 Pyrex pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 in oven for 1 hour.

title: Alabama Chicken
instructions: Crumble 2 packages of crackers into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dot with 1/4 cup margarine. Remove chicken from the bones and cut into bite size pieces spread over crackers. Spread mushrooms and water chestnuts over the chicken. Mix together the soups and sour cream spread over top. Crumble remaining crackers and put on top of creamed soup mix. Dot with remaining margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until good and hot.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 1 pie. Top with Cool Whip if desired.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together and form crust in the bottom of 2-quart baking pan. Bake 8 minutes at 350\u00b0. Blend together eggs 4x sugar melted margarine and vanilla. Spread over cooled crust. Slice bananas overfilling spread crushed pineapple over bananas. Cover with Cool Whip. Garnish with nuts and cherries.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Work first four ingredients together. Roll into small balls. Put the last two ingredients in a double boiler and melt. Dip balls in chocolate mixture and cool on wax paper. Keep chocolate mixture on a low fire during the dipping.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs then add rest of mixture together. Mix well spoon out and bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine together. Put a layer of graham cracker crumbs in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix Dream Whip cold milk and whip. Add sugar and cream cheese in the Dream Whip. Put layer of cream cheese mix on crust put pie filling on cream cheese and add rest of the cream cheese and sprinkle the rest of the graham cracker crumbs on top.

title: Butterscotch Rolls(Serves 8)
instructions: Place frozen rolls in greased Bundt pan. Mix butterscotch pudding and brown sugar; sprinkle over frozen rolls. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over the last mixture. Place chopped pecans on top. Pour melted butter over pecans. Let set overnight or at least 8 hours then bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lynne'S Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and grease 2 (5 x 9-inch) loaf pans. Mix together sugar shortening eggs and water. In another bowl mix together sifted flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Add to first mixture. Mash ripe bananas and add into mixture. Add chopped walnuts (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add onions and mix. Add egg and milk. Stir. Drop from teaspoon into hot oil. Cook until golden brown.

title: Date Nut Crackers
instructions: Combine dates milk and pecans in saucepan. Cook slowly over medium to high heat stirring constantly. Cook until mixture reaches the consistency of peanut butter. Spread mixture on Ritz crackers. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 4 to 5 minutes. Cool completely. Top with frosting.

title: Chicken-Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook wild rice and pecan rice (separately) according to package directions; set aside. Melt butter in heavy saucepan; saute onion and celery in butter until tender. Stir in flour; cook over low heat for 1 minute stirring constantly. Add mushrooms broth and half and half. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in rices chicken pimiento parsley and seasoning. Pour mixture into a greased 2-quart casserole; top with almonds and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and brown. Yield About 8 servings.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Wash and boil beets until tender. Peel beets while warm or you may use canned beets. Cut into slices. Mix cornstarch salt sugar and pepper in a 2-quart saucepan. Gradually stir in water and vinegar. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Boil and stir for 1 minute. Add beets. Heat and serve. Makes 4 servings. With fresh beets this recipe cans well. Be careful to measure and increase ingredients accordingly.

title: Myrtle'S Shrimp Gumbo
instructions: Combine oil onions celery garlic paprika and okra in heavy pot. Cook slowly until limp. Add next gumbo file to heat a minute or two to impart flavor and prevent \ropiness\. Add to pot cover and let simmer 15 minutes or longer. Can tomatoes chicken stock (may use cubes) salt and red and black pepper. Add shrimp to cook no longer than 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Feed (Dog Food)
instructions: Melt chips butter and peanut butter together. Remove from heat; add vanilla then coat Chex. Put powdered sugar in grocery sack; shake and add coated Chex. Shake again. Store in large plastic bag. Makes 9 cups. Can be served in a clean dog dish.

title: Chocolate Cheese Pie
instructions: Microwave chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the milk in large microwavable bowl on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes stirring halfway through heating time. (The chocolate will retain some of its original shape.) Remove from the oven. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Beat in cream cheese sugar and remaining milk with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended. Refrigerate about 10 minutes to cool. Gently stir in whipped topping until smooth. Spoon onto crust. Freeze 4 hours or until firm. Garnish with chocolate curls if desired. Let stand at room temperature or until pie can be easily cut. Store leftover pie in freezer. Makes 8 servings.

title: Date Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Add dates sugar eggs and salt. Cook about ten minutes stirring constantly until bubbly. Remove from heat; add cereal nuts and vanilla. With tablespoon form into ball and roll in flaked coconut. Refrigerate.

title: Saucepan Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate over low heat in a medium saucepan. Add remaining ingredients in the order listed stirring after each addition. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch square pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight container. For 1 serving combine 1/3 cup cocoa mixture and 3/4 cup boiling water. Makes 45 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Old Fashioned Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Stir first 4 ingredients; set aside. In large bowl beat margarine and peanut butter until smooth. Beat in sugars until well blended. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture and beat until well blended. Chill if necessary. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Flatten with fork. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes (light brown). Remove warm. Cool on rack.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
instructions: Line the bottoms and sides of a 8 inch cake pan or 1 1/2 quart baking dish with wafers. Combine pudding mix milk and butter in a sauce pan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full rolling boil. Remove from heat.

title: Out Of This World Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour into a greased sheet cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Crab Puffs
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Spread on English muffins. Freeze for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into quarters. Wait 15 minutes; defrost. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Beef Minestrone
instructions: Cook meat in Dutch oven; cook onion until tender. Add water and other ingredients except Parmesan. Bring to boil then reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Discard bay leaf. Sprinkle Parmesan over each serving. Serves 10.

title: Mom'S Apricot Crisp
instructions: Pour apricots (juice and all) in an oblong Pyrex dish. Sweeten to taste. Sprinkle with tapioca. Dot with butter and let set 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Pudding *
instructions: Cook and mash carrots; add all the other ingredients. Put in greased 8 or 9-inch square baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be doubled.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Set aside 12 thin slices Mozzarella cheese and half of meat mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef and egg; form into cocktail size balls. Brown in skillet. Add meatballs to sauce and heat thoroughly. Cook in crock-pot. The longer in the sauce the better they taste. Serve with toothpicks or in a bed of rice.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together and then put a layer of dough and nut mixture in a tube pan. Place the remaining half of the batter in pan and sprinkle with the remaining half of cinnamon and nut mixture. Bake in tube pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Monte Carlo Sandwiches
instructions: On each of 4 bread slices place 1 slice each of ham turkey and cheese. Cover with remaining slices of bread. In a shallow bowl beat eggs milk and salt and mix well. Dip each sandwich carefully into egg mixture turning to dip each side. Fry in oiled pan or grill on medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side or until golden brown and meat is hot and cheese is melted.

title: Garlic-Butter Vegetables
instructions: On a large microwave-safe platter arrange broccoli and cauliflower around outer edge. Sprinkle with water. Cover with microwave-safe clear plastic wrap; vent by leaving a small area unsealed at the edge. Micro-cook on 100% power (High) for 2 minutes. Place zucchini mushrooms and peppers in center. Cook covered on High for 4 to 5 minutes more or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Carefully drain off liquid. Drizzle with Garlic Butter.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients and mold. Pour cocktail sauce over before serving.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken
instructions: Cut vegetables and chicken in bite sizes. In a large frypan heat oil and cook chicken and onions. Add mushrooms. Cover and simmer in juices.
