Steam carrots and broccoli in microwave until done about 3 1/2 minutes. Vegetables should be slightly crisp. Add to chicken and add gourmet sauce. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Cook rice as instructed. Serve chicken over rice.

title: Salmon And Corn Chowder
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the potatoes onion celery chicken broth garlic salt and marjoram. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in cream and milk with butter (I substitute milk for cream). Combine flour and corn and stir in soup. Heat but do not boil just until thickened. Gently stir in salmon and heat through. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Easy And Thick Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pepper. Heat. When warm stir in pepper. You can vary this according to how hot you like sauce.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas and mix with all the other ingredients. Pour in baking pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Carrot-Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients; place in casserole dish. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix together and bake until done.

title: Vegetarian-Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: In medium bowl with electric mixer on high speed beat cream cheese garlic and pepper until well blended. Stir in green onions radishes and olives. Spoon into serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight to allow time for flavors to blend. Yields about 2 cups.

title: Macaroni Paprikash
instructions: Cook elbow according to directions; drain and return to pot. Saute onion in butter in large skillet and push aside. Shape ground beef into a large patty in the same pan. Brown 5 minutes on both sides and then break up into chunks. Blend in flour paprika salt bouillon cube milk mushrooms liquid from mushrooms and water. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils for 1 minute. Blend about 1/2 cup of the hot mixture into the sour cream then stir back into pan. Stir into cooked macaroni; add parsley. Put into greased casserole sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pink Salad
instructions: Put Jell-O in bowl. Add pineapple whip cream and marshmallows. Stir well. Mix all ingredients together well.

title: Snappy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan combine catsup water vinegar sugar Worcestershire sauce salt celery seed and bottled hot pepper sauce. Bring the catsup mixture to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Mix well and add chicken strips. Marinate at least 1 hour. Heat nonstick skillet and cook chicken until no longer pink. Remove from pan and set aside. Add onion and bell pepper strips to pan. Cook covered until tender. Squeeze lime juice into pan. Serve on hot corn or flour shells.

title: Pickledilly Chowder
instructions: Mix tomatoes onions and salt; let stand overnight. Drain and add vinegar and water and cook 20 minutes. Drain and add 1 quart vinegar sugar peppers cinnamon cloves ginger and mustard seed. Cook 1/2 hour. Can in pint jars or smaller. Makes about 5 to 6 pints.

title: Hot Light Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside.

title: Kapusta
instructions: Saut onion in oleo. Mix cabbage sauerkraut bay leaf and sauted onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Add 1-inch of water. Continue baking until cabbage is done (approximately 1/2 hour).

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Mix soups and rice; set aside. Grease casserole. Place chicken in it. Pour soup mixture over chicken. Cover tightly with foil and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 2 hours. Do not peek. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Sweet Sour Beans
instructions: Fry bacon crisp. Crumble and set aside. Into the skillet with bacon drippings place the vinegar and sugar. Add drained beans. Simmer 25 minutes turning occasionally. When ready to serve top with bacon. These reheat well. Serves 4.

title: Tomato Relish
instructions: Place tomatoes and liquid into small bowl; cut tomatoes into very small pieces. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a pint jar; cover tightly. Store in refrigerator several hours before using. Serve with hot or cold meats beans or dried peas.

title: Oatmeal Apple Butter Bars
instructions: Cut margarine into flour and sugar until crumbly. Stir in oatmeal. Press 1/2 of mixture firmly into greased 8-inch pan. Spread apple butter within 1/2 inch of edge. Sprinkle remaining oatmeal mixture over apple butter. Press carefully but firmly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent roll dough out on a pizza sheet and bake. Mix Ranch dressing cream cheese and mayonnaise. Spread on top of crust when cooled. Put on vegetables and sprinkle on the cheese.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onions and bell pepper in butter; cook spaghetti noodles (drain). Debone chicken. Mix chicken onions and bell pepper with Worcestershire sauce then Velveeta cheese and tomatoes in large pot. Keep heat on medium until cheese melts.

title: Marshmallows
instructions: Put gelatine and cold water in large crockery bowl; let stand. Cook sugar hot water and cream of tartar until it threads well. When it threads hard ball stage add to gelatine and beat constantly for about 15 minutes on medium speed with electric mixer. Add vanilla and coloring; mix. Line pan with buttered waxed paper and sprinkle heavy with powdered sugar. Pour the marshmallow mixture into it and sprinkle top with more powdered sugar. It may be cut with a knife or scissors when cool. Cut off in strips and then cut the strips into pieces. Dip each piece in powdered sugar and the pieces wont stick together. Note I use a 9 X 13 pan.

title: Bubble Loaf Or Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix 3/4 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon in plastic bag. Shake bits thoroughly until covered well. Pour into ungreased Bundt pan. Pour melted margarine sugar cinnamon and chopped nuts over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Put on plate immediately.

title: Pig Roasted In Pit
instructions: You will also need a shovel wood rocks a potato bag gunny sacks kerosene matches and chicken wire.

title: Chicken Creole
instructions: Broil fryer 10 minutes on each side after sprinkling salt and paprika on it. In electric skillet combine tomatoes and all other ingredients together. Bring to a boil; add chicken pieces. Cover and simmer 40 minutes over low heat. Serve with rice or noodles and a salad.

title: Dried Lima Beans And Bacon
instructions: Cover beans with water; bring to a boil and simmer over a medium fire for 1 hour. Add crisp crumbled bacon salt pepper and onion. Cover and cook until beans are tender not mushy. Serve hot. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Butter Mints
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add oil of peppermint. Add milk to make a dough-like consistency. Add color if desired. Mold in rubber candy molds. Allow to dry at least 24 hours before packing in tins.

title: Chocolate Orange Tea Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix butter cream cheese sugar egg orange rind and vanilla. Sift flour and salt together and stir in. Stir in chocolate pieces mixing thoroughly. Drop teaspoonfuls about 1-inch apart onto lightly greased baking sheet. Bake about 15 minutes until cookies are delicately browned at edges. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Chocolate Chip Blondies
instructions: Spray a 9 x 12-inch dish with nonstick spray (or grease with butter). Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour baking soda and salt. In separate bowl mix egg vanilla margarine vegetable oil white sugar and brown sugar. Add flour mixture to this bowl; stir thoroughly. Finally stir in chocolate chips. Turn into greased dish spreading cookie dough evenly with a spatula. Bake for 18 to 25 minutes until golden.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt Milky Way bars and 1 stick margarine. Set aside. Cream sugar and 1 stick of margarine. Add eggs. To this mixture add alternately the flour with soda and buttermilk. Add melted candy and margarine mixture. Add pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes in Bundt pan.

title: Non-Greasy Cracklin Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Add buttermilk to make thinner batter. Pour into 9-inch greased skillet. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put in baking dish.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Seven Minute Frosting
instructions: In top of double boiler combine sugar cold water egg whites corn syrup and a dash of salt. Beat 30 seconds on low speed of mixer. Place over boiling water (upper pan should not touch water). Cook about 7 minutes while beating constantly on high speed of mixer or until frosting forms stiff peaks. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Beat 2 to 3 minutes or until of spreading consistency.

title: Sour Cream Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain; rinse with cold water. Mix noodles and sour cream. Add 1/2 cup cheese. Put into casserole dish. Sprinkle top lightly with remaining cheese. Bake about an hour at 225\u00b0.

title: Sunday Macaroni
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Put back into sauce pan. Stir in margarine milk and cheese together. Add salt pepper sugar & tomatoes. Pour into 2 qt. casserole dish. Add more shredded cheese over top if desired. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Dot Hinshaw'S Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Blend peaches eggs and sugar. Whip the 3 milks together. Freeze in freezer. You can leave the eggs out of the recipe if desired. May substitute any fresh fruit.

title: Country Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder baking soda and sugar in a bowl. Cut in butter with a fork until crumbly. Add buttermilk and mix quickly to make a soft dough. Place on a lightly floured surface. Knead a few times. Roll into a 6 x 6-inch square. Place on a greased cookie sheet. With a floured knife cut across dough 2 times in one directions and 3 times in the opposite direction making 12 equal portions. Do not separate! Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown (about 15 minutes). Brush with melted butter and serve hot.

title: Autumn Apple Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in eggs. Sift next 4 ingredients; add alternately with coarsely grated peeled apples to egg mixture. Stir in lemon rind and nuts. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool before slicing.

title: Sawdust Cookies
instructions: Blend margarine and sugars. Stir in eggs and vanilla. Mix in oatmeal wheat germ and corn flakes. Sift flour soda and baking powder; add to mixture and mix thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by tablespoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 12 minutes. Yields 6 dozen cookies.

title: Breakfast Bake
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan put in your bread (buttered on both sides). Then in large mixing bowl add your eggs milk dry mustard and salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle grated cheese. Then pour mixture over your ham or sausage.

title: High Protein Bars
instructions: Melt butter peanut butter and carob chips over medium heat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread into a greased 5 x 7 x 2-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares. Refrigerate.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar syrup salt vanilla and butter. Line pie pan with crust. Put pecans in layer. Add mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Pink Cloud Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. Good unexpected dinner guest dessert. Fast and easy!

title: Peach Bread
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Combine the next 5 ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with peaches beginning and ending with flour. Stir in orange juice and vanilla. Bake in greased and floured loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Fudge Sundae Pie
instructions: Cook milk chocolate marshmallows and salt in 1-quart saucepan over medium heat until chocolate and marshmallows melt and mixture thickens. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Cool to room temperature. Line bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan or two 1-quart ice trays with wafers. Spoon half of ice cream and chocolate over. Top with nuts. Refrigerate 5 hours. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop drained artichokes fine. Add cheese and mayonnaise until smooth but not well blended. Dont stir too much or mayonnaise breaks down. Add garlic to taste. Cook at 300\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until top browns slightly. Serve warm with sturdy corn chips.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli onion and cauliflower. Toss well. Combine remaining ingredients mixing well. Pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serves 6.

title: Kart-Wheels
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix flour butter powdered sugar baking powder and milk until dough forms. Divide dough into 6 parts. Shape each part into a ball and place on an ungreased cookie sheet; flatten slightly. Make an indentation in the center of each ball (about 1 3/4-inches round and 3/4-inch deep). Fill indentation with about 2 tablespoons pie filling. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Yield 6 Kart-Wheels.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls into round pizza pan overlapping edges and press down to seal this forming the crust. Cook sausage scrambled and drain. Pour over crust. Sprinkle with hash browns. Mix eggs milk salt and pepper. Beat well and pour over hash browns. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and garnish with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Norwegian Meatballs
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a large bowl. Then roll into small balls. Brown meatballs in deep skillet until done. Then make a brown gravy and cook together with meatballs. Serve over rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add chili sauce and mustard. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Casserole
instructions: Layer hamburger and vegetables. Pour soup and water over all. Bake an hour or until vegetables are done.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix all except broccoli. Grease pan and add all together. Sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers and margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Beat margarine at medium speed of electric mixer until fluffy. Gradually add sugar and beat well. Add egg whites sour cream milk and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients; stir well. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Frost with Creamy Chocolate Frosting and cut into 24 squares.

title: Pork Chops With Glazed Apples
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat. Add pork chops; sprinkle with sage. Cook 8 to 10 minutes or until no longer pink in center. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from skillet. Keep warm. Add apples sugar and cinnamon. Cook 5 minutes over low heat. Stir occasionally. Serve over chops. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Combine cream cheese and margarine mixing until well blended. Add flour; mix well. Chill. Divide dough into quarters divide each quarter into 12 balls. Press each ball into bottom and sides of miniature muffin pans. Combine eggs brown sugar and vanilla. Stir in pecans. Spoon into pastry shells filling each cup. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 15 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Herbed Pasta Alfredo
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan over medium heat. Add onions and garlic; saute 2 minutes. Add flour and stir well. Gradually add milk and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook 3 minutes or until thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in cheeses and herbs. Serve over macaroni. Garnish with extra onions if desired. Contains 244 calories and 4.3 grams fat per serving.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix well. Chill then serve on lettuce.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Place flour and salt in large bowl. Cream sugar and margarine in separate bowl then add boiling water. Melt yeast in warm water. Add cold water to bowl with sugar and margarine then quickly add yeast mixture and eggs and beat until smooth. Pour that mixture into flour mixture and mix well with wooden spoon. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to one week. To make cloverleaf dinner rolls pinch off three walnut sized pieces of dough and place in cupcake tin side by side. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until golden. Excellent quick and easy!

title: Instant Cocoa
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in airtight container.

title: Fruit Juice Medley
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve chilled.

title: Marinated Mozzarella
instructions: Place cheese in a single layer in a 10 x 15-inch jellyroll pan. In a small bowl whisk next 6 ingredients. Pour oil mixture over cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend turning slices occasionally. Arrange on a serving plate; garnish with fresh basil. Serve with bagel chips or crackers.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine sugar flour cocoa baking soda and salt in large mixing bowl. Mix well. Heat margarine and water in saucepan until boiling. Pour over dry ingredients and mix. Beat in buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Pour thin batter in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Tangy Green Beans
instructions: Combine mustard sugar butter and salt. Heat slowly stirring constantly. Stir in lemon juice and vinegar. Pour over hot cooked green beans.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together flour salt and soda. Combine oil sugar eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Fold in apples and coconut. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mock Lemon Meringue Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package. Bake in a 10-inch tube pan. Cool and cut into three layers. Stir pudding and pie filling until smooth. Spread 1/3 of filling between each layer and on top of cake. Frost the layers and sides with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: Ho - Ho Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to the package and put in greased and floured jelly roll pan (10 x 15-inch) and bake; cool.

title: Corn Spoon Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Swiss cheese. Spread in an 11 x 7 x 1\t3/4-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle Swiss cheese on top. Bake an additional 5 to 10 minutes or until\tknife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 8 servings.

title: Taco Chili Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Heat chili stirring occasionally until hot. Mix Bisquick and milk until dough forms; beat 30 seconds. Spread half the dough in ungreased square baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Top with chili; sprinkle with 3/4 cup cheese. Drop remaining dough by 6 spoonfuls onto top; sprinkle with paprika. Bake until light brown about 25 minutes. Top with lettuce tomato and cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine shortening and sugar until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk. Baked in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan for 1 hour 25 minutes to 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cordial Drops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cookie mix egg and water in large bowl. Stir until blended. Stir in cherries and coconut. Shape dough into 36 balls. Roll in pecans. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are lightly brown. Cool 1 minute then remove to cooling rack.

title: Spaghetti Bolognaise
instructions: Brown the ground beef drain away fat and set to one side. In a large pan heat the oil and add the onion and garlic cook until soft but not brown. Add the beef to the pan and stir to heat through. Chop the tomatoes well add with the puree. Add the Italian seasoning salt pepper and gravy mix Bring to a boil then reduce and simmer for about 1 hour. If necessary thicken with corn starch which has been added to a little water. Boil the spaghetti for about 7 minutes do not over cook. Drain and rinse with boiling water. Serve sauce over the spaghetti sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Pumpkin-Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine next seven ingredients add to creamed mixture alternately with pumpkin beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in vanilla raisins and pecans. Spoon into greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until wooden pick tests clean. Remove from pans and cool on wire rack.

title: Mango Sherbet
instructions: Combine puree 1/2 cup sugar lemon juice and 1/2 cup water. Stir until sugar dissolves. Pour into a container and freeze to a mushy consistency.

title: Hamburger Barbecue Filling
instructions: Get out Mothers heaviest frying pan and put all ingredients except rolls in it. Cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes stirring frequently. Fill the rolls with mixture. Serve hot.

title: Drain Maintenance
instructions: Mix in quart jar. Shake well. Pour 1/4 cup of th dry mix in drain followed immediately with 1 cup boiling water. When the bubbling in the drain pipe stops flush thoroughly with cold water.

title: Mountain Cornbread
instructions: Beat eggs in a separate bowl. Add sugar; beat well. Add cornmeal milk and flour. Add melted butter baking powder and salt. Pour into a greased iron skillet. Bake at 450\u00b0 until golden brown and done. Cut into large slices. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Tremendous
instructions: In a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan spread contents of onion soup mix. Add layer of uncooked rice. Mix can of soup with water. Pour 1/2 over rice and soup mix. Place chicken pieces on top. Pour remaining water and soup mixture over chicken. Season with salt and pepper. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered. Add extra water if needed.

title: Beef And Rice Skillet
instructions: Brown in oleo bacon fat or oil steak and onion. Add rice and remaining ingredients. Simmer about 1 hour until meat and rice are tender.

title: Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix sour cream and eggs with mixer until blended. Add cherry pie filling and mix by hand until blended. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Apple Harvest Cake
instructions: Generously grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt cake pan; set aside. In a large mixing bowl combine the flours granulated sugar brown sugar cinnamon baking powder salt and baking soda. Add oil vanilla and eggs; beat until well mixed. Stir in chopped apples and nuts. Spoon batter evenly into prepared pan.

title: French Apricot Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: Combine cake mix margarine and egg with fork until crumbly. Reserve 1 1/2 cups. Press remaining in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Spread apricot jam over crust. In small bowl combine cream cheese sugar vanilla and egg. Beat until smooth. Spread over jam. Sprinkle reserved topping over cream cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 28 to 30 minutes. Chill before serving. Store in refrigerator.

title: Zucchini Rounds
instructions: In mixing bowl stir together the flour cheese salt and pepper. Stir in the beaten eggs until\tthe mixture is moistened.\tFold in zucchini. Pour oil in skillet 1/8-inch and heat. Drop slightly rounded tablespoonfuls of the batter into oil. Cook turning once for about 1 minute on each side or until golden brown.

title: Light And Easy Lemon Broccoli Chicken
instructions: In skillet in hot oil cook chicken for 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat. Combine soup and milk; stir in lemon juice and pepper. Pour over chicken. Top each chicken piece with lemon slice. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender stirring occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Gooey Pecan Bars
instructions: Combine cake mix 1 egg and 1/2 cup butter. Press into bottom of a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Set aside. Combine 2 eggs cream cheese powdered sugar and remaining 1/2 cup butter; beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in pecans; pour over cake mix layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until set covering loosely with aluminum foil after 45 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello powder into cottage cheese. Fold in mandarin oranges and crushed pineapple.

title: Seasoned Salt
instructions: *BLKLIN plate; heat for 30 to 45 seconds. Let stand for 1 minute to recrisp. Recrisp dry cereal the same way.

title: Bee'S Bingo Cherry Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the gelatin and hot water. Add the pineapple and cherry pie filling. Pour into an 8 x 10-inch pan; chill until set. Soften the cream cheese; mix well with the sugar. Blend in the sour cream and vanilla. Spread over the gelatin mixture. Sprinkle with nuts. Serves 6.

title: Soap Crayons
instructions: Grease plastic ice cube tray or popsicle molds with Pam or shortening. Mix ingredients together in bowl. Pour into trays or molds. Allow time to harden. Pop out.

title: Blueberry Pudding Pie
instructions: Mix pudding and milk. Cook until thickened. Spread over crust. Cook blueberries sugar and flour until thickened. Cool and spread over pudding. Cover with whipping cream and vanilla. Chill and serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix altogether except 1/2 cup nuts and chill. Shape into a ball and roll in remaining nuts.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice in water to cover until tender; drain. Cook broccoli until tender; drain. Mix rice and broccoli. Add jar of Cheez Whiz. Saute onion and celery in butter. Add to rice mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add mushroom soup. Pour into buttered large casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: No Bake Chocolate Bars
instructions: Combine crumbs and sugar in a large bowl. Melt chocolate and evaporated milk over low heat stirring constantly. Blend well. Add vanilla and set aside 1/2 cup chocolate mixture. Stir in crumbs mixture and spread into a well-buttered 9-inch square pan. Spread rest of chocolate over top. Chill and cut into bars.

title: Teenager'S Delight
instructions: Spread\tcooked\tand drained ground beef over bottom of casserole dish. Mix soups and milk and pour over beef layer. Cover with the Tater Tots. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle some grated Cheddar cheese over top for the last 15 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Peel apples and cut into chunks. Mix apples sugar and cinnamon in a bowl; set aside. Mix remaining ingredients in a large bowl with electric mixer. In greased cake pan layer the batter apples batter apples etc. Always start and end with batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Top with sifted powdered sugar when cool.

title: Southern Pecan Pie(9-Inch Pie)
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar corn syrup butter vanilla and pecan pieces. Pour filling into prepared pie shell. Arrange the pecan halves around the inside edge. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake for 40 minutes longer or until the center is firm. Cool to room temperature before cutting.

title: Orange Delight
instructions: Mix dry jello with sour cream and mix with Cool Whip pineapple and mandarin oranges. Chill. Can be used for dessert or for a salad.

title: Pork Chop Supreme
instructions: Pare and slice the potatoes. Put in a casserole dish. Lightly salt and pepper the potatoes. In a mixing bowl mix Lipton onion soup mix with milk. Fry pork chops in 1/4 cup oil on both sides until browned. Drain chops on paper towel and arrange them on top of potatoes. Pour soup mixture on top of pork chops. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Old Fashioned Tomato Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan bring tomatoes to a boil add baking soda garlic salt pepper and salt. Reduce heat add the milk and butter. Heat through but do not boil. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Pour this over bacon stuff. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Cut and serve. (You can use ham instead of bacon.) Serves 6.

title: 7 Layer Mexican Dip
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer dip bottom layer refried beans next layer sour cream then salsa then guacamole then jalapenos then cheese and last black olives. Chill and eat!

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix thoroughly and shape into a ball. Roll in paprika and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Torte
instructions: Cream oleo; add flour and nuts. Spread in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown (very light); cool.

title: Beef Teriyaki And Rice
instructions: Mix soy sauce brown sugar and seasonings. Add beef; let stand 10 minutes to marinate. Stir-fry beef in hot oil in skillet until browned. Add vegetables; stir-fry until tender-crisp. Mix broth and cornstarch; add to skillet. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Prepare 4 servings of Minute rice as directed on package. Serve beef mixture over rice. Serves 4.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Blend soup milk and dash of pepper. Arrange layers of potatoes onions and soup mix in 2-quart casserole. Dot top with margarine and sprinkle of paprika. Cover. Bake 1 hour in 375\u00b0 oven. Uncover and bake 15 more minutes or until done. Enjoy.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix corn meal flour baking powder sugar & salt. Add egg and cream. Mix well. Pour into greased pan - bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Papa'S Southern Style Sweet Kornbread
instructions: Beat eggs well. Pour cornmeal and sugar into mixing bowl. Blend together. Add beaten eggs; blend with cornmeal and sugar. Add buttermilk to desired thickness.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together ground beef onion eggs salt bread crumbs pepper seasoning and 1 cup of sauce. Divide this mixture in half. Press half in a 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle on the cheese and mushrooms. Top with remaining meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Near the end of baking time spread the rest of the sauce on meat loaf.

title: Peanut Butter Pudding Cake
instructions: Layer 1 In small bowl thoroughly mix 2/3 cup peanuts flour and softened butter. Press into bottom of an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool thoroughly.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: You can add garlic or a little Worcestershire sauce or any other juice or dry onion soup if you like.

title: Nacho Pasta Skillet
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring mixture to a boil. Cover and simmer 4 to 5 minutes or until vegetable are tender.

title: Green Pea Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: 5 Minute Meal
instructions: This meal takes only 5 minutes to prepare! Pour all vegetables in a large pan. Cut smoked sausage into bite size pieces and cook on medium until potatoes are soft.

title: Spuds
instructions: Mix soups sour cream onion cheese butter salt and pepper together well. Put into a long baking dish and cook for 45 minutes on 350\u00b0 or 20 minutes in microwave. Take out of oven and sprinkle cornflakes on top and return to oven for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Melt butter or oleo in pan. Add sugar milk and cocoa and bring to a roiling boil. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until peanut butter is melted. Add oats. Mix well and quick. Drop on to wax paper and let cool. Will harden as cookies cool.

title: Green Beans With Mustard
instructions: Steam green beans. Mix Dijon mustard salt and pepper and lemon. Whisk in olive oil and toss with the green beans. Serve hot.

title: Tahitian Chicken
instructions: Cut green pepper into chunks; slice mango or papaya. Saute chicken in butter or substitute until well browned. Remove excess fat from pan. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Combine syrup soy sauce water and garlic and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with ginger and salt. Cover. Simmer 30 minutes. Remove chicken to heated platter. Add pineapple green pepper green onion mango or papaya and cherry tomatoes to pan juices. Stir cornstarch in 2 tablespoons water; add to pan stirring gently until mixture boils and thickens. If mixture is not thick enough stir in 1 additional tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water. Spoon over chicken. Serves 6.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Make sure you have enough ice. Next chop mushrooms. Fry bacon and chop into small bits. Make second drink and call off work for tomorrow while you can still talk (great idea). Take Larrys Blend and fold in mushrooms and bacon (easy). Turn on VH-1. Turn up volume. Get buns and cheese ready. Put burgers on grill. Keep an eye on them and flip when juice comes through. Turn up VH-1 and hope no one is home next door. Better make a pitt stop next! Be sure to refresh you drink (if you can find the vodka). When juice runs clear (burgers not vodka) they are done. Place on buns with cheese. Eat drink and pass out!!! Then you start over tomorrow. Next cookbook will contain recipe for \The Perfect Porterhouse.\

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Add all ingredients to a large mixing bowl. Mix very well and put in airtight container. Add dressing to cole slaw potato salad or macaroni salad. Remaining dressing keeps well in refrigerator in airtight container.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt margarine in rectangular pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches in oven. Mix Bisquick paprika salt and pepper; coat chicken. Place skin side down in pan. Bake 35 minutes. Turn; bake about 15 minutes or until done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Punch
instructions: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water; add juice of 2 lemons pineapple juice and ginger ale.

title: Beef Barley Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add next 4 ingredients. Season to taste with salt pepper and parsley. Bring to a boil then add remaining ingredients. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. If too thick add bouillon or plain water.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and Crisco. Add egg yolks one at a time beating well after each addition. Add extract. Sift dry ingredients and add to first mixture alternately with milk beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold carefully into batter. Bake in 10-inch tube. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Complete Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Trim crust from bread. Place in casserole. Top with layers of cheese and ham. Mix eggs milk salt and mustard in blender. Pour mixture over cheese ham and bread. Refrigerate overnight. Take out 2 hours before baking. Top with cornflakes and melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: English Toffee Bars
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten egg flour salt and vanilla. Spread 1/4-inch thick in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Press down with a spoon or fingers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Melt the chocolate chips and spread over bars while still hot. Sprinkle with finely chopped walnuts.

title: Italian Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes; when done dice and chill. Place all ingredients in a bowl and carefully blend in Italian dressing and oregano.

title: French Poufs
instructions: Combine shortening 1/2 cup sugar and egg in bowl mixing well. Sift next 4 ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk beating well after each addition. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Dip immediately in melted butter and then in mixture of 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon.

title: All-Purpose Cake
instructions: Beat 3 eggs with 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon salt. Add 1 1/2 cups sugar. Beat in 1/2 cup water 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder and 1 1/2 cups flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Bring sauce to boil over low heat. Mix well. Pour over 6 large (1 to 1 1/2-inch thick) pork chops and marinate overnight in refrigerator. Bake uncovered at 300\u00b0 until meat is tender.

title: Creamy Scalloped Potatoes With Ham
instructions: Pare and thinly slice potatoes. Toss slices in 1 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar. Drain. In crock-pot put in a slice of ham. Arrange a layer of potatoes onion rings salt pepper flour and cheese. Add next layer same as the first until gone. Sprinkle with remaining flour. Add butter and undiluted soup. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 9 hours. Add somemore cheese if you like about 30 minutes before serving. Cheez Whiz is also a good cheese to use with this.

title: Double Treat Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda and salt. Set aside. Beat together margarine sugars eggs and vanilla until fluffy. Blend in peanut butter. Add dry ingredients. Stir in chocolate chips. Shape into balls using 1 tablespoon of dough. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Pour into 9-inch graham cracker pie shell. Refrigerate overnight. If preferred pie may be baked at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Top with whipped cream or meringue.

title: Surprise Spread
instructions: Mix together cream cheese sour cream and mayonnaise and spread over a 12-inch platter. Next layer with cocktail sauce and sprinkle seafood over the top. Layer the cheese green onion and tomatoes over the shrimp. Cover and chill.

title: Round Steak Potato Scallop
instructions: Shake flour and round steak in plastic bag until coated. Brown in 3 tablespoons shortening. Add onions; cook until tender. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons flour salt pepper thyme and garlic powder. Pour water over. Cover. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 until tender. Slice potatoes and layer over meat. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered 30 minutes at 450\u00b0 or until potatoes are tender.

title: Georgia Barbecue
instructions: Cook meat until tender. Combine all ingredients and simmer for 1 hour. Beef or pork may be used but this is an excellent way to use venison.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Pop the popcorn first. In a 2-quart pan combine brown sugar corn syrup margarine and salt. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Stir in soda and vanilla. Pour over popped corn stirring constantly. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes or immediately form into balls. Store in airtight container as soon as cool.

title: Spiced Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening. Gradually add sugar. Add egg and molasses; mix well. Combine flour and dry ingredients. Shape into balls; roll in sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes. Tops will crack.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Shake first 3 ingredients in a plastic bag. Drop into greased Bundt pan. Melt and pour over remaining 3 ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool a few minutes. Pull apart with fingers and eat.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Combine sauce sausage and half the pepperoni. Heat in microwave until bubbly. Add pasta and heat again. Top with cheese and pepperoni and heat until cheese is melted. Sprinkle with extra cheese and serve.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Spoon rice into greased casserole. Cover rice with broccoli. Mix in a bowl 2 tablespoons of butter and bread crumbs. In frying pan cook onions in remaining butter until soft. Stir in flour salt pepper and milk. Cook until thickened. Add ham. Heat one minute. Pour over broccoli casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Tacos
instructions: Combine ground beef and green pepper in 1 1/2-quart glass casserole; cover. Microwave at cook stage for 6 minutes stirring once. Stir in tomato paste and seasonings; cover. Microwave for 6 to 9 minutes or until mixture bubbles stirring once. Let stand 5 minutes. Divide mixture between taco shells. Over meat top with cheese then tomato onion and lettuce.

title: Summer Slush
instructions: Put ingredients into giant canister and fill with water to make 2 gallons. Freeze until slushy.

title: Old-Time Tomato And Onion Salad
instructions: Choose red ripe tomatoes; wash peel and wash onion. Slice tomatoes in half crosswise and onion paper thin. Arrange slices alternately in a large bowl or on individual salad plates. Serve with a drizzle of dressing.

title: Holiday Date Nut Squares
instructions: Simmer fruits in water 5 minutes. Stir in butter; let cool. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pork Tortilla Soup
instructions: Brown pork and onion in oil. Add remaining ingredients except tortillas and garnishes. Simmer covered 45 to 60 minutes or until pork is tender. Cut tortillas into wedges and carefully stir into soup. Serve with garnishes of grated cheese yogurt or sour cream if desired. Serves 4.

title: Hobo Packs
instructions: Make hamburger patties. Place a slice of potato onion and slice of carrot on top of hamburger patty. Wrap tightly in aluminum foil. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Great for on the grill.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients and put into loaf pan. Bake 30 minutes. Drain grease. Bake until done approximately 20 more minutes. Serve with my Easy Potatoes!

title: Triple Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Combine juice concentrate and sugar in heavy saucepan. Bring to boil stirring until sugar dissolves. Add fresh and dried berries and cook until dried berries begin to soften and fresh berries begin to pop stirring often about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in marmalade juice and peel and allspice. Cool completely. Cover; chill until cold. Can be made 3 days ahead. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into bite size pieces. De-shell Spanish peanuts and add to broccoli raisins and onion. Mix together mayonnaise sugar and wine vinegar and stir mixture into broccoli. Chill toss and enjoy!

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix all together chill and serve with a few ice cubes in each punch cup. Recipe can be\tdoubled or tripled very easily with very good results.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar eggs vanilla milk and 1/2 cup butter; beat with electric mixer until smooth. Spoon into a greased 2-quart shallow casserole. Combine brown sugar flour 1/3 cup butter and pecans; sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Tortilla Torte(Mexican)
instructions: Melt chocolate chips over low heat. Stir in 2 cups of sour cream. Cool. Lay 1 tortilla on a plate and spread with chocolate mixture. Repeat until all tortillas are used. Top last layer with sour cream mixed with 1/4 cup powdered sugar. (Can be frozen at this point.) Before serving top with whipping cream and shaved chocolate or toasted almonds. Makes 8 to 10 servings. This makes an elegant looking dessert especially as an ending to a Mexican meal. Nobody can tell that the thin pastry layers are tortillas.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: Combine ingredients and store. Mix with hot water.

title: Sausage Roll
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk all at once and mix. Divide dough into 2 parts. Roll out 1/4-inch thick; spread with sausage. Roll like a jelly roll. Repeat for second. Roll wrap and chill. Slice in 1/4-inch slices. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain and rinse with water. While beef is cooking follow directions on box for rice. After rice is done put rice beef tomato juice salt pepper and picante sauce in a large pan and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Brazillian Fried Rice
instructions: *add oil to pan using medium heat.

title: Salami Triangles
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salami; spread mixture on 4 slices of salami. Stack these. Top with unspread slice. You end up with 2 stacks of 5 slices each. Repeat. Wrap each stack in wax paper. Refrigerate. Cut each into 6 wedges. Top with pickled onion with toothpick.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Drain pineapple. Save juice to add to milk to make 1 cup. Beat eggs and sugar; add juice. Pour over bread pieces. Dribble butter over this mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven in a 2-quart casserole dish for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: In saucepan melt margarine or butter on low heat. Add flour; stir until smooth. Pour in whipping cream stirring continuously until it thickens; set aside. In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish lightly stir peas pimento and egg while adding cream mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove; top with cheese; return back to oven for 10 minutes. Prep time 30 minutes.

title: Conch Stew
instructions: Conch must be tenderized before cooking. You have to beat em to eat em.

title: Boston Brown Bread
instructions: Soak All-Bran in sour cream for 30 minutes. Cream together Crisco egg sugar and molasses. Dissolve soda in hot water. Add flour and salt. Stir into bran mixture. Add raisins and nutmeats. Bake in cans 1/2 to 2/3 full for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Cook chicken in seasoned water until tender. Remove. Cool. Debone then return to broth. Add carrot and potato; cook until tender. Then add noodles and top with the uncooked dumplings spooned on dumplings

title: Gallagher'S Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: Place water in pot over high heat. Add carrots celery and green onions; boil 5 minutes and set aside (do not drain). Melt butter in soup pot over medium heat; saute white onion 1 minute; add flour blending well. In a large sauce pan bring milk and broth to a boil. Whisk broth mixture into flour and onion mixture. Stir in cheese salt pepper cayenne and mustard. Add cooked vegetables including the water in which they were cooked. Bring to a boil stirring to blend well and serve immediately. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole #2
instructions: Layer chicken in bottom of pan. Mix soup with about a half can of chicken broth from boiled chicken and pour over chicken. Crush crackers and sprinkle over chicken. Melt oleo and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake until topping is golden brown about 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Dolly Lister'S Mizette
instructions: Brown bell pepper medium onion hamburger and sausage together. Drain. Add together in large bowl the hamburger mixture mushroom soup tomato soup tomato sauce chili powder garlic salt celery flakes and salt and pepper. Add cooked noodles. Stir together. Put into casserole dishes (enough for two). Put Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. I have frozen one casserole dish to use later.

title: Fruit Cocktail Pudding
instructions: Sift flour soda salt and sugar together. Mix egg vanilla and fruit cocktail together and combine all ingredients. Pour mixture into two buttered pans. Sprinkle top with brown sugar and nuts. Place in oven at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 275\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer. Serve cold with whipped cream. It is better made the same day as served.

title: Country Fries
instructions: In large skillet pour 2 tablespoons leftover bacon drippings or cooking oil. Turn heat up to high. Dump in all of the ingredients; salt and pepper to taste. Once everything starts frying well turn heat to medium or medium-low. Cover with lid and let cook 25 to 30 minutes. Must be stirred flipped or turned frequently.

title: Rocky Road Brownies
instructions: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions using oil eggs and substituting evaporated milk for water. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake according to package directions. Remove from oven. Top with marshmallows chocolate morsels and nuts if desired. Return to oven for 3 to 5 minutes or just until topping is warmed and begins to melt. Cool for 20 to 30 minutes before cutting.

title: Diane'S Bacon Gravy
instructions: Fry bacon in a frying pan. Keep 3 tablespoons of the bacon drippings. Mix the flour and milk together; add to the drippings. Stir to thicken.

title: Beet And Walnut Salad
instructions: In large bowl whisk together vinegar and oil. Toss in beets until well coated then add cheese and walnuts. Toss gently until just coated. Line serving platter with green leaf lettuce. Serve on beet-cheese mixture.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixing bowl add 1 cup flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Add mashed bananas butter and milk. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed until blended then on high speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs and remaining flour; beat until blended and stir in nuts.

title: Barbecued Steak
instructions: Place round steak in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Pour barbecue sauce over steak. Layer onion potatoes (quartered) carrots salt and pepper. Cover top with more barbecue sauce. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 60 minutes.

title: Lemon Or Orange Tea Cookies
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients together. Add liquid ingredients gradually to this mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oatmeal. Let stand for 10 minutes. Add brown and white sugar and butter. Stir until butter melts. Add eggs. Stir well. Sift together flour soda salt and cocoa. Add 1/2 package chocolate pieces. Pour batter into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle walnuts and remaining chocolate pieces on top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Cake is so rich it requires no frosting.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Cook beets until tender with 2-inches of tops left on. To pickle beets use a granite pan large enough to make 8-quarts. Heat all ingredients to a boiling point then all the cut up beets and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium. Have jars and lids hot. Fill jars and seal. Wait 2 weeks before opening for better flavor.

title: Original Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs separately; beat well. Sift the flour baking powder and salt. Add milk vanilla and mace. Combine all ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes. Frost with butter icing.

title: Pizza Pie Crust
instructions: Add 1 cup of water to yeast (more if needed). Add ingredients and stir. Let dough rise 1 hour. Makes 2 large pies. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Use any kind of sauce and toppings.

title: Chocolate Chip Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips in cream canister. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Freeze as directed. Add chocolate chips immediately after freezing. Yields approximately 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl until smooth. Stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup milk into bowl. Add pudding and mix. Beat 1 or 2 minutes (mixture will be thick). Stir in pumpkin and spices. Mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish as desired.

title: Pizza Bubble Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add spaghetti sauce to hamburger. Put the biscuits in 2 cake pans or 1 large pan. Put hamburger mixture on biscuits. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with cheese and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Spread on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Whip cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over cooled pretzel crust.

title: Lace Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients.\tDrop by 1/2 teaspoon onto foil lined baking sheet 2 inches apart (batter will spread). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 7 to 10 minutes. Check after 7 minutes.\tWatch for edges to turn golden. Allow to cool on foil. Peel off foil when completely cool.\t(Recipe makes a lot of cookies.)

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Beat eggs; add salt pepper and oregano. Dip chicken in egg then breadcrumbs. Heat oil in skillet and brown chicken on both sides. Place chicken in 13X9 baking dish and sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Pork Chops With Turnips
instructions: Brown chops in a little onion after you dip in egg and bread crumbs. Cook until tender. Cook about 4 good-size turnips with 4 good-size potatoes. Mash. Pour grease from chops in turnips and potatoes.

title: Delicious Strawberry Pie
instructions: Fill baked pie crust with 1 quart unsweetened strawberries. Boil water sugar lemon juice and cornstarch until clear. Add strawberry jello and red food coloring; cool. Pour over the strawberries. Spread whipped cream or Cool Whip on top. Decorate with berries.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients. Grease large container; put dough in and turn to grease top. Cover with foil; let stand overnight. Do not refrigerate. Next morning punch down and divide into 3 parts. Knead each part on a floured surface 8 to 10 times. Put in greased loaf pans; brush with oil. Cover with waxed paper; let rise 4 to 6 hours. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Brush top with melted butter. Can be frozen. If putting bread in pans on workday to rise it can set all day. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Quick Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Put biscuits in an ungreased 10-inch baking dish. Combine other 3 ingredients and pour over biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until biscuits brown. (They will rise to the top during baking.)

title: Caesar'S Fish
instructions: Arrange fillets in a single layer in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Drizzle dressing over fillets. Sprinkle crumbs over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top with cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Makes 4 servings.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Saute vegetables in butter until softened. Add the remaining ingredients. Cover skillet and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes. Add shrimp and simmer for 10 minutes. Thicken mixture with cornstarch. Serve with white rice.

title: Best-Ever Orange Cake
instructions: Place egg whites in large bowl and bring to room temperature about an hour. Measure sifted flour into bowl and set aside. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually beat in 1/2 cup of the granulated sugar beating after each addition. Continue beating until stiff peaks form. Set aside.

title: Okra And Tomatoes(Country Style)
instructions: Fry bacon crispy and set to drain on paper towels. Fry cut okra in bacon grease adding onions to saute. Add the whole tomatoes (mashed) the crisp bacon (crumbled) and the seasonings. Let simmer for about 30 minutes adding a little water when needed.

title: Miss Betty'S Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Cut each biscuit into fourths. Roll each piece in melted butter then in brown sugar/white sugar mixture. Place in pie pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake until brown.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form into 2 balls. Roll in nuts or parsley.

title: Stir-Fried Beef
instructions: Trim fat from beef; cut with grain into 2-inch strips. Cut strips across into 1/8-inch slices. Toss beef in vegetable oil 1 teaspoon cornstarch salt sugar soy sauce garlic powder and pepper. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Divinity
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan combine sugar corn syrup water and salt. Stirring constantly bring to a boil over medium heat. Without stirring cook over low heat (small to medium bubbles breaking across surface of liquid) until temperature on candy thermometer reaches 266\u00b0 or small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a hard ball which doesnt flatten until pressed about 40 minutes. When temperature reaches 260\u00b0 in a large bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Beating at high speed gradually add hot syrup in a thin steady stream. DO NOT SCRAPE SIDE OF SAUCEPAN. Continue beating at high speed until mixture begins to lose its gloss about 3 minutes.

title: Potato Supreme
instructions: Pressure potatoes and grate (potatoes need to be firm and not mushy or they will be hard to grate). Mix remaining ingredients and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Creamy Hot Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients. Use as a dipping sauce for bite size chicken pieces cooked French fries or tortilla chips.

title: Maple-Glazed Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut off wingtips and discard; cut wings in half at joint. Stir together syrup and next 5 ingredients; reserve 1 cup mixture and chill.\tPlace chicken in a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag; pour remaining syrup mixture over chicken.\tSeal and chill 4 hours turning chicken occasionally. Remove chicken from marinade discarding marinade. Grill chicken without grill lid over medium-high (350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0) for 30 minutes or until done turning and basting occasionally with reserved 1 cup syrup mixture. Yields 8 appetizer servings.

title: Snick Snack
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Mix ingredients and put mixture on individual pieces of party rye bread. Heat in oven and serve.

title: Blueberry Rolls
instructions: Roll biscuits together into oblong shape and butter. Mix flour berries sugar and lemon juice. Arrange berries on dough and roll up. Seal ends. Bake in hot oven 450\u00b0 about 20-25 minutes until brown. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Place meat in crock large enough to cover with liquid. Cover with the following mixture 1 part vinegar to 3 parts water then add all other ingredients. After 2 or 3 days drain meat.

title: Chicken Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender in 4 to 5 tablespoons butter or broth. Add chicken broth and pepper and simmer for 30 minutes. Blend flour milk cheese and parsley into a smooth sauce and add to broth. Cook stirring until thick and bubbly. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Moms Turkey Dressing
instructions: Crumble cornbread and biscuits and stuffing mix together. Saute celery onion in margarine; add to bread mixture. Cut up cooked giblets fine add to bread. Add salt and pepper eggs to bread mix together. Add soup sage chicken seasoning milk and hot pepper mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 25-35 minutes.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in mayonnaise. Stir in bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and Old Bay seasoning. Shape mixture into 4-ounce cakes and pan-fry until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake 2 (8-inch or 9-inch) cakes; let cool completely. In small bowl mix together vanilla pudding milk and sour cream. Mix well and chill 1 hour. In large bowl mix strawberry jello and boiling water then add in pie glaze and frozen strawberries. Mix well and chill 1 hour.

title: Quick Made Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Using 9 x 13-inch pan mix melted margarine and 1 cup brown sugar covering bottom of pan. Cover either with almonds pecans or chopped walnuts. Place rolls in rows to fit nicely in pan. In separate pan or bowl mix pudding mix (dry) 1/2 cup brown sugar and about a teaspoon of cinnamon. Sprinkle on top of rolls; cover with wax paper and let sit at room temperature overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 50 minutes. Turn upside down on foil.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix flour sugar and pecans. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Spread evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes; cool.

title: Flank Steak
instructions: Marinate steak 24 hours at room temperature. Cook on grill or in broiler about 7 minutes a side (well done or crispy on the outside).

title: Taboulee Salad
instructions: Mix water and bulgar together to moisten. Saute onion and oil. Add to bulgar. Set aside. Mix together green onion parsley and bell pepper. Mix together remaining ingredients. Add bulgur mixture. Mix well refrigerate and let stand 15 minutes or more. Serve.

title: Fudge
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan and boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in bits until melted. Add rest of ingredients until blended. Pour into 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Chill.

title: Baked Acorn Squash
instructions: Wash and cut in half. Remove seeds. Bake cut side down at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Turn cut side up. Fill cavity with butter and honey or brown sugar. Continue baking for 20 minutes more or until done.

title: Caesar Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs lengthwise in half with rippled vegetable cutter or sharp knife. Carefully remove yolks and place in a small bowl; reserve egg white halves.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Prepare meat balls and spaghetti sauce as directed in preceding recipes. Cook all 24 meat balls in thick spaghetti sauce. Cook lasagne noodles in salted boiling water until firm (not too done). Add cold water to stop cooking. Drain.

title: Stollen
instructions: Unroll the dough to make a large rectangle onto a greased cookie sheet. Spread with softened cream cheese (heated briefly in microwave). Sprinkle over raisins cinnamon and sugar. Lifting the long edge of the rectangle bring edge to center. Join with opposite edge (of long side of rectangle) in the center by pinching dough. Pinch short ends also (so filling doesnt run out).

title: Pizza Fish Fillets(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cut fish into 6 serving size pieces. Spray rectangular baking dish with nonstick spray coating. Measure the thickness of fish. Place fish in prepared baking dish tucking under the thin edges. Sprinkle with the lemon pepper. Bake fish uncovered in a 450\u00b0 oven for 6 to 9 minutes per 1/2 inch of thickness.

title: Broccoli Cornbread Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spray 2 (12-cup) muffin tins with Pam cooking spray. Fill cups about 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. You may easily cut this recipe in half and make 12 muffins.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grate some cheese on top. Cook for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cheese is melted.

title: Beer Battered Fish
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Add oil and fold in beaten egg whites. Dip fish in batter and fry in oil until golden brown. Good luck!

title: Impossible Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9-inch pie plate. Sprinkle pecans in plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth (1 minute with hand beater). Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean 50 to 55 minutes. Cool.

title: Shrimp Mousse
instructions: Slightly oil 1 mold or Bundt cake pan. Set aside. Cook shrimp soup and cream cheese (until smooth) over medium heat. Remove from fire. Add celery and onions. Stir. Melt gelatine in water per package directions. Add to shrimp mixture. Pour into mold. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Melt oleo then melt peanut butter with it and bring to a boil. Add powdered sugar and stir thoroughly. Put in buttered 9 x 11-inch pan. Place in refrigerator until hard; cut to size you desire.

title: Delicious Pineapple Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water. Cool a few minutes. Add jello to mayonnaise a little at a time until blended. Stir in remaining ingredients. Add pinch of salt. Place in covered dish. Refrigerate. Makes approximately 12 servings.

title: Texas Bean Casserole
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole combine all ingredients except cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot. Arrange cheese in criss-cross fashion on top of beans. Bake until cheese melts. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Mix well with a mixer and put into a greased casserole.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat slowly; add next 6 ingredients to meat. Simmer until ingredients thicken stirring occasionally. Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender. Drain. Combine cottage cheese with next 5 ingredients.

title: Vegetable Platter
instructions: Peel carrots. Cut in half crosswise and quarter lengthwise. Snap beans and cut in half. Cut roots of leeks and remove coarse outer leaves. Cut off all but 2 inches of the green tops. Cut in half lengthwise. Place chicken broth in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add green beans and return to boiling. Cover reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Add leeks and carrots; return to simmer and cook covered 6 to 8 minutes or until tender. Drain. Arrange on platter. Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with parsley. Makes 8 servings.

title: Sour Cream Dip
instructions: Soak gelatin in cold water in small pan for 5 minutes. Dissolve over hot water until liquid. Add 1/4 cup sour cream gradually to be dissolved with gelatin. Stir to blend. Add to remaining sour cream with onion and salt and mix thoroughly. Cover tightly chill in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Just before serving fluff up with fork and fold in crumbled bacon.

title: Heavenly Rice Dessert
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve 3/4 cup juice. Bring the juice to a boil. Stir in instant rice and simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let steam 5 minutes. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions. Fold marshmallows into hot pudding. Add pineapple pecans and rice. Chill. Garnish with whipped cream. Yields 6 servings.

title: Creamy Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Place frozen potatoes and onions in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes. In a small bowl soften cream cheese by microwaving 30 to 40 seconds. Stir in soup. Stir mixture into potatoes. Cover casserole and microwave on High 6 to 8 minutes or until center is hot. Stir once during cooking. Top with shredded cheese and let stand 5 minutes.

title: Raisin Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water on raisins. Let cool. Cream sugar with shortening. Add egg vanilla and molasses. Sift together flour baking soda and salt. Beat into creamed mixture. Grease 4 (No. 2) tin cans. Fill each can half full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Crumble ground beef into 1 1/2-quart glass casserole. Microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until no longer pink. Stir to break meat into pieces. Drain. Stir in sauce. Cover dish and microwave until mixture boils.

title: Easy Basil Potatoes
instructions: Clean potatoes; cut into 2-inch cubes (leave skins on). Put potatoes and all other ingredients into a microwavable cooking dish. Cover with Saran Wrap. Microwave on High for 10 to 14 minutes mixing ingredients halfway through.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes in loaf pan.

title: Lacy Corn Meal Pancakes
instructions: Mix corn meal baking soda and salt together. Add beaten egg and buttermilk beating until smooth. The secret of getting the cakes trimmed with lace is to get the batter thin.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar and milk in a large pot. Boil and stir 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat and add marshmallows peanut butter vanilla and salt. Mix well. Pour in greased pan.

title: Chicken And Cheese Strata
instructions: Pour egg mixture over bread cheese and chicken layers. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Quick No Rise Bread
instructions: Blend all ingredients together well. Grease a loaf pan and pour batter into it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Sausage Stars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blot sausage dry with paper towels and combine with cheeses salad dressing olives and red pepper. Lightly grease miniature (or regular) muffin tin and press 1 wrapper in each cup. Brush with oil. Bake 5 minutes until golden. Remove from tins; place on baking sheet. Fill with sausage mixture. Bake 5 minutes until bubbly. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Strawberry Salsa
instructions: In bowl combine strawberries green pepper onions and parsley. Stir in salad dressing and pepper. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Serve with chips.

title: Chicken Spaghetti(Serves 10)
instructions: Cook chicken with onion bay leaf and salt. Chill bone and chop. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. Use 2 tablespoons of chicken broth. Add flour salt pepper 1 cup chicken broth and 1 cup milk for white sauce. Dice celery onions pimentos and green pepper. Add cheese. Mix all ingredients together. Put in a shallow pan. Cover with buttered crumbs or potato chips.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Let first 5 ingredients stand 3 hours in ice water; drain well. Bring next 4 ingredients to a boil and then pour over cucumbers which are packed in the jars. Cold pack for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil and chunk chicken (save broth). Mix soups tomatoes and chilies in blender. Add chicken and heat slowly until hot through and through.

title: Creamy Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shells and chill.

title: Italian Pinwheels
instructions: Bring tortillas to room temperature. Soften cream cheese in microwave for 1 minute. Combine cream cheese and pesto. Spread the mixture over the surface of each tortilla. Scatter chopped peppers over cream cheese. Cover cheese and peppers with thin slices of salami dividing the meat evenly among the tortillas. Roll each tortilla tightly into a tube. Use plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: English Trifle
instructions: You simply put this together in layers

title: Fruit Freeze
instructions: Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and sugar. Add drained fruit and nuts mixing carefully. Add whipped cream. Put in ice tray and freeze approximately 4 hours. Serves 6.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake With Lime Glaze
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Position rack in lower third of oven and preheat to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a fleur-de-lis (Bundt or other) cake pan. Over a sheet of waxed paper sift together flour baking soda and salt. Set aside.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Mix remaining ingredients. In 13 x 9-inch pan layer meat mixture shredded Cheddar cheese and corn tortillas ending with meat mixture. Top with cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: To eggs add next 4 ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm. Sprinkle cheese on top and return to oven just long enough to melt.

title: Hoffman'S Crockpot Meatloaf
instructions: Mix all together. Should be very moist. (add more milk if needed). Shape and place in crockpot.

title: Vegetarian Pasta
instructions: Cut pepper into strips; slice carrots diagonally and cut broccoli into bite size pieces. Stir-fry in olive oil (1 tablespoon) until just tender. (Cook each vegetable separately). Mix vegetables and cooked pasta together. Add 1 clove crushed garlic 2 tablespoons olive oil and squeeze a lemon wedge into mixture; stir and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and chopped fresh parsley.

title: Dutchess Potatoes
instructions: If frozen thaw potatoes. Mix all ingredients well. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients well. Add rhubarb lemon rind eggs oil and nuts. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Use juice of lemon and powdered sugar for glaze. Spread on cake while still warm.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Stir in all other ingredients with a spoon; do not beat. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting

title: Goody Bars
instructions: Combine the first three ingredients. Spread mixture in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine rest of ingredients. Beat until smooth. Spread mixture over cake mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

title: Dessert
instructions: Mix cake mix and bake 10 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Time for cake is approximate. Check for doneness. Mix pudding milk and cream cheese according to directions on pudding. Spread on cake. Then spread pineapple on pudding mixture. Top with Cool Whip. Spread on pineapple. Sprinkle nuts on top.

title: Ham Quiche
instructions: Grease 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle ham cheese and onion in plate. Blend rest of ingredients and pour over. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes or until a knife comes out clean.

title: Salmon Loaf With Cheese Sauce
instructions: Flake salmon; mix all ingredients. Shape into loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with Cheese Sauce.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Melts
instructions: Cream 1 cup soft margarine. Add 1/3 cup confectioners sugar 3/4 cup cornstarch and 1 cup plain flour. Mix well. Chill 1 hour. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown on bottom 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Mix well with other ingredients. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Tomato Pan Bread
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients; mix until well blended. Pour batter into preheated 9-inch cake pan coated with vegetable spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bread tests done with toothpick. Remove from pan; cool on wire rack. Serve warm. Yields 10 servings.

title: Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a small pan combine sugar butter and milk; bring to a boil stirring constantly and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate chips until melted and smooth. Spread over cake. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl combine flour 3/4 cups sugar 2 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and salt. Stir in milk butter vanilla and pecans. Pour batter into a 10 x 8-inch pan. Combine remaining 1/2 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons cocoa. Sprinkle over batter. Carefully pour water on top. Bake for 35 minutes. Cut into squares and turn upside down to serve.

title: Susie Chew Brownies
instructions: Cook on low heat or in microwave the caramels and 1/3 cup or little more of the evaporated milk until caramels are melted. Meanwhile mix together cake mix margarine and 2 tablespoons evaporated milk. Add pecans to this. Take half of dough and spread in 9 x 11-inch pan ungreased. Bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0. Spread chocolate chips over dough then spread caramel mixture. Take remaining cake dough and sprinkle over top. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut when cool.

title: Ez Tater Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in small amount of water with chopped onion. When about done add soups. Bring to a boil and serve.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large skillet cook and stir the meat onions and bell pepper until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain off fat. Stir in tomatoes rice salt chili powder and pepper; heat through. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk Cool Whip and sour cream. Put layer of wafers in a large dish or pan layer of bananas and cover with pudding mixture. Continue with layers until all the mixture is used. Top with crushed wafers or cookies. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet until done. Mix tomatoes tomato paste and water all together in large pan. Add kidney beans and rest of ingredients. Coffee is optional. Simmer 2 hours. Enjoy with crackers fruit and dessert.

title: Thimbleberry Fritters
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder together. Add sugar egg yolks and water. Blend well. Beat egg whites stiff then fold into flour mixture along with berries. Drop dough from a tablespoon into hot (365\u00b0) deep oil. Fry until fritters are golden brown. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar if desired. Makes 12.

title: Beef Tips And Gravy
instructions: Brown beef tips. Transfer to crock-pot. Make a flour gravy; add to crock-pot. Mix cream of mushroom soup and Lipton onion soup mix to gravy and beef tips. Cook in crock-pot for 6 to 7 hours on medium setting. Serve over rice.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Bring the first 4 ingredients to a boil then cut to a simmer. Pack the cukes in jars; add the rest of ingredients. Pour liquid over cukes in jar and seal. Put in hot water bath in canner of boiling water and let it set for 30 to 40 minutes. Do not cook in canner just let it sit in water.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Fry onions in butter. Add flour salt curry powder and chicken stock. Stir constantly until mixture is thick. Add milk lemon juice and chicken. Heat well. (May be made in advance and reheated.) Serve over rice with chopped bacon or chutney diced pineapple and coconut. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Turkey And Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Layer asparagus and turkey in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine the next 4 ingredients; mix well. Spoon mixture over turkey. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Crispy Coated Chicken
instructions: Crush soup mix in pouch. Combine soup mix bread crumbs and pepper. Beat together egg and water. Dip chicken into egg mixture; coat with crumb mixture. On baking sheet arrange chicken. Drizzle with margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Serves 6.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Place bread slices in greased casserole. Cook sausage until slightly brown; drain. Spoon sausage over bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix eggs and half and half. Pour over cheese. Chill overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (until set). Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Hot Cranberry Apple Casserole
instructions: Wash cranberries and place in casserole. Lay apple slices over cranberries. In separate bowl mix remaining ingredients and spread over cranberry/apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. (Use of microwave to cook mixture will decrease cooking time. Place in oven under broiler until brown if using microwave.)

title: Pineapple Praline Cake
instructions: Mix yellow cake mix eggs and juice (if not enough juice add water to make 1 1/3 cups). Pour half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour crushed pineapple over mixture.
