Then cover with remaining batter. Bake 40 minutes or until done. Then take praline mixture (butter brown sugar pecans and coconut) and spread over cake. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 5 tablespoons warm water; set aside. Sift together dry ingredients then cut shortening into the mixture. Add buttermilk and yeast mixture to the dry ingredients and shortening. Stir by hand until somewhat sticky. Put on floured board. Roll out with floured rolling pin and cut biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown or golden. Makes 25 large biscuits. Will store in refrigerator for 3 to 4 days.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain. Add chili and seasonings. Add Velveeta cheese. Heat through. Serve hot with corn chips (Doritos Tostitos). For more spicy dip use Velveeta cheese with jalapeno peppers.

title: Nan Millar'S Shortbread
instructions: Knead together until dough forms a ball and does not stick to fingers. Must knead by hand and have butter at room temperature. Divide into two equal portions and pat each into a small pie pan (ungreased). Prick top with a fork. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Done when light brown on top. Makes 2 gift-size.

title: Chicken Bundles Italian
instructions: Bone skin and coarsely chop chicken (1 1/2 cups). In large skillet cook chicken and onion in hot oil over medium heat until chicken is no longer pink. In a large mixing bowl combine partially thawed and drained spinach cheeses spices and lemon juice; stir in chicken and onion and add salt and pepper to taste. Lightly butter 8 (10 ounce) custard cups or a muffin pan. Line each with an egg roll wrapper and spoon in chicken mixture in equal amounts in each cup. Fold the ends of each wrapper over the chicken mixture and seal to make a bundle; brush with remaining butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until tops are golden. Loosen bundles with knife and remove from cups.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Put pie filling in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sift cake mix on top. Grate butter over top. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until browned.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Cook onion in a small amount of olive oil or water. Mix to all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or in microwave on High until done.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix together all ingredients make into meatballs roll in flour and fry in a little oil until done. When done put in a container and add the rest of the sweet n sour sauce. Its best if eaten the next day. Warm on the stove or in the microwave--Enjoy!!

title: Spicy Blueberry Pie
instructions: Combine first seven ingredients toss gently. Fit 1 pie crust into 9 inch pie plate according to pkg directions. Spoon blueberry mixture into pie shell. Cover with remaining pie crust fold and crimp edges. Brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar. Cut crust to vent.

title: Meatballs With Bacon
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients. Form into balls. Moisten with egg and milk mixture. Wrap in bacon. Fasten bacon with toothpick. Bake in hot oven 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Divinity
instructions: Pour marshmallow cream into mixing bowl. In heavy saucepan bring sugar and water to a boil then cook at medium heat until soft ball stage. Pour mixture into marshmallow cream slowly while stirring. Beat by hand until candy forms peaks. Add pecans and spoon out on waxed paper.

title: Bird'S Nest Pudding
instructions: Let fruit come to a boil. Mix together sugar butter egg flour baking powder milk and vanilla. Drop by large spoons on the boiling fruit. Put in oven and bake until rich brown.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Bread
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl; stir well and set aside. Combine sugar and oil; beat at medium speed 2 minutes or until well blended. Add the egg and beat until light and lemon colored. On low speed of the mixer add the flour mixture alternately with the banana beginning and ending with the flour mixture. Blend well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla. Pour the batter into a bread pan coated with vegetable cooking spray; bake it at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yields 16 servings at 120 calories per 1/2 inch slice. Protein 2.1 g fat 4 g carbohydrate 19.4 g cholesterol 17 g iron 5 g sodium 93 g and calcium 17 g.

title: Fried Plantains
instructions: Peel plantain banana and cut into 1/2-inch slices at a 45\u00b0 angle. Pour enough cooking oil in a frying pan to cover 1/2 of the slices. Heat cooking oil on medium heat.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix together flour margarine and powdered sugar for crust. Press into pizza pan (optional). For crust Pillsbury sugar cookie dough can be used.

title: Banana Loaf And Icing
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add all other ingredients. Bake in 9 x 14-inch loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cranberry Crunch Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Stir in ice water and lemon juice. Chill until thick and syrupy. Fold in cranberry sauce celery and walnuts. Pour all this into a lightly oiled 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Tater Delights
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and green pepper and spread in baking dish. Top with mushroom soup and pour Cheddar cheese over this and top with Tater Tots. Bake until brown.

title: Cottage Cheese Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and oil. Add eggs one at a time. Mix dry ingredients. Add to mixture alternately with buttermilk and blend well. Add vanilla. Fold in chopped nuts and prunes. Pour into greased pan and bake at 300\u00b0 about 30 or 40 minutes.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: In large bowl put sugar flour and salt. In heavy small pan bring margarine water and cocoa to a boil. Take cocoa mixture from heat as soon as it boils and add immediately to dry ingredients. Add sour cream. Add eggs and soda mixing until well blended after each addition. Batter will be thin. Bake in a greased cookie sheet type pan with high sides or 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Curry Dip
instructions: One day in advance before serving mix well all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Break crackers coarsely into pastry-lined plate. Combine water sugar and cream of tartar in a saucepan and boil gently for 15 minutes. Add lemon juice and cool. Pour syrup over crackers. Dot generously with butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Makes 2 pies.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions omitting salt; drain. Combine macaroni and next 6 ingredients. Spoon mixture into a 1-quart baking dish coated with cooking spray; sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yield 6 servings (about 158 calories per serving).

title: Chicken Enchilada
instructions: Boil debone and dice the chicken. Mix chicken with next 6 ingredients. Fill and roll mixture into tortillas. Place in casserole dish. Pour remainder of sauce over casserole. Cover with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until hot through and cheese begins to brown.

title: Sugarless Cake
instructions: Combine raisins in water and simmer for 15 minutes. Let stand until cool. Add beaten egg. Add soft shortening oats sweetener and flavoring. Sift flour salt baking soda and cinnamon. Mix all together well. Pour into greased one-layer cake pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields an 8-inch cake.

title: Lemon Bisque
instructions: Chill bowl and beaters. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water; set in refrigerator. When mixture has partially congealed fold in the Pet milk which has been whipped with a beater. Add lemon juice and rind. Line a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan with vanilla wafer crumbs. Pour in Jell-O mixture; cover with more crumbs and put in refrigerator to chill.

title: Grandma'S Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients and mix well. Combine evaporated milk and cream; heat to scalding point then add to pumpkin mixture. Mix well. Pour into two 9-inch unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour and 15 minutes. If smaller shells are used bake longer. Pie is done when knife inserted near rim comes out clean.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and butter. Cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour to creamed mixture alternately with milk beating well after each addition. Stir in flavoring. Pour batter into well-greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Easy Dill Pickles
instructions: Boil vinegar water and salt. Place sprig of dill in bottom of sterile jar. Pack cucumbers in jar. Pour boiling brine over pickles and seal. Wait at least 6 weeks to use.

title: Poor Man'S Salami
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate 24 hours. Mix again and refrigerate another 24 hours. Roll and shape into loaves. Bake 8 hours at 150\u00b0 to 175\u00b0 on a broiler pan.

title: Oreo Cookie Jello
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add cold water. Chill until slightly thickened (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Measure 1 3/4 cups Jell-O into 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Chill 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Chill. Just before serving slice bananas and add to mixture. Stir and serve.

title: Vodka-Russel Refresher
instructions: Mix vodka and juice. Freeze stirring frequently. When icy place 1 scoop in a glass. Fill with Squirt.

title: Rotel Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain off grease. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and cheese. (I dice the cheese so it will melt faster.) Stir often. This can be cooked in crock-pot or microwave.

title: Mulled Cider
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cinnamon stick. Simmer 30 minutes covered. Serve hot with twist of orange peel and cinnamon stick. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Add celery onion and rice. Let simmer until tender stirring occasionally. Boil cabbage for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Mix mushroom soup and meat mixture together with the milk. In a 13 x 9-inch pan spread cabbage on bottom. Then spread the mushroom mixture over cabbage. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes with a lid over it then remove lid add cheese and bake for 15 minutes more or until cheese is melted.

title: Rachel'S Herbed Veal With Wine
instructions: Trim excess fat from veal. Cut veal into 1-inch strips and dredge in flour. Saute veal in butter and olive oil in large skillet until lightly browned. Remove veal to 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Saute onions in pan drippings until tender. Stir in chicken broth and next 5 ingredients. Mix well and pour over veal.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Cover with water and cook until tender. Drain and save liquid. Break corned beef in tiny bits. Put corned beef pepper onion and potatoes in a baking dish. Mix milk flour and potato liquid until smooth. Pour over casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Season meat with salt pepper and parsley. Cook manicotti in 4 quarts of water for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain in a bowl combine milk and egg. Moisten the bread slices. Tear and mix with meat. Stuff in manicotti. Place in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over manicotti. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Quick Lunch Casserole
instructions: Mix mac and chili cover with cheese and bake in oven at 350 degrees until hot through and cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve with a dollop of sour cream (optional).

title: Rita'S Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Melt butter; stir in cornstarch. Add onions garlic and green pepper. Cook until onions are done. Add the fat. Cook for 20 minutes. Add crawfish tails and cook additional 10 minutes. Add other ingredients and simmer. If desired add 1/3 can of Ro-Tel tomatoes to mixture.

title: Ranch Pretzels
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Break pretzels and place on cookie sheet. Pour sauce over pretzels. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes.

title: Dog Food Sandwiches
instructions: Cook sausage and hamburger; drain well. Add Velveeta cheese in chunks. Combine garlic and oregano to mixture. Spread on party rye. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into patties. Dip each patty into evaporated milk and then into crushed cracker crumbs or corn flakes. Fry until golden brown on each side.

title: Homemade Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Take milk and sugar and mix together for thickening. Then take 1/2 stick butter and dissolve and pour into the thickening. Pour thickening into large baking pan. Take the peaches and stir into thickening. Take the other 1/2 stick of butter and cut over the mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Easy Casserole
instructions: Brown everything but the soup. Add soup; mix well and put into a casserole and top with Tater Tots. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Remoulade Sauce
instructions: Puree ingredients in blender. Chill and serve over boiled shrimp.

title: Egg Nog(My Father'S From His Father To Me)
instructions: Separate yolks from whites; beat yolks until light. Blend with sugar whipping cream milk and salt. Mix well with the whiskey rum and brandy. Let stand covered under refrigeration overnight. Then beat whites of eggs until stiff not dry; fold lightly into mixture. Sprinkle grated nutmeg on top. Will keep for weeks.

title: Beef Taco Casserole
instructions: Place corn chips in greased baking dish. Mix taco seasoning with meat and pour over chips. Spoon beans over beef and bake at 350\u00b0F. for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheese on top. Place back in oven for 5 minutes. Remove and garnish with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Dutch Triple Fudge Cake
instructions: Cook chocolate pudding as directed. Blend in devils food cake mix (dry mix). Pour into prepared oblong pan 13 x 9 1/2 x 2-inch. Sprinkle with the chocolate bits and the chopped walnuts. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 if glass pan is used).

title: Babicka'S Babovka
instructions: Grate rind into the bottom of the mixing bowl. Cream with sugar and butter. Separate eggs. Add egg yolks and vanilla to mixture. Sift salt and baking powder into flour. The five flour siftings are essential for the resultant final texture. Then alternately combine sifted flour and milk with the creamed mixture. Beat egg whites and gently cut them in. Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Hoska crumbs may also be sprinkled in. Chopped walnuts if desired are then sprinkled in. Gently pour in the mixture and bake for about 45 minutes or until done in a 375\u00b0 oven. Cool before removing from pan to serve.

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Let stand overnight. Bring to a good boil; boil 1 minute. Take from stove and put in jello. Stir until well dissolved. Seal while hot.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Melt oleo in casserole dish. Mix all other ingredients and add to the casserole dish. Stir thoroughly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with grated cheese while still hot.

title: Talerine
instructions: Brown onion in little fat. Add ground beef and brown. Cook noodles until tender. Mix all ingredients in greased casserole dish. Save a little cheese to sprinkle on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Enchiladas With Refried Beans And Two Sauces
instructions: In a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat heat oil. Add onion green pepper and garlic; cook 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Add chili powder and oregano; cook and stir 1 minute. To mixture in skillet add beans corn broth cilantro salt and pepper; bring to boil stirring. Reduce heat to medium-low; cook 5 to 10 minutes stirring occasionally until most of the liquid has been absorbed.

title: Mamye Johnston Icebox Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a graham cracker pie crust. Let set in refrigerator for about 1 hour to set.

title: Brandy Slush
instructions: Mix together and freeze.

title: Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and shortening. Add eggs mixing well. Combine salt and flour. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk stirring well. Stir in pecans and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: In 3-quart glass casserole stir together soy sauce and cornstarch. Stir in chestnuts bean sprouts and mushrooms then meat celery and onion. Microwave on High 20 to 22 minutes stirring well after 10 minutes until hot and thickened. Stir thoroughly and serve over chow mein noodles or cooked rice.

title: Sweet Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce. Mix lettuce with pineapple and bananas. Mix salad dressing with sugar. Pour over lettuce. Mix thoroughly.

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all together and bake in buttered pie plate (large) at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Souped Up Potatoes
instructions: Mix soups and sour cream together. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan and line with hash browns salt and pepper to taste. Pour soup mixture over potatoes cover with cheese and cornflakes; dot with oleo. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: On waxed paper combine flour 1/2 of salt and pepper. Coat roast with mixture. In Dutch oven in oil brown roast evenly on all sides. Remove roast from oven. Place in oven-safe pot. Using Dutch oven cook onions until tender. Place onions on top of roast. Add remaining salt and 1 1/4 cups water. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours. Add potatoes and carrots. Bake 30 to 45 minutes more until meat and vegetables are tender. Mix 1/4 cup water with flour mixture on top of stove. Thicken broth with mixture. Pour over meat and vegetables.

title: Hot Clam Spread
instructions: Combine clams and lemon juice. Set aside. Saute mixture of rest of ingredients except for bread crumbs. Combine with the clams. Add bread crumbs. Spread should be stiff. Add more crumbs if necessary. Spread on your favorite crackers.

title: Mid-West Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add cabbage potato celery carrot onion and parsley. Cook over low heat 5 minutes. In bowl combine egg yolks and milk; blend in bread cubes salt and pepper. Gradually blend in vegetable mixture. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into well-greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Cabbage-Apple Slaw
instructions: In medium bowl combine cabbage carrots green pepper apples and onion (or scallion). In 1-cup measure or small bowl combine yogurt mayonnaise salt and pepper; pour over vegetables and toss until well coated. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Makes 4 servings. This will keep for several days in the refrigerator.

title: Salted Nut Roll
instructions: Combine caramels and evaporated milk in top of double boiler. Heat until caramels are melted. Remove from heat. Add 1/4 cup butter. Mix well until melted. Add 1 cup powdered sugar. Cool slightly. Drop by teaspoonfuls into a dish of salted peanuts. Form into log. Roll until coated with nuts. Place on waxed paper. Makes about 50.

title: Caroline'S Manicotti
instructions: You will need 2 (12 x 9-inch) casserole dishes and 2 (14 x 12-inch) sheets of foil.

title: Zucchini Doughnuts
instructions: Mix all together. Drop in grease at 375\u00b0 with a doughnut maker. When cooked on one side turn.

title: Busy Day Meat Loaves
instructions: Mix together the beef eggs tomato paste rolled oats relish onion soup and onion. Shape into 2-inch balls. Place in 12 ungreased muffin cups. Bake in a preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Makes 12 individual meat loaves.

title: Meat Loaf Topping
instructions: Combine and spread over top of meat loaf before baking.

title: Sugar Free Cocoa Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Mix well. Store in an air tight container. For each serving add 1/3 cup mix to 3/4 cup boiling water stir to dissolve. Yield 2 2/3 cups mix (8 servings). Exchanges 1 milk. Serving 1 cup. Calories 104.

title: Jonathan'S Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg and milk. Add to dry ingredients. Add margarine. Makes about twelve 4-inch pancakes.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Combine white cake mix flour eggs oil water Jell-O and 1/2 cup frozen strawberries in large bowl and mix well. Bake in greased and floured tube pan in 350\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes. Combine butter powdered sugar and 2 tablespoons crushed strawberries. Drizzle over warm cake.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Soak crumbs in broth soup and butter for 15 minutes. Add eggs and all other ingredients. You made add chicken pieces if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or until golden brown in 10 x 18-inch pan.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice in water for 7 minutes. Add milk and butter then cook 1 hour on low heat. Add eggs sugar vanilla and if desired raisins. Put in serving dish and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Cook 1 quart boiling water and raisins 15 or 20 minutes. Beat egg sugar flour vinegar and cinnamon. Add to boiling mixture. Cook until thick. Bake in 2 crusts. Makes 2 pies.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients. Serve with pineapple chunks banana chunks strawberries or any fruit you like.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Cheese Danish
instructions: Cream sugar egg cheese and vanilla until smooth. Grease cookie sheet and lay 1 package crescent rolls on sheet. Roll edge up. Put cream cheese mixture on top. Layer other package crescent rolls on top. Roll edge. Brush top with egg yolk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Granola
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Mix orange juice almond extract salt and honey. Pour over dry ingredients and toss together. Crumble into shallow baking sheets in 3/4-inch layer. Bake 1 hour at 250\u00b0 stirring occasionally. Add raisins after baking. Makes 14 cups.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Cream Of Mushroom Soup
instructions: Saute shallots in melted butter in pan and add mushrooms. Continue to saute for 5 minutes then add chicken broth. Bring soup to boil and simmer about 1/2 hour. Pour into blender gradually and mix until smooth. Return soup to pan; add cream salt pepper and sherry. Add rest of ingredients. Serve very hot.

title: Old Time Corn Relish
instructions: Chop all vegetables; mix with mustard sugar and vinegar in large enamel pot. Boil for 20 minutes. Quickly fill jars and seal.

title: Calico Bean Salad
instructions: Mix vegetables together. In a small bowl mix together sugar vinegar oil salt and pepper. Pour over bean mixture. Refrigerate overnight in an airtight container. Drain well before serving.

title: Butterscotch Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook pie filling as directed. Pour into dry yellow cake mix. Beat with mixer until smooth. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle butterscotch chips and pecans over cake mixture. Bake for 35 minutes.

title: Corn Light Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; mix wet ingredients. Combine and pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Pour hot water over dates and set aside to cool. Cream together sugar oleo butter and eggs. Sift together flour cocoa salt and soda. Add dry ingredients with date mixture to cream mixture. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Raisin Patties
instructions: Mash potatoes. Beat in egg and salt. Add flour and mix well. Mix in raisins. Drop mixture from a tablespoon on heated greased frypan. Brown slowly on each side.

title: Schav(Sorrel Soup)
instructions: Slice potatoes very thin and cook in soup stock until tender. Add onion and cook a few minutes longer then add sorrel leaves carefully picked over washed and finely chopped. Cook only long enough to wilt. Add salt and pepper to taste. Beat egg yolks and add slowly to soup. Add sour cream and serve sprinkled with minced dill weed.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice and drain well. Then pour hot water over it and drain again. Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy and light colored. Mix all ingredients except rice and raisins. Pour in casserole dish and stir in rice and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. This is creamier if not overcooked.

title: One Cup Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate before serving. Allow time for flavor to blend overnight.

title: Wilderness Pie
instructions: Let cream cheese set at room temperature for 1 1/2 hours. Combine Cool Whip with cream cheese and mix well. Slice banana in bottom of crust. Pour mixture over bananas and top with cherries.

title: Chicken Asparagus Hot Dish
instructions: In large 9 x 13-inch pan or 3-quart casserole dish layer the above ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. The last 15 minutes of baking sprinkle chow mein noodles over top. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Cooked Salad Dressing
instructions: Cook the first 5 ingredients until thickened then add salt pepper and butter. Add salad dressing and mustard to taste. Excellent for potato salad.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Beat Ricotta until smooth adding 1 1/2 cups sugar and egg yolks mixing after each addition. Beat in flour and vanilla. Beat egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar. Fold whipped cream and egg whites into Ricotta and put into a 12-inch spring-form pan that already has been buttered and sprinkled with graham cracker crumbs. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for first 10 minutes. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour. Turn off heat and cool in oven with door closed. Top with fruits.

title: Quick And Easy Cake
instructions: Note Use applesauce in baking to cut back or cut the fat in the recipe. To do this replace some or all of the fat in baking recipes with applesauce.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook mushrooms and onion in butter until tender. Remove from skillet. In same skillet brown meat which has been cut into 1 1/2 x 1/2-inch strips. Reserve 1/3 cup of the bouillon. Stir in remaining bouillon ketchup garlic and salt. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Blend reserved bouillon and flour. Stir into meat mixture. Add mushrooms and onion. Heat to boiling. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Heart Healthy Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil and margarine in pan on top of stove over medium heat; add chicken pieces and sprinkle with Lawrys seasoned salt to taste. Stir-fry until done. While chicken is cooking drain the liquid from each vegetable and place vegetables in microwave-safe casserole dish and heat them in microwave for 3 minutes then drain the accumulated liquid. Add the vegetable mixture to the cooked rice. Serve the cooked chicken over the vegetable and rice mixture. Add soy sauce to taste. Really quick meal. Takes less time to prepare than it does to read this recipe!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook in water 9 minutes the broccoli until tender and drain. Mix broccoli rice and cheese and put in a dish. Add shredded cheese on top layer. Add crackers crumbled. Bake 1/2 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Toffee Trifle
instructions: Make devils food cake following instructions on box. Let cake cool and then cut into 1-inch squares. Mix dry pudding mixture with the milk and kahlua. Crush frozen Heath bars and put aside.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa. Add egg yolks and milk. Cook stirring constantly until thick and smooth. Add butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Beet Pickles
instructions: Cook beets with peelings. Peel and pack hot in hot sterile jars. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to each pint. Heat vinegar water and sugar to boiling. Pour over beets. Seal.

title: Frances' Green Party Salad
instructions: Place the Jell-O in top of double boiler. Add the boiling water. Place the double boiler over hot water. Stir until Jell-O dissolves. Add marshmallows and stir until they are completely dissolved. Add pineapple. Set aside until cool. Set in refrigerator. When it begins to congeal add the cream cheese and Dream Whip that have been whipped together. Pour into a sheet pan rinsed in cold water. Refrigerate until set.

title: Risengrot
instructions: Add rice to 1 1/2 quarts milk. Cook in double boiler. Add more milk as needed. Cook 2 hours. Stir frequently every 20 minutes. Twenty minutes before done add cinnamon and almond. Serve with pat of butter in center sprinkled with cinnamon and sugar. Whoever gets almond has good luck for coming year. Serve New Years Eve.

title: Mexicana Cornbread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add milk eggs margarine and onions mixing just until moistened. Stir in corn and cheese. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm 6 to 8 servings.

title: Scalloped Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In lightly greased 2-quart shallow baking dish arrange remaining ingredients; pour over potatoes. Bake uncovered 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Shortbread Drops
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Blend in egg yolk vanilla and salt. Mix well. Stir in flour. Mix in nuts and drop by small teaspoons onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until light brown on bottom. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Add bananas. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and nuts. Place in greased loaf pan. Bake 1 hour.

title: Peppered Steak
instructions: Use long strips of round steak put paprika on and let set. Cut peppers in strips. Cut up green onions and quarter the tomatoes. Cook rice. Brown garlic in butter in skillet with meat and cook until brown. Pour beef broth on steak after browned. Simmer this for 30 minutes. Add onions and peppers; cook for 10 minutes. Mix soy sauce water and cornstarch together and pour on top of skillet; thicken to a clear brown sauce. Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Put over rice and serve.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake in 2 layers (according to directions on package). Let layers get completely cold. Split each layer in half to make 4 layers.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix the corn bread part; add all other ingredients except cheese and 1/3 cup oil. Put this 1/3 cup oil in large skillet and add half of corn bread mixture. Cover with half the grated cheese; put the remaining corn bread in next and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until golden brown and bread is done about 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Swiss Tagliarini
instructions: Brown meat in hot oil. Stir in remaining ingredients (except noodles). Cover. Cook about 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook 10 to 15 minutes more. Cook noodles and drain. Add to mixture before serving. (Stir in grated cheese if desired.) Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Chop onion and fry with next 3 ingredients. Stir sweet milk salt and pepper to taste. Put in pan and put biscuits on top. Bake quickly. When biscuits are done all is done.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and water. Cook until thick and clear. Remove from heat and add lemon juice and food color. Let cool. Soften cream cheese with 1 Tbsp. milk. Using a spoon spread cream cheese all over bottom of cooked pie shell. Place cut up berries in the pie shell. Pour glaze over berries. Refrigerate to get cool. When ready to eat top with whipped cream or cool whip. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Company Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water; cool and let almost set. Add crushed pineapple marshmallows and bananas. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat pineapple juice. Add sugar flour and beaten egg. Cook until thick; let cool then fold in whipped cream. Spread over Jell-O mixture. Sprinkle shredded cheese over all. Chill and serve.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all and place in baking dish or casserole that has been greased. Place chicken on top of mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour 1 stick melted oleo over top of chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cover the last 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers lengthwise remove seeds and wash. Lightly mix beef rice onion salt pepper and 1 can tomato sauce. Fill pepper halves. Top with cheese and arrange close together in baking dish. Pour 1 can tomato sauce over peppers. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Orange Pound Cake
instructions: Sift together cake mix and jello; then add water eggs oil and orange flavoring. Mix with electric mixer for 3 to 5 minutes until smooth. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in Bundt pan.

title: Zesty Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients together and form a ball. Roll in crushed pecans and refrigerate.

title: Jackson Bread Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl mix bread milk eggs and vanilla. Let stand 10 minutes. Combine cranberries sugar and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil then simmer 5 minutes. Drain cranberries reserving the liquid to make the sauce. Add cranberries raisins and walnuts to the bread mixture. Pour into a well-greased 2-quart mold and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Add the cornstarch to the reserved liquid and cook until thickened. Spoon over the pudding when serving.

title: Mexican Layer Dip
instructions: Layer in 2-inch rectangle dish and refrigerate.

title: Sherry Chicken
instructions: This sauce will marinate 7 to 10 chicken breasts so I cut it in half a lot. When grilling be very careful not to overcook. Ten to 15 minutes for chicken tenders is plenty of time. I found that when grilling these the tenders do best.

title: Lois' Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugar Crisco eggs and vanilla. Add milk sifted flour baking powder and salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Cut Out Butter Cookies
instructions: Work sugar butter flour and baking powder together. Then add eggs and baking soda. Mix with beater. Chill dough. Roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes large amount.

title: Viva La Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in baking dish; let stand 12 hours or overnight. Bake in slow oven (300\u00b0) for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Reese'S Bars
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and put into a Pyrex baking dish. Melt chocolate chips and spread over peanut mixture.

title: Hot Dish
instructions: Combine the hamburger salt and celery. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients; pat into 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool. Mix pudding and spread evenly over cooled crust. Arrange bananas pineapple and Cool Whip in order given on top of pudding mixture; spread evenly. Refrigerate. Serves 8; each serving equals 1 bread 1/2 protein 1/2 fat 1/8 milk 3/4 fruit and 40 optional.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix orange juice and water together. Add Hawaiian Punch and ginger ale and mix well. Put sherbet in and let set for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Spareribs
instructions: Brown chopped onion in oil. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer sauce for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Melt 1 stick butter and combine with graham crackers. Pat into pan to form crust. Bake 6 minutes at 375\u00b0. Combine butter sugar and eggs. Beat until smooth. Spread over cooled crust. Drain pineapple thoroughly in colander. Spread over sugar mixture. Slice bananas and arrange over pineapple as next layer. Spread softened Cool Whip as top layer. Seal edges. May garnish with chopped nuts and maraschino cherries. Best when refrigerated overnight.

title: Aunt Fudie'S Devilish Food Cake
instructions: Pour 1 cup cold water over all. Mix well with fork. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Do not overbake.

title: Katie'S Mexican Dip
instructions: Peel and mash avocados with lemon juice. Spread in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Spread picante sauce over avocados. Mix refried beans with a few tablespoons of water; mix until easy to spread. Add baking soda and mix well. Spread over picante sauce. Vigorously stir sour cream to make a smoother consistency. Spread over refried beans.

title: Sauce Bordelaise
instructions: Saute diced onions in butter until lightly browned; add flour and mix thoroughly. Add bouillon; stir until smooth. Slowly mix in red cooking wine crushed garlic and chopped parsley.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Prepare vegetables into bite sized pieces. Keep separate. Heat wok with 1/4 teaspoon oil. Place onion in pot and stir a few times. Cover for 1 minute. Put broccoli and cauliflower into wok and stir frequently; add carrots. Cover for 2 to 5 minutes until the vegetables are a little cooked. Add remaining vegetables and stir-fry until mushrooms are moist and noncrunchy. You want to make sure you do not overcook. They need to be crisp. Put Ramen in 3 cups of water with 2 packages Oriental broth. Steam until noodles start to separate. Put into small amount of oil and brown. Add to vegetables and mix. Add soy sauce to taste. May add soy sauce to vegetables while cooking.

title: Pumpkin Pie Ice Cream(3 Pies)
instructions: Crush the graham crackers. Add melted butter 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon Knox gelatine. Press warm crumbs into pie pan and chill.

title: Blue Ribbon Teriyaki
instructions: Place beef cubes mushrooms and pineapple chunks alternately onto skewers. Marinate for 30 minutes in the following sauce and then broil basting with the sauce.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Press ground round in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with onions. Add Tater Tots. Pour soup over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in 1/4 cup apple juice. Combine with remaining juice in medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Stir in apple slices; coat well. Spoon into 9-inch pie crust. Sprinkle on spices. Top with remaining pastry. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Blueberry Pudding (Hinds)
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Heat slowly on simmer about 5 minutes. Pour melted butter over soft bread crumbs and stir into hot blueberries. Dont crush berries. Keep warm 1/2 hour but dont cook! Add a little lemon juice. Serve with ice cream.

title: Apple Something
instructions: Peel core and cut apple into 8-inch wedges. Roll each wedge of apple in a crescent roll (large end first). Place rolled apple wedges in a greased baking dish size 8 x 8-inch. Heat water sugar and margarine until it bubbles. Pour over rolled apple wedges. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: White Bean Chicken Chili
instructions: Cook chicken breasts lightly brown (about 45 minutes). Let chicken cool. When cool cut in bite size pieces. Put enough broth in soup pot to cover bottom. Saut onions and garlic in it. Add chilies to pot with beans and liquid. Stir well. Mix in cumin oregano and Tabasco. Add the rest of broth and the chicken. Turn heat up to a slight boil and stir. Turn heat down to medium-low. Cover with a lid and cook for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well by hand. Shape into small balls. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Pie(Mine)
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch spices and salt together. Add eggs to\tdry ingredients. Stir into pumpkin. Add milk and butter stirring to mix well. Add vanilla and stir. Pour into pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 until done. Dot top with butter.

title: Sour Cream Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter or oleo and sugar. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Sift flour 3 times; mix soda in sour cream. Add flour and sour cream alternately. Add flavoring; mix well. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Boil 2 or 3 minutes.

title: Coconut Shrimp
instructions: Peel devein and wash shrimp. Dry well on paper towels. Set aside. In a bowl mix all dry ingredients for batter. Add 2 tablespoons oil and ice water. Stir to blend.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Sift together dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add yeast and buttermilk to the sifted dry ingredients. Knead dough enough to hold together. Roll dough out to 1/2 inch thickness. Cut out biscuits with a biscuit cutter and fold in half as a pocket book. Let biscuits rise for 2 hours if they are left out after the dough is made 3 hours if they are refrigerated first. Brush with melted butter or margarine and bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Wally Punch
instructions: Mix together and serve over ice. For a less sweet version of this use grapefruit juice instead of pineapple.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour and sugar in a medium bowl; cut in shortening and butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add sweet potatoes and milk stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead 4 or 5 times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Potatoes can be sliced and cooked in water on top of stove until almost done to cut down on oven time. Slice potatoes and onions thick. Add milk to mushroom soup. Pour layer of potatoes and onions in buttered casserole alternately with soup. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Add paprika if desired. Also parsley flakes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and vanilla. Put in bread pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Watergate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix pudding milk and ice cream until stiff. Mix Ritz crackers butter and sugar until crumbly. Line 13 x 9-inch pan with crumbs. Save some crumbs for top. Pour in pudding mix and add rest of crumbs on top. Keep in refrigerator until firm. Can be topped with Cool Whip.

title: Vegetable Quick Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flours sugar baking powder cinnamon salt baking soda and ginger in large bowl. Cut shortening into dry ingredients with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in carrots nuts and dates. Beat eggs and milk together with fork; add to bowl and stir only until dry ingredients are moistened. Batter will be stiff. Pour batter into 2 well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool for 10 minutes in pan. Remove from pan and cool on rack before slicing.

title: Doughnut Muffins
instructions: Be careful in your selection. Do not choose too young. When selected give your entire thoughts to preparation for domestic use. Some wives insist upon keeping them in a pickle; others are constantly getting them into hot water. This may make them hard and sometimes bitter. Even poor varieties may be sweet tender and good by garnishing them with patience well sweetened with love and seasoned with kisses.

title: Veal Cutlets Parmesan
instructions: Dip cutlets in beaten eggs combined with seasonings then in mixture of Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Fry in butter or oil until brown (about 8 minutes). Then place cutlets in baking dish. Pour tomato sauce over them and add slices of Mozzarella cheese. Bake in moderate oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: American Chowder
instructions: Saute onions in margarine. Add potatoes water celery and seasonings. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce and simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are done. Gradually add a small amount of milk to flour. Blend. Add flour mixture to hot potatoes. Add remaining milk. Add Smok-Y Links and cheese. Heat through until cheese is melted stirring occasionally.

title: Poppy Seed Cole Slaw Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl and whip until smooth. Pour over cabbage and mix. Remaining sauce can be stored in refrigerator for extended period. Do not use anything other than \real mayonnaise or it will be lumpy.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Mix butter vanilla flour and nuts. Shape in balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Condensed Milk
instructions: Blend all ingredients together until in blender. Makes about 14 ounces. (This is like Eagle Brand milk.)

title: Lemon Saucelubbock, Texas
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch salt and nutmeg; gradually add water cook over low heat until thick and clear. Add butter and lemon juice blend thoroughly. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Top dough with any of your favorite toppings plus one can pizza sauce.

title: Seashell Or Macaroni Soup
instructions: Cook in large pot seashells or macaroni. Add quartered potatoes then remainder of ingredients. Let cook until done. Simmer on low heat. Serve with hot cornbread or crackers.

title: Old Fashioned Egg Pie(Like My Mother Used To Make)
instructions: Thoroughly mix eggs salt sugar vanilla and nutmeg. Slowly stir in hot milk; pour into unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Carefully place pie into oven. Bake in very hot oven (475\u00b0) for 5 minutes then reduce heat to 425\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes longer. Pie will set when completely cooled.

title: Hot Apple Cider
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pan over medium flame 10 to 15 minutes or simmer in crock-pot on high for 30 to 50 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Heat margarine and oil in a Dutch oven or large heavy saucepan. Add chicken and brown well. Add tomatoes chicken broth onion parsley salt pepper bay leaf and garlic. Cover and cook over low heat 25 minutes. Add rice and cook 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Add frozen peas and cook 10 minutes longer or until rice is tender and all the liquid is absorbed. Has 500 calories per serving.

title: Poor Man'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients heat until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients mix thoroughly. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Almond Curry Fruit
instructions: All fruits must be well drained. Place drained fruits in layers in a baking dish; sprinkle with almonds. Combine melted margarine brown sugar and curry powder mixing well; pour this mixture over fruit and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Taco Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger. Mix seasoning and sauce with hamburger. Add rice. In a large baking dish put one layer of rice mixture one layer of shredded cheese and one layer crushed taco chips. Keep alternating. Bake in moderate oven until cheese melts.

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375\u00b0. Melt butter then add sugar and eggs. Beat well. Add dry ingredients gradually. Roll into balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Alhoa Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken water chestnuts celery and almonds or pecans. Add mayonnaise and mix well. Chill. Serve on lettuce and top with pineapple.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 9-inch square baking dish. Combine first 4 ingredients. Set aside. Cream butter and eggs. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Sift together flour soda baking powder and salt. Alternately add sifted dry ingredients and sour cream to mixture. Pour 1/2 of batter into baking dish. Cover with half of nut topping. Add remaining batter. Top with remaining nut mixture. Bake approximately 40 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon and drain. Slice onion and brown in bacon drippings. Combine all other ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix water orange juice and sugar until boiling. Put tea and cloves in cloth and leave in mixture 1 minute (or until taste). Now mix in pineapple juice and serve. Do not re-boil only reheat.

title: Zucchini Bundt Cake
instructions: Beat cake mix eggs oil cinnamon and vanilla for 6 to 7 minutes. Fold in raisins and walnuts.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Mix onion eggs mushroom soup and Velveeta cheese in casserole dish. Cover with crackers and margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Pie
instructions: Combine and pour in greased Pyrex. Pour 1 quart fruit over batter and sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Grandma'S Salami
instructions: Mix all ingredients good. Form into 2 logs and roll in foil; twist ends good. Refrigerate 24 hours. Take out and boil in water 1 hour. Remove from kettle. Poke holes in foil to drain. Remove foil and when cooled enough to handle wrap in Saran Wrap and refrigerate. Ready to eat.

title: Cheese Bites
instructions: Spread bread with a layer of the pimento cheese. Roll bread slices up and cut into bite-sized pieces. Dip pieces into melted butter and roll in Parmesan cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Fig Preserves
instructions: Mix and cook until mixture thickens (about 30 minutes). Put in sterile jars and seal immediately.

title: Four Hour Stew
instructions: Sprinkle salt sugar and tapioca over meat. Add 1 cup tomato juice and crushed garlic. Put in casserole in layers. Bake at 250\u00b0. Add potatoes 1 hour before done. Push potatoes down into juice.

title: Linguini With Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Saute in a saucepan sliced mushrooms 1/2 diced onion 1/2 stick butter garlic to taste and salt to taste until slightly turning brown. Meanwhile cook (boil) linguini in pot with enough water to cover them with a touch of salt. Add 2 cups of cooking wine to saucepan and bring to a boil then simmer. Stir in 1/2 can of tomato paste to turn the sauce to a nice red color. Cook on low for 3 to 5 minutes. When linguini is finished cooking serve with mushroom sauce.

title: Puppy Chow For People
instructions: Melt together margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over Crispix or Chex cereal. Coat with powdered sugar. Lay out flat to dry about 5 minutes. Great for the holidays!

title: One Step Lasagne(Here'S My Favorite Heart Healthy-Vegetarian Recipe.)
instructions: Defrost and drain spinach. Mix 1 cup Mozzarella cheese Ricotta cheese spinach egg and oregano. Grease a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Layer starting with 1/2 jar spaghetti sauce; layer of noodles; 1/3 or 1/2 cheese mixture (depending on how many layers you wish to make). Repeat layering as above. Top with 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Pour 1 cup water over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Sweet Pepper Conserve
instructions: Put peppers through grinder. Drain liquid and rinse once. Add rest of ingredients. Cook until thick and jellied. Pack in sterile jars. Serve with meat.

title: Oyster Cracker Snacks
instructions: Put crackers in large brown paper bag. Mix other ingredients together and pour over crackers. Shake bag until thoroughly coated. Put crackers in bowl or container. Let stand a short while. Crackers will appear oily at first but oily appearance will soon disappear. Cover and store.

title: Peanut Butter-Fudge Cutouts
instructions: Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with waxed paper. Combine milk chips and butter in a heavy 3-quart saucepan. Stir constantly over low heat until chips and butter melt and mixture is smooth. Pour immediately into prepared pan. Spread evenly with wet metal spatula. Chill until firm at least 2 hours. Turn out onto flat surface; peel off waxed paper. Roll to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut in desired shapes pressing cookie cutters firmly into fudge. Decorate with colored sugars red cinnamon candies silver dragees tubes of red white and green decorating gel or whatever you like.

title: Black Forest Chocolate Bars
instructions: In large bowl combine all above ingredients. Stir until well blended with a wooden spoon. Spread in a greased and floured 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Saucy Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops on both sides in small amount of oil. Season with salt and pepper. Top with onion slices. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl then pour over chops. Cover and simmer 45 to 60 minutes according to recipe. I cover with tinfoil and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Kit Kat Bars
instructions: Boil together the margarine butter brown sugar white sugar and milk. Boil for 4 minutes. Add the graham cracker crumbs and boil for another minute. Line 1 layer of the Waverly crackers in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour 1/2 of the sauce over the crackers. Next add another layer of the Waverly crackers and pour the rest of the sauce on top. Add 1 more layer of the crackers. Melt the chocolate and butterscotch chips along with the peanut butter. Spread this mixture on top.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix melted margarine eggs and sugar. Add other ingredients. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Goodie
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and pour into 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Add all other ingredients in a separate bowl and mix until crumbly. Pour over apple mixture. Bake 40 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Serves 6.

title: Chicketti
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half; dip in egg. Roll in crumbs. In skillet brown chicken on both sides. Cover; cook over low heat until tender 30 to 40 minutes. Spoon a tablespoon of sauce on each chicken piece; top with cheese. Cover and heat until cheese melts.

title: Wood Chuck
instructions: Make a roux of flour and melted butter. Add milk. Cook to thicken. Add cheese and remove from heat. Stir until cheese melts. Saute mushrooms and celery in 2 teaspoons butter; add to sauce. Add turkey or chicken meat (cooked and diced) and 2 hard-boiled eggs (diced). Serve on plates over the Chinese noodles. Garnish with slices of the 3rd egg.

title: Granny Smith Apple Pie
instructions: Mix Bisquick sugar and egg until lumpy. Crumble over apples. Sprinkle apple pie spice (or cinnamon) over all. Take 1 stick melted margarine and drizzle over top. May add pecans. Bake until crispy. May add Cool Whip. (This recipe is from the kitchen of Becky Strain.)

title: Chicken In Wine
instructions: Brown cut up chicken coated with salt pepper and flour. Remove chicken to 3-quart casserole. In skillet add onions carrots and garlic. Cover and cook 5 to 10 minutes. Add mushrooms and Burgundy wine. Scrape up browned vegetables and simmer all together 2 to 3 minutes. Dip out solid pieces from skillet and alternate in the casserole in layers with the chicken adding 2 to 3 sprigs of parsley 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme celery leaves and one bay leaf to each layer. Pour the heated wine over the casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve with snipped parsley.

title: Saucepan Brownies
instructions: In saucepan melt butter and chocolate. Let cool. Add sugar vanilla and salt. Stir well. Add eggs (beat one at a time) flour and nuts. Stir well. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Frost with chocolate frosting.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients. After spreading the topping sprinkle with 1 cup of finely chopped nuts.

title: Spinach Souffle
instructions: Mix together spinach souffle eggs milk onion mushrooms and Swiss cheese. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pressed Chicken(Salad Type)
instructions: Boil chicken or stewing hen well until meat is done and falls off the bones. Remove chicken from bones and chop into small pieces. Use boiled down juice; skim off fat from chicken broth. Add gelatin. Pour over chicken; mix well and chill.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onions and green peppers in margarine. Mix other ingredients. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in pie shell. Dot with butter or margarine. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Rice Pilaf
instructions: Finely chop first 4 ingredients and saute in butter and olive oil. Set aside. Add spices and soy sauce. Cook rice according to directions. Chop tomatoes and scallions fine. Rinse and drain pimientos and chop fine.

title: Million Dollar Pickles
instructions: Slice pickles. Make a brine of the boiled water and salt. Let cool. Put over pickles. Let stand for 7 days with weight on top.

title: Harvey'S Cole Slaw House
instructions: Shred cabbage and place in a wide mouth jar or glass dish. Add chopped onions and sugar (and carrots if desired).

title: Broccoli Sausage Luncheon(Serves 4)
instructions: Press sausage into the base of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Cover with sauce broccoli onion and green pepper. Sprinkle with bacon and cheese. Beat eggs with milk. Pour mixture over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until set. Serve immediately.

title: Golden Pound Cake
instructions: Put cake mix in a large bowl. Add eggs orange juice oil and pudding mix to cake mix in place of ingredients called for on package. Mix as directed on package. Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 45 to 50 minutes. Cool 1 hour before removing from pan.

title: Quick And Easy Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Cook spaghetti noodles. Cook chicken patties 2 at a time in microwave. Cover patties while cooking. Let them stand in microwave 3 minutes. Heat spaghetti sauce on stove or in microwave. Then put chicken (with Provolone cheese on top) onto plate. Put spaghetti noodles beside the chicken and cover with spaghetti sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Ground Turkey Stir-Fry
instructions: One cup of uncooked kashi may be substituted for brown rice.

title: Shrimp And Rice
instructions: Clean and devein shrimp; sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce. Roll in mixture of flour and paprika. Melt butter in large skillet. Add celery green pepper and onion. Cook over low heat about 5 minutes. Add shrimp; increase heat and cook about 5 minutes more or until flour browns and shrimp turns pink. Add hot rice and a small amount of water if needed. Fry bacon until crisp; crumble and add with bacon drippings to shrimp. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Lucy'S Roast
instructions: Place roast in large baking bowl or pan. Pour broth over roast and sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Cover baking dish. Cook roast for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Turn oven heat down to 250\u00b0 and cook until roast is tender. A large roast will take at least 4 hours. Place carrots and peeled halved potatoes around roast for the last hour of cooking. Uncover the roast periodically while cooking and ladle broth over meat to keep tender.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli and cauliflower until half done (you can steam or boil). Place florets and stalks in the bottom of a casserole dish. Layer one can of onion rings on top of vegetables. Beat together soup milk salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables. Top with remaining can of onion rings. Bake uncovered for about 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Spinach Orange Salad
instructions: In large bowl tear spinach and lettuce into bite-size pieces; add oranges and walnuts. In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour over salad and toss to coat. Cover. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Josh And Todd'S Favorite Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add lemon or vanilla extract and blend well. Add eggs one at a time and continue beating. Add baking powder and salt. Add flour and milk alternately to mixture. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Date Nut Balls
instructions: Melt butter sugar dates and vanilla in a double boiler. Cook for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Then add remaining ingredients. Let cool. Roll into small balls and shake in confectioners sugar.

title: Pop'S Punch
instructions: Mix Sauterne and brandy and chill. Chill soda water and champagne. Pour Sauterne-brandy over a block of ice in a punch bowl. Just before serving add chilled soda and champagne. Makes about 25 servings.

title: Crunchy Granola
instructions: Brown oatmeal wheat germ coconut and sesame seed in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Stir well to coat and roast for 5 minutes more. Its great with yogurt poured over it!

title: Super Nachos
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In skillet brown meat and onion; pour off fat. Add beans chilies chili powder hot pepper sauce and 2 cups shredded cheese spread. Cook until cheese melts. Arrange chips on baking sheet. Top with meat and remaining 2 cups cheese spread. Bake for 10 minutes. Garnish as desired.

title: Lettuce Salad
instructions: Mix Ranch dressing and mayonnaise according to directions; chill thoroughly.

title: Sally'S Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Mix yeast in 1 cup warm water with 2 tablespoons sugar. Mix remaining water and sugar. Mix with oleo salt and eggs. Mix in 4 cups flour. Mix in yeast mixture. Add remaining flour. Knead. Let rise in warm oven. Divide dough in half. Roll out 1/2; spread with oleo brown sugar and cinnamon. Cut into small slices. Put in greased jelly roll pan. Repeat with other half. (Should fill 2 jelly roll pans.) Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Do not overbake. Ice with powdered sugar glaze.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and sugar. In separate bowl stir together pineapple cranberry sauce and nuts. Add to cream cheese mixture. Gently stir in topping. Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Cover with heavy-duty foil and freeze. Slice frozen salad into 3/4-inch slabs and serve on a bed of lettuce. Makes 12 servings.

title: Finger Salad
instructions: Roll out crescent rolls onto baking sheet. Bake according to package directions. Let cool. Mix dressing cream cheese and mayonnaise until creamy. Spread onto top of rolls. Cut into squares. Place finely chopped vegetables and cheese on top. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Frozen Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix soup and yogurt together. Add remaining ingredients. Place in 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening until mealy. Add yeast to buttermilk. Add to flour mixture. Knead lightly. Roll and cut or refrigerate for later use. May be kept 8 to 10 days covered in refrigerator. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. If rolled thin this can be used as a delicious pizza crust or makes delicious cinnamon rolls. Spread with melted butter and a mixture of cinnamon and half brown and half white sugar. Roll in log and cut placing cut side down on greased pan. Upon removing from oven immediately cover with glaze of powdered sugar and warm water with a drop or two of almond or vanilla extract.

title: Creamy Baked Mashed Potatoes(Microwave)
instructions: In lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish thoroughly combine all ingredients except cheese. Microwave on High 7 minutes turning casserole twice. Top with remaining cheese. Let stand covered 5 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Simmer all ingredients in large pot for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Orange Frost
instructions: Pour orange juice in blender. Add packet of frost mix and ice. Blend on high for about 30 seconds. Makes about 30 to 32 fluid ounces.

title: Sugarless Apple Pie(Diabetic)
instructions: Peel and cut up apples; add apple juice. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 5 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in small amount of water. Stir into apple mixture and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 10 to 15 minutes until apples are done. Stir in cinnamon. Dot margarine over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until crust is brown and filling bubbly.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Cook ground beef; drain. Add sauce and cook until hot. Spread small amount of sauce in 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer cooked noodles sauce cottage cheese and Swiss cheese; sprinkle Parmesan cheese. Repeat. Try to have 3 layers.

title: Low-Fat, Low-Sugar Butterscotch Pumpkin Pie(For Dad)
instructions: With whisk in large bowl beat together until smooth cream cheese 1 tablespoon evaporated skim milk and sugar substitute. Fold in whipped topping. Spread mixture in bottom of crust.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into a 10 inch pie plate sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Doubly Good Refrigerator Yeast Rolls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Beat 2 minutes on low speed of electric mixer. Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Beat 3 minutes with a heavy duty electric mixer at medium speed. Add yeast mixture and beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85\u00b0) free from drafts for 3 hours or until doubled in bulk.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add soups; mix. Add rice and water. Place chicken breasts dipped in butter on top of mixture. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Penny Saving Recipe For Ranch Style Salad Dressing Mix
instructions: This recipe makes enough mix for 8 cups of dressing. Place all ingredients in jar. Cover and shake well. Store in cupboard.

title: Chocolate Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar. Add egg yolks 1 at a time beating after each addition. Sift flour soda and cocoa together. Add alternately with buttermilk mix well. Stir in vanilla coconut and pecans. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in 3 greased layer pans at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Hill'S Baked Beans
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cook for 5 hours on high or 8 hours on low in a crock-pot. Remove the lid and sit on high for the last hour to thicken beans. Add hot sauce or peppers for hot beans (to taste).

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Boil celery potatoes carrots and onions together in 2 cups water in Dutch oven or large kettle until tender. Add remaining ingredients except noodles; cook 30 to 60 minutes. The longer it cooks the better it tastes. Add noodles 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Can be put in hot jars and canned or put in freezer.

title: Baked Asparagus
instructions: Arrange asparagus in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with salt pepper garlic and parsley. Pour oil all over. Cover with aluminum foil. Prick holes in foil. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Uncover and cook an additional 15 minutes. Serves 4. Buon appetito.

title: Easy Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough; gently smooth dough into a ball on floured surface. Knead 20 times. Pat dough on bottom and up sides of pan (or roll out on cookie sheet). Pinch side 3/4 inch edge. Cook and stir beef onion salt and garlic until beef is brown and drain. Mix tomato sauce and Italian seasoning; spread over dough. Spread beef over sauce. Add mushrooms green peppers and cheese. Bake until crust browns 20 minutes.

title: Creme Brulee
instructions: 1. Heat cream and vanilla with half of the sugar until it reaches 170 degrees simmer.

title: Magic Marshmallow Meltaways
instructions: Separate rolls and place one marshmallow in center. Wrap dough all around pinching closed. Dip in melted margarine then roll in cinnamon/sugar. Bake in slightly greased muffin tin at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Stir together peanut butter and margarine. Gradually add sugar. Stir well. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls and place on wax paper. Let dry. Melt coating and cool a little. Dip balls into coating. Let excess drip off. Place on wax paper. Makes about 25.

title: Alaskan Sheet Cake
instructions: Boil water and margarine. Add flour sugar and salt. In a small bowl beat eggs buttermilk soda and vanilla. Add first mixture. Bake in greased jelly roll pan 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix then cover with cracker crumbs and pour over 1/4 cup butter. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Macadamia Nut Chiffon Pie
instructions: Mix gelatin sugar and salt. Beat together egg yolks cold milk and water. Stir into gelatin mixture and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Chill stirring occasionally until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold nuts and whipped cream into mixture and add vanilla. Pour into cooled pie shell. Chill until firm. Then top with additional whipped cream and sprinkle with Macadamia nuts.

title: Lazy Daisy Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until thick. Add sugar gradually beating constantly. Add vanilla. Sift together flour salt and baking powder. Add to first mixture; mix well. Heat to boiling point milk and 1 tablespoon butter. Add at once to mixture. Beat well. Do not add any more flour the batter is very thin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. When cake is done remove from oven and spread with blended mixture of melted butter brown sugar and cream.

title: Fruit Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and add enough water to make a gallon.

title: Betty'S Pink Shower Punch(Makes Thirty 7 Ounce Cups)
instructions: Serve with floating ring of ice. To make other flavors (colors) substitute other flavors Kool-Aid and sherbet.

title: Dilled Carrots
instructions: Cook first 6 ingredients until carrots are tender (about 15 minutes). Drain. Add yogurt and dill; heat briefly.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Beat sugar eggs and vanilla and spoon on top of crust. Lay bananas on top. Spread Cool Whip over bananas. Spread pineapple on top. Pecans and cherries may be added if desired.

title: No Roll Pastry Shell
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into pie pan. Combine milk and oil in cup. Whip with fork and pour all at once over flour mixture. Mix until flour is completely dampened. Press evenly with fingers to line bottom of pan and up the sides. Be sure dough is pressed to uniform thickness. To flute Prick entire surface. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. For unbaked shell Fill as desired and bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Sunshine Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix all together except pineapple and broccoli. Cover chill and toss together just before serving. Makes 20 cups.

title: Chicken And Wine
instructions: Place chicken in Pyrex dish with skin side up. Pour cans of soup over chicken. Add dash of salt and pepper on top of each chicken breast. Pour both wines over chicken. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours and 15 minutes uncovered. Use liquid to make gravy.

title: Seared Pork Loin And Blackberries
instructions: Place sugar 2 tablespoons butter vinegar and onions in heavy skillet over medium-low heat. Stir to coat well. Cook uncovered 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Mix other ingredients together in separate bowl and combine the 2 mixtures. Grease and flour 2 large loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beignets(Kind Of Like Elephant Ears)
instructions: Pour boiling water over sugar salt and shortening then add the cream. Let mixture stand until warm (not hot). Separately sprinkle yeast over warm water in a bowl. Let stand until dissolved then add shortening mixture. Mix well. Add 2 cups of flour and eggs; beat until well combined. Add just enough of remaining flour to make dough soft and not sticky. Put dough on lightly floured surface. Pat into rectangle about 1-inch thick. Use rolling pin to roll 1/4-inch thick. Cut into 2-inch squares. Heat oil to 360\u00b0 in large skillet or pot. Fry to crispy brown on all sides. Drain on paper towels. Dust with powdered sugar. Best right away.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Combine drained pineapple mandarin oranges and cottage cheese. Put dry jello over mixture and stir. Fold in Cool Whip and put in bowl. Chill.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press rolls into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake until brown. Cool. Mix cream cheese minced onion dill weed and mayonnaise. Spread cream cheese mixture over cooled crescent rolls. Sprinkle your choice of fresh vegetables over cream cheese. Press in lightly.

title: Syllabub
instructions: Beat together until sugar is dissolved and mixture is frothy. Serve immediately. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Zesty Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients; cool for 1 hour before serving.

title: Pickled Squash
instructions: Slice squash and onions thin. Cover with water. Add salt and let stand 2 hours. Drain. Mix spices and sugar then add vinegar. Bring to a boil. Add squash and onions and let stand 2 hours. Bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Put in hot jars. They seal by themselves.

title: Crabbies
instructions: Split muffins. Mix other ingredients and spread on 12 muffin halves. Cut each muffin half into sixths. Broil until bubbly. Can be made ahead and frozen.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in butter. Mix with mayonnaise eggs flour and milk. Mix in crab meat and half of cheese. Pour into pie crust and put remaining cheese on top of quiche. You can make your own pie crust or buy one. Bake in crust for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Silver Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cream shortening with the sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add the dry ingredients and milk alternately in small amounts beating well after each addition. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter. Pour into 3 greased 8-inch round pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon French Bread
instructions: Combine lemon rind and garlic powder with margarine. Spread on bread and toast until lightly browned.

title: Dressing For Potato Salad
instructions: Mix well and pour over potatoes. Then mix again until potatoes are covered.

title: Rhubarb Upside Down Cake
instructions: Mix together egg sugar flour baking powder vanilla salt and milk. Mix together in bottom of cast-iron skillet the 2 Tbsp. melted butter and brown sugar. Put about 2 cups rhubarb over mixture in skillet. Pour batter over rhubarb. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes. Remove from oven let sit a few minutes. Turn skillet upside down on cake plate. Cake will come right out.

title: Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cut bread slices into 4 squares. Fit 1/3 of bread tightly in bottom of greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with salt and pepper 1/3 of onion and 1/3 of cheese. Press down repeat instructions twice. Beat eggs add mustard Worcestershire sauce and milk. Mix well. Pour over casserole contents cover and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 2 hours before serving and drizzle with melted butter. One hour before serving bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until firm in center. (If you double this recipe use only 5 cups milk.) Serves 8.

title: Mama'S Best Turkey
instructions: You will need 1 large size Reynolds oven cooking bag.

title: Matt'S Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken to about 4/5 the way done. Mix in bowl honey lime juice teriyaki sauce garlic and ginger. Add sauce to chicken and green onion. Serve over rice.

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Combine in mixing bowl first 4 ingredients. Beat well and stir in chocolate chips. Set aside. In another bowl mix flour 1 cup sugar cocoa baking soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add 1 cup water oil vinegar and vanilla. Fill muffin cups 1/3 to 1/2 full with chocolate batter. Top each with 1 heaping teaspoonful of cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Tuna Patties
instructions: Beat egg well. Grate potato and onion and add to the beaten egg. Add tuna bread crumbs salt and pepper; mix well. Make into 5 patties. Then saute in small amount of butter or oil until brown on both sides.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Salt zucchini; let sit for 30 minutes. Rinse and drain. Butter a 4-quart dish. Layer 1/2 zucchini 1/2 tomatoes 1/2 cheese and 1/2 bread. Start again. Bake until zucchini is tender about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwave Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: Combine morsels in 1 3/4-quart or larger microwave casserole and microwave at 50% power (covered) 4 to 6 minutes. Stir and add peanut butter halfway through cooking time. Stir in peanuts and drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper or into small paper cups. Refrigerate until set.

title: Red Sour Cherry Salad
instructions: Strain juice from cherries and boil juice with sugar until sugar dissolves. Pour over 2 packages of gelatin and stir until gelatin dissolves. Add 2 cups of water orange juice and rind lemon juice and rind the cherries and pineapple. Chill until partially thickened. Stir in nuts. Pour into pan mold. Chill until firm.

title: Green Fried Tomatoes
instructions: Slice tomatoes 1/4 inch thick and dip in egg mixture then into bread crumbs. Fry in butter and oil until brown on both sides.

title: Cranberry Cookie Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium size saucepan melt margarine over moderate heat. Remove from heat. Beat in sugars egg and vanilla with a wooden spoon until smooth. Stir in flour and baking powder salt and cinnamon until thoroughly combined. Stir in cranberries and nuts. Grease bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Press batter evenly into pan. Bake 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Pronto Pie
instructions: Mix condensed milk lemon juice and Cool Whip together until it thickens. Fold in drained crushed pineapple. Refrigerate for 5 hours or until pie thickens.

title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar and melt. Add syrup and mix well. Add over sliced sweet potatoes in layers. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake 30 to 45 minutes until syrup thickens and forms glaze.

title: Snicker Bar Dessert
instructions: Soften ice cream in big bowl. Add topping and beat. Add peanut butter and mix in. Add pudding and thoroughly blend. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch pan and freeze well. Cut into squares and serve frozen. Makes 8 servings; each serving equals 1/4 milk 1/2 fruit 1/2 protein 1/2 fat and 40 optional calories.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
instructions: Peel and slice cucumbers very thin. Sprinkle salt on top. Mix well. Invert plate on top of cucumbers. Put something real heavy on plate for about 2 hours. This will get the water and bitterness out. Rinse cucumbers well and drain. Peel and slice onion thinly. Add whipping cream and half of the half and half. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Ham And Scalloped Potatoes
