instructions: Toss sliced potatoes in 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar and 1 cup water. Drain. Put half of ham potatoes and onions in crock-pot. Sprinkle with salt and pepper then grated cheese. Repeat with remaining half. Spoon undiluted soup over top. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or 4 hours on high.

title: Celery Delight
instructions: Cook celery in salted water (boiling) for 8 minutes; drain. Combine celery undiluted soup pimentos and water chestnuts. Turn into 6-cup casserole. Heat butter until hot; add almonds and stir until pale brown. Scatter over casserole; scatter crumbs over top (can be mixed with almonds if desired first). Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Fried Chicken
instructions: Wipe chicken well with damp paper towels. Combine flour ginger salt and pepper in paper bag. Shake chicken in mixture coating well. Brown chicken in butter turning often. Combine pineapple soy sauce and water; pour over chicken. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes or until tender. Serve with rice.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: In a small saucepan combine cornstarch and water. Add sugar soy sauce vinegar garlic ground ginger and pepper. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until mixture thickens and bubbles. Brush the chicken (split in halves lengthwise) with soy mixture. Place chicken halves skin side down in greased shallow baking pan. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Brush with soy mixture every 10 minutes. Turn chicken skin side up. Bake for 30 minutes. Brush occasionally. Drain pineapple and add during last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Roman Noodles
instructions: Combine onion green pepper and oil in a 2-quart casserole. Cook in microwave on Full power for 2 to 3 minutes until onion and green pepper are tender. Stir in mushrooms with liquid tomato sauce and seasonings. Cook in microwave covered on Full power for 3 minutes and heated through. Stir in noodles and water. Cook in microwave covered on Full power for 9 to 12 minutes until noodles are tender. Stir halfway through cooking time. Stir in the peas. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving. Serves about 4 to 5 people.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Combine tomatoes onion salt pepper sugar basil and oregano. Butter baking dish and alternate layers of tomato mixture and bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake in a hot oven 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Mix and cook together until thick about 20 minutes. Stir while cooking.

title: Strawberries Devonshire
instructions: In a small mixer bowl combine cream cheese sugar salt and 2 tablespoons whipping cream; beat until fluffy. Whip remaining cream; fold into cream cheese mixture. Serve with fresh strawberries.

title: Sour Cream Pastries
instructions: With pastry blender cut butter or margarine into flour until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Combine egg yolk and sour cream; blend into flour mixture. Chill dough several hours or overnight. Divide dough into 4 portions keeping each part refrigerated until ready to use. Roll each part to 10-inch circle on floured surface. Spread 2 tablespoons apricot preserves. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons coconut and 1 tablespoon nuts. Cut each circle into wedges and roll into crescent. Sprinkle with sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool on rack. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix and cream shortening sugar and eggs. Sift flour cinnamon baking powder baking soda and salt. Add sifted mixture alternately with sour milk a bit at a time to creamed mixture until all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in 8 x 8-inch pan.

title: Layered Nacho Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans in bottom of 2-quart dish. Mix taco seasoning with sour cream and spread on top of beans. Drain olives and green chilies. Layer remaining ingredients on top of sour cream ending with cheese on top. Refrigerate. Serve cold with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Spinach
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in greased casserole. Bake uncovered at 350 for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Double Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In a small saucepan combine butter sugar and water; bring just to a boil. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup chips and vanilla. Stir until chips melt and mix is smooth. Transfer to a large bowl. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Slowly add flour mixture. Stir in the rest of the chips. Spread into a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 16 squares.

title: Squash Dish
instructions: Mix soup onion carrot and sour cream. Add to mashed squash. Mix dressing with margarine. Add half to squash mixture. Add other half to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cornbread Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Crumble cornbread into a large mixing bowl. Add corn tomatoes onions and peas. Mix until evenly moist. Add ham and mix thoroughly. Stuff mixture into bell peppers. Place in large glass baking dish. Spoon excess stuffing around peppers and place 1 strip bacon on top of each pepper. Bake 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute medium onion in butter. Add flour. In another boiler heat 4 cups chicken stock and milk. When hot add to flour. Boil green onions carrots and celery until tender; drain some. Add Cheez Whiz and mustard.

title: Hobo Dinner
instructions: Note Need 1 square foil about 10 x 10-inches.

title: Mixed Vegetable Medley
instructions: Heat vegetables and water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan; reduce heat. Cover and cook over low heat until vegetables are tender. Drain. Stir remaining ingredients.

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients. Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: French Fries
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch wide sticks. Place in old water (ice) about 30 minutes. Pat dry. Place potatoes in plastic bag with other ingredients. Shake to coat. Arrange on large cookie sheet in a single layer. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring once or twice until golden brown.

title: Salmon Cheese Pate
instructions: Combine ingredients; sprinkle with parsley sprigs and refrigerate.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread crescent rolls out on a cookie sheet. Layer the rest of the ingredients on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Bacon-Broccoli Salad
instructions: Fry bacon and crumble. Add all other ingredients. The mayonnaise and sugar should be mixed together before adding.

title: Finger Salad(Vegetable Pizza)
instructions: *Broccoli cauliflower carrots peppers celery Cheddar cheese (grated for the topping) olives (if desired) or any other vegetables desired.

title: Cheri-Nut Gems
instructions: Soften butter; blend with sugar and cocoa. Mix well then add peanut butter and vanilla. Mix. Add cereal and chopped nuts; stir into sugar mixture. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Cherry Enchiladas
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar water and vanilla. Warm tortillas. Place one teaspoon of filling on tortilla and roll up. Place each rolled up tortilla on 9 x 13-inch baking pan sprayed with Pam. Pour mixture of butter sugar water and vanilla on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cherry Supreme Cake
instructions: For cake mix ingredients in order given. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes in tube pan.

title: Chocolate Pecan Toffee
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan melt butter over lowest possible heat. Remove from heat and add sugar; stir until well blended. Return to low heat and stir rapidly and thoroughly with a rubber scraper and continuously scrape the side and bottom of pot until the mixture reaches a full boil. When the mixture reaches a full boil add the corn syrup and water and mix well. Cover the pan for a few minutes to allow steam to dissolve any sugar crystals which may have formed on the side of the pan. Remove cover and with a pastry brush dipped in just a little bit of water wash down the sides of the pan to remove any crystals that may still be there.

title: Great Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown round steak after flouring in pan with oil and onions. Mix meat and all other ingredients together and cook for 1 hour. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oats cook on medium heat until boiling. Let boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat and blend in oats. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Tuna Sandwich Melts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except buns. Fill buns with 1/3 cup tuna mixture. Wrap in foil. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Makes 6 sandwiches.

title: Okra Pickles
instructions: Wash and pack okra down in hot sterilized jars. Put a garlic bud some hot pepper pieces and some dill seed in each jar. Bring vinegar water and salt to a boil; pour into jars and seal at once. Let ripen for several weeks before opening. Makes 4 to 5 pints.

title: Firecracker Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Cook together meat chili powder salt and onion. Drain after browning then cook 10 minutes. Spoon into 12 x 9-inch baking dish. Layer Ranch Style beans then tortillas (small pieces) then Ro-Tel and then cheeses (shredded). Spread soup over top of casserole; cover. Bake at 250\u00b0 to 300\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Oven-Fried Potato Skins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425\u00b0. Using a fork prick the potatoes. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until tender. Cut the potatoes lengthwise into quarters. Scoop out the pulp with a small spoon leaving 1/4-inch thick shells. Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Place the potato shells on the sheet with the skin sides down. Spray the potatoes with the nonstick spray. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp. Sprinkle the Monterey Jack cheese and Cheddar cheese on the potatoes then bake about 2 minutes more or until the cheeses are melted. Sprinkle with the green onions and serve.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together and place in a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spicy Cranberry Relish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; stir until well blended. Chill until ready to serve. Serve with meat. Makes 4 1/2 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour soda and salt. In a mixing bowl beat margarine. Add peanut butter and sugars. Beat until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Then add dry ingredients. Shape dough into balls and place on cookie sheet. Crisscross with tines of fork. Sprinkle with sugar if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: In saucepan heat beets and juice on low heat. Add sugar vinegar and pickling spice to taste. Stir until sugar dissolves. Let cool. Pour over eggs. Cover and store in refrigerator for several days until eggs are pickled as desired.

title: Andy'S Infamous Butter Cake
instructions: Beat together cake mix 2 eggs and margarine. Pat into greased cookie sheet. Mix together cream cheese 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour over first mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Mix in blender at high speed. Makes 1 quart.

title: Santa Fe Trail Corn Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and mix well. Add rest of ingredients and mix just until dry ingredients are moistened. Bake in well-greased 8-inch pan at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until center tests done.

title: Sourdough Starter And Bread
instructions: Mix these 3 ingredients and put in a quart jar. Leave Starter on the counter for 4 to 5 days. Set in refrigerator for 3 days. Take out of refrigerator and feed with the same 3 ingredients as listed. Let set out for 8 to 12 hours. Throw away 1 cup and refrigerate again for 3 days. Take out of refrigerator and feed again. Leave out 8 to 12 hours. Throw away 1 cup; refrigerate again for 3 days then take out and feed again. Leave out 8 to 12 hours. This is the third feeding so youre ready to take out a cup and make the bread. Return the remaining to refrigerator and feed every 3 to 5 days with the 3 ingredients to keep the Sourdough Starter usable. After each feeding either throw away 1 cup or make bread to give to a neighbor.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: Melt shortening in heavy skillet. Add onion; cook until brown. Add ground beef; brown. Stir often so there will be no lumps of meat. Add pepper tomato soup salt chili powder black and red pepper and kidney beans. Heat mixture thoroughly; serve piping hot. Serves 6.

title: Butter Crumb Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder and sugar. Combine butter with dry ingredients crumbling with fingertips. Take off 3/4 cup of mixture for crumbs for top then add well beaten egg milk and vanilla gradually. Stir thoroughly. Pour into well-buttered loaf pan. Add crumbs to top and sprinkle cinnamon over crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: New England Crab Spread
instructions: Mix cream cheeses together. Spread on bottom of 9-inch serving plate. Combine remaining ingredients except the crabmeat. Spread over cheese. Spread crabmeat over sauce and garnish with parsley. It should look like a pizza when finished. Chill 1 to 2 hours before serving with crackers.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Prepare Jell-O per box directions in a large bowl. Place in refrigerator while preparing other ingredients. In another large bowl place cranberry sauce cream cheese celery pineapple and nuts. Mix and pour into the Jell-O. Its more solid if made the night before or after combining all ingredients you can pour into a rectangular shallow pan and cut into small squares. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except grapes. Add grapes. Stir. Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix flour thoroughly with sugar add slightly beaten eggs. Add butter and salt to sugar mixture. Add syrup and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into prepared pie crust and bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake for 50 minutes.

title: 7 Can Soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large pan. Heat on medium heat until hot. Delicious with grilled cheese sandwiches on cold winter evenings!

title: Cherry Fluff Salad
instructions: Beat together milk and Cool Whip. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and chill.

title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt butter over low heat; blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring until smooth; remove from heat. Stir in milk and cheese. Bring to a boil stirring constantly until thickened. Arrange alternate layers of ham potatoes and broccoli in a 2-quart casserole. Pour sauce over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and sugar together; add milk. This will make a medium batter. Add 1/2 cup sugar to 2 cups fresh peaches or a No. 2 can of peaches with tapioca. Melt 1 stick of butter or margarine in a baking dish; add peaches and tapioca. Pour batter over top of peaches and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until batter is golden brown approximately 15 to 30 minutes depending on oven.

title: Yellow Squash Puffs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Drop by teaspoon into hot oil. Deep fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towel.

title: Skillet Barbecue Chicken And Rice
instructions: Brown chicken in hot oil. Stir in barbecue sauce water corn and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add flour and salt. Add vanilla. Gradually stir in pineapple. Grease the bottom of a tube pan. Add batter; bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until cake tests done.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans. In large bowl stir together flour baking soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Combine all other ingredients and add to dry ingredients. Stir just to moisten. Stir in nuts. Spoon into prepared pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool in pans 10 minutes and remove to rack to cool.

title: Potato Salad Dressing
instructions: In saucepan add flour mustard sugar salt and eggs. Beat until smooth. Add cream and beat then add vinegar a little at a time. Cook over a pan of boiling water or stir constantly over medium heat until mixture thickens. When cool pour over cooked diced potatoes onions celery seed and boiled eggs. Mix thoroughly.

title: Freezer Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Clean and drain strawberries. Add 2 cups sugar and cook at low heat until sugar dissolves then boil for 3 minutes hard. Stir often then add 2 cups sugar and boil 2 minutes longer. Cool and freeze.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hominy Casserole
instructions: One can of Cheddar cheese soup can be substituted for the Cheez Whiz.

title: Extra Special Baked Chicken
instructions: Run cold water over dried beef; drain. Arrange in bottom of 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Place halved chicken breasts over beef. Top each half with a slice of bacon.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: In a large bowl stir together sugar nonfat milk powder and creamer powder. Sift in cocoa. Stir to thoroughly blend all ingredients. Fill a 1-quart size jar with mixture. Insert vanilla bean down center of jar to add flavor. Screw on jar cap tightly. Store in a cool dry place.

title: Johnsonville Sausage And Potato Skillet
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet. Add sausage onion hash browns bell pepper black pepper and garlic. Saute over medium heat for 9 to 11 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Transfer to a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or cast-iron skillet. Spread condensed soup evenly over vegetable mixture. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle parsley and fried onions on top. Serves 8. Preparation time 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Let drain then cut into 3/4-inch slices. Combine soup and sour cream; mix in shredded carrots. Add squash and onion to soup and cream mixture (do not mash). Use about 3/4 pack of dressing. Add melted margarine to stuffing and mix. In casserole put layer of stuffing then spoon squash mixture on top. Add another layer of stuffing mix on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: In a medium-large bowl cut margarine into dry cake mix until crumbly. Mix in coconut. Spray nonstick spray on a 9 x 13-inch aluminum baking pan. Pat dry cake mixture lightly into pan (dont press) building up edges slightly. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Arrange apples on warm crust. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Mix sour cream and egg. Drizzle over all. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until light brown. Serve warm or chilled. Refrigerate leftovers. Also delicious using fresh peach slices.

title: Easy Cherry Cake
instructions: Put can of pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over the top of filling. Lay slices of oleo over mix. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (Blueberry or apple pie filling may be used.)

title: Bibingka(Baked Mochi Flour)
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Combine fresh milk and coconut milk. Add to dry ingredients. Fold in tsubushian. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut into desired serving size. Serve either hot or cold.

title: Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Thaw and drain the broccoli and place in the bottom of pie plate. Sprinkle with onion and cheese. Place milk Bisquick mix eggs salt and pepper in a blender. Cover and whirl for 15 seconds or else beat with hand mixer. Pour into pie plate. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 20 or 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Have butter standing in mixing bowl at room temperature. Beat sugar into butter with electric mixer. Add egg and beat well. Resift flour with baking powder. Adding 1/4 at a time blend flour into beaten mixture. Line cookie sheets with foil. Use cookie press. Decorate with red green or other sprinkle sugars. Bake at 375 degrees for 8 - 10 minutes. Makes about 100 cookies.

title: 1000 Calorie Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding as directed substituting Carnation cream instead of milk. Add water mixing until firm. Add cream cheese and mix. Fold in Cool Whip and add pineapple. Chill.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Fill greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 25 minutes or until lightly browned. For corn muffins bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix together. Pour into a graham cracker crust. Chill about 4 hours.

title: Crispy Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli carrots red pepper radishes and celery with salad dressing. Toss. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. Toss with salad mix before serving.

title: Melon Chicken Salad
instructions: Pare cantaloupe and cut into four crosswise slices. Remove seeds and cut out inside of cantaloupe rings to leave a one-half inch ring. Reserve cut-out melon. In large bowl combine reserved melon and cut rest of melon into cubes. Cut into cubes chicken celery radishes. Mix with blue cheese dressing cover and chill several hours. To serve place melon slices on salad plates and spoon chicken salad in middle of each ring. Garnish with celery leaves. Serves 4.

title: Lemon Supreme Pound Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well then add eggs one at a time mixing well after each one. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Glaze with mixture of approximately 1/8 cup lemon juice and 1 cup confectioners sugar.

title: Muffalatta
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and marinate 12 hours.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Put hamburger in a kettle with a little water. Cook until almost done then add onion ketchup vinegar and mustard and cook until well done. Mash the hamburger well. Cook on low heat.

title: Rotel Dip
instructions: Drain vegetables; melt cheese. Use hand mixer to blend. Good with taco chips.

title: Spinach Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Cut off top fourth of each tomato. Reserve for other uses. With a small spoon scoop out pulp to make hollow shells. Chop pulp; let drain in a colander.

title: Go To Bed Mints
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat well egg whites and cream of tartar. Gradually add sugar salt and coloring. When all is stiff stir in chocolate chips (or use regular chocolate chips and add mint flavoring). Drop on cookie sheet. Turn off oven. Put cookies in. Take out in morning.

title: Beefy Enchilada Skillet
instructions: Cook ground beef in skillet until brown and drain fat. Cut tortillas into 1-inch squares. Add sauce tortillas and 1/2 of cheese to meat. Let come to a boil. Cover and cook on low heat for 5 minutes or until hot. Top with remaining cheese and sour cream.

title: Dump Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Perfect Meringue
instructions: Beat egg whites with vanilla and cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Dont overbeat the egg whites before adding the sugar or the meringue will leak making the top of the pie filling moist and slipping. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff glossy peaks form and sugar dissolves. Rub some meringue between your fingers. You should not feel any sugar granules. Spread meringue over hot filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Blend cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Fold in prepared Dream Whip. Spread this on chilled crumb mixture. Chill several hours more. Before serving add pie filling.

title: Hermits
instructions: Mix well. Spread onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0. When cool cut. Frost with

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into large bowl. Mix in peanut butter blending with a fork. Stir in milk and egg. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with Raisin Butter if desired. Makes 15 servings.

title: Sunshine Cake
instructions: Mix together dry cake mix eggs and vegetable oil (batter will be thick). Add mandarin oranges (including juice); fold together. Pour batter into well-greased 8 x 10 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until brown. Let cool completely.

title: Annie'S German Plum Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together then add eggs until smooth. Stir in sifted flour and baking powder and add vanilla. The batter will be thick. Spread into a baking pan (9 x 13-inch) ungreased. Cut plums in half removing pits and rinse. When dry place plums skin side down on top of batter until it is covered. (I find it usually takes about 21 plums to cover the whole pan 42 halves 6 across and seven down). Sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 to 3/4 hour until batter is browning on the edges. If the plums are properly ripened they will create a syrupy glaze over the cake. This cake is like nothing else Ive ever tasted.

title: Santa Fe Pot Roast
instructions: Combine chili powder cumin garlic powder pepper and oregano. Make small slits in roast; in each slit insert some of the spice.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Combine egg white in cold water. Beat until frothy (not stiff). Add pecan halves. Mix until coated. Mix 1/2 cup sugar cinnamon and salt. Add nuts; mix thoroughly. Place on buttered 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake in a 225\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken In Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Add onion bell pepper celery and Lipton onion soup mix. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Add 1 can Campbells mushroom soup. Smother for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and salt in a saucepan. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir at least 1/2 of mixture into egg yolk. Blend into remaining mixture. Boil 1 minute more. Remove from heat; blend in butter and vanilla. Add coconut to taste. Cool stirring occasionally. Spread between layers and frost with 7 Minute Frosting.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Pour all ingredients together and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate or freeze.

title: Trash Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix and chill; best 12 hours before serving.

title: Raspberry-Nut Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a Bundt or tube cake pan. Prepare cake mix according to directions. Fold in vanilla and spices. Pour chopped nuts in bottom of cake pan. Carefully pour batter over nuts. Bake in a preheated oven per package instructions.

title: Deviled Ham Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well.

title: Summer Bombe
instructions: Select a bowl and measure it in cups allowing at least 1 cup per person. Line bowl with ladyfingers. Pack bowl with lemon ice cream (other flavors will do but lemon is best). Freeze.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Drain blueberries and pineapple. Measure liquid and add water to make 1 cup. Add to gelatin mix. Stir in fruit. Pour into 2-quart flat casserole and place in refrigerator until firm. Combine next 4 ingredients and blend well but do not beat. Spread over congealed salad and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Serves 12. This can be used for a salad or dessert.

title: Pecan Butterball Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream butter and sugar; stir in vanilla. Work in flour; add nuts. Take a pinch of dough and form in a ball size of a large marble. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Newman Road Kill Stew(Great Way To Clean Out Your Freezer)
instructions: Use your favorite to your taste salt savory salt black and/or red pepper garlic or onion salt plus herb or two with light hand summer savory oregano basil or whatever you like. Throw kill onion and seasonings into a large pot. Cover with water. Cook partially covered over medium heat until meat is tender (time depends on \kill\). Remove all bones and return meat to pot. Add tomatoes including juice and stir-fry veggies. Simmer until veggies are tender. Serve hot to brave friends or cowardly enemies. Will serve hundreds if its been a long time since you cleaned out your freezer.

title: Hershey Marshmallow Dessert
instructions: Prepare a graham cracker crust in 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt marshmallows and milk over low heat. Stir until completely melted (I use my microwave). Remove from heat. Let stand and cool. Fold whipped cream into marshmallow mixture. Add grated Hershey bar. Save enough chocolate to sprinkle on top of dessert. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Holiday Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Sift together the flour salt and ginger. Cut in the shortening. Add the walnuts and mix. Stir in water. Shape into a ball. Roll out on a lightly floured surface to 1/8-inch thickness. Line a 9-inch pie plate with the pastry. Trim and flute the edges. Chill for 15 minutes.

title: Egg Roll Filling
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet. In a large bowl combine all vegetables and meat. Blend in Accent blend in egg and soy sauce. Mix thoroughly. Put 2 Tbsp. of mixture on egg roll wrapper and roll up brush ends of egg roll wrapper with water and corn starch mixture to seal well. Deep fry until nice and brown.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Mix and lay on lettuce. May sprinkle with coconut.

title: Western Bean Bake
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet or saucepan. Transfer to baking pan and add remaining ingredients. Mix all together and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bacon Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Dice bacon; fry crisp. Drain on paper towel and cool. In bowl mix together bacon onion and mayonnaise. Remove stems from tomatoes. Place stem side down on a cutting board. Cut tomatoes making an X so you can scoop out pulp. Invert and drain. Fill with bacon mixture. Chill for several hours.

title: Chocolate Scotheroos
instructions: In a 3 qt. sauce pan combine sugar and corn syrup cook over medium heat stirring constantly until bubbles. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter until completely melted. Add rice Krispies. Spread in buttered 13x9-inch pan. Melt both kinds of chips and spread over mixture in pan. Let harden several hours and cut into squares.

title: Peppery Herb Rib Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients except steaks. Arrange steaks in shallow baking dish and cover with peppery herb mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain and save liquid.

title: Candied Pecan Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar salt eggs margarine milk and vanilla flavoring. Pour into casserole.

title: Cocktail Meat Balls
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs onion milk egg and next 4 ingredients (parsley salt pepper and Worcestershire sauce). Gently shape into 1-inch balls. Melt shortening in large skillet. Brown meat balls. Remove meat balls from skillet. Pour off fat. Heat chili sauce and jelly in skillet stirring constantly until jelly is melted. Add meat balls and stir well and until completely coated. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Party Punch For Kids
instructions: Partially defrost lemonade and strawberries. Pour chilled ginger ale over. Make frozen mold with Hawaiian Punch.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes until soft not mushy. Peel and cut in half lengthwise. Melt butter in skillet. Add sugar. Add water and bring to boil then add sweet potatoes. Cook slowly until liquid is thick and the potatoes are brown. Serves 6.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Put eggs in medium sized bowl; beat them well. Add sugar milk butter and vanilla. Now add flour and mix well to make a soft dough. Drop from tablespoon on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Christmas Toffee Bars
instructions: Mix and pour in pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and cut in small squares.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Let items sit at room temperature before mixing. Roll into size balls you want. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Date Salad
instructions: Mix cream cheese and whipped cream. Add dates pineapple nuts and vanilla. Mix together and put in refrigerator at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Crispy Lemon-Fried Chicken
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a large bowl; add 3 teaspoons salt lemon juice and enough water to cover chicken. Soak in refrigerator overnight. Drain thoroughly. In a paper bag combine flour paprika pepper and remaining salt. Toss chicken pieces in flour mixture; shake off excess. Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in large skillet. When hot carefully add chicken and brown lightly on all sides about 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix chicken vegetables salt pepper and cream of mushroom soup. Stir well. Add mixture to frozen pie shell. Top with remaining pie shell. Punch holes with fork in top pie shell. Cook at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Or follow directions on package of frozen pie shells.

title: Chocolate Candy Drops
instructions: Melt chips in double boiler. After melted stir in nuts and noodles. Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper and let harden.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve yeast in warm water with 1 teaspoon of sugar. Add milk butter salt remaining sugar eggs and 3 cups of flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic about 6 to 8 minutes adding additional flour as needed. Place in a greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled about 1 hour. Punch down; shape into rolls of desired size. Place in greased pans and let rise until doubled. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Rabbit
instructions: Boil rabbit until tender in water with salt and onion. Put in baking container and bake until brown. Sprinkle with pepper.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Put green beans in greased baking dish. Mix milk with mushroom soup and pour over beans. Top with crushed chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shannon'S Dream Bars
instructions: Prepare pan with margarine and 1/4 cup flour. Melt 1/2 cup margarine on low in saucepan. Add the 1/2 cup brown sugar and the 1 cup flour. Stir until mixed. Dump mixture into a 9 x 6-inch pan. Press the mixture evenly over the bottom and sides of the pan like a crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Trapper'S Sweet Bannock
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add oil and water and mix well. Stir in raisins. Spread in well greased skillet. Cover and cook slowly on back of grill over hot coals. Or bake in preheated oven at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Tropical Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots about 15 minutes.\tDrain.\tCombine other ingredients and cook until thickened. Heat carrots with thickened mixture.

title: Tapioca
instructions: Combine milk tapioca egg yolk and salt. Mix well. Let stand 5 minutes. Microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes or until boiling. Stir once during preparation. Let cool covered 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Snickers Ice Cream
instructions: Finish filling ice cream freezer with milk and freeze.

title: Baked Chicken With Vegetables
instructions: On square of foil place chicken breast rib side up. Fill hollow where ribs are with potatoes carrots onion salt and pepper. Put tablespoon margarine on top. Close foil wrap. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breast
instructions: In a medium bowl combine cheese eggs bread crumbs parsley salt and pepper. Place about 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture in the center of each chicken breast. Roll and secure with toothpicks. In a large skillet thoroughly brown chicken on all sides in hot oil; drain off fat. Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken. Bake about 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bulgogi-Marinated Beef
instructions: In a blender blend garlic onions and soy sauce. Add the next 4 ingredients and blend. Remove from blender and add sesame seed green onions (to taste) and vinegar. Pour sauce over meat and mix well. Let the meat soak overnight in a covered bowl in the refrigerator. Cook the next day in the crock-pot 1 hour on high and 2 to 3 hours on low. Serve over rice.

title: Grandma'S Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef with onions. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer until mixture is desired consistency.

title: Pie Blitz
instructions: Put pie mix in dish. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top of this. Sprinkle on pecans then pour melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve topped with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Cheese Candy
instructions: Melt cream cheese in a double boiler. Mix in sugar nuts and vanilla. Drop immediately by spoonfuls on wax paper. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Tomatoes Blue
instructions: Place tomato slices on a baking sheet. In a small bowl combine butter Blue cheese Parmesan cheese and parsley with a fork until well blended. Add enough crumbs to make a crumbly dough. Divide evenly among tomato slices and press to form a \crust\ on each. Broil until topping is brown and bubbly and tomatoes are heated through. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Biscuit Bake
instructions: In a bowl combine the soup mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce. Stir in chicken broccoli and onion. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Separate biscuits; cut each in half. Arrange cut side down over hot chicken mixture. In a bowl combine remaining ingredients and pour over biscuits. Bake uncovered 20 minutes longer or until golden brown. Yield 6 - 8 servings.

title: Corn Dish
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into an 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf Cordon Bleu
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs in a bowl. Add 2 Tbsp. parsley bread crumbs broth garlic salt tarragon mustard and pepper. Beat well. Mix in ground beef. Set aside.

title: Old Fashion Cookies
instructions: Cream vegetable oil oleo and both sugars. Add flour and eggs. Sift dry ingredients. Stir and blend. Roll balls marble size into granulated sugar and press with glass. Bake about 12 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Hershey'S Chocolate Mint Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and lightly flour 10 x 15-inch pan. In large mixing bowl beat flour sugar eggs and syrup until smooth. Pour into prepared pan and bake 25 to 30 minutes (until top springs back when lightly touched) or cake starts to pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely in pan.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in order. Bake until bubbly at 350\u00b0 or microwave on High until bubbly.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together hamburger 1/4 c ketchup salt pepper water onion soup mix bread crumbs and egg.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all together. Makes about 30 punch cups.

title: Batter Yeast Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar salt shortening egg and 1 cup flour. Beat well until smooth. Add remaining flour a little at a time and beat well. Grease muffin pan. Fill each muffin half full. Let rise in warm place free from drafts for about 30 - 40 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 - 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat sugar and Crisco until light. Add eggs. Beat well. Add orange juice pumpkin and milk.

title: Grandmom'S Potato Rolls
instructions: Heat milk until scalding; remove from heat. Add potatoes and margarine to melt. Add sugar and salt. Sprinkle yeast over mixture while warm. Let set 10 minutes. Add sifted 6 to 7 cups flour. Knead about 10 minutes. Let rise in greased bowl until double. Punch dough down. Pat into walnut size pieces to form cloverleaf rolls in muffin cups. Makes 3 dozen rolls. Let rise again until double. When risen bake until brown. Put small pat of butter on top of each roll.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add egg sour milk soda baking powder nutmeg salt and flour. Roll and cut. Bake 10 minutes at 450 degrees (I bake mine at 300 degrees as my oven is very hot). Add currants or coconut to batter if desired. I make mine plain.

title: Butter Horns And Triangles
instructions: Mix flour and butter; work in cottage cheese. Chill at least 8 hours. (Dough can be kept chilled for several days.) Divide dough into 4 portions. Roll one portion at a time on very well-floured board.

title: Swizzle Steak
instructions: Brown meat in frying pan. Add onion. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes* adding additional water if necessary. Before serving add 1 tablespoon cornstarch to a small amount of water and mix into meat to thicken sauce. Serve over hot rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Old Sugar Cured Kentucky Ham
instructions: *I just get a cured ham from the grocery; it never weighs 20 pounds and I dont know how old it is.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Mix onion garlic parsley bell pepper mushrooms and oregano. Add rice; pour into a baking pan. Put sliced eggplant on top of rice mixture. Pour tomato sauce and Mozzarella cheese on top of eggplant. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese when done.

title: Chocolate Tornado
instructions: Spoon whipped topping evenly into 6 dessert dishes. Using back of spoon spread whipped topping into the bottom and up sides of each dish. Pour milk into medium bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes or until thickened. Spoon pudding into dishes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Banana N Walnut Lite Delight
instructions: Toss bananas with lemon juice. Layer fresh fruit yogurt bananas and nuts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Spoon into lightly greased casserole dish (approximately 8 x 8 1/2-inch size). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Dip should be brown on sides and bottom makes 2 cups. Serve warm. Good with wheat crackers or vegetables.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix and pour directly into ice cream freezer. May be made in homemade freezer.

title: Beer-Based Glaze For Ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place ham fat side up in roasting pan. Pour all but 2 tablespoons of the beer on top of ham. Bake until cooked through about 1 hour basting occasionally with pan juices.

title: Sausage Snacks
instructions: Mix all ingredients well by hand. Roll into small balls and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chili Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Season rice with salt and pepper. Combine sour cream salt and chiles. Place a layer of rice cover with a layer of the sour cream mixture and top with strips of cheese. Repeat making 2 or 3 layers and ending with rice on top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with grated Cheddar cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted. Serves 6.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Lightly grease 9 x 13-inch\tpan. Separate crescent dough into 2 large rectangles. Press rectangles over bottom and 1/2-inch up sides of pan to form crust; seal perforations. Bake crust at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. In a medium bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour over partially baked crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 22 minutes until golden brown. Cool. Cut into bars. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Ethel'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Combine dry ingredients. Mix alternately with milk and eggs. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Add 1 teaspoon almond flavor. Add 1 cup nuts. Bake in well-greased tube pan for 1 hour or until done.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Put Oreos in blender to crush and set aside. Cream together the cream cheese butter and powdered sugar and set aside. Blend pudding and milk and let it begin to set then fold in Cool Whip. Blend in sugar and cream cheese mixture.

title: Pot Of Chili
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve juice. Brown meat in olive oil. Add garlic onion and peppers; saute. Add reserved juice and remaining ingredients except pineapple. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add pineapple and heat thoroughly. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash in salted water just until tender. Drain. Melt margarine and mix with stuffing mix; pat into bottom of casserole reserving 1 1/2 cups for topping.

title: Inmate Roast Beef Spread
instructions: Mix everything except the flour tortillas together and heat thoroughly. Place mixture in flour tortillas and enjoy. Serves 4.

title: Magic Bars
instructions: Melt butter in pan and pour into a baking dish. Follow with graham cracker crumbs and spread evenly. Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs. Follow with coconut chocolate chips and nuts. Pat ingredients down to make even. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until coconut is browned. Let cool slightly and cut into bars.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Salad With Boiled Dressing
instructions: Mix everything together and cook until thick stirring most of the time. Then cool and add as much mayonnaise as necessary and pour over chicken or turkey salad. Make to taste. If dressing is sour add more sugar or more water (or milk).

title: Chili Con Carne(Easy But Tasty)
instructions: Sear ground beef at high temperature in a large pot. Reduce temperature pour off grease and add corn oil. Add onions. Cook with beef at lower temperature until translucent. Add green peppers. Cook until texture is to your taste. Add canned tomatoes and can of beans. Add from second can of beans to your own desired amount. Rinse tomato and bean cans with one or two ounces of water; add to pot. Add teaspoon of bouillon powder; stir well. Add chili powder to taste. Add one or two shakes of garlic powder or one or two cloves of fresh garlic cloves. Stir well and simmer 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Melt margarine oil water and cocoa in saucepan. In mixing bowl put sugar and flour. Add melted ingredients then add buttermilk eggs and vanilla.

title: Parmesan Taters
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Wash potatoes leaving peeling on. Cut in quarters. Roll in cheese flour salt and pepper mixture. Place in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole. Melt butter and add to potatoes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn potatoes and bake 20 minutes or more until tender. Yields 8 servings.

title: Kraut Relish
instructions: Put in large jar with lid; press down so sauerkraut is covered with the liquid. Let set in refrigerator 24 hours. Good on burgers.

title: M&M'S Party Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening brown sugar and granulated sugar. Beat in vanilla and eggs. In another bowl sift flour baking soda and salt. Add dry ingredients to the sugar egg mixture. Blend well. Stir in 1/2 cup of M&Ms (save remaining for decoration). Drop rounded teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Cook or heat the beets. Boil together the remaining ingredients until thick and clear. Add some butter or margarine about the size of a walnut. Add the beets and mix.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake for 35 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Escalloped Potatoes
instructions: Melt margarine in bottom of large Pyrex dish. Mix all ingredients except potatoes. Make layers with potatoes and other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours covered with foil.

title: Tater Tots Baked Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and celery. Place Tater Tots in bottom of casserole. Pour hamburger mix on top of Tater Tots. Pour creamed corn on top and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Candy
instructions: Boil potato with jacket on until well done. Peel and mash while hot (do not add anything extra to potato). Add margarine and gradually add sugar until all mixed. Roll out mixture very thin (1/8 inch) and spread peanut butter over all. Roll up like a jelly roll. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Slice in 1/4 inch slices.

title: Tang Dessert
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and spread over cooled crust. Spread Cool Whip on top of filling. Refrigerate.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Spread\tapple pie filling in long buttered pan and sprinkle with cinnamon. Cook white sugar flour salt water and butter. Pour over apples and top with flour rolled oats salt brown sugar and Crisco. Mix together and sprinkle on top. Bake in moderate oven 35 minutes.

title: Granola
instructions: Put oats in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes. Remove. Stir in nuts coconut wheat germ and powdered milk. In separate bowl combine honey oil and vanilla. Stir everything together. Bake 10 to 15 minutes. Stir everything 3 to 5 minutes. Cook until golden.

title: Scalloped Peppers
instructions: Go to deli buy potato salad. Put in pretty bowl. Slice hard-boiled eggs over top and garnish with parsley.

title: Marinated Carrots(A Great Cookout Dish And Easy To Make!)
instructions: Layer drained artichoke hearts in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Layer drained spinach next. Blend cream cheese mayonnaise and margarine until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in milk. Spread over top of spinach. Sprinkle with pepper and grated cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Yellow Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to package. To rice add butter corn onions and soup. Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove and add grated cheese to top. Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Mexican Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine buttermilk baking mix and water to make a dough. Add sausage cheese and pepper to dough.

title: 24 Hour Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook together until thick eggs sugar butter and vinegar. Add 2 cups pineapple 2 oranges 2 cups white grapes or cherries and 1 cup marshmallows. Fold in 1 cup whipped cream and let stand 24 hours.

title: Banana Mallow Pie
instructions: Toast coconut with margarine in a skillet on low heat until golden brown. Pat into pie plate to form crust. Cool in refrigerator. Mix pudding mix with milk. Add marshmallows and 1/2 Cool Whip. Slice bananas in cooled coconut shell. Cover with pudding then top with Cool Whip.

title: Caramel Bars
instructions: Melt in double boiler the caramels and 1/3 cup of milk until very thin. Keep hot. Mix cake mix and butter and then mix in 1/3 cup milk. Take half and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl and refrigerate.

title: Batter For Onion Rings
instructions: Beat egg yolk. Add oleo salt 1/4 cup milk and flour. Add the other 1/4 cup milk. Beat egg white and fold into batter.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Roll chicken and wrap 1/2 slice bacon around and anchor with toothpick. Arrange in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon cream of celery and chicken soup and sour cream over chicken. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours covered. Uncover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Marmalade Drop Cookies
instructions: Beat sugar and butter until light and creamy. Beat in egg and marmalade. Mix flour and baking powder add to butter and egg mixture. If mixture is too dry add a little more marmalade. Drop the batter from a teaspoon about 2-inches apart on a greased sheet. Bake the cookies in 375\u00b0 oven for about 8 minutes. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cut fruit and nuts in large pieces. Sift together flour soda salt and cinnamon. Scatter half cup of dry ingredients over fruit and nuts. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually creaming until mixture is light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. To creamed mixture add fruit and nuts and remaining dry ingredients. Mix well. Drop from teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Makes 150. Will keep well for several weeks or may be frozen.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Parboil peppers for 5 minutes and cool. Mix raw rice and uncooked ground chuck with chopped onion and add 1/4 to 1/2 cup catsup stuff into pepper shells and put into baking dish. Cover with mixture of the tomato soup water and the remaining catsup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Put all the ingredients in bowl. Add one 8 ounce bottle Kraft coleslaw dressing. Mix. Ready to eat. (Can add crisp fried bacon crumbled.)

title: Curry Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve as a dip for raw vegetables. Can be used with fruits grapes and apple slices.

title: Hot Cranberry Cider
instructions: Combine apple cider cranberry juice brown sugar lemon peel cinnamon sticks and cloves in saucepan. Mix well. Simmer for 30 minutes. Remove cinnamon sticks. Pour into cups. Makes 12 servings.

title: Salmon Dip
instructions: Puree salmon. Add all other ingredients mixing well.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to box directions. Drain. Put spaghetti into a large bowl. Add butter and eggs. Mix well. The hot spaghetti will cook the eggs. Add bacon pepper and Parmesan cheese. Mix well. Serve hot. Serves 6.

title: Corn Supreme
instructions: Heat the corn and milk then stir in the egg. Now add the rest of the ingredients except for the buttered crumbs. Mix well. Pour in a dish; add buttered crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Some Of Terri'S Soup(Cemetery Soup)
instructions: Brown hamburger or ground turkey. Drain. Add the onion. Add everything else. Add the water. Cook on low fire. Cook for 3 hours.

title: Deer Roast
instructions: Place the deer in a roast pan with an onion (sliced or whole). Salt and pepper. Fill the pan with water to cover meat. Cook for 3 hours at 350\u00b0. Place the potatoes and carrots around the roast and cook 1 hour longer. Drain the broth off the roast into a saucepan. Mix about 3/4 cup flour with hot water in a jar. Shake well until lumps are gone. Pour the flour mixture into the broth stirring constantly. Now heat the broth up stirring constantly until desired thickness. You may need more flour depending how thick you like your gravy. Just remember the secret to no lump gravy is shaking the flour and hot water in a jar then stirring into broth; last heating and constantly stirring until thick.

title: Cheryl Ladd'S Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Lemon Fluff(Low Calorie)
instructions: Dissolve jello in 3/4 cup boiling water. Put jello milk and sweetener in blender. Blend 30 seconds. Refrigerate until partially set. Blend again for 30 to 45 seconds. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch dish or 4 small bowls. Refrigerate.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put into a 1-quart casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spray 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam. Line bottom with bread slices. Put sausage over bread. Mix eggs milk cheese and salt and pepper to taste. Pour over sausage. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 until eggs are done.

title: Saucy Kielbasa Appetizer
instructions: Boil kielbasa for 5 minutes. In a plastic bowl place water butter and entire box of brown sugar. Microwave for 2 minutes or until mixture is melted. Stir in 2 tablespoons of mustard until smooth. Taste and add more mustard if desired. Slice kielbasa into bite size pieces. In a large dish combine sauce and kielbasa and serve. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Inspiration Soup
instructions: Simmer 20 minutes (unlimited). (Weight Watchers Inspiration.)

title: Big Bag Wolf'S Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with shortening. Melt the butter and chocolate in a large saucepan over low heat. Remove the saucepan from the heat. Stir in the sugar flour baking powder vanilla and nuts. Add eggs and beat well with a beater.

title: Kids' Delight Cookie Bars
instructions: Place butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until melted. Tilt pan to coat evenly with butter. Remove from oven. Sprinkle Kavli crumbs over butter. Pour milk evenly over crumbs. Top evenly with remaining ingredients in the order listed. Press down firmly. Bake for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on wire rack in pan. When completely cool cut into bars. Makes 24 bars.

title: Scrumpous Pie
instructions: Mix and pat evenly in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan sprayed with Pam. Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown at 350 degrees. Cool completely.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Trifle
instructions: Cut up strawberries and mix with glaze. Then take the angel food cake and break up and put in a punch bowl.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix in large bowl. Roll into balls. Place meatballs in a large pot of boiling water. Cook until meatballs float to the top.

title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl mix flour brown sugar sugar cinnamon salt and oil. Remove 1/2 cup of flour mixture to use as topping and mix with pecans and set aside.

title: Chocolate Goodies
instructions: Heat milk and chocolate chips together. After mixture is hot and melted add remaining ingredients. Drop onto wax paper and let set up in refrigerator.

title: Salami Potato Swirl
instructions: Pare the potatoes. Cut into quarters. Cover with water. Add onion and garlic. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until just tender not mushy. Drain (save potato water for soup). Mash potatoes. Add butter milk eggs and black pepper. Whip until fluffy. Stir in salami cheese and green onions. Spoon into a buttered ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Heat under a broiler until crusty or at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Baked Ziti
instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients and make into meatballs. Brown in oven until done.

title: No Fuss Lasagne
instructions: Cook noodles separately. Follow package directions. Cook hamburger; drain. Add remaining ingredients to hamburger. Cook slowly until blended well. Alternate layers of noodles sauce and cheese in baking dish. Bake 20 minutes or until cheese is melted through and through at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Banana Pudding
instructions: Layer bananas and vanilla wafers in a large casserole dish. Combine pudding Cool Whip Eagle Brand milk and milk. Blend with mixer for 5 minutes then pour mixture over bananas and wafers; chill.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa together in microwave for 2 minutes on High power. Stir all ingredients together with wire whip. Put in about a 9 x 13-inch casserole microwave dish. Cook on 50% power for 9 minutes; rotate at 4 minutes. Then cook on High power for 5 minutes. Put marshmallows over top and melt on top the last few seconds of cooking.

title: Nut Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites until frothy. Add water and beat again. Add sugar baking powder and vanilla. Beat again. Add crackers and walnuts. Stir. Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Pour mixture in plate. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. When cool refrigerate. Add whipped cream before serving.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add cream of mushroom soup water garlic powder and mushrooms. Simmer for 20 minutes. Take off heat immediately and add sour cream. Cook wide noodles and pour sauce over them.

title: Hummus Ii
instructions: Drain and wash the chick peas. Boil in little water till the chick pease are very soft.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in dish (9 x 13-inch). Add all ingredients; mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chili-Cheese Dip
instructions: Spread softened cream cheese into the bottom of glass dish. Then spread chili over cream cheese. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over the chili. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until cheese starts to bubble. Serve with either Doritos or Tostitos.

title: Fresh Fruit Pies
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Pour into graham cracker crusts. Chill for 1 hour. Yields 2 pies.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan dump undrained crushed pineapple and cherry pie filling into pan. Swirl around until well mixed and corners filled. Sprinkle the yellow cake mix over the top. Drizzle the melted butter and then sprinkle the nuts on. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Creamy Ambrosia
instructions: Fold whipped cream and sour cream together. Drain fruits. Stir fruit coconut and marshmallows into cream mixture. Chill overnight.

title: Judge Ray Lee Jenkins' Special Brown Sugar Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Beat this mixture at least 15 minutes. The trick is in the beating. Grease loaf pan heavily as much as you can. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Deluxe Pineapple Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1 cup water for 10 minutes. Bring pineapple juice and fruit lemon juice and sugar to a boil. Remove from heat and add gelatine. Let mixture cool until partly set then add grated cheese and whipped cream. Place in 12 to 14 individual molds and chill until firm. Serve with following dressing.

title: Chili
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef onions and green pepper in large pan until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Ring Of Fire Chili
instructions: Brown ground chuck in large skillet stirring until crumbly; drain. Saute onions and garlic in oil in skillet for 10 minutes. Add oregano chili powder cumin red pepper tomato paste salt and pepper; mix well. Stir in bouillon cubes dissolved in water and beer. Add ground chuck; mix well. Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours. Add beans. Simmer for 30 minutes longer. May chill overnight and reheat for best flavor. Serve with plenty of bread and beer. Yield 10 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
instructions: Mix well. Divide. Color and flavor. Roll into small balls. Dip in granulated sugar. Press flat or in mold. Let dry overnight.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Combine eggs cream sugar salt and vanilla in bowl and mix thoroughly with mixer. Pour into can; add condensed milk and stir well. Add dairy milk to fill and stir. Makes approximately 4 quarts.

title: Beef And Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook meat onions pepper and tomatoes together until rice cooks. Layer sauce then rice and beans; finish with meat sauce. Add cheese topping.

title: Macaroon Kiss Cookies
instructions: Beat butter cream cheese and sugar in large bowl until well blended. Add egg yolk almond extract and orange juice; beat well. Stir together flour baking powder and salt. Gradually add flour mixture to butter mixture. Stir in 3 c. coconut. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or until firm enough to handle. Shape dough into balls; roll in coconut and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately press Hershey Kiss on top of each cookie. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Mix sour cream and onion. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Drain sauerkraut and spread over cream mixture. Break up 1 can corned beef and spread over kraut. Add Swiss cheese grated on top. Remove crusts from rye bread. Tear bread in pieces and put on top of cheese. Drizzle margarine slowly over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash potatoes; while still hot add the butter cinnamon sugar raisins and pecans. Pour into greased or sprayed baking dish. Cover with marshmallows. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until heated through and the marshmallows are browned.

title: French Dressing Chicken
instructions: To make sauce combine all ingredients except chicken and rice. Put chicken into greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Pour sauce over chicken. Bake at 350 degrees for 1-1/2 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add milk and flour beating well. Cook two layers plain.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Sift flour and sugar. Mix in pineapple with juice. Cook until thick (4 to 5 minutes). Add margarine or butter; let cool completely. Chop apples one at a time; add to mixture. Add a little Cool Whip to mixture. Put in dish. Cover with remaining Cool Whip; top with nuts and cherries. You can put half of the nuts in mixture and the other half on top. Cool 24 hours.

title: Sweet Cheese Mold
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and cream cheese. Fold in raisins pecans and chocolate chips. Shape in ball and chill. Serve with graham crackers cookies celery etc.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix throughly. Roll into balls or put green olives cashews or small weiners in center of cheese balls. These will keep for a long time in the refrigerator or they can be frozen. When ready Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10-12 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mash the potatoes. Add sugar eggs spices salt and milk. After mixed place in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 hour and 15 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Garnish with whipped cream.

title: Green Beans With Mushrooms
instructions: Place steamer rack over 1 inch boiling water in saucepan. Add green beans. Cover and cook for 4 minutes. Add mushrooms. Transfer to serving bowl. Combine water and mustard in small bowl; pour over vegetables. Add butter; toss to coat. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and grease loaf pan with butter. Combine flour sugar cinnamon soda and salt. Beat in eggs and oil and dry ingredients. Dont overmix. Gently stir in berries. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes according to oven. Lightly browned and toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool before inverting pan.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add sugar cocoa and milk. Bring to a boil on medium heat and continue to boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat\tand quickly add vanilla salt (optional) peanut butter and oatmeal. Mix\twell. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper and cool. Next watch them disappear.

title: Texas Salad
instructions: Toss together the lettuce beans Cheddar cheese tomatoes onion and Catalina dressing. Just before serving crush Fritos and toss again. Use about 1/2 bag Fritos.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Braised Turkey Patties
instructions: Form 6 patties with the first 3 ingredients; brown in a little oil or Pam. Remove from pan. Make gravy in same pan according to directions on envelope. Put patties back in pan; add sliced onion over all. Cover; simmer slowly until onion is cooked. If too thick add water. Recipe is fat-free.

title: Mounds Cake
instructions: Bake as directed on box. Let cool; split layers in half with a string.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Beat 3 to 5 minutes. Pour over top of batter in cake pan. Sprinkle with pecans or coconut if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Place 3 slices of onion on bottom of each jar and add 1/2 teaspoon dill seed and cucumbers sliced lengthwise. Add 1/2 teaspoon alum to each jar. Mix together vinegar water sugar and salt. Bring to a boil and pour over pickles in jars. Add 2 slices of onions and 1/2 teaspoon of dill weed on top of each jar and seal. This recipe is for quart jars.

title: Cinnamon Swirl Pudd'N Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding eggs water margarine and vanilla extract in bowl. Blend well and then beat at medium speed for 10 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over top of batter. With knife cut through to spread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Barbecue Chicken Wings
instructions: Cut wings in half. Dust in mixture of flour and chili powder. Fry in hot oil 8 to 10 minutes on each side until brown. Drain on paper towels. Heat together barbecue sauce and hot pepper sauce. Add chicken wings and simmer a few minutes. Makes 24 \hot\ wings.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into large Pyrex (9 x 13-inches).

title: Buttered Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa. Cream with butter. Add flour and eggs. Add vanilla salt and nuts. Bake in well-greased 8-inch cake pan at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mom'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs. Add seasoned salt and bread crumbs. Mix in meat and enough water to thin a little. Bake at 300\u00b0 until done about 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix together and pour into casserole. Top with bread crumbs. (4 slices bread diced and 4 tablespoons butter. Melt butter and toss in crumbs.)

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix together and pour half of mixture in bottom of pan. Cover with uncooked rice and chicken. Cover with remaining soup mixture and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook celery and onion in butter until tender. Blend in soup and milk; add tuna. Meanwhile cook noodles and drain. In casserole combine noodles and tuna mixture. Top with crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and form into balls. Dip in sugar.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Nana'S Party Mix
instructions: Melt butter and mix together with Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder. Mix together in large roasting pan the butter mixture with cereal nuts and pretzels. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven for one hour stirring every 15 minutes to coat all pieces well.

title: No Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Soak marshmallows in milk in refrigerator overnight. Cut candy in small pieces and combine all ingredients. Press in square pan.

title: Antipasto Salad
instructions: Chop celery and onions to the size that please you. Chop both kinds of olives. I buy large pitted black olives. Chop ham cheese and pepperoni to a size that pleases you. I buy a pound of cheese and a pound of baked ham unsliced. I also buy the sliced pepperoni and just cut it in half. Cook your shells per package directions and drain. Add it all together in a bowl and add dressing. I usually make it a day in advance so that its cold and the dressing and flavors mingle.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Chicken
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve juice. Add water to juice to make 2 1/4 cups. Saute onion in shortening in large skillet until tender. Add 1 1/4 cups water carrots and bouillon or broth. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Combine sugar cornstarch and ginger. Add catsup vinegar and soy sauce and stir into vegetable mixture. Cook until clear and thick. Add chicken green pepper and pineapple. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Vendors Waffles(Preparation Time:  5 Minutes.  Cooking Time:  6 Minutes)
instructions: Mix eggs with milk and salt. Sift flour and baking powder together then add to liquid. When ingredients are mixed stir in lard. Bake in waffle iron until done. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix soup broth Ro-Tel and onion. Pour over chicken breasts and Doritos. Layer Velveeta cheese over that and cook until cheese melts. Cook on about 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Blend sugar and flour. Continue blending egg pineapple juice and margarine. Heat on medium stirring constantly until thickens (takes about 15 minutes). Cool. Fold in 1 pint whipping cream. Cool and serve.

title: Rocky Road Candy Crisps
instructions: Put butter 3 cups marshmallows chocolate chips and corn syrup in medium saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until chocolate and marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs. Put in greased casserole. Put buttered cracker crumbs on top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Cook slowly for 2 1/2 hours stirring occasionally. Pour into clean hot jars and seal.

title: Pretzel Surprise
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels sugar and oleo. Press mixture in Pyrex dish (9 x 13-inch). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Beat 1 cup sugar cream cheese and Cool Whip. Pour over cooled pretzel layer. Mix boiling water with Jell-O. Add strawberries. Let stand 10 minutes. Serves 12 or more. Chill one hour. Store in refrigerator.

title: Steamed Vegetables
instructions: Place carrots and potatoes in a steamer; cover and cook for 6 minutes. Add sprouts. Cover and cook for 5 to 7 more minutes or until vegetables are tender. Combine margarine lemon juice and pepper; toss with steamed vegetables.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Saute onion in margarine add soup milk and pepper. Heat to boiling add potatoes. Cover and simmer 5 minutes until heated through. You can vary this dish by adding either diced ham smoked sausage or pepperoni.

title: Lime Cream Fruit Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool. Add lime juice. Beat in sour cream with wire whip. Add pineapple. Chill until partially set. Fold in cherries and pecans. Turn into mold and chill until firm.

title: Ice Box Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Mix with mixer butter and both sugars. Add eggs creaming mixture. Mix dry ingredients and add gradually. After well mixed stir in vanilla and nuts with spoon. Roll into logs then roll logs in floured cling wrap. Store overnight. Slice and bake. Dough lasts for a long time in frig.

title: Cheese And Bacon Muffins
instructions: Mix together. Batter will be lumpy. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 12.

title: Delphine'S Famous Oatmeal Chocolate Chips Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Mix flour soda and salt; add to first mixture. Add oats and chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes in very lightly greased pan. Do not overbake.

title: Summer Garden Pasta
instructions: Combine tomatoes green onions parsley basil wine vinegar salt sugar and pepper in a large bowl. Mix well. Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Saute garlic in hot olive oil until golden brown. Remove skillet from heat and discard garlic. Pour the garlic oil over the tomato mixture and toss gently to coat. Cover tomato mixture with plastic wrap. Chill for at least 3 hours. Cook pasta using package directions; drain well. Place in a warm serving bowl. Add chilled tomato mixture to pasta and mix well. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Serve with crusty French bread if desired.

title: Beef Topped Pasta
instructions: Prepare vermicelli according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile in 2-quart saucepan combine soup broccoli and pepper. Heat through stirring as needed. Serve over hot vermicelli.

title: Barbecued Meat Balls(Appetizer)
instructions: Mix hamburger and egg well. Add salt and pepper as desired. Form 24 to 30 small balls. Brown and drain.

title: Mini-Cheese Cakes
instructions: Place 12 vanilla wafers on bottom of 12 paper lined muffin cups. Then mix cream cheese sugar vanilla and eggs. Pour into muffin cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Sprinkle with coconut or top with various types of jam or other favorite toppings.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Use 1-quart casserole; blend soup and milk. Stir in tuna eggs and peas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot; stir. Top with chips; bake 5 minutes more.

title: Garlic Pickles (1 Gallon)
instructions: Rinse whole pickles and dry on paper towels. Cut into 1/8 inch thick slices and pack into gallon jar. Add hot pepper and garlic as you fill. Fill jar with pickles pepper and garlic and add all the sugar your jar will hold. Cover and refrigerate. Pickles and sugar will settle. Next day turn upside down a few times and add any leftover pickles/sugar to refill jar. Let set in refrigerator 1 week shaking occasionally. Serve chilled.

title: Creamy Chicken And Mushrooms
instructions: In skillet in 1 tablespoon margarine cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt together chocolate chips peanut butter and butter. Pour over Crispix in large bowl. Coat thoroughly. Add sugar and shake to coat! Great afternoon snack or snack for parties!

title: Noodles
instructions: Knead roll thin cut and put in boiling water. When done put in chicken broth or beef bouillon cubes.

title: Banana Bread Or Muffins
instructions: Cream together eggs sugar and oil. Beat in bananas. Add and beat until smooth the flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Pour in 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes or pour into 24 muffin cups and bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Veal In Wine With Mushrooms
instructions: Drain mushrooms measure liquid and add water to make 1 cup. Heat oil in pan add veal and saute until brown. Stir in mushroom liquid soup 1/2 cup wine onion and oregano. Bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer 1 1/2 hours until real tender stirring occasionally. Just before serving add remaining 1/2 cup wine mushrooms and sour cream. Serve over hot rice.

title: Baked Macaroni And Sausage
instructions: Remove sausage meat from casings and crumble. In a skillet fry sausage meat until browned. Add green pepper onion salt and pepper. Saute for 5 minutes. Do not drain. Stir in tomatoes water and tomato paste. Simmer covered for 20 minutes. Cook and drain elbow macaroni. Layer elbow macaroni and Mozzarella cheese in a baking dish ending with a layer of macaroni. Pour sauce over macaroni and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Barbecued Venison Ribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Roll venison ribs in flour and brown them in a frying pan on the top of the stove. Then put ribs in a Dutch oven and slice medium onion on it. Salt and pepper them. Pour 1/2 cup barbecue sauce over them.

title: Football Brisket
instructions: Mix onion soup with water in roasting pan. Season meat with pepper and garlic. Place meat in pan; cover tightly. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until meat is just about tender. Remove meat. Place gravy in bowl freeze until fat hardens and remove fat from gravy. Combine gravy with catsup beer and flour. Mix well. Slice meat place in roasting pan and cover with gravy mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until meat is tender. Taste for seasoning. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Egg White Candy
instructions: Beat egg white until stiff. Add brown sugar. Beat until well mixed. Add pecans. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Salad
