instructions: Fry bacon drain and crumble. In a large bowl break up the flowerets from the head of cauliflower. Add bacon. Add frozen peas with onions and Good Seasons dressing from the envelope. Add mayonnaise. Mix to desired consistency. Keep cool until served.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies and mix with 1 stick of melted butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan that can be put in the freezer. Let ice cream thaw until it can be beaten with a mixer. After beating pour into dish on top of cookies. Freeze.

title: Swedish Brown Beans
instructions: Simmer all ingredients together to reduce liquid and blend flavors.

title: Ham Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Combine cranberries brown sugar and orange juice in saucepan and heat slowly. Add starch and water to thicken. Thirty minutes before ham is finished baking according to directions on package score ham top and pour sauce over ham.

title: Cabbage Noodle Salad
instructions: Remove seasoning packet; set aside. Crush noodles. Combine noodles and next six ingredients in a large bowl. Combine seasoning packet and remaining ingredients. Mix with a wire whisk. Pour dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss to coat. Cover and chill. Yield 6 servings.

title: Braunschweiger Ball
instructions: Blend together braunschweiger ketchup Worcestershire sauce and garlic salt. Form into ball and chill until firm. Thin cream cheese with just enough mayonnaise to make it smooth and easy spreading consistency. When braunschweiger ball is firm frost it with the cream cheese mixture then roll in chopped parsley. Serve with crackers. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lazy Day Lasagna(Make Recipe As Is)
instructions: Brown meat pepper and onion. Add next 7 ingredients. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan; layer 1/2 meat sauce and uncooked lasagna noodles. Add remaining sauce. Be sure noodles are covered by sauce. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Natchitoches Meat Pies
instructions: Cook ground beef ground pork and seasoning until well done. Sift flour over meat mixture stirring often until well combined. Remove from heat; place in a colander to drain off excess grease. Allow to cool.

title: Holy Smoke Pie
instructions: Let margarine soften to room temperature then cut into flour. Add chopped nuts. Mixture will be crumbly. Pat into a large baking dish or pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0; cool. Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese; fold in 1 cup of Cool Whip from 9 ounce package. Spread over cooled crust. Mix together chocolate instant pudding and milk. Spread over cheese mixture. Spread rest of Cool Whip on top of pie and sprinkle chopped nuts on top.

title: Double Decadent Chocolate Chip Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Beat sugar margarine eggs and vanilla until smooth. Add 1 cup morsels melted. Mix well. Add flour oats baking powder remaining 1 cup morsels and nuts mixing well. Spread into prepared pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownies pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Cut into bars. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together vanilla sugar oleo and shortening. Add eggs and dry ingredients. Refrigerate. Roll cut and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden.

title: Date Bars
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs and 1 1/4 cups confectioners sugar until light colored. Mix in remaining ingredients. Spread in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven until golden and cake springs back when touched with fingertip 25 to 27 minutes. Cook in pan on rack for 15 minutes. Cut into 2 x 1-inch bars. Roll in confectioners sugar. Cool on rack. Makes 32 bars.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars eggs and peanut butter together. Add soda to 1 teaspoon cider vinegar and add to sugar mixture. Add vanilla. Mix flour and salt and add to sugar mixture. Roll dough into balls the size of walnuts and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 10 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese potato chips and almonds. Place in a large rectangular dish. Top with cheese potato chips and almonds. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Divine Salad
instructions: Mix it all together and chill. Delicious!!

title: Orange Pork Chop Rice
instructions: Trim and brown pork chops. Mix orange juice and mushroom soup to make a sauce. Dip pork chops into sauce and set aside. Spread uncooked rice in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over rice. Place pork chops on top. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Uncover the last 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Dorotha Taylor' Light As A Feather Gingerbread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add ingredients in the order given. Bake 35 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Oreo Cookie Surprise
instructions: Crush 2/3 cookies and place in bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Melt butter and pour over crumbs pat down. Mix cream cheese and sugar and cover over top of cookies. Cover with 1/2 bowl of Cool Whip. Mix 2 boxes of pudding with 3 c. milk layer over Cool Whip. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding. Sprinkle with remaining crushed cookies. Refrigerate 2 - 3 hours.

title: Oma'S Cake
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and mix. Add eggs and mix. Add flour and mix. Add milk and mix well. Beat 3 minutes with an electric mixer. My Oma used a wooden spoon! Grease Bundt pan with bread crumbs or graham cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cheesy Green Beans(M-M-Good)
instructions: After frying bacon save 1/4 cup fat and 2 tablespoons bacon. Saute onions and mushrooms in the 1/4 cup fat saved on low heat. Then add pepper cheese bacon and beans; mix lightly. Sprinkle over top the reserved 2 tablespoons of crumbled bacon.

title: Quarterback Crunch Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl combine cereals cracker snacks and pretzel sticks. In medium saucepan combine corn syrup sugar brown sugar and margarine. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until well blended. Pour peanut butter mixture over cereal mixture; mix well to coat. Press mixture in greased pan. Cool slightly; refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or until firm. Cut into bars. Makes 20 bars.

title: Stuffed Turkey Loaf
instructions: Brown onion and celery in butter in medium hot skillet. Combine with stuffing mix eggs and water to make stuffing. Add half of stuffing to the ground turkey mixing well. Pat out half of the meat mixture in a two-quart loaf pan 4 1/2 x 8 1/2 x 3-inches. Spread with stuffing and then top with remaining meat mixture. Pour tomato juice over loaf and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Oklahoma Taco Soup
instructions: Brown beef and drain off any fat. Do not drain the beans and corn. Add them and dried mixes to the browned beef adding a little water beef broth or red wine if the mixture is too thick. Cook until flavors blend and soup is piping hot. Serve with crackers or cornbread.

title: Blueberry Pudding
instructions: Mix together the last 4 ingredients. Place 1 cup of blueberries in bottom of 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Cover berries with 1/2 of crumb mixture. Place second cup of blueberries over crumbs. Top berries with remaining crumbs and press down firmly with a spoon. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm or cold with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cracker crumbs and mix well. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top (or potato chips may be used). Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding Pie
instructions: Melt first three ingredients together in covered dish on High in microwave 1 to 1 1/2 minutes stirring after 30 seconds. Spread chocolate mixture over prepared crust. Slice bananas and place on top of chocolate mixture. Mix milk and jello pudding; let stand 5 minutes. Spoon over bananas. Cover or decorate top with whipped topping. Refrigerate 1 hour and serve.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour part of batter into a funnel and let it drip into hot oil (375\u00b0). Make all kinds of shapes and fry until golden brown then turn. Drain on paper towel. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Orange Delight
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and jello then add pineapple and oranges. Add Cool Whip last.

title: Golden Beans Au Gratin
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Fry bacon until crisp; remove from skillet. Drain fat reserving 1 tablespoon. Cook and stir onion in reserved fat. Add Velveeta and milk; stir until cheese is melted. Crumble bacon. Add bacon beans and pepper to skillet; mix lightly. Spoon into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef salt black pepper onion garlic and oregano. Drain fat; add tomato sauce and tomatoes. Cook noodles; mix all cheeses together. Arrange in layers noodles cheese and meat sauce. Top with cheese and add parsley flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Let set for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Coffee Cake(M-M-Good)
instructions: In mixing bowl cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Sift together the flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Fold in the finely chopped apple. Spread batter in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.

title: Cherry Float
instructions: In tall glass stir together drink mix and lemon juice. Add sherbet; fill glass with carbonated beverage. Serve immediately.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Sprinkle apples with sugar lemon juice and salt. Add celery and nuts. Fold mayo into whipped cream. Gently fold into apple mixture. Chill. Serve in lettuce-lined bowl if desired.

title: Pork Chops In Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Brown pork chops. Place soup water and pork chops in crock-pot. Cook on slow 6 hours.

title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
instructions: Place 1/2 stick butter into an 8-inch skillet. Turn oven to 400\u00b0 to preheat. After oven is preheated put skillet in to melt butter. Pour in prepared ingredients and cook until golden brown.

title: Homemade Salsa
instructions: Chop up green onion and jalapenos. Mix with other ingredients. Make couple hours before serving. Refrigerate.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Lightly salt and pepper meat; brown in oil. Put 1/8 teaspoon ginger over meat while browning. Add water and bouillon cubes; bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 1 hour until meat is tender. Add green peppers cut in strips Chinese mixed vegetables and cornstarch to thicken gravy. Cook for 15 minutes. Serve over Chinese noodles or rice.

title: Greek-Potato-Tomato Skillet
instructions: Saute potatoes and onions in olive oil until golden and tender not brown. Discard excess oil. Add parsley salt and tomatoes. Cook covered over low heat until potatoes are tender.

title: Hot Butter Rum
instructions: Mix well and freeze. Use 2 tablespoons in a cup of hot water with one jigger rum. Super good!

title: Sausage Broccoli Bake
instructions: Cut smoked sausage into bite size pieces. Make macaroni and cheese as directed. Add all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Mix well and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: 2-Good Chili
instructions: Crumble ground beef into a large pot and cook until brown; drain off grease. Add chili mix water and crushed tomatoes. (If you like hot chili add cayenne pepper to taste.) Simmer for 30 minutes. Add beans and simmer for 15 more minutes.

title: Mississippi Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in oleo then add other ingredients and simmer for 10 or 15 minutes. Double recipe and use on pork or beef.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix kraut with chopped vegetables. Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil and pour over kraut mixture. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Oatmeal Candy
instructions: Combine sugar and milk; bring to boil and boil for 5 minutes. Add peanut butter; mix well and add oats. Drop on wax paper by spoonfuls.

title: Lemon Margarita Cookies
instructions: Combine in large bowl. Drop by tsp. on powdered sugar. Roll to coat. Place 1 1/2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes or until brown. Yield 6-8 dozen.

title: Grilled Chicken And Broccoli(Low Carb)
instructions: Brush the chicken with the mustard and grill or broil until cooked through about 4 minutes on a side. Slice into thin strips. Whisk together the lime juice and pulp oil thyme pepper and water chestnuts. Arrange the broccoli and chicken on a serving plate. Sprinkle with the lime dressing and Parmesan. Serve warm. Makes 4 servings. Per serving 141 calories 22 grams protein 6 grams carbs 4 grams fat 1 gram sat. fat 50 mg chol. 3 grams fiber 136 mg sodium. Diet Exchanges 0 milk 1 vegetable 1/2 fruit 0 bread 3 meat 1/2 fat.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Wash okra and pack in jar adding garlic and pepper. Boil 1 pint vinegar water salt and dill seed for 5 minutes. Pour in jars and seal. Use in about 6 weeks.

title: Lime Jello Dessert
instructions: Pour dry lime jello into Cool Whip. Add cottage cheese and pineapple. Stir well and refrigerate.

title: Oatmeal Fudge Cookies
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar margarine milk and dash of salt. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and vanilla flavoring. Mix well and add oatmeal. Mix in and drop from teaspoon onto wax paper.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Mix boiling water with jello and cool. Mix cake mix oil eggs and jello mixture and extract. Mix well. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan or angel food pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until tests done. Frost with cream cheese frosting or canned lemon frosting.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Spread rice evenly in a lightly greased 3-quart casserole dish. Spoon vegetables over rice. Pour chicken broth and water over vegetables. Add cooked sausage that has been drained. Spoon sausage over vegetables. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and stir well. Cover and bake an additional 30 minutes. Garnish with mushrooms and/or parsley.

title: Fudge Cake
instructions: Sift salt baking powder baking soda and flour together. Cream the butter and sugar then add the well beaten egg and chocolate. Add flour alternately with 1 cup sour milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Bake in baking pan several inches deep. Ice with chocolate or white icing and cut in blocks.

title: Darlene'S Cole Slaw(Serves 8 To 12)
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar oil and seasonings from Ramen noodles. Shake well and refrigerate. Just before serving combine cole slaw mix noodles (broken) sunflower seeds and almonds. Shake dressing well and pour over. Serve immediately. (Not good leftover easily halved.)

title: Apple Hoochie Koochie
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Cut margarine or butter into cake mix. Mix in coconut. Pat mixture into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Arrange apples on crust. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle on apples. Blend sour cream and eggs. Dribble over apples. Bake for 25 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.

title: Broccoli-Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix and put in 1-quart greased casserole. Mix 1/4 cup coarse cracker crumbs and 1 tablespoon melted butter and put on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Combine cucumbers and onions. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup salt. Cover with ice and set aside for 3 hours.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt margarine; add sugar salt and syrup. Bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add soda and vanilla. Pour over popped corn and mix well. Bake in a 250\u00b0 oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Cool and then break apart.

title: Lemon Nut Cake
instructions: Line pan with aluminum foil. Mix in order as listed. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In large mixer bowl combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into pie shell and bake 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 35 to 40 minutes longer or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cut bacon or ham in tiny pieces and fry until medium-done then add carrots and onion; fry until done. Add rice and oleo; fry about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Alfredo Chicken
instructions: Note Chicken may be 4 breast halves.

title: My Favorit Food Is Pot Roast
instructions: 1. First I wood put pepper and salt on the roast.

title: Irish Coffee Eggnog Punch
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Beat at low speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in Irish whiskey. Chill one to two hours. Pour into a punch bowl. Top punch with scoops of ice cream. Yield approximately 9 1/2 cups punch.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Add parsley onion and garlic. Cut bread in half (longways). Brush on butter mixture over both halves of bread. Bake at 325\u00b0 on a cookie sheet for 10 to 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Banana Rolls
instructions: Peel banana and cut in half. Cut the crusts off the white bread. Spread a thin layer of peanut butter on the bread slices. Put half a banana on each piece of bread. Wrap the bread around the banana. The peanut butter will make the bread stick to the banana. Cut the banana and bread rolls into 1-inch slices. Makes 10 mini sandwiches.

title: Coconut Pecan Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except frosting then fold in can of coconut pecan frosting. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Mix zucchini onion and salt; cover with water and allow to set a minimum of 5 hours or overnight. When time is up bring to a boil the remaining ingredients. Combine boiled syrup with drained zucchini and allow to simmer 1/2 hour. Put mixture in hot canning jars and seal.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Mustard(Good On Ham Sandwiches)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook until boiling.

title: Scottish Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter adding sugar gradually until well blended. Dont overwork or let butter become oily. Gradually work in flour. Turn dough out on lightly floured board to pat out. You can use all flour or part flour and part confectioners sugar to pat out on. Pat dough to 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch thickness. Cut with cookie cutter no larger than 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Prick each cookie twice with a fork. Place cookies on baking sheet.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Use salt and pepper to taste. Chill well before serving.

title: Sausage-Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from the mushrooms; chop stems finely. Reserve caps. Place stems in a paper towel and squeeze to remove any liquid. In a skillet heat 1 1/2 tablespoons butter. Cook stems and onions until soft. Add lemon juice basil salt and pepper; cook until almost all the liquids have evaporated. Cool. Combine mushroom mixture with sausage and parsley. Stuff into mushroom caps. Combine crumbs and cheese; sprinkle over stuffed mushrooms. Dot each with remaining butter. Place in a greased baking pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Baste occasionally with pan juices. Serve hot. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Lemon Cake
instructions: Beat ingredients for 3 minutes. Pour into a well greased and floured Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes in pan and then turn out onto cake plate.

title: Swedish Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Heat small amount of salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water). Add beans carrots cauliflower and onion. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until done 12 to 15 minutes. Drain vegetables reserving liquid. Place vegetables in an ungreased oblong dish. Heat margarine over low heat until melted. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture is smooth and bubbly; remove from heat. Stir in 1 cup of the reserved liquid and the whipping cream. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute; remove from heat. Pour over vegetables. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Set oven to 550\u00b0. Broil until top is light brown and bubbly 3 to 5 minutes. Serve. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli about 10 minutes in a covered dish with 3/4 cup of salted water. Bring to boil. Drain and save water. Saute onions in margarine (medium skillet) until tender. Mix in Cheez Whiz soup and saved water until well blended. Add rice and mix well. Spoon about 1/3 of rice mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Layer broccoli and rice mixture ending with rice mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 45 minutes.

title: Fish Chowder
instructions: Steam fish until flaky. Peel and dice potatoes. Cook potatoes and carrot until soft (not mushy); use just enough water to cover potatoes. Mash potatoes lightly (leave lumpy). Do not mash carrot. Add celery onion fish cream milk butter and salt and pepper to taste; simmer over low heat approximately 45 minutes. Do not boil. Yields approximately 6 quarts. Can be frozen.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in 1-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve as hot dip with crackers or chips.

title: Cauliflower With Cheese Sauce
instructions: Cook cauliflower until tender. Mix the next four ingredients together in a saucepan. Cook until the mixture is thick and cheese has melted. Pour over cauliflower.

title: Pumpkin Bread In Jars
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs pumpkin and water. Sift together flour powder soda salt and spices. Add to pumpkin mixture. Stir in nuts. Pour into 6 greased wide-mouthed pint sized jelly jars filling 1/2 full. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. When done remove one jar at a time from oven. Clean sealing edge and screw Kerr caps on firmly tight.

title: Easy Jello Salad
instructions: Combine Jell-O pudding and water in saucepan. Cook until mixture thickens and then cool completely. Add remaining ingredients and chill. Arrange extra mandarin oranges or strawberries on top.

title: Turkey Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place into greased loaf Pyrex dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Brown top in broiler.

title: Hot Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix well and roll into balls and bake 15 to 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 10 wells in a muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray. With a mixer at medium speed beat milk mayonnaise sugar and flour until smooth. Divide batter evenly in 10 prepared wells. Into each mound of dough bury 1 to 2 tablespoons of cheese. Spray tops of dough mounds with Pam. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and immediately spray tops with Pam again and dust biscuits with a little garlic salt. Makes 10 biscuits.

title: Peppy Potato Salad
instructions: Cover potatoes with salted water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook 30 minutes or until tender; drain and cool slightly. Peel and dice potatoes. Combine potatoes green onions green pepper celery carrot and eggs in a bowl.

title: Sparkling Apple Punch
instructions: Combine apple cider papaya nectar and ice in punch bowl. Add papaya and orange slices. Makes about 4 quarts.

title: Diabetic Cookies
instructions: Boil the raisins and prunes in the water for 3 minutes; let cool. Add the Crisco or oleo. When cool add the remaining ingredients. Mix well and chill. Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
instructions: In a large size pie plate spread can of dip second layer spread mashed avocado and third layer mix taco seasoning mayonnaise sour cream and spread. Top with green onions chopped tomatoes black olives and cheese. Serve with taco chips.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese and milk in double boiler. Grease casserole dish. Layer broccoli cheese and Ritz crackers. Repeat layers. End with crackers. Pour butter over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Taglinini-Mexican Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger onions and pepper. Cook the noodles. Add all ingredients together. Put cheese on top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Cookies From Old Oatmeal Box
instructions: Beat shortening sugars egg water and vanilla until creamy. Mix together flour salt and soda. Add to creamed mixture; blend well. Stir in oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated oven (325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Strawberry Preserves Or Jam
instructions: Combine strawberries and sugar and let set for 20 minutes. Boil for 1 minute the water and Penjell. Pour into strawberries and continue stirring for 2 or 3 minutes. Pour in jars and let stand until firm.

title: Peppered Steak
instructions: Cut round steak into bite size pieces. Add enough flour to coat the meat. Place meat in hot oil in skillet. While meat is frying start your rice (instructions are on box) and chop up peppers and onions. Cook meat until done stirring well. Remove the meat. Add peppers and onions to skillet. Fry until tender. Add meat soy sauce and water. Cook until sauce thickens. Serve over rice.

title: Ernest'S Baked Apples
instructions: Peel split and core the apples. Place in a frying pan and add the water and sugar. Bring the mixture to a boil. Cook until the apples begin to look clear. Lift the apples from the frying pan and place in ovenproof glass baking dish. To the sugar and water mixture add the orange juice. Cook the mixture down until only 1 cup remains. Pour over the apples. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In bottom of a greased 10 x 6-inch baking dish combine croutons and shredded cheese. Combine eggs milk salt mustard onion powder and pepper. Mix until blended. Pour over crouton mixture. Sprinkle bacon over top of casserole.

title: Double Chocolate Snack Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch). In small mixing bowl combine flour sugar cocoa baking soda and salt. Add water oil vinegar and vanilla; beat until smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips over top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack. Cut into squares. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Meringue Pineapple Bars
instructions: Combine cake mix egg yolks butter and vanilla. Mix well and pat into well-greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar gradually. Fold in coconut and pineapple. Pour mixture over cake mix. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into squares while warm. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Mix flour sugar and baking powder; add to well beaten egg yolks. Add dates and nuts. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake for 30 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve with whipped cream and cherry on top.

title: Shrimp Picante
instructions: Bring picante to boil in deep pan with butter onion and garlic. Cut shrimp in half or leave whole. Add to picante until hot. Serve on rice. Serves 2.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients. Add enough water to make ingredients form balls size of a nickel. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Hamburger Stew
instructions: Saute hamburger in pot. When fully cooked drain out all oil. Place back on stove.\tAdd vegetable soup and water. Put diced potatoes in soup mixture; boil until potatoes are soft. Add garlic salt for seasoning.

title: Whipping Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating each egg into sugar-butter mixture. Alternate putting cream and flour into mixture beating well. Add extract. Put into cold oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Daniels Favorite Baked Beans
instructions: Brown the chuck slightly. Drain. Add onion; cook 5 minutes. Add salt pepper garlic powder pork and beans and tomato sauce. Cook 10 to 15 minutes slowly to blend flavors.

title: Stove-Top Beef Stew
instructions: In large kettle melt margarine and saute one coarsely chopped onion and the beef pieces until brown on all sides. Add broth bay leaf salt and pepper. Add the other three onions (peeled but whole) and the chunks of carrots and potatoes. Add the water. Bring to a boil reduce heat cover and simmer at least two hours better longer as the kitchen fills with a wonderful aroma. Add more water as needed to keep broth lively. Serve in soup bowls with lots of broth. Serves 4.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the flour and the sugar. In heavy saucepan combine butter shortening coffee or water and cocoa. Stir and heat to boiling. Pour boiling mixture over the flour and sugar in the bowl. Add the buttermilk eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix well using a wooden spoon or high speed on electric mixer. Pour into a well-buttered 17 1/2 x 11-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brownies test done in th center. While brownies bake prepare the frosting.

title: Gingerbread(With Master Mix)
instructions: Add 1/4 cup water to ingredients and beat 2 minutes. Add remaining 1/4 cup water and beat 1 minute longer. Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Light 'N' Easy Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Place onions on 12 x 18-inch sheet of heavy-duty foil. Place chicken on onions. Sprinkle with salt pepper basil and paprika. Top with vegetables margarine and water. Sprinkle with additional basil salt and pepper to taste.

title: I Can'T Believe Its A Cookie
instructions: Mix ingredients. Roll into balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten cookies with a fork. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes.

title: A. Gentile Jr.'S International Onion Soup
instructions: Slice onions 1/8-inch thick. Saute in melted butter over medium heat until golden. Add water and bouillon cubes. When cubes dissolve lower heat. Add wine black pepper 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese garlic powder tarragon and red pepper. Simmer 30 minutes. Spoon soup into ovenproof soup dishes. Place slice of toasted bread into soup; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and cover with Muenster cheese. Place under broiler until brown and bubbly. Serves 4.

title: Chicken And Straw Mushroom Soup
instructions: Combine 1 tablespoon cornstarch and water. Set aside for later use. Debone the chicken breast and cut into 1/4-inch cubes. In a medium mixing bowl combine the chicken 1 tablespoon cornstarch and the salt. Mix well and set aside for later use. In 3-quart soup pot combine the straw mushrooms mushroom juice ginger onion and chicken stock. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Remove and discard the ginger and onion. Add the chicken pieces in a sprinkling fashion and the frozen peas. When the mixture begins to boil slowly pour the beaten egg whites over the boiling mixture. Restir the cornstarch and water; pour into the soup mixture. Stir constantly and continue to cook until the mixture begins to thicken. Stir in the sesame oil and white pepper. Pour into a serving soup bowl and garnish with the coriander.

title: Marshmallow Chocolate Philly Fudge
instructions: Place cream cheese in a bowl and cream until soft and smooth. Slowly blend in sugar. Add salt and melted chocolate; mix well. Add vanilla and cream and mix until well blended. Fold in marshmallows. Press into well greased pan. Place in refrigerator until firm about 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Pear Honey
instructions: Boil 20 minutes. Put in hot jars and seal.

title: Grasshopper Pie
instructions: Mix cookies and butter and press into pie pan. Put marshmallows and milk into double boiler until melted. Cool completely. Add creme de menthe and whipped cream. Pour into crust and chill several hours. Top with shaved chocolate.

title: Baked Beans With Pineapple
instructions: Combine beans pineapple ketchup brown sugar and mustard in saucepan. Simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally to cook down liquid. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with bacon. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add milk slowly. Cook in a large skillet until it thickens. Add butter and vanilla. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Unbaked Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil sugar milk and oleo for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in other ingredients and cook slightly longer. Let set for 1 hour. Spoon out on wax paper.

title: Cider 'N Spice Cake
instructions: Mix sugar salt and cornstarch in saucepan. Slowly stir in apple cider or juice. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add lemon juice and butter. Cool.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Line bottom of buttered casserole with mashed potatoes then add meat. Cover with more potatoes. Dot top with butter.

title: Pasta Salad Plus
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and rinse in cold water. Place in a large bowl; add the next nine ingredients. Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat.

title: Blueberry Pudding
instructions: Cream butter salt and sugar; add the egg whites one at a time. When all added mix in the milk and the flour sifted with the baking powder. Add the berries and pour into a buttered mold cover and steam for two hours. Serve with a hard sauce or lemon sauce.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Brush pie shell with egg white and bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 1 minute (this prevents a soggy crust). Beat eggs slightly and add other ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Bake for 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 then reduce to 375\u00b0 and continue to bake for 30 minutes until firm and light brown.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar. Add vanilla. Add Eagle Brand milk. Add peaches. Mix each time you add an ingredient. Add enough milk to fill 4-quart freezer.

title: Smothered Chicken With Vidalias
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper in a plastic food storage bag. Add chicken and shake to coat well. In 10-inch skillet melt shortening or oil and brown chicken. Drain off fat and sprinkle soup mix and onion over chicken in skillet. Mix together milk and water and add to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat about 30 minutes or until chicken is done. If dish seems too dry add more liquid. Serve over rice.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Place in mixing bowl. Grate cheese and add to macaroni. Add beaten eggs milk salt and pepper. Stir all well. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until set.

title: Pane Alle Olive(Bread With Olives)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the milk. Heap the flour and salt in a mound in a mixing bowl. Make a well in the center and pour in the oil. Mix while adding the yeast and milk. Stir mixture thoroughly and pour on floured surface. Knead the dough for 5 minutes and shape into a ball. Put the dough in a floured bowl cover and set aside to rise until double in volume. Punch down the dough add the olives and mix well.

title: Orange Refrigerator Cookies(From The Files Of Ola Dortch Williams)
instructions: Sift together flour salt soda and baking powder. In large bowl combine shortening butter brown sugar granulated sugar and 1 unbeaten egg. Beat on medium-high speed for 1 minute. Gradually add alternately sifted flour mixture and orange juice orange rind and lemon extract. Add 1 cup finely chopped pecans. Mix all and shape into a long roll. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Slice thin and put on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Potato And Bean Casserole(Delicious)
instructions: Boil potatoes; drain and slice round. Place sliced potatoes in bottom of baking dish. Top with can of green beans. Sprinkle pimientos over beans.

title: Old Fashioned Jelly Roll
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar and continue beating until fluffy. Add water and vanilla. Cream. Sift dry ingredients together and add gradually. Pour batter in a 15 x 11-inch jelly roll pan lined with greased wax paper. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Turn out immediately on a tea towel which has been sprinkled with powdered sugar. Cut off edges of cake and remove wax paper. Spread liberally with jelly or jam and roll up. Wrap with towel until cool. Remove towel and spread with cream icing and garnish with nuts or cherries. Yields 10 servings.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: In blender mix together the first 5 ingredients. Add 1 cup of the cheese; divide mixture in half. Stir chicken into 1/2 of the mixture. Heat tortillas. Spoon 2 tablespoons of chicken mixture in the middle of tortilla. Fold over and place seam side down in pan. After making the desired amount pour other half of mixture over the tortillas. Sprinkle with other half of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 16.

title: Veal Scallopini With Tomatoes
instructions: Place these ingredients on top of each shank. Pour 1 cup or less of water in bottom of casserole along with about 1/2 cup white wine. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours covered.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate and serve with chips.

title: Doubly Good Yeast Rolls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl; mix 3 minutes at low speed. Set aside.

title: Peanut Lover'S Dream Bars
instructions: To make graham cracker crust toss together the first 3 ingredients and press onto bottom of 12 x 8-inch pan sprayed with cooking spray. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes or until firm.

title: Celebration Salad
instructions: Prepare gelatin in boiling water. Allow to cool before adding pineapple and sherbet. Fold in ice cream. Place in an 8 x 8-inch glass cake dish. Allow to set before serving.

title: Barbeque Sauce For Chicken
instructions: Boil all together a few minutes and keep chicken basted with sauce on grill until done.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate. Brown beef and onions; drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spread in plate. Beat milk Bisquick and eggs until smooth 15 seconds in blender or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes. Top with tomatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Easy Ricotta Cheese Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed. Grease and flour 9 x 13 cake pan. Pour cake into the pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cake batter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Refrigerate.

title: Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a round pan 9 x 1 1/2-inch. Mix cream cheese 1/3 cup sugar and the almond extract. Reserve. Mix baking mix milk 1/4 cup sugar and the margarine until dough forms. Pat in bottom and 1-inch up side of pan. Spread cream cheese mixture over dough. Carefully spread preserves over cream cheese. Sprinkle with almonds.

title: Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Cook butter and sugar over low heat until bubbly. Cool. Add eggs one at a time beating thoroughly after each addition. Add vanilla extract then sifted dry ingredients and coconut. Mix thoroughly. One cup nut meats may also be added. Spread in shallow 10 1/2 x 15-inch pan (greased) and bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) about 25 minutes. While warm cut in squares. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Chinese Curried Beef
instructions: Snip off ends of pea pods. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil. Stir-fry pods for 1 minute. Remove and keep warm. Heat remaining oil. Stir-fry onions until lightly browned. Stir in beef. Stir-fry over high heat until just cooked. Pour off excess grease. Stir in curry powder and salt. Cook about 3 to 4 minutes until aroma is released. Add rice. Combine and heat thoroughly. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Disjoint the chicken. Season with salt. Chop the onion fine. Fry the chicken and set aside. Saute the onion chicken thin coconut milk and curry powder and cook until the sauce is thick using a little flour for thickening if necessary. When about dry add pure coconut milk. Add pepper and salt to taste.

title: Brown And Serve Sally Lunn Rolls
instructions: Sprinkle yeast into warm water; stir until dissolved. Beat in\tsugar\tsalt milk margarine and eggs. Add 3 cups flour and beat until smooth. Beat in enough additional flour (about 2 3/4 cups) to make a soft dough that leaves sides of bowl. Cover and let rise until doubled about 1 hour.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. With large spoon drop batter in hot oil in skillet. Keep pancakes small. Fry on both sides until brown.

title: Blender Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put ingredients into the blender and mix. Pour into a deep buttered pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Microwave One Dish Dinner
instructions: Brown meat and seasonings for 5 minutes Place eggplant in microwave dish and cover with meat mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp. basil and 1/2 tsp. oregano. Top with 16 oz. can of tomato sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover and microwave on medium for 10 minutes.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Chop Oreos very fine. Add 1/2 mixture whipped cream cheese margarine and sugar. Mix in Cool Whip. In another bowl whip pudding milk and vanilla until thick. Fold two mixtures together. Next put whipped mixture then top with remaining Oreos.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix cheese and peanut butter. Mix the frosting sugar in slowly then beat until fluffy. Gradually add Cool Whip and mix until smooth. Pour in pie shell and freeze 8 hours or overnight. Can garnish with chocolate curls. Remove from freezer 1/2 hour before cutting.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cut up chicken and mix soup and sour cream. Put in a Pyrex dish. Crumble the Ritz crackers on top of mixture along with melted margarine. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; blend until moistened. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Heavenly Delight
instructions: Melt margarine and then mix with eggs flour sugar pineapple and coconut. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until filling is set and brown. Makes 1 pie.

title: Pineapple Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spread on cake. Cake must be refrigerated. Delicious on a white cake.

title: Confetti Salad
instructions: Bring salt pepper sugar vinegar and water to a boil. Cool; stir in oil. Mix beans peas corn pimiento green pepper celery and onion. Pour dressing over vegetables. Toss to coat; chill in refrigerator. Makes fifteen 1/2 cup servings.

title: Hermits
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs molasses and dry ingredients. Fold in raisins and nuts. Roll in string 3/4-inch wide and 1/2-inch thick. Sprinkle sugar on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 on cookie sheet for 12 minutes. Cool and cut in cookie size pieces.

title: Orange Slice Cookies
instructions: Coat the orange slice pieces and nuts with some of the flour. Beat eggs and add sugar. Combine all of the ingredients. Line a 10 x 14-inch pan with waxed paper or grease and dust well with flour. Bake about 40 minutes at 315\u00b0.

title: Idiots Delight
instructions: Brown and season meat celery and onion! Mix remaining ingredients. Pour in baking dish; top with chow mein noodles (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or cook in crock-pot for 2 hours on low.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix together gelatin water oil unbeaten eggs and cake mix. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed of mixer. Beat until smooth. Add the strawberries. Beat for 1 minute or until thoroughly mixed. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. When cake is cooled frost with strawberry frosting.

title: Cup Of Gold Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half. Scoop out seeds. Place cut side down in shallow baking pan filled with 1/4-inch water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Turn squash. Fill each center with 1 tablespoon brown sugar 1/2 tablespoon butter and 4 to 5 orange sections. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes longer.

title: Marinated Salad
instructions: Use portions as desired of the above items. Marinate in Krafts Italian olive oil dressing. Refrigerate overnight. Serve cold.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Mix cream cheese until smooth and almond extract. Fold in Cool Whip. Cut angel food cake into 1-inch cubes. Lay 1/2 cake in trifle bowl 1/2 Cool Whip and cream cheese mixture. Top with 1/2 cherry pie filling. Repeat process.

title: Stuffed Red Snapper
instructions: Rub fish inside and out with lime juice and sherry. Season with salt and pepper; let stand in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt butter in skillet and saute celery scallions and garlic until tender. Add remaining ingredients except wine to skillet. Mix and use to stuff fish. Place in baking pan and pour over wine baking about 40 minutes or until fish flakes easily. Number of servings 6.

title: Hot Milk Cake
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add sugar gradually. Add flour and baking powder. Heat milk with butter until almost boiling. Add vanilla and hot milk mixture to batter and mix well. Grease pan and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 45 minutes. Test cake. Let cool and remove from pan.

title: Yellow Biscuit
instructions: Separate the eggs. Add all the sugar to egg yolks plus the lemon peel. Beat until nice and fluffy on high speed about 15 minutes. Fold in flour. Whip the egg whites until fluffy. Add to the egg yolk mixture. Mix thoroughly. Grease 9-inch pans and line the bottom with wax paper. Make four separate layers. Let it cool before frosting.

title: 7-Layer Casserole
instructions: In a large casserole dish put rice. Pour corn with juice over rice. Salt and pepper. Pour 1/2 can tomato sauce and 1 cup water. Sprinkle onion and pepper over this. Break up the ground beef over this and pour the remaining 1/2 can of sauce and 1 more cup of water. Place bacon strips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered and 1/2 hour uncovered.

title: Caramel Rolls
instructions: Spray baking pan with Pam. Place frozen rolls in pan. Pour butter over rolls. Sprinkle with brown sugar and pudding. Sprinkle with pecans (optional). Place in cold oven and leave overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Tex-Mex Bean Dip
instructions: In large 11 x 13-inch casserole dish layer bean dip; set aside. Combine avocados lemon juice salt and pepper. Mix well and spread over bean dip; set aside. Combine salsa dressing sour cream and taco seasoning. Mix well and spread over avocado mixture then layer chopped green onion diced tomatoes Cheddar cheese and black olives. Serve with toasted corn chips.

title: Perfect Cornbread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Mix milk egg and shortening and add to flour mixture. Stir just enough to moisten flour mixture. Pour into an iron skillet that has been heated on top of stove with 2 tablespoons of oil to hot (the cornbread mixture should sizzle when it is poured into the pan). Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fumi Salad
instructions: Blend together last 5 ingredients and pour over above ingredients just before serving.

title: Plum Crunch
instructions: Combine prunes sugar 1 tablespoon flour cinnamon and orange peel. Mix well. Put mixture in an 8-inch round pan. Combine 3/4 cup flour brown sugar and salt. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle mixture over the prunes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown on top.

title: Macaroni And Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook the Creamettes according to package directions. Mix all the ingredients except the potato chips and put in a greased casserole. If the mixture is too thick more milk may be added. Top with the crushed potato chips and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Juice Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Process on high until dressing is smooth. Cover and refrigerate several hours. Serve with fresh salad greens or fresh fruit. Makes 8 1/2 cups for 1-tablespoon servings.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: Mix and freeze in freezer like ice cream.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients and keep in a closed container. To serve add 3 to 4 tablespoons of mix to 1 cup of boiling water.

title: Baked Kidney Beans
instructions: Combine beans onion ketchup and sugar in greased 2-quart casserole. Top with bacon. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) 1 1/4 hours. Makes 6 servings.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: In a very large bowl mix together the melted margarine chopped onion cream of chicken soup sour cream and Cheddar cheese. Stir well. Gently stir in the thawed hash browns until thoroughly mixed. Spoon into a 2 to 2 1/2-quart baking dish (about 8 x 11-inch) well greased.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together 2 cups cooked chicken breasts cut into chunks with drained pineapple and drained mandarin oranges celery seedless grape halves and almonds with as much mayonnaise as you like.

title: Fluffy Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed; drain. Toss bread crumbs with butter salt pepper parsley basil and Parmesan cheese. Butter a 3-quart casserole dish. Arrange layers of macaroni bread crumbs and Cheddar cheese in casserole dish. Slowly drizzle milk over top of casserole until all is absorbed. Bake 1 hour until bubbly and brown.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Place bread in greased glass dish; pour margarine over bread. Place browned drained meat over bread. Mix together eggs mustard milk salt and pepper; pour over meat and bread.

title: Baked Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Drain salmon reserving liquid; add enough milk to measure 1 cup and set aside. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat; add onion and cook until tender. Add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk mixture; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Stir in salt and pepper; set aside.

title: Good Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix meats together by hand in large bowl. Add Worcestershire sauce eggs cracker crumbs ketchup water and soup mix. Mix. Shape into loaf in shallow baking dish. Drape loaf with bacon strips then pour tomato sauce over loaf. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until done to your liking.

title: 24 Hour Slaw
instructions: Slice cabbage; stir in sugar. Slice onions in rings. Place 1/2 of cabbage in bottom of dish. Cover with onion rings. Top with remaining cabbage. Set aside.

title: Miki'S Onion Ring Salad
instructions: Place onions in a bowl and pour mixture of vinegar and sugar over the top. Add water to cover. Put in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes; drain. When ready to serve fold in mayonnaise mixed with celery seed. This is real good with fried fish!

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Arrange cooked broccoli in 9 x 13-inch pan or larger flat casserole dish. Cut chicken in large bite size pieces; place over broccoli and mix soup mayonnaise and lemon juice. Pour over broccoli and chicken. Sprinkle with cheese bread crumbs and drizzle melted butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered about 1 hour.

title: Spiced Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 275\u00b0. Combine sugar salt cinnamon cloves and nutmeg. Beat egg white and water; add to sugar mixture. Beat until well blended. Gradually add pecan halves and stir until well coated with glaze. Place nuts on greased baking sheet and bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Crock-Pot Barbecue
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover. Cook on high in crock-pot for 6 to 8 hours. Wire whisk until meat is shredded. Makes 6 or more sandwiches.

title: Cherry Dream Squares
instructions: In bowl combine cake mix 6 tablespoons butter and 1 cup oats. Mix until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup crumbs for topping. To remaining crumbs add 1 egg until well blended. Press into greased 13 x 9- inch pan. Pour cherry filling over crust. Spread to cover. To reserved crumbs in large bowl add 1/4 cup oats 2 tablespoons butter nuts and brown sugar. Beat until mixed. Sprinkle over cherry mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Coq Au Vin(Chicken In Wine)
instructions: Fry bacon to crisp. Set bacon aside. Flour chicken and brown in bacon grease. Set chicken aside. Cook onions and mushrooms until mushrooms are tender. Place chicken onions and mushrooms in large pot (or roaster oven). Crumble bacon and add. Add carrots and crushed garlic. Pour in red wine and chicken broth. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 2 hours or until chicken is tender. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Candy Bar Pie
instructions: Place candy bars in pastry shell; set aside. In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Add eggs sour cream and peanut butter. Beat at low speed until combined. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until set. Cool on wire rack.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Fill pie shell with fresh sliced peaches.

title: Walnut Streusel Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add flour baking powder salt and baking soda alternately with sour cream. Add vanilla. Spread half of batter in greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the topping. Cover with remaining batter. Sprinkle rest of topping on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Frog Egg Salad
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Gradually stir in pineapple juice and beaten eggs. Cook over moderate heat stirring until thick. Add lemon juice. Cool to room temperature. (If you use pineapple without sugar add several packs of Equal as last step.) Bring water to rolling boil. Add salt and oil. Cook macaroni until done. Drain rinse drain and cool. Combine with egg mixture. Mix gently but good. Refrigerate in airtight container overnight. Add oranges pineapple Cool Whip marshmallows and coconut.

title: Oven Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Melt margarine into the bottom of a sheet cake pan or oven roaster. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Crack and beat eggs. Add hot milk and salt and pour into prepared pan. Bake 25 minutes then stir gently to loosen edges. Bake an additional 15 minutes or until eggs are set to your liking. Serves 25. Easy way to feed a crowd; we use this at camp a lot.

title: Lasagna Casserole
instructions: Cook hamburger garlic and onion.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Add milk to corn; add flour sifted with salt pepper and baking powder. Add butter and beaten eggs. Drop by spoonfuls in hot grease. Fry until golden brown.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash onion 1 tablespoon margarine eggs salt and pepper. Pour milk over 1 cup bread crumbs. Set aside for 3 minutes. Then stir into squash mixture. Spoon into lightly greased 1-quart casserole. Combine remaining bread crumbs and margarine. Spoon over squash. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Rum Ball
instructions: Crush wafers; mix nuts cocoa corn syrup and rum until soft paste. Dust palms of hands with confectioners sugar. Shape in balls. Set aside 1 hour then roll in sugar. Store in airtight container. Makes 30 balls.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix thoroughly shortening peanut butter granulated sugar brown sugar and egg. Blend in flour soda baking powder and salt. Cover and chill. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place 3 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. With fork dipped in flour flatten in crisscross pattern to 2 inches. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process for 5 to 10 seconds. Serve with corn chips.

title: Creamy White Cake Icing
instructions: Make paste with flour and milk. Cook and cool. Add shortening butter sugar. Beat until spreading consistency. May add 1/4 tsp. vanilla if desired.

title: Great Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together. Bake in large greased pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Gracie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a bowl at once. Beat at medium speed for 20 minutes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or longer. Put the cake in cold oven. Bake in Bundt pan.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Add topping.

title: Candy Cookies
instructions: Boil first 4 ingredients for 2 minutes then add quickly the peanut butter vanilla and quick oats. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper.

title: Strawberry Meringue Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix orange juice water egg yolks and orange peel. Beat for 4 minutes in mixer. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Beat egg whites with tartar to soft peaks. Gradually add 1 cup sugar beating until stiff. Spread meringue evenly over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool completely. With flexible spatula carefully remove layers from pans keeping meringue side up.

title: Preacher'S Casserole
instructions: Brown meat. Add onions and celery. Cook until well done. Mix in remaining ingredients. Put in greased casserole (2 1/2-quart size). Top with remaining noodles and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Just A Crock
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on low for 6 hours.

title: Easy Vegetarian Chili On Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onions carrots celery and jalapeno peppers. Cook stirring often for 6 minutes. Stir in tomatoes garlic green pepper parsley chili powder cumin oregano and salt. Bring to simmer. Cook covered for 20 minutes stirring often. Add beans and cook 5 minutes more. Add zucchini and cook uncovered for 5 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Georgia Delight Cake
instructions: Add eggs oil and mandarin oranges (and juice) to cake mix. Blend together and bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients until mixed well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Eggplant Mozzarella
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large saucepan over low heat cook green onions and mushrooms in 1/4 cup water until tender. Add spaghetti sauce; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle salt over sliced eggplant; set aside to cool about 10 minutes.

title: Pecan-Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine sugar syrup flour and milk into beaten eggs. Add butter nuts and coconut. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Crab Imperial
instructions: Heat milk to a boiling point. Melt butter and stir in flour. Pour heated milk into flour and butter mixture beating until smooth and creamy. Cool. Add egg seasonings lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise; blend well. Add crabmeat and mix well but gently. Fill shells or heatproof small dishes. Now mix 2 tablespoons mayonnaise with 2 tablespoons milk and brush over tops. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until piping hot and lightly browned. Serves 8.

title: Watermelon Preserves
instructions: Pare and cut watermelon rind into pieces 2 inches long and 3/4-inch wide. Cover with brine made by dissolving 1 tablespoon salt in 1 quart water. Let stand overnight; drain. Cover with water and boil for 10 minutes; drain. Cover with a heavy syrup made of 1 part sugar and 1 part water. Add 1 thinly sliced lemon to each 3 quarts rind. Add whole spices if desired. Cook slowly until rind is tender and clear.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes; mix all ingredients except corn flakes and some of the cheese. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle with corn flake crumbs and cheese. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes. Layer bacon strips over top and bake until done.

title: Family Favorite Chicken And Stuffing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions but add vegetables with seasoning packet. Combine soup milk and parsley; set aside. In a 2 to 3-quart baking dish arrange stuffing across center of dish. Spoon thin layer of soup mixture in dish on each side. Arrange chicken over soup mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Pour remaining soup mixture over chicken. Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more or until chicken is fork-tender.

title: Banana Nut Loaf
instructions: Place all ingredients into mixing bowl and mix together. Pour into small loaf pans which have been greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Dessert
instructions: Spread pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix over fruit. Spread nuts on top and press down. Pour melted oleo over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned good.

title: Crab Soup
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients. Cook over low heat until hot. Also good to prepare in crock-pot on low.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour cinnamon and salt. Toss with zucchini. Pour the lemon juice over the mixture. Put the mixture into the pie shell. Pour the beaten eggs over the mixture in the pie shell and place the top crust over the pie. Add a few slashes near the center to allow for steam to escape. Place pie on a cookie sheet and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or a few minutes longer until golden brown.

title: Molded Beet Salad
instructions: Drain beets; save juice. Measure juice and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid. Bring to a boil then remove from heat. Add gelatin sugar vinegar and horseradish. Stir until gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Add beets. Pour into mold or 8-inch square pan and refrigerate until firm. Serve over lettuce to which mayonnaise and red wine vinegar has been added to taste.

title: Granny'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except ground chuck. Add ground chuck to mixture. Press into 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Frosting
instructions: In a medium saucepan melt butter. Stir in cocoa and cook 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until smooth. Spread on cake or brownies.

title: Sawmill Gravy
instructions: Cook sausage until brown in a large skillet over medium flame. Drain and reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet. Blend in flour; brown stirring constantly. Add milk. Bring to a boil; reduce temperature. Add sausage salt and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. Serve over hot open-faced biscuits.

title: Easy Lasagne
instructions: Brown hamburger with onions; add water tomato paste and spices. Simmer 25 minutes. Stir occasionally. Grease bottom of lasagne pan. Start with sauce then layer of cooked noodles sauce and cheese ending with sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Celery Spaghetti
instructions: Cut celery ribs into long thin strands about the size of thick spaghetti. Lay in a large kettle; pour on quarts of boiling water and stir in salt. Cook until celery is limp (about 10 minutes). Serve after draining with any pasta sauce. Yield 2 servings.

title: Hot Hawaiian Spread
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together until smooth. Place cream cheese package (either 3 ounces or 8 ounces) on small plate. Pour jelly mixture over cream cheese liberally. This may be served on Ritz crackers or toasted thin sliced Pepperidge Farm bread.

title: Fresh Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Beat together eggs oil and sugar. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Turn butter into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 70 minutes at 300\u00b0. Frost with cream cheese icing.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie
instructions: In cooking pan mix lemon pie mix sugar egg yolks and 3 cups water. Cook until thickens. Pinch cream cheese into pie mixture. Use hand mixer. Pour into baked pie shell. Beat egg whites and put over top. Bake in oven until top is brown. Let cool.

title: Butter Bundt Cake
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients until dissolved. Add eggs 1 at a time beating 2 minutes after each egg. Add vanilla and butter flavoring. Now take sugar cinnamon and chopped pecans and mix together. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Put 1/3 of batter in pan then sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar mixture over it. Then 1/3 more batter and rest of sugar mixture. Finish with rest of batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done. Test with toothpick. Let stand 15 minutes before removing from pan then glaze.

title: Noodle Supreme Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Cook noodles and drain. Set aside. Mix Ricotta cheese 1 cup of Mozzarella cheese egg and oregano. Combine with spaghetti sauce noodles and beef. Pour in baking dish and top with other cup of Mozzarella cheese. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes to heat through. Can be frozen.

title: Marbled Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Butter a 9-inch baking pan. Chop and melt chocolate. Cool.

title: Portuguese Style Beans
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain water. Refill pan with enough water to cover beans. Cook over medium heat until tender about 1 hour. Saute onion and parsley in skillet. When beans are tender add onion and parsley to pot. Add tomato sauce and spices. Cut linguica in small pieces. Add to beans. Cook 1 hour over medium heat.

title: Grated Sweet Potato Pudding(My Mother'S Recipe)
instructions: When I was a teen-ager \Chewy Gooies\ were a special treat. Mrs. Barnes my second mom made them often for Sue and I. Sue carries on the tradition as do I whenever a special treat is called for.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Brown sausage and chicken in bacon drippings. Remove; add flour to make roux. Add onions green pepper and garlic. Cook until tender. Add water rice tomatoes parsley onion tops and salt. Stir in browned sausage and chicken. Bring to boil reduce heat to low temperature and cook covered for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Best Scalloped Corn
instructions: Cook onion in butter until lightly browned; add flour and seasonings. Mix well. Stir in corn baking powder and egg. Pour into buttered casserole. Cover with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Combine first 5 ingredients; mix until smooth. Add additional milk if necessary until batter resembles pancake batter. Working in batches dip tomato slices into batter allowing excess batter to drip back into bowl. Fry in 2 inches of hot oil (375\u00b0) in a heavy skillet until browned turning once carefully with tongs. Transfer to a colander to drain. To keep the cooked tomatoes from getting soggy before they are served stand them up like wheels in the serving dish instead of stacking them.

title: Canadian Rum Cake
instructions: Chop dates and walnuts. Set aside. Cream butter and sugar until well blended. Fold dates and walnuts into butter mixture. Add baking soda to boiling water and pour over batter. Add eggs and stir in the flour and salt. Cream until smooth. Add rum or rum flavoring and blend well. Pour into greased 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake in preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes invert onto serving plate. Drizzle with fondant icing if desired.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with 1/2 stuffing mix. Place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Boil skin and debone chicken breast (save the broth). Crumble chicken over stuffing mixture. Add 2 cans broth to soups and pour over chicken. Top with remaining stuffing mix.

title: Raisin Bars
instructions: Cover & cook raisins until tender. Cream the oleo sugar & egg. Add 3/4 c. liquid from raisins. Add flour baking powder soda cinnamon & nutmeg. Mix in cooked raisins and chopped nuts. Put in a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Put icing on them right after they come out of the oven.

title: Savannah Sweets
instructions: Peel sweet potatoes and cut in 1/4-inch thick lengthwise slices. Arrange in skillet preferably heavy sprinkling layers with sugar and dotting with butter. Add vanilla salt and cayenne to water to taste and pour over potatoes. Grind nutmeg over top. Cover skillet. Bring liquid to boil rapidly. Lower heat and simmer 20 minutes adding more liquid as needed to prevent scorching.

title: Tropical Punch
instructions: Mix together and put in freezer overnight. When ready just pour 7-Up or Sprite over the frozen mixture.

title: Italian Black-Eyed Peas With Pasta
instructions: In large skillet saute first 6 ingredients in olive oil until tender. Add tomatoes broth salt and pepper. Cover stirring frequently. Simmer 10 minutes. Add black-eyed peas. Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes.

title: Amaretto
instructions: Mix water sugar and lemon. Simmer 20 minutes. Cool. Add extracts and vodka. Can be used any time or let mellow.

title: No-Cook Divinity
instructions: Beat frosting mix corn syrup vanilla and boiling water in small mixer bowl on high speed until stiff peaks form about 5 minutes. Transfer to large mixer bowl; beat in powdered sugar gradually on low speed. (It may be necessary to stir in the last cup of sugar by hand.) Stir in nuts. Drop mixture by teaspoonful onto waxed paper. Turn over if necessary when outside feels firm. Dry at least 12 hours.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Place chicken in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with thawed vegetables. Blend soup and broth until creamy. Pour over chicken and vegetables. Salt and pepper to taste. Blend flour milk and melted margarine and spoon over chicken. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with a little of the milk. Cook over boiling water stirring until thick. Cover and cook 15 minutes longer stirring occasionally. Add a little of the hot mixture to the egg yolks. Pour back and cook a few minutes longer. Add margarine and vanilla. Pour filling into pie shell over 2 or 3 sliced bananas.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Brown meat in heavy skillet. Put other ingredients and cook slowly for 1 hour. Leave slightly uncovered. Serve between hot buns.

title: Ritzy Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Reserve 1 1/2 cups of cracker crumbs for top. Place in large casserole dish. Put crumbs on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Orange Balls
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers with rolling pin then mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Roll into balls about the size of a walnut then roll into coconut.

title: Krumkaker
instructions: Whip the eggs and sugar until white and fluffy. Add melted butter and vanilla. Add flour last. The dough should be a little thick. Bake in a krumkake iron. Roll into cone shape cookies.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Pour into a well-greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Pecan Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients; beat until smooth. Add strawberries and chopped pecans. Bake in 3 layers at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Orange Torte
instructions: Using a sharp knife cut cake into 4 thin lengthwise layers. Place bottom cake layer on a platter; spread with 1/3 cup marmalade. Place second layer on top; spread with 1/3 chocolate frosting. Place next layer on top; spread with remaining marmalade. Place final layer on top; frost top and sides of cake with chocolate frosting. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Cut into thin slices. Delicious and simple to make.

title: Buttons And Bows
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix thoroughly the Bisquick 2 tablespoons sugar nutmeg and cinnamon. Beat milk and eggs. Add to dry ingredients. Beat thoroughly 20 strokes. Round up dough on lightly floured board; knead 5 times. Roll out 1/2 inch thick. Cut with donut cutter. Take the donut and crisscross to form a figure eight to make the \bowknots.\ The holes are the \buttons.\ Bake on ungreased sheet for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly golden. Immediately roll in melted butter then in sugar.

title: Pepperoni Puff
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until done.

title: Veggie Melts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Set a 10-inch frying pan over medium heat. Add oil then onion and basil. Cook a few minutes then add broccoli. Continue to cook until broccoli is tender. Remove from heat. Lay out pita bread on baking sheet. Spoon sour cream to cover. Over sour cream put a layer of tomatoes. Layer about 1/2 cup broccoli on tomatoes layer spinach leaves and then mushrooms on tomatoes. Add alfalfa sprouts if desired and top with slices of cheese. Bake until vegetables are hot and cheese is nicely melted about 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Carrots, Cauliflower, Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine vegetables soup 1/2 cup cheese sour cream pepper pimento and 1/2 can French fried onions. Bake in covered dish for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with remaining onion rings and cheese. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Michelle'S Can'T Tell The Difference Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream wet ingredients except pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients together or stir well with a fork. Mix creamed ingredients dry ingredients and pumpkin gently until thoroughly mixed. If desired add raisins dates or nuts. Spoon into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake for 55 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the pan for 5 to 10 minutes before removing. Makes a delightful gluten free bread that you wont miss the wheat in.

title: Orange-Coconut Balls
instructions: Crush wafers and add powdered sugar. Mix well. Add softened orange juice melted butter and nutmeats. Mix well. Using hands shape into balls (use a teaspoon partially filled). Roll in Angel Flake coconut. Place on waxed paper until finished. Store in airtight containers in cool place.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add other ingredients and blend together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Not Mrs. Field'S Or Neiman-Marcus Cookie Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream the butter and both sugars in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and vanilla. In a separate bowl combine flour powdered oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda. Stir dry ingredients into butter and egg mixture until incorporated. Add grated chocolate bar and stir until well distributed. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Roll cookie dough into 1 to 1 1/2-inch balls. Place 2-inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake 6 to 10 minutes or until bottoms begin to brown. Remove and let cool. Remove with spatula from pan to waxed paper. Let cool completely before storing.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cornflakes. Put in greased shallow casserole dish and sprinkle with cornflakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden.

title: Sweetheart Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg yolk. Add flour and knead. Form dough into tiny balls and place on baking sheet. Make a depression in center of each and fill with jam or any desired tidbit. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until lightly browned. Makes 60 cookies.

title: Whimpy Burgers
instructions: Place hamburger patty on aluminum foil. Add 1/2 slice cheese spoonful of onion and ketchup in the center of the patty. Place another patty on top of mixture. Use a fork and press hamburger edges together. Continue until you have 6 hamburgers. Cook in skillet on medium heat. High heat will cause hamburger to burst. Serve with your favorite hamburger fixings.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Pare eggplant and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Dip each slice into egg then into crumbs. Saute on both sides in hot oil until brown. Place a layer of eggplant in a 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with oregano Parmesan cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Cover with tomato sauce; repeat until all is used.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 (approximate pan size is 13 x 9 x 2-inch).

title: Easy Venison Steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. If meat is not tender pound it treating each piece separately. Center the steak on a piece of aluminum foil of suitable size. Salt and pepper steak. Add 2 or 3 onion slices and a dash of Worcestershire sauce. Wrap tightly. Lay in pan and bake for 4 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Grannie Cake
instructions: Mix well flour sugar eggs and pineapple. Pour in long pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and pecans. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet over low heat. Add flour and salt. Continue cooking over low heat stirring constantly until smooth. Gradually add milk and stir constantly to prevent lumping. Cook until mixture thickens. Place layers of potatoes and mixture in buttered baking dish. Dot each layer with remaining butter and cheese slices. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brenda'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Pack firmly into ungreased pan. Cover with catsup. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Golden Glow Fruit Punch
instructions: Remove tags from bags and add to water in quart pitcher or container. Cover. Let stand in refrigerator at least 6 hours or overnight.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Arrange broccoli in greased baking dish. Put pieces of chicken on top. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Three Grain Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine corn meal sugar soy flour whole wheat flour salt and baking soda. Mix egg and yogurt together lightly and stir into dry ingredients. Stir in oil. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full and bake 25 minutes or until done.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli and cauliflower into bite-size pieces. Add peas onion and pimentos. Mix all together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Using a wire whisk mix dry ingredients thoroughly; set aside.
