In saucepan melt butter and unsweetened baking chocolate; stir constantly until melted. In a large mixing bowl beat sugar eggs and vanilla until blended. Add chocolate and butter mixture. Add dry ingredients 1/3 at a time alternately with sour cream mixing well after each addition. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Drop by tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375\u00b0. Transfer from hot baking sheet to cool surface immediately. Yields 5 dozen cookies.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix together powdered sugar graham crackers peanut butter vanilla and melted margarine; make balls and refrigerate. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip 1/2 of each ball.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Mix in crock-pot and cook on low for 16 hours covered. Mash with potato masher and cool.

title: Chess Squares
instructions: Combine butter 1 egg and cake mix. Press into oblong cake pan.

title: Glaze Strawberry Pie
instructions: Line baked shell with 3 cups berries. Simmer 1 cup berries and water for 4 minutes. Combine cornstarch and sugar; add to cooked fruit and cook until syrup is thick and clear stirring constantly. Add lemon juice; cool slightly and pour over berries in shell. Chill thoroughly. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Creamy Peach Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water. Chill until slightly thickened. Blend yogurt into whipped topping then blend in gelatin. Stir in peaches and nuts. Pour in mold or 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Chill until firm about 3 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all in bowl; cover and put in refrigerator overnight. Remove 1 hour before baking. Stir; put in casserole and cover with crushed potato chips. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger sausage and onion together. Drain. Cook rotelli noodles as directed. Add sauce to browned meats. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add meat mixture to cooked noodles and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with cheese. Place pepperoni on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Fresh Fruit Compote
instructions: Pour milk and orange juice in a bowl. Add pudding mix and beat slowly with beater at lowest speed for 1 minute. Add 1 cup Cool Whip and beat 1 minute longer or just until blended.

title: Poppy Seed Biscuit Ring
instructions: In a bowl combine butter onion poppy seeds and garlic. Separate each tube of biscuits into 10 biscuits. Dip in butter mixture and stand on end in lightly greased 10 inch tube pans. Bake at 400 degrees for 14 to 16 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from pan to a serving plate. Serve warm.

title: Christmas Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla. Add flour salt and nuts. Roll into 1-inch balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while warm. Cool and roll again.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Spray a cookie sheet. Pour milk in bowl. Mix dry ingredients in a plastic bag. Dip chicken in milk (one piece at a time); then in bread crumbs. Bake 30 to 35 minutes (turning once) at 400\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Sauce Salad
instructions: Place cranberry sauce in pan with water and salt. Beat over heat until smooth. Let come to rolling boil 1 minute. Pour over Jell-O; stir until dissolved. Add pineapple and nuts. Pour into a shallow dish and refrigerate until firm. Before serving beat cream cheese with some reserved pineapple juice until consistency of whipped cream. Spread over salad and serve. Garnish with additional pecans.

title: Cranberry Punch
instructions: Beat cranberry sauce until smooth. Stir in juices. Add ginger ale. Serve over ice. Makes 12 to 15 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Reese'S Bars
instructions: Mix together sugar peanut butter and graham cracker crumbs. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips and spread over mixture.

title: Burgers Florentine
instructions: Prepare spinach as label directs; drain well. Toast English muffins; keep warm. Preheat broiler. Into bowl tear bread into small pieces; add spinach ground beef egg salt and onion; mix well. Shape mixture into four 1-inch thick round patties. Place patties on rack in broiling pan. Broil patties about 5 minutes on each side for medium or until desired doneness. Just before patties are done cut Mozzarella cheese into 4 slices. Top each meat patty with cheese; broil 1 minute or until cheese melts. To serve place a patty on bottom half of each muffin; replace top half of muffin.

title: Ham And Swiss Rolls
instructions: Cut top off of dinner rolls and sprinkle cheese and ham on bottom half and return tops of rolls. Melt butter and add Worcestershire sauce onion flakes dry mustard and poppy seed. Pour over rolls. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Year Round Salad
instructions: Heat 1 cup orange juice and 1 cup water to boil. Dissolve jello and salt. Stir in 1 cup orange juice. Add pineapple nuts celery and cranberries and chill.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups and rice in saucepan and heat enough to mix well. Pour over chicken which has been salted and arranged in baking dish. Dot with margarine. Bake 2 hours at 275\u00b0 covered.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine all. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cheese Balls
instructions: Add pineapple to cheese. Mix pepper onion and salt into cheese mixture. Add 1/2 cup nuts. Form into 2 large balls; cover each with remaining nuts. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Lime Delight Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate and cool; add to first 4 ingredients for pie crust. Combine next 5 ingredients and whip. Pour into cooled crust. Garnish top of pie with shaved slivers of chocolate. Keep refrigerated.

title: Spaghetti A La' King Crab
instructions: Drain crab and slice. Heat oil and butter add garlic and saute gently. Add crab green onions tomatoes parsley lemon juice seasoning and salt. Heat gently 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except Pepperidge Farm herb dressing. Line bottom of dish with Pepperidge Farm herb dressing mixed with 2 sticks melted margarine. Save enough of stuffing to sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Beans In Dutch Oven
instructions: Cook bacon if not prepared ahead. Cook onion and green pepper in Dutch oven. Remove all from oven. Line bottom of oven with foil. Mix bacon onion pepper and seasonings with pork and beans. Pour into oven. Cover oven with lid. Bake with coals on top and bottom 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hot Fudge Chocolate Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl mix flour and sugar; set aside. Combine water oil margarine and cocoa in a saucepan; bring to a rapid boil. Remove from heat; stir well. Pour into flour and sugar mixture. Add buttermilk eggs and vanilla; mix well. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes in a well-greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan.

title: Date Nut Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil and egg. Stir in milk. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Stir into milk mixture. Blend in nuts and dates. Pour into greased loaf pan. Let stand 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Add pineapple to cream cheese; mix well. Add pepper onion and 1 cup nuts; gradually add salt until well mixed. Roll with remaining nuts.

title: Meat And Gravy Ring
instructions: *Either brown gravy with mushrooms or brown gravy with onions.

title: Zucchini Snack Squares
instructions: Beat eggs and oil together thoroughly. Stir in flour baking powder salt vegetables spices and cheese. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 24 (2-inch) squares.

title: Almond Tea
instructions: Squeeze juice from lemons; reserve the juice and set aside the rinds. Combine the lemon rinds water and sugar in a saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil and then remove from the heat. Remove and discard the lemon rinds. Stir in the reserved lemon juice vanilla extract almond extract pineapple juice and tea. Freeze the mixture in a container which can be transferred to a punch bowl for serving.

title: Fried Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles on paper towel. Then put milk salt and pepper and flour in a bowl. Dip sliced pickles in flour then into the batter then in the flour. Fry 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towel.

title: Sweet Potato Soufflle
instructions: Mix all ingredients pour into greased casserole dish.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease loaf pan. Mix sugar shortening and eggs thoroughly. Stir in milk. Mix dry ingredients and stir in. Blend in nuts and bananas. Pour into pan and bake 60 to 70 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Emily'S Apple Chunk Cake
instructions: In large bowl stir together the first 4 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients all at once; stir by hand until mixed. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 pan for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cool frost as desired with canned cream cheese or caramel frosting.

title: Barbecue Pork Chops
instructions: Arrange chops in baking pan. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl. Pour over chops; cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove chops from pan and pour sauce in a small saucepan. Bake chops at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. While chops are baking bring sauce to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Pour sauce over chops and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients in 2-quart mixing bowl. Set aside.\tIn a saucepan bring oil margarine peanut butter and water to a boil. Pour over dry ingredients and mix. Add beaten eggs vanilla and buttermilk; blend well. Pour batter into a greased and\tfloured 11 x 15 x 1-inch sheet pan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: German Green Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; remove from skillet leaving drippings. Add onion and cook until tender. Add flour sugar salt vinegar and water. Mix well and simmer until slightly thickened. Add beans and cook for 5 minutes. Crumble bacon on top just before serving.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook onion in 1/2 stick margarine. Add ground beef and cook until brown. Drain excess grease. Add cream of mushroom soup (undiluted). Drain sliced mushrooms and add to mixture. Cook rice according to directions. Drain excess water from rice and add 1/2 stick margarine to rice and toss. Serve beef mixture over rice. Add soy sauce if desired.

title: Meat 'N Potatoes Pie
instructions: Mix thoroughly 1/2 cup soup beef onion egg bread crumbs parsley and seasonings. Press firmly into 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Spoon off fat.

title: Glazed Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the canned fruits thoroughly. Mix all the ingredients together and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Dip For Strawberries
instructions: Combine cream cheese and marshmallow cream in food processor then add drops of lemon juice and blend again. Great for showers or weddings.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Cream shortening oil and sugar together then add eggs one at a time. Proverbs 2314 (beat) well. Sift and measure flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately to sugar mixture with milk. Stir in honey and spices then raisins figs (or dates) and almonds. 2 Kings 45 (pour) into well-greased vessels (loaf pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan) and Leviticus 245 (bake) for 45 minutes.

title: Tangy Potato Salad
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl. Chill overnight or at least 3 to 4 hours.

title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan. Add minced garlic; saute until soft. Add chopped lobster or crabmeat and cook for one minute. Add remaining ingredients (except shrimp) and stir until mixed. Mixture should be moist enough to mold when pinched. Stuff each shrimp. Throw any extra crumbs around bottom of dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until shrimp become white.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels sugar and margarine. Place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool.

title: Creamy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Increase portions of each ingredient by one when adding more chicken.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together. Lightly put in 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Quiche
instructions: Combine soup cheese chicken onion salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour into pie shell (deep dish). Spread egg over top and sprinkle with corn flake crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 until firm.

title: Crock-Pot Italian Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops on both sides on stove top. Drain on paper towels; set aside. Place mushrooms onion and garlic in bottom of crock-pot. Arrange pork chops on top of vegetables. Pour tomato sauce sherry lemon juice parsley oregano and basil over the chops. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours or on high 4 to 5 hours. Before serving turn to high and place green pepper strips on top of pork chops. Cover and cook 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Shrimp Butter
instructions: Whip cream cheese and butter together. Rinse and drain cans of shrimp. Add all ingredients and blend well. Use on crackers or bread.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Cook shrimp and seasonings for 5 minutes in oil. Add rice salt pepper Kitchen Bouquet and water. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Cant miss.

title: Eggnog Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks 1/2 cup of the sugar salt and nutmeg until light. Pour this gradually into hot milk. Cook only until mixture lightly coats the spoon. Remove from heat. Dissolve gelatin in cold water and add to milk mixture. Cool. When filling starts to set (this takes quite awhile) beat egg whites and add remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Whip the cream and add vanilla. Fold mixtures together. Pour into two 8-inch pie shells. Grate chocolate over top and chill. A holiday tradition in our family.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Boil first 5 ingredients for 1 minute. Set off and add remaining ingredients. Beat and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

title: Chinese Savory Beef
instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet or Dutch oven. Add the lean beef and quick-fry until brown. Add and quick-fry a few minutes 3 scallions or onion cloves of garlic and ginger. Add soy sauce brown sugar pepper and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 3 hours. Add more liquid if needed. Just before serving thicken with small amount of flour if desired. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Honey Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredient together and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients together. Blend in dry ingredients. Spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Ice while hot.

title: Four Cheese Fettucine
instructions: Fry parsley peppers and onions in oil for 15 minutes. Then put in roasting pan. Add tomatoes spices salt and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes then add garlic. Dredge chicken in flour salt pepper and paprika and fry. You can add chicken pieces uncooked to the sauce instead of frying them. Simmer at 275\u00b0 in covered roaster for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Sprinkle currants 1/2 hour before serving. Sprinkle toasted almonds on before serving. You can put rice on a platter and chicken on top or serve separate.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pinch off about 1/2 teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes. Fill cookies with Pillsbury Supreme vanilla frosting.

title: Basic Cutlets
instructions: Mix the flour and oat bran cereal in a large bowl. Dip the turkey cutlets one at a time into the egg substitute then into the flour mixture until well coated. In a nonstick pan sprayed with Pam fry the cutlets until golden brown. Serve alone or with any variety of sauces.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat eggs; add the sour cream soda and vanilla. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Nana'S Punch
instructions: Make a day ahead - gives time to season. Yields 40 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into very small flowerets. Crumble bacon; dice onion. Mix with sunflower kernels. Mix salad dressing (Miracle Whip) sugar and vinegar. Pour over broccoli mixture; stir.

title: Peach Marmalade
instructions: Cut all fruit and mix together. Put on fire. Add Sure Jell and mix well. When it comes to a boil add sugar. Boil 7 to 8 minutes. Makes 14 glasses.

title: Butternut Squash Soup
instructions: Pierce the squash with a knife in 4 or 5 places microwave on high power 10 to 13 minutes until slightly softened. Then peel seed and cut into chunks (about 7 c.)

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and blend in blender on medium speed until sugar dissolves. Add oil and continue to blend until all ingredients are mixed. Chill before using.

title: Chili
instructions: Fry onions green peppers sausage and hamburger together. Drain oil. Mix all other ingredients in. Let simmer for 4 hours.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 15 x 10-inch or 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl beat brown sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add molasses vanilla and eggs. Blend well. Lightly spoon flour into\tmeasuring cup; level off. Stir in oats flour baking soda and salt; blend well. Stir in nuts and add chocolate chips. Spread in prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes\tor until golden brown and center into sets.\tCool slightly; cut into bars. Serve\twarm or cold. Makes 48 bars.

title: Soft Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine flour soda and salt; set aside. Melt butter sugar and water; heat just to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and chips until mixture is smooth. Transfer to mixing bowl. Add eggs; beat well. Cool 15 minutes. Gradually blend in flour mixture. Spread into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Beat all ingredients together for 4 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Grease tins. Makes 2 large loaves.

title: Caramel Raisin Pudding
instructions: Stir until dissolved then pour over batter in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Bar
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form into a bar on foil. Refrigerate until firm. Makes 1 serving.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: In mixing bowl cream together the butter and sugar. Add eggs. Beat until light and fluffy. Add extract. Stir in flour and baking powder. Mix until smooth. Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Turn the mixture into the pan. Spoon the pie filling into the cake in 16 spots spacing 4 spoonfuls evenly in each direction. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden and cake tests done. Cut into 16 pieces. Place bottom side up on plate. Dust with powdered sugar and add whipped cream. Serve warm.

title: Peanut Break
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Line jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch) with waxed paper. Beat butter and sugar. Mix in flour syrup and egg. Stir in peanuts. Spread in pan. Bake until light brown (about 25 minutes). Loosen layer from sides of pan. Invert onto wire rack. Carefully remove paper. Cool. Break into pieces.

title: Pineapple And Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Empty the cans of crushed pineapple and the pistachio instant pudding together and mix. Add in 1 1/2 cups crushed walnuts. Add in 1 1/2 cups marshmallows then fold in 2 tubs of Cool Whip. Empty all of the contents in bowl into a trifle dish; garnish with pineapple chunks some crushed walnuts or any fruit like mandarin oranges or strawberries. This may be served to very grumpy people; it always makes them smile!!!

title: Pasta With Shrimp And Vegetables
instructions: Brown garlic cloves in olive oil. Saute zucchini and carrots until tender (approximately 3 minutes). Add shrimp basil oregano and salt. Toss shrimp with vegetables until they turn pink. Cook pasta. Serve shrimp and vegetables over cooked pasta.

title: Zucchini Brownie
instructions: Mix and pour into greased flour pan. Bake 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Miracle Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients in bowl. Mix well by hand. Pour into 9-inch pie plate. Bake until set. (The butter and flour will take care of the crust.)

title: Porcupine Meatballs
instructions: Mix thoroughly all ingredients except tomato juice. Form into balls and place in large baking dish. Cover with tomato juice cover dish and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove cover and bake 1/2 hour longer after basting meat with juice. The tomato gravy cooks down and requires no thickening.

title: Pork Chop And Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown chops in shortening; reserve drippings. In the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish spread rice. Combine pan drippings and onion soup mix; sprinkle over rice. Drain mushroom liquid into measuring cup and add enough hot water to equal 3 cups. Pour over rice and add vegetables. Arrange chops over rice mixture and sprinkle with drippings. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Savory Chicken Bites
instructions: Combine the first 6 items; mix well. Stir in chicken and celery. Separate crescent dough into 8 rectangles. Press perforations to seal. Spread mix over each piece of dough. Starting at long side roll up jelly roll fashion. Pinch seams to seal. Slice into 1-inch pieces; place seam side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 11 to 15 minutes. Yields 40. Leftovers can be frozen.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs to blend. Add oil sugar and 2 teaspoons vanilla. Beat until thick and foamy. Spoon in zucchini and pineapple. Combine flour soda salt baking powder spices walnuts and raisins. Stir gently into zucchini mixture until blended. Divide batter between 2 greased and flour dusted 5 x 9-inch loaf pans. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Turn out on rack to cool.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine apples marshmallows celery and nuts. Add enough salad dressing to moisten. Toss lightly; chill. Add additional salad dressing and garnish with apple slices before serving.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in shortening until tender. Add beef; brown lightly. Pour off drippings. Season with salt and pepper. Add mushrooms and liquid; cook 5 minutes. Add soup; simmer for 10 minutes. Add sour cream and parsley. Pour over cooked noodles; bake until heated through. Can be topped with grated cheese.

title: Very Easy Berry Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix flour baking powder milk and sugar and pour over butter. Add berries evenly over all. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until it pulls from sides of pan.

title: Tamale Dip
instructions: Mix together and then put in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until thoroughly heated.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla eggs cocoa flour and nuts. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cream Pie
instructions: Hull berries and set aside. Combine pie filling mix sour cream milk rind and 2 cups of whipped topping in bowl. Beat with wire whisk until well blended about 1 minute. Spoon half the filling into crust; arrange berries stem down in filling and press down. Top with remaining filling. Freeze 1 hour or chill in refrigerator 3 hours before serving. Garnish with remaining whipped topping and additional strawberries if desired.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Add to meat the eggs onions bread crumbs garlic salt pepper thyme poultry seasoning milk and parsley flakes. Mix well and shape in pan to get a nice slice when cooked. Mix no-fat dry gravy with water and 1/4 cup vinegar. Cover over meat about 1-inch in pan and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0. Serve with baked potatoes and vegetable.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Combine broth bouillon cubes tomatoes and onion; cook until tender. Add vegetables beans salt pepper basil and thyme. Simmer 20 minutes. Add cut up chicken breast and macaroni until macaroni is tender and chicken is not pink approximately 20 minutes. Simmer 20 minutes longer.

title: Carrot Bread(Diabetic)
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar substitute in a large bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until mixture thickens. Gradually add oil and water; beat until well combined.

title: Chocolate Death
instructions: Note chocolate fudge cake mixes and chocolate fudge pudding mixes are too rich for the normal palate. One or the other is fine but not both. Other ingredients on these packages to normally prepare them (milk eggs water etc.). For possible additions* see the following.

title: Crackling Cornbread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Add enough water to make stiff batter. Fry or bake in favorite shortening until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream Pecan Pie
instructions: Bake pastry shell at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Set aside. In small deep bowl combine flour and cinnamon. Blend in sour cream with electric mixer at medium speed. Beat in eggs sugar and vanilla until well blended. Reserve 1/4 cup pecans. Stir in remaining pecans. Pour into prepared pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Garnish with whipped cream and reserved pecan halves if desired.

title: Old-Fashioned Gingerbread
instructions: Pour boiling water over shortening; add sugar molasses and egg. Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour into well-greased and floured 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool in pan.

title: Game Bird
instructions: Breast the bird and clean. Soak for about one hour. Put bird in crock-pot without water. Cook on high for 3 to 6 hours. By this time meat will be tender. Remove meat from bone. Check for leftover shot. Add soup to meat and cook on high in crock-pot for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Cook milk and sugar to soft ball. Quickly beat in peanut butter marshmallow cream and vanilla. Spread into a greased 9 x 9-inch pan and cool. Cut into squares and enjoy! (This candy sets up like fudge.)

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter and evaporated milk in a 4-quart bowl. Mix well. Microwave on High 7 to 7 1/2 minutes mixing well after every 2 minutes of cooking. Remove from oven. Add chocolate pieces stirring until melted. Blend Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter. Add quick oats and raisins. Spread into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan; chill until firm. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; no kneading. Gease a loaf pan and pour in batter. Bake at 400 degrees for 40 minutes. This is not a smooth textured bread.

title: Henne Dorre
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In Dutch oven or shallow baking dish saute the chicken and nuts in butter until the meat is white. Leave in dish and remove from heat. Cut apples into thin slivers. Mix raisins and currants with apples. Stir together all the spices and salt. Mix with fruits. Distribute spiced fruit among chicken and nuts. Pour on mixture of wine and broth. Cover bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add garlic onion and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender. Add pepperoni and mushrooms; set aside. Cook noodles according to directions; drain. Add spaghetti sauce to meat mixture. Layer half the noodles meat sauce Mozzarella and Provolone cheeses in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Repeat layers. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and pour off grease. Mix eggs milk salt oregano and mustard together. Grease 13x9x2 inch baking pan well. Spread bread cubes on bottom of pan. Layer sausage then cheese. Pour milk mixture over all. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding
instructions: Sift together in a bowl the first 5 ingredients. Stir in the shortening nuts and milk to the sifted mixture. Spread into a 9-inch square pan. Mix brown sugar cocoa and sprinkle over the pan mixture. Pour the hot water over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 9 servings. Cake mixture rises to top. Sauce settles to bottom. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Korean Marinade Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chicken; mix well. Rinse chicken and place in a deep bowl. Pour marinade over chicken. Cover; place in refrigerator overnight. Shake occasionally. Keep mixed. When ready prepare grill as usual. Let briquets turn white as directed. Place chicken on grill. Use remaining marinade for basting. Cook chicken until cooked thoroughly approximately 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Poppy Cock Popcorn
instructions: Place popcorn and nuts in oven at 225\u00b0  about 20 minutes. In saucepan combine oleo sugar and Karo; cook to 250\u00b0 using candy thermometer. Add vanilla. Takes about 20 minutes. Pour over popcorn and nuts. Mix and let cool.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Wilt cabbage leaves in boiling water. Drain and cool in cold water.

title: Pork Adobo(A Filipino Main Dish)
instructions: In a saucepan put pork vinegar 1 tablespoon garlic bay leaves soy sauce salt and pepper. Bring to a boil then simmer uncovered until pork is tender (about 40 minutes; test with fork). If the sauce is reduced add about 1/2 cup water. Remove meat from sauce.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix vegetables soup and chicken in ungreased 9-inch pie plate. Stir remaining ingredients with fork until blended. Pour into pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown (425\u00b0 at high altitude). Prep time is 16 minutes and serves 6.

title: Carolyn'S Tomato Hot Salsa
instructions: Add all together. Cook down low until thick as you like. Sterilize jars. Boil cups and lids. Fill jars and seal.

title: Watermelon-Berry Slush
instructions: Place a single layer of watermelon in a shallow pan. Freeze until firm. Remove watermelon from freezer and let stand 5 minutes. Drop watermelon through food chute of food processor of blender. Add frozen chunks of raspberries alternately with mineral water processing until smooth. Yields 5 1/2 cups (31 calories per 1/2-cup serving). Contains 0.6 g protein 0.4 g fat 7.1 g. carbohydrate 0 mg cholesterol 1 mg sodium and 15 mg calcium.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Steam first 3 ingredients crispy. In a salad bowl throw first 6 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients to your taste. Mix well.

title: Yummy Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Mix all except Cheez Whiz. Put in greased 2-quart casserole. Spread Cheez Whiz on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Be sure to cover casserole. (Delicious as a side dish with meats.)

title: *Garu 1(Wheat For Church)
instructions: Pick over wheat to remove stones or imperfect wheat. Rinse wheat and place in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes or until soft; until water is milky and looks thickened. Drain in colander. Rinse in warm water and then in cold water. Press with paper towels to remove water.

title: Layered Bean Dip
instructions: Mix refried beans chilies and taco seasoning. Spread on a 12-inch round serving platter. Blend avocados lemon juice and 1/2 taco sauce until smooth. Spread on top of bean mixture. Spread sour cream on top of avocado mixture. Top with lettuce cheese taco sauce and olive slices. Serve with nacho chips. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Chili Relleno Squares
instructions: Layer cheeses and chilies in greased 8-inch square baking dish starting and ending with cheese. In a bowl beat eggs. Add milk and flour and beat. Pour over cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until set. Cut into squares.

title: Sawdust Salad
instructions: Mix and let gel. Cook 1 cup sugar 1 cup pineapple juice 1 egg and 1 tablespoon flour (or more). Allow to cool and spread over gelatin mixture. Whip two packages dry whipped topping and one 8 ounce package cream cheese. Spread over last mixture. Top with shredded cheese.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Peel and mash. Melt butter in milk and add to sweet potatoes. Mix well. Beat egg whites until stiff. Set aside. Add yolks and remaining ingredients to potatoes. Gently fold in egg whites. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Onion Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Place some sliced squares of margarine on bottom of glass casserole dish. Then layer the potatoes; after a few layers sprinkle some of the onion soup mix over the potatoes. Repeat the process until you reach the last layer of potatoes. The last layer place soup mix then some squares of margarine and sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for one hour covered with foil.

title: Salmon Salad
instructions: Sprinkle salmon with lemon juice. Stir in eggs pickle salad dressing green onion salt and pepper. Mix gently and chill. Serve on lettuce if desired. Serves 4.

title: Light Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Chop apples into small cubes with the peeling left on. Combine the pudding mix crushed pineapple and apple juice. Fold in Cool Whip. Add apples. Mix then add marshmallows. Refrigerate.

title: Fruit Punch Bars
instructions: Grease and flour bottom of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Beat eggs and sugar in a large bowl on high speed until light and fluffy. Add fruit cocktail flour soda salt and vanilla. Beat at medium speed until blended. Spread in pan. Sprinkle with coconut and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. While hot drizzle with glaze.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Place in bowl and cool shortening boiling water salt and sugar. Add yeast and beaten eggs. Add flour gradually. Cover and let rise until double. Knead and roll into small balls; dip balls in melted margarine. Place in angel food cake pan and let rise until double. It will take 1 1/2 sticks melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. You can bake 1/2 of this one day and the other half can be refrigerated and baked the next day. I dont cut it into pieces until I am ready to bake.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Pour sugar over cubed apples. Let stand 10 minutes. Melt margarine in saucepan. Pour beaten egg over mixture. Sift dry ingredients over mixture. Add nuts and raisins. Stir until moist. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Harvest Cake
instructions: Sift together first 6 ingredients. Add brown sugar shortening apple juice or cider and apples. Blend for 2 minutes. Add eggs and beat well. Stir in raisins and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan.

title: Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onions until clear and set aside. Add more oil and saute meat garlic salt pepper soy sauce Worcestershire sauce Tabasco and paprika until meat is grey. Add water tomato juice and onion and simmer covered for 1 hour or until meat is tender. Add Marsala wine and sour cream and simmer 5 minutes. Serve over cooked wide egg noodles.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Melt butter in large fry pan. Stir in flour. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes on low until smooth. Add 2 cups of milk gradually and stir until smooth. Add clams and simmer for 5 minutes. Put potatoes and celery in microwave bowl with clam juice. Cook for 3 minutes on High. In a large crock-pot place potato and clam mixture. Add milk mixture. Stir. Cook on high for 2 hours. Reduce to low and cook for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Strawberry Slush
instructions: Mix all together except 7-Up and freeze. An ice cream bucket works well. Thaw to slush before using. Add 7-Up as desired before serving.

title: Vanilla Butter Roll
instructions: Mix flour and shortening then add milk to make dough. Roll out in a thin oval shape.

title: Spicy Sausage Kebabs
instructions: Assemble skewers by alternating sausage with the vegetables. Grill or broil 4 minutes on each side if desired. Baste frequently with sauce.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Mix cinnamon and salt with sugar and well beaten egg and apples. Preheat oven at 400\u00b0. Cook for 15 minutes; turn temperature down to 350\u00b0 and bake until golden brown probably about 1 hour total baking.

title: Fresh Peach Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order listed. Pour into lightly greased Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven cool in pan 10 minutes. Then place on rack to cool completely.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocados and mix remaining ingredients.

title: Easy Corned Beef And Cabbage(Straight From Ireland)
instructions: Note Can use any other \cold\ vegetable.

title: Claire And Emily'S Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough otherwise just rinse and pat dry. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Use a handle of a spoon to prevent the knife from cutting all the way. Put potatoes in a baking dish fan them slightly sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter sprinkle with herbs.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine margarine with pretzels and 5 tablespoons sugar. Spread in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Put in 400\u00b0 oven for 8 minutes then cool. Mix cream cheese with 1 cup sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over cooled pretzel layer. Mix jello with 1 3/4 cups hot water. Add strawberries; stir until berries have melted and jello starts to congeal. Pour over cream cheese layer. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour into a large casserole dish.

title: Sour Cream Bundt Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix dry pudding oil sour cream eggs and milk. Mix together pecans brown sugar and white sugar. Add nut mixture to cake mixture. Blend together. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Jane'S Hamburgers
instructions: Add to meat and mix well. Shape into hamburger patties and barbecue.

title: Corn Pudding Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and golden brown.

title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain and rinse in cold water. Chop onion and celery. Add parsley salt and pepper to taste. Drain tuna. Mix all together. Add enough mayonnaise to coat macaroni. Store in refrigerator.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Alternate layers of sliced tomatoes and other ingredients in crust. The tomatoes may produce a lot of juice so sprinkle a little cornstarch in layers if tomatoes are real ripe.

title: Dutch Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and bacon drippings like a pie crust. Reserve 1 1/2 cups for topping. Mix eggs cinnamon nutmeg and mixture of soda and buttermilk. Grease and flour two 9-inch pans. Spread crust in each. Add the filling and rest of pie crust mixture over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Simmer the ground beef garlic salt parsley flakes salt tomatoes and tomato paste for 45 minutes. Boil the water with a pinch of salt and a few drops of cooking oil and the noodles; cook for 8 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Squares
instructions: Combine flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. In a separate bowl beat butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add peanut butter bananas eggs and milk. Beat well. Add flour mixture and peanut granules mixing until combined. Spread evenly into lightly greased 18 x 26-inch bun pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes or until center is firm. Cool. Dust with confectioners sugar if desired.

title: Peanutty Chocolate Drops
instructions: In saucepan combine baking chips and peanut butter. Heat over very low heat stirring constantly until chips are melted. Add remaining ingredients and stir until noodles are coated and peanuts are coated with chocolate mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Chill. Makes 30 cookies.

title: Banana Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and salt and continue beating until well mixed. Gradually add Milnot whipping cream and vanilla. Add chopped or mashed bananas. Add milk (more or less to finish filling freezer).

title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Coat slow cooker liner with nonstick cooking spray. Combine all the ingredients stirring well. Pour into cooker. Place thin slices of cheese on top if desired. Set slow cooker on low and cook 3 1/4 hours without stirring.

title: Waffles
instructions: Mix until smooth. Pour on greased griddle surface 2/3 full. Close lid and bake about 4 minutes. Serve hot with syrup. Great for open fires!

title: Veggie Pizza(Appetizer)
instructions: Spread rolls on ungreased cookie sheet. Press flat closing perforations. Bake until golden brown. Remove and cool completely. Mix the cream cheese Ranch dressing and mayo; spread over crust. Cut and shred veggies into small pieces. Spread veggies over cheese mixture. Cut into cracker size squares.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Combine raw meat with all other ingredients. Put in crock-pot or 3-quart casserole. Cover with lid. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours or on low in crock-pot all day. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Irish Cabbage Soup
instructions: Parboil cabbage for about 10 minutes. In a separate pot add potatoes onions and carrots to boiling water. Cook for 3 minutes. Add parboiled and drained cabbage to potato mixture. Add spices. Bring to boil and simmer for 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Then add half and half and bring back to hot heat not boiling. Serve hot.

title: Tater Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pecans. Pour into shell. Place whole pecans on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or more.

title: Fruit Slush
instructions: Bring to boil in large pan the sugar and water. Add remaining ingredients except for ginger ale. Pour in 5 (1-quart) plastic containers. Store in freezer.

title: No Cook Fudge
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Press into greased pan. Chill in refrigerator for 1 hour. Cut.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients to make dressing. Combine last 5 minutes to make salad. Pour dressing over salad and enjoy!\tCan be served as main course or side dish.

title: Lavosh
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut butter into mixture. Add buttermilk; stir together. Divide dough into size of tennis balls. Flour pastry cloth. With rolling pin roll dough out about 1/16-inch thick. Sprinkle\tsesame\tseed and poppy seed. Roll over\tagain to set seed into dough. Grease cookie sheet or flat pan.\tPlace dough on sheet; bake until slightly browned. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 8 minutes or until brown.

title: Shan Tung Salad
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise soy sauce and curry powder. Mix together all other ingredients except pineapple and noodles with mayonnaise mixture. Spoon into nests of lettuce and garnish with pineapple and noodles.

title: Make Your Own Teriyaki Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Remove the skin from the chicken. Place in a pot with enough water to cover the chicken. Boil in a medium pot until tender. Add the Veg-All and the cream of chicken soup. Mix well.

title: Herbed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes and slice 1/4-inch thick. Slice onions 1/4-inch thick. Layer 1/2 of the potatoes onions and tomatoes. Sprinkle with 1/2 each of salt thyme and rosemary. Repeat layers and seasonings. Drizzle with oil cover and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 425\u00b0. Sprinkle with parsley before serving. Serves 8. Each 3/4 cup serving contains 105 calories.

title: Easy Baked Beans
instructions: Drain the canned beans if they have excess juice. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased quart and half casserole dish. Place the diced bacon strips on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Hot Artichoke Spread
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Fold in chopped artichoke hearts. Pour into a small souffle dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly about 20 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: 6 Layer Dinner
instructions: Layer in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper after each item. Place pepper rings on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Top with oleo. Add milk coconut and chopped nuts; stir and pour over slightly cooled cake. Broil until coconut is toasted.

title: Brown Surprise
instructions: Mix brownie mix according to package directions. Line 18 muffin cups with papers (silver works best). Divide brownie mix evenly among the cups (about 2/3 full). Press an unwrapped peanut butter cup into center of each cup. Bake according to package directions.

title: Sugar-Free Pineapple Pie
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve juice. Take 1/2 cup juice and stir in cornstarch. Boil until thick; cool. Mix milk and sour cream. Beat in pudding. Fold in Cool Whip drained pineapple orange peel nutmeg and extract. Pour into crust. Chill. Sprinkle with remaining pineapple. Smooth glaze on top.

title: Potato Pizza Hot Dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel and slice potatoes. Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix Cheddar cheese with 1/2 can of milk; pour over potatoes. Brown hamburger; add salt pepper and onion salt. Add tomato soup. Let simmer 10 minutes then put on top of potatoes. Do not mix. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or until potatoes are done. Remove from oven. Add cheese on top. Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Luau Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Rub ribs on both sides with salt and pepper. Place ribs meat side up in foil-lined shallow pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Spoon off fat from meat while ribs are baking. Prepare luau sauce by combining the remaining ingredients in a small pan and bring to boiling point over medium heat. Pour sauce over ribs. Continue baking in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender basting with sauce several times during baking period.

title: Deviled Eggs Deluxe
instructions: Cut eggs in half placing yellows in a small bowl. Crush yellows with a fork. Add remaining ingredients. Fill egg halves and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Microwave Lasagna Recipe
instructions: Brown ground meat in colander (microwave-safe) 3 minutes on High. Stir. Brown additional 3 minutes. Add meat to sauce and set aside.

title: Breakfast Egg Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place rolls (opened) on bottom of 9 x 13-inch lightly sprayed or buttered pan. Cover with layer of sausage. Mix eggs milk oregano and basil in bowl. Pour mixture over sausage layer. Place cheese on top. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Let rest and set for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli. Mix over low heat soup ginger mayonnaise and lemon juice. Cook chicken in salted water with bay leaf.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers. Line bottom of baking dish with 1/2 crackers. Add chicken mixture and top with remaining crackers. Dot top with oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix eggs squash onion soup cheese salt pepper and butter and put in 2-quart greased casserole. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cracker crumbs on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until firm. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Arroz Caldo(Chix-Rice Soup)
instructions: Wash chicken and dry with paper towel. In a big 3-quart saucepan heat oil; saute garlic until browned. Add onion and ginger root and saute for 3 more minutes. Add chicken salt and fish sauce. Saute until chicken is light brown. Add rice; cook stirring for 3 to 5 minutes. Add water and bring to a boil. Lower heat and cook covered for 30 minutes or until the chicken is tender. Add a dash of pepper to taste. Remove from heat; garnish with green onions and garlic chips if desired. Prep time 20 minutes. Cooking Time 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and spices. Wash and cut raisins. Roll in small amount of flour mixture. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually. Then add eggs mixing thoroughly. Add flour alternating with soup. Stir until smooth. Fold in raisins. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch layer pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done. Frost as desired.

title: Fresh Peach Cobbler
instructions: Combine brown sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan. Add peaches and toss to coat. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Reduce heat and cook 2 minutes longer stirring occasionally; set aside.

title: Southern Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs well. Combine with all ingredients. Pour into buttered casserole. Sprinkle with crumbs; dot with butter. Place in pan of warm water. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven uncovered 1 hour and 15 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook cabbage leaves a few minutes in boiling water and drain. Place remaining ingredients (using only 2 tablespoons soup) mixed together and roll up into the cabbage leaves. Place in large saucepan or crock-pot. Add remaining soup pour over cabbage rolls. Simmer approximately 40 minutes lifting occasionally until done to keep from sticking. If the soup gets too thick you can add a small amount of water.

title: Snack Crackers
instructions: Mix spices in oil. Pour over crackers; stir and stir. Better if it sits a few hours to absorb. Good with soup or as a snack.

title: Easy Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice. Add Cool Whip. Stir in strawberries and pour into pie crust. Chill and serve.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain; arrange in a greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Place chicken on top of broccoli. Mix soup mayonnaise and lemon juice together; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle over cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook and peel the sweet potatoes. Beat with electric mixer until fluffy. Add the softened butter orange juice and rind eggs and sugar. Beat well. Spoon potato mixture into a 3-quart casserole. Cover with topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: German Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar coconut nuts cherries alternating with milk margarine and vanilla. Mix well and drop from a teaspoon on wax paper. Place toothpick in center of each piece and freeze.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Mix and follow advice in Proverbs 2314 for making a good boy (beat well). Put all in one pan that is greased and floured. Bake 3 hours in a moderate oven.

title: Alice'S Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Place sugar in saucepan and add water to cover sugar. Boil until it reaches soft ball stage. Remove from stove. Add vanilla and quickly add peanut butter. Pour into a buttered dinner plate. Let cool then cut and eat.

title: Lindsey'S Cheese Dreams
instructions: Toast bun halves. Layer with a slice of tomato crisp bacon slices (2 to 3) and top with cheese slice. Melt cheese slice and serve.

title: Chow Mein Hot Dish
instructions: Fry onion celery and ground beef until brown. Add all remaining ingredients. Stir well. Pour into a large buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Diet Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove mushroom stems; chop fine. Saute stems and scallions in corn oil. Add cottage cheese and bread crumbs. Stuff caps. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Each mushroom contains 15 calories.

title: Chicken Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken debone and cut into bite-sized pieces. Mix with next 7 ingredients. Melt margarine and then crumble crackers really fine and mix with margarine. Put mixture in a large casserole dish (8 x 11-inch) then put buttered crackers on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Banana Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs beaten very lightly and soda dissolved in sour cream. Beat well; then add bananas flour 1/4 teaspoon salt and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in well greased oblong pan in a 350\u00b0 oven about 35 to 40 minutes. Top with 1/2 cup nuts if desired.

title: Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Soak peas in warm water. Rinse well. Cover peas with water. Add salt and pepper. Add sausage; simmer until tender. Add red pepper if desired.

title: Cookies And Cream Ice Cream
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt in saucepan. Gradually stir in milk. Cook over medium heat approximately 15 minutes stirring constantly. Gradually add beaten eggs. Cook 1 minute; remove from heat. Refrigerate about 1 hour. Combine whipping cream and vanilla stirring with a wire whisk. Add crumbled cookies to mixture and freeze in 6-quart ice cream freezer as directed.

title: Spring Dip
instructions: Mix together. Serve with cut up vegetables.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk lemon juice and food coloring; mix well. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff but not dry. Gently fold into sweetened condensed milk mixture. Pour into crust and chill 3 hours or until set.

title: Chicken Breast In Sour Cream
instructions: Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish so that pieces dont overlap. Cover with mushrooms (do not use juice). Combine mushroom soup sherry and sour cream until blended. Pour over chicken completely covering it. Dust with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with wild long grain rice.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Boil sugar water cinnamon nutmeg and food coloring. Take off stove; add butter. Put in other pan flour baking powder and salt. Add and mix shortening. Add and mix in milk. Roll out and cut out and put apples in dough and put the sauce on them. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Crumble sausage into a large saucepan. Cook over medium heat; add onions. Cook until transparent. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of fat; stir in flour. Cook about 6 minutes; stir in milk. Add seasoning. Cook stirring until thickened. Serve over biscuits. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in baking dish. Lay bacon on top and bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and dust with flour a 10-inch tube pan.

title: Delicious Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Mix shortening salt sugar and potatoes. When cool add dissolved yeast and egg whites. Mix and add flour to make a stiff dough. Knead thoroughly and let rise in refrigerator overnight. Knead again. Make into rolls. Let double in bulk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Bread
instructions: Mix brown sugar and cinnamon; set aside. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour half of mixture in a well-greased bread pan. Put half of cinnamon and brown sugar in batter. Pour rest of mixture on top. Add the remaining cinnamon and brown sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Skillet Barbecue Beans
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients in a large skillet until sausage browns and crumbles; drain. Stir in beans and seasoning mix. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Yields 6 servings.

title: Delicate Graham Cracker Cake
instructions: In small bowl\tcombine graham cracker crumbs flour baking powder and salt. Set aside.

title: Erin'S Delicious Dirt
instructions: Prepare pudding according to directions. Crush cookies in processor or blender. Mix cream cheese and add to pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer Oreos and pudding mix in glass clear bowl or planter. Start and end with Oreos. Decorate with artificial flowers and candy worms. Preparation time 20 minutes.

title: Divinity Fudge
instructions: Let sugar water and syrup cook slowly until it strings. Pour on egg whites to which vinegar has been added. Beat until it is stiff enough to stand when dropped on a dish. Add nuts and pour out.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef and chopped onion until onions are clear. Drain. Return to pan. Add beans seasoning and tomato juice. Heat just to boiling point.

title: Beer Batter
instructions: Mix together. Dredge fish/shrimp in plain flour then dip in batter mixture. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook corn as directed on package. Add all other ingredients and put grated cheese on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Style Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients at room temperature in large bowl until smooth. Use a 9 x 13-inch cake tin with shortening and line bottom with wax paper. Pour mixture into tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes then additional 60 minutes at 325\u00b0 until top is golden brown. Remove from oven and cool before serving.

title: Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Mix softened butter mustard and onion salt. Spread on rolls. Use 2 slices of cheese and 4 slices of ham (approximately) per sandwich. Wrap individually in foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes (375\u00b0 for 30 minutes if frozen).

title: Blueberry Cream Pie
instructions: Prepare Dream Whip according to package directions. Add sugar and cream cheese and mix well. Pour into pie shell and top with blueberry pie filling.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Scrub cucumbers well. Do not peel. In large bowl sprinkle salt over cucumbers onions and green pepper. Stir gently. Let stand covered with foil for 1 to 3 hours or overnight. (If overnight place in refrigerator.) Drain off liquid. Combine vinegar sugar celery mustard and dill seed. Pour over vegetables; stir and cover. Let stand 36 hours. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Fennel, Carrot And Cranberry Salad
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together red wine honey and olive oil. Place fennel carrots and cranberries in a medium bowl and toss with half of the dressing. Let stand refrigerated for 4 hours. Drain fennel just before serving and discard all the liquid. Pour rest of the dressing over the salad. Season to taste and serve. Serves 4.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix pickling lime in 2 gallons of water; pour over cukes and soak 24 hours. Rinse thoroughly. Cover cukes onions and pepper with ice water; let stand 3 hours. Drain well. Cover with vinegar sugar salt celery seed turmeric and mustard seed. Let stand overnight. Bring to a boil and let boil for 20 minutes. Pack in jars and seal. Yields about 10 pints.

title: Lemon Yogurt Dip
instructions: Mix all three ingredients together. Good over fruit or pound cake.

title: Creamy Dijon Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients stir until smooth. Cover & chill. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Grease 2-quart casserole cover bottom with half the cracker crumbs. On top of the crumbs layer drained asparagus. Cover with 1 can soup. Add 2 eggs sliced another layer of crumbs then a layer of other can of asparagus then soup. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Cover the top with grated cheese; return to oven until cheese melts.

title: No Peep Chicken
instructions: Any size square pan to bake in will do. Cover the bottom with a thick layer of white rice (depending on size of pan and how much you like rice; the amount may vary.) If not a nonstick pan grease before putting rice in pan (fat free oil preferable). Spread 1 to 2 cans of cream of mushroom soup (if a small pan only 1 can) over top of all the rice (do not add water to the soup). Cut up small pieces of butter and place them over the soup. Cut up a few onions and mushrooms (optional and to taste) and spread them also on the soup. Place a layer of whole deboned and skinned chicken breasts on top of everything. Place a few pieces of butter on the chicken. Wrap the pan with Reynolds Wrap and bake it in the oven at 350\u00b0 for one and a half hours (without peeping at it).

title: Cinnamon Balls
instructions: Cut thawed bread dough into 1-inch squares or roll into balls. Mix vanilla butter or margarine sugar milk and cinnamon. Place half of the 1-inch bread dough squares on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread half the vanilla mixture over. Place remaining 1-inch bread dough squares on top then remaining vanilla mixture.

title: Peach Fizz
instructions: Put in blender and fill blender with crushed ice. Blend on high speed to make a slush drink. Great summer thirst quencher.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion and season with salt pepper and garlic powder. Remove from heat and cover. Allow to sit for 30 minutes. Return to burner. Cover with water and simmer until tender. Add tomato sauce and season with cumin oregano cayenne pepper and cilantro. Simmer until meat falls apart and flavor develops.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Mix mayonnaise flour eggs milk and salt. Add crab cheese and onions. Bake in a 9-inch pastry shell at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken soup and sour cream; set aside. Crush crackers. Melt butter and add to crackers. Add poppy seed. Put 1/2 of cracker mixture on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add chicken mixture. Cover chicken with rest of crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Orange Pork Chops
instructions: Sprinkle chops with flour and salt. Brown in fat in a skillet. Combine sugar nutmeg and raisins with orange juice. Pour over chops in skillet. After chops are well browned cook covered at low heat 45 minutes. Place orange sections on chops. Cover and cook 5 minutes longer. Serves 4.

title: Rose Schuster'S Hot Potato Salad
instructions: One hour before serving cook potatoes in 1 inch water in covered pan with salt; about 35 minutes. Drain peel and cut into 1/4-inch slices. Cook bacon until crisp. Add 1/2 cup onion and saute until tender not brown. In small bowl mix flour sugar salt and pepper. Stir in vinegar (amount depends on tartness desired) and water until smooth. Add to pan with bacon in it. Simmer stirring until slightly thickened. Pour over potatoes. Add raw onion parsley celery seed and radishes. Toss. Garnish. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Death By Chocolate 2
instructions: Bake cake mix in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool. Prick with a fork to create holes. Pour liqueur over cake. Put in refrigerator overnight. Mix mousse according to directions on box. Cut cake into small cubes. In a large bowl layer half cake half mousse half Cool Whip half Skor bars; repeat ending with sprinkling Skor bars on top. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or longer!

title: Krispy Starfish
instructions: Place wontons in a muffin pan. Bake 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. They will form crispy star-like cups. Mix together all ingredients in a bowl. Mixture should be moist but not soupy. Scoop mixture into each cup using a heaping teaspoon. Sprinkle top of mixture with a little shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes and serve warm or let cool.

title: Buzzard'S Breath Chili
instructions: Melt the lard butter or drippings in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until translucent.

title: Chewy Gooies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (great recipe for little boys to help with as it builds muscles stirring this glob). Pour into a 9 x 9-inch (or 8 x 8-inch) greased pan. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Top will be shiny.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring to boil sugar milk and cocoa. Boil for 1 minute. Take off heat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Stir until it starts to get thick and cooler. Spoon on wax paper.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Brown ground beef with taco sauce mix. Drain. Mix rest of ingredients and pour 1/2 of the mixture into a 2-quart casserole dish. Spread meat mixture on that. Pour remaining half of corn bread mixture on top of meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Invert on plate and serve hot.

title: Armenian Style Green Beans
instructions: Cook onion in salad oil until soft. Clean green beans and cut lengthwise. Add beans tomatoes water salt sugar and pepper to the onion. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until beans are tender. Serves 4.

title: Cornbread Casserole(Given To Clo Fletcher By Clara Hollingsworth)
instructions: Prepare cornbread using chicken broth and 2 teaspoons sage instead of liquid. Mix together chicken green pepper celery almonds salt pepper onions pimentos water chestnuts and mayonnaise. Crumble half of cold cornbread in buttered 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Add diced ingredients. Crumble rest of cornbread over top. Mix eggs milk and chicken broth. Pour over top of casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Before cooking mix soups together and pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cream Of Wheat Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Preheat greased skillet. Pour mixture into hot skillet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes good dressing for chicken and turkey.

title: Cake From Scratch
instructions: Mix eggs in mixing bowl. Add 1 cup sugar and mix well. Add flour and milk slowly (alternate) 1/4 spoon baking powder. Mix well. Add vanilla flavoring; mix well. Grease pan; dust pan(s) with flour. Pour batter in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Dissolve the jello and Kool-Aid in the cup of boiling water. Add the sugar and stir 2 minutes. Add 2 quarts of water and the pineapple juice. (Makes 1 gallon.) This can be frozen and served crushed or with ice cubes. Wait until you are ready to serve the punch then add the 7-Up. You may change the jello Kool-Aid flavor to make your punch the color you need.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Prepare broccoli according to directions. Drain and set aside. Saute onion in butter until soft. Combine broccoli onion rice soup and Cheez Whiz. Mix well. Pour into large casserole dish; top with bread crumbs. Dot with butter and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix shortening margarine 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs thoroughly. Stir in flour cream of tartar 1 teaspoon soda and salt. Shape dough by rounded teaspoons into balls. Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon; roll balls in mixture. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until set. Immediately remove from baking sheet. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Tossed Italian Salad
instructions: Mix oil garlic salt Worcestershire and lemon juice in jar for dressing. Separately sprinkle lettuce with cheese. Add onion bacon and croutons. Let stand until ready to serve. Just before serving add tomatoes. Pour dressing over salad; toss lightly.

title: Peppermint Stick Pie
instructions: Combine cereal and chocolate; mix well. Press into bottom and up sides of an ungreased 10-inch pie plate. Freeze for 5 minutes. Spoon ice cream into the crust. Freeze until ready to serve. Garnish with chocolate syrup and peppermint candies. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Ketchup
instructions: Core cook and grind tomatoes in a food mill. Put in refrigerator overnight. Spoon off water. Add remaining ingredients. Cook 10 minutes or until thick. Makes 6 to 10 pints.

title: Chicken 57
instructions: Skin chicken and remove fat. Very lightly flour chicken. Cover in oil for a few minutes on each side. Mix together 57 sauce and water. Pour off any excess oil and pour 57 mix over chicken. Cook slowly covered until done.

title: Limpa Bread
instructions: Heat liquid and add seeds. Let stand 5 minutes. Add shortening salt molasses and lemon rind. When cool add yeast mixture and the rye flour; beat well. Then add all but 1/2 cup of the remaining flour. Knead dough on floured board for about 10 minutes. Put in oiled bowl and let double in bulk (about 2 hours). Turn out on floured board again and work in the remaining 1/2 cup flour. Shape into 3 round loaves in 8-inch cake pans greased. Or make two (9-inch) loaf pans if you want it for sandwiches. Let rise to top of loaf pan about 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Brush tops of loaves with margarine and cool on racks.

title: Volcano Punch
instructions: Pour pineapple juice and limeade into a punch bowl to blend. Just before serving add ginger ale and scoops of sherbet. Garnish with fruit; examples strawberries pineapple chunks or orange slices. Makes approximately 50 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Tex-Mex Tuna Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine tuna cottage cheese sour cream red onion chilies salsa and noodles. Turn into 2-quart casserole dish coated with nonstick spray. Combine crackers and cashews. Sprinkle over top. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crab Crepes Filling And Sauce(Serves 10)
instructions: Melt butter; add onion and crab. Toss for 1 minute. Season; add wine. Boil quickly until wine is almost evaporated. This is the filling.

title: Southern Corn Cakes
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; mix well. Combine next 6 ingredients; mix well. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Mixture will be thin. Cook on hot grill until brown on each side.

title: Swedish Fruit Soup
instructions: Combine fruit water lemon sugar and cinnamon in pressure cooker. Close cover securely. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe; cook 10 minutes. Cool pressure cooker at once. If desired thicken with cornstarch or arrowroot. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Kres Me Melinzana(Beef With Eggplant)
instructions: Brown meat and onions in butter or shortening. Add tomato sauce mint parsley and seasonings. Let simmer until meat is almost cooked about 1 1/2 hours. Soak eggplant in salted water; drain and re-wash. Put into meat mixture and cook until done approximately 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Jane'S Skier'S French Toast
instructions: In a small saucepan combine corn syrup butter and brown sugar; simmer until syrupy. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Slice bread into 12 to 16 slices and place over sugar/butter mixture in dish. Beat together the eggs milk vanilla and salt; pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake for 45 minutes in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Serve hot before bottom hardens!

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Heat oil in skillet or deep fryer. Add pepper salt cayenne paprika and garlic powder to chicken. Cover chicken with flour.

title: White Fudge
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients for 5 minutes. Add marshmallow cream coconut and nuts. Pour into buttered pan.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix; bake at 325\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish greased with margarine and floured or spray with nonstick cooking spray. Bake 45 minutes. Mixture will be stiff and hard to stir and spread in baking dish.

title: Over Top Brownies
instructions: Bake the brownies following the instruction on the back of the box. After the brownies cool pour some chocolate syrup over the brownies. As much as you want. Then shake powdered sugar over the top. Again as much as you want. Then enjoy.

title: Tortilla Casserole
instructions: In 9 x 13 pan place tortillas in the bottom of pan. Layer ground beef (cooked) chopped onion beans and 2 packages of cheese. Place another layer of tortillas on top of layers. Combine cans of soup with Ro-Tel and pour this over the top. Sprinkle other package of cheese over all of this. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until heated through (about 45 minutes). Serve with salsa and sour cream if desired.

title: Pecan Chicken(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time 30 minutes.

title: Poppin Fresh Barbecue Cups
instructions: Brown ground beef with fat over low heat. Drain off fat. Add barbecue sauce onion and brown sugar to meat. Grease 8 muffin cups.

title: Mexican Lasagna
instructions: Place 4 uncooked lasagna noodles in 13 x 9-inch dish (spray dish). Spread half of meat mixture. Top with 4 more lasagna noodles and the rest of meat mixture. Mix 2 1/2 cups water and 2 1/2 cups picante. Pour over casserole. Cover with foil. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Calico Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix all well. Pour into greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Okra Cornbread
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Stir in okra if batter is too thin add more hush puppy mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown. Cut into squares. Serve hot.

title: Papa Cantella'S Italian Sausage Soup
instructions: Note Turkey Italian sausage works well in this soup. You may mix 1/2 pound mild and 1/2 pound hot Italian sausage which makes an excellent soup. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Cube bread. Add melted butter and toss well. In buttered 9 x 13-inch dish layer the ingredients in the following order half bread cubes half cheese and bread crumbs.

title: Surprise Chicken Hot Dish
instructions: Arrange first 5 ingredients in layers in buttered baking dish. Blend and heat the 2 cups soup with milk and pour over layered ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Puffs
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Heat water and butter to a rolling boil in a large saucepan. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball about 1 minute. Drop dough by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto Pam sprayed baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Remove puffs to wire rack. Cool slowly.

title: Old-Fashioned Peach Cobbler
instructions: Take 1 medium clear casserole bowl. Mix by hand the peaches flour sugar and eggs. Mix slowly as to not tear up the peaches. Slowly stir until all ingredients are moistened. Bake on top rack of oven at 350\u00b0 until crust rises and becomes golden brown.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook onion and margarine in frying pan until tender and slightly brown. Remove pan from heat; add dressing and squash; salt and pepper to taste. Mix well. Place in greased casserole pan. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Sheet Cake Brownies
instructions: In saucepan put margarine chocolate and water. Let melt and bring to a boil. Add flour sugar soda salt vanilla and sour milk. Stir well. Then add eggs; beat after each one. Pour into well-greased jelly roll pan. Bake 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. While baking make frosting.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover 15 minutes or until tender. Drain well and mash. Add cream cheese sour cream milk salt and pepper. Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer just until smooth. Spoon potato mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Drizzle top evenly with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until potatoes are lightly browned. Serve immediately. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Herbed Garlic Cheese Spread
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat the cream cheese butter and seasonings until well blended. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Beef Porcupines
instructions: Mix beef rice onion and spices. Form into small balls. Fry in hot oil turning frequently until lightly browned but not crusty. Add sauce and water. Mix well. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cherry Surprise
instructions: Spread pie mix in casserole dish. Spread pineapple cake mix nuts and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch pan put pineapple in bottom of pan. Add sugar and vanilla and mix well. Pour cake mix (dry) over pineapple mixture; slice butter over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and bubbly.

title: Spinach Quiche
instructions: Microwave pastry shell 4 minutes. Cook bacon slices until crisp; drain and crumble. Cook spinach; drain well pressing out water. Beat eggs. Toss cheese with flour add spinach milk eggs and seasonings. Place crumbled bacon in bottom of crust. Pour rest of ingredients into pastry shell. Microwave 6 minutes or until a metal knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt margarine in casserole dish. Mix remainder of ingredients using Jiffy corn muffin mix last. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Rise And Shine Pie
instructions: Place hash browns into greased 9-inch pie pan. With fingers press firmly to form solid crust. Brush with butter and bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven; reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Onto potato crust layer Swiss cheese ham Jack cheese then mushrooms. In small bowl whisk milk eggs and seasoned salt. Slowly pour over pie. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until center is set. Remove from oven; let stand 10 minutes before cutting into wedges. Makes 4 servings.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Mix and bake cake according to package directions in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix caramel sauce and milk leaving about 2 tablespoons of caramel in jar. When cake is removed from oven use a meat fork to put holes all over top of cake. Pour caramel and milk mixture over cake. Let soak in and cool completely. Spread Cool Whip over cooled cake and top with crushed Heath bars. Drizzle remaining caramel sauce over Heath bars. Refrigerate.

title: Chili Balls
instructions: Mix beef pork egg rice milk 1 teaspoon chili powder and salt. Form into small balls. Brown in hot fryer. Combine tomatoes water onion salt and remaining chili powder. Bring to a boil. Drop balls into mixture. Cover and cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Grilled Corn-On-The-Cob
instructions: You also need 100% cotton kitchen string.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Partly peel cucumbers leaving strips of green and slice thin. Add salt to cucumbers and let stand for 15 minutes. Combine the remaining ingredients. Press excess liquid from cucumbers and add to sauce. Chill and serve as relish. You may add small pieces of thinly sliced mushrooms carrots or abalone to decorate this relish.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Roll out bottom crust to fit into a 9 in. pan. Break Ritz crackers coarsely into sauce pan. Combine water sugar and cream of tartar. Boil gently for 15 minutes. Add lemon juice. Cool. Pour into pie shell. dot with butter. Add top crust and crimp edges. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Make two or three slits to let steam escape. Bake in preheated oven at 370 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill before serving. Makes 60 cups.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine eggs flour and sugar; beat well. Add milk corn and salt. Melt butter in baking dish; add corn mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until firm. Makes 10 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix confectioners sugar peanut butter and melted butter together to make a thick batter. Take and roll the mixture into small balls and then freeze until very hard.

title: Scalloped Green Beans
instructions: Place beans in bottom of buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix soup onion bacon cheese and Tabasco. Pour soup mixture over beans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until nicely browned and cheese is melted. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Andrea'S Oatmeal Cookies
