instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Add oatmeal flour salt and baking soda. Drop onto greased cookie sheets by spoonfuls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Yogurt Topped Apples
instructions: To make filling In small mixing bowl combine raisins and nutmeg; set aside.

title: Muffins By The Pailful
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store covered in refrigerator. Bake next day or after at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes in muffin cups 2/3 full.

title: Pistachio Nut Torte
instructions: Combine butter and sugar. Add flour and chopped nuts. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool completely. Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add 6 ounces Cool Whip and spread on top of crust. Combine pudding and milk beat on low for 2 minutes. Spread on top of cream cheese layer. Top with 10 to 16 ounces Cool Whip. Refrigerate. Add chopped nuts.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops. Set aside. In 15 x 10-inch baking dish put uncooked rice. Layer pork chops with green pepper slices tomato slices and onion slices. Salt and pepper well. Pour consomme over all; rinse the cans with a little water and add to casserole. Bake covered in a 350\u00b0 oven until liquid is absorbed and vegetables are done approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Crock Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and set aside. In a saucepan mix vinegar water salt and sugar; boil 1 or 2 minutes. Place cucumbers in a crock layering cucumbers then onion fresh dill and garlic cloves; repeat. If large cucumbers are used cut in 2 or 3 pieces. Pour vinegar mixture over top and weight down cucumbers by placing a plate and a weigh on top. Let stand at room temperature 24 hours then remove weight. Cover and refrigerate. These pickles will keep for months. Yields 2 gallon jars.

title: Tuna And Biscuit Roll
instructions: Drain and flake tuna. Cook onion in butter until tender. Blend in flour add milk and cook until smooth stirring constantly. Add cheese and heat until cheese melts. Stir in tuna. Prepare biscuit mix according to directions. Roll dough into rectangle about 12 inches long and 1/8 inch thick. Spread with tuna mixture. Roll like a jelly roll and seal ends and edge. Vent top of roll. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. (Be creative and shape roll like fish.)

title: French Toast
instructions: Beat eggs milk sugar and salt together in shallow dish. Heat shortening in skillet or on griddle. Dip bread slices one at a time into egg mixture. Turn and coat evenly. Fry until lightly brown on both sides. Serve with syrup jelly or 10xxx sugar.

title: Oreo Cookie Supreme
instructions: Layer bottom of pan with cookie crumbs. Pour over Eagle Brand milk; layer again. Pour over prepared pudding. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Cover with Cool Whip before serving.

title: Grandma'S Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat eggs oil & sugar cream well. Sift in dry ingredients. Fold in carrots and nuts. Bake 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean at 350\u00b0. Makes 3 layers or 1 9 x 13 cake. Top with cinnamon cream cheese frosting.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a bowl combine the eggs zucchini oil pineapple and vanilla. Combine the dry ingredients; stir into egg mixture just until moistened. Fold in nuts and raisins if desired. Pour into two greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; add salt sugar and oil blending well. Stir in 2 cups of flour and beat well; add remaining flour slowly to form a soft dough. Knead well. Store in a greased bowl with cover overnight in refrigerator. Punch down dough; make into rolls. Leave rolls on baking pan until they rise double in size 2 to 3 hours. Bake at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Chili Dip
instructions: In crock-pot mix all ingredients together. Stir occasionally. Great with Doritos or any kind of chip.

title: Zesty Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In saucepan bring water to a boil. Add potatoes onion garlic bouillon and salt. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring. Cover and lower heat. Cook about 10 minutes until potatoes are almost tender. Spread 1/2 potato mixture with liquid in a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Cover evenly with 1/2 cheese and 1/2 chilies. Repeat with remaining potato mixture cheese and chilies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Southwest Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain. Add onions. Pour into pot. Add all other ingredients. Bring to a boil and turn down heat. Let simmer for about 20 minutes. Serve hot topped with grated cheese and tortilla chips or Fritos.

title: No Baked Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar butter cocoa and milk; boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat add remaining ingredients. Drop from spoon onto wax paper.

title: Fiesta Potato Dippers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Toss potato wedges with oil and chili powder. Transfer to cookie sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Mix together cheese sour cream and cilantro until well blended. Makes 1 cup.

title: Fettucini Alfredo
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. While noodles are cooking heat butter over water both in chafing dish until melted. Stir in cream 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese and salt. Heat stirring occasionally until smooth. Drain noodles; toss with cream mixture until evenly coated. Serve with Parmesan cheese and pepper. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bass'S Squash Delight
instructions: Place about 3/4-inch of water in saucepan. While bringing water to boil add sugar salt and pepper. Have burner on high at all times. Cook fast to a boil that can not be stirred out. Add pre-cut squash and other ingredients (except margarine) finely chopped. Cover until tender. Continue to boil hard until all the fluid is gone. Stir regularly. Add margarine. Stir until melted. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand until served.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Balls
instructions: Melt margarine; stir in peanut butter and powdered sugar and mix well. Add graham crackers coconut and chopped nuts. Roll into small balls.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Shake all ingredients together in a bottle and its ready to use.

title: Peanut Butter Pudding
instructions: Using a whisk or hand mixer whip milk and peanut butter. Add pudding and mix well. Fold in Cool Whip and mix well. Makes 6 servings.

title: Seafood Fettucini
instructions: Melt butter; stir in flour. Gradually add half and half. Stir until thickened; add Parmesan. Cook and stir until smooth. Fold in crab delights; heat 3 minutes. Stir occasionally. Toss fettucini with sauce. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed on box. Bake in 13 x 9 pan. Cool. Punch holes in top with handle of wooden spoon. Pour cream of coconut over top then pour on Eagle brand milk. Layer cool whip and top with frozen coconut.

title: Molasses Fruit Cake
instructions: Put all together and knead to a stiff dough. Bake at 325\u00b0 until brown. Use dried fruit to stack. Sweeten the dried fruit and add spice and a little cinnamon.

title: Coach Thompson'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Pinch small balls; put on cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. While hot dip in confectioners sugar. Nuts and chocolate chips may be added to dough.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let rise once. Roll out dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Melt butter. Cut biscuits out and drop in butter. Keep layering in Bundt pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Put the first 3 ingredients in bottom of each pint jar. Put the beans in four pint jars. Bring the water vinegar and salt to a boil. Pour brine over beans. Seal with Ball type lids. Makes 4 pints. Does not have to be processed.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Sensation
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Stir pudding and half and half together and put in refrigerator for 15 minutes. Flatten cookie dough with fingers in a sprayed pizza pan. Soften cookie dough first. Bake 10 to 12 minutes and let cool completely.

title: Cranberry Almond Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg and beat well. Blend in almond extract. Combine flour salt cranberries and almonds.

title: Lasagne(Serve With French Bread)
instructions: Cook and stir meat onion and garlic; drain. Add tomatoes sauce parsley flakes sugar salt and basil. Heat to boiling; simmer 45 minutes uncovered. Save 1/2 the sauce for top. Mix cottage cheese with the remaining 1/2. Use a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. No grease in dish. Alternate noodles meat sauce Mozzarella cheese and cottage cheese mix 3 times. Top with 1/2 meat sauce and 1/4 Parmesan cheese. Let sit 15 minutes before cooking.

title: Easy Toffee(Servings:  4)
instructions: Line jelly roll pan with saltines. Bring brown sugar and butter to a boil. Pour over saltines. Bake in 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven for 7 to 9 minutes. Sprinkle chips over hot candy. Spread when melted. Freeze 30 minutes. Break like peanut brittle.

title: Cream Wafers
instructions: Mix thoroughly butter cream and flour. Cover and chill. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Roll about 1/3 of dough at a time 1/8-inch thick on floured cloth-covered board. (Keep remaining dough chilled.) Cut into 1 1/2-inch rounds. Transfer rounds with spatula to piece of waxed paper that is heavily covered with granulated sugar; turn each round so that both sides are coated with sugar. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Prick rounds with fork about four times. Bake 7 to 9 minutes or just until set but not brown. Cool. Put cookies together in pairs with Creamy Filling. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

title: Party Punch
instructions: The night before slice oranges and place in a bowl with water; freeze. When ready to serve place 7-Up in punch bowl and scoop out sherbet into punch bowl. Place ice with oranges in bowl and serve.

title: Marinated Tomato And Cucumber Salad
instructions: Combine tomato wedges and cucumber and onion slices in a large bowl; set aside. Combine vinegar oil mayonnaise sugar and salt. Beat using a wire whisk until smooth. Pour dressing over tomato mixture tossing gently. Cover and chill at least 2 hours stirring occasionally. Serve with slotted spoon. Yields 6 servings.

title: Pudding Dessert
instructions: Line bottom and sides of 9 x 12-inch pan with graham crackers. Mix together pudding and milk mix until smooth add Cool Whip mix until smooth. Pour into pan put graham crackers on top of pudding mixture. Melt frosting in microwave for 1 minute. Pour over graham crackers. Refrigerate until frosting hardens.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients thoroughly then add the pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in a 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Betty Maloney'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook eggs sugar and lemon juice until thick. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Place in refrigerator for 24 hours before serving.

title: Orange-Pineapple Ice Cream
instructions: Mix milk and pineapple in churn container. Add Sunkist drink to fill line of churn. Churn.

title: Best Ever Pie Crust
instructions: Sift the flour and salt together; cut Crisco into flour mixture with pastry blender or 2 knives. Mix egg vinegar and cold water together. Add to flour mixture and work with hands to form smooth ball. Roll out into circles and put in pie pans. Fill with favorite pie filling and bake.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain and mash into fine pulp. Add beaten eggs onion grated cheese and white sauce. Cook in a double boiler 1 hour. Place in a 2-quart casserole together with bread crumbs and bake at 375\u00b0 until crumbs brown. (Can cook in double boiler the day ahead then bake later.) Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry. Beat eggs with hand beater. Beat in remaining ingredients. Pour into pie crust. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Bake 45 minutes longer or until knife stuck in center comes out clean.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop oranges (with peel) pecans and cranberries. Put in bowl. Sprinkle sugar over top and let set for 10 minutes then stir. Put 2 cups boiling water and Jell-O into mix. Mix together well. Pour into a long dish and chill overnight.

title: Iced Tea
instructions: Boil 4 cups of water. Tie tea bags together; add to water as it starts to boil. Turn fire off. Let tea seep for 15 minutes (no more than 30 minutes). Add sugar to dissolve. Pour tea water into gallon container. Run cold water over tea bags; add to enough cold water to make 1 gallon of tea. Do not squeeze tea bags. Makes tea bitter.

title: Artichoke Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Heat in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Stir and pour into crock-pot chafing dish or fondue pot. Serve with crackers.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix kraut celery pepper pimentos and onion together. Mix well the sugar oil and vinegar. Add to kraut mixture and mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Spread dough on pizza pan. Spread sausage on dough then cheese then hash browns. Mix eggs and milk and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar oil and zucchini beating after each addition. Sift dry ingredients and add to zucchini mixture. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour for 2 loaves 30 minutes for 12 \Texas\ muffins and 20 minutes for 24 regular muffins.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl beat egg yolks; stir in Eagle Brand milk ReaLime and food coloring. Turn into shell. In small mixer bowl beat egg whites with cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff not dry. Spread on top and seal. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Green Chiles Casserole
instructions: Break eggs into a large bowl and beat until light. Add remaining ingredients blending thoroughly. Pour into a well-greased 2 quart baking dish and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour or until top of casserole is browned and center is firm. Cool for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with salsa and sour cream. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Warning Do not allow any water or steam near chocolate or it will hunk up.

title: Pickled Eggs And Beets
instructions: Hard-cook eggs; boil for 10 minutes and peel eggs. Pour beet juice into measuring cup. Place beets and eggs into container. Measure equal amounts of vinegar and sugar to beet juice. Combine beet juice vinegar and sugar in saucepan. Heat over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved. Pour liquids over the beets and eggs. Let stand at room temperature for several hours then store in refrigerator for several days. To serve place on egg tray or other serving dish.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Resift flour with baking soda and salt. Cream the butter until soft. Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add egg and beat well. Mix flavoring with sour milk. Stir dry ingredients alternately with sour milk into creamed mixture beginning and ending with dry ingredients and mixing until smooth after each addition. Stir in rhubarb and nuts. Pour batter into two well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Combine 1 tablespoon melted butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Cheese - Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a 4 quart saucepan combine potatoes onions carrots celery water margarine and bouillon. Bring to boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. In small bowl combine milk and flour beat until smooth. Gradually blend into vegetable mixture. Add cheese mustard and pepper. Cook and stir until cheese melts.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Add yeast to warm water and let dissolve. Add sugar salt oil and 1 cup of flour. Mix. Gradually add the remaining flour until dough forms a ball. Knead with dough hook or by hand until dough is no longer sticky. Spread on pizza pan. Add sauce your favorite toppings and cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients in a bowl. In a separate bowl mix the molasses oil egg and hot water. Beat dry ingredients into wet ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef; rinse and drain. Add minced onion and bell pepper. Add spaghetti seasoning tomato sauce and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix and freeze. When ready to use mix 3 or 4 large bottles of 7-Up with frozen mixture. This serves around 50 people.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Let dough stand at room temperature until soft not puffy. Roll out to size of cookie sheet. In a small bowl mix eggs oregano and garlic salt. Spread 3/4 of mixture on dough. Place sliced pepperoni and cheese on top. Roll up dough into long shapes. Seas ends well. Cut in half and seal those ends also. Bake in two loaf pans for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Before baking spread rest of egg mixture on top.

title: Apples And Peanut Butter Wedges
instructions: Cut the apple into wedges and apply peanut butter.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
instructions: Cream the cream cheese then add sugar eggs and vanilla. Pour into cupcake liners in muffin tins. Bake for 40 minutes at 300\u00b0. Remove from oven; cool 5 minutes. Cakes will fall slightly leaving a small depression in the center. Fill each depression with 2 teaspoons of Sour Cream Mix. Drop small dab of your favorite jelly or jam on top of each cake. Return to 300\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Cool completely. Refrigerate. (These may be frozen for up to a month.)

title: Deviled Crabs
instructions: Cook onion in 3 tablespoons butter. Blend in flour. Add milk gradually cooking until thick stirring constantly. Add seasonings Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Stir small amount of hot sauce into egg blending well; then add to sauce. Add parsley and crabmeat. Place in well-greased shells. Combine crumbs and 1 tablespoon butter; sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Place flaked tuna cheese and sliced eggs in a casserole dish. Pour soup and milk over mixture. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and crumbs brown.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
instructions: Combine corn green pepper pimento celery onion and oil; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients; stir well and pour over vegetables. Toss gently cover and chill 8 to 10 hours. Drain before serving.

title: Cocktail Franks
instructions: Saute onion and celery in hot oil until soft. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Simmer about 45 minutes. Can make ahead and freeze.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Cream margarine and sugar. Beat together. Sift together dry ingredients. Add all together with milk and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in tube pan. Dont open door.

title: Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers. Soak overnight in salted water (1 handful of salt for every 1/2 gallon of water). Drain. Cover cucumbers with boiling water. Allow to stand for 10 minutes. Drain and pack into sterilized jars. Combine vinegar 1 cup water and sugar. Bring to a boil and allow to boil for about 10 minutes. Pour hot vinegar solution over cucumbers in jars. Seal.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together; bake in buttered dish at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Crush garlic in small bowl; cover with oil. Refrigerate 1/2 hour. Fry bread cubes in 1/4 cup garlic oil. Cook eggs 1 minute in boiling water. Remove and cool. In small bowl combine lemon juice Worcestershire sauce salt pepper and anchovies. Mix well. In large bowl tear lettuce into bite size pieces. Drain oil from garlic; toss into salad. Add mixture; toss. Add bread and cheese. Toss well and serve at once.

title: Sensational Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove mushroom stems. Chop enough stems to make 1/2 cup. Cook mushroom caps in margarine 5 minutes. Combine cream cheese and Parmesan cheese mixing until well blended. Add chopped stems and onion; mix well. Fill mushroom caps. Broil until golden brown. Makes approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Better Than ? Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed and bake in 11 x 16-inch pan. While cake is baking mix pineapple with sugar. Boil 5 minutes. When cake is done punch holes in top and pour pineapple over the cake. Let cake cool. Mix pudding as directed. Pour over cake. Sprinkle with coconut. Slice bananas over cake and cover with Cool Whip. Cover with nuts. Chill and serve.

title: No Roll Pie Crust
instructions: Press into 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Potato Biscuits
instructions: Stir butter into potatoes. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk; add honey. Mix baking powder sugar and flour. Add milk and potatoes. Press into a circle 3/4-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown approximately 17 to 18 minutes. Yield 16 to 18 biscuits.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix hash browns sour cream milk salt pepper 1/2 cup melted butter and cream of chicken soup. Mix in Cheddar cheese and put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Crush corn flakes and mix with 1/4 cup melted butter. Put on top of potato mix (dont blend in). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Famous Pumpkin Pie(Makes One 9-Inch Deep Dish Pie)
instructions: Prepare pie shell. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Beat eggs lightly in large bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients in order given. Pour into pie shell. Bake for 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar milk and salt for 10 minutes. Add butter and boil to soft ball. Add vanilla and peanut butter.

title: Squash Stuffed Chicken
instructions: In a skillet melt butter or margarine over medium heat. Saute onion parsley and basil until the onion is tender. Add zucchini and continue to cook for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat; stir in bread crumbs eggs cheese salt and pepper. Carefully loosen the skin on the chicken on one side to form a pocket. Stuff with zucchini mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until chicken is done. Yield 4 servings.

title: Strawberry Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwave Pecan Pie
instructions: Put butter in medium mixing bowl microwave on High until butter melts. Add remaining ingredients except pecans. Beat at medium speed for 1 to 2 minutes until smooth. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie crust. Microwave on High for 15 to 17 minutes or until set. Rotate pie plate every 5 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Mashed Potato And Cheddar Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Butter a 2-quart souffle or casserole dish. Cook potatoes until tender. Drain and mash. Add butter and eggs. Beat until smooth and airy. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to baking dish and sprinkle cheese over. Bake until cheese is melted and potatoes are heated through (about 20 minutes). Serves 4.

title: Grandma'S Graham Cracker Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating after each one. Crush graham crackers and mix in baking powder. Add cracker mixture alternately with milk and vanilla. Blend in pineapple nuts and coconut. Pour into greased tube pan and bake 1 hour.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 8 x 8-inch pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream oleo sugar and egg. Sift dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture. Mix until well blended. Add sour cream and nuts. Pour into greased pan; sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next morning bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until nice and brown.

title: Stephanie Mclaughlin'S Fudge Drops
instructions: Combine butter milk and sugar in pan over medium heat. Bring to a boil. Cook 4 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add other ingredients. Stir vigorously 1 minute. Working quickly drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Cool.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Blend cheeses and garlic. Add chopped nuts. Make balls or roll. Cover with chili powder or additional chopped nuts.

title: Finger Lickin' Barbecue
instructions: Marinate meat according to package directions. When coals are white place meat on the grill. When meat is nearly done baste with sauce. Place in pan and cover with heavy foil. Place pan on an area on the grill where the heat is not direct for 30 minutes.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Combine onions cucumbers and salt. Cover with ice and let set 3 hours. Drain well.

title: Garlic Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Add crushed garlic and whole mushrooms. Gently mix in lemon juice and shrimp. (Add more butter if needed at this time.) Saute 1 minute on each side or until pink. Add wine; increase heat and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add cornstarch mixture. Return to flame until sauce is thickened. Serve over rice.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl. Blend in sugar shortening and salt. Beat egg with fork; add to mixture. Add 1/2 the flour; beat 150 strokes with wooden spoon. Add remaining flour; beat 150 strokes or until blended. Grease large bowl. Put dough in bowl; lightly grease with some of the butter. Cover let rise in warm place until doubled (about 1 1/2 hours). Punch dough down and turn in bowl. Lightly grease top with butter. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. (May be kept several days in fridge. Keep top greased and bowl tightly covered. Use as needed.)

title: Spicy Crispy Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dip chicken in egg; coat with combined remaining ingredients. Place in greased shallow baking dish. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Meal In A Skillet
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a big skillet. Cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Corn Custard Mexicana
instructions: Thaw corn. Place in large bowl. Add melted butter beaten eggs corn meal salt pimiento celery sour cream and cheese. Rinse seeds from chilies; chop. Add to corn mixture and mix well. Pour into buttered casserole (1 1/2 quarts) and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until set and golden brown. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. 5 or 10 minutes until it is done cover with velveeta cheese. Finish baking.

title: Chili Parlor Chili
instructions: Bring 1 quart of water to a boil. Add ground beef; crumble and cook until meat is no longer pink. Add the rest of the ingredients; spices first. Let simmer for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Crunchy Romaine Toss
instructions: Brown chopped walnuts and broken noodles in butter. Break lettuce into salad bowl. Add coarsely chopped broccoli chopped onions and remaining ingredients. Toss with Sweet/Sour Dressing.

title: Sunshine Spinach Salad
instructions: Prepare salad dressing mix with vinegar orange juice and water as directed on envelope substituting orange juice for the 2 tablespoons water and adding orange peel. Mix spinach orange sections onion and turkey bacon in large bowl. Add dressing; toss lightly. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cool Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and Eagle Brand together. Refrigerate for an hour. Add the cherries coconut nuts and marshmallows. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Yield 24.

title: Parmesan Chicken(Microwave)
instructions: Remove skin from chicken. Place margarine in small bowl. Microwave on High for 30 seconds. Mix together Parmesan cheese bread crumbs parsley flakes and garlic powder. Salt and pepper chicken. Roll in melted margarine and then in bread crumb mixture. Place in a 2-quart casserole dish with meaty ends of chicken on outer edges of the dish. Sprinkle with paprika on top of chicken pieces. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave for 12 to 14 minutes on High turning chicken halfway through baking time.

title: Buckaroons
instructions: Cream together\tshortening and sugars. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Mix\tflour\tsoda salt and baking powder together and add to sugar mixture. Mix in oatmeal vanilla chocolate chips and nuts. Drop on\tgreased cookie sheet and bake for 6 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick 'N Easy Scotchie Buns
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon in small bowl. Dip each biscuit in melted margarine until thoroughly coated then roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture. In a well buttered salad mold or Bundt pan place biscuits in pan to form a ring. Sprinkle approximately 1/3 of butterscotch pudding mix over top of biscuits. (Save the remainder for 2 more batches.) Sprinkle with chopped nuts and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Serve hot.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together in casserole dish and put a layer of onions on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Salad
instructions: Bring rice and chicken broth to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer 35 to 45 minutes. Drain. Add pecans raisins orange peel and onions. Mix oil and orange juice; pour over salad. Refrigerate. Serve at room temperature.

title: Orange Muffins With Topping
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar baking powder and salt. In another bowl blend together the orange juice concentrate orange marmalade buttermilk vegetable oil and egg substitute. Add to the flour mixture stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Spray muffin cups with nonstick vegetable cooking spray; fill 2/3 full in a small bowl.

title: Chocolate Cake Roll
instructions: Beat 4 egg yolks until light and fluffy. Beat 4 egg whites; add vanilla and sugar. Fold in egg yolk mixture. Add flour and cocoa. Put in buttered wax paper. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. When baked put on powdered sugar towel and roll like a jelly roll. Put in refrigerator. When ready to serve spread with ice cream and roll back up. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chocolate-Filled Angel Torte
instructions: Combine pudding mix with the milk. Heat to boiling stirring and cook until the mixture boils and is thickened. Cool slightly. Stir in the sour cream and rum. Split angel food cake into 3 layers. Spread chocolate mixture between the layers stacking layers back on top of each other again. Whip the cream and add the powdered sugar to sweeten slightly. Spread over top and sides of the cake. Decorate top with chocolate curls or shaved chocolate. Serve immediately or cover with a dome and refrigerate up to 3 hours before serving.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: You will also need six pint jars with lids.

title: Black Forest Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Put a layer of cake in punch bowl. Top with pudding. Spread cherry pie filling over pudding. Ice with Cool Whip. Repeat until punch bowl is full. Top with Hershey bar and cherries.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and drain. Add tomato soup and green beans. Mix and put into baking dish. Mix instant potatoes by package directions. Add beaten egg to potatoes and spread over beef mixture. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Minestrone Soup
instructions: In saucepan brown bacon and cook onion celery with garlic and basil until tender. Stir in soups water tomatoes macaroni and salt. Bring to boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Add cabbage and zucchini cooking 10 minutes longer stirring occasionally.

title: Anise Cookies
instructions: Melt margarine. Beat eggs and sugar; combine. Mix dry ingredients then add to egg mixture. Add milk and anise.

title: Coconut Balls
instructions: Mix. Roll in 1 1/2-inch balls. Roll in confectioners sugar. Tip Roll balls with wet hands to keep from sticking to hands.

title: Grandma'S Gingerbread Cake
instructions: Baking Temperature 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Baking Time 30 minutes.

title: Macaroni And Shrimp Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; salt and pepper to taste. It will be better if it is prepared and refrigerated overnight. Garnish with paprika.

title: Recipe For Happiness
instructions: Sprinkle generosity with kindness; add plenty of faith. Spread over a period of lifetime and serve everybody you meet.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter. Drain peaches and mix with butter. Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl to make batter and pour over peaches. Sprinkle mixture of brown sugar and cinnamon on top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Mama'S Sunday Tea
instructions: Using the 6 tea bags prepare tea the way you normally would using 2 1/2 quarts of water and adding the cloves or mint leaves. Remove tea bags and cloves or mint immediately. Sweeten to taste while tea is still hot. Add pineapple juice and lemon juice; chill. After desired temperature add soda or ginger ale just before serving and stir lightly. Serve with lemon garnish in tall chilled glasses.

title: Christmas Bread
instructions: Saute pepper and onions in melted margarine. Cut biscuits in four (4) pieces each. Mix all ingredients. Pour into Bundt pan ungreased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Quick Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Then cut up into small pieces. Place half of the chicken in the bottom of casserole dish. Then pour cream of mushroom soup over chicken. Then place remaining chicken in dish and cover with cream of chicken soup. Crush Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top and drizzle with butter.

title: One Day Sweet Pickles
instructions: Mix well with hands the pickles onions and salt. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain well and squeeze out juice with hands.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender; blend until smooth. Makes 2 full glasses.

title: Bread And Celery Stuffing
instructions: Pour water over bread and let stand for 20 minutes. Squeeze out extra water. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Make just before serving cooked turkey or roasted chicken.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: *Fat-free ingredients may be substituted.

title: Green Beans And Tomatoes
instructions: Saute the onion until limp and mix in the rest of the ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes and put into casserole. Cover and reheat leftovers.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl except crackers. Mix well. Shape into a ball and place in the middle of a serving platter. Must be refrigerated overnight. Arrange Wheatsworth crackers around ham ball before serving. Other crackers are fine but these taste especially good with the Ham Ball.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries. Drain pineapple and mix together. Add marshmallows and nuts and leave in refrigerator overnight. When ready to serve add Cool Whip.

title: French Doughnuts
instructions: Pour boiling water over shortening sugar and salt. Add milk. When lukewarm add the dissolved yeast. Add beaten eggs and enough flour to make mixture thick. Keep in refrigerator overnight or until cold. Roll out in flour. Cut into doughnuts. Fry in 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 shortening.

title: Favorite Pancakes
instructions: Heat griddle slowly while mixing batter. Beat egg well. Beat in buttermilk shortening flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Beat with rotary beater until smooth. Pour onto hot lightly greased griddle.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and chill.

title: No Cholesterol Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugars oil and egg whites. Add to the mixture in order the flour whole wheat flour oat bran baking soda cinnamon allspice (or nutmeg) and the apples mixing well after each. Spray Pam on 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Tina'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Mix with other ingredients and form a ball. Can be rolled in nuts.

title: Barbecue Deer
instructions: Cook roast in crock-pot until tender. Remove from pot and tear apart. Remove broth from pot. Replace meat. Add sauce carrot and onion. Season to taste. If too thick add some broth. Simmer 2 hours on low. Serve on a bun. Can add all the broth and leave juice to serve over noodle.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Gather 10 or 12 friends of the bride to be. Add a dash of lively conversation. Drop in one very surprised guest. Mix with appropriate gifts. Top with food and refreshments. Serve a decorated shower cake. Take about two and one-half hours. Makes one successful shower party.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Brown butter in pan slightly. Add onion and mushrooms. After all are browned add and simmer for 15 minutes the chicken celery broth soy sauce and sugar. (Cut down on the sugar.) Blend in the cornstarch and water that have been mixed together until smooth. Cook the chow mein mixture until slightly thickened and clear looking. Serves 4.

title: Apple Crisp(The Easy, Low-Fat Version)
instructions: Slice apples and soak in juice concentrate with 1 to 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Mix dry ingredients with enough juice concentrate to moisten into a crumbly dough-like texture that you will place on top of the apples in a casserole dish covered with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Eat with a low-fat cream or frozen yogurt.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut squash in medium pieces. Chop onion; mix with 3 tablespoons butter. Put in casserole dish. Cover tight. Cook in oven about 30 minutes until squash is tender at 350\u00b0. Take out and put cheese on top; let melt. Mix 1/2 cup melted butter with cracker crumbs. Place on top. Cover with foil. Cook 15 minutes.

title: Hamburger And Potato Pie
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Add beef and brown well. Stir in tomatoes and seasonings. Pour into a quart casserole. Combine potatoes egg yolk and butter. Beat until light and fluffy. Spread over meat mixture in casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Johnny'S Salsa Cruda
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Best is used fresh but will keep up to 24 hours. Makes 3 1/2 cups. Can also be put into canning jars and sealed.

title: Fast And Easy Mexican Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Doritos in large bowl. Mix well. Layer 9 x 13-inch pan with Doritos. Pour mixture over layered Doritos. Sprinkle crushed Doritos over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mustard Potatoes
instructions: Peel and quarter potatoes. Cook until soft (not too soft). Drain water. Pour 1 stick melted butter over potatoes. Add mustard and stir until potatoes are coated. Add parsley and serve warm.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large pan saute onions in butter until tender. Add cheese. Stir until melted. Stir in soup and asparagus. Cook until warm. Line 9 x 13-inch dish with rice. Pour mixture over rice and sprinkle top with cracker crumbs. Bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Blackberry Bundt Cakes
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in prepared Bundt pan.

title: Macadamia And Pineapple Rice Pilaf
instructions: Melt butter in flameproof casserole over medium heat; add rice. Stir until butter coats rice. Add garlic and stir a few seconds but not long enough for rice to change color. Add red and yellow peppers and cook a few seconds but not long enough for peppers to change color. Add stock; bring mixture gently to a boil. Add raisins Macadamias sage and salt. Cover; bake 18 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove dish from oven. Let cool about 10 minutes. Add cilantro and pineapple. Serve at once. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients; place in 2 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Heat milk butter and cheese; pour over frozen potatoes. Let stand 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well and place in greased casserole. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Boil sugar Karo and water until it spins a thread. Add peanuts and cook until dark amber color. Remove from fire. Add butter soda salt and vanilla. Stir vigorously and pour into buttered pans. Cool then break into pieces.

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Fry bacon and remove from skillet. To bacon drippings add remaining ingredients except lettuce and eggs. Bring sauce to a boil stirring constantly. Pour over lettuce immediately and cover for at least 1 minute until lettuce wilts. Sprinkle with minced eggs and crumbled bacon. Serve at once.

title: The Best Brownies
instructions: Blend oil sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl. Add eggs. Beat well. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture and stir until well blended. Stir in nuts.

title: Fluffy Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend all together and pour into 2 graham cracker pie crusts; let chill overnight.

title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil sugar oleo and syrup 5 minutes. Pour over popped corn in large baking pans. Stir. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: No Weep Meringue
instructions: In small saucepan mix cornstarch with cold water. Add boiling water and sugar and cook stirring until thick and clear. Cool; add vanilla. Beat 3 egg whites until soft peaks. Slowly pour cooled cooked mixture over beaten egg whites; beat well. Spread on pie and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool in oven with door open.

title: Roosevelt Beans
instructions: For thicker product drain liquid from beans.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Place pecans in unbaked pie shell. Mix sugar syrup and vanilla together. Add melted butter. Beat whole eggs together and mix well. Pour over pecans which have been placed in pie shell. Bake 1 hour in preheated oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Honey-Grilled Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Trin fat from tenderloin. Butterfly tenderloins by making a lengthwise cut in each cutting to within 1/4-inch of other side. Place in large Ziploc plastic bag.

title: Sugar And Spice Fruit Cup
instructions: Place fruit in serving bowl; combine the sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over fruit and toss gently. Refrigerate until serving time. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Nut Bread
instructions: Grease an 8 x 4 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan and sprinkle with flour. Sift flour; measure and sift 3 times with next 3 ingredients. Combine egg and milk and mix with fork. Add all at once with dry ingredients stirring quickly until flour is dampened but not smooth. Wash dry and cut cranberries. Toss with the 2 tablespoons sugar. Quickly stir in cranberries and nuts just to distribute. Turn into prepared pan pushing dough into corners. Bake in slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Increase heat to 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until nicely browned. Remove from pan to wire rack to cool before slicing. Makes 1 loaf and has no fat.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: After cooking carrots drain and set aside. Slice onion and green pepper. Mix with tomato soup vinegar oil and sugar. Heat to boiling and pour over drained carrots. Can be served hot but also good cold a day or so later.

title: No Cook Fudge Balls
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together with peanut butter. Mix real good. Add vanilla and melted butter; mix well. Shape into approximately 1-inch balls and roll in crushed nuts. Place on large foil-lined cookie sheet and freeze 20 minutes. Remove from freezer and store in refrigerator.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wipe mushroom caps with damp cloth and remove stems. Mix remaining ingredients and stuff in mushroom caps. Broil 5 to 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Golden Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine and mix well hash browns sour cream soup cheese and onion. Press into a sprayed casserole dish. Mix corn flakes and oleo until well blended. Put on top of potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside. Mix bran with milk until bran is moistened. Let stand 5 minutes. Add egg and oil beating until blended. Add flour mixture stirring until combined. Do not over mix. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake 20 minutes. Yields 12.

title: Mamall Nannie'S Pork Barbecue
instructions: Boil pork 4 to 5 hours or until tender. Pork should be salted to taste while cooking. Drain. Cool. Tear into small pieces. Place in large pan in 350\u00b0 oven to bake out some of moisture.

title: Maine Blueberry Muffins(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Lightly coat blueberries with 2 teaspoons flour. You can shake the flour and berries together in a paper bag. In a large bowl mix together the 1 3/4 cups flour baking powder nutmeg and cinnamon. In a small bowl beat eggs lightly. Add oil orange juice and grated rind. Add the liquid to dry mixture and stir a few times gently. Before the 2 mixtures are fully combined add berries and rind. Spoon into muffin cups coated with nonstick vegetable spray. Fill each one two-thirds full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 servings. Exchanges 1 starch and 1 fat.

title: Dijon Breaded Pork Chops
instructions: Mix crushed crackers salt thyme pepper and sage in shallow dish; set aside. Blend egg and mustard in shallow dish. Dip each pork chop into egg mixture then cracker mixture to coat. Heat oil in skillet. Add chops. Fry over moderate heat 16 to 20 minutes turning only once.

title: Easy Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Spread pie filling in 8 x 8-inch pan. Top with sliced potatoes. Mix cranberry sauce apricot and marmalade together and spoon over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies Supreme
instructions: Cream together the butter sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and add butter sugar and eggs. When mixed add chocolate chips and nuts. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Makes approximately 112 cookies.

title: South Of The Border Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger meat large onion and bell pepper; cook until tender. Drain. Add 1 can Ro-Tel 1 can tomato soup 1 package taco seasoning and 1 can mushrooms (stems and pieces); blend well. Add Velveeta cheese and blend until completely melted. Stir in 2 cups cooked rice. Simmer.

title: Sleepy Butterscotch Bars
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add sugar; stir well. Add marshmallows; cook until marshmallows melt stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in cereal. Press cereal mixture evenly into the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray. Let cool for 1 hour. Yield 18 servings. (Serving 1 x 3 x 2-inch bars.)

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in 1/2 cup of salted water until tender. Drain. Mix together 1 cup mayonnaise and 4 ounces Cheez Whiz. Stir into vegetable mixture. Crush 1 roll of Ritz crackers and spread on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese bubbles up.

title: Hot Crab Canapes
instructions: Fold mayonnaise and crab into egg white. Season to taste with Worcestershire salt pepper and Parmesan cheese. Refrigerate. Toast bread. Just before serving spread with crab mixture then sprinkle with paprika. Broil for 2 or 3 minutes until puffed and delicately browned; serve at once. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: Salmon Dip Appetizer
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together well. Chill overnight covered for full flavor. Serve with Pepperidge Farm wheat or butter thins crackers.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach and drain off excess water. Add soup mix chopped water chestnuts sour cream and mayonnaise. Chill.

title: Coconut-Pineapple Pie
instructions: Melt butter and mix with remaining ingredients. Pour filling into unbaked pie shell and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until set and lightly browned.

title: Cold Day Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and grate potatoes and carrots. Dice onion and celery. Add 5 cups of water. Cook until nearly tender not mushy. Add chicken bouillon cubes and evaporated milk. Add butter and parsley flakes. Season to taste.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Add together and heat. Serve with dill pickles barbecue bread and potato chips.

title: Pot Roast With Vegetable Gravy
instructions: Season meat with salt and pepper. Brown well in hot oil in Dutch oven. Remove meat and add celery onion carrots and garlic to oil. Saute until tender (do not brown). Add bouillon cube 1 cup water tomato sauce and oregano. Bring to a boil. Return meat to pot. Cover. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 hours or until tender. (May be cooked on top of stove if covered tightly.) Remove meat and keep warm. Skim off excess fat. Combine cornstarch and 1/2 cup water. Bring to boil boil 1 minute. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Bowen Avenue Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender container. Process on low for 30 seconds. Chill thoroughly. Stir well before serving on salad.

title: Kraut Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Herb Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes (with peelings on); cool and peel then cube and combine with other vegetables and eggs. Mix herbs spices and relish with mayonnaise and sour cream. In a large bowl combine all ingredients together and chill.

title: Edna'S Casserole
instructions: Dice onion and add to ground beef. Brown hamburger and onion. Drain. Add Ranch Style beans (drain first) and Spanish rice. Slice green and black olives in half and arrange on top of casserole. Tear or cut cheese in strips and arrange on top of casserole also. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until the cheese is melted. Serves 6.

title: Breaded Steak
instructions: Flatten steaks\tinto nice serving portions. Mix eggs and cheese together. Dip steak into\tegg mixture then into bread crumbs. Coat well. Fry quickly in hot oil. Place on paper towel to remove any excess oil. This is good with fried potatoes or with side dish of spaghetti and a salad.

title: Joe'S Favorite Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In a large pot brown the meat with garlic and onion. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer all day stirring occasionally.

title: Quick Coconut Pie
instructions: Blenderize for 2 minutes. Grease 9-inch glass pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. (Usually takes 30 minutes or more until it looks set in middle.)

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Boil water with pinch of salt. When boiling add butter. When melted add chopped cabbage. When cabbage is completely cooked set aside and let cool overnight.

title: Chicken Spaghetti Deluxe
instructions: Boil hen the day before. Debone and cut into large pieces. Reserve broth. Saute vegetables in oleo for 30 minutes. Add tomatoes mushrooms pimento and seasonings. Simmer 30 more minutes. Add chicken. Cook spaghetti in reserved broth until broth is absorbed. Mix with chicken mixture. Top with olives and cheese. Serves 12.

title: Noodles
instructions: For 3 eggs use 2 cups flour and 3 tablespoons milk. Mix ingredients together. Roll out then let stand until partly dry. Cut into thin strips. Cook in broth until done.

title: Ladies Hot Luncheon Sandwich
instructions: Remove crusts from bread. Butter 8 slices of bread. Arrange in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top each slice with meat and cheese. Top with remaining slices of bread. Combine eggs milk and dry mustard. Mix well. Pour over sandwiches and refrigerate overnight. Next day sprinkle with corn flakes and melted butter. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients in electric blender. Blend on low speed for 3 minutes. Pour in a greased 9-inch pie dish; let set for 5 minutes. Sprinkle 1 cup of coconut on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Eat warm or cold.

title: Potato Goody
instructions: Thaw potatoes for 30 minutes; mix all ingredients in large bowl. Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour uncovered.

title: Roast Pork With Apple Topping
instructions: In a small bowl combine the flour 1 1/2 teaspoons salt mustard caraway seed sugar pepper and sage; rub over roast. Cover and let stand 30 minutes.

title: Icicle Pickles
instructions: Split cucumbers lengthwise with skins left on. Put cucumbers in a crock. Add salt and 1 gallon boiling water. When cool cover with plate. Let stand 1 week. If mold forms remove. Drain and add another gallon of boiling water. Let stand 24 hours. Drain. Dissolve alum in 1 gallon of boiling water and pour over cucumbers. Let stand 24 hours. Drain and discard liquid. Combine vinegar sugar and mixed spices. Bring to boiling point. Put in cucumbers and let stand 24 hours. Drain in large pan; bring to boiling point (vinegar mixture) and put over cucumbers. Let stand 24 hours. Follow last step at least 3 times. The pickles are then ready to use or can be packed in hot jars and sealed.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: In a pan over low-medium heat melt marshmallows in the milk. After they are melted stir in Jell-O. Take off heat and mix well. Cool. It will get very thick almost hard. Make Dream Whip and add the cream cheese to the Dream Whip while beating it; combine Dream Whip Jell-O mixture and fruit cocktail together; place in 9 x 12-inch pan. Set.

title: Easy-Make Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour salt baking powder and milk. Mix fruit vanilla and sugar. Options 1/2 cup peaches 1/2 cup blackberries or 3/4 cup cherries. Heat oven to 450\u00b0; put butter in pan; place pan in oven. Heat until bubbly almost brown. Quickly pour in batter then fruit. Cook for 30 minutes at 450\u00b0. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 cook 30 more minutes.

title: Jennifer'S Dad'S Favorite Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat peaches and 1/4 cup sugar in microwave on High for 5 minutes. Mix 1 cup sugar oleo eggs flour and vanilla then stir into warm peaches.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: First brown hamburger just until red disappears. Then add garlic bell pepper and chopped onion and continue to brown hamburger all through. Drain all grease and juices from hamburger. Hamburger must be as dry as possible. Recommend to use paper towel in bowl to soak up grease. Put hamburger in 2-inch deep 15 x 10-inch baking dish (if possible or bigger) and spread out thoroughly. Cover with mushroom soup (do not mix just cover). Spread out. Bake for 45 minutes. Set Tater Tots carefully on top so soup and hamburger are completely covered. Bake until Tots are brown. Add cheese and bake for 30 minutes more. Dish serves 5.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Cook slowly in a heavy crock-pot until thick. Put in jars and seal while hot.

title: Baked Sausage And Eggs
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish. Combine cooked and drained sausage onion tomato mushrooms and bread cubes in baking dish. In large bowl combine eggs milk and basil pepper and garlic powder and mix well. Pour egg mixture over sausage mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake uncovered for 1 hour. Remove from oven and sprinkle both cheeses evenly over egg mixture. Bake 15 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand about 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with parsley.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Cook the first 2 ingredients over medium heat until light browned. Drain. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Simmer about 5 minutes. Spoon on hamburger buns.

title: Vegetable Relish
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables as directed on package. Drain and cool.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cook in medium size pot the sugar cocoa and milk on medium heat. Stir constantly. Bring to a rolling boil; cook for 2 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla. Add oats and peanut butter. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Let cool.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: On stove melt butter on low heat. Remove from heat and add sugar vanilla and eggs. Mix well set aside. In medium bowl add flour baking powder salt and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to mixture. Pour batter into greased 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle 1/2 c. chocolate chips. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding Salad
instructions: Prepare pudding according to package directions. Fold in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Egg Salad
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients. Blend mayonnaise with salt and dash of pepper. Chill.

title: Wedding Casserole
instructions: Slice all vegetables thinly. In 2-quart casserole layer using 1/2 the vegetables in the following way.

title: Mint-Lemon Iced Tea
instructions: Boil 5 cups water sugar lemon juice and peel and mint together for 5 minutes. Steep tea bags in 5 cups boiling water for 5 minutes. Combine mixtures and chill. Serve over ice with extra mint if desired.

title: Chocolate Eclairs
instructions: Layer graham crackers in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Mix instant pudding with 3 cups milk until thick. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread this mixture over crackers.\tPlace another layer of graham crackers on top of pudding mixture. Melt margarine. Stir in cocoa confectioners sugar and water. Mix until smooth. Spread on top of graham crackers. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Mama Tucker'S Boiled Custard
instructions: Mix egg yolks sugar flour vanilla and milk. Cook until slightly thick. Let it get cold. Beat egg whites and beat into custard.

title: Lemon-Parsley New Tatos
instructions: Pare a strip from the center of each new potato. Heat 1 inch salted water (1/4 teaspoon salt if desired to 1 cup water) to boiling in 3-quart saucepan; add potatoes. Cover and heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cook 20 to 25 minutes or until tender; drain. Return potatoes to saucepan.

title: Hot Cider Punch
instructions: Put cider and cranberry juice in 30 cup coffee maker. Put sugar and spices in coffee basket. Perk as you would for coffee. Serve hot.

title: Sticky Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Brown chicken and place in baking pan. Mix tomatoes soup mix and wine together and pour over chicken. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours. When done sprinkle cheese over top. Return to oven until cheese melts. Serves 4.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Saute onion slowly in butter for 3 minutes. Add beef and cook over low heat until brown. Blend in salt pepper milk and peas. Turn into 2-quart casserole dish. Make biscuits from Bisquick mix. Place on top of meat. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes until Bisquick biscuits are well browned.

title: Chile Rellenos Casserole
instructions: Combine in large bowl eggs milk flour and salt. Layer chiles and cheese (except for part of Cheddar) in glass baking pan. Pour egg mixture over layers. Sprinkle Cheddar on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until firm and golden brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. Combine flour cream of tartar salt and soda. Stir into creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Shape into balls the size of walnuts. Combine remaining sugar with cinnamon mixing well. Roll each ball in cinnamon mixture. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Flatten slightly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until the first cookie begins to fall. Yields 5 dozen.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix well and add

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. In prepared baking dish alternate layers of thinly sliced potatoes onion cheese salt pepper and butter. Combine soup and milk; pour over potatoes. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender.

title: Curley Macaroni Salad
instructions: Pour oil over warm macaroni. Mix sugar vinegar garlic salt parsley and pepper; shake well. Pour over macaroni and stir well. Chop fine;\tcelery cucumbers green pepper and carrot add. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Brazilian Toffee
instructions: Melt butter in heavy 8-inch skillet or heavy pan. When melted add 2 cups sugar. Add Brazil nuts water and corn syrup. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook slowly 25-35 minutes stirring occasionally to crack stage (hard ball) or 290\u00b0.

title: There'S Hardly Ever Any Left
instructions: Mix flour margarine and 1/2 cup nuts; press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Layer one Mix in mixer cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread in crust. Layer two Prepare chocolate pudding as directed. Pour over layer one. Layer three Spread with Cool Whip. Layer four Sprinkle chopped nuts (optional) over. I do half nuts and half plain.

title: Marble Cheesecake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into graham cracker crust. Enjoy!

title: Oven Fries
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into long strips. Toss in a bowl with oil until coated. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray; place potatoes on sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until tender. Turn occasionally to brown all sides. Serves 4. Each serving contains 120 calories 3 g protein 3.5 g fat 0 chol. and 8 mg sodium.

title: Double Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar with eggs. Add pecans. Add margarine syrups and vanilla. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes in preheated oven. Makes 2 pies.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shake well. This sauce is good on chicken.

title: Pickled Carrots
instructions: Boil the carrots until tender in salted water. Cool. Alternate the green pepper rings and the onion rings. Combine and beat the remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight in covered large jars. Serve as needed.

title: No-Peekie Stew
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours. Prepare rice 20 minutes before stew is done. Serve with stew on top of rice.

title: Microwave Potato Casserole(Club Member: Ben Steadman)
instructions: Peel and slice or dice potatoes. In large bowl mix potatoes onion bell pepper and mushrooms. Pour half of mixture in large casserole; dot with 1/2 of butter. Add rest of potato mixture; dot with remaining butter. Salt and pepper mixture; cover. Cook in microwave on High for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir; recover and cook for 15 to 20 more minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet stirring until crumbly. Place in 2-quart casserole. Top with soup and Tater Tots. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Bavarian Dumplings(Germany)
instructions: Chop the bacon. Heat the oil and fry the bacon pieces until golden brown. Cut up the rolls and put them in a bowl. Heat the milk and pour it over the bread. Stir in the eggs parsley salt pepper and bacon. With damp hands form little balls from the dough. Half-fill a big pan with water and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat and drop in the dumplings. Leave for about 20 minutes. When they bob up to the surface theyre ready.

title: Easy Potato Casserole
instructions: Shredding potatoes is easy compared to shredding carrots but they do discolor. Put them in cool water and then drain. Mix them with salt pepper and onion and pour half and half over to just barely cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for an hour or until done. Serves 6.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together until smooth. Great with most fruits.

title: Tex-Mex Salad
instructions: Toss onion tomatoes lettuce and cheese in Italian dressing; set aside. Brown meat. Add drained beans and vegetable seasoning; simmer 10 minutes. Mix with cold salad. Toss in crushed tortilla chips and avocado slices. Garnish with olives if desired. Serves 4.

title: Health Salad
instructions: Mix jello with boiling and cold water. Refrigerate jello until set. Add pineapple. Fold in sour cream and pecans. Add cherries for color. Let set overnight before serving.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Use flowerets of broccoli wash and cut in chunks. Cook broccoli and onion in chicken broth until almost tender. Add 1/2 package fine noodles. Cook until tender. Add water if necessary. Cut cheese in chunks and add to soup. Heat until cheese melts. Serve hot. Enjoy!

title: Ham-Cheese-Poppy Seed Rolls
instructions: Combine margarine poppy seed Worcestershire sauce onion and mustard. Slice packages of rolls as one. Spread top and bottom with spread. Place layer of ham on bottom. Top with layer of cheese. Replace top layer of rolls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts. (Also freezes well.)

title: Mushroom Cap Appetizers
instructions: Remove mushroom stems; mince. Place caps rounded side down on cookie sheet. Drain clams; save liquid. Over medium heat melt butter and brush on mushroom caps. In remainder of butter saute stems garlic and clam juice until tender about 5 minutes. Stir in clams crumbs salt and pepper. Tuck into mushrooms. Broil 8 minutes.

title: Crab Chantilly
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly butter a 9-inch quiche pan. Use a rolling pin to crush 1/2 package of crackers in a plastic bag. Whisk together the cream cheese mayonnaise lemon rind onion and Worcestershire sauce. Fold in the shredded crab and spread in a quiche pan. Top with the almonds then the crumbs the Parmesan cheese and a generous sprinkle of paprika.

title: Party Apple Dip
instructions: Cream all ingredients except apples. Serve with Granny Smith apple slices.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix sour cream lemon juice and sugar together. Add other ingredients and mix well. Place in mold or paper-lined muffin tins. Freeze. Remove from freezer abut 20 minutes before serving.

title: Watermelon Pickles
instructions: Trim dark green and pink parts from rind; cut into 1-inch squares. Measure 6 cups. Soak overnight in solution of salt and 1 quart water. Drain and rinse. Cover with cold water. Cook for 25 minutes until tender.

title: Sunday Chicken
instructions: In a medium bowl combine soups 1/4 cup butter and rice. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place chicken pieces over rice mixture. Brush with remaining butter. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 275\u00b0 for about 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Homemade Applesauce Cake With Homemade Applesauce
instructions: Put apple slices into a large saucepan. Grate lemon zest into the pan. Cover and stew the apples over low heat until tender 30 minutes. Mash the apples with a potato masher and squeeze in lemon juice. Stir in sugar and butter and simmer uncovered until thickened. Stays fresh in refrigerator up to 5 days.

title: Suet Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and fill cans 1/2 full. Cover with tinfoil and steam 2 to 3 hours. I set cans in water. Slice cold and steam before eating. (I use cans 3 or 4-inches in diameter.)

title: Easy Crust Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken in water until done. Debone chicken and place in a baking dish in bite-size pieces. Mix soup and broth; add 1/2 stick margarine and pour over chicken. Mix flour and milk. Pour over previous mixture. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Microwave Lasagna
instructions: Place ground beef and garlic in 2-quart casserole. Cook covered on full power for 4 to 5 1/2 minutes or until beef is no longer pink. Stir halfway through cooking time. Drain. Blend in water tomato paste tomato sauce oregano salt sugar basil and pepper. Cook covered on full power 6 to 8 minutes or until boiling. Stir halfway through cooking time. Blend cottage cheese 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese egg and parsley flakes in a small bowl. Layer half of noodles in 2-quart utility dish. Spread noodles with half of cheese mixture half of Mozzarella cheese and half of meat sauce. Repeat layers. Cover loosely with heavy-duty plastic wrap. Heat covered on full power for 13 to 16 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle top generously with Parmesan cheese.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press in pan the crescent rolls; bake until brown. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise and dry Ranch dressing; put on top of crust. Chop up raw vegetables; press into crust. Top with grated cheese.

title: Mexican Soup
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Combine taco mix with water; combine dressing mix with water. Combine all ingredients except the meat and onions. When all is mixed and warm add meat and onions. Simmer 45 minutes.\tTop with nachos and grated cheese.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Old almost rotten bananas which have been peeled and frozen are best. Thaw bananas in microwave mash with liquid from thawing and set aside. Cream softened margarine with sugar. Add eggs soda and vanilla. Add sour milk. Stir in mashed bananas. Add flour and chopped nuts. Pour into 2 loaf pans sprayed with Pam. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until top of loaf is golden brown and springs up when touched with finger.

title: Pork Chop And Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown chops in butter. Mix beans soup and milk. Pour mixture into 2-quart baking dish. Arrange chops on top. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

title: Jason'S Good Bars
instructions: Let sugar and Karo come to a boil stirring constantly. Add peanut butter; mix well. Pour over corn flakes. Take a teaspoonful and drop on waxed paper or cookie sheet.

title: Turkey And Rice Dressing
instructions: Remove neck and giblets; place in 3 1/2 cup chicken broth and simmer for 30 minutes. Reserve broth in a 5 to 8-quart Dutch oven. Melt margarine over medium heat. Saute onions celery and peppers. Add parsley chestnuts apples currants pine nuts cinnamon salt pepper poultry seasoning and Mahatma rice. Mix thoroughly. In microwave heat 2 packages of Frenchs brown gravy mix with 2 cups turkey broth for 1 minute stir and heat another minute. Add to stuffing mixture and mix well.

title: Banana Or Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Mix together with other ingredients. Freeze according to freezer directions. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Press broccoli between paper towels to remove excess moisture. Combine cornbread mix eggs chopped onion cheese butter and seasonings. Stir well. Stir in broccoli (batter will be thick). Pour mixture into a greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden. Cool slightly and cut into squares. Yields 9 to 12 servings.

title: Mema'S Chocolate Icing
instructions: Boil one minute on medium heat (rolling hard boil) reserving nuts. Use on layers of white or chocolate cake mix. Bake as directed on box. Sprinkle nuts on each layer.

title: Crisco Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs. Mix. Add half of flour and milk. Mix and add other half of flour and milk. Mix well. Bake in tube pan for about 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Crabby Burritos
instructions: In one skillet brown hamburger (sausage optional). In another skillet bring butter to boil on medium to medium-high. In a saucepan melt Velveeta with picante sauce. Add crabmeat to butter and let sit until warm enough to separate. As crabmeat gets stringy add red pepper and bring to a golden brown. Drain hamburger meat and mix with the crabmeat. Then you have two ways to complete the filling

title: Pig Feet
instructions: Clean feet real good. Put feet in pot of water enough to cover feet with 5 tablespoons of salt. Put in the refrigerator overnight. Next morning wash feet with water until salt is removed. Put back in pot with vinegar and crushed red pepper. After it comes to a boil cook three hours. Put feet in platter. Sprinkle with black pepper and salt if needed. Invite five more people and enjoy yourself.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening together. Mash bananas; add to sugar mixture. Add eggs; stir. Add flour and baking soda. Add vanilla and nuts.

title: Jello Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and fruit juice and bring to a boil. Add Jell-O and mix well. Cool. Beat\t1 can chilled Pet milk and add to mixture. Pour into prepared pie crust. Makes 2 pies.

title: Bourbon Souffle
instructions: To well beaten egg yolks add bourbon. To stiffly beaten egg whites add sugar. Dissolve gelatin in cold water and heat in double boiler. Pour slowly over whites and sugar beating constantly until like divinity. Fold yolks and whites together and pour into mold which has been rinsed in cold water. Garnish with chopped nuts. Chill until set.

title: Pizza Dip
instructions: Mix the cream cheese Italian seasoning and garlic powder together; spread on bottom of 8-inch pie pan. Sprinkle 1 cup of the Mozzarella cheese over this. Top with pizza sauce red and green peppers and the remaining 1 cup of Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with hard bread sticks.

title: Alberta Toomey'S Zucchini Squash
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan. Add chopped onion and cook until tender. Slice zucchini thin and add to butter and onions. Cook on low heat until squash starts to get tender. Add tomatoes salt and sugar. Cook on low heat for 1/2 hour. Then put in a greased baking dish. Top with sharp cheese and bake in oven for 15 minutes.

title: Corny Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan melt margarine. In a large mixing bowl add all ingredients including melted margarine. Stir well. Pour into pan. Bake until golden brown approximately 45 to 55 minutes or until tested done.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels and butter and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool.

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add honey; let stand a few minutes. Use two pie crusts with slits in the top crust. Begin baking at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and cook until crust is golden brown. Cool a few minutes before serving.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage with onion and bell pepper. Drain off excess fat. Mix together eggs Bisquick salt and pepper; set aside. Place both cheeses in bottom of greased 8 x 12-inch pan. Pour sausage mixture over cheese. Pour egg mixture evenly over top of sausage and cheese to completely cover them. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0 then reduce heat to 350\u00b0; bake 15 minutes longer. Serves 12.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Combine tomato paste celery onion pimento and soup; cook for 30 minutes. Add chicken spaghetti salt and pepper. Place in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Cover top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Very Best Chocolate Cake(No Eggs)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Put all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Pour in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with Caramel Icing when cool.

title: Steak And Onions
instructions: Brown meat on both sides; drain grease off of meat. Pour mixture of soup water and onions over meat and simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion; season with salt and pepper. Add remaining ingredients together except potatoes.

title: Old-Fashion Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling browns and a knife comes out clean when inserted in the center of the pie. Cool and top with Cool Whip if desired.

title: Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Melt butter and stir in flour. Gradually stir in chicken broth with wire whisk. Cook over low heat until mixture thickens. Mix egg yolks sherry and cream. Gradually beat hot sauce into egg mixture. Reheat until sauce is hot and fold in mushrooms and turkey. Add cooked spaghetti. Pour into ovenproof serving dish and top with Parmesan cheese and almonds. Put under broiler and brown until cheese and almonds are golden. Serves 6.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell and cool in refrigerator. In large bowl combine pie filling mix and sugar; add pineapple juice and sour cream and mix thoroughly with spoon. Pour mixture into cool pie shell and chill in refrigerator for at least 3 hours. When serving garnish with whipped topping.

title: Cracker Candy
instructions: Line cookie sheet pan with foil. Spray with Pam. Place crackers salt side up on foil. Bring oleo and sugar to a boil and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add 1 cup of almond flavoring. Pour mixture over crackers. Bake 400\u00b0 for 16 minutes. Top with chocolate chips as soon as you remove from the oven. Spread melted chips with spatula. Cool. Break into pieces. Store in container.

title: Chocolate Fudge Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine and chocolate over low heat. Add sugar flour and eggs (beaten). Add vanilla and nuts. Spread in a greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 about 25 or 30 minutes. Cut into squares when cooled.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Spray large double grocery bag inside with Pam and put in popped corn. Put brown sugar margarine light syrup and salt in large bowl. Microwave 4 minutes on High. Stir then microwave 4 more minutes. Remove from microwave and add butter flavoring and soda; stir. Pour hot mixture over popcorn in grocery bag. Shake bag well. Place in microwave for 3 minutes on High; remove. Shake again. Return to microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and shake well. Spread on wax paper to cool.

title: Quick And Easy Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs 15 minutes. Cool peel cut in half. Remove yolks and mash with potato masher. Add Thousand Island dressing to creamy consistency. Fill eggs garnish with paprika.

title: Quick Caramel Coffee Ring
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In small saucepan melt margarine. Coat bottom and sides of ungreased 12-cup fluted tube pan with 2 tablespoons of the melted margarine. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of the nuts over bottom of prepared pan. Add remaining nuts brown sugar and\twater to remaining margarine. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Separate dough into 20 biscuits; cut each biscuit in half and shape into a ball. Place 20 balls in bottom of prepared pan. Drizzle half of the caramel sauce over balls. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Invert immediately onto waxed paper and\tremove from pan. This nutty treat serves 10.

title: 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Place the items in layers starting with the spinach and ending with the frozen peas. Frost with the Miracle Whip and mayonnaise. Cover with the grated Swiss cheese.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients into paste and press into bottom of an 11 x 14-inch baking dish.

title: Taco Pie
