instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 400\u00b0. Thaw pie shell 10 minutes. Prick bottom and sides with fork. Bake pie shell on preheated sheet for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. In large skillet brown ground meat and onions; drain fat. Add taco seasoning mix.

title: Cranberry Sauce
instructions: Cook cranberries in water until they pop. Add sugar and cherry Jell-O. Stir well; cool. Add celery and nuts.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Serve.

title: Garlic Grits
instructions: Combine water grits and salt. Cook until grits are done. Add margarine and stir until melted. Add garlic cheese and stir until melted. Beat 2 eggs in a 1-cup measuring cup and add milk to fill that cup. Add to the grits mixture. Pour into a buttered casserole and cover with crumbled cornflakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Should serve 12.

title: Pasta With Seafood In Herb-Butter Sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan melt butter or margarine. Stir in parsley onion garlic salt and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. Add seafood to heat through. Toss with hot pasta. Serve immediately. Can also be made without seafood for a meatless meal. Serves 4.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix sauerkraut bell pepper pimento celery and onion. Bring sugar and cider vinegar to a boil and boil until clear. Pour over sauerkraut mixture. Chill overnight. Serve cold.

title: Mrs. Griffin Molasses Cake
instructions: Mix flour salt soda baking powder and spices. Cut in shortening until mixture looks like coarse meal. Add eggs. Mix boiling water and molasses together. Add to dry ingredients. Bake in 8-inch greased square pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Chicken 'N Biscuits Casserole
instructions: Cook together first 4 ingredients about 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan and boil for 3 minutes. Cool. Add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Combine biscuit mix and sugar in a large bowl. Blend well. Add milk and eggs mixing well. If mixing by hand about 50 to 60 strokes ought to do it! Pour batter into prepared pan. Pour melted butter evenly over surface. Spoon pie filling over top and sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes. Yields 12 servings.

title: Cool Whip Pineapple Dessert(Low Fat)
instructions: Just mix all of this up together in a bowl and keep refrigerated. Its very simple easy and good. If you want the fat use regular pudding and Cool whip.

title: Green Tomato Pickles
instructions: Wash and prepare vegetables. Combine vinegar sugar salt mustard seed and celery seed; bring to boil. Add vegetables and simmer for 10 minutes. Continue simmering while quickly packing in hot sterilized jars. Fill to 1/8-inch top. Seal immediately.

title: Avocado Guacamole Dip
instructions: Clean and finely dice green onions. Peel and finely dice tomatoes. Then peel and finely mash avocados. Squeeze juice from lemon over mashed avocados; mix well. (Lemon retards discoloration.) Add avocados to onion tomato mixture. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Fat-Free Broccoli Dip
instructions: In bowl beat softened cream cheese mustard and milk until well blended. Stir in thawed broccoli peppers and scallions. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and chill. Serve with rice cakes crackers breadsticks or vegetables.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Spread rice in 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle dry onion soup mix over. Mix together soups and water. Arrange raw chicken on top of soups and water mixture. Bake about 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: M & M Cookies
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients well. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. After 8 minutes pat down with a spatula.

title: Six Week Bran Muffins
instructions: Pour boiling water over cereal. Let stand. Mix with sugar eggs and oil. Add alternately the buttermilk and dry ingredients. Add raisins. Store in refrigerator and spoon into muffin pan as you want them. Keeps for 6 weeks. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Banana Pudding (From Scratch)
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt in top of double boiler. Mix in 1 whole egg and 3 egg yolks. Stir in milk. Cook uncovered over boiling water stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Spread small amount on bottom of 1-1/2 qt. casserole; cover with layer of Nilla Wafers. Top with layer of sliced bananas. Pour 1/3 of custard over bananas. Continue to layer wafers bananas and custard to make 3 layers of each ending with custard. Beat remaining 3 egg whites until stiff but not dry; gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar and beat until mixture forms stiff peaks. Pile on top of pudding covering entire surface. Bake in preheated hot oven (425\u00b0) 5 minutes or until delicately browned. Serve warm or chilled. Yield 8 servings of 3/4 cup.

title: Cheese Stuffed Pasta Shells
instructions: Brown meat in a 2-quart casserole. Drain off fat. Stir in sauce. Cover with Saran Wrap and microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes. Combine Ricotta and Parmesan cheeses eggs and 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella. Stuff manicotti with cheese filling. In a 13 x 2-inch baking dish (sprayed with Pam) arrange manicotti in single layer. Add meat sauce to completely cover. Sprinkle remaining Mozzarella on top. Cover dish with Saran Wrap and cook on Medium-high for 30 to 35 minutes rotating dish 1/2 turn during cooking. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 7 servings. Can bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Red And Green Layered Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 13 pan dissolve jello in water. Add cranberry sauce. Sprinkle with nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Flatten chicken between 2 pieces of wax paper. Dredge in flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Pour clarified butter into frying pan and lightly brown chicken. Add chicken stock lemon juice and parsley. Bring to a boil and cook for 8 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: St. Mary'S County Stuffed Ham
instructions: Fill a 40-quart pot 2/3 full of water; put rack in bottom. Bring to a boil. Meantime chop cabbage kale onions and celery. Place chopped ingredients in cheesecloth and immerse in boiling water for 7 minutes. Add all the spices in a quart jar; cover and shake well. After 7 minutes remove chopped greens from water; dump in shallow pan and let cool.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Add tomato paste onion and seasonings to meat. Cook over low heat 5 minutes stirring frequently. Place biscuits in greased muffin cups pressing to cover bottom and sides. Spoon about 1/4 cup of meat mix into each muffin cup and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and mix well. Sift flour and salt. Mix coloring and cocoa; add vinegar and mix well. Add flour mixture slowly alternating with buttermilk mixture. Add vanilla and beat until well blended. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour into 3 layer pans. Bake for 35 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Hot Appetizers
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or larger. Beat eggs slightly with flour salt and baking powder. Add cottage cheese and melted butter and blend together. Pour into melted butter pan.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Soften cheese in microwave. Add butter and salsa a little at a time. Cook for 1 minute in microwave on Medium-high. Stir. Cook for 4 or 5 minutes stirring every minute. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Brown ham and onion together; add peas Bloody Mary mix water and rice. Let cook 20 minutes. If too thick add more water. Add shrimp for last 5 to 10 minutes of cooking. Serve with rolls or cornbread.

title: Nona Pineapple Treat
instructions: Combine flour butter and cream cheese. Mix with mixer. Roll into walnut size balls and put into refrigerator overnight or half a day. Roll out and press with bottom of teacup. Put 1/2 teaspoon of pineapple preserves on each circle and roll up to a point in the middle or make a square. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 on a greased baking sheet. Keep cold until used.

title: Venison Chili
instructions: Fry beef fat in heavy skillet; add meat and brown. Add seasonings. Add enough water to cover meat. Cook slowly 4 to 5 hours stirring occasionally. Add remaining water as needed. Serve with pinto beans. Serves 8.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Follow Solomons advice and you will have a good cake.

title: Ribbon Jello Salad(Very Festive)
instructions: Pour into dish and refrigerate until firm about 1/2 hour. It must be firm. Then add 1 1/3 cups white sauce on top of lime Jell-O and put in refrigerator to set. Do the same with orange lemon and cherry Jell-O alternating with white sauce each layer. Be sure Jell-O is set between each layer. This does take some time to make but its a great dessert. Its always been a hit any time Ive taken it to an event. Use your imagination. I have made it red and white only in layers. Or use just your favorite flavors of Jell-O. Have fun!

title: Baked Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Melt margarine in medium saucepan. Add onion and celery and cook over low heat until tender. Add water or stock and bring to boil. Remove from heat; add stuffing mix all at once tossing lightly until moist.

title: Judy And Myrna'S Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Add meat and brown it. Add flour salt pepper garlic powder and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup; simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream and heat. Serve with rice noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Hard Rock Christmas Candy
instructions: Mix together syrup water sugar and salt. Bring to a boil and boil to hard-crack stage (300\u00b0 on a candy thermometer). Add food coloring and flavoring. Pour onto a cookie sheet that has been packed well with powdered sugar. This takes 1/2 box of sugar (press down well and make sure to cover any holes so that hot syrup wont drip through). Allow mixture to cool. Pick up candy and turn it over. Cool candy until it can be broken into small pieces. Makes 2 to 3 cups of broken candy or about 36 pieces. (This is not to be made by children unless there is adult supervision.)

title: Finger Salad
instructions: Mix. Bake in 200 degree oven 1-1/2 hours. Stir every 15 minutes. Spread on newspapers or paper towels to cool (and to wick off any excess oil).

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Combine lemonade milk and coloring. Stir well. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into crust and freeze until firm (about 4 hours or overnight). Garnish with lemon slices and whipped topping as desired. (Remove frozen pie from freezer about 15 minutes before serving to thaw slightly.) Serves 6 to 8.

title: Decorator Frosting
instructions: Mix all together. Beat well. Great for decorating cookies. Cakes too! Keeps well in refrigerator for 3 or 4 days.

title: Beef Stew(Servings: 4.  Preparation Time:  3 Hours.)
instructions: Season flour with salt and pepper to taste. Dredge meat in flour. In a large soup kettle brown meat in hot olive oil. Add sugar celery parsley garlic bay leaf tomatoes bouillon and tomato paste. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer one hour. Taste and season with additional salt and pepper or herbs of your choice if desired. Add carrots and potatoes and continue to simmer until vegetables are tender. Add onions and simmer until onions are tender.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mash potatoes; add other ingredients. Beat with mixer. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
instructions: Blend cheese with butter; stir in flour salt and paprika. Mix well. Wrap olive completely in a pinch of dough. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet. Can be frozen then baked. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken onion and salt. Refrigerate 12 hours. Add rest of ingredients except whipped cream mix and put in refrigerator for 2 hours. Add whipped cream last just before serving.

title: Easy Beef Stew
instructions: Note Do not use cream of onion soup.

title: Cranberry Bog
instructions: Pour boiling water over tea bags in saucepan. Steep 5 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add cranberry juice orange juice and sugar to tea. Stir and heat to serving temperature. Pour into mugs. Garnish with a half slice of orange.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: In large bowl combine soup mayonnaise and lemon juice. Add chicken onion peppers 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese and 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese. Mix well. Add noodles and toss to coat. Transfer to greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheeses. Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted and veggies are tender. Serves 6.

title: Great Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Cut or mash artichokes. Mix cheese and mayonnaise. Add artichokes. Place in baking dish and cook at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle paprika on top. May also be used as a dip by adding a little extra mayonnaise and blending the artichoke slightly.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix margarine with Ritz crackers and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients well and top with the cracker mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Shake 'N Bake
instructions: For raw meat put 8 teaspoons salt in.

title: Waffles And Nuts
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar. Add oil and eggs and mix until smooth and well mixed. Preheat waffle irons. Fill each section of waffle iron with mixture until brown and crisp approximately 6 or 7 minutes. Serve with margarine syrup or jelly. Makes 3 full size waffles.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix potatoes sugar and spice. Add melted margarine eggs and milk (add slowly until creamy). Add vanilla last. Pour into shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Torte
instructions: Crush pretzels fine. Mix with melted butter and 3 tablespoons sugar. Pat in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Line an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan with foil extending foil over edges of pan. Butter the foil; set pan aside.

title: Garden Vegetable Soup
instructions: Heat butter and oil in Dutch oven; saute carrots celery onion and garlic for 5 minutes. Peel tomatoes; cut in half crosswise. Place strainer over large bowl; remove seeds by squeezing gently. Chop pulp and add to join in large bowl. Add tomatoes and juice to Dutch oven. Add oregano basil salt and pepper; cook 15 minutes. Add beef broth and green beans; cook 30 minutes longer adding zucchini and parsley after 20 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Drain and set aside. Beat eggs. Stir in remaining ingredients except the broccoli and butter. Melt butter over broccoli and mix with remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12.

title: Bologna Bundles
instructions: Place equal amount of soup on each slice bologna. Fold over fasten with toothpicks. Arrange in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over all and lay bacon strips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Stew
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in slow cooker for 2 to 4 hours (or all day). Remove bay leaf before serving.

title: Sausage Ring
instructions: Thaw bread (not to rise). Cook sausage; drain. While hot add 1 egg cheese and seasoning. Mix and set aside. Roll dough into 6 x 18-inch (pull to size). Put meat filling in center; bring sides up and pinch on top. Form a ring; slice every 2 to 3 inches on top (not all the way through). Beat other egg and spread on top; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover and let rise for 45 minutes. Then bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Sandies Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; roll into logs and chill overnight. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Slice off 1/4-inch slices and bake until light brown. Makes about 10 dozen.

title: Coke Roast
instructions: Score roast in several places. Fill each slit with salt pepper and garlic salt. Sear roast on all sides in oil. Remove. Drain or blot fat from roast.

title: Beef Burritos
instructions: Crumble hamburger into skillet. Add onion. Season with salt garlic powder and pepper. Pour off fat and add chilli salsa. Place a large spoonful in the center of each tortilla. Sprinkle generously with cheese. Fold sides over and fold up ends. Place on a cookie sheet folded sides down. Cover with aluminum foil and heat in 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Serve alone or smothered in green chilli salsa.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for 1/2 stick butter and corn flakes. Mix 1/2 stick melted butter and crushed corn flakes; spread on top of mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corned Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese Miracle Whip and corned beef together. Combine vodka or gin and soup mix; let onion soup absorb the liquid. Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate mixture 1/2 hour then form into ball. Roll in crushed nuts.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Mix together. Will keep for up to 1 month in refrigerator.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Again stir us Lord!

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Dissolve the Jell-O in the consomme. After Jell-O is dissolved let cool. Add corned beef onion green pepper celery and mayonnaise. Press into loaf pan. Top with hard-boiled eggs.

title: Turner Farm Hickory Nut Pie
instructions: Slightly beat the eggs with a fork. Add the syrup sugar vanilla and salt and beat again. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell then sprinkle the nuts on the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes and then at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate Crisco and margarine; set aside to cool. Beat eggs with rotary beater and sugar; mix well. Add chocolate mixture to eggs and sugar. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add to egg and chocolate mixture; mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool before cutting into squares.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet. Add rice. Simmer until golden brown. Add onions and soup. Pour mixture into covered casserole dish. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour or until the rice has absorbed all the consomme.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients; bring to a slow boil then cook on medium for 1 1/2 hours or until thick. Delicious over steak hamburger pork chops even scrambled eggs or fried potatoes.

title: Strawberry Freezer Jam
instructions: Prepare fruit by thoroughly crushing one layer at a time. Measure 2 cups into large bowl or pan. Mix sugar into fruit; let stand 10 minutes. Mix water and fruit pectin in small saucepan. Bring to a full boil; boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Stir into fruit. Stir 3 minutes. Ladle quickly into scalded containers filling to within 1/2 inch of tops. Cover; let stand at room temperature for 24 hours then store in freezer. Small amounts may be stored in refrigerator for up to 3 weeks. Makes 4 3/4 cups.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Remove tops and seeds from peppers. Add to large pot of boiling water. Cook 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and place in casserole dish. Brown beef onion salt and pepper. Drain. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes and tomato paste. Stir well. Simmer 5 minutes. Add shredded cheese. Allow to melt. Stir in rice. Then stuff peppers. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (I always put more cheese on top during the last 5 minutes of baking time.)

title: Energy Treats
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients; add drops of water if needed. Form into 15 balls then roll in pretzels. Refrigerate.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Chop cabbage and add chunked pineapple and unpeeled diced apple. Toss in 2 handfuls of marshmallows. Dissolve sugar in mayonnaise and coat cabbage mixture.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Butter casserole dish. Sprinkle part of Pepperidge Farm dressing mix to line bottom of dish. Add all ingredients and mix and put into casserole. Cover with remaining dressing. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Lucky Charms Microwave Snacks
instructions: Grease square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Place butter and marshmallows in large microwavable bowl. Microwave on High 1 minute and 30 seconds to 3 minutes stirring after 1 minute until mixture is melted and smooth when stirred. Stir in cereal until well coated. Press mixture in pan; cool and cut into about 2 x 2-inch bars. Makes 16 bars.

title: Hearty Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Peel potatoes; boil until tender. Cut in 1/2 to 1-inch chunks. Spread evenly into baking dish. Combine onions soup parsley mayonnaise and sour cream; pour over potatoes. Sprinkle bacon on top; garnish with paprika. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lynda Fisher'S Black Russian Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and beat 4 minutes. Bake in a greased and floured Bundt or tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Pork Loin
instructions: Place sliced pork loin in bottom of crock pot.\tAdd spices onions and apple juice. Cook on low all day.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Thaw vegetables completely or blanch in boiling water; drain and cool. Mix the vegetables of your choice with soup mayonnaise eggs onion and grated cheese. Bake in casserole dish for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix together and keep warm (not boiling) to baste chicken. Serves 12.

title: Pork And Sauerkraut
instructions: Bring sauerkraut and seasonings to a boil. Add pork chops or spareribs. Peel and cut into chunks the potatoes. Add to pot. Cover and simmer 1/2 hour or until pork and potatoes are tender.

title: Esther'S Sugared Doughnuts
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk. Add 1 1/2 cups flour and beat until smooth. Cover. Let rise in warm place until double in bulk (about 2 hours).

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Layer chicken in bottom of casserole dish or cake pan. Crush half of the chips and put on top of the chicken. Add desired amount of cheese. Mix with a mixer the soups and Ro-Tel. Pour over chicken chips and cheese. Make another layer of chips and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and is heated thoroughly. Very good.

title: Cherry Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and eggs. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread pie filling over cake mixture. Mix brown sugar butter cinnamon and nuts. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Elaine'S Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
instructions: Blend chicken celery almonds green pepper pimento onion salt lemon juice and mayonnaise. Turn into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with grated cheese and crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pumpkin Nut Roll
instructions: Beat eggs with mixer for 3 minutes. Add sugar and lemon juice. Fold in pumpkin. Add together the flour cinnamon nutmeg salt and baking powder. Fold flour mixture into pumpkin. Line jelly roll pan with wax paper sprayed with Pam. Pour mixture over wax paper. Spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts over batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Aunt Lyd'S Punch
instructions: Mix gelatin completely in hot water. Add cold water and fruit juices. Stir in sugar; chill. When ready to serve puree bananas in blender. Mix fruit juice with ginger ale and pureed bananas. Garnish with fruit slices or ice ring made of strawberries frozen in lemonade.

title: Macaroni-Hamburger Casserole(For Electric Skillet)
instructions: In medium bowl cut tomatoes into small pieces; add diced celery pepper and all seasonings. Set aside. Preheat frypan to 300\u00b0; add vegetable oil and onion; cook until just beginning to brown. Add meat. Turn dial to 400\u00b0 stirring frequently until browned. Remove excess fat then add tomato mixture. Stir; bring to boil. Cover; close vent and reduce heat to medium simmer. Cook for at least 25 minutes. Add cooked macaroni. Simmer 15 minutes longer stirring occasionally.

title: Buffalo Chips
instructions: Cream butter or oleo and sugars. Add eggs flour baking powder vanilla and soda. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all ingredients well. Chill. Drop from a tablespoon on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Line cookie sheet with foil. Spread crackers on top of foil as close together as possible. Boil margarine and brown sugar for 3 minutes. Spoon this mixture over crackers. Put cookie sheet in 400\u00b0 oven for 6 to 7 minutes. Remove and pour melted Hershey bars over top. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Chill dough; roll into balls (size of a walnut). Roll balls in mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned but still soft at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Salmon Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill. Shape into 1 or 2 balls. Spread on crackers.

title: Zucchini Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large pot and simmer for at least 3 hours to allow flavors to mingle. This is a great stew to make anytime of the year. In the summer you can use fresh veggies and in the winter you can use frozen canned or dried veggies. Also you can add corn green beans peas etc. to please your familys taste buds.

title: *Quince Preserves(Liko)
instructions: Wash eggs and have at room temperature. Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla and mix thoroughly. Add flour and stir until mixed well. Put in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan square or round greased. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Brownies will be chewy and moist.

title: Marinated Cauliflower
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and marinate cauliflower.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Form cream cheese into heat-safe pan. Dump chili on top. Sprinkle Cheddar on top. Put in 350\u00b0 oven until melted and bubbly. Serve hot with chips.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all three ingredients together well. Form into small balls and bake at 375\u00b0 until slightly brown.

title: Fancy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit well with the exception of the frozen strawberries. Leave partially frozen and drain 1/2 of juice off the berries. Add all fruits then add pie filling to hold salad together. You may use any type fresh fruits as a substitute.

title: Apricot Candy
instructions: Put apricots and coconut through a food chopper twice. Add juice and turn onto board sprinkled with sugar. Knead until smooth. Pack in pan. Let harden and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: *I put mine in food processor.

title: Nacho Chili Dip
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. In 8-inch round glass baking dish spread soft cream cheese evenly along bottom. Evenly layer chili on top. Next top with shredded cheese. Bake for about 15 minutes or until chili is bubbling. Once out of the oven sprinkle tomatoes and spring onions on top.

title: Mom'S French Chef Meat Loaf
instructions: Fry out the salt pork. Add onion and cook until golden brown. Add pork and onion to other ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Bake in loaf pan in hot oven (450\u00b0) for 15 minutes then decrease heat to moderate (350\u00b0) and bake for 30 minutes longer or until done. Or microwave on High for 20- to 25 minutes or until done. Serve hot or cold. This is a very good juicy meat loaf not dry.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill at least 4 hours. Serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding and milk well. Add sour cream and Cool Whip; beat well. Layer wafers in bottom of pan. Slice bananas on top of wafers. Layer pudding (1/2 of it). Repeat wafers bananas and pudding until all gone. Refrigerate.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown chops. Add the tomato soup and 1 can of water. Put sliced potatoes and onions on top. Simmer until potatoes are tender.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix cooking apples raisins nuts and sugar; let stand 1 hour. Stir often. Mix together flour nutmeg cinnamon salt and soda. After one hour mix and beat well cooking oil vanilla and 2 eggs. Add this to apple mixture then add sifted ingredients to apple mixture. Beat by hand until well moistened. Grease and flour 3 loaf pans. Fill about half full or divide mixture evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour 15 minutes. Test with toothpick.

title: Mexican Pepper Bread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except cheese. Grease iron skillet. Pour half the mixture into skillet. Sprinkle cheese over mixture then pour the remaining half over cheese. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Pour into a 2 1/2 or 3-quart casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes uncovered. To freeze do not cook first.

title: Slow Cooker Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a slow cooker combine first 10 ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours. Add vegetables. Cover and cook on high 2 more hours or until the meat and vegetables are tender.

title: Mom'S Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cream together shortening sugar vanilla and egg yolks. Add milk alternately with dry ingredients. Add black walnuts which have been floured with a little of the flour. Beat egg whites stiff and fold into mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or a little longer. Ice with butter icing and decorate with walnuts.

title: Tiny Apple Cheesecakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Place paper liners in eight (1/3-cup) muffin cups. Place a cookie in bottom of each; set aside. In a small skillet melt butter. Add apples; cook and stir until tender about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon; spoon over cookies. With an electric mixer beat cream cheese egg sour cream vanilla and remaining 5 tablespoons sugar until smooth. Spoon over apples. Bake until set 25 to 28 minutes. Cool on a rack; remove cakes. Cover and refrigerate until cold about 2 hours. Garnish with sour cream apple slices and crushed vanilla wafers.

title: Spanish Style Carrots And Celery
instructions: Brown onion and green pepper in oil. Add carrots celery and seasonings. Cover with tomato sauce and water. Cover. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Prepare chicken breasts. Cook until tender and done. Cut into bite-size pieces. Mix together soup nuts salt pepper lemon juice mayonnaise and onion. Mix chicken and celery. Place each mixture in layers in a casserole. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 until baked through. If desired cheese can be sprinkled on top. Casserole may be prepared day before.

title: Parmesan Baked Cod
instructions: Combine flour corn meal and seasonings. Melt margarine in shallow baking dish.

title: Easy Floated Bread Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar salt vanilla and eggs to the milk. Butter slices of bread and arrange in 1 1/2-quart baking dish buttered side down with raisins between slices. Pour liquid mixture over them and let stand for 1 hour. Dot top with butter; bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve while hot with hard sauce or cream or plain.

title: Cheesy Baked Chicken
instructions: Roll chicken pieces in melted butter then in mixture of remaining ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat with mixer. Stir cookie crumbs in and blend well. Fold coconut and pecans in. Place in a greased cake (tube) pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Italian Beef Roast For Hot Sandwiches Ala Chicago
instructions: Rub Adolphs meat tenderizer into roast. Moisten with water. Pierce all over with thin metal skewers so tenderizer goes into roast. Rub a bit of Kitchen Bouquet over roast.

title: Memorable Macaroni Salad
instructions: In a large bowl stir first 6 ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Toss to coat well. Cover and chill. Makes 5 cups.

title: Apple Betty
instructions: Mound apples in buttered 9-inch plate. Sprinkle with orange juice.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix like biscuits. Roll out on a board. Grease pan well. Let rise 1 hour and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Easter Eggs
instructions: Cream together oleo and 1/2 pound of 4xx sugar. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese together. Grease iron skillet and pour in half mixture. Sprinkle half of shredded cheese. Pour remaining mixture in; top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cinnamon Bread
instructions: Combine milk oats sugar salt and oil in large bowl. Cool to lukewarm. Soften yeast in warm water. Add to oatmeal mix. Add 2 cups flour beating well. (Best to use bread attachments on mixer.) Add remaining flour to make a stiff dough. Either use kneading forks on mixer or turn out on floured surface and knead until smooth. Put in greased bowl; cover and let rise in warm place until doubled in size (about 1 1/2 hours). Punch down and turn out on floured surface. Divide dough in half. Round out each half to 15 x 9-inch rectangle. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon mixture over dough. Sprinkle with raisins and nuts. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Place in 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans (Corning or heavy best). Let rise in warm place until dough fills pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl beat sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and egg; blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. Stir in flour; mix well. Stir in potato chips. Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are light golden brown. Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets. Cool completely; sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Makes 30 cookies.

title: Mandarin Orange Gelatin Ice Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add frozen orange juice; stir until melted. Add ice cream oranges and crushed pineapple; stir well but do not use beater. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate and chill overnight to set. Serves 24.

title: Chile Corn Bread
instructions: Put first 7 ingredients together in large bowl beat about 1 minute until well blended. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Place half of mix in pan spreading evenly. Sprinkle chopped chiles over batter. Sprinkle all of cheese over chiles. Spread rest of batter on top of cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put rice in baking pan. Sprinkle with onion soup mix. Add water. Place chicken in single layer on rice. Spoon soup over chicken. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. (Add water if necessary at end.)

title: Bruchetta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place bread slices on an ungreased cookie sheet. Drizzle each slice with olive oil. Bake approximately 8 minutes or until the bread is toasted golden brown. Remove and cool slices.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix together sugar oil and eggs. Sift together the flour baking powder baking soda salt and cinnamon. Combine with egg mixture. Add carrots pineapple raisins and nuts. Blend. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Saute beef rice and onion in oil for 5 minutes. Season with salt pepper broth and 1/4 cup Ragu sauce. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Cobbler
instructions: Boil potatoes in water until tender. Add salt vanilla sugars and butter. Place in casserole dish and top with pie crust strips (homemade or store bought) in lattice design. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and butter; add eggs one at a time flour whipping cream and extracts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in a tube pan.

title: Portuguese Kale Soup
instructions: Note I use a 5-gallon soup pot because you can freeze this soup. Its okay to cut this recipe in half.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Note Bake crabmeat on cookie sheet for 5 minutes at 350\u00b0. Any shells will easily be seen and can be removed.

title: Apricot Pork
instructions: Stuff pork loin with your favorite dressing. Roast uncovered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Spoon sauce over roast to glaze the last 1/2 hour. Pass remaining sauce when serving.

title: Cherry Coconut Squares
instructions: Cream butter and 1/4 cup sugar until light; stir in 1/2 cup flour. Put into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Meanwhile mix remaining 1/2 cup sugar 2 tablespoons flour salt vanilla eggs nuts and coconut. Spread evenly over baked dough. Bake 25 minutes. Cut while warm.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Combine gelatin and boiling water; cool. Add milk and mayonnaise; blend both mixtures with mixer. Add cottage cheese pineapple and horseradish. Mold and chill for several hours. This is a very delicious tangy congealed. (Do not leave out horseradish.)

title: Swedish Rye Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. To the scalded milk add sugars shortening salt molasses orange peel and orange juice. Cool to lukewarm.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: In large container mix pineapple juice orange juice and lemon juice. In a saucepan mix sugar and water. Boil for 3 minutes or until sugar is well dissolved. Let cool. Add mashed bananas and sugar water to fruit juice mixture. Freeze.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Chop the onion and saute in the oleo. When nearly clear add the small can of mushrooms and heat thoroughly. Add the can of roast beef and stir to separate the pieces of beef. Add the sour cream and heat thoroughly. Serve over rice or noodles. Add a tossed salad and rolls for a complete meal. This recipe will serve 2 people.

title: Cheese, Basil And Tomato Casserole
instructions: Scatter croutons over bottom of a 9-inch glass pie plate. Overlap alternate slices of tomato and Mozzarella cheese on top in a circular pattern to cover. Sprinkle with basil chives and pepper. Microwave uncovered on High 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes until cheese is melted. Remove from oven spoon dressing on top. Let stand 5 minutes for flavors to develop. Makes 6 servings 171 calories per serving.

title: French Meat Pie
instructions: In a skillet heat oil over medium heat. Saute onion until tender. Remove and set aside. Brown beef and pork together. Drain. Combine meat onion potatoes and seasoning. Fill pastry with mixture and top with crust. Brush top of crust with egg if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Apple Gift Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening until very light. Add beaten egg. Measure mix and sift dry ingredients. Add to mixture and stir in apples. Drop in balls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Ono Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Salt and pepper chicken. Roll pieces in mayonnaise then roll each piece in the crushed cornflakes. Bake for one hour in 325\u00b0 oven or until done.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together. Add milk and cook over low heat about 1 minute stirring well to dissolve sugar. Add oleo; keep beating to melt. Do not overbeat. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter vanilla and oats. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper to harden.

title: Curry Dip
instructions: Blend together and allow to sit for at least 2 hours (best overnight). Will keep for weeks in a closed container in the refrigerator. Serve with carrot strips. Other veggies are good also but it is best with carrots.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini(Cooking Light)
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add mushrooms and onion and saute 7 minutes or until liquid evaporates. Stir in all-purpose flour. Gradually add chicken broth skim milk and light process cheese. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in 2 tablespoons Parmesan and next 5 ingredients. Set aside.

title: Apricot Syrup
instructions: In blender or food processor puree apricots and juice until smooth. Combine apricots syrup and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly; boil gently still stirring for 5 to 7 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 2 cups.

title: Holiday Kiwi Fruit Salad
instructions: Dip pear and apple in lemon juice to prevent darkening. Reserve 3 tablespoons of cranberry sauce. Slice remainder in quarter slices. Arrange kiwi fruit cranberry slices pear and apple on lettuce.

title: Grandma Mcmahon'S Chocolate Cake And Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar and eggs. Add buttermilk and flour mixture alternately ending with buttermilk. Melt together butter and chocolate. Add to mixture. Beat well. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt butter. Add onions to soften. Add rest of ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (iron skillet is best). Yummy with beans.

title: California Tamale Pie
instructions: In a medium skillet brown ground beef until crumbly. Drain fat. In medium bowl combine milk 1 cup of cornmeal and eggs; blend well. Add ground beef and remaining ingredients except cheese and 2 tablespoons of cornmeal. Stir to blend. Pour into lightly-greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and 2 tablespoons of cornmeal. Continue baking until cheese melts and cornmeal browns. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted water until tender. Cool a little; peel and slice. Add onion. In large skillet cook bacon and dice; set aside. Pour off bacon grease. Return 1/2 cup grease to skillet. Add sugar oleo salt pepper vinegar and 1 cup water. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add sour cream. Pour over potato and onion mixture. Add half of the diced bacon and chopped parsley. Toss well. Add rest of bacon. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve hot or cold. (Better on second day.) Makes 10 servings.

title: Stuffed Celery
instructions: Combine all ingredients except celery. Chill for 1 hour to blend flavors. Spread on celery.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut butter into cake mix dry until crumbly. Mix in coconut. Pat mixture lightly into ungreased oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches building up slight edges. Bake 10 minutes. Arrange apple slices on warm crust. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle on apples. Blend sour cream and egg yolk. Drizzle over apples. Topping will not completely cover apples. Bake 25 minutes or until edges are light brown. Do not overbake. Serve warm. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Homemade Tortilla Chips
instructions: Cut stack of tortillas into 8 wedges each. Spread wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with cumin and salt. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes or until dry and crisp. Monitor your chips as to not overbrown. Store in an airtight container. Serve with salsa.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine 2 tablespoons melted butter and cinnamon. Mix well. Spread into 8-inch square baking dish. Top with pineapple rings. Place cherries in centers on rings. Beat eggs in medium bowl. Blend in remaining butter. Add fruit and buttermilk. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Gradually add buttermilk to mixture beating until blended. Spread batter over fruit. Bake 30 minutes. Cool on rack and then serve.

title: Venison Swiss Steak
instructions: Rub meat with salt and pepper.\tPound all flour possible into steak. Sear in hot oil. Add water tomato juice and onion. Simmer slowly until done adding more tomato juice as needed to keep meat covered.\tServe with wild rice.

title: Tangy Pork Chops
instructions: In shallow dish combine flour salt and pepper. In second shallow dish combine egg and lemon juice; beat until foamy. In third shallow dish place crushed Rice Krispies. Melt butter or margarine in skillet. Coat chops by dipping in flour mixture egg/lemon juice mix then crushed Rice Krispies. Over medium heat brown both sides of chops. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes turning occasionally.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. One-third cup mix per cup of hot water. Preparation Time 15 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Spice Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine sugar oil and eggs. Add pumpkin and mix well. Combine dry ingredients; add to the pumpkin mixture alternately with water. Pour into two greased 9-in. 5-in.x3-in. loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60-70 minutes or until bread tests done. Cool in pans 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack; cool completely. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Sour Cream Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease one 8-inch loaf pan. Beat shortening and sugar until smooth and creamy. Add salt eggs bananas sour cream and baking soda. Lastly add the flour. Turn batter into pan. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from pan and cool on rack for 1 hour before serving. Stores well in freezer.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Add milk to pudding gradually. There is no need to cook this. Just proceed as you usually do to freeze the ice cream in your ice cream freezer. You may add flavoring or different flavored pudding for variation.

title: Rice And Shrimp
instructions: Following directions on package cook rice in medium saucepan. In large skillet melt butter. Add shrimp diced onion and mushrooms. Season with garlic. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Add prepared rice and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Meat Cups
instructions: Roll out biscuits to 3 1/2 to 4-inches in diameter. Bake over backs of large muffin cups 8 to 9 minutes. Brown meat and drain. Stir in beans sauce and water. Heat to boil. Remove tart cups and fill with meat/bean mixture. Top with lettuce tomato and cheese.

title: Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Marinate tomatoes broccoli olives and mushrooms in Italian dressing for 3 hours. Cook pasta according to package directions. Add cooled pasta to vegetables. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bacon bits.

title: Fantastic
instructions: This is 4 layers in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix first 3 ingredients and spread in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool. Mix next 3 ingredients and spread over bottom. Mix next 3 ingredients and spread over bottom. Mix next 2 ingredients and spread over second layer. Spread the last of the Cool Whip over the pudding. Chill overnight. You can add chopped nuts and a cherry on the top of the Cool Whip.

title: Blueberry Cup Cakes
instructions: Mix together egg sugar sour cream and oil then add flour and baking soda. Stir well and add blueberries. Bake in cup cake papers or greased muffin tin in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. These blueberries will never fall to bottom.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Cook onions and celery in oleo. Add green onions and parsley and cook 15 more minutes. Add seasoning and tails. Cook 8 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Salsa
instructions: Chop onions Jalapenos and tomatoes. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a blender set on puree until semi chunky. Salsa should be a liquid chunky mixture. Eat with any type of chips.

title: Banana Boats
instructions: Make a lengthwise cut about 1/2-inch deep down the top of each unpeeled banana. Brush each banana with lemon juice. Divide chocolate pieces and marshmallows evenly among bananas and fill the split in each banana. Place in individual bowls. Microwave on High for about 3 minutes or until chocolate melts.

title: Fresh Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries in water until they pop. Add sugar and jello. Stir and cook few more minutes. Add pineapple and nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken and pour off stock (about 4 cups). Add onion bay leaves and flat noodles to stock; boil 7 minutes. Add white raisins and slivered almonds. Bone chicken and add. Mix lightly; add salt and pepper. Put in a greased baking dish; store in refrigerator overnight (if too dry add broth). When ready to bake spread cream of mushroom soup over mixture. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs and add pats of butter. Bake uncovered about 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 16 to 20 people.

title: Spinach-Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook macaroni shells according to package directions; drain and set aside.

title: Mock Oyster Dip
instructions: Cook broccoli in water (overdone). Saute onion in butter; add cream of mushroom soup mushrooms and juice. Break up garlic cheese and add to mixture. Add hot sauce and broccoli. Mix well. Keep warm in chafing dish; eat with dipper potato chips. Can also be used in patty shells or over noodles as a casserole.

title: Marshmallow Cups
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler. With a brush coat paper cups with chocolate. Chill until firm. Fill with marshmallow creme to 1/8 inch of top. Cover top with melted chocolate. Chill again. Place in airtight container to store.

title: Green Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter. Add remaining ingredients and bake in greased casserole at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Beef And Bean Tostada
instructions: Deep fry tortillas until golden brown. Cook hamburger meat until well cooked then pour onion. Stir until onion is cooked. Cook chorizo for 20 minutes then mix it with meat chorizo and beans. Spread the ingredients on the tostada. Garnish with tomatoes lettuce and onion and sour cream.

title: Toffee Bark
instructions: Chop chocolate into small pieces and melt carefully. Fold in nuts and toffee bits. Pour onto a lightly oiled cookie sheet. Let it cool and set up. Break into pieces. Store in a covered container in a cool place. Yields 1 1/2 pounds candy.

title: Lace Cookies
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients (oats sugar baking powder and salt). Set aside. Combine egg butter and vanilla. Add to dry mixture. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven let sit just a few minutes and then quickly remove from pan. A sharp spatula works best.

title: Grandma'S Pretty Stuff
instructions: Mix all ingredients well! Chill well and ready to serve.

title: Strawberry Shortcut Cake
instructions: Generously grease only bottom of pan. Sprinkle marshmallows evenly over bottom. Thoroughly combine thawed strawberries and syrup with Jell-O; set aside. In large mixer bowl combine remaining ingredients. Blend at low speed until moist; beat on medium 3 minutes. Pour batter evenly over marshmallows in pan. Spoon strawberry mixture over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Seve warm or cool with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: Cream the cream cheese with sugar and milk until smooth. Stir in Cool Whip. Fold in angel food cake pieces. Top with cherries. Refrigerate. Makes 20 to 24 servings.

title: Hot Pepper Cornbread
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix well. Pour into an 8 x 11-inch greased pan. Bake 30 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute onion in oil until soft. Add carrots potatoes and water. Bring to boil. Add Miso soy sauce vegetable bouillon and spices stirring occasionally while adding them. Turn down to medium heat; cover and let cool 40 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes about 6 cups of soup.

title: Low-Fat Lasagna(Microwave)
instructions: Brown ground beef drain and add spaghetti sauce water and salt. Spread 1/3 meat mixture in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex baking pan. Lay 1/2 noodles over sauce. Spread 1/2 cottage cheese over noodles. Sprinkle 1/3 Mozzarella over cottage cheese. Repeat. Then top with remaining meat mixture. Sprinkle Parmesan over top. Cover dish with plastic wrap. Cover opposite way (double wrap). Ideally let set for a few hours. Cook in microwave at Medium or slightly higher for 30 minutes. Turn if you dont have turntable every 10 minutes. Remove plastic wrap. Add last of Mozzarella. Cook on Medium heat for 2 more minutes. If you wish sprinkle with parsley. Slice and serve.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Boil water sugar orange juice and lemon juice. Add tea bags; steep for several minutes. Add pineapple juice. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Blueberry Torte
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs sugar (1/2 cup) and margarine until crumbly. Press mixture into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix remaining 1/2 cup sugar milk and cream cheese until smooth then fold in Cool Whip. Spread this mixture over crust. Spread blueberry filling. Chill thoroughly. Serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients; add egg and juice. Mix well. Add nuts and fruit cocktail. Pour into pan 13 x 9 1/2-inch. Top with brown sugar. Dot with oleo and sprinkle with coconut. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chili Party Wings
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a plastic bag. Shake wings in bag a few at a time until coated. Place skin-side up in a single layer in well-buttered shallow baking pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes; turn wings and bake until tender about 10 minutes more.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Mix dry ingredients. Make a well in the center and pour in all liquid ingredients one at a time. Mix well by hand. Pour into prepared pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done.

title: Lemon Chicken(Method:  Foil)
instructions: Arrange chicken on foil with fruit slices above and below. Wrap and place in coals. Turn after 10 minutes. Cook another 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Baked Carrots
instructions: Scrape or pare carrots and place in casserole. Cream butter sugar salt and cinnamon together; add water and blend well. Pour over carrots; cover and bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pineapple Orange Slush
instructions: Combine pineapple-orange juice and sherbet in blender. Add ice and blend until slushy. Makes 6 servings.

title: Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: Mix molasses brown sugar water and shortening. Mix in remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Roll dough 1/4-inch thick on floured board. Cut with floured cookie cutter. Place about 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Makes 2 1/2 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies. May be decorated.

title: Pineapple Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix pineapple sugar flour and cheese together and put in bottom of 1 to 1 1/2 quart dish. Layer crackers over top. Pour margarine over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Steak Sauce
instructions: Put chutney in blender and grind up all fruit. Put this and remainder in large bowl and mix. Save all bottles and put steak sauce back into these bottles.

title: Fat-Free Spice Cake
instructions: Spray 9-inch square baking pan with cooking spray. In large bowl combine flour cornstarch baking powder salt cinnamon ginger and nutmeg. In medium bowl using a fork or wire whisk stir sugar and milk until sugar is almost dissolved. Add egg whites corn syrup and vanilla; stir until blended. Gradually add to flour mixture; stir until smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool in pan on wire rack.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut up and cook first 3 ingredients until tender in little water. Drain well. Melt 2 sticks margarine; add to this stuffing mix. Toss until all of margarine is absorbed. Layer on bottom of casserole dish. Put squash over and top with small amount of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Squash And Onion Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in greased casserole dish. Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Note You will need a tube pan for baking this cake.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Cut bread into cubes (9 cubes per slice). Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream together until well blended. Spread mixture in a 9 x 13-inch container. Layer remaining ingredients in order given. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Use tortilla chips to eat with dip.

title: Pizza Dippers
instructions: Brown meat drain; combine dry ingredients cut in shortening as in pie crust then add meat and cold water. Shape into 1-inch balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve hot with sauce for dipping.

title: Pepperidge Farm Chicken
instructions: Crush stuffing mix until fine. Wash chicken and dip in margarine and mustard mix then dip in stuffing. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Banana-Strawberry Parfait Pie
instructions: Heat strawberry juice and water (1 1/4 cups) to boiling point in a 2-quart saucepan. Remove from heat. Add strawberry-banana jello and stir until dissolved. Cut ice cream into pieces and add to hot liquid; stir immediately until melted. Chill until mixture is thickened but not set 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Make Ahead Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. Drain. Mix potatoes sour cream butter salt and pepper in a large bowl. Beat at a low speed until fluffy. Pile lightly into a buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Toss crumbs in melted butter. Sprinkle over potatoes. Continue baking for 30 minutes uncovered. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Combine oranges coconut and sugar; mix lightly. Chill. Serve on lettuce covered platter. Garnish with whipped topping if desired. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Opal'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all fruits in a bowl and add Cool Whip to taste. Chill before serving.

title: Judy'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook onion and green peppers in oleo until tender. Add flour until thick. Add chicken pimento black pepper eggs soup and mayonnaise; mix. Then add 1 cup of crushed chips.

title: Cold Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage. Slice onions. Place on top of cabbage. Sprinkle with 2 cups sugar. Put oil vinegar dry mustard celery seed salt and 4 teaspoons sugar in pan; bring to a boil. Pour over cabbage. Cover with lid or foil to steam. Allow to cool and refrigerate 4 hours before serving.

title: Cranberry Iced Tea
instructions: In large saucepot combine boiling water and tea bags. Let stand for 4 minutes. Remove and discard tea bags. In large pitcher combine brewed tea cranberry juice sugar and lemon juice. Chill mixture for at least 1 hour or until ready to serve. Serve over ice. Garnish with lemon slices if desired. One cup serving contains 116 calories.

title: Gluten
instructions: Make a stiff dough and cover with water. Let soak 1 or 2 hours or overnight.

title: Almost Heaven Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. When cake is done prick cake with fork while still warm. Pour pineapple and juice over warm cake. Blend pudding with milk and beat in cream cheese (small amount at a time). Spread over pineapple. Cover with Cool Whip. Garnish with nuts and coconut. Refrigerate until serving time. The longer the cake is refrigerated the better the flavor.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Stir until dissolved the water salt sugar and yeast then add slightly beaten eggs and shortening. First mix with spoon then with hands; add potatoes and flour. After mixing thoroughly place in refrigerator about 2 hours before baking. Shape into desired shape. Cover and let rise until light or double in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown about 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen or can be used in smaller quantities and will store about 4 days in refrigerator.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Hand mix meat onion garlic salt and pepper egg and oatmeal. Shape into loaf and place in 9 x 13 inch pan. Top loaf with tomato paste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until browned.

title: Stone Keys
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl combine cream cheese sugar and vanilla; beat until smooth. Blend in eggs one at a time. Remove 1 cup of batter and spread into bottom of crust; set aside. Add pumpkin cinnamon cloves and nutmeg to the remaining batter and stir gently until well blended. Carefully spread over the batter in the crust. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Allow to cool then refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. Cover with whipped cream if desired.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Sift flour cinnamon nutmeg and allspice together 3 times. Cream shortening sugar and eggs until fluffy. Sift dry ingredients into tomato soup alternating small amounts beating thoroughly after each addition. Last add nuts and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Let stand 24 hours before cutting. Cover with cream cheese icing or caramel icing whichever you prefer.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Combine juices and water in bottom part of percolator. Place all other ingredients in basket of percolator. Perk 5 to 10 minutes. This makes a delicious drink for a party or just to serve on cold days at home.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Cook rice until rinse and drain. Mix ingredients all together and keep chilled.

title: Banana Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Combine butter crumbs and sugar. Press firmly on bottom and up sides of pie dish. Chill. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened milk until smooth. Stir in lemon and vanilla. Line crust with bananas. Pour filling over. Chill 3 hours before serving. Top pie with rest of bananas.

title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad(Serves 12)
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Broiled Peaches
instructions: Cut peaches in halves and remove seeds; do not peel. Put 1 teaspoon brown sugar and 1 teaspoon butter on each half. Broil for about 20 minutes. Serve as vegetable with steak or fish.

title: Cherry Jello Salad
instructions: Bring cherries and juice water and sugar to a boil. Stir in Jell-O. Cool. Add other ingredients and refrigerate until set.

title: Impossible Cherry Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Beat all ingredients except pie filling 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand mixer. Pour into plate. Spoon pie filling evenly over top. Bake about 25 minutes. Top with streusel. Bake until streusel is brown about 10 minutes longer.

title: Sugar Cream Cake
instructions: Blend together the cake mix 2 eggs and softened butter. Spread into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat together the 2 remaining eggs sugar and softened cream cheese. Put on top of first mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salad dressing. Toss until well mixed. Add dressing. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight stirring occasionally. Drain before serving.

title: Shipwreck
instructions: In a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish alternate layers of potatoes onion carrots celery and ground beef. Cover with tomato soup and mushroom soup.

title: Country Style Hominy
instructions: Fry bacon and onion until bacon is very crisp. Add water from 1 can of hominy to bacon and continue to cook about 5 minutes. Discard liquid in other can of hominy. Add both cans of drained hominy to bacon mixture and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.

title: Beef Cubes With Noodles
instructions: Mix all soups with beef. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 hours. Serve on cooked and drained noodles.

title: Cottage Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain and place in large bowl. Fry onion in margarine and add to the noodles. Add cheese sour cream and sugar; mix well. Lastly add beaten eggs and transfer to a casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes. Sprinkle top with graham cracker or bread crumbs. Serve in squares.

title: Eggless Cake From Canada
instructions: Put together all ingredients except flour baking powder and baking soda in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil 3 minutes. Let cool. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Put into glass loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Broccoli Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Slice 1/4 inch from stem end of each tomato. Scoop out pulp and seeds. Place tomatoes in 1-quart baking dish. Cook broccoli with onion according to package directions; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except Parmesan cheese; mix well. Fill tomatoes with broccoli mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Foil-Wrapped Dinners
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Cut meat into 1-inch pieces. Run cold water over peas just until broken apart; drain. Tear off 4 pieces of heavy-duty aluminum foil each 18 x 15 inches. On center of each piece place 1 carrot (thinly sliced) 1 potato (cut into quarters) and 1/4 of the meat. Stir together mushroom soup and onion soup mix; spoon over meat. Top with peas. Wrap securely in foil; place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 50 minutes or until meat is tender. Garnish with 2 cherry tomatoes halved. Serves 4.

title: Saucepan Brownies
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add cocoa and stir until smooth. Cool. Add sugar and eggs one at a time to mixture in saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and turn out onto lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar baking powder salt and soda. Stir shortening until soft. Add flour mixture and 1 cup milk. Mix to dampen flour. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer or 300 strokes by hand. Add remaining milk eggs chocolate and food coloring. Beat 1 minute longer. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 3 (8-inch) pans for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix well refrigerate and serve with vegetables.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Toss lightly and serve. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Kentucky Corn Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into cupcake paper in large muffin tins. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Surprise Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Drain apricots reserving liquid. Combine brown sugar cornstarch salt cinnamon and orange rind. Blend well. Gradually add apricot syrup stirring constantly. Bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 2 minutes. Add apricots butter and pecans. Stir until butter is melted. Halve sweet potatoes and arrange in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Cover with apricot sauce. Bake uncovered in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Raw Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise sour cream vinegar and Worcestershire sauce until mixed. Toss with vegetables salt and pepper. Chill well. Serve.

title: Trawler Restaurant Crab Dip
instructions: Cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add grated sharp Cheddar cheese minced garlic clove Worcestershire sauce pepper horseradish (cream-style) and crab meat drained well. Form in ball and refrigerate a few hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Crushworthy Meat Loaf
instructions: Thaw bread in refrigerator overnight. Cover; let stand on floured surface at room temperature 1 hour. Reserve 1 tablespoon egg for glaze. Combine remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Shape into a 4 x 9-inch loaf. Place loaf in shallow baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Drain. Press dough onto bottom of a greased jelly roll pan. Place loaf in center of dough. Fold dough ends over loaf. Tuck ends in to cover entire loaf. Brush top and sides of loaf with reserved egg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Paul Varnell'S Spaghetti
instructions: First...you saute the onion garlic and bell pepper in the bacon drippings using a large deep pot or pan. Add the 2 small tomatoes (cubed) near the end for just a few moments. Add the canned tomatoes tomato sauce paste and catsup. Blend in all seasonings; reduce heat and allow to simmer.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into a ball. Chill then serve.

title: Pizza In A Bowl
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the package directions except omit the salt. Drain. Meanwhile cut half of the pepperoni slices in quarters; set aside. In a large skillet cook ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain off excess fat. Stir in pizza sauce tomato sauce tomato paste sugar pepper garlic salt and onion salt. Stir in the cooked macaroni and quartered pepperoni slices.

title: Relish
instructions: Grind together tomatoes peppers and onions. Add salt let stand 5 hours then boil 15 minutes and drain. Boil next 5 ingredients 2 minutes. Strain. Add to first mixture with mustard and celery seed. Bring to boil and jar.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix lemon juice sugar and sour cream together. Add remaining ingredients. Can be frozen and used as a dessert.

title: Katrina'S Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin
instructions: Place chicken on bottom. Place broccoli (blanched) on top of chicken. Blend soup milk mayonnaise mustard and lemon juice. Pour on top of broccoli and chicken. Sprinkle shredded cheese. Add bread crumbs (optional). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
instructions: Place wings in baking pan. Peel and grate onion; mix with chili sauce vinegar oil sugar Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Stir well. Pour over wings and bake about one hour or until done at 375\u00b0. Pour off fat and serve while hot.

title: Lite Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit well. Mix Cool Whip condensed milk and lemon juice together. Add nuts coconut and apples. Add all the rest of the ingredients. Chill 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips. Form into balls. Let stand until they dry out some. Melt chocolate chips in saucepan. Dip balls; set on wax paper to cool.

title: Pecan Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in shallow dish or plastic bag. Pour dressing over chicken. Cover. Marinate chicken in refrigerator 1 to 8 hours. Drain. Dip chicken in combined bread crumbs and pecans. Press to coat. Cook chicken in margarine in large skillet over medium heat 5 to 6 minutes on each side until tender.

title: Paula'S Cornish Hens
instructions: Remove skin off chicken and cut into pieces. Brown onion and garlic in olive oil. Add chicken and spices. Brown chicken on both sides. Add crushed tomatoes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add wine water bouillon and mustard. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook on low for 30 minutes in a covered pot. Simmer for another 5 minutes and serve with rice. Serves 4.

title: Fruited Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery grapes pineapple and mandarin oranges; toss well. Combine mayonnaise sour cream salt and pepper. Add to chicken mixture stirring well. Chill several hours before serving. Sprinkle almonds on top.

title: Famous Rotel Cheese Dip
instructions: To 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies add cheese which has been melted in a double boiler (for additional thickness add more cheese). Mix together. Serve warm as dip with corn chips tortilla chips or crackers.

title: Texas Potatoes
instructions: Mix hash browns onion soup and sour cream. Spread into casserole dish. Melt 1 cup butter and add to crushed Ritz crackers. Mix and spread on top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix jello with 2 cups boiling water. Drain pineapple and oranges. Measure fruit juice and add enough water to make 2 cups. Add to jello along with the fruit. Congeal.

title: Barbecue Beef(8 To 20 Servings)
instructions: Brown the roast well with salt and pepper. Combine all remaining ingredients; pour over browned meat. Cover; simmer for 4 or 5 hours at 250\u00b0. Tear meat and simmer one more hour. Great sandwiches.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Slightly beat eggs; add sugar salt and vanilla. Slowly add scalded milk and pour on cubed bread in a casserole. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Put pudding in a pan of hot water and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done (could take a little longer or a little less time).

title: Hobo Stew
instructions: You will need a large black pot.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Combine milk and 2 pints of sherbet. Beat until smooth. Add chilled and carbonated beverage and stir until blended. Spoon remaining sherbet on top. Makes 28 (1/2 scoop) servings.

title: Very Easy Yeast Rolls
instructions: Measure milk in pan. Add sugar salt oil or butter. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Set aside for 5 minutes. Warm milk mixture to lukewarm. Then add yeast. Add enough flour to make a pretty stiff dough. Grease the top and let rise double in pan for about 1 hour. Turn out on floured board and work down. Shape into rolls. Let raise again. Grease the tops and bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Lotta Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add beans (pour off liquid). Add condiments and bake for 40 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Frosting
instructions: Combine milk and flour. Cook until thick. Cool. With mixer beat oleo shortening and sugar. Add cool milk. Beat until light and fluffy. Add vanilla.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs pumpkin and water blending well. Sift dry ingredients together then sift into pumpkin mixture stirring to blend. Add nuts. Pour into 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) greased loaf pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 55 to 60 minutes. Let cool in pans slightly; remove from pans and cool loaves on wire racks. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Huckleberry Bread
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening and eggs. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately. Stir in berries and cinnamon. Divide into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Unusual Frozen Cake
instructions: Add milk (instead of water) to cake mix using the same amount as box instructs for water. Add vanilla and chopped nuts. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour batter into pan. Do not bake. Cover pan with foil or tight fitting lid and freeze overnight. The next day combine brown sugar cocoa boiling water and flavoring or vanilla stir well. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Take cake from freezer remove foil and pour cocoa mixture over frozen cake. Immediately bake for one hour or until done. Cool. Refrigerate if you like. Cut into squares. Remove squares with cake server and place upside-down on plate. Top with whipped topping.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: In crock-pot put butter in first. Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Add milk to desired consistency (usually I finish filling the crock-pot). Cook on low all day or on high for 3 hours.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients; then add wet ingredients. Stir well. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Yield 40 to 60 muffins.

title: Broccoli Chicken And Cheese
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet on medium-high heat brown chicken in butter for 10 minutes. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup and milk. Add broccoli and pepper. Heat to boiling. Reduce to low; cover and cook 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Garnish with cherry tomatoes and sage.

title: Hershey'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add eggs. Beat well. Combine flour baking soda and salt. Gradually beat into creamed mixture. Stir in chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown. Cool slightly. Remove from sheets. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Combine in large mixing bowl cake mix gelatin 1/2 cup strawberry juice and oil. Beat two minutes at high speed. Add eggs beat one minute. Then add 3/4 cup drained strawberries beat one minute. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Arroz Con Pollo For 24
instructions: Bake chicken uncooked for 30 minutes. Dissolve bouillon in water and add saffron; stir until dissolved. Stir in onions bay leaves parsley and 4 teaspoons salt; heat to boiling. Remove pans from oven. Remove chickens. Drain fat from pans.

title: Apples And Cabbage Salad
instructions: Beat egg and sugar; combine with water. Let come to almost boil. Combine flour and vinegar and stir well; combine vinegar combination with sugar egg and water. Stir continuously until almost clear. When sauce is clear (sticky) pour over the apples and cabbage already cut and in bowl.

title: Crazy Potatoes
instructions: Boil quartered potatoes until done. Pour remainder of ingredients over drained potatoes sprinkle with bacon bits and cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Spray bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan crumble bread and sprinkle in bottom of pan. Mix all ingredients together and pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Add spices. Add 1/2 cup salsa.

title: German Liver Dumplings
instructions: Mix together hamburger liver rolls 1 onion eggs flour bread crumbs marjoram salt and pepper; mixture will be soft but will shape in broth. Form balls big or small and drop in hot broth. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. They will rise. Remove when done; saute the second onion in butter and pour over dumplings. Serve with sauerkraut or mashed potatoes.

title: Quick Mix For Biscuits
instructions: In a large bowl mix all dry ingredients; blend well. With pastry blender cut in shortening until evenly distributed. Put in airtight jar or Tupperware bowl. Store in a cool place. Use within 10 to 12 weeks. You can use this for any recipe calling for Bisquick.

title: Chicken With Dressing
instructions: Melt oleo and pour over half stuffing in large pan 13 x 9. Spoon in other ingredients. Top with remaining 1/2 dressing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Georgia Smothered Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Let stand 1 hour. Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; dot with butter. Sprinkle with flour. Bake at 500\u00b0 until brown; reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Add Worcestershire sauce and water. Cover tightly with foil. Continue baking 1 1/2 to 2 hours basting occasionally. Gravy may be thickened if desired.

title: Mama'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar and flour then add milk and egg yellows. Stir and cook on low heat until thick. After the mixture has thickened add butter and vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Mesquite Turkey
