instructions: Place wet mesquite wood chips in 1 disposable aluminum pie pan on coals on one side of the bottom of outdoor grill (remove grids so that pan is sitting directly on the coals). Very important to keep wood chips wet at all times so it smokes. Quarter onion and carrots; place in cavity of turkey. Sprinkle Mrs. Dash in the cavity also. Put turkey in oblong pan on top of grill to one side. Turn both burners on high for 3/4 hour. The burner under the larger part of turkey turn low and the other burner turn medium for 4 hours or until done. This is the turkey that is served at the Leeds Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Diet Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cook cabbage celery and carrots in water with bouillon cubes. Add tomato juice and string beans. Fry hamburger salt pepper onion and parsley. Add all together and cook slowly.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add 1 tsp. baking soda. Pour over 6 quarts popped popcorn. Stir until well mixed. place in a 200 degree oven for 1 hour; stirring at 15 minute intervals. Remove from oven and let cool. Store in covered container.

title: Banana Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the vanilla and nuts. In a heavy saucepan cook stirring constantly over moderate heat until it makes the soft ball stage. Add vanilla and nuts. Beat until it becomes thick and glossy. Pour in a buttered 8-inch pan. Let firm then cut into squares.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: In large bowl dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Allow yeast to proof 10 minutes or until its foamy. Add remaining 1 cup warm water combining well with yeast. Add 3 cups flour and salt. Mix dough. Add remaining flour as needed to make a dough that holds together. Place dough on floured surface and knead for 10 minutes or until dough is soft and not sticky. Grease a large bowl with the olive oil. Put dough in bowl and turn a few times to coat with oil. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap and let rise for 2 hours in warm place.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Beat eggs with 1 cup of sugar. Add vanilla. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture. Add apples and nuts. Put in 9-inch greased pie plate. Add topping (cinnamon and sugar combination). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes approximately. Has coffee cake texture.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Mix well all ingredients except tomato sauce. Separate the cabbage leaves. Stuff each leaf with about 2 tablespoons of the mixture. Pour the tomato sauce over the stuffed leaves. Cover and cook on low heat about 3 1/2 hours.

title: Marie'S Chicken
instructions: Combine preserves salad dressing and soup mix. Place chicken pieces in baking pan; spread sauce over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or grill chicken over medium coals until nearly tender about 45 minutes; turn occasionally. Brush with sauce grill 15 minutes more basting occasionally. Makes 12 servings.

title: Seed Mounds
instructions: Boil honey and salt until a drop forms in cold water. Add nuts; drop by tablespoons onto platter. Makes 25.

title: Hazel'S Miracle Whip Cake
instructions: Sift together flour cocoa sugar soda and salt then add Miracle Whip coffee and vanilla. Stir together and bake 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 2 layers or 1 square pan.

title: Seven Layer Bars
instructions: Cream brown sugar and margarine. Stir in 1 1/2 cups Bisquick. Press in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 12 minutes. Beat eggs in medium bowl with a fork. Mix in sugar and almond extract. Stir in coconut almonds and 3 tablespoons Bisquick; spread over baked layer. Arrange cherries on top. Bake until light golden brown and set at 350\u00b0 for 22 to 25 minutes; cool. Cut into bars.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Preheat griddle to 350\u00b0. Whisk all dry ingredients together before mixing in liquid ingredients. Whisk eggs buttermilk and melted butter into dry mixture. Batter will be lumpy. Do not whisk until smooth. Use a 1/2 cup measuring cup to pour onto griddle. Turn when surface appears bubbly. Makes 8 to 10 pancakes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Orange Slice Candy Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Melt butter and let cool. Cream sugar; add 1 egg at a time and beat well. Add buttermilk and soda. Beat all together. Add flour and salt. Add chopped dates coconut nuts and candy. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 2 1/2 hours. Frost.

title: Snyder'S Hobo Lasagne
instructions: Break spaghetti in 1/2 and cook in boiling water until done drain. Brown hamburger drain grease. Drain mushrooms add to hamburger. Grease 9 x 12-inch pan; layer with sauce hamburger spaghetti and cheese continue through ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until cheese is melted through.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Place wild rice in strainer. Pour 3 quarts boiling water over rice 4 times letting rice set in strainer each time while water returns to boiling. Brown onion and celery in margarine. Combine all ingredients in 2-quart casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 1/4 hour. Add broth if mixture becomes dry. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Apple Spice Syrup
instructions: In a saucepan combine brown sugar cornstarch allspice and nutmeg; mix well. Add juice. Cook and stir over medium heat until syrup is bubbly and slightly thickened.

title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients for 2 minutes. Bake in a well-greased and lightly floured Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump pineapple in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch ungreased pan (dont drain pineapple). Sprinkle coconut over pineapple. Spread dry cake mix over coconut. Sprinkle with nuts. Melt butter and pour over nuts. (Dont mix.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Ripple Cookie Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix all ingredients except pie filling. Spread 1/2 of batter in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Top with pie filling. Spread remaining batter over fruit covering as much of the filling as possible. Swirls in batter and uncovered fruit peeking through are to be expected. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until brown.

title: Rich Egg Batter Bread
instructions: Place aluminum foil under the napkin in your roll basket and the rolls will stay hot longer.

title: Avocado Salad With Ginger
instructions: Combine lemon juice and ginger and salt in small bowl. Add avocado and toss gently but thoroughly. Let salad marinate at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before serving. Makes 4 servings.

title: Party Mix
instructions: In a small bowl add seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce to melted butter. Mix well. Pour cereal nuts and pretzels into large Glad-lock zipper bag. Pour margarine mixture over cereal mixture inside zipper bag. Seal top of bag securely. Shake bag until all pieces are evenly coated. Pour contents of bag into large bowl. Microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes stirring every 2 minutes. Spread on absorbent paper and cool. Store in airtight container. Makes 9 cups.

title: Cream-Cheese Corn
instructions: Cook corn as directed. Drain off 3/4 of the water after corn is cooked then add cream cheese; blend well. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes with skins on until tender; remove from heat. Let cool peel and slice. Heat milk and pour 1/2 cup warm milk in flour to thicken sauce. Add 1 1/2 cups of hot milk cheese and butter. Add sliced potatoes fresh cut onions and sauce. Repeat until all is used up. Heat in oven for 20 to 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix the ingredients together. Put into ungreased dish and top with 1 roll package Ritz crackers crumbled and sauteed in 1 stick melted margarine. Bake for 25 minutes at 250\u00b0.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoon in deep hot fat. Fry until golden brown.

title: Aunt Nellie'S Applesauce Cake
instructions: Use \dead ripe\ persimmons and put through a strainer. Sift together all dry ingredients; stir in remaining ingredients. Place in dessert mold and cover with greased or waxed paper and then in kettle with sufficient water cover tightly and steam for 1 to 3 hours. (Or place pudding in top pan of double boiler cover with aluminum foil then the lid and steam for 1 1/2 hours.)

title: Hot Baked Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and put in shallow baking dish. Over the top scatter 6 slices of bacon in pieces and some sliced olives. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Coney Island Sauce
instructions: Saute onion beef and celery in margarine for 10 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce brown sugar and spices. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes to blend flavors. Add to hot dogs. Sauce may be frozen.

title: Texas Bean Bake
instructions: Brown first 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats. Let stand about 30 minutes. Cream oleo and both sugars and salt. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients with others then add oats to mixture and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Add topping.

title: Chip Chop Stew
instructions: Salt and pepper a cut up chicken. Brown in oil until cooked. Drain off excess oil. In the same skillet add chopped garlic and onion.

title: Peanut Butter 'N Nana Sandwich
instructions: Spread peanut butter on one slice of bread. On ther other one slice up part of the banana to cover up the bread. Put together and eat. \Num Num\ says Cale and Kayla.

title: Overnight Candy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg whites and sugar until very stiff. Add chocolate chips vanilla and pecans. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Turn oven off. Place in oven and leave overnight. Remove with spatula.

title: Green Dip
instructions: Mix all together and chill before serving. Is a great raw vegetable dip.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix ingredients in gallon container. Keep airtight. Put 3 tablespoons of mix in 1 cup hot water. Stir.

title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Cream oleo brown sugar and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Blend in vanilla. Gradually add dry ingredients then oats and chocolate. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pecan Creamed Cheese Pie
instructions: Note Egg Beaters can be used instead of eggs.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Beat or stir until smooth. Pour into deep pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes or until top is brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine crumbs and shortening. Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. In large bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Toss 1/2 cup of chips with flour to coat. Stir into cheese mixture. Pour into prepared pan. Sprinkle remaining chips over top. Bake 55 minutes or until center is set. Cool. Chill. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Fresh Apple Cake(Diabetic)
instructions: Mix and sift flour baking soda spices and salt. Add butter vanilla egg and sweetener; beat until well blended. Stir in grated apples and nuts. Turn into well-greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cut in squares to serve. Makes 9 servings.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Soften butter. Cream with sugar and eggs. Beat in dry ingredients. Stir in apples nuts and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. I usually use a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Wonderful served warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Tear spinach into large salad bowl. Crisp the bean sprouts by placing in refrigerator for a couple of hours. Add noodles sprouts water chestnuts and chopped eggs. Crumble bacon over all. Add desired amounts of dressing just before serving.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Blend flour sugar and salt. Cut in lard. Beat egg. Add vinegar and water. Sprinkle over flour mixture. Blend with a fork. Makes 2 double crust pies.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a Bundt pan and add the 1/2 cup ground pecans. In a mixer beat the remaining ingredients for 2 minutes. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Persian Eggplant Stew
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut lengthwise in 1/2-inch slices. Sprinkle both sides of each slice lightly with salt (to prevent eggplants from soaking up too much oil while browning). Set aside.

title: Caesar Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil. Blend in the oil 1/4 cup at a time.

title: Aunt Esta'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Set eggs and butter out to reach room temperature. Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla; add flour and cocoa. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 350\u00b0 until set.

title: Golden Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 in a Bundt pan.

title: Pressure Cooker Stew
instructions: Brown meat seasonings and onion in about 1 or 2 tablespoons Crisco. Add 1/2 cup water. Add in this order (do not stir) potatoes carrots green beans with liquid and tomatoes with the liquid. Cook at 15 pounds pressure for 18 minutes. Run water over cooker to lower pressure. Stir and serve at once.

title: Tea Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening. Add eggs; mix. Sift together flour salt and soda. Combine both mixtures mixing well. Stir in nuts. Form dough into a roll. Cover with wax paper and refrigerate overnight. Slice thin and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Fruited Sweet Potatoes
instructions: In a 2-quart microwavable casserole combine potatoes with the water. Cover and microwave on High 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender stirring once. Add remaining ingredients. Stir well to combine. Cover and microwave on High 3 minutes or until apple is tender-crisp. Yields 4 servings.

title: O.K.'S Linguini Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pepperoni and cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Add pepperoni and cheese before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Applewoods Rolls
instructions: Heat milk to 90\u00b0; add sugar and yeast. Mix then add eggs oil salt and bread flour. Knead 10 minutes. Let rise for 1 hour. Divide into 24 balls. Cut each ball into 3 pieces. Put in oiled muffin pan. Let this rise for 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Super Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients until smooth and pour into graham crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. While baking mix sour cream vanilla and 1 tablespoon sugar. Remove pie and pour over top. Bake 5 more minutes; chill.

title: Shrimp Piau
instructions: Fry meat crisp then fry onions in grease. Leave all grease and onions then stir in shrimp and cook about 5 minutes. Stir in rice; let simmer about 10 more minutes.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Stew the chicken until done. Pick off the bones. Soak tortillas in chicken stock. Line baking dish tortilla chicken chicken soup and mushroom soup. Sprinkle garlic salt and chili powder over the chicken. Sprinkle cheese over top. Spread Ro-Tel tomatoes on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt shortening and chocolate together over hot water. Cool. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Beat eggs until light; add sugar and then chocolate mixture. Blend. Add flour vanilla and nuts. Mix well. Pour batter into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a moderate 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and remove meat from bone. Mix soup sour cream salt pepper and sage. In casserole dish layer cream sauce mixture then chicken. Sprinkle crumbled crackers on each layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Amish Friendship Bread
instructions: Use no metal utensils! Do not refrigerate starter. A 3 pound margarine container will hold 5 cups of starter.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Mix cabbage carrot and bell pepper. Cover with salt. Make a syrup of vinegar sugar water and celery seed. Boil for 1 minute. Cool to lukewarm and pour over cabbage. Stir and pack. Keeps indefinitely in the freezer.

title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order and freeze in 8 x 8-inch dish. Thaw before serving. Can be refrozen. Keeps well.

title: Funnel Cakes
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour a little batter into a funnel over hot oil. Fry until brown; sprinkle powdered sugar over each cake and serve.

title: Margarita'S Pasta Primavera(Low Calorie)
instructions: Drain any liquid off of cottage cheese. In a bowl combine cottage cheese and lemon juice. Set aside.

title: Chocolate Dump Cake
instructions: Combine all wet ingredients including cocoa then add dry ingredients. Batter will be very wet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Be sure center of cake is not wet when toothpick inserted.

title: Quick And Easy Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.\tSpray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam and sprinkle with flour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: In small bowl combine beaten eggs cream salt and pepper to form batter. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Dip chicken in batter then in flour (or crumbled corn flakes). Drop onto cookie sheet. Spray cookie sheet with Pam or cover with oil. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done. Turn once so can brown on both sides.

title: Microwave Corn Muffins
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart mixing bowl combine flour corn meal sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Add egg milk and oil and stir just until all ingredients are moistened. Spoon batter into 8 (6 ounce) custard cups lined with cupcake papers.

title: Squash Delight
instructions: Mix and drop by spoonful into hot oil. Fry until brown. Remove from fryer and drain.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients but chicken in a bowl. Put cut up chicken in casserole and pour mixture over chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cream shortening peanut butter and sugars. Add egg milk and vanilla. Beat well. Blend dry ingredients gradually; mix thoroughly. Shape into round balls about 1-inch. Roll in sugar and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and place a chocolate kiss on each cookie by pressing down. Return to oven for a minute or two.

title: French Onion Soup(6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Separate onions into rings and cook in melted butter until glossy. Add consomme water Worcestershire sauce salt or cube and pepper. Bring to boil. Cover tightly and cook over low heat for 15 minutes.

title: Doughnuts(Club Member: Ashley Wilson)
instructions: Measure 1 1/2 cups flour and remaining ingredients in a bowl. Blend on low speed scraping bowl constantly. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally. Add remaining flour. Roll dough out to 3/8 inch thick. Cut with floured doughnut cutter. With wide spatula slide doughnuts into oil. Turn as they rise to the surface. Fry 2 or 3 minutes at 375\u00b0 until golden brown. Remove and drain. Do not prick surface! Let cool and serve.

title: Cool And Simple Citrus Pie
instructions: Place concentrate in a large mixing bowl and beat about 30 seconds. Gradually spoon in ice cream and blend. Fold in whipped topping and add food coloring (if desired) whipping until smooth. Freeze if necessary until mixture will mound. Spoon into a pie crust. Freeze until firm at least 4 hours. Store any leftover pie in freezer.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo With Noodles
instructions: In a skillet melt 2 tablespoons of the butter over low heat; add cream the cognac and salt and pepper to taste. Bring mixture to a boil. Add morels; simmer and cover them for 10 minutes keeping mixture warm. Prepare noodles; drain the pasta and toss it with the butter. Add the morel mixture and 1/2 cup of the Parmesan cheese.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken until done. Remove chicken from bone. Tear it into small pieces. Mix dressing mix with the water and margarine. In a separate bowl mix the 2 cans of soup. Put 1 layer chicken 1 layer dressing mix and 1 layer soup. Repeat 3 times (if needed). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lazy Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and seasonings. Add tomato paste sauce and water. Bring to a boil; simmer 10 minutes. This will be a thin mixture. In a 13 x 9-inch pan spoon about 1 1/2 cups sauce making a layer across the bottom of the pan next layer of noodles (uncooked). Fill in any empty spaces with broken noodles then sprinkle 1/3 of grated cheese over sauce. Make 3 layers of sauce noodles and cheese on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

title: Abington Crumb Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 11 x 2 1/2 x 7-inch pans. Cream together shortening sugar and eggs; beat lightly. Sift flour with salt and baking powder. Blend in with additions of the milk. Pour into prepared pans and sprinkle with Crumbs.

title: Sour Cream And Chive Noodles
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine cottage cheese sour cream chives salt and pepper. Pour over egg noodles and stir to coat evenly. Bake in a covered casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can add additional sour cream to moisten.

title: Chipped Beef Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese onion chipped beef horseradish and 1/2 of the chopped nuts. Form into ball and roll in the remaining nuts. Serve with crackers.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
instructions: This delicate sweet dessert is famous at Mexican weddings or other festivities. A surprising treat for people who think Mexican food is always hot and spicy.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Soup
instructions: Fry bacon crisp; remove and chop. Add vegetables except for tomatoes to bacon drippings in pan and saute. Pour contents of pan (drippings and all) into Dutch oven. Add tomatoes peas and bacon and heat well. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Log
instructions: Beat cream cheese steak sauce and curry powder together. Blend in chicken and celery plus 2 tablespoons of parsley. Shape into a 9-inch log. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 4 hours or overnight. Toss together remaining parsley and nuts. Coat the log. Serve with crackers.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream and blend together the butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Sift together and stir in flour baking soda and salt. Add chocolate chips and pecans. Drop the batter from a teaspoon onto a cookie sheet leaving lots of room in between cookies. Bake for 10 minutes or until the cookies are as brown as you wish.

title: Raisin Puffs
instructions: Cook raisins in water until all water is gone. Set aside. Cream oleo sugar and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Add cooked raisins.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Add chopped prunes and stir in sour cream. Sift together flour soda baking powder and spices and add to creamed mixture. Pour into 2 (8-inch) greased pans or a flat pan. Bake in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until done. Frost with Creamy Icing.

title: Topoppo Salad
instructions: Mix mashed avocados and packaged guacamole dip seasoning according to package directions. Mix oil and vinegar (half and half). Layer the following on a dinner plate for each serving tortilla chips refried beans guacamole lettuce peas onion tomato green pepper chicken and cheese. Sprinkle with oil and vinegar dressing and top with salsa.

title: Scallops With Shake 'N Bake
instructions: Bread scallops in Shake N Bake. Lay on cookie sheet. Bake according to directions on package (about 20 minutes).

title: Hot Crab And Cheese Dip
instructions: Shred cheese. Mix everything (very thick). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until it is bubbly and brown at edges. Serve hot.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour Bundt pan. In mixing bowl combine all ingredients at medium speed; beat about 4 minutes. Pour batter into pan. Pound pan on counter a few times to get air out. Bake 60 minutes. Cool in pan for 30 minutes. Turn out and finish cooling. Dust with powdered sugar if desired. Cut into slices and freeze if you want.

title: Rivvel Soup
instructions: Combine the flour salt and beaten egg. Mix together with the fingers until mixture is crumbly. Drop these rivvels into the broth. Add corn and simmer for 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Cherry-Chocolate Cake And Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Prepare cake according to box directions; add pie filling and bake according to box directions.

title: Easy Cheese Souffle
instructions: Whip eggs milk mustard and salt in blender. Butter rectangular Pyrex dish. Lay 8 to 9 slices of bread in bottom. (Fill in any empty spaces with bread so cheese will not contact dish.) Cover with 1/2 of the cheese. Lay 8 or 9 more slices of bread on top and spread remaining cheese over. Pour liquid mix over. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Can be frozen. Bake 1 1/4 hours in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serve immediately.

title: Walnut Chicken
instructions: In a bowl mix together 1 tablespoon oil 2 teaspoons soy sauce and 1 teaspoon cornstarch. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Stir into mixture to coat. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup peanut butter and corn syrup in bowl. Mix well. Add cereal. Stir until coated. Press into pie plate. Beat cream cheese in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in powdered sugar and remaining 1 cup peanut butter. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon into pie plate. Freeze.

title: German Chocolate Upside Down Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box. Butter a 9 x 13 inch pan. Put pecans and coconut in pan and pour cake over them. Melt and mix cream cheese margarine and powdered sugar. Pour over cake mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45-50 minutes.

title: Grandmother'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine eggs raisins and vanilla and let stand for 1 hour. (Very important secret of good cookies.) Thoroughly cream shortening and sugars together. Sift dry ingredients into mixture and mix well. Blend in egg mixture oatmeal and nuts. Dough should be stiff.

title: Beef And Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: In a large skillet heat vegetable oil. Cook beef until done. Add mushrooms and broccoli. Saute with beef for 10 minutes or until broccoli is tender-crisp. In small bowl combine soy sauce lemon juice and cornstarch until smooth. Add this mixture to beef-vegetable mixture. Cook on medium heat until thickened. Fold in pimento. Serve over hot rice. Serves 4.

title: Asparagus Rolls
instructions: Roll bread to half its thickness. Spread with mayonnaise and Bleu cheese mixed. Roll asparagus up jelly roll fashion. Dip in melted butter and place seam side down in pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp and brown. Cut into thirds.

title: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
instructions: Drain pineapple (reserve syrup); set aside. Pour water over walnuts; drain. Heat oil in skillet and stir-fry nuts until brown. Remove. Stir-fry chicken garlic onion and ginger until chicken turns white. Remove. Add broccoli; stir-fry until tender-crisp. Return nuts and chicken mixture. Add pineapple. Combine reserved syrup cornstarch and soy sauce. Cook until thick and bubbly. Serve on rice.

title: Pilaf Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Fry onion in 1/4 cup butter in saucepan until transparent. Add pine nuts and rice. Saute until light brown. Add currants 1 tablespoon salt and water and a dash of pepper. Bring to a boil then cover and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes or until all the water is absorbed. Add melted butter. Cool before using as a stuffing.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients. Spoon on topping and refrigerate.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Layer ingredients as follows pineapple cherry pie filling coconut nuts. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top. Pour melted oleo over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Stir together in mixing bowl the rolled oats boiling water shortening molasses and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Combine stirring to dissolve the yeast and 1/2 cup warm water. Stir into lukewarm oatmeal mixture. Mix well. Add eggs and flour. Mix thoroughly; cover and let stand 15 minutes. Place dough in 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans and pat into loaf shape. Let rise in warm place until double (1 1/2 hours). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rum Punch
instructions: In punch bowl place rum pineapple juice lemonade and orange juice. Let steep 1 hour. Before serving add ginger ale. Decorate top with fruit slices.

title: Upside Down Pineapple Cake
instructions: Melt butter and brown sugar in heavy skillet and simmer a few minutes. Mix sugar flour eggs fruit juice salt and baking powder. Place pineapple rings in skillet. Place cherries in center of each pineapple ring. Pour cake batter over all. Place skillet in preheated 350\u00b0 oven and bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Flip over onto large cake plate immediately out of oven.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: *Choose to desired taste all or some of the following vegetables cauliflower broccoli tomatoes radishes onions celery peppers etc.

title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
instructions: Stuffing Roll or grind 16 round old fashioned \common\ crackers into fine crumbs. Put in good sized bowl adding 1 can minced clams with the juice. Season with salt and pepper and moisten to proper consistency with sherry. Use a shallow pan covered with aluminum foil. Place the shrimp on the pan and with a spoon put stuffing on top of each shrimp. Bake at 450\u00b0 to 500\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. To preserve moisture place a large lettuce leaf over the dressing.

title: Angel Cake
instructions: Break cake in small bite size pieces. Mix cream cheese and sugar well. Add milk. Fold in Cool Whip and then fold in cake pieces. Put into 9 x 13-inch dish and press lightly. Cover with cherry pie filling or filling of choice.

title: Warm Bean Salad(Party Size Recipe)
instructions: Brown sausage onion and celery. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer until blended. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 and serve.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Shred crab and mix with mayonnaise and celery; chill. Serves 6.

title: Jean'S Lasagne
instructions: Cook beef until browned; drain off grease. Stir in onion soup tomato sauce and water. Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes. Meanwhile cook lasagna noodles. Drain and let stand in cold water. In a 2-quart oblong dish place half the meat sauce then layer noodles and top with a layer of cheese. Repeat ending with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until cheese is desired brownness.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Take graham cracker crust and spread peanut butter from 1/2 to 1-inch thick according to your liking for peanut butter. Mix pudding per directions on box. Pour over peanut butter. Chill in the refrigerator 1/2 to 1 hour.

title: Cow Flops
instructions: In saucepan combine first four ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce to medium heat for 2 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Mix in coconut and oatmeal and drop quickly from teaspoon on wax paper or tray and let cool. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain all excess fat off meat. Pour in barbecue sauce and let simmer. Place biscuits into muffin tins. Spread out biscuit dough to cover muffin tin. Place meat sauce (approximately 2 large tablespoonfuls) into biscuit dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Place grated cheese on top of cups and place back into oven until cheese is melted.

title: Aunt Lizzy'S Ice Cream Dream Pie
instructions: You will need a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Gringo Chili
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan brown chicken and pork. Remove and set aside. Add shallots onions and garlic to pan and saute until tender. Stir in tomatillos tomatoes chicken broth chiles spices chicken and pork. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Serve in bowls and top with cheese. Good with either flour or corn tortillas.

title: Quick Turkey Appetizers
instructions: Place tortillas on 2 large (9 x 13-inch) baking sheets. Lightly brush both sides of tortillas with oil. Bake tortillas at 400\u00b0 for 3 minutes; remove from oven. Evenly spread salsa over all tortillas. Sprinkle turkey tomato cilantro red pepper olives and cheese evenly over salsa on each tortilla. Bake tortillas 12 minutes rearranging baking sheets halfway through. To serve slice tortillas in eighths. Makes 48 appetizers.

title: Buttercream Icing
instructions: Mix powdered sugar and butter. Stir in vanilla and milk. Beat until smooth and of spreading consistency. Frosts a 13 x 9-inch cake or fills and frosts two 8 x 9-inch cake layers.

title: Low Sugar Mocha Nut Cake
instructions: Combine the hot water and coffee; set aside. Cream the margarine brown sugar and sweetener with mixer on medium speed until mixture is light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; mix for 1 minute. Stir together flour cocoa dry milk baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture with coffee and nuts. Spray a 9-inch square pan with nonstick cooking oil; spread batter evenly in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Good cake for diabetics.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat and then add spaghetti sauce. Simmer. Cook lasagna as directed. Drain. On pan spread 1 cup sauce then alternate layers of lasagna meat cheese meat and lasagna etc. ending with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes until brown.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions until tender not soft. Cool thoroughly. Combine with remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: *One-half cup (1/2 cup) unpopped corn equals 3 cups popped.

title: Mother'S Baked Beans
instructions: Cover beans and baking soda with water and boil for about 2 hours. Add mustard sugar pepper and salt. Slice one small piece salt pork to the rind and place in center of the beans which have been placed in a 2 to 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 2 hours until soft. Add water from time to time to prevent drying out.

title: Busy Day Goulash
instructions: Brown meat. Add onion; cook until transparent. Add salt and pepper then set aside. While meat is browning add macaroni to boiling water and cook until tender; drain. Add salt and butter. Add tomatoes to meat mixture; bring to simmer. When bubbling add macaroni then simmer 10 minutes uncovered. Serve with toasted French bread and salad.

title: Cranberry Molded Salad
instructions: Melt cranberry sauce over medium heat. Drain reserving liquid and berries. Mix cranberry liquid boiling water and gelatin; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add lemon juice and salt. Chill until mixture mounds slightly on spoon. Add mayonnaise and mix until smooth. Fold in cranberries apple and nuts. Pour into 1-quart mold. Chill overnight. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Cook bell pepper and onion with 2 tablespoons water in microwave for 2 minutes or saute for 5 minutes in small amount of oil. Add eggs bread crumbs and rest of ingredients to meat. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. As soon as it comes from the oven put 1/2 cup Arbys sauce or any seasoned catsup on top.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Cook peas in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes. Rinse with cold water. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Green Pepper Jelly
instructions: Combine lemon juice vinegar and sugar in large pot and bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute and add green peppers and boil for 5 minutes. Stir in Certo and food coloring if desired. Place in hot jars. If you wish to strain the bits of peppers from the juice do so before adding the Certo. Also if you like hot sauces blend or chop 6 to 8 hot peppers with the green peppers. Delicious with cream cheese or meats.

title: Fish Milanese
instructions: Mix oil lemon juice salt pepper and onion. Rinse fish and pat dry. Place fish in marinade coat well. Cover and refrigerate. In one hour turn fish over. Leave in refrigerator for 1 more hour. Mix eggs and milk. Dip fish in egg mixture coat with flour and then bread crumbs firmly around fish. Refrigerate for about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove from skillet. Melt 1/4 cup butter add garlic and cook until light brown. Add parsley and pour over fish. Serve with lemon wedge.

title: Lazy Day Stew
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Chili Spaghetti
instructions: Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Put in 13 x 9 x 2 sprayed pan. Cover.

title: Hot Brown
instructions: Combine yellow cheese 1/2 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce with white sauce and stir over low heat until cheese melts. Place a slice of turkey on each slice of toast and cover with cheese sauce. Place 2 strips of bacon on each sandwich and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese. Place on pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and cheese melts.

title: Boiled Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil sugar cocoa milk and butter; cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and quickly add oats peanut butter vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper. Let stand for 1/2 hour until cool (if you can).

title: Zebras
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Line with foil. Grease foil. Melt 1 cup chocolate chips in a small saucepan over low heat stirring often. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Mix flour and baking powder.

title: Cloud Biscuits
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together to resemble crumbs. Combine beaten eggs and milk. Mix well. Knead gently 20 strokes. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10-20 minutes.

title: Grape-Nuts Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients and whip or beat with electric mixer 5 minutes. Place in refrigerator a few hours.

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Place butter into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add squash salt and pepper. Combine beaten egg mayonnaise green pepper onion pimento and sugar. Pour over squash. Sprinkle evenly with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Potatoes Deluxe
instructions: Peel cooled potatoes and grate. Add rest of ingredients to potatoes. Bake in a covered casserole for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0. If you prefer put them in a slow cooker for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Vidalia Onion Pie
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms with margarine in saucepan; salt and pepper to taste. Set aside.

title: Christmas Brunch Jam
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 2 tablespoons of juice. Chop cherries in blender. Combine pineapple juice cherries and sugar in large nonaluminum Dutch oven over medium-high heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves. Bring to full rolling boil and boil 1 minute stirring. Stir in pectin. Boil 1 minute more. Remove from heat and skim off foam. Let stand for 10 minutes. Ladle into hot sterilized jars. Leave 1/4-inch space in top of jar. Process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes. (Put in a boiler of water and bring them to a boil and let them boil for 10 minutes.)

title: Grape Conserve
instructions: Wash grapes. Separate skins from grapes and pulp. For every six quarts of grape pulp add 2 cups of cold water and boil them until the seeds are all loosened out. Then run them through a Folely food mill then put the seedless pulp back in a large dish with the skins. Stir. Measure all this by the cup (as you put it in both pulp and skins). To 3 cups of grape mixture add 1 full cup of sugar and cook slowly for hours until real thick. When it is nearly done taste for sweetness as more sugar may be added.

title: Spritz
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix butter sugar egg yolks and vanilla thoroughly. Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting. Work in the flour. Using 1/4 of the dough at a time force dough through cookie press onto ungreased baking sheet in desired shapes. Bake 7 to 10 minutes or until set but not brown. Cookies may be decorated with colored sugar or cherries before baking.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown meat in skillet with onion and drain. Combine all ingredients and either bake for 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven or cook in a crock-pot overnight. Add shredded cheese immediately after cooking cycle.

title: Artichoke Spread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into baking pan and bake for 20 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven. Serve with crackers.

title: Hilda'S Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast in heavy pot. Brown all sides using no fat. Next season with salt and garlic powder. Cover and cook on low heat for 2 hours; do not add water! Remove roast from pan; cover. Add water to gravy mix as per directions. Add to pan gravy. Cook until thickened. Add wine and mushrooms. Slice roast and return to pan to reheat.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Bring vegetables to boil and cook until done. Meanwhile make thickening. Cook melted butter and flour until bubbly. Stir into soup and add cream and cheese.

title: Caramel Ice Cream Topping
instructions: Heat stove to 100\u00b0 or low setting. Put 1 cup sugar in saucepan. Stir until sugar clumps and turns very brown. Then pour 1 cup of water in pan with sugar. Keep stirring constantly until like syrup. Pour over ice cream. Very gooood.

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain paper towel. Save 1/4 cup drippings from bacon in skillet. In medium bowl tear lettuce into bite size pieces. Crumble bacon and with onion slices tossing until well mixed. Stir remaining ingredients over medium heat to boiling point stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add lettuce mixture tossing until lettuce is slightly wilted and coated with dressing.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees until done approximately 45 min.

title: Carrots In Orange Sauce
instructions: Wash and pare carrots. Cut into 1/2 x 3-inch strips. Put in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Dot with butter. Mix together all ingredients and pour over carrots. Cover loosely with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pork Tandori
instructions: Combine first nine ingredients. Pour over meat that has been well pierced. Leave 6 to 8 hours or more refrigerated. Remove bay leaves and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours basting frequently.

title: Baked Spinach
instructions: Combine spinach egg milk and cracker crumbs. Add seasoning and place in a buttered baking dish. Combine remaining crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar butter and milk to a rolling boil and boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Take off burner and add peanut butter cocoa vanilla and oats. Spoon onto wax paper. When cooled store in Tupperware to keep fresh.

title: Peanut Butter Quickies
instructions: In large saucepan combine sugar flour milk and butter. Bring to a hard boil; boil 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Blend well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

title: Mama'S Honey Wheat Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Combine next 4 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Stir to melt shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Add softened yeast. Gradually add flour to form a stiff dough.

title: Pecan Praline Sauce
instructions: Melt butter over low heat; add pecans. Cook and stir until light brown; add sugar and syrup. Continue to stir until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream.

title: Filled Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake as directed on box. Fill paper cups 2/3 full. Mix cream cheese with sugar. Beat in egg and salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop 1 teaspoon of mixture into each cup. Bake according to directions on cake mix. Dont undercook.

title: Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour oats baking powder salt and soda. Stir in buttermilk eggs and margarine until smooth. Using 1/4 cup batter for each pancake bake on hot griddle. Stir in a little more buttermilk if batter becomes thick. Makes 12 to 14 pancakes.

title: Chicken Dinner Bars
instructions: Melt marshmallows and margarine. Combine with Rice Krispies and pat into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat together sugar and syrup (do not boil). Add peanut butter. Pour over Rice Krispies mixture.

title: Mom Crews Coconut Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Cream together Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and blend. Combine soda and salt with flour then add to creamed mixture. Stir in oats nuts and coconut mixing thoroughly after each ingredient. Divide dough into 3 balls then shape into rolls and roll in wax paper. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into slices with a sharp knife. Bake at 375\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet about 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Peanut Butter Stove Top Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar and syrup to a full boil. Boil two minutes. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and corn flakes. Add nuts or coconut. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

title: Green Enchilada Sauce
instructions: Wash tomatoes; quarter and remove all seeds. Peel garlic. Put all ingredients in large pot with a quart of water. Watch pot so tomatoes wont stick. Add water as needed. When all tomatoes are tender take off stove and cool. Run everything through blender. Return to stove; bring to a boil. Put in quart jars and process 45 minutes. Makes 7 to 9 quarts.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Arrange broccoli in greased 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer chicken. Combine next three ingredients and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes.

title: Gelatin Jiggles
instructions: Combine unflavored gelatin and jello. Add boiling water. Stir until jello is completely dissolved. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares or use cookie cutters to make shapes.

title: Moravian Love Feast Buns(Butter Semmels)
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Stir in the mashed potato and 1/2 cup sugar. Cover; let stand in a warm place until doubled about 1 1/2 hours. Add the milk to the butter and stir until melted. Cool. Mix in the eggs 1/2 cup sugar and salt. Stir into yeast mixture. Add the flour gradually stirring in enough to form a soft dough. Knead dough on a floured surface until smooth. Place in a greased bowl; grease top of dough. Cover and let rise until double about 1 1/2 hours. Punch down dough and divide into two portions. Roll out one portion of dough into a 12-inch square 1/4-inch thick; brush with 1 tablespoon melted butter. Cut dough into 2-inch squares. Turn up the corners together.

title: Mushroom Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients except mushrooms and cheese. Cover tightly and microwave on High (100%) until rice is tender and water absorbed. Stir in mushrooms and sprinkle with cheese. Microwave 4 to 6 minutes longer. Serves 6.

title: Chili Rellenos
instructions: Wash peppers and cut open; clean out seeds. Cook hamburger; season with salt and garlic. Drain and fill peppers with hamburger meat and cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Apple Dumpling
instructions: Peel and core apples. Cut into quarters and roll each quarter in a crescent roll. Put into baking dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over rolls. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Apple Cake
instructions: Warm milk. Mix eggs and sugar. Mix dry ingredients alternately with milk into egg mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into greased pan. Cover batter with apple slices slanted upright. Sprinkle with sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Frozen Fluffy Strawberry Pie
instructions: In a 9-inch pie plate combine coconut with melted margarine or butter. Press firmly on bottom and sides of pie plate.

title: Prize Winning Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain well. Combine soup eggs mayonnaise onion salt and pepper. Add to broccoli. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese on top. Pour melted margarine over cheese. Spread stuffing on top. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix corn flour egg yolks salt and pepper. Beat egg whites separately until stiff. Mix corn batter with egg whites and fry in oil until brown and flip.

title: Bean And Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions; drain and put in a large pan. Drain the kidney beans and add to macaroni. Drain the stewed tomatoes and cut into smaller pieces. Add the tomatoes and tomato sauce to the pan. Cut the hot dogs into bite-size pieces and brown in a separate pan sprayed with a cooking spray. Add to mixture. Stir all ingredients together and simmer until hot. Serves 2 to 3. Goes well with a salad or cole slaw.

title: Spareribs And Sauerkraut(Friska Kiselo Zelje)
instructions: If the sauerkraut is too sour it should be rinsed in clean cold water; drain. Place sauerkraut in a kettle to cook. Add washed spareribs. Cook together adding hot water. When meat is tender make brown sauce. Add a little chopped onion and brown together. Pour into the cooking sauerkraut and spareribs. Boil a short time together. Remove from heat and serve hot with polenta or mashed potatoes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes until partially done. Put cream cheese cream of celery soup and milk in a pan and warm until mixed through. Pour over potatoes and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dijon Honey Mustard Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients and process until smooth. Serve over salad greens etc.

title: Company Stew
instructions: Mix and pour soups water wine and mushrooms over lightly floured and browned stew meat. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 3 1/2 hours. Remove from oven. Fold in sour cream and serve.

title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
instructions: In saucepan bring pineapple to a boil. Remove from heat. Add jello and stir to dissolve. Add buttermilk and mix well. Cool slightly. Fold in whipped topping and nuts. Chill until mixture mounds. Pour into 8 1/2-cup lightly-oiled mold or pour into an 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish. Refrigerate. Makes 12 servings.

title: Rhubarb Torte
instructions: Coat rhubarb with mixture of white sugar and 3 tablespoons flour. Place in baking dish. Top with a mixture of the butter 1 cup flour and the brown sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with Cool Whip to serve.

title: Sausage Gravy
instructions: Fry sausage until brown. Dont drain grease just add flour until sausage is coated with flour. Then add milk salt and pepper. Cook on medium heat until bubbly. Serve with biscuits.

title: Sugar Ridge Farm Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a greased 3-quart casserole place a layer of thin sliced potatoes some ham handfuls of onions cheese peas and a sprinkling of salt and pepper. Dust with flour and re-layer potatoes and cheese. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs or crushed corn flakes. Lay a few chunks of margarine on top. Fill casserole with milk until about 2 inches from top. Bake in slow oven (300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0) for 2 1/2 hours until potatoes are done.

title: Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Cut up beef and onions (stems and all). Mix everything together. Form a ball. Roll ball in ground nuts. Serve with crackers.

title: Mulled Cider
instructions: Heat covered but do not boil. Hold over very low heat 15 minutes to allow flavors to develop.

title: Grapefruit Fizz
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar water and spices. Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Strain. Combine with grapefruit juice lime juice and ginger ale. Pour over ice cubes and garnish with lime slices. Very refreshing!

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Grate cheese and let come to room temperature. Cream cheese and butter until well blended. Add other ingredients. Use a cookie press with a star-shaped disk to shape dough into long rows on cookie sheet. With a knife cut across rows to make individual straws. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes or until light brown. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Mix ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Henrietta'S Butter Cookies
instructions: Dip apple slices in batter and deep fry in hot oil. I sometimes dip the slices in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon before dipping them in batter.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine sugar and spices; blend well. Stir in flour applesauce and baking soda; beat well. Add raisins. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: White Christmas Fudge
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in heavy 2-quart saucepan. Stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture reaches a boil. Boil over moderate heat 9 to 10 minutes to 238\u00b0 (cook to 240\u00b0 if weather is damp) to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and allow to stand until lukewarm (110\u00b0) about 1 hour. Add vanilla and beat until mixture just begins to lose its gloss and holds its shape. Requires very little beating. Quickly stir in walnuts and cherries and turn into oiled pan. Let stand until firm before cutting. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Broccoli Salad #1
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Add to broccoli mixture just before serving.

title: Spiced Pretzels
instructions: Break pretzels into bite size pieces and spread on cookie sheet. Pour oil over the pretzels. Mix the rest of the ingredients and sprinkle over the pretzels. Toss together. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes.

title: Texas Cowboy Goulash
instructions: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed on package. Set aside. Brown ground hamburger and onion in skillet. Drain off fat. Stir in chili powder. Add tomatoes and juice. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add corn and stir. Pour all into macaroni and cheese. Mix well. Yields 6 servings.

title: Old Fashioned Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans in water to cover overnight. Drain and place in large soup kettle. Add ham bone and 3 quarts of water. Simmer slowly for an hour. Stir in mashed potatoes and let simmer another hour. Then add all the remaining ingredients and simmer another hour or until done. Remove the ham bone; dice the meat off of it and return the meat to the kettle. Discard the bone. Serve with corn bread or large chunks of warm French bread.

title: Chicken Rotel Spaghetti
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Save 1 1/2 cups of broth and cook spaghetti in chicken broth; do not drain. Dice chicken into bite size pieces. Dice cheese and add to hot spaghetti. Stir until cheese is melted. Saute onion in butter. Add all ingredients. Pour into two 9 x 13-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Mix ginger with half the flour and coat pork. Heat oil in large frying pan; brown coated pork and remove from pan. Drain pineapple and reserve syrup. Add water to pineapple syrup to make 2/3 cup. (If not using pineapple use 2/3 cup water.) Stir liquid into remaining flour. Add liquid mixture vinegar and 2 tablespoons soy sauce to fat in frying pan. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Add sugar pepper and pork. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 1 hour over low heat. Add pineapple and green pepper and cook uncovered for 10 minutes.

title: Florence'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar in mixer. Add eggs (unbeaten) sour cream flour baking powder and baking soda. Mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Grease and flour large tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Turkey Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix turkey and poultry seasoning. Add egg catsup soy sauce Worcestershire sauce cracker crumbs salt and pepper.

title: Gas Grilled Chicken
instructions: Wash and clean chicken. Do not cut up. Salt to taste cover with foil. Before closing foil pour in the cup of water. Close foil. Place on grill and cook with hood down for 1 hour at 350 degrees. Uncover and brush on sauce. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Nanimo Bars
instructions: In double boiler cook first 5 ingredients until thick. Add graham cracker crumbs coconut and walnuts. Press into 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill. Cream butter pudding sugar and flavoring. Spread over first mixture and chill. Melt chocolate and butter; spread over top.

title: Hanky Panky
instructions: Brown meats and drain off fat. Add cheese and spices and stir until melted. Toast bread with a little margarine on each piece. Spread a small amount of meat mixture on each piece of toasted bread and place in warm oven until ready to serve. This is a great little appetizer and recipe freezes well.

title: Apple Joy Cake
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar and mix until fluffy. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to egg mixture. Continue to beat. Add oil gradually. When all mixed add apples nuts and flavoring. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hamburg Soup
instructions: Saute onions until tender adding hamburg to keep moist. Flavor with parsley oregano and basil. Set aside when browned and pour off fat. Boil potatoes in tomato juice and add corn with juice when tender. Combine all ingredients and simmer about 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Cut in shortening with dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and mix until ball forms. Do not knead. Pat out onto a floured board and cut with a large cutter. Bake in a 500\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Makes 20 to 25 biscuits.

title: Easy Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt the chocolate and butter until blended. Beat the eggs and sugar together. Combine all ingredients. Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake for 25 minutes in a 375\u00b0 preheated oven. Top with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Blueberry Streusel Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix cake mix sour cream and eggs in large bowl until blended. Fold in blueberries. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Sprinkle with Streusel Topping. Bake about 25 minutes.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan; mix and pour batter into pan. Mix blackberries water and sugar in bowl; pour fruit on top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Combine pudding and 3 cups milk. Beat for 2 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip.

title: Coconut Chews
instructions: Cook butter sugar dates and egg for 11 minutes over direct heat. Remove from heat and add Rice Krispies and walnuts. Drop from spoon into coconut and roll into balls.

title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Beat egg whites until frothy. Stir in crumbs onions parsley garlic tarragon salt and pepper. Mix into ground turkey. Broil until cooked through.

title: Mustard Grilled Boneless Chicken Breasts
instructions: Paint chicken breasts on both sides with mustard. Sprinkle lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce over and allow to marinate at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes. Preheat broiler or outdoor grill. Grill chicken for 3 to 4 minutes each side or until just tender. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix vegetables seasoning packet water and margarine in a bowl; add crumbs; stir until water is absorbed. Mix gravy chicken vegetables and thyme in a 2-quart casserole. Spoon stuffing over chicken mixture. Bake for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Pie Pastry
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Add oil and milk; mix well. Roll to size you want.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; set aside. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs and sugar. Combine oil and orange juice and add alternately with dry ingredients to egg/sugar mixture. Mix until smooth; add vanilla and beat well. Pour half of the batter into a greased and floured tube pan.

title: Crock Pot Ham And Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Put half of ham potatoes and onions in Crock Pot. Sprinkle with salt and pepper then grated cheese. Repeat with remaining half spoon undiluted soup over top seal edges. Cover and cook on Low 8-10 hours or High 4 hours. Stir well and serve.

title: Aunt Shirley'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: *1 square of chocolate is equal to 3 Tbsp. cocoa baking powder plus 1 Tbsp. shortening.

title: Orange Buttermilk Molded Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple with syrup to boil. Remove from heat and stir in Jell-O. Cool to room temperature. Stir in buttermilk; fold in Cool Whip and pecans. Pour into 8 cup molds and chill 4 hours.

title: Cheesy Turnips And Carrots
instructions: In a saucepan combine turnips carrots ginger water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and cook over medium-high heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender; drain and reserve liquid. Set vegetables aside.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients. Add eggs. Sift together flour cocoa baking powder and salt and add to first mixture. Add nuts and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Chinese Chop Suey
instructions: May also use veal lamb or chicken.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Medley
instructions: Cook broccoli and cauliflower as directed. Add rest of ingredients and mix. Put in greased casserole (2-quart) and bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes and uncovered for 15 minutes.

title: Jackstraw Eggplant
instructions: Cut eggplant in half lengthwise; peel. Slice 1/2-inch thick. Cut slice sin 1/2-inch strips. Beat flour water egg oil sugar and salt. Dip eggplant in batter. Allow excess batter to drain off. Fry a few at a time in deep hot fat (365\u00b0) for 4 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper toweling. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: A B'S Chicken Wings
instructions: For 20 Wings Boil water in large pot. Drop in wings and boil for 8 more minutes. Mix hot sauce margarine and mustard in bowl. Microwave in short intervals and keep stirring. Then add Good Seasons package. Brush on wings and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Do not turn wings during cooking.

title: Potato O'Brien
instructions: Place in a baking dish in order listed. Sprinkle corn flakes over top of first 5 ingredients. Drizzle margarine over top of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix in order and put in greased pan (I use a bundt pan). Bake at 325 for 1 hour. Allow cake to remain in pan and cover with glaze.

title: Molly'S Breakfast Egg Thing
instructions: Alternate layers of bread cheeses and olives in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine eggs mustard and milk. Pour over layers. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Salsa
instructions: Season sliced cucumbers with salt and fresh or dried dill weed. Cover with sour cream and chill for 1 or 2 hours.

title: Coal Flowers
instructions: Place a piece of coal in a deep glass dish. Pour the liquid around the coal but not on it. Dot the coal with the red ink. Do not move the dish and coral-like crystals will soon appear and spread over the coal. They will grow to a height of about 1/2-inch in a sponge-like appearance and will last for weeks.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar butter and Crisco. Add one egg at a time. Mix dry ingredients and add alternating with milk. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar and thoroughly cream. Add eggs one at a time and cream. Add chocolate which has been melted and vanilla. Gradually fold in sifted flour and baking powder alternately with milk. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes two 10-inch layers or three 8-inch layers.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine and bring to a boil spices brown sugar 1/3 cup water and 2 tablespoons butter or margarine. Pour over cooked sweet potato halves arranged in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until liquid is somewhat thickened. Baste frequently while baking.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix eggs sugar oil and pumpkin together in large bowl. Combine rest of ingredients in a separate bowl then add to pumpkin mixture. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook and bone chicken. Place chicken in buttered baking dish. Mix sour cream and soup. Add peas and carrots; mix. If needed add some broth. Pour over chicken. Top with crackers. Melt margarine and pour over crackers. If using grated cheese omit margarine and top with cheese. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put in 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle top with stuffing mix or cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add rest of ingredients using just enough flour to be able to roll out and cut into fat cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until golden. Sprinkle with sugar on tops before baking (optional).

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into crust. Chill until set 3 to 4 hours. Top with pie filling.

title: Super Seafood Spread
instructions: Place seafood of your choice in mixing bowl. Break up finely with fork. Add remaining ingredients except olives. Mix well. Chill. Garnish with olives and additional picante sauce if desired. Serve with crackers chips or raw vegetables. Makes about 2 1/2 cups of dip.

title: Dr. Carter'S Chicken #2
instructions: Wash and skin chicken. Place in 9 x 12-inch Pyrex dish. Spoon on preserves and dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: High Altitude Decrease baking powder to 1 1/2 teaspoons.

title: A. B. C. Salad
instructions: Put in a large pan. Chill until firm.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Fry hamburger; season with salt pepper and garlic powder. Mix in chili. Spread cream cheese in 9 x 9-inch pan. Spread seasoned meat over cheese. Top with diced green onions tomato and green pepper. Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave until cheese is melted. Serve with taco chips.

title: Sausage Cake
instructions: Combine sausage and sugars until well blended Add eggs and beat well. Sift together four spices and baking powder. Stir baking soda into coffee. Add flour mixture and coffee alternately to meat mixture beating well after each addition. Pour boiling water to cover over raisins and let stand 5 minutes. Drain well and pat dry with paper towel. Fold raisins and walnuts into batter Turn into well greased and floured Bundt pan (9c size). Bake 1 1/2 hours or until done at 350. Cool 15 minutes before turning out of pan. To store wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Surprise Cobbler
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar. Add sweet milk and beat together. Pour batter into a greased pan. Pour juicy fruit over batter and bake slowly about 35 minutes.

title: Shrimp Chowder
instructions: Sauce onions. Add 2 cans soup milk corn cheese and shrimp. Simmer until cheese is melted and flavors are blended. Good served with fresh spinach salad.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt chocolate bits peanut butter and margarine together. Stir in Chex cereal and marshmallows. Dump this into a grocery bag with powdered sugar and shake.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Appetizers
instructions: Grease a square 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix Bisquick water and oregano until dough forms. Turn onto floured surface. Gently roll in flour to coat. Knead 50 times. Divide dough into halves. Roll each half into 9-inch squares. Place one square into pan. Beat eggs slightly; reserve 1 tablespoon. Mix rest of eggs broccoli and 1 1/2 cups cheese thoroughly. Spread over square in pan.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Heat oil in large frying pan. Add onions and garlic. Cook until soft over low heat. Turn up heat and add the meat stirring until it is well browned.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar Karo and oleo to boil. Add peanut butter; stir until creamy. Remove from fire. Add corn flakes. Drop from spoon onto cookie sheet or pour onto cookie sheet. Cool and break. (No baking.)

title: Chocolate Logs
instructions: Mix together sugar dates peanut butter walnuts and butter. Shape into logs and chill for 2 hours.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Sprinkle jello over cottage cheese. Mix well. Stir in fruit cocktail. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Oyster Cracker Snacks
instructions: Mix oil dill weed and dressing mix. Pour over oyster crackers. Stir well until absorbed. Cover several hours and stir well again.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding and milk. Blend until thick. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer graham crackers in a large dish. Pour 1/2 pudding over crackers. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Layer crackers again and repeat. Finish with crackers.

title: Broccoli Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil spaghetti and rinse. In large container toss with 1/2 Wish-Bone dressing. Cook Skroodles; drain. Rinse. Add to spaghetti and Wish-Bone dressing.

title: Buster Boy Freeze
instructions: Crust Crush cookies and mix with 1/2 cup melted margarine. Pat all but 3/4 cup in a 9 x 13 pan. Freeze 1 hour.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (it helps if they are room temperature) in a bowl. Roll them into little balls and bake on a cookie sheet or baking pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan mix potatoes and broth. Heat to boiling; cover and turn heat to low and cook gently 2 to 3 minutes until potatoes are tender. Mix cornstarch with a little of the milk blending until smooth. Combine with remaining milk and salt; stir into potato mixture. Heat to boiling stirring until mixture is smooth and slightly thickened. Remove from heat and add cheese parsley and butter. Add vegetables and meat.

title: Garden Salad
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together; then mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar and pour over vegetables. Serve.

title: Boneless Chunky Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash and cut chicken into bite-size pieces. In a blender add stuffing parsley and cheese until fine. Melt margarine; dip chicken rolling in stuffing mixture. Place on a cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes. Voila!!

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions: Cover beans with water. Add baking soda and bring to a boil. Cover and let stand 30 minutes.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine sugar and milk in saucepan. Boil for 3 to 4 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter vanilla and cocoa; fold in nuts and oats. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool thoroughly before serving.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and add ground meat. Cook until brown. Mix other ingredients and put in casserole dish. Cook 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix pecans melted margarine and flour together well. Spread in bottom of 9 X 13 baking dish. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Beat until smooth powdered sugar cream cheese and 2 Tablespoons milk. Spread over cooled crust. Beat until smooth pudding and 3 cups milk. Spread over cream cheese layer. Top with cool whip. Refrigerate and serve cold.

title: Lima Beans In Carrot Ring
instructions: Cook limas according to directions and drain. Saute shallots in butter. Add yogurt and parsley. Stir to blend. Add cooked limas. Spoon into center of carrot ring. Serve immediately. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Mexican Cream Cake
instructions: Dump all together and mix. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Mix all ingredients; form into balls. Press with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until bottoms turn light brown.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on Ritz crackers; garnish with lettuce and tomatoes or fill pocket bread.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Bake pastry shell at 425\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove from oven. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Cut 6 slices cheese into pieces. In skillet brown meat and pour off fat. Add tomato sauce pepper onion and bouillon. Cook and stir until bouillon dissolves. Remove from heat. Stir in eggs flour and cheese pieces. Turn into prepared shell and bake 20 minutes or until hot. Top with remaining cheese slices. Bake 3 minutes longer. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: In saucepan cook bacon until crisp; remove bacon and set aside. To drippings add potatoes celery carrots onion water salt and pepper. Cook covered for about 15 minutes or until tender. Combine flour with small amount of milk until dissolved. Add to potato mixture along with remaining milk. Cook over medium heat until mixture boils. Garnish with bacon. Makes 4 to 5 servings. Tips Bacon can be omitted. Cook vegetables in water as directed. Add 2 tablespoons butter when adding milk.

title: Chicken And Gravy
instructions: Coat chicken with flour. Arrange it in single layers skins down in melted butter in a baking dish. Bake uncovered in moderate oven 425\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn chicken; bake until brown 15 to 20 minutes. Pour excess fat. Combine canned milk soup cheese salt and pepper. Add chopped onion and mushrooms to chicken. Pour milk mixture over chicken and add paprika. Cover dish with foil. Reduce temperature to 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Strawberry Cooler
instructions: In blender container place orange juice strawberries and pineapple juice. Cover and blend until frothy. Stir in carbonated water; pour over ice in tall glasses. Makes 5 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Fruit Salad Mix
instructions: Mix and sprinkle dry jello over cottage cheese; mix well. Add all ingredients together. Add Cool Whip; mix well. Cool for 4 hours or overnight. Any flavor jello may be used. Orange is the original flavor.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour; pat mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Squares
instructions: Mix well until blended. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch dish and bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carolina Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with sugar. Add eggs and beat mixture well. Add vinegar vanilla and nuts mix well. Put in unbaked pie shell and bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. This pecan pie is lighter and not as sweet as most pecan pie recipes.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Scald milk; add sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm and crumble in yeast. Stir in beaten eggs. Add flour and beat thoroughly. Cover and let rise until double in bulk. Place in a Sally Lunn ring mold or tubular pan (I use a Bundt pan). Let rise again until double in bulk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 16 large servings.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix Miracle Whip Italian seasoning garlic salt and black pepper; set aside. Cook rotini and drain. Add Swiss cheese while still hot then add to Miracle Whip mixture and add vegetables. You may use any or all of the different vegetables.

title: White Chili
instructions: Combine chicken and broth in 6-quart pot. Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Remove chicken from broth and skim off fat. Bone and cube chicken. Saute onions and garlic in olive oil until tender. Add chopped chilies cumin Tabasco sauce oregano and cinnamon. Do this in original pot. Add broth (6 cups should be left) and soaked beans. Cook until beans are done. Add chicken cubes and season to taste. Just before serving add 1 cup of shredded cheese.

title: Cottage Pudding
instructions: Stir shortening just to soften. Add egg. Beat well. Stir in dry ingredients. Add milk. Blend well. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Layer potatoes and onion in baking dish. Melt oil in pan; add flour; stir until smooth. Gradually add broth mayonnaise or sour cream salt and a little pepper. Stir until thick. Pour over taters; sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake 2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Put crackers in large bowl. Put garlic powder onion powder dill weed and dressing mix on crackers. Warm up the oil and pour over crackers. Bake in 200\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper. Drain well then add sauce mixture oregano salt and pepper. Let simmer 10 minutes. Cook the spaghetti and drain. Add to sauce mixture then pour into a large greased baking dish. Top with cheeses and arrange pepperoni on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until it bubbles and cheeses are melted.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Remove seeds from grapes; cut each grape into quarters. Slice apples and banana into small wedges. Lightly mix fruit in bowl. Add Miracle Whip lemon juice and vinegar. Lightly mix. Serves 4.

title: Apple Cream Cake
instructions: Sift together all the dry ingredients. Stir in the apple and 1/4 cup nuts. Combine butter milk and egg. Stir into the flour mixture and blend only. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch round pan. Spread sour cream over top. Combine sugars and spread over the sour cream. Sprinkle on remaining nuts. Bake at 400\u00b0 in preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm with butter or whipped cream. It is also good cold.

title: Cheesecake Delight
instructions: Tear cake into small hunks and put in 9 x 13 pan. Whip Dream Whip according to package direction. Cut cream cheese into small bits and add to Dream Whip. Whip until smooth. Pour over cake and stir gently until all the cake is covered. Pour pie filling on top and smooth so it will look nice Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Sour Cream Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes cream cheese and sour cream. Mash together. Add a small amount of milk if needed. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate until needed. Drizzle melted oleo on top and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until heated through. Very good.

title: Toll House Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Add flour sugar and brown sugar; beat until well blended. Add melted butter or margarine. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts; mix well. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream. (May freeze.)

title: Bee'S Gooseberry Pie
instructions: Wash some gooseberries and put some sugar on them. Boil them on the stove. Rol out a crust and put it in a pie plate. Put the berries in the crust and fold over the ends. Dot with butter and sprinkle with sugar. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven until done. Serves 6 to 8. Put some ice cream on top and youll swallow your tongue honey!

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck in shortening. Add onion tomatoes ketchup steak sauce and green pepper. Simmer for 30 minutes. Cook macaroni according to package directions and combine macaroni and ground beef mixture in a baking dish. Season to taste. Gently spoon cream of mushroom soup into mixture. (Put cheese on top before you bake.)

title: Cinnamon Cake
