instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour mixture into Bundt pan or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Dottie'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix and simmer. For 1 chicken or 6 chops.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Tear chicken into pieces and place in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix soup and sour cream with chicken. Mix stuffing mix with chicken broth. Place on top of chicken mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Crumble cornbread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread pinto beans over cornbread. Layer lettuce tomato onions pepper pickles and bacon. Combine mayonnaise and pickle juice until smooth. Pour over salad.

title: No Bake Cocoa Haystacks
instructions: Combine sugar butter milk and cocoa in medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to full boil; remove from heat.

title: Pumpkin Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with Ginger Cookies.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a large bowl until well blended. Flour and grease 2 loaf pans or 1 tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves or 1 (10-inch) tube pan. Remove when cooled.

title: Johnny Applesauce Cake(Century Old Recipe)
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar and blend well. Add beaten eggs and applesauce. Add remaining ingredients. Bake about 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Ritz Cracker Treats
instructions: Mix together butter brown sugar and nuts. Pile 1/2 teaspoon mix on a Ritz cracker. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes. Store in an airtight container.

title: Korean Wings
instructions: Mix all ingredients except wings in a large glass bowl. Add wings. Marinate overnight.

title: Speedy Scalloped Spinach
instructions: If using frozen spinach cook as directed. If using frozen or canned be sure to drain well. Blend soup seasoned salt onion and\tmilk. Combine\twith spinach and blend well. Spoon into buttered casserole dish and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Double Chocolate Mint Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt over hot (not boiling) water 3/4 cup mint-chocolate morsels; stir until smooth. Remove from heat; cool. In bowl combine flour baking soda and salt; set aside. In another bowl combine melted chocolate butter brown sugar sugar and vanilla; beat well. Gradually blend in flour mixture. Stir in remaining 3/4 cup mint-chocolate morsels and nuts.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger meat then drain fat. Add Veg-All tomatoes and sauce okra and onions. Cook on medium heat about 20 minutes. When done add spaghetti noodles. Then cook until noodles are tender. Salt and pepper to taste. You may have to add a little water to make it more soupy.

title: Fried Rice - Grandpa Lim'S Recipe
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in cooking oil until golden. Add chicken and cooking wine. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Add vegetables m.s.g. and salt. When vegetables are soft add cooked rice in small amounts mixing it through vegetables. Add soy sauce and mix well. When ingredients are thoroughly heated add sesame oil and toss. Ready to serve.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer nuts and coconut in pan. Mix cake mix according to directions and pour over nuts and coconut. Mix margarine cream cheese and sugar with mixer until smooth and creamy. Drop by spoonfuls over cake batter until covered. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes and turn out on large platter or cookie sheet.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Shape into balls. Press with a fork and crisscross. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add soup milk cheese and rice and mix in broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix well. Roll in small balls about the size of a walnut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Mix all together well. Bake in 12 Pam-sprayed muffin pans. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine sugar salt and spices; add pumpkin milk and eggs. Beat until smooth. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes; lower heat to 350\u00b0. Bake another 40 minutes.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Combine flour baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Stir in almonds raisins and rind. Turn into 2 well-greased 7 x 3 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Apple Torte
instructions: Pat 1/2 of this mixture into a cake pan.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix ingredients of crust together on medium speed until crumbly. Press into a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Breakfast Quiche
instructions: Cut bread in 1/2 slices; lay on the bottom of a pie pan (ovensafe). Mix salt in eggs. Pour eggs on top. Put ham grated cheese bell pepper and onion on it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Put 1/2 sliced cheese on top. Bake another 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce and chopped vegetables. Frost the top with mayonnaise and cover with cheese and bacon. This will keep in icebox for 2 days. I usually make just half the recipe.

title: Easy Cheesy Fudge Brownies
instructions: Grease oblong pan. Prepare filling. Heat butter and chocolate in small saucepan until melted. Cool. Mix chocolate sugar eggs and vanilla in large bowl on medium speed. Beat in flour on low speed. Spread half of dough in pan. Spread with cream cheese filling. Gently swirl through dough with spoon.

title: Quiche
instructions: Prepare 1 (9-inch) pie crust. Bake for 5 minutes. Sprinkle 1/2 to 3/4 pound cooked bacon or crumbled sausage in shell. Grate Cheddar cheese over meat. Mix eggs salt and half and half. Pour into shell over meat and cheese. Sprinkle pepper on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Skillet Corn
instructions: Rinse beef if salty. Lightly fry beef and onion in oleo until beef begins to curl. Stir in flour; add corn. Heat until hot. Add milk cheese green pepper and olives. Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Serve on buttered toast.

title: Peppermint Chocolate Bonbons
instructions: Mix chocolate chips margarine and cream in heavy saucepan. Place over very low heat and stir until chips and margarine are melted and mixture is smooth and thick. Remove from heat. Beat in powdered sugar until mixture is smooth again. Stir in peppermint extract. Cover and chill 1 to 2 hours until mixture is thick enough to shape or drop into small candy cups. Divide mixture into 24 portions. Drop with No. 70 small scoop or roll into small balls before placing in candy cups. Makes about 24 bon bons.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onions (do not brown). Add hamburger to onions and drain when done. Add spaghetti sauce. Add tomato sauce. (Rinse cans so there will be enough water in sauce.) Cook about 1 hour.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry salt pork and onions until lightly browned; add water potatoes and pepper. Boil 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Heat fresh clams and clam liquor to boiling; add with milk to soup mixture and again bring to a boil. Pour chowder over plain or crumbled crackers in a serving bowl. Makes 6 servings.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Cook the first 7 ingredients until thickened. Cool in the refrigerator. Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Shipwrecked Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until ground beef is done.

title: Raspberry Jello Salad
instructions: Mix all together and set.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine sugar mustard salt and vinegar in a saucepan and boil for 1 minute. Cool to lukewarm and slowly blend in oil celery seed and grated onion. Keep in refrigerator and use as needed. This is delicious on fresh leaf lettuce.

title: Lemon Bites
instructions: Mix flour butter and powdered sugar and press into 9 inch square pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Beat the rest of the ingredients and pour over crust. Bake 25 minutes more. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken. When done shred chicken. Mix 1 can cream of chicken soup with sour cream. Stir in chicken and put in casserole dish.

title: Cornmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and egg; beat well. Add the other ingredients; mix well. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown. (They have a better flavor when baked no longer than the light brown stage.)

title: Mexene Style Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter and cook onions until tender; stir in shrimp and let brown. Stir in Mexene seasoning flour salt and gradually add milk. Cook about 5 minutes. Stir in tomato catsup bay leaf and Worcestershire sauce. Let steam a few minutes. Serve over boiled rice while hot.

title: Mom'S Pumpkin Pies
instructions: Beat all together at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into 2 (9-inch) unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Party Mints
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine egg whites 1/2 pound sugar corn syrup extract and food color. Beat on low speed until ingredients are just blended. Increase speed to high; beat until stiff peaks are formed occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula. Beat time is 7 to 8 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Mix ingredients with water making a stiff dough. Roll dough thin and cut into pieces about 2 x 3 inches. Drop dumplings into broth. Cover and reduce heat to medium cooking about 5 minutes. Do not stir dumplings.

title: Chicken In Mushroom Soup
instructions: Cut up chicken and wash. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle dry onion soup all over chicken. Mix soup and pour over. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until chicken is done.

title: Tri-Tip Marinade
instructions: To marinade mix seasonings and liquids. Pour over your tri-tip. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Grill tri-tip and use marinade as a basting sauce.

title: Holiday Pate
instructions: Melt butter. Add onion and add chicken livers. Cook 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Add 3/4 cup broth sherry paprika allspice salt pepper and garlic. Cook 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add the bourbon. Soften the gelatin in the remaining 3/4 cup broth and cook over boiling water until dissolved. Place the chicken liver mixture in a blender. Blend until smooth. Stir the gelatin and walnuts into the mixture. Turn into or 5 or 6 cup mold or into several small molds and chill until firm. Can be frozen.

title: Simmered Sirloin With Noodles
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet cook beef onions mushrooms and garlic in butter over medium heat for 5-7 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink. Add the consomme Worcestershire sauce and basil; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 50-60 minutes.

title: Lasagna
instructions: 1. Heat oil in skillet. Cook onion over moderate heat until soft. Add meat and brown it. 2. Add rest of ingredients and cover. Cook over low heat 45 minutes stirring occasionally. 3. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Do not grease pan. Put small amount of sauce in bottom of pan. Lay in half the lasagna noodles (uncooked). Spread 1/2 the bucket of cottage cheese 1/2 mozzarella cheese. 4. Pour on half of sauce. Repeat layers. Top with parmesan cheese. Bake 35-40 minutes until bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Mix all ingredients except preserves and pack in a mold. Fill center with preserves and serve with crackers.

title: Pickled Cranberries
instructions: Boil with lid for 5 minutes (not berries). Add cranberries. Let come to boil. Stir gently not to crush berries. Cook for 2 minutes. Cool and store in refrigerator until served.

title: Lady Finger Candy
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Melt margarine peanut butter and vanilla together. Add to first mixture. Mix well. Roll out into balls. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Dip round balls into this with fork. Let dry on foil.

title: Hornets Nest Cake
instructions: Cook pudding until done. Empty cake mix contents into bowl. Pour cooked pudding into mix; stir thoroughly. Pour this into a greased cake pan. Sprinkle pecan chips and butterscotch chips evenly over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: Mix flour and cocoa. Add eggs and sugar. Add vanilla then melted butter. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until pie has begun to set. Dont overcook.

title: Creamy Brussels Sprouts And Noodles
instructions: Cook Brussels sprouts according to package directions. Meanwhile cook noodles in boiling salted water according to package directions. Drain well; rinse with hot water. Cook onions in 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large frying pan until transparent. Remove from heat. Blend in garlic paprika salt caraway seed sour cream and cottage cheese. Fold in noodles and sprouts. Spread in a 2-quart casserole. Mix bread crumbs with butter; sprinkle casserole and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Easy Rhubarb Dessert
instructions: Mix cake according to package. Pour batter into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread rhubarb over batter. Sprinkle sugar over and pour cream over top. Do not mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Pie Crust
instructions: Mix all together and knead. Makes 4 double pies. Roll out and bake according to type of pie you are making.

title: Oven Baked Spareribs
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour over spareribs and marinate overnight turning several times. Line shallow pan with foil.

title: Perfectly Easy Dinner Rolls
instructions: STEP ONE Combine water and yeast in large bowl. Let the mixture stand until yeast is foamy about 5 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Chop vegetables and cook with ground beef until crumbly and slightly brown. Add other ingredients and bake in a covered dish for 2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Whip egg whites until very stiff. Fold into mixture of all ingredients; stir until well mixed. Pour into shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes then at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into rolls. Wrap in wax paper and freeze at least 6 hours. Bake at 275\u00b0 until light brown. Slice real thin and put on greased cookie sheet.

title: Good 'N Easy Roast
instructions: Place roast in crock-pot. Add soup on top of roast. Do not add water. Cover. Cook on high for 5 hours or until roast is tender. Remove roast then soup which is now great gravy.

title: Brandy Slush
instructions: Boil together and cool the water and tea bags. Combine all ingredients and freeze in a large plastic container that mixture can be scooped from. To serve scoop frozen mixture into a glass and pour 7-Up Sprite or sour mix over it. It is delicious and serves a large crowd.

title: Stephen'S Favorite Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking soda and salt in small bowl. Beat margarine and sugars in large bowl with mixer until fluffy. Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture; beat until blended. Stir in chocolate chips and crisp rice cereal.

title: Mrs. Will Johnson'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and boil until well blended. Keep warm while using. (Roast your meat; use sauce as desired.)

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: In a 2-quart pan mix sugar and cocoa together until blended. Add butter and milk. Bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes. (Do not stir while boiling.) Turn heat off. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Mix until peanut butter is melted then stir in oats. Spoon onto wax paper.

title: Caramel Popcorn Bars
instructions: In a large bowl combine popcorn cereal M&Ms and pretzels. Set aside.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix all wet ingredients together. Add dry ingredients. Mix very well. Put batter into small bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mom'S Orange Bread
instructions: Cut orange in quarters; remove seeds and white core. Grind or use blender. (Add enough water to juice and pulp to make one cup.) Combine with oleo and salt; bring to boil. Cool to lukewarm; add yeast. Beat until well blended. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Knead for about 10 minutes on a well floured board. Let rise in warm place until double in bulk. Knead again. Place in well greased loaf pan. Let rise. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Six Cup Salad
instructions: Mix well; put in covered bowl overnight.

title: Blu Cobbler With Cookie Dough Topping
instructions: Mix together blueberries 5 tablespoons sugar orange juice and cornstarch; put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat together the butter 1 cup sugar egg and vanilla. Add 1 cup flour baking powder and salt. Drop by tablespoon over blueberries. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. The topping should be golden brown.

title: Pudding Fruit Dessert
instructions: Drain fruit in a bowl. Set aside. Stir together pudding mixes. Pour in liquid slowly with pudding mixes. Mix well. Microwave on High until it boils and looks clean about 6 minutes. Stir 2 or 3 times while cooking. Cool. Add fruit. Chill for awhile. Then serve.

title: Pecan Delight
instructions: Mix cream cheese and stick of butter until fluffy. Add flour sugar and salt. Mix well. Divide dough into equal parts. Place in muffin tins and form into shells.

title: Zucchini Italiano
instructions: Make sausage balls and fry them. Cook onions and pepper in butter until tender. Stir in tomatoes and paste. Add seasonings. Slice zucchini (do not peel) in 1/2-inch slices. Add uncooked noodles and sausage balls. Cover and cook until zucchini and noodles are tender 45 minutes. Pour in a greased casserole dish and cover with strips of cheese. Place in a 350\u00b0 oven. Remove when cheese is melted.

title: Pork Hash With Tofu
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for tofu and mix well. Place in a large bowl and flatten mixture around bowl. Cube the tofu in blocks and place in center of bowl. Steam 45 minutes over boiling water.

title: Onion Bread
instructions: Heat all ingredients except yeast and flour. When WARM take off stove and stir in yeast. Knead in the flour and let raise like other bread. Make into loaves and let raise again. Bake 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Makes 4 average loaves.

title: Potato Custard
instructions: Mix and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm in middle.

title: Blender Salad Dressing(Dietetic)
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender and mix thoroughly. Store in refrigerator. Yield 3 cups. Exchanges 1 tablespoon = 1 fat. Calories 1 serving = 61.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together butter sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time. Continue beating. Add flour slowly. Add flavoring last and 7-Up. Cook in tube pan greased and floured at 320\u00b0 until done 1 1/2 hours or so.

title: Fruit Pizza(12 Servings)
instructions: Cook until thick; cool and pour over fruit. Refrigerate pizza.

title: Sugar Cookies (Soft)
instructions: Mix butter cream and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Mix in vinegar. Add flour one cup at a time. Mix well. Roll out and cut. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
instructions: Combine cucumbers and green onions in a large bowl. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Combine all remaining ingredients. Pour over cucumber mixture and mix well. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Peel and thinly slice carrots. Cook until tender. Drain and cool. Mix and bring to boil sugar vinegar oil pepper Worcestershire sauce mustard and soup. Slice onion pepper and celery thinly. Mix with cooked carrots. Remove sauce from heat and pour over carrots. May be served hot or cold.

title: Meal In A Casserole
instructions: Butter casserole dish and arrange vegetables in order given. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Mix undiluted soup with the uncooked ground beef in a separate bowl. Spread the meat mixture over the top of the vegetables in the casserole dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. When half done cover the casserole dish with foil.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Toast almonds and sesame seeds; toast Ramen noodles.

title: Candied Carrots
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a small bowl; stir well. Cook corn according to package directions. Transfer corn to a serving platter and brush margarine mixture over corn.

title: Lorenz Family Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the chicken in saucepan and bring to soft boil. Dunk chicken and place on outdoor grill. Continue to dunk chicken every time you turn it (approximately every 10 minutes). Grill over medium for about 1 hour.

title: Four Day Coconut Cake
instructions: Icing Combine sour cream sugar and frozen coconut. Mix and leave covered overnight in refrigerator.

title: Beef And Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain. Combine all ingredients and cook in crock-pot on low setting 4 to 6 hours.

title: Pecan Cookies
instructions: Beat egg white stiff. Beat in sifted sugar. Add vinegar and vanilla. Fold in pecans. Drop on greased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Antipasto Dip
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl; set aside. Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat; add onion and garlic and cook 3 minutes or until tender. Add vinegar and remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Pour over vegetables; cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Steak Subs
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat in hot oil cook beef green onions garlic and oregano until beef is brown. Stir often. Add in gravy. Heat through. Line bottom half of rolls with lettuce. Spoon about 1/4 cup mixture onto each roll. Top with cheese and tomatoes.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine Cool Whip lemonade and condensed milk blending well. Pour the mixture into crust and chill until firm about 2 hours.

title: Rocky Road Fudge
instructions: In a 3-quart microwave-safe bowl combine corn syrup and sugar. Mix well. Microwave on High (100% power) until the mixture boils about 3 minutes. Remove from microwave. Stir in peanut butter; mix until smooth. Add chips stirring until melted. Stir in peanuts and marshmallows. Immediately pour into a greased and foil-lined 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate until mixture is firm. Remove foil from pan and cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Tuna-Macaroni Pie
instructions: Cook the elbow macaroni in a large amount of boiling salted water until tender. Drain the macaroni and set aside. In a saucepan melt the butter; stir in the all-purpose flour salt and pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Stir in the chopped celery chopped onion and shredded cheese; stir until the cheese is melted. Combine the cheese sauce and the drained macaroni. Break tuna into chunks. Combine macaroni-cheese mixture tuna soft bread crumbs and beaten eggs. Turn mixture into a greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle tomato slices with salt. Arrange the tomato slices and American cheese triangles on top the macaroni mixture in baking dish. Return to oven. Bake 10 minutes more or until the cheese triangles melt and the tomato slices are heated through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Spinach Brownies
instructions: Add beaten eggs butter and milk to dry ingredients. Add other ingredients. Mix and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool; cut into squares. Freeze. To use thaw and reheat at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Potatoes On The Grill
instructions: Use heavy foil. On a square of foil place 1/2 potato. Top with onion slices salt pepper and butter. Top with other half of potato. Wrap tightly with foil and place on coals. Roast for 1/2 hour to 1 hour turning often. With oven mitt on squeeze to check doneness. I roast the potatoes first then when I am ready to grill the meat I move the potatoes to an area with no coals until the meat is done.

title: Carole'S Chicken
instructions: Set aside chicken breasts. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Place chicken in a deep dish or bowl and pour marinade over chicken. Marinate chicken overnight or for several hours. Grill chicken over hot fire for 3 minutes each side.

title: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms; chop stems and set aside. In a skillet over medium heat cook sausage until well browned; drain. Spoon off all but 2 tablespoons of drippings from skillet. In hot drippings over medium heat cook mushroom stems until tender about 10 minutes stirring frequently. Remove skillet from heat; stir in sausage cheese and crumbs. Preheat.

title: Make-Ahead Breakfast
instructions: Crumble sausage in a medium skillet; cook over medium heat until browned stirring occasionally. Drain well. Spread bread crumbs in a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish; top with sausage and cheese. Combine eggs milk and seasonings; beat well and pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until set. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Grandmother'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: Stew chicken. Save broth. In a large pan put corn butter beans V-8 chicken broth chicken salt and pepper. Cook all day. Serve with homemade bread.

title: Whole Wheat Biscuits
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients mixing well. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk; stir until moistened. Turn dough onto a floured surface; knead lightly 4 to 5 times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch; cut with 2 3/4-inch biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until browned. Yield One dozen.

title: Homemade Salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl tossing gently to mix well. Makes 4 cups. Serve homemade salsa over fried eggs cold meats poultry hamburgers or as a dip with tortilla chips.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour with baking powder soda and salt. Cream the butter and add sugar gradually. Add eggs one at a time mixing thoroughly. Add bananas to flour mixture. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Mix well. Add nuts. Pour into well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Cream Of Wheat Cornbread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Spray muffin tins with Pam. Fill 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar together and pour over the first 4 ingredients. Best made night before!

title: Eunice Vaughn'S Cocoa Fried Pie Filling
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; cook over moderate heat until thick; cool. Put on your favorite pie crust or roll out canned biscuits. Fry until done.

title: Kona Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar then add eggs. Stir in bananas. Add flour and mix well. Pour in 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Savory Pork And Vegetables
instructions: Cut green beans into 2-inch pieces. In skillet cook chops in 1 tablespoon margarine for 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove. In remaining 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook mushrooms with rosemary until tender and liquid is evaporated stirring often. Add soup water and green beans; heat to boiling. Return chops to skillet. Cover; stirring occasionally cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until chops are no longer pink and green beans are tender. Serve with hot cooked fettuccine. Serves 4

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix thoroughly; shape into balls. Roll in flour and brown in small amount of oil in electric skillet. Place meat balls in kettle and add one 46-ounce can tomato or V-8 juice. Simmer until sauce thickens. Serve with mashed potatoes. Use sauce as gravy.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix sugar vinegar and oil until sugar dissolves. Combine sauerkraut and chopped vegetables.

title: Honey Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together in a mixing bowl. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles corn meal. Add milk gradually blending until well combined. Place dough onto floured surface and pat into a 1/2-inch thick rectangle.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs. Add cornbread mix and oil. Stir in corn garlic powder and cheese. Mix well and pour into greased (Pam) 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Lobster Bluff
instructions: Place fillets in a saucepan. Cover with water; add the salt. Bring to a boil; lower heat and simmer 10 minutes. Drain. Cover again with cold water. Add the vinegar. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 10 minutes. Drain. Serve with melted butter.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; chill. Hollow out bread. Fill with dip and serve.

title: Always Ready Bran Muffins
instructions: Put wheat bran in boiling water and let stand. In a separate bowl cream sugar margarine and eggs. Combine dry ingredients. Add together all ingredients and mix well. Store in tightly covered bowl in refrigerator at least 12 hours before use. Keeps well for 6 weeks in refrigerator. If it turns brown on top just stir before use. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: German Chocolate Pies
instructions: Mix chocolate and butter. Gradually blend in milk. Set aside. Mix sugar cornstarch salt eggs coconut and vanilla. Gradually beat in chocolate mixture and pour into pie shells. Sprinkle pecans over top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool for 4 hours.

title: Freezer Slaw
instructions: Combine and boil 1 minute. Cool to lukewarm. Pour over slaw. Put into containers and freeze. Thaw to serve.

title: Apple Crumble
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar and 1 ounce flour in mixing bowl. Squeeze lemon juice over apple slices. Toss apples with sugar mixture. Put in ovenproof baking dish. Thoroughly mix butter remaining flour and cinnamon. Add lemon rind and remaining 1/2 cup of sugar. Sprinkle mixture over apples and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: No Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Combine and fold all ingredients together. Spread into pan or Pyrex dish. Chill thoroughly cut into squares and serve.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix well and spread in a 9 X 13 inch pan.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix sugar Crisco and eggs. Beat hard until light. Add mashed banana. Sift flour with baking powder salt and soda. Stir into creamed mixture beating until smooth. Add walnuts. Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until done. Cool on rack.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions and let cool. Prepare pudding mixes according to package directions. Crumble half of the cake in the bottom of a punch bowl. Layer with pie filling pudding mixture half of the pineapple half of the whipped topping and half of the pecans. Repeat the layering. Top with maraschino cherries. Chill for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Eight-Layer Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce celery onion carrots green pepper and peas in glass bowl. Spread mayonnaise over layers sealing to side of dish. Sprinkle with sugar cheese and bacon. Chill covered overnight. Yields 12 servings.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients;\tpour into greased tube pan and bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Boston Butt Roast(In Crock-Pot)
instructions: Put Boston butt roast in crock-pot. Fill halfway with water. Add remaining ingredients stir and cook on low for approximately 8 hours or until very tender.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bars
instructions: Cream sugar oleo and oil in large bowl. Add eggs vanilla and buttermilk; mix well. Add dry ingredients; beat well. Add zucchini.

title: Club Cracker Squares
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Line pan with Club crackers. Bring oleo sugar brown sugar and milk to a boil and boil 5 minutes stirring often. Add graham cracker crumbs. Pour mixture over crackers in pan. Put another layer of crackers over mixture. Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter over low heat. Spread over cracker layer. Refrigerate until set. Cut in squares.

title: Egg And Sausage Ball
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Cool. Beat eggs and milk. Add seasonings and bread cubes. Fold in sausage and cheese. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool slightly before cutting.

title: Special Orange Tea Mix
instructions: Use 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons mix to 1 cup hot water.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all items together except grated cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake until melted.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate Cheddar cheese. Combine cheese Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Knead with hands until well blended. Roll in pecan pieces. Chill and serve.

title: Cream Icing
instructions: Boil milk and flour until thick and cool. Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add to boiled cooled mixture.

title: Mother'S Potato Rolls
instructions: Sprinkle yeast in lukewarm water and set aside. Combine potatoes potato water butter sugar and salt. Stir until butter is melted. When this mixture is lukewarm add yeast and eggs. Work in 4 cups flour 1 cup at a time. When well mixed work in 3 1/2 cups more flour. Use last 1/2 cup on board. Knead dough until smooth and satiny. Place in greased bowl cover with damp cloth and let rise in warm place until doubled in size. Punch down and shape into rolls or loaves. Brush with melted butter. Cover with waxed paper and allow to rise until doubled in size. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Skillet Barbecue Pork Chops
instructions: In a skillet brown pork chops in oil about 5 minutes on each side. Pour off excess fat. Sprinkle celery brown sugar lemon juice mustard salt and pepper over pork chops. Add tomato sauce. Cover; simmer on low heat for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add next 4 ingredients. Mix lightly but well. Add to flour mixture and blend. Add nuts. Bake in 4 small loaf pans well greased for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove from pans immediately and cool. Great for freezing. Makes 4 small loaves or two 9-inch square pans.

title: Russian Summit Tea
instructions: In a pitcher or large container combine all of the ingredients. Stir until well blended and sweeten to taste. Serves 12.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes sugar salt nutmeg cloves cinnamon eggs and vanilla. Melt butter in milk. Gradually pour in potato mixture stirring. Beat gently with rotary beater until well blended and smooth. Pour into shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 40 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Rice And Sausage
instructions: Cook sausage and drain fat. Add onions peppers and celery; cook until tender-crisp. Stir in rice and water chestnuts; heat. Add water as needed. Try turkey sausage rather than pork.

title: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
instructions: In a plastic or paper bag combine the flour salt and pepper and shake to mix. Add the chicken and shake to coat lightly. Remove the chicken and reserve the excess seasoned flour. In a large skillet warm 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium heat. Add the chicken and brown on one side about 5 minutes. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Turn the chicken and brown well on the second side about 5 minutes longer. Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.

title: Spaghetti Mexicali
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Saute onion and green pepper. Add beef. Cook until just brown. Add all other ingredients. Blend well. Bake in covered casserole dish for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut squash in little hunks; boil for 10 to 15 minutes until tender (not done). In a bowl take eggs and whip with fork until fluffy. Dice 1 medium onion. Add the chopped green chilies. In a casserole dish put Cheez Whiz on bottom and sides of dish. Put layer of squash; pour some of the egg mixture (eggs onion and green chilies) over the cheese and squash. Repeat layers until all is used up.

title: Fried Chicken Marinade
instructions: Mix diced green pepper with diced onion and garlic powder into cooking wine. Marinate chicken breast strips for 1 hour roll in cornmeal and fry until done.

title: Honey-Lemon Dressing
instructions: In a small bowl whisk the mayonnaise yogurt lemon juice honey and white pepper until smooth. Chill before serving.

title: Swanson Skinny Mashed Potatoes
instructions: In saucepan place potatoes and broth. Over high heat heat to boil. Cover and cook over medium heat 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Drain reserving broth. Mash potatoes with 1 1/4 cups of broth and pepper. If needed add additional broth until potatoes are desired consistency. Serves about 6.

title: Crab Cheese Dip
instructions: Blend sour cream and cream cheese. Stir in crab green onions and Cheddar cheese. Serve with Wheat Thins.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: Cut chicken into strips. Wrap beef and bacon around chicken in a roll. Place in a baking dish. Mix soup sour cream and spices; pour over chicken. Cover with foil. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Old-Time Giblet Gravy
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add oil flour onion and salt and pepper to taste. Blend well; let brown. Add 2 cups chicken broth (add more broth if needed). Add giblets and eggs; cook until thick stirring constantly. Serve with dressing.

title: Persimmon Cake
instructions: Mix the ingredients. Put in 2 greased round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until set. Top with icing.

title: Golden Gate Chow Mein
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips. Brown meat. Stir in celery onions soy sauce Accent and broth. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes. Blend cornstarch and reserved mushroom liquid. Gradually stir into meat mixture. Add Chinese vegetables mushrooms and brown gravy sauce. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Serve over noodles.

title: Green Bean Au Gratin
instructions: Make a white sauce with the first five ingredients. When thick add cheese and melt. Stir in green beans and pour into buttered 1 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese almonds and paprika. Bake uncovered 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Put onion rings on top during last 5 to 10 minutes of cooking time.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and beat well. Add oil. Beat well. Stir in other ingredients. Pour in greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Sandwich Pinwheels
instructions: Butter a 10 x 15 x 2-inch pan. In a large bowl beat eggs until frothy. Add flour baking powder and salt and blend well. Mix in melted butter chiles and cheeses.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Easy Lobster Newburgh Green Lake
instructions: Combine Newburgh sauce with cream to desired consistency over medium heat. Add chunked lobster meat and spoon over cooked patty shells. Serves approximately 6.

title: Hard Times Casserole
instructions: Boil the noodles and spinach together. Remove from the heat and mix in a bowl with the wine tomato sauce and herbs. Put in a casserole and add the sour cream. Mix in the Italian herbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve with a green salad and bread sticks or rolls.

title: Yeast Bread
instructions: Combine flour sugar yeast and salt well. Add oil and water. Dough should be soft but not sticky. Turn out on floured surface. Knead until smooth about 5 to 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl; turn once to oil top. Cover and let rise in greased bowl for 1 1/2 hours or until double. Shape as desired (rolls bread or can be used for cinnamon rolls). Place on lightly greased pan. Cover and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Scald milk. Beat eggs sugar and flour together. Add gradually to milk stirring constantly. Cook until mixture starts to thicken. Add vanilla to taste.

title: Copper Penny Carrots
instructions: *You may use frozen peppers and/or onions thawed and drained.

title: Creamy Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Stir sugar milk and cocoa well. Cook to soft ball stage. While waiting for mixture to boil get out three dinner plates. Put a walnut-size piece of oleo on each plate. Pour one third of cocoa mixture onto each plate. When somewhat cooled use a knife and with a whipping/folding motion incorporate oleo into cocoa mixture. Stir until thick and satiny. Working quickly drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper before fudge hardens.

title: Poppy Seed Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hungarian Beef Stew
instructions: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes. Wash. Saute onions in 2 tablespoons oil. Add paprika. Stir into onions. Add meat and rest of ingredients. Simmer over low heat 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Oriental Marinade
instructions: Mash garlic in small glass or stainless steel bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Taste and add more sugar or soy sauce depending on taste preference. (A sweeter marinade goes well with pork and a saltier marinade goes well with chicken.) Toss with cubed meat. Marinate 2 hours or overnight in refrigerator.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: *Can use any vegetables. Slice thinly and saute lightly in a little oil.

title: Special K Bars
instructions: Heat syrup and sugar together. Add peanut butter and cereal. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chips together and pour over top and chill.

title: Quick Bread(Diet)
instructions: Melt and cool butter or oleo. Add Equal. Add egg. Mix well. Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add to butter mixture alternately with milk. Stir in pecans. Pour into greased loaf pan (9 1/2 x 5 1/4 x 2 3/4-inch). Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 1 hour. Let stand one day wrapped in waxed paper or foil for easier slicing. Makes 20 slices 106 calories each.

title: Sausage Roll
instructions: Saute chopped onion and bell pepper in a little oil. Brown sausage. Add sauteed mixture to sausage. Add both kinds of Cheez Whiz to the sausage mixture and cook until well mixed. Let stand until it cools to room temperature. Put some flour on counter and roll out pastry sheet. Spread the mixture all the way to the sides of the dough. Start rolling then pinch the ends closed. Bake according to the directions on the bread package.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Mix and keep cool until ready to serve.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Press dough into ungreased cookie sheet (both packages). Be sure that it is pressed together (like a pizza crust). Cook 5 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Kona Inn Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Add eggs bananas and walnuts. Sift flour salt and soda 3 times. Blend wet and dry ingredients together. Do not overmix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes in 2 greased loaf pans. Let cool 10 to 15 minutes before turning out of pans.

title: Cheese 'N Chicken
instructions: Cook onion in margarine. Stir\tin chicken and cook. Add 1/4 cup picante sauce and\tcream cheese and cook until heated. Stir in 1 cup cheese. Spoon about 1/3 cup mixture in center of tortilla and roll up. Place seam\tside down in 7 x 12-inch dish. Top with remaining sauce and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Crust Crush the graham crackers. Blend with powdered sugar and melted oleo. Press in an oblong pan or dish.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave oven. Add remaining ingredients; drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. When cold they are set and can be stored in a covered container or they can be frozen. Makes around 40.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Baking Temperature 325\u00b0. Baking Time 45 minutes.

title: Turkey-Broccoli Bake
instructions: Prepare broccoli according to package directions. Drain well. Mix with lemon juice. Spread in 9-inch round baking dish. In saucepan melt the 2 tablespoons oleo. Blend in flour and salt. Add milk all at once. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Remove from heat and stir in Swiss cheese until melted. Add turkey. Spoon turkey mixture over broccoli. Combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and melted butter. Pour over casserole. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Horseradish Sauce
instructions: Pour boiling water over tomatoes to remove skins. Crush tomatoes and put on to boil slowly. Put onions and peppers through food chopper; add to tomatoes. Add spices and vinegar. Add sugar later and sir often especially after adding sugar. Cook at least 3 hours.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add orange juice and cranberry sauce; mix well. Chill until it begins to thicken then add apple celery and orange rind.

title: Hungarian Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter; stir in sour cream until smooth. Set aside. Butter bottom of a 13 1/2 x 8 3/4-inch baking dish. Slice 4 potatoes to form bottom layer. Salt and pepper to taste. Slice 5 eggs to form next layer. Cover with approximately half of the butter-sour cream mixture. Repeat layers with remaining potatoes eggs and butter-sour cream mixture. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs or cracker meal. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until dish is bubbling. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Crustless Egg Custard
instructions: Melt margarine. Add sugar and flour. Mix well. Add eggs and beat then add milk and flavoring. Mix well. Pour into a Pyrex dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 until brown. Let cool. Cut into wedges.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix 1st four ingredients and place in refrigerator. Toss with mayonnaise and dressing before serving.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Place washed whole cucumbers into a gallon glass jar; cover with vinegar. Cover. Let set for 6 weeks. Remove cucumbers from vinegar and pour vinegar out. Slice cucumbers into any size pieces and put back into jar. Add sugar and spice. Let set several days and stir with wooden spoon. After sugar has dissolved can leave in big jar or put into small jars and seal.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with peeling on. Fry bacon; save drippings. Take peeling off potatoes slice and season with salt and pepper. Add onion crumbled bacon flour vinegar and water to bacon drippings and cook until thick and clear. Stir in potatoes. Mix well. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan; heat when ready to serve.

title: Spiced Pineapple Pickups
instructions: Drain pineapple chunks reserving 3/4 cup of the juice. In saucepan combine pineapple juice vinegar sugar salt cloves and cinnamon. Heat 10 minutes. Add pineapple chunks and bring to a boil. Refrigerate overnight in a covered bowl. To serve drain pineapple and serve cold with toothpicks.

title: Curry
instructions: Chop each carrot into three pieces then cut the potatoes. Next cut the chicken. Get a big pan maybe to 1 foot high. Put the three cups of water in. Put in the carrots and then the potatoes and then the chicken. Add a cup of hot sauce. Boil for 3 to 5 minutes. When it is done get a big glass of water because it is hot! Serve it in the fall or winter.

title: California Choco Orange Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and beat according to directions on cake box. Fold in zest and chocolate chips. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Test with toothpick for doneness. Cool in pan for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar after cake is taken from Bundt pan.

title: Classic Sugar Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bow cream sugar butter and salt. Beat in egg lemon rind and vanilla until light and fluffy. Sift together flour and baking powder. Gradually stir into creamed mixture. On floured board using floured rolling pin roll dough until 1/8 in thick. Cut into fancy shapes. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Sprinkle with additional sugar. Bake 9 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned around the edge. Cool on racks. Store in airtight containers. Makes about 5 to 7 dozen cookies.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Rinse and pick over beans. Put in a large pot with the water onions and celery. Simmer for 2 hours. Add the remaining ingredients except the lemon juice and scallions and simmer covered for 1 hour. Mash or puree half the soup in a food processor. Combine with rest of soup. Season with the lemon juice salt and pepper. Serve garnished with the minced scallions.

title: Quick Turkey Chowder
instructions: Cook celery and onion in margarine in large saucepan until tender. Remove from heat; blend in flour. Cook over low heat stirring until mixture is bubbly. Slowly stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir for 1 minute. Stir in turkey corn potatoes peas pimento and pepper; heat through. Garnish with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Put pineapple in a casserole dish; mix together sugar and flour. Sprinkle over pineapple. Next sprinkle grated cheese and then sprinkle Ritz crackers on top. Melt margarine and pour over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Use a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Orange Candy Cookies
instructions: Crush corn flakes. Sift 1 1/2 cups flour with soda and salt. Blend butter and sugar. Add eggs. Beat until light and fluffy. Add sifted dry ingredients. Mix diced candy with remaining 1/2 cup flour. Add to mixture. Add nuts or coconut. Mix well. Shape into balls. Place on baking sheet. Bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease bundt pan. Combine 1/3 c. sugar cinnamon and vanilla. Grease and dust inside of bundt pan with above ingredients and set aside. In a lrg. bowl; beat butter and 1-1/2 cup sugar at med. speed. Add remaining ingredients and mix until well blended. Put some of the walnut mixture into bundt pan spoon in half of the batter; add remaining nut mixture and spoon in rest of the batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60-65 min.

title: Trail Snack Mix
instructions: Pour peanuts chocolate candy and raisins in a plastic container. Shake container until ingredients are well mixed. Store in airtight container and enjoy!!

title: Sock It To Me Cake
instructions: Beat eggs; add sour cream then cake mix sugar Wesson oil and flavoring. Beat well. Fold in nuts. Pour 1/2 of batter in a greased and floured tube pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon and then add rest of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Bread N Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers onions and peppers. Add salt; cover with ice water and soak for 1 hour. Drain and add sugar turmeric cloves mustard seed celery seed and vinegar. Bring to boil and put in jars; seal. Makes about 4 pints.

title: Skillet Macaroni And Beef
instructions: Cook beef in large skillet until it loses its redness. Drain and discard excess fat. Add macaroni onion and green pepper and cook until macaroni is yellow. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until macaroni is cooked to suit your taste. Makes 6 servings.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain. Add 2 quarts water to beans and hock. Simmer 2 hours or until beans are tender. Add all other ingredients. Simmer another hour or two.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Bring sugar and corn syrup to a boil. Add peanuts; stir constantly and cook on high heat until mixture turns light brown in color. Remove from heat; add butter and salt and stir. Add soda last and pour thinly onto a buttered greased cookie sheet.\tCool and break into pieces.

title: Quick Green Beans
instructions: Drain green beans and season with salt. Heat in baking dish. Add undiluted soup. Spread onion rings on top. Return to oven; heat thoroughly. This dish must be served while hot.

title: No-Crust Pepperoni-Cheese Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Sprinkle cheese and pepperoni on bottom of 9-inch pie plate. Set aside. Beat eggs milk and basil with wire whisk until well blended. Pour egg mixture over cheese and pepperoni. Bake 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean. Makes 6 servings 240 calories each.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Make a paste with food coloring and cocoa. Add to mixture. Add salt and flour alternately with buttermilk and vanilla. Fold in soda and vinegar (blend together). Bake 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven in 2 (8-inch) cake pans well-greased and floured. Layers may be split to make four. Frost with buttercream frosting or seven minute frosting.

title: Tiffany And Shane'S Holiday Fudge(Microwave)
instructions: Microwave chocolate and milk in large microwavable bowl on High 2 to 3 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted stirring halfway through heating time. Help Grandmommie remove from microwave. Stir until chocolate is completely melted.

title: Betty'S Yummy Bean Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients and layer with 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese and 1 cup Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with nachos for dipping.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Cover sliced pickles with water and a handful of salt. Let come to a boil and strain. Mix rest of ingredients with pickles. Cold pack for 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable And Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: In large skillet melt margarine. Add celery and stir over medium-high heat until crisp-tender. Stir in soup milk onion powder thyme and pepper; mix well. Stir in vegetables and chicken; heat through. Spoon into a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

title: Curried Chicken Balls
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Add mayonnaise to moisten. Form small balls and roll in chopped nuts. Chill overnight. Makes 50.

title: Apricot Tarts
instructions: Place dried apricots in a saucepan and cover with water. Cover and simmer until very tender about 30 minutes. Drain. Add sugar and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Allow to cool while preparing cookie dough.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Beat brown sugar shortening and egg together. In another bowl combine buttermilk baking soda and salt. Then add this to the first bowl alternately with flour. Add rhubarb nuts and vanilla. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco. Add sugar cream until fluffy. Blend in well beaten eggs. Mix cocoa red coloring and coffee together to form a\tsmooth\tpaste.\tBlend into creamed mixture. Sift flour soda and salt together 3 times. Add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture starting and ending with flour. Add vanilla. Pour into\t2 floured and greased 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Frost with chocolate or vanilla icing.

title: Mama'S Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt together and add to liquid mixture. (Add more flour if needed.) Refrigerate 30 minutes for easier handling. Roll out on a lightly floured surface. Cut out and space 2-inch apart on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake 400\u00b0 until lightly colored for soft chewy tea cake. Makes 4 or 5 dozen.

title: Country Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on until done. Drain and let cool. Slice unpeeled potatoes thin. Butter bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer half of the potatoes salt and pepper half of the cheese and half of the bacon. Dribble half of the butter over the layer. Repeat the layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbling about 15 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Cranberry Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Prepare muffin cups as above. In bowl mix first 5 ingredients. Stir into batter just until moistened. Stir in cranberries; do not overmix. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Honey Fluff
instructions: Combine sugar honey and water in saucepan; boil until syrup will harden when dropped in cold water or hard ball stage on thermometer. Pour syrup slowly over stiffly beaten egg whites. Add lemon flavoring and beat until stiff enough to hold peaks and drop on waxed paper. Add chopped nuts if desired.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Boil in salted water until tender and drain. In large bowl mix eggs mayonnaise and salt. Pour over potatoes. Add onions and mix.

title: Cream Cheese Topping
instructions: Have cream cheese at room temperature. Place in a medium mixing bowl cream cheese sour cream and sugar. Beat at medium speed until smooth. Place in refrigerator until well chilled.

title: Lemon Jello Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions in square baking dish; let cool for 20 minutes. Poke holes in cake. Mix jello with 3/4 cup boiling water and 1/4 cup cold water. Pour jello mixture over cake and place in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add egg and beat well. Alternate dry ingredients with the milk. Fold in nuts last. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cookie springs back when tested. Frost while slightly warm with a chocolate powdered sugar frosting. These are moist. Do not overbake.

title: Pork And Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown slices of tenderloin in a little oil. Remove meat and discard oil. Return meat to pan put 1/2 can sauerkraut on top of meat layer of onions half the carrots and half the potatoes. Then repeat with the other half of vegetables. Pour water and reserved juice on top of all. Bake in oven in a tightly covered pan at 325\u00b0 for about 3 hours.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Bring sugar cornstarch and orange juice to boil. Boil on low heat 1 minute. Add 1/4 cup lemon juice. When cool add fruit and mix well.

title: Jewish Apple Cake
instructions: Blend all the ingredients (except apples) until smooth. In a tube pan or 9 x 13-inch pan pour 1/2 inch of batter then layer of apples. Then sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cinnamon mixed in 1/2 cup of sugar. Add chopped nuts if you like. Then pour the remaining batter and repeat the same steps. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Grease and flour the pan.

title: Crab Mold
instructions: Heat soup; add cheese and gelatin. Mix until smooth. Cool. Add remaining ingredients to cooled mixture. Pour into greased mold and chill several hours or overnight.

title: Sunshine Blueberry Loaf
instructions: Combine margarine and sugar. Blend in eggs and lemon rind. Add combined dry ingredients alternately with orange juice mixing well after each addition. Fold in blueberries and nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pans.

title: Easy Cranberry Wild Rice
instructions: Cook onion in butter in 10-inch skillet until tender but not brown. Add enough water to cranberry sauce to make 4 1/4 cups. Add cranberry sauce and contents of rice and seasoning packets to skillet; stir. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and cook over low heat until all liquid is absorbed about 25 minutes. Stir in celery. Makes 8 servings.

title: Low-Fat Banana Nut Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix together the first 5 ingredients; set aside. In another large bowl mix together milk egg substitute vanilla applesauce and banana. Pour liquid ingredients into dry ingredients. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in chopped walnuts. Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine; chill 2 hours.

title: Frozen Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream lemon juice sugar salt drained pineapple banana and red food coloring to make mixture pink.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar; beat well. Add eggs one at a time; mix well. Add vanilla. Alternate flour and baking powder with milk or yogurt on low speed to blend. Pour cake into prepared pan. Recipe makes 3 layers or 1 (10-inch) tube pan or 13 x 9-inch sheet cake. Bake for 30 minutes to 1 hour depending on pan used. Serves 20 to 24.

title: Cornish Game Hens With Cranberry Gravy
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Have ready a large shallow roasting pan big enough to hold the 8 birds with a little space between. Wash the hens and dry well inside and out with paper toweling. Sprinkle inside of each with salt and pepper. Add a small piece of bay leaf a sliver of garlic a clove a slice of onion half a slice of lemon a sprig of celery leaves and a sprig of parsley to the inside of each bird. Tie legs and wings close to bodies and set birds in lightly oiled roasting pan. Lay a half strip of bacon over the breast of each bird. Add onions quarters giblets chicken stock and vermouth to the pan. Roast 15 minutes at 450\u00b0. Turn heat to 350\u00b0 and continue roasting until the birds are tender about 45 minutes. Baste occasionally and remove bacon for the last 15 minutes of cooking.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix well and cook cake in sheet pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tested done. Cool and cut in squares. Ice with following recipe.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit well and mix. Sprinkle dry gelatin over drained fruit; mix well. Fold in cottage cheese and Cool Whip.

title: Smoked Sausage Jambalaya
instructions: Cook sausage in Dutch oven until browned; remove from skillet and discard drippings. Combine ground beef green pepper onion and garlic; cook until beef is browned. Add tomatoes salt pepper and sausage. Cover; simmer 20 minutes. Add rice and water to meat-vegetable mixture; cover and cook 25 minutes or until rice is tender. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients with drained broccoli. Put in a buttered baking dish and add buttered bread crumbs on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together and put in greased baking dish. Bake until done in slow oven about 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together; cut in shortening. Add sweet potatoes; mix well. Add enough milk gradually to make a soft dough; knead for a few strokes. Roll dough 1/3-inch thick; cut in rounds. Place on a baking sheet. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tortilla Roll Up Appetizer
instructions: Mix ingredients together and spread on tortillas. Roll up and chill in refrigerator. Slice when ready to serve.

title: Date Nut Loaves
instructions: Dredge nuts and dates in 1/2 cup flour. Cream butter cream cheese and\tsugar.\tAdd eggs one at a time. Add flour salt and vanilla then nuts and dates. Pour into 3 loaf pans. Cook 1 hour at\t300\u00b0. May need to be cooked a little longer. Easily divided into thirds for one loaf. Freezes well.

title: German Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Melt 1/3 cup evaporated milk and 1 package of caramels in double boiler. Mix 1 package German chocolate cake mix margarine and 1/3 cup evaporated milk. In 9 x 13-inch pan spread 1/2 the cake mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Remove from oven spread package of chocolate chips caramel mixture. Spread the rest of cake mixture on top. (Drop by teaspoon it will spread easier.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry Sauce
instructions: Mix and set aside.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Let potatoes thaw and mix with soup sour cream cheese and onion. Place in a buttered 13 x 9 inch casserole dish. Cover with corn flakes and drizzle on the margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 10- 12.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Crust Grease bottom and sides of 15 x 10-inch baking pan. (Be certain sides of pan are 1-inch high.) In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed beat flour 1/2 cup sugar butter and salt until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press firmly and evenly into pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Put the bread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the sausage over the bread. Beat the eggs. Mix the eggs half and half cheese salt and pepper. Pour over the sausage that is sprinkled on the bread. Put in refrigerator overnight. Let stand 15 minutes before baking at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm and brown.

title: Divinity
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and water thoroughly. Cook into a medium ball when dropped in cold water. Pour 2/3 of syrup over beaten egg whites. Beat constantly. Cook other 1/3 until it forms a hard ball. Beat slowly into first mixture. Beat constantly until creamy. Add vanilla and nuts. Drop on wax paper.

title: Easy Coconut Cake
instructions: Cook cake according to directions on box. Just before cake is done mix together the Eagle Brand milk and cream of coconut. When cake is done (while still hot) poke holes in cake. Spread pineapple over cake. Pour milk mixture over cake and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Ginger Snaps(Ocie'S Molasses Cookies)
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt soda and spices. Cut in Crisco to\tresemble coarse crumbs. Stir in molasses and egg. Chill dough. Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in granulated sugar and place on cookie sheet. Do not mash down.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ground beef Lipton soup bread crumbs egg and catsup. Form into log and bake covered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Then uncovered for 30 minutes. Then saute chopped green peppers and onions in Mazola until tender. Add tomato sauce and warm. When meat loaf has completely cooked pour warm sauce over it and serve.

title: Wacky Kool-Aid Popcorn Balls
instructions: Place popped popcorn in a large buttered bowl. Bring sugar syrup and Kool-Aid (any flavor) to a boil. Boil over medium heat until mixture separates into a hard thread stage when dropped into cold water. Remove from heat and pour over popcorn. Mix quickly to coat well. Shape into balls.

title: Broiled Crab Puffs
instructions: Heat jar of cheese in microwave. Combine with all ingredients except crab and muffins. Mix well. Gently fold in crab. Spoon onto uncooked muffin triangles. Must freeze for 30 minutes before broiling. When ready to serve broil until heated through. Makes 48 appetizers. May be frozen 3 to 4 weeks.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash with onion in boiling salted water until tender. Drain well. Combine soup and sour cream. Fold in drained squash and onion. Melt butter; toss with stuffing mix. Spread 1/2 stuffing mix in a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top. Sprinkle remainder of stuffing mix over vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated through 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pudding Cake
instructions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Let cool. Mix the pudding; beat until thick. Add cream cheese to pudding; beat well together. When cake is cool put pudding and cheese mixture on cake then spread pineapple on top of pudding. Spread Cool Whip over top of this. Keep cake in refrigerator.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine flour soda salt baking powder cinnamon and nuts. Set aside. Beat eggs in large bowl and add sugar oil and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients. Stir only until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour in two well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done when tested.

title: Baked Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Pour in an ovenproof dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Dessert Nachos
instructions: Break graham crackers in half. Mark a diagonal line on each half with knife; break apart to form triangles. Place 1/2 of the triangles in a single layer on a serving plate. Spread evenly with 1/2 of the whipped topping then top with 1/2 of the fruit. Drizzle with strawberry butterscotch or caramel topping. Repeat layers and serve immediately. Makes 6 (2 ounce) servings. Preparation time 15 minutes.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat in skillet and drain off excess fat. Add tomato sauce and cook for about 1/2 hour. Add string beans and season to taste. Pour into casserole dish and spoon creamed potatoes over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain off the fat. Add taco mix and mix together. Drain off liquid from can of corn kidney beans and green beans and place in a large bowl with cover. Add ground beef mixture to vegetables. Now cut up the onion and add cheese to the vegetable mixture. Pour salad dressing on all ingredients. Cover and place in refrigerator overnight. When ready to serve cut up all lettuce and break up entire bag of corn chips. Toss together and serve. Add taco Salusa on top if desired. This makes a large bowl full to feed 8 to 10 people.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased pan at 300\u00b0 for approximately 30 to 35 minutes. Use chocolate glaze for icing.

title: One-Apiece Meat Loaves(Microwave)
instructions: Peel cucumber. Cut cucumber lengthwise in half. Using spoon scoop out seeds from each cucumber half. Coarsely shred enough cucumber to make 1 cup. Slice any remaining cucumber to use as garnish. In medium-sized bowl combine shredded cucumber ground beef bread crumbs grated onion salt pepper and egg. Divide meat mixture into 4 portions.

title: Spinach Dip In French Bread
instructions: Dip In large mixing bowl combine the drained spinach cream cheese milk minced garlic shredded lemon peel lemon juice Worcestershire sauce 1/4 teaspoon salt and hot pepper sauce. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until combined. Stir in the green onion. Cover and chill. Mix until serving time.

title: Caramel Apple Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add eggs 1 at a time; beat well after each egg. Add flour and milk a little at a time. Cream together; beat until blended. Stir in apple nuts. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients together. Add onion. Combine egg and milk and add to dry ingredients. Stir lightly. Drop a teaspoon of batter for each hush puppy into hot deep grease (360\u00b0). Makes 2 dozen.

title: Steamed Cabbage
instructions: Bring 1/2 cup water to a boil; add cabbage other ingredients and salt to taste. Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes. Stir frequently. Cut off heat and let steam for 5 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Sprinkle with bacon bits.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Bring sugar and water to a boil for 3 minutes. Cool and add frozen orange juice and juice of 2 lemons pineapple juice and bananas. Freeze. When ready to serve add 4 quarts of ginger ale.

title: Sauce For Chicken Wings
instructions: Put on cooked wings. Bake for 5 minutes at 350\u00b0 to set sauce.

title: Graham Cracker Crumb Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar eggs and margarine. Add baking powder salt and milk. Stir in pineapple coconut black walnuts and graham cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes in greased floured tube pan (can be baked for 1 hour and 30 minutes).

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook the carrots. Add butter and honey. Cook until glazed.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer 3 hours. Stir often.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil zucchini and onion for 5 minutes. Mix sour cream and soup. Fold in vegetables.\tMix butter with stuffing mix. In a 3 quart casserole spread half of the vegetable mixture. Add stuffing mixture.\tTop stuffing layer with last half of vegetables. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Chicken Creole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove from broth (about 2 quarts broth needed). Add broken spaghetti peppers and onion. Boil until spaghetti is tender about 20 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper pimento and mushrooms. Debone chicken. Dice and add to mixture. Grate cheese and mix until cheese is melted. Put in baking dish. May refrigerate for 24 hours before using. Place in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes before serving. Serves 10.

title: Cowboy Potatoes
instructions: Fry bacon and remove from pan. In bacon grease fry potatoes and onions until tender. Dice bacon and add to potatoes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Sift the flour baking powder and salt together. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs beating well. Beginning and ending with dry ingredients add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured angel food cake pan and cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or in 4 (8-inch) pans at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or in muffin pan 1/2 full at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Let meat marinate for 8 to 10 hours in the refrigerator. Either cook on the grill or broil in oven to your likeness.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Toss crab meat and bread crumbs lightly. Add all other ingredients and mix lightly together. Pat into 8 medium size crab cakes. Fry in melted butter in cast-iron skillet until golden brown.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Brown chicken in hot oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat 5 minutes on each side. Remove chicken reserving drippings in pan. Add bell pepper and onions to hot drippings and saute until tender. Return chicken to pan; add garlic stewed tomatoes tomato paste red wine bay leaf and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes. Discard bay leaf. Serve over spaghetti. Yield 4 servings.

title: Hershey Bar Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate bars and syrup together and let cool. Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs; beat well. Pour in syrup mixture and vanilla. Sift salt soda and flour together. Add alternately with milk. This makes a thin batter. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan and pour in batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Cook beef and onions until done; add rest of ingredients and simmer 45 minutes (you can use tomato juice in recipe).

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pudding with pineapple and its juice. Add marshmallows and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill in refrigerator before serving.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil and debone chicken saving broth. Saute mushrooms pimento celery and onion in butter. Boil spaghetti in chicken broth and drain. Melt cheese over noodles and mix in all other ingredients. Put in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-45 minutes to blend flavors.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Cook hen; cool and debone. Add oleo soup onion and celery to broth and simmer until tender. Crumble cornbread. Put half of the broth over the bread. Add raw eggs and mix well. Add rest of broth chicken and chopped eggs. Season with poultry seasoning salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 325\u00b0 until firm and light brown.

title: Pineapple Date-Nut Bread
instructions: Tips Let bread stand a day before cutting. Loaf also freezes well; thaw before slicing. If you wish to use muffin tins fill 2/3 full and bake about 35 minutes. Recipe will make 16 to 18 muffins.

title: Italian Cream Cake Icing
instructions: Stir and melt together in a heavy saucepan the cream cheese and oleo. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Sift powdered sugar into cream cheese and margarine until desired consistency to spread and add coconut.

title: Nicole Keeling'S Chess Cake
instructions: Mix together; pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Gelatin Salad(Carrot-Celery-Olive)
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add vinegar and ice cubes. Stir constantly until thickened about 3 minutes. Remove any unmelted ice.

title: Non-Boozey Raspberry Daiquiris
instructions: Put in a handful of ice cubes and blend ingredients until \slushy.\

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together the butter eggs and sugars until light and fluffy. Sift together the baking powder soda and flour. Stir into creamed mixture until well blended. Fold in chocolate and raisins or nuts.\tDrop by teaspoons onto greased baking\tsheets and bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook together drain and mash the squash onion and carrots. Mix together soup and sour cream then add to mashed mixture. Put layer of stuffing in a 9 x 13-inch pan then a layer of squash mixture. Next drizzle butter over. Repeat layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Syrup Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat eggs and sugar until creamy. Add to oil and sugar gradually. Add flour gradually and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 minutes.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil. Remove from heat and add Jell-O gelatin stirring until dissolved. Add peanuts and pour over popcorn mixing well. Quickly form into 1 1/2-inch balls. Makes approximately 4 dozen.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Take chicken and remove bones. Take chicken and soy sauce in skillet and brown. Put celery and onion in large pot. Cook until tender then add chicken. Cook until flavors are cooked in then add cornstarch and sorghum. Put bean sprouts last and cook four minutes. Add chicken broth to pot. Add chow mein noodles on top.

title: Uncle Aub'S Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Heat sugar cocoa eggs and a little milk enough to dissolve sugar. Add remaining milk. Put in ice cream mixer and freeze.

title: Baked Chicken Or Turkey Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except potato chips. Place in baking dish and top with potato chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Favorite Banana Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in top of double boiler; stir in brown sugar flour and salt. Gradually stir in milk and water. Cook until thickened stirring constantly (15 to 20 minutes).

title: Meat And Broccoli Strata
instructions: With a 3-inch cookie cutter cut a design out of each bread slice; set aside. Tear remaining bread into pieces place in bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Layer with sliced cheese broccoli meat and bread cutouts. In a medium bowl beat together remaining ingredients. Pour over mixture in pan. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Rice Pudding(Top Of Stove)
instructions: Mix all ingredients with a fork until thoroughly blended. (I put this back into the bread crumb container and refrigerate until needed.)

title: South Of The Border Casserole
