instructions: Chop onion and pepper and saute in margarine. Add beef and cook until done. While cooking beef separate with a fork. Combine all other ingredients. Layer cheese and Fritos on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: White Cake
instructions: Mix following directions on package using the milk instead of water and 3 egg whites instead of 2. Bake according to package directions.

title: Beans ... And(Low Sodium)
instructions: Brown diced pork in a large skillet with chopped onion garlic onion powder and seasonings. Add brown sugar celery and pineapple. Simmer over low heat until ready to serve or place in oven casserole at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 or crock-pot.

title: Sunrise Pancakes
instructions: Prepare Vanilla Cream Syrup; set aside.

title: Chewy Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs and molasses; mix well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 1 1/2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on wire racks. Yield approximately 8 dozen cookies.

title: Sausage Spaghetti
instructions: Prepare spaghetti; drain. In skillet cook hot links and pepper until pepper is tender-crisp. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Serve over spaghetti. Serves 6.

title: Fat-Free Banana Bread
instructions: Mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 in loaf pan for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs beating well. Add dry ingredients and chill dough. Roll dough into balls the size of walnuts. Roll balls in mixture of 2 teaspoons cinnamon and 2 teaspoons sugar. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until very light brown. Cool slightly before removing to cooling rack.

title: California Raisin Sauce
instructions: Rinse raisins; add water jelly rind and juice and bring to boil. Blend sugar with cornstarch salt and allspice; stir into orange mixture. Cook stirring until clear. Makes 1 1/2 cups. Great for baked ham.

title: Upside-Down Pie
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the butter sugar flour salt and baking powder. Add enough milk to make a batter; beat 1 minute. Pour into a buttered casserole. Make topping by using pineapple mixed with remaining sugar. Bring to a boil. Pour over batter. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven 30 minutes. Serve hot or cold. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Crush chips and put half in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Combine soups Ro-Tel tomatoes and broth. Whisk until smooth. Pour half over chips in pan. Sprinkle chicken onion and cheese over soup in layers. Put another layer of chips soup chicken onion and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot and cheese melts.

title: Cheese Strata
instructions: Grease casserole with margarine using 1 (12 x 7 x 2-inch) dish. Arrange 6 slices of bread in the bottom of baking dish. Cover with the cheese then with the remaining bread. Beat the eggs; add the milk mustard onion salt pepper and Accent. Pour over the bread. Let stand 1 hour. Bake in preheated oven at 325\u00b0 to 1 hour. Serve immediately or cover casserole and refrigerate overnight and bake the next day.

title: Mexican Beef Noodles
instructions: Brown 1 pound ground beef and 1/2 cup chopped peppers and 1/2 cup chopped onion; drain. Add 2 cups of water and 1 bag Lipton beef noodles. Cook on medium heat for 7 minutes. Add 1 can of kernel corn drained and simmer for 5 minutes. Add 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Boil margarine and brown sugar for 2 minutes. Set off heat. Add milk and return to heat. Let come to rolling boil. Cool to lukewarm and beat powdered sugar in mixture. Beat until smooth consistency to spread on cake.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Place turkey slices in shallow oblong baking dish. Arrange asparagus spears on top. Mix steak sauce and soup and pour over asparagus. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake in moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for about 20 minutes then place under broiler until bubbly.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Place the condensed milk cream cheese lime juice and vanilla in\ta food processor or the large bowl of an electric mixer. Blend on medium speed for 15 minutes. (The long mixing time incorporates\tair and eliminates lumps.) Place filling in\tthe cooled baked crust and refrigerate at least 8 hours before serving. Garnish with fresh whipped cream and twisted lime slices if desired. Serves 8.

title: Saucy Oven Barbecue Steak
instructions: Trim fat from meat; cut into serving size pieces. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add steak; brown on both sides. Transfer steak to a 2-quart shallow baking dish. Combine ingredients stirring well. Pour over steak. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Canned Peach Filling
instructions: Slice peaches; add sugar and lemon juice to peaches. Mix and let set while cooking glaze. Bring peach juice concentrate and 5 cups water to a boil. Dissolve rest of water in clear jel and thicken boiling juice stirring until thickened. Remove from heat and add salt butter and almond extract. Add peaches to cooked glaze. Fill canning jars and process. I pressure can at 5 pounds for 5 to 10 minutes and invert cans to help them seal. Yields 8 1/2 quarts.

title: Kosher Dill Pickles
instructions: Sterilize the jars for 5 minutes. Wash pickling cukes. Let stand in water for 2 hours. Put 2 sprigs of dill in bottom of\tquart jar. Pack cukes in jar. Add 2 pieces of garlic and a piece of red pepper. On top of each jar put 2 sprigs of dill and a sprinkle of alum. Combine vinegar salt and water and bring to a boil. Fill jars and seal. Makes 7 quarts.

title: Linguini With Feta Peppers
instructions: In medium bowl pour boiling water over tomatoes to cover for 2 minutes.\tDrain reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Thinly slice tomatoes and set aside.

title: Tuna And White Bean Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix gently. Keep chilled until serving time. Mixture can be served in lettuce cups hollowed out tomatoes or on toast or an open face sandwich. Makes 3 or 4 servings.

title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine peanut butter Crisco 1 teaspoon brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer. Add egg and beat until blended. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed. Mix just until blended.

title: Weight Watchers Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Keeps 7 days in refrigerator.

title: Lemon Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix the boiling water and jello well. Cream the sugar and cream cheese. Add to the jello mixture with the lemon juice. Add the vanilla and mix well. Whip the chilled Carnation milk and fold into other mixture. Pour into graham cracker crust. Sprinkle remaining crust over top. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Enchilada Sauce
instructions: Heat oil and brown flour. To the 2 c. water add the chili powder and disolve. Add the mixture to the browned flour and mix well. Add seasonings and blend. Bring it to a bubb boil stirring frequently. Simmer covered for 5 min. Evaporated milk can be added to soften flavor.

title: Ham Roll-Ups(Children'S)
instructions: Place one cheese slice and one broccoli spear on a ham slice. Roll up and hold together with toothpicks. Arrange in a shallow baking dish. Mix soup and milk in a bowl. Pour soup and milk mixture over ham rolls. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pasta And Vegetables
instructions: In large saucepan prepare macaroni according to package directions. Add carrots broccoli and pepper for the last 5 minutes of cooking time; drain.

title: Wild Rice And Seafood Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake uncovered 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Turkey Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery; add broth. Bring to boil; reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes or until veggies are tender. In a large bowl stir together undrained onion mixture turkey tortillas chili peppers soup and black pepper. Reserve 1/2 cup each cheese. Stir remaining cheeses into mixture. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with salsa and remaining cheeses. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix together pudding milk Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Alternate wafers bananas (sliced) and pudding mixture. Garnish with vanilla wafer crumbs. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

title: Ma Murphy'S Pea Soup
instructions: In a large kettle melt margarine. Add celery onion and bone. Saute until onion and celery are tender. Add water peas and pepper. Simmer covered until peas mash between fingers (about 1 hour). Remove bone from kettle; cut off meat and reserve. Add hot milk and meat; do not boil. Ready to serve. If too thick you may add more milk. Serve with croutons if desired.

title: Barbecued Kielbasa
instructions: In a medium saucepan put catsup brown sugar onion liquid smoke and garlic powder. Cook for 5 minutes. Put kielbasa in a casserole dish. Pour sauce over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until kielbasa is completely heated through and barbecue sauce thickens up.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Melt chocolate over boiling water. Add milk; stir 5 minutes or until thickened. Add water; mix well. Pour into freezing tray. Freeze until ice crystals form around side of pan. Add vanilla and whipped cream until thick enough to hold a soft peak. Fold into chilled mixture and freeze. When half frozen scrape from sides and bottom of tray. Beat until smooth but not melted. Freeze until firm.

title: Cheddar Vegetable Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Chop onion. In large frying pan heat the oil over medium heat. Add onion cover cook until tender (about 5 minutes). Add frozen vegetables marjoram 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Cook until tender stirring occasionally about 5 minutes. Meanwhile grate cheese. Beat eggs with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Transfer vegetable mixture to a bowl. Stir in Bisquick 1 cup of cheese and the egg mixture. Transfer to baking dish. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut boiled eggs in halves (each). Put yellow in bowl separately. Arrange on pretty tray. Break up yellow with fork. Add salad pickles about 1 tablespoon of mustard and enough Miracle Whip to reach a creamy fluffy consistency. Generously fill whites. Any leftover yellow mixture makes a great sandwich (smile).

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tops and bottoms off of tomatoes and make slices approximately 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and lightly dip in flour. Fry in hot butter until brown on both sides.

title: Pinto Bean Pie
instructions: Mash beans well using juice. Beat eggs and add all other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 3 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. These pies freeze well.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix cornbread mix as directed on package and then add drained corn. Pour half of mixture into an 8 x 8-inch greased dish. Then evenly spread meat over mixture. Then spread cheese on. Add remaining mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Let apples and sugar stand in a mixing bowl while you beat 2 egg whites until stiff. Then add yolks and stir. Add oil to egg mixture. Beat well and let stand. Mix together flour baking soda salt pecans and cinnamon. Pour egg mixture over apples. Stir then add dry ingredients. Stir with a spoon. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Frozen Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix up all ingredients and freeze. Take out of freezer a few minutes before serving.

title: Fried Cabbage
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in deep pan (I use iron skillet). Add cabbage onion and salt. Cover and cook slowly for about 20 minutes stirring often. Add sugar and cayenne pepper to vinegar and mix well. Pour over cabbage and cook for 5 minutes longer.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Layer in microwave-safe bowl. Cook on High for 5 minutes. Stir and serve with nacho chips.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Beat until light and fluffy. Add 7-Up and beat well again. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch lightly greased pan. Bake about 40 minutes or until done. Remove from oven and immediately cover with Icing.

title: Parmesan Onion Canapes
instructions: Mix cheese with mayonnaise. Make small rounds of thin sliced bread; spread with mayonnaise mixture. Place a very thin slice of onion on each. Put 1/2 teaspoon mayonnaise mixture on top of onion and sprinkle top generously with Parmesan cheese. Put canapes on cookie sheets in refrigerator until ready to use. Broil in preheated oven until golden brown. Watch closely as these burn easily.

title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed of mixer for 5 minutes; gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Mix together the flour baking powder spices and salt. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Spread on greased and floured cookie sheet. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out on towel (not terry one) sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll towel and cake together; cool. Unroll and take off towel.

title: Traditional Sweet Roll Dough
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in milk sugar salt eggs shortening and 2 1/2 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle.

title: Steak House Grilled Sirloin
instructions: Mix steak sauce onion garlic and pepper sauce; set aside. Grill or broil steak until desired doneness brushing with sauce mixture occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Add milk and vanilla alternately with flour to creamed mixture. Add melted chocolate. Put in jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Surprise Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions. Use 2 small cake pans. Cool and slice each cake to make 4 layers. Mix sour cream sugar and coconut. Use this mixture to put layers together. Frost top and sides of cake with Cool Whip. Chill before serving.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies Or Bars
instructions: Spread dough in greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely. Cut into 35 (2-inch) squares.

title: Creamed Corn
instructions: Take a knife and slice through each kernel of corn. Then in a large bowl and with the same knife push off all the corn into the bowl. Place corn in a pan with butter milk salt and pepper. Cook on low stirring regularly to keep it from sticking. Cook between 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Jade Empress Chicken
instructions: Combine the sherry soy sauce ginger and garlic in a bowl. Place the chicken cubes in the mixture and marinate in the refrigerator for several hours or overnight. In a large skillet bring the stock to a boil. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the celery onions and green pepper and stir-fry an additional 2 minutes. Stir in the chicken and marinade and cook until the chicken is opaque about 2 minutes. Drain the pineapple reserving the juice and cut the chunks into thirds setting them aside.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Put cooked deboned chicken breasts (cut up) in a 9 x 13-inch buttered casserole. Mix soups broth margarine and drained peas and carrots. Pour over chicken. Mix Bisquick and milk (it will be thin). Spoon over chicken mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spoon into paper lined muffin tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into lightly greased and floured pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lettuce-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients as listed in a large bowl. Refrigerate 4 to 6 hours. Toss well at serving time.

title: Crock-Pot Greens And Corn Bread
instructions: Cook greens down in crock-pot. Fix corn bread batter then pour over greens. Cover and cook until corn bread is almost done. Cover and simmer until done.

title: Easy Homemade Pickles
instructions: Combine in a saucepan the sugar vinegar crushed stick of cinnamon celery seed and mustard seed. Bring to boiling stirring until sugar is dissolved. Pour hot vinegar mixture over pickles which have been cut diagonally crosswise in 1/2-inch thick slices. Add half of garlic clove. Set in refrigerator for 1 week before serving.

title: Baked Grits Casserole
instructions: Cook grits according to package directions! Add cheese butter and eggs. Pour into baking pan. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Clusters
instructions: Combine peanut butter butterscotch morsels and chocolate morsels in double boiler over low heat stirring constantly until melted. Stir in peanuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Chill until firm. Store in a covered container in refrigerator. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Appetizer Cheese Roll
instructions: Bring cream cheese to room temperature. Mix cream cheese olives and chilies in medium bowl. Place room temperature Velveeta cheese between two layers of Saran Wrap or waxed paper. Roll into rectangle until about 1/4-inch thick. Spread mixture evenly over Velveeta. Using bottom paper roll into log. Place on serving dish seam side down. Trim ends evenly. Place in refrigerator covered for at least three hours. Serve with different types of crackers.

title: Bacon Crackers
instructions: Wrap a salted soda cracker with a piece of bacon and secure with a toothpick (1/2 slice per cracker). Bake on a rack on a cookie sheet in a slow oven until brown and bacon is crisp. Remove toothpick while warm. Can be frozen and then placed in oven to just warm before serving.

title: Spicy Texas Trash
instructions: Add to margarine mixture stirring well after each addition. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Overnight Rump Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper roast. Cut garlic clove in half and rub garlic on each side of roast. Cover all sides of roast with flour. Brown floured roast in oil on both sides. Place roast in slow cooker. Add onion soup mix golden mushroom soup and 1 soup can of water to pan the roast was browned in. Bring to slow boil. Stir well and pour over roast. Cook overnight on high.

title: Veal Kabobs On The Grill
instructions: Mix oil lemon juice soy and Worcestershire sauce seasoning salt and pepper. Marinate veal in mixture for 3 to 4 hours. Skewer veal cubes alternately with mushrooms green peppers tomatoes\tand onions. Cook on\toutdoor grill over medium coals turning occasionally and brushing with marinade. Serve with wild rice.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Blend in egg vanilla and salt; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in slightly cooled chocolate. Frosts top and sides of 2 (8 or 9-inch) layers.

title: Golden Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light. Beat egg yolks well and add to mixture creaming thoroughly. Sift together cake flour baking powder and salt. Add to batter alternately with milk scraping sides of bowl frequently. Add vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter.

title: Homemade Pimiento Cheese
instructions: Grate cheese (the whole box depending on amount desired) on cutting board then put grated cheese in plastic serving bowl. Then add pimiento and salad dressing until it is creamy enough. When halfway stirring salad dressing into cheese and pimientos add pickle juice. Then continue stirring until its ready to serve.

title: Glazed Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell and cool. Wash strawberries and drain removing caps. Place 2 layers of whole berries in pie shell with pointed ends up and largest berries in the center. Prepare glaze.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix meat with 1/2 can tomato sauce and remaining ingredients. Set remaining sauce aside. Shape meat into loaf and place in shallow baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Drain. Pour reserved tomato sauce over meat loaf and bake 5 minutes more. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 6 servings.

title: Crab Treats
instructions: Cream the cheese and oleo then stir in seasonings. Use a fork to flake the crab meat and stir into cheese mixture. Spread mixture on all 48 muffin pieces placing on cookie sheets and freezing. Package and keep frozen until needed. May also be baked without freezing. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and bubbly. Good as a snack or served with salad or raw vegies.

title: Randy'S Green Bean Surprise
instructions: Mix beans and soup in casserole dish. Bake until center is hot. Sprinkle with potatoes on top and bake another 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lite Fruit Cooler
instructions: Drain the fruit and combine with the cottage cheese and Cool Whip in a medium mixing bowl. Sprinkle the jello over the top and stir to mix well. Add pecans if desired. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Green Beans
instructions: Fry bacon and place on paper towel. Saute onion and bell pepper in bacon drippings. Drain drippings and add remaining ingredients to pan. Crumble and add bacon. Cook on medium to low heat until cheese is melted.

title: Baked Chicken And Cheese
instructions: Put chicken in a layer in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with layers of Swiss cheese. Combine 1 can of soup with milk and spread over chicken and cheese. Top with dressing. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350\u00b0. Cover with foil at end of baking time if dressing starts to get too brown.

title: Cherry Fluff
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Then add coconut and nutmeats. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill 3 hours or overnight.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine thawed potatoes 1/2 cup oleo onion sour cream soup and cheese. Place in a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix crushed corn flakes and the remaining 1/2 cup margarine and spread over potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Garnish and serve hot.

title: Little Challahs Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Stir in ginger salt and sugar. Blend in flour. Stir until moist. Knead on floured board until smooth. Break into 12 to 14 pieces. Roll into ropes (3) and braid. Arrange on lightly buttered cookie sheet. Brush with egg. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in covered dish in refrigerator. Good on apples. Soak apple slices in orange juice to keep from turning dark.

title: Cobbler Pie
instructions: Make batter out of flour shortening salt sugar soda and buttermilk. Pour into baking dish. Heat fruit of your choice with sugar to taste. Pour hot fruit on batter. Bake slowly at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Turnip Greens
instructions: Put greens and turnips in large pot. The greens cook down but to begin you will need to push them down to get all into the pot. Boil until tender 10 to 15 minutes. Season with bacon drippings.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan. Add onions and cook slowly for 15 minutes covered. Uncover increase heat to moderate and cook about 35 minutes stirring frequently and scraping bottom of pan until onions are deep golden brown. Sprinkle with salt and flour and stir for 3 minutes. Stir in broth and simmer partially covered for 35 minutes. Toast bread slices. Place toast in individual bowls. Pour soup over toast and sprinkle with cheese (melt cheese in microwave).

title: Sausage Eggs
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in 8-inch square pan for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sausage And Egg Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix together eggs mustard salt milk and green chilies. Cook and drain sausage. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer ingredients as follows. First 5 slices white bread (cubed) 2nd sausage 3rd egg mixture and 4th grated cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Spud Burgers
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Form into a roll. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven or on charcoal grill basting with steak or barbecue sauce as desired. Slice for burgers.

title: Crazy Crunch
instructions: Pop the corn and mix with nuts on cookie sheets. Combine sugar butter and corn syrup in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring until sugar is dissolved. Continue cooking and stir occasionally for 10 to 15 minutes or until mixture turns light caramel color. Pour over corn and nuts and mix.

title: Apple Nut Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg in large mixing bowl. Stir in sugar. Beat eggs slightly; blend in oil and vanilla. Pour into dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in apples and pecans. Turn into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 60 minutes or until cake is golden brown and springs back when touched lightly.

title: Navajo Fried Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Make well in middle. Slowly add liquid and mix in from center. Dough should be slightly sticky. Let set; wait 1 hour. Take small ball; roll or pat out very thin. Drop in smoking Crisco or oil. (Make sure its hot.) Turn when golden brown. Drain on paper. Serve warm or keep hot in warm oven. Serve with chopped lettuce onion tomatoes shredded cheese and taco sauce.

title: Garlic Roasted Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice garlic powder seasoning salt and pepper. Wrap chicken loosely in foil. Refrigerate overnight. Place chicken in ovenproof dish and bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until done. Yields 4 servings.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix Jell-O in bowl with 1 pint of hot water. When mixed well add sugar then add cold water. Stir in remaining ingredients except ginger ale. Add ginger ale just before you serve.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Boil rice in salt water until tender. Remove desired amount of leaves from cabbage and chop. Place leaves in pot with enough boiling salt water to cover and add vinegar; let simmer. Boil 5 minutes until done.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Press dough flat on lightly greased 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix remaining ingredients and spread on cooled crust. Cut into squares. Top with any or all of the following cherry tomatoes cucumber radishes olives mushrooms onions celery bacon sprouts green pepper carrots cauliflower shrimp broccoli and cheese.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Mix ingredients. Shape int good size thick cakes. Fry in butter or margarine until brown. Makes 2 to 4 depending on how thick you like them.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat melt butter. Cook mushrooms green pepper and onions until tender stirring occasionally. Stir in soup and milk. Add chicken and pimento. Heat just to boiling stirring occasionally. Stir in sherry. Spoon chicken mixture into patty shells or over toasted muffins or toast. Yields 4 cups.

title: Chicken, Sausage And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute sausage and set aside. In drippings saute mushrooms and onions; add sausage and cooked chicken. Cook wild rice according to package directions. In separate pan mix flour with cream until smooth. Add broth and cook until thickened. Add seasonings along with the rice sausage chicken mushrooms and onions. Put in 10 x 12-inch baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain. Add onion and remaining ingredients. Cook well. Serve on hamburger buns. Yields 12 servings.

title: Green Chile Chuck Roast
instructions: In deep skillet or Dutch oven heat oil hot. Brown roast on both sides. Add onion and chilies turn roast to cover fully with onion and chilies. Pour beer around side of roast. Sprinkle with seasonings and cover with tight lid. Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours over low heat. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix egg and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer. Add flour oil milk baking powder and salt by hand. Stir well. Stir in flavorings and poppy seed. Pour mixture into loaf pans which have been prepared with margarine and sugar. (No flour). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: The Beacon Barbecue
instructions: Cook meat until tender. Simmer all other ingredients together for 30 to 45 minutes or until slightly thick then add shredded meat. Cook together for a few minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli and drain. Drain carrots. In mixing bowl add undiluted soup mayonnaise and egg and mix well. In casserole dish (large one) put broccoli and carrots in. Pour mixture over top; spread (do not stir in). Place shredded cheese over the top. Top with bread crumbs and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Season hot potatoes with butter cinnamon and nutmeg to taste. Add corn flakes and sugar. Shape into balls. Roll in chopped nuts. Chill at least 30 minutes or overnight. Arrange on pineapple slices in buttered baking dish and bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut each chicken breast in half and wrap with bacon slice. Put the beef in an 8 x 10 inch baking dish. Place chicken on top of beef. Mix together the sour cream and the soup and pour over chicken. Cover pan and bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven. Remove cover during last 20 minutes of baking.

title: Grilled Chicken
instructions: Blend orange juice concentrate (undiluted) and Worcestershire sauce in blender. Do not add any other ingredients. Marinate chicken pieces about 1 hour. Cook over low flames turning occasionally and basting often with marinade.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Mix molasses sugar water vinegar and butter. Cook over medium heat in cast iron skillet until it cracks in cold water. Add soda and stir for a minute. Pour mixture over popped corn and allow to stand until cool. In palm of hands (with butter on them) press together into balls.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients well. Add eggs. Then add soda added to buttermilk and vanilla. Use enough flour to make dough stiff enough to roll out. Use a 450\u00b0 oven.

title: Soy Sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan combine all ingredients; boil gently uncovered 5 minutes until reduced to 1/2 cup. Chill to store; stir before using. This sauce has 120 mil. of sodium per teaspoon.

title: A Wilson Special
instructions: Peel and wrap the banana tightly in plastic wrap. Put it in the freezer for 2 hours. Place yogurt strawberries banana and orange juice in the jar of a blender. Puree until smooth and frothy.

title: Cheese And Ham Quiche
instructions: Mix together cheese eggs half and half paprika pepper salt and ham. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until set and brown. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Pineapple Chicken
instructions: Spray casserole dish with nonstick spray. Place chicken in dish. Sprinkle with paprika garlic and onion powder to taste. Add soy sauce to juice from pineapple and mix. Baste chicken with mixture. Pour pineapple over top. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. (When using boneless chicken bake for 30 minutes) Serve over rice.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in a 2 quart greased casserole dish. Pour water or orange juice over the apples. Sprinkle cinnamon on top of apples. Mix flour brown sugar and butter. Put on top of cinnamon apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Squares
instructions: Mix well. Place in a greased 9 x 11-inch baking dish. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until it feels firm. Cut in squares and serve with cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup on top.

title: Coffee-Orange-Fudge Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips and confectioners sugar. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Add chips and blend. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Beat all ingredients together. Add chocolate chips. Drop on cookie sheet. Makes 2 dozen sugarless chocolate chip cookies.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Bake in a 1 1/2-quart dish at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Shoestring Snack
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 450\u00b0. Spread potatoes evenly on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Heat about 4 minutes. Serve while hot. Yield 4 servings.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Add boiling water and stir until dissolved. Cool. Add lemon juice pineapple (with juice) and sugar. Chill until partially set. Combine half Cool Whip with mixture. Line a large bowl with plastic wrap. Break up cake into bite size pieces and alternate layers of mixture with cake layers. Refrigerate until firm (overnight). Unmold cake and frost with remaining whipped topping. Sprinkle generously with coconut.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts. Place dough on a cookie sheet (over wax paper). Sprinkle nuts. Bake 12 to 15 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven on a greased cookie sheet covered with wax paper. Prepare a hand or dish towel (clean) with powdered sugar. Place dough on towel. Place in the freezer for 5 minutes.

title: Spinach, Red Pepper, And Feta Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0.

title: Savory Pork-Vegetables
instructions: In skillet in 1 tablespoon hot margarine cook chops for 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove.

title: Shortcut Strawberry Cake
instructions: Butter the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread the miniature\tmarshmallows evenly over the bottom. Combine strawberries syrup and dry gelatin. In a large bowl combine the rest of the ingredients. Blend and beat for 3 minutes. Spoon the batter over the marshmallows then spoon the strawberry mixture over the batter. Bake at\t350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve hot warm or\tcool with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Cooked Mayonnaise
instructions: Beat egg yolks together with sugar salt mustard red pepper and Wesson oil. Set aside. Mix water and vinegar and beat until it comes to a boil. Beat water and vinegar into the first mixture. Put entire mixture in top of a double boiler and cook until it is thick. Pour into a covered jar and keep in refrigerator.

title: Spanish Rice In Microwave
instructions: No spires miraculously arise

title: Fried Eggplant
instructions: Peel eggplant; slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Soak in buttermilk at least 20 minutes. Mix flour salt and pepper. Dip eggplant into flour. Fry until golden brown on both sides.

title: Pumpkin Cloud Pie(Sugar-Free)
instructions: In a medium bowl stir cream cheese with a spoon until soft. Add 1/2 cup Cool Whip free and coconut extract. Mix gently to combine. Set aside. In a large bowl combine pumpkin dry pudding mix dry milk powder and water. Mix well using a wire whisk. Blend in pumpkin pie spice and remaining 1/4 cup Cool Whip free. Spread half of mixture into pie crust; evenly spread cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle coconut and pecans evenly over top. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Cut into 8 servings.

title: Barbecue Brisket
instructions: Place brisket in oblong baking dish; sprinkle with liquid smoke and salts. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to bake sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Place foil loosely over meat. Cook at 275\u00b0 for 5 hours. Uncover and pour barbecue sauce over meat. Cook without foil for another hour. Remove to platter and let cool before slicing. Remove fat from sauce remaining in dish. Add flour and water to sauce and stir. Cook until sauce thickens. Serve sauce hot with meat. Serve with rice or potatoes and tossed green salad. Makes 10 servings.

title: Maria'S Pineapple Punch
instructions: Take a quart of water and bring to a boil. Stir Jell-O and sugar until dissolved. Place mixture in gallon container. Fill container to 2 inches from the top with water. Freeze. Remove from freezer and let thaw to a slush. Add pineapple juice and ginger ale to punch bowl.

title: Cherry-O-Cream Pie
instructions: Blend condensed milk lemon juice and vanilla in a blender on medium speed. Add cream cheese while blender is running 1 piece at a time. Blend until smooth. Pour into pie crust; top with filling. Refrigerate until firm and serve.

title: Doug'S Chili
instructions: In a skillet brown the ground beef onions and green pepper until vegetables are tender; drain off fat. Stir in tomatoes beans salt chili powder and bay leaf. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Remove the bay leaf. Serve piping hot.

title: The Next Best Thing To Robert Redford #2
instructions: Crust Combine pecans flour and butter. Mix together; press into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Grandmother Burgess' Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: In double boiler scald milk. Mix next 4 ingredients; stir in enough milk to make smooth paste. Stir into rest of milk in double boiler. Stir until thickened. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Cool. Add vanilla and cream. Freeze in 2-quart freezer until hard to turn using 8 parts crushed ice to 1 part ice cream salt. Makes 1 1/4 quarts.

title: Garlic Barbecue Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid and shake well. Refrigerate overnight or longer the longer the better. Baste meat several times while cooking.

title: Gumdrop Cookies
instructions: Stir flour oats gumdrops baking powder soda and salt and set aside. With mixer cream margarine sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Beat in egg and stir in flour mixture.

title: Mexican Fruitcake
instructions: Mix sugar and eggs together. Sift flour. Add to sugar and eggs. Add pineapple and juice; mix well. Add chopped walnuts. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 9 x 3-inch ungreased pan. Cream margarine and cream cheese. Gradually add powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread on cake.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix oil eggs and water in mixer bowl; mix well. Stir in bananas and pecans. Spoon into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool in pan several minutes. Invert onto serving plate.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Combine sugar salt vinegar beet juice and cornstarch. Simmer until thick. Add beets and butter. Cook until beets are hot through.

title: Apple Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour loaf pan. Sift flour baking powder baking soda and spices in large bowl. Stir in brown sugar oatmeal and walnuts. Combine eggs milk and butter. Add to oatmeal mixture. Add apples but do not overmix. Spoon into prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until toothpick inserted into middle comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes and turn out of pan. Cool completely and wrap.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut rolled cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices; line pizza pan with slices until covered. Bake according to package directions.

title: Tortellini Minestrone Soup
instructions: Get out a very large bowl. Shred the cabbage by hand or in a food processor and place in bowl. Add the diced tomatoes sliced onions and diced cucumbers. Add both cans of sliced beets including all the beet juice. Add olive oil salad oil and vinegar. Next add oregano sweet basil leaves sugar salt and black pepper.

title: Tutti-Frutti Ice Cream
instructions: In saucepan beat eggs with sugar Pet milk and 2 cups regular milk. Cook until pudding consistency. Cool. Add Eagle Brand milk vanilla 3 bananas jar of maraschino cherries plus 1 tablespoon cherry juice pineapple pecans and food coloring to desired color. Finish filling can with milk and freeze. Makes 1 gallon.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer 15 minutes. Use to baste pork when grilling. Yield 3 1/2 cups.

title: Tossed Vegetable Salad
instructions: Wash thoroughly the greens cut up in pieces. Slice cucumber and onion. Cut pepper in thin 1-inch slices. Peel avocado and cube. Toss in all ingredients including chickpeas. Chill.

title: Mom'S Butter Bean Soup
instructions: Put butter beans in water to about 3 times depth of beans; add pork and onion. Cook until beans are tender. If needed add water during cooking. When beans are tender salt and pepper to taste and add chili sauce. At this point depending upon meat you chose you may want to shred bits into soup or serve for sandwiches on side. Simmer now about 15 to 20 minutes. Hearty inexpensive and easy!

title: Oatmeal Chewies
instructions: Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Combine oats 1 1/2 cups of flour brown sugar soda and salt; mix well. Stir in margarine; mix until well blended. Reserve 1 cup. Press remaining onto a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until light brown. Cool 10 minutes. Top with nuts and chocolate pieces. Mix caramel and 1/4 cup of flour until smooth (easier if warmed slightly). Drizzle over nuts and chocolate pieces to within 1/4 inch of pan edges. Sprinkle with reserved mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 22 minutes. Cool and cut.

title: Macaroni, Cheese And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed. Put 1/2 in casserole dish. Slice up half of Velvetta cheese and layer on macaroni. Put 1 1/2 cans chopped tomatoes in layer on top of cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbles approximately 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Orange Relish
instructions: Slice unpeeled orange into eighths; remove seeds. Place half the cranberries and half the orange pieces in a food processor container. Process until mixture is evenly chopped. Repeat with remaining cranberries and orange pieces. Stir in sugar to desired sweetness. Store in refrigerator or freezer. Makes about 2 1/2 cups. Delicious with Thanksgiving turkey!

title: Spanakopita
instructions: Prepare fresh spinach; sprinkle with salt. Tear into small pieces; rinse thoroughly. Drain. Beat the eggs. Crumble Feta cheese and mix. Add this to spinach. Chop onion; saute in olive oil. Add to spinach mixture. Season with pepper and oregano.

title: Tuna Dill Sandwich
instructions: Stir dressing dill and pepper. Add tuna onion and carrot; mix well. For each sandwich top one muffin half with lettuce cheese and tuna mixture.

title: Glorified Pork Chops
instructions: In skillet over medium heat in hot oil cook chops 1/2 at a time with onion 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup and water. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 10 minutes or until chops are fork-tender stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings. Preparation time 3 minutes; cook time 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken Divine
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling salted water until tender. Drain; arrange in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Place chicken on top. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Bacon Snacks
instructions: Sprinkle cheese on crackers. Wrap in bacon (1/3 slice each). Bake at 200\u00b0 for 2 to 4 hours.

title: Ranch Crackers
instructions: Mix in bowl the crackers dill weed oil and dressing. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Turn crackers every 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Place a slice of pineapple on crisp lettuce on a salad plate. Combine precooked shrimp thinly sliced celery green pepper strips and minced onion to taste. Mix with mayonnaise. Season well and heap on pineapple on salad plate. Garnish with olives and deviled eggs.

title: Chili
instructions: Use food processor and finely chop the clove of garlic. Brown garlic with ground beef. Put tomatoes onion and green pepper in blender; blend well. Onions and green pepper will be larger pieces so dont blend too much. Add to meat in skillet. Add tomato paste and seasonings. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to simmer and cook 1 hour. Add kidney beans; heat through. Serve with oyster crackers or crusty French bread.

title: Dressing
instructions: Saute chopped celery and onion in oleo in iron skillet until tender. Chop boiled eggs and set aside. Mix all other ingredients adding chopped eggs\tlast. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until brown on top.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Fill punch bowl with ice. Mix juices in pitcher; add ginger ale to thin. Mix well. Pour over ice; add more ginger ale to fill; stir. Serves 25 to 30.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix graham crackers and butter; make a crust in the bottom of a long cake pan. Mix powdered sugar and 3 eggs and beat with an electric mixer and pour over crust. Add sliced bananas; top with Cool Whip then sprinkle with cherries and pecans. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

title: Apple Butter(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Slow cook apples for 17 hours on low. Add remaining ingredients and cook on high for 8 hours.

title: Rhineland Potato Salad
instructions: Cook bacon onion and green pepper until bacon is crisp. Drain and add to remaining ingredients; toss lightly.

title: Sweet Rolls
instructions: Thaw bread and break apart in 13 x 9-inch pan (small pieces). Combine and heat brown sugar oleo milk cinnamon vanilla pudding and chopped nuts or coconut. Heat until blended. Do not cook. Pour over dough pieces and let rise to rim of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: One Dish Chicken Bake
instructions: Sift stuffing crumbs seasoning packet 1 1/2 cups hot water and 1/4 cup margarine until just moistened; set aside. Place chicken in 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken. Top with stuffing. Bake at 375 degrees for 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. 4 servings.

title: Pecan Tart Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and butter. Add flour. Refrigerate 1 hour. Divide into 2 dozen balls. Pat into muffin tins. Beat egg brown sugar butter vanilla and nuts. Drop into filled muffin tins filling 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Buttermilk Rolls
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup of the buttermilk to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast over lukewarm milk and stir until dissolved. Allow to stand a few minutes and then add remaining buttermilk. Blend well.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour water over oatmeal cool 20 minutes. Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs; mix. Sift flour soda salt and cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture. Add cooled oatmeal. Add nuts coconut and raisins. Pour into greased and floured oblong baking pan (13 x 9-inch). Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil and cool. Mix chopped vegetables and olives with kraut and sprouts in a large Pyrex bowl. Pour vinegar and sugar over it and mix well. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Hockey Puck Potatoes
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients and place mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Crumble on top cornflakes mixed with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain and cool. Add vegetables and mix well. Combine milk vinegar sugar mayonnaise salt and pepper. Add these ingredients to macaroni mixture. Mix thoroughly and chill at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook chicken. Combine chicken and soy sauce. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Let sit for 15 minutes. Cook rice in hot oil. Reduce heat. Add chicken and broth. Simmer covered 20 to 25 minutes. Stir in onions green peppers and celery. Cook uncovered. Push rice to side. Add eggs and cook until almost set. Blend into rice. Stir in lettuce or red cabbage.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill in refrigerator about 1 hour before serving.

title: Mom'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 until set.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar milk butter and cocoa for 1 1/2 minutes. Start counting when mixture has reached a full rolling boil. Remove from heat and add oats nuts vanilla and peanut butter. Mix well until blended. Spoon onto wax paper and cool.

title: Salmon And Asparagus Chantilly
instructions: Drain salmon reserving liquid. Remove skin and bone. Add enough milk to salmon juice to make 2 cups liquid. Melt butter; blend in flour. Add milk and salmon juice. Cook until smooth and thick. Add onion mustard salt pepper mayonnaise and parsley flakes. Combine sauce salmon eggs and asparagus spears. Place in shallow 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Potatoes Deluxe
instructions: Mix all ingredients and place in buttered 9 x 13 casserole. Mix crushed corn flakes with 1/4 c. melted margarine and sprinkle over top.

title: Danish Cake
instructions: Blend sugar and oil; add eggs. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Then add vanilla nuts and dates. Pour into buttered pan. Bake at 300\u00b0. When brown remove from stove and while still hot cover with the icing.

title: Orange Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add the egg and the orange rind and juice or extract. Beat vigorously. Then add the dry ingredients sifted together. Shape into two rolls and cover with wax paper. Chill thoroughly. Slice one-fourth-inch thick. Bake in a hot oven 400\u00b0 for about ten minutes. Makes about thirty cookies. (These are good decorated with icing fruit or nuts.)

title: Fresh Peach Cobbler
instructions: Bring 2 cups sugar and water to a boil. Take off heat after comes to boil. Cut up peaches. Set aside.

title: Rice Pudding(Arrozo Doce #2)
instructions: In a 1 to 1 1/2-quart saucepan bring the milk vanilla bean cinnamon stick pieces of lemon peel and 1/8 teaspoon of salt to a boil over moderate heat. Cover the pan tightly. Remove from heat and let the seasonings steep for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge Recipe 2
instructions: Stir milk butter and sugar until it boils; boil 8 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Mix flour salt baking powder and milk. Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour batter over melted oleo. Drop fruit over batter then sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until browned.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Drain the sweet potatoes and mash. Add eggs granulated sugar flavoring and butter. Mix well. Pour into baking dish. Mix flour brown sugar margarine and nuts separately. Spread over the top of sweet potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Vienna Bread
instructions: Stuff mushrooms cheese and olives in cracks of bread. Place on large piece of foil. Microwave butter green pepper onions salt lemon juice and mustard 2 minutes. Pour over bread. Wrap in foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Crunchy Waldorf Salad
instructions: Gently combine all ingredients. Chill until serving time. Serve on lettuce.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix sugar and cocoa together. Add eggs flour and salt. Mix well then add chopped nuts. Pour into greased and floured sheet cake pan (about 9 1/2 x 13 1/2 x 2-inch - an open roasting pan does well). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven and cover top while still hot with marshmallow cream.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; beat with an electric mixer until blended. Stir in pecans. Pour mixture into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cake With Creamy Icing
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add oil coffee and milk. Mix about 2 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes more. Pour into two 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Good with ham in place of vegetable. Also good as dessert; warm or cold.

title: Mini Taco Cups
instructions: Mix together the tomato sauce and seasoning mix. Cook and drain ground beef then add taco mix. Cut into quarters 1 package dinner rolls. Press pieces into mini muffin pans (greased). Form a cup and fill with meat mixture. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Use a teaspoon to get out of pan.

title: Teacher'S Perk Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease Bundt pan or spray with nonstick cooking spray. Place the frozen dinner rolls in Bundt pan (extra large size). If you dont have this pan divide between 2 regular size Bundt pans or experiment with a sheet pan. Sprinkle with pecans. Mix together the brown sugar and vanilla pudding. Sprinkle the pudding mixture on top of the pecans. Pour the melted margarine over the rolls. Spray plastic wrap with nonstick cooking spray; cover Bundt pan(s). Leave on counter overnight. In morning bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Butter bottom of pan. Layer ingredients in order listed. Do not mix. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 20 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion in water until tender. Drain well. Add butter soup and crackers. Pour into casserole dish. Top with Velveeta slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Potato Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients in a greased casserole. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes.

title: 106 Year Old Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add remaining ingredients and put in tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Eclair
instructions: Line 13 x 9-inch pan with some of the crackers. Pour cold milk into bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat at low speed on mixer until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Let stand for 5 minutes. Then blend in Cool Whip. Spread 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers. Add another layer of crackers. Top with remaining pudding mixture. Top with remaining crackers. Spread pie filling or frosting over top. (Frosting works better if warmed just a few seconds in microwave to make more spreadable.) Chill 3 hours or overnight.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix soy sauce sherry sugar ginger 5 spice powder and cornstarch together. Marinate the wings for 15 minutes. Deep fry in 375\u00b0 peanut oil until the wings are golden brown and tender.

title: Cheesy Zucchini
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling water 5 minutes and drain. Combine soup cheese sour cream and carrots; fold in squash and onion. Combine stuffing and oleo. Put 1/2 of stuffing mix on bottom of pan. Place squash mixture on stuffing. Cover top of squash mixture with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onion together. Spread over the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with green beans. Top with mashed potatoes. Drizzle melted butter over potatoes. Bake at 325\u00b0 until browned approximately 20 minutes.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: This makes a large bowl. Dont mix these until the last thing and then add cream.

title: Finger Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and powdered sugar; blend in flour. Press evenly in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread over hot baked layer. Return to oven to bake 20 minutes longer. Cool about 15 minutes in pan before cutting into bars.

title: Carrot Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 8 muffin cups or line with paper bake cups. Set aside.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Beat in sugar and oil. Add vanilla. Beat until lemon color add zucchini and stir. Add flour cinnamon baking soda salt and baking powder. Stir well. Fold in nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour. Take out and thump bottom of pans to test to see if done. Set for 10 minutes. Remove from pans to cool completely.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
instructions: To slightly beaten egg yolks add 1/2 cup sugar pumpkin milk salt cinnamon nutmeg and ginger. Cook until thick in double boiler. Pour cold water into bowl and sprinkle gelatine on top of water. Add to hot pumpkin mixture and mix thoroughly; cool. When it begins to thicken add remaining sugar and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into large baked pie shell. Chill in refrigerator or cold place. Pie may be garnished with whipped cream just before serving. This is delicious in a gingersnap crust.

title: Cream Cheese Crescents
instructions: Mix ingredients until smooth and creamy. Place dough in refrigerator overnight. Roll out on floured board about 1/8-inch thick. Cut in 2-inch squares. Fill with favorite filling. Roll into crescents. Bake at 400\u00b0 until light brown. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Cheese Souffle
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 1 1/2-quart souffle dish with butter and sprinkle with Swiss cheese. Stir flour and melted butter together. Let foam and cook 2 minutes without browning. Remove from heat pour in hot milk and beat. Return to heat and boil stirring for 1 minute. Sauce will be very thick. Remove from heat and beat the egg yolks into the hot mixture one at a time. Add salt pepper and nutmeg to taste.

title: Refrigerator Breakfast Sweet Rolls(Yields 36 Rolls)
instructions: Scald milk and set aside to cool to lukewarm. Put 1 teaspoon of sugar and yeast in the 1/4 cup water. Sift flour into large bowl and add salt lemon rind and 1/4 cup sugar. Cut the 1 cup butter into flour mix as for pie crust with pastry blender. Add beaten eggs and yeast to cooled milk. Combine lightly with flour-butter mix. Stir until well mixed but dont beat. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg yolks. Beat well. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add alternately with milk and vanilla. Beat thoroughly after each addition. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold nuts in batter then egg whites. Pour into a greased tube pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Swiss Chicken Casserole
instructions: Arrange chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese slices. Combine soup with milk and pour over chicken. Sprinkle stuffing mix or croutons over top and drizzle with margarine. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Old Fashioned Coconut Pie
instructions: In medium saucepan combine 1 1/2 cups sugar and flour. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat 6 to 8 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Stir 1 cup hot mixture into egg yolks; immediately return to saucepan and hot mixture. Cook and stir for 3 to 4 minutes longer. Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup coconut margarine and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Pour into pie shell and bake for 30 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0.

title: Surprise Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple in saucepan until it comes to a boil; stir in gelatins until dissolved. Cool. Add buttermilk and Cool Whip to mixture. Put in glass dish. Refrigerate.

title: Banana Split Freeze
instructions: Slice bananas and place on crust. Layer ice cream on top. Sprinkle with nuts and freeze. Combine chips oleo powdered sugar and milk. Cook and stir until thick. Add vanilla and cool. Pour cooled sauce on ice cream and freeze. Top with Dream Whip. (Can fold in pineapple or strawberries.) Freeze. Serves 15 to 18. Will keep 1 month in freezer.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Bake chicken garlic and onion at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. Cool and chop chicken reserving juice. Add tomato black olives green pepper and cheeses to cooled chicken onion and garlic. Wrap a handful of the chicken-vegetable-cheese mixture into each tortilla and place on a 10 x 15-inch pan which has been sprayed with Pam.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Clean and cut chicken into serving pieces. Brown in hot oil. Add vegetables and brown lightly. Salt and pepper to taste. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until done. If liquid evaporates add a little water.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put peaches in pan. Cut up stick of butter and place over peaches. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Mix 2 cups sugar flour and milk. Pour batter over peaches and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Drew'S P.B.J.
instructions: Spread peanut butter over 1/2 of bread and jelly over the other half. Fold together and eat. You will love it as much as he does.

title: Dilly Ham Balls
instructions: In a bowl combine ham bread crumbs onions 1 tbsp fresh dill (1 tsp dried dill) milk egg mustard and 1/4 tsp pepper; mix well. Shape into 1 inch balls. In a large skillet heat 1 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp oil. Brown ham balls add remaining butter and oil as needed. Remove ham balls to a serving dish cover and keep warm. Pour ham drippings into a sauce pan blend in flour. Gradually add water and stir until smooth. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Add sour cream and remaining dill and pepper heat through but do not boil. Pour over the ham balls. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Venison Roast
instructions: Marinate venison in strong vinegar-water solution for about 2 hours. Remove and rinse well. Dry meat off. Rub salt and red pepper into meat.

title: Stuffed Date Drops
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar until light. Add egg. Sift dry ingredients and mix alternating with sour cream. Stuff each date with nut quarter and add. Stir only to mix in dates. Drop onto greased cookie sheet 1 date to each cookie. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Top with Golden Frosting.

title: Nettie'S Coleslaw
instructions: Cut up cabbage onion and pepper in a large bowl. Bring all other ingredients to a boil and pour over the cabbage mixture. Let set overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken And Sausage Gumbo
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch chunks. In large saucepot heat oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sausage a few pieces at\ta time and cook until browned on all sides removing to plate as they brown.

title: Shrimp Stuffed Mirlitons
instructions: Simmer mirlitons in salted water until tender; cut in halves. Remove seeds and spoon out pulp. Mix pulp and bread crumbs. Saute onions garlic and shrimp in butter over medium heat about 10 to 15 minutes stirring frequently; cool. Add egg parsley and thyme. Fill shells; sprinkle the top with bread crumbs and butter. Bake 25 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Drain corn. Mix onion tomatoes and corn. Add mayonnaise to coat.

title: Caramel Filled Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Beat together butter or margarine sugars and vanilla until combined. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Stir together flour cocoa and baking soda. Add to butter mixture and beat on low speed until just combined. Stir in 1/2 cup nuts. Cover and chill dough 1 hour.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Mix and pour melted margarine over top. Shape into little balls. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown. Yields 48.

title: Royal Coconut Cookies
instructions: Sift flour powder soda and salt. Add sugars egg and flavoring. Beat until smooth. Fold in oats and coconut. Shape into small balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Loaded Potato Soup
instructions: Chop Potatoes. Put everything in a pot. Cook until the potatoes are done.

title: Kool-Aid Punch
instructions: Place defrosted lemon juice and all ingredients in large container. Add enough water to make 4 gallons. Refrigerate overnight. Garnish with maraschino cherries frozen in ice cubes.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients. Store in refrigerator in covered jar. Makes 1 2/3 cups.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: In large bowl beat together sugar butter vanilla and milk until smooth. If necessary add more milk until frosting spreads smooth. If desired add a few drops of food coloring. Can frost a two layer cake.

title: Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: Cook celery and onion together until tender. Break corn bread and toast up in a large bowl. Add celery and onion mixture and next 4 ingredients. After mixing put into baking dish or pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done to your likeness.

title: Andrew'S Devil'S Food Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Dough will be very sticky. Using 2 spoons dip a tablespoon amount out and roll in a bowl of powdered sugar to coat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 9 minutes. Serve with a glass of cold moo juice!

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles with a little butter. Drain. Pour into casserole dish and mix soup and tuna with it. Add bread crumbs sprinkled with Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl mix sugar and eggs. Combine flour meal baking powder and salt. Add to the egg mixture; stir in melted butter and milk. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 baking pan for 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortillas. Spread on tortillas and roll into log. Slice to desired size. Serve with picante sauce for dipping.

title: Michigan Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Beat egg and mix with cottage cheese parsley and garlic. Brown beef and sausage (drain) and add Prego and tomato paste. Simmer (if too thick add a little water). Coat 9 x 13-inch pan with a little oil. Layer noodles meat sauce then egg and cheese mixture then noodles. Repeat layers ending with meat sauce. Bake at 375\u00b0 covered for 1/2 hour. Remove cover and bake 1/2 hour more.

title: Old Fashioned Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients together. Cut in butter with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal. Pour beaten egg into the flour mixture and knead about 20 seconds. Brush with melted butter pat out the remaining half of the dough over top. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until done. Turn out on cooking rack.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef; add onion and peppers also mushroom if you prefer. Cook sliced potatoes until tender. Put a layer of ground beef mixture and then add potatoes and more soup. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook for 30 to 35 minutes in a 375\u00b0 oven. Before you cook it add a little milk on top. It helps it to stay moist.

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Boil rhubarb sugar and pineapple for 20 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Place in hot jars; cover with paraffin.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape into an 8 x 4 x 1 1/2 inch loaf. Place in a lightly greased shallow pan. Brush with 57 sauce if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Allow to set 5 minutes before slicing. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Spareribs Or Chicken And Potatoes
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pot and cook for 2 hours or until tender.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
instructions: Cook rice; mix with soup corn ro-tel. Put in casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0F. until cheese browns.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place 2 slices of cubed bread in the bottom of a casserole. Mix chicken vegetables and mayonnaise. Spoon over bread. Add the other 4 slices of cubed bread over this. Combine eggs and milk and pour over top of bread. Cover and chill at least one hour or overnight. Spoon mushroom soup over the top and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. During last 10 minutes of baking sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Mom'S French Dressing
instructions: Add ingredients to blender and blend for 1 minute. Pour into bottle and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Soup
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan heat fruit and juice to boiling. Simmer about 10 minutes; remove from heat. Add sugar; cool. In covered blender at low speed blend soup half at a time. Pour into a bowl; add orange sections. Refrigerate covered. Serve in a chilled bowl; garnish with strawberry slices.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Melt margarine then add sugar and beat well. Add 1 egg at a time beating after each one. Then add vanilla flavoring and self-rising flour and beat. Bake at 300\u00b0 until edges are brown.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil. Pour over the mixture. Put into refrigerator. (This will keep indefinitely.)

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: In a very large mixing bowl combine the flour baking powder and sugar making sure the baking powder is thoroughly blended in. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and add oil eggs vanilla and anise. Mix well and shape into a bow knot or twist on floured board. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown (about 10 minutes). Brush with powdered sugar glaze and sprinkle with nonpareils.

title: Chicken A La King Over Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except biscuits) in 1-quart casserole. Cover tightly and microwave on High (100%) until hot and bubbly 5 to 7 minutes. Stir. Serve over biscuits. (I use Bisquick biscuits.)

title: Sausage-Cheese Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix well eggs half and half milk dry mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Cut crusts off bread and cube. Place in the bottom of a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle sausage over bread. Pour egg mixture over bread and sausage. Top with slices of Velveeta cheese. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; add eggs and oil stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple 1 cup chopped pecans and bananas. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 23 to 28 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans and let cool completely on wire racks.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken cool remove from bone and cut in big chunks. Mix crackers with melted margarine and poppy seed. Mix soups and sour cream. Cover bottom of pan with 1/2 of cracker mixture. Place chicken next and spread soup mixture over chicken. Top with remaining cracker mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. May be frozen. Serves 6.

title: Cabbage Cheddar Chowder
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef celery onion and green pepper in Dutch oven until vegetables are tender; drain. Stir in cabbage and water. Cover and cook over low heat stirring occasionally until cabbage is done (about 10 minutes). Stir in milk cheese flour salt pepper and nutmeg. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Garnish with pimentos. Makes 8 servings.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Good with garlic crackers.

title: Cocktail Sauce
instructions: In a serving bowl mix all the above ingredients. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Noodle Burger Bake
instructions: Combine and brown meat and onions until tender. Add all ingredients except bread crumbs and melted oleo and pour into oblong baking dish or casserole. Top with bread crumbs and oleo. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Boursin
instructions: Bring cream cheese and butter (or margarine) to room temperature. Add herbs and spices; whip until light. Pack into container; chill in refrigerator for at least 8 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Super Duper Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate down and mix with oil. Add sugar and vanilla. Add eggs singly. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add chocolate mixture and nuts to dry ingredients. Chill overnight. Form into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Yields 6 dozen.

title: All You Can Eat Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a large pot add bouillon cubes cabbage celery onions and carrots with water. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Add tomatoes green beans and chicken broth. Simmer an additional 30 minutes.

title: Easy Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix biscuit mix raisins caraway seed and sugar. Beat eggs and milk and add all at once to dry ingredients. Stir to form a sticky dough. Knead on a lightly floured board a few times to form a smooth ball. Cut dough into 2 pieces. Shape pieces of dough into 2 smooth balls. Place balls on greased cookie sheets. With a sharp knife cut a cross 1/2 inch deep in center of each ball. Bake in preheated oven (400\u00b0) for 25 to 30 minutes until brown and center feels firm. Cool thoroughly on rack before cutting. Bread can be frozen in foil and thawed in wrapping 2 hours.

title: Okra Goulash
instructions: Fry okra. When the okra is almost done add onion and a hot pepper. Add tomatoes and salt. Cook until done.

title: Fruited Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise salt and pepper. Toss with chicken and celery. Cover and refrigerate. Stir in grapes and pecans. Serve on lettuce. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except milk until crumbly. Stir in milk until dough leaves side of bowl. Put dough on lightly floured surface. Knead ten times. Roll to 1/2-inch thick. Cut into biscuits. Place on ungreased cookie sheets and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Creamed Chicken In Biscuit Bowls
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet. Add onion celery and mushrooms. Saut 2 to 3 minutes until tender. Whisk in chicken soup and milk and cook over medium-low heat 3 to 4 minutes stirring occasionally. Add cheese stirring constantly until melted. Stir in chicken peas carrots pimiento salt and pepper. Cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes. Spoon into Biscuit Bowls.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg. Add milk vanilla and sugar; beat. Add butter or margarine. Add everything except flour. Beat again. Slowly add flour beating continuously and scraping side of bowl. If batter is too thick add milk. If too thin add more flour. Serves 2 hungry people.

title: Vegetarian Collard Greens
instructions: Cut greens and onions. Heat 1 cup water and a good amount of garlic olive oil with fresh garlic. Add cut greens and onions. Add water as it steams out. Cook for about 1 hour (until moist). Add seasonings for flavor.

title: Cream Of Squash Soup
instructions: Slice squash; peel quarter and slice onion. Slice garlic cloves. Cook with water 2 bouillon cubes and butter until tender. Mash with potato masher. Mix cornstarch with 1 cup of the skim milk. Add to mixture. Stir until it starts to thicken then add rest of milk. Tear or cut cheese into hunks and add. Turn off heat and cover for 2 to 3 minutes until cheese melts. More milk may be added.

title: Apple Valley Cake(Sauce Makes The Difference)
instructions: Beat together oil and sugar; beat 3 minutes then add flour (2 cups) and soda. Stir in eggs vanilla and salt. Stir in apples and nuts. Pour batter into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Husbands Delight
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Double Batch Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Excellent side dish!

title: Blueberry Nectar Pie
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and put into your favorite pie crust. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon butter over filling. Put on a top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheesy Meatloaf
instructions: Mix egg milk cheese oatmeal onion and salt together. Add hamburger. Using ice cream scoop place in 9 x 13 pan. Top with remaining ingredients. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: In large dishpan mix all ingredients. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli (Or Zucchini) Casserole
instructions: In boiling salted water add cut up broccoli and chopped onion. Cook until tender. Drain and cool. Combine carrots soup and sour cream and mix. Set aside. Melt margarine and add stuffing mix. Toss to coat. Put 1/2 of this in bottom of casserole dish. Combine broccoli with soup mixture and put in casserole on top of stuffing mix. Top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash and drain cauliflower and broccoli. Cut broccoli flowerets and cauliflower into small pieces. Add sliced mushrooms.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Lay crescent rolls on a cookie sheet pressing edges together to form crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 11 to 13 minutes.

title: Cole Slaw Dressing
instructions: Mix the ingredients together and pour over cabbage.

title: Cathedral Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler. Add margarine. Cool. Beat 2 eggs and add to chocolate chips mixture. Add mini marshmallows stir quickly. Form into 3 rolls by globbing on tinfoil. Roll in chopped nuts. Reroll in new tinfoil and refrigerate overnight. Slice and serve.

title: Chicken Broccoli Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. In 2-quart casserole combine soup sour cream and salt. Stir in rice chicken and broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with onions and bake an additional 5 to 8 minutes or until onions are deep golden brown. Yield 4 servings.

title: Do Not Stir Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 12-inch casserole. Make batter of 1 cup sugar flour salt baking powder and milk. Pour batter into melted margarine in casserole dish. Add fruit and juice. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar; do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Jackie'S Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease muffin pan or baking loaf pan. Pour in batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 25 minutes. Makes 6 medium muffins.

title: Pronto Pups
instructions: Heat deep-fry with oil to 375\u00b0. Blend egg and milk; stir in dry ingredients. Dip wieners in batter. Fry until brown 2 or 3 minutes on each side. To reheat place in 400\u00b0 oven about 5 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Cream Puffs
instructions: Heat water butter sugar and salt to a rolling boil in saucepan. Add flour all at once and stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until thick and smooth (about 1 minute) staying away from the sides. Remove from heat and add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Use a wooden spoon or electric mixer until paste is shiny and smooth. Drop tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Let cool. Fill each cream puff with instant pudding vanilla or chocolate.

title: Barbecued Hamburgers
instructions: Mix beef salt and pepper; form into 8 patties. Brown in skillet (use shortening if needed); pour off fat. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over burgers. Simmer 20 minutes or until done. Stir now and then.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0.

title: Hungarian Veal And Peppers
instructions: Spray Dutch oven with cooking spray. Saute over medium-high heat the onions and peppers for 5 minutes; set aside. Dredge veal in flour; saute for 5 minutes.
