Add pepper mixture and mushrooms to veal and the next 5 ingredients; stir well. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until veal is tender stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook an additional 10 minutes. Serve over noodles. Equally good made with boneless and skinless chicken breasts.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Combine vinegar oil sugar and salt. Bring to a boil. Pour hot mixture over cabbage onion peppers and carrots. Let stand for 1 1/2 hours. Refrigerate. Will keep for several days. Serves 25.

title: Double Almond Cookies
instructions: Prepare and chill dough for Basic Sliced Cookies as directed.

title: Glazed Meatballs
instructions: In medium bowl combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. In skillet brown meatballs turning occasionally; drain. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Pour sauce over meatballs; simmer 15 minutes. Serve warm. Makes about 4 dozen meatballs.

title: Flour Tortillas
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; add hot water and knead until smooth. Tear off small amounts and roll into ball. Roll out flat with rolling pin. Bake on a hot griddle. Turn. Be careful not to overcook.

title: Pastitso
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add water and tomato paste. Cook macaroni; drain. Add margarine and cheese. Cook milk 1/2 cup margarine cornstarch and water until thick; cool. Beat eggs until yellow. Add seasonings and cheese. In 2-quart casserole layer the meat macaroni and sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender and then cream them. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Bake in ungreased casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: Beat softened oleo and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Add vanilla salt flour and cocoa; beat well. Add pecans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. While still hot cover with marshmallows or marshmallow cream. Place in oven that has been turned off until marshmallows melt.

title: Chocolate Turtle Pie
instructions: Spread caramel topping on bottom of crust; sprinkle with pecans. Refrigerate. Stir pudding mix into milk in large saucepan. Cook and stir on medium heat until mixture comes to full boil. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice. Pour into crust. Place plastic wrap on surface of filling. Refrigerate 3 hours. Garnish as desired. Store leftover pie in refrigerator. Makes 8 servings.

title: Grandma'S Pear Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 c. hot pear juice. Beat in cream cheese with mixture while juice is hot. Let jell 10 minutes. Stir in mashed pears and cool whip. Top with crushed pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Nine Day Slaw
instructions: Combine in large bowl

title: Chocolate Beer Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar slowly and beat well. Add egg yolks one at a time beating until well blended. Add chocolate and beat until smooth. Mix and sift flour baking powder soda and salt 3 times. Add alternately with beer a little at a time. Add the beaten egg whites. Bake in oblong pan at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Almond Butter
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy pan. Heat carefully to golden brown. Add almonds and lemon juice. Serve with broccoli cauliflower and asparagus.

title: Chokecherry Marinade
instructions: Pound steak. Put in wide-mouth jar or crock. Pour marinade over meat. Let stand overnight in cool place. Also for roast. Best marinade for dip.

title: Luscious Lemon Drops
instructions: In large bowl combine dry cake mix whipped topping egg lemon juice and lemon peel. Stir to mix well but do not overmix.

title: Hot Dogs And Cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Smaker Doodles Cookies
instructions: Beat Crisco and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to Crisco eggs and sugar mixture. Chill dough. Roll ball about size of walnut. Roll in 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. The cookies will puff up and then flatten out.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Place cubed steak in skillet. Simmer in suet until fairly tender. Add garlic clove for 1/2 hour; remove. Add onion and cook until thin. Add bouillon broth as well then add the tomatoes and pepper. Continue simmering until tomatoes and peppers are thin and meat is tender. Add cornstarch to desired thickness. Add soy sauce to taste. Serve over cooked rice or Chinese noodles.

title: Oyster Soup
instructions: Cook oysters onion and celery until tender. Make paste of cornstarch and water; put into oyster mixture and pour milk in.

title: Chili Pork Chops
instructions: Arrange pork chops in 3-quart casserole so that \tails\ are in center. Place onion and pepper slices on top of chops. Pour chili sauce on top. Microwave on Medium for 30 to 35 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn after 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Clean strawberries and divide between 2 baked pie shells. Heat mixture except jello until clear and thick. Remove from heat; add gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Pour over strawberries in baked pie shell. Top with Cool Whip after jelled.

title: No Bake Cheesecake(Low-Fat)
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar sour cream vanilla and Cool Whip until smooth. Spoon into crust. Garnish with pie cherries. Chill until set at least 4 hours.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Grate cheese. Brown ground beef. Cook noodles. Layer ground beef noodles cheese and sauce at least twice. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Place sauce in bottom of casserole dish on top of ground beef on top of noodles and on top of cheese.)

title: Chili
instructions: Mix together and cook slow for 1 hour.

title: Ice Cream Sundae Dessert
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Crush Oreo cookies. Melt butter. Stir cookies into butter and press into dish; freeze. Spread vanilla ice cream on top of cookies; freeze. Top with the following fudge sauce which has been previously made and cooled. Cook unsweetened baking chocolate sugar and milk to boiling until thick. When cool add vanilla and spread on ice cream; freeze. Spread prepared whipped topping a sprinkle of nuts and position a cherry for each serving in that order on top of fudge sauce. Freeze. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Ranch, Bacon And Cheddar Dip
instructions: Mix dip mix and sour cream. Then add bacon bits and cheese. Mix well and serve with chips.

title: Easy Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
instructions: Unroll 1 package crescent rolls in to 1 9 x 13-inch pan. Pat out. Mix filling and spread over. Unroll other package of crescent rolls and put over top. \Paint\ the egg white over the top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon (a generous amount). Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Pickle Strips
instructions: Wash cucumbers. Cut in strips. Pour boiling water over them. Let stand 4 to 5 hours. Drain and pack solidly in jars. Boil solution 5 minutes. Pour boiling hot over pickles in jars. Cook in hot water bath for 5 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 quarts.

title: Veggie Squares
instructions: Spread crescent rolls in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool. Blend cream cheese mayo and Hidden Valley Ranch dressing until smooth. Fold in gradually each of the chopped vegetables (except tomatoes and Cheddar cheese). Spread mixture over crescent rolls. Chill. Top with tomatoes and Cheddar cheese. Cut into squares and serve. (It is best to refrigerate overnight before serving.)

title: Sissy'S Five Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening with sugar. Add eggs beating well. Alternately add flour and baking powder with milk. Add extracts last. Bake in greased 10-inch tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Poi Cocktail
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in a big glass and serve like a milk shake.

title: Tin Plate Special
instructions: Wash beans. Cover with cold water and let soak overnight. Bring beans to a boil and cook 1 hour. Drain discarding water. Brown roast in hot fat in a large Dutch oven or roaster. Add pepper and onions and cook until tender. Add beans and remaining ingredients. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until beans are tender and meat is done.

title: Hot Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: In saucepan melt butter and saute small pieces of chipped beef. Add flour and mix well then add onion and white pepper. Stir in milk as mixture thickens. Add sour cream. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Easy Beef Stew
instructions: Pepper meat and then place in roasting bag following bag directions. Add the 2 soups over meat and seal bag. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes per pound. Serve with potatoes.

title: Sweet Potato Custard
instructions: In a medium bowl stir together sweet potato and banana. Add milk blending well. Add brown sugar egg yolks and salt; mixing thoroughly.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Mix butter with mixer until soft and creamy. Gradually add sugars. Combine flour baking soda and cocoa beginning and ending with flour mixture.\tStir in vanilla. Spoon batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on\ta wire 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.\tYields 1 (10-inch) cake.

title: Autumn Soup
instructions: In large saucepan cook and stir meat until brown; drain off excess fat. Cook and stir onion with meat until onion is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except tomatoes; heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in tomatoes; heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain grease off. Mix tomatoes salt pepper chili powder sugar water and rice in bowl. Mix good. Add to meat and onion. Cook until rice is tender.

title: Sweetheart Salad
instructions: Mix fruit and marshmallows with cream cheese and add whipping cream or Dream Whip. Add a few drops of red food coloring.

title: Chocolate Malt Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together and pour in freezer. Add regular milk to fill line. Stir and freeze. Makes 1 gallon.

title: 1-2-3-4 Basic Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Add dry items one cup at a time. Add vanilla extract. Bake at 350\u00b0 in 8 or 9-inch pan. Complete with your favorite topping.

title: Cornbread Salad
instructions: Mix vegetables relish and bacon together. Mix mayonnaise and 1/4 cup pickle juice. Place 1/2 of crumbled bread in bowl. Next layer 1/2 of the mixed vegetables and top with 1/2 of the mayonnaise topping. Repeat with bread vegetables and mayonnaise topping. Chill overnight.

title: Lemon Cheese Pie
instructions: Crush graham crackers; mix in bowl with melted butter. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in refrigerator. Follow directions on pudding box. When pudding is cooked add cream cheese; mix with electric mixer until smooth. Pour into prepared crust; refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Cook all ingredients\tuntil tender.\tThen add 2 cups mashed potatoes to make soup thicken.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Grind ham pork and beef. Add graham cracker crumbs egg and milk. Mix and shape into balls. Top with sauce tomato soup vinegar brown sugar and dry mustard. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato And Egg
instructions: Peel wash and dry potatoes to fill skillet slightly layering. Cook sliced potatoes on a medium heat until brown and crispy. Beat the eggs. Add seasonings to taste. Pour eggs over potatoes in skillet; cook until set. Turn the potatoes over to brown on the other side. Turn out of skillet; cut into serving pieces.

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Add butter and cheese to grits; stir until blended. Add eggs and milk. Bake in greased casserole dish at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together well. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Trucker'S Beans
instructions: Brown beef and onions in skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Add hot pepper seeds if desired. Mix meat mixture with remaining ingredients. Bake in 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven until done about 2 hours.

title: Barbecued Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine beef oats onion egg salt pepper and 1/2 cup tomato sauce. Mix well and pack into a lightly greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake loaf at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Wassail
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Cut a broiler into small pieces. In a deep frying pan with a cover heat 3 tablespoons olive oil; add chicken and brown until golden on all sides. (If desired skin can be removed.) Add chopped onion parsley basil salt and pepper. Brown together with chicken until onion is golden. Pour over all 1/2 cup wine (white or red). Cover and let simmer for about a minute; add tomatoes that have been crushed with a fork. Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Makes 3 or 4 servings.

title: Scotch Bread Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add sifted flour. Roll very thin. Cut and bake at 325\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Cooked Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook egg noodles in chicken broth (as many cups cooked egg noodles as chicken). Mix ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. May top with crushed potato chips.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Mix equal amounts of apple juice and ginger ale to freeze a mold to put in punch bowl. Then add equal amounts of chilled apple juice and ginger ale to punch bowl.

title: Beef Tips With Mushrooms And Onions
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saute pan. Saute mushrooms onions and garlic. Remove from pan with broth remaining. Add sirloin and brown over medium heat. Remove meat to dish with mushrooms and onions. Add remaining ingredients to broth in pan making sure to make a paste with cornstarch first to avoid having lumps in gravy. Stir this constantly until mixture thickens. Add back the beef mushrooms and onions and mix together with gravy. Pour this into a large casserole dish. At this point the dish can be refrigerated for cooking the next day. Bake covered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. This is delicious served with rice and green beans. Also a good dish to fix on Saturday and cook on Sunday morning for a perfect Sunday lunch. Enjoy!

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water; cool slightly. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into 6-cup mold. Chill.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Soak poppy seed in the cup of water about 2 hours. Add this and other ingredients to cake mix and mix well. Pour into ungreased tube pan. Bake about 35 minutes at 325\u00b0. Turn pan upside down to cool. Glaze with your favorite glaze.

title: Crock-Pot Roast
instructions: Put chuck roast into crock-pot. Add all ingredients to this. Add enough water to cover just over the ingredients. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours. May be best to add your cut up potatoes last so it wont be mushy. You can add the last hour.

title: Choco-Peanut Squares
instructions: Line a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan with foil (foil should be over edges of pan). In medium pan combine sugar and syrup. Cook until sugar is dissolved. Stir in peanut butter until melted. Remove from heat; add cereal stirring until combined. Press cereal in pan. Microwave chocolate chips for 1 minute (all will not be melted). Spread on cereal. Wait 5 minutes then spread evenly. Chill about 30 minutes. Lift cereal out. Peel off foil and cut.

title: Zucchini And Corn Bake
instructions: Cook zucchini in small amount of water until tender. Drain and mash. Saute onion in butter until tender. Mix together onion zucchini corn eggs cheese salt and pepper. Pour into a greased baking dish.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar together and spoon dressing over salad several hours before serving or for crispier salad just before serving.

title: Boysenberry Pizza
instructions: Mix flour shortening and sugar until well blended. Add eggs water vinegar and walnuts. Mix well. Press into 12-inch pizza pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Chicken Ravioli
instructions: Boil chicken and remove from bone. Saute celery and bell pepper in 1/2 stick of butter. Boil egg noodles in chicken broth to cook. Add chicken mushroom soup celery mixture and egg noodles and simmer. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and margarine until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with creamed mixture.

title: Buffalo Shrimp Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Dip shrimp in sauce.

title: Potato Cheese Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine sour cream soup cheeses and onion into large bowl. Stir until mixed. Break apart any large clumps of hash browns while in package then combine and stir into other ingredients. Spray 9 x 13-inch glass pan with a nonstick oil pan coating. Pour into pan and add diced margarine on top. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Sausage Dressing
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet. Drain and retain grease. Saute onions and celery in 2 Tbsp of grease until tender. Mix bread cubes browned sausage onions celery all spices and orange juice. Stir in the remaining grease. Add chicken broth to moisten (1 to 2 small cans). Place in a baking dish. Pour the remaining butter over the dressing. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-45 minutes.

title: Abby'S Sprinkle Toast
instructions: Place bread on cookie sheet. Spread margarine over bread then add sprinkles or cinnamon sugar. Broil until toasted.

title: Summer Float
instructions: In 10 ounce glass put 3 or 4 scoops of vanilla frozen yogurt. Pour Kerns peach juice to fill glass.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Roll into a ball. Roll in nuts (optional). Refrigerate until ready to use. Makes 1 large cheese ball.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Combine squash and onion in saucepan with small amount of water. Cook until tender. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and pour into greased casserole dish. Top with some crumbled crackers and grated Cheddar cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 35 minutes until top is brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cherry Cola Salad
instructions: Combine water sugar and cherries. Boil gently 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add pineapple (do not drain) nuts and cola. Place into mold and chill. (I think its better the second day.)

title: Twinkie Dessert
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan lay Twinkies side by side (cream side up) in 2 rows. Spread with pineapple. Cover with bananas. Prepare pudding according to package directions. When thickened spread over bananas. Refrigerate. Before serving top with Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Martha'S Lemon Supreme Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed; bake in 3 layers. Cool.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump cherries pineapple and nuts in a 9 x 11-inch pan. In bowl cut oleo with 2 knives into dry cake mix and sprinkle over fruit. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cucumber-Dill Pasta Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large salad bowl. Chill until serving time.

title: Zesty Barbecued Ribs
instructions: In small bowl stir together barbecue sauce horseradish prepared mustard and Worcestershire sauce until well blended. Place spareribs in large saucepan; add water. Cover; bring to boil over high heat and boil gently 30 to 45 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Brush ribs with sauce. Grill brushing with sauce and turning frequently 20 minutes or until browned. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Fettucine Alfredo
instructions: Melt butter and stir in flour. Add cream and cook stirring often for 5 minutes. Boil pasta; drain. Put sauce over pasta; add 3/4 of the ham and cheese. Add black pepper. Toss and add rest of ham and cheese. As a side dish omit ham.

title: Italian Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on package also add bouillon cubes to water while cooking. Saute garlic in small skillet in 1 tablespoon olive oil for about 3 minutes. Cook broccoli in microwave for 4 minutes. Cook corn in microwave for 4 minutes. Drain pasta. Mix all ingredients together. Serve warm or cold.

title: Cabinet Pudding
instructions: Dissolve 2 tablespoons Knox plain gelatine in 3/4 cup cold water; stir until thoroughly dissolved. Add dissolved gelatine to custard. Set custard mixture aside to cool. When custard mixture is cool pour into macaroon mixture. Mix well; cover and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Serve in dessert dishes and top with whipped cream. This dessert was Mothers favorite to serve at parties and special dinners.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Mix well! Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours in greased and floured tube pan.

title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place foil on countertop for cooling cookies. Combine Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat on medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Beat egg into mixture. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Mix into creamed mixture just until blended. Stir in chocolate chips and pecan pieces. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 3-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies longer for crisp cookies.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix chill and serve. Very good on crackers.

title: Frozen Dessert
instructions: Soften cream cheese; beat in mayo and add Cool Whip. Fold in\tremaining ingredients. Spread into 9 x 13-inch cake pan; freeze and serve.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Combine all other ingredients and simmer on low heat.

title: Easy Microwave Chicken
instructions: Prepare chicken breasts and place in microwave dish. Bake on High for about 20 minutes (until chicken is done). Pour out juice. Pour Ragu over chicken. Put sliced cheese over sauce. Put back into microwave and heat sauce and melt cheese 2 to 5 minutes. Serve over noodles or as a main dish. Quick and delicious.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by spoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until biscuits are brown. Brush with melted butter and parsley while hot.

title: Delmarva Crab And Corn Chowder
instructions: *Four cups defatted chicken broth may be used instead of clam juice and water.

title: Buttermilk Loaf Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Blend in vanilla lemon juice and rind. Sift together dry ingredients; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Turn batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove and continue cooling on racks.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients. Add eggs then shortening and flavorings. Roll out dough and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes.

title: Duchess Bean Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon; drain and remove. Slice into fat the onions in rings. When brown add brown sugar vinegar garlic powder and salt. Cook 20 minutes. Drain excess fat. Pour sauce over this mixture butter beans green beans limas and kidney beans. Add baked beans. Stir and break bacon into mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Creme Delight
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese margarine and powdered sugar. Add pudding and slowly beat in milk. Fold in 4 ounces Cool Whip; reserve rest for top. Line a 9-inch pan with wafers. Slice bananas on top of wafers. Top with pudding mixture. Refrigerate. Top with Cool Whip before serving.

title: Beef-A-Roni
instructions: Cook macaroni until done and drain. Brown beef pepper and onion. Drain and add spaghetti sauce. Pour all ingredients into an oblong pan and top with shredded cheese. Bake at 325 degrees until cheese starts to brown.

title: Cool Pink Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill in refrigerator until very firm. May be served as a congealed salad or put in 2 graham cracker crusts and served as a pie.

title: A Holland Potato
instructions: Wash potato. Place onion on top of potato. Wrap bacon around potato and onion. Wrap all three in aluminum foil. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Rotate once while baking.

title: Saucy Barbecue Franks
instructions: Brown hot dogs with onions and bell peppers. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 20 to 30 minutes stirring often.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa margarine and whole milk in saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute at rolling boil. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and oats and stir well. Drop by the teaspoon on wax paper or foil; let cool.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Will need a 9 x 13-inch glass dish.

title: Holiday Fruit Salad
instructions: In large bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Slice bananas into gelatin mixture. Add frozen strawberries and undrained pineapple. Pour half the mixture into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate 1 hour. In mixer bowl beat cream with sour cream and sugar; spread over chilled layer. Gently spoon remaining gelatin mixture on top. Refrigerate until firm about 2 hours. Cut into squares; serve on lettuce-lined salad plates. Garnish with additional pineapple.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar in mixing bowl until fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating after each addition. Sift flour and measure. Add salt and cocoa to flour and sift again. Add flour\tmixture alternately with fruit juice to creamed mixture and mix well. Do not overmix. Add flavor and mix well. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake in preheated oven at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours or until cake tests done.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Cook and mash sweet potatoes. Blend with remaining ingredients. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell or into 2 small pie shells. This is to be topped with applesauce topping. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake an additional 25 to 30 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown onions and garlic in oil; add mushrooms. Sprinkle meat with 4 tablespoons flour and brown. Add soup water and seasonings. Put in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove. Add sour cream. Serve on rice or noodles.

title: Quick Hearty Nacho Dip
instructions: Cook first 3 ingredients in large skillet until meat is brown; drain. Add beans picante sauce and taco seasoning mix. Stir well. Cook over medium heat until blended. Spoon into 12 x 8 x 2 dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes until cheese melts. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Three Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown bacon hamburger diced onion. Drain off excess fat. Pour hamburg bacon and onion in large casserole dish. Combine beans soup brown sugar. Mix with hamburg mixture. Bake uncovered 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Marvelous Cookies(3 Dozen)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet with margarine. Cream margarine oil and brown sugar. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Add whole wheat flour salt baking powder wheat germ rolled oats raisins and nuts and mix well. Add water if too dry. Drop batter by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain fat. Pour in a large saucepan and add remaining ingredients. Cook on low for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Supreme Salad
instructions: First chop the lettuce two or three times. Put in a large bowl. Next add the sliced tomatoes. Then add the carrots cheese and the Bac*Os. Finally select a salad dressing and spread the dressing. Then serve.

title: Southern Chess Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Beat in thoroughly eggs milk vanilla and butter. Fold in pecans or walnuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until set.

title: Great Guacamole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Process until smooth. Chill. Serve with corn chips.

title: Colorful Candy Popcorn Balls
instructions: Pour popcorn into a huge bowl. Add peanuts and M&Ms. Mix together. Put in margarine and marshmallows in a large microwaveable bowl. Microwave on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until marshmallows are puffed (or you can use a saucepan and cook until marshmallows are puffed). Mix margarine and marshmallow together. Add gelatin to marshmallow mixture. Stir until well mixed. Pour over popcorn mixture. Slightly grease hands well. Shape mixture into balls and place on waxed paper until completely cool.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine and cook until it forms firm ball in cold water then add 2 cups raw peanuts. Cook until light brown or honey colored. Add vanilla small chunk butter then add soda and stir quickly until thoroughly dissolved. Pour onto Reynolds Wrap while still foaming. Be sure not to overstir after adding soda. Let cool thoroughly and break into pieces.

title: Vanilla Rice Pudding
instructions: Gradually stir milk and egg into pudding mix in a saucepan. Add rice and raisins. Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil. Cool 5 minutes stirring twice.

title: *Twists Cookies 1(Koulourakia)
instructions: Cream the butter for 15 minutes. Add sugar gradually and beat an additional 15 minutes. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Add baking powder then add flour gradually until it doesnt stick to your hands. Form dough into balls the size of a walnut. Roll dough with the palms of your hands to an 8-inch length. Fold in half and give it a couple of twists. Put on cookie sheet lined with tinfoil. Brush with beaten egg (sesame seed optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Punch Bowl Dessert
instructions: Bake cake and cool. Crumble 1/2 of cake in punch bowl. Mix pudding with milk. Pour 1/2 of pudding over 1/2 of cake. add 1/2 of cool whip. Repeat layers and top with 2 large butterfinger candy bars that have been crushed.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour salt baking powder soda nutmeg cinnamon and ginger together three times. Beat eggs until thick adding sugar gradually as you beat. Whip in the pumpkin then melted butter. Beat in the dry ingredients and mix well. Fold in the nuts. Pour into 2 buttered and floured pans. Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Wild Rice And Sausage(Yields 12 Servings)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large skillet; cook over medium heat until sausage is browned and vegetables are tender stirring to crumble meat. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except almonds; mix well. Spoon into a lightly greased 3-quart casserole and sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Mix sugar margarine eggs and pineapple thoroughly. Line an 8 x 8-inch baking dish with vanilla wafers. Spread half the pineapple mixture over the vanilla wafers. Add another layer of vanilla wafers. Top with remaining pineapple mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Granny Carnala'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Bring milk to a boil. Mix all dry ingredients. Cook in double boiler until thickens. Pour into pie shell. Beat egg whites for meringue.

title: Chili Con Queso
instructions: In a bowl toss cheese lightly with cornstarch and garlic powder.

title: Mexican Fiesta
instructions: Prepare macaroni as directed. Brown beef. Add onions and peppers to beef and cook until onion and pepper are tender. Stir in tomato sauce chili powder and salt. Toss with cooked pasta. Spoon into 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken Breast
instructions: Skin and wash chicken. Salt and pepper. Melt 1 stick margarine in roaster. Crumble crackers in butter. Roll chicken in buttered crumbs. Place in roaster. Make sure all chicken is covered. Bake in covered dish for 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Salmon Spread
instructions: Drain salmon and save juice; mix with ingredients and add enough juice to spread.

title: White Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Melt grated white chocolate in 1/3 cup of the crisco oil on low heat and set aside. Put remainder of oil eggs and cake mix in large bowl. Mix on low speed until well blended. Add melted chocolate and mix 1 minute. Mix water and pudding together and add to batter. Mix 2 minutes on medium speed. Add vanilla. Fold in chopped pecans and coconut mix well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt or tube pan and bake at 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 40 - 50 minutes or until done. Cool 15 minutes in pan before turning out.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Tear up bread into small pieces and place in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon cooked sausage over bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Beat remaining ingredients and pour over mixture. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. The cheese will rise to the top during baking.

title: Fried Cabbage
instructions: Chop up into small pieces about 5 slices of bacon and one yellow onion. Season with salt and pepper and fry over medium heat until bacon starts to just crisp and onion get soft. Add 1/2 head of coarsely chopped cabbage. Drizzle about 3 tablespoons of olive oil over the cabbage. Season again with salt and pepper to taste. Continue stir frying over medium heat until cabbage is soft. About 15 minutes. You can also add some chopped apples to this to give it a sweet taste.

title: Corn Pone Pie
instructions: Cornbread tops this beef and bean casserole.

title: Impossible Turkey And Stuffing Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate (9 x 1 1/4 inches). Mix turkey peas onions and cranberries in pie plate. Separate stuffing into small pieces on turkey mixture. Stir remaining ingredients with fork until blended. Pour into pie plate. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve with hot turkey gravy if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Isaac'S Homemade Powdered Donut Holes
instructions: Cut each canned biscuit into four pieces and deep fry. Put powdered sugar in a paper bag. Put cooked pieces into bag of sugar and shake. Voila! Donut holes!

title: Malacados
instructions: Sift flour. Make well; add butter sugar salt eggs and milk with yeast in it. Mix well. Cover with towel and put in warm place to rise (about 2 1/2 hours). After it rises pull in the sides and let rise again. Fry in deep fat.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Soften crackers in 2 cups milk and hold aside. Add eggs one at a time to creamed mix and beat well. Then add vanilla coconut pecans and baking powder and mix well. Pour in greased baking pan. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Bake for 1 hour using tube or layer cake pans. Ice cake with mixture of 1 pound confectioners sugar 1/2 pound butter and small drained can of crushed pineapple.

title: Chewy Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl of electric mixer combine granulated and brown sugars peanut butter shortening eggs and vanilla. Beat at high speed until light and creamy. Sift flour baking powder and salt together and add to egg mixture. Stir to mix well. Stir in coconut. Spread dough (it will be quite stiff) evenly in greased cake pan. Bake about 25 minutes or until a rich golden brown. Test with cake tester as you test any cake. Cool in pan. Cut into 2 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Barbecue
instructions: Cook all together on top of stove until pork is done. Cool. Grind in meat grinder.

title: Apricot Kielbasa
instructions: One day before party slice kielbasa into bite-size pieces. Mix apricot preserves and nectar to make a pourable sauce. Pour sauce over pieces and refrigerate 24 hours. Prior to party microwave or bake to heat kielbasa. Arrange pieces on serving platter with toothpicks. Provide hot mustard for dipping. Serve warm.

title: Jelly Pie
instructions: Put it in a bowl and mix them. Freeze it for 50 minutes.

title: Spicy Apple Pancakes With Cider Sauce
instructions: Beat baking mix cinnamon egg and milk with rotary beater until smooth. Stir in apple. Grease griddle if necessary. Pour batter by 1/4-cup measuring cupfuls onto hot griddle. Bake until bubbles appear. Turn; bake other side until golden brown. Serve with warm Cider Sauce. If you wish top with dairy sour cream. Makes 18 (4-inch) pancakes.

title: Apricot Nut Bread
instructions: Cream 1 cup sugar shortening and egg. Stir in 1/4 cup sugar and orange juice. Add dry ingredients. Stir apricots and nuts into batter. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 for glass pan or at 350\u00b0 for metal pan.

title: Pineapple Marshmallow Torte
instructions: Melt marshmallows in saucepan with milk; cool thoroughly stirring occasionally so it wont set. When cooled add the whipped cream and the drained pineapple. Let stand in refrigerator for at least 6 hours.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over margarine. Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Chill if desired. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Italian Deli Salad
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and chill well.

title: Scallops
instructions: Stir together the cheese mayonnaise and wine; reserve. In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat melt 2 tablespoons butter; add the scallops and cook stirring just until they are opaque a minute or so. With a slotted spoon remove scallops to paper toweling to drain. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons butter to the skillet with the onion; cook gently until slightly golden and add mushrooms. Cook rapidly stirring so they do not release their liquid a few minutes. Turn off heat and stir in the reserved cheese mixture and scallops. Bake in casserole until warmed through. Serve over noodles.

title: Green Beans
instructions: Cook on top of stove for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Irish Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large greased casserole. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cook covered until the last 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Moussaka(A Greek Specialty)
instructions: Brush both sides of eggplant slices with the oil; sprinkle with salt. In large skillet brown eggplant slices about 1 1/2 minutes on each side. Drain and set aside. In same skillet cook lamb or beef onion and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender; drain off excess fat. Stir in tomato sauce wine parsley oregano the 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 teaspoon salt. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Gradually stir mixture into the 1 beaten egg.

title: Potato And Ham Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes carrots and celery until crisp-tender. Drain and set aside. Cook ham green pepper and onion in 2 tablespoons margarine in skillet until golden. Place ham mixture and cooked vegetables in deep greased 2-quart casserole. Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in saucepan over low heat. Add flour and thyme. Stir until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add milk cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Stir in cheese salt and pepper; melt cheese. Pour sauce over mixture. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Chicken Oriental
instructions: In 1/2-cup metal measure or other small flameproof container combine soy sauce with 2 tablespoons honey oil ginger and garlic. Cook stirring frequently until mixture is warm about 1 minute. Transfer to self-sealing plastic bag or medium bowl (not aluminum). Add chicken and turn to coat with marinade. Seal bag or cover bowl and let stand 10 minutes to marinate.

title: Sauerbraten
instructions: Boil water and vinegar with onions celery carrot and spices. Allow to cool and pour over meat in pan. Cover and set aside in cool place for 2 to 3 days. Turn meat occasionally. Remove from marinade; dry and rub with salt and pepper. Soak raisins in cold water. Heat fat in pan and sear meat on all sides. Strain marinade and saute vegetables in same pan with meat. Stir in tomato paste and add half of heated marinade. Allow to simmer covered for about 2 hours at medium heat. Remove meat and keep warm. Add remaining marinade to broth and stir. Strain and quickly boil again with raisins and almonds thicken with cornstarch. Slice and serve with gravy.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Combine fruits nuts and 1/2 cup flour to coat. Set aside. Cream butter. Add sugars and beat well. Add eggs and beat. Add soda and dry ingredients along with the milk. Stir in fruits and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes or 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. You can garnish the top of the cookie with fruit and nuts.

title: Hanky Pankies
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage. Add red pepper flakes oregano and Velveeta. Simmer on low until cheese melts. Place a small amount on each piece of bread. Place on a cookie sheet and broil until cheese bubbles. Eat right away.

title: Lemon-Grape Shimmer
instructions: In a 2-quart non-metal pitcher mix together all ingredients. Serve over ice in tall glasses. Makes 7 (1-cup) servings.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening then add sugar gradually. Beat until its fluffy. Add the beaten egg and the molasses. Add sifted dry ingredients. Gradually add milk then add the raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Shrimp Rolls
instructions: Prepare marinade by combining sugar soy sauce Worcestershire sauce white wine and calamansi or lemon juice. Shell shrimp leaving tails. Wrap shrimp with 2 to 3 strips each of carrot and spring onion in lumpia wrapper. Roll. Seal with cornstarch paste. Deep-fat fry. Serve hot.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Stir cucumbers onions peppers and salt together and mix with plenty of crushed ice. Place in vessel with weight on top and let stand 3 hours.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix carrots sugar oil and beaten eggs together. Gradually add remaining flour ingredients. Mix well. Grease 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Poor Man'S Cake
instructions: Cook raisins with water for 15 minutes. Add sugar shortening and cold water. Stir until sugar and shortening are dissolved. Cool. Then add salt cinnamon nutmeg baking soda and flour. Mix well by hand. Pour into a greased cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done when pressed.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Fry 1 slice bacon or more until crispy. Pour off grease and mix with vinegar sugar and egg.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Place pineapple in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix flour and sugar; sprinkle over pineapple. Top with cheese then crushed crackers. Dot with oleo. Bake at 325\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Saute onion in small amount of margarine. Add broth rotel and soups. Mix well.

title: Eight Layer Jello Salad
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch glass dish if possible as this is a pretty salad. Add 1 1/2 cups of boiling water to first package of Jell-O (black cherry or blackberry). Pour into dish to set.

title: Quick Egg Custard
instructions: Grease pan with margarine; sprinkle with flour. Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add flour vanilla and milk; mix well. Pour into pan and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Best Of All Fruit Salad
instructions: Peel and dice apples. Add juice of lemon to apples to keep from discoloring. Boil pineapple\tjuice (reserved from can of pineapple). Beat eggs lightly. Mix sugar and flour. Add to eggs. Pour boiling juice into this stirring constantly then place on stove to\tcook. Cook until thickened. Add butter. Remove from stove and cool. When cooled add to fruit mixture.

title: Brown Sugar Pumpkin Pie(Makes 8 Servings)
instructions: In medium bowl cut margarine into flour until mixture is crumbly; stir in enough water until mixture forms a ball. Set aside 1/4 of the dough; roll remaining dough into an 11-inch circle about 1/8-inch thick. Place in 9-inch pie plate; trim edge even with pie plate. Roll out reserved dough and cut into 1-inch leaves; make vein marks in each leaf with back of knife. Attach leaves to edge of crust using 1 tablespoon egg product. Chill crust until ready to fill.

title: Hot Bean Salad
instructions: Saute sausage onion and celery. Drain off grease. Add pork and beans and chili beans. Add drained green beans yellow beans kidney beans and lima beans. Mix mustard brown sugar and tomato soup. Add to bean mixture and mix well. Put in a large casserole or roaster. Spread the tomato sauce on top of the bean mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 1 hour.

title: Turkey Barbecue
instructions: Brown turkey in oil. Combine rest of ingredients in sauce pan. Simmer 10 minutes. Pour over browned turkey and simmer 20 minutes more.

title: Mary Dell'S Fresh Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Mix lightly with washed drained blueberries. Pour into pie shell. Place dots of butter all over fruit. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Place top crust over pie and slit. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serve with thick cream whipped or plain.

title: Zesty Mozzarella Chicken
instructions: Combine egg and milk. In another bowl combine bread crumbs Parmesan cheese and seasonings. Dip each chicken breast in egg mixture and then in crumb mixture. Melt butter in skillet; brown chicken on both sides until juices run clear. Meanwhile heat tomato sauce and basil until warm. Sprinkle chicken with Mozzarella and serve with sauce. Serves 4 to 8.

title: Joe'S Oatmeal Pecan Cookies
instructions: Combine white and brown sugars with Crisco and beat well. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour salt soda and vanilla. Mix well. Add oatmeal and pecans and mix well. (I mix all this with a pastry mixer or by hand.) Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 11 or 12 minutes. Makes about 60 cookies.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
instructions: Cream butter; add sour cream. Gradually add biscuit mix stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon into lightly greased (or sprayed) mini-muffin pans filling 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield 3 dozen.

title: Morning Glory Bread
instructions: Grease a 9-inch loaf pan. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl cream sugars and margarine until smooth and light. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla. In separate bowl combine flour bran baking powder cinnamon and salt. Add carrots apples raisins nuts and coconut and toss to combine thoroughly. Stir into creamed mixture blending well. Spoon into loaf pan and bake for 1 hour or until bread tests done.

title: Fly Repellent Spray
instructions: Mix everything together. Can be doubled or tripled.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and drain. Grate onions and eggs. Mix eggs onions and cream of mushroom soup. Mix with squash and set aside. Crumble crackers melt butter and mix. Put one layer of squash mix and one layer of crackers then bake 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Quick And Easy Pasta
instructions: Prepare Velveeta and shells according to directions on box. Brown hamburger; drain. Pour Velveeta and shells in bottom of casserole dish; add crumbled hamburger. Next pour spaghetti sauce to cover. Add pepperoni slices and top with cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Candied Nuts
instructions: Melt butter in jelly-roll pan. Add nuts and beaten mixture of egg whites and sugar. Put into 325\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes.

title: Marzetti
instructions: Cook elbow macaroni. Drain rinse and return to pot. Using frying pan saute garlic in oil. Add ground beef; brown meat. Drain any fat. Add meat along with sauce and Cheez Whiz to cooked macaroni. Heat until cheese is melted into the sauce. Serve with grated cheese on top.

title: A Recipe For A Happy Marriage
instructions: Start with love a generous share then blend in warmth and laughter. Add lots of happy memories that will last forever after... Dont forget the patience for the days when things go wrong. Add a sense of humor and a faith thats deep and strong. Garnish with some compliments lovingly expressed and there you have the recipe for marriage at its best!

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Mix mayo soup eggs cheese and onion. Mix well. Place broccoli in casserole dish. Pour mixture over broccoli and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 min.

title: Oat Bran Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in muffin pan for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. (Moist and fruity!)

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Beat first 3 ingredients together. Sift flour and spices together; add to egg mixture. Add last 4 ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Lemony Wine Cooler
instructions: In pitcher combine wine sugar and lemon juice; stir until sugar dissolves. Chill. Just before serving arrange fruit and ice in glasses. Add club soda to chilled mixture and pour over fruit and ice. Makes about 7 cups.

title: Banana Nut Bread I
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine sugar oil egg and mashed banana. In a separate bowl mix together the flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to the banana mixture a small amount at a time. Add chopped nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with butter softened cream cheese or peanut butter.

title: Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Add onion and green onion to margarine cook until soft. Stir in pumpkin chicken stock bay leaf sugar curry powder nutmeg and parsley. Cook 15 minutes uncovered. Puree in blender. Add milk and salt gradually mix and simmer 10 minutes. Garnish with chopped green peppers or a drop of sour cream or paprika.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13 inch dish. Pour chopped chicken in dish. Mix soup and sour cream together and spread over chicken. Melt margarine and mix with crushed cracker crumbs. Sprinkle with poppy seeds. Bake 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli. Cook rice. Add cheese to hot rice. Add broccoli and soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or microwave on High until set.

title: Lasagna Pizza
instructions: Mix noodles beef pizza sauce and mushrooms; put in deep dish pizza pan or casserole dish. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Simple Lasagna
instructions: Boil noodles as directed. Brown hamburger. Season with salt and pepper. Drain off grease.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid Cool Whip and milk in a bowl. Spread in pie crust. Store in freezer.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a casserole dish. Layer chicken. Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken. Crumble crackers over top. Drizzle melted margarine over crackers. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grasshopper Pie
instructions: Make Oreos into crumbs by putting into blender. (Put cookies in 3 or 4 at a time because its easier to blend.) Press into pie pans. Soften ice cream. Add creme de menthe. Mix well. Add green food coloring if desired. Pour into crusts. Freeze overnight. Makes 2 (8-inch) pies. You can garnish top by adding some of the Oreo crumbs.

title: Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Use as a spread on crackers or Pepperidge Farm mini bread slices.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and transfer to a 3-quart oblong baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Baked Eggs
instructions: Beat eggs mustard and milk fold in ham bread salt and cheese. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Cover with foil bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate-Walnut Puffs
instructions: Melt chocolate chips over hot water. Beat egg whites until frothy; add dash of salt. Gradually add sugar to beaten eggs. Add vinegar and vanilla. Fold in melted chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove at once to racks to cool.

title: Milk Cupcakes(Portuguese)
instructions: Mix the sugar with the eggs then add the flour melted butter lemon and the milk. Sprinkle the mold with butter and sugar. (You can cut on the sugar and butter.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Preparation time 15 minutes.

title: Gingered Beef And Pineapple Stir-Fry
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut steak lengthwise with grain into 1/4-inch slices; cut slices in half crosswise. Combine steak and next 5 ingredients in a large zip-top heavy-duty plastic bag. Seal bag and marinate in refrigerator 2 hours turning bag occasionally. Remove steak from bag; discard marinade.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: You will need a 12 x 9 x 2-inch Pyrex pan.

title: Walnut Cranberry Relish
instructions: Drop walnuts into rapidly boiling water; boil 3 minutes. Drain well. Spread on flat baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes until crisp and very lightly browned. Cool and chop.

title: Three Apples Of The Land
instructions: Butter a 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Rub the pan with garlic clove; discard clove. Layer the potatoes apples cheese and horseradish in that order seasoning with salt and pepper. Repeat finishing last layer with grated cheese.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve jellos in the boiling water. Add 7-Up and chill until it molds off the spoon then add bananas pineapple and marshmallows. Let set in a large flat Pyrex dish (7 x 10-inch).

title: Lucille'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix cut up fruit with Cool Whip. For decoration top with cherries that have been drained and dried also nuts if desired.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream sugar butter or margarine and eggs. Add flour one cup at a time mix well. Add vanilla and mix; add 7-Up last. Beat for 20 minutes; pour into tube cake pan. Do not grease or flour the pan. Bake for 45 minutes for 1 hour or until knife inserted comes out clean. When cake is done loosen with knife around edges. Cool in pan on wire rack for 1/2 hour. Loosen again put cake on serving dish and sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: In large Dutch oven or kettle brown beef and onion. Drain any fat. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Yields 10 servings.

title: Company Corn
instructions: Mix all together in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat together crushed vanilla wafers chopped pecans and 3/4 cup softened butter and press evenly onto bottom of 3 greased round cake pans. Combine thoroughly pumpkin spice cake mix eggs and 1/4 cup softened butter. Spread batter evenly over the 3 cake pans lined with crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool. Mix powdered sugar 2/3 cup softened butter cream cheese and vanilla. This is the filling. On serving plate layer the 3 cakes (nut and crumb mixture side down) with 1/2 cup filling spread between each layer. Frost sides and layer; spread 1/4 cup caramel topping on top. Arrange pecan halves on cake and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl; mix at lowest speed until dough forms balls. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll balls in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss. Press down firmly so cookie cracks around edges. Let cool.

title: Shortbread Cookie
instructions: Place butter and sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer. Mix on low speed for 15 seconds. Add flour and salt. Continue mixing on low speed for 3 to 5 minutes until dough comes together. It will look dry just before it comes together. Place the dough on a lightly floured board. Roll 1/4-inch thick. Cut out dough until a 3-inch star cutter or other shape cookie shape.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix in order given and spread in pan 9 x 9-inch. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 20 servings.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer ingredients in order given in an 8 x 8-inch dish. Can prepare 2 to 3 hours in advance. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Country Supper Soup
instructions: Cut bacon in small pieces. Place all main ingredients (first 11 ingredients) together in a large soup kettle and simmer for 1/2 hour. Add remaining ingredients and continue simmering for another 1/2 hour. Serve with garlic bread.

title: Bread Pudding For A Crowd
instructions: Butter bread and place buttered side down in a greased cake pan (9 x 13-inch 6 slices per layer). Combine milk sugar salt and eggs. Pour over bread. With large spoon press bread down just enough to make sure all the bread gets the milk mixture over them. Let set 1/2 hour. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered then 1/2 hour uncovered. If raisins are desired sprinkle some between layers.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Place broccoli and margarine in bowl in microwave for 1 minute. Beat eggs; stir in cottage cheese. Stir in broccoli and margarine; mix well. Add corn muffin mix; mix well. Pour into a 9 x 12-inch greased pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Mix in crushed vanilla wafers and milk. Add pecans. Bake in a Bundt or angel food cake pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Wiener Daffle
instructions: Cut wieners; set aside. Mix remaining ingredients in pot and cook until mixture is hot and well mixed. Add wieners and cook until they are done about 10 minutes; enjoy.

title: Family Salisbury Steaks
instructions: Mix together all ingredients like any meat loaf. (Substitute ingredients as you wish but try and keep it on the spicy side). Shape into burger patties and brown well on both sides in large skillet. Drain excess fat. Cover patties with Heinz brown canned gravy. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Best Garlic Bread
instructions: Blend butter or margarine with garlic and honey. Slice bread in half lengthwise. Spread butter mixture thickly on both cut sides of bread. Sprinkle lightly with basil then paprika. Put loaf back together and coat lightly with olive oil. Wrap in foil and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Slice in large hunks and serve hot.

title: Easy Turkey And Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Prepare Stove Top stuffing according to package directions. Stir in 1/2 can French fried onions. Spray casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spoon stuffing mixture into dish and press it across bottom and up sides to form a shell. Combine soup milk turkey and peas. Pour into stuffing shell. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Shepherds Pie
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add the onion red pepper and garlic. Saute until softened. Add the meat and saute until browned. If desired transfer the cooked mixture to a food processor and chop for a few seconds on the pulse setting. Transfer the meat to a saucepan and add the stock parsley tomato paste Worcestershire sauce. Add mushrooms. Cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes.

title: Gems
instructions: Add sugar and melted shortening to beaten egg. Then add flour salt and baking powder alternately with milk. Drop by tablespoons on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until lightly browned. We have these for breakfast with butter oleo or jelly. I am told they are similar to English scones. They are a favorite of our family.

title: Candy
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave. Mix marshmallows Rice Krispies and peanut butter together. Stir in chocolate mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let cool then cut into pieces.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix 3 minutes on medium speed. Bake at 350\u00b0 in Bundt pan for 35 to 45 minutes or until slightly brown.

title: Mound Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and bake as directed on box. Then bring to a boil the milk sugar and marshmallow cream and boil for 1 minute. Take off heat and add coconut. Pour this mixture over warm cake. Mix chocolate pieces and oleo and melt over low heat. Pour this mixture over coconut that is on cake. Refrigerate 3 hours until chocolate is set.

title: Cherry Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter; add sugar. Add milk vanilla nuts cherries and coconut. Blend in flour by hand. Divide dough into 2 rolls (roll in reserved coconut). Slice and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Date Nut Rolls
instructions: Cook sugar dates eggs and oleo in skillet slowly for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat to let cool until you can handle. Add Rice Krispies nuts and vanilla. (You can handle this mixture best if you grease your fingers with vegetable oil.) Roll in a small ball and roll in Snow Flake coconut.

title: Tostado
instructions: Position oven rack in upper third of oven and preheat to very hot (450\u00b0). Crumble beef into large heavy skillet and place over moderately high heat. Add onion and garlic; cook 5 to 8 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Drain off fat. Add cumin oregano salt pepper and flour. Stir over medium heat for 1 minute. Add tomatoes and chilies; cook for 3 minutes or until thickened.

title: Peanut Patty
instructions: Bring sugar water and corn syrup to a boil. Add peanuts and food coloring. Cook to hard-boil stage. Remove from heat. Add margarine and a pinch of salt. Beat until thick. Pour into greased muffin tins or onto greased cookie sheet. Let set.

title: Chicken Paprika
instructions: Slice chicken breast thin; pound it to loosen it. Roll in flour with pepper and paprika. Saute in garlic and margarine (brown it) until cooked; then sprinkle coarse pepper on top. Serve with rice and green beans or mixed vegetables.

title: Granny'S Sugar Cookies(This Is A Good Rolled Cookie For Cookie Cutter.)
instructions: Cream the butter sugar and egg. Sift together and add the salt baking powder and flour. Blend in the vanilla. Roll out; cut in desired shapes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Thaw frozen broccoli according to directions on package. Mix soup and milk together. Add all ingredients to thawed broccoli. Lightly mix and pour into a 2 1/2 or 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Mixture bubbles up as it is baking. Make sure dish is large enough.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix all together with blender. Add 2 tablespoons or more (to taste) to one cup of boiling water.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Gradually add sugar beat until thickened. Add whipping cream vanilla and salt and mix thoroughly. Pour into can add milk to fill line on can and stir well. Freeze as directed. Makes 4 quarts.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburg with onion. Layer casserole dish with cabbage hamburg-onion and cabbage. Top with tomato soup. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Drain the liquid from the oysters and mix it with half and half; season with salt and pepper and a few drops of Tabasco. Butter an 8 x 12-inch Pyrex dish. Crumb 1/2-inch crackers in bottom of dish. Put in a layer of oysters. Pour 1/2 liquid over this and dot with butter. Put in 1/4-inch layer of crackers a layer of oysters and remaining liquid. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with finely crushed crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Mix baking soda with buttermilk and add with the rest of the ingredients to creamed butter and sugar. Pour into greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Cottage Pudding With Lemon Sauce
instructions: Sift dry ingredients 3 times. Beat together the butter sugar egg and lemon extract. Add flour and milk alternately; beat each time. Pour into buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Golden Corn Pudding
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pour into greased 1-quart casserole. Place casserole in baking pan. Pour very hot water into pan to a depth of about 1-inch. Bake until knife inserted 1-inch from edge of casserole comes out clean 50 to 60 minutes. Center will be soft but will set. Makes 6 servings.

title: Summer Squash Mess
instructions: Peel and sliced squash. Parboil for 15 minutes. Drain. Slice onion and mushrooms. Saute in butter until limp. Add the tomatoes and cheese. Add all to squash and cover with buttered crumbs in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Base(Microwave)
instructions: In 3-quart casserole dish combine chicken celery garlic and ginger. Cover with lid; microwave on High 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink stirring once during cooking. Stir in broth and water. Cover; microwave on High 5 minutes or until hot and bubbling.

title: Toll House Pan Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small bowl combine flour baking soda and salt. Set aside. In a large bowl combine oleo sugar brown sugar and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture; mix well. Stir in bits and nuts. Spread into a greased 15 x 10-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool; cut into squares.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix well and fry in deep fryer. Serves 4.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes; drain and cool. Mix mayonnaise cheese soup and beaten eggs. Add broccoli to cheese mixture and place in buttered baking dish. Top with crackers and dot with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Texas Tornado Cake
instructions: Sift together sugar flour soda and salt. Beat in eggs and fruit cocktail. Pour in lightly greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix brown sugar and walnuts together. Sprinkle over cake batter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Ice cake while hot.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Layer in 13 x 9-inch glass dish in order given. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with Tostitos Doritos dip style.

title: Cereal Cheese Stars
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix thoroughly. Roll on lightly floured board and cut with small cookie cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Mama'S Beef Roast
instructions: Place frozen roast on bottom of roasting pan or extra large pot (larger than Dutch oven). Then add vegetables all around roast and on top. Salt and pepper to taste. Then cover with lid or extra heavy duty foil and cook in oven at 500\u00b0 about 20 minutes. Then reduce heat to 250\u00b0 and cook all night. If oven cooks fast you may want to reduce heat to 200\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Chutney
instructions: Simmer cranberries sugar raisins spice and water in 2-quart saucepan (uncovered) over medium heat stirring frequently until juice is released from cranberries about 15 minutes. Reduce heat; stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered until thick about 15 minutes. Refrigerate covered up to 2 weeks.

title: No Bake Ice Cream(Coffee Can Method)
instructions: You will need one 3-pound coffee can one 1-pound coffee can ice and rock salt.

title: Gingerbread Cookies
instructions: Combine flour ginger soda salt and cinammon set aside. Cream butter or margarine and brown sugar 2 to 3 minutes. Beat in molasses. Stir in flour mixture just until blended. Chill dough until firm (1 to 2 hours). Preheat oven 375\u00b0. Divide dough into fourths. Working one fourth at a time roll on floured pastry cloth to 1/8 inch thick. Cut with desired shaped cookie cutters. Gently transfer cutouts to ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 7 to 8 minutes or until edges are light brown. Cool slightly before removing. Decorate as desired.

title: Spinach Madeline
instructions: Cook spinach as directed on package. Drain and reserve liquor. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Add flour stirring until blended and smooth but not brown. Add onion and cook until soft. Add vegetable liquor and milk slowly stirring to avoid lumps. Add seasonings and cheese cut in small pieces. Stir until melted. Combine with cooked spinach. Put in casserole dish (flavor is improved if refrigerated overnight). Heat in a 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly. Sprinkle fried onions over casserole and bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Icebox Rolls
instructions: Mix hot water 1/2 c. sugar and shortening; let cool. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water and 1 teaspoon sugar. Add to cool mixture well beaten eggs and unsifted flour; mix well. Put in greased bowl and let rise overnight. Work down. Cut out biscuits and let rise again. Bake. Put butter on half of biscuit. Fold over and pinch edges together. Bake at 400\u00b0 until finished.

title: Hearty Ham Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce leaves; mix well. Chill 2 or 3 hours before serving. Serve on lettuce if desired. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Orange-Pecan Bread
instructions: Combine egg orange raisins rind shortening and vanilla. Sift flour baking powder soda salt and sugar into orange mixture; mix well. Stir in pecans. Pour into a well-greased 5 x 9 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or longer (check with a toothpick at 1 hour).

title: Irish Lettuce Salad
instructions: Mix together. Pour on dressing just before serving.

title: Mexican Chef'S Salad
instructions: Chop onion tomatoes and lettuce; toss with cheese dressing hot sauce or taco sauce and taco seasoning salt. Crunch and add Doritos. Slice and add avocado. Brown ground beef; add salt and pepper to taste. Add kidney beans and cook 10 minutes. Mix all together and serve hot or cold.

title: Speedy Pizzas
instructions: Split the English muffins with a fork. Toast the muffin halves. Spread muffins with tomato sauce. Sprinkle each with a pinch of oregano. Cover with cheese. Broil until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs milk and pineapple (with juice). Toss bread cubes in to moisten. Put into buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Bake roast beef; shred into pieces. Using the broth from the roast dump into it the carrots celery meat onions and potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. When vegetables are tender add the gravy mixes. You may need to add water to broth if there is not enough to cover vegetables. Let simmer until desired thickness.

title: Marvelous Kugel
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions. Put remaining ingredients in blender. Blend until well mixed. Mix with noodles. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic; saute 1 minute stirring with a wire whisk until blended. Cook 8 minutes or until thickened and bubbly stirring constantly. Stir in cream cheese; cook 2 minutes. Add 1 cup Parmesan cheese stirring constantly until it melts. Mix vegetables and fettuccine. Pour cheese sauce over mixture; toss well to coat. Top with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese fresh parsley and pepper. Makes 4 servings each with 10 grams fat.

title: Cornbread Cakes
instructions: Mix ingredients and fry as you would pancakes. Turn only once when brown on one side. Then flip to the other side. Will make about 8 cakes.

title: Pineapple Party Salad
instructions: Drain syrup from pineapple. Add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups. Heat to boiling point. Dissolve lemon and lime gelatin in boiling liquid. Add salt. Cool until slightly thickened. When beginning to congeal fold in cottage cheese mayonnaise crushed pineapple and nuts. Pour into mold or 9-inch square pan. Place in refrigerator to chill and set. Serve on lettuce leaf topped with a touch of mayonnaise. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Congo Bars
instructions: Melt butter and remove from heat. Add sugar and stir well. Add eggs and stir well. Add all dry ingredients plus milk and vanilla. Stir thoroughly and add chips. Blend well. Spread mixture in oblong pan (9 x 13-inch) well greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cut while warm.

title: Wedding Bell Punch
instructions: Ice cream and sherbet need to be soft. (See tips on making punch.) Blend cold lemonade and orange juice with soft vanilla ice cream and pineapple sherbet.

title: Chicken Breasts With Sour Cream(Serves 4 To 6)
instructions: Coat chicken with next 7 ingredients mixed together. Place in buttered dish and marinate overnight in refrigerator. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and place a pat of butter on each chicken breast. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. (Boneless chicken breasts may be used but reduce baking time approximately 15 minutes to prevent drying and overbaking.) Garnish with lemon slice and sprig of parsley for a company meal of which you can be proud.

title: Blueberry Special
instructions: Melt margarine and mix with graham cracker crumbs chopped pecans and powdered sugar. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese eggs granulated sugar and lemon juice. Pour into shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Spread with 1 can of blueberry pie filling. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Hassan'S Steak Marinade
instructions: Combine these\tingredients in pan or bowl large enough to hold steak. Place steak in marinade and refrigerate 24 to 48 hours turning occasionally. Makes porterhouse T-bone etc. \mouthwatering good\ when cooked over coals.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Saute leeks onions and garlic in oil and butter. Add remaining ingredients and 6 cups of water. Simmer for 2 hours covered. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo oil powdered sugar and white sugar together. Add vanilla and eggs. Sift flour salt soda and cream of tartar together and add to first mixture. Mix well to form dough. Roll dough by teaspoon to form a ball. Roll in sugar (sometimes I add cinnamon to sugar). Place on greased cookie sheet. Press down with a small glass. Bake about 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Blueberry Nut Torte
instructions: To make the crust mix together flour 1/2 c. walnuts graham cracker crumbs and butter. Press into an 8 inch square pan or quiche dish. Bake 5 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. To make the filling cream together cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add whipped topping and mix with cream mixture until frothy. Turn into cooled crust and refrigerate for 20 minutes or until cream cheese mixture is firm. Sprinkle with walnuts. Top with can of blueberry pie filling. Return to refrigerator and chill until ready to serve. Makes 10 servings.

title: Crunchy Creamy Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach as directed and drain. Stir in sour cream. Turn into serving dish. Top with onion rings.

title: Coffee Punch
instructions: Mix coffee and syrup. Mash 1/2 of ice cream and add to coffee and syrup. Stir. Just before serving add soda water. Pour into chilled punch bowl. May use ice block to keep cold. Top with spoonfuls of remaining ice cream.

title: Crustless Omelette
instructions: Butter\tglass pie pan and line with the cheese slices. Beat eggs with fork; add milk and 8 of the bacon slices which have been broken up. Pour over the cheese slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. About 10 minutes before done baking add 4 slices of bacon which you curl when you take off the stove. Let dish stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in margarine and garlic powder. Sprinkle with Italian herbs. Cover and simmer 40 to 50 minutes until tender. Prepare Cacciatore Sauce according to recipe. Serve hot sauce over chicken accompanied by rice or noodles. Makes 5 servings.

title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup milk into bowl. Add pumpkin mix. Beat 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in pumpkin and spices; mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish as desired.

title: Dirty White Trash
instructions: Mix raisins peanuts pecans and Golden Grahams. Melt in microwave chocolate chips and peanut butter. Pour over first mixture and mix well. Pour confectioners sugar in a large sack. Put the mixture in on top of the sugar and shake to cover it all.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening salt nutmeg and sugar. Add beaten eggs and milk then stir in dry ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes on greased cookie sheets.

title: Jimmy Carter Dessert
instructions: Layer #1 Mix together oleo flour and peanuts. Put in cake pan and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: No Crust Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt margarine and chocolate in pan. Then mix sugar eggs flour and salt. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Chef Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in salad bowl with mayonnaise. Sprinkle top of salad with garlic salt. Serves 6.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes three 9-inch pies.

title: Steak Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook until onion is tender.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Chop up onion and green pepper. Brown meat; take off all grease. Add all ingredients onion peppers ketchup mustard and sugar. Mix thoroughly and simmer 30 minutes with no cover stirring occasionally. Makes 25 sandwiches. Use hamburger buns. Can split up and freeze.

title: Preston'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli; drain. Mix with other ingredients except crackers. Pour into casserole; sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Deep Dish Pizza Of Chicago
instructions: Grease a 14 x 12-inch pizza pan. On flour dusted surface roll dough to 16-inch circle. Press into bottom and 1 1/2-inches up sides of pan. Sprinkle with 3 cups of Mozzarella cheese. Crumble sausage over cheese. Top with oregano fennel tomatoes mushrooms and remaining cheese. Place in a 500\u00b0 oven. Immediately reduce heat to 400\u00b0. Bake 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Calico Bean Dish
instructions: Brown beef and onion in skillet. Mix other ingredients. Place in 2 1/2 quart casserole dish and bake covered for 45 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening at medium speed with an electric mixer until fluffy. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add egg and vanilla and beat until blended.
