Combine flour soda and salt; add butter into mixture mixing well. Stir in chocolate morsels and pecans. Drop dough by tablespoonful onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer to wire racks to cool.

title: Cheese Creamed Spinach
instructions: Cook spinach as directed; drain. Combine onion soup and sour cream. Add spinach. Put in greased 2-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on pkg. Cool. Mix together all ingredients and chill for 12 hours or overnight.

title: Venison Stir-Fry
instructions: Early in the day slice meat in 1/8-inch strips. Prepare all vegetables. Refrigerate meat and vegetables until ready to cook. In a small bowl mix cornstarch and stock together.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream first 5 ingredients. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Add chips and nuts stirring well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes on greased cookie sheet. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In a small bowl mix eggs pumpkin oil and water. In a large bowl mix sugar flour soda salt and spices. Slowly add small bowl to large and stir together until completely mixed. Pour into bread loaves (3 or 4) and bake for 50 to 60 minutes. In miniature bread pans (7 or 8) bake 30 to 35 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Rhubarb Dream Dessert
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into ungreased 7 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Mix rest of ingredients and spoon into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Lemon-Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a bowl combine oil lemon juice garlic salt and pepper. Arrange chicken in shallow casserole or baking pan. Pour over it lemon-oil mixture. Cover; bake until tender about 40 minutes. Baste occasionally. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer to allow chicken to brown. To serve sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Bacon Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms and remove stems. Brush caps with butter. Combine bacon mayonnaise onion cheese and salt. Fill mushroom caps with mixture. Place on baking sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 325\u00b0 until cheese bubbles.

title: Pudding Icing
instructions: Whip all together until well mixed. Place over any cake.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening sugar and eggs. Add water. Mix dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture. Mash bananas and add to mixture. Add walnuts if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased pan until done (about 45 minutes).

title: Apricot Nectar Cake
instructions: Mix well. Put in tube pan and bake 1 hour on lower level rack at 325\u00b0.

title: Sandra'S Freezer Pickles
instructions: Mix well. Pour over cucumbers. Refrigerate 5 days stirring twice daily. Put in small containers or freezer bags and freeze.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: Pepperoni Pinwheels
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Separate dough into 4 rectangles. Firmly press the perforations to seal. Place 8 pepperoni slices on each rectangle. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese. Starting at the shortest side tightly roll up each rectangle. Pinch to seal. Slice each roll into 4 equal sections. Pinch dough together on one side of each slice to seal. Place sealed side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve pinwheels with warmed pizza sauce. Makes 16 pinwheels.

title: Cranberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add juice from can of crushed pineapple. Add whole berry cranberry sauce with cut up mandarin oranges and crushed pineapple. Chill until firm in an 11 x 7-inch Pyrex dish. Top with chopped pecans.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: In medium saucepan sprinkle gelatin over 1/2 cup water; let stand for 1 minute. Stir over low heat until gelatin is dissolved about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining water.

title: Mock Avocado Diproswell, New Mexico
instructions: Blend well (in blender) until smooth. Chill for at least two (2) hours before serving.

title: Cheesy Grits Casserole
instructions: Prepare grits as directed on package. Add 1 cup cheese margarine and seasonings; stir until cheese is melted and margarine blended. Stir small amount of hot mixture into eggs; return to hot mixture. Mix well. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Top with remaining cheese; continue baking for 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Scallops Fettucini
instructions: Saute in a deep skillet preferably Teflon-coated first 4 ingredients. When the vegetables are al dente make a white sauce with the oleo in the skillet add flour stir and heat until bubbly. Let cool a little then remove from heat and add all at once milk. Stir well over low heat and add scallops parsley curry powder salt pepper and cayenne pepper. Heat slowly and stir until sauce thickens and scallops are done. Meanwhile boil spinach fettucini as directed on package. Serve sauce over the pasta. Top with grated Romano or Parmesan cheese. Accompany with tossed salad garlic bread and white wine. Serves 4.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except onion rings. Put in baking dish. Top with onion rings. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brownies
instructions: Sift flour and measure. Add baking powder and salt. Add sugar. Blend in shortening and eggs well beaten. Add melted chocolate nuts and vanilla. Spread on baking sheet and bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy; crumble. Chop green onion; mix bacon and onion with mayonnaise. Use mayonnaise to taste.

title: Don'S Lasagna
instructions: Grease bottom of a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place 3 lasagna noodles on the bottom of the dish. Spread ground meat over noodles. Spread tomato paste over ground meat. Spread Mozzarella cheese over the tomato paste. Spread Cheddar cheese over the Mozzarella cheese. Spread cottage cheese over the Cheddar cheese. Sprinkle with garlic salt to taste. Top with 3 more lasagna noodles. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove and enjoy.

title: Favorite Butter Cookies(Makes 3 Dozen)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Beat at low speed scraping bowl often until well mixed 1 to 2 minutes. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. On lightly floured surface roll out dough 1/3 at a time to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut out with cookie cutters. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. If desired sprinkle with colored sugar or bake and decorate later. Bake 6 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Remove immediately. Cool completely.

title: Sour Cream Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour once; measure. Add soda and salt; sift three times. Cream butter thoroughly; add sugar gradually and cream well. Beat in eggs then chocolate and about 1/4 of the flour and beat well then sour cream and remaining flour alternating with milk in small amounts beating after each addition. Add vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes. Makes a 3 layer cake.

title: Appetizer Meatballs
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and form into meatballs. Mix next 3 ingredients in pan and cook until it comes to a boil. Add the meatballs and let simmer at least 30 minutes. The longer they cook the more of the sauce flavor they have.

title: Butterfinger Cookies
instructions: Sift flour soda and salt together. Cream together sugar and shortening; beat in egg. Add Butterfinger bars and dredge in the dry ingredients. Chill. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for about 12 minutes. Remove from pan; cool.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and pour into a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Spareribs
instructions: Place ribs on a rack in large shallow pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile combine sugars and cornstarch in a medium saucepan. Stir in ketchup vinegar and water and bring to a boil. Stir until thickened and clear. Remove ribs. Discard fat. Place ribs back in roasting pan. Pour about 1 1/2 cups of the sauce over the ribs. Bake 30 minutes longer. Cut ribs into serving size pieces and brush with remaining sauce.

title: Cheesy Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Spray large skillet with no stick cooking spray. Add pepper and onion; cook and stir until tender. Remove from skillet. Spray skillet with no stick cooking spray. Add chicken. Cook and stir until cooked through. Add cooked vegetables chilies cumin and garlic; simmer 5 minutes.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar cornmeal and vinegar. Add melted margarine and whipping cream. Mix well. Pour into a 10-inch pie shell (pricked 3 times with fork in middle). Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Jello Pretzel Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan combine pretzels butter and sugar. Spread over bottom of pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugars and eggs. Add flour and cocoa; mix well. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake in greased 9 x 13 pan at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Jello Salad
instructions: Drain juices from canned fruit; add enough water to Jell-O to gel. Let completely gel. Mix with electric mixer on low combine pineapple cherries oranges and softened cream cheese. Add Jell-O nuts and marshmallows; mix again. Fold In Cool Whip. Save 1/4 of Cool Whip to spread on top. Refrigerate.

title: Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Mix apples cranberries and white sugar with spoon and put in 2-quart casserole with water.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Lightly toast the flaked coconut. Combine pineapple and sugar in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cool slightly. When cake is cool poke holes in it and pour pineapple mixture over cake. Prepare pudding mix. Cool. Spread over cake and pineapple mixture. Chill. Just before serving cover with Cool Whip and top with toasted coconut. If desired garnish with pineapple slices.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and green pepper in skillet. Drain off grease. Add tomato soup peas and egg noodles (already cooked). Pour in Pyrex dish and cover with grated cheese. Cook at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture and banana. Mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour into well-greased loaf pan. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Green Bean-Almondine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix ingredients in a glass baking dish. (Be careful about salt because mushroom soup is already somewhat salty since you dont dilute it.) Bake in oven for 45 minutes or until consistency is right. (Be careful because casserole thickens as it cools.)

title: Toasted Pecans
instructions: Beat egg whites. Add brown sugar. Mix with flour slowly. Add vanilla and salt. Fold in pecans. Spread out on greased cookie sheet (I spray with Pam). Bake at 250\u00b0 about 45 minutes. Cool and place in sealed container.

title: Pumpkin Dream Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add combined oats and flour; mix well. Spread evenly onto bottom of a prepared pan. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool slightly. Beat cream cheese and sugar at medium speed of electric mixer until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add remaining ingredients; mix until smooth. Pour over partly cooled crust. Bake an additional 45 to 50 minutes or until center appears set. Cool completely on a wire rack. Chill; serve with whipped cream if desired. Makes 20 bars.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix oil pudding eggs vanilla sour cream butter and cake mix. Divide cake mixture equally into 2 bowls. Add chocolate chips to one mixture and chocolate syrup to the other. Swirl ingredients in individual bowls. Pour into greased Bundt pan; bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients with a spoon then mixer. Pour half of batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased cookie sheet. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Let sugar cream and margarine boil until ball forms. Then add peanut butter vanilla and nuts.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook beef and onion in skillet. Add cooked macaroni and sauce. Stir to blend. Layer macaroni mixed alternately with cheese and pepperoni ending with layer of cheese. Bake uncovered 30 minutes.

title: Wrapped Catfish
instructions: Soak corn husks in water for 1 hour. Rinse drain and put aside. Heat olive oil in skillet then add onions and saute 2 minutes. Add the chiles and tomatillos and cook for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Add salt and set aside to cool.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: In a large casserole pan pour rice over the bottom of pan and spread evenly. Lay pork chops on top of rice. Spoon soup over the top. Pour the water over it. Cook for 25 to 35 minutes in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter sugar (brown and granulated) and vanilla until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. Sift together flour soda and salt. Gradually add creamed mixture mixing until well blended. Put in chocolate chips (and nuts if you want). Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 10 minutes until lightly browned. Makes about 5 dozen 3-inch cookies.

title: Vegetable Stew
instructions: Place whole potatoes and carrots in a vegetable steamer covered over boiling water for 15 minutes. Cut carrots into 1/2-inch slices. Peel potatoes and cut into 1-inch cubes; set aside. Heat oil in a 4-quart pot. Add potatoes carrots onion celery broccoli salt bouillon and water. Bring to a boil then simmer covered for 5 minutes. Add zucchini lima beans and peas. Return to boil cover and simmer for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 2.

title: Mound Bars
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix flour and sugar then add other ingredients. Pour into pie shells. Put in oven at 400\u00b0 then turn to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 to 40 minutes or until knife comes out clean when inserted in the center. Very good.

title: Molded Chicken Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup cold water over low heat about 4 minutes. Remove from heat add undiluted soup salt juice onion and salad dressing (or mayonnaise) beat until smooth. Chill until it mounds. Add celery and chicken; mix well and put in loaf pan or mold. Chill until firm. Serve with crackers.

title: Snails In Pasta Shells
instructions: Cook pasta shells and drain; cool. Drain and wash snails. Saute together the snails in garlic and butter for five minutes. Cool. Stuff each snail into a pasta shell and then surround with garlic butter mixture and cover pasta with sauce. Cover casserole dish and let stand several hours. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 until sizzling. Serve with French bread to dip into sauce.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook rice then add rest of ingredients and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Cookies (Almond Balls)(Pastini Di Mandorla)
instructions: Cream butter sugar egg and flavoring. Add flour baking powder and milk. Knead until well mixed. Pinch off small pieces of dough and roll between palms into balls. Roll balls in chopped almonds and place on greased cookie sheets. With thumb make indentations in center of each cookie and fill with marmalade or apricot jam. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Exquisite Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve cold or bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with crackers or with cocktail rye bread.

title: Chicken Burritos
instructions: Cut tenderloin (about 3 pounds) into filets. Combine meat and marinade for 18 to 24 hours. Grill to desired doneness.

title: Sour Dough Orange Drops
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Dough will be a smooth mixture. It doesnt need more flour!

title: Roy'S Spiced Cocoa
instructions: Bring water to a boil. In a mug add 1 or 2 shakes of cinnamon and two or 3 splashes of vanilla extract. Add water to mug and mix in cocoa. Finally add whipped cream and stir with candy cane.

title: Hearty Homestyle Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Bring pie crusts to room temperature according to package directions. Melt butter in large saucepan. Add all vegetables and saut 5 minutes. Combine soup herbs spices and chicken and stir into vegetable mixture. Unfold one pie crust and fit into pie plate. Fill with mixture and cover with second pie crust. Trim crust if necessary and press edges with a fork. (Brush top with a mixture of 1 egg beaten and 1 tablespoon of water to create a nice glossy crust if desired.) Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for an additional 40 minutes. Cover crust with foil for the last 15 minutes to prevent excessive browning.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
instructions: Combine sugar dash salt and flour; stir in melted butter lemon peel and juice. Combine milk and egg yolks; add to lemon mixture. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 8 x 8 x 2 inch baking pan. Place in larger pan on oven rack. Pour hot water into larger pan 1 inch deep. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Serve warm or chilled. Serves 9.

title: No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa salt margarine and milk. Mix and boil for 2 minutes. Add oatmeal peanut butter and vanilla. (May add 1/2 cup nuts if desired.) Mix well. Drop cookies on wax paper by teaspoons; let stand 25 minutes. They will be firm enough to eat as well as being good and rich too.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling water for five minutes; drain. Stir in sour cream chicken soup and carrot. Add melted margarine. Put half the stuffing in the bottom of a casserole dish. Put zucchini mixture over stuffing and add the remaining stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes uncovered.

title: Marinated Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers and onion. Sprinkle with salt and soak overnight. Drain well. Mix vinegar oil sugar and pepper. Pour over drained cucumbers. Place in jar and refrigerate. Keeps for months in the refrigerator.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to cake mix directions substituting pineapple juice for water. Bake cake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan according to package directions. After you take the cake out of the oven punch holes in the cake. Mix cream of coconut and Eagle Brand milk. Pour this mixture on top of cake. Refrigerate until cool. Top with Cool Whip and coconut.

title: Pommes De Terre Lyonnaise(Sauteed Potatoes With Onions)
instructions: Cook potatoes (unpeeled) in boiling water for 20 minutes. Drain cool peel and slice 1/4 inch thick. Heat butter and oil in skillet until bubbling subsides. Add potato slices and onion slices and cook until golden brown turning gently 2 or 3 times about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Split Seconds
instructions: Cream together in medium bowl the sugar butter or margarine egg and vanilla. Add flour sifted with baking powder. Combine well. Form dough on lightly floured surface until not sticky. Divide in 4 parts. Shape in roll 13 x 3/4-inch thick. Place on ungreased baking sheet about 4 inches apart 2 inches from sides of sheet. Make depression 1/4 inch deep lengthwise with knife handle. Fill with jelly or jam (about 1/3 cup). Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes until golden brown. While warm cut diagonally in 1-inch bars. Let cool. Very tasty.

title: Mom'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together the flour salt and soda; add to creamed mixture. Add oatmeal. If desired add nuts and chocolate pieces or raisins. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the rice. Bring to a boil and pour over rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Wadie Sizers Sweet Pickle Casserole
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup brown sugar 2 teaspoons orange juice and 2 teaspoons butter. Mix and set aside for use in glaze. Whip the potatoes until smooth. Beat in eggs. Add salt cloves and cinnamon. Mix well. Add remaining sugar orange juice and butter. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle pecans on top. Pour glaze over pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Mostaccioli & Sausage Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage; drain. In 2 qt. baking dish combine sausage sauce noodles and 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese mixing well. Top with remaining mozzarella cheese. Bake 25 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Turkey Hash
instructions: Saute onion and celery in 2 tablespoons oil. Add turkey (or leftover roast beef). Mix soup with milk; cook for 10 minutes. Cook potatoes until done. Add the rest of ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in 2-quart casserole dish.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and water until melted. Add mix and stir until thick. If not thickened stir in another 1/4 tablespoon cornstarch. Serve hot over biscuits.

title: Real Maine Whoopie Pies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift flour baking soda baking powder and salt together and set aside. Also make a paste of the hot water and cocoa and set aside.

title: Western Casserole
instructions: Combine flour and salt. Cut beef into small pieces. Dredge beef with flour mixture; brown in oil over medium heat. Add garlic tomato paste wine water thyme and bay leaves. Cover; simmer for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Stir in mushrooms. Cook noodles. Combine noodles and beef; pour into dish. Cover with foil; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover; top with cheese. Bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Place cheese in small mixer bowl. Let stand at room temperature until softened. Beat in onion and Worcestershire sauce on low speed. Beat on medium speed until fluffy. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. Shape mixture into 1 large ball or into 30 to 36 (1-inch) balls. Roll in parsley. Place on serving plate. Cover and refrigerate until firm about 2 hours. When serving small balls insert toothpicks.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix well until blended. Pour into pie crusts. Spread evenly. Chill for a couple of hours.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt in a bowl. In another bowl toss 2 tablespoons flour mixture with berries. Beat butter and 1 cup sugar in larger bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add remaining flour mixture alternately with milk and vanilla. Fold in berries. Spoon into 18 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups. Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Open biscuit rolls and put in a bowl. Separate the biscuits. Pour melted butter (warm not hot) over biscuits. Then sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on biscuits and carefully stir until the biscuits are coated. Put into ungreased pan (9 x 13-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour soda and salt. In a mixer bowl beat butter for 30 seconds. Add peanut butter and sugars; beat until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture; beat until well blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar if desired. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Crisscross with the tines of a fork. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Cool for one minute before removing to wire rack. Makes 48.

title: Chocolate Caramel Pecan Bars(Barbara Morkus, Carbondale, Colorado)
instructions: In a bowl beat to blend 1 cup butter brown sugar egg yolk and vanilla. Add flour and mix well. Press mixture evenly over bottom and sides of a buttered 10 x 15-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts over dough. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until crust is golden brown about 25 minutes. Pour caramel into crust and spread evenly. Sprinkle with chocolate. When chocolate softens about 5 minutes spread smooth. Let cool. Cut into 30 squares then cut each in half diagonally. If making ahead cover and chill up to 1 day. Freeze to store longer. Makes 60.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Combine poppy seed and milk in large bowl. Let stand at room temperature 3 to 4 hours. Let margarine and eggs warm to room temperature. Add sugar margarine eggs vanilla baking powder and flour to poppy seed and milk. Beat 1 minute scraping sides of bowl. Pour into loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or less. Yield 1 loaf.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In a large glass bowl mix sugar milk and butter. Microwave for 4 to 5 minutes or until mixture boils stirring 2 or 3 times. Microwave 3 minutes longer stirring once. Stir in peanut butter marshmallow cream and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Spread in a buttered pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches. Cool then refrigerate. Cut into squares when firm. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Spinach Strudel
instructions: Squeeze thawed spinach dry. In a large skillet saute yellow onions and spinach in oil until onions are translucent. Beat eggs in large bowl. Add spinach mixture green onions parsley cheese salt and pepper. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Unfold leaves of dough. Cover with a slightly damp dish towel. Remove 1 leaf leaving remainder covered with damp towel. Place leave in pan and brush with melted butter. Repeat until half of leaves (about 11) are used. Butter each layer. Spread with spinach mixture. Cover spinach filling with remaining fillo leaves brushing with butter each layer. With sharp knife cut through top layer to mark into serving size for appetizers about 1 1/2 to 2-inch squares.

title: Creamy Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip blending thoroughly. Spoon in crust. Chill until set about 4 hours. Serve with cherry or blueberry topping.

title: Low-Fat Cheesecakes
instructions: Line 12 muffin pans. Place vanilla wafer in bottom of each cup. Beat softened no-fat cream cheese sugar and vanilla; add eggs. Use mixer. Fill cupcake cups. Bake 25 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool. Serve with thawed berries.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Saute butter green pepper and onion; add to corned beef and noodles. Mix all and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: One-Bowl Chocolate Cake
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients together. Add oil and buttermilk. Beat slowly; add eggs and boiling water. Makes very thin batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. This is a very moist cake that will keep for several days.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt brown sugar Karo and butter; bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add soda salt and vanilla. Pour over popcorn. Bake for 1 hour at 250\u00b0. Stir every 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Boil potato in small amount of water for about 15 minutes. Mix all ingredients together and cook for 30 minutes. Stir often so it will not burn. The amount of ingredients can be varied to your taste. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serves 6.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Chop lettuce and tomato. Add cheese beans (drained) beef crushed Doritos and Catalina. Toss to coat.

title: Pork Chops With Pineapple
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper. Flour pork chops and brown in skillet with a small amount of oil. Place in oblong baking dish; arrange pineapple rings on top. Pour on 1/2 the pineapple juice. Cover and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Western Meat Balls
instructions: Mix ground beef oats salt pepper and milk. Form into balls. Roll in mixture of flour paprika and salt. Brown meat balls in 2 tablespoons hot fat. Add onion and cook about 5 minutes. Stir in barbecue sauce and water. Cover and simmer for about 45 minutes. Turn meat balls several times while cooking.

title: Green Soup (Caldo Verde)(A Traditional Portuguese Dish)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except collards. (Do not slice sausage until serving as it will make the soup pink.) Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium and simmer for 45 to 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove sausage and reserve. Puree potatoes in a blender or food processor until smooth. Return to pot. Add collards. Simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until the greens become barely tender. Slice the sausage; put a few into each soup bowl. Pour soup over and serve.

title: Peanut Butter And Banana Sandwich
instructions: Take 2 slices of bread and spread butter one one slice peanut butter on the other. Cut up one ripe banana and place on top of the peanut buttered slice of bread. Place the buttered side of bread on top of the bananas buttered side down. Cut in two. Serve with Cheetos and enjoy!

title: Pumpkin Spice Bread
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together (by hand). Make a well in center and add remaining ingredients. Stir just until everything is moistened. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until center is cooked completely. Can double recipe and cook in tube pan.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Spread 9 x 13-inch casserole or pan heavy with cooking oil. In large bowl combine corn salt and milk. In small bowl mix flour eggs and melted margarine. Beat. Add this mixture to the first. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake one hour at 325\u00b0. Will be golden brown on top.

title: Honey Please
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all the ingredients and pour into crust. Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and vinegar and boil for 5 minutes; let cool then pour over mixture of other ingredients. Serve cold.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Wash peppers. Cut 1-inch piece from tops and reserve. Scoop out seeds and fibers. Mix together meat grated onion rice egg water 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Stuff mixture into peppers and replace tops. Heat oil in heavy saucepan. Saute chopped onions 10 minutes. Mix tomatoes salt and pepper. Arrange peppers in upright position. On top add lemon juice and sugar. Cover and cook 30 minutes or longer until tender. Baste frequently with sauce. Taste for seasoning. Gravy should be sweet and sour. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Ethan'S Cherry Orchard Dumplings
instructions: Separate the rolls and sprinkle with flour to prevent them from sticking. Put one tbsp. of pie filling in the center of each roll. To seal each dumpling bring one side over and pinch them together. Spray the cookie sheet with non stick baking spray. Place the dumplings on the cookie sheet. Sprinkle them with sugar. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in large bowl and mix well with fork. Add shortening and mix well with fork until ingredients are crumbly.

title: Ham And Cheese Soup
instructions: Dice potatoes celery carrots and onion. Cook until tender but firm. Add diced ham and cheese soup. Heat thoroughly.

title: Easy Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: Thaw berries until mushy. Add sugar and cream; stir well. Put into freezing tray.

title: Sweet And Sour Tomato Salad
instructions: Can use 1/4 tablespoon celery seed and cloves.

title: Cold Crab Dip
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and sour cream. Add lemon juice and hot sauce then parsley. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Serve with crackers (Wheat Thins or Triscuits are best).

title: Turkey Supreme
instructions: Melt butter; add flour and stir until smooth. Add salt and pepper. Heat chicken stock milk and cream separately (2 pints half and half may be used instead of cream and milk). Pour heated stock into mixture and stir until smooth. Add milk and cream. Allow to cook over slow heat for 10 minutes. Serve sauce very hot over sliced breast of turkey and steamed noodles or rice. Sprinkle with toasted almonds. Serves 12.

title: Shrimp Sauce
instructions: Mix garlic powder with 8 to 10 teaspoons water. Blend all ingredients and whip. Let stand in refrigerator for 24 to 48 hours. Serve over fried rice or as dipping for carrots. Rice vinegar can be substituted for rice wine vinegar. Great over fried carrots.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 11 minutes. When cool roll in powdered sugar.

title: Sausage Sunburst
instructions: Brown sausage links in a skillet. Sift dry ingredients together and add eggs milk and shortening. Stir to moisten. Grease a skillet and arrange sausage links as spokes on a wheel. Pour batter over sausage and bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve with sausage gravy.

title: Elegant Squash Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine all ingredients. Pour into casserole sprayed with vegetable coating. Sprinkle with a bit more herb stuffing. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake
instructions: Mix oleo sugar eggs and pineapple together. Bring to a boil. Let cool.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of warm water and roll in balls.

title: Spanish Delight
instructions: Brown meat. Saute it with the onion and bell pepper. Add other ingredients except cheese and noodles. Cook a while then add the cheese and noodles. Serve.

title: Pecan Tarts
instructions: Mix together cream cheese 1/2 cup softened butter and sifted flour and chill 1 hour. Press into miniature tins. Beat egg brown sugar 1 tablespoon soft butter vanilla and salt. Chop nuts. Put 1/2 in bottom of pans. Put in filling. Top with remaining nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Thanksgiving Yams
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello gelatin and salt in boiling water. Drain pineapple measuring syrup. Add water to make 1/2 cup. Stir into jello with lemon juice. Blend in mayonnaise. Chill until very thick. Whip the cream. Fold fruits nuts and whipped cream into gelatin. Pour into 2 freezing trays or a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Freeze until firm 3 to 4 hours.

title: Easy Cookies
instructions: Blend together and spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Cucumber Sandwich Spread
instructions: Mix and add milk to ease spreading; add food coloring. Spread thinly on crustless white bread. Makes 18 to 20 sandwiches.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine pork and beans brown sugar Worcestershire chili powder molasses chili sauce and vinegar in bean pot or crock-pot with a lid. Mix well. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour for thin bean mixture or 1 1/2 hours for thicker bean mixture. The longer it bakes the thicker the bean mixture becomes. If desired add crumbled bacon bits to serve. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Gloria'S Carrot Cake(3 Layers)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into three individual baking pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Caramel Pecan Pie
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup sugar in heavy pan on burner; let brown nicely. Add beaten eggs milk rest of the sugar cornstarch and salt and let it thicken. Add margarine vanilla and pecans. Pour into shell. Beat egg whites; pour over and let brown. Could use Cool Whip or serve with ice cream.

title: Pork Chops Diane
instructions: Brown chops in small amount of oil on both sides. Sprinkle with soy sauce. Add wine and water. Simmer until tender. Add mushrooms heat and serve. Good over rice.

title: Cole Slaw Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients together and use with shredded cabbage.

title: Country Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown first 4 ingredients in a skillet. Drain. Mix noodle soup and uncooked rice in 4 1/2 cups boiling water. Mix with first 4 ingredients. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese And Cherry Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cream cheese until creamy. Add 3 eggs and 3/4 cup sugar. Blend well. Place mixture into cupcake shells filling them 3/4 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Mix 1 cup sour cream 3 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons vanilla. When cupcakes are finished spread the sour cream mixture on top of cupcakes while still hot then add cherry pie filling. Makes about 15 cupcakes.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Stir in other ingredients. Pour into the unbaked pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Country Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Prepare muffin mix according to package directions stirring with bacon. Fill greased or paper cup lined muffin cups 1/3 full. Drop 2 level teaspoons preserves in center of each. Add remaining batter to 3/4 full. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Kahlua Pie Filling
instructions: Note If you use the flavoring use 1 teaspoon.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add egg yolks and vanilla. Mix well with 2 1/2 cups flour. Using heaping teaspoonful of dough; roll dough into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Make thumbprint in center of each and fill with raspberry strawberry or apricot jam. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 20 minutes or until light golden color.

title: Basic Multi-Grain Pancakes
instructions: In a medium bowl mix together dry ingredients. In a second bowl combine all wet ingredients whipping them enough to beat eggs lightly. Add to dry ingredients stirring just to combine. The batter can stand for about 10 minutes out of the refrigerator or an hour or more refrigerated. Heat a griddle over medium heat. Grease it lightly (if not nonstick); immediately pour batter to form individual pancakes. Cook the pancakes until the bottoms are golden brown and the tops begin to bubble. Flip them over; cook them until the undersides are golden brown. Serve them immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: My Banana Pudding
instructions: In large bowl combine milk water and pudding mix. Beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl. Top with 1/3 each of wafers bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice ending with pudding. Cover and chill.

title: Grandma'S Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Bake 1 hour in pan that you have oiled and lined with brown paper in a moderate oven. Cool in pan for 1 hour before removing from pan. Doesnt require filling.

title: Chicken And Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in nonstick skillet; stir-fry chicken until browned 5 minutes. Add vegetables; stir-fry until crisp-tender. Stir in contents of sauce packet. Cook until hot. Microwave French fried onions 1 minute. Sprinkle over stir-fry. Serve with rice. Yield 6 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Bacon Spread
instructions: Saute bacon until crisp. Remove from pan and drain. Mash cream cheese with fork until smooth. Add bacon relish and enough mayonnaise for smooth spreading.

title: Melissa'S Tortellini With Vegetables
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions. Meanwhile heat olive oil in a medium size skillet. Stir in spices. Add garlic. Stir in onion and mushrooms. Cook and stir until onion is tender. Add sun-dried tomatoes which have been placed in boiling water for 2 minutes to soften. Drain tortellini and serve with stir-fried vegetables. Add cheese or soy sauce to your taste (optional).

title: Easy Egg Noodles
instructions: Measure flour and salt in bowl. Add egg and extra yolks; mix thoroughly. Add water 1 to 2 tablespoons at a time mixing well. Form dough into a ball. Knead until elastic and smooth. Cover and let set 10 minutes. Divide dough into 4 parts. Roll one at a time on well floured pastry sheet about 1/8-inch thick. Cut into thin or thick (whichever you prefer) strips with a pizza cutter. Shake off extra flour and place on towel or sheet pan to dry for several hours or overnight. Cook in 3 quarts water or use chicken broth 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Makes 6 cups.

title: Irish Stew
instructions: Put into saucepan. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil. Skim. Simmer gently then season with the spices adjusted to fit your own taste.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Place chicken in slow cooker. Sprinkle with Cavenders spice. Pour soup over top. Cook covered for 8 to 10 hours or until chicken is done.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in round pans. Let cool and cut layers in half with thread.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Melt the margarine in an 8 x 12-inch dish. Add crushed pretzels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash in small amount of water several minutes then drain. Combine all ingredients except a small amount of cheese and crackers. Pour into casserole. Sprinkle with remaining cracker and cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Yields 4 servings.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Cook onions and green pepper in fat until tender. Add ground beef cooking until mixture falls apart. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour removing cover for last 15 minutes.

title: Turkey Meatballs(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Spray cooking spray evenly into a large frying pan. Form mixture with fingers into medium sized balls and put into pan when hot. Brown on one side. Be careful not to burn them! Turn them over and add tomato sauce. Cover and cook on low heat until cooked through. Serve with more sauce and pasta.

title: Skillet Dish
instructions: In skillet brown meat and onions drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 45 minutes. Serve with cornbread.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix well all ingredients. Press mixture into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix well ingredients; do not beat in mixer. Beat with spoon. Bake in Bundt pan 1 hour 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mini Cheese Meat Loaves
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients except cheese. Shape in 8 mini meat loaves. Bake at 370\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Cut cheese slices in half and place a half slice on top of each loaf. Return to oven and continue baking about 5 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Venison Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients by hand in mixing bowl. Press into loaf pan and cover top with more barbecue sauce. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake
instructions: Boil first 8 ingredients together about five minutes then let cool. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together soda and flour. Add gradually to liquid mixture. Stir in nuts and candied fruit. Pour batter into two greased loaf pans and garnish top with maraschino cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until done.

title: Cheesy Pasta Bake Casserole
instructions: Cube the various blocks of cheeses and set aside. Pasta shells should be prepared al dente. In a 2-quart saucepan cook onion garlic and butter briefly then add flour salt and pepper and continue to cook until bubbling. Stir in milk and heat to boiling then continue to boil (stirring constantly) for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add cheeses until all cubes are melted. Place cooked shells into a 2-quart casserole dish and pour cheese sauce over it. Top with Parmesan cheese (and some breadcrumbs if desired) and place into a 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 30 minutes or until bubbling and light brown. (Serves 6.)

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Stir in the apples and nuts with Wesson oil and eggs. Mixture will be thick. Mix well and spoon in a well-greased Bundt pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cake is better day after.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Cook them to a soft ball stage and remove from heat. While hot add chocolate bits and add marshmallow. Mix well and add nuts. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut into desired size pieces when cool.

title: Pork Chops Supreme
instructions: Arrange pork chops in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; top each with onion brown sugar and catsup. Bake covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes or until tender.

title: Trudy'S Pound Cakes
instructions: Cream sugar Crisco and margarine together until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well after each. Add flour alternately with milk starting with flour and ending with flour. Add vanilla. Pour in greased and lightly floured 10-inch tube pan. Put in cold oven and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes (longer if needed).

title: Cherry Treats
instructions: Sift together first four ingredients. Add margarine and shortening. Cut in margarine and shortening as you would for pie dough. Work until dough is very crumbly. Add egg vanilla and milk; mix well. Use 2/3 of dough to spread on ungreased cookie sheet. On top of dough spread cherry pie filling. Use remaining dough for lattice top.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: In casserole combine peaches sugar 1 tablespoon baking mix and cinnamon. In bowl mix baking mix cinnamon brown sugar milk and few drops of vanilla. Pour over fruit. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Prepare pudding according to directions on box. Let stand 5 minutes. Line a 13 x 9-inch pan with a layer of graham crackers. Spread half of the pudding over crackers. Add another layer of crackers more pudding and top with layer of crackers. Spread pie filling over crackers. Chill about 3 hours.

title: Dixie'S Dill Pickles
instructions: Take clean quart canning jars and place 1 bunch fresh dill 1 clove fresh garlic 1 hot pepper (more if you like hotter pickles) and slice of onion (if desired) into each jar. Pack fresh green cucumbers into jars. Bring brine (vinegar water salt and alum) to a boil and cover pickles. Seal with hot scalded lid and screw band firmly tight. If mine seal I dont hot water bath them. If they dont seal overnight I hot water bath them 15 minutes.

title: Applesauce Squares
instructions: Add everything together and mix well. Grease a cookie sheet (15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch) or cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Stroganoff
instructions: In skillet brown meat along with onion in the oil. Add soup sour cream salt and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve over noodles.

title: Wild Rice Sausage Bake
instructions: Cook rice as package directs. Drain. Cook sausage until done breaking up with fork as it cooks. Drain well on paper towels. Simmer onion in 2 tablespoons of butter until soft. Stir in flour until bubbly; stir in milk salt and pepper until thickened. Saute mushrooms in remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Toss rice sausage milk mixture and mushrooms lightly. Put into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. This goes great with Chicken Breasts In Cream.

title: Granola Cookies
instructions: Mix in order. Bake at 350\u00b0. Drop on cookie sheet.

title: Santa'S Whiskers
instructions: In mixer bowl cream together butter or margarine and sugar. Blend in milk and vanilla. Stir in flour candied cherries and nuts. Form into 2 rolls each 2 inches in diameter and 8 inches long. Roll in coconut. Wrap and chill several hours or overnight. Slice 1/4-inch thick; place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Mix corn meal and flour; add buttermilk oil eggs and corn. Beat and mix well. Stir in jalapenos and onions. Mix in about half of the cheese. Grease a 9 x 14-inch baking dish with butter; heat well. Pour in batter and sprinkle with rest of cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: A To Z Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given. Place in greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple And Peanut Butter Crisp
instructions: Put apples in greased 8-inch square glass baking dish. Mix in cinnamon. In bowl combine sugar and flour. With pastry blender or 2 knives cut in margarine and peanut butter until mix resembles coarse crumbs. Add 1/2 cup to apple mixture. Mix well. Sprinkle remainder over apples. Bake uncovered in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes. Best served warm.

title: Shell Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil and drain pasta. Mix all ingredients together. Chill for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except eggs. Fold in eggs. Bake in unbaked pie crust at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Bake 45 more minutes or until done at 375\u00b0. Can be made as a pudding by baking without crust in a baking dish.

title: Grandma Tessie'S Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Scald milk. Add sugar salt and butter. Proof yeast. When milk mixture is lukewarm add yeast and beat in eggs. Gradually add flour and mix well. Knead on floured board until smooth and elastic. Place in bowl cover and let rise in warm area until double in bulk. (Stick two fingers into dough remove finger. If depressions remain dough is doubled). Punch down. Place in refrigerator tightly covered. After 24 hours pinch off desired portion; shape into desired shape. Place on greased pan. Let rise several hours until doubled in bulk. Bake in hot oven at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes. Recipe may be doubled for a larger quantity. Dough can be kept in refrigerator for a week.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Put cracker crumbs in a casserole dish then spread cherry pie filling over crumbs. Next put mixed ingredients on top. Serve after refrigeration overnight.

title: Brown Beef-Beer
instructions: Brown beef in butter. Add beer basil salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until meat is tender. Stir in gravy mix and cook until thick (about 5 minutes). I sometimes add sliced carrots. Serve over wild rice.

title: South Carolina Shrimp Gumbo
instructions: Saute bacon onion bell pepper and celery until tender. Add tomatoes tomato juice okra rice and bay leaf. Cook for 45 minutes. Add shrimp Tabasco sauce and salt to taste. Cook for an additional 20 minutes. Serve over rice with cornbread. Serves 4.

title: Icing For Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend cream cheese and powdered sugar together until smooth. Then put on top of cooked cheese cake.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Blend. Then beat at medium speed of mixer for 4 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch Bundt cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until it springs back when lightly pressed. Cool in pan 15 minutes and remove.

title: Creamy Baked Corn
instructions: Melt oleo in saucepan. Add flour; stir until smooth stirring constantly. Then gradually add milk until thick and bubbly. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients except paprika. Spoon mixture into coated baking dish then sprinkle with paprika. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Stir well; add cocoa and mix well. Add dry ingredients along with milk. Dont grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
instructions: In large pan or crock-pot put cheese and milk. Stir occasionally until cheese is melted. Add tomatoes with green chilies and cooked sausage. Stir well until all is hot and serve with tortilla chips. (You may use mild medium or hot sausage; choose to your taste.)

title: Pasta Primavera(Italian)
instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and keep warm. In a large skillet/wok melt butter. Add broccoli carrots onion garlic and basil. Saute 6 to 7 minutes. Add mushrooms. Cook 2 minutes. Add pea pods and cook 2 minutes longer or until all vegetables are crisp-tender. Serve vegetables over hot pasta. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 8 servings. Preparation time 10 to 15 minutes. Cooking time 21 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken salad oil orange juice vinegar and salt. Let stand while preparing remaining ingredients. Gently toss all ingredients.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Cranberry Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well blended. Cover and chill. Serve with fruits for dipping.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Roll dough to 12 x 9-inch rectangle on lightly floured surface. Combine oregano and garlic powder; mix with olive oil. Brush oil mixture lightly on dough reserving some for top of dough. Cover with pepperoni slices then cheese. Roll up jelly roll style. Brush with remaining oil mixture. Pinch seams of dough tightly. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Cool at least 15 minutes. Cut into 1-inch thick slices.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown burger and drain excess grease. Add all the other ingredients. Cook on low heat until done.

title: Shelia'S Cookies
instructions: Coat fruits raisins and nuts with 1 cup flour. Cream butter sugar and egg yolks. Add rest of flour nutmeg cinnamon and soda. Fold in egg whites. Drop by teaspoons on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Cool and place in airtight containers with paper towels between layers.

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Stir together sugar flour nutmeg cinnamon and salt. Mix with apples. Turn into an ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Dot with butter. Prepare pastry as directed except roll into 10-inch square. Fold pastry in half. Cut slits near center. Unfold edges under just inside edge of pan. Bake 1 hour or until juice begins to bubble through slits in crust. Best if served warm.

title: Breakfast Spread
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese with sugar then stir in berries. Spread on toasted bagels. Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Deluxe Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake in 5 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch pans. Bake 60 minutes at 325\u00b0 or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Grandma E'S Famous Sloppy Joes
instructions: Mix water with flour. Add sauce and cook until thick (boil about 2 minutes). Add to cooked hamburger.

title: Cranberry Orange Dressing
instructions: In food processor or mixer blend first 4 ingredients. With processor or mixer still running slowly pour oil in steady stream until blended. Yields 1 cup. Great on chicken salad veggies (use as a marinade for chicken then bake or grill).

title: Crisp Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken mayonnaise celery and onions into a mixing bowl. Add 1 cup cornflake crumbs soup and water chestnuts. Place in a 2-quart casserole. Melt oleo. Add remaining 1 cup cornflake crumbs. Mix well and use as topping for casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Sandwich Casserole
instructions: In large bowl combine mayonnaise celery chopped meat olives and mushrooms. Stir gently to mix. Place 6 slices bread in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread each slice evenly with meat mixture. Top with remaining bread slices; press down.

title: Angel Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Beat margarine sugar egg yolks shortening salt and flavorings together until fluffy. Add sifted flour and mix well. Using a level tablespoon for measuring size roll dough between palms and hands until ball is 1 inch in diameter. Dip the balls into unbeaten egg whites and roll in chopped pecans. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet using thumb to make depression in center of each ball and fill with jam or jelly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Coconut Pound Cake(The Best)
instructions: Separate eggs placing whites in a large bowl and yolks in another large bowl. Let egg whites warm to room temperature (about 1 hour). Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease a 10-inch tube pan. With electric mixer at high speed beat egg yolks with margarine and shortening until well blended. Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add extracts and beat until blended. At low speed beat in flour (in fourths) alternately with milk (in thirds) beginning and ending with flour. Add coconut and beat until well blended. Beat egg whites just until stiff peaks form. With wire whisk or rubber scraper gently fold whites into batter until well combined. Turn into prepared pan. Bake 2 hours or until cake tester inserted near center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack for 15 minutes. Remove cake from pan and cool thoroughly on wire rack. Makes 12 to 16 servings. The cake will have a nice \macaroon-like\ top and will slice better the day after it is made. She suggests that you wrap it well in plastic wrap and foil then store in refrigerator. To serve dust lightly with confectioners sugar. This cake will also freeze well.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: In medium sized bowl mix thawed Cool Whip with crushed pineapple (drain juice from pineapple). Stir in cherry pie filling and place nuts on top. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Soak beans overnight or at least 2 hours. Rinse and cook until fork-tender. Drain. Saute or brown ground beef onions peppers and garlic; salt and pepper. Drain off any excess oil. Add tomatoes and tomato sauce. In a casserole dish layer beans meat mixture and cheese. Continue to layer until casserole dish is full. Spread topping of cheese on top and bake in 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. Let cool and serve warm or cold.

title: Strawberry Stack Cake
instructions: Put 3 tablespoons strawberries in the bottom of a large deep glass bowl. Cut some of the cake and crumble over the strawberries. Cover the crumbled cake with strawberries and the juice. Drizzle the juice around the edges so it will show through the glass dish. Over the strawberries add a layer of Cool Whip. Then another layer of cake strawberries and Cool Whip. Finish with Cool Whip after filling the bowl. This is better when made the night before. It also freezes well.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger meat. Add onions green peppers and mushrooms and cook until brown. Then add spaghetti sauce mix and little water the sauce that comes in the spaghetti dinner box and the special tomato sauce. Let simmer and serve with spaghetti noodles and Parmesan cheese.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Sausage and cheese should be taken out of refrigerator 1 hour before mixing. Mix sausage and cheese; work Bisquick into mixture. Form into small balls. Place on ungreased baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Add yeast and sugar to the lukewarm water; stir. Let yeast work while you go to next step. (I dont sift the flour.) Put flour in bowl and make a well in it. Put salt and Crisco in bowl. Add yeast mixture. Mix until you can work it on a doughboard\tby hand. Put it in a greased bowl and put cooking oil on top. Cover with wax paper or towel and put in a warm place of any draft to rise. Let rise until double in size. Put on doughboard and lightly knead. You will need to add a little flour. Make into\trolls and let rise until double. Bake at 375\u00b0 or until brown approximately 15 minutes depending\ton oven. Put\toil on each roll before they rise. By\tthis it means that after\tyou form a roll put either Crisco or margarine over the top of it.

title: Nectarine Sherbet
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over 1/4 cup milk in a medium saucepan. Let stand 1 minute. Cook over medium heat stirring until gelatin dissolves; remove from heat. Add salt sugar and 1 cup milk. Stir until sugar dissolves. Let mix cool.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: In a saucepan cover frozen vegetables with water and boil for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender; drain and pour into a buttered dish 9 x 9-inch or 9 x 13-inch. In a bowl mix rest of the ingredients reserving half of the fried onion rings. Pour mixture over vegetables and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove cover and add the rest of the onion rings on top of casserole and bake for an extra 10 minutes.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Hors D'Oeuvre
instructions: Mix potted meat pickles mayonnaise and enough cracker crumbs to make a thick moist paste. Cut the tip end off peppers; remove seeds and membranes. Fill peppers with mixture. Serve as hors doeuvre. (After a few drinks are not so fiery!)

title: Onigari Yaki
instructions: In a saucepan combine sweet vinegar water soy sauce and sugar. Bring to a boil. Thread 6 shrimp on skewer. Dip skewers in sauce then broil over hot coals. Brush constantly with sauce until shrimp are glazed and barely tender (just a few minutes) on each side. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Blend white and brown sugars; add softened margarine and eggs. Mix well and add pumpkin then remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry. Stir together sugar flour and cinnamon. Mix with berries. Turn into pie crust. Sprinkle with lemon juice and dot with butter. Cover with top crust. Cut slits in crust and sprinkle with sugar. Cover edges of crust with aluminum foil. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes. Makes a 9-inch pie.

title: Venetian Pasta Rolls
instructions: Brown meat with onion. Stir in 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce and 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover each noodle with approximately 1/3 cup meat mixture. Roll up starting at narrow end. Place seam side down in 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Spoon remaining spaghetti sauce over noodles. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated. Makes 8 servings.

title: Guitar Cake(Serves 16)
instructions: Drain apricot halves and reserve 1/4 cup syrup. Combine apricots cherries peaches pears guava shells and pineapple ring in 2-quart Wonderlier. Combine reserved apricot syrup and curacao and pour over fruit. Marinate overnight.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats and chocolate chips mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Bake 9 to 10 minutes depending on your oven. Cool 1 minute and remove.

title: Marinated Garden Salad
instructions: Bring to a boil sugar vinegar oil salt pepper and green bean juice. Pour liquid over vegetables; marinate in refrigerator 24 hours. Keeps 1 to 2 weeks (if it last that long).

title: Snowballs
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add egg yolks and nuts. Blend well. Fold in whipped egg whites and pineapple. Spread mixture (1/2-inch thick) on alternating wafers (3 layers). Refrigerate overnight. Cover with whipped cream; sprinkle with coconut. Use cupcake liners for each snowball.

title: Chocolate Cake(Slow Cooker Style)
instructions: Lightly grease inside of slow cooker. Combine cake mix sour cream water eggs and oil in a large bowl. Blend well. Stir in pudding mix until well blended. Fold in chocolate chips. Pour mixture into slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours.

title: Low Calorie Lasagna(No Noodles)
instructions: Saute hamburger and onion until onion is transparent. Add all other ingredients. Bake in 9 x 9-inch casserole at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Make small meat balls from raw meat. Mix jelly and chili sauce and simmer meat balls in sauce for 1 hour on very low heat.

title: Vichyssoise
instructions: Trim leeks; cut off roots and tips and remove most of dark green (leave some of light green stems). Wash thoroughly and drain. (If leeks are very sandy it may be necessary to remove outer leaves and wash and drain them again.)

title: Jalapeno Pie
instructions: Butter 9-inch pie pan. Chop a jar of jalapenos and scatter on bottom of pan. Layer 1-inch grated cheese over top. Beat 3 eggs and pour over all. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut in small wedges to serve as snacks.

title: Helen'S Mock Angel Food
instructions: Mix the sugar flour and baking powder together. Add the milk egg whites and vanilla.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook onions in large skillet. Add rice; cook until transparent. Put in seasoning. Add to pork in bowl. Add water to make creamy. Cut hard center out of cabbage; lie flat. Place small amount on center of leaf and roll. Line bottom of pan with sauerkraut. Place cabbage rolls on top.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Boil water sugar and coffee; stir until dissolved. Cool. Add brandy or vodka and pour in 1/2 gallon jar. Add vanilla bean. Age in cool dark place for 30 days. Yields 1/2 gallon.

title: Chicken Hot Dish
instructions: Put dressing in bottom of sprayed casserole. Layer remaining ingredients. Beat 2 eggs and pour over top. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Oat Lacies
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add remaining ingredients except powdered sugar. Mix well. Cover and chill 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in powdered sugar. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until edges are light golden brown. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack. Cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Pear Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs. Sift flour salt and soda together. Stir into oil mixture. Add pears and nuts. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese Pie
instructions: Make a graham cracker pie shell but make sure you use graham crackers.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Layer coconut and pecans in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread the cake batter on top. Mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar together. Drop by teaspoonfuls on top of cake batter. Do not stir or press down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Remove from oven and flip over onto plate or piece of cardboard covered with foil. Or can be left in pan and drizzled with melted chocolate.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Chop and combine lettuce tomatoes onions and cucumber. Add Ranch Style beans. Toss well and refrigerate. Just before serving add Fritos and Catalina dressing. Toss.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake cake in rectangle pan. Make chocolate pudding and chill. When cake is cool slice lengthwise. Place 1/2 in pan then place 1 layer of Cool Whip. Smash up 2 Heath bars and sprinkle on Cool Whip. Start layering again chocolate cake pudding Cool Whip. Smash remaining Heath bars and sprinkle on top. Enjoy!

title: Tortellini Alfredo
instructions: Reduce cream to a sauce consistency. In a large skillet combine tortellini and reduced cream and salt and pepper. Bring cream back to a boil and lower flame. Then add cheese and toss in pan until sauce coats tortellini.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in boiling water in a Dutch oven. Stir in orange juice lemon juice and pineapple juice. Add strawberries. Freeze in a large plastic container or freezer bags. Remove 1 hour before serving. Add lemon-lime beverage. Stir until slushy.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: Beat egg. Add sugar and butter then add remaining ingredients. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon mixed with 5 tablespoons sugar on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: String Pie
instructions: Cook beef onion and green pepper in skillet over medium heat until meat is brown stirring to separate meat. Drain fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce; mix well.

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix pudding as directed on box; mix Cool Whip cream cheese margarine and sugar together. Mix pudding with other ingredients. Put layer of crushed Oreos in pan then layer of mixture and crumbs ending with Oreos on top.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Note For larger amount use 3 packages pudding 4 1/2 cups milk 8 ounces cream cheese and 16 ounces Cool Whip.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter in large cooking dish. Add water. Bring to a boil. Add instant rice. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Add corn and cream of mushroom soup. (Golden cream of mushroom soup may be substituted for more spicy flavor.) Sprinkle top with grated cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Cherry Coconut Cookies
instructions: Sift together onto waxed paper flour baking powder and salt. Mix in bowl shortening and sugar. Add egg and beat hard. Stir in milk and vanilla. Add flour mixture and mix well. Stir in finely cut maraschino cherries. Shape dough into balls using about a tablespoon of dough for each ball. Roll balls in chopped-shredded coconut. Place on greased baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Set oven at 375\u00b0. Bake on even rack slightly below center for 12 minutes or until light brown. Remove from oven at once. Do not overbake. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Cook celery and onion in margarine. Mix with other ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Hamburger Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Add remaining ingredients. Put all in a slow cooker to keep warm. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Beef Stroganoff Ii
instructions: Brown beef in skillet.\tDo not drain. Place beef and all ingredients in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix together thoroughly. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Nancy'S Apple Cake
instructions: Mix by hand sugar and oil. Add vanilla eggs cinnamon baking soda salt flour apples nuts and raisins. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan or tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Duchess Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes. Cut into large pieces. Heat 1 inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) to boiling. Add potatoes. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat cover and cook until tender 20 to 25 minutes. Drain. Shake pan gently over low heat to dry potatoes.

title: Picnic Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter; add potatoes. Sprinkle with dressing. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour. Serves 25.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook chicken until it leaves bone. Debone chicken. Cut chicken across grain in bite sizes (not too small). Add corn butter and chicken to broth. Cook a short time after adding onions. Season to taste.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix milk and thawed lemon juice thoroughly. Add Cool Whip. Pour into crust and freeze.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients in a large bowl and form into small meatballs. In a large kettle or Dutch oven combine remaining ingredients and then add the meatballs. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and let simmer for 1 hour.

title: Gluten Roast
instructions: Shape all into loaf. Place in buttered loaf pan. Pour 1 cup vegetable stock (1 cup McKays broth 1 teaspoon McKays plus 1 cup water) over roast. Lay 2 bay leaves on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chocolate-Covered Strawberries
instructions: Cover cookie sheet with wax paper set aside. Wash and pat dry strawberries. Melt chocolate chips and butter on top of a double boiler over simmering water stirring until smooth. Remove from heat; keep double boiler over water. Dip each strawberry two-thirds of the way up into chocolate mixture; allow excess to drip off. Place on prepared cookie sheet. Allow chocolate to set. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Parboil mushrooms for 5 minutes. Drain and cool. Fry sausage in small chunks until done. Be careful not to get too crisp. Drain and cool on paper towel. Crumble with fingers and mix well with cream cheese which is at room temperature. Stuff mushrooms with cheese and sausage mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place in broiler until tops are sizzling. Serve immediately.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: In a heavy pan cook onion celery and garlic in hot oil until soft. Stir in tomato sauce water seasonings and noodles. Mix until noodles are covered with liquids. Cover tightly as soon as sauce boils; turn heat very low and simmer 20 minutes. Remove. Stir in mayonnaise tuna and peas. Heat 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Raspberry Cheesecake
instructions: Beat butter 1/4 cup sugar and 1 egg in a small bowl until fluffy. Mix in 3/4 cup of the nuts flour and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Press mixture on bottom and 2-inches up sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Spread half the preserves on crust.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Crumble moistened bread into bowl add rest of ingredients. Mix well then add ground beef. Stir or knead until well blended. Pack into greased loaf pan and unmold onto a flat baking pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Spoon tomato puree over loaf 15 minutes before baking is finished.

title: Jewish Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into 10-inch square pan and bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Let stand until not quite cool 10 to 15 minutes. Cut into bars. Roll each bar in confectioners sugar.

title: Grandmother'S Soup
instructions: In a large stew pan place the bone and meat with about 3 quarts of water. Bring to a boil. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Simmer this for about 20 minutes then place the tomatoes and sliced onion with the meat and water. Cook this for about 1 1/2 hours at a medium boil. Then add the frozen vegetables and potatoes (which have been diced coarsely). About 20 minutes before you are ready to serve the soup add the pasta.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar eggs and chocolate thoroughly. Stir in buttermilk and vanilla. Mix together flour soda and salt. Blend. Stir in nuts. Chill at least 1 hour. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Drop rounded teaspoonful of dough 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together the pork and beans brown sugar ketchup and green onions. Pour into a baking dish. Place bacon slices on top. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Bake
instructions: Put chicken in flat bottom baking dish or pan. Combine salad dressing and soup mix; pour over chicken. Bake uncovered in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Crunch Top Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes crosswise into 1/2-inch slices. Melt butter in jelly roll pan in 375\u00b0 oven. Add single layer of potatoes. Turn slices once in butter. Mix remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over potatoes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crisp.

title: Fig Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake 1 1/2 hours on 300\u00b0. If you use plain flour add 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon soda.

title: Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Partially cook broccoli. Add other ingredients. Microwave on High 10 to 15 minutes. Add 1 cup diced chicken or turkey for complete meal. Serves 4.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Chop stems fine. In a skillet heat the margarine; saute the garlic and onion until onion is tender. Add the mushroom stems; cook over low heat. Raise heat; cook until liquid has evaporated. In a bowl combine the cooked stems with bread crumbs and all other ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Stuff mushrooms with this mixture. Arrange caps on a baking sheet. Brush tops with olive oil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Mushrooms can be stuffed and refrigerated up to one day ahead.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Slice dough and place on the bottom and sides of a cookie sheet with sides. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Quick Stove Top Tuna Casserole
instructions: Boil egg noodles until tender; drain. Drain tuna well then flake with fork. Place tuna in skillet; add cream of mushroom soup and milk. Add a dash of salt pepper and 2 teaspoons margarine. Simmer at medium temperature for 5 minutes. Add cooked egg noodles to tuna mixture and mix well. Simmer 5 minutes. In small pot melt 1/2 stick margarine; add bread crumbs and mix well. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over tuna mixture until covered. Turn off heat and let stand 5 minutes then serve. Serves 6.

title: Escalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Bake uncovered until crumbs are brown at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Fudge
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; mix well. Mix the sugar and evaporated milk in a large saucepan; bring to a boil and boil for 12 minutes stirring constantly. Pour over marshmallow mixture stir until well mixed. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Chill for 24 hours or longer. Cut into squares. Yield 117 servings.

title: Quiche
instructions: These ingredients are enough for 2 pies.

title: Mounds Bars
instructions: Combine the Eagle Brand milk confectioners sugar butter and coconut (do not add all the coconut at one time do not use all of coconut if mixture becomes too dry). Press onto cookie sheet and chill for at least two hours. (Can be chilled overnight.) In double boiler melt chocolate chips adding paraffin a little at a time until chocolate is thin. Cut candy into squares and dip in chocolate. Place on wax paper.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add to skillet Worcestershire sauce pepper relish and chunks of cheese. Heat slowly to let cheese melt. Let simmer about 15 minutes and put in crock-pot to keep warm. Serve immediately with tortilla chips. Add extra jalapenos.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix first five ingredients. In a small bowl mix remaining ingredients. Then mix together with top ingredients. Serve cold. Serves 10.

title: Creole Cauliflower Au Gratin
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan; add onion and green pepper and brown lightly. Blend in flour and add tomatoes and salt and pepper. Heat to boiling point and cook 3 minutes stirring constantly. Add cauliflower and heat thoroughly. Place mixture in a casserole and cover with shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese has melted and mixture is hot and bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Barbecues
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion. Drain fat off. Add remaining ingredients. Warm 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Mash up. Then put everything but 1/2 stick of butter in it. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Then pour 1/2 stick butter on top. Grate cheese and put on top. Melt it in the oven.

title: Macaroni And Cheese(Crock-Pot)
