instructions: Put all sauce ingredients in crock-pot; stir well. Cover; cook on high 1 hour. Add cooked drained macaroni. Cover; cook on low 3 hours or until done.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients. Add milk flour poppy seed and almond. Fold in nuts. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix and refrigerate in plastic or jars.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: *Can use 3/4 cup water 2 tablespoons minced onion 2 tablespoons chili powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon cumin 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and dash of hot pepper sauce in place of taco seasoning packet.

title: Freezer Corn
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes. Cool. Put in freezer bags. Freeze.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise sugar & vinegar; mix well. Refrigerate dressing about 3 hours. Fry bacon and crumble. Trim broccoli using only florets. Add pecans raisins and onions to broccoli. Mix with dressing when ready to serve. Serves 12.

title: Tabouli
instructions: Place the bulgur with cold water to cover in a large bowl. Set aside for 30 minutes until most of water is absorbed. Drain the bulgur squeezing out excess water. Toss the moist bulgur with all the remaining ingredients. Refrigerate at least 2 to 3 hours. Serves 6.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix well together the beef pork sausage onion salt pepper and eggs. Use 1 to 1 1/2 packages of soda crackers or 1 to 1 1/2 cups oatmeal. Mix well. Place 1/2 mixture into loaf pan. Put shredded cheese desired on top. Top with the rest of meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mexican Artichoke Dip (Spread)
instructions: Line an 8 x 8-inch baking dish with mashed green chilies. Then fill the dish with a mixture of the remaining ingredients. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 until browned. Good with corn chips or crackers.

title: Homemade Yeast Rolls
instructions: In large bowl combine yeast and 2 cups of flour. Heat milk sugar salt and butter/margarine. Add to flour mixture. Add egg and beat at low speed for 30 seconds. Beat at high speed for 3 minutes. Gradually add the remaining 1 1/2 cups flour and continuing mixing by hand to form a soft dough. Turn dough into a greased bowl in a warm place 80 to 85\u00b0. Dough should double in volume in 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Turn dough on floured board and shape. Place on greased baking sheet or muffin tin. Cover for 30 to 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Mama'S Layer Cake
instructions: Mix butter and sugar well. Add eggs one at the time except 2 of the whites. Add flour with baking powder mixed in and then add milk with vanilla mixed in. Mix well and put batter in 4 cake pans. Bake 30 minutes or until slightly brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Stir in brown sugar; spread evenly in the pan. Drain pineapple. Arrange the pineapple slices on the top of the sugar and butter mixture. Place a cherry in the center of each ring. Gently spread crushed pineapple over the top. Set aside.

title: Knox Blocks(Finger Jello)
instructions: Mix gelatine and jello. Add boiling water and dissolve. Add whipping cream. Pour into pan and refrigerate until set.

title: Prize Cookies
instructions: Pre-heat over to 375\u00b0. In large mixing bowl beat shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs; beat well. Stir together dry ingredients gradually add to shortening mixture. Mix well. Stir in mincemeat. Drop by rounded teaspoons 2 inches apart onto greased baking sheet. Bake 8-10 minutes until lightly browned. Cool. Frost if desired.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: First roll nuts in a little of the flour then sift rest of flour and other dry ingredients. Beat eggs slightly and add to oil then add all other ingredients. Gradually add sifted ingredients to egg-oil mixture stirring well after each addition. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour in tube pan. Ice with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Kids Slush
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 2-5 minutes. Put in ice cream pail and add all three flavors of juice. Freeze 12-24 hours stirring every 3 hours. The next day scoop into cup and add a little 7up. Stir and serve.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes celery and onions. Put in large soup pot and cover with water; cook until tender and water has cooked down a little. Add milk noodles and butter. Cook until noodles are done.

title: Fish Casserole
instructions: Melt butter; add cracker crumbs and egg. Mix fish into mixture. Bake 15 minutes covered at 375\u00b0 and 15 minutes uncovered. You can baste with wine!

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Grease bottom and sides of oblong baking dish. Mix blackberries with 1 1/2 cups sugar. Work shortening into dry ingredients. Work 3/4 cup cold water into mixture. Divide dough in half and roll out. Lay bottom dough in greased pan; prick dough. Sprinkle 1/4 cup flour over crust. Pour in berries; dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Sprinkle another 1/4 cup flour over berries. Lay top dough over this; pierce it. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons sugar on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar milk and salt in 3-quart pan. Cook over medium heat until a soft ball (234\u00b0) is formed. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour into buttered pan. Score while still warm.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Optional Omit bacon bits and add 1 1/2 to 2 cups of cooked chicken.

title: The No Guilt Fruitcake Treat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray 2 large heavy weight cookie sheets with cooking spray or line mini-muffin tins with paper liners spray with cooking spray. Set aside.

title: Slow-Cooked Breen Beans With Tomatoes
instructions: Drain the tomatoes reserving the juice. Remove the stem ends from the tomatoes and seed if desired. Break the tomatoes into chunks.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in jackets until tender. Cool peel and slice thin. Fry bacon until crisp; add onion and cook 1 minute more. Blend in flour salt sugar and pepper. Stir in vinegar and water; cook stirring 10 minutes. Pour over sliced potatoes; add celery seed and parsley. Serve at once.

title: Fresh Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt butter in baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 sugar over fruit and set aside. Combine remaining sugar flour and baking powder. Add milk and mix well. Pour mixture into dish. Add fruit. Do not stir. Bake 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Asparagus Salad
instructions: Drain asparagus reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Chop asparagus and set aside. Sprinkle gelatin over water in a small saucepan; let stand for 1 minute. Cook over medium heat until gelatin dissolves stirring constantly. Remove from heat and pour into container of electric blender. Add reserved liquid lemon juice mayonnaise cream cheese and onion; blend until smooth. Stir in pecans and asparagus and spoon into an 8-inch square pan. Cover and chill until firm. Cut into 9 squares and serve on lettuce. Yield 9 servings 100 calories per serving.

title: Layered Mexican Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 cup Cheddar cheese and 3 tablespoons of the onion and garlic. Spread into bottom of 9-inch pie plate. Mix salsa and tomato; spread over cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup Cheddar cheese and remaining 1 tablespoon onions. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients. Bake in five 1 pound coffee cans. Divide batter evenly. Should be about half full.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Combine all and place in a 9-inch casserole dish sprayed with Pam or greased. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (For larger casserole use a 16 ounce package of vegetables 1 1/2 cans of soup and 3/4 pint of sour cream.)

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add milk and vanilla alternately with baking powder and flour. Bake in 3 layer pans at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

title: Sugar Free Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Roll half of pastry and fit into pie pan. Mix concentrate tapioca spices salt and apples. Pour into unbaked crust. Dot with butter. Cover with remaining pie crust. Make slits in top crust. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tiger Fudge
instructions: Melt the white chocolate and peanut butter; pour into greased cookie sheet. Melt the chocolate bar. Pour onto first mixture in 3 strips then swirl.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Pam a 9 x 12-inch pan. Place bread on bottom in a single layer. Sprinkle meat then cheese over bread. Mix eggs milk and seasonings. Pour over casserole. Blend cornflakes and margarine and spread over top of casserole. Let stand in fridge overnight. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Meat And Potato Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to package. Roll out for a 9-inch 2 crust pie. Line pie plate with pastry. Combine meat milk soup mix pepper and allspice. Pat into pie plate. Put on top crust; flute edge. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or until brown.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the cheese and margarine together. Add sugar gradually and eggs beating after each addition. Add flour gradually and extract. Beat well.

title: Fruit Whip-Up
instructions: In medium bowl combine fruit cocktail (undrained) and pudding; mix well. Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows. Keep cool until ready to serve.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix well ingredients except prunes and nuts. Add prunes and nuts; mix and pour into 9 x 13 glass pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Before cake cools make holes in top of cake with toothpick.

title: Diabetic Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Blend oleo sugar and salt; add eggs and peanut butter. Stir in flour sifted with soda. Form dough into balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork in both directions (#). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pork Chops With Peas And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook chops in large heavy skillet over medium heat turning once every 5 minutes until done and fat is partially rendered. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon sage and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper. Remove from skillet and set aside.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables per package directions; drain. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole. In saucepan melt margarine over medium heat. Add flour. Gradually add milk; stir constantly until thickened about 5 minutes. Add spices and 1 cup of cheese; stir until cheese is melted. Spoon sauce over vegetables; toss to coat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and almonds. Bake 5 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix the 3 soups milk and stick of butter. Heat until butter melts. Pour 1/2 mixture into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Sprinkle rice into soup mixture and stir spreading evenly into pan. Lay chicken strips onto rice and soup mixture. Pour remaining mixture over chicken. Sprinkle heavily with Parmesan and almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Crazy Crust Pizza
instructions: Brown beef season to taste (no need to brown pepperoni). Drain well. Grease lightly and dust with flour a 12 to 14 inch pizza pan or a 15 x 10 jelly roll pan. Combine flour oregano pepper eggs and milk. Mix until smooth. Pour batter in pan. Tilt pan so batter covers bottom. Arrange meat any other toppings you wish to have and bake at 350 degrees until crust is golden brown.

title: Magic Chocolate Crackle Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan (or square one); set aside. In medium bowl combine flour with 1/2 cup sugar baking powder and salt. Add egg yolks; mix well. Cut in shortening and 1 ounce chocolate until crumbly. Firmly press into greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: 100% Natural Wheat Germ Bread
instructions: Mix dry yeast sugar and warm water; let stand until bubbly. In bowl mix brown sugar/honey milk salt oil 2 cups flour and wheat germ together. Add yeast mixture to be followed by 2 more cups flour. Beat with spoon until mixed. Put in 2 (1 pound) coffee cans (greased). Let rise until top of cans. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool; remove from cans. Keep refrigerated. Enjoy; best when toasted.

title: Angel Salad
instructions: Reserve some pineapple juice. Add all ingredients except pineapple. Cook and let thicken. Add pineapple (crushed) pecans marshmallows and cherries. Then fold in Cool Whip.

title: Delicious Party Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Sprite together. Place in freezer. When ready to serve pour Sprite over punch mixture. Dilute to taste. Serve slushy. Serves about 50 plus.

title: Snickerdoodle Drops
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. In large bowl beat together butter brown sugar and 3/4 cup granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and mix well. In medium bowl combine flour oats 1 teaspoon cinnamon soda and salt. Add to sugar mixture; mix well.

title: Zucchini Jam
instructions: Boil zucchini 6 minutes or until clear and drain. May have to squeeze. Add sugar lemon juice and pineapple. Boil hard for 6 minutes. Remove form heat and add jello.

title: Baked Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken thoroughly; dry with paper towel. Place chicken in baking dish. Pour barbecue sauce over chicken. Spread evenly. Sprinkle onion and celery over top of barbecue sauce; salt and pepper to taste. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Baked French Toast
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Combine eggs sugar milk cream butter vanilla and nutmeg; blend well. Pour mixture over bread slices turning until saturated. Arrange into lightly greased 4-quart dish. Pour excess over bread. Bake uncovered 30 to 45 minutes. Serve with warm syrup or fruit preserves. Serves 10.

title: Pull Later Taffy
instructions: Butter sides of heavy 2-quart pan. Mix sugar syrup water and salt. Add butter; cook over medium heat until it boils and sugar dissolves (stir constantly). Attach candy thermometer. Cook to 248\u00b0 no stirring. Remove from heat. Stir in extract and coloring. Pour into buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cool. With buttered hands roll into ball. Return to pan. When cold wrap in plastic wrap. Store up to 2 weeks at room temperature.

title: Amish Cheerios Squares
instructions: Butter 9-inch square pan. In a large saucepan blend jello syrup and butter. Heat to boiling over medium heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in Cheerios. Spread mixture in pan and let set about 30 minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Icebox Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk until thick. Mix in Eagle Brand and Cool Whip. In 9 x 13-inch dish layer the cookies 1/2 bananas 1/2 mixture then repeat. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix with 2 eggs and melted margarine (butter may be used). Batter will be thick. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan; top with mixture of remaining 2 eggs cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. If desired coconut and nuts may be added to batter in amount preferred. Cuts into squares or pieces easier when warm.

title: Cheese Pineapple Salad
instructions: Top pineapple with cheese. Top with mayonnaise.

title: Pecan Pie Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch). Combine flour sugar margarine and salt. Stir until crumbly (mixture will be dry). Press firmly in pan. Bake until lightly golden brown about 20 minutes. Prepare filling and pour over baked layer. Spread evenly. Bake until filling is set about 20 minutes. Cool and cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Makes 70 squares.

title: Oven Onion Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In a large plastic bag mix all ingredients. Close bag and shake until all potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into a greased shallow baking dish. Bake stirring occasionally approximately 40 minutes until potatoes are tender. Potatoes will stick if not stirred.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: In a pan over medium heat melt the chocolate chips butter or margarine and the peanut butter. Pour the box of cereal in a large bowl or dishpan. Pour the chocolate mixture over the cereal. Mix well to coat the cereal. Put the powdered sugar in a doubled grocery sack. Dump in the cereal. Shake well to coat. Store any leftover in an airtight container.

title: Carol'S Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion salt and pepper. Add garlic powder oregano tomato paste and hot water. Simmer. Layer cottage cheese sauce cooked lasagna noodles and Mozzarella cheese.

title: Sausage Souffle For Breakfast
instructions: Slightly butter a cake pan. Break bread into small pieces. Layer in the cheese on top of bread. Boil sausage then in a frying pan brown sausage. Cut sausage into thirds. Layer over cheese in pan. Beat eggs milk and dry mustard together then pour over ingredients in pan. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix juice. When ready to serve add to your punch bowl. Put one scoop of ice cream into serving glass and add ginger ale. Stir. You can make this up as you need it.

title: Cookies And Cream Ice Cream
instructions: Set ice cream and Cool Whip out to soften. Crush Oreos into very small pieces. Mix together and place in a freezer-safe container. Cover with foil. This is an easy summer treat.

title: Francaise'
instructions: Saute chopped onions and garlic in olive oil. Add Italian spices. Add rest of ingredients. Thicken with cornstarch.

title: Edinberg Squares
instructions: Cream together oil and brown sugar. Add oats and flour. Divide this mixture in half. Press one half of the mixture on the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch square pan. Put in thickened fruit. Sprinkle the rest of the crumble mixture on top of the thickened fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion in frying pan. Add green chilies. Add cans of tomato sauce sour cream seasonings and 1/2 pound of cheese. (Use 1/2 of cheese in meat mixture; set other half aside.) Simmer for 20 minutes over low heat. Take tortillas and cover bottom of 13 x 15-inch pan. Add layer of meat then another layer of tortillas and rest of meat. Take other half of cheese (grated) and put on top of meat mixture. Bake until cheese is melted for about 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Instant Mousse
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Pour into blender. Add all other ingredients and blend at high speed for 5 to 10 seconds. Pour into bowl and refrigerate for 5 minutes or longer.

title: Speedy Baked Beans
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together in ungreased casserole. Crush crackers; mix with melted margarine. Sprinkle over top of pineapple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly around edges and light brown on top. Serve while warm.

title: Scotch-A-Roos
instructions: Heat Karo syrup and sugar until it comes to a boil. Add peanut butter. Take off of burner. Add Rice Krispies. Place in a 9 x 11-inch cake pan.

title: Pasta Salad For A Crowd
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. Combine remaining ingredients and toss with pasta. Chill and serve.

title: Southern Fried Baked Steak
instructions: Pound steak to tenderize; cut into serving size pieces. Season with salt and pepper. Dust with flour. Combine milk and egg; dip meat into egg mixture and back into flour. In a skillet brown meat on both sides in oil. Place onion in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Place meat over onion. Pour broth over all. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover; bake 20 minutes more. Yields 6 servings.

title: Peach-Banana Dessert
instructions: Drain peaches measuring syrup. Add enough water to measure 1 cup. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add liquid. Pour into individual dessert dishes; add peaches and bananas. Chill until set. Makes 4 cups or 8 servings.

title: Pecan Pie Mini Muffins
instructions: Combine brown sugar flour and pecans. Add remaining ingredients. Lightly spray mini-muffin pan with cooking spray and fill 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. If using a dark pan bake at 325\u00b0.

title: Cherry Pie Mix Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except pie filling. Spread 3/4 of batter in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour on pie filling. Drop remaining batter on pie filling. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. While warm drizzle with powdered sugar frosting.

title: Durgin Park Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In large bowl beat the sugar and eggs until light. Stir together salt flour cornmeal and baking powder. Add to bowl along with butter and milk. Beat together quickly. Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Fold in a 2 pound bag frozen hash browns. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Peach Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar add the eggs one at a time and continue to cream mixture. Add almond extract. Mix in flour and baking powder. Turn mixture into greased and floured 9-inch spring-form pan or equivalent. Arrange peach slices on dough. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and brown sugar. Serve with fruits.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Put salmon 1/4 cup water and remaining ingredients into a bowl. Mix to blend. Spray loaf pan with cooking spray. Place mixture in pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes until golden. Let cool 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Crazy Salad
instructions: In a large bowl stir dry gelatin into cottage cheese and mix well. Add drained pineapple and whipped topping. Fold until all ingredients are mixed. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving time. Can be served as a salad on lettuce or as a dessert topped with some reserved whipped topping and a cherry.

title: Grandma Libey'S Banana Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs soda and baking powder. Alternately add flour and milk to mixture. Next stir in bananas and vanilla; beat well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Ice with caramel icing.

title: Deep-Fried Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms and trim stems slightly. Remove stems from mushrooms; set caps aside. Finely chop stems. In small saucepan combine chopped stems 1 tablespoon butter onion parsley flakes chives Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Cook and stir over medium heat until mushrooms are tender. Remove from heat. Stir in 2 tablespoons bread crumbs. Fill caps with stuffing mixture packing firmly and mounding mixture slightly.

title: Mic Crighton'S Freezer Corn
instructions: Mix together in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Stir then bake for 10 minutes. Cool and bag for freezer.

title: Paula'S Favorite Reese'S Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening or butter or margarine sugar brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy in large mixer bowl. Add eggs; beat well. Combine flour and baking soda; blend into creamed mixture. Stir in peanut butter chips and chocolate chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool slightly before removing from cookie sheet. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients in saucepan. If colored play dough is desired add color to water before mixing. If scented play dough is desired use peppermint extract. Heat over medium heat stirring until mixture comes away from side of pan. Let cool and have children knead until smooth. Add a little more flour while kneading if it is sticky. Store in airtight container. Yields 2 cups.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Debone chicken. Place cooked and drained spaghetti in a baking dish. Layer deboned and chopped chicken on spaghetti. Mix chicken soup and mushroom soup together and layer on top of chicken. Pour Ro-Tel tomatoes on top. Sprinkle with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Yum Yum
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and form dough. Press into bottom of lasagna dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly golden. Mix together cream cheese Cool Whip and confectioners sugar and spread on cooled crust. Mix pudding and milk together and pour over. Top with Cool Whip spreading evenly. Refrigerate until served.

title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Apple Cheesecake
instructions: Mix flour butter 1/3 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla together in food processor. Press dough into 10-inch spring-form pan making sure it goes up the sides. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes; cool. While cooling mix cream cheese eggs 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla together. Spread on cooled crust. Pare and slice apples thin. Toss with remaining sugar vanilla cinnamon and walnuts. Arrange topping attractively on top of filling. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool on rack 4 to 6 hours. Best served at room temperature.

title: Sundae Brownie Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Prick bottom and sides of pie crust with fork. Bake crust 10 minutes; remove from oven. Meanwhile in large bowl beat eggs; stir in sugar and butter. Stir together flour cocoa and salt; add to butter mixture. Stir in vanilla chocolate chips peanut butter chips and nuts. Pour into pie crust; return to oven. Bake an additional 25 to 30 minutes or until almost set. (Pie will not test done in center.) Serve warm or cool with ice cream; drizzle with topping. Garnish with a Hersheys Kiss.

title: Chops And Potatoes
instructions: Arrange sliced potatoes in greased dish or pan. Dot with butter. Arrange chops over potatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour milk over all.

title: Caramel Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare cake mix as directed. Pour 2 cups batter into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake only 15 minutes.

title: Christmas Dough Ornaments
instructions: Add water until thick (like cookie dough). Knead until you get all bubbles out. Bake at 325\u00b0 until brown (maybe 1 hour or so). Decorate.

title: Ginger Beef
instructions: In chopping bowl combine onions garlic turmeric chili peppers ginger and salt; chop fine. Add flank steak slices or strips and toss together. Let stand to season; refrigerate from 15 minutes to 3 hours depending on your schedule. Then in a Dutch oven heat oil. Add flank steak and onion mixture; brown lightly. Add tomatoes then cook uncovered over high heat for 10 minutes. Add soup; cover and simmer 1 hour if steak is sliced or 1 1/2 to 2 hours if its in strips or until steak is tender.

title: Hibiscus Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift dry ingredients and mix. Combine egg whites yolks orange zest and orange juice. Add to dry mixture. Set aside for 20 to 30 minutes. Lightly grease a baking sheet and mark 5-inch circles on the surface. Drop a spoonful of batter in each circle. Spread evenly to cover the area. Prepare and bake only one sheet at a time. Bake until the edges are a light brown but the center is soft (5 to 6 minutes). Quickly remove cookies from the pan with a spatula. Mold cookies around orange to create cupped shapes. Once shaped cool on rack. Fill with fresh fruit ice cream or pudding.

title: Chocolate Snack Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour brown sugar cocoa baking soda and salt with fork in ungreased square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean 35 to 40 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Yam Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all the ingredients. Divide into greased bread pans and bake 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Quick Picante Sauce
instructions: Remove seeds and veins from peppers. Place peppers onions and stewed tomatoes in food processor and chop to desired consistency. In large container combine tomato mixture and Italian dressing. Serve with chips or crackers.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Add buttermilk. Fold in beaten egg whites. Fill one 9 in. unbaked pie crust and bake at 325 degrees for one hour.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Chill. Will keep for several weeks. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Fish Stew
instructions: Dice fatback and fry until crisp. Dice onions and cook in fatback grease until brown. Prepare this over medium heat. Add soup water ketchup Texas Pete butter Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Simmer for 1 hour. Add fillet of flounder and allow to cook about 15 minutes or until done. Serves 20 to 25 people.

title: Cabbage, Meat And Rice Casserole
instructions: Place cabbage in a greased 2-quart casserole dish; sprinkle rice on top. Crumble ground beef over top. Mix remaining ingredients in saucepan; heat to boiling. Pour mixture over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Place the pastry in a baking dish. Brown meat and drain well. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Place in prepared crust.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Next place Veg-All. Mix chicken soup and broth together. Pour over chicken and vegetables. Mix flour milk and margarine together. Spoon over chicken mixture in dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Clean broccoli remove stems and cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Steam in 1/2 cup water until tender; do not drain. Set aside. If using frozen broccoli not necessary to thaw. Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat. Add flour; cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Add chicken stock; stir and bring to a boil. Turn heat to low. Add half and half cheese and broccoli. Heat until cheese melts. Do not boil.

title: California Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle onion soup over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle rice evenly in pan. Lay chicken on top of rice. Dilute soup with water or broth. Pour over chicken. Dot with butter and bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown onions with ground beef. Add the rest of the ingredients. Cook on high for 20 minutes then on low for 10 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Hash
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes. Cut as for French fries. Put in stewer; cover with water. Add salt and dust of pepper. Cook on medium heat until tender. Add corned beef and ground sage. Serves 4.

title: Waterfront Cooler
instructions: Pour ingredients into a tall glass stir well and serve over ice.

title: Company Cauliflower
instructions: In shallow pan toast sesame seed 10 minutes or until browned shaking pan occasionally. Rinse cauliflower and separate into small flowerets. Cook in a 2-quart covered saucepan in 1-inch boiling salted water for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender; drain well. Place half of cauliflower in 1-quart casserole; season with salt and pepper.

title: Golden Brown Chive Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Peel potatoes and place in a bowl of cold water until ready to use. Dry thoroughly and cut a thin slice off the long side of each potato so it can sit flat. Cut vertical slits from the top almost to the bottom of each potato being careful not to cut through it. Dip the cut potatoes in melted butter and sprinkle with salt.

title: Pecan Pies
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and margarine. Beat eggs; pour and mix with sugar mixture. Stir in pecans. Pour in pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Waffles
instructions: Stir together dry ingredients with whisk or fork. Separate the eggs and blend the yolks well with milk and canola oil. Lightly blend dry ingredients with the liquid ingredients until there are no lumps. Beat egg whites until they peak and fold them into batter. Bake in greased waffle iron until golden brown. Serves 6.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Mix egg yolks and milk then add dry ingredients. Cook in double boiler until thickened. Add vanilla and butter. Allow to cool then pour in crust. Beat egg whites; pour on pie and brown at 350\u00b0.

title: Pear Bread
instructions: Beat oil sugar and eggs until blended. Add sour cream and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients to wet; mix stir and blend until smooth. Add nuts and pears. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 1 hour.

title: Rotel Soup
instructions: Cook meat in pan of water (about 3 cups); salt and pepper. Cook meat until done. Add remaining ingredients except spaghetti. Add spaghetti about 1/2 hour before turning off soup. Cook soup for 1 to 2 hours on low.

title: Italian Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Coat chicken breasts in Frying Magic. In large skillet heat oil and cook chicken about 7 minutes on each side or until browned. Remove from skillet and onto plate. Steam broccoli spears and when done add broccoli and garlic to same skillet. Saute for 5 minutes. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish lay out broccoli spears. Place chicken breasts on top of spears and cheese slices on chicken. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Delicious. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan in 325\u00b0 oven as it heats. Remove pan from oven and add crumbs. Stir into butter. Pat out into even layer. Sprinkle chips coconut and nuts in evenly. Carefully drizzle milk over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes until golden brown and when partially cool cut into squares.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine mayonnaise ginger and salt. Stir in chicken grapes celery green onions and walnuts. Cover; chill. Makes 5 1/2 cups.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Mix Bisquick with the milk. Spread into greased pie pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Rainbow Cookies
instructions: Cream the margarine white sugar brown sugar eggs and vanilla in a large bowl. Blend in flour baking soda and salt.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake(Crock-Pot)
instructions: Beat egg whites to stiff peaks. Beat yolks until thick and lemon colored. Add lemon peel juice butter and milk. Combine dry ingredients and add to milk mixture; beat until smooth. Fold in egg whites. Spoon into slow cooker and cover. Cook on high 2 to 3 hours.

title: Awesome Caramel Brownies
instructions: Grease 9 x 13 pan. Combine cake mix butter 1/3 cup evaporated milk and pecans. Stir until batter forms. Press 1/2 of the batter into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Quick Sugar Cookies
instructions: Lightly grease cookie sheets or spray with Pam. Dip by teaspoon and roll in ball then press with fork or roll in ball the size you want cookie to be and press with top of Pam can dipped in sugar. You can also drop cookie from teaspoon. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar butter and flour. Add slightly beaten eggs Karo and vanilla. Pour into unbaked shell and bake at 350\u00b0 until set and brown.

title: Peggy'S Brie
instructions: Mix butter and sugar. Place on top of Brie and sprinkle with walnuts. Bake in oven or microwave until Brie is soft. Serve with crackers.

title: Spicy Apple Twists
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Cut each apple into eight pieces. Unroll crescent rolls and separate into 8 triangles. Cut each in half to make 16 triangles. Place on apple piece at wide end and roll up. Arrange in 9-inch square pan. Drizzle with butter; sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Pour orange juice or water into pan but not over dumplings. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until apples are tender. Serve warm plain or with cream.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Beat the first two ingredients together until fluffy. Add the peanut butter and milk. Fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into the pie shells.

title: S-Shaped Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar with eggs. Make well and put in flour baking powder salt vanilla and butter. Make balls and shape into s-shapes. Bake at 350\u00b0 on greased pan 15 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in shallow baking dish. Mix sugar flour milk and baking powder. Pour flour mixture over margarine. Pour peaches on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Raisin Pecan Tarts
instructions: Cream butter and cheese. Add flour; ball and divide into three parts. Place in refrigerator for one hour.

title: Fruit Slush
instructions: Combine sugar and 3 cups water; bring to a boil. Let cool. Add the rest of the ingredients and freeze. Take out 2 hours before serving.

title: Great Grandma'S Potato Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl. Stir in all ingredients except flour. Then add 5 cups flour. Beat thoroughly. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic (about 10 minutes). Put in a greased bowl turn greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place until double about 1 hour. Punch dough down and divide into loaves or rolls. Place in 2 to 3 greased loaf pans (or grease 1 cookie sheet for rolls). Let rise until double about 1 hour. Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Bake about 30 minutes. Remove from pans. Brush tops with butter. Yields 2 to 3 loaves.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs and 1 stick margarine. Put in bottom of 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 just a few minutes. Next mix filling of 2 soft sticks margarine eggs confectioners sugar and vanilla. Beat about 20 minutes with mixer. Stir in 1 cup crushed pecans. Spread on crumbs. Next layer bananas. Next layer well drained pineapple then spread Cool Whip on top and sprinkle a few nuts over Cool Whip. Chill for 24 hours. Decorate with cherries if desired.

title: Jansson'S Temptation(Swedish Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Keep potato strip in cold water to prevent discoloration. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet and add onions. Cook until soft but not brown about 5 minutes. Pat potatoes dry. Arrange layers of potatoes onions and anchovies in greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart baking dish. Begin and end with potatoes. Dot casserole with butter and sprinkle with pepper and bread crumbs. Pour cream around the casserole. Bake in the center of the oven until the potatoes are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed about 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Frozen Dessert
instructions: Mix well and freeze.

title: Sweet Potatoes With Caramel
instructions: Cook the ingredients until makes syrup. Put potatoes in dish; sprinkle with pecans. Pour syrup mixture over all.

title: Banana Cherry Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs; add bananas then flour and baking soda. Stir in cherries and nuts by hand. Pour in 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Combine with broccoli cheese bacon and onion. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Strawberry Glaze
instructions: Cook over low heat until thick and clear (10 minutes). Color with red food coloring. Add sliced strawberries when cool. Pour on cake.

title: Tennessee Baked Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Remove and drain. Saute onion in bacon grease until translucent. Add beans brown sugar chili sauce and bacon. Stir. Pour in casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix well. Pour over vegetables and chill. Drain to serve.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Thoroughly mix together all ingredients. Serve on a lettuce leaf with crackers or use as a sandwich filling.

title: Hot Roll Mix
instructions: Put warm water into a bowl; add egg salt Crisco and sugar and dissolve well. Make sure mixture is warm. Add yeast that has been dissolved in the warm water for about 3 minutes. Add flour a small amount at a time; mix well. Let set 5 minutes. Put on floured board or table on wax paper and knead. Make into rolls; let rise about 25 to 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until done. Brush with melted butter.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown ground sausage and hamburger meat together; add onion to the meat while cooking. Drain. Melt Velveeta cheese in a crock-pot. Add the remaining ingredients and the cooked meat to the melted cheese. Mix well. Serve hot.

title: Kielbasa, Onion And Potato Scallop
instructions: In a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish mix potatoes sauce mix boiling water butter and milk. Stir in onions; place sausage on top. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven 30 to 35 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender. Let stand 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Easy Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Break angel food cake into bite-size pieces. Slice strawberries. Using a clear glass bowl layer cake strawberries and Cool Whip. The last layer should be Cool Whip.

title: Baked Apple
instructions: Bring sugar water cinnamon and butter to a boil. Peel and core apples. Pour sugar and cinnamon mixture in center. Dot with butter. Wrap each apple in pie crust dough. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 40 minutes. Pour remainder of mixture over and around apples during last 10 minutes of baking.

title: Granny'S Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Pour boiling water over shortening sugar and salt; stir to dissolve. Cool and combine with yeast. Stir in eggs. Gradually add 4 cups flour beating well. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Work in remaining 2 to 4 cups flour to make a very soft dough. Cover and refrigerate overnight. May be kept in refrigerator as long as a week; use as needed. Form into rolls; brush with melted margarine. Place on greased cookie sheet. Let rise 45 minutes or until light. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until browned.

title: Cubed Steak - Tender Every Time
instructions: Roll steak in flour; place in oil and fry on high until brown on one side. Turn steak reduce heat to simmer. Add water cover and let simmer 20 to 30 minutes depending on thickness of steak. Serve with a generous portion of love. It makes the heart tender every time.

title: Party Delight
instructions: Place cream cheese in medium bowl. Gradually mix in sour cream. Add flaked crab. Mix well. Shape into ball. Put shredded Cheddar cheese on top. Makes 4 cups.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain and chop the first 3 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients. Place in a shallow dish and cover with 1 cup grated sharp Cheddar cheese and 1 cup grated Muenster cheese. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips or Triskets crackers.

title: Old-Fashioned Pear Relish
instructions: Grind pears onions peppers and celery. Mix with remaining ingredients and boil for 30 minutes. Seal in hot jars. Makes about 6 quarts.

title: Chocolate Pie(This Is Easy And Great!)
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine together. Beat eggs sugar and salt. Add vanilla. Mix with the first mixture. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until straw comes out clean.

title: Mimi'S Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all except soup. Form into 1-inch balls. Place in lightly greased skillet. Brown well on all sides. Remove excess drippings. Pour undiluted mushroom soup over all. Simmer until tender and well done.

title: Dream Pie
instructions: Beat whipped topping mixes 1 cup of the milk and vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer on high speed 6 minutes or until topping thickens and forms peaks. Add remaining milk and pudding mixes; beat on low speed. Beat on high speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Spoon into pastry shell. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Squash And Onions
instructions: Shred squash and onions in a frying pan. Add pepper and salt. Put oil or bacon grease and cornmeal in pan. Cover and stew until almost done. Remove lid to finish until slightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter Potato Candy
instructions: Boil the potato until well done. Peel the potato while it is still hot and mash it rapidly adding the powdered sugar. Stir thoroughly each time sugar is added. Continue to add sugar until the mixture is the consistency of biscuit dough. Spread on wax paper. Roll with rolling pin. Spread on peanut butter to desired thickness. Roll and leave in wax paper until chilled. Slice in pinwheels and serve.

title: Cocktail Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream the cheese butter and paste until fluffy. Add other ingredients. Chill so you can mold. Roll in nuts. Make a day before serving.

title: Juicy Pineapple Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients and stir until just mixed. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Take about 2 handfuls or so of brown sugar and spread around on top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until lightly browned. Remove from oven and prick all over with meat fork and pour sauce all over cake.

title: Layered Pudding Delight
instructions: Line 9-inch square pan with whole graham crackers. Prepare pudding mix. Let stand 5 minutes then fold in the Cool Whip. Spread half the mixture over the graham crackers then add another layer of graham crackers. Top with remaining pudding mixture and crackers. Spread pie filling on top of the last crackers. Chill for 3 hours before serving.

title: Bavarian Festival Cake
instructions: In medium bowl combine flour nuts and butter; mix thoroughly and press into bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Baked Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs cheese oregano pepper and salt; set aside. Lightly saute garlic in 2 tablespoons butter; stir in remaining butter. Dip chicken in garlic butter roll each piece in breadcrumbs mixture and pour on remaining garlic butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine soups bread chicken egg and spices; set aside. In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish melt butter in microwave. Pour 1/2 of butter in a cup; set aside. Pour soup mixture into casserole dish containing 1/2 of butter. Crush crackers into fine crumbs. Add to reserved butter. Mix and sprinkle over soup mixture. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Brownies
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate over low heat. Cool. Blend in sugar peanut butter salt and vanilla. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in flour. Spread in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Lemon Rice
instructions: Combine rice margarine garlic lemon peel pepper and broth in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil; stir once or twice. Lower heat to simmer; cover with tight fitting lid. Cook 15 to 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Stir in parsley. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pour a little oil in bottom of baking dish. Add garlic salt and pepper. Place chicken in dish. Dab with butter then add 1 or 2 cans cream of mushroom soup and dabs of sour cream. Last add can of fried onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Bring sugar and milk to a soft boil stage. Add 1 tablespoon of butter vanilla and peanut butter. Beat until creamy and pour into pan. Cut in 1-inch squares.

title: Dip Dogs
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder salt and cornmeal. Cut in shortening. Add egg and milk and mix well. Dip hot dogs in mixture. Cook in deep fat until brown.

title: Zucchini Caponata
instructions: Heat oil in heavy 2-quart saucepan over medium-high heat. Add onions celery and peppers. Cook and stir 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Add zucchini tomatoes basil salt and pepper. Reduce heat to medium. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are softened stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate 8 to 12 hours or overnight. Serve pita bread.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Soften butter and add sugar and mix well. Add salt flour and nuts. Roll into small balls. Bake at 325\u00b0 and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and diced onion. Drain meat mixture and return to pan. Stir in mushroom soup Ro-Tel and beans. Layer half of the tortillas evenly into 2 lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dishes. Top each with 1/4 of meat mixture and 1/4 cheese. Repeat layers with remaining tortillas meat mixture and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Deviled Chicken Wings
instructions: Stir to moisten rice then mix in the above ingredients; cover and simmer slowly 25-30 minutes. Stir occasionally adding water as needed.

title: Lemon Nut Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add extract. Add flour pecans raisins baking powder and salt. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours in greased Bundt pan.

title: Fay'S Make Ahead Cookie Mix
instructions: In a very large bowl combine salt butter and baking powder using an electric mixer to blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. Do not scoop or sift flour. Add flour into butter mixture. Blend until mixture is like crumbs. Store tightly covered in refrigerator. Keeps up to 4 weeks. Makes 8 cups of mix.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients. Place in large greased rectangular dish. Top with 1 1/2 cups crushed potato chips mixed with 1 cup grated Cheddar cheese and 2/3 cup toasted almonds. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake 25 minutes at 400\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and form into balls of desired size. Cook until brown. Place into dish and cover with brown gravy. Garnish with spaghetti.

title: No Peek Chicken
instructions: Butter a 11 x 16-inch baking dish and sprinkle the rice on the bottom. Lay the chicken pieces skin side up on the rice. Mix soup water and sherry; pour over the chicken. Sprinkle the onion soup mix over all. Cover tightly with aluminum foil making sure edges are sealed. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 375\u00b0. Do not peek or rice will burn.

title: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cut bacon into small pieces and chicken into about 1-inch cubes. Add garlic and oil into hot skillet; cook until chicken is done. Remove from skillet. Reheat pan and add wine so that it picks up flavors from skillet. Slowly add cream scallions cayenne pepper oregano and peas. Mix cornstarch with about 4 ounces water. Add a little at a time until you get a creamy sauce. Add chicken and bacon mixture; heat. Add black pepper to taste. Serve over pasta. Shrimp may be substituted for chicken.

title: Fried Rice With Chicken
instructions: Put butter in skillet. Add rice and brown. Add water and soup mix. Add mushrooms and chicken. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Holiday Chicken And Crab
instructions: Grease bottom of large casserole dish and place layer of artichoke hearts; cover layer with mushrooms finally topping with chicken & crab.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Italian Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain well. While still hot toss with Italian dressing; let stand 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and chill. Makes 12 servings.

title: Jerrie'S Dressing
instructions: Saut onion celery and bell pepper in a stick of butter. Prepare the corn kits. Follow corn kit directions. Mix in corn kits and 1 quart of chicken broth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Dont overcook.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Combine with eggs mayonnaise onion cheese and soup. Place in greased casserole and top with the Ritz crackers. Dot with margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Hot Buttered Rum Mix
instructions: Combine all sugars and spices. Add butter. Beat until fluffy. Add ice cream and stir until blended. Put in container and freeze.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and drain. Pat ground beef in bottom of greased pan. Spread soup over meat and cover with cheese. Top with tater tots. Bake covered for 45 minutes and uncovered for 15 minutes more.

title: Seven-Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add ingredients by layers in order listed. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Let cool in pan then cut into small squares.

title: Artichokes Au Gratin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook artichokes according to package directions; drain. Combine Parmesan cheese dry bread crumbs and paprika; stir in the 1 teaspoon softened margarine or butter. Set aside.

title: Chicken And Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Rub chicken well with salt and pepper. In large skillet in hot butter saute chicken until golden. Add onions garlic parsley wine tomato sauce and basil. Simmer covered about 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Push chicken to one side of skillet. Turn up heat so tomato mixture boils. Add shrimp. Cook uncovered 3 minutes or until just pink. Skim off any fat. Makes 6 servings.

title: Reeses Candy
instructions: Combine butter sugar cracker crumbs and peanut butter; mix thoroughly. Pat into 9 x 13 pan. Melt chips; spread over mixture in pan. Chill. Cut into squares. Note Might want to score squares in chocolate before chilling.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Spread on platter. Layer with shredded lettuce diced tomatoes and shredded Cheddar cheese. Top with black olives if desired. Place taco chips around platter.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Fry pork celery and onions together until brown. Add tomatoes and cheese and simmer until thick. Place cooked drained noodles in buttered baking dish. Add meat mixture. Season and brown in a 375\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients adding shrimp last. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: See'S Fudge
instructions: In double boiler melt butter and chocolate. Stir to blend. Blend in powdered sugar vanilla and eggs; stir until well blended. If desired stir in nuts and/or marshmallows. Pour into 8 inch square pan. Cut into squares when set.

title: Cheddar Cheese Ring
instructions: Combine all and mix well. Lightly grease (Pam or other spray product) a 5 or 6-cup round mold and place mixture into mold. Refrigerate overnight. Place jelly or preserves in center of the mold. Serve with crackers.

title: Shredded Beef Barbecue
instructions: Put beef onion and celery into pot; add water to cover and cook until tender. Cook and shred. Refrigerate broth until fat rises to top. Remove fat; add 3 cups of broth to other ingredients. Simmer mixture uncovered for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours over low heat with the meat.

title: Leftover Green Beans
instructions: Rinse green beans very well. Put some butter in pan then add chopped onion. Let let 3 to 5 minutes then pour beans in and let cook 5 minutes more. Put vinegar in and let simmer slow for 3 more minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
instructions: *This can be adjusted based on personal taste.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Stir all dry ingredients. Make wells. Before mixing dry ingredients shortening vinegar and vanilla pour hot coffee over and mix. Add 5 eggs last. Use 1/4 of recipe for 3 dozen cupcakes.

title: Ho Ho Cake
instructions: Mix as directed on pan and bake in 9 x 13 inch pan until done. Let cool before adding toppings.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour in crusts and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Pink lemonade or limeade may be used instead of lemonade.

title: Low Calorie Angel Cookies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients according to package directions. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet covered with foil or sprayed with nonstick spray. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove cookies from sheet while still warm. Makes 36 cookies. One cookie contains 89 calories (27 calories from fat).

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Cut potatoes as small as desired; slice eggs. Put in casserole add celery and onions. Cook bacon slowly until lightly brown or crisp. Add bacon to potatoes.

title: Mother'S Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Mix ingredients well; boil for 1 minute or until thick. Remove and beat until thick enough to spread.

title: Kentucky Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder baking soda salt and sugar in a mixing bowl. Cut in butter or shortening with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add buttermilk. Mix quickly to make soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead a few times to make a soft dough (dont overknead or biscuits will turn hard and dry). Roll out to a 6 x 6-inch square. Place on ungreased baking sheet. With knife cut dough into 12 even portions. Do not separate. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden about 15 minutes. Dust with flour if desired when biscuits come out of oven. Serve piping hot with butter jam and/or honey.

title: Italian Pasta Salad
instructions: Break spaghetti in half. Cook spaghetti drain rinse with cold water and toss with a small amount of vegetable oil. Cook zucchini and green beans in a little water until just tender but still crisp and bright in color. Rinse in cold water; drain and add to spaghetti along with onions olives tomatoes salt and cheese. Beat together last 5 ingredients until well blended. Toss lightly with spaghetti mixture. Refrigerate overnight in a sealed 2-quart container.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix fruit. Add Eagle Brand milk. Fold in whipped topping and serve.

title: Corn Flake Candy
instructions: Boil together the sugar syrup and cream until forms a soft ball. Remove from fire. Add vanilla. Pour over dry ingredients; mix well. Pour into buttered dish or pan; cut into squares.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese and blend with sour cream until smooth and creamy (1/2 package dry taco seasoning may also be added). Refrigerate until firm in 9 or 10-inch pan. Spread taco sauce over cheese and sour cream mixture. Top with green chilies lettuce tomato and shredded cheese. Serve with taco chips.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Mix flour and sugar. Mix and boil butter cocoa and cola; pour over flour and sugar. Add soda vanilla eggs buttermilk and marshmallows. Bake in greased sheet pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Buddy Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat peanut butter until smooth. Add sugar eggs and vanilla to the flour salt and chocolate chips. Bake until done 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Cut asparagus spears into small pieces. Place layer of asparagus in bottom of Pyrex dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Place layer of hard-boiled eggs and cover with sauce or soup. Repeat making 2 or 3 layers. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 or 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown and crisp. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spread croutons in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cook sausage stirring to crumble; drain. Sprinkle sausage over croutons. Combine eggs milk soup mushrooms and mustard. Mix well. Pour over sausage. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix bread eggs and onion. Put in covered bowl in refrigerator overnight. Next day mix celery crab meat and mayonnaise. Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Pork Chops O'Brien(Ready To Bake In 15 Minutes)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet heat oil. Brown pork chops on both sides. Drain. Sprinkle chops with seasoning; set aside. In large bowl combine soup milk sour cream pepper and seasoned salt. Stir in potatoes 1/2 cup of cheese and 1/2 of onions. Spray 9 x 13-inch dish with Pam. Spoon mixture into dish. Arrange pork chops on top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until chops are done. Top chops with rest of cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes more until brown.

title: Potato Almond Balls
instructions: Add egg to mashed potatoes before shaping and coating. Heat melted butter or oleo. Mashed potatoes formed into balls and rolled in toasted almonds are a real treat. Make balls about 1 1/2-inches in circumference.

title: Pape'S Potatoes
instructions: Microwave potatoes until soft. Place on broiling rack and put butter over potatoes. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) about 15 minutes until brown.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain and save juice from pineapple and oranges. Add 2 cups juice to the 2 boxes of pudding. Mix and cook until thick and it bubbles. Cool then add all the fruit. Mix well. Top with cherries. Chill.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Jam
instructions: Cook rhubarb and water until tender on medium heat. Add sugar; bring to a boil stirring constantly. Mix in pie filling. Cook 6 to 8 minutes more. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Put in containers and freeze. Keep refrigerated after thawing. Makes 4 1/2 pints.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese on plate and layer remaining ingredients in order shown above. Serve with crackers.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Cook carrots in 1/2 cup water; boil for 5 minutes. Combine with cauliflower broccoli green peppers and mushrooms. Combine mustard vinegar salt and pepper. Gradually add oil; stir briskly to blend. Pour over vegetables and toss to coat. Chill thoroughly.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Sift flour soda baking powder cinnamon cloves and nutmeg and add alternately with water. Mix in can of soup with nuts and raisins. Bake 45 minutes or 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Use your own favorite caramel icing or sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Cranberry Orange Muffins
instructions: Spray muffin tins with nonstick spray coating. In a bowl stir together flour 2 tablespoons of the sugar baking powder and salt. Make a well in center. In small bowl combine egg orange juice and oil and add all at once to flour mixture. Stir until moist; it will be lumpy. Toss cranberries with 2 tablespoons sugar and stir into mixture. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full and sprinkle sugar on top. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven 18 to 20 minutes or until golden. Remove from tins. Makes 12.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until light brown. Serve hot. Yields 150 servings.

title: Mexican Special
instructions: Mix beans and taco seasoning. Spread on large tray. Mix cream cheese with sour cream and spread on top of bean mixture. Layer remaining ingredients with cheese on top. Pour picante sauce over top. Refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Put the sugar and pineapple juice on stove and let it come to a boil. Add 1 package lemon Jell-O and cream cheese. Mix and let cool until it starts to congeal. Add the rest of the ingredients. Place in the refrigerator until it congeals.

title: Earth Apple Soup(Swiss Potato Soup)
instructions: Dice and cook potatoes and spices. Bring to a boil and simmer until very tender then mash.

title: Aunt Betty'S Spare Ribs
instructions: Pour all the above (after mixing together) over about 3 lbs. spare ribs and marinate about 4 hours. Bake spare ribs with marinade about 2 hours at 325 degrees basting occasionally.

title: Cinnamon Sugared Nuts
instructions: Combine sugar cinnamon salt and milk in saucepan. Stir while cooking to soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts stirring until creamy. Turn out quickly onto waxed paper and separate.

title: Sour Cream Sugared Pecans
instructions: In a heavy medium saucepan mix sour cream sugar and salt. Heat to 225\u00b0 on candy thermometer stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir rapidly until mixture has coated nuts and sugared. Spread on tray separate nuts and cool. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Chicken Paprika
instructions: Shake chicken in bag with flour 1 teaspoon salt and pepper. Reserve 2 tablespoons of flour. Brown chicken in butter. Pour pan fat into measuring cup. Return 3 tablespoons to skillet. Saute onion in fat about 10 minutes. Add paprika remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt and chicken broth; bring to boil. Lower heat. Return chicken. Cook covered 30 minutes or until tender. Remove chicken. Stir in light cream. Make paste of reserved 2 tablespoons flour and sour cream. Stir slowly into skillet. Cook stirring constantly over low heat until thickened. Do not boil. Return chicken. Serve over dumplings.

title: Coconut-Orange Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix milk egg whites and orange concentrate. Beat 4 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer. Fold in the 1/2 cup coconut. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch layer pans. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes; cool. Frost and fill with Fluffy White Frosting.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in margarine. Combine all ingredients. Place in casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until liquid is absorbed.

title: Chocolate Chip Pancakes
instructions: Mix in medium bowl milk egg and sugar until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips. Heat in a heavy skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Grease lightly. Using about 1/4 cup batter for each pancake pour batter into skillet in shape of heart and cook until bubbles appear on surface and edges are dry.

title: Chicken `65'
instructions: Mix chicken with the next 8 ingredients. Marinate for 3 hours. Then deep-fry the chicken pieces. Reserve the marinade.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Mix together last 5 ingredients. Dice bacon and fry. Leave 2 tablespoons drippings. Brown hamburger and onions. Add all beans bacon bits and other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or simmer on stove if desired.

title: Sauce For Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Saute onion in olive oil with garlic. Add tomatoes and sugar and cook 25 minutes. Turn off and add sugar and spices.

title: Lemon Snow Bars
instructions: Stir together flour and powdered sugar. Cut in butter until mixture clings together. Put mixture into bottom of 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: French Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Crumble wafers into fine crumbs. Put half the crumbs in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Rum Glazed Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour until tender. Let cool. Peel and cut diagonally into 1/4-inch slices. Arrange potatoes and apples in buttered 14-inch gratin dish and sprinkle the mixture with chestnuts. In stainless steel or enameled saucepan combine the butter brown sugar honey rum cinnamon ginger and mace; cook the mixture over moderate heat stirring until the brown sugar is dissolved. Spoon the syrup over the potatoes apples and chestnuts mixture and bake in hot 400\u00b0 oven basting occasionally for approximately 30 minutes or until apples are tender and potatoes are heated through. Put dish under broiler and brown lightly. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Simplicity
instructions: Sprinkle dry onion soup mix and uncooked rice over bottom of baking dish. Place chicken on rice. Combine soup and water. Pour over the chicken and rice. Sprinkle salt pepper and paprika on. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Do not open while baking.

title: Green Salad
instructions: Simmer meat and beans 10 minutes until meat is a gray color. Cool mixture and add tomatoes onion and cheese. Tear lettuce in bite size pieces. Toss with meat mixture and chill for 1 hour. When ready to serve toss with salad dressing and crumble Doritos on top.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Blend milk eggs and Bisquick together in blender then stir in ham broccoli and cheese (may add chopped onions if desired). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: In a large skillet cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: No Peek Oven Stew
instructions: In layers place all ingredients in order given into big roasting pan with cover (or use aluminum foil). Bake at 275\u00b0 for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Do not open oven door until done. Do not mix. Very important! Do not peek!!

title: Fried Plantains(Wild Bananas)
instructions: Peel and slice plantains into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place a little vegetable oil in a frying pan and heat on medium flame. Add plantain slices in single layer. Cook until browned on both sides. Serve with butter sugar and cinnamon. Serves 8.

title: Zucchini Squash
instructions: Cook in skillet. Get oil hot and then add the squash. Cook fast and keep stirred. It will brown a little. When cooked the cheese may be added. Add salt and black pepper.

title: Cinnamon Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth. Serve with fruit slices.

title: Impossible Chicken Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease 10-inch pie pan. Sprinkle chicken then mushrooms onions cheese and salt in pie pan. Put remainder of ingredients into blender or food processor. Process 15 seconds until smooth (you may use an electric mixer). Pour blended mixture evenly over cheese in pie pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Chinese Hash
instructions: Brown beef. Mix together all but noodles. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 with lid. Remove lid. Bake 30 minutes more. Add Chinese noodles and bake 15 more minutes no lid.

title: Cooked Pinto Beans For 100
instructions: Cook at 400\u00b0 in large roaster. Cook about 4 hours or until soft.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. While hot stir in 1 pint orange sherbet. Add mandarin oranges crushed pineapple and pineapple tidbits. Stir and chill.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs; cream. Sift all dry ingredients together; add to mixture. Add buttermilk and soda; combine then add jam (your choice blackberry strawberry). Add nuts and raisins. Beat until fluffy. Pour in 3 (9-inch) pans; bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine oil eggs sugar zucchini and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Blend well. Stir in flour soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. (Do not beat.) Stir in nuts. Spoon into 2 well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes and garlic in salt water until tender. Drain well. Add 1/2 stick light butter. Using hand blender mash all above ingredients until smooth. Slowly add skim milk and 2 Tablespoons lite mayo until creamy consistency. Sprinkle parsley before serving.

title: Quick Onion Bread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Place dough in greased pan or cookie sheet and shape into an oblong about an inch thick and 8 to 9 inches long. Brush top with soft butter. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until brown on top.

title: Strawberry Cups
instructions: In largest bowl stir together sugar apricots (quartered with syrup) crushed pineapple (with juice) strawberries (halved) bananas (sliced) and grapes (halved). Spoon into clear plastic cups filling each with juice. Garnish with coconut. Freeze. Thaw 1 hour before serving frozen.

title: Poor Man Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in the water for 5 minutes; then let cool. Cream sugar and Crisco. Add flour baking soda cloves nutmeg and cinnamon. Add raisins and mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in a greased Bundt pan or loaf pan. Any good frosting is good on this cake.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring milk margarine sugar and cocoa to a boil in saucepan. Boil for 30 seconds. Immediately pour over oatmeal that has been combined with vanilla and powdered sugar. Quickly mix together and drop cookies onto wax paper. Makes 3 dozen 2-inch cookies.

title: Date Squares
instructions: Combine dates sugar and water and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Chili
instructions: In chili kettle over medium heat saut beef stirring occasionally until red color disappears. Keep ground beef in small chunks. Pour off fat. Add onions green pepper garlic chili powder oregano basil red pepper and cumin; mix well. Cook stirring until onions and green pepper are tender about 5 minutes. Stir in sugar salt tomatoes tomato sauce and tomato paste. Mix well. Bring to boiling breaking up tomatoes with a fork. Simmer slowly covered stirring occasionally until thick and flavors are blended about 40 minutes. Add beans; simmer covered 10 minutes or until hot. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: Quick And Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add spices sauce and mushrooms. Boil noodles and drain. Layer noodles meat sauce sour cream and cheese twice. Cook at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Layer first 5 ingredients in order listed in a medium casserole dish. Cover and bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with cheese. Let set in oven until cheese melts.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup soup beef bread crumbs onion and egg. Shape into 6 patties. In a 10-inch skillet brown half of the patties on both sides. Set aside. Spoon off fat and repeat with remaining patties. In same skillet combine rest of soup and mushrooms. Heat to boiling and return patties to skillet. Reduce heat. Cover. Cook patties until done or no longer pink.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas and add sugar. Let stand 15 minutes. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Beat eggs. Dissolve soda in 1 tablespoon liquid (juice or water). Add shortening to bananas and sugar. Add dry ingredients soda eggs and nuts. Stir only until mixed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Sour Cream Potato Salad
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Cook; add salt if desired. Cool. Pour salad dressing over potatoes; toss lightly. Put in refrigerator while mixing the mashed eggs mayonnaise sour cream and mustard. Add bacon bits and onion. Fold this mixture in potatoes; sprinkle with paprika. Chill for 10 to 12 hours. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: S & W Bean Soup
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix well together the soup sour cream and poppy seed; add to chicken which has been cut into small pieces. Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Melt the margarine; crumble in the crackers and put over top of chicken mixture. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Festive Bread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Combine buttermilk oil eggs and orange rind; stir well. Add to dry ingredients; beat until smooth. Fold in cranberries dates and walnuts. (Batter will be thick.)

title: Simple Deviled Crabs
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan; add flour. Stir over low heat until smooth. Add milk; cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients (except crumbs). Mix well; pour into greased casserole dish or individual shells. Top with breadcrumbs and dot with butter. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 4.

title: Cool Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate bars in microwave. Watch every 30 seconds until melted. Careful not to burn. Fold in Cool Whip (for fuller mixture use electric mixer or add more Cool Whip). Spread into pie crust and refrigerate.

title: Dip For Vegetables
instructions: Combine all ingredients; blend until smooth.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cake springs back when touched.

title: Apricot Chicken With Rice
instructions: Put uncooked rice in bottom of 10 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix dry onion soup mix apricot preserves and salad dressing. Using half of this mixture stir in 2 1/2 cups water. Pour over rice. Place chicken on top of rice and brush with remaining salad dressing mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients as listed (small pieces). Spread enough mayo to make 1-inch thick on top. Sprinkle top with sugar. Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle on bacon bits. Chill for 8 hours.

title: Ham Biscuits
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Get ready-to-eat biscuits from baker section. Slice biscuits; leave bottom in pan. Spread mixture on biscuits. Put cubed ham on top. Put top of biscuits on. Bake 10 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli onion cheese and bacon in a large serving bowl. In a small bowl mix the mayonnaise sugar and vinegar together. Pour over vegetables. Toss gently but thoroughly to blend. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Banana Frosting
instructions: Mix Crisco salt vanilla and about 1/3 of the sugar. Add more sugar to thicken if frosting is thin. Mix well.

title: Lazy Man'S Holupschi
instructions: Fry ground beef in oil for 1 or 2 min. Add onion salt pepper and rice. Mix well while gently sauteing for 2 or 3 min. Add soup and water. Mix well. Turn cabbage into greased baking dish. Pour mixture over raw cabbage. Do not stir. Bake covered 1 1/2 hrs. at 325\u00b0F.

title: No Peek Stew
instructions: Layer the first 5 ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Combine next 4 dry ingredients and sprinkle over layers. Pour V-8 juice over top. Cover with foil. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours. Dont peek!

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Stir into milk the juice of 2 lemons and 2 egg yolks. Pour into vanilla wafer crumb crust. Beat egg whites until stiff and add vanilla and sugar. Mix and pour over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 just until meringue is browned. Chill in refrigerator 2 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups and rice in bowl. Grease a casserole dish. Pour soup in dish. Place chicken breast on top of soup. Put pat of butter on top of each breast. Cook in 250\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl combine 1/4 of the soup with remaining ingredients except water; mix well. Shape into six patties arrange in a single layer in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Skim off fat. Combine remaining soup and water. Spoon over patties. Return to oven; bake 10 minutes.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix together. Put 1/2 batter in greased and floured tube pan. Mix 2 tablespoons cinnamon and 1/3 cup sugar. Sprinkle 1/2 mixture on batter in pan and swirl. Pour rest of batter in pan. Sprinkle rest of mixture and swirl again. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn oven off and leave in oven for 10 minutes or bake 60 to 70 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Snow White Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk. Bring to rolling boil over medium heat whisking constantly to avoid scorching. Cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add marshmallow cream.
