Stir until smooth. Add nuts and vanilla stir until blended. Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan. Place on wire rack and cool. Cut into squares. Yield 3 pounds.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Place crescent rolls onto a 11 x 17-inch cookie pan. Pat together to make a thin crust all over the pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let cool. Mix the cream cheese sour cream and Ranch dressing. Blend until creamy. Spread over crust. Use food processor or grate veggies very fine. Sprinkle on top of cheese mixture. Refrigerate.

title: Corn Flake Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda salt and baking powder. Cream shortening add sugar gradually and beat until light. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture add corn flakes. Drop small teaspoons on greased baking sheet 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until delicately browned. Makes 8 dozen.

title: Aunt Gen'S Barbecue Pork Chops
instructions: Brown chops. Mix sauce and pour over chops. Cover. Cook for 1 1/2 hours. Last 20 minutes remove cover and turn chops until sauce is absorbed.

title: Apple Crisp Pie
instructions: Peel core and cube apples. Place in shallow rectangular baking dish. Spread with half the sugar. Combine remaining sugar flour salt and pecans. Cut butter into mixture with pastry blender until crumbly. Spread over apples pressing down over and around edges so topping completely covers apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve warm.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir peanuts sugar syrups and salt together in deep bowl. Cook on High 4 minutes. Stir candy so all sugar is mixed and continue cooking on High 3 more minutes. Add butter and vanilla to syrup blending well. Cook on High 1 to 3 minutes. Add soda and stir until light and foamy. Pour immediately onto lightly buttered surface spreading it out. Cool and break into pieces. Store in airtight container. If roasted salted peanuts are used dont salt and add peanuts after first 4 minutes of cooking.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple and sugar; bring to a boil. Remove. Add jello; dissolve then add 2 cups cold water. Put in refrigerator; let set (barely jell). Take out. Add Cool Whip nuts and cheese. Pour into dish; let set until jello sets.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: In large heavy skillet or wok cook chicken onions and mushrooms in oil over high heat stirring constantly for 5 minutes or until mushrooms are golden. Add remaining ingredients and cook 3 minutes longer until heated through and well blended. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: In 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch square pan simmer apples water and sugar in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan; stir in flour salt and pepper and cook until smooth. Add milk and chicken stock. Cook until thick like gravy. Add lemon juice and chicken. Add carrots onions celery and English peas. Place in baking dish.

title: Lace Dosai
instructions: Mix ingredients together and make sure there are no lumps. Heat grill; grease with butter. Pour batter and cook like pancakes. Serve with Coconut Chutney.

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs vanilla and oil. Mix dry ingredients. Mix until well blended.

title: Taffy Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla. Top with nuts and serve with fruit.

title: Babka
instructions: Pour warm water over yeast to dissolve. Meanwhile scald milk and melt butter and sugar in it. When cool add the flour eggs (which have been beaten) yeast salt and lemon extract. Beat well. Put in warm place to raise twice the size. Then put in greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour or until tester comes out clean.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Cranberry Delight
instructions: Grind the cranberries. Cut your oranges real fine (peel). Mix all together. Dissolve your Jell-O in the hot water and pour over the other ingredients. Refrigerate until it sets.

title: Grandma'S Hickory Nut Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs; beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Mix dry ingredients together lightly with fork. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Mix well. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool; frost.

title: Micro Turkey Loaves
instructions: Combine egg bread crumbs onion green pepper milk poultry seasoning and garlic salt. Add turkey; mix well. Shape into 4 loaves. Arrange around edges of 1 3/4-quart casserole dish. Micro covered 7 to 9 minutes until no longer pink. Spoon over loaves barbecue sauce before serving.

title: Fast Lasagne
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and microwave on High for 7 minutes until bubbly.

title: Burritos
instructions: Cook everything except cheese for 18 to 24 hours on low in crock-pot. Tear roast apart in the crock-pot. Add cheese on bottom of tortillas. Add cooked ingredients and wrap. Pour excess gravy juice on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until the cheese melts. Add more cheese on top if desired. Individual unbaked burritos can be wrapped and frozen for later use if desired.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Dissolve baking soda in sour milk. Beat eggs brown sugar and shortening. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Lo-Cal Taco Dip
instructions: Blend sour cream with taco seasoning. Put in a wide bowl. Top with shredded cheese lettuce and tomatoes. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt in mixing bowl. Mix butter cocoa and Coca-Cola; bring to a boil and pour over flour mixture then mix. Add buttermilk soda eggs vanilla and marshmallows; beat. The batter will be thin and the marshmallows will rise to the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan (greased and floured).

title: Potluck Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except cornflakes and 1/2 cup melted margarine. Pour into buttered casserole. Mix together cornflakes and 1/2 cup melted margarine. Sprinkle cornflakes and margarine mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Nestle Quik Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda together. Mix sugar eggs vanilla and oil together. Mix in buttermilk. Mix dry ingredients and milk mixture alternately together. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan lightly greased and floured.

title: Chocolate Caramel Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to package directions. Remove from oven and poke holes in it with a straw.\tPour can of sweetened milk and caramel topping over cake. Let cool. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with Heath or Skor bars.

title: Rhubarb Nutmeg Custard Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix eggs and cream add sugar flour nutmeg and butter. Pour over shell 3/4 full of cut rhubarb. Bake 50 - 60 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Ginger Ale Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water and add ginger ale. Stir. Chill until nearly set. Add other ingredients. Mix. Chill until firm. This recipe can be reduced in calories by using sugar-free jello and diet ginger ale. Also 1/2 package plain gelatin dissolved in a bit of ginger ale and stirred into hot water will make for a firmer salad. If you like a stronger ginger flavor use 2 cups ginger ale and no water.

title: Salmon Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients reserving a small portion of the grated Cheddar cheese on the side. Put mixture into a casserole dish and sprinkle reserved sharp Cheddar on top. Bake in oven for 40 minutes.

title: Breakfast Cereal Cookies
instructions: Cream Butter Buds both sugars Egg Beaters and vanilla with hand mixer until smooth. Add flour cinnamon nutmeg soda and baking powder. Stir in oats Tripletts and Grape-Nuts. Add raisins if desired. Drop by spoonfuls onto a baking sheet that has been sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Mix until soft dough forms. Drop by spoonfuls onto hot meat or vegetables in boiling stew. (Do not drop onto liquid.) Cook over low heat uncovered for 10 minutes. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer. Yields 10 to 12 dumplings.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: Crumble cookies on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Prepare pudding according to directions and pour over cookies. Top with whipped topping. Chill for several hours before serving.

title: Kiss-Kiss Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate over hot water. In a large bowl mix sugar butter and chocolate; add eggs one at a time until well blended. Mix in vanilla. Combine flour baking powder and salt; add gradually to chocolate mixture mixing well after each addition. Cover and chill overnight. Drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls into confectioners sugar coating lightly then shape into a pointed kiss. Place on greased baking sheet 2-inches apart and bake for 12 to 14 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Virginia'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Mix applesauce and jelling agent together. Add remaining ingredients. Boil 1 to 2 minutes. Put in jars; seal.

title: Swedish Cream
instructions: Add all ingredients except berries and heat to boiling (just the first 4 ingredients).

title: Peach Turnovers
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cut in margarine until mixture is crumbly then add milk to make dough soft. Place dough on a cutting board and knead gently 30 seconds. Divide dough in half and roll one half at a time into a rectangle approximately 6 x 8 inches about 1/4 inch thick. Cut each of these into 4 smaller rectangles about 6 x 3 inches. Place slices of peaches on half of each rectangle dot with margarine and sprinkle with sugar. Then fold these over and gently pinch turnover closed. Bake 15 to 18 minutes. Makes 8 turnovers.

title: Mac Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on box. Drain and cool. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill overnight or at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Tuna Fruit Salad
instructions: Mound attractively in lettuce lined bowls. Toss together unpeeled apples cut in 1/2-inch cubes 4 cups torn lettuce tuna (drained and flaked) and grapes. Cover and chill. Combine mayonnaise lemon juice and salt. Toss with tuna mixture. Serves 6.

title: Refrigerator Pickle
instructions: Mix sugar vinegar salt and celery seed and pour over cucumbers and onions. Makes about 2 quarts. Store in refrigerator. Keeps about 2 weeks.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt. Cut Crisco in with 2 knives or pastry blender until like coarse meal. Add milk; mix with fork or hand. Knead on lightly floured board 8 to 10 times. Roll or pat out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake on baking sheet at 425\u00b0 about 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Lover'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour baking soda and salt. Cream butter gradually adding sugars and beating until light and fluffy about 5 minutes. Blend in vanilla egg and sour cream. Gradually add flour mixture beating until smooth. Stir in chips and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Cook ground beef and drain. Mix with rest of ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. When cool frost with Watergate Icing.

title: Cocoa-Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine cocoa sugar salt and milk in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil on stove. When mixture comes to a soft ball remove from stove and add remaining ingredients. Mix and pour onto a greased plate.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: 7-Up Bundt Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and Crisco together. Add eggs and mix well. Add flour and lemon. Fold in 7-Up and mix until you have a smooth batter. (Hint When measuring 7-Up try to pour it really easy without making too much fizz. Also when pouring into mixture make sure you pour very easy and fold gently.) Pour mixture into well greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: In resealable plastic bag or large bowl combine all vegetables. Toss well. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients. Blend well. (Can mix dressing in a jar and shake vigorously to blend.) Pour dressing over vegetables. Toss to coat. Refrigerate at least one hour to allow flavors to blend.

title: Potato Cheese Casserole
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes and onion. Put in pan with 1/2 cup water. Add butter and salt. Boil until tender. Do not drain. Add cheese stir until cheese melts add sour cream. Put in greased casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 until browned on top.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients for sauce. Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan the broccoli which has been partially thawed chicken and sauce. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken water chestnuts celery mayonnaise onion and mushroom soup. Mix and spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Pepperidge Farm herbed stuffing mix that has been combined with melted butter. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook all ingredients together. Season to taste. Add 1 1/2 cups rice (raw). Stir until well coated. Add 5 bouillon cubes dissolved in 4 cups hot water. Boil for 5 minutes. Then cover and simmer 1 hour or until done.

title: Microwave Beets
instructions: Wash fresh beets well and remove stem and root ends. Place beets in a 2-quart microwave dish with water to cover. Cover dish with plastic wrap. Cook for 30 to 35 minutes on full power. When beets can be easily pierced with a sharp knife drain and peel off skins. Serve whole or diced. Serves 4.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Sift flour baking soda and salt. Cream margarine sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in bananas. Grease and lightly flour bread pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Do Ahead Brunch Eggs
instructions: *May substitute margarine for butter evaporated skim milk for evaporated milk and 2 egg whites for each whole egg.

title: Stove Top Potato Salad
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy. Remove bacon from pan. Saute onion until golden brown. Add sugar flour vinegar and water slowly until thick. Pour over drained potatoes. Crumble bacon and add to potato salad. Salt and pepper to taste. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Microwave Applesauce
instructions: Combine water and apples in microwave dish. Cover and cook 10 to 12 minutes. Add sugar and cinnamon.

title: Guacamole(Avocado Dip)
instructions: Peel and mash the avocados. Mix well with all the other ingredients. Pile into a serving dish with an avocado pit in the center. This is supposed to keep the guacamole from turning dark. Makes about 2 or 3 cups. Serve with fried tortilla triangles.

title: Spiced Green Tomatoes
instructions: Wash tomatoes but do not peel. If small tomatoes are used prick them slightly. Combine sugar vinegar and spices. Bring mixture to a boil. Pour mixture over tomatoes. Let stand 6 hours or overnight. Drain and cook fluid until it coats a spoon. Add tomatoes and cook until clear. Put into canning jars and seal. This can also be done with plums pears or peaches.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Stir together dry ingredients and chips last. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet for 7 to 8 minutes. Do not overbake. Leave on cookie sheet until cold.

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1/3-inch slices. Mix water eggs and salt. Dip eggplant in flour then in eggs then in bread crumbs. Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in large skillet over moderate heat. Cook eggplant until lightly browned on both sides. Add remaining olive oil as needed. Drain on paper towels.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Roll into balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Have cheeses at room temperature. Mix all ingredients until smoothly blended. If too soft refrigerate until semi-firm. Form a ball on cheese plate or tray using spoon and/or knife to create symmetrical shape. You may decorate with parsley flakes or chopped pecans.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream brown sugar Karo shortening and eggs and blend well. Add soda baking powder salt vanilla nutmeg and cinnamon. Add milk and flour until well blended.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease baking sheet. Combine shortening sugar egg milk and vanilla and beat at medium speed until well blended. Combine oats and dry ingredients. Mix into creamed mixture. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Mama Ann'S Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish in 325\u00b0 oven. Beat well sugar and eggs; stir milk in good; stir half at a time. Mix well flour salt peach or cherry pie filling. Take baking dish with melted butter; pour can of fruit and juice all over baking dish. Then take batter and pour slowly all over fruit. Spread over Pyrex dish and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except Durkee onions. Pour into a 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Soup
instructions: Pour chicken broth in a pot; bring to boil then put in hash browns. Cook until tender then add cream of chicken soup. Stir until blended. Cut Velveeta into small blocks and add to soup. Stir until melted. Fry bacon and crumble on top of soup. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Saute the squash in a little vegetable oil over medium heat until it has completely broken down about 15 to 20 minutes. Line a colander with a clean tea towel. Place the cooked squash in the lined colander. Squeeze excess moisture from the squash. Set aside.

title: Monterey Chicken Phyllo Appetizers
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In medium bowl combine chicken cheese onions and parsley flakes; mix well.

title: Cherry Pecan Bread
instructions: Pour off cherry juice and reserve. Quarter cherries. Stir in sugar and butter. Pour in orange cherry juice and water. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients and add a small amount at a time to your mixture. Add chopped nuts. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. Glaze with powdered sugar milk mixture. Decorate with chopped cherries and pecans.

title: Holiday Nuts 'N' Spice Cookies
instructions: Finely chop 1 1/2 cups of nuts. Combine flour chopped nuts and baking powder. Set aside.

title: Green Rice Casserole
instructions: Blend all well and then bake in casserole dish 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until its set.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together cheese 1/2 oleo and vanilla. Alternately beat in sugar and 1/3 cup milk. Blend in chocolate. Remove 2 cups for frosting; cover and refrigerate.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Boil 2 minutes stirring constantly. Cool. Stir in 1 cup powdered sugar or more and 3/4 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Herbed Meat Loaf
instructions: In medium mixing bowl combine egg stuffing mix milk onion soup mix and 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce; add ground beef and mix well. Shape into loaf and put in meat loaf pan. Drizzle 1/4 cup barbecue sauce over meat. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: 5 Hour Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Put all ingredients except buns in large covered kettle. Cook 5 hours at 350\u00b0 stirring every hour. Serve on buns. Serves 16.

title: Apple Surprise
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl. Put in a glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Roasted Pepper Salad
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Place peppers on broiler pan and roast until they turn light brown; keep turning peppers over until brown on all sides. When roasted peel skins off and take out seeds. Cut in strips. Place in dish and sprinkle with salt. Add parsley garlic and vinegar. Stir and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. This gives the peppers and flavoring a change to settle.

title: Cheese Toasties
instructions: Combine cheese mayonnaise milk onion mustard Worcestershire sauce and paprika. Mix well. Toast English muffins until crisp in a toaster. Brown bacon in skillet and drain off fat. Crumble bacon. Spread about 2 tablespoons of cheese mixture on each half slice of muffin. Cut each slice into 4 wedges. Sprinkle on bacon. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Serve hot. Makes 16 Cheese Toasties.

title: 60 Minute Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water and place milk sugar salt and shortening in saucepan and heat until lukewarm. Add yeast and flour. Mix well and cover. Let rise 15 minutes. Shape into rolls with well greased hands. Cover and let rise 15 minutes. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Beat 2 eggs slightly. Add sour cream. Mix. Add corn and Mazola. Mix well. Add to meal. Bake in greased 7 x 11-inch pan at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Check after 20 minutes to see if heat is correct.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
instructions: Mix well. Form into balls. Dip in sugar and press into mint mold. Let dry several hours on waxed paper sprinkled with sugar. Yields 90 or 250 mints.

title: Lemon Curd Tart Filling
instructions: This sauce can be used for French toast thumbprint cookies etc. Enjoy.

title: Sweet N' Sour Sausage Balls
instructions: Make 1-inch sausage balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Garden Vegetable Dish
instructions: Dice all these vegetables together about the same size each according to how much you want to make. Salt lightly; stir together. Pour hot vegetable oil over and let set 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Breast In Wine
instructions: Salt and pepper and slightly brown chicken; put in a casserole. Stir other ingredients in drippings of breast. Bring to a boil and pour over breast. Cover and cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mom'S Pork Dressing
instructions: Boil pork steaks. Pinch toasted bread onion and sage in bowl. Then pour the water off of the steaks over the bread mixture to make it moist. Then put mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake until brown.

title: Daisy'S Pineapple And Cheese Salad
instructions: Beat the egg. Add pineapple juice (about 1/2 cup) lemon juice and dash of salt. Cook over low heat until it starts to bubble. Remove from heat; keep stirring. Pour over other ingredients. Really good!

title: Manicotti
instructions: Brown beef onion and garlic. Cool. Stir in cheese. Stir in crumbs parsley and egg. Season to taste. Cook manicotti shells according to package directions (dont overcook). Stuff shells with meat handling carefully. Spoon 1/2 of spaghetti sauce over bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange shells on top of sauce. Pour remaining sauce over shells. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Heath Bars
instructions: Line cookie sheet with tinfoil place crackers. Melt butter and sugar; cook until boils. Boil 3 minutes. Stir constantly. Pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until dark brown in color. Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle 12 ounce package of milk chocolate chips; let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Spread chocolate then sprinkle with walnuts. Pan size 15 1/4 x 10 1/4-inches.

title: Hot Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine soup and cheese over low heat. Add remaining ingredients to stir until mixture is hot. Use toast points for dipping.

title: Raspberry Mousse
instructions: Dissolve jello in warm cranberry juice. Add cranberry sauce to warm mixture breaking it into small chunks. Chill mixture for about 45 minutes. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Almost! Better Than Money Cake
instructions: Follow cake mix directions; bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While cake is hot use handle of wooden spoon and poke holes every inch or so. Pour the caramel ice cream topping over; let cool. Top with Cool Whip; sprinkle with crushed Heath bars on top.

title: Doyle'S Dilly Of A Fish
instructions: Melt butter and add lemon juice. Thinly slice onion and diced green pepper. Place fish in a buttered glass baking dish. Brush with lemon butter and sprinkle with dill. Spread tomatoes over filets and add pinch of sugar. Spread onion and green pepper next. Pour remainder of lemon butter over top. Sprinkle dill over all. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Rigatoni With Shrimp And Feta Cheese(Serves 8)
instructions: In a kettle cook onion and garlic in oil over medium heat until softened. Add wine and boil mixture for 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes with juice 1 tablespoon parsley basil oregano and salt. Simmer mixture 10 minutes stirring occasionally until reduced and thickened somewhat. Add shrimp and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until shrimp are just firm.

title: Spice Tea
instructions: Mix well and shake. Add 2 teaspoonfuls to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Grape-Pear Chutney
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Cover and refrigerate several hours to blend flavors. Serve with veal turkey or ham.

title: Grape Tapioca
instructions: Add tapioca to boiling water. Boil 15 minutes. Turn off heat and cover 15 minutes. Then add sugar. Last add jello. Add fruit of any flavor; if grape add grapes.

title: Chocolate Walnut Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour sugar salt spice baking soda and baking powder. Add pumpkin oil water and eggs. Beat to blend thoroughly. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Spoon into greased loaf pan. Level top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour until loaf is lightly browned and springy to touch. Cool.

title: Mother'S English Coffee Cookies
instructions: Combine Spry and sugar. Add coffee eggs and raisins. Sift dry ingredients. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Makes a stiff dough. Try a sample cookie. Add a little more flour if needed. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 360\u00b0 until brown.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pecans. Shape into a ball and chill overnight. Roll in pecans before serving.

title: Cranberry Fruit Punch
instructions: Combine cranberry juice cocktail and orange lemon and pineapple juices. Mix well with sugar and water. Pour over ice. Ready to serve.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Sift flour salt baking soda sugar and baking powder. Add coconut chopped nuts oatmeal and brown sugar. Work in butter. Add eggs and vanilla.

title: Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate chips. Mix all ingredients. Drop onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Do not overcook!

title: Jello Surprise
instructions: Prepare Jell-O according to directions. Let set overnight. Just before serving prepare Dream Whip. Stir into Jell-O along with your favorite fruit and the marshmallows. My favorite bananas.

title: Cream Cheese Finger Cookies
instructions: In bowl cream butter and cream cheese. Beat in extract. Combine flour sugar and salt. Gradually add flour mixture and creamed mixture together. Stir in pecans. Shape into 2-inches logs. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes. Roll warm cookies into confectioners sugar. Yield 2 dozen cookies.

title: Impossible Bacon Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8 x 12-inch glass dish. Mix all ingredients and pour into dish. Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Pizza(My Own Recipe)
instructions: Soak yeast in water for 5 minutes. Add salt oregano oil and cheese. Stir to mix well. Add flour. Stir with fork until dough leaves sides of bowl. Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead until elastic. Cover with warmed pan for 10 minutes.

title: Alfajores(Dedicated To Helen Corley)
instructions: Open the top of the can of milk but leave the lid closed. Place the full can in a water bath; boil gently until the milk caramelizes (about 2 hours). Watch it carefully. Let the caramel cool in the can.

title: Spaghetti With Broccoli
instructions: Peel broccoli stems; cut into 3/4-inch slices. Break flowerets into small pieces. Set aside. In a 10-inch fry pan heat 4 tablespoons oil. Add 1/4 cup parsley and garlic. Cook 1 to 2 minutes without browning. Add tomatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Add all herbs. Lower heat to simmer for 30 minutes partially covered. In a small skillet brown pinenuts in 2 tablespoons oil until it browns. Set aside.

title: Fresh Apple Bread
instructions: Beat oil eggs sugar and buttermilk together. Add spices soda and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour and apples; mix well. Add nuts. Use 2 loaf pans lightly greased and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix sugar eggs oil and vanilla in large bowl. Fold in pineapple zucchini and remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Gourmet Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes in skins; do not cook too soft. Cool; peel and shred coarsely. In saucepan over low heat combine cheese and butter. Stir occasionally until cheese is almost melted. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream onion and seasonings. Fold in potatoes and turn into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a full boil over medium heat. Cook for 5 minutes stirring frequently and watching to make sure candy does not burn. Reduce heat if necessary. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 to 10 minutes. Stir until candy starts to set. Pour into buttered dish. Cool in refrigerator until completely set. Cut into squares.

title: Soft Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix together the shortening butter water and molasses. Sift together the remaining ingredients and add to first mixture. Chill well. Roll out or make into balls and press with glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut cookie dough in 1/2-inch slices. Line pizza pan overlapping slightly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.\tCool.

title: German Cabbage Salad
instructions: Combine cabbage bell pepper and onion. Pour vegetable oil and sugar mixed together over cabbage mixture.

title: Unbaked Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat eggs; add milk. Mix together. Heat in double boiler until thick. Cool. Put filling in pie crust; top with whipped topping.

title: Tallarene
instructions: Brown onion and beef in hot oil. Add soup water salt noodles corn and olives; mix thoroughly. Sprinkle cheese over top. Cover; cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until noodles are tender.

title: Spaghetti Parmesan
instructions: In saucepot prepare spaghetti as label directs; drain. Return spaghetti to saucepot. In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat cook hamburger and onion stirring occasionally until all pan juices evaporate and meat is browned. Add corn tomato sauce water salt pepper sugar and cinnamon; heat through. Toss spaghetti with Parmesan cheese and butter. Arrange spaghetti on warm platter. Spoon meat mixture over spaghetti. Serves 6.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pudding
instructions: Melt oleo. Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven until set (20 to 25 minutes). This can be baked in a crust and topped with Cool Whip.

title: Real Good Bran Muffins
instructions: Soak all bran in milk.\tCream butter brown sugar eggs and salt. Add\tflour\tmolasses and baking soda in hot water. Add all bran mixture and dates or raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes about 40 medium muffins. Dough can be put in icebox a few days to bake later. Muffins can also\tbe frozen.

title: Rhubarb Coffee Cake
instructions: You will need a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Crawfish Or Shrimp Casserole In A Rice Cooker
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl; then transfer into rice cooker. After bell rings wait 10 minutes and then serve.

title: Joe'S Delight
instructions: Dice and boil potatoes. Brown and crumble hamburger meat. Pour 1/2 water off cooked potatoes. Pour in green beans hamburger and soup. Cook until soup is hot.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Sprinkle flattened chicken breasts with salt black and cayenne pepper and parsley flakes. Place 1 slice of dried beef or ham on top of each breast trimming to fit. Roll breasts and place seam side down in buttered casserole dish. Mix soups together and pour over chicken. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Remove breasts to heated platter. Stir sour cream into sauce. To serve pour sauce over chicken and rice or pasta.

title: Health Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except ginger ale) in large container. Just before serving add ice ring of your choice. Pour chilled ginger ale over all. Loaded with vitamins A and C. Makes approximately 100 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven. This can be made and refrigerated until ready to bake.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed for 3 minutes. Gradually add dry ingredients; stir in pumpkin. Grease jelly roll pan. Pour batter into pan. Top with crushed nuts. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Turn out on cloth covered with confectioners sugar. Roll up in cloth (dish towel works well). Let set until cool. Unroll; spread with cream cheese mixture. Roll and chill.

title: Tomatoes Fines Herbes
instructions: Arrange tomato slices in serving dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over tomatoes. Let stand at room temperature at least 1 hour before serving. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage in a medium skillet; cover over medium heat until brown stirring occasionally. Drain well. Line bottom of buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with crescent rolls pressing firmly perforations to seal. Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well and pour over sausage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan-Custard Pie
instructions: *First toast 1 cup of pecans in oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 8 minutes; stir once.

title: French Toast
instructions: Beat eggs slightly in shallow bowl. Add salt and milk. Dip each piece of bread into egg mixture. Melt butter in skillet over low heat. Place slices of egg-coated bread in butter and cook until golden brown turning once. Serve immediately with syrup or lightly dusted with powdered sugar.

title: Cheeseburger And Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: For variation you may add 1 can French-cut green beans and omit cheese.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease bottom of 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Cream butter; gradually add sugar. Beat until fluffy. Blend in eggs and beat well. At low speed add dry ingredients alternately with pumpkin beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Stir in chips and nuts. Pour into greased pan (may sprinkle with 1/4 cup nuts on top). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes until toothpick test; cool. Let stand 6 hours before slicing. Eat rest of the bag of chocolate chips.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine meat egg cracker crumbs onion and the 1/3 cup tomato sauce salt oregano and pepper. Shape into a 10 x 12-inch rectangle on waxed paper. Sprinkle with the cheese. Roll up and press ends to seal. (Seal very carefully.) Place in a shallow pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Pour the 2/3 cup of sauce over the top and bake another 15 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon. Strip bacon across top of beans and bake until desired thickness at 325\u00b0 or until onion is done.

title: Sweet Carrot Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wipe mushroom caps clean. Melt 4 tablespoons oleo; let cool a bit. Use hands and coat caps well with oleo. Put in buttered baking dish. Mix crumbs parsley onion salt pepper and egg together. Fill each cap with mixture. Melt remaining oleo. Sprinkle caps with Parmesan and drizzle with oleo. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4. Very good.

title: Banana Nut Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix the dry ingredients in large bowl. Mix milk bananas egg whites and oil together. Add the dry ingredients to liquid and mix. Line muffin pans with paper baking cups or spray with Pam baking spray. Fill each cup with batter. Bake for 17 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour. Cook until well blended. Add next 5 ingredients. Heat until cheese melts. Beat yolks. Add to cheese mixture. Stir in the crab mixture. Bake in moderate oven until brown.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Add corned beef and heat. Stir in flour and egg. Blend. Add chopped kraut and seasonings. Cook over low heat until thick. Cover and chill overnight. The next day form mixture into small balls. Dip first into flour then into beaten egg and then into fine cracker crumbs. Fry in hot deep fat until golden brown. If desired cook in advance and reheat at serving time 10 to 12 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Beer Bread(Muffins)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in greased muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Cajun Party Mix
instructions: Combine the cereals pretzels and nuts. Pour into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over cereal mixture and stir to coat. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Store in airtight container. Yields 8 cups.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Store in airtight container. Use 2 teaspoons per cup of boiling water. Also a great cold weather drink.

title: Broccoli Cheese Squares
instructions: Over medium heat steam broccoli until partially cooked about 3 minutes. Turn off heat cool and press dry. In large mixing bowl beat eggs and milk until frothy. In separate bowl thoroughly mix flour baking powder and salt. Stir into egg mixture mixing well. Fold in broccoli cheese and onion; spoon into greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish spreading evenly. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes or until lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes and cut into bite-sized pieces. Yield 4 dozen 1 1/4-inch squares.

title: Sumter Salad Dressing(From Barbara'S Downstairs Tea Room)
instructions: Combine ingredients and refrigerate. Serve over spinach salad made of spinach leaves chopped eggs crumbled cooked bacon and sliced fresh mushrooms.

title: Low-Fat Lasagna
instructions: In saucepan brown both meats and drain. Mix in spaghetti sauce and spices. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. In 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan spread 1/4 of the meat sauce. Layer noodles meat sauce cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese (alternating layers). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Green Bean And Snow Pea Salad
instructions: Bring water and 1 teaspoon salt to boil. Add green beans and cook 2 minutes. Add snow peas and cook 30 seconds. Drain and rinse with cold water. Whisk vinegar 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper in bowl. Add oil and whisk thoroughly. Add beans peas and onion/pepper. Toss coating all ingredients. Serve at room temperature. May be prepared ahead and refrigerated.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Place ground beef in 4-quart saucepan; brown in oil. Add garlic and oregano. Place frozen spinach on top of beef on medium heat until spinach thaws. Pour in mushrooms (drained). Pour in cheese. Mix all together. Turn off heat. Mix sour cream and soup together. Add to mixture and stir. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Baked Onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a 1-quart saucepan at medium heat add butter honey and salt. In greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish arrange onion slices pour honey mixture over onions. Bake for 45 minutes until onions are fork tender and golden brown. Vidalia onions are best.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain fruit saving 3 tablespoons juice. Mix fruit and cheese. Combine flour and sugar; mix with fruit mixture. Pour into buttered 1-quart casserole dish. Mix butter and crackers until crumbly; spread over top. Pour remaining juice over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Brush mayonnaise on each piece of chicken then roll in bread crumbs. Place in foiled 9 x 13-inch pan and cover with foil. Bake approximately 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: My Favorite Bread Pudding
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat butter eggs and sugar until smooth. Add evaporated milk whole milk and vanilla. Cut French bread into small pieces and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle lightly with tap water (avoid soaking). With large spoon stir into bread pieces the egg and milk mixture. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until nicely browned. Delicious hot or cold alone or with someone.

title: Raspberry Souffle
instructions: Thaw berries (reserve some for garnish wrap in foil and return to freezer). Soften gelatin in cold water. Combine raspberries gelatin 2 tablespoons sugar and lemon juice. Heat to dissolve gelatin. Add almond extract and cool this until consistency of egg whites. Beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar until stiff. Whip cream; reserve 1/4 cup. Fold egg whites and whipped cream into raspberries. Pour into 1-quart souffle dish which may be extended with a wax paper collar. Refrigerate until serving time. Garnish with whipped cream and reserved berries.

title: Homemade Subs
instructions: Place bread on baking sheet and spray bread with cooking oil and sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Bake as directed. Let cool. Slice bread open and pour Italian dressing on both sides of bread then layer ham cheese roast beef lettuce and tomato. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cut into 4 pieces. Makes about 16 subs. May also use your favorite meats.

title: Green Chili Enchiladas
instructions: Cook tortillas in hot oil (about 15 seconds on each side). Place 2 tablespoons cheese and 1 tablespoon onion on each and roll. Place in flat 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Saute 1/4 cup onion in oil or oleo. Add flour and stir in broth. Cook until thick. Add sour cream and chiles. Continue cooking until this is heated. Pour mixture over rolled tortillas. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chips into a casserole dish. Top with chips. Cook at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until bubbly and done!

title: Spoon Burgers
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and drain. Add onion soup and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Stir until thickened. Spoon over hamburger buns.

title: Salsa Dip
instructions: Combine ingredients and refrigerate. Dip with your favorite taco chips or fresh vegetables.

title: O'Ma'S Pie Crust
instructions: Mix. Put in pie plate. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all by hand not a mixer. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Rumaki
instructions: Cut deveined livers in half and cook in oil over medium heat until no longer red. Remove skillet. Add soy sauce lemon juice and garlic. Let cool. Combine one piece of liver with a water chestnut half; roll bacon round the two and secure with toothpick. Broil when ready to serve until bacon is crisp.

title: Orange Delight
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs margarine and sugar; save 3/4 cup for topping and put rest in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook over medium heat until thickened. Remove from heat and pour in 1 baked pie shell.

title: 1890 Chicken And Macaroni Supper
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until almost tender about 12 minutes; drain. Place 1/3 of macaroni on bottom of 2-quart lightly greased casserole. Top with 1/2 the chicken pieces; dot chicken with 1/2 the butter salt pepper and 1/2 the chicken broth. Repeat layers ending with remaining 1/3 of macaroni on top. Pour cream over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Hot Ham Sandwiches For A Crowd
instructions: Make a paste of margarine onion poppy seeds mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Spread the paste on the cut surfaces of both halves of each bun. Stack ham and cheese equally on the 10 buns. Wrap each sandwich in completely in a square of aluminum foil and place on a cookie sheet. At this point the sandwiches may be kept in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Bake sandwiches for 20 minutes at 275\u00b0. May be doubled. Serves 10.

title: Cheese Loaf
instructions: Grate cheeses. Mix in flour and slightly beaten eggs. Add milk and butter. Mix. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chinese Pickled Beets
instructions: I was walking down lifes highway a long time ago. One day I saw a sign that read \Heavens Grocery Store.\ As I got a little closer the door came open wide and when I came to myself I was standing inside. I saw a host of angels. They were standing everywhere. Everything a Christian needed was in that grocery store and all you couldnt carry you could come back the next day for more. First I got some patience. Love was in the same row; further down was understanding - you need that everywhere you go. I got a box or two of wisdom and a bag or two of faith. I just couldnt miss the Holy Spirit for He was all over the place. I stopped to get some strength and courage to help me run the race. By then my basket was getting full but I remembered I needed some grace. I didnt forget salvation for salvation was free so I tried to get enough of that to save both you and me. Then I started up to the counter to pay my grocery bill for I thought I had everything to do my Masters will. As I went up the aisle I saw a prayer and I just had to put it in for I knew when I stepped outside I would run into sin. Peace and joy were plentiful they were on the last shelf. Song and praise were hanging near so I just helped myself. Then I said to the angel \How much do I owe?\ He just smiled and said \Just take them everywhere you go.\ Again I smiled at him and said \How much do I really owe?\ He smiled again and said \My child Jesus paid your bill a long time ago.\

title: Edible Aquarium(Children'S Recipe)
instructions: First dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water. Combine cold water and ice cubes to make 1 1/4 cups ice and water. Add to gelatin stirring until slightly thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. If mixture is still thin refrigerate until slightly thickened.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Mix strawberries and jello; set aside. Mix pudding with milk. After it thickens add sour cream and Cool Whip. Layer vanilla wafers strawberries and pudding mix in a deep dish.

title: Oatmeal Cookies(No Bake)
instructions: In saucepan put butter milk sugar and cocoa. Heat to rolling boil. Cook 4 minutes. Add peanut butter and oatmeal; mix in vanilla. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Let cool. Eat.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix butter and bread crumbs. Sprinkle half on bottom of pan. Cook sliced squash 5 to 10 minutes. Mix soup carrots and sour cream. Place layer of squash over buttered bread crumbs and then the soup mixture. Alternate layers. Sprinkle top with remaining bread crumb mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots in water and bouillon cube until soft. Melt oleo and add onions cubed cheese milk and sour cream. Stir until cheese melts. Pour over carrots. Place in greased casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and parsley flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Ernie'S Pork And Corn Stuffing Bake
instructions: Do not use fewer chops as the moisture from the chops is required for the stuffing and to sufficiently cover the stuffing when cooking to hold in the moisture.

title: Spinach Frittata
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given and pour into baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. To make individual servings bake in muffin pans.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream the sugar and oil together. Add eggs and pumpkin. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with water. Pour into 2 well-greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour until tests done with a toothpick. Let stand 10 minutes. Turn from pan to cool.

title: My Favorite Stew
instructions: Brown meat. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook all day!

title: Munch Mix
instructions: Combine butter and dressing mix. Stir in nuts pretzel and cereal. Microwave on high for 2 min. (heat through). Serve warm.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Boil zucchini about 5 minutes. Saute carrots and onions in 4 tablespoons butter. Mix zucchini carrots cream of chicken soup sour cream and 1 1/2 cups stuffing mix and pour into a baking dish. Saute 1 cup stuffing mix with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Breakfast Cinnamon Pinwheels
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and sugar together. Cut in shortening. Add enough milk to make a soft dough. Turn out on a lightly floured board. Knead together 1/2 minute. Roll oblong to 1/4-inch thick. Spread with soft margarine. Stir cinnamon sugar and nuts together. Sprinkle over dough. Roll up tightly like a jelly roll. Cut in 3/4-inch slices. Arrange cut side down on greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. (While still hot frost with thin powdered sugar icing.) Best served warm.

title: Nut Crunch
instructions: Place nuts in shallow baking dish. Toast in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Add sugar and salt. Continue beating until stiff peaks form. Fold in nuts. Melt butter in jelly roll pan; spread nut mixture over butter. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 stirring every 10 minutes. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Hawaiian Pie
instructions: Combine pineapple sugar and flour and cook 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Dissolve jello and gelatin in 1/4 cup hot water. Add to pineapple mixture and cool. Add cherries nuts bananas and coconut. Put into 3 baked pie shells and put in refrigerator to set for 1 hour or more. Serve with whipped cream!

title: Emma'S Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Pour cottage cheese into a mixing bowl add dry jello and fruit. This makes enough salad to refill the containers.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook carrots until crisp drain. Place in 1-quart casserole. Combine mayonnaise onion horseradish sauce and pepper. Mix with carrots. Mix cracker crumbs with oleo. Sprinkle on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all the items listed. Chill and serve.

title: Pink Cloud Congealed Salad
instructions: Heat crushed pineapple. Add jello and mix well. Let cool to room temperature. Add cream cheese softened and blended with the milk. Fold in Cool Whip or prepared Dream Whip.

title: New England Christmas Eve Seafood Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook seafoods and peas. Cut scallops in half also shrimp if they are large. Cook rice 30 minutes. Saute green pepper onions and mushrooms. Mix together mayonnaise curry powder and worcestershire. Combine with peas seafood salt and pepper. Place in lightly greased 3 qt. casserole and bake for 35 minutes.

title: Orient-Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into frying parts. Mix flour and seasonings together in a bag. Shake well. In a large frying pan melt margarine on low heat. Brown chicken on both sides. Place in a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Bambino'S
instructions: Place Melba toast rounds on tray. Squeeze a blob of ketchup (nickle size) on each round. Take oregano and sprinkle over whole tray of rounds. Proceed by putting a slice of pepperoni on rounds gently pushing it down so that ketchup spreads it out without running over the edge. Then sprinkle 3 to 4 pieces of grated Mozzarella on each slice of pepperoni. Put in 400\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 minutes. Make sure cheese is fully melted. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Laura'S Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put all ingredients in a large bowl and stir well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 inch pan and spread to cover the bottom evenly. Bake 22 to 25 minutes. This is a semi-fluffy yet chewy brownie about 1 inch thick. For a thicker chewier brownie add less water using just enough to mix well. Do not overcook or it will be hard and dry.

title: Fruit Fix
instructions: Put all fruits in a large pot. Cover with apple juice add cinnamon. Cook on medium-low until fruit is soft. Puree fruit mixture in food processor until smooth. Store in refrigerator in a mason jar. Use on crackers toast in plain yogurt oatmeal anything youd use preserves for. This is a very good source of Bioflavonoid and Vitamin C.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix and press in bottom of oblong pan butter or oleo cake mix and eggs. Blend the following on low speed in mixer and pour over the mixture 2 eggs cream cheese powdered sugar and butter flavoring. Bake 35 minutes or until golden brown in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Grate cheeses. Mix all ingredients together. This makes 2 balls. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Add pepper onion and mushroom soup. Cook and drain noodles. Add pepperoni and beef mixture. Stir in spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add salad dressing water and vanilla. Beat at medium or high speed until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in greased and floured 8 x 12-inch pan.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or dish in oven. Mix biscuit mix paprika salt and pepper. Coat chicken. Place in pan skin sides down. Bake 35 minutes and turn. Bake until tender about 15 more minutes.

title: Quick Deli Dills
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a rolling boil. Put dill in bottom of crock. Put garlic in bottom of crock. Put pickles on top. Add boiling brine to cover cukes. Put a plate over cukes to hold them under the brine. Cover crock with a towel. Check in 3 to 4 days to see if they look like pickles. Put in jars and cover with the brine. Store in fridge.

title: Mixed Vegetable Dish
instructions: Combine ingredients and put into 2-quart casserole dish. Top with croutons and sprinkle with butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie(For Chocolate Lovers!)
instructions: Melt butter chocolate chips and milk over low heat. Stir. Mix and add sugar flour and salt. Add eggs vanilla and pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix in all ingredients except the Cool Whip. Put the Cool Whip in last. Place the salad in the refrigerator to chill.

title: Brownies
instructions: In saucepan melt butter. Stir together sugar flour cocoa salt soda and oil. Add this mixture to butter. Stir until smooth. Add eggs vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 34 to 40 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Easy Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lime juice. Add Cool Whip. Mix well. Pour into pie crust. Chill for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix peanuts sugar Karo and salt in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Put in the microwave and cook for 7 to 8 minutes. Stir after 4 minutes. Add oleo and vanilla. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more. Take out and add soda gently stirring. Pour on a cookie sheet.

title: Chicken Burritos
instructions: Mix soup sour cream onion and cheese in bowl. Add mixture to chicken. Put about 2 tablespoons of mixture in tortilla and roll. Add remaining mixture on top of rolled tortillas. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Beef Steak Pie With Potato Crust
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut meat into 1-inch cubes. Coat with flour. Melt shortening. Brown meat on all sides. Add onions. Cook and stir until onions are tender. Pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons flour salt pepper thyme and garlic salt. Pour water over mixture. Cover and bake 45 to 60 minutes until meat is tender. Increase oven temperature to 450\u00b0. Arrange potatoes on meat. Sprinkle with salt and paprika. Bake uncovered 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Bake
instructions: Beat and pour into greased baking pan.

title: Quick Corn Chowder
instructions: Combine bacon and onion in 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High (100%) until bacon is crisp and onion is tender 4 to 6 minutes stirring after half the cooking time. Blend in flour. Stir in corn milk parsley salt and pepper. Microwave on High (100%) until slightly thickened and corn is tender 7 to 12 minutes stirring twice during cooking time.

title: Cranberry Orange Relish
instructions: In a food processor chop fine the cranberries and transfer to bowl. In the processor chop fine the oranges including rind; add them to the cranberries along with the sugar and orange juice. Combine well. Chill covered overnight and stir again before serving.

title: Cornmeal Pie
instructions: Mix and pour into pie shell. Bake 40 minutes.

title: Martha Washington Candy
instructions: Mix well the margarine condensed milk sugar and vanilla. Add nuts. Roll into balls. Melt chocolate and paraffin wax in double boiler. Coat balls with this mixture and place on wax paper.

title: Salami
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in a covered bowl in refrigerator. On the second day mix and return to refrigerator. Third day do the same procedure. Fourth day form into three rolls place on broiler rack and bake 6 hours at 150\u00b0 and 2 hours at 200\u00b0 turning every 2 hours.

title: Frozen Pumpkin Squares
instructions: Combine in large mixing bowl and mix the pumpkin sugar salt ginger cinnamon and nutmeg. Scoop in with spoon the vanilla ice cream while mixing slowly. When mixed well add chopped pecans. Spread small amount of ice cream mixture over bottom of pan then line bottom of pan with gingersnap cookies. Cover with ice cream mixture. Put another layer of gingersnap cookies. Add remaining ice cream mixture over top. Freeze until firm (about 5 hours or overnight). Cut into squares; garnish with whipped topping and toasted pecan pieces.

title: All-Bran Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: In large bowl mix shortening water sugar All-Bran and salt. Let stand until lukewarm. Beat eggs; stir into lukewarm ingredients. Stir in yeast dissolved in water. Add 3 cups whole wheat and 3 cups white flour stirring as added. Never use more than 7 cups. Brush top with melted butter and cover tightly with wax paper. Place in refrigerator for several hours or days.

title: Beacon Hill Cookies
instructions: Beat egg whites and salt until foams. Add sugar then beat until peaks foam. Add vanilla and vinegar. Melt chocolate chips and add walnuts. Fold into the above mixture.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Blend milk lemon juice lemon extract and 2 eggs yolks. Pour into crust. Beat 3 egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Add sugar then beat until stiff. Spread on pie. Seal edges by dipping fingers into a little water and running over exposed pie crust to crystalize it. Bake at 325 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 1 hour then refrigerate.

title: Dump Salad
instructions: Dump all ingredients together and mix. Chill overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Mix flour and baking powder in a bowl. Add peanut butter and sugar; mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Serve on warm hamburger rolls.

title: Basil-Tomato Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender; process until smooth. Pour into a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring ocasionally. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Yields 1 1/3 cups.

title: Western Lima Bean Bake
instructions: Cook beans and drain. Brown ground beef; add onion bell pepper and tomato sauce. Put beans in casserole dish and top with meat. Can add thin layer of cornbread on top and you can add cheese before cornbread (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Press 1/2 of the crushed crackers chopped pecans and melted butter mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together softened ice cream milk and instant pudding. Pour over crust. Refrigerate 1/2 hour. Spread Cool Whip then sprinkle on remaining crumb mixture. Refrigerate. Can be made in any combination of flavors.

title: Skewered Grilled Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes and water in 2-quart casserole dish. Microwave on High 12 to 15 minutes stirring after 8 minutes; drain. Mix remaining ingredients. Stir in potatoes; cover. Refrigerate 1 hour. Drain reserving salad dressing mixture. Arrange potatoes on skewers. Place on grill over hot coals. Grill covered for 4 minutes. Rotate skewers; brush with reserved salad dressing mixture. Continue grilling 4 minutes.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
instructions: Place meat in pot. Mix flour tapioca and pepper; pour over meat. Stir to coat meat with flour. Add remaining ingredients; stir to mix well. Cover; cook on low for 10 to 12 hours (or on high for 4 to 6 hours). Stir stew thoroughly before serving.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Make cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let cook and cut into bite-size pieces. Cook pudding as directed using evaporated milk (whole milk and liqueur of choice in the amounts listed). Chill until set.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Stir together sugar and syrup in a 2-quart microwave dish. Microwave on 100% for 4 minutes; stir in peanuts. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Will be light brown. Add butter and vanilla. Cook 1 1/2 minutes. Add soda and stir gently. Pour on greased baking sheet. Let cool at room temperature. Break into pieces (do not double recipe).

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook noodles until done. Cut all vegetables up small in a large bowl. When noodles are done drain and mix with vegetables. Add salad dressing to vegetable mixture then add salad seasoning. Mix well. Cool for about 6 hours and serve.

title: My Mama'S Old Fashioned Dumplings
instructions: Sift dry ingredients in bowl. Blend in butter egg and milk to make a fairly stiff dough. Roll on floured dough board cut into squares and drop into boiling broth (in which chicken was cooked). Cook 20 minutes and dont lift cover while cooking!

title: Pizza Sauce
instructions: Blend in blender the hot peppers garlic and onions. Add to juice. Cook 2 to 3 hours then add 3 small cans of tomato paste. Cook until thickened. Then fill hot jars and seal.

title: White Sangria
instructions: Combine all ingredients; chill. Add ice before serving.

title: Homemade Beef Jerky
instructions: Slice meat lengthwise with the grain into 1/4-inch pieces. Combine remaining ingredients and mix with meat strips. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and arrange in a single layer on a rack set in shallow baking pan. Bake in 150\u00b0 oven or at lowest oven temperature for at least 12 hours. Store in airtight container. Better than store bought.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: In large bowl combine broccoli rice soup Velveeta and 1 cup onions; mix well. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top with remaining onions and continue baking 5 minutes.

title: Pineapple Coconut Angel Flake Pie
instructions: Mix together and place in unbaked pie crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or longer. Test with toothpick to make sure center is done.

title: Spectacular Dessert
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients; press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown about 12 to 15 minutes. Blend and spread over the crust the cream cheese powdered sugar and nondairy topping. Mix instant pudding and milk and spread over previous mixture. Chill for 30 minutes. Spread remaining topping on top and sprinkle with chopped nuts. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Sour Cream Elderberry Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0. Bake for 40 minutes or more. Test with knife.

title: Sweet Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Pour in melted butter and egg and mix with milk. Bake at 425\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Party Mix
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Mix together remaining ingredients. Pour over dry ingredients and mix well. Bake on cookie sheets in 300\u00b0 oven until light brown. Drain on paper towels. Store in airtight containers.

title: Bierocks(Hamburger And Cabbage Squares)
instructions: In large pot brown and crumble hamburger; add chopped onion and cook over low heat. Add finely cut up cabbage and a little water. Simmer with lid on for 45 minutes or longer; add seasoning. Meanwhile prepare hot roll mix according to directions on box and let rise (or make bread dough from your own recipe). After risen punch down; divide into half. Roll half out into rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Cut in 6 squares. Place in each square a large spoonful of cabbage mixture cooled and drained. Fold up corners to middle and squeeze dough together to seal. Bake on cookie sheet in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until brown. This recipe was given to me by my grandmother. These have been sold in grocery store deli in Russell Kansas.

title: Cayman Islands Raspberry Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour scalded cream over bread. Blend sugar eggs vanilla and cinnamon in blender. Pour over bread and let soak 30 minutes. Fold in raspberries and pour into buttered Pyrex dish or spring-form pan. Bake in water bath for 1 hour until puffy and firm.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.\tBake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Onion Kuchen Bread
instructions: Separate onions into rings. Saute in butter in heavy skillet over low heat until transparent. Spray round cake pan with Pam. Place biscuits in cake pan. Spoon onion mixture on top of biscuits. Combine egg sour cream and salt. Spoon over onion mixture. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until topping is set. Slice in wedges. Serve warm.

title: Better Than Ever Cake
instructions: Bake cake. Punch holes while hot with end of wooden spoon. Boil pineapple and sugar. Pour over cake. Let cool. Layer pudding. Mix Cool Whip coconut and pecans. Spread over cake. Let set 24 hours.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Add milk and flour alternately. Roll nuts dates and candy in flour; add along with coconut to batter. Bake in tube pan (greased and floured) at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Yugoslav Vineyard Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly oil large shallow (3-quart) casserole. In large bowl combine potatoes eggplant green pepper zucchini onion carrots parsley and peas. Season with 1/3 cup olive oil salt Tabasco and black pepper. Toss well. Place half of sliced tomatoes in bottom of prepared casserole. Cover with half of diced vegetables. Sprinkle rice over vegetables. Cover with remaining vegetables. Cover with remaining sliced tomatoes. Pour 3 tablespoons olive oil vinegar and water. Bake covered 1 3/4 to 2 hours until vegetables are tender. Uncover. Top with cheese. Place under broiler 2 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut meat into strips. Heat oil; add meat and brown. Add onions and garlic. Add other seasonings tomato puree and water. Cover and simmer until meat is tender about 1 hour. Add strips of green peppers and cook 15 minutes longer. Serve on noodles or rice.

title: Smoked Salmon Dip
instructions: Have cream cheese at room temperature. Mix all ingredients together in electric mixer.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Top with milk mixed with Bisquick. Put in ungreased baking dish. Bake 27 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Lemon Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and lemon extract. Add 3 cups flour and baking powder. Mix 1 cup flour with fruit. Add fruit and nuts to other mixture. Bake 2 hours and 15 minutes at 250\u00b0.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Grease 9-inch pan. Soften cheese at room temperature and beat in large bowl until fluffy. Gradually add sugar and eggs; beat well after each one. Fold in vanilla and sour cream. Bake 35 minutes at 375\u00b0. Turn off oven and leave cake in oven for 1 hour. Chill after cake has cooled.

title: Barbecue Potato Salad
instructions: Marinate first 5 ingredients in dill pickle juice for at least 1 hour or overnight. Chop potatoes into small squares and mix all ingredients with barbecue sauce and mayonnaise; then refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Salt Free Lemon Sauce
instructions: In saucepan over low heat combine sugar and cornstarch. Slowly add the cold water and mix well. Bring the mixture to a boil and add the butter lemon juice and grated lemon rind. Continue to boil slowly until sauce becomes thick and opaque about 10 minutes. Delicious over plain cake or meringue cake.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Mix celery mustard seed salt vinegar and sugar; heat until dissolved (do not boil). Cool and pour over cucumbers. Put in refrigerator. Will keep for 4 months in refrigerator.

title: Granola(Kids Recipe)
instructions: In a large bowl mix dry ingredients. Combine oil honey and vanilla in a saucepan and warm. Add these to the dry ingredients and stir until all the particles are coated. (Hand mixing works well here). Spread this mixture in a long low pan or rimmed baking sheet that has been sprayed with vegetable shortening. Bake at 250\u00b0 for an hour turning with spatula every 15 minutes. When finished toasting add raisins and toss. Cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Corn Meal Catfish
instructions: Combine egg and water in pie plate until blended. Spoon flour onto waxed paper; combine cornmeal cheese basil and salt on second piece of waxed paper. Dredge fish in flour dip in egg then roll in corn meal mixture to coat. Heat 2 teaspoons of oil in large skillet. Place 2 fillets in skillet. Cook first side 4 to 5 minutes until golden brown. Turn and cook other side 4 to 5 minutes. Remove from skillet. Repeat with remaining fillets.

title: Peaches And Cream Pie(This Is Scrumptious!)
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Vanilla Extract
instructions: Score vanilla beans and drop into vodka. Tightly seal bottle and store in dark cool dry place i.e. pantry. Wait 6 months and voila pure vanilla extract.

title: Georgia Torte
instructions: Finely crush graham crackers. Combine and mix with remaining ingredients. Turn into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Red Tomato Relish
instructions: Cook until tender and seal in sterilized jars. Do not over cook.

title: Red Hot Cinnamon Cider
instructions: In 1-quart saucepan combine juice or cider and candies. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes or until candies dissolve. Serve hot or cold. If desired garnish with apple wedge or cinnamon stick stirrer.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt 1/2 oleo in casserole dish and put rest on top.

title: Milk Chocolate Bar Cake
instructions: Prepare cake batter according to package directions. Pour into prepared pans and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes. Cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes. Remove from pans and cool completely.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Chop onion and green pepper. Combine with brown sugar ketchup mustard Worcestershire and bacon in a 2-quart casserole dish. Drain beans then stir beans into mixture. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Pueblo Green Chili Stew
instructions: In large Dutch oven or deep skillet with lid lightly brown pork cubes in oil over medium-high heat. Add remaining ingredients; cover and simmer for 1 hour. Serve hot with fresh flour or corn tortillas. Makes 8 servings.

title: Microwave Rhubarb Sauce
instructions: Cook rhubarb and water in microwave 5 minutes on High power. Add jello and sugar; cook 2 minutes longer. Chill and serve.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Milkshake
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Pour into glasses and enjoy.

title: All Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In bowl mix the sugar and fruit. Pour butter into an 8 x 11-inch dish and put in oven to melt. Sift the flour baking powder and salt together and stir in milk to make batter. Pour batter in melted butter. Quickly spoon fruit and juices over batter. Return to oven and bake about 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Mix flour leavenings salt and spices in large bowl. Cream shortening and sugar until light. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Mix molasses and 2 cups water. Add alternately with dry ingredients to the creamed mixture beating until smooth. Pour into 2 greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven about 35 minutes. Serve hot with whipped cream. Makes 24 servings.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Brown sausage well and add the rest and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in single layer in shallow baking pan. Pour dressing over chicken. Dot with margarine. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Margaret Kalb'S Banana Cake
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in eggs just until combined. Mix in bananas and buttermilk. Sift together flour and soda and add to mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes until cake tests done.

title: Easy Skillet Goulash
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and drain. Return it to skillet. Add soups and sauce and stir until thickened. Add corn olives and cheese. Stir and let simmer. In the meantime cook pasta. Drain and add to meat and vegetable mixture. Stir until blended. Sprinkle additional grated Cheddar cheese and let simmer until cheese is melted.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix all together and put in graham cracker crust. Chill 1 hour.

title: Monastery Pumpkin Bread
instructions: In a bowl mix together flour sugar baking soda cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Break eggs into mixture. Add the oil and water. Mix until all ingredients are combined. Add pumpkin and mix. Dont overmix. Pour batter into 2 pans (10 1/4 x 3 5/8 x 2 5/8). Sprinkle chopped walnuts over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hour. Turn out on rack to cool.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Cut angel cake into bite-size pieces. Place 1/2 of cake in bottom of rectangular glass dish. Spread pie filling over cake. Put remaining 1/2 of cake pieces on top of filling. Mix pudding and milk then fold in sour cream. Spread this over cake pieces and top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for several hours before serving. A 9 x 13-inch pan is recommended.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Cook 1 hour the water chicken breasts 1 carrot 1 onion 1 teaspoon salt basil peppercorns 1 rib of celery garlic thyme and parsley. Skim foam. Refrigerate chicken. Skim fat.

title: Citrus Sage Chicken Breasts
instructions: Rinse chicken breasts; pat dry and place in shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour 1/2 of mixture over chicken. Bake 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Turn each piece and cover with remaining sauce; bake 15 to 20 minutes longer until done. Yields 8 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil noodles in leftover chicken broth. When done add chicken Ro-Tel and soup. Mix well. Add cheese; simmer until melted.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Melt shortening in skillet. Brown pork chops on both sides. Drain butter beans reserving juice. Arrange beans in 1 1/2-quart casserole in alternate layers with onion. Sprinkle salt and pepper over layers. Add reserved juice from beans and catsup to skillet in which pork chops were browned. Arrange pork chops on top of beans in casserole. Pour liquid over chops. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours until chops are tender. Serves 4.

title: Good Corn Bread
instructions: Beat the eggs and corn bread mix and the corn. Brown sausage in skillet. In a large skillet pour half the corn bread mixture and put the sausage over it. Place chopped peppers over sausage and the cheese over this. Put the rest of the corn bread mixture on top covering the sausage mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Makes 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan or 2 (8-inch)\tlayers. Grease and flour pans. Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well mixed. Batter will be very liquid; pour into pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Drain whole corn. Mix everything together except cheese. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Top with cheese and serve.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage. Melt cheese and tomatoes in microwave for 8 minutes. Mix sausage and cheese sauce together. Microwave for another 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Serve with chips.

title: Curried Chicken Balls
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in chicken green onions and celery. Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in nuts. Chill up to 2 days or freeze up to 1 month. Yield 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix together powdered sugar and peanut butter until it is like crumbs. Sprinkle in bottom of baked pie shell reserving a small amount for top of pie. Cook pudding as directed adding lightly beaten egg yolks and milk. Cool and pour into pie shell. Beat egg whites to peaks. Add sugar gradually. Cover pie with meringue and sprinkle with reserved peanut mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Minute Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in sauce for about an hour.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Coat Bundt pan with shortening and flour. Add batter and topping alternately. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together sugar shortening bananas and eggs. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake in well-greased pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Iowa Potato Casserole
